And he who intended to put on Ihram for `Umra only may do so. `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on Ihram for Hajj and some people did that along with him. And some people put on Ihram for `Umra and Hajj (both), and some persons put on Ihram for `Umra only, and I was among those who put on Ihram for `Umra (only).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah nikle. Unhone kaha: Jo tum mein se Hajj aur Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahe woh aisa kare. Aur jo Hajj ke liye ehram baandhna chahe woh kar sakta hai. Aur jo sirf Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahe woh kar sakta hai. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha aur kuch logon ne unke saath aisa kiya. Aur kuch logon ne Umra aur Hajj dono ke liye ehram baandha, aur kuch logon ne sirf Umra ke liye ehram baandha, aur main unmein se thi jinhone sirf Umra ke liye ehram baandha.

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (in his) Farewell Pilgrimage near the time of the appearance of the new moon of Dhul-Hijja. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who amongst you intends to put on Ihram for `Umra may do so; had I not brought sacrificial animals along with me, I would have put on Ihram for `Umra. She (further said). There were some persons who put on Ihram for `Umra, and some persons who put on Ihram for Hajj, and I was one of those who put on Ihram for `Umra. We went on till we reached Mecca, and on the day of `Arafa I found myself in a state of menses, but I did not put off the Ihram for `Umra. I told about (this state of mine) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Abandon your `Umra, and undo the hair of your head and comb (them), and put on Ihram for Hajj. She (`A'isha) said: I did accordingly. When it was the night at Hasba and Allah enabled us to complete our Hajj, he (the Holy Prophet) sent with me `Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr, and he mounted me behind him on his camel and took me to Tan`im and I put on Ihram for `Umra, and thus Allah enabled us to complete our Hajj and `Umra and (we were required to observe) neither sacrifice nor alms nor fasting.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Vida ke Hajj mein Zul-Hijja ke naye chaand nikalne ke qareeb nikle. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo tum mein se Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahe woh kar sakta hai; agar main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na laata, to main Umra ke liye ehram baandhta. Unhone aage kaha: Kuch log the jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha, aur kuch log jinhone Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, aur main un logon mein se ek thi jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha. Hum aage badhte rahe yahan tak ki hum Makkah pahunche, aur Arafa ke din maine khud ko haiz ki halat mein paaya, lekin maine Umra ka ehram nahi utaara. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is apni halat ke baare mein bataya, isper unhone kaha: Apni Umra chhod do, aur apne sar ke baal khol do aur kanghi karo, aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandho. Unhone kaha: Maine aisa hi kiya. Jab Hasba ki raat thi aur Allah ne humein apna Hajj mukammal karne mein saksham banaya, unhone mere saath Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko bheja, aur unhone mujhe apne oont par apne peeche sawaar kiya aur mujhe Tan'im le gaye aur maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha, aur is tarah Allah ne humein apna Hajj aur Umra mukammal karne mein saksham banaya aur na to isper humein qurbaani chahiye thi na sadaqa na roza.

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: We set out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) just at the appearance of the new moon of Dhul- Hijja. We had no other intention but that of performing the Hajj, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who among you intends to put on Ihram for `Umra should do so for `Umra. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Zul-Hijja ke naye chaand nikalne par nikle. Hamara koi doosra iraada nahi tha siwaay Hajj karne ke, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo tum mein se Umra ke liye ehram baandhna chahe use Umra ke liye aisa karna chahiye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at the appearance of the new moon of Dhu'l-Hijja. There were amongst us those who had put on Ihram for Umra, and those also who had put on Ihram both for Hajj and Umra, and still those who had put on Ihram for Hajj (alone). I was one of those who had put on Ihram for. Umra (only). 'Urwa (one of the narrators) said: Allah enabled her (A'isha) to complete both Hajj and Umra (according to the way as mentioned above). Hisham (one of the narrators) said: She had neither the sacrificial animal nor (was she required to) fast, nor (was she obliged to give) alms.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Zul-Hijja ke naye chaand nikalne par nikle. Hummein se kuch aise the jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha, aur woh bhi jinhone Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye ehram baandha tha, aur ab bhi woh jinhone Hajj akela ke liye ehram baandha tha. Main un logon mein se ek thi jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha tha, sirf. Urwa, raawiyon mein se ek, ne kaha: Allah ne unhe, Aisha ko, Hajj aur Umra dono mukammal karne mein saksham banaya, upar bataye gaye tareeke ke mutabik. Hisham, ek raawi, ne kaha: Unke paas na qurbaani ka jaanwar tha na unhe roza rakhna zaroori tha, na unpar zaroorat thi sadaqa dene ki.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: We proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. There were those amongst us who had put on Ihram for Umra, and those who had put on Ihram both for Hajj and" Umra, and those amongst us who had put on Ihram for Hajj (only), while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had put on Ihram for Hajj (only). He who put on Ihram for Umra put it off (after performing Umra), and he who had put on Ihram for Hajj or for both Hajj and 'Umra did not put it off before the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Vida ke Hajj ke saal aage badhe. Hummein se aise log the jinhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha, aur aise bhi jinhone Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye ehram baandha, aur hummein se aise the jinhone sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha tha. Jisne Umra ke liye ehram baandha usne ise utaar diya, Umra karne ke baad, aur jisne Hajj ke liye ya Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye ehram baandha usne ise qurbaani ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, se pehle nahi utaara.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: We proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with no other intention but that of performing the Hajj. As I was at Sarif or near it, I entered in the state of menses. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to me and I was weeping, whereupon he said: Are you in a state of menses? I said. Yes. whereupon he said: This is what Allah has ordained for all the daughters, of Adam. Do whatever the pilgrim does. except that you should not circumambulate the House till you have washed yourself (at the end of the menses period). And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered sacrifice of a cow on behalf of his wives.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aage badhe bina kisi aur iraade ke siwaay Hajj karne ke. Jab main Sarif mein ya uske qareeb thi, mujhe haiz ki halat aa gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur main ro rahi thi, isper unhone kaha: Kya tum haiz ki halat mein ho? Maine kaha: Haan, isper unhone kaha: Ye woh hai jo Allah ne Aadam ki saari betiyon ke liye muqarrar kiya hai. Woh sab karo jo ek haaji karta hai, siwaay is baat ke ki tumhe Ghar, Kaaba, ka tawaaf tab tak nahi karna chahiye jab tak tum khud ko dho na lo, haiz ki muddat khatam hone par. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ki taraf se ek gaay ki qurbaani di.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with no other aim but that of Hajj till we came (to the place known as) Sarif; and there I entered in the state of menses. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me while I was weeping. He said: What makes you weep? I said: Would that I had not come (for Pilgrimage) this year. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What has happened to you? You have perhaps entered the period of menses. I said: Yes. He said: This is what has been ordained for the daughters of Adam. Do what a pilgrim does except that you should not circumambulate the House, till you are purified (of the menses). She ('A'isha) said: When I came to Mecca, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his companions: Make this (Ihram) the Ihram for 'Umra. So the people put off Ihram except those who had sacrificial animals with them. She ('A'isha) said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) had the sacrificial animal with him, and so had Abu Bakr, 'Umar and other persons of means. They (those who had put off Ihram again) put on Ihram (for Hajj) when they marched (towards Mina), and it was the 8th of Dhu'l-Hijja. She ('A'isha) said: When it was the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), I was purified, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded me and I did the circumambulation of Ifada. She said that the flesh of cow was sent to us. I said: What is it? They said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has offered a cow as sacrifice on behalf of his wives. When it was the night at Hasba, I said: Messenger of Allah, people are coming back from Hajj and Umra, where as I am coming back from Hajj (alone). She (A'isha) reported: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded" Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr to mount me upon his camel behind him. She ('A'isha) said: I was very young and I well remember that I dozed off and my face touched the hind part of the haudaj (camel litter) till we came to Tan'im, and entered into the state of Ihram in lieu of Umra (which I for the time being abandoned) and which the people had performed.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath bina kisi aur maqsad ke siwaay Hajj ke nikle yahan tak ki hum Sarif naam ki jagah pahunche; aur wahan mujhe haiz ki halat aa gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye jab main ro rahi thi. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Maine kaha: Kaash main is saal Hajj ke liye na aati. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Shayad tum haiz ki muddat mein daakhil ho gayi ho. Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Ye woh hai jo Aadam ki betiyon ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Woh karo jo ek haaji karta hai siwaay is baat ke ki tumhe Ghar ka tawaaf tab tak nahi karna chahiye jab tak tum paak na ho jao, haiz se. Unhone kaha: Jab main Makkah pahunchi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne saathiyon se kaha: Ise, ehram ko, Umra ke liye ehram bana lo. To logon ne ehram utaar diya siwaay unke jinke saath qurbaani ke jaanwar the. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas qurbaani ka jaanwar tha, aur Abu Bakr, Umar aur doosre daulatmand logon ke paas bhi tha. Unhone, jinhone ehram utaara tha, phir se ehram baandha jab woh Mina ki taraf march karne lage, aur ye Zul-Hijja ki aathvi tareekh thi. Unhone kaha: Jab qurbaani ka din, 10 Zul-Hijja, tha, main paak ho gayi thi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya aur maine Ifada ka tawaaf kiya. Unhone kaha ki gaay ka gosht humare paas bheja gaya. Maine kaha: Ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ki taraf se ek gaay qurbaan ki hai. Jab Hasba ki raat thi, maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log Hajj aur Umra se wapas aa rahe hain, jabki main sirf Hajj se wapas aa rahi hoon, akele. Unhone kaha: Unhone Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki woh mujhe apne oont par apne peeche sawaar karein. Unhone kaha: Main bahut choti thi aur mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai ki main uunghi aur mera chehra Haudaj, oont ki gaadi, ke peechhle hisse se touch hua, yahan tak ki hum Tan'im pahunche, aur maine Umra ke badle mein ehram baandha, jise maine kuch waqt ke liye chhoda tha, aur jo logon ne kiya tha.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We entered into the state of. Ihram for Hajj till we were at Sarif and I was in menses. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me and I was weeping. The rest of the hadith is the same but (with this portion) that there were sacrificial animals with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and with Abu Bakr, Umar and with rich persons. And they pronounced Talbiya as they proceeded on. And there is no mention of this (too):" I was a girl of tender age and I dozed off and my face touched the bind part of the Haudaj."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha yahan tak ki hum Sarif mein the aur main haiz ki halat mein thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur main ro rahi thi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is hisse ke saath ki qurbaani ke jaanwar Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar aur daulatmand logon ke paas the. Aur unhone Talbiya padhi jab woh aage badhe. Aur iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Main choti umar ki larki thi aur main uunghi aur mera chehra Haudaj ke peechhle hisse se touch hua."

e: 'A'Isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj Afrad.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj Afrad ke liye ehram baandha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) putting on the Ihram for Hajj during the months of Hajj and the night of Hajj till we encamped at Sarif. He (the Holy Prophet) went to his Companions and said: He who has no sacrificial animal with him, in his case I wish that he should perform Umra (with this Ihram), and he who has the sacrificial animal with him should not do it. So some of them performed Hajj whereas others who had no sacrificial animals with them did not do (Hajj, but performed only 'Umra). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a sacrificial animal with him and those too who could afford it (performed) Hajj). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me (i. e. A'isha) while I was weeping, and he said: What makes you weep? I said: I heard your talk with Companions about Umra. He said: What has happened to you? I said: I do not observe prayer (due to the monthly period), whereupon he said: It would not harm you; you should perform (during this time) the rituals of Hajj (which you can do outside the House). Maybe Allah will compensate you for this. You are one among the daughters of Adam and Allah has ordained for you as He has ordained for them. So I proceeded on (with the rituals of Hajj) till we came to Mina. I washed myself and then circumambulated the House, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) encamped at Muhassab and called, Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr. and said: Take out your sister from the precincts of the Ka'ba in order to put on Ihram for Umra and circumambulate the House. and I shall wait for you here. She said: So I went out and put on Ihram and then circumambulated the House, and (ran) between al-Safa and al-Marwa, and then we came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was in his house in the middle of the night. He said: Have you completed your (rituals)? I said: Yes. He then announced to his Companions to march on. He came out, and went to the House and circumambulated it before the dawn prayer and then proceeded to Medina.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj ke mahinon mein aur Hajj ki raat mein Hajj ke liye ehram baandhkar aage badhe yahan tak ki hum Sarif mein theher gaye. Woh apne sahaba ke paas gaye aur kaha: Jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai, uske mamle mein main chahta hoon ki woh Umra kare, isi ehram ke saath, aur jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar hai use aisa nahi karna chahiye. To unmein se kuch ne Hajj kiya jabki doosron ne, jinke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi the, aisa nahi kiya, balki sirf Umra kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas qurbaani ka jaanwar tha aur woh bhi jo isse afford kar sakte the, Hajj kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere, yaani Aisha ke, paas aaye jab main ro rahi thi, aur unhone kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Maine kaha: Maine aapki apne sahaba se Umra ke baare mein baatcheet suni. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Main namaz nahi padh sakti, mahine ke usool ki wajah se, isper unhone kaha: Isse tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hoga; tumhe is waqt Hajj ke riti-rivaz karne chahiye, jo tum Ghar ke bahar kar sakti ho. Shayad Allah tumhe iska muaaviza dega. Tum Aadam ki betiyon mein se ek ho aur Allah ne tumhare liye woh muqarrar kiya hai jo Usne unke liye muqarrar kiya hai. To main aage badhi, Hajj ke riti-rivaz ke saath, yahan tak ki hum Mina pahunche. Maine khud ko dhoya aur phir Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Muhassab mein theher gaye aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko bulaaya, aur kaha: Apni behn ko Kaaba ki seemaon se bahar le jaao taaki woh Umra ke liye ehram baandh sake aur Ghar ka tawaaf kare. Aur main tumhara yahan intezaar karunga. Unhone kaha: To main bahar gayi aur ehram baandha aur phir Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi, aur phir hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur woh aadhi raat ko apne ghar mein the. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne apne riti-rivaz mukammal kar liye? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone phir apne sahaba ko march karne ka ailaan kiya. Woh bahar aaye, aur Ghar ki taraf gaye aur fajr ki namaz se pehle uska tawaaf kiya aur phir Madina ki taraf aage badhe.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Some among us put on Ihram for Hajj alone (Hajj Mufrad) ; some of us for Hajj and Umra together (Qiran), and some of us for Tamattal (first for Umra and after completing it for Hajj).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Hummein se kuch ne sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, Hajj Mufrad; hummein se kuch ne Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye ekasath, Qiran; aur hummein se kuch ne Tamattu ke liye, pehle Umra ke liye, aur ise mukammal karne ke baad Hajj ke liye.

e: AI-Qasim b. Muhammad reported that A'isha had come for Hajj.
hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad ne bayan kiya ki Aisha Hajj ke liye aayi thi.

e: 'Umra reported: I heard A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) five days before the end of Dhi Qa'dah, and we did see but that he intended to perform Hajj (only), but as we came near Mecca the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded that he who did not have the sacrificial animal with him should put off Ihram after circumambulating the House and running between al-Safa and aI-Marwa (and thus convert his Ihram from that of Hajj to 'Umra). 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: The flesh of cow was sent to us on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'I-Hijja). I said. What is this? It was said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sacrificed (the cow) on behalf of his wives. Yahya said: I made a mention of this hadith (what has been stated by Umra) to Qasim b. Muhammad, whereupon be said: By Allah, she has rightly narrated it to you.
hi: Umra ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Zil-Qada ke khatam hone se paanch din pehle nikle, aur humein laga ki unka iraada sirf Hajj karne ka hai, lekin jab hum Makkah ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use Ghar ka tawaaf aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudne ke baad ehram utaar dena chahiye, aur is tarah apne ehram ko Hajj se Umra mein badalna chahiye. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Gaay ka gosht humein qurbaani ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, bheja gaya. Maine kaha: Ye kya hai? Kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ki taraf se gaay ki qurbaani di. Yahya ne kaha: Maine ye hadees, jo Umra ne bataayi, Qasim bin Muhammad ko batayi, isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhone ise tumhe sahi tarah bataaya hai.

e: This hadlth has been narrated by Yahya through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: AI-Qasim narrated from the Mother of the Believers (Hadrat 'A'isha) that she said: Messenger of Allah. the people return (from Mecca) having done two worships (both Hajj and Umra), but I am coming back with one (only). whereupon he said: You should wait and when the period of menses is over, you should go to Tan'im and put on lhram and then meet us at such and such time (and I think he said tomorrow) ; and (the reward of this Umra) is for you equal to your hardship or your spending.
hi: Al-Qasim ne Ummul-Momineen, Hazrat Aisha, se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log Makkah se do ibaadaton, Hajj aur Umra dono, ke saath wapas aa rahe hain, lekin main sirf ek Hajj ke saath wapas aa rahi hoon, isper unhone kaha: Tumhe intezaar karna chahiye aur jab haiz ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, to tumhe Tan'im jaana chahiye aur ehram baandhna chahiye aur phir humse falan-falan waqt mile, aur mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha kal; aur is Umra ka sawaab tumhare liye tumhari mushkil ya tumhare kharche ke barabar hai.

e: Ibn al-Muththanna reported on the authority of Ibn Abu'Adi who transmitted on the authority of Ibn'Aun who narrated from al-Qasim and Ibrahim having said: I cannot differentiate the hadith of one from the other (Qasim and Ibrahim) that the Mother of the Believers (Allah be pleased with her) said this: Messenger of Allah, people have come back with two acts of worship. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn al-Muthanna ne Ibn Abu Adi ki sanad se riwayat ki jinhone Ibn Aun se riwayat ki jinhone al-Qasim aur Ibrahim se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Main ek ki hadees ko doosre se alag nahi kar sakta, Qasim aur Ibrahim, ki Ummul-Momineen (RA) ne ye kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log do ibaadaton ke saath wapas aaye hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we did not see but that he (intended to perform) Hajj (only), but when we reached Mecca we circumambulated the House; and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded that he who did not have with him a sacrificial animal should put off Ihram. She (A'isha) said: (And consequently) those who did not bring the sacrificial animals with them put off Ihram; and among his wives (too) who had not brought the sacrificial animals with them put off Ihram. A'isha said: I entered my period and could not (therefore) circumambulate the House. When it was the night of Hasba she said: Messenger of Allah, people are coming back (after having performed both) Hajj and'Umra, whereas I am coming back only with Hajj, whereupon he said: Did you not circumambulate (the Ka'ba) that very night we entered Mecca? She (A'isha) said: No, whereupon he said: Go along with your brother to Tan'im and put on the Ihram for Umra, and it is at such and such a place that you can meet (us). (In the meanwhile) Safiyya (the wife of the Holy Prophet) said: I think, I will detain you (since I have entered in the monthly) period and you shall have to wait for me for the farewell circuit). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: May you be wounded and your head shorn did you not circumambulate on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja)? She said: Yes. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There is no harm. You should go forward. 'A'isha said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was going upwards to the side of Mecca, whereas I was coming down from it, or I was going upward, whereas he was coming down. Isbiq said: She was climbing down, and he was climbing down.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nikle aur humein laga ki unka iraada sirf Hajj karna hai, lekin jab hum Makkah pahunche to humne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya; aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use ehram utaar dena chahiye. Unhone kaha: Aur natijatan jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi laaye the unhone ehram utaar diya; aur unki zaujaon bhi mein se jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi laayi thin unhone bhi ehram utaar diya. Aisha ne kaha: Mujhe mahine ka usool aa gaya aur is liye main Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kar saki. Jab Hasba ki raat thi unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log Hajj aur Umra dono karke wapas aa rahe hain, jabki main sirf Hajj ke saath wapas aa rahi hoon, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne Kaaba ka tawaaf usi raat nahi kiya tha jab hum Makkah mein daakhil hue the? Unhone kaha: Nahi, isper unhone kaha: Apne bhai ke saath Tan'im jao aur Umra ke liye ehram baandho, aur falan-falan jagah pe tum humse mil sakti ho. Isi dauran Safiyya, Nabi ki zauja, ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai, main tumhe rokungi, kyunki mujhe mahine ka usool aa gaya hai aur tumhe mera Vida ke tawaaf ke liye intezaar karna hoga. Isper unhone kaha: Tumhe zakhm lage aur tumhara sar mundhwa diya jaaye, kya tumne qurbaani ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, tawaaf nahi kiya tha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Koi nuksaan nahi hai. Tumhe aage badhna chahiye. Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah ki taraf upar ja rahe the, jabki main uski taraf se neeche aa rahi thi, ya main upar ja rahi thi, jabki woh neeche aa rahe the. Ishaq ne kaha: Woh neeche jaa rahi thin, aur woh neeche aa rahe the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased, with her) reported: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya having no explicit intention of Pilgrimage or 'Umra. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Talbiya padhte hue nikle bina koi khaas iraada rakhe Hajj ya Umra ka. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out on the 4th or 5th of Dhul'I-Hijja (for Pilgrimage to Mecca) and came to me, and he was very angry. I said: Messenger of Allah, who has annoyed you? May Allah cast him in fire I He said: Don't you know that I commanded the people to do an act, but they are hesitant. (Hakam said: I think that he said: They seem to be hesitant.) And if I were to know my affair before what I had to do subsequently, I would not have brought with me the sacrificial animals, and would have bought them (at Mecca) and would have put off lhram as others have done.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zul-Hijja ki chauthi ya paanchvi tareekh ko bahar nikle, Makkah ke Hajj ke liye, aur mere paas aaye, aur woh bahut gusse mein the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kisne aapko naaraaz kiya? Allah use aag mein daale! Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki maine logon ko ek kaam karne ka hukum diya, lekin woh hichkichaate hain. Hakam ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha: Woh hichkichaate huye dikhte hain. Aur agar mujhe apna maamla pehle pata hota jo mujhe baad mein karna pada, to main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na laata, aur unhe Makkah mein khareed leta aur ehram utaar deta jaisa doosron ne kiya.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out (for Pilgrimage) on The 4th or 5th of Dbu'l Hjjja. The rest of the hadith is the same, but he (the narrator) made no mention of the doubt of Hakam about his (the Prophet's) words: " They were reluctant."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zul-Hijja ki chauthi ya paanchvi ko bahar nikle, Hajj ke liye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone raawi ne Hakam ke unke alfaazon ke baare mein shaq ka koi zikr nahi kiya: "Woh hichkichaa rahe the."

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she put on Ihram for, Umra and arrived 'at Mecca) but did not circumambulate the House as she had entered in the period of menses, and then put on Ihram for Hajj and performed all the rituals concerning it (except circumambulating the House). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to her on the day of march (when pilgrims come to Mina): Your circumambulation would suffice both Hajj and Umra. She, however, felt reluctant. Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) sent her with 'Abd al-Rahman to Tan'im and she performed Umra (with separate rituals) after Hajj.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur Makkah pahunchi lekin Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kiya kyunki unhe haiz ki muddat aa gayi thi, aur phir unhone Hajj ke liye ehram baandha aur uske saare riti-rivaz kiye, siwaay Ghar ka tawaaf karne ke. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse march ke din, jab haaji Mina aate hain, kaha: Tumhara tawaaf Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye kaafi hoga. Woh, halaanki, hichkichaayi. Isper Nabi (SAW) ne unhe Abdur-Rahman ke saath Tan'im bheja aur unhone Hajj ke baad Umra kiya, alag riti-rivaz ke saath.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she entered in the monthly period at Sarif, and took bath at 'Arafa (after the period was over). The messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to her: Your circumambulation between al Safa and al-Marwa is enough for your Hajj and 'Umra.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhe mahine ka usool Sarif mein aa gaya, aur unhone Arafa mein ghusl kiya, muddat khatam hone ke baad. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tumhara al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf tumhare Hajj aur Umra ke liye kaafi hai.

e: Safiyya bint Shaiba reported that 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Messenger of Allah, the people are returning with two rewards whereas I am returning with one reward. Thereupon he commanded 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr to take her to al-Tan'im. She ('A'isha) said: He seated me behind him on his camel. She (further) stated: I lifted my head covering and took it off from my neck. He struck my foot as if he was striking the camel. I said to him: Do you find anyone bere? She (further) said: I entered into the state of Ihram for 'Umra till we reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was at Hasba.
hi: Safiyya bint Shaiba ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log do sawaabon ke saath wapas aa rahe hain jabki main ek sawaab ke saath wapas aa rahi hoon. Isper unhone Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ki woh unhe al-Tan'im le jaayein. Unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe apne oont par apne peeche baithaya. Unhone aage kaha: Maine apna sar ka kapda uthaya aur apni gardan se hataaya. Unhone mere paon par maara jaise woh oont ko maar rahe hon. Maine unse kaha: Kya aapko yahan koi dikhta hai? Unhone aage kaha: Maine Umra ke liye ehram baandha yahan tak ki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunche aur woh Hasba mein the.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered him to mount A'isha behind him and enable her to (enter into the state of Ihram for 'Umra) at Tan'im.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya ki woh Aisha ko apne peeche sawaar karein aur unhe Tan'im mein Umra ke liye ehram baandhne mein saksham banaayein.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) said: We, in the state of lhram, came with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for Hajj Mufrad (with the aim of Hajj only), and 'A'isha set out for Umra, and when we reached Sarif, she (Hadrat A'isha) entered in the state of monthly period; we proceeded on till we reached (Mecca) and circumambulated the Ka'ba and ran between (al-Safa) and al-Marwa; and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded that one who amongst us had no sacrificial animal with him should put off Ihram. We said: What does this "putting off" imply? He said: Getting out completely from the state of lhram, (so we put off Ihram), and we turned to our wives and applied perfume and put on our clothes. and we were at a four night's distance from 'Arafa. And we again put on Ihram on the day of Tarwiya (8th of Dhu'l-Hijja). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and found her weeping, and said: What is the matter with you? She said: The matter is that I have entered in the monthly period, and the people had put off lhram, but I did not and I did not circumambulate the House, and the people are going for Hajj now (but I can't go), whereupon he said: It is the matter which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam, so now take a bath and put on Ihram for Hajj. She ('A'isha) did accordingly, and stayed at the places of staying till the monthly period was over. She then circumambulated the House, and (ran between) al-Safa and al-Marwa. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: Now both your Hajj and 'Umra are complete, whereupon she said: I feel in my mind that I did not circumambulate the House till I performed Hajj (I missed the circumambulation of 'Umra). Thereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: 'Abd al-Rahman, take her to Tan'im (so as to enable her) to perform Umra (separately), and it was the night at Hasba.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Hum, ehram ki halat mein, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj Mufrad, sirf Hajj ke iraade se, ke liye aaye, aur Aisha Umra ke liye nikli, aur jab hum Sarif pahunche, unhe, Hazrat Aisha ko, mahine ka usool aa gaya; hum aage badhte rahe yahan tak ki hum Makkah pahunche aur Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude; aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use ehram utaar dena chahiye. Humne kaha: Ye "utaarne" ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Ehram se poori tarah bahar aana, to humne ehram utaara, aur hum apni zaujaon ki taraf mude aur khushboo lagayi aur apne kapde pehne, aur hum Arafa se char raaton ki doori par the. Aur humne phir Tarwiya ke din, 8 Zul-Hijja, ehram baandha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha (RA) ke paas aaye aur unhe rote hue paaya, aur kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Mamla ye hai ki mujhe mahine ka usool aa gaya hai, aur logon ne ehram utaar diya, lekin maine nahi utaara aur maine Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kiya, aur log ab Hajj ke liye ja rahe hain, lekin main nahi jaa sakti, isper unhone kaha: Ye woh baat hai jo Allah ne Aadam ki betiyon ke liye muqarrar ki hai, is liye ab ghusl karo aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandho. Unhone kaha: Maine aisa hi kiya, aur haaji jagahon par tab tak rukin jab tak mahine ka usool khatam nahi ho gaya. Phir unhone Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi. Unhone phir kaha: Ab tumhara Hajj aur Umra dono mukammal hain, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe apne dil mein lagta hai ki maine Ghar ka tawaaf tab tak nahi kiya jab tak maine Hajj mukammal nahi kiya, main Umra ka tawaaf chhut gayi. Isper unhone kaha: Abdur-Rahman, ise Tan'im le jaao taaki woh Umra kar sake, alag se, aur ye Hasba ki raat thi.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah is reported to have said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and she was weeping. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha (RA) ke paas aaye aur woh ro rahi thin. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) entered into the state of Ihram (separately) for 'Umra while the Prophet (ﷺ) was performing Hajj. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this addition: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was a person of gentle disposition, so when she (A'Isha) wished for a thing, he accepted it (provided it did not contravene the teachings of Islam). So he (in pursuance of her desire for a separate lhram for Umra) sent her with 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr and she put on Ihram for 'Umra at al-Tan'im. Matar and Abu Zubair (the two narrators amongst the chain of transmitters) said: Whenever 'A'isha performed Hajj she did as she had done along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne Umra ke liye ehram baandha, alag se, jabki Nabi (SAW) Hajj kar rahe the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) narm mizaaj ke aadmi the, is liye jab woh Aisha kisi cheez ki khwahish rakhti, to woh use qubool kar lete, jab tak ye Islam ki taalimaat ke khilaaf na ho. To unhone unki alag Umra ki khwahish ke mutabik unhe Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ke saath bheja aur unhone al-Tan'im mein Umra ke liye ehram baandha. Matar aur Abu Zubair, do raawi is sanad mein, ne kaha: Jab bhi Aisha ne Hajj kiya, woh waise hi karti thi jaisa unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath kiya tha.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) said.: We went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in 'a state of Ihram for the Hajj. There were women and children with us. When we reached Mecca we circumambulated the House and (ran) between al-Safa and al-Marwa. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who has no sacrificial animal with him should put off lhram. We said: What kind of putting off? He said: Getting out of lhram completely. So we came to our wives, and put on our clothes and applied perfume. When it was the day of Tarwiya, we put on Ihram for Hajj. and the first circumambulation and (running) between al-Safa and al-Marwa sufficed us.. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to become seven partners (in the sacrifice) of a camel and a cow.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ehram ki halat mein Hajj ke liye nikle. Hamare saath auraten aur bachche the. Jab hum Makkah pahunche to humne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use ehram utaar dena chahiye. Humne kaha: Kis tarah ka utaarna? Unhone kaha: Ehram se poori tarah bahar nikalna. To hum apni zaujaon ke paas aaye, aur apne kapde pehne aur khushboo lagayi. Jab Tarwiya ka din tha, humne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, aur pehla tawaaf aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudna humare liye kaafi tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum saat log ek oont aur ek gaay, qurbaani, mein saanjhedaar banein.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered us to put on Ihram (again) as we proceeded towards Mina after we had put it off (i. e. 'on the 8th of Dhu'l-Hijja). So we pronounced Talbiya at al-Abtah.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum phir se ehram baandhein jab hum Mina ki taraf badhe uske baad jab humne ise utaar diya tha, yaani 8 Zul-Hijja ko. To humne al-Abtah mein Talbiya padhi.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah is reported to have said: Neither Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) nor his Companions (circumambulated the Ka'ba and) ran between al-Safa and al-Marwa but once (sufficing both for Hajj and 'Umra). But in the hadith transmitted by Muhammad b. Bakr there is an addition:" That is first circumambulation."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha: Na Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne na hi unke sahaba ne Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech ek se zyada baar daudi, dono, Hajj aur Umra, ke liye kaafi thi. Lekin Muhammad bin Bakr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ek izafa hai: "Ye pehla tawaaf tha."

e: 'Ata'reported: I, along with some people, heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying: We the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ) put on Ihram for Hajj only. Ata' further said that Jabir stated: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came on the 4th of Dhu'l-Hijja and he commanded us to put off Ihram. 'Ata'said that he (Allah's Apostle) commanded them to put off Ihram and to go to their wives (for intercourse). 'Ata' said: It was not obligatory for them, but (intercourse) with them had become permissible. We said: When only five days had been left to reach 'Arafa, he (the Holy Prophet) commanded us to have intercourse with our wives. And we reached 'Arafa in a state as if we had just had intercourse (with them). He ('Ata') said: Jabir pointed with his hand and I (perceive) as if I am seeing his hand as it moved. In the (meantime) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood amongst us and said: You are well aware that I am the most God-fearing, most truthful and most pious amongst you. And if there were not sacrificial animals with me, I would also have put off Ihram as you have put off. And if I were to know this matter of mine what I have come to know later on, I would not have brought sacrificial animals with me. So they (the Companions) put off Ihram and we also put it off and listened to (the Holy Prophet) and obeyed (his command). Jabir said: 'Ali came with the revenue of the taxes (from Yemen). He (the Holy Prophet) said: For what (purpose) have you entered into the state of Ihram (whether you entered into the state purely for Hajj and, Umra jointly or Hajj and Umra separately)? He said: For the purpose for which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had entered. (The Prophet had entered as a Qiran, i.e. Ihram covering both Umra and Hajj simultaneously.) Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Offer a sacrifice of animal, and retain Ihram. And 'Ali brought a sacrificial animal for him (for the Holy Prophet). Suraqa b. Malik b. Ju'shum said: Messenger of Allah, is it (this concession putting off Ihram of Hajj or Umra) meant for this year or is it forever? He said: It is forever.
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya: Maine, kuch logon ke saath, Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Hum, Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba, ne sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha. Ata ne aage kaha ki Jabir ne bataya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zul-Hijja ki chauthi tareekh ko aaye aur unhone humein ehram utaarne ka hukum diya. Ata ne kaha ki unhone unhe ehram utaarne aur apni zaujaon ke paas, jinsi milaap ke liye, jaane ka hukum diya. Ata ne kaha: Ye unke liye zaroori nahi tha, lekin jinsi milaap unke liye jaayez ho gaya tha. Humne kaha: Jab Arafa pahunchne mein sirf paanch din bache the, unhone humein apni zaujaon ke saath jinsi milaap karne ka hukum diya. Aur hum Arafa pahunche is haalat mein jaise humne abhi-abhi unke saath jinsi milaap kiya ho. Unhone kaha: Jabir ne apne haath se ishara kiya aur main mehsoos karta hoon jaise main unke haath ko hilte hue dekh raha hoon. Isi dauran Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare beech khade hue aur kaha: Tumhe achhi tarah pata hai ki main tum mein sabse zyada Allah se darne wala, sabse sachcha aur sabse parhezgaar hoon. Aur agar mere saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na hote, to main bhi ehram utaar deta jaisa tumne utaara hai. Aur agar mujhe apna ye maamla pehle pata hota jo mujhe baad mein pata chala, to main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na laata. To unhone ehram utaara aur humne bhi utaara aur baat suni aur itaat ki. Jabir ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se tax ki aamdani lekar aaye. Unhone kaha: Kis maqsad ke liye tumne ehram baandha hai, chahe tumne sirf Hajj aur Umra ekasath ke liye ya Hajj aur Umra alag-alag ke liye ehram baandha ho? Unhone kaha: Usi maqsad ke liye jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ehram baandha, Nabi ne Qiran ke taur par ehram baandha tha, yaani Umra aur Hajj dono ko ekasath dhaankne wala ehram. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jaanwar ki qurbaani do, aur ehram baniye rehne do. Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) unke liye ek qurbaani ka jaanwar laaye. Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye chhoot sirf is saal ke liye hai ya hamesha ke liye? Unhone kaha: Ye hamesha ke liye hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We entered with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the state of Ihram for Hajj. When we came to Mecca he commanded us to put off Ihram and make it for 'Umra. We felt it (the command) hard for us, and our hearts were anguished on account of this and it (this reaction of the people) reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We do not know whether he received (this news) from the Heaven (through revelation) or from the people. (Whatever the case might be) he said; O people, put off Ihram. If there were not the sacrificial animals with me, I would have done as you do. So we put off the Ihram (after performing Umra), and we had intercourse with our wives and did everything which a non-Muhrim does (applying perfume, putting on clothes, etc.), and when It was the day of Tarwiya (8th of Dhu'l-Hijja) we turned our back to Mecca (in order to go to Mini, 'Arafat) and we put on lhram for Hajj.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj ke liye ehram ki halat mein daakhil hue. Jab hum Makkah pahunche unhone humein ehram utaarne aur ise Umra ke liye banaane ka hukum diya. Humein ye hukum bahut mushkil laga, aur hamare dil isse pareshaan hue aur ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi. Humein nahi pata ki unhe ye khabar aasmaan se mili, wahi ke zariye, ya logon se. Jo bhi ho, unhone kaha: Aye logo, ehram utaaro. Agar mere saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na hote, to main woh karta jo tum karte ho. To humne ehram utaara, Umra karne ke baad, aur humne apni zaujaon ke saath jinsi milaap kiya aur woh sab kiya jo ek non-Muhrim karta hai, khushboo lagaana, kapde pehnana, waghera, aur jab Tarwiya ka din tha, 8 Zul-Hijja, humne Makkah ki taraf peeth ki, Mina, Arafat jaane ke liye, aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandha.

e: Musa b. Nafi reported: I came to Mecca as a Mutamattil for Umra (performing Umra first and then putting off Ihram and again entering into the state of Ihram for Hajj) four days before the day of Tarwiya (i. e. on the 4th of Dhu'l-Hijja). Thereupon the people said: Now yours is the Hajj of the Meccans. I went to 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah and asked his religious verdict. Ata' said: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al'Ansari (Allah be pleased with them) narrated to me that he performed Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year when he took sacrificial animals with him (i.e. during the 10th year of Hijra known as the Farewell Pilgrimage) and they had put on Ihram for Hajj only (as Mufrid). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Put off Ihram and circumambulate the House, and (run) between al-Safa and al-Marwa, and get your hair cut and stay as non-Muhrims. When it was the day of Tarwiya, then put on Ihram for Hajj and make lhram for Mut'a (you had put on Ihram for Hajj, but take it off after performing Umra and then again put on Ihram for Hajj). They said: How should we make it Mut'a although we entered upon lhram in the name of Hajj? He said: Do whatever I command you to do. Had I not brought sacrificial animals with me, I would have done as I have commanded you to do. But it is not permissible for me to put off Ihram till the sacrifice is offered. Then they also did accordingly.
hi: Musa bin Nafi ne bayan kiya: Main Makkah mein Mutamattil, Umra ke liye pehle karke phir ehram utaarkar phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandhna, ke taur par aaya Tarwiya ke din se char din pehle, yaani 4 Zul-Hijja. Isper logon ne kaha: Ab tumhara Hajj Makkah walon ka Hajj hai. Main Ata bin Abi Rabah ke paas gaya aur unse mazhabi fatwa poocha. Ata ne kaha: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari (RA) ne mujhe riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya us saal jab woh apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar le gaye the, yaani hijrat ke daswein saal, jo Vida ke Hajj ke naam se jaana jaata hai, aur unhone sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha tha, Mufrid ke taur par. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ehram utaaro aur Ghar ka tawaaf karo, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudo, aur apne baal katvaao aur non-Muhrim ki tarah raho. Jab Tarwiya ka din tha, phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandho aur ise Mut'a ke liye banaao, tumne Hajj ke naam par ehram baandha tha, lekin ise Umra karne ke baad utaaro aur phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandho. Unhone kaha: Hum ise Mut'a kaise banaayein jabki humne Hajj ke naam par ehram baandha? Unhone kaha: Woh karo jo main tumhe karne ka hukum deta hoon. Agar main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na laata, to main bhi wahi karta jiska maine tumhe hukum diya hai. Lekin mere liye jaayez nahi hai ki main ehram utaaru jab tak qurbaani na de di jaaye. Phir unhone bhi waisa hi kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We set out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Muhrim for Hajj. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to make this Ihram for Umra, and some put it off (after performing 'Umra), but the Prophet (ﷺ) had sacrificial animals with him, so he could not make it (this Ihram) as that of Umra.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Muhrim ke taur par Hajj ke liye nikle. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ye ehram Umra ke liye banaane ka hukum diya, aur kuchne ise utaar diya, Umra karne ke baad, lekin Nabi (SAW) ke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar the, is liye woh ise ye ehram Umra ka nahi bana sake.

e: Abu Nadra reported: Ibn 'Abbas commanded the performance of Mut'a putting ihram for 'Umra during the months of Dhul-Hijja and after completing it. then putting on Ihram for Hajj), but Ibn Zubair forbade to do it. I made a mention of it to Jabir b. Abdullih and he said: It is through me that this hadith has been circulated. We entered into the state of Ihram as Tamattu' with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When 'Umar was Installed as Caliph, he said: Verily Allah made permissible for His Messenger (ﷺ) whatever He liked and as Re liked. And (every command) of the Holy Qur'an has been revealed for every occasion. So accomplish Hajj and Umra for Allah as Allah has commanded you; and confirm by (proper conditions) the marriage of those women (with whom you have performed Mut'a). And any person would come to me with a marriage of appointed duration (Mut'a), I would stone him (to death).
hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Ibn Abbas ne Mut'a karne ka hukum diya, Umra ke liye ehram baandhna Zul-Hijja ke mahinon mein aur ise mukammal karne ke baad, phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandhna, lekin Ibn Zubair ne aisa karne se mana kiya. Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ke saamne iska zikr kiya aur unhone kaha: Mere hi zariye ye hadees phaili hai. Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Tamattu ke taur par ehram baandha. Jab Umar khalifa muqarrar hue, unhone kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ke liye jo bhi jaayez kiya jo Usne chaha aur jaise Usne chaha. Aur Quran ka har hukum har mauqe ke liye nazil hua hai. Is liye Allah ke liye Hajj aur Umra poora karo jaisa Allah ne tumhe hukum diya hai; aur un auraton ki shaadi ko theek shartaon se tasdeeq karo jinke saath tumne Mut'a kiya hai. Aur koi bhi shakhs jo mere paas ek muqarrar muddat ki shaadi, Mut'a, ke saath aayega, main use pathhar maar-maar kar maut ke ghaat utaarunga.

e: Qatada narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters saying: (That 'Umar also said): Separate your Hajj from 'Umra, for that is the most complete Hajj, and complete your Umra.
hi: Qatada ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki, ye kehte hue: Ki Umar ne ye bhi kaha: Apne Hajj ko Umra se alag rakho, kyunki ye sabse mukammal Hajj hai, aur apni Umra mukammal karo.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We came with the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj, and the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) commanded us to make (our Ihram) into that of Umra.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhte hue aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum apna ehram Umra ke liye banaayein.

e:
Ja'far b Muhammad reported on the authority of his father: We went to Jabir b. Abdullah and he began inquiring about the people (who had gone to see him) till it was my turn. I said: I am Muhammad b. 'Ali b. Husain. He placed his hand upon my head and opened my upper button and then the lower one and then placed his palm on my chest (in order to bless me), and I was, during those days, a young boy, and he said: You are welcome, my nephew. Ask whatever you want to ask. And I asked him but as he was blind (he could not respond to me immediately), and the time for prayer came. He stood up covering himself in his mantle. And whenever he placed its ends upon his shoulders they slipped down on account of being short (in size). Another mantle was, however, lying on the clothes rack near by. And he led us in the prayer. I said to him: Tell me about the Hajj of Allah's Messenger (May peace be upon him). And he pointed with his hand nine, and then stated: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stayed in (Medina) for nine years but did not perform Hajj, then he made a public announcement in the tenth year to the effect that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to perform the Hajj. A large number of persons came to Medina and all of them were anxious to follow the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) and do according to his doing. We set out with him till we reached Dhu'l-Hulaifa. Asma' daughter of Umais gave birth to Muhammad b. Abu Bakr. She sent message to the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) asking him: What should 1 do? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Take a bath, bandage your private parts and put on Ihram. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) then prayed in the mosque and then mounted al-Qaswa (his she-camel) and it stood erect with him on its back at al-Baida'. And I saw as far as I could see in front of me but riders and pedestrians, and also on my right and on my left and behind me like this. And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was prominent among us and the (revelation) of the Holy Qur'an was descending upon him. And it is he who knows (its true) significance. And whatever he did, we also did that. He pronounced the Oneness of Allah (saying):" Labbaik,0 Allah, Labbaik, Labbaik. Thou hast no partner, praise and grace is Thine and the Sovereignty too; Thou hast no partner." 
And the people also pronounced this Talbiya which they pronounce (today). The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) did not reject anything out of it. But the Messenger of Allah (May peace. be upon him) adhered to his own Talbiya. Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) said: We did not have any other intention but that of Hajj only, being unaware of the Umra (at that season), but when we came with him to the House, he touched the pillar and (made seven circuits) running three of them and walking four. And then going to the Station of Ibrahim, he recited:" And adopt the Station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer." And this Station was between him and the House. My father said (and I do not know whether he had made a mention of it but that was from Allah's Apostle  that he recited in two rak'ahs:" say: He is Allah One," and say:" Say: 0 unbelievers." He then returned to the pillar (Hajar Aswad) and kissed it. He then went out of the gate to al-Safa' and as he reached near it he recited:" Al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the signs appointed by Allah," (adding: ) I begin with what Allah (has commanded me) to begin. He first mounted al-Safa' till he saw the House, and facing Qibla he declared the Oneness of Allah and glorified Him, and said:" There is no god but Allah, One, there is no partner with Him. His is the Sovereignty. to Him praise is due. and He is Powerful over everything. There is no god but Allah alone, Who fulfilled His promise, helped His servant and routed the confederates alone." He then made supplication in the course of that saying such words three times. He then descended and walked towards al-Marwa, and when his feet came down in the bottom of the valley, he ran, and when he began to ascend he walked till he reached al-Marwa. There he did as he had done at al-Safa'. And when it was his last running at al-Marwa he said: If I had known beforehand what I have come to know afterwards, I would not have brought sacrificial animals and would have performed an 'Umra. So, he who among you has not the sacrificial animals with him should put off Ihram and treat it as an Umra. Suraqa b. Malik b. Ju'sham got up and said: Messenger of Allah, does it apply to the present year, or does it apply forever? Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) intertwined the fingers (of one hand) into another and said twice: The 'Umra has become incorporated in the Hajj (adding):" No, but for ever and ever." 'All came from the Yemen with the sacrificial animals for the Prophet (May peace be upon him) and found Fatimah (Allah be pleased with her) to be one among those who had put off Ihram and had put on dyed clothes and had applied antimony. He (Hadrat'Ali) showed disapproval to it, whereupon she said: My father has commanded me to do this. He (the narrator) said that 'Ali used to say in Iraq: I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) showing annoyance at Fatimah for what she had done, and asked the (verdict) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding what she had narrated from him, and told him that I was angry with her, whereupon he said: She has told the truth, she has told the truth. (The Prophet then asked 'Ali): What did you say when you undertook to go for Hajj? I ('Ali) said: 0 Allah, I am putting on Ihram for the same purpose as Thy Messenger has put it on. 
He said: I have with me sacrificial animals, so do not put off the Ihram. He (Jabir) said: The total number of those sacrificial animals brought by 'Ali from the Yemen and of those brought by the Apostle (ﷺ) was one hundred. Then all the people except the Apostle (ﷺ) and those who had with them sacrificial animals, put off Ihram, and got their hair clipped; when it was the day of Tarwiya (8th of Dhu'l-Hijja) they went to Mina and put on the Ihram for Hajj and the Messenger of Ailah (ﷺ) rode and led the noon, afternoon, sunset 'Isha' and dawn prayers. He then waited a little till the sun rose, and commanded that a tent of hair should be pitched at Namira. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then set out and the Quraish did not doubt that he would halt at al-Mash'ar al-Haram (the sacred site) as the Quraish used to do in the pre-Islamic period. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), however, passed on till he came to 'Arafa and he found that the tent had been pitched for him at Namira. There he got down till the sun had passed the meridian; he commanded that al-Qaswa should be brought and saddled for him. Then he came to the bottom of the valley, and addressed the people saying: Verily your blood, your property are as sacred and inviolable as the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this town of yours. Behold! Everything pertaining to the Days of Ignorance is under my feet completely abolished. Abolished are also the blood-revenges of the Days of Ignorance. 
The first claim of ours on blood-revenge which I abolish is that of the son of Rabi'a b. al-Harith, who was nursed among the tribe of Sa'd and killed by Hudhail. And the usury of she pre-Islamic period is abolished, and the first of our usury I abolish is that of 'Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib, for it is all abolished. Fear Allah concerning women! Verily you have taken them on the security of Allah, and intercourse with them has been made lawful unto you by words of Allah. You too have right over them, and that they should not allow anyone to sit on your bed whom you do not like. But if they do that, you can chastise them but not severely. Their rights upon you are that you should provide them with food and clothing in a fitting manner. I have left among you the Book of Allah, and if you hold fast to it, you would never go astray. And you would be asked about me (on the Day of Resurrection), (now tell me) what would you say? They (the audience) said: We will bear witness that you have conveyed (the message), discharged (the ministry of Prophethood) and given wise (sincere) counsel. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) then raised his forefinger towards the sky and pointing it at the people (said):" O Allah, be witness. 0 Allah, be witness," saying it thrice. (Bilal then) pronounced Adhan and later on Iqama and he (the Holy Prophet) led the noon prayer. He (Bilal) then uttered Iqama and he (the Holy Prophet) led the afternoon prayer and he observed no other prayer in between the two. 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then mounted his camel and came to the place of stay, making his she-camel al-Qaswa, turn towards the side where there we are rocks, having the path taken by those who went on foot in front of him, and faced the Qibla. He kept standing there till the sun set, and the yellow light had somewhat gone, and the disc of the sun had disappeared. He made Usama sit behind him, and he pulled the nosestring of Qaswa so forcefully that its head touched the saddle (in order to keep her under perfect control), and he pointed out to the people with his right hand to be moderate (in speed), and whenever he happened to pass over an elevated tract of sand, he slightly loosened it (the nose-string of his camel) till she climbed up and this is how he reached al-Muzdalifa. There he led the evening and 'Isha prayers with one Adhan and two Iqamas and did not glorify (Allah) in between them (i. e. he did not observe supererogatory rak'ahs between Maghrib and 'Isha' prayers). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then lay down till dawn and offered the dawn prayer with an Adhan and Iqama when the morning light was clear. He again mounted al-Qaswa, and when he came to al-Mash'ar al-Haram, he faced towards Qibla, supplicated Him, Glorified Him, and pronounced His Uniqueness (La ilaha illa Allah) and Oneness, and kept standing till the daylight was very clear. 
He then went quickly before the sun rose, and seated behind him was al-Fadl b. 'Abbas and he was a man having beautiful hair and fair complexion and handsome face. As the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) was moving on, there was also going a group of women (side by side with them). Al-Fadl began to look at them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his hand on the face of Fadl who then turned his face to the other side, and began to see, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his hand to the other side and placed it on the face of al-Fadl. He again turned his face to the other side till he came to the bottom of Muhassir. 1680 He urged her (al-Qaswa) a little, and, following the middle road, which comes out at the greatest jamra, he came to the jamra which is near the tree. At this be threw seven small pebbles, saying Allah-o-Akbar while throwing every one of them in a manner in which the small pebbles are thrown (with the help of fingers) and this he did in the bottom of the valley. He then went to the place of sacrifice, and sacrificed sixty-three (camels) with his own hand. Then he gave the remaining number to 'All who sacrificed them, and he shared him in his sacrifice. He then commanded that a piece of flesh from each animal sacrificed should be put in a pot, and when it was cooked, both of them (the Prophet and Hadrat 'All) took some meat out of it and drank its soup. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) again rode and came to the House, and offered the Zuhr prayer at Mecca. He came to the tribe of Abd al-Muttalib, who were supplying water at Zamzam, and said: Draw water. O Bani 'Abd al-Muttalib; were it not that people would usurp this right of supplying water from you, I would have drawn it along with you. So they handed him a basket and he drank from it.
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Jabir bin Abdullah ke paas gaye aur woh logon, jo unse milne aaye the, ke baare mein poochhne lage yahan tak ki meri baari aayi. Maine kaha: Main Muhammad bin Ali bin Husain hoon. Unhone apna haath mere sar par rakha aur mera upari button khola aur phir neechla, aur phir apni hatheli mere seene par rakhi, mujhe barkat dene ke liye, aur main un dinon ek jawaan larka tha, aur unhone kaha: Tumhara swaagat hai, mere bhatije. Jo poochhna chaho poochho. Aur maine unse poocha lekin woh andhe the, is liye woh mujhe turant jawaab nahi de sake, aur namaz ka waqt aa gaya. Woh khade hue apne aap ko apne chogha mein lapetkar. Aur jab bhi unhone iske sirhe apne kandhon par rakhe woh chhote hone ki wajah se phisal jaate. Doosra chogha, halaanki, paas hi kapdon ke rack par pada tha. Aur unhone humari namaz ki imamat ki. Maine unse kaha: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Hajj ke baare mein bataiye. Aur unhone apne haath se nau ka ishara kiya, aur phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina mein nau saal theher lekin unhone Hajj nahi kiya, phir unhone daswein saal mein logon ke liye ailaan karwaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hajj karne wale hain. Bahut zyada log Madina aaye aur woh sab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki pairvi karne aur unke amal ke mutabik amal karne ke liye betaab the. Hum unke saath nikle yahan tak ki hum Dhu'l-Hulaifa pahunche. Asma, Umais ki beti, ne Muhammad bin Abu Bakr ko paida kiya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko payaam bheja unse poochte hue: Mujhe kya karna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Ghusl karo, apne khaas hisse ko patti se baandho aur ehram baandho. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir masjid mein namaz padhi aur phir al-Qaswa, apni oontni, par sawaar hue aur woh unke saath al-Baida mein khadi ho gayi. Aur maine jitni door dekh saka apne saamne sawaar aur paidal log dekhe, aur meri daayi taraf aur meri baayi taraf aur mere peeche bhi isi tarah. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare beech mumtaaz the aur unpar Quran ki wahi nazil ho rahi thi. Aur woh hi hain jo iski sahi ahmiyat jaante hain. Aur jo bhi unhone kiya, humne bhi wahi kiya. Unhone Allah ki wahdaniyat ka ailaan kiya ye kehte hue: "Main haazir hoon, Aye Allah, Main haazir hoon, main haazir hoon. Tera koi shareek nahi hai; saari tareef aur fazl Tere hi liye hai, aur baadshahat bhi; Tera koi shareek nahi hai." Aur logon ne bhi ye Talbiya padhi jo woh aaj padhte hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isme se kuch bhi radd nahi kiya. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni khud ki Talbiya par kaayam rahe. Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Hamara koi doosra iraada nahi tha siwaay sirf Hajj ke, Umra se anjaan us mausam mein, lekin jab hum unke saath Ghar, Kaaba, mein aaye, unhone khambe, Hajar Aswad, ko chhua aur saat chakkar lagaaye teen daudte hue aur char chalte hue. Aur phir Ibrahim ke Maqam ki taraf jaate hue, unhone padha: "Aur Ibrahim ke Maqam ko namaz ki jagah banaao." Aur ye Maqam unke aur Ghar ke beech tha. Mere walid ne kaha, aur mujhe nahi pata ki unhone iska zikr kiya ya nahi, lekin ye Allah ke Rasool se hai, ki unhone do rakaton mein padha: "Kaho: Woh Allah Ek hai," aur "Kaho: Aye kaafiro." Woh phir khambe, Hajar Aswad, ki taraf laute aur use chooma. Woh phir al-Safa ke darwaze se bahar gaye aur jab woh uske qareeb pahunche, unhone padha: "Al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki muqarrar ki hui nishaniyon mein se hain," aur izafa kiya: Main usi se shuru karta hoon jisse Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai shuru karne ka. Woh pehle al-Safa par chadhe yahan tak ki unhone Ghar dekh liya, aur Qibla ka rukh karke, unhone Allah ki wahdaniyat ka ailaan kiya aur uski hamd ki, aur kaha: "Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Ek, uska koi shareek nahi. Uski hi Baadshahat hai, use hi hamd hai, aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Woh akela hai, jisne apna wada poora kiya, apne banda ki madad ki, aur ittihaadi giroahon ko akele shikast di." Unhone phir dua ki isi silsile mein ye alfaaz teen baar kehte hue. Woh phir utre aur al-Marwa ki taraf chale, aur jab unke paon wadi ke tale mein utre, woh daude, aur jab unhone chadhna shuru kiya to woh chalte rahe yahan tak ki woh al-Marwa pahunche. Wahan unhone waisa hi kiya jaisa unhone al-Safa par kiya tha. Aur jab ye unki aakhri daud thi al-Marwa par, unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pehle se pata hota jo mujhe baad mein pata chala, to main qurbaani ke jaanwar na laata aur Umra karta. Is liye tum mein se jiske paas qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi hain use ehram utaar dena chahiye aur ise Umra maanna chahiye. Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'sham khade hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye is saal ke liye laagu hai, ya ye hamesha ke liye laagu hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek haath ki ungliyaan doosre mein jodi aur do baar kaha: Umra Hajj mein shaamil ho gaya hai, izafa karte hue: "Nahi, balki hamesha ke liye." Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se Nabi (SAW) ke liye qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko paaya ki woh un logon mein se ek thi jinhone ehram utaar diya tha aur rangaaye hue kapde pehne the aur antimony lagayi thi. Unhone isse napasandeeda samjha, isper unhone kaha: Mere waalid ne mujhe aisa karne ka hukum diya hai. Raawi ne kaha ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) Iraq mein kaha karte the: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya, Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke jo kiya usse naaraaz hokar, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se fatwa poocha jo unhone unse riwayat ki, aur unhe bataya ki main unse naaraaz tha, isper unhone kaha: Usne sach kaha, usne sach kaha. Nabi ne phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha: Jab tumne Hajj ke liye jaane ka faisla kiya to tumne kya kaha? Maine kaha: Aye Allah, main usi maqsad ke liye ehram baandh raha hoon jis maqsad ke liye Tera Rasool ne baandha hai. Unhone kaha: Mere paas qurbaani ke jaanwar hain, is liye ehram mat utaaro. Unhone kaha: Un qurbaani ke jaanwaron ki kul tadaad jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se laaye aur jo Rasool (SAW) laaye, sau thi. Phir sab logon ne, Rasool (SAW) aur unke jinke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar the ke siwaay, ehram utaara, aur apne baal katvaaye; jab Tarwiya ka din tha, 8 Zul-Hijja, woh Mina gaye aur Hajj ke liye ehram baandha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sawaar hue aur unhone zohar, asr, maghrib, isha aur fajr ki namaz padhayi. Woh phir thodi der ruke yahan tak ki suraj nikla, aur unhone hukum diya ki ek baal ka tambu Namira mein lagaaya jaaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir nikle aur Quraish ko koi shaq nahi tha ki woh al-Mash'ar al-Haram par rukenge jaisa Quraish Islam se pehle ke daur mein kiya karte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW), halaanki, aage badh gaye yahan tak ki woh Arafa pahunche aur unhone paaya ki unke liye Namira mein tambu lagaaya gaya tha. Wahan woh utre yahan tak ki suraj darmiyan-bindu se guzar gaya; unhone hukum diya ki al-Qaswa ko laaya jaaye aur unke liye zeen kasi jaaye. Woh phir wadi ke tale mein aaye, aur logon se khitaab karte hue kaha: Yaqeenan tumhara khoon, tumhari maal tumhare is din, tumhare is mahine, tumhare is shehar ki hurmat ki tarah hurmat wale hain. Dekho! Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutalliq har cheez mere paon ke neeche poori tarah mita di gayi hai. Jaahiliyat ke daur ke khoon-badle bhi mita diye gaye hain. Sabse pehla daawa jo hum khoon-badle par mitaate hain woh Rabi'a bin al-Harith ke bete ka hai, jo Sa'd qabile mein pala-badha aur Hudhail ne use qatal kiya. Aur Islam se pehle ka sood mita diya gaya hai, aur sabse pehla sood jo main mitata hoon woh Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib ka hai, kyunki ye sab mita diya gaya hai. Auraton ke maamle mein Allah se daro! Yaqeenan tumne unhe Allah ki zimmedaari par liya hai, aur unke saath jinsi milaap Allah ke alfaazon se tumhare liye jaayez kiya gaya hai. Tumhara bhi unpar haq hai, aur ye ki woh kisi ko bhi tumhare bistar par baithne na dein jise tum napasand karte ho. Lekin agar woh aisa karti hain, to tum unhe saza de sakte ho lekin sakhti se nahi. Tum par unka haq ye hai ki tum unhe achhe tareeke se khaana aur kapda do. Maine tum mein Allah ki Kitaab chhod di hai, aur agar tum usse mazbooti se pakde raho, to tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge. Aur tumse mere baare mein Qayamat ke din poocha jaayega, ab bataao tum kya kahoge? Unhone kaha: Hum gawaahi denge ki aapne payaam pahunchaaya, apni zimmedaari nibhaayi, aur hikmat se khaalis naseehat di. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone phir apni shahadat ki ungli aasmaan ki taraf uthaayi aur logon ki taraf ishara karte hue kaha: "Aye Allah, gawaah reh. Aye Allah, gawaah reh," teen baar kehte hue. Bilal ne phir Azaan padhi aur baad mein Iqamat, aur unhone zohar ki namaz padhayi. Unhone phir Iqamat kahi aur unhone asr ki namaz padhayi aur unhone dono ke beech koi aur namaz nahi padhi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir apne oont par sawaar hue aur theharne ki jagah aaye, apni oontni al-Qaswa ko us taraf mode jahan chattaanein thin, unke saamne paidal chalne walon ka raasta rakhte hue, aur Qibla ka rukh kiya. Woh wahan khade rahe yahan tak ki suraj dooba, aur peela prakash kuch kam ho gaya, aur suraj ka gola gaayab ho gaya. Unhone Usama ko apne peeche baithaya, aur unhone Qaswa ki naak ki rassi itni zor se kheenchi ki uska sar zeen ko chhoo gaya, use poori tarah kaboo mein rakhne ke liye, aur unhone logon ko apne daaye haath se ishara kiya ki woh sambhal ke raftaar mein chalein, aur jab bhi woh reti ke bulande hisse se guzarte, woh use thoda dheela karte yahan tak ki woh chadh jaati aur is tarah woh al-Muzdalifa pahunche. Wahan unhone maghrib aur isha ki namaz ek Azaan aur do Iqamaton ke saath padhi aur unke beech mein koi tasbeeh nahi ki, yaani unhone maghrib aur isha ke beech koi nafil rakat nahi padhi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir subah tak lete rahe aur unhone fajr ki namaz ek Azaan aur Iqamat ke saath padhi jab subah ki roshni saaf thi. Woh phir al-Qaswa par sawaar hue, aur jab woh al-Mash'ar al-Haram pahunche, unhone Qibla ka rukh kiya, Usse dua ki, Uski tareef ki, aur Uski wahdaniyat, La ilaha illa Allah, aur Ekta ka ailaan kiya, aur khade rahe yahan tak ki din ki roshni bahut saaf ho gayi. Woh phir jaldi gaye isse pehle ki suraj nikle, aur unke peeche al-Fadl bin Abbas baithe the aur woh khoobsurat baalon aur gore rang aur khoobsurat chehre wale aadmi the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) chal rahe the, wahan auraton ka ek giroh bhi unke saath-saath chal raha tha. Al-Fadl unhe dekhne lage. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath Fadl ke chehre par rakha jo phir apna chehra doosri taraf mod liye, aur dekhne lage, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath doosri taraf mod diya aur al-Fadl ke chehre par rakha. Woh phir apna chehra doosri taraf mode yahan tak ki woh Muhassir ke tale mein aaye. Unhone use thoda tez kiya, aur beech ke raaste ka anusaran karte hue, jo sabse badi jamra par nikalta hai, woh us jamra tak aaye jo darakht ke qareeb hai. Isper unhone saat chhoti kankariyaan maarin, har ek maarte waqt Allahu Akbar kehte hue us tareeke se jismein chhoti kankariyaan maari jaati hain, ungliyon ki madad se, aur ye unhone wadi ke tale mein kiya. Woh phir qurbaani ki jagah gaye, aur apne haath se teisathve oont qurbaan kiye. Phir unhone baaki tadaad Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko di jinhone unhe qurbaan kiya, aur woh unki qurbaani mein saanjhedaar bane. Unhone phir hukum diya ki har qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwar mein se gosht ka ek tukda ek bartan mein rakha jaaye, aur jab ye pak gaya, dono, Nabi aur Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam), ne usmein se kuch gosht khaya aur uska shorba piya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir sawaar hue aur Ghar aaye, aur Makkah mein zohar ki namaz padhi. Woh Abd al-Muttalib qabile ke paas aaye, jo Zamzam se paani supply kar rahe the, aur kaha: Paani nikaalo. Aye Banu Abd al-Muttalib; agar ye baat na hoti ki log tumse ye paani supply karne ka haq chheen lenge, to main tumhare saath ye nikaalta. To unhone unhe ek tokri di aur unhone usmein se piya.

e: Ja'far b. Muhammad narrated on the authority of his father thus: I came to Jabir b. Abdullah and asked him about the (Farewell) Pilgrimage of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same, but with the addition of this:" There was one Abu Sayyara among the Arabs, (of pre-Islamic period) who carried (people from Muzdalifa to Mini). As the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) set out from Muzdalifa to al-Mash'ar al-Haram, the Quraish were certain that he would halt there and that would be his station. But he passed on (without staying) there. and paid no heed to it till he came to 'Arafat and there he stayed."
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Main Jabir bin Abdullah ke paas aaya aur unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Vida ke Hajj ke baare mein poocha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: "Arabon mein Abu Sayyara naam ka ek shakhs tha, Islam se pehle ke daur mein, jo logon ko Muzdalifa se Mina le jaata tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Muzdalifa se al-Mash'ar al-Haram ki taraf nikle, Quraish ko yakeen tha ki woh wahan rukenge aur wahi unka padaav hoga. Lekin woh bina wahan ruke aage badh gaye, aur usse koi tavajjo nahi di yahan tak ki woh Arafat pahunche aur wahan theher gaye."

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (May peace be upon him) as saying: I have sacrificed (the animals) here, and the whole of Mini is a place for sacrifice; so sacrifice your animals at your places. 1 have stayed here (near these rocks), and the whole of Arafat is a place for stay. And I have stayed here (at Muzdalifa near Mash'ar al-Haram and the whole of Muzdalifa) is a place for stay (i. e. one is permitted to spend night in any part of it, as one likes).
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine yahan qurbaani di hai, aur poora Mina qurbaani ki jagah hai; is liye apni qurbaani apni jagah par karo. Maine yahan, in chattaanon ke qareeb, qayaam kiya hai, aur poora Arafat qayaam ki jagah hai. Aur maine yahan qayaam kiya hai, Muzdalifa mein Mash'ar al-Haram ke qareeb, aur poora Muzdalifa qayaam ki jagah hai, yaani, koi bhi ismein kahin bhi raat guzaar sakta hai jaisa woh chahe.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded to Mecca, he came to it (the Black Stone). he kissed it. and moved to his right. and moved quickly in three circuits, and walked in four circuits.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah ki taraf badhe, woh iske, Kaale Patthar ke, paas aaye, unhone use chooma, aur apni daayi taraf mude, aur teen chakkaron mein tez chale, aur char chakkaron mein aaram se chale.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Quraish (of the pre-Islamic days) and those who followed their religions practices stayed at Muzdalifa, and they named themselves as Hums, whereas all other Arabs stayed at 'Arafa. With the advent of Islam, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, commanded His Apostle (ﷺ) to come to 'Arafat and stay there, and then hurry from there, and this is the significance of the words of Allah: " Then hasten on from where the people hasten on."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quraish, Islam se pehle ke daur ke, aur woh log jo unke mazhabi riti-rivaz ki pairvi karte the, Muzdalifa mein theherte the, aur unhone khud ko Hums ka naam diya, jabki baaki sab Arab Arafa mein theherte the. Islam ke aane par, Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko hukum diya ki woh Arafat aayein aur wahan theherein, aur phir wahan se jaldi karein, aur ye Allah ke alfaazon ki ahmiyat hai: "Phir wahan se jaldi karo jahan se log jaldi karte hain."

e: Hisham narrated on the authority of his father that the Arabs with the exception of Hums who were Quraish, and their descendants, circumambulated the House naked. They kept circumambulating In this state of nudity unless the Hums supplied to them the clothes. The male provided (clothes) to the male and the female provided clothes to the female. And the Hums did not get out of Muzdalifa, whereas the people (other than the Quraish) went t o 'Arafat. Hisham said on the authority of his father who related from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) who said: Hums are those about whom Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" Then hasten to where the people hasten." She (further) said: The people hastened on from 'Arafat, whereas Hums hastened from Muzdalifa, and said: We'do not hasten but from Haram. But when this (verse) was revealed:" Hasten on from that (place) where the people hasten on," they (the Quraish) then went to 'Arafat.
hi: Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Arab, Hums, jo Quraish the aur unki naslein, ke ilawa, Ghar ka tawaaf nange badan karte the. Woh is nangi halat mein tawaaf karte rahte jab tak Hums unhe kapde na supply karein. Mard mard ko kapde deta aur aurat aurat ko kapde deti. Aur Hums Muzdalifa se bahar nahi jaate the, jabki log, Quraish ke ilawa, Arafat jaate the. Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se kaha jinhone Aisha (RA) se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Hums woh log hain jinke baare mein Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Phir jaldi karo jahan se log jaldi karte hain." Unhone aage kaha: Log Arafat se jaldi karte the, jabki Hums Muzdalifa se jaldi karte the, aur kehte the: Hum sirf Haram se jaldi karenge. Lekin jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Jaldi karo us jagah se jahan se log jaldi karte hain," to woh Quraish phir Arafat jaane lage.

e: Jubair. b. Mut'im reported: I lost my camel and went in search of it on the day of 'Arafa, and I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) staying along with people in 'Ara'fit. Thereupon I said: By Allah, he is among the Hums (Quraish) ; what has happened to him that he has come to this (place)? The Quraish were counted among Hums.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne bayan kiya: Maine apna oont kho diya aur usse dhoondhne nikla Arafa ke din, aur maine dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke saath Arafat mein theher hue hain. Isper maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, woh to Hums, Quraish, mein se hain; unhe kya hua hai ki woh yahan aaye hain? Quraish ko Hums mein gina jaata tha.
