e: Abu Musa (Allah be pleased with him) said: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was encamping at Batha. He said to me: Did you intend to perform Hajj? I said: Yes. He again said: With what intention have you entered into the state of Ihram (for Ifrad, Qiran or Tamattu'). I said: I pronounced Talbiya (I have entered into the state of Ihram ) with that very aim with which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is pronouncing Talbiya. He (the Holy Prophet) said; You have done well. Then circumambulate the House and run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa' and put off Ihram (as you have not brought the sacrificial animals along with you). So I circumambulated the House, and ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa' and then came to a woman of the tribe of Qais and she rid my head of the lice. I again put on Ihram for Hajj. and continued giving religious verdict (according to this practice) till during the Caliphate of Umar (Allah be pleased with him) when a person said to him: Abu Musa, or Abdullah b. Qais, exercise restraint in delivering some religious verdict of yours, for you do not know what has been introduced after you by the Commander of the Believers in the rites (of Hajj). Thereupon he said: 0 people, whom we gave the religious verdict (concerning putting off Ihram ) they should wait, for the Commander of the Believers is about to come to you, and you should follow him. Umar (Allah be pleased with him) then came and I made a mention of it to him. whereupon he said: If we abide by the Book of Allah (we find) the Book of Allah has commanded us to complete the (. Hajj and 'Umra), and if we abide by the Sunnah of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), we find that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not put off Ihram till the sacrificial animal was brought to its end (till it was sacrificed).
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh Batha mein khema laga rahe the. Unhone mujhse kaha: Kya tumhara Hajj karne ka irada tha? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone dobara kaha: Tumne kis niyat se ehram baandha, Ifrad, Qiran, ya Tamattu ke liye? Maine kaha: Maine Talbiya padhi, maine ehram baandha, usi maqsad se jis maqsad se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Talbiya padh rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Tumne achha kiya. Ab Ghar ka tawaaf karo aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudo aur ehram utaaro, kyunki tum apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi laaye. To maine Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi, aur phir Qais qabile ki ek aurat ke paas aaya aur usne mere sar ki jooen saaf kin. Maine phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandha, aur is amal ke mutabik fatwa dete raha yahan tak ki Umar (RA) ki khilafat ke daur mein ek shakhs ne unse kaha: Abu Musa, ya Abdullah bin Qais, apne kuch mazhabi fatwe dene mein ehtiyaat barto, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki Ameer-ul-Momineen ne Hajj ke riti-rivaz mein tumhare baad kya nayi baat pesh ki hai. Isper unhone kaha: Aye logo, jinhe humne, ehram utaarne ke maamle mein, fatwa diya woh intezaar karein, kyunki Ameer-ul-Momineen tumhare paas aane wale hain, aur tumhe unki pairvi karni chahiye. Umar (RA) phir aaye aur maine unse iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Agar hum Allah ki Kitaab ka anusaran karein to hum paate hain ki Allah ki Kitaab ne humein Hajj aur Umra mukammal karne ka hukum diya hai, aur agar hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ka anusaran karein, to hum paate hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tab tak ehram nahi utaara jab tak qurbaani ke jaanwar ko uske ant tak nahi laaya gaya, jab tak use qurbaan nahi kiya gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Abu Musa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was encamping at Batha. He (the Holy Prophet) said: With what purpose have you entered into the state of Ihram? I said: I have entered into the state of Ihram in accordance with the Ihram of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He said: Have you brought sacrificial animals along with you? I said: No. whereupon he said: Then circumambulate the House and run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and put off Ihram. So I circumambulated the House, ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa, and then came to a woman of my tribe. She combed and washed my head. I used to give religious verdict (according to the above mentioned command of the Holy Prophet) during the Caliphate of Abu Bakr and also during that of 'Umar. And it was during the Hajj season that a person came to me and said: You (perhaps) do not know what the Commander of the Believers has introduced in the rites (of Hajj). I said: 0 people, those whom we have given religious verdict about a certain thing should wait, for the Commander of the Believers is about to arrive among you, so follow him. When the Commander of the Believers arrived, I said: What is this that you have introduced in the rites (of Hajj)? -where upon he said: If we abide by the Book of Allah (we find) that there Allah, Exalted and Majestic, has said: Complete Hajj and 'Umra for Allah." And if we abide by the Sunnah of our Apostle (ﷺ) (we find) that the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) did not put off Ihram till he had sacrificed the animals.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur woh Batha mein khema laga rahe the. Unhone kaha: Tumne kis maqsad se ehram baandha? Maine kaha: Maine ehram baandha hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ehram ke mutabik. Unhone kaha: Kya tum apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye ho? Maine kaha: Nahi, isper unhone kaha: Phir Ghar ka tawaaf karo aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudo aur ehram utaaro. To maine Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi, aur phir apne qabile ki ek aurat ke paas aaya. Usne mere sar ko kanghi ki aur dhoya. Main is upar zikr kiye hue Nabi ke hukum ke mutabik fatwa deta raha Abu Bakr aur Umar ki khilafat ke daur mein bhi. Aur ye Hajj ke mausam mein tha ki ek shakhs mere paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhe shayad nahi pata ki Ameer-ul-Momineen ne Hajj ke riti-rivaz mein kya nayi baat pesh ki hai. Maine kaha: Aye logo, jinhe humne kisi khaas baat ke liye mazhabi fatwa diya hai unhe intezaar karna chahiye, kyunki Ameer-ul-Momineen tumhare beech aane wale hain, is liye unki pairvi karo. Jab Ameer-ul-Momineen aaye, maine kaha: Ye kya hai jo aapne Hajj ke riti-rivaz mein pesh ki hai? isper unhone kaha: Agar hum Allah ki Kitaab ka anusaran karein to hum paate hain ki wahan Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ne kaha hai: Allah ke liye Hajj aur Umra mukammal karo. Aur agar hum apne Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ka anusaran karein to hum paate hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tab tak ehram nahi utaara jab tak unhone jaanwaron ki qurbaani nahi de di.

e: Abu Musa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon im) had sent me to Yemen and I came back In the year in which he (the Holy Prophet) performed the (Farewell) Pilgrimage. Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him) said to me: Abu Musa, what did you ' say when you entered into the state of Ihram? I said: At thy beck and call; my (Ihram) is that of the Ihram of Allah's Apostle (May peace be upon him). He said: Have you brought the sacrificial animals? I said: No. Thereupon he said: Go and circumambulate the House, and (run) between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and then put off Ihram. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Yemen bheja tha aur main us saal wapas aaya jab unhone Vida ka Hajj kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Abu Musa, jab tumne ehram baandha to tumne kya kaha? Maine kaha: Main haazir hoon; mera ehram Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ehram ke mutabik hai. Unhone kaha: Kya tum qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye ho? Maine kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Jao aur Ghar ka tawaaf karo, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudo aur phir ehram utaaro. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Musa, (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he used to deliver religious verdict in favor of Hajj Tamattu'. A person said to him: Exercise restraint in delivering some of your religious verdicts, for you do not know what the Commander of Believers has introduced in the rites (of Hajj) after you (when you were away in Yemen). He (Abu Musa, ) met him (Hadrat Umar) subsequently and asked him (about it), whereupon 'Umar said: I know that Allah's Apostle (May peace be upon him) and also his Companions did that (observed Tamattu'), but I do not approve that the married persons should have intercourse with their wives under the shade of the trees, and then set out for Hajj with water trickling down from their heads.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh Hajj Tamattu ke haq mein mazhabi fatwa dete the. Ek shakhs ne unse kaha: Apne kuch mazhabi fatwe dene mein ehtiyaat barto, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki Ameer-ul-Momineen ne Hajj ke riti-rivaz mein tumhare baad kya nayi baat pesh ki hai, jab tum Yemen mein door the. Unhone baad mein unse mulaqaat ki aur unse iske baare mein poocha, isper Umar ne kaha: Mujhe pata hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba ne aisa kiya, Tamattu kiya, lekin main ye pasand nahi karta ki shaadishuda log darakhton ki chhaaya mein apni zaujaon ke saath jinsi milaap karein, aur phir Hajj ke liye nikalein apne saron se paani tapkata hua.

e: 'Abdullah b. Shaqiq reported that 'Uthman (Allah be pleased with him) used to forbid Tamattu', whereas 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) ordered to do it. 'Uthman said a word to 'Ali, but 'Ali said: You know that we used to perform Tamattu' with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: It is right, but we entertained fear.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne bayan kiya ki Uthman (RA) Tamattu se mana kiya karte the, jabki Ali (Alayhis Salam) isse karne ka hukum dete the. Uthman ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se ek baat kahi, lekin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Aapko pata hai ki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Tamattu kiya karte the, isper unhone kaha: Ye sahi hai, lekin humein dar tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ne isi sanad se bayan ki hai.

e: Sa'id b. al-Musayyab reported that 'Ali and 'Uthman (Allah be pleased with them) met at 'Usfan; and Uthman used to forbid (people) from performing Tamattu' and 'Umra (during the period of Hajj), whereupon 'Ali said: What is your opinion about a matter which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did but you forbid it? Thereupon Uthman said: You leave us alone, whereupon he ('Ali) said: I cannot leave you alone. When 'Ali saw this, he put on Ihram for both of them together (both for Hajj and 'Umra).
hi: Sa'id bin al-Musayyab ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman (RA) Usfan mein mile; aur Uthman logon ko Tamattu aur Umra, Hajj ke daur mein, karne se mana kiya karte the, isper Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Aapki us maamle mein kya raay hai jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya lekin aap mana karte hain? Isper Uthman ne kaha: Humein akela chhod do, isper unhone kaha: Main aapko akela nahi chhod sakta. Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ye dekha, unhone dono ke liye ekasath ehram baandha, Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye.

e: Abu Dharr (Allah be pleased with him) said that Tamattu' in Hajj was a special (concession) only for the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha ki Hajj mein Tamattu sirf Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye ek khaas chhoot thi.

e: Abu Dharr (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Tamattu' in Hajj was a special concession for us.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hajj mein Tamattu humare liye ek khaas chhoot thi.

e: Abu Dharr (Allah be pleased with him) said: Two are the Mut'as which were not permissible but only for us, i. e. temporary marriage with women and Tamattu' in Hajj.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: Do Mut'a hain jo sirf hamare liye jaayez the, yaani auraton ke saath muqarrar muddat ki shaadi aur Hajj mein Tamattu.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi al-Sha'tha' reported: I came to Ibrahim al-Nakha'I and Ibrahim Taimi and said: I intend to combine 'Umra and Hajj this year, whereupon Ibrahim al-Nakha'i said: But your father did not make such intention. Ibrahim narrated on the authority of, his father that he passed by Abu Dharr (Allah be pleased with him) at Rabdha, and made a mention of that, whereupon he said: It was a special concession for us and not for you.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu al-Sha'tha ne bayan kiya: Main Ibrahim al-Nakha'i aur Ibrahim Taimi ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mera iraada is saal Umra aur Hajj ko jodkar karne ka hai, isper Ibrahim al-Nakha'i ne kaha: Lekin aapke waalid ne aisa iraada nahi rakha. Ibrahim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki woh Rabdha mein Abu Dharr (RA) ke paas se guzre, aur iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye humare liye ek khaas chhoot thi, tumhare liye nahi.

e: Ghunaim b. Qais said: I asked Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) about Mut'a, whereupon he said: We did that, and it was the day when he was an unbeliever living in (one of the) houses of Mecca.
hi: Ghunaim bin Qais ne kaha: Maine Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (RA) se Mut'a ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Humne aisa kiya, aur ye us din tha jab woh Makkah ke ghar mein rehte hue kaafir the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters and in his narration (he) refers to Mu'awiya.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unki riwayat mein woh Muawiya ka zikr karte hain.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sulaiman (but with a slight modification of words).
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Mutarrif reported: 'Imran b. Husain said to me: Should I not narrate to you a hadith today by which Allah will benefit you subsequently-and bear in mind that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made some members of his family perform 'Umra within ten days of Dhu'l-Hijja. No verse was revealed to abrogate that, and he (the Holy Prophet) did not refrain from doing it till he died. So after him everyone said as he liked, (but it would be his. personal opinion and not the verdict of the Shari'ah).
hi: Mutarrif ne bayan kiya: Imran bin Husain ne mujhse kaha: Kya main tumhe aaj ek hadees na sunaun jisse Allah tumhe baad mein faayda dega - aur yaad rakho ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khaandaan ke kuch logon ko Zul-Hijja ke das dinon ke andar Umra karwaya. Koi aayat isse mansookh karne ke liye nazil nahi hui, aur unhone ise karne se apni maut tak parhez nahi kiya. To unke baad har shakhs ne apni marzi ke mutabik kaha, lekin ye unki apni raay hogi, na ki Shariat ka fatwa.

e: This hadith been narrated on the authority of Jurairi with the same chain of transmitters, and Ibn Hatim said in his narration: " A person said according to his personal opinion, and it was Umar."
hi: Ye hadees Jurairi ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur Ibn Hatim ne apni riwayat mein kaha: "Ek shakhs ne apni raay ke mutabik kaha, aur woh Umar the."

e: Imran b. Husain reported: I am narrating to you a hadith by which Allah will benefit you (and the hadith is) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined Hajj and 'Umra, and he did not forbid (this combination) till he died. (Moreover) nothing was revealed in the Holy Qur'an which forbade it. And I was always blessed till I was branded and then it (blessing) was abandoned. I then abandoned branding and it (the blessing was restored).
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya: Main tumhe ek hadees sunaa raha hoon jisse Allah tumhe faayda dega, aur hadees ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar kiya, aur unhone is joran ko mana nahi kiya apni maut tak. Aur Quran mein kuch bhi nazil nahi hua jo ise mana kare. Aur main hamesha barkat mein tha yahan tak ki mujhe daagh diya gaya aur phir woh barkat chali gayi. Maine phir daagh dena chhod diya aur woh barkat wapas aa gayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mutarrif with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mutarrif ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Mutarrif reported: 'Imran b. Husain sent for me during his illness of which he died, and said: I am narrating to you some ahadith which may benefit you after me. If I live you conceal (the fact that these have been transmitted by me), and if I die, then you narrate them if you like (and these are): I am blessed, and bear in mind that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined Hajj and Umra. Then no verse was revealed in regard to it in the Book of Allah (which abrogated it) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not forbid (from doing it). And whatever a person (, Umar) said was out of his personal opinion.
hi: Mutarrif ne bayan kiya: Imran bin Husain ne apni us beemari ke daurane jisse unka intiqaal hua mujhe bulwaaya, aur kaha: Main tumhe kuch hadeesein sunaa raha hoon jo mere baad tumhe faayda pahunchaayein. Agar main zinda rahun to tum ise chhupaana ki ye maine riwayat ki, aur agar main mar jaun, to phir tum chaho to riwayat karo, aur ye hain: Main barkat mein hoon, aur yaad rakho ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar kiya. Phir iske baare mein Allah ki Kitaab mein koi aayat nazil nahi hui jo ise mansookh kare aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse karne se mana nahi kiya. Aur jo bhi ek shakhs, Umar, ne kaha woh unki apni raay se tha.

e: 'Imran b. al-Husain (Allah be pleased with him) said: Know well that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined 'Hajj and 'Umra, and nothing was revealed in the Book (to abrogate it), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) too did not forbid us from (combining) them. And whatever a person said was out of his personal opinion.
hi: Imran bin al-Husain (RA) ne kaha: Achhi tarah jaan lo ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar kiya, aur Kitaab mein kuch bhi nazil nahi hua, isse mansookh karne ke liye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi humein inhe jodkar karne se mana nahi kiya. Aur jo bhi ek shakhs ne kaha woh unki apni raay se tha.

e: 'Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We performed Tamattu' (Hajj and 'Umra combining together) in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and nothing was revealed in the Qur'an (concerning the abrogation of this practice), and whatever a person (Hadhrat 'Umar) said was his personal opinion. 'Imran b. Husain narrated this hadith (in these words also):" Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) performed Hajj Tamattu' and we also performed it along with him."
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Tamattu, Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar, kiya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein, aur Quran mein kuch bhi nazil nahi hua, is riti-rivaz ke mansookh hone ke baare mein, aur jo bhi ek shakhs, Hazrat Umar, ne kaha woh unki apni raay thi. Imran bin Husain ne ye hadees in alfaazon mein bhi riwayat ki: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj Tamattu kiya aur humne bhi unke saath ise kiya."

e: 'Imran b. Husain said: There was revealed the verse of Tamattu' in Hajj in the Book of Allah and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to perform it. and then no verse was revealed abrogating the Tamattu' (form of Hajj), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not forbid to do it till he died. So whatever a person said was his personal opinion.
hi: Imran bin Husain ne kaha: Allah ki Kitaab mein Hajj mein Tamattu ki aayat nazil hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ise karne ka hukum diya. Aur phir Tamattu, Hajj ki shakl, ko mansookh karne wali koi aayat nazil nahi hui, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni wafat tak ise karne se mana nahi kiya. To jo bhi ek shakhs ne kaha woh unki apni raay thi.

e: A hadith like this is transmitted on the authority of Imran b. Husain, but with this variation that he ('Imran) said: We did that (Tamattu') in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he did not say anything but he (the Holy Prophet) commanded us to do it.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Imran bin Husain ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone kaha: Humne aisa, Tamattu, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein kiya aur unhone kuch nahi kaha, balki unhone humein aisa karne ka hukum diya.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed Tamattu' in Hajjat-ul-Wada'. He first put on Ihram for 'Umra and then for Hajj. and then offered animal sacrifice. So he drove the sacrificial animals with him from Dhu'l-Hulaifa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commenced Ihram of Umra and thus pronounced Talbiya for 'Umra. and then (put on Ihram for Hajj) and pronounced Talbiya for Hajj. And the people performed Tamattu' in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). They put on Ihram for Umra (first) and then for Hajj. Some of them had sacrificial animals which they had brought with them, whereas some of them had none to sacrifice. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mecca, he said to the people: He who amongst you has brought sacrificial animals along with him must not treat as lawful anything which has become unlawful for him till he has completed the Hajj; and he, who amongst you has not brought the sacrificial animals should circumambulate the House, and run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and clip (his hair) and put off the Ihram, and then again put on the Ihram for Hajj and offer sacrifice of animals. But he who does not find the sacrificial animal, he should observe fast for three days during the Hajj and for seven days when he returns to his family. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated (the House) when he came to Mecca: he first kissed the corner (of the Ka'ba containing the Black Stone), then ran in three circuits out of seven and walked in four circuits. And then when he had finished the circumambulation of the House he observed two rak'ahs of prayer at the Station (of Ibrahim), and then pronounced Salaam (for concluding the rak'ahs), and departed and came to al-Safa' and ran seven times between al-Safa' and al-Marwa. After that he did not treat anything as lawful which had become unlawful till he had completed his Hajj and sacrificed his animal on the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja). and then went back quickly (to Mecca) and performed circumambulation of the House (known as tawaf ifada) after which all that was unlawful for him became lawful; and those who had brought the sacrificial animals along with them did as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj mein Tamattu kiya. Unhone pehle Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur phir Hajj ke liye, aur phir jaanwar ki qurbaani di. To unhone Dhu'l-Hulaifa se apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umra ka ehram shuru kiya aur is tarah Umra ke liye Talbiya padhi, aur phir Hajj ke liye ehram baandha aur Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhi. Aur logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein Tamattu kiya. Unhone Umra ke liye ehram baandha pehle aur phir Hajj ke liye. Unmein se kuch ke paas qurbaani ke jaanwar the jo woh apne saath laaye the, jabki kuch ke paas qurbaani karne ke liye kuch nahi tha. To jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah aaye, unhone logon se kaha: Jo tum mein se apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaya hai use woh cheez jaayez nahi maanni chahiye jo uske liye napasandeeda ho gayi hai jab tak woh Hajj mukammal na kar le; aur jo tum mein se qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi laaya use Ghar ka tawaaf karna chahiye, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudna chahiye aur apne baal katvaana chahiye aur ehram utaarna chahiye, aur phir Hajj ke liye dobara ehram baandhna chahiye aur jaanwaron ki qurbaani deni chahiye. Lekin jise qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi milta, use Hajj ke dauran teen din roza rakhna chahiye aur jab woh apne gharwalon ke paas laut ta hai to saat din. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya jab woh Makkah aaye: unhone pehle konay, Kaaba ka jismein Kaala Patthar hai, ko chooma, phir saat mein se teen chakkaron mein daude aur char chakkaron mein chale. Aur phir jab unhone Ghar ka tawaaf mukammal kiya to unhone Maqam Ibrahim mein do rakat namaz padhi, aur phir Salaam kaha, rakaton ko khatam karne ke liye, aur wahan se chal diye aur al-Safa aaye aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech saat baar daude. Iske baad unhone kisi cheez ko jaayez nahi maana jo napasandeeda ho gayi thi jab tak unhone apna Hajj mukammal nahi kiya aur qurbaani ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, apna jaanwar qurbaan nahi kiya, aur phir jaldi wapas gaye, Makkah, aur Ghar ka tawaaf kiya jise Tawaf Ifada kaha jaata hai jiske baad unke liye jo bhi napasandeeda tha woh jaayez ho gaya; aur jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye the unhone waisa hi kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha. The wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), concerning his Tamattu' of Hajj and 'Umra and performing of Tamattu' by people in his company.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ki sanad se bayan ki gayi hai, unke Hajj aur Umra ke Tamattu ke baare mein aur unki sohbat mein logon ke zariye Tamattu karne ke baare mein.

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her), the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: Messenger of Allah. what about people who have put off Ihram whereas you have not put it off after your 'Umra? He said: I have stuck my hair and have driven my sacrificial animal, and would not, therefore, put off Ihram until I have sacrificed the animal.
hi: Hafsa (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, un logon ka kya jinhone ehram utaar diya jabki aapne apne Umra ke baad ehram nahi utaara? Unhone kaha: Maine apne baalon ko chipkaya hai, khushboo se, aur main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaya hoon, is liye main tab tak ehram nahi utaaronga jab tak main jaanwar ki qurbaani na de dun.

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I said: Messenger of Allah what is the matter with you that you have not put off Ihram? The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool aapko kya hua hai ki aapne ehram nahi utaara? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is the matter with people that they have put off Ihram, whereas you have not put it off after your Umra'? He said: I have driven my sacrificial animal and stuck my hair, and it is not permissible for me to put off Ihram unless I have completed the Hajj.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Logon ko kya hua hai ki unhone ehram utaar diya, jabki aapne apne Umra ke baad ise nahi utaara? Unhone kaha: Main apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaya hoon aur apne baalon ko chipkaaya hai, aur mere liye ehram utaarna jaayez nahi hai jab tak main Hajj mukammal na kar lun.

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) said: Messenger of Allah; the rest of the hadith is the same and (the concluding words of the Holy Prophet):" I won't put off Ihram until I have sacrificed the animal."
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool; baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur Nabi ke aakhri alfaaz: "Main ehram nahi utaaronga jab tak main jaanwar ki qurbaani na de dun."

e: Hafsa (Allah be pleased with her) said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded his wives that they should put off Ihram during the year of Hajj (at-ul-Wada'). whereupon she (Hafsa) said: What hinders you that you have not put off Ihram? Thereupon he said: I have stuck my hair and driven my sacrificial animal along with men and it is not permissible to put off Ihram (under this condition until I have sacrificed the animal.
hi: Hafsa (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko hukum diya ki woh Vida ke Hajj ke saal ehram utaar dein, isper unhone kaha: Aapko kya rok raha hai ki aapne ehram nahi utaara? Isper unhone kaha: Maine apne baalon ko chipkaaya hai aur logon ke saath apne qurbaani ke jaanwar laaya hoon aur is shart mein ehram utaarna jaayez nahi hai jab tak main jaanwar ki qurbaani na de dun.

e: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) set out for Umra during the turmoil, and he said: If I am detained (from going to) the House, we would do the same as we did with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So he went out and put on Ihram for 'Umra and moved on until he reached al-Baida'. He turned towards his Companions and said: There is one command for both of them. and 1 call you as my witness (and say) that verify I have- made Hajj with 'Umra compulsory for me. He proceeded until, when he came to the House, he circumambulated it seven times and ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa seven times, and made no addition to it and thought it to be sufficient for him and offered sacrifice.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) Umra ke liye nikle utpaat ke daurane, aur unhone kaha: Agar mujhe Ghar tak jaane se roka jaata hai, to hum wahi karenge jo humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath kiya tha. To woh bahar gaye aur Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur aage badhe yahan tak ki woh al-Baida pahunche. Woh apne saathiyon ki taraf mude aur kaha: In dono, Hajj aur Umra, ke liye ek hi hukum hai, aur main tumhe gawaah banata hoon aur kehta hoon ki maine Hajj ko Umra ke saath apne liye laazim kar liya hai. Woh aage badhe yahan tak ki, jab woh Ghar pahunche, unhone uska saat baar tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech saat baar daude, aur ismein koi izafa nahi kiya aur ise apne liye kaafi samjha aur qurbaani di.

e: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Abdullah and Salim b. Abdullah said to 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) at the time when Hajjaj came to fight against Ibn Zubair: There would be no harm if you do not (proceed) for Hajj this year, for we fear that there would be fight among people which would cause obstruction between you and the House, whereupon he said: If there would be obstruction between me and that (Ka'ba), I would do as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did. I was with him (the Holy Prophet) when the infidels of Quraish caused obstructions between him (the Holy Prophet) and the House. I call you as my witness (to the fact) that I have made 'Umra essential for me. He proceeded until he came to Dhu'l-Hulaifa and pronounced Talbiya for Umra, and said: If the way Is clear forme, I would then complete my 'Umra but If there is some obstruction between me and that (the Ka'ba). I would then do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done (at the occasion of Hudaibiya), and I was with him (the Holy Prophet). and then recited:" Verily in the Messenger of Allah, there is a model pattern for you" (xxxiii. 21). He then moved on until he came to the rear side of al-Baida' and said: There is one command for both of them automatically) (Hajj and Umra). If I am detained (in the performance) of 'Umra, I am ( automatically detained (in the performance) of Hajj (too). I call you as witness that Hajj along with 'Umra I had made essential for me. (I am performing Hajj and 'Umra as Qiran.) He then bought sacrificial animals at Qudaid and then circumambulated the House and ran between al-Safa' and al-Marwa once (covering both Hajj and Umra), and did not put off Ihram until on the Day of Sacrifice in the month of Dhu'l-Hijja.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Abdullah aur Salim bin Abdullah ne Abdullah bin Umar se us waqt kaha jab Hajjaj Ibn Zubair se ladne aaya: Koi nuksaan nahi hoga agar aap is saal Hajj ke liye na jaayein, kyunki humein dar hai ki logon mein jung hogi jo aapke aur Ghar ke beech rukaawat banegi, isper unhone kaha: Agar mere aur uske Kaaba beech rukaawat aayi, to main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha. Main unke saath tha jab Quraish ke kaafiron ne unke aur Ghar ke beech rukaawat daali. Main tumhe gawaah banata hoon is baat ka ki maine Umra ko apne liye laazim kar liya hai. Woh aage badhe yahan tak ki woh Dhu'l-Hulaifa pahunche aur Umra ke liye Talbiya padhi, aur kaha: Agar raasta mere liye saaf hai, to main phir apni Umra mukammal karunga lekin agar mere aur uske Kaaba beech koi rukaawat hai, to main phir wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha, Hudaibiya ke mauqe par, aur main unke saath tha. Aur phir padha: "Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye ek namoona hai" (33:21). Woh phir aage badhe yahan tak ki woh al-Baida ke pichhle hisse tak pahunche aur kaha: In dono, Hajj aur Umra, ke liye khud-b-khud ek hi hukum hai. Agar mujhe Umra ke ada karne mein roka jaata hai, to main khud-b-khud Hajj bhi ada karne mein ruk jaunga. Main tumhe gawaah banata hoon ki maine Hajj ko Umra ke saath apne liye laazim kar liya hai, main Hajj aur Umra Qiran ke taur par ada kar raha hoon. Woh phir Qudaid mein qurbaani ke jaanwar khareede aur phir Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech ek baar daude, Hajj aur Umra dono ko cover karte hue, aur unhone ehram tab tak nahi utaara jab tak Zul-Hijja mahine ke qurbaani ke din nahi aaya.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar intended to go to Hajj (during the year) when Hajjaj attacked Ibn Zubair, and he narrated the account as (narrated above), and he used to say at the end of the hadith: He who combines Hajj with Umra, for him one single circumambulation is sufficient, and he did not put off Ihram until he had completed both of them.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne Hajj ke liye jaane ka iraada kiya us saal jab Hajjaj ne Ibn Zubair par hamla kiya, aur unhone woh riwayat ki jaisi upar bayan hui, aur woh hadees ke akhir mein kaha karte the: Jo bhi Hajj aur Umra ko jodta hai, uske liye ek hi tawaaf kaafi hai, aur unhone tab tak ehram nahi utaara jab tak unhone dono mukammal nahi kar liye.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar intended to go for Hajj during the year when Hajjaj attacked Ibn Zubair. It was said to him: There is a state of war between people and we fear that they would detain you, whereupon he ('Abdullah b. Umar) said:" Verily in the Messenger of Allah there is a model pattern for you." I would do as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did. I call you as witness that I have undertaken to perform 'Umra. He then set out until, when he reached the rear side of al-Baida', he said: There is one command both for Hajj and Umra. so bear witness. Ibn Rumh said: I call you as witness that I have undertaken to perform my Hajjalong with my Umra (i. e. I am performing both of them as Qiran), and he offered the sacrifice of animals which he had bought at Qudaid. He then proceeded pronouncing Talbiya for both of them together until he reached Mecca, He circumambulated the House. and (ran) between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and made no addition to it. He neither sacrificed the animal, nor got his head shaved, nor got his hair clipped, nor did he make anything lawful which was unlawful (due to Ihram) until it was the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja). He then offered sacrifice, and got his hair cut, and saw that circumambulation of Hajj and 'Umra was complete with the first circumambulation. Ibn 'Umar said: This is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne Hajj ke liye jaane ka iraada kiya us saal jab Hajjaj ne Ibn Zubair par hamla kiya. Unse kaha gaya: Logon mein jung ki halat hai aur humein dar hai ki woh aapko rokenge, isper unhone kaha: "Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye ek namoona hai." Main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya. Main tumhe gawaah banata hoon ki maine Umra karne ka iraada kar liya hai. Woh phir nikle yahan tak ki, jab woh al-Baida ke pichhle hisse pahunche, unhone kaha: Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye ek hi hukum hai, is liye gawaah raho. Ibn Rumh ne kaha: Main tumhe gawaah banata hoon ki maine apna Hajj apni Umra ke saath karne ka iraada kar liya hai, yaani main dono Qiran ke taur par ada kar raha hoon, aur unhone woh jaanwar qurbaan kiye jo unhone Qudaid mein khareede the. Woh phir dono ke liye ekasath Talbiya padhte hue aage badhe yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche. Unhone Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude aur ismein koi izafa nahi kiya. Unhone na to jaanwar ki qurbaani di, na apna sar mundwaaya, na apne baal katvaaye, na hi unhone kuch bhi jaayez samjha jo napasandeeda tha, ehram ki wajah se, jab tak qurbaani ka din, 10 Zul-Hijja, nahi aaya. Unhone phir qurbaani di, aur apne baal katvaaye, aur dekha ki Hajj aur Umra ka tawaaf pehle tawaaf se hi mukammal ho gaya tha. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi tarah kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated from Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters except with (this variation) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was mentioned in the first part of the hadith,. i. e. when it was said to him: They would bar you (from going) to the House. He said: In that, case I would do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done. He did not mention at the end of this hadith (i. e. these words):" This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had done," as it Is narrated by al-Laith.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq ke ki hadees ke pehle hisse mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka zikr hua tha, yaani jab unse kaha gaya: Woh tumhe Ghar tak jaane se rokenge. Unhone kaha: Us surat mein main wahi karunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya. Unhone is hadees ke akhir mein iska zikr nahi kiya, yaani ye alfaaz: "Ye waisa hi hai jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha," jaisa al-Laith ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Nafi' thus reported on the authority of Ibn Umar: We entered into the state of Ihram with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Hajj Mufrad and in the narration of Ibn 'Aun (the words are):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram (with the intention) of Hajj Mufrad."
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar ke hawale se yun riwayat ki: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj Mufrad ke liye ehram baandha aur Ibn Aun ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj Mufrad ke iraade se ehram baandha."

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard Allah's Apostle (way peace be upon him) pronouncing Talbiya for both Hajj and Umra. Bakr (one of the narrators) said: I narrated it to Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: He (the Holy Prophet) pronounced the Talbiya for Hajj alone. I met Anas and narrated to him the words of Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: You treat us not but only as children. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya both for 'Umra and Hajj.
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hajj aur Umra dono ke liye Talbiya padhte suna. Bakr, ek raawi, ne kaha: Maine ye Ibn Umar ko riwayat ki, isper unhone kaha: Unhone sirf Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhi. Main Anas se mila aur unhe Ibn Umar ke alfaaz bataaye, isper unhone kaha: Tum hamein sirf bacchon jaisa maante ho. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Umra aur Hajj dono ke liye Talbiya padhte suna.

e: Bakr b. 'Abdullah reported: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) had narrated to us that he saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) combining Hajj and 'Umra. He (Bakr) said: I asked (about it) from Ibn 'Umar, whereupon he said: We entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj (only). I came to Anas and told him what Ibn Umar had said, whereupon he remarked: (You are treating us) as if we were children.
hi: Bakr bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Anas (RA) ne humein riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hajj aur Umra ko jodkar karte dekha. Unhone kaha: Maine iske baare mein Ibn Umar se poocha, isper unhone kaha: Humne sirf Hajj ke liye ehram baandha. Main Anas ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya jo Ibn Umar ne kaha tha, isper unhone kaha: Tum hamare saath waisa vyavahaar kar rahe ho jaise hum bachche hon.

e: Wabara reported: While I was sitting in the company of Ibn 'Umar, a person came to him and said: Is it right for me to circumambulate the House before I come to stay (at 'Arafat)? Ibn 'Umar said: Yes. whereupon he said: Ibn Abbas, however, says: Do not circumambulate the House until you come to stay at 'Arafat. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Performed the Hajj and circumambulated the House before coming to stay (at 'Arafat). If you say the Truth, is it more rightful to follow the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) or the words of Ibn Abbas?
hi: Wabara ne bayan kiya: Jab main Ibn Umar ki sohbat mein baitha tha, ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Kya mere liye jaayez hai ki main Ghar ka tawaaf karun isse pehle ki main Arafat mein theherne aaun? Ibn Umar ne kaha: Haan, isper unhone kaha: Ibn Abbas, halaanki, kehte hain: Ghar ka tawaaf mat karo jab tak tum Arafat mein theherne na aa jao. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj kiya aur Ghar ka tawaaf theherne, Arafat mein, se pehle kiya. Agar tum sach kehte ho, to kya Nabi (SAW) ki baat ki pairvi karna zyada haq hai ya Ibn Abbas ke alfaazon ki?

e: Wabara reported: A person asked Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with him): May I circumambulate the House, whereas I have entered-into the state of Ihram for Hajj? Thereupon he said: What prevents you from doing it? He said: I saw the son of so and so showing disapproval of it, and you are dearer to us as compared with him. And we see that he is allured by the world, whereupon he said: Who amongst you and us is not allured by the world? And said (further) ': 'We saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put on Ihram for Hajj and circumambulated the House and run between al Safa' and al-Marwa. And the way prescribed by Allah and that prescribed by His Apostle (ﷺ) deserve more to be followed than the way shown by so and so, if you speak the truth.
hi: Wabara ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Ibn Umar (RA) se poocha: Kya main Ghar ka tawaaf kar sakta hoon, jabki maine Hajj ke liye ehram baandha hai? Isper unhone kaha: Tumhe aisa karne se kya rokta hai? Usne kaha: Maine falan-falan ke bete ko iski aalochana karte dekha, aur aap humare liye unse zyada aziz hain. Aur humein lagta hai ki woh duniya se lalchaaye hue hain, isper unhone kaha: Hum mein se aur tum mein se kaun duniya se lalchaaya nahi hai? Aur aage kaha: Humne dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha aur Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude. Aur woh raasta jo Allah ne muqarrar kiya aur jo Uske Rasool (SAW) ne muqarrar kiya, use us raaste se zyada pairvi karne laayak hona chahiye jo falan-falan ne dikhaaya hai, agar tum sach kehte ho.

e: Amr b. Dinar said: We asked Ibn Umar about a person who came for Umra and circumambulated the House, but he did not run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa, whether he is allowed to (put off Ihram) and have intercourse with his wife. He replied: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated the House seven times and offered two rak'ahs of prayer after staying (at 'Arafat), and ran between al-Safa and al-Marwa seven times." Verily there is in Allah's Messenger a model pattern for you" (xxxill. 21).
hi: Amr bin Dinar ne kaha: Humne Ibn Umar se ek aise shakhs ke baare mein poocha jo Umra ke liye aaya aur Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, lekin usne al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudi nahi ki, kya use ehram utaarne aur apni biwi se jinsi milaap karne ki ijazat hai. Unhone jawab diya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ka saat baar tawaaf kiya aur do rakat namaz padhi, Arafat mein theherne ke baad, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech saat baar daude. "Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool mein tumhare liye ek namoona hai" (33:21).

e: This hadith is narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported: A person from Iraq said to him to inquire from 'Urwa b. Zubair for him whether a person who puts on Ihram for Hajj is allowed to put it off or not as he circumambulates the House. And if he says:" No, it can't be put off," then tell him that there is a person who makes such an assertion. He (Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman) then said: I asked him ( Urwa b. Zubair), where- upon he said: The person who has entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj cannot get out of it unless he has, completed the Hajj I (further) said (to him): (What) if a person makes that assertion? Thereupon he said: It is indeed unfortunate that he makes such an assertion. That person ('Iraqi) then met me and he asked me and I narrated to him (the reply of 'Urwa), whereupon he (the Iraqi) said: Tell him ('Urwa) that a person had informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done that; and why is it that Asma' and Zubair have done like this? He (Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman) said: I went to him and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he ('Urwa) said: Who is he (the 'Iraqi)? I said: I do not know, whereupon he said: What is the matter that he does not come to me himself and ask me? I suppose he is an 'Iraqi. I said: I do not know, whereupon he said: He has told a lie. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed Hajj, and 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) has told me that the first thing with which he commenced (the rituals) when he arrived at Mecca was that he performed ablution and then circumambulated the Ka'ba. Then Abu Bakr performed Hajj and the first thing with which he commenced (the Hajj) as the circumambulation of the Ka'ba and nothing besides it. So did 'Umar. Then 'Uthman performed Hajj and I saw that the first thing with which he commenced the Hajj was the circumambulation of the Ka'ba and nothing besides it. Then Mu'awiya and Abdullah b. 'Umar did that. Then I performed Hajj with my father Zubair b. al-'Awwam, and the first thing with which he commenced (Hajj) was the circumambulation of the House. He then did nothing besides it. I then saw the emigrants (Muhajirin) and the helpers (Ansar) doing like this and nothing besides it. And the last one whom I saw doing like this was Ibn 'Umar. And he did not break it (the Hajj) after performing 'Umra. And Ibn 'Umar is with them. Why don't they ask him (to testify it)? And none amongst those who had passed away commenced (the rituals of Hajj) but by circumambulating the Ka'ba on their (first arrival) and they did not put off Ihram (without completing the Hajj), and I saw my mother and my aunt commencing (their Hajj) with the circumambulation of the House, and they did not put off Ihram. My mother informed me that she came and her sister, and Zubair and so and so for 'Umra, and when they had kissed the corner (the Black Stone, after Sa'i and circumambulation), they put off Ihram. And he (the 'Iraqi) has told a lie in this matter.
hi: Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman ne bayan kiya: Iraq ke ek shakhs ne unse kaha ki woh Urwa bin Zubair se unke liye poochein ki kya ek shakhs jisne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha hai, use ehram utaarne ki ijazat hai jab woh Ghar ka tawaaf karta hai. Aur agar woh kahein: "Nahi, ise utaara nahi ja sakta," to unhe bataao ki ek shakhs hai jo aisa daawa karta hai. Unhone phir kaha: Maine unse poocha, isper unhone kaha: Woh shakhs jisne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha hai woh isse bahar nahi aa sakta jab tak usne Hajj mukammal na kar liya ho. Maine aage unse kaha: Kya agar koi shakhs aisa daawa kare? Isper unhone kaha: Ye waaqai badnaseebi hai ki woh aisa daawa karta hai. Woh shakhs, Iraqi, phir mujhse mila aur usne mujhse poocha aur maine unhe Urwa ka jawab bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Unse bataao ki ek shakhs ne unhe bataaya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya tha; aur ye kyun hai ki Asma aur Zubair ne bhi aisa kiya? Unhone kaha: Main unke paas gaya aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Woh, Iraqi, kaun hai? Maine kaha: Mujhe nahi pata, isper unhone kaha: Usse kya baat hai ki woh khud mere paas nahi aata aur mujhse poochta? Mera khayal hai woh ek Iraqi hai. Maine kaha: Mujhe nahi pata, isper unhone kaha: Usne jhoot kaha hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj kiya, aur Aisha (RA) ne mujhe bataya ki sabse pehla kaam jo unhone shuru kiya jab woh Makkah pahunche, ki unhone wuzu kiya aur phir Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya. Phir Abu Bakr ne Hajj kiya aur sabse pehla kaam jo unhone shuru kiya woh Kaaba ka tawaaf tha aur uske ilawa kuch nahi. Isi tarah Umar ne bhi kiya. Phir Uthman ne Hajj kiya aur maine dekha ki sabse pehla kaam jo unhone shuru kiya woh Kaaba ka tawaaf tha aur uske ilawa kuch nahi. Phir Muawiya aur Abdullah bin Umar ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Phir maine apne waalid Zubair bin al-Awwam ke saath Hajj kiya, aur sabse pehla kaam jo unhone shuru kiya woh Ghar ka tawaaf tha. Unhone phir uske ilawa kuch nahi kiya. Maine phir Muhajirin aur Ansar ko isi tarah karte dekha aur uske ilawa kuch nahi. Aur aakhri shakhs jise maine aisa karte dekha woh Ibn Umar the. Aur unhone Umra karne ke baad ise, Hajj, nahi toda. Aur Ibn Umar unke saath hai. Woh unse iski tasdeeq karne ko kyun nahi poochte? Aur unmein se koi bhi jo guzar gaye hain unhone apne pahle aane par Kaaba ka tawaaf karke shuru nahi kiya aur unhone ehram nahi utaara, bina Hajj mukammal kiye, aur maine apni maa aur apni khaala ko Ghar ke tawaaf se apna Hajj shuru karte dekha, aur unhone ehram nahi utaara. Meri maa ne mujhe bataya ki woh aur unki behn, aur Zubair aur falan-falan Umra ke liye aaye, aur jab unhone konay, Kaala Patthar, Sa'i aur tawaaf ke baad, ko chooma, to unhone ehram utaara. Aur unhone, Iraqi ne, is maamle mein jhoot bola hai.

e: Asma bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported: We set out (to Mecca) in a state of Ihram. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has the sacrificial animal with him should remain in the state of Ihram, but he who has not the sacrificial animal with him should put off Ihram. As I had not the sacrificial animal with me, I put off Ihram. And since Zubair (her husband) - had the sacrificial animal with him, he did not put off Ihram. She (Asma) said: I put on my clothes and then went out and sat by Zabair, whereupon he said: Go away from me, whereupon I said: Do you fear that I would jump upon you?
hi: Asma bint Abu Bakr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Makkah nikle ehram ki halat mein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar hai use ehram ki halat mein rehna chahiye, lekin jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use ehram utaar dena chahiye. Chunki mere paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi tha, maine ehram utaara. Aur chunki Zubair, unke shohar, ke paas qurbaani ka jaanwar tha, unhone ehram nahi utaara. Unhone kaha: Maine apne kapde pehne aur phir bahar gayi aur Zubair ke paas baith gayi, isper unhone kaha: Mujhse door ho jao, isper maine kaha: Kya aapko dar hai ki main aap par kood padungi?

e: Asma bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with th (m) said: We came for Hajj in the state of Ihram with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same except (for the words) that he (Zubair) said: Keep away from me, keep away from me, whereupon I said: Do you fear that I will jump upon you?
hi: Asma bint Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: Hum Hajj ke liye ehram ki halat mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone, Zubair ne, kaha: Mujhse door raho, mujhse door raho, isper maine kaha: Kya aapko dar hai ki main aap par kood padungi?

e: Abdullah, the freed slave of Asma' bint Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with them), narrated that he used to hear Asma, ' whenever she passed by Hajun, saying (these words): " May there be peace and blessing of Allah upon His Messenger." We used to stay here along with him with light burdens. Few were our rides, and small were our provisions. I performed 'Umra and so did my sister 'A'isha, and Zubair and so and so. And as we touched the House (performed circumambulation and Sa'i) we put off Ihram, and then again put on Ihram in the afternoon for Hajj. Harun (one of the narrators) in one of the narrations said: The freed slave of Asma' and he did not mention 'Abdullah.
hi: Abdullah, Asma bint Abu Bakr (RA) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki ki woh Asma ko sunte the, jab bhi woh Hajun se guzarti thin, ye alfaaz kehte hue: "Allah ke Rasool par salaamati aur uski barkat ho." Hum yahan unke saath halke bojh ke saath theherte the. Hamari sawaariyaan kam thin, aur hamara saamaan chhota tha. Maine Umra kiya aur meri behn Aisha ne bhi, aur Zubair aur falan-falan ne bhi. Aur jab humne Ghar ko chhua, tawaaf aur Sa'i kiya, to humne ehram utaara, aur phir dopahar mein Hajj ke liye phir se ehram baandha. Harun, ek raawi, ne ek riwayat mein kaha: Asma ke aazad kiye hue ghulam ne, aur unhone Abdullah ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Muslim al-Qurri reported: I asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about Tamattu' in Hajj and he permitted it, whereas Ibn Zubair had forbidden it. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: This is the mother of Ibn Zubair who states that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had permitted it, so you better go to her and ask her about it. He (Muslim al-Qurri said): So we went to her and she was a bulky blind lady and she said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted it.
hi: Muslim al-Qurri ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se Hajj mein Tamattu ke baare mein poocha aur unhone ise jaayez maana, jabki Ibn Zubair ne isse mana kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Ye Ibn Zubair ki maa hai jo kehti hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise jaayez kiya tha, is liye behtar hoga ki tum unke paas jao aur unse iske baare mein poochho. Unhone kaha: To hum unke paas gaye aur woh ek bhaari-bharkam andhi aurat thin aur unhone kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise jaayez kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Muslim al-Qurri heardlbn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) saying that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram for Umra and his Companions for Hajj. Neither Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) nor those among his Companions who had brought sacrificial animals with them put off Ihram, whereas the rest (of the pilgrims) did so. Talha b. Ubaidullah was one of those who had brought the sacrificial animals along with them so he did not put off Ihram.
hi: Muslim al-Qurri ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umra ke liye ehram baandha aur unke sahaba ne Hajj ke liye. Na Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne, na hi unke sahaba mein se un logon ne jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye the, ehram utaara, jabki baaki haajiyon ne aisa kiya. Talha bin Ubaidullah un logon mein se ek the jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye the is liye unhone ehram nahi utaara.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation (of words): " Talha and another person also were among those who had not brought the sacrificial animals with them and so they put off Ihram."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is farq, alfaazon mein, ke saath: "Talha aur ek doosra shakhs bhi un logon mein se the jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar nahi laaye the aur is liye unhone ehram utaara."

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that they (the Arabs of pre-Islamic days) looked upon Umra during the months of Hajj as the greatest of sins on the earth. So they intercalated the month of Muharram for Safar and said: When the backs of their camels would become all right and traces (if the pilgrims) would be effaced (from the paths) and the month of Safar would be over, then Umra would be permissible for one who wants to perform it. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and his Companions came in the state of Ihram for performing Hajj on the fourth (of Dhu'l-Hijja) he (Allah's Apostle) commanded them to change their state of Ihram (from Hajj) to that of 'Umra. It was something inconceivable for them. So they said: Messenger of Allah, is it a complete freedom (of the obligation) of Ihram? Thereupon he said: It is a complete freedom (from Ihram).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh, Islam se pehle ke daur ke Arab, Hajj ke mahinon mein Umra karna zameen par sabse bada gunah samajhte the. To woh Safar ke liye Muharram ke mahine mein badlaav laate the aur kehte the: Jab oonton ki peethein theek ho jaayein aur haajiyon ke nishaan raaston se mit jaayein aur Safar ka mahina khatam ho jaaye, tab Umra jaayez ho jaayega us shakhs ke liye jo ise karna chahe. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba Hajj karne ke liye ehram ki halat mein aaye chauthi tareekh ko, Zul-Hijja ki, unhone unhe hukum diya ki woh apne ehram ki haalat, Hajj se, Umra mein badal len. Unke liye ye kuch aisi baat thi jo unki samajh se pare thi. To unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye ehram se poori tarah aazaadi hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ye ehram se poori tarah aazaadi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) 'is reported to have said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on Ihigm for Hajj. When four days of Dhu'l-Hijja were over, he led the dawn prayer, and when the prayer was complete, he said: He who wants to change it to Umra may do so.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha. Jab Zul-Hijja ke char din guzar chuke the, unhone fajr ki namaz padhayi, aur jab namaz mukammal ho gayi, to unhone kaha: Jo ise Umra mein badalna chahe woh aisa kar sakta hai.

e: Rauh and Yahya b. Kathir narrated as Nasr reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered into the state of Ihram for Hajj. And in the narration of Abu Shihab (the words are): We went out with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj, And in an the ahadith (narrated in this connection the words are): He led the morning prayer at al-Batha', except al- jahdami who did not make mention of it.
hi: Rauh aur Yahya bin Kathir ne, jaisa Nasr ne riwayat ki, kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj ke liye ehram baandha. Aur Abu Shihab ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nikle Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhte hue. Aur is silsile mein bayan ki gayi saari hadeeson mein alfaaz hain: Unhone al-Batha mein subah ki namaz padhi, siwaay al-Jahdami ke jinhone iska zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came along with his Companions when four days had passed out of ten days (of Dhu'l-Hijja) and they were pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj, and he (the Holy Prophet) commanded them to change (this Ihram) into that of 'Umra.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne sahaba ke saath aaye jab Zul-Hijja ke das dinon mein se char din guzar chuke the aur woh Hajj ke liye Talbiya padh rahe the, aur unhone unhe hukum diya ki woh ise, ehram, Umra mein badal len.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the morning prayer at Dhu Tawa (a valley near Mecca) and arrived (in Mecca) when four days of Dhul-Hijja had passed and he commanded his Companions that they should change their Ihram (of Hajj) to that of Umra, except those who had brought sacrificial animals with them.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu Tawa, Makkah ke qareeb ek wadi, mein subah ki namaz padhi aur Makkah mein pahunche jab Zul-Hijja ke char din guzar chuke the aur unhone apne sahaba ko hukum diya ki woh apna ehram, Hajj ka, Umra mein badal len, siwaay unke jo apne saath qurbaani ke jaanwar laaye the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: This is the 'Umra of which we have taken advantage. So he who has not the sacrificial animal with him should get out of the state of Ihram completely, for 'Umra has been incorporated in Hajj until the Day of Resurrection,
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye woh Umra hai jiska humne faayda uthaaya hai. Is liye jiske paas qurbaani ka jaanwar nahi hai use ehram se poori tarah bahar aana chahiye, kyunki Umra ko Hajj mein shaamil kar diya gaya hai Qayamat ke din tak.

e: Abu Jam at al-Dubu'i reported: I performed Tamattu' but the people dis- couraged me to do so. I came to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about it. He ordered me to do so. I came to the House (Ka'ba) and slept. I saw a visitant in the dream who said: 'Umra is acceptable and so is the Hajj performed for God's sake. I came to Ibn Abbas and informed him about that Which I saw in the dream whereupon he said: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest This is the Sunnah of Abu'l-Qasim (the Holy Pro- phet) (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Jamra al-Dubu'i ne bayan kiya: Maine Tamattu kiya lekin logon ne mujhe aisa karne se rokna chaaha. Main Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur unse iske baare mein poocha. Unhone mujhe aisa karne ka hukum diya. Main Ghar, Kaaba, ke paas aaya aur soya. Maine khwaab mein ek aane wale ko dekha jisne kaha: Umra qubool hai aur waisa hi Hajj bhi jo Allah ki khaatir kiya jaaye. Main Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur unhe bataaya jo maine khwaab mein dekha tha, isper unhone kaha: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Ye Abu'l-Qasim, Nabi, ki Sunnat hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the Zuhr prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa; then called for his she-camel and marked it on the right side of its bump, removed the blood from it, and tied two sandals round its neck. He then mounted his camel, and when it brought him up to al-Baida', he pronounced Talbiya for the Pilgrimage.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein zohar ki namaz padhi; phir apni oontni bulwaayi, aur uske kohaan ki daayi taraf nishaan lagaaya, uska khoon hataaya, aur uski gardan ke aas-paas do jute baandhe. Woh phir apne oont par sawaar hue, aur jab woh al-Baida tak pahuncha unhe le kar, unhone Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation (of words): " When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Dhu'l-Hulaifa" and he made no mention (of the fact) that he led the Zuhr prayer.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is farq, alfaazon mein, ke saath: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Dhu'l-Hulaifa aaye" aur unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya ki unhone zohar ki namaz padhayi.

e: Abu Hassan al-A'raj reported that a person from Bani Hujaim said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): What is this religious verdict of yours which has engaged the attention of the people or which has become a matter of dispute among them that he who circumambulated the House can be free from Ihram? Thereupon he said: That is the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ), even though you may not approve of it.
hi: Abu Hassan al-A'raj ne bayan kiya ki Banu Hujaim mein se ek shakhs ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Ye aapka kaisa mazhabi fatwa hai jisne logon ki tavajjo apni taraf khainchi hai ya jo unke beech bahas ka mudda ban gaya hai ki jisne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya woh ehram se aazad ho sakta hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ye aapke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat hai, chahe aap ise pasand na karein.

e: Abu Hassan reported: It was said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that this affair had engaged the attention of the people that he who circumambu- lates the House was permitted to circumambulate for Umra (even though he was in a state of Ihram for Hajj), whereupon he said: That is the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ), even though you may not approve of it.
hi: Abu Hassan ne bayan kiya: Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha gaya ki is maamle ne logon ki tavajjo apni taraf khainchi hai ki jisne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya use Umra ke liye tawaaf karne ki ijazat hai, chahe woh Hajj ke liye ehram ki halat mein ho, isper unhone kaha: Ye aapke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat hai, chahe aap ise pasand na karein.

e: Ata' said: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) used to say that a pilgrim or non-pilgrim (one performing 'Umar) who circumambulates the House is free from the responsibility of Ihram. I (Ibn Juraij, one of the narrators) said to 'Ata': On what authority does he (Ibn Abbas) say this? He said: On the authority uf Allah's words:" Then their place of sacrifice is the Ancient House" (al-Qur'an, xxii. 33). I said: It concerns the time after staying at 'Arafat, whereupon he said: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had stated (that the place of sacrifice is the Ancient House) ; it way be after staying at 'Arafat or before (staying there). And he (Ibn Abbas) made this deduction I from the command of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) when he had ordered to put off Ihram on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage.
hi: Ata ne kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) kaha karte the ki ek haaji ya non-haaji, jo Umra kar raha hai, jo Ghar ka tawaaf karta hai woh ehram ki zimmedaari se aazad hota hai. Maine, Ibn Juraij, ek raawi ne, Ata se kaha: Woh Ibn Abbas ye kis buniyaad par kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke alfaazon ki buniyaad par: "Phir unki qurbaani ki jagah puraana Ghar hai" (Quran, 22:33). Maine kaha: Ye Arafat mein theherne ke baad ke waqt se mutalliq hai, isper unhone kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayaan kiya tha, ki qurbaani ki jagah puraana Ghar hai; ye Arafat mein theherne ke baad ho sakta hai ya usse pehle. Aur unhone ye nishkarsh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum se nikaala jab unhone Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par ehram utaarne ka hukum diya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Mu'awiya had said to them: Do you know that I clipped some hair from the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at al- Marwa with the help of a clipper? I said: I do not know it except as it verdict against you.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Muawiya ne unse kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar se kuch baal al-Marwa mein katr kaatne wale aupkaran ki madad se kaate the? Maine kaha: Mujhe iska pata nahi siwaay iske ki ye aapke khilaaf ek fatwa ke soorat mein hai.

e: Ibn Abbis (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Mu'awiya b. Abu Safyin had told him: I clipped the hair (from the head of) Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) with a clipper while he was at al-Marwa, or I saw him getting his hair clipped with a clipper as he was at al-Marwa. 1722
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ne unhe bataya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke baal katr kaatne wale ke saath kaate jab woh al-Marwa mein the, ya maine unhe apne baal katr kaatne wale se katvaate dekha jab woh al-Marwa mein the.

e: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We went out with Allah's messenger (ﷺ) pronouncing loudly the Talbiya for Hajj When we came to Mecca, he commanded us that we should change this (Ihram for Hajj) to that of Umra except one who had brought the sacrificial animal with him. When it was the day of Tarwiya (8th of Dhul-Hijja) and we went to Mini, we (again) pronounced Talbiya for Hajj.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath nikle Hajj ke liye buland aawaaz mein Talbiya padhte hue. Jab hum Makkah pahunche, unhone humein hukum diya ki hum ise, ehram Hajj ke liye, Umra mein badal len siwaay us shakhs ke jo apne saath qurbaani ka jaanwar laaya tha. Jab Tarwiya ka din tha, 8 Zul-Hijja, aur hum Mina gaye, humne phir se Hajj ke liye Talbiya padhi.

e: jibir and Abil Salld al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We went with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and we were pronouncing Talbiya for Hajj loudly.
hi: Jabir aur Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaye aur hum Hajj ke liye buland aawaaz mein Talbiya padh rahe the.

e: Abd Nadra reported: While I was in the company of Jibir, a person came and said: There is difference of opinion amomg Ibn Abbas and Ibn Zubair about two Mut'as (benefits, Tamattul in Hajj and temporary marriage with women), whereupon jibir said: We have been doing this during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), and then 'Umar forbade us to do so, and we never resorted to them.
hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Jab main Jabir ki sohbat mein tha, ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Zubair ke beech do Mut'a, faayde, Hajj mein Tamattu aur auraton ke saath muqarrar muddat ki shaadi, ke baare mein mat-bhinnata hai, isper Jabir ne kaha: Hum ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zindagi mein karte rahe, aur phir Umar ne humein aisa karne se mana kiya, aur humne kabhi phir isse rujoo nahi kiya.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) came from the Yemen, and the Apostle (ﷺ) said: With (what intention) have you put on Ihram? He said: I have put on Ibram in accordance with the intention with which Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has put on Ibram, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Had there not been the sacrificial animals with me, I would have put off Ihram (after performing 'Umra).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yemen se aaye, aur Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kis niyat se tumne ehram baandha? Unhone kaha: Maine ehram baandha hai usi niyat ke mutabik jis niyat se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ehram baandha, isper unhone kaha: Agar mere saath qurbaani ke jaanwar na hote, to main ehram utaar deta, Umra karne ke baad.

e: This hadith is narrated by Salim b. Hayyin with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Salim bin Hayyin ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya for both simultaneously, Talbiya for 'Umra and Hajj. Talbiya for Uwra and Hajj (he performed both Hajj and Umra as a Qarin). In another version words are: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronouncing Talbiya for Umra and Hajj (simultaneously)."
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dono ke liye ekasath Talbiya padhte suna, Umra aur Hajj ke liye Talbiya, Umra aur Hajj ke liye, unhone Hajj aur Umra dono Qarin ke taur par ada kiye. Ek doosri riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Umra aur Hajj ke liye ekasath Talbiya padhte suna."

e: Hanzala al-Aslami reported: I heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) as narrating from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life. Ibn Maryam (Jesus Christ) would certainly pronounce Talbiya for Hajj or for Umra or for both (simultaneously as a Qiran) In the valley of Rauha
hi: Hanzala al-Aslami ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat karte suna jinhone kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, Ibn Maryam, Isa Masih, zaroor Rauha ki wadi mein Hajj ya Umra ke liye ya dono ke liye, ekasath, Qiran ke taur par, Talbiya padhenge.

e: Hanzala b. 'Ali al-Aslaml reported that he had heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: By Him In Whose Hand is my life; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hanzala bin Ali al-Aslami ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Qatida saia. that Anas (Allah be pleased with him) had informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed four 'Umras, all during the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da except the one he performed along with Hajj (and these are) the Umra that he performed from al-Hudaibiya or during the time of (the truce of) Hudaibiya in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da then the Umra of the next year in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da, then the Umra for which b'e had started from ji'rana, the place where he distributed the spoils of (the battle of) Hunain in the month of Dhu'l-Qa'da, and then the 'Umra that he performed along with his Hajj (on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage).
hi: Qatada ne kaha ki Anas (RA) ne unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne char Umre kiye, sab Zul-Qada ke mahine mein siwaay us Umra ke jo unhone Hajj ke saath kiya, aur ye hain: Woh Umra jo unhone al-Hudaibiya se ki, ya Hudaibiya ki sandhi ke daurane, Zul-Qada ke mahine mein, phir agle saal ki Umra Zul-Qada ke mahine mein, phir woh Umra jiske liye woh Ji'rana se shuru huye, woh jagah jahan unhone Hunain ki jung ki daulat taqseem ki, Zul-Qada ke mahine mein, aur phir woh Umra jo unhone apne Hajj ke saath ki, Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par.

e: Qatada said: I asked Anas (Allah be pleased with him) as to how many Pilgrimages had been performed by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he replied: One Hajj and four `Umras were performed by him. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Qatada ne kaha: Maine Anas (RA) se poocha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kitne Hajj kiye, aur unhone jawab diya: Unhone ek Hajj aur char Umre kiye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu lshaq said: I asked Zaid b. Arqam: In how many military expeditions have you participated with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: In seventeen (expeditions). He (Abu Ishaq) said: Zaid b. Arqam reported to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had led nineteen expeditions. And he performed Hajj only once after Migration, and that was the Farewell Pilgrimage. Abu Ishaq also said: The second (Hajj) he performed at Mecca (before his Migration to Medina)
hi: Abu Ishaq ne kaha: Maine Zaid bin Arqam se poocha: Aap kitni fauji muhimon mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath shaamil huye? Unhone kaha: Satrah muhimon mein. Unhone kaha: Zaid bin Arqam ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unnees muhimon ki agvaani ki thi. Aur unhone hijrat ke baad sirf ek baar Hajj kiya, aur woh Vida ka Hajj tha. Abu Ishaq ne ye bhi kaha: Doosra Hajj unhone Makkah mein kiya tha, Madina ki hijrat se pehle.

e: 'Ataa reported that 'Urwa b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) had informed him (this): I and Ibn 'Umar were reclining against the (wall) of the apartment of A'isha and we were listening to the sound produced by the brushing of her teeth. I said Abu Abd al-Rahman (the kunya of 'Abdullah b. Umar), did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) perform 'Umra in the month of Rijab? He said: Yes. I said to 'A'isha: Mother, are you listening to what Abu Abd al-Rabman is saying? She said: What is he Saying? I said: He is saying that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) performed 'Umra during the month of Rajab, whereupon she said: May Allah grant pardon to Abu Abd al-Rahman I By my life he (the Holy Prophet) did not perform 'Umra during the month of Rajab. And never was there an Umra performed by him (the Holy Prophet) in which he ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) did not join him. Ibn 'Umar heard this and said nothing to affirm It or to deny it, but kept quiet.
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya ki Urwa bin Zubair (RA) ne unhe ye bataaya: Main aur Ibn Umar Aisha ke kamre ki deewar se tek lagaaye baithe the aur hum unke daant saaf karne ki aawaaz sun rahe the. Maine kaha, Abu Abd al-Rahman, Abdullah bin Umar ki kunyat, kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Rajab ke mahine mein Umra kiya tha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine Aisha se kaha: Ammi jaan, kya aap sun rahi hain jo Abu Abd al-Rahman keh rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Woh kya keh rahe hain? Maine kaha: Woh keh rahe hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Rajab ke mahine mein Umra kiya, isper unhone kaha: Allah Abu Abd al-Rahman ko maafi de! Meri jaan ki qasam, unhone Rajab ke mahine mein Umra nahi kiya. Aur unhone kabhi koi Umra nahi kiya jismein unhone, Abdullah bin Umar ne, unke saath shaamil na hua ho. Ibn Umar ne ye suna aur na to isse tasdeeq karne ke liye kuch kaha na inkaar karne ke liye, balki khamosh rahe.

e: Mujahid reported: I and 'Urwah b. Zubair entered the mosque and found 'Abdullah b. 'Umar sitting near the apartment of A'ishah and the people were observing the forenoon prayer (when the sun had sufficiently risen). We asked him about their prayer, and he said: It is bid'a (innovation), Urwah said to him: O Abu Abd al-Rahman, how many 'umrahs did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) perform? He said: Four 'umrahs, one he performed during the month of Rajab. We were reluctant either to believe him or reject him. We heard the noise of brushing of her teeth by 'A'ishah in her apartment. 'Urwah said: Mother of the Faithful, are you not hearing what Abi 'Abd al-Rahman is saying? She said: What is he saying? Thereupon he ('Urwah) said: He (Ibn 'Umar) states that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) performed four 'umrahs and one of them during the month of Rajab. Thereupon she remarked: May Allah have mercy upon Abu 'Abd al-Rahman. Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) perform 'Umrah in which he did not accompany him, and he (Allah's Apostle) never performed 'Umrah during the month of Rajab.
hi: Mujahid ne bayan kiya: Main aur Urwa bin Zubair masjid mein daakhil huye aur Abdullah bin Umar ko Aisha ke kamre ke qareeb baithe paaya aur log dopahar se pehle ki namaz, chasht ki namaz jab suraj kaafi upar aa chuka ho, padh rahe the. Humne unse unki namaz ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Ye bidaat hai. Urwa ne unse kaha: Aye Abu Abd al-Rahman, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kitne Umre kiye? Unhone kaha: Char Umre, ek unhone Rajab ke mahine mein kiya. Hum unpar bharosa karne ya use radd karne mein hichkichaaye. Humne Aisha ke daant saaf karne ki aawaaz unke kamre mein suni. Urwa ne kaha: Momino ki maa, kya aap sun nahi rahin jo Abu Abd al-Rahman keh rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Woh kya keh rahe hain? Isper unhone kaha: Woh Ibn Umar kehte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne char Umre kiye aur unmein se ek Rajab ke mahine mein. Isper unhone kaha: Allah Abu Abd al-Rahman par rehmat kare. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi koi Umra nahi kiya jismein unhone, Ibn Umar ne, unke saath saath na diya ho, aur unhone kabhi Rajab ke mahine mein Umra nahi kiya.

e: Ataa reported: I heard Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) narrating to us that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a woman of the Ansar (Ibn Abbas had mentioned her name but I have forgotten it): 'What has prevented you that you do not perform Hajj along with us? She said: We have only two camels for carrying water. One of the camels has been taken by my husband and my son for performing Hajj and one has been left for us for carrying water, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: So when the month of Ramadan come, perform Umra, for'Umra in this (month) is equal to Hajj (in reward).
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko humein riwayat karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ki ek aurat se kaha, Ibn Abbas ne uska naam liya tha lekin main bhool gaya: Tumhe kis cheez ne roka ki tum humare saath Hajj na karo? Unhone kaha: Hamare paas paani laane ke liye sirf do oont hain. Ek oont mera shohar aur mera beta Hajj ke liye le gaye aur ek humare paas paani laane ke liye chhoda gaya, isper unhone kaha: To jab Ramzan ka mahina aaye, Umra karo, kyunki is mahine mein Umra Hajj ke barabar hai, sawaab mein.

e: Ibn Abbis reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to a woman of the Ansar who was called Umm Sinan: What has prevented you that you did not perform Hajj with us? She said: The father of so and so (i. e. her husband) had only two camels. One of them had been taken away by him (my busbard) and his son for Hajj, whereas the other one is used by our boy to carry water. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Umra during the month of Rawadin would suffice for Hajj or Hajj along with me.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ki ek aurat se kaha jise Umm Sinan kaha jaata tha: Tumhe kis cheez ne roka ki tumne hamare saath Hajj nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Falan-falan ke waalid, yaani unke shohar, ke paas sirf do oont the. Unmein se ek unhone, mere shohar ne, aur unke bete ne Hajj ke liye le liya, jabki doosre ka istemal hamara larka paani laane ke liye karta hai. Isper unhone kaha: Ramzan ke mahine mein Umra Hajj ke liye ya mere saath Hajj ke liye kaafi hoga.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to come out (of Medina) by way of al-Shajarah and entered it by the way of al-Mu'arras and whenever he entered Mecca, he entered it from the upper side and went out of it from the lower side.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Madina se, al-Shajarah ke raaste se nikalte the aur al-Mu'arras ke raaste se daakhil hote the, aur jab bhi woh Makkah mein daakhil hote, woh uske upari hisse se daakhil hote aur uske neechle hisse se bahar nikalte.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters and in the narration transmitted by Zubair (it is mentioned) that the upper side is that'which is at al-Batha
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur Zubair ki riwayat mein ye zikr hai ki upari hissa woh hai jo al-Batha mein hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that when Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) came to Mecca he entered from its upper side and came out from its lower side.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah aaye, unhone uske upari hisse se daakhil hokar uske neechle hisse se bahar nikale.
