e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca during the year of Victory from Kada I. e. from the upper side. Hisham said.. My father entered It from both the Fides, but generally he entered from Kada.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatah ke saal Makkah mein Kada se daakhil huye, yaani upari hisse se. Hisham ne kaha: Mere waalid dono taraf se daakhil huye, lekin aam taur par woh Kada se daakhil hote.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) spent the night at Dhi Tuwa till it was dawn and then entered Mecca. 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) himself did like it. And in the narration transmitted by Ibn Sa'ld (the words are): Until he obrerved the dawn prayer. Yahya (another narrator) said: Until it was dawn.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Dhi Tuwa mein raat guzaari yahan tak ki subah hui aur phir Makkah mein daakhil huye. Abdullah, bin Umar, khud bhi isi tarah karte the. Aur Ibn Sa'id ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Yahan tak ki unhone fajr ki namaz padhi. Yahya, ek doosre raawi, ne kaha: Yahan tak ki subah hui.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) did not enter Mecca without spending the night at Dhi Tawu until it was dawn, when he took a bath, and then entered Mecca in the morning, and made a mention that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did that.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar (RA) Makkah mein bina Dhi Tuwa mein raat guzaare, yahan tak ki subah hui, daakhil nahi hote the, jab woh ghusl karte, aur phir subah Makkah mein daakhil hote, aur zikr kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya tha.

e: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca, he got down at Dhi Tuwa and spend the night there until he observed the dawn prayer. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed this prayer on a rough hillock, and not in the mosque which had been then built there, but to the lower side of it (the mosque) on a hillock.
hi: Abdullah, bin Umar, ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hote, woh Dhi Tuwa mein utarte aur wahan raat guzaarte yahan tak ki woh fajr ki namaz padh lete. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye namaz ek khardare pahaadi par padhi, na ki us masjid mein jo tab wahan banayi gayi thi, balki uske, masjid ke, neechle hisse mein ek pahaadi par.

e: Nafi' reported that Abdullah (b. 'Umar) informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned his face to the two hillocks which intervened between him and the long mountain by the side of the Ka'ba, and the mosque which had been built there was thus on the left of the hillock. Allah's Messenger's (ﷺ) place of prayer was lower than the black hillock, at a distance of ten cubits or near it. He (ﷺ) would then observe prayer facing these two hillocks of the long mountain that is intervening between you and the Ka'ba.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah, bin Umar, ne unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chehra un do pahaadiyon ki taraf kiya jo unke aur Kaaba ke qareeb wale lambe pahaad ke beech thi, aur woh masjid jo wahan banayi gayi thi is tarah pahaadi ki baayi taraf thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ki jagah kaali pahaadi se neeche thi, das haath ki doori par ya uske qareeb. Woh phir namaz padhte in do pahaadiyon ka rukh karte, us lambe pahaad ka jo tumhare aur Kaaba ke beech mein hai.

e: Nafi' reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated the House, while observing the first circumambulation, he walked swiftly in three (circuits), and walked in four circuits, and ran in the bottom of the valley as he moved between al-Safa and al-Marwa. Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) also used to do like this.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya, pehla tawaaf karte waqt, woh teen chakkaron mein tez chale, aur char chakkaron mein aaram se chale, aur wadi ke tale mein daude jab woh al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech chalte. Ibn Umar (RA) bhi isi tarah karte the.

e: Ibn'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated in Hajj and Umra he walked swiftly in the first three circuit about the House, and then walked in four circuits, and then observed two rak'ahs of prayer, and then ran between al-Safa and al-Marwa.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umra mein tawaaf kiya, woh Ghar ke pehle teen chakkaron mein tez chale, aur phir char chakkaron mein chale, aur phir do rakat namaz padhi, aur phir al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I saw that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mecca and kissed the Black Stone, (in the first circumambulation) he moved quickly in three circuits out of seven circuits.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine dekha ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah aaye aur Kaale Patthar ko chooma, pehle tawaaf mein, woh saat mein se teen chakkaron mein tez chale.

e: Nafi' reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walked swiftly from stone to stone in three circuits and walked (normally) in four.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek patthar se doosre patthar tak teen chakkaron mein tez chale aur char mein, normal soorat se, chale.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn Umar (Allah he pleased with them) walked swiftly from stone to stone, and stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did like this.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar (RA) ek patthar se doosre patthar tak tez chale, aur bayaan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa hi kiya.

e: jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walking swiftly from the Black Stone till he completed three circuits up to it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Kaale Patthar se tez chalte dekha yahan tak ki unhone uske teen chakkar mukammal kiye.

e: Jabir b." Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) walked swiftly in three circuitsfrom stone to stone.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) teen chakkaron mein ek patthar se doosre patthar tak tez chale.

e: Abu Tufail reported: I said to Ibn `Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): Do you think that walking swiftly round the House in three circuits, and just walking in four circuits is the Sunnah (of the Holy Prophet), for your people say that it is Sunnah? Thereupon he (Ibn `Abbas) said: They have told the truth and the lie (too). I said: What do your words "They have told the truth and the lie (too)" imply? Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mecca and the polytheists said that Muhammad and his Companions had emaciated and would, therefore, be unable to circumambulate the House; and they felt jealous of him (the Holy Prophet). (It was due to this) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded them to walk swiftly in three (circuits) and walk (normally) in four. I said to him: Inform me if it is Sunnah to observe Tawaf between al-Safa and al-Marwa while riding, for your people look upon it as Sunnah. He (Ibn `Abbas) said: They have told the truth and the lie too. I said: What do your words "They have told the truth and the lie too" imply? He said: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come to Mecca, there was such a large gathering of people around him that even the virgins had come out of their houses (to catch a glimpse of his face). And they were saying: He is Muhammad; He is Muhammad. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (was so gentle and kind) that the people were not beaten back (to make way) in front of him. When there was a throng (of people) around him, he rode (the she-camel). However, walking and trotting are better.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai ki Ghar ke teen chakkaron mein tez chalna, aur char chakkaron mein sirf chalna Sunnat hai, kyunki aapki qaum kehti hai ki ye Sunnat hai? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone sach bhi kaha hai aur jhoot bhi. Maine kaha: Aapke alfaaz "Unhone sach bhi kaha hai aur jhoot bhi" ka kya matlab hai? Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah aaye aur mushrikeen ne kaha ki Muhammad aur unke sahaba kamzor ho gaye hain aur Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kar payenge; aur unhe unse jalan thi. Isi wajah se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe teen chakkaron mein tez chalne aur char mein normal soorat se chalne ka hukum diya. Maine unse kaha: Mujhe bataiye kya ye Sunnat hai ki al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech sawaari par Tawaf kiya jaaye, kyunki aapki qaum ise Sunnat maanti hai. Unhone kaha: Unhone sach bhi kaha hai aur jhoot bhi. Maine kaha: Aapke alfaaz "Unhone sach bhi kaha hai aur jhoot bhi" ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah aaye, to unke aas-paas itna bada jamavda tha ki kunwari larkiyaan bhi apne gharon se bahar aa gayi thin, unka chehra ek jhalak dekhne ke liye. Aur woh keh rahi thin: Ye Muhammad hain; Ye Muhammad hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW), itne narm aur meherbaan the, ki log unke saamne, raasta banane ke liye, peeche nahi dhakele jaate the. Jab unke aas-paas bheed thi, to woh oontni par sawaar hue. Fir bhi, chalna aur tez-tez chalna behtar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of jurairi with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words (and this is) that he (the narrator) did not say: " They felt jealous of him. but said: The people of Mecca, were jealous people."
hi: Ye hadees Jurairi ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath, aur ye hai, ki unhone nahi kaha: "Unhe jalan thi," balki kaha: "Makkah ke log jalan karne wale log the."

e: Abu Tufail reported: I said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): People are of the view that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) moved quickly round the House and between al-Safa and al-Marwa, and (thus) it is Sunnah. He said: They told the truth and they told the lie.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Log ye maante hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ke aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tez chalna kiya, aur is tarah ye Sunnat hai. Unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha aur unhone jhoot kaha.

e: Abu Tufail reported; I. said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): I think that I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (Ibn 'Abbis) said' Give a description of him to me. I said: I saw him near al-Marwa on the back of a she- camel, and people had thronged around him. Thereupon Ibn'Abbis said: It was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for they (the Compainions of the Holy Prophet) were neither pushed aside from him, nor were they turned away.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Mujhe lagta hai maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha. Unhone kaha: Mujhe unka hulia bataao. Maine kaha: Maine unhe al-Marwa ke qareeb ek oontni ki peeth par dekha, aur log unke aas-paas jama the. Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hi the, kyunki unhe, Nabi ke sahaba ko, na to unse door dhakela jaata tha, na hi unhe hataaya jaata tha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (At lab be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his Companions came to Mecca and the fever in Medina had weakened them. Thereupon the polytheists (of Mecca) said: There would come to you a people whom the fever has made weak and they have suffered severely from it. They sat in Hatim. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded them to walk quickly ift three circuits and walk (in four) between the two corners. so that the polytheists should. see their endurance. The polytheists then said (to one anothery You were under the impression that fever had emaciated them. whereas they are stronger than so and so. Ibn Abbas said: He (the Holy Prophet) did not command them (the Muslims) to walk quickly in all the circuits out of kindness to them.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba Makkah aaye aur Madina mein bukhaar ne unhe kamzor kar diya tha. Isper mushrikeen, Makkah ke, ne kaha: Tumhare paas aisi qaum aane wali hai jise bukhaar ne kamzor kar diya hai aur unhone bahut zyada takleef uthaayi hai. Woh mushrikeen Hatim mein baithe. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya ki woh teen chakkaron mein tez chalein aur do konay ke beech, char mein, chalein, taaki mushrikeen unki sahansheelta dekh sakein. Mushrikeen ne phir ek-doosre se kaha: Tumhe laga tha ki bukhaar ne unhe kamzor kar diya hai, jabki woh falan-falan se zyada mazboot hain. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Unhone unhe, Musalmaanon ko, saare chakkaron mein tez chalne ka hukum nahi diya, unpar meherbaani karte hue.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah. 's Messenger (peace be upon him) observed Sa'i and walked quickly round the House with a view to showing his strength to the polytheists.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Sa'i kiya aur Ghar ka tawaaf tez chalte hue kiya, taaki mushrikeen ko apni taaqat dikha sakein.

e: Ahdullah b. Umar (reported) that he had not seen Allah's Messenger (way peace he upon him) touching anything in the House, except the two Yamani corners.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ghar mein kisi aur cheez ko chhute nahi dekha, siwaay do Yamani konon ke.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father (Allah he pleased with him) that Allah'& Messenger (tinny peace be upon him) did not touch any of the corners of the House. except that of Black Corner (in which the Black Stone is embedded and that (portion) near it, towards the houses of the tribe of jumuhi.
hi: Salim ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ke kisi konay ko nahi chhua, siwaay Kaale Konay ke, jismein Kaala Patthar jaddit hai, aur uske qareeb wale hisse ki taraf, Jumuhi qabile ke gharon ki taraf.

e: Nafi' reported on the authority of 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) did not touch but the Stone and the Yamani corner.
hi: Nafi ne Abdullah (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sirf Patthar aur Yamani konay ko chhua.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I have not abandoned touching of Yamani corners (and kissing of) the Stone since I saw Allah's messneger (ﷺ) touching them both In hardship and ease.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Yamani konon ko chhoona aur Patthar ko chooma chhodna nahi chhoda hai jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dono ko chhute dekha mushkil aur aasaan dono halaton mein.

e: NAfi' (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw'lbn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) touching the Stone with his hand and then kissing his hand. and he said: I have never abandoned it since I saw Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) doing It.
hi: Nafi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko apne haath se Patthar ko chhoote aur phir apne haath ko chumte dekha, aur unhone kaha: Maine ise kabhi nahi chhoda hai jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa karte dekha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) is reported to have said that he did not see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching other than the Yamani corners.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Yamani konon ke ilawa kisi aur ko chhute nahi dekha.

e: Salim narrated on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that 'Umar b. al-Khattib (Allah be pleased with him) kissed (the Black Stone) and then said: By Allah, I know that you are a stone and if I were not to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissing you, I would not have kissed you. Harun said in his narration: A hadith like this has been transmitted to me by Zaid b. Aslam on the authority of his father Aslam.
hi: Salim ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne Kaale Patthar ko chooma aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, main jaanta hoon ki tum ek patthar ho aur agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhe chumte na dekha hota, to main tumhe na chumta. Harun ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Isi tarah ki ek hadees mujhe Zaid bin Aslam ne apne walid Aslam ke hawale se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Umar (Allah be pleased with him) kissed the Stone and said: I am kissing you, whereas I know that you are a stone, but I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissing you (that Is why I kiss you).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar (RA) ne Patthar ko chooma aur kaha: Main tumhe chum raha hoon, jabki main jaanta hoon ki tum ek patthar ho, lekin maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhe chumte dekha hai, is liye main tumhe chumta hoon.

e: Abdullah b. Sarjis reported: I saw the bald one, i. e. 'Umar b. Khattib (Allah be pleased with him). kissing the Stone and saying: By Allah. I am kissing with full consciousness of the fact that you are a stone and that you can neither do any harm nor good; and if I had not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissing you. I would not have kissed you. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis ne bayan kiya: Maine mundhe sar wale shakhs ko, yaani Umar bin Khattab (RA) ko, Patthar chumte aur kehte dekha: Allah ki qasam, main iski poori jaankaari ke saath ki tum ek patthar ho aur ki tum na koi nuksaan pahunchaa sakte ho na koi faayda, tumhe chum raha hoon; aur agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhe chumte na dekha hota, to main tumhe na chumta. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abis b. Rabi'a reported: I saw 'Umar (Allah'be pleased with him) kissing the Stone and saying: I am kissing you and I know that you are a stone. And if I had not seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kissing you, I would not have kissed you.
hi: Abis bin Rabi'a ne bayan kiya: Maine Umar (RA) ko Patthar chumte aur kehte dekha: Main tumhe chum raha hoon aur main jaanta hoon ki tum ek patthar ho. Aur agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhe chumte na dekha hota, to main tumhe na chumta.

e: Suwaid b. Ghafala reported: I saw Umar (Allah be pleased with him) kissing the Stone and clinging to it and saying: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having great love for you.
hi: Suwaid bin Ghafala ne bayan kiya: Maine Umar (RA) ko Patthar chumte aur usse chipakte aur kehte dekha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumse bahut mohabbat karte dekha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " That he ('Umar) said: But I saw Abu'l-Qasim (way peace be upon him) having great love for you." And he did not mention about clinging to it.
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Ki unhone, Umar ne, kaha: Lekin maine Abu'l-Qasim, Nabi, ko tumse bahut mohabbat karte dekha." Aur unhone usse chipakne ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated the House on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage on the back of his camel and touched the Corner (of Black Stone) with a stick.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par apne oont ki peeth par Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur ek chhadi se Konay, Kaale Patthar, ko chhua.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulated the House on the back of his riding camel on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and touched the Stone with his stick so that the people should see him, and he should be conspicuous, and they should be able to ask him (questions pertaining to religion) as the people had crowded round him.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par apni sawaari wale oont ki peeth par Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur Patthar ko apni chhadi se chhua taaki log unhe dekh sakein, aur woh saaf-saaf dikhein, aur woh log unse, deeni maamlon mein, sawaal pooch sakein, kyunki log unke aas-paas jama the.

e: jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) circumambulated the House (and ran) between al-Safa and al-Marwa on the back of his she-camel, at the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage. so that the people should see him and he should be conspicuous, and they should be able to ask him (questions pertaining to religion), and the people had crowded round him. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Khashram no mention Is made of: " So that they should ask him."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daude apni oontni ki peeth par, Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par, taaki log unhe dekh sakein aur woh saaf-saaf dikhein, aur woh log unse, deeni maamlon mein, sawaal pooch sakein, aur log unke aas-paas jama the. Ibn Khashram ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Taaki woh unse sawaal poochh sakein."

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) circumambulated the Ka'ba on the back of his camel on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and touched the corner and he did not like that the people should be pushed away from him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par apne oont ki peeth par Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya aur konay ko chhua aur unhe ye pasand nahi tha ki logon ko unse door dhakela jaaye.

e: Abu Tufail reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) circumambulating the House. and touching the corner with a stick that he had with him, and then kissing the stick.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ghar ka tawaaf karte dekha, aur apne saath rakhi chhadi se konay ko chhookar, aur phir chhadi ko chumte hue.

e: Umm Salama reported: I made a complaint to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of my ailment, whereupon be said: Circumambulate behind the people while riding. She said: So I circumambulated and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at that time praying towards the side of the House and he was reciting al-Tur and a Book Inscribed (i. e. Sura Iii. of the Qur'un).
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni beemari ki shikaayat ki, isper unhone kaha: Sawaari par baithkar logon ke peeche tawaaf karo. Unhone kaha: To maine tawaaf kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt Ghar ki taraf mudkar namaz padh rahe the aur woh "al-Tur" aur "ek Likhi Hui Kitaab", yaani Surah 52, Quran ki, tilawat kar rahe the.

e: Hisham b. 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father who narrated from 'A'isha. He said to 'A'isha: I think if a person does not run between al- Safa' and al-Marwa, It does not do any harm to him (so far as Hajj is concerned). She said: Why (do you think so)? I said: For Allah says:" Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah" (ii. 158) (to the end of the verse), whereupon she said: Allah does not complete the Hajj of a person or his Umra if he does not observe Sa'i between al-Safa' and al-marwa; and if it were so as you state, then (the wording would have been (fala janah an la yatufu biha) . Do you know in what context (this verse was revealed)? (It was revealed in this context) that the Ansar in the Days of Ignorance pronounced the Talbiya for two idols. (fixedl on the bank of the river which were called Isaf and Na'ila. The people went there, and then circumambulated between al-Safa' and al-Marwa and then got their heads shaved. With the advent of Islam they (the Muslims) did not like to circumambulate between them as they used to do during the Days of Ignorance. It was on account of this that Allah. the Exalted and Majestic, revealed:" Verily al-Safe and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah" to the end of the verse. She said: Then people began to observe Sa'i.
hi: Hisham bin Urwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone Aisha se riwayat ki. Unhone Aisha se kaha: Mujhe lagta hai agar koi shakhs al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech na daude, to isse use koi nuksaan nahi hota, jahan tak Hajj ka sawal hai. Unhone kaha: Kyun aap aisa sochte hain? Maine kaha: Kyunki Allah kehta hai: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain" (2:158), aayat ke akhir tak, isper unhone kaha: Allah kisi shakhs ka Hajj ya uska Umra mukammal nahi karega agar woh al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech Sa'i na kare; aur agar aisa hota jaisa tum kehte ho, to phir alfaaz hote, fala janah an la yatufu biha. Kya tumhe pata hai ki ye aayat kis silsile mein nazil hui? Ye is silsile mein nazil hui ki Ansar Jaahiliyat ke daur mein do buton, nadi ke kinaare par lage, ke liye Talbiya padhte the jinhe Isaf aur Na'ila kaha jaata tha. Log wahan jaate, aur phir al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf karte aur phir apne sar mundwaate. Islam ke aane par unhe, Musalmaanon ko, unke beech tawaaf karna pasand nahi tha jaisa woh Jaahiliyat ke daur mein karte the. Isi ki wajah se Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne nazil kiya: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain" aayat ke akhir tak. Unhone kaha: Phir log Sa'i karne lage.

e: Hisham b. 'Urwa narrated on the authority of his father who reported: I said to 'A'isha: I do not see any harm to me if I do not circumambulate betweez al-Safa' and al-Marwa. She said: On what ground do you say so? (I said: ) Since Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, says:" Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah." It (your assertion) were (correct), it would have been said like this:" There is no harm for him, that he should not circumambulate between them." It (this verse) has been revealed about the people of Ansar. Whenever they pronounced the Talbiya, they pronounced it in the name of al-Manat during the Days of Ignorance; so they (thought) that it was not permissible for them (for the Muslims) to circumambulate between and al-Marwa. When they (the Muslims) came with Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) for Hajj, they mentioned it to him. So Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed this verse. By my life, Allah will not complete the Hajj of one who has not circumambulated between al-Safa and al-Marwa.
hi: Hisham bin Urwa ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone bayan kiya: Maine Aisha se kaha: Mujhe koi nuksaan nazar nahi aata agar main al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf na karun. Unhone kaha: Kis buniyaad par tum aisa kehte ho? Maine kaha: Kyunki Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, kehta hai: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain." Agar ye tumhara daawa sahi hota, to ye is tarah kaha jaata: "Uske liye koi nuksaan nahi hai, ki woh unke beech tawaaf na kare." Ye aayat Ansar ke logon ke baare mein nazil hui. Jab bhi woh Talbiya padhte, woh Jaahiliyat ke daur mein al-Manat ke naam par isse padhte the; is liye woh soch rahe the ki unke, Musalmaanon ke, liye al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf karna jaayez nahi tha. Jab woh Musalmaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj ke liye aaye, unhone iska zikr unse kiya. To Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki. Meri jaan ki qasam, Allah kisi ka Hajj mukammal nahi karega jisne al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf nahi kiya.

e: 'Urwa b. Zabair reported: I said to 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): I do not see any (fault) in one who does not circumambl" te between al-Safa' and al-Marwa, and I do not mind if I do not circumambulate between them, whereupon she said: O, the son of my sister, what you say is wrong. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed Sa'i and so did the Muslims. So it is a Sunnah (of the Prophet). And it was a common practice (with the pagan Arabs) that those who pronounced Talbiya for the wretched al-Manat, situated at Mushalla, did not observe Sa'i between al-Safa' and al-Marwa. With the advent of Islam, we asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about this practice, and (it was on this occasion) that Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed this verse:" Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah" ; so he who performed Hajj or 'Umra it is no sin on him if he circumambulates them. And if it were as you state, (then the wording would have been):" There is no harm for him, that he should not circumambulate round them." Zuhri said: I made a mention of that to Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al- Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham; he was impressed by that and said: This is what is called knowledge. And I have heard many a scholar saying: Many of the Arabs who did not circumambulate between al-Safa' and al-Marwa caid: Our circumambulation between these two hills is an act of ignorance; whereas others among the Ansar said: We have been commanded to circumambulate the House, and not Commanded to run between al-Safa' and al-Marwa. So Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed thia verse:" Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah." Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman said: I think that this (verse) has been revealed for such and such (persons).
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se kaha: Mujhe us shakhs mein koi khaami nazar nahi aati jo al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf nahi karta, aur mujhe koi farak nahi padta agar main unke beech tawaaf na karun, isper unhone kaha: Aye meri behn ke bete, jo tum keh rahe ho woh galat hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Sa'i ki aur Musalmaanon ne bhi. To ye Sunnat, Nabi ki, hai. Aur ye ek aam riti-rivaz tha, kaafir Arabon ke beech, ki jo log badnaseeb al-Manat, jo Mushalla mein sthit tha, ke liye Talbiya padhte, woh al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech Sa'i nahi karte the. Islam ke aane par, humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is riwaaz ke baare mein poocha, aur isi mauqe par Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain"; is liye jisne bhi Hajj ya Umra kiya use unke tawaaf karne mein koi gunah nahi hai. Aur agar ye waisa hi hota jaisa tum kehte ho, to alfaaz hote: "Uske liye koi nuksaan nahi hai, ki woh unke aas-paas tawaaf na kare." Zuhri ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Abu Bakr bin Abd al-Rahman bin al-Harith bin Hisham se kiya; woh isse prabhaavit hue aur kaha: Yehi hai jise ilm kaha jaata hai. Aur maine kayi ulema ko ye kehte suna hai: Bahut se Arab jinhone al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf nahi kiya kehte the: Hamara in do pahaadiyon ke beech tawaaf karna jaahiliyat ka amal hai; jabki Ansar mein se doosron ne kaha: Humein Ghar ka tawaaf karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, na ki al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech daudne ka. To Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain." Abu Bakr bin Abd al-Rahman ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki ye aayat aise-aise logon ke liye nazil hui.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported: I asked 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) ; the rest of the hadith is the same. And in this hadith (these words are also found):" When they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about this, they said: Messenger of Allah, we felt reluctant to circumambulate between al-Safa' and al-Marwa. Then Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed this verse:" Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of. Allah so he who perform Hajj or Umra it is no sin on him if he should circumambulate between them. 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laid down this Sa'i between them as Sunnah (of the Holy Prophet). So it is not advisable for anyone to abandon this Sa'i between them.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Aur is hadees mein ye alfaaz bhi mile hain: "Jab unhone, Nabi ke sahaba ne, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf karna napasand tha. Phir Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain," is liye jisne bhi Hajj ya Umra kiya use unke beech tawaaf karne mein koi gunah nahi hai." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke beech ye Sa'i Sunnat, Nabi ki, ke taur par sthapit ki. Is liye kisi ke liye ye salaah-laayak nahi hai ki woh unke beech ye Sa'i chhod de.

e: 'Urwa b. Zabair narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) who informed him that the Ansar and the people of the tribe of Ghassan before embracing Islam pronounced Talbiya for Manat, and so they avoided circumambulating between al-Safa' and al-Marwa, and it was a common practice with their forefather, that he who put on Ihram for Manat did not circumambulate between al-Safa' and al-Marwa. And when they embraced Islam, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, and then Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed this verse: " Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah" ; so he who performs Hajj or Umra, for him there is no harm if he should circumambulate between them, and he who does good spontaneously-surely Allah is Bountiful in rewarding and Knowing.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne Aisha (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone unhe bataya ki Ansar aur Ghassan qabile ke log, Islam qubool karne se pehle, Manat ke liye Talbiya padhte the, aur is liye woh al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf karne se bachte the, aur ye unke poorvajon ka ek aam riwaaz tha, ki jo Manat ke liye ehram baandhta woh al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf nahi karta tha. Aur jab unhone Islam qubool kiya, unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, aur phir Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain"; is liye jisne Hajj ya Umra kiya, uske liye unke beech tawaaf karne mein koi nuksaan nahi hai, aur jo apni marzi se achhaai kare - yaqeenan Allah sawaab dene mein sakhi aur sab jaanne wala hai.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Ansar felt reluctant that they should circumambulate between al-Safa' and al-Marwa until it was revealed: " Verily al-Safa' and al-Marwa are among the Signs of Allah" ; so whoever performs Hajj or 'Umra, for him there is no harm that he should circumambulate between them.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ko al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech tawaaf karna napasand tha yahan tak ki ye nazil hua: "Yaqeenan al-Safa aur al-Marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain"; is liye jo bhi Hajj ya Umra karta hai, uske liye unke beech tawaaf karne mein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and his Companions did not observe Sa'i between al-Safa' and al-Marwa but only one Sa'i.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba ne al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech ek se zyada Sa'i nahi ki, sirf ek Sa'i.

e: Ibn Juraij reported on the same authority a hadith like that, and said: But one Tawaf and that was the first Tawaf.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne isi sanad se isi jaisi hadees riwayat ki, aur kaha: Lekin sirf ek Tawaf, aur woh pehla Tawaf tha.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was sitting behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the riding animal from 'Arafat. As Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached the left side of the mountain which was situated near Muzdalifa, he made the camel kneel down and made water and then came back. I poured water and he, performed light ablution. I then said: Messenger of Allah, it is time for prayer. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The prayer awaits you (at the next station, Muzdalifa). Allah's Messenger (may peaced be upon him) rode on until he came to Muzdalifa and observed prayer. Then al-Fadl (Allah be pleased with him) sat behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and reached (Muzdalifa) in the morning. Kuraib said: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) narrated from al-Fadl (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) continued pronouncing Talbiya until he reached al-Jamara (al-'Aqaba).
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Arafat se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaari wale jaanwar par baitha tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us pahaad ki baayi taraf pahunche jo Muzdalifa ke qareeb sthit tha, unhone oont ko bithaya aur peshaab kiya aur phir wapas aaye. Maine paani daala aur unhone halka wuzu kiya. Maine phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, namaz ka waqt aa gaya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Namaz aage, agli padaav, Muzdalifa mein, tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sawaar hote rahe yahan tak ki woh Muzdalifa pahunche aur namaz padhi. Phir al-Fadl (RA) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche baithe aur subah pahunche, Muzdalifa. Kuraib ne kaha: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne al-Fadl (RA) se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Talbiya padhna jaari rakha yahan tak ki woh al-Jamara, al-Aqaba, pahunche.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) made al-Fadl sit behind him (on the camel back) from the place (where the two prayers) are combined (Muzdalifa). Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) also informed that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not stop pronouncing Talbiya till he threw pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-Fadl ko apne peeche baithaya, oont ki peeth par, us jagah se, jahan do namazein jodkar padhi jaati hain, Muzdalifa. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne ye bhi bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Talbiya padhna tab tak nahi roka jab tak unhone Jamrat al-Aqaba par kankariyaan nahi maarin.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated from al-Fadl b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) who sat behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he (the Holy Prophet) said to the people on the evening of 'Arafa and on the morning to the gathering of people (at Muzdalifa) as they were pushing on to proceed slowly. And he himself drove his she-camel with restraint until he entered Muhassir (it is a place in Mina), and further told them to take up pebbles which were to be thrown at Jamra. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) continued pronouncing Talbiya till he stoned the Jamra.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne al-Fadl bin Abbas (RA) se riwayat ki jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche baithe the ki unhone Arafa ki shaam ko aur subah logon ke jamavda ko, Muzdalifa mein, kaha jab woh dheere aage badhne ke liye zor daal rahe the. Aur unhone khud apni oontni ko sanyam se chalaya yahan tak ki woh Muhassir, jo Mina mein ek jagah hai, mein daakhil huye, aur unhe ye bhi bataaya ki woh kankariyaan uthaayein jo Jamra par maari jaani thin. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Talbiya padhna jaari rakha yahan tak ki unhone Jamra ko pathhar maare.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abd Zubair with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that in the hadith no mention is made of (this) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) continued pronouncing Talbiya till he stoned the Jamra, and he made this addition in his hadith: " The Apostle (ﷺ) pointed with his hand how a person should catch hold of pebbles (in order to throw them)."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Zubair ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki hadees mein iska koi zikr nahi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Talbiya padhna jaari rakha yahan tak ki unhone Jamra ko pathhar maare, aur unhone apni hadees mein ye izafa kiya: "Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath se ishara kiya ki kaise ek shakhs ko kankariyaan pakadni chahiye, unhe phenkne ke liye."

e: 'Abdullah narrated to us as we had gathered (at Muzdalifa): I have heard from one upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed (the Holy Prophet) pronouncing Talbiya at this place.
hi: Abdullah ne humein riwayat ki jab hum, Muzdalifa mein, jama the: Maine unse suna jinpar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui, Nabi (SAW) se, is jagah Talbiya padhte hue.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported that 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) pronounced Talbiya as he returned from the gathering of the people (at Muzdalifa). It was said: He might be a Bedouin (not knowing correctly the rituals of Hajj and, therefore, pronouncing Talbia at this stage), whereupon Abdullah said: Hive the people forgotten (this Sunnah of the Holy Prophet) or have they gone astray? I heard him, upon whom Sibrah al-Baqara was revealed, pronouncing Talbiya at the very place.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah, bin Mas'ud, ne Talbiya padhi jab woh logon ke jamavda, Muzdalifa mein, se wapas aaye. Kaha gaya: Woh shayad ek badawi hain, Hajj ke riti-rivaz sahi tarah na jaanne ki wajah se, is liye is padaav par Talbiya padh rahe hain, isper Abdullah ne kaha: Kya log, Nabi ki ye Sunnat, bhool gaye hain ya gumraah ho gaye hain? Maine unhe, jinpar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui, isi jagah Talbiya padhte suna.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid and al-Aswad b. Yazid reported: We heard 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud saying to the gathering of people (at Muzdalifa) that he had heard Talbiya from him, upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed, at this very place. And so he ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) pronounced Talbiya and we also pronounced it with him.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid aur al-Aswad bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Humne Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko logon ke jamavda, Muzdalifa mein, se ye kehte suna ki unhone unse, jinpar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui, isi jagah Talbiya suni thi. Aur is tarah unhone, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne, Talbiya padhi aur humne bhi unke saath ise padha.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them). He said: As we proceeded in the morning along with AUbs Messenger (ﷺ) from Mina to 'Arafat, some of us prounced Talbiya, and some pronounced Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki. Unhone kaha: Jab hum subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Mina se Arafat ki taraf aage badhe, hummein se kuch ne Talbiya padhi, aur kuch ne Takbir, Allahu Akbar, padhi.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them): We were along with Allah's Messenger (way peace he upon him) in the morning of 'Arafa (9th of Dhu'l-Hijja). Some of us pronounced Takbir and some of us Tahlil La ilaha ill-Allah). And to those of us who pronounced Takbir, I said: By Allah, how strange it is that you did not care to ask him: What did you see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) doing (on this occasion)?
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Arafa, 9 Zul-Hijja, ki subah the. Hummein se kuch ne Takbir padhi aur kuch ne Tahlil, La ilaha ill-Allah. Aur unse jo Takbir padh rahe the, maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye kitni ajeeb baat hai ki tumne unse ye poochhna zaroori nahi samjha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is mauqe par kya karte dekha?

e: Muhammad b. Abu Bakr al-Thaqafi asked Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him), while on their way from Mina to 'Arafa in the morning: What did you do on this day in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: One of us pronounced Tahlil, and he met with no disapproval, and one of us pronounced Takbir, and he also met with no disapproval.
hi: Muhammad bin Abu Bakr al-Thaqafi ne Anas bin Malik (RA) se poocha, jab woh Mina se Arafa ki taraf subah ja rahe the: Aapne is din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein kya kiya? Isper unhone kaha: Hummein se ek ne Tahlil padhi, aur usse koi aitraaz nahi kiya gaya, aur hummein se ek ne Takbir padhi, aur usse bhi koi aitraaz nahi kiya gaya.

e: Muhammad b. Abu Bakr reported: I said to Anas b. Malik in the morning of 'Arafa: What do you say as to pronouncing Talbiya on this day? He said: I travelled with Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and his Companions in this journey. Some of us pronounced Takbir and some of us pronounced Tahlil, and none of us found fault with his companion.
hi: Muhammad bin Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se Arafa ki subah kaha: Aap is din Talbiya padhne ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba ke saath is safar mein safar kiya. Hummein se kuch ne Takbir padhi aur kuch ne Tahlil padhi, aur hummein se kisi ne bhi apne saathi mein koi galti nahi nikaali.

e: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn Abbas, narrated from Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) that he had heard him saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded from 'Arafa, and as he approached the creek of a hill, he got down (from his camel) and urinated, and then performed a light ablution. I said to him: Prayer, whereupon he said: The prayer awaits you (at Muzdalifa). So he rode again, and as he came to Muzdalifa, he got down and performed ablution well. Then Iqima was pronounced for prayer, and he 'observed the sunset prayer. Then every person made his camel kneel down there, and then Iqama was pronounced for 'Isha' prayer and he observed it, and he (the Holy Prophet) did not observe any prayer (either Sunan or Nawifil) in between them (He observed the Fard of sunset and 'Isha' prayers successively.)
hi: Kuraib, Ibn Abbas ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Usama bin Zaid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone unhe ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafa se aage badhe, aur jab woh ek pahaad ki dhaar ke qareeb pahunche, woh apne oont se utre aur peshaab kiya, aur phir halka wuzu kiya. Maine unse kaha: Namaz, isper unhone kaha: Namaz tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai, Muzdalifa mein. To woh phir sawaar hue, aur jab woh Muzdalifa aaye, woh utre aur achhi tarah wuzu kiya. Phir maghrib ki namaz ke liye Iqamat kahi gayi, aur unhone maghrib ki namaz padhi. Phir har shakhs ne apna oont wahin bithaya, aur phir isha ki namaz ke liye Iqamat kahi gayi aur unhone ise padha, aur unhone inke beech koi aur namaz, Sunan ya Nawafil, nahi padhi. Unhone maghrib aur isha ke farz namaz ek ke baad ek padhi.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his way back from 'Arafat got down in one of these creeks (to answer the call of nature), and after he had done that I poured water (over his hands) and said: Are you going to pray? Thereupon he said: The place of prayer is ahead of you.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Arafat se wapas aate waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in dhaaron mein se ek mein utre, paishaab ki zaroorat poori karne ke liye, aur jab unhone aisa kar liya to maine paani daala, unke haathon par, aur kaha: Kya aap namaz padhne wale hain? Isper unhone kaha: Namaz ki jagah aage hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) narrated: AHah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his way back from 'Arafat and as he reached the creek (of a hillock) he got down and urinated (Usama did not say that he poured water), but said: He (the Holy Prophet) called for water and performed ablution, but it was not a thorough one. I said: Messenger of Allah, the prayer! Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you ahead (at Muzdalifa). He then proceeded, until he reached Muzdalifa and observed sunset and 'Isha' prayers (together) there.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafat se wapas aa rahe the aur jab woh dhaar, ek pahaadi ki, tak pahunche, woh utre aur peshaab kiya, Usama ne ye nahi kaha ki unhone paani daala, lekin kaha: Unhone paani mangwaaya aur wuzu kiya, lekin ye mukammal nahi tha. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, namaz! Isper unhone kaha: Namaz aage tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai, Muzdalifa mein. Woh phir aage badhe, yahan tak ki woh Muzdalifa pahunche aur wahan maghrib aur isha ki namaz ekasath padhi.

e: Kuraib reported that he asked Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) What did you do in the evening of 'Arafa as you rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: We came to a valley where people generally halted their (camels) for the sunset prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted his camel and urinated (and he did not say that he had poured water). He then called for water and performed light ablution. I said: Messenger of Allah, the prayer! Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you (at Muzdalifa). and he rode on until we came to Muzdalifa. Then he offered the sunset prayer. and the people halted their camels at their places, and did not untie them until Iqama was pronounced for the 'Isha' prayer and he observed the prayer, and then they untied (their camels). I said: What did you do in the morning? He said: Al-Fadl b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) sat behind him (the Holy Prophet) in the morning, whereas I proceeded on foot with the Quraish who had gone ahead.
hi: Kuraib ne bayan kiya ki unhone Usama bin Zaid (RA) se poocha: Aapne Arafa ki shaam ko kya kiya jab aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaar the? Unhone kaha: Hum ek wadi mein aaye jahan log aam taur par maghrib ki namaz ke liye apne oonton ko rokte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna oont roka aur peshaab kiya, aur unhone ye nahi kaha ki unhone paani daala. Unhone phir paani mangwaaya aur halka wuzu kiya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, namaz! Isper unhone kaha: Namaz tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai, Muzdalifa mein. Aur woh sawaar rahe yahan tak ki hum Muzdalifa aaye. Phir unhone maghrib ki namaz padhi, aur logon ne apne oont apni jagahon par rokh diye, aur unhe khol nahi diya jab tak isha ki namaz ke liye Iqamat nahi kahi gayi aur unhone namaz padhi, aur phir unhone oont khol diye. Maine kaha: Aapne subah kya kiya? Unhone kaha: Al-Fadl bin Abbas (RA) unke, Nabi ke, peeche subah baithe, jabki main paidal chala Quraish ke saath jo aage nikal gaye the.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when Allah's Messenger (may peace jbe upod him) came to the valley where the rich (people of Mecca) used to get down. he got down. and urinated (and he did not mention about pouring water) ; he then called for water and performed a light ablution. I said: Messenger of Allah, the prayer I Thereupon he said: Prayer awaits you ahead.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us wadi mein pahunche jahan Makkah ke daulatmand log utarte the, woh utre, aur peshaab kiya, aur unhone paani daalne ka koi zikr nahi kiya; phir unhone paani mangwaaya aur halka wuzu kiya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, namaz! Isper unhone kaha: Namaz aage tumhara intezaar kar rahi hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he sat behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on his ride as he came back from 'Arafa. And as he came to the valley, he halted his camel, and then went to the wilderness (to urinate). And when he came back, I poured water on him from the jug and he performed ablution, and then rode on until he came to Muzdalifa and there he combined the sunset and 'Isha' prayers.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche apni sawaari par baithe jab woh Arafa se wapas aa rahe the. Aur jab woh wadi mein aaye, unhone apna oont roka, aur phir sunsaan jagah gaye, peshaab karne ke liye. Aur jab woh wapas aaye, maine unpar jag se paani daala aur unhone wuzu kiya, aur phir sawaar hue yahan tak ki woh Muzdalifa pahunche aur wahan maghrib aur isha ki namaz jodkar padhi.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him) came back from 'Arafa and Usama (Allah be pleased with him) was seated behind him. Usama said that he (the Holy Prophet) continued the journey in this very state until he came to Muzdalifa.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafa se wapas aaye aur Usama (RA) unke peeche baithe the. Usama ne kaha ki unhone isi haalat mein safar jaari rakha yahan tak ki woh Muzdalifa pahunche.

e: Hisham (Allah be pleased with him) reported from his father: Usama (Allah be pleased with him) was asked in my presence or I asked Usama b. Zaid andhe rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he came back from 'Arafat. I said (to him): How did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) journey as he came back from 'Arafat? Thereupon he said: He made it (his riding camel) walk at a slow speed, and when he found an open space, he made it walk briskly.
hi: Hisham (RA) ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Usama (RA) se poocha gaya mere saamne ya maine Usama bin Zaid se poocha, aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaar the jab woh Arafat se wapas aaye. Maine unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafat se wapas aate waqt kaise safar karte the? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone use, apni sawaari wale oont ko, dheemi raftaar mein chalaya, aur jab unhe khula raasta milta, to woh use tez chalaate.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters. and in the hadith narrated by Humaid there is an addition (of these words): " Hisham said: Al-nass (speed of camel) is faster than al-'anaq."
hi: Ye hadees Urwa ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur Humaid ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ek izafa hai, ye alfaaz: "Hisham ne kaha: Al-nass, oont ki raftaar, al-'anaq se tez hai."

e: Abdullah b. Yazid al-Khatmi reported on the authority of Abu Ayyub (Allah be pleased with him) that he prayed the sunset and 'Isha' prayers (together) at Muzdalifa in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage.
hi: Abdullah bin Yazid al-Khatmi ne Abu Ayyub (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone maghrib aur isha ki namaz ekasath padhi Muzdalifa mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the sunset and 'Isha' prayers together at Muzdalifa.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne maghrib aur isha ki namaz Muzdalifa mein ekasath padhi.

e: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined the sunset and 'Isha', prayers at Muzdalifa and there was no prostration (i. e. any rak'ahs of Sunan or Nawafil prayers) in between them. He observed three rak'ahs of the sunset prayer and two rak'ahs of the 'Isha' prayer, and 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) observed the prayers in this very manner (at Muzdalifa) until he met his Lord.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne maghrib aur isha ki namaz Muzdalifa mein jodkar padhi aur unke beech koi sajda, yaani koi Sunan ya Nawafil rakat, nahi thi. Unhone maghrib ki namaz teen rakat aur isha ki namaz do rakat padhi, aur Abdullah, bin Umar, isi tareeke se Muzdalifa mein namaz padhte rahe yahan tak ki unki maut ho gayi, apne Rab se milne tak.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that he observed the sunset and 'Isha' prayers at Muzdalifa with (one) iqama. He narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that he observed prayers like this and Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) narrated that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did like this.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki unhone Muzdalifa mein maghrib aur isha ki namaz ek Iqamat ke saath padhi. Unhone Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone isi tarah namaz padhi aur Ibn Umar (RA) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi tarah kiya.

e: Shu'ba reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and said: He (the Holy Prophet) observed the two prayers (together) with one iqama.
hi: Shu'ba ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki aur kaha: Unhone do namazein, ekasath, ek Iqamat ke saath padhin.

e: Ibn 'Umar rep rte that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) combined the sunset and 'Isha ' prayers at Muzdalifa. He observed three rak'ahs of the sunset prayer and two rak'ahs of the 'Isha' prayer with one Iqama.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne maghrib aur isha ki namaz Muzdalifa mein jodkar padhi. Unhone maghrib ki namaz teen rakat aur isha ki namaz do rakat ek Iqamat ke saath padhi.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: We came back along with Ibn 'Umar till we reached Muzdalifa. There he led us in the sunset and 'Isha' prayers with one iqama and we then proceeded and he said: This is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in prayer at this place.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Hum Ibn Umar ke saath wapas aaye yahan tak ki hum Muzdalifa pahunche. Wahan unhone humari maghrib aur isha ki namaz ki imamat ek Iqamat ke saath ki aur hum phir aage badhe aur unhone kaha: Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne is jagah humari namaz ki imamat ki.

e: A'bdullah (b. 'Umar) reported: I have never seen Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) but observing the prayers at their appointed times except two prayers, sunset and 'Isha, ' at Muzdalifa (where he deferred the sunset prayer to combine it with 'Isha' and he observed the dawn prayer before its stipulated time on that day (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja).
hi: Abdullah, bin Umar, ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kabhi bhi apne muqarrar waqton par namazein na padhte hue nahi dekha, siwaay do namazon ke, maghrib aur isha, Muzdalifa mein, jahan unhone maghrib ki namaz ko isha ke saath jodne ke liye taal diya, aur unhone fajr ki namaz uske muqarrar waqt se pehle padhi us din, 10 Zul-Hijja.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Al-A`mash with a slight variation of words, i.e. he said before its time when it was still dark.
hi: Ye hadees Al-A'mash ki sanad se alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, yaani unhone kaha uske waqt se pehle jab abhi andhera tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Sauda (the wife of the Holy Prophet) who was bulky sought the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the night of Muzdalifa to move from (that place) ahead of him and before the multitude (set forth). He (Allah's Apostle) gave her the permission. So she set forth before his (Holy Prophet's) departure. But we stayed there until it was dawn and we moved on, when he departed. And if I were to seek the permission of Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) as Sauda had sought permission, I could have also gone with his permission and it would have been better for me than that for which I was happy.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Sauda, Nabi ki zauja, jo bhaari-bharkam thin, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Muzdalifa ki raat ko unse pehle aur bhaari bheed se pehle us jagah se rawaana hone ki ijazat maangi. Unhone unhe ijazat de di. To woh unke rawaana hone se pehle nikal gayin. Lekin hum wahan tab tak ruke rahe jab tak subah nahi hui aur hum tab aage badhe jab woh rawaana hue. Aur agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi hoti jaisa Sauda ne maangi thi, to main bhi unki ijazat se ja sakti thi aur ye mere liye us cheez se behtar hota jismein main khush thi.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that (hadrat) Sauda was a bulky lady, so she sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to proceed from Muzdalifa (to Mina) in the (latter part of the) night. He granted her permission. 'A'isha said: I wish I had also sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Sauda had. sought permission from him. 'A'isha did not proceed but with the Imam.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hazrat Sauda ek bhaari-bharkam aurat thin, is liye unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Muzdalifa se Mina ki taraf raat ke aakhri hisse mein rawaana hone ki ijazat maangi. Unhone unhe ijazat de di. Aisha ne kaha: Kaash maine bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi hoti jaisa Sauda ne unse maangi thi. Aisha imam ke saath hi rawaana huin.

e: 'A'isha said: I wish I had sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Sauda had sought, and observed the dawn prayer at Mina and stoned at al-Jamra before the people had come there. It was said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Did Sauda seek permission from him (the Holy Prophet)? She said: Yes. She was a bulky lady and so she sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to proceed to mina from Muzdalifa ahead of him), and he granted her permission.
hi: Aisha ne kaha: Kaash maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi hoti jaisa Sauda ne maangi thi, aur Mina mein fajr ki namaz padhi hoti aur al-Jamra par kankariyaan mari hoti logon ke wahan aane se pehle. Aisha (RA) se poocha gaya: Kya Sauda ne unse ijazat maangi thi? Unhone kaha: Haan. Woh ek bhaari-bharkam aurat thin is liye unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi, Mina ki taraf Muzdalifa se unse pehle jaane ki, aur unhone unhe ijazat de di.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdur-Rahman bin al-Qasim ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah, the freed slave of (Hadrat) Asma', reported: Asma' (Allah be pleased with her), as she was in the house at Muzdalifa, asked me whether the moon had set. I said: No. She prayed for some time, and again said: My son has the moon set? I said: Yes. And she said: Set forth along with me, and so we set forth until (we reached Mini) and the stoned at al-Jamra. She then prayed in her place. I said to her: Respected lady, we set forth (in the very early part of dawn) when it was dark, whereupon she said: My son, there is no harm in it; Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had granted permission to women.
hi: Abdullah, Hazrat Asma ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya: Asma (RA) ne, jab woh Muzdalifa mein ghar mein thin, mujhse poocha ki kya chaand doob gaya hai. Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone kuch der dua ki, aur phir kaha: Bete, kya chaand doob gaya hai? Maine kaha: Haan. Aur unhone kaha: Mere saath chalo, aur hum Mina tak chale aur al-Jamra par kankariyaan maarin. Woh phir apni jagah par namaz padhi. Maine unse kaha: Mohtarma, hum bahut jaldi rawaana huye jab abhi andhera tha, isper unhone kaha: Bete, ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai; Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne auraton ko ijazat di thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters, and In his narration (the words are): " She (Asma') said: My son, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted permission to women."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur unki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone, Asma ne, kaha: Bete, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne auraton ko ijazat di."

e: Ibn Shawwal (the freed slave of Umm Habiba) reported that he went to Umm Habiba (the wife of Allah's Apostle) who informed him that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent her from Muzdalifa during the night.
hi: Ibn Shawwal, Umm Habiba ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya ki woh Umm Habiba, Allah ke Rasool ki zauja, ke paas gaye jinhone unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe raat ke waqt Muzdalifa se bheja.

e: It is narrated from Umm Habiba: We used to set forth from Muzdalifa to Mina, (very early in the dawn) when it was dark. And in the narration of Naqid (the words are):" We set from Muzdalifa in the darkness (of the dawn)."
hi: Umm Habiba se riwayat ki gayi hai: Hum Muzdalifa se Mina ke liye rawaana hote the jab abhi andhera hota. Aur Naqid ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Hum Muzdalifa se andhere mein rawaana huye."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me from Muzdalifa ahead (of the caravan) along with the luggage or with the weak ones during (the latter part of the) night.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Muzdalifa se, kaafile se aage, bheja saamaan ke saath ya kamzor logon ke saath raat ke aakhri hisse mein.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I was among those (i. e. women and children) whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent forth with the weak members of his family.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main un logon, yaani auraton aur bachchon, mein se tha jinhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khaandaan ke kamzor logon ke saath aage bheja tha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ata' reported from Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me from Muzdalifa along with his luggage (in the very early part of @he dawn). I (Ibn Juraij, one of the narrators) said (to 'Ati'): Has this (news) reached you that Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had said:" He (Allah's Messenger) had sent me in the latter part of the night"? Thereupon he said: No, it was the dawn. I (again) said to him: (Did you hear) Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) having said this (too):" We stoned al-Jamra before the dawn prayer"? So where did he observe the dawn prayer? He said: No. But he said only so much (as described above).
hi: Ata ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Muzdalifa se unke saamaan ke saath bheja, subah ke bahut pehle hisse mein. Maine, Ibn Juraij, ek raawi ne, unse, Ata se, kaha: Kya ye khabar aapko pahunchi hai ki Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha tha: "Unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, mujhe raat ke aakhri hisse mein bheja tha"? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi, ye subah thi. Maine dobara unse poocha: Kya aapne suna Ibn Abbas (RA) ne ye bhi kaha tha: "Humne al-Jamra ko fajr ki namaz se pehle kankariyaan maarin"? To unhone fajr ki namaz kahan padhi? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Lekin unhone bas itna hi kaha jaisa upar bayaan hua.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to send ahead of him the weak members of his household to stay during the night at Mash'ar al-Haram at Muzdalifa. They remembered Allah so long as they could afford, and then they proceeded before the stay of the Imam, and before his return. So some of them reached Mina for the dawn prayer and some of them reached there after that; and as they reached there, they stoned al-Jamra; and Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has granted this concession to them.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) apne khaandaan ke kamzor logon ko aage bhej diya karte the taaki woh raat ko Muzdalifa mein Mash'ar al-Haram mein theherein. Woh jitni der kar sakte Allah ka zikr karte, aur phir woh Imam ke theherne aur unke laut ne se pehle rawaana ho jaate. To unmein se kuch Mina fajr ki namaz ke liye pahunchte aur kuch uske baad pahunchte; aur jab woh wahan pahunchte, woh al-Jamra ko kankariyaan maarte; aur Ibn Umar (RA) kaha karte the: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ye chhoot di hai.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported that 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with them) threw seven pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba from the heart of the valley. He pronounced Takbir with every pebble. It was said to him that people fling stones from the upper side (of the valley), whereupon 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah he pleased with them) said: By him, besides Whom there is no other god, that is the place (of flinging stones) of one upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed (the Holy Prophet).
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Jamrat al-Aqaba ko wadi ke dil se saat kankariyaan mari. Har kankaari ke saath unhone Takbir kahi. Unse kaha gaya ki log upari taraf se, wadi ki, pathhar phenkte hain, isper Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: Us Allah ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi doosra ma'bood nahi, ye woh jagah hai, pathhar phenkne ki, jispar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui, Nabi ki.

e: A'mash reported: I heard Hajjaj b. Yusuf saying as he was delivering sermon on the pulpit: Observe the order of the (Holy) Qur'an which has been observed by Gabriel. (Thus state the surahs in this manner)" one in which mention has been made of al-Baqara,"" one in which mention has been made of women (Surah al-Nisa')" and then the surah in which mention has been made of the Family of 'Imrin. He (the (narrator) said: I met Ibrahim and informed him about these words of his (the statement of Hajjaj b. Yusuf). He cursed him and said: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid has narrated to me that when he was in the company of 'Abdullah b. Mas'udd (Allah be pleased with them) he came to Jamrat al-'Aqaba and then entered the heart of the valley and faced towards it (the Jamra) and then flung seven pebbles at it from the heart of the valley pronouncing Takbir with every pebble. I said: Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, people fling pebbles at it (Jamra) from the upper side, whereupon he said: By Him besides Whom there is no god, that is the place (of flinging pebbles of one) upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed;
hi: A'mash ne bayan kiya: Maine Hajjaj bin Yusuf ko mimbar par khutba dete hue ye kehte suna: Quran ki tarteeb ka anusaran karo jo Jibra'eel ne rakhi hai. Is tarah surahon ko batao: "wahan jismein al-Baqara ka zikr kiya gaya hai," "wahan jismein auraton ka zikr kiya gaya hai, Surah al-Nisa" aur phir woh surah jismein Imran ke gharane ka zikr kiya gaya hai. Raawi ne kaha: Main Ibrahim se mila aur unhe unke, Hajjaj bin Yusuf ke, in alfaazon ke baare mein bataya. Unhone unpar laanat bheji aur kaha: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne mujhe riwayat ki ki jab woh Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ki sohbat mein the woh Jamrat al-Aqaba tak aaye aur phir wadi ke dil mein daakhil huye aur uska rukh kiya, Jamra ka, aur phir usse wadi ke dil se saat kankariyaan mari, har kankaari ke saath Takbir kehte hue. Maine kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, log ise, Jamra ko, upari taraf se kankariyaan maarte hain, isper unhone kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi, ye woh jagah hai, kankariyaan phenkne ki, jispar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui.

e: A'mash reported: I heard Hajjaj saying I Do not say Surah al-Baqara. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: A'mash ne bayan kiya: Maine Hajjaj ko ye kehte suna: Surah al-Baqara mat kaho. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported that he performed Hajj along with 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) and he flung seven pebbles at al-Jamra (from a position) that the House was on his left and Mina was on his right and said: That is the place (of flinging pebbles of one) upon whom Surah al-Baqara was revealed.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abdullah (RA) ke saath Hajj kiya aur unhone al-Jamra ko saat kankariyaan mari ek aisi position se ki Ghar unki baayi taraf tha aur Mina unki daayi taraf, aur kaha: Ye woh jagah hai, kankariyaan phenkne ki, jispar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui.

e: This hadith nas been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation of (words): As he came to Jamrat al-'Aqaba."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq, alfaazon mein, ke: Jab woh Jamrat al-Aqaba aaye.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported: It was said to 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with bird) that people threw pebbles at the Jamra from the upper side of 'Aqaba, whereas he threw stones at it from the heart of the valley, whereupon he said: By Him besides Whom there is no god, it is at this very place that one upon whom was revealed Surah al-Baqara threw stones at it.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Abdullah (RA) se kaha gaya ki log Jamra ko Aqaba ke upari taraf se pathhar phenkte hain, jabki unhone use wadi ke dil se pathhar maare, isper unhone kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi, isi jagah unhone pathhar maare jinpar Surah al-Baqara nazil hui.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) flinging pebbles while riding his camel on the Day of Nahr, and he was saying: Learn your rituals (by seeing me performing them), for I do not know whether I would be performing Hajj after this Hajj of mine.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Nahr ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, apne oont par sawaar hokar kankariyaan phenkte dekha, aur woh keh rahe the: Apne riti-rivaz seekho, mujhe unhe karte dekhkar, kyunki mujhe nahi pata ki mera ye Hajj mukammal karne ke baad main phir Hajj kar paunga ya nahi.

e: Umm al-Husain (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and saw him when he flung pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba and returned while he was riding the camel, and Bilal and Usama were with him. One of them was leading his camel, while the other was raising his cloth over the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to protect him from the sun. She (further) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said so many things, and I heard him saying: If a slave having some limb of his missing and having dark complexion is appointed to govern you according to the Book of Allah the Exalted. listen to him and obey him.
hi: Umm al-Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya aur unhe dekha jab unhone Jamrat al-Aqaba ko kankariyaan mari aur wapas aaye jabki woh oont par sawaar the, aur Bilal aur Usama unke saath the. Unmein se ek unke oont ko le ja raha tha, jabki doosra Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar par apna kapda uthaaye hue tha unhe suraj se bachaane ke liye. Unhone aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bahut si baaten kahin, aur maine unhe ye kehte suna: Agar koi ghulam jiska koi ang na ho aur jiski rangat kaali ho use Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik tumpar hukmaraan muqarrar kiya jaaye, to uski baat suno aur uski itaat karo.

e: Umm al-Husain (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and saw Usama and Bilal (too), one of whom had caught hold of the lose string of the she-camel of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) while the other one was raising his cloth (over his head) protecting him from the heat, till he flung pebbles at Jamrat al-'Aqaba.
hi: Umm al-Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya aur Usama aur Bilal ko dekha bhi, unmein se ek ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki oontni ki dheeli rassi pakad rakhi thi jabki doosra apna kapda, unke sar par, uthaaye hue tha unhe garmi se bachaane ke liye, yahan tak ki unhone Jamrat al-Aqaba ko kankariyaan mari.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) throwing stones (at Jamrat al 'Aqaba) like pelting of small pebbles.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Jamrat al-Aqaba par pathhar phenkte dekha jaise chhoti kankariyaan phenki jaati hain.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) flung pebbles at jamra on the Day of Nahr after sunrise, and after that (i. e. on the 11th, 12th and 13th of Dhu'l-Hijja when the sun had declined.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Nahr ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, Jamra ko suraj nikalne ke baad kankariyaan mari, aur uske baad, yaani 11, 12 aur 13 Zul-Hijja ko, jab suraj dhal chuka hota.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne isi tarah ki ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Jabir (b. Abdullab) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Odd number of stones are to be used for cleaning (the private parts after answering the call of nature), and casting of pebbles at the Jamras is to be done by odd numbers (seven), and (the number) of circuits between al-Safa' and al-Marwa is also odd (seven), and the number of circuits (around the Ka'ba) is also odd (seven). Whenever any one of you is required to use stones (for cleaning the private parts) he should use odd number of stones (three, five or seven).
hi: Jabir, bin Abdullah, (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Taaq tadaad mein patthar istemal kiye jaane chahiye safaai ke liye, paishaab-paakhaana ke baad, aur Jamron ko kankariyaan maarna bhi taaq tadaad mein hona chahiye, saat, aur al-Safa aur al-Marwa ke beech chakkaron ki tadaad bhi taaq hai, saat, aur Kaaba ke aas-paas chakkaron ki tadaad bhi taaq hai, saat. Jab bhi tum mein se koi safaai ke liye patthar istemal kare use taaq tadaad mein patthar istemal karne chahiye, teen, paanch ya saat.

e: 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved (after slaughtering the sacrificial animal on the 10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and so did a group of Companions, while some of them got their hair clipped. Abdullah said: Allah's Messenger (may peace'be upon him) observed once or twice:" May Allah have mercy upon those who get their heads shaved." And he also said:" Upon those too who got their hair clipped."
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna sar mundwaaya, qurbaani ke jaanwar ko 10 Zul-Hijja ko qurbaan karne ke baad, aur sahaba ke ek giroh ne bhi aisa hi kiya, jabki kuchne apne baal katvaaye. Abdullah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek ya do baar kaha: "Allah unpar rehmat kare jo apne sar mundwaate hain." Aur unhone ye bhi kaha: "Unpar bhi jo apne baal katvaate hain."

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having observed: O Allah, have mercy upon those who get their heads shaved. They (the Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who have got their hair clipped? He said: O Allah, have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They (again) said: Allah's Messenger, (what about those) who have got their hair clipped? Thereupon he said: (O Allah, have mercy upon those) who have got their hair clipped.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Allah, un logon par rehmat kar jo apne sar mundwaate hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, un logon par rehmat kar jinhone apne sar mundwaaye. Unhone dobara kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Isper unhone kaha: Aye Allah, unpar rehmat kar jinhone apne baal katvaaye.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May Allah have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about) those who got their hair clipped? He said: May Allah have mercy upon those who have got their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those who have got their hair clipped)? He said: May Allah have mercy upon those who got their hair shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about) those who got their hair clipped? He said: (O Allah, have mercy upon) those who got their hair clipped.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah un logon par rehmat kare jo apne sar mundwaate hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Unhone kaha: Allah un logon par rehmat kare jo apne sar mundwaate hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Unhone kaha: Allah un logon par rehmat kare jinhone apne sar mundwaaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, unpar rehmat kar jinhone apne baal katvaaye.

e: Ubaidullah reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and (it is said) that it was on the fourth turn that he (the Holy Prophet) said: (May Allah have mercy upon) those who got their hair clipped."
hi: Ubaidullah ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur kaha jaata hai ki ye chauthi baar tha jab unhone kaha: "Allah unpar rehmat kare jinhone apne baal katvaaye."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said: O Allah, grant pardon to those who got their heads shaved. They (Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who get their hair cut? He said: O Allah, grant pardon to those who get their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who got their hair clipped? He said: O Allah, grant pardon to those who get their heads shaved. They said: Messenger of Allah, (what about those) who get their hair clipped? He said: (O Allah, grant pardon to) those who get their hair clipped.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Allah, un logon ko maafi de jinhone apne sar mundwaaye. Unhone, Nabi ke sahaba ne, kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jo apne baal katvaate hain? Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, un logon ko maafi de jo apne sar mundwaate hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jinhone apne baal katvaaye? Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, un logon ko maafi de jo apne sar mundwaate hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unka kya jo apne baal katvaate hain? Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, unhe maafi de jo apne baal katvaate hain.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Yahya b. al-Husain reported on the authority of his grandfather that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) invoked blessing on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage three times for those who got their heads shaved and once for those who got their hair clipped. In the narration transmitted by Waki' there is no mention of the Farewell Pilgrimage.
