hi: Yahya bin al-Husain ne apne dada ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par apne sar mundwaane walon ke liye teen baar barkat ki dua ki aur apne baal katvaane walon ke liye ek baar. Waki ki riwayat mein Vida ke Hajj ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par apna sar mundwaaya.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased wish him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Mina; he went to the Jamra and threw pebbles at it, after which he went to his lodging in Mina, and sacrificed the animal. He then called for a barber and, turning his right side to him, let him shave him; after which he tiimed his left side. He then gave (these hair) to the people.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Mina aaye; woh Jamra gaye aur usse kankariyaan mari, jiske baad woh Mina mein apne padaav par gaye, aur jaanwar ki qurbaani di. Unhone phir ek naai ko bulwaaya aur, apni daayi taraf usse mudkar, unhe apna sar mundwaaya; jiske baad unhone apni baayi taraf mudi. Unhone phir ye baal logon ko de diye.

e: Abu Bakr reported: (He called for) the barber and, pointing towards the right side of his head, said: (Start from) here, and then distributed his hair among those who were near him. He then pointed to the barber (to shave) the left side and he shaved it, and he gave (these hair) to Umm Sulaim (Allah be pleased with her). And in the narration of Abu Kuraib (the words are):" He started from the right half (of his head), and he distributed a hair or two among the people. and then (asked the barber) to shave the left side and he did similarly, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Here is Abu Talha and he gave these (hair) to Abu Talha."
hi: Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya: Unhone naai ko bulwaaya aur apne sar ki daayi taraf ishara karte hue kaha: Yahan se shuru karo, aur phir apne baal un logon mein baant diye jo unke paas the. Unhone phir naai ko ishara kiya, baayi taraf mundhne ka, aur unhone use mundha, aur unhone ye baal Umm Sulaim (RA) ko diye. Aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone daayi aadhi, sar ki, se shuru kiya, aur unhone ek ya do baal logon mein baante, aur phir naai se baayi taraf mundhne ko kaha aur unhone waisa hi kiya, aur unhone kaha: Ye rahe Abu Talha aur unhone ye baal Abu Talha ko diye."

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) threw stones at Jamrat al-'Aqaba. He then want to his sacrificial animal and sacrificed it, and there was sitting the barber, and he pointed with his hand towards his head, and he shaved the right half of it, and he (the Holy Prophet) distributed them (the hair) among those who were near him. And he again said: Shave the other half, and said: Where is Abu Talha and gave it (the hair) to him.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Jamrat al-Aqaba ko pathhar maare. Woh phir apni qurbaani ke jaanwar ke paas gaye aur use qurbaan kiya, aur wahan naai baitha hua tha, aur unhone apne haath se apne sar ki taraf ishara kiya, aur unhone daayi aadhi mundhi, aur unhone unhe baal un logon mein baante jo unke paas the. Aur unhone dobara kaha: Doosri aadhi mundo, aur kaha: Abu Talha kahan hain aur unhe baal unhe de diye.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had thrown pebbles at the Jamra and had sacrificed the animal, he turned (the right side) of his head towards the barber, and i. e shaved it. He then called Abu Talha al-Ansari and gave it to him. He then turned his left side and asked him (the barber) to shave. And he (the barber) shaved. and gave it to Abu Talha and told him to distribute it amongst the people.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Jamra ko kankariyaan mari thin aur jaanwar ki qurbaani di thi, unhone apna sar, daayi taraf, naai ki taraf mudi, aur usse mundhwaaya. Unhone phir Abu Talha al-Ansari ko bulaaya aur unhe woh baal de diye. Unhone phir apni baayi taraf mudi aur unse, naai se, mundhne ko kaha. Aur unhone, naai ne, mundha, aur Abu Talha ko diye aur unhe hukum diya ki woh unhe logon mein baant den.

e: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped during the Farewell Pilgrimage at Mina for people who had something to ask. A man came and said: Messenger of Allah, being ignorant. I shaved before sacrificing, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Now sacrifice (the animal) and there is no harm (for you). Then another man came and he said: Messenger of Allah, being ignorant, I sacrificed before throwing the pebbles, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: (Now) throw the pebbles, and there is no harm (for you). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not asked about anything which had been done before or after (its proper time) but he said: Do it, and no harm is there (for you).
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Vida ke Hajj ke daurane Mina mein rukhe rahe un logon ke liye jinhe kuch poochhna tha. Ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, anjaani mein, maine qurbaani se pehle sar mundwaaya, isper unhone kaha: Ab qurbaani do aur tumhare liye koi nuksaan nahi hai. Phir ek aur shakhs aaya aur usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, anjaani mein, maine kankariyaan maarne se pehle qurbaani di, isper unhone kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro, aur tumhare liye koi nuksaan nahi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kisi bhi cheez ke baare mein nahi poocha gaya jo uske sahi waqt se pehle ya baad mein ki gayi thi, lekin unhone kaha: Ise karo, aur tumhare liye koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped while riding his camel and the people began to ask him. One of the inquirers said: Messenger of Allah, I did not know that pebbles should be thrown before sacrificing the animal, and by mistake I sacrificed the animal before throwing pebbles, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (Now) throw pebbles and there is no harm in it. Then another (person) came saying: I did not know that the animal was to be sacrificed before shaving, but I got myself shaved before sacrificing the animal, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Sacrifice the animal (now) and there is no harm in it. He (the narrator) said: I did not hear that anything was asked on that day (shout a matter) which a person forgot and could not observe the sequence or anything like it either due to forgetfulness or ignorance, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (about that): Do it; there is no harm in it.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont par sawaar hokar ruke aur log unse sawaal karne lage. Ek poochne wale ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe nahi pata tha ki kankariyaan jaanwar qurbaan karne se pehle maari jaani chahiye, aur galti se maine jaanwar ki qurbaani kankariyaan maarne se pehle di, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro aur ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Phir ek aur shakhs ye kehte hue aaya: Mujhe nahi pata tha ki jaanwar ki qurbaani sar mundwaane se pehle di jaani chahiye, lekin maine sar mundwaane se pehle apna sar mundhwaaya, yaani jaanwar qurbaan karne se pehle mundhwaaya, isper unhone kaha: Ab jaanwar ki qurbaani do aur ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Raawi ne kaha: Maine nahi suna ki us din kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya, kisi maamle mein, jise koi shakhs bhool gaya tha aur tarteeb ka anusaran nahi kar saka tha ya isi jaisa kuch, chahe bhool ki wajah se ya anjaani ki wajah se, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske baare mein kaha: Ise karo; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with them) reported: As Allah's Apostle. (ﷺ) was delivering sermon on the Day of Nahr, a man stood up before him and said: Messenger of Allah, I did not know that such and such (rite was to be performed) before such and such (rite). Then another man came and said: Messenger of Allah, I thought that such and such (rite) should precede such and such (rite), and then another man came and said: Messenger of Allah, I had thought that such and such was before such and such, and such and such (is the sequence) of the three (rites, viz. throwing of pebbles, sacrificing of animal and shaving of one's head). He said to all these three: Do now (if you have not observed the cequence) ; there is no harm in it.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Nahr ke din khutba de rahe the, ek shakhs unke saamne khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe nahi pata tha ki aisa-aisa riti-rivaz aisa-aisa riti-rivaz se pehle kiya jaana chahiye. Phir ek aur shakhs aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe laga ki aisa-aisa riti-rivaz aisa-aisa riti-rivaz se pehle hona chahiye, aur phir ek aur shakhs aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe laga ki aisa-aisa aisa-aisa se pehle tha, aur aisa-aisa, ye teenon riti-rivaz ki tarteeb hai, yaani kankariyaan maarna, jaanwar ki qurbaani, aur sar mundhwaana. Unhone in teenon se kaha: Ab karo, agar tumne tarteeb ka anusaran nahi kiya; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters. And the narration of Ibn Bakr is like one transmitted by 'Isa but with this (variation): " There are not these words in it: To all these three rites (throwing of pebbles sacrificing of animal and shaving of one's head)." And so far as the narration of Yahya al-Umawi (the words are): I got (my head) shaved before I sacrificed the animal, and I sacrified the animal before throwing pebbles, and like that.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Ibn Bakr ki riwayat Isa ki riwayat ki hui hadees jaisi hi hai lekin is farq ke saath: "Ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: In teenon riti-rivaz mein, kankariyaan maarna, jaanwar ki qurbaani, aur sar mundhwaana." Aur Yahya al-Umawi ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Maine apna sar qurbaani se pehle mundhwaaya, aur maine kankariyaan maarne se pehle jaanwar ki qurbaani di, aur isi jaisa.

e: Adullah b. 'Amr (b. al-'As) (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I got (my head) shaved before sacrificing the, animal, whereupon be (the Holy Prophet) said: Sacrifice the animal (now) ; there is no harm in it. He (the person said): I sacripced the animal before throwingpebbles. whereupon he said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr, bin al-As, (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine apna sar qurbaani se pehle mundhwaaya, isper unhone kaha: Ab jaanwar ki qurbaani do; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Maine kankariyaan maarne se pehle jaanwar ki qurbaani di. Isper unhone kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the back of the camel at Mina, and a person came to him," and the rest of the hadith Is like that transmitted by Ibn 'Uyaina.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Mina mein oont ki peeth par dekha, aur ek shakhs unke paas aaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Ibn Uyaina ne riwayat ki.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-As (Allah be pleased with them) said: As Allah's Messenger (may peace be'upon him) was standing near the jamra, a person came to him on the Day of Nahr and said: Messenger of Allah, I got (my head shaved) before throwing pebbles, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it. Another man (then) came and said: I have sacrificed before throwing the stones. He said: Throw stones (now) and there is no harm. Another came to him and said: I have observed the circumambulation of Ifada of the House before throwing pebbles. He said: Throw pebbles (now) ; there is no harm in it, He (the narrator) said: I did not see that he (the Holy Prophet) was asked about anything on that day, but he said: Do, and there is no harm in it.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Jamra ke qareeb khade the, ek shakhs unke paas Nahr ke din aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apna sar mundwaaya kankariyaan maarne se pehle, isper unhone kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Phir ek aur shakhs aaya aur kaha: Maine kankariyaan maarne se pehle qurbaani di hai. Unhone kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro aur koi nuksaan nahi hai. Doosra unke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine Ghar ka Tawaf-i-Ifada kankariyaan maarne se pehle kiya. Unhone kaha: Ab kankariyaan maaro; ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Raawi ne kaha: Maine nahi dekha ki us din unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya ho, lekin unhone kaha: Karo, aur ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that it was said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about sacrificing of animals, shaving of one's head, throwing of pebbles, and (the order of) precedence and succession, and he said: There is no harm in it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jaanwar ki qurbaani, sar mundhwaane, kankariyaan maarne, aur tarteeb ke pehle-baad ke baare mein poocha gaya, aur unhone kaha: Ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nabr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and then came back and observed the noon prayer at Mina. Nafi' (one of the narrators) said that Ibn Umar used to observe the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nahr, and then return and observe the noon prayer at Mina, and mentioned that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did that.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Nahr ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, Tawaf-i-Ifada kiya, aur phir wapas aaye aur Mina mein zohar ki namaz padhi. Nafi, ek raawi, ne kaha ki Ibn Umar Nahr ke din Tawaf-i-Ifada kiya karte the, aur phir wapas jaate aur Mina mein zohar ki namaz padhte, aur zikr kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya tha.

e: Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufai' (Allah be pleased with him) said: I asked Anas b. Malik to tell me about something he knew about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), viz. where he observed the noon prayer on Yaum al-Tarwiya. He said: At Mina. I said: Where did he observe the afternoon prayer on the Yaum an-Nafr? and he said: It was at al-Abtah. He then said: Do as your rulers do.
hi: Abd al-Aziz bin Rufai (RA) ne kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha ki mujhe woh bataayein jo unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein pata tha, yaani unhone Yaum al-Tarwiya, 8 Zul-Hijja, mein zohar ki namaz kahan padhi. Unhone kaha: Mina mein. Maine kaha: Unhone Yaum an-Nafr, Mina se Makkah wapas jaane ka din, mein asr ki namaz kahan padhi? Aur unhone kaha: Ye al-Abtah mein thi. Unhone phir kaha: Woh karo jo tumhare hukmaraan karein.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr and 'Umar observed halt at al-Abtah.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr aur Umar ne al-Abtah mein padaav kiya.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar regarded halt at Muhassab as Sunnah (of the Holy Prophet) and observed the noon prayer on Yaum al-Nafr at that place. Nafi' said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted at Muhassab and the Caliphs did the same after him.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar Muhassab mein padaav karna Sunnat, Nabi ki, maante the aur Yaum al-Nafr ke din zohar ki namaz us jagah padhte the. Nafi ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muhassab mein padaav kiya aur khulafa ne bhi unke baad aisa hi kiya.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported.: Halt at al-Abtah is not the Sunnah. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted there simply because it was easier for him to depart from there, when he left.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Al-Abtah mein padaav karna Sunnat nahi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wahan padaav sirf is liye kiya kyunki unke liye wahan se rawaana hona aasaan tha, jab woh chale.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim reported that Abu Bakr, 'Umar and Ibn Umar used to halt at Abtah. 'Urwa narrated from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that he did not observe this practice and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) halted there, for it is a place from where it was easy to depart.
hi: Salim ne bayan kiya ki Abu Bakr, Umar aur Ibn Umar Abtah mein padaav karte the. Urwa ne Aisha (RA) se riwayat ki ki unhone ye riwaaz nahi maana aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wahan padaav kiya, kyunki ye ek aisi jagah hai jahan se rawaana hona aasaan tha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Halt at Muhassab is not something (significant from the point of view of the Shari'ah). It is a place of halt where Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) halted.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhassab mein padaav karna Shariat ki nazar se koi ahem baat nahi hai. Ye ek padaav ki jagah hai jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne padaav kiya.

e: Abu Rafi' reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not command me to observe halt at al-Abtah when be departed from Mina, but I came and set up his (the Holy Prcphet's) tent (of my own accord) ; and he (Allah's Apostle) came and observed halt. This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters from Abu Rafi' who was (in charge) of the luggage of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Rafi ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe al-Abtah mein padaav karne ka hukum nahi diya jab woh Mina se rawaana huye, lekin main aaya aur unke khaime ko apni marzi se laga diya; aur woh Allah ke Rasool aaye aur padaav kiya. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se Abu Rafi se riwayat ki gayi hai jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamaan ke incharge the.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleated with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: God willing, we will get down tomorrow, at Khaif of Banu Kinanah, the place where they had taken an oath on unbelief.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah chahega to hum kal Khaif Banu Kinanah mein utrenge, woh jagah jahan unhone kufr par qasam khayi thi.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us as we were at Mina: We would observe halt tomorrow at-Khaif of Banu Kinanah, where (the polytheists) had taken an oath on unbelief, and that was that the Quraish and Banu Kinanah had, pledged against Banu Hashim and Banu Muttalib that they would neither marry nor do any transaction with them unless they deliver Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) to them. And (this pledge was) taken at this (place) Muhassab.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha jab hum Mina mein the: Hum kal Khaif Banu Kinanah mein padaav karenge, jahan mushrikeen ne kufr par qasam khayi thi, aur woh ye tha ki Quraish aur Banu Kinanah ne Banu Hashim aur Banu Muttalib ke khilaaf ehad kiya tha ki woh na to unse shaadi karenge na koi lena-dena rakhenge jab tak woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke haath na de dein. Aur ye ehad isi jagah, Muhassab mein, kiya gaya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: God willing, when Allah has granted us victory, our halt tomorrow will be at Khaif, where they (the unbelievers of Mecca) had taken an oath on unbelief.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah chahega, jab Allah humein fatah dega, kal hamara padaav Khaif mein hoga, jahan unhone, Makkah ke kaafiron ne, kufr par qasam khayi thi.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-'A'bbas b. Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with him) sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to spend in Mecca the nights (which be was required to spend) at Mina on account of his office of supplier of water, and he (the Holy Prophet) granted him permission.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki al-Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Makkah mein raaten guzaarne ki, jo unhe Mina mein guzaarni thin, apne paani supply karne ke ohde ki wajah se ijazat maangi, aur unhone unhe ijazat de di.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Ubaidullah b. Umar with the the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah bin Umar ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Bakr b. 'Abdullah al-Muzani said: While I was sitting along with Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) near the Ka'ba, there came a bedouin to him and said: What is the matter that I see that the progeny of your uncle supply honey and milk (as drink to the travellers), whereas you supply al-nabidh (water sweetened with dates)? Is it due to your poverty or due to your close-fistedness? Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Allah be praised, it is neither due to poverty nor due to close-fistedness (but due to the fact) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came here riding his she-came, and there was sitting behind him Usama. He asked for water, and we gave him a cup full of nabidh and he drank it, and gave the remaining (part) to Usama; and he (the Holy Prophet) said: You have done Food, You have done well. So continue doing like it So we do not like to change what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded us to do.
hi: Bakr bin Abdullah al-Muzani ne kaha: Jab main Ibn Abbas (RA) ke saath Kaaba ke qareeb baitha tha, unke paas ek badawi aaya aur kaha: Ye kya baat hai ki main dekh raha hoon ki aapke chacha ki naslein shahad aur doodh supply karti hain, musaafiron ko pilaane ke liye, jabki aap al-nabidh, khajoor se meetha kiya paani, supply karte hain? Kya ye aapki gareebi ki wajah se hai ya aapki kanjoosi ki wajah se? Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah ki tareef ho, ye na to gareebi ki wajah se hai na kanjoosi ki wajah se, balki iski wajah ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni oontni par sawaar hokar yahan aaye, aur Usama unke peeche baithe the. Unhone paani maanga, aur humne unhe nabidh se bhara ek pyaala diya aur unhone use piya, aur bacha hua Usama ko diya; aur unhone kaha: Tumne achha kiya, tumne achha kiya. To isi tarah karte raho. Is liye humein pasand nahi ki hum use badlein jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein karne ka hukum diya tha.

e: 'All (Allah be pleased with him) reperted: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put me in charge of his sacrificial animals, that I should give their flesh. skins and saddle cloths as sadaqa, but not to give anything to the butcher, saying: We would pay him ourselves.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka incharge banaaya, ki main unka gosht, khaal aur zeen ke kapde sadaqe mein doon, lekin qassab, khaal utaarne wale, ko kuch na doon, ye kehte hue: Hum use khud paisa denge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abd al-Karim al-Jazari with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abd al-Karim al-Jazari ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) with another chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of the wages of the butcher in it.
hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein qassab ki mazdoori ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ali b. Abi Talib (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) put him in charge of his sacrificial animals, and commanded him to distribute the whole of their meat, hides, and saddle cloths to the poor, and not to give to the butcher anything out of them.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka incharge banaaya, aur unhe hukum diya ki woh unka poora gosht, khaal, aur zeen ke kapde gareebon mein baant dein, aur unmein se qassab ko kuch na dein.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported: In the year of Hudaibiya (6 H ), we, along with Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), sacrificed a camel for seven persons and a cow for seven persons.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hudaibiya ke saal, 6 Hijri, humne, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath, saat logon ke liye ek oont aur saat logon ke liye ek gaay qurbaan ki.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We set out in the state of Ihram for Hajj along, with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He commanded us that seven persons should join in a camel and a cow for offering sacrifice.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Hajj ke liye ehram ki halat mein nikle Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath. Unhone humein hukum diya ki saat log ek oont aur ek gaay mein qurbaani ke liye saanjhedaar bane.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We performed Hajj along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and we sacrificed a camel on behalf of seven persons, and a cow on behalf of seven persons.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya, aur humne saat logon ki taraf se ek oont, aur saat logon ki taraf se ek gaay qurbaan ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We joined Allah's Apostle (may pea, @. e be upon him) in Hajj and Umra and seven persons shared in the sacrifice of an animal. A person said to Jabir (Allah be pleased with him): Can seven persons share in the sacrifice of al-Badnah (a camel) as he shares in al- Jazur (a cow)? He, (Jabir) said: It (al-Jazur) is nothing but one among the budun. Jabir was present at Hudaibiya and he said: We sacrificed on that day seventy camel, and seven men shared in each sacrifice (of camel).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj aur Umra mein shaamil huye aur saat log ek jaanwar ki qurbaani mein saanjhedaar bane. Ek shakhs ne Jabir (RA) se kaha: Kya saat log al-Badnah, oont, ki qurbaani mein saanjhedaar ho sakte hain jaise woh al-Jazur, gaay, mein hote hain? Unhone kaha: Ye al-Jazur budun, qurbaani ke jaanwaron, mein se ek hi hai. Jabir Hudaibiya mein maujood the aur unhone kaha: Humne us din sattar oont qurbaan kiye, aur saat aadmi har oont ki qurbaani mein saanjhedaar bane.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them), describing the Hajj of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He (the Holy Prophet) commanded us as we had entered into the state of Ihram to sacrifice the animals (as a rite of Hajj) and a group (of person; amongst us, i. e. seven) shared in the sacrifice of one (camel or cow), and it happened at that time when he commanded them to put off Ihram for Hajj (after performing 'Umra).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Hajj ka bayaan karte hue, kaha: Unhone humein hukum diya jab hum ehram mein daakhil huye ki hum jaanwaron ki qurbaani dein, Hajj ke ek riti-rivaz ke taur par, aur ek giroh, hummein se, yaani saat log, ek oont ya gaay ki qurbaani mein saanjhedaar bane, aur ye us waqt hua jab unhone unhe Hajj ke liye ehram utaarne ka hukum diya, Umra karne ke baad.

e: Jaibir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We performed Hajj Tamattu' along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we slaughtered a cow on behalf of seven persons sharing in it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj Tamattu kiya aur humne saat logon ki taraf se ek gaay qurbaan ki jismein woh saanjhedaar the.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed a cow on behalf of 'A'isha on the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja).
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Aisha ki taraf se Nahr ke din, 10 Zul-Hijja, ek gaay qurbaan ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed (animals) on behalf of his wives, and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Abu Bakr (the words are): " A cow on behalf of 'A'isha on the occasion of the Hajj."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ki taraf se jaanwar qurbaan kiye, aur Ibn Abu Bakr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Aisha ki taraf se Hajj ke mauqe par ek gaay."

e: Ziyad b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar came upon a person who was slaughtering (sacrificing) his camel and had made him kneel down. So he told him to make it stand up festered (and then sacrifice it) according to the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Ziyad bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ek shakhs ke paas aaye jo apne oont ko qurbaan kar raha tha aur usne use bitha diya tha. To unhone use khada karne ko kaha, bandhe hue paon ke saath aur phir use qurbaan karne ko, Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat ke mutabik.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the sacrificial animals from Medina. I wove garlands for his sacrificial animals (and then he hung them round their necks), and he would not avoid doing anything which the Muhrim avoids.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina se qurbaani ke jaanwar bheje. Maine unke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein bunin, aur phir unhone unhe unki gardanon mein pehna diya, aur woh koi bhi aisa kaam karne se nahi bachte jise Muhrim bachta hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Shihab.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: `A'isha narrated (in another hadith narrated through another chain of transmitters) these words: "As if I am seeing myself weaving the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."
hi: Aisha ne, ek doosri hadees mein, ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi, ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: "Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main khud ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein bunte dekh rahi hoon."

e: Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim reported on the authority of his father that he heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) saying: I used to weave garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with these hands of mine, but he (Allah's Apostle) neither avoided anything nor gave up anything (which a Muhrim should avoid or give up).
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin al-Qasim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein apne haathon se bunti thi, lekin woh na to kuch bachte the na kuch chhodte the, jo ek Muhrim ko bachna ya chhodna chahiye.

e: 'A'isha reported: I wove the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own bands, and then he (the Holy Prophet) marked them, and garlanded them, and then sent them to the House, and stayed at Medina and nothing was forbidden to him which was lawful for him (before).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein apne haathon se buni, aur phir unhone unpar nishaan lagaaya, aur unhe maala pehnaayi, aur phir unhe Ghar, Kaaba, ki taraf bheja, aur khud Madina mein rahe, aur unke liye koi cheez mana nahi ki gayi jo pehle unke liye jaayez thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the sacrificial animals and I wove garlands for them with my own 'hands, and he did not refrain from doing anything which he did not avoid in the state of non-Muhrim.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaani ke jaanwar bheje aur maine unke liye apne haathon se maalayein buni, aur unhone woh kaam karna nahi chhoda jo woh non-Muhrim ki halat mein nahi chhodte the.

e: Al-Qasim reported the Mother of the Faithful (Hadrat 'A'isha Siddiqa) (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: I used to weave these garlands from the multicoloured wool which was with us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the state of non Muhrim among us, and he would do all that was lawful for a lion-Muhrim with his wife.
hi: Al-Qasim ne Ummul-Momineen, Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa, (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Main ye maalayein rangee-birangee oon se buna karti thi jo humare paas hoti thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare beech non-Muhrim ki halat mein rehte the, aur woh apni zauja ke saath woh sab karte jo ek non-Muhrim ke liye jaayez tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I recall how I wove garlands for the sacrificial animals (the goats) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He sent them and then stayed with us as a non-Muhrim.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe yaad hai ki maine kaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron, bakriyon, ke liye maalayein buni. Unhone unhe bheja aur phir hamare saath ek non-Muhrim ke taur par rahe.

e: 'A'isha (Allah, be pleased, with her) reported: I often wove garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he garlanded his sacrificial animals, and then he sent them and stayed in the ouse) avoiding nothing which a Muhrim avoids.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main aksar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein bunti thi, aur unhone apne qurbaani ke jaanwaron ko maala pehnaayi, aur phir unhe bheja aur ghar mein rahe, koi bhi aisa kaam na chhodte hue jo ek Muhrim chhodta hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him) sent some goats as sacrificial animals to the House and He garlanded them.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch bakriyaan qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke taur par Ghar bheji aur unhone unhe maala pehnaayi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We used to garland the goats and send them (to Mecca), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed back in Medina as a non-Muhrim ard nothing was forbidden for him (which is forbidden for a Muhrim).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum bakriyon ko maala pehnaate the aur unhe Makkah bhejte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina mein ek non-Muhrim ke taur par ruke rehte, aur unke liye koi cheez mana nahi thi, jo ek Muhrim ke liye mana hoti hai.

e: 'Amra daughter of Abd al-Rahman reported that Ibn Ziyad had written to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with him) that 'Abdullah b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) bad said that he who sent a sacrificial animal (to Mecca) for him was forbidden what is forbidden for a pilgrim (in the state of Ihram) until the animal is sacrificed I have myself sent my sacrificial animal (to Mecca), so write to me your opinion. Amra reported 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: It is not as Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) had asserted, for I wove the garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then garlanded them with his own hands, and then sent them with my father, and nothing was forbidden for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which had been made lawful for him by Allah until the animals were sacrificed.
hi: Amra, Abdur-Rahman ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Ziyad ne Aisha (RA) ko likha tha ki Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha tha ki jo koi qurbaani ka jaanwar Makkah bhejta hai use un cheezon se mana kiya jaata hai jo ek haaji, ehram ki halat mein, ke liye mana hain jab tak jaanwar qurbaan na ho jaaye. Maine khud apna qurbaani ka jaanwar Makkah bheja hai, is liye mujhe apni raay likhein. Amra ne Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Aisa nahi hai jaisa Ibn Abbas (RA) ne daawa kiya hai, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein apne haathon se buni thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir unhe apne haathon se maala pehnaayi, aur phir unhe mere waalid ke saath bheja, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye koi cheez mana nahi thi jise Allah ne unke liye jaayez kiya tha jab tak jaanwar qurbaan nahi kar diye gaye.

e: Masruq reported: I heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) clapping her hands behind the curtain and saying: I used to weave garlands for the sacrificial animals of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands, and then he (the Holy Prophet) sent them (to Mecca), and he did not avoid doing anything which a Muhritn avoids until his animal was sacrificed.
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) ko parde ke peeche apne haath taali bajaate aur ye kehte suna: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke liye maalayein apne haathon se buna karti thi, aur phir unhone unhe Makkah bheja, aur unhone koi bhi aisa kaam karna nahi chhoda jise ek Muhrim chhodta hai jab tak unka jaanwar qurbaan nahi ho gaya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) rerorted that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a person who was driving a sacrificial camel (and told him to ride on it. Thereupon he said: Messenger of Allah, it is a sacrificial camel. He told him again to ride on it; (when he received the same reply) he said: Woe to you, (he uttered these words on the second or the third reply).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko dekha jo ek qurbaani ke oont ko haank raha tha aur unhone use uspar sawaar hone ko kaha. Isper usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye ek qurbaani ka oont hai. Unhone use dobara uspar sawaar hone ko kaha; jab unhe wahi jawab mila unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos, unhone ye alfaaz doosri ya teesri baar wale jawab par kahe.

e: This hadith has been narrated by A'raj with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " Whereas the person was driving a sacrificial camel which was garlanded."
hi: Ye hadees A'raj ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Jabki woh shakhs ek qurbaani ka oont haank raha tha jise maala pehnaayi gayi thi."

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: It is one out of these (narrations) that Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he narrated to us traditions out of which is that he said: When there was a person who was driving a garlanded sacrificial camel, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Woe to you; ride on it. He said: Messenger of Allah, it is a sacrificial animal, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe to you, ride on it; woe to you, ride on it.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye un riwayaton mein se ek hai jo Abu Huraira (RA) ne humein Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), se riwayat ki, aur unhone humein riwayaten batayi jinmein se ek ye hai ki unhone kaha: Jab ek shakhs tha jo ek maala pehnaaye hue qurbaani ke oont ko haank raha tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Tumpar afsos; usper sawaar ho. Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumpar afsos, usper sawaar ho; tumpar afsos, usper sawaar ho.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by a person who was driving a sacrificial camel, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Ride on It. He said: It is a sacrificial camel. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said twice or thrice: Ride on it.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek shakhs ke paas se guzre jo ek qurbaani ke oont ko haank raha tha, isper unhone kaha: Usper sawaar ho. Usne kaha: Ye ek qurbaani ka oont hai. Isper unhone do ya teen baar kaha: Usper sawaar ho.

e: Anas reported: Someone happened to pass by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with a sacrificial camel, or a sacrificial animal, whereupon he said: Ride on it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel, or animal, whereupon he said: (Ride) even if (it is a sacrificial camel).
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se ek qurbaani ke oont, ya qurbaani ke jaanwar, ke saath guzra, isper unhone kaha: Usper sawaar ho. Usne kaha: Ye ek qurbaani ka oont, ya jaanwar, hai, isper unhone kaha: Sawaar ho chahe woh qurbaani ka oont hi kyun na ho.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: There happened to pass (a person) with a sacrificial camel by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se ek qurbaani ke oont ke saath guzra aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he was asked about riding on a sacrificial animal, and he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Ride on it gently, when you have need for it, until you find (another) mount.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unse qurbaani ke jaanwar par sawaar hone ke baare mein poocha gaya, aur unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Usper narmi se sawaar ho, jab tumhe iski zaroorat ho, jab tak tumhe koi doosri sawaari na mil jaaye.

e: Abu Zubair reported: I asked Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) about riding on the sacrificial animal, to which he replied: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Ride on them gently until you find another mount.
hi: Abu Zubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Jabir (RA) se qurbaani ke jaanwar par sawaar hone ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone jawab diya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Unpar narmi se sawaar ho jab tak tumhe koi doosri sawaari na mil jaaye.

e: Musa b. Salama al-Hudhali reported: I and Sinan b. Salama proceeded (to Mecca to perform Umra. Sinan had a sacrificial camel with him which he was driving. The camel stopped in the way being completely exhausted and this state of it made him (Sinan) helpless. (He thought) if it stops proceeding further how he would be able to take it, along with him and said: I would definitely find out (the religious verdict) about it. I moved on in the morning and as we encamped at al-Batha', (Sinan) said: Come (along with me) to Ibn 'Abbis (Allah be pleased with them) so that we should narrate to him (this incident), and he (Sinan) reported to him the incident of the sacrificial camel. He (Ibn Abbas) said: You have referred (the matter) to the well informed person. (Now listen) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent sixteen sacrificial camels with a man whom he put in change of them. He set out and came back and said: Messenger of Allah, what should I do with those who are completely exhausted and become powerless to move on, whereupon he said: Slaughter them, and dye their hoofs in their blood, and put them on the sides of their humps, but neither you nor anyone among those who are with you must eat any part of them.
hi: Musa bin Salama al-Hudhali ne bayan kiya: Main aur Sinan bin Salama Makkah Umra karne ke liye aage badhe. Sinan ke paas ek qurbaani ka oont tha jise woh haank rahe the. Oont raste mein ruk gaya kyunki woh poori tarah thak gaya tha aur iski wajah se woh Sinan bebas ho gaye. Unhone socha agar ye aage badhna band kar de to kaise woh ise apne saath le jaayenge, aur unhone kaha: Main iske baare mein zaroor pata karunga, mazhabi fatwa. Main subah aage badha aur jab hum al-Batha mein khema laga rahe the, Sinan ne kaha: Chalo mere saath Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas taaki hum unhe ye ghatna sunaayein, aur unhone unhe qurbaani ke oont ki ghatna bataayi. Unhone kaha: Tumne ye maamla achhi tarah jaanne wale shakhs ke paas bheja hai. Ab suno: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne solah qurbaani ke oont ek shakhs ke saath bheje jise unhone unka incharge banaaya. Woh gaye aur wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe un jaanwaron ke saath kya karna chahiye jo poori tarah thak chuke hain aur aage badhne ki taaqat khoye chuke hain, isper unhone kaha: Unhe zibah karo, aur unke khuron ko unke khoon mein rangdo, aur unhe unke kohaan ke aas-paas rakh do, lekin na tum na tumhare saath waale koi bhi unmein se koi hissa khaaye.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent eighteen sacrificial camels with a person. The rest of the hadith is the same, and the first part (of the above-mentioned hadith) is not mentioned.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne athara qurbaani ke oont ek shakhs ke saath bheje. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur pehla hissa, upar bataayi gayi hadees ka, zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Dhuwaib, father of Qabisa (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent under his charge the sacrificial camels, and said: If any of these is completely exhausted and you apprehend its death, then slaughter it, then dip its hoofs in its blood and imprint it on its hump; but neither you nor any one of your comrades should eat it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Dhuwaib, Qabisa (RA) ke waalid, ne unhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne incharge ke saath qurbaani ke oont bheje, aur kaha: Agar unmein se koi poori tarah thak jaaye aur tumhe uski maut ka dar ho, to use zibah karo, phir uske khuron ko uske khoon mein dubao aur use uske kohaan par chhapo; lekin na tum na tumhare saathiyon mein se koi use khaaye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the people used to return through every path, whereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: None amongst you should depart until he performs the last circumambulation round the House. Zuhair said (the words are):  was not mentioned.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki log har raaste se wapas jaate the, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi tab tak rawaana na ho jab tak woh Ghar ka aakhri tawaaf mukammal na kar le. Zuhair ne kaha, alfaaz: ye zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: The people were commanded (by the Holy Prophet) to perform the last circumambulation round the House, but menstruating women were exempted.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Logon ko hukum diya gaya tha ki woh Ghar ka aakhri tawaaf karein, lekin haiz waali auraton ko chhoot di gayi.

e: Tawus reported: I was in the company of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) when Zaid b. Thabit said: Do you give religious verdict that the woman who is in menses is allowed to go without performing the last circumambulation of the House? Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said to him: Ask such and such woman of the Ansar, if you do not (believe my religious verdict) whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had coimmanded her this. Zaid b Thabit (went to that lady and after getting this verdict attested by her) came back to Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) smilingly and said: I did not find you but telling the truth.
hi: Tawus ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sohbat mein tha jab Zaid bin Thabit ne kaha: Kya aap mazhabi fatwa dete hain ki jo aurat haiz mein hai use bina Ghar ka aakhri tawaaf kiye jaane ki ijazat hai? Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: Falan-falan Ansar aurat se poochho, agar aapko mera fatwa yakeen nahi, ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ye hukum diya tha. Zaid bin Thabit us aurat ke paas gaye aur is fatwe ki unse tasdeeq karwaane ke baad muskuraate hue Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Maine aapko sach kehte hue hi paaya hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Safiyyah bint Huyayy entered the period of menses after performing Tawaf Ifada. I made a mention of her menses to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's. Messenger (ﷺ) remarked: Well, then she will detain us. I said: Messenger of Allah. she has performed Tawif Ifada and circumambulated the House, and it was after this that she entered the period of menses. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (If it is so), then proceed forth.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Safiyyah bint Huyayy ko Tawaf Ifada karne ke baad haiz aa gaya. Maine unke haiz ka zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Achha, to woh humein rok legi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhone Tawaf Ifada kiya hai aur Ghar ka tawaaf kiya hai, aur ye uske baad hi tha ki unhe haiz aaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar aisa hai, to aage badho.

e: This hadith is narrated (from 'A'isha) on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): Safiyyah bint Huyayy, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), entered the period of menses at the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage after she had performed Tawaf Ifada in the state of cleanliness; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha se Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: Safiyyah bint Huyayy, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ko Vida ke Hajj ke mauqe par haiz aa gaya, Tawaf Ifada karne ke baad, jab woh paak thin; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. al Qasim narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that she made a mention to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Safiyyah had entered the period of menses. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin al-Qasim ne Aisha (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha ki Safiyyah ko haiz aa gaya hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: We feared that Safiyyah might have entered the period of menses before performing Tawaf Ifada. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and said: Is Safiyyah going to detain us? Thereupon we said: She has performed Tawaf Ifada. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then there is no detention (for us) now.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humein dar tha ki kahin Safiyyah ko Tawaf Ifada karne se pehle haiz na aa gaya ho. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare paas aaye aur kaha: Kya Safiyyah humein rokegi? Isper humne kaha: Unhone Tawaf Ifada kar liya hai. Unhone kaha: To ab hum ruke nahi rahenge.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, Safiyyah bint Huyayy has entered the state of menses, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Perhaps she is going to detain us. Has she not clicumambulated the House along with you (i. e. whether she has not performed Tawaf Ifada)? They said: Yes. He said: Then they should set out.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Safiyyah bint Huyayy ko haiz aa gaya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shayad woh humein rokegi. Kya unhone tumhare saath Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kiya, yaani kya unhone Tawaf Ifada nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: To unhe, aap sab ko, rawaana ho jaana chahiye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) inclined to do with Safiyyah what a man feels inclined to do with his wife. They said: Messenger of Allah, she has entered the state of menses, whereupon he said: (Well) she is going to detain us. They (his wives) said: Messenger of Allah, she performed Tawaf Ziyara (Tawaf Ifada) on the Day of Nahr. Thereupon he said: Then she should proceed along with you
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safiyyah ke saath woh karne ka jhukav rakha jo ek aadmi apni biwi ke saath karna chahta hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhe haiz aa gaya hai, isper unhone kaha: Achha, woh to humein rokegi. Unhone, unki zaujaon ne, kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhone Nahr ke din Tawaf Ziyara, Tawaf Ifada, kiya tha. Isper unhone kaha: To unhe tumhare saath rawaana ho jaana chahiye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) decided to march (for return journey), he found Safiyyah at the door of her tent, sad and downcast. He remarked. Barren, shaven-head, you are going to detain us, and then said: Did you perform Tawaf Ifada on the Day of Nahr? She replied in the affirmative, whereupon he said: Then march on.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne march karne, wapasi safar ke liye, ka faisla kiya, unhone Safiyyah ko unke khaime ke darwaze par udaas aur pareshaan paaya. Unhone kaha: Baanjh, mundhe sar wali, tum humein rokogi, aur phir kaha: Kya tumne Nahr ke din Tawaf Ifada kiya? Unhone haan mein jawab diya, isper unhone kaha: To phir march karo.

e: This hadith is narrated by 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) through another chain of transmitters, but no mention is made of" sad and downcast".
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin "udaas aur pareshaan" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace, be upon him) entered the Ka'ba. Usama, Bilal and 'Uthman b. Talha, the keeper (of the Ka'ba), were along with him. He closed the door and stayed in it for some time. Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: I asked Bilal as he came out what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done there. He said: He prayed there in (such a position) that two pillars were on his left side, one pillar on his right, and three pillars were behind him, and the House at that time was resting on six pillars.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kaaba mein daakhil kiya. Usama, Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha, Kaaba ke rakshak, unke saath the. Unhone darwaza band kiya aur kuch der wahan rahe. Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Maine Bilal se poocha jab woh bahar aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wahan kya kiya. Unhone kaha: Unhone wahan namaz padhi is position mein ki do khambe unki baayi taraf the, ek khamba unki daayi taraf, aur teen khambe unke peeche the, aur Ghar us waqt chhe khambon par tika hua tha.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came on the Day of Victory, and got down in the courtyard of the Ka'ba and he sent (a message) for 'Uthman b. Talha (Allah be pleased with them). He came with the key and opened the door. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) then entered therein and Bilal, Usama b. Zaid, and 'Uthman b. Talha (along with him), and then commanded the door to be closed. They stayed there for a considerable time, and then the door was opened, and Abdullah said: I was the first to meet Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ). outside (the Ka'ba), and Bilal was close behind him. I said to Bilal: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observe prayer therein? He said: Yes. I said: Where? He said: Between the two pillars in front of his face. He said: I forgot to ask him as to the number of rakahs he prayed.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatah ke din aaye, aur Kaaba ke aangan mein utre aur unhone Uthman bin Talha (RA) ke liye payaam bheja. Woh chaabi lekar aaye aur darwaza khola. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir andar daakhil huye aur Bilal, Usama bin Zaid, aur Uthman bin Talha unke saath, aur phir unhone darwaza band karne ka hukum diya. Woh wahan kaafi der rahe, aur phir darwaza khola gaya, aur Abdullah ne kaha: Main sabse pehla shakhs tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahar, Kaaba ke, mila, aur Bilal unke peeche the. Maine Bilal se kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wahan namaz padhi? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kahan? Unhone kaha: Do khambon ke beech, unke chehre ke saamne. Unhone kaha: Main unse rakaton ki tadaad poochhna bhool gaya jo unhone padhi.

e: lbn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came daring the year of Victory on the she-camel of Usama b. Zaid until he made her kneel down in the courtyard of the Ka'ba (and got down). He then sent for 'Uthman b. Talha and said: Bring me the key. He went to his mother and she refused to give that to him. He said: By Allah, give that to him or this sword would be thrust into my side. So she gave that to him, and he came with that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and gave that to him, and he opened the door. The rest of the hadith is the same as the above one.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatah ke saal Usama bin Zaid ki oontni par aaye yahan tak ki unhone use Kaaba ke aangan mein bithaya aur utre. Unhone phir Uthman bin Talha ke liye payaam bheja aur kaha: Mujhe chaabi laao. Woh apni maa ke paas gaye aur unhone use dene se inkaar kiya. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, ise, chaabi, use do warna ye talwaar mere pehlu mein ghusaa di jaayegi. To unhone use di, aur woh use lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe di, aur unhone darwaza khola. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) entered the House, and Usama, Bilal and Uthman b. Talha were with him, and they kept the door closed for a considerable time. Then it was opened and I was the first to enter the House and meet Bilal, and I said: Where did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observe prayer? He said: Between these two front pillars. I, however, forgot to ask him the number of rak'ahs that he observed.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar mein daakhil kiya, aur Usama, Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha unke saath the, aur unhone darwaza kaafi der ke liye band rakha. Phir woh khola gaya aur main sabse pehla shakhs tha jo Ghar mein daakhil hua aur Bilal se mila, aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kahan namaz padhi? Unhone kaha: In do saamne wale khambon ke beech. Main, halaanki, unse rakaton ki tadaad poochhna bhool gaya jo unhone padhi.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported that he reached the Ka'ba and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had entered therein, and Bilal and Usama too. 'Uthman b. Talha closed the door to them, and they stayed there for a considerable time, and then the door was opend and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came out, and I went upstairs and entered the House and said: Where did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) observe prayer? They said: At this very place. I, however, forgot to ask them about the (number of) rak'ahs that he observed.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki woh Kaaba tak pahunche aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usmein daakhil kiya tha, aur Bilal aur Usama bhi. Uthman bin Talha ne unke liye darwaza band kar diya, aur woh wahan kaafi der ke liye rahe, aur phir darwaza khola gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar aaye, aur main upar gaya aur Ghar mein daakhil hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kahan namaz padhi? Unhone kaha: Isi jagah par. Main, halaanki, unse rakaton ki tadaad poochhna bhool gaya jo unhone padhi.

e: Salim narrated on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the House along with Usama b. Zaid, Bilal and Uthman b. Talha. They closed the door from within, and, as they opened it, I was the first to get into it and meet Bilal, and I asked him: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observe prayer in it? He said: Yes, he observed prayer between these two Yemenite pillars (pillars situated towards the side of Yemen).
hi: Salim ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Usama bin Zaid, Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha ke saath Ghar mein daakhil kiya. Unhone andar se darwaza band kiya, aur jab unhone use khola, main sabse pehla shakhs tha jo isme daakhil hua aur Bilal se mila, aur maine unse poocha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ismein namaz padhi? Unhone kaha: Haan, unhone in do Yemani khambon ke beech namaz padhi, khambe jo Yemen ki taraf sthit hain.

e: Salim b. Abdullah reported his father (Allah be pleased with him) saying: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entering the Ka'ba, and Usama b. Zaid, Bilal and 'Uthman b. Talha were along with him, but none (else) entered therein along with them. Then the door was closed for them from within. 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: Bilal and Uthman b. Talha informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed prayer in the interior of the Ka'ba between the two Yemenite pillars.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Kaaba mein daakhil hote dekha, aur Usama bin Zaid, Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha unke saath the, lekin unke saath koi aur usmein daakhil nahi hua. Phir unke liye darwaza andar se band kar diya gaya. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kaaba ke andar do Yemani khambon ke beech namaz padhi.

e: Ibn Juraij reported: I said to 'Ata': Have you heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: You have been commanded to observe circumambulation, and not commanded to enter it (the Ka'ba)? He ('Ata') said: He (Ibn Abbas) (at the same time) did not forbid entrance into it. I, however, heard him saying: Usama b. Zaid informed me that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered the House, he supplicated in all sides of it; and he did not observe prayer therein till he came out, and as he came out he observed two rak'ahs in front of the House, and said: This is your Qibla. I said to him: What is meant by its sides? Does that mean its corners? He said: (In all sides and nooks of the House) there is Qibla.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne bayan kiya: Maine Ata se kaha: Kya aapne Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna hai: Tumhe tawaaf karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, na ki isme, Kaaba mein, daakhil karne ka? Unhone kaha: Unhone isi waqt isme daakhil hone se mana nahi kiya. Maine, halaanki, unhe ye kehte suna: Usama bin Zaid ne mujhe bataya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar mein daakhil kiya, unhone iski har taraf dua ki; aur unhone wahan namaz nahi padhi jab tak woh bahar nahi aaye, aur jab woh bahar aaye, unhone Ghar ke saamne do rakat padhi, aur kaha: Ye tumhara Qibla hai. Maine unse kaha: Iski taraf ka kya matlab hai? Kya iska matlab uske konay hain? Unhone kaha: Ghar ki har taraf aur konay mein Qibla hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered the Ka'ba, and in it there were six pillars, and he stood near a pillar and made supplication, but did not observe the prayer.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kaaba mein daakhil kiya, aur usmein chhe khambe the, aur woh ek khambe ke qareeb khade hue aur dua ki, lekin namaz nahi padhi.

e: Isma'il b. Abu Khalid reported: I asked Abdullah b. Abu Aufa (Allah be pleased with him), a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whether Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had entered the House, while performing 'Umra, He said: NO.
hi: Ismail bin Abu Khalid ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahabi, se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umra karte waqt Ghar mein daakhil kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Nahi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) said to me: Had your people not been unbelievers in the recent past (had they not quite recently accepted Islam), I would have demolished the Ka'ba and would have rebuilt it on the foundation (laid) by Ibrahim; for when the Quraish had built the Ka'ba, they reduced its (area), and I would also have built (a door) in the rear.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Agar tumhari qaum haal hi tak kaafir na hoti, agar unhone bahut haal mein Islam qubool na kiya hota, to main Kaaba ko toda deta aur use us buniyaad par phir se banaata jo Ibrahim ne rakhi thi; kyunki jab Quraish ne Kaaba banaaya, unhone iska kshetra chhota kar diya, aur main peechhe ek darwaza bhi bana deta.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: Didn't you see that when your people built the Ka'ba, they reduced (its area with the result that it no longer remains) on the foundations (laid) by Ibrahim. I said: Messenger of Allah, why don't you rebuild it on the foundations (laid by) Ibrahim? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had your people not been new converts to Islam, I would have done that. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: If 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) had heard it from Allah's Messenger (may peace be up (vn him), I would not have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) abandoning the touching of the two corners situated near al-Hijr, but (for the fact) that it was not completed on the foundations (laid) by Ibrihim.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kya tumne nahi dekha ki jab tumhari qaum ne Kaaba banaaya, unhone iska kshetra chhota kar diya jiske natije mein ye Ibrahim ki rakhi hui buniyaad par nahi rahi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap ise Ibrahim ki rakhi hui buniyaad par phir se kyun nahi banaate? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tumhari qaum abhi-abhi Islam mein na aayi hoti, to main aisa kar deta. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Agar Aisha (RA) ne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hota, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko al-Hijr ke qareeb sthit do konon ko chhoote na dekha hota, lekin is baat ki wajah se ki ye Ibrahim ki buniyaad par mukammal nahi thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If your people, had not been recent converts to Islam, I would have spent the treasure of the Ka'ba in the way of Allah and would have constructed its door just on the level of the ground and would have encompassed in it the space of Hijr.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tumhari qaum abhi-abhi Islam mein aayi na hoti, to main Kaaba ka khazaana Allah ki raah mein kharch kar deta aur uska darwaza zameen ke barabar bana deta aur usmein Hijr ki jagah shaamil kar leta.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) reported on the authority of his mother's sister ('A'isha) saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, if your people had not been recently polytheists (and new converts to Islam), I would have demolished the Ka'ba, and would have brought it to the level of the ground and would have constructed two doors, one facing the east and the other one to the west, and would have added to it six cubits of area from Hijr, for the Quraish had reduced it when they rebuilt it.
hi: Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) ne apni maasi, Aisha, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, agar tumhari qaum haal hi mein mushrik na rahi hoti, aur nayi Musalman na hui hoti, to main Kaaba ko todkar zameen ke barabar la deta aur do darwaze banaata, ek poorab ki taraf aur doosra paschim ki taraf, aur Hijr se chhe haath kshetra jodta, kyunki Quraish ne ise chhota kar diya tha jab unhone ise phir se banaaya.

e: 'Ata' reported: The House was burnt during the time of Yazid b. Muawiya when the people of Syria had fought (in Mecca). And it happened with it (the Ka'ba) what was (in store for it). Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) felt it (in the same state) until the people came in the season (of Hajj). (The idea behind was) that he wanted to exhort them or incite them (to war) against the people of Syria. When the people had arrived he said to them: O people, advise me about the Ka'ba. Should I demolish it and then build it from its very foundation, or should I repair whatever has been damaged of it? Ibn 'Abbas said: An idea has occurred to me according to which I think that you should only repair (the portion which has been) damaged, and leave the House (in that very state in which) people embraced Islam (and leave those very stones in the same state) when people embraced Islam, and over which Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had raised it. Thereupon Ibn Zubair said: It the house of any one of you is burnt, he would not be contented until he had reconstructed it, then what about the House of your Lord (which is far more Important than your house)? I would seek good advice from my Lord thrice and then I would make up (my mind) about this affair. After seeking good advice thrice, he made up his mind to demolish it. The people apprehended that calamity might fall from heaven on those persons who would be first to climb (over the building for the purpose of demolishing it), till one (took up courage, and ascended the roof), and threw down one of its stones. When the people saw no calamity befalling him, they followed him, demolished it until it was razed to the ground. Then Ibn Zubair erected pillars and hung cartains on them (in order to provide facilities to the people for observing the time of its construction). And the walls were raised; and Ibn Zubair said: I heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) say that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had observed: If the people had Rot recently (abandoned) unbelief, find I had means enough to reconstruct it, which I had not, I would have definitely excompassed in it five cubits of area from Hijr. And I would also have constructed a door for the people to enter, and a door for their exit. I today have (the means to spend) and I entertain no fearfrom the side of people (that they would protest against this change). So he added five cubits of area from the side of Hatim to it that there appeared (the old) foundation (upon which Hadrat Ibrahim had built the Ka'ba). and the people saw that and it was upon this foundation that the wall was raised. The length of the Ka'ba was eighteen cubits. when addition was made to it (which was in its breadth), then naturally the length appears to be) small (as compared with its breadth). Then addition of ten cubits (of area) was made in its length (also). Two doors were also constructed, one of which (was meant) for entrance and the other one for exit. When Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) was killed, Hajjaj wrote to 'Abd al-Malik (b. Marwan) informing him about it, and telling him that Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) had built (the Ka'ba) on those very foundations (which were laid by Ibrahim) and which reliable persons among the Meccans had seen. 'Abd al-Malik wrote to him: We are not concerned with the censuring of Ibn Zubair in anything. Keep intact the addition made by him in the side of length, and whatever he has added frem the side of Hijr revert to (its previous) foundation, and wall up the door which he had opened. Thus Hajjaj at the command of Abd al-Malik) demolished it (that portion) and rebuilt it on (its previous) foundations.
hi: Ata ne bayan kiya: Ghar Yazid bin Muawiya ke daur mein jal gaya jab Syria ke log Makkah mein lade the. Aur iske saath, Kaaba ke saath, woh hua jo iske liye muqarrar tha. Ibn Zubair (RA) ne ise isi haalat mein mehsoos kiya jab tak log Hajj ke mausam mein na aa gaye. Iske peeche ye soch thi ki woh unhe Syria ke logon ke khilaaf ubhaarna ya bhadkaana chahte the. Jab log aa gaye, unhone unse kaha: Aye logo, mujhe Kaaba ke baare mein salaah do. Kya mujhe ise todkar iski buniyaad se banaana chahiye, ya jo bhi iska nuksaan hua hai use theek karna chahiye? Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Mujhe ek khayal aaya hai jiske mutabik mujhe lagta hai ki aapko sirf, nuksaan huye hisse ki, marammat karni chahiye, aur Ghar ko usi halat mein chhodna chahiye jismein log Islam mein aaye the, aur usi patthar ki halat mein chhodna chahiye jab log Islam mein aaye, aur jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise uthaaya tha. Isper Ibn Zubair ne kaha: Agar tum mein se kisi ka ghar jal jaaye, to woh tab tak santusht nahi hota jab tak use dobara nahi banaata, to phir tumhare Rab ke Ghar ka kya, jo tumhare ghar se kahin zyada ahem hai? Main apne Rab se teen baar achhi salaah maangunga aur phir iske baare mein apna faisla lunga. Teen baar achhi salaah maangne ke baad, unhone ise todne ka faisla kiya. Logon ko dar tha ki kahin aasmaan se aafat na aa jaaye un logon par jo sabse pehle, imaarat par chadhkar ise todne ke liye, chadhein, yahan tak ki ek ne himmat ki, aur chhat par chadha, aur uska ek patthar neeche phenka. Jab logon ne dekha ki uspar koi aafat nahi aayi, unhone uska anusaran kiya, ise toda yahan tak ki ye zameen ke barabar ho gaya. Phir Ibn Zubair ne khambe khade kiye aur unpar parde latka diye, taaki logon ko iski taamir ka waqt dekhne ki suvidha mil sake. Aur deewaren buland ki gayin; aur Ibn Zubair ne kaha: Maine Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bayaan kiya tha: Agar log haal hi mein kufr chhod na aaye hote, aur mere paas ise phir se banaane ke kaafi saadhan hote, jo mere paas nahi the, to main ismein Hijr se paanch haath ka kshetra zaroor shaamil karta. Aur main logon ke daakhil hone ke liye ek darwaza aur unke bahar jaane ke liye ek darwaza bhi banaata. Aaj mere paas kharch karne ke saadhan hain aur mujhe logon ki taraf se koi dar nahi hai, ki woh is badlaav ka virodh karenge. To unhone Hatim ki taraf se paanch haath ka kshetra ismein joda taaki puraani buniyaad zaahir ho jaaye, jispar Hazrat Ibrahim ne Kaaba banaaya tha. Aur logon ne ye dekha aur isi buniyaad par deewaar khadi ki gayi. Kaaba ki lambaai atharah haath thi. Jab ismein izafa kiya gaya, jo iski chaudai mein tha, to swaabhaavik soorat se lambaai chhoti, chaudai ke muqable, dikhne lagi. Phir das haath kshetra ka izafa iski lambaai mein bhi kiya gaya. Do darwaze bhi banaaye gaye, jinmein se ek daakhil hone ke liye tha aur doosra bahar jaane ke liye. Jab Ibn Zubair (RA) ko qatal kiya gaya, Hajjaj ne Abd al-Malik, bin Marwan, ko iske baare mein bataate hue likha, aur unhe bataya ki Ibn Zubair (RA) ne isi buniyaad par Kaaba banaaya tha, jo Ibrahim ne rakhi thi, aur jise Makkah ke bharosemand logon ne dekha tha. Abd al-Malik ne unhe likha: Humein Ibn Zubair ki kisi bhi baat mein nindaa karne ka koi lena-dena nahi hai. Unke ke zariye ki gayi lambaai ki taraf ki barhoutari ko waisi hi rehne do, aur jo bhi unhone Hijr ki taraf se joda hai use waapas, pichhli, buniyaad par le aao, aur us darwaze ko band karo jo unhone khola tha. To Hajjaj ne, Abd al-Malik ke hukum par, use toda aur pichhli buniyaadon par phir se banaaya.

e: Abdullah b. 'Ubaid reported that Harith b. 'Abdullah led a deputation to 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan during his caliphate. 'Abd al-Malik said: I do riot think that Abu Khubaib (i. e. Ibn Zabair) had heard from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) (about the intended wish of the Prophet [may peace be upon him) In regard to the alteration of the Ka'ba). Harith said: Yes, I myself did hear from her. He ('Abd al-Malik) said: Well, tell me what you heard from her. He stated that she (Hadrat 'A'isha) had said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) remarked: Verily your people have reduced (the area) of the House from its (original foundations, and if they had not recently abandoned polytheism (and embraced Islam) I would have reversed it to (those foundations) which they had left out of it. nd if your people would take initiative after me in rebuilding it, then come along with me so that I should show you what they have left out of it. He showed her about fifteen cubits of area from the side of Hatim (that they had separated). This is the narration transmitted by 'Abdullah b. Ubaid. Walid b. 'Ata' has, however, made this addition to it:" Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I would have made two doors on the level of the ground (facing) the east and the west. Do you know why your people raised the level of its door (i. e. the door of the Ka'ba)? She said: No. He said: (They did it) out of vanity so that (they might be in a position) to grant admittance to him only whom they wished. When a person intended to get into it, they let him climb (the stairs), and as he was about to enter, they pushed him and he fell down." 'Abd al-Malik said to Harith; Did you yourself hear her saying this? He said: Yes. He (Harith) said that he ('Abd al-Malik) scratched the ground with his staff for some time and then said: I wish I had left his (Ibn Zubair's) work there.
hi: Abdullah bin Ubaid ne bayan kiya ki Harith bin Abdullah ne Abd al-Malik bin Marwan ke daur mein unki khilafat ke daurane ek prtinidhi mandal ki agvaani ki. Abd al-Malik ne kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta ki Abu Khubaib, yaani Ibn Zubair, ne Aisha (RA) se suna hoga, Nabi ki Kaaba mein badlaav ki iraadi khwahish ke baare mein. Harith ne kaha: Haan, maine khud unse suna. Unhone kaha: Achha, mujhe bataao aapne unse kya suna. Unhone bataya ki unhone, Hazrat Aisha ne, kaha tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan tumhari qaum ne Ghar ka kshetra uski asal buniyaad se chhota kar diya, aur agar unhone haal hi mein shirk chhoda na hota, aur Islam qubool na kiya hota, to main use un buniyaadon par wapas le aata jinhe unhone chhoda tha. Aur agar tumhari qaum mere baad ise phir se banaane ki pahal karti, to mere saath aana taaki main tumhe dikha sakoon jo unhone chhoda hai. Unhone unhe Hatim ki taraf se pandrah haath ka kshetra dikhaaya, jise unhone alag kar diya tha. Ye riwayat Abdullah bin Ubaid ne di hai. Walid bin Ata ne, halaanki, isme ye izafa kiya: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main zameen ke barabar do darwaze banaata, poorab aur paschim ki taraf. Kya tumhe pata hai tumhari qaum ne kyun uske darwaze, Kaaba ke darwaze, ki oonchai badhaayi? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Unhone ye ghamand ki wajah se kiya taaki woh isme takht mein sirf usi ko daakhil karein jise woh chaahein. Jab koi shakhs usmein daakhil hona chahta, woh use seedhiyon par chadhne dete, aur jab woh daakhil hone hi wala hota, woh use dhakel dete aur woh gir jaata." Abd al-Malik ne Harith se kaha: Kya aapne khud unhe ye kehte suna? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha ki unhone apni chhadi se kuch der zameen khurchi aur phir kaha: Kaash maine unka, Ibn Zubair ka, kaam wahin chhod diya hota.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Qaza'ah reported that while Abd al-Malik b. Marwan was circumambulating the Ka'ba he said: May Allah ruin Ibn Zubair that he lies in attributing to the Mother of the Faithful, as he says: I heard her stating that Allah's Messenger (may'peace be upon him) had said: 'A'isha, if your people had not been new converts to Islam, I would have demolished the House and would have added (in it area) from the Hijr for your people have reduced the area from its foundations. Harith b. 'Abdullah b. Abu Rabi'a (Allah be pleased with him) said: Commander of the Faithful, don't say that, for I heard the Mother of the Faithful saying this, whereupon he said: If I had heard this before demolishing it, I would have left it in the state in which Ibn Zabair had built it.
hi: Abu Qaza'a ne bayan kiya ki jab Abd al-Malik bin Marwan Kaaba ka tawaaf kar rahe the, unhone kaha: Allah Ibn Zubair ko barbaad kare ki woh Ummul-Momineen se mansoob karte hue jhoot bolte hain, jaisa woh kehte hain: Maine unhe ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Aisha, agar tumhari qaum nayi Musalman na hoti, to main Ghar ko toda deta aur iska kshetra Hijr se badha deta kyunki tumhari qaum ne buniyaad se iska kshetra chhota kar diya. Harith bin Abdullah bin Abu Rabi'a (RA) ne kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, ye mat kahiye, kyunki maine khud Ummul-Momineen ko ye kehte suna, isper unhone kaha: Agar maine ye ise todne se pehle suna hota, to main ise usi haalat mein chhod deta jismein Ibn Zubair ne ise banaaya tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the wall, circumpassing the House (i. e. whether the wall on the side of Hijr was included in the Ka'ba). He said, Yes. I said: Then why did they not include it in the House? He said: 'Your people ran short of the means (to do so). I said: Why is it that the level of its door is raised high? He said: Your people did it so that they should admit one whom they liked, and forbid him whom they disliked, and if your people were not new converts to faith, and I did not apprehend that their hearts would feel agitated at this. I would have definitely included (the area of) this wall-in the House and would have brought the door to the level of the ground.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Ghar ke aas-paas ki deewaar ke baare mein poocha, yaani kya Hijr ki taraf ki deewaar Kaaba mein shaamil thi. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: To phir unhone ise Ghar mein kyun shaamil nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Tumhari qaum ke paas aisa karne ke saadhan kam pad gaye the. Maine kaha: Aisa kyun hai ki iske darwaze ki oonchai buland hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhari qaum ne aisa is liye kiya taaki woh usi ko andar aane dein jise woh pasand karte hain, aur usse rokein jise woh napasand karte hain, aur agar tumhari qaum nayi imaan waali na hoti, aur mujhe dar na hota ki isse unke dilon mein hulchul hogi, to main zaroor is deewaar ke kshetra ko Ghar mein shaamil karta aur darwaze ko zameen ke barabar laata.
