e: 'A'isha reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Hijr, and the rest of the hadith is the same. I also said: Why is it that the door has been made on a higher level, and one cannot (get into it) but with the help of a ladder? The rest of the hadith is the same as reported above and the concluding words are: (I do not change it) out of the apprehension that their hearts may disapprove of it."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Hijr ke baare mein poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Maine ye bhi kaha: Aisa kyun hai ki darwaza itni oonchai par banaaya gaya hai, aur ismein daakhil sirf seedhi ki madad se hi hua ja sakta hai? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui aur aakhri alfaaz hain: "Main ise nahi badalta is dar se ki kahin unke dilon mein iski napasandeegi na paida ho jaaye."

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that while al-Fadl b. Abbas had been riding behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a women of the tribe of Khath'am came to him (to the Holy Proppet) asking for a religious verdict. Fadl looked at her and she looked at him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned the face of al-Fadl to the other side. She said: Messenger of Allah, there is an obligation from Allah upon His servants in regard to Hajj. (But) my father is an aged man; he is incapable of riding safely. May I perform Hajj on his behalf? He said: Yes. It was during the Farewell Pilgrimage.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki jab al-Fadl bin Abbas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaar the, Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat unke paas aayi ek mazhabi fatwe ke liye poochhte hue. Fadl ne unhe dekha aur unhone Fadl ko dekha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-Fadl ka chehra doosri taraf moda. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki taraf se apne bandon par Hajj ka farz hai. Lekin mere waalid ek boodhe aadmi hain; woh mahfooz tarike se sawaari nahi kar sakte. Kya main unki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ye Vida ke Hajj ke daurane tha.

e: Fadl reported that a woman of Banu Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is very old. There is an old obligation of Hajj upon him from Allah, but he is not capable of sitting on the back of the camel. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Perform Hajj on his behalf.
hi: Fadl ne bayan kiya ki Banu Khath'am ki ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere waalid bahut boodhe hain. Unpar Allah ki taraf se Hajj ka ek puraana farz hai, lekin woh oont ki peeth par baithne mein saksham nahi hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unki taraf se Hajj karo.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met some riders at al-Rauha and asked who they were. They replied that they were Muslims. They said: Who art thou? He said: (I am) Messengef of Allah. A woman (then) lifted up a boy to him and said: Would this child be credited with having performed the Hajj? Thereupon he said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) al-Rauha mein kuch sawaaron se mile aur poocha ki woh kaun hain. Unhone jawab diya ki woh Musalman hain. Unhone kaha: Aap kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Ek aurat ne phir ek bachche ko unki taraf uthaaya aur kaha: Kya is bachche ko Hajj karne ka sawaab milega? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: A woman lifted up her child and said: Messenger of Allah, would the child be credited with having performed the Hajj? Thereupon he said: Yes, and there would be a reward for you.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat ne apne bachche ko uthaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya bachche ko Hajj ka sawaab milega? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

e: Karaib reported: A woman lifted a child and said: Messenger of Allah, would he be credited with Hajj? He said: Yes. and for you there would be a reward.
hi: Kuraib ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat ne ek bachche ko uthaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya use Hajj ka sawaab milega? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us and said: O people, Allah has made Hajj obligatory for you; so perform Hajj. Thereupon a person said: Messenger of Allah, (is it to be performed) every year? He (the Holy Prophet) kept quiet, and he repeated (these words) thrice, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If I were to say" Yes," it would become obligatory (for you to perform it every year) and you would not be able to do it. Then he said: Leave me with what I have left to you, for those who were before you were desroyed because of excessive questioning, and their opposition to their apostles. So when I command you to do anything, do it as much as it lies in your power and when I forbid you to do anything, then abandon it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Aye logo, Allah ne tumpar Hajj farz kiya hai; is liye Hajj karo. Isper ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ise har saal karna hai? Unhone khamoshi rakhi, aur unhone, us shakhs ne, ye teen baar dohraaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main "Haan" kehta, to ye farz ho jaata, har saal ise karna, aur tum aisa kar nahi paate. Phir unhone kaha: Mujhe usi cheez ke saath chhod do jo maine tumhare liye chhoda hai, kyunki tumse pehle log tabaah ho gaye kyunki unhone bahut sawaal poochhe, aur apne Nabiyon ka virodh kiya. Is liye jab main tumhe kisi cheez ka hukum dun, use jitna ho sake karo, aur jab main tumhe kisi cheez se mana karun, to use chhod do.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on three (days' journey) except when she has a Mahram with her.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen din ke safar par tab tak na nikle jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the same authority by Ubaidullah. And in the narration of Abu Bakr (the words are): " More than three (days)." Ibn Numair narrated on the authority of his father, (and the words are):" Three (days) except (when) she has a Mahram with her."
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Teen din se zyada." Ibn Numair ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki, aur alfaaz hain: "Teen din siwaay jab uske saath Mahram ho."

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah -be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Hereafter to travel for more than three nights journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh teen raaton ke safar se zyada ke liye safar kare jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

e: Qaza'ah reported: I heard a hadith from Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) and it impressed me (very much), so I said to him: Did you hear it (yourself) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: (Can) I speak of anything about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I did not bear? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Do not set out on a journey (for religious devotion) but for the three mosques-for this mosque of mine (at Medina) the Sacred Mosque (at Mecca), and the Mosque al-Aqsa (Bait al-Maqdis), and I heard him saying also: A woman should not travel for two days duration, but only when there is a Mahram with her or her husband.
hi: Qaza'a ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id (RA) se ek hadees suni aur usne mujhe bahut prabhaavit kiya, is liye maine unse kaha: Kya aapne ise khud Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Isper unhone kaha: Kya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein aisi koi baat keh sakta hoon jo maine khud na suni ho? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Deeni fariziyat ke liye safar sirf teen masjidon ke liye karo - meri is masjid ke liye, Madina mein, Masjid al-Haram, Makkah mein, aur Masjid al-Aqsa, Bait al-Maqdis, aur maine unhe ye bhi kehte suna: Ek aurat do din ke safar par na nikle, siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ya uska shohar ho.

e: Qaza'ah reported: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) saying: I heard four things from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which impressed me and captivated me (and one out of these is this), that he forbade a woman to undertake journey extending over two days but with her husband, or with a Mahram; and he then narrated the rest of the hadith.
hi: Qaza'a ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chaar cheezein sunin jinhone mujhe prabhaavit kiya aur mera dil moh liya, aur unmein se ek ye hai, ki unhone ek aurat ko do din se zyada ke safar par jaane se mana kiya siwaay uske shohar ya Mahram ke saath; aur phir unhone baaki hadees bayan ki.

e: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on three (days') journey, but in the company of a Mahram.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen din ke safar par na nikle, lekin Mahram ki sohbat mein.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on a journey extending beyond three nights but with a Mahram.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen raaton se zyada ke safar par na nikle, lekin Mahram ke saath.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters and he said: " More than three (days) except in the company of a Mahram."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Teen din se zyada siwaay Mahram ki sohbat mein."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a Muslim woman to travel a night's journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman aurat ke liye ek raat ka safar karna jaayez nahi hai siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake a day's journey except in the company of a Mahram.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh ek din ka safar kare siwaay Mahram ki sohbat mein.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake journey extending over a day and a night except when there is a Mahram with her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh ek din aur ek raat ka safar kare jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman to undertake three (days, ) journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aurat ke liye teen din ka safar karna jaayez nahi hai jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake journey extending over three days or more, except when she is in the company of her father, or her son, or her husband, or her brother, or any other Mahram.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh teen din ya usse zyada ka safar kare, siwaay iske ki woh apne waalid, ya apne bete, ya apne shohar, ya apne bhai, ya kisi doosre Mahram ki sohbat mein ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivering a sermon and making this observation:" No person should be alone with a woman except when there is a Mahram with her, and the woman should not undertake journey except with a Mahram." A person stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, my wife has set out for pilgrimage, whereas I am enlisted to fight in such and such battle, whereupon he said:" You go and perform Hajj with your wife."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khutba dete aur ye kehte suna: "Koi bhi shakhs kisi aurat ke saath akela na rahe siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho, aur aurat ko Mahram ke bagair safar nahi karna chahiye." Ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri biwi Hajj ke liye nikli hai, jabki mera naam ek fauji abhiyaan mein likha gaya hai, falan-falan jung ke liye, isper unhone kaha: "Jao aur apni biwi ke saath Hajj karo."

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Amr on the authority of the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Amr ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Juraij narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of it: " No person (man) should be alone with a woman except when there is a Mahram with her."
hi: Ibn Juraij ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki, lekin unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya: "Koi bhi shakhs, mard, kisi aurat ke saath akela na rahe siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho."

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted his camel while setting out on a journey, he glorified Allah (uttered Allah-o-Akbar) thrice, and then said: Hallowed is He Who subdued for us this (ride) and we were not ourselves powerful enough to use It as a ride, and we are going to return to our Lord. O Allah, we seek virtue and piety from Thee in this journey of ours and the act which pleaseth Thee. O Allah, lighten this journey of ours, and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, Thou art (our) companion during the journey, and guardian of (our) family. O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from hardships of the journey, gloominess of the sights, and finding of evil changes in property and family on return. And he (the Holy Prophet) uttered (these words), and made this addition to them: We are returning, repentant, worshipping our Lord. and praising Him.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne oont par sawaar hote safar shuru karte waqt, woh Allah ki tasbeeh karte, teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte, aur phir kehte: Muqaddas hai Woh jisne humare liye ye sawaari muskhar kar di jabki hum khud isse sawaari ke taur par istemal karne ki taaqat nahi rakhte, aur hum apne Rab ki taraf laut ne wale hain. Aye Allah, hum Tujhse achhaai aur takwa maangte hain apni is safar mein aur woh amal jo Tujhe pasand ho. Aye Allah, humare is safar ko aasaan bana, aur iski doori humare liye sahi kar de. Aye Allah, Tu safar mein hamara saathi hai, aur hamare khaandaan ka rakshak. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon safar ki mushkilon se, manzaron ki udaasi se, aur wapas aane par maal aur khaandaan mein buri tabdeeliyaan paane se. Aur unhone ye alfaaz kahe, aur isme ye izafa kiya: Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte hue, apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue, aur uski tareef karte hue.

e: Abdullah b. Sarjis (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set forth on a journey, he sought refuge (with Allah) from the hardships of the travelling, and finding of evil changes on return, and disgrace after honour, and the curse of the oppressed and a gloomy sad scene in family and property.
hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar par nikalte the, woh Allah se safar ki mushkilon se panah maangte, aur wapas aane par buri tabdeeliyaan paane se, izzat ke baad zillat se, aur mazloom ki bad-dua se, aur khaandaan aur maal mein ek udaas manzar se.

e: A hadlth like this has been narrated on the authority of Asim With the same chain of transmitters except (this difference) that the hadith transmitted by 'Abd al-Wahid (one of the narrators) the (word)" property" precedes the family, and in the hadith transmitted by Mahammad b. Khazim (the word)" family" precedes (theword" Property" ), on returning home, in the narrations of both the narrators (these words are found): " O Allah I seek refuge with Thee from the hardships of the journey."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Asim ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq ke ki Abd al-Wahid, ek raawi, ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz "maal" khaandaan se pehle aata hai, aur Muhammad bin Khazim ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz "khaandaan", alfaaz "maal" se, pehle aata hai, ghar wapas aate waqt, dono raawiyon ki riwayat mein ye alfaaz milte hain: "Aye Allah main safar ki mushkilon se Teri panah maangta hoon."

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from the battle or from expeditions or from Hajj or Umra and as he reached the top of the hillock or upon the elevated hard ground, he uttered Allah-o- Akbar thrice, and then said: There is no god but Allah. He is One, there is no partner with Him, His is the sovereignty and His is the praise and He is Potent over everything. (We are) returning, repenting, worshipping, prostrating before our Lord, and we praise Him Allah fulfilled His promise and helped His servant, and routed the confederates alone.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jung se ya muhimon se ya Hajj ya Umra se wapas aate aur jab woh pahaadi ke shikhar par ya buland kathor zameen par pahunchte, woh teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte, aur phir kehte: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Woh Ek hai, uska koi shareek nahi, uski hi baadshahat hai aur uski hi tareef hai aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte hue, ibadat karte hue, apne Rab ke aage sajda karte hue, aur hum uski tareef karte hain. Allah ne apna wada poora kiya aur apne banda ki madad ki, aur ittihaadi giroahon ko akele shikast di.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters (but with one alteration) that here Allah-o-Akbar is mentioned twice.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ek badlaav ke saath, ki yahan Allahu Akbar do baar zikr hua hai.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I and Abu Talha (both) came back along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Safiyyah (the wife of the Holy Prophet) rode behind him on his camel and as we came to the out- skirts of Medina he said: (We are those) who return, who repent, who worship our Lord, who praise (Him), and he went on uttering this until we entered Medina.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Talha, dono, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath wapas aaye. Safiyyah, Nabi ki zauja, unke oont par unke peeche sawaar thin aur jab hum Madina ki simaon tak pahunche unhone kaha: Hum woh hain jo wapas aate hain, jo tauba karte hain, jo apne Rab ki ibadat karte hain, jo uski tareef karte hain, aur woh ise kehte rahe yahan tak ki hum Madina mein daakhil huye.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made (his camel) kneel down (i, e. halt at the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa) and prayed there, and so did Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont ko bithaya, yaani Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen par ruke, aur wahan namaz padhi, aur Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bhi aisa hi kiya.

e: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to halt his camel in the stony ground at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to make a halt (and pray).
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) apne oont ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen mein rokte the, jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) rukte the aur namaz padhte.

e: Nafi' reported that when 'Abdullah b. 'Umar returned from Hajj or 'Umra he made his camel kneel down (i. e. halted) in the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made his camel halt.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki jab Abdullah bin Umar Hajj ya Umra se wapas aate, woh apne oont ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen mein bithaate, yaani rukte, jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont ko roka tha.

e: Salim (b. Abdullah b. 'Umar) reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was visited by (someone, i. e. an angel) during the fag end of the night at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, and it was said to him: Verily it is a blessed stony-ground.
hi: Salim, bin Abdullah bin Umar, ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein raat ke aakhri hisse mein koi, yaani ek farishta, mile, aur unse kaha gaya: Yaqeenan ye ek barakat wali patthreeli zameen hai.

e: Salim b. Abdullah b. Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Dhu'l- Hulaifa in the heart of the valley at the fag end of the night, and it was said to him: It is a blessed stony ground. Musa (one of the narrators) said: Salim made his came) halt at the mosque where 'Abdullah made his camel halt as seeking the place of stay of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It is, in fact, situated at a lower plain than the mosque, which stands in the heart of the valley, and it is between it (the mosque) (and Qibla) that that place (where Allah's Apostle used to get down for rest and prayer) is situated.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein wadi ke dil mein aaye raat ke aakhri hisse mein, aur unse kaha gaya: Ye ek barakat wali patthreeli zameen hai. Musa, ek raawi, ne kaha: Salim ne apne oont ko us masjid mein rokha jahan Abdullah apne oont ko rokte the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke padaav ki jagah dhoondhte hue. Ye, dar-asal, masjid se ek neechle maidaan mein sthit hai, jo wadi ke dil mein khadi hai, aur ismein aur usmein, masjid aur Qibla ke beech, woh jagah sthit hai jahan Allah ke Rasool aaraam aur namaz ke liye utarte the.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Abu Bakr Siddiq (Allah be pleased with him) sent me during Hajj before the Farewell Pilgrimage for which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had appointed him an Amir, among a group of people whom he had ordered to make announcement to the people on the Day of Nahr:" After this year no polytheist may perform the Pilgrimage and no naked person may circumambulate the House." Ibn Shihab stated that Humaid b. Abd al-Rahman said that according to this narration of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) the day of Hajj al-Akbar (Great Hajj) is this Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) ne mujhe Vida ke Hajj se pehle Hajj ke daurane bheja, jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Amir muqarrar kiya tha, ek giroh ke logon ke saath jinhe unhone hukum diya ki woh logon ko Nahr ke din ye ailaan karein: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta aur koi nanga shakhs Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kar sakta." Ibn Shihab ne bayaan kiya ki Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman ne kaha ki Abu Huraira (RA) ki is riwayat ke mutabik, Hajj al-Akbar, Bada Hajj, ka din yehi Nahr ka din hai, 10 Zul-Hijja.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no day when God sets free more servants from Hell than the Day of 'Arafa. He draws near, then praises them to the angels, saying: What do these want?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi din aisa nahi hai jab Allah Arafa ke din se zyada bandon ko jahannam se azaad karta ho. Woh qareeb aata hai, phir unhe farishton ke saamne bayan karta hai, kehta hai: Ye kya chahte hain?

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: An Umra is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the next, and Hajj which is accepted will receive no other reward than Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Umra unmein hue gunahon ka kaffara hai jo iske aur agle Umra ke beech hote hain, aur ek maqbool Hajj ko Jannat ke siwaay koi doosra badla nahi milta.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who came to this House (Ka'ba) (with the intention of performing Pilgrimage), and neither spoke indecently nor did he act wickedly. would return (free from sin) as on the (very first day) his mother bore him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo is Ghar, Kaaba, mein aaye, Hajj karne ke iraade se, aur na ashleel baat ki na hi burai ka koi kaam kiya, woh gunah se aazad hokar waise hi wapas aayega jaise woh us din tha jab uski maa ne use paida kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mainsur with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " He who performed Pilgrimage but neither spoke indecently nor acted wickedly."
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Jisne Hajj kiya lekin na ashleel baat ki na hi burai ka koi kaam kiya."

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid b. Haritha (Allah be pleased with him) said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Will you stay in your house at Mecca (which you abandoned at the time of migration)? Thereupon he said: Has 'Aqil left for as any land or house? And 'Aqil and Talib became the Inheritors of Abu Talib's (property), and neither Ja'far nor 'Ali inherited anything from him, for both (Ja'far and 'Ali) were Muslims whereas 'Aqil and Talib were non-Muslims.
hi: Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Kya aap Makkah mein apne ghar mein rahenge, jise aapne hijrat ke waqt chhoda tha? Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne hamare liye koi zameen ya ghar chhoda hai? Aur Aqil aur Talib Abu Talib ki maal ke waaris bane, aur na to Ja'far ne na hi Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse kuch virasat mein paaya, kyunki dono, Ja'far aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), Musalman the jabki Aqil aur Talib ghair-Musalman the.

e: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow? And it was at the time of the Conquest (of Mecca). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah chahega to aap kal kahan rukenge? Aur ye Fatah, Makkah ki, ke waqt ki baat hai. Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne humare liye koi rehne ki jagah chhodi hai?

e: Narrated Usama b. Zaid : Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow?  Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
hi: Usama bin Zaid ne bayan kiya: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah chahega to aap kal kahan rukenge? Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne humare liye koi rehne ki jagah chhodi hai?

e: Al-'Ali' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon as saying: For a Mahijir, it is only three (days') stay at Mecca, after completing (the Hajj or 'Umra) that is allowed, and it seemed as if he was saying that he should not (stay) beyond this (period).
hi: Al-Ala bin al-Hadrami ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Muhajir ke liye, Makkah mein sirf teen din ka theherna, Hajj ya Umra, mukammal karne ke baad jaayez hai, aur aisa lagta tha jaise woh kah rahe the ki unhe ismein aage nahi rukna chahiye.

e: Al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Muhijir should stay at Mecca after performing the rituals (of Hajj) but for three (days) only.
hi: Al-Ala bin al-Hadrami ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Muhajir ko Makkah mein Hajj ke riti-rivaz mukammal karne ke baad sirf teen din theherna chahiye.

e: Al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is only for three nights that a Muhajir should stay at Mecca after the completion of the rituals of Hajj.
hi: Al-Ala bin al-Hadrami ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye sirf teen raaton ke liye hai ki Muhajir ko Makkah mein Hajj ke riti-rivaz mukammal karne ke baad theherna chahiye.

e: Al-" Ala' b. al-Hadrami reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The stay at Mecca after the completion of his rituals (of Hajj) is only for three days.
hi: Al-Ala bin al-Hadrami ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Makkah mein apne riti-rivaz mukammal karne ke baad theherna, Hajj ka, sirf teen din ke liye hai.

e: Ibn Juraij narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying on the Day of Victory over Mecca: There is no Hijra (emigration) but only Jihad and good intention; and when you are called to battle, then go forth. He also said on the Day of Victory over Mecca: Allah made this town sacred on the day He created the earth and the heavens; so it is -sacred by the sacred- ness conferred on it by Allah until the Day of Resurrection and fighting in it was not lawful to anyone before me, and it was made lawful for me only during an hour on one day, for it is sacred by the sacredness conferred on it by Allah until the Day of Resurrection. Its thorns are not to be cut, its game is not to be molested, and the things dropped are to be picked up only by one who makes a public announcement of it, and its fresh herbage is not to be cut. Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, exception may be made in case of rush, for it is useful for their blacksmiths and for their houses. He (the Holy Prophet) conceding the suggestion of 'Abbas) said: Except rush.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Makkah par Fatah ke din ye kehte suna: Koi Hijrat nahi hai balki sirf Jihad aur nek niyat hai; aur jab tumhe jung ke liye bulaya jaaye, to nikal pado. Unhone Makkah par Fatah ke din ye bhi kaha: Allah ne is shehar ko muqaddas kiya usi din jab Usne zameen aur aasmaan banaaye; is liye ye muqaddas hai us pavitrata se jo Allah ne ise di hai Qayamat ke din tak, aur ismein jung karna kisi ke liye jaayez nahi tha mujhse pehle, aur ye mere liye sirf ek ghante ke liye ek din jaayez ki gayi, kyunki ye muqaddas hai us pavitrata se jo Allah ne ise di hai Qayamat ke din tak. Iske kaante nahi kaate jaane chahiye, iske shikaar ko pareshaan nahi karna chahiye, aur girī hui cheezein sirf woh utha sakta hai jo iska aam ailaan kare, aur iski taazi ghaas nahi kaati jaani chahiye. Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske liye chhoot di jaaye siwaay idhkhir, ek tarah ki ghaas, ke, kyunki ye unke lohaaron ke liye aur unke gharon ke liye kaam ka hai. Unhone, Abbas ke mashwara ko maante hue, kaha: Siwaay idhkhir ke.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Mansur, but he did not mention: " On that very day He created the heavens and the earth," and he (the narrator) substituted the word" fighting" (qital) for" killing" (qatl), and further said:" No one is to pick up the dropped thing except one who makes a public announcement of it."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Mansur ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Usi din Usne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye," aur unhone "qatal" ki jagah "jung", qital, lafz istemal kiya, aur aage kaha: "Girī hui cheez koi bhi shakhs nahi utha sakta siwaay uske jo iska aam ailaan kare."

e: Abu Shuraih al-'Adawi reported that he said to Amr b. Sa'id when he was sending troops to Mecca: Let me tell you something. O Commander, which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day following, the Conquest which my ears heard and my heart has retained, and my eyes saw as he spoke it. He praised Allah and extolled Him and then said: Allah, not men, has made Mecca sacred; so it is not permissible for any person believing in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood in it, or lop a tree in it. If anyone seeks a concession on the basis of fighting of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), tell him that Allah permitted His Messenger, but not you, and He gave him permission only for an hour on one day, and its sacredness was restored on the very day like that of yesterday. Let him who is present convey the information to him who is absent. It was said to Abu Shuraih: What did Amr say to you? He said: I am better informed of that than you, Abu Shuraih, but the sacred territory does not grant protection to one who is disobedient, or one who runs away after shedding blood, or one who runs away after committing
hi: Abu Shuraih al-Adawi ne bayan kiya ki unhone Amr bin Sa'id se kaha jab woh Makkah mein fauj bhej rahe the: Mujhe aapko kuch bataane dijiye, Aye hukmaraan, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fatah ke agle din kaha tha jise mere kaanon ne suna aur mere dil ne rakha, aur meri aankhon ne dekha jab unhone use kaha. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki aur phir kaha: Allah ne, na ki logon ne, Makkah ko muqaddas kiya hai; is liye kisi bhi aise shakhs ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat mein imaan rakhta ho jaayez nahi hai ki woh ismein khoon bahaaye, ya isme koi darakht kaate. Agar koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki jung ki buniyaad par koi chhoot maange, to unhe bataao ki Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di, lekin tumhe nahi, aur Usne unhe ijazat sirf ek ghante ke liye ek din di, aur iski pavitrata usi din bahaal ho gayi jaise kal thi. Jo yahan maujood hai woh jo maujood nahi hai use ye khabar pahunchaaye. Abu Shuraih se poocha gaya: Amr ne aapse kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Mujhe iske baare mein aapse zyada jaankaari hai, Abu Shuraih, lekin muqaddas ilaaka us shakhs ko panah nahi deta jo naafarmaan hai, ya jo khoon bahaane ke baad bhaag jaata hai, ya jo kuch karne ke baad bhaag jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira, (Allah be pleased with him) reported. When Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, granted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) victory over Mecca, he stood before people and praised and extolled Allah and then said: Verily Allah held back the elephants from Mecca and gave the domination of it to His Messenger and believers, and it (this territory) was not violable to anyone before me and it was made violable to me for an hour of a day, and it shall not be violable to anyone after me. So neither molest the game, nor weed out thorns from it. And it is not lawful for anyone to pick up a thing dropped but one who makes public announcement of it. And it a relative of anyone is killed he is entitled to opt for one of two things. Either he should be paid blood-money or he can take life as (a just retribution). 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, but Idhkhir (a kind of herbage), for we use it for our graves and for our houses, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: With the exception of Idhkhir. A person known as Abu Shah, one of the people of Yemen, stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, (kindly) write it for me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said I Write it for Abu Shah. Walid said: I asked al-Auzai': What did his saying mean:" Write it for me, Messenger of Allah"? He said: This very address that he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Makkah par fatah di, woh logon ke saamne khade hue aur Allah ki tareef aur hamd ki aur phir kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne haathiyon ko Makkah se roka aur iska ikhtiyar apne Rasool aur momino ko diya, aur ye ye ilaaka kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi tha mujhse pehle aur ye mere liye ek ghante ke liye ek din jaayez kiya gaya, aur ye mere baad kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi hoga. Is liye na to shikaar ko pareshaan karo, na hi ismein se kaante udhaad do. Aur kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi hai ki woh koi girī hui cheez utha le siwaay uske jo iska aam ailaan kare. Aur agar kisi ka koi rishtedaar qatal kiya jaata hai to use do cheezon mein se ek chunne ka haq hai. Ya to use khoon-baha diya jaaye ya woh badle mein jaan le sakta hai, insaaf ke taur par. Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, lekin Idhkhir, ek tarah ki ghaas, kyunki hum use apni qabron ke liye aur apne gharon ke liye istemal karte hain, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Idhkhir ke ilawa. Abu Shah naam ka ek shakhs, Yemen ke logon mein se ek, khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meherbaani karke ise mere liye likh dijiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise Abu Shah ke liye likh do. Walid ne kaha: Maine al-Auzai se poocha: Unke alfaaz "Ise mere liye likh dijiye, Allah ke Rasool" ka kya matlab tha? Unhone kaha: Yehi khitaab jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna tha.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The people of the Khuza'ah tribe killed a man of the tribe of Laith in the Year of Victory as a retaliation for one whom they had killed (whom the people of the tribe of Laith had killed). It was reported to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He mounted his camel and delivered this address: Verily Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, held back the Ele- phants from Mecca, and gave its domination to His Messenger and believers. Behold, it was not violable for anyone before me and it will not be violable for anyone after me. Behold, it was made violable for me for an hour of a day; and at this very hour it has again been made inviolable (for me as well as for others). So its thorns are not to be cut, its trees are not to be lopped, and (no one is allowed to) pick up a thing dropped, but the one who makes an announcement of it. And one whose fellow is killed is allowed to opt between two alternatives: either he should receive blood-money or get the life of the (murderer) in return. He (the narrator said): A person from the Yemen, who was called Abu Shah, came to him and said: Messenger of Allah, write it down for me, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Write it down for Abu Shah. One of the persons from among the Quraish also said: Except Idhkhir, for we use it in our houses ant our graves. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Except Idhkhir.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Khuza'ah qabile ke logon ne Fatah ke saal Laith qabile ke ek shakhs ko qatal kiya, badla lene ke taur par ek shakhs ke liye jise unhone qatal kiya tha, jise Laith qabile ke logon ne qatal kiya tha. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataaya gaya. Woh apne oont par sawaar huye aur ye khitaab diya: Yaqeenan Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne haathiyon ko Makkah se roka, aur iska ikhtiyar apne Rasool aur momino ko diya. Dekho, ye kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi tha mujhse pehle aur ye mere baad kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi hoga. Dekho, ye mere liye ek ghante ke liye ek din jaayez kiya gaya; aur usi ghante mein ise phir se na-jaayez kar diya gaya hai, mere aur doosron ke liye. Is liye iske kaante nahi kaate jaane chahiye, iske darakht nahi kaate jaane chahiye, aur koi bhi ijazat nahi hai ki woh koi girī hui cheez uthaaye, siwaay uske jo iska ailaan kare. Aur jiska saathi qatal kiya jaaye use do ikhtiyaaron mein se ek chunne ki ijazat hai: ya to use khoon-baha milna chahiye ya qaatil ki jaan badle mein leni chahiye. Raawi ne kaha: Yemen se ek shakhs, jise Abu Shah kaha jaata tha, unke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise mere liye likh dijiye, isper unhone kaha: Ise Abu Shah ke liye likh do. Quraish mein se ek shakhs ne bhi kaha: Idhkhir ke ilawa, kyunki hum ise apne gharon aur apni qabron mein istemal karte hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Idhkhir ke ilawa.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) say: It is not permissible for any one of you to carry weapons in Mecca.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ke liye bhi jaayez nahi hai ki woh Makkah mein hathiyaar le jaaye.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered Mecca in the Year of Victory with a helmet on his head; and when he took it off, a man came to him and said: Ibn Khatal is hanging on to the curtains of the Ka'ba, whereupon he said: Kill him. Malik (one of the narrators) attested this statement having been made.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fatah ke saal Makkah mein daakhil kiya apne sar par ek khod, helmet, pehne hue; aur jab unhone use utaara, ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Ibn Khatal Kaaba ke parde pakde latka hua hai, isper unhone kaha: Use qatal karo. Malik, ek raawi, ne is bayaan ki tasdeeq ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca and Qutaiba (another narrator) stated that he entered Mecca in the Year of Victory, wearing a black turban, but not wearing the Ihram.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah mein daakhil kiya aur Qutaiba, ek doosre raawi, ne bataya ki unhone Fatah ke saal Makkah mein daakhil kiya, ek kaali pagdi pehne hue, lekin ehram na baandhe hue.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered on the day of Victory of Mecca wearing a black turban on his head.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah ki Fatah ke din daakhil kiya apne sar par ek kaali pagdi pehne hue.

e: Amr b. Huraith reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed the people (on the day of the Victory of Mecca) with a black turban on his head.
hi: Amr bin Huraith ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon se khitaab kiya, Makkah ki Fatah ke din, apne sar par ek kaali pagdi pehne hue.

e: Ja'far b. 'Amr b. Huraith reported his father as saying: As if I am seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the pulpit with a black turban on his head, and its two ends hanging between his shoulders. Abu Bakr (another narrator) did not make mention of:" Upon the pulpit".
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Huraith ne apne walid ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par apne sar par ek kaali pagdi pehne dekh raha hoon, aur uske do sirhe unke kandhon ke beech latak rahe the. Abu Bakr, ek doosre raawi, ne "mimbar par" ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zaid b. 'Asim (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Ibrahim declared Mecca sacred and supplicated (for blessings to be showered) upon its inhabitants, and I declare Medina to be sacred as lbrahim had declared Mecca to be sacred. I have supplicated (Allah for His blessings to be showered) in its sa' and its mudd (two standards of weight and measurement) twice as did Ibrahim for the inhabitants of Mecca.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Asim (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya aur iske rehne walon par barkat ki dua ki, aur main Madina ko muqaddas ailaan karta hoon jaise Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya tha. Maine iske sa aur mudd, do wazan aur maap ke maapdand, mein barkat ki dua ki hai do guna, jaisa Ibrahim ne Makkah walon ke liye ki thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred and I declare sacred the area between its two stony grounds (lava lands by which he meant Medina).
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya aur main iski do patthreeli zameen, lava lands, jisse unka matlab Madina se tha, ke beech ke kshetra ko muqaddas ailaan karta hoon.

e: Nafi' b. Jubair reported that Marwan b. al-Hakam (Allah be pleased with him) addressed people and made mention of Mecca and its inhabitants and its sacredness, but he made no mention of Medina, its inhabitants and its sacredness. Rafi' b. Khadij called to him and said: What is this that I hear you making mention of Mecca and its inhabitants and its sacredness, but you did not make mention of Medina and its inhabitants and its sacredness, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has also declared sacred (the area) between its two lava lands (Medina)? And (we have record of this) with us written on Khaulani parchment. If you like, I can read it out to you. Thereupon Marwan became silent, and then Said: I too have heard some part of it.
hi: Nafi bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki Marwan bin al-Hakam (RA) ne logon se khitaab kiya aur Makkah, uske rehne walon, aur uski pavitrata ka zikr kiya, lekin unhone Madina, uske rehne walon, aur uski pavitrata ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Rafi bin Khadij ne unhe bulaaya aur kaha: Ye kya hai jo main sun raha hoon ki aap Makkah, uske rehne walon, aur uski pavitrata ka zikr kar rahe hain, lekin aapne Madina aur uske rehne walon aur uski pavitrata ka koi zikr nahi kiya, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi kshetra ko iski do lava zameenon, Madina, ke beech muqaddas ailaan kiya hai? Aur humare paas iska record hai hamare paas Khaulani parchment par likha hua. Agar aapko pasand ho, main ise aapko padh kar suna sakta hoon. Isper Marwan khamosh ho gaye, aur phir kaha: Maine bhi iska kuch hissa suna hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred; I declare Medina, that between the two mountains, as inviolable. No tree should be lopped and no game is to be molested.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya; main Madina ko, un do pahaadon ke beech, na chhune-laayak ailaan karta hoon. Koi darakht nahi kaata jaana chahiye aur koi shikaar pareshaan nahi kiya jaana chahiye.

e: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I have declared sacred the territory between the two lava plains of Medina, so its trees should not be cut down, or its game killed; and he also said: Medina is best for them if they knew. No one leaves it through dislike of it without Allah putting in it someone better than he in place of him; and no one will stay there in spite of its hardships and distress without my being an intercessor or witness on behalf of him on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maine Madina ki do lava zameenon ke beech ke ilaake ko muqaddas ailaan kiya hai, is liye iske darakht nahi kaate jaane chahiye, ya iska shikaar qatal nahi kiya jaana chahiye; aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Madina unke liye sabse behtareen hai agar unhe pata hota. Koi bhi ise napasand karke isse nahi jaata bina ki Allah usme uski jagah usse behtar kisi ko na bhej de; aur koi bhi wahan iski mushkilon aur pareshaani ke bawajood nahi rukega bina ki main Qayamat ke din uski taraf se shafaa'at karne wala ya gawaah na bunun.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, and then the (above-mentioned) hadith was narrated with this addition: " None should nurse ill-will towards the people of Medina, or Allah will melt him in fire like the melting of lead or the dissolution of salt in water.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, aur phir upar bataayi gayi hadees is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi: "Koi bhi Madina ke logon ke prati bura irada na rakhe, warna Allah use aag mein pighla dega jaise seesa pighalta hai ya jaise namak paani mein ghul jaata hai."

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that Sa'd rode to his castle in al-'Aqiq and found a slave cutting down the trees, or beating off their leaves, so he stripped him off his belongings. When Sa'd returned, there came to him the masters of the slave and negotiated with him asking him to return to their slave or to them what he had taken from their slave, whereupon he said: God forbid that I should return anything which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has given me as spoil, and refused to return anything to them.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd apne kile al-Aqiq mein gaye aur unhone paaya ki ek ghulam darakht kaat raha hai, ya unke pattoon ko jhaad raha hai, is liye unhone uski cheezein zabt kar li. Jab Sa'd wapas aaye, ghulam ke maalik unke paas aaye aur unse baat ki, unse kaha ki woh unke ghulam ko wapas dein ya jo unhone unke ghulam se liya hai use unhe wapas dein, isper unhone kaha: Allah na kare ki main koi bhi cheez wapas karun jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe maal-e-ganimat ke soorat mein di hai, aur unhe koi bhi cheez wapas karne se inkaar kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Talha (Allah be pleased with him): Find for me a servant from amongst your boys to serve me. Abu Talha went out along with me and made me sit behind him. And I used to serve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whenever he got down from the camel. And in one hadith he said: He proceeded and when (the mountain of) Uhud was within sight, he said: This is the mountain which loves us and we love it. And as he came close to Medina he said: O Allah, I declare (the area) between the two mountains of it (Medina) sacred just as Ibrahim declared Mecca as sacred. O Allah, bless them (the people of Medina) in their mudd and sa'.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha (RA) se kaha: Mere liye apne larkon mein se ek khaadim dhoondho jo meri khidmat kare. Abu Talha mere saath bahar gaye aur mujhe apne peeche baithaya. Aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khidmat karta jab bhi woh oont se utarte. Aur ek hadees mein unhone kaha: Woh aage badhe aur jab Uhud ka pahaad nazar aaya, unhone kaha: Ye woh pahaad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur hum usse mohabbat karte hain. Aur jab woh Madina ke qareeb aaye, unhone kaha: Aye Allah, main iske do pahaadon ke beech ke ilaake ko muqaddas ailaan karta hoon jaise Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya tha. Aye Allah, unhe, Madina ke logon ko, unke mudd aur sa mein barkat de.

e: Anas b. Malik reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) except with this variation that he said: " I declare sacred the area between its two lava mountains."
hi: Anas bin Malik ne isi tarah ki ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki siwaay is farq ke ki unhone kaha: "Main iski do lava pahaadon ke beech ke ilaake ko muqaddas ailaan karta hoon."

e: 'Asim reported: I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had declared Medina as sacred. He said: Yes. (the area) between so and so. He who made any innovation in it, and further said to me: It is something serious to make any innovation in it (and he who does it) there is upon him the curse of Allah, and that of the angels and of all the people, Allah will not accept from him on the Day of Resurrection either obligatory acts or the surpererogatory acts. Ibn Anas said: Or he accommodates an innovator.
hi: Asim ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ko muqaddas ailaan kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Haan. Ye ilaaka falan aur falan ke beech hai. Jisne ismein koi bidaat nikaali, aur unhone mujhse aage kaha: Ye ek sangin baat hai ki ismein koi bidaat nikaali jaaye, aur jo aisa kare uspar Allah ki, farishton ki aur sab logon ki laanat hai. Allah Qayamat ke din na to uske farz amal qubool karega na uske nafil amal. Ibn Anas ne kaha: Ya woh kisi bidaati ko panah deta hai.

e: 'Asim reported: I asked Anas (Allah be pleased with him) whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had declared Medina as sacred. He said: Yes, it is sacred, so its tree is not to be cut; and he who did that let the curse of Allah and that of the angels and of all people be upon him.
hi: Asim ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas (RA) se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ko muqaddas ailaan kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Haan, ye muqaddas hai, is liye iska darakht nahi kaata jaana chahiye; aur jisne aisa kiya uspar Allah ki, farishton ki aur sab logon ki laanat ho.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah bless them in their measurements, bless them in their sa's and bless them in their mudd.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah unhe unke maapdandon mein barkat de, unhe unke sa mein barkat de aur unhe unke mudd mein barkat de.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah he pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, increase in Medina twice the blessings (Thou showered) on Mecca.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, Madina mein Makkah ki barkaton se do guna izafa kar.

e: Ibrahim al-Taimi reported on the authority of his father: 'Ali b. Abi Talib (Allah be pleased with him) addressed us and said: He who thought that we have besides the Holy Qur'an anything else that we recite, he told a lie. And this document which is hanging by the sheath of the sword contains but the ages of the camels, and the nature of the wounds. He (Hadrat 'Ali) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Medina is sacred from 'Air to Thaur; So if anyone makes an innovation or accommodates an innovator, the curse of Allah, the angels, and all persons will fall upon him, and Allah will not accept any obligatory or supererogatory act as recompense from them. And the protection granted by the Muslims is one and must be respected by the humblest of them. If anyone makes a false claim to paternity, or being a client of other than his own masters, there is upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people. Allah will not accept from him any recompense in the form of obligatory acts or supererogatory acts. The hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr and Zabair ends with (these words): The humblest among them should respect it; and what follows after it is not mentioned there, and in the hadith transmitted by them (these words are) not found: (The document was hanging) on the sheath of his sword.
hi: Ibrahim al-Taimi ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Jisne socha ki humare paas Quran ke ilawa aur kuch hai jise hum padhte hain, usne jhoot kaha. Aur ye dastaavez jo talwaar ke myaan se latki hui hai usmein sirf oonton ki umar aur zakhmon ki fitrat ka zikr hai. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Madina Air se Thaur tak muqaddas hai; is liye agar koi bidaat nikaale ya kisi bidaati ko panah de, to Allah ki, farishton ki, aur sab logon ki laanat uspar padegi, aur Allah unse koi farz ya nafil amal muaaviza ke taur par qubool nahi karega. Aur Musalmaanon ke zariye di gayi panah ek hai aur unke sabse choti umar ke shakhs ko bhi maani jaani chahiye. Agar koi apne nasab ke baare mein jhoota daawa kare, ya apne asal maalikon ke ilawa kisi doosre ka mukhbeer, client, hone ka, to uspar Allah ki, farishton ki aur sab logon ki laanat hai. Allah unse koi muaaviza qubool nahi karega farz ya nafil amal ke soorat mein. Abu Bakr aur Zubair ki riwayat ki hui hadees ye alfaaz par khatm hoti hai: Unmein se sabse choti umar ke shakhs ko bhi ise maanna chahiye; aur uske baad jo kuch hai uska zikr wahan nahi hai, aur unki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ye alfaaz nahi milte: Dastaavez latki hui thi unki talwaar ke myaan par.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters (but at the end) these words are added: " He who violated the covenant with a Muslim, there is upon him the curse of Allah, of angels and of all people. Neither an obligatory act nor a supererogatory act would be accepted from him as recompense on the Day of Resurrection; and in the hadith transmitted by two other narrators these words are not found:" He who claimed false paternity." And in the hadith transmitted by Waki' there is no mention of the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, lekin aakhir mein, ye alfaaz jode gaye hain: "Jisne kisi Musalman ke saath kiya ehad tod diya, uspar Allah ki, farishton ki aur sab logon ki laanat hai. Na koi farz amal na koi nafil amal Qayamat ke din uske badle mein qubool kiya jaayega; aur do doosre raawiyon ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ye alfaaz nahi milte: Jisne jhoota nasab ka daawa kiya. Aur Waki ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein Qayamat ke din ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters by A'mash with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se A'mash ne alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Medina is a sacred territory, so he who made any innovation in it. or gave protection to an innovator, there is upon him the curse of Allah, that of the angels and that of all the people. There would not be accepted on the Day of Resurrection either obligatory acts or supererogatory acts from him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Madina ek muqaddas ilaaka hai, is liye jisne ismein koi bidaat nikaali, ya kisi bidaati ko panah di, uspar Allah ki, farishton ki aur sab logon ki laanat hai. Qayamat ke din unse koi farz ya nafil amal qubool nahi kiya jaayega.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of the Day of Resurrection. But this addition is made: " The protection granted by Muslims is one and must be respected by the humblest of them. And he who broke the covenant made by a Muslim, there is a curse of Allah, of his angels, and of the whole people upon him, and neither an obligatory act nor a supererogatory act would be accepted from him as recompense on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Qayamat ke din ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya. Lekin ye izafa kiya gaya hai: "Musalmaanon ke zariye di gayi panah ek hai aur unke sabse choti umar ke shakhs ko bhi maani jaani chahiye. Aur jisne kisi Musalman ke zariye kiya ehad toda, uspar Allah ki, uske farishton ki, aur sab logon ki laanat hai, aur na koi farz amal na koi nafil amal Qayamat ke din uske badle mein qubool kiya jaayega."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: If I were to see deer grazing in Medina, I would have never molested them, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has stated: There is between the two lava mountains a sacred territory.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Agar main Madina mein hiran charte huye dekhta, to main unhe kabhi pareshaan na karta, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bataaya hai: Do lava pahaadon ke beech ek muqaddas ilaaka hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declared sacred the territory between two lava mountains of Medina. Abu Huraira said: If I were to find deer in the territory between the two mountains, I would not molest them, and he (the Holy Prophet) declared twelve miles of suburb around Medina as a prohibited pasture.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ki do lava pahaadon ke beech ke ilaake ko muqaddas ailaan kiya. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Agar main do pahaadon ke beech ke ilaake mein hiran paata, to main unhe pareshaan na karta, aur unhone Madina ke aas-paas baarah mil ke ilaake ko mana ki hui charaai ke soorat mein ailaan kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when the people saw the first fruit (of the season or of plantation) they brought it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). When he received it he said: O Allah, bless us in our fruits; and bless us in our city; and bless us in our sa's and bless us in our mudd. O Allah, Ibrahim was Thy servant, Thy friend, and Thy apostle; and I am Thy servant and Thy apostle. He (Ibrahim) made supplication to Thee for (the showering of blessings upon) Mecca, and I am making supplication to Thee for Medina just as he made supplication to Thee for Mecca, and the like of it in addition. He would then call to him the youngest child and give him these fruits.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab log pehla phal, mausam ka ya baagbaani ka, dekhte, woh use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laate. Jab unhone use paaya, unhone kaha: Aye Allah, humein hamare phalon mein barkat de; aur humein hamare shehar mein barkat de; aur humein hamare sa mein barkat de aur humein hamare mudd mein barkat de. Aye Allah, Ibrahim Tera banda, Tera dost, aur Tera rasool the; aur main Tera banda aur Tera rasool hoon. Unhone, Ibrahim ne, Tujhse Makkah ke liye dua ki, aur main Tujhse Madina ke liye dua kar raha hoon jaise unhone Makkah ke liye ki, aur usi jaisa isse zyada bhi. Woh phir sabse choti umar ke bachche ko bulaate aur use ye phal de dete.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given the first fruit and he said: O Allah, shower blessings upon us in our city, and in our fruits, in our mudd and in our sa's, blessings upon blessings, and he would then give that to the youngest of the children present there.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pehla phal diya gaya aur unhone kaha: Aye Allah, humein hamare shehar mein, aur hamare phalon mein, hamare mudd mein aur hamare sa mein barkat de, barkaton par barkaten, aur woh phir use wahan maujood sabse choti umar ke bachche ko de dete.

e: Abu Sa'id Maula al-Mahri reported that they were hard pressed by the distress and hardship of Medina, and he come to AbU Sa'Id al-Khudri and said to him: I have a large family (to support) and we are enduring hardships; I have, therefore, made up my mind to take my family to some fertile land. Thereupon Abu Sa'id said: Don't do that, stick to Medina, for we have come out with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and (I think that he also said) until we reached 'Usfan, and he (the Prophet along with his Companions) stayed there for some nights. There the people said: By Allah, we are lying here idle, whereas our children are unprotected behind us, and we do not feel secure about them. This (apprehension of theirs) reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: What is this matter concerning you that has reached me? (I do not retain how he said it, whether he said like this: ) By Him (in the name of Whom) I take oath, (or he said like this: ) By Him in Whose Hand is my life, I made up my mind or if you like (I do not retain what word did he actually say), I should command my camel to proceed and not to let it halt until it comes to Medina and then said: Ibrahim declared Mecca as the sacred territory and it became sacred, and I declare Medina as the sacred territory-the area between the two mountains ('Air and Uhud). Thus no blood is to be shed within its (bounds) and no weapon is to be carried for fighting, and the leaves of the trees there should not be beaten off except for fodder. O Allah, bless us in our city; O Allah, bless us in our sil; O Allah, bless us in our mudd; O Allah, bless us in our sa; O Allah, bless us in our mudd. O Allah, bless us in our city. O Allah, bless with this blessing two more blessings. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, there is no ravine or mountain path of Medina which is not protected by two angels until you reach there. (He then said to the people: ) Proceed, and we, therefore, proceeded and we came to Medina By Him (in Whose name) we take oath and (in Whose name) oath is taken (Hammad is in doubt about it), we had hardly put down our camel saddles on arriving at Medina that we were attacked by the people of the tribe of 'Abdullah b. Ghatafan but none dared to do it before.
hi: Abu Sa'id Maula al-Mahri ne bayan kiya ki woh Madina ki mushkilon aur pareshaani se dabaav mein the, aur woh Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke paas aaye aur unse kaha: Mera ek bada khaandaan hai jise mujhe support karna hai, aur hum mushkilein jhel rahe hain; is liye maine apna khaandaan kisi upjaau zameen mein le jaane ka faisla kiya hai. Isper Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Aisa mat karo, Madina mein raho, kyunki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath bahar nikle, aur mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha, yahan tak ki hum Usfan pahunche, aur woh, Nabi apne sahaba ke saath, kuch raaton ke liye wahan ruke. Wahan logon ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum yahan bekaar padhe hain, jabki hamare bachche hamare peeche bina hifaazat ke hain, aur hum unke baare mein mahfooz mehsoos nahi karte. Ye unki ye fikar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi, isper unhone kaha: Ye kya baat hai jo mujhe pahunchi hai tumhare baare mein? Mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone kaise kaha, kya unhone aisa kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske naam ki main qasam khaata hoon, ya unhone aisa kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, maine faisla kar liya hai, agar aap pasand karein, mujhe yaad nahi unhone kaunsa lafz istemal kiya, main apne oont ko aage badhne ka hukum dunga aur use tab tak nahi rukne dunga jab tak ye Madina na pahunche aur phir kaha: Ibrahim ne Makkah ko muqaddas ilaaka ailaan kiya aur ye muqaddas ho gaya, aur main Madina ko muqaddas ilaaka ailaan karta hoon - un do pahaadon, Air aur Uhud, ke beech ka ilaaka. Is liye iski seemaon ke andar koi khoon na bahaaya jaaye aur koi hathiyaar jung ke liye na le jaaya jaaye, aur wahan ke darakhton ke pattoon ko charaai ke ilawa kisi aur maqsad ke liye na jhaada jaaye. Aye Allah, humein hamare shehar mein barkat de; Aye Allah, humein hamare sa mein barkat de; Aye Allah, humein hamare mudd mein barkat de; Aye Allah, humein hamare sa mein barkat de; Aye Allah, humein hamare mudd mein barkat de. Aye Allah, humein hamare shehar mein barkat de. Aye Allah, is barkat ke saath do aur barkatein de. Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, Madina mein koi bhi ghati ya pahaadi raasta nahi hai jo do farishton ke zariye mahfooz na ho jab tak tum wahan pahunch na jao. Unhone phir logon se kaha: Aage badho, aur hum, is liye, aage badhe aur hum Madina pahunche. Us hasti ki qasam jiske naam par hum qasam khaate hain aur jiske naam par qasam khayi jaati hai, Hammad ko ismein shaq hai, humne mushkil se apne oonton ki zeenein Madina pahunchne par rakhi thin ki humpar Abdullah bin Ghatafan qabile ke logon ne hamla kiya lekin isse pehle kisi ne aisa karne ki himmat nahi ki.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Kbudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, bless us in our sa' and mud and shower with its blessings two other blessings (multiply blessings showerted upon it).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, humein hamare sa aur mudd mein barkat de aur iski barkaton ke saath do aur barkatein baraso, iske upar barsi barkaton ko badhaa.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated by Yabya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Maula al-Mahri reported that he came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri during the nights (of the turmoil) of al-Barrah, and sought his advice about leaving Medina, and complained of the high prices prevailing therein and his large family, and informed him that he could not stand the hardships of Medina and its rugged surrounding. He said to him: Woe to you; I will not advise you to do it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No one will endure hardships of Medina without my being an intercessor or a witness on his behalf on the Day of Resurrectiar), if he is a Muslim.
hi: Abu Sa'id Maula al-Mahri ne bayan kiya ki woh Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke paas al-Barrah ke utpaat ki raaton mein aaye, aur Madina chhodne ke baare mein unki salaah maangi, aur wahan chal rahe oonche daamon aur apne bade khaandaan ki shikaayat ki, aur unhe bataya ki woh Madina ki mushkilon aur uske khardare kshetra ko bardaasht nahi kar sakte. Unhone unse kaha: Tumpar afsos; main tumhe ye karne ki salaah nahi dunga, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi Madina ki mushkilein bardaasht nahi karega bina ki main uski taraf se Qayamat ke din shafaa'at karne wala ya gawaah na bunun, agar woh ek Musalman hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority of his father Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have declared sacred what is between the two lava grounds of Medina just as Ibrahim (peace be upon him) declared Mecca as sacred. He (the narrator) then said: Abu Sa'id caught hold of (Abu Bakr, another narrator, used the word" found" ) a bird in his hand and then released it from his hand and set it free.
hi: Abdur-Rahman ne apne walid Abu Sa'id (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Madina ki do lava zameenon ke beech ke ilaake ko muqaddas ailaan kiya jaisa Ibrahim (AS) ne Makkah ko muqaddas ailaan kiya tha. Raawi ne phir kaha: Abu Sa'id ne apne haath mein ek chidiya pakadi, Abu Bakr, ek doosre raawi, ne lafz "paai" istemal kiya, aur phir use apne haath se chhod diya aur azaad kar diya.

e: Sahl b. Hunif reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pointed with his hands towards Medina and said: That is a sacred territory and a place of safety.
hi: Sahl bin Hunaif ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haathon se Madina ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: Ye ek muqaddas ilaaka hai aur hifaazat ki jagah hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: When we came to Medina, and it was an unhealthy, uncogenial place, Abu Bakr fell sick and Bilal also fell sick; and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw the illness of his Companions he said: O Allah, make Medina as congenial to us as you made Mecca congenial or more than that; make it conducive to health, and bleesus in its sa' and in its mudd, and transfer its fever to al-juhfa.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Madina aaye, aur ye ek beemaari-vaale, na-anukool jagah thi, Abu Bakr bimaar pad gaye aur Bilal bhi bimaar pad gaye; aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba ki beemari dekhi unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Madina ko hamare liye Makkah jaisa anukool bana de ya usse bhi zyada; ise sehat ke liye laabhkaari bana, aur humein iske sa aur mudd mein barkat de, aur iske bukhaar ko al-Juhfa ki taraf muntaqil kar de.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who patiently endures the hardships of it (of this city of Medina), I would be an intercessor or a withness on his behalf on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo iski, is shehar Madina ki, mushkilon ko sabar se sehta hai, main uski taraf se Qayamat ke din shafaa'at karne wala ya gawaah banunga.

e: Yuhannis, the freed slave of Zubair, narrated that when he was sitting with Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) during the days of turmoil, his freed slave-girl came to him. After saluting him she said: Abu Abd al-Rahmin, I have decided to leave (Medina) for the time is hard for us, whereupon Abdullah said to her: Stay here, foolish lady, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: For one who shows endurance on the hardships and rigour of it (of Medina) I would be an intercessor or a witness on his behalf on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Yuhannis, Zubair ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki ki jab woh Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ke saath baithe the utpaat ke dinon mein, unki aazad ki hui laundi unke paas aayi. Unhe salaam karne ke baad unhone kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, maine Madina chhodne ka faisla kiya hai kyunki hamare liye waqt mushkil hai, isper Abdullah ne unse kaha: Yahin raho, moorkh aurat, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo iski, Madina ki, mushkilon aur sakhti ko sabar se sehta hai, main uski taraf se Qayamat ke din shafaa'at karne wala ya gawaah banunga.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who patiently endured the hardships and rigours of (this city, i. e. Medina), I would be his witness and intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo is shehar, yaani Madina, ki mushkilon aur sakhti ko sabar se sehta hai, main uska gawaah aur shafaa'at karne wala Qayamat ke din banunga.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: For one among my Ummah who shows endurance against the hardships and rigours of Medina, I would be an intercessor or a witness on his behalf on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri ummat mein se jo koi Madina ki mushkilon aur sakhti ke khilaaf sabar dikhaata hai, main uski taraf se Qayamat ke din shafaa'at karne wala ya gawaah banunga.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None who shows endurance on the hardships of Medina,... (the rest of the hadith is the same).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi jo Madina ki mushkilon ke khilaaf sabar dikhaaye,... baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are at the approaches of Medina angels so that plague and the Dajjal shall not penetrate into it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Madina ke raaston par farishte hain taaki mahamaari aur Dajjal isme daakhil na ho sakein.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Dajjal will come from the eastern side with the intention of attacking Medina until he will get down behind Uhud. Then the angels will turn his face towards Syria and there he will perish.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Dajjal poorab ki taraf se Madina par hamla karne ke iraade se aayega yahan tak ki woh Uhud ke peeche utrega. Phir farishte uska chehra Syria ki taraf mode denge aur wahan woh nasht ho jaayega.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A time will come for the people (of Medina) when a man will invite his cousin and any other near relation: Come (and settle) at (a place) where living is cheap, come to where there is plenty, but Medina will be better for them; would they know it! By Him in Whose Hand is my life, none amongst them would go out (of the city) with a dislike for it, but Allah would make his successor in it someone better than be. Behold. Medina is like furnace which eliminates from it the impurities. And the Last Hour will not come until Medina banishes its evils just as a furnace eliminates the impurities of iron.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Logon, Madina ke, ke liye ek waqt aayega jab koi shakhs apne chachere bhai aur kisi aur qareebi rishtedaar ko bulaayega: Aao aur baso ek jagah jahan jeevanyapan sasta hai, aao jahan bahutayat hai, lekin Madina unke liye behtar hoga; kaash unhe pata hota! Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, unmein se koi bhi shehar se napasand karke bahar nahi jaayega, lekin Allah uski jagah usse behtar kisi ko banaayega. Dekho. Madina ek bhatti jaisa hai jo ismein se apvitrataa ko hataata hai. Aur Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Madina apni buraaiyon ko bhagaa na de jaise ek bhatti loha ki apvitrataa ko hataati hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: I have been commanded (to migrate) to a town (Medina) which would overpower other towns. They (the people) call it Yathrib; its correct name is (in fact) Medina. It eliminates (bad) people just as a furnace removes the alloy of iron.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai, hijrat karne ka, ek aise shehar, Madina, mein jo doosre shehron par haavi hoga. Log ise Yathrib kehte hain; iska sahi naam dar-asal Madina hai. Ye buray logon ko hataata hai jaise ek bhatti loha ke mishran ko hataati hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yabya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " Just as a furance removes impurity," but no mention is made of iron.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Jaise ek bhatti apvitrataa hataati hai," lekin loha ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Jabir b. `Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a desert Arab swore allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He suffered from a severe fever in Medina (and) so he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Muhammad, cancel my oath of allegiance. But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) refused it. He again came and said: Cancel my oath of allegiance. But he (the Holy Prophet) refused it. He again came to him and said: Cancel my oath of allegiance, but he refused. The desert Arab, however, went away (cancelling the allegiance himself). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Medina is like a furnace which drives away its impurity and purifies what is good.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek registaan ke Arab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bai'at ki. Woh Madina mein sakht bukhaar se pareshaan hue aur is liye woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye ye kehte hue: Muhammad, meri bai'at radd karo. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse inkaar kiya. Woh dobara aaye aur kaha: Meri bai'at radd karo. Lekin unhone isse inkaar kiya. Woh dobara unke paas aaye aur kaha: Meri bai'at radd karo, lekin unhone inkaar kiya. Registaan ka Arab, halaanki, chala gaya, khud bai'at radd karte hue. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Madina ek bhatti jaisa hai jo apni apvitrataa ko bhagaata hai aur achhaai ko muqaddas karta hai.

e: Zaid b. Thabit reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is Taiba, thereby meaning Medina. It drives away impurity just as fire removes the impurity of silver.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye Taiba hai, jiska matlab Madina hai. Ye apvitrataa ko isi tarah bhagaata hai jaise aag chandi ki apvitrataa ko hataati hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura (Allah be pleased with him) reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Allah named Medina as Tabba.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ne Madina ka naam Tabba rakha.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Abul-Qasim (Muhammad, may peace be upon him) said: He who intends to do harm to the people of this city (that is, Medina), Allah would efface him as salt is dissolved in water.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu'l-Qasim, Muhammad, SAW, ne kaha: Jo is shehar, yaani Madina, ke logon ko nuksaan pahunchaane ka iraada karta hai, Allah use aise mitaa dega jaise namak paani mein ghul jaata hai.
