e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who intends to do harm to its people (he meant Medina), Allah would efface him as salt is dissolved in water. Ibn Hatim (one of the narrators) substituted the word" harm" for" mischief".
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo iske logon ko, unka matlab Madina se tha, nuksaan pahunchaane ka iraada karta hai, Allah use aise mitaa dega jaise namak paani mein ghul jaata hai. Ibn Hatim, ek raawi, ne "nuksaan" lafz ki jagah "shararat" lafz istemal kiya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who intends to do harm to the people of Medina, Allah would efface him just as water dissolves salt.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo Madina walon ko nuksaan pahunchaane ka iraada karta hai, Allah use aise mitaa dega jaise paani namak ko ghula deta hai.

e: Sa'd b. Malik heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this except (this variation) that he said: " Sudden attack or harm."
hi: Sa'd bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi tarah kehte suna siwaay is farq ke ki unhone kaha: "Achaanak hamla ya nuksaan."

e: Abu Huraira and Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: O Allah, bless the people of Medina in their mudd, the rest of the hadith being the same, and in It (this is also mentioned):" He wo intends to do harm to its people, Allah would efface him just as salt it dissolved in water."
hi: Abu Huraira aur Sa'd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aye Allah, Madina ke logon ko unke mudd mein barkat de, baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur ismein ye bhi zikr hai: "Jo iske logon ko nuksaan pahunchaane ka iraada karta hai, Allah use aise mitaa dega jaise namak paani mein ghul jaata hai."

e: Sufyan b. Abd Zuhair reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Syria will be conquered and some people will go out of Medina along with their families driving their camels. and Medina is better for them if they were to know it. Then Yemen will be conquered and some people will go out of Medina along with their families driving their camels, and Medina is better for them if they were to know it. Then Iraq will be conquered and some people will go out of it along with their families driving their camels, and Medina is better for them if they were to know it.
hi: Sufyan bin Abd Zuhair ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Syria fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log Madina se apne khaandaanon ke saath apne oont haankte huye jaayenge, aur Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota. Phir Yemen fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log Madina se apne khaandaanon ke saath apne oont haankte huye jaayenge, aur Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota. Phir Iraq fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log isse apne khaandaanon ke saath apne oont haankte huye jaayenge, aur Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota.

e: Sufyan b. Abu Zuhair heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Yemen will be conquered and some people will go away (to that country) driving their camels and carrying their families on them and those who are under their authority, while Medina is better for them if they were to know it. Then Syria will be conquered and some people will go away driving their camels along with them and carrying their families with them and those who are under their authority, while Medina is better for theni if they were to know it. Thtn lraq will be conquered and some people will go away (to that country) driving their camels and carrying their families with them and those who are under their authority. while Medina is better for them if they were to know it.
hi: Sufyan bin Abu Zuhair ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yemen fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log us mulk ki taraf chale jaayenge apne oont haankte huye aur apne khaandaanon ko unpar lekar aur woh jo unke qabze mein hain, jabki Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota. Phir Syria fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log chale jaayenge apne oont apne saath haankte huye aur apne khaandaanon ko apne saath lekar aur woh jo unke qabze mein hain, jabki Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota. Phir Iraq fatah kiya jaayega aur kuch log us mulk ki taraf chale jaayenge apne oont haankte huye aur apne khaandaanon ko apne saath lekar aur woh jo unke qabze mein hain, jabki Madina unke liye behtar hai agar unhe pata hota.

e: Salid b. Musayyib heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) say that 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about Medina: Its inhabitants will abandon it, whereas it is good for them and it will become the haunt of beasts and birds. (Imam Muslim said that Abu Safwan, one of the narrators whose name was 'Abdullah b. 'Abd al-Malik, was an orphan and I bn juraij took him under his care for ten years.)
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ke baare mein kaha: Iske rehne wale ise chhod denge, jabki ye unke liye achha hai, aur ye jaanwaron aur parindon ka aashiyaana ban jaayega. Imam Muslim ne kaha ki Abu Safwan, ek raawi jinka naam Abdullah bin Abd al-Malik tha, ek yateem the aur Ibn Juraij ne unki das saal tak dekhbhaal ki.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: They (the residents of) Medina will abandon Medina whereas it is good for them and it will be haunted by beasts and birds, and two shepherds will come out from Muzainah intending (to go) towards Medina and tending their herd, and will find nothing but wilderness there until when they will reach the mountain path of Wada, they will fall down on their faces.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Woh, Madina ke rehne wale, Madina ko chhod denge jabki ye unke liye achha hai aur ye jaanwaron aur parindon ka aashiyaana ban jaayega, aur Muzainah se do gadariye Madina ki taraf jaate hue nikalenge aur apna reyd charaate huye, aur wahan bebiyaabaan ke ilawa kuch nahi paayenge yahan tak ki jab woh Wada ke pahaadi raaste par pahunchenge, woh apne muhon ke bal gir padenge.

e: AbduUah b. Zaid al-Mazini (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: That which is between my house" and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid al-Mazini (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke beech hai woh Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baagh hai.

e: Abdullah b. Zaid al-Ansari heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: That which exists between my pulpit and my house is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid al-Ansari ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo mere mimbar aur mere ghar ke beech maujood hai woh Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baagh hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: That which exists between my house and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is upon my cistern.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo mere ghar aur mere mimbar ke beech maujood hai woh Jannat ke baagon mein se ek baagh hai, aur mera mimbar mere Haud, Kauthar, par hai.

e: Abu Humaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We went out along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the expedition of Tabuk, and Abu Humaid further related: We proceeded until we reached the valley of Qura; and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am going forth, so he among you who wants to move fast with me may do so; and he who likes to go slowly may do so. We proceeded until Medina was within our sight, and he said: This is Tabah (another name of Medina); this is Uhud, the mountain which loves us and we love it.
hi: Abu Humaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ki muhim mein nikle, aur Abu Humaid ne aage bataaya: Hum aage badhe yahan tak ki hum Qura ki wadi tak pahunche; aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main aage ja raha hoon, is liye tum mein se jo mere saath tez chalna chaahe woh aisa kar sakta hai; aur jo dheere chalna chaahe woh bhi aisa kar sakta hai. Hum aage badhe yahan tak ki Madina hamari nazron mein aa gaya, aur unhone kaha: Ye Tabah hai, Madina ka doosra naam; ye Uhud hai, woh pahaad jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur hum usse mohabbat karte hain.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: Uhud is a mountain which loves us and which we love.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Uhud ek aisa pahaad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur jisse hum mohabbat karte hain.

e: This hadith is narrated by Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) with another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cast a glance at Uhud and said: Uhud is a mountain which loves us and we love it."
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ki taraf ek nazar daali aur kaha: Uhud ek aisa pahaad hai jo humse mohabbat karta hai aur hum usse mohabbat karte hain."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated It directly from Allah's Apostle' (ﷺ) having said this: A prayer in my mosque is a thousand times more excellent than a prayer in any other mosque, except Masjid al-Haram (Mosque of the Ka'ba).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki: Meri masjid mein ek namaz kisi aur masjid mein padhi hui namaz se hazaar guna zyada behtareen hai, siwaay Masjid al-Haram, Kaaba ki Masjid, ke.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Prayer in my mosque is more excellent than a thousand prayers observed in other mosques except the Masjid al- Haram.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri masjid mein namaz doosri masjidon mein padhi gayi hazaar namazon se zyada behtareen hai siwaay Masjid al-Haram ke.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Prayer in the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is more excellent than a thousand prayers in other mosques except the Masjid al-Haram, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is the last of the Apostles, and his mosque is the last of the mosques. Abu Salama and Abu Abdullah (two of the narrators in this chain of narrations said: We had no doubt that what Abu Haraira (Allah be pleased with him) had said was from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and so we did not like to get an attestation from Abu Huraira about this hadith until Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) died. We discussed it (the issue of getting attestation from Abu Huraira) amongst ourselves and blamed one another as to why we did not talk about it to Abu Huraira regarding it so that he could attribute its transmission to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in case he had heard It from him. While we were discussing it as we sat with 'Abdullah b. Ibrahlm b. Qariz; we made a mention of this hadith, and our omission (in getting its attestation) about its direct transmission by Abu Huraira from him (the Holy Proohet) ; thereupon Abdullah b. Ibrahim said to us: I bear witness to the fact that I heard Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am the last of the Apostles and my mosque is the last of the mosques.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid mein namaz doosri masjidon mein hazaar namazon se zyada behtareen hai siwaay Masjid al-Haram ke, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sabse aakhri Rasool hain, aur unki masjid sabse aakhri masjidon mein se hai. Abu Salama aur Abu Abdullah, is sanad ke do raawi, ne kaha: Humein koi shaq nahi tha ki jo Abu Huraira (RA) ne kaha woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se tha, is liye humein Abu Huraira se is baat ki tasdeeq lena pasand nahi tha jab tak Abu Huraira (RA) ka intiqaal nahi ho gaya. Humne apas mein iski charcha ki, tasdeeq lene ke maamle ki, aur ek-doosre ko dosh diya ki humne Abu Huraira se iske baare mein baat kyun nahi ki taaki woh ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mansoob kar sakein agar unhone ye khud unse suna ho. Jab hum ismein Abdullah bin Ibrahim bin Qariz ke saath baithe iski charcha kar rahe the, humne is hadees ka zikr kiya, aur humari galti, iski tasdeeq lene mein, uski seedhi riwayat ke baare mein Abu Huraira se; isper Abdullah bin Ibrahim ne humse kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main sabse aakhri Rasool hoon aur meri masjid sabse aakhri masjidon mein se hai.

e: Yahya b. Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said to Abu Salih: Did you hear Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) making a mention of the excellence of prayer in the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: No (I did not hear directly from Abu Huraira), but I heard Abdullah b. Ibrahlm b. Qariz; say that' he had heard from Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers. or. is like one thousand prayers observed in other mosques besides It, except that it be in al-Masjid al-Haram.
hi: Yahya bin Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Salih se kaha: Kya aapne Abu Huraira (RA) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid mein namaz ki fazilat ka zikr karte suna? Unhone kaha: Nahi, maine Abu Huraira se seedhe nahi suna, lekin maine Abdullah bin Ibrahim bin Qariz ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) se suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Meri is masjid mein namaz hazaar namazon se behtar hai, ya isse behtar, hazaar namazon jaisi jo iske ilawa doosri masjidon mein padhi jaaye, siwaay iske ki ye al-Masjid al-Haram mein ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Yabya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers (observed in other mosque.) besides it, except that of Masjid al-Haram.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri is masjid mein namaz hazaar namazon, jo iske ilawa doosri masjid mein padhi jaaye, se behtar hai, siwaay Masjid al-Haram ke.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi tarah kehte suna.

e: Ibn Umar narrated from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a hadlth like this.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki hadees riwayat ki.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a woman fell ill and she said: In case Allah cures me I will certainly go and observe prayer in Bait al-Maqdis. She recovered and so she made preparations to go out (to that place). She came to Maimuna. the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). and after greeting her she informed her about it, whereupon she said: Stay here. and eat the provision (which you had made) and observe prayer In the mosque of the Messenger (ﷺ). for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Prayer In it is better than a thousand prayers observed in other mosques except the mosque of the Ka'ba.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat bimaar pad gayi aur usne kaha: Agar Allah mujhe theek kar de to main zaroor Bait al-Maqdis jaakar namaz padhoongi. Woh theek ho gayi aur is liye usne us jagah jaane ki taiyaari ki. Woh Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ke paas aayi, aur unhe salaam karke unhe iske baare mein bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Yahin raho, aur jo intezaam tumne kiye hain unhe khaao aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid mein namaz padho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ismein namaz doosri masjidon mein padhi gayi hazaar namazon se behtar hai siwaay Kaaba ki masjid ke.

e: Abu Hurairah (Allah be pleased with him) reported it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that he said: Do not undertake a journey to visit any Mosque, but three: this Mosque of mine, the Mosque of al-Haram and the Mosque of Aqsa (Bait al-Maqdis).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Kisi masjid ki ziyarat ke liye safar mat karo, siwaay teen ke: meri ye masjid, al-Haram ki masjid aur Aqsa ki masjid, Bait al-Maqdis.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri (but with this change of words) that he (Allah's Apostle) said: " Undertake journey to three mosques."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein is badlaav ke saath, ki unhone kaha: "Teen masjidon ke liye safar karo."

e: Abu Haraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: One should undertake journey to three mosques: the mosque of the Ka'ba, my mosque, and the mosque of Elia (Bait al-Maqdis).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi ko teen masjidon ke liye safar karna chahiye: Kaaba ki masjid, meri masjid, aur Elia ki masjid, Bait al-Maqdis.

e: Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rabman reported: 'Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) happened to pass by me and I said to him. How did you hear your father making mention of the mosque founded on Piety? He said: My father said: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was in the house of one of his wives, and said: Messenger of Allah, which of the two mosques is founded on piety? Thereupon he took a handful of pebbles and threw them on the ground and then said: This is the very mosque of yours (mosque at Medina). He (the narrator) said: I bear witness that I heard your father making mention of it.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) mere paas se guzre aur maine unse kaha: Aapne apne waalid ko Takwa ki buniyaad par banaayi masjid ka zikr karte kaise suna? Unhone kaha: Mere waalid ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya jab woh apni ek zauja ke ghar mein the, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, in do masjidon mein se kaunsi Takwa ki buniyaad par banaayi gayi hai? Isper unhone mutthi bhar kankariyaan uthaayin aur unhe zameen par phenka aur phir kaha: Ye hi tumhari masjid hai, Madina ki masjid. Raawi ne kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki maine aapke waalid ko iska zikr karte suna.

e: Abu Sa'id reported from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a hadlth like this, but in the chain of transmitters no mention was made of Abd al- Rahman b. Abu Sa'id.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki ek hadees riwayat ki, lekin sanad mein Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sa'id ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited (the mosque) at Quba' riding and on foot.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne masjid mein Quba ki ziyarat ki, sawaari par aur paidal.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the mosque at Quba' riding and on foot, and he observed two rak'ahs of (Nafl prayer) in it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Quba ki masjid mein aaye sawaari par aur paidal, aur unhone ismein do rakat, Nafl namaz, padhi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Quba' riding as well as on foot.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Quba aaye sawaari par aur paidal bhi.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to come to Quba' riding and on foot
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Quba aaya karte the, sawaari par aur paidal.

e: Ibn 'Umar had narrated this hadith through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Umar ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Umar used to come to Quba' on every Saturday and he said: I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) coming (to this place) on every Saturday.
hi: Ibn Umar har shanivaar ko Quba aaya karte the aur unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko har shanivaar ko is jagah aate dekha.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to come to Quba', i. e. (he came) on every Saturday, and he used to come riding or on foot. Ibn Dinar (another narrator) said that Ibn Umar used to do like this.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Quba aaya karte the, yaani woh aate har shanivaar ko, aur woh sawaari par ya paidal aate the. Ibn Dinar, ek doosre raawi, ne kaha ki Ibn Umar isi tarah kiya karte the.

e: This hadlth has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Dinar, but he made no mention of: " Every Saturday."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Dinar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya: "Har shanivaar."

e: 'Alqama reported: While I was walking with 'Abdullah at Mina, 'Uthman happened to meet him. He stopped there and began to talk with him. Uthman said to him: Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a young girl who may recall to you some of the past of your bygone days; thereupon he said: If you say so, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 0 young men, those among you who can support a wife should marry, for it restrains eyes from casting (evil glances). and preserves one from immorality; but those who cannot should devote themselves to fasting for it is a means of controlling sexual desire.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Jab main Mina mein Abdullah ke saath chal raha tha, Uthman unse mile. Woh wahan ruke aur unse baat karne lage. Uthman ne unse kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, kya humein aapki shaadi ek jawaan larki se nahi karni chahiye jo aapko aapke beete hue dinon ki kuch yaadein dila sake; isper unhone kaha: Agar aap aisa kehte hain, to jaan lijiye ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye jawaano, tum mein se jo koi biwi ka bhar-poshan kar sakta hai use shaadi karni chahiye, kyunki ye aankhon ko buri nazar daalne se rokti hai, aur insaan ko badchalni se bachaati hai; lekin jo aisa nahi kar sakte unhe roze rakhne chahiye kyunki ye jinsi khwahish ko kaboo mein rakhne ka zariya hai.

e: 'Alqama reported: While I was going along with 'Abdullah b. Ma'sud (Allah he pleased with him) in Mina, 'Uthman b. 'Affan (Allah be pleased with him) happened to meet him and said: Come here, Abu 'Abd al-Rahman (kunya of Abdullah b. Mas'ud), and he isolated him (from me), and when 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) saw that there was no need (for this privacy), he said to me: 'Alqama, come on, and so I went there. (Then) 'Uthman said to him: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a virgin girl that your past may be recalled to your mind? 'Abdullah said: If you say so, the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated above.
hi: Alqama ne bayan kiya: Jab main Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ke saath Mina mein chal raha tha, Uthman bin Affan (RA) unse mile aur kaha: Yahan aao, Abu Abd al-Rahman, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki kunyat, aur unhone unhe mujhse alag kar diya, aur jab Abdullah, bin Mas'ud, ne dekha ki isme koi zaroorat, is niji baatcheet ki, nahi thi, unhone mujhse kaha: Alqama, aao, aur to main wahan gaya. Phir Uthman ne unse kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, kya humein aapki shaadi ek kunwari larki se nahi karni chahiye taaki aapka beeta hua waqt aapke zehan mein dobara aaye? Abdullah ne kaha: Agar aap aisa kehte hain, baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar riwayat ki gayi.

e: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us: 0 young men, those among you who can support a wife should marry, for it restrains eyes (from casting evil glances) and preserves one from immorality; but he who cannot afford It should observe fast for it is a means of controlling the sexual desire.
hi: Abdullah, bin Mas'ud, (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse kaha: Aye jawaano, tum mein se jo koi biwi ka bhar-poshan kar sakta hai use shaadi karni chahiye, kyunki ye aankhon ko buri nazar daalne se rokti hai aur insaan ko badchalni se bachaati hai; lekin jo aisa afford nahi kar sakta use roza rakhna chahiye kyunki ye jinsi khwahish ko kaboo mein rakhne ka zariya hai.

e: Abu al-Rahman b. Yazid said: I and my uncle 'Alqama and al-Aswad went to 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him). He (the narrator further) said: I was at that time young, and he narrated a hadith which it seemed he narrated for me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said like one transmitted by Mu'awiya, and further added: I lost no time in marrying.
hi: Abu al-Rahman bin Yazid ne kaha: Main aur mere chacha Alqama aur al-Aswad Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ke paas gaye. Unhone aage kaha: Main us waqt jawaan tha, aur unhone ek hadees riwayat ki jise unhone shayad mere liye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha jaisa Muawiya ne riwayat kiya, aur aage izafa kiya: Maine shaadi karne mein koi der nahi ki.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported on the authority of Abdullah: We went to him, and I was the youngest of all (of us), but he did not mention:" I lost no time in marrying."
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne Abdullah ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum unke paas gaye, aur main hummein se sabse jawaan tha, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Maine shaadi karne mein koi der nahi ki."

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that some of the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) asked his (the Prophet's) wives about the acts that he performed in private. Someone among them (among his Companions) said: I will not marry women; someone among them said: I will not eat meat; and someone among them said: I will not lie down in bed. He (the Holy Prophet) praised Allah and glorified Him, and said: What has happened to these people that they say so and so, whereas I observe prayer and sleep too; I observe fast and suspend observing them; I marry women also? And he who turns away from my Sunnah, he has no relation with Me
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ne unki, Nabi ki, zaujaon se unke niji amal ke baare mein poocha. Unmein se kisi, Nabi ke sahaba mein se, ne kaha: Main auraton se shaadi nahi karunga; unmein se kisi ne kaha: Main gosht nahi khaaunga; aur unmein se kisi ne kaha: Main bistar par nahi soonga. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki, aur kaha: In logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh aisa aisa kehte hain, jabki main namaz padhta hoon aur sota bhi hoon; main roza rakhta hoon aur kabhi kabhi chhodta bhi hoon; main auraton se shaadi bhi karta hoon? Aur jo mera Sunnat se munh mode, uska mujhse koi taalluq nahi.

e: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messengger of Allah (ﷺ) rejected (the idea) of Uthman b. Muz'unliving in celibacy (saying): And if he (the Holy Prophet) had given me permission We would have got ourselves castrated.
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uthman bin Muz'un ke tark-e-shaadi mein rehne ke iraade ko radd kiya, ye kehte hue: Aur agar unhone mujhe ijazat di hoti to hum khud ko khaassi kara lete.

e: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib reported: I heard Sa'd (b. Abi Waqqas) saying that the idea of 'Uthman b. Maz'un for living in celibacy was rejected (by the Holy Prophet), and if he had been given permission they would have got themselves castrated.
hi: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne bayan kiya: Maine Sa'd, bin Abi Waqqas, ko ye kehte suna ki Uthman bin Maz'un ke tark-e-shaadi mein rehne ke iraade ko Nabi ne radd kar diya tha, aur agar unhe ijazat di jaati to woh khud ko khaassi kara lete.

e: Sa'id b. al Musayyib heard Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) saying that Uthman b. Maz'un decided to live in celibacy, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade him to do so, and if he had permitted him, we would have got ourselves castrated.
hi: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Uthman bin Maz'un ne tark-e-shaadi mein rehne ka faisla kiya, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe aisa karne se mana kiya, aur agar unhe ijazat di hoti, to hum khud ko khaassi kara lete.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a woman, and so he came to his wife, Zainab, as she was tanning a leather and had sexual intercourse with her. He then went to his Companions and told them: The woman advances and retires in the shape of a devil, so when one of you sees a woman, he should come to his wife, for that will repel what he feels in his heart.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aurat ko dekha, aur is liye woh apni zauja, Zainab, ke paas aaye jab woh chamda ranga rahi thin, aur unse jinsi milaap kiya. Woh phir apne sahaba ke paas gaye aur unhe bataya: Aurat shaitaan ki shakl mein aage badhti hai aur peechhe hatti hai, is liye jab tum mein se koi aurat ko dekhe, use apni zauja ke paas jaana chahiye, kyunki isse woh khatam ho jaayega jo woh apne dil mein mehsoos karta hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw a woman; and the rest of the hadith was narrated but (with this exception) that he said he came to his wife Zainab, who was tanning a (piece of) leather, and he made no mention of: " She retires in the shape of satan."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aurat ko dekha; aur baaki hadees riwayat ki gayi lekin is farq ke saath ki unhone kaha ki woh apni zauja Zainab ke paas aaye, jo ek chamde ka tukda ranga rahi thin, aur unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya: "Woh shaitaan ki shakl mein peechhe hatti hai."

e: Jabir heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) say: When a woman fascinates any one of you and she captivates his heart, he should go to his wife and have an intercourse with her, for it would repel what he feels.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi aurat tum mein se kisi ko lubhaati hai aur uske dil ko moh leti hai, use apni zauja ke paas jaakar unke saath jinsi milaap karna chahiye, kyunki isse woh khatam ho jaayega jo woh mehsoos kar raha hai.

e: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: We were on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had no women with us. We said: Should we not have ourselves castrated? He (the Holy Prophet) forbade us to do so He then granted us permission that we should contract temporary marriage for a stipulated period giving her a garment, and 'Abdullah then recited this verse: 'Those who believe do not make unlawful the good things which Allah has made lawful for you, and do not transgress. Allah does not like trangressers" (al-Qur'an, v. 87).
hi: Abdullah, bin Mas'ud, ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par the aur hamare saath koi auraten nahi thin. Humne kaha: Kya humein khud ko khaassi nahi kara lena chahiye? Unhone humein aisa karne se mana kiya. Unhone phir humein ijazat di ki hum ek muqarrar muddat ke liye ek kapda dekar Mut'a, asthaayi shaadi, kar sakte hain, aur Abdullah ne phir ye aayat padhi: "Aye imaan waalo, un achhi cheezon ko haraam mat karo jinhe Allah ne tumhare liye jaayez kiya hai, aur had se aage mat badho. Allah had se aage badhne walon ko pasand nahi karta" (Quran, 5:87).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jarir with the same chain of transmitters and he also recited this (above-mentioned verse) to us, but he did not say that 'Abdullah recited it.
hi: Ye hadees Jarir ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone bhi ye upar bataayi gayi aayat humein padhi, lekin unhone ye nahi kaha ki Abdullah ne ise padha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " We were young, so we said: Allah's Messenger, should we not have ourselves castrated? But he (the narrator) did not say; We were on an expedition."
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Hum jawaan the, is liye humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein khud ko khaassi nahi kara lena chahiye? Lekin raawi ne ye nahi kaha: Hum ek muhim par the."

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah and Salama b. al-Akwa' said: There came to us the proclaimer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has granted you permission to benefit yourselves, i. e. to contract temporary marriage with women.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah aur Salama bin al-Akwa ne kaha: Hamare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ailaan karne wala aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe ijazat di hai apna faayda uthaane ki, yaani auraton se asthaayi shaadi karne ki.

e: Salama b. al. Akwa' and Jabir b. Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and permitted us to contract temporary marriage.
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa aur Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare paas aaye aur humein asthaayi shaadi karne ki ijazat di.

e: Ibn Uraij reported: 'Ati' reported that jibir b. Abdullah came to perform 'Umra, and we came to his abode, and the people asked him about different things, and then they made a mention of temporary marriage, whereupon he said: Yes, we had been benefiting ourselves by this temporary marriage during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and during the time of Abu Bakr and 'Umar.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne bayan kiya: Ata ne bataya ki Jabir bin Abdullah Umra karne aaye, aur hum unke rehne ki jagah aaye, aur logon ne unse mukhtalif cheezon ke baare mein poocha, aur phir unhone asthaayi shaadi ka zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Haan, humne is asthaayi shaadi se faayda uthaaya Nabi (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein aur Abu Bakr aur Umar ke daur mein.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We contracted temporary marriage giving a handful of (tales or flour as a dower during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and durnig the time of Abu Bakr until 'Umar forbade it in the case of 'Amr b. Huraith.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Humne asthaayi shaadi ki mutthi bhar khajooren ya aata mehr ke taur par dekar, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein aur Abu Bakr ke daur mein, jab tak Umar ne ise Amr bin Huraith ke maamle mein mana nahi kiya.

e: Abu Nadra reported: While I was in the company of Jabir b. Abdullah, a person came to him and said that Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn Zubair differed on the two types of Mut'as (Tamattu' of Hajj 1846 and Tamattu' with women), whereupon Jabir said: We used to do these two during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Umar then forbade us to do them, and so we did not revert to them.
hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Jab main Jabir bin Abdullah ki sohbat mein tha, ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha ki Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Zubair ke beech do tarah ke Mut'a, Hajj ka Tamattu aur auraton ke saath Tamattu, ke baare mein mat-bhinnata hai, isper Jabir ne kaha: Hum ye dono karte the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Umar ne phir humein ye karne se mana kiya, aur is liye humne inki taraf rujoo nahi kiya.

e: Iyas b. Salama reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave sanction for contracting temporary marriage for three nights in the year of Autas 1847 and then forbade it.
hi: Iyas bin Salama ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Autas ke saal teen raaton ke liye asthaayi shaadi ki ijazat di aur phir isse mana kiya.

e: Sabra Juhanni reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted temporary marriage for us. So I and another person went out and saw a woman of Bana 'Amir, who was like a young long-necked she-camel. We presented ourselves to her (for contracting temporary marriage), whereupon she said: What dower would you give me? I said: My cloak. And my companion also said: My cloak. And the cloak of-my companion was superior to my cloak, but I was younger than he. So when she looked at the cloak of my companion she liked it, and when she cast a glance at me I looked more attractive to her. She then said: Well, you and your cloak are sufficient for me. I remained with her for three nights, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has any such woman with whom he had contracted temporary marriage, he should let her off.
hi: Sabra Juhanni ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein asthaayi shaadi ki ijazat di. To main aur ek doosra shakhs bahar gaye aur humne Banu Amir ki ek aurat dekhi, jo ek jawaan lambi-gardan wali oontni jaisi thi. Humne khud ko unke saamne pesh kiya, asthaayi shaadi ke liye, isper unhone kaha: Tum mujhe kya mehr doge? Maine kaha: Meri chadar. Aur mere saathi ne bhi kaha: Meri chadar. Aur mere saathi ki chadar meri chadar se behtar thi, lekin main unse jawaan tha. To jab unhone mere saathi ki chadar dekhi, unhe pasand aayi, aur jab unhone mujhpar nazar daali to main unhe zyada aakarshak laga. Unhone phir kaha: Achha, tum aur tumhari chadar mere liye kaafi hain. Main unke saath teen raaton tak raha, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas bhi aisi koi aurat hai jiske saath usne asthaayi shaadi ki hai, use use chhod dena chahiye.

e: Rabi' b. Sabra reported that his father went on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the Victory of Mecca, and we stayed there for fifteen days (i. e. for thirteen full days and a day and a night), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted us to contract temporary marriage with women. So I and another person of my tribe went out, and I was more handsome than he, whereas he was almost ugly. Each one of us had a cloaks, My cloak was worn out, whereas the cloak of my cousin was quite new. As we reached the lower or the upper side of Mecca, we came across a young woman like a young smart long-necked she-camel. We said: Is it possible that one of us may contract temporary marriage with you? She said: What will you give me as a dower? Each one of us spread his cloak. She began to cast a glance on both the persons. My companion also looked at her when she was casting a glance at her side and he said: This cloak of his is worn out, whereas my cloak is quite new. She, however, said twice or thrice: There is no harm in (accepting) this cloak (the old one). So I contracted temporary marriage with her, and I did not come out (of this) until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declared it forbidden.
hi: Rabi bin Sabra ne bayan kiya ki unke waalid Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par Makkah ki Fatah ke daurane gaye, aur hum wahan pandrah din theher, yaani terah poore din aur ek din aur raat, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne ki ijazat di. To main aur mere qabile ka ek doosra shakhs bahar gaye, aur main unse zyada khoobsurat tha, jabki woh taqreeban badsurat the. Hummein se har ek ke paas ek chadar thi. Meri chadar phati-puraani thi, jabki mere chachere bhai ki chadar bilkul nayi thi. Jab hum Makkah ke neechle ya upari hisse mein pahunche, humein ek jawaan aurat mili jo ek jawaan sundar lambi-gardan wali oontni jaisi thi. Humne kaha: Kya ye mumkin hai ki hummein se koi tumse asthaayi shaadi kar sake? Unhone kaha: Tum mujhe kya doge mehr ke taur par? Hummein se har ek ne apni chadar phailaayi. Woh dono shakhson par nazar daalne lagi. Mere saathi ne bhi unhe dekha jab woh apni taraf nazar daal rahi thin aur unhone kaha: Iski chadar phati-puraani hai, jabki meri chadar bilkul nayi hai. Unhone, halaanki, do ya teen baar kaha: Is chadar, puraani wali, ko qubool karne mein koi harj nahi hai. To maine unse asthaayi shaadi ki, aur main isse bahar nahi aaya jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise mana nahi kiya.

e: Rabi' b. S'abra al-jahanni reported on the authority of his father. We went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Mecca during the year of Victory and he narrated like this a hadith transmitted by Bishr (the previous one) but with this addition: " She said: Can it be possible?" And it is also mentioned in it:" He said: The cloak of this (man) is old and worn out."
hi: Rabi bin Sabra al-Juhanni ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah gaye Fatah ke saal aur unhone isi tarah ki ek hadees riwayat ki jaisi Bishr ne pehle wali riwayat ki thi lekin is izafe ke saath: "Unhone kaha: Kya ye mumkin hai?" Aur ismein ye bhi zikr hai: "Unhone kaha: Iski, is aadmi ki, chadar puraani aur phati-puraani hai."

e: Sabra al-Juhani reported on the authority of his father that while he was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he said: O people, I had permitted you to contract temporary marriage with women, but Allah has forbidden it (now) until the Day of Resurrection. So he who has any (woman with this type of marriage contract) he should let her off, and do not take back anything you have given to them (as dower).
hi: Sabra al-Juhani ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the unhone kaha: Aye logo, maine tumhe auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne ki ijazat di thi, lekin Allah ne ise ab mana kar diya hai Qayamat ke din tak. Is liye jiske paas bhi is tarah ke shaadi ke ehad wali koi aurat hai use chhod dena chahiye, aur unhe jo bhi tumne unhe diya hai, mehr ke taur par, use wapas mat lo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-'Aziz b 'Umar with the same chain of transmitters, and he said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) standing between the pillar and the gate (of the Ka'ba) and he was relating a hadith as narrated by Ibn Numair.
hi: Ye hadees Abd al-Aziz bin Umar ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, aur unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khambe aur darwaze, Kaaba ke, ke beech khade dekha aur woh ek hadees bayan kar rahe the jaisi Ibn Numair ne riwayat ki hai.

e: 'Abd al-Malik b. Rabi' b. Sabraal-Juhanni reported on the authority of his father who narrated it on the authority of his father (i e. 'Abd al-Malik's grandfather, Sabura al-Juhanniy Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted us to contract temporary marriage in the Year of Victory, as we entered Mecca, and we did come out of it but he forbade us to do it.
hi: Abd al-Malik bin Rabi bin Sabra al-Juhanni ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone ise apne walid, yaani Abd al-Malik ke dada, Sabura al-Juhanni, ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein asthaayi shaadi karne ki ijazat di Fatah ke saal, jab hum Makkah mein daakhil huye, aur hum isse bahar aaye lekin unhone humein aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: Sabra b. Ma'bad reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) permitted his Companions to contract temporary marriage with women in the Year of Victory. So I and a friend of mine from Banu Sulaim went out, until we found a young woman of Banu Amir who was like a young she-camel having a long neck. We proposed to her for contracting temporary marriage with us, and presented to her our cloaks (as dower). She began to look and found me more handsome than my friend, but found the cloak of my friend more beautiful than my cloak. She thought in her mind for a while, but then preferred me to my friend. So I remained with her for three (nights), and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to part with them (such women).
hi: Sabra bin Ma'bad ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba ko auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne ki ijazat di Fatah ke saal. To main aur Banu Sulaim ke mere ek dost bahar gaye, yahan tak ki humein Banu Amir ki ek jawaan aurat mili jo ek jawaan oontni jaisi thi jiski gardan lambi thi. Humne unhe unse asthaayi shaadi ka prastaav diya, aur unhe apni chadarein pesh kin, mehr ke taur par. Woh dekhne lagi aur unhone mujhe apne dost se zyada khoobsurat paaya, lekin unhone mere dost ki chadar meri chadar se zyada khoobsurat paayi. Unhone kuch der apne dil mein socha, lekin phir mujhe apne dost par tarjeeh di. To main unke saath teen raaton tak raha, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum unse, aisi auraton se, alag ho jaayein.

e: Rabi' b. Sabra reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prohibited the contracting of temporary marriage.
hi: Rabi bin Sabra ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne asthaayi shaadi karne se mana kiya.

e: Rabi' b. Sabra reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade on the Day of Victory to contract temporary marriage with women.
hi: Rabi bin Sabra ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fatah ke din auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Rabi' b. Sabra that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade to contract temporary marriage with women at the time of Victory, and that his father had contracted the marriage for two red cloaks.
hi: Ye hadees Rabi bin Sabra ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fatah ke waqt auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne se mana kiya, aur ki unke walid ne do laal chadaron ke liye shaadi ki thi.

e: 'Urwa b. Zabair reported that 'Abdullah b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) stood up (and delivered an address) in Mecca saying: Allah has made blind the hearts of some people as He has deprived them of eyesight that they give religious verdict in favour of temporary marriage, while he was alluding to a person (Ibn 'Abbas). Ibn Abbas called him and said: You are an uncouth person, devoid of sense. By my life, Mut'a was practised during the lifetime of the leader of the pious (he meant Allah's Messenger, may peace be upon him), and Ibn Zubair said to him: just do it yourselves, and by Allah, if you do that I will stone you with your stones. Ibn Shihab said. Khalid b. Muhajir b. Saifullah informed me: While I was sitting in the company of a person, a person came to him and he asked for a religious verdict about Mut'a and he permitted him to do it. Ibn Abu 'Amrah al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) said to him: Be gentle. It was permitted in- the early days of Islam, (for one) who was driven to it under the stress of necessity just as (the eating of) carrion and the blood and flesh of swine and then Allah intensified (the commands of) His religion and prohibited it (altogether). Ibn Shihab reported: Rabi' b. Sabra told me that his father (Sabra) said: I contracted temporary marriage with a woman of Banu 'Amir for two cloaks during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; then he forbade us to do Mut'a. Ibn Shihab said: I heard Rabi' b. Sabra narrating it to Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz and I was sitting there.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) Makkah mein khade huye aur khitaab diya ye kehte hue: Allah ne kuch logon ke dilon ko andha kar diya hai jaise Usne unhe najar se mehroom kiya hai ki woh asthaayi shaadi ke haq mein mazhabi fatwa dete hain, aur woh ek shakhs, Ibn Abbas, ki taraf ishara kar rahe the. Ibn Abbas ne unhe bulaaya aur kaha: Tum ek gawaar shakhs ho, samajh se khaali. Meri jaan ki qasam, Mut'a Nabi-e-Muttaqi, unka matlab Allah ke Rasool se tha, ke zindagi kaal mein amal mein laayi jaati thi, aur Ibn Zubair ne unse kaha: Bas khud aisa karo, aur Allah ki qasam, agar tumne aisa kiya to main tumhe tumhare hi pattharon se sangsaar karunga. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Khalid bin Muhajir bin Saifullah ne mujhe bataya: Jab main ek shakhs ki sohbat mein baitha tha, ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur unhone Mut'a ke baare mein mazhabi fatwa maanga aur unhone use aisa karne ki ijazat di. Ibn Abu Amrah al-Ansari (RA) ne unse kaha: Naram raho. Ye Islam ke shuruaati dinon mein jaayez tha uske liye jo zaroorat ke dabaav mein isse majboor ho jaata, bilkul jaise murda jaanwar khaana aur khoon aur khinzeer ka gosht, aur phir Allah ne apne deen ko aur mazboot kar diya aur ise poori tarah mana kar diya. Ibn Shihab ne bayaan kiya: Rabi bin Sabra ne mujhe bataya ki unke waalid, Sabra, ne kaha: Maine Banu Amir ki ek aurat se do chadaron ke badle asthaayi shaadi ki thi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein; phir unhone humein Mut'a karne se mana kiya. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine Rabi bin Sabra ko ye Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ko riwayat karte suna aur main wahan baitha tha.

e: Sabra al-Juhanni reported on the authority of his father: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the contracting of temporary marriage and said: Behold, it is forbidden from this very day of yours to the Day of Resurrection, and he who has given something (as a dower) should not take it back.
hi: Sabra al-Juhanni ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne asthaayi shaadi karne se mana kiya aur kaha: Dekho, ye aaj ke tumhare is din se Qayamat ke din tak mana hai, aur jisne bhi kuch diya hai, mehr ke taur par, use wapas na le.

e: 'Ali b. AbiTalib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited on the Day of Khaibar the contracting of temporary marriage with women and the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne aur ghareloo gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Malik narrated this hadith on the authority of the same chain of trans- witters that 'Ali b. Abil Talib said to a person: You are a person led astray; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us (to do Mut'a), as is stated In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yahya b. Malik.
hi: Malik ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki ki Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne ek shakhs se kaha: Tum ek gumraah shakhs ho; Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya, Mut'a karne se, jaisa Yahya bin Malik ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein bayaan hua hai.

e: Muhammad b. 'Ali narrated on the authority of his father 'Ali that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on the Day of Khaibar prohibited for ever the contracting of temporary marriage and eating of the flesh of the domestic asses.
hi: Muhammad bin Ali ne apne walid Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din hamesha ke liye auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi karne aur ghareloo gadhon ka gosht khaane ko mana kar diya.

e: 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) heard that Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) gave some relaxation in connection with the contracting of temporary marriage, whereupon he said: Don't be hasty (in your religious verdict), Ibn 'Abbas, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the Day of Khaibar prohibited that forever - along with the eating of flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne suna ki Ibn Abbas (RA) ne asthaayi shaadi karne ke silsile mein kuch chhoot di, isper unhone kaha: Jaldbaazi mat karo apne mazhabi fatwe mein, Ibn Abbas, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din ise hamesha ke liye mana kar diya - ghareloo gadhon ka gosht khaane ke saath.

e: 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the Day of Khaibar forbade forever the contracting of temporary marriage and the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din hamesha ke liye asthaayi shaadi karne aur ghareloo gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) having said this: One should not combine a woman and her father's sister, nor a woman and her mother's sister in marriage.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Kisi ko ek aurat aur uski walid ki behn ko, na hi ek aurat aur uski maa ki behn ko, ekasath shaadi mein jodna nahi chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade combining of four women in marriage: a woman with her father's sister, and a woman with her mother's sister.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne shaadi mein char auraton ko jodne se mana kiya: ek aurat ko uski waalid ki behn ke saath, aur ek aurat ko uski maa ki behn ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Father's sister should not be combined with her brother's daughter, nor the daughter of a sister with her mother's sister.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Waalid ki behn ko uske bhai ki beti ke saath nahi jodna chahiye, na hi behn ki beti ko uski maa ki behn ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade a person to combine in marriage a womanarid her father's sister, and a woman and her mother's sister. Ibn Shihab said: So we regarded the paternal aunt of her (wife's) father and the maternal aunt of her (wife's) father at the same level.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko shaadi mein ek aurat aur uski waalid ki behn, aur ek aurat aur uski maa ki behn ko jodne se mana kiya. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Is liye humne, biwi ke waalid ki phupi aur biwi ke waalid ki khaala ko ek hi darje mein maana.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: One should not combine in marriage a woman with her father's sister, or her mother's sister.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi ko shaadi mein ek aurat ko uski waalid ki behn, ya uski maa ki behn ke saath nahi jodna chahiye.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A man must not make proposal of marriage to a woman when his brother has done so already. And he must not offer a price for a thing for which his brother had already offered a price; and a woman must not be combined in marriage with her father's sister, nor with her mother's sister, and a woman must not ask to have her sister divorced in order to deprive her of what belongs to her, but she must marry, because she will have what Allah has decreed for her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aadmi ko kisi aurat se shaadi ka prastaav tab nahi dena chahiye jab uske bhai ne pehle hi aisa kiya ho. Aur use kisi cheez ki keemat pesh nahi karni chahiye jiske liye uske bhai ne pehle hi keemat pesh ki ho; aur ek aurat ko uski waalid ki behn ke saath, na hi uski maa ki behn ke saath jodna nahi chahiye, aur ek aurat ko apni behn ki talaaq ki maang nahi karni chahiye taaki woh use uski maal se mehroom kar sake, lekin use shaadi karni chahiye, kyunki use woh milega jo Allah ne uske liye muqarrar kiya hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the combining of a woman in marriage with her father's sister, or with her mother's sister, or that a woman should ask for divorce for her sister in order to deprive her of what belongs to her. Allah, the Exalted'and Majestic, is her Sustainer too.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aurat ko shaadi mein uski waalid ki behn, ya uski maa ki behn ke saath jodne se, ya ye ki ek aurat apni behn ki talaaq maange taaki use uski maal se mehroom kar sake, mana kiya. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, uski, behn ki, bhi parvaan karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade to combine a woman and her father's sister, and a woman and her mother's sister.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aurat aur uski waalid ki behn, aur ek aurat aur uski maa ki behn ko jodne se mana kiya.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Amr b. Dinar
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Amr bin Dinar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nubaih b. Wahb reported that 'Umar b. Ubaidullah intended to marry Talha b. 'Umar with the daughter of Shaiba b. Jubair; so he sent a messenger to Aban b. Uthman to attend the marriage, and he was at that time the Amir of Hajj. Aban said: I heard 'Uthman b. 'Affan say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had stated: A Muhrim must neither marry himself, nor arrange the marriage of another one, nor should he make the proposal of marriage.
hi: Nubaih bin Wahb ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Ubaidullah ne Talha bin Umar ki shaadi Shaiba bin Jubair ki beti se karne ka iraada kiya; is liye unhone Aban bin Uthman ke paas ek payaam laane wala bheja shaadi mein shaamil hone ke liye, aur woh us waqt Hajj ke Amir the. Aban ne kaha: Maine Uthman bin Affan ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bayaan kiya tha: Ek Muhrim na to khud shaadi kare, na kisi doosre ki shaadi ka intezaam kare, na hi use shaadi ka prastaav dena chahiye.

e: Nubaih b. Wahb reported: Umar b. Ubaidullah b. Ma'mar sent me to Aban b. Uthman as he wanted to make the proposal of the marriage of his son with the daughter of Shaiba b. Uthman. He (Aban b. Uthman) was at that time (busy) in the season of Pilgrimage. He said: I deem him to be a man of the desert (for it is a common thing) that a Muhrim can neither marry, nor is he allowed to be married to anyone. It is Uthman (b. Affan) who reported this to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Nubaih bin Wahb ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Ubaidullah bin Ma'mar ne mujhe Aban bin Uthman ke paas bheja kyunki woh apne bete ki shaadi ka prastaav Shaiba bin Uthman ki beti se rakhna chahte the. Woh, Aban bin Uthman, us waqt Hajj ke mausam mein masroof the. Unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki woh ek registaan ka aadmi hai, kyunki ye ek aam baat hai, ki ek Muhrim na to shaadi kar sakta hai, na hi use kisi se shaadi karne ki ijazat hai. Ye Uthman, bin Affan, hain jinhone humein ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Uthman b. 'Affan reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: A Muhrim should neither marry himself, nor should he be got married to anyone, nor should he make the proposal of marriage.
hi: Uthman bin Affan ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Ek Muhrim na to khud shaadi kare, na hi uski shaadi karwaayi jaaye, na hi use shaadi ka prastaav dena chahiye.

e: 'Uthman (b. 'Affan) reported it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that he said: A Muhrim should neithermarry (in that state) nor make the proposal of marriage.
hi: Uthman, bin Affan, ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Ek Muhrim na to shaadi kare us haalat mein na hi shaadi ka prastaav de.

e: Nabaih b. Wahb reported that Umar b. 'Ubaidullah b. Ma'mar intended to marry his son Talha with the daughter of Shaiba b. Jubair during the Pilgrimage. Aban b. Uthman was at that time the Amir of Pilgrims. So he ('Umar b. Ubaidullah) sent someone (as a messenger) to Aban saying: I intend to marry Talha b. 'Umar and I earnestly desire you to be present there (in this ceremony of marriage). Aban said to him: I find you a block-headed 'Iraqi. I heard 'Uthman b. 'Affan say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A Muhrim should not marry.
hi: Nabaih bin Wahb ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Ubaidullah bin Ma'mar ne apne bete Talha ki shaadi Shaiba bin Jubair ki beti se karne ka iraada kiya Hajj ke daurane. Aban bin Uthman us waqt Hajj ke Amir the. To unhone, Umar bin Ubaidullah ne, Aban ke paas kisi ko payaam laane wale ke taur par bheja ye kehte hue: Mera iraada Talha bin Umar ki shaadi karne ka hai aur main dil se chahta hoon ki aap wahan, is shaadi ki rasm mein, maujood rahein. Aban ne unse kaha: Mujhe lagta hai tum ek gaon, moorkh, Iraqi ho. Maine Uthman bin Affan ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek Muhrim ko shaadi nahi karni chahiye.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married Maimuna in the state of Ihram. Ibn Numair made this addition: " I narrated it to Zuhri and he said: Yazid b. al-Asamm (Allah be pleased with him) told me that he (the Holy Prophet) married her when he was not a muhrim."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Maimuna se ehram ki halat mein shaadi ki. Ibn Numair ne ye izafa kiya: "Maine ise Zuhri ko riwayat ki aur unhone kaha: Yazid bin al-Asamm (RA) ne mujhe bataya ki unhone unse shaadi ki jab woh Muhrim nahi the."

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) married Maimuna while he was a Muhrim.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Maimuna se shaadi ki jabki woh ek Muhrim the.

e: Yazid b. al-Asamm reported: Maimuna daughter of al-Harith narrated to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her and he was not in the state of Ihram. And she (Maimuna) was my mother's sister and that of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them).
hi: Yazid bin al-Asamm ne bayan kiya: Maimuna, al-Harith ki beti, ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse shaadi ki aur woh ehram ki halat mein nahi the. Aur woh, Maimuna, meri maa ki behn thin aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ki bhi.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as having said this: None amongst you should outbid another in a transaction, nor should he make proposals of marriage upon the proposal made by someone else.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi kisi doosre ke souda mein zyada bol na de, na hi use shaadi ke aisa prastaav dena chahiye jab kisi aur ne pehle hi prastaav de diya ho.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as having said this: A person should not enter into a transaction when his brother (had already entered into but not finalised), and he should not make proposal of marriage upon the proposal already made by his brother, until he permits it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek shakhs ko koi souda tab shuru nahi karna chahiye jab uska bhai, pehle hi ismein daakhil ho chuka hai lekin mukammal nahi hua hai, aur use apne bhai ke pehle diye gaye shaadi ke prastaav ke upar apna prastaav nahi dena chahiye, jab tak woh bhai ijazat na de.

e: Narrated Ibn Umar : The above hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar through another chain.
hi: Upar bayan hui hadees Ibn Umar ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as having forbidden a dweller of the town selling the merchandise of a villager or outbidding in a sale (in order that another might fall into a snare), or a person making the proposal of marriage when his brother has already made such a proposal, or entering into a transaction when his brother has already entered; and a woman asking the divorce of her sister in order to deprive her of what belongs to her. 'Amr made this addition: " The person should not purchase in opposition to his brother."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki unhone shehar ke rehne wale ko dehaati ka saamaan bechne ya bikri mein zyada bol dene, taaki koi doosra jaal mein phans jaaye, ya kisi shakhs ko shaadi ka prastaav dene se jab uske bhai ne pehle hi aisa prastaav diya ho, ya kisi souda mein daakhil hone se jab uska bhai pehle hi ismein daakhil ho chuka ho; aur ek aurat ko apni behn ki talaaq maangne se mana kiya taaki use uski maal se mehroom kar sake. Amr ne ye izafa kiya: "Shakhs ko apne bhai ke khilaaf khareedaari nahi karni chahiye."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: Do not outbid in a sale in order to ensnare. No man should enter into a transaction in which his brother has already entered, and no dweller of the town should sell on behalf of the villager. And no man should make a proposal of marriage which his brother has already made and no woman should ask for the divorce of another (co-wife) in order to deprive her of what belongs to her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Bikri mein zyada bol na do taaki jaal mein phansaao. Kisi aadmi ko koi souda tab shuru nahi karna chahiye jab uska bhai pehle hi ismein daakhil ho chuka ho, aur kisi shehar ke rehne wale ko dehaati ki taraf se saamaan nahi bechna chahiye. Aur kisi aadmi ko shaadi ka aisa prastaav nahi dena chahiye jo uska bhai pehle hi de chuka ho aur kisi aurat ko doosri, saanjhi biwi, ki talaaq nahi maangni chahiye taaki use uski maal se mehroom kar sake.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight alteration.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin thodi tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Muslim should not purchase in opposition to his brother, and he should not make the proposal of marriage on the proposal already made by his brother.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman ko apne bhai ke khilaaf khareedaari nahi karni chahiye, aur use apne bhai ke pehle diye gaye shaadi ke prastaav par apna prastaav nahi dena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amir said on the pulpit that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A believer is the brother of a believer, so it is not lawful for a believer to outbid his brother, and he should not propose an engagement when his brother has thus proposed until he gives it up.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne mimbar par kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek momin doosre momin ka bhai hai, is liye ek momin ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai ke khilaaf bikri mein zyada bol de, aur use shaadi ka mangetar-prastaav tab tak nahi dena chahiye jab uska bhai pehle hi aisa prastaav de chuka ho, jab tak woh use chhod na de.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited Shighar which means that a man gives his daughter in marriage on the condition that the other gives his daughter to him in marriage with- out any dower being paid by either.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Shighar ko mana kiya, jiska matlab hai ki ek aadmi apni beti ki shaadi is shart par kare ki doosra apni beti uski shaadi mein de, bina donon taraf se koi mehr diye.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of" Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited Shighar.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Shighar ko mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said: There is no Shighar in islam.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Islam mein Shighar ki koi jagah nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited Shighar. Ibn Numair added: Shighar means that a person should say to the other person: Give me the hand of your daughter in marriage and I will (in return) marry my daughter to you; or merry me your sister, and I will marry my sister to you.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Shighar ko mana kiya. Ibn Numair ne izafa kiya: Shighar ka matlab hai ki ek shakhs doosre shakhs se kahe: Apni beti ki shaadi mujhse kar do aur main, badle mein, apni beti ki shaadi tumse karunga; ya mujhse apni behn ki shaadi karo, aur main apni behn ki shaadi tumse karunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Vmar with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of Ibn Numair.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein Ibn Numair ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited Shighar.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Shighar ko mana kiya.

e: 'Uqba b. Amir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most worthy condition which must be fulfilled is that which makes sexual intercourse lawful. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Muthanna (instead of the word" condition" ) it is" conditions".
hi: Uqba bin Aamir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse zyada laayak shart jo poori ki jaani chahiye woh hai jo jinsi milaap ko jaayez banaati hai. Ibn Muthanna ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "shart" lafz ki jagah "shartein" lafz hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said: A woman without a husband (or divorced or a widow) must not be married until she is consulted, and a virgin must not be married until her permission is sought. They asked the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ): How her (virgin's) consent can be solicited? He (the Holy Prophet) said: That she keeps silence.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi aurat, jo shohar-hin ho ya talaaqshuda ya bewa, ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chahiye jab tak usse rai na li jaaye, aur ek kunwari ki shaadi tab tak nahi honi chahiye jab tak uski ijazat na li jaaye. Unhone Nabi Allah ke (SAW) se poocha: Uski, kunwari ki, sehmati kaise maangi jaaye? Unhone kaha: Ki woh khamosh rahe.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a virgin whose marriage is solemnised by her guardian, whether it was necessary or not to consult her. Allah's Messerger (ﷺ) said: Yes, she must be consulted. 'A'isha reported: I told him that she feels shy, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Her silence implies her consent.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek kunwari ke baare mein poocha jiski shaadi uske abhibhaavak ne tay ki hai, kya isse uski rai lena zaroori hai ya nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, uski rai leni chahiye. Aisha ne bataya: Maine unse kaha ki woh sharmaati hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Uski khamoshi hi uski sehmati hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A woman without a husband has more right to her person than her guardian, and a virgin's consent must be asked from her, and her silence implies her consent.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat, jo shohar-hin ho, ka apni zaat par apne abhibhaavak se zyada haq hai, aur ek kunwari ki sehmati usse maangni chahiye, aur uski khamoshi hi uski sehmati hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman who has been previously married (Thayyib) has more right to her person than her guardian. And a virgin should also be consulted, and her silence implies her consent.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki hai, Thayyib, ka apni zaat par apne abhibhaavak se zyada haq hai. Aur ek kunwari se bhi salaah li jaani chahiye, aur uski khamoshi hi uski sehmati hai.

e: Sufyan reported on the basis of the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): A woman who has been previously married (Thayyib) has more right to her person than her guardian; and a virgin's father must ask her consent from her, her consent being her silence, At times he said: Her silence is her affirmation.
hi: Sufyan ne isi sanad se riwayat ki, aur alfaaz hain: Ek aurat jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki hai, Thayyib, ka apni zaat par apne abhibhaavak se zyada haq hai; aur ek kunwari ke waalid ko uski sehmati usse maangni chahiye, uski sehmati uski khamoshi hai. Kabhi kabhi unhone kaha: Uski khamoshi uski tasdeeq hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married me when I was six years old, and I was admitted to his house at the age of nine. She further said: We went to Medina and I had an attack of fever for a month, and my hair had come down to the earlobes. Umm Ruman (my mother) came to me and I was at that time on a swing along with my playmates. She called me loudly and I went to her and I did not know what she had wanted of me. She took hold of my hand and took me to the door, and I was saying: Ha, ha (as if I was gasping), until the agitation of my heart was over. She took me to a house, where had gathered the women of the Ansar. They all blessed me and wished me good luck and said: May you have share in good. She (my mother) entrusted me to them. They washed my head and embellished me and nothing frightened me. Allah's Messenger (, may peace be upon him) came there in the morning, and I was entrusted to him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse shaadi ki jab main chhe saal ki thi, aur mujhe unke ghar mein nau saal ki umar mein bheja gaya. Unhone aage kaha: Hum Madina gaye aur mujhe ek mahine tak bukhaar aaya, aur mere baal mere kaanon ke lobe tak aa gaye the. Umm Ruman, meri maa, mere paas aayin aur main us waqt apne saathiyon ke saath jhoole par thi. Unhone mujhe zor se pukaara aur main unke paas gayi aur mujhe nahi pata tha ki unhe mujhse kya chahiye tha. Unhone mera haath pakda aur mujhe darwaze tak le gayin, aur main keh rahi thi: Ha, ha, jaise main haanft rahi thi, yahan tak ki mere dil ki hulchul khatam ho gayi. Woh mujhe ek ghar mein le gayin, jahan Ansar ki auraten ikattha thin. Unhone sab ne mujhe barkat di aur mera achha mustaqbil cheteya aur kaha: Achhaai mein tumhara hissa ho. Unhone, meri maa ne, mujhe unke supard kiya. Unhone mera sar dhoya aur mujhe sajaaya aur kisi cheez ne mujhe daraaya nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah wahan aaye, aur mujhe unke supard kiya gaya.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married me when I was six years old, and I was admitted to his house when I was nine years old.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse shaadi ki jab main chhe saal ki thi, aur mujhe unke ghar mein bheja gaya jab main nau saal ki thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married her when she was seven years old, and he was taken to his house as a bride when she was nine, and her dolls were with her; and when he (the Holy Prophet) died she was eighteen years old.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse shaadi ki jab woh saat saal ki thin, aur unhe unke ghar dulhan ke soorat mein laaya gaya jab woh nau saal ki thin, aur unki gudiyaan unke saath thin; aur jab unka intiqaal hua woh atharah saal ki thin.

e: Narrated 'A'isha : 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married her when she was six years old, and he (the Holy Prophet) took her to his house when she was nine, and when he (the Holy Prophet) died she was eighteen years old
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse shaadi ki jab woh chhe saal ki thin, aur unhone unhe apne ghar le gaye jab woh nau saal ki thin, aur jab unka intiqaal hua woh atharah saal ki thin.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted marriage with me in Shawwal and took me to his house as a bride during Shawwal. And who among the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was dearer to him than I, and' A'isha liked that the women (of her family) should enter the houses as brides during the month of Shawwal.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse Shawwal mein shaadi ki aur mujhe Shawwal mein dulhan ke soorat mein apne ghar le gaye. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se kaun mujhse zyada unke qareeb thi? Aur Aisha ko pasand tha ki, unke khaandaan ki, auraten Shawwal ke mahine mein dulhan ke taur par gharon mein daakhil hon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of the act of 'A'isha (being admitted as a wife in the house of the Holy Prophet).
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone Aisha ke amal ka koi zikr nahi kiya, Nabi ke ghar mein zauja ke taur par daakhil hone ka.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when there came a man and informed him that he had contracted to marry a woman of the Ansar. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Did you cast a glance at her? He said: No. He said: Go and cast a glance at her, for there is something in the eyes of the Ansar.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha jab ek shakhs aaya aur unhe bataya ki usne Ansar ki ek aurat se shaadi karne ka faisla kiya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne unpar nazar daali? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Jao aur unpar nazar daalo, kyunki Ansar ki aankhon mein kuch khaas baat hoti hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have contracted marriage with a woman of the Ansar, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Did you cast a glance at her, for there is something in the eyes of the Ansar? He said: I did cast a glance at her, whereupon he said: For what (dower) did you marry her? He said: For four 'uqiyas. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: For four 'uqiyas; it seems as if you dig out silver from the side of this mountain (and that is why you are prepared to pay such a large amount of dower). We have nothing which we should give you. There is a possibility that we may send you to an (expedition) where you may get (booty). So he sent that man (in the expedition) which was despatched to Banu 'Abs.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine Ansar ki ek aurat se shaadi karne ka faisla kiya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne unpar nazar daali, kyunki Ansar ki aankhon mein kuch khaas baat hoti hai? Usne kaha: Maine unpar nazar daali, isper unhone kaha: Kis mehr ke liye tumne unse shaadi ki? Usne kaha: Chaar uqiya ke liye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Chaar uqiya; aisa lagta hai jaise tum is pahaad ki taraf se chandi khoad rahe ho, isi liye tum itni badi mehr dene ko taiyaar ho. Hamare paas kuch nahi hai jo hum tumhe dein. Ho sakta hai hum tumhe kisi muhim mein bhejein jahan tumhe maal-e-ganimat mile. To unhone us shakhs ko us muhim mein bheja jo Banu Abs ke khilaaf rawaana ki gayi thi.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi (Allah be pleased with him) reported: A woman came to Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I have come to you to entrust myself to you (you may contract my marriage with anyone at your discretion). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw her and cast a glance at her from head to foot. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then lowered his head. When the woman saw that he had made no decision in regard to her, she sat down. There stood up a person from amongst his companions and said: Messenger of Allah, marry her to me if you have no need of her. He (the Prophet) said: is there anything with you (which you con give as a dower)? He said: No, Messenger of Allah, by Allah I have nothing. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Go to your people (family) and see if you can find something. He returned and said: I have found nothing. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: See even if it is an iron ring. He went and returned and said: No, by Allah, not even an iron ring, but only this lower garment of mine (Sahl said that he had no upper garment), half of which (I am prepared to part with) for her. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: How can your lower garment serve your purpose, for it you wear it, she would not be able to make any use of it and if she wears it there would not be anything on you? The man sat down and as the sitting prolonged he stood up (in disappointment) and as he was going back Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded (him) to be called back, and as he came, he said to him: Do you know any part of the Qur'an?
