He said: I know such and such surahs (and he counted them), whereupon he (ﷺ) said: Can you recite them from heart (from your memory)? He said: Yes, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Go, I have given her to you in marriage for the part of the Qur'an which you know.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main aapke paas apne aap ko sompne aayi hoon, aap mujhe apne vivek se kisi se bhi shaadi karwaa sakte hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe dekha aur unpar sar se paon tak nazar daali. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir apna sar jhukaaya. Jab aurat ne dekha ki unhone unke baare mein koi faisla nahi liya, woh baith gayin. Unke sahaba mein se ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar aapko unki zaroorat nahi hai to unki shaadi mujhse kar dijiye. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas kuch hai, jo tum mehr ke taur par de sako? Usne kaha: Nahi, Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam mere paas kuch nahi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne logon, khaandaan, ke paas jao aur dekho kya tumhe kuch mil sakta hai. Woh wapas aaya aur kaha: Mujhe kuch nahi mila. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho chahe ye ek loha ki angoothi hi ho. Woh gaya aur wapas aaya aur kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, ek loha ki angoothi bhi nahi, lekin sirf ye mera neeche pehna hua kapda hai, Sahl ne kaha ki unke paas koi upari kapda nahi tha, jiska aadha hissa main dene ko taiyaar hoon unke liye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhare neeche wale kapde tumhare kaam kaise aayenge, kyunki agar tum ise pehnoge, to woh isse koi istemal nahi kar payegi aur agar woh ise pehnegi, to tumpar kuch nahi hoga? Woh aadmi baith gaya aur jab baithna lamba hua woh khada hua, nirasha mein, aur jab woh wapas ja raha tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe bulwaane ka hukum diya, aur jab woh aaya, unhone usse kaha: Kya tumhe Quran ka koi hissa yaad hai? Usne kaha: Mujhe aisi-aisi surahen yaad hain, aur unhone unhe gina, isper unhone kaha: Kya tum unhe apni yaadaasht se padh sakte ho? Usne kaha: Haan, isper unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, kaha: Jao, maine unhe tumse shaadi mein de diya us hisse ke liye jo Quran ka tumhe yaad hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd with a minor alteration of words, but the hadith transmitted through Za'idah (the words are that the Holy Prophet) said: Go, I have married her to you, and you teach her something of the Qur'an.
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se alfaazon mein choti tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Za'idah ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain ki Nabi ne kaha: Jao, maine unki shaadi tumse kar di hai, aur tum unhe Quran ka kuch sikhaao.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported: I asked 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is the amount of dower of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She said: It was twelve 'uqiyas and one nash. She said: Do you know what is al-nash? I said: No. She said: It is half of uqiya, and it amounts to five hundred dirhams, and that was the dower given by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to his wives.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se poocha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki mehr ki raqam kya thi? Unhone kaha: Ye baarah uqiya aur ek nash thi. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai al-nash kya hai? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Ye aadhi uqiya ke barabar hai, aur ye paanch sau dirham banti hai, aur ye woh mehr thi jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko di.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw the trace of yellowness on 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and said: What is this? Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger, I have married a woman for a date-stone's weight of gold. He said: God bless you! Hold a wedding feast, even if only with a sheep.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abdur-Rahman bin Auf par peelaapan ka nishaan dekha aur kaha: Ye kya hai? Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine ek aurat se ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sone mein shaadi ki hai. Unhone kaha: Allah tumhein barkat de! Waleema karo, chahe sirf ek bakri ke saath.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleasedwith him) reported that 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf (Allah be pleased with him) married during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a nawat weight of gold and the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Give a feast even with a sheep.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein ek nawat wazan ke sone mein shaadi ki aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Waleema karo, chahe ek bakri ke saath.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf (Allah be pleased with him) married a woman for a date-stone's weight of gold and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: Hold a wedding feast, even if only with a sheep.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne ek aurat se ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sone mein shaadi ki aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Waleema karo, chahe sirf ek bakri ke saath.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Humaid with the same chain of transmitters except (with this minor alteration of words) that 'Abd al-Rahman said: " I married a woman."
hi: Ye hadees Humaid ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay alfaazon ki is halki tabdeeli ke ki Abdur-Rahman ne kaha: "Maine ek aurat se shaadi ki."

e: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw the signs of the happiness of wedding in me, and I said: I have married a woman of the Ansar. He said: How much Mahr have you paid? I said: For a date-stone weight of gold. And in the hadith transmitted by Ishaq (it is): (nawat weight) of gold.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhme shaadi ki khushi ke nishaan dekhe, aur maine kaha: Maine Ansar ki ek aurat se shaadi ki hai. Unhone kaha: Kitna mehr diya tumne? Maine kaha: Ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona. Aur Ishaq ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein hai: nawat wazan sone ki.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that 'Abd al-Rahman married a woman for a datestone weight of gold.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Abdur-Rahman ne ek aurat se ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sone mein shaadi ki.

e: Shu'ba has narrattd this hadith with the same chain of transmitters except for (this alteration) that he said that a person from among the sons of 'Abd al Rahman said: " from gold".
hi: Shu'ba ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai siwaay is tabdeeli ke ki unhone kaha ki Abdur-Rahman ke betoon mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: "sone se."

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on an expedition to Khaibar and we observed our morning prayer in early hours of the dawn. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then mounted and so did Abu Talha ride, and I was seating myself behind Abu Talha. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) moved in the narrow street of Khaibar (and we rode so close to each other in the street) that my knee touched the leg of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). (A part of the) lower garment of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) slipped from his leg and I could see the whiteness of the leg of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). As he entered the habitation he called: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest). Khaibar is ruined. And when we get down in the valley of a people evil is the morning of the warned ones. He repeated it thrice. In the meanwhile the people went out for their work, and said: By Allah, Muhammad (has come). Abd al-'Aziz or some of our companions said: Muhammad and the army (have come). He said: We took it (the territory of Khaibar) by force, and there were gathered the prisoners of war. There came Dihya and he said: Messenger of Allah, bestow upon me a girl from among the prisoners. He said: Go and get any girl. He made a choice for Safiyya daughter of Huyayy (b. Akhtab). There came a person to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Apostle of Allah, you have bestowed Safiyya bint Huyayy, the chief of Quraiza and al-Nadir, upon Dihya and she is worthy of you only. He said: Call him along with her. So he came along with her. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw her he said: Take any other woman from among the prisoners. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) then granted her emancipation and married her. Thabit said to him: Abu Hamza, how much dower did he (the Holy Prophet) give to her? He said: He granted her freedom and then married her. On the way Umm Sulaim embellished her and then sent her to him (the Holy Prophet) at night. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) appeared as a bridegroom in the morning. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He who has anything (to eat) should bring that. Then the cloth was spread. A person came with cheese, another came with dates, and still another came with refined butter, and they prepared hais and that was the wedding feast of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khaibar ki muhim par nikle aur humne subah ki namaz fajr ke shuru mein padhi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir sawaar huye aur Abu Talha bhi sawaar huye, aur main Abu Talha ke peeche baith gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khaibar ki tang gali mein aage badhe aur hum gali mein itne kareeb sawaar the ki mera ghutna Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taang se chhu gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke neeche wale kapde ka ek hissa unki taang se phisal gaya aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taang ki safedi dekh sakta tha. Jab woh basti mein daakhil huye unhone pukaara: Allahu Akbar, Allah sabse Buland hai. Khaibar tabaah ho gaya. Aur jab hum kisi qaum ki wadi mein utarte hain to un logon ki subah bahut buri hoti hai jinhe pehle chetaavni di gayi thi. Unhone ye teen baar dohraaya. Isi dauran log apne kaam ke liye bahar nikle, aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, Muhammad aa gaye hain. Abd al-Aziz ya hamare kuch saathiyon ne kaha: Muhammad aur fauj aa gaye hain. Raawi ne kaha: Humne ise, Khaibar ke ilaake ko, taaqat se le liya, aur isi mauqe par jung ke qaidiyon ko ikattha kiya gaya. Wahan Dihya aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe qaidiyon mein se ek larki de dijiye. Unhone kaha: Jao aur koi bhi larki le lo. Unhone Safiyyah, Huyayy bin Akhtab ki beti, ko chun liya. Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne Safiyyah bint Huyayy ko, jo Quraiza aur al-Nadir ki sardaar hain, Dihya ko de diya hai aur woh sirf aapke laayak hain. Unhone kaha: Use unke saath bulaao. To woh unke saath aaye. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe dekha, unhone kaha: Dihya ko qaidiyon mein se koi doosri aurat le lo. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone phir unhe azaad kiya aur unse shaadi ki. Thabit ne unse kaha: Abu Hamza, unhone unhe kitna mehr diya? Unhone kaha: Unhone unhe aazaadi di aur phir unse shaadi ki. Raaste mein Umm Sulaim ne unhe sajaaya aur phir unhe unke paas raat ko bheja. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah dulha ke soorat mein najar aaye. Unhone kaha: Jiske paas bhi kuch khaane ko hai use woh le aana chahiye. Phir kapda phailaaya gaya. Ek shakhs panir lekar aaya, doosra khajooren lekar aaya, aur ek aur shudh ghee lekar aaya, aur unhone hais taiyaar ki aur ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Waleema tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters on the authority of Anas that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) emancipated Safiyya, and her emancipation was treated as her wedding gift, and in the hadith transmitted by Mu'adh on the authority of his father (the words are): " He (the Holy Prophet) married Safiyya and bestowed her emancipation as her wedding gift."
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safiyyah ko aazaad kiya, aur unki aazaadi hi unka mehr thi, aur Mu'adh ki apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone Safiyyah se shaadi ki aur unki aazaadi hi unka mehr thi."

e: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about one who emancipated a slave woman, and then married her, that for him there are two rewards.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un logon ke baare mein kaha jinhone kisi laundi ko aazaad karke phir usse shaadi ki, ki unke liye do sawaab hain.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was sitting behind Abu Talha on the Day of Khaibar and my feet touched the foot of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and we came (to the people of Khaibar) when the sun had risen and they had driven out their cattle, and had themselves come out with their axes, large baskets and hatchets, and they said: (Here come) Muhammad and the army. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Khaibar is ruined. Verily when we get down in the valley of a people, evil is the morning of the warned ones (al-Qur'an, xxxvii. 177). Allah, the Majestic and the Glorious, defeated them (the inhabitants of Khaibar), and there fell to the lot of Dihya a beautiful girl, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got her in exchange of seven heads, and then entrusted her to Umm Sulaim so that she might embellish her and prepare her (for marriage) with him. He (the narrator) said: He had been under the impression that he had said that so that she might spend her period of 'Iddah in her (Umm Sulaim's) house. (The woman) was Safiyya daughter of Huyayy. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arranged the wedding feast consisting of dates, cheese, and refined butter, and pits were dug and tiers were set in them dining cloths, and there was brought cheese and refined butter, and these were placed there. And the people ate to their fill, and they said: We do not know whether he (the Holy Prophet) had married her (as a free woman), or as a slave woman. They said: If he (the Holy Prophet) would make her wear the veil, then she would be a (free married) woman, and if he would not make her wear the veil, then she should be a slave woman. When he intended to ride, he made her wear the veil and she sat on the hind part of the camel; so they came to know that he had married her. As they approached Medina, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drove (his ride) quickly and so we did. 'Adba' (the name of Allah's Apostle's camel) stumbled and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell down and she (Radrat Safiyya: also fell down. He (the Holy Prophet) stood up and covered her. Women looked towards her and said: May Allah keep away the Jewess! He (the narrator) said: I said: Aba Hamza, did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) really fall down? He said: Yes, by Allah, he in fact fell down.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Khaibar ke din Abu Talha ke peeche baitha tha aur mere paon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paon ko chhu rahe the, aur hum Khaibar ke logon ke paas tab pahunche jab suraj nikal chuka tha aur unhone apne maweshi bahar nikale the, aur woh khud apni kulhaadiyon, badi tokariyon aur chhoti kulhaadiyon ke saath bahar aaye the, aur unhone kaha: Ye aa gaye hain Muhammad aur fauj. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Khaibar tabaah ho gaya. Yaqeenan jab hum kisi qaum ki wadi mein utarte hain, to un logon ki subah bahut buri hoti hai jinhe chetaavni di gayi thi, Quran, 37:177. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne unhe, Khaibar ke logon ko, shikast di, aur Dihya ke hisse mein ek khoobsurat larki aayi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use saat sar, ghulamon, ke badle mein le liya, aur phir use Umm Sulaim ko sompa taaki woh use sajaaye aur unke liye taiyaar kare, shaadi ke liye. Raawi ne kaha: Unhe laga tha ki unhone kaha tha ki woh apni iddat ki muddat unke, Umm Sulaim ke, ghar mein guzaare. Ye aurat Safiyyah, Huyayy ki beti, thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Waleema tay kiya jismein khajooren, panir, aur shudh ghee shaamil the, aur gadde khode gaye aur unmein daawat ke kapde bichhaaye gaye, aur panir aur shudh ghee laaya gaya, aur ye wahan rakhe gaye. Aur log tab tak khaate rahe jab tak peth bhar nahi gaye, aur unhone kaha: Humein nahi pata ki unhone unse shaadi ki, azaad aurat ke taur par, ya ghulam aurat ke taur par. Unhone kaha: Agar unhone unhe parda pehnaaya, to woh ek azaad shaadishuda aurat hoti, aur agar unhone unhe parda na pehnaaya, to woh ek laundi hoti. Jab unhone sawaar hone ka iraada kiya, unhone unhe parda pehnaaya aur woh oont ke peechhle hisse par baithi; to unhe pata chal gaya ki unhone unse shaadi ki hai. Jab woh Madina ke qareeb pahunche, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni sawaari tez chalaayi aur humne bhi aisa hi kiya. Adba, Allah ke Rasool ke oont ka naam, lad khaayi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) gir gaye aur woh, Hazrat Safiyyah, bhi gir gayin. Unhone khada hokar unhe dhaanka. Auraten unki taraf dekhne lagin aur kaha: Allah is Yahudi aurat ko door rakhe! Raawi ne kaha: Maine kaha: Abu Hamza, kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) waaqai gir gaye the? Unhone kaha: Haan, Allah ki qasam, woh waaqai gir gaye the.

e: Anas said: I also saw the wedding feast of Zainab, and he (the Holy Prophet) served bread and meat to the people, and made them eat to their heart's content, and he (the Holy Prophet) sent me to call people, and as he was free (from the ceremony) he stood up and I followed him. Two persons were left and they were busy in talking and did not get out (of the apartment). He (the Holy Prophet) then proceeded towards (the apartments of) his wives. He greeted with as-Salamu 'alaikum to every one of them and said: Members of the household, how are you? They said: Messenger of Allah, we are in good state 'How do you find your family? He would say: In good state. When he was free from (this work of exchanging greetings) he came back, and I also came back along with him. And as he reached the door, (he found) that the two men were still busy in talking. And when they saw him having returned, they stood up and went out; and by Allah! I do not know whether I had informed him, or there was a revelation to him (to the affect) that they had gone. He (the Holy Prophet) then came back and I also returned along with him, and as he put his step on the threshold of his door he hung a curtain between me and him, and (it was on this occasion) that Allah revealed this verse: (" O you who believe), do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to 'you" (xxxiii. 53).
hi: Anas ne kaha: Maine Zainab ka Waleema bhi dekha, aur unhone logon ko roti aur gosht pesh kiya, aur unhe dil bhar kar khilaya, aur unhone mujhe logon ko bulaane bheja, aur jab woh, rasm se, aazaad huye woh khade hue aur main unke peechhe chala. Do log reh gaye aur woh baatcheet mein masroof the aur kamre se bahar nahi nikle. Woh phir apni zaujaon ki taraf gaye. Unhone har ek ko As-Salamu alaikum kehkar salaam kiya aur kaha: Ghar ke logo, aap kaise hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum theek hain. Aap apne khaandaan ko kaisa paate hain? Woh kehte: Theek. Jab woh is salaam badalne ke kaam se aazaad huye woh wapas aaye, aur main bhi unke saath wapas aaya. Aur jab woh darwaze tak pahunche, unhone paaya ki do log abhi bhi baatcheet mein masroof the. Aur jab unhone unhe wapas aate dekha, woh khade hue aur bahar chale gaye; aur Allah ki qasam! Mujhe nahi pata ki maine unhe bataya tha ya unpar wahi hui thi ki woh chale gaye hain. Woh phir wapas aaye aur main bhi unke saath wapas aaya, aur jab unhone apna paon apne darwaze ki dahleez par rakha, unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda latka diya, aur isi mauqe par Allah ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Aye imaan waalo, Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil na ho jab tak tumhe ijazat na di jaaye" (33:53).

e: Anas, (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Safiyya (Allah be pleased with her) fell to the lot of Dihya in the spoils of war, and they praised her in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: We have not seen the like of her among the captives of war. He sent (a messenger) to Dihya and he gave him whatever he demanded. He then sent her to my mother and asked her to embellish her. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then got out of Khaibar until when he was on the other side of it, he halted, and a tent was pitched for him. When it was morning Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has surplus of provision with him should bring that to us. Some persons would bring the surplus of dates, and the other surplus of mush of barley until there became a heap of bals. They began to eat the hais and began to drink out of the pond which had the water of rainfall in it and which was situated by their side. Anas said that that constituted the wedding feast of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (further) said: We proceeded until we saw the walls of Medina, and we were delighted. We made our mounts run quickly and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also made his mount run quickly. And Safiyya (Allah be pleased with her) was at his back, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had seated her behind him. The camel of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stumbled and he (the Holy Prophet) fell down and she also fell down. And none among the people was seeing him and her, until Allah's Messeuger (ﷺ) stood up and he covered her, and we came to him and he said: We have received no injury. We entered Medina and there came out the young ladies of the household. They saw her (hadrat Safiyya) and blamed her for falling down.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Safiyyah (RA) jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein Dihya ke hisse mein aayin, aur logon ne unki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein tareef ki aur kaha: Humne jung ke qaidiyon mein unke jaisa kabhi nahi dekha. Unhone Dihya ko koi payaam bheja aur unhe jo bhi unhone maanga diya. Unhone phir unhe meri maa ke paas bheja aur unse unhe sajaane ko kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir Khaibar se bahar nikle yahan tak ki jab woh iske doosre taraf the, woh ruke, aur unke liye ek tambu laga diya gaya. Jab subah hui Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas bhi khaane ka faaltu saamaan hai use humein laana chahiye. Kuch log khajooron ka faaltu saamaan laaye, aur doosre jau ke aate ka, yahan tak ki unka dher lag gaya. Woh hais khaane lage aur us talab se paani peene lage jismein baarish ka paani tha aur jo unke bagal mein sthit tha. Anas ne kaha ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka Waleema tha. Unhone aage kaha: Hum aage badhe yahan tak ki humne Madina ki deewaren dekhin, aur hum khush hue. Humne apni sawaariyon ko tez daudaaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi apni sawaari tez daudaayi. Aur Safiyyah (RA) unke peeche thin, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe apne peeche baithaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka oont lad khaayi aur woh gir gaye aur woh bhi gir gayin. Aur logon mein se koi bhi unhe dekh nahi raha tha, yahan tak ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur unhone unhe dhaanka, aur hum unke paas aaye aur unhone kaha: Humein koi chot nahi lagi. Hum Madina mein daakhil huye aur ghar ki jawaan larkiyaan bahar aayin. Unhone unhe, Hazrat Safiyyah, dekha aur unke girne ke liye unhe dosh diya.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When the 'Iddah of Zainab was over, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Zaid to make a mention to her about him. Zaid went on until he came to her and she was fermenting her flour. He (Zaid) said: As I saw her I felt in my heart an idea of her greatness so much so that I could not see towards her (simply for the fact) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a mention of her. So I turned my back towards her. and I turned upon my heels, and said: Zainab, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has sent (me) with a message to you. She said: I do not do anything until I solicit the will of my Lord. So she stood at her place of worship and the (verse of) the Qur'an (pertaining to her marriage) were revealed, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to her without permission. He (the narrator) said: I saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) served us bread and meat until it was broad day light and the people went away, but some persons who were busy in con- versation stayed on in the house after the meal. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also went out and I also followed him, and he began to visit the apartments of his wives greeting them (with the words): As-Salamu 'alaikum, and they would say: Allah's Messenger, how did you find your family (hadrat Zainab)? He (the narrator) stated: I do not know whether I had informed him that the people had gone out or he (the Holy Prophet) informed me (about that). He moved on until he entered the apartment, and I also went and wanted to enter (the apartment) along with him, but he threw a curtain between me and him, as (the verfes pertaining to seclusion) had been revealed, and people were instructed in what they had been instructed. Ibn Rafii had made this addition in his narration:" O you who believe, enter not the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, not waiting for its cooking being finished..." to the words"... Allah forbears not from the truth."
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Zainab ki iddat khatam hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zaid se kaha ki woh unse unke baare mein zikr karein. Zaid gaye yahan tak ki woh unke paas pahunche aur woh apna aata guundh rahi thin. Unhone kaha: Jab maine unhe dekha to mere dil mein unki azmat ka khayaal aaya itna zyada ki main unki taraf nahi dekh saka sirf is liye ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka zikr kiya tha. To maine apni peeth unki taraf ki, aur main apne pairon ke bal mud gaya, aur kaha: Zainab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe payaam bheja hai. Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi karti jab tak main apne Rab ki marzi na maang lun. To woh apni namaz ki jagah khadi hui aur Quran ki aayaten unki shaadi se mutalliq nazil huyin, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas bina ijazat maange aaye. Raawi ne kaha: Maine dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein roti aur gosht pesh kiya yahan tak ki poora din nikal aaya aur log chale gaye, lekin kuch log jo baatcheet mein masroof the woh khaane ke baad ghar mein reh gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bhi bahar gaye aur main bhi unke peeche gaya, aur unhone apni zaujaon ke kamron ki ziyarat shuru ki unhe salaam karte hue in alfaazon mein: As-Salamu alaikum, aur woh kehtin: Allah ke Rasool, aapne apne khaandaan, Hazrat Zainab, ko kaisa paaya? Raawi ne bataaya: Mujhe nahi pata ki maine unhe bataya tha ki log chale gaye hain ya unhone mujhe bataya iske baare mein. Woh chalte gaye yahan tak ki woh kamre mein daakhil huye, aur main bhi gaya aur unke saath daakhil hona chaahta tha, lekin unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda daal diya, jaise parde se mutalliq aayaten nazil hui thin, aur logon ko woh hukum diya gaya jo unhe diya jaana tha. Ibn Rafi ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya: "Aye imaan waalo, Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak tumhe khaane ke liye ijazat na di jaaye, khaana pakne ka intezaar na karte hue..." un alfaazon tak "...Allah sach se nahi hichkichaata."

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I did not see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) giving a wedding feast (on the marriage) of any one (of his wives) as he did in the case of (his marriage with) Zainab, for then he sacrificed a goat (on this occasion).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kisi zauja ki shaadi par aisa Waleema karte nahi dekha jaisa unhone Zainab ki shaadi ke mauqe par kiya, kyunki tab unhone ek bakri qurbaan ki thi.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave no better wedding feast than the one he did (on the occasion of his marriage with) Zainab. Thabit al-Bunani (one of the narrators) said: What did he serve in the wedding feast? He (Anas) said: He fed them bread and meat (so lavishly) that they (the guests) abandoned it (of their own accord after having taken them to their hearts' content).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi Zainab ki shaadi ke mauqe par kiye gaye se behtar Waleema nahi diya. Thabit al-Bunani, ek raawi, ne kaha: Unhone Waleema mein kya pesh kiya? Unhone kaha: Unhone unhe roti aur gosht itna khilaaya ki woh mehmaan khud, santusht hokar, use chhod dete.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married Zainab bint jahsh, he invited people (to the wedding feast) and they ate food. They then sat there and entered into conversation. He (the Holy Prophet) made a stir as if he was preparing to stand up, but (the persons busy in talking) did not stand up. When he (the Holy Prophet) saw it, he stood up and when he did so, some other persons stood up. 'Asim and Abd al-A'la in their narrations made this addition: Three (persons) sat there, and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came there to enter (the apartment) but he found the people sitting there. Then they stood up and went away. He said: Then I came and informed Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that they had gone away. He (the Holy Prophet) then came there until he entered (the apartment). I also went and was about to enter, when he hung a curtain between me and him (and it was on this occasion that) Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed this verse:" O you who believe, enter not the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, not waiting for its cooking being finished to the (words)" Surely this is serious in the sight of Allah" (xxxiii. 53).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab bint Jahsh se shaadi ki, unhone logon ko Waleema ke liye bulaaya aur unhone khaana khaya. Woh phir wahan baithe aur baatcheet mein daakhil huye. Unhone aisi harkat ki jaise woh khade hone ki taiyaari kar rahe hon, lekin baatcheet mein masroof log khade nahi huye. Jab unhone ye dekha, woh khade huye aur jab unhone aisa kiya, kuch doosre log khade huye. Asim aur Abd al-A'la ne apni riwayaton mein ye izafa kiya: Teen log wahan baithe rahe, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye kamre mein daakhil hone ke liye lekin unhone paaya ki log wahan baithe hain. Phir woh khade hue aur chale gaye. Raawi ne kaha: Phir main aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataaya ki woh chale gaye hain. Unhone phir wahan aakar kamre mein daakhil huye. Main bhi gaya aur daakhil hone hi wala tha, jab unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda latka diya, aur isi mauqe par Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Aye imaan waalo, Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak tumhe khaane ke liye ijazat na di jaaye, khaana pakne ka intezaar na karte hue" un alfaazon tak "Yaqeenan ye Allah ki nazar mein sangin baat hai" (33:53).

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was the best informed among the people pertaining to Hijab (veil and seclusion). Ubayy b. Ka'b used to ask me about it. Anas (Allah be pleased with him) thus narrated: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up in the morning as a bridegroom of Zainab bint jahsh (Allah be pleased witt her) as he had married her at Medina. He invited people to the wedding feast after the day had well risen. There sat Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there kept sitting along with him some persons after the people had stood up (for departure) ; then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and walked on and I also walked along with him until he reached the door of the apartment of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her). He then thought that they (those who had been sitting there after meal) had gone away. So he returned and I also returned with him, but they were still sitting at their places. So he returned for the second time and I also returned until he reached the apartment of 'A'isha. He again returned and I also returned and they had (by that time) stood up, and he hung a curtain between me and him (at the door of the apartment of Hadrat Zainab, where he had to stay), and Allah revealed the verse pertaining to veil.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main logon mein Hijab, parda aur alag-thalag, ke baare mein sabse zyada jaankaari rakhne wala tha. Ubayy bin Ka'b iske baare mein mujhse poochha karte the. Anas (RA) ne is tarah riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah ko Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ke dulha ke soorat mein utthe kyunki unhone Madina mein unse shaadi ki thi. Unhone logon ko Waleema ke liye bulaaya din achhi tarah nikalne ke baad. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan baithe rahe aur unke saath kuch log baithe rahe logon ke khade hone, rawaana hone ke liye, ke baad; phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur chal diye aur main bhi unke saath chala yahan tak ki woh Aisha (RA) ke kamre ke darwaze tak pahunche. Unhone phir socha ki woh chale gaye honge. To woh wapas gaye aur main bhi unke saath wapas gaya, lekin woh abhi bhi apni jagahon par baithe the. To woh doosri baar wapas gaye aur main bhi wapas gaya yahan tak ki woh Aisha ke kamre tak pahunche. Woh phir wapas gaye aur main bhi wapas gaya aur woh us waqt tak khade ho chuke the, aur unhone mere aur apne beech ek parda latka diya, Hazrat Zainab ke kamre ke darwaze par, jahan unhe rukna tha, aur Allah ne parde se mutalliq aayat nazil ki.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted marriage and he went to his wife. My mother Umm Sulaim prepared hais and placed it in an earthen vessel and said: Anas, take it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and say: My mother has sent that to you and she offers greetings to you, and says that it is a humble gift for you on our behalf, Messenger of Allah. So I went along with it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: My mother offers you salutations, and says that it is a humble gift for you on our behalf. He said: Place it here, and then said: Go and invite on my behalf so and so and anyone whom you meet, and he even named some persons. He (Anas) said: I invited whom he had named and whom I met. I (one of the narrators) said: I said to Anas: How many (persons) were there? He (Anas) said: They were about three hundred persons. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (said to me): Anas, bring that earthen vessel. They (the guests) then began to enter until the courtyard and the apartment were fully packed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Make a circle of ten (guests), and every person should eat from that nearest to him. They began to eat, until they ate to their fill. A group went out (after eating the food), and another group came in until all of them had eaten. He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Anas, lift it (the earthen vessel), so I lifted it, but I could not assess whether it had more (food) when I placed it (before Allah's Messenger) or when I lifted it (after the people had been served out of it). A group among them (the guests) began to talk in the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting and his wife had been sitting with her face turned towards the wall. It was troublesome for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and greeted his wives. He then returned. When they (the guests) saw that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had returned they thought that it (their overstay) was something troublesome for him. He (the narrator) said: They hastened towards the door and all of them went out. And there came Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he hung a curtain and went in, and I was sitting in his apartment and he did not stay but for a short while. He then came to me and these verses were revealed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and recited them to the people:" O you who believe, enter not the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, not waiting for its cooking being finished-but when you are invited, enter, and when you have taken food, disperse not seeking to listen to talk. Surely this gives the Prophet trouble", to the end of verse (xxxiii. 53). (Al-Ja'd said that Anas  stated: I am the first amongst the people to hear these verses), and henceforth the wives of the Apostle (ﷺ) began to observe seclusion (al-hijab).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne shaadi ki aur woh apni zauja ke paas gaye. Meri maa Umm Sulaim ne hais taiyaar ki aur use ek mitti ke bartan mein rakha aur kaha: Anas, ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le jaao aur kaho: Meri maa ne ye aapko bheja hai aur woh aapko salaam kehti hain, aur kehti hain ki ye humari taraf se aapke liye ek chhota sa tohfa hai, Allah ke Rasool. To main ise lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Meri maa aapko salaam kehti hain, aur kehti hain ki ye humari taraf se aapke liye ek chhota sa tohfa hai. Unhone kaha: Ise yahan rakh do, aur phir kaha: Jao aur mere taraf se falan-falan aur jise bhi tum milo unhe bulaao, aur unhone kuch logon ke naam bhi liye. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe bulaaya jinka naam unhone liya tha aur jinse main mila. Ek raawi ne kaha: Maine Anas se kaha: Kitne log wahan the? Unhone kaha: Woh taqreeban teen sau log the. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Anas, woh mitti ka bartan laao. Woh mehmaan phir daakhil hone lage yahan tak ki aangan aur kamra poori tarah bhar gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Das ka ek chakkar banaao, aur har shakhs ko apne najdeek se khaana chahiye. Woh khaane lage, yahan tak ki woh santusht ho gaye. Ek giroh khaana khaane ke baad bahar gaya, aur ek doosra giroh andar aaya yahan tak ki sabne khaana khaya. Unhone mujhse kaha: Anas, ise, mitti ke bartan ko, uthaao, is liye maine ise uthaaya, lekin main andaaza nahi laga saka ki ismein zyada khaana tha jab maine ise rakha tha, Allah ke Rasool ke saamne, ya jab maine ise uthaaya, logon ko usmein se khaana serve karne ke baad. Ek giroh unmein se, mehmaanon mein se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar mein baat karne laga aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe the aur unki zauja apna chehra deewaar ki taraf mode baithi thin. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye pareshaani ki baat thi, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar gaye aur apni zaujaon ko salaam kiya. Woh phir wapas aaye. Jab woh mehmaan ye dekhte ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wapas aa gaye hain unhe laga ki ye unka der tak rukna unke liye kuch pareshaani ki baat thi. Raawi ne kaha: Woh darwaze ki taraf jaldi karne lage aur sab bahar chale gaye. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur unhone parda latka diya aur andar chale gaye, aur main unke kamre mein baitha tha aur woh sirf thodi der ke liye ruke. Woh phir mere paas aaye aur ye aayaten nazil huyin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar aaye aur unhe logon ke saamne padha: "Aye imaan waalo, Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak tumhe khaane ke liye ijazat na di jaaye, khaana pakne ka intezaar na karte hue - lekin jab tumhe bulaaya jaaye, daakhil ho, aur jab tum khaana kha lo, chale jaao, baaton mein masroof rehne ki koshish na karte hue. Yaqeenan ye Nabi ke liye pareshaani ki baat hai" aayat 33:53 ke akhir tak. Al-Jad ne kaha ki Anas ne bataaya: Main is aayat ko sunne wala pehla shakhs hoon, aur isi ke baad se Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ne parda, al-hijab, rakhna shuru kiya.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) contracted marriage with Zainab (Allah be pleased with bet), Umm Sulaim sent him hats in a vessel of stone as a gift. Anas stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Go and invite on my behalf all the Muslims whom you meet. So I invited on his behalf everyone whom I met. They entered (his house) and they ate and went out. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had kept his hand on the food, and he invoked blessing on that, and said whatever Allah wished him to say, and none whom I met was left uninvited. They ate to their fill and went out, but a group among them remained there and was engaged in lengthy discussion. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) felt shy of saying them anything. So he went out and left them in his house and Allah the Great and Majestic revealed this verse:" 0 you who believe, enter not the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, not waiting for its cooking being finished." Qatada (instead of using the word Ghaira Nazirina) used the word Ghaira Mutahayyinina (i. e. not waiting for the time of the food). But when you are invited, enter..." up to this verse. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zainab (RA) se shaadi ki, Umm Sulaim ne unhe hais ek patthar ke bartan mein tohfe ke taur par bheji. Anas ne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Jao aur mere taraf se sab Musalmaanon ko bulaao jinse tum milte ho. To maine unke taraf se har us shakhs ko bulaaya jisse main mila. Woh unke ghar daakhil huye aur unhone khaana khaya aur bahar chale gaye. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath khaane par rakha, aur uske liye barkat ki dua ki, aur jo bhi Allah unse kehna chaahta woh kaha, aur koi bhi jisse main mila woh bina bulaaye nahi chhoda gaya. Woh santusht hokar khaake bahar chale gaye, lekin unmein se ek giroh wahan reh gaya aur lambi baatcheet mein masroof ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unse kuch kehne mein sharam mehsoos hui. To woh bahar gaye aur unhe apne ghar mein chhod diya aur Allah, jo Azeem-o-Buland hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Aye imaan waalo, Nabi ke gharon mein daakhil mat ho jab tak tumhe khaane ke liye ijazat na di jaaye, khaana pakne ka intezaar na karte hue." Qatada ne, lafz Ghaira Nazirina ki jagah, Ghaira Mutahayyinina lafz istemal kiya, yaani, khaane ke waqt ka intezaar na karte hue. "Lekin jab tumhe bulaaya jaaye, daakhil ho..." is aayat tak. "Ye tumhare dilon aur unke dilon ke liye zyada shudh hai."

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When any one of you is invited to a feast, he should attend it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum mein se koi Waleema mein bulaaya jaaye, use wahan haazir hona chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you is invited to a feast, he should accept. 'Ubaidallah took this feast to be a wedding feast.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi daawat mein bulaaya jaaye, use qubool karna chahiye. Ubaidullah ne is daawat ko Waleema samjha.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased withthem) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said this: When any one of you is invited to a wedding feast, he should accept that.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi Waleema mein bulaaya jaaye, use qubool karna chahiye.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may be upon him) having said this: Accept the feast, when you are invited.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Daawat qubool karo, jab tumhe bulaaya jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you invites his brother, he (the latter) should accept his wedding feast, or any other like it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ko bulaaye, use, jane wale ko, uska Waleema, ya usi jaisi koi doosri daawat, qubool karni chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleated with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who is invited to a wedding feast or like it, he should accept it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jise Waleema ya usi jaisi kisi cheez mein bulaaya jaaye, use ise qubool karna chahiye.

e: " Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messen- ger (ﷺ) as saying: Come to the feast, when you are invited.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Daawat mein aao, jab tumhe bulaaya jaaye.

e: Nafil reported: I heard Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) narrating that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Accept the feast when you are invited to it. And Abdullah (b. Umar) used to come to the feast, whether it was a wedding feast or other than that, and he would come there even in the state of fasting.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ko ye riwayat karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Daawat qubool karo jab tumhe usmein bulaaya jaaye. Aur Abdullah, bin Umar, daawat mein aaya karte the, chahe woh Waleema ho ya kuch aur, aur woh wahan aate the chahe woh roze mein hote.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: When you are invited to a feast (even though it is) the leg of the sheep, you should accept it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tumhe daawat mein bulaaya jaaye, chahe woh bakri ki taang ho, tumhe use qubool karna chahiye.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: When any one of you is invited to a feast, he should accept it. He may eat if he likes, or he may abandon (eating) if he likes. Ibn Mathanni did not make mention of the word" feast".
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum mein se koi daawat mein bulaaya jaaye, use qubool karna chahiye. Woh chahe to khaa sakta hai, ya chahe to na khaaye. Ibn Mathanni ne "daawat" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abd Zubair with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abd Zubair ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Haraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any one of you is invited, he should accept (the invitation). In case he is fasting, he should pray (in order to bless the inmates of the house), and if he is not fasting he should eat.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum mein se koi bulaaya jaaye, use qubool karna chahiye. Agar woh roze mein hai, to use dua karni chahiye, ghar walon ko barkat dene ke liye, aur agar woh roze mein nahi hai, to use khaana chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) used to say: The worst kind of food is the wedding feast to which the rich are invited and the poor are ignored. He who does not come to the feast, he in fact disobeys Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ye kaha karte the: Sabse bura khaana Waleema ka hota hai jismein daulatmandon ko bulaaya jaata hai aur gareebon ko nazarandaaz kiya jaata hai. Jo daawat mein nahi aata, woh dar-asal Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani karta hai.

e: Sufyan reported: I said to Zuhri: Abu Bakr, what does this hadith mean:" The worst kind of food is at a wedding feast of the rich"? He laughed and said: The food served in the feast given by the rich is not worst (in itself). Sufyan said: My father was rich, so I felt disturbed when I heard this hadith, so I asked Zuhri who said: I heard from 'Abd al-Rahman al-Alraj that he heard Abu Huraira (Allah he pleased with him) say: The worst kind of food is that served at the wedding feast. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Sufyan ne bayan kiya: Maine Zuhri se kaha: Abu Bakr, is hadees ka kya matlab hai: "Sabse bura khaana daulatmandon ke Waleema mein hota hai"? Woh muskuraaye aur kaha: Daulatmandon ki di gayi daawat mein serve kiya gaya khaana khud bura nahi hota. Sufyan ne kaha: Mere waalid daulatmand the, is liye jab maine ye hadees suni to main pareshaan ho gaya, is liye maine Zuhri se poocha jinhone kaha: Maine Abd al-Rahman al-Alraj se suna ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse bura khaana woh hai jo Waleema mein serve kiya jaata hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e:
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.

A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Haraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying. The worst kind of food is at the wedding feast from which one who comes is turned away, and he who refuses it is invited, and he who did not accept the invitation disobeyed Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse bura khaana Waleema mein hota hai jismein aane wale ko rok diya jaata hai, aur jo isse inkaar karta hai use bulaaya jaata hai, aur jo daawat qubool nahi karta usne Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki.

e: 'A'isha (Allah he pleased with her) reported: There came the wife of Rifa'a to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I was married to Rifa'a but he divorced me, making may divorce irrevocable. Afterwards I married Abd al-Rahman b. al-Zubair, but all he possesses is like the fringe of a garment (i. e. he is sexually weak). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled, and said: Do you wish to return to Rifa'a. (You) cannot (do it) until you have tasted his sweetness and he ('Abd al-Rahman) has tasted your sweetness. Abu Bakr was at that time near him (the Holy Prophet) and Khalid (b. Sa'id) was at the door waiting for the permission to be granted to him to enter), He (Khalid) said; Abu Bakr, do you hear what she is saying loudly in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rifa'a ki zauja Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri shaadi Rifa'a se hui thi lekin unhone mujhe talaaq de di, meri talaaq ko naa-qabil-e-rujoo banate hue. Baad mein maine Abd al-Rahman bin al-Zubair se shaadi ki, lekin unke paas jo kuch hai woh ek kapde ke kinaare jaisa hai, yaani woh jinsi taur par kamzor hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye, aur kaha: Kya tum Rifa'a ke paas laut na chaahti ho? Tum aisa tab tak nahi kar sakti jab tak tumne uski meethaas na chakhi ho aur usne, Abd al-Rahman ne, tumhari meethaas na chakhi ho. Abu Bakr us waqt unke paas the aur Khalid (bin Sa'id) darwaze par khade the ijazat ka intezaar karte hue kamre mein daakhil hone ke liye. Unhone, Khalid ne, kaha: Abu Bakr, kya aap sun rahe hain jo woh zor se keh rahi hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein?

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Rifa'a al-Quraid (Allah be pleased with him) divorced his wife, making her divorce irrevocable. Afterwards she married Abd at-Rahman b. al-Zubair (Allah be pleased with him), She came to Allah'sApostle (may peace be upon him and said to Allah's messenger (ﷺ) that she had been the wife of Rifa'a (Allah be pleased with him) and he had divorced her by three pronouncements and afterwards she married 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Zubair. By Allah, all he possesses is like the fringe of a garment, and she took hold of the fringe of her garment. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughed and said: Perhaps you wish to return to Rifa'a, (but you) cannot (do it) until he has tasted your sweetness and you have tasted his sweetness. Abu Bakr al-siddiq (Allah be pleased with him) was sitting at that time with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Khalid b. Sa'id b. al-'As (Allah be pleased with him) was sitting at the door of his apartment and he was not permitted to (enter the room), and Kbalid called loudly saying: Abu Bakr, why don't you scold her for what she is saying loudly in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Rifa'a al-Quraid (RA) ne apni biwi ko talaaq di, unki talaaq ko naa-qabil-e-rujoo banate hue. Baad mein unhone Abd al-Rahman bin al-Zubair (RA) se shaadi ki. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha ki woh Rifa'a (RA) ki zauja thi aur unhone use teen talaaqein di thin aur baad mein unhone Abd al-Rahman bin al-Zubair se shaadi ki. Allah ki qasam, unke paas jo kuch hai woh ek kapde ke kinaare jaisa hai, aur unhone apne kapde ka kinaara pakad liya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hanse aur kaha: Shayad tum Rifa'a ke paas laut na chaahti ho, lekin tum aisa tab tak nahi kar sakti jab tak usne tumhari meethaas na chakhi ho aur tumne uski meethaas na chakhi ho. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq (RA) us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the aur Khalid bin Sa'id bin al-As (RA) unke kamre ke darwaze par baithe the aur unhe kamre mein daakhil hone ki ijazat nahi thi, aur Khalid ne zor se kaha: Abu Bakr, aap use kyun nahi daantte jo woh zor se keh rahi hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein?

e: `A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Rifa`a al Qurazi divorced his wife and afterwards `Abd al-Rahman b. al-Zubair married her. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, Rifa`a has divorced me by three pronouncements. (The rest of the hadith is the same.)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Rifa'a al-Qurazi ne apni biwi ko talaaq di aur baad mein Abd al-Rahman bin al-Zubair ne unse shaadi ki. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Rifa'a ne mujhe teen talaaqein di hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about a woman whom a man married and then divorced her, and then she married (another) person, and she was divorced before sexual intercourse with her, whether it was lawful for her first husband (to marry her in this state). He (the Holy Prophet) said: No, until he has tasted her sweetness.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jise ek shakhs ne shaadi kiya aur phir talaaq di, aur phir usne ek doosre shakhs se shaadi ki, aur jinsi milaap se pehle hi usne use talaaq de di, kya ye uske pehle shohar ke liye jaayez hai (ki woh isi haalat mein usse dobara shaadi kare). Unhone kaha: Nahi, jab tak usne uski meethaas na chakhi ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'Asha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: A person divorced his wife by three pronouncements; then another person married her and he also divorced her without having sexual intercourse with her. Then the first husband of her intended to remarry her. It was about such a case that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, whereupon he said: No, until the second one has tasted her sweetness as the first one had tasted.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne apni biwi ko teen talaaqein dein; phir ek doosre shakhs ne unse shaadi ki aur unhone bhi unse jinsi milaap kiye bina unhe talaaq di. Phir unke pehle shohar ne unse dobara shaadi karne ka iraada kiya. Isi tarah ke maamle ke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Nahi, jab tak doosre ne bhi uski meethaas na chakhi ho jaisa pehle ne chakhi thi.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the same chain of transmitters by 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se Aisha (RA) ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn" Abbas (Allah be pleased with thern) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If anyone amongst you intends to go to his wife he should say: In the name of Allah,0 Allah protect us against Satan and keep away the Satan from the one that you have bestowed upon us, and if He has ordained a male child for them, Satan will never be able to do any harm to him.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi apni zauja ke paas jaane ka iraada kare use kehna chahiye: Allah ke naam se, Aye Allah, humein Shaitaan se bacha aur Shaitaan ko us cheez se door rakh jo Tune humein di hai, aur agar Usne unke liye ek larke ko muqarrar kiya hai, to Shaitaan use kabhi nuksaan nahi pahuncha payega.

e: This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters and there is no mention of (the words)" Bismillah" (In the name of Allah) in it.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein "Bismillah", Allah ke naam se, alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) declared that the Jews used to say: When a man has intercourse with his wife through the vagina but being on her back. the child will have squint, so the verse came down:" Your wives are your tilth; go then unto your tilth as you may desire" (ii. 223)
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bataaya ki Yahudi kaha karte the: Jab koi aadmi apni zauja se yoni ke raaste jinsi milaap karta hai lekin peeth ki taraf se, to bachcha bhengaapan lekar paida hoga, is liye ye aayat nazil hui: "Tumhari zaujaen tumhari khetiyaan hain; is liye apni khetiyon mein jaao jaise tum chaho" (2:223).

e: Jabir (b. Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Jews used to say that when one comes to one's wife through the vagina, but being on her back, and she becomes pregnant, the child has a squint. So the verse came down: " Your wives are your ti'Ith; go then unto your tilth, as you may desire."
hi: Jabir, bin Abdullah, (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Yahudi kaha karte the ki jab koi apni zauja ke paas yoni ke raaste aata hai, lekin peeth ki taraf se, aur woh garbhvati ho jaati hai, to bachcha bhengaapan lekar paida hota hai. To ye aayat nazil hui: "Tumhari zaujaen tumhari khetiyaan hain; is liye apni khetiyon mein jaao, jaise tum chaho."

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters, but in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhri there is an addition (of these words): " If he likes he may (have intercourse) being on the back or in front of her, but it should be through one opening (vagina)."
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein ek izafa hai, in alfaazon ka: "Agar woh chaahe to woh peeth ki taraf se ya saamne se jinsi milaap kar sakta hai, lekin ye ek hi raaste, yoni, se hona chahiye."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: When a woman spends the night away from the bed of her husband, the angels curse her until morning.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab koi aurat apne shohar ke bistar se door raat guzaarti hai, to farishte subah tak use laanat dete hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated through the same chain of transmitters (with a slight variation): " He said: Until she comes back."
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, alfaazon ki halki tabdeeli ke saath: "Unhone kaha: Jab tak woh laut na aaye."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, when a man calls his wife to his bed, and she does not respond, the One Who is in the heaven is displeased with her until he (her husband) is pleased with her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, jab ek aadmi apni zauja ko apne bistar par bulaaye, aur woh na aaye, to Woh jo aasmaan mein hai unse naaraaz rehta hai jab tak woh, uska shohar, unse khush na ho jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah he pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) as saying: When a man invites his wife to his bed and she does not come, and he (the husband) spends the sight being angry with her, the angels curse her until morning.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi aadmi apni zauja ko apne bistar par bulaaye aur woh na aaye, aur woh, shohar, us raat unse naaraaz hokar guzaare, to farishte subah tak use laanat dete hain.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah he pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoin him) said: The most wicked among the people in the eye of Allah on the Day of judgment is the men who goes to his wife and she comes to him, and then he divulges her secret.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki nazar mein Qayamat ke din sabse buray log woh hain jo apni zauja ke paas jaate hain aur woh unke paas aati hai, aur phir woh uska raaz zaahir kar deta hai.

e: Abu Sirma al-Khudri (Allah he pleased with him ) reported Allah's Messen- ger (ﷺ) as saying: The most important of the trusts in the sight of Allah on the Day of judgment is that a man goes to his wife and she goes to him (and the breach of this trust is) that he should divulge her secret Ibn Numair narrates this hadith with a slight change of wording.
hi: Abu Sirma al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ki nazar mein Qayamat ke din sabse ahem amaanaton mein se ye hai ki ek aadmi apni zauja ke paas jaaye aur woh uske paas jaaye, aur is amaanat ki bharti ye hai ki woh uska raaz zaahir kare. Ibn Numair ne ye hadees alfaazon ki halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Sirma said to Abu Sa'id al Khadri (Allah he pleased with him): 0 Abu Sa'id, did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioning al-'azl? He said: Yes, and added: We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the expedition to the Bi'l-Mustaliq and took captive some excellent Arab women; and we desired them, for we were suffering from the absence of our wives, (but at the same time) we also desired ransom for them. So we decided to have sexual intercourse with them but by observing 'azl (Withdrawing the male sexual organ before emission of semen to avoid-conception). But we said: We are doing an act whereas Allah's Messenger is amongst us; why not ask him? So we asked Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ), and he said: It does not matter if you do not do it, for every soul that is to be born up to the Day of Resurrection will be born.
hi: Abu Sirma ne Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) se kaha: Aye Abu Sa'id, kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko al-azl ka zikr karte suna? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur izafa kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Banu al-Mustaliq ki muhim par nikle aur kuch behtareen Arab auraton ko qaid kar liya; aur humne unhe chaaha, kyunki hum apni zaujaon ki gairmaujoodgi se pareshaan the, lekin saath hi hum unke liye fidya bhi chaahte the. To humne unke saath jinsi milaap karne ka faisla kiya lekin azl karte hue, mani nikalne se pehle mardana aza ko bahar nikaal lena garbh se bachne ke liye. Lekin humne kaha: Hum ye amal kar rahe hain jabki Allah ke Rasool humare beech hain; kyun na unse poochhein? To humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha, aur unhone kaha: Isse koi farq nahi padta agar tum aisa na karo, kyunki har rooh jo Qayamat ke din tak paida honi hai woh zaroor paida hogi.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Habban with the same chain of transmitters (but with this alteration) that he said: " Allah has ordained whom he has to createuntil the Day of judgment."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Habban ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone kaha: "Allah ne muqarrar kar rakha hai ki usne kise banaana hai Qayamat ke din tak."

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We took women captives, and we wanted to do 'azl with them. We then asked Allah's Messen- ger (ﷺ) about it, and he said to us: Verily you do it, verily you do it, verily you do it, but the soul which has to be born until the Day of judg- ment must be born.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humne auraton ko qaid kiya, aur hum unke saath azl karna chaahte the. Humne phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone humse kaha: Yaqeenan tum aisa karte ho, yaqeenan tum aisa karte ho, yaqeenan tum aisa karte ho, lekin jis rooh ko Qayamat ke din tak paida hona hai woh zaroor paida hogi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) (was asked if he had heard it himself), to which he said: Yes. (I heard) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There is no harm if you do not practise it, for it (the birth of the child) is something ordained (by Allah).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA), unse poocha gaya ki kya unhone ise khud suna tha, unhone kaha: Haan. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Isme koi harj nahi hai agar tum aisa na karo, kyunki ye, bachche ka paidaish, kuch aisa hai jo Allah ne muqarrar kar rakha hai.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Abu Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation (of words).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was asked about 'azl, whereupon he said: There is no harm if you do not do that, for it (the birth of the child) is something ordained. Muhammad (one of the narrators) said: (The words) La 'alaykum (there is no harm) implies its Prohibition.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se azl ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Isme koi harj nahi hai agar tum aisa na karo, kyunki ye, bachche ka paidaish, kuch aisa hai jo muqarrar hai. Muhammad, ek raawi, ne kaha: Alfaaz "La alaykum", isme koi harj nahi, iska matlab hai iski mumaaniyat.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that mention was made of 'azl in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) whereupon he said: Why do you practise it? They said: There is a man whose wife has to suckle the child, and if that person has a sexual intercourse with her (she may conceive) which he does not like, and there is another person who has a slave-girl and he has a sexual intercourse with her, but he does not like her to have conception so that she may not become Umm Walad, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: There is no harm if you do not do that, for that (the birth of the child) is something pre- ordained. Ibn 'Aun said: I made a mention of this hadith to Hasan, and he said: By Allah, (it seems) as if there is upbraiding in it (for 'azl).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein azl ka zikr kiya gaya, isper unhone kaha: Tum ise kyun karte ho? Unhone kaha: Ek shakhs hai jiski zauja ko bachche ko doodh pilaana hota hai, aur agar us shakhs ne unse jinsi milaap kiya, to woh garbhvati ho sakti hai jise woh napasand karta hai, aur ek doosra shakhs hai jiske paas ek laundi hai aur woh usse jinsi milaap karta hai, lekin woh nahi chahta ki woh garbhvati ho taaki woh Umm Walad na ban jaaye, isper unhone kaha: Isme koi harj nahi hai agar tum aisa na karo, kyunki ye, bachche ka paidaish, kuch aisa hai jo pehle se muqarrar hai. Ibn Aun ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Hasan ko batayi, aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, aisa lagta hai jaise ismein azl ke liye malaamat hai.

e: Ibn 'Aun reported: I reported to Muhammad on the authority of Ibrahim the hadith reported by 'Abd al-Rahmann b. Bishr (the hadith concerning 'azl), where- upon he said: That (hadith) Abd al-Rahman b. Bishr had narrated to me (also).
hi: Ibn Aun ne bayan kiya: Maine Muhammad ko Ibrahim ke hawale se woh hadees batayi jo Abd al-Rahman bin Bishr ne riwayat ki thi, azl se mutalliq hadees, isper unhone kaha: Woh hadees Abd al-Rahman bin Bishr ne mujhe bhi riwayat ki thi.

e: Ma'bad b. Sirin said to Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him): Did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) making a mention of something in regard to al-'azl? Thereupon he said: Yes. The rest (of the hadith is the same)
hi: Ma'bad bin Sirin ne Abu Sa'id (RA) se kaha: Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko al-azl ke baare mein kuch kehte suna? Isper unhone kaha: Haan. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Mention was made about al-'azl in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Why any one of you practises it? (He did not say: One of you should not do it), for there is no created soul, whose creator is not Allah.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Al-azl ka zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein kiya gaya, isper unhone kaha: Tum mein se koi ise kyun karta hai? Unhone ye nahi kaha: Tum mein se kisi ko ye nahi karna chahiye, kyunki koi bhi paida ki gayi rooh nahi hai jiska paida karne wala Allah na ho.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about 'azl, whereupon he said: The child does not come from all the liquid (sermen) and when Allah intends to create anything nothing can prevent it (from coming into existence).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se azl ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Bachcha saare virya se nahi aata, aur jab Allah kisi cheez ko banaane ka iraada karta hai to kuch bhi use rok nahi sakta ise wajood mein aane se.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Abu Sa'id from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Sa'id ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have a slave-girl who is our servant and she carries water for us and I have intercourse with her, but I do not want her to conceive. He said: Practise 'azl, if you so like, but what is decreed for her will come to her. The person stayed back (for some time) and then came and said: The girl has become pregnant, whereupon he said: I told you what was decreed for her would come to her.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Mere paas ek laundi hai jo hamari naukar hai aur woh humare liye paani laati hai aur main uske saath jinsi milaap karta hoon, lekin main nahi chahta ki woh garbhvati ho. Unhone kaha: Azl karo, agar tum aisa chaho, lekin jo uske liye muqarrar hai woh use zaroor milega. Woh shakhs ruk gaya aur phir aaya aur kaha: Laundi garbhvati ho gayi hai, isper unhone kaha: Maine tumhe bataaya tha ki jo uske liye muqarrar tha woh use milta.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying: I have a slave-girl and I practise 'azl with her, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This cannot prevent that which Allah has decreed. The person then came (after some time) and said: Messenger of Allah, the slave-girl about whom I talked to you has conceived, whereupon Allah's Messeuger (ﷺ) said: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Mere paas ek laundi hai aur main uske saath azl karta hoon, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye us cheez ko nahi rok sakta jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai. Woh shakhs phir aaya, kuch waqt baad, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh laundi jiske baare mein maine aapse baat ki thi woh garbhvati ho gayi hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main Allah ka aur uske Rasool ka banda hoon.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: A person came to Allah's Apostle (the rest of the hadith is the same).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We used to practise 'azl while the Qur'an was revealed (during the days when the Prophet was alive).
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum azl kiya karte the jabki Quran nazil ho raha tha, Nabi ke zindagi kaal ke dinon mein.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We used to practise 'azl during the life of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum azl kiya karte the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We used to practise 'azl during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). This (the news of this practise) reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he did not forbid us.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum azl kiya karte the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Ye, is amal ki khabar, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi, aur unhone humein mana nahi kiya.

e: Abu Darda' (Allah be pleased with him) related from the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) that he came upon a woman who was in the advanced stage of pregnancy at the door of a tent. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Perhaps he (the man accompanying her) intends to cohabit with her. They said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I have decided to curse him with such a curse as may go along with him to his grave. How can he own him (the child to be born) and that is not lawful for him, and how can he take him as a servant for that is not lawful for him?
hi: Abu Darda (RA) ne Nabi Allah ke (SAW) se riwayat ki ki woh ek aurat ke paas aaye jo garbhaavastha ke agle daur mein thi ek tambu ke darwaze par. Unhone kaha: Shayad woh, uske saath aaya aadmi, uske saath jinsi talluq banaane ka iraada rakhta hai. Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maine faisla kiya hai ki main use aisi laanat dun jo uski qabr tak uske saath jaaye. Woh use, is paida hone waale bachche ko, kaise apna maan sakta hai jabki ye uske liye jaayez nahi hai, aur woh use naukar ke taur par kaise le sakta hai jabki ye bhi uske liye jaayez nahi hai?

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Judaima daughter of Wahb al-Asadiyya (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assaying: I intended to prohibit cohabitation with a suckling woman until I considered that the Romans and the Persians do it without any injury being caused to their children thereby. (Imam Muslim said: Khalaf reported it from Judamat al-'Asadiyya, but the correct wording is what has been stated by Yahya.)
hi: Judaima, Wahb al-Asadiyya ki beti, (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine doodh pilaane waali aurat ke saath jinsi milaap ko mana karne ka iraada kiya tha yahan tak ki maine dekha ki Rome aur Iran ke log aisa karte hain bina apne bacchon ko koi nuksaan pahunchaaye. Imam Muslim ne kaha ki Khalaf ne ise Judamat al-Asadiyya se riwayat kiya, lekin sahi alfaaz woh hain jo Yahya ne bataaye.

e: Judama daughter of Wahb, sister of Ukkasha (Allah be pleased with her). reported: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with some persons and he was saying: I intended to prohibit cohabitation with the suckling women, but I considered the Greeks and Persians, and saw that they suckle their children and this thing (cohabitation) does not do any harm to them (to the suckling women). Then they asked him about 'azl, whereupon he said. That is the secret (way of) burying alive, and Ubaidullah has made this addition in the hadith transmitted by al-Muqri and that is:" When the one buried alive is asked."
hi: Judama, Wahb ki beti, Ukkasha ki behn, (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch logon ke saath gayi aur woh keh rahe the: Maine doodh pilaane waali auraton ke saath jinsi milaap ko mana karne ka iraada kiya tha, lekin maine Greek aur Iran ke logon ko dekha, aur paaya ki woh apne bacchon ko doodh pilaate hain aur ye cheez, jinsi milaap, unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaati, doodh pilaane waali auraton ko. Phir unhone unse azl ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ye chhupi hui zinda dafan karne wali tarkeeb hai, aur Ubaidullah ne al-Muqri ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ye izafa kiya hai: "Jab zinda dafan kiye gaye se poocha jaayega."

e: Judama bint Wahb al-Asadiyya (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying this. The rest of the hadith is the same concerning 'azl and ghila (cohabitating with a suckling woman), but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Judama bint Wahb al-Asadiyya (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai azl aur ghila, doodh pilaane waali aurat ke saath jinsi milaap, ke baare mein, lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I do 'azi with my wife. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why do you do that? The person said: I fear harm to her child or her children. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: If that were harmful it would harm the Persians and the Greeks.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main apni zauja ke saath azl karta hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum aisa kyun karte ho? Us shakhs ne kaha: Mujhe uske bachche ya bacchon ke liye nuksaan ka dar hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar ye nuksaandeh hota to ye Iran aur Greek ke logon ko nuksaan pahunchaata.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported tha Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with her and she heard the voice of a person seeking permission to enter the house of Hafsa. 'A'isha (Allah he pleased with her) said: Allah's Messenger, he is the person who seeks permission to enter your house, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I think he is so and so (uncle of Hafsa by reason of fosterage). 'A'isha said: Messenger of Allah, if so and so (her uncle by reason of fosterage) were alive, could he enter my house? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes. Fosterage makes unlawful what consanguinity makes unlawful.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath the aur unhone ek shakhs ki aawaaz suni jo Hafsa ke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat maang raha tha. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye woh shakhs hai jo aapke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat maang raha hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki woh falan-falan hain, Hafsa ke doodh-rishte ke chacha. Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar falan-falan, mere doodh-rishte ke chacha, zinda hote, kya woh mere ghar mein daakhil ho sakte? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan. Doodh-rishta wahi cheezein haraam karta hai jo khoon ka rishta haraam karta hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: "What becomes unlawful through breastfeeding is that which becomes unlawful through birth."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Jo doodh pilaane se haraam hota hai woh wahi hai jo paidaish se haraam hota hai."

e: The above hadith is narrated through another chain.
hi: Upar bataayi gayi hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Aflah, the brother of Abu'l-Qu'ais, who was her uncle by reason of fosterage, came, and asked her permission (to enter the house) after seclusion (Hijab) was instituted. I refused to admit him. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I informed him what I had done. He commanded me to grant him permission (as the brother of her foster-father was also her uncle).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Aflah, Abu'l-Qu'ais ke bhai, jo unke doodh-rishte ke chacha the, aaye aur unhone unse (ghar mein daakhil hone ki) ijazat maangi Hijab (parde) ki sthapana ke baad. Maine unhe daakhil hone se inkaar kar diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, maine unhe bataya jo maine kiya tha. Unhone mujhe hukum diya ki main unhe ijazat dun, kyunki doodh-rishte ke waalid ka bhai bhi uska chacha hota hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: There came to me Aflah b. Abu Qulais, my uncle by reason of fosterage; the rest of the hadith is the same (but with this) addition:" I ('A'isha) said (to the Holy Prophet): It was the woman who suckled me and not the man, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: May your hands or your right hand be besmeared with dust (you were mistaken)."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere paas Aflah bin Abu Qulais aaye, mere doodh-rishte ke chacha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Maine, Aisha ne, kaha: Ye ek aurat thi jisne mujhe doodh pilaaya, na ki mard, isper unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, kaha: Tumhare haath ya tumhare daaye haath mein mitti lag jaaye, tum galat thi."

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that there came Aflah the brother, of Abu'l-Qu'ais, who sought her permission (to enter) after seclusion was instituted, and AbuQu'ais was the father of 'A'isha by reason of fosterage. 'A'isha said: By Allah, I would not permit Aflah unless I have solicited the opinion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Abu Qulais has not suckled me, but his wife has given me suck. 'A'isha' (Allah be pleased with her) said: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered, I said: Allah's Messenger, Aflah is the brother of Abu'l-Qulais; he came to me to seek my permission for entering (the houst). I did not like the idea of granting him permission until I had solicited your opinion. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Grant him permission. 'Urwa said it was on account of this that 'A'isha used to say. What is unlawful by reason of consanguinity is unlawful by reason of fosterage.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Aflah, Abu'l-Qu'ais ke bhai, aaye jinhone unse ijazat maangi (daakhil hone ki) Hijab ki sthapana ke baad, aur Abu Qu'ais Aisha ke doodh-rishte ke waalid the.
