Aisha ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main Aflah ko ijazat nahi dungi jab tak main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki raay na le lun, kyunki Abu Qulais ne mujhe doodh nahi pilaaya, balki unki zauja ne mujhe doodh pilaaya hai. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) daakhil huye, maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Aflah, Abu'l-Qulais ke bhai hain; woh mere paas aaye mujhse daakhil hone ki ijazat maangne, mujhe unhe ijazat dene ka khayal pasand nahi aaya jab tak main aapki raay na le lun. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhe ijazat do. Urwa ne kaha ki isi wajah se Aisha kaha karti thin: Jo khoon ke rishte se haraam hai woh doodh ke rishte se haraam hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (that 'A'isha said): There came Aflah, the brother of Abu'l Qulais (Allah be pleased with him), and sought permission from her, the rest of the hadith is the same (except for the words that the Holy Prophet) said:" He is your uncle. Let your hand be besmeared with dust. Abu'l Qulais was the husband of the woman who had suckled 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her).
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aisha ne kaha: Aflah, Abu'l Qulais ke bhai, (RA) aaye aur unse ijazat maangi, baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay in alfaazon ke ki Nabi ne kaha: "Woh tumhare chacha hain. Tumhare haath par mitti lag jaaye. Abu'l Qulais us aurat ke shohar the jinhone Aisha (RA) ko doodh pilaaya tha."

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My foster uncle came to me and sought permission (to enter the house), but I refused him permission until I had solicited the opinion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I said to him: My foster-uncle sought my permission to (enter the house), but I did not permit him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You better admit your uncle (into the house). I ('A'isha) said: It was the woman who suckled me and not the man. (But he) said: He is your uncle, admit him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere doodh-rishte ke chacha mere paas aaye aur ijazat maangi, ghar mein daakhil hone ki, lekin maine unhe ijazat dene se inkaar kiya jab tak main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki raay na le lun. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, maine unse kaha: Mere doodh-rishte ke chacha ne mujhse ijazat maangi daakhil hone ki, lekin maine unhe ijazat nahi di, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe apne chacha ko andar aane dena chahiye. Maine, Aisha ne, kaha: Ye ek aurat thi jisne mujhe doodh pilaaya, na ki mard. Lekin unhone kaha: Woh tumhare chacha hain, unhe andar aane do.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " The brother of Abu'l-Qu'ais sought permission from her ('A'isha) (to enter the house). The rest is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Abu'l-Qu'ais ke bhai ne unse, Aisha se, ijazat maangi, ghar mein daakhil hone ki. Baaki waisi hi hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My foster-uncle Abu'l Ja'd (kunya of Aflah) sought permission from me, which I refused. (Hisham said to me that Abu'l-Ja'd was in fact Abu'l-Qu'ais). When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came, I ('A'isha) informed him about it. He said: Why did you not permit him? Let your right hand or hand be besmeared with dust.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere doodh-rishte ke chacha Abu'l Ja'd, Aflah ki kunyat, ne mujhse ijazat maangi, jise maine inkaar kar diya. Hisham ne mujhse kaha ki Abu'l-Ja'd dar-asal Abu'l-Qu'ais the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, maine, Aisha ne, unhe iske baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha: Tumne unhe ijazat kyun nahi di? Tumhare daaye haath ya haath par mitti lag jaaye.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that her foster-uncle whose name was Aflah sought permission from her (to enter the house) but she observed seclusion from him, and informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said to her: Don't observe veil from him for he is Mahram (one with whom marriage cannot be contracted) on account of fosterage as one is Mahram on account of consanguinity.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unke doodh-rishte ke chacha, jinka naam Aflah tha, ne unse ijazat maangi, ghar mein daakhil hone ki, lekin unhone unse parda kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iski khabar di, jinhone unse kaha: Unse parda mat karo, kyunki woh Mahram hain, jinke saath shaadi nahi ho sakti, doodh-rishte ki wajah se jaise khoon ke rishte ki wajah se koi Mahram hota hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Aflah b. Qu'ais sought permission from me (to enter the house), but I refused to grant him the permission, and he sent me (the message saying): I am your uncle (in the sense) that the wife of my brother has suckled you, (but still) I refused to grant him permission. There came the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and I made a mention of it to him, and he said: He can enter (your house), for he is your uncle.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Aflah bin Qu'ais ne mujhse ijazat maangi, ghar mein daakhil hone ki, lekin maine unhe ijazat dene se inkaar kiya, aur unhone mujhe payaam bheja, ye kehte hue: Main tumhara chacha hoon, is arth mein ki mere bhai ki zauja ne tumhe doodh pilaaya hai, lekin phir bhi maine unhe ijazat dene se inkaar kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur maine unhe iska zikr kiya, aur unhone kaha: Woh daakhil ho sakte hain, tumhare ghar mein, kyunki woh tumhare chacha hain.

e: 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) reported having said this: Messenger of Allah, why is it that you select (your wife) from among the Quraish, but you ignore us (the nearest of the kin)? Thereupon he said: Have you anything for me (a suitable match for me)? I said; Yes, the daughter of Hamza, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: She is not lawful for me, for she is the daughter of my brother by reason of fosterage.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki unhone ye kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aisa kyun hai ki aap Quraish se apni zauja chunte hain, lekin humein, sabse qareebi rishtedaaron ko, nazarandaaz karte hain? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas mere liye koi (mere liye munaasib match) hai? Maine kaha: Haan, Hamza ki beti, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh mere liye jaayez nahi hai, kyunki woh mere doodh-rishte ke bhai ki beti hain.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: It was proposed that he (the Holy Prophet) be married to the daughter of Hamza, whereupon he said: She is not lawful for me for she is the daughter of my foster-brother, and that is unlawful by reason of fosterage what is unlawful by reason of genealogy.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ye prastaav rakha gaya ki unki shaadi Hamza ki beti se ki jaaye, isper unhone kaha: Woh mere liye jaayez nahi hai kyunki woh mere doodh-rishte ke bhai ki beti hain, aur ye doodh-rishte ki wajah se haraam hai jo naslon ki wajah se haraam hai.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Hammam, Sa'id, Bishr b 'Umar, but with a small variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hammam, Sa'id, Bishr bin Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein choti tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her), the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: It was said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Is not the daughter of Hamza a suitable match for you? Or it was said: Why don't you propose to marry the daughter of Hamza, the son of Abd al-Muttalib? Thereupon he said: Hamza is my brother by reason of fosterage.
hi: Umm Salama (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha gaya: Kya Hamza ki beti aapke liye ek munaasib match nahi hain? Ya kaha gaya: Aap Hamza bin Abd al-Muttalib ki beti se shaadi ka prastaav kyun nahi dete? Isper unhone kaha: Hamza mere doodh-rishte ke bhai hain.

e: Umm Habiba, the daughter of AbuSufyan, reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me and I said to him: Have you any inclination towards my the daughter of Abu Sufyan? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then what should I do? I said: Marry her. He said: Do you like that? I said: I am not the exclusive (wife) of yours; I, therefore, wish to join my sister in good. He, said: She is not lawful for me. I said: I have been informed that you have given the proposal of marriage to Durrah daughter of Abu Salama He raid: You mean the daughter of Umm Salama? I said: Yes. He said: Even if she had not been my step-daughter brought up under my guardianship, she would not have been lawful for me, for she is the daughter of my foster-brother (Hamza), for Thuwaiba had suckled me and her father. So do not give me the proposal of the marriage of your daughters and sisters.
hi: Umm Habiba, Abu Sufyan ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur maine unse kaha: Kya aapka jhukav mere behn, Abu Sufyan ki beti, ki taraf hai? Unhone kaha: To phir mujhe kya karna chahiye? Maine kaha: Unse shaadi kijiye. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe ye pasand hai? Maine kaha: Main aapki akeli zauja nahi hoon; is liye main chahti hoon ki meri behn achhaai mein mere saath jud jaaye. Unhone kaha: Woh mere liye jaayez nahi hain. Maine kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki aapne Durrah, Abu Salama ki beti, ko shaadi ka prastaav diya hai. Unhone kaha: Tumhara matlab Umm Salama ki beti se hai? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Chahe woh meri palak-poshit sotele beti na hoti, phir bhi woh mere liye jaayez nahi hoti, kyunki woh mere doodh-rishte ke bhai, Hamza, ki beti hain, kyunki Thuwaiba ne mujhe aur unke waalid ko doodh pilaaya tha. Is liye mujhe apni betiyon aur behnon ka prastaav mat do.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Habiba, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that she said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, marry my sister 'Azza, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you like it? She said: Yes, Messenger of Allah, I am not the exclusive wife of yours, and I wish that the person who joins me in good should be my sister. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is not lawful for me. I said: Messenger of Allah, we discussed that You intend to marry Durrah bint Abu Salama. He (the Holy Prophet) said: You mean the daughter of Abu Salama? She said: Yes, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) said: Even if she were not the step-daughter of mine, brought up under my guardianship, she would not have been lawful for me, for she is the daughter of my foster-brother. Thuwaiba gave me suck and to Abu Salama (also), so do not offer to me your daughters and sisters.
hi: Umm Habiba, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri behn Azza se shaadi kijiye, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhe ye pasand hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, Allah ke Rasool, main aapki akeli zauja nahi hoon, aur main chahti hoon ki jo mere saath achhaai mein jude woh meri behn ho. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye mere liye jaayez nahi hai. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humne charcha ki thi ki aap Durrah bint Abu Salama se shaadi karne ka iraada rakhte hain. Unhone kaha: Tumhara matlab Abu Salama ki beti se hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Chahe woh meri palak-poshit sotele beti na hoti, phir bhi woh mere liye jaayez nahi hoti, kyunki woh mere doodh-rishte ke bhai ki beti hain. Thuwaiba ne mujhe doodh pilaaya aur Abu Salama ko bhi, is liye mujhe apni betiyon aur behnon ka prastaav mat do.

e: The above hadith is narratted through other chains except they did not mention 'Azza like the chain of Yazid Bin Abi Habib.
hi: Upar bataayi gayi hadees doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay iske ki unhone Azza ka zikr nahi kiya jaisa Yazid bin Abi Habib ki sanad mein hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), Suwaid and Zubair reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: One suckling or two do not make (marriage) unlawful.
hi: Aisha (RA), Suwaid aur Zubair ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek ya do baar doodh pilaana (shaadi ko) haraam nahi karta.

e: Umm al-Fadl reported: A bedouin came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) when he was in my house and said: Allah's Apostle, I have had a wife and I married another besides her, and my first wife claimed that she had suckled once or twice my newly married wife, thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: One suckling or two do not make the (marriage) unlawful.
hi: Umm al-Fadl ne bayan kiya: Ek registaan ka Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh mere ghar mein the aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri ek zauja hai aur maine uske ilawa doosri se shaadi ki, aur meri pehli zauja ka daawa hai ki usne meri nayi zauja ko ek ya do baar doodh pilaaya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek ya do baar doodh pilaana shaadi ko haraam nahi banaata.

e: Umm Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a person from Banu 'Amir b. Sa'sa said: Allah's Apostle, does one suckling make the (marriage) unlawful? He said: No.
hi: Umm Fadl (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Banu Amir bin Sa'sa ke ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ek baar doodh pilaana shaadi ko haraam banaata hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi.

e: Umm Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Being suckled once or twice, or one suckling or two, do not make marriage unlawful.
hi: Umm Fadl (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek ya do baar doodh pilaaya jaana, ya ek ya do baar doodh pilaana, shaadi ko haraam nahi banaata.

e: In the narration transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bishr there is a mention of two sucklings and Ibn Abu Shaiba has narrated it with a small variation of wording.
hi: Ibn Bishr ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat mein do baar doodh pilaane ka zikr hai aur Ibn Abu Shaiba ne ise choti tabdeeli ke saath riwayat kiya hai.

e: Umm Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be'apon him) having said this: One or two sucklings do not make (the marriage) unlawful.
hi: Umm Fadl (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek ya do baar doodh pilaana shaadi ko haraam nahi banaata.

e: Umm Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): Does one suckling make (the marriage) unlawful? He said: No.
hi: Umm Fadl (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Kya ek baar doodh pilaana shaadi ko haraam banaata hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with, her) reported that it had been revealed in the Holy Qur'an that ten clear sucklings make the marriage unlawful, then it was abrogated (and substituted) by five sucklings and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) died and it was before that time (found) in the Holy Qur'an (and recited by the Muslims).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quran mein pehle ye nazil hua tha ki das saaf doodh pilaana shaadi ko haraam banaata hai, phir ise mansookh kiya gaya aur paanch baar doodh pilaane se badla gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya aur ye us waqt tak Quran mein maujood tha, aur Musalmaan ise padhte the.

e: 'Amra reported that she heard 'A'isha (Allah he pleased with her) discussing fosterage which (makes marriage) unlawful; and she ('A'isha) said: There was revealed in the Holy Qur'an ten clear sucklings, and then five clear (sucklings).
hi: Amra ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha (RA) ko doodh-rishte, jo shaadi ko haraam banaata hai, ka zikr karte suna; aur unhone, Aisha ne, kaha: Quran mein pehle das saaf baar doodh pilaana nazil hua tha, aur phir paanch saaf baar.

e: Ahadith like this is transmitted by 'A'isha through another chain of narrators.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: ' A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Sahla bint Suhail came to Allah's Apostle (may peace be eupon him) and said: Messengerof Allah, I see on the face of Abu Hudhaifa (signs of disgust) on entering of Salim (who is an ally) into (our house), whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Suckle him. She said: How can I suckle him as he is a grown-up man? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said: I already know that he is a young man 'Amr has made this addition in his narration that he participated in the Battle of Badr and in the narration of Ibn 'Umar (the words are): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughed.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Sahla bint Suhail Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Abu Hudhaifa ke chehre par (naapasandeegi ke nishaan) dekhti hoon Salim (jo ek mitr hai) ke, humare ghar mein aane par, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao. Unhone kaha: Main unhe kaise doodh pila sakti hoon jabki woh ek bade aadmi hain? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur kaha: Mujhe pata hai ki woh ek jawaan aadmi hain. Amr ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki unhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya tha aur Ibn Umar ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hanse.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hadhaifa, lived with him and his family in their house. She (i. e. the daughter of Suhail came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Salim has attained (purbety) as men attain, and he understands what they understand, and he enters our house freely, I, however, perceive that something (rankles) in the heart of Abu Hudhaifa, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to her: Suckle him and you would become unlawful for him, and (the rankling) which Abu Hudhaifa feels in his heart will disappear. She returned and said: So I suckled him, and what (was there) in the heart of Abu Hudhaifa disappeared.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Salim, Abu Hudhaifa ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, unke aur unke khaandaan ke saath unke ghar mein rehte the. Unhone, yaani Suhail ki beti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aakar kaha: Salim baaligh ho gaye hain jaise mard hote hain, aur woh samajhte hain jo woh samajhte hain, aur woh humare ghar mein azaadi se aate hain, main, halaanki, mehsoos karti hoon ki Abu Hudhaifa ke dil mein kuch (khatakta) hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao aur tum unke liye haraam ho jaogi, aur woh, jo Abu Hudhaifa ke dil mein khatakta hai, gaayab ho jaayega. Woh laut ke aayin aur kaha: To maine unhe doodh pilaaya, aur jo Abu Hudhaifa ke dil mein tha woh gaayab ho gaya.

e: Ibn Abu Mulaika reported that al-Qasim b. Muhammad b. Abu Bakr had narrated to him that 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Sahla bint Suhail b. 'Amr came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, Salim (the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa) is living with us in our house, and he has attained (puberty) as men attain it and has acquired knowledge (of the sex problems) as men acquire, whereupon he said: Suckle him so that he may become unlawful (in regard to marriage) for you He (Ibn Abu Mulaika) said: I refrained from (narrating this hadith) for a year or so on account of fear. I then met al-Qasim and said to him: You narrated to me a hadith which I did not narrate (to anyone) afterwards. He said: What is that? I informed him, whereupon he said: Narrate it on my authority that 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) had narrated that to me.
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya ki al-Qasim bin Muhammad bin Abu Bakr ne unhe riwayat ki thi ki Aisha (RA) ne bataya ki Sahla bint Suhail bin Amr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Salim, Abu Hudhaifa ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, humare saath humare ghar mein rehte hain, aur woh baaligh ho gaye hain jaise mard hote hain aur unhone (jinsi maamlon ka) ilm haasil kar liya hai jaise mard karte hain, isper unhone kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao taaki woh tumhare liye haraam ho jaayein, shaadi ke maamle mein. Unhone (Ibn Abu Mulaika ne) kaha: Main is hadees ko sunaane se ek saal ya isse zyada waqt tak rukā rahā dar ki wajah se. Main phir al-Qasim se mila aur unse kaha: Aapne mujhe ek hadees sunaayi jo maine baad mein kisi ko nahi sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Woh kya hai? Maine unhe bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Ise mere hawale se riwayat karo ki Aisha (RA) ne ye mujhe riwayat ki thi.

e: Umm Salama said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): A young boy who is at the threshold of puberty comes to you. I, however, do not like that he should come to me, whereupon 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Don't you see in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a model for you? She also said: The wife of Abu Hudhaifa said: Messenger of Allah, Salim comes to me and now he is a (grown-up) person, and there is something that (rankles) in the mind of Abu Hudhaifa about him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Suckle him (so that he may become your foster-child), and thus he may be able to come to you (freely).
hi: Umm Salama ne Aisha (RA) se kaha: Ek jawaan larka jo baalig hone ki dehleez par hai tumhare paas aata hai. Mujhe, halaanki, ye pasand nahi ki woh mere paas aaye, isper Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein apne liye ek namoona nahi dekhti? Unhone ye bhi kaha: Abu Hudhaifa ki zauja ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Salim mere paas aate hain aur ab woh ek bade aadmi hain, aur unke baare mein Abu Hudhaifa ke dimaag mein kuch (khatakta) hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao (taaki woh tumhare doodh-rishte ka bachcha ban jaaye), aur is tarah woh tumhare paas azaadi se aa sakein.

e: Zainab daughter of Abu Salama reported: I heard Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon himy, saying to 'A'isha: By Allah, I do not like to be seen by a young boy who has passed the period of fosterage, whereupon she ('A'isha) said: Why is it so? Sahla daughter of Suhail came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I swear by Allah that I see in the face of Abu Hudhaifa (the signs of disgust) on account of entering of Salim (in the house), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Suckle him. She (Sahla bint Suhail) said: He has a heard. But he (again) said: Suckle him, and it would remove what is there (expression of disgust) on the face of Abu Hudhaifa. She said: (I did that) and, by Allah, I did not see (any sign of disgust) on the face of Abu Hudhaifa.
hi: Zainab, Abu Salama ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Maine Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ko Aisha se ye kehte suna: Allah ki qasam, mujhe ye pasand nahi ki mujhe koi jawaan larka dekhe jo doodh pilaane ki muddat se guzar chuka hai, isper unhone, Aisha ne, kaha: Aisa kyun hai? Sahla, Suhail ki beti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Allah ki qasam khaati hoon ki main Abu Hudhaifa ke chehre par (napasandeegi ke nishaan) dekhti hoon Salim ke, ghar mein aane ki wajah se, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao. Unhone, Sahla bint Suhail ne, kaha: Unki daadhi hai. Lekin unhone dobara kaha: Unhe doodh pilaao, aur ye Abu Hudhaifa ke chehre par jo hai, napasandeegi ka izhaar, use door kar dega. Unhone kaha: Maine ye kiya, aur Allah ki qasam, maine Abu Hudhaifa ke chehre par koi (napasandeegi ka) nishaan nahi dekha.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), used to say that all wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) disclaimed the idea that one with this type of fosterage (having been suckled after the proper period) should come to them. and said to 'A'isha: By Allah, we do not find this but a sort of concession given by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) only for Salim, and no one was ging to be allowed to enter (our houses) with this type of fosterage and we do not subscribe to this view.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ye kaha karti thin ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki saari zaujaon ne is khayal ko radd kiya ki is tarah ke doodh-rishte wala, munaasib muddat ke baad doodh pilaaya gaya, koi bhi unke paas aaye, aur unhone Aisha se kaha: Allah ki qasam, humein lagta hai ki ye sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se Salim ke liye ek khaas chhoot thi, aur is tarah ke doodh-rishte ke saath kisi ko bhi (hamare gharon mein) aane ki ijazat nahi thi aur hum is raay se sehmat nahi hain.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me when a man was sitting near me, and he seemed to disapprove of that. And I saw signs of anger on his face and I said: Messenger of Allah, he is my brother by forsterage, whereupon he said: Consider who your brothers are because of fosterage since fosterage is through hunger (i. e. in infancy).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab ek aadmi mere paas baitha tha, aur woh isse naapasand karte lag rahe the. Aur maine unke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dekhe aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye mera doodh-rishte ka bhai hai, isper unhone kaha: Ye dekho ki tumhare doodh-rishte ke bhai kaun hain, kyunki doodh-rishta bhookh ke zariye hota hai, yaani shishuavastha mein.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu al-Ahwas with another chain of transmitters and a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu al-Ahwas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah her pleased with him) reported that at the Battle of Hanain Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an army to Autas and encountered the enemy and fought with them. Having overcome them and taken them captives, the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace te upon him) seemed to refrain from having intercourse with captive women because of their husbands being polytheists. Then Allah, Most High, sent down regarding that: " And women already married, except those whom your right hands possess (iv. 24)" (i. e. they were lawful for them when their 'Idda period came to an end).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hanain ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Autas ki taraf ek fauj bheji aur dushman ka saamna kiya aur unse jung ki. Unhe shikast dekar aur qaidi banaakar, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba qaidi auraton se jinsi milaap karne se katraane lage kyunki unke shohar mushrik the. Isper Allah, sabse Buland, ne is baare mein ye nazil kiya: "Aur woh auraten jo pehle se shaadishuda hain, siwaay unke jinke tum daaye haath maalik hain" (4:24), yaani woh unke liye jaayez hui jab unki iddat khatam ho gayi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent a small army. The rest of the hadith is the same except this that he said: Except what your right hands possess out of them are lawful for you; and he did not mention" when their 'idda period comes to an end".
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chhoti fauj bheji. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay iske ki unhone kaha: Siwaay unke jo tumhare daaye haath maalik hain unmein se, tumhare liye jaayez hain; aur unhone "jab unki iddat khatam ho jaaye" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of AbuSa'id (al-Khudri) (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters and the words are: They took captives (women) on the day of Autas who had their husbands. They were afraid (to have sexual intercourse with them) when this verse was revealed:" And women already married except those whom you right hands posses" (iv. 24)
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id (al-Khudri) (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: Unhone Autas ke din auraton ko qaidi banaaya jinke shohar the. Woh dar rahe the, unse jinsi milaap karne se, jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur woh auraten jo pehle se shaadishuda hain siwaay unke jo tumhare daaye haath maalik hain" (4:24).

e: Likewise, the above hadith has been narrated through another chain.
hi: Isi tarah, upar bataayi gayi hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Qatada reported a hadith like this with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Qatada ne isi jaisi ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas and Abd b. Zam'a (Allah be pleased with them) disputed with each other over a young boy. Sa'd said: Messenger of Allah, he is the son of my brother 'Utba b. Abu Waqqas as he made it explicit that he was his son. Look at his resemblance. Abd b. Zam'a said Messenger of Allah, he is my brother as he was born on the bed of my father from his slave-girl. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at his resemblance and found a clear resemblance with 'Utba. (But) he said: "He is yours O 'Abd (b. Zam'a), for the child is to be attributed to one on whose bed it is born, and stoning for a fornicator. Sauda bint Zam'a, O you should observe veil from him." So he did not see Sauda at all. Muhammad b. Rumh did not make a mention (of the words): "O Abd."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas aur Abd bin Zam'a (RA) ne ek jawaan larke ke baare mein ek-doosre se jhagda kiya. Sa'd ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye mere bhai Utba bin Abu Waqqas ka beta hai kyunki unhone ye saaf kiya tha ki ye unka beta hai. Unki (larke ki) shaklo-surat dekhiye. Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye mera bhai hai kyunki ye mere waalid ke bistar par unki laundi se paida hua. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski shaklo-surat dekhi aur Utba se ek saaf samaanta paayi. Lekin unhone kaha: "Ye tumhaara hai, Aye Abd (bin Zam'a), kyunki bachche ko usi ka mana jaana chahiye jiske bistar par woh paida hua hai, aur zina karne wale ke liye sangsaar hai. Sauda bint Zam'a, tumhe unse parda karna chahiye." To unhone Sauda ko kabhi nahi dekha. Muhammad bin Rumh ne "Aye Abd" alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Uyaiyna and Ma'mar (and the words are): The child is attributed to him on whose bed he is born; but they did not mention this:" For a fornicator there is stoning."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Uyaiyna aur Ma'mar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: Bachche ko usi ka mana jaana chahiye jiske bistar par woh paida hota hai; lekin unhone ye zikr nahi kiya: "Zina karne wale ke liye sangsaar hai."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The child is to be attributed to one on whose bed he is born, and for a fornicator there is stoning.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bachche ko usi ka mana jaana chahiye jiske bistar par woh paida hota hai, aur zina karne wale ke liye sangsaar hai.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me looking pleased as if his face was glistening and said: Did you see that Mujazziz cast a glance at Zaid b. Haritha and Usama b. Zaid, and (then) said: Some (of the features) of their feet are found in the others?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye khushi ke bhaavon ke saath jaise unka chehra chamak raha ho, aur kaha: Kya tumne dekha ki Mujazziz ne Zaid bin Haritha aur Usama bin Zaid ki taraf nazar daali, aur phir kaha: Unke paanvon ke kuch nishaan doosre mein bhi paaye jaate hain?

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: One day Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me looking pleased and he said: 'A'isha, don't you see Mujazziz al-Mudliji? (He) entered (my house) and saw Usama and Zaid with a rug over them covering their heads, but their feet appeared, and (he) said: These feet are related to one another.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye khushi ke bhaavon ke saath aur unhone kaha: Aisha, kya tum Mujazziz al-Mudliji ko nahi dekh rahi? Unhone daakhil hokar Usama aur Zaid ko dekha, ek chaadar se dhaanke hue unke sar, lekin unke paanv dikhte the, aur unhone kaha: In paanvon ka aapas mein rishta hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: A physiognomist visited (our house) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was present, and Usama b. Zaid and Zaid b. Haritha were both lying asleep, and he (the physiognomist), said: These feet are related to one another. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was pleased to hear this, and he was happy and informed 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) about it.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakalo-surat pehchaanne wala hamare ghar aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) maujood the, aur Usama bin Zaid aur Zaid bin Haritha dono so rahe the, aur unhone, is shakhs ne, kaha: In paanvon ka aapas mein rishta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye sunkar khush hue, aur unhone Aisha (RA) ko iski khabar di.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri and Yunus said: Mujazziz was a physiognomist.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Yunus ne kaha: Mujazziz ek shakalo-surat pehchaanne wale the.

e: 'Abd al-Malik b. Abu Bakr b. Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham reported on the authority of his father from Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Umm Salama, he stayed with her for three nights, and said: There is no lack of estimation on the part of your husband for you. If you wish I can stay with you for a week, but in case I stay with you for a week, then I shall have to stay for a week with all my wives.
hi: Abd al-Malik bin Abu Bakr bin Abd al-Rahman bin al-Harith bin Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se Umm Salama (RA) se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama se shaadi ki, woh unke saath teen raaton tak rahe, aur kaha: Tumhare shohar ke liye tumhari koi kami nahi hai. Agar tum chaaho to main tumhare saath ek hafte tak reh sakta hoon, lekin agar main tumhare saath ek hafte tak rahoon, to mujhe apni sabhi zaujaon ke saath ek hafta bitaana hoga.

e: Ibn Abu Bakr b. Abd al-Rahman reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Umm Salama and she stayed with him (during the night), and it was dawn, he (the Holy Prophet) said to her: There is no lack of estimation for you on the part of your husband. So if you desire I can spend a week with you, and if you like I may spend three (nights). and then I will visit you in turn. She said: Spend three (nights).
hi: Ibn Abu Bakr bin Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama se shaadi ki aur woh unke saath raat mein rahin, aur subah hui, unhone unse kaha: Tumhare liye tumhare shohar ki taraf se koi kami nahi hai. To agar tum chaaho main tumhare saath ek hafta guzaar sakta hoon, aur agar tum chaaho main teen (raaten) guzaar sakta hoon, aur phir main tumse baari-baari milta rahoonga. Unhone kaha: Teen (raaten) guzaariye.

e: Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Umm Salama and he visited her, and when he intended to come out, she caught hold of his cloth. whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you so desire, I can extend the time (of my stay) with you, but then I shall have to calculate the time (that I stay with you and shall have to spend the same time with other wives). For the virgin woman, (her husband has to stay with her) for a week, and for the woman previously married it is three days.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama se shaadi ki aur unke paas gaye, aur jab woh bahar nikalne ka iraada karne lage, unhone unka kapda pakad liya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum chaaho, to main tumhare saath (rehne ka) waqt badha sakta hoon, lekin phir mujhe iska hisaab rakhna hoga, jo waqt main tumhare saath guzaarta hoon woh doosri zaujaon ke saath bhi guzaarna hoga. Kunwari aurat ke liye, uske shohar ko uske saath ek hafta rehna hoga, aur pehle se shaadishuda aurat ke liye ye teen din hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Humaid.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Humaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her, and he (the narrator) made mention of so many things in this connection (and one of them was this) that he said: If you desire that I spend a week with you, I shall have to spend a week with my (other) wives, and if spend a week with you, I shall have to spend a week with my (other) wives.
hi: Umm Salama (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse shaadi ki, aur unhone is silsile mein kayi cheezon ka zikr kiya, aur unmein se ek ye tha ki unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho ki main tumhare saath ek hafta guzaaru, to mujhe apni doosri zaujaon ke saath bhi ek hafta guzaarna hoga, aur agar main tumhare saath ek hafta guzaaru, to mujhe apni doosri zaujaon ke saath bhi ek hafta guzaarna hoga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When anyone who has already a wife marries virgin, he should stay with her for seven nights (and then turn to his other wife), but when anyone having a virgin with him (as his wife) marries a woman who has been previously married he should stay with her for three nights. Khalid (one of the narrators) said. If I were to say that it could be directly traced to the Prophet (ﷺ). I would have told the truth, but he (Hadrat Anas) said: Such is the tradition.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Jab koi shakhs jiski pehle se ek zauja hai, ek kunwari se shaadi karta hai, use uske saath saat raaten reh na chahiye (aur phir apni doosri zauja ki taraf mudna chahiye), lekin jab koi shakhs jiske paas ek kunwari (zauja ke taur par) hai, ek aisi aurat se shaadi karta hai jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki hai, use uske saath teen raaten rehna chahiye. Khalid, ek raawi, ne kaha: Agar main ye kahun ki ise seedhe Nabi (SAW) se joda ja sakta hai, to main sach kahunga, lekin unhone, Hazrat Anas ne, kaha: Aisi hi rivaayat hai.

e: Abu Qilaba reported on the authority of Anas: It is the Sunnah to stay with a virgin (after having married her) for a week. Khalid (one of the narrators) said: If wish I can say that it can be traced up to the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Qilaba ne Anas ki sanad se riwayat ki: Ye Sunnat hai ki ek kunwari ke saath, shaadi karne ke baad, ek hafta guzaara jaaye. Khalid, ek raawi, ne kaha: Agar main chahoon to main keh sakta hoon ki ise Nabi (SAW) tak seedhe joda ja sakta hai.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had nine wives. So when he divided (his stay) with them, the turn of the first wife did not come but on the ninth (day). They (all the wives) used to gather every night in the house of one where he had to come (and stay that night). It was (the night when he had to stay) in the house of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), when Zainab came there. He (the Holy Prophet) stretched his hand towards her (Zainab), whereupon she ('A'isha) said: It is Zainab. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) withdrew his hand. There was an altercation between the two until their voices became loud (and it was at that time) when Iqama was pronounced for prayer. There happened to come Abu Bakr and he heard their voices and said: Messenger of Allah, (kindly) come for prayer, and throw dust in their mouths. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went out. 'A'isha said: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) would finish his prayer there would also come Abu Bakr and he would do as he does (on such occasions, i.e. reprimanding). When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, there came to her Abu Bakr, and spoke to her ('A'isha) in stern words and said: Do you behave like this?
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nau zaujaen thin. To jab unhone (apna waqt) unke beech baanta, pehli zauja ki baari sirf nauven (din) aati thi. Woh sabhi zaujaen har raat us ek ke ghar mein ikattha hoti thin jahan unhe (Nabi ko) aana hota (aur woh raat wahan guzaarni hoti). Ye woh raat thi jab unhe Aisha (RA) ke ghar aana tha, jab Zainab wahan aayin. Unhone unki taraf haath badhaaya, isper unhone, Aisha ne, kaha: Ye Zainab hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath vaapas kheench liya. In dono ke beech ek jhagda hua yahan tak ki unki aawaazein buland ho gayin, aur ye us waqt tha jab namaz ke liye Iqamat kahi gayi. Wahan Abu Bakr aaye aur unhone unki aawaazein sunin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, namaz ke liye aaiye, aur unke munhon mein mitti daaliye. To Nabi (SAW) bahar gaye. Aisha ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni namaz mukammal kar chuke, Abu Bakr bhi aa gaye aur unhone woh kiya jo woh aise mauqon par karte (yaani daant lagana). Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni namaz mukammal kar chuke, Abu Bakr unke, Aisha ke, paas aaye, aur unse sakht alfaazon mein baat ki aur kaha: Kya tum aisa vyavahaar karti ho?

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Never did I find any woman more loving to me than Sauda bint Zam'a. I wished I could be exactly like her who was passionate. As she became old, she had made over her day (which she had to spend) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to 'A'isha. She said: I have made over my day with you to 'A'isha. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) allotted two days to 'A'isha, her own day (when it was her turn) and that of Sauda.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine kabhi kisi aurat ko mujhse zyada muhabbat karne wala nahi paaya jitna Sauda bint Zam'a. Mera dil chaahta tha ki main bilkul unki tarah hoti, unki jaisi jazbaati. Jab woh boodhi ho gayin, unhone apna din, jo unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath guzaarna hota tha, Aisha ke naam kar diya. Unhone kaha: Maine tumhari khaatir apna din tumhe de diya hai. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Aisha ko do din diye, unka apna din aur Sauda ka din.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of narrators (and the words are): When Sauda became old (the rest of the hadith is the same) and in the narration of Sharik there is an addition (of these words:" She was the first woman whom he (Allah's Apostle) married after me."
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hisham ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: Jab Sauda boodhi ho gayin, baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur Sharik ki riwayat mein ye izafa hai: "Woh pehli aurat thin jinse unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, mere baad shaadi ki."

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I felt jealous of the women who offered themselves to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Then when Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this:" You may defer any one of them you wish, and take to yourself any you wish; and if you desire any you have set aside (no sin is chargeable to you)" (xxxiii. 51), I ('A'isha.) said: It seems to me that your Lord hastens to satisfy your desire.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe un auraton se jalan hoti thi jinhone khud ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sompa aur maine kaha: Jab Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye nazil kiya: "Tum inmein se jise chaaho taal sakte ho, aur jise chaaho apne paas rakh sakte ho; aur agar tum kisi ko chaaho jise tumne alag kiya tha, koi gunah nahi hoga tumpar" (33:51), maine kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki tumhare Rab tumhari khwahish poori karne mein jaldi karte hain.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) used to say: Does the woman not feel shy of offering herself to a man? Then Allah the Exalted and Glorious revealed this verse:" You may defer any of them you wish and take to yourself any you wish." I ('A'isha said): It seems to me that your Lord hastens to satisfy your desire.
hi: Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Aisha (RA) ye kaha karti thin: Kya aurat ko sharm nahi aati apne aap ko ek aadmi ko sompne mein? Phir Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Tum inmein se jise chaaho taal sakte ho, aur jise chaaho apne paas rakh sakte ho." Maine, Aisha ne, kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki tumhare Rab tumhari khwahish poori karne mein jaldi karte hain.

e: 'Ata related that when they were with Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) at the funeral of Maimuna In Sarif, Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: This is the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) ; so when you lift her bier, do not shake her or disturb her, but be gentle, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had nine wives, with eight of whom he shared his time, but to one of them, he did not allot a share. 'Ati said: The one to whom he did not allot a share of time was Safiyya, daughter of Huyayy b. Akhtab.
hi: Ata ne riwayat ki ki jab woh Ibn Abbas (RA) ke saath Maimuna ke janaze mein Sarif mein the, Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja hain; is liye jab tum unki laash uthaao, unhe hilaao mat ya pareshaan mat karo, balki narmi se karo, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nau zaujaen thin, jinmein se aath ke saath unhone apna waqt baanta, lekin ek ko unhone koi hissa nahi diya. Ata ne kaha: Woh jinhe unhone kisi waqt ka hissa nahi diya Safiyyah, Huyayy bin Akhtab ki beti, thin.

e: Ibn Juraij narrated a hadith with the same chain of transmitters, and she (Hadrat Maimuna) was the last of them to die at Medina.
hi: Ibn Juraij ne ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki, aur woh, Hazrat Maimuna, unmein se aakhri thin jinka intiqaal Madina mein hua.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman may be married for four reasons: for her property, her status. her beauty and her religion, so try to get one who is religious, may your hand be besmeared with dust.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat se char wajahon se shaadi ki jaati hai: uski maal ke liye, uske martaba ke liye, uski khoobsurati ke liye, aur uske deen ke liye, is liye deendaar aurat ko chunne ki koshish karo, tumhare haath par mitti lag jaaye.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I married a woman during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him). I met the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Jabir, have you married? I said: Yes. He said: A virgin or one previously marrried? I said: With due previously married, whereupon he said: Why did you not marry a virgin with whom you could sport? I said: Allah's Messenger, I have sisters; I was afraid that she might intervene between me and them, whereupon he said: Well and good, if it is so. A woman is married for four reasons, for her religion, her property, her status, her beauty, so you should choose one with religion. May your hands cleave to dust.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein ek aurat se shaadi ki. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mila, isper unhone kaha: Jabir, kya tumne shaadi ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kunwari se ya jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse? Maine kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse, isper unhone kaha: Tumne ek kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki jiske saath tum khel sakte the? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri behnein hain; mujhe dar tha ki woh mere aur unke beech rukaawat ban jaayegi, isper unhone kaha: Achha hai, agar aisa hai. Ek aurat char wajahon se shaadi ki jaati hai, uske deen ke liye, uski maal ke liye, uske martaba ke liye, uski khoobsurati ke liye, is liye tumhe deendaar ko chunna chahiye. Tumhare haath mitti se chipak jaayein.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I married a woman, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Have you married? I said: Yes. He said: Is it a virgin or a previously married one (widow or divorced)? I said: With a previously married one, whereupon he said: Where had you been (away) from the amusements of virgins? Shu'ba said: I made a mention of it to 'Amr b. Dinar and he said: I too heard from Jabir making mention of that (that Allah's Apostle) said: Why didn't you marry a girl, so that you might sport with her and she might sport with you?
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine ek aurat se shaadi ki, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kya tumne shaadi ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kya woh kunwari hai ya jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi, bewa ya talaaqshuda? Maine kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse, isper unhone kaha: Kunwariyon ki khushiyon se tum kahan the? Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Amr bin Dinar se kiya aur unhone kaha: Maine bhi Jabir se ye zikr karte suna ki (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Tumne ek larki se shaadi kyun nahi ki, taaki tum uske saath khel sakte aur woh tumhare saath khel sakti?

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: 'Abdullah died and he left (behind him) nine or seven daughters. I married a woman who had been previously married. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Jabir, have you married? I said: Yes. He (again) said: A virgin or one previously married? I said: Messenger of Allah, with one who was previously married, whereupon he said: Why didn't you marry a young girl so that you could sport with her and she could sport with you, or you could amuse with her and she could amuse with you? I said to him: 'Abdullah died (he fell as martyr in Uhud) and left nine or seven daughters behind him; I, therefore, did not approve of the idea that I should bring a (girl) like them, but I preferred to bring a woman who should look after them and teach them good manners, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: May Allah bless you, or he supplicated (for the) good (to be) conferred on me (by Allah).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abdullah ka intiqaal ho gaya aur unhone (apne peeche) nau ya saat betiyaan chhodin. Maine ek aurat se shaadi ki jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jabir, kya tumne shaadi ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone dobara kaha: Kunwari se ya jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse, isper unhone kaha: Tumne ek jawaan larki se shaadi kyun nahi ki taaki tum uske saath khel sakte aur woh tumhare saath khel sakti, ya tum uske saath khush ho sakte aur woh tumhare saath khush ho sakti? Maine unse kaha: Abdullah ka intiqaal ho gaya (woh Uhud mein shaheed hue the) aur unhone nau ya saat betiyaan chhodin; is liye mujhe ye khayal pasand nahi aaya ki main unke jaisi (larki) laaun, lekin maine ek aisi aurat ko lena behtar samjha jo unki dekhbhaal kare aur unhe achhe akhlaaq sikhaaye, isper unhone, Allah ke Rasool ne, kaha: Allah tumhein barkat de, ya unhone mere liye achhaai ki dua ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Jabir, have you married? The rest of the hadith is the same up to (the words):" The woman would look after them and comb them." He (Allah's Messenger), said: You did well. But no mention is made of the subsequent portion.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jabir, kya tumne shaadi ki? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai un alfaazon tak: "Aurat unki dekhbhaal karti aur unke baal sanwaarti." Unhone kaha: Tumne achha kiya. Lekin baad ke hisse ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition. When we returned I urged my camel to move quickly as it was slow. There met me a rider from behind me and he goaded it with an iron-tipped stick which he had with him. My camel moved forward like the best that you have ever seen. As I turned (my face) I found him to be Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) He said: Jabir, what hastens you? I said: Messenger of Allah, I am newly wedded. whereupon he said: Is it a virgin that you have married or one previously married? I said: With one previously married. He said: Why not a young girl so that you could play with her and she could play with you? Then when we arrived at and were about to enter Medina he said: Wait, so that we may enter by night (i. e. in the evening) in order that the woman with dishevelled hair may comb it, and the woman whose husband had been away may get herself clean; and when you enter (then you have the) enjoyment (of tho wife's company).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim mein the. Jab hum wapas aaye maine apne oont ko tez chalne ke liye khaenchi kyunki woh dheema tha. Mere peeche se ek sawaar mujhse mila aur usne apni loha-nokdar chhadi se, jo uske paas thi, use dhakela. Mera oont sabse behtareen chalne laga jo tumne kabhi dekha ho. Jab maine mud kar dekha to paaya ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) the. Unhone kaha: Jabir, tumhe kya jaldi hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri abhi-abhi shaadi hui hai, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne ek kunwari se shaadi ki ya jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse? Maine kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse. Unhone kaha: Kyun na ek jawaan larki hoti taaki tum uske saath khel sakte aur woh tumhare saath khel sakti? Phir jab hum pahunche aur Madina mein daakhil hone hi wale the unhone kaha: Ruko, taaki hum raat mein daakhil hon, yaani shaam ko, taaki jiski aurat ke baal bikhre huye hain woh unhe sanwaar sake, aur jiski aurat ka shohar (safar par) door raha ho woh khud ko saaf-suthra kar sake; aur jab tum daakhil ho to tumhe zauja ke saath khushi milegi.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on an expedition, but my camel delayed me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and said to me: Jabir, I said: Yes. Allah's Messenger, (here I am at your beck and call) He said: What is the matter with you? I said: My camel has delayed me and is tired, so I have lagged behind. He (the Holy Prophet) got down and goaded it with a crooked stick and then said: Mount it. So I mounted and (to my great surprise) I saw it (moving so quickly that) I had to restrain it (from going ahead of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) (in the course of journey said to me): Have you married? I said: Yes. He (again) said: Is it with a virgin or one previously married? I said. With one previously married, whereupon he (again) said: Why not with a young girl with whom you could sport and she could have sported with you? I said: I have sisters, so I preferred to marry a woman who could keep them together (as one family). who could comb them and look after them. He said: You are about to go (to your house), and there you have the enjoyment (of the wife's company). He again said: Do you want to sell your camel? I said: Yes. So he bought it from me for one u'qiya (of silver), Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived (at Medina) and I arrived in the evening. I went to the mosque and found him at the door of the mosque, and said: Is it now that you have arrived? I said: Yes, He said: Leave your camel, and enter (the mosque) and offer two rak'ahs. So I entered and offered two rak'ahs of prayer, and then returned. He (the Holy Prophet) then commanded Bilal to weigh out one 'uqiya (of silver) tor me. Bilal weighed that out for me (lowering the scale of) balance. So I proceeded and as I turned my back he said: Call for me, Jabir. So I was called back, and I said (to myself): He would return me the camel, and nothing was more displeasing to me than this (that after having received the price I should also get the camel). He said: Take your camel and keep its price with you, (also).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaya, lekin mera oont mujhe der karwaane laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur mujhse kaha: Jabir, maine kaha: Haan, Allah ke Rasool, main haazir hoon. Unhone kaha: Kya baat hai? Maine kaha: Mera oont mujhe der karwaa raha hai aur thak gaya hai, is liye main peeche reh gaya hoon. Woh (Nabi) utre aur usse ek tedhi chhadi se dhakela aur phir kaha: Ispar sawaar ho. To main sawaar hua aur (mere hairat ke liye) maine dekha ki woh itni tezi se chal raha hai ki mujhe use rokna pada, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aage nikalne se bachaane ke liye. Unhone, safar ke daurane, mujhse kaha: Kya tumne shaadi ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone dobara kaha: Kya ye ek kunwari se hai ya jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse? Maine kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse, isper unhone dobara kaha: Kyun na ek jawaan larki se, jiske saath tum khel sakte aur woh tumhare saath khel sakti? Maine kaha: Meri behnein hain, is liye maine ek aisi aurat se shaadi karna behtar samjha jo unhe ekjut rakh sake (ek khaandaan ki tarah), jo unhe sanwaar sake aur unki dekhbhaal kar sake. Unhone kaha: Tum apne ghar jaane hi wale ho, aur wahan tumhe zauja ki khushi milegi. Unhone phir kaha: Kya tum apna oont bechna chaahte ho? Maine kaha: Haan. To unhone mujhse ise ek uqiya, chandi ki, mein khareeda. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunche aur main shaam ko pahuncha. Main masjid gaya aur unhe masjid ke darwaze par paaya, aur unhone kaha: Kya ab tum pahunche ho? Maine kaha: Haan, unhone kaha: Apna oont chhod do, aur daakhil ho aur do rakat namaz padho. To main daakhil hua aur do rakat namaz padhi, aur phir wapas aaya. Unhone phir Bilal ko hukum diya ki woh mere liye ek uqiya, chandi ki, tolein. Bilal ne mere liye tola, taraazu ka pallada niche karte hue. To main chal diya aur jab main peeth mode raha tha unhone kaha: Jabir ko wapas bulaao. To mujhe wapas bulaaya gaya, aur maine (khud se) socha: Woh mujhe oont wapas kar denge, aur ismein mujhe koi khushi nahi thi (kyunki main qeemat pa chuka tha aur oont bhi wapas mil raha tha). Unhone kaha: Apna oont lo aur uski keemat bhi apne paas rakho.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a journey, and I was riding a camel meant for carrying water and it lagged behind all persons. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) hit it or goaded it (I think) with something he had with him. And after it (it moved so quickly) that it went ahead of all persons and it struggled with me (to move faster than I permitted It) and I had to restrain it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you sell it at such and such (price)? May Allah grant you pardon. I said: Allah's Apostle, it is yours. He (again) said: Do you sell it at such and such (price)? May Allah grant you pardon. ' I said: Allah's Apostle, it is yours. He said to me: Have you married after the death of your father? I said: Yes. He (again) said: With one previously married or a virgin? I said: With one previously married. He said: Why didn't you marry a virgin who might amuse you and you might amuse her, and she might sport with you and you might sport with her? Abu Nadra said: That was the common phrase which the Muslims spoke:" You do such and such (thing) and Allah may grant you pardon."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, aur main paani laane wale oont par sawaar tha aur woh sab logon se peeche reh gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use maara ya usse kisi cheez se, jo unke paas thi, dhakela. Aur uske baad woh itni tezi se chala ki woh sab logon se aage nikal gaya aur mere saath sangharsh karne laga, mujhe tez chalne se bhi tez chalne ke liye, aur mujhe use rokna pada. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum ise itni-itni (keemat mein) bechte ho? Allah tumhe maafi de. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye aapka hai. Unhone dobara kaha: Kya tum ise itni-itni keemat mein bechte ho? Allah tumhe maafi de. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye aapka hai. Unhone mujhse kaha: Kya tumne apne waalid ki maut ke baad shaadi ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone dobara kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse ya kunwari se? Maine kaha: Jiski pehle shaadi ho chuki thi usse. Unhone kaha: Tumne ek kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki jo tumhe khush kar sake aur tum use khush kar sako, aur woh tumhare saath khele aur tum uske saath khelo? Abu Nadra ne kaha: Ye woh aam kahavat thi jo Musalman kehte the: "Tum itni-itni cheez karte ho aur Allah tumhe maafi de."

e: 'Abdullah b. Amr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The whole world is a provision, and the best object of benefit of the world is the pious woman.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Poori duniya ek saamaan hai, aur duniya ke saamaan mein sabse behtareen ek nek aurat hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Woman is like a rib. When you attempt to straighten it, you would break it. And if you leave her alone you would benefit by her, and crookedness will remain in her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aurat paslee jaisi hai. Jab tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, tum use tod doge. Aur agar tum use akele chhod do to tumhe uska faayda milega, aur uski tedhi-medhi shakl waisi hi rahegi.

e: A hadith like this is reported by another chain of narrators.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Woman has been created from a rib and will in no way be straightened for you; so if you wish to benefit by her, benefit by her while crookedness remains in her. And if you attempt to straighten her, you will break her, and breaking her is divorcing her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Aurat ek paslee se banayi gayi hai aur ye kisi bhi tarah se tumhare liye seedhi nahi ki jaayegi; is liye agar tum uska faayda uthaana chaahte ho, to uska faayda uthaao jabki uski tedhaai bani rahe. Aur agar tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, to tum use tod doge, aur use todna use talaaq dena hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who believes in Allah and the Hereafter, if he witnesses any matter he should talk in good terms about it or keep quiet. Act kindly towards woman, for woman is created from a rib, and the most crooked part of the rib is its top. If you attempt to straighten it, you will break it, and if you leave it, its crookedness will remain there. So act kindly towards women.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai, agar woh kisi maamle ka gawaah bane to use isper achhi tarah baat karni chahiye ya khamosh rehna chahiye. Auraton ke saath meherbaani se pesh aao, kyunki aurat ek paslee se banaayi gayi hai, aur paslee ka sabse tedha hissa uska sabse upari hissa hota hai. Agar tum use seedha karne ki koshish karoge, tum use tod doge, aur agar tum use chhod doge, uski tedhaai wahin rahegi. Is liye auraton ke saath meherbaani se pesh aao.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believing man should not hate a believing woman; if he dislikes one of her characteristics, he will be pleased with another.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek momin aadmi ko ek momin aurat se nafrat nahi karni chahiye; agar use uski ek khoobi napasand hai, to woh uski doosri khoobi se khush hoga.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Had it not been for Eve, woman would have never acted unfaithfully towards her husband.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Hawwa na hoti, to koi bhi aurat kabhi apne shohar ke saath bewafaai na karti.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: These are some of the ahadith which Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and one of these (this one): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had it not been for Bani Isra'il, food would not have become stale, and meal would not have gone bad; and had it not been for Eve, a woman would never have acted unfaithfully toward her husband.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Ye kuch hadeesein hain jo Abu Huraira (RA) ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar Bani Israel na hote, to khaana kabhi baasi na hota, aur gosht kabhi kharaab na hota; aur agar Hawwa na hoti, to koi bhi aurat kabhi apne shohar ke saath bewafaai na karti.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he divorced his wife while she was menstruating during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). 'Umar b. Khattib (Allah be pleased with him) asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Command him ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) to take her back (and keep her) and pronounce divorce when she is purified and she again enters the period of menstruation and she is again purified (after passing the period of menses), and then if he so desires he may keep her and if he desires divorce her (finally) before touching her (without having an intercourse with her), for that is the period of waiting ('ldda) which God, the Exalted and Glorious, has commanded for the divorce of women.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhe hukum do (Abdullah bin Umar ko) ki woh unhe wapas le lein aur unhe rakhein, aur jab woh paak ho jaayein aur phir dobara haiz mein aayein aur phir paak ho jaayein (haiz ki muddat guzarne ke baad), to agar woh chaahein woh unhe rakh sakte hain aur agar chaahein to unhe (aakhirkar) talaaq de sakte hain unhe chhue bina (jinsi milaap kiye bina), kyunki ye woh iddat ki muddat hai jo Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne auraton ki talaaq ke liye muqarrar ki hai.

e: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported that he divorced a wife of his with the pronouncement of one divorce during the period of menstruation. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded him to take her back and keep her until she was purified, and then she entered the period of menses in his (house) for the second time. And he should wait until she was purified of her menses. And then if he would decide to divorce her, he should do so when she was purified before having a sexual intercourse with her; for that was the 'Idda which Allah had commanded for the divorce of women. Ibn Rumh in his narration made this addition: When 'Abdullah was asked about it, he said to one of them: If you have divorced your wife with one pronouncement or two (then you can take her back), for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded me to do it; but if you have divorced her with three pronouncements, then she is forbidden for you until she married another husband, and you disobeyed Allah in regard to the divorce of your wife what He had commanded you. (Muslim said: The word" one divorce" used by Laith is good.)
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zauja ko ek talaaq di haiz ki muddat mein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya ki woh unhe wapas lein aur unhe rakhein jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein, aur phir woh doosri baar unke (ghar) mein haiz mein aayin. Aur unhe intezaar karna chahiye jab tak woh apne haiz se paak na ho jaayein. Aur phir agar woh unhe talaaq dene ka faisla karein, to unhe aisa karna chahiye jab woh paak ho jaayein jinsi milaap se pehle; kyunki ye woh iddat thi jo Allah ne auraton ki talaaq ke liye muqarrar ki thi. Ibn Rumh ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya: Jab Abdullah se iske baare mein poocha gaya, unhone ek shakhs se kaha: Agar tumne apni zauja ko ek ya do talaaq di hai (to tum unhe wapas le sakte ho), kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe aisa karne ka hukum diya tha; lekin agar tumne unhe teen talaaqein di hain, to woh tumhare liye haraam hai jab tak woh kisi doosre shohar se shaadi na kar le, aur tumne Allah ki naafarmani ki apni zauja ki talaaq ke maamle mein jo Usne tumhe hukum diya tha. (Muslim ne kaha: Laith ke zariye istemal kiya gaya lafz "ek talaaq" behtar hai.)

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I divorced my wife during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when she was in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) made a mention of it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Command him to take her back and leave her (in that state) until she is purified. Then (let her) enter the period of second menses, and when she is purified, then divorce her (finally) before having a sexual intercourse with her, or retain her (finally). That is the 'Idda (the prescribed period) which Allah commanded (to be kept in view) while divorcing the women. 'Ubaidullah reported: I said to Nafi': What became of that divorce (pronounced within 'Idda)? He said: It was as one which she counted.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni zauja ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein aur unhe (is halat mein) chhod dein jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein. Phir unhe doosri baar haiz mein aane dein, aur jab woh paak ho jaayein, to unhe talaaq dein (aakhirkar) jinsi milaap se pehle, ya unhe rakh lein (aakhirkar). Ye woh iddat hai jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai auraton ko talaaq dene ke liye. Ubaidullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Nafi se kaha: Us talaaq ka kya hua, jo iddat ke andar di gayi thi? Unhone kaha: Ye ek maani jaati thi jise unhone gina.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah, but he made no mention of the words of Ubaidullah that he said to Nafi'.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone Ubaidullah ke un alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya jo unhone Nafi se kahe.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he divorced his wife during the period of menses. 'Umar (Allah be, pleas'ed with him) asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he commanded him ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) to have her back and then allow her respite until she enters the period of the second menses, and then allow her respite until she is purified, then divorce her (finally) before touching her (having a sexual intercourse with her), for that is the prescribed period which Allah commanded (to be kept in view) for divorcing the women. When Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) was asked about the person who divorces his wife in the state of menses, he said: If you pronounced one divorce or two, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded him to take her back, and then allow her respite until she enters the period of the second menses, and then allow her respite until she is purified, and then divorce her (finally) before touching her (having a sexual intercourse with her) ; and if you have pronounced (three divorces at one and the same time) you have in fact disobeyed your Lord with regard to what He commanded you about divorcing your wife. But she is however (finally separated from you).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zauja ko haiz ki muddat mein talaaq di. Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha, aur unhone unhe (Abdullah bin Umar ko) hukum diya ki woh unhe wapas lein aur phir unhe muhlat dein jab tak woh doosri haiz ki muddat mein daakhil na ho jaayein, aur phir unhe muhlat dein jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein, phir unhe (aakhirkar) talaaq dein unhe chhue bina (jinsi milaap kiye bina), kyunki ye woh muqarrar muddat hai jo Allah ne auraton ki talaaq ke liye muqarrar ki hai. Jab Ibn Umar (RA) se us shakhs ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni zauja ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq deta hai, unhone kaha: Agar tumne ek ya do talaaq di, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya tha ki woh unhe wapas lein, aur phir unhe muhlat dein jab tak woh doosri haiz ki muddat mein daakhil na ho jaayein, aur phir unhe muhlat dein jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein, aur phir unhe (aakhirkar) talaaq dein unhe chhue bina (jinsi milaap kiye bina); aur agar tumne (teen talaaqein ek saath di), to tumne apne Rab ki naafarmani ki us maamle mein jo Usne tumhe apni zauja ki talaaq ke baare mein hukum diya tha. Lekin woh, halaanki, (tumse) hamesha ke liye alag ho chuki hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I divorced my wife while she was in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) made mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he was enraged and he said: Command him to take her back until she enters the second ensuing menses other than the one in which he divorced her and in case he deems proper to divorce her, he should pronounce divorce (finally) before touching her (in the period) when she is purified of her menses, and that is the prescribed period in regard to divorce as Allah has commanded. 'Abdullah made a pronouncement of one divorce and it was counted in case of divorce. 'Abdullah took her back as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iska zikr kiya aur woh naaraaz hue aur kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein jab tak woh doosri aane wali haiz mein daakhil na ho jaayein jisme unhone unhe talaaq nahi di, aur agar woh unhe talaaq dena munaasib samjhein, to unhe (aakhirkar) talaaq deni chahiye unhe chhue bina (haiz ke waqt jab woh paak ho jaayein), aur ye woh muqarrar muddat hai talaaq ke maamle mein jaisa Allah ne hukum diya hai. Abdullah ne ek talaaq di aur ise talaaq ke maamle mein gina gaya. Abdullah ne unhe wapas le liya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya tha.

e: A hadith like this was reported on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of narrators. Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them), however, said: I took her back, and counted this pronouncement of divorce (as valid) with which I divorced her.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Ibn Umar (RA) ne, halaanki, kaha: Maine unhe wapas le liya, aur is talaaq ko gina jise maine di, (jaayez ke taur par).

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he divorced his wife while she was in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) made mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: Command him to take her back, then divorce her when she is pure or she is pregnant.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iska zikr kiya aur unhone kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein, phir unhe talaaq dein jab woh paak hon ya garbhvati hon.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he divorced his wife while she was in her menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about that, and he said: Command him to take her back until she is pure and then she enters the second menses and then becomes pure. Then either divorce her (finally) or retain her.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz mein thin. Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein aur phir doosri haiz mein daakhil hon aur phir paak ho jaayein. Phir ya to unhe (aakhirkar) talaaq dein ya unhe rakh lein.

e: Ibn Sirin reported: One who was blameless (as a narrator) narrated to me for twenty years that Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) pronounced three divorces to his wife while she was in the state of menses. He was commanded to take her back. I neither blamed them (the narrators) nor recognised the hadith (to be perfectly genuine) until I met Abu Ghallab Yunus b. Jubair al-Bahili and he was very authentic, and he narrated to me that he had asked Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with there) and he narrated it to him that he made one pronouncement of divorce to his wife as she was in the state of menses, but he was commanded to take her back. I said: Was it counted (as one pronouncement)? He said: Why not, was I helpless or foolish?
hi: Ibn Sirin ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs jo bilkul bharosemand tha (ek raawi ke taur par) ne mujhe bees saal tak riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar (RA) ne apni zauja ko teen talaaqein di jab woh haiz mein thin. Unhe hukum diya gaya ki woh unhe wapas lein. Maine na to unhe (raawiyon ko) dosh diya na hi is hadees ko (bilkul sahi) samjha jab tak main Abu Ghallab Yunus bin Jubair al-Bahili se nahi mila aur woh bahut bharosemand the, aur unhone mujhe riwayat ki ki unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se poocha tha aur unhone unhe riwayat ki ki unhone apni zauja ko ek talaaq di jab woh haiz mein thin, lekin unhe hukum diya gaya ki woh unhe wapas lein. Maine kaha: Kya ise (ek talaaq ke taur par) gina gaya? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi, kya main bebas ya moorkh tha?

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ayyub with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ayyub ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ayyub reported a hadith like this with the same chain of narrators and he said: Umar (Allah be pleased with him) asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about it and he commanded him that he should take her back until she is divorced in the state of purity without having a sexual intercourse with her, and said: Divorce her in the beginning of her 'Idda or her 'Idda commences.
hi: Ayyub ne isi jaisi hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki aur unhone kaha: Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha aur unhone unhe hukum diya ki woh unhe wapas lein jab tak woh paak ki halat mein talaaq na de jinsi milaap kiye bina, aur kaha: Unhe unki iddat ki shuruaat mein talaaq do ya unki iddat shuru ho.

e: Yunus b. Jubair reported: I said to Ibn'Umar (Allah be pleased with them): A person divorcedhis wife while she was in the state of menses, whereupon he said: Do you know 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them), for he divorced his wife in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked him, and he (the Holy Prophet) commanded him that he should take her back, and she started her 'Idda. I said to him: When a person divorces his wife, and she is in the state of menses, should that pronouncement of divorce be counted? He said: Why not, was he hopless or foolish?
hi: Yunus bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha: Ek shakhs ne apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz mein thin, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe Abdullah bin Umar (RA) pata hai, kyunki unhone apni zauja ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di. Umar (RA) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse poocha, aur unhone unhe hukum diya ki woh unhe wapas lein, aur unki iddat shuru hui. Maine unse kaha: Jab koi shakhs apni zauja ko talaaq deta hai, aur woh haiz ki halat mein hai, kya us talaaq ko gina jaana chahiye? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi, kya woh bebas ya moorkh tha?

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I divorced my wife while she was in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah he pleased wish him) came toAllah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made mention of that to him, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told that be should take her back, and when she is pure he may divorce her. if he would so wish. I (one of the narrators) said to Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them): Did you count (this pronouncement of divorce) in her case? He said: What (after all) prevents him from doing so? Do you find him (Ibn Umar) either helpless or foolish?
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Umar (RA) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bataaya ki unhe use wapas lena chahiye, aur jab woh paak ho jaaye woh use talaaq de sakta hai, agar woh aisa chaahe. Ek raawi ne Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha: Kya aapne uska (talaaq ka) shumaar unke maamle mein kiya? Unhone kaha: Kya, aakhirkaar, use aisa karne se rok raha hai? Kya tum use (Ibn Umar ko) bebas ya moorkh paate ho?

e: Anas b. Sirin reported: I asked Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) about the woman whom he had divorced. He said: I divorced her while she was in the state of menses. It was mentioned to 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) and he then made a mention of that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Command him to take her back and when the period of menses is over, then (he may divorce her in the state of her purity.
