He (Ibn Umar) said: So I took her back, then divorced her in her purity. I (the narrator) said: Did you count that divorce which you pronounced in the state of menses? He said: Why should I not have counted that? Was I helpless or foolish?
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) se us aurat ke baare mein poocha jise unhone talaaq di thi. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Iska zikr Umar (RA) se kiya gaya aur unhone phir iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein aur jab haiz ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, to woh unhe unki paak ki halat mein talaaq de sakte hain. Unhone (Ibn Umar ne) kaha: To maine unhe wapas le liya, phir unhe unki paak ki halat mein talaaq di. Maine (raawi ne) kaha: Kya aapne us talaaq ko gina jo aapne haiz ki halat mein di? Unhone kaha: Main ise kyun na ginta? Kya main bebas ya moorkh tha?

e: Anas b. Sirin reported that he had heard Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) as saying. I divorced my wife while she was in the state of menses. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and informed him about it, whereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: Command him to take her back and when she is pure, then divorce her. I said to Ibn 'Umar Allah be pleased with them): Did you count that pronouncement of divorce? He said: Why not?
hi: Anas bin Sirin ne bayan kiya ki unhone Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Maine apni zauja ko talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Umar (RA) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iski khabar di, isper unhone kaha: Unhe hukum do ki woh unhe wapas lein aur jab woh paak ho jaayein, to unhe talaaq dein. Maine Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha: Kya aapne us talaaq ko gina? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi?

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation in wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Ibn Tawus narrated on the authority of his father that Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) was asked about the person who divorced his wife in the state of menses, whereupon he said: Do you know 'Abdullah b. Umar? He said: Yes. He said: It was he who divorced his wife jn the state of menses and 'Umar went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and gave him this information. and he commanded him that he should take her back; and he (Abu Tawus) said: I did not hear any addition to this (hadith) from my father.
hi: Ibn Tawus ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar (RA) se us shakhs ke baare mein poocha gaya jisne apni zauja ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe Abdullah bin Umar pata hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Yehi woh the jinhone apni zauja ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di aur Umar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe ye khabar di, aur unhone unhe hukum diya ki woh unhe wapas lein; aur unhone (Abu Tawus ne) kaha: Maine apne walid se iske aage koi izafa nahi suna.

e: Abu Zubair reported that he heard 'Abd al-Rahman b. Aiman (the freed slave of 'Azza) say that he asked Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) and Abu Zubair heard: What is your opinion about the person who divorced his wife in the state of menses? Thereupon he said: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) divorced his wife during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while she was in the state of menses. Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told him to take her back and so he took her back and he (further) said: When she is pure, then either divorce her or retain her. Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) then recited this verse:" O Apostle, when you divorce women, divorce them at the commencement of their prescribed period" (Ixv 1).
hi: Abu Zubair ne riwayat ki ki unhone Abd al-Rahman bin Aiman (Azza ke aazad kiye hue ghulam) ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se poocha, aur Abu Zubair ne suna: Aapki us shakhs ke baare mein kya raay hai jisne apni zauja ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di? Isper unhone kaha: Ibn Umar (RA) ne apni zauja ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein talaaq di jab woh haiz ki halat mein thin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe kaha ki woh unhe wapas lein aur to unhone unhe wapas le liya aur unhone aage kaha: Jab woh paak ho jaayein, to unhe ya to talaaq den ya rakh len. Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir ye aayat padhi: "Aye Nabi, jab tum auraton ko talaaq do, unhe unki muqarrar muddat ki shuruaat mein talaaq do" (65:1).

e: The story in the above hadith has likewise been narrated through another chain.
hi: Upar bataayi gayi hadees ki kahaani isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this is reported on the same authority (but with this difference that the narrator) 'Abd al-Rahman b. Aiman (was mentioned) as the freed slave of 'Urwa (Imam Muslim said: He made a mistake who said that it was 'Urwa; it was in fact the freed slave of 'Azza.)
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki raawi Abd al-Rahman bin Aiman ka zikr Urwa ke aazad kiye hue ghulam ke taur par kiya gaya hai (Imam Muslim ne kaha: Jisne kaha ki ye Urwa the, unhone galti ki; woh dar-asal Azza ke aazad kiye hue ghulam the.)

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the (pronouncement) of three divorces during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and that of Abu Bakr and two years of the caliphate of Umar (Allah be pleased with him) (was treated) as one. But Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) said: Verily the people have begun to hasten in the matter in which they are required to observe respite. So if we had imposed this upon them, and he imposed it upon them.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki teen talaaqon ka ailaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein, aur Abu Bakr ke daur mein, aur Umar (RA) ki khilafat ke pehle do saalon mein ek (talaaq) ke taur par maana jaata tha. Lekin Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Yaqeenan log us maamle mein jaldi karne lage hain jismein unhe muhlat rakhni chahiye. Is liye agar humne ise unpar laagu kar diya, aur unhone ise unpar laagu kar diya.

e: Abu Sahba' said toIbn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): Do you know that three (divorces) were treated as one during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and that of Abu Bakr, and during three (years) of the caliphate of Umar (Allah be pleased with him)? Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: Yes.
hi: Abu Sahba ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Kya aap jaante hain ki teen (talaaqein) ek maani jaati thin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein, aur Abu Bakr ke daur mein, aur Umar (RA) ki khilafat ke teen saalon mein? Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Haan.

e: Abu al-Sahba' said to Ibn 'Abbas: Enlighten us with your information whether the three divorces (pronounced at one and the same time) were not treated as one during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr. He said: It was in fact so, but when during the caliphate of 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) people began to pronounce divorce frequently, he allowed them to do so (to treat pronouncements of three divorces in a single breath as one).
hi: Abu al-Sahba ne Ibn Abbas se kaha: Humein apni jaankaari se roshan kijiye ki kya teen talaaqein (ek hi baar mein di gayi) ek nahi mani jaati thin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ke zindagi kaal mein. Unhone kaha: Ye waaqai aisa hi tha, lekin jab Umar (RA) ki khilafat mein log baar-baar talaaq dene lage, unhone unhe aisa karne ki ijazat di (yaani ek hi saans mein di gayi teen talaaqon ko ek maane).

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported about (declaring of one's woman) unlawful as an oath which must be atoned, and Ibn 'Abbas said: Verily, there is in the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a model pattern for you.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne apni aurat ko haraam quraar dene ke baare mein riwayat ki ki ye ek qasam hai jiska kaffara dena zaroori hai, aur Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein tumhare liye ek namoona hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: When a man declares his wife unlawful for himself that is an oath which must be atoned, and he said: There is in the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a noble pattern for you.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab koi shakhs apni zauja ko apne liye haraam quraar deta hai, ye ek qasam hai jiska kaffara dena zaroori hai, aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein tumhare liye ek shaandaar namoona hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) narrated that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to spend time with Zainab daughter of Jahsh and drank honey at her house. She ('A'isha further) said: I and Hafsa agreed that one whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) would visit first should say: I notice that you have an odour of the Maghafir (gum of mimosa). He (the Holy Prophet) visited one of them and she said to him like this, whereupon he said: I have taken honey in the house of Zainab bint Jabsh and I will never do it again. It was at this (that the following verse was revealed): 'Why do you hold to be forbidden what Allah has made lawful for you... (up to). If you both ('A'isha and Hafsa) turn to Allah" up to:" And when the Prophet confided an information to one of his wives" (lxvi. 3). This refers to his saying: But I have taken honey.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zainab bint Jahsh ke saath waqt bitaate the aur unke ghar mein shahad peete the. Unhone, Aisha ne, aage kaha: Main aur Hafsa ne ye tay kiya ki jinke paas bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pehle aayein, unhe kehna chahiye: Mujhe lagta hai ki aapse Maghafir (Mimosa flava ki gond) ki khushboo aa rahi hai. Woh (Nabi) unmein se ek ke paas gaye aur unhone unse aisa kaha, isper unhone kaha: Maine Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar mein shahad piya hai aur main phir kabhi aisa nahi karunga. Ye isi mauqe par tha ki ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum kyun uss cheez ko haraam maante ho jise Allah ne tumhare liye jaayez kiya hai..." (waghera). "Agar tum dono, Aisha aur Hafsa, Allah ki taraf rujoo karti ho" waghera: "Aur jab Nabi ne apni ek zauja se ek raaz baanta" (66:3). Ye unke us kehne ki taraf ishara karta hai: Lekin maine shahad piya hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) liked sweet (dish) and honey. After saying the afternoon prayer he used to visit his wives going close to them. So he went to Hafsa and stayed with her more than what was his usual stay. I ('A'isha) asked about that. It was said to me: A woman of her family had sent her a small vessel of honey as a gift, and she gave to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from that a drink. I said: By Allah, we would also contrive a device for him. I mentioned that to Sauda, and said: When he (Allah's Apostle) would visit you and draw close to you, say to him: Allah's Messenger, have you taken maghafir? And he would'say to you: No. Then say to him: What is this odour? And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt it very much that unpleasant odour should emit from him. So he would say to you: Hafsa has given me a drink of honey. Then you should say to him: The honey-bees might have sucked 'Urfut, and I would also say the same to him and. Safiyya, you should also say this. So when he (the Holy Prophet) came to Sauda, she said: By Him besides whom there is no god, it was under compulsion that I had decided to state that which you told me when he would be at a little distance at the door. So when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came near, she said: Messenger of Allah, did you eat Maghafir? He said: No. She (again) said: Then what is this odour? He said: Hafsa gave me honey to drink. She said: The honey-bee might have sucked 'Urfut. When he came to me I told him like this. He then visited Safiyya and she also said to him like this. When he (again) visited Hafsa, she said: Messenger of Allah, should I not give you that (drink)? He said: I do not need that. Sauda said: Hallowed be Allah, by Him we have (contrived) to make that (honey) unlawful for him. I said to her: Keep quiet.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko meethi cheezein aur shahad pasand tha. Asr ki namaz padhne ke baad woh apni zaujaon ke paas jaate unke qareeb aakar. To woh Hafsa ke paas gaye aur unke saath apni maamool se zyada der theherey. Maine, Aisha ne, iske baare mein poocha. Mujhe bataaya gaya: Unke khaandaan ki ek aurat ne unhe shahad ka ek chhota bartan tohfe mein diya tha, aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko usmein se ek peene ki cheez di. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum bhi unke liye koi tarkeeb sochenge. Maine iska zikr Sauda se kiya, aur kaha: Jab woh, Allah ke Rasool, aapke paas aayein aur qareeb aayein, unse kaho: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne maghafir liya hai? Aur woh tumse kahenge: Nahi. Phir unse kaho: Ye kaisi khushboo hai? Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye bahut naapasand tha ki unse koi naapasand khushboo aaye. To woh tumse kahenge: Hafsa ne mujhe shahad peene ko diya. Phir tumhe unse kehna chahiye: Shahad ki makkhiyon ne Urfut chusa hoga, aur main bhi unse yehi kahungi aur Safiyyah, tumhe bhi ye kehna chahiye. To jab woh Sauda ke paas aaye, unhone kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi, ye majboori mein tha ki maine faisla kiya woh kehne ka jo tumne mujhse kaha jab woh darwaze par thode fasle par honge. To jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qareeb aaye, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne Maghafir khaya? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone dobara kaha: To ye kaisi khushboo hai? Unhone kaha: Hafsa ne mujhe shahad piya. Unhone kaha: Shahad ki makkhi ne Urfut chusa hoga. Jab woh mere paas aaye maine unse ye hi kaha. Woh phir Safiyyah ke paas gaye aur unhone bhi unse ye hi kaha. Jab woh dobara Hafsa ke paas gaye, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main aapko woh (peene ki cheez) na dun? Unhone kaha: Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi hai. Sauda ne kaha: Allah ki tareef ho, humne ise unke liye haraam kar diya. Maine unse kaha: Khamosh raho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Urwa ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was commanded to give option to his wives, he started it from me saying: I am going to mention to you a matter which you should not (decide) in haste until you have consulted your parents. She said that he already knew that my parents would never allow me to seek separation from him She said: Then he said: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: Prophet, say to thy wives: If you desire this world's life and its adornment, then come, I will give you a provision and allow you to depart a goodly departing; and if you desire Allah and His Messenger and the abode of the Hereafter, then Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward She is reported to have said: About what should I consult my parents, for I desire Allah and His Messenger and the abode of the Hereafter? She ('A'isha) said: Then all the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did as I had done.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko hukum diya gaya ki woh apni zaujaon ko ikhtiyar den, unhone ye mujhse shuru kiya ye kehte hue: Main tumhe ek baat batane ja raha hoon jise tumhe jaldbaazi mein tay nahi karna chahiye jab tak tum apne maa-baap se salaah na le lo. Unhone kaha ki unhe pehle se pata tha ki mere maa-baap mujhe kabhi unse alag hone ki salaah nahi denge. Unhone kaha: Phir unhone kaha: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: Nabi, apni zaujaon se kaho: Agar tum duniya ki zindagi aur uski shaan-o-shaukat chaahti ho, to aao, main tumhe kuch saamaan dunga aur tumhe achhi tarah rukhsat dunga; aur agar tum Allah aur uske Rasool aur Aakhirat ka ghar chaahti ho, to Allah ne tummein se achhaai karne walon ke liye ek bada sawaab taiyaar kiya hai. Unhone kaha ki unhone kaha: Main kis baare mein apne maa-baap se salaah loon, kyunki main Allah aur uske Rasool aur Aakhirat ka ghar chaahti hoon? Unhone, Aisha ne, kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki saari zaujaon ne wahi kiya jo maine kiya tha.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sought our permission when he had a (turn to spend) a day with (one of his wives) amongst us (whereas he wanted to visit his other wives too). It was after this that this verse was revealed: " Thou mayest put off whom thou pleasest of them, and take for thee whom thou pleasest" (xxxiii. 5). Mu'adha said to her: What did you say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he sought your permission? She said: I used to say: If it had the option in this I would not have (allowed anyone) to have precedence over me.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hamse ijazat maangi jab unki baari ek zauja ke saath din guzaarne ki thi, jabki woh doosri zaujaon se bhi milna chahte the. Isi ke baad ye aayat nazil hui: "Tum unmein se jise chaaho peeche rakh sakte ho aur jise chaaho apne paas rakh sakte ho" (33:5). Mu'adha ne unse kaha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kya kaha jab unhone aapse ijazat maangi? Unhone kaha: Main kehti thi: Agar isme mujhe koi ikhtiyar hota to main kisi ko bhi apne upar tarjeeh na deti.

e: The above hadith has likewise been narrated through another chain.
hi: Upar bayan hui hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave us the option (to get divorce) but we did not deem it as divorce.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyar diya, talaaq ke liye, lekin humne ise talaaq nahi samjha.

e: Masruq reported: I do not mind if I give option to my wife (to get divorce) once, hundred times, or thousand times after (knowing it) that she has chosen me (and would never seek divorce). I asked 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) (about it) and she said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave us the option, but did it imply divorce? (It was in fact not a divorce; it is effective when women actually avail themselves of it.)
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Mujhe koi aitraaz nahi hai agar main apni zauja ko ek baar, sau baar, ya hazaar baar ikhtiyar dun, ye jaante hue ki unhone mujhe chuna hai aur kabhi talaaq nahi maangengi. Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyar diya, lekin kya usse talaaq hoti hai? Ye asal mein talaaq nahi thi; ye tab prabhaavi hoti jab auraten waaqai isse istemal karti.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave option to his wives, but it was not a divorce.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko ikhtiyar diya, lekin ye talaaq nahi thi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave us the option (to get divorce) and we chose him and he did not count it a divorce.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyar diya, talaaq ke liye, aur humne unhe chuna aur unhone ise talaaq nahi maana.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messeinger (ﷺ) gave us the option (to get divorce), but me made a choice of him and he did not count anything (as divorce) in regard to us.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyar diya, talaaq ke liye, lekin humne unhi ko chuna aur unhone hamare maamle mein kuch bhi talaaq nahi maana.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of narrators.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) came and sought permission to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He found people sitting at his door and none amongst them had been granted permission, but it was granted to Abu Bakr and he went in. Then came 'Umar and he sought permission and it was granted to him, and he found Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sitting sad and silent with his wives around him. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: I would say something which would make the Prophet (ﷺ) laugh, so he said: Messenger of Allah, I wish you had seen (the treatment meted out to) the daughter ofKhadija when you asked me some money, and I got up and slapped her on her neck. Allah's Messenger (mav peace be upon him) laughed and said: They are around me as you see, asking for extra money. Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) then got up went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and slapped her on the neck, and 'Umar stood up before Hafsa and slapped her saying: You ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which he does not possess. They said: By Allah, we do not ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for anything he does not possess. Then he withdrew from them for a month or for twenty-nine days. Then this verse was revealed to him:" Prophet: Say to thy wives... for a mighty reward" (xxxiii. 28). He then went first to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and said: I want to propound something to you, 'A'isha, but wish no hasty reply before you consult your parents. She said: Messenger of Allah, what is that? He (the Holy Prophet) recited to her the verse, whereupon she said: Is it about you that I should consult my parents, Messenger of Allah? Nay, I choose Allah, His Messenger, and the Last Abode; but I ask you not to tell any of your wives what I have said He replied: Not one of them will ask me without my informing her. God did not send me to be harsh, or cause harm, but He has sent me to teach and make things easy.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu Bakr (RA) aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone paaya ki log unke darwaze par baithe hain aur unmein se kisi ko ijazat nahi mili thi, lekin Abu Bakr ko ijazat mil gayi aur woh andar gaye. Phir Umar aaye aur unhone bhi ijazat maangi aur unhe bhi mil gayi, aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko udaas aur khaamosh baitha paaya, unki zaujaon se ghire hue. Unhone, Hazrat Umar ne, kaha: Main aisa kuch kahunga jisse Nabi (SAW) hansenge, is liye unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kaash aapne dekha hota ki Khadija ki beti ka kya haal hua, jab aapne mujhse kuch paisa maanga, aur main uthkar uski gardan par thappad maara. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hanse aur kaha: Woh mere aas-paas hain jaisa tum dekh rahe ho, zyada paisa maang rahi hain. Abu Bakr (RA) phir uthe, Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur unki gardan par thappad maara, aur Umar Hafsa ke saamne khade hue aur unhe thappad maara ye kehte hue: Tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se woh maangti ho jo unke paas nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch nahi maangte jo unke paas nahi hai. Phir woh unse ek mahine ke liye, ya untees dinon ke liye, alag ho gaye. Phir unpar ye aayat nazil hui: "Nabi: Apni zaujaon se kaho... bade sawaab ke liye" (33:28). Woh phir sabse pehle Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur kaha: Aisha, mujhe tumse ek baat kehni hai, lekin mujhe koi jaldbaazi bhara jawaab nahi chahiye isse pehle ki tum apne maa-baap se salaah lo. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh kya hai? Unhone woh aayat unhe padh kar sunayi, isper unhone kaha: Kya ye aap ke baare mein hai ki main apne maa-baap se salaah lun, Allah ke Rasool? Nahi, main Allah ko, Uske Rasool ko, aur Aakhri Ghar ko chunti hoon; lekin main aapse kehti hoon ki apni kisi bhi zauja ko mat batayiye jo maine kaha hai. Unhone jawab diya: Unmein se koi bhi mujhse bina bataye nahi poochegi. Allah ne mujhe sakhti karne ya nuksaan pahunchaane ke liye nahi bheja, balki Usne mujhe sikhaane aur cheezon ko aasaan banaane ke liye bheja hai.

e:
'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) kept himself away from his wives, I entered the mosque, and found people striking the ground with pebblesand saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has divorced his wives, and that was before they were commanded to observe seclusion 'Umar said to himself: I must find this (actual position) today. So I went to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and said (to her): Daughter of Abu Bakr, have you gone to the extent of giving trouble to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon she said: Son of Khattab, you have nothing to do with me, and I have nothing to do with you. You should look to your own receptacle. He ('Umar) said: I visited Hafsa daughter of 'Umar, and said to her: Hafsa, the (news) has reached me that you cause Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) trouble. You know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) does not love you, and had I not been (your father) he would have divorced you. (On hearing this) she wept bitterly. I said to her: Where is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Shesaid: He is in the attic room. I went in and found Rabah, the servant of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), sitting on the thresholds of the window dangling his feet on the hollow wood of the date-palm with the help of which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) climbed (to the apartment) and came down. I cried: 0 Rabah, seek permission for me from Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him). Rabah cast a glance at the apartment and then looked toward me but said nothing. I again said: Rabah, seek permission for me from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Rabah looked towards the apartment and then cast a glance at me, but said nothig. I then raised my voice and said: 0 Rabah, seek permission for me from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I think that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is under the impression that I have come for the sake of Hafsa. By Allah, if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would command me to strike her neck, I would certainly strike her neck. I raised my voice and he pointed me to climb up (and get into his apartment). I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he was lying on a mat. I sat down and he drew up his lower garment over him and he had nothing (else) over him, and that the mat had left its marks on his sides. I looked with my eyes in the store room of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I found only a handful of barley equal to one sa' and an equal quantity of the leaves of Mimosa Flava placed in the nook of the cell, and a semi-tanned leather bag hanging (in one side), and I was moved to tears (on seeing this extremely austere living of the Holy Piophet), and he said: Ibn Khattab, what wakes you weep? 
I said: Apostle of Allah, why should I not shed tears? This mat has left its marks on your sides and I do not see in your store room (except these few things) that I have seen; Ceasar and Closroes are leading their lives in plenty whereas you are Allah's Messenger. His chosen one, and that is your store! He said: Ibn Khattab, aren't you satisfied that for us (there should be the prosperity) of the Hereafter, and for them (there should be the prosperity of) this world? I said: Yes. And as I had entered I had seen the signs of anger on his face, and I therefore, said: Messenger of Allah, what trouble do you feel from your wives, and if youhave divorced them, verily Allah is with you, His angels, Gabriel, Mika'il, I and Abu Bakr and the believers are with you. And seldom I talked and (which I uttered on that day) I hoped that Allah would testify to my words that I uttered. And so the verse of option (Ayat al-Takhyir) was revealed. Maybe his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your place wives better than you..." (Ixv. 5). And if you back up one another against him, then surely Allah is his Patron, and Gabriel and the righteous believers, and the angels after that are the aidera (lvi. 4). And it was 'A'isha, daughter of Abu Bakr, and Hafsa who had prevailed upon all the wives of Allah's Prophet (way peace be upon him) for (pressing them for mote money). I said: Messenger of Allah, have you divorced them? He said: No. I said: Messenger of Allah, I entered the mosque and found the Muslims playing with pebbles (absorbed in thought) and saying: Allah's Messenger has divorced his wives. Should I get down and inform there that you have not divorced them? He said: Yes, if you so like. And I went on talking to him until I (found) the signs of anger disappeared on his face and (his seriousness was changed to a happy mood and as a result thereof) his face had the natural tranquillity upon it and he laughed and his teeth were the most charming (among the teeth) of all people. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) climbed down and I also climbed down and catching hold of the wood of the palm-tree and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came down (with such ease) as if he was walking on the ground, not touching anything with his hand (to get support). I said: Messenger of Allah, you remained in your apartment for twenty-nine days. He said: (At times) the month consists of twenty-nine days. I stood at the door of the mosque and I called out at the top of my voice: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has not divorced his wives (and it was on this occasion that this) verse was revealed:" And if any matter pertaining to peace or alarm comes within their ken, they broadcast it; whereas, if they would refer it to the Apostle and those who have been entrusted with authority amongst them, those of them who are engaged in obtaining intelligence would indeed know (what to do with) it" (iv 83). And it was I who understood this matter, and Allah revealed the verse pertaining to option (given to the Prophet (may peace be upon him in regard to the retaining or divorcing of his wives).
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko apni zaujaon se alag rakha, main masjid mein daakhil hua, aur maine paaya ki log kankariyon se zameen kood rahe hain aur keh rahe hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai, aur ye us waqt se pehle tha jab unhe parda karne ka hukum diya gaya. Umar ne apne dil mein kaha: Mujhe aaj ye asaliyat pata karni hai. To main Aisha (RA) ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Abu Bakr ki beti, kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko takleef dene ki had tak chali gayi ho? Isper unhone kaha: Khattab ke bete, tumhe mujhse koi lena-dena nahi, aur mujhe tumse koi lena-dena nahi. Tumhe apne khud ke bartan par dhyaan dena chahiye. Unhone, Umar ne, kaha: Main Umar ki beti Hafsa se mila, aur unse kaha: Hafsa, ye khabar mujhe mili hai ki tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko takleef pahunchaati ho. Tumhe pata hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumse muhabbat nahi karte, aur agar main, tumhara waalid, na hota to woh tumhe talaaq de dete. Ye sunkar woh zaar-zaar rone lagin. Maine unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool kahan hain? Unhone kaha: Woh chhat wale kamre mein hain. Main andar gaya aur maine paaya ki Rabah, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khaadim, chhote darwaze ki dahleez par baithe apne paon khajoor ke khokhle tane par latka rahe hain jiski madad se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) upar chadhkar aate-jaate the. Maine chillaaya: Aye Rabah, mere liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maango. Rabah ne kamre ki taraf nazar daali aur phir meri taraf dekha lekin kuch nahi kaha. Maine phir kaha: Rabah, mere liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maango. Rabah ne kamre ki taraf dekha aur phir meri taraf nazar daali, lekin kuch nahi kaha. Maine phir apni aawaaz buland ki aur kaha: Aye Rabah, mere liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maango. Mujhe lagta hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko laga hoga ki main Hafsa ke liye aaya hoon. Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe unki gardan maarne ka hukum dete, to main zaroor unki gardan maarta. Maine apni aawaaz buland ki aur unhone mujhe ishara kiya ki main upar chadh jaaun. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya, aur woh ek chataayi par lete hue the. Main baith gaya aur unhone apna neechla kapda apne upar khainch liya aur unke paas aur kuch nahi tha, aur chataayi ne unke pehluon par nishaan chhod diye the. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke bhandaar mein apni nazron se dekha. Maine sirf ek mutthi bhar jau paayi jo ek sa ke barabar thi, aur utni hi maqdaar mein Mimosa Flava ke patte ek konay mein rakhe the, aur ek aadha ranga hua chamde ka thaila ek taraf latak raha tha, aur main aansuon mein bah gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ibn Khattab, tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe kyun na roona aaye? Is chataayi ne aapke pehluon par nishaan chhod diye hain aur main aapke bhandaar mein siwaay in kuch cheezon ke aur kuch nahi dekh raha; Caesar aur Chosroes apni zindagi bahutayat mein guzaar rahe hain jabki aap Allah ke Rasool hain, Uske chune hue, aur ye aapka bhandaar hai! Unhone kaha: Ibn Khattab, kya tum santusht nahi ho ki hamare liye Aakhirat ki khushhaali ho, aur unke liye is duniya ki? Maine kaha: Haan. Aur jab main daakhil hua tha maine unke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dekhe the, is liye maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko apni zaujaon se kya takleef hai, aur agar aapne unhe talaaq de di hai, to yaqeenan Allah aapke saath hai, Uske farishte, Jibra'eel, Mika'il, aur main aur Abu Bakr aur momino aapke saath hain. Aur maine kam hi baat ki, aur main ummeed karta hoon ki Allah meri un baaton ki tasdeeq karega jo maine kahin. Aur is tarah Aayat al-Takhyir (ikhtiyar ki aayat) nazil hui: Shayad unka Rab, agar woh tumhe talaaq de, to tumhari jagah tumse behtar zaujaen unhe de... (65:5). Aur agar tum dono unke khilaaf ek-doosre ki madad karo, to yaqeenan Allah uska sarparast hai, aur Jibra'eel aur nek momin, aur uske baad farishte madadgaar hain (66:4). Aur ye Aisha, Abu Bakr ki beti, aur Hafsa thin jinhone Allah ke Nabi ki saari zaujaon ko (zyada paisa maangne ke liye) apna majboot himayat diya tha. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne unhe talaaq de di? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main masjid mein daakhil hua aur Musalmaanon ko kankariyon se khelte (fikr mein doobe) aur ye kehte paaya: Allah ke Rasool ne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai. Kya mujhe utarkar unhe bataana chahiye ki aapne unhe talaaq nahi di? Unhone kaha: Haan, agar tum chaho. Aur main tab tak unse baat karta raha jab tak main gusse ke nishaan unke chehre se gaayab hote nahi dekh liye aur unki sanjeedagi khushi mein badal gayi aur unke chehre par ek fitrati shaanti aa gayi aur woh hanse aur unke daant sab logon mein sabse khoobsurat the. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) neeche utre aur main bhi utra, khajoor ke tane ko pakadte hue, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is tarah utre jaise woh zameen par chal rahe hon, bina apne haath se kisi cheez ko chhue (madad ke liye). Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap apne kamre mein untees din se the. Unhone kaha: Kabhi kabhi mahina untees din ka hota hai. Main masjid ke darwaze par khada hua aur poori aawaaz mein pukaara: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko talaaq nahi di hai, aur isi mauqe par ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur agar koi shanti ya khatre se jude maamla unke saamne aata hai, woh use aam kar dete hain; jabki agar woh ise Rasool aur unke beech se ikhtiyar rakhne walon ke paas bhejein, to unmein se jo ilm rakhte hain unhe zaroor pata chal jaayega ki usse kya karna hai" (4:83). Aur ye main hi tha jisne ye maamla samjha, aur Allah ne Nabi (SAW) ko unki zaujaon ko rakhne ya talaaq dene ke baare mein ikhtiyar se mutalliq aayat nazil ki.

e:
Abdullah b. Abbas (Allah be pleased with tlicm) reported: I intended to ask 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) about a verse, but I waited for one year to ask him out of his fear, until he went out for Pilgrimage and I also accompanied him. As he came back and we were on the way he stepped aside towards an Arak tree to ease himself. I waited for him until he was free. I then walked along with him and said: Commander of the Faithful, who are the two among the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who backed up one another (in their demand for extra money)? He said: They were Hafsa and 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with them). I said to him: It is for one year that I intended to ask you about this matter but I could not date so on account of the awe for you. He said: Don't do that. If you think that I have any knowledge, do ask me about that. And if I were to know that, I would inform you. He (the narrator) stated that 'Umar had said: By Allah, during the days of ignorance we had no regard for women until Allah the Exalt- ed revealed about them what He has revealed, and appointed (turn) for them what he appointed. He said: It so happened that I was thinking about some matter that my wife said: I wish you had done that and that. I said to her: It does not concern you and you should not feel disturbed in a matter which I intend to do. She said to me: How strange is it that you, O son of Khattab, do not like anyone to retort upon you, whereas your daughter retorts upon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upou him) until he spends the day in vexation. 'Umar said: I took hold of my cloak, then came out of my house until I visited Hafsa and said to her: O daughter, (I heard) that you retort upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until he spends the day in vexation, whereupon Hafsa said: By Allah, we do retort upon him. I said: You should bear in mind, my daughter, that I warn you against the punishment of Allah and the wrath of His Messenger (ﷺ). You may not be misled by one whose beauty has fascinated her, and the love of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for her. I ('Umar) then visited Umm Salama because of my relationship with her and I talked to her. Umm Salama said to me: Umar b. al-Khattab, how strange is it that you meddle with every matter so much so that you are anxious to interfere between Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his wives, and this perturbed me so much that I refrained from saying what I had to say, so I came out of her apartment, and I had a friend from the Anar. 
When I had been absent (from the company of the Holy Prophet) he used to bring me the news and when he had been absent I used to bring him the news, and at that time we dreaded a king of Ghassan. It was mentioned to us that he intended to attack us, and our minds were haunted by him. My friend, the Ansari, came to me, and he knocked at the door and said: Open it, open it. I said: Has the Ghassani come? He said: (The matter is) more serious than that. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has separated himself from his wives. I said: Let the nose of Hafsa and 'A'isha be besmeared with dust. I then took hold of my cloth and went out until I came and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his attic to which he climbed by means of a ladder made of date-palm, and the servant of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was black had been sitting at the end of the ladder. I said: This is Umar. So permission was granted to me. I narrated this news to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and as I narrated the news concerning Umm Salama, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled. He was lying on the mat and there was nothing between him and that (mat), and under his head there was a pillow made of leather and it was stuffed with plam fibres and at his feet were lying a heap of sant tree (acacia niloctica, meant for dyeing) and near his head there was hanging a hide. And I saw the marks of the maton the side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and so I wept. He said: What makes you weep? I said: Messenger of Allah, the Khusrau and the Ceasars (spendd their lives in) the midst of (luxuries), whereas you being Allah's Messenger (are leading your life in this poverty). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't you like that they should have riches of their world, and you have the Hereafter.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mera iraada Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) se ek aayat ke baare mein poochne ka tha, lekin main unse ek saal tak unke dar ki wajah se nahi poochh saka, yahan tak ki woh Hajj ke liye nikle aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Jab woh wapas aa rahe the aur hum raaste mein the, woh ek Arak darakht ki taraf gaye khud ko halka karne ke liye. Main unka intezaar karta raha jab tak woh farigh hue. Main phir unke saath chala aur kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se woh do kaun thin jinhone ek-doosre ka himayat kiya (zyada paisa maangne mein)? Unhone kaha: Woh Hafsa aur Aisha (RA) thin. Maine unse kaha: Ek saal se main aapse ye poochhna chahta tha lekin aapke dar ki wajah se aisa nahi kar saka. Unhone kaha: Aisa mat karo. Agar tumhe lagta hai ki mujhe koi ilm hai, to mujhse zaroor poochho. Aur agar mujhe woh pata hoga, to main tumhe bataunga. Unhone kaha ki Umar ne kaha tha: Allah ki qasam, jaahiliyat ke daur mein hum auraton ki koi tavajjo nahi dete the yahan tak ki Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne unke baare mein woh nazil kiya jo Usne nazil kiya, aur unke liye woh muqarrar kiya jo Usne muqarrar kiya. Unhone kaha: Aisa hua ki main kisi baat ke baare mein soch raha tha ki meri zauja ne kaha: Kaash aapne aisa aisa kiya hota. Maine unse kaha: Isse tumhara koi lena-dena nahi, aur tumhe us maamle mein pareshaan nahi hona chahiye jo main karna chaahta hoon. Unhone mujhse kaha: Kitni ajeeb baat hai ki tum, Khattab ke bete, kisi ko bhi apne khilaaf jawaab dena pasand nahi karte, jabki tumhari beti Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab deti hai yahan tak ki woh poora din pareshaan rehte hain. Umar ne kaha: Maine apna chogha uthaaya, phir apne ghar se bahar nikla yahan tak ki main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Beti, maine suna hai ki tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab deti ho yahan tak ki woh poora din pareshaan rehte hain, isper Hafsa ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum unhe zaroor jawaab dete hain. Maine kaha: Tumhe ye baat dhyaan mein rakhni chahiye, meri beti, ki main tumhe Allah ki saza aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ke gusse se aagah karta hoon. Tum us shakhs ke bhramit na ho jiski khoobsurati ne use lubhaaya hai, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka usse muhabbat. Main, Umar, phir Umm Salama ke paas gaya kyunki mera unse rishtedaari ka taalluq tha aur maine unse baat ki. Umm Salama ne mujhse kaha: Umar bin al-Khattab, kitni ajeeb baat hai ki tum har maamle mein dakhal dete ho, itna zyada ki tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unki zaujaon ke beech bhi dakhal dena chahte ho, aur isne mujhe itna pareshaan kiya ki maine woh baat kehna hi chhod diya jo main kehna chaahta tha, is liye main unke kamre se bahar chala gaya, aur mera ek dost Ansar mein se tha. Jab main gair-haazir hota, woh mere liye khabar laata aur jab woh gair-haazir hota, main uske liye khabar laata, aur us waqt hum Ghassan ke ek raja se dar rahe the. Humein bataaya gaya tha ki uska hamla karne ka iraada hai, aur hamare zehan uske khyaal se pareshaan the. Mera Ansar dost mere paas aaya, aur usne darwaza khadkhadaaya aur kaha: Khol do, khol do. Maine kaha: Kya Ghassani aa gaya hai? Usne kaha: Isse zyada sangin baat hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni zaujaon se khud ko alag kar liya hai. Maine kaha: Hafsa aur Aisha ki naak mitti se sanni ho. Maine phir apna kapda uthaaya aur bahar nikla yahan tak ki main aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke chhat wale kamre mein paaya jahan woh khajoor ke tane se bani seedhi se chadhte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khaadim, jo kaale rang ka tha, seedhi ke aakhri hisse mein baitha hua tha. Maine kaha: Ye Umar hai. To mujhe ijazat mil gayi. Maine ye khabar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sunayi aur jab maine Umm Salama ke baare mein khabar sunayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye. Woh chataayi par lete hue the aur unke aur uske beech kuch nahi tha, aur unke sar ke neeche chamde ka takiya tha jismein khajoor ke reshe bhare hue the aur unke paon ke paas sant darakht (rangaai ke kaam aane wale ek podhe) ka dher pada tha aur unke sar ke qareeb ek chamda latak raha tha. Aur maine chataayi ke nishaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke pehlu par dekhe, is liye main ro pada. Unhone kaha: Kis baat ne tumhe rulaaya? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Khusrau aur Caesar aish o araam mein zindagi guzaar rahe hain, jabki aap, Allah ke Rasool hokar, is gareebi mein zindagi guzaar rahe hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhe pasand nahi ki unke paas is duniya ki daulat abhi ho, aur tumhare paas Aakhirat ho.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: I came along with Umar until we reached Marr al-Zahran (the name of a place), and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Sulaiman b. Bilal (except with) the variation (of words) that I said: (What) about these two women? He said: They were Hafsa and Umm Salama. And he made this addition: I came to the apartments and in every apartment there was (the noise) of weeping. And this addition was also made: And he (the Holy Prophet) had taken an oath of remaining away from them for a month, and when twenty-nine days had passed, he visited them.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Main Umar ke saath aaya yahan tak ki hum Marr al-Zahran (ek jagah ka naam) pahunche, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Sulaiman bin Bilal ne riwayat ki, siwaay is farq (alfaazon mein) ke ki maine kaha: In do auraton ka kya hai? Unhone kaha: Woh Hafsa aur Umm Salama thin. Aur unhone ye izafa kiya: Main kamron mein aaya aur har kamre mein rone ki awaaz thi. Aur ye izafa bhi kiya gaya: Aur unhone ek mahine ke liye unse door rehne ki qasam khayi thi, aur jab untees din guzar chuke, woh unse milne aaye.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) is reported to have said: I intended to ask Umar about those two ladies who had pressed for (worldly riches) during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ), and I kept waiting for one year, but found no suitable opportunity with him until I happened to accompany him to Mecca. And as he reached Marr al Zahran he went away to answer the call of nature, and he said (to me): Bring me a jug of water, and I took that to him. After having answered the call of nature, as he came back, I began to pour water (over his hands and feet), and I remembered (this event of separation of Allah's Apostle  for providing comforts of life) and I had not yet finished my talk when he said: They were 'A'isha and Hafsa.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha: Mera iraada Umar se un do khavateen ke baare mein poochne ka tha jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein (duniyaavi daulat ke liye) zor daala, aur main ek saal tak intezaar karta raha, lekin unke saath koi munaasib mauqa nahi mila jab tak main unke saath Makkah nahi gaya. Aur jab woh Marr al-Zahran pahunche woh paishaab-paakhaana ki zaroorat ke liye chale gaye, aur unhone mujhse kaha: Mere liye paani ka ek jag laao, aur main woh unke paas le gaya. Zaroorat poori karne ke baad, jab woh wapas aaye, main paani daalne laga (unke haathon aur paon par), aur mujhe ye ghatna yaad aa gayi (zindagi ki aaram-suvidhaon ki alagta ke baare mein) aur maine abhi apni baat khatm nahi ki thi ki unhone kaha: Woh Aisha aur Hafsa thin.

e:
Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported. I had always been anxious to ask 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) about the two ladies amongst the wives of Allah's Prophet (may peace be upon Lim) about whom Allah, the Exalted, said: " If you both turn in repentance to Allah, then indeed your hearts are inclined (to this)" (Ixvi. 4), until 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) set out for Hajj and I also went along with him. And as we were going along a path, 'Umar (Allah be pleased with hiyn) went aside and I also went aside with him with a jug (of water). He answered the call of nature, and then came to me and I poured water over his hands and he performed ablution I said: Commander of the Faithful, who are the two ladies amongst the wives of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) about whom Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: 'If you both turn to Allah in repentance, then indeed your heart are inclined to it"? 'Umar (Allah he pleased with him) said: How strange is it for you, Ibn 'Abbas! (Zuhri said: By Allah, he disliked what he asked about, but did not keep it a secret.) He ('Umar) said: They are Hafsa and 'A'isha; and he then began to narrate the hadith and said: We were such people among the Quraish who dominated women, and as we reached Medina we found there people who were dominated by their women, and our women began to learn (the habits) of their women. He further said: And my house was situated in the suburb of Aledina in the tribe of Banu Umayya b. Zaid. One day I became angry with my wife and she retorted upon me. I did not like that she should retort upon me. She said: You disapprove of my retorting upon you By Allah, the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) retort upon him, and one of them detaches herself from him for the day until the night. So I ('Umar) went out and visited Hafsa and said: Do you retort upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She said: Yes. I said; Does any one of you detach herself from him from the day to the night? She said: Yes. He said: She who did like it amongst you in fact failed and incurred loss. Does everyone amongst you not fear the wrath of Allah upon her due to the wrath of His Messenger (ﷺ), and (as a result thereof) she may perish? So do not retort upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and do not ask him for anything, but ask me that which you desire, (and the frank behaviour) of your companion may not mislead you, if she is more graceful and is dearer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than you (meaning 'A'isha) (Allah be pleased with her). 
He (Hadrat 'Umar further) said: I had a compalaion from the Ansar and, we used to remain in the company of the Messenger (ﷺ) turn by turn. He remained there for a day while I remained there on the other day, and he brought me the news about the revelation and other (matter), and I brought him (the news) like this. And we discussed that the Ghassanids were shoeing the horses in order to attack us. Id y companion once attended (the Apostle). and then came to me at night and knocked at my door and called me, and I came out to him, and he said: A matter of great importance has happened. I said: What is that? Have the Ghassanids come? He said: No, but even more serious and more significant than that: the Prophet (ﷺ) has divorced his wives. I said: Hafsa has failed and has incurred loss. and I feared that it would happen. When it was dawn I observed the dawn prayer and dressed myself, and then came there (in the house of the Holy Prophet) and visited Hafsa, and she was weeping. I said: Has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divorced you (all)? She said: I do not know. He has, however, separated himself in his attic. I came to a black servant and said to him: Seek permission for 'Umar. He went in and then came to me and said: I made mention of you to him, but he kept quiet. I then went to the pulpit and sat there, and there was a group of people sitting by it and some of then were weeping. I sat there for some time, until I was overpowered (by that very idea) which was in my mind. I then came back to the boy and said to him: Seek permission for Umar. He went in and came to me and said: I made mention of you to him but he kept quiet. I was about to turn back when the boy called me and said: Go in; permission has been granted to you. I went in and greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was reclining against the couch of mat and it had left its marks upon his side. I said: Messenger of Allah, have you divorced your wives? He raised his head towards me and said: No. I said: Allah is the Greatest. Messenger of Allah, I wish if you had seen how we the people of Quraish had domination over women but when we came to Medina we found people whom their women dominated. So our women began to learn from their women. One dily I became angry with my wife and she began to retort upon me. I did not approve that she should retort upon me. She said: You do not like that I should retort upon you, but, by Allah. the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) retort upon him and any one of them separates herself from him for a day until night. I said: He who did that amongst them in fact failed and incurred loss. Does any of them feel sate from the wrath of Allahupon her due to the wrath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and she has certainly perished. Allah's Messtnger (ﷺ) smiled, I said: Messenger of Allah, I visited Hafsa and said: (The behaviour) of your companion ('A'isha) may not mislead you, If she is more graceful than you and is dearer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than you. 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled for the second time. I said: Allah's Messenger, way I talk to you about agreeable things? He said: Yes. I sat down and lifted my head (to see things) in the house and, by Allah, I did not see anything significant besides three hides. I said: Messenger of Allah, supplicate the Lord that He should make (life) prosperous for your Ummah as He has made plentiful for the people of Persia and Rome (in spite of the fact) that they do no, worship Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) sat up an I then said: Ibn Khattab, do you doubt that they are a nation whom their nice things have been given immediately in the life of this world. I said: Allah's Messenger! seek pardon for me. And he (Allah's Messenger) had taken an oath that he would not visit them for a month due to extreme annoyance with them until Allah showed His displeasure to him (Allah's Messenger). Zuhri said: 'Urwa informed me that 'A'Isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: When twenty-nine nights were over, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me, and he began (his visit) with me. I said: Messenger of Allah, you had taken an oath that you would not visit us for a month, while you have visited after I have counted only twenty-nine (nights). Thereupon he said: The month may also be of twenty-nine (days). He then said: 'A'isha, I am going to talk to you about a matter, and you should not be hasty in it (and do not give your final decision) until you have consulted your parents. He then recited this verse to me:" O Prophet, say to your wives" till he reached" mighty reward" (xxxiii. 28). 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: By Allah, he knew that my parents would not allow me to separate from him. I said: Is there any need to consult my parents in this matter? I in fact choose Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) and the abode in the Hereafter. Ma'mar said: Ayyub reported to me that 'A'isha said: Don't inform your wives that I have chosen you, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah has sent me as a conveyer of message, and He has not sent me as a source of hardship (to others). Qatada said:" Saghat qulubukum" means" Your hearts have inclined."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main hamesha ye poochne ke liye betaab tha Umar (RA) se un do khavateen ke baare mein Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se jinke baare mein Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: "Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba mein mudho, to yaqeenan tumhare dil jhuk chuke hain" (66:4), yahan tak ki Umar (RA) Hajj ke liye nikle aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Aur jab hum ek raaste par ja rahe the, Umar (RA) alag ho gaye aur main bhi unke saath paani ke jag ke saath alag ho gaya. Unhone zaroorat poori ki, aur phir mere paas aaye aur maine unke haathon par paani daala aur unhone wuzu kiya. Maine kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein woh do khavateen kaun hain jinke baare mein Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: 'Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba mein mudho, to yaqeenan tumhare dil jhuk chuke hain'? Umar (RA) ne kaha: Kitni ajeeb baat hai tumhare liye, Ibn Abbas! (Zuhri ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhe napasand tha jo unhone poocha lekin ise raaz nahi rakha.) Unhone kaha: Woh Hafsa aur Aisha hain; aur phir woh hadees riwayat karne lage aur kaha: Hum aise log the Quraish mein jo auraton par hukmaraan the, aur jab hum Madina pahunche humein wahan log mile jo apni auraton se hukmaraani mein the, aur hamari auraten unki auraton ki aadatein seekhne lagin. Unhone aage kaha: Aur mera ghar Madina ke bahri hisse mein tha Banu Umayya bin Zaid qabile mein. Ek din main apni zauja par gussa hua aur unhone mujhe jawaab diya. Mujhe ye pasand nahi tha ki woh mujhe jawaab de. Unhone kaha: Aap ise napasand karte hain ki main aapko jawaab dun. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen unhe jawaab deti hain, aur unmein se ek din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai. To main, Umar, bahar gaya aur Hafsa ke paas gaya aur kaha: Kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab deti ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya tum mein se koi din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Jisne tum mein se aisa kiya usne dar-asal khud ko nuksaan pahunchaaya. Kya tum mein se har ek ko Allah ke gusse ka dar nahi hai uske Rasool (SAW) ke gusse ki wajah se, aur (natijatan) woh tabaah na ho jaaye? Is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab mat do aur unse kuch mat maango, lekin mujhse maango jo tumhe chahiye, (aur tumhari saathi ka khulapan) tumhe bhramit na kare, agar woh tumse zyada khoobsurat hai aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumse zyada aziz hai (unka matlab Aisha se tha) (RA). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne aage) kaha: Mera ek saathi Ansar mein se tha, aur hum baari-baari Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein rehte the. Woh ek din wahan rahte jabki main doosre din wahan rahta, aur woh mere paas wahi aur doosre maamle ki khabar laata, aur main use is tarah khabar laata. Aur humne charcha ki ki Ghassanids apne ghodon ko naal chadhaa rahe hain hamare khilaaf hamla karne ke liye. Mera saathi ek baar Nabi ke paas gaya, aur phir raat ko mere paas aaya aur mera darwaza khatkhataaya aur mujhe bulaaya, aur main unke paas bahar aaya, aur unhone kaha: Ek bahut aham baat hui hai. Maine kaha: Woh kya hai? Kya Ghassanids aa gaye hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin isse bhi zyada sangin aur ahem: Nabi (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai. Maine kaha: Hafsa tabaah ho gayi aur nuksaan uthaaya, aur mujhe dar tha ki aisa hoga. Jab subah hui, maine fajr ki namaz padhi aur khud ko taiyaar kiya, aur phir wahan aaya (Nabi ke ghar) aur Hafsa ke paas gaya, aur woh ro rahi thin. Maine kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe (sab ko) talaaq de di hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata. Unhone, halaanki, apne chhat wale kamre mein khud ko alag kar liya hai. Main ek kaale khaadim ke paas aaya aur usse kaha: Umar ke liye ijazat maango. Woh andar gaya aur phir mere paas aaya aur kaha: Maine unse aapka zikr kiya, lekin woh khamosh rahe. Main phir mimbar ki taraf gaya aur wahan baitha, aur wahan ek giroh baitha hua tha aur unmein se kuch ro rahe the. Main wahan kuch der baitha raha, jab tak main us khyaal se dabaav mein aa gaya jo mere zehan mein tha. Main phir launde ke paas aaya aur usse kaha: Umar ke liye ijazat maango. Woh andar gaya aur mere paas wapas aaya aur kaha: Maine unse aapka zikr kiya lekin woh khamosh rahe. Main wapas jaane hi wala tha ki launde ne mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Andar jaao; aapko ijazat mil gayi hai. Main andar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko salaam kiya aur woh ek chataayi wale takht par tek lagaaye hue the aur usne unke pehlu par nishaan chhod diye the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai? Unhone apna sar meri taraf uthaaya aur kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Allah sabse Buland hai. Allah ke Rasool, kaash aapne dekha hota ki hum, Quraish ke log, kaise auraton par hukmaraan the lekin jab hum Madina aaye, humein aise log mile jinhein unki auraten hukmaraan karti thin. To hamari auraten bhi unki auraton se seekhne lagin. Ek din main apni zauja par gussa hua aur woh mujhe jawaab dene lagi. Mujhe pasand nahi tha ki woh mujhe jawaab de. Unhone kaha: Aapko pasand nahi ki main aapko jawaab dun, lekin, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen unhe jawaab deti hain aur unmein se koi ek din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai. Maine kaha: Jisne aisa kiya usne dar-asal khud ko nuksaan pahunchaaya. Kya unmein se koi Allah ke gusse se apne aap ko mahfooz mehsoos karti hai uske Rasool (SAW) ke gusse ki wajah se, aur woh zaroor tabaah ho gayi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye, maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur kaha: (Tumhari saathi Aisha ki) khulapan tumhe bhramit na kare, agar woh tumse zyada khoobsurat hai aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumse zyada aziz hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) doosri baar muskuraaye. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main aapse kuch khushnuma baaton par baat kar sakta hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan. Main baith gaya aur apna sar uthaaya (cheezein dekhne ke liye) ghar mein aur, Allah ki qasam, maine teen chamdon ke ilawa koi aham cheez nahi dekhi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, apne Rab se dua kijiye ki Woh aapki ummat ke liye khushhaali karde jaisa Usne Farsi aur Roman logon ke liye bahutayat ki hai jabki woh Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ki ibadat nahi karte, isper woh (Allah ke Rasool) baithe aur maine phir kaha: Ibn Khattab, kya tumhe shaq hai ki woh ek qaum hain jinhe unki achhi cheezein isi duniyavi zindagi mein turant di gayi hain. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool! mere liye maafi maangiye. Aur unhone, Allah ke Rasool, qasam khayi thi ki woh unse ek mahine ke liye nahi milenge unke saath ziyaadti ki wajah se yahan tak ki Allah ne unhe apni napasandeegi dikhaayi. Zuhri ne kaha: Urwa ne mujhe bataya ki Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Jab untees raaten guzar gayin, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye, aur unhone apna dauraa mere saath shuru kiya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne qasam khayi thi ki aap humse ek mahine tak nahi milenge, jabki aap sirf untees (raaton) ke baad aaye hain jinhe maine gina hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mahina untees (dinon) ka bhi ho sakta hai. Unhone phir kaha: Aisha, main tumse ek maamle par baat karne wala hoon, aur tumhe usmein jaldbaazi nahi karni chahiye jab tak tum apne maa-baap se salaah na lo. Unhone phir ye aayat mujhe padhi: "Aye Nabi, apni zaujaon se kaho" yahan tak ki woh pahunche "bade sawaab" (33:28). Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhe pata tha ki mere maa-baap mujhe unse alag hone ki ijazat nahi denge. Maine kaha: Kya ismein mere maa-baap se salaah lene ki koi zaroorat hai? Main dar-asal Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko chunti hoon. Ma'mar ne kaha: Ayyub ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Aisha ne kaha: Apni doosri zaujaon ko mat bataayiye ki maine aapko chuna hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne mujhe ek payaam pahunchaane wale ke taur par bheja hai, aur Usne mujhe doosron ke liye mushkilon ka zariya banaakar nahi bheja hai. Qatada ne kaha: "Saghat qulubukum" ka matlab hai "Tumhare dil jhuk gaye hain."

e: Fatima bint Qais reported that Abu 'Amr b. Hafs divorced her absolutely when he was away from home, and he sent his agent to her with some barley. She was displeased with him and when he said: I swear by Allah that you have no claim on us. she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said: There is no maintenance due to you from him, and he commanded her to spend the 'Idda in the house of Umm Sharik, but then said: That is a woman whom my companions visit. So better spend this period in the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man and you can put off your garments. And when the 'Idda is over, inform me. She said: When my period of 'Idda was over, I mentioned to him that Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan and Jahm had sent proposal of marriage to me, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: As for Abu Jahm, he does not put down his staff from his shoulder, and as for Mu'awiya, he is a poor man having no property; marry Usama b. Zaid. I objected to him, but he again said: Marry Usama; so I married him. Allah blessed there in and I was envied (by others).
hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki Abu Amr bin Hafs ne unhe poori tarah talaaq de di jab woh ghar se door the, aur unhone apna agent unke paas kuch jau ke saath bheja. Woh unse naaraaz thin aur jab unhone kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ki tumhara humpar koi haq nahi hai, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unse ye zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: Tumhare liye unse koi bhar-poshan nahi banta hai, aur unhone unhe Umm Sharik ke ghar mein iddat guzaarne ka hukum diya, lekin phir kaha: Woh ek aisi aurat hain jinke ghar mere sahaba aate hain. Is liye behtar hoga ki tum ye muddat Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein guzaaro, kyunki woh ek andhe aadmi hain aur tum apne kapde utaar sakti ho. Aur jab iddat khatam ho jaaye, mujhe bataana. Unhone kaha: Jab meri iddat ki muddat khatam ho gayi, maine unhe bataaya ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan aur Jahm ne mujhe shaadi ka prastaav bheja hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak Abu Jahm ka sawal hai, woh apni chhadi apne kandhe se neeche nahi rakhte, aur jahan tak Muawiya ka sawal hai, woh ek gareeb aadmi hai jiske paas koi maal nahi hai; Usama bin Zaid se shaadi karo. Maine unse aitraaz kiya, lekin unhone phir kaha: Usama se shaadi karo; to maine unse shaadi ki. Allah ne isme barkat di aur mujhse doosron ko rashk hua.

e: Fatima bint Qais reported that her husband divorced her during the life time of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) and gave her a meagre maintenance allowance. When she saw that, she said: By Allah, I will inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and if maintenance allowance is due to me then I will accept that which will suffice me, and if it is not due to me, I will not accept anything from him. She said: I made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: There is neither maintenance allowance for you nor lodging.
hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar ne unhe Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein talaaq di aur unhe thoda bhar-poshan diya. Jab unhone ye dekha, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataungi, aur agar bhar-poshan mujhe milna chahiye to main woh qubool karungi jo mere liye kaafi ho, aur agar ye mera haq nahi hai, to main unse kuch qubool nahi karungi. Unhone kaha: Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone kaha: Na tumhe bhar-poshan milega na hi rehne ki jagah.

e: Fatima bint Qais reported that her husband al-Makhzulmi divorced her and refused to pay her maintenance allowance. So she came to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) and informed him, whereupon he said: There is no maintenance allowance for you, and you better go to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum and live with him for he is a blind man and you can put off your clothes in his house (i. e. you shall not face much difficulty in observing purdah there).
hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar al-Makhzumi ne unhe talaaq di aur unhe bhar-poshan dene se inkaar kiya. To woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhe bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai, aur behtar hoga ki tum Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar jao aur unke saath raho kyunki woh ek andhe aadmi hain aur tum unke ghar mein apne kapde utaar sakti ho (yaani tumhe wahan parde ki adhik zaroorat nahi padegi).

e: Abu Salama reported that Fatima bint Qais, the sister of al-Dahhak b. Qais informed him that Abu Hafs b. Mughira al-Makhzumi divorced her three times and then he proceeded on to the Yemen. The members of his family said to her: There is no maintenance allowance due to you from us. Khalid b. Walid along with a group of persons visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the house of Maimuna and they said: Abu Hafs has divorced his wife with three pronouncements; is there any maintenance allowance due to her? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No maintenance allowance is due to her, but she is required to spend the 'Idda; and he sent her the message that she should not be hasty in making a decision about herself and commanded her to move to the house of Umm Sharik, and then sent her the message that as the first immigrants (frequently) visit the house of Umm Sharik, she should better go to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, the blind, (and further said: In case you put off your head-dress, he (Ibn Umm Makhtum) will not see you. So she went to his house, and when the 'Idda was over, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her to Usama b. Zaid b. Haritha.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki Fatima bint Qais, al-Dahhak bin Qais ki behn, ne unhe bataaya ki Abu Hafs bin Mughira al-Makhzumi ne unhe teen baar talaaq di aur phir Yemen chale gaye. Unke khaandaan ke logon ne unse kaha: Humse tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi banta. Khalid bin Walid kuch logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Maimuna ke ghar gaye aur kaha: Abu Hafs ne apni zauja ko teen baar talaaq di hai; kya unke liye koi bhar-poshan banta hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unke liye koi bhar-poshan nahi banta, lekin unhe iddat guzaarni zaroori hai; aur unhone unhe payaam bheja ki woh apne baare mein jaldbaazi mein faisla na len aur unhe Umm Sharik ke ghar mein muntaqil hone ka hukum diya, aur phir unhe payaam bheja ki chunki pehle Muhajir Umm Sharik ke ghar (aksar) aate hain, unhe behtar hoga Ibn Umm Maktum, andhe, ke ghar jaana chaahiye, aur ye bhi kaha: Agar tum apna sar ka kapda utaar do, woh (Ibn Umm Maktum) tumhe nahi dekhenge. To woh unke ghar gayi, aur jab iddat khatam hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki shaadi Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha se karwaayi.

e: Fatima bint Qais reported: I had been married to a person from Banu Makhzum and he divorced me with irrevocable divorce. I sent a message to his family asking for maintenance allowance, and the rest of the hadith has been transmitted with a slight change of words.
hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya: Meri shaadi Banu Makhzum ke ek shakhs se hui thi aur unhone mujhe akhandit talaaq di. Maine unke khaandaan ko bhar-poshan ke liye payaam bheja, aur baaki hadees alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she had been married to Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira and he divorced her with three pronouncements. She stated that she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him about abandoning that house. He commanded her to move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, the blind. Marwan refused to testify the divorced woman abandoning her house (before the 'Idda was over). 'Urwa said that 'A'isha objected to (the words of) Fatima bint Qais.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unki shaadi Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira se hui thi aur unhone unhe teen baar talaaq di. Unhone bataya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi unse ghar chhodne ke baare mein poochne ke liye. Unhone unhe Ibn Umm Maktum, andhe, ke ghar mein jaane ka hukum diya. Marwan ne talaaqshuda aurat ki iddat khatam hone se pehle ghar chhodne ki gawaahi dene se inkaar kiya. Urwa ne kaha ki Aisha ne Fatima bint Qais (ke alfaazon) par aitraaz kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted through another chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba reported that 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira set out along with 'Ali b. Abi Talib (Allah be pleased with him) to the Yemen and sent to his wife the one pronouncement of divorce which was still left from the (irrevocable) divorce; and he commanded al-Harith b. Hisham and 'Ayyash b. Abu Rabi'a to give her maintenance allowance. They said to her: By Allah, there is no maintenance allowance for you, except in case you are pregnant. She came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and mentioned their opinion to him, whereupon he said: There is no maintenance allowance for you. Then she sought permission to move (to another place), and he (the Holy Prophet) permitted her. She said: Allah's Messenger, where (should I go)? He said: To the house of Ibn Umm Maktum and, as he is blind, she could put off her garmeqts in his presence and he would not see her. And when her 'Idda was over. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married her to Usama b. Zaid. Marwan (the governor of Medina) sent Qabisa b. Dhuwaib in order to ask her about this hadith, and she narrated it to him, whereupon Marwan said: We have not heard this hadith but from a woman. We would adopt a safe (path) where we found the people. Fatima said that when these words of, Marwan were conveyed to her. There is between me and you the word of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic: Do" not turn them out" of their houses. She asserted: This is in regard to the revocable divorce what new (turn can the event take) after three pronouncements (separation between irrevocable). Why do you say there is no maintenance allowance for her if she is not pregnant? Then on what ground do you restrain her?
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba ne bayan kiya ki Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath Yemen ke liye nikle aur apni zauja ko akhri talaaq bheji jo (akhandit) talaaq mein se baaki bachi thi; aur unhone al-Harith bin Hisham aur Ayyash bin Abu Rabi'a ko unhe bhar-poshan dene ka hukum diya. Unhone unse kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai, siwaay is baat ke ki tum garbhvati ho. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unki raay unhe bataayi, isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai. Phir unhone (ghar) muntaqil hone ki ijazat maangi, aur unhone unhe ijazat de di. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kahan (jaaun)? Unhone kaha: Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar, aur woh andhe hain, woh apne kapde unke saamne utaar sakti hain aur woh unhe nahi dekhenge. Aur jab unki iddat khatam hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki shaadi Usama bin Zaid se karwaayi. Marwan (Madina ke gavarnar) ne Qabisa bin Dhuwaib ko unse is hadees ke baare mein poochne bheja, aur unhone use ye riwayat ki, isper Marwan ne kaha: Humne ye hadees sirf ek aurat se suni hai. Hum ek mahfooz raasta apnaayenge jahan humne logon ko paaya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha ki jab Marwan ke ye alfaaz unhe pahunchaaye gaye. Mere aur tumhare beech Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ka lafz hai: "Unhe unke gharon se mat nikaalo." Unhone kaha: Ye akhandit talaaq ke baare mein hai; teen baar talaaq (poori talaaq) ke baad kya naya rukh ho sakta hai? Tum kyun kehte ho ki unke liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai agar woh garbhvati nahi hain? Phir tum kis buniyaad par unhe rokte ho?

e: Sha'bi reported: I visited Fatima bint Qais and asked her about the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about (board and lodging during the 'Idda) and she said that her husband divorced her with an irrevocable divorce. She (further. said): I contended with him before Allah's Messerger (ﷺ) about lodging and maintenance allowance, and she said: He did not provide me with any lodging or maintenance allowance, and he commanded me to spend the 'Idda in the house of Ibn Umm Maktum.
hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Main Fatima bint Qais ke paas gaya aur unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke fatwe ke baare mein poocha (rehne aur bhar-poshan ke baare mein iddat ke daurane) aur unhone kaha ki unke shohar ne unhe akhandit talaaq di. Unhone aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne rehne aur bhar-poshan ke baare mein unse jhagda kiya, aur unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe koi rehne ki jagah ya bhar-poshan nahi diya, aur unhone mujhe Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein iddat guzaarne ka hukum diya.

e: A hadith like this has been trarismitted on the authority of Hushaim through another chain of narrators.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hushaim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sha'bi reported: We visited Fatima bint Qais and she served us fresh dates and a drink of barley flour, and I asked her: Where should a woman who has been divorced by three pronouncements, spend the period of her 'Idda. She said: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements, and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) permitted me to spend my 'Idda period with my family (with my parents).
hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Hum Fatima bint Qais ke paas gaye aur unhone humein taazi khajooren aur jau ke aate ka sherbet pesh kiya, aur maine unse poocha: Ek aurat, jise teen baar talaaq mili hai, kahan apni iddat ki muddat guzaare? Unhone kaha: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apni iddat apne khaandaan ke saath, apne maa-baap ke saath, guzaarne ki ijazat di.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that there is no lodging and maintenance allowance for a woman who has been given irrevocable divorce.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki us aurat ke liye koi rehne ki jagah aur bhar-poshan nahi banta jise akhandit talaaq di gayi ho.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements. I decided to move (from his house to another place). So I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: Move to the house of your cousin 'Amr b. Umm Maktum and spend your period of 'Idda there.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di. Maine (ghar se doosri jagah) muntaqil hone ka faisla kiya. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi, aur unhone kaha: Apne chachere bhai Amr bin Umm Maktum ke ghar muntaqil ho jao aur apni iddat ki muddat wahan guzaaro.

e: Abu Ishaq reported: I was with al-Aswad b. Yazid sitting in the great mosque, and there was with us al-Sha'bi, and he narrated the narration of Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not make any provision for lodging and maintenance allowance for her. Al-Aswad caught hold of some pebbles in his fist and he threw them towards him saying: Woe be to thee, you narrate like it, whereas Umar said: We cannot abandon the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of our Apostle (ﷺ) for the words of a woman. We do not know whether she remembers that or she forgets. For her, there is a provision of lodging and maintenance allowance. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said:" Turn them not from their houses nor should they themselves go forth unless they commit an open indecency" (lxv. 1).
hi: Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Main al-Aswad bin Yazid ke saath badi masjid mein baitha tha, aur hamare saath al-Sha'bi bhi the, aur unhone Fatima bint Qais (RA) ki riwayat sunaayi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi kiya. Al-Aswad ne mutthi bhar kankariyaan uthaayin aur unhe unki taraf phenka ye kehte hue: Tumpar afsos, tum aisa riwayat karte ho, jabki Umar ne kaha: Hum Allah ki Kitaab aur hamare Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ko ek aurat ke alfaazon ke liye nahi chhod sakte. Humein nahi pata ki woh yaad rakhti hai ya bhool jaati hai. Uske liye rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam hai. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: "Unhe unke gharon se mat nikaalo, na hi unhe khud nikalna chahiye jab tak woh koi khula bura kaam na karein" (65:1).

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ishaq ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that her husband divorced her with three, pronouncements and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made no provision for her lodging and maintenance allowance. She (further said): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: When your period of 'Idda is over, inform me. So I informed him. (By that time) Mu'awiya, Abu Jahm and Usama b. Zaid had given her the proposal of marriage. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: So far as Mu'awiya is concerned, he is a poor man without any property. So far as Abu Jahm is concerned, he is a great beater of women, but Usama b. Zaid... She pointed with her hand (that she did not approve of the idea of marrying) Usama. But Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon himn) said: Obedience to Allah and obedience to His Messenger is better for thee. She said: So I married him, and I became an object of envy.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar ne unhe teen baar talaaq di aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye rehne aur bhar-poshan ka koi intezaam nahi kiya. Unhone aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jab tumhari iddat ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, mujhe bataana. To maine unhe bataaya. (Us waqt tak) Muawiya, Abu Jahm aur Usama bin Zaid ne unhe shaadi ka prastaav diya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak Muawiya ka sawal hai, woh ek gareeb aadmi hai bina kisi maal ke. Jahan tak Abu Jahm ka sawal hai, woh auraton ko bahut maarne wala hai, lekin Usama bin Zaid... Unhone apne haath se ishara kiya ki unhe Usama se shaadi karna pasand nahi tha. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki itaat aur Uske Rasool ki itaat tumhare liye behtar hai. Unhone kaha: To maine unse shaadi ki, aur main rashk ka vishay ban gayi.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira sent 'Ayyish b. Abu Rabi'a to me with a divorce, and he also sent through him five si's of dates and five si's of barley. I said: Is there no maintenance allowance for me but only this, and I cannot even spend my 'Idda period in your house? He said: No. She said: I dressed myself and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
