He said: How many pronouncements of divorce have been made for you? I said: Three. He said what he ('Ayyish b. Abu Rabi'a) had stated was true. There is no maintenance allowance for you. Spend 'Idda period in the house of your cousin, Ibn Umm Maktum. He is blind and you can put off your garment in his presence. And when you have spent your Idda period, you inform me. She said: Mu'awiya and Abu'l-Jahm (Allah be pleased with them) were among those who had given me the proposal of marriage. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Mu'awiya is destitute and in poor condition and Abu'l-Jahm is very harsh with women (or he beats women, or like that), you should take Usama b. Zaid (as your husband).
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira ne Ayyish bin Abu Rabi'a ko mere paas talaaq ke saath bheja, aur unhone unke haath paanch sa khajooren aur paanch sa jau bhi bheji. Maine kaha: Kya mere liye sirf itna hi bhar-poshan hai, aur kya main apni iddat ki muddat bhi aapke ghar mein nahi guzaar sakti? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Maine khud ko taiyaar kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kitni baar talaaq di gayi hai? Maine kaha: Teen baar. Unhone kaha: Jo unhone, Ayyish bin Abu Rabi'a ne, kaha woh sahi hai. Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai. Apni iddat apne chachere bhai, Ibn Umm Maktum, ke ghar mein guzaaro. Woh andhe hain aur tum unke saamne apna kapda utaar sakti ho. Aur jab tum apni iddat ki muddat guzaar chuko, mujhe bataana. Unhone kaha: Muawiya aur Abu'l-Jahm (RA) un logon mein the jinhone mujhe shaadi ka prastaav diya tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Muawiya bebas aur gareeb haalat mein hain aur Abu'l-Jahm auraton ke saath bahut sakht hain, ya woh auraton ko maarte hain, ya isi jaisa, tumhe Usama bin Zaid ko apna shohar banaana chahiye.

e: Abu Bakr b. Abu'l-Jahm reported: I and Abu Salama b 'Abd al-Rahman came to fatima bint Qais (Al! ah be pleased with her) and asked her (about divorce, etc.). She said: I was the wife of Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira, and he set out to join the battle of Najran. The rest of the hadith is the same, but he made this addition:" She said: I married him and Allah hornoured me on account of Ibn Zaid and Allah favoured me because of him."
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abu'l-Jahm ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke paas aaye aur unse (talaaq waghera ke baare mein) poocha. Unhone kaha: Main Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira ki zauja thi, aur woh Najran ki jung mein shaamil hone gaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone ye izafa kiya: Unhone kaha: Maine unse shaadi ki aur Allah ne mujhe Ibn Zaid ki wajah se izzat di aur Allah ne mujhpar unki wajah se meherbaani ki.

e: Abu Bakr reported: I and Abu Salama came to Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) during the time of Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) and she narrated to us that her husband gave her an irrevocable divorce. (The rest of the hadith is the same.)
hi: Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Salama Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke paas aaye Ibn Zubair (RA) ke daur mein aur unhone humein riwayat ki ki unke shohar ne unhe akhandit talaaq di. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made no provision for lodging and maintenance allowance.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi kiya.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Yahya b. Sa'id b. al-'As married the daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Hakam, and he divorced her and he turned her out from his house. 'Urwa (Allah be -pleased with him) criticised this (action) of theirs (the members of the family of her in-laws). They said: Verily, Fatima too went out (of her in-laws' house). 'Urwa said: I came to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and told her about it and she said: There is no good for Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) in making mention of it.
hi: Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Yahya bin Sa'id bin al-As ne Abd al-Rahman bin al-Hakam ki beti se shaadi ki, aur unhone unhe talaaq di aur apne ghar se nikaal diya. Urwa (RA) ne unke (uske sasural walon ke) is amal ki aalochana ki. Unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, Fatima bhi bahar gayi thi (apne sasural ke ghar se). Urwa ne kaha: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya aur unhone kaha: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke liye is baat ka zikr karna achha nahi hai.

e: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she said: Allah's Messenger, my husband has divorcee me with three pronouncements and I am afraid that I may be put to hardship, and so he commanded her and so she moved (to another house).
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di hai aur mujhe dar hai ki mujhe mushkilon mein daala jaayega, aur isper unhone unhe hukum diya aur woh (doosre ghar mein) muntaqil ho gayin.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: It is no good for Fatima to make mention of it, i. e. her statement:" There is no lodging and maintenance allowance (for the divorced women)."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke liye is baat ka zikr karna achha nahi hai, yaani unka ye bayaan: "Talaaqshuda auraton ke liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi hai."

e: Ibn al-Qasim narrated on the authority of his father that 'Urwa b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Didn't you see that such and such daughter of al-Hakam was divorced by her husband with an irrevocable divorce, and she left (the house of her husband)? Thereupon 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: It was bad that she did. He ( Urwa) said: Have you not heard the words of Fatima? Thereupon she said: There if no good for her in making mention of it.
hi: Ibn al-Qasim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Urwa bin Zubair (RA) ne Aisha (RA) se kaha: Kya aapne nahi dekha ki al-Hakam ki falan-falan beti ko uske shohar ne akhandit talaaq di, aur woh (uske sasural ke ghar se) bahar chali gayi? Isper Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Ye bura tha ki usne aisa kiya. Unhone (Urwa ne) kaha: Kya aapne Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke alfaaz nahi sune? Isper unhone kaha: Uske liye ye baat kehna achha nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: My maternal aunt was divorced, and she intended to pluck her dates. A person scolded her for having come out (during the period of 'Idda). She came to Allah's Prophet (may peace be upon him.) and he said: Certainly you can pluck (dates) from your palm trees, for perhaps you may give charity or do an act of kindness.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Meri maasi ko talaaq di gayi thi, aur unka iraada apni khajooren todne ka tha. Ek shakhs ne unhe (iddat ke daurane) bahar aane ke liye daanta. Woh Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhone kaha: Yaqeenan tum apne khajoor ke darakhton se (khajooren) tod sakti ho, kyunki shayad tum sadaqa do ya koi nek kaam karo.

e: 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba (b. Mas'ud) reported that his father wrote to Umar b. 'Abdullah b al Arqam al-Zuhri that he would go to Subai'ah bint al-Hirith al-Aslamiyya (Allah be pleased with her) and ask her about a verdict from him which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her when she had asked that from him (in regard to the termination of 'Idda at the birth of a child) 'Umar b. Abdullah wrote to 'Abdullah b. 'Utba informing him that Subai'ah had told him that she had been married to Sa'd b. Khaula and he belonged to the tribe of Amir b. Lu'ayy, and was one of those who participated in the Battle of Badr, and he died in the Farewell Pilgrimage and she had been in the family way at that time. And much time had not elapsed that she gave birth to a child after his death and when she was free from the effects of childbirth she embellished herself for those who had to give proposals of marriage. Abd al-Sunabil b. Ba'kak (from Banu 'Abd al-Dar) came to her and said: What is this that I see you embellished; perhaps you are inclined to marry, By Allah, you cannot marry unless four months and ten days (of 'Idda are passed). When he said that. I dressed myself, and as it was evening I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about it, and he gave me a religious verdict that I was allowed to marry when I had given birth to a child and asked me to marry if I so liked. Ibn Shihab said: I do not find any harm fur her in marrying when she has given birth to a child even when she is bleeding (after the birth of the child) except that her husband should not go near her until she is purified.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya ki unke walid ne Umar bin Abdullah bin al-Arqam al-Zuhri ko likha ki woh Subai'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyya (RA) ke paas jaayein aur unse ek fatwe ke baare mein poochhein jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe diya tha jab unhone unse ye poocha tha (bachche ki paidaish par iddat khatam hone ke baare mein). Umar bin Abdullah ne Abdullah bin Utba ko likha aur unhe bataya ki Subai'ah ne unhe bataaya tha ki unki shaadi Sa'd bin Khaula se hui thi aur woh Amir bin Lu'ayy qabile ke the, aur Badr ki jung mein shaamil huye the, aur unka intiqaal Vida ke Hajj mein hua aur woh us waqt garbhvati thin. Aur zyada waqt nahi guzra tha ki unhone unki maut ke baad ek bachche ko paida kiya aur jab woh bachche ki paidaish ke asraat se azaad hui to unhone khud ko un logon ke liye sajaaya jinhe shaadi ka prastaav dena tha. Abd al-Sunabil bin Ba'kak (Banu Abd al-Dar se) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Ye kya hai ki main aapko saja hua dekh raha hoon; shayad aap shaadi karna chahti hain, Allah ki qasam, aap shaadi tab tak nahi kar sakti jab tak chaar mahine aur das din (iddat ke) na guzar jaayein. Jab unhone ye kaha, maine khud ko taiyaar kiya, aur chunki shaam ho gayi thi main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone mujhe fatwa diya ki mujhe shaadi ki ijazat hai jab maine bachche ko paidaish de diya hai aur mujhse kaha ki agar main chahun to shaadi kar loon. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Mujhe koi nuksaan nazar nahi aata uske liye shaadi karne mein jab usne bachche ko paidaish de diya ho chahe woh khoon bah raha ho (bachche ki paidaish ke baad) siwaay is baat ke ki uska shohar use tab tak na chhue jab tak woh paak na ho jaaye.

e: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman and Ibn 'Abbas. (Allah be pleased with them) got together in the house of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) and began to discuss about the woman who gave birth to a child a few nights after the death of her husband. Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with then) ) said: Her 'Idda is that period which is longer of the two (between four months and ten days and the birth of the child, whichever is longer). AbuSalama, however said: Her period of 'Idda is over (with the birth of the child), and they were contending with each other over this issue, whereupon Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) said: I subscribe (to the view) held by my nephew (i. e. Abu Salama). They sent Kuraib (the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas) to Umm Salama to ask her about it. He came (back) to them and informed them that Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) said that Subai'ah al-Aslamiyya gave birth to a child after the death of her husband when the few flights (had hardly) passed and she made mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he commanded her to marry.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman aur Ibn Abbas (RA) Abu Huraira (RA) ke ghar ikattha huye aur us aurat ke baare mein charcha shuru ki jisne apne shohar ki maut ke kuch raaton baad bachche ko paida kiya. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Uski iddat woh muddat hai jo do mein se lambi ho, chaar mahine das din aur bachche ki paidaish ke beech, jo bhi lamba ho. Abu Salama, halaanki, ne kaha: Uski iddat khatam ho jaati hai, bachche ki paidaish ke saath, aur woh is mudde par ek-doosre se jhagad rahe the, isper Abu Huraira (RA) ne kaha: Main apne bhatije, yaani Abu Salama, ki raay ka himayat karta hoon. Unhone Kuraib (Ibn Abbas ke aazad kiye hue ghulam) ko Umm Salama ke paas bheja unse iske baare mein poochne ke liye. Woh (wapas) unke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ki Umm Salama (RA) ne kaha ki Subai'ah al-Aslamiyya ne apne shohar ki maut ke baad ek bachche ko paida kiya jab kuch hi raaten guzri thi aur usne iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone use shaadi karne ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narated with the same chain of transrmitters except with a small change of words (and that is): They sent him to Umm Salama, but no mention was made of Kuraib.
hi: Ye hadees isi tarah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay alfaazon mein choti tabdeeli ke, ki: Unhone use Umm Salama ke paas bheja, lekin Kuraib ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Zainab (bint Abu Salama) (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I went to Umm Habiba, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), when her father Abu Sufyan had died. Umm Habiba sent for a perfume having yellowness in it or something else like it, and she applied it to a girl and then rubbed it on her cheeks and then said: By Allah, I need no perfume but for the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the pulpit:" It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to mourn for the dead beyond three days, but (in case of the death) of the husband it is permissible for four months and ten days." Zainab said: I then visited Zainab hint Jahsh (Allah be pleased with her) when her brother died and she sent for perfume and applied it and then said: By Allah, I don't feel any need for the perfume but that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the pulpit:" It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafbler to mourn the dead beyond three days except in case of her husband (for whom she can mourn) for four months and ten days." Zainab (Allah be pleased with her) said: I heard my mother Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. I have a daughter whose husband has died and there has developed some trouble in her eye; should we apply collyrium to it? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No (repeating it twice or thrice, saying only, NO" all the time). Then he said: It is only four mouths and ten days, whereas in the preIslamic period none of you threw away the dung until one year had passed. Humaid said: I said to Zainab: What is this throwing of dung until a year is passed? Zainab said: When the husband of a woman died, she went into a hut and put on her worst clothes, and did not apply perfume or something like it until a year was over. Then an animal like a donkey, or a goat, or a bird was brought to her and she rubbed her hand over it, and it so happened that one on which she rubbed her hand died. She then came out of her house and she was given dung and she threw it and then she made use of anything like perfume or something else as she liked.
hi: Zainab (bint Abu Salama) (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Umm Habiba, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ke paas gayi jab unke waalid Abu Sufyan ka intiqaal hua tha. Umm Habiba ne peelaapan wali khushboo ya usi jaisa kuch mangwaaya, aur unhone use ek larki par lagaayi aur phir apne gaalon par mala, aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe khushboo ki koi zaroorat nahi hai siwaay is baat ke ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par ye kehte suna: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai, lekin shohar ki maut ke maamle mein ye chaar mahine das din ke liye jaayez hai." Zainab ne kaha: Main phir Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ke paas gayi jab unke bhai ka intiqaal hua aur unhone khushboo mangwaayi aur use lagaya aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe koi khushboo ki zaroorat mehsoos nahi hoti siwaay is baat ke ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par ye kehte suna: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai siwaay uske shohar ke maamle mein jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din shok mana sakti hai." Zainab (RA) ne kaha: Maine apni maa Umm Salama (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri ek beti hai jiske shohar ka intiqaal ho gaya hai aur uski aankh mein kuch takleef paida ho gayi hai; kya humein usme surma lagaana chahiye? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nahi (do ya teen baar dohraate hue, sirf "NAHI" kehte hue). Phir unhone kaha: Ye sirf chaar mahine das din ke liye hai, jabki Islam se pehle ke daur mein tum mein se koi bhi mal tab tak nahi phenkti thi jab tak ek saal na guzar jaaye. Humaid ne kaha: Maine Zainab se kaha: Ye kya hai, ek saal tak mal phenkna? Zainab ne kaha: Jab kisi aurat ke shohar ka intiqaal hota, woh ek jhopdi mein chali jaati aur apne sabse buray kapde pehanti, aur woh khushboo ya usi jaisi koi cheez tab tak nahi lagati jab tak ek saal na guzar jaaye. Phir gadhe, bakri, ya parinde jaisa koi jaanwar laaya jaata aur woh apna haath uspar malti, aur aisa hota tha ki jispar woh apna haath malti woh mar jaata. Woh phir apne ghar se bahar aati aur use mal diya jaata aur woh use phenkti aur phir woh koi khushboo ya usi jaisi cheez istemal karti jaisa woh chahti.

e: Zainab bint Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a relative of Umm Habiba (Allah he pleased with her) died. She sent for a yellow (perfume) and applied that to her forearm and said: I, am doing it, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to mourn beyond three days except the husband (for whom she can mourn) for four months and ten days.
hi: Zainab bint Umm Salama (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umm Habiba (RA) ke ek rishtedaar ka intiqaal hua. Unhone peeli khushboo mangwaayi aur use apni baazu par lagaayi aur kaha: Main ye kar rahi hoon, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai siwaay shohar ke jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din shok mana sakti hai.

e: This hadith was narrated by Zainab from her mother and from Zainab, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), or from some other lady from among the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Zainab ne apni maa se aur Zainab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se, ya Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se kisi aur khaatoon se riwayat ki hai.

e: Zainab bint Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) reported on the authority of her mother that a woman lost her husband. (As her eyes were ailing) they (her kith and kin) entertained fear about her eyes, so they came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought permission for the use of collyrium, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One among you used to spend one year in a dungeon dressed in worst clothes. (And at the end of this period) she threw dung at the dog which happened to pass that way and then she came out (of her 'Idda). Can't she (wait) even for four months and ten days?
hi: Zainab bint Umm Salama (RA) ne apni maa ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek aurat ne apna shohar kho diya. (Kyunki uski aankhein bimaar thin) unhe (uske rishtedaaron ko) uski aankhon ki fikar thi, is liye woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur surma istemal karne ki ijazat maangi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi apne sabse buray kapdon mein ek saal andheri jagah mein guzaarti thi. (Aur is muddat ke akhir mein) woh kutte par mal phenkti jo waha se guzarta aur phir woh (iddat se) bahar aati. Kya woh chaar mahine das din bhi intezaar nahi kar sakti?

e: Humaid b. Nafi' narrated two traditions from Umm Salama dealing with collyrium and the other hadith from the wives of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) except with this that no mention was made of Zainab.
hi: Humaid bin Nafi ne Umm Salama se surme ke baare mein do riwayaten aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon se doosri hadees riwayat ki siwaay is baat ke ki Zainab ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Zainab bint Abu Salama reported: Umm Salama and Umm Habiba (Allah be pleased with them) were talking with each other (and saying) that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned to him that her daughter had lost her husband, and her eyes were sore and she wanted to use collyrium, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One among you used to throw dung at the end of a year, and now (this abstinence from adornment) is only for four months and ten days.
hi: Zainab bint Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Umm Salama aur Umm Habiba (RA) ek-doosre se baat kar rahi thin ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhe bataaya ki uski beti ne apna shohar kho diya hai, aur uski aankhein dukh rahi hain aur woh surma istemal karna chahti hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi ek saal ke akhir mein mal phenkti thi, aur ab ye sirf chaar mahine das din ke liye hai.

e: Zainab bint Abu Salama reported that when the news of the death of Abu Safyan came to Umm Habiba she sent for yellow (perfume) on the third day and rubbed it on her forearms and on her cheeks and said: I had in fact no need of it, but I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not permissible for the women believing in Allah and the Hereafter to abstain from adornment beyond three days except (at the death of) husband (in which case she must abstain from adornment) for four months and ten days.
hi: Zainab bint Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki jab Abu Sufyan ki maut ki khabar Umm Habiba tak pahunchi unhone teesre din peeli khushboo mangwaayi aur use apni baazuon aur gaalon par mala aur kaha: Mujhe dar-asal iski koi zaroorat nahi thi, lekin maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Un auraton ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hain, teen din se zyada sajj-dhajj se parhez karna jaayez nahi hai siwaay shohar ki maut ke maamle mein jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din tak sajj-dhajj se parhez kar sakti hai.

e: Safiyya bint Abu 'Ubaid reported on the authority of Hafsa or 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with thein) or from both of them that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter (or believing in Allah and His Messenger) that she should observe mourning for the dead beyond three days except in case of her husband.
hi: Safiyya bint Abu Ubaid ne Hafsa ya Aisha (RA) ke hawale se, ya donon se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho, ya Allah aur Uske Rasool par imaan rakhti ho, ye jaayez nahi hai ki woh murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok mana, siwaay uske shohar ke maamle mein.

e: A hadith like this is transmitted on the authority of Nafi'.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Nafi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Safiyya bint Abu 'Ubaid reported that she heard Hafsa daughter of Umar (Allah be pleased with them), (and) wife of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ), narrating a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and she made this addition: " She should abstain from adorning herself (in case of the death of her husband) for four months and ten days."
hi: Safiyya bint Abu Ubaid ne bayan kiya ki unhone Hafsa, Umar ki beti, (aur) Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ko isi tarah ki hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat karte suna, aur unhone ye izafa kiya: "Use shohar ki maut ke maamle mein chaar mahine das din tak sajj-dhajj se parhez karna chahiye."

e: Safiyya bint Abu 'Ubaid narrated this tradition of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) on the authority of some wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
hi: Safiyya bint Abu Ubaid ne ye riwayat Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki kuch zaujaon ke hawale se riwayat ki.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to observe mourning on the dead for more than three (days), except in case of her husband.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai, siwaay uske shohar ke maamle mein.

e: Umm `Atiyya (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: A woman must not observe mourning for one who had died for more than three (days) except for four months and ten days in the case of her husband. And she must not wear a dyed garment except one of the types made of dyed yarn, or apply collyrium, or touch perfume except a little perfume or incense, when she has been purified after her courses.
hi: Umm Atiyya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Ek aurat ko kisi ki maut par teen din se zyada shok nahi manaana chahiye siwaay chaar mahine das din shohar ke maamle mein. Aur use rangaa hua kapda nahi pehnna chahiye siwaay us kism ke jo rangaaye hue dhaage se banaya gaya ho, ya surma lagaana chahiye, ya khushboo chhuna chahiye siwaay thodi khushboo ya loban ke, jab woh apne haiz ke baad paak ho jaaye.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Umm 'Atiyya ('Allah be pleased with her) said: We were forbidden to observe mourning for the dead beyond three days except in the case of husband (where it is permissible) for four months and ten days, and (that during this period) we should neither use collyrium nor touch perfume, nor wear dyed clothes, but concession was given to a woman when one of us was purified of our courses to make use of a little incense or scent.
hi: Umm Atiyya (RA) ne kaha: Humein murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaane se mana kiya gaya siwaay shohar ke maamle mein jahan ye chaar mahine das din ke liye jaayez hai, aur is muddat ke daurane hume na surma istemal karna chahiye na khushboo chhuni chahiye, na rangaaye hue kapde pehnne chahiye, lekin ek aurat ko chhoot di gayi jab hummein se koi apne haiz se paak hoti hai ki woh thodi khushboo ya loban istemal kare.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi reported that'Uwaimir al-'Ajlani came to 'Asim b. 'Adi al-Ansari and said to him. Tell me about a person who finds a man with his wife; should he kill him, and be killed In retaliation; or how should he act? 'Asim, ask for me (religious verdict about it) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So 'Asim asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he did not like this question and he disapproved of it so much that'Asim felt aggrieved at what he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When 'Asim came back to his family, 'Uwaimir came to him and said: 'Asim, what did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say to you? 'Asim said to 'Uwaimir: You did not bring something good. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like this religious verdict that I sought from him. 'Uwaimir said: By Allah, I will not rest until I have asked him about it. 'Uwaimir proceeded until he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was sitting amidst people, and said: Messenger of Allah, tell me about a person who found a man with his wife. Should he kill him, and then you would kill him, or how should he act? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (Verses) have been revealed concerning you and your wife; so go and bring her. Sahl said that they both invoked curses (and further said): I was along with people in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And when they had finished, Uwaimir said: Allah's Messenger, I shall have told a lie against her if I keep her (now). So he divorced her with three pronouncements before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded him. Ibn Shihab said: Subsequently that was the practice of invokers of curses (al Mutala'inain)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi ne bayan kiya ki Uwaimir al-Ajlani Asim bin Adi al-Ansari ke paas aaye aur unse kaha: Mujhe bataao us shakhs ke baare mein jo apni zauja ke paas kisi doosre aadmi ko paaye; kya use use qatal kar dena chahiye, aur badle mein khud qatal kar diya jaaye; ya use kya karna chahiye? Asim, mere liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (mazhabi fatwa) maango. To Asim ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha aur unhe ye sawaal napasand aaya aur unhone isse itni sakhti se aitraaz kiya ki Asim ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jo sunkar dukh hua. Jab Asim apne khaandaan ke paas wapas aaye, Uwaimir unke paas aaye aur kaha: Asim, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapse kya kaha? Asim ne Uwaimir se kaha: Tum koi achhi baat nahi laaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye mazhabi fatwa napasand kiya jo maine unse maanga. Uwaimir ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tab tak nahi rukunga jab tak main iske baare mein unse na poochh loon. Uwaimir aage badhe yahan tak ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas pahunche jab woh logon ke beech baithe the, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe bataaiye us shakhs ke baare mein jo apni zauja ke paas kisi aadmi ko paaye. Kya use use qatal kar dena chahiye, aur phir aap use qatal karenge, ya use kya karna chahiye? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhare aur tumhari zauja ke baare mein aayaten nazil hui hain; is liye jao aur unhe le aao. Sahl ne kaha ki dono ne laanat ka aahvaan kiya, aur aage kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath logon mein tha. Aur jab woh (ye amal) mukammal kar chuke, Uwaimir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main unke khilaaf jhoot bol chuka hunga agar main use (ab) rakhun. To unhone use teen baar talaaq di isse pehle ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe hukum den. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Iske baad ye laanat ka aahvaan karne walon (al-Mutala'inain) ka amal ban gaya.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported.. 'Uwaimir al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) from Banu'l-'Ajlan came to 'Asim b. 'Adi (Allah be pleased with him) the remaining part of the hadith is the same and it was also reecorded in it: " And subsequebtly the separation became the practice of al-Mutala'inain." And this addition was also made:" She was pregnant and her son was ascribed to her, and it became customary that such (a son) would inherit her and she would inherit him in the share prescribed by Allah for her.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Uwaimir al-Ansari (RA) Banu'l-Ajlan se Asim bin Adi (RA) ke paas aaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ismein ye bhi darj hai: "Aur iske baad alagav al-Mutala'inain ka amal ban gaya." Aur ye izafa bhi kiya gaya: "Woh garbhvati thin aur unke bete ka nasab unki maa se joda gaya, aur ye riwaaz ban gaya ki aisa bacha uski maa ki virasat paayega aur woh us hisse mein uski virasat paayegi jo Allah ne uske liye muqarrar kiya hai."

e: Ibn Shihab narrated about the invokers of curses and the practice of (li'an) based on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd, of the tribe of Sa'ida. that a person from the Ansar came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, tell me about the person who found a man with his wife. The remaining part of the hadith is the same (but) with this addition: They invoked curses in the mosque and I was present there. And he narrated in the hadith: He divorced her with three pronouncements before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded him (to get separation). He separated from her in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: There is a separation between the invokers of curses.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne laanat ka aahvaan karne walon aur li'an ke amal ke baare mein Sahl bin Sa'd, Sa'ida qabile se, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe bataaiye us shakhs ke baare mein jo apni zauja ke paas kisi aadmi ko paaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: Unhone masjid mein laanat ka aahvaan kiya aur main wahan maujood tha. Aur unhone hadees mein riwayat ki: Unhone use teen baar talaaq di isse pehle ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe (alag hone ka) hukum den. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein use se alag ho gaye, isper unhone kaha: Laanat ka aahvaan karne walon ke beech alagav hai.

e: Sa'id b Jubair reported: I was asked about the invokers of curses during the reign of Mus'ab (b. Zubair) whether they could separate (themselves by this process). He said: I did not understand what to say. So I went to the house of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) in Mecca. I said to his servant: Seek permission for Me. He said that he (Ibn 'Umar) had been taking rest. He (Ibn 'Umar) heard my voice. and said: Are you Ibn Jubair? I said: Yes. He'said: Come in. By Allah, it must be some (great) need which has brought you here at this Hour. So I got in and found him lying on a blanket reclining against a pillow stuffed with fibres of date-palm. I said: O Abu'Abd al-Rahman, should there be separation between the invokers of curses? He said: Hallowed be Allah, yes, The first one who asked about it was so and so. he said: Messenger of Allah, tell me If one of us finds his wife committing adultery: what should he do? If he talks, that is something great, and if he keeps quiet that is also (something great) (which he cannot afford to do). Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet (or some time). After some time he (that very person) came to him (Allah's Messenger) and said: I have been involved in that very cage about which I had asked you Allah the Exalted and Majestic then revealed (these) verses of Surah Nur:" Those who accuse their wives" (verse 6), and he (the Holy Prophet) recited them to him and admonished him, and exhorted him and informed him that the torment of the world is less painful than the torment of the Hereafter. He said: No, by Him Who sent you with Truth, I did not tell a lie against her. He (the Holy Prophet) then called her (the wife of that person who had accused her) and admonished her, and exhorted her, and informed her that the torment of this world is less painful than the torment of the Hereafter. She said: No, by Him Who sent thee with Truth, he is a liar. (it was) the man who started the swearing of oath and he swore in the name of Allah four times that he was among the truthful. and at the fifth turn he said: Let there be curse of Allah upon him if he were among the liars. Then the woman was called and she swore four times in the name of Allah that he (her husband) was among the liars, and at the fifth time (she said): Let there be curse upon her if he were among the truthful. He (the Holy Prophet) then effected separation between the two.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Mujhse Mus'ab (bin Zubair) ke daur mein poocha gaya ki kya laanat ka aahvaan karne wale khud ko alag kar sakte hain (is amal se). Unhone kaha: Mujhe samajh nahi aaya ki kya kahun. To main Ibn Umar (RA) ke ghar Makkah gaya. Maine unke khaadim se kaha: Mere liye ijazat maango. Usne kaha ki woh (Ibn Umar) aaraam kar rahe the. Unhone (Ibn Umar ne) meri aawaaz suni, aur kaha: Kya tum Ibn Jubair ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Andar aao. Allah ki qasam, koi (badi) zaroorat hi hogi jo tumhe is waqt yahan laayi hai. To main andar gaya aur unhe ek kambal par leta hua paaya, ek takiya par tek lagaaye hue jismein khajoor ke reshe bhare the. Maine kaha: Aye Abu Abd al-Rahman, kya laanat ka aahvaan karne walon ke beech alagav hona chahiye? Unhone kaha: Allah muqaddas hai, haan. Sabse pehle jisne iske baare mein poocha woh falan-falan the. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe bataaiye agar hummein se koi apni zauja ko badchalni karte paaye: use kya karna chahiye? Agar woh baat kare, to ye ek badi baat hai, aur agar woh khamosh rahe, to ye bhi (badi baat hai) (jise woh bardaasht nahi kar sakta). Allah ke Nabi (SAW) kuch der khamosh rahe. Kuch der baad woh (wahi shakhs) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Main usi maamle mein phans gaya hoon jiske baare mein maine aapse poocha tha. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne phir Surah Nur ki (in) aayaton ko nazil kiya: "Woh log jo apni zaujaon par ilzaam lagaate hain" (aayat 6), aur unhone unhe padh kar sunaaya, aur naseehat ki, aur bataaya ki duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se kam dukhdaayi hai. Usne kaha: Nahi, us hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, maine unke khilaaf jhoot nahi kaha. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir use (us shakhs ki zauja ko jispar ilzaam lagaaya gaya tha) bulaaya aur unhe naseehat ki, aur samjhaya, aur bataya ki is duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se kam dukhdaayi hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi, us hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, ye jhootey hain. (Woh aadmi tha) jisne qasam khaane ki shuruaat ki, aur usne Allah ke naam par chaar baar qasam khayi ki woh sachchon mein se hai, aur paanchvi baar usne kaha: Allah ki laanat use ho agar woh jhootho mein se hai. Phir us aurat ko bulaaya gaya aur usne Allah ke naam par chaar baar qasam khayi ki woh (uska shohar) jhootho mein se hai, aur paanchvi baar usne kaha: Uspar laanat ho agar woh sachcho mein se hai. Unhone phir donon ke beech alagav kiya.

e: A hadith like this is narrated by Ibn Numair with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Numair ne alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying to the invokers of curse: Your account is with Allah. One of you must be a liar. You have now no right over this woman. He said: Messenger of Allah, what about my wealth (dower that I paid her at the time of marriage)? He said: You have no claim to wealth. If you tell the truth, it (dower) is the recompense for your having had the right to intercourse with her, and if you tell a lie against her, it is still more remote from you than she is. Zuhair said in his narration: Sufyan reported to us on the authority of 'Amr that he had heard Sa'id b Jubair saying: I heard Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko laanat ka aahvaan karne walon se ye kehte suna: Tumhara hisaab Allah ke paas hai. Tum mein se ek zaroor jhootho mein se hai. Ab tumhara is aurat par koi haq nahi hai. Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere maal ka kya, (jo mehr maine unhe shaadi ke waqt diya tha)? Unhone kaha: Tumhara maal par koi daawa nahi hai. Agar tum sach kehte ho, to ye (mehr) uska muaaviza hai jo tumhe unse jinsi milaap ka haq hasil karne ke liye tha, aur agar tumne unke khilaaf jhoot bola, to ye (mehr) tumse aur bhi door hai unki nisbat. Zuhair ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Sufyan ne humein Amr ki sanad se riwayat ki ki unhone Sa'id bin Jubair ko ye kehte suna: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha tha.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) effected separation between the two members of Banu al-'Ajlan, and said: Allah knows that one of you is a liar. Is there one to repent among you?
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu al-Ajlan ke do afraad ke beech alagav kiya, aur kaha: Allah jaanta hai ki tum mein se ek jhootha hai. Kya tum mein se koi tauba karne ke liye hai?

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I asked Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) about invoking curse (li'an), and he narrated Similarly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) se laanat ka aahvaan (li'an) ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki riwayat ki.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Mus'ab b. Zubair did not effect separation between the Mutala'inain (invokers of curses). Sa'id said: It was mentioned to 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) and he said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) effected separation between the two members of Banu al-'Ajlan.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki Mus'ab bin Zubair ne Mutala'inain (laanat ka aahvaan karne walon) ke beech alagav nahi kiya. Sa'id ne kaha: Ye Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ko bataaya gaya aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu al-Ajlan ke do afraad ke beech alagav kiya.

e: Nafi' reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that a person invoked curse on the wife during the lifetime of Allah s Messenger (ﷺ), so he effected separation between them and traced the lineage of the son to his mother.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein apni zauja par laanat ka aahvaan kiya, to unhone unke beech alagav kiya aur bete ka nasab uski maa se joda.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person from the Anger and his wife to invoke curse (upon one another in order to testify to their truthfulness), and then effected separation between them.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar mein se ek shakhs aur uski zauja se laanat ka aahvaan karwaaya (ek-doosre par apni sachchaai tasdeeq karne ke liye), aur phir unke beech alagav kiya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidulah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported: We were on the night of Friday staying in the mosque when a person from the Ansar came there and said: If a person finds hiswoman along with a man, and he speaks about it, you would lash him, and if he kills, you will kill him, and if he keeps quiet he shall have to consume anger. By Allah, I will definitely ask about him from Allah's Mescenger (ﷺ). On the following day he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him thus: If a man were to find with his wife a man and if he were to talk about it, you would lash him; and if he killed, you would kill him, and if he were to keep quiet. he would consume anger, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah, solve (this problem), and he began to supplicate (before Him), and then the verses pertaining to li'an were revealed:" Those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves" (xxiv. 6). The person was then put to test according to these verses in the presence of the people. There came he and his wife in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and they invoked curses (in order to testify their claim). The man swore four times in the name of Allah that he was one of the truthful and then invoked curse for the fifth time saying: Let there be curse of Allah upon him if he were among the liars. Then she began to invoke curse. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her: just wait (and curse after considering over it), but she refused and invoked curse and when she turned away, he (Allah's Apostle) said: It seems that this woman shall give birth to a curly-haired black child, And so she did gave birth to a curly-haired black child.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hum juma ki raat masjid mein theher rahe the jab Ansar mein se ek shakhs wahan aaya aur kaha: Agar koi shakhs apni aurat ko kisi aadmi ke saath paaye, aur woh iske baare mein baat kare, to tum use koda maaroge, aur agar woh qatal kare, to tum use qatal karoge, aur agar woh khamosh rahe to use gussa peena hoga. Allah ki qasam, main iske baare mein zaroor Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poochunga. Agle din woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse yun poocha: Agar ek aadmi apni zauja ke paas kisi aadmi ko paaye aur agar woh iske baare mein baat kare, to tum use koda maaroge; aur agar woh qatal kare, to tum use qatal karoge, aur agar woh khamosh rahe, to use gussa peena hoga. Isper unhone kaha: Allah, is samasya ka hal kar, aur unhone (Allah se) dua karni shuru ki, aur phir li'an se mutalliq aayaten nazil huyin: "Woh log jo apni zaujaon par ilzaam lagaate hain aur unke paas apne siwaay koi gawaah nahi hai" (24:6). Us shakhs ki phir logon ke saamne in aayaton ke mutabik azmaish li gayi. Woh aur uski zauja Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein aaye, aur unhone (apna daawa tasdeeq karne ke liye) laanat ka aahvaan kiya. Aadmi ne Allah ke naam par chaar baar qasam khayi ki woh sachcho mein se hai aur phir paanchvi baar laanat ka aahvaan karte hue kaha: Allah ki laanat use ho agar woh jhootho mein se hai. Phir usne laanat ka aahvaan karna shuru kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Bas ruko (aur iske baare mein soch kar laanat karo), lekin usne inkaar kiya aur laanat ka aahvaan kiya aur jab woh mudi, unhone kaha: Aisa lagta hai ki ye aurat ek ghungharaale baalon wali kaale bachche ko paidaish degi. Aur waaqai usne ek ghungharaale baalon wali kaale bachche ko paida kiya.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of A'mash.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Muhammad (one of the narrators) reported: I asked Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) knowing that he had a knowledge of (the case of li'an). He said: Hilal b. Umayya (Allah be pleased with him) accused his wife with the charge of fornication with Sharik b. Sahma, the brother of al-Bara'b Malik from the side of his mother. And he was the first person who invoked curse (li'an) in Islam. He in fact invoked curse upon her. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: See to her if she gives birth to a white-complexioned child having dark hair and bright eyes; he must be the son of Hilal b. Umayya; and if she gives birth to a child with dark eyelids, curly hair and lean shanks, he must be the offspring of Sharik b. Sahma. He said: I was informed that she gave birth to a child having dark eyelids, curly hair and lean shanks.
hi: Muhammad (ek raawi) ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik (RA) se poocha, ye jaante hue ki unhe li'an ke maamle ki jaankaari hai. Unhone kaha: Hilal bin Umayya (RA) ne apni zauja par Sharik bin Sahma, al-Bara bin Malik ke maa ki taraf se bhai, ke saath badchalni ka ilzaam lagaaya. Aur woh sabse pehle shakhs the jinhone Islam mein laanat ka aahvaan (li'an) kiya. Unhone waaqai unpar laanat ka aahvaan kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho ki agar woh gore rang, kaale baal aur roshan aankhon wale bachche ko paidaish de; woh zaroor Hilal bin Umayya ka beta hoga; aur agar woh gehri palkon, ghungharaale baalon aur patli taangon wale bachche ko paidaish de, woh zaroor Sharik bin Sahma ki aulaad hoga. Unhone kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya ki usne gehri palkon, ghungharaale baalon aur patli taangon wale bachche ko paida kiya.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Mention was made of li'an in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And Asim b. 'Adi passed a remark about it and then turned away, and a man of his tribe came to him complaining that he had found a man with his wife, whereupon 'Asim said: I have been taken by my words. He took him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about the man whom he had found with his wife and this man was a lean, yellow-coloured man with lank hair, and the person who was accused of committing adultery with her (his wife) had fleshy shanks, with wheat complexion and heavy bulk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, make (this case) manifest. And as she gave birth to a child, whose face resembled that person about whom her husband had made mention that he had found her with, and Allah's Messenger (may peace be, upon him) had asked them to invoke curses. A person said to Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him): Is she (that woman) about whom Allah's Messenger (may peace be upen him) (said):" If I were to stone anybody without evidence, I would have stoned her"? Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) said: No, it is not she. That woman was one who openly spread evil in society.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein li'an ka zikr hua. Aur Asim bin Adi ne iske baare mein kuch kaha aur phir chala gaya, aur unke qabile ka ek shakhs unke paas aakar ye shikaayat ki ki usne apni zauja ke paas ek aadmi paaya, isper Asim ne kaha: Main apni hi baaton mein phans gaya hoon. Woh use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur unhe us aadmi ke baare mein bataaya jise unhone apni zauja ke paas paaya tha, aur ye aadmi patla, peela-rangat waala aur seedhe baal wala tha, aur jise badchalni ka ilzaam lagaya gaya tha uske gosht bhare taangein, gehun jaisi rangat, aur bhaari qaad thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, ise saaf kar. Aur jab usne ek bachche ko paida kiya jiska chehra us shakhs se milta tha jiske baare mein uske shohar ne zikr kiya tha ki usne use uski zauja ke saath paaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse laanat ka aahvaan karne ko kaha tha. Ek shakhs ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: Kya woh aurat wahi hai jiske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: "Agar main bina saboot ke kisi ko sangsaar karta, to main use sangsaar karta"? Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Nahi, woh nahi hai. Woh aurat woh thi jo khule aam samaaj mein buraai phailaati thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) through another chain of transmitters with the addition of these words: 'With flesh, and curly tangled hair."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai in alfaazon ke izafe ke saath: "Gosht bhare, ghungharaale, uljhe hue baalon wali."

e: 'Abdullah b Shaddad reported that mention was made about the invokers of curses before Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them). Ibn Shaddad said: Are these the two about whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said." If I were to stone one without evidence, I would have definitely stoned her"? Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: She is not this woman; but she is the one who (committed adultery) openly.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaddad ne bayan kiya ki laanat ka aahvaan karne walon ka zikr Ibn Abbas (RA) ke saamne hua. Ibn Shaddad ne kaha: Kya ye woh dono hain jinke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Agar main bina saboot ke kisi ko sangsaar karta, to main zaroor use sangsaar karta"? Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Woh ye aurat nahi hai; balki woh hai jisne (badchalni) khule aam ki.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. 'Ubada al-Ansari said: Messenger of Allah, tell me if a man finds his wife with another person, should he kill him? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No. Sa'd said: Why not? I swear by Him Who has honored you with the Truth. There upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Listen to what your chief says.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Ubada al-Ansari ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe bataaiye agar koi aadmi apni zauja ko kisi doosre shakhs ke saath paaye, kya use use qatal karna chahiye? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nahi. Sa'd ne kaha: Kyun nahi? Us hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath izzat di. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Suno tumhara sardaar kya kehta hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, if I were to find with my wife a man, should I wait until I bring four witnesses? He said: Yes.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Ubada (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar main apni zauja ke paas kisi aadmi ko paaun, kya mujhe chaar gawaah laane tak intezaar karna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said: Messenger of Allah, if I were to find with my wife a man, should I not touch him before bringing four witnesses? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes. He said: By no means. By Him Who has sent you with the Truth, I would hasten with my sword to him before that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Listen to what your chief says. He is jealous of his honour, I am more jealous than he (is) and God is more jealous than I.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Ubada (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar main apni zauja ke paas kisi aadmi ko paaun, kya mujhe use chaar gawaah laane se pehle nahi chhuna chahiye? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kabhi nahi. Us hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, main apni talwaar ke saath usse pehle uske paas jaldi jaaunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Suno tumhara sardaar kya kehta hai. Woh apni izzat par ghairat rakhta hai, main usse zyada ghairat rakhta hoon, aur Allah mujhse zyada ghairat rakhta hai.

e: AI-Mughira b. Shu'ba (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Sa'd b. 'Ubada (Allah be pleased with him) said: If I were to see a man with my wife, I would have struck him with the sword, and not with the flat part (side) of it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard of that, he said: Are you surprised at Sa'd's jealousy of his honour? By Allah, I am more jealous of my honour than he, and Allah is more jealous than I. Because of His jealousy Allah has prohibited abomination, both open and secret And no person is more jealous of his honour than Allah, and no persons, is more fond of accepting an excuse than Allah, on account of which He has sent messengers, announcers of glad tidings and warners; and no one is more fond of praise than Allah on account of which Allah has promised Paradise.
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Ubada (RA) ne kaha: Agar main apni zauja ke saath kisi aadmi ko dekhun, main use talwaar se maarunga, na ki uske chapte hisse se. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna, unhone kaha: Kya tumhe Sa'd ki apni izzat ke prati ghairat par hairat hai? Allah ki qasam, main apni izzat ke prati unse zyada ghairat rakhta hoon, aur Allah mujhse zyada ghairat rakhta hai. Apni ghairat ki wajah se Allah ne badnaseebi ko haraam kiya hai, chahe woh khuli ho ya chhupi. Aur koi bhi shakhs Allah se zyada apni izzat ke prati ghairat nahi rakhta, aur koi bhi shakhs Allah se zyada kisi bahaane ko qubool karna pasand nahi karta, jiski wajah se Usne rasool, khushkhabri sunaane wale aur chetaavni dene wale bheje; aur koi bhi Allah se zyada tareef pasand nahi karta jiski wajah se Allah ne Jannat ka wada kiya hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority, of 'Abd al-Malik b. Umair with the same chain of narraters but with a slight change of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abd al-Malik bin Umair ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: There came a person to the Prophet (may peace he upon him) ) from Banu Fazara and said: My wife has given birth to a child who is black, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Have you any camels? He said: Yes. He again said: What is this colour? He said: They are red. He said: Is there a dusky one among them? He said: Yes, there are dusky ones among them He said: How has it come about? He said: It is perhaps the strain to which it has reverted, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is perhaps the strain to which he (the child) has reverted.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas Banu Fazara se aaya aur kaha: Meri zauja ne ek kaale bachche ko paida kiya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhare paas oont hain? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone dobara kaha: Unka rang kya hai? Usne kaha: Woh laal hain. Unhone kaha: Kya unmein koi bhoora bhi hai? Usne kaha: Haan, unmein bhoore bhi hain. Unhone kaha: Ye kaise hua? Usne kaha: Shayad ye us nasl ki taraf laut gaya hai jismein ye hai, isper unhone kaha: Shayad ye (bachcha) us nasl ki taraf laut gaya hai jismein woh hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar, the (words are): " Messenger of Allah, my wife has given birth to a dark-complexioned boy, and he at that time was intending to disown him." And this addition has been made at the end of the hadith:" He (the Holy Prophet) did not permit him to disown him."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Ma'mar ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Allah ke Rasool, meri zauja ne ek gehre rangat wale larke ko paida kiya hai," aur woh us waqt use nakaarne ka iraada rakhte the. Aur hadees ke akhir mein ye izafa kiya gaya hai: "Unhone unhe use nakaarne ki ijazat nahi di."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: My wife has given birth to a dark-complexioned child and I have disowned him. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Have you any camels? He said: Yes. He said: What is their colour? He said? They are red. He said: Is there anyone dusky among them? He said: Yes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: How has it come about? He said: Messenger of Allah, it is perhaps due to the strain to which it has reverted, whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said: It (the birth) of the black child may be due to the strain to which he (the child) might have reverted.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek registaan ka Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Meri zauja ne ek gehre rangat wale bachche ko paida kiya hai aur maine use nakaar diya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhare paas oont hain? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Unka rang kya hai? Usne kaha: Woh laal hain. Unhone kaha: Kya unmein koi bhoora hai? Usne kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaise hua? Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, shayad ye us nasl ki wajah se hai jismein ye hai, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Kaale bachche ka paidaish bhi shayad us nasl ki wajah se ho jismein woh hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) as saying: If anyone emancipates his share ina slave and has enough money to pay the full price for him, a fair price for the slave should be fixed, his partners given their shares, and the slave be thus emancipated, otherwise he is emancipated only to the extent of the first man's share.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi apne hisse ke ghulam ko azaad karta hai aur uske paas poori keemat chukaane ke liye kaafi paisa hai, to ghulam ki munasib keemat tay ki jaani chahiye, uske saanjhedaaron ko unka hissa diya jaana chahiye, aur is tarah ghulam ko azaad kiya jaana chahiye, warna woh sirf pehle aadmi ke hisse ki had tak hi azaad hota hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The slave who is jointly owned by two persons, and is emancipated by one of them, (this one) has liability (upon him to secure complete freedom for that slave).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ghulam jo do logon ki saanjhi malkiyat mein hai, aur unmein se ek ne use azaad kiya, (usi ek par) zimmedaari hai (us ghulam ke liye poori azaadi hasil karne ki).

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased witli him) reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone emancipates a share in a slave, he is to be completely emancipated if he has money; but if he has none, the slave will be required to work to pay for his freedom, but must not be over-burhened.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi apne hisse ke ghulam ko azaad karta hai, woh poori tarah azaad ho jaayega agar uske paas paisa hai; lekin agar uske paas nahi hai, to ghulam ko apni azaadi ki qeemat chukaane ke liye kaam karna hoga, lekin usse zyada bojh na daala jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Abu 'Aruba with the same chain of transmitters but with the addition: " If he (one of the joint owners emancipating the slave) has not (enough) money (to secure freedom for the other half) a fair price for the slave should be fixed, and he will be required to work to pay for his freedom, but must not be over-burdened.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id bin Abu Aruba ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Agar unke paas, ek saanjhedaar ke zariye ghulam ko azaad karne wale ke paas, kaafi paisa (doosre aadhe ki azaadi ke liye) nahi hai to ghulam ki munasib keemat tay ki jaani chahiye, aur use apni azaadi ki keemat chukaane ke liye kaam karna hoga, lekin usse zyada bojh na daala jaaye."

e: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of the same chain of transmitters but with a slight change of words.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Ibn Umar reported that 'A'isha decided to buy a slave-girl and then set her free, but her masters said: We are prepared to sell her to you on the condition that her right of inheritance would vest with you. She (Hadrat A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whereupon he said: This should not stand in your way. The right of inheritance vests in one who emancipates.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Aisha ne ek laundi khareedne aur phir use azaad karne ka faisla kiya, lekin uske maalikon ne kaha: Hum use aapko is shart par bechne ke liye taiyaar hain ki uski virasat ka haq aapke paas rahega. Unhone (Hazrat Aisha ne) iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya isper unhone kaha: Ye tumhare raaste mein rukaawat nahi hona chahiye. Virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pjeased with her) reported that Barira came to her in order to seek her help in securing freedom, but she had (so far) paid nothing out of that sum stipulated in the contract. 'A'isba said to her. Go to your family (who owns you), and if they like that I should pay the amount (of the contract) on your behalf (for purchasing your freedom), then I shall have the right in your inheritance. (If they accepted it) I am prepared (to make this payment). Barira made a mention of that to the (members of) her family, but they refused and said: If she (Hadrat 'A'isha) wants to do good to You for the sake of Allah, she may do it, but the right of inheritance will be ours. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said to her: Buy her, and emancipate her, for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates (the slave). Allah's Messenger, may peace be upon him) then stood up and said: What has happened to the people that they lay down conditions which are not (found) in the Book of Allah? And he who laid down a condition not found in the Book of Allah, that is not valid. even if it is laid down hundred times. The condition laid down by Allah is the most weighty and the most valid.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Barira unke paas apni azaadi hasil karne mein madad maangne aayi, lekin unhone abhi tak us raqam mein se kuch nahi diya tha jo maamle mein tay ki gayi thi. Aisha ne unse kaha: Apne khaandaan ke paas jao (jo tumhare maalik hain), aur agar unhe pasand ho ki main woh raqam tumhari taraf se ada karun (tumhari azaadi khareedne ke liye), to phir mujhe tumhari virasat mein haq milega. (Agar unhone ise qubool kiya) main ye bhugtaan karne ke liye taiyaar hoon. Barira ne iska zikr apne khaandaan se kiya, lekin unhone inkaar kar diya aur kaha: Agar woh (Hazrat Aisha) Allah ki khaatir tumhare saath achhaai karna chahti hain, to woh kar sakti hain, lekin virasat ka haq hamara hi rahega. Unhone (Hazrat Aisha ne) iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, aur unhone unse kaha: Unhe khareed lo, aur unhe azaad kar do, kyunki virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir khade hue aur kaha: Logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh aisi shartein rakhte hain jo Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi hain? Aur jisne bhi koi shart rakhi jo Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi hai, woh maany nahi hai. Chahe woh sau baar rakhi jaaye. Allah ke zariye rakhi gayi shart sabse zyada mahatvapurna aur sabse zyada maany hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported: Barira came to me and said: 'A'isha, I have entered into contract for securing freedom with my family (who owns me) for nine 'uqiyas (of silver), one 'uqiya every year The rest of the hadith is the same (but with this addition):" This (the problem of the right of inheritance) should not stand in your way. Buy her, and set her free. He said in a hadith: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up among men, extolled Allah, praised Him, and then said:" for......"
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya: Barira mere paas aayi aur kaha: Aisha, maine apni azaadi ke liye apne khaandaan (jinki main malkiyat mein hoon) ke saath ek souda kiya hai nau uqiya, chandi ki, ke liye, ek uqiya har saal. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Ye (virasat ka maamla) tumhare raaste mein rukaawat nahi hona chahiye. Unhe khareedo, aur unhe azaad kar do." Unhone ek hadees mein kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke beech khade hue, Allah ki tareef ki, uski hamd ki, aur phir kaha: "Kyunki..."

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Barira came to me and said: My family (owners) have made contract with me (for granting freedom) for nine 'uqiyas (of silver) payable in nine years, one 'uqiya every year. Help me (in making this payment). I said to her: If your family so desires, I am prepared to make them the full payment in one instalment, and thus secure freedom for you, but the right of inheritance will vest in me, if I do so. She (Barira) made a mention of that to her family, but they refused (except) on the condition that the right of inheritance would vest in them. She came to me and made mention of if She ('A'isha) said: I scolded her. She (Barira) said: By Allah, it is not possible (they will never agree to it). And as she was saying it, Allah's messenger (ﷺ) heard, and he asked me, I informed him and he said: Buy her and emancipate her, and let the right of inherit- ance vest in them, for they cannot claim it (rightfully) since the right of inherritance vests with one who emancipates (the slave; therefore, these people have no right to lay such false claims). And I did so. She ('A'isha) said: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered a sermon in the evening. He extolled Allah and praised Him with what He deserves, and then said afterwards,: What has happened to the people that they lay down conditions which are not found in the Book of Allah? And the condition which is not found in the Book of Allah is invalid, even if its number is one hundred. The Book of Allah is more true (than any other deed) and the condition laid down by Allah is more binding (than any other condition). What has happened to the people among you that someone among you says:" Emancipate so and so, but the right of inheritance vests in me"? Verily, the right of inheritance vests in one who emancipates.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Barira mere paas aayi aur kaha: Mere khaandaan, malikon, ne mere saath souda kiya hai, azaadi dene ke liye, nau uqiya, chandi ki, ke liye jo nau saalon mein bhugtaan ki jaayegi, ek uqiya har saal. Meri madad karo (ye bhugtaan karne mein). Maine unse kaha: Agar tumhara khaandaan chahe, main unhe ek hi kist mein poora bhugtaan karne ke liye taiyaar hoon, aur is tarah tumhari azaadi hasil kar loon, lekin virasat ka haq mujhme nihit hoga, agar main aisa karti hoon. Woh (Barira) apne khaandaan ke paas gayi aur iska zikr kiya, lekin unhone inkaar kiya (siwaay) is shart ke ki virasat ka haq unme nihit hoga. Woh mere paas aayi aur iska zikr kiya. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine unhe daanta. Unhone (Barira ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, ye mumkin nahi hai (woh kabhi isse sehmat nahi honge). Aur jab woh ye keh rahi thi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sun liya, aur unhone mujhse poocha, maine unhe bataaya aur unhone kaha: Unhe khareedo aur unhe azaad kar do, aur virasat ka haq unmein nihit rehne do, kyunki woh isper (munasib taur par) daawa nahi kar sakte kyunki virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai; is liye in logon ko aise jhoote daawe rakhne ka koi haq nahi hai. Aur maine aisa hi kiya. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne shaam ko khutba diya. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki jaise Woh iske laayak hai, aur phir kaha: Logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh aisi shartein rakhte hain jo Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi hain? Aur woh shart jo Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi hai maany nahi hai, chahe uski tadaad sau ho. Allah ki Kitaab zyada sach hai (kisi bhi doosre amal se), aur Allah ke zariye rakhi gayi shart zyada bandhak hai (kisi bhi doosri shart se). Tum mein se logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki koi kehta hai: "Falan-falan ko azaad karo, lekin virasat ka haq mujhme nihit hoga"? Yaqeenan, virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai.

e: Hisham b. 'Urwa narrated a hadith like this with the same chain of trans- mitters except (with this change) that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of jartr (the words are): Her (Barira's) husband was a slave, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the option (either to retain her matrimonial relation with her husband or sever it off). She opted to break off (and secure freedom for her even from the matrimonial alliance). And if he were free he would not have given her the option. In the hadith narrated on the authority (of this chain of transmitters) these words are not found: Amma ba'du.
hi: Hisham bin Urwa ne isi sanad se isi jaisi hadees riwayat ki siwaay (is tabdeeli ke) ki Jarir ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: Unke (Barira ke) shohar ek ghulam the, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ikhtiyar diya (chahe apne shohar ke saath vaivahik talluq banaaye rakhein ya isse alag ho jaayein). Unhone alag hone ka ikhtiyar chuna (aur apni azaadi haasil ki vaivahik gathbandhan se bhi). Aur agar woh azaad hote to unhe ikhtiyar na diya jaata. Is sanad ki riwayat mein ye alfaaz nahi milte: Amma ba'du.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. al. Qasim reported on the authority of his father: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: There were three issues which were clarified in case of Barira: her owners had decided to sell her on the condition that the right of her inheritance would vest with them. She ('A'isha) said: I made a mention of that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: Buy her and emancipate her, for verily the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates. She said that she emancipated (her) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the option (either to retain her matrimonial alliance or break it after emancipation). She (taking advantage of the option) opted for herself (the severing of matrimonial alliance). 'A'isha said: The people used to give her charity and she gave us that as gift. I made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: That is charity for her but gift for you, so take that.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin al-Qasim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Teen maamle the jo Barira ke maamle mein saaf hue: unke maalikon ne unhe is shart par bechne ka faisla kiya tha ki unki virasat ka haq unmein rahega. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone kaha: Unhe khareedo aur unhe azaad kar do, kyunki virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai. Unhone kaha ki unhone unhe azaad kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ikhtiyar diya (ya to apna vaivahik gathbandhan rakhein ya azaadi ke baad tod dein). Unhone (ikhtiyar ka faayda uthaate hue) apne liye (vaivahik gathbandhan tod dene ka) chunaav kiya. Aisha ne kaha: Log unhe sadaqa diya karte the aur woh humein woh tohfe mein deti thin. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye unke liye sadaqa hai lekin tumhare liye tohfa, is liye ise le lo.

e: 'A'isha (Allah's be pleased with her) reported that she had bought Barira from the people of Ansar, but they laid down the condition that the right of inheritance (would vest in them), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The right of inheritance vests with one who shows favour (who emancipates) and Allah's Messenger (may peacebe upon him) gave her the choice (either to retain) her matrimonial alliance or break it). Her husband was a slave. She (Barira also) gave 'A'isha some meat as gift. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I wish you could prepare (cook) for us out of this meat. 'A'isha said, It has been given as charity to Barira, whereupon he said: That is charity for her and gift for us.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Barira ko Ansar ke logon se khareeda tha, lekin unhone ye shart rakhi thi ki virasat ka haq (unmein rahega), isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo achhaai dikhaata hai, jo azaad karta hai, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ikhtiyar diya (chahe apna vaivahik gathbandhan rakhein ya tod dein). Unke shohar ek ghulam the. Unhone (Barira ne bhi) Aisha ko kuch gosht tohfe mein diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kaash tum humare liye is gosht mein se kuch pakaa deti. Aisha ne kaha, Ye Barira ko sadaqe mein diya gaya hai, isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai aur humare liye tohfa.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: She wanted to buy Barira with a view to emancipating her. They (the sellers) laid down the condition that the right of inheritance would vest (with them). She (Hadrat 'A'isha) made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Buy her and emancipate her for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given meat as gift. They (his Companions) said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): This was given as charity to Barira, whereupon he said: That is charity for her but gift for us. And she was given option (to retain her matrimonial alliance or to break it). Abd al-Rahman said: Her husband was a free man. Shu'ba said: I then asked him (one of the narrators) about Barira's husband (whether he had been a free mart or a slave), whereupon he said: I do not know.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Unhone Barira ko azaad karne ke iraade se khareedna chaaha. Unhone (bechne walon ne) shart rakhi ki virasat ka haq unmein rahega. Unhone (Hazrat Aisha ne) iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Unhe khareedo aur unhe azaad kar do kyunki virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko gosht tohfe mein diya gaya. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Ye Barira ko sadaqe mein diya gaya tha, isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai lekin humare liye tohfa. Aur unhe ikhtiyar diya gaya (apna vaivahik gathbandhan rakhne ya tod ne ka). Abd al-Rahman ne kaha: Unke shohar ek azaad shakhs the. Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine phir unse (ek raawi se) Barira ke shohar ke baare mein poocha (kya woh azaad the ya ghulam), isper unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the husband of Barira was a slave.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Barira ke shohar ek ghulam the.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her). the wife of Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) said: Three are the Sunan (usages) (that we came to know in case of Bairara). She was given option in regard to her husband when she was emancipated. Sbe was given meat as charity. Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) visited me when an earthen pot with meat in it was placed on the fire. He asked for food and be was given bread with ordinary meat (usually cooked in the) house. Thereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Don't I see the earthen pot on fire with meat in it? They said: Yes. Allah's Messenger, there is meat in it which was given as charity to Barira. We did not deem it advisable that we should give you that to eat, whereupon he said: It is charity for her, but it is gift for us. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) also said: The right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Teen Sunanein hain (jinke baare mein hum Barira ke maamle mein jaan paaye). Unhe unke shohar ke baare mein ikhtiyar diya gaya jab unhe azaad kiya gaya. Unhe gosht sadaqe mein diya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab gosht ka ek mitti ka bartan aag par rakha hua tha. Unhone khaana maanga aur unhe roti aur ghar ka aam gosht diya gaya. Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Kya main aag par gosht ka mitti ka bartan nahi dekh raha? Unhone kaha: Haan, Allah ke Rasool, ismein gosht hai jo Barira ko sadaqe mein diya gaya tha. Humein ye munaasib nahi laga ki hum aapko woh khaane ke liye dein, isper unhone kaha: Ye uske liye sadaqa hai, lekin ye humare liye tohfa hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: 'A'isha (Allah be pleated with her) thought of buying a slave-girl and emancipating her, but her owners refused to (sell her but on the condition) that the right of inheritance would vest in them. She made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). whereupon he said: Let this (condition) not stand in your way for the right of inheritance vests with one who emancipates.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Aisha (RA) ne ek laundi khareedne aur use azaad karne ke baare mein socha, lekin uske maalikon ne inkaar kiya (unhe bechne se) siwaay is shart ke ki virasat ka haq unmein rahega. Unhone iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye shart tumhare raaste mein rukaawat na bane kyunki virasat ka haq usi mein nihit hota hai jo azaad karta hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) forbade the selling and making a gift of the right of inheritance of a slave. Imam Muslim said: All the persons depend upon Abdullah b. Dinar in regard to this hadith.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghulam ki virasat ka haq bechne aur tohfe mein dene se mana kiya. Imam Muslim ne kaha: Sab log is hadees ke baare mein Abdullah bin Dinar par nirbhar karte hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) through another chain of transmitters but with this change that in tba hadith narrated by al-Thaqafi from Ubaidullah there is only a mention of selling (or right of inheritance, al-Wala' ) but not that of making a gift.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki al-Thaqafi ki Ubaidullah se riwayat ki hui hadees mein sirf bechne ka (ya virasat ke haq, al-Wala) zikr hai, tohfe mein dene ka nahi.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) made it obligatory for every tribe (the payment) of blood-wit; he then also made it explicit that it is not permissible for a Muslim to make himself the ally (of the slave emancipated by another) Muslim without his permission. He (the narrator further added): I was informed that he (the Holy Prophet) cursed the one who did that (and it was recorded) in his Sahifa (in a document).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har qabile ke liye khoon-baha (bhugtaan) farz kiya; unhone phir ye bhi saaf kiya ki kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh khud ko kisi doosre Musalman ke zariye azaad kiye gaye ghulam ka saathi banaaye uski ijazat ke bagair. Raawi ne aage kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya ki unhone (Nabi ne) us shakhs par laanat ki jisne aisa kiya (aur ye unke Sahifa mein, ek dastaavez mein, darj kiya gaya).

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who takes anyone as his ally without the consent of his previous master, there will be the curse of Allah and that of His angels upon him, and neither, any obligatory act of his nor the supererogatory one will be accepted (by Allah).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo kisi ko apna saathi banaata hai uske pehle maalik ki sehmati ke bagair, uspar Allah ki laanat aur uske farishton ki laanat hai, aur na uska koi farz amal na koi nafil amal (Allah ke zariye) qubool kiya jaayega.
