e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who took the freed slave as his ally without the consent of his previous master, there is upon him the curse of Allah and that of His angels and that of the whole mankind, and there will not be accepted from him his obligatory acts or supercrogatory acts on the Day of Resurrection. This hadith is narrated through the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight change of words.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne azaad kiye gaye ghulam ko apna saathi banaya uske pehle maalik ki sehmati ke bagair, uspar Allah ki laanat aur uske farishton ki aur poori manavata ki laanat hai, aur usse Qayamat ke din uske farz ya nafil amal qubool nahi kiye jaayenge. Ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Ibrahim al-Taimi reported on the authority of his father: 'Ali b. Abu Talib (Allah be pleased with him) addressed us and said: He who thinks that we (the members of the Prophet's family) read anything else besides the Book of Allah and this Sahifa (and he said that Sahifa was tied to the scabbard of the sword) tells a lie. (This Sahifa) contains (problems) pertaining to the ages of the camels and (the recompense) of the injuries, and it also records the words of the Prophet (ﷺ): Medina is a sacred territory from 'Ayr to Thaur (it is most probably Uhud). He who innovates (an act or practice) or gives protection to an innovator, there is a curse of Allah and that of His angels and that of the whole humanity upon him. Allah will not accdpt from him (as a recompense) any obligatory act or supererogatory act, and the responsibility of the Muslims is a joint responsibility; even the lowest in rank can undertake the responsibility (on behalf of others), and he who claims anyone else as his father besides his own father or makes one his ally other than the one (who freed him), there is a curse of Allah. that of His angels and that of the wholemankind upon him. Allah will not accept the obligatory act of the supererogatery act (as a recompense) from him.
hi: Ibrahim al-Taimi ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Jisne socha ki hum (Nabi ke khaandaan ke log) Allah ki Kitaab aur is Sahifa (aur unhone kaha ki ye Sahifa talwaar ke myaan se bandhi hui thi) ke ilawa aur kuch padhte hain, jhoot kehta hai. (Is Sahifa mein) oonton ki umaron aur chotoon (ke muaaviza) se mutalliq (samasyaen) hain, aur isme Nabi (SAW) ke ye alfaaz bhi darj hain: Madina Ayr se Thaur tak ek muqaddas ilaaka hai (ye sambhavatah Uhud hai). Jo koi nayi baat (amal ya tarika) shuru karta hai ya kisi nayi baat shuru karne wale ko panah deta hai, uspar Allah ki laanat aur uske farishton ki aur poori manavata ki laanat hai. Allah usse koi farz ya nafil amal muaaviza ke taur par qubool nahi karega, aur Musalmaanon ki zimmedaari ek saanjhi zimmedaari hai; sabse chhota darja rakhne wala bhi (doosron ki taraf se) zimmedaari le sakta hai, aur jo apne asal waalid ke ilawa kisi aur ka daawa apne waalid ke taur par kare ya kisi ko apna saathi banaaye kisi doosre ke bajaaye (jisne use azaad kiya), uspar Allah ki laanat hai. uske farishton ki aur poori manavata ki laanat hai. Allah usse farz ya nafil amal (muaaviza ke taur par) qubool nahi karega.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone emancipates a Muslim slave, Allah will set free from Hell an organ of his body for every organ of his (slave's) body.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi kisi Musalman ghulam ko azaad karta hai, Allah uske badan ke har ang ke liye uska ek ang jahannam se azaad karega.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace benpon him) as saying: He who emancipates a slave, Allah will set free from Hell every limb (of his body) for every limb of his (slave's) body, even his private parts.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi ghulam ko azaad karta hai, Allah uske (ghulam ke) badan ke har ang ke liye uske badan ka har ang jahannam se azaad karega, uske gupt angon samet bhi.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who emancipates a believing slave. Allah will set free from Fire his every limb for every limb of his (slave's), even his private parts for his.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi momin ghulam ko azaad karta hai, Allah uske (ghulam ke) har ang ke liye uska har ang aag se azaad karega, uske gupt angon samet uske gupt angon ke liye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A Muslim who emancipates a Muslim (slave). Allah will save from Fire every limb of his for every limb (of the slave). Sa'id b. Marjana said: When I heard this hadith from Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him), I went away and made a mention of it to 'Ali b. Husain and he at once emancipated the slave for which Ibn ja'far was prepared to pay ten thousand dirhams or one thousand dinars.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman jo kisi Musalman ghulam ko azaad karta hai, Allah uske (ghulam ke) har ang ke liye uska har ang aag se bachaayega. Sa'id bin Marjana ne kaha: Jab maine ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) se suni, main gaya aur iska zikr Ali bin Husain se kiya aur unhone turant us ghulam ko azaad kiya jiske liye Ibn Ja'far das hazaar dirham ya ek hazaar dinar dene ko taiyaar the.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A son does not repay what he owes his father unless he buys him (the father) in case he is a slave and then emancipates him. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Abu Shaiba there is a slight change of words.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek beta apne waalid ka haq nahi chuka sakta jab tak woh use (waalid ko) na khareed le agar woh ghulam ho aur phir use azaad kare. Ibn Abu Shaiba ki riwayat mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (two types of transactions) Mulamasa and Munabadha
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mulamasa aur Munabadha (do tarah ke saudon) se mana kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported like this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi tarah ki riwayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like this through another chain cf transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah ki ek hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Two types of trarisactions have been forbidden (by the Holy Prophet), al-Mlulamasa and al-Munabadha. As far as Mulamasa transaction is concerned, it is that every one of them (the parties entering into transaction) should touch the garment of the other without careful consideration, and al-Munabadha is that every one of them should throw his cloth to the other and one of them should not see the cloth of his friend.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Do tarah ke saudon se mana kiya gaya hai (Nabi ke ke zariye), al-Mulamasa aur al-Munabadha. Jahan tak Mulamasa sauda ka sawal hai, ye ye hai ki saude mein daakhil hone wale har ek shakhs ko dhyaan se socha-samjha bina doosre ke kapde ko chhoona chahiye, aur al-Munabadha ye hai ki har ek apna kapda doosre ki taraf phenke aur unmein se koi bhi apne dost ka kapda na dekhe.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us (from), two types of business transactions and two ways of dressing. He forbade Mulamasa and Munabadha in transactions. Mulamasa means the touching of another's garment with his hand, whether at night or by day, without turning it over except this much. Munabadha means that a man throws his garment to another and the other throws his garment, and thus confirming their contract without the inspection of mutual agreement.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein do tarah ke saudon aur do tarah ke kapde pehnne se mana kiya. Unhone saudon mein Mulamasa aur Munabadha se mana kiya. Mulamasa ka matlab hai kisi doosre ke kapde ko apne haath se chhoona, chahe raat ho ya din, use palte bina, siwaay itna. Munabadha ka matlab hai ki ek aadmi apna kapda doosre ki taraf phenke aur doosra apna kapda phenke, aur is tarah unke saanjhi sehmati ka nirikshan kiye bina apna anubandh pakka karna.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade a transaction determined by throwing stones, and the type which involves some uncertainty.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aisa sauda mana kiya jo kankariyaan phenkne se tay hota hai, aur woh kism jismein koi anishchitata shaamil ho.

e: 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction called habal al-habala.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne habal al-habala naam ka sauda mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that the people of pre-Islamic days used to sell the meat of the slaughtered camel up to habal al-habala. And habal al-habala implies that a she-camel should give birth and then the (born one should grow young) and become pregnant. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade them that (this transaction).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Islam se pehle ke daur ke log qurbaan kiye gaye oont ka gosht habal al-habala tak bechte the. Aur habal al-habala ka matlab hai ki ek oontni bachcha de aur phir woh (paida hua bachcha bada hokar) garbhvati ho jaaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ye sauda karne se mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: One amongst you should not enter into a transaction when another is bargaining.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi souda tab shuru na kare jab doosra pahle se souda kar raha ho.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person should not enter into a transaction when his brother is already making a transaction and he should not make a proposal of marriage when his brother has already made a proposal except when he gives permission.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs ko souda tab shuru nahi karna chahiye jab uska bhai pehle se souda kar raha ho, aur use shaadi ka prastaav tab nahi dena chahiye jab uska bhai pehle hi prastaav de chuka ho, siwaay is baat ke ki woh ijazat de.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A Muslim should not purchase (in opposition) to his brother.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman ko apne bhai ke khilaaf khareedaari nahi karni chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight change of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace'be upon him) as saying: Do not go out to meet riders to enter into transaction with them; none of you must buy in opposition to another, nor must you bid against one another; a townsman must not sell for a man from the desert, and do not tie up udders of carnels and sheep, and he who buys them after that has been done has two courses open to him: after he has milked them he may keep them if he is pleased with them, or he may return them along with a sit of dates if he is displeased with them.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kaafile se milne ke liye bahar mat jaao unse saude karne ke liye; tum mein se koi doosre ke khilaaf khareedaari na kare, na hi ek-doosre ke khilaaf bikri mein zyada bolo; shehar ka rehne wala kisi dehaati ke liye na beche, aur oont aur bakriyon ke thann na baandho, aur jo koi unhe aise (baandhe hue) khareede, uske paas do ikhtiyar hain: doodh nikaalne ke baad woh unhe rakh sakta hai agar woh unse santusht hai, ya woh unhe kuch khajooron ke saath wapas kar sakta hai agar woh unse asantusht hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (people) meeting the caravan (for entering into business transaction with them), and the selling of goods by a townsman on behalf of a man of the desert, and seeking by a woman the divorce of her sister (from her husband), and outbidding (against one another), and tying up the udders (of animals), and buying of (things) in opposition to one's brother.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaafile se milne (unse sauda karne ke liye) se mana kiya, aur shehar ke rehne wale ka kisi dehaati ki taraf se saamaan bechna, aur ek aurat ka apni behn ki talaaq maangna (uske shohar se), aur bikri mein zyada bolna (ek-doosre ke khilaaf), aur jaanwaron ke thann baandhna, aur apne bhai ke khilaaf khareedaari karna, se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the outbidding (against another).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bikri mein zyada bolne se (ek-doosre ke khilaaf) mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not go out to meet merchandise in the way, (wait) until it is brought into the market. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Numair but with a slight change of words.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Saamaan se milne ke liye raaste mein bahar mat jaao, (intezaar karo) jab tak ye bazaar mein na laaya jaaye. Ye hadees Ibn Numair ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'Ubaidullah.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Do not meet the traders (in the way).
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Vyaapaariyon se (raaste mein) mat milo.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: Do not meet the merchandise (in the way).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Saamaan se (raaste mein) mat milo.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not meet the merchant in the way and enter into business transaction with him, and whoever meets him and buys from him (and in case it is done, see) that when the owner of (merchandise) comes into the market (and finds that he has been paid less price) he has the option (to declare the transaction null and void).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Vyaapaari se raaste mein mat milo aur uske saath sauda mat karo, aur jo koi use milta hai aur usse khareedta hai (aur agar aisa hota hai, dekho) ki jab saamaan ka maalik bazaar mein aata hai (aur paata hai ki use kam keemat di gayi thi) use ikhtiyar hai (sauda radd karne ka).

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): The townsman'should not sell for a man from the desert (with a view to taking advantage of his ignorance of the market conditions of the city). And Zuhair reported from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he forbade the townsman to sell on behalf of the man from the desert.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki: Shehar ka rehne wala kisi dehaati ke liye na beche (uski shehar ke bazaar haalat ki anjaani ka faayda uthaane ke iraade se). Aur Zuhair ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone shehar ke rehne wale ko dehaati ki taraf se bechne se mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The riders (carrying merchandise) should not be met in the way, and townsman should not sell for a man of the desert. The narrator reported. I said to Ibn 'Abbas: What do these words really imply-" The townsman for the man of the desert"? He said: That he should work as a broker on his behalf.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sawaariyon (saamaan le jaane wale) se raaste mein na milo, aur shehar ka rehne wala kisi dehaati ke liye na beche. Raawi ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas se kaha: In alfaazon ka asal matlab kya hai - "Shehar ka rehne wala dehaati ke liye"? Unhone kaha: Ki woh uski taraf se ek dalaal ke taur par kaam kare.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The townsman should not sell for a man from the desert, leave the people alone, Allah will give them provision from one another. Yahya reported it with a slight change of words.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Shehar ka rehne wala dehaati ke liye na beche, logon ko akele chhod do, Allah unhe ek-doosre se rozi dega. Yahya ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported a similar hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne isi tarah ki hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were forbidden that a townsman should sell for a man of the desert, even if he is his brother or father.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humein mana kiya gaya tha ki shehar ka rehne wala dehaati ke liye beche, chahe woh uska bhai ho ya waalid.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) said: We were forbidden that a townsman should sell for a man of the desert.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Humein mana kiya gaya tha ki shehar ka rehne wala dehaati ke liye beche.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be'upon him) as saying: He who bought a goat having its udder tied up should go back with it, milk it, and, if he is satisfied with its milk, he should retair it, otherwise he should return it along with a sa' of dates.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne bandhe hue thann waali bakri khareedi use use wapas jaana chahiye, use doodh nikaalna chahiye, aur agar woh uske doodh se santusht hai to use rakh le, warna use ek sa khajooron ke saath wapas kar de.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys a goat with its udder tied up has the option to retain the goat if he so desires or return it within three days, and in case he returns it he should do so along with a sa' of dates.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo bandhe hue thann waali bakri khareedta hai use ikhtiyar hai ki agar chahe to bakri rakhe ya teen din ke andar wapas kare, aur agar woh wapas kare to use ek sa khajooron ke saath karna chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: lie who buys a goat having its udder tied up has the option to return it within three days. If he returns it he should pay a sa' of dates. Wheat is not essential.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo bandhe hue thann waali bakri khareedta hai use teen din ke andar wapas karne ka ikhtiyar hai. Agar woh wapas kare to use ek sa khajooren bhugtaan karni chahiye. Gehun zaroori nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys a goat having its udder tied up has two courses left for him. He may retain it, and if he desires may return it along with a sa' of dates and not wheat.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo bandhe hue thann waali bakri khareedta hai uske paas do raste hain. Woh use rakh sakta hai, aur agar woh chaahe to use ek sa khajooron ke saath wapas kar sakta hai, na ki gehun ke saath.

e: Ayyub narrated with the same chain of transmitters but with this change of words: " He who buys a goat has the option...."
hi: Ayyub ne isi sanad se riwayat ki lekin is alfaaz ki tabdeeli ke saath: "Jo bakri khareedta hai use ikhtiyar hai..."

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: Out of the ahadith which Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If one among you buys a she-camel having its udder tied up he has the two options for him after milking it either (to retain it) or return it with a sa' of dates.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Un hadeeson mein se jo Abu Huraira (RA) ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi bandhe hue thann waali oontni khareedta hai use doodh nikaalne ke baad do ikhtiyar hain, ya to use rakhe ya use ek sa khajooron ke saath wapas kare.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys foodgrain should not sell it until he has taken possession of it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo anaaj khareedta hai use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne uska kabza na le liya ho.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys food-rain should not sell it until he has taken possession of it. Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: I regard everything like food (so far as this principle is concerned).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo anaaj khareedta hai use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne uska kabza na le liya ho. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Main har cheez ko khaane ke saman jaisa maanta hoon (jahan tak ye siddhant lagoo hota hai).

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys foodgrain should not sell it, until he has weighed it (and then taken possession of it). I (Tawus) said to Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them): Why is it so? Thereupon he said: Don't you see that they (the people) sell foodgrains against gold for the stipulated time. Abu Kuraib did not make any mention of the stipulated time.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo anaaj khareedta hai use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne use taul na le liya ho (aur phir uska kabza na le liya ho). Maine (Tawus ne) Ibn Abbas se kaha: Aisa kyun hai? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum nahi dekhte ki log anaaj sona ke badle muqarrar muddat ke liye bechte hain. Abu Kuraib ne muqarrar muddat ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys foodgrain should not sell it until he has taken full possession of it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo anaaj khareedta hai use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne uska poora kabza na le liya ho.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We used to buy foodgrains during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) would then send to us one who commanded us to take them (the foodgrains) to a place other than the one where we had bought them before we sold it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein anaaj khareedte the. Woh phir humare paas kisi ko bhejte jo humein hukum deta ki hum unhe (anaaj ko) usse doosri jagah le jaayein jahan humne unhe khareeda tha, isse pehle ki hum unhe bechein.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys foodgrain should not sell that before taking possession of it. He (the narrator) said: We used to buy foodgrain from the caravans in bulk, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to re-sell that until we had shifted it to some other place.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo anaaj khareedta hai use uska kabza lene se pehle nahi bechna chahiye. Raawi ne kaha: Hum kaafiloon se bahutayat mein anaaj khareedte the, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein use dobara bechne se mana kiya jab tak humne use kisi aur jagah muntaqil na kar diya ho.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had taken full possession of it (after measuring it).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne anaaj khareeda use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne, taulne ke baad, uska poora kabza na le liya ho.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying,: He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had taken possession of it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne anaaj khareeda use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne uska kabza na le liya ho.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that they were beaten during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) if they had bought foodgrains in bulk and then sold them in the spot without shifting them (to some other place).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein maara jaata tha agar unhone bahutayat mein anaaj khareeda tha aur phir use usi jagah bina muntaqil kiye becha tha.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported his father havingsaid this: I saw people being beaten during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in case they bought the foodgrain in bulk, and then sold them at that spot before taking it to their places. This hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah b. Abdullah b. 'Umar through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" His father (Ibn 'Umar) used to buy foodgrains in bulk and then carried them to his people."
hi: Salim bin Abdullah (RA) ne apne walid ke ye alfaaz kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine logon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein maara jaate dekha agar woh anaaj bahutayat mein khareedte the, aur phir use apni jagah le jaane se pehle usi jagah bech dete the. Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Unke walid, Ibn Umar, bahutayat mein anaaj khareeda karte the aur phir use apne logon tak le jaate."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who bought foodgrain should not sell it until he had measured it. In the narration of Abu Bakr there the word is Ibta' instead of Ishtara.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne anaaj khareeda use tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak usne use taula na ho. Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein "Ishtara" ki jagah "Ibta'" lafz hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be please with him) is reported to have said to Marwan: Have you made lawful the transactions involving interest? Thereupon Marwan said: I have not done that. Thereupon Abu Huraira (ﷺ) said: You have made lawful the transactions with the help of documents only, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction of foodgrains until full possession is taken of them. Marwan then addressed the people and forbade them to enter into such transactions (as are done with the help of documents). Sulaiman said: I saw the sentinels snatching (these documents) from the people.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, Marwan se kaha: Kya aapne sood se jude saudon ko jaayez bana diya hai? Isper Marwan ne kaha: Maine aisa nahi kiya. Isper Abu Huraira (SAW) ne kaha: Aapne dastaavezon ki madad se saude jaayez bana diye hain, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne anaaj ke sauda se mana kiya jab tak uska poora kabza na le liya jaaye. Marwan ne phir logon se khitaab kiya aur unhe aise saude karne se mana kiya (jo dastaavezon ki madad se kiye jaate hain). Sulaiman ne kaha: Maine chowkidaaron ko ye (dastaavezein) logon se chheenat dekha.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you purchase foodgrains, do not sell them until you have taken possession of them.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum anaaj khareedo, use tab tak mat becho jab tak tumne uska kabza na le liya ho.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) is reported to have said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of a heap of dates the weight of which is unknown in accordance with the known weight of dates.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne, ye kaha jaata hai, kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khajooron ke ek dher ka sauda mana kiya jiska wazan anjaan ho, khajooron ke jaane-maane wazan ke mutabik.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) but with this variation that no mention is made of the dates (which one finds) at the end of the previous hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki pichhli hadees ke akhir mein khajooron (jo mili) ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Both parties in a business transaction have the right to annul it so long as they have not separated; except in transactions which have been made subject to the right of parties to annul them.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi business sauda ke donon pakshon ko use radd karne ka haq hai jab tak woh alag nahi ho jaate; siwaay un saudon ke jinhein pakshon ke unhe radd karne ke haq ke adheen banaaya gaya ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with thcm) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two persons enter into a transaction, each of them has the right to annul it so long as they are not separated and are together (at the place of transaction) ; or if one gives the other the right (to annul the transaction) But if one gives the other the option, the transaction is made on this condition (i. e. one has the right to annul the transaction), it becomes binding. And if they are separated after they have made the bargain and none of them annulled it, even then the transaction is binding.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab do log koi sauda karte hain, unmein se har ek ko use radd karne ka haq hai jab tak woh alag nahi ho jaate aur saath (sauda ki jagah par) hain; ya agar ek doosre ko haq de (sauda radd karne ka). Lekin agar ek doosre ko ikhtiyar de, sauda is shart par banta hai (yaani ek ko sauda radd karne ka haq hai), ye pakka ho jaata hai. Aur agar woh sauda karne ke baad alag ho jaate hain aur unmein se koi bhi use radd nahi karta, tab bhi sauda pakka hota hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two persons enter into a transac. tion, each one of them has the right to annul it so long as they are not separated, or their transaction gives one another (as a condition) the right of annulling, and if their transaction, has the right of annulling it the transaction becomes binding. Ibn Abi Umar made this addition that whenever he (Ibn Umar) entered into a transaction with a person with the intention of not breaking it, he walked a while and then returned to him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab do log koi sauda karte hain, unmein se har ek ko use radd karne ka haq hai jab tak woh alag nahi ho jaate, ya unka sauda ek-doosre ko (shart ke soorat mein) radd karne ka haq deta hai, aur agar unka sauda radd karne ka haq deta hai to sauda pakka ho jaata hai. Ibn Abu Umar ne ye izafa kiya ki jab bhi woh (Ibn Umar) kisi shakhs ke saath, use na todne ke iraade se, sauda karte, woh thodi der chalte aur phir uske paas wapas aate.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transaction between two persons entering a transaction until they separate, but only when there is an option to annul it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sauda karne wale do logon ke beech koi (pakka) sauda tab tak nahi hota jab tak woh alag nahi ho jaate, siwaay iske ki use radd karne ka ikhtiyar ho.

e: Hakim b. Hazim (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Both parties in a business transaction have the right to annul it so long as they have not separated; and if they speak the truth and make everything clear they will be blessed in their transaction; but if they tell a lie and conceal anything the blessing on their transaction will be blotted out.
hi: Hakim bin Hazim (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi business sauda ke donon paksh use radd karne ka haq rakhte hain jab tak woh alag nahi ho jaate; aur agar woh sach bolte hain aur sab kuch saaf karte hain to unhe apne sauda mein barkat milegi; lekin agar woh jhoot bolte hain aur kuch chhupaate hain to unke sauda ki barkat mit jaayegi.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Hakim b. Hizam (Imam Muslim) said: Hakim b. Hizam was born inside the Ka'ba and lived for one hundred and twenty years.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hakim bin Hizam ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. (Imam Muslim) ne kaha: Hakim bin Hizam Kaaba ke andar paida huye the aur ek sau bees saal jeevit rahe.

e: Abdullah b. Dinar narrated that he heard Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) saying: A man mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he was deceived in a business transaction, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When you enter into a transaction, say: There should be no attempt to deceive.
hi: Abdullah bin Dinar ne riwayat ki ki unhone Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr kiya ki use ek business sauda mein dhoka diya gaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum koi sauda karo, kaho: Isme koi dhoka na ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters but these words are not found in it." When he buys he should say: There should be no attempt to deceive."
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Dinar ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ye alfaaz ismein nahi hain: "Jab woh khareede use kehna chahiye: Isme koi dhoka na ho."

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits until they were clearly in good condition, he forbade it both to the seller and to the buyer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phalon ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh saaf taur par achhi haalat mein na aa jaayein, unhone bechne wale aur khareedne wale donon ko mana kiya.

e: Another chain on the authority of Ibn 'Umar narrated the same as the above hadith.
hi: Ibn Umar ki ek doosri sanad se upar wali hadees ki tarah hi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of palm-trees (i. e. their trults) until the dates began to ripen, and ears of corn until they were white and were safe from blight. He forbade the seller and the buyer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khajoor ke darakhton (yaani unke phalon) ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak khajooren pakni shuru na ho jaayein, aur anaaj ki baalen (bechne se mana kiya) jab tak woh safed na ho jaayein aur keeda lagne se mahfooz na ho jaayein. Unhone bechne wale aur khareedne wale donon ko mana kiya.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not buy fruit until its good condition becomes clear, and (the danger) of blight is no more. He said: Its good condition becoming clear implies that it becomes red or yellow.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Phal tab tak mat khareedo jab tak uski achhi haalat saaf na ho jaaye, aur (keeda lagne ka) khatra khatam na ho jaaye. Unhone kaha: Uski achhi haalat ka saaf hona ka matlab hai ki woh laal ya peela ho jaaye.

e: This hadith is reported or the authority of Yahya with the same chain of transmitters up to" until its good condition becomes clear," but lie did not mention what follows (these words).
hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai "jab tak uski achhi haalat saaf na ho jaaye" tak, lekin unhone iske aage ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nafi, reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) a hadith like that narrated before.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki jo pehle riwayat ki gayi thi.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger' (ﷺ) as saying: Do not buy fruits (on the trees) until their good condition becomes clear.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Phal (darakhton par) tab tak mat khareedo jab tak unki achhi haalat saaf na ho jaaye.

e: In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba it was stated that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) was asked what good condition implied. He said: When (the danger of) blight is no more.
hi: Shu'ba ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein bataaya gaya ki Ibn Umar (RA) se poocha gaya ki achhi haalat ka kya matlab hai. Unhone kaha: Jab (keeda lagne ka) khatra khatam ho jaaye.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (or forbade us) the sale of fruits until they are ripe in a good condition.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (ya humein) phalon ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh achhi haalat mein pak na jaayein.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the sale of fruit until its good condition is obvious.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko phal ke bikri se mana karte suna jab tak uski achhi haalat saaf na ho.

e: Abu Bakhtari reported: I asked Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the sale of dates. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of dates of the trees until one eats them or they are eaten (i. e. they are fit to be eaten) or until they are weighed (or measured). I said: What does it imply:" Until it is weighed"? Thereupon a person who was with him (Ibn Abbas) said: Until he is able to keep it with him (after plucking them).
hi: Abu Bakhtari ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se khajooron ke bikri ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne darakhton par khajooron ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak koi unhe khaaye ya woh khaaye jaane ke laayak ho, ya jab tak unhe taula na jaaye (ya naapa na jaaye). Maine kaha: Iska kya matlab hai: "Jab tak use taula na jaaye"? Isper unke saath baithe ek shakhs ne kaha: Jab tak woh (kaatne ke baad) use apne paas rakh sake.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not sell the fruits until their good condition becomes evident."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Phal tab tak mat becho jab tak unki achhi haalat saaf na ho jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding the sale of fruits until their good condition becomes evident and the purchase of dates for dates.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko phalon ke bikri se mana karte suna jab tak unki achhi haalat saaf na ho jaaye, aur khajooron ko khajooron ke badle khareedne se bhi.

e: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a concession in case of the sale known as al-araya, there is an addition of the word an tuba'a in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Numair.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-araya naam ke sauda ke maamle mein chhoot di, aur Ibn Numair ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "an tuba'a" lafz ka izafa hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not buy the fruit until their condition is clear, and do not buy the fresh dates. A hadith like this has been reported by Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Phal tab tak mat khareedo jab tak unki halat saaf na ho jaaye, aur taazi khajooren mat khareedo. Isi jaisi ek hadees Ibn Umar ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the transaction of Af Muzabana and Muhaqala. Muzabana means that fresh dates on the trees should be sold against dry dates. Muhaqala implies that the wheat in the ear should be sold against the wheat and getting the land on rent for the wheat (produced in it). He (the narrator) said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had aid: Do not sell fresh fruits on the trees until their good condition becomes manifest, and do not sell fresh dates on the trees against dry dates. Salim said: Abdullah informed me on the authority of Zaid b. Thabit, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having given concession afterwards in case of ariyya transactions by which dry dates can be exchanged with fresh dates, but he did not permit it in other cases.
hi: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-Muzabana aur al-Muhaqala saude se mana kiya. Muzabana ka matlab hai ki darakhton par taazi khajooren sookhi khajooron ke badle bechi jaayein. Muhaqala ka matlab hai ki baali mein gehun ko gehun ke badle bechna aur gehun (jo usmein paida hoga) ke liye zameen kiraaye par lena. Raawi ne kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha tha: Darakhton par taazi phal tab tak mat becho jab tak unki achhi haalat saaf na ho, aur darakhton par taazi khajooren sookhi khajooron ke badle mat becho. Salim ne kaha: Abdullah ne mujhe Zaid bin Thabit ke hawale se bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baad mein ariyya saudon mein chhoot di jismein sookhi khajooren taazi khajooron se badali ja sakti hain, lekin unhone ise doosre maamlon mein ijazat nahi di.

e: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) having given concession in case of 'ariyya for selling dry dates (with) fresh dates after measuring them out.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ariyya ke maamle mein sookhi khajooren taazi khajooron (ke badle bechne) mein chhoot di, unhe naapne ke baad.

e: Zaid b. Thabit reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) give concession in case of 'ariyya transactions according to which the members of the household give dry dates according to a measure and then eat fresh dates (in exchange for it)
hi: Zaid bin Thabit ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ariyya saudon mein chhoot di jiske mutabik khaandaan ke log naap ke mutabik sookhi khajooren dete hain aur phir (badle mein) taazi khajooren khaate hain.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Yahya b. Sa'id reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters but with this change: 'Ariyya implies that date-palm trees should be donated to the people and then they sell it with a measure of dry dates.
hi: Yahya bin Sa'id ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki lekin is tabdeeli ke saath: Ariyya ka matlab hai ki khajoor ke darakht logon ko tohfe mein diye jaayein aur phir woh use sookhi khajooron ke ek naap ke badle bechein.

e: Zaid b Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave concession in case of al-'ariyya transactions (for exchanging dates) for dates with measure. Yahya said: 'Ariyya implies that a person should buy fresh dates on the tree for his family to eat against a measure of dry dates.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-ariyya saudon mein chhoot di (khajooron ka khajooron se, naap ke saath, exchange karne ke liye). Yahya ne kaha: Ariyya ka matlab hai ki ek shakhs apne khaandaan ke khaane ke liye darakht par taazi khajooren khareede sookhi khajooron ke ek naap ke badle.

e: Zaid b. Thabit (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granting concession in case of 'ariyya transactions and that implies selling of (dry dates for fresh dates) according to a measure.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ariyya saudon mein chhoot di aur iska matlab hai (sookhi khajooren taazi khajooron ke badle) naap ke mutabik bechna.

e: Ubaidullah reported this hadith with a slight change of words on the same authority (as quoted above).
hi: Ubaidullah ne ye hadees isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Nafi, reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters stating that Allah's Messengtr (ﷺ) granted concession in case of 'ariyya transactions (for exchange of the same commodity) with measure.
hi: Nafi ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki ye kehte hue ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ariyya saudon mein (usi cheez ke exchange ke liye) naap ke saath chhoot di.

e: Bashair b. Yasir reported on the authority of some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) among the members of his family among whom one was Sahl b. Abu Hathma that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade buying of fresh dates against dry dates and that it is Riba and this is Muzabana, but he made an exemption of 'ariyya (donations) of a tree or two in which case the members of a family sell dry dates and buy fresh dates for eating them.
hi: Bashair bin Yasir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke hawale se, apne khaandaan ke logon mein se, jinmein se ek Sahl bin Abu Hathma the, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taazi khajooren sookhi khajooron ke badle khareedne se mana kiya aur ki ye Riba hai aur ye Muzabana hai, lekin unhone ek ya do darakhton ke ariyya (tohfe) mein chhoot di jismein khaandaan ke log sookhi khajooren bechte hain aur khane ke liye taazi khajooren khareedte hain.

e: Bushair b. Yasar reported on the authority of some of the Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he exempted the transactions, of 'ariyya (from the direct exchange of one kind) after measuring the dry dates (in exchange for fresh dates).
hi: Bushair bin Yasar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone ariyya saudon mein chhoot di (ek hi kism ke seedhe exchange se) sookhi khajooron ko naapne ke baad (taazi khajooron ke badle mein).

e: Bushair b. Yasir reported on the authority of some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hinn) from among the members of his family that he forbade (the direct exchange of a commodity having different qualities) but with the change that Ishaq and Ibn al-Muthanna used the word Zabn in place of Riba and Ibn Abu 'Umar used the word Riba (interest).
hi: Bushair bin Yasir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke hawale se, apne khaandaan ke logon mein se, riwayat ki ki unhone mana kiya (mukhtalif gunon wali cheez ka seedha exchange) lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki Ishaq aur Ibn al-Muthanna ne "Riba" ki jagah "Zabn" lafz istemal kiya aur Ibn Abu Umar ne "Riba" (sood) lafz istemal kiya.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Sahl bin Abu Hathma ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sahl b. Abu Hathma reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, i. e. exchange of fresh dates with dry dates. except in case of those to whom donations of some trees have been made. It is for them that concession has been given.
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzabana se mana kiya, yaani taazi khajooron ka sookhi khajooron se exchange, siwaay un logon ke jinhe kuch darakht tohfe mein diye gaye hon. Unhi ke liye chhoot di gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having given exemption of 'ariyya transactions measuring less than five wasqs or up to five wasqs (the narrator Dawud is in doubt whether it was five or less than five).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ariyya saudon mein chhoot dete hue paaya jinka naap paanch wasq se kam ya paanch wasq tak ho (raawi Dawud ko shak hai ki ye paanch tha ya paanch se kam).

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana implies the selling of fresh dates for dry dates by measuring them out and the selling of raisins by measure for grapes.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzabana se mana kiya, aur Muzabana ka matlab hai taazi khajooren sookhi khajooron ke badle naap kar bechna aur kishmish angoor ke badle naap kar bechna.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Umar) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade Muzabana, i. e. buying of fresh dates (on) the trees for dry dates by measure, and the buying of grapes for raisins by measure and the selling of field of corn for corn by measure.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzabana se mana kiya, yaani darakhton par taazi khajooren sookhi khajooron ke badle naap kar khareedna, aur angoor ko kishmish ke badle naap kar khareedna aur anaaj ke khet ko anaaj ke badle naap kar bechna.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana is the selling of dry dates by measure for fresh dates and the selling of raisins by measure for grapes and selling of all Ports of fruits on the basis of calculation.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzabana se mana kiya, aur Muzabana hai sookhi khajooron ko naap kar taazi khajooron ke badle bechna aur kishmish ko naap kar angoor ke badle bechna aur sab tarah ke phalon ko andaaze ke aadhar par bechna.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Muzabana, and Muzabana implies the selling of dry dates for fresh dates on the tree with a definite measure (making it clear) that in case it increases, it belongs to me and if it is less, it is my responsibility.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzabana se mana kiya, aur Muzabana ka matlab hai sookhi khajooren darakht par taazi khajooron ke badle ek muqarrar naap ke saath bechna (ye saaf karte hue) ki agar ye badh jaaye to woh mera hai aur agar kam ho to ye meri zimmedaari hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ayyub.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ayyub ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah (b. Umar) (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Mazabana, and it implies that one should sell the fresh fruits of his orchard (for dry fruits) or, if it is fresh dates, for dry dates with a measure, or if it is grapes for raisins or if it is corn in the field for dry corn with a measure He (the Holy Prophet) in fact forbade all such transactions. Qutaiba has narrated it with a slight variation of words.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mazabana se mana kiya, aur iska matlab hai ki koi apne baag ke taaze phal (sookhe phalon ke badle) beche, ya, agar ye taazi khajooren hain, sookhi khajooron ke badle naap kar, ya agar angoor hain to kishmish ke badle, ya agar khet mein anaaj hai to sookhe anaaj ke badle naap kar. Unhone in sab saudon se mana kiya. Qutaiba ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Nafi ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone buys palm-trees after they have been fecundated the fruit belongs to the seller unless the buyer makes a proviso.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi khajoor ke darakht unke pardan hone ke baad khareedta hai to phal bechne wale ka rahega jab tak khareedne wala koi shart na rakhe.

e: Nafi reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whichever tree is bought with its roots, and if it is fecundatedits fruit would belong to one who has grafted it except when the provision is laid down by the buyer.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo bhi darakht apni jadon samet khareeda jaaye, aur agar woh pardan ho, to uska phal usi ka hoga jisne use gaadha hai, siwaay is baat ke ki khareedne wala shart rakhe.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Whosoever grafts the tree and then sells its roots, its fruit will belong to one who grafts it except when provision is laid down by the buyer.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi darakht ko gaadta hai aur phir uski jaden bechta hai, uska phal usi ka rahega jisne use gaadha hai, siwaay is baat ke ki khareedne wala shart rakhe.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi, with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who buys a tree after it has been fecundated, its fruit belongs to one who sells it except when the provision has been laid down by the buyer (that it will belong to him), and he who buys a slave, his property belongs to one who sells him except when a provision has been laid down by the buyer (that it will be transferred to him with the slave).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo darakht uske pardan hone ke baad khareedta hai, uska phal bechne wale ka hoga siwaay is baat ke ki khareedne wale ne shart rakhi ho (ki woh uski hogi), aur jo ghulam khareedta hai, uski maal bechne wale ki hogi siwaay is baat ke ki khareedne wale ne shart rakhi ho (ki woh ghulam ke saath uski ho jaayegi).

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of al Zuhri.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees al-Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported on the authority of his father as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying so.
hi: Ibn Umar ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden Muhaqala. and Muzabana, Mukhibara and the sale of fruits until their good condition becomes clear, and (he commanded) that (commodities) should not be sold but for the dinar and dirham except in case of araya.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muhaqala, aur Muzabana, Mukhabara aur phalon ke bikri se, jab tak unki achhi haalat saaf na ho, mana kiya, aur (hukum diya) ki cheezein dinar aur dirham ke siwaay na bechi jaayein siwaay araya ke maamle mein.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the types of sales as described before.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pehle bataaye gaye kism ke saudon se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Mukhabara and Muhaqala, and Muzabana, and the sale of the fruit until it is fit for eating, and its sale but with dirham and dinar. Exception is made in case of 'araya. Ata' said: Jabir explained (these terms) for us. As for Mukhabara it is this that a wasteland is given by a person to another and he makes an investment in it and then gets a share in the produce. According to him (Jabir), Muzabana is the sell of fresh dates on the tree for dry dates with a measure, and Muhaqala in agriculture implies that one should sell the standing crop for grains with a measure.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mukhabara aur Muhaqala, aur Muzabana, aur phal ke bikri se, jab tak ye khaane ke laayak na ho, aur iski bikri sirf dirham aur dinar ke saath, mana kiya. Araya ke maamle mein chhoot di gayi. Ata ne kaha: Jabir ne humein ye (shabd) samjhaaye. Jahan tak Mukhabara ka sawal hai, ye hai ki ek banjar zameen ek shakhs ko doosre ke zariye di jaati hai aur woh usmein investment karta hai aur phir upaj mein hissa paata hai. Unke mutabik, Muzabana darakht par taazi khajooron ki sookhi khajooron ke badle naap ke saath bikri hai, aur kheti mein Muhaqala ka matlab hai ki khadi fasal ko anaaj ke badle naap ke saath bechna.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala, and Muzabana, and Mukhabara, and the buying of date-palm until its fruit is ripened (ripening means that its colour becomes red or yellow, or it is fit for being eaten). And Muhaqala implies that crops in the field are bought for grains according to a customary measure. Muzabana implies that date-palm should be sold for dry dates by measuring them with wisqs, and al-Mukhabara is (a share), maybe one-third or one-fourth (in produce) or something like it. Zaid (one of the narrators) said to Ata' b. Abu Rabah (the other narrator): Did You bear Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) making a mention of it that he had heard it directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Muhaqala, aur Muzabana, aur Mukhabara se, aur khajoor ke darakht ki khareedaari se jab tak uska phal pak na jaaye (pakne ka matlab hai ki uska rang laal ya peela ho jaaye, ya woh khaane ke laayak ho), mana karte suna. Aur Muhaqala ka matlab hai ki khet mein fasal anaaj ke badle ek aam naap ke mutabik khareedi jaaye. Muzabana ka matlab hai ki khajoor ka darakht sookhi khajooron ke badle wisq ke naap se becha jaaye, aur al-Mukhabara ek hissa hai, shayad tihai ya chauthai (upaj mein) ya isi jaisa kuch. Zaid (ek raawi) ne Ata bin Abu Rabah (doosre raawi) se kaha: Kya aapne Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko iska zikr karte suna ki unhone ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muzabana and Muhaqala, and Mukhabara, and the sale of fruits until they are ripe. I (the narrator) said to Sa'id (the other narrator): What does ripening imply? He said: It meant that they become red or become yellow and are fit for eating.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Muzabana aur Muhaqala, aur Mukhabara, aur phalon ke bikri se, jab tak woh pak na jaayein, mana karte suna. Maine (raawi ne) Sa'id (doosre raawi) se kaha: Pakne ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki woh laal ho jaayein ya peele ho jaayein aur khaane ke laayak ho jaayein.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala and Muzabana and Mu'awama and Mukhabara. (One of the narrators) 'said: Sale years ahead is Mu'awama, and making exceptional but he made an exemption of araya.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Muhaqala aur Muzabana aur Mu'awama aur Mukhabara se mana karte suna. (Ek raawi ne) kaha: Saalon aage ki bikri Mu'awama hai, aur ek apwaad banaate hue unhone araya mein chhoot di.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). but he made no mention of transactions years (ahead) implying Mu'awama.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Jabir (RA) ki sanad se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin unhone saal (aage) ke saudon ka koi zikr nahi kiya jinka matlab Mu'awama hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade leasing of land, and selling ahead for years and selling of fruits before they become ripe.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se, aur saalon aage bechne se, aur phalon ko unke pakne se pehle bechne se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden the renting of land.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko zameen kiraaye par dene se mana karte suna.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who has land should cultivate it himself, but if he does not cultivate it himself, then he should let his brother cultivate it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas zameen hai use khud isse kheti karni chahiye, lekin agar woh khud kheti na kare, to use apne bhai ko kheti karne dena chahiye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had surplus of land. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He, who has surplus land (in his possession) should cultivate it, or he should lend it to his brother for benefit, but if he refuses to accept it, he should retain it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke paas atirikt zameen thi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas atirikt zameen ho (apni malkiyat mein) use isse kheti karni chahiye, ya use apne bhai ko faayde ke liye udhaar dena chahiye, lekin agar woh ise qubool karne se inkaar kare, to use isse apne paas rakhna chahiye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden taking of rent or share of land.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko zameen se kiraaya ya hissa lene se mana karte suna.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who has land should cultivate it, but if he does not find it possible to cultivate it, or finds himself helpless to do so, he should lend it to his Muslim brother, but he should not accept rent from him.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas zameen hai use isse kheti karni chahiye, lekin agar woh isse kheti karna sambhav na paaye, ya isse karne mein khud ko asamarth paaye, use ise apne Musalman bhai ko udhaar dena chahiye, lekin use usse kiraaya nahi lena chahiye.

e: Sulaiman b. Musa asked Ata': Did Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:" He who has land should cultivate it himself, or let his brother cultivate it, and should not give on rent"? He said: Yes.
hi: Sulaiman bin Musa ne Ata se poocha: Kya Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: "Jiske paas zameen hai use khud isse kheti karni chahiye, ya apne bhai ko isse kheti karne dein, aur ise kiraaye par nahi dena chahiye"? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having forbidden Mukhabara.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Mukhabara se mana karte suna.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who has surplus of land should either cultivate it himself, or let his brother cultivate it, an should not sell it. I (the narrator) said to Sa'id: What does his statement" do not sell it" mean? Does it imply" rent"? He said: Yes.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas atirikt zameen hai use isse khud kheti karni chahiye, ya apne bhai ko isse kheti karne dena chahiye, aur ise bechna nahi chahiye. Maine (raawi ne) Sa'id se kaha: Unke alfaaz "ise mat becho" ka kya matlab hai? Kya iska matlab "kiraaya" hai? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We used to cultivate land on rent during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and we got a share out of the grain left in the ears after threshing them and something unspecified. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has land should cultivate it or let his brother till it, otherwise he should leave it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein zameen kiraaye par kheti karte the aur humein woh anaaj mein hissa milta jo baaliyon mein bacha rehta unhe daantne (thresh karne) ke baad, aur kuch anishchit hissa. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas zameen hai use isse kheti karni chahiye ya apne bhai ko isse kheti karne dena chahiye, warna use ise chhod dena chahiye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We used to get land (on rent) during the lifetime of Allah's Messeuge, (ﷺ) with a share of one-third or one-fourth (of the produce from the land irrigated) with the help of canals. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up (to address) and said: HRe who has land should cultivate it, and if he does not cultivate it, he should lend it to his brother, and if he does not lend it to his brother, he should then retain it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein zameen (kiraaye par) tihai ya chauthai hisse ke saath lete the (nehron ki madad se sinchit zameen ki upaj se). Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue (khitaab dene ke liye) aur kaha: Jiske paas zameen hai use isse kheti karni chahiye, aur agar woh isse kheti na kare, to use apne bhai ko ise udhaar dena chahiye, aur agar woh apne bhai ko udhaar na de, to use ise apne paas rakhna chahiye.

e: Jabir (Allah he pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who has (surplus) land should donate it (to others), or lend it.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas (atirikt) zameen hai use ise (doosron ko) sadqa dena chahiye, ya udhaar dena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight change of words.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Jabir b. `Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reportedthat Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden renting of land. Bukair (one of the narrators) said: Nafi` reported to me that he heard Ibn `Umar (Allah be pleased with them) saying: We usedto give land on rent; we then abandoned this practice when we heard the hadith of Rafi` b. Khadij.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya. Bukair (ek raawi) ne kaha: Nafi ne mujhe bataaya ki unhone Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Hum zameen kiraaye par diya karte the; humne ye amal chhod diya jab humne Rafi bin Khadij ki hadees suni.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the selling (renting of) uncultivated land for two years or three.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do ya teen saal ke liye bina jotai wali zameen ke bikri (kiraaye) se mana karte suna.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding selling of (produce) in advance for two years, and in the narmtion of Ibu Abd Shaiba (the words are): " Selling of the fruits (on the tree) in advance for two years."
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do saal aage ke liye (upaj ki) pahle se bikri se mana karte suna, aur Ibu Abd Shaiba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Do saal aage ke liye darakht par phalon ki pahle se bikri."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who has land should cultivate it or lend it to his brother, but if he refuses, he should retain his land.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas zameen hai use isse kheti karni chahiye ya apne bhai ko udhaar dena chahiye, lekin agar woh inkaar kare, to use apni zameen apne paas rakhni chahiye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muzabana, and Huqul. Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) said: Muzabana means the selling of fruits for dry dates and Huqul is the renting of land.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Muzabana aur Huqul se mana karte suna. Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: Muzabana ka matlab hai phalon ko sookhi khajooron ke badle bechna aur Huqul zameen kiraaye par dena hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding Muhaqala and Muzabana.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Muhaqala aur Muzabana se mana karte suna.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having forbidden Mazabana and Muhaqala. Muzibana means the buying of fruits on the trees and Muhaqala is the renting of land.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mazabana aur Muhaqala se mana kiya. Muzibana ka matlab hai darakhton par phal khareedna aur Muhaqala zameen kiraaye par dena hai.

e: Zaid b. Amr reported: I heard Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) say: We did not see any harm in renting of the land, but as the first year was over Rafi' alleged Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having forbidden that.
hi: Zaid bin Amr ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Humne zameen kiraaye par dene mein koi nuksaan nahi dekha, lekin jaise hi pehla saal khatam hua Rafi ne daawa kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse mana kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Amr b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters but (in) the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Uyainah (the words are): " We abandoned it (renting) on account of that."
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Dinar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin Uyainah ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Humne ise, kiraaye par dena, isi wajah se chhod diya."

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Rafi forbade us from benefitting from our land (in the form of rent).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Rafi ne humein apni zameen se faayda uthaane (kiraaye ke soorat mein) se mana kiya.

e: Nafi reported that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) rented his land during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and during the caliphate of Abu Bakr and that of Umar and that of Uthman (Allah be pleased with them) and during the early period of Muawiya's caliphate until at the end of Muawiya's reign, it reached him (Ibn 'Umar) that Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) narratted (a hadith) in which (there was a decree) of prohibition by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He (Ibn 'Umar) went to him (Rafi b. Khadij) and I was with him and he asked him, whereupon he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to forbid the renting of land. So Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) abandoned it, and subsequently whenever he was asked about it, he said: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) alleged that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade it.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar (RA) ne apni zameen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein aur Abu Bakr aur Umar aur Uthman (RA) ki khilafat ke daurane aur Muawiya ki khilafat ke shuru ke daurane bhi kiraaye par di yahan tak ki Muawiya ke shaasan ke akhir mein, unhe (Ibn Umar ko) pata chala ki Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne ek hadees riwayat ki thi jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka (isse mana karne ka) faisla tha. Woh (Ibn Umar) unke (Rafi bin Khadij ke) paas gaye aur main unke saath tha aur unhone unse poocha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya karte the. To Ibn Umar (RA) ne ise chhod diya, aur uske baad jab bhi unse iske baare mein poocha jaata, woh kehte: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne daawa kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub and he made an addition in the hadith narrated by Ibn Ulayya in which he said: Ibn Umar abandoned it afterwards and he did not rent it (the land).
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone Ibn Ulayya ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein ye izafa kiya jismein unhone kaha: Ibn Umar ne baad mein ise chhod diya aur unhone zameen kiraaye par nahi di.

e: Nafi reported: I went to Rafi b. Khadij in the company of Ibn 'Umar (All be pleased with them) until he (Ibn 'Umar) came to him at Balat (a place near Prophet's Mosque at Medina) and he (Rafi b. Khadij) informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the renting of land.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya: Main Rafi bin Khadij ke paas gaya Ibn Umar (RA) ki sohbat mein yahan tak ki woh (Ibn Umar) Balat (Nabi ki Masjid ke qareeb Madina mein ek jagah) mein unke paas aaye aur unhone (Rafi bin Khadij ne) unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya tha.

e: Nafi, reported from Ibn Umar (Allah be pleated with them) that he came to Rafi and he narrated this hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat ki ki woh Rafi ke paas aaye aur unhone ye hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Nafi, reported that Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to rent the land, and that he was conveyed the hadith transmitted on the authority of Rafi b. Khadij. He (the narrator) said: He then went to him along with me. He (Rafi) narrated from some of his uncles in which it was mentioned that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) then abandoned this practice of renting.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar (RA) zameen kiraaye par diya karte the, aur unhe Rafi bin Khadij ki riwayat ki hui hadees pahunchaayi gayi. Raawi ne kaha: Woh phir mere saath unke paas gaye. Unhone (Rafi ne) apne kuch chachaon se riwayat ki jismein ye zikr tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya. Ibn Umar (RA) ne phir ye amal chhod diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim b. Abdullah reported that AbduUah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to give land on rent until (this news) reached him that Rafi b. Khadij Ansari used to forbid the renting of land. Abdullah met him and said: Ibn Khadij, what is this that you narrate from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to renting of land? Rafi b. Khadij said to Abdullah: I heard it from two uncles of mine and they had participated in the Battle of Badr who narrated to the members of the family that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. Abdullah said: I knew it that the land was rented during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abdullah then apprehended that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have said something new in this connection (in regard to prohibition of renting) which I failed to know. So he abandoned the renting of land.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) zameen kiraaye par diya karte the yahan tak ki (ye khabar) unhe pahunchi ki Rafi bin Khadij Ansari zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya karte the. Abdullah unse mile aur kaha: Ibn Khadij, ye kya hai jo tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zameen kiraaye par dene ke baare mein riwayat karte ho? Rafi bin Khadij ne Abdullah se kaha: Maine ise apne do chachaon se suna aur unhone Badr ki jung mein shirkat ki thi jinhone khaandaan ke logon ko riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya. Abdullah ne kaha: Mujhe pata tha ki zameen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein kiraaye par di jaati thi. Abdullah ko phir dar hua ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne is silsile mein (mana karne ke baare mein) kuch nayi baat kahi ho jo main jaanne mein na safal hua ho. To unhone zameen kiraaye par dena chhod diya.

e: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We used to give on rent land during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We rented it on the share of one-third or one-fourth of the (produce) along with a definite quantity of corn. One day a person from among my uncles came to us and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us this act which was a source of benefit to us, but the obedience to Allah and to His Messenger (ﷺ) is more beneficial to us. He forbade us that we should rent land with one-third or one-fourth of (the produce) and the corn of a measure, and he commanded the owner of land that he should cultivate it or let it be cultivated by other (persons) but he showed disapproval of renting it or anything besides it.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein zameen kiraaye par diya karte the. Humne ise tihai ya chauthai hisse (upaj ke) ek muqarrar maqdaar anaaj ke saath kiraaye par diya. Ek din mere chachaon mein se ek shakhs humare paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein iss amal se mana kiya jo humare liye faayde ka srot tha, lekin Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ki itaat humare liye zyada faaydemand hai. Unhone humein mana kiya ki hum zameen tihai ya chauthai hisse ke saath aur naap ke anaaj ke saath kiraaye par dein, aur unhone zameen ke maalik ko hukum diya ki woh isse kheti kare ya doosron ke zariye kheti karvaaye lekin unhone isse kiraaye par dene ya kisi aur cheez ke saath deni ki aalochana ki.

e: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We used to give land on rent, and we rented it on one-third or one-fourth share. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum zameen kiraaye par diya karte the, aur humne ise tihai ya chauthai hisse par diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Another chain narrated the same as the above hadith.
hi: Ek doosri sanad ne bhi upar wali hadees jaisi hi riwayat ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Rafi' b. Khadij with the same chain of transmitters, but in it no mention is made of some of his uncles.
hi: Ye hadees Rafi bin Khadij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein unke kuch chachaon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Rafi (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Zuhair b. Rafi (who was his uncle) came to me and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade a practice which was useful for us. I said: What is this? (I believe) that whatrver Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) says is absolutely true. He (Zuhair) said that he (the Holy Prophet) asked me: What do you do with your cultivable lands? I said: Allah's Messenger, we rent those irrigated by canals for dry dates or barley. He said: Don't do that. Cultivate them or let them be cultivated (by others) or retain them yourself.
hi: Rafi (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Zuhair bin Rafi (jo unke chacha the) mere paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aisa amal mana kiya jo humare liye kaam ka tha. Maine kaha: Ye kya hai? (Mujhe yaqeen hai) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jo bhi kehte hain woh bilkul sach hai. Unhone (Zuhair ne) kaha ki unhone (Nabi ne) mujhse poocha: Tum apni jotne laayak zameen ke saath kya karte ho? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum unhe jo nehron se sinchit hain sookhi khajooron ya jau ke badle kiraaye par dete hain. Unhone kaha: Aisa mat karo.
