Unhe kheti karo ya doosron ke zariye karvaao ya khud apne paas rakho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Rafi from the Prophet (ﷺ) about this, but he did not make mention of his uncle Zuhair.
hi: Ye hadees Rafi ki sanad se Nabi (SAW) se is baare mein riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone apne chacha Zuhair ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Hanzala b. Qais reported that he asked Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) about renting of land, whereupon he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of land. I said: Is it forbidden (even if it is paid) in gold (dinar) and silver (dirham)? Thereupon he said: If it is paid in gold and silver, there is no harm in it.
hi: Hanzala bin Qais ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rafi bin Khadij (RA) se zameen kiraaye par dene ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen kiraaye par dene se mana kiya. Maine kaha: Kya ye mana hai (chahe iska bhugtaan) sone (dinar) ya chandi (dirham) mein diya jaaye? Isper unhone kaha: Agar iska bhugtaan sona aur chandi mein kiya jaata hai, to ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Hanzala b. Qais al-Ansri reported: I asked Rafi' b. Khadij about the renting of land for gold and silver, whereupon he said: There is no harm in it for the people let out land situated near canals and at the ends of the streamlets or portion of fields. (But it so happened) that at times this was destroyed and that was saved. whereas (on other occasions) this portion was saved and the other was destroyed and thus no rent was payable to the people (who let out lands) but for this one (which was saved). It was due to this that he (the Holy Prophet) prohibited it. But if there is something definite and reliable (e. g. money). there is no harm in it.
hi: Hanzala bin Qais al-Ansri ne bayan kiya: Maine Rafi bin Khadij se sona aur chandi ke liye zameen kiraaye par dene ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai kyunki log nehron ke qareeb aur nadiyon ke kinaaron par sthit zameen ya khet ke hisse kiraaye par dete the. (Lekin aisa hota tha) ki kabhi ye barbaad hota aur woh bach jaata, jabki (doosre mauqon par) ye hissa bachta aur doosra barbaad hota aur is tarah logon (jo zameen kiraaye par dete the) ko koi kiraaya nahi milta siwaay is hisse ke jo bacha rehta. Isi wajah se unhone (Nabi ne) ise mana kiya. Lekin agar koi cheez muayyan aur bharosemand hai (jaise paisa), to ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Hanzala reported that he heard Rafi' b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) say: We were the major agriculturists of the Ansar and so we let out land (saying): The produce of this (part of land) would be ours and (the produce) of that would be theirs. But it so happened that at times this (land) gave harvest, but the other one produced nothing. So he (the Holy Prophet) forbade this. But so far as the payment in silver (dirham, a coin) is concerned, he did not forbid.
hi: Hanzala ne bayan kiya ki unhone Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Hum Ansar ke sabse bade kisaan the aur is liye hum zameen (ye kehte hue) kiraaye par dete: Is (zameen ke hisse) ki upaj hamari hogi aur woh unki hogi. Lekin aisa hota tha ki kabhi ye (zameen) fasal deti, lekin doosri kuch nahi paida karti. To unhone (Nabi ne) ise mana kiya. Lekin jahan tak chandi (dirham, ek sikka) mein bhugtaan ka sawal hai, unhone ise mana nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. al Sa'ib reported: I asked Abdullah b. Ma'qil about Muzara'a (cultivating land on share basis in the produce). He said: Thabit b. Dahhak informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzara'a as Ibn Abu Shaiba forbade it with a slight change of words. He (the narrator) said: I asked Ibn Ma'qil but he did not name 'Abdullah.
hi: Abdullah bin al-Sa'ib ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Ma'qil se Muzara'a (upaj mein hisse ke aadhar par zameen ki kheti) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Thabit bin Dahhak ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzara'a se mana kiya jaise Ibn Abu Shaiba ne alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath mana kiya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine Ibn Ma'qil se poocha lekin unhone Abdullah ka naam nahi liya.

e: Abdullah b. al-Sa'ib reported: We visited 'Abdullah b. Ma'qil and asked him about sharing of crops, whereupon he said: Thabit alleged that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Muzara'a and commanded leasing it out on rent (for money) and said: There is no harm in it.
hi: Abdullah bin al-Sa'ib ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Ma'qil ke paas gaye aur unse fasal ke hisse baantne ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Thabit ne daawa kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muzara'a se mana kiya aur isse kiraaye par (paise ke liye) dene ka hukum diya aur kaha: Ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Mujahid said to Tiwus: Come along with me to Ibn Rafi b. Khadij in order to listen from him the hadith transmitted on the authority of his father (pertaining to the renting of land) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He (Tawus) scolded him and said: By Allah, it I were to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden it, I would have never done it. But it has been narrated to me by one who has better knowledge of it amongst them (and he meant Ibn 'Abbas) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It is better if a person lends, his land to his brother (for cultivation) than that he gets recognised rent on it.
hi: Mujahid ne Tawus se kaha: Mere saath Ibn Rafi bin Khadij ke paas chalo unse unke walid se riwayat ki hui hadees sunne ke liye (zameen kiraaye par dene se mutalliq) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se. Unhone (Tawus ne) unhe daanta aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe pata hota ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse mana kiya, to main aisa kabhi nahi karta. Lekin mujhe usne riwayat ki hai jise iska behtareen ilm hai unmein se (aur unka matlab Ibn Abbas se tha) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Behtar hai ki koi shakhs apni zameen apne bhai ko udhaar de (kheti ke liye) isse ki woh usse maany kiraaya paaye.

e: Tawus reported that he let out his land on rent, whereupon Amr said: I said to him: Abu Abd al-Rahrman, I wish if you abandon this renting of land, for they alleged that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade Mukhabara. He siad: Amr, one who has informed me has the best knowledge of it among them (he meant Ibn Abbas). (He said) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not prohibit it altogether, but said: Lending of land by one among you to his brother is better for him than getting a specified amount of produce from it.
hi: Tawus ne bayan kiya ki unhone apni zameen kiraaye par di, isper Amr ne kaha: Maine unse kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, kaash aap zameen kiraaye par dena chhod dein, kyunki unhone daawa kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mukhabara se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Amr, jisne mujhe bataaya hai unhein iska sabse behtareen ilm hai (unka matlab Ibn Abbas se tha). (Unhone kaha) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise poori tarah mana nahi kiya, lekin kaha: Tum mein se kisi ka apni zameen apne bhai ko udhaar dena uske liye behtar hai isse ki usmein se ek muqarrar maqdaar upaj paaye.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If one among you lets out land to his brother, that is better for him than if he receives such and such (the definite thing). Ibn 'Abbis (Allah be pleased with them) said: It is Haql, and in the parlance of the Ansr it is Muhaqala.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum mein se koi apni zameen apne bhai ko udhaar de, ye uske liye isse behtar hai ki woh aisa aisa (ek muayyan cheez) paaye. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Ye Haql hai, aur Ansar ki boli mein ye Muhaqala hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who has land, it is better for him that he should let it out to his brother.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske paas zameen hai, uske liye behtar hai ki woh ise apne bhai ko udhaar de.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted with the people of Khaibar the (trees) on the condition that he would have half the produce in fruits and harvest.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke logon se (darakhton ke baare mein) souda kiya is shart par ki unhe phalon aur fasal mein aadha hissa milega.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) handed over the land of Khaibar (on the condition) of the share of produce of fruits and harvest, and he also gave to his wives every year one hundred wasqs: eighty wasqs of dates and twenty wasqs of barley. When 'Umar became the caliph he distributed the (lands and trees) of Khaibar, and gave option to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to earmark for themselves the land and water or stick to the wasqs (that they got) every year. They differed in this matter. Some of them opted for land and water, and some of them opted for wasqs every year. 'A'isha and Hafsa were among those who opted for land and water.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ki zameen soonpi (phalon aur fasal ki upaj mein hisse ki shart par), aur unhone apni zaujaon ko har saal sau wasq bhi diye: assi wasq khajooren aur bees wasq jau. Jab Umar khalifa bane, unhone Khaibar (ki zameen aur darakhton) ko taqseem kiya, aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon ko ikhtiyar diya ki woh apne liye zameen aur paani chunein ya har saal (jo unhe milte the) wasq par kaayam rahein. Ismein unme mat-bhinnata thi. Kuch ne zameen aur paani chuna, aur kuch ne har saal wasq chuna. Aisha aur Hafsa un logon mein thin jinhone zameen aur paani chuna.

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contracted with the people of Khaibar (land and trees on the condition that they should give) half of the yield from land and trees. The rest of the hadith is the same. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of AIi b. Mushir there is no mention of it, but that A'isha and Hafsa were those who opted for land and water, but he (the narrator) said: He (Hadrat 'Umar, gave option to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that land would be earmarked for them, but he made no mention of water.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke logon se souda kiya (zameen aur darakhton ka is shart par ki woh) zameen aur darakhton ki upaj ka aadha hissa dein. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Ali bin Mushir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein iska koi zikr nahi hai, lekin ye ki Aisha aur Hafsa woh thin jinhone zameen aur paani chuna, lekin unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Unhone, Hazrat Umar ne, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon ko ikhtiyar diya ki unke liye zameen alag ki jaayegi, lekin unhone paani ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Khaibar had been conquered, the Jews asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to let them continue (cultivation in those lands) on half of the share of yield in fruits and crop, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I will allow you to continue here, so long as we would desire. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this addition:" The fruit would be distributed equal to the half of Khaibar. And out of hall of the produce of the land, Allah's Apostle (may peace be be upon him) got the fifth part."
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Khaibar fatah kar liya gaya, Yahudiyon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki unhe wahan (kheti karna) jaari rakhne diya jaaye phalon aur fasal ki upaj ke aadhe hisse par, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main tumhe yahan jaari rakhne dunga, jab tak hum chaahenge. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: "Phal Khaibar ke aadhe hisse ke barabar taqseem kiya jaayega. Aur zameen ki upaj ke aadhe hisse mein se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko paanchvaan hissa mila."

e: Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned to the Jews of Khaibar the date-palms of Khaibar and its land on the condition that they should work upon them with their own wealth (seeds, implements), and give half of the yield to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke Yahudiyon ko Khaibar ke khajoor ke darakht aur uski zameen wapas ki is shart par ki woh apne khud ke dhan (beej, upkaran) se unpar kaam karein, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko upaj ka aadha hissa dein.

e: Ibn Umar reported that 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) expelled the Jews and Christians from the land of Hijaz, and that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar he made up his mind to expel the Jews from it (the territory of Khaibar) because, when that land was conquered, it came under the sway of Allah, that of His Messenger (ﷺ) and that of the Muslims. The jews asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to let them continue there on the condition that they would work on it, and would get in turn half of the fruit (of the trees), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: We would let you continue there so long as we will desire. So they continued (to cultivate the lands) till 'Umar externed them to Taima' ang Ariha (two villages in Arabia, but out of Hijaz).
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne Yahudiyon aur Isaiyon ko Hijaz ki zameen se nikaal diya, aur ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar fatah kiya, unhone Yahudiyon ko usse (Khaibar ke ilaake se) nikaalne ka mann banaya kyunki, jab woh zameen fatah ki gayi, ye Allah, Uske Rasool (SAW) aur Musalmaanon ke qabze mein aa gayi. Yahudiyon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki unhe wahan jaari rakhne diya jaaye is shart par ki woh usmein kaam karenge, aur badle mein phal ka aadha hissa payenge, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Hum tumhe wahan jaari rakhne denge jab tak hum chaahenge. To woh (zameen mein kheti karna) jaari rakhte rahe yahan tak ki Umar ne unhe Taima aur Ariha (Arabia mein do gaon, lekin Hijaz se bahar) nikaal diya.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Never does a Muslim plants a tree except that he has the reward of charity for him, for what is eaten out of that is charity; what is stolen out of that, what the beasts eat out of that, what the birds eat out of that is charity for him. (In short) none incurs a loss to him but it becomes a charity on his part.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi Musalman kabhi darakht nahi lagaata siwaay iske ki uske liye sadaqe ka sawaab ho, kyunki jo bhi usmein se khaaya jaaye woh sadaqa hai; jo bhi usmein se chura liya jaaye, jo jaanwar usmein se khaayein, jo parinde usmein se khaayein, sab uske liye sadaqa hai. (Sankshep mein) koi bhi uska nuksaan nahi karta lekin ye uski taraf se sadaqa ban jaata hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited Umm Mubashshir al-Ansariya at her orchard of date-palms and said to her: Who has planted these trees of dates-a Muslim or a non-Musim? She said: A Muslim, of course, whereupon he said: Never a Muslim plants, or cultivates a land, and it out of that men eat, or the animals eat, or anything else eats, but that becomes charity on his (planter's) behalf.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Mubashshir al-Ansariya ke khajoor ke baag mein unse milne gaye aur unse kaha: In khajoor ke darakhton ko kisne lagaaya - ek Musalman ne ya kisi ghair-Musalman ne? Unhone kaha: Zaroor ek Musalman ne, isper unhone kaha: Koi bhi Musalman jab darakht lagaata hai, ya zameen mein kheti karta hai, aur usmein se log khaate hain, ya jaanwar khaate hain, ya koi aur cheez khaati hai, lekin ye uski (lagaane waale ki) taraf se sadaqa ban jaata hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Never does a Muslim plant, or cultivate, but has reward for him for what the beasts eat, or the birds eat or anything else eats out of that.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi Musalman kabhi lagaata ya kheti karta nahi hai, lekin uske liye sawaab hai us cheez ke liye jo jaanwar khaate hain, ya parinde khaate hain ya koi aur cheez usmein se khaati hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited the orchard of Umm Ma'sud and said: Umm Ma'bad. he who has planted this tree, is he a Muslim or a non-Muslim? She said: Of course, he is a Muslim, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: No Muslim who plants (trees) and from their fruits the human beings or the beasts or birds eat, but that would be taken as an act of charity on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Ma'sud ke baag mein unse milne gaye aur kaha: Umm Ma'bad, jisne ye darakht lagaaya hai, kya woh Musalman hai ya ghair-Musalman? Unhone kaha: Zaroor, woh Musalman hain, isper unhone kaha: Koi bhi Musalman jo darakht lagaata hai aur unke phalon se insaan ya jaanwar ya parinde khaate hain, lekin ye Qayamat ke din ek sadaqe ke amal ke taur par gina jaayega.

e: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Abu Muawiya (but With a slight change of words).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Muawiya ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath).

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying Never does a Muslim plant trees or cultivate land and birds or a man or a beast eat out of them but that is a charity on his behalf.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi Musalman kabhi darakht nahi lagaata ya zameen mein kheti nahi karta aur parinde ya koi aadmi ya jaanwar usmein se khaayein lekin ye uski taraf se sadaqa hai.

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited the date-palms of Umm Mubashshir (Allah be pleased with her), a lady from the Ansar, and said: Who planted this palm-a Muslim or an unbelievers The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Mubashshir (RA), Ansar ki ek khaatoon, ke khajoor ke darakhton se milne gaye aur kaha: Is khajoor ko kisne lagaaya - ek Musalman ne ya ek kaafir ne? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: If You sell fruits to your brother (and Jabir b. Ahduthh reported through another chain of narrators: If you were to sell fruits to your brother) and these is a stricken with Calamity, it is not permissible for you to get anything from him. Why do you get the wealth of your brother, without jutification?
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum apne bhai ko phal becho (aur Jabir bin Abdullah ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki: Agar tum apne bhai ko phal bechte) aur ye kisi aafat se prabhaavit hota hai, to tumhare liye jaayez nahi hai ki tum usse kuch lo. Tum apne bhai ka dhan kyun bina kisi munasib wajah ke lete ho?

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the sale of the fruit of date-palms until it becomes mellow. We (some of the other narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: What does the word" mellow" mean? He said: (There the fruit) turns red or yellow. Don't you see if Allah had checked (the growth of) fruits; then what for the wealth of your brother would be permissible for you?
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khajoor ke darakht ke phal ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak ye pak na jaaye. Humne (raawiyon mein se kuch ne) kaha: "Pak jaana" lafz ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: (Wahan phal) laal ya peela ho jaata hai. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki agar Allah ne phalon ki (badhat) ko roka hota; to phir tumhare liye apne bhai ka dhan kya jaayez hota?

e: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of fruits until these are mellow. They (the companions of Anas) said: What is meant by" mellow"? He said: It implies that these became red. He said: When Allah hinders the growth of fruits, (then) what for the wealth of your brother would become permissible for you?
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phalon ke bikri se mana kiya jab tak woh pak na jaayein. Unhone (Anas ke sahaba ne) kaha: "Pakna" ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki woh laal ho jaayein. Unhone kaha: Jab Allah phalon ki badhat roke, to tumhare liye apne bhai ka dhan kya jaayez ho sakta hai?

e: Anas (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If Allah does not fructify them, then what is permissible for one of you to take the wealth of his brother?
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Allah unhe phal na de, to tum mein se kisi ke liye apne bhai ka dhan lena kya jaayez hai?

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded to make deductions in the payment of that stricken with a Calamity.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aafat se prabhaavit (fasal) ke bhugtaan mein kami karne ka hukum diya.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleeased with him) reported that in the time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a man suffered loss in fruits he had bought and his debt increased; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told (the people) to give him charity and they gave him charity, but that was not enough to pay the debt in full, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his creditors: " Take what you find, you will have nothing but alms.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke daur mein ek shakhs ko un phalon mein nuksaan hua jo usne khareede the aur uska karza badh gaya; is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (logon se) kaha ki woh use sadaqa dein aur unhone use sadaqa diya, lekin ye poora karza chukaane ke liye kaafi nahi tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske karzdaataon se kaha: "Jo tumhe milta hai woh le lo, tumhe uske alawa aur kuch nahi milega."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Bukair b. al-Ashajj with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Bukair bin al-Ashajj ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard the voices of altercation of two disputants at the door; both the voices were quite loud. The one demanded some remission and desired that the other one should show leniency to him, whereupon the (other one) was saying: By Allah will not do that. Then there came Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to them and said: Where is he who swears by Allah that he would not do good? He said: Massenger of Allah, it is I. He may do as he desires.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne darwaze par do jhagadne walon ki tez aawaazein sunin; donon aawaazein kaafi buland thin. Ek ne kuch chhoot maangi aur chahta tha ki doosra usse narmi dikhaaye, isper (doosra) keh raha tha: Allah ki qasam main aisa nahi karunga. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Woh kahan hai jo Allah ki qasam khaata hai ki woh achhaai nahi karega? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye main hoon. Woh jo chaahe kare.

e: Abdullah b. Ka'ab b. Malik reported from his father that he pressed in the mosque Ibn Abu Hadrad for the payment of the debt that he owed to him during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). (In this altercation) their voices became loud, until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them, while he was in the house, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out towards them, and he lifted the curtain of his apartment and he called upon Ka'b b. Malik and said: O Ka'b. He said: At thy beck and call, Allah's Messenger. He pointed out with the help of his hand to remit half of the loan due to him. Ka'b said: Allah's Messenger, I am ready to do that, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to Ibn Abu Hadrad): Stand up and make him the payment (of the rest).
hi: Abdullah bin Ka'b bin Malik ne apne walid se riwayat ki ki unhone masjid mein Ibn Abu Hadrad par un karze ke bhugtaan ke liye dabaav daala jo unpar tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. (Is jhagade mein) unki aawaazein buland ho gayin, yahan tak ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe suna, jabki woh ghar mein the, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unki taraf bahar aaye, aur unhone apne kamre ka parda uthaaya aur Ka'b bin Malik ko bulaaya aur kaha: Aye Ka'b. Unhone kaha: Haazir hoon, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone apne haath se ishara kiya ki unpar bakaaya karze ka aadha hissa maaf kar diya jaaye. Ka'b ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main aisa karne ke liye taiyaar hoon, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Ibn Abu Hadrad se) kaha: Uth jao aur unhe (baaki ka) bhugtaan karo.

e: The above hadith is narrated through another chain with a slight variation of words at the begining and the rest is of the hadith is the same.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai shuru mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ka'b b. Malik reported that he made a demand for the payment of the debt that Ibn Abu Hadrad owed to him. This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters and (the words are): " He had to get the loan from Abdullah b. Hadrad al-Aslami. He met him and pressed him for payment. There was an altercation between them, until their voices became loud. There happened to pass by them Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: O Ka'b, and pointed out with his hand in such a way as he meant half. So he got half of what he (Ibn Abu Hadrad) owed to him and remitted the half."
hi: Ka'b bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki unhone us karze ke bhugtaan ki maang ki jo Ibn Abu Hadrad par unka tha. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Unka Abdullah bin Hadrad al-Aslami se karza lena tha. Woh unse mile aur bhugtaan ke liye dabaav daala. Unke beech jhagada hua, yahan tak ki unki aawaazein buland ho gayin. Wahan se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) guzre aur unhone kaha: Aye Ka'b, aur apne haath se is tarah ishara kiya jaise unka matlab aadha tha. To unhone woh liya jo unka unpar (Ibn Abu Hadrad par) haq tha ka aadha hissa aur baaki maaf kar diya."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who found his property intact with a person (who bought it but who later on) became insolvent (or a person who became insolvent), he (the seller) is entitled to get it more than anyone else. '
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi shakhs ke paas apni maal mahfooz paata hai (jisne use khareeda tha lekin baad mein) dho paisa hua (ya jo shakhs khud dho paisa hua), use (bechne wale ko) doosron se zyada haq hai use paane ka.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters (but with a slight variation of words and these are)" Whenever a man becomes poor."
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath aur ye hain) "Jab bhi koi shakhs gareeb ho jaata hai."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying about a person who becomes insolvent and (the thing bought by him) is found intact with him, that belongs to one who sold it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna us shakhs ke baare mein jo dho paisa hota hai aur (jo usne khareeda tha) uske paas mahfooz paaya jaata hai, ki woh usi ka hai jisne use becha tha.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When a man becomes insolvent (and the other) man (the seller) finds his commodity intact with him, he is more entitled to get it (than anyone else)
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi shakhs dho paisa ho jaata hai aur doosra (bechne wala) apna saamaan uske paas mahfooz paata hai, use isse zyada haq hai use paane ka (kisi aur se zyada).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters (but with a change of these words): " He is more entitled to get it than any other creditor."
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (lekin alfaazon ki tabdeeli ke saath): "Use kisi aur karzdaata se zyada haq hai use paane ka."

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a inan becomes insolvent, and the other person (seller) finds his goods intact with him, he is more entitled to get them than anyone else.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi shakhs dho paisa ho jaata hai, aur doosra shakhs (bechne wala) apna saamaan uske paas mahfooz paata hai, use kisi aur se zyada haq hai use paane ka.

e: Hudhaifa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying The angels took away the soul of a person who had lived among people who were before you. They (the angels) said: Did you do anything good? He said: No. they said: Try to recall. He said: I used to lend to people and order my servants to give respite to one in straitened circumstances and give allowance to the solvent, for Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said (to the angels): You should ignore (his failing).
hi: Hudhaifa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishton ne ek shakhs ki jaan li jo tumse pehle logon mein rehta tha. Unhone (farishton ne) kaha: Kya tumne koi achhaai ki? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Yaad karne ki koshish karo. Usne kaha: Main logon ko udhaar dete tha aur apne khaadimon ko hukum deta tha ki mushkil mein pade shakhs ko rahat dein aur sakshampanna ko chhoot dein, kyunki Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne (farishton se) kaha: Tum uski (is) khaami ko nazar-andaaz karo.

e: Hudhaifa reported: A person met his Lord (after death) and He said: What (good) did you do? He said: I did no good except this that I was a rich man, and I demanded from the people (the repayment of debt that I advanced to them). I, however, accepted that which the solvent gave and remitted (the debt) of the insolvent, whereupon He (the Lord) said: You should ignore (the faults) of My servant. Abu Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) said: This is what I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs apne Rab se mila (maut ke baad) aur Usne kaha: Tumne kya (achha) kiya? Usne kaha: Maine koi achhaai nahi ki siwaay is baat ke ki main ek daulatmand shakhs tha, aur main logon se (unhe diye gaye karze ki wapasi ki) maang karta tha. Main, halaanki, jo sakshampanna deta woh qubool kar leta aur dho paisa ka (karza) maaf kar deta, isper Usne (Rab ne) kaha: Tum mere banda ki (khaamiyon ko) nazar-andaaz karo. Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: Ye woh hai jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna.

e: Hudhaifa (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A person died and he entered Paradise. It was said to him What (act) did you do? (Either he recalled it himself or he was made to recall), he said I used to enter into transactions with people and I gave respite to the insolvent and did not show any strictness in case of accepting a coin or demanding cash payment. (For these acts of his) he was granted pardon. Abu Mas'ud said: I heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs mara aur woh Jannat mein daakhil hua. Usse poocha gaya: Tumne kya (amal) kiya? (Ya to usne khud yaad kiya ya use yaad karwaaya gaya), usne kaha: Main logon ke saath saudon mein daakhil hota tha aur main dho paisa ko rahat deta tha aur koi sikke ke bare mein sakhti nahi dikhaata tha ya naqad bhugtaan maangne mein. (Uske in amalon ke liye) use maafi mili. Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: Maine ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.

e: Hudhaifa (Allah be pleased with him) reported: A servant from amongst the servants of Allah was brought to Him whom Allah had endowed with riches. He (Allah) said to him: What (did you do) in the world? (They cannot conceal anything from Allah) He (the person) said: O my Lord, You endowed me with Your riches. I used to enter into transactions with people. It was my nature to be lenient to (my debtors). I showed leniency to the solvent and gave respite to the insolvent, whereupon Allah said: I have more right than you to do this to connive at My servant. 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhani and Abu Mas'ud said: This is what we heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke bandon mein se ek banda Uske saamne laaya gaya jise Allah ne daulat di thi. Usne (Allah ne) usse kaha: Duniya mein (tumne kya kiya)? (Woh Allah se kuch chhupa nahi sakte.) Usne (us shakhs ne) kaha: Aye mere Rab, Tune mujhe apni daulat di. Main logon ke saath saudon mein daakhil hota tha. Meri fitrat thi (apne karzdaaron ke saath) narmi rakhna. Maine sakshampanna ke saath narmi dikhaayi aur dho paisa ko rahat di, isper Allah ne kaha: Mujhe tumse zyada haq hai ye karne ka, apne banda ki taraf se aankh moondh lene ka. Uqba bin Aamir al-Juhani aur Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: Ye woh hai jo humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.

e: Abu Mas'ud (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person from people who lived before you was called to account (by Allah at the Day of Judgment) and no good was found in his account except this that lie being a rich man had (financial) dealings with people and had commanded his servants to show leniency to the straitened ones. Upon this Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: We have more right to this, so overlook (his faults).
hi: Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumse pehle rehne wale logon mein se ek shakhs ka hisaab liya gaya (Allah ke zariye Qayamat ke din) aur uske hisaab mein koi achhaai nahi mili siwaay is baat ke ki, ek daulatmand shakhs hokar, uska logon ke saath (maali) lena-dena tha aur usne apne khaadimon ko hukum diya tha ki mushkil mein pade logon ke saath narmi dikhaayein. Isper Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: Humein isse zyada haq hai, is liye (uski khaamiyon ko) nazar-andaaz karo.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was a person who gave loans to the people and said to his men: When an insolvent comes to you show him leniency that Allah may overlook our (faults). So when he met Allah, He overlooked his faults (forgave him).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs tha jo logon ko udhaar deta tha aur apne aadmiyon se kehta tha: Jab koi dho paisa shakhs tumhare paas aaye to use narmi dikhaao taaki Allah humari (khaamiyon ko) nazar-andaaz kare. To jab woh Allah se mila, Usne uski khaamiyon ko nazar-andaaz kiya (usse maaf kiya).

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada reported that Abu Qatada (Allah be pleased with him) demanded (the payment of his debt) from his debtor but he disappeared; later on he found him and he said: I am hard up financially, whereupon he said: (Do you state it) by God? He said: By God. Upon this he (Qatada) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves that Allah saves him from the torments of the Day of Resurrection should give respite to the insolvent or remit (his debt).
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya ki Abu Qatada (RA) ne apne karzdaar se (apne karze ka bhugtaan) maanga lekin woh gaayab ho gaya; baad mein unhone use paaya aur usne kaha: Main maali soorat se tang haal hoon, isper unhone kaha: (Kya tum ye) Allah ki qasam khaakar kehte ho? Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam. Isper unhone (Qatada ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo muhabbat karta hai ki Allah use Qayamat ke din ke azaabon se bachaaye use dho paisa ko rahat deni chahiye ya uska (karza) maaf kar dena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyob with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyob ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Delay (in the payment of debt) on the part of a rich man is injustice, and when one of you is retired to a rich man, he should follow him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Daulatmand aadmi ki taraf se (karze ke bhugtaan mein) der karna anyaay hai, aur jab tum mein se koi daulatmand aadmi ki taraf bheja jaaye, use uska anusaran karna chahiye.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (, Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of excess water.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne atirikt paani ke bikri se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the hiring of a Camel to cover a she-Camel and from selling water and land to be tilled. So from all this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne oont ko ek oontni par charhaane ke liye kiraaye par dene se aur paani aur jotne laayak zameen bechne se mana kiya. To in sab cheezon se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Excess water must not be withheld so that the growth of herbage may be hindered.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Atirikt paani na roka jaaye taaki ghaas ki paidaayish rukavat mein na aaye.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not withhold excess of water, so that you may prevent the growth of herbage.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Atirikt paani mat roko, taaki tum ghaas ki paidaayish na roko.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The excess of water should not be sold in order to enable the sate of herbage.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Atirikt paani ko is liye nahi bechna chahiye ki isse ghaas ki bikri ho sake.

e: Aba Mas'ud al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the charging of price of the dog, and earnings of a prostitute and sweets offered to a kahin.
hi: Aba Mas'ud al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutte ki keemat lene se, aur veshya ki kamaai se, aur kaahin (jyotishi) ko diye jaane wale mithai se mana kiya.

e: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Abu Mas'ud through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Mas'ud ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Rafi b. Khadij (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The worst earning is the earning of a prostitute, the price of a dog and the earning of a cupper.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse buri kamaai veshya ki kamaai hai, kutte ki keemat, aur cupping (hijama) karne wale ki kamaai.

e: Rafi b. Khadij reported Allah'& Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The price of a dog is evil, the earning of a prostitute is evil and the earning of a cupper is evil.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kutte ki keemat bura hai, veshya ki kamaai bura hai aur cupping karne wale ki kamaai bura hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Rafi' b. Khadij through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Rafi bin Khadij ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Rafi' b. Khadij through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Rafi bin Khadij ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Zubair said: I asked Jabir about the price of a dog and a cat; he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disapproved of that.
hi: Abu Zubair ne kaha: Maine Jabir se kutte aur billi ki keemat ke baare mein poocha; unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise napasand kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) giving command for killing dogs.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya.

e: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered to kill dogs, and he sent (men) to the corners of Medina that they should be killed.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, aur unhone Madina ke konon mein (aadmiyon ko) bheja taaki unhe maara jaaye.

e: Abdullah (b. Umar) (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered the killing of dogs and we would send (men) in Medina and its corners and we did not spare any dog that we did not kill, so much so that we killed the dog that accompanied the wet she-camel belonging to the people of the desert.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya aur hum Madina aur uske konon mein (aadmiyon ko) bhejte the aur humne kisi bhi kutte ko nahi chhoda jise humne na maara ho, yahan tak ki humne us kutte ko bhi maara jo registaan ke logon ki doodh dene wali oontni ke saath jaata tha.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be, upon him) ordered the killing of dogs except the dog tamed for hunting, or watching of the herd of sheep or other domestic animals. It was said to Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) talks of (exception) about the dog for watching the field, whereupon he said: Since Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) possessed land.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya siwaay us kutte ke jo shikaar ke liye sikhaaya gaya ho, ya bhed ya doosre paaltu jaanwaron ke jhund ki dekhbhaal ke liye ho. Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha gaya ki Abu Huraira (RA) khet ki rakhwaali karne wale kutte ke apwaad ka zikr karte hain, isper unhone kaha: Kyunki Abu Huraira (RA) ke paas zameen thi.

e: Abu Zubair heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to kill dogs, and we carried out this order so much so that we also kill the dog coming with a woman from the desert. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade their killing. He (the Prophet further) said: It is your duty the jet-black (dog) having two spots (on the eyes), for it is a devil.
hi: Abu Zubair ne Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, aur humne is hukum ka paalan kiya yahan tak ki humne us kutte ko bhi maara jo registaan se ek aurat ke saath aaya tha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe maarne se mana kiya. Unhone (Nabi ne aage) kaha: Tumhara farz hai ki tum us gehre kaale kutte ka khyaal rakho jiski aankhon par do dhabbe hon, kyunki woh ek shaitaan hai.

e: Ibn Mughaffal reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered the killing of dogs and then said: what is the trouble with them (the people of Medina)? How dogs are nuisance to them (the citizens of Medina)? He then permitted keehing of dogs for hunting and (the protection of) herds.
hi: Ibn Mughaffal ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya aur phir kaha: Unhe (Madina ke logon ko) kya taklif hai? Kutte unke liye pareshaani kaise hain? Unhone phir shikaar aur (rewaton ki hifaazat) ke liye kutte rakhne ki ijazat di.

e: In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yahya, he (the Holy Prophet) permitted the keeping of dogs for (the protection of) herds, for hunting and (the protection of) cultivated land.
hi: Yahya ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein, unhone (Nabi ne) rewaton ki hifaazat ke liye, shikaar ke liye aur kheti ki zameen ki hifaazat ke liye kutte rakhne ki ijazat di.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who keeps a dog other than that meant for watching the herd or for hunting loses every day out of his deeds equal to two qirat.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo rewaton ki dekhbhaal ya shikaar ke liye nahi hai use har din apne amalon mein se do qirat ke barabar nuksaan hota hai.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who kept a dog other than one meant for hunting or for watching the herd, lost two qirat of his reward every day.
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo shikaar ya rewaton ki dekhbhaal ke liye nahi hai, use har din apne sawaab mein se do qirat ka nuksaan hota hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying He who kept a dog other than one meant for hunting or for watching the herd lost out of his deeds (equal to) two qirat every day.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo shikaar ya rewaton ki dekhbhaal ke liye nahi hai use har din apne amalon mein se (do qirat ke barabar) nuksaan hota hai.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who kept a dog other than one meant for watching the herd or for hunting would lose every day two qirat of his good deeds. 'Abdullah and Abu Huraira also said: Or dog meant for watching the field.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo rewaton ki dekhbhaal ya shikaar ke liye nahi hai use har din apni achhaaiyon mein se do qirat ka nuksaan hoga. Abdullah aur Abu Huraira ne ye bhi kaha: Ya khet ki dekhbhaal ke liye kutta.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who kept a dog other than one meant for hunting or for the protection of the herd would lose two qirat of his deeds every day. Salim said: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) used to say: Or the dog meant for watching the field, and he was the owner of the land.
hi: Salim ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo shikaar ya rewaton ki hifaazat ke liye nahi hai use har din apne amalon mein se do qirat ka nuksaan hoga. Salim ne kaha: Abu Huraira (RA) kaha karte the: Ya khet ki dekhbhaal ke liye kutta, aur woh zameen ke maalik the.

e: Salim b. Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whosover amongst the owners of the house keeps a dog other than one meant for watching the herd or for hunting loses two qirat of his deeds every day.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ghar ke maalikon mein se jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo rewaton ki dekhbhaal ya shikaar ke liye nahi hai use har din apne amalon mein se do qirat ka nuksaan hota hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) narrated Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog ther than one meant for watching the fields or herds or hunting would lose one qirat every day out of his reward (with God).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo khet ya rewaton ki dekhbhaal ya shikaar ke liye nahi hai use har din apne sawaab (Allah ke saath) mein se ek qirat ka nuksaan hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog which is neither meant for hunting nor for watching the anitmals nor for watching the fields would lose two qirat every day out of his reward; and there is no mention of the fields in the hadith transmitted by Abu Tahir.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo na shikaar ke liye hai, na jaanwaron ki dekhbhaal ke liye, na khetoon ki dekhbhaal ke liye use har din apne sawaab mein se do qirat ka nuksaan hoga; aur Abu Tahir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein khetoon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog except one meant for watching the herd, or for hunting or for watching the fields. he lost two qirat of reward every day. Zuhri said: The words of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) were conveyed to Ibn Umar who said: May Allah have mercy upon Abu Huraira; he owned a field.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai siwaay us kutte ke jo rewaton ki dekhbhaal ke liye, ya shikaar ke liye, ya khetoon ki dekhbhaal ke liye ho, use har din sawaab mein do qirat ka nuksaan hoga. Zuhri ne kaha: Abu Huraira (RA) ke alfaaz Ibn Umar ko bataaye gaye jinhone kaha: Allah Abu Huraira par rehmat kare; unke paas ek khet tha.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog would lose out of his deeds equal to one qirat every day. except (one kept) for watching the field or herd.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai use har din apne amalon mein se ek qirat ke barabar nuksaan hoga, siwaay us kutte ke jo khet ya rewaton ki dekhbhaal ke liye rakha gaya ho.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog, but not meant for hunting or watching the herd, would lose one qirat of reward every day.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai, lekin shikaar ya rewaton ki dekhbhaal ke liye nahi, use har din sawaab mein se ek qirat ka nuksaan hoga.

e: Sufyan b. Abu Zuhair (he was a person belonging to the tribe of Shanu'a and was amongst the Conpanions of Allah's Messenger [may peace be upon him ) said: I heard Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: He who kept a dog (other than that) which is indispensable for watching the field or the animals would lose one qirat out of his deeds every day. As-Sa'ib b Yazid (one of the narrators) said: Did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes. by the Lord of this mosque.
hi: Sufyan bin Abu Zuhair (jo Shanu'a qabile ke the aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi kutta rakhta hai jo khet ya jaanwaron ki dekhbhaal ke liye zaroori nahi hai use har din apne amalon mein se ek qirat ka nuksaan hoga. As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (ek raawi) ne kaha: Kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan, is masjid ke Rab ki qasam.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan b. Abu Zuhair al-Shana'i.
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan bin Abu Zuhair al-Shana'i ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Humaid that Anas b. Malik was asked about the earnings of the cupper. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got himself cupped. His cupper was Abu Taiba and he (the Holy Prophet) commanded to give him two sa's of corn. He (the Holy Prophet) talked with the members of his family and they lightened the burden of Kharaj (tax) from him (i. e. they made remis- sion in the charges of their own accord). He (Allah's Apostle) said: The best (treat- ment) which you take is cupping, or it is the best of your treatments.
hi: Humaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Anas bin Malik se cupping (hijama) karne wale ki kamaai ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud pe cupping karwaayi. Unke cupping karne wale Abu Taiba the aur unhone (Nabi ne) hukum diya ki unhe do sa anaaj diya jaaye. Unhone (Nabi ne) apne khaandaan ke logon se baat ki aur unhone unke lakhraaj (kar) ka bojh halka kiya (yaani unhone apni marzi se kharche mein chhoot di). Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Sabse behtareen (ilaaj) jo tum apnaate ho woh cupping hai, ya ye tumhare ilaajon mein sabse behtareen hai.

e: Rumaid reported that Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) has asked about the earnings of a cupper. Then (the above-mentioned hadith was reported but with this addition) that he said: The best treatment which you get is cupping. or aloeswood and do not torture your children by pressing their uvula.
hi: Rumaid ne bayan kiya ki Anas bin Malik (RA) se cupping karne wale ki kamaai ke baare mein poocha gaya. Phir (upar bataayi gayi hadees riwayat ki gayi lekin is izafe ke saath) ki unhone kaha: Sabse behtareen ilaaj jo tum paate ho woh cupping hai, ya aloeswood, aur apne bachchon ko unki gale ki jeebh dabaakar takleef mat do.

e: Humaid reported Anas (Allah be pleased with him) having said this: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for young cupper belonging to us. He capped him and he (the Holy Prophet) commanded that he should be paid one sa' or one mudd or two mudds (of wheat). It was said (that charges were high) and a reduction was made in the charges.
hi: Humaid ne Anas (RA) ke ye alfaaz bayan karte hue riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humare khaandaan ke ek jawaan cupping karne wale ko bulaaya. Unhone unpar cupping ki aur unhone (Nabi ne) hukum diya ki use ek sa ya ek mudd ya do mudd (gehun) diya jaaye. Kaha gaya (ki kharche zyada the) aur kharche mein kami ki gayi.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got himself cupped and he paid the clipper his charges and he put medicine in his nostrils.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud pe cupping karwaayi aur unhone cupping karne wale ko uska kharcha diya aur unhone apni naak mein dawaai daali.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: The slave of Banu Bayada cupped Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he gave him his wages, and talked to his master and he reduced the charges, and if this earning was unlawful Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) would not have given it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Banu Bayada ke ek ghulam ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par cupping ki aur unhone use uski mazdoori di, aur uske maalik se baat ki aur unhone kharche mein kami ki, aur agar ye kamaai gairkaanooni hoti to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) use nahi dete.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressing in Medina. He said: O people, Allah is giving an indication (of the prohibition) of wine. and He is probably soon going to give an order about it. So he who has anything of it with him should sell that, and derive benefit out of it. He (the narrator) said: We waited for some time that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah, the Exalted, has forbidden wine. So who hears this verse and he has anything of it with him, he should neither drink it nor sell it. He (the narrator) said: The people then brought whatever they had of it with them on the streets of Medina and spilt that.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Madina mein khitaab dete suna. Unhone kaha: Aye logo, Allah sharaab ke (mana honeka) ishara de raha hai, aur Woh shayad jald hi iske baare mein hukum dega. Is liye jiske paas isme se kuch hai use use bech dena chahiye, aur usse faayda uthaana chahiye. Raawi ne kaha: Hum kuch der intezaar karte rahe ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne sharaab ko haraam kiya hai. Is liye jo ye aayat sune aur uske paas isme se kuch ho, use na to use peena chahiye na hi bechna chahiye. Raawi ne kaha: Log phir jo bhi unke paas tha usmein se, Madina ki galiyon mein laaye aur use bahaa diya.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Wa'ala as-Saba'i (who was an Egyptian) asked 'Abdullah b. Abbas; (Allah be pleased with them) about that which is extracted from the grapes, whereupon he said: A person presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a small water-skin of wine. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Do you know that Allah has forbidden it? He said: No. He then whispered to another man. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him what he had whispered. He said: I advised him to sell that, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily He Who has forbidden its drinking has forbidden its sale also. He (the narrator) said: He opened the waterskin until what was contained in it was spilt.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Wa'ala as-Saba'i (jo Misri the) ne Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se poocha us cheez ke baare mein jo angooron se nikaali jaati hai, isper unhone kaha: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sharaab ka ek chhota paani ka thaila diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai ki Allah ne ise haraam kiya hai? Usne kaha: Nahi. Woh phir doosre shakhs se kaanaphusi karne laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse poocha usne kya kaanaphusi ki. Usne kaha: Maine use ise bechne ki salaah di, isper unhone kaha: Yaqeenan Jisne iski peene se mana kiya hai Usne iski bikri se bhi mana kiya hai. Raawi ne kaha: Usne thaila khola yahan tak ki jo usmein tha woh bah gaya.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Wa'ala narrated this on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Abbas.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Wa'ala ne ye Abdullah bin Abbas ke hawale se riwayat ki.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: When the concluding verses of Sura Baqara were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out and read them out to the people and then forbade them to trade in wine.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Surah Baqara ki aakhri aayaten nazil hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar gaye aur unhe logon ko padh kar sunaaya aur phir unhe sharaab ka vyaapaar karne se mana kiya.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: When the concluding verses of Sura Baqara pertaining to Riba were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the mosque and he forbade the trade in wine.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Surah Baqara ki Riba se mutalliq aakhri aayaten nazil hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein gaye aur unhone sharaab ke vyaapaar se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying in the Year of Victory while he was in Mecca: Verily Allah and His Messenger have forbidden the sale of wine, carcass, swine and idols, It was said: Allah's Messenger, you see that the fat of the carcass is used for coating the boats and varnishing the hides and people use it for lighting purposes, whereupon he said: No, it is forbidden, Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May Allah the Exalted and Majestic destroy the Jews; when Allah forbade the use of fat of the carcass for them, they melted it, and then sold it and made use of its price (received from it).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Fatah ke saal, jab woh Makkah mein the, ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah aur Uske Rasool ne sharaab, murda jaanwar, khinzeer aur buton ki bikri se mana kiya hai. Kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, aap dekhte hain ki murda jaanwar ki charbi kishtiyon par lagaayi jaati hai aur chamde ko chikna karne ke liye istemal ki jaati hai aur log ise roshni ke liye istemal karte hain, isper unhone kaha: Nahi, ye mana hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, Yahudiyon ko tabaah kare; jab Allah ne unke liye murda jaanwar ki charbi ke istemal ko mana kiya, unhone use pighlaaya aur phir use becha aur uski keemat (jo unhe mili) ka istemal kiya.

e: Yazid b. Abu Habib reported: 'Ata' reported to me that he heard Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) saying it that he had heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Year of Victory.
hi: Yazid bin Abu Habib ne bayan kiya: Ata ne mujhe bataya ki unhone Jabir (bin Abdullah) ko ye kehte suna ki unhone ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Fatah ke saal suna.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with him) reported: This news reached 'Umar that Samura had sold wine, whereupon he said: May Allah destroy Samura; does he not know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:" Let there be the curse of Allah upon the Jews that fat was declared forbidden for them, but they melted it and then sold it"?
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Umar tak ye khabar pahunchi ki Samura ne sharaab bechi, isper unhone kaha: Allah Samura ko tabaah kare; kya use pata nahi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Yahudiyon par Allah ki laanat ho ki unke liye charbi haraam ki gayi, lekin unhone use pighlaaya aur phir use becha"?

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Dinar with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Dinar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: May Allah destroy the Jews for Allah forbade the use of fats for them, but they sold them and made use of their price.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah Yahudiyon ko tabaah kare kyunki Allah ne unke liye charbi ke istemal ko haraam kiya, lekin unhone use becha aur uski keemat ka istemal kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: May Allah destroy the Jews for Allah forbade the use of fat for them, but they sold it and made use of its price.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah Yahudiyon ko tabaah kare kyunki Allah ne unke liye charbi ke istemal ko haraam kiya, lekin unhone use becha aur uski keemat ka istemal kiya.

e: Abu Salid al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not sell gold for gold, except like for like, and don't increase something of it upon something; and don't sell silver unless like for like, and don't increase some thing of it upon something, and do not sell for ready money something to be given later.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sone ko sone ke badle mat becho, siwaay barabar-barabar ke, aur usme se kisi cheez ko kisi cheez par mat badhaao; aur chandi ko chandi ke badle mat becho siwaay barabar-barabar ke, aur usme se kisi cheez ko kisi cheez par mat badhaao, aur naqad ke badle koi cheez baad mein deni ke liye mat becho.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar told him that a person of the tribe of Laith said that Abu Sa'id al-Kludri narrated it (the above-mentioned hadith) from tile Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a narration of Qutaiba. So 'Abduliali and Nafi' went along with him, and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Rumh (the words are) that Nafi' said: 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) went and I along with the person belonging to Banu Laith entered (the house) of Sa'id al-Khudri, and he ('Abdullah b. Umar) said: I have been informed that you say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of silver with silver except in case of like for like, and sale of gold for gold except in case of like for like. Abu Sa'id pointed towards this eyes and his ears with his fingers and said: My eyes saw, and my ears listened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Do not sell gold for gold, and do not sell silver for silver except in case of like for like, and do not increase something of it upon something, and do not sell for ready money something, not present, but hand to hand.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne unhe bataya ki Laith qabile ke ek shakhs ne kaha ki Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne ise (upar bataayi gayi hadees) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki, Qutaiba ki riwayat mein. To Abdullah aur Nafi unke saath gaye, aur Ibn Rumh ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain) ki Nafi ne kaha: Abdullah (bin Umar) gaye aur main Banu Laith ke shakhs ke saath Sa'id al-Khudri ke (ghar mein) daakhil hua, aur unhone (Abdullah bin Umar ne) kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki aap kehte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chandi ko chandi ke badle bechne se, siwaay barabar-barabar ke, aur sona ko sone ke badle bechne se, siwaay barabar-barabar ke, mana kiya. Abu Sa'id ne apni aankhon aur kaanon ki taraf apni ungliyon se ishara kiya aur kaha: Meri aankhon ne dekha, aur mere kaanon ne suna Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue: Sone ko sone ke badle mat becho, aur chandi ko chandi ke badle mat becho siwaay barabar-barabar ke, aur usme se kisi cheez ko kisi cheez par mat badhaao, aur naqad ke badle koi cheez, jo maujood na ho, mat becho, balki haath se haath.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not sell gold for gold and silver for silver weight for weight or of the same quality.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sone ko sone ke badle aur chandi ko chandi ke badle wazan ke barabar ya ek hi mayaar ke saath mat becho.

e: 'Uthman b. 'Affan reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not sell a dinar for two dinars and one dirham for two dirhams.
hi: Uthman bin Affan ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek dinar do dinar ke badle mat becho aur ek dirham do dirham ke badle mat becho.

e: Malik b. Aus b. al-Hadathan reported: I came saying who was prepared toexchange dirhams (for my gold), whereupon Talha b. Ubaidullah (Allah be pleased with him) (as he was sitting with 'Umar b. Khattib) said: Show us your gold and then come to us (at a later time). When our servant would come we would give you your silver (dirhams due to you). Thereupon 'Umar b. al-Khattib (Allah be pleased with him) said: Not at all. By Allah, either give him his silver (coins). or return his gold to him, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Exchange of silver for gold (has an element of) interest in it. except when (it is exchanged) on the spot;and wheat for wheat is an interest unless both are handed over on the spot: barley for barley is interest unless both are handed over on the spot; dates for dates is interest unless both are handed over on the Spot.
hi: Malik bin Aus bin al-Hadathan ne bayan kiya: Main ye poochte hue aaya ki kaun mere sone ke badle dirham exchange karne ke liye taiyaar hai, isper Talha bin Ubaidullah (RA) (jo Umar bin Khattab ke saath baithe the) ne kaha: Humein apna sona dikhaao aur phir (baad mein) hamare paas aao. Jab hamara khaadim aayega hum tumhe tumhari chandi (jo tumhara haq hai) de denge. Isper Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Bilkul nahi. Allah ki qasam, ya to unhe unki chandi (sikke) do, ya unka sona unhe wapas karo, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Chandi ka sone ke badle exchange (sood ka tatva rakhta hai), siwaay iske ki (ye) mauke par ho; aur gehun ko gehun ke badle sood hai jab tak donon mauke par na diye jaayein: jau ko jau ke badle sood hai jab tak donon mauke par na diye jaayein: khajoor ko khajoor ke badle sood hai jab tak donon mauke par na diye jaayein.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abi Qilabah reported: I was in Syria (having) a circle (of friends). in which was Muslim b. Yasir. There came Abu'l-Ash'ath. He (the narrator) said that they (the friends) called him: Abu'l-Ash'ath, Abu'l-Ash'ath, and he sat down. I said to him: Narrate to our brother the hadith of Ubada b. Samit. He said: Yes. We went out on an expedition, Mu'awiya being the leader of the people, and we gained a lot of spoils of war. And there was one silver utensil in what we took as spoils. Mu'awiya ordered a person to sell it for payment to the people (soldiers). The people made haste in getting that. The news of (this state of affairs) reached 'Ubada b. Samit, and he stood up and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding the sale of gold by gold, and silver by silver, and wheat by wheat, and barley by barley, and dates by dates, and salt by salt, except like for like and equal for equal. So he who made an addition or who accepted an addition (committed the sin of taking) interest. So the people returned what they had got. This reached Mu'awiya. and he stood up to deliver an address. He said: What is the matter with people that they narrate from the Messenger (ﷺ) such tradition which we did not hear though we saw him (the Holy Prophet) and lived in his company? Thereupon, Ubida b. Samit stood up and repeated that narration, and then said: We will definitely narrate what we heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) though it may be unpleasant to Mu'awiya (or he said: Even if it is against his will). I do not mind if I do not remain in his troop in the dark night. Hammad said this or something like this.
hi: Abi Qilabah ne bayan kiya: Main Syria mein tha (kuch dosto ka) ek daayra tha, jismein Muslim bin Yasir bhi the. Abu'l-Ash'ath aaye. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki woh (dost) unhe pukaarte: Abu'l-Ash'ath, Abu'l-Ash'ath, aur woh baith gaye. Maine unse kaha: Humare bhai ko Ubada bin Samit ki hadees sunaao. Unhone kaha: Haan. Hum ek muhim par nikle, Muawiya logon ke sardaar the, aur humne bahut sa maal-e-ganimat kamaaya. Aur maal-e-ganimat mein ek chandi ka bartan bhi tha. Muawiya ne ek shakhs ko hukum diya ki use logon (sipaahiyon) ko bhugtaan ke liye beche. Log ise haasil karne mein jaldi karne lage. Isi haalat ki khabar Ubada bin Samit tak pahunchi, aur woh khade hue aur kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sone ko sone se, aur chandi ko chandi se, aur gehun ko gehun se, aur jau ko jau se, aur khajoor ko khajoor se, aur namak ko namak se, siwaay barabar-barabar ke, bechne se mana karte suna. To jisne izafa kiya ya izafe ko qubool kiya (usne sood lene ka gunah kiya). To log ne jo unhone haasil kiya tha use wapas kiya. Ye Muawiya tak pahunchi, aur woh khitaab dene ke liye khade hue. Unhone kaha: Logon ko kya ho gaya hai ki woh Rasool (SAW) se aisi riwayaten karte hain jo humne nahi suni jabki hum unhe (Nabi ko) dekhte the aur unki sohbat mein rahte the? Isper Ubada bin Samit khade hue aur us riwayat ko dohraaya, aur phir kaha: Hum zaroor woh riwayat karenge jo humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai chahe ye Muawiya ko napasand ho (ya unhone kaha: Chahe ye unki marzi ke khilaaf ho). Mujhe koi aitraaz nahi hai agar main andheri raat mein unki fauj mein na rahun. Hammad ne ye ya isi jaisa kuch kaha.

e: The above hadith is likewise narrated through another chain of transmission on the authority of Abi Qilabah.
hi: Upar wali hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad se Abi Qilabah se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ubida b. al-Simit (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gold is to be paid for by gold, silver by silver, wheat by wheat, barley by barley, dates by dates, and salt by salt, like for like and equal for equal, payment being made hand to hand. If these classes differ, then sell as you wish if payment is made hand to hand.
hi: Ubida bin al-Simit (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sone ko sone se, chandi ko chandi se, gehun ko gehun se, jau ko jau se, khajoor ko khajoor se, aur namak ko namak se, barabar-barabar bhugtaan hokar aur mauke par bhugtaan hokar hi diya jaana chahiye. Agar ye kisme alag hon, to jaise chaho becho agar mauke par bhugtaan kiya jaaye.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gold is to be paid for by gold, silver by silver, wheat by wheat, barley by barley, dates by dates, salt by salt, like by like, payment being made hand to hand. He who made an addition to it, or asked for an addition, in fact dealt in usury. The receiver and the giver are equally guilty.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sona sone se, chandi chandi se, gehun gehun se, jau jau se, khajoor khajoor se, namak namak se, barabar-barabar, mauke par bhugtaan hokar diya jaana chahiye. Jisne isme izafa kiya, ya izafa maanga, usne dar-asal sood ka len-den kiya. Lene wala aur dene wala dono barabar ke dosi hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Dates are to be paid for by dates, wheat by wheat, barley by barley, salt by salt, like for like, payment being made on the spot. He who made an addition or demanded an addition, in fact, dealt in usury except in case where their classes differ.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Khajoor ko khajoor se, gehun ko gehun se, jau ko jau se, namak ko namak se, barabar-barabar, mauke par bhugtaan hokar dena chahiye. Jisne izafa kiya ya izafa maanga, usne dar-asal sood ka len-den kiya siwaay is baat ke ki unki kisme alag ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Fudail b. Ghazwan with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of (payment being) made on the spot.
hi: Ye hadees Fudail bin Ghazwan ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone mauke par (bhugtaan hone) ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Mess-., nger (ﷺ) as saying: Gold is to be paid for by gold with equal weight, like for like, and silver is to be paid for by silver with equal weight, like for like. He who made an addition to it or demanded an addition dealt in usury.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sone ko barabar wazan ke saath, barabar-barabar, sone se hi bhugtaan kiya jaana chahiye, aur chandi ko barabar wazan ke saath, barabar-barabar, chandi se hi bhugtaan kiya jaana chahiye. Jisne isme izafa kiya ya izafa maanga usne sood ka len-den kiya.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Let dinar be exchanged for dinar, with no addition on either side and dirham be exchanged for dirham with no addition on either side.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Dinar ko dinar ke badle exchange karo, kisi bhi taraf koi izafa na ho aur dirham ko dirham ke badle exchange karo, kisi bhi taraf koi izafa na ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Musa b. Abu Tamim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Musa bin Abu Tamim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Minhal reported: My partner sold silver to be paid in the (Hajj) season or (in the days of) Hajj. He (my partner) came to me and informed me, and I said to him: Such transaction is not desirable. He said: I sold it in the market (on loan) but nobody objected to this. I went to al-Bara' b. 'Azib and asked him, and he said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Medina and we made such transaction, whereupon he said: In case the payment is made on the spot, there is no harm in it, and in case (it is 'sold) on loan, it is usury. You better go to Zaid b. Arqam, for he is a greater trader than I; so I went to him and asked him, and he said like it.
hi: Abu Minhal ne bayan kiya: Mere partner ne chandi bechi (Hajj ke) mausam mein ya (Hajj ke dinon mein) bhugtaan hone ke liye. Woh (mera partner) mere paas aaya aur mujhe bataya, aur maine usse kaha: Aisa sauda pasandeeda nahi hai. Usne kaha: Maine ise bazaar mein (udhaar par) becha lekin kisi ne iska aitraaz nahi kiya. Main al-Bara bin Azib ke paas gaya aur unse poocha, aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye aur humne aisa sauda kiya, isper unhone kaha: Agar bhugtaan mauke par kiya jaaye, to ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai, aur agar ye udhaar par becha jaaye, to ye sood hai. Tumhe behtar hoga ki tum Zaid bin Arqam ke paas jao, kyunki woh mujhse bade vyaapaari hain; to main unke paas gaya aur unse poocha, aur unhone bhi yehi kaha.

e: Habib reported that he heard Abu Minhal as saying: I asked al-Bara' b. Azib about the exchange of (gold for silver or vice versa), whereupon he said: you better ask Zaid b. Arqam for he knows more than I. So I asked Zaid but he said: You better ask al-Bara' for he knows more than I. Then both of them said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of silver for gold when payment is to be made in future.
hi: Habib ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu Minhal ko ye kehte suna: Maine al-Bara bin Azib se (sone ke chandi se ya ulta) exchange ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Tumhe behtar hoga ki tum Zaid bin Arqam se poocho kyunki woh mujhse zyada jaante hain. To maine Zaid se poocha lekin unhone kaha: Tumhe behtar hoga ki tum al-Bara se poocho kyunki woh mujhse zyada jaante hain. Phir donon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chandi ko sone ke badle bechne se mana kiya jab bhugtaan baad mein kiya jaana ho.

e: Abd al-Rabman b. Abia Bakra reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the sale of gold for gold, and silver for silver except equal for equal, and commanded us to buy silver for gold as we desired and buy gold for silver as we desired. A person asked him (about the nature of payment), whereupon he said: It is to be made on the spot. This is what I heard (from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him ).
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ko sone ke badle, aur chandi ko chandi ke badle, siwaay barabar-barabar ke, bechne se mana kiya, aur humein hukum diya ki hum chandi ko sone ke badle khareedein jaise hum chaahein aur sone ko chandi ke badle khareedein jaise hum chaahein. Ek shakhs ne unse (bhugtaan ki fitrat ke baare mein) poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ye mauke par hona chahiye. Ye hai jo maine (Allah ke Rasool se) suna.

e: Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakra said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Fadala b. Ubaid al-Ansari reported: A necklace having gold and gems in it was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Khaibar and it was one of the spoils of war and was put to sale. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The gold used in it should be separated, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said: (Sell) gold for gold with equal weight.
hi: Fadala bin Ubaid al-Ansari ne bayan kiya: Sone aur ratnon wala ek haar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Khaibar mein laaya gaya aur ye maal-e-ganimat mein se ek tha aur bikri ke liye rakha gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Isme istemal hua sona alag kiya jaana chahiye, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aage kaha: Sona sone ke badle barabar wazan ke saath (becho).

e: Fadila b. 'Ubaid (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I bought on the day (of the Victory of Khaibar) a necklace for twelve dinars (gold coins). It was made of gold studded with gems. I separated (gold from gems) in it, and found (gold) of more (worth) than twelve dinars. I made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: It should not be sold unless it is separated.
hi: Fadila bin Ubaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine (Khaibar ki Fatah ke) din baarah dinar (sone ke sikke) mein ek haar khareeda. Ye sone ka tha, ratnon se jadit. Maine (sona ratnon se) usmein alag kiya, aur paaya ki (sona) baarah dinar se zyada keemat ka tha. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ise tab tak nahi becha jaana chahiye jab tak use alag na kiya jaaye.

e: A hadith like this is narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Yazid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Sa'id bin Yazid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Fadala b.
