'Ubaid reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger ( may peace be upon him) on the day (of the Victory of) Khaibar, and made transaction with the Jews for the 'uqiya of gold for the dinars or three (gold coins), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not sell gold for gold but for equal weight
hi: Fadala bin Ubaid ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the Khaibar ke (Fatah ke) din, aur humne Yahudiyon ke saath sone ke uqiya ka sauda kiya dinaron ya teen (sone ke sikkon) ke badle, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sone ko sone ke badle sirf barabar wazan mein hi becho.

e: Hanash reported: We were along with Fadala b. Ubaid (Allah be pleased with him) in an expedition. There fell to my and my friend's lot a necklace made of gold, silver and jewels. I decided to buy that. I asked Fadala b. 'Ubaid, whereupon he said: Separate its gold and place it in one pan (of the balance) and place your gold in the other pan, and do not receive but equal for equal, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who believes in Allah and the Hereafter should not take but equal for equal.
hi: Hanash ne bayan kiya: Hum Fadala bin Ubaid (RA) ke saath ek muhim par the. Mujhe aur mere dost ko sone, chandi aur ratnon se bana ek haar mila. Maine ise khareedne ka faisla kiya. Maine Fadala bin Ubaid se poocha, isper unhone kaha: Iska sona alag karo aur ise ek pally (tarazu ke) mein rakho, aur apna sona doosri pally mein rakho, aur barabar ke ilawa kuch mat lo, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai use barabar ke ilawa kuch nahi lena chahiye.

e: Ma'mar b. Abdullah reported that he sent his slave with a sa' of wheat and said to him: Sell it, and then buy with it barley. The slave went away and he got a sa' (of barley) and a part of sa' over and above that. When he came to Ma'mar he informed him about that, whereupon Ma'mar said to him: Why did you do that? Go back and return that, and do not accept but weight, for weight, for I used to hear from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Wheat for wheat and like for like. He (one of the narrators) said: Our food in those days consisted of barley. It was said to him (Ma'mar) that (wheat) is not like that (barley). He replied: I am afraid these may not be similar
hi: Ma'mar bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne ghulam ko ek sa gehun ke saath bheja aur usse kaha: Ise becho, aur phir isse jau khareedo. Ghulam gaya aur usne ek sa (jau) aur uske upar kuch aur bhi paaya. Jab woh Ma'mar ke paas aaya usne unhe iske baare mein bataaya, isper Ma'mar ne usse kaha: Tumne aisa kyun kiya? Wapas jaao aur ise wapas karo, aur wazan ke barabar wazan ke ilawa kuch mat qubool karo, kyunki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna karta tha: Gehun ko gehun se aur barabar-barabar. Unhone (ek raawi ne) kaha: Un dinon hamara khaana jau se banta tha. Unse (Ma'mar se) kaha gaya ki (gehun) usi jaisa (jau) nahi hai. Unhone jawab diya: Mujhe dar hai ki ye ek jaisa na ho.

e: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deputed a person from Banu 'Adi al-Ansari to collect revenue from Khaibar. He came with a fine quality of dates, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Are all the dates of Khaibar like this? He said: Allah's Messenger, it is not so. We buy one sa' of (fine quality of dates) for two sa's out of total output (including even the inferior quality of dates), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't do that, but like for like, or sell this (the inferior quality and receive the price) and then buy with the price of that, and that would make up the measure.
hi: Abu Huraira aur Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Adi al-Ansari se ek shakhs ko Khaibar se raajasva ikattha karne bheja. Woh acchi kism ki khajooren lekar aaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kya Khaibar ki saari khajooren aisi hi hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aisa nahi hai. Hum ek sa (acchi kism ki khajooren) do sa ke badle khareedte hain kul upaj mein se (ghatiya kism ki khajooron samet), isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisa mat karo, balki barabar-barabar, ya ise (ghatiya kism) becho aur uski keemat lo aur phir uski keemat se khareedo, aur ye naap poora karega.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deputed a person to collect revenue from Khaibar. He brought fine quality of dates, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Are all the dates of Khaibar like this)? He said: No. We got one sa' (of fine dates) for two sa's (of inferior dates), and (similarly) two sa's for three sa's. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't do that rather sell the inferior quality of dates for dirhams (money), and then buy the superior quality with the help of dirhams.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar se raajasva ikattha karne ek shakhs ko bheja. Woh acchi kism ki khajooren laaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya Khaibar ki saari khajooren aisi hi hain? Usne kaha: Nahi. Humein ek sa (acchi khajooren) do sa (ghatiya khajooren) ke badle milta hai, aur (isi tarah) do sa teen sa ke badle. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisa mat karo balki ghatiya kism ki khajooren dirham (paise) mein becho, aur phir dirham ki madad se behtareen kism khareedo.

e: Abd Sa'id reported: Bilal (Allah be pleased with him) came with fine quality of dates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: From where (you have brought them)? Bilal said: We had inferior quality of dates and I exchanged two sa's (of inferior quality) with one sa (of fine quality) as food for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe! it is in fact usury; therefore, don't do that. But when you intend to buy dates (of superior quality), sell (the inferior quality) in a separate bargain and then buy (the superior quality). And in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Sahl there is no mention of" whereupon".
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya: Bilal (RA) acchi kism ki khajooren lekar aaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Ye kahan se laaye? Bilal ne kaha: Hamare paas ghatiya kism ki khajooren thin aur maine do sa (ghatiya kism ki) exchange kar do ek sa (acchi kism ki) ke badle Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khaane ke liye, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haaye afsos! Ye dar-asal sood hai; is liye aisa mat karo. Lekin jab tum (behtareen kism) khareedne ka iraada karo, (ghatiya kism) ek alag sauda mein becho aur phir (behtareen kism) khareedo. Aur Ibn Sahl ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "isper" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Dates were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: These dates are not like our dates, whereupon a man said: We sold two sa's of our dates (in order to get) one sa', of these (fine dates), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is interest; so return (these dates of fine quality), and get your (inferior dates) ; then sell our dates (for money) and buy for us (with the help of money) such (fine dates).
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Khajooren Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi gayin, aur unhone kaha: Ye khajooren hamari khajooron jaisi nahi hain, isper ek aadmi ne kaha: Humne apni do sa khajooren bechkar in (acchi khajooron) ki ek sa haasil ki, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye sood hai; is liye (ye acchi kism ki khajooren) wapas karo, aur apni (ghatiya khajooren) le lo; phir hamari khajooren (paise ke liye) becho aur humare liye (paise ki madad se) aisi (acchi khajooren) khareedo.

e: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported: We were given to eat, during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), dates of different qualities mixed together, and we used to sell two sa's of these for one sa, (of fine quality of dates). This reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: There should be no exchange of two sa's of (inferior) dates for one sa (of fine dates) and two sa's of (inferior) wheat for one sa' of (fine) wheat. and one dirham for two dirharms.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humein khaane ke liye di jaati thin, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein, mukhtalif kism ki khajooren ek saath milaayi hui, aur hum do sa in (ghatiya) ko ek sa (acchi kism) ke badle bechte the. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi, isper unhone kaha: Do sa (ghatiya) khajooron ka ek sa (acchi) khajooron ke badle exchange nahi hona chahiye aur do sa (ghatiya) gehun ka ek sa (acche) gehun ke badle, aur ek dirham do dirham ke badle.

e: Abu Nadra reported: I asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the conversion (of gold and silver for silver and gold). We said: Is it hand to hand exchange? I said: Yes. whereupon he said: There is no harm in it. I informed Abu Sa'id about it, telling him that I had asked Ibn 'Abbas about it and he said: Is it hand to hand exchange? I said: Yes, whereupon he said: There is no harm in it. He (the narrator) said, or he said like it: We will soon write to him, and he will not give you this fatwa (religious verdict). He said: By Allah, someone of the boy-servants of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) brought dates, but he refused to accept them (on the plea) that those did not seem to be of the dates of our land. He said: Something had happened to the dates of our land, or our dates. So I got these dates (in exchange by giving) excess (of the dates of our land), whereupon he said: You made an addition for getting the fine dates (in exchange) which tantamounts, to interest; don't do that (in future). Whenever you find some doubt (as regards the deteriorating quality of) your dates, sell them, and then buy the dates that you like.
hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se sone aur chandi ke exchange ke baare mein poocha. Humne kaha: Kya ye haath-se-haath exchange hai? Maine kaha: Haan, isper unhone kaha: Ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Maine Abu Sa'id ko iske baare mein bataaya, unhe kaha ki maine Ibn Abbas se iske baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Kya ye haath-se-haath exchange hai? Maine kaha: Haan, isper unhone kaha: Ismein koi nuksaan nahi hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha, ya unhone isi jaisa kuch kaha: Hum jald hi unhe likhenge, aur woh tumhe ye fatwa nahi denge. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch khaadim khajooren laaye, lekin unhone unhe qubool karne se inkaar kiya (is aadhar par) ki woh humari zameen ki khajooron jaisi nahi lag rahi thin. Unhone kaha: Humari zameen ki khajooron ya hamari khajooron mein kuch hua tha. Is liye maine ye khajooren (badle mein diye gaye) izafe se paayi, isper unhone kaha: Tumne acchi khajooren paane ke liye izafa kiya jo sood ke barabar hai; aisa (mustaqbil mein) mat karo. Jab bhi tumhe apni khajooron ki mayaar mein koi shaq mile, unhe becho, aur phir woh khajooren khareedo jo tumhe pasand hon.

e: Abu Nadra reported: I asked Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) about the conversion of gold with gold but they did not find any harm in that. I was sitting in the company of Abd Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) and asked him about this exchange, and he said: Whatever is addition is an' interest. I refused to accept it on account of their statement (statement of Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn 'Umar). He said: I am not narrating to you except what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). There came to him the owner of a date-palm with one sa' of fine dates, and the dates of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) were of that colour. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: Where did you get these dates? I went with two sa's of (inferior dates) and bought one sa' of (these fine dates), for that is the prevailing price (of inferior dates) in the market and that is the price (of the fine quality of dates in the market), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon you! You have dealt in interest, when you decide to do it (i. e. exchange superior quality of dates for inferior quality) ; so you should sell your dates for another commodity (or currency) and then with the help of that commodity buy the dates you like. Abu Sa'ad said: When dates are exchanged for dates (with different qualities) there is the possibility (of the element of) interest (creeping into that) or when gold is exchanged for gold having different qualities. I subsequently came to Ibn 'Umar and he forbade me (to do it), but I did not come to Ibn 'Abbas; (Allah be pleased with them). He (the narrator) said: Abu as-Sahba' narrated to me: He asked Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) in Mecca, and he too disapproved of it.
hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas (RA) se sone ko sone ke badle exchange karne ke baare mein poocha lekin unhe usmein koi nuksaan nahi mila. Main Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ki sohbat mein baitha tha aur maine unse is exchange ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Jo bhi izafa hai woh sood hai. Maine unke (Ibn Abbas aur Ibn Umar ke) bayaan ki wajah se ise qubool karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone kaha: Main tumhe wahi riwayat karta hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Ek khajoor ke darakht ka maalik unke paas ek sa acchi khajooren lekar aaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khajooren usi rang ki thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Tumhe ye khajooren kahan se mili? Main do sa (ghatiya khajooren) lekar gaya aur ek sa (in acchi khajooron) ki khareedi, kyunki ye (ghatiya khajooron ki) bazaar mein prachalit keemat hai aur ye (acchi kism ki khajooron ki bazaar mein keemat) hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumpar afsos! Tumne sood ka len-den kiya, jab tumne aisa karne ka faisla kiya (yaani acchi kism ki khajooren ghatiya kism ki khajooron se exchange karna); is liye tumhe apni khajooren kisi aur cheez (ya mudra) ke badle bechni chahiye aur phir us cheez ki madad se woh khajooren khareedni chahiye jo tumhe pasand hain. Abu Sa'ad ne kaha: Jab khajooren khajooron ke badle exchange ki jaati hain (mukhtalif gunon ke saath) to sood ke tatva ki sambhaavna hoti hai (isme ghusne ki) ya jab sona sone ke badle exchange kiya jaata hai mukhtalif gunon ke saath. Main baad mein Ibn Umar ke paas aaya aur unhone mujhe (aisa karne se) mana kiya, lekin main Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas nahi aaya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Abu as-Sahba ne mujhe riwayat ki: Unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se Makkah mein poocha, aur unhone bhi ise napasand kiya.

e: Abu Salih reported: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) said: Dinar (gold) for gold and dirham for dirham can be (exchanged) with equal for equal; but he who gives more or demands more in fact deals in interest. I sald to him: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) says otherwise, whereupon he said: I met Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) and said: Do you see what you say; have you heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), or found it in the Book of Allah, the Glorious and Majestic? He said: I did not hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and I did not find it in the Book of Allah (Glorious and Majestic), but Usama b. Zaid narrated it to me that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: There can be an element of interest in credit.
hi: Abu Salih ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Dinar (sona) ko sona ke badle aur dirham ko dirham ke badle barabar-barabar (exchange kiya jaana chahiye); lekin jo zyada de ya zyada maange usne dar-asal sood ka len-den kiya. Maine unse kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) doosri baat kehte hain, isper unhone kaha: Main Ibn Abbas (RA) se mila aur kaha: Kya aap dekhte hain jo aap kehte hain; kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, ya Allah ki Kitaab, jo Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem hai, mein paaya? Unhone kaha: Maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nahi suna, aur maine ise Allah ki Kitaab, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, mein nahi paaya, lekin Usama bin Zaid ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Udhaar mein sood ka tatva ho sakta hai.

e: Ubaidullah b. Abu Yazid heard Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) as saying: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There can be an element of interest in credit (when the payment is not equal).
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abu Yazid ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Usama bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Udhaar mein sood ka tatva ho sakta hai (jab bhugtaan barabar na ho).

e: Ibn 'Abbas; (Allah be pleased with them) reported on the authority of Usama b. Zaid Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: There is no element of interest when the money or commodity is exchanged hand to hand.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Usama bin Zaid ke hawale se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sood ka koi tatva nahi hai jab paisa ya saamaan haath se haath exchange kiya jaaye.

e: Ata' b. Abu Rabah reported: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with them) met Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) and said to him: What do you say in regard to the conversion (of commodities or money) did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), or is it something which you found In Allah's Book, Majestic and Glorious? Thereupon Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleated with them) said: I don't say that. So far at Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) is concerned, you know him better, and to far as the Book of Allah to concerned, I do not know it (more than you do), but 'Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: Beware, there can be an element of interest in credit.
hi: Ata bin Abu Rabah ne bayan kiya: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) Ibn Abbas (RA) se mile aur unse kaha: Aap conversion (saudon ya paise ke) ke baare mein kya kehte hain, kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, ya ye kuch hai jo aapne Allah ki Kitaab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, mein paaya? Isper Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Main aisa nahi kehta. Jahan tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka sawal hai, aap unhe mujhse behtar jaante hain, aur jahan tak Allah ki Kitaab ka sawal hai, main use nahi jaanta (aapse zyada), lekin Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha: Dhyaan rakho, udhaar mein sood ka tatva ho sakta hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) (Allah be pleased with him) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed the one who accepted interest and the one who paid it I asked about the one who recorded it, and two witnesses to it. He (the narrator) said: We narrate what we have heard.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs par laanat ki jo sood qubool karta hai aur jo ise ada karta hai. Maine iska record rakhne wale aur uske do gawaahon ke baare mein poocha. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Hum riwayat karte hain jo humne suna hai.

e: Jabir said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed the accepter of interest and its payer, and one who records it, and the two witnesses, and he said: They are all equal.
hi: Jabir ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sood qubool karne wale aur ise ada karne wale, aur jo ise record karta hai, aur do gawaahon par laanat ki, aur unhone kaha: Woh sab barabar (gunahgaar) hain.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon himn) as having said this (and Nu'man) pointed towards his ears with his fingers): What is lawful is evident and what is unlawful is evident, and in between them are the things doubtful which many people do not know. So he who guards against doubtful things keeps his religion and honour blameless, and he who indulges in doubtful things indulges in fact in unlawful things, just as a shepherd who pastures his animals round a preserve will soon pasture them in it. Beware, every king has a preserve, and the things God his declaced unlawful are His preserves. Beware, in the body there is a piece of flesh; if it is sound, the whole body is sound and if it is corrupt the whole body is corrupt, and hearken it is the heart.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna (aur Nu'man ne apni ungliyon se apne kaanon ki taraf ishara kiya): Jo jaayez hai woh saaf hai aur jo na-jaayez hai woh saaf hai, aur unke beech mein anishchit cheezein hain jinke baare mein bahut se log nahi jaante. To jo anishchit cheezon se bachta hai woh apna deen aur izzat mahfooz rakhta hai, aur jo anishchit cheezon mein padta hai woh dar-asal na-jaayez cheezon mein padta hai, bilkul waise jaise ek gadariya jo apne jaanwaron ko kisi mahfooz kshetra ke aas-paas charaata hai jald hi unhe usmein charaayega. Dhyaan raho, har raja ka apna mahfooz kshetra hai, aur Allah ne jo cheezein na-jaayez ki hain woh Uska mahfooz kshetra hain. Dhyaan raho, badan mein gosht ka ek tukda hai; agar woh theek hai, poora badan theek hai aur agar woh bura hai, poora badan bura hai, aur suno ye dil hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakariya with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zakariya ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: AI-Nu'man b. Bashir reported it from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The hadith narrated by Zakariya is, however, more complete and lengthy than the other ones.
hi: Al-Nu'man bin Bashir ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki. Zakariya ki riwayat ki hui hadees, halaanki, doosron se zyada mukammal aur lambi hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir b. Sa'd, a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was heard delivering a sermon at Hims and was saying: I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: The lawful is evident and the unlawful is evident, the rest of the hadith is the same as related by Zakariya.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir bin Sa'd, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek sahabi, ko Hims mein khutba dete hue suna gaya aur woh keh rahe the: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jaayez saaf hai aur na-jaayez saaf hai, baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Zakariya ne bayan ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported that he was travelling on his camel which had grown jaded, and he decided to let it off. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met him and prayed for him and struck it, so it trotted as it had never trotted before. He said: Sell it to me for an 'uqaya. I said: No. He again said: Sell it to me. So I sold it to him for an 'uqaya, but made the stipulation that I should be allowed to ride back to my family. Then when I came to (my place) I took the camel to him and he paid me its price in ready money. I then went back and he sent: (someone) behind me (and as I came) he said: Do you see that I asked you to reduce price for buying your camel. Take your camel and your coins; these are yours.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh apne oont par safar kar rahe the jo thak gaya tha, aur unhone use chhod dene ka faisla kiya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse mile aur unke liye dua ki aur use maara, to woh us tarah tez chala jaisa pehle kabhi nahi chala tha. Unhone kaha: Ise mujhe ek uqiya mein becho. Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone dobara kaha: Ise mujhe becho. To maine ise unhe ek uqiya mein becha, lekin shart rakhi ki mujhe apne khaandaan ke paas wapas sawaari karne di jaaye. Phir jab main (apni jagah) aaya main oont unke paas le gaya aur unhone mujhe uski keemat naqad ada ki. Main phir wapas gaya aur unhone (kisi ko) mere peeche bheja aur (jab main aaya) unhone kaha: Kya tumhe lagta hai ki maine tumhare oont ki keemat kam karne ke liye poocha tha? Apna oont aur apne sikke le lo; ye tumhare hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I went on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He overtook me and I was on a water-carrying camel who had grown tired and did not walk (trot). He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: What is the matter with your camel? I said: It is sick. He (the Holy Prophet) stepped behind and drove it and prayed for it, and then it always moved ahead of other camels. He (then) said: How do you find your camel? I said: It is, by the grace of your prayer, all right. He said: Would you sell this (camel) to me? I felt shy (to say him," No" ) as we had no other camel for carrying water, but (later on) I said: Yes, and to I sold it to him on the condition that (I would be permitted) to ride it until I reached Madina. I said to him: Allah's Messenger, I am newly married, so I asked his permission (to go ahead of the caravan). He permitted me, and I reached Medina well in advance of other people, until I reached my destination. There my maternal uncle met me and asked me about the camel, and I told him what I had done with regard to it. He reproved me in this connection. He (Jabir) said: When I asked his permission (to go ahead of the caravan) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) inquired of me whether I had married a virgin or a non-virgin. I said to him: I have married a non-virgin. He said: Why did you not marry a virgin who would have played with you and you would have played with her? I said to him: Allah's Messenger, my father died (or he fell as a martyr), and I have small sisters to (look after), so I did not like the idea that I should marry a woman who is like them and thus be not able to teach them manners and look after them properly. So I have married a non-virgin so that she should be able to look after them and teach them manners, When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, I went to him in the morning with the camel. He paid me its price and returned that (the camel) to me.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaya. Unhone mujhe pakad liya aur main paani le jaane wale oont par tha jo thak gaya tha aur nahi chal (daud) raha tha. Unhone mujhse kaha: Tumhare oont ko kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Woh bimaar hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) peeche jaakar use haanka aur uske liye dua ki, aur phir woh hamesha doosre oonton se aage chalne laga. Unhone (phir) kaha: Tumhe apna oont kaisa lag raha hai? Maine kaha: Ye, aapki dua ki barkat se, bilkul theek hai. Unhone kaha: Kya tum ise mujhe becho ge? Mujhe sharam mehsoos hui (unse "Nahi" kehne mein) kyunki hamare paas paani le jaane ke liye koi doosra oont nahi tha, lekin (baad mein) maine kaha: Haan, aur maine ise unhe becha is shart par ki mujhe Madina pahunchne tak isper sawaari karne di jaaye. Maine unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri abhi-abhi shaadi hui hai, is liye maine unse ijazat maangi (kaafile se aage jaane ki). Unhone mujhe ijazat di, aur main Madina doosron se pehle pahuncha, yahan tak ki main apni manzil tak pahuncha. Wahan mere maama mujhse mile aur oont ke baare mein poocha, aur maine unhe bataaya ki maine uske saath kya kiya tha. Unhone mujhe is baare mein daanta. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Jab maine unse (kaafile se aage jaane ki) ijazat maangi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse poocha ki kya maine kunwari ya ghair-kunwari se shaadi ki hai. Maine unse kaha: Maine ghair-kunwari se shaadi ki hai. Unhone kaha: Tumne kisi kunwari se shaadi kyun nahi ki jo tumhare saath khelti aur tum uske saath khelte? Maine unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere waalid ka intiqaal ho gaya (ya woh shaheed ho gaye), aur meri chhoti behnein hain (jinki dekhbhaal karni hai), is liye mujhe ye khyaal pasand nahi aaya ki main unhi jaisi kisi aurat se shaadi karun aur is tarah unhe achhi tarah tameez sikhaane aur dekhbhaal karne mein asamarth rahun. Is liye maine ghair-kunwari se shaadi ki taaki woh unki dekhbhaal kar sake aur unhe tameez sikhaa sake. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye, main unke paas subah oont ke saath gaya. Unhone mujhe uski keemat di aur woh (oont) mujhe wapas kiya.

e: Jabir reported: We went from Mecca to Medina with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when my camel fell ill, and the rest of the hadith is the same. (But it in also narrated in it: ) He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Sell your camel to me. I said: No, but it is yours. He said: No. (it can't be), but sell it to me. I said: No, but, Allah's Messenger, it is yours. He said: No, it can't be, but sell it to me. I said: Then give me an 'uqaya of gold for I owe that to a person and then it would be yours. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I take it (for an 'uqiya of gold) and you reach Medina on it. As I reached Medina, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Bilal: Give him an 'uqiya of gold and make some extra payment too. He (Jabir) said: He gave me an 'uqiya of gold and made an addition of a qirat. He (Jabir) said: The addition made by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with me (as a sacred trust for belssing) and lay with me in a pocket until the people of Syria took it on the Day of Harra.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Hum Makkah se Madina Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaye jab mera oont bimaar pad gaya, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai. (Lekin isme ye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai): Unhone mujhse kaha: Apna oont mujhe becho. Maine kaha: Nahi, lekin ye aapka hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi, (aisa nahi ho sakta), lekin ise mujhe becho. Maine kaha: Phir mujhe ek uqiya sona dijiye kyunki main ye kisi shakhs ka dena rakhta hoon aur phir ye aapka ho jaayega. Unhone kaha: Main ise (ek uqiya sona ke liye) leta hoon aur tum isper Madina pahuncho. Jab main Madina pahuncha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bilal se kaha: Unhe ek uqiya sona do aur kuch atirikt bhugtaan bhi karo. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Unhone mujhe ek uqiya sona diya aur ek qirat ka izafa kiya. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jo izafa kiya woh mere paas tha (barkat ke liye ek muqaddas amaanat ke soorat mein) aur mere paas ek jeb mein raha yahan tak ki Syria ke logon ne ise Harra ke din le liya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a journey and my camel meant for carrying water lagged behind. The rest of the hadith is the same and it is mentioned also: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pricked it and then said to me: Ride in the name of Allah. He constantly made addition (in prayers for me) and went on saying. May Allah forgive you!
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the aur mera paani le jaane wala oont peeche reh gaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ismein ye bhi zikr hai: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use maara aur phir mujhse kaha: Allah ke naam par sawaar ho. Unhone (mere liye dua mein) lagataar izafa kiya aur kehte rahe: Allah tumhe maafi de!

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: My camel had grown tired as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me. He goaded it and it began to jump. After that I tried to restrain its rein so that I could listen to his (Prophet's) words, but I could not do that. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met me and said: Sell it to me, and I sold it for five 'uqiyas. I said: On the condition that I may use it as a ride (for going back) to Medina. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Well, you may use it as a ride up till Medina. When I came to Medina I handed over that to him and he made an addition of an uqiya (to that amount which had been agreed upon) and then presented that (camel) to me.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mera oont thak gaya tha jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye. Unhone use ubhaara aur woh koodne laga. Iske baad maine iski lagaam ko rokne ki koshish ki taaki main unke (Nabi ke) alfaaz sun sakoon, lekin main aisa nahi kar saka. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse mile aur kaha: Ise mujhe becho, aur maine ise paanch uqiya mein becha. Maine kaha: Is shart par ki main ise sawaari (Madina wapas jaane ke liye) ke soorat mein istemal kar sakoon. Unhone kaha: Achha, tum ise Madina tak sawaari ke soorat mein istemal kar sakte ho. Jab main Madina pahuncha, maine use unhe soonpa aur unhone (jo raqam tay hui thi) usmein se ek uqiya ka izafa kiya aur phir woh (oont) mujhe tohfe mein de diya.

e: Abd Mutawakkil al-Najl reported from Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) who said: I accompanied Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in one of his journeys (the narrator says, he said in Jihad), and he narrated the rest of the hadith, and made this addition: He (the Holy Prophet) said: Jabir, have you received the price? I said: Yes, whereupon he said: Yours is the price as well as the camel; yours is the price as well as the camel.
hi: Abd Mutawakkil al-Najl ne Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke ek safar mein saath tha (raawi kehte hain, unhone kaha Jihad mein), aur unhone baaki hadees riwayat ki, aur ye izafa kiya: Unhone kaha: Jabir, kya tumhe keemat mil gayi? Maine kaha: Haan, isper unhone kaha: Keemat bhi tumhari hai aur oont bhi tumhara hai; keemat bhi tumhari hai aur oont bhi tumhara hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought a camel from me for two 'uqiyas and a dirham or two dirhams. As he reached Sirar (a village near Medina), he commanded a cow to be slaughtered and it was slaughtered, and they ate of that, and as he (the Holy Prophet) reached Medina he ordered me to go to the mosque and offer two rak'ahs of prayer, and he measured for me the price of the camel and even made an excess payment to me.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse ek oont do uqiya aur ek dirham ya do dirham mein khareeda. Jab woh Sirar (Madina ke qareeb ek gaon) pahunche, unhone ek gaay ko zibah karne ka hukum diya aur use zibah kiya gaya, aur unhone usmein se khaya, aur jab woh (Nabi) Madina pahunche unhone mujhe masjid mein jaakar do rakat namaz padhne ka hukum diya, aur unhone mere liye oont ki keemat naapi aur mujhe atirikt bhugtaan bhi kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported this narration from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but with this variation that he said: He (the Holy Prophet) bought the camel from me on a stipulated price. And he did not mention two 'uqiyas and a dirham or two dirhams, and he comanded a cow (to be slaughtered) and it was slaughtered, and he then distributed its flesh.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne ye riwayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone kaha: Unhone mujhse oont ek tay ki gayi keemat par khareeda. Aur unhone do uqiya aur ek dirham ya do dirham ka koi zikr nahi kiya, aur unhone ek gaay (ko zibah karne) ka hukum diya aur use zibah kiya gaya, aur phir unhone uska gosht baanta.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: I have taken your camelfor four dinars, and you may ride upon it to Medina.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Maine tumhara oont chaar dinar mein liya hai, aur tum isper Madina tak sawaar ho sakte ho.

e: Abu Rafi' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took from a man as a loan a young camel (below six years). Then the camels of Sadaqa were brought to him. He ordered Abu Rafi' to return to that person the young camel (as a return of the loan). Abu Rafi' returned to him and said: I did not find among them but better camels above the age of six. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give that to him for the best men are those who are best in paying off the debt.
hi: Abu Rafi ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs se udhaar ke taur par ek jawaan oont (chhe saal se kam) liya. Phir Sadaqe ke oont unke paas laaye gaye. Unhone Abu Rafi ko hukum diya ki woh us shakhs ko jawaan oont (karze ki vaapasi ke soorat mein) wapas kare. Abu Rafi unke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: Mujhe unmein chhe saal se upar behtareen oonton ke ilawa kuch nahi mila. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Use woh de do kyunki sabse behtareen log woh hain jo karza chukaane mein sabse behtareen hain.

e: Abu Rafi', the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took as a loan (the rest of the hadith is the same), but with this variation that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Good amongst the servants of Allah is he who is best in paying off the debt.
hi: Abu Rafi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne udhaar liya (baaki hadees waisi hi hai), lekin is tabdeeli ke saath ki unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Allah ke bandon mein sabse achha woh hai jo karza chukaane mein sabse achha hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) owed (something) to a person. He behaved in an uncivil manner with him. This vexed the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who has a right is entitled to speak, and said to them (his Companions): Buy a camel for him and give that to him. They said: We do not find a camel (of that age) but one with better age than that. He said: Buy that and give that to him, for best of you or best amongst you are those who are best in paying off debt.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par ek shakhs ka kuch bakaaya tha. Usne unke saath asabhya vyavahaar kiya. Isse Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba pareshaan hue, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiska haq hai use bolne ka haq hai, aur unse (apne sahaba se) kaha: Uske liye ek oont khareedo aur use de do. Unhone kaha: Humein us umar ka koi oont nahi mila siwaay iske ki usse behtareen umar ka ek mila. Unhone kaha: Use khareedo aur use de do, kyunki tum mein se sabse behtareen, ya tum mein se sabse achhe log woh hain jo karza chukaane mein sabse achhe hain.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a camel on loan, and then returned him (the lender) the camel of a more mature age and said: Good among you are those who are good in clearing off the debt.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne udhaar mein ek oont liya, aur phir unhone (karzdaata ko) usse behtar umar ka oont wapas kiya aur kaha: Tum mein se achhe log woh hain jo karza chukaane mein achhe hain.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: There came a person demanding a camel from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him (the camel) of that age or of more mature age, and said: Best among you is one who is best in clearing off the debt.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apna oont maangne aaya. Unhone kaha: Unhe (oont) usi umar ka ya usse behtar umar ka do, aur kaha: Tum mein sabse behtareen woh hai jo karza chukaane mein sabse behtareen hai.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported: There came a slave and pledg- ed allegiance to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on migration; he (the Holy Prophet) did not know that he was a slave. Then there came his master and demanded him back, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Sell him to me. And he bought him for two black slaves, and he did not afterwards take allegiance from anyone until he had asked him whether he was a slave (or a free man)
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek ghulam aaya aur usne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se hijrat par bai'at ki; unhe nahi pata tha ki woh ghulam tha. Phir uska maalik aaya aur use wapas maanga, isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Use mujhe becho. Aur unhone use do kaale ghulamon ke badle khareeda, aur uske baad unhone kisi se bhi bai'at nahi li jab tak unhone unse poocha nahi ki kya woh ghulam hai (ya azaad shakhs).

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought some grain from a Jew on credit and gave him a coat-of- mail of his as a pledge.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Yahudi se udhaar par kuch anaaj khareeda aur apni ek kavach bandhak ke soorat mein di.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought from a Jew grain (as loan) and pledged him his iron coat-of-mail.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Yahudi se anaaj (udhaar ke soorat mein) khareeda aur unhe apni loha ki kavach bandhak rakhi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bought from a Jew grain for a specified time; and gave him iron coat-of-mail of his as a pledge.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Yahudi se anaaj khareeda ek muqarrar muddat ke liye; aur unhe apni loha ki kavach bandhak diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), through another chain ol transmitters, but no mention was made of (its being made) of iron.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin iske loha ki hone ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, they were paying one and two years in advance for fruits, so he said: Those who pay in advance for anything must do so for a specified weight and for a definite time.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Nabi (SAW) Madina aaye, log phalon ke liye ek aur do saal pahle se bhugtaan kiya karte the, is liye unhone kaha: Jo koi kisi cheez ke liye pahle se bhugtaan kare use ye ek muayyan wazan aur muayyan muddat ke liye karna chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to (Medina) and the people were paying in advance (for the fruits, etc.), he said to them: He who makes an advance payment should not make advance payment except for a specified measure and weight (and for a specified period).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (Madina) aaye aur log pahle se bhugtaan kar rahe the (phalon waghera ke liye), unhone unse kaha: Jo pahle se bhugtaan kare use muayyan naap aur wazan (aur muayyan muddat) ke liye hi karna chahiye.

e: Ibn Abu Najih has narrated a hadith like this with the same chain of transmitters, but he has not mentioned: " for a definite period".
hi: Ibn Abu Najih ne isi jaisi ek hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai, lekin unhone "muayyan muddat ke liye" ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Abu Najih through another chain of transmitters mentioning in it" for a specified period".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Najih ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai jismein "muayyan muddat ke liye" ka zikr hai.

e: Ma`mar (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who hoards is a sinner. It was said to Sa`id (b. al-Musayyib): You also hoard. Sa`id said: Ma`mar who narrated this hadith also hoarded.
hi: Ma'mar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo jamaakhori karta hai woh gunahgaar hai. Sa'id (bin al-Musayyib) se kaha gaya: Aap bhi jamaakhori karte hain. Sa'id ne kaha: Ma'mar jinhone ye hadees riwayat ki, unhone bhi jamaakhori ki.

e: Ma'mar b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No one hoards but the sinner.
hi: Ma'mar bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi jamaakhori nahi karta siwaay gunahgaar ke.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sulaiman b. Bilal from Yahya.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman bin Bilal ki sanad se Yahya se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne kaha unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qasam khaana ek cheez ki turant bikri karvaata hai, lekin barkat ko mita deta hai.

e: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Beware of swearing; it produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing.
hi: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (RA) ne kaha unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qasam khaane se bacho; ye ek cheez ki turant bikri karvaata hai, lekin barkat ko mita deta hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who has a partner in a dwelling or a garden, it is not lawful for him to sell that until he is permitted by his partner. If he (the partner) agrees, he should go in for that, and if he disapproves of that, he should abandon (the idea of selling it).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiska ghar ya baag mein saanjhedaar hai, uske liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh use tab tak beche jab tak uska saanjhedaar ijazat na de. Agar woh (saanjhedaar) sehmat ho, use aage badhna chahiye, aur agar woh napasand kare, to use isse (bechne ke iraade se) hat jaana chahiye.

e: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decreed pre-emption in every joint ownership and not divided-the one-it may be a dwelling or a garden. It is not lawful for him (for the partner) to sell that until his partner gives his consent. He (the partner) is entitled to buy it when he desires and he can abandon it if he so likes. And if he (the one partner) sells it without getting the consent of the (other partner), he has the greatest right to it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har saanjhi malkiyat mein shuf'a ka haq (pre-emption) ka faisla diya jo bataayi nahi gayi ho - chahe ye ghar ho ya baag. Uske (saanjhedaar ke) liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh use tab tak beche jab tak uska saanjhedaar sehmati na de. Woh (saanjhedaar) chaahein to khareedne ka haq rakhte hain aur chaahein to isse hat sakte hain. Aur agar woh (ek saanjhedaar) doosre saanjhedaar ki sehmati liye bina use bech deta hai, to usse (doosre saanjhedaar ko) sabse zyada haq hai isper.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is pre-emption in everything which is shared, be it land, or a dwelling or a garden. It is not proper to sell it until he informs his partner; he may go in for that, or he may abandon it; and it he (the partner intending to sell his share) does not do that, then his partner has the greatest right to it until he permits him.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har saanjhi cheez mein shuf'a ka haq hai, chahe ye zameen ho, ya ghar, ya baag. Ise tab tak bechna theek nahi hai jab tak woh apne saanjhedaar ko na bataaye; woh chaahein to isse khareed sakte hain, ya isse hat sakte hain; aur agar woh (saanjhedaar jo apna hissa bechna chahta hai) aisa nahi karta, to uske saanjhedaar ko usper sabse zyada haq hai jab tak woh use ijazat na de.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None among you should prevent his neighbour from fixing a beam in his wall. Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) then said: What is this that I see you evading (this injunction of the Holy Prophet)? By Allah, I will certainly throw it between your shoulders (narrate this to you.)
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi apne padosi ko apni deewaar mein shahtir tikaane se na roke. Abu Huraira (RA) ne phir kaha: Ye kya hai jo main dekh raha hoon ki tum ise (Nabi ke is hukum ko) taal rahe ho? Allah ki qasam, main ise zaroor tumhare kandhon ke beech phenkunga (ye tumhe riwayat karunga.)

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transrmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who wrongly took a span of land, Allah shall make him carry around his neck seven earths.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo galat tarike se zameen ka ek span (bitta) le lega, Allah use apni gardan mein saat zameenein le jaane par majboor karega.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Arwi (bint Uwais) disputed with him (in regard to a part of the land) of his hodse. He said: Leave it and take off your claim from it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who took a span of land without his right would be made to wear around his neck seven earths on the Day of Resurrection. He (Sa'id b. Zaid) said: O Allah, make her blind if she has told a lie and make her grave in her house. He (the narrator) said: I saw her blind groping (her way) by touching the walls and saying: The curse of Sa'id b. Zaid has hit me. And it so happened that as she was walking in her house, she passed by a well in her house and fell therein and that be- came her grave.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Arwi (bint Uwais) ne unse (unke ghar ki zameen ke ek hisse ke baare mein) jhagda kiya. Unhone kaha: Ise chhod do aur isse apna daawa hataao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne bina haq ke zameen ka ek span liya use Qayamat ke din apni gardan mein saat zameenein pehnaayi jaayengi. Unhone (Sa'id bin Zaid ne) kaha: Aye Allah, use andha kar de agar usne jhoot bola hai aur uski qabar uske hi ghar mein bana. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine unhe andhi ho kar deewaron ko chhookar (apna raasta) taatolte hue dekha aur kehte hue: Sa'id bin Zaid ki laanat mujhpar padi hai. Aur aisa hua ki jab woh apne ghar mein chal rahi thi, woh apne ghar mein ek kuen ke paas se guzri aur usmein gir gayi aur ye uski qabar ban gaya.

e: Hisham b. Urwa reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Arwa bint Uwais disputed with Sa'id b. Zaid that he had seized some of the land belonging to her. She brought this dispute before Marwan b. al-Hakam. Sa'id said: How could I take a part of her land, after what I heard from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon'him)? He (Marwan) said: What did you hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who wrongly took a span of land would be made to wear around his neck seven earths. Marwan said: I do not ask any evidence from you after this. He (Sa'id) said: O Allah, make her blind if she has told a lie and kill her in her own land. He (the narrator) said: She did not die until she had lost her eyesight, and (one day) as she was walking in her land, she fell down into a pit and died.
hi: Hisham bin Urwa ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Arwa bint Uwais ne Sa'id bin Zaid se jhagda kiya ki unhone uski zameen ka kuch hissa hadap liya tha. Woh ye jhagda Marwan bin al-Hakam ke saamne le gayi. Sa'id ne kaha: Main uski zameen ka hissa kaise le sakta hoon, jab maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye suna hai? Unhone (Marwan ne) kaha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kya suna? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne galat tarike se zameen ka ek span liya use apni gardan mein saat zameenein pehnaayi jaayengi. Marwan ne kaha: Iske baad main aapse koi saboot nahi maangunga. Unhone (Sa'id ne) kaha: Aye Allah, use andha kar de agar usne jhoot bola hai aur use uski hi zameen mein maar de. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh nahi mari jab tak usne apni najar nahi khoyi, aur (ek din) jab woh apni zameen mein chal rahi thi, woh ek gadde mein gir gayi aur mar gayi.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) say: He who took a span of earth wrongly would be made to wear around his neck seven earths on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne galat tarike se zameen ka ek span liya use Qayamat ke din apni gardan mein saat zameenein pehnaayi jaayengi.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: One should not take a span of land without having legitimate right to it, otherwise Allah would make him wear (around his neck) seven earths on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi ko bina munasib haq ke zameen ka ek span nahi lena chahiye, warna Allah use Qayamat ke din apni gardan mein saat zameenein pehnaayega.

e: Muhammad b. Ibrahim said that Abu Salama reported to him that there was between him and his people dispute over a piece of land, and he came to 'A'isha and mentioned that to her, whereupon she said: Abu Salama, abstain from getting this land, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who usurps even a span of land would be made to wear around his neck seven earths.
hi: Muhammad bin Ibrahim ne kaha ki Abu Salama ne unhe bataya ki unke aur unke logon ke beech zameen ke ek tukde par jhagda tha, aur woh Aisha ke paas aaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Abu Salama, is zameen ko haasil karne se bacho, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo zameen ka ek span bhi hadapta hai use apni gardan mein saat zameenein pehnaayi jaayengi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Salama ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Haraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When you disagree about a path, its breadth should be made seven cubits.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum kisi raaste ke baare mein muttafiq nahi ho, uski chaudai saat haath honi chahiye.

e: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A Muslim is not entitled to inherit from a non-Muslim, and a non-Muslim is not entitled to inherit from a Muslim.
hi: Usama bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman kisi ghair-Musalman se virasat paane ka haq nahi rakhta, aur ek ghair-Musalman kisi Musalman se virasat paane ka haq nahi rakhta.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Give the shares to those who are entitled to them, and what remains over goes to the nearest male heir.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hisse un logon ko do jo unke haqdaar hain, aur jo bacha rahta hai woh sabse qareebi mard waaris ko jaata hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Give the shares to those who are entitled to them, and what is left from those wno are entitled to it goes to the nearest male heir.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Hisse un logon ko do jo unke haqdaar hain, aur jo un se bach jaata hai jo iske haqdaar hain woh sabse qareebi mard waaris ko jaata hai.

e: Tawus reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) narrating that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Distribute the property amongst Ahl al-Fara'id, according to the Book of Allah, and what is left out of them goes to the nearest male heir.
hi: Tawus ne Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maal ko Ahl al-Fara'id ke beech taqseem karo, Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik, aur jo unse bach jaata hai woh sabse qareebi mard waaris ko jaata hai.

e: There is another chain of Tawus reporting like the reports that were mentioned before the previous hadith chain through Tawus (the chains of Wuhaib and Rowh bin Qasim).
hi: Tawus ki ek doosri sanad se woh riwayaten hain jo Tawus se pehle wali hadees ki sanad se pehle bataayi gayi thin (Wuhaib aur Rowh bin Qasim ki sanadein).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I fell sick and there came to me on foot Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr for inquiring after my health. I fainted. He (the Holy Prophet) performed ablution and then sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I felt some relief and said: Allah's Messenger, how should I decide about my property? He said nothing to me in response until this verse pertaining to the law of inheritance was revealed:" They ask you for a decision; say: Allah gives you a decision concerning the person who has neither parents nor children" (iv. 177).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main bimaar pad gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr paidal mere paas mera haal-chaal poochhne aaye. Main behosh ho gaya. Unhone (Nabi ne) wuzu kiya aur phir mujhpar apne wuzu ka paani chhidka. Mujhe kuch rahat mehsoos hui aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main apni maal ke baare mein kaise faisla karun? Unhone mujhe iske jawaab mein kuch nahi kaha jab tak virasat ke qaanoon se mutalliq ye aayat nazil nahi hui: "Woh aapse faisla poochhte hain; kaho: Allah tumhe us shakhs ke baare mein faisla deta hai jiske na maa-baap hain na bachche" (4:177).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and Abi Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) visited me on foot in Banu Salama, and found me unconscious. He (the Holy Prophet) called for water and performed ablution and sprinkled out of it (the water) over me. I felt relieved. I said: Allah's Messenger, what should I do with my property? And this verse was revealed:" Allah enjoins you concerning your children: for the male is equal of the portion of two females."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) mujhse milne aaye paidal Banu Salama mein, aur mujhe behosh paaya. Unhone (Nabi ne) paani mangwaaya aur wuzu kiya aur usmein se (paani) mujhpar chhidka. Mujhe rahat mehsoos hui. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe apni maal ke saath kya karna chahiye? Aur ye aayat nazil hui: "Allah tumhe tumhare bachchon ke baare mein hukum deta hai: mard ke liye do auraton ke barabar hissa hai."

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: While I had been ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me and Abu akr (Allah be pleased with him) was with him, and they both came walking on foot. He (the Holy Prophet) found me unconscious. Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution and then sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I felt relieved regained my consciousness) and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there. I said: Allah's Messenger, what should I do with my property? He gave me no reply until the verse (iv. 177) relating to the law of inheritance was revealed.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab main bimaar tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye aur Abu Bakr (RA) unke saath the, aur donon paidal chalkar aaye. Unhone (Nabi ne) mujhe behosh paaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur phir mujhpar apne wuzu ka paani chhidka. Mujhe rahat mehsoos hui (hosh mein aaya) aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wahan paaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe apni maal ke saath kya karna chahiye? Unhone mujhe koi jawaab nahi diya jab tak aayat (4:177) virasat ke qaanoon se mutalliq nazil nahi hui.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whilo I was ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me and found me unconscious. He (the Holy Prophet) performed ablution, and sprinkled over me the water of his ablution. I regained my consciousness and said: Allah's Messenger, my case of inheritance is that of Kalala. Then the verse pertaining to the inheritance ( of Kalala) was revealed. I (one of the narrators) said: I said to Muhammad b. Munkadir: (Do you mean this verse)" They ask you; say: Allah gives you decision in regard to Kalala" (iv. 177)? He said: Yes, it was thus revealed.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab main bimaar tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur mujhe behosh paaya. Unhone (Nabi ne) wuzu kiya, aur mujhpar apne wuzu ka paani chhidka. Main hosh mein aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera virasat ka maamla Kalala jaisa hai. Phir virasat (Kalala ki) se mutalliq aayat nazil hui. Maine (ek raawi ne) kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Munkadir se kaha: (Kya aapka matlab ye aayat hai) "Woh aapse poochhte hain; kaho: Allah tumhe Kalala ke baare mein faisla deta hai" (4:177)? Unhone kaha: Haan, ye isi tarah nazil hui.

e: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Talha reported: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) delivered a sermon on Friday and made a mention of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he also made a mention of Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) and then said: I do not leave behind me any problem more difficult than that of Kalala. I did not refer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) more repeatedly than in case of the problem of Kalala, and he (the Holy Prophet) never showed more annoyance to me than in regard to this problem, so much so that he struck my chest with his fingers and said: 'Umar, does the verse revealed in summer season, at the end of Sura al-Nisa' not suffice you? Hadrat 'Umar (then) said: If I live I would give such verdict about (Kalala) that everyone would be able to decide whether he reads the Qur'an or he does not.
hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya: Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne juma ke din khutba diya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka zikr kiya aur unhone Abu Bakr (RA) ka bhi zikr kiya aur phir kaha: Main apne peeche Kalala se zyada mushkil koi samasya nahi chhod raha. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kisi doosre maamle se zyada baar Kalala ke maamle ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone (Nabi ne) is maamle mein kabhi mujhpar itni napasandeegi nahi dikhaayi jitni ismein dikhaayi, itni ki unhone apni ungliyon se mera seena thoka aur kaha: Umar, kya Sura al-Nisa ke aakhir mein garmiyon ke mausam mein nazil hui aayat tumhare liye kaafi nahi hai? Hazrat Umar ne (phir) kaha: Agar main zinda raha to main Kalala ke baare mein aisa fatwa dunga ki har koi faisla kar sakega chahe woh Quran padhta ho ya na padhta ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the last verse revealed in the Holy Qur'an is: " They ask thee for a religious verdict; say: Allah gives you a religious verdict about Kalala (the person who has neither parents nor children)" (iv 177).
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quran mein sabse aakhri nazil hui aayat ye hai: "Woh aapse mazhabi fatwa poochhte hain; kaho: Allah tumhe Kalala (jiske na maa-baap hain na bachche) ke baare mein mazhabi fatwa deta hai" (4:177).

e: Abu Ishaq said that he heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib (Allah be pleased with him say: The last verse revealed (in the Holy Quran) is that pertaining to Kalala, and the last sura revealed is Sura al-Bara'at.
hi: Abu Ishaq ne kaha ki unhone al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Quran mein sabse aakhri nazil hui aayat Kalala se mutalliq hai, aur sabse aakhri surah jo nazil hui woh Sura al-Bara'at hai.

e: Abu Ishaq said that he heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib (Allah be pleased with him) say: The last complete sura revealed (in the Holy Qur'an) is Sura Tauba (i e. al-Bara'at, ix.), and the last verse revealed is that pertaining to Kalala.
hi: Abu Ishaq ne kaha ki unhone al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Quran mein sabse aakhri poori surah jo nazil hui woh Sura Tauba hai (yaani al-Bara'at, 9), aur sabse aakhri nazil hui aayat Kalala se mutalliq hai.

e: Aba Ishaq reported this hadith on the authority of al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) with a slight variation of words, viz. the last sura that was revealed complete.
hi: Aba Ishaq ne ye hadees al-Bara (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki, yaani sabse aakhri poori nazil hui surah.

e: Al-Bara' (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the last verse revealed was: " They ask of thee religious verdict.." (iv. 177).
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya ki sabse aakhri nazil hui aayat thi: "Woh aapse mazhabi fatwa poochhte hain.." (4:177).

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when the body of a dead person having burden of debt upon him was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he would ask whether he had left property enough to clear off his debt, and if the property left had been sufficient for that (purpose), he observed funeral prayer for him, otherwise he said (to his companions): You observe prayer for your companion. But when Allah opened the gateways of victory for him, he said: I am nearer to the believers than themselves, so if anyone dies leaving a debt, its payment is my responsibility, and if anyone leaves a property, it goes to his heirs.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab kisi murda shakhs ki laash jiske paas karza tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi jaati woh poochte ki kya usne itni maal chhodi hai jo uske karze ko chukaane ke liye kaafi ho, aur agar chhodi hui maal iske liye kaafi hoti, to woh uske liye janaaza namaz padhte, warna woh (apne sahaba se) kehte: Tum apne saathi ke liye namaz padho. Lekin jab Allah ne unke liye fatah ke darwaze khole, unhone kaha: Main momino ke khud se bhi zyada qareeb hoon, is liye agar koi karza chhodkar mar jaata hai, uska bhugtaan meri zimmedaari hai, aur agar koi maal chhodta hai, woh uske waarison ko jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Zuhri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees al-Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abn Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said this: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, there is no believer on the earth with whom I am not the nearest among all the people. He who amongst you (dies) and leaves a debt, I am there to pay it, and he who amongst you (dies) leaving behind children I am there to look after them. And he who amongst You leaves behind property, that is for the inheritor whoever he is.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, zameen par koi momin nahi hai jiske sabse zyada qareeb main na hoon sab logon mein se. Jo tum mein se (marta hai) aur karza chhodta hai, main use chukaane ke liye hoon, aur jo tum mein se (marta hai) apne peeche bachche chhodta hai main unki dekhbhaal karne ke liye hoon. Aur jo tum mein se maal chhodta hai, ye waaris ke liye hai chahe woh koi bhi ho.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us from Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). And he narrated many ahadith, and one was this: Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him said: I am, according to the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, nearest to the believers of all the human beings. So whoever amongst you dies in debt or leaves behind destitute children, you should call me (for help) ), for I am his guardian. And who amongst you leaves property, his inheritor is entitled to get it, whoever he is.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira (RA) ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur unhone bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin, aur ek ye thi: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main, Allah ki Kitaab, Buland-o-Azeem, ke mutabik, sab insaanon mein se momino ke sabse qareeb hoon. To jo bhi tum mein se karza mein mar jaaye ya apne peeche laachaar bachche chhode, tumhe mujhe bulaana chahiye (madad ke liye), kyunki main uska sarparast hoon. Aur jo tum mein se maal chhode, uska waaris usse paane ka haqdaar hai, chahe woh koi bhi ho.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who leaves property, that is for the inheritors; and he who leaves behind destitute children, then it is my responsibility (to look after them).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo maal chhodta hai, woh waaris ke liye hai; aur jo laachaar bachche chhodkar mar jaata hai, to (unki dekhbhaal karna) meri zimmedaari hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I donated a pedigree horse in the path of Allah. Its possessor made it languish. I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price. I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he said: Don't buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog who swallows its vomit.
hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine ek acchi nasl ka ghoda Allah ki raah mein sadqa diya. Uske maalik ne use kamzor kar diya. Maine socha ki woh use sasti keemat mein bechega. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ise mat khareedo aur apna sadaqa wapas mat lo, kyunki jo sadaqa wapas leta hai woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti nigal jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Malik b. Anas with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " Don't buy that even if he gives you for one dirham."
hi: Ye hadees Malik bin Anas ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Ise mat khareedo chahe woh ise ek dirham mein de."

e: Zaid b. Aslam reported on the authority of his father that 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) donated a horse in the path of Allah. He found that it had languished in the hand of its possessor, and he was a man of meagre resources He (Hadrat 'Umar) intended to buy it. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Don't buy that even if you get it for a dirham for he who gets back the charity is like a dog which swallows its vomit.
hi: Zaid bin Aslam ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Umar (RA) ne Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda sadqa diya. Unhone paaya ki ye uske maalik ke haath mein kamzor ho gaya, aur woh ek kam saadhan waala shakhs tha. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) use khareedne ka iraada kiya. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ise mat khareedo chahe tumhe ye ek dirham mein mile kyunki jo sadaqa wapas leta hai woh us kutte jaisa hai jo apni ulti nigal jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters but with this (change) that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Malik and Rauh (he was the son of Qisirn) is more complete and lengthy.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is (tabdeeli) ke saath ki Malik aur Rauh (jo Qisirn ke bete the) ki riwayat ki hui hadees zyada mukammal aur lambi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar b. al-Khattib (Allah be pleased with him) donated a horse in the path of Allah and (later on) he found it being sold, and he decided to buy that. He asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. whereupon he (the Holy prophet) said: Don't buy that and do not get back what you gave in charity.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) ne Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda sadqa diya aur (baad mein) unhone paaya ki use becha ja raha hai, aur unhone use khareedne ka faisla kiya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ise mat khareedo aur jo tumne sadaqe mein diya use wapas mat lo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim reported from Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that 'Umar donated a horse in the path of Allah and then found it being sold, and he decided to buy that. He asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Umar, do not get back what you gave as charity.
hi: Salim ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Umar ne Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda sadqa diya aur phir paaya ki use becha ja raha hai, aur unhone use khareedne ka faisla kiya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Umar, jo tumne sadaqe mein diya use wapas mat lo.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said this: He who gets back his charity is like a dog which vomits, and then returns to that and eats it.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo apna sadaqa wapas leta hai woh us kutte jaisa hai jo ulti karta hai, aur phir usi ki taraf wapas jaata hai aur use khaata hai.

e: This hadith is also reported through another chain.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Muhammad son of Fatima (Allah be pleased with her) daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Muhammad, jo Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Allah ke Rasool ki beti) ke bete the, ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: The similitude of one who gives a charity and then gets it back is like that of a dog which vomits and then eats its vomit.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi sadaqa deta hai aur phir use wapas leta hai uski misaal us kutte jaisi hai jo ulti karta hai aur phir apni ulti khaata hai.

e: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: One who gets back the gift is like one who eats vomit.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi tohfa wapas leta hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo ulti khaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Tawus reported on the authority of his father who reported from Ibn Abas (Allah be pleased with them) who reported from Allah's Messenger 'may peace be upon him) that he said: One who gets back his gift is like a dog which vomits and then swallows that vomit.
hi: Abdullah bin Tawus ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone Ibn Abbas (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Jo koi apna tohfa wapas leta hai woh us kutte jaisa hai jo ulti karta hai aur phir woh ulti nigal jaata hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his father brought him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have donated this slave of mine to my son. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you donated to every one of your sons (a slave) like this? He said: No. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: Then take him back.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya ki unke walid unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Maine ye mera ghulam apne bete ko sadqa diya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne apne har ek bete ko is tarah (ek ghulam) sadqa diya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: To use wapas le lo.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: My father brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have donated this slave to my son. whereupon he said: Have you made (such) donation to every one or your sons? He said: No. Thereupon he (the-Holy Prophet) said: Then take him back.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Maine ye ghulam apne bete ko sadqa diya hai. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne (aisa) sadqa apne har ek bete ko diya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To use wapas le lo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with different chains of transmitters and a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon se aur alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his father had donated a slave to him. Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) said: Who is this slave (how have you come to possess it)? Thereupon he (Nu'man b. Bashir) said: My father has donated it to me, whereupon he said: Have all brothers (of yours) been given this gift as given to you? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then return him.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya ki unke waalid ne unhe ek ghulam sadqa diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ghulam kaun hai (tumhe ye kaise mila)? Isper unhone (Nu'man bin Bashir ne) kaha: Mere waalid ne ye mujhe sadqa diya, isper unhone kaha: Kya (tumhare) sab bhaiyon ko ye tohfa diya gaya hai jaisa tumhe diya gaya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To use wapas karo.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: My father donated to me some of his property. My mother Amra bint Rawaha said: I shall not be pleased (with this act) until you make Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a witness to it. My father went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in order to make him the witness of the donation given to me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Have you done the same with every son of yours? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Fear Allah, and observe equity in case of your children. My father returned and got back the gift.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid ne apni kuch maal mujhe sadqa di. Meri maa Amra bint Rawaha ne kaha: Main tab tak santusht nahi hoongi jab tak tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iska gawaah nahi banaate. Mere waalid Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye taaki woh mujhe diye gaye sadqa ke gawaah bane. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kya tumne apne har bete ke saath aisa hi kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Allah se daro, aur apne bachchon ke maamle mein barabri rakho. Mere waalid wapas gaye aur unhone tohfa wapas le liya.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that his mother bint Rawaha asked his (Nu'man's) father about donating some gifts from his property to his son. He deferred the matter by one year, and then set forth to do that. She (Nu'man's mother) said: I shall not be pleased unless you call Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as witness to what you confer as a gift on your son. (Nu'man said): So father took hold of my hand and I was at that time a boy, and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and said: Allah's Messenger, the mother of this son (of mine), daughter of Rawaha wishes that I should call you witness to what I confer as gift to her son. Allah's Messenger (may pease be upon him) said: Bashir, have you any other son besides this (son of yours)? He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given gifts to all of them like this? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then call me not as witness, for I cannot be witness to an injustice.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya ki unki maa bint Rawaha ne unke (Nu'man ke) waalid se apni maal se kuch tohfe apne bete ko dene ke baare mein poocha. Unhone maamla ek saal taal diya, aur phir aisa karne ke liye nikle. Unhone (Nu'man ki maa ne) kaha: Main tab tak santusht nahi hoongi jab tak tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko gawaah nahi banaate us tohfe ke jo tum apne bete ko de rahe ho. (Nu'man ne kaha): To waalid ne mera haath pakda aur main us waqt ek bacha tha, aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere is bete (ki) maa, Rawaha ki beti, chahti hain ki main aapko gawaah banaaun us tohfe ka jo main apne bete ko de raha hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Bashir, kya tumhare is bete ke ilawa koi aur bete hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne unhe sab ko is tarah tohfe diye hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: To mujhe gawaah mat banao, kyunki main ek anyaay ka gawaah nahi ban sakta.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir, reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Have you, besides him, other sons? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given gifts to all of them like this (as you have given to Nu'man)? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: I cannot bear witness to an injustice.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Kya tumhare paas iske ilawa aur bete hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne sab ko aise hi tohfe diye hain (jaisa tumne Nu'man ko diya hai)? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Main ek anyaay ka gawaah nahi ban sakta.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his father: Call me not as witness to an injustice.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke waalid se kaha: Mujhe anyaay ka gawaah mat banao.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir (Allah be pleased with them) reported: My father took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, bear witness that I have given such and such gift to Nu'man from my property, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you conferred upon all of your sons as you have conferred upon Nu'man? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Call someone else besides me as a witness. And he further said: Would it, please you that they (your children) should all behave virtuously towards you? He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then don't do that (i e. don't give gift to one to the exclusion of others).
