hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gawaah rahiye ki maine aisa aisa tohfa Nu'man ko apni maal se diya hai, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne apne saare beton ko waisa hi diya hai jaisa tumne Nu'man ko diya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Mere ilawa kisi doosre ko gawaah banao. Aur unhone aage kaha: Kya tumhe pasand aayega ki woh (tumhare bachche) sab tumhare saath achhe se pesh aayein? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: To aisa mat karo (yaani ek ko doosron se alag karke tohfa mat do).

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: My father conferred a gift upon me, and then brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to make him a witness (to it). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Have you given such gift to every son of yours (as you have given to Nu'man)? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't you expect goodness from them as you expect from him? He said: Yes. of course. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I am not going to bear witness to it (as it is injustice). Ibn Aun (one of the narrators) said: I narrated this hadith to Muhammad (the other narrator) who said: Verily we narrated that lie (the Holy Prophet) had said: Observe equity amongst your children.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid ne mujhe ek tohfa diya, aur phir mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye taaki woh iske gawaah bane. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne apne har bete ko aisa hi tohfa diya hai (jaisa tumne Nu'man ko diya hai)? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum unse achhaai ki ummeed nahi rakhte jaise tum ismein (Nu'man se) rakhte ho? Unhone kaha: Haan, bilkul. Unhone kaha: Main iska gawaah nahi banunga (kyunki ye anyaay hai). Ibn Aun (ek raawi) ne kaha: Maine ye hadees Muhammad (doosre raawi) ko riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Yaqeenan humne riwayat ki ki unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Apne bachchon ke beech barabri rakho.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that the wife of Bashir said (to her husband): Give to my son your slave as a gift, and make for me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a witness He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: The daughter of so and so (his wife Amra bint Rawaha) asked me to give my slave as a gift to her son, and call for me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a witness. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has he (Nu'man) brothers? He (Bashir) said: Yes. He (further) said: Have you given to all others as you have given to him? He said: No. He said: Then it is not fair; and verily I cannot bear witness but only to what is just.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Bashir ki zauja ne (apne shohar se) kaha: Mere bete ko apna ghulam tohfe mein do, aur mere liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko gawaah banaao. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Falan-falan ki beti (unki zauja Amra bint Rawaha) ne mujhse kaha ki main apna ghulam apne bete ko tohfe mein dun, aur unke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko gawaah banaaun. Isper unhone kaha: Kya unke (Nu'man ke) bhai hain? Unhone (Bashir ne) kaha: Haan. Unhone (aage) kaha: Kya tumne baaki sab ko waisa hi diya hai jaisa tumne unhe diya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: To ye theek nahi hai; aur yaqeenan main sirf uski hi gawaahi de sakta hoon jo insaaf ho.

e:
Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: "Any man who is given a
gift for life, it belongs to him and
his heirs. It belongs to the one to
whom it is given, and does not go
back to the one who gave it,
because he has given it in such a
way that it is subject to the rules
of inheritance."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Jis kisi shakhs ko zindagi-bhar ke liye koi tohfa diya jaata hai, ye uska aur uske waarison ka ho jaata hai. Ye us shakhs ka hai jise ye diya gaya hai, aur ye us shakhs ke paas wapas nahi jaata jisne ise diya, kyunki usne ise is tarah diya hai ki ye virasat ke qawaid ke adheen ho jaata hai."

e: Jaber b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upan him) as saying: He who conferred a life grant upon a person, it becomes his possession and that of his successors, for he surrendered his right in that by his declaration. (This property) now belongs to one to whom this lifelong grant has been made, and to his successors. Yahya narrated in the beginning of his narration: Whatever man is given a life grant, then it belongs to him and his posterity.
hi: Jaber bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne kisi shakhs ko zindagi-bhar ke liye koi tohfa diya, ye uski aur uske uttaradhikariyon ki malkiyat ban jaata hai, kyunki usne apni elan se usme apna haq soonp diya. (Ye maal) ab uski hai jise ye zindagi-bhar ka tohfa diya gaya hai, aur uske uttaradhikariyon ki. Yahya ne apni riwayat ki shuruaat mein bataya: Jis kisi shakhs ko zindagi-bhar ka tohfa diya jaata hai, to ye uska aur uski aulaad ka hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever a person conferred Umra (life grant) upon a person and he says: I confer upon you this and upon your descendants and anyone who survives you, and that becomes his possession and that of his posterity. It would become (a permanent possession) of those who were conferred upon this gift, and it would not return to its owner (donor), for he gave that as a gift in which accrued the right of inheritance.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab bhi koi shakhs kisi doosre ko Umra (zindagi-bhar ka tohfa) deta hai aur kehta hai: Main ye tumhe aur tumhari aulaad ko, aur tumse jo bhi zinda rahe, deta hoon, to ye uski aur uski aulaad ki malkiyat ban jaata hai. Ye un logon ki (sthaayi malkiyat) ban jaayega jinhe ye tohfa diya gaya, aur ye apne asal maalik (dene wale) ke paas wapas nahi aayega, kyunki usne ise tohfe mein diya jismein virasat ka haq bhi shaamil ho gaya.

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) said: The Umra for which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave sanction that a person way say: This (property) is for you and for your descendants. And when he said: That is for you as long as you live, then it will return to its owner (after the death of the donee). Ma'mar said: Zuhri used to give religious verdict according to this.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Umra jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne swikriti di woh ye hai ki koi shakhs keh sakta hai: Ye (maal) tumhare liye aur tumhari aulaad ke liye hai. Aur jab woh kahe: Ye tumhare liye hai jab tak tum zinda ho, to ye (donee ki maut ke baad) apne maalik ke paas wapas chala jaayega. Ma'mar ne kaha: Zuhri isi ke mutabik mazhabi fatwa dete the.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that whoever is conferred upon a life grant along with his descendants is entitled to make use of the property conferred so long as he lives and his successors (also enjoy this privilege). That (property) becomes the their defect belonging. The donor cannot (after declaring Umra) lay down any condition or make any exception. Abu Salama said: For he conferred a grant and as such it becomes heritage. and the right of inheritance abrogated his condition.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki jise bhi zindagi-bhar ka tohfa uski aulaad ke saath diya jaata hai woh us diye gaye maal ka istemal karne ka haq rakhta hai jab tak woh zinda hai aur uske uttaradhikari bhi (is suvidha ka aanand lete rahenge). Ye maal unhi ki ho jaati hai. Tohfa dene wala (Umra ka ailaan karne ke baad) koi shart ya apwaad nahi rakh sakta. Abu Salama ne kaha: Kyunki usne ek tohfa diya aur is tarah ye virasat ban gayi, aur virasat ke haq ne uski shart ko radd kar diya.

e: Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Life grant is for one upon whom it is bestowed.
hi: Jabir (bin Abdullah) (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zindagi-bhar ka tohfa usi ka hai jise ye diya jaata hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Jabir reported this hadith directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
hi: Jabir ne ye hadees seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Keep your property to yourselves and do not squander it, for he who conferred a life grant upon another that property will belong to him upon whom it is conferred whether he lives or dies, and (would pass on) to his successors (as heritage).
hi: Jabir (bin Abdullah) (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apni maal apne paas rakho aur use bekaar mat gawaao, kyunki jisne kisi doosre ko zindagi-bhar ka tohfa diya, woh maal usi ki hogi jise ye diya gaya hai chahe woh zinda rahe ya mar jaaye, aur (aage jaayegi) uske uttaradhikariyon (virasat ke soorat mein).

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Jabir through other chains of transmitters, but (with this addition of words) that thehadith transmitted on the authority of Ayyub (these words are found): " The Helpers (Ansar) conferred the benefit of 'Umra, upon the Emigrants (Muhajirin), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Keep your property to yourselves.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin (alfaazon ke is izafe ke saath) ki Ayyub ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (ye alfaaz milte hain): "Madad karne walon (Ansar) ne Umra ka faayda Muhajirin ko diya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apni maal apne paas rakho."

e: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a woman gave her garden as a life grant to her son. He died and later on she also died and left a son behind and brothers also, The sons of the woman making life grant said (to those who had been conferred upon this 'Umra): This garden has returned to us. The sons of the one who had been given life grant said: This belonged to our father, during his lifetime and in case of his death. They took their dispute to Tariq, the freed slave of 'Uthman. He called Jabir and he gave testimony of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Life grant belongs to one who is conferred upon this (privilege). Tariq gave this decision and then wrote to Abd al-Malik and informed him, Jabir bearing witness to it. Abd al-Malik said: Jabir has told the truth. Then Tariq gave a decree and, as a result thereof, it is to this day that the garden belongs to descendants of one who was conferred upon the life grant.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat ne apna baag apne bete ko zindagi-bhar ke tohfe ke soorat mein diya. Woh mar gaya aur baad mein woh (aurat) bhi mar gayi aur apne peeche ek bete aur bhaiyon ko chhod gayi. Us aurat ke betoon ne (jinhone Umra diya tha) kaha: Ye baag humein wapas mil gaya hai. Us shakhs ke betoon ne jise zindagi-bhar ka tohfa diya gaya tha kaha: Ye humare waalid ka tha, unke zindagi kaal mein aur unki maut ke waqt bhi. Woh apna jhagda Tariq, Uthman ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ke paas le gaye. Unhone Jabir ko bulaaya aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ye kehte hue gawaahi di: Zindagi-bhar ka tohfa usi ka hota hai jise ye suvidha di jaati hai. Tariq ne ye faisla diya aur phir Abd al-Malik ko likha aur unhe bataaya, Jabir isi ki gawaahi de rahe the. Abd al-Malik ne kaha: Jabir ne sach kaha. Phir Tariq ne ek hukum diya aur uske natije ke soorat mein, aaj tak ye baag jise zindagi-bhar ka tohfa diya gaya tha uski aulaad ka hai.

e: Sulaiman b. Yasir reported that Jabir gave this verdict. The inheritor has a right (to inherit) the life grant according to the statement of Jabir (b. 'Abdullah) (Allah be pleased with him) which he narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasir ne bayan kiya ki Jabir ne ye fatwa diya. Waaris ko zindagi-bhar ke tohfe ka haq hai Jabir (bin Abdullah) (RA) ke bayaan ke mutabik jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Life grant is permissible.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zindagi-bhar ka tohfa jaayez hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Life grant is the heritage of one upon whom it is conferred.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zindagi-bhar ka tohfa uski virasat hai jise ye diya jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Life grant is permissible.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zindagi-bhar ka tohfa jaayez hai.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is the duty of a Muslim who has something which is to be given as a bequest not to have it for two nights without having his will written down regarding it.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ka jiske paas koi cheez wasiyat mein dene laayak hai, uska farz hai ki woh do raaton se zyada bina apni wasiyat likhwaaye bina na guzaare.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters. but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: A hadith like this have been narrated on the authority of Nafi', who based his narrations of the words of Ibn 'Umar but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Nafi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, jinhone Ibn Umar ke alfaazon par apni riwayat mabni ki lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father ('Abdullah b. Umar) that he (his father) had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not proper for a Muslim who has got something to bequeathe to spend even three nights without having his will written down with him regarding it. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: Ever since I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say this I have not spent a night without having my will (written) along with me.
hi: Salim ne apne walid (Abdullah bin Umar) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unhone (unke walid ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman jiske paas kuch wasiyat mein dene laayak hai, uske liye theek nahi hai ki woh teen raaton se bhi zyada bina apni wasiyat likhwaaye guzaare. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, maine kabhi bhi apni wasiyat apne saath rakhe bina raat nahi guzaari.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father (Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me in my illness which brought me near death in the year of Hajjat-ul-Wada' (Farewell Pilgrimage). I said: Allah's Messenger, you can well see the pain with which I am afflicted and I am a man possessing wealth, and there is none to inherit me except only one daughter. Should I give two-thirds of my property as Sadaqa? He said: No. I said: Should I give half (of my property) as Sadaqa? He said: No. He (further) said: Give one-third (in charity) and that is quite enough. To leave your heirs rich is better than to leave them poor, begging from people; that you would never incur an expense seeking therewith the pleasure of Allah, but you would be rewarded therefor, even for a morsel of food that you put in the mouth of your wife. I said: Allah's Messenger. would I survive my companions? He (the Holy Prophet) said: If you survive them, then do such a deed by means of which you seek the pleasure of Allah, but you would increase in your status (in religion) and prestige; you may survive so that people would benefit from you, and others would be harmed by you. (The Holy Prophet) further said: Allah, complete for my Companions their migration, and not cause them to turn back upon their heels. Sa'd b. Khaula is, however, unfortunate. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt grief for him as he had died in Mecca.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne walid (Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab main bimaar tha, ek aisi beemari jisne mujhe maut ke qareeb pahuncha diya tha, Vida ke Hajj ke saal. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap acchi tarah dekh sakte hain jis dard mein main mubtala hoon aur main daulat rakhne wala aadmi hoon, aur mera waaris sirf ek beti hai. Kya main apni maal ka do-tihai sadaqe mein dun? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Kya main aadha (apni maal ka) sadaqe mein dun? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone aage kaha: Ek-tihai do (sadaqe mein) aur ye kaafi hai. Apne waarison ko daulatmand chhodna unhe gareeb, logon se bheekh maangte hue chhodne se behtar hai; ki tum kabhi bhi koi kharcha Allah ki khushi ke liye kar nahi karoge lekin tumhe iske liye sawaab milega, chahe woh khaane ka ek tukda ho jo tum apni zauja ke muh mein dete ho. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main apne saathiyon se zyada jeevit rahunga? Unhone kaha: Agar tum unse zyada jeevit raho, to aisa amal karo jisse tum Allah ki khushi chaaho, lekin tumhare darje (deen mein) aur izzat mein izafa hoga; tum shayad zinda raho taaki log tumse faayda uthaayein, aur doosron ko tumse nuksaan pahunche. Nabi (SAW) ne aage kaha: Allah, mere sahaba ki hijrat poori kar, aur unhe unke pairon par wapas mat mod. Sa'd bin Khaula, halaanki, badnaseeb the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke liye dukh hua kyunki unka intiqaal Makkah mein hua tha.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported from S'ad (b. Abu Waqqas): Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me to inquire after my health, the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted on the authority of Zuhri, but lie did not make mention of the words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in regard to Sa'd b. Khaula except this that he said:" He (the Holy Prophet) did not like death in the land from which lie had migrated."
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne Sa'd (bin Abu Waqqas) ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mera haal poochhne aaye, baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi, lekin unhone Sa'd bin Khaula ke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: Unhe (Nabi ko) us zameen mein maut pasand nahi thi jahan se unhone hijrat ki thi.

e: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father. I was ailing. I sent message to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying: Permit me to give away my property as I like. He refused. I (again) said: (Permit me) to give away half. He (again refused). I (again said): Then one-third. He (the Holy Prophet) observed silence after (I had asked permission to give away) one-third. He (the narrater) said: It was then that endowment of one-third became permissible.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Main bimaar tha. Maine Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko payaam bheja ye kehte hue: Mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main apni maal jaise chaahun de dun. Unhone inkaar kiya. Maine (dobara) kaha: (Mujhe ijazat dijiye) aadha dene ki. Unhone (phir inkaar kiya). Maine (dobara kaha): To ek-tihai. Unhone khamoshi rakhi (jab maine ek-tihai dene ki ijazat maangi). Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Tab se ek-tihai ka sadqa jaayez hua.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters. But he did not mention: " It was then that one-third became permissible."
hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Tab se ek-tihai jaayez hua."

e: Ibn Sa'd reported his father as saying: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me during my illness. I said: I am willing away the whole of my property. He said: No. I said: Then half? He said: No. I said: Should I will away one-third? He said: Yes, and even one-third is enough.
hi: Ibn Sa'd ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab main bimaar tha. Maine kaha: Main apni poori maal wasiyat mein deta hoon. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Phir aadhi? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Kya main ek-tihai wasiyat mein dun? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur ek-tihai bhi kaafi hai.

e: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari reported from three of the sons of Sa'd all of whom reported from their father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited Sa'd as he was ill in Mecca. He (Sa'd) wept. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What makes you weep? He said: I am afraid I may die in the land from where I migrated as Sa'd b. Khaula had died. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: O Allah, grant health to Sa'd. O Allah, grant health to Sad. He repeated it three times. He (Sa'd) said: Allah's Messenger, I own a large property and I have only one daughter as my inheritor. Should I not will away the whole of my property? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He said: (Should I not will away, ) two-thirds of the property? he (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He (Sa'd) (again) said: (Should I not will away) half (of my property)? He said: No. He (Sa'd) said: Then one-third? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yes), one-third, and one-third is quite substanial. And what you spend as charity from your property is Sadaqa and flour spending on your family is also Sadaqa, and what your wife eats from your property is also Sadaqa, and that you leave your heirs well off (or he said: prospreous) is better than to leave them (poor and) begging from people. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed this with his hands.
hi: Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari ne Sa'd ke teen betoon se riwayat ki jinme se sab ne apne waalid se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) Sa'd se milne gaye jab woh Makkah mein bimaar the. Unhone (Sa'd ne) roya. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Unhone kaha: Mujhe dar hai ki main us zameen mein mar jaaunga jahan se maine hijrat ki, jaisa Sa'd bin Khaula ki maut hui thi. Isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, Sa'd ko sehat de. Aye Allah, Sa'd ko sehat de. Unhone ise teen baar dohraaya. Unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek badi maal hai aur mera sirf ek beti waaris hai. Kya mujhe apni poori maal wasiyat mein nahi deni chahiye? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: (Kya mujhe nahi deni chahiye) apni maal ka do-tihai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone (Sa'd ne dobara) kaha: (Kya mujhe nahi deni chahiye) aadha (apni maal ka)? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: Phir ek-tihai? Isper unhone kaha: (Haan), ek-tihai, aur ek-tihai bahut zyada hai. Aur jo tum apni maal se sadaqe mein kharch karte ho woh sadaqa hai aur apne khaandaan par kharch karna bhi sadaqa hai, aur jo tumhari zauja tumhari maal se khaati hai woh bhi sadaqa hai, aur ki tum apne waarison ko daulatmand chhodo (ya unhone kaha: samriddh) unhe gareeb chhodkar logon se bheekh maangte hue chhodne se behtar hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) apne haathon se iski taraf ishara kiya.

e: Humaid b. Abd al-Rahmin al-Himayri reported on the authority of the three of the sons of Sa'd: They said: Sa'd fell ill in Mecca. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited him to inquire after his health. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Humaid bin Abd al-Rahmin al-Himayri ne Sa'd ke teen betoon ke hawale se riwayat ki: Unhone kaha: Sa'd Makkah mein bimaar pad gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse milne gaye unka haal poochne ke liye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Humaid b. Abd al-Rahman reported this hadith on the authority of three of Sa'd's sons: Sa'd fell ill in Mecca and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited him. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman ne ye hadees Sa'd ke teen betoon ke hawale se riwayat ki: Sa'd Makkah mein bimaar pad gaye aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) unse milne gaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) said: (I wish) if people would reduce from third to fourth (part for making a will of their property), for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: So far as the third (part) is concerned it is quite substantial. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Waki (the words are)" large" or" much".
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: (Main chaahta hoon) ki log ek-tihai se chauthai tak kam kar dein (apni maal ki wasiyat karte waqt), kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak ek-tihai (hisse) ka sawal hai, ye bahut zyada hai. Waki ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain "bada" ya "bahut zyada".

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that a person said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): My father died and left behind property without making any will regarding it. Would he be relieved of the burden of his sins if I give sadaqa on his behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se kaha: Mere waalid ka intiqaal ho gaya aur unhone maal chhodi bina koi wasiyat kiye. Kya unke gunahon ka bojh halka ho jaayega agar main unki taraf se sadaqa dun? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Haan.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a man said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): My mother died all of a sudden, and I think if she (could have the opportunity) to speak she would have (made a will) regarding Sadaqa'. Will I be entitled to reward if I give charity on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se kaha: Meri maa achaanak mar gayi, aur mujhe lagta hai ki agar unhe (bolne ka mauka milta) to woh (sadaqe ke baare mein wasiyat karti). Kya mujhe sawaab milega agar main unki taraf se sadaqa dun? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Haan.

e: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, my mother died all of a sudden without making any will. I think if (she could have the opportunity) to speak she would have made a Sadaqa. Would there be any reward for her if I give charity on her behalf? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri maa achaanak mar gayi bina koi wasiyat kiye. Mujhe lagta hai ki agar (unhe bolne ka mauka milta) to woh sadaqa deti. Kya unhe koi sawaab milega agar main unki taraf se sadaqa dun? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a man dies, his acts come to an end, but three, recurring charity, or knowledge (by which people) benefit, or a pious son, who prays for him (for the deceased).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi aadmi marta hai, uske amal khatm ho jaate hain, siwaay teen ke: jaari sadaqa, ya ilm jisse log faayda uthaayein, ya ek nek beta, jo uske (marne wale ke) liye dua kare.

e: Ibn Umar reported: Umar acquired a land at Khaibar. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought his advice in regard to it. He said: Allah's Messenger, I have acquired land in Khaibar. I have never acquired property more valuable for me than this, so what do you command me to do with it? Thereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: If you like, you may keep the corpus intact and give its produce as Sadaqa. So 'Umar gave it as Sadaqa declaring that property must not be sold or inherited or given away as gift. And Umar devoted it to the poor, to the nearest kin, and to the emancipation of slaves, aired in the way of Allah and guests. There is no sin for one, who administers it if he eats something from it in a reasonable manner, or if he feeds his friends and does not hoard up goods (for himself). He (the narrator) said: I narrated this hadith to Muhammad, but as I reached the (words)" without hoarding (for himself) out of it." he (Muhammad' said:" without storing the property with a view to becoming rich." Ibn 'Aun said: He who read this book (pertaining to Waqf) informed me that in it (the words are)" without storing the property with a view to becoming rich."
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Umar ne Khaibar mein zameen haasil ki. Woh Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur iske baare mein unse salaah maangi. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine Khaibar mein zameen haasil ki hai. Maine kabhi meri liye isse zyada keemati koi maal haasil nahi ki, is liye aap mujhe iske baare mein kya karne ka hukum dete hain? Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Agar tum chaho, to tum asal maal barkarar rakh sakte ho aur uski upaj sadaqe mein de sakte ho. To Umar ne ise sadaqe mein diya, ye ailaan karte hue ki maal na becha jaana chahiye, na virasat mein diya jaana chahiye aur na hi tohfe mein diya jaana chahiye. Aur Umar ne ise gareebon ke liye, sabse qareebi rishtedaaron ke liye, aur ghulamon ki azaadi ke liye, Allah ki raah mein aur mehmaanon ke liye samarpit kiya. Isme koi gunah nahi hai us shakhs ke liye jo iska intezam karta hai agar woh isme se kuch munasib tarike se khaaye, ya agar woh apne dosto ko khilaaye aur (apne liye) saamaan jama na kare. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine ye hadees Muhammad ko riwayat ki, lekin jab main is alfaaz tak pahuncha "bina isme se (apne liye) jama kiye," unhone (Muhammad ne) kaha: "bina daulatmand banne ke iraade se maal jama kiye." Ibn Aun ne kaha: Jisne ye kitaab (Waqf se mutalliq) padhi usne mujhe bataya ki ismein (alfaaz hain) "bina daulatmand banne ke iraade se maal jama kiye."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Aun with the same chain of transmitters up to the words: " Or he may feed the friend withoiut hoarding from it" and he made no mention of what follows.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Aun ki sanad se isi sanad se in alfaazon tak riwayat ki gayi hai: "Ya woh apne dost ko bina isme se jama kiye khilaaye," aur unhone iske baad ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'Umar reported: I acquired land from the lands of Khaibar. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have acquired a piece of land. Never have I acquired land more loved by me and more cherished by me than this. The rest of the hadith is the same, but he made no mention of this:" I narrated it to Muhammad" and what follows.
hi: Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine Khaibar ki zameenon mein se zameen haasil ki. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine ek zameen ka tukda haasil kiya hai. Maine kabhi koi zameen isse zyada aziz aur isse zyada pasand nahi haasil ki. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya: "Maine ise Muhammad ko riwayat ki" aur uske baad ki baat.

e: Talha b. Musarrif reported: I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made any will (in regard to his property). He said: NO. I said: Then why has making of will been made necessary for the Muslims, or why were they commanded to make will? Thereupon he said: He made the will according to the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic.
hi: Talha bin Musarrif ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni maal ke baare mein koi wasiyat ki. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: To phir Musalmaanon ke liye wasiyat karna kyun zaroori kiya gaya, ya unhe wasiyat karne ka hukum kyun diya gaya? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone Allah ki Kitaab, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ke mutabik wasiyat ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Malik b. Mighwal with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words. In the hadith related by Waki (the words are)" I said: How the people have been ordered about the will" ; and in the hadith of Ibn Numair (the words are):" How the will has been prescribed for the Muslims, '.
hi: Ye hadees Malik bin Mighwal ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Waki ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Maine kaha: Logon ko wasiyat ke baare mein kaise hukum diya gaya hai"; aur Ibn Numair ki hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Musalmaanon ke liye wasiyat kaise muqarrar ki gayi hai."

e: A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left neither dinar nor dirham (wealth in the form of cash), nor goats (and sheep), nor camels. And he made no will about anything (in regard to his material possessions, as he had none),
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne na dinar chhoda na dirham (naqad soorat mein daulat), na bakriyaan (aur bhedein), na oont. Aur unhone kisi bhi cheez ke baare mein koi wasiyat nahi ki (apni dunyawi maal ke baare mein, kyunki unke paas koi thi hi nahi).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Aswad b. Yazid reported: It was mentioned before A'isha that will had been made (by the Holy Prophet) in favour of 'Ali (as the Prophet's first caliph), whereupon she said: When did he make will in his favour? I had been providing support to him (to the Holy Prophet) with my chest (or with my lap). He asked for a tray, when he fell in my lap (relaxing his body), and I did not realise that he had breathed his last. When did he make any will in his ('Ali's) favour?
hi: Aswad bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Aisha ke saamne ye zikr hua ki (Nabi ke ke zariye) Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke haq mein wasiyat ki gayi thi (Nabi ke pehle khalifa ke soorat mein), isper unhone kaha: Unhone kab unke haq mein wasiyat ki? Main unhe (Nabi ko) apne seene (ya apni god) se sahaara de rahi thi. Unhone ek thaali maangi, jab woh mere god mein gir gaye (apna badan aaram dete hue), aur mujhe ehsaas nahi hua ki unhone aakhri saans li thi. Unhone kab unke (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke) haq mein koi wasiyat ki?

e:
Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: Thursday, (and then said): What is this Thursday? He then wept so much that his tears moistened the pebbles. I said: Ibn 'Abbas, what is (significant) about Thursday? He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: The illness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a serious turn (on this day), and he said: Come to me, so that I should write for you a document that you may not go astray after me. They (the Companions around him) disputed, and it is not meet to dispute in the presence of the Apostle. They said: How is lie (Allah's Apostle)? Has he lost his consciousness? Try to learn from him (this point). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Leave me. I am better in the state (than the one in which you are engaged). I make a will about three things: Turn out the polytheists from the territory of Arabia; show hospitality to the (foreign) delegations as I used to show them hospitality. He (the narrator) said: He (Ibn Abbas) kept silent on the third point, or he (the narrator) said: But I forgot that.

This hadith was mentioned through another chain.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Guruwaar (aur phir kaha): Ye guruwaar kya hai? Woh phir itna roye ki unke aansuon ne kankariyon ko geela kar diya. Maine kaha: Ibn Abbas, guruwaar ke baare mein kya khaas baat hai? Unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beemari ne sangin mod le liya (is din), aur unhone kaha: Mere paas aao, taaki main tumhare liye ek dastaavez likh sakoon jisse tum mere baad gumraah na ho. Unhone (unke aas-paas ke sahaba ne) asahmati jataayi, aur Rasool ki maujoodgi mein asahmati jataana theek nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Unhe (Allah ke Rasool ko) kya hua hai? Kya woh apna hosh kho baithe hain? Unse (ye baat) jaanne ki koshish karo. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Mujhe chhod do. Main us haalat mein (jismein tum masroof ho) usse behtareen haalat mein hoon. Main teen cheezon ke baare mein wasiyat karta hoon: Mushrikeen ko Arabia ke ilaake se nikaal do; (foreign) numainda mandalon ka mehmaannawaazi karo jaisa main unki karta tha. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) teesri baat par khamoshi rakhi, ya unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Lekin main use bhool gaya. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi zikr ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported from Ibn Abbas that he said: Thursday, and what about Thursday? Then tears began to flow until I saw them on his cheeks as it they were the strings of pearls. He (the narrator) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Bring me a shoulder blade and ink-pot (or tablet and inkpot), so that I write for you a document (by following which) you would never go astray. They said: Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) is in the state of unconsciousness.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Guruwaar, aur guruwaar ke baare mein kya (khaas baat) hai? Phir aansu behne lage yahan tak ki maine unhe unke gaalon par dekha jaise woh moti ki maalayen hon. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mere paas kandhe ki haddi aur syaahi ka thaila (ya takhti aur syaahi ka thaila) laao, taaki main tumhare liye ek dastaavez likh sakoon (jise follow karke) tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) beIhoshi ki haalat mein hain.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to leave this world, there were persons (around him) in his house, 'Umar b. al-Kbattab being one of them. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Come, I may write for you a document; you would not go astray after that. Thereupon Umar said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is deeply afflicted with pain. You have the Qur'an with you. The Book of Allah is sufficient for us. Those who were present in the house differed. Some of them said: Bring him (the writing material) so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may write a document for you and you would never go astray after him And some among them said what 'Umar had (already) said. When they indulged in nonsense and began to dispute in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said: Get up (and go away) 'Ubaidullah said: Ibn Abbas used to say: There was a heavy loss, indeed a heavy loss, that, due to their dispute and noise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) could not write (or dictate) the document for them.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is duniya se jaane hi waale the, unke ghar mein (unke aas-paas) kuch log the, Umar bin al-Khattab bhi unmein se ek the. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Aao, main tumhare liye ek dastaavez likh sakoon; tum uske baad gumraah nahi hoge. Isper Umar ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dard se bahut pareshaan hain. Tumhare paas Quran hai. Allah ki Kitaab humare liye kaafi hai. Ghar mein maujood logon mein mat-bhinnata thi. Unmein se kuchne kaha: Unhe (likhne ka saamaan) laao taaki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumhare liye ek dastaavez likh sakein aur tum unke baad kabhi gumraah nahi honge. Aur unmein se kuchne wahi kaha jo Umar ne pehle hi kaha tha. Jab unhone bekaar baaton mein lipatna aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein jhagdaana shuru kiya, unhone kaha: Utho (aur chale jao). Ubaidullah ne kaha: Ibn Abbas kaha karte the: Ye ek bhaari nuksaan tha, waaqai ek bhaari nuksaan, ki unke jhagde aur shor-sharaabe ki wajah se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke liye dastaavez likh (ya bataa) na sake.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Sa'd b. Ubida asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a decision about a vow taken by his mother who had died before fulfilling it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Fulfil it on her behalf.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Ubada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni maa ki li hui ek mannat ke baare mein faisla poocha jo unhone use poora karne se pehle hi mar gayi thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unki taraf se use poora karo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) singled out one day forbidding us to take vows and said: It would not avert anything; it is by which something is extracted from the miserly person.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din humein mannat lene se mana karne ke liye khaas taur par nikaala aur kaha: Ye kuch bhi nahi hataata; ismein se kanjoos shakhs se kuch nikalwaaya jaata hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The vow neither hastens anything nor defers anything, but is the means whereby (something) is extracted from the miserly person.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mannat na kisi cheez ko jaldi laati hai na kisi cheez ko taalti hai, lekin ye zariya hai jismein se (kuch) kanjoos shakhs se nikalwaaya jaata hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (people) taking vows, and said: It does not (necessarily) bring good (in the form of substantial, and tangible results), but it is the meant whereby something is extracted from the miserly persons.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (logon ko) mannat lene se mana kiya, aur kaha: Ye (zaroori taur par) achhaai (thos aur mahsoos parinaamon ke soorat mein) nahi laati, lekin ye zariya hai jismein se kuch kanjoos logon se nikalwaaya jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Heraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not take vows, for a vow has no effect against Fate; it is only from the miserly that something is extracted.
hi: Abu Heraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mannat mat lo, kyunki mannat ka bhagya ke khilaaf koi asar nahi hota; ismein se sirf kanjoos se hi kuch nikalwaaya jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding taking of vows, and said: It does not avert Fate, but is the means by which something is extracted from the miser.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mannat lene se mana karte suna, aur kaha: Ye bhagya ko nahi taalti, lekin ye zariya hai jismein se kanjoos se kuch nikalwaaya jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The vow does not bring anything near to the son of Adam which Allah has not ordained for him, but (at times) the vow coincides with Destiny, and this is how something is extracted from the miserly person, which that miser was not willing to give.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mannat Aadam ke bete ke qareeb koi aisi cheez nahi laati jo Allah ne uske liye muqarrar nahi ki, lekin (kabhi kabhi) mannat Taqdeer se mel khaati hai, aur isi tarah kanjoos shakhs se kuch nikalwaaya jaata hai, jo woh kanjoos dena nahi chaahta tha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amr b. Abu 'Amr.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Abu Amr ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Imran b. Husain reported that the tribe of Thaqif was the ally of Banu 'Uqail. Thaqif took two persons from amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as prisoners. The Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took one person at Banu Uqail as prisoner, and captured al-'Adbi (the she-camel of the Holy Prophet) along with him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and he was tied with ropes. He said: Muhammad. He came near him and said: What is the matter with you? Thereupon he (the prisoner) said: Why have you taken me as prisoner and why have you caught hold of one proceeding the pilgrims (the she-camel as she carried the Prophet on her back and walked ahead of the multitude)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yours is a great fault). I (my men) have caught hold of you for the crime of your allies, Banu Thaqif. He (the Holy Prophet) then turned away. He again called him and said: Muhammad, Muhammad, and since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was very compassionate, and tenderhearted, he returned to him, and said: What is the matter with you? He said: I am a Muslim, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Had you said this when you had been the master of yourself, you would have gained every success. He then turned away. He (the prisoner) called him again saying: Muhammad, Muhammad. He came to him and said: What is the matter with you? He said: I am hungry, feed me, and I am thirsty, so provide me with drink. He (the Holy Prophet) said: That is (to satisfy) your want. He was then ransomed for two persons (who had been taken prisoner by Thaqif). He (the narrator) said: A woman of the Ansar had been taken prisoner and also al-Adbi' was caught. The woman had been tied with ropes. The people were giving rest to their animals before their houses. She escaped one night from the bondage and came to the camels. As she drew near the camels, they fretted and fumed and so she left them until she came to al-, Adbi'. It did not fret and fume; it was docile She rode upon its back and drove it away and she went off. When they (the enemies of Islam) were warned of this, they went in search of it, but it (the she-camel) exhausted them. She (the woman) took vow for Allah, that in case He would save her through it, she would offer that as a sacrifice. As she reached Medina, the people saw her and they said: Here is al-Adbi, the she-camel of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She (the woman) said that she had taken a vow that if Allah would save her on its back, she would sacrifice it. They (the Prophet's Companions) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Hallowed be Allah, how ill she rewarded it that she took vow to Allah that if He saves her on its back, she would sacrifice it! There is no fulfillment of the vow in an act of disobedience, nor in an act over which a person has no control. In the version of Ibn Hujr (the words are):" There is no vow in disobedience to Allah."
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki Thaqif qabila Banu Uqail ka sahyogi tha. Thaqif ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se do logon ko qaidi banaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ne Banu Uqail ke ek shakhs ko qaidi banaaya, aur unke saath al-Adbi (Nabi ki oontni) ko bhi pakad liya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uske paas aaye aur woh rassiyon se bandha hua tha. Usne kaha: Muhammad. Woh (Nabi) uske qareeb aaye aur kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Isper unhone (qaidi ne) kaha: Aapne mujhe kyun qaidi banaaya aur haajiyon se aage chalne wali (oontni) ko kyun pakda? (Ye oontni Nabi ko unki peeth par le jaati aur bheed se aage chalti thi.) Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: (Tumhara ye ek bada qusoor hai). Maine (mere aadmiyon ne) tumhe tumhare sahyogiyon, Banu Thaqif, ke jurm ke liye pakda hai. Woh phir mud gaye. Usne unhe dobara bulaaya aur kaha: Muhammad, Muhammad, aur chunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahut dayaalu aur narm dil the, woh uski taraf wapas mud gaye, aur kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Usne kaha: Main ek Musalman hoon, isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Agar tum ye baat tab kehte jab tum apni zaat ke maalik the, to tumhe har kaamyaabi milti. Woh phir mud gaye. Unhone (qaidi ne) unhe dobara bulaaya ye kehte hue: Muhammad, Muhammad. Woh uske paas aaye aur kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Usne kaha: Mujhe bhookh lagi hai, mujhe khilaao, aur mujhe pyaas lagi hai, is liye mujhe peene ko do. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ye tumhari zaroorat (poori karne ke liye) hai. Woh phir do logon (jinhe Thaqif ne qaidi banaaya tha) ke badle mein fidya diya gaya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Ansar ki ek aurat ko qaidi banaaya gaya tha aur al-Adbi bhi pakdi gayi thi. Us aurat ko rassiyon se bandha gaya tha. Log apne jaanwaron ko apne gharon ke saamne aaraam de rahe the. Woh ek raat apni qaid se bhaag nikli aur oonton ke paas aayi. Jaise woh oonton ke qareeb aayi, woh bechain ho gaye, is liye usne unhe chhod diya yahan tak ki woh al-Adbi ke paas aayi. Woh bechain nahi hui; woh vinamr thi. Woh uski peeth par sawaar hui aur use haank kar le gayi aur woh chali gayi. Jab unhe (Islam ke dushmanon ko) iski chetaavni mili, woh iski talaash mein gaye, lekin isne (oontni ne) unhe thaka diya. Usne (aurat ne) Allah se mannat li ki agar Woh use isi ke zariye bacha le, to woh ise qurbaan kar degi. Jab woh Madina pahunchi, logon ne use dekha aur kaha: Ye al-Adbi hai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki oontni. Usne (aurat ne) kaha ki usne mannat li thi ki agar Allah use uski peeth par bachaaye, to woh ise qurbaan kar degi. Woh (Nabi ke sahaba) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Allah muqaddas hai, usne isko kaisa bura badla diya ki usne Allah se mannat li ki agar Woh use iski peeth par bachaaye, to woh ise qurbaan kar degi! Naafarmani ke amal mein mannat ka koi poora hona nahi hota, na hi kisi aise amal mein jispar shakhs ka koi niyantran na ho. Ibn Hujr ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Allah ki naafarmani mein koi mannat nahi hoti."

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters and a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw an old man being supported between his two sons. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with him? They said: He had taken the vow to walk (on foot to the Ka'ba). Thereupon he (Allah's Apoitle) said: Allah is indifferent to his inflicting upon himself chastisement, and he commanded him to ride.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek boodhe aadmi ko dekha jise uske do beton ke beech sahaara diya ja raha tha. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ise kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Usne (Kaaba tak) paidal chalne ki mannat li thi. Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Allah ko iski koi parvaah nahi ki woh khud par ye saza laadta hai, aur unhone use sawaari karne ka hukum diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) found an old man walking between his two sons supported by them, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: What is the matter with him? He (the narrator) said: Allah's Messenger, they are his sons and there is upon him the (fulfilment) of the vow, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Ride, old man, for Allah is not in need of you and your vow.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek boodhe aadmi ko apne do beton ke beech chalte hue paaya, unke sahaare se, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise kya hua hai? Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye uske bete hain aur usper mannat (poora karne) ka farz hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sawaar ho jaao, boodhe aadmi, kyunki Allah ko tumhari aur tumhari mannat ki koi zaroorat nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Abu 'Amr with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Abu Amr ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Uqba b. Amir reported: My sister took a vow that she would walk bare foot to the house of Allah (Ka'ba). She asked me to inquire from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. I sought his decision and he said: She should walk on foot and ride also.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne bayan kiya: Meri behn ne Allah ke Ghar (Kaaba) tak nange paon chalne ki mannat li. Usne mujhse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poochne ko kaha. Maine unse faisla maanga aur unhone kaha: Use paidal aur sawaar dono tarah chalna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Uqba b. Amir Juhani. but in this no mention has been made of" barefoot".
hi: Ye hadees Uqba bin Aamir Juhani ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein "nange paon" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'Uqba. b. Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The expiation of the (breach of) a vow is the same as that of the (breach of an oath).
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mannat (todne) ka kaffara wahi hai jo qasam (todne) ka hai.

e: 'Umar b. al-Khattib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Great and Majestic, forbids you to swear by your fathers. Umar said: By Allah. I have never sworn (by my father) since I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding it mentioning them" on my behalf" nor on behalf of someone else.
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, tumhe apne baap-dada ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai. Umar ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi (apne baap ki) qasam nahi khayi jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise mana karte suna, na to "mere taraf se" ya kisi doosre ki taraf se.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri except that in the hadith narrated on the authority of Uqail the words are: " I did not take oath by (anyone else except Allah) since I heard Allah's Messenger forbidding it. nor did I speak in such terms, and the narrator did not say," on my own behalf or on behalf of someone else".
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is baat ke ki Uqail ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Maine (kisi aur ki, Allah ke ilawa) qasam nahi li jab se maine Allah ke Rasool ko ise mana karte suna, na hi maine aise alfaazon mein baat ki," aur raawi ne ye nahi kaha, "mere apni taraf se ya kisi doosre ki taraf se."

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) heard 'Umar while he was taking oath by his father. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Salim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umar ko suna jab woh apne baap ki qasam khaa rahe the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Umar) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) found, Umar b. al-Khattab amongst the riders and he was taking oath by his father Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called them (saying) ; Our Allah, the Exated and Majestic, has forbidden you that you take oath by your father. He who bag to take an oath, he must take it by Allah or keep quiet.
hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umar bin al-Khattab ko sawaaron ke beech paaya aur woh apne baap ki qasam khaa rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe bulaaya (aur kaha): Hamare Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne tumhe apne baap ki qasam khaane se mana kiya hai. Jise bhi qasam khaani ho, use Allah ki qasam khaani chahiye ya khamosh rehna chahiye.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who has to take an oath, he must not take oath but by Allah. The Quraish used to take oath by their fathers. So he (the Holy Prophet) said: Do not take oath by your fathers.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jise qasam khaani ho, use sirf Allah ki hi qasam khaani chahiye. Quraish apne baap-dada ki qasam khaaya karte the. To unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Apne baap-dada ki qasam mat khaao.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who takes an oath in the course of which he says: By Lat (and al-'Uzza), he should say: There is no god but Allah; and that if anyone says to his friend:" Come and I will gamble with you," he should pay sadaqa.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo qasam khaate hue kahe: Laat ki qasam (aur al-Uzza ki), use kehna chahiye: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi hai; aur agar koi apne dost se kahe: "Aao main tumse jua khelun," use sadaqa dena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Samura reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not swear by idols, nor by your fathers.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Samura ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Buton ki, na hi apne baap-dada ki qasam mat khaao.

e: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported: I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with a group of Ash'arites requesting to give us a mount. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with a mount, and there is nothing with me which I should give you as a ride. He (the narrator) said: We stayed there as long as Allah willed. Then there were brought to him (to the Holy Prophet) camels. He (the Holy Prophet) then ordered to give us three white humped camels, We started and said (or some of us said to the others): Allah will not bless us. We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) begging him to provide us with riding camels. He swore that he could not provide us with a mount, but later on he provided us with that. They (some of the Prophet's Companions) came and informed him about this (rankling of theirs), whereupon he said: It was not I who provided you with a mount, but Allah has provided you with that. So far as I am concerned, by Allah, if He so wills, I would not swear, but if, later on, I would see better than it, I (would break the vow) and expiate it and do that which is better.
hi: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas Ash'ari qabile ke logon ke ek giroh ke saath aaya, humein sawaari dene ki darkhwaast karte hue. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhe sawaari nahi de sakta, aur mere paas kuch nahi hai jo main tumhe sawaari ke liye dun. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Hum wahan jitni der Allah ne chaaha rahe. Phir unke paas oont laaye gaye. Unhone (Nabi ne) hukum diya ki humein teen safed kohaan waale oont diye jaayein. Hum chal diye aur kaha (ya humme se kuchne doosron se kaha): Allah humein barkat nahi degi. Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye unse sawaari dene ki darkhwaast karte hue. Unhone qasam khayi ki woh humein sawaari nahi de sakte, lekin baad mein unhone humein sawaari di. Woh (kuch Nabi ke sahaba) aaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Ye main nahi tha jisne tumhe sawaari di, balki Allah ne tumhe sawaari di hai. Jahan tak mera sawal hai, Allah ki qasam, agar Woh chaahe, to main qasam nahi khaaunga, lekin agar baad mein main isse behtar kuch dekhun, to main (mannat todunga) aur uska kaffara dunga aur woh karunga jo behtar hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: My friends sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him to provide them with mounts as they were going along with him in jaish al-'Usrah (the army of destitutes or of meagre means or army setting out during the hard times and that is the occasion of the expedition of Tabuk) I said: Apostle of Allah, my friends have sent me to you so that you may provide them with mounts. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with anything to ride. And it so happened that he was at that time much perturbed. I little knew of it, so I came back with a heavy heart on account of the refusal of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and the fear that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have some feelings against me. I returned to my friends and informed them about what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. I had hardly stayed for a little that I heard Bilal calling: 'Abdullah b. Qais. I responded to his call. He said: Hasten to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he is calling you, When I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) he said: Take this pair, this pair, and this pair (i. e. six camels which he had bought from Sa'd), and take them to y, our friends and say: Verily Allah (or he said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has provided you with these animals. So ride upon them. Abu Musa said: I went along with them to my friends and said: Verily Allah's messenger (ﷺ) has provided you with these animals for riding; but by Allah, I shall not leave you until some of you go along with me to him who had heard the talk of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then I asked him for you, and his refusal for the first time, and then his granting them to me subsequently; so you should not think that I narrated to you something which he did not say. They said to me: By Allah, in our opinion you are certainly truthful, and we would do as you like. So Abu Musa went along withsome of the menfrom them until they came to those who had heard the words of Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) and his refusal to (provide) them with (animals) ; and subsequently his granting (the animals) to them; and they narrated to them exactly as Abu Masa had narrated to them.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Mere dosto ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja unse sawaari dene ki darkhwaast karte hue jab woh unke saath jaish al-Usrah (mushkil waqt ya kam saadhan waali fauj, jo Tabuk ki muhim ka mauka hai) mein ja rahe the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere dosto ne mujhe aapke paas bheja hai taaki aap unhe sawaari dein. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhe sawaari ke liye kuch nahi de sakta. Aur aisa hua ki woh us waqt bahut pareshaan the. Mujhe iska thoda hi pata tha, is liye main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke inkaar aur is dar ki wajah se ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse naaraaz na ho jaayein, bhaari dil se wapas aaya. Main apne dosto ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kya kaha tha. Main mushkil se thodi der ruka tha ki maine Bilal ko pukaarte suna: Abdullah bin Qais. Maine unki pukaar ka jawaab diya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaldi jao, woh tumhe bula rahe hain. Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya unhone kaha: Ye jodi lo, ye jodi lo, aur ye jodi lo (yaani chhe oont jo unhone Sa'd se khareede the), aur unhe apne dosto ke paas le jaao aur kaho: Yaqeenan Allah (ya unhone kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool SAW) ne tumhe ye jaanwar diye hain. To unpar sawaar ho. Abu Musa ne kaha: Main unke saath apne dosto ke paas gaya aur kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe sawaari ke liye ye jaanwar diye hain; lekin Allah ki qasam, main tumhe tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak tum mein se kuch mere saath us shakhs ke paas na jaayein jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baat suni thi jab maine unse tumhare liye maanga tha, aur unka pehli baar inkaar, aur phir unka baad mein unhe (jaanwar) dena; taaki tum ye na sochho ki maine tumhe woh riwayat kiya jo unhone nahi kaha. Unhone mujhse kaha: Allah ki qasam, hamari raay mein tum zaroor sachche ho, aur hum wahi karenge jo tumhe pasand ho. To Abu Musa unmein se kuch aadmiyon ke saath gaye yahan tak ki woh un logon ke paas pahunche jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz sune the aur unka (jaanwar) na dena; aur uske baad unka unhe dena; aur unhone unhe bilkul waisa hi riwayat kiya jaisa Abu Masa ne unhe riwayat kiya tha.

e: Ayyub said: We were sitting in the company of Abu Musa that he called for food and it consisted of flesh of fowl. It was then that a person from Banu Tamim visited him. His complexion was red having the resemblance of a slave. He said to him: Come and (join me in food). He showed reluctance. He (Abu Masa) said: Come on, for I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating it (fowl's meat), whereupon that person said: I saw it eating something (of filth and rubbish) and I found it repugnant and took an oath that I would never eat that. He (Abu Muds) said: Come, so that I would narrate to you about that (the incident pertaining to vow). (And he narrated thus): I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with a group of people belonging to the tribe of Ash'ari, asking him to provide us with riding camels. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I cannot provide you with riding animals. And there is nothing with me with which I can provide you a mount. We stayed (for some time) there as Allah willed, and there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) booty of camels. He called us and commanded that we should be given five white humped camels. As we were about to go back, some of us said to the other: As we made Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forget oath, there would be no blessing for us (in his gift). We went back to him and said: Allah's Messenger, we came to you to provide us with riding animals and you took an oath that you would never equip us with mounts and then you have provided us with the riding beasts Allah's Messenger, have you forgotten? Thereupon he said: I swear by Allah that if Allah so wills, I shall not swear an oath, and then consider something else to be better than it without making atonement for my oath and doing the thing that is better. So you go; Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has given you riding animals.
hi: Ayyub ne kaha: Hum Abu Musa ki sohbat mein baithe the ki unhone khaana mangwaaya aur usmein murgi ka gosht tha. Isi waqt Banu Tamim ka ek shakhs unse milne aaya. Uski rangat laal thi jo ek ghulam jaisi thi. Unhone (Abu Musa ne) usse kaha: Aao aur (mere saath khaane mein shaamil ho). Usne hichkichaahat dikhaayi. Unhone (Abu Masa ne) kaha: Aao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise (murgi ka gosht) khaate dekha, isper us shakhs ne kaha: Maine ise (murgi ko) kuch (gandagi aur kachra) khaate dekha aur mujhe ye napasand aaya aur maine qasam li ki main use kabhi nahi khaaunga. Unhone (Abu Masa ne) kaha: Aao, taaki main tumhe iske baare mein riwayat kar sakoon (mannat se mutalliq ghatna). (Aur unhone is tarah riwayat ki): Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Ash'ari qabile ke logon ke ek giroh ke saath aaya, unse sawaari waale oont dene ki darkhwaast karte hue. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhe sawaari waale jaanwar nahi de sakta. Aur mere paas kuch nahi hai jisse main tumhe sawaari de sakoon. Hum jitni der Allah ne chaaha wahan ruke, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas oonton ka maal-e-ganimat laaya gaya. Unhone humein bulaaya aur hukum diya ki humein paanch safed kohaan waale oont diye jaayein. Jab hum wapas jaane ki taiyaari kar rahe the, humme se kuchne doosron se kaha: Chunki humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki qasam bhula di, humare liye koi barkat nahi hogi (unke tohfe mein). Hum unke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aapke paas aaye taaki aap humein sawaari waale jaanwar dein aur aapne qasam li thi ki aap humein kabhi sawaari se lais nahi karenge aur phir aapne humein sawaari waale jaanwar diye. Allah ke Rasool, kya aap bhool gaye? Isper unhone kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ki agar Allah chaahe, to main qasam nahi khaaunga, aur phir agar main kisi doosri cheez ko isse behtar samajhun to main apni qasam ka kaffara diye bina aur behtareen cheez kiye bina (aisa nahi karunga). Is liye jao; Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne tumhe sawaari waale jaanwar diye hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa al-Ash'ari with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zahdam al-Jarmi reported: We were in the company of Abu Musa. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Zahdam al-Jarmi ne bayan kiya: Hum Abu Musa ki sohbat mein the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Zahdam al-Jarmi reported: I visited Abu Musa and lie was eating fowl's meat. The rest of the hadith is the same with this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Allah, I did not forget it.
hi: Zahdam al-Jarmi ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Musa se milne gaya aur woh murgi ka gosht kha rahe the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai is izafe ke saath ki unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main ise bhoola nahi.

e: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported: We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) requesting him to provide us with riding camels. He (the Holy Prophet) said: There is nothing with me with which I should equip you. By Allah, I would not provide you with (riding camels). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent to us three camels with spotted bumps. We said: We came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him to equip us with riding animals. He took an oath that he could not equip us. We came to him and informed him. He said: By Allah, I do not take an oath, but when I find the other thing better than that, I do that which is better.
hi: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye unse sawaari waale oont dene ki darkhwaast karte hue. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Mere paas kuch nahi hai jisse main tumhe lais kar sakoon. Allah ki qasam, main tumhe (sawaari waale oont) nahi dunga. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humare paas dhabbedaar kohaan waale teen oont bheje. Humne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye unse sawaari waale jaanwar maangte hue. Unhone qasam li ki woh humein lais nahi kar sakte. Hum unke paas aaye aur unhe bataaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main qasam nahi khaata, lekin jab main doosri cheez usse behtar paata hoon, main woh karta hoon jo behtar hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: We walked on foot and came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) asking him to provide us with mounts. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Hum paidal chale aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye unse sawaari maangte hue. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: A person sat late in the night with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and then came to his family and found that his children had gone to sleep. His wife brought food for him. but he took an oath that he would not eat because of his children (having gone to sleep without food) He then gave precedence (of breaking the vow and then expiating it) and ate the food He then came to Allah s Messenger (ﷺ) and made mention of that to him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: He who took an oath and (later on) found something better than that should do that, and expiate for (breaking) his vow.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs raat der tak Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke saath baitha raha, aur phir apne khaandaan ke paas aaya aur paaya ki uske bachche so gaye hain. Uski zauja uske liye khaana laayi, lekin usne qasam li ki woh apne bachchon ki wajah se (jo bina khaaye so gaye the) nahi khaayega. Woh phir (mannat todne aur uska kaffara dene mein) pehle kadam uthaya aur khaana khaya. Woh phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse iska zikr kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jisne qasam li aur (baad mein) usse behtar kuch paaya, use woh karna chahiye, aur apni mannat ka kaffara dena chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who took an oath and then found another thing better than (this) should expiate for the oath (broken) by him and do (the better thing).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne qasam li aur phir doosri cheez (isse) behtar paayi use apni (tootee) qasam ka kaffara dena chahiye aur (behtar cheez) karni chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who took an oath and (later on) found another thing better than that, he should do that which is better, and expiate for the vow (broken by him).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne qasam li aur (baad mein) doosri cheez usse behtar paayi, use woh karna chahiye jo behtar hai, aur apni mannat (jo usne todi hai) ka kaffara dena chahiye.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters (with these words): " He should expiate for (breaking) the vow and do that which is better."
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (in alfaazon ke saath): "Use apni mannat (todne) ka kaffara dena chahiye aur woh karna chahiye jo behtar hai."

e: Tamim b. Tarafa reported: A beggar came to 'Adi b. Hatim and he begged him to give him the price of a slave, or some portion of the price of the slave. He ('Adi) said: I have nothing to give you except my coat-of-mail and helmet. I will, however, write to my family to give that to you, but he did not agree to that. Thereupon 'Adi was enraged, and said: By Allah, I will not give you anything. The person (then) agreed to accept that, whereupon he said: By Allah, had I not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying:" He who took an oath, but then found something more pious in the sight of Allah, he should (break the oath) and do that which is more pious," I would not have broken the oath (and thus paid you anything).
hi: Tamim bin Tarafa ne bayan kiya: Ek bhikhaari Adi bin Hatim ke paas aaya aur usne unse ek ghulam ki keemat, ya ghulam ki keemat ka kuch hissa, maanga. Unhone (Adi ne) kaha: Mere paas apni kavach aur khod ke ilawa tumhe dene ke liye kuch nahi hai. Main, halaanki, apne khaandaan ko likhunga ki woh ise tumhe dein, lekin usne isse sehmati nahi jataayi. Isper Adi gusse ho gaye, aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhe kuch nahi dunga. Us shakhs ne (phir) ise qubool karne par sehmati jataayi, isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota: "Jisne qasam li, lekin phir Allah ki nazar mein kuch zyada tqvapurna paaya, use (qasam todni chahiye) aur woh karna chahiye jo zyada takvapurna hai," to main qasam nahi todta (aur is tarah tumhe kuch nahi deta).

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who took an oath, but he found something else better than that, should do that which is better and break his oath.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne qasam li, lekin usne kuch aur usse behtar paaya, use woh karna chahiye jo behtar hai aur apni qasam todni chahiye.

e: 'Adi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone amongst you takes an oath, but he finds (something) better than that he should expiate (the breaking of the oath), and do that which is better.
hi: Adi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi qasam leta hai, lekin woh (kuch) usse behtar paata hai use (qasam todne) ka kaffara dena chahiye, aur woh karna chahiye jo behtar hai.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Adi bin Hatim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Tamim b. Tarafa reported that he heard 'Adi b. Hatim say that a person came to him and asked for one hundred dirhams. He ('Adi) said: You asked me for one hundred dirhams and I am the son of Hatim; by Allah, I will not give you. But then he said: (I would have done that) if I had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who takes an oath, but then finds something better than that, should do that which is better.
hi: Tamim bin Tarafa ne bayan kiya ki unhone Adi bin Hatim ko ye kehte suna ki ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur unse sau dirham maange. Unhone (Adi ne) kaha: Tumne mujhse sau dirham maange hain aur main Hatim ka beta hoon; Allah ki qasam, main tumhe nahi dunga. Lekin phir unhone kaha: (Main aisa karta) agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte na suna hota: Jo qasam leta hai, lekin phir kuch usse behtar paata hai, use woh karna chahiye jo behtar hai.

e: Tamim b. Tarafa reported: I heard 'Adi b. Hatim say that a person asked that and then narrated (the hadith) like one (mentioned above), but he made this addition:" Here are four hundred (dirhams) for you out of my gift."
hi: Tamim bin Tarafa ne bayan kiya: Maine Adi bin Hatim ko ye kehte suna ki ek shakhs ne maanga aur phir unhone hadees isi jaisi riwayat ki jaisi upar bataayi gayi hai, lekin unhone ye izafa kiya: "Ye rahe tumhare liye chaar sau (dirham) mere tohfe se."

e:
Abd al-Rahman b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Abd al-Rahman b. Samura, don't ask for authority for if it is granted to you for asking for it, you would be commissioned for it (without having the support of Allah), but if you are granted it without your asking for it. You would be helped (by Allah) in it. And when you take an oath and find something else better than that, expiate for (breaking) your oath, and do that which is better. This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Farrukh.

The above hadith is narratted through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Abd al-Rahman bin Samura, ohda maangne ki koshish mat karo, kyunki agar ye tumhe maangne par diya jaata hai, to tumhe ismein zimmedaari di jaayegi (bina Allah ke himayat ke), lekin agar tumhe ye bina maange diya jaata hai, tumhe ismein (Allah ke zariye) madad milegi. Aur jab tum qasam khaate ho aur koi doosri cheez isse behtar paate ho, apni qasam (todne) ka kaffara do, aur woh karo jo behtar hai. Ye hadees Ibn Farrukh ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura through another chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" authority".
hi: Ye hadees Abd al-Rahman bin Samura ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein "ohda" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Haraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Your oath should be about something regarding which your companion will believe you. 'Amr said: By which your companion will believe you.
hi: Abu Haraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhari qasam ussi cheez ke baare mein honi chahiye jispar tumhara saathi tumpar bharosa karega. Amr ne kaha: Jispar tumhara saathi tumpar bharosa karega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: An oath is to be interpreted according to the intention of the one who takes it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qasam ka matlab uski niyat ke mutabik nikaala jaana chahiye jisne ise li hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that (Hadrat) Sulaiman had sixty wives. He (one day) said: I will visit each one of them every night, and every one of them will become pregnant and give birth to a male child who will be a horseman and fight in the cause of Allah. But (it so happened) that none of them became pregnant except one, but she gave birth to an incomplete child. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had he said Insha' Allah (if God so wills), then every one of them would have given birth to a child who would have been a horseman and fought in the cause of Allah
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki (Hazrat) Sulaiman ke saath saath biwiyaan thin. Unhone (ek din) kaha: Main har raat unmein se har ek se milunga, aur unmein se har ek garbhvati hogi aur ek larka paidaish degi jo ghudsawaar banega aur Allah ki raah mein larega. Lekin (aisa hua ki) unmein se koi bhi garbhvati nahi hui siwaay ek ke, lekin usne ek adhoora bachcha paida kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar unhone Insha Allah (agar Allah ne chaaha) kaha hota, to unmein se har ek ne ek aisa bachcha paida kiya hota jo ghudsawaar banta aur Allah ki raah mein larta.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying that Sulaiman b. Dawud, the Messenger of Allah, observed: I will have an intercourse with seventy wives during the night; all of them will give birth to a male child who will fight in the cause of Allah. His companion or the ang I said to him: Say," If God wills." But he (Hadrat Sulaimin) did not say so, and he forgot it. And none of his wives gave birth to a child, but one who gave birth to a premature child. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had he said Insha' Allah (if God so will). he would not have failed and his desire would have been materialised.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki Sulaiman bin Dawud, Allah ke Rasool, ne kaha: Main raat ke daurane sattar biwiyon ke saath jinsi milaap karunga; woh sab ek larka paidaish degi jo Allah ki raah mein larega. Unke saathi ya farishte ne unse kaha: Kaho, "Agar Allah ne chaaha." Lekin unhone (Hazrat Sulaiman ne) aisa nahi kaha, aur woh ise bhool gaye. Aur unki koi bhi biwi ne bachcha paidaish nahi diya, siwaay ek ke jisne ek adhoore bachche ko paida kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar unhone Insha Allah kaha hota, to woh naakaam nahi hote aur unki khwahish poori ho jaati.

e: Abu Huraira reported this hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne ye hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Sulaiman b. Dawud said: I will certainly have intercourse with seventy wives during the night, and every wife amongst them will give birth to a child, who will fight in the cause of Allah. It was said to him: Say:" Insha' Allah" (God willing), but he did not say so and forgot it. He went round them but none of them give birth to a child except one woman and that too was an incomplete person. Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he had said" Insha' Allah." he would not have failed, and his desire must have been fulfilled.
