hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Sulaiman bin Dawud ne kaha: Main zaroor raat ke daurane sattar biwiyon ke saath jinsi milaap karunga, aur unmein se har biwi ek bachche ko paidaish degi, jo Allah ki raah mein larega. Unse kaha gaya: Kaho: "Insha Allah" (Allah ki marzi ho), lekin unhone aisa nahi kaha aur ise bhool gaye. Woh unke paas gaye lekin unmein se kisi ne bhi bachcha paidaish nahi diya siwaay ek aurat ke aur woh bhi ek adhoora shakhs tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar unhone "Insha Allah" kaha hota, to woh naakaam na hote, aur unki khwahish zaroor poori hoti.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that Sulaiman b. Dawud (once) said: I will go round in the night to my ninety wives, and every one of them will give birth to a child (who will grow up) as a horseman and fight in the cause of Allah His companions said to him: Say" Insha' Allah." but he did not say Inshii' Allah. He went round all of them but none of them became pregnant but one, and she gave birth to a premature child. And by Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, if he had said, Insha' Allah (his wives would have given birth to the children who would all have grown up into horsemen and fought in the way of Allah).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki Sulaiman bin Dawud ne (ek baar) kaha: Main raat mein apni nabbe biwiyon ke paas jaunga, aur unmein se har ek ek bachche ko paidaish degi (jo bada hokar) ghudsawaar (banega) aur Allah ki raah mein larega. Unke saathiyon ne unse kaha: Kaho "Insha Allah," lekin unhone Insha Allah nahi kaha. Woh sabke paas gaye lekin unmein se koi bhi garbhvati nahi hui siwaay ek ke, aur usne ek adhoora bachcha paida kiya. Aur us hasti ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar unhone Insha Allah kaha hota (to unki biwiyon ne aise bachche paida hue hote jo sab ghudsawaar bante aur Allah ki raah mein larte).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zinad with the same chain of transmitters with a variation of (these words): " Every one of them giving birth to a child, who would have fought in the cause of Allah."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Zinad ki sanad se isi sanad se in alfaazon mein tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Unmein se har ek ek bachche ko paidaish degi, jo Allah ki raah mein larega."

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he narrated a hadith and (one) of them is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I swear by Allah, it is more sinful in Allah's sight for one of you to persist in an oath regarding his family than payment of its expiation which Allah has imposed upon him (for breaking the oath).
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur unhone ek hadees riwayat ki aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon, tum mein se kisi ke liye apne khaandaan ke baare mein qasam par ade rehna Allah ki nazar mein usse zyada gunahgaar hai jitna ki uska kaffara dena, jo Allah ne (qasam todne ke liye) usper laagoo kiya hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Umar (b. Khattab) said: Messenger of Allah, I had taken a vow during the days of Ignorance (Jahiliyya) that I would observe I'tikaf for a night in the Sacred Mosque. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Fulfil your vow.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar (bin Khattab) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine Jaahiliyat ke daur mein ek mannat li thi ki main Masjid al-Haram mein ek raat I'tikaf karunga. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Apni mannat poori karo.

e: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of Ibn Umar with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that 'Umar b. Khattab asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was at ji'rana (a town near Mecca) on his way back from Ta'if: Messenger of Allah, I had taken a vow during the days of Ignorance that I would observe I'tikaf for one day in the Sacred Mosque. So what is your opinion? He said: Go and observe I'tikaf for a day. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him a slave girl out of the one-fifth (of the spoils of war meant for the Holy Prophet). And when Allah's Messenger (inay peace be upon him) set the war prisoners free. 'Umar b. Khattab heard their voice as they were saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set as free. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What is this? They said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set free the prisoners of war (which had fallen to the lot of people). Thereupon he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abdullah, go to that slave-girl and set her free.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha jab woh Ji'rana (Makkah ke qareeb ek shehar) mein the Taif se wapas aate waqt: Allah ke Rasool, maine Jaahiliyat ke daur mein mannat li thi ki main Masjid al-Haram mein ek din I'tikaf karunga. To aapki kya raay hai? Unhone kaha: Jao aur ek din I'tikaf karo. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ek laundi di paanchvein hisse (jo maal-e-ganimat ka Nabi ke liye tha) mein se. Aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jung ke qaidiyon ko azaad kiya, Umar bin Khattab ne unki aawaaz sun li jab woh keh rahe the: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne azaad kar diya hai. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jung ke qaidiyon ko azaad kar diya hai (jo logon ke hisse mein aaye the). Isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abdullah, us laundi ke paas jao aur use azaad karo.

e: lbn 'Umar reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came back from the Battle of Hunain, Umar asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the vow he had taken during the days of Ignorance that he would observe I'tikaf for a day. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hunain ki jung se wapas aaye, Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us mannat ke baare mein poocha jo unhone Jaahiliyat ke daur mein li thi ki woh ek din I'tikaf karenge. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Nafi' reported: A mention of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing 'Umra from ja'rina was made before Ibn 'Umar. He said: He did not enter into the state of Ihram from that (place), and Umar had taken a vow of observing I'tikaf for a night during the days of Ignorance. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Ji'rina se Umra karne ka zikr Ibn Umar ke saamne hua. Unhone kaha: Unhone waha se ehram mein daakhil nahi hua, aur Umar ne Jaahiliyat ke daur mein ek raat I'tikaf karne ki mannat li thi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zadhan Abl Umar reported: I came to Ibn 'Umar as he had granted freedom to a stave. He (the narrator further) said: He took hold of a wood or something like it from the earth and said: It (freedom of a slave) has not the reward evert equal to it, but the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) say: He who slaps his slave or beats him, the expiation for it is that he should set him free.
hi: Zadhan Abl Umar ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Umar ke paas aaya jab unhone ek ghulam ko azaadi di thi. Unhone (aage raawi ne) kaha: Unhone zameen se lakdi ya isi jaisi koi cheez uthaayi aur kaha: Iska (ghulam ki azaadi ka) sawaab iske barabar bhi nahi hai, lekin ye baat ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo apne ghulam ko thappad maarta hai ya use maarta hai, uska kaffara ye hai ki woh use azaad kare.

e: Zadhan reported that Ibn Umar called his slave and he found the marks (of beating) upon his back. He said to him: I have caused you pain. He said: No. But he (Ibn Umar) said: You are free. He then took hold of something from the earth and said: There is no reward for me even to the weight equal to it. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who beats a slave without cognizable offence of his or slaps him (without any serious fault), then expiation for it is that he should set him free.
hi: Zadhan ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne apne ghulam ko bulaaya aur unhe uski peeth par (maarne ke) nishaan mile. Unhone usse kaha: Maine tumhe dard diya hai. Usne kaha: Nahi. Lekin unhone (Ibn Umar ne) kaha: Tum azaad ho. Unhone phir zameen se kuch uthaaya aur kaha: Iske wazan ke barabar bhi mera koi sawaab nahi hai. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi ghulam ko uske pehchaanne laayak qusoor ke bina maarta hai ya use thappad maarta hai (bina kisi sangin qusoor ke), to iska kaffara ye hai ki woh use azaad kare.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Mu'awiya b. Suwaid reported: I slapped a slave belonging to us and then fled away. I came back just before noon and offered prayer behind my father. He called him (the slave) and me and said: Do as he has done to you. He granted pardon. He (my father) then said: We belonged to the family of Muqarrin during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him. and had only one slave-girl and one of us slapped her. This news reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: Set her free. They (the members of the family) said: There is no other servant except she. Thereupon he said: Then employ her and when you can afford to dispense with her services, then set her free.
hi: Mu'awiya bin Suwaid ne bayan kiya: Maine hamare ek ghulam ko thappad maara aur phir bhaag gaya. Main dopahar se thodi pehle wapas aaya aur apne walid ke peeche namaz padhi. Unhone use (ghulam ko) aur mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Woh karo jo usne tumhare saath kiya. Usne maafi de di. Unhone (mere waalid ne) phir kaha: Hum Muqarrin ke khaandaan se the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein, aur humare paas sirf ek laundi thi aur hummein se ek ne use thappad maara. Ye khabar Allah ke Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone kaha: Use azaad kar do. Unhone (khaandaan ke logon ne) kaha: Uske ilawa koi doosra khaadim nahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: To use kaam par rakho aur jab tum uski khidmaton ke bina kaam chalaa sako, phir use azaad kar do.

e: Hilal b. Yasaf reported that a person got angry and slapped his slave-girl. Thereupon Suwaid b. Muqarrin said to him: You could find no other part (to slap) but the prominent part of her face. See I was one of the seven sons of Muqarrin, and we had but only one slave-girl. The youngest of us slapped her, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to set her free. 2097
hi: Hilal bin Yasaf ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs gussa hua aur usne apni laundi ko thappad maara. Isper Suwaid bin Muqarrin ne usse kaha: Kya tumhe koi doosra hissa nahi mila (thappad maarne ke liye) siwaay uske chehre ke sabse ubhare hisse ke? Dekho main Muqarrin ke saat beton mein se ek tha, aur humare paas sirf ek laundi thi. Hummein se sabse chhote ne use thappad maara, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein use azaad karne ka hukum diya.

e: Hilal b. Yasaf reported: We used to sell cloth in the house of Suwaid b. Muqarrin, the brother of Nu'man b. Muqarrin. There came out a slave-girl, and she said something to a person amongst us, and he slapped her. Suwaid was enraged-the rest of the hadlth is the same.
hi: Hilal bin Yasaf ne bayan kiya: Hum Suwaid bin Muqarrin ke ghar, Nu'man bin Muqarrin ke bhai, mein kapda bechte the. Ek laundi bahar aayi, aur usne humme se ek shakhs ko kuch kaha, aur usne use thappad maara. Suwaid gusse ho gaye - baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Suwaid b. Muqarrin reported that he had a slave-girl and a person (one of the members of the family) slapped her, whereupon Suwaid said to him: Don't you know that it is forbidden (to strike the) face. He said: You see I was the seventh one amongst my brothers during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and we had but only one servant. One of us got enraged and slapped him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to set him free.
hi: Suwaid bin Muqarrin ne bayan kiya ki unke paas ek laundi thi aur ek shakhs (khaandaan ke ek sadasya) ne use thappad maara, isper Suwaid ne usse kaha: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki chehre par maarna mana hai? Usne kaha: Dekho main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein apne bhaiyon mein saatvan tha, aur humare paas sirf ek khaadim tha. Hummein se ek gussa hua aur usne use thappad maara. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein use azaad karne ka hukum diya.

e: Wahb b. Jarir reported: Shu'ba informed that Muhammad b. Munkadir said to me: What is your name? The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Wahb bin Jarir ne bayan kiya: Shu'ba ne bataya ki Muhammad bin Munkadir ne mujhse kaha: Tumhara naam kya hai? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Badri reported: I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me: Understand, Abu Masud; but I did not recognise the voice due to intense anger. He (Abu Mas'ud) reported: As he came near me (I found) that he was the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was saying: Bear in mind, Abu Mas'ud; bear in mind. Abu Mas'ud. He (Aba Maslad) said: threw the whip from my hand. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Bear in mind, Abu Mas'ud; verily Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave. I (then) said: I would never beat my servant in future.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Badri ne bayan kiya: Main apne ghulam ko koda se maar raha tha jab maine apne peeche ek aawaaz suni: Samjho, Abu Masud; lekin maine tez gusse ki wajah se aawaaz ko pehchaana nahi. Unhone (Abu Mas'ud ne) bayaan kiya: Jab woh mere qareeb aaye (maine paaya) ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) the aur woh keh rahe the: Yaad rakho, Abu Mas'ud; yaad rakho, Abu Mas'ud. Unhone (Abu Masud ne) kaha: Maine koda apne haath se phenk diya. Isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Yaad rakho, Abu Mas'ud; yaqeenan Allah ka tumpar zyada haq hai jitna tumhara apne ghulam par hai. Maine (phir) kaha: Main mustaqbil mein apne khaadim ko kabhi nahi maarunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authorityo A'mash but with this variation of words: " There fell from my hand the whip on account of his (the Prophet's) awe."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath: "Koda mere haath se unki (Nabi ki) izzat ki wajah se gir gaya."

e: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported: When I was beating my servant, I heard a voice behind me (saying): Abu Mas'ud, bear in mind Allah has more dominance over you than you have upon him. I turned and (found him) to be Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said: Allah's Messenger, I set him free for the sake of Allah. Thereupon he said: Had you not done that, (the gates of) Hell would have opened for you, or the fire would have burnt you.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ne bayan kiya: Jab main apne khaadim ko maar raha tha, maine apne peeche ek aawaaz suni (ye kehte hue): Abu Mas'ud, yaad rakho Allah ka tumpar zyada haq hai jitna tumhara usper hai. Main muda aur (paaya ki woh) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main use Allah ki khaatir azaad karta hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne aisa na kiya hota, to (jahannam ke darwaze) tumhare liye khul jaate, ya aag tumhe jala deti.

e: Abu Mas'ud reported that he had been beating his slave and he had been saying: I seek refuge with Allah, but he continued beating him, whereupon he said: I seek refuge with Allah's Messenger, and he spared him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, God has more dominance over you than you have over him (the slave). He said that he set him free.
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne bayan kiya ki woh apne ghulam ko maar rahe the aur woh keh raha tha: Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon, lekin unhone use maarte rehna jaari rakha, isper usne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki panah maangta hoon, aur unhone use chhod diya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ka tumpar zyada haq hai jitna tumhara usper (ghulam par) hai. Unhone kaha ki unhone use azaad kar diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but made no mention of (these words) of his: I seek refuge with Allah, I seek refuge with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone unke ye alfaaz ka koi zikr nahi kiya: Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki panah maangta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l-Qasim (one of the names of Allah's Messenger ) said: He who accused his slave of adultery, punishment would be imposed upon him on the Day of Resurrection, except in case the accusation was as he had said.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Abu'l-Qasim (Allah ke Rasool ke naamon mein se ek) ne kaha: Jo apne ghulam par jina ka ilzaam lagaata hai, use Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi, siwaay is baat ke ki ilzaam waisa hi tha jaisa usne kaha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ghazwan (and the words are): " I heard Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) as the Prophet of repentance."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Ghazwan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Maine Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ko tauba ke Nabi ke soorat mein suna."

e: Al-Ma'rur b. Suwaid said: We went to Abu Dharr (Ghifari) in Rabadha and he had a mantle over him, and his slave had one like it. We said: Abu Dharr, had you joined them together, it would have been a complete garment. Thereupon he said: There was an altercation between me and one of the persons among my brothers. His mother was a non-Arab. I reproached him for his mother. He complained against me to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). As I met Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) he said: Abu Dharr, you are a person who still has (in him the remnants) of the days (of Ignorance). Thereupon I said: Allah's Messenger, he who abuses (other) persons, they abuse (in return) his father and mother. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Abu Dharr, you are a person who still has (the remnants) of Ignorance in him They (your servants and slaves) are your brothers. Allah has put them in your care, so feed them with what you eat, clothe them with what you wear. and do not burden them beyond their capacities; but if you burden them (with an unbearable burden), then help them (by sharing their extra burden).
hi: Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid ne kaha: Hum Abu Dharr (Ghifari) ke paas Rabadha mein gaye aur unhone ek chogha pehna hua tha, aur unke ghulam ne bhi waisa hi pehna hua tha. Humne kaha: Abu Dharr, agar aap unhe joḍ dete, to ye ek poora kapda ban jaata. Isper unhone kaha: Mere aur mere ek bhai ke beech jhagda hua. Uski maa ghair-Arab thi. Maine uski maa ke baare mein use bura-bhala kaha. Usne mere khilaaf Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se shikaayat ki. Jab main Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se mila unhone kaha: Abu Dharr, tum ab bhi (apne andar Jaahiliyat ke) daur ki (baaki cheezein) rakhte ho. Isper maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jo (doosre) logon ko bura-bhala kehta hai, woh (badle mein) uske maa-baap ko bhi bura-bhala kehte hain. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Abu Dharr, tum ab bhi apne andar Jaahiliyat ki (baaki cheezein) rakhte ho. Woh (tumhare khaadim aur ghulam) tumhare bhai hain. Allah ne unhe tumhari dekhbhaal mein rakha hai, is liye unhe woh khilaao jo tum khaate ho, unhe woh pehnaao jo tum pehnte ho, aur unhe unki taaqat se zyada bojh mat do; lekin agar tum unhe (na uthaaye jaane laayak) bojh do, to unki madad karo (atirikt bojh baantkar).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash but with a slight variation of words, e. g. in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhair and Abu Mu'awiya after his words (these words of the Holy Prophet): " You are a person having the remnants of Ignorance in him." (these words also occur, that Abu Dharr) said: Even up to this time of my old age? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. In the tradition transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya (the words are):" Yes, in this time of your old age." In the tradition transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (the words are):" If you burden him (with an unbearable burden), you should sell him (and get another slave who can easily undertake this burden)." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhair (the words are):" Help him in that (work)." In the hadith transmitted by Abu Mu'awiya (separately) there is no such word: Then sell him or help him." This hadith concludes with these words:" Do not burden him beyond his capacity."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, jaise Zuhair aur Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein unke (Nabi ke) in alfaazon ke baad: "Tum ek aisa shakhs ho jismein Jaahiliyat ki baaki cheezein hain," ye alfaaz bhi milte hain ki Abu Dharr ne kaha: Kya mere is boodhape ke waqt bhi? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Haan. Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Haan, tumhare is boodhape ke waqt bhi." Isa ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Agar tum use (na uthaaye jaane laayak) bojh do, to tumhe use bech dena chahiye (aur ek doosra ghulam le lena chahiye jo asaani se ye bojh utha sake)." Zuhair ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Us kaam mein uski madad karo." Abu Mu'awiya ki (alag) riwayat ki hui hadees mein aisa koi lafz nahi hai: "Phir use becho ya uski madad karo." Ye hadees in alfaazon ke saath khatm hoti hai: "Use uski taaqat se zyada bojh mat do."

e: Ma'rur b. Suwaid reported: I saw Abu Dharr wearing clothes, and his slave wearing similar ones. I asked him about it, and he narrated that he had abused a person during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoe. him) and he reproached him for his mother. That person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made mention of that to him. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: You are a person who has (remnants of) Ignorance in him. Your slaves are brothers of yours. Allah has placed them in your hand, and he who has his brother under him, he should feed him with what he eats, and dress him with what he dresses himself, and do not burden them beyond their capacities, and if you burden them, (beyond their capacities), then help them.
hi: Ma'rur bin Suwaid ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Dharr ko kapde pehne dekha, aur unke ghulam ko bhi waisi hi pehne dekha. Maine unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein ek shakhs ko bura-bhala kaha tha aur uski maa ke baare mein use taane maare the. Woh shakhs Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse iska zikr kiya. Isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Tum ek aisa shakhs ho jismein (Jaahiliyat ki baaki) cheezein hain. Tumhare ghulam tumhare bhai hain. Allah ne unhe tumhare haath mein rakha hai, aur jiske adheen apna bhai ho, use woh khilaana chahiye jo woh khud khaata hai, aur unhe woh pehnaana chahiye jo woh khud pehnta hai, aur unhe unki taaqat se zyada bojh mat do, aur agar tum unhe (unki taaqat se zyada) bojh do, to unki madad karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is essential to feed the slave, clothe him (properly) and not burden him with work which is beyond his power.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ghulam ko khilaana zaroori hai, use theek se kapde pehnaana, aur use aisa kaam bojh na dena jo uski taaqat se zyada ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the slave of anyone amongst you prepares food for him and he serves him after having sat close to (and undergoing the hardship of) heat and smoke, he should make him (the slave) sit along with him and make him eat (along with him), and if the food seems to run short, then he should spare some portion for him (from his own share) - (another narrator) Dawud said:" i. e. a morsel or two". 4097
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se kisi ka ghulam uske liye khaana taiyaar karta hai aur woh use serve karta hai garmi aur dhuen ke bagal mein baithkar (aur uski takleef sehkar), use chahiye ki woh use (ghulam ko) apne saath baithaaye aur use bhi khilaaye, aur agar khaana kam lage, to use isme se kuch usse alag rakhna chahiye (apne hisse mein se). Dawud (ek raawi) ne kaha: yaani ek ya do niwaale.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a slave looks to the welfare of his master and worships Allah well, he has two rewards for him.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi ghulam apne maalik ki bhalaai ka khyaal rakhta hai aur achhi tarah Allah ki ibadat karta hai, uske liye do sawaab hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: For a faithful slave there are two rewards. By him in Whose hand is the life of Abu Huraira, but for Jihad in the cause of Allah, and Pilgrimage and kindness to my mother, I would have preferred to die as a slave. He (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: This news reached us that Abu Huraira did not perform Pilgrimage until his mother died for (keeping himself constantly) in her service.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek imaandaar ghulam ke liye do sawaab hain. Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Abu Huraira ki zindagi hai, agar Allah ki raah mein Jihad, aur Hajj, aur meri maa ke prati narmi na hoti, to mujhe ek ghulam ke soorat mein marna behtar lagta. Unhone (ek raawi ne) kaha: Ye khabar humein mili ki Abu Huraira ne apni maa ki maut tak Hajj nahi kiya, unki lagataar khidmat karne ke liye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Tahir but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Tahir ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a slave fulfils obligation of Allah and obligation of his master, he has two rewards for him. I narrated this to Ka'b, and Ka'b said: (Such a slave) has no accountability, nor has a poor believer.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi ghulam Allah ki zimmedaari aur apne maalik ki zimmedaari poori karta hai, uske liye do sawaab hain. Maine ye Ka'b ko riwayat ki, aur Ka'b ne kaha: (Aise ghulam) ka koi hisaab nahi hai, na ek gareeb momin ka.

e: The above hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Upar wali hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is good for a slave that he worships Allah well, and serves his master (well). It is good for him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek ghulam ke liye achhi baat hai ki woh Allah ki achhi ibadat kare, aur apne maalik ki (achhi) khidmat kare. Ye uske liye achha hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who gives up his share in a slave, and has enough money to pay the full price of the slave, then full emancipation devolves upon him; but if he has not the money, then he emancipated what he emancipated.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo ek ghulam mein apna hissa chhodta hai, aur uske paas ghulam ki poori keemat chukaane laayak paisa hai, to poori azaadi usper aa jaati hai; lekin agar uske paas paisa nahi hai, to usne utna hi azaad kiya jitna usne azaad kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who emancipates his share in the slave, it is his responsibility to secure full freedom for him provided he (the slave) has enough money to pay the (remaining) price, but it he has not so much money he would be emancipated to the extent that the first man emancipated.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi ghulam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, uski zimmedaari hai ki woh uski poori azaadi mahfooz kare bashart-e ki uske (ghulam ke) paas bache hue keemat chukaane laayak paisa ho, lekin agar uske paas itna paisa nahi hai to woh utna hi azaad kiya jaayega jitna pehle shakhs ne azaad kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who gives up his share in a slave, and he has money enough to meet the full price, a fair price for him should be fixed; otherwise be has emancipated him to the extent that he has emancipated.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi ghulam mein apna hissa chhodta hai, aur uske paas poori keemat chukaane laayak paisa hai, use ek munasib keemat tay ki jaani chahiye; warna usne utna hi azaad kiya jitna usne azaad kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who emancipates a slave (shared) by him and another one, his full price may be justly assessed from his wealth, neither less nor more, and he (the slave) would be emancipated if he (the partner) would be solvent enough (to forgo the amount of his share).
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo kisi ghulam ko azaad karta hai jo uska aur kisi doosre ka saanjha hai, uski poori keemat uski maal se munasib soorat se aankalan ki jaani chahiye, na kam na zyada, aur woh (ghulam) azaad ho jaayega agar woh (saanjhedaar) itna sakshampanna hai (apne hisse ki raqam maaf karne ke liye).

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who gives up his share in a slave, the remaining (share) will be paid out of his riches if his riches are enough to meet the price of the slave.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo koi ghulam mein apna hissa chhodta hai, baaki (hissa) uski daulat se ada kiya jaayega agar uski daulat ghulam ki keemat chukaane ke liye kaafi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: In case the slave is owned by two persons, and one of them emancipates him, he will guarantee (his full freedom).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar ghulam do logon ki malkiyat mein hai, aur unmein se ek use azaad karta hai, woh uski (poori azaadi ki) zamaanat lega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " He who emancipates a portion in a slave, he should (secure full) freedom for him from his property."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Jo kisi ghulam mein hissa azaad karta hai, use apni maal se uski poori azaadi mahfooz karni chahiye."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who emancipates his portion in a slave, full emancipation may be secured for him out of his property (if he has money) if he has enough property to meet (the required expenses), but if he has not enough property, the slave should be put to extra labour (in order to earn money for buying his freedom), but he should not be overburdened.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi ghulam mein apna hissa azaad karta hai, poori azaadi uski maal se mahfooz ki jaa sakti hai (agar uske paas paisa hai) agar uske paas zaroori kharche ke liye kaafi maal hai, lekin agar uske paas kaafi maal nahi hai, to ghulam ko atirikt kaam par lagaya jaana chahiye (apni azaadi ki keemat kamaane ke liye), lekin usse zyada bojh na daala jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " He will be required to work (in order to secure freedom) for that por- tion in which he has not been emancipated, without overburdening him."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Use us hisse ke liye kaam karne ki zaroorat hogi jismein uski azaadi nahi hui hai, usse zyada bojh daale bina."

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported that a person who had no other property emancipated six slaves of his at the time of his death. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for them and divided them into three sections, cast lots amongst them, and set two free and kept four in slavery; and he (the Holy Prophet) spoke severely of him.
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs jiske paas koi doosri maal nahi thi usne apni maut ke waqt apne chhe ghulam azaad kar diye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe bulaaya aur unhe teen hisson mein baanta, unke beech pardhe daale, aur do ko azaad kiya aur chaar ko ghulami mein rakha; aur unhone (Nabi ne) uski sakhti se aalochana ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " A person from among the Ansar willed away the freedom of six slaves of his at the time of his death."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne apni maut ke waqt apne chhe ghulamon ki azaadi ki wasiyat ki."

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Imran b. Husain through another chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Imran bin Husain ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that a person among the Ansar declared his slave free after his death, as he had no other property. This news reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Who will buy him from me? And Nu'aim b. al-Nahham bought him for eight hundred dirhams and he handed them over to him, 'Amr (one of the narrators) said: I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah as saying: He was a Coptic slave, and he died in the first year (of the Caliphate of 'Abdullah b. Zubair).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne apni maut ke baad apne ghulam ko azaad ailaan kiya, kyunki uske paas koi doosri maal nahi thi. Ye khabar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone kaha: Mujhse ise kaun khareedega? Aur Nu'aim bin al-Nahham ne use aath sau dirham mein khareeda aur unhe (raqam) soonp di. Amr (ek raawi) ne kaha: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Woh ek Qibti ghulam tha, aur unka intiqaal pehle saal (Abdullah bin Zubair ki khilafat ke) mein hua.

e: Jabir is reported to have said: A person amongst the Ansar who had no other property declared a slave free after his death. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sold him, and Ibn al-Nahham bought him and he was a Coptic slave (who) died in the first year of the Caliphate of Ibn Zubair.
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Ansar mein se ek shakhs jiske paas koi doosri maal nahi thi, usne apni maut ke baad ek ghulam ko azaad ailaan kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use becha, aur Ibn al-Nahham ne use khareeda aur woh ek Qibti ghulam tha (jinka) intiqaal Ibn Zubair ki khilafat ke pehle saal mein hua.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sahl b. Abu Hathma and Rafi' b. Khadij reported that 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid and Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid went out and as they reached Khaibar they were separated. Then Muhayyisa found 'Abdullah b. Sahl having been killed. He buried him, and then came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). They were Huwayyisa b. Mas'ud and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl, and he (the latter one) was the youngest of the people (those three who had come to seek an interview with the Holy Prophet) began to talk before his Companions (had spoken). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The eldest one (eldest in regard to age should speak). So he kept quiet, and his companions (Muhayyisa and Huwayyisa) began to speak, and he ('Abd al Rahman) spoke along with them and they narrated to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the murder of 'Abdullah b. Sahl. Thereupon he said to them: Are you prepared to take fifty oaths so that you may be entitled (to blood-wit) of your companion (or your man who has murdered)? They said: How can we take an oath on a matter which we have not witnessed? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then the Jews will exonerate themselves by fifty oaths. They said: How can we accept the oaths of people who are unbelievers? When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that, he himself paid his blood-wit.
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma aur Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid aur Muhayyisa bin Mas'ud bin Zaid nikle aur jab woh Khaibar pahunche woh alag ho gaye. Phir Muhayyisa ne Abdullah bin Sahl ko qatal paaya. Unhone use dafn kiya, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye. Woh Huwayyisa bin Mas'ud aur Abd al-Rahman bin Sahl the, aur woh (aakhri wala) logon mein sabse chhote (jo Nabi se milne aaye the) apne saathiyon se pehle bolne lage. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sabse bada (umar mein sabse bada bolna chahiye). To woh khamosh ho gaye, aur unke saathi (Muhayyisa aur Huwayyisa) bolne lage, aur woh (Abd al-Rahman) unke saath bhi bola aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Abdullah bin Sahl ke qatal ka zikr kiya. Isper unhone unse kaha: Kya tum pachaas qasamein khaane ke liye taiyaar ho taaki tum apne saathi ke haq (khoon-baha) ke haqdaar ho sako (ya us aadmi ke jisne qatal kiya)? Unhone kaha: Hum ek aise maamle par kaise qasam khaayein jise humne khud nahi dekha? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: To Yahudi pachaas qasamon se khud ko bekasoor sabit karenge. Unhone kaha: Hum un logon ki qasamein kaise qubool karein jo kaafir hain? Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye dekha, unhone khud khoon-baha ada ki.

e: Sahl. b. Abu Hathma and Rafi' b. Khadij reported that Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud and 'Abdullah b. Sahl went towards Khaibar and they separated near the palm-trees. 'Abdullah b. Sahl was killed. They accused the Jews (for this act). And there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) his brother (the brother of the slain person) 'Abd al-Rahman and his cousins Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa; and 'Abd al-Rahman talked to him about the matter pertaining to (the murder of) his brother, and he was the youngest among them. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Show regard for the greatness of the old, or he said: Let the eldest begin speaking. Then they (Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa) spoke about the matter of their companion (murder of their cousin, 'Abdullah b. Sahl). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Let fifty (persons) among you take oath for levelling the charge (of murder) against a person amongst them, and he would be surrendered to you. They said: We have not witnessed this matter ourselves. How can we then take oath? He (the Holy Prophet) said: The Jews will exonerate themselves by the oaths of fifty of them. They said: Messenger of Allah, they are non-believing people. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood wit for him. Sahl said: As one day I entered the fold a she-camel amongst those camels hit me with its leg.
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma aur Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya ki Muhayyisa bin Mas'ud aur Abdullah bin Sahl Khaibar ki taraf gaye aur woh khajoor ke darakhton ke qareeb alag ho gaye. Abdullah bin Sahl qatal kar diya gaya. Unhone Yahudiyon par ilzaam lagaaya (is amal ke liye). Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas unka bhai (marne wale shakhs ka bhai) Abd al-Rahman aur unke chachere bhai Huwayyisa aur Muhayyisa aaye; aur Abd al-Rahman ne unse apne bhai ke maamle ke baare mein baat ki, aur woh unmein sabse chhote the. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Boodhon ki azmat ka khyaal rakho, ya unhone kaha: Sabse bade ko bolna shuru karne do. Phir woh (Huwayyisa aur Muhayyisa) apne saathi ke maamle (unke chachere bhai Abdullah bin Sahl ke qatal) ke baare mein bole. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se pachaas (log) ilzaam (qatal ka) lagaane ke liye qasam khaayein ek shakhs par unmein se, aur woh tumhe soonp diya jaayega. Unhone kaha: Humne khud ye maamla nahi dekha. Hum kaise qasam khaayein? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Yahudi apni pachaas qasamon se khud ko bekasoor sabit karenge. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaafir log hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki taraf se khoon-baha ada ki. Sahl ne kaha: Ek din jab main us bade mein daakhil hua un oonton mein se ek oontni ne mujhe apni taang se maara.

e: Sahl b. Abu Hathma has narrated this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words, but no mention has been made of the hitting by the she-camel.
hi: Sahl bin Abu Hathma ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai, lekin oontni ke maarne ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Abu Hathma ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Bushair b. Yasar reported that 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid and Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid, both of them were Ansar belonging to the tribe of Banu Haritha, set out to Khaibar during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). There was peace during those days and (this place) was inhabited by the Jews. They parted company for their (respective) needs. 'Abdullab b. Sahl was killed, and his dead body was found in a tank. His companion (Muhayyisa) buried him and came to Medina, and the brothers of the slain 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl. and Muhayyisa and Huwayyisa told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the case of 'Abdullah and the place where he had been murdered. Bushair reported on the authority of one who had seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he had said to them: You take fifty oaths and you are entitled to blood-wit of (one) slain among you (or your companion). They said: Messenger of Allah, we neither saw (with our own eyes this murder) nor were we present there. Thereupon (Allah's Messenger is reported to have said): Then the Jews will exonerate themselves by taking fifty oaths. They said: Allah's Messenger, how can we accept the oath of unbelieving people? Bushair said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood-wit himself.
hi: Bushair bin Yasar ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid aur Muhayyisa bin Mas'ud bin Zaid, donon Ansar Banu Haritha qabile se the, Khaibar nikle Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Un dinon shaanti thi aur (ye jagah) Yahudiyon ke zariye basi hui thi. Woh apni (alag) zaroorat ke liye alag ho gaye. Abdullab bin Sahl qatal kar diya gaya, aur uski laash ek talab mein mili. Unke saathi (Muhayyisa) ne use dafn kiya aur Madina aaye, aur marne wale ke bhai Abd al-Rahman bin Sahl, aur Muhayyisa aur Huwayyisa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Abdullah ka maamla aur jagah jahan unhe qatal kiya gaya tha bataayi. Bushair ne un logon se riwayat ki jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha tha ki unhone (Nabi ne) unse kaha: Tum pachaas qasamein khaao aur tum apne beech ke ek qatal shakhs (ya apne saathi) ka khoon-baha paane ke haqdaar ho jaate ho. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humne na to (apni aankhon se ye qatal) dekha na hi hum wahan maujood the. Isper (Allah ke Rasool ne kaha): Phir Yahudi pachaas qasamein leke khud ko bekasoor sabit karenge. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum kaafiron ki qasam kaise qubool karein? Bushair ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud khoon-baha ada ki.

e: Bushair b. Yasar reported that a person from the Ansar belonging to the tribe of Banu Haritha who was called 'Abdullah b. Sahl b. Zaid set out and the son of his uncle called Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud b. Zaid, the rest of the hadith is the same up to the words: " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid the blood-wit himself." Bushair b. Yasar reported that Sahl b. Abu Hathma said: One camel amongst the camels paid as blood-wit kicked me while I was in the (camel) enclosure.
hi: Bushair bin Yasar ne bayan kiya ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs Banu Haritha qabile se, jise Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid kaha jaata tha, nikla aur unke chacha ka beta jise Muhayyisa bin Mas'ud bin Zaid kaha jaata tha, baaki hadees waisi hi hai in alfaazon tak: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud khoon-baha ada ki." Bushair bin Yasar ne bayan kiya ki Sahl bin Abu Hathma ne kaha: Khoon-baha mein diye gaye oonton mein se ek oont ne mujhe laat maari jab main (oont ke) bade mein tha.

e: Bushair b. Yasar al-Ansari reported on the authority of Sahl b. Abu Hathma al-Ansari that some men (of his tribe went to Khaibar, and they were separated from one another, and they found one of them slain. The rest of the hadith is the same. And it was said in this connection: Allah's Messenger (may peace be him) did not approve of his blood go waste. He paid blood-wit of one hundred camels of Sadaqa.
hi: Bushair bin Yasar al-Ansari ne Sahl bin Abu Hathma al-Ansari ke hawale se riwayat ki ki unke qabile ke kuch log Khaibar gaye, aur woh ek-doosre se alag ho gaye, aur unhone unmein se ek ko qatal paaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Aur isi silsile mein kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uska khoon bekaar jaane dena manzoor nahi kiya. Unhone sadaqe ke sau oont khoon-baha ke soorat mein ada kiye.

e: Abu Laila 'Abdullah b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl reported that the elderly persons of (the tribe) had informed Sahl b. Abu Hathma that 'Abdullah b. Sahl and Muhayyisa went out to Khaibar under some distress which had afflicted them. Muhayyisa came and informed that Abdutlah b. Sahl had been killed, and (his dead body) had been thrown in a well or in a ditch. He came to the Jews and said: By Allah, it is you who have killed him. They said: By Allah, we have not killed him. He then came to his people, and made mention of that to them. Then came he and his brother Huwayyisa, and he was older than he, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl. Then Muhayyisa went to speak, and it was he who had accompanied ('Abdullah) to Khaibar, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Muhayyisa: Observe greatness of the great (he meant the seniority of age). Then Huwayyisa spoke and then Muhayyisa also spoke. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: They should either pay blood-wit for your companion, or be prepared for war. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote about it to them (to the Jews). They wrote: Verily, by Allah, we have not killed him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Huwayyisa and Muhayyisa and Abd al-Rahman: Are you prepared to take oath in order to entitle yourselves for the blood-wit of your companion? They said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then the Jews will take oath (of their innocence). They said: They are not Muslims. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), however, himself paid the blood-wit to them and sent to them one hundred camels until they entered into their houses, Sahl said: One red she-camel among them kicked me.
hi: Abu Laila Abdullah bin Abd al-Rahman bin Sahl ne bayan kiya ki (unke qabile ke) boodhe logon ne Sahl bin Abu Hathma ko bataya tha ki Abdullah bin Sahl aur Muhayyisa Khaibar gaye kisi pareshaani ki wajah se jo unhe hui thi. Muhayyisa aaye aur bataya ki Abdullah bin Sahl qatal kar diya gaya, aur (unki laash) ek kuen ya khaai mein phenki gayi. Woh Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumne hi unhe qatal kiya hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne unhe qatal nahi kiya. Woh phir apne logon ke paas gaye, aur unse iska zikr kiya. Phir woh aur unke bhai Huwayyisa, jo unse bade the, aur Abd al-Rahman bin Sahl aaye. Phir Muhayyisa bolne lage, aur woh (Abdullah ke saath) Khaibar gaye the, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Muhayyisa se kaha: Baade (umar mein) ki azmat ka khyaal rakho (unka matlab umar mein sabse bada tha). Phir Huwayyisa bole aur phir Muhayyisa bhi bole. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ya to woh tumhare saathi ke liye khoon-baha adaa karein, ya jung ke liye taiyaar rahein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (Yahudiyon ko) iske baare mein likha. Unhone likha: Yaqeenan, Allah ki qasam, humne unhe qatal nahi kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Huwayyisa aur Muhayyisa aur Abd al-Rahman se kaha: Kya tum apne saathi ka khoon-baha paane ke liye qasam khaane ko taiyaar ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: To Yahudi qasam khaayenge (apni bekasooriyat ki). Unhone kaha: Woh Musalman nahi hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne, halaanki, khud unhe khoon-baha ada ki aur unhe sau oont bheje yahan tak ki woh apne gharon mein daakhil hue. Sahl ne kaha: Unmein se ek laal oontni ne mujhe laat maari.

e: Sulaiman b. Yasar, the freed slave of Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), narrated from one of the Ansari Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) retained (the practice) of Qasama as it was in the pre-Islamic days.
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar, Maimuna (Allah ke Rasool ki zauja) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek Ansari sahabi se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Qasama (ke tareeke) ko barkarar rakha jaisa ye Islam se pehle ke daur mein tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided (according to Qasama) between the persons of Ansar (and yours) about a slain (Muslim) for which they made claim against the Jews
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke logon (aur tumhare) ke beech ek qatal (Musalman) ke maamle mein faisla kiya jiske liye unhone Yahudiyon ke khilaaf daawa kiya."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman and Sulaiman b. Yasar.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman aur Sulaiman bin Yasar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that some people belonging (to the tribe) of 'Uraina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Medina, but they found its climate uncogenial. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them: If you so like, you may go to the camels of Sadaqa and drink their milk and urine. They did so and were all right. They then fell upon the shepherds and killed them and turned apostates from Islam and drove off the camels of the Prophet (ﷺ). This news reached Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he sent (people) on their track and they were (brought) and handed over to him. He (the Holy Prophet) got their hands cut off, and their feet, and put out their eyes, and threw them on the stony ground until they died.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Uraina qabile ke kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Madina mein aaye, lekin unhe wahan ka mausam anukool nahi laga. Is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Agar tum chaho, to tum sadaqe ke oonton ke paas ja sakte ho aur unka doodh aur peshaab pee sakte ho. Unhone aisa kiya aur theek ho gaye. Woh phir gadariyon par jhapat pade aur unhe qatal kar diya aur Islam se murtad ho gaye aur Nabi (SAW) ke oont haank kar le gaye. Ye khabar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone unka pichha karne (logon ko) bheja aur unhe (laaya gaya) aur unhe soonpa gaya. Unhone (Nabi ne) unke haath aur paon kaat diye, aur unki aankhein nikaal din, aur unhe patthreeli zameen par phenka jab tak woh mar gaye.

e:
Anas reported: Eight men of the tribe of 'Ukl came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and swore allegiance to him on Islam, but found the climate of that land uncogenial to their health and thus they became sick, and they made complaint of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: Why don't you go to (the fold) of our camels along with our shepherd, and make use of their milk and urine. They said: Yes. They set out and drank their (camels') milk and urine and regained their health. They killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. This (news) reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he sent them on their track and they were caught and brought to him (the Holy Prophet). He commanded about them, and (thus) their hands and feet were cut off and their eyes were gouged and then they were thrown in the sun, until they died. 
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn al-Sabbah with a slight variation of words.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Ukl qabile ke aath aadmi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone Islam par unse bai'at ki, lekin unhe us zameen ka mausam apni sehat ke liye anukool nahi laga, aur is tarah woh bimaar pad gaye, aur unhone iski shikaayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki, aur unhone kaha: Tum humare oonton ke (baade) mein hamare gadariye ke saath kyun nahi jaate, aur unka doodh aur peshaab kyun nahi istemal karte? Unhone kaha: Haan. Woh nikle aur unka (oonton ka) doodh aur peshaab piya aur apni sehat wapas paayi. Unhone gadariye ko qatal kiya aur oont haank kar le gaye. Ye (khabar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi aur unhone unka pichha karne (logon ko) bheja aur unhe pakda gaya aur unke (Nabi ke) paas laaya gaya. Unhone unke baare mein hukum diya, aur (is tarah) unke haath aur paon kaat diye gaye aur unki aankhein nikaal di gayin aur phir unhe dhoop mein phenka gaya, jab tak woh mar gaye. Ye hadees Ibn al-Sabbah ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that some people of the tribe of 'Ukl or 'Uraina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and they found the climate of Medina uncogenial. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded them to the milch she-camels and commanded them to drink their urine and their milk. The rest of the hadith is the same (and the concluding words are): " Their eyes were pierced, and they were thrown on the stony ground. They were asking for water, but they were not given water."
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Ukl ya Uraina qabile ke kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur unhe Madina ka mausam anukool nahi laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe doodh dene wali oontniyon (ke paas jaane) ka hukum diya aur unhe unka peshaab aur doodh peene ka hukum diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai (aur samaapti ke alfaaz hain): "Unki aankhein bhedi gayin, aur unhe patthreeli zameen par phenka gaya. Woh paani maang rahe the, lekin unhe paani nahi diya gaya."

e: Abu Qilaba reported: I was sitting behind 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz and he said to the people: What do you say about al-Qasama? Thereupon 'Anbasa said: Anas b Malik narrated to us such and such (hadith pertaining to al-Qasama). I said: This is what Anas had narrated to me: People came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and the rest of the hadith is the same. When I (Abu Qilaba) finished (the narration of this hadith), 'Anbasa said: Hallowed be Allah. I said: Do you blame me (for telling a lie)? He ('Anbasa) said: No. This is how Anas b Malik narrated to us. O people of Syria, you would not be deprived of good, so long as such (a person) or one like him lives amongst you.
hi: Abu Qilaba ne bayan kiya: Main Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ke peeche baitha tha aur unhone logon se kaha: Aap al-Qasama ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Isper Anbasa ne kaha: Anas bin Malik ne humein aisi-aisi (hadees al-Qasama se mutalliq) riwayat ki. Maine kaha: Ye hai jo Anas ne mujhe riwayat ki: Log Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Jab main (Abu Qilaba) is hadees ki riwayat khatm kar chuka, Anbasa ne kaha: Allah muqaddas hai. Maine kaha: Kya aap mujhpar ilzaam laga rahe hain (jhoot bolne ka)? Unhone (Anbasa ne) kaha: Nahi. Ye waisa hi hai jaisa Anas bin Malik ne humein riwayat ki. Aye Syria ke logo, tumhe achhaai se mehroom nahi kiya jaayega, jab tak aise (shakhs) ya isi jaisa koi tumhare beech rahe.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eight persons from the tribe of 'Ukl, but with this addition that he did not cauterise (the wounds which hid been inflicted upon them while punishing them).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Ukl qabile ke aath log aaye, lekin is izafe ke saath ki unhone (unhe saza dete waqt jo zakhm lage the unhe) daagha nahi.

e: Anas reported: There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some ponple from 'Uraina. They embraced Islam and swore allegiance to him and there had spread at that time pleurisy. The rest of the hadith is the same (but with this addition):" There were by his (the Prophet's) side about twenty young men of the Ansar; he sent them (behind) them (culprits), and he also sent along with them one expert in following the track so that he might trace their footprints."
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Uraina se kuch log aaye. Unhone Islam qubool kiya aur unse bai'at ki aur us waqt pleurisy (ek beemari) failel thi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai (lekin is izafe ke saath): "Unke (Nabi ke) pehlu mein Ansar ke bees jawaan the; unhone unhe (aparaadhiyon ka) pichha karne bheja, aur unhone unke saath ek pairon ke nishaan ka mahir bhi bheja taaki woh unke pairon ke nishaan dhoondh sake."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pierced their eyes because they had pierced the eyes of the shepherds.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki aankhein is liye bhedi kyunki unhone gadariyon ki aankhein bhedi thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a Jew killed a girl with a stone for her silver ornaments. She was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when there was yet some life in her. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: Has so and so killed you? She indicated with the nod of her head: No. He said for the second time, and she again said: No with the nod of her head. He asked for the third time, and she said: Yes with the nod of her head and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded to crush his head between two stones.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi ne ek larki ko uske chandi ke gehnon ke liye patthar se maarkar qatal kiya. Use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya jab usmein abhi kuch jaan baaki thi. Unhone (Nabi ne) usse kaha: Kya falan-falan ne tumhe maara? Usne sar hilaakar ishara kiya: Nahi. Unhone doosri baar poocha, aur usne phir sar hilaakar kaha: Nahi. Unhone teesri baar poocha, aur usne haan mein sar hilaakar kaha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki uska sar do pattharon ke beech kuchla jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith narrated on the authority of Ibn Idris (the words are): " He (commanded) to crush his head between two stones."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Ibn Idris ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone (hukum diya) ki uska sar do pattharon ke beech kuchla jaaye."

e: Anas reported that a Jew killed a girl of the Ansar for her ornaments and then threw her in a well and smashed her head with a stone. He was caught and brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he commanded that he should be stoned to death. So he was stoned until he died.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi ne Ansar ki ek larki ko uske gehnon ke liye qatal kiya aur phir use ek kuen mein phenka aur ek patthar se uska sar kuchal diya. Use pakda gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aur unhone hukum diya ki use sangsaar karke maara jaaye. To use sangsaar kiya gaya yahan tak ki woh mar gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: A girl was found with her head crushed between two stones. They asked her as to who had done that-has so and so (done it) until they mentioned a Jew. She indicated with the nod of her head (that it was so). So the Jew was caught, and he made confession (of his guilt). And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that his head be smashed with stones.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Ek larki paayi gayi jiska sar do pattharon ke beech kuchla gaya tha. Unhone usse poocha ki kisne aisa kiya - kya falan-falan (yahan tak ki unhone ek Yahudi ka naam liya). Usne sar hilaakar ishara kiya (ki haan aisa hi tha). To Yahudi pakda gaya, aur usne apna gunah qubool kiya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki uska sar pattharon se kuchla jaaye.

e: Imran b. Husain reported: Ya'la b. Munya or Ibn Umayya fought with a person, and the one bit the hand of the other. And he tried to draw his hand from his mouth and thus his foreteeth ware pulled out. They referred their dispute to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Does any one of you bite as the camel bites? So there is no blood-wit for it.
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya: Ya'la bin Munya ya Ibn Umayya ne ek shakhs se ladaai ki, aur ek ne doosre ka haath kaata. Aur usne apna haath uske munh se kheenchne ki koshish ki aur is tarah uski aage ke daant nikal gaye. Unhone apna jhagda Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas rakha, isper unhone kaha: Kya tum mein se koi oont ki tarah kaatta hai? Is liye iska koi khoon-baha nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ya'la.
hi: Ye hadees Ya'la ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported that a person bit the arm of another person; he pulled it out and his foretooth fell down. This matter was taken to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he turned it down saying: Did you want to eat his flesh?
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne doosre shakhs ki baazu kaati; usne use kheencha aur uska agla daant gir gaya. Ye maamla Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aur unhone ise radd kiya ye kehte hue: Kya tum uska gosht khaana chahte the?

e: Safwan b. Ya'la reported that a person bit the arm of the servant of Ya'la b. Munya. He pulled it and his foretooth fell. The matter was referred to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he turned it down and said: Did you intend to bite his hand, as the camel bites?
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Ya'la bin Munya ke khaadim ki baazu kaati. Usne use kheencha aur uska agla daant gir gaya. Maamla Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja gaya aur unhone ise radd kiya aur kaha: Kya tumhara iraada uska haath oont ki tarah kaatne ka tha?

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported that a person bit the hand of a person. He withdrew his hand and his foretooth or foreteeth fell down. He (the man who lost his teeth) referred the matter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said, What do you want me to do? Do you ask me that I should order him to put his hand in your mouth, and you should bite it as the camel bites? (If you want retaliation, then the only way out is) that you put your hand in his mouth (allow him) to bite that and then draw it away.
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne kisi ka haath kaata. Usne apna haath kheencha aur uska agla daant ya daant gir gaye. Usne (jise daant khoye) apna maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas rakha aur unhone kaha: Tum mujhse kya chaahte ho? Kya tum mujhse maang rahe ho ki main use hukum dun ki woh apna haath tumhare munh mein rakhe, aur tum use kaato jaise oont kaatta hai? (Agar tum badla chaahte ho, to sirf ek hi raasta hai) ki tum apna haath uske munh mein daalo (aur use ijazat do) ki woh use kaate aur phir use kheench le.

e: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Munya reported on the authority of his father that there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a person who had bitten the hand of another person and who had withdrawn his hand (and as a result thereof) his foreteeth had fallen (those which had bitten). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) turned down his (claim), and said: Do you wish to bite as the camel bites?
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Munya ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek shakhs aaya jisne doosre shakhs ka haath kaata tha aur jisne apna haath kheencha tha (aur natijatan) uske agle daant gir gaye the (jinhone kaata tha). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske (daawe ko) radd kiya, aur kaha: Kya tum oont ki tarah kaatna chaahte the?

e: Safwan b. Ya'la b. Umayya thus reported from his father: I participated in the expedition to Tabuk with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). And Ya'la used to say: That was the most weighty of my deeds, in my opinion. Safwan said that Ya'la had stated: I had a servant; he quarrelled with another person, and the one bit the hand of the other. ('Ata' said that Safwan had told him which one had bitten the hand of the other.) So he whose hand was bitten drew ill from (the mouth) of the one who had bitten it and (in this scuffle) one of his foreteeth was also drawn out. They both came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he declared his (claim for the compensation of) tooth as invalid.
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umayya ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ki muhim mein shaamil hua. Aur Ya'la kaha karte the: Ye mere khyaal se mere amalon mein sabse sangin tha. Safwan ne kaha ki Ya'la ne bataya: Mera ek khaadim tha; usne kisi doosre shakhs se jhagda kiya, aur ek ne doosre ka haath kaata. (Ata ne kaha ki Safwan ne unhe bataya tha ki kisne kisi ka haath kaata tha.) To jiska haath kaata gaya usne apna haath kaatne wale ke munh se kheencha aur (is jhagde mein) uska ek agla daant bhi nikal gaya. Woh donon Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone uska (daant ke muaaviza ka) daawa nishprabhaavi ailaan kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Umm Haritha, the sister of Rubayyi' (she was the father's sister of Hadrat Anas) injured a person (she broke his teeth). The dispute was referred to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Retribution, retribution. Umm Rubayyi' said: Messenger of Allah, will retribution be taken from so and so? By Allah, it shall not be taken from her (i. e. from Umm Haritha). Thereupon Allah's Apostle said: Hallowed be Allah. O Umm Rubayyi', Qisas (retribution is a command, prescribed) in the Book of Allah. She said: No, by Allah, Qisas will never be taken from her; and she went on saying this until they (the relatives of the one who had been injured) accepted the blood-wit. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily there are amongst the servants of Allah (such pious persons) who, if they take oath of Allah, He honours it.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Umm Haritha, Rubayyi ki behn (jo Hazrat Anas ki phupi thin) ne ek shakhs ko chot pahunchaayi (uske daant tod diye). Jhagda Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Badla, badla. Umm Rubayyi ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya falan-falan se badla liya jaayega? Allah ki qasam, ye unse (yaani Umm Haritha se) nahi liya jaayega. Isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Allah muqaddas hai. Aye Umm Rubayyi, Qisas (badla ek hukum hai, jo) Allah ki Kitaab mein muqarrar hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Qisas kabhi unse nahi liya jaayega; aur woh ye kehti rahi yahan tak ki unhone (jinhe chot lagi thi unke rishtedaaron ne) khoon-baha qubool kar liya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke bandon mein (aise nek log) hain jo agar Allah ki qasam khaayein, to Woh usse izzat deta hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not permissible to take the life of a Muslim who bears testimony (to the fact that there is no god but Allah, and I am the Messenger of Allah, but in one of the three cases: the married adulterer, a life for life, and the deserter of his Din (Islam), abandoning the community.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ki jaan lena jaayez nahi hai jo gawaahi deta hai (ki Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon), siwaay teen sooraton mein se ek mein: shaadishuda vyabhichaari, jaan ke badle jaan, aur apne deen (Islam) chhodne wala, jama'at ko chhodkar.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said: By Him besides Whom there is no god but He, the blood of a Muslim who bears the testimony that there is no god but Allah, and I am His Messenger, may be lawfully shed only in case of three persons: the one who abandons Islam, and deserts the community [Ahmad, one of the narrators, is doubtful whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used the word li'l-jama'ah or al-jama'ah), and the married adulterer, and life for life.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, ek Musalman ka khoon jo gawaahi deta hai ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi aur main Uska Rasool hoon, sirf teen logon ke maamle mein jaayez taur par bahaaya jaa sakta hai: woh jo Islam chhodta hai, aur jama'at chhodta hai (Ahmad, ek raawi, ko shak hai ki Nabi ne "li'l-jama'ah" ya "al-jama'ah" lafz istemal kiya), aur shaadishuda vyabhichaari, aur jaan ke badle jaan.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of words, i. e. he did not say: By Him besides Whom there is no god.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, yaani unhone ye nahi kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: No person who is killed unjustly, but the share of (this offence of his also) falls upon the first son of Adam, for he was the first to introduce killing.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Koi bhi shakhs jo anyaay se qatal kiya jaata hai, iska hissa Aadam ke pehle bete par padta hai, kyunki woh qatal ki pehli shuruaat karne wale the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jarir and 'Isa b. Yunus with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Jarir aur Isa bin Yunus ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. (Mas'ud) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The first (thing) that will be decided among people on the Day of Judgment will pertain to bloodshed.
hi: Abdullah bin (Mas'ud) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse pehli cheez jiska faisla Qayamat ke din logon ke beech hoga woh khoon-kharaaba se mutalliq hogi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Bakra reported that (in the Farewell Address) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Time has completed a cycle and come to the state of the day when Allah created the heavens and the earth. The year is constituted of twelve months, of which four are sacred; three of them consecutive, viz. Dhu'l-Qa'da, Dhu'l- Hijja and Muharram, and also Rajab the month of Mudar which comes between Jumada and Sha'ban. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: which month is this? We said Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) remained silent for some time until we thought that he would give it a name other than that (by which it was known). He said: Is it not Dha'l-Hijja? We said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Which city is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the Holy Prophety remained silent until we thought that he would give it another name. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is it not the Balda (the city of Mecca)? We said: Yes. He said: What day is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the Holy Prophet) remained silent until we thought that he would give it another name. He said: Is it not the Day of Sacrifice? We said: Allah's Messenger. yes. Thereupon he said: Your blood, your property (Muhammad, one of the narrators, said: I think, he also said this) and your honour are sacred to you like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this city of yours, and in this month of yours. You will soon meet your Lord and He will ask you about your deeds. So do not turn after me unbelievers (or misguided), some of you striking the necks of the others. Behold I let him who is present convey to him who is absent, for many a one whom a message is conveyed has a more retentive memory than one who hears. He again said: Behold! have I not delivered (the message) to you? This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Abu Bakra ne bayan kiya ki (Vida ke khutba mein) Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Waqt ne ek chakkar poora kar liya hai aur us din ki haalat mein wapas aa gaya hai jab Allah ne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye the. Saal baarah mahinon se bana hai, jinmein se chaar muqaddas hain; teen unmein se lagataar hain, yaani Dhu'l-Qa'da, Dhu'l-Hijja aur Muharram, aur Rajab bhi, Mudar ka mahina, jo Jumada aur Sha'ban ke beech aata hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir kaha: Ye kaunsa mahina hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh (Nabi) kuch der khamosh rahe yahan tak ki humein laga ki woh ise koi aur naam denge jis naam se ye jaana jaata hai. Unhone kaha: Kya ye Dha'l-Hijja nahi hai? Humne kaha: Haan. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ye kaunsa shehar hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone (Nabi ne) khamoshi rakhi yahan tak ki humein laga ki woh ise koi aur naam denge. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Kya ye Balda (Makkah ka shehar) nahi hai? Humne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Ye kaunsa din hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone (Nabi ne) khamoshi rakhi yahan tak ki humein laga ki woh ise koi aur naam denge. Unhone kaha: Kya ye Qurbaani ka din nahi hai? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan. Isper unhone kaha: Tumhara khoon, tumhari maal (Muhammad, ek raawi, ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha) aur tumhari izzat tumhare liye utni hi muqaddas hai jitni tumhare is din ki pavitrata hai, tumhare is shehar mein, aur tumhare is mahine mein. Tum jald hi apne Rab se miloge aur Woh tumse tumhare amalon ke baare mein poochega. Is liye mere baad kaafir (ya gumraah) mat ban jaana, tum mein se kuch doosron ki gardanein na maarein. Dekho, jo yahan maujood hai woh usse ye baat pahunchaaye jo yahan nahi hai, kyunki jise ye payaam pahunchaaya jaata hai unmein se kayi log sunne wale se zyada mazboot yaadaasht rakhte hain. Unhone dobara kaha: Dekho! Kya maine tumhe (payaam) pahunchaa nahi diya? Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Bakra reported that when it was that day (the 10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) he mounted his camel and a person caught its nosestring, whereupon he said: Do you know which day is this? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best. (The Prophet  kept silent) until we thought that he would give that another name. He said: Is it not the day of Nahr (Sacrifice) (10th of Dhu'l- Hijja)? We said: Allah's Messenger, yes. He (again) said: Which month is it? We said: Allah and His Messenger knows best. He said: Is it not Dhu'l-Hijja? We said: Allah's Messenger, yes. He said: Which city is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He (the narrator) said (that the Prophet kept silent until we thought that he would give it another name besides its (original) name. He said: Is it not Balda (the city of Mecca)? We said: Yes, Allah's Messenger. He (then) said: Verily your blood (lives) and your property and your honour are as sacred unto you as sacred is this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours. Let him who is present convey it to one who is absent. He then turned his attention towards two multicoloured (black and white) rams and slaughtered them, and two goats, and distributed them amongst us.
hi: Abu Bakra ne bayan kiya ki jab woh din (10 Zul-Hijja) tha, woh apne oont par sawaar hue aur ek shakhs ne uski naak ki rassi pakadi, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai ye kaunsa din hai? Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. (Nabi khamosh rahe) yahan tak ki humein laga ki woh ise koi aur naam denge. Unhone kaha: Kya ye Nahr ka din (Qurbaani ka din, 10 Zul-Hijja) nahi hai? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan. Unhone (dobara) kaha: Ye kaunsa mahina hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone kaha: Kya ye Dhu'l-Hijja nahi hai? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan. Unhone kaha: Ye kaunsa shehar hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha (ki Nabi khamosh rahe yahan tak ki humein laga ki woh iske asal naam ke ilawa koi aur naam denge. Unhone kaha: Kya ye Balda (Makkah ka shehar) nahi hai? Humne kaha: Haan, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone (phir) kaha: Yaqeenan tumhara khoon (zindagiyaan) aur tumhari maal aur tumhari izzat tumhare liye utni hi muqaddas hai jitni tumhare is din ki pavitrata hai, tumhare is mahine mein, tumhare is shehar mein. Jo yahan maujood hai woh isse us tak pahunchaaye jo yahan nahi hai. Woh phir do rangeen (kaale aur safed) mendhon ki taraf muqe aur unhe zibah kiya, aur do bakriyon ko bhi, aur unhe humme beech baanta.

e: Abu Bakra reported that when it was the day of (Dhu'l-Hijja) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) mounted the camel and addressed and a person had been holding its nosestring. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Bakra ne bayan kiya ki jab woh din (Dhu'l-Hijja ka) tha, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) oont par sawaar hue aur khitaab diya aur ek shakhs uski naak ki rassi pakde hue tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Bakra through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr (Sacrifice) and said: What day is this? And the rest of the hadith is the same except that he did not make mention of" your honour," and also did not make mention of this: He then turned his attention towards two rams and what follows, and in a hadith (the words pertaining to sacred- ness are recorded in this way):" Like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours to the day when you will meet your Lord. Behold, have I not conveyed (the Message of God)? They said: Yes. He said: O Allah, bear witness."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bakra ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr (Qurbaani) ke din khutba diya aur kaha: Ye kaunsa din hai? Aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone "tumhari izzat" ka koi zikr nahi kiya, aur unhone iska bhi koi zikr nahi kiya ki woh phir do mendhon ki taraf mude aur uske baad ki baat, aur ek hadees mein (pavitrata se mutalliq alfaaz is tarah likhe hue hain): "Jaisi tumhare is din ki pavitrata hai, tumhare is mahine mein, tumhare is shehar mein, us din tak jab tum apne Rab se miloge. Dekho, kya maine payaam pahunchaa diya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, gawaah rehna."

e: 'Alqama b. Wa'il reported on the authority of his-father: While I was sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), a person came there dragging another one with the help of a strap and said: Allah's Messenger, this man has killed my brother. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Did you kill him? And the other man said: (In case he did not make a confession of this, I shall brine, a witness against him). He (the murderer) said: Yes, I have killed him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Why did you kill him? He said: I and he won striking down the leaves of a tree and he abused me and enraged me, and to I struck his head with an axe and killed him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you anything with you to pay blood-wit on your behalf? He said: I do not possess any property but this robe of mine and this axe of mine. He (the Holy, Prophet) said: Do you think your people will pay ransom for you? He said: I am more insignificant among my people than this (that I would not be able to get this benefit from my tribe). He (the Holy Prophet) threw the strap towards him (the claimant of the blood-wit) saying: Take away your man. The man took him away, and as he returned, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he kills him, he will be like him. He returned and said: Allah's Messenger, it has reached me that you have said that" If he killed him, he would be like him."
