I caught hold of him according to your command, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't you like that he should take upon him (the burden) of your sin and the sin of your companion (your brother)? He said: Allah's Apostle, why not? The Messenger of Allah (may peace be. upon him) said: If it is so, then let it be. He threw away the strap (around the offender) and set him free.
hi: Alqama bin Wa'il ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Jab main Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein baitha tha, ek shakhs wahan aaya doosre ko rassi se kheenchte hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, is aadmi ne mere bhai ko qatal kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Kya tumne use qatal kiya? Aur doosre aadmi (daawedaar) ne kaha: (Agar usne ye qubool na kiya to main uske khilaaf ek gawaah laaunga). Unhone (qaatil ne) kaha: Haan, maine use qatal kiya. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Tumne use kyun qatal kiya? Usne kaha: Main aur woh ek darakht ke pattoon ko todne mein masroof the aur usne mujhe bura-bhala kaha aur mujhe gussa dilaaya, is liye maine uske sar par kulhaadi maari aur use qatal kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhare paas apni taraf se khoon-baha dene ke liye kuch hai? Usne kaha: Mere paas is chogha aur is kulhaadi ke ilawa koi maal nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe lagta hai ki tumhare log tumhare liye fidya denge? Usne kaha: Main apne logon mein isse bhi zyada mamooli hoon (ki main apne qabile se ye faayda le sakoon). Unhone (Nabi ne) rassi uski taraf (daawedaar ki taraf) phenki ye kehte hue: Apna aadmi le jaao. Woh aadmi use le gaya, aur jab woh wapas ja raha tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar woh use qatal kare, to woh usi ke jaisa ho jaayega. Woh wapas gaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe pata chala hai ki aapne kaha hai ki "agar woh use qatal karta, to woh usi ke jaisa hota." Maine use aapke hukum ke mutabik pakda tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumhe ye pasand nahi ki woh tumhare aur tumhare saathi (tumhare bhai) ke gunah ka bojh apne upar le le? Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kyun nahi? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar aisa hai, to isi tarah rehne do. Unhone rassi (aparaadhi ke aas-paas se) phenk di aur use azaad kar diya.

e: 'Alaqama b. Wa'il reported on the authority of his father that a person was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who had killed another person, and the heir of the person slain had dragged him (to the Holy Prophet) with a strap around his neck. As he turned away Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The killer and the killed are (doomed) to fire. A person came to the other person (the heir of the deceased) and he reported to him the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and so he let him off. Isma'il b. Salim said: I made a mention of it to Habib b. Abu Thabit and he said: Ibn Ashwa' reported to me that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had asked him to pardon him, but he refused.
hi: Alaqama bin Wa'il ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya jisne doosre shakhs ko qatal kiya tha, aur qatal kiye gaye shakhs ke waaris ne use uski gardan ke aas-paas ek rassi se (Nabi ke paas) kheench kar laaya tha. Jaise woh mudkar jaane laga Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Qatal karne wala aur qatal kiya gaya, dono (barbaad hokar) aag mein jaayenge. Ek shakhs doosre shakhs (marne wale ke waaris) ke paas aaya aur usne unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz bataaye, aur is liye usne use chhod diya. Ismail bin Salim ne kaha: Maine iska zikr Habib bin Abu Thabit se kiya aur unhone kaha: Ibn Ashwa ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse use maaf karne ko kaha tha, lekin usne inkaar kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that among two women of the tribe of Hudhail one flung a stone upon the other causing an abortion to her so Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) gave judgment that a male or a female slave of best quality be given as compensation.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Hudhail qabile ki do auraton mein se ek ne doosri par patthar phenka jiski wajah se uska haml zaya ho gaya, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ki behtareen mayaar ka ek mard ya aurat ghulam muaaviza ke soorat mein diya jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment in case of the abortion of a woman of Banu Lihyan (that the offender and near relative should give compensation in the form of) good quality of a slave or a slave-girl. And the woman about whom the judgment was given for compensation died and thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment that her inheritance goes to her sons and her husband, and the payment of the blood-wit lies with the family of (one who struck her).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Lihyan ki ek aurat ke garbhpat ke maamle mein faisla diya (ki aparaadhi aur qareebi rishtedaar ko muaaviza dena chahiye) achhi mayaar ka ek ghulam ya laundi ke soorat mein. Aur jiske liye muaaviza ka faisla diya gaya thi woh aurat mar gayi aur isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ki uski virasat uske betoon aur uske shohar ko jaati hai, aur khoon-baha ka bhugtaan (jisne use maara uske) khaandaan ki zimmedaari hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that two women of the tribe of Hudhail fought with each other and one of them flung a stone at the other, killing her and what was in her womb. The case was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave judgment that the diyat (indemnity) of her unborn child is a male or a female slave of the best quality, and he also decided that the diyat of the woman is to be paid by her relative on the father's side, and he (the Holy Prophet) made her sons and those who were with them her heirs. Hamal b. al-Nabigha al-Hudhali said: Messenger of Allah, why should I play blood-wit for one who neither drank, nor ate, nor spoke, nor made any noise; it is like a nonentity (it is, therefore, not justifiable to demand blood-wit for it). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He seems to be one of the brothers of soothsavers on account of the rhymed speech which he has composed.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Hudhail qabile ki do auraton ne ek-doosre se ladaai ki aur unmein se ek ne doosri par patthar phenka, use aur uske garbh mein jo tha use qatal kar diya. Maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur unhone faisla diya ki uske paida na hue bachche ki diyat (muaaviza) ek behtareen mayaar ka mard ya aurat ghulam hai, aur unhone ye bhi faisla diya ki aurat ki diyat uske waalid ki taraf ke rishtedaar ke zariye ada ki jaayegi, aur unhone (Nabi ne) uske betoon aur unke saath rehne walon ko uska waaris banaaya. Hamal bin al-Nabigha al-Hudhali ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main us cheez ke liye khoon-baha kyun dun jisne na piya, na khaaya, na bola, na koi aawaaz nikaali; ye toh kuch bhi nahi hai (is liye iske liye khoon-baha maangna munasib nahi hai). Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye tukbandi jo usne banaayi hai uski wajah se ye jaadugaron ke bhaiyon mein se ek lagta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that two women fought-the rest of the hadith is the same but herein no mention has been made of: He made her son and those who were with them her heirs. Someone said: Why should we pay blood-wit? And he did not name Hamal b. Malik.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki do auraton ne ladaai ki - baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: Unhone uske bete aur unke saath rehne walon ko uska waaris banaaya. Kisi ne kaha: Hum khoon-baha kyun dein? Aur unhone Hamal bin Malik ka naam nahi liya.

e: Al-Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that a woman struck her co-wife with a tent-pole and she was pregnant and she killed her. One of them belonged to the tribe of Lihyan. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made the relatives of the murderer responsible for the payment of blood-wit on her behalf, and fixed a slave or a female slave as the indemnity for what was in her womb. One of the persons amongst the relatives of the murderer said: Should we pay indemnity for one who, neither ate, nor drank, nor made any noise, who was just like a nonentity? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) remarked: He speaks rhymed phrases like the people of the desert. He did impose indemnity upon them.
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat ne apni saut ko tambu ke khoonte se maara aur woh garbhvati thi aur usne use qatal kar diya. Unmein se ek Lihyan qabile ki thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qaatil ke rishtedaaron ko uski taraf se khoon-baha dene ki zimmedaari di, aur uske garbh mein jo tha uske liye ek ghulam ya laundi muaaviza ke soorat mein tay kiya. Qaatil ke rishtedaaron mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Kya hum us cheez ke liye muaaviza dein jisne na khaaya, na piya, na koi aawaaz nikaali, jo bilkul kuch bhi nahi tha? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh registaan ke logon ki tarah tukbandi mein baat kar raha hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) unpar muaaviza laagoo kiya.

e: Al-Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: A woman killed her fellow-wife with a tent-pole. Her case was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he gave judgment that blood-wit should be paid by the relatives (of the offender) on the father's side. And as she was pregnant, he decided regarding her unborn child that a male or a female slave of good quality be given. Some of her offender's) relatives said: Should we make compensation for one who never ate, nor drank, nor made any noise, who was like a nonentity? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He was talking rhymed phrases like the rhymed phrases of desert Arabs.
hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat ne apni saut ko tambu ke khoonte se qatal kiya. Uska maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aur unhone faisla diya ki khoon-baha (aparaadhi ke) waalid ki taraf ke rishtedaaron ke zariye ada ki jaani chahiye. Aur chunki woh garbhvati thi, unhone uske paida na hue bachche ke baare mein faisla diya ki ek achhi mayaar ka ghulam ya laundi diya jaaye. Uske (aparaadhi ke) kuch rishtedaaron ne kaha: Kya hum us cheez ke liye muaaviza dein jisne kabhi na khaaya, na piya, na koi aawaaz nikaali, jo bilkul kuch bhi nahi tha? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh registaan ke Arabon ki tukbandi jaisi tukbandi mein baat kar raha tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Mansur transmitted this hadith with a slight variation of words.
hi: Mansur ne ye hadees alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Miswar b. Makhrama reported that 'Umar b. Khattab consulted people about the diyat of abortion of an unboam child. Mughira b. Shu'ba said: I bear witness to the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave judgment about it that a good quality of slave or female slave should be given for it. Thereupon 'Umar said: Bring one who may bear witness to you. Then Muhammad b. Maslama bore witness to him.
hi: Miswar bin Makhrama ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab ne paida na hue bachche ke garbhpat ke diyat ke baare mein logon se salaah maangi. Mughira bin Shu'ba ne kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne iske baare mein faisla diya tha ki iske liye achhi mayaar ka ek ghulam ya laundi di jaani chahiye. Isper Umar ne kaha: Kisi ko laao jo tumhari gawaahi de. Phir Muhammad bin Maslama ne unki gawaahi di.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cut off the hand of a thief for a quarter of a dinar rid upwards.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath kaata chauthai dinar ya usse zyada ki chori ke liye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The hand of a thief should not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and upwards.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Chor ka haath sirf chauthai dinar aur usse zyada ke liye hi kaata jaana chahiye.

e: 'A'isha reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The hand (of a thief) should not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and what is above that.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: (Chor ka) haath sirf chauthai dinar aur usse zyada ke liye hi kaata jaana chahiye.

e: 'A'isha reported that she heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The hand of the thief may not be cut off but for a quarter of a dinar and upwards.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Chor ka haath sirf chauthai dinar aur usse zyada ke liye hi kaata jaa sakta hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. 'Abdullah b. al-Had with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Yazid bin Abdullah bin al-Had ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the hand of the thief was not cut off for less than the price of a shield, iron coat or armour and both of them are valuable.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein chor ka haath dhaal, loha ki kavach, ya kavach ki keemat se kam ke liye nahi kaata jaata tha aur ye donon keemati thin.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters, and in the hadith narrated by 'Abd al-Rahim and Abu Usama (the words are): " That (the shield) was valuable those days."
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Abd al-Rahim aur Abu Usama ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Woh (dhaal) us daur mein keemati thi."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) cut off the hand of a thief (in case of the theft) of a shield the price of which was three dirhams.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chor ka haath kaata (ek dhaal ki chori ke maamle mein) jiski keemat teen dirham thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through some other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se kuch doosri sanadon se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Let there be the curse of Allah upon the thief who steals an egg and his hand is cut off, and steals a rope and his hand is cut off.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ki laanat ho us chor par jo ek anda chorata hai aur uska haath kaata jaata hai, aur ek rassi chorata hai aur uska haath kaata jaata hai.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Quraish had been anxious about the Makhzumi woman who had committed theft, and said: Who will speak to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her? They said: Who dare it, but Usama, the loved one of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? So Usama spoke to him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you intercede regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah? He then stood up and addressed (people) saying: O people, those who have gone before you were destroyed, because if any one of high rank committed theft amongst them, they spared him; and it anyone of low rank committed theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment upon him. By Allah, if Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, were to steal, I would have her hand cut off. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Rumh (the words are):" Verily those before you perished."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Quraish us Makhzumi aurat ke baare mein pareshaan the jisne chori ki thi, aur unhone kaha: Uske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaun baat karega? Unhone kaha: Ye himmat sirf Usama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aziz, kar sakte hain. To Usama ne unse baat ki. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum Allah ke muqarrar kiye gaye sazaon mein se ek ke baare mein sifaarish kar rahe ho? Woh phir khade hue aur (logon se) khitaab kiya ye kehte hue: Aye logo, tumse pehle jo log the, unhe is liye tabaah kiya gaya kyunki agar unmein se koi buland darje ka shakhs chori karta, woh use bakhsh dete; aur agar koi neechi darje ka shakhs chori karta, woh use muqarrar saza dete. Allah ki qasam, agar Muhammad ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) chori karti, to main uska bhi haath kaatwaata. Ibn Rumh ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Yaqeenan tumse pehle log tabaah ho gaye."

e: `A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that the Quraish were concerned about the woman who had committed theft during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), in the expedition of Victory (of Mecca). They said: Who would speak to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her? They (again) said: Who can dare do this but Usama b. Zaid, the loved one of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Usama b. Zaid spoke about her to him (interceded on her behalf). The color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed, and he said: Do you intercede in one of the prescribed punishments of Allah? He (Usama) said: 'Messenger of Allah, seek forgiveness for me.' When it was dusk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and gave an address. He (first) glorified Allah as He deserves, and then said: Now to our topic. This (injustice) destroyed those before you that when any one of (high) rank committed theft among them, they spared him, and when any weak one among them committed theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment upon him. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, even if Fatima daughter of Muhammad were to commit theft, I would have cut off her hand. He (the Holy Prophet) then commanded about that woman who had committed theft, and her hand was cut off. `A'isha (further) said: Hers was a good repentance, and she later on married and used to come to me after that, and I conveyed her needs (and problems) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Quraish us aurat ke baare mein pareshaan the jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein chori ki, Fatah ki muhim (Makkah ki) mein. Unhone kaha: Uske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaun baat karega? Unhone (dobara) kaha: Ye himmat sirf Usama bin Zaid, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aziz, kar sakte hain. Use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur Usama bin Zaid ne unse uske baare mein baat ki (uski taraf se sifaarish ki). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre ka rang badal gaya, aur unhone kaha: Kya tum Allah ke muqarrar kiye gaye sazaon mein se ek ke baare mein sifaarish kar rahe ho? Unhone (Usama ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere liye maafi maangiye. Jab shaam ho gayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur khitaab diya. Unhone (pehle) Allah ki tareef ki jaisa Woh iske laayak hai, aur phir kaha: Ab humare mudde par aate hain. Ye (anyaay) tumse pehle logon ko tabaah karta tha ki jab unmein se koi (buland) darje ka shakhs chori karta, woh use bakhsh dete, aur jab unmein se koi kamzor shakhs chori karta, woh use muqarrar saza dete. Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar Muhammad ki beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) chori karti, to main uska bhi haath kaat deta. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir us aurat ke baare mein hukum diya jisne chori ki thi, aur uska haath kaata gaya. Aisha ne (aage) kaha: Uski tauba achhi thi, aur woh baad mein shaadi ki aur mujhse milne aayi karti thi, aur main uski zaroorat (aur samasyaen) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchaati thi.

e: 'A'isha reported that a woman from the tribe of Makhzum used to borrow things (from people) and then denied (having taken them). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded her hand to be cut off. Her relatives came to Usama b. Zaid and spoke to him (requesting him to intercede on her behalf). He spoke to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about her. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Makhzum qabile ki ek aurat (logon se) cheezein udhaar leti aur phir (unhe lene se) inkaar kar deti. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne uska haath kaatne ka hukum diya. Uske rishtedaar Usama bin Zaid ke paas aaye aur unse baat ki (unse guzaarish ki ki woh uski taraf se sifaarish karein). Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se uske baare mein baat ki. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jaibir reported that a woman from the tribe of Makhzum committed theft. She was brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and she sought refuge (intercession) from Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: By Allah, even if she were Fatima, I would have her hand cut off. And thus her hand was cut off.
hi: Jaibir ne bayan kiya ki Makhzum qabile ki ek aurat ne chori ki. Use Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur usne Umm Salama, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, se panah (sifaarish) maangi. Isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar woh Fatima (Alayhas Salam) bhi hoti, to main uska haath kaatwaata. Aur is tarah uska haath kaata gaya.

e: 'Ubada b. as-Samit reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Receive (teaching) from me, receive (teaching) from me. Allah has ordained a way for those (women). When an unmarried male commits adultery with an unmarried female (they should receive) one hundred lashes and banishment for one year. And in case of married male committing adultery with a married female, they shall receive one hundred lashes and be stoned to death.
hi: Ubada bin as-Samit ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhse (taalim) qubool karo, mujhse qubool karo. Allah ne un (auraton) ke liye ek raasta muqarrar kiya hai. Jab ek kunwara mard kisi kunwari aurat ke saath zina karta hai (unhe) sau koda aur ek saal ka nirvaasan milna chahiye. Aur agar shaadishuda mard shaadishuda aurat ke saath zina kare, unhe sau koda aur sangsaar karke maut milegi.

e: The above hadith is likewise narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ubada b. as-Samit reported that whenever Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) received revelation, he felt its rigour and the complexion of his face changed. One day revelation descended upon him, he felt the same rigour. When it was over and he felt relief, he said: Take from me. Verily Allah has ordained a way for them (the women who commit fornication),: (When) a married man (commits adultery) with a married woman, and an unmarried male with an unmarried woman, then in case of married (persons) there is (a punishment) of one hundred lashes and then stoning (to death). And in case of unmarried persons, (the punishment) is one hundred lashes and exile for one year.
hi: Ubada bin as-Samit ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko wahi milti, woh iski sakhti mehsoos karte aur unke chehre ka rang badal jaata. Ek din unpar wahi utri, unhone wahi sakhti mehsoos ki. Jab ye khatam hui aur unhe rahat mehsoos hui, unhone kaha: Mujhse (taalim) lo. Yaqeenan Allah ne unke (jina karne wale auraton ke) liye ek raasta muqarrar kiya hai: (Jab) ek shaadishuda mard shaadishuda aurat ke saath (zina karta hai), aur ek kunwara mard kunwari aurat ke saath, to shaadishuda (logon) ke liye (saza hai) sau koda aur phir sangsaar karna (maut tak). Aur kunwaare logon ke liye, (saza hai) sau koda aur ek saal ka nirvaasan.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation that the unmarried is to be lashed and exiled, and the married one is to be lashed and stoned. There is neither any mention of one year nor that of one hundred.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is tabdeeli ke ki kunwaare ko koda maara jaana aur nirvaasit kiya jaana chahiye, aur shaadishuda ko koda maara jaana aur sangsaar kiya jaana chahiye. Na to saal ka koi zikr hai, na sau ka.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that 'Umar b. Khattab sat on the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Verily Allah sent Muhammad (ﷺ) with truth and He sent down the Book upon him, and the verse of stoning was included in what was sent down to him. We recited it, retained it in our memory and understood it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) awarded the punishment of stoning to death (to the married adulterer and adulteress) and, after him, we also awarded the punishment of stoning, I am afraid that with the lapse of time, the people (may forget it) and may say: We do not find the punishment of stoning in the Book of Allah, and thus go astray by abandoning this duty prescribed by Allah. Stoning is a duty laid down in Allah's Book for married men and women who commit adultery when proof is established, or it there is pregnancy, or a confession.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar par baithe aur kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) ko sach ke saath bheja, aur Usne unpar Kitaab nazil ki, aur sangsaar ki aayat unmein shaamil thi jo unpar nazil hui thin. Humne ise padha, ise apni yaad mein rakha aur ise samjha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sangsaar karke maut ki saza di (shaadishuda vyabhichaari mard aur aurat ko) aur, unke baad, humne bhi sangsaar karne ki saza di, mujhe dar hai ki waqt ke guzarne ke saath, log (ise bhool jaayein) aur kahein: Humein sangsaar karne ki saza Allah ki Kitaab mein nahi milti, aur is tarah is Allah ke zariye muqarrar farz ko chhodkar gumraah ho jaayein. Sangsaar karna ek farz hai jo Allah ki Kitaab mein muqarrar hai un shaadishuda mardon aur auraton ke liye jo zina karte hain jab saboot sthapit hota hai, ya agar garbhavastha hoti hai, ya agar qubooli hoti hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person from amongst the Muslims came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque. He called him saying: Allah's Messenger. I have committed adultery. He (the Holy Prophet) turned away from him, He (again) came round facing him and said to him: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery. He (the Holy Prophet) turned away until he did that four times, and as he testified four times against his own self, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him and said: Are you mad? He said: No. He (again) said: Are you married? He said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take him and stone him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Musalmaanon mein se ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh masjid mein the. Usne unhe bulaakar kaha: Allah ke Rasool. Maine zina kiya hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) usse munh mode. Woh phir unke saamne aaya aur usse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine zina kiya hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir munh mode yahan tak ki usne ye chaar baar kiya, aur jab usne khud apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur kaha: Kya tum paagal ho? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone (dobara) kaha: Kya tum shaadishuda ho? Usne kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use le jaao aur use sangsaar karo.

e: Ibn Shihab (one of the narrators) said: One who had heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying this informed me thus: I was one of those who stoned him. We stoned him at the place of prayer (either that of 'Id or a funeral). When the stones hurt him, he ran away. We caught him in the Harra and stoned him (to death).
hi: Ibn Shihab (ek raawi) ne kaha: Jisne Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna usne mujhe is tarah bataya: Main un logon mein se ek tha jinhone use sangsaar kiya. Humne use namaz ki jagah (chahe Eid ki ho ya janaaze ki) par sangsaar kiya. Jab pathhar usse takraaye, woh bhaag gaya. Humne use Harra mein pakda aur use sangsaar kiya (maut tak).

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: As he was being brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) I saw Ma'iz b. Malik-a short-statured person with strong sinews, having no cloak around him. He bore witness against his own self four times that he had committed adultery, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Perhaps (you kissed her or embraced her). He said: No. by God, one deviating (from the path of virtue) has committed adultery. He then got him stoned (to death), and then delivered the address: Behold, as we set out for Jihad in the cause of Allah, one of you lagged behind and shrieked like the bleating of a male goat, and gave a small quantity of milk. By Allah, in case I get hold of him, I shall certainly punish him.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Jab unhe Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya jaa raha tha maine Ma'iz bin Malik ko dekha - ek choti kad ka shakhs mazboot maans-peshiyon wala, bina kisi chogha ke. Unhone khud apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di ki unhone zina kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shayad (tumne use bosaa liya ya use gale lagaaya). Unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, ek bhatakne wale (achhaai ke raaste se) ne zina kiya. Unhone phir use sangsaar karwaaya, aur phir khitaab diya: Dekho, jab hum Allah ki raah mein Jihad ke liye nikle, tum mein se ek peeche reh gaya aur ek nar bakri ki mimyaahat jaisa chillaaya, aur usne thodi si doodh di. Allah ki qasam, agar main use pakadun, to main use zaroor saza dunga.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a short-statured person with thick uncombed hair, muscular body, having a mantle around him and he had committed adultery. He turned him away twice and then made pronouncement about him and he was stoned. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: We set out for Jihad in the cause of Allah and one of you lagged behind and shrieked like the bleating of a male goat and one of then (goats' gave a small quantity of milk. In case Allah gives me power over one of them, I will punish him (in such a way that it may have a deterrent effect upon others). In another narration transmitted on the authority of Sa'id b Jubair (the words are), that He (the Holy Prophet) turned him away four times."
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek choti kad ka shakhs laaya gaya jismein moti bekasi hui baal thi, mazboot badan tha, aur woh ek chogha pehne hue tha, aur usne zina kiya tha. Unhone use do baar mode, aur phir uske baare mein faisla diya aur use sangsaar kiya gaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Hum Allah ki raah mein Jihad ke liye nikle aur tum mein se ek peeche reh gaya aur ek nar bakri ki mimyaahat jaisa chillaaya aur unmein se ek (bakri) ne thodi si doodh di. Agar Allah mujhe unmein se kisi par ikhtiyar deta hai, to main use saza dunga (jismein aisa hoga ki ye doosron par ek rokthaam ka asar chhode). Sa'id bin Jubair ki riwayat ki hui ek doosri riwayat mein (alfaaz hain), ki unhone (Nabi ne) use chaar baar moda.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura through another chain of transmitters with the difference that along with the mentioning (of the fact) that he (the Holy Prophet) turned him away twice, or thrice.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Samura ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se is farq ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone (Nabi ne) use do ya teen baar moda, iska bhi zikr ke saath.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to Ma'iz b. Malik: Is it true what has reached me about you? He said: What has reached you about me? He said: It has reached me that you have committed (adultery) with the slave-girl of so and so? He said: Yes. He (the narrator) said: He testified four times. He (the Holy Prophet) then made pronouncement about him and he was stoned (to death).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ma'iz bin Malik se kaha: Kya jo mujhe tumhare baare mein pahuncha hai woh sach hai? Unhone kaha: Aapko mere baare mein kya pahuncha hai? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Mujhe pahuncha hai ki tumne falan-falan ki laundi ke saath (zina) kiya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Unhone chaar baar gawaahi di. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir uske baare mein faisla diya aur use sangsaar kiya gaya (maut tak).

e: Abu Sa'id reported that a person belonging to the clan of Aslam, who was called Ma, iz b. Malik, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have committed immorality (adultery), so inflict punishment upon me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) turned him away again and again. He then asked his people (about the state of his mind). They said: We do not know of any ailment of his except that he has committed something about which he thinks that he would not be able to relieve himself of its burden but with the Hadd being imposed upon him. He (Ma'iz) came back to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he commanded us to stone him. We took him to the Baqi' al-Gharqad (the graveyard of Medina). We neither tied him nor dug any ditch for him. We attacked him with bones, with clods and pebbles. He ran away and we ran after him until he came upon the ston ground (al-Harra) and stopped there and we stoned him with heavy stones of the Harra until he became motionless (lie died). He (the Holy Prophet) then addressed (us) in the evening saying Whenever we set forth on an expedition in the cause of Allah, some one of those connected with us shrieked (under the pressure of sexual lust) as the bleating of a male goat. It is essential that if a person having committed such a deed is brought to me, I should punish him. He neither begged forgiveness for him nor cursed him.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Aslam qabile ka ek shakhs, jise Ma'iz bin Malik kaha jaata tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine badchalni (zina) ki hai, is liye mujhpar saza laagoo kijiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baar-baar usse munh mode. Unhone phir uske logon se (uski maansikta ki haalat ke baare mein) poocha. Unhone kaha: Humein uski koi bimaari nahi pata siwaay is baat ke ki usne kuch aisa kiya hai jiske baare mein use lagta hai ki woh apne aap ko is bojh se tab tak azaad nahi kar payega jab tak use Hadd (muqarrar saza) na di jaaye. Woh (Ma'iz) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaya aur unhone humein use sangsaar karne ka hukum diya. Hum use Baqi al-Gharqad (Madina ke qabristan) mein le gaye. Humne use na bandha na uske liye koi khaai khodi. Humne use haddiyon, dhelon aur kankariyon se hamla kiya. Woh bhaaga aur hum uske peeche daude yahan tak ki woh patthreeli zameen (al-Harra) par pahuncha aur wahan ruka aur humne use Harra ke bhaari pattharon se sangsaar kiya yahan tak ki woh nishcheshta ho gaya (mar gaya). Unhone (Nabi ne) phir shaam ko khitaab kiya ye kehte hue: Jab bhi hum Allah ki raah mein kisi muhim par nikalte hain, hummein se juda hua koi (jinsi laalch ke dabaav mein) nar bakri ki mimyaahat jaisa chillaata hai. Ye zaroori hai ki agar aisa amal karne wala koi shakhs mere paas laaya jaaye, to main use saza dun. Unhone na to uske liye maafi maangi na hi use bura-bhala kaha.

e: Dawud narrated the hadith with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stood tip (to address the audience) in the evening and praised Allah, glorified Him and then said: What about the people, that as we set out on an expedition, one of you remained behind us and he shrieked like the bleating of a male goat? But he did not mention (these words): People connected with us."
hi: Dawud ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki (aur alfaaz hain): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) shaam ko khade hue (audience se khitaab karne ke liye) aur unhone Allah ki tareef ki, Uski hamd ki aur phir kaha: Logon ko kya hua hai, ki jab hum kisi muhim par nikalte hain, tum mein se ek humare peeche reh jaata hai aur nar bakri ki mimyaahat jaisa chillaata hai? Lekin unhone ye alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya: "Humse jude log."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Dawud with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that in the hadith narrated by Sufyan (the words are): " He made a confession of having committed adultery, thrice."
hi: Ye hadees Dawud ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is farq ke saath ki Sufyan ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Unhone zina karne ki gawaahi teen baar di."

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Ma, iz b. Malik came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said to him: Messenger of Allah, purify me, whereupon he said: Woe be upon you, go back, ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance. He (the narrator) said that he went back not far, then came and said: Allah's Messenger, purify me. whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Woe be upon you, go back and ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance. He (the narrator) said that he went back not far, when he came and said: Allah's Messenger, purify me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said as he had said before. When it was the fourth time, Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) said: From what am I to purify you? He said: From adultery, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked if he had been mad. He was informed that he was not mad. He said: Has he drunk wine? A person stood up and smelt his breath but noticed no smell of wine. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Have you committed adultery? He said: Yes. He made pronouncement about him and he was stoned to death. The people had been (divided) into two groups about him (Ma'iz). One of them said: He has been undone for his sins had encompassed him, whereas another said: There is no repentance more excellent than the repentance of Ma'iz, for he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and placing his hand in his (in the Holy Prophet's) hand said: Kill me with stones. (This controversy about Ma'iz) remained for two or three days. Then came Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to them (his Companions) as they were sitting. He greeted them with salutation and then sat down and said: Ask forgiveness for Ma'iz b. Malik. They said: May Allah forgive Ma'iz b. Malik. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He (Ma'iz) has made such a repentance that if that were to be divided among a people, it would have been enough for all of them. He (the narrator) said: Then a woman of Ghamid, a branch of Azd, came to him and said: Messenger of of Allah, purify me, whereupon he said: Woe be upon you; go back and beg forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance. She said: I find that you intend to send me back as you sent back Ma'iz. b. Malik. He (the Holy, Prophet) said: What has happened to you? She said that she had become pregnant as a result of fornication. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is it you (who has done that)? She said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: (You will not be punished) until you deliver what is there in your womb. One of the Ansar became responsible for her until she was delivered (of the child). He (that Ansari) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said the woman of Ghamid has given birth to a child. He (the Holy Prophet) said: In that case we shall not stone her and so leave her infant with none to suckle him. One of the Ansar got up and said: Allah's Apostle, let the responsibility of his suckling be upon me. She was then stoned to death.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Ma'iz bin Malik Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe muqaddas karo, isper unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos, wapas jao, Allah se maafi maango aur Uski taraf tauba mein mudo. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki woh dur nahi gaye, phir aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe muqaddas karo. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumpar afsos, wapas jao aur Allah se maafi maango aur Uski taraf tauba mein mudo. Unhone kaha ki woh dur nahi gaye, jab woh aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe muqaddas karo. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne wahi kaha jo unhone pehle kaha tha. Jab ye chauthi baar tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kis cheez se main tumhe muqaddas karun? Unhone kaha: Zina se. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne poocha ki kya woh paagal the. Unhe bataaya gaya ki woh paagal nahi the. Unhone kaha: Kya usne sharaab pee hai? Ek shakhs khada hua aur uski saans soonghi lekin usmein koi sharaab ki mahak nahi thi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tumne zina kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone uske baare mein faisla diya aur usse sangsaar karke maara gaya. Log unke (Ma'iz ke) baare mein do giroh mein baant gaye. Unmein se kuchne kaha: Woh barbaad ho gaya kyunki uske gunahon ne use gher liya tha, jabki doosre ne kaha: Ma'iz ki tauba se zyada khoobsurat koi tauba nahi hai, kyunki woh Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur apna haath unke (Nabi ke) haath mein rakh kar kaha: Mujhe pattharon se maar do. (Ma'iz ke baare mein ye bahas) do ya teen din tak jaari raha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke (apne sahaba ke) paas aaye jab woh baithe the. Unhone unhe salaam kiya aur phir baithe aur kaha: Ma'iz bin Malik ke liye maafi maango. Unhone kaha: Allah Ma'iz bin Malik ko maaf kare. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhone (Ma'iz ne) aisi tauba ki hai ki agar ye ek qaum ke beech baant di jaaye, to ye unke liye kaafi hoti. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Phir Ghamid, Azd ki ek shaakha, ki ek aurat unke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe muqaddas karo, isper unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos; wapas jao aur Allah se maafi maango aur Uski taraf tauba mein mudo. Unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki aapka iraada mujhe wapas bhejne ka hai jaisa aapne Ma'iz bin Malik ko bheja tha. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha ki woh zina ke natije mein garbhvati ho gayi thin. Unhone kaha: Kya ye tum ho (jisne aisa kiya)? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone unse kaha: (Tumhe saza nahi milegi) jab tak tum apne garbh mein jo hai use paidaish na do. Ansar mein se ek shakhs uski zimmedaari lene ko taiyaar hua jab tak woh (bachche ko) paidaish na de de. Woh (woh Ansari) Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha ki Ghamid ki aurat ne bachche ko paida kiya hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Us surat mein hum use sangsaar nahi karenge aur uske bachche ko bina kisi doodh pilaane wale ke chhod denge. Ansar mein se ek shakhs khade hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, uske doodh pilaane ki zimmedaari mujhpar chhod dijiye. Unhe phir sangsaar karke maara gaya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Ma'iz b. Malik al-Aslami came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I have wronged myself; I have committed adultery and I earnestly desire that you should purify me. He turned him away. On the following day, he (Ma'iz) again came to him and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned him away for the second time, and sent him to his people saying: Do you know if there is anything wrong with his mind. They denied of any such thing in him and said: We do not know him but as a wise good man among us, so far as we can judge. He (Ma'iz) came for the third time, and he (the Holy Prophet) sent him as he had done before. He asked about him and they informed him that there was nothing wrong with him or with his mind. When it was the fourth time, a ditch was dug for him and he (the Holy Prophet) pronounced judg- ment about him and he wis stoned. He (the narrator) said: There came to him (the Holy Prophet) a woman from Ghamid and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed adultery, so purify me. He (the Holy Prophet) turned her away. On the following day she said: Allah's Messenger, Why do you turn me away? Perhaps, you turn me away as you turned away Ma'iz. By Allah, I have become pregnant. He said: Well, if you insist upon it, then go away until you give birth to (the child). When she was delivered she came with the child (wrapped) in a rag and said: Here is the child whom I have given birth to. He said: Go away and suckle him until you wean him. When she had weaned him, she came to him (the Holy Prophet) with the child who was holding a piece of bread in his hand. She said: Allah's Apostle, here is he as I have weaned him and he eats food. He (the Holy Prophet) entrusted the child to one of the Muslims and then pronounced punishment. And she was put in a ditch up to her chest and he commanded people and they stoned her. Khalid b Walid came forward with a stone which he flung at her head and there spurted blood on the face of Khalid and so he abused her. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) heard his (Khalid's) curse that he had huried upon her. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Khalid, be gentle. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, she has made such a repentance that even if a wrongful tax-collector were to repent, he would have been forgiven. Then giving command regarding her, he prayed over her and she was buried.
hi: Abdullah bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Ma'iz bin Malik al-Aslami Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apne aap par anyaay kiya hai; maine zina kiya hai aur main dil se chahta hoon ki aap mujhe muqaddas karein. Unhone unhe munh mode. Agle din, woh (Ma'iz) unke paas dobara aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine zina kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe doosri baar munh mode, aur unhe unke logon ke paas ye kehte hue bheja: Kya tumhe pata hai ki unke dimaag mein kuch garbad hai. Unhone aisi kisi baat se inkaar kiya aur kaha: Hum unhe siwaay ek aqlmand achhe insaan ke aur kuch nahi jaante, jitna hum jaan sakte hain. Woh (Ma'iz) teesri baar aaye, aur unhone unhe waisa hi bheja jaisa pehle kiya tha. Unhone unke baare mein poocha aur unhe bataaya gaya ki unmein ya unke dimaag mein kuch bhi galat nahi hai. Jab ye chauthi baar thi, unke liye ek khaai khodi gayi aur unhone (Nabi ne) unke baare mein faisla diya aur unhe sangsaar kiya gaya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Ghamid se ek aurat unke (Nabi ke) paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine zina kiya hai, is liye mujhe muqaddas karo. Unhone (Nabi ne) unhe munh mode. Agle din unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhe kyun munh mode dete hain? Shayad aap mujhe munh modte hain jaisa aapne Ma'iz ko moda. Allah ki qasam, main garbhvati ho gayi hoon. Unhone kaha: Achha, agar tum isi par ade ho, to jao jab tak tum (bachche ko) paidaish na de do. Jab unhone paida kiya woh bachche ko kapde mein lapetkar laayi aur kaha: Ye hai woh bachcha jise maine paida kiya hai. Unhone kaha: Jao aur use doodh pilaao jab tak tum use doodh chhudaao. Jab unhone use doodh chhudaya, woh bachche ke saath unke (Nabi ke) paas aayi jo apne haath mein ek roti ka tukda pakde hue tha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye woh hai jisse maine doodh chhudaya hai aur woh khaana khaata hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) bachche ko ek Musalman ko soonp diya aur phir saza ka faisla diya. Aur unhe seene tak ek khaai mein rakha gaya aur unhone (Nabi ne) logon ko hukum diya aur unhone unhe sangsaar kiya. Khalid bin Walid ek patthar lekar aage aaye jo unhone unke sar par phenka aur Khalid ke chehre par khoon uchhala aur is liye unhone use bura-bhala kaha. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne unki (Khalid ki) laanat suni jo unhone unpar phenki thi. Isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Khalid, narmi rakho. Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, unhone aisi tauba ki hai ki agar ek galat tax vasooli karne wala bhi tauba karta, to use maafi mil jaati. Phir unke baare mein hukum dete hue, unhone unke (janaaze ki) namaz padhi aur unhe dafn kiya gaya.

e: Imran b. Husain reported that a woman from Juhaina came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and she had become pregnant because of adultery. She said: Allah's Apostle, I have done something for which (prescribed punishment) must be imposed upon me, so impose that. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called her master and said: Treat her well, and when she delivers bring her to me. He did accordingly. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pronounced judgment about her and her clothes were tied around her and then he commanded and she was stoned to death. He then prayed over her (dead body). Thereupon Umar said to him: Allah's Apostle, you offer prayer for her, whereas she had committed adultery! Thereupon he said: She has made such a repentance that if it were to be divided among seventy men of Medina, it would be enough. Have you found any repentance better than this that she sacr ficed her life for Allah, the Majestic?
hi: Imran bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki Juhaina se ek aurat Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur woh zina ki wajah se garbhvati ho gayi thi. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Nabi, maine kuch aisa kiya hai jiske liye (muqarrar saza) mujhpar laagoo hona chahiye, is liye woh laagoo kijiye. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne uske maalik ko bulaaya aur kaha: Uska achha khyaal rakho, aur jab woh (bachche ko) paidaish de, use mere paas laao. Unhone aisa hi kiya. Phir Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne uske baare mein faisla diya aur uske kapde uske aas-paas bandhe gaye aur phir unhone hukum diya aur use sangsaar karke maara gaya. Unhone phir uske (murda badan ke) liye namaz padhi. Isper Umar ne unse kaha: Allah ke Nabi, aap uske liye namaz padhte hain, jabki usne zina kiya! Isper unhone kaha: Unhone aisi tauba ki hai ki agar ye Madina ke sattar aadmiyon mein baant di jaaye, to ye kaafi hogi. Kya tumhe iske jaisi koi behtareen tauba mili hai ki unhone apni jaan Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ke liye qurbaan kar di?

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira and Zaid b Khalid al-Juhani reported that one of the desert tribes came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I beg of you in the name of Allah that you pronounce judgment about me according to the Book of Allah. The second claimant who was wiser than him said: Well, decide amongst us according to the Book of Allah, but permit me (to say something). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon ham) said: Say. He said: My son was a servant in the house of this person and he committed adultery with his wife. I was informed that my son deserved stoning to death (as punishment for this offence). I gave one hundred goats and a slave girl as ransom for this. I asked the scholars (if this could serve as an expiation for this offence). They informed me that my son deserved one hundred lathes and exile for one year. and this woman deserved stoning (as she was married). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life. I will decide between you according to the Book of Allah. The slave-girl and the goats should be given back, and your son is to be punished with one hundred lashes and exile for one year. And, O Unais (b. Zuhaq al-Aslami), go to this woman in the morning, and if she makes a confession, then stone her. He (the narrator) said: He went to her in the morning and she made a confession. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made pronouncement about her and she was stoned to death.
hi: Abu Huraira aur Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya ki registaan ke ek qabile ka ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main aapse Allah ke naam par bhikh maangta hoon ki aap mere baare mein Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik faisla karein. Doosre daawedaar ne, jo usse zyada aqlmand tha, kaha: Achha, humare beech Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik faisla kijiye, lekin mujhe (kuch kehne ki) ijazat dijiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kaho. Unhone kaha: Mera beta is shakhs ke ghar mein khaadim tha aur usne uski zauja ke saath zina kiya. Mujhe bataaya gaya ki mera beta sangsaar karke maut ka haqdaar hai (is aparaadh ki saza ke soorat mein). Maine iske badle sau bakriyaan aur ek laundi di. Maine ulema se poocha (kya ye is aparaadh ka kaffara ban sakta hai). Unhone mujhe bataya ki mera beta sau koda aur ek saal ka nirvaasan ka haqdaar hai, aur ye aurat sangsaar (kyunki woh shaadishuda thi) ki haqdaar hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, main tumhare beech Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik faisla karunga. Laundi aur bakriyaan wapas ki jaani chahiye, aur tumhare bete ko sau koda aur ek saal ke nirvaasan ki saza di jaani chahiye. Aur, Aye Unais (bin Zuhaq al-Aslami), is aurat ke paas subah jaao, aur agar woh qubool kare, to use sangsaar karo. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh subah unke paas gaye aur unhone qubool kiya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske baare mein faisla diya aur use sangsaar karke maara gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that a Jew and a Jewess were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had committed adultery. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the Jews and said: What do you find in Torah for one who commits adultery? They said: We darken their faces and make them ride on the donkey with their faces turned to the opposite direction (and their backs touching each other), and then they are taken round (the city). He said: Bring Torah if you are truthful. They brought it and recited it until when they came to the verse pertaining to stoning, the person who was reading placed his hand on the verse pertaining to stoning, and read (only that which was) between his hands and what was subsequent to that. Abdullah b. Salim who was at that time with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Command him (the reciter) to lift his hand. He lifted it and there was, underneath that, the verse pertaining to stoning. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment about both of them and they were stoned. Abdullah b. 'Umar said: I was one of those who stoned them, and I saw him (the Jew) protecting her (the Jewess) with his body.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi aur ek Yahudi aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye gaye jinhone zina kiya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Yahudiyon ke paas aaye aur kaha: Tumhe Torah mein us shakhs ke liye kya milta hai jo zina karta hai? Unhone kaha: Hum unke chehron ko kaala karte hain aur unhe gadhe par sawaar karte hain unke chehre ulti simt mein mode hue (aur unki peeth ek-doosre ko chhuti hui), aur phir unhe (shehar mein) ghumaaya jaata hai. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Torah laao agar tum sachche ho. Woh use laaye aur ise padhne lage yahan tak ki jab woh sangsaar se mutalliq aayat par pahunche, jo shakhs padh raha tha usne apna haath sangsaar se mutalliq aayat par rakh diya, aur padha (sirf woh jo) unke haathon ke beech tha aur uske baad ka. Abdullah bin Salim, jo us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the, unhone kaha: Use (padhne wale ko) hukum dijiye ki woh apna haath uthaaye. Usne apna haath uthaaya aur uske neeche sangsaar se mutalliq aayat thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke baare mein faisla diya aur unhe sangsaar kiya gaya. Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: Main un logon mein se tha jinhone unhe sangsaar kiya, aur maine use (Yahudi ko) apne badan se use (Yahudi aurat ko) bachaate hue dekha.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stoned to death the Jews, both male and female, who had committed adultery. The Jews brought them to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Yahudiyon ko sangsaar karke maara, mard aur aurat donon, jinhone zina kiya tha. Yahudi unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Jews brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a man and a woman who had committed adultery. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Yahudiyon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek mard aur ek aurat laayi jinhone zina kiya tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: There happened to pass by Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a Jew blackened and lashed. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called them (the Jews) and said: Is this the punishment that you find in your Book (Torah) as a prescribed punishment for adultery? They said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) called one of the scholars amongst them and said: I ask you in the name of Allah Who sent down the Torah on Moses if that is the prescribed punishment for adultery that you find in your Book. He said: No. Had you not asked me in the name of Allah, I would not have given you this information. We find stoning to death (as punishment prescribed in the Torah). But this (crime) became quite common amongst our aristocratic class. So when we caught hold of any rich person (indulging in this offence) we spared him, but when we caught hold of a helpless person we imposed the prescribed punishment upon him. We then said: Let us argree (on a punishment) which we can inflict both upon the rich and the poor. So We decided to blacken the face with coal and flog as a substitute punishment for stoning. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, I am the first to revive Thy command when they had made it dead. He then commanded and he (the offender) was stoned to death. Allah, the Majestic and Glorious, sent down (this verse):" O Messenger, (the behaviour of) those who vie with one another in denying the truth should not grieve you..." up to" is vouchsafed unto you, accept it" (v. 41) 2176 It was said (by the Jews): Go to Muhammad; it he commands you to blacken the face and award flogging (as punishment for adultery), then accept it, but it he gives verdict for stoning, then avoid it. It was (then) that Allah, the Majestic and Great, sent down (these verses):" And they who do not judge in accordance with what Allah has revealed are, indeed, deniers of the truth" (v. 44) ;" And they who do not judge in accordance with what Allah has revealed-they, they indeed are the wrongdoers" (v. 45) ;" And they who do not judge in accordance with what God has revealed-they are the iniquitous (v. 47). (All these verses) were revealed in connection with the non-believers.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se ek Yahudi guzra jiska chehra kaala kiya gaya tha aur use koda maara gaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (Yahudiyon ko) bulaaya aur kaha: Kya ye woh saza hai jo tum apni Kitaab (Torah) mein zina ke liye muqarrar paate ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Nabi ne) unmein se ek aalim ko bulaaya aur kaha: Main tumhe Allah ke naam par poochta hoon, jisne Musa par Torah nazil ki, kya ye zina ke liye muqarrar saza hai jo tum apni Kitaab mein paate ho. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Agar aapne mujhe Allah ke naam par na poocha hota, to main aapko ye jaankaari na deta. Hum Torah mein sangsaar (saza ke soorat mein muqarrar) paate hain. Lekin ye (jurm) hamare ameer vargon mein aam ho gaya. Is liye jab humne kisi daulatmand shakhs ko (is jurm mein) pakda, humne use bakhsh diya, lekin jab humne kisi bebas shakhs ko pakda, humne use muqarrar saza di. Humne phir kaha: Aao hum (ek saza par) sehmat hon jo hum daulatmand aur gareeb, dono par laagoo kar sakein. To humne kaayle se chehra kaala karne aur sangsaar ke badle koda maarne ka faisla kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, main tere hukum ko phir se zinda karne wala pehla shakhs hoon jab unhone ise mardaana kar diya tha. Unhone phir hukum diya aur usse (jurm karne wale ko) sangsaar karke maara gaya. Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne (ye aayat) nazil ki: "Aye Rasool, un logon ka (vyavahaar) jo sach ko nakaarne mein ek-doosre se aage badhne ki koshish karte hain, aapko dukhi na kare..." "aapko diya jaata hai, use qubool karo" (5:41) tak. (Yahudiyon ne) kaha: Muhammad ke paas jaao; agar woh tumhe chehra kaala karne aur koda maarne ka hukum dete hain, to ise qubool karo, lekin agar woh sangsaar ka faisla dete hain, to isse bacho. (Phir) Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne (ye aayaten) nazil kin: "Aur jo Allah ke nazil kiye hue ke mutabik faisla nahi karte, woh yaqeenan sach ko nakaarne waale hain" (5:44); "Aur jo Allah ke nazil kiye hue ke mutabik faisla nahi karte - woh, woh yaqeenan zaalim hain" (5:45); "Aur jo Allah ke nazil kiye hue ke mutabik faisla nahi karte - woh badkaar hain" (5:47). (Ye saari aayaten) ghair-imaandaaron ke silsile mein nazil hui thin.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash up to the words: " Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pronounced judgment and he was stoned (to death)" And he mentioned nothing subsequent to that pertaining to the revelation of verses.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se in alfaazon tak riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya aur usse sangsaar karke maara gaya." Aur unhone iske baad aayaton ki nazil hone se mutalliq kuch bhi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stoned (to death) a person from Banu Aslam, and a Jew and his wife.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Aslam ke ek shakhs, aur ek Yahudi aur uski zauja ko sangsaar karke maara.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Juraij with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Ishaq Shaibani said: I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufi if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) awarded (the punishment) of stoning (to death). He said: Yes. I said: After Sura al-Nur was revealed or before that? He said: I do not know.
hi: Abu Ishaq Shaibani ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufi se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sangsaar (karke maut) ki saza di. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Surah al-Nur nazil hone ke baad ya usse pehle? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the slave-woman of any of you commits adultery and this (offence of hers) becomes clear, she should be flogged (as the prescribed) punishment, but hurl no reproach at her. If she commits adultery again, she should (again be punished) by flogging, but hurl no reproach upon her. If she commits fornication for the third time and it becomes clear, then he should sell her, even if only for a rope of hair.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se kisi ki laundi zina karti hai aur ye (uska aparaadh) saaf ho jaata hai, use koda maar kar saza deni chahiye, lekin use dosh mat do. Agar woh phir zina karti hai, use (phir) koda mar kar saza di jaani chahiye, lekin use dosh mat do. Agar woh teesri baar zina karti hai aur ye saaf ho jaata hai, to use use bech dena chahiye, chahe sirf baalon ki ek rassi ke badle.

e: This hadith his been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the slave-woman who committed adultery and was not protected (married). He said: If she commits adultery, then flog her and if she commits adultery again, then flog her and then sell her even for a rope. Ibn Shihab said: I do not know whether he said this (his statement pertaining to the sale of slave-woman) at the third or the fourth time. Ibn Shihab said that the word dafir (used in the text) means rope.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us laundi ke baare mein poocha gaya jisne zina kiya tha aur woh mahfooz (shaadishuda) nahi thi. Unhone kaha: Agar woh zina kare, to use koda maaro, aur agar woh phir zina kare, to use koda maaro aur phir use bech do chahe rassi ke badle hi ho. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone (Nabi ne) ye teesri ya chauthi baar mein kaha (unka bayaan laundi ki bikri se mutalliq). Ibn Shihab ne kaha ki lafz dafir (jo istemal hua hai) ka matlab rassi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira and Zaid b. Khalid al-Jubani, but in this no merition is made of the words of Ibn Shihab that dafir means rope.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira aur Zaid bin Khalid al-Jubani ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein Ibn Shihab ke alfaaz ka koi zikr nahi hai ki dafir ka matlab rassi hota hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani in the same way as transmitted by Malik with this (difference) tnat there is a doubt whether her sale (that of the slave-girl committing adultery) was mentioned after the third or the fourth time.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira aur Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ki sanad se usi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai jaise Malik ne ise riwayat kiya, is farq ke saath ki isme shak hai ki uski (zina karne wali laundi ki) bikri teesri ya chauthi baar ke baad zikr ki gayi thi.

e: Abd al-Rahman reported that 'Ali, while delivering the address said: O people, impose the prescribed punishment upon your slaves, those who are married and those not married, for a slave-woman belonging to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had committed adultery, and he committed me to flog her. But she had recently given birth to a child and I was afraid that if I flogged her I might kill her. So I mentioned that to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he said: You have done well.
hi: Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne, khitaab dete hue, kaha: Aye logo, apne ghulamon par muqarrar saza laagoo karo, chahe woh shaadishuda hon ya na hon, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek laundi ne zina kiya, aur unhone mujhe use koda maarne ki zimmedaari di. Lekin usne haal hi mein ek bachche ko paida kiya tha aur mujhe dar tha ki agar main use koda maaroon, to main use maar sakta hoon. To maine iska zikr Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se kiya aur unhone kaha: Tumne achha kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of as-Suddi with the same chain of trznsmitters, but he did not mention: " Those who are married and those who are not married." There is also an addition in it:" I spare her until she is all right."
hi: Ye hadees as-Suddi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone ye zikr nahi kiya: "Woh shaadishuda hon ya na hon." Ismein ye izafa bhi hai: "Main use tab tak bakhshta hoon jab tak woh theek na ho jaaye."

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person who had drink wine was brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He gave him forty stripes with two lashes. Abu Bakr also did that, but when Umar (assumed the responsibilities) of the Caliphate, he consulted people and Abd al-Rahman said: The mildest punishment (for drinking) is eighty (stripes) and 'Umar their prescribed this punishment.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs jisne sharaab pi thi use Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Unhone use chalis koda maare do koda dandon se. Abu Bakr ne bhi aisa hi kiya, lekin jab Umar (khalifa ki zimmedaariyan sambhaale), unhone logon se salaah maangi aur Abd al-Rahman ne kaha: (Sharaab peene ke liye) sabse halki saza aasi (koda) hai aur Umar ne unhe ye saza di.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gave a beating with palm branches and shoes, and that Abu Bakr gave forty lashes. When Umar (became the Commander of the Faithful) and the people went near to pastures and towns, he said (to the Companions of the Holy Prophet). What is your opinion about lashing for drinking? Thereupon Abd al-Rahman b. Auf said: My opinion is that you fix it as the mildest punishment. Then 'Umar inflicted eighty stripes.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) khajoor ki daaliyon aur jootoon se maar dete the, aur Abu Bakr ne chalis koda maare. Jab Umar (Momino ke Ameer bane) aur log charaagaahon aur shehron ke qareeb chale gaye, unhone (Nabi ke sahaba se) kaha: Sharaab peene ke liye koda maarne ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Isper Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha: Meri raay hai ki aap ise sabse halki saza ke soorat mein tay karein. Phir Umar ne aasi koda laagoo kiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to strike forty times with shoes and palm branches (in case of drinking of) wine. The rest of the hadith is the same and there is no mention of pastures and towns.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) jootoon aur khajoor ki daaliyon se chalis baar maara karte the (sharaab peene ke maamle mein). Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur charaagaahon aur shehron ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Hudain b. al-Mundhir Abu Sasan reported: I saw that Walid was brought to Uthmin b. 'Affan as he had prayed two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer, and then he said: I make an increase for you. And two men bore witness against him. One of them was Humran who said that he had drunk wine. The second one gave witness that he had seen him vomiting. Uthman said: He would not have vomited (wine) unless he had drunk it. He said: 'Ali, stand up and lash him. 'Ali said: Hasan, stand up and lash him. Thereupon Hasan said: Let him suffer the heat (of Caliphate) who has enjoyed its coolness. ('Ali felt annoyed at this remark) and he said: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far, stand up and flog him, and he began to flog him and 'Ali counted the stripes until these were forty. He (Hadrat 'Ali) said: Stop now, and then said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gave forty stripes, and Abu Bakr also gave forty stripes, and Umar gave eighty stripes, and all these fall under the category of the Sunnab, but this one (forty stripes) is dearer to me.
hi: Hudin bin al-Mundhir Abu Sasan ne bayan kiya: Maine dekha ki Walid ko Uthman bin Affan ke paas laaya gaya jab unhone subah ki namaz ke do rakat padhe the, aur phir unhone kaha: Main tumhare liye aur izafa karta hoon. Aur do aadmiyon ne unke khilaaf gawaahi di. Unmein se ek Humran the jinhone kaha ki unhone sharaab pi thi. Doosre ne gawaahi di ki unhone unhe ulti karte dekha tha. Uthman ne kaha: Woh (sharaab) ulti nahi karte agar unhone use na piya hota. Unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam), khade ho jao aur use koda maaro. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Hasan (Alayhis Salam), khade ho jao aur use koda maaro. Isper Hasan ne kaha: Us shakhs ko garmi bhugtne do jisne (khilafat ki) thandak ka aanand liya hai. (Ali (Alayhis Salam) is baat par naaraaz hue) aur unhone kaha: Abdullah bin Ja'far, khade ho jao aur use koda maaro, aur unhone use koda maarna shuru kiya aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) koda gina te rahe yahan tak ki woh chaalis ho gaye. Unhone (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Ab ruk jao, aur phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chaalis koda maare, aur Abu Bakr ne bhi chaalis koda maare, aur Umar ne assi koda maare, aur ye sab Sunnat ke daayre mein aate hain, lekin ye (chaalis koda) mujhe zyada priya hai.

e: Ali reported: If I impose Hadd on anyone, and he (in course of punish ment) dies, I would not mind except in case of a drunkard. If he dies. I would pay indemnity for him because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has laid down no rule for it.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Agar main kisi par Hadd (muqarrar saza) laagoo karta hoon, aur woh (saza ke daurane) mar jaata hai, mujhe koi aitraaz nahi hoga siwaay ek sharaabi ke maamle mein. Agar woh mar jaaye, main uski taraf se muaaviza ada karunga kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne iske liye koi qaida nahi banaaya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Sufyan.
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Barda Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None should be given more than ten lashes, but in case of any Hadd out of the Huded of Allah.
hi: Abu Barda Ansari ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi ko das koda se zyada nahi diye jaane chahiye, siwaay Allah ke Hudud (muqarrar sazaon) mein se kisi ek ke maamle mein.

e: Ubida b. as-Samit reported: While we were in the company of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoi him) he said: Swear allegiance to me that you will not associate anything with Allah, that you will not commit adultery, that you will not steal, that you will not take any life which it is forbidden by Allah to take but with (legal) justification; and whoever among you fulfils it, his reward is with Allah and he who commits any such thing and is punished for it, that will be all atonement for it And if anyone commits anything and Allah conceals (his faultfls), his matter rests with Allah. He may forgive if He likes, and He may punish him if He likes.
hi: Ubida bin as-Samit ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the unhone kaha: Mujhse bai'at karo ki tum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karoge, ki tum zina nahi karoge, ki tum chori nahi karoge, ki tum koi jaan nahi loge jise Allah ne mana kiya hai leni, siwaay munasib (kaanooni) vajah ke; aur jo koi tum mein se ise poora karta hai, uska sawaab Allah ke paas hai, aur jo koi aisa koi amal karta hai aur use saza milti hai, ye uske liye ek kaffara hoga. Aur agar koi kuch karta hai aur Allah use chhupa deta hai (uske dosh ko), to uska maamla Allah ke paas hai. Woh chaahe to use maaf kar sakta hai, aur woh chaahe to use saza de sakta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters with this addition: " He recited to us the verse pertaining to women, viz, that they will not associate anything with Allah.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Unhone humein auraton se mutalliq aayat padhi, yaani ki woh Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karengi."

e: 'Ubida b. as-Samit reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took (a pledge) from us as he took from the women that we will not associate anything with Allah and we will not steal, and we will not commit adultery, and we will not kill our children, and we will not bring calumny upon one another. And he who amongst you fulfils (this pledge), his reward rests with Allah, and he upon whom amongst you is imposed the prescribed punishment and that is carried out, that is his expiation (for that sin), and he whose (sins) were covered by Allah, his matter rests with Allah. He may punish him if He likes or may forgive him if He so likes.
hi: Ubida bin as-Samit ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse (bai'at) li jaisi unhone auraton se li thi ki hum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karenge aur hum chori nahi karenge, aur hum zina nahi karenge, aur hum apne bachchon ko qatal nahi karenge, aur hum ek-doosre par jhoota ilzaam nahi lagaayenge. Aur jo tum mein se (is bai'at ko) poora karta hai, uska sawaab Allah ke paas hai, aur jispar tum mein se muqarrar saza laagoo ki jaati hai aur woh di jaati hai, ye uske liye kaffara hai (us gunah ka), aur jiske (gunah) Allah ne chhupaaye, uska maamla Allah ke paas hai. Woh chaahe to use saza de sakta hai ya woh chaahe to use maaf kar sakta hai.

e: Ubida b. as-Samit repnrted: I was one of those headmen who swore allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we will not associate anything with Allah, and will not commit adultery, and will not steal, and will not kill any soul which Allah has forbidden, but with justice nor plunder, nor disobey (Allah and His Apostle), then Paradise (will be the reward) in case we do these (acts) ; and if we commit any outrage (and that goes unpunished in the world), it is Allah Who would decide about it. Ibn Rumh said: Its judgment lies with Allah.
hi: Ubida bin as-Samit ne bayan kiya: Main un sardaaron mein se ek tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bai'at li ki hum Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karenge, aur zina nahi karenge, aur chori nahi karenge, aur koi jaan qatal nahi karenge jise Allah ne mana kiya hai, siwaay insaaf ke, na luteraagardi karenge, na (Allah aur Uske Rasool ki) naafarmani karenge, phir Jannat (sawaab hoga) agar hum ye (amal) karein; aur agar hum koi ghor aparaadh karte hain (aur woh duniya mein bina saza ke reh jaata hai), to ye Allah hi hai jo iske baare mein faisla karega. Ibn Rumh ne kaha: Iska faisla Allah ke paas hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No requital is payable for a wound caused by an animal, for (falling into) a well and a mine, and one-fifth (is the share of the government) in the buried treasure (treasure-trove).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi jaanwar ke ke zariye pahunchaayi gayi chot ka koi muaaviza nahi hai, na kuen (mein girne) ka, na khaan (mein girne) ka, aur (sarkaar ka hissa) paanchvaan hissa hai gadhe hue khazane mein (treasure-trove).

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The wound caused (by falling) in the well, in the mine, and caused bv the animal has no requital for it; and there is one-fifth (for the government) in the buried treasure.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kuen mein, khaan mein, aur jaanwar ke ke zariye pahunchaayi gayi chot ka koi muaaviza nahi hai; aur gadhe hue khazane mein (sarkaar ke liye) paanchvaan hissa hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If the people were given according to their claims, they would claim the lives of persons and their properties, but the oath must be taken by the defendant.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar logon ko unke daawon ke mutabik diya jaata, to woh doosron ki jaanein aur maal ka daawa karte, lekin qasam prativaadi (jispar ilzaam laga hai) ko honi chahiye.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment on the basis of oath by the defendant.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne prativaadi ki qasam ke aadhar par faisla diya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pronounced judgment on the basis of an oath and a witness (by the plaintiff).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek qasam aur ek gawaah (vaadi ke zariye) ke aadhar par faisla diya.

e: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You bring to me, for (judgment) your disputes, some of you perhaps being more eloquent in their plea than others, so I give judgment on their behalf according to what I hear from them. (Bear in mind, in my judgment) if I slice off anything for him from the right of his brother, he should not accept that, for I sliced off for him a portion from the Hell.
hi: Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum apne jhagde faisle ke liye mere paas laate ho, tum mein se kuch shayad apni dalil mein doosron se zyada vaakpatu hon, is liye main unke haq mein faisla deta hoon jo maine unse suna hai. (Yaad rakho, mere faisle mein) agar main uske liye kuch uske bhai ke haq se kaat kar deta hoon, use ise qubool nahi karna chahiye, kyunki maine uske liye jahannam ka ek hissa kaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard the clamour of contenders at the door of his apartment. He went to them, and said: I am a human being and the claimants bring to me (the dispute) and perhaps some of them are more eloquent than the others. I judge him to be on the right, and thus decide in his favcur. So he whom I, by my judgment, (give the undue share) out of the right of a Muslim,. I give him a portion of Fire; he may burden himself with it or abandon it.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne kamre ke darwaze par jhagde karne walon ka shor suna. Woh unke paas gaye, aur kaha: Main ek insaan hoon aur daawedaar mere paas (jhagda) laate hain aur shayad unmein se kuch doosron se zyada vaakpatu hote hain. Main use haq mein faisla deta hoon jise main sahi maanta hoon, aur is tarah uske haq mein faisla deta hoon.
