Is liye jise main, apne faisle se, (munasib hisse se zyada) ek Musalman ke haq se deta hoon, main use aag ka ek hissa deta hoon; woh chaahe to isse apne upar le sakta hai ya isse chhod sakta hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported: Hind. the daughter of 'Utba, wife of Abu Sufyan, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Abu Sufyan is a miserly person. He does not give adequate maintenance for me and my children, but (I am constrained) to take from his wealth (some part of it) without his knowledge. Is there any sin for me? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take from his property what is customary which may suffice you and your children.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hind, Utba ki beti, Abu Sufyan ki zauja, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Abu Sufyan ek kanjoos shakhs hai. Woh mere aur mere bachchon ke liye kaafi bhar-poshan nahi dete, lekin (mujhe majboor hokar) unki daulat se (kuch hissa) bina unhe bataye lena padta hai. Kya iske liye mujhpar koi gunah hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unki maal se woh lo jo aam riwaaj ke mutabik ho aur jo tumhare aur tumhare bachchon ke liye kaafi ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chair of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported that Hind came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, by Allah, there was no other household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherished Allah bringing disgrace upon it, (and now) there is no other household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherish Allah granting it honour. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is so, by Him in Whose Hand is my life She said: Allah's Messenger, Abu Sufyan is a niggardly person. Is there any harm for me if I spend upon his children out of his wealth without his permission? Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: There is no harm for you if you spend upon them what is reasonable.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Hind Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, zameen ki satah par aapke khaandaan se zyada koi doosra khaandaan nahi tha jiske baare mein main Allah se ye chaahti thi ki uspar beizzati aaye, (aur ab) zameen ki satah par aapke khaandaan se zyada koi doosra khaandaan nahi hai jiske baare mein main Allah se ye chaahti hoon ki use izzat mile. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ye aisa hi hoga, us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Abu Sufyan ek kanjoos shakhs hai. Kya mujhe koi nuksaan hai agar main unke bachchon par unki maal se bina unki ijazat ke kharch karun? Isper Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hai agar tum unpar wo kharch karo jo munasib hai.

e: A'isha reported that Hind, daughter of Utba h. Rabi', came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, by Allah, there was no household upon the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherished that it should be disgraced. But today there is no household on the surface of the earth than your household about which I cherish that it be honoured Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. It will increase, by Him in Whose Hand is my life. She then said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a niggardly person; is there any harm for me if I spend out of that which belongs to him on our children? He said to her: No, but only that what is reasonable.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Hind, Utba bin Rabi ki beti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, zameen ki satah par aapke khaandaan se zyada koi doosra khaandaan nahi tha jiske baare mein main chaahti thi ki use apmaanit kiya jaaye. Lekin aaj zameen ki satah par aapke khaandaan se zyada koi doosra khaandaan nahi hai jiske baare mein main chaahti hoon ki use izzat mile. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye aur badhega, us hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai. Unhone phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Abu Sufyan ek kanjoos shakhs hai; kya mujhe koi nuksaan hai agar main unki maal se, jo unki hai, humare bachchon par kharch karun? Unhone unse kaha: Nahi, lekin sirf jo munasib ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah likes three things for you and He disapproves three things for you. He is pleased with you that you worship Him and associate nor anything with Him, that you hold fast the rope of Allah, and be not scattered; and He disapproves for you irrelevant talk, persistent questioning ane the wasting of wealth.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah tumhare liye teen cheezon ko pasand karta hai aur teen cheezon ko napasand karta hai. Woh isse khush hai ki tum Uski ibadat karo aur Uske saath kisi ko shareek na karo, ki tum Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se pakde raho, aur alag-thalag na ho; aur Woh tumhare liye be-mudda baat, baar-baar sawaal karna aur daulat gawaana napasand karta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verity Allah, the Glorious and Majestic, has forbidden for you: disobedience to mothers, and burying alive daughters, withholding the right of others in spite of having the power to return that to them and demanding that (which is not one's legitimate right). And He disapproved three things for you; irrelevant talk, persistent questioning and wasting of wealth.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah, jo Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne tumhare liye ye cheezein mana ki hain: maaon ki naafarmani, aur betiyon ko zinda dafn karna, doosron ka haq rokna jabki unhe wapas dene ki taaqat ho, aur woh maangna (jo apna vaajib haq nahi). Aur Usne tumhare liye teen cheezein napasand ki hain: be-mudda baat, baar-baar sawaal karna aur daulat gawaana.

e: A hadith like this has been trransmitted on the authority of Mansur with a slight vairiation of words.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Mansur ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sha'bi reported that the scribe of al-Mughira b. Shu'ba said: Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira: Write for me something which you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; and he wrote: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Verily Allah disapproves three thingq for you: irrelevant talk, wasting of wealth and persistent questioning.
hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya ki al-Mughira bin Shu'ba ke likhne wale ne kaha: Muawiya ne Mughira ko likha: Mere liye kuch aisa likho jo tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai; aur unhone likha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah tumhare liye teen cheezein napasand karta hai: be-mudda baat, daulat gawaana aur baar-baar sawaal karna.

e: Warrad reported that al-Mughira wrote to Mu'awiya: Peace be upon you, and then coming to the poirt (I should say) that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah has Prohibited three things and has forbidden three things. He has declared absolutely haram the disobedience of father, burying of daughters alive, and withholding that which you have power to return, and has forbidden three things: irrelevant talk, persistent questioning, and wasting of wealth.
hi: Warrad ne bayan kiya ki al-Mughira ne Muawiya ko likha: Aapko salaam ho, aur phir mudde par aate hue (main kahunga) ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah ne teen cheezein mana ki hain aur teen cheezein na-jaayez qaraar di hain. Usne waalid ki naafarmani ko, betiyon ko zinda dafn karne ko, aur woh rokne ko jise wapas dene ki tumhare paas taaqat ho, saaf taur par haraam ailaan kiya hai, aur Usne teen cheezon se mana kiya hai: be-mudda baat, baar-baar sawaal karna, aur daulat gawaana.

e: 'Amr b. al-'As reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a judge gives a decision, having tried his best to decide correctly and is right, there are two rewards for him; and if he gave a judgment after having tried his best (to arrive at a correct decision) but erred, there is one reward for him.
hi: Amr bin al-As ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab koi qaazi faisla deta hai, apni poori koshish karke sahi faisla karne ki aur woh sahi hai, uske liye do sawaab hain; aur agar usne apni poori koshish (sahi faisla karne ki) ke baad faisla diya lekin galat hua, uske liye ek sawaab hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Usama b. al-Had al-Laithi.
hi: Ye hadees Usama bin al-Had al-Laithi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported: My father dictated (and I wrote for him) to Ubaidullah b. Abu Bakra while he was the judge of Sijistan: Do not judge between two persons when you are angry, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should judge between two persons when he is angry.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid ne likhwaaya (aur maine unke liye likha) Ubaidullah bin Abu Bakra ke naam jab woh Sijistan ke qaazi the: Do logon ke beech faisla mat karo jab tum gusse mein ho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ko bhi do logon ke beech faisla nahi karna chahiye jab woh gusse mein ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who innovates things in our affairs for which there is no valid (reason) (commits sin) and these are to be rejected.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo humare maamlon mein aisi cheezein nayi laata hai jiske liye koi maany (vajah) nahi hai (gunah karta hai) aur ye radd ki jaani chahiyein.

e: Sa'd b. Ibrahim reported: I asked Qasim b. Muhammad about a person who had three dwelling houses and he willed away the third part of every one of these houses; he (Qasim b. Muhammad) said: All of them could be combined in one house; and then said: 'A'isha informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who did any act for which there is no sanction from our behalf, that is to be rejected.
hi: Sa'd bin Ibrahim ne bayan kiya: Maine Qasim bin Muhammad se poocha us shakhs ke baare mein jiske teen rehne ke ghar the aur usne har ek ghar ka teesra hissa wasiyat mein diya; unhone (Qasim bin Muhammad ne) kaha: Ye sab ek hi ghar mein jode jaa sakte hain; aur phir kaha: Aisha ne mujhe bataaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jisne aisa amal kiya jiske liye humari taraf se koi swikriti nahi hai, use radd kiya jaana chahiye.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Should I not tell you of the best witnesses? He is the one who produces his evidence before he is asked for it.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kya main tumhe sabse behtareen gawaahon ke baare mein na bataaun? Woh hai jo apna saboot pesh karta hai isse pehle ki usse maanga jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: While two women had been going along witn their two sons, a wolf came and made away with the child of one of them. One of them said to her companion: It is with your child that it (the wolf) has run away The other one said: It has run away with your child. They brought the matter to (Hadrat) Dawud (David) for decision and he made a decision in favour of the elder one. They then went to Sulaiman b. Dawud (may there be peace upon both of them) and told them (the story). He said: Bring me a knife so that I may cut him (the child) (into two parts) for you. The younger one said: No, it can't be, may Allah have mercy upon you, he (the child) belongs to her (the elder). So he gave a decision in favour of the younger one. abu Huraira said: If ever I heard of the word as-sikin at all, it was that day. We called it by no other name but al-Mudya.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab do auraten apne do beton ke saath ja rahi thin, ek bhediya aaya aur unmein se ek ke bachche ko le gaya. Unmein se ek ne apni saathi se kaha: Tumhare hi bachche ko woh (bhediya) le gaya hai. Doosri ne kaha: Ye tumhare bachche ko le gaya. Woh maamla (Hazrat) Dawud (David) ke paas faisle ke liye laayin aur unhone bade shakhs ke haq mein faisla diya. Woh phir Sulaiman bin Dawud (dono par shaanti ho) ke paas gayin aur unhe (kahani) bataayi. Unhone kaha: Mere paas ek chaaku laao taaki main use (bachche ko) tumhare liye kaat sakoon. Choti waali ne kaha: Nahi, aisa nahi ho sakta, Allah aap par rehmat kare, woh (bachcha) uski hai (badi ki). To unhone (Sulaiman ne) choti ke haq mein faisla diya. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Agar maine kabhi 'as-sikin' lafz suna, to woh us din tha. Hum ise sirf 'al-Mudya' naam se hi pukaarte the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu az-Zinad with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu az-Zinad ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammim b. Munabbih said: Abu Huraira reported (so many) ahadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and one of them is this: A person bought from another person a piece of land, and the person who had, bought that land found in it an earthen ware which contained gold. The person who had bought the land said (to the seller of the land): Take your gold from me, for I bought only the land from you and not the gold. The man who had sold the land said: I sold the land to you and whatever was in it. They referred the matter to a person. One who was made as a judge said to them: Have you any issue? One of them said: I have a boy, and the other said: I have a young daughter He (the judge) said: Marry this young boy with the girl, and spend something on yourselves and also give (some) charity out of it.
hi: Hammim bin Munabbih ne kaha: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki (itni saari) hadeesein riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye hai: Ek shakhs ne doosre shakhs se zameen ka ek tukda khareeda, aur jis shakhs ne zameen khareedi thi usne usmein mitti ka ek bartan paaya jismein sona tha. Jisne zameen khareedi thi usne (zameen bechne wale se) kaha: Apna sona mujhse le lo, kyunki maine tumse sirf zameen khareedi thi, sona nahi. Jisne zameen bechi thi usne kaha: Maine tumhe zameen bechi thi aur usmein jo bhi tha. Unhone apna maamla ek shakhs ke paas rakha. Jise qaazi banaaya gaya tha usne unse kaha: Kya tumhare koi aulaad hai? Unmein se ek ne kaha: Mere paas ek larka hai, aur doosre ne kaha: Mere paas ek jawaan beti hai. Unhone (qaazi ne) kaha: Is jawaan larke ki shaadi is larki se karo, aur apne upar kuch kharch karo aur usme se kuch sadaqa bhi do.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported: A man came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked him about picking up of stray articles. He said: Recognise (well) its bag and the strap (by which it is tied) then make announcement of that for a year. If its owner comes (within this time return that to him), otherwise it is yours. He (again) said: (What about) the lost goat? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is yours or for your brother, or for the wolf. He said: (What about) the lost camel? Thereupon he said: You have nothing to do with it; it has a leather bag along with it, and its shoes also. It comes to the watering-place, eats (the leaves of the) trees until its master finds him.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse gum hui cheezon ko uthaane ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Uski thaili aur band (jisse woh bandhi hai) achhi tarah pehchaano, phir ek saal tak iska aam ailaan karo. Agar uska maalik (is waqt ke andar) aaye (to use wapas karo), warna ye tumhari hai. Unhone (dobara) kaha: (Kya kiya jaaye) gum hui bakri ke baare mein? Isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ye tumhari hai ya tumhare bhai ki, ya bhediye ki. Unhone kaha: (Kya kiya jaaye) gum hue oont ke baare mein? Isper unhone kaha: Tumhe isse koi lena-dena nahi; iske saath ek chamde ki thaili bhi hai, aur iske joote bhi. Ye paani pilaane ki jagah pahunchta hai, darakhton ke (pattoon ko) khaata hai yahan tak ki uska maalik use dhoondh leta hai.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about picking up of stray articles, whereupon he said: Make announcement about it for a year, and recognise well the strap and the bag (containing that) ; then spend that; and if its owner comes, make him the payment of that. He (the inquirer) said: Messenger of Allah, what about the lost goat? he said: Take it, for that is yours or for your brother, or for the wolf. He (again) said: (What about) the lost camel? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was enraged until his cheeks became red (or his face became red) and then said: You have nothing to do about that; it has feet and a leather bag (to quench its thirst) until its owner finds it.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gum hui cheezon ko uthaane ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ek saal tak iska ailaan karo, aur band aur thaili (jismein ye hai) achhi tarah pehchaano; phir ise kharch karo; aur agar uska maalik aaye, use uski keemat ada karo. Unhone (poochne wale ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gum hui bakri ke baare mein kya? Unhone kaha: Ise le lo, kyunki ye tumhari hai ya tumhare bhai ki, ya bhediye ki. Unhone (dobara) kaha: (Kya kiya jaaye) gum hue oont ke baare mein? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko gussa aaya yahan tak ki unke gaal laal ho gaye (ya unka chehra laal ho gaya) aur phir kaha: Isse tumhara koi lena-dena nahi; iske paas paon aur chamde ki thaili hai (apni pyaas bujhaane ke liye) jab tak uska maalik use dhoondh nahi leta.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Rabi'a b. Abu Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " There came a person to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was with him, and he asked him about picking up of a stray article, and he said: When none comes to demand it, then spend that."
hi: Ye hadees Rabi'a bin Abu Abd al-Rahman ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek shakhs aaya jab main unke saath tha, aur usne unse gum hui cheez ko uthaane ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Jab koi use maangne nahi aata, to ise kharch karo."

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported. There came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a person, the rest of the hadith is the same but with the variation (of these words): His face became red, his forehead too, and he felt annoyed; and made an addition after the words: He should make announcement of that for a year, and if its owner does not turn up, then it is a trust with you.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek shakhs aaya, baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is tabdeeli ke saath (in alfaazon ki): Unka chehra laal ho gaya, unki peshaani bhi, aur woh naaraaz mehsoos hue; aur in alfaazon ke baad izafa kiya: Use ek saal tak iska ailaan karna chahiye, aur agar uska maalik nahi aata, to ye tumhare paas ek amaanat hai.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani, the Companion ot Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the picking up of stray gold or silver, whereupon he said: Recognise well the strap and the bag (containing) that and then make an announcement regarding that for one year, but if none recognises it, then spend that and it would be a trust with you; and if someone comes one day to make demand of that, then pay that to him. He (the inquirer) asked about the lost camel, whereupon he said: You have nothing to do with that. Leave that alone, for it has feet and also a leather bag, it drinks water, and eats (the leaves) of the trees. He asked him about sheep, whereupon he said: Take it, it is for you, or for your brother, or for the wolf.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahabi, ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gum hue sone ya chandi ko uthaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Band aur thaili (jismein ye hai) achhi tarah pehchaano aur phir ek saal tak iska ailaan karo, lekin agar koi ise pehchaane nahi, to ise kharch karo aur ye tumhare paas ek amaanat hogi; aur agar koi ek din ise maangne aata hai, to ye use ada karo. Unhone (poochne wale ne) gum hue oont ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Isse tumhara koi lena-dena nahi. Isse akela chhod do, kyunki iske paas paon aur chamde ki thaili bhi hai, ye paani peeta hai, aur darakhton ke (pattoon) ko khaata hai. Unhone unse bhedon ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ise le lo, ye tumhare liye hai, ya tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported: A person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about a lost camel; Rabi'a made this addition: He (the Holy Prophet) was so much annoyed that his cheeks became red." The rest of the hadith is the same. He (the narrator) made this addition:" If its (that of the article) owner comes and he recognises the bag (which contained it) and its number, and the strap. then give that to them, but if not, then it is for you."
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gum hue oont ke baare mein poocha; Rabi'a ne ye izafa kiya: Woh (Nabi) itne naaraaz hue ki unke gaal laal ho gaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Unhone (raawi ne) ye izafa kiya: "Agar uska (cheez ka) maalik aaye aur woh us thaili ko aur uski tadaad ko, aur band ko pehchaane, to woh use de do, lekin agar nahi, to ye tumhari hai."

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about picking up of stray things, whereupon he said: Make announcement of that for one year, but if it is not recognised (by the owner), then recognise its big and strap, then eat it; and if its owner comes, then give that to him. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Al-Dahhak b. Uthman with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se gum hui cheezon ko uthaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Ek saal tak iska ailaan karo, lekin agar ye (uske maalik ke zariye) pehchaani nahi jaati, to uski thaili aur band pehchaano, phir ise khaao; aur agar uska maalik aaye, to use ye de do. Ye hadees Al-Dahhak bin Uthman ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salama b. Kuhail reported: I heard Sowaid b. Ghafala say: I went out, and also Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a for Jihad, and I found a whip and took it up. They said to me: Leave it. I said: No. but I will make announcement of it and if its owner comes (then I will return that), otherwise I will use it, and I refused them. When we returned from Jihad. by a good fortune for me, I performed Pilgrimage. I came to Medina and met Ubayy b. Ka'b, and related to him the affair of the whip and their opinion (the opinion of Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a) about it (i. e. I should throw it). Thereupon he said: I found a money bag during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which contained one hundred dinars. I came to him along with it, and he said: Make an announcement of it for one year; so I announced it, but did not find anyone who could (claim it after) recognising it. I again came to him and he said: Make announcement for one year. So I made announcement of it, but I found none who could recognise it. I came to him he said: Make announcement of it for one year. I made announcement of that but did not find one who could recognise it, whereupon he said: Preserve (in your mind) its number, its bag and its strap, and if its owner comes (then return that to him), otherwise make use of it. So I made use of that. I (Shu'ba) met him (Salama b. Kuhail) after this in Mecca, and he said: I do not know whether he said three years or one year.
hi: Salama bin Kuhail ne bayan kiya: Maine Sowaid bin Ghafala ko ye kehte suna: Main nikla, aur Zaid bin Suhan aur Salman bin Rabi'a bhi Jihad ke liye, aur maine ek koda paaya aur use uthaaya. Unhone mujhse kaha: Ise chhod do. Maine kaha: Nahi, lekin main iska ailaan karunga aur agar iska maalik aata hai (to main use wapas kar dunga), warna main ise istemal karunga, aur maine unse inkaar kiya. Jab hum Jihad se wapas aaye, mere liye ek achhi kismat se, maine Hajj kiya. Main Madina aaya aur Ubayy bin Ka'b se mila, aur unhe koda ka maamla bataya aur unki raay iske baare mein (yaani Zaid bin Suhan aur Salman bin Rabi'a ki raay ki mujhe ise phenk dena chahiye). Isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein paise ki ek thaili paayi jismein sau dinar the. Main use lekar unke paas aaya, aur unhone kaha: Ek saal tak iska ailaan karo; to maine iska ailaan kiya, lekin mujhe koi nahi mila jo ise pehchaan kar (uska daawa) kar sake. Main dobara unke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Ek saal tak ailaan karo. To maine iska ailaan kiya, lekin mujhe koi nahi mila jo ise pehchaan sake. Main unke paas aaya, unhone kaha: Ek saal tak iska ailaan karo. Maine iska ailaan kiya lekin koi nahi mila jo ise pehchaan sake, isper unhone kaha: (Apne dimaag mein) iski tadaad, iski thaili aur band mahfooz rakho, aur agar iska maalik aaye (to ise use wapas karo), warna ise istemal karo. To maine ise istemal kiya. Main unse (Salama bin Kuhail se) iske baad Makkah mein mila, aur unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone teen saal kaha ya ek saal.

e: Shu'ba reported: Salama b. Kuhail informed me or he informed people and I was among them. He said: I heard Sawaid b. Ghafala who reported: I went out along with Zaid b. Suhan and Salman b. Rabi'a, and found a whip, the rest of the hadith is the same up to the words:" I made use of that." Shu'ba said: I heard him say after ten years, that he made an announcement of it for one year.
hi: Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Salama bin Kuhail ne mujhe bataya ya unhone logon ko bataya aur main unmein tha. Unhone kaha: Maine Sawaid bin Ghafala ko ye kehte suna: Main Zaid bin Suhan aur Salman bin Rabi'a ke saath nikla, aur ek koda paaya, baaki hadees waisi hi hai in alfaazon tak: "Maine ise istemal kiya." Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine unhe das saal baad ye kehte suna ki unhone ek saal tak iska ailaan kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Salama b. Kuhail through different chains of transmitters. In their ahadith, it is three years, except in the hadith of Hammid b. Salama it is two years or three years. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Sufyan and Zaid b. Abu Unaisa and Hammid b. Salama (the words are): " If someone comes and informs you about the number (of articles) of the bag and the straps, then give that to him." Sufyan has made this addition in the narration of Waki':" Otherwise it is like your property." And in the narration of Ibn Numair the words are:" Otherwise make use of that."
hi: Ye hadees Salama bin Kuhail ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai. Unki hadeeson mein, ye teen saal hai, siwaay Hammid bin Salama ki hadees mein jahan ye do saal ya teen saal hai. Sufyan aur Zaid bin Abu Unaisa aur Hammid bin Salama ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Agar koi aaye aur tumhe thaili ki tadaad aur band ke baare mein bataaye, to use ye de do." Sufyan ne Waki ki riwayat mein ye izafa kiya: "Warna ye tumhari maal jaisa hai." Aur Ibn Numair ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Warna ise istemal karo."

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Uthman al-Taimi reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade taking into custody the stray thing of the pilgrims.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Uthman al-Taimi ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne haajiyon ki gum hui cheez ko apni malkiyat mein lene se mana kiya.

e: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as sayin.: He who found a stray article is himself led astray if he does not advertise it.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo gum hui cheez paata hai aur uska ailaan nahi karta, woh khud gumraah hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: None (of you) should milk the animal of another, but with his permission. Does any one of you like that his chamber be raided, and his vaults be broken, and his foodstuff be removed? Verily the treasures for them (those who keep animals) are the udders of the animals which feed them. So none of you should milk the animal of another but with his permission.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi (tum mein se) doosre ke jaanwar ka doodh na nikaale, bina uski ijazat ke. Kya tum mein se koi pasand karega ki uske kamre par chhaapa maara jaaye, aur uske tijoriyaan toDi jaayein, aur uska khaana le liya jaaye? Yaqeenan unke (jaanwar rakhne walon ke) liye khazane hain jaanwaron ke thann, jo unhe khilaate hain. Is liye koi bhi tum mein se doosre ke jaanwar ka doodh na nikaale bina uski ijazat ke.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abd Shuraib al-Adawi reported: My eare listened and my eye saw when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke and said: He who believes In Allah and the eireafter should show respect to the guest even with utmost kindness and courtesy. They said: Messenger of Allah, what is this utmost kindness and courtesy? He replied: It is for a day and a night. Hospitality extends for three days, and what is beyond that is a Sadaqa for him; and he who believes in Allah and the Hereafter should say something good or keep quiet.
hi: Abd Shuraib al-Adawi ne bayan kiya: Mere kaanon ne suna aur meri aankhon ne dekha jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baat ki aur kaha: Jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai use apne mehmaan ki izzat karni chahiye, poori narmi aur adab ke saath. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye poori narmi aur adab kya hai? Unhone jawab diya: Ye ek din aur ek raat ke liye hai. Mehmaannawaazi teen dinon tak jaari rehti hai, aur uske baad jo bhi hai woh uske liye sadaqa hai; aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai use kuch achha kehna chahiye ya khamosh rehna chahiye.

e: Abu Shuriah al-Khuza'i reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (The period of the entertainment of a guest is three days, and utmost kindness and courtesy is for a day and a night. =" It is not permissible for a Muslim to stay with, his brother until he makes him sinful. They said: Messenger of Allah, how he would make him sinful? He (the Holy Prophet) said: He stays with him (so long) that nothing is left with him to entertain him.
hi: Abu Shuriah al-Khuza'i ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: (Mehmaan ke mehmaannawaazi ki muddat teen din hai, aur poori narmi aur adab ek din aur ek raat ke liye hai). Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai ke paas tab tak rahe jab tak woh use gunahgaar na bana de. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh use kaise gunahgaar banaayega? Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Woh unke paas (itni der) rahta hai ki unke paas uski mehmaannawaazi karne ke liye kuch nahi bachta.

e: Sa'id al-Maqburi reported: I heard Abu Shuraih al-Khuzill saying: My ears heard and my eyes saw and my mind retained it, when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spok this, and he then narrated the hadith and made mention of this:" It is not permissible for any one of you to stay with his brother until he makes him sinful."
hi: Sa'id al-Maqburi ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Shuraih al-Khuzil ko ye kehte suna: Mere kaanon ne suna aur meri aankhon ne dekha aur mere dimaag ne ise rakha, jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye baat ki, aur phir unhone hadees riwayat ki aur ye zikr kiya: "Tum mein se kisi ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai ke paas tab tak rahe jab tak woh use gunahgaar na bana de."

e: 'Uqba b. Amir reported: We said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): You send us out and we come to the people who do not give us hospitality, so what is your opinion? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you come to the people who order for you what is befitting a guest, accept it; but if they do not. take from them what befits them to give to a guest.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne bayan kiya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Aap humein bhejte hain aur hum aise logon ke paas aate hain jo humein mehmaannawaazi nahi dete, to aapki kya raay hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum aise logon ke paas aao jo tumhare liye woh muhaiya karayein jo ek mehmaan ke laayak hai, use qubool karo; lekin agar woh na karein, to unse woh lo jo unhe ek mehmaan ko dena chahiye.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: While we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, a person came upon his mount and began to stare on the right and on the left, (it was at this moment) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who has an extra mount should give that to one who has no mount for him, and he who has surplus of provisions should give them to him who has no provisions, and he made mention of so many kinds of wealth until we were of the opinion that none of us has any right over the surplus.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, ek shakhs apni sawaari par aaya aur daayi taraf aur baayi taraf ghoorne laga, (ye us waqt tha) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jiske paas atirikt sawaari hai use use us shakhs ko dena chahiye jiske paas koi sawaari nahi hai, aur jiske paas atirikt raashan hai use unhe dena chahiye jiske paas raashan nahi hai, aur unhone itne kism ki daulat ka zikr kiya ki humein laga ki humme se kisi ka bhi atirikt cheez par koi haq nahi hai.

e: Iyas b. Salama reported on the authority of his father: We set out on an expedition with, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We faced hardship (in getting provisions) until we decided to slaughter some of our riding animals. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), commanded us to pool our provisions of food. So we spread a sheet of leather and the provisions of the people were collected on it. I stretched myself to measure how much that was (the length and breadth of the sheet on which the provisions were laid). I measured it and (found) that it was (in length and breadth) of (so much size) on which a goat could sit. We were fourteen hundred persons. We (all) ate until we were fully satisfied and then filled our bags with provisions. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Is there any water for performing ablution. Then there came a man with a small bucket containing some water. He threw it in a basin. We all fourteen hundred persons performed ablution using the water in plenty. Then there came after that eight persons and they said: Is there any water to perform ablution? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The ablution has already been performed.
hi: Iyas bin Salama ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par nikle. Humein mushkilon ka saamna karna pada (raashan haasil karne mein) yahan tak ki humne apne kuch sawaari waale jaanwaron ko zibah karne ka faisla kiya. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne humein humara raashan ikattha karne ka hukum diya. To humne chamde ki ek chaadar bichhaayi aur logon ka raashan usper ikattha kiya gaya. Maine khud ko phailaaya ye naapne ke liye ki ye kitna tha (chaadar ki lambaai aur chaudai jispar raashan rakha gaya tha). Maine ise naapa aur (paaya) ki ye (lambaai aur chaudai mein) itna tha ki ek bakri usmein baith sakti thi. Hum chaudah sau log the. Hum sab (aisa) khaya yahan tak ki hum poori tarah santusht ho gaye aur phir apni thailiyaan raashan se bhar li. Phir Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Kya wuzu karne ke liye koi paani hai? Phir ek aadmi ek chhoti balti ke saath aaya jismein kuch paani tha. Usne use ek bartan mein daala. Hum sab, chaudah sau log, ne bahut zyada paani se wuzu kiya. Phir uske baad aath log aaye aur unhone kaha: Kya wuzu karne ke liye koi paani hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Wuzu ho chuka hai.

e: Ibn 'Aun reported: I wrote to Nafi' inquiring from him whether it was necessary to extend (to the disbelievers) an invitation to accept (Islam) before meeting them in fight. He wrote (in reply) to me that it was necessary in the early days of Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a raid upon Banu Mustaliq while they were unaware and their cattle were having a drink at the water. He killed those who fought and imprisoned others. On that very day, he captured Juwairiya bint al-Harith. Nafi' said that this tradition was related to him by Abdullah b. Umar who (himself) was among the raiding troops.
hi: Ibn Aun ne bayan kiya: Maine Nafi ko likha unse ye poochte hue ki kya jung se pehle (kaafiron ko) Islam qubool karne ka aahvaan dena zaroori tha. Unhone jawaab mein mujhe likha ki ye Islam ke shuruaati dinon mein zaroori tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Mustaliq par hamla kiya jab woh bekhabar the aur unke maweshi paani par pi rahe the. Unhone un logon ko qatal kiya jinhone jung ki aur doosron ko qaidi banaaya. Usi din, unhone Juwairiya bint al-Harith ko pakda. Nafi ne kaha ki ye riwayat unhe Abdullah bin Umar ne di jo khud is hamla karne wali fauj mein the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Aun and the name of Juwairiya bint al-Harith was mentioned beyond any doubt.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Aun ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Juwairiya bint al-Harith ka naam bina kisi shak ke zikr kiya gaya hai.

e: It has been reported from Sulaiman b. Buraida through his father that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) appointed anyone as leader of an army or detachment he would especially exhort him to fear Allah and to be good to the Muslims who were with him. He would say: Fight in the name of Allah and in the way of Allah. Fight against those who disbelieve in Allah. Make a holy war, do not embezzle the spoils; do not break your pledge; and do not mutilate (the dead) bodies; do not kill the children. When you meet your enemies who are polytheists, invite them to three courses of action. If they respond to any one of these, you also accept it and withhold yourself from doing them any harm. Invite them to (accept) Islam; if they respond to you, accept it from them and desist from fighting against them. Then invite them to migrate from their lands to the land of the Muhajireen and inform them that, if they do so, they shall have all the privileges and obligations of the Muhajireen. If they refuse to migrate, tell them that they will have the status of Bedouin Muslims and will be subjected to the Commands of Allah like other Muslims, but they will not get any share from the spoils of war or Fai' except when they actually fight with the Muslims (against the disbelievers). If they refuse to accept Islam, demand from them the Jizya. If they agree to pay, accept it from them and hold off your hands. If they refuse to pay the tax, seek Allah's help and fight them. When you lay siege to a fort and the besieged appeal to you for protection in the name of Allah and His Prophet, do not accord to them the guarantee of Allah and His Prophet, but accord to them your own guarantee and the guarantee of your companions for it is a lesser sin that the security given by you or your companions be disregarded than that the security granted in the name of Allah and His Prophet be violated. When you besiege a fort and the besieged want you to let them out in accordance with Allah's Command, do not let them come out in accordance with His Command, but do so at your (own) command, for you do not know whether or not you will be able to carry out Allah's behest with regard to them.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi ko fauj ya toli ka sardaar banaate, woh khaas taur par usse Allah se darne aur unke saath rehne wale Musalmaanon ke saath achha vyavahaar karne ki taakeed dete. Woh kehte: Allah ke naam par aur Allah ki raah mein jung karo. Un logon se jung karo jo Allah ko nahi maante. Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, maal-e-ganimat mein hera-pheri mat karo; apna vaada mat todo; aur (murda) laashon ko vikrit mat karo; bachchon ko qatal mat karo. Jab tum apne dushmanon se milo jo mushrikeen hain, unhe teen tareekon ki taraf bulaao. Agar woh inmein se kisi ek ko qubool karein, to tum bhi ise qubool karo aur unhe koi nuksaan pahunchaane se rukh jao. Unhe Islam qubool karne ka nimantran do; agar woh tumhare aahvaan par jawaab dein, to unse ise qubool karo aur unke khilaaf jung karna chhod do. Phir unhe apni zameen se Muhajireen ki zameen ki taraf hijrat karne ka nimantran do aur unhe bataao ki agar woh aisa karte hain, to unhe Muhajireen ke saare haq aur zimmedaariyaan milengi. Agar woh hijrat karne se inkaar karein, to unhe bataao ki unhe registaan ke Musalmaanon jaisa darja milega aur woh Allah ke hukumon ke adheen honge jaise doosre Musalman, lekin unhe jung ke maal-e-ganimat ya Fai mein se koi hissa nahi milega jab tak woh Musalmaanon ke saath (kaafiron ke khilaaf) waaqai jung na karein. Agar woh Islam qubool karne se inkaar karein, to unse Jizya maango. Agar woh dene par razaamand hon, to unse ye qubool karo aur apne haath rok lo. Agar woh tax dene se inkaar karein, to Allah ki madad maango aur unse jung karo. Jab tum kisi qile ko gher lo aur ghere hue log Allah aur Uske Nabi ke naam par tumse hifaazat ki maang karein, to unhe Allah aur Uske Nabi ki zamaanat mat do, balki unhe apni khud ki zamaanat aur apne saathiyon ki zamaanat do, kyunki ye kam gunah hai ki tumhare ya tumhare saathiyon ke zariye di gayi hifaazat ki avahelnaa ho, uski nisbat ki Allah aur Uske Nabi ke naam par di gayi hifaazat ka ullanghan ho. Jab tum kisi qile ko gher lo aur ghere hue log chaahein ki tum unhe Allah ke hukum ke mutabik bahar jaane do, to unhe Uske hukum ke mutabik bahar mat jaane do, balki apne (khud ke) hukum par aisa karo, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki tum unke maamle mein Allah ke faisle ko poora kar paaoge ya nahi.

e: Sulaiman b. Buraida repotted on the authority of his father that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an Amir with a detachment he called him and advised him. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraida ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi toli ke saath koi Amir bhejte, woh use bulaate aur unhe salaah dete. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Masa that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) deputed any of his Companions on a mission, he would say: Give tidings (to the people) ; do not create (in their minds) aversion (towards religion) ; show them leniency and do not be hard upon them.
hi: Abu Masa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne kisi sahabi ko kisi mission par bhejte, woh kehte: (Logon ko) khushkhabri do; unke dilon mein (deen ke prati) beruchi paida mat karo; unhe narmi dikhaao aur unpar sakhti mat karo.

e: It has also been narrated by Sa'd b. Abu Burda through his father through his grandfather that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) sent him and Mu'adh (on a mission) to the Yemen, and said (by way of advising them): Show leniency (to the people) ; don't be hard upon them; give them glad tidings (of Divine favours in this world and the Hereafter) ; and do not create aversion. Work in collaboration and don't be divided.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Burda ne apne walid ke hawale se, apne dada ke hawale se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhe aur Mu'adh ko (ek mission par) Yemen bheja, aur kaha (unhe salaah dete hue): Narmi dikhaao (logon ke prati); sakhti mat karo; unhe khushkhabri do (is duniya aur Aakhirat mein Allah ke fazl ki); aur beruchi paida mat karo. Saath milkar kaam karo aur baante mat jao.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Buraida but for the last two words.
hi: Ye hadees Buraida ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin akhri do lafzon ke bina.

e: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) has been reported by Anas b. Malik to have said: Show leniency; do not be hard; give solace and do not create aversion.
hi: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ye alfaaz Anas bin Malik ne riwayat kiye: Narmi dikhaao; sakhti mat karo; sukoon do aur beruchi paida mat karo.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When Allah will gather together, on the Day of Judgment, all the earlier and later generations of mankind, a flag will be raised (to mark off) every person guilty of breach of faith, and it will be announced that this is the perfidy of so and so, son of so and so (to attract the attention of people to his guilt).
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab Allah Qayamat ke din manavata ki saari purani aur nayi peedhiyon ko ikattha karega, har us shakhs ke liye jisne bharosa toda ek jhanda uthaaya jaayega (uski pehchaan ke liye), aur ailaan kiya jaayega ki ye falan-falan ka, falan-falan ke bete ka, dhoka hai (logon ka dhyaan uske dosh ki taraf kheenchne ke liye).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through some other Chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se kuch doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of the same narrator, with the wording: Allah will set up a flag for every person guilty of breach of faith on the Day of Judgment, and it will be announced: Look, this is the perfidy of so and so.
hi: Ye hadees usi raawi se ek doosri sanad se in alfaazon mein riwayat ki gayi hai: Allah Qayamat ke din har us shakhs ke liye jisne bharosa toda ek jhanda khadi karega, aur ailaan kiya jaayega: Dekho, ye falan-falan ka dhoka hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: There will be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke din har dhokebaaz shakhs ke liye ek jhanda hoga.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) as saying: There will be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment, and it would be said: Here is the perfidy of so and so.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke din har dhokebaaz shakhs ke liye ek jhanda hoga, aur kaha jaayega: Ye rahi falan-falan ki bharosa-shikanaa.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There will be for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment a flag by which he will be recognised. It will be announced: Here is the breach of faith of so and so.
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Qayamat ke din har dhokebaaz shakhs ke liye ek jhanda hoga jisse woh pehchaana jaayega. Ailaan kiya jaayega: Ye rahi falan-falan ki bharosa-shikanaa.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: There would be a flag for every perfidious person on the Day of Judgment by which he will be recognised.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke din har dhokebaaz shakhs ke liye ek jhanda hoga jisse woh pehchaana jaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: On the Day of Judgment there will be a flag fixed behind the buttocks of every person guilty of the breach of faith.
hi: Abu Sa'id ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Qayamat ke din har bharosa-todne wale ke naitambon ke peeche ek jhanda gaada jaayega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: On the Day of Judgment there will be a flag for every person guilty of the breach of faith. It will be raised in proportion to the extent of his guilt; and there is no guilt of treachery more serious than the one committed by the ruler of men.
hi: Abu Sa'id ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Qayamat ke din har bharosa-todne wale shakhs ke liye ek jhanda hoga. Ise uske dosh ki had ke anupaat mein uthaaya jaayega; aur bharosa-toDne ka koi dosh usse zyada sangin nahi hai jo logon ke hukmaraan ke zariye kiya jaata hai.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: War is a stratagem.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jung ek chaal hai.

e: This hadith has also been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not desire an encounter with the enemy; but when you encounter them, be firm.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dushman se muqaabla karne ki khwahish mat rakho; lekin jab tumhara unse muqaabla ho, to mazbooti se dato raho.

e: It is narrated by Abu Nadr that he learnt from a letter sent by a man from the Aslam tribe, who was a Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ) and whose name was 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa, to 'Umar b. 'Ubaidullah when the latter marched upon Haruriyya (Khawarij) informing him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in one of those days when lie was confronting the enemy waited until the sun had declined. Then he stood up (to address the people) and said: O ye men, do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you security; (but) when you (have to) encounter them exercise patience, and you should know that Paradise is under the shadows of the swords. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up (again) and said: O Allah. Revealer of the Book, Disperser of the clouds, Defeater of the hordes, put our enemy to rout and help us against them.
hi: Abu Nadr ne bataya ki unhone Aslam qabile ke ek shakhs ke ek khat se seekha, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi the aur jinka naam Abdullah bin Abu Aufa tha, jo unhone Umar bin Ubaidullah ko likha tha jab woh Haruriyya (Khawarij) par charhaai kar rahe the, unhe bataate hue ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unmein se ek din jab woh dushman ka saamna kar rahe the, intezaar kiya yahan tak ki suraj dhal gaya. Phir woh (logon se khitaab karne) khade hue aur kaha: Aye logo, dushman se muqaabla ki khwahish mat karo. Allah se hifaazat ki dua karo; (lekin) jab tum unse muqaabla karo, sabar dikhaao, aur tumhe pata hona chahiye ki Jannat talwaaron ke saaye ke neeche hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (dobara) khade hue aur kaha: Aye Allah, Kitaab ke Zaahir Karne Waale, Baadalon Ke Bikherne Waale, Fauj Ke Harane Waale, humare dushman ko bhaga de aur unke khilaaf humari madad kar.

e: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abu Aufa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the tribes (who had marched upon Medina with a combined force in 5 H) and said: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in (taking) account, put the tribes to rout. O Lord, defeat them and shake them.
hi: Ibn Abu Aufa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un qabilon par laanat ki (jo saanjhi taqat ke saath Madina par 5 Hijri mein charhe the) aur kaha: Aye Allah, Kitaab ke Zaahir Karne Waale, Hisaab lene mein Tez, qabilon ko bhaga de. Aye Rab, unhe shikast de aur unhe hilaa de.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abu Aufa with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Aufa ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Uyaina through another chain of transmitters (who added the words)" the Disperser of clouds" in his narration.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Uyaina ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (jinhone apni riwayat mein "Baadalon Ke Bikherne Waale" alfaaz jode).

e: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day of the Battle of Uhud: O Allah, if Thou wilt (defeat Muslims), there will be none on the earth to worship Thee.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ki jung ke din kaha: Aye Allah, agar Tu chaahe (Musalmaanon ko shikast de), to zameen par koi bhi Teri ibadat karne wala nahi bachega.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that a woman was found killed in one of the battles fought by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He disapproved of the killing of women and children.
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zariye ladi gayi ek jung mein ek aurat marti hui paayi gayi. Unhone auraton aur bachchon ko qatal karne ki napasandeegi jataayi.

e: It is narrated by Ibn 'Umar that a woman was found killed in one of these battles; so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the killing of women and children.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki in jungon mein se ek mein ek aurat marti hui paayi gayi; is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne auraton aur bachchon ko qatal karne se mana kiya.

e: It is reported on the authority of Sa'b b. Jaththama that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ), when asked about the women and children of the polytheists being killed during the night raid, said: They are from them.
hi: Sa'b bin Jaththama ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki jab Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se raat ke hamlon ke daurane mushrikeen ki auraton aur bachchon ke maare jaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: Woh unhi mein se hain.

e: It is narrated by Sa'b b. Jaththama that he said (to the Holy Prophet): Messenger of Allah, we kill the children of the polytheists during the night raids. He said: They are from them.
hi: Sa'b bin Jaththama ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone (Nabi se) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum raat ke hamlon ke daurane mushrikeen ke bachchon ko qatal karte hain. Unhone kaha: Woh unhi mein se hain.

e: Sa'b b. Jaththama has narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) asked: What about the children of polytheists killed by the cavalry during the night raid? He said: They are from them.
hi: Sa'b bin Jaththama ne riwayat ki ki Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: Mushrikeen ke bachchon ka kya jinhe raat ke hamle ke daurane ghudsawaar fauj ne qatal kiya? Unhone kaha: Woh unhi mein se hain.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered the date-palms of Banu Nadir to be burnt and cut. These palms were at Buwaira. Qutaibah and Ibn Rumh in their versions of the tradition have added: So Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed the verse:" Whatever trees you have cut down or left standing on their trunks, it was with the permission of Allah so that He may disgrace the evil-doers" (lix. 5).
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Nadir ke khajoor ke darakhton ko jalaane aur kaatne ka hukum diya. Ye darakht Buwaira mein the. Qutaibah aur Ibn Rumh ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya: To Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Jo bhi darakht tumne kaate hain ya unke tano par khada rehne diya, ye Allah ki ijazat se tha taaki Woh badkaaron ko apmaanit kar sake" (59:5).

e:
It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caused the date-palms of Banu Nadir to be cut down and burnt. It is in this connection that Hassan (the poet) said: It was easy for the nobles of Quraish to burn Buwaira whose sparks were flying in all directions, 
in the same connection was revealed the Qur'anic verse:" Whatever trees you have cut down or left standing on their trunks."
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Nadir ke khajoor ke darakhton ko kataane aur jalaane ka wajah bana. Isi silsile mein Hassan (kavi) ne kaha: Quraish ke rayeeson ke liye Buwaira jalaana aasaan tha jiske chingaariyaan sab simt mein ud rahi thin, isi silsile mein Qurani aayat nazil hui: "Jo bhi darakht tumne kaate hain ya unke tano par khada rehne diya."

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) burnt the date-palms of Banu Nadir.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Nadir ke khajoor ke darakht jalaaye.

e: It has been narrated by Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One of the Prophets made a holy war. He said to his followers: One who has married a woman and wants to consummate to his marriage but has not yet done so; another who has built a house but has not yet erected its roof; and another who has bought goats and pregnantshe-camels and is waiting for their offspring-will not accommpany me. So he marched on and approached a village at or about the time of the Asr prayers. He said to the sun: Thou art subserviant (to Allah) and so am I. O Allah, stop it for me a little. It was stopped for him until Allah granted him victory. The people gathered the spoils of war (at one place). A fire approached the spoils to devour them, but it did not devour them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Some of you have been guilty of misappropriation. So one man from each tribe should swear fealty to me. The did so (putting their hands into his). The hand of one man stuck to his hand and the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Your tribe is guilty of misappropriation. Let all the members of your tribe swear fealty to me one by one. They did so, when the hands of two or three persons got stuck with his hand. He said: You have misappropriated. So they took out gold equal in volume to the head of a cow. They-placed it among the spoils on the earth. Then the fire approached the spoils and devoured them. The spoils of war were not made lawful for any people before us, This is because Allah saw our weakness and humility and made them lawful for us.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nabiyon mein se ek ne muqaddas jung ki. Unhone apne anuyaayiyon se kaha: Jisne ek aurat se shaadi ki hai aur apni shaadi ko poora karna chahta hai lekin abhi tak nahi kiya; aur ek doosra jisne ek ghar banaaya hai lekin abhi tak uski chhat nahi khadi ki; aur ek aur jisne bakriyaan aur garbhvati oontniyaan khareedi hain aur unke bachchon ka intezaar kar raha hai - woh mere saath nahi jaayenge. To woh aage badhe aur asr ki namaz ke waqt ke aas-paas ek gaon ke qareeb pahunche. Unhone suraj se kaha: Tu Allah ke adheen hai aur main bhi. Aye Allah, ise mere liye thoda roka rakh. Ye unke liye roka gaya yahan tak ki Allah ne unhe fatah di. Logon ne maal-e-ganimat ikattha kiya (ek jagah). Ek aag maal-e-ganimat ki taraf badhi use khaane ke liye, lekin usne use nahi khaaya. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Tum mein se kuch (maal-e-ganimat mein) dhoka-dhaddi ke gunahgaar hain. Is liye har qabile se ek shakhs mujhse wafadaari ki qasam khaaye. Unhone aisa kiya (apna haath unke haath mein daalte hue). Ek shakhs ka haath unke haath se chipak gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhaara qabila dhoka-dhaddi ka gunahgaar hai. Tumhare qabile ke sab log ek-ek karke mujhse wafadaari ki qasam khaayein. Unhone aisa kiya, jab do ya teen logon ke haath unke haath se chipak gaye. Unhone kaha: Tumne dhoka diya hai. To unhone gaay ke sar ke barabar wazan ka sona nikaala. Unhone use maal-e-ganimat mein zameen par rakha. Phir aag maal-e-ganimat ki taraf badhi aur use khaa gayi. Jung ka maal-e-ganimat humse pehle kisi bhi logon ke liye jaayez nahi kiya gaya. Ye is liye kyunki Allah ne humari kamzori aur vinamrata dekhi aur unhe humare liye jaayez kiya.

e: A hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Sa'd who heard it from his father as saying: My father took a sword from Khums and brought it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Grant it to me. He refused. At this Allah revealed (the Qur'anic verse):" They ask thee concerning the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war are for Allah and the Apostle" (viii. 1).
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ki ek hadees unhone apne walid se suni jinhone kaha: Mere waalid ne Khums se ek talwaar li aur use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Ise mujhe de dijiye. Unhone inkaar kiya. Isper Allah ne (Qurani aayat) nazil ki: "Woh aapse jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Maal-e-ganimat Allah aur Rasool ke liye hai" (8:1).

e: A hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Sa'd who heard it from his father as saying: " Four verses of the Qur'an have been revealed about me. I found a sword (among the spoils of war). It was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He (my father) said: Messenger of Allah, bestow it upon me. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Place it there. Then he (my father) stood up and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Place it from where you got it. (At this) he (my father) said again: Messenger of Allah, bestow it upon me Shall I be treated like one who has no share in (the booty)? The Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him said: Place it from where you got it. At this was revealed the verse:" They ask thee about the spoils of war.... Say: The spoils of war are for Allah and the Messenger"
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ki ek hadees unhone apne walid se suni jinhone kaha: "Quran ki chaar aayaten mere baare mein nazil hui hain. Maine (maal-e-ganimat mein se) ek talwaar paayi. Ye Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi. Unhone (mere waalid ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise mujhe de dijiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise wahan rakh do. Phir unhone (mere waalid ne) khade hokar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Ise wahan se hataao jahan se tumne ise liya. Isper unhone (mere waalid ne) dobara kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise mujhe de dijiye. Kya mera vyavahaar us shakhs jaisa hoga jise koi hissa nahi milta (maal-e-ganimat mein)? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise wahan rakh do jahan se tumne ise liya. Isper ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh aapse jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke baare mein poochte hain.... Kaho: Maal-e-ganimat Allah aur Rasool ke liye hai."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd and I was among the troops. They got a large number of camels as a booty. Eleven or twelve camels fell to the lot of every fighter and each of them also got one extra camel.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne Najd ki taraf ek muhim bheji aur main fauj mein tha. Unhe maal-e-ganimat mein bahut se oont mile. Har lade wale ko gyaarah ya baarah oont mile aur unmein se har ek ko ek atirikt oont bhi mila.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd and Ibn Umar was also among the troops, and their share (of the spoils) came to twelve camels and they were given one camel over and above that. and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not make any change in it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Najd ki taraf ek muhim bheji aur Ibn Umar bhi fauj mein the, aur unke hisse (maal-e-ganimat ke) mein baarah oont aaye aur unhe iske ilawa ek aur oont diya gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ismein koi tabdeeli nahi ki.

e: It has been narrated by Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent an expedition to Najd, and I (also) went with the troops. We got camels and goats as spoils of war, and our share amounted to twelve camels per head, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave an extra camel to each of us.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Najd ki taraf ek muhim bheji, aur main (bhi) fauj ke saath gaya. Humein oont aur bakriyaan maal-e-ganimat mein milin, aur humara hissa har sar peeche baarah oont tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humme se har ek ko ek atirikt oont diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Aun said: I wrote to Nafi' asking him about Nafl (spoils of war) and be wrote to me that Ibn 'Umar was among that expedition. (The rest of the hadith is the same.)
hi: Ibn Aun ne kaha: Maine Nafi ko likha unse Nafl (jung ke maal-e-ganimat) ke baare mein poochte hue aur unhone mujhe likha ki Ibn Umar us muhim mein the. (Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.)

e: A hadith has been narrated by Salim who learnt it from his father and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us an extra (camel) besides our share of Khums; (and in this extra share) I got a Sharif (and a Sharif is a big old camel).
hi: Salim ki ek hadees jo unhone apne walid se seekhi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Khums mein se apne hisse ke ilawa ek atirikt (oont) diya; (aur is atirikt hisse mein) mujhe ek Sharif mila (aur ek Sharif ek bada boodha oont hota hai).

e: Ibn Shihab reported: It reached me through Ibn Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a share of spoils to the troop. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya: Mujhe Ibn Umar ke zariye ye khabar pahunchi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne fauj ko maal-e-ganimat mein se hissa diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to give (from the spoils of war) to small troops seat on expeditions something more than the due share of each fighter in a large force. And Khums (one-fifth of the total spoils) was to be reserved (for Allah and His Apostle) in all cases.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muhimon par gayi choti toliyon ko (maal-e-ganimat mein se) badi fauj mein har lade wale ke vaajib hisse se kuch zyada dete the. Aur Khums (kul maal-e-ganimat ka paanchvaan hissa) sab maamlon mein alag rakhaa jaata tha.

e: Abu Muammad al-Ansari, who was the close companion of Abu Qatada. narrated the hadith (which follows).
hi: Abu Muammad al-Ansari, jo Abu Qatada ke gehre saathi the, ne (ye) hadees riwayat ki.

e: Abu Muhammad, the freed slave of Abu Qatada reported on the authority of Abu Qatda and narrated the hadith.
hi: Abu Muhammad, Abu Qatada ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Abu Qatada ke hawale se ye hadees riwayat ki.

e:
Abu Qatada reported: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah (my peace be upon him) on an expedition in the year of the Battle of Hunain. When we encountered the enemy, (some of the Muslims turned back (in fear). I saw that a man from the polytheists overpowered one of the Muslims. I turned round and attacked him from behind giving a blow between his neck and shoulder. He turned towards me and grappled with me in such a way that I began to see death staring me in the face. Then death overtook him and left me alone. I joined 'Umar b. al-Khattab who was saying: What has happened to the people (that they are retreating)? I said: It is the Decree of Allah. Then the people returned. (The battle ended in a victory for the Muslims) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat down (to distribute the spoils of war). He said: One who has killed an enemy and can bring evidence to prove it will get his belongings. So I stood up and said: Who will give evidence for me? Then I sat down. Then he (the Holy Prophet) said like this. I stood up (again) and said: Who will bear witness for me? He (the Holy Prophet) made the same observation the third time, and I stood up (once again). Now the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you, O Abu Qatada? Then I related the (whole) story, to him. At this, one of the people said: He has told the truth. Messenger of Allah 1 The belongings of the enemy killed by him are with me. Persuade him to forgo his right (in my favour). (Objecting to this proposal) Abu Bakr said: BY Allah, this will not happen. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) will not like to deprive one of the lions from among the lions of Allah who fight in the cause of Allah and His Messenger and give thee his share of the booty. So the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: He (Abu Bakr) has told the truth, and so give the belongings to him (Abu Qatada). So he gave them to me. I sold the armour (which was a part of my share of the booty) and bought with the sale proceeds a garden in the street of Banu Salama. This was the first property I acquired after embracing Islam. 
In a version of the hadith narrated by Laith, the words uttered by Abu Bakr are:" No, never! He will not give it to a fox from the Quraish leaving aside a lion from the lions of Allah among...." And the hadith is closed with the words:" The first property I acquired."
hi: Abu Qatada ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaye Hunain ki jung ke saal. Jab humara dushman se saamna hua, (kuch Musalman darkar) peeche muD gaye. Maine dekha ki mushrikeen mein se ek shakhs Musalmaanon mein se ek par haavi ho gaya. Main muDa aur usse peeche se hamla kiya, uski gardan aur kandhe ke beech maar kar. Woh mere paas muDa aur mujhse itni zor se lipat gaya ki mujhe maut apni aankhon ke saamne dikhne lagi. Phir maut ne use pakDa aur mujhe akela chhoD diya. Main Umar bin al-Khattab se mila jo keh rahe the: Logon ko kya hua hai (ki woh peeche haT rahe hain)? Maine kaha: Ye Allah ka faisla hai. Phir log wapas laute. (Jung Musalmaanon ke liye jeet mein khatam hui) aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe (jung ke maal-e-ganimat baantne ke liye). Unhone kaha: Jisne kisi dushman ko qatal kiya hai aur iska saboot pesh kar sakta hai, use uska saamaan milega. To main khada hua aur kaha: Kaun mere liye gawaahi dega? Phir main baith gaya. Phir unhone (Nabi ne) isi tarah kaha. Main (dobara) khada hua aur kaha: Kaun mere liye gawaahi dega? Unhone (Nabi ne) teesri baar wahi baat kahi, aur main (phir ek baar) khada hua. Ab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai, Aye Abu Qatada? Phir maine unhe (poori) kahani sunaayi. Isper, logon mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Unhone sach kaha hai. Allah ke Rasool, usne jise qatal kiya uska saamaan mere paas hai. Use raazi karo ki woh apna haq (mere haq mein) chhoD de. (Is prastaav ka virodh karte hue) Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, aisa nahi hoga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye pasand nahi hoga ki Allah ke sheron mein se ek sher ko, jo Allah aur Uske Rasool ki raah mein larta hai, uski maal-e-ganimat ka hissa dene se vanchit kiya jaaye. Is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhone (Abu Bakr ne) sach kaha hai, is liye saamaan use (Abu Qatada ko) de do. To unhone woh mujhe diya. Maine kavach (jo mere hisse ka ek hissa tha) becha aur bikri se mili raqam se Banu Salama ki gali mein ek baag khareeda. Ye pehli maal thi jo maine Islam qubool karne ke baad haasil ki. Laith ki riwayat ki hui hadees ke ek soorat mein, Abu Bakr ke zariye kahe gaye alfaaz hain: "Nahi, kabhi nahi! Woh ise Quraish ke ek lomdi ko nahi denge, Allah ke sheron mein se ek sher ko chhoDkar...." Aur hadees in alfaazon ke saath khatm hoti hai: "Pehli maal jo maine haasil ki."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf who said: While I was standing in the battle array on the Day of Badr, I looked towards my right and my left, and found myself between two boys from the Ansar quite young in age. I wished I were between stronger persons. One of them made a sign to me and. said: Uncle, do you recognise Abu Jahl? 1 said: Yes. What do you want to do with him, O my nephew? He said: I have been told that he abuses the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). By Allah, in Whose Hand is my life, if I see him (I will grapple with him) and will not leave him until one of us who is destined to die earlier is killed. The narrator said: I wondered at this. Then the other made a sign to me and said similar words. Soon after I saw Abu Jahl. He was moving about among men. I said to the two boys: Don't you see? He is the man you were inquiring about. (As soon as they heard this), they dashed towards him, struck him with their swords until he was killed. Then they returned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him (to this effect). He asked: Which of you has killed him? Each one of them said: I have killed him. He said: Have you wiped your swords? They said: No. He examined their swords and said: Both of you have killed him. He then decided that the belongings of Abu Jahl he handed over to Mu'adh b. Amr b. al-Jamuh. And the two boys were Mu'adh b. Amr b. Jawth and Mu'adh b. Afra.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab main Badr ke din jung ki safon mein khada tha, maine apni daayi aur baayi taraf dekha, aur khud ko Ansar ke do bahut jawaan larkon ke beech paaya. Main chaahta tha ki main zyada mazboot logon ke beech hota. Unmein se ek ne mujhe ishara kiya aur kaha: Chacha, kya aap Abu Jahl ko pehchaante hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Tum unke saath kya karna chahte ho, mere bhatije? Unhone kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bura-bhala kehte hain. Allah ki qasam, jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar main unhe dekhun (main unse jhagDunga) aur unhe tab tak nahi chhoDunga jab tak hummein se koi jisko pehle marna tay hai, maara nahi jaata. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe isper hairat hua. Phir doosre ne mujhe ishara kiya aur waisi hi baaten kahin. Jald hi maine Abu Jahl ko dekha. Woh logon ke beech ghoom rahe the. Maine do larkon se kaha: Kya tum nahi dekhte? Ye woh aadmi hai jiske baare mein tum poochh rahe the. (Jaise hi unhone ye suna), woh unki taraf daude, unhe apni talwaaron se maara yahan tak ki woh maare gaye. Phir woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas gaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya. Unhone poocha: Tum mein se kisne unhe qatal kiya? Unmein se har ek ne kaha: Maine unhe qatal kiya. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne apni talwaaren pochh li hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone unki talwaaren jaanchi aur kaha: Tum donon ne unhe qatal kiya. Unhone phir faisla diya ki Abu Jahl ka saamaan Mu'adh bin Amr bin al-Jamuh ko soonpa jaaye. Aur woh do larke Mu'adh bin Amr bin Jawth aur Mu'adh bin Afra the.

e: Auf b. Malik has narrated that a man from the Himyar tribe killed an enemy and wanted to take the booty. Khalid b. Walid, who was the commander over them, forbade, him. 'Auf b Malik (the narrator) came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him (to this effect). The latter asked Khalid: What prevented you from giving the booty to him? Khalid said: I thought it was too much. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Hand it over to him. Now when Khalid by Auf, the latter pulled him by his cloak and said (by way of chafing him): Hasn't the same thing happened what I reported to you from the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him)? When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard it. he was angry (and said): Khalid, don't give him, Khalid, don't give him. Are you going to desert the commanders appointed by roe? Your similitude and theirs is like a person who took camels and sheep for grazing. He grazed them and when it was time for them to have a drink, he brought them to a pool. So they drank from it, drinking away its clear water and leaving the turbid water below So the clear water (i. e. the best reward) is for you and the turbid water (i e. blame) is for them.
hi: Auf bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Himyar qabile ke ek shakhs ne ek dushman ko qatal kiya aur maal-e-ganimat lena chaaha. Khalid bin Walid, jo unpar sardaar the, ne unhe mana kiya. Auf bin Malik (raawi) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya. Unhone Khalid se poocha: Tumhe use maal-e-ganimat dene se kis cheez ne roka? Khalid ne kaha: Mujhe laga ye bahut zyada tha. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Use ye de do. Ab jab Khalid Auf se mile, unhone (Auf ne) unhe unke chogha se kheencha aur kaha (unhe chidhaate hue): Kya wahi baat nahi hui jo maine aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat karke bataayi thi? Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna, woh naaraaz hue (aur kaha): Khalid, use mat do, Khalid, use mat do. Kya tum mere muqarrar kiye gaye sardaaron ko chhoDne ja rahe ho? Tumhari aur unki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jisne oont aur bhedein charaane ke liye leen. Usne unhe charaaya aur jab unhe paani pilaane ka waqt aaya, woh unhe ek talab mein laaya. Is liye unhone usmein se piya, uska saaf paani piya aur neeche gandla paani chhoD diya. Is liye saaf paani (yaani sabse achha muaaviza) tumhare liye hai aur gandla paani (yaani ilzaam) unke liye hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Auf b. Malik al-Ashja'i who said: I joined the expedition that marched under Zaid b. Haritha to Muta, and I received reinformcement from the Yemen. (After this introduction), the narrator narrated the tradition that had gone before except that in his version Auf was reported to have said (to Khalid): Khalid, didn't you know that the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) had decided In favour of giving the booty (sized from an enemy) to one who killed him? He (Khalid) said: Yes. but I thought it was too much.
hi: Auf bin Malik al-Ashja'i ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main us muhim mein shaamil hua jo Zaid bin Haritha ke netritva mein Muta gayi thi, aur mujhe Yemen se kumak mili. (Is bhoomika ke baad), raawi ne wahi hadees riwayat ki jo pehle riwayat ki gayi thi siwaay is baat ke ki unke soorat mein Auf ne (Khalid se) ye kaha: Khalid, kya tumhe nahi pata tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya tha ki dushman se le liya gaya maal-e-ganimat use milega jisne use qatal kiya? Unhone (Khalid ne) kaha: Haan, lekin mujhe laga ki ye bahut zyada tha.

e: It has been reported by Salama b. al-Akwa': We fought the Battle of Hawazin along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (One day) when we were having our breakfast with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him), a man came riding a red camel. He made it kneel down, extracted a strip of leather from its girth and tethered the camel with it. Then he began to take food with the people and look (curiously around). We were in a poor condition as some of us were on foot (being without any riding animals). All of a sudden, he left us hurriedy, came to his camel, untethered it, made it kneel down, mounted it and urged the beast which ran off with him. A man on a brown rhe-camel chased him (taking him for a spy). Salama (the narrator) said: I followed on foot. I ran on until I was near the thigh of the she-camel. I advanced further until I was near the haunches of the camel. I advanced still further until I caught hold of the nosestring of the camel. I made it kneel down. As soon as it placed its knee on the ground, I drew my sword and struck at the head, of the rider who fell down. I brought the camel driving it along with the man's baggage and weapons. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came forward to meet me and the people were with him. He asked: Who has killed the man? The people said: Ibn Akwa'. He said: Everything of the man is for him (Ibn Akwa').
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa ne riwayat ki: Humne Hawazin ki jung Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ladi. (Ek din) jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath naashta kar rahe the, ek shakhs laal oont par sawaar hokar aaya. Usne use bithaya, uske kamarband se chamde ki ek patti nikaali aur oont ko usse baandh diya. Phir usne logon ke saath khaana khaana shuru kiya aur (jigyaasa se) idhar-udhar dekha. Hum kaafi tang halat mein the kyunki hummein se kuch paidal the (kisi sawaari waale jaanwar ke bagair). Achaanak, woh humein jaldi mein chhoD gaya, apne oont ke paas aaya, use khola, bithaya, sawaar hua aur jaanwar ko dora ki hukum diya jo uske saath bhaag gaya. Ek bhoori oontni par sawaar shakhs ne uska picha kiya (unhe jaasoos maankar). Salama (raawi) ne kaha: Main paidal peeche gaya. Main daudta raha yahan tak ki main oontni ki jaangh ke qareeb pahuncha. Main aur aage baDha yahan tak ki main oont ki jaangh ke qareeb pahuncha. Main phir bhi aage baDha yahan tak ki maine oont ki naak ki rassi pakaD li. Maine use bithaaya. Jaise hi usne apna ghutna zameen par rakha, maine apni talwaar nikaali aur sawaar ke sar par maara jo gir gaya. Main oont ko uske saamaan aur hathiyaaron ke saath haankte hue le aaya.
