Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aage baDhe aur log unke saath the. Unhone poocha: Kisne us shakhs ko qatal kiya? Logon ne kaha: Ibn Akwa. Unhone kaha: Us shakhs ki har cheez usi (Ibn Akwa) ke liye hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Salama (b. al-Akwa') who said: We fought against the Fazara, and Abu Bakr was the commander over us. He had been appointed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When we were only at an hour's distance from the water of the enemy, Abu Bakr ordered us to attack. We made a halt during the last part of the night to rest and then we attacked from all sides and reached their watering-place where a battle was fought. Some of the enemies were killed and some were taken prisoners. I saw a group of persons that consisted of women and children. I was afraid lest they should reach the mountain before me, so I shot an arrow between them and the mountain. When they saw the arrow, they stopped. So I brought them, driving them along. Among them was a woman from Banu Fazara. She was wearing a leather coat. With her was her daughter who was one of the prettiest girls in Arabia. I drove them along until I brought them to Abu Bakr who bestowed that girl upon me as a prize. So we arrived in Medina. I had not yet disrobed her when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) met me in the street and said: Give me that girl, O Salama. I said: Messenger of Allah, she has fascinated me. I had not yet disrobed her. When on the next day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again met me in the street, he said: O Salama, give me that girl, may God bless your father. I said: She is for you, Messenger of Allah! By Allah. I have not yet disrobed her. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent her to the people of Mecca, and surrendered her as ransom for a number of Muslims who had been kept as prisoners at Mecca.
hi: Salama (bin al-Akwa) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Humne Fazara ke khilaaf jung ki, aur Abu Bakr humpar sardaar the. Unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muqarrar kiya tha. Jab hum dushman ke paani se sirf ek ghante ki doori par the, Abu Bakr ne humein hamla karne ka hukum diya. Humne raat ke aakhri hisse mein aaraam ke liye padaav kiya aur phir humne har taraf se hamla kiya aur unki paani pilaane ki jagah tak pahunche jahan ek jung ladi gayi. Kuch dushman maare gaye aur kuch qaidi banaaye gaye. Maine auraton aur bachchon ka ek giroh dekha. Mujhe dar tha ki kahin woh mujhse pehle pahaad tak na pahunch jaayein, is liye maine unke aur pahaad ke beech ek teer chalaaya. Jab unhone teer dekha, woh ruk gaye. To main unhe haankte hue le aaya. Unmein Banu Fazara ki ek aurat thi. Woh chamde ka kapda pehne hue thi. Unke saath unki beti thi jo Arabia ki sabse khoobsurat larkiyon mein se ek thi. Main unhe haankte hue Abu Bakr tak laaya jinhone woh larki mujhe inaam ke soorat mein di. To hum Madina pahunche. Maine abhi tak unke kapde nahi utaare the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse gali mein mile aur kaha: Aye Salama, mujhe woh larki de do. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhone mujhe mohit kiya hai. Maine abhi tak unke kapde nahi utaare the. Jab agle din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse dobara gali mein mile, unhone kaha: Aye Salama, mujhe woh larki de do, Allah tumhare waalid ko barkat de. Maine kaha: Woh aapke liye hai, Allah ke Rasool! Allah ki qasam, maine abhi tak unke kapde nahi utaare hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Makkah ke logon ke paas bheja, aur unhe kai Musalmaanon ke fidye ke soorat mein soonpa jo Makkah mein qaidi banaaye gaye the.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If you come to a township (which has surrendered without a formal war) and stay therein, you have a share (that will be in the form of an award) in (the properties obtained from) it. If a township disobeys Allah and His Messenger (and actually fights against the Muslims) one-fifth of the booty seized therefrom is for Allah and His Apostle and the rest is for you.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum kisi shehar (jisne bina rasmi jung ke aatm-samarpan kiya hai) mein aate ho aur usmein reh jaate ho, tumhara isme (isse haasil hui maal mein) ek hissa hai (jo inaam ke soorat mein hoga). Agar koi shehar Allah aur Uske Rasool ki naafarmani karta hai (aur waaqai Musalmaanon ke khilaaf jung karta hai) isse hasil hue maal-e-ganimat ka paanchvaan hissa Allah aur Uske Rasool ke liye hai aur baaki tumhare liye hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Umar, who said: The properties abandoned by Banu Nadir were the ones which Allah bestowed upon His Apostle for which no expedition was undertaken either with cavalry or camelry. These properties were particularly meant for the Prophet (ﷺ). He would meet the annual expenditure of his family from the income thereof, and would spend what remained for purchasing horses and weapons as preparation for Jihad.
hi: Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Banu Nadir ke zariye chhoDi gayi maal woh thi jo Allah ne Apne Rasool ko di thi jiske liye koi muhim na ghudsawaar fauj se na oont fauj se ki gayi thi. Ye maal khaas taur par Nabi (SAW) ke liye thi. Woh iski aamdani se apne khaandaan ke saalana kharche poori karte the, aur jo bacha use ghode aur hathiyaaron ke liye kharch karte, Jihad ki taiyaari ke soorat mein.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
It is reported by Zuhri that this tradition was narrated to him by Malik b. Aus who said: Umar b. al-Khattab sent for me and I came to him when the day had advanced. I found him in his house sitting on his bare bed-stead, reclining on a leather pillow. He said (to me): Malik, some people of your tribe have hastened to me (with a request for help). I have ordered a little money for them. Take it and distribute it among them. I said: I wish you had ordered somebody else to do this job. He said: Malik, take it (and do what you have been told). At this moment (his man-servant) Yarfa' came in and said: Commander of the Faithful, what do you say about Uthman, Abd al-Rabman b. 'Auf, Zubair and Sa'd (who have come to seek an audience with you)? He said: Yes, and permitted them. so they entered. Then he (Yarfa') came again and said: What do you say about 'Ali and Abbas (who are present at the door)? He said: Yes, and permitted them to enter. Abbas said: Commander of the Faithful, decide (the dispute) between me and this sinful, treacherous, dishonest liar. The people (who were present) also said: Yes. Commander of the Faithful, do decide (the dispute) and have mercy on them. Malik b. Aus said: I could well imagine that they had sent them in advance for this purpose (by 'Ali and Abbas). 'Umar said: Wait and be patient. I adjure you by Allah by Whose order the heavens and the earth are sustained, don't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" We (prophets) do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is (to be given in) charity"? They said: Yes. Then he turned to Abbas and 'Ali and said: I adjure you both by Allah by Whose order the heavens and earth are sustained, don't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" We do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is (to be given in) charity"? They (too) said: Yes. (Then) Umar said: Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, had done to His Messenger (ﷺ) a special favour that He has not done to anyone else except him. He quoted the Qur'anic verse:" What Allah has bestowed upon His Apostle from (the properties) of the people of township is for Allah and His Messenger". The narrator said: I do not know whether he also recited the previous verse or not. Umar continued: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distrbuted among you the properties abandoned by Banu Nadir. By Allah, he never preferred himself over you and never appropriated anything to your exclusion. (After a fair distribution in this way) this property was left over. 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would meet from its income his annual expenditure, and what remained would be deposited in the Bait-ul-Mal. (Continuing further) he said: I adjure you by Allah by Whose order the heavens and the earth are sustained. Do you know this? They said: Yes. Then he adjured Abbas and 'All as he had adjured the other persons and asked: Do you both know this? They said: Yes. He said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed away, Abu Bakr said:" I am the successor of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." Both of you came to demand your shares from the property (left behind by the Messenger of Allah). (Referring to Hadrat 'Abbas), he said: You demanded your share from the property of your nephew, and he (referring to 'Ali) demanded a share on behalf of his wife from the property of her father. Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said:" We do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is (to be given in) charity." So both of you thought him to be a liar, sinful, treacherous and dishonest. And Allah knows that he was true, virtuous, well-guided and a follower of truth. When Abu Bakr passed away and (I have become) the successor of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr (Allah be pleased with him), you thought me to be a liar, sinful, treacherous and dishonest. And Allah knows that I am true, virtuous, well-guided and a follower of truth. I became the guardian of this property. Then you as well as he came to me. Both of you have come and your purpose is identical. You said: Entrust the property to us. I said: If you wish that I should entrust it to you, it will be on the condition that both of you will undertake to abide by a pledge made with Allah that you will use it in the same way as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used it. So both of you got it. He said: Wasn't it like this? They said: Yes. He said: Then you have (again) come to me with the request that I should adjudge between you. No, by Allah. I will not give any other judgment except this until the arrival of the Doomsday. If you are unable to hold the property on this condition, return it to me.
hi: Zuhri ne bataya ki ye riwayat unhe Malik bin Aus ne sunaayi jinhone kaha: Umar bin al-Khattab ne mujhe bulaaya aur main unke paas aaya jab din kaafi aage badh chuka tha. Maine unhe apne ghar mein paaya, apne khaali bistar par baithe hue, ek chamde ke takiye par tek lagaaye hue. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: Malik, tumhare qabile ke kuch log (madad ki maang lekar) mere paas jaldi aaye hain. Maine unke liye thoda paisa hukum diya hai. Ise lo aur unke beech baanto. Maine kaha: Kaash aapne ye kaam kisi aur ko hukum diya hota. Unhone kaha: Malik, ise lo (aur jo tumhe kaha gaya hai woh karo). Isi waqt (unke naukar) Yarfa aaye aur kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap Uthman, Abd al-Rahman bin Auf, Zubair aur Sa'd (jo aapse milne aaye hain) ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur unhe ijazat di. To woh andar aaye. Phir woh (Yarfa) dobara aaye aur kaha: Aap Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas (jo darwaze par maujood hain) ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur unhe andar aane ki ijazat di. Abbas ne kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, mere aur is gunahgaar, bharosa-tor, beimaan jhoote ke beech faisla (jhagda) kijiye. Logon (jo maujood the) ne bhi kaha: Haan, Ameer-ul-Momineen, faisla kijiye aur unpar rehmat kijiye. Malik bin Aus ne kaha: Main achhi tarah samajh sakta tha ki unhe (Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ne) is maqsad ke liye pehle bheja tha. Umar ne kaha: Sabar karo. Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiske hukum se aasmaan aur zameen tikA hue hain, kya tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Hum (Nabi log) koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh sadaqa hai"? Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir woh Abbas aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki taraf mude aur kaha: Main tum dono ko Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiske hukum se aasmaan aur zameen tikA hue hain, kya tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Hum koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh sadaqa hai"? Woh (bhi) bole: Haan. (Phir) Umar ne kaha: Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne Apne Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek khaas meherbaani ki jo Usne unke ilawa kisi doosre ke saath nahi ki. Unhone Qurani aayat padhi: "Jo Allah ne shehar ke logon ki (maal) mein se Apne Rasool ko diya hai woh Allah aur Uske Rasool ke liye hai." Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone pichhli aayat bhi padhi ya nahi. Umar ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Nadir ke zariye chhoDi gayi maal tum mein taqseem ki. Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi khud ko tumse upar nahi rakha aur kabhi tumhe chhoDkar khud ke liye kuch nahi liya. (Is tarah munasib taqseem ke baad) ye maal bach gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) iski aamdani se apna saalana kharch poora karte, aur jo bachta woh Bait-ul-Mal mein jama kiya jaata. (Aage kehte hue) unhone kaha: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiske hukum se aasmaan aur zameen tikA hue hain. Kya tum ye jaante ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir unhone Abbas aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bhi waisi hi qasam di jaisi unhone doosron ko di thi aur poocha: Kya tum donon ye jaante ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka uttaradhikari hoon." Tum donon (Nabi ke chhoDe hue) maal se apne hisse ka daawa karne aaye. (Hazrat Abbas ki taraf ishara karte hue) unhone kaha: Tumne apne bhatije ki maal se apna hissa maanga, aur unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki taraf ishara karte hue) apni zauja ke naam par uske waalid ki maal se hissa maanga. Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: "Hum koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh sadaqa hai." To tum donon ne unhe jhoota, gunahgaar, bharosa-tor aur beimaan samjha. Aur Allah jaanta hai ki woh sachche, nekokaar, sahi raah par the aur sach ke anuyaayi the. Jab Abu Bakr ka intiqaal hua aur (main Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr, Allah unpar khush ho, ka uttaradhikari bana), tumne mujhe jhoota, gunahgaar, bharosa-tor aur beimaan samjha. Aur Allah jaanta hai ki main sachcha, nekokaar, sahi raah par hoon aur sach ka anuyaayi hoon. Main is maal ka rakshak bana. Phir tum aur woh (Ali (Alayhis Salam)) mere paas aaye. Tum dono aaye ho aur tumhara maqsad ek hi hai. Tumne kaha: Ye maal humein soonp do. Maine kaha: Agar tum chahte ho ki main ise tumhe soonp dun, to ye is shart par hoga ki tum dono Allah ke saath kiye gaye ehad ko poora karoge ki tum ise usi tarah istemal karoge jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise karte the. To tum donon ne ise liya. Unhone kaha: Kya aisa nahi tha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Phir tum (dobara) mere paas is maang ke saath aaye ho ki main tumhare beech faisla dun. Nahi, Allah ki qasam. Main iske ilawa koi doosra faisla nahi dunga Qayamat ke aane tak. Agar tum is shart par maal rakhne mein asamarth ho, to ise mujhe wapas kar do.

e: The same hadith has been narrated by a different chain of transmitters with a slight variation in wording: 'Umar b. al-Khattab sent for me and said: Some families from your tribe have come to me (then follows the foregoing hadith) by Malik with the difference that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would spend on his family for a year. And sometimes Ma'mar said: He would retain sustenance for his family for a year, and what was left of that he spent in the cause of Allah, the Majestic and Exalted.
hi: Yehi hadees ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Umar bin al-Khattab ne mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Tumhare qabile ke kuch pariwaar mere paas aaye hain (phir aage wali hadees jaisi hi hai) Malik ke zariye, is farq ke saath ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne khaandaan par ek saal ka kharch dete the. Aur kabhi Ma'mar ne kaha: Woh apne khaandaan ke liye ek saal ka bhar-poshan barkarar rakhte, aur jo isme se bacha use Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein kharch karte.

e: It is narrated on the authority of 'A'isha who said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed away, his wives made up their minds to send 'Uthman b. 'Affan (as their spokesman) to Abu Bakr to demand from him their share from the legacy of the Prophet (ﷺ). (At this), A'isha said to them: Hasn't the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" We (Prophets) do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is (to be given in) charity"?
hi: Aisha ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, unki zaujaon ne Uthman bin Affan ko (apne numainda ke soorat mein) Abu Bakr ke paas bhejne ka faisla kiya unse Nabi (SAW) ki virasat mein apna hissa maangte hue. (Isper), Aisha ne unse kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha nahi tha: "Hum (Nabi log) koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh sadaqa hai"?

e: It is narrated on the authority of Urwa b. Zubair who narrated from A'isha that she informed him that Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), sent someone to Abu Bakr to demand from him her share of the legacy left by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from what Allah had bestowed upon him at Medina and Fadak and what was left from one-filth of the income (annually received) from Khaibar. Abu Bakr said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" We (prophets) do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is (to be given in) charity." The household of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) will live on the income from these properties, but, by Allah, I will not change the charity of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from the condition in which it was in his own time. I will do the same with it as the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upun him) himself used to do. So Abu Bakr refused to hand over anything from it to Fatima who got angry with Abu Bakr for this reason. She forsook him and did not talk to him until the end of her life. She lived for six months after the death of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When she died, her husband. 'Ali b. Abu Talib, buried her at night. He did not inform Abu Bakr about her death and offered the funeral prayer over her himself. During the lifetime of Fatima, 'All received (special) regard from the people. After she had died, he felt estrangement in the faces of the people towards him. So he sought to make peace with Abu Bakr and offer his allegiance to him. He had not yet owed allegiance to him as Caliph during these months. He sent a person to Abu Bakr requesting him to visit him unaccompanied by anyone (disapproving the presence of Umar). 'Umar said to Abu Bakr: BY Allah, you will not visit them alone. Abu Bakr said: What will they do to me? By Allah, I will visit them. And he did pay them a visit alone. 'All recited Tashahhud (as it is done in the beginning of a religious sermon) ; then said: We recognise your moral excellence and what Allah has bestowed upon you. We do not envy the favour (i. e. the Catiphate) which Allah nas conferred upon you; but you have done it (assumed the position of Caliph) alone (without consulting us), and we thought we had a right (to be consulted) on account of our kinship with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He continued to talk to Abu Bakr (in this vein) until the latter's eyes welled up with tears. Then Abd Bakr spoke and said: By Allah, in Whose Hand is my life, the kinship of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is dearer to me than the kinship of my own people. As regards the dispute that has arisen between you and me about these properties, I have not deviated from the right course and I have not given up doing about them what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do. So 'Ali said to Abu Bakr: This aftetnoon is (fixed) for (swearing) allegiance (to you). So when Abu Bakr had finished his Zuhr prayer, he ascended the pulpit and recited Tashahhud, and described the status of 'Ali, his delay in swearing allegiance and the excuse which lie had offered to him (for this delay). (After this) he asked for God's forgiveness. Then 'Ali b. Abu Talib recited the Tashahhud. extolled the merits of Abu Bakr and (said that) his action was nott prompted by any jealousy of Abu Bakr on his part or his refusal to accept the high position which Allah had conferred upon him, (adding: ) But we were of the opinion that we should have a share in the government, but the matter had been decided without taking us into confidence, and this displeased us. (Hence the delay in offering allegiance. The Muslims were pleased with this (explanation) and they said: You have done the right thing. The Muslims were (again) favourably inclined to 'Ali since he adopted the proper course of action.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jo Aisha se riwayat karte hain ki unhone unhe bataya ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ne kisi ko Abu Bakr ke paas bheja unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki chhoDi hui maal mein apna hissa maangte hue, us cheez se jo Allah ne unhe Madina aur Fadak mein di thi, aur jo Khaibar ki aamdani ke paanchvein hisse mein se bacha tha. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Hum (Nabi log) koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh sadaqa hai." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khaandaan in maal ki aamdani se guzara karega, lekin, Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sadaqe ko us haalat se nahi badloonga jismein ye unke apne waqt mein thi. Main iske saath waisa hi karunga jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud kiya karte the. To Abu Bakr ne isme se kuch bhi Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko dene se inkaar kiya jo isi wajah se Abu Bakr se naaraaz ho gayin. Unhone unse mumh moD liya aur apni zindagi ke akhir tak unse baat nahi ki. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ke chhe mahine baad tak jeevit rahin. Jab unka intiqaal hua, unke shohar, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe raat mein dafn kiya. Unhone Abu Bakr ko unki maut ke baare mein nahi bataaya aur khud unki janaaza namaz padhi. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke zindagi kaal mein, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko logon se (khaas) izzat mili. Jab woh mar gayin, unhe logon ke chehron mein apne prati doori mehsoos hui. To unhone Abu Bakr se shaanti banaane aur unhe apni wafadaari dikhaane ki koshish ki. Unhone abhi tak in mahinon mein khalifa ke soorat mein unse wafadaari nahi ki thi. Unhone Abu Bakr ke paas ek shakhs bheja unse guzaarish karte hue ki woh akele (unke saath) unse milne aayein (Umar ki maujoodgi ki napasandeegi jataate hue). Umar ne Abu Bakr se kaha: Allah ki qasam, aap unse akele nahi milenge. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Woh mera kya karenge? Allah ki qasam, main unse milunga. Aur unhone akele unse mulaqaat ki. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Tashahhud padha (jaise deeni khutbe ki shuruaat mein kiya jaata hai); phir kaha: Hum aapki naitik utkrishtta aur jo Allah ne aapko diya hai use pehchaante hain. Humein us favour (yaani khilafat) se koi jalan nahi hai jo Allah ne aapko di hai; lekin aapne ise akele (humse salaah liye bina) kiya hai, aur humein laga ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath humare rishtedaari ki wajah se humein bhi (salaah dene ka) haq tha. Woh Abu Bakr se (is bhaav mein) baat karte rahe yahan tak ki unki (Abu Bakr ki) aankhon mein aansu aa gaye. Phir Abu Bakr bole aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka rishtedaari mujhe apne khud ke logon ki rishtedaari se zyada aziz hai. Jahan tak humare beech in maal ke baare mein paida hue jhagde ka sawal hai, main sahi raaste se nahi hata hoon aur maine unke saath woh karna nahi chhoDa jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) karte the. To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Bakr se kaha: Ye dopahar (aapse) wafadaari (ki qasam khaane) ke liye (muqarrar) hai. To jab Abu Bakr ne apni zohar ki namaz khatm kar li, woh mimbar par chaDhe aur Tashahhud padha, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki haalat, unki wafadaari mein deri, aur unhone jo unhe (is deri ke liye) uzr diya use bayaan kiya. (Iske baad) unhone Allah se maafi maangi. Phir Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Tashahhud padha, Abu Bakr ki khoobiyon ki tareef ki aur (kaha ki) unka amal na to Abu Bakr ke prati kisi jalan se prerit tha na hi us buland darje ko qubool karne se inkaar (jo Allah ne unhe diya tha), (izafa karte hue): Lekin humari raay thi ki humein sarkaar mein hissa milna chahiye tha, lekin maamla humein vishwaas mein liye bina tay kar diya gaya tha, aur isse hum naaraaz hue. (Isi wajah se wafadaari dene mein deri hui.) Musalman is (spashteekaran) se khush hue aur unhone kaha: Aapne sahi kiya. Musalman (dobara) Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke prati anukool hue kyunki unhone munasib karyavaahi apnaayi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha that Fatima and 'Abbas approached Abu Bakr, soliciting transfer of the legacy of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to them. At that time, they were demanding his (Holy Prophet's) lands at Fadak and his share from Khaibar. Abu Bakr said to them: I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Then he quoted the hadith having nearly the same meaning as the one which has been narrated by Uqail on the authority of al-Zuhri (and which his gone before) except that in his version he said: Then 'Ali stood up, extolled the merits of Abu Bakr mentioned his superiority, and his earlier acceptance of Islam. Then he walked to Abu Bakr and swore allegiance to him. (At this) people turned towards 'Ali and said: you have done the right thing. And they became favourably inclined to 'Ali after he had adopted the proper course of action.
hi: Aisha ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aur Abbas Abu Bakr ke paas gaye, unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki virasat unhe soonpne ki maang karte hue. Us waqt, woh Fadak mein unki (Nabi ki) zameenon aur Khaibar se unke hisse ki maang kar rahe the. Abu Bakr ne unse kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai. Phir unhone wahi maaeni wali hadees riwayat ki jo Uqail ne al-Zuhri ke hawale se riwayat ki (aur jo pehle guzar chuki hai) siwaay is baat ke ki unke soorat mein unhone kaha: Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) khade hue, Abu Bakr ki khoobiyon ki tareef ki, unki fazeelat ka zikr kiya, aur unka pehle Islam qubool karna. Phir woh chal kar Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur unse wafadaari ki qasam khayi. (Isper) log Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki taraf mude aur kaha: Aapne sahi kiya. Aur woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke prati anukool ho gaye jab unhone munasib karyavaahi apnaayi.

e: It has been narrated by 'Urwa b Zubair on the authority of 'A'isha, wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), that Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), requested Abu Bakr, after the death of the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him), that he should set apart her share from what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had left from the properties that God had bestowed upon him. Abu Bakr said to her: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" We do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is Sadaqa (charity)." The narrator said: She (Fatima) lived six months after the death of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and she used to demand from Abu Bakr her share from the legacy of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from Khaibar, Fadak and his charitable endowments at Medina. Abu Bakr refused to give her this, and said: I am not going to give up doing anything which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do. I am afraid that it I go against his instructions in any matter I shall deviate from the right course. So far as the charitable endowments at Medina were concerned, 'Umar handed them over to 'Ali and Abbas, but 'Ali got the better of him (and kept the property under his exclusive possession). And as far as Khaibar and Fadak were concerned 'Umar kept them with him, and said: These are the endowments of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (to the Umma). Their income was spent on the discharge of the responsibilities that devolved upon him on the emergencies he had to meet. And their management was to be in the hands of one who managed the affairs (of the Islamic State). The narrator said: They have been managed as such up to this day.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne Aisha, Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ne Abu Bakr se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ke baad, guzaarish ki ki woh unka hissa alag kar dein us cheez se jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un maal se chhoDa jo Allah ne unhe di thi. Abu Bakr ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Hum koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh Sadaqa (sadaqa) hai." Raawi ne kaha: Woh (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ke chhe mahine baad tak jeevit rahin aur woh Abu Bakr se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki virasat mein Khaibar, Fadak aur Madina mein unke sadaqe ke bhoo-sadqa se apna hissa maangti thin. Abu Bakr ne unhe ye dene se inkaar kiya, aur kaha: Main woh koi bhi cheez karna chhoDne nahi ja raha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kiya karte the. Mujhe dar hai ki agar main kisi bhi maamle mein unke hidayaton ke khilaaf jaaun to main sahi raaste se bhatak jaunga. Jahan tak Madina ke sadaqe ke bhoo-sadqa ka sawal hai, Umar ne unhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abbas ko soonpa, lekin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unpar bartari haasil ki (aur maal ko apne akele ikhtiyar mein rakha). Aur jahan tak Khaibar aur Fadak ka sawal hai Umar ne unhe apne paas rakha, aur kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke bhoo-sadqa hain (Ummat ke liye). Unki aamdani un zimmedaariyon ke nirvahan par kharch ki jaati thi jo unpar hoti thin un aapaatkaalon mein jinka unhe saamna karna padta tha. Aur unka intezam usi ke haath mein hoga jo (Islami hukumat ke) maamle sambhaalta hai. Raawi ne kaha: Woh aaj tak isi tarah munazzam ki jaati hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My heirs cannot share even a dinar (from my legacy) ; what I leave behind after paving maintenance allowance to my wives and remuneration to my manager is (to go in) charity.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mere waaris ek dinar bhi (meri virasat mein se) baant nahi sakte; jo main apni zaujaon ko bhar-poshan aur apne prabandhak ko mazdoori dene ke baad chhoDta hoon woh (sadaqe mein jaayega).

e: A similar hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zinad through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Zinad ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It his been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: " We do not have any heirs; what we leave behind is a charitable endowment."
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Hum koi waaris nahi rakhte; jo hum peeche chhoDte hain woh ek sadaqai bhoo-sadqa hai."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) allowed two shares from the spoils to the horseman and one share to the footman.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne maal-e-ganimat mein ghudsawaar ko do hisse aur paidal ko ek hissa dene ki ijazat di.

e: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Ubaidullah by a different chain of transmitters who do not mention the words: " from the booty".
hi: Yehi riwayat Ubaidullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: "Maal-e-ganimat se."

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of `Umar b. al-Khattab who said: When it was the day on which the Battle of Badr was fought, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cast a glance at the infidels, and they were one thousand while his own Companions were three hundred and nineteen. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned (his face) towards the Qibla. Then he stretched his hands and began his supplication to his Lord: "O Allah, accomplish for me what Thou hast promised to me. O Allah, bring about what Thou hast promised to me. O Allah, if this small band of Muslims is destroyed. Thou will not be worshipped on this earth." He continued his supplication to his Lord, stretching his hands, facing the Qibla, until his mantle slipped down from his shoulders. So Abu Bakr came to him, picked up his mantle and put it on his shoulders. Then he embraced him from behind and said: Prophet of Allah, this prayer of yours to your Lord will suffice you, and He will fulfill for you what He has promised you. So Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed (the Qur'anic verse): "When ye appealed to your Lord for help, He responded to your call (saying): I will help you with one thousand angels coming in succession." So Allah helped him with angels. 
Abu Zumail said that the hadith was narrated to him by Ibn `Abbas who said: While on that day a Muslim was chasing a disbeliever who was going ahead of him, he heard over him the swishing of the whip and the voice of the rider saying: Go ahead, Haizum! He glanced at the polytheist who had (now) fallen down on his back. When he looked at him (carefully he found that) there was a scar on his nose and his face was torn as if it had been lashed with a whip, and had turned green with its poison. An Ansari came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and related this (event) to him. He said: You have told the truth. This was the help from the third heaven. The Muslims that day (i.e. the day of the Battle of Badr) killed seventy persons and captured seventy. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Abu Bakr and `Umar (Allah be pleased with them): What is your opinion about these captives? Abu Bakr said: They are our kith and kin. I think you should release them after getting from them a ransom. This will be a source of strength to us against the infidels. It is quite possible that Allah may guide them to Islam. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What is your opinion, Ibn Khattab? He said: Messenger of Allah, I do not hold the same opinion as Abu Bakr. I am of the opinion that you should hand them over to us so that we may cut off their heads. Hand over `Aqil to `Ali that he may cut off his head, and hand over such and such relative to me that I may cut off his head. They are leaders of the disbelievers and veterans among them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) approved the opinion of Abu Bakr and did not approve what I said. The next day when I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I found that both he and Abu Bakr were sitting shedding tears. I said: Messenger of Allah, why are you and your Companion shedding tears? Tell me the reason. For I will weep, or I will at least pretend to weep in sympathy with you. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I weep for what has happened to your companions for taking ransom (from the prisoners). I was shown the torture to which they were subjected. It was brought to me as close as this tree. (He pointed to a tree close to him.) Then God revealed the verse: "It is not befitting for a prophet that he should take prisoners until the force of the disbelievers has been crushed..." to the end of the verse: "so eat ye the spoils of war, (it is) lawful and pure. So Allah made booty lawful for them."
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jis din Badr ki jung ladi gayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaafiron par ek nazar daali, aur woh ek hazaar the jabki unke apne sahaba teen sau unnees the. Nabi (SAW) ne (apna chehra) Qibla ki taraf moda. Phir unhone apne haath phailaaye aur apne Rab se dua karne lage: "Aye Allah, jo Tune mujhse vaada kiya use poora kar. Aye Allah, jo Tune mujhse vaada kiya use anjaam de. Aye Allah, agar Musalmaanon ka ye chhota giroh tabaah ho jaata hai, to Teri ibadat is zameen par nahi ki jaayegi." Woh apne Rab se dua karte rahe, apne haath phailaate hue, Qibla ki taraf munh karke, yahan tak ki unka chogha unke kandhon se phisal gaya. To Abu Bakr unke paas aaye, unka chogha uthaaya aur unke kandhon par rakh diya. Phir unhone unhe peeche se gale lagaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Nabi, Apne Rab se aapki ye dua aapke liye kaafi hogi, aur Woh aapke liye poora karega jo Usne aapse vaada kiya hai. To Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne (Qurani aayat) nazil ki: "Jab tumne apne Rab se madad ke liye guhaar lagayi, Usne tumhari pukaar ka jawaab diya (ye kehte hue): Main tumhari madad ek hazaar farishton se karunga jo ek ke baad ek aayenge." To Allah ne unki madad farishton se ki. Abu Zumail ne kaha ki ye hadees unhe Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Jab us din ek Musalman ek kaafir ka picha kar raha tha jo uske aage jaa raha tha, usne apne oopar koda ki aawaaz suni aur sawaar ki aawaaz ye kehte hue: Aage baDho, Haizum! Usne mushrik ki taraf dekha jo (ab) apni peeth ke bal gir gaya tha. Jab usne use (dhyaan se) dekha (paaya ki) uski naak par ek nishaan tha aur uska chehra faTa hua tha jaise use koda se maara gaya ho, aur uske zeher se hara ho gaya tha. Ek Ansari Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe ye (ghatna) bataayi. Unhone kaha: Tumne sach kaha. Ye teesre aasmaan se madad thi. Us din (yaani Badr ki jung ke din) Musalmaanon ne sattar logon ko qatal kiya aur sattar ko qaidi banaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr aur Umar (Allah unse khush ho) se kaha: In qaidiyon ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Woh humare hi khoon aur khaandaan hain. Mujhe lagta hai aapko unhe fidya lekar riha kar dena chahiye. Ye kaafiron ke khilaaf humari taqat ka strot banega. Ye poori tarah mumkin hai ki Allah unhe Islam ki taraf maargdarshan kare. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhari kya raay hai, Ibn Khattab? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri raay Abu Bakr jaisi nahi hai. Meri raay hai ki aapko unhe humein soonp dena chahiye taaki hum unke sar kaat sakein. Aqil ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko soonpo taaki woh unka sar kaat sakein, aur falan-falan rishtedaar mujhe soonpo taaki main unka sar kaat sakoon. Woh kaafiron ke sardaar hain aur unmein anubhavi hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ki raay qubool ki aur jo maine kaha usse manzoori nahi di. Agle din jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, maine paaya ki woh aur Abu Bakr donon baithe hue aansu bahaa rahe the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap aur aapke saathi aansu kyun bahaa rahe hain? Mujhe wajah bataaiye. Kyunki main bhi roonga, ya kam se kam aapke saath sanvedana mein rone ka dikhaava karunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main us cheez ke liye ro raha hoon jo tumhare saathiyon ke saath hua (qaidiyon se) fidya lene ke liye. Mujhe woh yaatna dikhaayi gayi jismein woh gher liye gaye the. Ye mere paas is darakht jitne qareeb laayi gayi. (Unhone apne qareeb ek darakht ki taraf ishara kiya.) Phir Allah ne aayat nazil ki: "Kisi Nabi ke liye theek nahi hai ki woh qaidi banaaye jab tak kaafiron ki taaqat kuchli na jaaye..." aayat ke akhir tak: "is liye jung ke maal-e-ganimat ko khaao, jaayez aur muqaddas (ye hai)." To Allah ne maal-e-ganimat unke liye jaayez kiya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent some horsemen to Najd. They captured a man. He was from the tribe of Banu Hanifa and was called Thumama b. Uthal. He was the chief of the people of Yamama. People bound him with one of the pillars of the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to (see) him. He said: O Thumama, what do you think? He replied: Muhammad, I have good opinion of you. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you do me a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you want wealth, ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be pon him) lefthim (in this condition) for two days, (and came to him again) and said: What do you think, O Thumama? He replied: What I have already told you. If you do a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you want wealth, ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) left him until the next day when he (came to him again) and said: What do you think, O Thumama? He replied: What I have already told you. If you do me a favour, you will do a favour to a grateful person. If you kill me, you will kill a person who has spilt blood. If you want wealth ask and you will get what you will demand. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Set Thumama free. He went to a palm-grove near the mosque and took a bath. Then he entered the mosque and said: I bear testimony (to the truth) that there is no god but Allah and I testify that Muhammad is His bondman and His messenger. O Muhammad, by Allah, there was no face on the earth more hateful to me than your face, but (now) your face has become to me the dearest of all faces. By Allah, there was no religion more hateful to me than your religion, but (now) your religion has become the dearest of all religions to me. By Allah, there was no city more hateful to me than your city, but (now) your city has become the dearest of all cities to me. Your horsemen captured me when I intended going for Umra. Now what is your opinion (in the matter)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) announced good tidings to him and told him to go on 'Umra. When he reached Mecca, somebody said to him: Have you changed your religion? He said: No! I have rather embraced Islam with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). By Allah, you will not get a single grain of wheat from Yamama until it is permitted by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch ghudsawaar Najd bheje. Unhone ek shakhs ko pakDa. Woh Banu Hanifa qabile se the aur unhe Thumama bin Uthal kaha jaata tha. Woh Yamama ke logon ke sardaar the. Logon ne unhe masjid ke ek khambe se baandh diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse milne aaye. Unhone kaha: Aye Thumama, tum kya sochte ho? Unhone jawab diya: Muhammad, meri aapke baare mein achhi raay hai. Agar aap mujhe qatal karte hain, to aap ek aise shakhs ko qatal karenge jisne khoon bahaya hai. Agar aap mujhpar meherbaani karte hain, to aap ek shukraguzaar shakhs par meherbaani karenge. Agar aap daulat chaahte hain, to poochhiye aur aapko jo bhi aap maangenge woh milega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (is haalat mein) do din chhoDa, (aur dobara unke paas aaye) aur kaha: Tum kya sochte ho, Aye Thumama? Unhone jawab diya: Jo maine aapko pehle hi bataaya hai. Agar aap meherbaani karte hain, to aap ek shukraguzaar shakhs par meherbaani karenge. Agar aap mujhe qatal karte hain, to aap ek aise shakhs ko qatal karenge jisne khoon bahaya hai. Agar aap daulat chaahte hain, to poochhiye aur aapko jo bhi aap maangenge woh milega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe agle din tak chhoDa jab (woh unke paas dobara aaye) aur kaha: Tum kya sochte ho, Aye Thumama? Unhone jawab diya: Jo maine aapko pehle hi bataaya hai. Agar aap mujhpar meherbaani karte hain, to aap ek shukraguzaar shakhs par meherbaani karenge. Agar aap mujhe qatal karte hain, to aap ek aise shakhs ko qatal karenge jisne khoon bahaya hai. Agar aap daulat chaahte hain, to poochhiye aur aapko jo bhi aap maangenge woh milega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Thumama ko azaad kar do. Woh masjid ke qareeb ek khajoor ke baag mein gaye aur nahaaye. Phir woh masjid mein daakhil hue aur kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon (sach ki) ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Muhammad Uske banda aur Uske rasool hain. Aye Muhammad, Allah ki qasam, zameen par koi chehra nahi tha jo mujhe aapke chehre se zyada napasand ho, lekin (ab) aapka chehra mujhe sabse zyada aziz ho gaya hai. Allah ki qasam, koi deen nahi tha jo mujhe aapke deen se zyada napasand ho, lekin (ab) aapka deen mujhe sabse zyada aziz ho gaya hai. Allah ki qasam, koi shehar nahi tha jo mujhe aapke shehar se zyada napasand ho, lekin (ab) aapka shehar mujhe sabse zyada aziz ho gaya hai. Aapke ghudsawaaron ne mujhe pakDa jab main Umra ke liye jaane ka iraada rakhta tha. Ab aapki iske baare mein kya raay hai? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe khushkhabri di aur unhe Umra ke liye jaane ko kaha. Jab woh Makkah pahunche, kisi ne unse kaha: Kya aapne apna deen badal liya hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi! Balki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Islam qubool kiya hai. Allah ki qasam, tumhe Yamama se ek daana gehun bhi tab tak nahi milega jab tak isse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ijazat na den.

e: The same tradition has been narrated by a different chain of transmitters with a slight difference in the wording.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: We were (sitting) in the mosque when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and said: (Let us) go to the Jews. We went out with him until we came to them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and called out to them (saying): O ye assembly of Jews, accept Islam (and) you will be safe. They said: Abu'l-Qasim, you have communicated (God's Message to us). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I want this (i. e. you should admit that God's Message has been communicated to you), accept Islam and you would be safe. They said: Abu'l-Qisim, you have communicated (Allah's Message). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I want this... - He said to them (the same words) the third time (and on getting the same reply) he added: You should know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and I wish that I should expel you from this land Those of you who have any property with them should sell it, otherwise they should know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle (and they may have to go away leaving everything behind).
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum masjid mein (baithe) the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare paas aaye aur kaha: (Chalo) Yahudiyon ke paas chalte hain. Hum unke saath bahar nikle yahan tak ki hum unke paas pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur unhe pukaara (ye kehte hue): Aye Yahudiyon ke giroh, Islam qubool karo (aur) tum mahfooz ho jaaoge. Unhone kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, aapne (Allah ka Payaam humein) pahunchaa diya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main ye chaahta hoon (yaani tum ye maano ki Allah ka Payaam tumhe pahunchaaya gaya hai), Islam qubool karo aur tum mahfooz ho jaaoge. Unhone kaha: Abu'l-Qisim, aapne (Allah ka Payaam) pahunchaa diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main ye chaahta hoon... - Unhone unse (wahi alfaaz) teesri baar kaha (aur wahi jawaab paane par) unhone izafa kiya: Tumhe pata hona chahiye ki zameen Allah aur Uske Rasool ki hai, aur main chaahta hoon ki main tumhe is zameen se nikaal dun. Tum mein se jinke paas koi maal hai unhe use bech dena chahiye, warna unhe pata hona chahiye ki zameen Allah aur Uske Rasool ki hai (aur unhe sab kuch peeche chhoDkar jaana pad sakta hai).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Jews of Banu Nadir and Banu Quraiza fought against the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who expelled Banu Nadir, and allowed Quraiza to stay on, and granted favour to them until they too fought against him Then he killed their men, and distributed their women, children and properties among the Muslims, except that some of them had joined the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who granted them security. They embraced Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned out all the Jews of Medina. Banu Qainuqa' (the tribe of 'Abdullah b. Salim) and the Jews of Banu Haritha and every other Jew who was in Medina.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Banu Nadir aur Banu Quraiza ke Yahudiyon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khilaaf jung ki jinhone Banu Nadir ko nikaal diya, aur Quraiza ko rehne diya, aur unpar meherbaani ki yahan tak ki woh bhi unke khilaaf jung karne lage. Phir unhone unke aadmiyon ko qatal kiya, aur unki auraton, bachchon aur maal ko Musalmaanon mein taqseem kiya, siwaay is baat ke ki unmein se kuch Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aa mile the jinhe unhone hifaazat di. Unhone Islam qubool kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ke saare Yahudiyon ko nikaal diya, Banu Qainuqa (Abdullah bin Salim ka qabila) aur Banu Haritha ke Yahudiyon ko aur har doosre Yahudi ko jo Madina mein tha.

e: A similar hadith has been transmitted by a different chain of narrators, but the hadith narrated by Ibn Juraij is more detailed and complete.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Ibn Juraij ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hadees zyada vistrit aur mukammal hai.

e: It has been narrated by 'Umar b. al-Khattib that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: I will expel the Jews and Christians from the Arabian Peninsula and will not leave any but Muslim.
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Yahudiyon aur Isaiyon ko Arab prayadweep se nikaal dunga aur sirf Musalmaanon ko chhoDunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zubair with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zubair ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri who said: The people of Quraiza surrendered accepting the decision of Sa'd b. Mu'adh about them. Accordingly, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent for Sa'd who came to him riding a donkey. When he approached the mosque, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to the Ansar: Stand up to receive your chieftain. Then he said (to Sa'd): These people have surrendered accepting your decision. He (Sa'd) said: You will kill their fighters and capture their women and children. (Hearing this), the Prophet (ﷺ) said: You have adjudged by the command of God. The narrator is reported to have said: Perhaps he said: You have adjudged by the decision of a king. 
Ibn Muthanna (in his version of the tradition) has not mentioned the alternative words.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Quraiza ke log Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke unke baare mein faisle ko qubool karke aatm-samarpan kar gaye. Uske mutabik, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Sa'd ke liye payaam bheja jo ek gadhe par sawaar hokar unke paas aaye. Jab woh masjid ke qareeb aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar se kaha: Apne sardaar ka swaagat karne ke liye khade ho jao. Phir unhone (Sa'd se) kaha: In logon ne aapka faisla qubool karke aatm-samarpan kiya hai. Unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: Aap unke lade waalon ko qatal karenge aur unki auraton aur bachchon ko qaidi banaayenge. (Ye sunkar), Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Aapne Allah ke hukum ke mutabik faisla kiya hai. Raawi ne kaha: Shayad unhone kaha: Aapne ek raja ke faisle ke mutabik faisla kiya hai. Ibn Muthanna ne (apne soorat mein) vaikalpik alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

e: Through the same chain of transmitters Shu'ba has narrated the same tradition in which he says that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to Sa'd): You have adjudged according to the command of God. And once he said: you have adjudged by the decision of a king.
hi: Isi sanad se Shu'ba ne isi tarah ki riwayat ki hai jismein woh kehte hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Sa'd se) kaha: Aapne Allah ke hukum ke mutabik faisla kiya hai. Aur ek baar unhone kaha: Aapne ek raja ke faisle ke mutabik faisla kiya hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of A'isha who said: Sa'd was wounded on the day of the Battle of the Ditch. A man from the Quraish called Ibn al-Ariqah shot at him an arrow which pierced the artery in the middle of his forearm. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pitched a tent for him in the mosque and would inquire after him being in close proximity. When he returned from the Ditch and laid down his arms and took a bath, the angel Gabriel appeared to him and he was removing dust from his hair (as if he had just returned from the battle). The latter said: You have laid down arms. By God, we haven't (yet) laid them down. So march against them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked: Where? He pointed to Banu Quraiza. So the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) fought against them. They surrendered at the command of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but he referred the decision about them to Sa'd who said: I decide about them that those of them who can fight be killed, their women and children taken prisoners and their properties distributed (among the Muslims).
hi: Aisha ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Sa'd khaai ki jung ke din zakhmi ho gaye the. Quraish se ek shakhs jise Ibn al-Ariqah kaha jaata tha usne unpar ek teer chalaaya jo unki baazu ke beech ki dhamni ko chheD gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye masjid mein ek tambu lagaaya aur unke qareeb rehte hue unka haal poochte the. Jab woh khaai se wapas aaye aur apne hathiyaar rakh diye aur nahaaye, farishta Jibrail unke saamne aaye aur woh apne baalon se dhool hataa rahe the (jaise woh abhi-abhi jung se wapas aaye hon). Unhone (Jibrail ne) kaha: Aapne hathiyaar rakh diye. Allah ki qasam, humne (abhi tak) unhe nahi rakha. Is liye unke khilaaf march karo. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne poocha: Kahan? Unhone Banu Quraiza ki taraf ishara kiya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke khilaaf jung ki. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum par aatm-samarpan hue, lekin unhone unke baare mein faisla Sa'd ko soonpa jinhone kaha: Main unke baare mein faisla deta hoon ki unmein se jo lad sakte hain unhe qatal kiya jaaye, unki auraton aur bachchon ko qaidi banaaya jaaye aur unki maal taqseem ki jaaye (Musalmaanon mein).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hisham (who learnt it from his father) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to Sa'd): You have adjudged their case with the judgment of God. the Exalted and Glorified.
hi: Hisham (jinhone ise apne walid se seekha) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Sa'd se) kaha: Aapne unka maamla Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke faisle ke mutabik nirdharit kiya hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha that Sa'd's wound became dry and was going to heal when he prayed: O God, surely Thou knowest that nothing is dearer to me than that I should fight for Thy cause against the people who disbeliever Your Messenger (ﷺ) and turned him out (from his native place). If anything yet remains to be decided from the war against the Quraish, spare my life so that I may fight against them in Thy cause. O Lord, I think Thou hast ended the war between us and them. If Thou hast done so, open my wound (so that it may discharge) and cause my death thereby. So the wound begin to bleed from the front part of his neck. The people were not scared except when the blood flowed towards them, and in the mosque along with Sa'd's tent was the tent of Banu Ghifar. They said: O people of the tent, what is it that is coming to us from you? Lo! it was Sa'd's wound that was bleeding and he died thereof.
hi: Aisha ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Sa'd ka zakhm sukh raha tha aur theek hone waala tha jab unhone dua ki: Aye Allah, yaqeenan Tu jaanta hai ki mujhe kuch bhi isse zyada aziz nahi hai ki main Teri raah mein un logon ke khilaaf larun jinhone Tere Rasool (SAW) ko na maana aur unhe (unki janambhoomi se) nikaal diya. Agar Quraish ke khilaaf jung mein kuch aur faisla hona baaki hai, to meri zindagi bacha taaki main Teri raah mein unke khilaaf lad sakoon. Aye Rab, mujhe lagta hai Tune humare aur unke beech jung khatm kar di hai. Agar Tune aisa kiya hai, to mera zakhm khol de (taaki isse rakt beh sake) aur isse meri maut ka wajah bana. To zakhm unki gardan ke agle hisse se beh na laga. Log tab tak nahi ghabraaye jab tak khoon unki taraf nahi baha, aur masjid mein Sa'd ke tambu ke saath Banu Ghifar ka tambu tha. Unhone kaha: Aye tambu ke logo, ye kya hai jo tumhari taraf se hamare paas aa raha hai? Dekho! ye Sa'd ka zakhm tha jismein se khoon beh raha tha aur uski wajah se unka intiqaal ho gaya.

e:
This tradition has been narrated by Hishim through the same chain of transmitters with a little difference in the wording. He said: (His wound) began to bleed that very night and it continued to bleed until he died. He has made the addition that it was then that (a non-believing) poet said: 
Hark, O Sa'd, Sa'd of Banu Mu'adh, 
What have the Quraiaa and Nadir done? 
By thy life! Sa'd b. Mu'adh>br> Was steadfast on the morn they departed. 
You have left your cooking-pot empty, 
While the cooking-pot of the people is hot and boiling. 
Abu Hubab the nobleman has said, 
O Qainuqa', do not depart. 
They were weighty in their country 
just aa rocks are weighty in Maitan.
hi: Ye riwayat Hisham ke zariye isi sanad se alfaazon mein thoDi tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone kaha: (Unka zakhm) usi raat behna shuru hua aur behta raha yahan tak ki unka intiqaal ho gaya. Unhone ye izafa kiya ki isi mauqe par (ek ghair-imaandaar) kavi ne kaha: Suno, Aye Sa'd, Banu Mu'adh ke Sa'd, Quraiza aur Nadir ne kya kiya hai? Teri jaan ki qasam! Sa'd bin Mu'adh us subah ade rahe jab woh nikle. Tumne apna khaana pakaane ka bartan khaali chhoD diya hai, jabki logon ka bartan garam aur ubal raha hai. Abu Hubab, ijjatdaar, ne kaha hai, Aye Qainuqa, mat jao. Woh apne desh mein bhaari the jaise chattaanein Maitan mein bhaari hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah who said: On the day he returned from the Battle of Ahzab, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made for us an announcement that nobody would say his Zuhr prayer but in the quarters of Banu Quraiza (Some) people, being afraid that the time for prayer would expire, said their prayers before reaching the street of Banu Quraiza. The others said: We will not say our prayer except where the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has ordered us to say it even if the time expires. When he learned of the difference in the view of the two groups of the people, the Messenger of Allah (may peace be tipon him) did not blame anyone from the two groups.
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Us din jab woh Ahzab ki jung se wapas aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humare liye ye ailaan kiya ki koi bhi apni zohar ki namaz sirf Banu Quraiza ke ilaake mein padhega. (Kuch) log, ye Dar te hue ki namaz ka waqt nikal jaayega, unhone Banu Quraiza ki gali tak pahunchne se pehle apni namaz padh li. Doosron ne kaha: Hum apni namaz sirf wahi padhenge jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya hai isse padhne ka chahe waqt nikal jaaye. Jab unhe do giroh ke logon ke vichaaron mein antar ka pata chala, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne donon giroh mein se kisi ko bhi dosh nahi diya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said: When the Muhajirs migrated from Mecca to Medina; they came (in a state that) they had not anything (i. e. money) in theirhands, while the Ansar possessed lands and date palms. They divided their properties with the Muhajirs. The Ansar divided and gave them on the condition that they would give half the fruit from the orchards every year, and the Muhajirs would recompense them by working with them and putting in labour. The mother of Anas b. Malik was called Umm Sulaim and she was also the mother of 'Abdullah b. Talha who was a brother of Anas from his mother's side. The mother of Anas had given the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) her date-palms. He bestowed them upon Umm Aiman, the slave-girl who had been freed by him and was the mother of Usama b. Zaid. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had finished the war with the people of Khaibar and returned to Medina, the Muhajirs returned to the Ansar all the gifts which they had given them out of the fruits. (Anas b. Malik said: ) The Messenger of. Allah (ﷺ) returned to my mother her date-palms and gave to Umm Aiman instead of them date-palms from his orchard. Ibn Shihab says that Umm Aiman was the mother of Usama b. Zaid who was the slave-girl of 'Abdullah b. 'Abd-ul-Muttalib and hailed from Abyssinia. When Amina gave birth to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the death of his father, Umm Aiman used to nurse him until he grew up. He (later on) freed her and married her to Zaid b. Haritha. She died five months after the death of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Muhajir Makkah se Madina hijrat karke aaye; woh (aisi haalat mein) aaye ki unke haathon mein kuch nahi tha (yaani paisa), jabki Ansar ke paas zameenein aur khajoor ke darakht the. Unhone apni maal Muhajir ke saath baanti. Ansar ne baanta aur unhe is shart par diya ki woh har saal baagon se aadha phal denge, aur Muhajir unke saath kaam karke aur mehnat karke unhe muaaviza denge. Anas bin Malik ki maa ko Umm Sulaim kaha jaata tha aur woh Abdullah bin Talha ki bhi maa thin jo Anas ke maa ki taraf se bhai the. Anas ki maa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne khajoor ke darakht diye the. Unhone unhe Umm Aiman ko diya, jo laundi jinhe unhone azaad kiya tha aur Usama bin Zaid ki maa thin. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khaibar ke logon ke saath jung khatm karke Madina wapas aaye, Muhajir ne Ansar ko woh saare tohfe wapas kiye jo unhone unhe phalon mein se diye the. (Anas bin Malik ne kaha:) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne meri maa ko unke khajoor ke darakht wapas kiye aur Umm Aiman ko unke badle apne baag se khajoor ke darakht diye. Ibn Shihab kehte hain ki Umm Aiman Usama bin Zaid ki maa thin jo Abdullah bin Abd-ul-Muttalib ki laundi thin aur Abyssinia se thin. Jab Amina ne unke waalid ki maut ke baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko paida kiya, Umm Aiman unhe doodh pilaati thin yahan tak ki woh bade hue. Unhone (baad mein) unhe azaad kiya aur unki shaadi Zaid bin Haritha se karvaayi. Unka intiqaal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ke paanch mahine baad hua.

e: It has been narrated by Anas that (after his migration to Medina) a person placed at the Prophet's (ﷺ) disposal some date-palms growing on his land until the lands of Quraiza and Nadir were conquered. Then he began to return to him whatever he had received. (In this connection) my people told me to approach the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and ask from him what his people had given him or a portion thereof, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had bestowed those trees upon Umm Aiman. So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he gave hem (back) to me. Umm Aiman (also) came (at this time). She put the cloth round my neck and said: No, by Allah, we will not give to, you what he has granted to me. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Umm Aiman, let him have them and for you are such and such trees instead. But she said: By Allah, there is no god besides Him. No, never! The Prophet (ﷺ) continued saying: (You will get) such and such. until he had granted her ten times or nearly ten times more (than the original gift).
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki (Madina hijrat karne ke baad) ek shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) ke istemal ke liye apni zameen par ugne wale kuch khajoor ke darakht rakhe jab tak Quraiza aur Nadir ki zameenein fatah nahi ho gayin. Phir unhone unhe wapas dena shuru kiya jo unhe mila tha. (Isi silsile mein) mere logon ne mujhse kaha ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaaun aur unse maangoon jo unke logon ne unhe diya tha ya uska ek hissa, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne woh darakht Umm Aiman ko de diye the. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhone unhe (wapas) mujhe diya. Umm Aiman (bhi) aayi (is waqt). Unhone mere gale mein kapda daala aur kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhe wahi nahi denge jo unhone mujhe diya hai. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Umm Aiman, unhe use lene do aur tumhare liye aisa aisa darakht (hain badle mein). Lekin unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Uske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai. Nahi, kabhi nahi! Nabi (SAW) kehte rahe: (Tumhe milega) aisa aisa. yahan tak ki unhone unhe dus guna ya lagbhag dus guna zyada (asal tohfe se) diya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mughaffal who said I found a bag containing fat on the day of the Battle of Khaibar. I caught hold of it and said: I will not give anything today from it to anybody. Then I turned round and saw that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was smiling (at my words).
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Khaibar ki jung ke din charbi wali ek thaili paayi. Maine use pakDa aur kaha: Aaj main isme se kisi ko kuch nahi dunga. Phir main muDa aur dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (mere alfaazon par) muskuraa rahe the.

e: This tradition has been transmitted by a different chain of narrators with a different wording, the last in the chain being the same narrator, (i. e. 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal), who said: A bag containing food and fat was thrown to us. I lept forward to catch it. Then I turned round and saw (to my surprise) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and I felt ashamed of my act in his presence.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai, jismein aakhri raawi wahi hai (yaani Abdullah bin Mughaffal), jinhone kaha: Khaane aur charbi se bhari ek thaili humari taraf phenki gayi. Maine use pakadne ke liye chalaang lagaayi. Phir main muDa aur dekha (hairat se) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain aur mujhe unki maujoodgi mein apne amal par sharm mehsoos hui.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas who learnt the tradition personally from Abu Safyan. The latter said: I went out (on a mercantile venture) during the period (of truce) between me and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). While I was in Syria, the letter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was handed over to Hiraql (Ceasar), the Emperor of Rome (who was on a visit to Jerusalem at that time). The letter was brought by Dihya Kalbi who delivered it to the governor of Busra The governor passed it on to Hiraql, (On receiving the letter), he said: Is there anyone from the people of this man who thinks that he is a prophet. People said: Yes. So, I was called along with a few others from the Quraish. We were admitted to Hiraql and he seated usbefore him. He asked: Which of you has closer kinship with the man who thinks that he is a prophet? Abu Sufyan said: I. So they seated me in front of him and stated my companions behind me. Then, he called his interpreter and said to him: Tell them that I am going to ask this fellow (i. e. Abu Sufyan) about the man who thinks that he is a prophet. It he tells me a lie, then refute him. 
Abu Sufyan told (the narrator): By God, if there was not the fear that falsehood would be imputed to me I would have lied. (Then) Hiraqi said to his interpreter: Inquire from him about his ancestry, I said: He is of good ancestry among us. He asked: Has there been a king among his ancestors? I said: No. He asked: Did you accuse him of falsehood before he proclaimed his prophethood? I said: No. He asked: Who are his follower people of high status or low status? I said: (They are) of low status. He asked: Are they increasing in number or decreasing? I said. No. they are rather increasing. He asked: Does anyone give up his religion, being dissatisfied with it, after having embraced it? I said: No. He asked: Have you been at war with him? I said: Yes. He asked: How did you fare in that war? I said: The war between us and him has been wavering like a bucket, up at one turn and down at the other (i. e. the victory has been shared between us and him by turns). Sometimes he suffered loss at our hands and sometimes we suffered loss at his (hand). He asked: Has he (ever) violated his covenant? I said: No. but we have recently concluded a peace treaty with him for a petiod and we do not know what he is going to do about it. (Abu Sufyin said on oath that he could not interpolate in this dialogue anything from himself more than these words ) He asked: Did anyone make the proclamation (Of prophethood) before him? I said: No. He (now) said to his interpreter: Tell him, I asked him about his ancestry and he had replied that he had the best ancestry. This is the case with Prophets; they are the descendants of the noblest among their people (Addressing Abu Sufyan), he continued: I asked you if there had been a king among his ancestors. You said that there had been none. If there had been a king among his ancestors, I would have said that he was a man demanding his ancestral kingdom. I asked you about his followers whether they were people of high or low status, and you said that they were of rather low status. Such are the followers of the Prophets. I asked you whether you used to accuse him of falsehood before he proclaimed his prophethood, and you said that you did not. 
So I have understood that when he did not allow himself to tell a lie about the poeple, he would never go to the length of forging a falsehood about Allah. I asked you whether anyone renounced his religion being dissatisfied with it after he had embraced it, and you replied in the negative. Faith is like this when it enters the depth of the heart (it perpetuates them). I asked you whether his followers were increasing or decreasing. You said they were increasing. Faith is like this until it reaches its consummation. I asked you whether you had been at war with him, and you replied that you had been and that the victory between you and him had been shared by turns, sometimes he suffering loss at your hand and sometimes you suffering lost at his. This is how the Prophets are tried before the final victory its theirs. I asked you whether he (ever) violated his covenant, and you said that he did not. This is how the Prophets behave. They never violate (their covenants). I asked you whether anyone before him had proclaimed the same thing, and you replied in the negative. I said: If anyone had made the same proclamation before, I would have thought that he was a man following what had been proclaimed before. (Then) he asked: What does he enjoin upon you? I said: He exhorts us to offer Salat, to pay Zakat, to show due regard to kinship and to practise chastity. He said: It what you have told about him is true, he is certainly a Prophet. I knew that he was to appear but I did not think that he would be from among you. If I knew that I would be able to reach him. I would love to meet him; and it I had been with him. I would have washed his feet (out of reverence). His dominion would certainly extend to this place which is under my feet. Then he called for the letter of the Messenger of Allah (may pface be upon him) and read it. The letter ran as follows:" In the name of Allah, Most Gracious and Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, to Hiraql, the Emperor of the Romans. Peace be upon him who follows the guidance. After this, I extend to you the invitation to accept Islam. Embrace Islam and you will be safe. Accept Islam, God will give you double the reward. And if you turn away, upon you will be the sin of your subjects." O People of the Book, come to the word that is common between us that we should worship none other than Allah, should not ascribe any partner to Him and some of us should not take their fellows as Lords other than Allah. If they turn away, you should say that we testify to our being Muslims ." 
When he hid finished the reading of the letter, noise and confused clamour was raise around him, and he ordered us to leave. Accordingly, we left. (Addressing my companions) while we were coming out (of the place). I said: Ibn Abu Kabsha (referring sarcastically to the Holy Prophet) has come to wield a great power. Lo! (even) the king of the Romans is afraid of him. I continued to believe that the authority of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would triumph until God imbued me with (the spirit of) Islam.
hi: Ibn Abbas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees khud Abu Sufyan se seekhi. Unhone kaha: Main (vyaapaarik safar par) bahar nikla us muddat ke daurane (jab humare aur Allah ke Rasool SAW ke beech shaanti thi). Jab main Syria mein tha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khat Hiraql (Caesar), Rome ke samraat (jo us waqt Jerusalem ki safar par the), ko soonpa gaya. Khat Dihya Kalbi laaye jinhone use Busra ke gavarnar ko diya. Gavarnar ne use Hiraql ko diya. (Khat paane par), unhone kaha: Kya us shakhs ke logon mein se koi hai jo sochta hai ki woh ek nabi hai? Logon ne kaha: Haan. To, mujhe Quraish ke kuch doosron ke saath bulaaya gaya. Humein Hiraql ke saamne le jaaya gaya aur unhone humein apne saamne baithaaya. Unhone poocha: Tum mein se kaun us shakhs ke sabse qareeb rishtedaar hai jo sochta hai ki woh ek nabi hai? Abu Sufyan ne kaha: Main. To unhone mujhe unke saamne baithaya aur mere saathiyon ko mere peeche khada kiya. Phir, unhone apna dubhaashiya bulaaya aur usse kaha: Unhe bataao ki main is shakhs (yaani Abu Sufyan) se us shakhs ke baare mein poochne wala hoon jo sochta hai ki woh ek nabi hai. Agar woh mujhse jhoot bole, to use nakaaro. Abu Sufyan ne (raawi ko) bataaya: Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe dar na hota ki mujhpar jhoot ka ilzaam lagega, to main jhoot bolta. (Phir) Hiraqi ne apne dubhaashiye se kaha: Unse unke pariwaar ke baare mein poocho. Maine kaha: Woh humare beech achhe pariwaar ke hain. Unhone poocha: Kya unke poorvajon mein koi raja hua hai? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone poocha: Kya tumne unhe unki nabuwwat ka ailaan karne se pehle jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagaya tha? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone poocha: Unke anuyaayi kaun hain, buland darje ke log ya nichle darje ke? Maine kaha: (Woh) nichle darje ke (hain). Unhone poocha: Kya woh tadaad mein baDh rahe hain ya kam ho rahe hain? Maine kaha: Nahi, woh balki baDh rahe hain. Unhone poocha: Kya koi apna deen chhodta hai, usse asantusht hokar, ise qubool karne ke baad? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone poocha: Kya tum unke saath jung mein rahe ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone poocha: Us jung mein tumhara kya haal raha? Maine kaha: Humare aur unke beech jung ek balti ki tarah dol rahi hai, ek mode par upar aur doosre par neeche (yaani jeet humare aur unke beech baari-baari se baanti gayi hai). Kabhi unhe humare haath nuksaan hua aur kabhi humein unke (haath). Unhone poocha: Kya unhone (kabhi) apna vaada toDa? Maine kaha: Nahi, lekin humne haal hi mein ek muddat ke liye unke saath shaanti sandhi ki hai aur humein nahi pata woh iske baare mein kya karenge. (Abu Sufyan ne qasam khaakar kaha ki woh is dialogue mein in alfaazon se zyada kuch khud se nahi joD sake) Unhone poocha: Kya kisi ne unse pehle (nabuwwat ka) ailaan kiya? Maine kaha: Nahi. Unhone (ab) apne dubhaashiye se kaha: Unse kaho, maine unse unke pariwaar ke baare mein poocha aur unhone jawab diya ki unka sabse achha pariwaar tha. Nabiyon ke saath aisa hi hota hai; woh apne logon mein sabse behtareen ke vanshaj hote hain. (Abu Sufyan ko sambodhit karte hue), unhone jaari rakha: Maine tumse poocha ki kya unke poorvajon mein koi raja tha. Tumne kaha ki koi nahi tha. Agar unke poorvajon mein koi raja hota, to main kehta ki woh ek aisa aadmi hai jo apne poorvajon ka hukumat maang raha hai. Maine tumse unke anuyaayiyon ke baare mein poocha ki kya woh buland ya nichle darje ke log the, aur tumne kaha ki woh balki nichle darje ke the. Aise hi Nabiyon ke anuyaayi hote hain. Maine tumse poocha ki kya tum unhe unki nabuwwat ka ailaan karne se pehle jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagaate the, aur tumne kaha ki nahi. To maine samjha ki jab unhone khud ko logon ke baare mein jhoot bolne ki ijazat nahi di, to woh kabhi Allah ke baare mein jhoot ghadne ki had tak nahi jaayenge. Maine tumse poocha ki kya kisi ne apna deen chhoDa, usse asantusht hokar, ise qubool karne ke baad, aur tumne nakaaraatmak jawaab diya. Imaan aisa hi hota hai jab ye dil ki gehraayi mein daakhil karta hai (ye unhe hamesha ke liye barkarar rakhta hai). Maine tumse poocha ki kya unke anuyaayi baDh rahe hain ya kam ho rahe hain. Tumne kaha ki woh baDh rahe hain. Imaan aisa hi hota hai jab tak ye apni poornata tak nahi pahunchta. Maine tumse poocha ki kya tum unke saath jung mein rahe ho, aur tumne jawaab diya ki tum the aur ki tumhare aur unke beech jeet baari-baari se baanti gayi hai, kabhi unhe tumhare haath nuksaan hua aur kabhi tumhe unke (haath). Aise hi Nabiyon ki pareeksha hoti hai aakhri jeet unki hone se pehle. Maine tumse poocha ki kya unhone (kabhi) apna vaada toDa, aur tumne kaha ki nahi. Aise hi Nabi vyavahaar karte hain. Woh kabhi apne (vaade) nahi toDte. Maine tumse poocha ki kya unse pehle kisi ne wahi ailaan kiya. Tumne nakaaraatmak jawaab diya. Maine kaha: Agar kisi ne pehle wahi ailaan kiya hota, to main sochta ki woh ek aisa aadmi hai jo pehle se hue ailaan ka anusaran kar raha hai. (Phir) unhone poocha: Woh tumpar kya farz karte hain? Maine kaha: Woh humein Namaz padhne, Zakat dene, rishtedaari ka munasib samman karne, aur pavitrata ka abhyaas karne ki taakeed karte hain. Unhone kaha: Agar jo tumne unke baare mein bataaya hai woh sach hai, to woh zaroor ek Nabi hain. Mujhe pata tha ki woh pragat honge lekin mujhe nahi laga ki woh tumhare beech se honge. Agar mujhe pata hota ki main unke paas pahunch paunga, to main unse milne ki khwaaish rakhta; aur agar main unke saath hota, to main unke paon dhota (izzat mein). Unka raaj zaroor is jagah tak failega jo mere paon ke neeche hai. Phir unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khat maanga aur use padha. Khat is tarah tha: "Allah ke naam par, Sabse Meherbaan, Sabse Rehmvaan. Muhammad ki taraf se, Allah ke Rasool, Hiraql ko, Romans ke samraat. Us par shaanti ho jo margdarshan ka anusaran karta hai. Iske baad, main aapko Islam qubool karne ka nimantran deta hoon. Islam qubool karo aur tum mahfooz rahoge. Islam qubool karo, Allah tumhe dugna sawaab dega. Aur agar tum munh moDte ho, to tumpar tumhari prajaa ka gunah hoga." Aye Kitaab ke logo, aao us baat ki taraf jo humare beech saanjhi hai ki hum sirf Allah ki hi ibadat karein, Usse kisi ko shareek na karein aur humme se kuch Allah ke ilawa apne saathiyon ko Rab na banaayein. Agar woh munh moDein, to tumhe kehna chahiye ki hum gawaahi dete hain ki hum Musalman hain." Jab unhone khat padhna khatm kiya, unke aas-paas shor aur bhraant hulchul huyi, aur unhone humein jaane ka hukum diya. Uske mutabik, hum chale gaye. (Apne saathiyon ko sambodhit karte hue) jab hum bahar (us jagah se) aa rahe the, maine kaha: Ibn Abu Kabsha (Nabi-e-Paak ki taraf vyangya se ishara karte hue) badi taqat sambhaalne aaye hain. Dekho! (khud) Romans ka raja unse Darta hai. Main tab tak vishwaas karta raha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ikhtiyar jeetega yahan tak ki Allah ne mujhe Islam (ki jazba) se bhar diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters but with the addition: " When Allah inflicted defeat on the armies of Persia, Caesar moved from Hims to Aelia (Bait al-Maqdis) for thanking Allah as He granted him victory." In this hadith these words occur:" From Muhammad, servant of Allah and His Messenger," and said:" The sin of your followers," and also said the words:" to the call of Islam".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Jab Allah ne Persia ki fauj ko shikast di, Caesar Hims se Aelia (Bait al-Maqdis) ki taraf gaye Allah ka shukriya adaa karne ke liye jaise Usne unhe jeet di." Is hadees mein ye alfaaz milte hain: "Muhammad ki taraf se, Allah ke banda aur Uske Rasool," aur kaha: "Tumhare anuyaayiyon ka gunah," aur ye alfaaz bhi kahe: "Islam ke aahvaan ki taraf."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) wrote to Chosroes (King of Persia), Caesar (Emperor of Rome), Negus (King of Abyssinia) and every (other) despot inviting them to Allah, the Exalted. And this Negus was not the one for whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said the funeral prayers.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne Chosroes (Persia ke raja), Caesar (Rome ke samraat), Negus (Abyssinia ke raja) aur har (doosre) tanashaah ko likha unhe Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ki taraf nimantrit karte hue. Aur ye Negus woh nahi the jinke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne janaaza namaz padhi thi.

e: The tradition has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik (the same narrator) through a different chain of transmitters, but this version does not mention: " And he was not the Negus for whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had said the funeral prayers."
hi: Ye riwayat Anas bin Malik (usi raawi) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin is soorat mein iska zikr nahi hai: "Aur woh Negus nahi the jinke liye Nabi (SAW) ne janaaza namaz padhi thi."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of the same narrator through another chain of transmitters with the same difference in the wording.
hi: Ye riwayat usi raawi ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se isi antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.
