e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abbas who said: I was in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Hunain. I and Abd Sufyan b. Harith b. 'Abd al-Muttalib stuck to the Messenaer of Allah (ﷺ) and we did not separate from him. And the Messenger of Allah (may place be upon him) was riding on his white mule which had been presented to him by Farwa b. Nufitha al-Judhami. When the Muslims had an encounter with the disbelievers, the Muslims fled, falling back, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to spur his mule towards the disbelievers. I was holding the bridle of the mule of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) checking it from going very fast, and Abu Sufyan was holding the stirrup of the (mule of the) Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who said: Abbas, call out to the people of al-Samura. Abbas (who was a man with a loud voice) called out at the top of the voice: Where are the people of Samura? (Abbas said: ) And by God, when they heard my voice, they came back (to us) as cows come back to their calves, and said: We are present, we are present! 'Abbas said: They began to fight the infidels. Then there was a call to The Ansar. Those (who called out to them) shouted: O ye party of the Ansar! O party of the Ansar! Banu al-Harith b. al-Khazraj were the last to be called. Those (who called out to them) shouted: O Banu Al-Harith b. al-Khazraj! O BanU Harith b. al-Khazraj! And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who was riding on his mule looked at their fight with his neck stretched forward and he said: This is the time when the fight is raging hot. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took (some) pebbles and threw them in the face of the infidels. Then he said: By the Lord of Muhammad, the infidels are defeated. 'Abbas said: I went round and saw that the battle was in the same condition in which I had seen it. By Allah, it remained in the same condition until he threw the pebbles. I continued to watch until I found that their force had been spent out and they began to retreat.
hi: Abbas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha Hunain ke din. Main aur Abd Sufyan bin Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chipke rahe aur hum unse alag nahi hue. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni safed khachchar par sawaar the jo unhe Farwa bin Nufitha al-Judhami ne pesh ki thi. Jab Musalmaanon ka kaafiron se saamna hua, Musalman peeche haT gaye, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni khachchar ko kaafiron ki taraf badhaana shuru kiya. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khachchar ki lagaam pakDe hue tha use bahut tez chalne se rokte hue, aur Abu Sufyan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki (khachchar ki) rikaab pakDe hue the, jinhone kaha: Abbas, al-Samura ke logon ko pukaaro. Abbas (jo ek buland aawaaz waale aadmi the) ne poori aawaaz mein pukaara: Samura ke log kahan hain? (Abbas ne kaha:) Aur Allah ki qasam, jab unhone meri aawaaz suni, woh wapas aaye (humare paas) jaise gaayen apne bachchon ke paas wapas aati hain, aur kaha: Hum haazir hain, hum haazir hain! Abbas ne kaha: Woh kaafiron se ladne lage. Phir Ansar ko pukaara gaya. Unhone (jinhone unhe pukaara) chillaaya: Aye Ansar ke giroh! Aye Ansar ke giroh! Banu al-Harith bin al-Khazraj ko sabse aakhri baar pukaara gaya. Unhone (jinhone unhe pukaara) chillaaya: Aye Banu Al-Harith bin al-Khazraj! Aye Banu Harith bin al-Khazraj! Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jo apni khachchar par sawaar the, apni gardan aage badhaakar unki jung dekh rahe the aur unhone kaha: Ye woh waqt hai jab jung teez ho rahi hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (kuch) kankariyaan uthaayi aur unhe kaafiron ke chehron par phenkin. Phir unhone kaha: Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam, kaafir shikast khaa gaye. Abbas ne kaha: Main ghooma aur dekha ki jung usi haalat mein thi jismein maine ise dekha tha. Allah ki qasam, ye usi haalat mein rahi yahan tak ki unhone kankariyaan phenkin. Main dekhta raha yahan tak ki maine paaya ki unki taqat khatm ho gayi thi aur woh peeche hatne lage.

e: A version of the tradition has been transmitted through another chain of narrators. In this version the words uttered by the Prophet (ﷺ) (after he had thrown the pebbles in the face of the enemy) are reported as: " By the Lord of the Ka'ba, they have been defeated." And there is at the end the addition of the words:" Until Allah defeated them" (and I imagine) as if I saw the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) chasing them on his mule.
hi: Riwayat ka ek soorat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Is soorat mein Nabi (SAW) ke zariye kahe gaye alfaaz (kaafiron ke chehron par kankariyaan phenkne ke baad) is tarah riwayat kiye gaye hain: "Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam, woh shikast khaa gaye hain." Aur aakhri mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Yahan tak ki Allah ne unhe shikast di" (aur main sochta hoon) jaise maine Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko unhe apni khachchar par picha karte dekha ho.

e: 'Abbas reported: I was with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on the Day of Hunain. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that the hadith transmitted by Yonus and Ma'mar is more detailed and complete.
hi: Abbas ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Hunain ke din. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Yonus aur Ma'mar ke zariye riwayat ki hui hadees zyada vistrit aur mukammal hai.

e: It has been narratedon the authority of Abu Ishaq who said: A man asked Bara' (b. 'Azib): Did you run away on the Day of Hunain. O, Abu Umira? He said: No, by Allah, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not turn his back; (what actually happened was that) some young men from among his companions, who were hasty and who were either without any arms or did not have abundant arms, advanced and met a party of archers (who were so good shots) that their arrows never missed the mark. This party (of archers) belonged to Banu Hawazin and Banu Nadir. They shot at the advancing young men and their arrows were not likely to miss their targets. So these young men turned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was riding on his white mule and Abu Sufyan b. al-Harith b. 'Abd al-Muttalib was leading him. (At this) he got down from his mule, invoked God's help, and called out: I am the Prophet. This is no untruth. I am the son of 'Abd al-Muttalib. Then he deployed his men into battle array.
hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs ne Bara (bin Azib) se poocha: Kya aap Hunain ke din bhaage the, Aye Abu Umira? Unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni peeth nahi moDi; (jo waaqai hua woh ye tha ki) unke saathiyon mein se kuch jawaan log, jo jaldbaaz the aur jinke paas ya to koi hathiyaar nahi tha ya kaafi hathiyaar nahi tha, aage baDhe aur teerandaazon ke ek giroh (jo itne achhe nishaanebaaz the ki unke teer kabhi nishaan nahi chukte the) se mile. Ye giroh (teerandaazon ka) Banu Hawazin aur Banu Nadir se mutaliq tha. Unhone aage baDhe jawaan logon par teer chalaaye aur unke teer apna nishaan chukane wale nahi the. To ye jawaan log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf mude jabki woh apni safed khachchar par sawaar the aur Abu Sufyan bin al-Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib unhe le ja rahe the. (Isper) woh apni khachchar se utre, Allah ki madad maangi, aur pukaara: Main Nabi hoon. Ye koi jhoot nahi hai. Main Abd al-Muttalib ka beta hoon. Phir unhone apne aadmiyon ko jung ki safon mein taina't kiya.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) by Abu Ishiq that a person said to Bara' (b. 'Azib): Abu Umara, did you flee on the Day of Hunain? He replied: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not retreat. (What actually happened was that some hasty young men who were either inadequately armed or were unarmed met a group of men from Banu Hawazin and Banu Nadir who happened to be (excellent) archers. The latter shot at them a volley of arrows that did not miss. The people turned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Abu Sufyan b. Harith was leading his mule. So he got down, prayed and invoked God's help. He said: I am the Prophet. This is no untruth. I am the son of Abd al-Muttalib. O God, descend Thy help. Bara' continued: When the battle grew fierce. we, by God. would seek protection by his side, and the bravest among us was he who confronted the onslaught and it was the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Ishiq ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Bara (bin Azib) se kaha: Abu Umara, kya aap Hunain ke din bhaage the? Unhone jawab diya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) peeche nahi haTe. (Jo waaqai hua woh ye tha ki) kuch jaldbaaz jawaan log jo ya to poori tarah se hathiyaarbandh nahi the ya bina hathiyaar ke the, Banu Hawazin aur Banu Nadir ke aadmiyon ke ek giroh se mile jo (bahut achhe) teerandaaz nikle. Unhone (aakhri) unpar teeron ki barsaat ki jo nishaan nahi chukti thi. Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf mude. Abu Sufyan bin Harith unki khachchar le ja rahe the. To woh utre, dua ki aur Allah ki madad maangi. Unhone kaha: Main Nabi hoon. Ye koi jhoot nahi hai. Main Abd al-Muttalib ka beta hoon. Aye Allah, apni madad utaar. Bara ne aage kaha: Jab jung teez hui, hum, Allah ki qasam, unke pehlu mein hifaazat talaash karte, aur humme se sabse bahaadur woh tha jo hamle ka saamna karta aur woh the Nabi (SAW).

e: It has been narrated through a still different chain of transmitters by the same narrator (i. e. Abu Ishaq) who said: I heard from Bara' who was asked by a man from the Qais tribe: Did you run away from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Hunain? Bara' said: But the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not run away. On that day Banu Hawzzin took part in the battle as archers (on the side of the disbelievers). When we attacked them, they retreated and we fell upon the booty; (they rallied) and advanced towards us with arrows. (At that time) I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) riding on his white mule and Abu Sufyan b. al-Harith was holding its bridle. He (the Messenger of Allah was saying: I am the Prophet. This is no untruth. I am a descendant of 'Abd al-Muttalib.
hi: Ek phir bhi doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai usi raawi (yaani Abu Ishaq) se jinhone kaha: Maine Bara se suna jinse Qais qabile ke ek shakhs ne poocha: Kya aap Hunain ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bhaage the? Bara ne kaha: Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) nahi bhaage. Us din Banu Hawzzin ne teerandaazon ke soorat mein jung mein hissa liya (kaafiron ki taraf se). Jab humne unpar hamla kiya, woh peeche haTe aur hum maal-e-ganimat par gir paDe; (woh phir sanghatit hue) aur teeron ke saath humari taraf baDhe. (Us waqt) maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni safed khachchar par sawaar dekha aur Abu Sufyan bin al-Harith uski lagaam pakDe hue the. Woh (Allah ke Rasool) keh rahe the: Main Nabi hoon. Ye koi jhoot nahi hai. Main Abd al-Muttalib ka vanshaj hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Bara' with another chain of transmitters, but this hadith is short as compared with other ahadith which are more detailed.
hi: Ye hadees Bara ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ye hadees doosri hadeeson ke muqable choti hai jo zyada vistrit hain.

e: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Salama who said: We fought by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Hunain. When we encountered the enemy, I advanced and ascended a hillock. A man from the enemy side turned towards me and I shot him with an arrow. He (ducked and) hid himself from me. I could not understand what he did, but (all of a sudden) I saw that a group of people appeared from the other hillock. They and the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) met in combat, but the Companions of the Prophet turned back and I too turned back defeated. I had two mantles, one of which I was wrapping round the waist (covering the lower part of my body) and the other I was putting around my shoulders. My waist-wrapper got loose and I held the two mantles together. (In this downcast condition) I passed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who was riding on his white mule. He said: The son of Akwa' finds himself to be utterly perplexed. Wher. the Companions gathered round him from all sides. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got down from his mule. picked up a handful of dust from the ground, threw it into their (enemy) faces and said: May these faces be deformed 1 There was no one among the enemy whose eyes were not filled with the dust from this handful. So they turned back fleeing. and Allah the Exalted and Glorious defeated them, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed their booty among the Muslims.
hi: Ye riwayat Salama ki sanad se hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke pehlu mein Hunain mein lade. Jab humne dushman ka saamna kiya, main aage baDha aur ek pahaadi par chaDha. Dushman ki taraf se ek shakhs mere taraf muDa aur maine use ek teer se maara. Woh (jhuk gaya aur) khud ko mujhse chhipaa liya. Mujhe samajh nahi aaya usne kya kiya, lekin (achaanak) maine dekha ki logon ka ek giroh doosri pahaadi se pragat hua. Woh aur Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba jung mein mile, lekin Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba muDe aur main bhi shikast khaakar muDa. Mere paas do chogha the, ek main kamar ke aas-paas lapet raha tha (apne badan ke neechle hisse ko dhakte hue) aur doosra apne kandhon par daal raha tha. Mera kamarband dheela ho gaya aur maine donon chogho ko saath pakDa. (Is niraash halaat mein) main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se guzra jo apni safed khachchar par sawaar the. Unhone kaha: Akwa ka beta khud ko poori tarah abhibhoot paata hai. Jab sahaba unke charon taraf ikattha hue, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni khachchar se utre, zameen se ek mutthi dhool uthaayi, use unke (dushman ke) chehron par phenki aur kaha: In chehron ko vikrit ho jaaye 1 Dushman mein koi bhi shakhs nahi tha jiski aankhein is mutthi ki dhool se bhar na gayi ho. To woh bhaagte hue peeche muDe, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne unhe shikast di, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka maal-e-ganimat Musalmaanon mein taqseem kiya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Amr who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) besieged the people of Ta'if, but did get victory over them. He said: God willing, we shall return. His Companions said: Shall we depart without having conquered it? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (All right) make a raid in the morning. They did so. and were wounded (with the arrows showered upon them). So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We shall depart tomorrow. (The narrator says): (Now) this (announcement) pleased them, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) laughed at (their waywardness).
hi: Ibn Amr ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ta'if ke logon ko gher liya, lekin unpar jeet haasil nahi ki. Unhone kaha: Allah chaahe, hum wapas jaayenge. Unke sahaba ne kaha: Kya hum ise fatah kiye bina hi jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: (Achha) subah hamla karo. Unhone aisa kiya, aur (teeron ki barsaat se) zakhmi ho gaye. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Hum kal wapas jaayenge. (Raawi kehte hain): (Ab) ye (ailaan) unhe khush kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unki (chapal) hansi mein hanse.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that when (the news of) the advance of Abu Sufyan (at the head of a force) reached him. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) held consultations with his Companions. The narrator said: Abu Bakr spoke (expressing his own views), but he (the Holy Prophet) did not pay heed to him. Then spoke 'Umar (expressing his views), but he (the Holy Prophet) did not pay heed to him (too). Then Sa'd b. 'Ubada stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, you want us (to speak). By God in Whose control is my life, if you order us to plunge our horses into the sea, we would do so. If you order us to goad our horses to the most distant place like Bark al-Ghimad, we would do so. The narrator said: Now the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called upon the people (for the encounter). So they set out and encamped at Badr. (Soon) the water-carriers of the Quraish arrived. Among them was a black slave belonging to Banu al-Hajjaj. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) caught him and interrogated him about Abu Sufyan and his companions. He said: I know nothing about Abu Sufyan, but Abu Jahl, Utba, Shaiba and Umayya b. Khalaf are there. When he said this, they beat him. Then he said: All right, I will tell you about Abu Sufyan. They would stop beating him and then ask him (again) about Abu Sufyan. He would again say', I know nothing about Abu Sufyan, but Abu Jahl. 'Utba, Shaiba and Umayya b. Khalaf are there. When he said this, they beat him likewise. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing in prayer. When he saw this he finished his prayer and said: By Allah in Whose control is my life, you beat him when he is telling you the truth, and you let him go when he tells you a lie. The narrator said: Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is the place where so and so would be killed. He placed his hand on the earth (saying) here and here; (and) none of them fell away from the place which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had indicated by placing his hand on the earth.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki jab Abu Sufyan (ek fauj ke agua ke soorat mein) ke aage baDhne ki khabar unhe (Nabi ko) pahunchi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba se salaah maangi. Raawi ne kaha: Abu Bakr ne (apni raay dete hue) baat ki, lekin unhone (Nabi ne) unpar dhyaan nahi diya. Phir Umar ne (apni raay dete hue) baat ki, lekin unhone (Nabi ne) unpar bhi dhyaan nahi diya. Phir Sa'd bin Ubada khade hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap chaahte hain ki hum (baat karein). Us Allah ki qasam jiske vash mein meri zindagi hai, agar aap humein hukum dete hain ki hum apne ghode samundar mein daal dein, hum aisa karenge. Agar aap humein hukum dete hain ki hum apne ghodon ko Bark al-Ghimad jaisi door jagah tak haankein, hum aisa karenge. Raawi ne kaha: Ab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ko bulaaya (muqaable ke liye). To woh nikle aur Badr mein padaav daala. (Jald hi) Quraish ke paani laane wale pahunche. Unmein Banu al-Hajjaj ka ek kaala ghulam tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ne use pakDa aur Abu Sufyan aur unke sahaba ke baare mein poochh-taachh ki. Usne kaha: Mujhe Abu Sufyan ke baare mein kuch nahi pata, lekin Abu Jahl, Utba, Shaiba aur Umayya bin Khalaf wahan hain. Jab usne ye kaha, unhone use maara. Phir usne kaha: Achha, main tumhe Abu Sufyan ke baare mein bataunga. Woh use maarna band karte aur phir usse (dobara) Abu Sufyan ke baare mein poochte. Woh dobara kehta, mujhe Abu Sufyan ke baare mein kuch nahi pata, lekin Abu Jahl, Utba, Shaiba aur Umayya bin Khalaf wahan hain. Jab usne ye kaha, unhone use usi tarah maara. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz padh rahe the. Jab unhone ye dekha unhone apni namaz khatm ki aur kaha: Allah ki qasam jiske vash mein meri zindagi hai, tum use maarte ho jab woh tumhe sach bataata hai, aur tum use chhoD dete ho jab woh tumse jhoot bolta hai. Raawi ne kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye woh jagah hai jahan falan-falan qatal kiya jaayega. Unhone apna haath zameen par rakha (kehte hue) yahan aur yahan; aur unmein se koi bhi us jagah se nahi giraa jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zameen par apna haath rakhkar bataayi thi.

e: It has been narrated by 'Abdullah b. Rabah from Abu Huraira, who said: Many deputations came to Mu'awiya. This was in the month of Ramadan. We would prepare food for one another. Abu Huraira was one of those who frequently invited us to his house. I said: Should I not prepare food and invite them to my place? So I ordered meals to be prepared Then I met Abu Huraira in the evening and said: (You will have) your meals with me tonight. He said: You have forestalled me. I said: Yes, and invited them. (When they had finished with the meals) Abu Huraira said: Should I not tell yon a tradition from your traditions, O ye assembly of the Ansar? He then gave an account of the Conquest of Mecca and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) advanced until he reached Mecca. He deputed Zubair on his right flank and Khalid on the left, and he despatched Abu Ubaida with the force that had no armour. They advanced to the interior of the valley. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the midst of a large contingent of fighters. He saw me and said: Abu Huraira. I said: I am here at your call, Messenger of Allah I He said: Let no one come to me except the Ansar, so call to me the Ansar (only). Abu Huraira continued: So they gathered round him. The Quraish also gathered their ruffians and their (lowly) followers, and said: We send these forward. If they get anything, we shall be with them (to share it), and if misfortune befalls them, we shall pay (as compensation) whatever we are asked for. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to the Ansar): You see the ruffians and the (lowly) followers of the Quraish. And he indicated by (striking) one of his hands over the other that they should be killed and said: Meet me at as-Safa. Then we went on (and) if any one of us wanted that a certain person should be killed, he was killed, and none could offer any resistance. Abu Huraira continued: Then came Abu Sufyan and said: Messenger of Allah, the blood of the Quraish has become very cheap. There will be no Quraish from this day on. Then he (the Holy Prophet) said: Who enters the house of Abu Sufyan, he will be safe. Some of the Ansar whispered among themselves: (After all), love for his city and tenderness towards his relations have overpowered him. Abu Huraira said: (At this moment) revelation came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and when he was going to receive the Revelation, we understood it, and when he was (actually) receiving it, none of us would dare raise his eyes to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) until the revelation came to an end. When the revelation came to an end, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O ye Assembly of the Ansar! They said: Here we are at your disposal, Messenger of Allah. He said: You were saying that love for his city and tenderness towards his people have overpowered this man. They said: So it was. He said: No, never. I am a bondman of God and His Messenger. I migrated towards God and towards you. I will live with you and will die with you. So, they (the Ansar) turned towards him in tears and they were saying: By Allah, we said what we said because of our tenacious attachment to Allah and His Messenger. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Surely, Allah and His Messenger testify to your assertions and accept your apology. The narrator continued: People turned to the house of Abu Sufyan and people locked their doors. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded until he approached the (Black) Stone. He kissed it and circumambulated the Ka'ba. He reached near an idol by the side of the Ka'ba which was worshipped by the people. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a bow in his hand, and he was holding it from a corner. When he came near the idol, he began to pierce its eyes with the bow and (while doing so) was saying: Truth has been established and falsehood has perished. When he had finished the circumambulation, he came to Safa', ascended it to a height from where he could see the Ka'ba, raised his hands (in prayer) and began to praise Allah and prayed what he wanted to pray.
hi: Abdullah bin Rabah ne Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Kayi numainda mandal Muawiya ke paas aaye. Ye Ramzan ke mahine mein tha. Hum ek-doosre ke liye khaana taiyaar karte. Abu Huraira un logon mein se the jo hamein aksar apne ghar bulaate the. Maine kaha: Kya mujhe khaana taiyaar nahi karna chahiye aur unhe apni jagah nahi bulaana chahiye? To maine khaana taiyaar karne ka hukum diya. Phir main shaam ko Abu Huraira se mila aur kaha: (Aapko) aaj raat mere saath khaana khaana hai. Unhone kaha: Aapne mujhse pehle hi ye kaha (yaani mera bhi yahi iraada tha). Maine kaha: Haan, aur unhe bulaaya. (Jab woh khaane se farigh hue) Abu Huraira ne kaha: Kya main tumhe tumhari hi ek riwayat na sunaun, Aye Ansar ke giroh? Unhone phir Makkah ki Fatah ka byora diya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage baDhe yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche. Unhone Zubair ko apni daayi taraf aur Khalid ko baayi taraf muqarrar kiya, aur unhone Abu Ubaida ko us fauj ke saath bheja jiske paas koi kavach nahi tha. Woh wadi ke andar ki taraf aage baDhe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) laDaakon ke ek bade dal ke beech mein the. Unhone mujhe dekha aur kaha: Abu Huraira. Maine kaha: Main aapki pukaar par haazir hoon, Allah ke Rasool 1 Unhone kaha: Mere paas Ansar ke ilawa koi na aaye, is liye mujhe Ansar (hi) bulaao. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: To woh unke charon taraf ikattha hue. Quraish ne bhi apne buray logon aur apne (nichle darje ke) anuyaayiyon ko ikattha kiya, aur kaha: Hum inhe aage bhejte hain. Agar unhe kuch milta hai, to hum unke saath honge (ise baantne ke liye), aur agar koi durbhaagya unhe pahunchta hai, to hum jo bhi humse maanga jaaye, muaaviza denge. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Ansar se) kaha: Tum Quraish ke buray logon aur (nichle darje ke) anuyaayiyon ko dekhte ho. Aur unhone apne ek haath ko doosre par (maarkar) ishara kiya ki unhe qatal kar diya jaana chahiye aur kaha: Mujhse as-Safa mein milo. Phir hum aage baDhe (aur) agar hummein se koi chaahta ki koi khaas shakhs qatal kiya jaaye, use qatal kar diya jaata, aur koi bhi virodh nahi kar paata. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: Phir Abu Sufyan aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Quraish ka khoon bahut sasta ho gaya hai. Aaj se koi Quraish nahi hoga. Phir unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein daakhil hota hai, woh mahfooz hoga. Kuch Ansar ne aapas mein kaanaphusi ki: (Aakhirkaar), apne shehar ke liye muhabbat aur apne rishtedaaron ke prati narmi ne unhe abhibhoot kar liya hai. Abu Huraira ne kaha: (Is pal) Nabi (SAW) par wahi utri aur jab woh wahi paane wale hote, hum ise samajh jaate the, aur jab woh use (waaqai) paate, hummein se koi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf apni aankhein uthaane ki himmat nahi karta jab tak wahi khatm na ho jaaye. Jab wahi khatm hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Ansar ke giroh! Unhone kaha: Hum yahan hain aapki khidmat mein, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Tum keh rahe the ki apne shehar ke liye muhabbat aur apne logon ke prati narmi ne is aadmi ko abhibhoot kar liya hai. Unhone kaha: Haan, aisa hi tha. Unhone kaha: Nahi, kabhi nahi. Main Allah aur Uske Rasool ka banda hoon. Maine Allah ki taraf aur tumhari taraf hijrat ki. Main tumhare saath rahunga aur tumhare saath maroonga. To, woh (Ansar) aansuon mein unki taraf mude aur keh rahe the: Allah ki qasam, humne jo kaha woh Allah aur Uske Rasool ke prati apne dridh lagaav ki wajah se kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah aur Uske Rasool tumhare daave ki gawaahi dete hain aur tumhari maafi qubool karte hain. Raawi ne aage kaha: Log Abu Sufyan ke ghar ki taraf mude aur logon ne apne darwaze band kar liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage baDhe yahan tak ki woh (Kaale) Patthar ke qareeb pahunche. Unhone use chooma aur Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya. Woh Kaaba ke bagal mein ek but ke paas pahunche jiski log ibadat karte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein ek dhanush tha, aur woh use ek kone se pakDe hue the. Jab woh but ke qareeb aaye, unhone dhanush se uski aankhein bhedni shuru ki aur (aisa karte hue) keh rahe the: Sach qaim ho gaya hai aur jhoot khatm ho gaya hai. Jab unhone tawaaf khatm kiya, woh Safa aaye, uspar chaDhe itni oonchai tak jahan se woh Kaaba dekh sakte the, apne haath uthaaye (dua mein) aur Allah ki tareef karne lage aur jo woh chahte the dua ki.

e: The tradition has been narrated by a different chain of transmitters with the following additions: (i) Then be (the Messenger of Allah) said with his hands one upon the other: Kill them (who stand in your way).... (ii) They (the Ansar) replied: We said so, Messenger of Allah! He said: What is my name? I am but Allah's bondman and His Messenger.
hi: Riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye in izafon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: (i) Phir unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) apne haathon ko ek-doosre par (rakhkar) kaha: Unhe (jo tumhare raaste mein khade hain) qatal karo.... (ii) Unhone (Ansar ne) jawaab diya: Humne aisa kaha, Allah ke Rasool! Unhone kaha: Mera naam kya hai? Main sirf Allah ka banda aur Uska Rasool hoon.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Rabah who said: We came to Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan as a deputation and Abu Huraira was among us. Each of us would prepare food for his companions turn by turn for a day. (Accordingly) when it was my turn I said: Abu Huraira, it is my turn today. So they came to my place. The food was not yet ready, so I said to Abu Huraira: I wish you could narrate to us a tradition from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) until the food was ready. (Complying with my request) Abu Huraira said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca. He appointed Khalid b. Walid as commander of the right flank, Zubair as commander of the left flank, and Abu 'Ubaida as commander of the foot-soldiers (who were to advance) to the interior of the valley. He (then) said: Abu Huraira, call the Ansar to me. So I called out to them and they came hurriedly. He said: O ye Assembly of the Ansaar, do you see the ruffians of the Quraish? They said: Yes. He said: See, when you meet them tomorrow, wipe them out. He hinted at this with his hand, placing his right hand on his left and said: You will meet us at as-Safa'. (Abu Huraira continued): Whoever was seen by them that day was put to death. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ascended the mount of as-Safa'. The Ansar also came there and surrounded the mount. Then came Abu Sufyan and said: Messenger ot Allah, the Quraish have perished. No member of the Quraish tribe will survive this day. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who enters the house of Abu Safyin will be safe, who lays down arms will be safe, who locks his door will be safe. (some of) the Ansar said: (After all) the man has been swayed by tenderness towards his family and love for his city. At this, Divine inspiration descended upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: You were saying that the man has been swayed by tenderness towards his family and love for his city. Do you know what my name is? I am Muhammad, the bondman of God and His Messenger. (He repeated this thrice.) I left my native place for the take of Allah and joined you. So I will live with you and die with you. Now the Ansar said: By God, we said (that) only out of our greed for Allah and His Messenger. He said: Allah and His Apostle testify to you and accept your apology.
hi: Abdullah bin Rabah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ke paas ek numainda mandal ke soorat mein aaye aur Abu Huraira humme the. Hummein se har ek baari-baari se ek din apne saathiyon ke liye khaana taiyaar karta. (Uske mutabik) jab meri baari thi maine kaha: Abu Huraira, aaj meri baari hai. To woh mere yahan aaye. Khaana abhi taiyaar nahi tha, is liye maine Abu Huraira se kaha: Kaash aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek riwayat sunaate jab tak khaana taiyaar nahi hota. (Meri guzaarish maanke) Abu Huraira ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah ki Fatah ke din the. Unhone Khalid bin Walid ko daayi taraf ka sardaar muqarrar kiya, Zubair ko baayi taraf ka sardaar, aur Abu Ubaida ko paidal sipaahiyon ka sardaar (jinhe wadi ke andar ki taraf aage baDhna tha). Unhone (phir) kaha: Abu Huraira, Ansar ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe pukaara aur woh jaldi mein aaye. Unhone kaha: Aye Ansar ke giroh, kya tum Quraish ke buray logon ko dekhte ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Dekho, jab tum unse kal milo, unhe mita do. Unhone apne haath se ishara karte hue kaha, apna daaya haath apne baaye par rakhte hue, aur kaha: Tum humse as-Safa mein miloge. (Abu Huraira ne aage kaha): Us din jise bhi unhone dekha use maar diya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) as-Safa ke pahaad par chaDhe. Ansar bhi wahan aaye aur pahaad ko gher liya. Phir Abu Sufyan aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Quraish barbaad ho gaya hai. Quraish qabile ka koi sadasya aaj is din se nahi bachega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein daakhil hoga woh mahfooz hoga, jo hathiyaar rakh dega woh mahfooz hoga, jo apna darwaza band karega woh mahfooz hoga. Ansar mein se (kuch) ne kaha: (Aakhirkaar) us aadmi ko apne khaandaan ke prati narmi aur apne shehar ke liye muhabbat ne abhibhoot kar diya hai. Isper, Ilaahi targhib Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par utri. Unhone kaha: Tum keh rahe the ki us aadmi ko apne khaandaan ke prati narmi aur apne shehar ke liye muhabbat ne abhibhoot kar diya hai. Kya tumhe pata hai mera naam kya hai? Main Muhammad hoon, Allah ka aur Uske Rasool ka banda. (Unhone ye teen baar dohraaya.) Maine apni janambhoomi Allah ki khaatir chhoDi aur tumhare saath aa mila. Is liye main tumhare saath rahunga aur tumhare saath maroonga. Ab Ansar ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne (ye) sirf Allah aur Uske Rasool ke prati apne hirs ki wajah se kaha. Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool tumhari gawaahi dete hain aur tumhari maafi qubool karte hain.

e: It has been narrated by Ibn Abdullah who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca. There were three hundred and sixty idols around the Ka'ba. He began to thrust them with the stick that was in his hand saying:" Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Lo! falsehood was destined to vanish" (xvii. 8). Truth has arrived, and falsehood can neither create anything from the beginning nor can It restore to life
hi: Ibn Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue. Kaaba ke aas-paas teen sau saTh but the. Unhone unhe apne haath mein pakDi hui lakDi se hilaana shuru kiya ye kehte hue: "Sach aa gaya hai aur jhoot mit gaya hai. Dekho! Jhoot ko mitna hi tha" (17:81). Sach aa gaya hai, aur jhoot na to shuruaat se kuch bana sakta hai na zindagi ko wapas la sakta hai.

e: This tradition has been narrated by Ibn Abu Najah through a different chain of transmitters up to the word: Zahaqa, (This version) does not contain the second verse and substitutes Sanam for Nusub (both the words mean" idol" or" image" that is worshipped).
hi: Ye riwayat Ibn Abu Najah ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye lafz 'Zahaqa' tak riwayat ki hai. (Ye soorat) doosri aayat shaamil nahi karta aur 'Nusub' ki jagah 'Sanam' istemal karta hai (donon lafzon ka matlab hai "but" ya "pratima" jiski ibadat ki jaati hai).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Muti' who heard from his father and said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say on the day of the Conquest of Mecca: No Quraishite will be killed hound hand and foot from this day until the Day of judgment.
hi: Abdullah bin Muti ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne walid se suna aur kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Makkah ki Fatah ke din ye kehte suna: Aaj se Qayamat ke din tak koi bhi Quraishi haath-paon baandhkar qatal nahi kiya jaayega.

e: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Zakriyya through the same chain of transmitters with the following addition: " No rebellious Quraishite with al-Asi as his name embraced Islam that day except Muti. His name-was al-Asi, but the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) changed his name to Muti.
hi: Yehi riwayat Zakriyya ki sanad se isi sanad se in izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Us din al-Asi naam wale kisi bhi baaghi Quraishi ne Islam qubool nahi kiya siwaay Muti ke. Unka naam al-Asi tha, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka naam badalkar Muti kar diya."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib who said: 'Ali b. Abu Talib penned the treaty between the Prophet (ﷺ) and the polytheists on the Day of Hudaibiya. He wrote: This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has settled. They (the polytheists) said: Do not write words" the Messenger of Allah". If we knew that you were the Messenger of Allah, we would not fight against you. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali: Strike out these words. He (Ali) said: I am not going to strike them out. So the Prophet (ﷺ) struck them out with his own hand. The narrator said that the conditions upon which the two sides had agreed included that the Muslims would enter Mecca (next year) and would stay there for three days, and that they would not enter bearing arms except in their sheaths or bolsters.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi (SAW) aur mushrikeen ke beech ki sandhi Hudaibiya ke din likhi. Unhone likha: Ye woh hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne tay kiya hai. Unhone (mushrikeen ne) kaha: "Allah ke Rasool" alfaaz mat likho. Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhare khilaaf jung na karte. Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: In alfaazon ko mitao. Unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Main inhe nahi mitaunga. To Nabi (SAW) ne unhe apne khud ke haath se mitaya. Raawi ne kaha ki jin sharton par donon paksh sehmat hue unmein ye shaamil tha ki Musalman (agle saal) Makkah mein daakhil honge aur wahan teen din tak rahenge, aur ki woh apni talwaaron ke myaanon ke bagair aur oont ke pallang (bolster) ke bagair daakhil nahi honge.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq, who heard Bars' b. Azib say: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made peace with the people of Hudaibiya, 'Ali drew up the agreement between them, and so he wrote: Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah. (This is followed by the same wording as we have in the previous tradition except the omission of the words: This is what he has settled.)
hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Bars bin Azib ko ye kehte suna: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hudaibiya ke logon ke saath shaanti banaayi, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unke beech ka samjhauta likha, aur unhone likha: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool. (Iske baad wahi alfaaz hain jo pichhli hadees mein hain siwaay in alfaazon ko chhodne ke: Ye woh hai jo unhone tay kiya hai.)

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Bara' who said: When the Prophet (ﷺ) was checked from going to the Ka'ba, the people of Mecca made peace with him'on the condition that he would (be allowed to) enter Mecca (next year) and stay there for three days, that he would not enter (the city) except with swords in their sheaths and arms encased in their covers, that he would not take eway with him anyone from its dwellers, nor would he prevent anyone from those with him to stay on in Mecca (if he so desired). He said to 'Ali: Write down the terms settled between us. (So 'Ali wrote): In the name of Allah, most Gracious and most Merciful. This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has settled (with the Meccans), The polytheists said to him: If we knew that thou art the Messenger of of Allah, we would follow you. But write: Muhammad b. 'Abdullah. So he told 'Ali to strike out these words. 'Ali said: No, by Allah, I will not strike them out. The Messenger of Allah (may Peace be upon him) said: Show me their place (on the parchment). So he ('Ali) showed him their place and he (the Holy Prophet) struck them out; and 'Ali wrote: Ibn 'Abdullah. (According to the terms of the treaty, next year) the Prophet (ﷺ) stayed there for three days When it was the third day, they said to 'Ali: This is the last day according to the terms of your companion. So tell him to leave. 'Ali informed the Prophet (ﷺ) accordingly. He said: Yes, and left (the city). Ibn Janab in his version of the tradition used:" we would swear allegiance to you" instead of" we would follow you".
hi: Bara ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko Kaaba tak jaane se roka gaya, Makkah ke logon ne unse shaanti banaayi is shart par ki woh (agle saal) Makkah mein daakhil ho sakenge aur teen din tak rahenge, ki woh (shehar mein) tab tak daakhil nahi honge jab tak talwaaren myaanon mein aur hathiyaar apne khaanon mein na hon, ki woh apne saath uske kisi bhi vaasi ko nahi le jaayenge, na hi unhe apne saath waalon mein se kisi ko Makkah mein rehne se rokenge (agar woh chaahe). Unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Humare beech tay hui sharten likh do. (To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne likha): Allah ke naam par, Sabse Meherbaan, Sabse Rehmvaan. Ye woh hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne (Makkah ke logon ke saath) tay kiya hai. Mushrikeen ne unse kaha: Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhara anusaran karte. Lekin likho: Muhammad bin Abdullah. To unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se in alfaazon ko mitane ko kaha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main inhe nahi mitaunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe unki jagah dikhaao (chamde par). To unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) unhe unki jagah dikhaayi aur unhone (Nabi ne) unhe mitaya; aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne likha: Ibn Abdullah. (Sandhi ki sharton ke mutabik, agle saal) Nabi (SAW) wahan teen din rahe. Jab teesra din tha, unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Ye tumhare saathi ki sharton ke mutabik aakhri din hai. Is liye unhe jaane ko kaho. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi (SAW) ko iske mutabik bataaya. Unhone kaha: Haan, aur (shehar) chhoD diya. Ibn Janab ki riwayat mein "hum tumhara anusaran karte" ki jagah "hum tumse wafadaari ki qasam khaate" istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Quraish made peace with the Prophet (ﷺ). Among them was Suhail b. Amr. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali: Write" In the name of Allah, most Gracious and most Merciful." Suhail said: As for" Bismillah," we do not know what is meant by" Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" (In the name of Allah most Gracious and most Merciful). But write what we understand, i. e. Bi ismika allahumma (in thy name. O Allah). Then, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Write:" From Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah." They said: If we knew that thou welt the Messenger of Allah, we would follow you. Therefore, write your name and the name of your father. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Write" From Muhammad b. 'Abdullah." They laid the condition on the Prophet (ﷺ) that anyone who joined them from the Muslims, the Meccans would not return him, and anyone who joined you (the Muslims) from them, you would send him back to them. The Companions said: Messenger of Allah, should we write this? He said: Yes. One who goes away from us to join them-may Allah keep him away! and one who comes to join us from them (and is sent back) Allah will provide him relief and a way of escape.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath shaanti banaayi. Unmein Suhail bin Amr the. Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Likho "Allah ke naam par, Sabse Meherbaan, Sabse Rehmvaan." Suhail ne kaha: Jahan tak "Bismillah" ka sawal hai, humein nahi pata ki "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" (Allah ke naam par sabse meherbaan, sabse rehmvaan) ka kya matlab hai. Lekin woh likho jo hum samajhte hain, yaani Bi ismika allahumma (tere naam mein, Aye Allah). Phir, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Likho: "Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool ki taraf se." Unhone kaha: Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhara anusaran karte. Is liye, apna naam aur apne waalid ka naam likho. To Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Likho "Muhammad bin Abdullah ki taraf se." Unhone Nabi (SAW) par ye shart rakhi ki jo koi bhi Musalmaanon mein se unse mil jaaye, Makkah ke log use wapas nahi karenge, aur jo koi bhi unmein se tum (Musalmaanon) se mile, tum use unhe wapas bhej doge. Sahaba ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein ye likhna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan. Jo humse door jaakar unse mile - Allah use door rakhe! aur jo unse humse milne aata hai (aur wapas bhej diya jaata hai) Allah use rahat aur bachne ka raasta dega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Wa'il who said: Sahal b. Hunaif stood up on the Day of Siffin and said: O ye people, blame yourselves (for want of discretion) ; we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Hudaibiya. If we had thought it fit to fight, we could fight. This was in the truce between the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the polytheists. Umar b. Khattab came, approached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, aren't we fighting for truth and they for falsehood? He replied: By all means. He asked: Are not those killed from our side in Paradise and those killed. from their side in the Fire? He replied: Yes. He said: Then why should we put a blot upon our religion and return, while Allah has not decided the issue between them and ourselves? He said: Son of Khattab, I am the Messenger of Allah. Allah will never ruin me. (The narrator said): Umar went away, but he could not contain himself with rage. So he approached Abu Bakr and said: 'Abu Bakr, aren't we fighting for truth and they for falsehood? He replied: Yes. He asked: Aren't those killed from our side in Paradise and those killed from their side in the Fire? He replied: Why not? He (then) said: Why should we then disgrace our religion and return while God has not yet decided the issue between them and ourselves? Abu Bakr said: Son of Khattab, verily, he is the Messenger of Allah, and Allah will never ruin him. (The narrator continued): At this (a Sura of) the Qur'an (giving glad tidings of the victory) was revealed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He sent for Umar and made him read it. He asked: Is (this truce) a victory? He (the Messenger of Allah) replied: Yes. At this Umar was pleased, and returned.
hi: Abu Wa'il ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Sahal bin Hunaif Siffin ke din khade hue aur kaha: Aye logo, khud ko dosh do (vivek ki kami ke liye); hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiya ke din the. Agar humne jung karna theek samjha hota, to hum jung karte. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur mushrikeen ke beech ki sandhi mein tha. Umar bin Khattab aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum sach ke liye nahi ladh rahe aur woh jhoot ke liye? Unhone jawab diya: Bilkul. Unhone poocha: Kya humari taraf se maare gaye Jannat mein nahi hain aur unki taraf se maare gaye Aag mein? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Unhone kaha: To phir humein apne deen par dagh kyun lagaana chahiye aur wapas jaana chahiye, jabki Allah ne unke aur humare beech maamla tay nahi kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Khattab ke bete, main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Allah mujhe kabhi barbaad nahi karega. (Raawi ne kaha): Umar chale gaye, lekin woh apne aap ko gusse se sanbhal nahi paaye. To woh Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Abu Bakr, kya hum sach ke liye nahi ladh rahe aur woh jhoot ke liye? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Unhone poocha: Kya humari taraf se maare gaye Jannat mein nahi hain aur unki taraf se maare gaye Aag mein? Unhone jawab diya: Kyun nahi? Unhone (phir) kaha: To phir humein apne deen ko apmaanit kyun karna chahiye aur wapas jaana chahiye jabki Allah ne abhi tak unke aur humare beech maamla tay nahi kiya hai? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Khattab ke bete, yaqeenan, woh Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah unhe kabhi barbaad nahi karega. (Raawi ne jaari rakha): Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Quran (ki ek Surah, jeet ki khushkhabri sunaate hue) nazil hui. Unhone Umar ko bulaaya aur use unhe padha diya. Unhone poocha: Kya (ye samzhauta) ek jeet hai? Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) jawab diya: Haan. Isper Umar khush hue, aur wapas gaye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Shaqiq who said: I heard Sahl b. Hunaif say at Siffin: O ye people, find fault with your (own) discretion. By Allah, on the Day of Abu Jandal (i. e. the day of Hudaibiya), I thought to myself that, if I could, I would reverse the order of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (the terms of the truce being unpalatable). By Allah, we have never hung our swords on our shoulders in any situation whatsoever except when they made easy for us to realise the goal envisaged by us, but this battle of yours (seems to be an exception). Ibn Numair (in his version) did not mention the words:" In any situation whatsoever"
hi: Shaqiq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko Siffin mein ye kehte suna: Aye logo, apne (khud ke) vivek mein dosh dhoondho. Allah ki qasam, Abu Jandal ke din (yaani Hudaibiya ke din), maine socha ki, agar main kar paata, to main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ko palat deta (samjhauta ki sharton se santusht na hote hue). Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi bhi apni talwaaren apne kandhon par kisi bhi paristhiti mein nahi latkaayi siwaay jab unhone humare liye humare lakshya ko poora karna aasaan bana diya, lekin tumhari ye jung (ek apwaad lagti hai). Ibn Numair ne (apne soorat mein) ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: "Kisi bhi paristhiti mein."

e: The same tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of A'mash. This version contains the words: Ila amrin yofzi'una instead of Ila amrin na'rifuhu.
hi: Yehi riwayat A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Is soorat mein alfaaz hain: Ila amrin yofzi'una, 'Ila amrin na'rifuhu' ki jagah.

e: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Wa'il who said: I heard Sahl b. Hunaif say at Siffin: Blame (the hollowness) of your views about your religion. I thought to myself on the day of Abu Jandal that if I could turn down the order of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I would. The situation was so difficult that if we mended it at one place, it was rent at another.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Wa'il se hai jinhone kaha: Maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko Siffin mein ye kehte suna: Apne deen ke baare mein apne (khokhle) vichaaron ko dosh do. Maine Abu Jandal ke din socha ki agar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ko radd kar sakoon, to main aisa karta. Haalat itni mushkil thi ki agar humne ise ek jagah theek kiya, to woh doosri jagah phaT gayi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said: When they (Companions of the Holy Prophet) were overwhelmed with grief and distress on his return from Hudaibiya where he had slaughtered his sacrificial beasts (not being allowed to proceed to Mecca), the Qur'anic verse: Inna fatahna... laka fathan mobinan to fauzan 'aziman, was revealed to him. (At this) he said: On me has descended a verse that is dearer to me than the whole world.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab woh (Nabi ke sahaba) Hudaibiya se unki wapasi par dukh aur pareshaani se abhibhoot the, jahan unhone (Makkah jaane ki ijazat na milne par) apne qurbaani ke jaanwar zibah kiye the, Qurani aayat: Inna fatahna... laka fathan mobinan to fauzan 'aziman, unpar nazil hui. (Isper) unhone kaha: Mujhpar ek aisi aayat utri hai jo mujhe poori duniya se zyada aziz hai.

e: This tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Hudbaifa b. al-Yaman who said: Nothing prevented me from being present at! he Battle of Badr except this incident. I came out with my father Husail (to participate in the Battle), but we were caught by the disbelievers of Quraish. They said: (Do) you intend to go to Muhammad? We said: We do not intend to go to him, but we wish to go (back) to Medina. So they took from us a covenant in the name of God that we would turn back to Medina and would not fight on the side of Muhammad (ﷺ). So, we came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and related the incident to him. He said: Both, of you proceed (to Medina) ; we will fulfil the covenant made with them and seek God's help against them.
hi: Hudbaifa bin al-Yaman ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mujhe Badr ki jung mein maujood rehne se sirf is ghatna ne roka. Main apne waalid Husail ke saath nikla (jung mein hissa lene ke liye), lekin humein Quraish ke kaafiron ne pakad liya. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhara iraada Muhammad ke paas jaane ka hai? Humne kaha: Humara iraada unke paas jaane ka nahi hai, lekin hum (wapas) Madina jaana chahte hain. To unhone humse Allah ke naam par ek ehad liya ki hum Madina wapas jaayenge aur Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf se jung nahi karenge. To, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe ghatna sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Tum donon (Madina) aage baDho; hum unke saath kiya gaya ehad poora karenge aur unke khilaaf Allah ki madad chaahenge.

e: It has been narrated by Ibrahim al-Taimi on the authority of his father who said: We were sitting in the company of Hudhaifa. A man said: If I were in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I would have fought by his side and would have striven hard for his causes. Hudhaifa said: You might have done that, (but you should not make a flourish of your enthusiasm). I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the night of the Battle of Abzib and we were gripped by a violent wind and severe cold. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be him) said: Hark, the man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgment by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted). We all kept quiet and none of us responed to him. (Again) he said: Hark, a man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgment by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted). We kept quiet and none of us responded to him. He again said: Hark, a man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgtuent by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted) Then he said: Get up Hudhaifa, bring me the news of the enemy. When he called me by name I had no alternative but to get up. He said: Go and bring me information about the enemy, and do nothing that may provoke them against me. When I left him, I felt warm as if I were walking in a heated bath untill I reached them. I saw Abu Sufyan warming his back against fire I put an arrow in the middle of the bow. intending to shoot at him, when I recalled the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)" Do not provoke them against me." Had I shot at him, I would have hit him. But I returned and (felt warm as if) I were walking in a heated bath (hammam). Presenting myself before him, I gave him information about the enemy. When I had done so, I began to feel cold, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wrapped me in a blanket that he had in excess to his own requirement and with which he used to cover himself while saying his prayers. So I continued to sleep until it was morning. When it was morning he said: Get up, O heavy sleeper.
hi: Ibrahim al-Taimi ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Hum Hudhaifa ki sohbat mein baithe the. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Agar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke daur mein hota, to main unke pehlu mein larta aur unke maksad ke liye kaDi mehnat karta. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Aap aisa kar sakte the, (lekin aapko apne josh ka dikhaava nahi karna chahiye). Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Ahzab ki jung ki raat aur hum ek tez hawa aur sakht sardi mein phanse hue the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Suno, jo shakhs (jaasoosi karke) mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Hum sab khamosh rahe aur hummein se koi bhi jawaab nahi diya. (Dobara) unhone kaha: Suno, jo shakhs mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Hum khamosh rahe aur hummein se koi bhi jawaab nahi diya. Unhone phir kaha: Suno, jo shakhs mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Phir unhone kaha: Uth jao Hudhaifa, mujhe dushman ki khabar lao. Jab unhone mujhe naam se pukaara mere paas uth jaane ke ilawa koi ikhtiyar nahi tha. Unhone kaha: Jao aur mujhe dushman ke baare mein jaankaari lao, aur aisa kuch mat karo jo unhe mere khilaaf uksaaye. Jab main unse (Nabi se) alag hua, mujhe garmi mehsoos hui jaise main ek garam snaanghar mein chal raha hoon yahan tak ki main unke paas pahuncha. Maine dekha ki Abu Sufyan aag ke saamne apni peeth garam kar rahe hain. Maine dhanush ke beech mein ek teer rakha, unpar chalaane ke iraade se, jab mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz yaad aaye "Unhe mere khilaaf mat uksaao." Agar maine unpar teer chalaaya hota, to main unhe maar deta. Lekin main wapas gaya aur (mehsoos kiya jaise) main ek garam snaanghar (hammam) mein chal raha hoon. Unke saamne khud ko pesh karte hue, maine unhe dushman ke baare mein jaankaari di. Jab main aisa kar chuka, mujhe sardi mehsoos hone lagi, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kambal mein lapeta jo unki apni zaroorat se zyada tha aur jisse woh apni namaz ke daurane khud ko dhaakte the. To main tab tak sota raha jab tak subah nahi hui. Jab subah hui unhone kaha: Uth jao, Aye gehri neend mein sone wale.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that (when the enemy got the upper hand) on the day of the Battle of Uhud, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was left with only seven men from the ansar and two men from the Quraish. When the enemy advanced towards him and overwhelmed him, he said: Whoso turns them away from us will attain Paradise or will be my Companion in Paradise. A man from the Ansar came forward and fought (the enemy) until he was killed. The enemy advanced and overwhelmed him again and he repeated the words: Whoso turns them away, from us will attain Paradise or will be my Companion in Paradise. A man from the Arsar came forward and fought until he was killed. This state continued until the seven Ansar were killed (one after the other). Now, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his two Companions: We have not done justice to our Companions.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki (jab dushman haavi ho gaya) Uhud ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath sirf Ansar ke saat aadmi aur Quraish ke do aadmi reh gaye. Jab dushman unki taraf baDha aur unpar haavi hua, unhone kaha: Jo unhe humse door karega use Jannat milegi ya woh Jannat mein mera saathi hoga. Ansar mein se ek shakhs aage aaya aur (dushman se) lada yahan tak ki woh maara gaya. Dushman aage baDha aur unpar dobara haavi hua aur unhone dohraaya: Jo unhe humse door karega use Jannat milegi ya woh Jannat mein mera saathi hoga. Ansar mein se ek shakhs aage aaya aur lada yahan tak ki woh maara gaya. Ye haalat tab tak jaari rahi jab tak saatoon Ansar (ek ke baad ek) maare nahi gaye. Ab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne do saathiyon se kaha: Humne apne saathiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kiya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abd-ul-'Aziz b. Abu Hazim, who learnt from his father (Abu Hazim). The latter heard it from Sahl b. Sa'd who was asked about the injury which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got on the day of the Battle of Uhud. He said: The face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was injured, his front teeth were damaged and his helmet was crushed. Fatima, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), was washing the blood (from his head), and 'Ali b. Abu Talib was pouring water on it from a shield. When Fatima saw that the bleeding had increased on account of (pouring) water (on the wound), she took a piece of mat and burnt it until it was reduced to ashes. She put the ashes on the wound and the bleeding stopped.
hi: Abd-ul-Aziz bin Abu Hazim ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne walid (Abu Hazim) se seekha. Unhone (Abu Hazim ne) ise Sahl bin Sa'd se suna jinse Uhud ki jung ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko lagi chot ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra ghayal hua, unke agle daant tooTe, aur unka khod (helmet) kuchal gaya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, unke sar se khoon dho rahi thin, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ek dhaal se usper paani daal rahe the. Jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne dekha ki (ghaav par) paani daalne se khoon aur badh raha hai, unhone chataayi ka ek tukda liya aur use jalaaya yahan tak ki woh raakh mein badal gaya. Unhone raakh ghaav par lagaayi aur khoon behna band ho gaya.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Hazim who heard from Sahl b. Sa'd. The latter was asked about the injury of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: By God, I know the person who washed the wound of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who poured water on it and with what the wound was treated. Then Sahl narrated the same tradition as has been narrated by 'Abd al-'Azlz except that he added the words:" And his face was injured" and replaced the word" Hushimat" by" Kusirat" (i. e. it was broken).
hi: Abu Hazim ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Sahl bin Sa'd se suna. Unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki chot ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai us shakhs ka jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ghaav dhoya, jisne usper paani daala aur jisse ghaav ka ilaaj kiya gaya. Phir Sahl ne wahi hadees riwayat ki jo Abd al-Azlz ne riwayat ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone ye alfaaz izafa kiye: "Aur unka chehra ghayal hua tha," aur "Hushimat" lafz ki jagah "Kusirat" (yaani ye tooTa tha) lafz istemal kiya.

e: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd through a different chain of transmitters with a slight difference in the wording.
hi: Yehi riwayat Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had his front teeth damaged on the day of the Battle of Uhud, and got a wound on his head. He was wiping the blood (from his face) and was saying: How will these people attain salvation who have wounded their Prophet and broken his tooth while he called them towards God? At this time, God, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the Verse:" Thou hast no authority" (iii. 127).
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke agle daant Uhud ki jung ke din tooTe, aur unke sar par chot lagi. Woh apne (chehre se) khoon pochh rahe the aur keh rahe the: Ye log mukti kaise paayenge jinhone apne Nabi ko zakhmi kiya aur unka daant toDa jabki unhone unhe Allah ki taraf bulaaya? Isi waqt, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne aayat nazil ki: "Tumhe ismein koi ikhtiyar nahi hai" (3:127).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah who said: It appeared to me as if I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and heard him) relate the story of a Prophet who had been beaten by his people, was wiping the blood from his face and was saying. My Lord, forgive my people, for they do not know.
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mujhe aisa laga jaise maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha (aur unhe sunaa) ek Nabi ki kahani riwayat karte hue jinhe unke logon ne maara tha, aur woh apne chehre se khoon pochh rahe the aur keh rahe the: Mere Rab, mere logon ko maaf kar de, kyunki woh nahi jaante.

e: A version of the tradition with a slightly different wording has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
hi: Riwayat ka ek soorat alfaaz mein thoDe antar ke saath ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated by Hammam b. Munabbih who said: This is what has been related to us by Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (With this introduction) he narrated a number of traditions. One of these was that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Great is the wrath of Allah upon a people who have done this to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he was at that time pointing to his front teeth. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also said: Great is the wrath of Allah upon a person who has been killed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the way of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ye woh hai jo humein Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki. (Is bhoomika ke saath) unhone kayi riwayaten riwayat kin. Unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Bada hai Allah ka gussa un logon par jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aisa kiya, aur us waqt woh apne agle daant ki taraf ishara kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Bada hai Allah ka gussa us shakhs par jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki raah mein qatal kiya hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Mas'ud who said: While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was saying his prayer near the Ka'ba and Abu Jahl with his companions was sitting (near by), Abu Jahl said, referring to the she-camel that had been slaughtered the previous day: Who will rise to fetch the foetus of the she-camel of so and so, and place it between the shoulders of Muhammad when he goes down in prostration (a posture in prayer). The one most accursed among the people got up, brought the foetus and, when the Prophet (ﷺ) went down in prostration, placed it between his shoulders. Then they laughed at him and some of them leaned upon the others with laughter. And I stood looking. If I had the power, I would have thrown it away from the back of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) had bent down his head in prostration and did not raise it, until a man went (to his house) and informed (his daughter) Fatima, who was a young girl (at that time) (about this ugly incident). She came and removed (the filthy thing) from him. Then she turned towards them rebuking them (the mischief-mongers). When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, he invoked God's imprecations upon them in a loud voice. When he prayed, he prayed thrice, and when he asked for God's blessings, he asked thrice. Then he said thrice: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the Quraish. When they heard his voice, laughter vanished from them and they feared his malediction. Then he said: O God, it is for Thee to deal with Abu Jahl b. Hisham, 'Utba b. Rabi'a, Shaiba b. Rabi'a. Walid b. Uqba, Umayya b. Khalaf, Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait (and he mentioned the name of the seventh person. which I did not remember). By One Who sent Muhammad with truth, I saw (all) those he had named lying slain on the Day of Badr. Their dead bodies were dragged to be thrown into a pit near the battlefield. 
Abu Ishiq had said that the name of Walid b. 'Uqba has been wrongly mentioned in this tradition.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Kaaba ke qareeb apni namaz padh rahe the aur Abu Jahl apne saathiyon ke saath (qareeb) baitha tha, Abu Jahl ne, pichhle din zibah ki gayi oontni ka zikr karte hue, kaha: Kaun jaayega falan-falan ki oontni ka bhroon laane, aur use Muhammad ke kandhon ke beech rakhega jab woh sajde mein jaayenge (namaz ki ek mudra)? Logon mein sabse zyada shraapit shakhs uThA, bhroon laaya, aur jab Nabi (SAW) sajde mein gaye, use unke kandhon ke beech rakh diya. Phir woh unpar hanse aur unmein se kuch hansi mein ek-doosre par jhuk gaye. Aur main khada dekh raha tha. Agar mujhme taqat hoti, to main ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki peeth se hataa deta. Nabi (SAW) ne sajde mein apna sar jhukaaya rakha aur ise nahi uThAya, yahan tak ki ek shakhs gaya (apne ghar) aur (unki beti) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko soochit kiya, jo us waqt ek jawaan larki thin (is ghinauni ghatna ke baare mein). Woh aayin aur unhe (gandi cheez) unse hataayi. Phir woh unki (buraai karne walon ki) taraf mudi unhe daantne. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz khatm ki, unhone unke khilaaf Allah ki laanat buland aawaaz mein maangi. Jab unhone dua ki, unhone teen baar dua ki, aur jab unhone Allah ki barkatein maangi, unhone teen baar maangi. Phir unhone teen baar kaha: Aye Allah, Quraish ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Jab unhone unki aawaaz suni, unse hansi gaayab ho gayi aur woh unki laanat se Darne lage. Phir unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Walid bin Uqba, Umayya bin Khalaf, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait (aur unhone saatvein shakhs ka naam liya, jo mujhe yaad nahi raha) ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Us hasti ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sach ke saath bheja, maine (un sab) ko jinke naam unhone liye the, Badr ke din maare hue paDe dekha. Unki laashein maidaan-e-jung ke qareeb ek gadde mein phenkne ke liye kheenchi gayin. Abu Ishiq ne kaha tha ki Walid bin Uqba ka naam is hadees mein galat zikr kiya gaya hai.

e: It has been narrated by Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) who said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was lying postrate in prayer and around him were some people from the Quraish, 'Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait brought the foetus of a she-camel and threw it on the back of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He did not raise his head until Fatima arrived, removed it from his back and cured him who had done that (ugly act). He said: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the chiefs of the Quraish. Abu Jahl b. Hisham, 'Utba b. Rabi'a. Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait, Shaiba b. Rabi'a, Umayya b. Khalaf or Ubayy b. Khalaf (Shu'ba, one of the narrator of this tradition is in doubt about the exact person). I saw that all were slain in the Battle of Badr and their dead bodies were thrown into a well, except that of Umayya or Ubayy which was cut into pieces and was thrown into the well.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein sajde mein leTe the aur unke aas-paas Quraish ke kuch log the, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ek oontni ka bhroon laaye aur use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki peeth par phenka. Unhone apna sar nahi uThAya jab tak Fatima (Alayhas Salam) nahi aayin, unhone use unki peeth se hataaya aur jisne woh (ghinauna kaam) kiya use bura-bhala kaha. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Quraish ke sardaaron ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Umayya bin Khalaf ya Ubayy bin Khalaf (Shu'ba, is hadees ke raawiyon mein se ek, isme shak mein hain kaunse sahi shakhs). Maine dekha ki sab Badr ki jung mein maare gaye aur unki laashein ek kuen mein phenki gayin, siwaay Umayya ya Ubayy ke jise kaTkar tukdon mein kuen mein phenka gaya.

e: Abu Ishiq has narrated a similar tradition through a different chain of transmitters and has added: He (the Messenger of Allah) loved to repeat the supplication thrice. He was saying: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the Quraish (repeating these words thrice). And among the Quraish, he mentioned (the names of) al-Walid b. 'Utba and Umayya b. Khalaf. (The narrator says there is no doubt about the names of these persons but he has forgotten the name of the seventh man).
hi: Abu Ishiq ne isi jaisi ek riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki hai aur ye izafa kiya hai: Unhe (Allah ke Rasool ko) dua ko teen baar dohraana pasand tha. Woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, Quraish ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai (in alfaazon ko teen baar dohraate hue). Aur Quraish mein, unhone al-Walid bin Utba aur Umayya bin Khalaf ke (naam) zikr kiye. (Raawi kehte hain ki in logon ke naamon mein koi shak nahi hai lekin unhe saatvein shakhs ka naam yaad nahi raha.)

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his face towards the Ka'ba and invoked God's imprecations upon six men of the Quraish, amorig whom were Abu Jahl. Umayya b. Khalaf, Utba b. Rabi'a, Shaiba b. Rabi'a and 'Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait I swear by God that I saw them lying slain in the battlefield of Badr. It being a hot day, their complexion had changed (showing signs of decay).
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chehra Kaaba ki taraf moda aur Quraish ke chhe aadmiyon ke khilaaf Allah ki laanat maangi, jinmein Abu Jahl, Umayya bin Khalaf, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a aur Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait shaamil the. Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki maine unhe Badr ke maidaan-e-jung mein maare hue paDe dekha. Ye ek garam din tha, unka rang badal gaya tha (kshay ke chinh dikhaate hue).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of `A'isha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), who said to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him): Messenger of Allah, has there come upon you a day more terrible than the day of Uhud. He said: I have experienced from thy people and the hardest treatment I met from them was what I received from them on the day of `Aqaba. I betook myself to Ibn `Abd Yalil b. `Abd Kulal with the purpose of inviting him to Islam, but he did not respond to me as I desired. So I departed with signs of (deep) distress on my face. I did not recover until I reached Qarn al-Tha`alib. Where I raised my head, lo! near me was a cloud which had cast its shadow on me. I looked and lo! there was in it the angel Jibril who called out to me and said: God, the Honoured and Glorious, has heard what thy people have said to thee, and how they have reacted to thy call. And He has sent to thee the angel in charge of the mountains so that thou mayest order him what thou wishest (him to do) with regard to them. The angel in charge of the mountains (then) called out to me, greeted me and said: Muhammad, God has listened to what thy people have said to thee. I am the angel in charge of the mountains, and thy Lord has sent me to thee so that thou mayest order me what thou wishest. If thou wishest that I should bring together the two mountains that stand opposite to each other at the extremities of Mecca to crush them in between, (I would do that). But the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said to him: I rather hope that God will produce from their descendants such persons as will worship Allah, the One, and will not ascribe partners to Him.
hi: Aisha, Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aappar Uhud ke din se zyada bhayaanak koi din aaya hai. Unhone kaha: Maine tumhare logon se tajurba kiya, aur unse mila sabse kaThOr vyavahaar woh tha jo mujhe Aqaba ke din mila. Main Ibn Abd Yalil bin Abd Kulal ke paas gaya unhe Islam ka nimantran dene ke maqsad se, lekin unhone mujhe wo jawaab nahi diya jo maine chaaha tha. To main (gehre) dukh ke chinh apne chehre par liye chala gaya. Main tab tak theek nahi hua jab tak main Qarn al-Tha'alib nahi pahuncha. Jahan maine apna sar uThAya, dekho! Mere qareeb ek badal tha jisne mujhpar apni chhaaya daali thi. Maine dekha aur dekho! Usmein farishta Jibril the jinhone mujhe pukaara aur kaha: Allah, Sammanit aur Shaandaar, ne suna hai jo tumhare logon ne tumse kaha, aur unhone tumhare aahvaan ka kaisa jawaab diya. Aur Usne tumhe pahaadon ke prabhaari farishte ko bheja hai taaki tum unhe unke baare mein apni ichchha ke mutabik hukum de sako. Pahaadon ke prabhaari farishte ne (phir) mujhe pukaara, mujhe salaam kiya aur kaha: Muhammad, Allah ne suna hai jo tumhare logon ne tumse kaha. Main pahaadon ka prabhaari farishta hoon, aur tumhare Rab ne mujhe tumhare paas bheja hai taaki tum mujhe apni ichchha ke mutabik hukum de sako. Agar tum chahte ho ki main un do pahaadon ko jo Makkah ke conaron par ek-doosre ke saamne khade hain, ek saath laaun unhe beech mein kuchal ne ke liye, (main aisa karunga). Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Main balki ummeed rakhta hoon ki Allah unki aulaad se aise log paida karega jo Allah, jo Ek hai, ki ibadat karenge aur Usko koi shareek nahi maanenge.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jundub b. Sufyan who said: A finger of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wounded in one of the encounters He said: Thou art just a little finger which has bled, and what thou hast experienced is in the cause of Allah.
hi: Jundub bin Sufyan ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek ungli kisi ek muqaable mein zakhmi ho gayi. Unhone kaha: Tum bas ek choti ungli ho jo khoon behi hai, aur jo tumne tajurba kiya hai woh Allah ki raah mein hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a cave (or raid) when his finger was hurt.
hi: Aswad bin Qais ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek ghufa (ya hamle) mein the jab unki ungli zakhmi hui.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais who heard Jundub saying that Gabriel delayed his visit to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) The polytheists began to say that Muhammad has been forsaken. At this Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed: " Wa'dd hd wa'l-laili iza saja, ma wadda'ka Rabbuka wa' ma qala" .
hi: Aswad bin Qais ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Jundub ko ye kehte suna ki Jibril ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne mein deri ki. Mushrikeen kehne lage ki Muhammad ko chhoD diya gaya hai. Isper Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne nazil kiya: "Wa'dd hd wa'l-laili iza saja, ma wadda'ka Rabbuka wa' ma qala."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais who said: I heard Jundub b. Sufyan say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell ill and did not wake up for two or three nights (for prayers) A woman came to him and said: Muhammad, I hope that your satan has left you. I haven't seen him approach you for two or three nights. The narrator says: At this, Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed:" By the Glorious......"
hi: Aswad bin Qais ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Jundub bin Sufyan ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar paD gaye aur do ya teen raaton tak (namaz ke liye) nahi uThe. Ek aurat unke paas aayi aur kaha: Muhammad, mujhe ummeed hai ki tumhare shaitaan ne tumhe chhoD diya hai. Maine use tumhare paas do ya teen raaton se aate nahi dekha. Raawi kehte hain: Isper, Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne nazil kiya: "Shaandaar ki qasam......"

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aswad bin Qais ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Usama b. Zaid that the Prophet (ﷺ) rode a donkey. It had on it a saddle under which was a mattress made at Fadak (a place near Medina). Behind him he seated Usama. He was going to the street of Banu Harith al-Khazraj to inquire after the health of Sa'd b. Ubada This happened before the Battle of Badr. (He proceeded) until he passed by a mixed company of people in which were Muslims, polytheists, idol worshippers and the Jews and among them were 'Abdullah b. Ubayy and 'Abdullah b. Rawaha. When the dust raised by the hoofs of the animal spread over the company, 'Abdullah b. Ubayy covered his nose with his mantle and said: Do not scatter the dust over us (Not minding this remark), the Prophet (ﷺ) greeted them, stopped, got down from his animal, invited them to Allah, and recited to them the Qur'an. 'Abdullah b. Ubayy said: O man, if what you say is the truth, the best thing for you would be not to bother us with it in our assemblies. Get back to your place. Whoso comes to you from us, tell him (all) this. Abdullah b. Rawaha said: Come to us in our gatherings, for we love (to hear) it. The narrator says: (At this), the Muslims, the polytheists and the Jews began to rebuke one another until they were determined to come to blows. The Prophet (ﷺ) continued to pacify them. (When they were pacified), he rode his animal and came to Sa'd b. 'Ubida. He said: Sa'd, haven't you heard what Abu Hubab (meaning 'Abdullah b. Ubayy) has said? He has said so and so. Sa'd said: Messenger of Allah, forgive and pardon. God has granted you a sublime position, (but so far as he is concerned) the people of this settlement had-decided to make him their king by making him wear a crown and a turban (in token thereof), but God has circumvented this by the truth He has granted you. This has made him jealous and his jealousy (must have) prompted the behaviour that you have witnessed. So, the Prophet (may peace upon him) forgave him.
hi: Usama bin Zaid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ek gadhe par sawaar hue. Uspar ek zeen thi jiske neeche Fadak (Madina ke qareeb ek jagah) mein banaayi gayi ek gaddi thi. Unke peeche unhone Usama ko baithaya. Woh Banu Harith al-Khazraj ki gali ki taraf ja rahe the Sa'd bin Ubada ka haal poochne ke liye. Ye Badr ki jung se pehle hua tha. (Woh aage baDhe) yahan tak ki woh logon ke ek mile-jule giroh ke paas se guzre jismein Musalman, mushrikeen, but-parast aur Yahudi the aur unmein Abdullah bin Ubayy aur Abdullah bin Rawaha the.
