Jab jaanwar ke khuron se uThi dhool giroh par phaili, Abdullah bin Ubayy ne apni naak apne chogha se dhaanki aur kaha: Humpar dhool mat bikhero. (Is Tippni ko dhyaan mein na rakhte hue), Nabi (SAW) ne unhe salaam kiya, ruke, apne jaanwar se utre, unhe Allah ki taraf bulaaya, aur unhe Quran padha. Abdullah bin Ubayy ne kaha: Aye aadmi, agar jo tum kehte ho woh sach hai, to sabse achhi baat ye hogi ki tum humein isse humari mahfilon mein pareshaan na karo. Apni jagah wapas jaao. Jo bhi humme se tumhare paas aaye, use ye (sab) bataao. Abdullah bin Rawaha ne kaha: Hamare paas humari mahfilon mein aao, kyunki hum ise (sunna) pasand karte hain. Raawi kehte hain: (Isper), Musalman, mushrikeen aur Yahudi ek-doosre ko daantne lage yahan tak ki woh ladne ke iraade tak pahunch gaye. Nabi (SAW) unhe shaant karte rahe. (Jab woh shaant hue), woh apne jaanwar par sawaar hue aur Sa'd bin Ubida ke paas aaye. Unhone kaha: Sa'd, kya tumne suna nahi ki Abu Hubab (Abdullah bin Ubayy ka matlab) ne kya kaha hai? Unhone aisa aisa kaha. Sa'd ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maaf kijiye aur maafi kijiye. Allah ne aapko ek uchcha darja diya hai, (lekin jahan tak unka sawal hai) is basti ke log unhe apna raja banaane ka faisla kar chuke the use taaj aur pagdi pehnaakar (iske pratik ke soorat mein), lekin Allah ne ise sach se rok diya jo Usne aapko diya hai. Isne unhe jalan mein daal diya hai aur unki jalan ne (unke) vyavahaar ko uksaaya jiska aapne mushaahda kiya. To, Nabi (SAW) ne unhe maaf kiya.

e: A similar tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters by Ibn Shihab with the addition of the words: " Before Abdullah (b. Ubayy) became a Muslim."
hi: Isi jaisi ek riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Ibn Shihab ne is izafe ke saath riwayat ki hai: "Isse pehle ki Abdullah (bin Ubayy) Musalman bane."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that it was said to the Prophet (ﷺ): Would that you approached Abdullah b. Ubayy (to persuade him to accept Islam). The Prophet (ﷺ) (accordingly) went to him, riding a donkey, and (a party of) Muslims also went (with him). On the way they had to walk over a piece of land affected with salinity. When the Prophet (ﷺ) approached him, he said: Do not come near me. By Allah, the obnoxious smell of your donkey has offended me. (As a rejoinder to this remark), a man from the Ansar said: By God, the smell of the donkey of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is better than your smell. (At this), a man from the tribe of 'Abdullah got furious. Then people from both sides got furious and exchanged blows with sticks, hands and shoes. (The narrator says) that (after this scuffle) we learnt that (the Qur'anic verse):" It two parties of the Believers have a quarrel, make ye peace between them" (xlix. 9) was revealed about these fighting parties.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) se kaha gaya: Kaash aap Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas jaate (unhe Islam qubool karne ke liye raazi karne ke liye). Nabi (SAW) (uske mutabik) unke paas gaye, gadhe par sawaar hokar, aur (Musalmaanon ka ek giroh) bhi (unke saath) gaya. Raaste mein unhe khaariyat waali zameen ke ek tukde par chalna paDa. Jab Nabi (SAW) unke qareeb aaye, unhone kaha: Mere qareeb mat aao. Allah ki qasam, tumhare gadhe ki ghinauni gandh ne mujhe apmaanit kiya hai. (Is Tippni ke jawaab mein), Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke gadhe ki gandh tumhari gandh se behtar hai. (Isper), Abdullah ke qabile ka ek shakhs bahut gussa ho gaya. Phir dono taraf ke log gusse ho gaye aur laathiyon, haathon aur jootoon se maar-peeT ki. (Raawi kehte hain) ki (is jhaDap ke baad) humne seekha ki (Qurani aayat): "Agar do imaandaaron ke giroh mein jhagda hai, to tum unke beech shaanti karo" (49:9) in laDne wale girohon ke baare mein nazil hui.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (after the encounter at Badr): Who will ascertain for us what has happened to Abu Jahl? Ibn Mas'ud went (to gather this information). He found that the two sons of 'Afra' had struck him and he lay cold at the point of death. He caught him by his beard and said: Art thou Abu Jahl? He said: is there anybody superior to the person you have killed, or (he said) his people have killed him. Ibn Mas'ud says that, according to Abu Mijlaz, Abu Jahl said: Alas! a person other than a farmer would have killed me.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha (Badr ke muqaable ke baad): Kaun humare liye pata karega ki Abu Jahl ke saath kya hua? Ibn Mas'ud gaye (ye jaankaari ikattha karne). Unhone paaya ki Afra ke do beton ne unhe maara tha aur woh maut ke qareeb thanda paDe the. Unhone unki daaDhi pakadi aur kaha: Kya tum Abu Jahl ho? Unhone kaha: Kya us shakhs se badkar koi hai jise tumne qatal kiya, ya (unhone kaha) uske logon ne use qatal kiya? Ibn Mas'ud kehte hain ki, Abu Mijlaz ke mutabik, Abu Jahl ne kaha: Haaye afsos! Ek kisaan ke ilawa koi doosra shakhs mujhe maarta.

e: A similar tradition has been transmitted by a different chain of narrators, on the same authority with a slight difference In the wording.
hi: Isi jaisi ek riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye, usi raawi se, alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who will kill Ka'b b. Ashraf? He has maligned Allah, the Exalted, and His Messenger. Muhammad b. Maslama said: Messenger of Allah, do you wish that I should kill him? He said: Yes. He said: Permit me to talk (to him in the way I deem fit). He said: Talk (as you like). So, Muhammad b. Maslama came to Ka'b and talked to him, referred to the old friendship between them and said: This man (i. e. the Holy Prophet) has made up his mind to collect charity (from us) and this has put us to a great hardship. When be heard this, Ka'b said: By God, you will be put to more trouble by him. Muhammad b. Maslama said: No doubt, now we have become his followers and we do not like to forsake him until we see what turn his affairs will take. I want that you should give me a loan. He said: What will you mortgage? He said: What do you want? He said: Pledge me your women. He said: You are the most handsome of the Arabs; should we pledge our women to you? He said: Pledge me your children. He said: The son of one of us may abuse us saying that he was pledged for two wasqs of dates, but we can pledge you (cur) weapons. He said: All right. Then Muhammad b. Maslama promised that he would come to him with Harith, Abu 'Abs b. Jabr and Abbad b. Bishr. So they came and called upon him at night. He came down to them. Sufyan says that all the narrators except 'Amr have stated that his wife said: I hear a voice which sounds like the voice of murder. He said: It is only Muhammad b. Maslama and his foster-brother, Abu Na'ila. When a gentleman is called at night even it to be pierced with a spear, he should respond to the call. Muhammad said to his companions: As he comes down, I will extend my hands towards his head and when I hold him fast, you should do your job. So when he came down and he was holding his cloak under his arm, they said to him: We sense from you a very fine smell. He said: Yes, I have with me a mistress who is the most scented of the women of Arabia. He said: Allow me to smell (the scent on your head). He said: Yes, you may smell. So he caught it and smelt. Then he said: Allow me to do so (once again). He then held his head fast and said to his companions: Do your job. And they killed him.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kaun Ka'b bin Ashraf ko qatal karega? Usne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, aur Uske Rasool ke baare mein bura-bhala bola hai. Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aap chaahte hain ki main use qatal karun? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Mujhe (usse jaisa main munasib samjhun) baat karne ki ijazat dijiye. Unhone kaha: Baat karo (jaisa tum chaho). To, Muhammad bin Maslama Ka'b ke paas aaye aur unse baat ki, unke beech purani dosti ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Is aadmi (yaani Nabi-e-Paak) ne (humse) sadaqa ikattha karne ka mann bana liya hai aur isne humein bahut mushkil mein daal diya hai. Jab usne ye suna, Ka'b ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, use tumhe aur zyada mushkil mein daalega. Muhammad bin Maslama ne kaha: Koi shak nahi, ab hum unke anuyaayi ban chuke hain aur hum unhe tab tak chhoDna pasand nahi karte jab tak hum ye nahi dekhte ki unka maamla kya modh leta hai. Main chaahta hoon ki tum mujhe udhaar do. Unhone kaha: Tum kya bandhak rakhoge? Unhone kaha: Tum kya chaahte ho? Unhone kaha: Apni auraton ko bandhak rakho. Unhone kaha: Tum Arabon mein sabse sundar ho; kya hum apni auraton ko tumhare paas bandhak rakhein? Unhone kaha: Apne bachchon ko bandhak rakho. Unhone kaha: Humme se kisi ka beta humein bura-bhala kah sakta hai ye kehte hue ki use do wasq khajooron ke liye bandhak rakha gaya tha, lekin hum tumhe (hamare) hathiyaar bandhak rakh sakte hain. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. Phir Muhammad bin Maslama ne vaada kiya ki woh unke paas Harith, Abu Abs bin Jabr aur Abbad bin Bishr ke saath aayenge. To woh aaye aur raat ko unhe bulaaya. Woh unke paas neeche aaye. Sufyan kehte hain ki Amr ke ilawa sab raawiyon ne bataaya hai ki unki zauja ne kaha: Main ek aawaaz sun rahi hoon jo qatal ki aawaaz jaisi lagti hai. Unhone kaha: Ye sirf Muhammad bin Maslama aur unke doodh-bhai Abu Na'ila hain. Jab ek buzurg shakhs raat ko bulaaya jaata hai chahe use bharche se bhi bhedne ke liye ho, use pukaar ka jawaab dena chahiye. Muhammad ne apne saathiyon se kaha: Jaise woh neeche aayega, main apne haath unke sar ki taraf phailaunga aur jab main unhe mazbooti se pakDunga, tum apna kaam karo. To jab woh neeche aaye aur woh apna chogha apni baazu ke neeche dabaaye hue the, unhone unse kaha: Hum tumse ek bahut acchi khushboo mehsoos karte hain. Unhone kaha: Haan, mere paas ek premika hai jo Arabia ki khushboodaar auraton mein se ek hai. Unhone kaha: Mujhe (aapke sar ki khushboo) soonghne dijiye. Unhone kaha: Haan, tum soongh sakte ho. To unhone use pakDa aur soonghi. Phir unhone kaha: Mujhe (ek baar phir) aisa karne dijiye. Unhone phir unka sar mazbooti se pakDa aur apne saathiyon se kaha: Apna kaam karo. Aur unhone use qatal kiya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raided Khaibar. One morning we offered prayers in the darkness of early dawn (near Khaibar). Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mounted (his horse). Abu Talha mounted his and I mounted behind Abu Talha on the same horse. The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) rode through the streets of Khaibar and (I rode so close to him) that my knee touched the thigh of the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ). The wrapper got aside from his thigh, and I could see its whiteness. When he entered the town, he said: God is Great. Khaibar shall face destruction. When we descend in the city-square of a people, it is a bad day for them who have been warned (and have not taken heed). He said these words thrice. The people of the town had just come out from (their houses) to go about their jobs. They said (in surprise): Muhammad has come. We captured Khaibar by force.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar par chhaapa maara. Ek subah humne fajr ki namaz andhere mein padhi (Khaibar ke qareeb). Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghode par sawaar hue. Abu Talha apne (ghode) par sawaar hue aur main Abu Talha ke peeche usi ghode par sawaar hua. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) Khaibar ki galiyon se guzre (aur main unke itna qareeb sawaar tha) ki mera ghutna Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki jaangh ko chhoo gaya. Kapda unki jaangh se hat gaya, aur main uski safedi dekh sakta tha. Jab woh shehar mein daakhil hue, unhone kaha: Allah Buland Hai. Khaibar barbaadi ka saamna karega. Jab hum kisi qaum ke shehar ke chowk mein utarte hain, ye un logon ke liye ek bura din hota hai jinhe chetaavni di gayi hai (aur unhone dhyaan nahi diya). Unhone ye alfaaz teen baar kahe. Shehar ke log abhi-abhi (apne gharon se) bahar nikle the apna kaam karne. Unhone (hairat mein) kaha: Muhammad aa gaya hai. Humne Khaibar taqat se pakda.

e: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of the same narrator (i. e. Anas) who said: I was riding behind Abu Talha on the day of the Battle of Khaibar (and we were riding so close to the Prophet that) my foot would touch his We encountered the people at sunrise when they had come out with their axes, spades and strings driving their cattle along. They shouted (in surprise): Muhammad has come along with his force! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Khaibar shall face destruction. Behold! when we descend in the city-square of a people, it is a bad day for those who have been warned (but have not taken heed). Allah, the Glorious and Majestic, inflicted defeat upon them.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) usi raawi (yaani Anas) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Abu Talha ke peeche sawaar tha Khaibar ki jung ke din (aur hum Nabi ke itna qareeb sawaar the ki) mera paon unka chhoo raha tha. Hum logon se suraj nikalne par mile jab woh apni kulhaadiyon, khurpiyon aur rassiyon ke saath apne maweshi haankte hue bahar aaye the. Unhone (hairat mein) chillaaya: Muhammad apni fauj ke saath aa gaya hai! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Khaibar barbaadi ka saamna karega. Dekho! Jab hum kisi qaum ke shehar ke chowk mein utarte hain, ye un logon ke liye ek bura din hota hai jinhe chetaavni di gayi hai (lekin unhone dhyaan nahi diya). Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne unhe shikast di.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas b. Malik with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Salama b. al-Akwa' who said: We marched upon Khaibar with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We journeyed during the night. One of the people said to (my brother) 'Amir b. al-Akwa': Won't you recite to us some of your verses? Amir was a poet. So he began to chant his verses to urge the camels, reciting: 
O God, if Thou hadst not guided us 
We would have neither been guided rightly nor practised charity, 
Nor offered prayers. 
We wish to lay down our lives for Thee; so forgive Thou our lapses, 
And keep us steadfast when we encounter (our enemies). 
Bestow upon us peace and tranquillity. 
Behold, when with a cry they called upon us to help. 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who is this driver (of the camels)? They said: It is 'Amir. He said: God will show mercy to him. A man said: Martyrdom is reserved for him. Messenger of Allah, would that you had allowed us to benefit ourselves from his life. (The narrator says): We reached Khaibar and besieged them, and (we continued the siege) until extreme hunger afflicted us. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Behold, God has conquered it for you. When it was evening of the day on which the city was conquered. the Muslims lit many fires. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What are these fires? And what are they cooking? They said: They are cooking meat. He asked. Which meat? They said: That of domestic asses. He said: Let them throw it away and break the pots (in which it is being cooked). A man said: Or should they throw it away and wash the pots? He said: They may do that. When the people drew themselves up in battle array 'Amir caught hold of his sword that was rather short He drove a Jew before him to strike him with it. (As he struck him), his sword recoiled and struck his own knee, and 'Amir died of the wound. When the people returned (after the conquest of Kliaibar) and he (Salama) had caught hold of my hand, and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw that I was silent (and dejected) ; he said: What's the matter with thee? I said to him: My father and my mother be thy ransom, people presume that 'Amir's sacrifice has been in vain. He asked: Who has said that? I said: So and so and Usaid b. Hudair al-Ansari. He said: Who has said that has lied. For him (for 'Amir) there is a double reward. (He indicated this by putting two of his fingers together.) He was a devotee of God and a warrior fighting for His cause. There will be hardly any Arab who can fight as bravely as he did. Qutaiba has differed in a few words.
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar ki taraf march kiye. Hum raat ke daurane safar kar rahe the. Logon mein se ek ne (mere bhai) Amir bin al-Akwa se kaha: Kya tum humein apni kuch aayatein na sunaao? Amir ek kavi the. To unhone oonton ko uksaane ke liye apni aayatein gaani shuru ki, padhte hue: Aye Allah, agar Tune humein margdarshan na diya hota, hum na to sahi tarah maargdarshit hote na hi sadaqa dete, na hi namaz padhte. Hum apni jaan Tere liye qurbaan karna chahte hain; is liye humari galtiyaan maaf kar de, aur humein sthir rakh jab hum (apne dushmanon) ka saamna karein. Humein shaanti aur sukoon de. Dekho, jab woh chillaakar humein madad ke liye pukaarein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye (oonton ka) chalak kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Amir hai. Unhone kaha: Allah unpar rehmat karega. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Shahaadat unke liye taiyaar hai. Allah ke Rasool, kaash aapne humein unki zindagi se faayda uthane diya hota. (Raawi kehte hain): Hum Khaibar pahunche aur unhe gher liya, aur (humne ghera jaari rakha) yahan tak ki bhookh ne humein sata liya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho, Allah ne ise tumhare liye fatah kiya hai. Jab us din ki shaam thi jismein shehar fatah kiya gaya, Musalmaanon ne bahut si aagen jalaayin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaisi aagen hain? Aur woh kya pakaa rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Woh gosht pakaa rahe hain. Unhone poocha: Kaunsa gosht? Unhone kaha: Ghareloo gadhon ka. Unhone kaha: Unhe ise phenk dene do aur bartan toD do (jinmein ye pakaya ja raha hai). Ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya unhe ise phenkna chahiye aur bartan dhona chahiye? Unhone kaha: Woh aisa kar sakte hain. Jab log jung ki safon mein khade hue Amir ne apni talwaar pakdi jo kaafi choti thi. Unhone ek Yahudi ko apne aage haanka use isse maarne ke liye. (Jaise unhone use maara), unki talwaar palat gayi aur unke apne ghutne par lagi, aur Amir is zakhm se mar gaye. Jab log (Khaibar ki jeet ke baad) wapas aaye aur unhone (Salama ne) mera haath pakDa tha, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dekha ki main khamosh (aur udaas) tha; unhone kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine unse kaha: Mere maa-baap tumhare fidye hon, log samajhte hain ki Amir ki qurbaani bekaar gayi. Unhone poocha: Kisne aisa kaha? Maine kaha: Falan-falan aur Usaid bin Hudair al-Ansari. Unhone kaha: Jisne aisa kaha usne jhoot kaha. Unke (Amir ke) liye dugna sawaab hai. (Unhone apni do ungliyaan saath karke ishara kiya.) Woh Allah ke ek bandah the aur Uski raah mein larne wale ek mujahid the. Shaayad hi koi Arab hoga jo unki tarah bahaduri se lad sake. Qutaiba ne kuch alfaazon mein antar kiya hai.

e:
It has been reported on the authority of Salama b. Akwa' who said: On the day of the Battle of Khaibar my brother fought a fierce fight by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). His sword rebounded and killed him. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon hill) talked about his death and doubted (whether it was martyrdom). (They said): (He is) a man killed by his own weapon, and expressed doubt about his affair. Salama said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) returned from Khaibar, I said: Messenger of Allah, permit me that I may recite to you some rajaz verses. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) permitted him. 'Umar b. Khattab said: I know what you will recite. I recited: 
By God, if God had guided us not, 
We would hive neither been guided aright nor practised charity, 
Nor offered prayers. 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What you have said is true, 'I (continued): 
And descend on us peace and tranquillity 
And keep us steadfast if we encounter (with our enemies) 
And the polytheists have rebelled against us. 
When I finished my rajaz, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who composed these verses? I said: They were composed by my brother. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May God show mercy to him! I said: By God, some people are reluctant to invoke God's mercy on him (because) they say he is a man who died by his own sword. (Hearing this) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He died as God's devotee and warrior. Ibn Shihab has said: I asked one of the sons of Salama (b. Akwa') about (the death of 'Amir). He related to me a similar tradition except that he said: When I said some people were reluctant invoke God's blessings on him, the Messenger of Allah (may peace be, upon him said: They lied. ('Amir) died as God's devotee and warrior (in the cause of Allah). For him there is a double reward, and he pointed out this by putting his two fingers together.
hi: Salama bin Akwa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Khaibar ki jung ke din mere bhai ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke pehlu mein ek ghamasan jung ladi. Unki talwaar palat gayi aur unhe maar diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ne unki maut ke baare mein baat ki aur shak kiya (ki kya ye shahaadat thi). (Unhone kaha:) (Woh) ek aisa aadmi hain jo apne khud ke hathiyaar se maare gaye, aur unke maamle mein shak jataaya. Salama ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khaibar se wapas aaye, maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main aapko kuch rajaz aayatein padh kar sunaaun. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ijazat di. Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Mujhe pata hai tum kya padhoge. Maine padha: Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ne humein margdarshan na diya hota, hum na sahi tarah margdarshit hote na sadaqa dete, na hi namaz padhte. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo tumne kaha woh sach hai, main (jaari rakhkar): Aur humpar shaanti aur sukoon utaar Aur humein sthir rakh agar hum (apne dushmanon) ka saamna karein Aur mushrikeen humare khilaaf bagaavat kar chuke hain. Jab maine apna rajaz khatm kiya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisne ye aayatein banaayi? Maine kaha: Ye mere bhai ne banaayi thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah unpar rehmat dikhaaye! Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, kuch log unke liye Allah ki rehmat maangne mein hichkichaate hain (kyunki) woh kehte hain ki woh ek aisa aadmi hain jo apni khud ki talwaar se mar gaye. (Ye sunkar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh Allah ke bandah aur mujahid ke soorat mein mare. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine Salama (bin Akwa) ke beton mein se ek se (Amir ki maut ke baare mein) poocha. Unhone mujhe isi jaisi ek riwayat sunaayi siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: Jab maine kaha ki kuch log unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangne mein hichkichaate hain, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unhone jhoot kaha. (Amir) Allah ke bandah aur mujahid (Uski raah mein) ke soorat mein mare. Unke liye dugna sawaab hai, aur unhone apni do ungliyaan saath karke ishara kiya.

e:
It has been reported on the authority of Barra' who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was carrying the earth with us on the Day of Ahzab and the whiteness of his belly had been covered with earth. (While engaged in this toil) he was reciting: 
By God, if Thou hadst not guided us 
We would have neither been guided aright nor practised charity, 
Nor offered prayers. 
Descend on us peace and tranquillity. 
Behold I these people (the Meccans) refused to follow us. 
According to another version, he recited: 
The chieftains (of the tribes) refused to follow us 
When they contemplated mischief, we rejected it. 
And with this (verse) he would raise his voice.
hi: Barra ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ahzab ke din humare saath zameen le ja rahe the aur unke pet ki safedi mitti se dhak gayi thi. (Is mehnat mein lage hue) woh padh rahe the: Allah ki qasam, agar Tune humein margdarshan na diya hota Hum na sahi tarah margdarshit hote na sadaqa dete, Na namaz padhte. Humpar shaanti aur sukoon utaar. Dekho! Ye log (Makkah ke log) humara anusaran karne se inkaar kar chuke hain. Ek doosre soorat ke mutabik, unhone padha: Sardaaron (qabilon ke) ne humara anusaran karne se inkaar kiya Jab unhone shararat ka soch socha, humne use radd kar diya. Aur is (aayat) ke saath woh apni aawaaz buland karte.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq who said: I heard from Bara' a similar tradition except that he said:" These people (the Meccans) rebelled against us."
hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Bara se isi jaisi ek riwayat suni siwaay is baat ke ki unhone kaha: "Ye log (Makkah ke log) humare khilaaf bagaavat kar chuke hain."

e:
It has been reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us while we were digging the ditch and were carrying the earth on our shoulders. (Seeing our condition), he said: 
O God, there is no life but the life of the Hereafter. 
So forgive Thou the Muhajirs and the Ansar.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare paas aaye jab hum khaai khod rahe the aur apne kandhon par mitti Dho rahe the. (Humari haalat dekhkar), unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwaay koi zindagi nahi hai. Is liye Muhajirin aur Ansar ko maaf kar de.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O God, there is no life, but the life of the Hereafter, 
So forgive Thou the Ansar and the Muhajirs.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwaay koi zindagi nahi hai, Is liye Ansar aur Muhajirin ko maaf kar de.

e:
According to another version of the tradition, reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) is reported to have said: O God, there is no life but the life of the Hereafter, 
So grant honour to the Ansar and the Muhajirs.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi ek doosri hadees ke mutabik, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, Aakhirat ki zindagi ke siwaay koi zindagi nahi hai, Is liye Ansar aur Muhajirin ko izzat de.

e:
According to still another version of the tradition narrated by the same authority, and handed down through a different chain of transmitters, it has been reported that they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) were reciting rajaz verses and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was (reciting) with them. And they were chanting: O God, there is no good but the good of the Hereafter. 
So help Thou the Ansar and the Muhajirs. 
Shaiban substituted" So forgive Thou" for" So help Thou".
hi: Isi raawi se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi ek doosri hadees ke mutabik, ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki woh (Nabi ke sahaba) rajaz aayatein padh rahe the aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath (padh rahe the). Aur woh gaa rahe the: Aye Allah, Aakhirat ke bhale ke siwaay koi bhala nahi hai, Is liye Ansar aur Muhajirin ki madad kar. Shaiban ne "Is liye madad kar" ki jagah "Is liye maaf kar" istemal kiya.

e:
It has been narrated (through a still difterent chain of transmitters) by Anas that the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ) were chanting on the day of the Battle of the Ditch: We are those who have sworn allegiance to Muhammad 
(And made a covenant with him) to follow Islam as long as we live. 
Hammad is not sure whether Anas said:" Ala'l-Islam" or," Ala'l-Jihad". And the Prophet (ﷺ) was chanting: 
O God, the real good is the good of the Hereafter, 
So forgive Thou the Ansar and the Muhajirs.
hi: (Ek phir bhi doosri sanad ke zariye) Anas ne riwayat ki hai ki Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba khaai ki jung ke din gaa rahe the: Hum woh hain jinhone Muhammad se wafadaari ki qasam khayi hai (Aur unke saath ehad kiya hai) Islam ka anusaran karne ka jab tak hum jeevit hain. Hammad ko muayyan nahi hai ki Anas ne "Ala'l-Islam" kaha ya "Ala'l-Jihad". Aur Nabi (SAW) gaa rahe the: Aye Allah, asal bhalaai Aakhirat ki bhalaai hai, Is liye Ansar aur Muhajirin ko maaf kar de.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Abu 'Ubaid who said that he heard Salama b. al-Akwa' say: I went out before the Adhan for the morning prayer had been delivered. The milch she-camels of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were grazing at Dhu Qarad. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf's slave met me and said: The milch she-camels of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been taken away. I said: Who has taken them away? He said: (the people belonging to the tribe of) Ghatafan. I cried thrice: Help! I made the whole city between the two lavas hear my cry. Then I ran straight in their pursuit until I overtook them at Dhu Qarad where they were just going to water their animals. I, being an archer, began to shoot them with my arrows and was saying: I am the son of al-Akwa'. And today is the day when the cowards will meet their doom. I continued to chant until I rescued the milch she-camels from them, and snatched from them thirty mantles. Now, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and some other people came along. I said: Prophet of Allah, I have prevented them from water while they were thirsty. So you should send a force (to punish them). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ibn al-Akwa', you have taken (what, you have taken). Now let them go. Then we returned and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made me mount behind him on his she-camel until we entered Medina.
hi: Yazid bin Abu Ubaid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Salama bin al-Akwa ko ye kehte suna: Main subah ki namaz ke Azaan se pehle bahar nikla. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki doodh dene wali oontniyaan Dhu Qarad mein char rahi thin. Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ke ghulam mujhse mile aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki doodh dene wali oontniyaan le jaayi gayi hain. Maine kaha: Kisne unhe le liya? Unhone kaha: (Ghatafan qabile ke log). Maine teen baar chillaaya: Madad! Maine poore shehar ko do lava-zameenon ke beech apni pukaar sunayi. Phir main unka picha karne seedha daudta gaya yahan tak ki maine unhe Dhu Qarad mein pakad liya jahan woh apne jaanwaron ko paani dene hi wale the. Main, ek teerandaz hote hue, unhe apne teeron se maarne laga aur keh raha tha: Main al-Akwa ka beta hoon. Aur aaj woh din hai jab kayaron ko apna anjaam milega. Main gaana jaari rakha yahan tak ki maine unse doodh dene wali oontniyaan chhuDaayin, aur unse teen dus chogha chheene. Ab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur kuch doosre log aaye. Maine kaha: Allah ke Nabi, maine unhe paani se roka jabki woh pyaase the. Is liye aapko unhe saza dene ke liye ek toli bheji chahiye. Unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Ibn al-Akwa, tumne (jo liya woh) le liya. Ab unhe jaane do. Phir hum wapas gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apni oontni par apne peeche sawaar kiya yahan tak ki hum Madina mein daakhil huye.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Salama. He heard the tradition from his father who said: We arrived at Hudaibiya with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we were fourteen hundred in number. There were fifty goats for them which could not be watered (by the small quantity of water in the local well). So, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat on the brink of the well. Either he prayed or spat into the well The water welled up. We drank and watered (the beasts as well). Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called us to take the vow of allegiance, as he was sitting at the base of a tree. I was the first man to take the vow. Then other people took the vow. When half the number of people had done so, he said to me: You take the vow, Salama. I said: I was one of those who took the vow in the first instance. He said: (You may do) again. Then the Messenger. of Allah (ﷺ) saw that I was without weapons. He gave me a big or a small shield. Then he continued to administer vows to the people until it was the last batch of them. He said (to me): Won't you swear allegiance, Salama? I said: Messenger of Allah, I took the oath with the first batch of the people and then again when you were in the middle of the people. He said: (Doesn't matter), you may (do so) again. So I took the oath of allegiance thrice. Then he said to me: Salama, where is the shield which I gave to thee? I said: Messenger of Allah, my uncle 'Amir met me and he was without any weapons. So I gave the shield to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) laughed and said: You are like a person of the days gone by who said: O God. I seek a friend who is dearer to me than myself. (When all Companions had sworn allegiance to the Holy Prophet), the polytheists sent messages of peace, until people could move from our camp to that of the Meccans and vice versa. Finally, the peace treaty was concluded. 
I was a dependant of Talha b. Ubaidullah. I watered his horse, rubbed its back. I served Talha (doing odd jobs for him) and partook from his food. I had left my family and my property as an emigrant in the cause of Allah and His Messenger (may peace be uron him). When we and the people of Mecca had concluded a peace treaty and the people of one side began to mix with those of the other, I came to a tree, swept away its thorns and lay down (for rest) at its base; (while I lay there), four of the polytheists from the Meccans came to me and began to talk ill of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I got enraged with them and moved to another tree. They hung their weapons (to the branches of the tree) and lay down (for rest). (While they lay there), somebody from the lower part of the valley cried out: Run up, O Muhajirs! Ibn Zunaim has been murdered. I drew my sword and attacked these four while they were asleep. I seized their arms and collected them up in my hand, and said: By the Being Who has conferred honour upon Muhammad, none of you shall raise his head, else I will smite his face. (Then) I came driving them along to the Prophet (ﷺ). (At the same time). my uncle Amir came (to him) with a man from" Abalat called Mikraz. Amir was dragging him on a horse with a thick covering on its back along with seventy polytheists. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cast a glance at them and said: Let them go (so that) they may prove guilty of breach of trust more than once (before we take action against them). So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forgave them. On this occasion. God revealed the Qur'anic verse:" It is He Who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Mecca after He had granted you a victory over them" (xlviii. 24). Then we moved returning to Medina, and halted at a place where there was a mountain between us and Banu Lihyan who were polytheists. The Messenaer of Allah (ﷺ) asked God's forgiveness for one who ascended the mountain at night to act as a scout for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Compinions. I ascended (that mountain) twice or thrice that night. (At last) we reached Medina. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent his camels with his slave, Rabah, and I was with him. I (also) went to the pasture with the horse of Talha along with the camels. 
When the day dawned, Abd al-Rahman al-Fazari made a raid and drove away all the camels of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and killed the man who looked after them. I said: Rabah, ride this horse, take it to Talha b. 'Ubaidullah and Inform the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the polytheists have made away with his camels. Then I stood upon a hillock and turning my face to Medina, shouted thrice: Come to our help I Then I set out in pursuit of the raiders, shooting at them with arrows and chanting a (self-eulogatory) verse in the Iambic metre: 
I am the son of al-Akwa' 
And today is the day of defeat for the mean. 
I would overtake a man from them, shoot at him an arrow which, piercing through the saddle, would reach his shoulder. and I would say: Take it, chanting at the same time the verse 
And I am the son of al-Akwa' 
And tody is the day of defeat for the mean. 
By God, I continued shooting at them and hamstringing their animals. Whenever a horseman turned upon me, I would come to a tree and (hid myself) sitting at its base. Then I would shoot at him and hamstring his horse. (At last) they entered a narrow mountain gorge. I ascended that mountain and held them at bay throwing stones at them. I continued to chase them in this way until I got all the camels of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) released and no camel was left with them. They left me; then I followed them shooting at them (continually) until they dropped more than thirty mantles and thirty lances. lightening their burden. On everything they dropped, I put a mark with the help of (a piece of) stone so that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions might recognise them (that it was booty left by the enemy). (They went on) until They came to a narrow valley when so and so, son of Badr al-Fazari joined them. They (now) sat down to take their breakfast and I sat on the top of a tapering rock. Al-Fazari said: Who is that fellow I am seeing? They said: This fellow has harassed us. By God, he has not left us since dusk and has been (continually) shooting at us until he has snatched everything from our hands. He said: Four of you should make a dash at him (and kill him). (Accordingly), four of them ascended the mountain coming towards me. When it became possible for me to talk to them, I said: Do you recognise me? They said: No. Who are thou? I said: I am Salama, son of al-Akwa'. By the Being Who has honoured the countenance of Muhammad (ﷺ) I can kill any of you I like but none of you will be able to kill me. One of them said: I think (he is right). So they returned. I did not move from my place until I saw the horsemen of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who came riding through the trees. Lo! the foremost among them was Akhram al-Asadi. 
Behind him was Abu Qatada al-Ansari and behind him was al-Miqdad b. al-Aswad al-Kindi. I caught hold of the rein of Akhram's horse (Seeing this). they (the raiders) fled. I said (to Akhram): Akhram, guard yourself against them until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his Companions join you. He said: ) Salama, if you believe In Allah and the Day of Judgment and (if) you kaow that Paradise is a reality and Hell is a reality, you should not stand between me and martyrdom. so I let him go. Akhram and Abd al-Rahman (Fazari) met in combat. Akhram hamstrung Abd al-Rahman's horse and the latter struck him with his lance and killed him. Abd al-Rabman turned about riding Akhram's horse. Abu Qatada, a horse-man of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), met 'Abd al-Rahman (in combat), smote him with his lance and killed him. By the Being Who honoured the countenance of Muhammad (may peace oe upon him), I followed them running on my feet (so fast) that I couldn't see behind me the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ), nor any dust raised by their horses. (I followed them) until before sunset they reached a valley which had a spring of water, which was called Dhu Qarad, so that they could have a drink, for they were thirsty. They saw me running towards them. I turned them out of the valley before they could drink a drop of its water. They left the valley and ran down a slope. I ran (behind them), overtook a man from them, shot him with an arrow through the shoulder blade and said: Take this. I am the son of al-Akwa'; and today is the day of annihilation for the people who are mean. The fellow (who was wounded) said: May his mother weep over him! Are you the Akwa' who has been chasing us since morning? I said: Yes, O enemy of thyself, the same Akwa'. They left two horses dead tired on the hillock and I came dragging them along to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I met 'Amir who had with him a container having milk diluted with water and a container having water. I performed ablution with the water and drank the milk. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was at (the spring of) water from which I had driven them away. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had captured those camels and everything else I had captured and all the lances and mantles I had snatched from the polytheists and Bilal had slaughtered a she-camel from the camels I had seized from the people, and was roasting its liver and hump for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I said: Messenger of Allah, let me select from our people one hundred men and I will follow the marauders and I will finish them all so that nobody is left to convey the news (of their destruction to their people). (At these words of mine), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) laughed so much that his molar teeth could be seen in the light of the fire, and he said: Salama, do you think you can do this? I said: Yes, by the Being Who has honoured you. He said: Now they have reached the land of Ghatafan where they are being feted. (At this time) a man from the Ghatafan came along and said: So and so slaughtered a camel for them. When they were exposing its skin, they saw dust (being raised far off). They said: They (Akwa' and his companions) have come. So. they went away fleeing. 
When it was morning, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Our best horseman today is Abu Qatada and our best footman today is Salama. Then he gave me two shares of the booty-the share meant for the horseman and the share meant for the footman, and combined both of them for me. Intending to return to Medina, he made me mount behind him on his she-camel named al-Adba'. While we were travelling, a man from the Ansar who could not be beaten in a race said: Is there anyone who could compete (with me) in race to Medina? Is there any competitor? He continued repeating this. When I heard his talk, I said: Don't you show consideration to a dignified person and don't you have awe for a noble man? He said: No, unless he be the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I said: Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be thy ransom, let me get down so that I may beat this man (in the race). He said: It you wish, (you may). I said (to the man): I am coming to thee, I then turned my feet. sprang up and tan and gasped (for a while) when one or two elevated places were left and again followed his heel and again gasped (for a while) when one or two elevated places were left and again dashed until I joined him and gave a blow between his shoulders. I said: You have been overtaken, by God. He said: I think so. Thus, I reached Medina ahead of him. By God, we had stayed there only three nights when we set out to Khaibar with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (On the way) my uncle, Amir, began to recite the following rajaz verses for the people: 
By God, if Thou hadst not guided us aright, 
We would have neither practised charity nor offered prayers. 
(O God! ) We cannot do without Thy favours; 
Keep us steadfast when we encounter the enemy, 
And descend tranquillity upon us. 
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who is this? 'Amir said: it is 'Amir. He said: May thy God forgive thee! The narrator said: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked forgiveness for a particular person, he was sure to embrace martyrdom. Umar b. Khattab who was riding on his camel called out: Prophet of Allah, I wish you had allowed us to benefit from Amir. Salama continued: When we reached Khaibar, its king named Marhab advanced brandishing his sword and chanting: 
Khaibar knows that I am Marhab (who behaves like) 
A fully armed, and well-tried warrior. 
When the war comes spreading its flames. 
My uncle, Amir, came out to combat with him, saying: 
Khaibar certainly knows that I am 'Amir, 
A fully armed veteran who plunges into battles. 
They exchanged blows. Marbab's sword struck the shield of 'Amir who bent forward to attack his opponent from below, but his sword recoiled upon him and cut the main artery: in his forearm which caused his death. Salama said: I came out and heard some people among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: Amir's deed has been wasted; he has killed himself. So I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) weeping and I said: Messenger of Allah. Amir's deed has been wasted. The Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who passed this remark? I said: Some of your Companions. He said: He who has passed that remark has told a lie, for 'Amir there is a double reward. Then he sent me to 'Ali who had sore eyes, and said: I will give the banner to a man who loves Allah and His Messenger or whom Allah and His Messenger love. So I went to 'Ali, brought him beading him along and he had sore eyes, and I took him to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who applied his saliva to his eyes and he got well. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave him the banner (and 'Ali went to meet Marhab in a single combat). The latter advanced chanting: 
Khaibar knows certainly that I am Marhab, 
A fully armed and well-tried valorous warrior (hero) 
When war comes spreading its flames. 
'Ali chanted in reply: 
I am the one whose mother named him Haidar, (And am) like a lion of the forest with a terror-striking countenance. I give my opponents the measure of sandara in exchange for sa' (i. e. return thir attack with one that is much more fierce). 
The narrator said: 'Ali struck at the head of Mirhab and killed him, so the victory (capture of Khaibar) was due to him. This long tradition has also been handed down Through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Salama ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone apne walid se ye hadees suni jinhone kaha: Hum Hudaibiya pahunche Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aur hum chaudah sau the. Unke liye pachaas bakriyaan thin jinhe (mahalli kuen mein thoDe se paani se) paani nahi diya ja sakta tha. To, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuen ke kinare par baithe. Ya to unhone dua ki ya kuen mein thooka. Paani uThA. Humne piya aur (jaanwaron ko bhi) paani pilaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein wafadaari ki qasam lene ke liye bulaaya, jab woh ek darakht ke bunyad par baithe the. Main sabse pehla aadmi tha jisne qasam li. Phir doosre logon ne qasam li. Jab aadhe log aisa kar chuke, unhone mujhse kaha: Tum qasam lo, Salama. Maine kaha: Main un logon mein se ek tha jinhone pehli baar hi qasam li thi. Unhone kaha: (Tum kar sakte ho) dobara. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dekha ki main bina hathiyaar ke tha. Unhone mujhe ek badi ya choti dhaal di. Phir unhone logon se qasam lena jaari rakha yahan tak ki ye unka aakhri giroh tha. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: Kya tum wafadaari ki qasam nahi loge, Salama? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine logon ke pehle giroh ke saath qasam li thi aur phir dobara jab aap logon ke beech mein the. Unhone kaha: (Koi baat nahi), tum (aisa) dobara kar sakte ho. To maine teen baar wafadaari ki qasam li. Phir unhone mujhse kaha: Salama, woh dhaal kahan hai jo maine tumhe di thi? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere chacha Amir mujhse mile aur woh bina kisi hathiyaar ke the. To maine unhe dhaal de di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hanse aur kaha: Tum us guzre hue daur ke shakhs jaise ho jisne kaha: Aye Allah, main ek aisa dost dhoondhta hoon jo mujhe mere apne aap se zyada aziz ho. (Jab sab sahaba ne Nabi (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam li), mushrikeen ne shaanti ke payaam bheje, yahan tak ki log hamare camp se Makkah walon ke camp mein aa-jaa sakte the. Aakhirkaar, shaanti sandhi sampann hui. Main Talha bin Ubaidullah ka aashrit tha. Main unke ghode ko paani pilaata, uski peeth malta. Maine Talha ki khidmat ki (unke liye chhote-mote kaam karke) aur unke khaane mein hissa liya. Maine apna khaandaan aur apni maal hijrat karne wale ke soorat mein Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ki khaatir chhoDi thi. Jab humne aur Makkah ke logon ne shaanti sandhi sampann ki thi aur ek taraf ke log doosri taraf ke saath ghulne-milne lage, main ek darakht ke paas aaya, uske kaante hataaye aur uski jaD par (aaraam ke liye) leT gaya; (jab main wahan letaa tha), Makkah ke mushrikeen mein se chaar mere paas aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein burai baaten karne lage. Main unse gussa ho gaya aur ek doosre darakht ki taraf gaya. Unhone apne hathiyaar (darakht ki shaakhaon par) latka diye aur (aaraam ke liye) leT gaye. (Jab woh wahan leTe the), wadi ke neechle hisse se kisi ne chillaaya: Bhaago upar, Aye Muhajiro! Ibn Zunaim ka khoon ho gaya hai. Maine apni talwaar kheenchi aur in chaaron par hamla kiya jabki woh so rahe the. Maine unke hathiyaar pakDe aur unhe apne haath mein ikattha kiya, aur kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko izzat di, tum mein se koi apna sar nahi uThAyega, warna main uska chehra vikrit kar dunga. (Phir) main unhe haankte hue Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya. (Isi waqt), mere chacha Amir Abalat ke ek shakhs, Mikraz naam, ke saath aaye. Amir unhe ek ghode par kheench rahe the jismein uski peeth par ek moTi chaadar thi, sattar mushrikeen ke saath. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unpar ek nazar daali aur kaha: Unhe jaane do (taaki) woh ek se zyada baar bharosa-shikanaa ke dosi bane (isse pehle ki hum unke khilaaf karyavaahi karein). To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe maaf kiya. Is avasar par, Allah ne Qurani aayat nazil ki: "Woh Woh hai Jisne unke haath tumse aur tumhare haath unse Makkah ki wadi mein roke, iske baad Usne tumhe unpar jeet di" (48:24). Phir hum Madina ki taraf wapas jaate hue chale, aur ek jagah ruke jahan hamare aur Banu Lihyan ke beech ek pahaad tha, jo mushrikeen the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs ke liye Allah ki maafi maangi jo raat ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba ke liye jaasoos ka kaam karne pahaad par chaDha. Maine us raat use (us pahaad ko) do ya teen baar chaDhaa. (Aakhirkaar) hum Madina pahunche. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont apne ghulam Rabah ke saath bheje, aur main unke saath tha. Main (bhi) Talha ke ghode ke saath oonton ke saath charaagaah gaya. Jab din phoota, Abd al-Rahman al-Fazari ne chhaapa maara aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saare oont haank kar le gaye, aur us shakhs ko qatal kiya jo unki dekhbhaal kar raha tha. Maine kaha: Rabah, is ghode par sawaar ho, ise Talha bin Ubaidullah ke paas le jaao aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko soochit karo ki mushrikeen ne unke oont le liye hain. Phir main ek Tille par khada hua aur apna chehra Madina ki taraf karke teen baar chillaaya: Humari madad ko aao! Phir main hamlaawaron ka picha karne nikla, unpar teer chalaate hue aur ye (aatm-tareef ki) aayat gaate hue Iambic metre mein: Main al-Akwa ka beta hoon Aur aaj kayaron ke liye shikast ka din hai. Main unmein se ek aadmi ko pakad leta, use ek teer maarta jo, zeen ko chheedkarunke kandhe tak pahunch jaata, aur main kehta: Ise lo, saath mein ye aayat gaate hue Aur main al-Akwa ka beta hoon Aur aaj kayaron ke liye shikast ka din hai. Allah ki qasam, main unpar teer chalaana aur unke jaanwaron ke pairon ki nas kaatna jaari rakha. Jab bhi koi ghudsawaar mere upar muDta, main ek darakht ke paas jaata aur (chhipta) uski jaD par baithkar. Phir main unpar teer chalaata aur unke ghode ki nas kaatta. (Aakhirkaar) woh ek tang pahaadi darre mein daakhil hue. Main us pahaad par chaDha aur unhe patthar phenkkar rok liya. Main is tarah unka picha karta raha yahan tak ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saare oont chhuDaaye aur unke paas koi oont nahi bacha. Unhone mujhe chhoD diya; phir main unka picha karta raha unpar (lagataar) teer chalaate hue yahan tak ki unhone teis dus chogha aur teis dus barchhein giraayi, apna bojh halka karte hue. Har cheez jo unhone giraayi, maine ek patthar ki madad se ek nishaan lagaaya taaki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba use pehchaan sakein (ki ye dushman ke zariye chhoDaa gaya maal-e-ganimat hai). (Woh chalte gaye) yahan tak ki woh ek tang wadi mein pahunche jab falan-falan, Badr al-Fazari ka beta, unse mila. Woh (ab) apna naashta karne baithe aur main ek nukili chattaan ki chotti par baitha. Al-Fazari ne kaha: Ye kaunsa shakhs hai jise main dekh raha hoon? Unhone kaha: Is shakhs ne humein pareshaan kiya hai. Allah ki qasam, usne shaam se humein nahi chhoDa aur woh (lagataar) humpar teer chalaata raha yahan tak ki usne humare haathon se sab kuch cheen liya. Unhone kaha: Tum mein se chaar use daash den (aur use qatal kar den). (Uske mutabik), unmein se chaar mere paas aane pahaad par chaDhe. Jab main unse baat karne mein saksham hua, maine kaha: Kya tum mujhe pehchaante ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Tum kaun ho? Maine kaha: Main Salama hoon, al-Akwa ka beta. Us Hasti ki qasam jisne Muhammad (SAW) ke chehre ki izzat ki, main tum mein se jise chaahun qatal kar sakta hoon lekin tum mein se koi bhi mujhe qatal nahi kar payega. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai (woh sahi hai). To woh wapas gaye. Main apni jagah se nahi hila jab tak maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghudsawaaron ko nahi dekha, jo darakhton ke beech sawaar hokar aa rahe the. Dekho! Unmein sabse aage Akhram al-Asadi the. Unke peeche Abu Qatada al-Ansari the aur unke peeche al-Miqdad bin al-Aswad al-Kindi the. Maine Akhram ke ghode ki lagaam pakdi (Ye dekhkar), woh (hamlawaar) bhaage. Maine (Akhram se) kaha: Akhram, apne aap ko unse bachao jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba tumse nahi milte. Unhone kaha: Salama, agar tum Allah aur Qayamat ke din par imaan rakhte ho aur (agar) tum jaante ho ki Jannat sach hai aur Jahannam sach hai, tumhe mere aur shahaadat ke beech khada nahi hona chahiye. To maine unhe jaane diya. Akhram aur Abd al-Rahman (Fazari) muqaable mein mile. Akhram ne Abd al-Rahman ke ghode ki nas kaati aur unhone (baad wale ne) unhe apni barchhi se maara aur unhe qatal kar diya. Abd al-Rahman Akhram ka ghoda sawaar hokar mudi. Abu Qatada, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek ghudsawaar, Abd al-Rahman se (muqaable mein) mile, unhe apni barchhi se maara aur unhe qatal kar diya. Us Hasti ki qasam jisne Muhammad (SAW) ke chehre ki izzat ki, main unka picha karta raha apne pairon se daudte hue (itna tez) ki main apne peeche Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ko nahi dekh paaya, na hi unke ghodon ke zariye uThayi gayi koi dhool. (Maine unka picha kiya) yahan tak ki suraj dubne se pehle woh ek wadi tak pahunche jahan paani ka ek srot tha, jise Dhu Qarad kaha jaata tha, taaki woh paani pi sakein, kyunki woh pyaase the. Unhone mujhe unki taraf daudte dekha. Maine unhe wadi se bahar nikaala isse pehle ki woh iske paani ki ek boond bhi pi sakein. Unhone wadi chhoDi aur ek dhalaan neeche bhaage. Main (unke peeche) daudte hue unmein se ek aadmi ko pakad liya, use kandhe ki haddi ke seene se ek teer maara aur kaha: Ise lo. Main al-Akwa ka beta hoon; aur aaj kayaron ke logon ke liye tabaahi ka din hai. Us shakhs ne (jo zakhmi hua tha) kaha: Uski maa uspar roye! Kya tum al-Akwa ho jo subah se humara picha kar raha hai? Maine kaha: Haan, Aye khud ka dushman, wahi al-Akwa. Unhone Tille par do ghode bahut thake hue chhoDe aur main unhe haankte hue Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya. Main Amir se mila jinke paas paani mein milaya hua doodh ka aur paani ka ek bartan tha. Maine paani se wuzu kiya aur doodh piya. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh (paani ke) srot par the jahan se maine unhe (dushmanon ko) bhagaaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un oonton ko aur har us cheez ko jo maine pakDa tha pakad liya tha, aur woh sab barchhein aur chogha jo maine mushrikeen se chheene the, aur Bilal ne un oonton mein se ek oontni zibah ki thi jo maine logon se chheeni thi, aur uska jigar aur kohaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye seKk rahe the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humare logon mein se sau aadmi chun ne dijiye aur main lootenTakon ka picha karunga aur unhe khatam kar dunga taaki koi bhi (unki tabaahi ki) khabar unke logon tak pahunchaane ke liye na bache. (Mere in alfaazon par), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itne hanse ki unke daadhon ke daant aag ki roshni mein dikh gaye, aur unhone kaha: Salama, kya tumhe lagta hai tum ye kar sakte ho? Maine kaha: Haan, us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di. Unhone kaha: Ab woh Ghatafan ki zameen tak pahunch gaye hain jahan unka svaagat kiya ja raha hai. (Is waqt) Ghatafan se ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Falan-falan ne unke liye ek oont zibah kiya. Jab woh uski khaal khaal utaar rahe the, unhone dhool dekhi (door daura hui). Unhone kaha: Woh (Akwa aur unke saathi) aa gaye hain. To woh bhaagte hue chale gaye. Jab subah hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aaj humara sabse achha ghudsawaar Abu Qatada hai aur aaj humara sabse achha paidal Salama hai. Phir unhone mujhe maal-e-ganimat ke do hisse diye - ghudsawaar ke liye tay hissa aur paidal ke liye tay hissa, aur unhe mere liye jodkar diya. Madina wapas jaane ka iraada karte hue, unhone mujhe apni oontni al-Adba par apne peeche sawaar kiya. Jab hum safar kar rahe the, Ansar mein se ek shakhs jise dauD mein koi harra nahi sakta tha, ne kaha: Kya koi hai jo Madina tak dauD mein (mujhse) muqaabla kar sake? Kya koi pratispardhi hai? Woh isi baat ko dohraate rahe. Jab maine unki baat suni, maine kaha: Kya tum ek buzurg shakhs ka lihaaz nahi rakhte aur ek ijjatdaar aadmi ka izzat nahi karte? Unhone kaha: Nahi, siwaay iske ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hon. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere maa-baap aapke fidye hon, mujhe utarne dijiye taaki main is aadmi ko (dauD mein) haraau. Unhone kaha: Agar tum chaho, (tum kar sakte ho). Maine (us aadmi se) kaha: Main aa raha hoon, tumhari taraf. Phir maine apne pair mode, uchla aur daudaa aur haaphAta (kuch waqt ke liye) jab ek ya do oonchi jagahen chhoot gayin aur phir unki eDi ka picha kiya aur phir haaphAta (kuch waqt ke liye) jab ek ya do oonchi jagahen chhoot gayin aur phir daudaa yahan tak ki main unke saath ho gaya aur unke kandhon ke beech ek maar di. Maine kaha: Tum pakDe gaye ho, Allah ki qasam. Unhone kaha: Mujhe aisa hi lagta hai. Is tarah, main unse pehle Madina pahuncha. Allah ki qasam, hum wahan sirf teen raatein rahe the ki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar nikle. (Raaste mein) mere chacha, Amir, logon ke liye ye rajaz aayatein padhne lage: Allah ki qasam, agar Tune humein sahi margdarshan na diya hota, Hum na sadaqa dete na namaz padhte. (Aye Allah!) Hum Teri meherbani ke bina kuch nahi kar sakte; Humein sthir rakh jab hum dushman ka saamna karein, Aur humpar sukoon utaar. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaun hai? Amir ne kaha: Ye Amir hai. Unhone kaha: Tumhara Allah tumhe maaf kare! Raawi ne kaha: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kisi khaas shakhs ke liye maafi maangi, unhe shahaadat zaroor milti. Umar bin Khattab, jo apne oont par sawaar the, ne pukaara: Allah ke Nabi, kaash aapne humein Amir se faayda uthane diya hota. Salama ne jaari rakha: Jab hum Khaibar pahunche, uske raja jise Marhab kaha jaata tha aage baDhe apni talwaar lehraate hue aur gaate hue: Khaibar jaanta hai ki main Marhab hoon (jo vyavahaar karta hai) Ek poori tarah hathiyaarbandh, aur achhi tarah aazmaayi hui mujahid ki tarah. Jab jung apni jvaalaon ko failaate hue aati hai. Mere chacha, Amir, unke saath jung ke liye bahar aaye, ye kehte hue: Khaibar zaroor jaanta hai ki main Amir hoon, Ek poori tarah hathiyaarbandh anubhavi jo jungon mein kood padta hai. Unhone waar exchange kiye. Marhab ki talwaar Amir ki dhaal se takraayi jo apne saathi par neeche se hamla karne ke liye aage jhuke, lekin unki talwaar unhi par palti aur unki baazu ki badi rag kaat di jisne unki maut ka wajah bana. Salama ne kaha: Main bahar aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch logon ko ye kehte suna: Amir ka amal bekaar gaya hai; unhone khud ko qatal kiya hai. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas roate hue aaya aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool. Amir ka amal bekaar gaya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Tippni kisne ki? Maine kaha: Aapke kuch sahaba ne. Unhone kaha: Jisne ye Tippni ki usne jhoot bola, kyunki Amir ke liye dugna sawaab hai. Phir unhone mujhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas bheja jinki aankhein dukh rahi thin, aur kaha: Main jhanda ek aise aadmi ko dunga jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai ya jise Allah aur Uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain. To main Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas gaya, unhe le kar aaya, unhe raaste dikhaate hue kyunki unki aankhein dukh rahi thin, aur maine unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaya, jinhone apni lar unki aankhon par lagaayi aur woh theek ho gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe jhanda diya (aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) Marhab se ek-ek muqaable mein milne gaye). Baad wale aage baDhe gaate hue: Khaibar zaroor jaanta hai ki main Marhab hoon, Ek poori tarah hathiyaarbandh aur achhi tarah aazmaayi hui bahaadur mujahid (nayak) Jab jung apni jvaalaon ko failaate hue aati hai. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne jawaab mein gaaya: Main woh hoon jiski maa ne uska naam Haidar rakha, (Aur hoon) jangal ke sher jaisa jismein ek aatank paida karne wala mukhda hai. Main apne pratirodhiyon ko sandara ka nap deta hoon sa ke badle mein (yaani unke hamle ka jawaab ek aur zyada uggr hamle se deta hoon). Raawi ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Mirhab ke sar par vaar kiya aur unhe qatal kiya, is liye jeet (Khaibar ki fatah) unki wajah se hui. Ye lambi hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Ikrama b. Ammar.
hi: Ye hadees Ikrama bin Ammar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that eighty Persons from the inhabitants of Mecca swooped down upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from the mountain of Tan'im. They were armed and wanted to attack the Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions unawares. He (the Holy Prophet) captured them but spared their lives. So, God, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the verses: " It is He Who restrained your hands from them and their hands from you in the valley of Mecca after He had given you a victory over them."
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Makkah ke rehne walon mein se assi log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Tan'im ke pahaad se jhapat pade. Woh hathiyaarbandh the aur Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaba par bekhabar hamla karna chahte the. Unhone (Nabi ne) unhe pakda lekin unki jaanein bakhsh di. To, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne aayaten nazil ki: "Woh Woh hai jisne tumhare haath unse aur unke haath tumse Makkah ki wadi mein roke iske baad Usne tumhe unpar jeet di."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that, on the Day of Hunain. Umm Sulaim took out a dagger she had in her possession. Abiu Talha saw her and said: Messenger of Allah, this is Umm Sulaim. She is holding a dagger. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked (her): What for are you holding this dagger? She said: I took it up so that I may tear open the belly of a polytheist who comes near me. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to smile (at these words). She said: Messenger of Allah, kill all those people-other than us-whom thou hast declared to be free (on the day of the Conquest of Mecca). (They embraced Islam because) they were defeated at your hands (and as such their Islam is not dependable). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Umm Sulaim. God is sufficient (against the mischief of the polytheists) and He will be kind to us (so you need not carry this dagger).
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki, Hunain ke din, Umm Sulaim ne apne paas rakhi ek khanjar nikaali. Abu Talha ne unhe dekha aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye Umm Sulaim hai. Woh ek khanjar pakde hue hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) poocha: Ye khanjar aap kis liye pakde hue hain? Unhone kaha: Maine ise uThAya taaki main kisi mushrik ka pet chir sakoon jo mere qareeb aaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (in alfaazon par) muskuraane lage. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, un sab logon ko qatal karo - humare siwaay - jinhe aapne azaad ailaan kiya hai (Makkah ki Fatah ke din). (Unhone Islam qubool kiya kyunki) woh aapke haathon shikast khaa chuke the (aur is tarah unka Islam bharosemand nahi hai). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Umm Sulaim, Allah kaafi hai (mushrikeen ki shararat ke khilaaf) aur Woh humpar meherbaan hoga (is liye tumhe ye khanjar rakhne ki zaroorat nahi hai).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) allowed Umm Sulaim and some other women of the Ansar to accompany him when he went to war; they would give water (to the soldiers) and would treat the wounded.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Sulaim aur Ansar ki kuch doosri auraton ko jung mein jaate waqt apne saath jaane ki ijazat di; woh (sipaahiyon ko) paani deti thin aur zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karti thin.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said: On the Day of Uhud some of the people, being defeated, left the Prophet (ﷺ), but Abu Talha stood before him covering him with a shield. Abu Talha was a powerful archer who broke two or three bows that day. When a man would pass by carrying a quiver containing arrows, he would say: Spare them for Abu Talha. Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) raised his head to look at the people, Abu Talha would say: Prophet of Allah, may my father and my mother be thy ransom, do not raise your head lest you be struck by an arrow shot by the enemy. My neck is before your neck. The narrator said: I saw `A'isha bint Abu Bakr and Umm Sulaim. Both of them had tucked up their garments, so I could see the anklets on their feet. They were carrying water-skins on their backs and would pour water into the mouths of the people. They would then go back (to the well), would fill them again and would return to pour water into the mouths of the soldiers. (On this day), Abu Talha's sword dropped down from his hands twice or thrice because of drowsiness.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Uhud ke din kuch log, shikast khaakar, Nabi (SAW) ko chhoD gaye, lekin Abu Talha unke saamne unhe dhaal se dhaankte hue khade rahe. Abu Talha ek taakatvar teerandaaz the jinhone us din do ya teen dhanush toDe. Jab koi shakhs teeron se bhara tarkash lekar guzarta, woh kehte: Ise Abu Talha ke liye chhoDo. Jab bhi Nabi (SAW) logon ko dekhne ke liye apna sar uThAte, Abu Talha kehte: Nabi, mere maa-baap aapke fidye hon, apna sar mat uThAiye kahin dushman ke teer se aap ghayal na ho jaayein. Meri gardan aapki gardan ke aage hai. Raawi ne kaha: Maine Aisha bint Abu Bakr aur Umm Sulaim ko dekha. Donon ne apne kapde uThA rakhe the, is liye main unke pairon mein pahne kaDe dekh sakta tha. Woh apni peeth par paani ki thailiyaan le ja rahi thin aur logon ke munh mein paani daal rahi thin. Woh phir (kuen ki taraf) wapas jaatin, unhe dobara bhartin aur sipaahiyon ke munh mein paani daalne wapas aatin. (Is din), Abu Talha ki talwaar do ya teen baar unke haathon se gir gayi kyunki unhe neend aa rahi thi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Hurmuz that Najda wrote to Ibn Abbas inquiring of him five things. Ibn Abbas said: If I had not the fear of committing (sin) for concealing the knowledge I would not have written to him. Najda wrote to him saying (after praising the Almighty and invoking blessings on the Prophet): Tell me whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took women to participate with him in Jihad; (if he did), whether he allotted them a regular share from the booty; whether he killed the children of (the enemy in the war), how long an orphan would be entitled to consideration as such, and for whom the Khums (fifth part of the booty) was booty. Ibn Abbas wrote to him: You have written asking me whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took women with him to participate in Jihad. He did take them to the battle and sometimes he fought along with them. They would treat the wounded and were given a reward from the booty, but he did not assign any regular share for them. And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not kill the children of the enemy, so you should not kill the children. Also you have written to me asking me when the orphanhood of an orphan comes to an end. By my life, if a man has become bearded but is still incapable of getting his due from others or fulfilling his obligation towards them, (he is yet an orphan to be treated as such), but when he can look after his interests like grown-up people, he is no longer an orphan. And you have written to me inquiring about Khums as to whom it is meant for. (In this connection) we (the kinsmen of the Messenger of Allah) used to say: It is for us, but those people (i.e. Banu Umayya) have denied it to us.
hi: Yazid bin Hurmuz ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Najda ne Ibn Abbas ko likha unse paanch cheezein poochte hue. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Agar mujhe ilm chhupaane ka gunah karne ka dar na hota to main unhe nahi likhta. Najda ne unhe likhkar kaha (Allah ki tareef aur Nabi ke liye barkat maangne ke baad): Mujhe bataiye ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) auraton ko Jihad mein hissa lene ke liye apne saath le jaate the; (agar unhone aisa kiya), kya unhone unhe maal-e-ganimat mein se ek muqarrar hissa diya; kya unhone jung mein (dushman ke) bachchon ko qatal kiya, ek anaath kab tak anaath maana jaata hai, aur Khums (maal-e-ganimat ka paanchvaan hissa) kiske liye maal-e-ganimat tha. Ibn Abbas ne unhe likha: Tumne mujhse poocha hai ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) auraton ko Jihad mein hissa lene ke liye apne saath le jaate the. Unhone unhe jung mein le jaaya aur kabhi kabhi unke saath larte the. Woh zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karti thin aur unhe maal-e-ganimat se inaam diya jaata tha, lekin unhone unke liye koi muqarrar hissa tay nahi kiya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dushman ke bachchon ko qatal nahi kiya, is liye tumhe bachchon ko qatal nahi karna chahiye. Tumne mujhe ye bhi poocha hai ki ek anaath ki anaathata kab khatm hoti hai. Meri jaan ki qasam, agar koi aadmi daadhi wala ho gaya hai lekin abhi bhi doosron se apna haq lene ya unke prati apni zimmedaari poori karne mein asamarth hai, (woh abhi bhi ek anaath hai jise usi tarah maana jaana chahiye), lekin jab woh bade logon ki tarah apne hiton ka khyaal rakh sakta hai, woh ab anaath nahi hai. Aur tumne mujhse Khums ke baare mein poocha hai ki ye kiske liye hai. (Isi silsile mein) hum (Allah ke Rasool ke rishtedaar) kaha karte the: Ye humare liye hai, lekin un logon (yaani Banu Umayya) ne ise humein nakaara hai.

e: This tradition has been narrated by the game authority (Yazid b. Hurmus) through a different chain of transmitters with the following difference in the elucidation of one of the points raised by Najda in his letter to Ibn Abas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used not to kill the children, so thou shouldst not kill them unless you could know what Khadir had known about the child he killed, or you could distinguish between a child who would grow up to he a believer (and a child who would grow up to be a non-believer), so that you killed the (prospective) non-believer and left the (prospective) believer aside.
hi: Ye riwayat usi raawi (Yazid bin Hurmus) ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye is antar ke saath riwayat ki hai Najda ke Ibn Abas ko likhe gaye khat mein ek mudde ki spashteekaran mein: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bachchon ko qatal nahi karte the, is liye tumhe unhe qatal nahi karna chahiye jab tak tumhe woh na pata ho jo Khadir ko us bachche ke baare mein pata tha jise unhone qatal kiya tha, ya tum ek aise bachche ke beech antar kar sako jo ek imaandaar bankar bada hoga (aur ek bachche jo ek ghair-imaandaar bankar bada hoga), taaki tum us (bhaavi) ghair-imaandaar ko qatal karo aur (bhaavi) imaandaar ko alag chhoD do.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Hurmuz who said: Najda b. 'Amir al-Haruri wrote to Ibn Abbas asking him about the slave and the woman as to whether they would get a share from the booty (it they participated in Jihad) ; about the killing of (enemy) children (in war) ; about the orphan as to when his orphanhood comes to an end; about kinsmen (of the Holy Prophet) as to who they are. He said to Yazid: Write to him. (If he were not likely to fall into folly, I would not have written to him.) Write: You have written asking about the woman and the slave whether they would get a share of the booty if they participated in Jihad. (You should know that) there is nothing of the sort for them except that they will be given a prize. And you have written asking me about the killing of the enemy children in war. (You should understand that) the Messenger of Allah (may peare be upon him) did not kill them. and thou shouldst not kill them unless thou knew what the companion of Moses (i. e. Khadir) knew about the boy he had killed. And you have written asking me about the orphan as to when the period of his orphanhood comes to an end, so that the sobriquet of" orphan" is dropped from him. (In this regard, you should know that) the sobriquet" orphan" will not be dropped from him until he attains maturity of body and mind. And you have written asking me about the close relatives (of the Holy Prophet) as to who they are. We think that it is we, but our people have denied us this (position and its concomitant privileges).
hi: Yazid bin Hurmuz ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Najda bin Amir al-Haruri ne Ibn Abbas ko likha unse ghulam aur aurat ke baare mein poochte hue ki kya unhe maal-e-ganimat mein se hissa milega (agar woh Jihad mein hissa lete hain); jung mein (dushman ke) bachchon ko qatal karne ke baare mein; anaath ke baare mein ki uski anaathata kab khatm hoti hai; (Nabi-e-Paak ke) rishtedaaron ke baare mein ki woh kaun hain. Unhone Yazid se kaha: Unhe likho. (Agar unke moorkhata mein padne ki sambhaavna na hoti, to main unhe nahi likhta.) Likho: Tumne aurat aur ghulam ke baare mein poocha hai ki kya unhe maal-e-ganimat ka hissa milega agar woh Jihad mein hissa lein. (Tumhe pata hona chahiye ki) unke liye aisi koi cheez nahi hai siwaay iske ki unhe ek inaam diya jaayega. Aur tumne mujhse jung mein dushman ke bachchon ko qatal karne ke baare mein poocha hai. (Tumhe samajhna chahiye ki) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe qatal nahi kiya, aur tumhe bhi unhe qatal nahi karna chahiye jab tak tumhe woh na pata ho jo Musa ke saathi (yaani Khadir) ko us larke ke baare mein pata tha jise unhone qatal kiya tha. Aur tumne mujhse anaath ke baare mein poocha hai ki uski anaathata ki muddat kab khatm hoti hai, jisse "anaath" ka naam use se hat jaata hai. (Is baare mein, tumhe pata hona chahiye ki) "anaath" ka naam use se tab tak nahi hataya jaayega jab tak woh badan aur dimaag ki paripakvta na paa le. Aur tumne mujhse (Nabi-e-Paak ke) qareebi rishtedaaron ke baare mein poocha hai ki woh kaun hain. Humein lagta hai ki ye hum hain, lekin hamare logon ne humein ye (darja aur uske saathi haq) nakaara hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Hurmuz through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Hurmuz ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the anthority of Yazid b. Hurmuz who said: Najda wrote to Ibn Abbas. I was sitting in the company of Ibn 'Abbas when he read his letter and wrote its reply. Ibn Abbas said: Were it not for preventing him from falling into wickedness. I would not have replied to his letter, may he never be joyful. He wrote in reply to him referring to the share of the close relatives (of the Holy Prophet) (from the booty) whom God has mentioned. (I have to tell you that) we thought we were the close relatives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but our people have refused to recognise us as such. You have asked about the orphan as to when his orphanhood comes to an end. (I have to say that) when he reaches the age of marriage, attains maturity of mind, and his property is returned to him, then he is no longer an orphan. You have inquired whether the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upo him) used to kill anyone from the children of the polytheists in the war. (You should know that) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used not to kill any one of their children, and you (too) should not kill any one of them, except when you knew about them what Khadir had known about the boy whom he killed. And you have inquired whether there is a fixed share of the booty for women and slaves when they participate in a battle. (I have to tell you that) there is no fixed share for them except that they will be given some reward from the spoils of war.
hi: Yazid bin Hurmuz ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Najda ne Ibn Abbas ko likha. Main Ibn Abbas ki sohbat mein baitha tha jab unhone unka khat padha aur uska jawaab likha. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Agar unhe buraai mein padne se rokna na hota, main unke khat ka jawaab nahi deta, kaash woh kabhi khush na ho. Unhone unhe jawaab mein likha (Nabi-e-Paak ke) qareebi rishtedaaron ke hisse (maal-e-ganimat se) ka zikr karte hue jinka Allah ne zikr kiya hai. (Mujhe tumhe ye bataana hai ki) humein laga ki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qareebi rishtedaar hain, lekin hamare logon ne humein aisa maanne se inkaar kiya hai. Tumne poocha hai anaath ke baare mein ki uski anaathata kab khatm hoti hai. (Mujhe kehna hai ki) jab woh shaadi ki umar tak pahunchta hai, dimaag ki paripakvta paata hai, aur uski maal use wapas kar di jaati hai, to woh ab anaath nahi hai. Tumne poocha hai ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jung mein mushrikeen ke kisi bhi bachche ko qatal karte the. (Tumhe pata hona chahiye ki) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke kisi bhi bachche ko qatal nahi karte the, aur tumhe (bhi) unmein se kisi ko qatal nahi karna chahiye, siwaay tab jab tumhe unke baare mein woh pata ho jo Khadir ko us larke ke baare mein pata tha jise unhone qatal kiya. Aur tumne poocha hai ki kya jab auraten aur ghulam kisi jung mein hissa lete hain to unke liye maal-e-ganimat ka koi tay hissa hai. (Mujhe tumhe bataana hai ki) unke liye koi tay hissa nahi hai siwaay iske ki unhe jung ke maal-e-ganimat se kuch inaam diya jaayega.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yazid b. Hurmuz. but not complete (as we find in the above mentioned ahadith).
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Hurmuz ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin poori tarah nahi (jaise humein upar bataayi gayi hadeeson mein milta hai).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya, the Ansarite, who said: I took part with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in seven battles. I would stay behind in the camp of men, cook their food, treat the wounded and nurse the sick.
hi: Umm Atiyya, Ansar ki, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath saat jungon mein hissa liya. Main mardon ke camp mein peeche rahti, unka khaana pakaati, zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karti aur bimaaron ki dekhbhaal karti.

e: A similar tradition has been narrated on the authority of Hisham b. Hassan through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek riwayat Hisham bin Hassan ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq that 'Abdullah b. Yazid went (out of the city) with people for offering" Istisqa" ' prayer (for rainfall). He offered two rak'ahs. Then he prayed for rain. That day I met Zaid b. Arqam. There was only one man between me and him (at that time). I asked him: How many military expeditions did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) undertake? He said: Nineteen expeditions. I asked him: On how many expeditions did you accompany him? He said: On seventeen expeditions. I asked: Which was the first expedition he led? He answered: Dhat-ul-, Usair or 'Ushair.
hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Abdullah bin Yazid logon ke saath "Istisqa" ki namaz (baarish ke liye) padhne (shehar se bahar) gaye. Unhone do rakat padhi. Phir unhone baarish ke liye dua ki. Us din main Zaid bin Arqam se mila. Us waqt mere aur unke beech sirf ek aadmi tha. Maine unse poocha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kitni fauji muhimein cheDin? Unhone kaha: Unnees muhimein. Maine unse poocha: Aap kitni muhimon mein unke saath gaye? Unhone kaha: Satrah muhimon mein. Maine poocha: Unhone sabse pehle kaunsi muhim ka netritva kiya? Unhone jawaab diya: Dhat-ul-Usair ya Ushair.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Arqam that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fought nineteen battles and after the Migration performed only one Pilgrimage called Hajjat-ul-Wada'.
hi: Zaid bin Arqam ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unnees jungein lariin aur hijrat ke baad sirf ek Hajj kiya jise Hajjat-ul-Wada kaha jaata hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Zubair who heard Jabir b. `Abdullah say: I fought in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) nineteen battles.
