Jabir said: I did not participate in the Battle of Badr and the Battle of Uhud. My father prevented me (from participating in these battles as my age was tender). After `Abdullah (my father) was killed on the Day of Uhud, I never lagged behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and joined every battle (he fought).
hi: Abu Zubair ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein unnees jungon mein hissa liya. Jabir ne kaha: Maine Badr ki jung aur Uhud ki jung mein hissa nahi liya. Mere waalid ne mujhe (in jungon mein hissa lene se) roka (kyunki meri umar kam thi). Uhud ke din Abdullah (mere waalid) ke shaheed hone ke baad, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kabhi peeche nahi raha aur (unke ke zariye ladi) har jung mein shaamil hua.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Buraida (who heard the tradition from his father) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) conducted nineteen military campaigns and he (actually) fought in eight of them.
hi: Buraida (jinhone ye hadees apne walid se suni) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unnees fauji abhiyaan chalaaye aur woh (waaqai) unmein se aaTh mein lade.

e: It has been narrated by Buraida who heard it from his father that he joined the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in sixteen military campaigns
hi: Buraida ne apne walid se seekhi ye hadees ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke soLah fauji abhiyaanon mein hissa liya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Salama who said: I joined seven military expeditions led by the Messenger of Allah himself (ﷺ), and nine expeditions which he sent out once under Abu Bakr and once under Usama b. Zaid.
hi: Salama ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool khud (SAW) ke zariye netritvit saat fauji muhimon mein shaamil hua, aur nau muhimein jo unhone bheji, ek Abu Bakr ke adheen aur ek Usama bin Zaid ke adheen.

e: The (foregoing) tradition has also been narrated on the authority of Hatim through the same chain of transmitters with the difference that according to this version both these types of expeditions were seven in number.
hi: Upar wali riwayat Hatim ki sanad se isi sanad se is antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki is soorat ke mutabik in donon kism ki muhimein tadaad mein saat thin.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa (Ash'ari) who said: We set out on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We were six in number and had (with us) only one camel which we rode turn by turn Our feet were injured. My feet were so badly injured that my nails dropped off. We covered our feet with rags. so this expedition was called Dhat-ur-Riqa' (i. e. the expedition of rags) because we bandaged our feet with rags (on that day). Abu Burda said: Abu Musa narrated this tradition, and then disliked repeating it as he did not want to give any publicity to what he did in a noble cause Abu Usama said: Narrators other than Abu Buraida have added to the version of the words:" God will reward it."
hi: Abu Musa (Ash'ari) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par nikle. Hum chhe the aur hamare paas sirf ek oont tha jispar hum baari-baari se sawaar hote. Hamare paon ghayal ho gaye. Mere paon itni badi tarah ghayal hue ki mere naakhun tak gir gaye. Humne apne paon chithdon se dhaanke. Is liye is muhim ko Dhat-ur-Riqa (yaani chithdon ki muhim) kaha gaya kyunki humne apne paon chithdon se baandhe the (us din). Abu Burda ne kaha: Abu Musa ne ye riwayat sunaayi, aur phir ise dohraana napasand kiya kyunki woh apne ek nek kaam mein kiya gaya kaam prachaarit nahi karna chaahte the. Abu Usama ne kaha: Abu Buraida ke ilawa doosre raawiyon ne is alfaaz ka izafa kiya hai: "Allah ise sawaab dega."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of A'isha, wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out for Badr. When he reached Harrat-ul-Wabara (a place four miles from Medina) a man met him who was known for his valour and courage. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were pleased to see him. He said: I have come so that I may follow you and get a share from the booty. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Do you believe in Allah and His Apostle? He said: No. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Go back, I will not seek help from a Mushrik (polytheist). He went on until we reached Shajara, where the man met him again. He asked him the same question again and the man gave him the same answer. He said: Go back. Im will not seek help from a Mushrik. The man returned and overtook him at Baida'? He asked him as he had asked previously: Do you believe in Allah and His Apostle? The man said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Then come along with us.
hi: Aisha, Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Badr ke liye nikle. Jab woh Harrat-ul-Wabara (Madina se chaar meel doori par ek jagah) pahunche unse ek shakhs mila jo apni bahaduri aur himmat ke liye jaana jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba use dekhkar khush hue. Unhone kaha: Main is liye aaya hoon ki main aapka anusaran karoon aur maal-e-ganimat mein se hissa paaun. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kya tum Allah aur Uske Rasool par imaan rakhte ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Wapas jao, main kisi Mushrik se madad nahi maangunga. Woh chalte rahe yahan tak ki hum Shajara pahunche, jahan woh shakhs unse dobara mila. Unhone unse wahi sawaal poocha aur us shakhs ne wahi jawaab diya. Unhone kaha: Wapas jao. Main kisi Mushrik se madad nahi maangunga. Woh shakhs wapas gaya aur unse Baida mein mila. Unhone usse jaise pehle poocha tha waisa hi poocha: Kya tum Allah aur Uske Rasool par imaan rakhte ho? Us shakhs ne kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: To humare saath aao.

e: It has been narrarted on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: People are subservient to the Quraish: the Muslims among them being subservient to the Muslims among them, and the disbelievers among the people being subservient to the disbelievers among them.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Log Quraish ke adheen hain: unmein se Musalman Musalmaanon ke adheen hain, aur logon mein se kaafir kaafiron ke adheen hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hammam b. Munabbih who said: This is one of the traditions narrated by Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who said: People are subservient to the Quraish: the Muslims among them being subservient to the Muslims among them, and the disbelievers among them being subservient to the disbelievers among them.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ye un riwayaton mein se ek hai jo Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Log Quraish ke adheen hain: unmein se Musalman Musalmaanon ke adheen hain, aur unmein se kaafir kaafiron ke adheen hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: People are the followers of Quraish in good as well as evil (i. e. in the customs of Islamic as well as pre-Islamic times).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Log Quraish ke anuyaayi hain achhaai aur burai dono mein (yaani Islami aur pre-Islami daur ke riwaajon mein).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Caliphate will remain among the Quraish even if only two persons are left (on the earth),
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Khilafat Quraish mein hi rahegi chahe sirf do log (zameen par) bache hon.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura who said: I joined the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) with my father and I heard him say: This Caliphate will not end until there have been twelve Caliphs among them. The narrator said: Then he (the Holy Prophet) said something that I could not follow. I said to my father: What did he say? He said: He has said: All of them will be from the Quraish.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein apne waalid ke saath shaamil hua aur maine unhe ye kehte suna: Ye Khilafat tab tak khatam nahi hogi jab tak inmein se baarah Khalifa na ho chuke hon. Raawi ne kaha: Phir unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kuch aisa kaha jo main samajh nahi paaya. Maine apne waalid se kaha: Unhone kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Unhone kaha: Woh sab Quraish se honge.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Jabir b. Samura who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The affairs of the people will continue to be conducted (well) as long as they are governed by twelve men. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said words which were obscure to me. I asked my father: What did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say? He said: All of the (twelve men) will be from the Quraish.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Logon ke maamle tab tak (achhi tarah) chalte rahenge jab tak baarah aadmiyon ka unpar shaasan rahega. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne aise alfaaz kahe jo mujhe aspashth lage. Maine apne waalid se poocha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Unhone kaha ki un (baarah aadmiyon) mein se sab Quraish se honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Samura ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Islam will continue to be triumphant until there have been twelve Caliphs. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said something which I could not understand. I asked my father: What did he say? He said: He has said that all of them (twelve Caliphs) will be from the Quraish.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Islam tab tak jeetta hua chalta rahega jab tak baarah Khalifa na ho chuke hon. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne kuch kaha jo main samajh nahi paaya. Maine apne waalid se poocha: Unhone kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Unhone kaha ki un sab (baarah Khalifa) mein se sab Quraish se honge.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: This order will continue to be dominant until there have been twelve Caliphs. The narrator says: Then he said something which I could not understand, and I said to my father: What did he say? My father told me that he said that all of them (Caliphs) would be from the Quraish.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ye hukum tab tak prabhaavshaali rahega jab tak baarah Khalifa na ho chuke hon. Raawi kehte hain: Phir unhone kuch kaha jo main samajh nahi paaya, aur maine apne waalid se kaha: Unhone kya kaha? Mere waalid ne mujhe bataya ki unhone kaha ki woh sab (Khalifa) Quraish se honge.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Jabir b. Samura who said: I went with my father to the Messenger of Allah (may peeace be upon him) and I heard him say: This religion would continue to remain powerful and dominant until there have been twelve Caliphs. Then he added something which I couldn't catch on account of the noise of the people. I asked my father: What did he say? My father said: He has said that all of them will be from the Quraish.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main apne waalid ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur maine unhe ye kehte suna: Ye deen tab tak taakatvar aur prabhaavshaali rehna jaari rakhega jab tak baarah Khalifa na ho chuke hon. Phir unhone kuch aur kaha jo main logon ke shor ki wajah se pakad nahi paaya. Maine apne waalid se poocha: Unhone kya kaha? Mere waalid ne kaha: Unhone kaha ki woh sab Quraish se honge.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas who said: I wrote (a letter) to Jabir b. Samura and sent it to him through my servant Nafi', asking him to inform me of something he had heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He wrote to me (in reply): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say on Friday evening, the day on which al-Aslami was stoned to death (for committing adultery): The Islamic religion will continue until the Hour has been established, or you have been ruled over by twelve Caliphs, all of them being from the Quraish. also heard him say: A small force of the Muslims will capture the white palace, the police of the Persian Emperor or his descendants. I also heard him say: Before the Day of Judgment there will appear (a number of) impostors. You are to guard against them. I also heard him say: When God grants wealth to any one of you, he should first spend it on himself and his family (and then give it in charity to the poor). I heard him (also) say: I will be your forerunner at the Cistern (expecting your arrival).
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Jabir bin Samura ko (ek khat) likha aur ise apne ghulam Nafi ke zariye unhe bheja, unse guzaarish karte hue ki woh mujhe koi baat bataayen jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni ho. Unhone mujhe jawaab mein likha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko juma ki shaam ye kehte suna, us din jab al-Aslami ko sangsaar karke maara gaya tha (zina karne ke liye): Islami deen tab tak jaari rahega jab tak Qayamat sthapit na ho jaaye, ya tumpar baarah Khalifa ka shaasan na ho chuka ho, sab Quraish se. Maine unhe ye bhi kehte suna: Musalmaanon ka ek chhota dal safed mahal, Persia ke samraat ki (fauj) ya unke vanshaj ko pakad lega. Maine unhe ye bhi kehte suna: Qayamat ke din se pehle (kai) dhoke baaz pragat honge. Tumhe unse bachna chahiye. Maine unhe ye bhi kehte suna: Jab Allah tum mein se kisi ko daulat deta hai, use pehle apne aur apne khaandaan par kharch karna chahiye (aur phir gareebon ko sadaqe mein dena chahiye). Maine unhe (ye bhi) kehte suna: Main Haud (Kauthar) par tumhaara agrasar hunga (tumhare aane ka intezaar karte hue).

e: Ibn Samura al-'Adawi reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say, and he then narrated (the above-mentioned hadith).
hi: Ibn Samura al-Adawi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, aur phir unhone (upar bataayi gayi) hadees riwayat ki.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar who said: I was present with my father when he was wounded. People praised him and said: May God give you a noble recompense! He said: I am hopeful (of God's mercy) as well as afraid (of His wrath) People said: Appoint anyone as your successor. He said: Should I carry the burden of conducting your affairs in my life as well as in my death? (So far as Caliphate is concerned) I wish I could acquit myself (before the Almighty) in a way that there is neither anything to my credit nor anything to my discredit. If I would appoint my successor, (I would because) one better than me did so. (He meant Abu Bakr.) If I would leave You alone, (I would do so because) one better than me, i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), did so. 'Abdullah says: When he mentioned the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) I understood that he would not appoint anyone as Caliph.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main apne waalid ke saath tha jab woh zakhmi hue. Logon ne unki tareef ki aur kaha: Allah aapko ek nek badla de! Unhone kaha: Mujhe ummeed hai (Allah ki rehmat ki) aur mujhe dar bhi hai (Uske gusse ka). Logon ne kaha: Kisi ko apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar kijiye. Unhone kaha: Kya mujhe apni zindagi aur apni maut mein tumhare maamle chalaane ka bojh uThAna chahiye? Jahan tak Khilafat ka sawal hai, kaash main khud ko (Sarvashaktimaan ke saamne) is tarah bari kar sakoon ki na mere pakhth mein kuch ho na mere khilaaf. Agar main apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar karta, (aisa is liye hoga kyunki) mujhse behtar kisi ne aisa kiya. (Unka matlab Abu Bakr se tha.) Agar main tumhe akela chhoDun, (aisa is liye hoga kyunki) mujhse behtar kisi ne, yaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne, aisa kiya. Abdullah kehte hain: Jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka zikr kiya, mujhe samajh aaya ki woh kisi ko Khalifa muqarrar nahi karenge.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said: I entered the apartment of (my sister) Hafsa. She said: Do yoa know that your father is not going to nominate his successor? I said: He won't do that (i. e. he would nominate). She said: He is going to do that. The narrator said: I took an oath that I will talk to him about the matter. I kept quiet until the next morning, still I did not talk to him, and I felt as if I were carryint, a mountain on my right hand. At last I came to him and entered his apartment. (Seeing me) he began to ask me about the condition of the people, and I informed him (about them). Then I said to him: I heard something from the people and took an oath that I will communicate it to you. They presume that you are not going to nominate a successor. If a grazer of camels and sheep that you had appointed comes back to you leaving the cattle, you will (certainly) think that the cattle are lost. To look after the people is more serious and grave. (The dying Caliph) was moved at my words. He bent his head in a thoughtful mood for some time and raised it to me and said: God will doubtlessly protect His religion. If I do not nominate a successor (I have a precedent before me), for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not nominate his successor. And if I nominate one (I have a precedent), for Abu Bakr did nominate. The narrator (Ibn Umar) said: By God. when he mentioned the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, I (at once) understood that he would not place anyone at a par with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and would not nominate anyone.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main (apni behn) Hafsa ke kamre mein daakhil hua. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai ki tumhare waalid apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar nahi karne wale hain? Maine kaha: Woh aisa nahi karenge (yaani woh karenge). Unhone kaha: Woh aisa karne waale hain. Raawi ne kaha: Maine qasam li ki main unse is maamle ke baare mein baat karunga. Main khamosh raha yahan tak ki agli subah, phir bhi maine unse baat nahi ki, aur mujhe laga jaise main apne daaye haath mein ek pahaad uThA raha hoon. Aakhirkaar main unke paas aaya aur unke kamre mein daakhil hua. (Mujhe dekhkar) unhone mujhse logon ki haalat ke baare mein poochna shuru kiya, aur maine unhe (unke baare mein) bataaya. Phir maine unse kaha: Maine logon se kuch suna aur qasam li ki main aapko ye bataunga. Unhe lagta hai ki aap kisi ko apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar nahi karne waale hain. Agar aapne muqarrar kiya hua koi oont aur bhed charaane wala aapke paas jaanwaron ko chhoDkar wapas aata hai, to aap zaroor sochenge ki jaanwar gum ho gaye. Logon ka khyaal rakhna isse zyada sangin aur mahatvapurna hai. (Marte hue Khalifa) mere alfaazon se prabhaavit hue. Unhone thoDi der ke liye vichaar mein apna sar jhukaaya aur phir mujhe uThAkar kaha: Allah zaroor apne deen ki hifaazat karega. Agar main apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar nahi karta (mere paas ek udaaharan hai), kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar nahi kiya. Aur agar main muqarrar karta hoon (mere paas ek udaaharan hai), kyunki Abu Bakr ne muqarrar kiya tha. Raawi (Ibn Umar) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ka zikr kiya, maine (turant) samajh liya ki woh kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke barabar nahi rakhenge aur kisi ko muqarrar nahi karenge.

e: It has been reported on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Samura who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'Abd al-Rahman, do not ask for a position of authority, for if you are granted this position as a result of your asking for it, you will be left alone (without God's help to discharge the responsibilities attendant thereon), and it you are granted it without making any request for it, you will be helped (by God in the discharge of your duties).
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Abd al-Rahman, ohde ki khwaish mat karo, kyunki agar tumhe ye haalat tumhare maangne ke natije mein di jaati hai, to tumhe akela chhoD diya jaayega (Allah ki madad ke bina isse jud i zimmedaariyon ko poora karne ke liye), aur agar tumhe bina maange di jaati hai, to tumhari madad ki jaayegi (Allah ke zariye tumhare kartavyon ko poora karne mein).

e: The same tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated by Abu Musa who said: Two of my cousins and I entered the apartment of the Prophet (ﷺ). One of them said: Messenger of Allah, appoint us rulers of some lands that the Almighty and Glorious God has entrusted to thy care. The other also said something similar. He said: We do not appoint to this position one who asks for it nor anyone who is covetous for the same.
hi: Abu Musa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mere do chachere bhai aur main Nabi (SAW) ke kamre mein daakhil hue. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein us kuch zameen ka shaasak muqarrar kijiye jo Sarvashaktimaan aur Shaandaar Allah ne aapki dekhbhaal mein soonpi hai. Doosre ne bhi isi jaisi kuch kaha. Unhone kaha: Hum is haalat par usse muqarrar nahi karte jo ise maangta hai na hi kisi ko jo ise chaahta hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Musa who said: I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and with me were two men from the Ash'ari tribe. One of them was on my right hand and the other on my left. Both of them made a request for a position (of authority) while the Prophet (ﷺ) was brushing his teeth with a tooth-stick. He said (to me): Abu Musa (or 'Abdullah b. Qais), what do you say (about the request they have made)? I said: By God Who sent thee on thy mission with truth, they did not disclose to me what they had in their minds, and I did not know that they would ask for a position. The narrator says (while recalling this hadith): I visualise as if I were looking at the miswak of the Prophet (ﷺ) between his lips. He (the Holy Prophet) said: We shall not or shall never appoint to the public offices (in our State) those who with to have them, but you may go, Abu Musa (or Abdullah b. Qais) (to take up your assignment). He sent him to Yemen as governor. then he sent Mu'adh b. jabal in his wake (to help him in the discharge of duties). When Mu'adh reached the camp of Abu Musa, the latter (received him and) said: Please get yourself down; and he spread for him a mattress, while there was a man bound hand and foot as a prisoner. Mu'adh said: Who is this? Abu Musa said: He was a Jew. He embraced Islam. Then he reverted to his false religion and became a Jew. Mu'adh said: I won't sit until he is killed according to the decree of Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ) (in this case). Abu Musa said: Be seated. It will be done. He said: I won't sit unless he is killed in accordance with the decree of Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ). He repeated these words thrice. Then Abu Musa ordered him (to be killed) and he was kilied. Then the two talked of standing in prayer at night. One of them, i. e. Mu'adh, said: I sleep (for a part of the night) and stand in prayer (for a part) and I hope that I shall get the same reward for steeping as I shall get for standing (in prayer).
hi: Abu Musa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur mere saath Ash'ari qabile ke do aadmi the. Unmein se ek mere daaye haath par tha aur doosra mere baaye haath par. Donon ne (ohde ki) haalat ke liye maang ki jabki Nabi (SAW) miswak se apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Unhone (mujhse) kaha: Abu Musa (ya Abdullah bin Qais), tum kya kehte ho (unhone jo maang ki hai uske baare mein)? Maine kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko sach ke saath aapki muhim par bheja, unhone mujhe apne dil mein jo tha woh nahi bataya, aur mujhe nahi pata tha ki woh haalat maangenge. Raawi kehte hain (ye hadees yaad karte hue): Mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main Nabi (SAW) ke miswak ko unke honTon ke beech dekh raha hoon. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Hum (humare Hukumat mein) aam pado par un logon ko muqarrar nahi karenge ya kabhi nahi karenge jo unhe paana chahte hain, lekin tum ja sakte ho, Abu Musa (ya Abdullah bin Qais) (apni taqarruri ke liye). Unhone unhe Yemen ka gavarnar banaakar bheja. Phir unhone Mu'adh bin Jabal ko unke peeche bheja (unhe zimmedari nibhaane mein madad karne ke liye). Jab Mu'adh Abu Musa ke camp mein pahunche, baad wale ne (unhe swagat kiya aur) kaha: Barah-e-karam utar jaayiye; aur unhone unke liye ek gaddi bichhaayi, jabki ek shakhs haath-paon se bandha hua qaidi ke soorat mein wahan tha. Mu'adh ne kaha: Ye kaun hai? Abu Musa ne kaha: Woh ek Yahudi tha. Usne Islam qubool kiya. Phir woh apne jhoote deen ki taraf laut aaya aur Yahudi ban gaya. Mu'adh ne kaha: Main tab tak nahi baithunga jab tak usse Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ke faisle ke mutabik (is maamle mein) qatal na kar diya jaaye. Abu Musa ne kaha: Baith jaao. Ye ho jaayega. Unhone kaha: Main tab tak nahi baithunga jab tak use Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ke faisle ke mutabik qatal na kar diya jaaye. Unhone ye alfaaz teen baar dohraaye. Phir Abu Musa ne (use qatal karne ka) hukum diya aur use qatal kiya gaya. Phir dono ne raat ki namaz mein khade hone ke baare mein baat ki. Unmein se ek, yaani Mu'adh, ne kaha: Main (raat ke ek hisse ke liye) sota hoon aur (ek hisse ke liye) namaz mein khada hota hoon aur mujhe ummeed hai ki mujhe sone ka utna hi sawaab milega jitna namaz mein khade hone ka.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr who said: I said to the Prophet (ﷺ): Messenger of Allah, will you not appoint me to a public office? He stroked my shoulder with his hand and said: Abu Dharr, thou art weak and authority is a trust. and on the Day of judgment it is a cause of humiliation and repentance except for one who fulfils its obligations and (properly) discharges the duties attendant thereon.
hi: Abu Dharr ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aap mujhe kisi aam pad par muqarrar nahi karenge? Unhone apne haath se mere kandhe ko thoka aur kaha: Abu Dharr, tum kamzor ho aur ohda ek amaanat hai, aur Qayamat ke din ye beizzati aur pashchataap ka wajah hai siwaay us shakhs ke jo iski zimmedaariyaan poori karta hai aur usse jude kartavyon ko (munasib soorat se) nirvaha karta hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of of Allah (ﷺ) said: Abu Dharr, I find that thou art weak and I like for thee what I like for myself. Do not rule over (even) two persons and do not manage the property of an orphan.
hi: Abu Dharr ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Abu Dharr, main paata hoon ki tum kamzor ho aur main tumhare liye woh chaahta hoon jo main apne liye chaahta hoon. Do logon (bhi) par shaasan mat karo aur kisi anaath ki maal ka intezam mat karo.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Behold! the Dispensers of justice will be seated on the pulpits of light beside God, on the right side of the Merciful, Exalted and GlorioUS. Either side of the Being is the right side both being equally mrneritorious. (The Dispensers of justice are) those who do justice in their rules, in matters relating to their families and in all that they undertake to do.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho! Insaaf karne wale Allah ke qareeb roshni ke mimbaron par baiThenge, Rehmvaan, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar ki daayi taraf. Us Hasti ki dono taraf daayi taraf hai, donon barabar mahatvapurna hain. (Insaaf karne wale) woh hain jo apne shaasan mein, apne khaandaan se mutaliq maamlon mein, aur jo bhi woh karte hain usmein insaaf karte hain.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abd al-Rahman b. Shumasa who said: I came to A'isha to inquire something from her. She said: From which people art thou? I said: I am from the people of Egypt. She said: What was the behaviour of your governor towards you in this war of yours? I said: We did not experience anything bad from him. If the camel of a man from us died, he would bestow on him a camel. If any one of us lost his slave, he would give him a slave. If anybody was in need of the basic necessities of life, he would provide them with provisions. She said: Behold! the treatment that was meted out to my brother, Muhammad b. Abu Bakr, does not prevent me from telling you what I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said in this house of mine: O God, who (happens to) acquire some kind of control over the affairs of my people and is hard upon them-be Thou hard upon him, and who (happens to) acquire some kind of control over the affairs of my people and is kind to them-be Thou kind to him.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Shumasa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Aisha ke paas unse kuch poochne aaya. Unhone kaha: Tum kaunse logon mein se ho? Maine kaha: Main Egypt ke logon mein se hoon. Unhone kaha: Tumhare is jang mein tumhare gavarnar ka tumhare prati kaisa vyavahaar tha? Maine kaha: Humein unse koi burai tajurba nahi hui. Agar hummein se kisi ka oont mar jaata, woh use ek oont dete. Agar hummein se koi apna ghulam kho deta, woh use ek ghulam de dete. Agar kisi ko zindagi ki bunyaadi zaroorat ki cheezon ki zaroorat hoti, woh unhe raashan mahaiyaa karaate. Unhone kaha: Dekho! Jo vyavahaar mere bhai, Muhammad bin Abu Bakr, ke saath kiya gaya usse mujhe tumhe ye bataane se nahi rokta jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Unhone mere is ghar mein kaha: Aye Allah, jo (kabhi) mere logon ke maamlon par kisi tarah ka niyantran haasil karta hai aur unpar sakht hota hai - Tu bhi uspar sakht ho, aur jo (kabhi) mere logon ke maamlon par kisi tarah ka niyantran haasil karta hai aur unpar meherbaan hota hai - Tu bhi uspar meherbaan ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abd al-Rahman b. Shumasa with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abd al-Rahman bin Shumasa ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet (May be upon him) said: Beware. every one of you is a shepherd and every one is answerable with regard to his flock. The Caliph is a shepherd over the people and shall be questioned about his subjects (as to how he conducted their affairs). A man is a guardian over the members of his family and shal be questioned about them (as to how he looked after their physical and moral well-being). A woman is a guardian over the household of her husband and his children and shall be questioned about them (as to how she managed the household and brought up the children). A slave is a guardian over the property of his master and shall be questioned about it (as to how he safeguarded his trust). Beware, every one of you is a guardian and every one of you shall be questioned with regard to his trust.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Dhyaan raho, tum mein se har ek gadariya hai aur har ek apne rewaad ke baare mein jawaabdeh hai. Khalifa logon ka gadariya hai aur unse apni prajaa ke baare mein poocha jaayega (ki unhone unke maamle kaise chalaaye). Ek aadmi apne khaandaan ke sadasyon ka rakshak hai aur unse unke baare mein poocha jaayega (ki usne unki shaareerik aur naitik bhalaai ka khyaal kaise rakha). Ek aurat apne shohar ke ghar aur uske bachchon ki rakshak hai aur usse unke baare mein poocha jaayega (ki usne ghar ka intezam kaise kiya aur bachchon ko kaise paala). Ek ghulam apne maalik ki maal ka rakshak hai aur usse iske baare mein poocha jaayega (ki usne apni amaanat ki hifaazat kaise ki). Dhyaan raho, tum mein se har ek rakshak hai aur tum mein se har ek se apni amaanat ke baare mein poocha jaayega.

e: This tradition has been narrated through more; than one chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek se zyada sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but there is (a slight change of wording) in the hadith transmitted through Zuhri that he said: " I think that he (the narrator) said: The man is a custodian of the wealth of his father, and he would be answerable for what is in his custody."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Zuhri ke zariye riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaazon mein thoDa badlaav hai) ki unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai ki unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Aadmi apne waalid ki daulat ka rakshak hai, aur woh iske baare mein jawaabdeh hoga jo uski dekhbhaal mein hai."

e: A hadith having the same meaning has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar.
hi: Isi jaisa matlab wali ek hadees Abdullah bin Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hasan who said: Ubaidullah b Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yasir al-Muzani in his last iliness. Ma'qil said (to him): I am narrating to you a tradition I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). If I knew that I am to survive this illness. I would, not narrate it to you. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: If God appointed anyone ruler over a people and he died while he was still treacherous to his people, God would forbid his entry into Paradise.
hi: Hasan ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ubaidullah bin Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yasir al-Muzani se unki aakhri beemari mein milne gaye. Ma'qil ne (unse) kaha: Main aapko ek hadees riwayat kar raha hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni. Agar mujhe pata hota ki main is beemari se bach jaunga, to main ise aapko na sunaata. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar Allah kisi shakhs ko kisi logon ka shaasak muqarrar karta hai aur woh apne logon ke prati bharosaghaati karte hue hi mar jaata hai, to Allah use Jannat mein daakhil hone se mana karega.

e: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Hasan who said: Ibn, Ziyad paid a visit to Ma'qil b. Yasir who was seriously ill. Here follows the same tradition as has gone before with the addition that Ibn Ziyad asked: Why didn't you narrate this tradition to me before this day? Ma'qil reprimanded him and said: I did not narrate it to you or I was not going to narrate it to you.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye Hasan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ibn Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yasir se milne gaye jo sakht bimaar the. Yahan wahi hadees hai jo pehle guzar chuki hai is izafe ke saath ki Ibn Ziyad ne poocha: Aapne ye hadees mujhe pehle kyun nahi sunaayi? Ma'qil ne unhe daanta aur kaha: Maine ise aapko riwayat nahi kiya ya main ise aapko riwayat karne wala nahi tha.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Malik that Ubaidullah b. Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yaser in the latter's illness. Ma'qil said to him: I am narrating to you a tradition. If I were not at death's door, I would not narrate it to you. I heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) say: A ruler who, having obtained control over the affairs of the Muslims, does not strive for their betterment and does not serve them sincerely shall not enter Paradise with them.
hi: Abu Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Ubaidullah bin Ziyad Ma'qil bin Yaser se unki beemari mein milne gaye. Ma'qil ne unse kaha: Main aapko ek hadees riwayat kar raha hoon. Agar main maut ke darwaze par na hota, to main ise aapko na sunaata. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shaasak jo, Musalmaanon ke maamlon par niyantran haasil karne ke baad, unki bhalaai ke liye koshish nahi karta aur unki nishklank sewa nahi karta, unke saath Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu al-Aswad who said: My father related to me that Ma'qil b. Yasir fell ill. 'Ubaidullah b. Ziyad called on him to inquire after his health. Here follows the tradition as narrated by Hasan from Ma'qil.
hi: Abu al-Aswad ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mere waalid ne mujhe bataya ki Ma'qil bin Yasir bimaar pad gaye. Ubaidullah bin Ziyad unse unka haal poochne aaye. Yahan wahi riwayat hai jo Hasan ne Ma'qil se riwayat ki.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hasan that A'idh b. 'Amr who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called on 'Ubaidullah b. Ziyad and said (to him): O my son, I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The worst of guardians is the cruel ruler. Beware of being one of them. Ubaidullah said (to him out of arrogance): Sit you down. You are from the chaff of the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ). A'idh said: Was there worthless chaff among them? Such worthless chaff appeared after them and among other people.
hi: Hasan ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aidh bin Amr, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se ek the, Ubaidullah bin Ziyad se milne gaye aur (unse) kaha: Aye mere bete, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse buray rakshak zaalim shaasak hote hain. Unmein se ek na banne se bacho. Ubaidullah ne (garv se) kaha: Baith jaao. Tum Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ke bhoosi mein se ho. Aidh ne kaha: Kya unmein bekaar bhoosi thi? Aisi bekaar bhoosi unke baad aur doosre logon mein pragat hui.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood among us (to deliver a sermon). He talked about the misappropriation of booty, and declared it to be a serious matter and a grave sin. Then he said: I shouldn't find that any of you should come on the Day of Judgment with a growling camel mounted on his neck, and should appeal to me for help saying:" Messenger of Allah, help me." and I should say: I have no authority to help you; I already communicated to you. I shouldn't find that any of you should come on the Day of Judgment with a bleating ewe mounted on his neck, and he should say to me:" Messenger of Allah, help me," and I should say: I have no authority to help you; I conveyed to you. I shouldn't find that one of you should come on the Day of Judgment with a Person crying loudly mounted on his neck, and he should say to me:" Messenger of Allah, help me," and I should say: I have no authority to help you; I conveyed to you. I shouldn't find that any one of you should come on the Day of Judgment with fluttering clothes wrapped round his neck and he should say to me:" Messenger of Allah, help me," and I should say: I have no authority to help you; I conveyed to you. I shouldn't find that any of you should come on the Day of Judgment with a heap of gold and silver placed on his neck and he should say to me:" Messenger of Allah, help me." and I should say: I have no authority to help you; I already conveyed to you (the warning from the Almighty).
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare beech khade hue (khutba dene ke liye). Unhone maal-e-ganimat ki dhoka-dhaddi ke baare mein baat ki, aur ise ek sangin maamla aur bhaari gunah ailaan kiya. Phir unhone kaha: Mujhe ye na mile ki tum mein se koi Qayamat ke din apni gardan par ek gharraate hue oont ke saath aaye, aur mujhse madad ke liye guhaar lagaaye ye kehte hue: "Allah ke Rasool, meri madad kijiye," aur main kahun: Mujhe tumhari madad karne ka koi haq nahi hai; maine tumhe pehle hi bata diya tha. Mujhe ye na mile ki tum mein se koi Qayamat ke din apni gardan par ek maimaate hue bhed ke saath aaye, aur woh mujhse kahe: "Allah ke Rasool, meri madad kijiye," aur main kahun: Mujhe tumhari madad karne ka koi haq nahi hai; maine tumhe bata diya tha. Mujhe ye na mile ki tum mein se koi Qayamat ke din apni gardan par zor se chillaate hue insaan ke saath aaye, aur woh mujhse kahe: "Allah ke Rasool, meri madad kijiye," aur main kahun: Mujhe tumhari madad karne ka koi haq nahi hai; maine tumhe bata diya tha. Mujhe ye na mile ki tum mein se koi Qayamat ke din apni gardan mein lipTe phaDphaDaate kapdon ke saath aaye aur woh mujhse kahe: "Allah ke Rasool, meri madad kijiye," aur main kahun: Mujhe tumhari madad karne ka koi haq nahi hai; maine tumhe bata diya tha. Mujhe ye na mile ki tum mein se koi Qayamat ke din apni gardan par sona-chandi ka Dher rakhkar aaye aur woh mujhse kahe: "Allah ke Rasool, meri madad kijiye," aur main kahun: Mujhe tumhari madad karne ka koi haq nahi hai; maine tumhe pehle hi (Sarvashaktimaan ki chetaavni) pahunchaa di thi.

e: The above tradition has been narrated on the same authority through different chains of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat isi raawi ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira has narrated this hadith with a slight variation of words.
hi: Abu Huraira ne ye hadees alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira has narrated this hadith similar to the above mentioned hadith.
hi: Abu Huraira ne ye hadees upar bataayi gayi hadees jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) appointed a man from the Asad tribe who was called Ibn Lutbiyya in charge of Sadaqa (i. e. authorised hign to receive Sadaqa from the people on behalf of the State. When he returned (with the collictions), he said: This is for you and (this is mine as) it was presented to me as a gift. The narrator said: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upod him) stood on the pulpit and praised God and extolled Him. Then he said: What about a State official whom I give an assignment and who (comes and) says: This is for you and this has been presented to me as a gift? Why didn't he remain in the house of his father or the house of his mother so that he could observe whether gifts were presented to him or not. By the Being in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, any one of you will not take anything from it but will bring it on the Day of Judgment, carrying on his neck a camel that will be growling, or a cow that will be bellowing or an ewe that will be bleating. Then he raised his hands so that we could see the whiteness of his armpits. Then he said twice: O God, I have conveyed (Thy Commandments).
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Asad qabile ke ek shakhs ko muqarrar kiya jise Ibn Lutbiyya kaha jaata tha Sadaqa ka prabhaari (yaani unhe ye ikhtiyar diya ki woh sarkaar ki taraf se logon se Sadaqa haasil karein). Jab woh wapas aaye (ikattha ki gayi cheezon ke saath), unhone kaha: Ye tumhare liye hai aur (ye mera hai kyunki) ye mujhe tohfe ke soorat mein diya gaya. Raawi ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par khade hue aur Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki. Phir unhone kaha: Ek sarkaari aamil ke baare mein kya khyaal hai jise main ek zimmedaari deta hoon aur jo (aakar) kehta hai: Ye tumhare liye hai aur ye mujhe tohfe ke soorat mein diya gaya hai? Unhone apne waalid ya apni maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi rehna chuna taaki woh dekh sakein ki unhe tohfe diye jaate hain ya nahi. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, tum mein se koi bhi ismein se kuch nahi lega lekin (isse) Qayamat ke din lekar aayega, apni gardan par ek gharraate hue oont, ya ek rambhaate hue gaay, ya ek maimaate hue bhed le jaate hue. Phir unhone apne haath uThAye taaki hum unki baazuon ki safedi dekh sakein. Phir unhone do baar kaha: Aye Allah, maine (Tere hukum) pahunchaa diye hain.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) appointed Ibn Lutbiyya, a man from the Azd tribe, in charge of Sadaqa (authorising him to receive gifts from the people on behalf of the State). He came with the collection, gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ), and said: This wealth is for you and this is a gift presented to me. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him: Why didn't you remain in the house of your father and your mother to see whether gifts were presented to you or not. Then he stood up to deliver a sermon. Here follows the tradition like the tradition of Sufyan.
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne Ibn Lutbiyya, Azd qabile ke ek shakhs, ko Sadaqa ka prabhaari muqarrar kiya (unhe sarkaar ki taraf se logon se tohfe haasil karne ka ikhtiyar diya). Woh ikattha ki gayi cheezon ke saath aaye, unhe Nabi (SAW) ko diya, aur kaha: Ye daulat tumhare liye hai aur ye mujhe diya gaya ek tohfa hai. Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tumne apne waalid aur apni maa ke ghar mein rehna kyun nahi chuna ye dekhne ke liye ki tumhe tohfe diye jaate hain ya nahi. Phir woh khutba dene khade hue. Yahan wahi hadees hai jaisi Sufyan ki hadees.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) appointed a man from the Azd tribe called Ibn al-Utbiyya, in charge of Sadaqat to be received from Banu Sulaim. When he came (back), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him to render his account. He said: This wealth is for you (i.e. for the public treasury) and this is a gift (presented to me). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You should have remained in the house of your father and your mother, until your gift came to you if you spoke the truth; then he addressed us. He praised God and extolled Him, and afterwards said: I appoint a man from you to a responsible post sharing with him authority that God has entrusted to me, and he comes to me saying: This wealth is for you (i.e. for the public treasury) and this is a gift presented to me. Why did he not remain in the house of his father and his mother and his gift came to him, if he was truthful? By God, any one of you will not take anything from (the public funds) without any justification, but will meet his Lord carrying it on himself on the Day of judgment. I will recognise any one of you meeting Allah and carrying a growling camel, or a cow bellowing or a goat bleating. Then he raised his hands so high that whiteness of his armpits could be seen. Then he said: O my Lord, I have conveyed (Thy Commandments). The narrator says: My eyes saw (the Prophet standing in that pose) and my ears heard (what he said).
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Azd qabile ke ek shakhs jise Ibn al-Utbiyya kaha jaata tha, Banu Sulaim se Sadaqat haasil karne ka prabhaari muqarrar kiya. Jab woh (wapas) aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse apna hisaab dene ko kaha. Unhone kaha: Ye daulat tumhare liye hai (yaani aam khazane ke liye) aur ye ek tohfa hai (mujhe diya gaya). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe apne waalid aur apni maa ke ghar mein rehna chahiye tha, jab tak tumhara tohfa tumhare paas na aata, agar tum sach bol rahe ho; phir unhone humein khitaab kiya. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki, aur uske baad kaha: Main tum mein se ek shakhs ko ek zimmedaar pad par muqarrar karta hoon, Allah ne mujhe soonpe hue ikhtiyar mein se hissa dekar, aur woh mere paas ye kehte hue aata hai: Ye daulat tumhare liye hai (yaani aam khazane ke liye) aur ye mujhe diya gaya ek tohfa hai. Unhone apne waalid aur apni maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi raha aur unka tohfa unke paas aa jaata, agar woh sachche the? Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi (aam dhan mein se) bina kisi munasib wajah ke kuch nahi lega, lekin apne Rab se Qayamat ke din milega ise apne upar dhote hue. Main tum mein se kisi ko bhi pehchaanunga jo Allah se ek gharraate hue oont, ya ek rambhaate hue gaay ya ek maimaate hue bakri lekar milega. Phir unhone apne haath itni oonchai tak uThAye ki unki baazuon ki safedi dekhi ja sakti thi. Phir unhone kaha: Aye mere Rab, maine (Tere hukum) pahunchaa diye hain. Raawi kehte hain: Meri aankhon ne dekha (Nabi ko us mudra mein khada) aur mere kaanon ne suna (jo unhone kaha).

e: This tradition has been hanoed down through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Hisham with aslight variation in the wording.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Hisham ki sanad se alfaazon mein thoDe se antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) appointed a man in charge of Sadaqa (authorising him to receive charity from the people on behalf of the State). He came (back to the Holy prophet) with a large number of things and started saying: This is for you and this has been presented to me as a gift. Here follows the tradition that has gone before except that 'Urwa (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) asked Abu Humaid: Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah (himself) (ﷺ)? He replied: My ears heard it from his mouth.
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko Sadaqa ka prabhaari muqarrar kiya (unhe sarkaar ki taraf se logon se sadaqa haasil karne ka ikhtiyar diya). Woh (Nabi-e-Paak ke paas) bahut si cheezon ke saath wapas aaye aur kehna shuru kiya: Ye tumhare liye hai aur ye mujhe tohfe ke soorat mein diya gaya hai. Yahan wahi riwayat hai jo pehle guzar chuki hai siwaay is baat ke ki Urwa (sanad ke ek raawi) ne Abu Humaid se poocha: Kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (khud) suna? Unhone jawaab diya: Mere kaanon ne ise unke munh se suna.

e: It has been reported on the authority of 'Adi b. 'Amira al-Kindi who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Whosoever from you is appointed by us to a position of authority and he conceals from us a needle or something smaller than that, it would be misappropriation (of public funds) and will (have to) produce it on the Day of Judgment. The narrator says: A dark-complexioned man from the Ansar stood up - I can visualise him still - and said: Messenger of Allah, take back from me your assignment. He said: What has happened to you? The man said: I have heard you say so and so. He said: I say that (even) now: Whosoever from you is appointed by us to a position of authority, he should bring everything, big or small, and whatever he is given therefrom he should take, and he should restrain himself from taking that which is forbidden.
hi: Adi bin Amira al-Kindi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se jo koi humare ke zariye ohde ki haalat par muqarrar kiya jaata hai aur humse ek sui ya usse choti koi cheez chhupaata hai, ye (aam dhan ki) dhoka-dhaddi hogi aur use Qayamat ke din pesh karna hoga. Raawi kehte hain: Ansar ka ek gehre rang ka shakhs khada hua - main abhi bhi unhe dekh sakta hoon - aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera kaam mujhse wapas le lijiye. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Us shakhs ne kaha: Maine aapko aisa aisa kehte suna hai. Unhone kaha: Main (ab bhi) wahi kehta hoon: Tum mein se jo koi humare ke zariye ohde ki haalat par muqarrar kiya jaata hai, use har cheez laani chahiye, chhoti ya badi, aur usmein se jo kuch usse diya jaata hai use lena chahiye, aur use apne aap ko usse rokna chahiye jo mana hai lena.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Isma'il ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Adi b. 'Amira al-Kindi heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (as) was narrated in the (above-mentioned) hadith.
hi: Adi bin Amira al-Kindi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna (jaisa) upar bataayi gayi hadees mein riwayat kiya gaya hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij that the Qur'anic injunction: " 0 you who believe, obey Allah, His Apostle and those in authority from amongst You" (iv. 59) -was revealed in respect of 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa b. Qais b. Adi al-Sahmi who was despatched by the Prophet (ﷺ) as leader of a military campaign. The narrator said: He was informed of this fact by Ya'la b. Muslim who was informed by Sa'id b. Jubair who in turn was informed by Ibn Abbas.
hi: Ibn Juraij ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Qurani aayat: "Aye imaan waalo, Allah ki, Uske Rasool ki, aur tum mein se ikhtiyar rakhne walon ki itaat karo" (4:59) - Abdullah bin Hudhafa bin Qais bin Adi al-Sahmi ke silsile mein nazil hui, jinhe Nabi (SAW) ne ek fauji muhim ke netritvakarta ke soorat mein bheja tha. Raawi ne kaha: Unhe ye baat Ya'la bin Muslim ne bataayi jinhe Sa'id bin Jubair ne bataayi jinhe Ibn Abbas ne bataayi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Holy prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoso obeys me obeys God, and whoso disobeys me disobeys God. Whoso obeys the commander (appointed by me) obeys me, and whoso disobeys the commander disobeys me. The same tradition transmitted by different persons omits the portion: And whose disobeys the commander disobeys me.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi-e-Paak (SAW) ne kaha: Jo meri itaat karta hai woh Allah ki itaat karta hai, aur jo meri naafarmani karta hai woh Allah ki naafarmani karta hai. Jo hukmaraan (jise maine muqarrar kiya) ki itaat karta hai woh meri itaat karta hai, aur jo hukmaraan ki naafarmani karta hai woh meri naafarmani karta hai. Yehi hadees mukhtalif logon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai jisme ye hissa chhoDa gaya hai: Aur jo hukmaraan ki naafarmani karta hai woh meri naafarmani karta hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoso obeys me obeys God; and whose disobeys me disobeys God. Whoso obeys my commander obeys me, and whoso disobeys my commander disobeys me.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo meri itaat karta hai woh Allah ki itaat karta hai; aur jo meri naafarmani karta hai woh Allah ki naafarmani karta hai. Jo mere hukmaraan ki itaat karta hai woh meri itaat karta hai, aur jo mere hukmaraan ki naafarmani karta hai woh meri naafarmani karta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira by more than one chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek se zyada sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih has transmitted this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: According to one version of the tradition, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoso obeys the commander. He did not say:" My commander."
hi: Riwayat ke ek soorat ke mutabik, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo hukmaraan ki itaat karta hai. Unhone "Mera hukmaraan" nahi kaha.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is obligatory for you to listen to the ruler and obey him in adversity and prosperity, in pleasure and displeasure, and even when another person is given (rather undue) preference over you.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhare liye zaroori hai ki tum shaasak ki baat suno aur uski itaat karo, mushkil aur samriddhi mein, khushi aur naaraazgi mein, aur jab bhi koi doosra shakhs tumse zyada tarjeeh paaye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr who said: My friend (i. e. the Holy Prophet) advised me to listen (to the man in position of authority) and obey (him) even if he were a slave maimed (and disabled).
hi: Abu Dharr ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mere dost (yaani Nabi-e-Paak) ne mujhe salaah di ki main (ikhtiyar ki haalat waale aadmi ki) baat sunun aur uski itaat karoon chahe woh vikalaang aur ashakt ghulam hi kyun na ho.

e: In another version of the tradition, we have the wording: " An Abyssinian slave maimed and disabled."
hi: Riwayat ke ek doosre soorat mein, humare paas alfaaz hain: "Ek Abyssinian ghulam vikalaang aur ashakt."

e: Abu 'Imran narrated this hadith with a slight change of wording.
hi: Abu Imran ne ye hadees alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Husain who learnt the tradition from his grandmother. She said that she heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering his sermon on the occasion of the Last Pilgrimage. He was saying: If a slave is appointed over you and he conducts your affairs according to the Book of Allah, you should listen to him and obeey (his orders).
hi: Yahya bin Husain ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apni dadi se seekhi. Unhone kaha ki unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Aakhri Hajj ke avasar par apna khutba dete suna. Woh keh rahe the: Agar tumpar ek ghulam muqarrar kiya jaata hai aur woh tumhare maamle Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik chalaata hai, tumhe uski baat sunni chahiye aur uski itaat karni chahiye (uske hukumon ki).

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, and he said: "An Abyssinian slave."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur unhone kaha: "Ek Abyssinian ghulam."

e: In other versions of the above tradition, the wordings are" an Abyssinian slave." and" a maimed Abyssinian slave".
hi: Upar bataayi gayi riwayat ke doosre sooraton mein alfaaz hain "ek Abyssinian ghulam" aur "ek vikalaang Abyssinian ghulam".

e: Another version of the tradition does not qualify the slave with the epithets" maimed,"" an Abyssinian" but makes the addition: " I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) (say this) at Mina or 'Arafat."
hi: Riwayat ka ek doosra soorat ghulam ko "vikalaang," "ek Abyssinian" ki khaasiyaton se yukt nahi karta lekin izafa karta hai: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye (kehte) Mina ya Arafat mein suna."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Husain who learnt the tradition from his grandmother. Umm Husain. He said': I heard her say: I performed Hajjat-ul-Wada' in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said a lot of things (on this occasion). Then I heard him say: If a maimed slave is appointed a commander over you the narrator says: I think she said:" a black stave" who leads you according to the Book of Allah, then listen to him and obey him.
hi: Yahya bin Husain ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apni dadi, Umm Husain, se seekhi. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein Hajjat-ul-Wada kiya. Unhone (is avasar par) bahut si baaten kahin. Phir maine unhe ye kehte suna: Agar ek vikalaang ghulam tumpar hukmaraan muqarrar kiya jaata hai - raawi kehte hain: Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha "ek kaala ghulam" - jo tumhe Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik le jaata hai, to uski baat suno aur uski itaat karo.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: It is obligatory upon a Muslim that he should listen (to the ruler appointed over him) and obey him whether he likes it or not, except that he is ordered to do a sinful thing. If he is ordered to do a sinful act, a Muslim should neither listen to him nor should he obey his orders.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek Musalman par farz hai ki woh (muqarrar shaasak ki) baat sune aur uski itaat kare chahe use pasand ho ya na ho, siwaay is baat ke ki use koi gunah waala kaam karne ka hukum diya jaaye. Agar use koi gunah waala kaam karne ka hukum diya jaata hai, ek Musalman ko na to unki baat sunni chahiye na hi unke hukumon ki itaat karni chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Ubaidullah.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu 'Abd al-Rahman from 'Ali that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a force (on a mission) and appointed over them a man. He kindled a fire and said: Enter it. Some people made up their minds to enter it (the fire), (carrying out the order of their commander), but the others said: We fled from the fire (that's why we have come into the fold of Islam). The matter was reported to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said to those who Contemplated entering (the fire at the order of their commander): If you had entered it, you would have remained there until the Day of Judgment. He commanded the act of the latter group and said: There is no submission in matters involving God's disobedience or displeasure. Submission is obligatory only in what is good (and reasonable).
hi: Abu Abd al-Rahman ke hawale se Ali (Alayhis Salam) se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek fauj (ek mission par) bheji aur unpar ek shakhs muqarrar kiya. Unhone aag jalaayi aur kaha: Ismein daakhil ho jaao. Kuch logon ne mann bana liya ki woh (aag mein) daakhil ho jaayenge (apne sardaar ka hukum poora karte hue), lekin doosron ne kaha: Hum aag se bhaage the (isi liye hum Islam mein daakhil hue hain). Ye maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Unhone un logon se jo (aag mein) daakhil hone ka soch rahe the (apne sardaar ke hukum par) kaha: Agar tum ismein daakhil ho jaate, to tum wahan Qayamat ke din tak rehte. Unhone doosre giroh ke amal ki tareef ki aur kaha: Allah ki naafarmani ya naaraazgi mein koi tabediyat nahi hai. Tabediyat sirf usi mein farz hai jo achha (aur munasib) hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'All who said: The Mersenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent an expeditionand appointed over the Mujahids a man from the Ansar. (While making the appointment), he ordered that his work should be listened to and obeyed. They made him angry in a matter. He said: Collect for me dry wood. They collected it for him. Then he said: Kindle a fire. They kindled (the fire). Then he said: Didn't the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) order you to listen to me and obey (my orders)? They said: Yes. He said: Enter the fire. The narrator says: (At this), they began to look at one another and said: We fled from the fire to (find refuge with) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and now you order us to enter it). They stood quiet until his anger cooled down and the fire went out. When they returned, they related the incident to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: If they had entered it, they would not have come out. Obedience (to the commander) is obligatory only in what is good.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek muhim bheji aur Mujahids par Ansar ke ek shakhs ko muqarrar kiya. (Taqarruri karte waqt), unhone hukum diya ki unke kaam ki baat suni aur maani jaaye. Unhone unhe ek maamle mein gussa dilaaya. Unhone kaha: Mere liye sookhi lakDi ikattha karo. Unhone unke liye ise ikattha kiya. Phir unhone kaha: Aag jalaao. Unhone (aag) jalaayi. Phir unhone kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe hukum nahi diya ki tum meri baat suno aur (mere hukumon ki) itaat karo? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Aag mein daakhil ho jaao. Raawi kehte hain: (Isper), woh ek-doosre ki taraf dekhne lage aur kaha: Hum aag se bhaage the (Allah ke Rasool SAW ke paas panah lene ke liye) (aur ab tum humein ismein daakhil hone ka hukum de rahe ho). Woh khamosh khade rahe yahan tak ki unka gussa Thanda hua aur aag bujh gayi. Jab woh wapas gaye, unhone ye ghatna Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Agar woh ismein daakhil ho jaate, to woh bahar nahi aa paate. Tabediyat (sardaar ki) sirf usi mein farz hai jo achha ho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of" Ubida who learnt the tradition from his father who, in turn, learnt it from his own father. 'Ubada's grandfather said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took an oath of allegiance from us on our listening to and obeying the orders of our commander in adversity and prosperity, in pleasure and displeasure (and even) when somebody is given preference over us, on our avoiding to dispute the delegation of powers to a person deemed to be a fit recipient thereof (in the eye of one who delegates it) and on our telling the truth in whatever position we be without fearing in the matter ef Allah the reproach of the reproacher.
hi: Ubida ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apne waalid se seekhi jinhone ise apne (khud ke) waalid se seekhi. Ubida ke dada ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse wafadaari ki qasam li humare sardaar ke hukumon ko sunne aur unki itaat karne ke baare mein, mushkil aur samriddhi mein, khushi aur naaraazgi mein (aur bhi) jab kisi ko humpar tarjeeh di jaati hai, humare kisi (munasib maane jaane wale shakhs) ko soonpe gaye ikhtiyaaron ke vitran par jhagda karne se bachne par aur humare, chahe hum kisi bhi haalat mein hon, sach kehne par, is maamle mein Allah ki khaatir kisi bhi taane maarne wale ke taane se na Darte hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubada b. Walid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubada bin Walid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: The same tradition has been handed down through more than one chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek se zyada sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Junida b. Abu Umayya who said: We called upon 'Ubada b. Samit who was ill and said to him: May God give you health I Narrate to us a tradition which God may prove beneficial (to us) and which you have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called us and we took the oath of allegiance to him. Among the injunctions he made binding upon us was: Listening and obedience (to the Amir) in our pleasure and displeasure, in our adversity and prosperity, even when somebody is given preference over us, and without disputing the delegation of powers to a man duly invested with them (Obedience shall be accorded to him in all circumstances) except when you have clear signs of his disbelief in (or disobedience to) God-signs that could be used as a conscientious justification (for non-compliance with his orders).
hi: Junida bin Abu Umayya ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Ubada bin Samit se milne gaye jo bimaar the aur unse kaha: Allah aapko sehat de! Humein ek hadees sunaiye jo Allah humare liye laabhkaari sabit kare aur jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni ho. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bulaaya aur humne unse wafadaari ki qasam li. Un hukumon mein se ek jo unhone humpar bandhak kiye woh ye tha: (Amir ki) baat sunna aur itaat karna humari khushi aur naaraazgi mein, humari mushkil aur samriddhi mein, chahe kisi ko humpar tarjeeh di jaaye, aur kisi aisi shakhs ko soonpe gaye ikhtiyaaron par jhagda kiye bina jo munasib soorat se unhe soonpe gaye hain (Tabediyat use sab paristhitiyon mein di jaayegi) siwaay tab jab tumhe Allah mein uski bewafai (ya naafarmani) ke saaf ishara milein - aise ishara jo (unke hukumon ka anupaalan na karne ke liye) buddhipurassak nyaayik banaaye ja sakein.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: A commander (of the Muslims) is a shield for them. They fight behind him and they are protected by (him from tyrants and aggressors). If he enjoins fear of God, the Exalted and Glorious, and dispenses justice, there will be a (great) reward for him; and if he enjoins otherwise, it redounds on him.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ek (Musalmaanon ka) sardaar unke liye ek dhaal hai. Woh unke peeche larte hain aur unhe (unke ke zariye atyaacharon aur hamlaawaron se) mahfooz kiya jaata hai. Agar woh Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ka Dar aur insaaf laagoo karta hai, to uske liye ek (bada) sawaab hoga; aur agar woh isse doosri tarah karta hai, to iska bura natija usi par padega.

e: It has been narrated by Abu Huraira that the Prophet (may pceace be upon him) said: Banu Isra'il were ruled over by the Prophets. When one Prophet died, another succeeded him; but after me there is no prophet and there will be caliphs and they will be quite large in number. His Companions said: What do you order us to do (in case we come to have more than one Caliph)? He said: The one to whom allegiance is sworn first has a supremacy over the others. Concede to them their due rights (i. e. obey them). God (Himself) will question them about the subjects whom He had entrusted to them.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Banu Isra'il par Nabiyon ka shaasan tha. Jab ek Nabi mar jaate, doosra unki jagah leta; lekin mere baad koi Nabi nahi hoga aur Khalifa honge aur woh kaafi zyada tadaad mein honge. Unke sahaba ne kaha: Aap humein kya hukum dete hain (agar humare paas ek se zyada Khalifa ho jaayein)? Unhone kaha: Jise sabse pehle wafadaari ki qasam di jaati hai use doosron par fazeelat hai. Unhe unke haq diye jaao (yaani unki itaat karo). Allah (Khud) unse prajaa ke baare mein sawaal karega jo Usne unhe soonpi thi.

e: The same tradition has been transmitted by a different chain of narrators.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: After me there will be favouritism and many things that you will not like. They (his Companions) said: Messenger of Allah, what do you order that one should do if anyone from us has to live through such a time? He said: You should discharge your own responsibility (by obeying your Amir), and ask God for your right (by guiding the Amir to the right path or by replacing him by one more just and God-fearing).
hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mere baad pakshpaat hoga aur bahut si cheezein jo tumhe pasand nahi aayengi. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar hummein se koi aisa waqt jeeta hai to aap kya karne ka hukum dete hain? Unhone kaha: Tumhe apni zimmedaari poori karni chahiye (apne Amir ki itaat karke), aur Allah se apna haq maangna chahiye (Amir ko sahi raah dikhaakar ya use kisi zyada insaaf-pasand aur Allah se darne wale se badalkar).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abd Rabb al-Ka'ba who said: I entered the mosque when 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As was sitting in the shade of the Ka'ba and the people had gathered around him. I betook myself to them and sat near him. (Now) Abdullah said: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey. We halted at a place. Some of us began to set right their tents, others began to compete with one another in shooting, and others began to graze their beasts, when an announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) announced that the people should gather together for prayer, so we gathered around the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: It was the duty of every Prophet that has gone before me to guide his followers to what he knew was good for them and warn them against what he knew was bad for them; but this Umma of yours has its days of peace and (security) in the beginning of its career, and in the last phase of its existence it will be afflicted with trials and with things disagreeable to you. (In this phase of the Umma), there will be tremendous trials one after the other, each making the previous one dwindle into insignificance. When they would be afflicted with a trial, the believer would say: This is going to bring about my destruction. When at (the trial) is over, they would be afflicted with another trial, and the believer would say: This surely is going to be my end. Whoever wishes to be delivered from the fire and enter the garden should die with faith in Allah and the Last Day and should treat the people as he wishes to be treated by them. He who swears allegiance to a Caliph should give him the piedge of his hand and the sincerity of his heart (i. e. submit to him both outwardly as well as inwardly). He should obey him to the best of his capacity. It another man comes forward (as a claimant to Caliphate), disputing his authority, they (the Muslims) should behead the latter. The narrator says: I came close to him ('Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As) and said to him: Can you say on oath that you heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He pointed with his hands to his ears and his heart and said: My ears heard it and my mind retained it. I said to him: This cousin of yours, Mu'awiya, orders us to unjustly consume our wealth among ourselves and to kill one another, while Allah says:" O ye who believe, do not consume your wealth among yourselves unjustly, unless it be trade based on mutual agreement, and do not kill yourselves. Verily, God is Merciful to you" (iv. 29). The narrator says that (hearing this) Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-As kept quiet for a while and then said: Obey him in so far as he is obedient to God; and diqobey him in matters involving disobedience to God.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abd Rabb al-Ka'ba ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main masjid mein daakhil hua jab Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As Kaaba ki chhaaya mein baithe the aur log unke aas-paas ikattha the. Main unke paas gaya aur unke qareeb baitha. (Ab) Abdullah ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein gaya. Hum ek jagah ruke. Hummein se kuch apne khaime theek karne lage, doosre teeraandaazi mein ek-doosre se muqaabla karne lage, aur doosre apne jaanwar charaane lage, jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki log namaz ke liye ikattha ho jaayein, is liye hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aas-paas ikattha hue. Unhone kaha: Ye mujhse pehle guzre har Nabi ka farz raha hai ki woh apne anuyaayiyon ko us cheez ki taraf margdarshit karein jo woh jaanta tha unke liye achha hai aur unhe us cheez se chetaavni dein jo woh jaanta tha unke liye bura hai; lekin tumhari ye Ummat apni safar ke shuru mein shaanti aur (hifaazat) ke din rakhti hai, aur iske wajood ke aakhri charan mein isse pareekshaon aur tumhe napasand cheezon se pareshaan kiya jaayega. (Ummat ke is charan mein), lagataar ek ke baad ek bahut badi pareekshaen aayengi, har ek pichhli ko chhoti banaate hue. Jab woh kisi pareeksha se pareshaan honge, imaandaar kahega: Ye mere tabaahi ka wajah banega. Jab woh (pareeksha) khatm ho jaati hai, unhe ek doosri pareeksha se pareshaan kiya jaayega, aur imaandaar kahega: Ye yaqeenan mera anjaam hoga. Jo bhi aag se bacha aur baag mein daakhil hona chahta hai use Allah aur Aakhri Din par imaan rakhkar marna chahiye aur logon ke saath waisa hi vyavahaar karna chahiye jaisa woh chaahta hai woh usse karein. Jo koi Khalifa se wafadaari ki qasam khaata hai use unhe apne haath ka wachan aur apne dil ki eemaandaari deni chahiye (yaani unhe bahar aur andar donon taraf se maanna chahiye). Use apni poori taqat se unki itaat karni chahiye. Agar koi doosra shakhs aage aata hai (Khilafat ka daawedaar bankar), unke haq par jhagda karte hue, unhe (Musalmaanon ko) baad wale ka sar kaat dena chahiye. Raawi kehte hain: Main unke (Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ke) qareeb aaya aur unse kaha: Kya aap qasam khaakar keh sakte hain ki aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Unhone apne haathon se apne kaanon aur apne dil ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: Mere kaanon ne ise suna aur mere dimaag ne ise rakha. Maine unse kaha: Aapke ye chachere bhai, Muawiya, humein hukum dete hain ki hum apas mein apni daulat na-munasib soorat se kharch karein aur ek-doosre ko qatal karein, jabki Allah kehta hai: "Aye imaan waalo, apni daulat apas mein na-munasib soorat se kharch mat karo, siwaay iske ki ye saanjhi sehmati par mabni vyaapaar ho, aur apne aap ko qatal mat karo. Yaqeenan, Allah tumpar Rehmvaan hai" (4:29). Raawi kehte hain ki (ye sunkar) Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As kuch der khamosh rahe aur phir kaha: Unki itaat karo jab tak woh Allah ki itaat mein hai; aur unki naafarmani karo un maamlon mein jo Allah ki naafarmani ki taraf le jaate hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd Rabb al-Ka'ba as-Sa'idl who said: I saw a group of people near the Ka'ba.... Then he narrated the tradition as narrated by A'mash.
hi: Abd Rabb al-Ka'ba as-Sa'idl ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine logon ka ek giroh Kaaba ke qareeb dekha.... Phir unhone hadees riwayat ki jaisi A'mash ne riwayat ki thi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Usaid b. Hudair that a man from the Ansar took the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) aside and said to him: Will you not appoint me governor as you have appointed so and so? He (the Messenger of Allah) said: You will surely come across preferential treatment after me, so you should be patient until you meet me at the Cistern (Haud-i-Kauthar).
hi: Usaid bin Hudair ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko alag le jaakar unse kaha: Kya aap mujhe gavarnar muqarrar nahi karenge jaise aapne falan-falan ko kiya hai? Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Tumhe mere baad zaroor pakshapaat waala vyavahaar mile ga, is liye tumhe sabar karna chahiye jab tak tum mujhse Haud-i-Kauthar par mile.

e: This tradition has been narrated on the same authority through a different chain of transmitters. Another version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Shu'ba does not include the words: " He took the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) aside."
hi: Yehi riwayat isi raawi ke zariye ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek doosra soorat in alfaazon ko shaamil nahi karta: "Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko alag le jaaya."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Alqama b. Wai'l al-Hadrami who learnt the tradition from his father. The latter said: Salama b. Yazid al-ju'afi asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Prophet of Allah, what do you think if we have rulers who rule over us and demand that we discharge our obligations towards them, but they (themselves) do not discharge their own responsibilities towards us? What do you order us to do? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) avoided giving any answer. Salama asked him again. He (again) avoided giving any answer. Then he asked again-it was the second time or the third time-when Ash'ath b. Qais (finding that the Prophet was unnecessarily being pressed for answer) pulled him aside and said: Listen to them and obey them, for on them shall he their burden and on you shall be your burden.
hi: Alqama bin Wai'l al-Hadrami ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apne waalid se seekhi. Baad wale ne kaha: Salama bin Yazid al-Ju'afi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Allah ke Nabi, aap kya sochte hain agar hamare shaasak hon jo humpar shaasan karein aur maang karein ki hum unke prati apni zimmedaariyaan poori karein, lekin woh (khud) humare prati apni zimmedaariyaan poori na karein? Aap humein kya karne ka hukum dete hain? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne koi bhi jawaab dene se bacha. Salama ne unse dobara poocha. Unhone (phir) koi jawaab dene se bacha. Phir unhone dobara poocha - ye doosri baar ya teesri baar thi - jab Ash'ath bin Qais ne (ye dekhkar ki Nabi ko jawaab ke liye anaavashyak soorat se dabaava daala ja raha tha) unhe alag kheenchaa aur kaha: Unki baat suno aur unki itaat karo, kyunki unpar unka bojh hoga aur tumpar tumhara bojh hoga.

e: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters, on the authority of Simak who said: Ash'ath b. Qais pulled him (Salama b. Yazid) when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Listen to them and obey them, for on them shall be the burden of what they do and on you shall be the burden of what you do.
