hi: Simak ke hawale se ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ash'ath bin Qais ne unhe (Salama bin Yazid) kheencha jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unki baat suno aur unki itaat karo, kyunki unpar unke amal ka bojh hoga aur tumpar tumhare amal ka bojh hoga.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman who said: People used to ask the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the good times, but I used to ask him about bad times fearing lest they overtake me. I said: Messenger of Allah, we were in the midst of ignorance and evil, and then God brought us this good (time through Islam). Is there any bad time after this good one? He said: Yes. I asked: Will there be a good time again after that bad time? He said: Yes, but therein will be a hidden evil. I asked: What will be the evil hidden therein? He said: (That time will witness the rise of) the people who will adopt ways other than mine and seek guidance other than mine. You will know good points as well as bad points. I asked: Will there be a bad time after this good one? He said: Yes. (A time will come) when there will be people standing and inviting at the gates of Hell. Whoso responds to their call they will throw them into the fire. I said: Messenger of Allah, describe them for us. He said: All right. They will be a people having the same complexion as ours and speaking our language. I said: Messenger of Allah, what do you suggest if I happen to live in that time? He said: You should stick to the main body of the Muslims and their leader. I said: If they have no (such thing as the) main body and have no leader? He said: Separate yourself from all these factions, though you may have to eat the roots of trees (in a jungle) until death comes to you and you are in this state.
hi: Hudhaifa bin al-Yaman ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se achhe daur ke baare mein poochte the, lekin main unse buray daur ke baare mein poochta tha is dar se ki woh kahin mujhe pareshaan na kar den. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum jaahiliyat aur burai ke beech the, aur phir Allah ne Islam ke zariye humein ye achha daur diya. Kya is achhe daur ke baad koi bura daur bhi hoga? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine poocha: Kya us buray daur ke baad phir achha daur aayega? Unhone kaha: Haan, lekin usmein ek chhupi hui burai hogi. Maine poocha: Us chhupi hui burai mein kya hoga? Unhone kaha: (Us daur mein) aise log honge jo mere raaste ke ilawa doosre raaste apnaayenge aur mere margdarshan ke ilawa doosra margdarshan dhoondenge. Tum achhi baaton ke saath-saath buri baaten bhi jaan paaoge. Maine poocha: Kya is achhe daur ke baad koi bura daur hoga? Unhone kaha: Haan. (Ek aisa waqt aayega) jab log Jahannam ke darwazon par khade hokar bulaayenge. Jo unke aahvaan ka jawaab dega use woh aag mein daal denge. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein unka vivaran dijiye. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. Woh humari hi tarah rangat wale honge aur humari bhaasha bolenge. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar main us daur mein jeevit rahoon to aap kya mashwara dete hain? Unhone kaha: Tumhe Musalmaanon ke jamaat aur unke agua se chipke rehna chahiye. Maine kaha: Agar unke paas (aisa koi) jamaat na ho aur na koi agua ho? Unhone kaha: To in sab giroh se khud ko alag kar lo, chahe tumhe (jungal mein) darakhton ki jaDein khaani padein jab tak tumhe maut na aa jaaye aur tum is haalat mein ho.

e: It his been narrated through a different chain of transmitters, on the authority of Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman who said: Messenger of Allah, no doubt, we had an evil time (i. e. the days of Jahiliyya or ignorance) and God brought us a good time (i. e. Islamic period) through which we are now living Will there be a bad time after this good time? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. I said: Will there be a good time after this bad time? He said: Yes. I said: Will there be a bad time after good time? He said: Yes. I said: How? Whereupon he said: There will be leaders who will not be led by my guidance and who will not adopt my ways? There will be among them men who will have the hearts of devils in the bodies of human beings. I said: What should I do. Messenger of Allah, if I (happen) to live in that time? He replied: You will listen to the Amir and carry out his orders; even if your back is flogged and your wealth is snatched, you should listen and obey.
hi: Hudhaifa bin al-Yaman ke hawale se ek doosri sanad ke zariye ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, koi shak nahi, humara ek bura daur tha (yaani Jaahiliyat ya agyanta ke din) aur Allah humare paas ek achha daur laaya (yaani Islami daur) jismein hum ab reh rahe hain. Kya is achhe daur ke baad koi bura daur hoga? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya is buray daur ke baad koi achha daur hoga? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya achhe daur ke baad koi bura daur hoga? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kaise? Isper unhone kaha: Aise agua honge jo mere margdarshan se margdarshit nahi honge aur jo mere raaston ko nahi apnaayenge? Unmein aise log honge jinke sharirik soorat mein shaitaanon ke dil honge. Maine kaha: Mujhe kya karna chahiye. Allah ke Rasool, agar main (kabhi) us daur mein jeevit rahun? Unhone jawaab diya: Tum Amir ki baat sunoge aur uske hukumon ka paalan karoge; chahe tumhari peeth par koda maara jaaye aur tumhari daulat cheeni jaaye, tumhe baat sunni chahiye aur itaat karni chahiye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who defected from obedience (to the Amir) and separated from the main body of the Muslims - if he died in that state-would die the death of one belonging to the days of Jahiliyya (i.e. would not die as a Muslim). One who fights under the banner of a people who are blind (to the cause for which they are fighting, i.e. do not know whether their cause is just or otherwise), who gets flared up with family pride, calls (people) to fight for their family honour, and supports his kith and kin (i.e. fights not for the cause of Allah but for the sake of this family or tribe) - if he is killed (in this fight), he dies as one belonging to the days of Jahiliyya. Whoso attacks my Ummah (indiscriminately) killing the righteous and the wicked of them, sparing not (even) those staunch in faith and fulfilling not his promise made with those who have been given a pledge of security - he has nothing to do with me and I have nothing to do with him.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jisne (Amir ki) itaat se munh moda aur Musalmaanon ke jamaat se alag ho gaya - agar woh us haalat mein mara - to woh Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs jaisi maut mareega (yaani ek Musalman ki tarah nahi mareega). Jo aise logon ke jhande ke neeche larta hai jo andhe hain (jis maqsad ke liye woh lad rahe hain, yaani nahi jaante ki unka maqsad sahi hai ya galat), jo khaandaani ghamand se bhad kar jaata hai, logon ko unke khaandaani samman ke liye larne ke liye bulaata hai, aur apne khoon-rishtedaaron ka himayat karta hai (yaani Allah ki khaatir nahi balki is khaandaan ya qabile ki khaatir larta hai) - agar woh (is jung mein) maara jaata hai, to woh Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs ki tarah marta hai. Jo koi meri Ummat par (bina bhedbhaav ke) hamla karta hai, unmein se nekokaar aur bure logon ko qatal karta hai, unmein se dridh imaan waalon ko bhi nahi bakhshta aur un logon ke saath kiya vaada poora nahi karta jinhe hifaazat ka aashwaasan diya gaya hai - use mujhse koi lena-dena nahi hai aur mujhe usse koi lena-dena nahi hai.

e: The same tradition has been narrated by the same authority through another chain of transmitters with a slight difference in wording.
hi: Yehi riwayat isi raawi ke zariye ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever defects from obedience (to the Amir) and separates from the main body of the Muslim - and dies in that state - dies the death of one belonging to the days of jahiliyya. And he who is killed under the banner of a man who is blind (to the cause for which he is fighting), who gets flared up with family pride and fights for his tribe is not from my Ummah, and whosoever from my followers attacks my followers (indiscriminately) killing the righteous and the wicked of them, sparing not (even) those staunch in faith and fulfilling not his obligation towards them who have been given a pledge (of security), is not from me (i.e. is not my follower).
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi (Amir ki) itaat se munh moDta hai aur Musalman ke jamaat se alag ho jaata hai - aur us haalat mein marta hai - Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs ki tarah marta hai. Aur jo aise aadmi ke jhande ke neeche qatal kiya jaata hai jo andha hai (jis maqsad ke liye woh lad raha hai), jo khaandaani ghamand se bhad kar jaata hai aur apne qabile ke liye larta hai woh meri Ummat se nahi hai, aur jo koi mere anuyaayiyon mein se mere anuyaayiyon par (bina bhedbhaav ke) hamla karta hai, unmein se nekokaar aur bure logon ko qatal karta hai, unmein se dridh imaan waalon ko bhi nahi bakhshta aur un logon ke prati apni zimmedaari poori nahi karta jinhe hifaazat ka vaada diya gaya hai, woh mujhse nahi hai (yaani woh mera anuyaayi nahi hai).

e: This hadlth has been narrated on the authority of Jarir with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation in wording.
hi: Ye hadees Jarir ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who found in his Amir something which he disliked should hold his patience, for one who separated from the main body of the Muslims even to the extent of a handspan and then he died would die the death of one belonging to the days of Jahiliyya.
hi: Ibn Abbas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jise apne Amir mein kuch napasand milta hai use sabar rakhna chahiye, kyunki jo Musalmaanon ke jamaat se ek bitte bhar bhi alag hua aur phir mar gaya, woh Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs jaisi maut mareega.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upoh him) said: One who dislikes a thing done by his Amir should be patient over it, for anyone from the people who withdraws (his obedience) from the government, even to the extent of a handspan and died in that conditions, would die the death of one belonging to the days of jahilliyya.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Ibn Abbas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo apne Amir ke zariye kiye gaye kisi kaam ko napasand karta hai use uspar sabar karna chahiye, kyunki logon mein se koi bhi jo sarkaar se (apni itaat) waapas leta hai, chahe ek bitte bhar bhi, aur us haalat mein marta hai, Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs jaisi maut mareega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abdullah al-Bajali that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who is killed under the banner of a man who is blind (to his just cause), who raises the slogan of family or supports his own tribe, dies the death of one belonging to the days of Jahiliyya.
hi: Ibn Abdullah al-Bajali ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo aise aadmi ke jhande ke neeche qatal kiya jaata hai jo andha hai (apne munasib maqsad ke prati), jo khaandaan ya apne qabile ke himayat ka naara buland karta hai, Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs jaisi maut marta hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Nafi, that 'Abdullah b. Umar paid a visit to Abdullah b. Muti' in the days (when atrocities were perpetrated on the People Of Medina) at Harra in the time of Yazid b. Mu'awiya. Ibn Muti' said: Place a pillow for Abu 'Abd al-Rahman (family name of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar). But the latter said: I have not come to sit with you. I have come to you to tell you a tradition I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I heard him say: One who withdraws his band from obedience (to the Amir) will find no argument (in his defence) when he stands before Allah on the Day of Judgment, and one who dies without having bound himself by an oath of allegiance (to an Amir) will die the death of one belonging to the days of Jahillyya.
hi: Nafi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Abdullah bin Umar Abdullah bin Muti se milne gaye un dinon (jab Madina ke logon par Harra mein atyaachaar kiye ja rahe the) Yazid bin Muawiya ke daur mein. Ibn Muti ne kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman (Abdullah bin Umar ke khaandaan ka naam) ke liye ek takiya rakho. Lekin baad wale ne kaha: Main tumhare saath baithne nahi aaya. Main tumhare paas ek hadees bataane aaya hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni. Maine unhe ye kehte suna: Jo apna haath (Amir ki) itaat se waapas leta hai use koi dalil (apne bachaav mein) nahi milegi jab woh Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne khada hoga, aur jo kisi Amir se wafadaari ki qasam liye bina marta hai woh Jaahiliyat ke daur se mutaliq shakhs jaisi maut mareega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that he visited Ibn Muti', and related from the Prophet (ﷺ) the tradition that has gone before.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki woh Ibn Muti se milne gaye aur unhone Nabi (SAW) se hadees riwayat ki jo pehle guzar chuki hai.

e: The same tradition has been transmitted by a different chain of narrators.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Arfaja who said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Different evils will make their appearance in the near future. Anyone who tries to disrupt the affairs of this Umma while they are united you should strike him with the sword whoever he be. (If remonstrance does not prevail with him and he does not desist from his disruptive activities, he is to be killed.)
hi: Arfaja ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Nazdeeki mustaqbil mein mukhtalif buraayian pragat hongi. Jo koi is Ummat ke maamlon ko baantne ki koshish karta hai jabki woh ekjut hain, use talwaar se maaro chahe woh koi bhi ho. (Agar samjhaane se woh nahi maanta aur apni bikhraav wali gatividhiyaan nahi chhodta, to use qatal kar diya jaana chahiye.)

e: In another version of the tradition narrated on the same authority through a different chains of transmitters we have the words: " Kill him."
hi: Isi raawi ki riwayat ke doosre soorat mein, jo ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, humare paas alfaaz hain: "Use qatal karo."

e: It has been narrated (through a still different chain of transmitters) on the Same authority (i. e. 'Arfaja) who said similarly-but adding: " Kill all of them." I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When you are holding to one single man as your leader, you should kill who seeks to undermine your solidarity or disrupt your unity.
hi: Isi raawi (yaani Arfaja) se, ek phir bhi doosri sanad ke zariye, ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone isi jaisi baat kahi - lekin ye izafa kiya: "Unhe sabko qatal karo." Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum ek hi shakhs ko apna agua maankar chipke ho, use qatal karo jo tumhari ekta ko kamzor ya baantne ki koshish kare.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Aba Sa'id al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When oath of allegiance has been taken for two caliphs, kill the one for whom the oath was taken later.
hi: Aba Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab do Khalifaon ki wafadaari ki qasam li gayi ho, to us shakhs ko qatal karo jiske liye qasam baad mein li gayi thi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Umm Salama that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: In the near future there will be Amirs and you will like their good deeds and dislike their bad deeds. One who sees through their bad deeds (and tries to prevent their repetition by his band or through his speech), is absolved from blame, but one who hates their bad deeds (in the heart of his heart, being unable to prevent their recurrence by his hand or his tongue), is (also) fafe ( so far as God's wrath is concerned). But one who approves of their bad deeds and imitates them is spiritually ruined. People asked (the Holy Prophet): Shouldn't we fight against them? He replied: No, as long as they say their prayers.
hi: Umm Salama ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nazdeeki mustaqbil mein Amir honge aur tum unke nek karyon ko pasand karoge aur unke bure karyon ko napasand karoge. Jo unke bure karyon ko dekhta hai (aur apne haath ya apne bhaashan ke zariye unke dohraav ko rokne ki koshish karta hai), woh dosh se azad hai, lekin jo unke bure karyon se ghrina karta hai (apne dil ki gehraayi mein, apne haath ya zabaan se unki punaraavritti rokne mein asamarth hote hue), (bhi) mahfooz hai (Allah ke gusse ki fikar jahan tak hai). Lekin jo unke bure karyon ko manzoori deta hai aur unki nakal karta hai, aadhyaatmik soorat se barbaad ho jaata hai. Logon ne (Nabi-e-Paak se) poocha: Kya humein unke khilaaf jung nahi karni chahiye? Unhone jawaab diya: Nahi, jab tak woh apni namaz padhte hain.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tmnamitters) on the authority of Umm Salama (wife of the Holy Prophet) that he said: Amirs will be appointed over you, and you will find them doing good as well as bad deeds. One who hates their bad deeds is absolved from blame. One who disapproves of their bad deeds is (also) safe (so far as Divine wrath is concerned). But one who approves of their bad deeds and imitates them (is doomed). People asked: Messenger of Allah, shouldn't we fight against them? He replied: No, as long as they say their prayer. (" Hating and disapproving" refers to liking and disliking from the heart.)
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Umm Salama (Nabi-e-Paak ki zauja) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone kaha: Tumpar Amir muqarrar kiye jaayenge, aur tum unhe achhe aur bure kaam karte paaoge. Jo unke bure karyon se ghrina karta hai woh dosh se azad hai. Jo unke bure karyon ko napasand karta hai woh (bhi) mahfooz hai (Ilaahi gusse ke silsile mein). Lekin jo unke bure karyon ko manzoori deta hai aur unki nakal karta hai (barbaad hai). Logon ne poocha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein unke khilaaf jung nahi karni chahiye? Unhone jawaab diya: Nahi, jab tak woh apni namaz padhte hain. ("Ghrina aur napasandi" dil se pasand aur napasand ko darshaata hai.)

e: Another version of the tradition narrated on the same authority attributes the same words to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) except that it replaces kariha with ankhara and vice versa.
hi: Isi raawi ke zariye riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek doosra soorat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke wahi alfaaz maanta hai siwaay is baat ke ki isme kariha ki jagah ankhara istemal kiya gaya hai aur vice versa.

e: Another version omits a portion at the end of the tradition-a portion which begins with man radiya wa taba and ends with the last word of the tradition.
hi: Riwayat ka ek doosra soorat hadees ke aakhri hisse ko chhoDta hai - ek hissa jo man radiya wa taba se shuru hota hai aur hadees ke aakhri lafz par khatm hota hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Auf b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The best of your rulers are those whom you love and who love you, who invoke God's blessings upon you and you invoke His blessings upon them. And the worst of your rulers are those whom you hate and who hate you and whom you curse and who curse you. It was asked (by those present): Shouldn't we overthrow them with the help of the sword? He said: No, as long as they establish prayer among you. If you then find anything detestable in them. You should hate their administration, but do not withdraw yourselves from their obedience.
hi: Auf bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhare sabse achhe shaasak woh hain jinse tum muhabbat karte ho aur jo tumse muhabbat karte hain, jo Allah se tumhare liye barkatein maangte hain aur tum unke liye Uski barkatein maangte ho. Aur tumhare sabse bure shaasak woh hain jinse tum ghrina karte ho aur jo tumse ghrina karte hain aur jinhe tum bura bhala kehte ho aur jo tumhe bura bhala kehte hain. Poocha gaya (maujood logon ke zariye): Kya humein unhe talwaar ki madad se hataana nahi chahiye? Unhone kaha: Nahi, jab tak woh tum mein namaz sthapit karte hain. Agar tumhe unmein koi ghinaunI baat mile, to tumhe unke prashaasan se ghrina karni chahiye, lekin tumhe unki itaat se khud ko waapas nahi lena chahiye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Auf b. Malik al-Ashja'i who said that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The best of your rulers are those whom you love and who love you, upon whom you invoke God's blessings and who invoke His blessing upon you. And the worst of your rulers are those whom you hate and who hate you, who curse you and whom you curse. (Those present) said: Shouldn't we overthrow them at this? He said: No, as long as they establish prayer among you. No, as long as they establish prayer among you. Mind you! One who has a governor appointed over him and he finds that the governor indulges in an act of disobedience to God, he should condemn the governor's act, in disobedience to God, but should not withdraw himself from his obedience. Ibn Jabir said: Ruzaiq narrated to me this hadith. I asked him: Abu Miqdam, have you heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza or did he describe it to you and he heard it from 'Auf (b. Malik) and he transmitted this tradition of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Upon this Ruzaiq sat upon his knees and facing the Qibla said: By Allah, besides Whom there is no other God, I heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza and he said that te had heard it from Auf (b. Malik) and he said that he had heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Auf bin Malik al-Ashja'i ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhare sabse achhe shaasak woh hain jinse tum muhabbat karte ho aur jo tumse muhabbat karte hain, jinke liye tum Allah se barkatein maangte ho aur jo tumhare liye Uski barkatein maangte hain. Aur tumhare sabse bure shaasak woh hain jinse tum ghrina karte ho aur jo tumse ghrina karte hain, jo tumhe bura bhala kehte hain aur jinhe tum bura bhala kehte ho. (Maujood logon ne) kaha: Kya humein unhe isper uThA nahi dena chahiye? Unhone kaha: Nahi, jab tak woh tum mein namaz sthapit karte hain. Nahi, jab tak woh tum mein namaz sthapit karte hain. Dhyaan raho! Jiska koi gavarnar muqarrar hai aur woh paata hai ki gavarnar Allah ki naafarmani ka koi kaam kar raha hai, use gavarnar ke us amal ki burai karni chahiye, Allah ki naafarmani mein, lekin use apni itaat se khud ko waapas nahi lena chahiye. Ibn Jabir ne kaha: Ruzaiq ne mujhe ye hadees riwayat ki. Maine unse poocha: Abu Miqdam, kya aapne ise Muslim bin Qaraza se suna ya unhone ise aapko bataaya aur unhone ise Auf (bin Malik) se suna aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ye hadees riwayat ki? Isper Ruzaiq apne ghutnon par baithe aur Qibla ka rukh karke kaha: Allah ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi doosra Ma'bood nahi hai, maine ise Muslim bin Qaraza se suna aur unhone kaha ki unhone ise Auf (bin Malik) se suna tha aur unhone kaha ki unhone ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna tha.

e: The above hadith has been narrated through addtional chains of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees atirikt sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir who said: We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Hudaibiya. We swore fealty to hiin (the Holy Prophet) and 'Umar was holding the latter's hand (when he was sitting) under the tree (called) Samura (to administer the oath to the Companions). The narrator added: We took oath to the effect that we would not flee (from the battlefield if there was an encounter with the Meccans), but we did not take oath to fight to death.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Hudaibiya ke din ek hazaar chaar sau the. Humne unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) wafadaari ki qasam li aur Umar unka haath pakde hue the (jab woh) Samura (naamak) darakht ke neeche baithe the (sahaba ko qasam dilaane ke liye). Raawi ne izafa kiya: Humne ye qasam li ki hum bhaagenge nahi (jung ke maidaan se agar Makkah walon se muqaabla ho), lekin humne maut tak larne ki qasam nahi li.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Jabir who said: While swearing fealty to the Prophet (ﷺ) we did not take the oath to death but that we would not run away (from the battlefield).
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam khaate waqt humne maut tak ki qasam nahi li thi balki ye ki hum bhaagenge nahi (jung ke maidaan se).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zubair who heard Jabir being questioned as to how many people were there on the Day of Hudaibiya. He replied: We were fourteen hundred. We swore fealty to him, and Umar was holding his hand while he was sitting under the tree (to administer the oath). The tree was a samura (a wild tree found in deserts). All of as took the oath of fealty at his hands except Jadd b. Qais al-Ansari who hid himself under the belly of his camel.
hi: Abu Zubair ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Jabir se poochha jaate hue suna ki Hudaibiya ke din kitne log the. Unhone jawaab diya: Hum chaudah sau the. Humne unse wafadaari ki qasam li, aur Umar unka haath pakde hue the jab woh darakht ke neeche baithe the (qasam dilaane ke liye). Darakht ek samura tha (registaan mein paaya jaane wala ek jangli darakht). Humme se sabne unke haathon par wafadaari ki qasam li siwaay Jadd bin Qais al-Ansari ke jo apne oont ke pet ke neeche chhipe rahe.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Zubair who heard Jabir being questioned as to whether the Prophet (ﷺ) took the oath of fealty at Dhu'l-Hulaifa. He said: No! But he offered his prayers at that place, and he administered the oath of fealty nowhere except near the tree in (the plain oo Hudaibiya. Ibn Juraij said that he was informed by Abu Zabair who heard Jabir b. Abdullah say: The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed over the well at Hudaibiya (as a result of which its scanty water rose up and increased so as to be sufficient for the 1400 or 1500 men who had encamped at the place).
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Zubair ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Jabir se poochha jaate hue suna ki kya Nabi (SAW) ne Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein wafadaari ki qasam li. Unhone kaha: Nahi! Lekin unhone us jagah apni namaz padhi, aur unhone kahin bhi wafadaari ki qasam nahi li siwaay Hudaibiya ke maidaan mein darakht ke qareeb. Ibn Juraij ne kaha ki unhe Abu Zabair ne bataaya jinhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna: Nabi (SAW) ne Hudaibiya mein kuen par dua ki (jiske natije mein iska kam paani uThA aur badh gaya taaki ye 1400 ya 1500 aadmiyon ke liye kaafi ho jo us jagah tikte hue the).

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Jabir who said: We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Hudaibiya when the Prophet (ﷺ) said to us: Today you are the best people on the earth. And Jabir said: If I had the eyesight, I could show you the place of the tree.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Hudaibiya ke din ek hazaar chaar sau the jab Nabi (SAW) ne humse kaha: Aaj tum zameen par sabse behtareen log ho. Aur Jabir ne kaha: Agar mujhme nazar hoti, to main tumhe darakht ki jagah dikha sakta.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Salim b. Abu al-Ja'd who said: I asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah about the number of the Companions (of the Prophet who took the oath of fealty under) the tree. He said: If we were a hundred thousand, it (i. e. the water in the well at Hudaibiya) would have sufficed us, but actually we were one thousand and five hundred.
hi: Salim bin Abu al-Ja'd ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah se sahaba ki tadaad poochi (jinhone darakht ke neeche wafadaari ki qasam li thi). Unhone kaha: Agar hum ek lakh hote, to ye (yaani Hudaibiya ke kuen ka paani) humare liye kaafi hota, lekin waastav mein hum ek hazaar paanch sau the.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir who said: If we had been a hundred thousand in number, it (the water) would have sufficed us, but actually we were fifteen hundred.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Agar hum tadaad mein ek lakh hote, to ye (paani) humare liye kaafi hota, lekin waastav mein hum pandrah sau the.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Salim b. al-Ja'd who said: I asked Jabir: How many were you on the Day of Hudaibiya? He said: One thousand and four hundred.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Salim bin al-Ja'd ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Jabir se poocha: Hudaibiya ke din aap kitne the? Unhone kaha: Ek hazaar chaar sau.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa who said: The Companions of the Tree (i e. those who swore fealty under the tree) were one thousand and three hundred, and the people of Aslam tribe were one-eighth of the Muhajirs.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Darakht ke saathi (yaani woh jinhone darakht ke neeche wafadaari ki qasam li) ek hazaar teen sau the, aur Aslam qabile ke log Muhajirin ka aaThavaan hissa the.

e: The same tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ma'qil b. Yasar who aaid: I remember being present on the Day of the Tree, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was taking the oath of the people and I was holding a twig of the tree over his head. We were fourteen hundred (in number). We did not take oath to the death, but to the effect that we would not run away from the battlefield.
hi: Ma'qil bin Yasar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mujhe Darakht ke din maujood rehna yaad hai, aur Nabi (SAW) logon ki qasam le rahe the aur main unke sar ke upar darakht ki ek Tahani pakde hue tha. Hum chaudah sau the (tadaad mein). Humne maut tak ki qasam nahi li, balki ye ki hum jung ke maidaan se bhaagenge nahi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyab who said: My father was one of those who swore fealty to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) near the tree. When we passed that way next year intending to perform the Hajj, the place of the tree was hidden to us. If you could point out clearly, you would (certainly) be knowing better. 
It has also been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib who learnt from his father that they were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of the Tree (i. e. in the year of the fealty of God's pleasure sworn under the tree at Hudaibiya), but next year they forgot the spot of the tree.
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyab ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mere waalid un logon mein se ek the jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se darakht ke qareeb wafadaari ki qasam li. Jab hum agle saal usi raaste se Hajj karne ke iraade se guzre, darakht ki jagah humse chhipi hui thi. Agar tum use saaf taur par dikha sakte, to tumhe zaroor (mujhse) zyada pata hota. Ye bhi Sa'id bin Musayyib se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne waalid se seekha ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Darakht ke saal mein the (yaani Hudaibiya mein darakht ke neeche Allah ki khushi ki wafadaari ki qasam ke saal mein), lekin agle saal woh darakht ki jagah bhool gaye.

e: The tradition has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib who learnt it from his father. The latter said: I had seen the tree. When I came to the spot afterwards, I could not recognise it.
hi: Ye riwayat Sa'id bin Musayyib ke hawale se hai jinhone ise apne waalid se seekha. Baad wale ne kaha: Maine darakht dekha tha. Jab main baad mein us jagah aaya, main use pehchaan nahi paaya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Abu Ubaid (the freed slave of Salama b. al-Akwa') who said: 1 asked Salama as to what effect he had sworn fealty to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Hudaibiya. He said: To the effect that we will die fighting.
hi: Yazid bin Abu Ubaid (Salama bin al-Akwa ke aazad kiye hue ghulam) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Salama se poocha ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Hudaibiya ke din kis maayne mein wafadaari ki qasam li thi. Unhone kaha: Is maayne mein ki hum lade-lade marenge.

e: The above tradition has also been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Zaid who said: A person came to him and said: Here is Ibn Hanzala who is making people swear allegiance to him. He (, Abdullah) asked: To what effect? He replied: To the effect that they will die for him. 'Abdullah said: I will never swear allegiance to this effect after the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Ye rahe Ibn Hanzala jo logon se apni wafadaari ki qasam le rahe hain. Unhone (Abdullah ne) poocha: Kis maayne mein? Usne jawaab diya: Is maayne mein ki woh unke liye maroge. Abdullah ne kaha: Main is maayne mein kabhi wafadaari ki qasam nahi lunga Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baad.

e: It has been narrated by Salama b. al-Akwa' that he visited al-Hajjaj who said to him: O son of al-Akwa', you have turned apostate and have come to live again in the desert with the Bedouins (after your migration). He said: No, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has permitted me to live in the desert.
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone al-Hajjaj se mulaqaat ki jinhone unse kaha: Aye al-Akwa ke bete, tumne apna deen chhoD diya hai aur (apni hijrat ke baad) phir se registaan mein Bedouin ke saath rehne aaye ho. Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe registaan mein rehne ki ijazat di hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Mujashi' b. Mas'ud as-Sulami who said: I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) to offer him my pledge of migration. He said: The period of migration has expired (and those who wereto get the reward for this great act of devotion have got it). You may now give your pledge to serve the cause of Islam, to strive in the way of Allah and to follow the path of virtue.
hi: Mujashi bin Mas'ud as-Sulami ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya unhe apni hijrat ki wafadaari ki qasam dene. Unhone kaha: Hijrat ki muddat khatam ho chuki hai (aur jinhe is bade deeni lagan bhare kaam ka sawaab paana tha unhe woh mil chuka hai). Ab tum Islam ke maqsad ki khidmat karne ki, Allah ki raah mein koshish karne ki aur nekokaari ke raaste ka anusaran karne ki qasam de sakte ho.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Mujashi' b. Mas'ud who said: I brought my brother Abu Ma'bad to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) after the conquest of Mecca and said: Messenger of Allah, allow him to swear his pledge of migration at your hand. He said: The period of migration is over with those who had to do it (and now nobody can get this meritorious distinctions) I said: For what actions will you allow him to bind himself in oath? He said: (He can do so) for serving the cause of Islam, for fighting in the way of Allah and for fighting in the cause of virtue. Abd Uthman said: I met Abd Ma'bad and told him what I had heard from Mujashi'. He said: He has told the truth.
hi: Mujashi bin Mas'ud ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main apne bhai Abu Ma'bad ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya Makkah ki fatah ke baad aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhe apne haath par hijrat ki qasam khaane dijiye. Unhone kaha: Hijrat ki muddat un logon ke saath khatam ho chuki hai jinhe ise karna tha (aur ab koi bhi ye punyapurna vishishtata haasil nahi kar sakta). Maine kaha: Aap unhe kis amal ke liye qasam khaane dijiye ge? Unhone kaha: (Woh aisa kar sakte hain) Islam ke maqsad ki khidmat karne ke liye, Allah ki raah mein larne ke liye aur nekokaari ki khaatir larne ke liye. Abd Uthman ne kaha: Main Abd Ma'bad se mila aur unhe bataya jo maine Mujashi se suna tha. Unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha.

e: Another version of the tradition transmitted on the authority of Asim has the same wording but does not mention the name of Abu Ma'bad.
hi: Asim ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek doosra soorat wahi alfaaz rakhta hai lekin Abu Ma'bad ka naam zikr nahi karta.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day of the Conquest of Mecca: There is no Hijra now, but (only) Jihad (fighting for the cause of Islam) and sincerity of purpose (have great reward) ; when you are asked to set out (on an expedition undertaken for the cause of Islam) you should (readily) do so.
hi: Ibn Abbas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah ki Fatah ke din kaha: Ab koi Hijra nahi hai, lekin (sirf) Jihad (Islam ke maqsad ke liye jung) aur maqsad ki eemaandaari (ka bada sawaab) hai; jab tumse kaha jaaye ki tum (Islam ke maqsad ke liye ki gayi muhim par) nikalo, tumhe (turant) aisa karna chahiye.

e: The above tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about migration, whereupon he said: There is no migration after the Conquest (of Mecca), but Jihad and sincere intention. When you are asked to set out (for the cause of Islam), you should set out,
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hijrat ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: (Makkah ki) Fatah ke baad koi hijrat nahi hai, lekin Jihad aur nirmal iraada hai. Jab tumse kaha jaaye ki tum (Islam ke maqsad ke liye) nikalo, tumhe nikalna chahiye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudari that a Bedouin asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Migration. He replied: Do you talk of Hijra? The affair of Hijra is very difficult. But have you got camels? The bedouin said: Yes. He asked: Do you pay the poor-rate payable on their account? He replied: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Go on doing good deeds (across the seas), for surely God will not leave any of your deeds unrewarded.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek registaan ke Arab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hijrat ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Kya tum Hijra ki baat kar rahe ho? Hijra ka maamla bahut mushkil hai. Lekin kya tumhare paas oont hain? Registaan ke Arab ne kaha: Haan. Unhone poocha: Kya tum unke liye gareeb-kar ada karte ho? Unhone jawaab diya: Haan. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Nekokaari ke amal karte raho (samundron ke paar bhi), kyunki Allah zaroor tumhare kisi bhi amal ko bina sawaab ke nahi chhodega.

e: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitter with the addition of the following words at the end: " Do you milk them on the day they arrive at the water? He replied: Yes."
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aakhri alfaazon mein: "Kya tum unhe us din doodh nikaalte ho jab woh paani ke paas pahunchte hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Haan."

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ). She said: When the believing women migrated (to Medina) and came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they would be tested in accordance with the following words of Allah. the Almighty and Exalted:" O Prophet, when believing women come to thee to take the oath of fealty to thee that they will not associate in worship anything with God, that they will not steal. that, they will not commit adultery..." to the end of the verse (lx. 62). 
Whoso from the believing women accepted these conditions and agreed to abide by them were considered to have offered themselves for swearing fealty. When they had (formally) declared their resolve to do so, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) would say to them: You may go. I have confirmed your fealty. By God, the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never touched the hand of a woman. He would take the oath of fealty from them by oral declaration. By God, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never took any vow from women except that which God had ordered him to take, and his palm never touched the palm of a woman. When he had taken their vow, he would tell them that he had taken the oath from them orally.
hi: Aisha, Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone kaha: Jab imaandaar auraten (Madina) hijrat karke aayin aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin, unki pareeksha in Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke alfaazon ke mutabik hoti: "Aye Nabi, jab imaandaar auraten tumhare paas wafadaari ki qasam khaane aayein ki woh Allah ke saath ibadat mein kisi ko shareek nahi karengi, ki woh chori nahi karengi, ki woh zina nahi karengi..." aayat ke akhir tak (60:12). Imaandaar auraton mein se jinhone in sharton ko qubool kiya aur unpar chalne par sehmat huyin, unhe apne aap ko wafadaari ki qasam khaane ke liye pesh karne wali maana jaata. Jab unhone (aupcharik soorat se) aisa karne ka apna azm elan kiya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse kehte: Tum jaa sakti ho. Maine tumhari wafadaari ki pushti ki hai. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka haath kabhi kisi aurat ke haath ko nahi chhua. Woh unse maukhik elan ke zariye wafadaari ki qasam lete. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi auraton se koi vaada nahi liya siwaay uske jo Allah ne unhe lene ka hukum diya, aur unki hatheli kabhi kisi aurat ki hatheli ko nahi chhoo paayi. Jab unhone unka vaada le liya hota, woh unhe bataate ki unhone unse maukhik soorat se qasam le li hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa that 'A'isha described to him the way the Prophet (ﷺ) took the oath of fealty from women. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never touched a woman with his hand. He would only take a vow from her and when he had taken the (verbal) vow, he would say: You may go. I have accepted your fealty.
hi: Urwa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aisha ne unhe woh tareeka bataaya jisse Nabi (SAW) auraton se wafadaari ki qasam lete the. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi aurat ko apne haath se nahi chhua. Woh sirf unse ek vaada lete aur jab unhone (maukhik) vaada le liya hota, woh kehte: Tum jaa sakti ho. Maine tumhari wafadaari qubool kar li hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar who said: We used to take oath to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that we would listen to and obey his orders. He would tell us (to say in the oath): As far as it lies in my power.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se qasam lete the ki hum unki baat sunenge aur unke hukumon ki itaat karenge. Woh humein (qasam mein kehne ko) kehte: Jitna mere vash mein hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) inspected me on the battlefield on the Day of Uhud, and I was fourteen years old. He did not allow me (to take part in the fight). He inspected me on the Day of Khandaq-and I was fifteen yearsold, and he permitted me (to fight), Nafi' said: I came to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz who was then Caliph, and narrated this tradition to him. He said: Surely, this is the demarcation between a minor and a major. So he wrote to his governors that they should pay subsistence allowance to one who was fifteen years old, but should treat those of lesser age among children.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Uhud ke din jung ke maidaan mein jaancha, aur meri umar chaudah saal thi. Unhone mujhe (jung mein hissa lene ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone mujhe Khandaq ke din jaancha - aur meri umar pandrah saal thi, aur unhone mujhe (larne ki) ijazat di. Nafi ne kaha: Main Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ke paas gaya jo us waqt Khalifa the, aur unhe ye hadees riwayat ki. Unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, ye ek naabaalig aur ek baalig ke beech ki seema hai. To unhone apne gavarnaron ko likha ki unhe us shakhs ko bhar-poshan bhatta dena chahiye jo pandrah saal ka tha, lekin bachchon mein se choti umar walon ko doosri tarah se maanein.

e: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain Of transmitters with the following change in the wording: " I was fourteen years old and he thought me too young (to participate in the fight)."
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye is alfaazon mein badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Meri umar chaudah saal thi aur unhone mujhe (jung mein hissa lene ke liye) bahut jawaan samjha."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that one should travel to the land of the enemy taking the Qur'an with him.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki koi bhi Quran apne saath lekar dushman ki zameen mein safar kare.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to forbid that one should travel to the land of the enemy taking the Qur'an (with him) lest it should fall into the hands of the enemy.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mana kiya karte the ki koi bhi Quran (apne saath) lekar dushman ki zameen mein safar kare kahin ye dushman ke haathon mein na pad jaaye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not take the Qur'an on a journey with you, for I am afraid lost it should fall into the hands of the enemy. Ayyub (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: The enemy may seize it and may quarrel with you over it.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Quran ko apne saath safar par mat le jaao, kyunki mujhe dar hai ki ye dushman ke haathon mein pad jaayega. Ayyub (sanad ke raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Dushman ise pakad sakta hai aur ismein tumse jhagda kar sakta hai.

e: The above hadith has been narrated through several other chains with slight differences of wording.
hi: Upar wali hadees kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a race of the horses which had been especially prepared for the purpose from Hafya' to Thaniyyat al-Wada' (the latter being the winning post), and of those which had not been trained from Thaniyya to the mosque of Banu Zuraiq, and Ibn Umar was among those who took part in this race.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un ghodon ki daud karvaayi jo khaas taur par is maqsad ke liye taiyaar kiye gaye the Hafya se Thaniyyat al-Wada tak (baad wala jeet ka nishaan tha), aur un ghodon ki (daud) jo prashikshit nahi the Thaniyya se Banu Zuraiq ki masjid tak, aur Ibn Umar un logon mein the jinhone is daud mein hissa liya.

e: This tradition has been handed down through several other chains of transmitters.  One of the chaines has the addition of the following words from Abdullah b. 'Umar: " I came first in the race and my horse jumped into the mosque with me."
hi: Ye riwayat kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Ek sanad mein Abdullah bin Umar ke ye izafi alfaaz hain: "Main daud mein pehle aaya aur mera ghoda mere saath masjid mein kood gaya."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There will be great benefit in the forelock of the horses until the Day of judgment.
hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ghodon ki peshaani mein Qayamat ke din tak bada faayda hoga.

e: The same tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jarir b. Abdullah who said: I saw that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was twisting the forelock of a horse with his fingers and he was saying: (A great) benefit. i. e. reward (for rearing them for Jihad) and spoils of war, has been tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Judgment.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek ghode ki peshaani ke baal apni ungliyon se moD rahe the aur keh rahe the: (Ek bada) faayda, yaani sawaab (unhe Jihad ke liye paalne ka) aur maal-e-ganimat, ghodon ki peshaaniyon se Qayamat ke din tak jodi gayi hai.

e: The above tradition has also been narrated on the authority of Yunus through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat Yunus ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Urwat al-Bariqi who said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.
hi: Yehi riwayat Urwat al-Bariqi ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Bahut achhaai ghodon ki peshaani se Qayamat ke din tak judi hai.

e: 'Urwat al-Bariqi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Good is tied to the forelock of the horses. It Was said to him: Messenger of Allah, why is it so? He (the Prophet said): For reward and booty until the Day of Judgment.
hi: Urwat al-Bariqi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha: Achhaai ghodon ki peshaani se judi hai. Unse poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, aisa kyun hai? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat ke liye Qayamat ke din tak.

e: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters with the difference that here instead of" Urwat al-Bariqi" there is" Urwa b. ja'd."
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai is antar ke saath ki yahan "Urwat al-Bariqi" ki jagah "Urwa bin ja'd" hai.

e: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of 'Urwat al-Bariqi does not mention (the words): " reward and booty".
hi: Urwat al-Bariqi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat in alfaazon ka zikr nahi karta: "Sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat."

e: A version of the tradition transmitted on the authority of 'Urwa b. al-ja'd does not mention" reward and booty".
hi: Urwa bin al-ja'd ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat "sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat" ka zikr nahi karta.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is a blessing in the forelocks of the war horses.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jung ke ghodon ki peshaani mein ek barkat hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abn Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to dislike the Shikal horse.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Shikal ghode ko napasand karte the.

e: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the addition from Abd ar-Razzaq (one of the narrators) explaining the meaning of shikal as a bone whose right back foot and left front foot or left back foot and right front foot are white.
hi: Ye riwayat Sufyan ki sanad se Abd ar-Razzaq (ek raawi) ke izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone shikal ka matlab samjhaaya jise ek aisi haddi (ghoda) hai jiska daaya peechla paon aur baaya aagla paon, ya baaya peechla paon aur daaya aagla paon safed ho.

e: The tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace upon him) said: Allah has undertaken to look after the affairs of one who goes out to fight in His way believing in Him and affirming the truth of His Apostles. He is committed to His care that Re will either admit him to Paradise or bring him back to his home from where he set out with a reward or (his share of) booty. By the Being in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad. If a person gets wounded in the way of Allah, he will come on the Day of Judgment with his wound in the same condition as it was when it was first inflicted; its colour being the colour of blood but its smell will be the smell of musk. By, the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, if it were not to be too hard upon the Muslime. I would not lag behind any expedition which is going to fight in the cause of Allah. But I do not have abundant means to provide them (the Mujahids) with riding beasts, nor have they (i. e. all of them) abundant means (to provide themselves with all the means of Jihad) so that they could he left behind. By the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, I love to fight in the way of Allah and be killed, to fight and again be killed and to fight again and be killed.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne us shakhs ke maamlon ki dekhbhaal karne ki zimmedaari li hai jo Uski raah mein larne nikalta hai, Uspar imaan rakhte hue aur Uske Rasoolon ki sachchaai ko maante hue. Woh Uski dekhbhaal mein hai ki Woh use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega ya use ghar wapas laayega jahan se woh nikla tha sawaab ya maal-e-ganimat mein se hisse ke saath. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar koi shakhs Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai, woh Qayamat ke din apne zakhm ke saath aayega usi haalat mein jaisa ye pehli baar pahunchaayi gayi thi; iska rang khoon ka rang hoga lekin iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar ye Musalmaanon par bahut mushkil na hoti, main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta jo Allah ki khaatir larne jaa rahi hai. Lekin mere paas unhe (Mujahids ko) sawaari waale jaanwar dene ke liye kaafi saadhan nahi hain, na hi unke paas (yaani unmein se sab ke paas) kaafi saadhan hain (khud ko Jihad ke saare saadhan mahaiyaa karaane ke liye) taaki unhe peeche chhoDa jaa sake. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, main Allah ki raah mein larna aur qatal ho jaana pasand karta hoon, phir larna aur dobara qatal ho jaana aur phir larna aur qatal ho jaana.

e: The same tradition has been melted through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: Allah has undertaken to provide for one who leaves his home (only) to fight for His cause and to affirm the truth of His word; Allah will either admit him to Paradise or will bring him back home from where he had come out, with his reward and booty.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs ke liye intezam karne ki zimmedaari li hai jo apna ghar chhoDta hai (sirf) Uski khaatir larne aur Uske alfaazon ki sachchaai ki pushti karne ke liye; Allah use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega ya use ghar wapas laayega jahan se woh nikla tha, apne sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat ke saath.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who is wounded in the way of Allah-and Allah knows better who is wounded in His way-will appear on the Day of Judgment with his wound bleediing. The colour (of its discharge) will be the colour of blood, (but) its smell will be the smell of musk.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai - aur Allah behtar jaanta hai ki kaun Uski raah mein zakhmi hota hai - Qayamat ke din apne zakhm se khoon bahaate hue pragat hoga. Iske (rise ka) rang khoon ka rang hoga, (lekin) iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Haraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Every wound received by a Muslim in the way of Allah will appear on the Day of Judgment in the same condition as it was when it was inflicted, and would be bleeding profusely. The colour (of its discharge) will be the colour of blood, but its smell will be the smell of musk. By the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, if it were not hard upon the Muslims, I would not lag behind any expedition undertaken for Jihad, but I do not possess abundant means to provide the Mujahids with riding animals, nor do they (i. e. all of them) have abundant means (to provide themselves with all the means of Jihad) to follow me, nor would it please their hearts to stay behind me.
hi: Abu Haraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisi Musalman ko Allah ki raah mein lagi har chot Qayamat ke din usi haalat mein pragat hogi jaisi ye pahunchaayi gayi thi, aur bahut zyada khoon behta hoga. Iske (rise ka) rang khoon ka rang hoga, lekin iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar Musalmaanon par ye mushkil na hoti, main Jihad ke liye undertaken kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta, lekin mere paas Mujahids ko sawaari waale jaanwar dene ke liye kaafi saadhan nahi hain, na hi unke paas (yaani sabke paas) mera anusaran karne ke liye kaafi saadhan hain, na hi unke dilon ko ye achha lagta ki woh mere peeche reh jaayein.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: I would not stay behind (when) an expedition (for Jihad was being mobilised) if it were going to be too hard upon the believers.... This is followed by the same words as have appeared in the previous tradition, but this tradition has the same ending as the previous hadith with a slight difference in the wording:" By the Being in Whose Hand is my life, I love that I should be killed in the way of Allah; then I should be brought back to life and be killed again in His way...."
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main kisi muhim se peeche nahi rahta (jab) ek muhim (Jihad ke liye sanchaalit ki jaa rahi hoti) agar ye momino par bahut mushkil na hoti.... Iske baad wahi alfaaz hain jo pichhli hadees mein aaye hain, lekin ye hadees pichhli hadees jaisi hi khatam hoti hai alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath: "Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, mujhe pasand hai ki main Allah ki raah mein qatal ho jaaun; phir mujhe zinda kiya jaaye aur Uski raah mein dobara qatal kiya jaaun...."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If it were not hard upon my Umma (to follow my example), I would not lag behind any expedition-as in the traditions gone before.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar meri Ummat ke liye ye mushkil na hoti (mera udaaharan follow karne ke liye), main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta - jaise pichhli hadeeson mein hai.

e: Another version of the tradition narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira has the same wording as the previous tradition: " Allah takes care of one who goes out in the way of Allah" but ends in the words:" I would not lag behind any expedition which is undertaken to fight in the way of Allah, the Exalted."
hi: Ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka doosra soorat pichhli hadees jaisa hi hai: "Allah us shakhs ki dekhbhaal karta hai jo Allah ki raah mein nikalta hai" lekin in alfaazon mein khatam hota hai: "Main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta jo Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larne ke liye undertaken ki jaati hai."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: " Nobody who dies and has something good for him with Allah will (ever like to) return to this world even though he were offered the whole world and all that is in its (as an inducement), except the martyr who desires to return and be killed in the world for the (great) merit of martyrdom that he has seen.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Koi bhi jo marta hai aur uske liye Allah ke paas kuch achha hai, woh (kabhi) is duniya mein wapas nahi aana chaahega chahe use poori duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai woh sab pesh kiya jaaye (protsaahan ke soorat mein), siwaay shaheed ke jo wapas aana aur duniya mein qatal hona chaahta hai shahaadat ke (bade) ahmiyat ke liye jo usne dekha hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik (through a different chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Nobody who enters Paradise will (ever like to) return to this world even if he were offered everything on the surface of the earth (as an inducement) except the martyr who will desire to return to this world and be killed ten times for the sake of the great honour that has been bestowed upon him.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se (ek doosri sanad ke zariye) ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Koi bhi jo Jannat mein daakhil hota hai woh (kabhi) is duniya mein wapas nahi aana chaahega chahe use zameen ki satah par har cheez pesh ki jaaye (protsaahan ke soorat mein) siwaay shaheed ke jo is duniya mein wapas aana chaahega aur das baar qatal hona chaahega us bade samman ki khaatir jo unhe diya gaya hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: What deed could be an equivalent of Jihad in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted? He answered: You do not have the strength to do that deed. The narrator said: They repeated the question twice or thrice. Every time he answered: You do not have the strength to do it. When the question was asked for the third time, he said: One who goes out for Jihad is like a person who keeps fasts, stands in prayer (constantly), (obeying) Allah's (behests contained in) the verses (of the Qur'an), and does not exhibit any lassitude in fasting and prayer until the Mujahid returns from Jihad in the way of Allah, the Exalted.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Kaunsa amal Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein Jihad ke barabar ho sakta hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Tum mein us amal ko karne ki taqat nahi hai. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone ye sawaal do ya teen baar dohraaya. Har baar unhone jawaab diya: Tum mein ise karne ki taqat nahi hai. Jab teesri baar sawaal poocha gaya, unhone kaha: Jo Jihad ke liye nikalta hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo (lagataar) roze rakhta hai, namaz mein khada hota hai, (Quran ki aayaton mein Allah ke hukumon ki) itaat karta hai, aur roza aur namaz mein koi thakaavat nahi dikhaata jab tak Mujahid Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein Jihad se wapas nahi aata.

e: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir who said: As I was (sitting) near the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a man said: I do not care if, after embracing Islam, I do not do any good deed (except) distributing drinking water among the pilgrims. Another said: I do not care if, after embracing Islam, I do not do any good deed beyond maintenance service to the Sacred Mosque. Another said: Jihad in the way of Allah is better than what you have said. 'Umar reprimanded them and said: Don't raise your voices near the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday. When prayer was over, I entered (the apartment of the Holy Prophet) and asked his verdict about the matter in which they had differed. (It was upon this that) Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, revealed the Qur'anic verse:" Do you make the giving of drinking water to the pilgrims and the maintenance of the Sacred Mosque equal to (the service of those) who believe in Allah and the Last Day and strive hard in the cause of Allah. They are not equal in the sight of God. And Allah guides not the wrongdoing people" (ix. 20).
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar ke qareeb (baitha) tha, ek shakhs ne kaha: Mujhe koi parvaah nahi agar, Islam qubool karne ke baad, main koi achha amal nahi karta (siwaay) haajiyon ke beech peene ka paani baantne ke. Doosre ne kaha: Mujhe koi parvaah nahi agar, Islam qubool karne ke baad, main koi achha amal nahi karta siwaay Muqaddas Masjid ki dekhbhaal ki sewa ke. Doosre ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein Jihad tumhare kahe se behtar hai. Umar ne unhe daanta aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar ke qareeb juma ke din apni aawaazein buland mat karo. Jab namaz khatm hui, main (Nabi-e-Paak ke kamre mein) daakhil hua aur unse us maamle par unka faisla poocha jismein woh muttafiq nahi the. (Isi par) Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne Qurani aayat nazil ki: "Kya tum haajiyon ko peene ka paani dene aur Muqaddas Masjid ki dekhbhaal ko unke (sewa) ke barabar maante ho jo Allah aur Aakhri Din par imaan rakhte hain aur Allah ki raah mein poori koshish karte hain. Woh Allah ki nazar mein barabar nahi hain. Aur Allah anyaaykaari logon ko margdarshan nahi deta" (9:20).

e: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Nu'man bin Bashir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leaving (for Jihad) in the way of Allah in the morning or in the evening (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein subah ya shaam nikalna (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The journey undertaken by a person in the morning (for Jihad) in the way of Allah (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisi shakhs ke zariye subah undertaken ki gayi safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A journey undertaken in the morning or evening (fond Jihad) in the way of Allah (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Subah ya shaam ko undertaken ki gayi ek safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If some persons of my Umma (were not to undertake the hardships of Jihad), and he (Abu Huraira) then narrated the rest of the hadith and then said: A journey undertaken for jihad in the evening or morning merits a reward better than the world and all that is in it.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar meri Ummat ke kuch log (Jihad ki mushkilon ka bhaar undertaken karne se) na katraate, aur unhone (Abu Huraira ne) phir hadees ka baaki hissa riwayat kiya aur phir kaha: Shaam ya subah undertaken ki gayi Jihad ki safar ka sawaab duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A journey undertaken in the morning or evening (for Jihad) in the way of Allah is better than (anything) on which the sun rises or sets.
hi: Abu Ayyub ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Subah ya shaam undertaken ki gayi safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein us cheez se behtar hai jispar suraj uthta ya dubta hai.

e: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub through a different chain of transmitters having the same wording.
hi: Ye riwayat Abu Ayyub ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se isi alfaazon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa`id al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to him): Abu Sa`id, whoever cheerfully accepts Allah as his Lord, Islam as his religion and Muhammad as his Apostle is necessarily entitled to enter Paradise. He (Abu Sa`id) wondered at it and said: Messenger of Allah, repeat it for me. He (the Messenger of Allah) did that and said: There is another act which elevates the position of a man in Paradise to a grade one hundred (higher), and the elevation between one grade and the other is equal to the height of the heaven from the earth. He (Abu Sa`id) said: What is that act? He replied: Jihad in the way of Allah! Jihad in the way of Allah!
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) kaha: Abu Sa'id, jo koi khushi se Allah ko apna Rab, Islam ko apna deen, aur Muhammad ko apna Rasool maanta hai woh zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Unhone (Abu Sa'id ne) isse hairat kiya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise mere liye dohraiye. Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) aisa kiya aur kaha: Ek aur amal hai jo Jannat mein aadmi ki haalat ko sau (uchhi) darjon tak uThAta hai, aur ek darje aur doosre ke beech utna hi antar hai jitna zameen se aasmaan ki oonchai. Unhone (Abu Sa'id ne) poocha: Woh amal kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Allah ki raah mein Jihad! Allah ki raah mein Jihad!

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Qatada that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up among them (his Companions) to deliver his sermon in which he told them that Jihad in the way of Allah and belief in Allah (with all His Attributes) are the most meritorious of acts. A man stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, do you think that if I am killed in the way of Allah, my sins will be blotted out from me? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, in case you are killed in the way of Allah and you were patient and sincere and you always fought facing the enemy, never turming your back upon him. Then he added: What have you said (now)? (Wishing to have further assurance from him for his satisfaction), he asked (again): Do you think if I am killed in the way of Allah, all my sins will be obliterated from me? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, it you were patient and sincere and always fought facing the enemy and never turning your back upon him, (all your lapses would be forgiven) except debt. Gabriel has told me this.
hi: Abu Qatada ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke (apne sahaba ke) beech khutba dene khade hue jismein unhone unhe bataya ki Allah ki raah mein Jihad aur Allah par imaan (Uske saare Gunon ke saath) sabse punyapurna amal hain. Ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun, kya mere gunah mujhse mit jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, agar tum Allah ki raah mein qatal kiye jaate ho aur tum sabar aur eemaandaar rahe aur tum hamesha dushman ka saamna karte hue lade, kabhi apni peeth na mode. Phir unhone izafa kiya: Tumne (ab) kya kaha? (Unse aur bharosa paane ki khwaish karte hue apni santushti ke liye), unhone (phir) poocha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun, kya mere sab gunah mujhse mit jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, agar tum sabar aur eemaandaar the aur hamesha dushman ka saamna karte hue lade aur kabhi apni peeth nahi modi, (tumhari saari galtiyaan maaf ho jaayengi) siwaay karze ke. Jibril ne mujhe ye bataya hai.

e: The tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Qatada who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was on the pulpit and said: Do you think if I am killed in the way of Allah... (except this difference in its beginning, the rest of the tradition is the same as the previous one).
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Qatada ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh mimbar par the aur kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun... (iski shuruaat mein ye antar chhodkar, baaki riwayat pichhli jaisi hi hai).

e: Another version of the tradition differently transmitted begins with the words: " A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was sitting on the pulpit.... He said: What do you find if I strike with the sword?" (The rest of the tradition is the same as the previous one.)
hi: Riwayat ka doosra soorat, jise alag tarike se riwayat kiya gaya hai, in alfaazon se shuru hota hai: "Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur woh mimbar par baithe the.... Unhone kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main talwaar se maarun?" (Baaki riwayat pichhli jaisi hi hai.)

e: It has been reported on the authority of 'Amr b. al-'As that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: All the sins of a Shahid (martyr) are forgiven except debt.
hi: Amr bin al-As ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek Shahid (shaheed) ke sab gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain siwaay karze ke.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Amr b. al-'As through a different chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Death in the way of Allah blots out everything except debt.
hi: Amr bin al-As ke hawale se ek doosri sanad ke zariye ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein maut sab kuch mita deti hai siwaay karze ke.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Masruq Who said: We asked 'Abdullah about the Qur'anic verse:" Think not of those who are slain in Allah's way as dead. Nay, they are alive, finding their sustenance in the presence of their Lord.." (iii. 169). He said: We asked the meaning of the verse (from the Holy Prophet) who said: The souls, of the martyrs live in the bodies of green birds who have their nests in chandeliers hung from the throne of the Almighty. They eat the fruits of Paradise from wherever they like and then nestle in these chandeliers. Once their Lord cast a glance at them and said: Do ye want anything? They said: What more shall we desire? We eat the fruit of Paradise from wherever we like. Their Lord asked them the same question thrice. When they saw that they will continue to be asked and not left (without answering the question). they said: O Lord, we wish that Thou mayest return our souls to our bodies so that we may be slain in Thy way once again. When He (Allah) saw that they had no need, they were left (to their joy in heaven).
hi: Masruq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Humne Abdullah se Qurani aayat ke baare mein poocha: "Un logon ko murda mat samjho jo Allah ki raah mein maare gaye hain. Nahi, woh zinda hain, apne Rab ke saamne rozi paate hue.." (3:169). Unhone kaha: Humne (Nabi-e-Paak se) is aayat ka matlab poocha, aur unhone kaha: Shaheedon ki roohein hare parindon ke badan mein zinda hain jinke ghosle Sarvashaktimaan ke singhaasan se latke jhaad-fanoos mein hain. Woh Jannat ke phal khaate hain jahan se woh chaahein aur phir in jhaad-fanoos mein baste hain. Ek baar unke Rab ne unpar nazar daali aur kaha: Kya tumhe kuch chahiye? Unhone kaha: Hum aur kya chaahein? Hum Jannat ke phal khaate hain jahan se hum chaahein. Unke Rab ne unse yahi sawaal teen baar poocha. Jab unhone dekha ki unse baar-baar poocha jaayega aur unhe (jawaab diye bina) nahi chhoDa jaayega, unhone kaha: Aye Rab, humari khwaish hai ki Tu humari roohein humare badan mein wapas de taaki hum dobara Teri raah mein qatal ho sakein. Jab Unhone (Allah ne) dekha ki unhe kisi cheez ki zaroorat nahi hai, unhe (unki jannat mein khushi mein) chhoD diya gaya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that a man came to the Prophet (may peace he upon him) and said: Who is the best of men? He replied: A man who fights in the way of Allah spending his wealth and staking his life. The man then asked: Who is next to him (in excellence)? He said: Next to him is a believer who lives in a mountain gorge worshipping hid Lord and sparing men from his mischief.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Insaanon mein sabse behtareen kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ek aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein larta hai apni daulat kharch karke aur apni jaan daav par lagaakar. Us aadmi ne phir poocha: Unke baad kaun hai (fazeelat mein)? Unhone kaha: Unke baad ek imaandaar hai jo ek pahaadi khaai mein rehta hai apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue aur logon ko apni shararat se bachaate hue.

e: It has been narrated (through a diferent chain of transmetters) on the same authority (i. e. Abu Sa'id Khadri) who said: A man asked: Messenger of Allah, which of men is the best? He said: A believer who fights staking his life and spending his wealth in the way of Allah. He asked: Who is next to him (in excellence)? He said: Next to him is a man who lives an isolated life in a mountain gorge, worshipping his Lord and sparing men from his mischief.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Usi raawi (yaani Abu Sa'id Khadri) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs ne poocha: Allah ke Rasool, insaanon mein kaun sabse behtareen hai? Unhone kaha: Ek imaandaar jo apni jaan daav par lagaakar aur Allah ki raah mein apni daulat kharch karke larta hai. Unhone poocha: Unke baad kaun hai (fazeelat mein)? Unhone kaha: Unke baad ek aadmi hai jo ek pahaadi khaai mein alag-thalag zindagi jeeta hai, apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue aur logon ko apni shararat se bachaate hue.

e: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab has a little differently worded ending. i. e." A man in a mountain valley." but did not mention" next to him a man who...."
hi: Ibn Shihab ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat thoda halke alfaazon mein khatm hota hai, yaani "Ek aadmi ek pahaadi wadi mein." lekin "unke baad ek aadmi jo...." ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Of the men he lives the best life who holds the reins of his horse (ever ready to march) in the way of Allah, flies on its back whenever he hears a fearful shriek, or a call for help, flies to it seeking death at places where it can be expected. (Next to him) is a man who lives with his sheep at a hill-top or in a valley, says his prayers regularly, gives Zakat and worships his Lord until death comes to him. There is no better person among men except these two.
