hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Insaanon mein sabse achhi zindagi woh jeeta hai jo apne ghode ki lagaam pakde rehta hai (hamesha march karne ke liye taiyaar) Allah ki raah mein, uski peeth par udta hai jab bhi woh koi bhayaanak chillaahat, ya madad ki pukaar sunta hai, use maut ki taraf udta hai un jagahon par jahan iski ummeed ki jaa sakti hai. (Unke baad) ek aadmi hai jo apni bhedon ke saath ek pahaadi ki chotti par ya wadi mein rehta hai, muqarrar soorat se apni namaz padhta hai, Zakat deta hai aur apne Rab ki ibadat karta hai yahan tak ki use maut aati hai. In do logon ke ilawa insaanon mein koi behtareen shakhs nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Two more versions of the tradition narrated by 'Abdullah b. Badr and Abu Huraira, respectively, have been handed down through different chains of transmitters with negligible difference in the wording.
hi: Riwayat ke do aur soorat, jo kramashah Abdullah bin Badr aur Abu Huraira ke zariye riwayat kiye gaye hain, mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein mamuli antar ke saath riwayat kiye gaye hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: God laughs at the two men both of whom will enter Paradise (though) one of them kills the other. They said: Messenger of Allah, how is it? He said: One of them fights in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted. and dies a martyr. Then God turns in mercy to the murderer who embraces Islam, fights in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, and dies a martyr.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah do aadmiyon par hansta hai jinmein se donon Jannat mein daakhil honge (halaanki) unmein se ek doosre ko qatal karta hai. Unhone (poochha): Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise? Unhone kaha: Unmein se ek Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larta hai, aur ek shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai. Phir Allah rehmat mein qaatil ki taraf mudta hai jo Islam qubool karta hai, Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larta hai, aur ek shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai.

e: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zinad (with the same chain of transmitters).
hi: Yehi riwayat Abu Zinad ki sanad se (isi sanad se) riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: God laughs at the two men one of whom kills the other; both of them will enter Paradise. They (the Companions) said: How, Messenger of Allah? He said: One is slain (in the way of Allah) and enters Paradise. Then God forgives the other and guides him to Islam; then he fights in the way of Allah and dies a martyr.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah do aadmiyon par hansta hai jinmein se ek doosre ko qatal karta hai; donon Jannat mein daakhil honge. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Kaise, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone kaha: Ek qatal kiya jaata hai (Allah ki raah mein) aur Jannat mein daakhil hota hai. Phir Allah doosre ko maaf karta hai aur use Islam ki taraf margdarshit karta hai; phir woh Allah ki raah mein larta hai aur shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger Allah (ﷺ) said: A disbeliever and a believer who killed him will never be gathered together in Hell.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek kaafir aur woh imaandaar jisne use qatal kiya, kabhi bhi Jahannam mein ikattha nahi honge.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: No two such persons shall be together in Hell as if one of them is such that his presence hurts the other. It was asked: Messenger of Allah, who are they? He said: A believer who killed a disbeliever and (then) kept to the right path."
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Do aise log Jahannam mein saath nahi honge ki unmein se ek ki maujoodgi doosre ko dukh de. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Ek imaandaar jisne ek kaafir ko qatal kiya aur (phir) sahi raah par chala.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari who said A man brought a muzzled she-camel and said: It is (offered) in the way of Allah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: For this you will have seven hundred she-camels on the Day of Judgment all of which will be muzzled.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs ek naath waali oontni laaya aur kaha: Ye (Allah ki raah mein) pesh ki jaati hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Iske liye tumhe Qayamat ke din sat sau oontniyaan milengi, sab naath waali hongi.

e: A similar tradition has been narrated on the authority of al-A'mash.
hi: Isi jaisi ek riwayat al-A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: My riding beast has been killed, so give me some animal to ride upon. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I have none with me. A man said: Messenger of Allah, I can guide him to one who will provide him with a riding beast. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who guides to something good has a reward similar to that of its doer.
hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Meri sawaari waali jaanwar qatal ho gayi hai, is liye mujhe koi jaanwar dijiye sawaar hone ke liye. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Mere paas koi nahi hai. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main use kisi aise shakhs tak margdarshit kar sakta hoon jo use sawaari waala jaanwar de. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo kisi achhi cheez ki taraf margdarshit karta hai use uske karne wale jaisa hi sawaab milta hai.

e: The above tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that a young man from Aslam tribe said: Messenger of Allah, I wish to fight (in the way of Allah) but I don't have anything to equip myself with for fighting. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Go to so and so, for he had equipped himself (for fighting) but he fell ill. So, he (the young man) went to him and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sends you his greetings and says that you should give me the equipage that you have provided yourself with. The man said (to his wife or maidservant): So and so, give him the equipage I have collected for myself and do not withhold anything from him. Do not withhold anything from him so that you may be blessed therein.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aslam qabile ke ek jawaan shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main (Allah ki raah mein) larna chahta hoon lekin mere paas larne ke liye khud ko lais karne ke liye kuch nahi hai. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Falan-falan ke paas jao, kyunki unhone apne aap ko (larne ke liye) taiyaar kiya tha lekin woh bimaar pad gaye. To, woh (jawaan shakhs) unke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aapko salaam bhejte hain aur kehte hain ki aapko mujhe woh saamaan dena chahiye jo aapne apne liye taiyaar kiya tha. Us shakhs ne (apni zauja ya laundi se) kaha: Falan-falan, unhe woh saamaan do jo maine apne liye ikattha kiya hai aur unse kuch mat rokna. Unse kuch mat rokna taaki tumhein isme barkat mile.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Anybody who equips a warrior (going to fight) in the way of Allah (is like one who actually) fights. And anybody who looks well after his family in his absence (is also like one who actually) fights.
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi Allah ki raah mein (jung karne jaane wale) ek mujahid ko taiyaar karta hai (woh usi ke barabar hai jo waaqai) larta hai. Aur jo koi uski gairhaazri mein uske khaandaan ka achhi tarah khyaal rakhta hai (woh bhi usi ke barabar hai jo waaqai) larta hai.

e: The above tradition has been narrated on the authority of Khalid al- Juhani who said: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who equips a warrior in the way of Allah (is like one who dctually fights) aud he who looks after the family of a warrior in the way of Allah in fact participated in the battle.
hi: Upar wali riwayat Khalid al-Juhani ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Allah ki raah mein ek mujahid ko taiyaar karta hai (woh usi jaisa hai jo waaqai larta hai) aur jo Allah ki raah mein ek mujahid ke khaandaan ka khyaal rakhta hai woh waaqai mein jung mein hissa leta hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a force to Banu Lihyan (who are from Banu Hudhail, and said: One man from every two and the reward (will be divided) between the two.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Lihyan (jo Banu Hudhail se hain) ke khilaaf ek fauj bheji, aur kaha: Har do mein se ek aadmi jaaye aur sawaab (baanta jaayega) do ke beech.

e: The above tradition has also been narrated through two different chains of transmitters on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri and Yahya, respectively.
hi: Upar wali riwayat do doosri sanadon ke zariye Abu Sa'id Khudri aur Yahya ke hawale se, kramashah, riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated (through a still different chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudrl that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) despatched a force to Banu Lihyan. (and said: ) One man from every two should join the force. Then he said to those who stayed behind: Those of you who will look well after the family and wealth of those who are going on the expedition will be getting half the reward of the warriors.
hi: (Ek phir bhi doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Sa'id Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Lihyan par ek fauj bheji. (Aur kaha:) Har do mein se ek aadmi fauj mein shaamil ho. Phir unhone unse kaha jo peeche reh gaye the: Tum mein se jo un logon ke khaandaan aur daulat ka achhi tarah khyaal rakhega jo muhim par ja rahe hain unhe mujahidon ka aadha sawaab milega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Sulaimin b. Buraida who learnt the tradition from his father. The latter said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The sanctity of the wives of Mujahids is like the sanctity of their mothers for those who sit at home (i. e do not go out for Jihad). Anyone who stays behind looking after the family of a Mujahid and betrays his trust will be made to stand on the Day of judgment before the Mujahid who will take away from his meritorious deeds whatever he likes. So what do you think (will he leave anything)?
hi: Sulaimin bin Buraida ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apne waalid se seekhi. Baad wale ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujahids ki zaujaon ki pavitrata unke liye jo ghar par baiThte hain (yaani Jihad ke liye nahi jaate) unki maaon ki pavitrata jaisi hai. Jo koi peeche rehkar ek Mujahid ke khaandaan ka khyaal rakhta hai aur unke bharose ko dhoka deta hai, use Qayamat ke din us Mujahid ke saamne khada kiya jaayega jo uske punyapurna karyon mein se jo bhi chaahe le lega. Is liye tumhe kya lagta hai (kya woh kuch bhi chhoDega)?

e: This tradition has been narrated by the same authority through different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees usi raawi ke zariye ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of 'Alqama b. Murthad has a differently worded end: It will be said to the Mujahid: Take from his noble deeds whatever you like. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned to us and asked: What do you think (will he leave anything)? - (i. e. he will take away everything).
hi: Alqama bin Murthad ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat thoda alag alfaazon mein khatm hota hai: Mujahid se kaha jaayega: Unke nek karyon mein se jo bhi chaaho le lo. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humari taraf mude aur poocha: Tumhe kya lagta hai (kya woh kuch bhi chhoDega)? - (yaani woh sab kuch le lega).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq, that he heard Bara' talking about the Qur'anic verse: " Those who sit (at home) from among the believers and those who go out for Jihad in the way of Allah are not aqual" (iv. 95). (He said that) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered Zaid (to write the verse). He brought a shoulder-blade (of a slaughtered camel) and inscribed it (the verse) thereon. The son of Umm Maktum complained of his blindness to the Prophet (ﷺ). (At this) descended the revelation:" Those of the believers who sit (at home) without any trouble (illness, incapacity, disability)" (iv. 95). The tradition has been handed down through two other chains of transmitters.
hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone Bara ko Qurani aayat ke baare mein baat karte suna: "Jo momino mein se (ghar par) baiThte hain aur jo Allah ki raah mein Jihad ke liye nikalte hain woh barabar nahi hain" (4:95). (Unhone kaha ki) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zaid ko (aayat likhne ka) hukum diya. Woh (zibah kiye gaye oont ki) kandhe ki haddi laaye aur uspar ise (aayat) likha. Umm Maktum ke bete ne Nabi (SAW) se apni andhepan ki shikaayat ki. (Isper) wahi utri: "Woh momino mein se jo ghar par (bina kisi mushkil ke, beemari, asamarthata, vikalaangta ke) baiThte hain" (4:95). Ye riwayat do doosri sanadon ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Bara' who said: When the Qur'anic verse:" Those who sit (at home) from among mu'min" (iv. 94) was revealed, the son of Umm Maktum spoke to him (the Holy Prophet). (At this). the words:" other than those who have a trouble (illness)" were revealed.
hi: Bara ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Qurani aayat: "Jo mu'min mein se (ghar par) baiThte hain" (4:94) nazil hui, Umm Maktum ke bete ne unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) baat ki. (Isper), alfaaz: "un logon ke ilawa jinhe koi mushkil (beemari) hai" nazil huye.

e:
It has been reported on the authority of Jabir that a man said: Messenger of Allah, where shall I be if I am killed? He replied: In Paradise. The man threw away the dates he had in his hand and fought until he was killed (i. e. he did not wait until he could finish the dates). 
In the version of the tradition narrated by Suwaid we have the words:" A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ). on the day of Uhud......"
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar main qatal kiya jaata hoon to main kahan hunga? Unhone jawaab diya: Jannat mein. Us shakhs ne apne haath mein pakdi khajooren phenk din aur larta raha yahan tak ki woh qatal ho gaya (yaani usne khajooren khatm hone ka intezaar nahi kiya). Suwaid ke zariye riwayat ki gayi riwayat mein humare paas alfaaz hain: "Ek shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha, Uhud ke din......"

e: It has been reported on the authority of Bara! ' who stated: A man from Banu Nabit (one of the Ansar tribes) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: I testify that there is no god except Allah and that thou art His bondman and Messenger. Then he went forward and fought until he was killed. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He has done a little but shall be given a great reward.
hi: Bara ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Banu Nabit (Ansar ke ek qabile) ka ek shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur ki tum Uske banda aur Rasool ho. Phir woh aage baDha aur larta raha yahan tak ki woh qatal ho gaya. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Unhone thoda kiya lekin unhe bada sawaab milega.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Busaisah as a scout to see what the caravan of Abu Sufyan was doing. He came (back and met the Prophet in his house) where there was nobody except myself and the Messenger of Allah. I do not remember whether he (Hadrat Anas) made an exception of some wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) or not and told him the news of the caravan. (Having heard the news), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out (hurriedly), spoke to the people and said: We are in need (of men) ; whoever has an animal to ride upon ready with him should ride with us. People began to ask him permission for bringing their riding animals which were grazing on the hillocks near Medina. He said: No. (I want) only those who have their riding animals ready. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions proceeded towards Badr and reached there forestalling the polytheists (of Mecca). When the polytheists (also) reached there, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None of you should step forward to (do) anything unless I am ahead of him. The polytheists (now) advanced (towards us), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Get up to enter Paradise which is equal in width to the heavens and the earth. 'Umair b. al- Humam al-Ansari said: Messenger of Allah, is Paradise equal in extent to the heavens and the earth? He said: Yes. 'Umair said: My goodness! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him: What prompted you to utter these words (i. e. my goodness! ')? He said: Messenger of Allah, nothing but the desire that I be among its residents. He said: Thou art (surely) amona its residents. He took out dates from his bag and began to eat them. Then he said: If I were to live until I have eaten all these dates of mine, it would be a long life. (The narrator said): He threw away all the dates he had with him. Then he fought the enemies until he was killed.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Busaisah ko jaasoosi karne bheja ye dekhne ki Abu Sufyan ka caravan kya kar raha hai. Woh (wapas) aaye (aur unke ghar mein Nabi se mile) jahan mere aur Allah ke Rasool ke siwaay koi nahi tha. Mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone (Hazrat Anas ne) Nabi (SAW) ki kuch zaujaon ka apwaad rakha ya nahi aur unhe caravan ki khabar batayi. (Ye khabar sunkar), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar aaye (jaldi mein), logon se baat ki aur kaha: Humein (aadmiyon ki) zaroorat hai; jiske paas sawaari ke liye ek taiyaar jaanwar hai use humare saath sawaar hona chahiye. Log unse apne sawaari waale jaanwar laane ki ijazat maangne lage jo Madina ke qareeb pahaadiyon par char rahe the. Unhone kaha: Nahi. (Mujhe chahiye) sirf woh jinke sawaari waale jaanwar taiyaar hain. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba Badr ki taraf badhe aur wahan pahunche mushrikeen (Makkah ke) se aage. Jab mushrikeen (bhi) wahan pahunche, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi (kuch) karne aage na baDhe jab tak main unse aage na hoon. Mushrikeen (ab) aage baDhe (humari taraf), aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jannat mein daakhil hone ke liye utho jo chaudai mein aasmaan aur zameen ke barabar hai. Umair bin al-Humam al-Ansari ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya Jannat aasmaan aur zameen ke barabar failaav mein hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Umair ne kaha: Meri bhalaai! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse poocha: Kisne tumhe ye alfaaz kehne ko preit kiya (yaani "meri bhalaai")? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, sirf ye khwaish ki main iske bashindon mein se hoon. Unhone kaha: Tum (zaroor) iske bashindon mein se ho. Unhone apni thaili se khajooren nikaali aur unhe khaana shuru kiya. Phir unhone kaha: Agar main tab tak zinda rahoon jab tak main apni ye saari khajooren khaa loon, ye ek lambi zindagi hogi. (Raawi kehte hain): Unhone apni saari khajooren phenk din jo unke paas thi. Phir woh dushmanon se larne lage yahan tak ki woh qatal ho gaye.

e: The tradition has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Qais. He heard it from his father who, while facing the enemy, reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Surely, the gates of Paradise are under the shadows of the swords. A man in a shabby condition got up and said; Abu Musa, did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this? He said: Yes. (The narrator said): He returned to his friends and said: I greet you (a farewell greeting). Then he broke the sheath of his sword, threw it away, advanced with his (naked) sword towards the enemy and fought (them) with it until he was slain.
hi: Ye riwayat Abdullah bin Qais ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone ise apne waalid se suna jinhone, dushman ka saamna karte hue, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan, Jannat ke darwaze talwaaron ke saaye ke neeche hain. Ek shakhs, phati-puraani halat mein, khada hua aur kaha: Abu Musa, kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna? Unhone kaha: Haan. (Raawi ne kaha): Woh apne dosto ke paas gaya aur kaha: Main tumhe salaam karta hoon (ek vida ka salaam). Phir usne apni talwaar ki myaan toDi, use phenka, dushman ki taraf apni (nangi) talwaar ke saath aage baDha aur usse (dushman se) larta raha yahan tak ki woh maara gaya.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that some people came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said to him: Send with us some men who may teach us the Qur'an and the Sunnah. Accordingjy, he sent seventy men from the Ansar. They were called the Reciters and among them was my maternal uncle. Haram. They used to recite the Qur'an, discuss and ponder over its meaning at night. In the day they brought water and poured it (in pitchers) in the mosque, collected wood and sold it, and with the sale proceeds bought food for the people of the Suffa and the needy. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent the Reciters with these people, but these (treacherous people) fell upon them and killed thern before they reached their destination (While dying), they said: O Allah, convey from us the news to our Prophet that we have met Thee (in a way) that we are pleased with Thee and Thou art pleased with us. (The narrator said): A man attacked Haram (maternal uncle of Anas) ) from behind and smote him with a spear which pierced him. (While dying), Haram said: By the Lord of the Ka'ba, I have met with success. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his Companions: Your brethren have been slain grid they were saying: O Allah, convey from us to our Prophet the news that we have met Thee in a way that we are pleased with Thee and Thou art pleased with us.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse kaha: Humare saath kuch aadmi bhejiye jo humein Quran aur Sunnat sikha sakein. Uske mutabik, unhone Ansar mein se sattar aadmi bheje. Unhe Qari kaha jaata tha aur unmein mera mama, Haram, bhi tha. Woh raat mein Quran padha karte, charcha karte aur uske matlab par vichaar karte. Din mein woh paani laate aur ise masjid mein (ghadon mein) daalte, lakDi ikattha karte aur ise bechte, aur bikri ki raqam se Suffa ke logon aur zaroorat-mandon ke liye khaana khareedte. Nabi (SAW) ne Qariyon ko in logon ke saath bheja, lekin ye (bewafa log) unpar jhapat pade aur unhe unke manzil tak pahunchne se pehle qatal kar diya. (Marte hue), unhone kaha: Aye Allah, humari taraf se humare Nabi ko khabar pahunchaa ki humne Tujhse (is tarah) mulaqaat ki hai ki hum Tujhse khush hain aur Tu humse khush hai. (Raawi ne kaha): Ek shakhs ne peeche se Haram (Anas ke mama) par hamla kiya aur unhe ek barchhi se maara jo unhe chheed gayi. (Marte hue), Haram ne kaha: Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam, mujhe kaamyaabi mili hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba se kaha: Tumhare bhai qatal kar diye gaye hain aur woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, humari taraf se humare Nabi ko khabar pahunchaa ki humne Tujhse (is tarah) mulaqaat ki hai ki hum Tujhse khush hain aur Tu humse khush hai.

e:
It has been Deported on the authority of Anas who said: My uncle and I have been named after him was not present with the Messenger of Allah (mav peace be upon him) on the Day of Badr. He felt distressed about it. He would say: I have missed the first battle fought by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and if God now gives me an opportunity to see a battlefield with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), God will see what I do therein. He was afraid to say more than this (lest he be unable to keep his word with God). He was present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Uhud. He met Sa'd b. Mu'adh (who was retreating). Anas said to him: O Abu 'Amr, where (are you going)? Woe (to thee)! I find the smell of Paradise beside the Uhud mountain. (Reprimanding Sa'd in these words) he went forward and fought thein (the enemy) until he was killed. (The narrator says). More than eighty wounds inflicted with swords, spears and arrows were found on his body. His sister, my aunt, ar-Rubayyi', daughter of Nadr, said: I could not recognise my brother's body (it was so badly mutilated) except from his finger-tips. (It was on this occasion that) the Qur'anic verse:" Among the Believers are men who have been true to their covenant with God. Of them some have completed their vow (to the extreme), and some still wait: but they have never changed (their determination) in the least" (xxxiii. 23). 
The narrator said that the verse had been revealed about him (Anas b. Nadr) and his Companions.
hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mere chacha, jinke naam se mera naam rakha gaya hai, Badr ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maujood nahi the. Unhe iski wajah se dukh hua. Woh kehte: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zariye ladi gayi pehli jung mein hissa nahi liya, aur agar Allah ab mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek jung ka maidaan dekhne ka mauka deta hai, Allah dekhega ki main usmein kya karta hoon. Unhe isse zyada kehne mein Dar tha (kahin woh Allah se apna wachan poora na kar payein). Woh Uhud ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maujood the. Woh Sa'd bin Mu'adh se mile (jo peeche haT rahe the). Anas ne unse kaha: Aye Abu Amr, kahan (ja rahe ho)? Afsos (tumpar)! Main Uhud pahaad ke bagal mein Jannat ki mahak paa raha hoon. (Sa'd ko in alfaazon mein daantte hue) woh aage baDhe aur unse (dushman se) larte rahe yahan tak ki woh qatal ho gaye. (Raawi kehte hain): Unke badan par assi se zyada talwaar, barchhi aur teer ke zakhm paaye gaye. Unki behn, meri chachi, ar-Rubayyi, Nadr ki beti, ne kaha: Main apne bhai ki laash ko pehchaan nahi paayi (ye itni khaufnaak soorat se vikrit thi) siwaay unki ungliyon ke sire se. (Isi mauqe par) Qurani aayat: "Imaandaaron mein aise log hain jinhone Allah ke saath apni ahd nibhaayi hai. Unmein se kuchne apni ahd poori tarah poora kar li hai, aur kuch abhi intezaar mein hain: lekin unhone kabhi apne (azm) mein zara bhi badlaav nahi kiya" (33:23), nazil hui. Raawi ne kaha ki ye aayat unke (Anas bin Nadr ke) aur unke sahaba ke baare mein nazil hui thi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari that a desert Arab came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, one man fights fgr the spoils of war; another fights that he may be remembered, and another fights that he may see his (high) position (achieved as a result of his valour in fighting). Which of these is fighting in the cause of God? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who fights so that the word of Allah is exalted is fighting in the way of Allah.
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek registaan ka Arab Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ek aadmi maal-e-ganimat ke liye larta hai; doosra is liye larta hai ki use yaad rakha jaaye, aur doosra is liye larta hai ki woh apna (uchcha) darja dekhe (jo jung mein uski bahaduri ke natije mein haasil hua ho). Inmein se Allah ki khaatir kaun larta hai? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo is liye larta hai ki Allah ka lafz buland ho, woh Allah ki raah mein larta hai.

e: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Musa who said. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked which of the men fights in the way of Allah: (one who fights) for displaying his valour; (a man who) fights out of his family pride and (a man who) fights for the sake of show, who amongst these fights in the way of Allah? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who fights that the word of Allah be exalted fights in the way of Allah.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Musa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki insaanon mein se kaun Allah ki raah mein larta hai: (koi jo) larta hai apni bahaduri dikhaane ke liye; (koi aadmi jo) apne khaandaani ghamand ki khaatir larta hai aur (koi aadmi jo) dikhaave ki khaatir larta hai, inmein se kaun Allah ki raah mein larta hai? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo is liye larta hai ki Allah ka lafz buland ho woh Allah ki raah mein larta hai.

e: It has been narrated (through yet another chain of transmitters) on the same authority, i. e. Abu Musa, who said: We, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, one of us hho fights to display his valour... (followed by the same words as we have in the previous tradition).
hi: (Ek phir bhi doosri sanad ke zariye) usi raawi, yaani Abu Musa, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hummein se ek jo apni bahaduri dikhaane ke liye larta hai... (uske baad wahi alfaaz hain jo pichhli hadees mein hain).

e: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the same authority, i. e. Abu Musa Ash'ari, that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about fighting in the way of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, a man who fights out of rage or out of family pride. He raised his head towards him-and he did so because the man was standing and said: Who fights that the word of Allah be exalted fights in the way of Allah.
hi: Ek doosri sanad ke zariye usi raawi, yaani Abu Musa Ash'ari, se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki raah mein larne ke baare mein poocha, ek aadmi jo gusse ki wajah se ya khaandaani ghamand ki wajah se larta hai. Unhone apna sar unki taraf uThAya - aur unhone aisa is liye kiya kyunki woh aadmi khada tha - aur kaha: Jo is liye larta hai ki Allah ka lafz buland ho woh Allah ki raah mein larta hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman b. Yasar who said: People dispersed from around Abu Huraira, and Natil, who was from the Syrians. said to him: O Shaikh, relate (to us) a tradition you have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The first of men (whose case) will be decided on the Day of Judgment will be a man who died as a martyr. He shall be brought (before the Judgment Seat). Allah will make him recount His blessings (i. e. the blessings which He had bestowed upon him) and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his life). (Then) will Allah say: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I fought for Thee until I died as a martyr. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You fought that you might be called a" brave warrior". And you were called so. (Then) orders will be passed against him and he will be dragged with his face downward and cast into Hell. Then will be brought forward a man who acquired knowledge and imparted it (to others) and recited the Qur'an. He will be brought And Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Then will Allah ask: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I acquired knowledge and disseminated it and recited the Qur'an seeking Thy pleasure. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You acquired knowledge so that you might be called" a scholar," and you recited the Qur'an so that it might be said:" He is a Qari" and such has been said. Then orders will be passed against him and he shall be dragged with his face downward and cast into the Fire. Then will be brought a man whom Allah had made abundantly rich and had granted every kind of wealth. He will be brought and Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them and (admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Allah will (then) ask: What have you done (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I spent money in every cause in which Thou wished that it should be spent. Allah will say: You are lying. You did (so) that it might be said about (You):" He is a generous fellow" and so it was said. Then will Allah pass orders and he will be dragged with his face downward and thrown into Hell.
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Log Abu Huraira ke aas-paas se bikhar gaye, aur Natil, jo Syria walon mein se the, ne unse kaha: Aye Sheikh, humein (ek hadees) sunaiye jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni ho. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse pehla insaan (jiske maamle) ka faisla Qayamat ke din hoga woh ek aadmi hoga jo shaheed hokar mara. Use (Nyaay ki Kursi ke saamne) laaya jaayega. Allah use Apni barkatein ginwaayenge (yaani woh barkatein jo Usne use di thin) aur woh unhe ginwaayega (aur unhe apni zindagi mein bhogne ki baat kubool karega). (Phir) Allah kahega: Tumne (in barkaton ka badla dene ke liye) kya kiya? Woh kahega: Maine Teri khaatir tab tak larai ki jab tak main shaheed nahi ho gaya. Allah kahega: Tumne jhoot bola. Tum is liye lade taaki tumhe "bahaadur mujahid" kaha jaaye. Aur tumhe kaha gaya (aisa hi). (Phir) uske khilaaf hukum diye jaayenge aur use munh ke bal ghaseeta jaayega aur Jahannam mein daala jaayega. Phir ek aadmi laaya jaayega jisne ilm haasil kiya tha aur ise (doosron ko) sikhaaya, aur Quran padha. Use laaya jaayega. Aur Allah use Apni barkatein ginwaayenge aur woh unhe ginwaayega (aur unhe apni zindagi mein bhogne ki baat kubool karega). Phir Allah poochenge: Tumne (in barkaton ka badla dene ke liye) kya kiya? Woh kahega: Maine ilm haasil kiya aur ise phailaaya aur Quran padha Tujhe khush karne ke liye. Allah kahenge: Tumne jhoot bola. Tumne ilm is liye haasil kiya taaki tumhe "ek aalim" kaha jaaye, aur tumne Quran is liye padha taaki kaha jaaye: "Woh ek Qari hai" aur aisa hi kaha gaya. Phir uske khilaaf hukum diye jaayenge aur use munh ke bal ghaseeta jaayega aur Aag mein daala jaayega. Phir ek aadmi laaya jaayega jise Allah ne khoob daulatmand banaaya tha aur har tarah ki daulat di thi. Use laaya jaayega aur Allah use Apni barkatein ginwaayenge aur woh unhe ginwaayega aur (unhe apni zindagi mein bhogne ki baat kubool karega). Allah (phir) poochenge: Tumne (in barkaton ka badla dene ke liye) kya kiya? Woh kahega: Maine har us maqsad mein paisa kharch kiya jismein Tu chaahta tha ki ise kharch kiya jaaye. Allah kahenge: Tum jhoot bol rahe ho. Tumne (aisa) is liye kiya taaki (tumhare baare mein) kaha jaaye: "Woh ek sakhi shakhs hai" aur aisa hi kaha gaya. Phir Allah hukum denge aur use munh ke bal ghaseeta jaayega aur Jahannam mein phenka jaayega.

e: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Amr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A troop of soldiers who fight in tile way of Allah and get their share of the booty receive in advance two-thirds of their reward in the Hereafter and only one-third will remain (to their credit). If they do not receive any booty, they will get their full reward.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek sipaahiyon ki toli jo Allah ki raah mein larti hai aur maal-e-ganimat mein apna hissa paati hai, unhe Aakhirat mein apne sawaab ka do-tihai hissa pehle hi mil jaata hai aur sirf ek-tihai hi baaki rahega (unke haq mein). Agar unhe koi maal-e-ganimat nahi milta, unhe poora sawaab milega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Amr (through a different chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A troop of soldiers, large or small, who fight (in the way of Allah), get their share of the booty and return safe and sound, receive in advance two-thirds of their reward (only one-third remaining to their credit to be received in the Hereafter) ; and a troop of soldiers, large or small, who return empty-handed and are afflicted or wounded, will receive their full reward (in the Hereafter).
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ke hawale se (ek doosri sanad ke zariye) ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sipaahiyon ki ek toli, badi ya choti, jo (Allah ki raah mein) larti hai, maal-e-ganimat mein apna hissa paati hai aur mahfooz wapas aati hai, unhe apne sawaab ka do-tihai hissa pehle hi mil jaata hai (sirf ek-tihai baaki rehta hai unke haq mein jo Aakhirat mein milega); aur sipaahiyon ki ek toli, badi ya choti, jo khaali haath wapas aati hai aur (jung mein) pareshaan ya zakhmi hoti hai, unhe (Aakhirat mein) poora sawaab milega.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Umar b. al-Khattab that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (The value of) an action depends on the intention behind it. A man will be rewarded only for what he intended. The emigration of one who emigrates for the sake of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) is for the sake of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) ; and the emigration of one who emigrates for gaining a worldly advantage or for marrying a woman is for what he has emigrated.
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: (Kisi amal ki keemat) uske peechhe ki niyat par nirbhar karti hai. Ek aadmi ko usi cheez ka sawaab milega jiske liye usne niyat ki thi. Jo Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ki khaatir hijrat karta hai uski hijrat Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) ki khaatir hai; aur jo duniyaavi faayde ke liye ya kisi aurat se shaadi karne ke liye hijrat karta hai uski hijrat usi cheez ke liye hai jiske liye usne hijrat ki.

e: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Sufyan who said that he heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab relate (this tradition) from the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was delivering a sermon from the pulpit.
hi: Ye riwayat Sufyan ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha ki unhone Umar bin al-Khattab ko (ye hadees) Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte suna jab woh mimbar se khutba de rahe the.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: Who seeks martyrdom with sincerity shall get its reward, though he may not achieve it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo eemaandaari se shahaadat maangta hai use uska sawaab milega, chahe woh use haasil na kare.

e: It has been reported on the authority of Sahl b. Aba Umama b. Sahl b. Hunaif who learned the tradition from his father who (in turn) learned it from his grandfather-that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who sought martyrdom with sincerity will be ranked by Allah among the martyrs even if he died on his bed. In his version of the tradition Abd Tahir did not mention the words:" with sincerity".
hi: Sahl bin Aba Umama bin Sahl bin Hunaif ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ye hadees apne waalid se seekhi jinhone (badle mein) ise apne dada se seekha - ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo eemaandaari se shahaadat maangta hai use Allah shaheedon mein shaamil karega chahe woh apne bistar par mare. Apni riwayat mein Abd Tahir ne "eemaandaari se" alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who died but did not fight in the way of Allah nor did he express any desire (or determination) for Jihad died the death of a hypocrite. 
'Abdullah b. Mubarak said: We think the hadith pertained to the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo mara lekin na to Allah ki raah mein lada na hi usne Jihad ke liye koi khwaish (ya azm) zaahir ki, woh ek munafiq ki maut mara. Abdullah bin Mubarak ne kaha: Humein lagta hai ki ye hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke daur se mutaliq thi.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir who said: We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on an expedition. He said: There are some people in Medina. They are with you whenever you cover a distance or cross a valley. They have been detained by illness.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par the. Unhone kaha: Madina mein kuch log hain. Woh tumhare saath hain jab bhi tum koi doori tay karte ho ya kisi wadi ko paar karte ho. Unhe beemari ne roka hua hai.

e: In a version of the tradition narrated on the authority of A'mash, we have the words: " They will share with you the reward (for Jihad)."
hi: A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ke ek soorat mein humare paas alfaaz hain: "Woh (Jihad ka) sawaab tumhare saath baantenge."

e:
It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to visit Umm Haram daughter of Milhan (who was the sister of his foster-mother or his father's aunt). She was the wife of 'Ubada b. Samit, One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid her a visit. She entertained him with food and then sat down to rub his head. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dozed off and when he woke up (after a while), he was laughing. She asked: What made you laugh. Messenger of Allah? He said: Some people from my Umma were presented to me who were fighters in the way of Allah and were sailing in this sea. (Gliding smoothly on the water), they appeared to be kings or like kings (sitting) on thrones (the narrator has a doubt about the actual expression used by the Holy Prophet). She said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He may include me among these warriors. He prayed for her. Then he placed his head (down) and dozed off (again). He woke up laughing, as before. (She said) I said: Messenger of Allah, what makes you laugh? He replied: A people from my Umma were presented to me. They were fighters in Allah's way. (He described them in the same words as he had described the first warriors.) She said: Messenger of Allah, pray to God that He may include me among these warriors. He said: You are among the first ones. 
Umm Haram daughter of Milhan sailed in the aea in the time of Mu'awiya. When she came out of the sea and (was going to mount a riding animal) she fell down and died.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Haram, Milhan ki beti (jo unki doodh-maa ki behn thin ya unki chachi thin), se milne jaate the. Woh Ubada bin Samit ki zauja thin. Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse mulaqaat ki. Unhone unhe khaana khilaaya aur phir unka sar malne baithi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unghi aa gayi aur jab woh (thodi der baad) jaage, woh hans rahe the. Unhone poocha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kis baat ne hansaya? Unhone kaha: Meri Ummat ke kuch log mujhe dikhaaye gaye jo Allah ki raah mein mujahid the aur is samundar mein sailing kar rahe the. (Paani par sahjata se glide karte hue), woh raajaon jaise ya raajaon jaise (baiThe hue) apne singhaasan par lagte the (raawi ko shak hai Nabi-e-Paak ne kaunse alfaaz istemal kiye). Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe in mujahidon mein shaamil kare. Unhone unke liye dua ki. Phir unhone apna sar (neeche) rakha aur (dobara) unghi aa gayi. Woh pehle jaisa hanste hue jaage. (Unhone kaha) Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kis baat ne hansaya? Unhone jawaab diya: Meri Ummat ke log mujhe dikhaaye gaye. Woh Allah ki raah mein mujahid the. (Unhone unhe usi alfaazon mein bataya jaisa unhone pehle mujahidon ko bataaya tha.) Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe in mujahidon mein shaamil kare. Unhone kaha: Tum pehlon mein se ho. Umm Haram, Milhan ki beti, ne Muawiya ke daur mein samundar mein sailing ki. Jab woh samundar se bahar aayin (aur ek sawaari waale jaanwar par chadhne wali thin) woh gir gayin aur mar gayin.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Umm Haram (and she was the aunt of Anas) who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us one day and had a nap in our house. When he woke up, he was laughing. I said: Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh? He said: I saw a people from my followers sailing on the surface of the sea (looking) like kings (sitting) on their thrones. I said: Pray to Allah that He may include me among them. He said: You will be among them. He had a (second) nap, woke up and was laughing. I asked him (the reason for his laughter). He gave the same reply. I said: Pray to Allah that He may include me among them. He said: You are among the first ones. Anas said: 'Ubada b. Samit married her. He joined a naval expedition and took her along with him. When she returned, a mule was brought for her. While mounting it she fell down, broke her neck (and died).
hi: Umm Haram (jo Anas ki chachi thin) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) ek din humare paas aaye aur humare ghar mein jhapki li. Jab woh jaage, woh hans rahe the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kis baat ne hansaaya? Unhone kaha: Maine apne anuyaayiyon mein se ek qaum ko samundar ki satah par sailing karte dekha (jo) raajaon jaise (dikhte the) apne singhaasan par (baiThe hue). Maine kaha: Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe unmein shaamil kare. Unhone kaha: Tum unmein hogi. Unhone (doosri baar) jhapki li, jaage aur hans rahe the. Maine unse (unki hansi ki wajah) poochi. Unhone wahi jawaab diya. Maine kaha: Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe unmein shaamil kare. Unhone kaha: Tum pehlon mein se ho. Anas ne kaha: Ubada bin Samit ne unse shaadi ki. Woh ek naval muhim mein shaamil hue aur unhe apne saath le gaye. Jab woh wapas aayin, unke liye ek khachchar laaya gaya. Uspar chadhte hue woh gir gayin, unki gardan tooti (aur unka intiqaal ho gaya).

e: It has been reported on the authority of Umm Haram daughter of Milhan (through another chain of transmitters). She said: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept (at a place) near me. He woke up smiling. She said: Messenger of Allah. what made thee laugh? He said: A people from my followers were presented to me. They were sailing on the surface of this green sea... (here follows the tradition that has gone before).
hi: Umm Haram, Milhan ki beti, ke hawale se (ek doosri sanad ke zariye) ye riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone kaha: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere qareeb (ek jagah) soye. Woh muskuraate hue jaage. Unhone (Umm Haram ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kis baat ne hansaaya? Unhone kaha: Meri anuyaayiyon mein se ek qaum mujhe dikhaayi gayi. Woh is hare samundar ki satah par sailing kar rahe the... (yahan wahi riwayat hai jo pehle guzar chuki hai).

e: It has been reported by 'Abdullah b. 'Abd al-Rahman that he heard Anas b. Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid a visit to Milhan's daughter, maternal aunt of Anas (and the sister of the Holy Prophet's foster-mother). He placed his head near her (from this point onward, the narrator carried on the previous tradition to its end).
hi: Abdullah bin Abd al-Rahman ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone Anas bin Malik ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Milhan ki beti, Anas ki maasi (aur Nabi-e-Paak ki doodh-maa ki behn), se milne gaye. Unhone apna sar unke qareeb rakha (is bindu se aage, raawi ne pichhli hadees ko uske ant tak jaari rakha).

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Salman who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Keeping watch for a day and a night is better (in point of reward) than fasting for a whole month and standing in prayer every night. If a person dies (while, performing this duty), his (meritorious) activity will continue and he will go on receiving his reward for it perpetually and will be saved from the torture of the grave.
hi: Salman ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek din aur ek raat ke liye pahre par rahna (sawaab ke soorat mein) poore mahine ke roze aur har raat namaz mein khada hone se behtar hai. Agar koi shakhs (ye zimmedari nibhaane karte hue) marta hai, uski (punyapurna) gatividhi jaari rahegi aur usko iske liye sadaiv sawaab milega aur woh qabar ke azaab se bacha rahega.

e: This tradition has been handed down on the authority of Salman al-Khair through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat Salman al-Khair ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: While a man walks along a path, finds a thorny twig lying on the way and puts it aside, Allah would appreciate it and forgive him The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The martyrs are of five kinds: one who dies of plague; one who dies of diarrhoea (or cholera) ; one who is drowned; one who is buried under debris and one who dies fighting in the way of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab ek shakhs kisi raaste par chalta hai, kaanTe dar ki ek shaakha raaste mein padi paata hai aur use hataata hai, Allah iski qadar karega aur use maaf karega. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Shaheed paanch kism ke hote hain: jo mahamaari se marta hai; jo pait ke rog (ya haija) se marta hai; jo Doob jaata hai; jo malbe ke neeche dab jaata hai aur jo Allah ki raah mein larte hue marta hai.

e:
It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (through another chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whom do you consider to be a martyr among you? They (the Companions) said: Messenger, of Allah, one who is slain in the way of Allah is a martyr. He said: Then (if this is the definition of a martyr) the martyrs of my Umma will be small in number. They asked: Messenger of Allah, who are they? He said: One who is slain in the way of Allah is a martyr; one who dies in the way of Allah, is a martyr; one who dies of plague is a martyr; one who dies of cholera is a martyr. 
Ibn Miqsam said: I testify the truth of your father's statement (with regard to this tradition) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: One who is drowned is a martyr.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se kise shaheed maante ho? Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jo Allah ki raah mein maara jaata hai woh shaheed hai. Unhone kaha: Phir (agar ye shaheed ki paribhaasha hai) meri Ummat ke shaheed tadaad mein bahut chhote honge. Unhone poocha: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Jo Allah ki raah mein maara jaata hai woh shaheed hai; jo Allah ki raah mein marta hai, woh shaheed hai; jo mahamaari se marta hai woh shaheed hai; jo haija se marta hai woh shaheed hai. Ibn Miqsam ne kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki aapke waalid ke bayaan ki sachchaai (is hadees ke silsile mein) ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Doobta hai woh shaheed hai.

e: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Suhail contains the additional words: " And one who is drowned is a martyr."
hi: Suhail ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat in izafi alfaazon ko shaamil karta hai: "Aur jo Doobta hai woh shaheed hai."

e: Another version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Suhail thouch a different chain of transmitters contains the additional words: " A drowned person is a martyr."
hi: Suhail ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek doosra soorat in izafi alfaazon ko shaamil karta hai: "Doobne wala shaheed hai."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Hafsa daughter of Sirin who said: Anas b. Malik asked me the cause of death of Yahya b. 'Abu 'Amra. I said: (He died) of plague. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that death by plague is martyrdom for a Muslim.
hi: Hafsa, Sirin ki beti, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Anas bin Malik ne mujhse Yahya bin Abu Amra ki maut ka wajah poocha. Maine kaha: (Unka intiqaal) mahamaari se hua. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha ki mahamaari se maut ek Musalman ke liye shahaadat hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Asim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Amir who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say-and he was delivering a sermon from the pulpit: Prepare to meet them with as much strength as you can afford. Beware, strength consists in archery. Beware, strength consists in archery. Beware, strength consists in archery.
hi: Ibn Amir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna - aur woh mimbar se khutba de rahe the: Unse (dushmanon se) muqaabla karne ke liye jitni taaqat ho sake taiyaari karo. Dhyaan raho, taaqat teerandaazi mein hai. Dhyaan raho, taaqat teerandaazi mein hai. Dhyaan raho, taaqat teerandaazi mein hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Uqba b. Amir who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Lands shall be thrown open to you and Allah will suffice you (against your enemies), but none of you should give up playing with his arrows.
hi: Uqba bin Amir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zameenein tumhare liye khol di jaayengi aur Allah tumhare liye (tumhare dushmanon ke khilaaf) kaafi hoga, lekin tum mein se koi bhi apne teeron se khelna na chhode.

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the same authority through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Yehi riwayat isi raawi ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been reported by 'Abd al-Rahman b. Shamasa that Fuqaim al- Lakhmi said to Uqba b. Amir: You frequent between these two targets and you are an old man, so you will be finding it very hard. 'Uqba said: But for a thing I heard from the Prophet (ﷺ), I would not strain myself. Harith (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: I asked Ibn Shamasa: What was that? He said that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Who learnt archery and then gave it up is not from us. or he has been guilty of disobedience (to Allah's Apostle).
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Shamasa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Fuqaim al-Lakhmi ne Uqba bin Amir se kaha: Aap in do nishaanon ke beech baar-baar aate-jaate hain aur aap ek boodhe aadmi hain, is liye aapko ye bahut mushkil lagega. Uqba ne kaha: Lekin ek baat ke liye jo maine Nabi (SAW) se suni, main khud ko itni mehnat nahi deta. Harith (sanad ke ek raawi) ne kaha: Maine Ibn Shamasa se poocha: Woh kya thi? Unhone kaha ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jo teerandaazi seekhkar phir isse chhod deta hai woh humme se nahi hai, ya woh (Allah ke Rasool ki) naafarmani ka dosi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Thauban that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A group of people from my Umma will always remain triumphant on the right path and continue to be triumphant (against their opponents). He who deserts them shall not be able to do them any harm. They will remain in this position until Allah's Command is executed (i.e. Qiyamah is established). In Qutaiba's version of the tradition, we do not have the words:" They will remain in this position."
hi: Thauban ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh hamesha sahi raah par jeetta hua rahega aur (apne virodhiyon ke khilaaf) jeetta rahega. Jo unhe chhodta hai woh unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaa payega. Woh is haalat mein tab tak rahenge jab tak Allah ka hukum poora nahi hota (yaani Qiyamat sthapit nahi ho jaati). Qutaiba ki riwayat ki gayi riwayat mein humare paas ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Woh is haalat mein rahenge."

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Mughira who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to be triumphant over the people until the Command of Allah overtakes them while they are still triumphant.
hi: Mughira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh logon par jeetta hua rehna jaari rakhega jab tak Allah ka Hukum unhe pakad na le jabki woh abhi bhi jeette hain.

e: The same tradition has been narrated through another chain of transmitters on the same authority.
hi: Yehi riwayat isi raawi ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: This religion will continue to exist, and a group of people from the Muslims will continue to fight for its protection until the Hour is established.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Ye deen wajood mein bana rahega, aur Musalmaanon ka ek giroh iski hifaazat ke liye larta rahega jab tak Ghadi (Qiyamat) sthapit nahi ho jaati.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to fight In defence of truth and remain triumphant until the Day of judgment.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh sach ki hifaazat mein larna jaari rakhega aur Qayamat ke din tak jeetta rahega.

e: It his been narrated on the authority of Umair b. Umm Hani who said: I heard Mu'awiya say (while delivering a sermon from the pulpit) that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to obey Allah's Command, and those who desert or oppose them shall not be able to do them any harm. They will be dominating the peeple until Allah's Command is executed (i. e. Resurrection is established).
hi: Umair bin Umm Hani ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Muawiya ko (mimbar se khutba dete waqt) ye kehte suna ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh Allah ke Hukum ki itaat karna jaari rakhega, aur jo unhe chhodte ya unka virodh karte hain woh unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaa payenge. Woh logon par haavi rahenge jab tak Allah ka Hukum poora nahi hota (yaani Punarutthaan sthapit nahi ho jaata).

e: It has been related by, Yazid b. al-Asamm that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sfyan quote a tradition from the Prophet (ﷺ) which he related from the Prophet (mail peace he upon him) -and he did not hear him quote from the Prophet (masy peace be upon him) any tradition other than this in the course of his sermon from the pulpit-that whom Allah wants to do a favour, He grants him an understanding of religion. A group of people from the Muslims will remain on the Right Path and continue until the Day of Judgment to triumph over those who oppose them.
hi: Yazid bin al-Asamm ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ko Nabi (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat karte suna jo unhone Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki - aur unhone unhe mimbar se apne khutbe mein iske ilawa koi doosri hadees Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hue nahi suna - ki jise Allah favour dena chahta hai, Woh use deen ki samajh deta hai. Musalmaanon ka ek giroh Sahi Raah par rahega aur Qayamat ke din tak un logon par jeetta rahega jo unka virodh karte hain.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Shamasa al- Mahri who said: I was in the company of Maslama b. Mukhallad, and 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As was with him. 'Abdullah said: The Hour shall some oniy when the worst type of people are left on the earth. They will be worse than the people of pre-Islamic days. They will get whatever they ask of Allah. While we were yet sitting when 'Uqba b. 'Amir came, and Maslama said to him: 'Uqba, listen to what 'Abdullah says. 'Uqba said: He knows better; so far as I am concerned, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to fight in obedience to the Command of Allah, remaining dominant over their enemies. Those who will oppose them shall not do them any harm. They will remain ill this condition until the Hour overtakes them. (At this) 'Abdullah said: Yes. Then Allah will raise a wild which will be fragrant like musk and whose touch will be like the touch of silk; (but) it will cause the death of all (faithful) persons, not leaving behind a single person with an iota of faith in his heart. Then only the worst of men will remain to be overwhelmed by the Hour.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Shamasa al-Mahri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Maslama bin Mukhallad ki sohbat mein tha, aur Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As unke saath the. Abdullah ne kaha: Ghadi (Qiyamat) tabhi aayegi jab zameen par sirf sabse buray kism ke log bache honge. Woh Islam-purv daur ke logon se bhi bure honge. Unhe woh sab kuch milega jo woh Allah se maangenge. Jab hum abhi baithe hue the ki Uqba bin Amir aaye, aur Maslama ne unse kaha: Uqba, suno Abdullah kya keh rahe hain. Uqba ne kaha: Woh behtar jaante hain; jahan tak mera sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh Allah ke Hukum ki itaat mein larna jaari rakhega, apne dushmanon par haavi rehte hue. Jo unka virodh karenge woh unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayenge. Woh is haalat mein rahenge jab tak Ghadi unhe pakad na le. (Isper) Abdullah ne kaha: Haan. Phir Allah ek hawa uThAyega jo mushk jaisi khushboodaar hogi aur jiska sparsh resham ke sparsh jaisa hoga; (lekin) ye sab (imaandaar) logon ki maut ka wajah banegi, kisi bhi ek shakhs ko peeche na chhodte hue jiske dil mein imaan ki ek zarra bhi ho. Phir sirf sabse bure log bachenge jinhe Ghadi apne aagosh mein le legi.

e: It has been narrated by Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people of the West will continue to triumphantly follow the truth until the Hour is established.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Paschim ke log sach ka jeettA hua anusaran karna jaari rakhenge jab tak Ghadi sthapit nahi ho jaati.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When you journey through a fertile land, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to graze in the land. When you travel In an arid (land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should quicken their pace (lest your camels grow feeble and emaciated for lack of fodder). When you halt for the night, avoid (pitching your tent on) the road, for it is the abode of noxious little animals at night.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum ek upjaau zameen se guzarte ho, tumhe (dheere jaana chahiye aur) oonton ko zameen mein charne ka mauka dena chahiye. Jab tum ek shushk (zameen) mein safar karte ho jahan vanaspati ki kami hai, tumhe unki raftaar tez karni chahiye (kahin tumhare oont chaare ki kami se kamzor aur dubla-patla ho jaayein). Jab tum raat ke liye rukte ho, raaste (par apna khaima gaadne) se bacho, kyunki ye raat mein haanikaarak choti jaanwaron ka basera hai.

e: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When you travel (through a land) where there is plenty of vegetation, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to enjoy the benefit of the earth. When you travel (through a land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should hasten with them (so that you may be able to cross that land while your animals ore still in a good condition of health). When you make a halt for the night, avoid (doing so on) the road, for the tracks are the pathways of wild beasts or the abode of noxious little animals.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum (aisi zameen mein) safar karte ho jahan bahut vanaspati hai, tumhe (dheere jaana chahiye aur) oonton ko zameen ka faayda lene ka mauka dena chahiye. Jab tum (aisi zameen mein) safar karte ho jahan vanaspati ki kami hai, tumhe unke saath jaldi karni chahiye (taaki tum us zameen ko paar kar sako jab tak tumhare jaanwar abhi bhi achhi sehat mein hain). Jab tum raat ke liye rukte ho, raaste par (aisa karne) se bacho, kyunki ye raaste jangli jaanwaron ke raaste hain ya haanikaarak choti jaanwaron ka basera hain.

e: On the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Travelling is a tortuous experience. It deprives a person of his sleep. his food and drink. When one of you has accomplished his purpose, he should hasten his return to his family.
hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Safar ek pareshaani bhara tajurba hai. Ye insaan se uski neend, uska khaana aur peena chheen leti hai. Jab tum mein se koi apna maqsad poora kar leta hai, use apne khaandaan ke paas jaldi wapas jaana chahiye.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not come (back) to his family by night. He would come to them in the morning or in the evening.
hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat mein apne khaandaan ke paas (wapas) nahi aate the. Woh unke paas subah ya shaam ko aate the.

e: Another version of the tradition narrated on the same authority worded slightly differently. It says: (He) would not enter (upon his household at night).
hi: Isi raawi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka doosra soorat alfaazon mein thoda alag hai. Ismein kaha gaya hai: (Woh) raat mein (apne khaandaan ke paas) daakhil nahi hote the.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah who said: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition. When we came (back) to Medina and were going to enter our houses, he said: Wait and enter (your houses) in the later part of the evening so that a woman with dishevelled hair may have used the comb, and a woman whose husband has been away from home may have removed the hair from her private parts.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaye. Jab hum Madina (wapas) aaye aur apne gharon mein daakhil hone waale the, unhone kaha: Ruko aur shaam ke aakhri hisse mein daakhil ho taaki bikhre baalon waali aurat ne kangha kar liya ho, aur jis aurat ka shohar ghar se door raha ho usne apne guptaang ke baal hataa liye hon.

e: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If one of you comes (back from a journey) at night. he should not enter his house as a night visitor (but should wait) until a woman whose husband has been away from house has removed the hair from her private parts and a woman with dishevelled hair has combed her hair.
hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi raat ko (safar se) wapas aata hai, use apne ghar mein raat ke mehmaan ki tarah daakhil nahi hona chahiye (balki intezaar karna chahiye) jab tak woh aurat jiska shohar ghar se door raha ho apne guptaang ke baal hataa na le aur bikhre baalon waali aurat ne apne baalon mein kangha na kar liya ho.

e: This tradition has been handed down through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitters) on the authority of Jabir who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man who had long absent should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki ek aadmi jo lambe waqt se gair-haazir raha ho apne khaandaan ke paas (ek achaanak) raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aaye.

e: The above tradition has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitten) on the authority of Jabir who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses.
hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki ek aadmi apne khaandaan ke paas ek (achaanak) raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aaye, unki wafadaari par shak karte hue aur unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue.

e: This tradition has been reported through anothee chain.  'Abdurahman, one of the sub-narrators, said "I do not know if it in the hadith or not", meaning (the words) "doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Abdurahman, sanad ke ek raawi, ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata ki ye hadees mein hai ya nahi," unka matlab (in alfaazon se) tha "unki wafadaari par shak karte hue aur unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue."

e: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Jabir (but through a different chain of transmitters) mentions the undesirability of coining to one's house like a night visitor, but does not contain the words: " Doubting their fidelity or spying into their lapses."
hi: Jabir ki sanad se (lekin ek doosri sanad ke zariye) riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat apne ghar mein raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aane ki napasandeegi ka zikr karta hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Unki wafadaari par shak karte hue ya unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue."

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, I set off trained dogs and they catch for me (the game) and I recite the name of Allah over it (I slaughter the game by reciting Bismillah-i-Allah-o-Akbar), whereupon he said: When you set off your trained dogs, if you recited the name of Allah (while setting them off), then eat (the game). I said: Even if they (the trained dogs) kill that (the game)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Even if these kill, but (on the condition) that no other dog, which you did not set off (along with your dogs), participates (in catching the game). I said to him: I throw Mi'rad, a heavy featherless blunt arrow, for hunting and killing (the game). Thereupon he said: When you throw Mi'rad, and it pierces, then eat, but if it falls flatly (and beats the game to death), then do not eat that.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhodta hoon aur woh mere liye (shikaar) pakadte hain aur main uspar Allah ka naam padhta hoon (main shikaar ko Bismillah-i-Allah-o-Akbar padhkar zibah karta hoon), isper unhone kaha: Jab tum apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhodte ho, agar tumne (unhe chhodte waqt) Allah ka naam liya, to (shikaar) khaao. Maine kaha: Chahe woh (sikhaaye hue kutte) use maar bhi dein? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Chahe woh maar dein, lekin (is shart par) ki koi doosra kutta, jise tumne (apne kutton ke saath) na chhoda ho, shaamil na ho (shikaar pakadne mein). Maine unse kaha: Main shikaar ke liye Mi'rad, ek bhaari bina par ka kunda teer, phenkta hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum Mi'rad phenko, aur ye (shikaar ko) bhed de, to khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein gire (aur shikaar ko maar-maar kar maut de), to use mat khaao.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: We are a people who hunt with these (trained) dogs, then (what should we do)? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: When you set of your trained dogs having recited the name of Allah, then eat what these (hounds) have caught for you, even if it (the game) is killed, provided (the hunting dog) has not eaten (any part of the game). If it has eaten (the game), then you don't eat it as I fear that it might have caught for its own self. And do not eat it if other dogs have joined your trained dogs.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Hum aise log hain jo in (sikhaaye hue) kutton se shikaar karte hain, to (humein kya karna chahiye)? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jab tum Allah ka naam lekar apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhoDte ho, to woh khaao jo ye (shikaari kutte) tumhare liye pakadein, chahe (shikaar) maara gaya ho, bashart-e ki (shikaari kutte ne) usmein se kuch na khaaya ho. Agar usne (shikaar) khaaya hai, to tum use mat khaao kyunki mujhe Dar hai ki usne shayad ye apne khud ke liye pakda ho. Aur ise mat khaao agar doosre kutte tumhare sikhaaye hue kutton ke saath shaamil ho gaye hon.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting) with the help of an arrow having a stub end. He said: If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat, but if it strikes flatly and it dies, that is Waqidh (beaten into death), do not eat that. I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting with the help of) dogs, whereupon he said. When you send your dog (for hunting) reciting the name of Allah, then eat (the game), but if some part of it is eaten (by the dogs, then do not eat that, for it (your dog) has caught that (the-game) for itself. I (again) said: If I find along with my dog another dog, and do not know which of (the dogs) has caught (the game). then (what should I do)? Thereupon he ('Allah's Messenger) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and not on the other one.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek bina par ke kunde teer ki madad se (shikaar) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Agar ye (shikaar ko) apne nukili sire se maare, to khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein maare aur woh mar jaaye, to ye Waqidh hai (peeta-maara), use mat khaao. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kutton (ki madad se shikaar) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Jab tum Allah ka naam lekar apne kutte ko (shikaar ke liye) bhejte ho, to (shikaar) khaao, lekin agar iska koi hissa (kutton ke zariye) khaaya gaya hai, to use mat khaao, kyunki usne (tumhaare kutte ne) use apne liye pakda hai. Maine (dobara) kaha: Agar main apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paaun, aur mujhe nahi pata ki (kutton mein se) kisne (shikaar) pakda hai, to (mujhe kya karna chahiye)? Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Phir use mat khaao, kyunki tumne apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya tha aur doosre par nahi.

e: Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Mi'rad (i. e. hunting with the help of arrow having a stub end, and he stated the same (as we find in the previous hadith).
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Mi'rad (yaani ek bina par ke kunde teer ki madad se shikaar) ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone wahi kaha jaisa humein pichhli hadees mein milta hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Adi bin Hatim ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting the game with the help of Mi'rad, whereupon he said: If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat it, but if it strikes flat, that is (the game is) beaten (into death), (then do not eat that) 'Adi further said: I asked him about hunting with the help of a dog, whereupon he said: If that (the dog) catches it (the game) for you and does not eat out of that, then you eat (the game) for Dhakat (slaughtering) of that is its being caught by it (by the dog). But if you find another dog besides it, and you fear that that dog (the second one) had caught it (the game) along with that (your dog) and killed it. then don't eat; for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and did not recite that on the other one (which joined your dog incidentally).
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Mi'rad ki madad se shikaar ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Agar ye (shikaar ko) apne nukili sire se maare, to ise khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein maare, ki (shikaar) maara gaya hai (peeta gaya hai), (to use mat khaao). Adi ne aage kaha: Maine unse kutte ki madad se shikaar ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Agar ye (kutta) tumhare liye ise (shikaar ko) pakadta hai aur usmein se nahi khaata, to tum (shikaar) khaao kyunki uska Dhakat (zibah) uski uske (kutte) ke zariye pakde jaane mein hai. Lekin agar tum uske ilawa ek aur kutta paate ho, aur tumhe Dar hai ki us kutte (doosre) ne use (tumhare kutte) ke saath (shikaar) pakda aur use maara, to phir mat khaao; kyunki tumne apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya aur doosre par (jo galti se tumhare kutte ke saath shaamil ho gaya) nahi liya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakariya b. Abu Za'ida with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zakriyya bin Abu Za'ida ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sha'bi reported: I heard Adi b. Hatim say-and he was our neighbour, and our partner and co worker at Nahrain-that he asked Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) saying: I let off my dog and find another dog along with my dog and that (any one of them) catches the (game), but I do not know which one had caught it, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah while letting off your dog and did not recite on the other.
hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Maine Adi bin Hatim ko ye kehte suna - aur woh humare padosi, saanjhedaar aur Nahrain mein saath-saath kaam karne wale the - ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Main apna kutta chhodta hoon aur apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paata hoon aur woh (unmein se koi bhi) (shikaar) pakadta hai, lekin mujhe nahi pata ki kisne use pakda, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Phir use mat khaao, kyunki tumne apna kutta chhodte waqt Allah ka naam liya aur doosre par nahi liya.

e: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Adi bin Hatim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Adi b. Hatim reported: Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said to me: When you let off your dog, recite the name of Allah, and if it catches (game for you) and you find it alive, then slaughter it; if you find it killed and that (your dog) has eaten nothing out of that, (even then) you may eat it; but if you find along with your dog another dog, and (the game an) dead, then don't eat, for you do not know which of the two has killed it. And if you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, but if it (game) goes out of your sight for a day and you do not find on that but the mark of your arrow, then eat that it you so like, but if you find it drowned in water, then don't eat that.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jab tum apna kutta chhodte ho, Allah ka naam lo, aur agar ye (shikaar) pakadta hai aur tum use zinda paate ho, to use zibah karo; agar tum use maara hua paate ho aur (tumhare kutte ne) usmein se kuch nahi khaaya, (tab bhi) tum use khaa sakte ho; lekin agar tum apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paate ho, aur (shikaar) mara hua hai, to use mat khaao, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki dono mein se kisne use maara. Aur agar tum apna teer chalaate ho, Allah ka naam lo, lekin agar ye (shikaar) ek din ke liye tumhari nazron se ojhal ho jaaye aur tumhe usmein tumhare teer ke nishaan ke siwaay kuch na mile, to agar tum chaho use khaa sakte ho, lekin agar tum use paani mein Dooba hua paate ho, to use mat khaao.

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting.
