He said: When you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, and if you find it (the arrow) killed (that). then eat, except when you find it fallen into water, for in that case you do not know whether it is water that caused its death or your arrow.
hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaar ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Jab tum apna teer chalaao, Allah ka naam lo, aur agar tum ise (teer ko shikaar ko) maara hua paate ho, to khaao, siwaay tab jab tum use paani mein gira hua paao, kyunki tab tumhe nahi pata ki iski maut paani ki wajah se hui ya tumhare teer ki wajah se.

e: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, we are in the land of the People of the Book, (so) we eat in their utensils, and (live) in a hunting region. where I hunt with, the help of my bow, and hunt with my trained dog, or with my dog which is not trained. So inform me what is lawful (Halal) for us out of that. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Regarding what you have mentioned of the fact that you live in the land belonging to the People of the Book and so you eat in their utensils, but if you can get utensils other than theirs, then don't eat in them; but if you do not find any, then wash them and eat in them. And regarding what you have mentioned about (your living) in a hunting region, what you hunt, (strike) with the help of your bow, recite the name of Allah (while shooting an arrow) and then eat; and what you catch with the help of your trained dog, recite the name of Allah (while letting oil) the dog and then eat it, and what you get with the help of your untrained dog, (if you find it alive) and slaughter it (according to the law of the Shari'ah), eat it.
hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum Kitaab waalon (Ahl-e-Kitaab) ki zameen mein hain, (is liye) hum unke bartano mein khaate hain, aur (rehte hain) ek shikaar ke ilaake mein, jahan main apni kaman ki madad se shikaar karta hoon, aur apne sikhaaye hue kutte se, ya apne kutte se jo sikhaaya hua nahi hai. Is liye mujhe bataiye ki isme se humare liye kya jaayez (Halal) hai. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jahan tak tumne is baat ka zikr kiya hai ki tum Kitaab waalon ki zameen mein rehte ho aur is liye tum unke bartano mein khaate ho, lekin agar tumhe unke ilawa doosre bartan mil sakte hain, to unmein mat khaao; lekin agar tumhe nahi milte, to unhe dho lo aur unmein khaao. Aur jahan tak tumne apne (shikaar ke ilaake mein rehne) ka zikr kiya hai, jo tum shikaar karte ho, (maarte ho) apni kaman ki madad se, Allah ka naam lo (teer chalaate waqt) aur phir khaao; aur jo tum apne sikhaaye hue kutte ki madad se pakadte ho, Allah ka naam lo (kutte ko chhodte waqt) aur phir use khaao, aur jo tumhe apne na-sikhaaye hue kutte ki madad se milta hai, (agar tum use zinda paate ho) aur use zibah karo (Shariat ke qanoon ke mutabik), use khaao.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Haiwa with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Haiwa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: If you shoot with your arrow and (the game) goes out of your sight and you find it (later on), then eat that if it has not gone rotten.
hi: Abu Tha'laba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Agar tum apna teer chalaao aur (shikaar) tumhari nazron se ojhal ho jaaye aur tum use (baad mein) paao, to use khaao agar ye saDa nahi hai.

e: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying about one who comes three days later on the game he has shot: Eat it, provided it has not gone rotten.
hi: Abu Tha'laba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us shakhs ke baare mein kehte suna jo apne shikaar kiye hue jaanwar par teen din baad aata hai: Use khaao, bashart-e ki ye saDa nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Tha'laba al- Khushani with a slight variation of (words): He (the Holy Prophet) said in regard to the game killed by (a trained) dog: Eat after three days provided it has not gone rotten.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ek (sikhaaye hue) kutte ke zariye maare gaye shikaar ke baare mein kaha: Teen din baad khaao, bashart-e ki ye saDa nahi hai.

e: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon prohibited the eating of every fanged beast of prey. Zuhri added: We did not bear of it until we came to Syria.
hi: Abu Tha'laba ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwar ko khaane se mana kiya. Zuhri ne izafa kiya: Humne isko tab tak nahi suna jab tak hum Syria nahi aa gaye.

e: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts. Ibn Shihab said: I did not bear of this from our 'Ulama' in the Hijaz, until Abu Idris narrated that to me and he was one of the jurists of Syria.
hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale jaanwaron ko khaane se mana kiya. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine ise apne ulema se Hijaz mein nahi suna, jab tak Abu Idris ne mujhe ye riwayat nahi ki aur woh Syria ke ek fiqh aalim the.

e: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey.
hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron ko khaane se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters, but some of the chains have a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin kuch sanadon mein alfaazon mein halka antar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The eating of all fanged beasts of prey is unlawful.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron ko khaana na-jaayez hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey, and all the birds having talons.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron aur sab panjon waale parindon ko khaane se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the eating) of all the fanged beasts of prey, and of all the birds having talons.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron aur sab panjon waale parindon ko (khaane se) mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida our chief that we might intercept a caravan of the Quraish and provided us with a bag of dates. And he found for us nothing besides it. Abu Ubaida gave each of us one date (everyday). I (Abu Zubair, one of the narrators) said: What did you do with that? He said: We sucked that just as a baby sucks and then drank water over that, and it sufficed us for the day until night. We beat off leaves with the help of our staffs, then drenched them with water and ate them. We then went to the coast of the sea, and there rose before us on the coast of the sea something like a big mound. We came near that and we found that it was a beast, called al-'Anbar (spermaceti whale). Abu 'Ubaida said. It is dead. He then said: No (but it does not matter), we have been sent by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the path of Allah and you are hard pressed (on account of the scarcity of food), so you eat that. We three hundred in number stayed there for a month, until we grew bulky. He (Jabir) said: I saw how we extracted pitcher after pitcher full of fat from the cavity of its eye, and sliced from it compact piece of meat equal to a bull or like a bull. Abu 'Ubaida called forth thirteen men from us and he made them sit in the cavity of its eye, and he took hold of one of the ribs of its chest and made it stand and then saddled the biggest of the camels we had with us and it passed under it (the arched rib), and we provided ourselves with pieces of boiled meat (especially for use in our journey). When we came back to Medina, we went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: That was a provision which Allah had brought forth for you. Is there any piece of meat (left) with you, so tnat you give to us that? He (Jabir) said: We sent to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tome of that (a piece of meat) and he ate it.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja aur Abu Ubaida ko humara sardaar muqarrar kiya taaki hum Quraish ke ek caravan ko rok sakein, aur humein khajooron ka ek thaila diya. Aur unhe humare liye iske ilawa kuch nahi mila. Abu Ubaida ne hummein se har ek ko ek khajoor (roz) diya. Maine (Abu Zubair, ek raawi) kaha: Aapne uske saath kya kiya? Unhone kaha: Hum ise chooste jaise ek bachcha choosta hai aur phir uspar paani peete, aur ye humare liye us din se raat tak kaafi ho jaata. Hum apni lakDiyon se pattoon ko peette, phir unhe paani mein bhigote aur unhe khaate. Hum phir samundar ke kinaare gaye, aur wahan samundar ke kinaare humare saamne ek badi Tille jaisi cheez uThi. Hum uske qareeb aaye aur humne paaya ki ye ek jaanwar hai, jise al-Anbar (spermaceti whale) kaha jaata hai. Abu Ubaida ne kaha: Ye mara hua hai. Unhone phir kaha: Nahi (lekin isse koi farak nahi padta), humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Allah ki raah mein bheja hai aur tum (khaane ki kami ki wajah se) tang haal ho, is liye ise khaao. Hum teen sau ki tadaad mein wahan ek mahine tak rahe, yahan tak ki hum mote ho gaye. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Maine dekha ki humne kaise uski aankh ki khaai se ghade ke baad ghada charbi nikaali, aur usmein se ek bail ke barabar ya bail jaise gosht ke moTe tukde kaate. Abu Ubaida ne hummein se terah aadmiyon ko bulaaya aur unhe uski aankh ki khaai mein baithaya, aur unhone uski chhaati ki ek paslIyon mein se ek pakDi aur use khada kiya aur phir humare paas sabse bade oont par zeen kasi aur woh uske neeche se guzra (moDi hui paslI), aur humne apne aap ko (khaas taur par apni safar mein istemal karne ke liye) ubale hue gosht ke tukdon se lais kiya. Jab hum Madina wapas aaye, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye ek rozi thi jo Allah ne tumhare liye laayi. Kya tumhare paas gosht ka koi tukda (bacha hua) hai, taaki tum humein woh do? Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko usmein se kuch (gosht ka ek tukda) bheja aur unhone use khaaya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition). We were three hundred riders and our chief (leader) was 'Ubaida b. al-Jarrah. We were on the look out for a caravan of the Quraish. So we stayed on the coast for half a month, and were so much afflicted by extreme hunger that we (were obliged) to eat leaves. That is why it was called the Detachment of the Leaves. The ocean cast out for us an animal which was called al-'Anbar (whale). We ate of that for half of the month and rubbed its fat on our (bodies) until our bodies became stout. Abu 'Ubaida caught hold of one of its ribs and fixed that up. He then cast a glance at the tallest man of the army and the highest of the camels. and then made him ride over that, and that-tnan passed beneath it (the rib), and many a man could sit in its eye-socket, and we extracted many pitchers of fat from the cavity of its eye. We had small bags containing dates with us (before finding the whale). 'Ubaida gave every person amongst us a handful of dates (and when the provision ran short), he then gave each one of us one date. And when that (stock) was exhausted, we felt its loss.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja. Hum teen sau sawaar the aur humare sardaar (agua) Ubaida bin al-Jarrah the. Hum Quraish ke ek caravan ki taak mein the. To hum samundar ke kinaare aadhe mahine tak rahe, aur bahut zyada bhookh se pareshaan hue ki humein (majboor hokar) pattE khaane pade. Isi wajah se ise Pattoon ki Toli kaha jaata hai. Samundar ne humare liye ek jaanwar phenka jise al-Anbar (whale) kaha jaata tha. Humne isse aadhe mahine tak khaaya aur iski charbi apne (badan) par mali yahan tak ki humare badan moTe ho gaye. Abu Ubaida ne uski paslIyon mein se ek pakDi aur use taina kiya. Unhone phir fauj ke sabse lambe aadmi aur sabse ooche oont ki taraf dekha, aur phir use uspar sawaar karaaya, aur woh aadmi iske (paslI ke) neeche se guzra, aur bahut se aadmi iski aankh ki khaai mein baith sakte the, aur humne iski aankh ki khaai se bahut se ghade charbi ke nikaale. Humare paas khajooron ki chhoti thailiyaan thin (whale paane se pehle). Ubaida ne hummein se har shakhs ko mutthi bhar khajooren din (aur jab rozi kam padi), unhone hummein se har ek ko ek khajoor di. Aur jab (ye bhandaar) khatm ho gaya, humein iski kami mehsoos hui.

e: 'Amr reported on the authority of Jabir that in the expedition of Khabat (leaves) a person slaughtered three camels, then three, then three, then Abu 'Ubaida forbade him (to do so fearing that the rides may become short).
hi: Amr ne Jabir ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Khabat (patton) ki muhim mein ek shakhs ne teen oont zibah kiye, phir teen, phir teen, phir Abu Ubaida ne unhe (aisa karne se) mana kiya (Dar te hue ki sawaari waale jaanwar kam pad jaayenge).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent us (on an expedition), and we were three hundred in number, and we were carrying our bags of provisions around our necks.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja, aur hum teen sau ki tadaad mein the, aur hum apni rozi ki thailiyaan apni gardanon ke aas-paas le ja rahe the.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent on in expedition a detachment consisting of three hundred (persons) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah as their chief. Their provisions ran short: 'Abu 'Ubaida collected their provisions in the provision bag. and he fed us (for some time). Later on when the provisions ran short he gave us one date every day.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teen sau (logon) ki ek toli ek muhim par bheji aur Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Unki rozi kam pad gayi: Abu Ubaida ne unki rozi ko ek thaile mein ikattha kiya, aur unhone (kuch waqt ke liye) humein khilaaya. Baad mein jab rozi kam pad gayi unhone humein har din ek khajoor di.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the sea coast and I was one among them. The rest of the hadith is the same with a slight variation of wording that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Wahb b. Kaisan (the words are): " The army ate out of that (the whale) for eighteen days."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne samundar ke kinaare ek muhim bheji aur main unmein se ek tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath ki Wahb bin Kaisan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Fauj ne usmein se (whale mein se) aTharah dinon tak khaaya."

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the land of the tribe of Juhaina, and appointed a person as a chief over them.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Juhaina qabile ki zameen par ek muhim bheji, aur unpar ek shakhs ko sardaar muqarrar kiya.

e: 'Ali b. Abi Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade on the Day of Khaibar temporary marriage (Muta') with women and the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi (Mut'a) aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through a different chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating) of the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Abu Tha'laba ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (khaane) se mana kiya.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) forbade the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the (flesh) of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar in spite of the fact that people needed that.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ko khaane se mana kiya Khaibar ke din is baat ke bawajood ki logon ko iski zaroorat thi.

e: Shaibani reported: I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa about (the lawfulness or unlawfulness of) the flesh of the domestic asses. He said: We experienced hunger on the Day of Khaibar as we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We found domestic asses in the exterior of Medina. We slaughtered them and our earthen pots were boiling when the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned upside down and nothing of the flesh of the domestic asses should be eaten. I said: What kind of prohibition is it that he (the Holy Prophet) has made? He said: We discussed it amongst -ourselves. Some of us aaid that it has been declared unlawful for ever, (whereas others said) it has been declared unlawful since one-fifth (of the booty) has not been given (to the treasury, as is legally required).
hi: Shaibani ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa se ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (ke jaayez ya na-jaayez hone) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Humein Khaibar ke din bhookh mehsoos hui jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the. Humein Madina ke bahri hisse mein ghareloo gadhe mile. Humne unhe zibah kiya aur humare mitti ke bartan ubal rahe the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht mein se kuch bhi khaaya na jaaye. Maine kaha: Ye kaisa mana hai jo unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Humne aapas mein iski charcha ki. Humme se kuch ne kaha ki ise hamesha ke liye na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai, (jabki doosron ne kaha) ise is liye na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai kyunki paanchvaan hissa (maal-e-ganimat ka) nahi diya gaya hai (khazane ko, jaisa kaanooni taur par zaroori hai).

e: Sulaiman Shaibini reported: I heard Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We were smitten with hunger during the nights of Khaibar. On the Day of Khaibar, we fell upon domestic asses and we slaughtered them, and when our earthen pots boiled with them, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an annoancement that the earthen pots should be turned over, and nothing should be eaten of the flesh of the domestic asses. Some of the people said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden (the use of this flesh) for one-fifth (due to the State) has not been paid, while others said: He prohibited it for ever.
hi: Sulaiman Shaibini ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ko ye kehte suna: Hum Khaibar ki raaton mein bhookh se pareshaan hue. Khaibar ke din, hum ghareloo gadhon par jhapat pade aur humne unhe zibah kiya, aur jab humare mitti ke bartan unke saath ubalte the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein, aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht mein se kuch bhi na khaaya jaaye. Kuch logon ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (is gosht ke istemal se) mana kiya kyunki paanchvaan hissa (sarkaar ko deye jaane waala) ada nahi kiya gaya tha, jabki doosron ne kaha: Unhone ise hamesha ke liye mana kiya.

e: 'Adi (he was the son of Thabit) said: I heard al-Bara' and 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We found domestic asses and we cooked them. Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over.
hi: Adi (jo Thabit ke bete the) ne kaha: Maine al-Bara aur Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ko ye kehte suna: Humein ghareloo gadhe mile aur humne unhe pakaaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein.

e: Al-Bara' said: We found on the Day of Khaibar domestic asses, and the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over.
hi: Al-Bara ne kaha: Humein Khaibar ke din ghareloo gadhe mile, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein.

e: Bara was heard saying: We were forbidden (to eat) the flesh of the domestic asses.
hi: Bara ko ye kehte suna gaya: Humein ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (khaane) se mana kiya gaya.

e: Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to throw away the flesh of domestic asses whether uncooked or cooked; he then never commanded us to eat that.
hi: Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ko phenk dein chahe kachcha ho ya pakaaya hua; unhone phir humein kabhi ise khaane ka hukum nahi diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Asim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I do not know whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating of the domestic ass) due to the fact that they were the beasts of burden for the people, so he (the Holy Prophet) did not like their beasts of burden to be destroyed (as a matter of expediency), or he prohibited the use of the flesh of domestic asses (not as an expediency but as a law of the Shari'ah) on the Day of Khaibar.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Mujhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (ghareloo gadhe ko khaane se) mana is liye kiya kyunki woh logon ke bojh dhone waale jaanwar the, is liye unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) pasand nahi tha ki unke bojh dhone waale jaanwar tabaah ho jaayein (ek vyaavhaarikta ke maamle ke soorat mein), ya unhone ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ke istemal ko mana kiya (na vyaavhaarikta ke soorat mein balki Shariat ke qanoon ke soorat mein) Khaibar ke din.

e: Salama b. Akwa' reported: We went to Khaibar with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah granted (us) victory over them. On that very evening of the day when they had been granted victory, they lit many fires. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What are those fires and what for those have been lit? They said: (These have been lit) for (cooking) the flesh. Thereupon he said: Of what flesh? They said: For the flesh of the domestic asses. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace bo upon him) said: Throw that away and break them (the earthen pots in which the fiesa was being cooked). A person said: Messenger of Allah, should we throw it away and wash them (the cooking pots)? He said: You may do so.
hi: Salama bin Akwa ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar gaye. Phir Allah ne (humein) unpar jeet di. Us din ki shaam jab unhe jeet mili, unhone bahut si aagen jalayin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaisi aagen hain aur ye kis liye jalaayi gayi hain? Unhone kaha: (Ye jalaayi gayi hain) gosht (pakaane) ke liye. Isper unhone kaha: Kaunsa gosht? Unhone kaha: Ghareloo gadhon ka gosht. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise phenk do aur unhe (mitti ke bartanon ko jinmein gosht pakaya ja raha tha) toD do. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein ise phenk dena chahiye aur unhe (bartanon ko) dho lena chahiye? Unhone kaha: Tum aisa kar sakte ho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yazid b. Abu Ubaid.
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Abu Ubaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar, we caught hold of the asses outside the village. We cooked them (their flesh). Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made the announcement: Listen, verily Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (the eating of) their (flesh), for it is a loathsome evil of Satan's doing. Then the earthen pots were turned over along with what was in them, and these were brimming (with flesh) at that time.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar fatah kiya, humne gaon ke bahar gadhe pakde. Humne unhe (unka gosht) pakaaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya: Suno, yaqeenan Allah aur Uske Rasool ne tumhe (unka gosht khaane se) mana kiya hai, kyunki ye Shaitaan ke kaam ki ek ghinaunI burai hai. Phir mitti ke bartan unmein jo tha uske saath ulTe kar diye gaye, aur ye us waqt gosht se bhare hue the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: When it was the Day of Khaibar a visitor came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses have been eaten. Then another came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses are being destroyed. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded Abu Talha to make an announcement that Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (from eating) of the flesh of (domestic) asses, for these are loathsome or impure. He (the narrator) said: The earthein pots were turned over along with what was in them.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Jab Khaibar ka din tha ek visitor aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gadhe khaaye ja chuke hain. Phir doosra aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gadhe barbaad kiye jaa rahe hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha ko hukum diya ki woh ailaan karein ki Allah aur Uske Rasool ne tumhe (ghareloo) gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya hai, kyunki ye ghinaune ya apavitra hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mitti ke bartan unmein jo tha uske saath ulTe kar diye gaye.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited eating of the flesh of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar, and permitted the cooking of the flesh of horses.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya, aur ghodon ke gosht pakaane ki ijazat di.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah is reported to have said: We ate during the time of Khaibar the (flesh) of horses and of wild asses, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us (to eat) the flesh of domestic asses.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: Humne Khaibar ke daurane ghodon aur jangli gadhon ka (gosht) khaaya, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ghareloo gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has hen transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Asma' reported: We slaughtered a horse and ate it during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Asma ne riwayat ki: Humne ek ghoda zibah kiya aur use khaaya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the eating of (the flesh) of the lizard, whereupon he said: I am neither the eater of it nor its prohibitor.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chhipkali (ke gosht) khaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Main na to iske khaane wale mein se hoon na hi iske mana karne wale mein se.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said. I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chhipkali khaane ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Main na to ise khaata hoon, na hi ise mana karta hoon.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was sitting on the pulpit about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said: I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se, jab woh mimbar par baithe the, chhipkali khaane ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Main na to ise khaata hoon, na hi ise mana karta hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith pertaining to the eating of the lizard is transmitted from the Prophet (ﷺ) on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but in this very hadith narrated through a different chain of transmitters there is a slight variation of wording (and the words are): " A lizard was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but he neither ate that nor declared it unlawful." And in the hadith transmitted through Usama (the words are):" The man (inquirer) was standing in the mosque and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit."
hi: Chhipkali khaane se mutaliq ek hadees Nabi (SAW) se Ibn Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin isi hadees mein ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath (aur alfaaz hain): "Ek chhipkali Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi lekin unhone na to use khaaya na hi ise na-jaayez ailaan kiya." Aur Usama ke zariye riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Woh aadmi (poochhne wala) masjid mein khada tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par baithe the."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that there were some persons with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) from among his Companions, Sa'd being one of them. There was brought to them the flesh of the lizard when a lady amongst the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is the flesh of the lizard. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: Eat, for it is lawful, but it is not my diet.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke kuch sahaba the, Sa'd bhi unmein se ek the. Unhe chhipkali ka gosht laaya gaya jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se ek khaatoon ne kaha: Ye chhipkali ka gosht hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Khaao, kyunki ye jaayez hai, lekin ye mera khaana nahi hai.

e: Taubat Al-'Anbari reported: Al-Sha'bi (one of the narrators) asked me if I had heard the hadith transmitted on the authority of Hasan from the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: I sat in the company if Ibn 'Umar for two years or a year and a half but I did not hear narrated from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but this one (pertaining to the flesh of the lizard) as narrated by Mu'adh.
hi: Taubat Al-Anbari ne riwayat ki: Al-Sha'bi (raawiyon mein se ek) ne mujhse poocha ki kya maine Hasan ke zariye Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hadees suni hai. Unhone kaha: Main Ibn Umar ki sohbat mein do saal ya Dedh saal baitha lekin maine unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sirf yehi ek hadees riwayat karte suna (chhipkali ke gosht se mutaliq) jaisi Mu'adh ke zariye riwayat ki gayi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported: I and Khalid b. Walid went to the apartment of Maimuna along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and there was presented to him a roasted lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stretched his hand towards It, whereupon some of the women who had been in the house of Maimuna said: Inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what he intends to eat. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted his hand. I said: Messenger of Allah, Is it forbidden? He said: No. It is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, while, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking (at me).
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne riwayat ki: Main aur Khalid bin Walid Maimuna ke kamre mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaye, aur unhe ek bhuni hui chhipkali pesh ki gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath iski taraf badhaaya, isper Maimuna ke ghar mein maujood kuch auraton ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataao ki woh kya khaane wale hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath uThA liya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye mana hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Ye mere logon ki zameen mein nahi milti, aur mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe isse koi ruchi nahi hai. Khalid ne kaha: Maine phir ise chaba kar khaaya, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that Khalid b. Walid who is called the Sword of Allah had informed him that he visited Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother (that of Khalid) and that of 'Ibn Abbas, and he found with her a roasted lizard which her sister Hufaida the daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she presented that lizard to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It was rare that some food was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was not mentioned or named. While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to stretch forth his hand towards the lizard, a woman from amongst the women present there informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what they had presented to him. They said: Messenger of Allah, it is a lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) withdrew his hand, whereupon Khalid b. Walid said: Messenger of Allah, is a lizard forbidden? There opon he said: No, but it is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at me and he did not forbid (me to eat it).
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Khalid bin Walid, jinhe Allah ki Talwaar kaha jaata hai, ne unhe bataya ki woh Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se milne gaye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein, aur woh unki (yaani Khalid ki) maa ki behn thin aur Ibn Abbas ki bhi, aur unhe unke paas ek bhuni hui chhipkali mili jise unki behn Hufaida, al-Harith ki beti, Najd se laayi thin, aur unhone woh chhipkali Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pesh ki. Ye bahut kam hota tha ki koi khaana Nabi (SAW) ko pesh kiya jaaye aur uska zikr ya naam na liya jaaye. Jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna haath chhipkali ki taraf badhaane hi waale the, wahan maujood auraton mein se ek ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataya jo unhe pesh kiya gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye ek chhipkali hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath waapas kheench liya, isper Khalid bin Walid ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya chhipkali mana hai? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin ye mere logon ki zameen mein nahi milti, aur mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe isse koi ruchi nahi hai. Khalid ne kaha: Maine phir ise chaba kar khaaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the aur unhone mujhe (ise khaane se) mana nahi kiya.

e: Khalid b. Walid reported that he visited Maimuna daughter of al-Harith with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother. She presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard which Umm Hufaid daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she had been married to a person belonging to Banu Ja'far. It was the habit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not to eat anything until he knew what that was. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this (addition): " Ibn al-Asamm narrated it from Maimuna and he was under her care."
hi: Khalid bin Walid ne riwayat ki ki woh Maimuna, al-Harith ki beti, se milne gaye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath, aur woh unki maa ki behn thin. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht pesh kiya jo Umm Hufaid, al-Harith ki beti, Najd se laayi thin, aur unki shaadi Banu Ja'far se mutaliq ek shakhs se hui thi. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aadat thi ki woh kuch bhi tab tak nahi khaate jab tak unhe pata na chale ki ye kya hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is (izafe) ke saath: "Ibn al-Asamm ne ise Maimuna se riwayat ki aur woh unki dekhbhaal mein the."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: While we were in the house of Maimuna there were brought to Allah's Messenger two roasted lizards. Here no mention is made of al- 'Asamm narrating from Maimuna.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Maimuna ke ghar mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do bhuni hui chhipkaliyaan laayi gayin. Yahan al-Asamm ke Maimuna se riwayat karne ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that there had been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard and Khalid b. Walid was also present there. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht laaya gaya aur Khalid bin Walid bhi wahan maujood the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that he heard Ibn 'Abbas says: The sister of my mother Umm Hufaid presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) clarified butter (ghee), cheese and some lizards. He ate out of the clarified butter and cheese, but left the lizard finding no liking for it. But it was eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Had it been forbidden (haram), it could not be eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki unhone Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna: Meri maa ki behn Umm Hufaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ghee, panir, aur kuch chhipkaliyaan pesh kin. Unhone ghee aur panir khaaya, lekin chhipkali chhod di kyunki unhe isse koi ruchi nahi thi. Lekin ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki meiz par khaaya gaya. Agar ye mana (haram) hoti, to ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki meiz par nahi khaaya jaa sakta.

e: Yazid b. al-Asamm reported: A newly wedded person of Medina invited us to a wedding feast, and he served us thirteen lizards. There were those who ate it and those who abandoned it. I met Ibn 'Abbas the next day, and informed him (about this) in the presence of many persons. Some of them said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed: I neither eat it nor forbid (anyone) from eating it, nor declare it to be unlawful. Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Sad it is what you say! Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has not been sent, but (to declare in clear words) the lawful and the unlawful (things). We were once with Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him) as he was with Maimuna, and there were with him al-Fadl b. 'Abbas, Khalid b. Walid and some women (also) when a tray of food containing flesh was presented to him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was about to eat that, Maimuna said: It is the flesh of the lizard. He withdrew his hand saying: That is the flesh which I never eat; but he said to them (those who were present there): You may eat. Al-Fadl ate out of that, so did Khalid b Walid, and the women. Maimuna (however) said: I do not eat anything but that which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eats.
hi: Yazid bin al-Asamm ne riwayat ki: Madina ke ek nayi shaadi kiye hue shakhs ne humein shaadi ki daawat par bulaaya, aur usne humein terah chhipkaliyaan serve ki. Kuchne unhe khaaya aur kuchne chhoDa. Main agle din Ibn Abbas se mila aur unhe (iske baare mein) bataya bahut se logon ki maujoodgi mein. Unmein se kuchne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Main na to ise khaata hoon na hi (kisi ko) khaane se mana karta hoon, na hi ise na-jaayez ailaan karta hoon. Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye bahut afsos ki baat hai jo tum keh rahe ho! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sirf is liye bheja gaya hai ki woh (saaf alfaazon mein) jaayez aur na-jaayez cheezon ka ailaan karein. Hum ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the jab woh Maimuna ke saath the, aur unke saath al-Fadl bin Abbas, Khalid bin Walid aur kuch auraten (bhi) thin jab unhe gosht waali khaane ki ek thaali pesh ki gayi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise khaane hi waale the, Maimuna ne kaha: Ye chhipkali ka gosht hai. Unhone apna haath waapas kheench liya ye kehte hue: Ye woh gosht hai jo main kabhi nahi khaata; lekin unhone unse (jo wahan maujood the) kaha: Tum khaa sakte ho. Al-Fadl ne usmein se khaaya, aur Khalid bin Walid ne bhi, aur auraton ne bhi. Maimuna (halaanki) ne kaha: Main kuch bhi nahi khaati siwaay uske jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaate hain.

e: Abu Zubair reported that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying that there was presented to Allah's Messenger (the flesh) of the lizard, but he refused to eat that, saying: I do not know; perhaps it (lizard) might (be one of those natives of) the distant past whose (forms) had beer, distorted.
hi: Abu Zubair ne riwayat ki ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht pesh kiya gaya, lekin unhone use khaane se inkaar kiya, ye kehte hue: Mujhe nahi pata; shayad ye (chhipkali) (un logon mein se ek ho) jo bahut pehle ke daur ke the jinke (soorat) vikrit kiye gaye the.

e: Abu Zubair reported: I asked Jabir about ithe eating) of the lizard, whereupon he said: Don't eat that as he (the Holy Prophet) felt disgust. He (the narrator) said that Umar b. al-Khattab reminded: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not declare it to be unlawful. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has (made it a source) of benefit for more than one (persons). It is a common diet of the shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that.
hi: Abu Zubair ne riwayat ki: Maine Jabir se chhipkali (khaane) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ise mat khaao kyunki unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) ghrina mehsoos hui. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki Umar bin al-Khattab ne yaad dilaaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise na-jaayez ailaan nahi kiya. Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ise (ek se zyada logon ke liye) faayde ka srot banaaya hai. Ye gadariyon ka aam khaana hai. Agar ye mere paas hoti, to main use khaata.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that a person said: Messenger of Allah, we live in a land abounding in lizards, so what do you command or what verdict you give (about eating of it)? Thereupon he said: It was mentioned to me that a people from among Bani Isra'il were distorted (so there is a likelihood that those people might have been distorted in the shape of lizards). So he neither commanded (us to eat that) nor forbade (us). Abu Sa'id said: After some time Umar said: Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has made it (a source of) benefit for more than one (person), for it is the common diet of shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked it.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aisi zameen mein rehte hain jahan chhipkaliyaan bahutayat mein hain, is liye aap kya hukum dete hain ya iske (khaane ke) baare mein kya faisla dete hain? Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya tha ki Banu Isra'il ke kuch log vikrit kiye gaye the (is liye ye sambhaavna hai ki woh log chhipkaliyon ke soorat mein vikrit ho gaye hon). Is liye unhone na to (humein ise khaane ka) hukum diya na hi (humein) mana kiya. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Kuch waqt baad Umar ne kaha: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ise (ek se zyada logon ke liye) faayde ka srot banaaya hai, kyunki ye gadariyon ka aam khaana hai. Agar ye mere paas hoti, to main ise khaata. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise napasand karte the.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that an Arab of the desert came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I live in a low land abounding in lizards, and these are the common diet of my family, but he (the Holy Prophet) did not make any reply. We said to him: Repeat it (your problem) and so he repeated it, but he did not make any reply. (It was repeated thrice ) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him out at the third time saying: O man of the desert, verily Allah cursed or showed wrath to a tribe of Bani Isra'il and distorted them to beasts which move on the earth. I do not know, perhaps this (lizard) may be one of them. So I do not eat it, nor do I prohibit the eating of it.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki registaan ka ek Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main ek neechi zameen mein rehta hoon jahan chhipkaliyaan bahutayat mein hain, aur ye mere khaandaan ka aam khaana hai, lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) koi jawaab nahi diya. Humne unse kaha: Ise (apni samasya ko) dohraao, aur unhone dohraaya, lekin unhone koi jawaab nahi diya. (Ise teen baar dohraaya gaya.) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teesri baar unhe bulaaya ye kehte hue: Aye registaan ke aadmi, yaqeenan Allah ne Banu Isra'il ke ek qabile par laanat ki ya gussa dikhaaya aur unhe zameen par chalne waale jaanwaron mein vikrit kiya. Mujhe nahi pata, shayad ye (chhipkali) unmein se ek ho. Is liye main ise nahi khaata, na hi ise khaane se mana karta hoon.

e: Ibn Abu Aufa reported: We went on seven expeditions with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ate locusts.
hi: Ibn Abu Aufa ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath saat muhimon par gaye aur tiddiyaan khaayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters. Abu Bakr (one of the narrators) said" seven expeditions," whereas Ishaq said" six," and Ibn Umar said" six" or" seven".
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'fur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Abu Bakr (ek raawi) ne kaha "saat muhimein," jabki Ishaq ne kaha "chhe," aur Ibn Umar ne kaha "chhe" ya "saat".

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters, and he mentioned seven expeditions.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'fur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur unhone saat muhimon ka zikr kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We chased a hare at Marr az-Zahrin (a valley near Mecca). They (my companions) ran, but felt exhausted; I also tried until I caught hold of it. I brought it to Abu Talha. He slaughtered it and sent its haunch and two hind legs to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through me; and he accepted them.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Humne Marr az-Zahrin (Makkah ke qareeb ek wadi) mein ek khargosh ka picha kiya. Woh (mere saathi) daude, lekin thak gaye; maine bhi koshish ki yahan tak ki maine use pakad liya. Main ise Abu Talha ke paas laaya. Unhone ise zibah kiya aur iski jaangh aur do peechhle taangein mere zariye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bhejin; aur unhone unhe qubool kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yahya with a slight change of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Buraida reported that Abdullah b. al-Mughaffal saw a person from amongst his companions throwing small pebbles, whereupon he said: Don't throw pebbles. for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like it, or he forbade flinging of pebbles since neither the game is taken thereby, nor an enemy defeated. but it may break a tooth or put out an eye. He, afterwards, again saw him flinging pebbles, and said to him: I inform you that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not approve or he forbade flinging of pebbles, but if I see you again flinging pebbles. I will not speak with you.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin al-Mughaffal ne apne saathiyon mein se ek ko choti kankariyaan phenkte dekha, isper unhone kaha: Kankariyaan mat phenko, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise pasand nahi karte the, ya unhone kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya kyunki isse na to shikaar pakda jaata hai, na hi dushman ko shikast di jaati hai, lekin ye ek daant tod sakti hai ya aankh nikaal sakti hai. Unhone, baad mein, unhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekha, aur unse kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkna manzoor nahi kiya, ya isse mana kiya, lekin agar main tumhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekhta hoon, main tumse baat nahi karunga.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Kahmas.
hi: Ye hadees Kahmas ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited throwing of pebbles. Ibn Ja'far reported (in the narration transmitted by him) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: It neither inflicts defeat to the enemy nor kills the game but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mahdi with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya. Ibn Ja'far ne (apni riwayat ki hui riwayat mein) bataya ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye na to dushman ko shikast deti hai na hi shikaar ko maarti hai, lekin daant toDti hai aur aankh nikaalti hai. Ye hadees Ibn Mahdi ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that. a near one of 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal threw pebbles. He prohibited him (to do so). He said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had prohibited the throwing of pebbles by saying: It does not catch the game, nor does it inflict defeat on the enemy, but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. He (the near one of Abdullah b. Mughadal) again repeated it (the act of throwing of pebbles) whereupon he said: I narrate to you that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hish) disliked and prohibited throwing of pebbles, but I see you again throwing pebbles; I (would therefore) not speak with you.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Mughaffal ke ek qareebi rishtedaar ne kankariyaan phenki. Unhone unhe (aisa karne se) mana kiya. Unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya tha ye kehte hue: Ye na to shikaar pakadti hai, na hi dushman ko shikast deti hai, lekin daant toDti hai aur aankh nikaalti hai. Unhone (Abdullah bin Mughaffal ke rishtedaar ne) ise (kankariyaan phenkne ka amal) dobara dohraaya, isper unhone kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkna napasand kiya aur mana kiya, lekin main tumhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekh raha hoon; main (is liye) tumse baat nahi karunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Shaddid b. Aus said: Two are the things which I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Verily Allah has enjoined goodness to everything; so when you kill, kill in a good way and when you slaughter, slaughter in a good way. So every one of you should sharpen his knife, and let the slaughtered animal die comfortably.
hi: Shaddid bin Aus ne kaha: Do baaten hain jo mujhe yaad hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kahin: Yaqeenan Allah ne har cheez mein achhaai laazim ki hai; is liye jab tum (kisi ko) qatal karo, achhi tarah se qatal karo aur jab tum zibah karo, achhi tarah se zibah karo. Is liye tum mein se har ek ko apna chaaku tez karna chahiye, aur zibah kiye jaane waale jaanwar ko aaraam se marne dena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid al-Hadhdha' through different chains o transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Khalid al-Hadhdha ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hishim b. Zaid b. Anas b. Milik reported: I visited the house of al-Hakam b. Ayyub along with my grandfather Anas b. Milik, (and there) some people had made a hen a target and were shooting arrows at her. Thereupon Asas said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden tying of the animals (and making them the targets of arrows, etc.).
hi: Hishim bin Zaid bin Anas bin Milik ne riwayat ki: Main al-Hakam bin Ayyub ke ghar gaya apne dada Anas bin Milik ke saath, (aur wahan) kuch logon ne ek murgi ko nishaana bana rakha tha aur uspar teer chala rahe the. Isper Anas ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jaanwaron ko baandhne (aur unhe teeron ka nishaana banaane, waghera) se mana kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Do not make anything having life as a target.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Kisi bhi jeevit cheez ko nishaana mat banaao.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by a party of men who had tied a hen and were shooting arrows at it. As soon as they saw Ibn 'Umar, they scattered from it. Thereupon Ibn Umar said: Who has done this? Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse upon him who does this.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar aadmiyon ke ek giroh ke paas se guzre jinhone ek murgi ko baandh rakha tha aur uspar teer chala rahe the. Jaise hi unhone Ibn Umar ko dekha, woh usse bikhar gaye. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha: Kisne ye kiya? Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs par laanat ki hai jo aisa karta hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by some young men of the Quraish who had tied a bird (and th, is made it a target) at which they had been shooting arrows Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. So no sooner did they see Ibn 'Umar they went away. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar said: Who has done this? Allah has cursed him who does this. Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked curse upon one who made a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship).
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar Quraish ke kuch jawaan aadmiyon ke paas se guzre jinhone ek parinde ko baandh rakha tha (aur isko nishaana banaaya tha) jispar woh teer chala rahe the. Har teer jo unhone miss kiya woh parinde ke maalik ki malkiyat ban jaata tha. To jaise hi unhone Ibn Umar ko dekha, woh chale gaye. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha: Kisne ye kiya? Allah ne use laanat di jo aisa karta hai. Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne kisi jeevit cheez ko (apni nishaanebaazi ka) nishaana banaaya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that any beast should be killed after it has been tied.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki kisi bhi jaanwar ko use baandhne ke baad qatal kiya jaaye.

e: Jundab b. Sufyan reported: I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of 'Id al-Adha. While he had not returned after having offered (the Id prayer) and finished it, he saw the flesh of the sacrificial animals which had been slaughtered before he had completed the prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: One who slaughtered his sacrificial animal before his prayer or our prayer ('Id), he should slaughter another one in its stead, and he who did not slaughter, he should slaughter by reciting the name of Allah.
hi: Jundab bin Sufyan ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Id al-Adha ke din. Jab woh (Id ki namaz) padhkar aur khatm karke wapas nahi aaye the, unhone dekha ki qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht zibah kiya gaya tha unke namaz mukammal karne se pehle. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jisne apna qurbaani ka jaanwar apni namaz ya humari (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah kiya, use uski jagah doosra zibah karna chahiye, aur jisne zibah nahi kiya, use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karna chahiye.

e: Jundab b. Sufyan reported: I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on the occasion) of 'Id al-Adha. After he had completed the prayer with people, he found that the goats had been slaughtered, whereupon he said: He who slaughtered sacrificial animal before the prayer should slaughter a goat (again) in its stead and he who has not slaughtered he should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah.
hi: Jundab bin Sufyan ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Id al-Adha (ke avasar par). Jab unhone logon ke saath namaz mukammal kar li, unhone paaya ki bakriyaan zibah ki jaa chuki thin, isper unhone kaha: Jisne namaz se pehle qurbaani ka jaanwar zibah kiya use uski jagah (dobara) ek bakri zibah karni chahiye aur jisne zibah nahi kiya use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Aswad b. Qais with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees al-Aswad bin Qais ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jundab al-Bajali reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing ('Id) prayer on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) and then delivering a sermon and he said: He who sacrificed the (animal) before offering ('Id) prayer, he should offer again in its stead, and he who did not sacrifice the animal should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah.
hi: Jundab al-Bajali ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Qurbaani ke Din (10 Zul-Hijja) (Id ki) namaz padhte dekha aur phir khutba dete hue, aur unhone kaha: Jisne (jaanwar) (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya, use uski jagah dobara qurbaani deni chahiye, aur jisne jaanwar qurbaan nahi kiya use Allah ka naam lekar use zibah karna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Al-Bara' reported: My maternal uncle Abu Burda sacrificed his animal before ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is a goat (slaughtered for the sake of) flesh (and not as a sacrifice on the day of Adha). He said: I have a lamb of six months. Thereupon he said: Offer it as a sacrifice, but it will not justify for anyone except you, and then said: He who sacrificed (the animal) before ('Id) prayer, he in fact slaughtered it for his own self, and he who slaughtered after prayer, his ritual of sacrifice became complete and he in fact observed the religious practice of the Muslims.
hi: Al-Bara ne riwayat ki: Mere maama Abu Burda ne apna jaanwar (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek bakri hai (gosht ke liye zibah ki gayi, na ki Adha ke din qurbaani ke soorat mein). Unhone kaha: Mere paas chhe mahine ka ek bhed hai. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karo, lekin ye tumhare siwaay kisi doosre ke liye vaajib nahi hogi, aur phir kaha: Jisne (jaanwar) (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya, usne dar-asal ise apne khud ke liye zibah kiya, aur jisne namaz ke baad zibah kiya, uski qurbaani ki rasm mukammal ho gayi aur usne dar-asal Musalmaanon ke deeni amal ka paalan kiya.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that his maternal'uncle Abu Burda b. Niyar sacrificed his animal earlier than the Prophet (ﷺ) had sacrificed. Thereupon he said: Apostle of Allah, it is the day of meat and it is not desirable (to have longing for it and not to make use of it immediately), so I hastened in offering my animal as a sacrifice, so that I might feed my family and neighbours and my kith and kin. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Offer again your sacrifice. He said: Messenger of Allah, I have a small milch goat of less than one year, and that is better than two dry goats (from which only) meat (can be acquired). Thereupon he said: That is better than the two animals of sacrifice on your behalf, and the sacrifice of a goat, of less than six months shall not be accepted as a sacrifice on behalf of anyone after your (sacrifice).
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki ki unke maama Abu Burda bin Niyar ne apna jaanwar Nabi (SAW) ke qurbaani karne se pehle qurbaan kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye gosht ka din hai aur ye vaanchhaneey nahi hai (iske liye tarasna aur turant iska istemal na karna), is liye maine jaldi ki apne jaanwar ko qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karne mein, taaki main apne khaandaan, padosiyon aur apne rishtedaaron ko khilaa sakoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dobara apni qurbaani pesh karo. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek chhoti doodh dene wali bakri hai jo ek saal se kam ki hai, aur ye do sookhi bakriyon se behtar hai (jinse sirf) gosht (haasil kiya jaa sakta hai). Isper unhone kaha: Ye tumhari taraf se do qurbaani ke jaanwaron se behtar hai, aur chhe mahine se kam umar ki bakri ki qurbaani tumhare (qurbaani) ke baad kisi ki taraf se qubool nahi ki jaayegi.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address on the day (of Nahr) in which he said: None of you should offer sacrifice of animals until he has completed the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon my maternal uncle said: Messenger of Allah, it is the day of meat, so it is not desirable (to keep my family in the state of longing). The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Nahr ke) din ek khitaab diya jismein unhone kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi jaanwaron ki qurbaani tab tak na de jab tak usne (Id ki) namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Isper mere maama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye gosht ka din hai, is liye ye vaanchhaneey nahi hai (mere khaandaan ko tarasti halat mein rakhna). Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Al-Bara' reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who observes prayer like our prayer and turns his face towards our Qibla (in prayer) and who offers sacrifices (of animals) as we do, he must not slaughter the (animal as a sacrifice) until he has completed the prayer. Thereupon my maternal uncle said: Messenger of Allah, I have sacrificed the animal on behalf of my son. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is the thing in which you have made haste for your family. He said: I have a goat with me better than two goats. Thereupon he said: Sacrifice it for that is the best.
hi: Al-Bara ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo humari tarah namaz padhta hai aur humare Qibla ki taraf apna chehra karta hai (namaz mein) aur jo humari tarah (jaanwaron ki) qurbaani deta hai, use jaanwar (qurbaani ke soorat mein) tab tak zibah nahi karna chahiye jab tak usne namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Isper mere maama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apne bete ki taraf se jaanwar qurbaan kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye woh cheez hai jismein tumne apne khaandaan ke liye jaldi ki hai. Unhone kaha: Mere paas ek bakri hai do bakriyon se behtar. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, kyunki ye sabse achhi hai.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: The first (act) with which we started our day (the day of 'Id-ul Adha) was that we offered prayer. We then returned and sacrificed the animals and he who did that in fact adhered to our Sunnah (practice). And he who slaughtered the (animal on that day before the 'Id prayer), for him (the slaughtering of animal was directed to the acquiring of) meat for his family, and there is nothing of the sort of sacrifice in it. It was Abu Burda b. Niyar who had slaughtered (the animal before the 'Id prayer). He said: I have a small lamb, of less than one year, but better than that of more than a year. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) qaid: Sacrifice it, but it will not suffice (as a sacrifice) for anyone after you.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sabse pehla (amal) jisse humne apna din (Id-ul Adha ka din) shuru kiya woh ye tha ki humne namaz padhi. Hum phir wapas gaye aur jaanwar qurbaan kiye aur jisne aisa kiya usne dar-asal humari Sunnat (amal) ka paalan kiya. Aur jisne (jaanwar) us din (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya, uske liye (jaanwar ka zibah karna) apne khaandaan ke liye gosht haasil karne ke liye tha, aur ismein qurbaani jaisi koi baat nahi hai. Ye Abu Burda bin Niyar the jinhone (jaanwar) (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Mere paas ek chhota bhed hai, ek saal se kam ka, lekin ek saal se zyada ke bhed se behtar. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, lekin ye (qurbaani ke soorat mein) tumhare baad kisi ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees al-Bara bin Azib ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr after the ('Id) prayer. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr ke din (Id ki) namaz ke baad khitaab kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr and said: None should sacrifice the animal unless he has completed the ('Id) prayer. A person said: I have a milch goat of less than one year, better than two fat goats. Thereupon he said: Sacrifice it, and no goat of less than a year of age will be accepted as sacrifice after you.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr ke din khitaab kiya aur kaha: Kisi ko jaanwar qurbaan nahi karna chahiye jab tak usne (Id ki) namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Mere paas ek saal se kam ki doodh dene wali bakri hai, do moti bakriyon se behtar. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, aur ek saal se kam umar ki koi bakri tumhare baad qurbaani ke soorat mein qubool nahi ki jaayegi.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Abu Burda slaughtered the animal as a sacrifice before the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Offer a substitute for it (since it does not absolve you of the responsibility of sacrifice). Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger. I have nothing with me but a goat of less than six months. Shu'ba (one of the narrators) said: I think he (al-Bara' b. 'Azib also) said: And it is better than a goat of one year. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Make it a substitute for that (and sacrifice it), but it will not suffice for anyone (as a sacrifice) after you.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki ki Abu Burda ne jaanwar (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaani ke soorat mein zibah kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Iske badle mein doosra qurbaan karo (kyunki ye tumhe qurbaani ki zimmedaari se azad nahi karta). Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas chhe mahine se kam umar ki ek bakri ke siwaay kuch nahi hai. Shu'ba (ek raawi) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (al-Bara bin Azib ne bhi) kaha: Aur ye ek saal ki bakri se behtar hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise uska badla banao (aur ise qurbaan karo), lekin ye tumhare baad kisi ke liye (qurbaani ke soorat mein) kaafi nahi hogi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but did not mention tht doubt (expressed in his statement) That is (the goat of less than a year) is better than a goat of more than one year.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone us shak (unke bayaan mein zaahir kiye gaye) ka koi zikr nahi kiya: Ki (ek saal se kam ki bakri) ek saal se zyada ki bakri se behtar hai.

e: Anas (b. Malik) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said on the day of Nahr (Sacrifice): He who slaughtered (the animal as a sacrifice) before the ('Id) prayer. should repeat it (i. e. offer another animal). Thereupon a person stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, that is the day when meat is much desired, and he also made a mention of the need of his neighbour, and perhaps Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) attested it. He (the person who had sacrificed the animal before the 'Id prayer) said: I have a goat of less than one year of age with me and I like it more than two fleshy goats; should I offer it as a sacrifice? He permitted him to do so. He (the narrator) said: I do not know whether this permission was granted to anyone else besides him or not. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then turned towards two rams. and he slaughtered them, and the people' came to the goats and got them distributed amongst themselves (for offering them as sacrifice).
hi: Anas (bin Malik) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Nahr (Qurbaani) ke din ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne (jaanwar ko qurbaani ke soorat mein) (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah kiya, use ise (yaani doosra jaanwar) dobara pesh karna chahiye. Isper ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye woh din hai jab gosht ki bahut khwaish hoti hai, aur unhone apne padosi ki zaroorat ka bhi zikr kiya, aur shayad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise pramanit kiya. Unhone (jisne Id ki namaz se pehle jaanwar qurbaan kiya tha) kaha: Mere paas ek saal se kam umar ki ek bakri hai aur mujhe ye do maansal bakriyon se zyada pasand hai; kya main ise qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karun? Unhone unhe aisa karne ki ijazat di. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye ijazat unke ilawa kisi aur ko di gayi ya nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir do menDhon ki taraf mude, aur unhe zibah kiya, aur log bakriyon ke paas aaye aur unhe aapas mein baant liya (unhe qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karne ke liye).

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the 'Id prayer and then delivered the sermon giving the command: He who slaughtered the animal before prayer should slaughter (another animal as a sacrifice). The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Id ki namaz padhi aur phir hukum dete hue khutba diya: Jisne jaanwar namaz se pehle zibah kiya use (doosra jaanwar) zibah karna chahiye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of 'Id al-Adha. He smelt the odour of flesh and he prohibited thern from slaughtering (the animals before the 'Id prayer), saying: He who slaughtered the animals (before the 'Id prayer) should do that again (as it is not valid as a sacrifice).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Id al-Adha ke din khitaab kiya. Unhone gosht ki mahak soongi aur unhone humein (jaanwaron ko (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah karne se) mana kiya, ye kehte hue: Jisne jaanwaron ko (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya use dobara aisa karna chahiye (kyunki ye qurbaani ke soorat mein maany nahi hai).

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Sacrifice only a grown-up animal, unless it is difficult for you, in which case sacrifice a ram (of even less than a year, but more than six months' age).
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sirf ek pooran vayask jaanwar qurbaan karo, jab tak ye tumhare liye mushkil na ho, jismein haalat mein ek menDha qurbaan karo (chahe ek saal se kam ka ho, lekin chhe mahine se zyada umar ka ho).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the 'Id prayer in Medina on the Day of Sacrifice. Some persons slaughtered their animals ahead of him under the impression that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had-already offered sacrifice. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Those who had slaughtered their animals ahead of him should slaughter the other ones in their stead. And they should not sacrifice the animal before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had sacrificed (his animal)
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Madina mein Qurbaani ke Din Id ki namaz padhayi. Kuch logon ne apne jaanwar unse pehle zibah kiye is dhaarna mein ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pehle hi qurbaani de di hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jinhone apne jaanwar unse pehle zibah kiye unhe unki jagah doosre zibah karne chahiye. Aur unhe apna jaanwar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jaanwar qurbaan karne se pehle qurbaan nahi karna chahiye.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the gifts of goats to be distributed amongst his Companions. They sacrificed them, but a lamb of one year of age was left. (Someone) made a mention of that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: You sacrifice it.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba mein baantne ke liye bakriyon ke tohfe diye. Unhone unhe qurbaan kiya, lekin ek saal umar ka ek bhed bach gaya. (Kisi ne) iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ise tum qurbaan karo.

e: Amir al-Juhani reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed sacrificial animals (amongst us for sacrificing them on 'Id al-Adha). So we sacrificed them. There fell to my lot a lamb of less than one year I said: Allah's Messenger, there has fallen to my lot a lamb (Jadha'a), whereupon he said: Sacrifice that.
hi: Amir al-Juhani ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaani ke jaanwar baante (humare beech unhe Id al-Adha par qurbaan karne ke liye). To humne unhe qurbaan kiya. Mere hisse mein ek saal se kam ka ek bhed aaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere hisse mein ek bhed (Jadha'a) aaya hai, isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhan with a slight change of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Uqba bin Aamir al-Juhan ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed with his own hands two horned rams which were white with black markings reciting the name of Allah and glorifying Him (saying Allah-o-Akbar). He placed his foot on their sides (while sacrificing).
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khud ke haathon se do singon waale menDhe qurbaan kiye jo safed the kaale nishaanon ke saath, Allah ka naam lete hue aur Uski buland-o-baala ka bayaan karte hue (Allahu Akbar kehte hue). Unhone apna paon unke pehlu par rakha (zibah karte waqt).

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed two horned rams of white colour with black markings over them. He also stated: I saw him sacrificing them with his own hand and saw him placing his foot on their sides, and recited the name of Allah and Glorified Him.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do singon waale menDhe qurbaan kiye jo safed rang ke the kaale nishaanon ke saath. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Maine unhe apne khud ke haath se qurbaan karte dekha aur unhe apna paon unke pehlu par rakhte dekha, aur Allah ka naam liya aur Uski buland-o-baala ka bayaan kiya.

e: Shu'ba reported: Qatada informed me that he had heard Anas saying that Allah's Messenger (may peace be npon him) sacrificed (the horned rams) and like that. I said: Did you (Qatada) hear from Anas? He said. Yes.
hi: Shu'ba ne riwayat ki: Qatada ne mujhe bataya ki unhone Anas ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (singon waale menDhon ko) qurbaan kiya aur waisa hi. Maine kaha: Kya aapne (Qatada ne) ise Anas se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a ram with black legs, black belly and black (circles) round the eyes should be brought to him, so that he should sacrifice it. He said to 'A'isha: Give me the large knife, and then said: Sharpen it on a stone. She did that. He then took it (the knife) and then the ram; he placed it on the ground and then sacrificed it, saying: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (In the name of Allah," O Allah, accept  on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and the Umma of Muhammad" ).
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki kaali taangon, kaale pet, aur aankhon ke aas-paas kaale (ghere) waala ek menDha unke paas laaya jaaye, taaki woh use qurbaan kar sakein. Unhone Aisha se kaha: Mujhe bada chaaku do, aur phir kaha: Ise ek patthar par tez karo. Unhone aisa kiya. Unhone phir use (chaaku) liya aur phir menDhe ko, use zameen par rakha aur phir use qurbaan kiya, ye kehte hue: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (Allah ke naam par, "Aye Allah, Muhammad ki taraf se aur Muhammad ke khaandaan ki taraf se, aur Muhammad ki Ummat ki taraf se qubool kar").

e: Rafi' b. Khadij is reported to have said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow, but we have no knives with us. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Make haste or be careful (in making arrangements for procuring knives) which would let the blood flow (and along with it) the name of Allah is also to be recited. Then eat, but not the tooth or nail. And I am going to tell you why it is not permissible to slaughter the animal with the help of tooth and bone; and as for the nail. it is a bone, and the bone is the knife of Abyssinians. He (the narrator) said: There fell to our lot as spoils of war camels and goats, and one of the camels among them became wild. A person (amongst usl struck It with an arrow which brought it under control. whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This camel became wild like wild animals, so if you find any animal getting wild, you do the same with that
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne kaha (aisa kaha jaata hai): Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, lekin humare paas chaaku nahi hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jaldi karo ya saavdhaani se karo (chaaku haasil karne ke intezaam mein) jo khoon bahaayein (aur uske saath) Allah ka naam bhi liya jaana chahiye. Phir khaao, lekin daant ya naakhun se nahi. Aur main tumhe bataane wala hoon ki jaanwar ko daant aur haddi ki madad se zibah karna kyun jaayez nahi hai; aur naakhun ke jahan tak sawal hai, ye ek haddi hai, aur haddi Abyssinians ka chaaku hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Humein jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein oont aur bakriyaan milin, aur unmein se ek oont jangli ho gaya. Ek shakhs (hummein se) ne use teer se maara jisne use kaboo mein kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye oont jangli ho gaya jaanwaron ki tarah, is liye agar tum kisi jaanwar ko jangli hote paate ho, tum uske saath waisa hi karo.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: While we were with Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) in Dhu'I-Hulaifa in Tihama, we got hold of goats and camels. Some persons (amongst us) made haste and boiled (the flesh of goats and camels) in their earthen pots. He then commanded and these were turned over; then he equalised ten goats for a camel. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein Tihama mein the, humein bakriyaan aur oont mile. Kuch logon (hummein se) ne jaldi ki aur (bakriyon aur oonton ka gosht) apne mitti ke bartano mein ubaala. Unhone phir hukum diya aur unhe ulTa kar diya gaya; phir unhone das bakriyon ko ek oont ke barabar kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported from his grandfather that he said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow, but we do not have long knives with us, should we then slaughter them with the peel of the reed? The rest of the hadith is the same. (And at the end the words are):" A camel became wild (and got out of our control). We attacked it with arrows until we made it fall down."
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne apne dada se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, lekin humare paas lambe chaaku nahi hain, kya humein unhe (jaanwaron ko) beans ke chhilke se zibah karna chahiye? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. (Aur ant mein alfaaz hain): "Ek oont jangli ho gaya (aur humare kaboo se bahar ho gaya). Humne use teeron se hamla kiya yahan tak ki humne use giraaya."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Masruq with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id bin Masruq ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported that he said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow. and we do not have large knives with us. The rest of the hadith is the same, but no mention is made of this:" The people hastened and they boiled (flesh) in the earthen pots. He (the Holy Prophet), cammanded and these were turned over and the narrator narrated the whole event.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, aur humare paas bade chaaku nahi hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Log jaldi karne lage aur mitti ke bartano mein (gosht) ubaala. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) hukum diya aur unhe ulTa kar diya gaya," aur raawi ne poori ghatna riwayat ki.
