e: Abu Ubaid reported: I was with 'Ali b. Abi Talib on the occasion of the 'Id day. He started with the 'Id prayer before delivering the sermon, and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat the flesh of our sacrificial animals beyond three days.
hi: Abu Ubaid ne riwayat ki: Main Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ki sohbat mein tha Id ke din. Unhone khutba dene se pehle Id ki namaz shuru ki, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein humari qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya.

e: Abu 'Ubaid, the freed slave of Ibn Azhar, reported that he said 'Id (prayer) with Umar b. al-Khattab, and then said the 'Id (prayer) with 'Ali b. Abu Talib. He (the narrator further) reported: He led us in prayer before delivering the sermon and then addressed the people saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden you to eat the flesh of your sacrificial animals beyond three nights, so do not eat that.
hi: Abu Ubaid, Ibn Azhar ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki ki unhone Id (ki namaz) Umar bin al-Khattab ke saath padhi, aur phir Id (ki namaz) Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath padhi. Unhone (raawi ne aage) riwayat ki: Unhone humein namaz padhaayi khutba dene se pehle aur phir logon se khitaab karte hue kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen raaton se zyada khaane se mana kiya hai, is liye use mat khaao.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: None of you should eat the flesh of his sacrificial animal beyond three days.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi apni qurbaani ke jaanwar ka gosht teen din se zyada na khaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that the flesh of sacrificial animals be eaten beyond three (days) Salim (son of Ibn Umar) said: Ibn 'Umar did not eat the flesh of the sacrificial animals beyond three (days). Ibn Abu 'Umar said:" Beyond three days."
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya. Salim (Ibn Umar ke bete) ne kaha: Ibn Umar qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada nahi khaate the. Ibn Abu Umar ne kaha: "Teen din se zyada."

e: Abdullah b. Waqid reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (people) to cat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three days. Abdullah b. Abu Bakr said, I made a mention of that to 'Amra, whereupon she said: He has told the truth, for I heard 'A'isha say: The poor among the people of the desert come (to the towns) on the occasion of Id al-Adha during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Retain with you (the flesh) sufficing for three (days), and whatever is left out of that give in charity. After this. they (the Muslims) said: Allah's Messenger, the people make waterskins with the (hides) of their sacrificed animals and they melt fat out of them. Thereupon he said. What the then? They said: You forbade (us) to eat the flesh of sacrificial animals beyond threoq (days), whereupon he said: I forbade you for those (poor persons) who flocked (to the towns on this occasion for getting meat) but now when (this situation has improved) you may eat, preserve and give -in charity.
hi: Abdullah bin Waqid ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (logon ko) qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya. Abdullah bin Abu Bakr ne kaha, maine iska zikr Amra se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha, kyunki maine Aisha ko ye kehte suna: Registaan ke gareeb log (shehron mein) Id al-Adha ke avasar par aate the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne paas teen (dinon) ke liye kaafi (gosht) rakho, aur jo bhi isse bacha ho use sadaqe mein do. Iske baad, unhone (Musalmaanon ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ki khaal se paani ki thailiyaan banaate hain aur unse charbi pighlaate hain. Isper unhone kaha: Ab kya? Unhone kaha: Aapne humein qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya, isper unhone kaha: Maine tumhe un logon (gareebon) ke liye mana kiya jo (is avasar par gosht paane ke liye shehron mein) jama the, lekin ab jab (ye haalat sudhar gayi hai) tum khaa sakte ho, mahfooz rakh sakte ho, aur sadaqe mein de sakte ho.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade eating of the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three (days). but afterwards said: Eat, make a provision, and keep it.
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya, lekin baad mein kaha: Khaao, saadhan banao, aur ise mahfooz rakho.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: We did not eat the flesh of our sacrificial animals beyond three days in Mina. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted us saying: Eat and make it a provision (for journey). I asked 'Ata' whether Jabir had also said: Till we came to Medina. He said: Yes.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Humne apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada nahi khaaya Mina mein. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ijazat di ye kehte hue: Khaao aur ise (safar ke liye) saadhan banaao. Maine Ata se poocha ki kya Jabir ne bhi kaha tha: Jab tak hum Madina nahi aa gaye. Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We did not eat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three (days), but then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to make it a provision for journey and cat it (beyond three days).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Humne qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada nahi khaaya, lekin phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum ise safar ke liye saadhan banaayein aur ise khaayein (teen din se zyada).

e: Jabir reported: We made provision (out of the flesh of sacrificed animals for our journey) to Medina during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki: Humne (qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke gosht se) Madina ke apne safar ke liye saadhan banaaya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: O people of Medina, do not eat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three days. Ibn al-Muthanni said: Three days. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) complained to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) that they had children and servants of theirs (to feed), whereupon he said: Eat, and feed others, and store, and make it a provision of food.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aye Madina ke logo, qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada mat khaao. Ibn al-Muthanni ne kaha: Teen din. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ke sahaba ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaayat ki ki unke bachche aur unke naukar hain (jinhe khilaana hai), isper unhone kaha: Khaao, aur doosron ko khilaao, aur jama karo, aur ise khaane ka saadhan banaao.

e: Salama b. al-Akwa' reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) having said: He who sacrifices (animal) among you nothing should be left in his house (out of its flesh) on the morning of the third day. When it was the next year they (his Companions) said: Should we do this year as we did daring the previous year? Thereupon he said: Don't do that, for that was a year when the people were hard pressed (on account of poverty). so I wanted that the (flesh) might be distributed amongst them.
hi: Salama bin al-Akwa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo tum mein se qurbaani karta hai, teesre din ki subah tak uske ghar mein (uske gosht mein se) kuch nahi bachna chahiye. Jab agla saal aaya unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Kya humein is saal wahi karna chahiye jo humne pichhle saal kiya tha? Isper unhone kaha: Aisa mat karo, kyunki woh ek saal tha jab log (gareebi ki wajah se) tang haal the, is liye main chaahta tha ki (gosht) unke beech baanta jaaye.

e: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) slaughtered his sacrificial animal and then said: Thauban, make his meat usable (for journey), and I continuously served him that until he arrived in Medina.
hi: Thauban ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna qurbaani ka jaanwar zibah kiya aur phir kaha: Thauban, iske gosht ko istemal ke laayak banao (safar ke liye), aur maine lagataar ise use serve kiya jab tak woh Madina nahi pahunche.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mu'awiya b. Salih with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mu'awiya bin Salih ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me on the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada' (the Farewell Pilgrimage): Make the flesh usable. So I made it usable (for him) and he ate it constantly until he reached Medina. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabya b. Hamza with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not say: On the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada'.
hi: Thauban, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha Hajjat-al-Wada (Vida ke Hajj) ke avasar par: Gosht ko istemal ke laayak banao. To maine ise (unke liye) istemal ke laayak banaaya aur unhone ise lagataar khaaya jab tak woh Madina nahi pahunche. Ye hadees Yahya bin Hamza ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone nahi kaha: Hajjat-al-Wada ke avasar par.

e: Abdullah b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this: I prohibited you from visiting the graves, but (now) you may visit them, and I prohibited you (from eating) the flesh of sacrific- ed animals beyond three days, but now keep it as long as you like. I prohibited you from the use of Nabidh except (that preoared) in dry waterskins. Now drink (Nabidh prepared in any utensil), but do not drink when it becomes intoxicant.
hi: Abdullah bin Buraida ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha: Maine tumhe qabron par jaane se mana kiya tha, lekin (ab) tum unhe visit kar sakte ho, aur maine tumhe (khaane se) qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada mana kiya tha, lekin ab ise jitna chaaho rakho. Maine tumhe Nabidh (khajoor ka sherbet) ka istemal karne se mana kiya tha siwaay sookhi paani ki thailiyon mein (taiyaar kiya hua). Ab piyo (kisi bhi bartan mein taiyaar kiya hua Nabidh), lekin mat piyo jab ye nashe waala ho jaaye.

e: Ibn Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: I used to forbid you. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Main tumhe mana kiya karta tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (The sacrifice of Fara' and 'Atira) has no (sanction in Islam). Ibn Rafi' made this addition in his narration that Fara' means the first-born young one of a camel.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: (Fara aur Atira ki qurbaani) ka (Islam mein koi vidhan) nahi hai. Ibn Rafi ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki Fara ka matlab hai oont ka pehla paida kiya bachcha.

e: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: When any one of you intending to sacrifice the animal enters in the month (of Dhu'l-Hijja) he should not get his hair or nails touched (cut). It was said to Sufyan that some of the (scholars) did not deem this hadith to be Maffu'. He said: But I deem it as Marfu' (i. e. chain of narration traceable right up to the Holy Prophet).
hi: Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi (jaanwar ki) qurbaani ka iraada rakhta hai aur (Zul-Hijja ke) mahine mein daakhil hota hai, use apne baal ya naakhun (kaTvaake) nahi chhona chahiye. Sufyan se kaha gaya ki kuch (aalim) is hadees ko Marfu (Nabi tak jaane wali riwayat) nahi maante. Unhone kaha: Lekin main ise Marfu maanta hoon (yaani sanad Nabi-e-Paak tak jaati hai).

e: Umm Salama reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone of you intends to offer sacrifice he should not get his hair cut or nails trimmed.
hi: Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Agar tum mein se koi qurbaani dene ka iraada rakhta hai use apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye.

e: Umm Salama reported (these words) directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): If anyone has in his possession a sacrificial animal to offer as a sacrifice (on 'Id al-Adha), he should not get his hair cut and nails trimmed after he has entered the first days of Dhu'l Hijja
hi: Umm Salama ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki: Agar kisi ke paas ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai jise woh (Id al-Adha par) qurbaan karna chahta hai, use Zul-Hijja ke pehle dinon mein daakhil hone ke baad apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Muslim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Muslim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to have said: He who has a sacrificial animal with him whom (he intends) to offer as sacrifice, and he enters the month of Dhu'I-Hijja, he should not get his hair cut or nails trimmed until he has sacrificed the animal.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jiske paas ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai jise (woh qurbaan karna chahta hai), aur woh Zul-Hijja ke mahine mein daakhil hota hai, use apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye jab tak usne jaanwar qurbaan na kar diya ho.

e: 'Amr b. Muslim b. 'Ammar al-Laithi reported: While we were in a bathroom just before 'Id al-Adha some of the persons tried to remove the hair with the help of hair-removing chemicals. Thereupon some of the people owning the bath (or some of the people sitting therein) said that Sa'id b. Musayyib did not approve of it, or he prohibited it. Then I met Sa'id b. Musayyib and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: O my nephew, this is the hadith which has been forgotten, and abandoned. Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), narrated to me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said as narrated above.
hi: Amr bin Muslim bin Ammar al-Laithi ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Id al-Adha se pehle ek naahne ki jagah (hammam) mein the kuch logon ne baal hataane waale rasaayanik padaarthon ki madad se baal hataane ki koshish ki. Isper hammam ke kuch maalikon (ya wahan baiThe kuch logon) ne kaha ki Sa'id bin Musayyib ise manzoor nahi karte the, ya unhone ise mana kiya tha. Phir main Sa'id bin Musayyib se mila aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Aye mere bhatije, ye woh hadees hai jise bhula diya gaya hai, aur chhoD diya gaya hai. Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne upar bataayi gayi baat kahi thi.

e: Amr b. Muslim al-Jundani reported that Ibn Musayyib had told him that it was Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), who had informed him of that as narrated above.
hi: Amr bin Muslim al-Jundani ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Musayyib ne unhe bataya tha ki ye Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, thin jinhone unhe upar bataayi gayi baat ki jaankaari di thi.

e: Abu Tufail 'Amir b. Withila reported: I was in the company of 'Ali b. Abi Talib, when a person came to him, and said: What was it that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told you in secret? Thereupon he (liadrat 'All) was enraged and said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not tell me anything in secret that he hid from people, except that he told me four things. He said: Com- mader of Faithful, what are these? He said: Allah cursed him who cursed his father; Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone besides Allah; and Allah cursed him who accommodates an innovator (in religion) ; and Allah cursed him who changed the minarets (the boundary lines) of the land.
hi: Abu Tufail Amir bin Withila ne riwayat ki: Main Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ki sohbat mein tha, jab ek shakhs unke paas aaya, aur kaha: Kya thi woh baat jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapko chupke se batayi thi? Isper woh (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam)) naaraaz ho gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe kuch bhi chupke se nahi bataya jise unhone logon se chhupaaya ho, siwaay is baat ke ki unhone mujhe chaar baaten bataayi thin. Unhone kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, woh kya hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne waalid ko bura-bhala kaha; Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jo kisi navachaari (deen mein) ko panah deta hai; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne zameen ke meenaron (seemaon) ko badla.

e: Abu Tufail reported: We said to 'Ali b. Abi Talib: Inform us about something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told you in secret, whereupon he said: He told me nothing in secret which he bid from people, but I heard him say: Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone besides Allah; and cursed him who accommodated an innovator; and Allah cursed him who cursed his parents and Allah cursed him who changed the boundary lines (of the land possessed by him).
hi: Abu Tufail ne riwayat ki: Humne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Humein kuch aisa bataiye jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapko chupke se bataya, isper unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe kuch bhi chupke se nahi bataaya jise unhone logon se chhupaaya ho, lekin maine unhe ye kehte suna: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur laanat ki us shakhs par jo kisi navachaari ko panah deta hai; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne maa-baap ko bura-bhala kaha aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne (apni malkiyat ki) zameen ki seemaon ko badla.

e: Abu Tufail reported: 'Ali was asked whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had showed special favour (by disclosing to him) a thing (which he kept secret from others). Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) singled us not for (disclosing to us) anything (secret) which he did not make public, (but those few things) which lie in the sheath of my sword. He drew out the written document contained in it and on that (it was mentioned): Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone else besides Allah; and Allah cursed him who stole the signposts (demarcating the boundary lines of the) land; and Allah cursed him who cursed his father; and Allah cursed him who accommodated an innovator (in religion).
hi: Abu Tufail ne riwayat ki: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha gaya ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe koi khaas favour dikhaayi thi (unhe koi aisi cheez bataakar jise unhone doosron se chupaaya). Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein kisi bhi cheez ke liye alag nahi kiya (unhe bataane ke liye) jo unhone doosron ko nahi bataayi, (lekin woh kuch baaten) jo meri talwaar ke myaan mein hain. Unhone myaan mein rakha likha dastaavez nikaala aur usmein (ye likha tha): Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne zameen ki (seemaon ka nirdharan karne wale) nishaan chura liye; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne waalid ko bura-bhala kaha; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jo kisi navachaari (deen mein) ko panah deta hai.

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported; There fell to my lot along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an old she-camel from the spoils of Badr. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted me another camel. I made them kneel down one day at the door of an Ansari, and I wanted to carry on them Idhkhir (a kind of grass) in order to sell that. There was with me a goldsmith of the tribe of Qainuqa'. I saught to give a wedding feast (on the occasion of marriage with) Fatima with the help of that (the price accrued from the sale of this grass). And Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib was busy in drinking in that house in the company of a singing girl who was singing to him. She said: Hamza, get up for slaughtering the fat she-camels. Hamza attacked them with the sword and cut off their humps and ripped their haunches, and then took out their livers. I said to Ibn Shihab: Did he take out anything from the hump? He said: He cut off the humps altogether. Ibn Shihab reported 'Ali having said: I saw this (horrible) sight and it shocked me, and I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and there was Zaid b, Haritha with him and communicated to him this news. He came in the company of Zaid and I also went along with him and he went to Hamza and he expressed anger with him. Hamza raised his eyes and said: Are you (not) but the servants of my father? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned back on his heels (on hearing this) until he went away from them.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maal-e-ganimat mein se Badr se mere hisse mein ek boodhi oontni aayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek aur oont diya. Maine unhe ek din ek Ansari ke darwaze par bithaya, aur main unpar Idhkhir (ek tarah ki ghaas) le jaana chahta tha ise bechne ke liye. Mere saath Qainuqa qabile ka ek sunaar tha. Maine (is ghaas ki bikri se aayi raqam se) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (se shaadi ke avasar par) Waleema karne ki koshish ki. Aur Hamza bin Abd al-Muttalib us ghar mein sharaab peene mein masroof the ek gaane wali larki ki sohbat mein jo unhe gaana suna rahi thi. Usne kaha: Hamza, uTho maansal oontniyon ko zibah karne ke liye. Hamza ne unpar talwaar se hamla kiya aur unke kohaan kaat diye aur unki jaanghen chir dalin, aur phir unke jigar nikaal liye. Maine Ibn Shihab se kaha: Kya unhone kohaan mein se kuch nikaala? Unhone kaha: Unhone kohaan poori tarah kaat diye. Ibn Shihab ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Maine ye (khaufnaak) nazaara dekha aur ye mujhe sadmen mein daal gaya, aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Zaid bin Haritha unke saath the aur maine ye khabar unhe di. Woh Zaid ki sohbat mein aaye aur main bhi unke saath gaya aur woh Hamza ke paas gaye aur unhone unpar gussa zaahir kiya. Hamza ne apni aankhein uThAyin aur kaha: Kya tum mere waalid ke ghulamon ke ilawa kuch aur ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni eDiyon par mud gaye (ye sunkar) yahan tak ki woh unse door chale gaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Husain b. 'Ali reported 'Ali having said: There fell to my lot a she-camel out of the spoils of war on the Day of Badr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me (another) she-camel on that day out of the Khums (one-fifth reserved for Allah and His Messenger). When I made up my mind to consummate my marriage with Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I prevailed upon a goldsmith of the tribe of Qainuqa' to go along with me so that we might bring Idhkhir wishing to sell that to the goldsmiths and thus I should be able to arrange my wedding feast. While I was arranging the equipments. i. e. litters, sacks and ropes, my two she-camels were sitting down at the side of the apartment of a person of the Ansar. I collected (the different articles of equipment) and found to my surprise that their humps had been chopped off and their haunches had been cut off and their livers had been taken out. I could not help weeping when I saw that plight of theirs. I said: Who has done that? They said: Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib has done this. and he is in this house dead drunk in the company of some of the Ansair with asinging girl singing before him and his companions. She said in her song: O Hamza. get up and attack these falty she-camels. Thereupon Hamza stood up with a sword (in his hand) and cut off their humps and ripped their haunches and tore out their livers. 'Ali said: I went away until I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was with him Zaid b. Haritha. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recognised from my face what I had experienced, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you? I said: Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I have never seen (such an unfortunate day) as this day. Hamza has committed aggression to my she-camels, and has cut off their humps. and ripped their haunches, and he is in a house in the company of some drunkards. (Hearing this) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for his mantle and, putting it on him, he proceeded, and I and Zaid b. Haritha followed him, until he came to the door (of the house) in which there was Hamza. He (the Holy Prophet) sought permission which they granted him. and they were all drunk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to reprimand Hamza for what he had done. Hamza's eyes were red. He cast a glance at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then looked towards his knees. and then lifted his eyes and cast a glance at his waist and then lifted his eyes and saw his face. And then Hamza said: Are you anything but the slaves of my father? Alah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to know that he was intoxicated, and he thus turned upon his heels, and came out, and we also came out along with him.
hi: Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Badr ke din jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein se mere hisse mein ek oontni aayi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe us din (ek aur) oontni di Khums (Allah aur Uske Rasool ke liye alag rakha gaya paanchvaan hissa) mein se. Jab maine Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ke saath apni shaadi poori karne ka mann banaaya, maine Qainuqa qabile ke ek sunaar ko manaaya mere saath jaane ke liye taaki hum Idhkhir laa sakein use sunaaron ko bechne ke iraade se aur is tarah main apna shaadi ka daawat munazzam kar saka. Jab main saamaan (yaani doliyaan, thailiyaan aur rassiyaan) munazzam kar raha tha, meri do oontniyaan ek Ansari ke kamre ke bagal mein baiThi hui thin. Maine (mukhtalif saamaan ki cheezein) ikattha kin aur hairat se paaya ki unke kohaan kaat diye gaye the aur unki jaanghen chir dali gayi thin aur unke jigar nikaal liye gaye the. Maine khud ko rone se rok nahi paaya jab maine unki ye halat dekhi. Maine kaha: Kisne ye kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Hamza bin Abd al-Muttalib ne ye kiya hai, aur woh is ghar mein sharaab ke nashe mein hain kuch Ansar ki sohbat mein aur ek gaane wali larki unke saamne gaa rahi hai aur unke saathi (bhi). Usne apne gaane mein kaha: Aye Hamza, uTho aur in mote-taaze oontniyon par hamla karo. Isper Hamza (talwaar apne haath mein liye) khade hue aur unke kohaan kaat diye aur unki jaanghen chir dalin aur unke jigar nikaal liye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Main chala gaya yahan tak ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unke saath Zaid bin Haritha the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere chehre se pehchaan liya ki maine kya tajurba kiya tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi (aisa badnaseeb din) nahi dekha jaisa ye din. Hamza ne meri oontniyon par hamla kiya hai, aur unke kohaan kaat diye hain, aur unki jaanghen chir dali hain, aur woh ek ghar mein kuch sharaabiyon ki sohbat mein hain. (Ye sunkar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chogha mangwaaya aur, use pehankar, woh chal diye, aur main aur Zaid bin Haritha unke peeche gaye, yahan tak ki woh us ghar ke darwaze par pahunche jismein Hamza the. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ijazat maangi jo unhe di gayi. aur woh sab nashe mein the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hamza ko unke kiye hue kaam ke liye daantna shuru kiya. Hamza ki aankhein laal thin. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf ek nazar daali aur phir unke ghutnon ki taraf dekha, aur phir apni aankhein uThaakar unki kamar ki taraf dekha aur phir apni aankhein uThaakar unka chehra dekha. Aur phir Hamza ne kaha: Kya tum mere waalid ke ghulamon ke ilawa kuch aur ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko samajh aaya ki woh nashe mein hain, aur woh is tarah apni eDiyon par mud gaye, aur bahar aaye, aur hum bhi unke saath bahar aaye.

e: The above hadith has been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I was the cup-bearer of some people in the house of Abu Talha on the day when liquor was forbidden. Their liquor had been prepared from dry dates or fresh dates when the announcer made the announcement. He (Abu Talha) said to me: Go out and find out (what the announcement is). I got out (and found) an announcer making this announcement: Behold, liquor has been declared unlawful. He said: The liquor (was spilt and) flawed in the lanes of Medina. Abu Talha said to me: Go out and Spill it, and I spilt it. They said or some of them said: Such and such were killed, such and such were killed for (the wine) had been in their stomachs. He (the narrator) said. I do not know whether it is the narration transmitted by Anas, (or by someone else). Then Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed:" There shall be no sin (imputed) unto those who have believed and done good works for what they may have eaten as long as they fear (Allah) and believe and do good works" (v. 93).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main kuch logon ka saaqi tha Abu Talha ke ghar mein us din jab sharaab mana ki gayi. Unki sharaab sookhi khajooron ya taazi khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi jab ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya. Unhone (Abu Talha ne) mujhse kaha: Bahar jaao aur pata karo (ailaan kya hai). Main bahar gaya (aur paaya) ki ek ailaan karne wala ye ailaan kar raha tha: Dekho, sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Sharaab (bikhri gayi thi aur) Madina ki galiyon mein beh rahi thi. Abu Talha ne mujhse kaha: Bahar jaao aur ise bahaa do, aur maine ise bahaa diya. Unhone kaha ya unmein se kuchne kaha: Aisa aisa qatal kiye gaye, aisa aisa qatal kiye gaye (sharaab ke) unke pait mein hone ki wajah se. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha. Mujhe nahi pata ki ye Anas ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hadees hai (ya kisi doosre ke zariye). Phir Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne nazil kiya: "Unke liye koi gunah nahi (aropit) hoga jinhone imaan rakha aur achhe amal kiye us cheez ke liye jo unhone khaya ho jab tak woh (Allah se) darte rahe aur imaan rakhte rahe aur achhe amal karte rahe" (5:93).

e: 'Abd al-Aziz b. Suhaib reported: They (some persons) asked Anas b. Malik, about Fadikh (that is, a wine prepared from fresh dates), whereupon he said: There was no liquor with us except this Fadikih of yours. It was only this Fadikh that I had been serving to Abu Talha and Abu Ayyub and some persons from amongst the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in our house. When a person came and said: Has the news reached you? We said, No. He said: Verily liquor has been declared forbidden. Thereupon, Abd Talha said: Anas, spill these large pitchers. He (the narrator) said: They then never reverted to it, nor even asked about this after the announcement by that person.
hi: Abd al-Aziz bin Suhaib ne riwayat ki: Unhone (kuch logon ne) Anas bin Malik se Fadikh (yaani taazi khajooron se taiyaar sharaab) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Humare paas iske ilawa koi sharaab nahi thi (siwaay) is tumhare Fadikh ke. Ye sirf yehi Fadikh tha jo main Abu Talha aur Abu Ayyub aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ko humare ghar mein serve karta tha. Jab ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Kya tumhe khabar pahunchi hai? Humne kaha: Nahi. Usne kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Isper, Abu Talha ne kaha: Anas, in badi thailiyon ko bahaa do. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh phir kabhi isse waapas nahi laute, na hi is shakhs ke ailaan ke baad iske baare mein poocha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I was standing amongst the uncles of my tribe serving them Fadikh while I was the youngest of them, when a person came and said: Verily the use of liqour has been prohibited. They said: Anas, spill it away. So I spilt it. He (one of the narrators. Sulaiman Taimi) said that he asked Anas what that was (the Fadikh). He said: It had been prepared from unripe and ripe dates. Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days. Sulaiman said: A person narrated it to me from Anas b. Malik that he had said so.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main apne qabile ke chachaon ke beech khada tha unhe Fadikh serve karte hue jabki main unmein sabse jawaan tha, jab ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ke istemal ko mana kiya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Anas, ise bahaa do. To maine ise bahaa diya. Unhone (raawiyon mein se ek, Sulaiman Taimi ne) kaha ki unhone Anas se poocha ki woh (Fadikh) kya tha. Unhone kaha: Ye kachchi aur pakki khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi. Abu Bakr bin Anas ne kaha: Ye un dinon unki sharaab thi. Sulaiman ne kaha: Ek shakhs ne mujhe Anas bin Malik se riwayat ki ki unhone aisa kaha tha.

e: Anas reported: I was standing amongst the members of my (tribe) and serving them liquor. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this variation that Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days (prepared from dates), and Anas was present there and he did not deny this (fact) Mu'tamir reported on the authority of his father: A person who was with me told me that he had heard Anas saying that that was their liquor in those days.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Main apne (qabile) ke sadasyon ke beech khada tha aur unhe sharaab serve kar raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is antar ke saath ki Abu Bakr bin Anas ne kaha: Ye un dinon unki sharaab thi (khajooron se taiyaar), aur Anas wahan maujood the aur unhone ise nakaara nahi kiya. Mu'tamir ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Ek shakhs jo mere saath tha usne mujhe bataya ki usne Anas ko ye kehte suna tha ki woh un dinon unki sharaab thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported I was serving wine to Abu Talha, and Abu Dujana. and Mu'adh b. jabal admidst a group of Ansar when a visitor came to us and said There is a fresh news; the (verses) concerning the prohibition of liquor have been revealed. So we spilt it on that day; and it was a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates. Anas b. Malik said: Whil Khamr was declared unlawful, the common liquor of theirs was then a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main Abu Talha, aur Abu Dujana, aur Mu'adh bin Jabal ko sharaab serve kar raha tha Ansar ke ek giroh ke beech jab ek visitor humare paas aaya aur kaha: Ek taazi khabar hai; (aayaten) sharaab ki mana ke baare mein nazil hui hain. To humne ise us din bahaa diya; aur ye sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ka mishran tha. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Jab Khamr ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya, tab unki aam sharaab sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ka mishran hoti thi.

e: Anas b. Malik said: I was serving wine to Abu Talha, Abu Dujana, and Suhail b. Baida' from a waterskin which contained the mixture of unripe dates and fresh dates. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main Abu Talha, Abu Dujana, aur Suhail bin Baida ko ek chamde ki thaili se sharaab serve kar raha tha jismein kachchi aur taazi khajooron ka mishran tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik is reported to have said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden to mixture fresh dates and unripe dates and then drinking (the wine prepared out of it), and that was their common intoxicant when liquor was prohibited.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taazi khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ko mishrit karne aur phir (usse taiyaar sharaab) peene se mana kiya, aur ye unki aam nashe waali cheez thi jab sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I was serving drink to Abu 'Ubaida b. jarrah, Abu Talha and Ubayy b. Ka'b prepared from unripe dates and fresh dates when a visitor came and he said: Verily liquor has been prohibited. Thereupon, Abu Talha said: Anas, stand up and break this pitcher. I stool up and (took hold) of a pointed stone and struck the pitcher with its lower part until it broke into pieces.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah, Abu Talha aur Ubayy bin Ka'b ko sharaab serve kar raha tha jo kachchi aur taazi khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi jab ek visitor aaya aur usne kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Isper, Abu Talha ne kaha: Anas, uTho aur is ghade ko toDo. Main uThA aur ek nukili patthar (lekar) uske neechle hisse se ghade ko maara yahan tak ki ye tukdon mein toot gaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah revealed the verse in which Allah prohibited the use of liquor. In those days no other liquor was drunk but that prepared from dates.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Allah ne aayat nazil ki jismein Allah ne sharaab ke istemal ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya. Un dinon koi doosri sharaab nahi payi jaati thi siwaay uske jo khajooron se taiyaar ki jaati thi.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the use of Khamr from which vinegar is prepared. He said: No (it is prohibited).
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us Khamr ke istemal ke baare mein poocha gaya jisse sirka taiyaar kiya jaata hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi (ye mana hai).

e: Wa'il al-Hadrami reported that Tariq b. Suwaid a-Ju'fi asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about liquor. He forbade (its use) and he expressed hatred that it should be prepared. He (Tariq) said: I prepare it as a medicine, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is no medicine, but an ailment.
hi: Wa'il al-Hadrami ne riwayat ki ki Tariq bin Suwaid a-Ju'fi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sharaab ke baare mein poocha. Unhone (iske istemal se) mana kiya aur ghrina zaahir ki ki ye taiyaar ki jaaye. Unhone (Tariq ne) kaha: Main ise dawaai ke soorat mein taiyaar karta hoon, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye dawaai nahi hai, balki ek bimaari hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Wine is prepared from the (fruit) of these two trees-date-palm and vine.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sharaab in do darakhton ke (phal) se taiyaar ki jaati hai - khajoor aur angoor.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Wine comes from vine and date-palms. Abu Kuraib has narrated it with a slight variation of words.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sharaab angoor aur khajoor se aati hai. Abu Kuraib ne ise alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat kiya hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) prohibited the mixing of grapes and fresh dates, and dry dates and fresh dates.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor aur taazi khajooron ke, aur sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ke mishran se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the (preparation of) Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, and he prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing the fresh dates and unripe dates together.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taazi khajooron aur angoor ko milaakar Nabidh (taiyaar karne) se mana kiya, aur unhone taazi khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not mix fresh dates and dry dates, and grapes and fresh dates for preparing Nabidh.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Taazi khajooren aur sookhi khajooren, aur angoor aur taazi khajooren mat milaao Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing grapes and fresh dates. and he forbade the preparation of Nabidh by mixing unripe dates with fresh dates.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor aur taazi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya, aur unhone kachchi khajooron ko taazi khajooron ke saath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prohibited that fresh dates and grapes be mixed together and that fresh dates and unripe dates be mixed together.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki taazi khajooren aur angoor ekasath milaayi jaayein aur ki taazi khajooren aur kachchi khajooren ekasath milaayi jaayein.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us to mix grapes and dry dates together and unripe dates and dry dates (to prepare Nabidh.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein angoor aur sookhi khajooron ko ekasath, aur kachchi khajooron aur sookhi khajooron ko (Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye) milaane se mana kiya.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abi Maslama with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abi Maslama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who amongst you drinks Nabidh should drink that (prepared either from) grapes alone, or from dates alone, or from unripe dates alone (and not by mixing them with one another).
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo tum mein se Nabidh peeta hai use woh peena chahiye jo (ya to) angoor se, ya sirf khajooron se, ya sirf kachchi khajooron se (akela) taiyaar ki gayi ho (na ki unhe ek-doosre ke saath milaakar).

e: Isma'il b. Muslim al-'Abadi reported on the authority of the same chain of transmitters: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us that we should mix dry dates with unripe dates or (mix) grapes with dry dates (and prepare Nabidh). He also said: He who amongst you drinks-the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Isma'il bin Muslim al-Abadi ne isi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya ki hum sookhi khajooron ko kachchi khajooron ke saath, ya angoor ko sookhi khajooron ke saath (Nabidh taiyaar karte waqt) milaayein. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Jo tum mein se peeta hai - baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe dates and fresh dates together, and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing grapes and dates together, but prepare Nabidh from each (one of them) separately.
hi: Abu Qatada ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Lagbhag pakki khajooron aur taazi khajooron ko ekasath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, aur angoor aur khajooron ko ekasath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, balki har ek (inmein se) se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe and fresh dates and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, but prepare Nabidh out of each (one of them) separately. Yahya stated that he had met 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada and he narrated it on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said this.
hi: Abu Qatada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Lagbhag pakki aur taazi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo aur taazi khajooron aur angoor ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, balki har ek se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo. Yahya ne bataya ki unki mulaqaat Abdullah bin Abu Qatada se hui aur unhone ise apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir through these two chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se in do sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding the preparation of the mixture of ripe dates and unripe dates, and the mixture of grapes and dates, and that of nearly ripe dates and fresh dates but the Prophet said: Prepare the Nabidh from each one of them separately.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pakki khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ke mishran se, aur angoor aur khajooron ke mishran se, aur lagbhag pakki aur taazi khajooron ke mishran se mana karte hue riwayat ki, lekin Nabi ne kaha: Har ek se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Qatada through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Qatada ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) from grapes and dates, and unripe dates and dry dates (by mixing them together). He (the Prophet also) said: Prepare Nabidh from each one of them separately.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor aur khajooron ke, aur kachchi khajooron aur sookhi khajooron ke mishran se (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya. Unhone (Nabi ne bhi) kaha: Har ek se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo.

e: The above hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the mixing of dates and grapes together, and mixing of unripe dates and ripe dates together (for preparing Nabidh), and he wrote to the people of Jurash (in Yemen) forbidding them to prepare the mixture of dates and grapes.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khajooron aur angoor ko ekasath, aur kachchi khajooron aur pakki khajooron ko ekasath milaane se (Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye) mana kiya, aur unhone Jurash (Yemen mein) ke logon ko likha unhe khajooron aur angoor ka mishran taiyaar karne se mana karte hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that he was forbidden to prepare Nabidh by mixing unripe dates and fresh dates, and dates with grapes.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki unhe kachchi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ko, aur khajooron aur angoor ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya gaya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that they were forbidden to prepare Nabidh by mixing dry dates and fresh dates and dates and grapes together.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki unhe sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ko aur khajooron aur angoor ko ekasath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya gaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the preparation of Nabidh in gourd or varnished jar.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu ya varnish ki hui gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

e: The above hadith is narrated through a different chain with slight variation in wording.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not prepare Nabidh in gourd or jar or in a pitcher besmeared with pitch (known as green pitcher).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Kaddu ya gagri mein ya khaal se leep kiye gaye ghade mein (jise hari gagri kaha jaata hai) Nabidh taiyaar mat karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) in varnished jar, pitcher besmeared with green pitch and hollow stump. It was said to Abu Huraira: What that Hantama was? He said: It is green pitcher (besmeared with pitch).
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne varnish ki hui gagri, hari khaal se leep ki hui gagri, aur khokhle thoonThh mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya. Abu Huraira se poocha gaya: Hantama kya thi? Unhone kaha: Ye hari gagri hai (khaal se leep ki hui).

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to the group of Abd al-Qais: I forbid you (to prepare Nabidh) in gourd. and green pitcher, hollow stump and varnished jar and the waterskin having its upper end cut, but (prepare it) in your small waterskin, and tie its mouth
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abd al-Qais qabile ke giroh se kaha: Main tumhe mana karta hoon (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) kaddu mein, aur hari gagri, khokhle thoonThh, varnish ki hui gagri, aur upari sira kaate hue paani ki thaili mein, lekin (ise taiyaar karo) apni chhoti paani ki thaili mein, aur uska muh baandh do.

e: 'Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade to prepare Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu aur varnish ki hui gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibrahim reported: I said to Aswad if he had asked the Mother of the Believers (in which utensils) he (the Holy Prophet) disapproved the preparation of Nabidh. He (Aswad) said: Yes. I said: Mother of the Believers, inform me about the utensils in which) Allah's Apostle forbade to prepare Nabidh. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: He forbade us, the members of his family, to prepare Nabidh in gourd, or varnished jar. I said to him: Do you remember green pitcher, and pitcher? He said: I narrated to you what I have heard; should I narrate to you which I did not hear?
hi: Ibrahim ne riwayat ki: Maine Aswad se poocha ki kya unhone Momino ki Maa se poocha ki (kin bartano mein) unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) Nabidh taiyaar karna manzoor nahi kiya. Unhone (Aswad ne) kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Momino ki Maa, mujhe (un bartanon ke baare mein) bataiye jinmein Allah ke Rasool ne Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya. Unhone (Hazrat Aisha ne) kaha: Unhone humein, apne khaandaan ke logon ko, kaddu, ya varnish ki hui gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya. Maine unse kaha: Kya aapko hari gagri, aur gagri yaad hai? Unhone kaha: Maine tumhe wahi riwayat ki hai jo maine suna hai; kya mujhe tumhe wahi riwayat karni chahiye jo maine nahi suna?

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar.
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu aur varnish ki hui gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: The above hadith has been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Thumama b. Hazn Al-Qushairi reported: I met 'A'isha and asked her (about the utensils in which) Nabidh (may be prepared). She narrated to me that a group of 'Abd al-Qais came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about Nabidh. He (the Holy Prophet) forbade them to prepare Nabidh in varnished jar, hollow stumps and gourd and green pitcher.
hi: Thumama bin Hazn Al-Qushairi ne riwayat ki: Main Aisha se mila aur unse (un bartanon ke baare mein) poocha (jinmein) Nabidh (taiyaar kiya jaa sakta hai). Unhone mujhe riwayat ki ki Abd al-Qais qabile ka ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poocha: Allah ke Rasool, Nabidh ke baare mein. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe varnish ki hui gagri, khokhle thoonTh aur kaddu aur hari gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding (the preparation of Nabidh) in varnished jar, green pitcher, gourd, and hollow stump,
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko varnish ki hui gagri, hari gagri, kaddu, aur khokhle thoonTh mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana karte hue riwayat ki.

e: Ishaq b. Suwaid reported through the same chain of transmitters but for the difference that he substituted the word" gourd" for" waterskin" (meant for preserving wine).
hi: Ishaq bin Suwaid ne isi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki hai lekin is antar ke saath ki unhone "paani ki thaili" (jo sharaab mahfooz rakhne ke liye hoti hai) ki jagah "kaddu" lafz istemal kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that there came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a group of people from the tribe of 'Abd al-Qais. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them: I forbid you to prepare Nabidh in gourd, in pitcher besmeared with pitch, in hollow stump and in waterskin (meant for preserving wine). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Hammad the word." gourd" has been used in place of" waterskin".
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Abd al-Qais qabile ke kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Main tumhe mana karta hoon Nabidh taiyaar karne se kaddu mein, khaal se leep ki hui gagri mein, khokhle thoonTh mein aur paani ki thaili mein (jo sharaab mahfooz rakhne ke liye hoti hai). Hammad ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein "paani ki thaili" ki jagah "kaddu" lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (preparation of Nabidh) in gourd in pitcher besmeared with pitch, in varnished jar, and in hollow stumps.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu mein, khaal se leep ki hui gagri mein, varnish ki hui gagri mein, aur khokhle thoonThon mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade, the preparation of Nabidh in gourd, in varnished jar, hollow stump and from mixing up ripe dates with nearly ripe dates.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu mein, varnish ki hui gagri mein, khokhle thoonTh mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se, aur pakki khajooron ko lagbhag pakki khajooron ke saath milaane se mana kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (preparation) of Nabidh in gourd, in hollow stump and in varnished jar.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu, khokhle thoonTh aur varnish ki hui gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch).
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd, in pitcher besmeared with green pitch, in hollow stump and in varnished jar.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu mein, hari khaal se leep ki hui gagri mein, khokhle thoonTh mein, aur varnish ki hui gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of) Nabidh, the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Nabidh (taiyaar karne se) mana kiya, baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade drinking in green pitcher, in gourd and in the hollow stump.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri, kaddu aur khokhle thoonTh mein peene se mana kiya.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I bear testimony to the fact that Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas testified to the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd in vessel besmeared with pitch and hollow stump.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas ne is baat ki gawaahi di ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaddu mein, khaal se leep kiye gaye bartan mein aur khokhle thoonTh mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I asked Ibn 'Umar about (the preparation of) Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), whereupon he said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (preparation of) Nabidh in green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). I then came to Ibn Abbas and said: Do you hear what Ibn 'Umar has said? Thereupon he said: What does he say? I said: He stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden the (preparation of) Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), whereupon he said: Ibn 'Umar has told the truth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declared unlawful the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). I said: What is this thing, the Nabidh of a pitcher (Nabidh prepared in a pitcher)? Thereupon, he said: Everything that is prepared in earthen pitcher.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar se hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein (Nabidh ki taiyaari ke) baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri mein (Nabidh ki taiyaari) se mana kiya. Main phir Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur kaha: Kya aap sunte hain jo Ibn Umar ne kaha hai? Isper unhone kaha: Woh kya kehte hain? Maine kaha: Unhone bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein (Nabidh ki taiyaari) se mana kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ibn Umar ne sach kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein Nabidh taiyaar karne ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya. Maine kaha: Ye kya cheez hai, gagri ka Nabidh (gagri mein taiyaar Nabidh)? Isper unhone kaha: Har cheez jo mitti ki gagri mein taiyaar ki jaaye.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed people in one of his expeditions. Ibn 'Umar said: I went forward to him but he went away before I reached him. I asked (the people present there): What did he say? They said that he (the Holy Prophet) had forbidden the preparation of Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni ek muhim ke daurane logon se khitaab kiya. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Main unki taraf aage badha lekin woh chale gaye isse pehle ki main unke paas pahunchoon. Maine (wahan maujood logon se) poocha: Unhone kya kaha? Unhone kaha ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaddu aur varnish ki hui gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar with different chains of transmitters but they have not mentioned: " In one of his expeditions" except Malik and Usama.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Unki ek muhim mein" siwaay Malik aur Usama ke.

e: Thabit reported: I said to Ibn 'Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the preparation of Nabidh in the green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). He said: This is what they stated. I said: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbid this? He said: They said so.
hi: Thabit ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar se kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Ye woh hai jo unhone bataya. Maine kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse mana kiya tha? Unhone kaha: Unhone (logon ne) aisa kaha.

e: A person asked Ibn 'Umar if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). He said: Yes. Then Tawus said: By Allah, I heard it from him.
hi: Ek shakhs ne Ibn Umar se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir Tawus ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine ise unse (khud) suna.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person came to him and said: Did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbid the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch and) in varnished jar? He said: Yes.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) mein aur varnish ki hui gagri mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch) and in varnished jar.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui) aur varnish ki hui gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: Ibrahim b. Maisarah reported that he heard Tawus as saying: I was sitting with Ibn 'Umar when a man came to him, and said: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbid the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), in varnished jar and in gourd? Thereupon he said: Yes.
hi: Ibrahim bin Maisarah ne riwayat ki ki unhone Tawus ko ye kehte suna: Main Ibn Umar ke saath baitha tha jab ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui), varnish ki hui gagri, aur kaddu mein Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya? Isper unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Muharib b. Dithar reported: I heard Ibn 'Umar say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) in a pitcher besmeared with pitch, in gourd, in varnished jar. He said, I heard it from him more than once.
hi: Muharib bin Dithar ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) khaal se leep ki hui gagri mein, kaddu mein, varnish ki hui gagri mein mana kiya. Unhone kaha, Maine ise unse (khud) ek se zyada baar suna.

e: Muharib b. Dithar reported a hadith like this on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through a different chain of transmitters. He (the narrator) said: I think he also made a mention of hollow stump.
hi: Muharib bin Dithar ne isi jaisi ek hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone khokhle thoonTh ka bhi zikr kiya.

e: 'Uqba b. Huraith said: I heard Ibn 'Umar saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), in varnished jar, and in gourd, and he said: Prepare Nabidh in small waterskins.
hi: Uqba bin Huraith ne kaha: Maine Ibn Umar ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui), varnish ki hui gagri, aur kaddu mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya, aur unhone kaha: Choti paani ki thailiyon mein Nabidh taiyaar karo.

e: Jabalah reported: I heard Ibn 'Umar narrating that Allah's messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden (the preparation of Nabidh) in the pitcher besmeared with pitch. I said to him: What is Huntama? He said: It is a pitcher (besmeared with pitch).
hi: Jabala ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar ko ye riwayat karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaal se leep ki hui gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya tha. Maine unse kaha: Huntama kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye ek gagri hai (khaal se leep ki hui).

e: Zadhan reported: I said to Ibn 'Umar: Tell me in your own language and then explain it to me in any language because your language is different from our language (about the vessels) in which Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has forbidden (us) to drink. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden (the preparation) of Nabidh in Hantama and that is a pitcher (besmeared with pitch), in gourd and that is pumpkin, in the varnished jar, in hollow stump and in wooden vessels. This Naqir is the wood of date-palm from which the vessel is fashioned out or hollowed out, but he commanded us to prepare Nabidh in waterskins.
hi: Zadhan ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar se kaha: Mujhe apni khud ki bhaasha mein bataiye aur phir mujhe kisi bhi bhaasha mein samjhaiye kyunki aapki bhaasha humari bhaasha se alag hai (un bartano ke baare mein) jinmein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (humein) peene se mana kiya hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Nabidh (taiyaar karne) se mana kiya Hantama mein aur ye ek gagri hai (khaal se leep ki hui), kaddu mein aur ye ek kaddu hai, varnish ki hui gagri mein, khokhle thoonTh mein aur lakadi ke bartano mein. Ye Naqir khajoor ke darakht ki lakDi hai jismein se bartan banaaya ya khokhla kiya jaata hai, lekin unhone humein paani ki thailiyon mein Nabidh taiyaar karne ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Musayyib reported: I heard 'Abdullah b 'Umar saying this near the pulpit while pointing towards the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): A group of the tribe of 'Abd al-Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about (vessels) which might (be used for preparing Nabidh and) drinking in them. He (the Holy Prophet) forbade them (to use) gourd, hollow stump, vessel besmeared with pitch. I said to him: Abu Muhammad, (what about) varnished jar? and we think he had forgotten to mention the word 'varnished jar". Thereupon he said: I did not hear it from him on that day, i. e. from 'Abdullah b. 'Umar, and he hated that (i. e. preparation of Nabidh in gourd).
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne riwayat ki: Maine Abdullah bin Umar ko mimbar ke qareeb ye kehte suna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar ki taraf ishara karte hue: Abd al-Qais qabile ka ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse un bartano ke baare mein poocha (jinka Nabidh taiyaar karne aur unmein peene ke liye istemal ho sakta hai). Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe kaddu, khokhle thoonTh, khaal se leep ki hui gagri (istemal karne se) mana kiya. Maine unse kaha: Abu Muhammad, (varnish ki hui gagri ke baare mein kya)? Aur humein lagta hai ki woh "varnish ki hui gagri" lafz kehna bhool gaye the. Isper unhone kaha: Maine ise unse us din nahi suna, yaani Abdullah bin Umar se, aur unhe woh (yaani kaddu mein Nabidh taiyaar karna) napasand tha.

e: It is reported on the authority of Jabir and Ibn Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in hollow stump and varnished jar and gourd.
hi: Jabir aur Ibn Umar ki sanad se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khokhle thoonTh, varnish ki hui gagri, aur kaddu mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya.

e: It is reported on the authority of Ibn Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh in) a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch)  and gourd and varnished jar.
hi: Ibn Umar ki sanad se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) hari gagri (khaal se leep ki hui), kaddu, aur varnish ki hui gagri mein mana kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in green pitcher, in varnished jar, in hollow stump, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not find anything to prepare Nabidh in that (i. e. waterskin), it was prepared for him in a big bowl made of stone.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hari gagri, varnish ki hui gagri, khokhle thoonTh mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko usmein (yaani paani ki thaili mein) Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye kuch nahi mila, ye unke liye ek pathhar ke bade kaTore mein taiyaar kiya gaya.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah that Nabidh was prepared for him in a big bowl of stone.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabidh unke liye pathhar ke ek bade kaTore mein taiyaar kiya gaya.

e: Jabir reported that Nabidh was prepared for Allan's Messenger (ﷺ) in a waterskin, but if they did not find waterskin it was prepared in a big bowl of stone. One of the persons and I had heard from Abu Zubair that it was Biram (a vessel made of stone).
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki Nabidh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani ki thaili mein taiyaar kiya jaata, lekin agar unhe paani ki thaili nahi milti to ye pathhar ke ek bade kaTore mein taiyaar kiya jaata. Logon mein se ek aur maine Abu Zubair se suna tha ki ye Biram tha (pathhar se bana ek bartan).

e: 'Abdullah b. Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I had forbidden you from the preparation of Nabidh except in a waterskin. But now you may drink in all vessels, but do not drink what is intoxicant.
hi: Abdullah bin Buraida ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine tumhe Nabidh taiyaar karne se paani ki thaili ke ilawa doosre bartano mein mana kiya tha. Lekin ab tum sab bartano mein pee sakte ho, lekin woh mat piyo jo nashe waala hai.

e: Ibn Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I had forbidden you (from the preparation of Nabidh) and drinking it in certain vessels, (but now you may do so if you like) for it is not vessels or a vessel that makes a thing lawful or unlawful. It is every intoxicant that is unlawful.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine tumhe kuch bartano mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) aur ise peene se mana kiya tha (lekin ab tum aisa kar sakte ho agar tum chaho), kyunki ye bartan ya ek bartan nahi hai jo kisi cheez ko jaayez ya na-jaayez banaata hai. Ye har woh cheez hai jo nashe waali ho jo na-jaayez hai.

e: Ibn Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (may Peace be upon him) as saying: I had forbidden you from the drinking (and preparation of) Nabidh in the vessels made out of leather, but (now) you may drink in all vessels, but you do not drink an intoxicant.
hi: Ibn Buraida ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine tumhe chamde se bane bartano mein Nabidh peene (aur taiyaar karne) se mana kiya tha, lekin (ab) tum sab bartano mein pee sakte ho, lekin nashe waali cheez mat piyo.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in vessels, they said all the people cannot (afford to have) them. He (the Holy Prophet) then granted them permission (to prepare) Nabidh in a green pitcher, but not in those besmeared with pitch.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bartano mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne se) mana kiya, unhone kaha ki sab log unhe (muayyan bartan) afford nahi kar sakte. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir unhe hari gagri mein (Nabidh taiyaar karne ki) ijazat di, lekin un mein nahi jo khaal se leep ki hui hon.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about Bit'i, whereupon he said: Every drink that causes intoxication is forbidden.
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Bit'i ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Har peene ki cheez jo nashe ka wajah banti hai woh mana hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about it, whereupon he said that everything that causes intoxication is forbidden.
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha ki har cheez jo nashe ka wajah banti hai woh mana hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with this chain of transmitters but in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Sufyan and Salih (these words are not found)" she was asked about Bit". (These words are found in the hadith) transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Salih (only these words are found) that she (Hadrat 'A'isha) had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Every intoxicating drink is forbidden.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin Sufyan aur Salih ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (ye alfaaz nahi milte): "Unse Bit ke baare mein poocha gaya." (Ye alfaaz milte hain) Ma'mar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein, aur Salih ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (sirf ye alfaaz milte hain) ki unhone (Hazrat Aisha ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har nashe waali cheez mana hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent me and Mu'adh b. Jabal to Yemen. I said: Allah's Messenger, there is prepared in our land a wine out of barley which is known as Mizr (beer of our times) and a wine from honey which is known as Bit, (are these also forbidden? ), whereupon he said: Every intoxicant is forbidden.
hi: Abu Musa ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe aur Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Yemen bheja. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humari zameen mein jau se banayi jaati hai ek sharaab jise Mizr kaha jaata hai (humare daur ki beer) aur shahad se banayi jaati hai ek sharaab jise Bit kaha jaata hai, (kya ye bhi mana hain?), isper unhone kaha: Har nashe waali cheez mana hai.

e: Abu Burda reported on the authority of his grandfather that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent him and Mu'adh b. Jabal to Yemen and said to them: Give good tidings to the (people). and make things easy (for them), teach (them), and do not repel (them) ; and I think he also said: Cooperate cheerfully with each other. When he (the Holy Prophet) turned his back, Abu Musa returned to him and said: Allah's Messenger, they (the people of Yemen) have a drink which is (made) from honey and which is prepared by cooking it until it coagulates, and Mizr is prepared from barley, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Every intoxicant that detains you from prayer is forbidden.
hi: Abu Burda ne, apne dada ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe aur Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Yemen bheja aur unse kaha: (Logon ko) khushkhabri do, aur (unke liye) cheezein aasaan banao, unhe sikhaao, aur (unhe) khadeD mat karo; aur mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Khushi-khushi ek-doosre ke saath sahyog karo. Jab unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) apni peeth phereri, Abu Musa unke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unke paas (Yemen ke logon ke paas) ek peene ki cheez hai jo shahad se banayi jaati hai aur jise ise tab tak pakaakar taiyaar kiya jaata hai jab tak ye jamm na jaaye, aur Mizr jau se taiyaar ki jaati hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Har nashe waali cheez jo tumhe namaz se roke woh mana hai.

e: Abu Burda reported on the authority of his father: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me and Mu'adh to Yemen saying: Call people (to the path of righteousness) and give good tidings to the (people), and do not repel them, make things easy for them and do not make things difficult. I (Burda) said: Allah's Messenger, give us a religious verdict about two kinds of drinks which we prepare in Yemen. One is Bit' which is prepared from honey; it is a fermented Nabidh and is strong and turns into wine, and (the second is) Mizr which is prepared from millet and barley. Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), who had been gifted with the most eloquent and pithy expressions, said: I forbid you from every intoxicant that keeps you away from prayer.
hi: Abu Burda ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe aur Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja ye kehte hue: Logon ko (achhaai ke raaste ki taraf) bulaao aur (unhe) khushkhabri do, aur unhe khadeD mat karo, unke liye cheezein aasaan banao aur cheezein mushkil mat banao. Maine (Burda ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein do kism ke peene ki cheezon ke baare mein deeni faisla dijiye jo hum Yemen mein taiyaar karte hain. Ek Bit hai jo shahad se taiyaar ki jaati hai; ye ek khameer uThA hua Nabidh hai aur ye tez hai aur sharaab mein badal jaata hai, aur (doosra hai) Mizr jo bajra aur jau se taiyaar kiya jaata hai. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jinhe sabse zyada vaakpatu aur sarthak alfaaz ka gun diya gaya tha, ne kaha: Main tumhe har us nashe waali cheez se mana karta hoon jo tumhe namaz se door rakhti hai.

e: Jabir reported that a person came from Jaishan, a town of Yemen, and he asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about the wine which was drunk in their land and which was prepared from millet and was called Mizr. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked whether that was intoxicating. He said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Every intoxicant is forbidden. Verily Allah the Exalted and Majestic, made a covenant to those who drank intoxicants to make their drink Tinat al-Khabal. They said: Allah's Messenger, what is Tinat a]-Khabal? He said: It is the sweat of the denizens of Hell or the discharge of the denizens of Hell.
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Jaishan se aaya, Yemen ka ek shehar, aur usne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us sharaab ke baare mein poocha jo unki zameen mein pi jaati thi aur jo bajra se taiyaar ki jaati thi aur jise Mizr kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne poocha ki kya woh nashe waali hai. Usne kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Har nashe waali cheez mana hai. Yaqeenan Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne un logon ke saath ek ehad kiya hai jo nashe waali cheezein peete hain ki unhe Tinat al-Khabal peene ko milega. Unhone (sahaba ne) poocha: Allah ke Rasool, Tinat al-Khabal kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Jahannam ke bashindon ka pasina hai ya Jahannam ke bashindon ka rasaav.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Every intoxicant is Khamr and every intoxicant is forbidden. He who drinks wine in this world and dies while he is addicted to it, not having repented, will not be given a drink in the Hereafter.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Har nashe waali cheez Khamr hai aur har Khamr mana hai. Jo is duniya mein sharaab peeta hai aur uski lat mein hi marta hai, bina tauba kiye, use Aakhirat mein peene ki koi cheez nahi di jaayegi.

e: Ibn 'Umar, through another chain of transmitters; reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Every intoxicant is Khamr and every intoxicant is forbidden.
hi: Ibn Umar ne, ek doosri sanad ke zariye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Har nashe waali cheez Khamr hai aur har nashe waali cheez mana hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Musa b. Uqba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Musa bin Uqba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nafi' reported Ibn 'Umar as saying: I do not know this but from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who said: Every intoxicant is Khamr and every Khamr is forbidden.
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Mujhe ye nahi pata siwaay is baat ke ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hai jinhone kaha: Har nashe waali cheez Khamr hai aur har Khamr mana hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who drank (wine) in this world would be deprived of it in the Hereafter.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne is duniya mein sharaab pi use Aakhirat mein isse mehroom kiya jaayega.

e: Ibn 'Umar said: He who drank wine in the world and did not repent would be deprived of it (the pure drink) in the Hereafter. It was said to Malik: Is this hadith Marfu'? He said: Yes.
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Jisne is duniya mein sharaab pi aur tauba nahi ki use Aakhirat mein isse (yaani muqaddas peene ki cheez se) mehroom kiya jaayega. Malik se poocha gaya: Kya ye hadees Marfu hai? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who drank wine in this world will not be provided with pure drink in the Hereafter, except in case he repents.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne is duniya mein sharaab pi use Aakhirat mein muqaddas peene ki cheez nahi di jaayegi, siwaay is baat ke ki usne tauba ki ho.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported this hadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Umar ne ye hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Nabidh was prepared for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the beginning of the night and he would drink it in the morning and the following night and the following day and the night after that up to the afternoon. If anything was left out of that he gave it to his servant, or gave orders for it to be poured out.
