hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye Nabidh raat ki shuruaat mein taiyaar kiya jaata aur woh ise subah aur agli raat aur agle din aur uske baad ki raat dopahar tak peete. Agar usmein se kuch bacha rehta, unhone use apne khaadim ko de diya, ya ise phenkne ka hukum diya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Nabidh was prepared for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the waterskin, Shu'ba said: It was the night of Monday. He drank it on Monday and on Tuesday up to the afternoon, and If anything was left out of it he gave it to his servant or poured it out.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani ki thaili mein Nabidh taiyaar kiya jaata. Shu'ba ne kaha: Ye Somvaar ki raat thi. Unhone ise Somvaar aur Mangalvaar ko dopahar tak piya, aur agar usmein se kuch bacha to unhone apne khaadim ko de diya ya ise phenk diya.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that raisins were steeped in water for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he would drink it on that day and on the next day and on the following day until the evening of the third day. He would then order it to be drunk by (other people) or to be thrown away.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki kishmish Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani mein bhigo di jaati thin aur woh ise us din aur agle din aur uske baad ke din teesre din ki shaam tak peete. Phir woh (doosre logon se) hukum dete ki ise piyein ya phenk dein.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Nabidh was prepared from raisins for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the waterskin and he would drink it on that day and on the next day and the day following and when It was the evening of the third day, and he would drink it and give it to (his Companions) and if something was left over, he threw that away.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Nabidh kishmish se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani ki thaili mein taiyaar kiya jaata aur woh ise us din aur agle din aur uske baad ke din peete, aur jab teesre din ki shaam hoti, woh ise peete aur (apne sahaba ko) dete aur agar kuch bacha rehta, woh ise phenk dete.

e: Yahya Abu 'Umar al-Nakhai reported that some people asked Ibn Abbas about the sale and purchase of wine and its commerce. He asked (them): Are you Muslims? They said, Yes. Thereupon he said: Its sale and purchase and its trade are not permissible. They then asked him about Nabidh and he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out on a journey and then came back and some persons amongst his Companions prepared Nabidh for him in green pitcher, hollow stump and gourd. He commanded it to be thrown away, and it was done accordingly. He then ordered them (to prepare it.) in a waterskin and it was prepared in that by steeping raisins in water, and it was prepared in the night. In the morning he drank out of that and on that day and then the next night, and then on the next day until the evening. He drank and gave others to drink. When it was morning (of the third night) he commanded what was left of that to be thrown away.
hi: Yahya Abu Umar al-Nakhai ne riwayat ki ki kuch logon ne Ibn Abbas se sharaab ki bikri aur khareed aur uske vyaapaar ke baare mein poocha. Unhone (unse) poocha: Kya tum Musalman ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Iski bikri aur khareed aur iska vyaapaar jaayez nahi hai. Unhone phir Nabidh ke baare mein poocha aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar par nikle aur phir wapas aaye aur kuch logon ne unke sahaba mein se unke liye hari gagri, khokhle thoonTh, aur kaddu mein Nabidh taiyaar kiya. Unhone ise phenk dene ka hukum diya, aur aisa kiya gaya. Unhone phir unhe (ise) paani ki thaili mein (taiyaar karne) ka hukum diya aur ye kishmish paani mein bhigokar taiyaar kiya gaya, aur ye raat mein taiyaar kiya gaya. Subah mein unhone usmein se piya aur us din aur phir agli raat aur phir agle din shaam tak. Unhone piya aur doosron ko dene ke liye diya. Jab subah hui (teesri raat ki), unhone jo bacha tha use phenk dene ka hukum diya.

e: Thumama (i. e. Ibn Hazn al-Qushairi) reported: I met 'A'isha and asked her about Nabidh (that was served to the Holy Prophet). 'A'isha called an Abyssinian maid (servant) and said: Ask her (about it) for it was he, who prepared the Nabidh for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Abyssinian (maid-servant) said: I prepared Nabidh for him in a waterskin in the night and tied its mouth and then suspended it; and when it was morning he (the Holy Prophet) drank from it.
hi: Thumama (yaani Ibn Hazn al-Qushairi) ne riwayat ki: Main Aisha se mila aur unse Nabidh (jo Nabi-e-Paak ko serve kiya jaata) ke baare mein poocha. Aisha ne ek Abyssinian laundi (khaadima) ko bulaaya aur kaha: Unse (iske baare mein) poocho kyunki ye woh hi thin jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye Nabidh taiyaar kiya. Abyssinian (laundi) ne kaha: Maine unke liye raat mein paani ki thaili mein Nabidh taiyaar kiya aur uska muh baandha aur phir use latka diya; aur jab subah hui unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) usmein se piya.

e: 'A'isha reported: We prepared Nabidh for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a waterskin, the upper part of which was tied and it (the waterskin) had a hole (in its lower part). We prepared the Nabidh in the morning and he drank it in the evening and we prepared the Nabidh in the night, and he would drink it in the morning.
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye Nabidh paani ki thaili mein taiyaar kiya, jiska upari hissa baandha jaata tha aur usme (uske neechle hisse mein) ek chhed hota tha. Humne subah Nabidh taiyaar kiya aur unhone ise shaam ko piya aur humne raat mein Nabidh taiyaar kiya aur unhone ise subah piya.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Abu Usaid al-Sa'idi invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to his wedding feast, and his wife had been serving them on that day while yet a bride. Sahl said ' Do you know what she served as a drink to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She steeped the dates in water during the night in a big bowl, and when he (the Holy Prophet) had eaten food she served him this drink.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne riwayat ki ki Abu Usaid al-Sa'idi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni shaadi ki daawat par bulaaya, aur unki zauja ne us din unhe serve kiya jabki woh abhi bhi ek dulhan thin. Sahl ne kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko peene ke liye kya serve kiya? Unhone khajooren raat mein paani mein bhigo din ek bade kaTore mein, aur jab unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) khaana khaaya, unhone unhe ye peene ki cheez serve ki.

e: Sahl reported that Abu Usaid al-Sa'idi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same, but he did not mention this: when he had eaten (the food) she gave him this to drink".
hi: Sahl ne riwayat ki ki Abu Usaid al-Sa'idi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Jab unhone (khaana) khaaya, unhone unhe peene ke liye ye diya."

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported (this hadith through another chain of transmitters) and he said (these words): " In a big bowl of stone, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taken the food, she drenched the dates and served (this) especially to him."
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne (ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye) riwayat ki aur unhone (ye alfaaz) kahe: "Ek pathhar ke bade kaTore mein, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaana khaaya, unhone khajooren bhigoyin aur khaas taur par unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) serve kin."

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported: An Arab woman was mentioned before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He commanded Abu Usaid to send a message to her and he (accordingly) sent a message to her. She came and stayed in the fortresses of Banu Sa'idah. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out until he came to her while she was (at that time) sitting with her head downcast. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked to her, she said: I seek refuge with Allah from you. Thereupon he said: I (have decided to) keep you away from me. They (the people near her) said: Do you know who he is? She said: No. They said: He is the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He came to you in order to give you the proposal of marriage. She said: Then I am the most unfortunate woman because of this (i. e. my defiance). Sahl said: Allah's. Messenger (ﷺ) then set forth on that day until he sat in the Saqifa of Banu Sa'idah along with his Companions. He then said to Sahl: Serve us drink. He (Sahl) said: I brought out for them this bowl (containing drink) and served them this. Abu Hazim said: Sahl brought out this cup for us and we also drank from that. Then 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz asked him to give that (cup) as a gift to him and he gave (it to) him as a gift. In the narration of Abu Bakr b. Ishaq (the words) are:" Sahl, serve us drink."
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek Arab aurat ka zikr hua. Unhone Abu Usaid ko payaam bhejne ka hukum diya, aur unhone (uske mutabik) usse payaam bheja. Woh aayi aur Banu Sa'idah ke qilon mein Thehri. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar gaye yahan tak ki woh uske paas pahunche jabki woh (us waqt) baiThi thi apna sar jhukaaye hue. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse baat ki, usne kaha: Main tumse Allah ki panah maangti hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Main tumhe apne se door rakhta hoon (yaani tumhe chhod deta hoon). Unhone (uske paas maujood logon ne) kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai woh kaun hain? Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Woh Allah ke Rasool hain. Woh tumhare paas shaadi ka prastaav lekar aaye. Usne kaha: Phir main is (yaani meri avagya) ki wajah se sabse badnaseeb aurat hoon. Sahl ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir us din tab tak aage badhe jab tak woh apne sahaba ke saath Banu Sa'idah ke Saqifa mein nahi baithe. Phir unhone Sahl se kaha: Humein peene ke liye kuch do. Unhone (Sahl ne) kaha: Main unke liye ye kaTora (usme peene ki cheez) lekar aaya aur unhe ye serve kiya. Abu Hazim ne kaha: Sahl humare liye ye pyaala laaye aur humne bhi usmein se piya. Phir Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ne unse guzaarish ki ki woh ise (pyaale ko) unhe tohfe mein de dein aur unhone ise unhe tohfe mein diya. Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): "Sahl, humein peene ke liye kuch do."

e: Anas reported: I served drink to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in this cup of mine: honey, Nabidh, water and milk.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne is pyaale mein peene ki cheez serve ki: shahad, Nabidh, paani aur doodh.

e: Abu Bakr Siddiq reported: As we went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from Mecca to Medina, we passed by a shepherd and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was feeling thirsty. He (Abu Bakr Siddiq) said: I milked for him a small quantity of milk (from his goat) and brought it to him (the Holy Prophet), and he drank it and I was very happy.
hi: Abu Bakr Siddiq ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah se Madina jaa rahe the, hum ek gadariye ke paas se guzre aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pyaas mehsoos ho rahi thi. Unhone (Abu Bakr Siddiq ne) kaha: Maine unke liye (uski bakri se) thodi si doodh nikaali aur ise unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas laaya, aur unhone ise piya aur main bahut khush hua.

e: Al-Bara' reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forth from Mecca to Medina, Suraqa b. Malik b. Ju'shum pursued him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked curse upon him, and his horse sank (in the desert). He (Suraqa) said: (Allah's Messenger), invoke blessings for me and I will do no harm to you. He (the Holy Prophet) then supplicated Allah. (At that time) he (the Holy Prophet) felt thirsty, and they happened to pass by a shepherd. Abu Bakr Siddiq said: I took hold of a bowl and milked some milk into it for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and gave it to him. He drank it and I was pleased.
hi: Al-Bara ne riwayat ki: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah se Madina ki taraf nikle, Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum ne unka picha kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke khilaaf laanat maangi, aur unka ghoda (registaan mein) dhaans gaya. Unhone (Suraqa ne) kaha: (Allah ke Rasool), mere liye barkatein maangiye aur main aapko koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir Allah se dua ki. (Us waqt) unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) pyaas mehsoos hui, aur woh ek gadariye ke paas se guzre. Abu Bakr Siddiq ne kaha: Maine ek kaTora liya aur usmein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye kuch doodh nikaala aur unhe diya. Unhone ise piya aur main khush hua.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented two cups at Bait al-Maqdis on the night of Heavenly Journey, one containing wine and the other containing milk. He looked at both of them, and be took the one containing milk, whereupon Gabriel (peace be upon him) said: Praise is due to Allah Who guided you to the true nature; had you taken the one containing wine, Your Umma would have gone astray.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Bait al-Maqdis mein Aasmaani Safar ki raat ko do pyaale pesh kiye gaye, ek mein sharaab thi aur doosre mein doodh. Unhone donon ko dekha, aur unhone doodh waala liya, isper Jibril (shanti unpar ho) ne kaha: Tareef ho Allah ki jisne aapko sahi fitrat ki taraf margdarshit kiya; agar aapne sharaab waala liya hota, aapki Ummat gumraah ho gayi hoti.

e: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters, but he did not mention Aelia (Capitolina. i. e. Bait al-Maqdis).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone Aelia (Capitolina, yaani Bait al-Maqdis) ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Humaid Sa'idi reported: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a cup of milk from Naqi' which had no cover over it, whereupon he said: Why did you not cover it? - even if you had covered it only with a stick. Abu Humaid said that he had been ordered that waterskins be tied during the night, and the doors be closed during the night.
hi: Abu Humaid Sa'idi ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Naqi se doodh ka ek pyaala lekar aaya jispar koi Dhakkan nahi tha, isper unhone kaha: Tumne ise Dhaka kyun nahi? Chahe tumne ise sirf ek lakDi se hi Dhaka hota. Abu Humaid ne kaha ki unhe hukum diya gaya tha ki raat mein paani ki thailiyon ko baandha jaaye, aur raat mein darwaze band kiye jaayein.

e: Abu Humaid Sa'idi reported through another chain of transmitters that he brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a cup containing milk, but there is no mention of the word" in the night
hi: Abu Humaid Sa'idi ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas doodh ka ek pyaala laaye, lekin "raat mein" alfaaz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir b 'Abdullah reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he asked for water. A person said: Allah's Messenger, may we not give you Nabidh to drink? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes (you may). He (the narrator) said: Then that person went out speedily and brought a cup containing Nabidh, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why did you not cover it? - even if it is with a wood. He said that then he drank it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the aur unhone paani maanga. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum aapko Nabidh peene ke liye na den? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Haan (tum de sakte ho). Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Phir woh shakhs jaldi se bahar gaya aur Nabidh ka ek pyaala laaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumne ise Dhaka kyun nahi? Chahe ye lakDi se hi ho. Unhone kaha ki phir unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ise piya.

e: Jabir reported that a person who was known as Abu Humaid brought for him (the Holy Prophet) a cup of milk from al-Naqi'. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Why did you not cover it even with a wood across it?
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs jise Abu Humaid kaha jaata tha, unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) liye al-Naqi se doodh ka ek pyaala laaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tumne ise Dhaka kyun nahi chahe ek lakDi ise cross karte hue rakh di hoti?

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Cover vessels, waterskins, close the doors and extinguish the lamps, for the Satan does not loosen the waterskin, does not open the door and does not uncover the vessels. And if one amongst you fails to find (something) to cover it well, he should cover it by placing (a piece of) wood across it. Qutaiba did not mention the closing of the doors in the hadith transmitted by him.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Bartano ko Dhako, paani ki thailiyon ko baandho, darwaze band karo aur diye bujha do, kyunki Shaitaan na to paani ki thaili khol paata hai, na darwaza kholta hai, na bartano se Dhakkan hataata hai. Aur agar tum mein se koi (bartan ko) achhi tarah Dhakne ke liye kuch nahi paata, use ek lakDi cross mein rakhkar Dhak dena chahiye. Qutaiba ne apni riwayat ki hui hadees mein darwaze band karne ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Jabir but with a slight change of wording, and he did not mention the words: " Putting a stick across the vessel."
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath, aur unhone in alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya: "Bartan par ek lakDi cross mein rakhna."

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Shut the doors; the rest of the hadith is the same but with a slight variation of wording: Cover the utensils, and further said: It (the mouse) may set fire to the clothes of the residents of the house.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Darwaze band karo; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath: Bartano ko Dhako, aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Ye (chuha) ghar ke bashindon ke kapdon mein aag laga sakta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words: " The mouse may set the house on fire over its inhabitants."
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath: "Chuha ghar ko uske bashindon ke upar aag laga sakta hai."

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: When the wings of the night (spread) or it is night, restrain your children (from going out), for the Satan is abroad at that time, and when a part of the night is passed, free them and shut the doors. making mention of God's name, for the Satan does not open a closed door; and tighten the (mouths of waterskins and mention the name of Allah, cover your utensils and mention the name of Allah even though you should just put something on them, and extinguish your lamps.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab raat ke pankh (failte) hain ya raat ho jaati hai, apne bachchon ko roko (bahar jaane se), kyunki Shaitaan us waqt bahar hota hai, aur jab raat ka kuch hissa guzar jaata hai, unhe azaad kar do aur darwaze band karo, Allah ka naam lete hue, kyunki Shaitaan band darwaza nahi kholta; aur (paani ki thailiyon ke muh) kaskar baandho aur Allah ka naam lo, apne bartano ko Dhako aur Allah ka naam lo chahe tum unpar sirf kuch rakh do, aur apne diye bujha do.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not let your animals and children go out when the sun sets until the first and the darkest part of the night is over, for the Satan is let loose with the sinking of the sun until the darkest part of the night is over.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Apne jaanwaron aur bachchon ko bahar mat jaane do jab suraj dubta hai jab tak raat ka pehla aur sabse andhera hissa nahi guzar jaata, kyunki Shaitaan suraj dhalne ke saath azaad ho jaata hai jab tak raat ka sabse andhera hissa guzar nahi jaata.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters,
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Cover the vessels and tie the waterskin, for there is a night in a year when pestilence descends, and it does not pass an uncovered vessel or an untied waterskin but some of that pestilence descending into it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Bartano ko Dhako aur paani ki thaili ko baandho, kyunki saal mein ek raat hoti hai jab mahamaari utarti hai, aur ye kisi bhi bina-Dhake bartan ya bina baandhi hui paani ki thaili se nahi guzarti bina kuch mahamaari usmein daale.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Laith b. Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation in wording (and that is that) he (the Holy Prophet) said: There is a day in a year when descends the pestilence; at the end of the hadith Laith said that the non Arabs save themselves from it in Kanun Awwal (this is the month of December).
hi: Ye hadees Laith bin Sa'd ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath (aur woh ye hai ki) unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Saal mein ek din hota hai jab mahamaari utarti hai; hadees ke ant mein Laith ne kaha ki ghair-Arab log isse Kanun Awwal mein bachte hain (ye December ka mahina hai).

e: Salim, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Do not leave the fire burning in your houses when you go to sleep.
hi: Salim ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Apne gharon mein aag jalti na chhodo jab tum sone jaao.

e: Abu Musa reported that a house was burnt down in Medina during the night over its inhabitants. When their matter was reported to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said; This fire is an enemy of yours. So when you go to sleep, extinguish it.
hi: Abu Musa ne riwayat ki ki Madina mein ek ghar raat mein jalkar khaakh ho gaya uske bashindon par. Jab unka maamla Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, unhone kaha: Ye aag tumhari dushman hai, is liye jab tum sone jaao, ise bujha do.

e: Hudhaifa reported: When we attended a dinner along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we did not lay our hands on the food until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had laid his hand and commenced eating (the food). Once we went with him to a dinner when a girl came rushingly as it someone had been pursuing her. She was about to lay her hand on the food, when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) caught her hand. Then a desert Arab came there (rushingly) as if someone had been pursuing him. He (the Holy Prophet) caught his hand; and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Satan considers that food lawful on which Allah's name is not mentioned. He had brought this girl so that the food might be made lawful for him and I caught her hand. And he had brought a desert Arab so that (the food) might be lawful for him. So I caught his hand. By Him, in Whose hand is my life, it was (Satan's) hand that was in my hand along with her hand.
hi: Hudhaifa ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaane par shaamil hote, hum apne haath khaane par tab tak nahi rakhte jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna haath rakhkar khaana shuru na kar dein. Ek baar hum unke saath ek khaane par gaye jab ek larki daudkar aayi jaise koi uska picha kar raha ho. Woh apna haath khaane par rakhne hi waali thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uska haath pakad liya. Phir registaan ka ek Arab wahan aaya (daudkar) jaise koi uska picha kar raha ho. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) uska haath pakada; aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shaitaan uss khaane ko jaayez maanta hai jispar Allah ka naam nahi liya jaata. Woh is larki ko is liye laaya ki khaana uske liye jaayez ho jaaye aur maine uska haath pakad liya. Aur woh registaan ke Arab ko is liye laaya ki (khaana) uske liye jaayez ho jaaye. Is liye maine uska haath pakad liya. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, ye (Shaitaan ka) haath hi tha jo mere haath mein uske haath ke saath tha.

e: Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman reported: When we were invited to a dinner with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of hadith is the same but there is a slight variation of wording (and the variation is) that in that hadith the desert Arab precedes the arrival of that girl, and at the conclusion there is an addition (to this effect):" He (the Holy Prophet) then mentioned the name of Allah and ate."
hi: Hudhaifa bin al-Yaman ne riwayat ki: Jab humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaane ki daawat di gayi; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath (aur badlaav ye hai) ki us hadees mein registaan ka Arab us larki ke aane se pehle aata hai, aur ant mein ek izafa hai (is tarah): "Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir Allah ka naam liya aur khaaya."

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a person enters his house and mentions the name of Allah at the time of entering it and while eating the food, Satan says (addressing himself: You have no place to spend the night and no evening meal; but when he enters without mentioning the name of Allah, the Satan says: You have found a place to spend the night, and when he does not mention the name of Allah while eating food, he (the Satan) says: You have found a place to spend the night and evening meal.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab koi shakhs apne ghar mein daakhil hota hai aur daakhil hote waqt aur khaana khaate waqt Allah ka naam leta hai, Shaitaan (khud se) kehta hai: Tumhare paas raat guzaarne ki koi jagah nahi hai aur na hi shaam ka khaana; lekin jab woh bina Allah ka naam liye daakhil hota hai, Shaitaan kehta hai: Tumhe raat guzaarne ki jagah mil gayi hai, aur jab woh khaana khaate waqt Allah ka naam nahi leta, woh (Shaitaan) kehta hai: Tumhe raat guzaarne ki jagah aur shaam ka khaana dono mil gaye hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah through the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Do not eat with your left hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Apne baaye haath se mat khaao, kyunki Shaitaan apne baaye haath se khaata hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you intends to eat (meal), he should eat with his right hand. and when he (intends) to drink he should drink with his right hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi (khaana) khaane ka iraada karta hai, use apne daaye haath se khaana chahiye, aur jab woh peena chahta hai use apne daaye haath se peena chahiye, kyunki Shaitaan apne baaye haath se khaata hai aur apne baaye haath se peeta hai.

e: This hadith is reported by Zuhri on the authority of Sufyan with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne Sufyan ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki hai.

e: Salim, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should eat with his left hand and drink with that (left hand), for the Satan eats with left hand and drinks with that (hand). Nafi' has made this addition in that:" Do not take up anything with that (left hand) and do not give anything with that" ; and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Tahir there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Salim ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi apne baaye haath se na khaaye aur na hi us (baaye haath) se peeye, kyunki Shaitaan apne baaye haath se khaata hai aur us (baaye haath) se peeta hai. Nafi ne isme ye izafa kiya: "Us (baaye haath) se kuch mat uThAao aur us (baaye haath) se kuch mat do"; aur Abu Tahir ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat mein alfaazon mein halka badlaav hai.

e: Salama b. Akwa' reported on the authority of his father that a person ate in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his left hand, whereupon he said: Eat with your right hand. He said: I cannot do that, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: May you not be able to do that. It was vanity that prevented him from doing it, and he could not raise it (the right hand) up to his mouth.
hi: Salama bin Akwa ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein apne baaye haath se khaaya, isper unhone kaha: Apne daaye haath se khaao. Usne kaha: Main aisa nahi kar sakta, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Kaash tum aisa na kar sako. Ye ghamand tha jisne use aisa karne se roka, aur woh use (yaani daaya haath) apne munh tak nahi uThA saka.

e: 'Umar b. Abu Salama reported: I was under the care of Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), and as my hand used to roam about in the dish he said to me: Boy, mention the name of Allah, and eat with your right hand and eat from what is near to you.
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki dekhbhaal mein tha, aur chunki mera haath thaali mein idhar-udhar ghoomta tha, unhone mujhse kaha: Bete, Allah ka naam lo, aur apne daaye haath se khaao aur woh khaao jo tumhare qareeb hai.

e: Umar b. Abu Salama reported: I (had the opportunity) one day to dine with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I picked up flesh from around the dish. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Eat from that which is near to you.
hi: Umar bin Abu Salama ne riwayat ki: Mujhe (mauka mila) ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaane ka, aur maine thaali ke aas-paas se gosht uThAya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh khaao jo tumhare qareeb hai.

e: Abu Sa'id (Khudri) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from its mouth.
hi: Abu Sa'id (Khudri) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani ki thailiyon ko ulTa karke unke munh se peene se mana kiya.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's, Messenger (may peace he upon him) forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from their mouths.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani ki thailiyon ko ulTa karke unke munh se peene se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported from Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but he also said that Ikhtinath means that its head (i. e., of the waterskin) be turned upside down and then (water) be drank from that.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone ye bhi kaha ki Ikhtinath ka matlab hai ki iska (paani ki thaili ka) sir neeche ki taraf mode aur phir (paani) usmein se piya jaaye.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) disapproved the drinking of water while standing.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hokar paani peene ko manzoor nahi karte the.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade that a person should drink while standing. Qatada reported: We said to him: What about eating? Thereupon he (Anas) said: That is even worse and more detestable (abominable).
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki koi shakhs khade hokar peene. Qatada ne riwayat ki: Humne unse kaha: Khaane ke baare mein kya? Isper unhone (Anas ne) kaha: Ye aur bhi bura aur zyada ghinaunA hai.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Anas with a different chain of transmitters, but no mention is made of the words of Qatada.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Qatada ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) warned against drinking while standing.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khade hokar peene ke khilaaf chetaavni di.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters but with a slight, variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should drink while standing; and if anyone forgets, he must vomit.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi khade hokar na peeye; aur agar koi bhool jaaye, use ulti karni chahiye.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: I served. (water of) Zamzam to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he drank it while standing.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Zamzam (ka paani) serve kiya, aur unhone ise khade hokar piya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank (water) from Zamzam in a bucket while he was standing.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zamzam se ek balti mein (paani) piya jabki woh khade the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) drank (water) from Zamzam while he was standing.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zamzam se (paani) piya jabki woh khade the.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I served (water from) Zamzam to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he drank while standing, and he asked for it while he was near the House (i. e. House of Allah-Ka'ba).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Zamzam (ka paani) serve kiya, aur unhone khade hokar piya, aur unhone ise us waqt maanga jab woh Ghar (yaani Allah ke Ghar, Kaaba) ke qareeb the.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade breathing in a vessel.
hi: Abu Qatada ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bartan mein saans lene se mana kiya.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to breathe three times in the course of a drink (i. e. he drank in three gulps).
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek peene ke daurane teen baar saans lete the (yaani woh teen ghunT mein peete the).

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) breathed three times (outside the vessel) in the course of a drink and said: It is more thirst- quenching, healthier and more wholesome. Anas said: So I also breathe three times in the course of a drink.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek peene ke daurane teen baar (bartan se bahar) saans lete the aur kehte the: Ye zyada pyaas bujhaane wala, zyada sehatmand, aur zyada laabhkaari hai. Anas ne kaha: Is liye main bhi ek peene ke daurane teen baar saans leta hoon.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Anas with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a cup of milk mixed with water, while there was on his right a desert Arab and on his left Abu Bakr. He (the Holy Prophet) drank; he then gave it to the desert Arab and said: (Give to one) who is on the right, then again who is on the right.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas paani mein milaya hua doodh ka ek pyaala laaya gaya, jabki unke daaye taraf ek registaan ka Arab tha aur baaye taraf Abu Bakr the. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) piya; phir unhone ise registaan ke Arab ko diya aur kaha: (Us shakhs ko do) jo daaye taraf hai, phir jo (uske baad) daaye taraf hai.

e: Anas reported: The Apostle of Allah (may peace he upon him) came to Medina when I was ten years old and he died when I was twenty years old. My mother exhorted me to serve him. He (the Holy Prophet) came to our house, and we ruined a flabby goat for him and mixed it (the milk) with water from the well of the house. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank that. Umar and Abu Bakr on his left side said to him: Allah's Messenger, give it to Abu Bakr, but he (the Holy Prophet) gave it to the desert Arab who was on his right. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who is on the right, then he who is on the right.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye jab main das saal ka tha aur unka intiqaal hua jab main bees saal ka tha. Meri maa ne mujhe unki khidmat karne ke liye protsaahit kiya. Woh (Nabi-e-Paak) humare ghar aaye, aur humne unke liye ek dubli-patli bakri ka doodh nikaala aur ise ghar ke kuen ke paani se milaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise piya. Umar aur Abu Bakr, jo unki baayi taraf the, ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise Abu Bakr ko do, lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ise registaan ke Arab ko diya jo unki daayi taraf tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo daaye taraf hai, phir jo daaye taraf hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to our house and he asked for a drink. We milked a goat for him and then mixed it (the milk) with the water of this well of mine. I gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he drank it, while Abu Bakr was on his left and 'Umar was in front of him, and a desert Arab was on his right. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the drink, Umar said: Allah's Messenger, here is Abu Bakr, give him to drink; but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave it to the desert Arab and he left out Abu Bakr and Umar. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Those on the right, those on the right, those on the right (deserve preference). Anas said: This is the Sunnah, this is the Sunnah, this is the Sunnah.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare ghar aaye aur unhone peene ki cheez maangi. Humne unke liye ek bakri ka doodh nikaala aur phir ise mere is kuen ke paani se milaaya. Maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko diya aur unhone ise piya, jabki Abu Bakr unki baayi taraf the aur Umar unke saamne the, aur ek registaan ka Arab unki daayi taraf tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) peene se farigh hue, Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, yahan Abu Bakr hain, unhe peene ke liye do; lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise registaan ke Arab ko diya aur Abu Bakr aur Umar ko chhoD diya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh jo daayi taraf hain, woh jo daayi taraf hain, woh jo daayi taraf hain (tarjeeh ke haqdaar hain). Anas ne kaha: Ye Sunnat hai, ye Sunnat hai, ye Sunnat hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd Sa'idi reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given a drink, and he drank from that, and there was on his right side a boy. and on his left some old men. He said to the boy: Do you permit me to give it to them (the old men), but that boy said: by God. I will not give preference at your hand over me in my share. He (the narrator) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then gave it in his hand.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd Sa'idi ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko peene ki cheez di gayi, aur unhone usmein se piya, aur unki daayi taraf ek larka tha, aur baayi taraf kuch boodhe log the. Unhone larke se kaha: Kya tum mujhe ye unhe (boodhe logon ko) dene ki ijazat dete ho, lekin us larke ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main apne hisse mein apne upar aapke haath se koi tarjeeh nahi dunga. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir ise uske haath mein rakh diya.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him.) as saying: When any one of you eats food he should not wipe his hand until he has licked it or has it licked*.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi khaana khaata hai use apna haath tab tak nahi poonchhna chahiye jab tak usne ise chaat na liya ho ya kisi doosre se chaatvaa na liya ho.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you eats food he should not wipe his hand until he has licked it or have it licked.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi khaana khaata hai use apna haath tab tak nahi poonchhna chahiye jab tak usne ise chaat na liya ho ya kisi doosre se chaatvaa na liya ho.

e: Ibn Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) licking his three fingers (after having finished the food). Ibn Hatim made no mention of" three". This hadith is also narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Ka'b bin Malik ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni teen ungliyaan chaatte dekha (khaana khatm karne ke baad). Ibn Hatim ne "teen" ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to eat (food) with three fingers and he licked his hand before wiping it (with towel).
hi: Ibn Ka'b bin Malik ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) teen ungliyon se (khaana) khaate the aur woh apne haath ko chaate the ise (taule se) poonchhne se pehle.

e: 'Abdullah b. Ka'b reported that his father Ka'b narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to eat with three fingers and when he had finished (eating), he licked them.
hi: Abdullah bin Ka'b ne riwayat ki ki unke waalid Ka'b ne unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) teen ungliyon se khaate the aur jab woh (khaana) khatm karte, woh unhe chaatte.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Ka'b b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ka'b bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the licking of fingers and the dish, saying: You do not know in what portion the blessing lies."
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ungliyaan aur thaali chaatne ka hukum diya, ye kehte hue: Tumhe nahi pata ki kis hisse mein barkat hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you drops a mouthful he should pick it up and remove any of the filth on it, and then eat it, and should not leave it for the Satan, and should not wipe his hand with towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi apna nivaala girata hai use use uThA lena chahiye aur usmein se koi bhi gandagi hataa deni chahiye, aur phir use khaana chahiye, aur use Shaitaan ke liye nahi chhodna chahiye, aur use apna haath taule se poonchhna nahi chahiye jab tak usne apni ungliyaan chaat na li hon, kyunki use nahi pata ki khaane ke kis hisse mein barkat hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The Satan is present with any one of you in everything he does; he is present even when he eats food; so if any one of you drops a mouthful he should remove away anything filthy on it and eat it and not leave for the devil; and when he finishes (food) he should lick his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of his food the blessing lies.
hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Shaitaan tum mein se har ek ke saath maujood hota hai har cheez mein jo woh karta hai; woh us waqt bhi maujood hota hai jab woh khaana khaata hai; is liye agar tum mein se koi apna nivaala girata hai use usmein se koi bhi gandagi hataa deni chahiye aur use khaana chahiye aur Shaitaan ke liye nahi chhodna chahiye; aur jab woh (khaana) khatm karta hai use apni ungliyaan chaatni chahiye, kyunki use nahi pata ki uske khaane ke kis hisse mein barkat hai.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words but no mention is made of the first part of the hadith, i. e. the Satan is present with any one of you.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath, lekin hadees ke pehle hisse ka koi zikr nahi hai, yaani Shaitaan tum mein se har ek ke saath maujood hota hai.

e: Jabir reported from Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) about mentioning the licking (of fingers) and the (falling of) the mouthful.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ungliyaan chaatne aur nivaale (girne) ka zikr riwayat kiya.

e: Anas reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate food he licked his three fingers, and he said: When any one of you drops a mouthful he should remove anything filthy from it and then eat it, and should not leave it for the Satan. He also commanded us that we should wipe the dish saying: You do not know in what portion of your food the blessing lies.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaana khaate woh apni teen ungliyaan chaatte, aur unhone kaha: Jab tum mein se koi apna nivaala girata hai use usmein se koi bhi gandagi hataa deni chahiye aur phir use khaana chahiye, aur use Shaitaan ke liye nahi chhodna chahiye. Unhone humein ye bhi hukum diya ki hum thaali poonch dein ye kehte hue: Tumhe nahi pata ki tumhare khaane ke kis hisse mein barkat hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you eats food he should lick his fingers, for he does not know in what part of the food sticking to his fingers the blessing lies.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi khaana khaata hai use apni ungliyaan chaatni chahiye, kyunki use nahi pata ki khaane ke us hisse mein jo uski ungliyon se chipka hai kis hisse mein barkat hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hammad with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hammad ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

e: Abu Mas'ud Ansari reported that a person from the Ansar who was called Abu Shu'aib had a slave who was a butcher (by profession). He (Abu Mas'ud) saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and found signs of hunger on his face. He said to the servant: 0 ye, prepare for us food sufficient for five persons, for I intend to invite Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who would be the fifth amongst the five. He (the narrator) reported that he then prepared the food and came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and invited all the five (including him) who was the fifth amongst them to the feast. A man followed him and when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reached the door, he said: This man has followed us; if you like you may permit him (to join the meal) and if you like he can go back. Thereupon the person said: Allah's Messenger, I permit him.
hi: Abu Mas'ud Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs jise Abu Shu'aib kaha jaata tha, unka ek ghulam tha jo qassab (peshewar) tha. Unhone (Abu Mas'ud ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha aur unke chehre par bhookh ke nishaan paaye. Unhone khaadim se kaha: Aye tum, humare liye paanch logon ke laayak khaana taiyaar karo, kyunki mera iraada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bulaane ka hai jo paanch mein se paanchvaan honge. Unhone (raawi ne) riwayat ki ki unhone (ghulam ne) phir khaana taiyaar kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur sab paanch logon (jinmein woh khud shaamil the) ko daawat par bulaaya jinmein se woh paanchvaan the. Ek shakhs unke peeche gaya aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) darwaze par pahunche, unhone kaha: Ye shakhs humare peeche aaya hai; agar tum chaho to use (khaane mein shaamil hone ki) ijazat de sakte ho aur agar tum chaho woh wapas jaa sakta hai. Isper us shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main use ijazat deta hoon.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Mas'ud Ansari through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Mas'ud Ansari ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir also.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a Persian neighbour who made excellent soup. He prepared some for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then came to him to invite him to eat. He (Allah's Messenger) said, "and her too," referring to `Aisha. The man said "No," so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said "No." He returned later to invite him again, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "and her too." The man said "No," so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said "No." He returned another time to invite him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "and her too." The man said yes on this third occasion, and they then stood eagerly to go out together to the man's home.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek Farsi padosi tha jo bahut acchi shorba banaate the. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye kuch taiyaar ki aur phir unke paas aaye unhe khaane ke liye bulaate hue. Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha, "Aur unhe bhi," Aisha ka zikr karte hue. Us shakhs ne kaha "Nahi," is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir kaha "Nahi." Woh baad mein unhe dobara bulaane wapas aaye, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha "Aur unhe bhi." Us shakhs ne kaha "Nahi," is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir kaha "Nahi." Woh unhe bulaane ek aur baar wapas aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, "Aur unhe bhi." Us shakhs ne is teesre avasar par "haan" kaha, aur woh phir uThe bahar jaane ke liye khushi-khushi saath us shakhs ke ghar.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out (of his house) one day or one night, and there he found Abu Bakr and 'Umar also. He said: What has brought you out of your houses at this hour? They said: Allah's Messenger, it is hunger. Thereupon he said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, what has brought you out has brought me out too; get up. They got up along with him. and (all of them) came to the house of an Ansari, but he was not at home. When his wife saw him she said: Most welcome, and Allah's Messenger (may peace be Upon him) said to her: Where is so and so? She said: He has gone to get some fresh water for us. When the Ansari came and he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his two Companions, he said: Praise be to Allah, no one has more honourable guests today than I (have). He then went out and brought them a bunch of ripe dates, dry dates and fresh dates, and said: Eat some of them. He then took hold of his long knife (for slaughtering a goat or a sheep). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Beware of killing a milch animal. He slaughtered a sheep for them and after they had eaten of it and of the bunch and drank, and when they had taken their fill and had been fully satisfied with the drink, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Bakr and Umar: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, you will certainly be questioned about this bounty on the Day of judgment. Hunger brought you out of your house, then you did not return until this bounty came to you.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din (apne ghar se) bahar gaye ya ek raat, aur wahan unhone Abu Bakr aur Umar ko bhi paaya. Unhone kaha: Kya cheez tumhe is waqt apne gharon se bahar laayi? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye bhookh hai. Isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, jo tumhe bahar laaya hai woh mujhe bhi bahar laaya hai; uTho. Woh unke saath uThe. (Sab) ek Ansari ke ghar aaye, lekin woh ghar par nahi the. Jab unki zauja ne unhe dekha, unhone kaha: Khush aamdeed, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Falan-falan kahan hai? Usne kaha: Woh humare liye kuch taaza paani laane gaye hain. Jab Ansari aaye aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke do sahaba ko dekha, unhone kaha: Tareef ho Allah ki, aaj kisi ke paas mujhse zyada izzatdaar mehmaan nahi hain. Woh phir bahar gaye aur unke liye pakki khajooren, sookhi khajooren aur taazi khajooron ka guchcha laaye, aur kaha: Isme se kuch khaao. Unhone phir apni lambi chaaku pakadi (ek bakri ya bhed zibah karne ke liye). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Doodh dene wale jaanwar ko maarne se bacho. Unhone unke liye ek bhed zibah kiya aur unke isse aur guchche se khaane aur peene ke baad, aur jab woh poori tarah santusht ho gaye aur peene ki cheez se poori tarah santusht ho gaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr aur Umar se kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, tumse zaroor is nemat ke baare mein Qayamat ke din poocha jaayega. Bhookh ne tumhe apne ghar se bahar laaya, phir tum wapas nahi gaye jab tak ye nemat tumhare paas nahi aayi.

e: Abu Huraira reported: One day while Abu Bakr was sitting and there was with him Umar also there came to them Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: What makes you stay here? They said: It is hunger that has brought us out from our houses. By Him Who has stint you with Truth; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki: Ek din jab Abu Bakr baithe hue the aur unke saath Umar bhi the wahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur unhone kaha: Tumhe yahan kya roke hue hai? Unhone kaha: Ye bhookh hai jo humein humare gharon se bahar laayi. Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath izzat di; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: When the ditch was dug, I saw Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) feeling very hungry. I came to my wife and said to her: Is there anything with you? I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) feeling extremely hungry. She brought out a bag of provisions which contained a sa', of barley. We had also with us a lamb. I slaughtered it. She ground the flour. She finished (this work) along with me. I cut it into pieces and put it in the earthen pot and then returned to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (for inviting him). She said: Do not humiliate me in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and those who are with him. When I came to him I whispered to him saying: Allah's Messenger, we have slaughtered a lamb for you and she has ground a sa' of barley which we had with us. So you come along with a group of people with you. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said loudly: O people of the ditch, Jabir has arranged a feast for you, so (come along). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not remove your earthen pot from the hearth and do not bake the bread from the kneaded flour until I come. So I came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and he was ahead of the people; and I came to my wife and she said (to me): You will be humbled. I said: I did what you had asked me to do. She (his wife) said: I brought out the kneaded flour and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put some saliva of his in that and blessed It. He then put saliva in the earthen pot and blessed it and then said. Call another baker who can bake with you. and bring out the soup from it, but do not remove it from the hearth, and the guests were one thousand. (Jabir said): I take an oath by Allah that all of them ate (the food to their fill) until they left it and went away and our earthen pot was brimming over as before, and so was the case with our flour, or as Dahhak (another narrator) said: It (the flour) was in the same condition and loaves had been prepared from that.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Jab khaai khodi gayi, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bahut zyada bhookh mehsoos karte dekha. Main apni zauja ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Kya tumhare paas kuch hai? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bahut bhookh mehsoos karte dekha hai. Unhone rozi ka ek thaila nikaala jismein ek sa jau tha. Humare paas ek bhed bhi tha. Maine use zibah kiya. Unhone aata pisa. Unhone (ye kaam) mere saath khatm kiya. Maine ise (gosht) tukdon mein kaata aur ise mitti ke bartan mein rakha aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya (unhe bulaane ke liye). Unhone (meri zauja ne) kaha: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke saath ke logon ke saamne sharminda mat karna. Jab main unke paas aaya maine unse chupke se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humne aapke liye ek bhed zibah kiya hai aur unhone humare paas jo jau tha uska ek sa pisa hai. Is liye aap logon ke ek giroh ke saath aayein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne buland aawaaz mein kaha: Aye khaai ke logo, Jabir ne tumhare liye ek daawat rakhi hai, is liye (chalo). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne mitti ke bartan ko chulhe se mat hataao aur roti ka aata mat sekno jab tak main na aaun. To main aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur woh logon se aage the; aur main apni zauja ke paas aaya aur unhone (mujhse) kaha: Tumhe apmaanit kiya jaayega. Maine kaha: Maine woh kiya jo tumne mujhse kaha tha. Unhone (unki zauja ne) kaha: Maine gundhaa hua aata nikaala aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna kuch laar usmein daali aur ise barkat di. Phir unhone mitti ke bartan mein laar daali aur ise barkat di aur phir kaha. Ek aur baker (nan banane wala) bulaao jo tumhare saath baker sake, aur usmein se shorba nikaalo, lekin ise chulhe se mat hataao, aur mehmaan hazaar the. (Jabir ne kaha): Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki un sab ne khaaya (khaana apni tripti tak) yahan tak ki woh ise chhodkar chale gaye aur humara mitti ka bartan pehle jaisa hi bhara hua tha, aur waisa hi humara aata bhi tha, ya jaisa Dahhak (ek doosre raawi) ne kaha: Ye (aata) usi haalat mein tha aur usmein se roti taiyaar ki gayi thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Abu Talha said to Umm Sulaim: I felt some feebleness in the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and perceived that it was due to hunger; so have you anything with you? She said: Yes. She brought out barley loaves, then took out a head-covering of hers, in a part of which she wrapped those loaves and then put them beneath my mantle and covered me with a part of it. She then sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I set forth and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sitting in the mosque in the company of some persons. I stood near them, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Has Abu Talha sent you? I said, Yes. He said: Is it for a feast? I said. Yes. Thereupon Allah's messenger (ﷺ) said to'those who were with him to get up He went forth and so I did before them, until I came to Abu Talha and informed him. Abu Talba said: Umm Sulaim, here comes Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with people and we do not have enough (food) to feed them. She said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Abu Talha went out (to receive him) Until he met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came forward along with him until they both (Allah's Messenger, along with Abu Talha) came in. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Umm Sulaim. bring forth that which you have with you. She brought the bread. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that the bread be broken into small pieces, and when Umm Sulaim had squeezed a small waterskin and put seasoning on it, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited something regarding it what Allah wished him to say. He then said: Allow ten (guests to come in and have their meals). He permitted them; they ate until they had their fill. They then went out. He (the Holy Prophet) again said: Permit ten (more) and he (the host gave permission to them. They ate until they had enough. Then they went out. he again said: Permit ten (more) until all the people had eaten to their fill, and they were seventy or eighty persons.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Abu Talha ne Umm Sulaim se kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aawaaz mein kuch kamzori mehsoos ki aur samjha ki ye bhookh ki wajah se hai; is liye kya tumhare paas kuch hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone jau ki rotiyaan nikaali, phir apna sar ka kapda nikaala, jiske ek hisse mein unhone in rotiyon ko lapeta aur phir unhe mere chogha ke neeche rakha aur mujhe uske ek hisse se dhaka. Unhone phir mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja. Main nikla aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko masjid mein kuch logon ki sohbat mein baithe paaya. Main unke qareeb khada hua, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya Abu Talha ne tumhe bheja hai? Maine kaha, Haan. Unhone kaha: Kya ye daawat ke liye hai? Maine kaha, Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse jo unke saath the uThne ko kaha. Woh bahar gaye aur main unse pehle gaya, yahan tak ki main Abu Talha ke paas aaya aur unhe bataaya. Abu Talha ne kaha: Umm Sulaim, ye rahe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke saath aa rahe hain aur humare paas unhe khilaane ke liye kaafi (khaana) nahi hai. Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Abu Talha (unka svaagat karne) bahar gaye yahan tak ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath aage aaye yahan tak ki woh dono (Allah ke Rasool, Abu Talha ke saath) andar aaye. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Umm Sulaim, jo tumhare paas hai woh laao. Woh roti laayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki roti ko chhote tukdon mein toDa jaaye, aur jab Umm Sulaim ne ek choti paani ki thaili nichodi aur usper masaala Dala, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske baare mein kuch padha jo Allah unse kehna chahta tha. Unhone phir kaha: Das (mehmaanon ko aane aur apna khaana khaane) ki ijazat do. Unhone unhe ijazat di; unhone tab tak khaaya jab tak woh poori tarah santusht ho gaye. Phir woh bahar gaye. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir kaha: Das aur ki ijazat do aur unhone (mezbaan ne) unhe ijazat di. Unhone tab tak khaaya jab tak unhe kaafi ho gaya. Phir woh bahar gaye. Unhone phir kaha: Das aur ki ijazat do yahan tak ki sab logon ne apni tripti tak khaa liya, aur woh sattar ya assi log the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Abu Talha sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in order to invite him (for meal). She had prepared a meal. So I came and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with some people. He looked at me, and I felt shy and said: Accept the invitation of Abu Talha. He (the Holy Prophet) asked the people to get up. Thereupon Abu Talha said: Allah's Messenger, I have prepared something for you. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touched (the food) and invoked blessings upon it, and then said: Let ten persons from my Companions enter (the house). He then said: Eat, and (in the meanwhile) brought out something from between his fingers for them. They then began to eat until they had their fill and then went out. He then asked ten more men (to have the meal) and they ate to their fill, and the ten persons went on getting in (and eating the food) and then getting out until none was left amongst them who had not got in and eaten to his fill. He then collected (the remaining part of the food) and it (the quantity of the food) was the same (as it had been prior to the serving of guests).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Abu Talha ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja unhe (khaane ke liye) bulaane. Unhone (Umm Sulaim ne) ek khaana taiyaar kiya tha. To main aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kuch logon ke saath paaya. Unhone mujhe dekha, aur mujhe sharminda mehsoos hua aur maine kaha: Abu Talha ki daawat qubool kariye. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) logon se uThne ko kaha. Isper Abu Talha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aapke liye kuch taiyaar kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (khaane ko) chhua aur uspar barkatein maangi, aur phir kaha: Mere sahaba mein se das aadmiyon ko andar aane do. Unhone phir kaha: Khaao, aur (isi beech) unke liye apni ungliyon ke beech se kuch nikaala. Woh phir khaana shuru karte yahan tak ki woh poori tarah santusht ho jaate aur phir bahar chale jaate. Unhone phir das aur logon ko (khaana khaane) ke liye poocha aur unhone apni tripti tak khaaya, aur das log andar aate rehte (aur khaana khaate) aur phir bahar jaate yahan tak ki koi bhi baaki nahi bacha jo andar nahi aaya tha aur apni tripti tak nahi khaaya tha. Unhone phir (khaane ka baaki hissa) ikattha kiya aur ye (khaane ki maqdaar) waisa hi tha (jaisa mehmaanon ko serve karne se pehle tha).

e: Anas b Malik reported: Abu Talha sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same, but 'there is a slight variation of wording that he said at the end (The Holy Prophet) took what was left (of the food) and collected it and then invoked blessings upon it and it returned to its original state. He (the Holy Prophet) then said Take this.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Abu Talha ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin isme alfaazon mein halka badlaav hai ki unhone ant mein kaha (Nabi-e-Paak ne) jo bacha tha (khaane mein se) use liya aur ise ikattha kiya aur phir uspar barkatein maangi aur ye apni asal haalat mein waapas aa gaya. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir kaha: Ise lo.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Abu Talha ordered Umm Sulaim to prepare a meal specially for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He then sent me to him (to the Holy Prophet) ; the rest of the hadith is the same (but there is a slight variation of wording):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) placed his hand and mentioned the name of Allah upon that, and then said: Admit ten men. He (Abu Talha) admitted them and they got in. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Eat while mentioning the name of Allah upon it (the meal). They ate until eighty persons had taken the food. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had his meal and so the members of the household, and still they left some food."
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Abu Talha ne Umm Sulaim ko khaas taur par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye ek khaana taiyaar karne ka hukum diya. Unhone phir mujhe unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas bheja; baaki hadees waisi hi hai (lekin alfaazon mein halka badlaav hai): "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath rakha aur uspar Allah ka naam liya, aur phir kaha: Das aadmiyon ko andar aane do. Unhone (Abu Talha ne) unhe andar aane diya aur woh andar gaye. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Khaao aur uspar Allah ka naam lete rahiye (khaane par). Unhone khaaya yahan tak ki assi log khaana kha chuke. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna khaana khaaya aur ghar ke logon ne bhi, aur phir bhi unhone kuch khaana baaki chhoda."

e: Anas b. Malik reported this incident pertaining to the feast given by Abu Talha to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with the addition of these words: " Abu Talha stood at the door (to welcome the honourable guest) until Allah's Messenger (may peacec be upon him) came there, He (Abu Talha) said to him: Allah's Messenger, the thing (we intend to offer you as a meal) is small in quantity. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Bring that, for Allah will soon bless it (and increase it).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne ye ghatna Abu Talha ke zariye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko di gayi daawat ke baare mein riwayat ki in alfaazon ke izafe ke saath: "Abu Talha darwaze par khade rahe (izzatdaar mehmaan ka swaagat karne ke liye) jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan nahi aaye. Unhone (Abu Talha ne) unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, cheez (jo hum aapko khaane ke soorat mein pesh karna chahte hain) maqdaar mein choti hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ise laao, kyunki Allah jald hi ise barkat dega (aur ise badhaayega)."

e: Anas b. Malik reported this hadith (with a slight variation of wording) Then AlIah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate and the people of his house also ate. but (still) there was left a surplus, which they sent to their neighbours.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne ye hadees riwayat ki (alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath) ki phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaaya aur unke ghar ke logon ne bhi khaaya, lekin (phir bhi) kuch atirikt bach gaya, jise unhone apne padosiyon ko bheja.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Abu Talha saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying down upon his belly in the mosque. He came to Umm Sulaim and said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying down upon the belly in the mosque, and I think he is hungry. The rest of the hadith is the same (but with the addition of these words) that Allah's messenger (ﷺ) ate (the food) and so did Abu Talha, Umm Sulaim and Anas b. Malik, but there was left some. thing which we presented to our neighbours.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Abu Talha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko masjid mein apne pait ke bal leta hua dekha. Woh Umm Sulaim ke paas aaye aur kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko masjid mein pait ke bal leta hua dekha, aur mujhe lagta hai unhe bhookh lagi hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai (lekin in alfaazon ke izafe ke saath) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khaaya aur Abu Talha, Umm Sulaim aur Anas bin Malik ne bhi khaaya, lekin kuch bacha reh gaya jo humne apne padosiyon ko pesh kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day and found him sitting in the company of his Companions and talking to them, and he had tied his belly with a bandage. Usama said: I am in doubt whether there was stone on that (his belly) or not. I asked some of his Companions why Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had bandaged his belly. They said: (He has done that to relieve) his hunger. I went to Abu Talha, the husband of Umm Sulaim, the daughter of Milhan, and said to him: Father, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having bandaged his belly. I asked some of his Companions (the reason of it) and they said that it was due to hunger. Abu Talha came to mv mother and said: Is there anything? She said: Yes, I have some pieces of bread with me and some dates. If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) comes to us alone we can feed him to his fill, but if someone comes along with him this would be insufficient for them. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaya aur unhe apne sahaba ki sohbat mein baithe aur unse baat karte paaya, aur unhone apne pait ko ek paTTi se baandh rakha tha. Usama ne kaha: Mujhe shak hai ki uspar (unke pait par) koi patthar tha ya nahi. Maine unke sahaba mein se kuchse poocha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna pait kyun baandh rakha tha. Unhone kaha: (Unhone aisa kiya) unki bhookh se rahat paane ke liye. Main Abu Talha, Umm Sulaim ke shohar, Milhan ki beti, ke paas gaya, aur unse kaha: Waalid, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apna pait baandhe hue dekha. Maine unke kuch sahaba se (iski wajah) poochi aur unhone kaha ki ye bhookh ki wajah se hai. Abu Talha meri maa ke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya kuch hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, mere paas roti ke kuch tukde hain aur kuch khajooren. Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) akele humare paas aate hain hum unhe unki tripti tak khila sakte hain, lekin agar koi unke saath aata hai to ye unke liye kaafi nahi hoga. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported this hadith pertaining to the entertainment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) by Abu Talha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne ye hadees Abu Talha ke zariye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki mehmaannawaazi ke baare mein ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: A tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared. Anas b. Malik said: I went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to that feast. He presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) barley bread and soup containing pumpkin, and sliced pieces of meat. Anas said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) going after the pumpkin round the dish, so I have always liked the pumpkin since that day.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Ek darzi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek khaane ki daawat di jo unhone taiyaar kiya tha. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath us daawat par gaya. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jau ki roti aur kaddu wali shorba aur gosht ke kate hue tukde pesh kiye. Anas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko thaali ke aas-paas kaddu ki taraf jaate hue dekha, is liye main tab se kaddu ko hamesha pasand karta hoon.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal. I also went along with him. He brought soup containing pumpkin. Allah's 'messenger (ﷺ) ate that pumpkin with relish. He (Anas) said: When I saw that I began to place it before him, and did not eat it (myself). Anas said: It was since then that pumpkin was always my favourite (food).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khaane par bulaaya. Main bhi unke saath gaya. Woh kaddu waali shorba laaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us kaddu ko chao se khaaya. Unhone (Anas ne) kaha: Jab maine ye dekha, main use unke saamne rakhne laga, aur ise khud nahi khaya. Anas ne kaha: Tab se hi kaddu hamesha mera pasandeeda (khaana) raha.

e: Anas b. Malik rdported that a tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a feast. There has been an addition to this that Thabit said: I heard Anas saying that any meal that was prepared for me after that I tried that it should contain pumpkin.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki ek darzi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek daawat par bulaaya. Ismein ye izafa hai ki Thabit ne kaha: Maine Anas ko ye kehte suna ki koi bhi khaana jo iske baad mere liye taiyaar kiya jaata, main koshish karta ki usmein kaddu ho.

e: 'Abdullah b. Busr reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my father and we brought to him a meal and a preparation from dates, cheese and butter. He ate out of that. He was then given dates which he ate, putting the stones between his fingers and holding his forefinger and middle finger together" - Shu'bah said: "I think we learn from this that one may hold the date stones between two fingers, In shaAllah." Then a drink was brought for him and he drank it, and then gave it to one who was on his right side. He (the narrator) said: My father took hold of the rein of his riding animal and requested him to supplicate for us. Thereupon he said: O Allah. bless them in what You have provided them as a sustenance; and forgive them and have mercy upon them.
hi: Abdullah bin Busr ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere waalid ke paas aaye aur hum unke liye ek khaana aur khajooren, panir aur makkhan se banayi ek taiyaari laaye. Unhone usmein se khaaya. Unhe phir khajooren di gayin jinhe unhone khaaya, khajoor ki giThliyaan apni ungliyon ke beech rakhte hue aur apni pehli ungli aur beech ki ungli ko saath rakhte hue. Shu'ba ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai humein isse seekhna chahiye ki koi bhi khajoor ki giThliyaan do ungliyon ke beech rakh sakta hai, InshaAllah. Phir unke liye ek peene ki cheez laayi gayi aur unhone ise piya, aur phir use us shakhs ko diya jo unki daayi taraf tha. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mere waalid ne unke sawaari waale jaanwar ki lagaam pakadi aur unse guzaarish ki ki woh humare liye dua karein. Isper unhone kaha: Aye Allah, unhe uspar barkat de jo Tune unhe rozi ke soorat mein diya hai; aur unhe maaf kar aur unpar rehmat kar.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and they did not doubt about keeping the dates between his fingers (as is expressed in the previous hadith).
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone khajoor ki giThliyon ko ungliyon ke beech rakhne ke baare mein koi shak zaahir nahi kiya (jaisa pichhli hadees mein hai).

e: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating cucumber with fresh dates.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kheera taazi khajooron ke saath khaate dekha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) squatting and eating dates.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ubka baithkar khajooren khaate dekha.

e: Anas reported that there were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dates. He distributed them in the state that he had been sitting upright (in an easy posture) and he had also been eating them a (bit) quickly.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khajooren laayi gayin. Unhone unhe seedha baithkar (aaram se) baante aur unhe kuch jaldi se bhi khaaya.

e: Jabala b. Suhaim reported: Ibn Zubair used to provide us with dates during the time that the people were hard pressed because of famine (Once) as we were busy in eating there happened to appear before us Ibn 'Umar. He said: Don't eat two dates together, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade eating them together but only after seeking permission from his brother (partner). Shu'ba said: I do not think these words pertaining to seeking permission but from the words of Ibn 'Umar.
hi: Jabala bin Suhaim ne riwayat ki: Ibn Zubair humein khajooren dete the us daur mein jab log akaal ki wajah se tang haal the. (Ek baar) jab hum khaane mein masroof the Ibn Umar humare saamne pragat hue. Unhone kaha: Do khajooren ekasath mat khaao, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ekasath khaane se mana kiya siwaay is baat ke ki apne bhai (saanjhedaar) se ijazat li jaaye. Shu'ba ne kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta ki ijazat lene se mutaliq ye alfaaz Ibn Umar ke khud ke alfaaz hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but these words of his (are not found): " The people were hard pressed because of the famine during those days."
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin unke ye alfaaz (nahi milte): "Log un dinon akaal ki wajah se tang haal the."

e: Jabala b. Suhaim reported: I heard Ibn 'Umar as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade anyone taking two dates together without seeking the consent of his companions.
hi: Jabala bin Suhaim ne riwayat ki: Maine Ibn Umar ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kisi ko bhi do khajooren ekasath lene se mana kiya bina apne saathiyon ki sehmati liye.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A family which has dates will not be hungry.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek khaandaan jinke paas khajooren hain woh bhooke nahi rahenge.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: 'A'isha a family which has no dates (in their house) its members will be hungry; (or) 'A'isha the family which has no dates its members may be hungry. He said this twice or thrice.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aisha, jis khaandaan (ghar) mein khajooren nahi hain uske sadasya bhooke rahenge; (ya) Aisha, jis khaandaan mein khajooren nahi hain uske sadasya bhooke rah sakte hain. Unhone ye do ya teen baar kaha.

e: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who ate seven dates (of the land situated) between these two lava plains in the morning, no poison will harm him until it is evening.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne in do lava-zameenon ke beech ki saat khajooren subah khaayi, koi zeher use us shaam tak nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who ate seven 'ajwa' dates in the morning, poison and magic will not harm him on that day.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne subah saat Ajwa khajooren khaayin, zeher aur jaadu use us din nuksaan nahi pahunchaayenge.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Hashim with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Hashim ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The 'ajwa' dates of 'Aliya' contain healing effects and these are antidote in the early morning.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aliya ki Ajwa khajooron mein shifaayak prabhaav hai aur ye subah subah zeher-nashak hain.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' and their juice is a medicine for the eyes.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Truffles ek kism ka "Manna" hain aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Through another chain of transmitters, Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' and their juice is a medicine for the eyes.
