hi: Ek doosri sanad ke zariye, Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Truffles ek kism ka "Manna" hain aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of blessing and their juice is a medicine for the eyes. Shu'ba said: When Hakam narrated this hadith to me, I did not deem it as a Munkar hadith because of the narration of Abd al-Malik.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Truffles ek kism ki barkat hain aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai. Shu'ba ne kaha: Jab Hakam ne mujhe ye hadees riwayat ki, maine ise Munkar hadees nahi maana Abd al-Malik ki riwayat ki wajah se.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' which Allah the Glorious and Exalted, sent down upon the people of Israil, and its juice is a medicine for the eyes.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Truffles ek kism ka "Manna" hain jo Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne Israel ke logon par utaara, aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allal a Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' which Allah sent down upon Moses and their juice is a medicine for the eyes.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Truffles ek kism ka "Manna" hain jo Allah ne Musa par utaara aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are 'Manna' which Allah, the Exalted the Majestic, sent to the people of Israil, and its juice is a medicine for the eyes.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Truffles "Manna" hain jo Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Israel ke logon ko bheja, aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are 'Manna' and its juice is the medicine for the eyes.
hi: Sa'id bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Truffles "Manna" hain aur inka ras aankhon ke liye dawaai hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Marr az-Zahran, and we were plucking the fruit of the Arak tree, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: Pluck only its black ones (for they are the most pleasant). We said: Allah's Messenger, it seems you shepherded the flock. He said: Yes. Has there been a prophet who did not shepherd it (or some words like it)?
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Marr az-Zahran mein the, aur hum Arak darakht ke phal chun rahe the, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sirf iske kaale (phal) chuno (kyunki woh sabse suhaavne hain). Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, lagta hai aap bhi bakriyaan charaate the. Unhone kaha: Haan. Kya koi aisa Nabi hua jinhone bakriyaan na charaayi hon (ya isi jaise alfaaz)?

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The best of condiments or condiment is vinegar.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sabse achha masaala ya masaala sirka hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sulaiman b. Bilal with the same chain of transmitters and he is reported to have said: " The best condiment." And he did not doubt (about this word).
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman bin Bilal ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Sabse achha masaala." Aur unhone (is lafz ke baare mein) koi shak zaahir nahi kiya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) asked his family for condiment. They (the members of his household) said: We have nothing with us but vinegar. He asked for it, he began to eat it, and then said: Vinegar is a good condiment, vinegar is a good condiment.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khaandaan se masaala maanga. Unhone (unke khaandaan ke sadasyon ne) kaha: Humare paas sirka ke ilawa kuch nahi hai. Unhone ise maanga, ise khaana shuru kiya, aur phir kaha: Sirka ek achha masaala hai, sirka ek achha masaala hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of my hand one day (and led me) to his residence. There was presented to him some pieces of bread, whereupon he said: Is there no condiment? They (the members of his household) said: No, except some vinegar. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Vinegar is a good condiment. Jabir said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard it trom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Talha said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard about it from Jabir.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din mera haath pakadA (aur mujhe le gaye) apne ghar. Unhe roti ke kuch tukde pesh kiye gaye, isper unhone kaha: Kya koi masaala nahi hai? Unhone (unke khaandaan ke sadasyon ne) kaha: Nahi, siwaay kuch sirke ke. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Sirka ek achha masaala hai. Jabir ne kaha: Main hamesha sirke se muhabbat karta hoon jab se maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Talha ne kaha: Main hamesha sirke se muhabbat karta hoon jab se maine iske baare mein Jabir se suna.

e: This hadith is reported on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of his hand and led him to his residence as narrated above up to the words: " Vinegar is a good condiment." But in the hadith transmitted through this chain of transmitters, there is no mention of the subsequent part.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka haath pakada aur unhe apne ghar le gaye jaisa upar riwayat kiya gaya hai in alfaazon tak: "Sirka ek achha masaala hai." Lekin is sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hadees mein baaki hisse ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: While I was sitting in my house there happened to pass by me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He made a gesture to me and I stood up for him. He took hold of my hand until we came to one of the apartments of his wives. He entered and then asked me to get in. So I entered and there was hanging a curtain beside her. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is there any food (with you)? They (the members of the household) said: Yes And then there were brought three loaves of bread for him (the Holy Prophet) and placed in the basket of palm leaves. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) picked up one loaf and placed that before him, and then picked up another one and placed it before me. He then picked up the third one and broke it into two parts, and kept the one-half before him and the other half before me, and then said: Is there any condiment? They (the members of the household) said: There is nothing (in the form of condiment) but some vinegar only. He said: Bring that, for vinegar is a good condiment.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Jab main apne ghar mein baitha tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas se guzre. Unhone mujhe ishara kiya aur main unke liye khada hua. Unhone mera haath pakada yahan tak ki hum unki zaujaon mein se ek ke kamre mein pahunche. Woh andar gaye aur phir mujhe andar aane ko kaha. To main andar gaya aur wahan unke bagal mein ek parda latak raha tha. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Kya koi khaana hai? Unhone (khaandaan ke logon ne) kaha: Haan. Aur phir unke liye teen rotiyaan laayi gayin aur khajoor ke pattoon ki Tokri mein rakhi gayin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek roti uThAyi aur ise apne saamne rakha, aur phir ek aur uThAyi aur ise mere saamne rakha. Unhone phir teesri uThAyi aur ise do hisson mein toDa, aur ek aadha apne saamne aur doosra aadha mere saamne rakha, aur phir kaha: Kya koi masaala hai? Unhone (khaandaan ke logon ne) kaha: Kuch nahi hai (masaale ke soorat mein) siwaay thode sirke ke. Unhone kaha: Ise laao, kyunki sirka ek achha masaala hai.

e: Abd Ayydb Ansari reported that when food was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he ate out of that, and sent the remaining part to me, and one day he sent to me the left-over; (I found that he) had not taken from it at all for it included garlic. I asked him whether that was forbidden, whereupon he said: No, but I do not like it because of its odour. He (Abu Ayyub Ansiri) said: Then I also do not like what you do not like.
hi: Abu Ayyub Ansari ne riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khaana laaya jaata, unhone usmein se khaaya aur baaki hissa mujhe bheja, aur ek din unhone mujhe jo bacha tha woh bheja; (maine paaya ki) unhone usmein se bilkul nahi liya tha kyunki usmein lehsun tha. Maine unse poocha ki kya ye mana hai, isper unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin mujhe iski mahak ki wajah se pasand nahi hai. Unhone (Abu Ayyub Ansari ne) kaha: Phir mujhe bhi woh pasand nahi hai jo aapko pasand nahi hai.

e: This Hadith is narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Aflah, the freed slave of Abu Ayyub Ansiri, reported: Allah's Messnger (ﷺ) had alighted in his house (viz. of Abu Ayyub Ansari at the time of his emigration to Medina) and he occupied the lower storey, whereas Abu Ayyub Ansari lived in the upper storey. One night, Abu Ayyub Ansari got up and said (to himself): (How unfortunate it is) that we walk above the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so they went aside and spent the night in a nook and then told Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about it whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: The lower storey is more comfortable (for me). but he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: We (would not live) over the roof under which you live. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shifted to the upper storey, whereas Abu Ayyub Ansari shifted to the lower storey; and he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) used to prepare food for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) ; and when it was brought (back) to him he asked (to locate) the part, where his fingers had touched (the food), and he followed his fingers on that part where his fingers (those of the Holy Prophet) had touched it. (One day) he prepared food which contained garlic, and when it was returned to him he asked (to locate) the part which the fingers of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had touched. It was said to him that he had not eaten (the food). He (Abd Ayyub Ansari) was distressed and went up to him (to the Holy Prophet) and said: Is it forbidden? But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No, (it is not forbidden), but I do not like it. and he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: I also do not like what you do not like or which you did not like. He (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: (The Prophet did not eat garlic) as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was visited (by angels) and brought him the message of Allah.
hi: Aflah, Abu Ayyub Ansari ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke ghar mein Thehre the (yaani Abu Ayyub Ansari ke ghar mein jab woh Madina hijrat kar rahe the) aur unhone neechle manzil mein rehna chuna, jabki Abu Ayyub Ansari upari manzil mein rehte the. Ek raat, Abu Ayyub Ansari uThe aur kaha (khud se): (Ye kitna badnaseeb hai) ki hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke upar chalte hain, is liye woh alag ho gaye aur ek kone mein raat guzari aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iske baare mein bataya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Neechli manzil (mere liye) zyada aaramdayak hai. Lekin unhone (Abu Ayyub Ansari ne) kaha: Hum (nahi rahenge) us chhat ke upar jiske neeche aap rehte hain. Is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) upari manzil mein chale gaye, jabki Abu Ayyub Ansari neechli manzil mein chale gaye; aur unhone (Abu Ayyub Ansari) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye khaana taiyaar karna shuru kiya; aur jab ye unhe (wapas) laaya jaata woh us hisse ko (dhundhte the) jahan unki (Nabi-e-Paak ki) ungliyon ne (khaane ko) chhua tha, aur woh apni ungliyaan wahan rakhte jahan unki (Nabi-e-Paak ki) ungliyon ne ise chhua tha. (Ek din) unhone ek khaana taiyaar kiya jismein lehsun tha, aur jab ye unhe wapas laaya gaya unhone (dekhne ke liye) poocha ki us hisse ko (Dhundhein) jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungliyon ne chhua tha. Unhe bataya gaya ki unhone (khaana) nahi khaaya tha. Woh (Abu Ayyub Ansari) pareshaan hue aur unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas gaye aur kaha: Kya ye mana hai? Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nahi, (ye mana nahi hai), lekin mujhe pasand nahi hai. Aur unhone (Abu Ayyub Ansari) kaha: Mujhe bhi woh pasand nahi hai jo aapko pasand nahi hai ya jo aapko pasand nahi tha. Unhone (Abu Ayyub Ansari ne) kaha: (Nabi ne lehsun nahi khaaya) kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (farishte) milne aate the aur unke paas Allah ka payaam laate the.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I am hard pressed by hunger. He sent (message) to one of his wives (to procure food for him). but she said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth, thrre is nothing with me (to serve him) but only water. He (the Holy Prophet) then sent the (same) message to another, and she gave the same reply, until all of them gave the same reply: By Him Who has sent thee with the Truth, there is nothing with me but only water, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah would show mercy to him who will entertain this guest tonight. A person from the Ansar stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, I (am ready to entertain). He took him to his house and said to his wife: Is there anything with you (to serve the gdest)? She said: No, but only a subsistence for our children. He said: Distract their attention with something, and when the guest enters extinguish the lamp and give him the impression that we are eating. So they sat down. and the guest had his meal. When it was morning he went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who said: Allah was well pleased with what you both did for your guest this night.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main bhook se tang haal hoon. Unhone apni ek zauja ke paas (uske liye khaana laane) payaam bheja, lekin unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, mere paas (unhe serve karne ke liye) paani ke siwaay kuch nahi hai. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir wahi payaam doosri (zauja) ko bheja, aur unhone bhi wahi jawaab diya, yahan tak ki unmein se sabne wahi jawaab diya: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, mere paas paani ke siwaay kuch nahi hai, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Allah us shakhs par rehmat karega jo aaj raat is mehmaan ki mehmaannawaazi karega. Ansar mein se ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main (mehmaannawaazi ke liye) taiyaar hoon. Woh use apne ghar le gaye aur apni zauja se kaha: Kya tumhare paas kuch hai (mehmaan ko serve karne ke liye)? Unhone kaha: Nahi, sirf humare bachchon ke liye guzaara hai. Unhone kaha: Unhe kisi cheez se pareshaan karo (unka dhyaan bataao), aur jab mehmaan andar aaye diya bujha do aur unhe ye ehsaas do ki hum khaa rahe hain. To woh baiThe, aur mehmaan ne khaana khaaya. Jab subah hui woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye jinhone kaha: Allah khush hua us cheez se jo tum donon ne aaj raat apne mehmaan ke liye ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a guest spent the night with a person from the Ansar who had nothing with him but food (sufficient) for his own self and his children. He said to his wife: (Lull) the children to sleep, and put out the lamp, and serve the guest with what you have with you. It was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" Those who prefer the needy to their own selves in spite of the fact that they are themselves in pressing need" (Lix. 9).
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki ek mehmaan Ansar mein se ek shakhs ke saath raat guzaarne aaya jiske paas apne aur apne bachchon ke liye kaafi khaana nahi tha. Unhone apni zauja se kaha: (Bachchon ko) sula do, aur diya bujha do, aur mehmaan ko jo tumhare paas hai woh serve karo. Isi avasar par ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jo doosron ki zaroorat ko apni khud ki zaroorat par tarjeeh dete hain is baat ke bawajood ki woh khud zarooratmand hain" (59:9).

e: Abu Huraira reported that a man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he should entertain him as a guest, but he had nothing with which he could entertain him. He, therefore, asked if there was any person who would entertain him (assuring the audience) that Allah would show mercy to him. A person from the Ansar who was called Abu Talha stood up and he took him to his house. The rest of the hadith is the same and mention is (also) made in that about the revelation of the verse as narrated by Waki'.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya taaki woh unki mehmaannawaazi kar sakein, lekin unke paas kuch nahi tha jisse woh unki mehmaannawaazi kar saken. Unhone is liye poocha ki kya koi shakhs hai jo unki mehmaannawaazi karega (audience ko ye vishwaas dilaate hue ki Allah unpar rehmat karega). Ansar mein se ek shakhs jise Abu Talha kaha jaata tha khada hua aur unhe apne ghar le gaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ismein bhi zikr hai (aayat ki) nazil hone ka jaisa Waki ke zariye riwayat kiya gaya hai.

e: Miqdad reported: I and two of my companions were so much afflicted by hunger that we had lost our power of seeing and hearing. We presented ourselves (as guests) to the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), but none amongst them would entertain us. So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he took us to his residence and there were three goats. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Milk these for us. So we milked them and every person amongst us drank his share and we set aside the share of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). (It was his habit) to come during the night and greet (the people present there) in a manner that would not wake up one in sleep but make one who was awake hear it. He would then go to the mosque and say prayer, then go to the milk and drink it. Miqdad added: One night the Satan came to me when I had taken my share, and he said: Muhammad has gone to the Ansar, who would offer him hospitality and he would get what is with them, and he has no need for this draught (of milk). So I took (that milk) and drank it, and when it had penetrated deeply in my stomach and I was certain that there was no way out (but to digest it), the Satan aroused (my sense of) remorse and said: Woe be to thee! what have you done? You have taken the drink reserved for Muhammad! When he would come and he would not find it, he would curse you, and you would be ruined, and thus there would go (waste) this world and the Hereafter (for) you. There was a sheet over me; as I placed (pulled) it upon my feet, my head was uncovered and as I placed it upon my head, my feet were uncovered, and I could not sleep, but my two companions had gone to sleep for they had not done what I had done. There came Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he greeted as he used to greet (by saying as-Salamu 'Alaikum). He then came to the mosque and observed prayer and then came to his drink (milk) and uncovered it, but did not find anything in it. He raised his head towards the sky, and I said (to myself) that he (the Holy Prophet) was going to invoke curse upon me and I would be thus ruined; but he (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah, feed him who fed me and give drink to him who provided me drink. I held tight the sheet upon myself (and when he had supplicated), I took hold of the knife and went to the goats (possessed by the Holy Prophet) so that I may slauhter one for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which was the fattest amongst them, and in fact all of them were milch goats; then I took hold of the vessel which belonged to the family of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in which they used to milk and drink therefrom, and milked them in that until it swelled up with foam. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: Have you taken your share of the milk during the night? I said: Drink it. and he drank it; he then handed over (the vessel) to me and I said: Allah's Messenger, drink it, and he drank it and handed over (the vessel) to me again, I then perceived that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been satiated and I had got his blessings. I burst into laughter (so much) so that I fell upon the ground, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Miqdad, it must be one of your mischiefs. I said: Allah's Messenger, this affair of mind is like this and this. and I have done so. Thereupon. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: This is nothing but a mercy from Allah. Why is it that you did not give me an opportunity so that we should have awakened our two friends and they would have got their share (of the milk)? I said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth. I do not mind whatever you give (to them), and whatever the (other) people happen to get, when I had got it along with you from among the people.
hi: Miqdad ne riwayat ki: Main aur mere do saathi itni bhook se pareshaan the ki humne apni dekhne aur sunne ki taaqat kho di thi. Humne khud ko Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba ke saamne (mehmaan ke soorat mein) pesh kiya, lekin unmein se kisi ne bhi humari mehmaannawaazi nahi ki. To hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur woh humein apne ghar le gaye jahan teen bakriyaan thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Humare liye inhe dooho. To humne unhe dooha aur humme se har ek ne apna hissa piya aur humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka hissa alag rakh diya. (Unki aadat thi) raat ko aana aur (wahan maujood logon ko) is tarah salaam karna ki ye sone waale ko na jaagaaye lekin jaagte hue ko sunayi de. Woh phir masjid jaate aur namaz padhte, phir doodh ke paas jaate aur ise peete. Miqdad ne izafa kiya: Ek raat Shaitaan mere paas aaya jab maine apna hissa le liya tha, aur usne kaha: Muhammad Ansar ke paas gaye hain, jo unki mehmaannawaazi karenge aur unhe woh milega jo unke paas hai, aur unhe is (doodh ke) ghunT ki koi zaroorat nahi hai. To maine (woh doodh) liya aur use piya, aur jab ye mere pait mein gehra utar gaya aur mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ki ise pachaane ke siwaay koi raasta nahi tha, Shaitaan ne mera pashchataap jagaaya aur kaha: Afsos tumpar! Tumne kya kiya? Tumne Muhammad ke liye rakhi hui peene ki cheez le li! Jab woh aayenge aur ise nahi payenge, woh tumhe bad-dua denge, aur tum barbaad ho jaaoge, aur is tarah ye duniya aur Aakhirat (tumhare liye) barbaad ho jaayenge. Mere upar ek chaadar thi; jaise maine ise apne paon par rakha, mera sar khula reh jaata, aur jaise maine ise apne sar par rakha, mere paon khule reh jaate, aur main so nahi paaya, lekin mere do saathi so gaye kyunki unhone woh nahi kiya tha jo maine kiya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, aur unhone salaam kiya jaisa woh salaam karte the (as-Salamu Alaikum kehte hue). Woh phir masjid mein aaye aur namaz padhi aur phir apni peene ki cheez (doodh) ke paas aaye aur use Dhaka hataaya, lekin usmein kuch nahi paaya. Unhone apna sar aasmaan ki taraf uThAya, aur maine (khud se) kaha ki woh mere khilaaf laanat maangne waale hain aur main is tarah barbaad ho jaunga; lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Allah, use khilaa jisne mujhe khilaaya, aur use peene ko de jisne mujhe peene ko diya. Maine chaadar apne aap par kaska (aur jab unhone dua ki), maine chaaku uThAya aur bakriyon (jo Nabi-e-Paak ki thin) ke paas gaya taaki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye ek zibah kar sakoon jo unmein sabse motI thi, aur waastav mein woh sab doodh dene wali bakriyaan thin; phir maine woh bartan liya jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khaandaan ka tha jismein woh doodh nikaalte aur usmein se peete, aur unhein dooha yahan tak ki ye jhaag se ubhar gaya. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Kya tumne raat mein apna doodh ka hissa liya tha? Maine kaha: Piyiye. Aur unhone ise piya; unhone phir (bartan) mujhe soonpa aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, piyiye, aur unhone ise piya aur phir bartan mujhe dobara soonpa, maine phir mehsoos kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tript ho chuke the aur mujhe unki barkatein mil gayi thi. Main hansi mein phaT paDa (itna) ki main zameen par gir gaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Miqdad, ye zaroor tumhari kisi shararat mein se ek hoga. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera ye maamla aisa aisa hai, aur maine aisa kiya hai. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Allah ki taraf se ek rehmat ke siwaay kuch nahi hai. Ye kaise hai ki tumne mujhe mauka nahi diya taaki hum apne do saathiyon ko jagaaye aur unhe unka hissa (doodh mein se) mil jaaye? Maine kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, mujhe koi parvaah nahi hai aap unhe kuch bhi den, aur jo bhi (doosre) log paayein, jab maine ise aapke saath logon se pehle pa liya hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mughira with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mughira ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr reported: We were one hundred and thirty (persons) with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Does any one of You possess food? There was a person with (us) who had a sa' of flour or something about that, and it was kneaded. Then a tall polytheist with dishevelled hair came driving his flock of sheep. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Would you like to sell it (any one of these goats) or offer it as a gift or a present? He said: No, (I am not prepared to offer as a gift), but I would sell it. He (the Holy Prophet) bought a sheep from him, and it was slaughtered and its meat was prepared, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that its liver should be roasted. He (the narrator) said: By Allah, none among one hundred and thirty persons was left whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not given a part out of her liver; if anyone was present he gave it to him. but if he was absent it was set aside for him. And he (the Holy Prophet) filled two bowls (one with soup and the other with mutton) and we all ate out of them to our hearts' content, but (still) some part was (left) in (those) two bowls, and I placed it on the camel- (or words to the same effect).
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne riwayat ki: Hum ek sau tees (log) the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum mein se kisi ke paas khaana hai? Ek shakhs the (humare saath) jinke paas ek sa aata ya isi jaisi koi cheez thi, aur ise gundha gaya. Phir ek lamba mushrik bikhre baalon ke saath apni bakriyon ka rewaad haankte hue aaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum ise (in bakriyon mein se koi ek) bechna ya tohfe ya inaam ke soorat mein dena chahoge? Usne kaha: Nahi, (main tohfe mein dene ke liye taiyaar nahi hoon), lekin main ise bechunga. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) usse ek bakri khareedi, aur use zibah kiya gaya aur uska gosht taiyaar kiya gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki uska jigar bhuna jaaye. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, ek sau tees logon mein se koi bhi nahi bacha jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske jigar mein se ek hissa na diya ho; agar koi maujood tha, unhone ise use diya, lekin agar woh gair-haazir tha ye uske liye alag rakha gaya. Aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) do kaTore bhare (ek shorba se aur doosra bakri ke gosht se) aur hum sabne unmein se apni tripti tak khaaya, lekin (phir bhi) kuch hissa (bacha) in do kaToron mein, aur maine ise oont par rakha (ya isi jaisa alfaaz).

e: 'Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr reported that the people of Suffa were very poor. Once the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to his Companions): He who amongst you has food for two persons should take three (guests with him). and he who has with him food for four persons should take five or six (guests with him for entertaining them). It was (in accordance with these instructions of the Holy Prophet) that Abu Bakr brought three persons, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) brought ten persons (as guests to their respective houses). Abu Bakr had brought three persons (he himself, and myself), my father and my mother (along with therm). He (the narrator) said: I do not know whether he also said: My wife and one servant who was common between our house and that of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr had had his evening meal with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He stayed here until night prayer had been offered. He then came back (to the house of Allah's Apostle) and stayed there until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt drowsy and (Abu Bakr) then came (back to his own house) when (a considerable) part of the night had been over, as Allah had desired. His wife said to him: What held you back from your guests? He said: Oh! have you not served them the evening meal (by this time)? She said: It was in fact served to them. but they refused to eat until you came. He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: I slunk away and bid myself. He (Abu Bakr) said: O, you stupid fellow, and he reprimanded me, and said to the guests: Eat, though it may not be pleasant now. He said: By Allah. I will never eat it He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: By Allah. we did not take a morsel when from beneath that (there appeared) more until they had eaten to their fill, and lo! it was more than what it was before. Abu Bakr saw that and found that it was so or more than that. He said to his wife: Sister of Band Firis, what is th-is? She said: By the coolness of my eyes. it is in excess by three times over the previous one. Then Abu Bakr ate saying: That was from the Satan (viz. his vow for not eating the food). He then took a morsel out of that and then took it (the rest) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and it was kept there until morning, and during (those days) there was a covenant between us and some other people, and the period of covenant was over, and we had appointed twelve officials with every person amongst them. It is Allah only Who knows as to how many people were there with each of them. He sent (this food to them) and all of them ate out of it.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne riwayat ki ki Suffa ke log bahut gareeb the. Ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne sahaba se) kaha: Jiske paas do logon ke liye khaana hai use teen (mehmaan) apne saath le jaana chahiye, aur jiske paas chaar logon ke liye khaana hai use paanch ya chhe (mehmaan) apne saath le jaana chahiye (unki mehmaannawaazi ke liye). Ye (in hidayaton ke mutabik) tha ki Abu Bakr teen logon ko laaye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) das logon ko (mehmaanon ke soorat mein unke respective gharon mein) laaye. Abu Bakr teen logon ko laaye the (khud, aur main), mere waalid aur meri maa (unke saath). Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone ye bhi kaha: Meri zauja aur ek naukar jo humare aur Abu Bakr ke ghar ke beech saanjha tha. Abu Bakr ne apna shaam ka khaana Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath khaaya. Woh wahan tab tak rahe jab tak Isha ki namaz nahi hui. Woh phir wapas aaye (Allah ke Rasool ke ghar) aur wahan tab tak rahe jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko neend nahi aayi, aur (Abu Bakr) phir aaye (apne khud ke ghar) jab raat ka (kaafi) hissa guzar chuka tha, jaisa Allah chaahta tha. Unki zauja ne unse kaha: Tumhe apne mehmaanon se kis cheez ne roka? Unhone kaha: Kya! Kya tumne unhe (is waqt tak) shaam ka khaana serve nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Ye waastav mein unhe serve kiya gaya. Lekin unhone khaane se inkaar kiya jab tak tum nahi aa gaye. Unhone (Abd al-Rahman ne) kaha: Main chhupa aur khud ko chhupaa liya. Unhone (Abu Bakr ne) kaha: Aye tum moorkh shakhs, aur unhone mujhe daanta, aur mehmaanon se kaha: Khaao, chahe ye ab suhaavna na ho. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi nahi khaunga. Unhone (Abd al-Rahman ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne koi nivaala nahi liya jab uske neeche se (aur) zyada pragat hua yahan tak ki unhone apni tripti tak khaaya, aur dekho! Ye pehle se zyada tha. Abu Bakr ne ye dekha aur paaya ki ye waisa hi tha ya usse zyada. Unhone apni zauja se kaha: Banu Firis ki behn, ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Meri aankhon ki Thandak ki qasam, ye pehle se teen guna zyada hai. Phir Abu Bakr ne khaaya ye kehte hue: Ye Shaitaan ki taraf se tha (yaani khaana na khaane ki unki qasam). Unhone phir usmein se ek nivaala liya aur phir ise (baaki hisse ko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas le gaye, aur ye wahan subah tak rakha gaya, aur (un dinon mein) hamara kuch doosre logon ke saath ek ehad tha, aur ehad ki muddat khatm ho gayi thi, aur humne baarah ohdedaar muqarrar kiye the har shakhs ke saath. Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki har ek ke saath kitne log the. Unhone (ye khaana unhe) bheja aur unmein se sabne usmein se khaaya.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abd Bakr reported: There came to our house some guests. It was a common practice with my father to (go) and talk to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the night. While going he said: 'Abd al-Rahman, entertain the guests. When it was evening we served the food to them, but they refused saying: So long as the owner of the house does not come and join us, we would not take the meal. I said to them: He ('Abd Bakr) is a stern person, and if you would not do that (if you do not take the food). I fear, I may be harmed by him, but they refused. As he (my father) came, the first thing he asked was: Have you served the guests? They (the peopleof the household) said: We have not served them sofar. He said: Did I not command 'Abd al-Rahman (to do this)? He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: I slunk away and kept myself away by that time. He again said: O stupid fellow, I ask you on oath that In case you hear my voice you come to me. I came and said: By Allah, there is no fault of mine. These are your guests; you may ask them. I provided them with food but they refused to eat until you came. He said to them: Why is it that you did not accept our food? By Allah, I shall not even take food tonight (as you have not taken). They said: By Allah, we would not take until you join us. Thereupon he Abu Bakr) said: I have never seen a more unfortunate night than this. Woe be to thee! that you do not accept from us food prepared for you. He again said: What I did first (that is the taking of vow for not eating the food) was prompted by the Satan. Bring the food. The food was brought, and he ate by reciting the name of Allah and they also ate, and when it was morning he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, their oath (that of the guests) came to be true, but mine was not true, and after that he informed him of the whole incident. He said: Your oath came to be the most true and you are the best of them. He (the narrator) said. I do not know whether he made an atonement for it.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakr ne riwayat ki: Humare ghar mein kuch mehmaan aaye. Ye mere waalid ka aam amal tha (jaana aur) raat mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baat karna. Jaate waqt unhone kaha: Abd al-Rahman, mehmaanon ki mehmaannawaazi karo. Jab shaam hui, humne unhe khaana serve kiya, lekin unhone ye kehte hue inkaar kiya: Jab tak ghar ka maalik nahi aata aur hummein shaamil nahi hota, hum khaana nahi khaayenge. Maine unse kaha: Woh (Abu Bakr) ek sakht shakhs hain, aur agar tum aisa nahi karte (agar tum khaana nahi khaate), mujhe Dar hai ki unse mujhe nuksaan ho sakta hai, lekin unhone inkaar kiya. Jaise woh (mere waalid) aaye, sabse pehle unhone poocha: Kya tumne mehmaanon ko serve kiya? Unhone (khaandaan ke logon ne) kaha: Humne unhe ab tak serve nahi kiya. Unhone kaha: Kya maine Abd al-Rahman ko (ye karne ka) hukum nahi diya tha? Unhone (Abd al-Rahman ne) kaha: Main chhupA aur khud ko us waqt tak door rakha. Unhone phir kaha: Aye moorkh shakhs, main tumhe qasam deta hoon ki agar tum meri aawaaz suno to mere paas aao. Main aaya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, mera koi qusoor nahi hai. Ye aapke mehmaan hain; aap unse poochh sakte hain. Maine unhe khaana diya lekin unhone khaane se inkaar kiya jab tak aap nahi aa gaye. Unhone unse kaha: Tumne kyun humara khaana qubool nahi kiya? Allah ki qasam, main aaj raat khaana bhi nahi khaunga (kyunki tumne nahi khaaya). Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum tab tak nahi khayenge jab tak aap hummein shaamil nahi ho jaate. Isper unhone (Abu Bakr ne) kaha: Maine kabhi is raat se zyada badnaseeb koi raat nahi dekhi. Afsos tumpar! Ki tum humse woh khaana qubool nahi karte jo tumhare liye taiyaar kiya gaya. Unhone phir kaha: Jo maine pehle kiya (yaani khaana na khaane ki qasam) woh Shaitaan ki targhib thi. Khaana laao. Khaana laaya gaya, aur unhone Allah ka naam lekar khaaya aur unhone (mehmaanon ne) bhi khaaya, aur jab subah hui unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaakar kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unki (mehmaanon ki) qasam sach nikli, lekin meri sach nahi nikli, aur uske baad unhone unhe poori ghatna bataayi. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Tumhari qasam sabse zyada sach thi aur tum unmein sabse achhe ho. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone iske liye koi prayaschit kiya ya nahi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Food for two persons suffices three persons and food for three persons suffices four persons.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Do logon ke liye khaana teen logon ke liye kaafi hai aur teen logon ke liye khaana chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I heard Allah'. s Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Food for one person suffices two persons and food for two persons suffices four persons, and food for four persons suffices eight persons; and in the tradition transmitted on the authority of Ishaq there is no mention of the fact that he heard it directly (from the Holy Prophet).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs ke liye khaana do logon ke liye kaafi hai, aur do logon ke liye khaana chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai, aur chaar logon ke liye khaana aaTh logon ke liye kaafi hai; aur Ishaq ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat mein iska koi zikr nahi hai ki unhone ise seedhe (Nabi-e-Paak se) suna.

e: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Jabir but with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Food for one suffices two and food for two suffices for four.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek shakhs ke liye khaana do logon ke liye kaafi hai aur do logon ke liye khaana chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Food for one (person) suffices two, and food for two (persons) suffices four persons and food for four persons suffices eight persons.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek (shakhs) ke liye khaana do logon ke liye kaafi hai, aur do (logon) ke liye khaana chaar logon ke liye kaafi hai aur chaar logon ke liye khaana aaTh logon ke liye kaafi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a non-Muslim eats in seven intestines whereas a Muslim eats in one intestine.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki ek ghair-Musalman saat aanton mein khaata hai jabki ek Musalman ek aant mein khaata hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar but with a different chain oi transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar saw a poor man. He placed food before him and he ate much. He (Ibn 'Umar) said: He should not come to me. for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that the non-Muslim eats in seven intestines.
hi: Nafi ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar ne ek gareeb shakhs dekha. Unhone uske saamne khaana rakha aur usne bahut khaaya. Unhone (Ibn Umar ne) kaha: Use mere paas nahi aana chahiye, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki ghair-Musalman saat aanton mein khaata hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer eats in one intestine, whereas a non-believer eats in seven intestines.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek imaandaar ek aant mein khaata hai, jabki ek ghair-imaandaar saat aanton mein khaata hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer eats in one intestine, whereas a non-believer eats in seven intestines.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek imaandaar ek aant mein khaata hai, jabki ek ghair-imaandaar saat aanton mein khaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invited a non-Muslim. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a goat be milked for him. It was milked and he drank its milk. Then the second one was milked and he drank its milk, and then the other one was milked and he drank its milk. till he drank the milk of seven goats. On the next morning he embraced Islam. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a goat should be milked for him and he drank its milk and then another was milked but he did not finish it, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A believer drinks In one intestine whereas a non-believer drinks in seven intestines.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek ghair-Musalman ko bulaaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki unke liye ek bakri dohi jaaye. Ise dooha gaya aur unhone iska doodh piya. Phir doosri dohi gayi aur unhone iska doodh piya, aur phir teesri dohi gayi aur unhone iska doodh piya, yahan tak ki unhone saat bakriyon ka doodh piya. Agli subah usne Islam qubool kar liya. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki unke liye ek bakri dohi jaaye aur unhone iska doodh piya aur phir doosri dohi gayi lekin unhone ise poora nahi kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek imaandaar ek aant mein peeta hai, jabki ek ghair-imaandaar saat aanton mein peeta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never found fault with food (served to him). If he liked anything, he ate it and if he did not like it he left it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi khaane (jo unhe serve kiya jaata) mein koi dosh nahi nikaala. Agar unhe kuch pasand aata, woh ise khaate aur agar unhe woh pasand nahi aata, woh ise chhod dete.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
Abu Huraira reported: I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finding fault with food (served to him) ; if he liked it he ate it, and if did not like it he kept silent.

This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khaane (jo unhe serve kiya jaata) mein koi dosh nikaalte nahi dekha; agar unhe ye pasand aata woh ise khaate, aur agar unhe pasand nahi aata woh khamosh rehte. Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: He who drinks in the vessel of silver in fact drinks down in his belly the fire of Hell.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Jo chandi ke bartan mein peeta hai woh dar-asal apne pait mein Jahannam ki aag utaarta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters. The hadith of Ibn Mushir on the authority of 'Ubaidullah it is as: He who eats or drinks in the vessel of silver and gold, - but there is no mention in any one of the other chains of the words pertaining to eating and gold.
hi: Ye hadees doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Ibn Mushir ki Ubaidullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Jo chandi aur sone ke bartan mein khaata ya peeta hai, - lekin doosri kisi sanad mein khaane aur sone ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority of his mother's sister Umm Salama who said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who drank in vessels of gold or silver he in fact drank down in his belly the fire of Hell.
hi: Abd al-Rahman ne, apni maa ki behn Umm Salama ki sanad se, riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo sone ya chandi ke bartano mein peeta hai woh dar-asal apne pait mein Jahannam ki aag utaarta hai.

e: Mu'awiya b. Suwaid b. Muqarrin reporxed: I visited al-Bara' b. 'Azib and heard him say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to do seven things and forbade us to do seven (things). He commanded us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral procession, to answer the sneezer, to fulfil the vow, to help the poor, to accept the invitation and to greet everybody, and he forbade us to wear rings or gold rings, to drink in silver (vessels), and to use the saddle cloth made of red silk, and to wear garments made of Qassi material, or garments made of silk or brocade and velvet.
hi: Mu'awiya bin Suwaid bin Muqarrin ne riwayat ki: Main al-Bara bin Azib se milne gaya aur unhe ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein saat cheezein karne ka hukum diya aur humein saat (cheezon) se mana kiya. Unhone humein bimaaron se milne, janaaze ka anusaran karne, chheenkne wale ko jawaab dene, mannat poori karne, gareebon ki madad karne, daawat qubool karne aur sab ko salaam karne ka hukum diya, aur unhone humein anguThiyaan ya sone ki anguThiyaan pehnne, chandi (ke bartano) mein peene, aur laal resham se banaayi zeen ki gaddi istemal karne, aur Qassi kapde se, ya resham aur brocade aur velvet se bane kapde pehnne se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight change of wording that he made no mention of: " to fulfil the vows" but substituted these words:" finding of the lost articles".
hi: Ye hadees Ash'ath bin Sulaim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath ki unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Mannaton ko poora karna" balki in alfaazon ka istemal kiya: "Khoyi hui cheezon ko dhoondhna."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ash'ath b. Abu ashSha'tha' with the same chain of transmitters (and with these words): There is no doubt about the words: To fulfil the vows were mentioned and this addition had been made in the. hadith: (The Holy Prophet) forbade drinking in silver vessels, for one who drinks (in them) in this world would not drink (in them) in the Hereafter.
hi: Ye hadees Ash'ath bin Abu ash-Sha'tha ki sanad se isi sanad se (in alfaazon ke saath) riwayat ki gayi hai: Isme koi shak nahi hai (in) alfaazon ke baare mein: Mannaton ko poora karna zikr kiya gaya, aur hadees mein ye izafa kiya gaya hai: (Nabi-e-Paak ne) chandi ke bartano mein peene se mana kiya, kyunki jo (unme) is duniya mein peeta hai woh Aakhirat mein (unmein) nahi peeyega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but with this difference that instead of the words: Ifsha as-Salam (spreading the salutations), he substituted the words Radd as-Saldm (i. e. responding to the words of salutation) and he said: He forbade (the use of) gold ring.
hi: Ye hadees Ash'ath bin Sulaim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki alfaaz "Ifsha as-Salam" (salaam phailaana) ki jagah unhone "Radd as-Salam" (yaani salaam ke alfaazon ka jawaab dena) alfaaz istemal kiye aur unhone kaha: Unhone (sone ki) anguThi (istemal karne) se mana kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the auttiniity of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but the words (pertaining to) Ifsha as-Salam and the (use) of gold ring have been reported without doubt.
hi: Ye hadees Ash'ath bin Sulaim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin Ifsha as-Salam aur sone ki anguThi (ke istemal) se mutaliq alfaaz bina kisi shak ke riwayat kiye gaye hain.

e: 'Abdullah b. Ukaim reported: While we were with Hudhaifa in Mada'in he asked for water. A villager brought a drink for him in a silver vessel. He (Hudhaifa) threw it away saying: I inform you that I have already conveyed to him that he should not serve me drink in it (silver vessel) for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Do not drink in gold and silver vessels, and do not wear brocade or silk, for these are meant for them (the non-believers) in this world, but they are meant for you in the Hereafter on the Day, of Resurrection.
hi: Abdullah bin Ukaim ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Hudhaifa ke saath Mada'in mein the unhone paani maanga. Ek gaanv waale ne unke liye chandi ke bartan mein ek peene ki cheez laayi. Unhone (Hudhaifa ne) ise phenk diya ye kehte hue: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki maine pehle hi unhe bataya tha ki unhe mujhe isme (chandi ke bartan mein) peene ki cheez serve nahi karni chahiye kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Sone aur chandi ke bartano mein mat piyo, aur brocade ya resham mat pehno, kyunki ye is duniya mein unke (ghair-imaandaaron ke) liye hain, lekin ye tumhare liye Aakhirat mein, Punarutthaan ke Din, hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of `Abdullah b. `Ukaim with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Ukaim ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of lbn `Ukaim through another chain of transmitters, but in this hadith no mention is made of the words: "On the Day of Resurrection"
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Ukaim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin is hadees mein alfaaz "Punarutthaan ke Din" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Shu'ba reported from al-Hakam that he heard 'Abd al-Rahmin (i. e. Ibn Abu Laila) as saying: I personally saw Hudhaifa asking for water in Mada'in and a man giving it to him in a silver vessel. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Shu'ba ne al-Hakam se riwayat ki ki unhone Abd al-Rahman (yaani Ibn Abu Laila) ko ye kehte suna: Maine khud dekha ki Hudhaifa Mada'in mein paani maang rahe the aur ek shakhs unhe chandi ke bartan mein ye de raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu`ba through another chain of transmitters. But there is no mention of "I personally saw him" in this hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Lekin is hadees mein "maine khud unhe dekha" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hudhaila with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hudhaifa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abd al-Rahmin b. Abu Laili reported that Hudhaifa asked for water and a Magian gave him water in a silver vessel, whereupon he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not wear silk or brocade and do not drink ifi vessels of gold and silver, and do not eat in the dishes made of them (i. e. gold and silver), for these are for them (the non-believers) in this world.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Laila ne riwayat ki ki Hudhaifa ne paani maanga aur ek Magian ne unhe chandi ke bartan mein paani diya, isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Resham ya brocade mat pehno, aur sone aur chandi ke bartano mein mat piyo, aur unse bane thaali mein mat khaao (yaani sone aur chandi ke), kyunki ye unke (ghair-imaandaaron ke) liye hain is duniya mein.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Umar b. Khattab saw (some one selling) the garments of silk at the door of the mosque, whereupon he said: Allah's Messenger, would that you buy it and wear it for the people on Friday and for (receiving) the delegations when they come to you? Upon this. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: go who wears it has no share (of reward) in the Hereafter. Then these garments were sent to Allah" s Messenger (ﷺ), and he presented one of these silk garment to Umar. Thereupon Umar said: You make me wear (this silk garment) Whereas you said about the silk garment of Utarid (the person who had been busy selling this garment at the door of the mosque) what you had to say, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I have not presented you this for wearing it (but to make use of its price) ; so 'Umar presented it to his polytheist brother in Mecca.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Umar bin Khattab ne masjid ke darwaze par (kisi ko) resham ke kapde bechte dekha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kaash aap ise khareed lein aur juma ke din aur numainda mandalon (ke svagat) ke liye ise pehnein jab woh aapke paas aayein? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo ise pehnta hai uska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga. Phir ye kapde Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheje gaye, aur unhone in resham ke kapdon mein se ek Umar ko diya. Isper Umar ne kaha: Aap mujhe (ye resham ka kapda) pehnaate hain jabki aapne Utarid (us shakhs ke) resham ke kapde ke baare mein wahi kaha jo aapko kehna tha? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maine ye tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi diya (balki iski keemat ka istemal karne ke liye); to Umar ne ise apne mushrik bhai ko Makkah mein diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ke zariye ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Umar saw Utarid al-Tamimi standing in the market (and selling) the silk garments, and he was the person who went to (courts of) kings and got (high prices) for these garments from them. Umar said: Allah's Messenger I saw 'Utarid standing in the market with a silk garment; would that you buy and wear it for (receiving) the delegations of Arabs when they visit you? I (the narrator) said: I think he ('Umar) also said: You may wear it on Friday (also). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: He who wears silk in this world has no share in the Hereafter. Later on when these silk garments were presented to Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) he presented one silk garment to 'Umar and presented one also to Usama b. Zaid and gave one to 'Ali b. Abu 'Talib. saying: Tear them and make head coverings for your ladies. 'Umar came carrying his garment and said: Allah's Messenger, you have sent it to me, whereas you had said yesterday about the (silk) garment of Utarid what you had to say. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I have not sent it to you that you wear it, but I have sent It to you so that you may derive benefit out of it; and Usama (donned) the garment (presented to him) and appeared to be brisk, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) looked at him with a look by which he perceived that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not like what he had done. He said: Allah's Messenger. why is it that you look at me like this. whereas you yourself presented it to me? He said: I never sent it to you to wear it, but I sent It to you so that you may tear it and make out head covering for your ladies.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Umar ne Utarid al-Tamimi ko bazaar mein khada (resham ke kapde bechte hue) dekha, aur woh woh shakhs the jo raajaon ke darbaaron mein jaate the aur in kapdon ke liye unse (unhe bechkar unse oonchi keemat) haasil karte the. Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine Utarid ko bazaar mein resham ke kapde ke saath khada dekha; kaash aap ise khareed lein aur ise Arabon ke numainda mandalon (ke svagat) ke liye pehnein jab woh aapse milne aayein? Maine (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (Umar ne) ye bhi kaha: Aap ise juma ke din bhi pehan sakte hain. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai uska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga. Baad mein jab ye resham ke kapde Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pesh kiye gaye unhone ek resham ka kapda Umar ko diya aur ek Usama bin Zaid ko diya, aur ek Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko diya, ye kehte hue: Unhe faaD do aur apni auraton ke liye sar dhaanpne wale kapde banao. Umar apna kapda lekar aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne ise mujhe bheja hai, jabki aapne kal Utarid ke (resham ke) kapde ke baare mein wahi kaha jo aapko kehna tha. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi bheja hai, lekin maine ise tumhe is liye bheja hai taaki tum ismein se faayda uThA sako; aur Usama ne (unhe di gayi) kapda pehna aur khush dikhaayi diye, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ek nazar se dekha jisse unhe samajh aa gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unka kiya hua kaam pasand nahi aaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise hai ki aap mujhe is tarah dekh rahe hain, jabki aapne khud ye mujhe diya? Unhone kaha: Maine ise tumhe kabhi pehnne ke liye nahi bheja, lekin maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tum ise faaD kar apni auraton ke liye sar dhaanpne waale kapde bana sako.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported: 'Umar b. at-Khattab found a silk garment being sold in the market; he purchased it and brought it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, get it and adorn yourself (by wearing it) on the 'Id (days) and for the delegation. Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is the dress of one who has no share (in the Hereafter). 'Umar stayed there so long as Allah wished. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent him a silk cloak. 'Umar came back with that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. you said that it is the dress of one who has no share in the Hereafter, but then you sent it to me. Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You sell it and meet your need (with its proceeds).
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne riwayat ki: Umar bin al-Khattab ne bazaar mein bikta hua ek resham ka kapda paaya; unhone ise khareeda aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise le lijiye aur khud ko iss se sajaaiye Id (ke dinon) mein aur numainda mandal ke liye. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye us shakhs ka pahnaava hai jiska koi hissa nahi hai (Aakhirat mein). Umar wahan Thehre rahe jitni der Allah ne chaaha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe ek resham ka chogha bheja. Umar ise lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne kaha tha ki ye us shakhs ka pahnaava hai jiska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hai, lekin phir aapne ise mere paas bheja. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise becho aur apni zaroorat poori karo (iski keemat se).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: lbn 'Umar reported that 'Umar saw a person of the tribe of 'Utirid selling a garment made of brocade or silk and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Would that you buy it? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: He who wears it has no share for him in the Hereafter. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented with a striped silk garment and he sent it to him ('Umar). He (, Umar) said: You sent it to me whereas I heard from you about it what you had to say, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: I sent it to you so that you may benefit by it.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Umar ne Utarid qabile ke ek shakhs ko brocade ya resham se bana ek kapda bechte dekha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Kaash aap ise khareed lein? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jo ise pehnta hai uska Aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi hoga. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dhaaridaar resham ka kapda pesh kiya gaya aur unhone ise unhe (Umar ko) bheja. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Aapne ise mujhe bheja jabki maine aapse iske baare mein suna jo aapko kehna tha, isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tum ismein se faayda uThA sako.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are that the Holy Prophet) said: I sent it to you so that you might derive benefit from it. but I did not send it to you to wear it.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath (aur alfaaz hain ki Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tum ismein se faayda uThA sako, lekin maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi bheja.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar saw a person with a garment of brocade and he brought it to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) -the rest of the hadith is the same, except for the words that he (the Holy Prophet) said: I sent it to you that you might get money thereby.
hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Umar ne ek shakhs ko brocade ke kapde ke saath dekha aur ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye - baaki hadees waisi hi hai, siwaay in alfaazon ke ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tumhe ismein se paisa mile.

e: Abdullah. the freed slave of Asma' (the daughter of Abu Bakr). the maternal uncle of the son of 'Ata, reported: Asma' sent me to 'Abdullah b. 'Umar saying: The news has reached me that you prohibit the use of three things: the striped robe. saddle cloth made of red silk. and the fasting in the holy month of Rajab. 'Abdullah said to me: So far as what you say about fasting in the month of Rajab, how about one who observes continuous fasting? -and so far as what you say about the striped garment, I heard Umar b. Khatab say that he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): He who wears silk garment has no share for him (in the Hereafter), and I am afraid it may not be that striped garment; and so far as the red saddle clotb is concerned that is the saddle cloth of Abdullah and it is red. I went back to Asma' and informed her. whereupon she said: Here is the cloak of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and she brought out to me that cloak made of Persian cloth with a hem of brocade, and its sleeves bordered with brocade and said: This wall Allah's Messenger's cloak with 'A'isha until she died, and when she died. I got possession of it. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to wear that, and we waslied it for the sick and sought cure thereby.
hi: Abdullah, Asma (Abu Bakr ki beti) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, Ata ke bete ke maama, ne riwayat ki: Asma ne mujhe Abdullah bin Umar ke paas bheja ye kehte hue: Mujhe khabar mili hai ki aap teen cheezon ke istemal se mana karte hain: dhaaridaar chogha, laal resham se bana zeen ki gaddi, aur muqaddas Rajab ke mahine mein roza. Abdullah ne mujhse kaha: Jahan tak Rajab ke mahine mein roza ka sawal hai, us shakhs ka kya jo lagataar roza rakhta hai? Aur jahan tak dhaaridaar kapde ka sawal hai, maine Umar bin Khattab ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna tha: Jo resham ka kapda pehanta hai uska (Aakhirat mein) koi hissa nahi hai, aur mujhe Dar hai ki ye kahin woh dhaaridaar kapda hi na ho; aur jahan tak laal zeen ki gaddi ka sawal hai woh Abdullah ki zeen ki gaddi hai aur woh laal hai. Main Asma ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe bataya, isper unhone kaha: Ye rahi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki cheddar, aur unhone Farsi kapde ki ek cheddar nikaali jismein brocade ki keenari thi, aur jiski baazuen brocade se banda thi, aur kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool ki cheddar Aisha ke paas thi jab tak unka intiqaal nahi hua, aur jab unka intiqaal hua, maine ise apne paas rakh liya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise pehante the, aur hum ise bimaaron ke liye dhote aur uski madad se shifaa talaash karte.

e: Khalifa b. Ka'b AbCi Dhubyan reported: I heard 'Abdullah b. Zubair addressing the people and saying: Behold! do not dress yuor women with silk clothes for I heard 'Umar b. Khattab as sayinp that he had heard Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not wear silk, for one who wear it in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter.
hi: Khalifa bin Ka'b Abu Dhubyan ne riwayat ki: Maine Abdullah bin Zubair ko logon se khitaab karte aur ye kehte suna: Dekho! Apni auraton ko resham ke kapde mat pehnaao kyunki maine Umar bin Khattab ko ye kehte suna tha ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Resham mat pehno, kyunki jo ise is duniya mein pehanta hai woh ise Aakhirat mein nahi pehanega.

e: 'Asim al-Abwal reported on the authority Abu Uthman saying: 'Umar wrote to us when we were in Adharba'ijan saying: 'Utba b. Farqad, this wealth is neither the result of your own labour nor the result of the labour of your father, nor the result of the labour of your mother, so feed Muslims at their own places as you feed (members of your family and yourselves at your own residence), and beware of the life of pleasure, and the dress of the polytheists and wearing of silk garments, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the wearing of silk garments, but only this much, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his. forefinger and middle finger and he joined. them (to indicate that only this much silk can be allowed in the dress of a man). 'Asim said also: This is what is recorded in the lette., (sent to us), and Zuhair raised his two fingers (to give an idea of the extent to which silk may be used).
hi: Asim al-Ahwal ne Abu Uthman ki sanad se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Umar ne humein likha jab hum Adharba'ijan mein the: Utba bin Farqad, ye daulat na tumhare khud ke amal ka natija hai, na tumhare waalid ke amal ka, na tumhari maa ke amal ka, is liye Musalmaanon ko unki apni jagahon par waisa hi khilaao jaisa tum (apne khaandaan ke sadasyon ko aur khud ko) apni khud ki jagah par khilaate ho, aur aish-o-araam ki zindagi se, aur mushrikeen ke pahnaave se, aur resham ke kapde pehnne se bacho, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham ke kapde pehnne se mana kiya, lekin sirf itna, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni pehli ungli aur beech ki ungli uThAyi aur unhe milaaya (ye bataane ke liye ki ek aadmi ke pahnaave mein sirf itna hi resham ijazat diya jaa sakta hai). Asim ne ye bhi kaha: Ye woh hai jo khat mein darj hai (jo humein bheja gaya), aur Zuhair ne apni do ungliyaan uThAyin (ye idea dene ke liye ki resham kis had tak istemal kiya jaa sakta hai).

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Asim.
hi: Ye hadees Asim ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu 'Uthman reported: While we were with 'Utba b. Farqad there came a letter of 'Umar (containing the instructions) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: None should wear silk (with the exception of so much) but he will have nothing of it in the Hereafter. Abu 'Uthman said: To the extent of two fingers which are close to the thumb, and I was shown the (silk) borders of the Tayalisa mantle (which were about two fingers in breadth and I saw them.
hi: Abu Uthman ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Utba bin Farqad ke saath the wahan Umar ka ek khat aaya (jismein ye hidayat the) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Kisi ko resham nahi pehnna chahiye (siwaay itna) lekin uska Aakhirat mein isse kuch nahi hoga. Abu Uthman ne kaha: Do ungliyon ki had tak jo anguthe ke paas hain, aur mujhe Tayalisa chogha ki (resham ki) keenariyaan dikhaayi gayin (jo lagbhag do ungli chaudi thin) aur maine unhe dekha.

e: The previous hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Pichhli hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Qatada reported: I heard Abe 'Uthman al-Nahdi as saying: There came to us a letter of 'Umar as we were in Adharba'ijan or in Syria in the company of 'Utba b. Farqad (and the letter ran thus): After (usual praise and glorification of Allah) it is stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden the use of silk btit to the extent of these two fingers, and Abu Uthman said: We at once understood by these words that he meant (silk) patterns on (the cloth).
hi: Qatada ne riwayat ki: Maine Abu Uthman al-Nahdi ko ye kehte suna: Humare paas Umar ka ek khat aaya jab hum Adharba'ijan mein the ya Syria mein Utba bin Farqad ki sohbat mein (aur khat is tarah tha): (Aam tareef aur Allah ki hamd ke baad) ye kaha gaya hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham ke istemal se mana kiya siwaay in do ungliyon ki had tak, aur Abu Uthman ne kaha: Humein turant in alfaazon se samajh aaya ki unka matlab tha (resham ke) design (kapde par).

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada but there is no mention of the words of Abd Uthman.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin Abu Uthman ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Suwaid b. Ghafala said: 'Umar addressed us at a place known as Jabiya (Syria) and he said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade us the wearing of silk but to the extent of two or three fingers or four fingers.
hi: Suwaid bin Ghafala ne kaha: Umar ne humein Jabiya (Syria) naam ki jagah par khitaab kiya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein resham pehnne se mana kiya, siwaay do ya teen ungliyon ya chaar ungliyon ki had tak.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that one day Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) put on a cloak made of brocade, which had been presented to him. He then quickly put it off and sent it to 'Umar b. Khattab, and it was said to him: Messenger of Allah. why is it that you put it of immediately. whereupon he said: Gabriel forbade me from it (i. e. wearing of Ods garment), and 'Umar came to him weeping and said: Messenger of Allah you disapproved a thing but you gave it to me. What about me, then? Thereupon be (the Holy Prophet) Wd: I did not give it to you to wear it, but I gave you that you might sell it; and so he (Hadrat Umar) sold it for two thousand dirhams.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne brocade se bana ek chogha pehna, jo unhe tohfe mein diya gaya tha. Unhone phir ise turant utaar diya aur ise Umar bin Khattab ko bhej diya, aur unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise hai ki aapne ise turant utaar diya, isper unhone kaha: Jibril ne mujhe isse (yaani ye kapda pehnne se) mana kiya, aur Umar unke paas roate hue aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool aapko ek cheez pasand nahi thi lekin aapne ise mujhe de diya. Phir mera kya? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi diya, lekin maine tumhe ye diya taaki tum ise bech sako; aur is tarah unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) ise do hazaar dirham mein becha.

e: 'Ali reported: A silk cloak was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and he sent it to me and I wore it. but then found some sign of disapproval upon his face, whereupon he said: I did not send it to you that you wear it, but I sent it to you so that you might tear it and make out head dream for your women.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek resham ka chogha pesh kiya gaya, aur unhone ise mujhe bheja aur maine ise pehna, lekin phir unke chehre par kuch napasandeegi ke chinh paaye, isper unhone kaha: Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi bheja, lekin maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tum ise faaD kar apni auraton ke liye sar dhaanpne wale kapde bana sako.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Ja'far but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Ja'far ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ali reported that Ukaidir of Duma presented to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a silk garment, and he presented it to 'Ali. and said: Tear it to make head covering for Fitimas out of it. This tradition is transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr, and Abu Kuraib said: Among the women.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Duma ke Ukaidir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek resham ka kapda pesh kiya, aur unhone ise Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko diya, aur kaha: Ise faaD do Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke liye sar dhaanpne wale kapde banane ke liye. Ye riwayat Abu Bakr ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Abu Kuraib ne kaha: Auraton ke beech.

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me to wear a garment in the form of silk cloak. I went out wearing it, but saw signs of anger on his face, so I tore it and distributed it amongst my women.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe resham ke chogha ke soorat mein ek kapda diya. Main use pehankar bahar gaya, lekin maine unke chehre par gusse ke chinh dekhe, is liye maine ise faaD diya aur apni auraton ke beech baant diya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may Peace be upon him) sent a silk gown to 'Umar, whereupon 'Umar said: You sent it to me whereas you said what you had to, say (i. e. it is forbidden for men). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: I did not send it to you so that you might wear it, but I sent it to you so that you might derive benefit from its price.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek resham ka pahnaava Umar ko bheja, isper Umar ne kaha: Aapne ise mujhe bheja jabki aapne wahi kaha jo aapko kehna tha (yaani ye mardon ke liye mana hai). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Maine ise tumhe pehnne ke liye nahi bheja, lekin maine ise tumhe is liye bheja taaki tum iski keemat se faayda uThA sako.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who wore silk in this world would not wear it in the Hereafter.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai woh ise Aakhirat mein nahi pehanega.

e: Abu Umama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who wore silk in this world would not wear it in the Hereafter.
hi: Abu Umama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai woh ise Aakhirat mein nahi pehanega.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir said: A silk go vn was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he wore it and observed prayer in it and then returned and put it off so violently as if he despised it. He then said: It does not befit the Godfearing persons.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek resham ka pahnaava pesh kiya gaya aur unhone ise pehana aur usmein namaz padhi aur phir wapas aaye aur ise itni sakhti se utaara jaise woh ise napasand kar rahe hon. Phir unhone kaha: Ye Allah se darne walon ke liye munasib nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of azid b. Abu Habib with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Abu Habib ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported to them (his companions) that Allah's Messnger (ﷺ) had granted concession to Abd al-Rahman b. *Anf and Zubair b. 'Awwam for the wearing of a silk shirt during the journey and because of itch which they both had or any other disease from which both of them had been suffering.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne unhe (apne sahaba ko) bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abd al-Rahman bin Auf aur Zubair bin Awwam ko chhoot di safar ke daurane resham ka kurta pehnne ki aur unke khaaj ki wajah se jo unhe thi ya kisi doosri bimaari ki wajah se jisse woh donon pareshaan the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" journey".
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin "safar" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted concession, or Zubair b. Awwam and 'Abd Al-Rahman b. Auf were granted concession, for the wearing of silk because of the itch that they both had.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chhoot di, ya Zubair bin Awwam aur Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ko chhoot di gayi, resham pehnne ki khaaj ki wajah se jo unhe thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf and Zu'bair. b. 'Awwam complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about lice; he granted them concession to wear shirts of silk.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Abd al-Rahman bin Auf aur Zubair bin Awwam ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se juonon ki shikaayat ki; unhone unhe resham ke kurte pehnne ki chhoot di.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-As reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw me wearing two clothes dyed in saffron. whereupon he said: These are the clothes (usually worn by) the non-believers, so do not wear them.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe zafraan (kesar) mein ranga hua do kapda pehne dekha, isper unhone kaha: Ye ghair-imaandaaron ke (aam taur par pehne jaane wale) kapde hain, is liye unhe mat pehno.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of trarnmitteis.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw me in two clothes dyed in saffron, whereupon he said: Has your mother ordered you to do so? And I said: I will wash them. He said: But burn them.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe zafraan mein ranga hua do kapda pehne dekha, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhari maa ne tumhe aisa karne ka hukum diya? Aur maine kaha: Main unhe dhoonga. Unhone kaha: Balki unhe jalaa do.

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade wearing of silk and yellow clothes, and the gold ring, and the reciting of the Qur'an in the ruku' (state of kneeling in prayer).
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham aur peele kapdon, aur sone ki anguThi, aur Ruku (namaz mein jhukne ki mudra) mein Quran padhne se mana kiya.

e: Ali b. Abu Talib reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade me to recite the Qur'an while I am in ruku; and the wearing of gold and clothes dyed in saffron.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Ruku mein Quran padhne se mana kiya; aur sone aur zafraan mein ranga hua kapdon (istemal karne) se.

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade me to use gold rings. to wear silk clothes and to recite the Qur'an in ruku' and sajda (prostration), and to wear yellow garments.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe sone ki anguThiyaan istemal karne, resham ke kapde pehnne aur Ruku aur Sajda (sajdaa) mein Quran padhne, aur peele kapde pehnne se mana kiya.

e: Qatada said: We asked Anas b. Malik which garment did Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) love or like (to wear). He said: The mantle of Yemen.
hi: Qatada ne kaha: Humne Anas bin Malik se poocha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kaunsa kapda sabse zyada aziz tha ya pasand tha. Unhone kaha: Yemen ka chogha.

e: Anas reported that the garment most liked by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the mantle of Yemen.
hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse zyada pasand kapda Yemen ka chogha tha.

e: Abu Burda reported: I visited A'isha and she brought out for us the coarse lower garfnent (of Allah's Messenger) made in Yemen and clothes made out of Mulabbada cloth, and she swore in the name of Allah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died in these two clothes.
hi: Abu Burda ne riwayat ki: Main Aisha se milne gaya aur unhone humare liye (Allah ke Rasool ka) khadada neechla kapda nikaala jo Yemen mein banaaya gaya tha aur Mulabbada kapde se bane kapde, aur unhone Allah ke naam par qasam khayi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in do kapdon mein intiqaal kar gaye.

e: Abu Burda reported that A'isha brought out for us the lower garment and the upper garment made of the Mulabbada cloth and said: It was in these (clothes) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. Ibn Hatim (one of the narrators) in his narration Wd: The lower garment of coarse cloth.
hi: Abu Burda ne riwayat ki ki Aisha ne humare liye neechla kapda aur Mulabbada kapde se bana upari kapda nikaala aur kaha: Ye woh (kapde) the jinme Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua. Ibn Hatim (raawiyon mein se ek) ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Khadada kapde ka neechla hissa.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ayyub with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went out one morning wearing a blanket made of (camel's or sheep's) black hair with patterns of camel saddles upon it.
hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek subah (kaale) baal (oont ya bhed) se bana ek kambal pehankar bahar gaye jispar oont ki zeen ki gaddi ke design bane hue the.

e: A'isha reported that the pillow on which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reclined was of leather stuffed with palm fibre.
