hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jis takiye par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tek lagaate the woh chamde ka tha jismein khajoor ke reshe bhare hue the.

e: A'isha reported that the bedding on which. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept was made of leather stuffed with palm fibre.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jis bistar par Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sote the woh chamde ka bana tha jismein khajoor ke reshe bhare hue the.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported: When I was married, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) asked me if I had got the carpet. I said: How can we have carpets? (i. e. I am so poor that I cannot even think of carpets). whereupon he said: You shall soon possess them.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Jab meri shaadi hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse poocha ki kya mere paas galeecha hai. Maine kaha: Humare paas galeecha kahan se hoga? (Yaani main itna gareeb hoon ki main galeeche ke baare mein soch bhi nahi sakta.) Isper unhone kaha: Tumhe jald hi mil jaayenge.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: When I was married. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me if I had got carpets. I said: How can we have carpets? Thereupon he said: You will soon have. Jabir said: My wife had possessed a carpet, and I said to her to remove that away from me, but she would say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: You will soon have.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Jab meri shaadi hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse poocha ki kya mujhe galeeche mile. Maine kaha: Humare paas galeeche kahan se hoge? Isper unhone kaha: Tumhe jald hi mil jaayenge. Jabir ne kaha: Meri zauja ke paas ek galeecha tha, aur maine unse kaha ki ise mere paas se hataao, lekin woh kehtin: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Tumhe jald hi mil jaayenge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the saule chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messengor (ﷺ) said: There should be a bedding for a man. a bedding for his wife and the third one for the guest, and the fourth one is for the Satan.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek aadmi ke liye ek bistar hona chahiye, uski zauja ke liye ek bistar, aur teesra mehmaan ke liye, aur chauthaa Shaitaan ke liye hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Allah will not look upon him who trails his garment out of pride.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah us shakhs ki taraf nahi dekhega jo apna kapda garv se zameen par ghaseeta hue chalta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through other chains of transmitters also with the addition of these words: " On the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se doosri sanadon se in alfaazon ke izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Qayamat ke din."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who trails his (lower) garment out of pride, Allah will not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo apna (neechla) kapda garv se ghaseeta hai, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who trailed his garment out of pride, Allah would not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne apna kapda garv se ghaseeta, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.

e: Salim reported: I heard Ibn Umar as saying that he had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying like this (as mentioned above) but with a slight variation of wording .
hi: Salim ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi jaisi baat kehte suna (jaisa upar bataya gaya) lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Muslim b. Yannaq reported that Ibn Umar saw a person trailing his lower garment, whereupon he said: From whom do you come? He described his relationship (with the tribe he belonged) and it was found that he belonged to the tribe of Laith. Ibn. Umar recognised him and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with these two ears of mine saying: He who trailed his lower garment with no other intention but pride, Allah would not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Muslim bin Yannaq ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne ek shakhs ko apna neechla kapda ghaseette dekha, isper unhone kaha: Tum kis (khaandaan) se ho? Usne apna rishta bataya aur pata chala ki woh Laith qabile se hai. Ibn Umar ne use pehchaana aur kaha: Maine apne in do kaanon se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne apna neechla kapda sirf garv se ghaseeta koi doosri niyat nahi thi, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muslim b. Yannaq through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Muslim bin Yannaq ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Muhammad b. 'Abbad b. Ja'far reported: I ordered Muslim b. Yasar, the freed slave of Nafi' b. 'Abd al-Harith, while I was sitting between them, that he should ask Ibn 'Umar if he had heard anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to one who trails his lower garment out of pride. He said: I heard him (the Holy Prophet) as saying: Allah will not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Muhammad bin Abbad bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya: Maine Muslim bin Yasar (Nafi bin Abd al-Harith ke aazad kiye hue ghulam) ko hukum diya, jab main unke beech baitha tha, ki woh Ibn Umar se poochhein ki kya unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch suna hai us shakhs ke baare mein jo apna neechla kapda garv se ghaseetta hai. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) ye kehte suna: Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I happened to pass before Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon bin) with my lower garment trailing (upon the ground). He said: 'Abdullah, tug up your lower garment,, I tugged it up, and he again said: Tug it still further, and I tugged it still further and I went on tugging it afterward, whereupon some of the people said: To what extent? Thereupon he said: To the middle of the shanks.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne se apna neechla kapda ghaseette hue guzra. Unhone kaha: Abdullah, apna neechla kapda upar kheencho. Maine ise upar kheencha, aur unhone dobara kaha: Ise aur upar kheencho, aur maine ise aur upar kheencha aur baad mein bhi kheenchta raha, isper kuch logon ne kaha: Kahan tak? Isper unhone kaha: Pindaliyon ke beech tak.

e: Abu Huraire reported that he saw a person whose lower garment bad been trailin. and he was striking the ground with his foot (conceitedly). He was the Amir of Bahrain and it was being said: Here comes the Amir, here comes the Amir. He (Abu Huraira) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah will not look toward him who trails his lower garment out of pride.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek shakhs ko dekha jiska neechla kapda ghaseet raha tha, aur woh apne paon se zameen thok raha tha (garv se). Woh Bahrain ke Amir the aur kaha jaa raha tha: Ye rahe Amir, ye rahe Amir. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah us shakhs ki taraf nahi dekhega jo apna neechla kapda garv se ghaseetta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn ja'far (the words are): Marwan had made Abu Huraira as his deputy. and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna (the words are). Abu Huraira was the Governor of Medina.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Ibn Ja'far ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Marwan ne Abu Huraira ko apna numainda banaya tha. Aur Ibn Muthanna ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Abu Huraira Madina ke gavarnar the.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that there was a person who used to walk with pride because of his thick hair and fine mantles. He was made to sink in the earth and he would go on sinking in the earth until the Last Hour would come.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha ki ek shakhs tha jo apne moTe baalon aur behtareen chogho ki wajah se garv se chalta tha. Use zameen mein dhansaaya gaya aur woh zameen mein dhansta hi jaayega jab tak Qayamat na aa jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira but with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was a person who walked with pride because of his (fine) mantles and well pleased with his personality. Allah made him sink in the earth and he would go on sinking in that until the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs tha jo apne (behtareen) chogho ki wajah se aur apni shakhsiyat se santusht hokar garv se chalta tha. Allah ne use zameen mein dhansaaya aur woh usmein dhansta rahega Qayamat ke din tak.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with a slight variation of wording: While there was a man who strutted in his two mantles.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Ek aadmi tha jo apne do chogho mein akad ke saath chalta tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was a person (living before you) who took pride in his cloak. the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs (tumse pehle) tha jise apne chogha par garv tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the wearing of gold signet ring.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ki angoothi pehnne se mana kiya.

e: The previous hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Pichhli hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a person wearing a gold signet ring in his hand. He (the Holy Prophet) pulled it off and threw it away, saying: One of you is wishing live coal from Hell. and putting it on his hand. It was said to the person after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had left: Take your signet ring (of gold) and derive benefit out of it. whereupon he said: No, by Allah, I would never take it when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has thrown it away.
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko apne haath mein sone ki angoothi pehne dekha. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) use nikaal kar phenk diya aur kaha: Tum mein se koi jahannam ka jalta hua koyla chaahta hai, aur ise apne haath mein pehanta hai. Us shakhs ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jaane ke baad kaha gaya: Apni (sone ki) angoothi le lo aur isse faayda uthao, isper usne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi nahi lunga jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise phenk diya hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upol him) got fashioned a signet ring of gold but he kept its stone on the inner side of his palm as he wore it, so the people (following his example) got fashioned (such rings). Then one day as he sat on the pulpit he pulled it away saying: I wore this ring and kept its stone towards the inner side. He then threw it away, and said: By Allah, I will never wear it; so the people threw their rings away.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sone ki ek angoothi banwaayi lekin uska pathhar apni hatheli ke andaruni hisse par rakha jab woh use pehante, is liye log (unka anusaran karte hue) aisi hi angoothiyaan banwaane lage. Phir ek din jab woh mimbar par baithe the unhone use nikaal diya ye kehte hue: Maine ye angoothi pehni thi aur iska pathhar andaruni taraf rakha tha. Phir unhone ise phenk diya, aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, main ise kabhi nahi pehnunga; is liye log ne apni angoothiyaan phenk din.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se doosri sanadon se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has also been likewise narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through several other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees isi tarah Ibn Umar ki sanad se kayi doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made for himself a ring of silver, and he (wore it in his finger). then it was in Abu Bakr's finger. then it was in'Umar's finger. then it was in 'Uthman's finger. until it fell into the well of Aris and it had these words engraved upon it (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah). Ibn Numair narrated it with a slight variation of words.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne liye chandi ki ek angoothi banwaayi thi, aur unhone use (apni ungli mein) pehna. Phir ye Abu Bakr ki ungli mein rahi. Phir ye Umar ki ungli mein rahi. Phir ye Uthman ki ungli mein rahi, yahan tak ki ye Aris ke kuen mein gir gayi aur ismein ye alfaaz khode hue the (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool). Ibn Numair ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had made for himself a gold ring; then he discarded it, and then made for himself a silver ring, and had these words engraved upon it (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah), and said: No one should engrave anything like the engraving of this signet ring of mine. And when he wore it, he kept its stone towards the inside of his palm, and it was this which fell down (from the hands) of Mu'ayqib into the well of Aris.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne liye ek sone ki angoothi banwaayi thi; phir unhone ise chhod diya, aur phir apne liye chandi ki ek angoothi banwaayi, aur ismein ye alfaaz khodwaaye (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool), aur kaha: Koi bhi mere is angoothi ke khodne jaisa kuch na khode. Aur jab unhone ise pehna, unhone iska pathhar apni hatheli ke andaruni taraf rakha, aur yehi woh angoothi thi jo Mu'ayqib ke (haathon se) Aris ke kuen mein gir gayi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had made for him a silver ring. and got engraved on it (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah) and said to the people I have got made a ring of silver and engraved in it (these words) (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah). So none should engrave these (words) like this engravement.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye chandi ki ek angoothi banwaayi thi, aur ismein (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool) khodwaaya aur logon se kaha: Maine chandi ki ek angoothi banwaayi hai aur ismein (ye alfaaz) khodwaaye hain (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool). Is liye koi bhi is khodai jaisa kuch na khode.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the words (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah) in it.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool) alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to write letters to the Byzantine (Emperor) they (his Companions) told him that they would not read a letter unless it is sealed. (Then) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a silver ring made (for himself), (its shape is so vivid in my mind) as if I see its brightness in the band of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and its engravement was (Muhammad, Messenger of Allah).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Byzantine (Samraat) ko khat likhne ka faisla kiya, unhone (unke sahaba ne) unse kaha ki woh khat tab tak nahi padhenge jab tak use muhar na lagi ho. (Phir) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne liye) chandi ki angoothi banwaayi (iska aakaar mere zehan mein itna spasht hai) ki mujhe lagta hai main iski chamak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein dekh raha hoon, aur ismein khodai thi (Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool).

e: Anas reported that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) decided to write (letters) to non-Arabs (i. e. Persian and Byzantine Emperors) it was said to him that the non-Arabs would not accept a letter but that having a seal over it; so he (the Holy Prophet) got a silver ring made. He (Anas) said: I perceive as if I am looking at its brightness in his hand.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghair-Arab (yaani Persia aur Byzantine Samraaton) ko khat likhne ka faisla kiya, unse kaha gaya ki ghair-Arab bina muhar lagi kisi khat ko qubool nahi karenge; is liye unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) chandi ki angoothi banwaayi. Unhone (Anas ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai jaise main uski chamak unke haath mein dekh raha hoon.

e: Anas reported that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) decided to write to the Kisra (the King of Persia), Caesar (Emperor of Rome), and the Negus (the Emperor of Abyssinia), it was said to him that they would not accept the letter without the seal over it; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got a seal made, the ring of which was made of silver and there was engraved on it: "Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah."
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kisra (Persia ke raja), Caesar (Rome ke samraat), aur Negus (Abyssinia ke samraat) ko likhne ka faisla kiya, unse kaha gaya ki woh khat ko bina muhar ke qubool nahi karenge; is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek muhur banwaayi, jiski angoothi chandi ki thi aur ismein khoda gaya tha: "Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool."

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I saw one day on the finger of Allah's Messenger (may peace be Upon him) a silver ring; so the people also got silver rings made and wore them Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) discarded his ring, and the people also discarded their rings.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungli mein chandi ki angoothi dekhi; is liye log ne bhi chandi ki angoothiyaan banwaayin aur unhe pehna. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni angoothi chhod di, aur log ne bhi apni angoothiyaan chhod din.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that one day he saw on the finger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a silver ring, and the people also made silver rings and put them on. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) threw his ring away, and so the people also threw away their rings.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek din unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungli mein chandi ki angoothi dekhi, aur log ne bhi chandi ki angoothiyaan banwaayin aur unhe pehna. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni angoothi phenk di, aur log ne bhi apni angoothiyaan phenk din.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the ring of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was made of silver and it had an Abyssinian stone in it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki angoothi chandi ki bani thi aur ismein ek Abyssinian pathhar tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wore a silver ring on his right hand which had an Abyssinian stone in it, and he kept its stone towards the palm.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne daaye haath mein chandi ki angoothi pehante the jismein ek Abyssinian pathhar tha, aur woh iska pathhar hatheli ki taraf rakhte the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus b. Yazid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus bin Yazid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that the ring of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was on this, and he pointed toward the little finger of his left hand.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki angoothi is (ungli) par thi, aur unhone apne baaye haath ki chhoti ungli ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Ali reported: He the Prophet (ﷺ), forbade me that I should wear my ring in this (forefinger) or in that near it. 'Asim (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: He did not remember which of the two (fingers) he pointed out; and he forbade to wear Qassi material (silk garments), and to sit on the silk saddle cloth, and he said: As regards Qassi, it is a variegated garment which was brought from Egypt and Syria which had figures upon it, and as regards Mayathir, it is something which women prepared for their husbands as red cloths for their saddles.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Unhone (Nabi ne) mujhe mana kiya ki main apni angoothi is (tarjani ungli) mein ya iske paas waali mein pehanun. Asim (sanad ke raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Unhe yaad nahi tha ki unhone in do (ungliyon) mein se kaunsi ki taraf ishara kiya; aur unhone Qassi kapda (resham ke kapde) pehnne se aur resham ki zeen ki chaadar par baithne se mana kiya, aur kaha: Jahan tak Qassi ka sawal hai, ye ek rangbirangi kapda hai jo Egypt aur Syria se laayi jaati thi jismein akritiyaan hoti thin, aur jahan tak Mayathir ka sawal hai, ye kuch aisa hai jo auraten apne shohar ke liye laal kapde ke soorat mein unki zeen ke liye taiyaar karti thin.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of 'Ali through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported that he (Allah'. s Apostle) forbade or forbade me. the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) mana kiya ya mujhe mana kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Ali reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade me that I should wear a ring in this and that finger of mine, and he pointed to the middle finger and the next one.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe mana kiya ki main apni angoothi is aur us ungli mein pehanun, aur unhone beech ki ungli aur uske paas waali ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying during an expedition in which we also participated: Make a general practice of wearing sandals, for a man is riding as it were when he wears sandals.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek muhim ke daurane jismein hum bhi shaamil the, ye kehte suna: Chappal pehnna aam bataao, kyunki ek aadmi jab chappal pehanta hai to woh gaya sawaari kar raha ho jaisa lagta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: "When one of you puts on sandals, he should first put in the right foot, and when he takes off he should take off the left one first. And he should wear both of them or take both off."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi chappal pehante hai, use pehle daaya paon rakhna chahiye, aur jab woh utaarta hai use pehle baaya paon utaarna chahiye. Aur use donon pehanne chahiye ya donon utaarne chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should walk in one sandal; either he should wear the two or should take off the two.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi ek chappal mein na chale; use ya to donon pehanne chahiye ya donon utaarne chahiye.

e: Abu Razin reported: Abu Huraira came to us and he struck his forehead with his hand and said: Behold I you talk amongst yourself that I attribute wrongly to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (certain things) in order to guide you to the right path. In such a case, I would myself go astray. Listen. I bear testimony to the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: When the thong of any one of you is broken, he should not walk in the second one until he has got it repaired.
hi: Abu Razin ne bayan kiya: Abu Huraira humare paas aaye aur unhone apni peshaani apne haath se thoki aur kaha: Dekho! Tum aapas mein baat karte ho ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam par galat cheezein manzoob karta hoon taaki tumhe sahi raah dikha sakoon. Aisi haalat mein, main khud gumraah ho jaaunga. Suno. Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se kisi ki chappal ka fita toot jaaye, use tab tak doosre mein na chale jab tak use theek na kara le.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that a man should eat with the left hand or walk with one sandal or wrap himself completely leaving no opening for the arms (to draw out) or support himself when sitting with a single garment wrapped round his knees which may expose his private parts.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki koi shakhs baaye haath se khaaye ya ek chappal mein chale ya khud ko poori tarah lapet le bina baahon (ke nikaalne) ke liye koi khula chhode ya baithte waqt khud ko ek hi kapde se sahaara de jo unke ghutnon ke aas-paas lipta ho jo unke gupt ang khol sakta hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the thong of the shoe of any one of you is cut off. he should not walk with one sandal until he has got the thong repaired, and he should not walk with one shoe and he should not eat with his left hand and should not wrap his cloth round his knees or wrap himself completely leaving no room for the arms.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se kisi ke joote ka fita kat jaaye, use tab tak ek chappal mein nahi chalna chahiye jab tak use theek na kara le, aur use ek joote mein bhi nahi chalna chahiye, aur use baaye haath se nahi khaana chahiye aur apna kapda apne ghutnon ke aas-paas nahi lapetna chahiye ya khud ko poori tarah lapetna nahi chahiye bina baahon (ke nikaalne) ke liye koi jagah chhode.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the wrapping of oneself completely leaving no room for the arm and supporting oneself when sitting with a single garment wrapped round one's knees and a person raising one of his feet and placing it on the other while lying on his back.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko poori tarah lapetne se mana kiya bina baahon ke liye koi jagah chhode, aur baithte waqt khud ko ek hi kapde se sahaara dene se jo ghutnon ke aas-paas lipta ho, aur kisi shakhs ke zariye apna ek paon uthaakar doosre par rakhne se jab woh peeth ke bal leta ho.

e: Jabir. b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not walk in one sandal and do not wrap the lower garment round your knees and do not eat with your left hand and do not wrap yourself completely leaving no room for the arms (to draw out) and do not place one of your feet upon the other while lying on your back.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek chappal mein mat chalo aur apna neechla kapda apne ghutnon ke aas-paas mat lapeTo aur apne baaye haath se mat khaao aur khud ko poori tarah mat lapeTo bina baahon (ke nikaalne) ke liye koi jagah chhoDe aur apna ek paon doosre par mat rakho jab tum peeth ke bal leTe ho.

e: Jalbir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should lie on his back and place one of his feet upon the other.
hi: Jalbir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi peeth ke bal na leTe aur apna ek paon doosre par na rakhe.

e: 'Abbad b. Tamim reported from his uncle that he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying in the mosque and placing his one foot upon the other.
hi: Abbad bin Tamim ne apne chacha se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko masjid mein leTe hue dekha, apna ek paon doosre par rakhe hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitter.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) forbade dyeing (one's cloth or hair) in saffron. Hammad said that it pertains to men only.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kesar mein rangaai karne se mana kiya (apne kapde ya baalon ki). Hammad ne kaha ki ye sirf mardon par laagoo hota hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that a person should (wear) clothes dyed in saffron.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki koi shakhs kesar mein rangaaye gaye kapde (pehne).

e: Jabir reported that when Abu Qubafa (father of Abu Bakr) came in the yeu of Victory or on the Day of Victory (to the Prophet to pledge his allegiance to him) his head and his beard were white like hyssop. He (the Holy Prophet) commaded or the women were commanded by him that they should change this with something (that the colour of his hair should be changed).
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki jab Abu Qubafa (Abu Bakr ke waalid) Fatah ke saal ya Fatah ke din aaye (Nabi ke paas apni wafadaari ki qasam dene), unka sar aur unki daadhi hyssop (ek podha) jaisi safed thi. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) hukum diya ya auraton ko unke ke zariye hukum diya gaya ki woh ise kisi cheez se badle (ki unke baal ka rang badla jaaye).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Abu Qubafa was led (to the andience of the Holy Prophet) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca and his head and beard were white like hyssop, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Change it with something but avoid black.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Abu Qubafa ko Makkah ki Fatah ke din (Nabi-e-Paak ke saamne) laaya gaya aur unka sar aur daadhi hyssop jaisi safed thi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise kisi cheez se badlo lekin kaale rang se bacho.

e: Abu Horaira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Jews and the Christians do not dye (their hair), so oppose them.
hi: Abu Horaira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yahudi aur Isaayi (apne baal) nahi rangte, is liye unke virudh jaao.

e: A'isha reported that Gabriel (peace be upon him) made a promise with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. And there was in his hand (in the hand of Allah's Apostle) a staff. He threw it from his hand and said: Never has Allah or His messengers (angels) ever broken their promise. Then he cast a glance (and by chance) found a puppy under his cot and said: 'A'isha, when did this dog enter here? She said: By Allah, I don't know He then commanded and it was turned out. Then Gabriel came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: You promised me and I waited for you, but you did not come, whereupon he said: It was the dog in your house which prevented me (to come), for we (angels) do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Jibril (dono par shaanti ho) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek muayyan waqt par aane ka vaada kiya; woh waqt aaya lekin woh unse milne nahi aaye. Aur unke (Allah ke Rasool ke) haath mein ek lathi thi. Unhone use apne haath se phenka aur kaha: Kabhi bhi Allah ya Uske farishte apna vaada nahi todte. Phir unhone ek nazar daali aur (achaanak) unke charpai ke neeche ek pilla paaya aur kaha: Aisha, ye kutta yahan kab aaya? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata. Unhone phir hukum diya aur use bahar nikaala gaya. Phir Jibril aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Aapne mujhse vaada kiya aur main aapka intezaar karta raha, lekin aap nahi aaye, isper unhone kaha: Ye aapke ghar mein kutta tha jisne mujhe (aane se) roka, kyunki hum (farishte) us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya tasveer ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Hazim with the same chain of transmitters that Gabriel had promised Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he would come; the rest of the hadith is the same, but it is not so lengthy as the other one.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Hazim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Jibril ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se vaada kiya tha ki woh aayenge; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin ye doosri jitni lambi nahi hai.

e: Maimuna reported that one morning Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was silent with grief. Maimuna said: Allah's Messenger, I find a change in your mood today. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Gabriel had promised me that he would meet me tonight, but he did not meet me. By Allah, he never broke his promises, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spent the day in this sad (mood). Then it occurred to him that there had been a puppy under their cot. He commanded and it was turned out. He then took some water in his hand and sprinkled it at that place. When it was evening Gabriel met him and he said to him: you promised me that you would meet me the previous night. He said: Yes, but we do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture. Then on that very morning he commanded the killing of the dogs until he announced that the dog kept for the orchards should also be killed, but he spared the dog meant for the protection of extensive fields (or big gardens).
hi: Maimuna ne bayan kiya ki ek subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dukh se khamosh the. Maimuna ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aaj main aapke mizaaj mein badlaav paati hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jibril ne mujhse vaada kiya tha ki woh aaj raat mujhse milenge, lekin woh nahi mile. Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi apna vaada nahi toDa, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne poora din is udaas (mizaaj) mein guzaara. Phir unhe khyaal aaya ki unke charpai ke neeche ek pilla tha. Unhone hukum diya aur use bahar nikaala gaya. Phir unhone apne haath mein kuch paani liya aur use us jagah chhidka. Jab shaam hui Jibril unse mile aur unhone (Nabi ne) unse kaha: Aapne mujhse vaada kiya tha ki aap pichhli raat mujhse milenge. Unhone kaha: Haan, lekin hum aise ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya tasveer ho. Phir usi subah unhone (Nabi ne) kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya yahan tak ki unhone ailaan kiya ki baagon ki dekhbhaal ke liye rakhe gaye kutte ko bhi maara jaaye, lekin unhone bade khetoon (ya bade baagon) ki hifaazat ke liye rakhe gaye kutte ko bakhsh diya.

e: Abu Talha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: Angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture.
hi: Abu Talha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte kisi aise ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya tasveer ho.

e: Abu Talha reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a dog or a statue.
hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein kutta ya moorti ho.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Tilha, the Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Verily, angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture. Busr reported: Zaid fell ill and we went to inquire after his health and (found) that there was hanging at his door a curtain with a picture on it. I said to 'Ubaidullah Khaulani who had been under the patronage of Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): Did not Zaid himself inform us before about (the Holy Prophet's command pertaining to the pictures), whereupon 'Ubaidullah said: Did you not hear when he said:" Except the prints on the cloth"?
hi: Abu Tilha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahabi, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan, farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ho. Busr ne bayan kiya: Zaid bimaar pad gaye aur hum unka haal poochne gaye aur (paaya) ki unke darwaze par ek parda latka hua tha jispar tasveer thi. Maine Ubaidullah Khaulani se kaha, jo Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ki sarparasti mein rahe the: Kya Zaid ne khud humein pehle nahi bataaya tha (tasveeron se mutaliq Nabi-e-Paak ke hukum ke baare mein), isper Ubaidullah ne kaha: Kya tumne nahi suna jab unhone kaha tha: "Siwaay kapde par chhape hue nishaanon ke"?

e: Abu Talha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Angels do not enter a house in which there is a picture. Busr said: Zaid b. Khalid fell sick and we visited him to inquire after his health. As we were in his house (we saw) a curtain having pictures on it. I said to 'Ubaidullah Khaulani: Did he not narrate to us (the Holy Prophet's command pertaining to pictures)? Thereupon he said: He in fact did that (but he also said): Except the prints upon the cloth. Did you not hear this? I said: No, whereupon He said: He had in fact made a mention of this.
hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ho. Busr ne kaha: Zaid bin Khalid bimaar pad gaye aur hum unka haal poochne gaye. Jab hum unke ghar mein the (humne dekha) ek parda jispar tasveerein thin. Maine Ubaidullah Khaulani se kaha: Kya unhone humein ye (Nabi-e-Paak ka tasveeron se mutaliq hukum) riwayat nahi ki? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone waaqai aisa kiya (lekin unhone ye bhi kaha): Siwaay kapde par chhape hue nishaanon ke. Kya tumne ye nahi suna? Maine kaha: Nahi, isper unhone kaha: Unhone waaqai iska zikr kiya tha.

e: Abu Talha Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or portraits. I came to 'A'isha and said to her: This is a news that I have received that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or a dog, (and further added) whether she had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) making a mention of it. She said: No (I did not hear this myself), but I narrate to you what I saw him doing. I bear testimony to the fact that he (the Holy Prophet) set out for an expedition. I took a carpet and screened the door with it. When he (the Holy Prophet) came back he saw that carpet and I perceived signs of disapproval on his face. He pulled it until it was torn or it was cut (into pieces) and he said: God has not commanded us to clothe stones and clay. We cut it (the curtain) and prepared two pillowa out of it by stuffing them with the fibre of date-palms and he (the Holy Prophet) did not find fault with it.
hi: Abu Talha Ansari ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ya moortiyaan ho. Main Aisha ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Ye khabar mujhe mili hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ya kutta ho, (aur aage poocha) ki kya unhone khud Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iska zikr karte suna hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi (maine khud ye nahi suna), lekin main tumhe riwayat karti hoon jo maine unhe karte dekha. Main is baat ki gawaahi deti hoon ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ek muhim ke liye prasthaan kiya. Maine ek galeecha liya aur usse darwaze ko dhaaka. Jab woh (Nabi-e-Paak) wapas aaye unhone woh galeecha dekha aur maine unke chehre par napasandeegi ke nishaan mahsoos kiye. Unhone use tab tak kheencha jab tak ye phaT gaya ya kaT gaya (tukdon mein) aur unhone kaha: Allah ne humein pattharon aur mitti ko kapde pahanaane ka hukum nahi diya. Humne ise (parde ko) kaata aur ismein se khajoor ke reshe bhar kar do takiye banaaye aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) isme koi kami nahi paayi.

e: A'isha reported: We had a curtain with us which had portraits of birds upon it. Whenever a visitor came, he found them in front of him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Change them, for whenever I enter the room) I see them and it brings to my mind (the pleasures) of worldly life. She said: We had with us a sheet which had silk badges upon it and we used to wear it. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna but with this addition: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not command us to tear that."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Humare paas ek parda tha jismein parindon ki tasveerein thin. Jab bhi koi mehmaan aata, use ye unke saamne dikhti. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Inhe badlo, kyunki jab bhi main (kamre mein) daakhil hota hoon main inhe dekhta hoon aur ye mere zehan mein duniyaavi zindagi (ki khushiyaan) le aata hai. Unhone kaha: Humare paas ek chaadar thi jismein resham ki paTiyan thin aur hum ise pehanate the. Ye hadees Ibn Muthanna ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein use phaadne ka hukum nahi diya."

e: A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from the journey and I had screened my door with a curtain having portraits of winged horses upon it. He commanded me and I pulled it away.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aaye aur maine apna darwaza ek parde se dhaaka tha jismein paron waale ghodon ki tasveerein thin. Unhone mujhe hukum diya aur maine ise hataa diya.

e: This hadith has been narrpted on the authority of Waki' with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Waki ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (my apartment) and I had hung (on the door of my apartment) a thin curtain having pictures on it. The colour of his face underwent a change. He then took hold of that curtain and tore it and then said: The most grievous torfnent for the people on the Day of Resurrection would be for those who try to imitate Allah in the act of creation.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (mere kamre mein) daakhil hue aur maine (apne kamre ke darwaze par) ek patla parda latkaaya tha jismein tasveerein thin. Unke chehre ka rang badal gaya. Phir unhone woh parda pakda aur use faad diya aur phir kaha: Qayamat ke din logon ke liye sabse dukhdaayi saza un logon ke liye hogi jo Allah ki srijan ki kriya ki nakal karne ki koshish karte hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording (and the variation is that the narrator is reported to have said): He (the Holy Prophet) inclined towards that curtain and tore it with his hand.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur antar ye hai ki raawi ne kaha): Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) us parde ki taraf jhukav dikhaya aur use apne haath se faad diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me. and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hangin. over it and on which there were portraits. No sooner did he see it than he tore it and the colour of his face underwent a change and he said: A'isha, the most grievous torment from the Hand of Allah on the Day of Resurrection would be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation. A'isha said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye. Aur mere paas ek taakh thi jispar ek patla kapda parda latka hua tha jispar tasveerein thin. Jaise hi unhone ise dekha, unhone use faad diya aur unke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur unhone kaha: Aisha, Allah ke Haath se Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza un logon ko milegi jo (Allah ki) srijan kriya ki nakal karte hain. Aisha ne kaha: Humne ise tukdon mein faada aur isse ek ya do takiye banaaye.

e: A'isha reported she had a cloth havinc, pictures upon it and it was hanging upon the shelf and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take it (away) from me (from my sight), so I removed it and made cushions from that.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki unke paas ek kapda tha jismein tasveerein thin aur ye taakh par latka hua tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise mujhse (meri nazar se) hataao, is liye maine ise hataaya aur usse takiye banaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me when I had screened (my door) with a carpet having pictures on it. He removed it and we made cushions out of that.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab maine (apne darwaze ko) ek galeeche se dhaaka tha jismein tasveerein thin. Unhone ise hataaya aur humne isse takiye banaaye.

e: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported that she had hung a curtain which had pictures upon it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (the room) and he pulled it. A'isha said: I then tore it and prepared two cushions out of that. A person who was then in that company and whose name was Rabi'a b. 'Ata, the freed slave of Banu Zuhra, asked: Did you hear Abu Mabammad making a mention of A'isha having stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recline upon them? lbn al-Qasim said: No, but I heard Qasim b. Muhammad saying so.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek parda latkaaya tha jismein tasveerein thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (kamre mein) daakhil hue aur unhone ise kheencha. Aisha ne kaha: Maine phir ise faada aur isse do takiye banaaye. Us sabha mein maujood ek shakhs jiska naam Rabi'a bin Ata tha, Banu Zuhra ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne poocha: Kya aapne Abu Mabammad ko Aisha ke ye bayaan karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unpar tek lagaate the? Ibn al-Qasim ne kaha: Nahi, lekin maine Qasim bin Muhammad ko aisa kehte suna.

e: A'isha reported that she bought a carpet which had pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that, he stayed at the door and did not get in. I perceived or I was made to perceive upon his face signs of disgust. She said: Allah's Messenger, I offer repentance to Allah and His Messenger. (but tell me) what is the sin that I have committed. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is this carpet? She said: I bought it for you so that you might sit on it and take rest. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The owners of these pictures would be tormented and they would be asked to bring to life what they tried to create. He then said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek galeecha khareeda jismein tasveerein thin. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dekha, woh darwaze par ruke aur andar nahi gaye. Maine unke chehre par ghrina ke nishaan dekhe ya mujhe dekhaaye gaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Allah aur Uske Rasool se maafi maangti hoon (lekin mujhe bataaiye) maine kya gunah kiya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye galeecha kya hai? Unhone kaha: Maine ise aapke liye khareeda taaki aap ispar baith kar aaraam kar sakein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: In tasveeron ke maalikon ko saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega ki jo unhone banaaya use zinda karein. Phir unhone kaha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters also. Some of the other ahadith narrated through other chains of transmitters are more complete and there is an addition in them (transmitted through other chains of transmitters). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of the nephew of Majishun she (A'isha) is reported to have said: I took it and prepared two cushions out of that and he (the Holy Prophet) used to recline against them in the house.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi kuch aur hadeesein zyada mukammal hain aur unmein izafa hai (doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat kiya gaya). Majishun ke bhatije ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein unhone (Aisha ne) ye kaha bataya jaata hai: Maine ise liya aur usse do takiye banaaye aur woh (Nabi-e-Paak) ghar mein unpar tek lagaate the.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Those who paint pictures would be punished on the Day of Resurrection and it would be said to them: Breathe soul into what you have created.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo tasveerein banaate hain unhe Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega: Jo tumne banaaya hai usmein jaan phoonko.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Umar ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verity the most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. Ashajj (one of the narrators) in the hadith narrated by him did not make mention of the word" verity".
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza paane wale log tasveer banaane waale honge. Ashajj (raawiyon mein se ek) ne apni riwayat mein "yaqeenan" lafz zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Mu`awiya through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): "Verily, the most grievously tormented people amongst the denizens of Hell on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures." The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Yaqeenan, Jahannam ke bashindon mein se sabse dukhdaayi saza Qayamat ke din tasveer banaane walon ko milegi." Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Muslim b. Subaih reported: I was with Masriuq in the house which had the portrayals of Mary (hadrat Maryan). Thereupon Masriuq said: These are portraits of Kisra. I said: No, these are of Mary. Masruq said: I heard Abdullah b, Mas'ud as saying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: The most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. (Muslim said): I read this before Nasr b. 'Ali at-Jahdami and he read it before other narrators, the last one being Ibn Sa'id b Abl at Hasan that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: I am the person who paints pictures; give me a religious verdict about them. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said to him: Come near me (still further). He came near him so much so that he placed his hand upon his head and said: I am going to narrate to yor what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I heard him say: All the painters who make pictures would be in the fire of Hell. The soul will be breathed in every picture prepared by him and it shall punish him in the Hell, and he (Ibn 'Abbas) said: If you have to do it at all, then paint the pictures of trees and lifeless things; and Nasr b. 'Ali confirmed it.
hi: Muslim bin Subaih ne bayan kiya: Main Masriuq ke saath us ghar mein tha jismein Mary (Hazrat Maryam) ki tasveerein thin. Isper Masriuq ne kaha: Ye Kisra ki tasveerein hain. Maine kaha: Nahi, ye Mary ki hain. Masruq ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza paane wale log tasveer banaane waale honge. (Muslim ne kaha): Maine ise Nasr bin Ali at-Jahdami ke saamne padha aur unhone ise doosre raawiyon ke saamne padha, aakhri wale Ibn Sa'id bin Abl at Hasan the, ki ek shakhs Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main woh shakhs hoon jo tasveerein banaata hoon; mujhe iske baare mein ek mazhabi fatwa dijiye. Unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) usse kaha: Mere aur qareeb aao. Woh unke itne qareeb aaya ki unhone apna haath uske sar par rakha aur kaha: Main tumhe wahi riwayat karne wala hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Maine unhe ye kehte suna: Sab tasveer banaane wale jo tasveerein banaate hain woh Jahannam ki aag mein honge. Har us tasveer mein jaan phoonki jaayegi jo usne banaayi aur woh use Jahannam mein saza degi, aur unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) kaha: Agar tumhe waaqai isse karna hi hai, to darakhton aur nirjeev cheezon ki tasveerein banaao; aur Nasr bin Ali ne iski pushti ki.

e: Anas b. Malik said: I was sitting with Ibn 'Abbas when he gave religious verdicts but he did not say that it was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had said that. However when a man said to him (Ibn 'Abbas): I am the painter of these pictures. Ibn 'Abbas said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who painted pictures in the world would be compelled to breathe soul in them on the Day of Resurrection, but he would not be able to breathe soul (in them).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main Ibn Abbas ke saath baitha tha jab woh mazhabi fatwe de rahe the lekin unhone ye nahi kaha ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha. Lekin jab ek shakhs ne unse (Ibn Abbas se) kaha: Main in tasveeron ka banaane wala hoon. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne is duniya mein tasveerein banaayi use Qayamat ke din unmein jaan phoonkne ke liye majboor kiya jaayega, lekin woh (unmein) jaan phoonkne mein saksham nahi hoga.

e: Nadr b. Anas reported that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and he narrated (the above menlioned hadith) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Nadr bin Anas ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur unhone (upar bataayi gayi hadees) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Zur'a reported: I visited the house of Marwan in the company of Abu Huraira and he found pictures there. whereupon he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, said: Who is a more wrongdoer than one who tries to create creation like Mine creation. Let him create an atom or a grain of wheat or that of barley. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zur'a and he said: Abu Huraira went to the house of Sa'ld or Marwan which they had built in Medina and he (Abu Huraira) saw a painter who had been painting pictures in his house, whereupon he told that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said like this, but he made no mention of the words:" Let him create the grain of barley."
hi: Abu Zur'a ne bayan kiya: Main Marwan ke ghar Abu Huraira ki sohbat mein gaya aur unhone wahan tasveerein paayin, isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne kaha: Usse zyada anyaayi kaun hai jo Meri srijan jaisi srijan banaane ki koshish karta hai. Use ek anu ya gehun ka ek daana ya jau ka ek daana banaane do. Ye hadees Abu Zur'a ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: Abu Huraira Sa'ld ya Marwan ke ghar gaye jo unhone Madina mein banwaaya tha aur unhone (Abu Huraira ne) ek tasveer banaane wale ko dekha jo unke ghar mein tasveerein bana raha tha, isper unhone bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa hi kaha tha, lekin unhone in alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya: "Use jau ka daana banaane do."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not enter the house in which there are portrayals or pictures.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein akritiyaan ya tasveerein hon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog and a bell.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte un musafiron ke saath nahi jaate jinke paas kutta aur ghantee ho.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The bell is the musical instrument of the Satan.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ghantee Shaitaan ka baaja hai.

e: Abu Bashir Ansari reported that he had had (the opportunity of accompanying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in some of his journeys. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent one of his messengers 'Abdullah b Abi Bakr said: I think he said (these words) when the people were at the places of rest: No necklace of strings be left on the necks of the camels or the necklace kept unbroken. Imam Malik said: To my mind (this practice) of wearing necklace round the necks of camels or animals was because of the fact that they (wanted to save them) from the influence of the evil eye.
hi: Abu Bashir Ansari ne bayan kiya ki unhe apne kuch safaron mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jaane ka mauka mila tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne ek doot ko bheja. Abdullah bin Abi Bakr ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (ye alfaaz) kahe the jab log aaraam ki jagahon par the: Oonton ki gardanon par koi doraabandh (dhaage ki maala) na chhoda jaaye ya (agar hai to) doraabandh na toda jaaye. Imam Malik ne kaha: Mera khyaal hai ki (ye riwaaj) oonton ya jaanwaron ki gardanon mein doraabandh pehnne ki is liye thi ki (log unhe bachaana chaahte the) buri nazar ke asar se.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the animals to be beaten) on the face or cauterisation on the face.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya (jaanwaron ko) chehre par maarne se ya chehre par daagna se.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported that there happened to pass before Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) an ass the face of which had been cauterised, whereupon he said: Allah has cursed one who has cauterised it (on the face).
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek gadha guzra jiska chehra daaga gaya tha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne ise (chehre par) daaga.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw an ass which had been cauterised on the face. He disapproved of it saying: By Allah, I do not cauterise (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face, and commanded (for the cauterisation) of his ass and it was cauterised on the buttocks and he was the first to cauterise on the buttocks.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek gadha dekha jise chehre par daaga gaya tha. Unhone ise napasand kiya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, main (jaanwar ko) chehre se door kisi hisse par hi daagta hoon, aur unhone apne gadhe ko daagne ka hukum diya aur ise pichhle hisse par daaga gaya aur woh sabse pehle the jinhone pichhle hisse par daaga.

e: Anas reported that Umm Sulaim gave birth to a child. She said to him: Anas, see that nothing is given to this child until he is brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the morning, so that he should chew some dates and touch his palate with it. I went to him in the morning and he was in the garden at that time having the mantle of Jauniyya over him and he was bus in cauterising (the camels) which had been brought to him (as spoils of war) in victory (over the enemy).
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim ne ek bachche ko paida kiya. Unhone unse kaha: Anas, dekho ki is bachche ko kuch bhi na diya jaaye jab tak use subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na le jaaya jaaye, taaki woh kuch khajooren chabaayein aur unse iska taalu chhuyein. Main subah unke paas gaya aur woh baag mein the us waqt Jauniyya ka chogha oDhe hue the aur woh (oonton ko) daagne mein masroof the jo unhe (jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke soorat mein) laaye gaye the (dushman par) jeet mein.

e: Anas reported that when his mother gave birth to a child they brought that child to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he might chew some dates and touch his palate with them. and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was at that time in the fold busy in cauterising the animals Shu'ba said: So far as I know (he was cauterising) their ears.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab unki maa ne ek bachche ko paida kiya, woh use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye taaki woh kuch khajooren chabaayein aur unse uska taalu chhuyein, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt bade mein the jaanwaron ko daagne mein masroof. Shu'ba ne kaha: Jahan tak mujhe pata hai (woh unke) kaanon ko daag rahe the.

e: Anas reported: We went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was in the fold and he was cauterising the animals of the flock and I think (he was cauterising them) on their ears. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye jab woh bade mein the aur woh reWad ke jaanwaron ko daag rahe the aur mujhe lagta hai (woh unhe daag rahe the) unke kaanon par. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I saw in the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an instrument for cauterisation and he was cauterising the caracia collected as Zakat.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein daagne ka ek upkaran dekha aur woh Zakat ke soorat mein ikattha kiye gaye oonton ko daag rahe the.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Qaza. I said to Nafi: What is Qaza'? He said: This means having a part of a boy's head shaved and leaving a part unshaven.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Qaza se mana kiya. Maine Nafi se kaha: Qaza kya hai? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki ek larke ke sar ka ek hissa munda hua ho aur ek hissa bina munda hua chhoda jaaye.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters. and the exposition of Qaza' is the same as that of Abu Usama.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Qaza ki vyaakhya wahi hai jo Abu Usama ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters and Muhammad b. Muthanna as well as 'Umar b. Nafi have given the same exposition (of the word Qaza') in their narration.
hi: Ye hadees Umar bin Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Muhammad bin Muthanna aur Umar bin Nafi donon ne apni riwayat mein (Qaza lafz ki) wahi vyaakhya di hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid sitting on the paths. They (his Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, there is no other help to it (but to sit there as we) hold our meetings and discuss matters there. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you have to sit at all, then fulfil the rights, of the path. They said: What are their rights? Thereupon he said: Keeping the eye downward (so that you may not stare at the women), refraining from doing some harm to the other and exchanging mutual greetings (saying as-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil.
hi: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raaston par baithne se bacho. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, isse bachna mumkin nahi (kyunki hum wahan) apni sabhaen karte hain aur wahan maamlon par charcha karte hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tumhe waaqai baithna hi hai, to raaste ke haqoq poore karo. Unhone poocha: Unke haq kya hain? Isper unhone kaha: Aankhon ko neeche rakhna (taaki tum auraton ko na ghooro), doosre ko koi nuksaan pahunchaane se bacho aur aapas mein salaam (ek-doosre se as-Salamu Alaikum kehna) exchange karna aur achhaai ka hukum dena aur burai se rokna.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have a daughter who has been newly wedded. She had an attack of smallpox and thus her hair had fallen; should I add false hair to her head? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has cursed the woman who adds some false hair and the woman who asks for it.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri ek beti hai jiski nayi shaadi hui hai. Use chechak ka hamla hua aur uske baal jhad gaye; kya main uske sar mein nakli baal joDun? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne us aurat par laanat ki hai jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo isse maangti hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have married my daughter (whose) hair of head have fallen. Her spouse likes them (the long hair). Allah's Messenger (may add false hair to her head? He forbade her to do this.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri beti ki shaadi ki hai jiske sar ke baal jhad gaye hain. Unke shohar unhe (lambe baal) pasand karte hain. Kya Allah ke Rasool (unke sar mein) nakli baal jod sakte hain? Unhone use aisa karne se mana kiya.

e: A'isha reported that a girl of the Ansar who had fallen ill and had lost the hair was married. They (her relatives) thought of adding false hair (to her head). so they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he cursed the woman who adds false hair and the woman who asks for it.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ki ek larki, jo bimaar pad gayi thi aur uske baal jhad gaye the, ki shaadi hui. Woh (uske rishtedaar) nakli baal jodne ka soch rahe the, is liye unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone us aurat par laanat ki jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo isse maangti hai.

e: A'isha reported that a woman from the Ansar married her daughter who had lost her hair because of illness. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Her husband wants that false hair should be aaded to her head. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The woman who adds false hair has been cursed. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ki ek aurat ne apni beti ki shaadi karvaayi jiske baal beemari ki wajah se jhad gaye the. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Uske shohar chaahte hain ki uske sar mein nakli baal jode jaayein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nakli baal jodne wali aurat par laanat ki gayi hai. Ye hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursing the woman who added false hair and the woman who asked for tattoos. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us aurat par laanat karte suna jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo tattoo maangti hai. Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported that Allah had cursed those women who tattooed and who have themselves tattooed, those who pluck hair from their faces and those who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created. This news reached a woman of the tribe of Asad who was called Umm Ya'qub and she used to recite the Holy Qur'an. She came to him and said: What is this news that has reached me from you that you curse those women who tattooed and those women who have themselves tattooed, the women who pluck hair from their faces and who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created? Thereupon 'Abdullah said: Should I not curse one upon whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse and that is in the Book also. Thereupon that woman said: I read the Qur'an from cover to cover, but I did not find that in it. whereupon he said: If you had read (thoroughly) you would have definitely found this in that (as) Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has said:" What Allah's Messenger brings for you accept that and what he has forbidden you, refrain from that." That woman said: I find this thing in your wife even now. Thereupon he said: Go and see her. She reported: I went to the wife of 'Abdullah but found nothing of this sort in her. She came back to him and said: I have not seen anything. whereupon he said: Had there been anything like it in her, I would have never slept with her in the bed.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ne un auraton par laanat ki hai jo tattoo banaati hain aur jo apna tattoo banwaati hain, jo apne chehre se baal noch dalti hain aur jo khoobsurati ke liye apne daanton ke beech jagah banaati hain, Allah ki srijan ko badalte hue. Ye khabar Asad qabile ki ek aurat tak pahunchi jise Umm Ya'qub kaha jaata tha aur woh Muqaddas Quran padha karti thi. Woh unke (Abdullah ke) paas aayi aur kaha: Ye kya khabar mujhe aapke baare mein pahunchi hai ki aap un auraton par laanat karte hain jo tattoo banwaati hain aur woh auraten jo tattoo banaati hain, woh auraten jo apne chehre se baal nochti hain aur khoobsurati ke liye apne daanton ke beech jagah banaati hain, Allah ki srijan ko badalte hue? Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Kya main us par laanat na karun jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat maangi hai aur ye Kitaab mein bhi hai. Isper us aurat ne kaha: Maine Quran shuru se aakhir tak padha, lekin mujhe ismein ye nahi mila, isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne (poori tarah se) padha hota, to tumhe zaroor ye usmein mila hota (jaise) Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kaha hai: "Jo Allah ka Rasool tumhare liye laata hai use qubool karo aur jisse woh tumhe mana karta hai, usse bacho." Us aurat ne kaha: Mujhe ye cheez ab bhi tumhari zauja mein milti hai. Isper unhone kaha: Jaao aur unhe dekho. Unhone (raawi ne) riwayat ki: Main Abdullah ki zauja ke paas gayi lekin mujhe unmein aisi koi cheez nahi mili. Woh unke paas wapas aayi aur kaha: Maine kuch nahi dekha, isper unhone kaha: Agar unmein aisi koi cheez hoti, to main kabhi unke saath bistar mein na sota.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur without the story pertaining to Umm Ya'qub.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se Umm Ya'qub se mutaliq kahani ke bina riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abdullah.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reprimanded that a woman should add anything to her head (in the form of artificial hair).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne burai ki ki koi aurat apne sar mein kuch (nakli baalon ke soorat mein) joDe.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf said that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyin during the season of Hajj, (saying) as he sat upon the pulpit holding a bunch of hair in his hand which was (previously) in the hand of his sentinel: O people of Medina, where are your scholars? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding this and saying: That the people of Bani Isra'il were ruined at the time when their women wore such hair.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha ki unhone Hajj ke mausam mein Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan ko, jab woh mimbar par baithe hue baalon ka ek gucchha apne haath mein liye the jo (pehle) unke pahredaar ke haath mein tha, ye kehte suna: Aye Madina ke logo, tumhare aalim kahan hain? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise mana karte suna aur ye kehte suna: Banu Isra'il ke log tab barbaad ho gaye the jab unki auraton ne aise baal pehne.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Musayyib reported: Mu'awiya came to Medina and he addressed us and he took out a bunch of hair and said: What do I see that one of you does but that what the Jews did? (I can well recall) that when this act (adding of artificial hair) reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he named it as cheating.
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne bayan kiya: Muawiya Madina aaye aur humein khitaab kiya aur unhone baalon ka ek gucchha nikaala aur kaha: Ye kya hai jo main dekh raha hoon ki tum mein se koi karta hai lekin jo Yahudiyon ne kiya (waisa hi)? (Mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai) ki jab ye amal (nakli baal jodna) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahuncha, unhone ise dhoka kaha.

e: Sa, id b. Musayyib reported that Mu'awiya said one day: Should I narrate to you the evil make-up. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade cheating. It was during that time that a person came with a staff and there was a cloth on its head, whereupon Mu, awiya said: Behold, that is cheating. Qatada said: This implies how women artificially increase their hair with the help of rags.
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne bayan kiya ki Muawiya ne ek din kaha: Kya main tumhe bura shringaar riwayat na karun? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dhoke se mana kiya. Usi waqt ek shakhs ek lathi lekar aaya aur uske sar par kapda tha, isper Muawiya ne kaha: Dekho, ye dhoka hai. Qatada ne kaha: Iska matlab hai ki kaise auraten chithdon ki madad se apne baal kritrim soorat se badhaati hain.

e: AbU Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Two are the types of the denizens of Hell whom I did not see: people having flogs like the tails of the ox with them and they would be beating people, and the women who would be dressed but appear to be naked, who would be inclined (to evil) and make their husbands incline towards it. Their heads would be like the humps of the bukht camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Paradise and they would not smell its odour whereas its odour would be smelt from such and such distance.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jahannam ke do kism ke bashinda hain jinhe maine nahi dekha: aise log jinke paas bail ki poonch jaisi kodeya hain aur woh logon ko maar rahe honge, aur woh auraten jo pehnaayi jaayengi lekin nangi lagengi, jo (burai ki taraf) jhuki hongi aur apne shohar ko uski taraf jhukayengi. Unke sar bukht oont ke kohaan jaisa ek taraf jhuka hua honge. Woh Jannat mein daakhil nahi hongi aur na hi iski mahak sooghegi jabki iski mahak itni-itni doori se soonghi jaayegi.

e: A'isha reported that a woman said: Allah's Messenger, may I say to my (co-wife) that my husband has given me (such and such) a thing but which he has not in fact gives me? 'Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who makes a false statement of that which one has not been given is like one who wears a garment of falsehood.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main apni saut se keh sakti hoon ki mere shohar ne mujhe (aisi aisi) cheez di hai jo unhone waastav mein nahi di? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo shakhs jhoota bayaan deta hai us cheez ka jo use nahi di gayi hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo jhoot ka kapda pehanta hai.

e: Asma' reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have a co-wife. Is there any harm for me if I give her the false impression (of getting something from my husband which he has not in fact given me)? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who creates such a (false impression) of receiving what one has not been given is like one who wears the garment of falsehood.
hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri ek saut hai. Kya mujhe koi nuksaan hai agar main use jhoota bhram doon (ki mujhe apne shohar se kuch mila hai jo waastav mein unhone nahi diya)? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi aisa (jhoota bhram) banaata hai ki use woh mila hai jo use nahi diya gaya, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo jhoot ka kapda pehanta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that person at Baqi' called another person as" Abu'l- Qasim," and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned towards him. He (the person who had uttered these words) said: Messenger of Allah, I did not mean you, but I called such and such (person), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You may call yourself by my name, but not by my kunya.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Baqi mein ek shakhs ne doosre shakhs ko "Abu'l-Qasim" kehkar pukaara, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uski taraf mude. Usne (jisne ye alfaaz kahe the) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera matlab aap se nahi tha, main to falan-falan (shakhs) ko bula raha tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apna naam mere naam par rakh sakte ho, lekin meri kunya par nahi.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The names dearest to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abd al-Rahman.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ko sabse aziz naam Abdullah aur Abd al-Rahman hain.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person amongst us and he gave him the name of Muhammad. Thereupon his people said: We will not allow You to give the name of Muhammad (to your child) after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He set forth with his son carrying him on his back and came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and said: Allah's Messenger a son has been born to me and I have given him the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Give him my name but do not give him my kunya, for I am Qasim in the sense that I distribute (the spoils of war) and the dues of Zakat amongst you.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakha. Isper unke logon ne kaha: Hum tumhe apne bachche ka naam Muhammad rakhne nahi denge Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad. Woh apne bete ko peeth par uthaakar chal pade aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere ghar ek beta paida hua hai aur maine uska naam Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad rakha hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Usse mera naam do lekin meri kunya mat do, kyunki main is maayne mein Qasim hoon ki main (jung ke maal-e-ganimat) aur Zakat ke haq tum mein baantta hoon.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to one of the persons amongst us and he decided to give him the name of Muhammad We said: We will not allow you to give the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until you ask him (the Holy Prophet). So he (that person) came and said (to the Holy Prophet): A child was born in my house and I wanted to give him the name (of Muhammad) after the name of Allah's Messenger, whereas my people did not allow me that I should name him after that (sacred) name until I have asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in this connection, whereupon he said: Give him the name after my name, but do not call him by my kunya, for I have been sent as a Qasim as I distribute amongst you.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakhne ka faisla kiya. Humne kaha: Hum tumhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad naam rakhne nahi denge jab tak tum unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) na poocho. To woh (shakhs) aaya aur kaha (Nabi-e-Paak se): Mere ghar mein ek bachcha paida hua aur main use Allah ke Rasool ke naam ke baad naam dena chahta tha, jabki mere logon ne mujhe us (muqaddas) naam ke baad naam rakhne nahi diya jab tak main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se na poochoon, isper unhone kaha: Usse mera naam do, lekin use meri kunya se mat pukaaro, kyunki mujhe Qasim ke soorat mein bheja gaya hai kyunki main tum mein baantta hoon.
