e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Husain With the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of these words: " (I have been sent as a distributor), so I distribute amongst you."
hi: Ye hadees Husain ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein in alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "(Mujhe ek vitarak ke soorat mein bheja gaya hai), is liye main tum mein baantta hoon."

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Give the name after my name, but do not give (the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim after my) kunya, for I am Abu'l-Qasim (in the sense) that I distribute amongst you (the spoils of war) and disseminate the knowledge (of revelation). This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Naam mere naam ke baad do, lekin kunya (Abu'l-Qasim ki kunya mere baad) mat do, kyunki main Abu'l-Qasim (is maayne mein) hoon ki main tum mein (jung ka maal-e-ganimat) baantta hoon aur (wahi ke) ilm ko phailaata hoon. Ye hadees Abu Bakr ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but there is a slight variation (of wording) that, instead of the word Bu'ithat (I have been sent), the word ju'ilat (I have been made) has been used.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein alfaazon mein halka antar hai ki, Bu'ithat (mujhe bheja gaya hai) lafz ki jagah ju'ilat (mujhe banaya gaya hai) lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person from the Ansar and he made up his mind to give him the name of Muhammad. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and, asked him (about it), whereupon he said: The Ansar have done well to give the name (to your children) after my name, but do not give them the kunya after my kunya.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakhne ka faisla kiya. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse (iske baare mein) poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ansar ne achha kiya ki (apne bachchon ka naam) mere naam ke baad rakha, lekin unhe meri kunya ke baad kunya mat do.

e: This hadith has been narrated through different chains of transmitters on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: A child was born in the house of a person amongst us, and he gave him the name of Qasim. We said: We will not allow you (to give the name) to your child as Qasim (and thus adopt the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim) and coal your eyes. He (that person) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Call your son 'Abd al-Rahman.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua, aur usne uska naam Qasim rakha. Humne kaha: Hum tumhe apne bachche ka naam Qasim rakhne nahi denge (aur is tarah Abu'l-Qasim ki kunya apnaane nahi denge) aur apni aankhon ko Thanda karne (khushi karne). Woh (shakhs) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Apne bete ko Abd al-Rahman bulaao.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Uyaina, but there is no mention of this: " We will not allow you to cool your eyes."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Uyaina ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Hum tumhe apni aankhein Thandi karne nahi denge."

e: Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) said: Give name (to your children) after my name but do not give the kunya (of Abu'l- Qasim) after my kunya. 'Amr reported from Abu Huraira that he did not say that he had heard it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ne kaha: Naam (apne bachchon ko) mere naam ke baad do lekin kunya (Abu'l-Qasim ki) meri kunya ke baad mat do. Amr ne Abu Huraira se riwayat ki ki unhone ye nahi kaha ki unhone ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: When I came to Najran, they (the Christians of Najran) asked me: You read" O sister of Harun" (i. e. Hadrat Maryam) in the Qur'an, whereas Moses was born much before Jesus. When I came back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I asked him about that, whereupon he said: The (people of the old age) used to give names (to their persons) after the names of Apostles and pious persons who had gone before them.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Jab main Najran gaya, unhone (Najran ke Isaayiyon ne) mujhse poocha: Tum Quran mein "Aye Haroon ki behn" (yaani Hazrat Maryam) padhte ho, jabki Musa Isa se bahut pehle paida huye the. Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaya maine unse iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: (Purane daur ke log) apne logon ka naam apne se pehle guzre Rasoolon aur nekokaar logon ke naam ke baad rakhte the.

e: Samura b. Jundub reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to give names to our servants as these four names: Aflah (Successful), Rabdh (Profit), Yasar (Wealth), and Nafi' (Beneficial).
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya ki hum apne khaadimon ka naam in chaar naamon mein se koi rakhen: Aflah (Kaamyaab), Rabdh (Munafa), Yasar (Daulat), aur Nafi (Faayde-mand).

e: Samura b. Jundub reported AUah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Don't give names to your servants as Rabdh, 'Ya ar, Aflah and Nafi'.
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apne khaadimon ka naam Rabdh, Yasar, Aflah aur Nafi mat do.

e:
Samura b. Jundub reported: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four: Subhan Allah (Hallowed be Allah), Al-Hamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa-Allah (There is no deity but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater). There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). 

And do not give these names to your servants: Yasar and Rabah and Najih and Aflah.
hi: Samura bin Jundub ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ko sabse aziz alfaaz chaar hain: Subhan Allah (Allah Paak hai), Al-Hamdulillah (Sab tareef Allah ke liye), La ilaha illa-Allah (Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi), Allahu Akbar (Allah Sabse Buland hai). Tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hai ki tum inmein se kisse (Allah ko yaad karte hue) shuru karo. Aur apne khaadimon ko ye naam mat do: Yasar aur Rabah aur Najih aur Aflah.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba and there is no mention but of the fact about giving the name to the servant and there is no mention of the four expressions (of remembrance) and he did not mention the four words
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein sirf khaadim ko naam dene ki baat ka zikr hai, char (yaad ke) shabdon ka koi zikr nahi hai aur unhone woh chaar alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to forbid (his followers) to name persons as Ya'la (Elevated), Baraka (Blessing), Aflah (Successful), Yasar and Nafi', but I saw that he kept silent after that and he did not say anything until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. And he did not forbid (his followers to do this), then 'Umar decided to prohibit (people) from giving these names, but later on gave up the idea.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne anuyaayiyon ko) logon ka naam Ya'la (Uchcha), Baraka (Barkat), Aflah (Kaamyaab), Yasar aur Nafi rakhne se mana karne ka faisla kiya, lekin maine dekha ki woh uske baad khamosh rahe aur unhone kuch nahi kaha jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal nahi hua. Aur unhone (iski aakhri soorat mein) mana nahi kiya, phir Umar ne (logon ko) in naamon se mana karne ka faisla kiya, lekin baad mein ye vichaar chhod diya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed the name of 'Asiya (Disobedient) and said: You are Jamila (i. e. good and handsome). Ahmad (one of the narrators) narrated it with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Asiya (Napharmani) ka naam badla aur kaha: Tum Jamila ho (yaani achhi aur khoobsurat). Ahmad (raawiyon mein se ek) ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar had a daughter who was called 'Asiya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Jamila.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar ki ek beti thi jise Asiya kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Jamila naam diya.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that the name of Juwairiya (the wife of the Holy Prophet) was Barra (Pious). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed her name to Juwairiya and said: I did not like that it should be said: He had come out from Barra (Pious). The hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi 'Umar is slightly different from it.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Juwairiya (Nabi-e-Paak ki zauja) ka naam Barra (Nekokaar) tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka naam Juwairiya badal diya aur kaha: Mujhe ye pasand nahi tha ki kaha jaaye: "Woh Barra (Nekokaari) se bahar aaya." Ibn Abi Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees isse thoda alag hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the name of Zainab was Barra. It was said of her: She presents herself to be innocent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Zainab.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Zainab ka naam Barra tha. Unke baare mein kaha jaata tha: Woh khud ko masoom pesh karti hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Zainab naam diya.

e: Zainab, daughter of Umm Salama, reported: My name first was Barra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me the name of Zainab. Then there entered (into the house of Allah's Prophet as a wife) Zainab, daughter of Jahsh, and her name was also Barra, and he gave her the name of Zainab.
hi: Zainab, Umm Salama ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Mera naam pehle Barra tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Zainab naam diya. Phir Zainab, Jahsh ki beti, (Allah ke Nabi ke ghar mein ek zauja ke soorat mein) daakhil hui, aur unka naam bhi Barra tha, aur unhone unhe bhi Zainab naam diya.

e: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Ata' reported: I had given the name Barra to my daughter. Zainab, daughter of Abu Salama, told me that Allah's' Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden me to give this name. (She said): I was also called Barra, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't hold yourself to be pious. It is God alone who knows the people of piety among you. They (the Companions) said: Then, what name should we give to her? He said: Name her as Zainab.
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata ne bayan kiya: Maine apni beti ka naam Barra rakha tha. Zainab, Abu Salama ki beti, ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye naam rakhne se mana kiya. (Unhone kaha): Mujhe bhi Barra kaha jaata tha, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne aap ko nekokaar mat samajho. Ye sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki tum mein se kaun nekokaar hai. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Phir hum unhe kya naam dein? Unhone kaha: Unhe Zainab naam do.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vilest name in Allah's sight is Malik al-Amidh (King of Kings). The narration transmitted on the authority of Shaiba (contains these words): There is no king but Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. Sufyan said: Similarly, the word Shahinshah (is also the vilest appellation). Ahmad b. Hanbal said: I asked Abu 'Amr about the meaning of Akhna. He said: The vilest.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ki nazar mein sabse ghinaunA naam Malik al-Amidh (Baadshahon ka Baadshah) hai. Shaiba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (ye alfaaz hain): Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ke siwaay koi raja nahi hai. Sufyan ne kaha: Isi tarah, Shahinshah lafz bhi (sabse ghinaunA hai). Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Maine Abu Amr se Akhna ka matlab poocha. Unhone kaha: Sabse ghinaunA.

e: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so many ahadith and one of them was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The most wretched person in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection and the worst person and target of His wrath would of the person who is called Malik al-Amlak (the King of Kings) for there is no king but Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kayi hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki nazar mein Qayamat ke din sabse abhaagi shakhs aur sabse bure shakhs aur Uske gusse ka nishaana woh shakhs hoga jise Malik al-Amlak (Baadshahon ka Baadshah) kaha jaata hai, kyunki Allah ke siwaay koi raja nahi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I took 'Abdullah b. Abi Talha Ansari to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at that time wearing a woollen cloak and besmearing the camels with tar. He said: Have you got with you the dates? I said: Yes. He took hold of the dates and put them in his mouth and softened them, then opened the mouth of the infant and put that in it and the child began to lick it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Ansar have a liking for the dates, and he (the Holy Prophet) gave him the name of 'Abdullah.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Abi Talha Ansari ko unke paidaish ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt ek oon ka chogha pehne hue the aur oonton ko taar (colouring) lagaa rahe the. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas khajooren hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone khajooren pakadin aur unhe apne munh mein daala aur unhe naram kiya, phir bachche ka munh khola aur woh use daala aur bachcha ise chaatne laga. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ansar ko khajooron ka shauk hai, aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) usko Abdullah naam diya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the son of Abu Talha had been ailing. Abu Talha set out (on a journey) and his son breathed his last (in his absence). When Abu Talha came back, he said (to his wife): What about my child? Umm Sulaim (the wife of Abu Talha) said: He is now in a more comfortable state than before. She served him the evening meal and he took it. He then came to her (and had sexual intercourse with her) and when it was all over she said: Make arrangements for the burial of the child. When it was morning. Abu Talha came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him, whereupon he said: Did you spend the night with her. He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: O Allah, bless both of them (and as a result of blessing) she gave birth to a child. Abu Talha said to me (Anas b. Malik) to take the child, (so I took him) and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She (Umm Sulaim) also had sent some dates (along with the child). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took him (the child) (in his lap) and said: Is there anything with you (for Tahnik). They (the Companions) said: Yes. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took hold of them (dates and chewed them). He then put them (the chewed dates) in the mouth of the child and then rubbed his palate and gave him the name of 'Abdullah.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Abu Talha ke bete bimaar the. Abu Talha (safar par) nikle aur unke bete ne aakhri saans li (unki anupasthiti mein). Jab Abu Talha wapas aaye, unhone (apni zauja se) kaha: Mere bachche ka kya haal hai? Umm Sulaim (Abu Talha ki zauja) ne kaha: Woh ab pehle se zyada aaraam mein hain. Unhone unhe raat ka khaana pesh kiya aur unhone use khaya. Phir woh unke paas aaye (aur unke saath jinsi milaap kiya) aur jab sab kuch khatam ho gaya unhone kaha: Bachche ke dafn ki intezam karo. Jab subah hui, Abu Talha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe bataya, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne unke saath raat guzaari? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir kaha: Aye Allah, donon ko barkat de (aur barkat ke natije mein) unhone ek bachche ko paida kiya. Abu Talha ne mujhse (Anas bin Malik se) kaha ki main bachche ko lekar jaaun, (is liye main use lekar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Woh (Umm Sulaim) kuch khajooren bhi bhej chuki thin (bachche ke saath). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use (bachche ko) (apni god mein) liya aur kaha: Kya tumhare paas kuch hai (Tahnik ke liye)? Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (khajooren aur unhe chabaaya) liya. Phir unhone unhe (chabai gayi khajooren) bachche ke munh mein daali aur phir uska taalu mala aur use Abdullah naam diya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmit ters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: A child was born in my house and I brought him to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upod him) and he gave him the name of Ibrahim and he rubbed his palate with dates.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Mere ghar mein ek bachcha paida hua aur main use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya aur unhone use Ibrahim naam diya aur khajooron se uska taalu mala.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair and Fatima daughter of Mandhir b. Zubair, reported that Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr was at the time of migration in the family way with 'Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womb). She came to Quba' and gave birth to 'Abdullah at that place and then sent him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he should rub his palate with chewed dates. Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) took hold of him (the child) and he placed him in his lap and then called for dates. 'A'isha said: Some time was spent before we were able to find them. He (the Holy Prophet) chewed them and then put his saliva in his mouth. The first thing that entered his stomach, was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Asma' said: He then rubbed him and blessed him and gave him the name of Abdullah. He ('Abdullah) went to him (the Holy Prophet) when he had attained the age of seven or eight years in order to pledge allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Zubair had commanded him to do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled when he saw him coming towards him and then accepted his allegiance.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair aur Fatima, Mandhir bin Zubair ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, hijrat ke waqt Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati thin (apne garbh mein). Woh Quba aayin aur usi jagah Abdullah ko paida kiya aur phir use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja taaki woh chabai gayi khajooron se uska taalu malein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use (bachche ko) pakda aur apni god mein rakha aur phir khajooren maangin. Aisha ne kaha: Kuch waqt lag gaya isse pehle ki hum unhe dhoondh paayein. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe chabaaya aur phir apni lar uske munh mein daali. Sabse pehli cheez jo uske pait mein gayi, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki lar thi. Asma ne kaha: Phir unhone use mala aur use barkat di aur use Abdullah naam diya. Woh (Abdullah) unke paas gaye jab woh saat ya aath saal ke ho gaye taaki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam le, jaisa Zubair ne unhe hukum diya tha karne ke liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe apni taraf aate dekhkar muskuraaye aur phir unki wafadaari qubool ki.

e: Asma' reported that she had become pregnant at Mecca with Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womt) and she (further) said: I set out (for migration to Medina) as I was in the advanced stage of pregnancy. I came to Medina and got down at the place known as Quba' and gave birth to a child there. Then I came to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). He placed him (the child) in his lap and then commanded for the dates to be brought. He chewed them and then put the saliva in his mouth. The first thing which went into his stomach was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He then rubbed his palate with dates and then invoked blessings for him and blessed him. He was the first child who was born in Islam (after Migration).
hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki woh Makkah mein Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati ho gayi thi (apne garbh mein) aur unhone (aage) kaha: Main nikli (Madina hijrat karne ke liye) jab main garbhavastha ke aakhri charan mein thi. Main Madina aayi aur Quba naam ki jagah par utri aur wahan ek bachche ko paida kiya. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi. Unhone use (bachche ko) apni god mein rakha aur phir khajooren laane ka hukum diya. Unhone unhe chabaaya aur phir lar uske munh mein daali. Sabse pehli cheez jo uske pait mein gayi woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki lar thi. Phir unhone khajooron se uska taalu mala aur phir uske liye barkatein maangi aur use barkat di. Woh Islam mein (hijrat ke baad) paida hone waala pehla bachcha tha.

e: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that when she migrated to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Medina she was in the family way with Abdullah b. Zubair in her womb.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki jab woh Madina mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas hijrat karke aayin, woh Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati thin apne garbh mein.

e: 'A'isha reported that the new-born infants were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He blessed them and rubbed their palates with dates.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki naye paida hue bachche Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye jaate the. Unhone unhe barkat di aur khajooron se unka taalu mala.

e: 'A'isha reported: We took 'Abdullah b. Zubair to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) so that he should put saliva in his mouth and we had to make a good deal of effort in order to procure them.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Zubair ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye taaki woh apni lar uske munh mein daalein, aur humein khajooren haasil karne ke liye kaafi mehnat karni padi.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Mundhir b. Aba Usaid was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth Allah's. Apostle (ﷺ) placed him on his thigh and Abfi Usaid kept sitting there. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been occupied with something else before him. Abu Usaid commanded his child to be lifted from the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and so he was lifted. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the work he said: Where is the child? Abd Usaid said: Allah's Messenger, we took him away. He said: What is his name? He said; Allah's Messenger, it is so and so, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Nay, his name is Mundhir, and named him Mundhir on that day.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Mundhir bin Aba Usaid ko unke paidaish ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe apni jaangh par rakha aur Abu Usaid wahin baithe rahe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse pehle kisi doosri cheez mein masroof the. Abu Usaid ne apne bachche ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki god se uthane ka hukum diya aur is tarah use uthaaya gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna kaam khatm kar chuke, unhone kaha: Bachcha kahan hai? Abd Usaid ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum use le gaye. Unhone kaha: Uska naam kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye aisa aisa hai, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Nahi, uska naam Mundhir hai, aur usi din unhone use Mundhir naam diya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the sublimest character among mankind. I had a brother who was called Abu 'Umair. I think he was weaned. When Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) came to our house he saw him, and said: Abu 'Umair, what has the sparrow done? He (Anas) said that he had been playing with that.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka charitr insaaniyat mein sabse uchcha tha. Mera ek bhai tha jise Abu Umair kaha jaata tha. Mujhe lagta hai unka doodh chhudaya ja chuka tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare ghar aaye unhone use dekha aur kaha: Abu Umair, chidiya ne kya kiya? Unhone (Anas ne) kaha ki woh usi ke saath khel rahe the.

e: Anas b Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed me: O My Son.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse khitaab kiya: Aye mere Bete.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that none else had asked more questions from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Dajjal than I, but he simply said in a slight mood): O, myson, why are you worried because of him? He will not harm you. I said: The people think that he would have with him rivers of water and mountains of bread, whereupon he said: He would be more insignificant in the sight of Allah than all these things (belonging to him).
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya ki kisi aur ne mujhse zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dajjal ke baare mein sawaal nahi poocha, lekin unhone (halke mizaaj mein) kaha: Aye mere bete, tum uski wajah se kyun pareshaan ho? Woh tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega. Maine kaha: Log sochte hain ki uske paas paani ki nadiyaan aur roti ke pahaad honge, isper unhone kaha: Woh Allah ki nazar mein in sab cheezon se zyada tuchcha hoga (jo uske paas hongi).

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ismail, with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported: I was sitting in Medina in the company of the Ansar when Abu Musa came trembling with fear. We said to him: What is the matter? He said: 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) sent for me. I went to him and paid him salutation thrice at (his) door but he made no response to me and so I came back. Thereupon he ('Umar) said: What stood in your way that you did not turn up? I said: I did come to you and paid you salutations at your door three times but I was not given any response, so I came back as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has said: When any one of you seeks permission three times and he is not granted permission, he should come back. Umar said: Bring a witness to support that you say, otherwise I shall take you to task. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: None should stand with him (as a witness) but the youngest amongst the people. Abu Sa'id said: I am the youngest amongst the people, whereupon he said: Then you go with him (to support his contention).
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya: Main Madina mein Ansar ki sohbat mein baitha tha jab Abu Musa Dar se kaanpte hue aaye. Humne unse kaha: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Umar ne mujhe bulaaya. Main unke paas gaya aur unke darwaze par teen baar salaam kiya lekin unhone mujhe koi jawaab nahi diya, is liye main wapas aa gaya. Isper unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne roka ki tum wapas nahi aaye? Maine kaha: Main aapke paas aaya aur aapke darwaze par teen baar salaam kiya lekin mujhe koi jawaab nahi mila, is liye main wapas chala gaya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha hai: Jab tum mein se koi teen baar ijazat maangta hai aur use ijazat nahi mili, use wapas jaana chahiye. Umar ne kaha: Ek gawaah lao is baat ki tasdeeq karne ke liye, warna main tumse sakhti se paisa loonga. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Koi bhi unke saath (gawaah ke soorat mein) khada na ho siwaay logon mein sabse choti umar wale ke. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main logon mein sabse choti umar wala hoon, isper unhone kaha: Phir tum unke saath jaao (unke daawe ka himayat karne).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Khusaifa with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: Abu Sa'id said: So I stood up, and went to 'Umar and gave witness (to what Abu Musa had said).
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Khusaifa ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Abu Sa'id ne kaha: To main khada hua aur Umar ke paas gaya aur gawaahi di (jo Abu Musa ne kaha tha uski).

e: Abd Sa'id Khudri reported: We were in the company of Ubayy b. Ka'b that Abu Musa Ash'ari came there in a state of anger. He stood (before us) and said: I ask you to bear witness in the name of Allah whether anyone amongst you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Permission (for entering the house) should be sought three times and if permission is granted to you (then get in). otherwise go back. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: What is the iiiatter? He said: I sought permission yesterday from 'Umar b. Khattab three times but he did not permit me, so I came back; then I went to him today and visited him and informed him that I had come to him yesterday and greeted him thrice, then came back, whereupon he said: Yes, we did hear you but be were at that time busy, but why did you not seek permission (further and you must have never gone back until you were permitted to do so). He said: I sought permission (in the manner) that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said (in connection 'With the seeking of permission for entering the house of a stranger). Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: By Allah, I shall torture your back and your stomach unless you bring one who may bear witness to what you state. 'Ubayy b. Ka'b said: By Allah, none should stand with you (to bear testimony) but the youngest amongst us. And he therefore, said to Abu Sa'id: Stand up. So I stood up until I came to Umar and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say this.
hi: Abd Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum Ubayy bin Ka'b ki sohbat mein the ki Abu Musa Ash'ari gusse ki haalat mein wahan aaye. Woh (humare saamne) khade hue aur kaha: Main tumse Allah ke naam par gawaahi maangta hoon ki kya tum mein se kisi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna hai: Ijazat (ghar mein daakhil hone ke liye) teen baar maangi jaani chahiye aur agar tumhe ijazat mil jaaye (to andar jao). warna wapas jao. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Maine kal Umar bin Khattab se teen baar ijazat maangi lekin unhone mujhe ijazat nahi di, is liye main wapas aa gaya; phir main aaj unke paas gaya aur unse mila aur unhe bataya ki main kal unke paas aaya tha aur unhe teen baar salaam kiya, phir wapas aa gaya, isper unhone kaha: Haan, humne tumhe suna lekin hum us waqt masroof the, lekin tumne aur ijazat kyun nahi maangi (tumhe kabhi tab tak wapas nahi jaana chahiye tha jab tak tumhe ijazat na mil jaaye). Unhone kaha: Maine (usi tarah) ijazat maangi jaisa maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna (kisi ajanabi ke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat maangne ke silsile mein). Isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhari peeth aur tumhara pait sataaunga jab tak tum kisi ko na lao jo tumhare kahe ki gawaahi de sake. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, koi bhi tumhare saath (gawaahi dene) khada na ho siwaay hummein se sabse choti umar wale ke. Aur is liye, unhone Abu Sa'id se kaha: Khade ho jao. To main khada hua yahan tak ki main Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Abu Musa al-Ash'ari came to the door of 'Umar and sought his permission (to get into his house). Umar said: That is once. He again sought permission for the second time and 'Umar said: It is twice. He again sought permission for the third time and Umar said: It is thrice. He (Abu Musa) then went back. He (Hadrat 'Umar) (sent someone) to pursue him so that he should be brought back. Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: If this act (of yours is in accordance with the command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have preserved in your mind, then it is all right, otherwise (I shall give you such a severe punishment) that it will serve as an example to others. Abu Sa'id said: Then he (Abu Musa) came to us and said: Do you remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:" Permission is for three times"? They (Companions sitting in that cothpany) began to laugh, whereupon he (Abu Musa) said: There comes to you your Muslim brother who had been perturbed and you laugh. Abu Sa'id said: (Well), you go forth. I shall be your participant in this trouble of yours. So he came to him (Hadrat Umar) and said: Here is Abu Sa'id (to support my statement).
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Umar ke darwaze par aaye aur unse ijazat maangi (unke ghar mein daakhil hone ke liye). Umar ne kaha: Ye ek baar hai. Unhone dobara ijazat maangi doosri baar aur Umar ne kaha: Ye do baar hai. Unhone dobara teesri baar ijazat maangi aur Umar ne kaha: Ye teen baar hai. Woh (Abu Musa) phir wapas chale gaye. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) (kisi ko unka) picha karne (bheja) taaki unhe wapas laaya jaaye. Isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Agar ye amal (tumhara) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ke mutabik hai jo tumne apne zehan mein rakha hai, to ye theek hai, warna (main tumhe aisi saza dunga) ki ye doosron ke liye ek udaaharan banega. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Phir woh (Abu Musa) humare paas aaye aur kaha: Kya tumhe yaad hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha tha: "Ijazat teen baar maangi jaani chahiye"? Unhone (us sabha mein baithe sahaba ne) hansna shuru kiya, isper unhone (Abu Musa ne) kaha: Tumhare paas tumhara Musalman bhai aata hai jo pareshaan tha aur tum hanste ho. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: (Achha), tum aage jaao. Main tumhari is mushkil mein tumhaara sahyogi banunga. To woh unke (Hazrat Umar ke) paas aaye aur kaha: Ye rahe Abu Sa'id (mere bayaan ka himayat karne ke liye).

e: This hadith bu been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ubaid b. Umair reported that Abu Musa brought permission from Umar (to enter the house) three times, and finding him busy came back, whereupon Umar said (to the Inmates of his house): Did you not hear the voice of 'Abdullah b. Qais (the Kunya of Abu Musa Ash'ari)? He was called back. and he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What did prompt you to do it? Thereupon, he said: This is how we have been commanded to act. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring evidence (in support of) it, otherwise I shall deal (strictly) with you. So he (Abu Musa) set out and came to the meeting of the Ansar and asked them to bear witness before hadrat Umar about this. They (the Companions present there) said: None but the youngest amongst us would bear out this fact. So Abu Sa'id Khudri (who was the youngest one in that company) said: We have been commanded to do so (while visiting the house of other people). Thereupon 'Umar said: This command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had remained hidden from me up till now due to (my) business in the market.
hi: Ubaid bin Umair ne bayan kiya ki Abu Musa Umar se (ghar mein daakhil hone ki) ijazat teen baar maangte the, aur unhe masroof paakar wapas chale gaye, isper Umar ne kaha (apne ghar ke logon se): Kya tumne Abdullah bin Qais (Abu Musa Ash'ari ki kunya) ki aawaaz nahi suni? Unhe wapas bulaaya gaya, aur unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Tumhe aisa karne ke liye kis baat ne preit kiya? Isper unhone kaha: Humein aisa hi amal karne ka hukum diya gaya hai. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Iska saboot lao, warna main tumhare saath (sakhti se) pesh aaunga. Is liye woh (Abu Musa) nikle aur Ansar ki sabha mein aaye aur unse guzaarish ki ki woh Hazrat Umar ke saamne iski gawaahi dein. Unhone (us sabha mein maujood sahaba ne) kaha: Sirf hummein se sabse choti umar wala hi is baat ki gawaahi dega. To Abu Sa'id Khudri (jo us sabha mein sabse choti umar ke the) ne kaha: Humein aisa hi amal karne ka hukum diya gaya hai (jab hum doosron ke ghar jaayein). Isper Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ye hukum mujhse ab tak chhupa raha bazaar mein (meri) masroofiyat ki wajah se.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij, but there is no mention of the words" business in the market".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein "bazaar mein masroofiyat" ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that he went to 'Umar b. Khattab and greeted him by saying: As-Salamu-'Alaikum, here is 'Abdullah b. Qais, but he did not permit him (to get in). He (Abu Musa Ash'ari) again greeted him with as-Salamu-'Alaikum and said: Here is Abu Musa, but he (Hadrat 'Umar) did not permit him (to get in). He again said: As-Salam-u-'Alaikum, (and said) here is Ash'ari, (then receiving no response he came back). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring him back to me, bring him back to me So he went there (in the presence of Hadrat 'Umar) and he said to him: Abu Musa, what made you go back, while we were busy in some work? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) as saying: Permission should be sought thrice. And if you are permitted, (then get in), otherwise go back. He said: Bring witness to this fact, otherwise I shall do this and that, i. e. I shall punish you. Abu Musa went away and 'Umar said to him (on his departure): It he (Abu Musa) finds a witness he should meet him by the side of the pulpit in the evening and it he does not find a witness you would not find him there. When it was evening he (Hadrat 'Umar) found him (Abu Musa) there. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Musa, have you been able to find a witness to what you have said? He said: Yes. Here is Ubayy bin Ka'b, whereupon he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Yes, he is an authentic (witness). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Tufail (the kunya of Ubayy b. Ka'b), what does he (Abu Musa say? Thereupon he said: Ibn Khattab, I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying so. Do not prove to be a hard (task-master) for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he Hadrat 'Umar said: Hallowed be Allah. I had heard something (in this connection), but I wished it to be established (as an undeniable fact).
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari ne bayan kiya ki woh Umar bin Khattab ke paas gaye aur unhe ye kehte hue salaam kiya: As-Salamu-Alaikum, ye rahe Abdullah bin Qais, lekin unhone unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone (Abu Musa Ash'ari ne) dobara unhe As-Salamu-Alaikum kehkar salaam kiya aur kaha: Ye rahe Abu Musa, lekin unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone phir kaha: As-Salamu-Alaikum, (aur kaha) ye rahe Ash'ari, (phir koi jawaab na paakar woh wapas chale gaye). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Unhe mere paas wapas lao, unhe mere paas wapas lao. To woh wahan (Hazrat Umar ki maujoodgi mein) gaye aur unhone (Umar ne) unse kaha: Abu Musa, kya baat thi ki tum wapas chale gaye, jabki hum kisi kaam mein masroof the? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ijazat teen baar maangi jaani chahiye. Aur agar tumhe ijazat mil jaaye, (to andar jao), warna wapas jao. Unhone kaha: Iska saboot lao, warna main aisa aisa karunga, yaani main tumhe saza dunga. Abu Musa chale gaye aur Umar ne unse (unke jaate waqt) kaha: Agar woh (Abu Musa) koi gawaah dhoondh lein, to unhe unse shaam ko mimbar ke pas milna chahiye aur agar unhe koi gawaah nahi milta to tum unhe wahan nahi paaoge. Jab shaam hui unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unhe (Abu Musa ko) wahan paaya. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Musa, kya tumhe apne kahe ka gawaah mil gaya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ye rahe Ubayy bin Ka'b, isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Haan, woh ek pramanik (gawaah) hain. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Tufail (Ubayy bin Ka'b ki kunya), (Abu Musa) kya kehte hain? Isper unhone kaha: Ibn Khattab, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa hi kehte suna. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye ek sakht (kaam-daar) mat bano, isper unhone Hazrat Umar ne kaha: Allah muqaddas hai. Maine (is silsile mein) kuch suna tha, lekin main chaahta tha ki ise ek muayyan tathya ke soorat mein sthapit kiya jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Talha b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation of wording: He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Mundhir (the Kunya of Ubayy b. Ka'b), did you hear this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: Yes. and he further said: Ibn Khattab, do not be a torment for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). No mention has, however, been made of the words of 'Umar:" Hallowed be Allah" and what follows subsequently.
hi: Ye hadees Talha bin Yahya ki sanad se isi sanad se is antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Mundhir (Ubayy bin Ka'b ki Kunya), kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Isper unhone kaha: Haan. Aur unhone aage kaha: Ibn Khattab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye koi azaab mat bano. Umar ke alfaazon ka: "Allah muqaddas hai" aur jo iske baad aata hai iska koi zikr nahi kiya gaya hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and called him (with a view to seeking permission). whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) came out saying: It is I. it is I.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe pukaara (ijazat maangne ke iraade se), isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kaun hai? Maine kaha: Main hoon. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) bahar aakar kaha: Main hoon, main hoon.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I sought permission from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoh him) to see him. He said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It is I. it is I (these words lead me to no conclusion).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine unse milne ke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi. Unhone kaha: Kaun hai? Maine kaha: Main hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main hoon, main hoon (in alfaazon se mujhe koi nishkarsh nahi mila).

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording and that is: The Prophet (ﷺ) uttered these words: It is I. it is I." in the manner as if he disapproved of this.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur woh hai: Nabi (SAW) ne ye alfaaz is tarah kahe: "Main hoon, main hoon." jaise unhone isse napasand kiya ho.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'id reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had with him a scratching instrument with which he had been scratching his head. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him. he said: If I were to know that you had been peeping through the door, I would have thrust that into your eyes, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Permission is needed as a protection against glance.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke chhed se jhaanka, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khujaane ka upkaran tha jisse woh apna sar khuja rahe the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha, unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tum jhaank rahe ho, to main use tumhari aankhon mein ghusaa deta, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ijazat (jhaankne se) hifaazat ke soorat mein zaroori hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he had with him some pointed thing with which he had been adjusting (the hair of his head). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: If I were to know that you had been peeping. I would have thrust it in your eyes. Allah has prescribed seeking permission because of protection against glance.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke chhed se jhaanka aur unke paas koi nukili cheez thi jisse woh (apne sar ke baalon ko) theek kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tum jhaank rahe ho, to main ise tumhari aankhon mein ghusaa deta. Allah ne (jhaankne se) hifaazat ke soorat mein ijazat maangna muqarrar kiya hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person peeped in some of the holes (in the doors) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and he found him) standing up (lifting) an arrow or some arrows. The narrator said: I perceived as if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was going to pierce (his eyes).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke kuch chhedon mein se jhaanka (aur usne unhe paaya) ek teer ya kuch teer uthaaye khade hue. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe laga jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (uski aankhein) chheed dene wale the.

e: Abu Huraira reported having heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who peeped into the house of people without their consent, it is permissible for them to put out his eyes.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi logon ke ghar mein unki sehmati ke bina jhaanka, unke liye jaayez hai ki woh uski aankhein nikaal den.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If a person were to cast a glance in your (house) without permission, and you had in your hand a staff and you would have thrust that in his eyes, there is no harm for you.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi shakhs tumhare (ghar) mein bina ijazat ke jhaake, aur tumhare haath mein ek lathi ho aur tum use uski aankhon mein ghusaa do, tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hai.

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the sudden glance (that is cast) on the face (of a non-Mahram). He commanded me that I should turn away my eyes.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se achaanak nazar padne ke baare mein poocha (jo kisi ghair-mahram ke chehre par padti hai). Unhone mujhe apni aankhein modne ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The rider should first greet the pedestrian, and the pedestrian the one who is seated and a small group should greet a larger group (with as-Salam-u-'Alaikum).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sawaar ko pehle paidal chalne wale ko salaam karna chahiye, aur paidal chalne wale ko baithe hue shakhs ko, aur ek chhoti toli ko ek badi toli ko salaam karna chahiye (as-Salam-u-Alaikum kehkar).

e: Abu Talha reported: While we were sitting in front of the houses and talking amongst ourselves, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to come there. He stood by us and said: What about you and your meetings on the paths? Avoid these meetings on the paths. We said: We were sitting here without (any intention of doing harm to the passers-by) ; we are sitting to discuss matters and to hold conversation amongst ourselves. Thereupon he said: If there is no help (for you but to sit on these paths), then give the paths their rights and these are lowering of the gaze, exchanging of greetings and good conversation.
hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya: Jab hum gharon ke saamne baithe aapas mein baat kar rahe the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye. Woh humare paas khade hue aur kaha: Ye kya hai ki tum raaston par apni sabhaen karte ho? In raaston par sabha karne se bacho. Humne kaha: Hum yahan (raahgeeron ko koi nuksaan pahunchaane ki koi niyat ke bina) baithe hain; hum maamlon par charcha karne aur aapas mein baat karne baithe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Agar isse bachna nahi ho sakta (aur tumhe in raaston par baithna hi hai), to raaston ke haqoq poore karo aur woh hain aankhon ko neeche rakhna, salaam exchange karna aur achhi baatchit.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid sitting on the paths. They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, we cannot help but holding our meetings (in these paths) and discuss matters (there). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you insist on holding meetings, then give the path its due right. They said: What are its due rights? Upon this he said: Lowering the gaze, refraining from doing harm, exchanging of greetings. commanding of good and forbidding from evil.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raaston par baithne se bacho. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum bina apni sabhaen (in raaston par) kiye reh nahi sakte aur wahan maamlon par charcha karne se bhi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum sabha karne par ade ho, to raaste ko uska munasib haq do. Unhone kaha: Uska haq kya hai? Isper unhone kaha: Nazar neeche rakhna, koi nuksaan pahunchaane se bachna, salaam exchange karna, achhaai ka hukum dena aur burai se rokna.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the rights of a Muslim over his brother: responding to salutation, saying Yarhamuk Allah when anybody sneezes and says al-Hamdulillah, visiting the sick. following the bier. ' Abd al-Razzaq said that this hadith has been transmitted as mursal hadith from Zuhri and he then substantiated it on the authority of Ibn Musayyib.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ke apne bhai par paanch haq hain: salaam ka jawaab dena, jab koi cheenkta hai aur al-Hamdulillah kehta hai to Yarhamuk Allah kehna, bimaar se milne jaana, janaaze ke saath jaana. Abd al-Razzaq ne kaha ki ye hadees Zuhri se mursal hadees ke soorat mein riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone phir ise Ibn Musayyib ki sanad se pushti ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Six are the rights of a Muslim over another Muslim. It was said to him: Allah's Messenger, what are these? Thereupon he said: When you meet him, offer him greetings;when he invites you to a feast accept it. when he seeks your council give him, and when he sneezes and says:" All praise is due to Allah," you say Yarhamuk Allah (may Allah show mercy to you) ; and when he fails ill visit him; and when he dies follow his bier.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ke doosre Musalman par chhe haq hain. Unse poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kya hain? Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum unse milo, unhe salaam karo; jab woh tumhe khaane par bulaayein, ise qubool karo; jab woh tumse salaah maangein use do, aur jab woh cheenken aur kahein: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai," tum Yarhamuk Allah kaho (Allah tum par rehmat kare); aur jab woh bimaar padein unse milne jao; aur jab unka intiqaal ho jaaye unke janaaze ke saath jaao.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the People of the Book offer you salutations, you should say: The same to you.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Kitaab waale (Yahudi ya Isaayi) tumhe salaam karein, tumhe kehna chahiye: Tumhe bhi wahi.

e: Anas reported that the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: The People. of the Book offer us salutations (by saying as-Salamu- 'Alaikum). How should we reciprocate them? Thereupon he said: Say: Wa 'Alaikum (and upon you too).
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ne unse kaha: Kitaab waale humein salaam karte hain (as-Salamu-Alaikum kehkar). Humein unka jawaab kaise dena chahiye? Isper unhone kaha: Kaho: Wa Alaikum (aur tumpar bhi).

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the Jews offer you salutations, some of them say as-Sam-u-'Alaikum (death be upon you). You should say (in response to it): Let it be upon you.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Yahudi tumhe salaam karein, unmein se kuch kehte hain as-Sam-u-Alaikum (tumpar maut ho). Tumhe (iske jawaab mein) kehna chahiye: Woh tumpar hi ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that a group of Jews came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and sought his audience and said: As-Sam-u-'Alaikum. A'isha said in response: As-Sam-u-'Alaikum (death be upon you) and curse also, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, verily Allah loves kindness in every matter. She said: Did you bear what they said? Thereupon he said: Did you not hear that I said (to them): Wa 'Alaikum.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Yahudiyon ka ek giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse mulaqaat ki ijazat maangi aur kaha: As-Sam-u-Alaikum. Aisha ne jawaab mein kaha: As-Sam-u-Alaikum (tumpar maut ho) aur laanat bhi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, yaqeenan Allah har maamle mein narmi ko pasand karta hai. Unhone kaha: Aapne suna unhone kya kaha? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne nahi suna ki maine (unse) kaha: Wa Alaikum.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I said 'Alaikum, and the transmitter did not make mention of the word "and".
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maine Alaikum kaha, aur raawi ne "aur" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported that some Jews came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and they said: Abu'l-Qasim (the Kunya of the Holy Prophet), as-Sam-u-'Alaikum, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Wa 'Alaikum. A'isha reported: In response to these words of theirs, I said: But let there be death upon you and disgrace also, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, do not use harsh words. She said: Did you hear what they said? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Did I not respond to them when they said that; I said to them: Wa 'Alaikum (let it be upon you).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki kuch Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone kaha: Abu'l-Qasim (Nabi-e-Paak ki Kunya), as-Sam-u-Alaikum, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Wa Alaikum. Aisha ne bayan kiya: Unke in alfaazon ke jawaab mein, maine kaha: Lekin tumpar maut ho aur beizzati bhi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, sakht alfaaz istemal mat karo. Unhone kaha: Aapne suna unhone kya kaha? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Kya maine unhe jab unhone ye kaha jawaab nahi diya; maine unse kaha: Wa Alaikum (ye tumpar hi ho).

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'znash with a slight variation of wording. 'A'isha understood their meaning and cursed them and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha. (do not do that) for Allah does not like the use of harsh words, and it was at this stage that this verse of Allah. the Exalt. ed and Glorious. was revealed:" And when they come to thee, they greet thee with a greeting with which Allah greets thee not" (Iviii. 8) to the end of the verse.
hi: Ye hadees A'znash ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Aisha ne unka matlab samjha aur unpar laanat ki aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, (aisa mat karo) kyunki Allah sakht alfaazon ke istemaal ko pasand nahi karta, aur isi mauqe par Allah ki, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur jab woh tumhare paas aate hain, woh tumhe ek aisa salaam karte hain jisse Allah tumhe salaam nahi karta" (58:8) aayat ke akhir tak.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that some people from amongst the Jews said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Abu'l-Qasim. as-Sam-u-'Alaikum, whereupon he said: Wa 'Alaikum, A'isha was enraged and asked him (Allah's Apostle) whether he had not heard what they had said. He said, I did hear and I retorted to them (and the curse that I invoked upon them would receive response from Allah), but (the curse that they invoked upon us) would not be responded.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Yahudiyon mein se kuch logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, as-Sam-u-Alaikum, isper unhone kaha: Wa Alaikum, Aisha gusse mein aayin aur unse poocha ki kya unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) nahi suna unhone kya kaha. Unhone kaha: Maine suna aur maine unhe jawaab diya (aur jo laanat maine unpar maangi use Allah se jawaab milega), lekin (jo laanat unhone humpar maangi) use koi jawaab nahi milega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not greet the Jews and the Christians before they greet you and when you meet any one of them on the roads force him to go to the narrowest part of it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yahudiyon aur Isaayiyon ko salaam mat karo isse pehle ki woh tumhe salaam karein aur jab tum unmein se kisi se raaston par milo, use raaste ke sabse sankeern hisse mein jaane par majboor karo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording. The hadith transmitted on the authority of Waki', the words are 'When you meet the Jews." And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba, the words are: 'When you meet the People of the Book." And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Jarir the words are:" When you meet them," but none amongst the polytheists has been mentioned explicitly by name.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Waki ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain "Jab tum Yahudiyon se milo." Aur Shu'ba ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Jab tum Kitaab waalon se milo." Aur Jarir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Jab tum unse milo," lekin mushrikeen mein se kisi ka bhi naam saaf taur par zikr nahi kiya gaya hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by young boys he would great them.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jawaan bachchon ke paas se guzarte the woh unhe salaam karte the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sayyar with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sayyar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sayyar reported: I was walking with Thibit al-Bunani that he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. And Thibit reported that he walked with Anas and he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. and Anas reported that he walked with Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon. him) and he happened, to pass by children and he greeted them.
hi: Sayyar ne bayan kiya: Main Thibit al-Bunani ke saath chal raha tha ki woh bachchon ke paas se guzre aur unhe salaam kiya. Aur Thibit ne bayan kiya ki woh Anas ke saath chal rahe the aur woh bachchon ke paas se guzre aur unhe salaam kiya. Aur Anas ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal rahe the aur woh bachchon ke paas se guzre aur unhe salaam kiya.

e: Ibn Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: The sign that you have been permitted to come in is that the curtain is raised or that you hear me speaking quietly until I forbid you.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Nishaani ye hai ki tumhe andar aane ki ijazat mil gayi hai jab parda uThAya jaata hai ya jab tum mujhe dheeme se baat karte suno jab tak main tumhe mana na karun.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported that Sauda (Allah he pleated with her) went out (in the fields) in order to answer the call of nature even after the time when veil had been prescribed for women. She had been a bulky lady, significant in height amongst the women, and she could not conceal herself from him who had known her. 'Umar b. Khattab saw her and said: Sauda, by Allah, you cannot conceal from us. Therefore, be careful when you go out. She ('A'isha) said: She turned back. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at that time in my house having his evening meal and there was a bone in his hand. She (Sauda) cline and said: Allah's Messenger. I went out and 'Umar said to me so and so. She ('A'isha) reported: There came the revelation to him and then it was over; the bone was then in his hand and he had not thrown it and he said:" Permission has been granted to you that you may go out for your needs."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Sauda (Allah unse khush ho) parde ke hukum ke nazil hone ke baad bhi (khetoon mein) shauch ke liye bahar jaati thin. Woh ek moTi khaatoon thin, qad mein auraton mein saaf taur par nazar aati thin aur woh khud ko usse chhipa nahi paati thin jo unhe pehchaanta ho. Umar bin Khattab ne unhe dekha aur kaha: Sauda, Allah ki qasam, tum humse chhup nahi sakti. Is liye jab tum bahar jao to savdhaan raho. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Woh (Sauda) wapas mudi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt mere ghar mein apna raat ka khaana khaa rahe the aur unke haath mein ek haddi thi. Woh (Sauda) aayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main bahar gayi aur Umar ne mujhse aisa aisa kaha. Unhone (Aisha ne) bataya: Unpar wahi utri aur phir ye khatam hui; woh haddi tab unke haath mein thi aur unhone use nahi phenka tha aur unhone kaha: Tumhe ijazat di gayi hai ki tum apni zaroorat ke liye bahar jaa sakti ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are: She (Sauda) was a woman who looked to be significant amongst the people (so far as the bulk of her) body was concerned. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: Woh (Sauda) ek aisi aurat thin jo qad (badan ki moti ke maamle mein) mein logon mein saaf nazar aati thin. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go out in the cover of night when they went to open fields (in the outskirts of Medina) for easing themselves. 'Umar b Khattab used to say: Allah's Messenger, ask your ladies to observe veil, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not do that. So there went out Sauda, daughter of Zarn'a, the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), during one of the nights when it was dark. She was a tall statured lady. 'Umar called her saying: Sauda, we recognise you. (He did this with the hope that the verses pertaining to veil would be revealed.) 'A'isha said: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, then revealed the verses pertaining to veil.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen raat ke andhere mein bahar jaati thin jab woh khule khetoon (Madina ke bahari ilaakon mein) mein khud ko halka karne jaati thin. Umar bin Khattab kaha karte the: Allah ke Rasool, apni khavateen ko parda karne ka hukum dijiye, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa nahi kiya. To Sauda, Zarn'a ki beti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ek raat bahar gayin jab andhera tha. Woh ek lambe qad ki khaatoon thin. Umar ne unhe pukaara ye kehte hue: Sauda, hum tumhe pehchaanate hain. (Unhone ye ummeed karte hue kiya tha ki parde se mutaliq aayaten nazil hongi.) Aisha ne kaha: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne phir parde se mutaliq aayaten nazil kin.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Behold, no person should spend the night with a married woman, but only in case he is married to her or he is her Mahram.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Dekho, koi bhi shakhs kisi shaadishuda aurat ke saath raat na guzare, siwaay is baat ke ki woh uska shohar ho ya uska mahram ho.

e: `Uqba b. `Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Beware of getting, into the houses and meeting women (in seclusion). A person from the Ansar said: Allah's Messenger, what about husband's brother, whereupon he (ﷺ) said: Husband's brother is like death.
hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Auraton ke gharon mein jaane aur unse (ekaant mein) milne se bacho. Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, shohar ke bhai ke baare mein kya? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Shohar ka bhai maut jaisa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Abu Habib with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Abu Habib ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Wahb reported: I heard Laith b. Said as saying: Al-Hamv means the brother of husband or like it from amongst the relatives of the husband, for example, cousin, etc.
hi: Ibn Wahb ne bayan kiya: Maine Laith bin Sa'id ko ye kehte suna: Al-Hamv ka matlab hai shohar ka bhai ya shohar ke rishtedaaron mein se usi jaisa koi, jaise chachera bhai, aadi.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr. b. al-'As reported that some persons from Banu Hisham entered the house of Asma' daughter of 'Umais when Abu Bakr also entered (and she was at that time his wife). He (Abu Bakr) saw it and disapproved of it and he made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I did not see but good only (in my wife). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah has made her immune from all this. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit and said: After this day no man should enter the house of another person in his absence, but only when he is accompanied by one person or two persons.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne bayan kiya ki Banu Hisham mein se kuch log Asma, Umais ki beti, ke ghar daakhil hue jab Abu Bakr bhi daakhil hue (aur woh us waqt unki zauja thin). Unhone (Abu Bakr ne) ise dekha aur napasand kiya aur iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur kaha: Maine (apni zauja mein) sirf achhaai hi dekhi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne unhe is sab se paak rakha hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par khade hue aur kaha: Aaj ke din ke baad koi bhi aadmi doosre ke ghar mein uski gairhaazri mein na jaaye, siwaay is baat ke ki woh ek ya do aadmiyon ke saath ho.

e: Anas reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in the company of one of his wives a person happened to pass by them. He called him and when he came, he said to him: 0 so and so, she was my such and such wife. Thereupon he said, Allah's Messenger, if I were to doubt at all, I would have entertained no doubt about you at least. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily Satan circulates in the body like blood.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni ek zauja ki sohbat mein the ek shakhs unke paas se guzra. Unhone use bulaaya aur jab woh aaya, unhone usse kaha: Aye falan-falan, ye meri aisi aisi zauja hain. Isper usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar mujhe kisi bhi shakhs par shak hota, to mujhe kam se kam aap par to shak na hota. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Shaitaan badan mein khoon ki tarah safar karta hai.

e: Safiyya daughter of Huyyay (the wife of Allah's Apostle) reported that while Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him) had been observing I'tikaf, I came to visit him one night and talked with him for some time. Then I stood up to go back and he (Allah's Apostle) also stood up with me in order to bid me good-bye. She was at that time residing in the house of Usama b. Zaid. The two persons from the Ansar happened to pass by him. When they saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). they began to walk swiftly, thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them: Walk calmy, she is Safiyya daughter of Huyyay... Both of them said: Messenger, hallowed be Allah, (we cannot conceive of ab., ug doubtful even in the remotest corners of our minds), whereupon he said: Satan circulates in the body of man like the circulation of blood and I was afraid lest it should instill any evil in your heart or anything.
hi: Safiyya, Huyyay ki beti (Nabi-e-Paak ki zauja), ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) I'tikaf mein the, main ek raat unse milne aayi aur kuch waqt unse baat ki. Phir main wapas jaane ke liye khadi hui aur woh (Allah ke Rasool) mujhe vida karne ke liye mere saath khade hue. Woh us waqt Usama bin Zaid ke ghar mein reh rahi thin. Ansar ke do log unke paas se guzre. Jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha, woh tezi se chalne lage, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Aaram se chalo, ye Safiyya hain, Huyyay ki beti... Donon ne kaha: Rasool, Allah muqaddas hai, (hum apne zehan ke sabse chhupe kone mein bhi koi shak nahi soch sakte), isper unhone kaha: Shaitaan insaan ke badan mein isi tarah safar karta hai jaise khoon safar karta hai aur mujhe dar tha ki kahin ye tumhare dil mein koi burai ya kuch daal na de.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Safiyya, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), through another chain of transmitters (and the words) are: " She went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to visit him as he was observing I'tikaf in the mosque during Ramadan. She talked with him for some time and then stood up to go back and Allikh's Apostle (ﷺ) stood up in order to bid her good-bye." The rest of the hadith is the same except with the variation of the words that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:" Satan penetrates in man like the penetration of blood (in every part of body)."
hi: Ye hadees Safiyya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gayin jab woh Ramzan mein masjid mein I'tikaf mein the. Unhone kuch waqt unse baat ki aur phir wapas jaane ke liye khadi hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe vida karne ke liye khade hue." Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay alfaazon ke antar ke ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Shaitaan insaan mein isi tarah daakhil karta hai jaise khoon daakhil karta hai (badan ke har hisse mein)."

e: Abu Waqid al-Laith reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting in the mosque along wish tome people when there came to him three persons; two of them stepped forward to the direction of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and one of them went away. The two stood by the side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and one of them found a space in his circle and he sat in that; and the other one sat behind him and the third one went away. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his work, he said. Should I not inform you about these three persons? One of them sought refuge with Allah and Allah gave him refuge and the second one felt shy and Allah showed kindness to has shyness (and so he was accommodated in that meeting), and the last one reverted and Allah turned away His attention from him.
hi: Abu Waqid al-Laith ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein kuch logon ke saath baithe the jab unke paas teen log aaye; unmein se do Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf aage badhe, aur ek chala gaya. Do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khade hue, aur unmein se ek ko unke ghere mein jagah mil gayi aur woh usmein baith gaya; aur doosra unke peeche baith gaya aur teesra chala gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna kaam khatm kar chuke, unhone kaha: Kya main tumhe in teen logon ke baare mein na bataun? Unmein se ek ne Allah se panah maangi aur Allah ne use panah di, aur doosre ko sharam mehsoos hui aur Allah ne uski sharam par meherbaani ki (is liye use us sabha mein jagah mil gayi), aur aakhri wala mud gaya aur Allah ne use apna dhyaan hataa liya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ishaq b. 'Abdullah b. Talha with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ishaq bin Abdullah bin Talha ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: None of you should make another one stand in the meeting and then occupy his place.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi sabha mein doosre ko khada karke uski jagah na le.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No person should ask another person to stand at his place and then he should himself sit there, but he should simply say: Make room and accommodate.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi shakhs doosre shakhs se apni jagah par khade hone ko na kahe aur phir khud wahan baith jaaye, balki use bas kehna chahiye: Jagah do aur samaao.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters. but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None should make one'& brother stand and then sit at his place (and it was common with) Ibn Umar that when any person stood in the company (with a view to making room for him) he did not sit there.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi apne bhai ko khada karke uski jagah na baithe (aur Ibn Umar ka ye tareeka tha) ki jab bhi koi shakhs sabha mein khada hota (unhe jagah dene ke iraade se) woh wahan nahi baithte the.

e: This hadith hilt been reported on the authority of Ma'mar with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) as saying: None amongst you should make his brother stand on Friday (during the congregational prayer) and then occupy his-place. but he should only say to him (Accommodate me).
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi juma ke din (samuhik namaz ke daurane) apne bhai ko khada na kare aur phir uski jagah le, balki use bas kehna chahiye (Mujhe jagah do).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone amongst you stands up, and in the badltb transmitted on the authority of Abu 'Awina, the words are:" He who stands in his place and (goes away) and then comes back to it, he his the greatest right (to occupy that).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab tum mein se koi khada hota hai, aur Abu Awina ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein, alfaaz hain: Jo apni jagah par khada hota hai aur (chala jaata hai) aur phir wahan wapas aata hai, use isse (uspar kabza karne ka) sabse zyada haq hai.

e: Umm Salama reported that she had a eunuch (as a slave) in her house. Allah's Messenger imay peace be upon him) was once in the house that he (the eunuch) said to the brother of Umm Salama: Abdullahb. Aba Umayya. if Allah grants you victory in Ta'if on the next day, I will show you the daughter of Ghailan for she has four folds (upon her body) on the front side of her stomach and eight folds on the back. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard this and he said: Such (people) should not visit you.
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya ki unke ghar mein unke paas ek khoja (ek ghulam ke soorat mein) tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek baar ghar mein the jab usne (khoje ne) Umm Salama ke bhai se kaha: Abdullah bin Aba Umayya, agar Allah tumhe Ta'if mein agle din jeet deta hai, to main tumhe Ghailan ki beti dikhaunga kyunki uske badan ke aage waale hisse mein pait par chaar taheh hain aur peeche aath taheh hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna aur kaha: Aise log tumhare paas na aayein.

e: 'A'isha reported that a eunuch used to come to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and they did not And anything objectionable in his visit considering him to be a male without any sexual desire. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) one day came as he was sitting with some of his wives and he was busy in describing the bodily characteristics of a lady and saying: As the comes in front tour folds appear on her front side and as she turns her back eight folds appear on the back side. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I me that he knows these things; do not, therefore. allow him to cater. She (" A'isha) said: Then they began to observe veil from him.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki ek khoja Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ke paas aaya karta tha aur unhe uske aane mein koi aiterazjanak baat nahi lagti thi, ye maankar ki woh koi jinsi ichchha na rakhne wala mard hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din aaye jab woh apni kuch zaujaon ke saath baitha tha aur ek aurat ke shareerik gunon ka varnan karne mein masroof tha aur keh raha tha: Jab woh saamne aati hai chaar taheh uske saamne wale hisse par pragat hoti hain aur jab woh apni peeth modti hai aath taheh peeche pragat hoti hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ki use ye cheezein pata hain; is liye ise (khaane ke liye) mat aane do. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Phir woh usse parda karne lagin.

e:
As narrated by Asma bint Abi Bakr (may Allah be pleased with her): Muhammad ibn Al-Ala’ Abu Kurayb Al-Hamdani told us, Abu Usama told us, from Hisham, who informed me from his father, from Asma bint Abi Bakr, who said:
“Az-Zubair married me, and he did not possess any wealth on earth, no servant, nor anything except his horse.” She continued, “I used to feed his horse, take care of it, and manage its upkeep. I would grind date stones for his horse, feed it, draw water, and patch his bucket. I also kneaded dough, but I was not good at baking, so my Ansar neighbors, who were truthful and kind women, would bake for me. I would carry date stones on my head from Az-Zubair’s land that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had allocated to him. The land was two-thirds of a farsakh (a measure of distance) away.”
She further said: “One day, as I was carrying the date stones on my head, I met the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) along with a group of his companions. He called me and said, ‘Ikh, Ikh (a sound made to signal a camel to kneel down),’ indicating that he wanted to carry me behind him. However, I felt shy and remembered your jealousy. The Prophet (peace be upon him) understood my hesitation and said, ‘By Allah, carrying the date stones on your head is harder on you than riding with me.’”
She continued: “After that, Abu Bakr sent me a servant who took over the responsibility of caring for the horse. It was as if he had set me free.
hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti (Allah unse khush ho), ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone kaha: Zubair ne mujhse shaadi ki aur unke paas duniya mein koi daulat nahi thi, na koi naukar, na apne ghode ke ilawa aur kuch. Unhone aage kaha: Main unke ghode ko khilaati, uska khyaal rakhti aur uski dekhbhaal karti. Main unke ghode ke liye khajoor ki gutliyaan peesti, use khilaati, paani laati aur uski balti theek karti. Main aata bhi gundhti thi, lekin roti pakaane mein achhi nahi thi, is liye mere Ansar padosi, jo sachche aur meherbaan auraten thin, mere liye roti pakaate the. Main Zubair ki zameen se, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe di thi, khajoor ki gutliyaan apne sar par laati thi. Woh zameen do-tihai farsakh (doori ki ek naap) door thi. Unhone aage kaha: Ek din jab main apne sar par khajoor ki gutliyaan laa rahi thi, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mili unke kuch sahaba ke saath. Unhone mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Ikh, Ikh (oont ko baithaane ka ishara), ye jataate hue ki woh mujhe apne peeche sawaar karna chaahte the. Halaanki, mujhe sharam mehsoos hui aur mujhe tumhari (Zubair ki) ghairat yaad aayi. Nabi (SAW) ne mera sankoch samjha aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, apne sar par khajoor ki gutliyaan le jaana tumhare liye mere saath sawaar hone se zyada mushkil hai. Unhone aage kaha: Iske baad, Abu Bakr ne mujhe ek naukar bheja jisne ghode ki dekhbhaal ki zimmedaari le li. Jaise unhone mujhe azaad kar diya ho.

e: Asma' reported: I performed the household duties of Zubair and he had a horse; I used to look after it. Nothing was more burdensome for me than looking after the horse I used to bring grass for it and looked after it, then I got a servant as Allah's Apustle (ﷺ) had some prisoners of war in his possession. He gave me a female servant. She (the female servant) then began to look after the horse and thus relieved me of this burden. A person came and he said: Mother of 'Abdullah, I am a destitute person and I intend that I should start business under the shadow of your house. I (Asma') said: If I grant you permission, Zubair may not agree to that, so you come and make a demand of it when Zubair is also present there. He came accordingly find said: Mother of 'Abdullah. I am a destitute person. I intend to start t mall business in the shadow of your house. I said: Is there not in Medina (any place for starting the business) except my house? Zubair said: Why is it that you prohibit the destitute man to start business here? So he started business and he (earned so much) that we sold our slave-girl to him There came Zubair to me while the money was in my lap. He said: Give this to me. I said: (I intend) to spend it as charity.
hi: Asma ne bayan kiya: Main Zubair ke ghar ke kaam-kaaj karti thi aur unke paas ek ghoda tha; main uska khyaal rakhti thi. Ghode ka khyaal rakhna mere liye sabse mushkil kaam tha. Main iske liye ghaas laati aur iski dekhbhaal karti, phir mujhe ek naukar mila kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch jung ke qaidi the. Unhone mujhe ek laundi di.
