Woh (laundi) phir ghode ki dekhbhaal karne lagi aur is tarah mujhe is bojh se rahat mili. Ek shakhs aaya aur usne kaha: Abdullah ki maa, main ek majboor shakhs hoon aur mera iraada hai ki main tumhare ghar ki chhaaya mein vyaapaar shuru karun. Maine (Asma ne) kaha: Agar main tumhe ijazat doon, to Zubair shaayad sehmat na ho, is liye tum aao aur ye maang karo jab Zubair bhi wahan maujood hon. Woh uske mutabik aaye aur kaha: Abdullah ki maa, main ek majboor shakhs hoon. Mera iraada hai ki main tumhare ghar ki chhaaya mein choti vyaapaar shuru karun. Maine kaha: Kya Madina mein mere ghar ke ilawa (vyaapaar shuru karne ke liye) koi jagah nahi hai? Zubair ne kaha: Tum majboor aadmi ko yahan vyaapaar karne se kyun rok rahi ho? Is liye usne vyaapaar shuru kiya aur usne (itna kamaya) ki humne apni laundi use bech di. Zubair mere paas aaye jab paisa mere god mein tha. Unhone kaha: Ise mujhe do. Maine kaha: (Mera iraada hai) ise sadaqe mein kharch karne ka.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When there are three (persons), two should not converse secretly between themselves to the exclusion of the (third) one.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab teen (log) hon, do ko teesre ko chhodkar aapas mein chupke se baat nahi karni chahiye.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of lbn 'Umar through two different chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se do doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you are three, two amongst you should not converse secretly between yourselves to the exclusion of the other (third one), unti some other people join him (and dispel his loneliness), for it may hurt his feelings.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum teen ho, do ko tum mein se doosre (teesre) ko chhodkar aapas mein chupke se baat nahi karni chahiye, jab tak koi doosra shakhs uske saath na aa jaaye (aur uska akelapan door na kare), kyunki isse uski bhaavnaon ko chot pahunch sakti hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you are three, two should not converse secretly to the exclusion of your companion for that hurts his feelings.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum teen ho, do ko apne saathi ko chhodkar chupke se baat nahi karni chahiye kyunki isse uski bhaavnaon ko chot pahunchti hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha (the wife of Allah's Apostle) said: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell ill, Gabriel used to recite this: "In the name of Allah, may He cure you from all kinds of illnesses and safeguard you from the evil of a jealous one when he feels jealous and from the evil influence of eye."
hi: Aisha (Allah ke Rasool ki zauja) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade, Jibril ye padha karte: "Allah ke naam par, Woh aapko har kism ki beemari se theek kare aur aapko jalan rakhne wale ki burai se aur buri nazar ke asar se mahfooz rakhe jab woh jalan mehsoos kare."

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Gabriel came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Muhammad, have you fallen ill? Thereupon he said: Yes. He (Gabriel) said: "In the name of Allah I exorcise you from everything and safeguard you from every evil that may harm you and from the eye of a jealous one. Allah would cure you and I invoke the name of Allah for you."
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Jibril Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Muhammad, kya aap bimaar hain? Isper unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Jibril ne) kaha: "Allah ke naam par main aapko har cheez se jhaad-phoonk karta hoon aur aapko har us burai se mahfooz rakhta hoon jo aapko nuksaan pahunchaa sakti hai aur jalan rakhne wale ki nazar se. Allah aapko theek kare aur main aapke liye Allah ka naam pukaarta hoon."

e: Abu Huraira reported so many abidith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The influence of an evil eye is a fact.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kayi hadeesein riwayat kin aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna riwayat ki: Buri nazar ka asar ek waastavikta hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The influence of an evil eye is a fact; if anything would precede the destiny it would be the influence of an evil eye, and when you are asked to take bath (as a cure) from the influence of an evil eye, you should take bath.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Buri nazar ka asar ek waastavikta hai; agar koi cheez taqdeer se aage badh sakti, to woh buri nazar ka asar hota, aur jab tumse buri nazar ke asar se (ilaaj ke soorat mein) nahaane ko kaha jaaye, tumhe nahaana chahiye.

e: A'isha reported: that a Jew from among the Jews of Banu Zuraiq who was called Labid b. al-A'sam cast a spell upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the result that he (under the influence of the spell) felt that he had been doing something whereas in fact he had not been doing that. (This state of affairs lasted) until one day or during one night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made supplication (to dispel its effects). He again made a supplication and he again did this and said to 'A'isha: "Do you know that Allah has told me what I had asked Him? There came to me two men and one amongst them sat near my head and the other one near my feet and he who sat near my head said to one who sat near my feet or one who sat near my feet said to one who sat near my head: What is the trouble with the man? He said: The spell has affected him. He said: Who has cast that? He (the other one) said: It was Labid b. A'sam (who has done it). He said: What is the thing by which he transmitted its effect? He said: By the comb and by the hair stuck to the comb and the spathe of the date-palm. He said: Where is that? He replied: In the well of Dhi Arwan." She said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some of the persons from among his Companions there and then said: "'A'isha, by Allah, its water was yellow like henna and its trees were like heads of the devils." She said that she asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as to why he did not burn that. He said: "No, Allah has cured me and I do not like that I should induce people to commit any high-handedness in regard (to one another), but I only commanded that it should be buried."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Banu Zuraiq ke Yahudiyon mein se ek Yahudi jise Labid bin al-A'sam kaha jaata tha, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu kiya jiske natije mein unhe (jaadu ke asar mein) lagta ki woh kuch kar rahe hain jabki waastav mein woh aisa nahi kar rahe hote the. (Ye haalat tab tak jaari rahi) yahan tak ki ek din ya ek raat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dua ki (iske asar ko khatam karne ke liye). Unhone dobara dua ki aur unhone dobara aisa kiya aur Aisha se kaha: "Kya tumhe pata hai Allah ne mujhe bataya hai jo maine Usse poocha tha? Mere paas do aadmi aaye aur unmein se ek mere sar ke qareeb baitha aur doosra mere paon ke qareeb, aur jisne mere sar ke qareeb baithe the usne uske paas jo mere paon ke qareeb baitha tha, ya jisne mere paon ke qareeb baithe the usne uske paas jo mere sar ke qareeb baitha tha, kaha: Is aadmi ko kya takleef hai? Unhone kaha: Jaadu ne unhe prabhaavit kiya hai. Unhone poocha: Kisne ye kiya? Unhone (doosre ne) kaha: Ye Labid bin A'sam tha (jisne ye kiya). Unhone poocha: Woh cheez kya hai jisse usne iska asar pahunchaaya? Unhone kaha: Kanghi se aur kanghi mein phanse baalon se aur khajoor ke phool ke aavraan se. Unhone poocha: Woh kahan hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Dhi Arwan ke kuen mein." Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne kuch sahaba ko wahan bheja aur phir kaha: "Aisha, Allah ki qasam, iska paani mehndi jaisa peela tha aur iske darakht shaitaanon ke sar jaise the." Unhone kaha ki unhone (Aisha ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki unhone ise (jaadu ka saamaan) kyun nahi jalaya. Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ne mujhe theek kar diya hai aur mujhe pasand nahi ki main logon ko ek-doosre ke khilaaf koi zulm karne ke liye uksaaun, lekin maine sirf ise gaadne ka hukum diya."

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was affected with a spell, the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording: " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the well and looked towards it and there were trees of date-palm near it. I ('A'isha) said: I asked Allah'& Messenger (ﷺ) to bring it out, and 1 did not say: Why did not you burn it?" And there is no mention of these words:" I commanded (to bury them and they buried."
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jaadu ka asar hua, baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is alfaaz ke antar ke saath: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuen ke paas gaye aur iski taraf dekha aur wahan khajoor ke darakht the. Maine (Aisha ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ise bahar nikaalne ko kaha, aur maine ye nahi poocha: Aapne ise kyun nahi jalaya?" Aur ismein in alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Maine (ise gaadne ka) hukum diya aur unhone ise gaada."

e: Anas reported that a Jewess came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with poisoned mutton and he took of that what had been brought to him (Allah's Messenger). (When the effect of this poison were felt by him) he called for her and asked her about that, whereupon she said: I had determined to kill you. Thereupon he said: Allah will never give you the power to do it. He (the narrator) said that they (the Companion's of the Holy Prophet) said: Should we not kill her? Thereupon he said: No. He (Anas) said: I felt (the affects of this poison) on the uvula of Allah's Messenger.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas zeher wali bakri ka gosht laayi aur unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) usme se khaya jo unhe diya gaya tha. (Jab unhone is zeher ke asar mehsoos kiye) unhone use bulaaya aur iske baare mein poocha, isper usne kaha: Maine aapko qatal karne ka faisla kar liya tha. Isper unhone kaha: Allah tumhe kabhi is kaam ki taqat nahi dega. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ke sahaba ne) kaha: Kya humein use qatal nahi karna chahiye? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone (Anas ne) kaha: Maine (is zeher ke) asar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke munh ke andar ke hisse par mehsoos kiye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a Jewess brought poisoned meat and then served it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi aurat zeher wala gosht laayi aur phir use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pesh kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported: When any person amongst us fell ill, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) used to rub him with his right band and then say: O Lord of the people, grant him health, heal him, for Thou art a Greet Healer. There is no healere, but with Thy healing Power one is healed and illness is removed. She further added: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell ill, and his illness took a serious turn I took hold of hie hand to that I should do with it what he ward to do with that (i. e. I would rub his body with his sacred hand). But he withdrew his hand from my hand and then said: O Allah, pardon me and make me join the companion. ship on She said. I was gazing at him constantly whereas he had passed away.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Jab humme se koi bimaar pad jaata, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe apne daaye haath se malte aur phir kehte: Aye logon ke Rab, use sehat de, use theek kar, kyunki Tu ek Mahaan Chikitsak hai. Koi doosra chikitsak nahi hai, lekin Teri chikitsa taaqat se hi shifa milti hai aur beemari duur hoti hai. Unhone aage kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade aur unki beemari ne sangin modh liya, maine unka haath pakda taaki main usse woh karoon jo woh khud karte the (yaani main unke muqaddas haath se unka badan malti). Lekin unhone apna haath mere haath se hataa liya aur phir kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar aur mujhe uchch sathi (Firdaus) mein shaamil kar de. Unhone kaha: Main unhe lagataar nihaar rahi thi jab unka intiqaal ho gaya.

e: This. hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): " He rubbed him with his hand" and (in) the hadith transmitted on the authority of Thauri (the words are)." He used to rub with his right hand." This hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Unhone unhe apne haath se mala" aur Thauri ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Woh apne daaye haath se malte the." Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited the sick he would say: Lord of the people. remove the disease, cure him, for Thou art the great Curer, there is no cure but through Thine healing Power, which leaves nothing of the disease.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar se milne jaate woh kehte: Logon ke Rab, beemari duur kar, ise theek kar, kyunki Tu Mahaan Chikitsak hai, koi chikitsa nahi hai siwaay Teri chikitsa taaqat ke, jo beemari ka koi hissa baaki nahi chhodti.

e: 'A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit any sick he supplicated for him and said: Lord of the people, remove the malady, cure him for Thou art a great Curer. There is no cure but through Thine healing Power which leaves no trouble, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi bimaar se milne aate woh unke liye dua karte aur kehte: Logon ke Rab, beemari duur kar, ise theek kar kyunki Tu Mahaan Chikitsak hai. Koi chikitsa nahi hai siwaay Teri chikitsa taaqat ke jo koi mushkil nahi chhodti, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite (this supplication) as the words of invocation:" Lord of the people, remove the trouble for in Thine Hand is the cure; none is there to relieve him (the burden of disease) but only Thou.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua padha karte the: "Logon ke Rab, mushkil duur kar kyunki Tere Haath mein hi shifa hai; koi bhi nahi hai jo use (beemari ka bojh) hataa sake siwaay Tere."

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitted.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that when any of the members of the household fell ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to blow over him by reciting Mu'awwidhatan, and when he suffered from illness of which he died I used to blow over him and rubbed his body with his hand for his hand had greater healing power than my hand.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab khaandaan ke kisi sadasya ko koi beemari hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Mu'awwidhatan (do sura, al-Falaq aur al-Nas) padhkar unpar phoonk maarte, aur jab unhe woh beemari hui jismein unka intiqaal hua main unpar phoonk maarti aur unke haath se unka badan malti kyunki unka haath mere haath se zyada shifa ki taaqat waala tha.

e: 'A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell ill, he recited over his body Mu'awwidhatan and blew over him and when his sickness was aggravated I used to recite over him and rub him with his band with the hope that it was more blessed.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade, unhone apne badan par Mu'awwidhatan padhi aur khud par phoonk maari aur jab unki beemari badhi main unpar padhti aur unke haath se unhe malti is ummeed ke saath ki ye zyada barkat wala hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated through some other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yanus and Ziyari (the words are): " When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) fell ill, he blew over his body by reciting Mu'awwidhatan and rubbed him with his hand.
hi: Ye hadees kuch doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai. Yanus aur Ziyari ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar pade, unhone apne badan par Mu'awwidhatan padhkar khud par phoonk maari aur unhe apne haath se mala."

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Aswad reported on the authority of his father: I asked 'A'isha about invocation. She said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had granted its sanction to the members of a family of the Ansar for invocation in curing every type of poison.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin al-Aswad ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Maine Aisha se jhaad-phoonk ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke ek khaandaan ke sadasyon ko har kism ke zeher ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk karne ki ijazat di thi.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted sanction to the members of a family of the Ansar for invocation (for removing the effects) of the poison of the scorpion.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke ek khaandaan ke sadasyon ko bicchhu ke zeher (ke asar ko hataane) ke liye jhaad-phoonk karne ki ijazat di thi.

e: 'A'isha reported that when any person fell ill with a disease or he had any ailment or he had any injury, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his forefinger upon the ground and then lifted it by reciting the name of Allah. (and said): The dust of our ground with the saliva of any one of us would serve as a means whereby our illness would be cured with the sanction of Allah. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abu Shaiba and Zubair with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab koi shakhs kisi beemari se pareshaan hota ya koi takleef hoti ya use koi chot lagti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni tarjani ungli zameen par rakhte aur phir use uThAte Allah ka naam padhte hue. (Aur kehte): Humari zameen ki mitti, hummein se kisi ke lar ke saath, humari beemari theek karne ka zariya hogi Allah ki ijazat se. Ye hadees Ibn Abu Shaiba aur Zubair ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the use of invocation for curing the influence of an evil eye.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne buri nazar ke asar ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk ka istemaal karne ka hukum diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mis'ar with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mis'ar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) commanded me that I should make use of invocation for curing the influence of an evil eye.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ki main buri nazar ke asar ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk ka istemaal karun.

e: Anas b. Malik reported in connection with invocation that he had been granted sanction (to use invocation as a remedy) for the sting of the scorpion and for curing small pustules and dispelling the influence of an evil eye.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne jhaad-phoonk ke silsile mein bayan kiya ki unhe (jhaad-phoonk ke istemaal ki) ijazat mili thi bicchhu ke daans ke liye aur choti phunsiyon ke ilaaj aur buri nazar ke asar ko duur karne ke liye.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted him sanction to use invocation (as a cure) for the influence of the evil eye, the sting of the scorpion and small pustules.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe buri nazar ke asar, bicchhu ke daans, aur choti phunsiyon ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk istemaal karne ki ijazat di.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a small girl in the house of Umm Salama that he had been seeing on her face black stains and told her that that was due to the influence of an evil eye, and he asked that she should be cured with the help of invocation (hoping) that her face should become spotless.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama ke ghar ki ek choti larki se kaha ki unhone uske chehre par kaale daag dekhe hain aur usse kaha ki ye buri nazar ke asar ki wajah se hai, aur unhone kaha ki uska jhaad-phoonk se ilaaj karwaaya jaaye (ye ummeed karte hue) ki uska chehra daag-rahit ho jaaye.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted sanction to the family of Hazm for invocation (in mitigating the effect of the poison of) the snake, and, he said -to Asma' daughter of 'Umais: What is this that I see the children of my brother lean? Are they not fed properly? She said: No, but they fall under the influence of an evil eve. He said: Use invocation. She recited (the words of invocation before him), whereupon he (by approving them) said: Yes, use this invocation for them.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hazm khaandaan ko saap (ke zeher ke prabhaav ko kam karne) ke liye jhaad-phoonk karne ki ijazat di, aur unhone Asma, Umais ki beti, se kaha: Ye kya hai ki main dekh raha hoon ki mere bhai ke bachche dubla hain? Kya unhe theek se khilaaya nahi jaata? Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin unpar buri nazar ka asar padhta hai. Unhone kaha: Jhaad-phoonk istemaal karo. Unhone (unke saamne jhaad-phoonk ke alfaaz) padhe, isper unhone (ise manzoori dete hue) kaha: Haan, unke liye ye jhaad-phoonk istemaal karo.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted a special sanction for invocation in case of the snake poison to a tribe of 'Amr. Abu Zubair said: I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah as saying that the scorpion stung one of us as we were sitting with Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him). A person said: Allah's Messenger, I use invocation (for curing the effect of sting), whereupon he said: He who is competent amongst you to benefit his brother should do so.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Amr qabile ko saap ke zeher ke maamle mein jhaad-phoonk ki khaas ijazat di. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna ki ek bicchhu ne hummein se ek ko daansa jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main jhaad-phoonk istemaal karta hoon (daans ke asar ko theek karne ke liye), isper unhone kaha: Tum mein se jo apne bhai ko faayda pahunchaane mein saksham ho use aisa karna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported I had a maternal uncle who treated the sting of the scorpion with the help of invocation. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade invocation. He came to him and said: Allah's Messenger, you forbade to practise invocation, whereas I employ it for curing the sting of the scorpion, whereupon he said: He who amongst you is capable of employing it as a means to do good should do that.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Mera ek maama tha jo bicchhu ke daans ka ilaaj jhaad-phoonk ki madad se karta tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhaad-phoonk se mana kiya. Woh unke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne jhaad-phoonk karne se mana kiya, jabki main ise bicchhu ke daans ke ilaaj ke liye istemaal karta hoon, isper unhone kaha: Tum mein se jo isse achhaai ke sadhan ke soorat mein istemaal karne mein saksham ho, use aisa karna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited invocation. Then the people of Amr b. Hazm came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: We know an invocation which we use for curing the sting of the scorpion but you have prohibited it. They recited (the words of invocation) before him, whereupon he said: I do not see any harm (in it), so he who amongst you is competent to do good to his brother should do that.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhaad-phoonk se mana kiya. Phir Amr bin Hazm ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Humein ek jhaad-phoonk pata hai jise hum bicchhu ke daans ke ilaaj ke liye istemaal karte hain lekin aapne ise mana kiya hai. Unhone (unke saamne jhaad-phoonk ke alfaaz) padhe, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe ismein koi nuksaan nazar nahi aata, is liye tum mein se jo apne bhai ki achhaai karne mein saksham ho use aisa karna chahiye.

e: 'Auf b. Malik Ashja'i reported We practised incantation in the pre-Islamic days and we said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion about it? He said: Let me know your invocation and said: There is no harm in the invocation as long as there is no polytheism in it.
hi: Auf bin Malik Ashja'i ne bayan kiya: Hum Islam se pehle ke daur mein jhaad-phoonk (jhaad-phoonk) karte the aur humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe apni jhaad-phoonk bataao, aur kaha: Jhaad-phoonk mein koi harj nahi hai jab tak ismein koi shirk na ho.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that some persons amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey and they happened to pass by a tribe from the tribes of Arabia. They demanded hospitality from the members of that tribe, but they did not extend any hospitality to them. They said to them: Is there any invocator amongst you, at the chief of the tribe has bgen stung by a scorpion? A person amongst us said: 'Yes. So he came to him and he practised invocation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the person became all right. He was given a flock of sheep (as recompense), but he refused to accept that, saying: I shall make a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and if he approves of it. then I shall accept it. So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him and he (that person) said: Allah's Messenger by Allah, I did not practice invocation but with the help of Sura al-Fatiha of the Holy Book. He (the Holy Prophet) smiled and said: How did you come to know that it can be used (as invocation)? - and then said: Take out of that and allocate a share for me along with your share.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch log ek safar par nikle aur Arabia ke qabilon mein se ek qabile ke paas se guzre. Unhone us qabile ke logon se mehmaannawaazi ki maang ki, lekin unhone unhe koi mehmaannawaazi nahi di. Unhone unse kaha: Kya tum mein koi jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai, kyunki qabile ke sardaar ko bicchhu ne daansa hai? Hummein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Haan. To woh unke paas gaya aur usne Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se jhaad-phoonk ki aur woh shakhs theek ho gaya. Use bakriyon ka ek rewad diya gaya (badle mein), lekin usne ise qubool karne se inkaar kiya, ye kehte hue: Main iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se karunga, aur agar woh iski manzoori dete hain, to main ise qubool karunga. To hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya aur unhone (us shakhs ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, maine Muqaddas Kitaab ki Sura al-Fatiha ki madad ke ilawa koi jhaad-phoonk nahi ki. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) muskuraaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaise pata chala ki ise (jhaad-phoonk ke soorat mein) istemaal kiya jaa sakta hai? - aur phir kaha: Usmein se lo aur mere liye bhi apne hisse ke saath ek hissa alag rakho.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bishr with the same the same chain of transmitters (with these words): That he recited Umm-ul-Qur'an (Sura Fatiha), and he collected his spittle and he applied that and the person became all right.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bishr ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (in alfaazon ke saath): Ki unhone Umm-ul-Qur'an (Sura Fatiha) padhi, aur unhone apni lar ikattha ki aur use lagaaya aur woh shakhs theek ho gaya.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: We landed at a place where a woman came to us and said: A scorpion has bitten the chief of the tribe. Is there any invocator amongst you? A person amongst us stood up (and went with her). We had no idea that he had been a good invocator but he practiced invocation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the (the chief) was all right. They gave him a flock of sheep and served us milk. We said (to him): Are you a good invocator. Thereupon he said: I did not do it but by the help of Sura al-Fatiha. He said: Do not drive (these goats) until we go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and find out (whether it is permissible to accept (this reward of invocation). So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: How did you come to know that this (Sura al-Fatiha) could be used as an invocation? So distribute them (amongst those who had been present there with him) and allocate a share of mine also.
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum ek jagah utre jahan ek aurat humare paas aayi aur kaha: Ek bicchhu ne qabile ke sardaar ko kaata hai. Kya tum mein koi jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai? Hummein se ek shakhs khada hua (aur uske saath gaya). Humein nahi pata tha ki woh ek achha jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai lekin usne Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se jhaad-phoonk ki aur (sardaar) theek ho gaya. Unhone use bakriyon ka ek rewad diya aur humein doodh pilaaya. Humne (usse) kaha: Kya tum ek achhe jhaad-phoonk karne wale ho? Isper unhone kaha: Maine ye sirf Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se kiya. Unhone kaha: (In bakriyon ko) mat haanko jab tak hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na jaayein aur pata na karein (ki kya ye jaayez hai ki jhaad-phoonk ka ye inaam qubool kiya jaaye). To hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Tumhe kaise pata chala ki ise (Sura al-Fatiha ko) jhaad-phoonk ke soorat mein istemaal kiya jaa sakta hai? Is liye inhe (unke beech) baanto jo wahan unke saath maujood the aur mera bhi ek hissa alag rakho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and he said: There stood up with her a person amongst us whom we did not know before as an invocator.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: Uske saath hummein se ek shakhs khada hua jise hum pehle jhaad-phoonk karne wale ke soorat mein nahi jaante the.

e: Uthman b. Abu al-'As Al-Thaqafi reported that he made a complaint of pain to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he felt in his body at the time he had become Muslim. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Place your hand at the place where you feel pain in your body and say Bismillah (in the name of Allah) three times and seven times A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that I find and that I fear).
hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As Al-Thaqafi ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us dard ki shikaayat ki jo unhe apne badan mein mehsoos hota tha jab se unhone Islam qubool kiya tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apna haath us jagah rakho jahan tumhe apne badan mein dard mehsoos hota hai aur teen baar Bismillah (Allah ke naam par) kaho aur saat baar A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru (Main Allah ki aur Uski taaqat ki panah maangta hoon us burai se jo main mehsoos karta hoon aur jisse main Darta hoon).

e: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. I did that and Allah dispelled that from me.
hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Shaitaan mere aur meri namaz aur mere Quran padhne ke beech aata hai aur mujhe confuse karta hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh Shaitaan hai jise Khinzab kaha jaata hai, aur jab tum uska asar mehsoos karo, isse Allah ki panah maango aur apni baayi taraf teen baar thooko. Maine aisa kiya aur Allah ne use mujhse duur kiya.

e: 'Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he narrated like this. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Salam b. Nuh there is no mention of three times,
hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone isi tarah riwayat ki. Salam bin Nuh ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein teen baar ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Uthman b. Abu al-'As with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Uthman bin Abu al-As ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is a remedy for every malady, and when the remedy is applied to the disease it is cured with the permission of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har beemari ka ek ilaaj hai, aur jab ilaaj beemari par laagoo kiya jaata hai, ye Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki ijazat se theek ho jaati hai.

e: Jabir reported that he visited Muqanna' and then said: I will not go away unless you get yourself cupped, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: It is a remedy.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki unhone Muqanna se mulaqaat ki aur phir kaha: Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak tum khud ko cupping (hijama) na karwaao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye ek ilaaj hai.

e: 'Asim b. 'Umar b. Qatada reported: There came to our house 'Abdullah and another person from amongst the members of the household who complained of a wound. Jabir said: What ails you? He said: There is a wound which is very painful for me, whereupon he said: Boy, bring to me a cupper. He said: 'Abdullah, what do you intend to do with the cupper? I said: I would get this wound cupped. He said: By Allah. oven the touch of fly or cloth causes me pain (and cupping) would thus cause me (unbearable) pain. And when he saw him feeling pain (at the idea of cupping), he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there is any effective remedy amongst your remedies, these are (three): Cupping, drinking of honey and cauterisation with the help of fire. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: As for myself I do not like cauterisation. The cupper was called and he cupped him and he was all right.
hi: Asim bin Umar bin Qatada ne bayan kiya: Abdullah aur khaandaan ke ek doosre sadasya humare ghar aaye jinhone ek zakhm ki shikaayat ki. Jabir ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Ek zakhm hai jo mujhe bahut takleef deta hai, isper unhone kaha: Bete, mere liye ek cupping karne wala lao. Unhone kaha: Abdullah, aapka cupping karne wale se kya iraada hai? Maine kaha: Main is zakhm ki cupping karwaaunga. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, makhi ya kapde ka sparsh bhi mujhe dard deta hai (aur cupping) is liye mujhe (asahaya) dard degi. Aur jab unhone use (cupping ke khyaal se) dard mehsoos karte dekha, unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tumhare ilaajon mein koi prabhaavshaali ilaaj hai, to woh ye (teen) hain: Cupping, shahad peena, aur aag se daagna. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Jahan tak mera sawal hai, mujhe daagna pasand nahi hai. Cupping karne wale ko bulaaya gaya aur usne unhe cupping ki aur woh theek ho gaye.

e: Jabir reported that Umm Salama sought permission from Allah's messenger (may Allah's peace upon him) tor getting herself cupped. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) asked Abu Taiba to cup her. He (Jabir) said: I think he (Abu Taiba) was her faster brother or a young boy before entering upon the adolescent period.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se khud ko cupping karvaane ki ijazat maangi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Taiba se kaha ki woh unhe cupping karein. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai Abu Taiba unke doodh-bhai the ya ek jawaan larka the kishoravastha mein daakhil karne se pehle.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a phystian to Ubayy b. Ka'b. He cut the vein and then cauterised it.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ubayy bin Ka'b ke paas ek chikitsak bheja. Usne uski nas kaati aur phir use daaga.

e: A'mash reported this with the same chain of transmitters and he made no mention of the fact that he cut one of his veins.
hi: A'mash ne ise isi sanad se riwayat ki aur unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya ki unhone uski ek nas kaati.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdillah reported that on the day of Ahzab Ubayy received the wound of an arrow in his medial arm vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it.
hi: Jabir bin Abdillah ne bayan kiya ki Ahzab ke din Ubayy ko unki baazu ki darmiyan nas mein teer ka zakhm laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use daaga.

e: Jabir reported that Sa'd b. Mu'adh received a wound of the arrow in his vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it with a rod and it was swollen, to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did it for the second time.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Mu'adh ko unki nas mein teer ka zakhm laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use ek lathi se daaga aur ye sooj gayi, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dobara kiya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got himself cupped and gave to the cupper his wages and he put the medicine in the nostril.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko cupping karvaayi aur cupping karne wale ko uski mazdoori di aur unhone naak mein dawaai daali.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got himself cupped and never withheld the wages of anyone.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko cupping karvaayi aur kabhi kisi ki mazdoori nahi roki.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever from the vehement raging of the (heat of Hell), so cool it with the help of water.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar (Jahannam ki garmi) ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is due to vehemence of the heat of Hell, so cool it with water.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki ugra garmi se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement raging of the fire of Hell, so extinguish it with water.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se bujhao.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement Paging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement raging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Asma' reported that a woman running high fever was brought to her. She asked water to be brought and then sprinkled it in the opening of a shirt at the uppermost part of the chest and said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Cool (the fever) with water. for it is because of the vehemence of the beat of Hell.
hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat jise tez bukhaar tha unke paas laayi gayi. Unhone paani mangwaaya aur phir use kurte ke gale ke khule hisse mein, seene ke sabse upar wale hisse mein, chhidka aur kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: (Bukhaar) ko paani se Thanda karo, kyunki ye Jahannam ki garmi ki ugra jvala ki wajah se hota hai.

e: Hisham reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Numair (the words are): " She poured water on her sides and in the opening of the shirt at the uppermost part of the chest." There is no mention of these words:" It is from the vehemence of the heat of the Hell." This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Usama with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Hisham ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki. Ibn Numair ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Unhone uske paksho par aur kurte ke gale ke khule hisse mein, seene ke sabse upar wale hisse mein, paani daala." In alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Ye Jahannam ki garmi ki ugra jvala ki wajah se hai." Ye hadees Abu Usama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: I heard Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of the Hell, so cool it with water.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki tez garmi ki wajah se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of Hell, so cool it down in your (bodies) with water. Aba Bakr has made no mention of the word" from you" ('ankum), but he said that Rafi' b. Khadij had informed him of it.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki tez garmi ki wajah se hota hai, is liye ise apne (badan) mein paani se Thanda karo. Aba Bakr ne "tumse" (ankum) lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya, lekin unhone kaha ki Rafi bin Khadij ne unhe iski jaankaari di thi.

e: 'A'isha reported: we (intended to pour) medicine in the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his illness, but he pointed out (with the gesture of his hand) that it should not be poured into the mouth against his will. We said: (It was perhaps due to the natural) aversion of the patient against medicine. When he recovered, he said: Medicine should be poured into the mouth of every one of you except Ibn 'Abbas, for he was not present amongst you.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hum (unki beemari mein) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke munh mein dawaai daalne (ka iraada rakhte) the, lekin unhone (apne haath ke ishare se) bataya ki ise unki marzi ke bina munh mein nahi daala jaana chahiye. Humne kaha: (Ye shaayad) mareez ka dawaai ke prati svaabhaavik virodh (tha). Jab woh theek hue, unhone kaha: Dawaai tum mein se har ek ke munh mein daali jaani chahiye siwaay Ibn Abbas ke, kyunki woh tumhare beech maujood nahi the.

e: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, the sister of 'Ukasha b. Mihsan said: I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my son who had not, by that time, been weaned and he urinated over his (clothes). He ordered water to be brought and sprinkled (it) over them. She (further) said: I visited him (Allah's Apostle) along with my son and I had squeezed the swelling in the uvula, whereupon he said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing like this? Use this Indian aloeswood, for it contains seven types of remedies, one among them being a remedy for pleurisy. It is applied through the nose for a swelling of the uvula and poured into the side of the mouth for pleurisy.
hi: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, Ukasha bin Mihsan ki behn, ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gayi apne bete ke saath jiska us waqt tak doodh nahi chhuda tha aur usne unke (kapdon) par peshaab kar diya. Unhone paani mangwaaya aur (ise) unpar chhidkaaya. Unhone (aage) kaha: Main unse (Allah ke Rasool se) apne bete ke saath milne gayi thi aur maine uski gale ki jeeb ki sooji hui jagah dabaayi thi, isper unhone kaha: Tum apne bachchon ko is tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Ye Indian aloeswood istemaal karo, kyunki ismein saat kism ke ilaaj hain, unmein se ek pleurisy ka ilaaj hai. Ise gale ki jeeb ki sooji ke liye naak ke zariye lagaaya jaata hai aur pleurisy ke liye munh ke ek taraf daala jaata hai.

e: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was one of the earlier female emigrants who had pledged allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She was the sister of Ukasha b. Mihsan, one of the posterity of Asad b. Khuzaima. She reported that she came to Allah's messenger (ﷺ) along with her son who had not attained the age of weaning and she had compressed the swelling of his uvula. (Yunus said: She compressed the uvula because she was afraid that there might be swelling of uvula.) Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing in this way? You should use Indian aloeswood, for it has seven remedies in it, one of them being the remedy for pleurisy. Ubaidullah reported that she had told that that was the child who had urinated in the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for water and sprinkled it on his urine, but he did not wash it well.
hi: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, purani aurat prawaasiyon mein se ek thin jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam li thi. Woh Ukasha bin Mihsan ki behn thin, Asad bin Khuzaima ki aulaad mein se ek. Unhone bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne bete ke saath aayin jiski doodh chhudaane ki umar nahi hui thi aur unhone uski gale ki jeeb ki sooji ko dabaaya tha. (Yunus ne kaha: Unhone gale ki jeeb dabaayi kyunki unhe dar tha ki gale ki jeeb sooj sakti hai.) Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apne bachchon ko is tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Tumhe Indian aloeswood istemaal karna chahiye, kyunki ismein saat ilaaj hain, unmein se ek pleurisy ka ilaaj hai. Ubaidullah ne riwayat ki ki unhone bataya ki ye woh bachcha tha jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki god mein peshaab kiya tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani mangwaaya aur use uske peshaab par chhidka, lekin unhone ise achhi tarah nahi dhoya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Nigella seed is a remedy for every disease except death.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kalonji (mangraila) har beemari ka ilaaj hai siwaay maut ke.

e: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no disease for which Nigella seed does not provide remedy.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi beemari nahi hai jiska ilaaj Kalonji na de.

e: 'A'isha the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: When there was any bereavement in her family the women gathered there for condolence and they departed except the members of the family and some selected persons. She asked to prepare talbina in a small couldron and it was cooked and then tharid was prepared and it was poured over talbina, then she said: Eat it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (may peade be upon him) as saying: Talbina gives comfort to the aggrieved heart and it lessens grief.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Jab unke khaandaan mein koi maut hoti, auraten shok manaane wahan ikattha hotin aur woh chali jaatin siwaay khaandaan ke sadasyon aur kuch chune hue logon ke. Unhone ek chhoti degchi mein talbina banaane ko kaha aur ise pakaaya gaya aur phir tharid banaayi gayi aur ise talbina par daala gaya, phir unhone kaha: Ise khaao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Talbina dukhi dil ko aaraam deta hai aur ye gam ko kam karta hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and told him that his brother's bowels were loose. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Give him honey. So he gave him that and then came and said: I gave him honey but it has only made his bowels more loose. He said this three times; and then he came the fourth time, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him honey. He said: I did give him, but it has only made his bowels more loose, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has spoken the truth and your brother's bowels are in the wrong. So he made him drink (honey) and he was recovered.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki uske bhai ke pet mein dast (diarrhea) hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use shahad do. To usne use shahad diya aur phir aaya aur kaha: Maine use shahad diya lekin isne sirf uske dast ko aur badhaya hai. Usne ye teen baar kaha; aur phir woh chauthi baar aaya, aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Use shahad do. Usne kaha: Maine use diya, lekin isne sirf uske dast ko aur badhaya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne sach kaha hai aur tumhare bhai ka pet galat hai. Is liye usne use (shahad) pilaaya aur woh theek ho gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that he asked Usama b. Zaid: What have you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about plague? Thereupon Usama said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Plague is a calamity which was sent to Bani Isra'il or upon those who were before you. So when you hear that it has broken out in a land, don't go to it, and when it has broken out in the land where you are, don't run out of it. In the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Nadr there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Usama bin Zaid se poocha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mahamaari ke baare mein kya suna hai? Isper Usama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mahamaari ek aafat hai jo Banu Isra'il par ya tumse pehle ke logon par bheji gayi thi. Is liye jab tum sunte ho ki ye kisi zameen mein phaili hai, wahan mat jaao, aur jab ye us zameen mein phaili ho jahan tum ho, wahan se mat bhaago. Abu Nadr ki riwayat mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Plague is the sign of a calamity with which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, affects people from His servants. So when you hear about it, don't enter there (where it has broken out), and when it has broken out in a land and you are there, then don't run away from it.
hi: Usama bin Zaid ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Mahamaari ek aafat ka nishaan hai jisse Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Apne bandon mein se logon ko prabhaavit karta hai. Is liye jab tum iske baare mein suno, wahan mat jao (jahan ye phaili hai), aur jab ye kisi zameen mein phaili ho aur tum wahan ho, phir wahan se mat bhaago.

e: Usama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Plague is a calamity which was inflicted on those who were before you, or upon Bani Isra'il. So when it has broken out in a land, don't run out of it, and when it has spread in a land, then don't enter it.
hi: Usama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahamaari ek aafat hai jo tumse pehle ke logon par, ya Banu Isra'il par, thopi gayi thi. Is liye jab ye kisi zameen mein phaili ho, wahan se mat bhaago, aur jab ye kisi zameen mein phail jaaye, wahan mat jaao.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that a person asked Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas about the plague, whereupon Usama b. Zaid said: I would inform you about it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is a calamity or a disease which Allah sent to a group of Bani Isra'il, or to the people who were before you; so when you hear of it in land, don't enter it and when it has broken out in your land, don't run away from it.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas se mahamaari ke baare mein poocha, isper Usama bin Zaid ne kaha: Main tumhe iske baare mein bataunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek aafat ya beemari hai jo Allah ne Banu Isra'il ke ek giroh par, ya tumse pehle ke logon par bheji thi; is liye jab tum ise kisi zameen mein sunte ho, wahan mat jaao aur jab ye tumhari zameen mein phaili ho, wahan se mat bhaago.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: This calamity or illness was a punishment with which were punished some of the nations before you. Then it was left upon the earth. It goes away once and comes back again. He who heard of its presence in a land should not go towards it, and he who happened to be in a land where it had broken out should not fly from it.
hi: Usama bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye aafat ya beemari ek saza thi jisse tumse pehle ki kuch qaumein saza payi gayi thin. Phir ye zameen par chhoDi gayi. Ye kabhi kabhi chali jaati hai aur phir wapas aati hai. Jisne kisi zameen mein iski maujoodgi ke baare mein suna use uski taraf nahi jaana chahiye, aur jo kisi aisi zameen mein tha jahan ye phail chuki hai use wahan se nahi bhaagna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Shu'ba reported from Habib: While we were in Medina we heard of plague having broken out in Kufa. 'Ata b. Yasir and others said to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. If you are in a land where it (this scourge) has broken out, don't get out of it, and if you were to know that it had broken (in another land, then don't enter it. I said to him: From whom (did you hear it)? They said: 'Amir b. Sa'd has narrated it. So I came to him. They said that he was not present there. So I met his brother Ibrahim b. Sa'd and asked him. He said: I bear testimony to the fact that Usama narrated it to Sa'd saying: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that it is a God-sent punishment from the calamity or from the remnant of the calamity with which people were afflicted before you. So when it is in a land and you are there, don't get out of it, and if (this news reaches you) that it has broken out in a land, then don't enter therein. Habib said: I said to Ibrahim: Did you hear Usama narrating it to Sa'd and he was not denying it. He said: Yes.
hi: Shu'ba ne Habib se riwayat ki: Jab hum Madina mein the humne suna ki Kufa mein mahamaari phail gayi hai. Ata bin Yasir aur doosron ne mujhse kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Agar tum kisi aisi zameen mein ho jahan ye (aafat) phail chuki hai, wahan se mat jaao, aur agar tumhe pata chale ki ye (kisi doosri zameen mein) phail gayi hai, wahan mat jaao. Maine unse kaha: Kisse (tumne ye suna)? Unhone kaha: Amir bin Sa'd ne ise riwayat ki. To main unke paas gaya. Unhone kaha ki woh wahan maujood nahi the. Is liye main unke bhai Ibrahim bin Sa'd se mila aur unse poocha. Unhone kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Usama ne ise Sa'd se riwayat ki ye kehte hue: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki ye ek Allah ke zariye bheji gayi saza hai us aafat se ya us aafat ke baaki hisse se jisse tumse pehle ke log pareshaan huye the. Is liye jab ye kisi zameen mein ho aur tum wahan ho, wahan se mat jaao, aur agar (tumhe khabar mile) ki ye kisi zameen mein phaili hai, wahan mat jaao. Habib ne kaha: Maine Ibrahim se kaha: Kya aapne Usama ko Sa'd se ye riwayat karte suna aur woh iska khandan nahi kar rahe the? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except for the fact that no mention has been made of the account of 'Ata b. Yasir as in the previous hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is baat ke ki Ata bin Yasir ke byore ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya hai jaisa pichhli hadees mein hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Malik, Khuzaima b. Thabit and Usama b. Zaid.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd bin Malik, Khuzaima bin Thabit aur Usama bin Zaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: Usama b. Zaid and Sa'd had been sitting and they had been conversing and they said this hadith.
hi: Ibrahim bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bayan kiya: Usama bin Zaid aur Sa'd baithe hue the aur woh baat kar rahe the aur unhone ye hadees bayaan ki.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Malik on the authority of his father.
hi: Ye hadees Ibrahim bin Sa'd bin Malik ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e:
'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported: Umar b. Khattab set out for Syria. As he came at Sargh (a town by the side of Hijaz on the way to Syria), there met him the commander of the forces, Abu Ubaida b. Jandb, and his companions. They informed him that a scourge had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbas further reported that 'Umar said: Call to me tile earliest emigrants. So I called them. He (Hadrat 'Umar) sought their advice, and they told him that the scourge had broker, out in Syria. There was a difference of opinion (whether they should proceed further or go back to their homes in such a situation). Some of them said: You ('Umar) have set forth for a task, and, therefore, we would not advise you to go back, whereas some of them said: You have along with you the remnants (of the sacred galaxy) of men and (the blessed) Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so we would not advise you to go forth towards this calamity (with such eminent persons and thus expose them deliberately to a danger). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: You can now go away. He said: Call to me the Ansar. So I called them to him, and he consulted them, and they trod the same path as was trodden by the Muhajirin, and they differed in their opinions as they had differed. He said: Now, you can go. He again said: Call to me the old persons of the Quraish who had migrated before the Victory (that is the Victory of Mecca), so I called them (and Hadrat 'Umar consulted them) and not even two persons differed (from the opinion held by the earlier delegates). They said: Our opinion is that you better go back along with the people and do not make them go to this scourge, So 'Umar made announcement to the people: In the morning I would be on the back of my side. So they (set forth in the morning), whereupon Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah said: Are you going to run away from the Divine Decree? Thereupon 'Umar said: Had it been someone else to say this besides you! 'Umar (in fact) did not approve of his opposing (this decision) and he said: Yes, we are running from the Divine Decree (to the) Divine Decree. You should think if there had been camels for you and you happened to get down in a valley having two sides, one of them covered with verdure and the other being barren, would you not (be doing) according to the Divine Decree if you graze them in verdure? And in case you graze them in the barren land (even then you would be grazing them) according to the Divine Decree. 
There happened to come 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and he had been absent in connection with some of his needs. He said: I have with me a knowledge of it, that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you hear of its presence (the presence of plague) in a land, don't enter it, but if it spreads in the land where you are, don't fly from it. Thereupon 'Umar b. Khattab praised Allah and then went back?
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab Syria ke liye nikle. Jab woh Sargh (Hijaz ke bagal mein ek shehar, Syria ke raaste mein) pahunche, unse fauj ke sardaar, Abu Ubaida bin Jandb, aur unke saathi mile. Unhone unhe bataya ki Syria mein ek aafat phail gayi hai. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha ki Umar ne kaha: Sabse purane prawaasiyon ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe bulaaya. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unse salaah maangi, aur unhone unhe bataya ki Syria mein aafat phail gayi hai. Rai mein antar tha (ki kya unhe aage badhna chahiye ya aisi haalat mein apne gharon ko wapas jaana chahiye). Unmein se kuch ne kaha: Aap (Umar) ek kaam ke liye nikle hain, is liye hum aapko wapas jaane ki salaah nahi denge, jabki kuch ne kaha: Aapke saath (muqaddas jamaat ke) log aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (barkat waale) sahaba hain, is liye hum aapko is aafat ki taraf badhne ki salaah nahi denge (aise uchcha logon ke saath aur unhe jaanboojh kar khatre mein daalne ki). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Ab tum jaa sakte ho. Unhone kaha: Ansar ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe unke paas bulaaya, aur unhone unse salaah maangi, aur woh usi raaste par chale jaise Muhajirin chale the, aur unki rai mein bhi ussi tarah antar tha jaise pehle ke logon mein tha. Unhone kaha: Ab tum jaa sakte ho. Unhone phir kaha: Quraish ke un boodhe logon ko bulaao jinhone Fatah (yaani Makkah ki Fatah) se pehle hijrat ki thi, is liye maine unhe bulaaya (aur Hazrat Umar ne unse salaah maangi) aur do se zyada logon ne (pehle ke numainda mandal se) asahmati nahi jataayi. Unhone kaha: Humari rai hai ki aapko logon ke saath wapas jaana chahiye aur unhe is aafat ki taraf mat jaane dijiye. To Umar ne logon ko ailaan kiya: Subah main apni sawaari ki peeth par hunga. To woh (subah nikale), isper Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ne kaha: Kya aap Ilaahi Faisle se bhaag rahe hain? Isper Umar ne kaha: Kaash koi aur tumhare siwaay ye kehta! Umar ne (asal mein) unke virodh ko qubool nahi kiya aur unhone kaha: Haan, hum Ilaahi Faisle se (Doosre) Ilaahi Faisle ki taraf bhaag rahe hain. Tumhe sochna chahiye ki agar tumhare paas oont hote aur tum ek wadi mein utarte jismein do hisse hote, ek hariyaali se dhaka aur doosra banjar, kya tum Ilaahi Faisle ke mutabik nahi hoge agar tum unhe hariyaali mein charaao? Aur agar tum unhe banjar zameen mein charaao (tab bhi tum unhe) Ilaahi Faisle ke mutabik hi charaa rahe hoge. Abd al-Rahman bin Auf aaye jo apni kuch zaroorton ki wajah se gairhaazir the. Unhone kaha: Mere paas iske baare mein ilm hai, ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum kisi zameen mein iski maujoodgi (mahamaari ki maujoodgi) ke baare mein suno, wahan mat jaao, lekin agar ye us zameen mein phaile jahan tum ho, wahan se mat bhaago. Isper Umar bin Khattab ne Allah ki tareef ki aur phir wapas chale gaye.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ma'mar with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " Do you think that he would graze in the barren land but would abandon the green land? Would you not attribute it to be a failing on his part? He said: Yes. He said: Then proceed. And he moved on until he came to Medina. And he said to me: This is the right place, or he said: That is the destination if Allah so wills."
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Kya tumhe lagta hai ki woh banjar zameen mein charaaega lekin hariyaali waali zameen chhod dega? Kya tum ise uski taraf se ek galti nahi maanoge? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Phir aage badho. Aur woh aage badhe yahan tak ki woh Madina pahunche. Aur unhone mujhse kaha: Ye sahi jagah hai, ya unhone kaha: Ye manzil hai agar Allah ne chaaha."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Harith with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Harith ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Rabi'ah reported: 'Umar went to Syria and as he came to Sargh, information was given to him that an epidemic had broken out in Syria. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: When you hear of its presence in a land, don't move towards it, and when it breaks out in a land and you are therein, then don't run away from it. So 'Umar b. Khattab came back from Sargh. Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Umar went back, along with people on hearing the hadith reported on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf.
hi: Amir bin Rabi'ah ne bayan kiya: Umar Syria gaye aur jab woh Sargh pahunche, unhe khabar di gayi ki Syria mein ek mahamaari phaile hai. Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne unhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Jab tum kisi zameen mein iski maujoodgi ke baare mein suno, uski taraf mat badho, aur jab ye kisi zameen mein phail jaaye aur tum wahan ho, phir wahan se mat bhaago. To Umar bin Khattab Sargh se wapas aa gaye. Salim bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Umar Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ki riwayat ki hui hadees sunkar logon ke saath wapas chale gaye.

e:
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no infection, no safar, no hama. A desert Arab said: Allah's Messenger, how is it that when the camel is in the sand it is like a deer-then a camel afflicted with scab mixes with it and it is affected by sub? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Who infected the first one?


Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi beemari (khud se) sarayat karne wali nahi hoti, na koi safar (badnaseeb mahina), na koi hama (haddiyon se paida hone waala ullu). Ek registaan ke Arab ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise hai ki jab oont registaan mein hota hai to woh hiran jaisa lagta hai - phir khaarish waala oont usmein mil jaata hai aur usse (bhi khaarish) ho jaati hai? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Pehle wale ko kisne bimaar kiya? [Tippni: Zyaadatar ulema iska matlab ye samajhte hain ki ye cheezein khud se, kisi posheeda ya ghair-mamooli zariye se, kisi ko nuksaan nahi pahunchaati ya faila sakti; balki Allah hi aakhri ikhtiyaar rakhne wala hai, aur inhe lekar koi bhi khauf bhara wehm galat hai.]

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no evil omen, no safar, no hama. A desert Arab said: Allah's, Messenger.... The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi bura shakoon nahi hai, koi safar nahi hai, koi hama nahi hai. Ek registaan ke Arab ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool... Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no trahsitive disease. Thereupon a desert Arab stood up. The rest of the hadith is the same and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhri' the Prophet (ﷺ) is reported to have said: There is no transitive disease, no safar, no hama.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai. Isper ek registaan ka Arab khada hua. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein Nabi-e-Paak (SAW) ne kaha ki hai: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi safar nahi hai, koi hama nahi hai.

e: Abu Salama h. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, but he is also reported to have said: A sick person should not be taken to one who is healthy. Abu Salama said that Abu Huraira used to narrate these two (different ahadith) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), but afterwards Abu Huraira became silent on these words:" There is no transitive disease," but he stuck to this that the sick person should not be taken to one who is healthy. Harith b. Abu Dhubab (and he was the first cousin of Abu Huraira) said: Abu Huraira, I used to hear from you that you narrated to us along with this hadith and the other one also (there is no transitive disease), but now you observe silence about it. You used to say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no transitive disease. Abu Huraira denied having any knowledge of that, but he said that the sick camel should not be taken to the healthy one. Harith, however, did not agree with him, which irritated Abu Huraira and he said to him some words in the Abyssinian language. He said to Harith: Do you know what I said to you? He said: No. Abu Huraira said: I simply denied having said it. Abu Salama sad: By my life, Abu Huraira in fact used to report Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: There is no transitive disease. I do not know whether Abu Huraira has forgotten it or he deemed it an abrogated statement in the light of the other one.
hi: Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, lekin unhone ye bhi kaha ki: Kisi bimaar shakhs ko kisi sehatmand ke paas nahi le jaana chahiye. Abu Salama ne kaha ki Abu Huraira ye do (alag) hadeesein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat karte the, lekin baad mein Abu Huraira in alfaazon par khamosh ho gaye: "Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai," lekin unhone isper zaroor kaayam rahe ki bimaar shakhs ko sehatmand ke paas nahi le jaana chahiye. Harith bin Abu Dhubab (jo Abu Huraira ke chachere bhai the) ne kaha: Abu Huraira, main aapse sunte tha ki aap humein is hadees ke saath doosri hadees bhi riwayat karte the (koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai), lekin ab aap ismein khamoshi barat te hain. Aap kaha karte the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai. Abu Huraira ne iski koi jaankaari hone se inkaar kiya, lekin unhone kaha ki bimaar oont ko sehatmand ke paas nahi le jaana chahiye. Harith ne, halaanki, unse asahmati jataayi, jisse Abu Huraira ko takleef hui aur unhone unse Abyssinian bhaasha mein kuch alfaaz kahe. Unhone Harith se kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai maine tumse kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Maine bas iska khandan kiya ki maine ye kaha tha. Abu Salama ne kaha: Meri jaan ki qasam, Abu Huraira waastav mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ye alfaaz riwayat karte the: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai. Mujhe nahi pata ki Abu Huraira ise bhool gaye ya unhone ise doosri hadees ke prakash mein radd samjha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease and he also reported along with it: The ill should not be taken to the healthy.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai aur unhone iske saath ye bhi riwayat ki: Bimaar ko sehatmand ke paas nahi le jaana chahiye.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no huma, no star promising rain, no safar.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi huma nahi hai, koi baarish ki peshangoi karne waala taara nahi hai, koi safar nahi hai.

e:
Jabir reported Allal's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no ill omen, no ghoul.


Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi bura shakoon nahi hai, koi ghoul nahi hai. [Tippni: Zyaadatar ulema iska matlab ye samajhte hain ki ye cheezein khud se, kisi posheeda ya ghair-mamooli zariye se, kisi ko nuksaan nahi pahunchaati ya faila sakti; balki Allah hi aakhri ikhtiyaar rakhne wala hai, aur inhe lekar koi bhi khauf bhara wehm galat hai.]

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no ghoul, no safar.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi ghoul nahi hai, koi safar nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no safar, no ghoul. He (the narrator) said: I heard Abu Zubair say: Jabir explained for them the word safar. Abu Zubair said: safar means belly. It was said to Jabir: Why is it so? He said that it was held that safar implied the worms of the belly, but he gave no explanation of ghoul. Abu Zubair said: Ghoul is that which kills the travellers.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi safar nahi hai, koi ghoul nahi hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine Abu Zubair ko ye kehte suna: Jabir ne unhe safar lafz ka matlab samjhaaya. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Safar ka matlab pet hai. Jabir se poocha gaya: Aisa kyun hai? Unhone kaha ki ye maana jaata tha ki safar pet ke keedon ki taraf ishara karta hai, lekin unhone ghoul ka koi spashteekaran nahi diya. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Ghoul woh hai jo musafiron ko maar deta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no divination but the best type is the good omen. It was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is good omen? Thereupon he said: A good word which one of you hears.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi peshangoi nahi hai lekin sabse achha kism shubh shakoon hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Shubh shakoon kya hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ek achha lafz jo tum mein se koi sunta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no divination, but good omen pleases me, i. e. the good word or a good word.



Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi peshangoi nahi hai, lekin shubh shakoon mujhe khush karta hai, yaani ek achha lafz ya ek achhi baat.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no divination, but good omen pleases me. It was said: What is good omen? He said: Sacred words.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi peshangoi nahi hai, lekin shubh shakoon mujhe khush karta hai. Poocha gaya: Shubh shakoon kya hai? Unhone kaha: Muqaddas alfaaz.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no divination, but I like good words.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi peshangoi nahi hai, lekin mujhe achhe alfaaz pasand hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no hama, no divination, but I like good omen.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi hama nahi hai, koi peshangoi nahi hai, lekin mujhe shubh shakoon pasand hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there be bad luck, it is in the house, and the wife, and the horse.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar badnaseebi hoti hai, to ye ghar mein, aur zauja mein, aur ghode mein hoti hai.

e:
'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no transitive disease, no ill omen, and bad luck is lound in the house, or wife or horse.



Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi sarayat karne wali beemari nahi hai, koi buri shakoon nahi hai, aur badnaseebi ghar mein, ya zauja mein ya ghode mein paayi jaati hai. [Tippni: Zyaadatar ulema iska matlab ye samajhte hain ki ye cheezein khud se, kisi posheeda ya ghair-mamooli zariye se, kisi ko nuksaan nahi pahunchaati ya faila sakti; balki Allah hi aakhri ikhtiyaar rakhne wala hai, aur inhe lekar koi bhi khauf bhara wehm galat hai.]

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with other chains of transmitters but with slight variations of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeliyon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Umar b. Muhammad b. Zaid reported that he heard his father narrating from Ibn 'Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. If bad luck is a fact, then it is in the horse, the woman and the house.
hi: Umar bin Muhammad bin Zaid ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne waalid ko Ibn Umar se riwayat karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Agar badnaseebi ek waastavikta hai, to ye ghode mein, aurat mein aur ghar mein hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" Haqq"" (fact).
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein "Haqq" (waastavikta) lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If there is bad luck in anything, it is the horse, the abode and the woman.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar kisi cheez mein badnaseebi hai, to ye ghode mein, ghar mein aur aurat mein hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If bad luck were to be in anything, it is found in the woman, the horse and the abode.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar badnaseebi kisi cheez mein hoti, to ye aurat mein, ghode mein aur ghar mein paayi jaati.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If bad luck were to be in anything, it is found in the land, in the servant and in the horse.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar badnaseebi kisi cheez mein hoti, to ye zameen mein, khaadim mein aur ghode mein paayi jaati.

e: Mu'awiya b. al-Hakam as-Sulami reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, there were things we used to do in the pre-Islamic days. We used to visit Kahins, whereupon he said: Don't visit Kahins. I said: We used to take omens. He said: That is a sort of personal whim of yours, so let it not prevent you (from doing a thing).
hi: Mu'awiya bin al-Hakam as-Sulami ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kuch cheezein thin jo hum Islam se pehle ke daur mein karte the. Hum jyotishiyon (kahin) ke paas jaate the, isper unhone kaha: Jyotishiyon ke paas mat jaao. Maine kaha: Hum shakoon liya karte the. Unhone kaha: Ye tumhaari ek niji ichchha ka hissa hai, is liye ise tumhe kisi kaam se rokne mat do.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mu'awiya b. Hakam as-Sulami through another chain of transmitters. The hadith transmitted on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir (there is an addition of these words): I said: Among us there are men who draw lines and thus make divination. What about this? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: There was a Prophet who drew lines, so whose lines agree with his line for him it is allowable.
