hi: Ye hadees Mu'awiya bin Hakam as-Sulami ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (in alfaazon ka izafa hai): Maine kaha: Hummein se log hain jo lakeer kheenchke peshangoi karte hain. Iske baare mein kya khyaal hai? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ek Nabi the jo lakeer kheenchte the, is liye jiski lakeer unki lakeer se milti-julti ho uske liye ye jaayez hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: I said: Allah's Messenger, the kahins used to tell us about things (unseen) and we found them to be true. Thereupon he said: That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches and throws into the ear of his friend, and makes an addition of one hundred lies to it.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jyotishi humein (ghaib) cheezon ke baare mein bataate the aur humne unhe sach paaya. Isper unhone kaha: Ye ek sach se mutaliq lafz hai jise ek jinn cheen leta hai aur apne dost ke kaan mein daal deta hai, aur ismein sau jhoot mila deta hai.

e: 'Urwa reported from 'A'isha that she said that people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the kahins. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them: It is nothing (i. e. it is a mere superstition). They said: Allah's Messenger, they at times narrate to us things which we find true. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches away and then cackles into the ear of his friend as the hen does. And then they mix in it more than one hundred lies.
hi: Urwa ne Aisha se riwayat ki ki unhone kaha ki logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se jyotishiyon ke baare mein poocha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Ye kuch nahi hai (yaani ye sirf wehm hai). Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh kabhi kabhi humein aisi cheezein riwayat karte hain jo humein sach lagti hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek sach se mutaliq lafz hai jise ek jinn cheen leta hai aur phir murgi ki tarah apne dost ke kaan mein kartAta hai. Aur phir woh ismein sau se zyada jhoot mila dete hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah. Ibn 'Abbas reported: A person from the Ansar who was amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reported to me: As we were sitting during the night with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), a meteor shot gave a dazzling light. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What did you say in the pre-Islamic days when there was such a shot (of meteor)? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best (the actual position), but we, however, used to say that that very night a great man had been born and a great man had died, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (These meteors) are shot neither at the death of anyone nor on the birth of anyone. Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, issues Command when He decides to do a thing. Then (the Angels) supporting the Throne sing His glory, then sing the dwellers of heaven who are near to them until this glory of God reaches them who are in the heaven of this world. Then those who are near the supporters of the Throne ask these supporters of the Throne: What your Lord has said? And they accordingly inform them what He says. Then the dwellers of heaven seek information from them until this information reaches the heaven of the world. In this process of transmission (the jinn snatches) what he manages to overhear and he carries it to his friends. And when the Angels see the jinn they attack them with meteors. If they narrate only which they manage to snatch that is correct but they alloy it with lies and make additions to it.
hi: Abdullah, Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Ansar mein se ek shakhs jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, ne mujhe bataya: Jab hum raat ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the, ek ulka tez roshni ke saath giri. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum log Islam se pehle ke daur mein aisi (ulka giraaish) ke waqt kya kehte the? Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain (asal haalat), lekin hum kaha karte the ki usi raat koi mahaan aadmi paida hua hai aur koi mahaan aadmi mara hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: (Ye ulkaen) na to kisi ki maut par giri jaati hain na kisi ke paidaish par. Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, jab koi kaam karne ka faisla karta hai to hukum jaari karta hai. Phir (farishte) jo Singhaasan ko sambhaale hue hain, Uski mahima gaate hain, phir aasmaan ke woh bashinda gaate hain jo unke qareeb hain, yahan tak ki ye mahima un logon tak pahunchti hai jo is duniyaavi aasmaan mein hain. Phir woh log jo Singhaasan ko sambhaalne walon ke qareeb hain unse poochte hain: Tumhare Rab ne kya kaha? Aur woh unhe bataate hain jo Usne kaha. Phir aasmaan ke bashinda unse jaankaari maangte hain jab tak ye jaankaari duniya ke aasmaan tak nahi pahunchti. Is transmit karne ki prakriya mein (jinn cheen leta hai) jo woh sun paata hai aur ise apne doston tak le jaata hai. Aur jab farishte jinn ko dekhte hain woh unpar ulka se hamla karte hain. Agar woh sirf woh riwayat karte hain jo woh cheenne mein saphal hue, ye sahi hota hai lekin woh ismein jhoot mila dete hain aur isme izafe karte hain.

e: The hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Safiyya reported from some of the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: He who visits a diviner ('Arraf) and asks him about anything, his prayers extending to forty nights will not be accepted.
hi: Safiyya ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki kuch zaujaon ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo kisi jyotishi (Arraf) ke paas jaata hai aur usse kuch poochta hai, uski chalis raaton tak ki namaz qubool nahi ki jaayegi.

e: 'Amr b. Sharid reported on the authority of his father that there was in the delegation of Thaqif a leper. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent a message to him: We have accepted your allegiance, so you may go.
hi: Amr bin Sharid ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Thaqif ke numainda mandal mein ek kodi (leper) shakhs tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use payaam bheja: Humne tumhari wafadaari qubool kar li hai, is liye tum jaa sakte ho.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the killing of a snake having stripes over it, for it affects eyesight and miscarries pregnancy.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dhaariyaan waale saap ko qatal karne ka hukum diya, kyunki ye nazar ko prabhaavit karta hai aur garbhpat ka wajah banta hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham. He said: The short-tailed snake and the snake having stripes over it should be killed.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone kaha: Choti poonch waale saap aur dhaariyaan waale saap ko qatal kiya jaana chahiye.

e: Salim, on the authority of his father. reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Kill the snakes having stripes over them and short-tailed snakes, for these two types cause miscarriage (of a pregnant woman) and they affect the eyesight adversely. So Ibn 'Umar used to kill every snake that he found. Abu Lubaba b. 'Abd al-Mundhir and Zaid b. Khattab saw him pursuing a snake, whereupon he said: They were forbidden (to kill) those snakes who live in houses.
hi: Salim ne apne waalid ke hawale se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Dhaariyaan waale saap aur choti poonch waale saap ko qatal karo, kyunki ye do kism (garbhvati aurat ka) garbhpat karaate hain aur ye nazar ko bura prabhaav dalte hain. To Ibn Umar har us saap ko qatal karte the jo unhe milta. Abu Lubaba bin Abd al-Mundhir aur Zaid bin Khattab ne unhe ek saap ka picha karte dekha, isper unhone kaha: Unhe (in saapon ko qatal karne se) mana kiya gaya hai jo gharon mein rehte hain.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanding the killing of dogs and the killing of the striped and the short-tailed snakes, for both of them affect the eyesight adversely and cause miscarriage. Zuhri said: We thought of their poison (the pernicious effects of these two). Allah, however, knows best. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said: I did not spare any snake. I rather killed everyone that I saw. One day as I was pursuing a snake from amongst the snakes of the house, Zaid b. Khattab or Abu Lubaba happened to pass by me and found me pursuing it. He said: 'Abdullah, wait. I said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded (us) to kill them, whereupon he said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of the snakes of the houses. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kutton aur dhaariyaan waale aur choti poonch waale saapon ko qatal karne ka hukum dete suna, kyunki ye dono nazar ko bura prabhaav daalte hain aur garbhpat karaate hain. Zuhri ne kaha: Humne unke zeher ke baare mein socha (in dono ke haanikaarak prabhaav ke baare mein). Allah, halaanki, sabse behtar jaanta hai. Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: Maine kisi saap ko nahi chhoda. Maine balki har ek ko qatal kiya jo maine dekha. Ek din jab main ghar ke saapon mein se ek saap ka picha kar raha tha, Zaid bin Khattab ya Abu Lubaba mere paas se guzre aur mujhe iska picha karte paaya. Unhone kaha: Abdullah, ruko. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (humein) inhe qatal karne ka hukum diya, isper unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gharon ke saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya tha. Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nafi' reported that Abu Lubaba talked to Ibn 'Umar to open a door in his house which would bring them nearer to the mosque and they found a fresh slough of the snake, whereupon 'Abdullah said: Find it out and kill it. Abu Lubaba said: Don't kill them, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of the snakes found in houses.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abu Lubaba ne Ibn Umar se baat ki apne ghar mein ek darwaza kholne ke baare mein jo unhe masjid ke qareeb le aata, aur unhe saap ki taazi kachcli mili, isper Abdullah ne kaha: Ise dhoondho aur qatal karo. Abu Lubaba ne kaha: Inhe qatal mat karo, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gharon mein paaye jaane wale saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya tha.

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Urnar used to kill all types of snakes until Abu Lubaba b. 'Abd al-Mundhir Badri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of the snakes of the houses, and so he abstained from it.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar sab kism ke saapon ko qatal kiya karte the yahan tak ki Abu Lubaba bin Abd al-Mundhir Badri ne unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gharon ke saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya tha, aur is liye unhone isse parhez kiya.

e: Nafi' reported that he heard Abu Lubaba informing Ibn 'Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of domestic snakes.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu Lubaba ko Ibn Umar ko ye bataate suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya tha.

e: 'Abdullah reported that Abu Lubaba had informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of the snakes found in the house.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Abu Lubaba ne unhe bataya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghar mein paaye jaane wale saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya tha.

e: Nafi' reported that Abu Lubaba b. 'Abd al-Mundhir al-Ansari (first) lived in Quba. He then shifted to Medina and as he was in the company of 'Abdullah b. 'Umar opening a window for him, he suddenly saw a snake in the house. They (the inmates of the house) attempted to kill that. Thereupon Abu Lubaba said: They had been forbidden to make an attempt to kill house snakes and they had been commanded to kill the snakes having small tails, small snakes and those having streaks over them, and it was said: Both of them affect the eyes and cause miscarriage to women.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abu Lubaba bin Abd al-Mundhir al-Ansari (pehle) Quba mein rehte the. Phir woh Madina muntaqil huye aur jab woh Abdullah bin Umar ki sohbat mein ek chhota darwaza khol rahe the, unhone achaanak ghar mein ek saap dekha. Unhone (ghar ke logon ne) use qatal karne ki koshish ki. Isper Abu Lubaba ne kaha: Unhe ghar ke saapon ko qatal karne ki koshish se mana kiya gaya tha aur unhe hukum diya gaya tha ki woh chhoti poonch waale saap, chhote saap aur dhaariyaan waale saapon ko qatal karein, aur kaha gaya tha: Ye dono aankhein prabhaavit karte hain aur auraton ke garbhpat ka wajah bante hain.

e: Nafi' reported on the authority of his father that as 'Abdullah b. 'Umar saw one day (standing) near the ruin (of his house) the slough of a snake and said (to the people around him): Pursue this snake and kill it. Abu Lubaba Ansari said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He forbade the killing of snakes found in the houses except the short-tailed snakes and those having streaks upon them, for both of them obliterate eyesight and affect that which is in the wombs of (pregnant) women.
hi: Nafi ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki jab Abdullah bin Umar ne ek din (apne ghar ke) khandhar ke qareeb ek saap ki kachcli dekhi aur (apne aas-paas ke logon se) kaha: Is saap ka picha karo aur ise qatal karo. Abu Lubaba Ansari ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko suna. Unhone gharon mein paaye jaane wale saapon ko qatal karne se mana kiya siwaay chhoti poonch waale saapon aur dhaariyaan waale saapon ke, kyunki ye dono nazar mita dete hain aur (garbhvati) auraton ke garbh mein jo hota hai use prabhaavit karte hain.

e: Nafi' reported that Abu Lubaba happened to pass by Ibn 'Umar who lived in the fortified place near the house of 'Umar b. Khattab and was busy in keeping his eyes upon a snake and killing it, the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abu Lubaba Ibn Umar ke paas se guzre jo Umar bin Khattab ke ghar ke qareeb quile-numaa jagah mein rehte the aur ek saap par apni aankhein rakhne aur use qatal karne mein masroof the, baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in a cave when there was revealed to him (the Sura al-Mursalat, i. e. Sura lxxvii.:" By those sent forth to spread goodness" ) and we had just heard (it) from his lips that there appeared before us a snake. He said: Kill it. We hastened to kill it, but it slipped away from us, thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah saved it from your harm just as he saved you from its evil.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hum ek gufaa mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the jab unpar Sura al-Mursalat (77) nazil hui, aur humne abhi ise unke honTon se suna hi tha ki humare saamne ek saap pragat hua. Unhone kaha: Ise qatal karo. Humne jaldi ki ise qatal karne ki, lekin ye humse fisal gaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne ise tumhare nuksaan se bachaaya jaise Usne tumhe iski burai se bachaaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees al-A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded a Muhrim (one who is in the state of pilgrimage) to kill the snake at Mina.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Muhrim (jo Hajj ki haalat mein hai) ko Mina mein saap ko qatal karne ka hukum diya.

e: 'Abdullah reported: While we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the cave, the rest of the hadith is the same as the one narrated above.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Jab hum gufaa mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the, baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu as-Sa'ib, the freed slaved of Hisham b. Zuhra, said that he visited Abu Sa'id Khudri in his house, (and he further) said: I found him saying his prayer, so I sat down waiting for him to finish his prayer when I heard a stir in the bundles (of wood) lying in a comer of the house. I looked towards it and found a snake. I jumped up in order to kill it, but he (Abu Sa'id Khudri) made a gesture that I should sit down. So I sat down and as he finished (the prayer) he pointed to a room in the house and said: Do you see this room? I said: Yes. He said: There was a young man amongst us who had been newly wedded. We went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (to participate in the Battle) of Trench when a young man in the midday used to seek permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to return to his family. One day he sought permission from him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (after granting him the permission) said to him: Carry your weapons with you for I fear the tribe of Quraiza (may harm you). The man carried the weapons and then came back and found his wife standing between the two doors. He bent towards her smitten by jealousy and made a dash towards her with a spear in order to stab her. She said: Keep your spear away and enter the house until you see that which has made me come out. He entered and found a big snake coiled on the bedding. He darted with the spear and pierced it and then went out having fixed it in the house, but the snake quivered and attacked him and no one knew which of them died first, the snake or the young man. We came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention to him and said: Supplicate to Allah that that (man) may be brought back to life. Thereupon he said: Ask forgiveness for your companion and then said: There are in Medina jinns who have accepted Islam, so when you see any one of them, pronounce a warning to it for three days, and if they appear before you after that, then kill it for that is a devil.
hi: Abu as-Sa'ib, Hisham bin Zuhra ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha ki woh Abu Sa'id Khudri se unke ghar milne gaye, (aur aage) kaha: Maine unhe namaz padhte paaya, is liye main baith gaya unki namaz khatm hone ka intezaar karte hue jab maine ghar ke ek kone mein rakhe lakdi ke bandalon mein halchal suni. Maine uski taraf dekha aur ek saap paaya. Main ise qatal karne ke liye uchla, lekin unhone (Abu Sa'id Khudri ne) ishara kiya ki main baith jaaun. Is liye main baith gaya aur jab unhone (namaz) khatm ki, unhone ghar ke ek kamre ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: Kya tum ye kamra dekh rahe ho? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Hummein se ek jawaan shakhs tha jinki nayi shaadi hui thi. Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaai (Khandaq) ki jung mein gaye jab dopahar ke waqt ek jawaan shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apne khaandaan ke paas wapas jaane ki ijazat maangta. Ek din usne unse ijazat maangi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (usse ijazat dete hue) ne usse kaha: Apne hathiyaar apne saath le jaao kyunki mujhe Quraiza qabile se dar hai (ki woh tumhe nuksaan pahunchaayein). Us aadmi ne hathiyaar liye aur phir wapas aaya aur apni zauja ko donon darwazon ke beech khadi paaya. Woh unki taraf jhuka jalan se aveg mein aakar aur unpar barchhi lekar hamla karne ke liye badha unhe bhedne. Unhone kaha: Apni barchhi door rakho aur ghar mein daakhil ho jab tak tum ye na dekh lo ki mujhe kis cheez ne bahar nikaala. Woh andar gaya aur bistar par lipta hua ek bada saap paaya. Usne barchhi se hamla kiya aur ise bhed diya aur phir bahar chala gaya use ghar mein hi chhod kar, lekin saap tadapa aur usse jhapT gaya aur kisi ko nahi pata ki dono mein se kaun pehle mara, saap ya jawaan shakhs. Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya aur kaha: Allah se dua kijiye ki woh (aadmi) zinda ho jaaye. Isper unhone kaha: Apne saathi ke liye maafi maango, aur phir kaha: Madina mein aise jinn hain jinhone Islam qubool kiya hai, is liye jab tum unmein se kisi ko dekho, use teen din tak chetaavni do, aur agar woh uske baad bhi tumhare saamne pragat hote hain, to unhe qatal karo kyunki woh ek shaitaan hai.

e: Asma' b. 'Ubaid reported about a person who was called as-Sa'ib having said: We visited Abu Sa'id Khudri. When we had been sitting (with him) we heard a stir under his bed. When we looked we found a big snake, the rest of the hadith is the same. And in this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: Verily in these houses there live aged (snakes), so when you see one of them, make life hard for it for three days, and if it goes away (well and good), otherwise kill it for (in that case) it would be a nonbeliever. And he (the Holy Prophet) said (to his Companions): Go and bury your companion (who had died by the snake bite).
hi: Asma bin Ubaid ne as-Sa'ib naam ke ek shakhs ke baare mein riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Hum Abu Sa'id Khudri se milne gaye. Jab hum (unke saath) baithe, humne unke bistar ke neeche halchal suni. Jab humne dekha humne ek bada saap paaya, baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Aur ismein riwayat kiya gaya hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan in gharon mein purane (saap) rehte hain, is liye jab tum unmein se kisi ko dekho, teen din ke liye uski zindagi mushkil bana do, aur agar ye chala jaaye (theek hai), warna ise qatal karo kyunki (us haalat mein) ye ek gair-imaandaar (kaafir) hoga. Aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) (apne sahaba se) kaha: Jaao aur apne saathi ko dafn karo (jo saap ke daans se mara tha).

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Messenger having said: There is a group of jinns in Medina who accepted Islam, so he who would see anything from these occupants should warn him three times; and if he appears after that, he should kill him for he is a satan.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Madina mein jinnon ka ek giroh hai jinhone Islam qubool kiya, is liye jo koi in bashindon mein se kuch dekhe use teen baar chetaavni deni chahiye; aur agar woh uske baad pragat hota hai, use qatal karna chahiye kyunki woh ek shaitaan hai.

e: Umm Sharik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded her to kill geckos. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Shaiba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Umm Sharik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe chhipkali (geckos) qatal karne ka hukum diya. Ye hadees Ibn Abi Shaiba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Sharik reported that she consulted Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in regard to killing of geckos, and he commanded to kill them and Umm Sharik is one of the women of Bani 'Amir b. Luwayy. This hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters with the same meaning.
hi: Umm Sharik ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chhipkaliyon ko qatal karne ke baare mein salaah maangi, aur unhone unhe qatal karne ka hukum diya, aur Umm Sharik Banu Amir bin Luwayy ki auraton mein se ek hain. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se isi matlab ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) commanded the killing of geckos, and he called them little noxious creatures.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chhipkaliyon ko qatal karne ka hukum diya, aur unhone unhe choti haanikaarak jeev kaha.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said about the gecko as a noxious creature". Harmala made this addition that she said: I did not hear that he had commanded to kill them.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chhipkali ke baare mein use "haanikaarak jeev" kaha. Harmala ne ye izafa kiya ki unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine nahi suna ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe qatal karne ka hukum diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who killed a gecko with the first stroke for him is such and such a reward, and he who killed it with a second stroke for him is such and such reward less than the first one, and he who killed it with the third stroke for him is such and such a reward less than the second one.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne pehli hi maar mein chhipkali ko qatal kiya use aisa aisa sawaab milta hai, aur jisne isse doosri maar mein qatal kiya use pehle se kam sawaab milta hai, aur jisne isse teesri maar mein qatal kiya use doosre se kam sawaab milta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): - He who killed a gecko with the first stroke for him are ordained one hundred virtues, and with the second one less than that and with the third one less than that.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Jisne pehli hi maar mein chhipkali ko qatal kiya use sau punyapurna karyon ke barabar sawaab milta hai, aur doosri maar mein isse kam aur teesri maar mein aur bhi kam.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (that he who kills a gecko) with the first stroke there are seventy rewards for him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna (ki jo pehli maar mein chhipkali ko qatal karta hai) use sattar (70) sawaab milte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: An ant had bitten a Prophet (one amongst the earlier Prophets) and he ordered that the colony of the ants should be burnt. And Allah revealed to him:" Because of an ant's bite you have burnt a community from amongst the communities which sings My glory."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek chionti ne ek Nabi ko (pehle guzre Nabiyon mein se ek) daansa aur unhone chiontiyon ki poori basti ko jalaane ka hukum diya. Aur Allah ne unpar wahi ki: "Ek chionti ke daans ki wajah se tumne ek aisi qaum ko jala diya jo Meri mahima gaati hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: An Apostle from amongst the Apostles of Allah encamped under a tree, and an ant bit him, and he commanded his belongings to be removed from underneath the tree. He then commanded and it was burnt, and Allah revealed to bin):" Why one ant (which had bitten you) was not killed?"
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasoolon mein se ek Rasool ek darakht ke neeche ruke aur ek chionti ne unhe daansa, aur unhone apna saamaan darakht ke neeche se hataane ka hukum diya. Phir unhone hukum diya aur ise jalaaya gaya, aur Allah ne unpar wahi ki: "Sirf ek chionti (jisne tumhe daansa tha) ko qatal kyun nahi kiya gaya?"

e: Abu Huraira reported so many ahadith and one of them was this that Allah' Messenger (ﷺ) said: When an Apostle from amongst the Apostles of Allah came to sit under a tree an ant bit him. He commanded his luggage to be removed from under the tree and he commanded it to be burnt in the fire and Allah revealed to him:" Why one ant (which had bitten you) was not killed (and why did you burn the others)?
hi: Abu Huraira ne kayi hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasoolon mein se ek Rasool ek darakht ke neeche baithne aaye ek chionti ne unhe daansa. Unhone apna saamaan darakht ke neeche se hataane ka hukum diya aur unhone hukum diya ki use aag mein jalaaya jaaye aur Allah ne unpar wahi ki: "Sirf ek chionti (jisne tumhe daansa) ko kyun nahi qatal kiya gaya (aur baaki ko kyun jalaaya)?"

e: Nafi' reported from 'Abdullah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A woman was punished because she had kept a cat tied until it died, and (as a punishment of this offence) she was thrown into the Hell. She had not provided it with food, or drink, and had not freed her so that she could eat the vermin of the earth.
hi: Nafi ne Abdullah se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek aurat ko saza di gayi kyunki usne ek billi ko baandh kar rakha yahan tak ki woh mar gayi, aur (is jurm ki saza ke soorat mein) use Jahannam mein phenka gaya. Usne use na khaana diya, na paani, aur na use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Umar also.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman was punished because of a cat. She had neither provided her with food nor drink, nor set her free so that she might eat the vermin of the earth.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gayi. Usne na use khaana diya, na paani, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abu Huraira reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Hammam b. Manabbih reported this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira.
hi: Hammam bin Manabbih ne ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as sayings: A person suffered from intense thirst while on a journey, when he found a well. He climbed down into it and drank (water) and then came out and saw a dog lolling its tongue on account of thirst and eating the moistened earth. The person said: This dog has suffered from thirst as I had suffered from it. He climbed down into the well, filled his shoe with water, then caught it in his mouth until he climbed up and made the dog drink it. So Allah appreciated this act of his and pardoned him. Then (the Companions around him) said: Allah's Messenger, is there for us a reward even for (serving) such animals? He said: Yes, there is a reward for service to every living animal.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Ek shakhs ko safar ke daurane tez pyaas lagi, jab usne ek kuen ko paaya. Woh usmein utra aur (paani) piya aur phir bahar aaya aur ek kutte ko dekha jo pyaas ki wajah se apni zubaan latka raha tha aur geeli mitti khaa raha tha. Us shakhs ne kaha: Is kutte ne bhi utni hi pyaas jheli hai jitni maine jheli thi. Woh kuen mein neeche utra, apne joote mein paani bhara, phir use apne munh mein pakda yahan tak ki woh upar chadha aur kutte ko woh pilaya. To Allah ne uske is amal ki qadar ki aur use maaf kiya. Phir (uske aas-paas ke sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein aise jaanwaron (ki sewa) ka bhi sawaab milta hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, har zinda jaanwar ki sewa ka sawaab milta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may pace be upon him) as saying: A prostitute saw a dog moving around a well on a hot day and hanging out its tongue because of thirst. She drew water for it in her shoe and she was pardoned (for this act of hers).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek veshya ne ek garam din mein ek kutte ko kuen ke aas-paas ghoomte aur pyaas ki wajah se apni zubaan bahar nikaale hue dekha. Usne apne joote mein iske liye paani nikaala aur use maaf kar diya gaya (uske is amal ke liye).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was a dog moving around a well whom thirst would have killed. Suddenly a prostitute from the prostitutes of Bani Isra'il happened to see it and she drew water in her shoe and made it drink, and she was pardoned because of this.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek kutta kuen ke aas-paas ghoom raha tha jise pyaas ne maar diya hota. Achaanak Banu Isra'il ki veshyaon mein se ek veshya ne ise dekha aur usne apne joote mein paani nikaala aur use pilaaya, aur use isi wajah se maaf kar diya gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: The son of Adam abuses Dahr (the time), whereas I am Dahr since in My hand are the day and the night.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kaha: Aadam ka beta Dahr (waqt) ko bura-bhala kehta hai, jabki Main hi Dahr hoon kyunki din aur raat Mere Haath mein hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: The son of Adam displeases Me by abusing Dahr (time), whereas I am Dahr--I alternate the night and the day.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kaha: Aadam ka beta Mujhe naaraaz karta hai jab woh Dahr (waqt) ko bura-bhala kehta hai, jabki Main hi Dahr hoon - Main raat aur din ko badalta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: The son of Adam causes Me pain as he says: Woe be upon the Time. None of you should say this: Woe be upon the Time, as I am the Time (because) I alternate the day and the night, and when I wish I can finish them up.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kaha: Aadam ka beta Mujhe dukh deta hai jab woh kehta hai: Afsos Waqt par. Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Afsos Waqt par, kyunki Main hi Waqt hoon (kyunki) Main din aur raat ko badalta hoon, aur jab Main chaahun Main unhe khatm kar sakta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should say: Woe be upon the Time, for verily Allah is the Time.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Afsos Waqt par, kyunki yaqeenan Allah hi Waqt hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Do not curse Time, for it is Allah Who is Time.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Waqt ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki Allah hi Waqt hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should abuse Time for it is Allah Who is the Time, and none of you should call 'Inab (grape) as al-karm, for karm is a Muslim person.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi Waqt ko bura-bhala na kahe kyunki Allah hi Waqt hai, aur tum mein se koi bhi angoor (Inab) ko al-karm na kahe, kyunki karm ek Musalman shakhs hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not use the word karm (for wine) for worthy of respect is the heart of a believer.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Karm lafz (sharaab ke liye) istemaal mat karo kyunki samman ke laayak momin ka dil hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not name grape as karm, for worthy of respect is a Muslim.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Angoor ko karm mat kaho, kyunki samman ke laayak ek Musalman hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should use the word al-harin (for grape) for the heart of a believer is karm (worthy of respect).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi al-harin lafz (angoor ke liye) istemaal na kare kyunki momin ka dil hi karm hai (samman ke laayak).

e: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) various ahadith, one of which is this that he said: None of you should use the word al-karm for 'Inab, for karm (worthy of respect) is a Muslim person.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kayi hadeesein riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye thi ki unhone kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi Inab ke liye al-karm lafz istemaal na kare, kyunki karm (samman ke laayak) ek Musalman shakhs hai.

e: 'Alqama b. Wa'il reported, from his father, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: Do not say al-karm (for the word vine) but say al-habala (that is grape).
hi: Alqama bin Wa'il ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Al-karm (angoor ki bel ke liye lafz) mat kaho, balki al-habala kaho (yaani angoor).

e: This hadith has been reported by Alqama b. Wa'il on the authority of his father with a different chain of transmitters and with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Alqama bin Wa'il ne apne waalid ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should say: My bondman and my slave-girl, for all of you are the bondmen of Allah, and all your women are the slave-girls of Allah; but say: My servant, my girl, and my young man and my young girl.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Mera ghulam aur meri laundi, kyunki tum sab Allah ke bande ho, aur tumhari saari auraten Allah ki laundiyaan hain; balki kaho: Mera naukar, meri larki, aur mera jawaan larka aur meri jawaan larki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should say: My bondman, for all of you are the bondmen of Allah, but say: My young man, and the servant should not say: My Lord, but should say: My chief.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Mera ghulam, kyunki tum sab Allah ke bande ho, balki kaho: Mera jawaan larka, aur naukar ko ye nahi kehna chahiye: Mera Rab, balki kehna chahiye: Mera sardaar.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of al-A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are that the servant should not say to his chief: My Lord, and Abu Mu'awiya made an addition:" For it is Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, Who is your Lord."
hi: Ye hadees al-A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain ki naukar ko apne sardaar se ye nahi kehna chahiye: Mera Rab, aur Abu Mu'awiya ne ye izafa kiya: "Kyunki tumhara Rab to Allah hai, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so many ahadith and one of them is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None of you should say: Supply drink to your lord, feed your lord, help your lord in performing ablution, and none of you should say: My Lord. He should say: My chief, my patron; and none of you should say: My bondman, my slave-girl, but simply say: My boy, my girl, my servant.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kayi hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Apne sardaar ko peene ke liye do, apne sardaar ko khaana khilaao, apne sardaar ko wuzu karne mein madad karo, aur tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Mera Rab. Unhe kehna chahiye: Mera sardaar, mera aashrayaadaata; aur tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: Mera ghulam, meri laundi, balki simply kaho: Mera larka, meri larki, mera naukar.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: None of you should say: "My soul has become evil," but he should say: "My soul has become remorseless." This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: "Meri jaan bura ho gayi hai," balki use kehna chahiye: "Meri jaan bekaraar ho gayi hai." Ye hadees Abu Bakr ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abia Mu'iwiya with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abia Mu'awiya ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Umama b. Sahl b. Hunaif, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should say:" My soul has become evil," but he should say:" My soul has become remorseless."
hi: Abu Umama bin Sahl bin Hunaif ne apne waalid ke hawale se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi ye na kahe: "Meri jaan bura ho gayi hai," balki use kehna chahiye: "Meri jaan bekaraar ho gayi hai."

e: Abd Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There was a woman from Bani Isra'il who was short-statured and she walked in the company of two tall women with wooden sandals in her feet and a ring of gold made of plates with musk filled in them and then looked up, and musk is the best of scents; then she walked between two women and they (the people) did not recognise her, and she made a gesture with her hand like this, and Shu'ba shook his hand in order to give an indication how she shook her hand.
hi: Abd Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Banu Isra'il mein ek aurat thi jo qad mein choti thi aur woh do lambi auraton ki sohbat mein lakdi ki chappalein pehne chalti thi aur sona ki taheh-daar angoothi jismein mushk bhara hota tha, aur phir upar dekhti, aur mushk khushbuon mein sabse achha hai; phir woh do auraton ke beech chalti aur unhe (logon ko) woh pehchaan mein nahi aati, aur woh apna haath is tarah ishara karti, aur Shu'ba ne apna haath hilaakar dikhaya ki woh apna haath kaise hilaati thi.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a mention of a woman of Bana Isra'il who had filled her ring with musk and musk is the most fragrant of the scents.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Banu Isra'il ki ek aurat ka zikr kiya jisne apni angoothi mushk se bhari thi aur mushk khushbuon mein sabse khushboodaar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who is presented with a flower should not reject it, for it is light to carry and pleasant in odour.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jise koi phool pesh kiya jaaye use ise radd nahi karna chahiye, kyunki ye le jaane mein halka hai aur khushboo mein suhaavna hai.

e: Nafi' reported that when Ibn Umar wanted fumigation he got it from aloeswood without mixing anything with it, or he put camphor along with aloeswood and then said: This is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fumigated.
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki jab Ibn Umar dhoop (fumigation) chaahte, woh use aloeswood se lete bina usmein kuch milaaye, ya woh kapoor aloeswood ke saath milaate aur phir kehte: Isi tarah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dhoop dete the.

e: `Amr b. Sharid reported his father as saying: One day when I rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said (to me): Do you remember any poetry of Umayya b. Abu Salt. I said: Yes. He said: Then go on. I recited a couplet, and he said: Go on. Then I again recited a couplet and he said: Go on. I recited one hundred couplets (of his poetry). This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sharid through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Amr bin Sharid ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Ek din jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaar tha, unhone (mujhse) kaha: Kya tumhe Umayya bin Abu Salt ki koi shayari yaad hai? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Sunaao. Maine ek sher padha, aur unhone kaha: Aage badho. Phir maine ek aur sher padha aur unhone kaha: Aage badho. Maine (unki shayari ke) sau sher padhe. Ye hadees Sharid ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: `Amr b. Sharid reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him to recite poetry, the rest of the hadith is the same, but with this addition: "He (that is Umayya b. Abu Salt) was about to become a Muslim", and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mahdi (the words are) "He was almost a Muslim in his poetry."
hi: Amr bin Sharid ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse shayari sunaane ko kaha, baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is izafe ke saath: "Woh (yaani Umayya bin Abu Salt) Musalman hone hi waale the," aur Ibn Mahdi ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain) "Apni shayari mein woh takriban Musalman hi the."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The truest word spoken by an Arab (pre-Islamic) in poetry is this verse of Labid: "Behold! apart from Allah everything is vain."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Islam se pehle ke daur ke kisi Arab ne shayari mein sabse sachcha jo lafz kaha woh Labid ka ye sher hai jiska matlab hai: "Dekho! Allah ke siwaay har cheez bekaar hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The truest word uttered by a poet is this verse of Labid: "Behold! apart from Allah everything is vain," and Umayya b. Abu Salt was almost a Muslim.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi kavi ka sabse sachcha kaha hua lafz Labid ka ye sher hai jiska matlab hai: "Dekho! Allah ke siwaay har cheez bekaar hai," aur Umayya bin Abu Salt takriban Musalman hi the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The truest verse recited by a poet is: "Behold! apart from Allah everything is vain," and Ibn Abu Salt was almost a Muslim.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi kavi ka padha hua sabse sachcha sher ye hai: "Dekho! Allah ke siwaay har cheez bekaar hai," aur Ibn Abu Salt takriban Musalman hi the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The truest couplet recited by a poet is: "Behold! apart from Allah everything is vain," and he made no addition to it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi kavi ka padha hua sabse sachcha sher ye hai: "Dekho! Allah ke siwaay har cheez bekaar hai," aur unhone ismein koi izafa nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The truest word which the poet stated is the word of Labid: "Behold! apart from Allah everything is vain."
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sabse sachcha lafz jo kisi kavi ne kaha woh Labid ka lafz hai: "Dekho! Allah ke siwaay har cheez bekaar hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is better for a man's belly to be stuffed with pus which corrodes it than to stuff (one's mind) with frivolous poetry. Abu Bakr has reported it with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi aadmi ke pait ka pep se bhar jaana, jo use gala de, isse behtar hai ki woh (apne dimaag ko) faaltu shayari se bhar le. Abu Bakr ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: Sa`d reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is better for the belly of any one of you to be stuffed with pus rather than to stuff (one's mind) with poetry.
hi: Sa'd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tum mein se kisi ke pait ka pep se bhar jaana isse behtar hai ki woh (apne dimaag ko) shayari se bhar le.

e: Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri reported: We were going with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). As we reached the place (known as) `Arj there met (us) a poet who had been reciting poetry. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Catch the satan or detain the satan, for filling the belly of a man with pus is better than stuffing his brain with poetry.
hi: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ja rahe the. Jab hum Arj naamak jagah pahunche, humein ek kavi mila jo shayari padh raha tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shaitaan ko pakdo ya Shaitaan ko roko, kyunki kisi aadmi ke pait ka pep se bhar jaana isse behtar hai ki uska dimaag shayari se bhar jaaye.

e: Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who played Nardashir (a game similar to backgammon) is like one who dyed his hand with the flesh and blood of swine.
hi: Buraida ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jisne Nardashir (backgammon jaisa ek khel) khela woh us shakhs jaisa hai jisne apna haath khinzeer ke gosht aur khoon se rangaa ho.

e: Abu Salama reported: I used to see dreams (and was so much perturbed) that I began to quiver and have temperature, but did not cover myself with a mantle. I met Abu Qatada and made a mention of that to him. He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A good vision comes from Allah and a (bad) dream (hulm) from devil. So when one of you sees a bad dream (hulm) which he does not like, he should spit on his left side thrice and seek refuge with Allah from its evil; then it will not harm him.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Main sapne dekha karta tha (aur itna pareshaan hota tha) ki main kaanpne lagta aur bukhaar aa jaata, lekin main khud ko chogha se nahi dhaaka karta. Main Abu Qatada se mila aur unhe iska zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se aata hai aur (bura) sapna (hulm) Shaitaan ki taraf se. Is liye jab tum mein se koi bura sapna dekhe jo use pasand na aaye, use apni baayi taraf teen baar thookna chahiye aur iski burai se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye; phir ye use nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Qatada, but there is no mention of the words of Abu Salama: "I saw dreams (which perturbed me) but I did not cover myself with a mantle."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Qatada ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein Abu Salama ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Maine sapne dekhe (jinhone mujhe pareshaan kiya) lekin main khud ko chogha se nahi dhaaka karta tha."

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but it does not contain the words: "I felt disturbed because of that," and there is an addition of these words in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yunus: "Then spit thrice on the left side when you get up from sleep."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Main isse pareshaan mehsoos karta tha," aur Yunus ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Phir jab tum neend se utho to apni baayi taraf teen baar thooko."

e: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A good vision is from Allah and a bad dream (hulm) is from the satan; so if one of you sees anything (in a dream) which he dislikes, he should spit on his left side thrice and seek refuge with Allah from its evil, and then it will never harm him. Abu Salama said: I used to see dreams weighing more heavily upon me than a mountain; but since I heard this hadith I don't care for it (its burden).
hi: Abu Qatada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Achha khwaab Allah ki taraf se hota hai aur bura sapna (hulm) Shaitaan ki taraf se; is liye agar tum mein se koi (sapne mein) kuch dekhe jo use napasand ho, use apni baayi taraf teen baar thookna chahiye aur iski burai se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye, aur phir ye use kabhi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega. Abu Salama ne kaha: Main aise sapne dekha karta tha jo mujhpar ek pahaad se bhi zyada bhaari padte the; lekin jab se maine ye hadees suni hai mujhe iski (bojh ki) parvaah nahi.

e: Abu Salama reported: I used to see dreams, but the hadith transmitted on the authority of Laith b. Nu`man, the words of Abu Salama at the concluding part of the hadith are not mentioned. Ibn Rumh has reported in the hadith: "He (one who sleeps) should change the side on which he had been lying before."
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Main sapne dekha karta tha, lekin Laith bin Nu'man ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein, Abu Salama ke alfaaz hadees ke aakhri hisse mein zikr nahi kiye gaye hain. Ibn Rumh ne hadees mein riwayat ki hai: "Use (jo soya hai) us taraf badalna chahiye jispar woh pehle leta hua tha."

e: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The good vision are from Allah and the evil dreams are from the satan. If one sees a dream which one does not like, one should spit on one's left side and seek the refuge of Allah from the satan; it will not do one any harm, and one should not disclose it to anyone and if one sees a good vision one should feel pleased but should not disclose it to anyone but whom one loves.
hi: Abu Qatada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Achhe khwaab Allah ki taraf se hote hain aur bure sapne Shaitaan ki taraf se. Agar koi aisa sapna dekhe jo use pasand na aaye, use apni baayi taraf thookna chahiye aur Shaitaan se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye; ye use koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega, aur use ise kisi ko nahi bataana chahiye, aur agar koi achha khwaab dekhe, use khushi mehsoos karni chahiye lekin ise kisi ko na bataaye siwaay us shakhs ke jise woh muhabbat karta ho.

e: Abu Salama reported: I used to see (such horrible dreams) that I fell ill. I saw Abu Qatada who also said: I used to see dreams which made me sick until I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Good dreams are from Allah, so if any one of you sees which he likes he should not disclose it to one but whom he loves, but if he sees something which he does not like he should spit on his left side thrice and seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of the Satan and its mischief (i.e. of the dream), and he should not relate it to anyone, then it would not harm him.
hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Main aise (bhayaanak sapne) dekha karta tha ki main bimaar pad jaata. Maine Abu Qatada ko dekha jinhone bhi kaha: Main aise sapne dekha karta tha jo mujhe bimaar kar dete the yahan tak ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Achhe khwaab Allah ki taraf se hote hain, is liye agar tum mein se koi aisa sapna dekhe jo use pasand aaye use ise kisi ko na bataaye siwaay us shakhs ke jise woh muhabbat karta ho, lekin agar woh kuch aisa dekhe jo use pasand na aaye, use apni baayi taraf teen baar thookna chahiye aur Shaitaan ki burai se aur uski (sapne ki) burai se Allah ki panah maangni chahiye, aur use ise kisi ko na bataaye, phir ye use nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone sees a dream which he does not like, he should spit on his left side three times, and seek refuge with Allah from the Satan three times, and let him turn over from the side on which he was sleeping.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi aisa sapna dekhe jo use pasand na aaye, use apni baayi taraf teen baar thookna chahiye, aur Shaitaan se teen baar Allah ki panah maangni chahiye, aur use us taraf se palat jaana chahiye jispar woh sota tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the time draws near (when the Resurrection is near) a believer's dream can hardly be false. And the truest vision will be of one who is himself the most truthful in speech, for the vision of a Muslim is the forty-fifth part of Prophecy, and dreams are of three types: one good dream which is a sort of good tidings from Allah; the evil dream which causes pain is from the satan; and the third one is a suggestion of one's own mind; so if any one of you sees a dream which he does not like he should stand up and offer prayer and he should not relate it to people, and he said: I would love to see fetters (in the dream), but I dislike wearing of necklace, for the fetters is (an indication of) one's steadfastness in religion. The narrator said: I do not know whether this is a part of the hadith or the words of Ibn Sirin.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab waqt qareeb aata hai (yaani jab Qayamat nazdeek hoti hai) momin ka khwaab mushkil se hi galat ho sakta hai. Aur sabse sachcha khwaab us shakhs ka hoga jo khud apni baaton mein sabse sachcha ho, kyunki ek Musalman ka khwaab Nabuwwat ka paintaalisvaan hissa hai, aur khwaab teen kism ke hote hain: ek achha khwaab jo Allah ki taraf se ek kism ki khushkhabri hai; woh dukhdaayi sapna jo takleef pahunchaata hai Shaitaan ki taraf se hai; aur teesra ek shakhs ke apne khud ke zehan ka soch hai; is liye agar tum mein se koi aisa sapna dekhe jo use pasand na aaye use khada hokar namaz padhni chahiye aur ise logon ko nahi bataana chahiye, aur unhone kaha: Mujhe (sapne mein) beDiyaan dekhna pasand hai, lekin mujhe haar pehanne se nafrat hai, kyunki beDiyaan (ishara hain) deen mein sthirta ka. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye hadees ka hissa hai ya Ibn Sirin ke alfaaz.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I love to see fetters but I hate necklace (in a dream), for fetters signifies one's steadfastness in religion, and he also reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vision of a believer is forty-sixth part of Prophecy.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Mujhe beDiyaan dekhna pasand hai lekin mujhe haar se nafrat hai (sapne mein), kyunki beDiyaan deen mein sthirta ka ishara dete hain, aur unhone ye bhi riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek momin ka khwaab Nabuwwat ka chhiyaalisvaan hissa hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and the words are: "When the time draws near," the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: "Jab waqt qareeb aata hai," baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Muhammad b. Sirin reported from Abu Huraira a hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he mentioned in his hadith his words: "I dislike shackles," up to the end of his statement, but he made no mention of this: "A vision is a forty-sixth part of Prophecy."
hi: Muhammad bin Sirin ne Abu Huraira se ek hadees riwayat ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aur unhone apni hadees mein unke alfaaz zikr kiye: "Mujhe shackles (baDiyaan) napasand hain," apne bayaan ke ant tak, lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya: "Khwaab Nabuwwat ka chhiyaalisvaan hissa hai."

e: `Ubada b. as-Samit reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vision of a believer is the forty-sixth part of Prophecy.
hi: Ubada bin as-Samit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek momin ka khwaab Nabuwwat ka chhiyaalisvaan hissa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily the vision of a believer is one of the forty-sixth part of Prophecy.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan momin ka khwaab Nabuwwat ke chhiyaalisvein hisson mein se ek hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vision of a Muslim which he sees or which is shown to him, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mushir (the words are): "The pious dream is the forty-sixth part of Prophecy."
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman ka khwaab jo woh dekhta hai ya jo use dikhaaya jaata hai, aur Ibn Mushir ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Nekokaar khwaab Nabuwwat ka chhiyaalisvaan hissa hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vision of a pious man is the forty-sixth part of Prophecy.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Nekokaar aadmi ka khwaab Nabuwwat ka chhiyaalisvaan hissa hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn `Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The pious dreams are the seventieth part of Prophecy.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Nekokaar khwaab Nabuwwat ka sattarvaan hissa hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of `Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Nafi` with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): "I think Ibn `Umar said: The seventieth part from Prophecy."
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Mujhe lagta hai Ibn Umar ne kaha: Nabuwwat ka sattarvaan hissa."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who saw me in a dream in fact saw me, for the satan does not appear in my form.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne mujhe sapne mein dekha usne waaqai mujhe dekha, kyunki Shaitaan mere soorat mein pragat nahi ho sakta.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who saw me in a dream would soon see me in the state of wakefulness, or as if he saw me in a state of wakefulness, for the satan does not appear in my form.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne mujhe sapne mein dekha woh jald hi mujhe jaagte hue dekhega, ya jaise usne mujhe jaagte hue dekha ho, kyunki Shaitaan mere soorat mein pragat nahi ho sakta.

e: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who saw me in dream in fact saw the truth (what is true).
hi: Abu Qatada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne mujhe sapne mein dekha usne waaqai sach (jo sach hai) dekha.

e: The above two hadith have been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali do hadeesein isi tarah ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hain.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who saw me in sleep in fact saw me, for it is not possible for the satan to appear in my form; and he also said: When any one of you sees a hulm he should not inform anyone, for it is a sort of vain sport of devil in the state of sleep.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne mujhe neend mein dekha usne waaqai mujhe dekha, kyunki Shaitaan ke liye mere soorat mein pragat hona mumkin nahi hai; aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Jab tum mein se koi hulm (bura sapna) dekhe use kisi ko nahi bataana chahiye, kyunki ye Shaitaan ka neend ki haalat mein ek kism ka bekaar khel hai.

e: Jabir b. `Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who saw me in a dream in fact saw me, for the satan cannot assume my form.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne mujhe sapne mein dekha usne waaqai mujhe dekha, kyunki Shaitaan mera soorat nahi le sakta.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There came to him (the Holy Prophet) a desert Arab and said: I saw in a dream that I had been beheaded and I had been following it (the severed head). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reprimanded him saying: Do not inform about the vain sporting of devil with you during the night.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas ek registaan ka Arab aaya aur kaha: Maine sapne mein dekha ki mera sar kaat diya gaya hai aur main iska picha kar raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use daantte hue kaha: Shaitaan ke zariye raat mein tumhare saath khela gaya bekaar khel mat riwayat karo.

e: Jabir reported that there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a desert Arab and said: Allah's Messenger, I saw in the state of sleep as if my head had been cut off and I had been moving on haltingly after it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to that desert Arab: Do not narrate to the people the vain sporting of satan with you in your sleep and (the narrator) also said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his subsequent address: None amongst you should narrate the vain sporting of devil with him in the dream.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek registaan ka Arab aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine neend ki haalat mein dekha jaise mera sar kaat diya gaya ho aur main uske peeche latakte hue chal raha hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us registaan ke Arab se kaha: Logon ko Shaitaan ke tumhare saath neend mein khela gaya bekaar khel mat sunaao aur (raawi ne) ye bhi kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne baad ke khitaab mein ye kehte suna: Tum mein se koi bhi Shaitaan ke sapne mein khud ke saath khela gaya bekaar khel na sunaaye.

e: Jabir reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I have seen in the state of sleep as if my head had been cut off. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) laughed and said: When the satan plays with any one of you in the state of sleep, do not mention it to the people; and in the hadith transmitted by Abu Bakr (the words are): "If one of you is played with, and he did not make any mention of the word: "Satan."
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine neend ki haalat mein dekha jaise mera sar kaat diya gaya ho. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hanse aur kaha: Jab Shaitaan tum mein se kisi ke saath neend ki haalat mein khelta hai, ise logon ko mat bataao; aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Agar tum mein se kisi ke saath khela jaaye, aur unhone "Shaitaan" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya."

e: It is reported either on the authority of Ibn `Abbas or on the authority of Abu Huraira that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I saw while I was sleeping during the night (this vision) that there was a canopy from which butter and honey were trickling and I also saw people collecting them in the palms of their hands, some more, some less, and I also saw a rope connecting the earth with the sky and I saw you catching hold of it and rising towards the heaven; then another person after you catching hold of it and rising towards (Heaven); then another person catching hold of it, but it was broken while it was rejoined for him and he also climbed up. Abu Bakr said: Allah's Messenger, may my father be sacrificed for you, by Allah, allow me to interpret it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Well, give its interpretation. Thereupon Abu Bakr said: The canopy signifies the canopy of Islam and that what trickles out of it in the form of butter and honey is the Holy Qur'an and its sweetness and softness and what the people get hold of it in their palms implies major portion of the Qur'an or the small portion; and so far as the rope joining the sky with the earth is concerned, it is the Truth by which you stood (in the worldly life) and by which Allah would raise you (to Heaven). Then the person after you would take hold of it and he would also climb up with the help of it. Then another person would take hold of it and climb up with the help of it. Then another person would take hold of it and it would be broken; then it would be rejoined for him and he would climb up with the help of it. Allah's Messenger, may my father be taken as a ransom for you, tell me whether I have interpreted it correctly or I have made an error. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You have interpreted a part of it correctly and you have erred in interpreting a part of it. Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger, by Allah, tell me that part where I have committed an error. Thereupon he said: Don't take an oath.
hi: Ibn Abbas ya Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine raat ko sote hue (ye khwaab) dekha ki ek chhata thi jismein se ghee aur shahad Tapak raha tha aur maine ye bhi dekha ki log ise apni hatheliyon mein ikattha kar rahe the, kuch zyada, kuch kam, aur maine ek rassi bhi dekhi jo zameen ko aasmaan se jodti thi aur maine aapko ise pakadte aur aasmaan ki taraf uThte hue dekha; phir aapke baad ek doosra shakhs ise pakadta hai aur (aasmaan ki taraf) uThta hai; phir ek doosra shakhs ise pakadta hai, lekin ye toot gayi jabki ye uske liye dobara jodi gayi aur woh bhi upar chadha. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere waalid aap par qurbaan ho, Allah ki qasam, mujhe iski vyaakhya karne dijiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Achha, iski vyaakhya do. Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha: Chhata Islam ki chhata hai aur jo isse ghee aur shahad ke soorat mein Tapakta hai woh Muqaddas Quran hai aur iski mithaas aur narmi hai aur jo log apni hatheliyon mein isse pakadte hain woh Quran ka bada hissa ya chhota hissa darshaata hai; aur jahan tak aasmaan ko zameen se jodne wali rassi ka sawal hai, ye woh Sach hai jispar aap (duniyaavi zindagi mein) khade the aur jiske zariye Allah aapko (Aasmaan ki taraf) uThAyega. Phir aapke baad ka shakhs use pakadega aur uski madad se upar chadhega. Phir ek doosra shakhs use pakadega aur uski madad se upar chadhega. Phir ek doosra shakhs use pakadega aur ye toot jaayegi; phir ye uske liye dobara jodi jaayegi aur woh uski madad se upar chadhega. Allah ke Rasool, mere waalid aap par fidiya ho, mujhe bataiye ki maine iski sahi vyaakhya ki hai ya mujhse koi galti hui hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumne iska ek hissa sahi vyaakhya kiya hai aur ek hisse ki vyaakhya mein galti ki hai. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, mujhe bataiye woh hissa jahan maine galti ki hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Qasam mat lo.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a person as he was returning from Uhud and he said: Allah's Messenger, I saw in sleep during the night a canopy trickling butter and honey; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek shakhs aaya jab woh Uhud se wapas aa rahe the aur usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine raat ko sote hue ek chhata dekhi jismein se ghee aur shahad Tapak raha tha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: It is reported either on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas or on that of Abu Huraira that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Verily I saw during the night a canopy; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas ya Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Yaqeenan maine raat ko ek chhata dekhi; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say to his Companions: He who amongst you sees a vision should narrate it and I would interpret it for him, and a person came and said: Allah's Messenger, I saw a canopy. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne sahaba se kaha karte the: Tum mein se jo koi khwaab dekhe use ise riwayat karna chahiye aur main iski vyaakhya karunga, aur ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine ek chhata dekhi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I saw during the night that which a person sees during the sleep as if we are in the house of `Uqba b. Rafi` that there was brought to us the fresh dates of Ibn Tab. I interpreted it as the sublimity for us in the world and good ending in the Hereafter and that our religion is good.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine raat ko woh dekha jo koi shakhs neend mein dekhta hai jaise hum Uqba bin Rafi ke ghar mein hon ki humare paas Ibn Tab ki taazi khajooren laayi gayin. Maine iski vyaakhya humare liye is duniya mein uchcha darja aur Aakhirat mein achha anjaam ke soorat mein ki aur ki humara deen achha hai.

e: Abdullah b. `Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I saw in a dream that I was using miswak and two persons contended to get it from me, one being older than the other one. I gave the miswak to the younger one. It was said to me to give that to the older one and I gave it to the older one.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine sapne mein dekha ki main miswak istemal kar raha tha aur do log ye mujhse lene ke liye jhagad rahe the, ek doosre se bada tha. Maine miswak choti umar wale ko diya. Mujhse kaha gaya ki main ise bade wale ko doon aur maine ise bade wale ko diya.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I dreamt (while asleep) that I was about to migrate from Mecca to a land abounding in palm trees and I guessed that it would be Yamama or Hajar, but it was the city of Yathrib (the old name of Medina), and I saw in this dream of mine that I was brandishing a sword and its upper end was broken and this is what fell (in the form of misfortune to the believers on the Day of Uhud). I brandished (the sword) for the second time and it became all right and this is what came to be true when Allah granted us victory and solidarity of the believers. And I saw therein cows also and Allah is the Doer of good. These meant the group from amongst the believers on the Day of Uhud and the goodness which Allah brought after that and the reward of attestation of his Truth which Allah brought to us after the Day of Badr.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine (neend mein) sapna dekha ki main Makkah se ek khajoor ke darakhton se bhare desh ki taraf hijrat karne wala hoon, aur maine anumaan lagaya ki ye Yamama ya Hajar hoga, lekin ye Yathrib (Madina ka purana naam) shehar tha, aur maine apne is sapne mein ye bhi dekha ki main ek talwaar lehra raha hoon aur uska upari sira toot gaya hai aur ye woh hai jo (badnaseebi ke soorat mein momino ke liye) Uhud ke din hua. Maine ise doosri baar lehraaya aur ye poori tarah theek ho gaya aur ye woh hai jo sach saabit hua jab Allah ne humein jeet di aur momino mein ekta di. Aur maine ismein gaayen bhi dekhin, aur Allah nekokaar ka karta hai. Ye Uhud ke din momino mein se giroh ko darshaate the aur us achhaai ko jo Allah ne uske baad di aur Uski sachchaai ki tasdeeq ka sawaab jo Allah ne humein Badr ke din ke baad diya.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that Musailima al-Kadhdhab (the greater liar) (who claimed prophethood after the death of the Holy Prophet) came during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to Medina and said: If Muhammad assigns his caliphate to me after him I would follow him, and there came along with him a large body of persons of his tribe, and there came to him Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with Thabit b. Qais b. Shammas and the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) had a piece of wood in his hand until he came in front of Musailima in the company of his companions and said: If you were to ask even this (wood), I would never give it to you. I am not going to do anything against the will of God in your case, and if you turn away (from what I say) Allah will destroy you. And I find you in the same state which I was shown (in the dream) and here is Thabit and he would answer you on my behalf. He (the Holy Prophet) then went back. Ibn `Abbas said: I asked the (meaning of the) words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): "You are the same what I was made to see about you in my dream." and Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: While I was sleeping I saw in my hands two gold bangles. This had a disturbing effect upon me and I was given a suggestion in the sleep that I should blow over them, so I blew over them and they were no more. And I interpreted these (two bangles) as the two great liars who would appear after me and the one amongst them was Al-`Anasi the inhabitant of San`a' and the other one Musailima the inhabitant of Yamama.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Musailima al-Kadhdhab (bada jhoota) (jisne Nabi-e-Paak ki maut ke baad nabuwwat ka daawa kiya) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein Madina aaya aur kaha: Agar Muhammad apni Khilafat mere baad mujhe soonp dein to main unka anusaran karunga, aur uske saath uske qabile ke bahut se log aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ke saath uske paas aaye aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke haath mein lakdi ka ek tukda tha yahan tak ki woh Musailima ke saamne apne sahaba ke saath aaye aur kaha: Agar tum ye (lakdi) bhi maango, main tumhe kabhi nahi dunga. Main tumhare maamle mein Allah ki marzi ke khilaaf kuch nahi karunga, aur agar tum (jo main kehta hoon usse) munh modte ho, Allah tumhe barbaad karega. Aur main tumhe usi haalat mein paata hoon jismein mujhe (sapne mein) dikhaaya gaya tha, aur ye rahe Thabit aur woh meri taraf se tumhe jawaab denge. Phir woh (Nabi-e-Paak) wapas chale gaye. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaazon ka (matlab) poocha: "Tum wahi ho jo mujhe apne baare mein sapne mein dikhaaya gaya tha," aur Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab main so raha tha maine apne haathon mein sone ke do kangan dekhe. Isne mujhe pareshaan kiya aur mujhe neend mein ishara kiya gaya ki main unpar phoonk maaroon, is liye maine unpar phoonk maari aur woh gaayab ho gaye. Aur maine in (do kangan) ki vyaakhya do bade jhoothon ke soorat mein ki jo mere baad pragat honge aur unmein se ek al-Ansi tha, San'a ka bashinda, aur doosra Musailima tha, Yamama ka bashinda.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While I was sleeping, the treasures of the earth were presented to me and I was made to wear in my hands two gold bangles. I felt a sort of burden upon me and I was disturbed and it was suggested to me that I should blow over them, so I blew and both of them disappeared. I interpreted them as two great liars who would appear at any time, one is the inhabitant of San`a' and the other is that of Yamama.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab main so raha tha, zameen ke khazane mere saamne pesh kiye gaye aur mujhe apne haathon mein sone ke do kangan pehnaaye gaye. Maine ek kism ka bojh mehsoos kiya aur pareshaan hua aur mujhe ishara mila ki main unpar phoonk maaroon, is liye maine phoonk maari aur donon gaayab ho gaye. Maine unhe do bade jhoothon ke soorat mein vyaakhyaayit kiya jo kabhi bhi pragat honge, ek San'a ka bashinda aur doosra Yamama ka bashinda.

e: Samura b. Jundab reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed his dawn prayer he turned his face towards them (that is towards his Companions) and said: Did any one of you see any vision last night?
hi: Samura bin Jundab ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni fajr ki namaz padh chuke unhone apna chehra unki (yaani apne sahaba ki) taraf moda aur kaha: Kya tum mein se kisi ne kal raat koi khwaab dekha?

e: Wathila b. al-Asqa' reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah granted eminence to Kinana from amongst the descendants of Isma'il, and he granted eminence to the Quraish amongst Kinana, and he granted eminence to Banu Hashim amonsgst the Quraish, and he granted me eminence from the tribe of Banu Hashim.
hi: Wathila bin al-Asqa ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Allah ne Isma'il ki aulaad mein se Kinana ko uchcha darja diya, aur Usne Kinana mein se Quraish ko uchcha darja diya, aur Usne Quraish mein se Banu Hashim ko uchcha darja diya, aur Usne Banu Hashim qabile se mujhe uchcha darja diya.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I recognise the stone in Mecca which used to pay me salutations before my advent as a Prophet and I recognise that even now.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Makkah mein us patthar ko pehchaanta hoon jo mere Nabi banne se pehle mujhe salaam kiya karta tha aur main use abhi bhi pehchaanta hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I shall be pre-eminent amongst the descendants of Adam on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first intercessor and the first whose intercession will be accepted (by Allah).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Qayamat ke din Aadam ki aulaad mein sabse uchcha rahunga aur main pehla sifaarish karne wala hunga aur pehla jiski sifaarish (Allah ke zariye) qubool ki jaayegi.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for water and he was given a vessel and the people began to perform ablution in that and I counted (the persons) and they were between sixty and eighty and I saw water which was spouting from his fingers.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani maangwaaya aur unhe ek bartan diya gaya aur log usmein wuzu karne lage aur maine (logon ko) gina aur woh saTh se assi ke beech the aur maine dekha ki unki ungliyon se paani nikal raha tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the time of the afternoon prayer and the people asking for water for performing ablution which they did not find. (A small quantity) of water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he placed his hand in that vessel and commanded people to perform ablution. I saw water spouting from his fingers and the people performing ablution until the last amongst them performed it.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko asr ki namaz ke waqt dekha aur log wuzu karne ke liye paani maang rahe the jo unhe nahi mil raha tha.
