(Thodi maqdaar mein) paani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur unhone apna haath us bartan mein rakha aur logon ko wuzu karne ka hukum diya. Maine dekha ki unki ungliyon se paani nikal raha tha aur log wuzu kar rahe the yahan tak ki unmein se aakhri shakhs ne bhi kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and his Companions were at a place known as az-Zaura' (az-Zaurd' is a place in the bazar of Medina near the mosque) that he called for a vessel containing water. He put his hand in that. And there began to spout (water) between his fingers and all the Companions performed ablution. Qatada, one of the narrators in the chain of narrators, said: Abu Hamza (the kunya of Hadrat Anas b. Malik), how many people were they? He said: They were about three hundred.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur unke sahaba az-Zaura naamak jagah par the (az-Zaura Madina ke bazaar mein masjid ke qareeb ek jagah hai) ki unhone paani se bhara ek bartan maangwaaya. Unhone apna haath usmein rakha. Aur unki ungliyon ke beech se (paani) nikalna shuru hua aur sab sahaba ne wuzu kiya. Qatada, sanad ke ek raawi, ne kaha: Abu Hamza (Hazrat Anas bin Malik ki kunya), woh kitne log the? Unhone kaha: Woh takriban teen sau the.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was at az-Zaura' and a vessel containing water was brought to him in which his finger could not be completely dipped or completely covered; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) az-Zaura mein the aur paani se bhara ek bartan unke paas laaya gaya jismein unki ungli poori tarah dubTi nahi thi ya poori tarah dhaki nahi thi; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir reported that Umm Malik used to send clarified butter in a small skin to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Her sons would come to her and ask for seasoning when they had nothing with them (in the form of condiments) and she would go to that (skin) in which she offered (clarified butter) to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and she would find in that clarified butter and it kept providing her with seasoning for her household until she had (completely) squeezed it. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and (informed him about it). Thereupon, he (the Holy Prophet) said: Did you squeeze it? She said: Yes. Thereupon he said: If you had left it in that very state, it would have kept on provid- ing you (the clarified butter) on end.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Umm Malik Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek choti mashk mein ghee bheja karti thin. Unke bete unke paas aakar chikna-masaala maangte jab unke paas kuch nahi hota (chatni-masaale ke soorat mein) aur woh us (mashk) ki taraf jaatin jismein unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ghee pesh kiya tha, aur unhe usmein ghee milta aur ye unke khaandaan ke liye chatni-masaala mahaiyaa karaata rehta jab tak unhone ise (poori tarah) nichoda nahi. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin (aur unhe iske baare mein bataya). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Kya tumne ise nichoda? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne ise usi haalat mein chhoda hota, to ye tumhe (ghee) hamesha ke liye deta rehta.

e: Jabir reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for food. And he gave him half a wasq of barley, and the person and his wife and their guests kept on making use of it (as a food) until he weighed it (in order to find out the actual quantity, and it was no more). He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (and informed him about it). He said: Had you not weighed it, you would be eating out of it and it would have remained intact for you.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur khaana maanga. Unhone use aadha wasq jau diya, aur us shakhs, uski zauja aur unke mehmaanon ne isse (khaane ke soorat mein) istemal karna jaari rakha yahan tak ki usne ise taula (asal maqdaar pata karne ke liye, aur ye aur nahi bacha). Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye (aur unhe iske baare mein bataya). Unhone kaha: Agar tumne ise nahi taula hota, to tum ismein se khaate rehte aur ye tumhare liye poora bana rehta.

e: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported that he went along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the expedition of Tabuk and he (the Holy Prophet) combined the prayers. He offered the noon and afternoon prayers together and the sunset and night prayers together and on the other day he deferred the prayers; he then came out and offered the noon and afternoon prayers together. He then went in and (later on) came out and then after that offered the sunset and night prayers together and then said: God willing, you would reach by tomorrow the fountain of Tabuk and you should not come to that until it is dawn, and he who amongst you happens to go there should not touch its water until I come. We came to that and two persons (amongst) us reached that fountain ahead of us. It was a thin flow of water like the shoelace. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked them whether they had touched the water. They said: Yes. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) scolded them, and he said to them what he had to say by the will of God. The people then took water of the fountain in their palms until it became somewhat significant and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) washed his hands and his face too in it, and then, took it again in that (fountain) and there gushed forth abundant water from that fountain, until all the people drank to their fill. He then said: Mu'adh, it is likely that if you live long that you see what is here filled with gardens.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ki muhim mein gaye aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) namazon ko jodkar padha. Unhone zohar aur asr ki namaz saath padhi aur maghrib aur isha saath, aur doosre din unhone namazon ko taal diya; phir woh bahar aaye aur zohar aur asr ek saath padhi. Phir woh andar gaye aur (baad mein) bahar aaye aur phir maghrib aur isha ek saath padhi aur phir kaha: Allah chaahe to tum kal Tabuk ke sarowar tak pahunchoge aur tumhe wahan tab tak nahi aana chahiye jab tak subah na ho jaaye, aur tum mein se jo pehle wahan pahunche use uska paani mere aane tak nahi chhuna chahiye. Hum wahan aaye aur do log humse pehle us sarowar tak pahunche. Ye juute ke fite jaisi ek patli paani ki dhaara thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse poocha ki kya unhone paani chhua tha. Unhone kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe daanta, aur unse woh kaha jo unhe Allah ki marzi se kehna tha. Log phir sarowar ka paani apni hatheliyon mein le gaye yahan tak ki ye kuch hisson mein jama ho gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath aur chehra bhi ismein dhoya, aur phir use us (sarowar) mein wapas daala aur us sarowar se bahut paani nikal aaya, yahan tak ki sab logon ne pet bhar kar piya. Phir unhone kaha: Mu'adh, agar tum lambi zindagi jeete ho, to sambhavana hai ki tum dekhoge ki jo yahan hai woh baagon se bhar gaya hai.

e: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi reported: We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the expedition to Tabuk and we came to a wadi where there was a garden belonging to a woman. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said. Make an assessment (of the price of its fruit). And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also made an assessment and it was ten wasqs. He asked that lady (to calculate the amount) until they would, God willing, come back to her. So we proceeded on until we came to Tabuk and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The violent storm will overtake you during the night, so none amongst you should stand up and he who has a camel with him should hobble it firmly. A violent storm blew and a person who had stood up was carried away by the storm and thrown between the mountains of Tayy. Then the messenger of the son of al 'Alma', the ruler of Aila, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a letter and a gift of a white mule. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote him (the reply) and presented him a cloak. We came back until we halted in the Wadi al-Qura. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked that lady about her garden and the price of the fruits in that. She said: Ten wasqs. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am going to depart, and he who amongst you wishes may depart with me but he who wants to stay may stay. We resumed the journey until we came to the outskirts of Medina. (It was at this time) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This is Taba, this is Uhud, that is a mountain which loves us and we love it, and then said: The best amongst the houses of the Ansar is the house of Bani Najjar. Then the house of Bani Abd al-Ashhal, then the house of Bani Abd al-Harith b. Khazraj, then the house of Bani Sa'ida, and there is goodness in all the houses of the Ansar. Said b. Ubada came to us and Abu Usaid said to him: Did you not see that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has declared the houses of the Ansar good and he has kept us at the end. Said met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, you have declared the house of the Ansar as good and have kept us at the end, whereupon he said: Is it not enough for you that you have been counted amongst the good.
hi: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ki muhim par nikle aur hum ek wadi mein pahunche jahan ek aurat ka baag tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: (Uske phal ki keemat ka) andaaza lagaao. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi andaaza lagaya aur ye das wasq tha. Unhone us khaatoon se poocha (raqam ka hisaab lagaane ke liye) yahan tak ki woh, Allah chaahe, uske paas wapas aa jaayein. To hum aage badhe yahan tak ki hum Tabuk pahunche aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tez toofaan tumhe raat mein pakadega, is liye tum mein se koi khada na ho aur jiske paas oont ho use use mazbooti se baandh dena chahiye. Ek tez toofaan aaya aur ek shakhs jo khada ho gaya tha use toofaan pahaadon ke beech le gaya. Phir al-Alma ke bete, Aila ke shaasak, ka doot Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek khat aur ek safed khachchar ka tohfa lekar aaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (jawaab) likha aur unhe ek chogha pesh kiya. Hum wapas aaye yahan tak ki hum Wadi al-Qura mein ruke. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us khaatoon se unke baag aur usmein phal ki keemat ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Das wasq. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main aage jaane wala hoon, aur tum mein se jo chaahe mere saath aa sakta hai lekin jo rukna chaahe rah sakta hai. Humne apni safar jaari rakhi yahan tak ki hum Madina ke bahari ilaakon mein pahunche. (Isi waqt) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye Taba hai, ye Uhud hai, woh ek pahaad hai jo humse muhabbat karta hai aur hum usse muhabbat karte hain, aur phir kaha: Ansar ke gharon mein sabse behtareen Banu Najjar ka ghar hai. Phir Banu Abd al-Ashhal ka ghar, phir Banu Abd al-Harith bin Khazraj ka ghar, phir Banu Sa'ida ka ghar, aur Ansar ke sab gharon mein achhaai hai. Sa'id bin Ubada humare paas aaye aur Abu Usaid ne unse kaha: Kya aapne nahi dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke gharon ko achha ailaan kiya hai aur humein aakhir mein rakha hai. Sa'id Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne Ansar ke ghar ko achha ailaan kiya aur humein aakhir mein rakha, isper unhone kaha: Kya ye tumhare liye kaafi nahi hai ki tumhe achhon mein gina gaya hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters up to the words: There is good in all the houses of the Ansar, and there is no mention of the subsequent event pertaining to Sa'd b. 'Ubada.
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Yahya ki sanad se isi sanad se in alfaazon tak riwayat ki gayi hai: Ansar ke sab gharon mein achhaai hai, aur uske baad Sa'd bin Ubada se mutaliq ghatna ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: We went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on an expedition towards Najd and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) found us in a valley abounding in thorny trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed for rest under a tree and he suspended his sword by one of its branches under which he was taking rest. The persons scattered in the valley and they also began to take rest under the shade of trees, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person came to me while I was asleep and he took hold of the sword. I woke up and found him standing upon my head and I had hardly become alert (and saw) that the sword was in his hand. And he said: Who can protect you from me? I said: Allah. He again said: Who can protect you from me? I said: Allah. He put his sword in the sheath (and you can see) this man sitting here. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not in any way touch him.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Najd ki taraf ek muhim par gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein kaanTedaar darakhton se bhari ek wadi mein paaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek darakht ke neeche aaraam ke liye ruke aur unhone apni talwaar uski ek shaakha par latka di jiske neeche woh aaraam kar rahe the. Log wadi mein bikhar gaye aur woh bhi darakhton ki chhaaya mein aaraam karne lage, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek shakhs mere paas aaya jab main so raha tha aur usne talwaar pakad li. Main jaaga aur paaya ki woh mere sar par khada hai aur main mushkil se hi hosh mein aaya (aur dekha) ki talwaar uske haath mein thi. Aur usne kaha: Kaun tumhe mujhse bacha sakta hai? Maine kaha: Allah. Usne phir kaha: Kaun tumhe mujhse bacha sakta hai? Maine kaha: Allah. Usne apni talwaar myaan mein rakh di (aur tum ye aadmi yahan baitha dekh sakte ho). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use kisi bhi tarah se nuksaan nahi pahunchaaya.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansiri, who was one amongst the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that he went on an expedition along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) towards Najd and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed there, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back he also came back along with him. They, for one day, stayed for rest; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se ek the, ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Najd ki taraf ek muhim par gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan ruke, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wapas aaye woh bhi unke saath wapas aaye. Woh ek din aaraam ke liye ruke; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and as we reached the place Dhat-ur-Riqa'; the rest of the hadith is the same, but there is no mention of the word that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not harm him.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaye aur jab hum Dhat-ur-Riqa jagah pahunche; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use nuksaan nahi pahunchaaya.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of that guidance and knowledge with which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has sent me is that of rain falling upon the earth. There is a good piece of land which receives the rainfall (eagerly) and as a result of it there is grown in it herbage and grass abundantly. Then there is a land hard and barren which retains water and the people derive benefit from it and they drink it and make the animals drink. Then there is another land which is barren. Neither water is retained in it, nor is the grass grown in it. And that is the similitude of the first one who develops the understanding of the religion of Allah and it becomes a source of benefit to him with which Allah sent me. (The second one is that) who acquires the knowledge of religion and imparts it to others. (Then the other type is) one who does not pay attention to (the revealed knowledge) and thus does not accept guidance of Allah with which I have been sent.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us margdarshan aur ilm ki misaal jiske saath Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne mujhe bheja hai, woh baarish ki tarah hai jo zameen par giri hai. Ek achhi zameen ka tukda hai jo baarish ko (betaab hokar) qubool karta hai aur iske natije mein ismein ghaas aur charaayi bahutayat mein ugti hai. Phir ek sakht aur banjar zameen hai jo paani ko rok leti hai aur log isse faayda uthate hain aur ise peete hain aur jaanwaron ko pilaate hain. Phir ek doosri zameen hai jo banjar hai. Na ismein paani rukta hai, na ismein ghaas ugti hai. Aur ye pehle wale ki misaal hai jo Allah ke deen ki samajh vikasit karta hai aur ye uske liye us cheez ka srot ban jaata hai jiske saath Allah ne mujhe bheja hai. (Doosra woh hai) jo deen ka ilm haasil karta hai aur ise doosron ko sikhaata hai. (Phir teesri kism hai) jo (nazil kiye gaye ilm) par dhyaan nahi deta aur is tarah Allah ka margdarshan qubool nahi karta jiske saath mujhe bheja gaya hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and of that with which Allah sent me is that of a person who came to us and said: O people, I have seen an army with my eyes and I am a plain warner (and issue you warning) that you should immediately manage to find an escape. A group of people from amongst them paying heed (to his warning) fled to a place of protection and a group amongst them belied him and the morning overtook them in their houses and the army attacked them and killed them and they were routed. And that is the similitude of the one who obeyed me, followed with which I had been sent and the similitude of the other is of one who disobeyed and belied me and the Truth with which I have been sent.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur uski jiske saath Allah ne mujhe bheja hai ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo humare paas aaya aur kaha: Aye logo, maine apni aankhon se ek fauj dekhi hai aur main ek saaf chetaavni dene wala hoon (aur tumhe chetaavni deta hoon) ki tumhe turant bhaag nikalne ka intezaam karna chahiye. Unmein se logon ka ek giroh (uski chetaavni) sunkar hifaazat ki jagah bhaag gaya aur unmein se ek giroh ne use jhoota kaha aur subah unhe unke gharon mein hi pakad liya aur fauj ne unpar hamla kiya aur unhe qatal kiya aur unhe barbaad kar diya. Aur ye us shakhs ki misaal hai jisne meri baat maani, jo mujhe diya gaya use maana, aur doosre ki misaal us shakhs ki hai jisne meri naafarmani ki aur Sach ko jhoota kaha jiske saath mujhe bheja gaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of my Umma is that of a person who lit fire and there began to fall into it insects and moths. And I am there to hold you back, but you plunge into it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur meri Ummat ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jisne aag jalaayi aur usmein keede aur patange girne lage. Aur main tumhe rokne ke liye hoon, lekin tum ismein kud padte ho.

e: The above hadith was likewise narrated with another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: Abu Huraira reported us some ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst many, (and) one is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person lit fire and when the atmosphere was aglow, moths and insects began to fall into the fire, but I am there to hold them back, but they are plunging into it despite my efforts, and he further added: That is your example and mine. I am there to hold you back from fire and to save you from it, but you are plunging into it despite my efforts.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Abu Huraira ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek shakhs ne aag jalaayi aur jab vaataavaran jal utha, patange aur keede aag mein girne lage, lekin main unhe rokne ke liye hoon, lekin woh mere koshish ke bawajood usmein kud rahe hain, aur unhone aage kaha: Ye tumhari aur meri misaal hai. Main tumhe aag se rokne ke liye hoon aur tumhe isse bachaane ke liye, lekin tum mere koshish ke bawajood ismein kud rahe ho.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. My example and your example is that of a person who lit the fire and insects and moths began to fall in it and he would be making efforts to take them out, and I am going to hold you back from fire, but you are slipping from my hand.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur tumhari misaal us shakhs ki hai jisne aag jalaayi aur ismein keede aur patange girne lage aur woh unhe bahar nikaalne ki koshish kar raha hai, aur main tumhe aag se rokne wala hoon, lekin tum mere haath se fisal rahe ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles (before me) is that of a person who constructed a building and he built it fine and well and the people went round it saying: Never have we seen a building more imposing than this. but for one brick, and I am that brick (with which you give the finishing touch to the building).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur (mujhse pehle guzre) Rasoolon ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jisne ek imaarat banaayi aur use behtareen aur achhi tarah banaaya aur log uske chaaron taraf ghoomte hue kehte: Humne kabhi is imaarat se zyada shaandaar koi imaarat nahi dekhi, siwaay ek EenT ki jagah ke, aur main woh EenT hoon (jisse tum imaarat ko akhri soorat dete ho).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles before me is that of a person who built a house quite imposing and beautiful and he made it complete but for one brick in one of its corners. People began to walk round it, and the building pleased them and they would say: But for this brick your building would have been perfect. Muhammad (ﷺ) said: And I am that final brick.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur mujhse pehle ke Rasoolon ki misaal us shakhs ki hai jisne ek shaandaar aur khoobsurat ghar banaaya aur ise poora kiya siwaay ek konay mein ek EenT ke. Log iske aas-paas chalne lage, aur imaarat unhe pasand aayi aur woh kehte: Lekin ye EenT hoti to tumhaari imaarat mukammal hoti. Muhammad (SAW) ne kaha: Aur main woh aakhri EenT hoon.

e: Abu Hurairh reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles before me is that of a person who built a house quite imposing and beautiful, but for one brick in one of its corners. People would go round it, appreciating the building, but saying: Why has the brick not been fixed here? He said: I am that brick and I am the last of the Apostles.
hi: Abu Hurairh ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur mujhse pehle ke Rasoolon ki misaal us shakhs ki hai jisne ek shaandaar aur khoobsurat ghar banaaya, siwaay ek konay mein ek EenT ke. Log iske aas-paas jaate, imaarat ki tareef karte, lekin kehte: Yahan EenT kyun nahi lagaayi gayi? Unhone kaha: Main woh EenT hoon aur main aakhri Rasool hoon.

e: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur Rasoolon ki misaal; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles is like that of a person who built a house and he completed it and made it perfect but for the space of a brick. People entered therein and they were surprised at it and said: Had there been a brick (it would have been complete in all respects). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am that place where the brick (completing the building is to be placed), and I have come to finalise the chain of Apostles.
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri aur Rasoolon ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jisne ek ghar banaaya aur use poora kiya aur mukammal banaaya siwaay ek EenT ki jagah ke. Log usmein daakhil hue aur hairat mein pad gaye aur kaha: Agar yahan ek EenT hoti (to ye sab tarah se mukammal hota). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main woh jagah hoon jahan EenT (imaarat ko poora karne wali) rakhi jaani hai, aur main Rasoolon ki shrinkhala ko poora karne aaya hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, intends to show mercy to an Umma from amongst His servants He calls back His Apostle to his eternal home and makes him a harbinger and recompense in the world to come; and when He intends to cause destruction to an Umma, He punishes it while its Apostle is alive and He destroys it as he (the Apostle) witnesses it and he cools his eyes by destruction as they had belied him and disobeyed his command.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Apne bandon mein se kisi Ummat par rehmat dikhaane ka iraada karta hai Woh Apne Rasool ko unke shaashvat ghar mein wapas bulaata hai aur unhe aane wali duniya mein ek agrasar aur muaaviza banaata hai; aur jab Woh kisi Ummat ko barbaad karne ka iraada karta hai, Woh use saza deta hai jabki uska Rasool zinda hai aur Woh use barbaad karta hai jab woh (Rasool) ise dekh raha hota hai aur woh apni aankhein Thanda karta hai unke tabaahi se kyunki unhone use jhoota kaha aur uske hukum ki naafarmani ki.

e: Jundab reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I shall be there at the Cistern before you.
hi: Jundab ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Haud (Kauthar) par tumse pehle wahan hunga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jundab through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jundab ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sahl (b. Sa'd) reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: I shall go to the Cistern before you and he who comes would drink and he who drinks would never feel thirsty, and there would come to me people whom I would know and who would know me. Then there would be intervention between me and them. Abu Hazim said that Nu'man b. Abu 'Ayyash heard it and I narrated to them this hadith, and said: Is it this that you heard Sahl saying? He said: Yes, and I bear witness to the fact that I heard it from Abu Sa'id Khudri also, but he made this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) would say: They are my followers, and it would be said to him: You do not know what they did after you and I will say to them: Woe to him who changes (his religion) after me.
hi: Sahl (bin Sa'd) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Haud (Kauthar) par tumse pehle jaunga aur jo aayega woh piyega aur jo piyega use kabhi pyaas nahi lagegi, aur mere paas aisa log aayenge jinhe main jaanunga aur jo mujhe jaanenge. Phir mere aur unke beech alagav hoga. Abu Hazim ne kaha ki Nu'man bin Abu Ayyash ne ise suna aur maine unhe ye hadees riwayat ki, aur kaha: Kya yehi hai jo aapne Sahl ko kehte suna? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki maine ise Abu Sa'id Khudri se bhi suna, lekin unhone ye izafa kiya ki woh (Nabi-e-Paak) kahenge: Ye mere anuyaayi hain, aur unse kaha jaayega: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya kiya, aur main unse kahunga: Uspar afsos jisne mere baad (apna deen) badla.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: `Abdullah b. `Amr al-`As, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: My Cistern (is as wide and broad that it requires) a month's journey (to go round it) all, and its sides are equal and its water is whiter than silver, and its odour is more fragrant than the fragrance of musk, and its jugs (placed around it) are like stars in the sky; and he who would drink from it would never feel thirsty after that. Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I would be on the Cistern so that I would be seeing those who would be coming to me from you, but some people would be detained (before reaching me). I would say: My Lord, they are my followers and belong to my Ummah, and it would be said to me: Do you know what they did after you? By Allah, they did not do good after you, and they turned back upon their heels. He (the narrator) said: lbn Abu Mulaika used to say (in supplication): O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee that we should turn back upon our heels or put to any trial about our religion.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr al-As ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mera Haud (itna vishaal aur bada hai ki iska chakkar lagaane mein) ek mahine ki safar lagegi, aur iske sab kinaare barabar hain aur iska paani chandi se zyada safed hai, aur iski mahak mushk ki mahak se zyada khushboodaar hai, aur iske aas-paas rakhe ghade aasmaan ke taaron jaise hain; aur jo isse peega use uske baad kabhi pyaas nahi lagegi. Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main Haud par hunga taaki main tum mein se un logon ko dekh sakoon jo mere paas aa rahe honge, lekin kuch log (mujhtak pahunchne se pehle) roke jaayenge. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, ye mere anuyaayi hain aur meri Ummat se hain, aur mujhse kaha jaayega: Kya tumhe pata hai unhone tumhare baad kya kiya? Allah ki qasam, unhone tumhare baad koi achhaai nahi ki, aur woh apni eDiyon par palat gaye. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Ibn Abu Mulaika (dua mein) kaha karte the: Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon ki hum apni eDiyon par palat jaayein ya humein apne deen ke baare mein kisi pareeksha mein daala jaaye.

e: 'A'isha reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say in the company of his Companions: I would be on the Cistern waiting for those who would be coming to me from amongst you. By Allah, some persons would be prevented from coming to me, and I would say: My Lord, they are my followers and people of my Umma. And He would say,: You don't know what they did after you; they had been constantly turning back on their heels (from their religion).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne sahaba ki sohbat mein kehte suna: Main Haud par hunga tum mein se un logon ka intezaar karte hue jo mere paas aa rahe honge. Allah ki qasam, kuch logon ko mere paas aane se roka jaayega, aur main kahunga: Mere Rab, ye mere anuyaayi hain aur meri Ummat ke log hain. Aur Woh kahenge: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya kiya; woh (apne deen se) lagataar apni eDiyon par palte rahe.

e: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said I used to hear from people making a mention of the Cistern, but I did not hear about it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). One day while a girl was combing me I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: " O people." I said to that girl: Keep away from me. She said: He (the Holy Prophet) has addressed the men only and he has not invited the attention of the women. I said: I am amongst the people also (and have thus every right to listen to the things pertaining to religion). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I shall be your harbinger on the Cistern; therefore, be cautious lest one of you should come (to me) and may be driven away like a stray camel. I would ask the reasons, and it would be said to me: You don't know what innovations they made after you. And I would then also say: Be away.
hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Main logon se Haud ka zikr sunti thi, lekin maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nahi suna tha. Ek din jab ek larki mere baal kangahi kar rahi thi maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: "Aye logo." Maine us larki se kaha: Mujhse door raho. Usne kaha: Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) sirf mardon ko khitaab kiya hai aur unhone auraton ka dhyaan nahi bulaaya hai. Maine kaha: Main bhi logon mein se hoon (aur mujhe deen ki baaton sunne ka poora haq hai). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main tumhare agrasar ke soorat mein Haud par hunga; is liye savdhaan raho kahin tum mein se koi (mere paas) aaye aur ise ek bhatakte hue oont ki tarah bhagaa diya jaaye. Main wajah poochunga, aur mujhse kaha jaayega: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya nayi cheezein banaayin. Aur main phir kahunga: Door raho.

e: Umm Salama reported that she heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying this as he was sitting on the pulpit and she was getting her hair combed. (He uttered these words): " O people." And she said to one who was combing: Leave my head; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Umm Salama ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue suna jab woh mimbar par baithe the aur woh (Umm Salama) apne baal kangahi karwaa rahi thin. (Unhone ye alfaaz kahe): "Aye logo." Aur unhone (Umm Salama ne) kangahi karne wali se kaha: Mera sar chhod do; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day went out and he offered prayer over the martyrs of Uhud just as prayer is offered over the dead. He then came back and sat on pulpit and said: I shall be present there (at the Cistern) before you. I shall be your witness and, by Allah, I perceive as if I am seeing with my own eyes my Cistern at this very state and I have been given the keys of the treasures of the earth or the keys of the earth and, by Allah, I am not afraid concerning you that you would associate anything (with Allah after me), but I am afraid that you would be vying with one another (for the possession of) the treasures of the earth.
hi: Uqba bin Amir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din bahar gaye aur unhone Uhud ke shaheedon ke liye namaz padhi jaisi ki murda ke liye padhi jaati hai. Phir woh wapas aaye aur mimbar par baithe aur kaha: Main tumse pehle wahan (Haud par) maujood hunga. Main tumhaara gawaah hunga, aur, Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai jaise main apni khud ki aankhon se abhi apna Haud dekh raha hoon aur mujhe zameen ke khazanon ki, ya zameen ki, chaabiyaan di gayi hain aur, Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumhare baare mein ye dar nahi hai ki tum (Allah ke saath) kisi ko shareek karoge, lekin mujhe dar hai ki tum zameen ke khazanon ke liye ek-doosre se pratispardha karoge.

e: Uqba b. 'Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah's Messenger offered prayer over those who had fallen matyrs at Uhud. He then climbed the pulpit as if someone is saying good-bye to the living and the dead, and then said: I shall be there as your predecesor on the Cistern before you, and it is as wide as the distance between Aila and Juhfa (Aila is at the top of the gulf of 'Aqaba). I am not afraid that you would associate anything with Allah after me, but I am afraid that you may be (allured) by the world and (vie) with one another (in possessing material wealth) and begin killing one another, and you would be destroyed as were destroyed those who had gone before you. 'Uqba said that that was the last occasion that he saw Allah's Massenger on the pulpit.
hi: Uqba bin Amir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud mein shaheed huye logon ke liye namaz padhi. Phir woh mimbar par chadhe jaise koi zinda aur murda logon se vida le raha ho, aur phir kaha: Main tumhare aage tumhaare purv-mard ke soorat mein Haud par hunga, aur ye Aila aur Juhfa ke beech ki doori jitna vishaal hai (Aila Aqaba ki khaadi ke top par hai). Mujhe dar nahi hai ki tum mere baad Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek karoge, lekin mujhe dar hai ki tum duniya se (lubhaaye jaaoge) aur ek-doosre se (dunyawi daulat ki malkiyat ke liye) pratispardha karoge aur ek-doosre ko qatal karna shuru karoge, aur tum barbaad ho jaaoge jaise tumse pehle log barbaad hue. Uqba ne kaha ki ye aakhri baar tha jab unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par dekha.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying; I shall be there at the Cistern before you, and I shall have to contend for some people, but I shall have to yield. I would be saying: My Lord, they are my friends, they are my friends, and it would be said: You don't know what innovations they made after you.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main tumse pehle wahan Haud par hunga, aur mujhe kuch logon ke liye laDaai karni padegi, lekin mujhe hataa diya jaayega. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, ye mere dost hain, ye mere dost hain, aur kaha jaayega: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya nayi cheezein banaayin.

e: The hadith has been narrated on the authority ot al-A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of: " They are my companions; they are my companions."
hi: Ye hadees al-A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Ye mere saathi hain; ye mere saathi hain."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hudhaifa ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Haritha reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: His Cistern would be as extensive as the distance between San'a' and Medina. Mustaurid (one of the narrators) said: Did you not hear anything about the utensils? Thereupon he said. No. Mustaurid said: You would find that the utensils would be like stars.
hi: Haritha ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Unka Haud San'a aur Madina ke beech ki doori jitna vishaal hoga. Mustaurid (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Kya aapne bartano ke baare mein kuch nahi suna? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi. Mustaurid ne kaha: Tumhe pata chalega ki bartan taaron jaise honge.

e: Haritha b. Wahb al-Khuza'i reported Allah's Messeiiger's (ﷺ) words concerning the Cistern like it, but he made no mention of the words of Mustaurid.
hi: Haritha bin Wahb al-Khuza'i ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Haud ke baare mein alfaaz isi tarah riwayat kiye, lekin unhone Mustaurid ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is before you a Cistern and the distance between its two sides is as it is between Jarba' and Adhruh.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhare saamne ek Haud hai aur iske do kinaaron ke beech ki doori utni hai jitni Jarba aur Adhruh ke beech hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Umar and the words are: That he said there would be before you a Cistern extending from jarba' and Adhruh and the same has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna and the wording is:" My Cistern."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: Ki unhone kaha ki tumhare saamne ek Haud hoga jo Jarba aur Adhruh tak phaila hoga, aur yahi hadees Ibn Muthanna ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein alfaaz hain: "Mera Haud."

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority, of 'Ubaidullah with this addition: Ubaidullah was asked (about these two names, i. e. Jarba' and Adhruh). He said: These are the two towns of Syria and there is between them the distance which can be covered in three nights, and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bishr (the words are)." Three days."
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Ubaidullah se poocha gaya (in do naamon ke baare mein, yaani Jarba aur Adhruh). Unhone kaha: Ye Syria ke do shehar hain aur inke beech utni doori hai jitni teen raaton mein tay ki jaa sake, aur Ibn Bishr ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Teen din."

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be before you a Cistern (as extensive) as there is the distance between Jarba' and Adhruh and there would be jugs like stars in the sky; he who would come to that and drink from it would never feel thirsty after that.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhare saamne ek Haud hoga (jo utna vishaal hoga) jitni doori Jarba aur Adhruh ke beech hai, aur ismein aasmaan ke taaron jaise ghade honge; jo isse aayega aur peega use uske baad kabhi pyaas nahi lagegi.

e: Abu Dharr said: Allah's Messenger, what about the vessels of that Cistern? He said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the vessels would outnumber the stars in the sky and its planets shining on a dark cloudless night. These would be the vessels of Paradise. He who drinks out of it (the Cistern) would never feel thirsty. There would flow in it two spouts from Paradise and he who would drink out of it would not feel thirsty; and the distance between its (two corners) is that between 'Amman and Aila, and its water is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey.
hi: Abu Dharr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, us Haud ke bartano ke baare mein kya? Unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, bartano ki tadaad aasmaan mein taaron aur graho se zyada hogi jo ek andheri baadal-rahit raat mein chamakte hain. Ye Jannat ke bartan honge. Jo isse (Haud se) peega use kabhi pyaas nahi lagegi. Ismein Jannat se do naaliyaan aayengi aur jo isse peega use pyaas nahi lagegi; aur iske (do kinaaron ke) beech ki doori Amman aur Aila ke beech ki doori hai, aur iska paani doodh se safed hai aur shahad se meetha hai.

e: Thauban reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: I would be pushing back from my Cistern the crowd of people. I would strike away from it (the Cistern) with my staff the people of Yemen until the water (of the Haud) would spout forth upon them. He was asked about its breadth. He said: From this place of mine to 'Amman, and he was asked about the drink and he said: It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. There would spout into it two streamlets having their sources in Paradise. the one is from gold and the other is from silver. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and the words are:" I would be on the Day of Resurrection near the bank of the Cistern."
hi: Thauban ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main apne Haud se logon ki bheed ko peeche dhakelunga. Main Yemen ke logon ko apni lathi se ismein se (peeche) hataaunga yahan tak ki paani (Haud ka) unpar ubal pade. Unse iski chaudai ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Meri is jagah se Amman tak, aur unse peene (ke paani) ke baare mein poocha gaya aur unhone kaha: Ye doodh se safed hai aur shahad se meetha hai. Ismein Jannat se do chhoti naaliyaan aayengi jinke srot Jannat mein hain, ek sone ki aur doosri chandi ki. Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: "Main Qayamat ke din Haud ke kinaare ke qareeb hunga."

e: Thaubin reported this hadith pertaining to the Cistern. Muhammad b. Bashshar said: I said to Yahya b. Hammad: This is the hadith that I heard from Abu 'Awana and he said: I also heard it from Shu'ba. I said: Narrate that to me and he narrated that to me.
hi: Thauban ne Haud se mutaliq ye hadees riwayat ki. Muhammad bin Bashshar ne kaha: Maine Yahya bin Hammad se kaha: Ye woh hadees hai jo maine Abu Awana se suni thi aur unhone kaha: Maine ise Shu'ba se bhi suna. Maine kaha: Mujhe ye riwayat kijiye, aur unhone mujhe ye riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: I will drive away from my Cistern people just as the stray camels are driven away.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main apne Haud se logon ko isi tarah bhagaunga jaise bhatakte hue oonton ko bhagaaya jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain ot transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: My Cistern would be as extensive as the distance between Aila and San'a, of Yemen, and there would be in it jugs like stars in the sky.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mera Haud Aila aur Yemen ke San'a ke beech ki doori jitna vishaal hoga, aur ismein aasmaan ke taaron jaise ghade honge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Some persons from amongst my associates would turn to my Cistern; when I would see them and they would be presented to me, they would be detained in the way while coming to me. I would say: My Lord, they are my companions, they are my companions, and it would be said to me: You don't know what innovations they made after you.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mere kuch saathiyon mein se log mere Haud ki taraf palTenge; jab main unhe dekhunga aur woh mere saamne pesh kiye jaayenge, unhe raaste mein rok liya jaayega mere paas aane se. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, ye mere saathi hain, ye mere saathi hain, aur mujhse kaha jaayega: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya nayi cheezein banaayin.

e: Anas reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he made this addition: " The vessels would be as numerous as the number of stars.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki aur ye izafa kiya: "Bartan taaron ki tadaad jitne honge."

e: Anas b. Milik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be such a vast distance between the sides of my Cistern as it is between Sana' and Medina.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mere Haud ke kinaaron ke beech utni hi vishaal doori hogi jitni San'a aur Madina ke beech hai.

e: Anas reported this hadith with this change that there was some doubt between (places mentioned) and there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Anas ne ye hadees is badlaav ke saath riwayat ki ki (jagah ka) kuch shak tha aur alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: You would be shown in it jugs of gold and silver (as numerous) as the number of stars in the sky. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas b. Malik with this addition:" More numerous than stars in the sky."
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhe ismein aasmaan ke taaron jitni tadaad mein sone aur chandi ke ghade dikhaaye jaayenge. Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Aasmaan ke taaron se bhi zyada."

e: Jabir b. Samura reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Behold, I shall be present ahead of you on the Cistern, and the distance between its different sides would be like that between Sana' and Aila, and its jugs would be like stars in the sky.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Dekho, main tumse pehle Haud par maujood hunga, aur iske mukhtalif kinaaron ke beech ki doori San'a aur Aila ke beech ki doori jitni hogi, aur iske ghade aasmaan ke taaron jaise honge.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: I wrote (a letter) to Jabir b. Samura (and it was sent) through my servant Nafi' asking him to inform me about something (pertaining to the Haud Kauthar). He wrote to me: I heard him (the Holy Prophet) say: I shall be there ahead of you at the Haud Kauthar.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bayan kiya: Maine Jabir bin Samura ko (ek khat) likha (aur ye mere naukar Nafi ke zariye bheja gaya) unse kuch (Haud Kauthar se mutaliq) bataane ki guzaarish karte hue. Unhone mujhe likha: Maine unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) ye kehte suna: Main tumse pehle Haud Kauthar par maujood hunga.

e: Sa`d reported that on the Day of Uhud I saw on the right side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and on his left side two persons dressed in white clothes and whom I did not see before nor after that, and they were Gabriel and Michael (Allah be pleased with both of them).
hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Uhud ke din maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki daayi taraf aur unki baayi taraf do log dekhe jo safed kapde pehne hue the aur jinhe maine na pehle dekha tha na uske baad, aur woh Jibril aur Mikail the (Allah unse khush ho).

e: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: I saw on the right side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and on his left side two persons with white clothes on the Day of Uhtid fighting a desperate fight, and I saw them neither before nor after that.
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki daayi taraf aur unki baayi taraf Uhud ke din safed kapdon mein do log dekhe jo bhaanjne wali jung lad rahe the, aur maine unhe na uske pehle na uske baad dekha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the sublimest among people (in character) and the most generous amongst them and he was the bravest of men. One night the people of Medina felt disturbed and set forth in the direction of a sound when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met them on his way back as he had gone towards that sound ahead of them. He was on the horse of Abu Talha which had no saddle over it, and a sword was slung round his neck, and he was saying: There was nothing to be afraid of, and he also said: We found it (this horse) like a torrent of water (indicating its swift-footedness), whereas the horse had been slow before that time.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) charitr mein logon mein sabse uchcha the aur unmein sabse sakhi the aur woh sabse bahaadur aadmi the. Ek raat Madina ke log pareshaan ho gaye aur ek aawaaz ki simt mein badhe jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe raaste mein mile jab woh us aawaaz ki taraf unse pehle hi jaa chuke the. Woh Abu Talha ke ghode par the jispar koi zeen nahi thi, aur unke gale mein ek talwaar latak rahi thi, aur woh keh rahe the: Darne ki koi baat nahi hai, aur unhone ye bhi kaha: Humne ise (is ghode ko) paani ki dhaara jaisa tez paaya (iski chaal ki teezi ka ishara dete hue), jabki ye ghoda us waqt se pehle dheema tha.

e: Anas reported that there was consternation in Medina. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) borrowed the horse from Abu Talha which was called Mandub. He rode it and said: We have found no reason for consternation, and we have found it to be (as quick as a torrent) of water.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Madina mein khalbali machi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha se ghoda liya jise Mandub kaha jaata tha. Woh isper sawaar hue aur kaha: Humein khalbali ki koi vajah nahi mili, aur humne ise (paani ki dhaara jitna) tez paaya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the most generous of people in charity, but he was generous to the utmost in the month of Ramadan. Gabriel (peace be upon him) would meet him every year during the month of Ramadin until it ended, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited to him the Qur'an; and when Gabriel met him Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was most generous in giving charity like the blowing wind.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sadaqe mein logon mein sabse sakhi the, lekin woh Ramzan ke mahine mein sabse zyada sakhi hote the. Jibril (unpar shaanti ho) har saal Ramzan ke mahine mein unse milte yahan tak ki ye khatam ho jaata, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe Quran padhte the; aur jab Jibril unse milte Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sadaqa dene mein bahte hue hawa ki tarah sabse sakhi ho jaate.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I served the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for ten years, and, by Allah, he never said to me any harsh word, and he never said to me about a thing as to why I had done that and as to why I had not done that. Abu Rabi' has made this addition (in this narration):" The work which a servant should do." There is no mention of his words" By Allah".
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki das saal khidmat ki, aur Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi mujhse koi sakht lafz nahi kaha, aur unhone kabhi kisi baat ke baare mein mujhse nahi poocha ki maine aisa kyun kiya aur waisa kyun nahi kiya. Abu Rabi ne (is riwayat mein) ye izafa kiya hai: "Woh kaam jo ek naukar ko karna chahiye." Unke alfaaz "Allah ki qasam" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina, Abla Talha took hold of my hand and brought me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, Anas is a prudent young boy, and he will serve you. He (Anas) said: I served him in journey and at home, but, by Allah, he never asked me about a thing which I did as to why I did so, nor about a thing which I did not do as to why I had not done that.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye, Abu Talha ne mera haath pakda aur mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Anas ek aqlmand jawaan larka hai, aur woh aapki khidmat karega. Unhone (Anas ne) kaha: Maine safar mein aur ghar mein unki khidmat ki, lekin, Allah ki qasam, unhone kabhi mujhse kisi baat ke baare mein nahi poocha jo maine ki thi ki maine aisa kyun kiya, na kisi baat ke baare mein jo maine nahi ki thi ki maine aisa kyun nahi kiya.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I served the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for nine years, and I do not know (of any instance) when he said to me: Why you have done this and that, and he never found fault with me in anything.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nau saal khidmat ki, aur mujhe nahi pata (koi bhi mauka) jab unhone mujhse kaha: Tumne ye aisa kyun kiya, aur unhone mujhme kabhi koi khaami nahi nikaali.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the best disposition amongst people. He sent me on an errand one day, and I said: By Allah, I would not go. I had, however, this idea in my mind that I would do as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had commanded me to do. I went out until I happened to come across children who had been playing in the street. In the meanwhile, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came there and he caught me by the back of my neck from behind me. As I looked towards him I found him smiling and he said: Unais, did you go where I commanded you to go? I said: Allah's Messenger, yes, I am going. Anas further said: I served him for nine years but I know not that he ever said to me about a thing which I had done why I did that, or about a thing I had left as to why I had not done that.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka mizaj logon mein sabse achha tha. Unhone mujhe ek din ek kaam ke liye bheja, aur maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, main nahi jaunga. Mere man mein, halaanki, ye khyaal tha ki main woh karunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe karne ka hukum diya. Main bahar gaya yahan tak ki mujhe kuch bachche mile jo gali mein khel rahe the. Isi beech, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye aur unhone mujhe peeche se meri gardan se pakda. Jab maine unki taraf dekha to paaya ki woh muskuraa rahe the aur unhone kaha: Unais, kya tum wahan gaye jahan maine tumhe jaane ka hukum diya tha? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan, main jaa raha hoon. Anas ne aage kaha: Maine unki nau saal khidmat ki lekin mujhe nahi pata ki unhone kabhi mujhse kisi baat ke baare mein poocha ki maine aisa kyun kiya, ya kisi baat ke baare mein jo maine chhod diya thi ki maine aisa kyun nahi kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the best amongst people in disposition and behaviour.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mizaj aur vyavahaar mein logon mein sabse behtareen the.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: It never happened that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked for anything and he said: No.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Aisa kabhi nahi hua ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch maanga gaya ho aur unhone kaha ho: Nahi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Musa b. Anas reported on the authority of his father: It never happened that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked anything for the sake of Islam and he did not give that. There came to him a person and he gave him a large flock (of sheep and goats) and he went back to his people and said: My people, embrace Islam, for Muhammad gives so much charity as if he has no fear of want.
hi: Musa bin Anas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Aisa kabhi nahi hua ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Islam ki khaatir kuch maanga gaya ho aur unhone woh nahi diya ho. Unke paas ek shakhs aaya aur unhone use bakriyon aur bakron ka ek bada rewad diya aur woh apne logon ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha: Mere logo, Islam qubool karo, kyunki Muhammad itna sadaqa dete hain jaise unhe garibi ka koi Dar hi na ho.

e: Anas 'b. Malik reported that a person requested Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to give him a very large flock and he gave that to him. He came to his tribe and said: O people, embrace Islam. By Allah, Muhammad donates so much as if he did not fear want. Anas said that the person embraced Islam for the sake of the world but later he became Muslim until Islam became dearer to him than the world and what it contains.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut bada rewad maanga aur unhone use ye diya. Woh apne qabile ke paas aaya aur kaha: Aye logo, Islam qubool karo. Allah ki qasam, Muhammad itna sadqa dete hain jaise unhe garibi ka koi dar hi na ho. Anas ne kaha ki us shakhs ne duniya ki khaatir Islam qubool kiya lekin baad mein woh sacche taur par Musalman ban gaya yahan tak ki Islam unhe duniya aur usmein jo kuch tha usse zyada aziz ho gaya.

e: Ibn Shihab reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went on the expedition of Victory, i. e. the Victory of Mecca, and then he went out along with the Muslims and they fought at Hunain, and Allah granted victory to his religion and to the Muslims, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave one hundred camels to Safwan b. Umayya. He again gave him one hundred camels, and then again gave him one hundred camels. Sa'id b. Musayyib said that Safwan told him: (By Allah) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me what he gave me (and my state of mind at that time was) that he was the most detested person amongst people in my eyes. But he continued giving to me until now he is the dearest of people to me.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatah ki muhim par gaye, yaani Makkah ki Fatah, aur phir woh Musalmaanon ke saath bahar gaye aur unhone Hunain mein jung ki, aur Allah ne apne deen aur Musalmaanon ko jeet di, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safwan bin Umayya ko sau oont diye. Unhone unhe dobara sau oont diye, aur phir unhe sau aur oont diye. Sa'id bin Musayyib ne kaha ki Safwan ne unhe bataya: (Allah ki qasam) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe woh diya jo unhone diya (aur us waqt meri mansikta ye thi) ki woh mere liye logon mein sabse napasandeeda shakhs the. Lekin unhone mujhe dete rehna jaari rakha yahan tak ki ab woh mere liye logon mein sabse aziz hain.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: In case we get wealth from Bahrain, I would give you so much and so much; he made an indication of it with both his hands. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) died before wealth from Bahrain came, and it fell to the lot of Abu Bakr after him. He commanded the announcer to make announcement to the effect that he to whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had held out promise or owed any debt should come (to him). I came and said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had said to me: In case there comes to us the wealth of Bahrain I shall give you so much, and so much. Abu Bakr took a handful (of the coins) and gave that to me once and asked me to count them I counted them as five hundred dinars and he said: Here is double of this for you.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar humein Bahrain se daulat mile, to main tumhe itni aur itni doonga; unhone apne donon haathon se iska ishara kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal Bahrain se daulat aane se pehle hua, aur ye unke baad Abu Bakr ke hisse mein aayi. Unhone ailaan karne wale ko hukum diya ki woh ailaan kare ki jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne vaada diya tha ya jinka koi karza tha use (unke paas) aana chahiye. Main aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha tha: Agar humein Bahrain ki daulat mile, to main tumhe itni aur itni dunga. Abu Bakr ne (sikkon ki) ek mutthi li aur use mujhe ek baar di aur mujhe unhe ginne ko kaha. Maine unhe gina aur woh paanch sau dinar the aur unhone kaha: Iska dugna tumhare liye hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) died, there came to Abfi Bakr wealth from al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami. Abu Bakr said: He to whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) owed any debt or held out any promise should come to us; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, Abu Bakr ke paas al-Ala bin al-Hadrami se daulat aayi. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne koi karza diya tha ya vaada kiya tha use humare paas aana chahiye; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A child was born into me this night and I named him after the name of my father Ibrihim. He then sent him to Umm Saif, the wife of a blacksmith who was called Abu Saif. He (the Holy Prophet) went to him and I followed him until we reached Abu Saif and he was blowing fire with the help of blacksmith's bellows and the house was filled with smoke. I hastened my step and went ahead of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Abu Saif, stop it, as there comes Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). He stopped and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for the child. He embraced him and said what Allah had desired. Anas said: I saw that the boy breathed his last in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shed tears and he said: Ibrahim, our eyes shed tears and our hearts are filled with grief, but we do not say anything except that by which Allah is pleased. O Ibrahim, we are grieved for you.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aaj raat mere ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur maine uska naam apne waalid Ibrahim ke naam par rakha. Phir unhone use Umm Saif, ek lohaar ki zauja jise Abu Saif kaha jaata tha, ke paas bheja. Woh (Nabi-e-Paak) unke paas gaye aur main unke peeche gaya yahan tak ki hum Abu Saif tak pahunche aur woh lohaar ki bhaTThi se aag phook rahe the aur ghar dhuen se bhar gaya tha. Maine apne kadam tez kiye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aage badh gaya aur kaha: Abu Saif, ruko, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aa rahe hain. Woh ruke aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bachche ko bulaaya. Unhone use gale lagaaya aur kaha jo Allah ne chaaha. Anas ne kaha: Maine dekha ki larke ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein aakhri saans li. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu behe aur unhone kaha: Ibrahim, humari aankhon se aansu behte hain aur humare dil gam se bhar jaate hain, lekin hum kuch nahi kehte siwaay us baat ke jisse Allah khush ho. Aye Ibrahim, hum tumhari yaad mein dukhi hain.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I have never seen anyone more kind to one's family than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Ibrahim was sent to the suburb of Medina for suckling. He used to go there and we accompanied him. He entered the house, and it was filled with smoke as his foster-father was a bricksmith. He took him (his son Ibrihim) and kissed him and then came back. 'Amr said that when Ibrihim died. Allah's LMessenger (ﷺ) said: Ibrihim is my son and he dies as a suckling babe. He has now two foster-mothers who would complete his suckling period in Paradise.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine kabhi kisi ko apne khaandaan ke prati Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada meherbaan nahi dekha, aur Ibrahim ko doodh pilaane ke liye Madina ke bahar bheja gaya tha. Woh wahan jaate aur hum unke saath jaate. Woh ghar mein daakhil hote, aur ye dhuen se bhara hota kyunki unke doodh-waalid ek eenT-banaane wale the. Woh unhe (apne bete Ibrahim ko) uThAte aur unhe chumte aur phir wapas aa jaate. Amr ne kaha ki jab Ibrahim ka intiqaal hua, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ibrahim mera beta hai aur woh doodh peene ki umar mein hi mar gaya. Ab uski do doodh-maayen hain jo Jannat mein uski doodh peene ki muddat poori karengi.

e: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that there came a few desert Arabs to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Do you kiss your children? He said: Yes. Thereupon they said: By Allah but we do not kiss our children. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Then what can I do if Allah has deprived you of mercy? Ibn Numair said: (We has deprived) your heart of mercy.
hi: Aisha (Allah unse khush ho) ne bayan kiya ki kuch registaan ke Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Kya aap apne bachchon ko chumte hain? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, lekin hum apne bachchon ko nahi chumte. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: To main kya karun agar Allah ne tumse rehmat cheen li hai? Ibn Numair ne kaha: (Usne tumhare dil se rehmat cheen li hai).

e: Abu Huraira reported that al-Aqra' b. Habis saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) kissing Hasan. He said: I have ten children, but I have never kissed any one of them, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who does not show mercy (towards his children), no mercy would be shown to him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki al-Aqra bin Habis ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko chumte dekha. Unhone kaha: Mere das bachche hain, lekin maine kabhi unmein se kisi ko nahi chuma, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo (apne bachchon ke prati) rehmat nahi dikhaata, uspar bhi koi rehmat nahi dikhaayi jaayegi.

e: The above hadith has likewise been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jarir b. 'Abdullah through different chains of transmitters and the words are: " That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who shows no mercy to the people, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, does not show mercy to him."
hi: Ye hadees Jarir bin Abdullah ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: "Ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo logon par rehmat nahi dikhaata, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, uspar rehmat nahi dikhaate."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jarir through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jarir ki sanad se kuch doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was more modest than the virgin behind the curtain (or in the apartment), and when he disliked anything, we recognised that from his face.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) parde ke peeche (ya kamre mein) baithi kunwari se bhi zyada sharmeele the, aur jab woh kisi cheez ko napasand karte, hum unke chehre se pehchaan lete the.

e: Masruq reported: We went to Abdullah b. 'Amr when Mu'dwiya came to Kufa, and he made a mention of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: He was never immoderate in his talk and he never reviled others. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said: The best amongst you are those who are best in morals. Uthman said: When he came to Kufa along with Mu'awiya... (The rest of the hadith is the same).
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Amr ke paas gaye jab Muawiya Kufa aaye, aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Woh apni baat mein kabhi bhi ati na the aur unhone kabhi kisi ko bura-bhala nahi kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Tum mein sabse behtareen woh hain jo charitr mein sabse behtareen hain. Uthman ne kaha: Jab woh Muawiya ke saath Kufa aaye... (baaki hadees waisi hi hai).

e: This hadith had been narrated on the authority of al-A'mash through another chain of transmitters also.
hi: Ye hadees al-A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Simak b. Harb reported: I said to Jabir b. Samura: Did you have the privilege of sitting in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes, very frequently, and added: He did not stand up (and go) from the place where he offered the dawn prayer until the sun rose, and after the rising of the sun he stood up, and they (his Companions) entered into conversation with one another and they talked of the things (that they did during the Days of Ignorance), and they laughed (on their unreasonable and ridiculous acts). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled only.
hi: Simak bin Harb ne bayan kiya: Maine Jabir bin Samura se kaha: Kya aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithne ka saubhaagya mila? Unhone kaha: Haan, bahut baar, aur izafa kiya: Woh us jagah se, jahan unhone fajr ki namaz padhi thi, tab tak nahi uThte the jab tak suraj nahi nikal jaata, aur suraj nikalne ke baad woh khade hote, aur woh (unke sahaba) aapas mein baatchit karte aur un cheezon ki baat karte (jo unhone Jaahiliyat ke daur mein ki thin), aur woh (apne anuchit aur haasyaaspad karyon par) hanste. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sirf muskuraate the.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had in one of his journeys his black slave who was called Anjasha along with him. He goaded by singing the songs of camel-driver. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Anjasha, drive slowly as you are driving (the mounts who are carrying) glass vessels
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unki ek safar mein unka kaala ghulam tha jise Anjasha kaha jaata tha. Woh oont chalaane wale geet gaakar jaanwaron ko uksaa raha tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Anjasha, dheere chalo kyunki tum (kaanch ke bartan le ja rahe savaaron ko) le ja rahe ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to his wives as the camel-driver who was called Anjasha had been, driving (the camels) on which (they were riding). Thereupon he said: Anjasha, be careful, drive slowly for you are driving the mounts who carry vessels of glass. Abu Qilaba said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) uttered words which if someone had uttered amongst you, you would have found fault with him.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni zaujaon ke paas aaye jab Anjasha naamak oont chalaane wala unke (oonton ko) haank raha tha jinpar woh sawaar thin. Isper unhone kaha: Anjasha, savdhaan raho, dheere chalo kyunki tum kaanch ke bartan le jaane wale savaaron ko haank rahe ho. Abu Qilaba ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aise alfaaz kahe ki agar tum mein se kisi ne unhe kaha hota, to tum unmein khaami paate.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Umm Sulaim was with the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and a camel-driver had been driving (the camels) oil which they were riding. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Anjasha, drive slowly, for you are carrying (on the camels) vessels of glass.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ke saath thin aur ek oont chalaane wala (oonton ko) haank raha tha jinpar woh sawaar thin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Anjasha, dheere chalo, kyunki tum kaanch ke bartan (oonton par) le ja rahe ho.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a camel-driver who had a very melodious voice. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Anjasha, drive slowly; do not break the vessels of glass, meaning the weak women.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek oont chalaane wala tha jiski aawaaz bahut madhur thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Anjasha, dheere chalo; kaanch ke bartan mat todo, jiska matlab tha komal auraten.

e: Anas reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of a camel-driver having a melodious voice.
hi: Anas ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki, lekin unhone ek madhur aawaaz waale oont chalaane wale ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had completed his dawn prayer, the servants of Medina came to him with utensils containing water, and no utensil was brought in which he did not dip his hand; and sometime they came in the cold dawn (and he did not feel reluctant in acceding to their request even in the cold weather) and dipped his hand in them.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni fajr ki namaz khatm kar chukte, Madina ke naukar paani se bhare bartan lekar unke paas aate, aur koi bhi bartan aisa nahi laaya jaata jismein unhone apna haath na dubaaya ho; aur kabhi kabhi woh Thandi subah mein aate (aur unhone Thande mausam mein bhi unki guzaarish maanne mein koi hichkichaahat nahi dikhaayi) aur unmein apna haath dubaaya.

e: Anas reported: I saw when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got his hair cut by the barber, his Companions came round him and they eagerly wanted that no hair should fall but in the hand of a person.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Maine dekha jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne baal nayi se katwaaye, unke sahaba unke aas-paas ikattha ho gaye aur woh betaab the ki koi bhi baal zameen par na gire balki sirf kisi shakhs ke haath mein hi paDe.

e: Anas reported that a woman had a partial derangement in her mind, so she said. Allah's Messenger, I want something from you. He said: Mother of so and so, see on which side of the road you would like (to stand and talk) so that I may do the needful for you. He stood aside with her on the roadside until she got what she needed.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat ke dimaag mein kuch kami thi, is liye usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe aapse kuch chahiye. Unhone kaha: Falan-falan ki maa, dekho tum raaste ke kis taraf (khade hokar baat karna) pasand karogi taaki main tumhaari zaroorat poori kar sakoon. Woh unke saath raaste ke kinaare khade hue yahan tak ki use woh mil gaya jo use chahiye tha.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said that whenever he had to choose between two things he adopted the easier one, provided it was nor sin, but if it was any sin he was the one wio was the farthest from it of the people; and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never took revenge from anyone because of his personal grievance, unless what Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, had made inviolable had been violated.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha ki jab bhi unhe do cheezon mein se ek chunna hota, woh aasaan waali ko apnaate, bashart-e ki ye gunah na ho, lekin agar ye koi gunah hota to woh logon mein isse sabse zyada door rehne waale the; aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi se apni niji shikaayat ki wajah se badla nahi liya, jab tak Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke zariye muqaddas banaayi gayi cheez ka ullanghan na hua ho.

e: The above hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shibab through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) make a choice between two things but adopting the easier one as compared to the difficult one, but his choice for the easier one was only in case it did not involve any sin, but if it involved sin he was the one who was the farthest from it amongst the people.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi do cheezon mein se ek chunte hue mushkil ke muqable aasaan wale ko nahi apnaya siwaay is baat ke ki, lekin unka aasaan wale ka chunaav sirf tab hota jab isme koi gunah shaamil na ho, lekin agar isme gunah shaamil hota to woh logon mein isse sabse door rehne wale the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never beat anyone with his hand, neither a woman nor a servant, but only, in the case when he had been fighting in the cause of Allah and he never took revenge for anything unless the things made inviolable by Allah were made violable; he then took revenge for Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi ko apne haath se nahi maara, na kisi aurat ko na naukar ko, siwaay tab jab woh Allah ki raah mein jung kar rahe hon, aur unhone kabhi kisi baat ke liye badla nahi liya jab tak Allah ke zariye muqaddas banaayi gayi cheez ka ullanghan na hua ho; phir woh Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke liye badla lete.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I prayed along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the first prayer. He then went to his family and I also went along with him when he met some children (on the way). He began to pat the cheeks of each one of them. He also patted my cheek and I experienced a coolness or a fragrance of his hand as if it had been brought out from the scent bag of a perfumer.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath pehli namaz padhi. Woh phir apne khaandaan ke paas gaye aur main bhi unke saath gaya jab woh raaste mein kuch bachchon se mile. Woh unmein se har ek ke gaal thoke lagne lage. Unhone mere gaal ko bhi thoka aur mujhe unke haath se Thandaas ya khushboo mehsoos hui jaise ye kisi attar ke thaile se nikaali gayi ho.

e: Anas reported: I never smelt ambergris or musk as fragrant as the fragrance of the body of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I never touched brocade or silk and found it as soft as the body of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Maine kabhi ambergris ya mushk itni khushboodaar nahi soonghi jitni Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke badan ki khushboo thi, aur maine kabhi resham ya reshmi kapda nahi chhua aur use itna narm nahi paaya jitna Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka badan tha.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a very fair complexion and (the drops) of his perspiration shone like pearls, and when he walked he walked inclining forward, and I never touched brocade and silk (and found it) as soft as the softness of the palm of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I never smelt musk or ambergris and found its fragrance as sweet as the fragrance of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka rang bahut gora tha aur unke pasine ki (buundein) moti jaisi chamakti thin, aur jab woh chalte, thoda aage ki taraf jhukkar chalte, aur maine kabhi resham ya reshmi kapda nahi chhua (aur use paaya) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hatheli ki narmi jaisa narm, aur maine kabhi mushk ya ambergris nahi soongha aur uski khushboo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khushboo jaisi meethi nahi paayi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to come to our house and there was perspiration upon his body. My mother brought a bottle and began to pour the sweat in that. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got up he said: Umm Sulaim, what is this that you are doing? Thereupon she said: That is your sweat which we mix in our perfume and it becomes the most fragrant perfume.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare ghar aaya karte the aur unke badan par pasina hota. Meri maa ek shishi laayin aur usmein pasina daalne lageen. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uThe, unhone kaha: Umm Sulaim, ye kya kar rahi ho? Isper unhone kaha: Ye aapka pasina hai jise hum apni khushboo mein milaate hain aur ye sabse khushboodaar attar ban jaata hai.
