e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to the house of Umm Sulaim and slept in her bed while she was away from her house. On the other day too he slept in her bed. She came and it was said to her: It is Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who is having siesta in your house, lying in your bed. She came and found him sweating and his sweat falling on the leather cloth spread on her bed. She opened her scent-bag and began to fill the bottles with it. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was startled and woke up and said: Umm Sulaim, what are you doing? She said: Allah's Messenger, we seek blessings for our children through it. Thereupon he said: You have done something right.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Sulaim ke ghar aaye aur unke bistar par soye jabki woh apne ghar se door thin. Doosre din bhi woh unke bistar par soye. Woh aayin aur unhe bataya gaya: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain jo aapke ghar mein aaraam kar rahe hain, aapke bistar par lete hue. Woh aayin aur unhe paseene se tar-baTar paaya aur unka pasina unke bistar par bichhe chamde ke kapde par gir raha tha. Unhone apni khushboo ka thaila khola aur usmein shishiyaan bharni shuru kiin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) chaunke aur jaage aur kaha: Umm Sulaim, tum kya kar rahi ho? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum ismein se apne bachchon ke liye barkat maangte hain. Isper unhone kaha: Tumne sahi kiya hai.

e: Umm Sulaim reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited her house and (took rest) and she spread a piece of cloth for him and he had had a siesta on it. And he sweated profusely and she collected his sweat and put it in a perfume and in bottles. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Umm Sulaim, what is this? She said: It is your sweat, which I put in my perfume. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sweated in cold weather when revelation descended upon him.
hi: Umm Sulaim ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke ghar aaye (aur aaram kiya) aur unhone unke liye ek kapda bichhaaya aur unhone usper aaraam kiya. Aur unhe bahut zyada pasina aaya aur unhone unka pasina ikattha kiya aur ise apni khushboo mein aur shishiyaan mein daala. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Umm Sulaim, ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Ye aapka pasina hai, jise main apni khushboo mein daalti hoon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Thande mausam mein bhi pasina aata jab unpar wahi utrti.

e: 'A'isha reported: When revelation descended upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) even during the cold days, his forehead perspired.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par wahi utrti, Thande dinon mein bhi, unki peshaani par pasina aata.

e: 'A'isha reported that Harith b. Hisham asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): How does the the wahi (inspiration) come to you? He said: At times it comes to me like the ringing of a bell and that is most severe for me and when it is over I retain that (what I had received in the form of wahi), and at times an Angel in the form of a human being comes to me (and speaks) and I retain whatever he speaks.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Harith bin Hisham ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Wahi (Ilaahi targhib) aapke paas kaise aati hai? Unhone kaha: Kabhi ye ghanti ki tarah baj kar mere paas aati hai aur ye mere liye sabse mushkil hota hai aur jab ye khatam ho jaati hai, main use (jo mujhe wahi ke soorat mein mila) barkarar rakhta hoon, aur kabhi kabhi ek Farishta ek insaan ke soorat mein mere paas aata hai (aur baat karta hai) aur main jo kuch woh kehta hai use barkarar rakhta hoon.

e: 'Ubida b. Samit reported that when wahi (inspiration) descended upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he felt a burden on that account and the colour of his face underwent a change.
hi: Ubada bin Samit ne bayan kiya ki jab wahi (targhib) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par utrti, unhe iski wajah se ek bojh mehsoos hota aur unke chehre ka rang badal jaata.

e: 'Ubida b. Samit reported that when wahi descended upon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), he lowered his head and so lowered his Companions their heads, and when (this state) was over, he raised his head.
hi: Ubada bin Samit ne bayan kiya ki jab wahi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par utrti, woh apna sar jhuka lete aur unke sahaba bhi apna sar jhuka lete, aur jab (ye haalat) khatam hoti, woh apna sar uThAte.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that the People of the Book used to let their hair fall (on their foreheads) and the polytheists used to part them on their heads, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) liked to conform his behaviour to the People of the Book in matters in which he received no command (from God) ; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) let fall his hair upon his forehead, and then he began to part it after this.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Kitaab waale apne baal (apni peshaani par) girne diya karte the aur mushrikeen unhe apne sar par baanta karte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna vyavahaar Kitaab waalon ke mutabik dhaalna pasand karte the un maamlon mein jinmein unhe (Allah se) koi hukum nahi mila hota; is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne baal apni peshaani par girne diye, aur phir unhone iske baad unhe baantna shuru kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Al-Bara' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was of medium height, having broad shoulders, with his hair hanging down on the lobes of his ears. He put on a red mantle over him, and never have I seen anyone more handsome than Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Al-Bara ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) drmyaana qad ke the, unke kandhe chaude the, aur unke baal unke kaanon ke lo tak latakte the. Unhone apne upar ek laal chogha pehna hua tha, aur maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada khoobsurat kisi ko nahi dekha.

e: Al-Bara' reported: Never did I see anyone more handsome than Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the red mantle. His hair had been hanging down on the shoulders and his shoulders were very broad, and he was neither very tall nor short-statured. Ibn Kuraib said he had hair.
hi: Al-Bara ne bayan kiya: Maine kabhi laal chogha mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada khoobsurat kisi ko nahi dekha. Unke baal unke kandhon par latakte the aur unke kandhe bahut chaude the, aur woh na bahut lambe the na bahut chhote qad ke. Ibn Kuraib ne kaha ki unke (kandhon tak) baal the.

e: Al-Bara' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the most handsome face amongst men and he had the best disposition and he was neither very tall nor short-statured.
hi: Al-Bara ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra mardon mein sabse khoobsurat tha aur unka mizaj sabse achha tha aur woh na bahut lambe the na chhote qad ke.

e: Qatada reported: I asked Anas b. Malik: How was the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: His hair was neither very curly nor very straight, and they hung over his shoulders and earlobes.
hi: Qatada ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal kaise the? Isper unhone kaha: Unke baal na bahut ghungharaale the na bahut seedhe, aur woh unke kandhon aur kaan ke lo tak latakte the.

e: Anas reported that the hair of Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) came upon his shoulders.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal unke kandhon tak aate the.

e: Anas reported that the hair of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reached half of the earlobe.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baal kaan ke lo tak aadhe tak pahunchte the.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a broad face with reddish (wide) eyes, and lean heels. Shu'ba reported: I said to Simak: What does this dali-ul-fam mean? And he said: This means broad face. I said: What does this ashkal mean? He said: Long in the slit of the eye. I said: What is this manhus-ul-aqibain? He said: It implies little flesh at the heels.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra chauda tha laalimyukt (badi) aankhon ke saath, aur unki eDiyaan patli thin. Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Maine Simak se kaha: Iska matlab kya hai dali-ul-fam? Aur unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai chauda chehra. Maine kaha: Iska matlab kya hai ashkal? Unhone kaha: Aankh ke katave mein lamba. Maine kaha: Iska matlab kya hai manhus-ul-aqibain? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai eDiyon mein kam gosht.

e: Jurairi reported: I said to Abu Tufail: Did you see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes, he had a white handsome face. Muslim b. Hajjaj said: Abu Tufail who died in 100 Hijra was the last of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Jurairi ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Tufail se kaha: Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha? Unhone kaha: Haan, unka chehra safed aur khoobsurat tha. Muslim bin Hajjaj ne kaha ki Abu Tufail, jinka intiqaal 100 Hijri mein hua, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein sabse aakhri the.

e: Abu Tufail reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there is one amongst the people of the earth who (are living at the present time and) had seen him except me. I said to him: How did you find him? He said: He had an elegant white color, and he was of an average height.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha aur zameen ke logon mein aisa koi bhi nahi hai (jo abhi jeevit ho) jisne unhe dekha ho siwaay mere. Maine unse (kisi ne) poocha: Aapne unhe kaisa paaya? Unhone kaha: Unki rangat suhaavni safed thi, aur woh darmiyana qad ke the.

e: Ibn Sirin reported: Anas b. Malik was asked whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had not become old enough to have white hair. Ibn Idris said that he had a few white hair. Abu Bakr and Umar, however, dyed hair with hina' (henna).
hi: Ibn Sirin ne bayan kiya: Anas bin Malik se poocha gaya ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne baal rangte the. Unhone kaha: Woh itni umar tak nahi pahunche the ki unke baal safed hote. Ibn Idris ne kaha ki unke kuch safed baal the. Abu Bakr aur Umar, halaanki, apne baal hina (mehndi) se rangte the.

e: Ibn Sirin reported: I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had not reached the stage when (he needed) dyeing (of his white hair). He had a few white hair in his beard. I said to him: Did Abu Bakr dye his hair? He said: Yes, with hina' (henna).
hi: Ibn Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne baal rangte the. Unhone kaha: Woh us charan tak nahi pahunche the jahan (unhe apne safed baalon ko) rangne ki zaroorat padti. Unki daadhi mein kuch safed baal the. Maine unse kaha: Kya Abu Bakr apne baal rangte the? Unhone kaha: Haan, hina se.

e: Muhammad b. Sirin reported: I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had but little white hair.
hi: Muhammad bin Sirin ne bayan kiya: Maine Anas bin Malik se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne baal rangte the. Unhone kaha: Unke bahut kam safed baal the.

e: Thabit reported that Anas b. Malik was asked about the dyeing (of the hair of) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Thereupon he said.: (They were so few) that if I so liked I could count their number in his head, and he further said: (That is) he did not dye. Abu Bakr, however, dyed them and so did 'Umar dye them with pure henna.
hi: Thabit ne bayan kiya ki Anas bin Malik se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (baalon ko) rangne ke baare mein poocha gaya. Isper unhone kaha: (Woh itne kam the) ki agar main chaahta to unhe unke sar mein gin sakta, aur unhone aage kaha: (Iska matlab hai) unhone rangna nahi kiya. Abu Bakr, halaanki, unhe rangte the aur Umar bhi shuddh hina se unhe rangte the.

e: Anas b. Malik did not like that a person should pick out his white hair from his head or beard, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not dye, and there was some whiteness in his hair at his chin, on his temples and very little on his head.
hi: Anas bin Malik ko ye pasand nahi tha ki koi shakhs apne safed baal apne sar ya daadhi se chun-chunkar nikaale, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne baal nahi range, aur unke baalon mein unki thoDi par, unke kanpTon par, aur unke sar mein bahut kam safedi thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muthanna through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Muthanna ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas (b. Malik) was asked about the old age of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He said: Allah did not blemish him with white hair.
hi: Anas (bin Malik) se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke buDhaape ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ne unhe safed baalon se apmaanit nahi kiya.

e: Abu Juhaifa reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having some whiteness (in hair) at this place, and Zuhair placed one of his fingers at his chin. Juhaifa was asked how old he had been at that time. He said: I made arrows and put feathers to them (i. e. I had passed my childhood).
hi: Abu Juhaifa ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is jagah kuch safedi (baalon mein) ke saath dekha, aur Zuhair ne apni ek ungli apni thoDi par rakhi. Juhaifa se poocha gaya ki us waqt unki umar kya thi. Unhone kaha: Maine teer banaaye the aur unpar par lagaaye the (yaani main apna bachpan paar kar chuka tha).

e: Abu Juhaifa reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he had white complexion and had some white hair, and Hasan b. 'Ali resembled him.
hi: Abu Juhaifa ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha ki unki rangat safed thi aur unke kuch safed baal the, aur Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) unse milte-julte the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Juhaifa with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Juhaifa ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura was asked about the old age of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He said: When he oiled his head nothing was seen (as a mark of old age) and when he did not apply oil something (of the old age) became visible.
hi: Jabir bin Samura se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke buDhaape ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Jab unhone apne sar mein tel lagaaya to kuch bhi (buDhaape ke nishaan ke soorat mein) nazar nahi aata tha aur jab unhone tel nahi lagaaya to kuch (buDhaape ka) nazar aata tha.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that there had appeared some whiteness on the front part of the head and beard of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When he applied oil, it did not become visible, but when he did not (apply) oil, it became apparent. And he had a thick beard. A person said: His face was as (bright) as the sword. Thereupon he (Jabir) said: No, it was round and like the sun and the moon. And I saw the seal near his shoulder of the size of a pigeon's egg and its color was the same as that of his body.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sar ke agle hisse aur daadhi par kuch safedi pragat hui thi. Jab unhone tel lagaaya, ye nazar nahi aati thi, lekin jab unhone (tel) nahi lagaaya, ye pragat ho jaati thi. Aur unki daadhi ghani thi. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Unka chehra talwaar jaisa (chamakdaar) tha. Isper unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Nahi, ye gol tha aur suraj aur chaand jaisa. Aur maine unke kandhe ke qareeb Muhur (Nabuwwat ki muhar) dekhi jo kabutar ke anDe ke aakaar ki thi aur iska rang unke badan ke rang jaisa hi tha.

e: Jabir. Samura reported: I saw the seal on his back as if it were a pigeon's egg.
hi: Jabir bin Samura ne bayan kiya: Maine unki peeth par muhar dekhi jaise ye kabutar ka anda ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: As-Sa'ib b. Yazid reported: My mother's sister took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, here is the son of my sister and he is ailing. He touched my head and invoked blessings upon me. He then performed ablution and I drank the water left from his ablution; then I stood behind him and I saw the seal between his shoulders.
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid ne bayan kiya: Meri maa ki behn mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayin aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe mere behn ke bete aur ye bimaar hai. Unhone mera sar chhua aur mere liye barkat maangi. Phir unhone wuzu kiya aur maine unke wuzu se bacha hua paani piya; phir main unke peeche khada hua aur maine unke kandhon ke beech Muhur dekhi.

e: Abdullah b. Sarjis reported: I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and ate with him bread and meat, or he said Tharid (bread soaked in soup). I said to him: Did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) seek forgiveness for you? He said: Yes, and for you, and he then recited this verse:" Ask forgiveness for thy sin and for the believing men and believing women" (xlvii. 19). I then went after him and saw the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders on the left side of his shoulder having spots on it like moles.
hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha aur unke saath roti aur gosht khaya, ya unhone Tharid (soop mein bhigi roti) kaha. Maine unse kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapke liye maafi maangi? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhare liye bhi, aur phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Apne gunahon ke liye aur imaandaar mardon aur imaandaar auraton ke liye maafi maango" (47:19). Main phir unke peeche gaya aur maine unke kandhon ke beech, unke kandhe ke baayi taraf, Nabuwwat ki Muhur dekhi jispar til jaisi jagahen thin.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither very conspicuously tall nor short-statured, and his color was neither glaringly white nor brown; his hair was neither very curly nor very straight; Allah commissioned him (as a Prophet) when he had reached the age of forty years, and he stayed in Mecca for ten years and for ten years in Medina; Allah took him away when he had just reached the age of sixty, and there had not been twenty white hair in his head and beard.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) na bahut spashth soorat se lambe the na chhote qad ke, aur unka rang na chamakdaar safed tha na bhoora; unke baal na bahut ghungharaale the na bahut seedhe; Allah ne unhe (Nabi ke soorat mein) muqarrar kiya jab woh chaalis saal ki umar tak pahunche the, aur woh Makkah mein das saal aur Madina mein das saal rahe; Allah ne unhe le liya jab woh saTh saal ki umar tak abhi-abhi pahunche the, aur unke sar aur daadhi mein bees se kam safed baal the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas b. Malik with this addition that instead of the word al-Amhaq there is the word Azhar.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki "al-Amhaq" lafz ki jagah "Azhar" lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he was sixty-three years old, and so was the case with Abu Bakr, and so was the case with Umar who was also sixty-three (when he died).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ke the, aur yehi haal Abu Bakr ka bhi tha, aur yehi haal Umar ka bhi tha jo bhi terasath saal ke the (jab unka intiqaal hua).

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-three. And a hadith like this had been transmitted on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ki umar tak pahunch chuke the. Aur isi jaisi ek hadees Sa'id bin Musayyib ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amr reported: I said to 'Urwa: How long did Allah's Apostle - (ﷺ) stay in Mecca? He said: For ten years. I said: Ibn 'Abbas says (that he stayed in Mecca) for thirteen years.
hi: Amr ne bayan kiya: Maine Urwa se kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein kitne saal rahe? Unhone kaha: Das saal. Maine kaha: Ibn Abbas kehte hain (ki woh Makkah mein) terah saal rahe.

e: 'Amr reported: I said to 'Urwa: How long did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stay in Mecca? He said: For ten years. I said: Ibn Abbas says it is some years above ten. He ('Urwa) sought forgiveness for him and said: His statement is based on the verse of a poet.
hi: Amr ne bayan kiya: Maine Urwa se kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein kitne saal rahe? Unhone kaha: Das saal. Maine kaha: Ibn Abbas kehte hain ki ye das se kuch saal upar hai. Unhone (Urwa ne) unke liye maafi maangi aur kaha: Unka bayaan ek kavi ke sher par aadhaarit hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for thirteen years and he died when he had attained the age of sixty three years.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein terah saal rahe aur unka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ki umar tak pahunche.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for thirteen years (after he had received revelation) and stayed in Medina for ten years, and he was sixty-three when he died.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein terah saal rahe (wahi milne ke baad) aur Madina mein das saal rahe, aur woh terasath saal ke the jab unka intiqaal hua.

e: Abu Ishaq reported: I was sitting with 'Abdullah b. 'Utba and there was a discussion about the age of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Some of the persons said: Abu Bakr was older than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). 'Abdullah said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he was sixty-three, and Abu Bakr died when he was sixty-three and so 'Umar fell as a martyr when he was sixty-three. A person from the people who was called 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that Jabir had said: We were sitting with Mu'awiya that there was a discussion about the age of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon Mu'awiya said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-three, and Abu Bakr died when he had attained the age of sixty-three, and Umar fell as a martyr when he had attained the age of sixty-three.
hi: Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Utba ke saath baitha tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki umar ke baare mein charcha ho rahi thi. Kuch logon ne kaha: Abu Bakr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bade the. Abdullah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ke the, aur Abu Bakr ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ke the aur isi tarah Umar shaheed hue jab woh terasath saal ke the. Logon mein se ek shakhs jise Amir bin Sa'd kaha jaata tha ne riwayat ki ki Jabir ne kaha tha: Hum Muawiya ke saath baithe the aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki umar ke baare mein charcha ho rahi thi. Isper Muawiya ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ki umar tak pahunch chuke the, aur Abu Bakr ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh terasath saal ki umar tak pahunch chuke the, aur Umar shaheed hue jab woh terasath saal ki umar tak pahunch chuke the.

e: Jabir reported that he heard Mu'awiya say in his address that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died at the age of sixty-three, so was the case with Abu Bakr and 'Umar, and I (am now) sixty-three.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki unhone Muawiya ko apne khutbe mein kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal terasath saal ki umar mein hua, yehi haal Abu Bakr aur Umar ka tha, aur main (ab) terasath saal ka hoon.

e: 'Ammar, the freed slave of Banu Hashim, reported: I asked Ibn 'Abbas how old was he when death overtook the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: I little know that such a thing is not known to a man like you who belong to his people. He said: I asked people about it but they differed with me, and I liked to know your opinion about it. He said: Do you know counting? He said: Yes. He then said: Bear this in mind very well that he was commissioned (as a Prophet) at the age of forty, and he stayed in Mecca for fifteen years; sometime in peace and sometime in dread, and (lived) for ten years after his migration to Medina.
hi: Ammar, Banu Hashim ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas se poocha ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat hui to unki umar kya thi. Unhone kaha: Mujhe thoda hi pata hai ki aisi baat tumhare jaise shakhs ko nahi pata, jo unke logon se hain. Unhone kaha: Maine logon se iske baare mein poocha lekin unhone mujhse asahmati jataayi, aur main iske baare mein tumhaari raay jaanna chaahta tha. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhe ginti aati hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir unhone kaha: Ye achhi tarah samajh lo ki unhe (Nabi ke soorat mein) chaalis saal ki umar mein muqarrar kiya gaya, aur woh Makkah mein pandrah saal rahe; kabhi shaanti mein aur kabhi bhay mein, aur (rehe) das saal Madina hijrat karne ke baad.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ammar, the freed slave of Banu Hashim, reported that Ibn 'Abbas said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-five.
hi: Ammar, Banu Hashim ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal tab hua jab woh painsaath saal ki umar tak pahunche the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Khalid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for fifteen years (after his advent as a Prophet) and he heard the voice of Gabriel and saw his radiance for seven years but did not see any visible form, and then received revelation for ten years, and he stayed in Medina for ten years.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein pandrah saal rahe (Nabi banne ke baad) aur unhone saat saal tak Jibril ki aawaaz suni aur unki chamak dekhi lekin koi drishya soorat nahi dekha, aur phir das saal tak wahi mili, aur woh Madina mein das saal rahe.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am al-Mahi (the obliterator) by whom unbelief would be obliterated, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet mankind will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (the last to come) after whom there will be no Prophet.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Muhammad hoon aur main Ahmad hoon, aur main al-Mahi (mitaane waala) hoon jiske zariye kufr mit jaayega, aur main Hashir (ikattha karne waala) hoon jiske paon par insaaniyat ikattha ki jaayegi, aur main Aqib (aakhri aane waala) hoon jiske baad koi Nabi nahi hoga.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have many names: I am Muhammad, I am Ahmad, I am al-Mahi through whom Allah obliterates unbelief, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet people will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (after whom there would be none), and Allah has named him as compassionate and merciful.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mere kayi naam hain: Main Muhammad hoon, main Ahmad hoon, main al-Mahi hoon jiske zariye Allah kufr ko mita deta hai, aur main Hashir (ikattha karne waala) hoon jiske paon par log ikattha kiye jaayenge, aur main Aqib hoon (jiske baad koi na ho), aur Allah ne unhe rehmvaan aur meherbaan naam diya hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar (and the words are): I said to Zuhri: What does (the word) al-'Aqib imply? He said: One after whom there is no Prophet, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar and 'Uqail there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Maine Zuhri se kaha: al-Aqib lafz ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Woh jiske baad koi Nabi nahi hai, aur Ma'mar aur Uqail ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned many names of his and said: I am Muhammad, Ahmad. Muqaffi (the last in succession), Hashir, the Prophet of repentance, and the Prophet of Mercy.
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne kayi naamon ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Main Muhammad hoon, Ahmad, Muqaffi (uttaradhikaar mein aakhri), Hashir, Tauba ka Nabi, aur Rehmat ka Nabi.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did an act, and held it to be valid. This news reached some persons amongst his Companions (and it was felt) that they did not approve of it and avoided (it). This reaction of theirs was conveyed to him. He stood to deliver an address; and said: What has happened to the people to whom there was conveyed on my behalf a matter for which I granted permission and they disapproved it and avoided it? By Allah, I have the best knowledge of Allah amongst them, and I fear Him most amongst them.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek amal kiya aur ise vaidh mana. Ye khabar unke sahaba mein se kuch logon tak pahunchi (aur mehsoos hua) ki woh isse sehmat nahi the aur unhone isse bacha. Unki ye jawab unhe (Nabi tak) pahunchaayi gayi. Woh khitaab dene khade hue aur kaha: Un logon ko kya hua hai jinhe mere taraf se ek maamla bataya gaya jiske liye maine ijazat di aur unhone isse na-pasandgi jataayi aur isse bacha? Allah ki qasam, mujhe unmein Allah ka sabse achha ilm hai, aur main unmein sabse zyada Usse Darta hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted permission for doing a thing, but some persons amongst the people avoided it. This was conveyed to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he was so much annoyed that the sign of his anger appeared on his face. He then said: What has happened to the people that they avoid that for which permission has been granted to me? By Allah, I have the best knowledge of Allah amongst them, and fear Him most amongst them.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kisi cheez karne ki ijazat di, lekin kuch logon ne isse bacha. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchaaya gaya, aur woh itne naaraaz hue ki unke gusse ke nishaan unke chehre par nazar aaye. Phir unhone kaha: Logon ko kya hua hai ki woh usse bachte hain jiski ijazat mujhe di gayi hai? Allah ki qasam, mujhe unmein Allah ka sabse achha ilm hai, aur main unse sabse zyada Darta hoon.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that 'Abdullah b. Zubair had narrated to him that a person from the Ansar disputed with Zubair in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to the watering places of Harra from which they watered the date-palms. The Ansari said: Let the water flow, but he (Zubair) refused to do this and the dispute was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said to Zubair: Zubair, water (your date-palms), then let the water flow to your neighbor. The Ansari was enraged and said: Allah's Messenger, (you have given this decision) for he is the son of your father's sister. The face of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) underwent a change, and then said: Zubair, water (your date-palms), then hold it until it rises up to the walls. Zubair said: I think, by Allah, that this verse:" Nay, by the Lord, they will not (really) (believe) until they make thee a judge of what is in dispute among them, and find in this no dislike of what thou decidest and submit with full submission" (iv. 65).
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Zubair ne unhe riwayat ki ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs ne Zubair se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein Harra ke paani ki jagahon ke baare mein jhagda kiya jinse woh khajoor ke darakhton ko sinchit karte the. Ansari ne kaha: Paani bahne do, lekin unhone (Zubair ne) aisa karne se inkaar kiya aur jhagda Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya aur unhone Zubair se kaha: Zubair, (apne khajoor ke darakhton ko) paani do, phir paani apne padosi ki taraf bahne do. Ansari gusse ho gaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, (aapne ye faisla diya) kyunki woh aapke waalid ki behn ka beta hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya, aur phir unhone kaha: Zubair, (apne khajoor ke darakhton ko) paani do, phir ise tab tak roko jab tak ye deewaron tak nahi pahunch jaata. Zubair ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai, Allah ki qasam, ki ye aayat: "Nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam, woh (waastav mein) tab tak imaan nahi rakhenge jab tak woh tumhe apne beech ke jhagdon ka nirnayak na maanein, aur jo tum faisla karte ho usse koi asantushti mehsoos na karein aur poori tarah qubool karein" (4:65), (isi mauqe par nazil hui).

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid that which I forbid you to do and do that which I command you to do to the best of your capacity. Verily the people before you went to their doom because they had put too many questions to their Prophets and then disagreed with their teachings.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jiske baare mein main tumhe mana karta hoon usse bacho aur jiska hukum tumhe deta hoon use apni poori kshamta ke saath karo. Yaqeenan, tumse pehle ke log is liye tabaah huye kyunki unhone apne Nabiyon se bahut zyada sawaal poochhe aur phir unki taalim ke saath asahmati jataayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters (and the words are) that he reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Abandon that which I have asked you to abandon, for the people before you went to their doom (for asking too many questions).
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki hai (aur alfaaz hain) ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jise maine tumhe chhodne ke liye kaha hai use chhod do, kyunki tumse pehle ke log (bahut zyada sawaal poochne ki wajah se) tabaah ho gaye.

e: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The greatest sinner amongst the Muslims is one who asked about a thing (from Allah's Apostle) which had not been forbidden for the Muslims and it was forbidden for them because of his persistently asking about it.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Musalmaanon mein sabse bada gunahgaar woh hai jisne (Allah ke Rasool se) us cheez ke baare mein poocha jo Musalmaanon ke liye mana nahi ki gayi thi aur ye unki lagataar us baare mein poochhte rehne ki wajah se unke liye mana kar di gayi.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amir b. Sa'd and the words are. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The greatest sinner of the Muslims amongst Muslims is one who asked about a certain thing which had not been prohibited and it was prohibited because of his asking about it.
hi: Ye hadees Amir bin Sa'd ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Musalmaanon mein sabse bada gunahgaar woh hai jisne ek muayyan cheez ke baare mein poocha jo mana nahi ki gayi thi aur ye uske poochhne ki wajah se mana kar di gayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and with this addition: " A person asked about a thing from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he indulged in hair-splitting."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek cheez ke baare mein poocha aur usne baal ki khaal nikaalne wale sawaalon mein masroof ho gaya."

e: Anas b. Malik reported that something was conveyed to him (the Holy prophet) about his Companions, so he addressed them and said: Paradise and Hell were presented to me and I have never seen the good and evil as (I did) today. And if you were to know you would have wept more and laughed less. He (the narrator) said: There was nothing more burdensome for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than this. They covered their heads and the sound of weeping was heard from them. Then there stood up 'Umar and he said: We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as our Apostle, and it was at that time that a person stood up and he said: Who is my father? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Your father is so and so; and there was revealed the verse:" O you who believe, do not ask about matters which, if they were to be made manifest to you (in terms of law), might cause to you harm" (v. 101).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) baare mein unke sahaba se kuch pahunchaaya gaya, is liye unhone unhe khitaab kiya aur kaha: Jannat aur Jahannam mujhe pesh kiye gaye aur maine kabhi bhaLai aur burai ko aisa nahi dekha jaisa aaj dekha. Aur agar tumhe pata hota, to tum zyada rote aur kam hanste. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye isse zyada bhaari kuch nahi tha. Unhone apne sar dhaake aur unse rone ki aawaaz suni gayi. Phir Umar khade hue aur unhone kaha: Hum Allah se apne Rab ke soorat mein, Islam se apne zindagi ke tareeke ke soorat mein aur Muhammad se apne Rasool ke soorat mein poori tarah khush hain, aur usi waqt ek shakhs khada hua aur usne kaha: Mera waalid kaun hai? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Tumhaara waalid falan-falan hai; aur ye aayat nazil hui: "Aye imaan waalo, aise maamlon ke baare mein mat poochho jo, agar tumhe (kaanoon ke soorat mein) pragat kiye jaayein, tumhe nuksaan pahunchaa sakte hain" (5:101).

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person said: Allah's Messenger, who is my father? And he said: Your father is so and so, and there was revealed this verse:" Do not ask about matters which, if they were to be made manifest to you, might cause you harm" (v. 101).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera waalid kaun hai? Aur unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid falan-falan hai, aur ye aayat nazil hui: "Aise maamlon ke baare mein mat poochho jo, agar tumhe pragat kiye jaayein, tumhe nuksaan pahunchaa sakte hain" (5:101).

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him stood when the sun had passed the meridian and he led them noon prayer and after observing salutations (completing the prayer) he stood upon the pulpit and talked about the Last Hour and made a mention of the important facts prior to it and then said: He who desires to ask anything from me let him ask me about it. By Allah, I shall not move from this place so long as I do not inform you about that which you ask. Anas b. Malik said: People began to shed tears profusely when they heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said it repeatedly: You ask me. Thereupon 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said repeatedly: Ask me, and (it was at this juncture that 'Umar knelt down and said): We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as the Messenger (of Allah). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept quiet so long as 'Umar spoke. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (The Doom) is near; by Him, in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, there was presented to me the Paradise and Hell in the nook of this enclosure, and I did not see good and evil like that of the present day. Ibn Shihab reported: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba told me that the mother of 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa told 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa: I have never heard of a son more disobedient than you. Do you feel yourself immune from the fact that your mother committed a sin which the women in the pre-Islamic period committed and then you disgrace her in the eyes of the people? 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa said: If my fatherhood were to be attributed to a black slave I would have connected myself with him.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue jab suraj darmiyan-akaash paar kar chuka tha aur unhone unhe zohar ki namaz padhaayi aur salaam poori karne ke baad (namaz poori karke) woh mimbar par khade hue aur aakhri ghaDi ke baare mein baat ki aur uske pehle ki mahatvapurna baaton ka zikr kiya aur phir kaha: Jo mujhse kuch bhi poochna chaahe use poochne do. Allah ki qasam, main is jagah se tab tak nahi hilunga jab tak main tumhe woh nahi bataa deta jo tum poochte ho. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye sunkar bahut roene lage aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse baar-baar kaha: Mujhse poochho. Isper Abdullah bin Hudhafa khade hue aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera waalid kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid Hudhafa hai, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne baar-baar kaha: Mujhse poochho, aur (isi mauqe par Umar ghutnon ke bal baithe aur kaha): Hum Allah se apne Rab ke soorat mein, Islam se apne zindagi ke tareeke ke soorat mein aur Muhammad se (Allah ke) Rasool ke soorat mein poori tarah khush hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khamosh rahe jab tak Umar bolte rahe. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: (Tabaahi) nazdeek hai; Us Hasti ki qasam, Jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, Jannat aur Jahannam mujhe is jagah ke ek kone mein pesh kiye gaye, aur maine kabhi aaj jaisi bhalai aur burai nahi dekhi. Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba ne mujhe bataya ki Abdullah bin Hudhafa ki maa ne Abdullah bin Hudhafa se kaha: Maine tumse zyada naafarman beta kabhi nahi suna. Kya tumhe khud ko is baat se mahfooz mehsoos hota hai ki tumhaari maa ne woh gunah kiya jo auraten Islam se pehle ke daur mein karti thin aur phir tum use logon ki nazron mein apmaanit karte ho? Abdullah bin Hudhafa ne kaha: Agar meri pitritva ek kaale ghulam ko diya jaata, to main khud ko usse jodta.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that the people asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) until he was hard pressed. He went out one day and he occupied the pulpit and said: Ask me and I shall leave no question of yours unanswered for you, and when the people heard about it they were overawed, as if (something tragic) was going to happen. Anas said: I began to look towards the right and the left and (found) that every person was weeping wrapping his head with the cloth. Then a person in the mosque broke the ice and they used to dispute with him by attributing his fatherhood to another man than his own father. He said: Allah's Apostle, who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa. Then 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) dared say something and said: We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as our Messenger, seeking refuge with Allah from the evil of Turmoil. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Never did I see the good and evil as today. Paradise and Hell were given a visible shape before me (in this worldly life) and I saw both of them near this well.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itna poochha ki woh dabaav mein aa gaye. Woh ek din bahar gaye aur mimbar par baithe aur kaha: Mujhse poochho aur main tumhare kisi bhi sawaal ko bina jawaab diye nahi chhodunga, aur jab logon ne ye suna woh dar gaye jaise kuch (dukhad) hone waala ho. Anas ne kaha: Main daaye aur baaye dekhne laga aur (paaya) ki har shakhs apna sar kapde se lapetkar ro raha tha. Phir masjid mein ek shakhs ne khaamoshi todi aur log unhe (unke asli waalid ke bajaaye) doosre aadmi ka pitritva batakar unse jhagda karte the. Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera waalid kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid Hudhafa hai. Phir Umar bin Khattab (Allah unse khush ho) ne kuch kehne ki himmat ki aur kaha: Hum Allah se apne Rab ke soorat mein, Islam se apne zindagi ke tareeke ke soorat mein aur Muhammad se apne Rasool ke soorat mein poori tarah khush hain, aashaanti ki burai se Allah ki panah maangte hue. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Maine kabhi bhalai aur burai ko aaj jaisa nahi dekha. Jannat aur Jahannam ko (is duniyaavi zindagi mein) mere saamne ek drishya soorat diya gaya aur maine unhe donon ko is kuen ke qareeb dekha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Qatada.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was asked such things which he disapproved and when they persisted on asking him he felt enraged and then said to the people: Ask me what you wish to ask. Thereupon a person said: Who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa. Then another person stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Salim, the freed slave of Shaiba. When 'Umar saw the signs of anger upon the face of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), he said: Allah's Messenger, we ask repentance from Allah. And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Kuraib (the words are):" Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Salim, the freed slave of Shaiba."
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aisi baaten poochhi gayin jinhe unhone napasand kiya aur jab unhone unse poochhna jaari rakha woh naaraaz ho gaye aur phir logon se kaha: Mujhse woh poochho jo tum poochhna chaahte ho. Isper ek shakhs ne kaha: Mera waalid kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid Hudhafa hai. Phir ek doosra shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera waalid kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid Salim hai, Shaiba ke aazad kiye hue ghulam. Jab Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dekhe, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum Allah se maafi maangte hain. Aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Allah ke Rasool, mera waalid kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhaara waalid Salim hai, Shaiba ke aazad kiye hue ghulam."

e: Musa b. Talha reported: I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by people near the date-palm trees. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What are these people doing? They said: They are grafting, i. e. they combine the male with the female (tree) and thus they yield more fruit. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I do not find it to be of any use. The people were informed about it and they abandoned this practice. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (was later) on informed (that the yield had dwindled), whereupon he said: If there is any use of it, then they should do it, for it was just a personal opinion of mine, and do not go after my personal opinion; but when I say to you anything on behalf of Allah, then do accept it, for I do not attribute lie to Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Musa bin Talha ne bayan kiya: Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khajoor ke darakhton ke qareeb logon se guzre. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye log kya kar rahe hain? Unhone kaha: Woh grafting kar rahe hain, yaani woh nar ko maada (darakht) ke saath jodte hain aur is tarah zyada phal dete hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe iska koi faayda nazar nahi aata. Logon ko iske baare mein bataya gaya aur unhone ye tareeka chhod diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko (baad mein) bataya gaya (ki paidaawaar kam ho gayi hai), isper unhone kaha: Agar ismein koi faayda hai, to unhe ye karna chahiye, kyunki ye sirf meri niji raay thi, aur meri niji raay ka anusaran mat karo; lekin jab main tumhe Allah ki taraf se kuch kahun, to use qubool karo, kyunki main Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, par jhoot ka ilzaam nahi lagaata.

e: Rafi' b. Khadij reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina and the people had been grafting the trees. He said: What are you doing? They said: We are grafting them, whereupon he said: It may perhaps be good for you if you do not do that, so they abandoned this practice (and the date-palms) began to yield less fruit. They made a mention of it (to the Holy Prophet), whereupon he said: I am a human being, so when I command you about a thing pertaining to religion, do accept it, and when I command you about a thing out of my personal opinion, keep it in mind that I am a human being. 'Ikrima reported that he said something like this.
hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye aur log darakhton ki grafting kar rahe the. Unhone kaha: Tum kya kar rahe ho? Unhone kaha: Hum inki grafting kar rahe hain, isper unhone kaha: Shaayad ye tumhare liye achha ho agar tum aisa na karo, is liye unhone ye tareeka chhod diya (aur khajoor ke darakhton ki) paidaawaar kam ho gayi. Unhone iska zikr kiya (Nabi-e-Paak se), isper unhone kaha: Main ek insaan hoon, is liye jab main tumhe deen se mutaliq kisi cheez ke baare mein hukum dun, use qubool karo, aur jab main tumhe apni niji raay se kisi cheez ke baare mein hukum dun, to yaad rakho ki main ek insaan hoon. Ikrima ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) isi jaisi baat kahi.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by the people who had been busy in grafting the trees. Thereupon he said: If you were not to do it, it might be good for you. (So they abandoned this practice) and there was a decline in the yield. He (the Holy Prophet) happened to pass by them (and said): What has gone wrong with your trees? They said: You said so and so. Thereupon he said: You have better knowledge (of a technical skill) in the affairs of the world.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke paas se guzre jo darakhton ki grafting mein masroof the. Isper unhone kaha: Agar tum ye na karo, to shaayad ye tumhare liye achha ho. (Is liye unhone ye tareeka chhod diya) aur paidaawaar mein kami aayi. Woh unke paas se guzre (aur kaha): Tumhare darakhton ko kya hua? Unhone kaha: Aapne aisa aisa kaha tha. Isper unhone kaha: Duniyaavi maamlon mein (ek takniki mahaarat ka) tumhe zyada behtar ilm hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported so many 'ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one among them was that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, a day would come to you when you would not be able to see me, and the glimpse of my face would be dearer to one than one's own family, one's property and in fact everything. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ishaq with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, ek din tumhare paas aayega jab tum mujhe dekh nahi paaoge, aur mere chehre ki jhalak kisi ke liye uske apne khaandaan, uski maal aur waastav mein har cheez se zyada aziz hogi. Ye hadees Ishaq ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I am most akin to the son of Mary among the whole of mankind and the Prophets are of different mothers, but of one religion, and no Prophet was raised between me and him (Jesus Christ).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main poori manavata mein Mary ke bete ke sabse qareeb hoon aur Nabi log alag-alag maaon ke hain, lekin ek hi deen ke, aur mere aur unke (Isa Masih ke) beech koi Nabi nahi bheja gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I am most akin to Jesus Christ among the whole of mankind, and all the Prophets are of different mothers but belong to one religion and no Prophet was raised between me and Jesus.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main poori manavata mein Isa Masih ke sabse qareeb hoon, aur sab Nabi alag-alag maaon ke hain lekin ek hi deen se mutaliq hain aur mere aur Isa ke beech koi Nabi nahi bheja gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am most close to Jesus, son of Mary, among the whole of mankind in this worldly life and the next life. They said: Allah's Messenger how is it? Thereupon he said: Prophets are brothers in faith, having different mothers. Their religion is, however, one and there is no Apostle between us (between I and Jesus Christ).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin aur ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main is duniyaavi zindagi aur agli zindagi mein poori manavata mein Isa, Mary ke bete, ke sabse qareeb hoon. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise hai? Isper unhone kaha: Nabi imaan mein bhai hain, jinki maaen alag-alag hain. Unka deen, halaanki, ek hi hai aur humare (mere aur Isa Masih ke) beech koi Rasool nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No child is born but he is pricked by the satan and he begins to weep because of the pricking of the satan except the son of Mary and his mother. Abu Huraira then said: You may recite if you so like (the verse):" I seek Thy protection for her and her offspring against satan the accursed" (iii. 36).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin use Shaitaan chubhota hai aur woh Shaitaan ke chubhne ki wajah se rone lagta hai siwaay Mary ke bete aur uski maa ke. Abu Huraira ne phir kaha: Tum chaaho to ye aayat padh sakte ho: "Main Teri panah maangti hoon uske aur uski aulaad ke liye laanat-yukt Shaitaan se" (3:36).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " The newborn child is touched by the satan (when he comes in the world) and he starts crying because of the touch of satan." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'aib there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "naye paida hue bachche ko Shaitaan chhuta hai (jab woh duniya mein aata hai) aur Shaitaan ke chhune ki wajah se woh rone lagta hai." Shu'aib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The satan touches every son of Adam on the day when his mother gives birth to him with the exception of Mary and her son.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Shaitaan Aadam ke har bete ko us din chhuta hai jab uski maa use paidaish deti hai siwaay Mary aur uske bete ke.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The crying of the child (starts) when the satan begins to prick him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bachche ka rona (shuru hota hai) jab Shaitaan use chubhna shuru karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported ahadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and one of them was) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said Jesus son of Mary saw a person committing theft; thereupon Jesus said to him: You committed theft. He said: Nay. By Him besides Whom there is no god (I have not committed theft). Thereupon Jesus said: I affirm my faith in Allah It is my ownself that deceived me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hadeesein riwayat kin (aur unmein se ek ye thi) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Isa, Mary ke bete, ne ek shakhs ko chori karte dekha; isper Isa ne usse kaha: Tumne chori ki. Usne kaha: Nahi, Us Hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai (maine chori nahi ki). Isper Isa ne kaha: Main Allah par apna imaan pushT karta hoon. Ye mera hi khud tha jisne mujhe dhoka diya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: O, the best of creation; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He is Ibrahim (peace be upon him).
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Aye, srijan mein sabse behtareen; isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh (srijan mein sabse behtareen) Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas ne isi jaisi ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said that Ibrahim (as) circumcised himself with the help of an adze when he was eighty years old.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) ne apna khatna khud kiya ek kulhaadi jaisi taraashne wali cheez ki madad se jab woh assi saal ke the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: We have more claim to doubt than Ibrahim (peace be upon him) when he said, My Lord, show me how thou wilt quicken the dead. He said: Believeth thou not? He said: Yes, but that my heart rest at ease (the Holy Qur'an. 260). May Lord have mercy on Lot that he wanted a strong support and had I stayed in the prison as long as Yusuf stayed I would have responded to him who invited me.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Humein shak karne ka haq Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) se zyada hai jab unhone kaha, mere Rab, mujhe dikha kaise Tu murda ko zinda karega. Usne kaha: Kya tumhe imaan nahi hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, lekin is liye ki mera dil sthir ho (Quran, 2:260). Mere Rab ki rehmat Lot par ho ki unhone ek mazboot sahaara chaaha, aur agar main jail mein utni der rehta jitni Yusuf rahe, to main us shakhs ko jawaab deta jisne mujhe bulaaya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) never told a lie but only thrice: two times for the sake of Allah (for example, his words): "I am sick," and his words: "But it was the big one amongst them which has done that" and because of Sara (his wife). He had come in a land inhabited by haughty and cruel men along with Sara. She was very good-looking amongst the people, so he said to her: If these people were to know that you are my wife they would snatch you away from me, so if they ask you tell them that you are my sister and in fact you are my sister in Islam, and I do not know of any other Muslim in this land besides I and you. And when they entered that land the tyrants came to see her and said to him (the king): 'There comes to your land a woman, whom you alone deserve to possess', so he (the king) sent someone (towards her) and she was brought to him, and Ibrahim (peace be upon him) stood in prayer. When she visited him (the tyrant king came) he could help but stretch his hand towards her and his hand was tied up. He said: 'Supplicate to Allah so that He may release my hand and I will do no harm to you.' She did that and the man repeated (the same highhandedness) and his hand was again tied up more tightly than on the first occasion. He said the same thing to her again, and she again did that (supplicated), but he repeated (the same highhandedness and his hands were tied up more tightly than on the previous occasion). He then again said: 'Supplicate your Lord so that He may set my hand free; by Allah I shall do no harm to you.' She did and his hand was freed. Then he called the person who had brought her and said to him: 'You have brought to me the satan and you have not brought to me a human being, so turn them out from my land,' and he gave Hajar as a gift to her. She returned (along with Hajar) and when Ibrahim (peace be upon him) saw her, he said: 'How have you returned?' She said: 'With full safety (have I returned). Allah held the hand of that debauch and he gave me a maid-servant.' Abu Huraira said: 'O sons of the rain of the sky, she is your mother.'
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Nabi Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) ne kabhi jhoot nahi bola siwaay teen baar: do baar Allah ki khaatir (jaise unke alfaaz): "Main bimaar hoon," aur unke alfaaz: "Lekin ye unmein se badhiya waale ne kiya" aur Sara ki wajah se (unki zauja). Woh ghamandi aur zaalim logon ki basaayi zameen mein Sara ke saath aaye. Woh logon mein bahut khoobsurat thin, is liye unhone (Ibrahim ne) unse kaha: Agar in logon ko pata chala ki tum meri zauja ho, woh tumhe mujhse cheen lenge, is liye agar woh tumse poochhein to unhe batana ki tum meri behn ho aur waastav mein tum Islam mein meri behn ho, aur mujhe is zameen mein apne aur tumhare siwaay koi doosra Musalman pata nahi hai. Aur jab woh us zameen mein daakhil hue zaalim log unhe dekhne aaye aur unse (raja se) kaha: 'Tumhare zameen mein ek aurat aayi hai jiski maalki paane ka haq sirf tumhe hai,' is liye usne (raja ne) kisi ko (unki taraf) bheja aur woh unke paas laayi gayin, aur Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) namaz mein khade the. Jab woh (raja) unse mila, woh apna haath unki taraf badhaaye bina nahi rah paaya aur uska haath baandh diya gaya. Usne kaha: 'Allah se dua karo ki Woh mera haath azaad kar de aur main tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga.' Unhone (Sara ne) aisa kiya aur usne (raja ne) dobara (wahi ziddapan) dohraaya aur uska haath dobara pehle se zyada mazboot baandh diya gaya. Usne unse phir wahi kaha, aur unhone phir aisa kiya (dua ki), lekin usne dohraaya (wahi ziddapan aur uske haath pehle se zyada mazboot baandh diye gaye). Phir usne kaha: 'Apne Rab se dua karo ki Woh mera haath azaad kare; Allah ki qasam, main tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaunga.' Unhone aisa kiya aur uska haath azaad ho gaya. Phir usne us shakhs ko bulaaya jo unhe laaya tha aur usse kaha: 'Tum mere paas Shaitaan lekar aaye ho, tum mere paas koi insaan nahi laaye, is liye unhe meri zameen se nikaal do,' aur usne unhe Hajar tohfe mein di. Woh (Hajar ke saath) wapas aayin aur jab Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) ne unhe dekha, unhone kaha: 'Tum kaise wapas aayin?' Unhone kaha: 'Poori hifaazat ke saath (main wapas aayi hoon). Allah ne us badkaar ka haath pakda aur usne mujhe ek naukaraani di.' Abu Huraira ne kaha: 'Aye aasmaan ki baarish ke beto, woh tumhaari maa hain.'

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported that Abu Huraira reported many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one, of them speaks that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: Banu Isra'il used to take bath (together) naked and thus saw private parts of one another, but Moses (peace be upon him) used to take bath alone (in privacy), and they said: By Allah, nothing prevents Moses to take bath along with us; but scrotal hernia. One day when he (Moses) was taking bath (alone) he placed his clothes upon a stone, but the stone began to move along with his clothes. Moses raced after it saying: My garment, stone; until (some of the people) of Banu Isra'il looked at the private parts of Moses, and they said: By Allah, there is no trouble with Moses. The stone stopped after he (Moses) had been seen. He took hold of his garments and struck the stone. Abu Huraira said: I swear by Allah that there were six or seven scars on the stone because of the striking of stone by Moses (peace be upon him).
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya ki Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye kehti hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Banu Isra'il nange hokar (saath) nahaya karte the aur is tarah ek-doosre ke gupt ang dekhte the, lekin Musa (unpar shaanti ho) akele (nijta mein) nahate the, aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, kuch bhi Musa ko humare saath nahane se nahi rokta siwaay iske ki unhe hernia hai. Ek din jab woh (Musa akele) nahaa rahe the unhone apne kapde ek patthar par rakhe, lekin patthar unke kapdon ke saath chalne laga. Musa uska picha karne daude ye kehte hue: Mera kapda, patthar; yahan tak ki Banu Isra'il ke (kuch logon) ne Musa ke gupt ang dekh liye, aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Musa mein koi problem nahi hai. Patthar tab ruka jab unhe (Musa ko) dekh liya gaya. Unhone apne kapde pakde aur patthar ko maara. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki patthar par chhe ya saat nishaan the Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ke zariye patthar ko maarne ki wajah se.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Moses was a modest person. He was never seen naked and Banu Isra'iI said: (He was afraid to expose his private part) because he had been suffering from scrotal hernia. He (one day) took bath in water and placed his garments upon a stone. The stone began to move on quickly. He followed that and struck it with the help of a stone (saying): O stone, my garment; O stone, my garments, O stone; until it stopped near the big gathering of Isrii'll, and this verse was revealed (pertaining to the incident):" O you who believe, be not Iike those who maligned Moses, but Allah cleared him of what they said, and he was worthy of regard with Allah" (xxxiii. 69).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Musa ek sharmeele shakhs the. Woh kabhi nange nahi dekhe gaye aur Banu Isra'il ne kaha: (Woh apna gupt ang dikhaane se Darte the) kyunki unhe hernia thi. Woh (ek din) paani mein nahaaye aur apne kapde ek patthar par rakhe. Patthar tez chalne laga. Unhone uska picha kiya aur ek doosre patthar se use maara (ye kehte hue): Aye patthar, mera kapda; Aye patthar, mera kapda, Aye patthar; yahan tak ki ye Isra'ilon ke bade jamavaad ke qareeb ruka, aur ye aayat is ghatna se mutaliq nazil hui: "Aye imaan waalo, un logon jaise mat bano jinhone Musa par jhoota ilzaam lagaaya, lekin Allah ne unhe uske ilzam se saaf kiya jo unhone kaha, aur woh Allah ki nazar mein samman ke laayak the" (33:69).

e: Abu Huraira reported that the Angel of Death was sent to Moses (peace be upon him) to inform of his Lord's summons. When he came, he (Moses) boxed him and his eye was knocked out. He (the Angel of Death) came back to the Lord and said: You sent me to a servant. who did not want to die. Allah restored his eye to its proper place (and revived his eyesight), and then said: Go back to him and tell him that if he wants life he must place his hand on the back of an ox, and he would be granted as many years of life as the number of hair covered by his hand. He (Moses) said: My Lord what would happen then He said: Then you must court death. He said: Let it be now. And he supplicated Allah to bring him close to the sacred land. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If I were there, I would have shown you his grave beside the road at the red mound.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Maut ke Farishte ko Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ke paas unke Rab ke bulaave ki khabar dene bheja gaya. Jab woh aaye, unhone (Musa ne) unhe thappad maara aur unki aankh nikal gayi. Woh (Maut ke Farishte) Rab ke paas wapas gaye aur kaha: Tune mujhe ek banda ke paas bheja jo marna nahi chaahta. Allah ne unki aankh apni sahi jagah par wapas rakh di (aur unki nazar wapas de di), aur phir kaha: Wapas unke paas jao aur unse kaho ki agar woh zindagi chaahte hain, to unhe apna haath ek bail ki peeth par rakhna hoga, aur unhe utne saal ki zindagi milegi jitne baal unka haath dhaakega. Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Mere Rab, phir kya hoga? Unhone kaha: Phir tumhe maut ko qubool karna hoga. Unhone kaha: Ise ab hi hone do. Aur unhone Allah se dua ki ki Woh unhe muqaddas zameen ke qareeb le jaaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main wahan hota, to main tumhe unki qabar dikhaata jo raaste ke bagal mein laal Tille ke paas hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said that the Angel of Death came to Moses and said: Respond (to the call) of Allah (i. e. be prepared for death). Moses (peace be upon him) gave a blow at the eye of the Angel of Death and knocked it out. The Angel went back to Allah (the Exalted) and said: You sent me to your servant who does not like to die and he knocked out my eye. Allah restored his eye to its proper place (and revived his eyesight) and said: Go to My servant and say: Do you want life? And in case you want life, keep your hand on the body of the ox and you would live such number of years as the (number of) hair your hand covers. He (Moses) said: What, then? He said: Then you would die, whereupon he (Moses) said: Then why not now? (He then prayed): Allah, cause me to die close to the sacred land. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had I been near that place I would have shown his grave by the side of the path at the red mound.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki Maut ke Farishte Musa ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ki (pukaar ka) jawaab do (yaani maut ke liye taiyaar raho). Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ne Maut ke Farishte ki aankh par thappad maara aur use nikaal diya. Farishta Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ke paas wapas gaya aur kaha: Tune mujhe apne banda ke paas bheja jo marna pasand nahi karta aur usne meri aankh nikaal di. Allah ne unki aankh apni sahi jagah par wapas rakh di (aur unki nazar wapas de di) aur kaha: Mere banda ke paas jao aur kaho: Kya tum zindagi chaahte ho? Aur agar tum zindagi chaahte ho, to apna haath bail ke badan par rakho aur tumhe utne saal jeeoge jitne baal tumhaara haath dhaakega. Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Phir kya? Unhone kaha: Phir tum maroge, isper unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Phir abhi kyun nahi? (Phir unhone dua ki): Allah, mujhe muqaddas zameen ke qareeb marne de. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main us jagah ke qareeb hota, to main tumhe unki qabar raaste ke bagal mein laal Tille ke paas dikhaata.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar.
hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: While a Jew was selling goods, he was given something which he did not accept or he did not agree (to accept) that 'Abdul 'Azlz (one of the narrators) is doubtful about it. He (the Jew) said: By Allah, Who chose Moses (peace be upon him) among mankind. A person from the Ansar heard it and gave a blow at his face saying: (You have the audacity) to say: By Him Who chose Moses amongst mankind, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is living amongst us. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Abu'l-Qasim, I am a Dhimmi and (thus need your protection) by a covenant, and added: Such and such person has given a blow upon my face. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why did you give a blow on his face? He said: Allah's Messenger, this man said: By Him Who chose Moses (peace be upon him) amongst mankind, whereas you are living amongst us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became angry and signs of anger could be seen on his face, and then said: Don't make distinction amongst the Prophets of Allah. When the horn will be blown and whatever is in the heavens and the earth would swoon but he whom Allah grants exception, then another horn will be blown and I would be the first amongst those who would recover and Moses (peace be upon him) would be catching hold of the Throne and I do not know whether it is a compensation for that when he swooned on the Day of Tur or he would be resurrected before me and I do not say that anyone is more excellent than Yunus son of Matta (peace he upon him).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Jab ek Yahudi maal bech raha tha, use kuch diya gaya jo usne qubool nahi kiya ya usne (qubool karne se) inkaar kiya (Abd al-Aziz, raawiyon mein se ek, iske baare mein shak mein hain). Usne (Yahudi ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, Jisne Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ko manavata mein chuna. Ansar ka ek shakhs ye sunkar uske chehre par thappad maara ye kehte hue: (Tum himmat kaise kar sakte ho) ye kehne ki: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne Musa ko manavata mein chuna, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare beech jeevit hain. Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, main ek Dhimmi hoon aur (is liye mujhe aapki hifaazat chahiye) ek ehad ke tehat, aur izafa kiya: Falan-falan shakhs ne mere chehre par thappad maara. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumne uske chehre par thappad kyun maara? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, is aadmi ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ko manavata mein chuna, jabki aap humare beech jeevit hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) naaraaz ho gaye aur unke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dikhne lage, aur phir kaha: Allah ke Rasoolon ke beech antar mat karo. Jab singhaa (trumpet) bajega aur jo kuch aasmaan aur zameen mein hai woh murchhit ho jaayenge siwaay us shakhs ke jise Allah chhoot deta hai, phir doosra singhaa bajega aur main sabse pehla hunga jo hosh mein aayega, aur Musa (unpar shaanti ho) Singhaasan pakde honge aur mujhe nahi pata ki kya ye uske liye ek muaaviza hai jab woh Tur ke din behosh hue the ya woh mujhse pehle uThAye jaayenge, aur main ye nahi kehta ki koi bhi Yunus, Matta ke bete (unpar shaanti ho) se zyada behtareen hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Salama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that two persons, one from amongst the Jews and the other from amongst the Muslims, fell into dispute and began to abuse one another. The Muslim said: By Him Who chose Muhammad (ﷺ) in the worlds. And the Jew said: By Him Who chose Moses in the worlds. Thereupon the Muslim lifted his hand and slapped at the face of the Jew. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about his affair and the affair of the Muslim. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't make me superior to Moses for mankind will swoon and I would be the first to recover from it and Moses would be at that time seizing the side of the Throne and I do not know (whether) he would swoon and would recover before me or Allah would make an exception for him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki do log, ek Yahudiyon mein se aur doosra Musalmaanon mein se, aapas mein jhagad pade aur ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage. Musalman ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jisne Muhammad (SAW) ko duniyaon mein chuna. Aur Yahudi ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jisne Musa ko duniyaon mein chuna. Isper Musalman ne apna haath uThAya aur Yahudi ke chehre par thappad maara. Yahudi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhe apna aur Musalman ka maamla bataya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe Musa se uchcha mat banaao, kyunki manavata murchhit ho jaayegi aur main sabse pehla hunga jo isse hosh mein aayega, aur Musa us waqt Singhaasan ka kinaara pakde honge aur mujhe nahi pata (ki kya) woh murchhit honge aur mujhse pehle hosh mein aayenge ya Allah unke liye apwaad banaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person from amongst the Muslims and a person from amongst the Jews fell into dispute and reviled each other. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalmaanon mein se ek shakhs aur Yahudiyon mein se ek shakhs aapas mein jhagad pade aur ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kaha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a Jew who had received a blow at his face came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same, up to the hand (where the words are): That he (the Holy Prophet) said: I do not know whether he would be one who would fall into swoon and would recover before me or he would be compensated for his swooning at Tur (and thus he would not swoon on this occasion) of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi jise chehre par thappad laga tha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, haath tak (jahan alfaaz hain): Ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki woh us kism ka hoga jo murchhit hoga aur mujhse pehle hosh mein aayega ya use Tur mein apni murchha ka muaaviza mil chuka hoga (aur is tarah woh Qayamat ke is avasar par murchhit nahi hoga).

e: Abu Sa'id Kudari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having, said this: Don't make distinction amongst the Apostles. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Rasoolon mein antar mat karo. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I came. And in the narration transmitted on the authority of Haddib (the words are): I happened to pass by Moses on the occasion of the Night journey near the red mound (and found him) saying his prayer in his grave.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main aaya. Aur Haddib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Main Mi'raj ki raat laal Tille ke qareeb Musa ke paas se guzra (aur unhe) apni qabar mein namaz padhte paaya.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I happened to pass by Moses as he was busy in saying prayer in his grave, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa there is an addition of these words:, I happened to pass on the occasion of the Night journey."
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Musa ke paas se guzra jab woh apni qabar mein namaz padhne mein masroof the, aur Isa ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Main Mi'raj ki raat guzra."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may prace be upon him) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: It is not meet for a servant of Mine that he should say: I am better than Yunus b. Matta (peace be upon him).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Mahaan, ne kaha: Mere kisi banda ke liye munasib nahi hai ki woh kahe: Main Yunus, Matta ke bete (unpar shaanti ho), se behtar hoon.

e: Abu al-Aliya said: The son of the uncle of your Prophet (ﷺ), i. e. Ibn Abbas, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not meet for a servant that he should say: I am better than Yunus b. Matta (and this Matta) is the name of his father.
hi: Abu al-Aliya ne kaha: Tumhare Nabi ke chachere bhai, yaani Ibn Abbas, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Kisi banda ke liye munasib nahi hai ki woh kahe: Main Yunus bin Matta se behtar hoon (aur ye Matta unke waalid ka naam hai).

e: Abu Huraira reported: It was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as to who was the most worthy of respect amongst people. He said: The most God-conscious amongst you They said: It is not this that we are asking about, whereupon he said: Then he is Yusuf, the Apostle of Aliah and the son of Allah's Apostle, Ya'qub, who was also the son of Allah's Apostle, the friend of Allah (Ibrahim) They said: This is not what we are asking you. He said: You mean the tribes of Arabia? Those who are good in pre-Islamic days are good in Islam (after embracing Islam) when they get an understanding of it.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki logon mein sabse zyada samman ke laayak kaun hai. Unhone kaha: Tum mein Allah se sabse zyada Darne wala. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Ye woh nahi hai jo hum poochh rahe hain, isper unhone kaha: Phir woh Yusuf hain, Allah ke Rasool, aur Allah ke Rasool Ya'qub ke bete, jo khud bhi Allah ke Rasool, Allah ke dost (Ibrahim), ke bete the. Unhone kaha: Ye woh nahi hai jo hum aapse poochh rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Tumhaara matlab Arabia ke qabile hain? Jo Jaahiliyat ke daur mein achhe the woh Islam mein bhi achhe hain (Islam qubool karne ke baad) jab unhe iski samajh hoti hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Zakariyya (peace be upon him) was a carpenter.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Zakariyya (unpar shaanti ho) ek lakDi ka kaam karne wale (badhai) the.

e:
Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I said to Ibn Abbas that Nauf al-Bikali was of the opinion that Moses (peace be upon him), the Apostle of Bani Isra'il, was not the same who accompanied Khadir, whereupon he said: The enemy of Allah tells a lie. I heard Ubayy b. Ka'b say: Moses (peace be upon him) stood up to give sermon to the people of Isra'il. He was asked as to who amongst the people has the best knowledge, whereupon he said: I have the best knowledge. Thereupon Allah was annoyed with him that he did not attribute (the best knowledge) to Him.
