He revealed to him: A servant amongst My servants is at the junction of two rivers who has more knowledge than yours. Moses said: How can I meet him? It was said to him: Carry a fish in the large basket and the place where you find it missing there you will find him. Thereupon Moses proceeded forth along with a young man (Yusha'). Joshua b. Nun and Moses (peace be upon him) put the fish in the basket and there went along with him the young man (Yusha') until they came to a certain rock and Moses and his companion went to sleep and the fish stirred in that basket and fell into the ocean and Allah stopped the current of water like a vault until the way was made for the fish. Moses and his young companion were astonished and they walked for the rest of the day and the night and the friend of Moses forgot to inform him of this incident. When it was morning, Moses (peace be upon him) said to the young man: Bring for us the breakfast for we are dead tired because of this journey, and they did not feel exhausted until they had passed that place where they had been commanded (to stay). He said: Don't you know that when we reached the Sakhra (rock) I forgot the fish and nothing made me forget it but Satan that I could not remember it? How strange is it that the fish found a way in the river? Moses said: That was what we had been aiming at. Then both of them retraced their steps until they reached Sakhra; there they saw a man covered with a cloth. Moses greeted him. Khadir said to him: Where is as-Salam in our country.? He said: I am Moses, whereupon he (Khadir) said: You mean the Moses of Bani Isra'il? He said: Yes. He (Khadir) said: You have a knowledge out of the knowledge of Allah which in fact Allah imparted to you and about that I know nothing and I have knowledge out of Allah's knowledge which He imparted to me and about that you do not know. Moses (peace be upon him) said to him: May I follow you so that you may teach me that with which you have been taught righteousness. He said: You will not be able to bear with me; how you will be able to bear that about which you do not know? Moses said: Thou wilt find me patient, nor shalt I disobey you in aught. Khadir said to him: If you were to follow me, then do not ask me about anything until I myself speak to you about it. He said: Yes. So Khadir and Moses set forth on the bank of the river that there came before them a boat. Both of them talked to them (the owners of the boat) so that they might carry both of them. 
They had recognised Khadir and they carried them free. Khadir thereupon took hold of a plank in the boat and broke it away. Moses said: These people have carried us without any charge and you attempt to break their boat so that the people sailing in the boat may drown. This is (something) grievous that you have done. He said: Did I not say that you would not bear with me? He said: Blame me not for what I forgot and be not hard upon what I did. Then both of them got down from the boat and began to walk along the coastline that they saw a boy who had been playing with other boys. Khadir pulled up his head and killed him. Moses said: Have you killed an innocent person who is in no way guilty of slaying another? You have done something horrible. Thereupon he said: Did I not say to you that you will not be able to bear with me? He (Moses) said: This (act) is more grievous than the first one. He (Moses) further said. If I ask you about anything after this, keep not company with me, then you would no doubt find (a plausible) excuse for this. Then they both walked on until they reached the inhabitants of a village. They asked its inhabitants for food but they refused to entertain them as their guests. They found in it a wall which had been bent on one side and was about to fall. Khadir set it right with his own hand. Moses, said to him: It is the people to whom we came but they showed us no hospitality and they did not serve us food. If you wish you can get wages for it. He (Khadir) said: This is the parting of ways between me and you. Now I wish to reveal to you the significance of that for which you could not bear with me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. May Allah have mercy upon Moses! I wish if Moses could show patience and a (fuller) story of both of them could have been told. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that the first thing which Moses said was out of forgetfulness. Then there came a sparrow until it perched on the wall of the boat and took water from the ocean. Thereupon, Khadir said: My knowledge and your knowledge in comparison with the knowledge of Allah is even less than the water taken by the sparrow in its beak in comparison to the water of the ocean, and Sa'id b. Jubair used to recite (verses 79 and 80 of Sura Kahf) in this way: There was before them a king who used to seize every boat by force which was in order, the boy was an unbeliever.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas se kaha ki Nauf al-Bikali ki raay thi ki Musa (unpar shaanti ho), Banu Isra'il ke Rasool, woh nahi the jo Khadir ke saath gaye the, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke dushman ne jhoot bola hai. Maine Ubayy bin Ka'b ko ye kehte suna: Musa (unpar shaanti ho) Isra'il ke logon ko khutba dene khade hue. Unse poocha gaya ki logon mein sabse achha ilm kise hai, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe sabse achha ilm hai. Isper Allah unse naaraaz hue ki unhone (sabse achha ilm) Usse jodkar nahi bataaya. Usne unpar wahi ki: Mere bandon mein se ek banda do nadiyon ke sangam par hai jise tumse zyada ilm hai. Musa ne kaha: Main unse kaise mil sakta hoon? Unse kaha gaya: Ek badi tokri mein machhli le jaao aur jahan tumhe woh gum milega wahin tumhe woh milenge. Isper Musa ek jawaan shakhs (Yusha) ke saath aage badhe. Yusha bin Nun aur Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ne machhli tokri mein rakhi aur jawaan shakhs (Yusha) unke saath gaya yahan tak ki woh ek chattaan tak pahunche aur Musa aur unke saathi so gaye aur machhli tokri mein hili aur samundar mein gir gayi aur Allah ne paani ki dhaara ko ek gumbad jaisa rok diya yahan tak ki machhli ke liye raasta bana. Musa aur unka jawaan saathi hairat mein pad gaye aur woh baaki din aur raat chalte rahe aur Musa ke dost ne unhe is ghatna ki khabar dena bhool gaye. Jab subah hui, Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ne jawaan shakhs se kaha: Humare liye naashta lao kyunki hum is safar ki wajah se bahut thak gaye hain, aur woh tab tak nahi thake jab tak woh us jagah se aage nahi nikal gaye jahan unhe (rukne ka) hukum tha. Unhone kaha: Kya aapko nahi pata ki jab hum Sakhra (chattaan) tak pahunche maine machhli bhula di aur mujhe kuch nahi bhulaaya siwaay Shaitaan ke ki main use yaad na rakh sakoon? Kitna ajeeb hai ki machhli ne nadi mein raasta paa liya? Musa ne kaha: Yehi hai jo hum dhoondh rahe the. Phir donon apne kadam wapas gaye yahan tak ki woh Sakhra pahunche; wahan unhone ek shakhs dekha jo kapde mein lipta hua tha. Musa ne unhe salaam kiya. Khadir ne unse kaha: Yahan as-Salam kahan hai? Unhone kaha: Main Musa hoon, isper unhone (Khadir ne) kaha: Kya tum Banu Isra'il ke Musa ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Khadir ne) kaha: Tumhe Allah ke ilm mein se ilm hai jo Allah ne tumhe diya hai aur uske baare mein mujhe kuch nahi pata, aur mujhe Allah ke ilm mein se ilm hai jo Usne mujhe diya hai jiske baare mein tumhe kuch nahi pata. Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ne unse kaha: Kya main aapka anusaran karun taaki aap mujhe woh sikha sakein jo aapko sikhaaya gaya hai nekokaari ke baare mein? Unhone kaha: Tum mere saath sabar nahi rakh paaoge; jab tumhe uska ilm nahi hai to tum kaise sabar rakh paaoge? Musa ne kaha: Tum mujhe sabar karta paaoge, aur main kisi bhi baat mein tumhaari naafarmani nahi karunga. Khadir ne unse kaha: Agar tum mera anusaran karte ho, to jab tak main khud tumhe iske baare mein na bataaun mujhse kuch mat poochho. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. To Khadir aur Musa nadi ke kinare aage badhe ki unke saamne ek naav aayi. Donon ne unse (naav ke maalikon se) baat ki taaki woh unhe le jaayein. Unhone Khadir ko pehchaana aur unhe bina kisi keemat ke le gaye. Khadir ne phir naav mein ek takhta pakda aur use toDkar alag kiya. Musa ne kaha: In logon ne humein bina koi keemat liye le jaaya aur tum unki naav todne ki koshish karte ho taaki naav mein sawaar log Doob jaayein. Ye ek gambheer kaam hai jo tumne kiya. Unhone kaha: Kya maine nahi kaha tha ki tum mere saath sabar nahi rakh paaoge? Unhone kaha: Mujhe us baat ke liye dosh mat do jo main bhoola aur mujhse jo maine kiya uske liye sakhti mat dikhaao. Phir donon naav se utre aur samudri kinare par chalne lage ki unhone ek larka dekha jo doosre larkon ke saath khel raha tha. Khadir ne uska sar pakDa aur use qatal kar diya. Musa ne kaha: Kya tumne ek nirdosh shakhs ko qatal kar diya jo kisi doosre ko qatal karne ka dosi nahi tha? Tumne kuch bhayaanak kiya hai. Isper unhone kaha: Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ki tum mere saath sabar nahi rakh paaoge? Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Ye (kaam) pehle wale se zyada sangin hai. Unhone (Musa ne) aage kaha: Agar iske baad main tumse kuch poochhun, to mere saath saathi mat bano, phir tumhe (mujhe chhodne ka) munasib bahaana mil jaayega. Phir donon chalte rahe yahan tak ki woh ek gaon ke bashindon tak pahunche. Unhone gaon ke bashindon se khaana maanga lekin unhone unhe mehmaan ke soorat mein manzoor nahi kiya. Unhone usmein ek deewar paayi jo ek taraf jhuki hui thi aur girne hi waali thi. Khadir ne apne haath se ise theek kar diya. Musa ne unse kaha: Ye woh log hain jinke paas hum aaye lekin unhone humein koi mehmaannawaazi nahi di aur humein khaana nahi diya. Agar tum chaaho to iske liye mazdoori le sakte ho. Isper unhone (Khadir ne) kaha: Ye mere aur tumhaare beech raaston ka alagav hai. Ab main tumhe us cheez ka matlab bataana chaahta hoon jiske liye tum mere saath sabar nahi rakh paaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah Musa par rehmat kare! Kaash Musa sabar dikha paate aur unke dono ki (poori) kahani sunaayi jaa sakti. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha ki pehli baat jo Musa ne kahi thi woh bhool ki wajah se thi. Phir ek chidiya aayi yahan tak ki woh naav ki deewar par baithi aur samundar se paani liya. Isper Khadir ne kaha: Mera aur tumhaara ilm Allah ke ilm ke muqable us paani se bhi kam hai jo chidiya apni chonch mein samundar ke paani ke muqable leti hai, aur Sa'id bin Jubair Sura Kahf ki (aayat 79 aur 80) is tarah padhte the: Unke aage ek raja tha jo har naav zabardasti pakad leta tha jo achhi haalat mein hoti, aur larka ek gair-imaandaar tha.

e: Sa, id b. jubair reported that it was said to Ibn 'Abbas that Nauf al-Bikali was of the opinion that Moses who went in search of knowledge was not the Moses of Bani Isra'il. He said: Sa'id, did you hear it from him? I said: Yes. Thereupon he said that Nauf had not stated the fact.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Abbas se kaha gaya ki Nauf al-Bikali ki raay thi ki jo Musa ilm ki talaash mein gaye woh Banu Isra'il ke Musa nahi the. Unhone kaha: Sa'id, kya tumne ye unse suna? Maine kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha ki Nauf ne sach nahi kaha.

e:
Ubayy b. Ka'b narrated to us that he had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Moses had been delivering sermons to his people. And he made this remark: No person upon the earth has better knowledge than I or nothing better than mine. Thereupon Allah revealed to him: I know one who is better than you (in knowledge) or there is a person on the earth having more knowledge than you. Thereupon he said: My Lord, direct me to him. It was said to him: Keep a salted fish as a provision for journey. The place where that fish would be lost (there you will find that man). So he set forth and a young slave along with him until they came to a place Sakhra. but he did not find any clue. So he proceeded on and left that young man there. The fish began to stir in water and the water assumed the form of an ark over the fish. The young man said: I should meet Allah's Apostle (peace be upon him) and inform him, but he was made to forget and when they had gone beyond that place, he (Moses) said to the young man: Bring breakfast. We have been exhausted because of the journey, and he (Moses) was not exhausted until he had crossed that (particular) place (where he had) to meet Khadir, and the youth was reminded and said: Did you not see that as we reached Sakhra I forgot the fish and it is satan alone who has made me forgetful of it'? It is strange that he has been able to find way in the ocean too. He said: This is what we sought for us. 
They returned retracing their steps, and he (his companion) pointed to him the location (where) the fish (had been lost). Moses began to search him there. He suddenly saw Khadir wrapped in a cloth and lying on his back. He said to him: As-Salamu-'Alaikum. He removed the cloth from his face and said: Wa 'Alaikum-us-Salam! Who are you? He said: I am Moses. He said: Who Moses? He said: Moses Of Bani Isra'il. He said: What brought you here? He said: I have come so that you may teach me what you have been taught of righteousness. He said: You shall have to bear with me, and how can you have patience about a thing of which you have no comprehensive knowledge? You will not have patience when you see me doing a thing I have been ordered to do. He said: If Allah pleases, you will find me patient, nor shall I disobey you in aught. Khadir said: If you follow me, don't ask me about anything until I explain it to you. So they went on until they embarked upon a boat. He (Khadir) made a hole in that. Thereupon he (Moses) said: You have done this so that you may drown the persons sitting in the boat. You have done something grievous. Thereupon he said: Did I not tell you that you will not be able to bear with me? Thereupon he (Moses) said: Blame me not for what I forgot and be not hard upon me for what I did. (Khadir gave him another chance.) So they went on until they reached a place where boys were playing. He went to one of them and caught hold'of one (apparently) at random and killed him. Moses (peace be upon him) felt agitated and said: You have killed an innocent person not guilty of slaying another. You have done something aboininable. 
Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May Allah have mercy upon us and Moses. Had he shown patience he would have seen wonderful things, but fear of blame, with respect to his companion, seized him and he said: If I ask anything after this, keep not company with me. You will then have a valid excuse in my case, and had he (Moses) shown patience he would have seen many wonderful things. He (the narrator) said: Whenever he (the Holy Prophet) made mention of any Prophet, he always said: May there be mercy of Allah upon us and upon my brother so and so. They, however, proceeded on until they came to the inhabitants of a village who were very miserly. They went to the meeting places and asked for hospitality but they refused to show any hospitality to them. They both found in that village a wall which was about to fall. He (Khadir) set it right. Thereupon he (Moses) said: If you so liked. you could get wages for it. Thereupon he said: This is the partince, of ways between me and you, and, taking hold of his cloth, he said: Now I will explain to you the real significance (of all these acts) for which you could not show patience. As for the boat, it belonged to the poor people working on the river and I intended to damage it for there was ahead of them (a king) who seized boats by force. (When he came) to catch hold of it he found it a damaged boat, so he spared it (and later on) it was set right with wood. So far as the boy is concerned, he has been, by very nature, an unbeliever, whereas his parents loved him very much. Had he grown up he would have involved them in wrongdoing and unbelief, so we wished that their Lord should give them in its place one better in purity and close to mercy. And as for the wall it belonged to two orphan boys in the city and there was beneath it a (treasure) belongin to them,... up to the last verse.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b ne humein riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musa apne logon ko khutba de rahe the. Aur unhone ye Tippni ki: Zameen par koi bhi shakhs mujhse zyada ilm waala nahi hai ya mujhse behtar kuch nahi hai. Isper Allah ne unpar wahi ki: Main aisa shakhs jaanta hoon jo tumse behtar (ilm mein) hai ya zameen par ek shakhs hai jo tumse zyada ilm waala hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mere Rab, mujhe unke paas margdarshan de. Unse kaha gaya: Ek namkeen machhli safar ke raashan ke soorat mein rakho. Jahan woh machhli gum ho jaaye (wahan tumhe woh aadmi milega). Is liye woh nikle, aur unke saath ek jawaan ghulam bhi tha, yahan tak ki woh Sakhra jagah tak pahunche, lekin unhe koi ishara nahi mila. Is liye woh aage badhe aur us jawaan shakhs ko wahan chhod diya. Machhli paani mein hilne lagi aur paani machhli ke upar ek naav ka soorat le liya. Jawaan shakhs ne kaha: Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (unpar shaanti ho) se milna chahiye aur unhe bataana chahiye, lekin use bhula diya gaya aur jab woh us jagah se aage nikal gaye, unhone (Musa ne) us jawaan shakhs se kaha: Naashta lao. Hum safar ki wajah se bahut thak gaye hain, aur woh (Musa) tab tak nahi thake jab tak woh us (khaas) jagah ko paar nahi kar gaye (jahan unhe) Khadir se milna tha, aur jawaan shakhs ko yaad aaya aur usne kaha: Kya aapne dekha nahi ki jab hum Sakhra pahunche maine machhli bhula di aur ye sirf Shaitaan hai jisne mujhe ise bhula diya? Ye ajeeb hai ki usne samundar mein bhi raasta paa liya. Unhone kaha: Yehi hai jo hum chaahte the. Woh apne kadam wapas gaye, aur unhone (unke saathi ne) unhe woh jagah dikhaayi (jahan) machhli (gum hui thi). Musa unhe wahan dhoondhne lage. Unhone achaanak Khadir ko kapde mein lipte aur peeth ke bal lete dekha. Unhone unse kaha: As-Salamu-Alaikum. Unhone apna chehra kapde se hataaya aur kaha: Wa Alaikum-us-Salam! Tum kaun ho? Unhone kaha: Main Musa hoon. Unhone kaha: Kaunse Musa? Unhone kaha: Banu Isra'il ke Musa. Unhone kaha: Tumhe yahan kya laaya? Unhone kaha: Main is liye aaya hoon taaki aap mujhe woh sikhaayein jo aapko nekokaari ke baare mein sikhaaya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Tumhe mere saath sabar rakhna hoga, aur tum kaise sabar rakh paaoge us cheez ke baare mein jiska tumhe poora ilm nahi hai? Tumhare paas sabar nahi hoga jab tum mujhe woh karte dekhoge jiska mujhe hukum diya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Agar Allah chaahe, tum mujhe sabar rakhte paaoge aur main kisi bhi cheez mein tumhaari naafarmani nahi karunga. Khadir ne kaha: Agar tum mera anusaran karte ho, to jab tak main tumhe iske baare mein na samjhaaun mujhse kuch mat poochho. To woh aage badhe yahan tak ki woh ek naav mein sawaar hue. Unhone (Khadir ne) usmein ek chhed banaaya. Isper unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Tumne ye is liye kiya ki naav mein baithe logon ko Doob jaane do. Tumne kuch sangin kiya hai. Isper unhone kaha: Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ki tum mere saath sabar nahi rakh paaoge? Isper unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Us baat ke liye mujhe dosh mat do jo main bhoola aur mere kaam ke liye mujhpar sakhti mat karo (Khadir ne unhe ek aur mauka diya.) To woh aage badhe yahan tak ki woh ek jagah pahunche jahan larke khel rahe the. Woh unmein se ek ke paas gaya aur (bikhare tareeke se) ek ko pakda aur use qatal kar diya. Musa (unpar shaanti ho) vichalit hue aur kaha: Tumne ek nirdosh shakhs ko qatal kiya jo kisi doosre ko qatal karne ka dosi nahi tha. Tumne kuch ghinauna kiya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah humpar aur Musa par rehmat kare. Agar unhone sabar dikhaaya hota to woh anokhi cheezein dekhte, lekin unhe apne saathi ke baare mein dosh ka dar pakad gaya aur unhone kaha: Agar iske baad main kuch poochun, to mere saath saathi mat bano. Tumhe phir mere maamle mein ek munasib bahaana mil jaayega, aur agar unhone (Musa ne) sabar dikhaaya hota to woh bahut si anokhi cheezein dekh paate. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Jab bhi woh (Nabi-e-Paak) kisi Nabi ka zikr karte, woh hamesha kehte: Allah ki rehmat ho humpar aur mere bhai falan-falan par. Woh, halaanki, aage badhe yahan tak ki woh ek gaon ke bahut kanjoos bashindon tak pahunche. Woh mahfilon mein gaye aur mehmaannawaazi maangi lekin unhone unhe koi mehmaannawaazi nahi di. Donon ne us gaon mein ek deewar paayi jo girne hi waali thi. Unhone (Khadir ne) use theek kiya. Isper unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Agar tum chaahte to iske liye mazdoori le sakte the. Isper unhone kaha: Ye mere aur tumhaare beech raaston ka alagav hai, aur apna kapda pakDkar unhone kaha: Ab main tumhe (in sab karyon ka) asli matlab samjhaaunga jinke liye tum sabar nahi dikha paaye. Jahan tak naav ka sawal hai, ye nadi par kaam karne wale gareeb logon ki thi aur mera iraada isse nuksaan pahunchaane ka tha kyunki unke aage (ek raja) tha jo naaven zabardasti chheenta tha. (Jab woh) use pakadne aaya to usne use nuksaan-grast paaya, is liye usne ise chhod diya (aur baad mein) ise lakdi se theek kiya gaya. Jahan tak us larke ka sawal hai, woh mizaj se hi ek gair-imaandaar tha, jabki uske maa-baap use bahut muhabbat karte the. Agar woh bada hota to unhe anyaay aur avishvaas mein le jaata, is liye humne chaaha ki unka Rab unhe iski jagah koi behtar, muqaddas aur rehmat ke qareeb koi de. Aur jahan tak deewar ka sawal hai, ye shehar ke do anaath larkon ki thi aur iske neeche unka ek (khazana) tha... aakhri aayat tak.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Ishaq.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ishaq ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas has reported this hadith on the authority of Ubayy b. ka'b that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to recite this.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne ye hadees Ubayy bin Ka'b ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise padha karte the.

e: 'Utba b. Mas, ud reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas contended with Hurr b. Qais b. Hisn al-Fazari aboat the companion of Moses (peace be upon hiin). Ibn 'Abbas said that he was Khadir. There happened to pass Ubayy b. Ka'b Ansari. Ibn Abbas called him and said: Abu Tufail, come to us. There has been a difference of opinion between me and my friend about the companion of Moses whom he wanted to meet on the way. Did hear anything from Allah's meesenger (ﷺ) making a mention of anything? Ubayy said: I heard Allah's Messenger (may Peace be upon him) as saying: As Moses was amongst the group of Bani Isra'il, there came to him a person and he said to him: Do you know anyone having better knowledge than you? Moses said: No. Thereupon Allah revealed to Moses: Of course, there is amongst Our servants Khadir (who has better knowledge) than you. Moses asked the way of meeting him. Allah made the fish a sign and it was said to him: Where you miss the fish return to that (place) and you will soon find him. So Moses moved on as Allah wished him to move on. He then said to his young companion: Bring for us the breakfast. Thereupop that young man said to Moses. when he asked him for the breakfast: Don't you see that as we had reached the Sakhra I forgot the fish and nobody made it forget (in our mind) but the satan that I should remind you of it? Mosed said to that young man: This was what we wanted. So they retraced their steps and met Khadir and the events which followed have been described in His Book except that Yunus (the narrator) said that he followed the traces of fish in the ocean.
hi: Utba bin Mas'ud ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Abbas ne Hurr bin Qais bin Hisn al-Fazari se Musa (unpar shaanti ho) ke saathi ke baare mein bahas ki. Ibn Abbas ne kaha ki woh Khadir the. Ubayy bin Ka'b Ansari wahan se guzre. Ibn Abbas ne unhe bulaaya aur kaha: Abu Tufail, humare paas aao. Mere aur mere dost ke beech Musa ke saathi ke baare mein mat-bhinnata hai jinse woh raaste mein milna chaahte the. Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein kuch suna? Ubayy ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Musa Banu Isra'il ke giroh ke beech the, unke paas ek shakhs aaya aur usne unse kaha: Kya aapko koi aisa pata hai jise aapse zyada achha ilm hai? Musa ne kaha: Nahi. Isper Allah ne Musa par wahi ki: Zaroor, humare bandon mein Khadir hai (jinhe tumse zyada ilm hai). Musa ne unse milne ka raasta poocha. Allah ne machhli ko ek nishaan banaya aur unse kaha gaya: Jahan tumhe machhli gum lage, waha wapas jaao aur tumhe jald hi woh mil jaayenge. Is liye Musa aage badhe jaisa Allah ne unhe aage badhne ka margdarshan diya. Unhone phir apne jawaan saathi se kaha: Humare liye naashta lao. Isper us jawaan shakhs ne Musa se kaha, jab unhone naashte ke liye poocha: Kya aapko nahi lagta ki jab hum Sakhra pahunche maine machhli bhula di aur kisi ne mujhe ise bhulaaya nahi (humare zehan mein) siwaay Shaitaan ke ki main aapko iski yaad dilaana bhool jaaun? Musa ne us jawaan shakhs se kaha: Yehi tha jo hum chaahte the. To woh apne kadam wapas gaye aur Khadir se mile aur jo ghatnaen iske baad huyin unka varnan Uski (Allah ki) Kitaab mein kiya gaya hai siwaay is baat ke ki Yunus (raawi) ne kaha ki unhone samundar mein machhli ke nishaan ka picha kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Abu Bakr Siddiq reported him thus: I saw the feet of the polytheists very close to us as we were in the cave. I said: Allah's Messenger, if one amongst them were to see at his feet he would have surely seen us. Thereupon he said: Abu Bakr, what can befall two who have Allah as the third One with them.
hi: Anas bin Malik (ra) ne riwayat ki ke Abu Bakr Siddiq (ra) ne bayan kiya: Maine mushrikeen ke paon hamare saron ke bilkul upar dekhe jab hum ghaar mein the. Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasool Allah, agar unmein se koi apne paon ki taraf dekh le to woh humein apne paon ke neeche dekh lega. To Aap SAW ne farmaya: Ae Abu Bakr, tumhara kya khayal hai un do ke baare mein jinka teesra Allah hai?

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat on the pulpit and said: Allah gave a choice to His servant that he may opt the beauties of the world or that which is with Him and the servant chose that which was with Him. Thereupon Abu Bakr wept and he wept bitterly and said: Let our fathers and our mothers be taken as ransom for you. It was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had been given the choice and Abu Bakr knew it better than us, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: Behold, of all people the most generous toward me in regard to his companionship and his property was Abu Bakr and were I to choose anyone as my bosom friend, I would have chosen Abu Bakr as my dear friend, but (for him) I cherish Islamic brotherliness and love. There shall be left open no window in the mosque except Abu Bakr's window.
hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par baithe aur kaha: Allah ne Apne banda ko ikhtiyar diya ki woh duniya ki zeenat chun sakta hai ya woh jo Uske paas hai, aur banda ne woh chuna jo Uske paas tha. Isper Abu Bakr rone lage aur bahut roye aur kaha: Humaare maa-baap aap par qurbaan ho jaayein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko hi ye ikhtiyar diya gaya tha aur Abu Bakr ise humse behtar samajhte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho, sab logon mein se apni sohbat aur apni maal ke saath mere prati sabse sakhi Abu Bakr the, aur agar main apna gehra dost kisi ko banaata, to main Abu Bakr ko apna aziz dost banaata, lekin (unke liye) main Islami bhaichaara aur muhabbat rakhta hoon. Masjid mein koi chhota darwaza khula nahi chhodi jaayegi siwaay Abu Bakr ke chhote darwaze ke.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If I were to choose a bosom friend I would have definitely chosen Abu Bakr as my bosom friend, but he is my brother and my companion and Allah, the Exalted and Gliorious. has taken your brother and companion (meaning Prophet himself) as a friend.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar main koi gehra dost chunta, to main zaroor Abu Bakr ko apna gehra dost chunta, lekin woh mere bhai aur saathi hain, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne tumhare bhai aur saathi (yaani khud Nabi) ko apna dost bana liya hai.

e: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If I were to choose from my Umma anyone as my bosom friend, I would have chosen Abu Bakr.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar main apni Ummat mein se kisi ko apna gehra dost chunta, to main Abu Bakr ko chunta.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If I were to choose as my bosom friend I would have chosen the son of Abu Quhafa (Abu Bakr) as my bosom friend.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar main apna gehra dost chunta, to main Abu Quhafa ke bete (Abu Bakr) ko apna gehra dost chunta.

e: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If I were to choose amongst the people of earth someone as my bosom friend, I would have chosen the son of Abu Quhafa as my friends but God has taken your companion as a friend.
hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar main zameen ke logon mein se kisi ko apna gehra dost chunta, to main Abu Quhafa ke bete ko apna dost chunta lekin Allah ne tumhare saathi ko apna dost bana liya hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters and the one narrated on the authority of Abdullah (the words are): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said: Behold I am free from the dependence of all bosom friends and if I were to choose anyone as bosom friend I would have taken Abu Bakr as my bosom friend. Allah has taken your companion as a friend.
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho, main sab gehre doston ke prati kisi bhi tarah ki nirbharta se azad hoon aur agar main kisi ko apna gehra dost chunta, to main Abu Bakr ko apna gehra dost banata. Allah ne tumhare saathi ko apna dost bana liya hai."

e: 'Amr b. al-'As reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent him in command of the army despatched to Dhat-as-Salasil. When 'Amr b. al-'As came back to the Prophet (ﷺ) he said: Who amongst people are dearest to you? He said: A'isha. He then said: Who amongst men? He said: Her father, and I said: And who next? He said: Umar. He then enumerated some other men.
hi: Amr bin al-As ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Dhat-as-Salasil bheji gayi fauj ka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Jab Amr bin al-As Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye, unhone poocha: Logon mein aapko sabse aziz kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Aisha. Unhone phir kaha: Mardon mein kaun? Unhone kaha: Unke waalid, aur maine kaha: Aur unke baad kaun? Unhone kaha: Umar. Phir unhone kuch aur mardon ka zikr kiya.

e: Ibn Abu Mulaika reported: I heard `A'isha as saying and she was asked as to whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would have nominated as his successor if he had to nominate one at all. She said: Abu Bakr. It was said to her: Then whom after Abu Bakr? She said: `Umar. It was said to her. Then whom after `Umar? She said: Abu `Ubaida b. al-Jarrah, and then she kept quiet at this.
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha ko ye kehte suna jab unse poocha gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kise apna uttaradhikaari muqarrar kiya hota agar unhe kisi ko muqarrar karna padta. Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr. Unse poocha gaya: Phir Abu Bakr ke baad kaun? Unhone kaha: Umar. Unse poocha gaya: Phir Umar ke baad kaun? Unhone kaha: Abu Ubaida bin al-Jarrah, aur phir woh isper khamosh ho gayin.

e:
Muhammad b. Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that a woman asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about something but lit, told her to come to him on some other occasion, whereupon she said: What in your opinion (should I do) if I come to you but do not find you, and it seemed as if she meant that he might die. Thereupon he said: If you do not find me, then come to Abu Bakr. 
This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jubair b. Mut'im through another chain of transmitters (and the words are) that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and discussed with him something and he gave a command as we find in the above-mentioned narration.
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki ek aurat ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch poocha lekin unhone (ya usse kaha) ki woh unse kisi doosre avasar par milne aaye, isper usne kaha: Aapki raay mein (mujhe kya karna chahiye) agar main aapke paas aaun lekin aapko na paaun (aisa lagta hai jaise uska matlab tha ki woh mar sakte hain)? Isper unhone kaha: Agar tum mujhe na pao, to Abu Bakr ke paas jaana. Ye hadees Jubair bin Mut'im ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain) ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unse kuch charcha ki aur unhone ek hukum diya jaisa upar bataayi gayi riwayat mein hai.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his (last) illness asked me to call Abu Bakr, her father, and her brother too, so that he might write a document, for he feared that someone else might be desirous (of succeeding him) and that some claimant may say: I have better claim to it, whereas Allah and the Faithful do not substantiate the claim of anyone but that of Abu Bakr.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni (aakhri) beemari mein mujhse Abu Bakr, unke waalid, aur unke bhai ko bulaane ko kaha, taaki woh ek dastaavez likh sakein, kyunki unhe dar tha ki koi doosra (unka uttaradhikaari banne ki) khwaish rakh sakta hai aur koi daawedaar keh sakta hai: Mera isper zyada haq hai, jabki Allah aur Imaandaar Abu Bakr ke ilawa kisi aur ke daave ki pushti nahi karte.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who amongst you is fasting today? Abu Bakr said: I am. He (again) said: Who amongst you followed a funeral procession today? Abu Bakr said: I did. He (the Prophet) again said: Who amongst you served food to the needy? Abu Bakr said: I did. He (again) said: Who amongst you has today visited the sick? Abu Bakr said: I did. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Anyone in whom (these good deeds) are combined will certainly enter paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se aaj kaun roza rakhe hue hai? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Main. Unhone (dobara) kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne janaaza ka picha kiya? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine kiya. Unhone (Nabi ne) phir kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne kisi zaroorat-mand ko khaana khilaaya? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine khilaaya. Unhone (dobara) kaha: Tum mein se aaj kisne kisi bimaar se mulaqaat ki? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine ki. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jismein bhi (ye achhe amal) ikatthe hote hain woh zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person had been driving an ox loaded with luggage. The ox looked towards him and said: I have not been created for this but for lands (i. e. for ploughing the land and for drawing out water from the wells for the purpose of irrigating the lands). The people said with surprise and awe: Hallowed be Allah, does the ox speak? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I believe it and so do Abu Bakr and 'Umar. Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A shepherd was tendirig the flock when a wolf came there and took away one goat. Tile shepherd pursued it (the wolf) and rescued it (the goat) from that (wolf). The wolf looked towards him and said: Who would save it on the day when there will be no shepherd except me? Thereupon people said: Hallowed be Allah I Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I believe in it and so do Abu Bakr and Umar believe.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs saamaan lade hue ek bail ko haank raha tha. Bail ne uski taraf dekha aur kaha: Mujhe iske liye nahi banaaya gaya balki zameenon ke liye (yaani zameen jotne aur sinchaai ke liye kuen se paani nikaalne ke liye). Log hairat aur bhay se bole: Allah muqaddas hai, kya bail bolta hai? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main ismein vishvaas rakhta hoon aur waise hi Abu Bakr aur Umar. Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek gadariya apna rewad dekhbhaal kar raha tha jab ek bhediya wahan aaya aur ek bakri le gaya. Gadariye ne uska (bhediye ka) picha kiya aur use (bakri ko) usse bachaaya. Bhediye ne uski taraf dekha aur kaha: Us din ise kaun bachaayega jab koi gadariya nahi hoga siwaay mere? Isper log bole: Allah muqaddas hai! Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main ismein vishvaas rakhta hoon aur waise hi Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi vishvaas rakhte hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of the story pertaining to the ox.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein bail se mutaliq kahani ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri, and there is a clear mention of the stories of ox and goat (and the words are): I believe in it and so do Abu Bakr and Umar, but they were not at that time present there.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur ismein bail aur bakri ki kahaniyon ka saaf zikr hai (aur alfaaz hain): Main ismein vishvaas rakhta hoon aur waise hi Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi rakhte hain, lekin woh us waqt wahan maujood nahi the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transrritters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abu Mulaika reported: I heard Ibn 'Abbas as saying: When 'Umar b. Khattab was placed in the coffin the people gathered around him. They praised him and supplicated for him before the bier was lifted up, and I was one amongst them. Nothing attracted my attention but a person who gripped my shoulder from behind. I saw towards him and found that he was 'Ali. He invoked Allah's mercy upon 'Umar and said: You have left none behind you (whose) deeds (are so enviable) that I love to meet Allah with them. By Allah, I hoped that Allah would keep you and your two associates together. I had often heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I came and there came too Abu Bakr and 'Umar; I entered and there entered too Abu Bakr and 'Umar; I went out and there went out too Abu Bakr and 'Umar, and I hope and think that Allah will keep you along with them.
hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna: Jab Umar bin Khattab ko taabut mein rakha gaya, log unke aas-paas ikattha ho gaye. Unhone unki tareef ki aur unke liye taboot uThAe jaane se pehle dua ki, aur main bhi unmein se ek tha. Kisi cheez ne mera dhyaan nahi kheencha siwaay ek shakhs ke jisne peeche se mera kandha pakda. Maine uski taraf dekha aur paaya ki woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) the. Unhone Umar ke liye Allah ki rehmat maangi aur kaha: Tumne apne peeche koi aisa nahi chhoda (jiske) amal (itne aziz hon) ki main unke saath Allah se milne ko pasand karun. Allah ki qasam, mujhe ummeed thi ki Allah tumhe aur tumhare do saathiyon ko saath rakhega. Maine aksar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main aaya aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi aaye; main daakhil hua aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi daakhil hue; main bahar gaya aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi bahar gaye, aur mujhe ummeed hai aur main sochta hoon ki Allah tumhe unke saath rakhega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Umar bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say ing: While I was asleep I saw people being presented to me (in a dream) and they wore shirts and some of these reached up to the breasts and some even beyond them. Then there happened to pass 'Umar b. Khattab and his shirt had been trailing. They said: Allah's Messeneer, how do you interpret the dream? He said: (As strength of) faith.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab main so raha tha maine dekha ki log (sapne mein) mere saamne pesh kiye gaye aur unhone kurte pehne hue the aur kuch unke seenon tak aa rahe the aur kuch usse bhi aage tak. Phir Umar bin Khattab wahan se guzre aur unka kurta zameen tak latak raha tha. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap iski kya vyaakhya karte hain? Unhone kaha: (Imaan ki) taqat.

e: Hamza b. Abdullah b. 'Umar b. Khattab reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: While I was asleep I saw (in a dream) a cup containing milk being presented to me. I took out of that until I perceived freshness being reflected through my nails. Then I presented the leftover to 'Umar b. Khattab. They said: Allah's Messenger: How do you interpret it? He said: This implies knowledge.
hi: Hamza bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Khattab ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab main so raha tha maine dekha (sapne mein) ek pyaala mujhe pesh kiya gaya jismein doodh tha. Maine ismein se peeya yahan tak ki mujhe apne naakhoonon se guzarti taazgi mehsoos hui. Phir maine bacha hua Umar bin Khattab ko diya. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iski aap kya vyaakhya karte hain? Unhone kaha: Ismein ilm darshaaya gaya hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While I was asleep I saw myself on a well with a leathern bucket on a pulley. I drew (water) out of that as Allah wished me (to draw). Then the son of Abu Quhafa (Abu Bakr) drew from it one bucketful or two and there was some weakness in drawing that (may Allah forgive him). Then that bucket (changed into a large bucket) and Ibn Khattab drew it. I did not see any strongest man drawing it like 'Umar b. Khattab. He brought out so much water that the camels of the people had enough to drink and then laid down (for rest).
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab main so raha tha maine khud ko ek kuen par dekha jismein chamde ki balti thi ek chakki par. Maine (paani) nikaala jitna Allah ne mujhe (nikaalne ke liye) chaaha. Phir Abu Quhafa ke bete (Abu Bakr) ne isse ek ya do balti nikaali aur unke nikaalne mein kuch kamzori thi (Allah unhe maaf kare). Phir woh balti (ek badi balti mein badal gayi) aur Ibn Khattab ne ise nikaala. Maine kabhi Umar bin Khattab jaisa taakatvar aadmi ise nikaalte nahi dekha. Woh itna paani laaye ki logon ke oonton ne pet bhar kar piya aur phir (aaraam ke liye) baith gaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I saw Ibn Abu Quhafa drawing (water) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Ibn Abu Quhafa ko (paani) nikaalte dekha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While I was asleep I saw myself drawing water from my tank in order to quench the thirst of the people that there came to me Abu Bakr. He took hold of the leathern bucket from my hand so that he should serve water to the people. He drew two bucketfuls and there was some weakness in his drawing (Allah may forgive him). Then there came Ibn Khattab and he took hold of that, and I did not see a person stronger than he (drawing water) until the people went away with their thirst quenched and the tank filled with water.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab main so raha tha maine khud ko apne tanke se paani nikaalte dekha logon ki pyaas bujhaane ke liye jab mere paas Abu Bakr aaye. Unhone mere haath se chamde ki balti pakDi taaki woh logon ko paani de sakein. Unhone do balti nikaali aur unke nikaalne mein kuch kamzori thi (Allah unhe maaf kare). Phir Ibn Khattab aaye aur unhone use pakDa, aur maine unse zyada taakatvar aadmi (paani nikaalte hue) nahi dekha yahan tak ki log apni pyaas bujhaakar chale gaye aur tanka paani se bhar gaya.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I saw (in a dream) as if I was drawing water with a leathern bucket on a wooden pulley. There came Abu Bakr and he drew out a bucketful or two and as he drew out, some weakness (was perceived in it) (may Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, forgive him). Then Umar came in order to serve water -and the bucket was changed into a large leather bucket and I did not see such a wonderful man amongst persons (drawing water) and he went on serving water to the people until they were fully satisfied and then went to their resting places.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Maine (sapne mein) dekha jaise main lakdi ki chakki par chamde ki balti se paani nikaal raha hoon. Abu Bakr aaye aur unhone ek ya do balti nikaali aur jab unhone nikaala, kuch kamzori thi (Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, unhe maaf kare). Phir Umar aaye paani dene ke liye aur balti ek badi chamde ki balti mein badal gayi aur maine (paani nikaalne walon mein) aisa anokha aadmi nahi dekha aur woh logon ko paani dete rahe yahan tak ki woh poori tarah santusht ho gaye aur phir apni aaraam ki jagahon par chale gaye.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father some of the dreams of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to Abu Bakr and Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) and a hadith like this.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne waalid ke hawale se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Abu Bakr aur Umar bin Khattab (Allah unse khush ho) se mutaliq kuch sapnon ke baare mein isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I entered Paradise and saw in it a house or a palace. I said: For whom is it resersred? They (the Angels) said: It is for 'Umar b. Khattab. (The Prophet said to 'Umar b. Khattab): I intenied to get into it but I thought of your feelings. Thereupon 'Umar wept and said: Apostle of Allah, could I feel any jealousy in your case?
hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main Jannat mein daakhil hua aur usmein ek ghar ya mahal dekha. Maine kaha: Ye kiske liye mahfooz hai? Unhone (Farishton ne) kaha: Ye Umar bin Khattab ke liye hai. (Nabi ne Umar bin Khattab se kaha): Mera iraada ismein daakhil hone ka tha lekin maine tumhaari bhaavnaon ka khyaal kiya. Isper Umar rone lage aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main aapke maamle mein koi jalan mehsoos kar sakta hoon?

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While I was asleep I saw myself in Paradise and a woman performing ablution by the side of a palace. I said: For whom is it meant? They said: It is meant for 'Umar b. Khattab. (The Holy Prophet) said: There came across my mind the feeling of Umar and so I turned back and went away. Abu Huraira said: 'Umar wept as we were present in that meeting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst us and Umar said: Allah's Messenger, may my father and mother be taken as ransom for you. Could I at all feel any jealousy about you? This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab main so raha tha maine khud ko Jannat mein dekha aur ek aurat ek mahal ke bagal mein wuzu kar rahi thi. Maine kaha: Ye kiske liye hai? Unhone (Farishton ne) kaha: Ye Umar bin Khattab ke liye hai. (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Mere zehan mein Umar ki jazba aayi aur is liye main mudkar chala gaya. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Umar rone lage jab hum us sabha mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maujood the aur Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan ho jaayein. Kya main aapke maamle mein koi jalan mehsoos kar sakta hoon? Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'd b. Waqqas reported that Umar sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to visit him when some women of the Quraish were busy in talking with him and raising their voices above his Voiee. When'Umar sought permission they stood up and went hurriedly behind the curtain. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him permission smilingly. Thereupon 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, may Allah keep you happy all your life. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I wonder at these women who were with me and no sooner did they hear your voice, they immediately went behind the curtain. Thereupon 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, you have more right that they should fear you. Then Umar (addressing the women) said: O ye enemies of yourselves, do you fear me and fear not the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? They said: Yes, you are harsh and strict as compared to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (maypeace be upon him) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if satan would encounter you in the way he would certainly take a different way from that of yours.
hi: Sa'd bin Waqqas ne bayan kiya ki Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se unse milne ki ijazat maangi jab Quraish ki kuch auraten unse baat karne mein masroof thin aur unki aawaaz se apni aawaaz buland kar rahi thin. Jab Umar ne ijazat maangi, woh khadi hokar parde ke peeche jaldi se chali gayin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muskuraate hue unhe ijazat di. Isper Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah aapko poori zindagi khush rakhe. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe in auraton par hairat hota hai jo mere saath thin aur jaise hi unhone tumhaari aawaaz suni, woh turant parde ke peeche chali gayin. Isper Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko unse zyada haq hai ki woh aapse Darein. Phir Umar ne (auraton ko sambodhit karte hue) kaha: Aye khud ki dushmano, kya tum mujhse Darti ho aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nahi Darti? Unhone kaha: Haan, tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke muqable sakht aur kaThOr ho. Isper, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar Shaitaan tumhe raaste mein mile, to woh zaroor tumhare raaste se doosra raasta le lega.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Umar b. Khattab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while there were some women with him and they were raising their voices above the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when Umar sought permission to get into the house they went behind the curtain hurriedly. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Umar bin Khattab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye jab kuch auraten unke saath thin aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aawaaz se apni aawaaz buland kar rahi thin, aur jab Umar ne ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat maangi, woh jaldi se parde ke peeche chali gayin. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There had been among the people before you inspired persons and if there were any such among my Umma Umar b. Khattab would be one of them. Ibn Wahb explained the word Muhaddathun as those who receive hint from the High (Mulhamun).
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Tumse pehle ke logon mein Ilaahi targhib paane wale log the aur agar meri Ummat mein aisa koi hai to Umar bin Khattab unmein se ek hoga. Ibn Wahb ne "Muhaddathun" lafz ki vyaakhya un logon ke soorat mein ki jinhe Uchch (Allah) se ishara milta hai (Mulhamun).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd b. Ibrahim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd bin Ibrahim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Umar as saying: My lord concorded with (my judgments) on three occasions. In case of the Station of Ibrahim, in case of the observance of veil and in case of the prisoners of Badr.
hi: Ibn Umar ne Umar ko ye kehte suna: Mere Rab ne teen mauqon par (mere faislon se) sehmati jataayi. Ibrahim ke Jagah ke maamle mein, parde ki paalna ke maamle mein aur Badr ke qaidiyon ke maamle mein.

e: Ibn Umar reported that when 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul (the hypocrite) died, his son Abdullah b. Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon -him) and asked him to give his shirt which should be used for the coffin of his father. He gave that to him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to say prayer over him Thereupon I Umar caught hold of the clothe of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, are you going to offer prayer, whereas Allah has forbidden to offer prayer for him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has given me a choice saying: Ask forgiveness for them or you may not ask for them; even if you ask for them seventy times, I will make an addition to the seventy. He was a hypocrite and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said prayer over him that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the verse:" And never pray over any one of them that has died and never should you stand by his grave" (ix. 84).
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul (munaafiq) ka intiqaal hua, unke bete Abdullah bin Abdullah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse unka chogha maanga jise unke waalid ke taabut ke liye istemal kiya jaaye. Unhone use unhe diya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke liye namaz padhne khade hue. Isper Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde pakde aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aap uske liye namaz padhne wale hain, jabki Allah ne uske liye namaz padhne se mana kiya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya hai ye kehte hue: Unke liye maafi maango ya na maango; chahe tum unke liye sattar baar maafi maango, main sattar mein izafa karunga. Woh ek munaafiq tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske liye namaz padhi ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne aayat nazil ki: "Aur unmein se kisi ke liye kabhi namaz mat padho jo mar chuka ho aur uski qabar ke paas kabhi mat khade ho" (9:84).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitter but with the addition of the words: " He abandoned saying prayer over the hypocrites who had died."
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Unhone mare hue munaafiqon ke liye namaz padhna chhod diya."

e: `Aisha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was lying in the bed in my apartment with his thigh uncovered and Abu Bakr sought permission to enter. It was given to him and he conversed in the same very state (the Prophet's thigh or shank uncovered). Then `Umar sought permission for entering and it was given to him and he conversed in that very state. Then `Uthman sought permission to enter; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat down and he set right his clothes. Muhammad (one of the narrators) said: I do not say that it happened on the same day. He (`Uthman) then entered and conversed and as he went out, `Aisha said: Abu Bakr entered and you did not stir and did not observe much care (in arranging your clothes), then `Umar entered and you did not stir and did not arrange your clothes, then `Uthman entered and you got up and set your clothes right, so he (ﷺ) said: Should I not show modesty to one whom even the Angels show modesty.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere kamre mein bistar par lete hue the, unki jaangh khuli hui thi aur Abu Bakr ne (andar aane ki) ijazat maangi. Unhe di gayi aur unhone usi haalat mein baatchit ki (Nabi-e-Paak ki jaangh ya paindli khuli hui). Phir Umar ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi aur unhe di gayi aur unhone usi haalat mein baatchit ki. Phir Uthman ne andar aane ki ijazat maangi; Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe aur unhone apne kapde theek kiye. Muhammad (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Main ye nahi kehta ki ye usi din hua. Woh (Uthman) phir andar aaye aur baatchit ki aur jab woh bahar gaye, Aisha ne kaha: Abu Bakr andar aaye aur aap hile nahi aur zyada dhyaan nahi rakha (apne kapdon ke intezaam mein), phir Umar andar aaye aur aap hile nahi aur apne kapde theek nahi kiye, phir Uthman andar aaye aur aap uThe aur apne kapde theek kiye, is liye unhone kaha: Kya mujhe us shakhs ke saamne sharm nahi mehsoos karni chahiye jise Farishte bhi sharm dikhaate hain.

e: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (mav peace be upon him), and Uthman both reported that Abu Bakr sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for entrance (in his apartment) as he had been lying on his bed covered with the bed-sheet of A'isha, and he gave permission to Abu Bakr in that very state and he, having his need fulfilled, went back. Then Umar sought permission and it was given to him in that very state and, after having his need fulfilled, he went back. And 'Uthman reported: Then I sought permission from him and he got up and raid to A'isha: Wrap yourself well with your cloth, then I got my need fulfilled and came back. And A'isha said: Allah's Messenger, why is it that I did not see you feeling any anxiety in case of dressing properly in the presence of Abu Bakr and 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) as you showed in case of 'Uthman. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily Uthman is a person who is very modest and I was afraid that if I permitted him to enter in this very state he would not inform me of his need.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, aur Uthman donon ne ye riwayat ki ki Abu Bakr ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (unke kamre mein) andar jaane ki ijazat maangi jab woh apne bistar par leTe hue the Aisha ki chaadar se dhake, aur unhone Abu Bakr ko usi haalat mein ijazat di aur unhone (Abu Bakr ne), apni zaroorat poori karke, wapas jaakar chale gaye. Phir Umar ne ijazat maangi aur unhe bhi usi haalat mein di gayi aur, apni zaroorat poori karke, woh wapas gaye. Aur Uthman ne riwayat ki: Phir maine unse ijazat maangi aur woh uThe aur Aisha se kaha: Apne aap ko apne kapde se achhi tarah lapetlo, phir main andar gaya, apni zaroorat poori ki aur wapas aaya. Aur Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aisa kyun hai ki maine aapko Abu Bakr aur Umar (Allah unse khush ho) ki maujoodgi mein koi bechaini mehsoos karte kapdon ki munasib intezam ke maamle mein nahi dekha jaisa Uthman ki maujoodgi mein dikhaaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Uthman ek bahut sharmeele shakhs hain aur mujhe dar tha ki agar main unhe is haalat mein andar aane ki ijazat deta to woh mujhe apni zaroorat nahi bataate.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Uthman and A'isha with the same wording.
hi: Ye hadees Uthman aur Aisha ki sanad se isi alfaazon mein riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in one of the gardens of Medina, reclining against a pillow and fixing a stick in a mud, that a person came asking for the gate to be opened, whereupon he said: Open it for him and give him glad tidings of Paradise and, lo, it was Abu Bakr. I opened (the gate) for him and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise. Then another person asked for the door to be opened, whereupon he said: Open it and give him the glad tidings of Piradise. He said: I went away and, lo, it was 'Umar. I opened it for him and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise. Then still another man asked for the door to be opened, and thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Open it and give him the glad tidings of Paradise after a trial would afflict him. I went and, lo, it was 'Uthman b. 'Affan. 1 opened the door and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise and informed him (what the Prophet had said). Thereupon he said: O Allah, grant me steadfastness. Allah is one Whose help is to be sought.
hi: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina ke ek baag mein takiye par tek lagaaye aur mitti mein ek lakdi laga rahe the, ek shakhs darwaza kholne ki maang karne aaya, isper unhone kaha: Ise unke liye kholo aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri do, aur dekho, woh Abu Bakr the. Maine (darwaza) unke liye khola aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri di. Phir ek doosre shakhs ne darwaza kholne ki maang ki, isper unhone kaha: Ise kholo aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri do. Unhone kaha: Main gaya aur dekha, ye Umar the. Maine ise unke liye khola aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri di. Phir ek aur shakhs ne darwaza kholne ki maang ki, aur isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise kholo aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri do ek pareeksha ke baad jo unhe pareshaan karegi. Main gaya aur dekha, ye Uthman bin Affan the. Maine darwaza khola aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri di aur unhe (jo Nabi ne kaha tha) bataya. Isper unhone kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe sthirta de. Allah hi hai Jiski madad maangi jaani chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Musa al-Ash'ari with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that he performed ablution in his house and then came out saying: I would remain with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the whole day long. He came to the mosque, and asked about Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). They (his Companions) said: He has gone in this direction. He (Abu Musa Ash'ari) said: I followed his steps asking about him until I came to Bi'r Aris (it is a well in the suburb of Medina). I sat by its wooden door until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had relieved himself and then performed ablution. I went to him and he was sitting with his shanks uncovered hp to the knees and his legs dangl- ing in that well. I offered him salutations. I then came back and sat at the door as if I had been a chamberlain at the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that day. There came Abu Bakr and knocked the door and I said: Who is it? He said: This is Abu Bakr. I said: Wait, please. I went and said: Allah's Messenger, here is Abu Bakr seeking permission. Thereupon he said: Admit him and give him glad tidings of Paradise. I came and I said to Abu Bakr to get in (and also told him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was giving him the glad tidings of Paradise. Abu Bakr got in and sat on the right side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and dangled his feet in the well as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done, and he uncovered his shanks. I then returned and sat there and I had left my brother as he had been performing ablution and he was to meet me and I said: If Allah would intend goodness for such and such he would intend goodness for his brother and He would bring him. I was thinking this that a person stirred the door. I said: Who is it. He said: This is Umar b., Khattab. I said: Wait. Then I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), greeted him and said: Here is 'Umar seeking your. permission to get in. Thereupon he said: Let him come in and give him glad tid- ings of Paradise. I came to Umar and said: There is permission for you and glad tidings for you from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Paradise. He got in and sat on the left side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his feet dangling in the well. I then returned and sat and said: If Allah would intend goodness for such and such (that is for his brother), He would bring him. And I was contemplat- ing over it that a man stirred the door and I said: Who is it? He said: This is Uthman b. Affan. I said: Wait, please. I then came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him. and he said: Admit him and give him glad tidings (and inform) him of the turmoil which he shall have to face. I came and said: Get in, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gives you the glad tidings of Paradise along with the trial which you shall have to face. He got in and saw the elevated plan round the well fully occupied. He sat on the other side. Sharik said that Sa'id b. al-Musayyib reported: I drew a conclusion from it that their groves would be (in this very state, the graves of Hadrat Abu Bakr, 'Umar Faruq by the tide of the Prophet  and the grave of Hadrat 'Uthman away from their graves).
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne ghar mein wuzu kiya aur phir bahar aaye ye kehte hue: Main poore din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath rahunga. Woh masjid mein aaye, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Woh is simt mein gaye hain. Unhone (Abu Musa Ash'ari ne) kaha: Maine unke qadmon ka picha kiya unke baare mein poochte hue yahan tak ki main Bi'r Aris pahuncha (ye Madina ke bahari ilaake mein ek kuen hai). Main uske lakdi ke darwaze par baitha yahan tak ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud ko halka karke wuzu kar chuke. Main unke paas gaya aur woh apni paindliyaan ghutnon tak khuli rakhkar baithe the aur unke paon us kuen mein latak rahe the. Maine unhe salaam kiya. Main phir wapas aakar darwaze par baitha jaise main us din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ka chauki dar hunga. Abu Bakr aaye aur darwaza khatkhataaya aur maine kaha: Kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Abu Bakr hain. Maine kaha: Ruko barah-e-karam. Main gaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe Abu Bakr jo ijazat maang rahe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Unhe daakhil karo aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri do. Main aaya aur maine Abu Bakr se andar aane ko kaha (aur unhe ye bhi bataya) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri de rahe hain. Abu Bakr andar gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki daayi taraf baithe aur apne paon kuen mein latka diye jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kiya tha, aur unhone apni paindliyaan khol din. Main phir wapas gaya aur wahan baitha aur maine apne bhai ko chhod diya tha jo wuzu kar rahe the aur unhe mujhse milna tha aur maine kaha: Agar Allah falan-falan ke liye achhaai chaahe, to Woh unke bhai ke liye bhi achhaai chaahega aur unhe laayega. Main ye soch hi raha tha ki ek shakhs ne darwaza khatkhataaya. Maine kaha: Kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Umar bin Khattab hain. Maine kaha: Ruko. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya, unhe salaam kiya aur kaha: Ye rahe Umar jo aapse andar aane ki ijazat maang rahe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Unhe andar aane do aur unhe Jannat ki khushkhabri do. Main Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhare liye ijazat hai aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se tumhare liye Jannat ki khushkhabri. Woh andar gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baayi taraf baithe, apne paon kuen mein latkate hue. Main phir wapas gaya aur baitha aur kaha: Agar Allah falan-falan (yaani apne bhai) ke liye achhaai chaahe, to Woh unhe laayega. Aur main ispar soch hi raha tha ki ek aadmi ne darwaza khatkhataaya aur maine kaha: Kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Uthman bin Affan hain. Maine kaha: Ruko barah-e-karam. Main phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhe soochit kiya, aur unhone kaha: Unhe daakhil karo aur unhe khushkhabri do (aur unhe bataao) us pareeksha ke baare mein jiska unhe saamna karna hoga. Main aaya aur kaha: Andar aao, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumhe Jannat ki khushkhabri dete hain us pareeksha ke saath jiska tumhe saamna karna hoga. Woh andar gaye aur kuen ke aas-paas oonchi jagah ko poori tarah bhara paaya. Woh doosri taraf baithe. Sharik ne kaha ki Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne kaha: Maine ismein se ye natija nikaala ki unki (Hazrat Abu Bakr, Umar Faruq ki Nabi-e-Paak ke bagal mein aur Hazrat Uthman ki unki qabron se alag) qabrein isi tarah hongi.

e: Abu Musa. reported: I set out with the intention (of meeting) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and came to know that he had gone to the gardens (in the suburb of Medina). I followed him and found him in a garden sitting upon an elevated place round the well with his shanks uncovered which had been dangling in the well. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that there is no mention of the words of Sa'id: all drew a conclusion from it pertaining to their graves."
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne ke iraade se nikla aur mujhe pata chala ki woh baagon (Madina ke bahari ilaake mein) gaye hain. Maine unka picha kiya aur unhe ek baag mein kuen ke aas-paas oonchi jagah par baithe paaya, apni paindliyaan khuli rakhkar jo kuen mein latak rahi thin. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki ismein Sa'id ke alfaaz ka koi zikr nahi hai ki unhone ismein se unki qabron ke baare mein natija nikaala.

e: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib reported Abu Musa Ash'ari having said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out one day to the suburbs of Medina for reliev- ing himself. I followed his steps. The rest of the hadith is the same. Ibn Musayyib said: I concluded (from the manner of their sitting) the (order) of their graves. (The three) would be together (the graves of the Holy Prophet, Hadrat Abu Bakr and Hadrat Umar) and that of 'Uthman would be separate (from them).
hi: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib ne Abu Musa Ash'ari se ye kehte hue riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din khud ko halka karne Madina ke bahari ilaakon mein gaye. Maine unke qadmon ka picha kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Ibn Musayyib ne kaha: Maine (unke baithne ke tareeke se) unki qabron ke (kram) ka natija nikaala. (Teen) saath honge (Nabi-e-Paak, Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Umar ki qabrein) aur Uthman ki alag (unse) hogi.

e: Amir b Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported (on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressing 'Ali said: You are in the same position with relation to me as Aaron (Harun) was in relation to Moses but with (this explicit difference) that there is no prophet after me. Sa'd said: I had an earnest desire to hear it directly from Sa'd, so I met him and narrated to him what (his son) Amir had narrated to me, whereupon he said: Yes, I did hear it. I said: Did you hear it yourself? Thereupon he placed his fingers upon his ears and said: Yes, and if not, let both my ears become deaf.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne (apne waalid ke hawale se) ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko sambodhit karte hue kaha: Tum mere prati usi haalat mein ho jismein Harun (Aaron) Musa ke prati the lekin (is spashth antar ke saath) ki mere baad koi Nabi nahi hoga. Sa'd ne kaha: Mujhe ise seedhe Sa'd se sunne ki betaab ichchha thi, is liye main unse mila aur unhe woh sunaya jo (unke bete) Amir ne mujhe sunaaya tha, isper unhone kaha: Haan, maine ise suna. Maine kaha: Kya aapne ise khud suna? Isper unhone apni ungliyaan apne kaanon par rakhi aur kaha: Haan, aur agar nahi, to mere dono kaan behre ho jaayein.

e: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left 'Ali b. Abi Talib behind him (as he proceeded) to the expedition of Tabuk, whereupon he ('Ali) said: Allah's Messenger, are you leaving me behind amongst women and children? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses but with this exception that there would be no prophet after me?
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko apne peeche chhoda (jab woh) Tabuk ki muhim (ki taraf badhe), isper unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aap mujhe auraton aur bachchon ke beech peeche chhod rahe hain? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Kya tum santusht nahi ho ki tum mere liye woh ho jo Harun Musa ke liye the, is apwaad ke saath ki mere baad koi Nabi nahi hoga?

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that Muawiya b. Abi Sufyan appointed Sa'd as the Governor and said: What prevents you from rebuking Abu Turab (Hadrat 'Ali), whereupon be said: It is because of three things which I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said about him that I would not rebuke him and even if I find one of those three things for me, it would be more dear to me than the red camels. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say about 'Ali as he left him behind in one of his campaigns (that was Tabuk). 'Ali said to him: Allah's Messenger, you leave me behind along with women and children. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses but with this exception that there is no prophethood after me. And I (also) heard him say on the Day of Khaibar: I would certainly give this standard to a person who loves Allah and his Messenger, and Allah and his Messenger love him too. He (the narrator) said: We had been anxiously waiting for it, when he (the Holy Prophet) said: Call 'Ali. He was called and his eyes were inflamed. He applied saliva to his eyes and handed over the standard to him, and Allah gave him victory. (The third occasion is this) when the (following) verse was revealed: "Let us summon our children and your children." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husain and said: O Allah, they are my family.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ne Sa'd ko Gavarnar muqarrar kiya aur kaha: Tumhe Abu Turab (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ki burai karne se kis cheez ne roka, isper unhone kaha: Ye teen baaton ki wajah se hai jo mujhe yaad hai ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke baare mein kehte suna ki main unki burai nahi karunga, aur agar main inmein se koi ek cheez apne liye paata, to woh mujhe laal oonton se zyada aziz hoti. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein ye kehte suna jab unhone unhe apne ek abhiyaan (yaani Tabuk) mein peeche chhod diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhe auraton aur bachchon ke saath peeche chhod rahe hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kya tum santusht nahi ho ki tum mere liye woh ho jo Harun Musa ke liye the is apwaad ke saath ki mere baad koi nabuwwat nahi hai. Aur maine (unhe) Khaibar ke din bhi ye kehte suna: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ko dunga jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai, aur Allah aur Uske Rasool bhi usse muhabbat karte hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Hum betaabi se iske intezaar mein the, jab unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaao. Unhe bulaaya gaya aur unki aankhein sooji hui thin. Unhone unki aankhon par lar lagaayi aur jhanda unhe soonpa, aur Allah ne unhe jeet di. (Teesra mauka ye hai) jab (ye) aayat nazil hui: "Aao hum apne bachchon aur tumhare bachchon ko bulaaein." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam), Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Hasan aur Husain ko bulaaya aur kaha: Aye Allah, ye mera khaandaan hai.

e: Sa'd reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying to 'Ali: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses?
hi: Sa'd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) se ye kehte suna: Kya tum santusht nahi ho ki tum mere liye woh ho jo Harun Musa ke liye the?

e: Suhail reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar: I shall certainly give this standard in the hand of one who loves Allah and his Messenger and Allah will grant victory at his hand. Umar b. Khattab said: Never did I cherish for leadership but on that day. I came before him with the hope that I may be called for this, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali b. Abu Talib and he conferred (this honour) upon him and said: Proceed on and do not look about until Allah grants you victory, and 'Ali went a bit and then halted and did not look about and then said in a loud voice: Allah's Messenger, on what issue should I fight with the people? Thereupon he (the Prophet) said: Fight with them until they bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is his Messenger, and when they do that then their blood and their riches are inviolable from your hands but what is justified by law and their reckoning is with Allah.
hi: Suhail ne Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ke haath mein dunga jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur jiske haath se Allah jeet dega. Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Maine kabhi netritva ki khwaish nahi ki siwaay us din ke. Main is ummeed mein unke saamne aaya ki mujhe iske liye bulaaya jaaye, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaaya aur unhe (ye samman) diya aur kaha: Aage badho aur idhar-udhar mat dekho jab tak Allah tumhe jeet na de, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) thoda aage badhe aur phir ruke aur idhar-udhar nahi dekha aur phir buland aawaaz mein kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main kis maamle par logon se larun? Isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Unse tab tak laro jab tak woh is baat ki gawaahi na dein ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Uske Rasool hain, aur jab woh aisa karein to unka khoon aur unki daulat tumhare haathon se apathya hai siwaay uske jise kaanoon munasib maane, aur unka hisaab Allah ke paas hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar: I would certainly give this standard to a person at whose hand Allah would grant victory and who loves Allah and His Messenger and Allah and His Messenger love him also. The people spent the night thinking as to whom it would be given. When it was morning the people hastened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) all of them hoping that that would be given to him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Where is 'Ali b. Abu Talib? They said: Allah's Messenger, his eyes are sore. He then sent for him and he was brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) applied saliva to his eyes and invoked blessings and he was all right, as if he had no ailment at all, and conferred upon him the standard. 'Ali said: Allah's Messenger, I will fight them until they are like us. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Advance cautiously until you reach their open places, thereafter invite them to Islam and inform them what is obligatory for them from the rights of Allah, for, by Allah, if Allah guides aright even one person through you that is better for you than to possess the most valuable of the camels.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ko dunga jiske haath se Allah jeet dega aur jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur Allah aur Uske Rasool bhi usse muhabbat karte hain. Log raat bhar sochte rahe ki ye kise diya jaayega. Jab subah hui, log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaldi aaye sab ye ummeed karte hue ki ye unhe diya jaayega. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) kahan hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unki aankhein dukh rahi hain. Phir unhone unhe bulwaaya aur unhe laaya gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki aankhon par lar lagaayi aur barkat maangi aur woh theek ho gaye, jaise unhe koi taklif hi na thi, aur unhe jhanda soonpa. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main unse larunga jab tak woh humaari tarah na ho jaayein. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Savdhaani se aage badho jab tak tum unki khuli jagahon tak na pahunch jao, phir unhe Islam ka nimantran do aur unhe bataao unki Allah ke prati kya zimmedaariyaan hain, kyunki, Allah ki qasam, agar Allah tumhare zariye ek shakhs ko bhi sahi raah dikhaata hai, ye tumhare liye behtareen oonton ke maalik hone se behtar hai.

e: Salama b. Akwa' reported that it was 'Ali whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) left behind him (in the charge of his family and the Islamic State) on the occasion of the campaign of Khaibar, and his eyes were inflamed and he said: Is it for me to remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? So he went forth and rejoined Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and on the evening of that night (after which) next morning Allah granted victory. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I will certainly give this standard to a man whom Allah and His Messenger love. or he said: Who loves Allah or His Messenger and Allah will grant him victory through him, and, lo, we saw 'Ali whom we least expected (to be present on that occasion). They (the Companions) said: Here is 'Ali. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hin) gave him the standard. Allah granted victory at his hand.
hi: Salama bin Akwa ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) the jinhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ki muhim ke mauke par apne peeche (apne khaandaan aur Islami hukumat ki zimmedaari mein) chhoda tha, aur unki aankhein sooji hui thin aur unhone kaha: Kya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se peeche rehun?
