Is liye woh aage nikle aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se dobara aa mile aur us raat ki shaam (jiske) agli subah Allah ne jeet di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us aadmi ko dunga jise Allah aur Uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain, ya unhone kaha: Jo Allah ya Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur Allah use uske zariye jeet dega, aur dekho, humne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko dekha jinki humein kam se kam ummeed thi (us mauke par unki maujoodgi ki). Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Ye rahe Ali (Alayhis Salam). Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe jhanda diya. Allah ne unke haath se jeet di.

e: Yazid b. Hayyan reported, I went along with Husain b. Sabra and 'Umar b. Muslim to Zaid b. Arqam and, as we sat by his side, Husain said to him: Zaid. you have been able to acquire a great virtue that you saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) listened to his talk, fought by his side in (different) battles, offered prayer behind me. Zaid, you have in fact earned a great virtue. Zaid, narrate to us what you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: I have grown old and have almost spent my age and I have forgotten some of the things which I remembered in connection with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so accept whatever I narrate to you, and which I do not narrate do not compel me to do that. He then said: One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to deliver sermon at a watering place known as Khumm situated between Mecca and Medina. He praised Allah, extolled Him and delivered the sermon and. exhorted (us) and said: Now to our purpose. O people, I am a human being. I am about to receive a messenger (the angel of death) from my Lord and I, in response to Allah's call, (would bid good-bye to you), but I am leaving among you two weighty things: the one being the Book of Allah in which there is right guidance and light, so hold fast to the Book of Allah and adhere to it. He exhorted (us) (to hold fast) to the Book of Allah and then said: The second are the members of my household I remind you (of your duties) to the members of my family. He (Husain) said to Zaid: Who are the members of his household? Aren't his wives the members of his family? Thereupon he said: His wives are the members of his family (but here) the members of his family are those for whom acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. And he said: Who are they? Thereupon he said: 'Ali and the offspring of 'Ali, 'Aqil and the offspring of 'Aqil and the offspring of Ja'far and the offspring of 'Abbas. Husain said: These are those for whom the acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. Zaid said: Yes.
hi: Yazid bin Hayyan ne bayan kiya: Main Husain bin Sabra aur Umar bin Muslim ke saath Zaid bin Arqam ke paas gaya aur jab hum unke qareeb baithe, Husain ne unse kaha: Zaid, tumne ek badi punyapurnata haasil ki hai ki tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha, unki baat suni, unke saath (mukhtalif) jungon mein lade, unke peeche namaz padhi. Zaid, tumne waastav mein ek badi punyapurnata kamaayi hai. Zaid, humein woh riwayat karo jo tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Unhone kaha: Main boodha ho gaya hoon aur lagbhag apni umar guzaar chuka hoon aur maine kuch cheezein bhula di hain jo mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke silsile mein yaad thin, is liye jo main tumhe riwayat karta hoon use qubool karo, aur jise main riwayat nahi karta use karne ke liye mujhe majboor mat karo. Phir unhone kaha: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khumm naamak paani ki jagah par khutba dene khade hue jo Makkah aur Madina ke beech sthit hai. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki, uski hamd ki aur khutba diya aur (humein) prerit kiya aur kaha: Ab humare maqsad par aate hain. Aye logo, main ek insaan hoon. Main apne Rab se ek doot (Maut ka Farishta) paane wala hoon aur main, Allah ke bulaave ke jawaab mein, (tumhe vida kahunga), lekin main tumhare beech do bhaari cheezein chhod raha hoon: ek Allah ki Kitaab hai jismein sahi margdarshan aur roshni hai, is liye Allah ki Kitaab ko mazbooti se pakdo aur uska paalan karo. Unhone (humein) Allah ki Kitaab (ko mazbooti se pakadne ke liye) prerit kiya aur phir kaha: Doosri cheez mere khaandaan ke sadasya hain, main tumhe (tumhare kartavyon ke baare mein) apne khaandaan ke prati yaad dilaata hoon. Unhone (Husain ne) Zaid se kaha: Unke khaandaan ke sadasya kaun hain? Kya unki zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya nahi hain? Isper unhone kaha: Unki zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya hain (lekin yahan) khaandaan ke sadasya woh hain jinke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai. Aur unhone kaha: Woh kaun hain? Isper unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki aulaad, Aqil aur Aqil ki aulaad aur Ja'far ki aulaad aur Abbas ki aulaad. Husain ne kaha: Ye woh hain jinke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai. Zaid ne kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Arqam through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Arqam ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Hayyan but with this addition: " The Book of Allah contains right guidance, the light, and whoever adheres to it and holds it fast, he is upon right guidance and whosoever deviates from it goes astray.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Hayyan ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ki Kitaab mein sahi margdarshan hai, roshni hai, aur jo koi ise mazbooti se pakDta hai aur qaayam rehta hai, woh sahi margdarshan par hai aur jo isse bhatakta hai woh gumraah ho jaata hai."

e: Yazid b. Hayyan reported: We went to him (Zaid b. Arqam) and said to him. You have found goodness (for you had the honour) to live in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and offered prayer behind him, and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording that lie said: Behold, for I am leaving amongst you two weighty things, one of which is the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, and that is the rope of Allah. He who holds it fast would be on right guidance and he who abandons it would be in error, and in this (hadith) these words are also found: We said: Who are amongst the members of the household? Aren't the wives (of the Holy Prophet) included amongst the members of his house hold? Thereupon he said: No, by Allah, a woman lives with a man (as his wife) for a certain period; he then divorces her and she goes back to her parents and to her people; the members of his household include his ownself and his kith and kin (who are related to him by blood) and for him the acceptance of Zakat is prohibited.
hi: Yazid bin Hayyan ne bayan kiya: Hum unke (Zaid bin Arqam ke) paas gaye aur unse kaha: Aapne achhaai paayi hai (kyunki aapko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein rehne aur unke peeche namaz padhne ka samman mila. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is alfaazon ke antar ke saath ki unhone kaha: Dekho, main tumhare beech do bhaari cheezein chhod raha hoon, jinmein se ek Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki Kitaab hai aur ye Allah ki rassi hai. Jo ise mazbooti se pakdta hai woh sahi margdarshan par hoga aur jo ise chhodta hai woh galat raaste par hoga, aur ismein ye alfaaz bhi milte hain: Humne kaha: Khaandaan ke sadasya kaun hain? Kya (Nabi-e-Paak ki) zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya nahi hain? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, ek aurat ek shakhs ke saath (uski zauja ke soorat mein) ek muayyan muddat tak rehti hai; woh phir use talaaq deta hai aur woh apne maa-baap aur apne logon ke paas wapas chali jaati hai; unke khaandaan ke sadasya unke khud aur unke khoon ke rishtedaar log hain aur unke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai.

e: Sahl b. Sa`d reported that a person from the offspring of Marwan was appointed as the governor of Medina. He called Sahl b. Sa`d and ordered him to abuse `Ali. Sahl refused to do that. He (the governor) said to him: If you do not agree to it (at least) say: May Allah curse Abu Turab. Sahl said: There was no name dearer to `Ali than Abu Turab (for it was given to him by the Prophet himself) and he felt delighted when he was called by this name. He (the governor) said to him: Narrate to us the story of his being named as Abu Turab. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the house of Fatima and he did not find `Ali in the house; whereupon he said: Where is your uncle's son? She said: (There cropped up something) between me and him which had annoyed him with me. He went out and did not rest here. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to find out where he was. He came and said: Allah's Messenger, he is sleeping in the mosque. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and found him lying in the mosque and saw that his mantle had slipped from his back and his back was covered with dust and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to wipe it away from him (from the body of Hadrat `Ali) saying: Get up, covered with dust (Abu Turab); get up, covered with dust.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ki aulaad mein se ek shakhs Madina ka gavarnar muqarrar kiya gaya. Unhone Sahl bin Sa'd ko bulaaya aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bura-bhala kehne ka hukum diya. Sahl ne aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone (gavarnar ne) unse kaha: Agar tum isse sehmat nahi ho, to (kam se kam) kaho: Allah Abu Turab par laanat kare. Sahl ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke liye Abu Turab se zyada aziz koi naam nahi tha (kyunki ye khud Nabi-e-Paak ne diya tha) aur woh khush hote the jab unhe is naam se pukaara jaata. Unhone (gavarnar ne) unse kaha: Unke Abu Turab naam rakhe jaane ki kahani humein sunao. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar aaye aur unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ghar mein nahi paaya; isper unhone kaha: Tumhare chacha ka beta kahan hai? Unhone kaha: (Humare beech kuch hua) jisne unhe mujhse naaraaz kiya. Woh bahar gaye aur yahan aaraam nahi kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs se poocha ki woh kahan hain. Woh aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh masjid mein so rahe hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur unhe masjid mein lete paaya aur dekha ki unka chogha unki peeth se phisal gaya tha aur unki peeth mitti se dhaki thi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise unse (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke badan se) safai karne lage ye kehte hue: utho, mitti se dhake hue (Abu Turab); utho, mitti se dhake hue.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) lay on bed during one night and said: Were there a pious person from amongst my companions who should keep a watch for me during the nightt? She said: We heard the noise of arms, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who is it? And Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas said: Allah's MesseDger. I have come to serve as your sentinel. 'A'isha said: Allah' s Messenger (ﷺ) slept (such a sound sleep) that I heard the noise of his snoring.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek raat bistar par lete aur kaha: Kaash mere saathiyon mein se koi nekokaar shakhs hota jo raat bhar mera pahra de. Unhone kaha: Humne hathiyaaron ki aawaaz suni, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaun hai? Aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main aapka pahredaar bankar aaya hoon. Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni gehri neend soye ki maine unke kharraaTon ki aawaaz suni.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) laid down on bed during one night on his arrival at Medina and said: Were there a pious person from amongst my Companions who should keep a watch for me durin. the night? She (A'isha) reported: We were in this state that we heard the clanging noise of arms. lie (the Holy Prophet) said: Who is it? He said: This is Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: What brings you here? Thereupon he said: I harboured fear (lest any harm should come to) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so I came to serve as your sentinel. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked blessings upon him. He then slept. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Rumh with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunchne ke baad ek raat bistar par lete aur kaha: Kaash mere sahaba mein se koi nekokaar shakhs hota jo raat bhar mera pahra de. Unhone (Aisha ne) bayaan ki: Hum is haalat mein the ki humne hathiyaaron ki khadkhadaahat suni. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tumhe yahan kya laaya? Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe (Allah ke Rasool ko koi nuksaan pahunchne ka) dar hua, is liye main aapka pahredaar bankar aaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye barkat maangi. Phir woh so gaye. Ye hadees Ibn Rumh ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amir b. Rabi reported A'isha as saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed one night; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdullah bin Amir bin Rabi ne Aisha ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek raat bistar par gaye; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: `Abdullah b. Shaddad reported that he heard `Ali saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not gather his parents except in case of Sa`d b. Malik that he said to him on the Day of Uhud: Shoot an arrow, may my father and mother be taken as ransom for you.
hi: Abdullah bin Shaddad ne bayan kiya ki unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne maa-baap ko kabhi ikattha nahi kiya siwaay Sa'd bin Malik ke maamle mein ki unhone Uhud ke din unse kaha: Teer chalaao, mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho jaayein.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'd b Abi Waqqqs said: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) gathered his parents for me on the Day of Uhud.
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ke din mere liye apne maa-baap ko ikattha kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabyl b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported oLi the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gathered for him on the Day of Uhud his parents when a polytheist had set fire to (i. e. attacked fiercely) the Muslims. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: (Sa'd), shoot an arrow, (Sa'd), may my mother and father be taken as ransom for you. I drew an arrow and I shot a featherless arrow at him aiming his side that lie fell down and his private parts were exposed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughed that I saw his front teeth.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ke din unke liye unke maa-baap ko ikattha kiya jab ek mushrik ne Musalmaanon par (tez hamla karte hue) aag laga di thi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: (Sa'd), teer chalaao, (Sa'd), mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho jaayein. Maine ek teer nikaala aur maine usper ek bina par ka teer chalaaya uski taraf nishaana lete hue jisse woh gir gaya aur uske gupt ang khul gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itna hanse ki maine unke agle daant dekhe.

e: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that many verses of the Qur'an had been revealed in connection with him. His mother Umm Sa'd had taken oath that she would never talk with him until he abandoned his faith and she neither ate nor drank and said: Allah has commanded you to treat well your parents and I am your mother and I command you to do this. She passed three days in this state until she fainted because of extreme hunger and at that time her son whose name was Umara stood up and served her drink and she began to curse Sa'd that Allah, the Exalted and Glorions, revealed these verses of the Holy Qur'an:" And We have enjoined upon a person goodness to his parents but if they contend with thee to associate (others) with Me of which you have no knowledge, then obey them not" (xxix. 8) ; Treat thein with customary good in this world" (xxxi. 15). He also reported that there fell to the lot of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) huge spoils of war and there was one sword in them. I picked that up and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Bestow this sword upon me (as my share in the spoils of war) and you know my state. Thereupon he said: Return it to the place from where you picked it up. I went back until I decided to throw it in a store but my soul repulsed me so I came back and asked him to give that sword to me. He said in a loud voice to return it to the place from where I had picked it up. It was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" They asked about the spoils of war" (viii. 1). He further said: I once fell ill and sent a message to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He visited me and I said to him: Permit me to distribute (in charity) my property as much as I like. He did not agree. I said: (Permit me to distribute) half of it. He did not agree. I said: (Permit me to distribute) the third part, whereupon he kept quiet and it was after this (that the distribution of one's property in charity) to the extent of one-third was held valid. He further said: I came to a group of persons of the Ansir and Muhajirin and they said: Come, so that we may serve you wine, and it was before the use of wine had been prohibited. I went to them in a garden and there had been with them the roasted head of a camel and a small water-skin containing wine. I ate and drank along with them and there came under discussion the Ansr (Helpers) and Muhajirin (immigrants). I said: The immigrants are better than the Ansar, that a person picked up a portion of the head (of the camel and struck me with it that my nose was injured. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of the situation that Aliah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed verses pertaining to wine:" Intoxicants and the games of chance and (sacrificing to) stones set up and (divining by) arrows are only an uncleanliness, the devil's work" (v. 90).
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Quran ki bahut si aayaten unke silsile mein nazil hui thin. Unki maa Umm Sa'd ne qasam khayi thi ki woh tab tak unse baat nahi karengi jab tak woh apna imaan chhod na dein aur unhone na khaana khaya na paani piya aur kaha: Allah ne tumhe apne maa-baap ke saath achha vyavahaar karne ka hukum diya hai aur main tumhaari maa hoon aur main tumhe ye karne ka hukum deti hoon. Unhone teen din is haalat mein guzaare yahan tak ki woh atyadhik bhookh ki wajah se behosh ho gayin aur us waqt unke bete jiska naam Umara tha khade hue aur unhe peene ke liye kuch diya aur woh Sa'd ko bura-bhala kehne lagin ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Muqaddas Quran ki ye aayaten nazil kin: "Aur Humne har shakhs ko apne maa-baap ke prati achhaai dikhaane ka hukum diya hai lekin agar woh tumse jhagda karein ki tum Mere saath (doosron ko) shareek karo jiske baare mein tumhe koi ilm nahi hai, to unki baat mat maano" (29:8); "Duniya mein unke saath prachalit riwaaz ke mutabik achha vyavahaar karo" (31:15). Unhone ye bhi riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hisse mein jung ke bade maal-e-ganimat aaye aur unmein ek talwaar thi. Maine use uThAya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ye talwaar mujhe de dijiye (maal-e-ganimat mein mere hisse ke soorat mein) aur aap meri haalat jaante hain. Isper unhone kaha: Ise wapas rakh do jahan se tumne ise uThAya tha. Main wapas gaya yahan tak ki maine ise ek gudam mein phenkne ka faisla kiya lekin mere dil ne mujhe rok diya is liye main wapas aaya aur unse ye talwaar dene ko kaha. Unhone buland aawaaz mein kaha ki main ise wapas rakh dun jahan se maine ise uThAya tha. Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke baare mein poochte hain" (8:1). Unhone aage kaha: Ek baar main bimaar pad gaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khabar bheji. Woh mujhse milne aaye aur maine unse kaha: Mujhe apni maal jitna chaahun baantne ki ijazat dijiye. Woh sehmat nahi hue. Maine kaha: (Iska aadha) baantne ki ijazat dijiye. Woh sehmat nahi hue. Maine kaha: (Iska ek-tihai baantne ki ijazat dijiye), isper woh khamosh rahe aur iske baad hi (kisi ki maal ka ek-tihai sadaqe mein baantna) vaidh mana gaya. Unhone aage kaha: Main Ansar aur Muhajirin ke logon ke ek giroh ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Aao, hum tumhe sharaab pilaayein, aur ye sharaab mana hone se pehle ki baat hai. Main unke paas ek baag mein gaya aur unke paas oont ka bhuna hua sar tha aur sharaab bhari ek chhoti mashk. Maine unke saath khaya aur piya aur charcha Ansar aur Muhajirin par aayi. Maine kaha: Muhajirin Ansar se behtar hain, isper ek shakhs ne (oont ke) sar ka ek tukda uThAya aur mujhe usse maara jisse meri naak zakhmi ho gayi. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe haalat bataayi ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne sharaab se mutaliq aayaten nazil kin: "Nashe wali cheezein, jue ke khel, patthar rakhe hue buton, aur teeron se peshangoi (ye sab) apavitr hain, Shaitaan ka kaam hai" (5:90).

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Simak and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are): When they intended to feed her (Sa'd'. s mother), they opened her mouth with the help of a stick and then put the feed in her mouth, and in the same hadith the words are: He struck the nose of Sa'd and it was injured and Sa'd had (the mark) of wound on his nose.
hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Jab unhone unhe (Sa'd ki maa ko) khilaana chaaha, unhone ek lakdi ki madad se unka munh khola aur phir unke munh mein khaana daala, aur isi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Usne Sa'd ki naak par maara aur ye zakhmi hui aur Sa'd ki naak par (zakhm ka) nishaan tha.

e: Sa'd reported: This verse was revealed in relation to six persons and I and Ibn Mas'ud were amongst them. The polytheists said to him (the Holy Prophet): Do not keep such persons near you. It was upon this that (this verse was revealed):" Drive not away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening desiring only His pleasure" (vi. 52).
hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Ye aayat chhe logon ke silsile mein nazil hui aur main aur Ibn Mas'ud unmein se the. Mushrikeen ne unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Aise logon ko apne qareeb mat rakho. Isi mauke par (ye aayat nazil hui): "Un logon ko dur mat karo jo apne Rab ko subah aur shaam pukaarte hain sirf Uski khushi chaahte hue" (6:52).

e: Sa'd reported: We were six men in the company of Allah's Messenger (, nay peace be upon him) that the polytheists said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): Drive them away so that they may not be overbold upon us. He said: I, Ibn Mas'ud and a person from the tribe of Hudhail, Bilal and two other persons, whose names I do not know (were amongst such persons). And there occurred to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what. Allah wished and he talked with himself that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed:" Do not drive away those who call their Lord morning and evening desiring to seek His pleasure."
hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Hum chhe log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki mushrikeen ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Unhe door karo taaki woh humpar zyada himmat na dikhaayein. Unhone kaha: Main, Ibn Mas'ud aur Hudhail qabile ka ek shakhs, Bilal aur do doosre log, jinke naam mujhe nahi pata (in logon mein the). Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jo Allah ne chaaha hua aur unhone apne aap se baat ki ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne nazil kiya: "Un logon ko dur mat karo jo apne Rab ko subah aur shaam pukaarte hain Uski khushi chaahte hue."

e: Abu 'Uthman reported on one of the days when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fighting and none remained with him save Talha and Sa'd.
hi: Abu Uthman ne bayan kiya ki un dinon mein se ek din jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jung lad rahe the, koi bhi unke saath nahi bacha siwaay Talha aur Sa'd ke.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) exhorting people on the Day of the Battle of the Ditch to fight. Zubair said: I am ready (to participate). He then again exhorted and he again said: I am ready to participate. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Behold. for every Prophet there is a helper and my helper is Zubair.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Khaai ki jung ke din logon ko larne ke liye prerit karte suna. Zubair ne kaha: Main taiyaar hoon (hissa lene ke liye). Unhone dobara prerit kiya aur unhone (Zubair ne) dobara kaha: Main hissa lene ke liye taiyaar hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho, har Nabi ke liye ek sahaayak hota hai aur mera sahaayak Zubair hai.

e: Jabir reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Jabir ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported on the Day of the Battle of the Trench: I and Umar b. Abu Salama were with women folk in the fort of Hassan (b. Thabit). He at one time leaned for me and I cast a glance and at anothertime I leaned for him and he would see and I recognised my father as he rode on his horse with his arms towards the tribe of Quraizah. 'Abdullah b. 'Urwa reported from Abdullah b. Zubair: I made a mention of that to my father, whereupon he said: My son, did you see me (on that occasion)? He said: Yes. Thereupon he said: By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed me saying: I would sacrifice for thee my father and my mother.
hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne Khaai ki jung ke din ke baare mein bayan kiya: Main aur Umar bin Abu Salama Hassan (bin Thabit) ke quile mein auraton ke saath the. Woh kabhi mere liye jhukte aur main ek nazar daalta aur kabhi main unke liye jhukta aur woh dekhte aur maine apne waalid ko pehchaana jab woh apne ghode par sawaar apne hathiyaaron ke saath Quraiza qabile ki taraf badh rahe the. Abdullah bin Urwa ne Abdullah bin Zubair se riwayat ki: Maine iska zikr apne waalid se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Mere bete, kya tumne mujhe (us mauke par) dekha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse khitaab karte hue kaha: Main tumhaari khaatir apne maa-baap ko qurbaan karunga.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported: When it was the Day of the Battle of the Ditch I and 'Umar b. Salama were in the fort in which there were women, i. e. the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne bayan kiya: Jab Khaai ki jung ka din tha main aur Umar bin Salama quile mein the jismein auraten thin, yaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was upon the mountain of Hira, ' and there were along with him Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman. 'Ali, Talha, 'Zubair, that the mountain stirred; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Be calm, there is none upon you but a Prophet, a Fiddle (the testifier of truth) and a Martyr.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hira pahaad par the, aur unke saath Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talha, Zubair the, ki pahaad hila. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shaant raho, tumpar koi bhi nahi hai siwaay ek Nabi, ek Siddiq (sach ki tasdeeq karne wala) aur ek Shaheed ke.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on the mountain of Hira' that it stirred; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Hira! be calm, for there is none upon you but a Prophet, a Siddiq, a Shahid, and there were upon it Allah's Prophet (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, 'Umar, Uthman, 'Ali, Talha, Zubair, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased witli them).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hira pahaad par the ki ye hila; isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Hira! shaant raho, kyunki tumpar koi bhi nahi hai siwaay ek Nabi, ek Siddiq, ek Shaheed ke, aur ispar Allah ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talha, Zubair, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (Allah unse khush ho) the.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father ('Urwa b. Zubair) that A'isha said: BY Allah, both fathers of yours are amongst those who have been men. tioned in this verse:" Those who responded to the call of Allah and the Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon thein".
hi: Hisham ne apne waalid (Urwa bin Zubair) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Aisha ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumhare donon waalid unmein se hain jinka is aayat mein zikr kiya gaya hai: "Jinhone Allah aur Rasool ke aahvaan ka jawaab diya jung ke natije mein aayi mushkil ke baad."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hishan through the same chain of transmitters but with this addition (that by both fathers of yours) he meant Abu Bakr and Zubair.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki (tumhare donon waalid se) unka matlab Abu Bakr aur Zubair se tha.

e: 'Urwa reported: 'Aisha said to me: Your fathers (Zubair and Abu Bakr) were amongst those about whom (it has been revealed):" Those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon them."
hi: Urwa ne bayan kiya: Aisha ne mujhse kaha: Tumhare waalid (Zubair aur Abu Bakr) unmein se the jinke baare mein (ye nazil hui): "Jinhone Allah aur Uske Rasool ke aahvaan ka jawaab diya jung ke natije mein aayi mushkil ke baad."

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: For every Umma there is a man of trust and the man of trust of this Umma is Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah.
hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har Ummat ke liye ek vishvaas ka aadmi hota hai aur is Ummat ka vishvaas ka aadmi Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah hain.

e: Anas reported that the people of Yemen came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Send with us a person who should teach us Sunnah and al-Islam, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) caught hold of the hand of Ubaida and said: He is a man of trust of this Umma.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Yemen ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Humare saath ek shakhs bhejiye jo humein Sunnat aur Islam sikhaaye, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) Ubaida ka haath pakda aur kaha: Woh is Ummat ke vishvaas ke aadmi hain.

e: Hudhaifa reported that the people of Najran came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, send along with us a man of trust; whereupon he said: I would definitely send to you a man of trust, a man of trust in the true sense of the term. Thereupon his Companions looked up eagerly and he sent Abu Ubaida b. Jarrah.
hi: Hudhaifa ne bayan kiya ki Najran ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humare saath ek vishvaas ke aadmi ko bhejiye; isper unhone kaha: Main zaroor tumhare paas ek vishvaas ka aadmi bhejunga, wastavik soorat mein ek vishvaas ka aadmi. Isper unke sahaba ne betaab hokar dekha aur unhone Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ko bheja.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ishaq ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Hasan: O Allah, behold, I love him. Thou too love him and love one who loves him.
hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hasan (Alayhis Salam) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aye Allah, dekho, main unse muhabbat karta hoon. Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar aur us shakhs se bhi muhabbat kar jo unse muhabbat karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at a time during the day but he did not talk to me and I did not talk to him until he reached the market of Bani Qainuqa`. He came back to the tent of Fatima and said: Is the little chap (meaning Hasan) there? We were under the impression that his mother had detained him in order to bathe him and dress him and garland him with a sweet garland. Not much time had passed that he (Hasan) came running until both of them embraced each other, thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, I love him; love him Thou and love one who loves him (Hasan).
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath din mein ek waqt gaya lekin unhone mujhse baat nahi ki aur maine unse baat nahi ki yahan tak ki woh Banu Qainuqa ke bazaar tak pahunche. Woh Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke tambu tak wapas aaye aur kaha: Kya woh chhota bacha (yaani Hasan (Alayhis Salam)) yahan hai? Humein laga ki unki maa ne unhe roka hoga unhe nahlaane, kapde pehnaane aur ek meethi maala se saja ne ke liye. Zyada waqt nahi guzra tha ki woh (Hasan (Alayhis Salam)) daudte hue aaye yahan tak ki donon ne ek-doosre ko gale lagaaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon; Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar aur us shakhs se bhi muhabbat kar jo unse (Hasan se) muhabbat karta hai.

e: Al-Bara' b. Azib reported: I saw Hasan b. 'Ali upon the shoulders of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he was saying: O Allah, I love him, and love him Thou.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kandhon par (baithe) dekha aur woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon, aur Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar.

e: Al-Bara' b. Azib reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with Al-Hasan b. 'Ali placed upon his shoulders  and he was saying: O Allah, I love him, and love him Thou.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha jinke kandhon par al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) baithe the aur woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon, aur Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar.

e: Iyas reported on the authority of his father: I (had the honour of) leading the white mule on which rode Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and with him were Hasan and Husain, till it reached the apartment of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The one amongst them was seated before him and the other one was seated behind him.
hi: Iyas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Mujhe safed khachchar ki lagaam pakadne ka samman mila jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sawaar the aur unke saath Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Husain (Alayhis Salam) the, yahan tak ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kamre tak pahuncha. Unmein se ek unke aage baithe hue tha aur doosra unke peeche.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went out one norning wearing a striped cloak of the black camel's hair that there came Hasan b. 'Ali. He wrapped hitn under it, then came Husain and he wrapped him under it along with the other one (Hasan). Then came Fatima and he took her under it, then came 'Ali and he also took him under it and then said: Allah only desires to take away any uncleanliness from you, O people of the household, and purify you (thorough purifying)
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek subah kaale oont ke baal ka dhaari-daar chogha pehne bahar aaye ki Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye. Unhone unhe iske andar lapeta, phir Husain (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur unhe bhi doosre (Hasan) ke saath usmein lapeta. Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aayin aur unhone unhe bhi usmein liya, phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur unhe bhi usmein liya aur phir kaha: Allah bas ye chaahta hai ki tumse har tarah ki apavitrata hataaye, Aye khaandaan ke logo, aur tumhe (poori tarah) muqaddas kare.

e: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father: We were in the habit of calling Zaid b. Harith as Zaid b. Muhammad until it was revealed in the Qur'an:" Call them by the names of their fathers. This is more equitable with Allah" (This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Qutaiba b. Sa'd)
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Hum Zaid bin Harith ko Zaid bin Muhammad kehte the yahan tak ki Quran mein ye nazil hua: "Unhe unke waalidon ke naam se bulaao. Ye Allah ki nazar mein zyada munasib hai" (33:5). (Ye hadees Qutaiba bin Sa'd ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai)

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition and appointed Usama b. Zaid as its chief. The people objected to his command, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said: You object to his command and before this you objected to the command of his father (Zaid). By Allah, he was fit as the commander and he was one of the dearest of persons to me and after him, behold! this one (Usama) is one of the dearest of persons to me.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek muhim bheji aur Usama bin Zaid ko iska sardaar muqarrar kiya. Logon ne unke sardaar muqarrar hone par aitraaz kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha: Tum unke sardaar hone par aitraaz karte ho aur isse pehle tumne unke waalid (Zaid) ke sardaar hone par bhi aitraaz kiya tha. Allah ki qasam, woh (Zaid) sardaari ke laayak the aur woh un logon mein se the jo mujhe sabse aziz the, aur unke baad, dekho! ye shakhs (Usama) un logon mein se hai jo mujhe sabse aziz hain.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the pulpit: You object to the command of Usima b. Zaid as you had objected before to the command of his father (Zaid). By Allah, he was most competent for it and, by Allah, he was dearest to me amongst people and, by Allah, the same is the case with Usama b. Zaid. He is most dear to me after him and I advise you to treat him well for he is pious amongst you.
hi: Salim ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mimbar par kaha: Tum Usama bin Zaid ke sardaar hone par aitraaz karte ho jaise tumne pehle unke waalid (Zaid) ke sardaar hone par aitraaz kiya tha. Allah ki qasam, woh iske sabse zyada laayak the aur, Allah ki qasam, woh logon mein mujhe sabse aziz the aur, Allah ki qasam, Usama bin Zaid ka bhi yehi haal hai. Woh unke baad mujhe sabse aziz hain aur main tumhe salaah deta hoon ki tum unke saath achha vyavahaar karo kyunki woh tum mein mutaqqi hain.

e: Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika reported that Abdullah b. Jafar said to Ibn Zubair: Do you remember (the occasion) when we three (i. e. I, you and lbn 'Abbas) met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he mounted us (on his camel) but left you? He said: Yes.
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Ja'far ne Ibn Zubair se kaha: Kya tumhe yaad hai (woh mauka) jab humne teenon ne (yaani main, tum aur Ibn Abbas) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mulaqaat ki aur unhone humein (apne oont par) sawaar kiya lekin tumhe chhod diya? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Habib b. Ash-Shahid.
hi: Ye hadees Habib bin Ash-Shahid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that when Allah's Messenger (may peace be, upon him) came back from a journey, the children of his family used to accord him welcome. It was in this way that once he came back from a journey and I went to him first of all. He mounted me before him. Then there came one of the two sons of Fatima and he mounted him behind him and this is how we three entered Medina riding on a beast.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aate, unke khaandaan ke bachche unka svaagat karte. Isi tarah ek baar woh safar se wapas aaye aur main sabse pehle unke paas gaya. Unhone mujhe apne aage sawaar kiya. Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke do beton mein se ek aaye aur unhone unhe apne peeche sawaar kiya aur is tarah hum teenon Madina mein ek jaanwar par sawaar hokar daakhil hue.

e: Abdullah b. Ja'a'far reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from a journey he met us. Once he met me, Hasan or Husain, and he mounted one of us before him and the other one behind him until we entered Medina.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aate woh humse milte. Ek baar woh mujhse, Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ya Husain (Alayhis Salam) se mile, aur unhone humme se ek ko apne aage sawaar kiya aur doosre ko apne peeche yahan tak ki hum Madina mein daakhil hue.

e: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted me behind him and narrated to me something in secret which I would narrate to none amongst people.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apne peeche sawaar kiya aur mujhe kuch guptata mein bataya jo main logon mein se kisi ko nahi bataunga.

e: `Abdullah b. Ja`far reported that he heard `Ali say in Kufa that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The best of the women of her time was Mary, daughter of `Imran, and the best of the women of her time was Khadija, daughter of Khuwailid. Abu Kuraib said that Waki` pointed towards the sky and the earth.
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Kufa mein ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne daur ki auraton mein sabse behtareen Mary thin, Imran ki beti, aur apne daur ki auraton mein sabse behtareen Khadija thin, Khuwailid ki beti. Abu Kuraib ne kaha ki Waki ne aasmaan aur zameen ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are many persons amongst men who are quite perfect but there are none perfect amongst women except Mary, daughter of 'Imran, Asiya wife of Pharaoh, and the excellence of 'A'isha as compared to women is that of Tharid over all other foods.
hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mardon mein bahut se aise log hain jo bilkul mukammal hain lekin auraton mein koi mukammal nahi hai siwaay Mary, Imran ki beti, Aasiya, Firaun ki zauja, aur (auraton ke muqable) Aisha ki fazeelat waisi hai jaise Tharid (soop mein bhigi roti) sab doosre khaano se behtar hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Gabriel came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, lo. Khadija is coming to you with a vessel of seasoned food or drink. When she comes to you, offer her greetings from her Lord, the Exalted and Glorious, and on my behalf and give her glad tidings of a palace of jewels in Paradise wherein there is no noise and no toil. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Jibril Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, dekhiye, Khadija aap ke paas ek bartan lekar aa rahi hain jismein masaale-daar khaana ya peene ki cheez hai. Jab woh aapke paas aayein, unhe unke Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki taraf se salaam kahiye, aur mere taraf se bhi, aur unhe Jannat mein ratnon ke ek mahal ki khushkhabri dijiye jismein na shor hai na koi mehnat. Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ismail reported: I said to 'Abdullah b. Abi Aufa: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) give glad tidings of Paradise to Khadija? He said: Yes. He did give glad tidings to her of a palace of jewels in Paradise wherein there would be no noise and no toil.
hi: Ismail ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Abi Aufa se kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khadija ko Jannat ki khushkhabri di thi? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone unhe Jannat mein ratnon ke ek mahal ki khushkhabri di jismein na shor hoga na koi mehnat.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the a tliority of Ibn Abi Aufa through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abi Aufa ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) gave glad tidings to Khadija bint Khuwailid of a palace in Paradise.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khadija bint Khuwailid ko Jannat mein ek mahal ki khushkhabri di.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did I feel jealous of any woman as I was jealous of Khadija. She had died three years before he (the Holy Prophet) married me. I often heard him praise her, and his lord, the Exalted and Glorious, had commanded him to give her the glad tidings of a palace of jewels in Paradise: and whenever he slaughtered a sheep he presented (its meat) to her female companions.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine kisi doosri aurat ke prati utni jalan kabhi mehsoos nahi ki jitni Khadija ke prati. Unka intiqaal us shaadi se teen saal pehle hua tha jismein unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) mujhse shaadi ki. Maine unhe unki tareef karte hue aksar suna, aur unke Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne unhe hukum diya tha ki woh unhe Jannat mein ratnon ke ek mahal ki khushkhabri dein; aur jab bhi woh ek bhed zibah karte, woh (uska gosht) unki aurat saathiyon ko pesh karte.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did I feel jealous of the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but in case of Khadija, although I did no, (have the privilege to) see her. She further added that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slaughtered a sheep, he said: Send it to the companions of Khadija I annoyed him one day and said: (It is) Khadija only who always prevails upon your mind. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Her love had been nurtured in my heart by Allah Himself.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki kisi bhi zauja ke prati kabhi utni jalan mehsoos nahi karti thi jitni Khadija ke prati, halaanki maine unhe kabhi nahi dekha tha. Unhone aage kaha ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bhed zibah karte, woh kehte: Ise Khadija ke saathiyon ke paas bhejo. Ek din maine unhe naaraaz kiya aur kaha: (Ye) sirf Khadija hi hai jo hamesha aapke zehan par chhaayi rehti hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unka muhabbat Allah ne khud mere dil mein poshit kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Usama up to the slaughtering of a sheep, but he. did not make mention of the subsequent words.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Usama ki sanad se bhed zibah karne tak riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone uske baad ke alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did I feel jealous of any wife amongst the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as I feel in case of Khadija (though I had never seen her), for he praised her very often.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se kisi ke prati kabhi jalan mehsoos nahi karti jitni Khadija ke prati (halaanki maine unhe kabhi nahi dekha tha), kyunki woh unki bahut baar tareef karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not marry any other woman till her (Khadija's) death.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki (Khadija ki) maut tak koi doosri aurat se shaadi nahi ki.

e: A'isha reported that Hala b. Khuwailid (sister of Khadija) sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to see him and he was reminded of Khadija's (manner of) asking leave to enter and (was overwhelmed) with emotions thereby and said: O Allah, it is Hala, daughter of Khuwailid, and I felt jealous and said: Why do you remember one of those old women of the Quraish with gums red and who is long dead-while Allah has given you a better one in her stead?
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Hala bint Khuwailid (Khadija ki behn) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se unse milne ki ijazat maangi aur unhe Khadija ke ijazat maangne ke tareeke ki yaad aayi aur (isse bhaavuk ho gaye) aur kaha: Aye Allah, ye Hala hain, Khuwailid ki beti, aur mujhe jalan hui aur maine kaha: Aap Quraish ki us boodhi aurat ko kyun yaad karte hain jiski masudein laal thin aur jo bahut waqt pehle mar chuki - jabki Allah ne aapko iske badle ek behtar (zauja) di hai?

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: I saw you in a dream for three nights when an angel brought you to me in a silk cloth and he said: Here is your wife, and when I removed (the cloth) from your face, lo, it was yourself, so I said: If this is from Allah, let Him carry it out.
hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine tumhe teen raaton tak sapne mein dekha jab ek Farishta tumhe resham ke kapde mein lapetkar mere paas laaya aur usne kaha: Ye rahi tumhaari zauja, aur jab maine (kapda) tumhaare chehre se hataaya, dekho, ye tum khud thi, is liye maine kaha: Agar ye Allah ki taraf se hai, to Woh ise poora karega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: I can well discern when you are pleased with me and when you are annoyed with me. I said: How do you discern it? Thereupon be said: When you are pleased with me you say;" No, by the Lord of Muhammad," and when you are annoyed with me, you say:" No, by the Lord of Ibrahim." I said: Allah's Messenger, by Allah, I in fact leave your name (when I am annoyed with you).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Main achhi tarah pehchaan sakta hoon jab tum mujhse khush hoti ho aur jab tum mujhse naaraaz hoti ho. Maine kaha: Aap ye kaise pehchaante hain? Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum mujhse khush hoti ho tum kehti ho: "Nahi, Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam," aur jab tum mujhse naaraaz hoti ho, tum kehti ho: "Nahi, Ibrahim ke Rab ki qasam." Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, main waastav mein aapka naam chhod deti hoon (jab main aapse naaraaz hoti hoon).

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hishim b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters up to the words: " No, by the Lord of Ibrahim," and he did not make mention of what follows subsequently.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ki sanad se isi sanad se in alfaazon tak riwayat ki gayi hai: "Nahi, Ibrahim ke Rab ki qasam," aur unhone iske baad ki baat ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: 'A'isha reported that she used to play with dolls in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when her playmates came to her they left (the house) because they felt shy of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent them to her.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein guDiyon se khela karti thin aur jab unki khel-saathi unke paas aatin, woh (ghar se) chali jaatin kyunki unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sharam aati thi, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe unke paas bhej dete.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that people sent their gifts when it was the turn of 'A'isha seeking thereby the pleasure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki log apne tohfe bhejte the jab Aisha ki baari hoti, isse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khushi chaahte hue.

e: `A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: The wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). She sought permission to get in as he had been lying with me in my mantle. He gave her permission and she said: Allah's Messenger, verily, your wives have sent me to you in order to ask you to observe equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. She (`A'isha) said: I kept quiet. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her (Fatima): O daughter, don't you love whom I love? She said: Yes, (I do). Thereupon he said: I love this one. Fatima then stood up as she heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and went to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and informed them of what she had said to him and what Allah's messenger (ﷺ) had said to her. Thereupon they said to her: We think that you have been of no avail to us. You may again go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and tell him that his wives seek equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. Fatima said: By Allah, I will never talk to him about this matter. `A'isha (further) reported: The wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) then sent Zainab b. Jahsh, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and she was one who was somewhat equal in rank with me in the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I have never seen a woman more advanced in religious piety than Zainab, more God-conscious, more truthful, more alive to the ties of blood, more generous and having more sense of self-sacrifice in practical life and having more charitable disposition and thus more close to God, the Exalted, than her. She, however, lost temper very soon but was soon calm. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted her to enter as she (`A'isha) was along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in her mantle, in the same very state when Fatima had entered. She said: Allah's Messenger, your wives have sent me to you seeking equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. She then came to me and showed harshness to me and I was seeing the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether he would permit me. Zainab went on until I came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would not disapprove if I retorted. Then I exchanged hot words until I made her quiet. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said: She is the daughter of Abu Bakr.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ne Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja. Unhone (andar aane ki) ijazat maangi jab woh mere saath mere chogha mein leTe hue the. Unhone unhe ijazat di aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, yaqeenan, aapki zaujaon ne mujhe aapke paas ye poochne bheja hai ki aap Abu Quhafa ki beti (yaani mujhe, Aisha ko) ke maamle mein insaaf rakhein. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Main khamosh rahi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse (Fatima (Alayhas Salam) se) kaha: Beti, kya tum usse muhabbat nahi karti jisse main muhabbat karta hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan, (main karti hoon). Isper unhone kaha: Main isse muhabbat karta hoon. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) phir khadi hui jab unhone ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ke paas gayin aur unhe bataya jo unhone unse kaha tha aur jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe kaha tha. Isper unhone unse kaha: Humein lagta hai ki tumne humaari koi madad nahi ki. Tum phir se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ja sakti ho aur unhe bataao ki unki zaujaen Abu Quhafa ki beti ke maamle mein insaaf chaahti hain. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main is maamle par unse kabhi baat nahi karungi. Aisha ne (aage) riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon ne phir Zainab bint Jahsh, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ko bheja, aur woh koi thin jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nazron mein kuch had tak mere barabar darje mein thin aur maine kabhi koi aurat unse zyada deeni deeni lagan mein aage, zyada Allah se Darne wali, zyada sachchi, zyada rishtedaaron ki taraf jaagrat, zyada sakhi aur zindagi ke maamlaat mein zyada qurbani ki jazba wali aur zyada daaneshiil mizaj wali aur is tarah Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ke zyada qareeb nahi dekhi, unke muqable. Woh, halaanki, bahut jaldi gussa mein aa jaati thin lekin jald hi shaant bhi ho jaati thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe andar aane ki ijazat di jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke chogha mein thi, usi haalat mein jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) daakhil hui thin. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapki zaujaon ne mujhe aapke paas bheja hai Abu Quhafa ki beti ke maamle mein insaaf maangte hue. Woh phir mere paas aayin aur mujhpar kathorta dikhaayi aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aankhon ko dekh rahi thi ki kya woh mujhe ijazat denge (jawaab dene ki). Zainab ne baat jaari rakhi yahan tak ki mujhe pata chal gaya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) napasand nahi karenge agar main jawaab dun. Phir humne garam alfaazon ka aadaan-pradaan kiya yahan tak ki maine unhe shaant kar diya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur kaha: Woh Abu Bakr ki beti hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his last illness) inquired: Where I would be tomorrow, where I would be tomorrow (thinking, that the turn of 'A'isha was not very near) and when it was my turn, Allah called him to his Heavenly Home and his head was between my neck and chest.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni aakhri beemari mein poocha: Main kal kahan hunga, main kal kahan hunga (ye sochte hue ki Aisha ki baari zyada dur nahi thi) aur jab meri baari aayi, Allah ne unhe Apne Svarg-vaasi Ghar bulaaya aur unka sar mere gale aur seene ke beech tha.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of breathing his last was reclining against her chest and she was leaning over him and listening to him as he was saying: O Allah, grant me pardon, show mercy to me, enjoin me to companions (on High).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aakhri saans lete waqt unke seene par tek lagaaye hue the aur woh unpar jhuki hui thin aur unhe sun rahi thin jaise woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar, mujhe (Uchcha) saathiyon mein shaamil kar.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: I heard that never a prophet dies until he is given an option to opt the life of (this) world or that of the Hereafter. She further said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say in his last illness in which he' died. I heard him saying in gruffness of the voice: Along with those persons upon whom Allah bestowed favours from amongst the Apostles, the testifiers of truth, the martyrs, the pious and goodly company are they (iv. 69). (It was on bearing these words) that I thought that he had been given choice (and he opted to live with these pious persons in the Paradise).
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine suna ki koi bhi Nabi tab tak nahi marta jab tak use is duniya ki zindagi ya Aakhirat ki zindagi chunne ka ikhtiyar na diya jaaye. Unhone aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni aakhri beemari mein, jismein unka intiqaal hua, ye kehte suna. Maine unhe aawaaz ki kaanpti mein ye kehte suna: Un logon ke saath jinpar Allah ne apna sakhi aashirwaad diya, Rasoolon mein se, sach ki tasdeeq karne walon mein se, shaheedon mein se, nekokaar aur achhi sohbat mein se hain woh (4:69). (In alfaazon ko sunkar) maine socha ki unhe ikhtiyar diya gaya tha (aur unhone in nekokaar logon ke saath Jannat mein rehna chuna).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that he used to say: Never a prophet dies in a state that he is not made to see his abode in Paradise, and then given a choice. 'A'isha said that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to leave the world, his head was over her thigh and he had fallen into swoon three times. When he felt relief his eyes were fixed at the ceiling. He then said: O Allah, along with the high companions (i. e. along with the Apostles who live in the most elevated place of the Paradise). (On hearing these words), I then said (to myself) He is not going to opt us and I remembered a hadith which he had narrated to us as he was healthy and in which he said: No prophet dies until he sees his abode in Paradise, he is then given a choice. 'A'isha said: These were the last words which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke (the words are): O Allah, with companions on High.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki woh kaha karte the: Koi bhi Nabi us haalat mein nahi marta jismein use apna Jannat mein ghar dikhaya na gaya ho, aur phir usse ikhtiyar na diya gaya ho. Aisha ne kaha ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) duniya se jaane hi waale the, unka sar unki jaangh par tha aur woh teen baar murchhit ho chuke the. Jab unhe rahat mehsoos hui unki aankhein chhat par sthir thin. Phir unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Uchcha saathiyon ke saath (yaani un Rasoolon ke saath jo Jannat ke sabse uchcha jagah mein rehte hain). (In alfaazon ko sunkar), maine phir (khud se) kaha: Woh humein nahi chunenge aur mujhe ek hadees yaad aayi jo unhone humein tab riwayat ki thi jab woh sehatmand the, aur jismein unhone kaha tha: Koi Nabi tab tak nahi marta jab tak woh apna Jannat mein ghar na dekh le, use phir ikhtiyar diya jaata hai. Aisha ne kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aakhri alfaaz the (alfaaz hain): Aye Allah, Uchcha saathiyon ke saath.

e: 'A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set ont on a journey, he used to cast lots amongst his wives. Once this lot came out in my favour and that of Hafsa. They (Hafsi, and 'A'isha) both went along with him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to travel (on camel) when it was night along with 'A'isha and talked with her. Hafsa said to 'A'isha: Would you like to ride upon my camel tonight and allow me to ride upon your camel and you would see (what you do not generally see) and I would see (what I do not see) generally? She said: Yes. So 'A'isha rode upon the camel of Hafsa and Hafsa rode upon the camel of 'A'isha and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came near the camel of 'A'isha. (whereas) Hafsa had been riding over that. He greeted her and then rode with her until they came down. She ('A'isha) thus missed (the company of the Holy Prophet) and when they sat down, 'A'isha felt jealous. She put her foot in the grass and said: O Allah, let the scorpion sting me or the serpent bite me. And so far as thy Messenger is concerned, I cannot say anything about him.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar par nikalte, woh apni zaujaon ke beech qura (lottery) daalte the. Ek baar ye qura mere aur Hafsa ke haq mein nikla. Woh donon (Hafsa aur Aisha) unke saath gayin aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ko (oont par) safar karte the Aisha ke saath aur unse baat karte. Hafsa ne Aisha se kaha: Kya tum aaj raat mere oont par sawaar hona chaahogi aur mujhe apne oont par sawaar hone dogi aur tum woh dekhogi (jo tum aam taur par nahi dekhti) aur main woh dekhungi (jo main aam taur par nahi dekhti)? Unhone kaha: Haan. To Aisha Hafsa ke oont par sawaar hui aur Hafsa Aisha ke oont par, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha ke oont ke qareeb aaye (jabki) Hafsa uspar sawaar thin. Unhone unhe salaam kiya aur phir unke saath sawaar rahe yahan tak ki woh utar gaye. Woh (Aisha) is tarah (Nabi-e-Paak ki sohbat) se chook gayin aur jab woh baithe, Aisha ne jalan mehsoos ki. Unhone apna paon ghaas mein rakha aur kaha: Aye Allah, bicchhu mujhe daanse ya saap mujhe kaate. Aur jahan tak Tere Rasool ka sawal hai, main unke baare mein kuch nahi keh sakti.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The excellence of 'A'isha over women is like the excellence of Tharid over all other foods.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Auraton mein Aisha ki fazeelat waisi hai jaise Tharid sab doosre khaano se behtar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se kuch doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her: Gabriel offered you greetings and I said: So there should be peace and mercy of Allah upon him.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Jibril ne tumhe salaam kiya aur maine kaha: To unpar Allah ki shaanti aur rehmat ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakriyya' through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zakariyya ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, here is Gabriel offering you greetings. She said: 1 made a reply: Let there be peace and blessings of Allah upon him, and added: He sees what I do not see.
hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, ye rahe Jibril jo tumhe salaam kar rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Maine jawaab diya: Unpar Allah ki shaanti aur barkatein ho, aur izafa kiya: Woh (Jibril) woh dekhte hain jo main nahi dekhti.

e:
'A'isha reported that (one day) there sat together eleven women making an explicit promise amongst themselves that they would conceal nothing about their spouses. The first one said: My husband is a sort of the meat of a lean camel placed at the top of a hill, which it is difficult to climb up, nor (the meat) is good enough that one finds in oneself the urge to take it away (from the top of that mountain). 
The second one said: My husband (is so bad) that I am afraid I would not be able to describe his faults-both visible and invisible completely. 
The third one said: My husband is a long-statured fellow (i. e. he lacks intelligence). If I give vent to my feelings about him, he would divorce me, and if I keep quiet I would be made to live in a state of suspense (neither completely abandoned by him nor entertained as wife). 
The fourth one said: My husband is like the night of Tihama (the night of Hijaz and Mecca), neither too cold nor hot, neither there is any fear of him nor grief. 
The fifth one said: My husband is (like) a leopard as he enters the house, and behaves like a lion when he gets out, and he does not ask about that which he leaves in the house. 
The sixth one said: So far as my husband is concerned, he eats so much that nothing is left back and when he drinks he drinks that no drop is left behind. And when he lies down he wraps his body and does not touch me so that he may know my grief. 
The seventh one said: My husband is heavy in spirit, having no brightness in him, impotent, suffering from all kinds of conceivable diseases, heaving such rough manners that he may break my head or wound my body, or may do both. 
The eighth one said: My husband is as sweet as the sweet-smelling plant, and as soft as the softness of the hare. 
The ninth one said: My husband is the master of a lofty building, long-statured, having heaps of ashes (at his door) and his house is near the meeting place and the inn. 
The tenth one said: My husband is Malik, and how fine Malik is, much above appreciation and praise (of mine). He has many folds of his camel, more in number than the pastures for them. When they (the camels) hear the sound of music they become sure that they are going to be slaughtered. 
The eleventh one said: My husband is Abu Zara'. How fine Abu Zara' is! He has suspended in my ears heavy ornaments and (fed me liberally) that my sinews and bones are covered with fat. So he made me happy. He found me among the shepherds living in the side of the mountain, and he made me the owner of the horses, camels and lands and heaps of grain and he finds no fault with me. I sleep and get up in the morning (at my own sweet will) and drink to my heart's content. The mother of Abu Zara', how fine is the mother of Abu Zara'! Her bundles are heavily packed (or receptacles in her house are filled to the brim) and the house quite spacious. So far as the son of Abu Zara' is concerned, his bed is as soft as a green palm-stick drawn forth from its bark, or like a sword drawn forth from its scabbard, and whom just an arm of a lamb is enough to satiate. So far as the daughter of Abu Zara' is concerned, how fine is the daughter of Abu Zara', obedient to her father, obedient to her mother, wearing sufficient flesh and a source of jealousy for her co-wife. As for the slave-girl of Abu Zara', how fine is she; she does not disclose our affairs to others (outside the four walls of the house). She does not remove our wheat, or provision, or take it forth, or squander it, but she preserves it faithfully (as a sacred trust). And she does not let the house fill with rubbish. One day Abu Zara' went out (of his house) when the milk was churned in the vessels, that he met a woman, having two children like leopards playing with her pomegranates (chest) under her vest. He divorced me (Umm Zara') and married that woman (whom Abu Zara') met on the way. I (Umm Zara') later on married another person, a chief, who was an expert rider, and a fine archer: he bestowed upon me many gifts and gave me one pair of every kind of animal and said: Umm Zara', make use of everything (you need) and send forth to your parents (but the fact) is that even if I combine all the gifts that he bestowed upon me, they stand no comparison to the least gift of Abu Zara'. 
'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: I am for you as Abu Zara' was for Umm Zara'.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki (ek din) gyaarah auraten ikattha baithi thin aur aapas mein saaf vaada kiya ki woh apne shohar ke baare mein kuch bhi nahi chhupaayengi. Pehli ne kaha: Mera shohar ek patle oont ke gosht jaisa hai jise ek pahaadi ki chotti par rakha gaya hai jispar chadhna mushkil hai, na hi (ye gosht) itna achha hai ki koi use uThAkar le jaane ki khwaish rakhe (pahaad ki chotti se). Doosri ne kaha: Mera shohar (itna bura hai) ki mujhe dar hai ki main uske dosh - dikhne wale aur na dikhne wale - poori tarah bayaan nahi kar paungi. Teesri ne kaha: Mera shohar ek lamba-qad shakhs hai (yaani use samajh ki kami hai). Agar main apni bhaavnaen ushke baare mein zaahir karti hoon, woh mujhe talaaq de dega, aur agar main khamosh rehti hoon, mujhe ek anishchit haalat mein jeena hoga (na poori tarah use chhoda gaya, na poori tarah zauja ke soorat mein rakha gaya). Chauthi ne kaha: Mera shohar Tihama (Hijaz aur Makkah) ki raat jaisa hai, na bahut Thanda na garam, na uska koi dar hai na koi gam. Paanchvi ne kaha: Mera shohar (baagh jaisa) hai jab woh ghar mein daakhil hota hai, aur sher jaisa vyavahaar karta hai jab woh bahar jaata hai, aur ghar mein jo chhod jaata hai uske baare mein nahi poochhta. Chhathi ne kaha: Jahan tak mere shohar ka sawal hai, woh itna khaate hain ki kuch bacha hi nahi rahta aur jab woh peete hain toh koi boond nahi bachti. Aur jab woh lete hain woh apna badan lapet lete hain aur mujhe nahi chhoote taaki unhe mera dukh pata na chale. Saatvi ne kaha: Mera shohar be-jaan sa hai, koi chamak nahi hai unmein, napunsak hai, sab kism ki soch-samajh mein aane wali beemariyon se pareshaan, itna khurdura mizaj ki woh mera sar phod sakte hain ya mera badan zakhmi kar sakte hain, ya donon kar sakte hain. AaThvi ne kaha: Mera shohar meethi khushboo waale podhe jaisa meetha hai, aur khargosh ki narmi jitna narm. Nauvin ne kaha: Mera shohar ek uchi imaarat ka maalik hai, lamba-qad, jiske (darwaze par) raakh ke Dher hain aur uska ghar milne ki jagah aur saraay ke qareeb hai. Dasvin ne kaha: Mera shohar Malik hai, aur Malik kitna behtareen hai, meri tareef aur samman se bahut zyada uchcha. Unke oonton ke bahut se jhund hain, unke charne ki jagahon se bhi zyada tadaad mein. Jab woh (oont) sangeet ki aawaaz sunte hain, unhe yaqeen ho jaata hai ki unhe zibah kiya jaane wala hai. Gyaarahvin ne kaha: Mera shohar Abu Zara hai. Abu Zara kitne behtareen hain! Unhone mere kaanon mein bhaari gehne latka diye hain aur (mujhe sakhaawat se khilaaya hai) ki meri naasein aur haddiyaan charbi se dhaki hain. Is liye unhone mujhe khush kiya. Unhone mujhe gadariyon ke beech pahaad ke kinaare rehte paaya, aur unhone mujhe ghodon, oonton aur zameenon aur anaaj ke dheron ki maalkin banaaya, aur unhe mujhme koi khaami nazar nahi aati. Main sota hoon aur subah (apni khushi se) uThta hoon aur dil bharkar peeta hoon. Abu Zara ki maa, Abu Zara ki maa kitni behtareen hain! Unke bandal bahut bhare hue hain (ya unke ghar ke bartan bhare hue hain) aur ghar kaafi vishaal hai. Jahan tak Abu Zara ke bete ka sawal hai, unka bistar hari khajoor ki chhadi jitna narm hai jo iski chhaal se nikaali gayi ho, ya ek talwaar jaisi jo apni myaan se nikaali gayi ho, aur jinhe ek bhed ka ek hi baazu tript karne ke liye kaafi hai. Jahan tak Abu Zara ki beti ka sawal hai, Abu Zara ki beti kitni behtareen hain, apne waalid ki aagyaakaari, apni maa ki aagyaakaari, poora gosht pahne hue aur apni saut ke liye jalan ka srot. Jahan tak Abu Zara ki laundi ka sawal hai, woh kitni behtareen hain; woh humaare maamle (ghar ki chaar deewaron ke baahar) doosron ko nahi bataati. Woh humaara gehun ya raashan nahi hataati, na ise le jaati hai, na barbaad karti hai, balki ise vishvaas ke saath mahfooz rakhti hai. Aur woh ghar ko kachre se nahi bharne deti. Ek din Abu Zara (apne ghar se) bahar gaye jab doodh bartano mein maThTha jaisa banaya ja raha tha, ki unki mulaqaat ek aurat se hui, jiske do bachche baagh jaise the aur uski chogha ke neeche unki chhaati ke saath khel rahe the. Unhone mujhe (Umm Zara ko) talaaq di aur us aurat se shaadi ki (jise Abu Zara raaste mein mile). Main (Umm Zara) baad mein ek doosre shakhs se shaadi ki, ek sardaar, jo ek anubhavi savaar the, aur ek achhe teerandaaz the: unhone mujhe kayi tohfe diye aur mujhe har kism ke jaanwar ka ek-ek joda diya aur kaha: Umm Zara, har cheez (jo tumhe chahiye) istemal karo aur apne maa-baap ko bhi bhejo, lekin (asal baat ye hai) ki agar main un saare tohfon ko jodun jo unhone mujhe diye, woh Abu Zara ke sabse chhote tohfe ke muqable bhi kuch nahi hain. Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Main tumhare liye waisa hi hoon jaisa Abu Zara Umm Zara ke liye the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham bin Urwa ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Miswar b. Makhramali reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say, as he sat on the pulpit: The sons of Hisham b. Mughira have asked my permission to marry their daughter with 'Ali b. Abi Talib (that refers to the daughter of Abu Jahl for whom 'All had sent a proposal for marriage). But I would not allow them, I would not allow them, I would not allow them (and the only alternative possible is) that 'Ali should divorce my daughter (and then marry their daughter), for my daughter is part of me. He who disturbs her in fact disturbs me and he who offends her offends me.
hi: Miswar bin Makhrama ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par baithe ye kehte suna: Hisham bin Mughira ki aulaad ne mujhse apni beti ki shaadi Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se karne ki ijazat maangi hai (ye Abu Jahl ki beti ka zikr hai jiske liye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne shaadi ka prastaav bheja tha). Lekin main unhe ijazat nahi dunga, main unhe ijazat nahi dunga, main unhe ijazat nahi dunga (aur sirf ek hi ikhtiyar mumkin hai) ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) mere beti ko talaaq de (aur phir unki beti se shaadi kare), kyunki meri beti mera hissa hai. Jo use pareshaan karta hai woh waastav mein mujhe pareshaan karta hai aur jo use aahat karta hai woh mujhe aahat karta hai.

e: Miswar b. Makhramah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fatima is a part of me. He in fact tortures me who tortures her.
hi: Miswar bin Makhrama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mera hissa hain. Woh waastav mein mujhe yaatna deta hai jo unhe yaatna deta hai.

e: (Imam Zain-ul-'Abidin) 'Ali b. Husain reported that when they came to Medina from Yazid b. Mu'awiya after the martyrdom of Husain b. 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) Miswar b. Makhramah met him and said to him: Is there any work for me which you ask me to do? I said to him: No. He again said to me: Would you not give me the sword of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for I fear that the people may snatch it from you? By Allah, if you give that to me, no one would be able to take it away, so long as there is life in me. Verily 'Ali b. Abi Talib sent a proposal of marriage to the daughter of Abu Jahl in spite of (the fact that his wife) Fatima (had been living in his house). Thereupon I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say while addressing the people on the pulpit. I was adolescing in those days. He said: Fatima is a part of me and I fear that she may be put to trial in regard to religion. He then made a mention of his son-in law who had been from the tribe of 'Abd Shams and praised his behaviour as a son-in-law and said: Whatever he said to me he told the truth and whatever he promised he fulfilled it for me. I am not going to declare forbidden what is lawful and make lawful what is forbidden, but, by Allah, the daaghter of Allah's Messenger and the daughter of the enemy of Allah can never be combined at one place.
hi: (Imam Zain-ul-Abidin) Ali bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki jab woh Yazid bin Muawiya se Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) (Allah unse khush ho) ki shahaadat ke baad Madina aaye, Miswar bin Makhrama unse mile aur unse kaha: Kya mere liye koi kaam hai jo aap mujhse karne ko kahen? Maine unse kaha: Nahi. Unhone phir mujhse kaha: Kya tum mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki talwaar nahi doge kyunki mujhe dar hai ki log ise tumse cheen sakte hain? Allah ki qasam, agar tum mujhe woh do, koi bhi ise le nahi paayega, jab tak mujhme jaan hai. Yaqeenan, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi ka prastaav bheja tha, is bawajood ki (unki zauja) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (unke ghar mein reh rahi thin). Isper maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko logon se mimbar par khitaab karte hue suna. Main un dinon jawaan ho raha tha. Unhone kaha: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) mera hissa hai aur mujhe dar hai ki use deen ke maamle mein pareeksha di jaaye. Phir unhone apne daamad ka zikr kiya jo Abd Shams qabile se the aur ek daamad ke soorat mein unke vyavahaar ki tareef ki aur kaha: Unhone jo bhi mujhse kaha sach kaha, aur jo bhi vaada kiya use poora kiya. Main jaayez ko haraam ilaan karne nahi ja raha aur haraam ko jaayez banaane nahi ja raha, lekin, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ki beti aur Allah ke dushman ki beti kabhi ek jagah nahi jodi jaa sakti.

e: 'Ali b. Husain reported that Miswar b. Makhramah informed him that 'Ali b. Abi Talib sent the proposal of marriage to the daughter of Abu Jahl as he had Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), (as his wife). When Fatima heard about it, she came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: The people say that you never feel angry on account of your daughters and now 'Ali is going to marry the daughter of Abu Jahl. Makhramah said: Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rose up and I heard him reciting Tashahhud and say: Now to the point. I gave a daughter of mine (Zainab) to Abu'l-'As b. Rabi, and he spoke to me and spoke the truth. Verily Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad, is a part of me and I do not approve that she may be put to any trial and by Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger cannot be combined with the daughter of God's enemy (as the co-wives) of one person. Thereupon 'Ali gave up (the idea of his intended) marriage.
hi: Ali bin Husain ne bayan kiya ki Miswar bin Makhrama ne unhe bataya ki Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi ka prastaav bheja jabki unke paas (unki zauja ke soorat mein) Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, thin. Jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne iske baare mein suna, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: Log kehte hain ki aap apni betiyon ke maamle mein kabhi naaraaz nahi hote aur ab Ali (Alayhis Salam) Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi karne wale hain. Makhrama ne kaha: Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uThe aur maine unhe Tashahhud padhte suna aur kaha: Ab humaare maqsad par aate hain. Maine apni ek beti (Zainab) Abu'l-As bin Rabi ko di, aur unhone mujhse baat ki aur sach bola. Yaqeenan, Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti, mera hissa hai aur main ye manzoor nahi karta ki use kisi bhi pareeksha mein dala jaaye, aur Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ki beti aur Allah ke dushman ki beti ek shakhs ki (patniyaan) nahi ho sakti. Isper Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne apni (irade ki) shaadi chhod di.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called his daughter Fatima (during his last illness). He said. to her something secretly and she wept. He again said to her something secretly and she laughed. 'A'isha further reported that she said to Fatima: What is that which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you secretly and you wept and then said to you something secretly and you laughed?
