Thereupon she said: He informed me secretly of his death and so I wept. He then again informed me secretly that I would be the first amongst the members of his family to follow him and so I laughed.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni beti Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko bulaaya (apni aakhri beemari mein). Unhone unse gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur woh ro pADi. Unhone phir gupt soorat se kuch aur kaha aur woh hans padi. Aisha ne aage riwayat ki ki unhone Fatima (Alayhas Salam) se kaha: Woh kya hai jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapse gupt soorat se kaha aur aap ro padi aur phir aapse gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur aap hans padi? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe gupt soorat se apni maut ke baare mein bataya is liye main royi. Unhone phir mujhe gupt soorat se bataya ki main unke khaandaan mein sabse pehle unka anusaran karungi is liye main hans padi.

e: 'A'isha reported: We, the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), were with him (during his last illness) and none was absent therefrom that Fatima, who walked after the style of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), came there, and when he saw her he welcomed her saying: You are welcome, my daughter. He their made her sit on his right side or on his left side. Then he said something secretly to her and she wept bitterly and when he found her (plunged) in grief he said to her something secretly for the second time and she laughed. I ('A'isha) said to her: Allah's Messenger has singled you amongst the women (of the family) for talking (to you something secretly) and you wept. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recovered from illness, I said to her. What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say to you? Thereupon she said: I am not going to disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, I said to her: I adjure you by the right that I have upon you that you should narrate to me what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you. She said: Yes, now I can do that (so listen to it). When he talked to me secretly for the first time he informed me that Gabirel was in the habit of reciting the Qur'an along with him once or twice every year, but this year it had been twice and so he perceived his death quite near, so fear Allah and be patient (and he told me) that he would be a befitting forerunner for me and so I wept as you saw me. And when he saw me in grief he talked to me secretly for the second time and said: Fatima, are you not pleased that you should be at the head of the believing women or the head of this Umma? I laughed and it was that laughter which you saw.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hum, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen, unke saath (unki aakhri beemari mein) thin aur koi bhi wahan se anupasthit nahi thi ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam), jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chaal ke tareeke mein chalti thin, wahan aayin, aur jab unhone unhe dekha unhone unka svaagat kiya ye kehte hue: Tumhaara svaagat hai, meri beti. Phir unhone unhe apni daayi ya baayi taraf baithaya. Phir unhone unse gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur woh zaar-zaar ro padi aur jab unhone unhe (dukh mein) doobi paaya unhone unse dobara gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur woh hans padi. Main (Aisha) ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne tumhe auraton (khaandaan ki) mein se khaas taur par choona (kuch batane ke liye) aur tum roi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) beemari se theek hue, maine unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne aapse kya kaha? Isper unhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz nahi bataungi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, maine unse kaha: Main tumhe us haq ki qasam deti hoon jo mujhe tumpar hai ki tum mujhe woh riwayat karo jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumse kaha. Unhone kaha: Haan, ab main aisa kar sakti hoon (is liye ise suno). Jab unhone pehli baar mujhse gupt soorat se baat ki, unhone mujhe bataya ki Jibril unke saath saal mein ek ya do baar Quran padha karte the, lekin is saal ye do baar hua tha aur is liye unhe apni maut nazdeek mehsoos hui, is liye Allah se Daro aur sabar rakho (aur unhone mujhse kaha) ki woh mere liye ek achha agrasar honge aur is liye main royi jaisa aapne mujhe dekha. Aur jab unhone mujhe dukh mein dekha unhone doosri baar mujhse gupt soorat se baat ki aur kaha: Fatima (Alayhas Salam), kya tum khush nahi hogi ki tum imaandaar auraton ki sardaar ho, ya is Ummat ki auraton ki sardaar ho? Main hansi aur ye woh hansi thi jo aapne dekhi.

e: `A'isha reported that all the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had gathered (in her apartment) during the days of his (Prophet's) last illness and no woman was left behind that Fatima, who walked after the style of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), came there. He welcomed her by saying: You are welcome, my daughter, and made her sit on his right side or on his left side, and then talked something secretly to her and Fatima wept. Then he talked something secretly to her and she laughed. I said to her: What makes you weep? She said: I am not going to divulge the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I (`A'isha) said: I have not seen (anything happening) like today, the happiness being more close to grief (as I see today) when she wept. I said to her: Has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) singled you out for saying something leaving us aside? She then wept and I asked her what he said, and she said: I am not going to divulge the secrets of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And when he died I again asked her and she said that he (the Holy Prophet) told her: Gabriel used to recite the Qur'an to me once a year and for this year it was twice and so I perceived that my death had drawn near, and that I (Fatima) would be the first amongst the members of his family who would meet him (in the Hereafter). He shall be my good forerunner and it made me weep. He again talked to me secretly (saying): Aren't you pleased that you should be the sovereign amongst the believing women or the head of women of this Ummah? And this made me laugh.
hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki saari zaujaen (unke kamre mein) ikattha hui thin unki (Nabi ki) aakhri beemari ke dinon mein aur koi bhi aurat peeche nahi rahi ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam), jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chaal ke tareeke mein chalti thin, wahan aayin. Unhone unka svaagat kiya ye kehte hue: Tumhaara svaagat hai, meri beti, aur unhe apni daayi ya baayi taraf baithaya, aur phir unse gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ro padi. Phir unhone unse gupt soorat se kuch kaha aur woh hans padi. Maine unse kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Unhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz nahi bataungi. Maine (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine kabhi aaj jaisi (koi ghatna hoti) nahi dekhi, khushi jo dukh ke itne qareeb ho (jaisa main aaj dekh rahi hoon) jab woh royi. Maine unse kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein chhodkar tumhe khaas taur par kuch batane ke liye chuna? Woh phir royi aur maine unse poocha unhone kya kaha, aur unhone kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz nahi bataungi. Aur jab unka intiqaal hua maine unse dobara poocha aur unhone kaha ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe bataya tha: Jibril saal mein ek baar mujhe Quran padha karte the aur is saal ye do baar tha aur is liye mujhe apni maut nazdeek mehsoos hui, aur ki main (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) unke khaandaan mein sabse pehle honi ki (Aakhirat mein) unse mile. Woh mere liye ek achha agrasar honge aur isse mujhe rona aaya. Unhone mujhse phir gupt soorat se kaha (ye kehte hue): Kya tum khush nahi hogi ki tum imaandaar auraton mein sardaar ho ya is Ummat ki auraton mein sardaar ho? Aur isse mujhe hansi aayi.

e: Salman reported: In case it lies in your power don't be one to enter the bazar first and the last to get out of that because there is a bustle and the standard of Satan is set there. He said: I was informed that Gabriel (Allah be pleased with him) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and there was with him Umin Salama and he began to talk with him. He then stood up, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to Umm Salama: (Do you know) who was he and what did he say? She said: He was Dihya (Kalbi). He reported Umm Salama having said: By Allah, I did not deem him but only he (Dihya) until I heard the address of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) informing him about us. He (the narrator) said: I said to Uthman: From whom did you hear it? He said: From Usima b. Zaid.
hi: Salman ne bayan kiya: Agar ye tumhare vash mein hai to bazaar mein sabse pehle daakhil hone waale aur sabse aakhri nikalne waale mat bano kyunki wahan hulchul hai aur Shaitaan ka jhanda wahan gada hai. Unhone kaha: Mujhe bataya gaya ki Jibril (Allah unse khush ho) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unke saath Umm Salama thin aur unhone unse baat karni shuru ki. Woh phir khade hue, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama se kaha: (Kya tumhe pata hai) woh kaun the aur unhone kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Woh Dihya (Kalbi) the. Unhone Umm Salama ke ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Allah ki qasam, main unhe kuch aur nahi samajhti thi (siwaay Dihya ke) yahan tak ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka khitaab suna jismein unhone humein unke baare mein bataya. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Maine Uthman se poocha: Aapne ye kisse suna? Unhone kaha: Usama bin Zaid se.

e: 'A'isha, the Mother of the Faithful, reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One who has the longest hands amongst you would meet me most immediately. She farther said: They (the wives of Allah's Apostle) used to measure the hands as to whose hand was the longest and it was the hand of Zainab that was the longest amongst them, as she used to work with her hand and Spend (that income) on charity.
hi: Aisha, Imaandaaron ki Maa, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se jiske haath sabse lambe hain woh mujhse sabse pehle milega. Unhone aage kaha: Woh (Allah ke Rasool ki zaujaen) apne haathon ko naapa karti thin ki kiska haath sabse lamba hai aur ye Zainab ka haath tha jo unmein sabse lamba tha, kyunki woh apne haath se kaam karti thin aur (us aamdani ko) sadaqe mein kharch karti thin.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Umm Aiman and I went along with him and she served him a drink in a vessel and he reported that the narrator said: I do not know whether it was because of the fasting (or for any other reason) that he (the Holy Prophet) refused to accept that. She raised her voice and showed annoyance to him.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Aiman ke paas gaye aur main unke saath gaya aur unhone unhe ek bartan mein peene ki cheez pesh ki aur unhone (raawi ne) riwayat ki: Mujhe nahi pata ki roze ki wajah se (ya kisi doosri wajah se) unhone ise qubool karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone apni aawaaz buland ki aur unhe naaraazgi dikhaayi.

e: Anas reported that after the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Abu Bakr said to 'Umar: Let us visit Umm Aiman as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit her. As we came to her, she wept. They (Abu Bakr and Umar) said to her: What makes you weep? What is in store (in the next world) for Allah's-Messenger (ﷺ) is better than (this worldly life). She said: I weep not because I am ignorant of the fact that what is in store for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (in the next world) is better than (this world), but I weep because the revelation which came from the Heaven has ceased to come. This moved both of them to tears and they began to weep along with her.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ke baad Abu Bakr ne Umar se kaha: Aao hum Umm Aiman se milne jaayein jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse milne jaate the. Jab hum unke paas aaye, woh royin. Unhone (Abu Bakr aur Umar ne) unse kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne rulaaya? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye jo (agli duniya mein) taiyaar hai woh is (duniyaavi zindagi) se behtar hai. Unhone kaha: Main is liye nahi roti ki mujhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye (agli duniya mein) jo taiyaar hai woh is duniya se behtar hai, lekin main is liye roti hoon ki Aasmaan se aane wali wahi rukh gayi hai. Ye baat unhe donon ko bhi rulaane laga aur woh unke saath rone lage.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not enter the house of any woman except that of his wives and that of Umm Sulaim. He used to visit her. It was said to him why it was so, whereupon he said: I feel great compassion for her. Her brother was killed while he was with me.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi aurat ke ghar mein daakhil nahi hote the siwaay apni zaujaon ke aur Umm Sulaim ke. Woh unse milne jaate the. Unse poocha gaya ki aisa kyun hai, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe unke prati bahut rehm mehsoos hoti hai. Unke bhai ka intiqaal ho gaya tha jab woh mere saath the.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I entered Paradise and heard the noise of steps. I said: Who is it? They said: She is Ghumaisa, daughter of Milhan, the mother of Anas b. Malik.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main Jannat mein daakhil hua aur qadmon ki aawaaz suni. Maine kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Ghumaisa hain, Milhan ki beti, Anas bin Malik ki maa.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I was shown Paradise and I saw the wife of Abu Talha (i.e. Umm Sulaim) and I heard the noise of steps before me and, lo, it was that of Bilal.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe Jannat dikhaayi gayi aur maine Abu Talha ki zauja (yaani Umm Sulaim) ko dekha aur maine apne aage qadmon ki aawaaz suni aur, dekho, ye Bilal ki thi.

e: Anas reported that the son of Abu Talba who was born of Umm Sulaim died. She (Umm Sulaim) said to the members of her family: Do not narrate to Abu Talha about his son until I narrate it to him. Abu Talha came (home) ; she presented to him the supper. He took it and drank water. She then embellished herself which she did not do before. He (Abu Talha) had a sexual intercourse with her and when she saw that he was satisfied after sexual intercourse with her, she said: Abu Talha, if some people borrow something from another family and then (the members of the family) ask for its return, would they resist its return? He said: No. She said: I inform you about the death of your son. He was annoyed, and said: You did not inform me until I had a sexual intercourse with you and you later on gave me information about my son. He went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him what had happened. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May Allah bless both of you in the night spent by you! He (the narrator) said: She became pregnant. Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) was in the course of a journey and she was along with him and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back to Medina from the journey he did not enter (his house) (during the night). When the people came near Medina, she felt the pangs of delivery. He (Abu Talha) remained with her and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded on. Abu Talha said: O Lord, you know that I love to go along with Allah's Messenger when he goes out and enter along with him when he enters and I have been detained as Thou seest. Umm Sulaim said: Abu Talha, I do not feel (so much pain) as I was feeling formerly, so better proceed on. So we proceeded on and she felt the pangs of delivery as they reached (Medina) and a child was born and my mother said to me: Anas, none should suckle him until you go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tomorrow morning. And when it was morning I carried him (the child) and went along with him to Allah's Messenger (may peace beupon him). He said: I saw that he had in his hand the instrument for the cauterisation of the camels. When he saw me. he said: This is, perhaps, what Umm Sulaim has given birth to. I said: Yes. He laid down that instrument on the ground. I brought that child to him and placed it in his lap and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Ajwa dates of Medina to be brought and softened them in his month. When these had become palatable he placed them in the mouth of that child. The child began to taste them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: See what love the Ansar have for dates. He then wiped his face and named him 'Abdullah.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Abu Talha ke bete ka, jo Umm Sulaim se paida hua tha, intiqaal ho gaya. Unhone (Umm Sulaim ne) khaandaan ke sadasyon se kaha: Abu Talha ko unke bete ke baare mein mat bataao jab tak main khud unhe na bataaun. Abu Talha (ghar) aaye; unhone unhe raat ka khaana pesh kiya. Unhone khaya aur paani piya. Phir unhone khud ko sanwaara jaisa unhone pehle nahi kiya tha. Unhone (Abu Talha ne) unke saath jinsi milaap kiya aur jab unhone dekha ki woh jinsi milaap ke baad santusht hain, unhone kaha: Abu Talha, agar kuch log ek khaandaan se kuch udhaar lein aur phir (khaandaan ke sadasya) uski vaapasi maangein, kya woh iski vaapasi mein virodh karenge? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Main aapko aapke bete ki maut ke baare mein bataati hoon. Woh naaraaz hue, aur kaha: Tumne mujhe tab tak nahi bataya jab tak maine tumhare saath jinsi milaap na kar liya aur baad mein tumne mujhe apne bete ke baare mein bataya. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe bataya ki kya hua tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah tum donon ko us raat mein barkat de jo tumne guzaari! Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh garbhvati ho gayin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar par the aur woh unke saath thin aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se Madina wapas aaye woh (unke ghar mein) daakhil nahi hue (us raat). Jab log Madina ke qareeb aaye, unhe zach-bachche ka dard mehsoos hui. Woh (Abu Talha) unke saath rahe aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage badh gaye. Abu Talha ne kaha: Aye Rab, Tujhe pata hai ki mujhe muhabbat hai Allah ke Rasool ke saath jaane ka jab woh nikalte hain aur unke saath daakhil hone ka jab woh daakhil hote hain aur mujhe roka gaya hai jaisa Tu dekh raha hai. Umm Sulaim ne kaha: Abu Talha, mujhe utna dard mehsoos nahi ho raha jitna pehle ho raha tha, is liye behtar hoga ki aap aage badhein. Is liye hum aage badhe aur unhe prasav dard mehsoos hui jab hum (Madina) pahunche aur ek bachcha paida hua aur meri maa ne mujhse kaha: Anas, koi bhi use doodh na pilaaye jab tak tum kal subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na jaao. Aur jab subah hui, main use (bachche ko) uThAkar unke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya. Unhone kaha: Maine dekha ki unke haath mein oonton ko daagne ka upkaran tha. Jab unhone mujhe dekha, unhone kaha: Ye shaayad woh hai jise Umm Sulaim ne paida kiya hai. Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone woh upkaran zameen par rakh diya. Main woh bachcha unke paas laaya aur use unki god mein rakh diya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina ki Ajwa khajooren mangwaayin aur unhe apne munh mein naram kiya. Jab woh khaane laayak ho gayin, unhone unhe us bachche ke munh mein daala. Bachcha unhe chakhne laga. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho Ansar ko khajooron se kitna muhabbat hai. Phir unhone uska chehra pochha aur use Abdullah naam diya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Bilal: Bilal, narrate to me which act at the time of morning prayer you did in Islam for which you hope to receive good reward, for I heard during the night the sound of your steps before me in Paradise. Bilal said: I did not do any act in Islam for which I hope to get any benefit but this that when I perform complete ablution during the night or day I observe prayer with that purification what Allah has ordained for me to pray.
hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bilal se kaha: Bilal, mujhe bataao subah ki namaz ke waqt Islam mein tumne kaunsa amal kiya jiske liye tum achhe sawaab ki ummeed rakhte ho, kyunki maine raat ko Jannat mein apne aage tumhaare qadmon ki aawaaz suni. Bilal ne kaha: Maine Islam mein aisa koi amal nahi kiya jiske liye main koi faayda paane ki ummeed rakhta hoon siwaay is baat ke ki jab main raat ya din mein mukammal wuzu karta hoon main us pavitrata ke saath namaz padhta hoon jo Allah ne mujhe padhne ka farz kiya hai.

e: Abdullah reported that when this verse was revealed: " There is no harm on persons who believe and perform good acts, what they had eaten (formerly) when they avoided it (now) and they affirmed their faith" (v. 93) up to the end. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: You are one amongst them.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Un logon par koi dosh nahi hai jo imaan rakhte hain aur nekokaar amal karte hain, jo unhone (pehle) khaaya tha jab unhone (ab) isse parhez kiya aur unhone apna imaan pushT kiya" (5:93) akhir tak. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Tum unmein se ek ho.

e: Abu Musa reported: When I and my brother came from Yemen we used to consider Ibn Mas'ud and his mother amongst the members of the household. of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) because of their visiting them frequently and staying there for long (periods of) time.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Jab main aur mera bhai Yemen se aaye hum Ibn Mas'ud aur unki maa ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke khaandaan mein se maante the kyunki woh baar-baar unse milne jaate aur wahan lambe (waqt) tak rehte the.

e: The above hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Upar wali hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa. reported: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and thought that 'Abdullah was amongst the members of the family, or like that.
hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur socha ki Abdullah khaandaan ke sadasyon mein se hain, ya kuch isi jaisa.

e: Abu Ishaq reported that he heard Abu'l-Ahwas say: I was along with Abu Musa and Abu Mas'ud as Ibn Mas'ud died and one of them said to the other: Do you find one like him besides him? Thereupon he said: Do you say this (no one can be his rival)? He was admitted (to the company of the Holy Prophet) whereas we were detained and he had been present in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whereas we had been absent.
hi: Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu'l-Ahwas ko ye kehte suna: Main Abu Musa aur Abu Mas'ud ke saath tha jab Ibn Mas'ud ka intiqaal hua aur unmein se ek ne doosre se kaha: Kya tumhe unke jaisa koi (aur) milta hai? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tum ye kehte ho (koi unka pratidwandi nahi ho sakta)? Unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ki sohbat mein) daakhila mila jabki humein roka gaya tha aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein maujood the jabki hum anupasthit the.

e: Abu Ahwas reported: We were in the house of Abu Musa along with some of the companions of 'Abdullah and they were looking at the Holy Book. 'Abdullah stood up, whereupon Abu Mas'ud said: I do not know whether Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) has left after him one having a better knowledge (of Islam) than the man who is standing. Abu Musa said: If you say this, that is correct, because he had been present when we had been absent and he was permitted when we were detained.
hi: Abu Ahwas ne bayan kiya: Hum Abu Musa ke ghar mein Abdullah ke kuch sahaba ke saath the aur woh Muqaddas Kitaab dekh rahe the. Abdullah khade hue, isper Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne baad koi behtareen (Islam ka) ilm rakhne wala shakhs chhoda hai us aadmi se jo khada hai. Abu Musa ne kaha: Agar tum ye kehte ho, to ye sahi hai, kyunki woh maujood the jab hum anupasthit the aur unhe ijazat mili thi jab humein roka gaya tha.

e: Zaid b. Wahab reported: I was sitting along with Hudhaifa and Abu Musa, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Zaid bin Wahab ne bayan kiya: Main Hudhaifa aur Abu Musa ke saath baitha tha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that he (said to his companions to conceal their copies of the Qur'an) and further said: He who conceals anything he shall have to bring that which he had concealed on the Day of judgment, and then said: After whose mode of recitation you command me to recite? I in fact recited before AIlah's Messenger (ﷺ) more than seventy chapters of the Qur'an and the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) know it that I have better understanding of the Book of Allah (than they do), and if I were to know that someone had better understanding than I, I would have gone to him. Shaqiq said: I sat in the company of the Companions of Mubkmmad (ﷺ) but I did not hear anyone having rejected that (that is, his recitation) or finding fault with it.
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya (unhone apne sahaba se kaha ki woh apni Quran ki prtiyaan chhupaayein) aur phir kaha: Jo kuch bhi chhupaata hai use Qayamat ke din woh jo usne chhupaaya use laana hoga, aur phir kaha: Kiske Quran padhne ke tareeke ka anusaran karne ka tum mujhe hukum dete ho? Maine waastav mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Quran ke sattar se zyada adhyaay padhe hain aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba jaante hain ki mujhe Allah ki Kitaab ki (unse zyada) behtareen samajh hai, aur agar mujhe pata chalta ki kisi ko mujhse behtar samajh hai, main unke paas jaata. Shaqiq ne kaha: Main Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ki sohbat mein baitha lekin maine kisi ko usse (yaani unke padhne ke tareeke se) inkaar karte ya usmein khaami dhoondhte nahi suna.

e: Abdullah reported: By Him besides Whom there is no god, there is no chapter in the Book of Allah about which I do not know as to where it was revealed and there is no verse about which I do not know in what context it was revealed, and if I were to know of one having a better understanding of the Book of Allah than I (and I could reach him) on the back of the mule, I would have definitely gone to him on camel's back.
hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Allah ki Kitaab mein koi aisa adhyaay nahi hai jiske baare mein mujhe nahi pata ki ye kahan nazil hua, aur koi aisi aayat nahi hai jiske baare mein mujhe nahi pata ki kis silsile mein ye nazil hui, aur agar mujhe pata chalta ki koi Allah ki Kitaab ki mujhse zyada behtar samajh rakhta hai (aur main unhe pahunch sakta hoon) khachchar ki peeth par, to main zaroor unke paas oont ki peeth par jaata.

e: Masruq reported: We used to go to Abdullah b. 'Amr and talk to him, Ibn Numair said: One day we made a mention of Abdullah b. Mas'ud, whereupon he said: You have made mention of a person whom I love more than anything else. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn Qur'an from four persons: Ibn Umm 'Abd (i. e. 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud) he started from him-then Mu'adh b. Jabal and Ubayya b. Ka'b, then Salim the ally of Abu Hudhaifa.
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Amr ke paas jaate aur unse baat karte. Ibn Numair ne kaha: Ek din humne Abdullah bin Mas'ud ka zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Tumne us shakhs ka zikr kiya jise main sabse zyada muhabbat karta hoon. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Quran chaar logon se seekho: Ibn Umm Abd (yaani Abdullah bin Mas'ud) - unhone unse shuru kiya - phir Mu'adh bin Jabal aur Ubayy bin Ka'b, phir Salim, Abu Hudhaifa ke saathi.

e: Masruq reported: We were in the company of Abdullah b 'Amr that we made a mention of a hadith from Abdullah b. Mas'ud; thereupon he said: That is a person whose love ever remains (fresh in my heart) after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn Qur'an from four persons: Ibn Umm 'Abd, i e. Abdullah b. Mas'ud and he started from his name-then Ubayy b. Ka'b and Mu'adh b Jabal. Zuhri did not make a mention of the words yaquluhu in his narration
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Amr ki sohbat mein the jab humne Abdullah bin Mas'ud se mutaliq ek hadees ka zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye woh shakhs hain jinka muhabbat hamesha (mere dil mein taaza) rehta hai maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Quran chaar logon se seekho: Ibn Umm Abd, yaani Abdullah bin Mas'ud, aur unhone unke naam se shuru kiya - phir Ubayy bin Ka'b aur Mu'adh bin Jabal. Zuhri ne apni riwayat mein "yaquluhu" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba and Abu Kuraib, and both of them said: Abu Mu'awiya narrated to us from A'mash on the authority of Jarir and Waki', and in a narration of Abu Bakr transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya the mention of Mu'adh has preceded Ubayy's, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Kuraib, the name of Ubayy preceded Mu'ddh's.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bakr bin Abu Shaiba aur Abu Kuraib ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur donon ne kaha: Abu Mu'awiya ne humein A'mash ki sanad se Jarir aur Waki ke hawale se riwayat ki, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein jo Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se hai, Mu'adh ka zikr Ubayy se pehle aata hai, aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein, Ubayy ka naam Mu'adh se pehle aata hai.

e: This tradition has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba through A'mash, but there is a difference of order of the four.
hi: Ye riwayat Shu'ba ki sanad se A'mash ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein chaaron ke kram mein antar hai.

e: Masruq reported: They made a mention of Ibn Mas'ud before 'Abdullah b. Amr, whereupon he said: He is a person whose love is always fresh in my heart after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn the recita- tion of the Qur'an from four persons: from Ibn Mas'ud, Salim, the ally of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubayy b. Ka'b, Mu'adh b. Jabal.
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Unhone Abdullah bin Amr ke saamne Ibn Mas'ud ka zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Woh ek shakhs hain jinka muhabbat mere dil mein hamesha taaza rehta hai maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Quran padhna chaar logon se seekho: Ibn Mas'ud se, Salim se, Abu Hudhaifa ke saathi, Ubayy bin Ka'b se, Mu'adh bin Jabal se.

e: Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh reported it on the authority of his father Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition. He made a mention of these two names but I do not know whose name he mentioned first.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh ne ise apne waalid Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki aur ye izafa kiya. Unhone in do naamon ka zikr kiya lekin mujhe nahi pata ki unhone kiska naam pehle liya.

e: Anas is reported to have said: Four persons collected the Qur'an during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and all of them were Ansar: Mu'adh b. Jabal, Ubayy b. Ka'b, Zaid b. Thabit, Abu Zaid. Qatada said: Anas, who was Abu Zaid? He said: He was one of my uncles.
hi: Anas ke baare mein riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone kaha: Chaar logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein Quran ikattha kiya aur woh sab Ansar the: Mu'adh bin Jabal, Ubayy bin Ka'b, Zaid bin Thabit, Abu Zaid. Qatada ne kaha: Anas, Abu Zaid kaun the? Unhone kaha: Woh mere chachaon mein se ek the.

e: Hammam said: I said to Anas b. Malik: Who collected the Qur'an during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Four (persons), all of them belonging to Ansir: Ubayy b. Ka'b, Mu'adh b. Jabal, Zaid b. Thabit and a person from the Ansar whose Kunya was Abu Zaid.
hi: Hammam ne kaha: Maine Anas bin Malik se kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein Quran kisne ikattha kiya? Unhone kaha: Chaar (log), sab Ansar se mutaliq: Ubayy bin Ka'b, Mu'adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit aur Ansar mein se ek shakhs jinki Kunya Abu Zaid thi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Ubayy: Verily Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has commanded me to recite the Qur'an to you, whereupon he said: (Has) Allah mentioned my name to you? He said: Allah has mentioned your name to me. Thereupon he began to shed tears (of joy)
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ubayy se kaha: Yaqeenan Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne mujhe tumhe Quran padhne ka hukum diya hai, isper unhone kaha: (Kya) Allah ne aapko mera naam bataya? Unhone kaha: Allah ne mujhe tumhaara naam bataaya. Isper woh khushi ke aansu bahaane lage.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Ubayy b. Ka'b: I have been commanded to recite to you the Sura (al- Bayyinah) which opens with these words (Lam Yakunil-ladhiyna Kafaruu) He said: Has he mentioned to you my name? He said: Yes; thereupon he shed tears of joy.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ubayy bin Ka'b se kaha: Mujhe tumhe Sura (al-Bayyinah) padhne ka hukum diya gaya hai jo in alfaazon se shuru hoti hai (Lam Yakunil-ladhiyna Kafaruu). Unhone kaha: Kya unhone aapko mera naam bataya? Unhone kaha: Haan; isper woh khushi ke aansu bahaane lage.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while the bier of Sa'd b. Mu'adh was placed before them: The Throne of the most Gracious shook at the death of Sa'd b. Mu'adh.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna jab Sa'd bin Mu'adh ka taabut unke saamne rakha gaya: Rehmvaan ka Singhaasan Sa'd bin Mu'adh ki maut par hila.

e: Jabir reported that the Throne of the most Compassionate shook because of the death of Sa'd b. Mu'adh.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Rehmvaan ka Singhaasan Sa'd bin Mu'adh ki maut ki wajah se hila.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: That his bier (that of Sa'd) was placed (before them) and the Throne of the most Compassionate shook.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Unka taabut (Sa'd ka) (unke saamne) rakha gaya aur Rehmvaan ka Singhaasan hila.

e: Al-Bara' reported that a garment of silk was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). His Companions touched it and admired its softness; there- upon he said: Do you admire the softness of this (cloth)? The handkerchiefs of Sa'd b. Mu'adh in Paradise are better than this.
hi: Al-Bara ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko resham ka ek kapda pesh kiya gaya. Unke sahaba ne ise chhua aur iski narmi ki tareef ki; isper unhone kaha: Kya tum iski (is kapde ki) narmi ki tareef karte ho? Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke Jannat mein rumaal ismein zyada behtar hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba combining the two chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se do sanadon ko joDkar riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented a garment of sundus and he prohibited the use of silk. The persons admired it, whereupon he said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the kerchiefs of Sa'd b. Mu'adh in Paradise are better than this.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sundus (resham) ka ek kapda pesh kiya gaya aur unhone resham ke istemal se mana kiya. Logon ne iski tareef ki, isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, Sa'd bin Mu'adh ke Jannat mein rumaal ismein zyada behtar hain.

e: Anas reported the king of Dumat al-Jandal presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the garment and lie made no mention (of the fact) that he prohibited the use of silk.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Dumat al-Jandal ke raja ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kapda pesh kiya aur unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya ki unhone resham ke istemal se mana kiya.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of his sword on the Day of Uhud and said: Who would take it from me? All the persons stretched their hands saying: I would do it, I would do it. He (Allah's Apostle) said: Who would take it in order to fulfil its rights? Then the people withdrew their hands. Simak b. Kharasha Abu Dujana said: I am here to take it and fulfil its rights. He took it and struck the heads of the polytheists.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ke din apni talwaar pakadi aur kaha: Isse mujhse kaun lega? Sab logon ne apne haath phailaaye ye kehte hue: Main lunga, main lunga. Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Isse iske haq poore karne ke liye kaun lega? Phir logon ne apne haath peeche kar liye. Simak bin Kharasha Abu Dujana ne kaha: Main ise lene aur iske haq poore karne ke liye taiyaar hoon. Unhone ise liya aur mushrikeen ke saron par vaar kiye.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: The dead body of my father was brought and he was covered (with cloth) and it had been mutilated. I made an attempt to lift the cloth, but my people prohibited me to do so. I again made an attempt to lift the cloth, but my people prohibited me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted it or he commanded it to be lifted. He heard the noise (of a loud) weeping, or the noise of a woman mourner. He inquired who she was. They said: The daughter of 'Amr or the sister of Amr, whereupon he said: Why does she weep? The Angels provide him shade with the help of their Wings until he would be lifted (to his heavenly abode)
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid ka murda badan laaya gaya aur woh (kapde se) dhaka hua tha aur ye vikrit ho gaya tha. Maine kapda uThAne ki koshish ki, lekin mere logon ne mujhe aisa karne se roka. Maine phir kapda uThAne ki koshish ki, lekin mere logon ne mujhe roka. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise uThAya ya ise uThAne ka hukum diya. Unhone (zoro se) rone ki, ya shok manaane waali aurat ki aawaaz suni. Unhone poocha ki woh kaun hai. Unhone kaha: Amr ki beti, ya Amr ki behn, isper unhone kaha: Woh kyun ro rahi hai? Farishte apne pankhon se unhe chhaaya de rahe hain jab tak unhe (unke svargeeya ghar tak) uThAya jaayega.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: My father fell as a martyr on the Day of Uhud and I attempted to uncover his face and weep, but they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) forbade me to do this, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not forbid me and Fatima bint Amr, the sister of my father, was also weeping There- upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You may weep or you may not weep; the Angels provide him shade with the help of their wings until you lift him (to be buried in the grave).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid Uhud ke din shaheed ho gaye aur maine unka chehra khol kar rone ki koshish ki, lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ke sahaba ne) mujhe aisa karne se mana kiya, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe mana nahi kiya aur Fatima bint Amr, mere waalid ki behn, bhi ro rahi thin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum ro sakte ho ya na ro sakte ho; Farishte unhe apne pankhon se chhaaya de rahe hain jab tak tum unhe (qabar mein dafn karne ke liye) uThAte ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters, but with this difference that there is no mention of the Angels and the weeping of a female mourner.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin is antar ke saath ki ismein Farishton aur shok manaane wali aurat ke rone ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Jabir reported: My father was brought in a state that his ears had been cut off and (his dead body) was placed before Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Mere waalid ko is haalat mein laaya gaya ki unke kaan kaat diye gaye the aur (unka murda badan) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne rakha gaya, baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Barza reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was there in a battlefield that Allah conferred upon him the spoils of war. He said to his Companions: Is anyone missing amongst you? They said: So and so and so. He again said: Is there anyone missing amongst you? They said: So and so and so. He then said: Is there anyone missing amongst you? They said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: But I am missing Julaibib. They (his Companions) searched him amongst those who had been killed and they found him by the side of seven (dead bodies) whom he had killed and he had been killed (by the oppoments). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came there and stood (by his side) and said: He killed seven (persons). Then (his opponents) killed him. He is mine and I am his. He then placed him upon his hands and there was none else to lift but Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Then the grave was dug for him and he was placed in the grave and no mention is made of a bath.
hi: Abu Barza ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek jung ke maidaan mein the ki Allah ne unhe jung ka maal-e-ganimat diya. Unhone apne sahaba se kaha: Kya tum mein se koi gaayab hai? Unhone kaha: Falan-falan aur falan-falan. Unhone dobara kaha: Kya tum mein se koi gaayab hai? Unhone kaha: Falan-falan aur falan-falan. Phir unhone kaha: Kya tum mein se koi gaayab hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Lekin mujhe Julaibib gaayab lagta hai. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) unhe maare gaye logon mein dhoondha aur unhe saat (murdon) ke bagal mein paaya jinhe unhone qatal kiya tha aur unhe (virodhiyon ke zariye) qatal kar diya gaya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye aur (unke bagal mein) khade hue aur kaha: Unhone saat logon ko qatal kiya. Phir unhe (unke virodhiyon ne) qatal kiya. Woh mera hai aur main uska hoon. Phir unhone use apne haathon par rakha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ilawa koi doosra nahi tha jo unhe uThAta. Phir unke liye qabar khodi gayi aur unhe qabar mein rakha gaya aur kisi snaan ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e:
'Abdullah b. Samit reported that Abu Dharr said: We set out from our tribe Ghafir who look upon the prohibited months as permissible months. I and my brother Unais and our mother stayed with our maternal uncle who treated us well. The men of his tribe fell jealous and they said: When you are anay from your house, Unais commits adultery with your wife. Our -naternal uncle came and he accused us of the sin which was conveyed to him. I said: You have undone the good you did to us. We cannot stay with you after this. We came to our camels and loaded (our) luggage. Our maternal uncle began to weep covering himself with (a piece of) cloth. We proceeded on until we encamped by the side of Mecca. Unais cast lot on the camels (we had) and an equal number (above that). They both went to a Kahin and he made Unais win and Unais came with our camels and an equal number along with them. He (Abu Dharr) said: My nephew, I used to observe prayer three years before my meeting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said: For whom did you say prayer? He said: For Allah. I said: To which direction did you turn your face (for observing prayer)? He said: I used to turn my face as Allah has directed me to turn my face. I used to observe the night prayer at the time of the end of night and I fell down in prostration like the mantle until the sun rose over me. Unais said: I have a work in Mecca, so you better stay here. 
Unais went until he came to Mecca and he came to me late. I said: What did you do? He said: I met a person in Mecca who is on your religion and he claims that verily it is Allah Who has sent him. I said: What do the people say about him? He said: They say that he is a poet or a Kahin or a magician. Unais who was himself one of the poets said. I have heard the words of a Kahin but his words in no way resemble his (words). And 1 also compared his words to the verses of poets but such words cannot be uttered by any poet. By Allah, he is truthful and they are liars. Then I said: you stay here, until I go, so that I should see him. He said: I came to Mecca and I selected an insignificant person from amongst them and said to him: Where is he whom you call as-Sabi? He pointed out towards me saying: He is Sabi. Thereupon the people of the valley attacked me with sods and bows until I fell down unconscious. I stood up after havin. regained my consciousness and I found as if I was a red idol. I came to Zamzarn and washed blood from me and drank water from it and listen, O son of my brother, I stayed there for thirty nights or days and there was no food for me but the water of Zamzarn. And I became so bulky that there appeared wrinkles upon my stomach, and I did not feel any hunger in my stomach. It was during this time that the people of Mecca slept in the moonlit night and none was there to eircumambulate the House but only two women who had been invoking the name of Isafa, and Na'ila (the two idols). 
They came to me while in their circuit and I said: Marry one with the other, but they did not dissuade from their invoking. They came to me and I said to them: Insert wood (in the idols' private parts). (I said this to them in such plain words) as I could not express in metaphorical terms. These women went away crying and saying: Had there been one amongst our people (he would have taught a lesson to you for the obscene words used for our idols before us). These women met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr who had also been coming down the hill. He asked them: What has happened to you? They said: There is Sabi, who has hidden himself between the Ka'ba and its curtain. He said: What did he say to you? They said: He uttered such words before us as we cannot express. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and he kissed the Black Stone and circumambulated the House along with his Companion and then observed prayer, and when he had finished his prayer, Abu Dharr said: I was the first to greet him with the salutation of peace and uttered (these words) in this way; Allah's Messen- ger, may there be peace upon you, whereupon he said: It may be upon you too and the mercy of Allah. He then said: Who are you? I said: From the tribe of Ghifar. He leaned his hand and placed his finger on his forehead and I said to myself: Perhaps he has not liked it that I belong to the tribe of Ghifar. 
I attempted to catch hold of his hand but his friend who knew about him more than I dissuaded me f rom doing so. He then lifted his head and said: Since how long have you been here? I said: I have been here for the last thirty nights or days. He said: Who has been feeding you? I said: There has been no food for me but the water of Zamzam. I have grown so bulky that there appear wrinkles upon my stomach and I do not feel any hunger. He said: It is blessed (water) and it also serves as food. Thereupon Abu Bakr said: Allah's Messenger, let me serve as a host to him for tonight, and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded forth and so did Abu Bakr and I went along with them. Abu Bakr opened the door and then he brought for us the raisins of Ta'if and that was the first food which I ate there. Then I stayed as long as I had to stay. I then came to Allah's Messenaer (ﷺ) and he said: I have been shown the land abound- ing in trees and I think it cannot be but that of Yathrib (that is the old name of Medina). You are a preacher to your people on my behalf. I hope Allah would benefit them through you and He would reward you. I came to Unais and he said: What have you done? I said: I have done that I have embraced Islam and I have testified (to the prophethood of Allah's Messenger). He said: I have no aversion for your religion and I also embrace Islam and testify (to the prophethood of Muhammad). Then both of us came to our mother and she said: I have no aversion for your religion and I also embrace Islam and testify to the prophethood of Muhammad. We then loaded our camels and came to our tribe Ghifir and half of the tribe embraced Islam and their chief was Aimi' b. Rahada Ghifirl and he was their leader and hall of the tribe said: We will embrace Islam when Allah's Messenger (may p,. ace be upon him) would come to Medina, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina the remaining half also embraced Islam. Then a tribe Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, we also embrace Islam like our brothers who have embraced Islam. And they also embraced Islam. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah granted pardon to the tribe of Ghifar and Allah saved (from destruction) the tribe of Aslam.
hi: Abdullah bin Samit ne bayan kiya ki Abu Dharr ne kaha: Hum apne qabile Ghafir se nikle jo mana kiye gaye mahinon ko jaayez maante the. Main, mera bhai Unais aur humari maa apne mama ke saath rahe jo humare saath achha vyavahaar karte the. Unke qabile ke logon ko jalan hui aur unhone kaha: Jab tum apne ghar se door ho, Unais tumhaari zauja ke saath zina karta hai. Humaare mama aaye aur unhone humpar us gunah ka ilzaam lagaaya jo unhe pahunchaaya gaya tha. Maine kaha: Aapne humari achhaai bigaad di jo aapne humare liye ki thi. Hum iske baad aapke saath nahi reh sakte. Hum apne oonton ke paas aaye aur (apna) saamaan lada. Humaare mama rone lage khud ko kapde se dhankte hue. Hum aage badhe yahan tak ki hum Makkah ke qareeb ruke. Unais ne oonton par qura (lottery) daala aur unke barabar (aur zyada) tadaad (kisi aur cheez par bhi). Woh donon ek Kahin (jyotishi) ke paas gaye aur usne Unais ko jitwaaya aur Unais humare oont aur unke barabar tadaad aur cheezein lekar aaya. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Mere bhatije, main teen saal pehle namaz padha karta tha isse pehle ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milta. Maine kaha: Aap kiske liye namaz padhte the? Unhone kaha: Allah ke liye. Maine kaha: Aap apna chehra kis simt mein modte the (namaz padhne ke liye)? Unhone kaha: Main apna chehra usi simt mein modta jaisa Allah ne mujhe modne ka margdarshan diya. Main raat ke aakhri hisse mein raat ki namaz padhta aur main chogha jaisa sajde mein girta yahan tak ki suraj mujhpar chadh jaata. Unais ne kaha: Mujhe Makkah mein ek kaam hai, is liye behtar hoga ki aap yahan ruko. Unais gaye yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche aur der se mere paas aaye. Maine kaha: Aapne kya kiya? Unhone kaha: Main Makkah mein ek shakhs se mila jo tumhare deen par hai aur woh daawa karta hai ki Allah ne unhe bheja hai. Maine kaha: Log unke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Woh kehte hain ki woh ek kavi hain ya Kahin ya jaadugar hain. Unais, jo khud kaviyon mein se the, ne kaha: Maine ek Kahin ke alfaaz sune hain lekin unke alfaaz kisi bhi tarah unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) alfaazon se milte-julte nahi hain. Aur maine unke alfaazon ki tulna kaviyon ki shayari se bhi ki lekin aise alfaaz koi kavi nahi kah sakta. Allah ki qasam, woh sachche hain aur woh log jhoote hain. Phir maine kaha: Tum yahan ruko, jab tak main jaaun, taaki main unhe dekh sakoon. Unhone kaha: Main Makkah aaya aur maine unmein se ek mamuli shakhs ko chuna aur usse kaha: Woh kahan hai jise tum as-Sabi kehte ho? Usne mujhe ishara kiya, ye kehte hue: Ye rahe Sabi. Isper wadi ke logon ne mujhpar mitti ke Dhelon aur dhanushon se hamla kiya yahan tak ki main behosh gir gaya. Main hosh mein aane ke baad khada hua aur paaya ki jaise main ek laal murti hoon. Main Zamzam ke paas aaya aur apna khoon dhoya aur ismein se paani piya, aur suno, mere bhai ke bete, main tees raaton ya dinon tak wahan raha aur mere liye Zamzam ke paani ke siwaay koi khaana nahi tha. Aur main itna vishaal ho gaya ki mere pet par tahen pragat huin, aur mujhe apne pait mein koi bhookh mehsoos nahi hui. Ye us waqt tha jab Makkah ke log chaandni raat mein soye the aur koi bhi Ghar (Kaaba) ka tawaaf karne wala nahi tha siwaay do auraton ke jo Isafa aur Na'ila (do murtiyon) ka naam pukaar rahi thin. Woh apne chakkar mein mere paas aayin aur maine kaha: Ek ko doosre se shaadi karwaao, lekin unhone apna pukaarna nahi chhoda. Woh mere paas aayin aur maine unse kaha: Lakdi daalo (murtiyon ke gupt ang mein). (Maine ye unse itne saaf alfaazon mein kaha) kyunki main mahaavir alfaazon mein zaahir nahi kar saka. Ye auraten rote hue chali gayin ye kehte hue: Kaash humare logon mein se koi hota (woh tumhe humaari murtiyon ke liye istemal kiye gaye ashleel alfaazon ke liye sabak sikhaata). In auraton ki mulaqaat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr se hui jo pahaad se neeche aa rahe the. Unhone unse poocha: Tumhe kya hua? Unhone kaha: Wahan Sabi hai, jo apne aap ko Kaaba aur uske parde ke beech chhipa chuka hai. Unhone kaha: Usne tumse kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Usne humaare saamne aise alfaaz kahe jo hum bayaan nahi kar sakte. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur unhone Kaale Patthar ko chuma aur apne saathi ke saath Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur phir namaz padhi, aur jab unhone apni namaz khatm ki, Abu Dharr ne kaha: Main sabse pehla tha jisne unhe shaanti ka salaam kiya aur ye (alfaaz) is tarah kahe: Allah ke Rasool, aap par shaanti ho, isper unhone kaha: Ye tumpar bhi ho aur Allah ki rehmat. Phir unhone kaha: Tum kaun ho? Maine kaha: Ghifar qabile se. Unhone apna haath jhukaaya aur apni ungli apni peshaani par rakhi aur maine khud se kaha: Shaayad unhe pasand nahi aaya ki main Ghifar qabile se hoon. Maine unka haath pakadne ki koshish ki lekin unke dost, jo unhe mujhse zyada jaante the, ne mujhe aisa karne se roka. Unhone phir apna sar uThAya aur kaha: Tum yahan kab se ho? Maine kaha: Main yahan pichhli tees raaton ya dinon se hoon. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kaun khilaa raha hai? Maine kaha: Mere liye Zamzam ke paani ke siwaay koi khaana nahi raha. Main itna vishaal ho gaya hoon ki mere pait par tahen pragat hoti hain aur mujhe koi bhookh mehsoos nahi hoti. Unhone kaha: Ye barkat waala (paani) hai aur ye khaane ka bhi kaam deta hai. Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe unki aaj raat mehmaannawaazi karne dijiye, aur phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage badhe aur Abu Bakr bhi, aur main unke saath gaya. Abu Bakr ne darwaza khola aur phir humare liye Ta'if ki kishmish laaye aur ye pehla khaana tha jo maine wahan khaaya. Phir main jitna rehna tha utna raha. Main phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Mujhe darakhton se bhari ek zameen dikhaayi gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai ki ye Yathrib (Madina ka purana naam) ke siwaay aur kuch nahi ho sakti. Tum mere taraf se apne logon ke liye ek prachaarak ho. Mujhe ummeed hai ki Allah tumhare zariye unhe faayda pahunchaayega aur Woh tumhe sawaab dega. Main Unais ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Tumne kya kiya? Maine kaha: Maine ye kiya ki maine Islam qubool kiya aur (Allah ke Rasool ki nabuwwat ki) gawaahi di. Unhone kaha: Mujhe tumhaare deen se koi vimukhta nahi hai aur main bhi Islam qubool karta hoon aur (Muhammad ki nabuwwat ki) gawaahi deta hoon. Phir hum dono apni maa ke paas aaye aur unhone kaha: Mujhe tumhaare deen se koi vimukhta nahi hai aur main bhi Islam qubool karti hoon aur Muhammad ki nabuwwat ki gawaahi deti hoon. Hum phir apne oont lade aur apne qabile Ghifar ke paas aaye aur aadha qabila Islam qubool kar chuka tha aur unke sardaar Aimi bin Rahada Ghifari the aur woh unke agua the aur aadha qabila ne kaha: Hum Islam tab qubool karenge jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aayenge, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye, baaki aadha qabila bhi Islam mein daakhil ho gaya. Phir Aslam qabila Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum bhi apne bhaiyon ki tarah Islam qubool karte hain jinhone Islam qubool kiya hai. Aur unhone bhi Islam qubool kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne Ghifar qabile ko maafi di aur Allah ne Aslam qabile ko (tabaahi se) bachaaya.

e: This hadlth has been narrated on the authority of Humaid b. Hilal with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " As I came to Mecca, Unais said: (Well), go but be on your guard against the Meccans for they are his enemies and are annoyed with him."
hi: Ye hadees Humaid bin Hilal ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Jab main Makkah aaya, Unais ne kaha: (Achha), jaao lekin Makkah walon se savdhaan raho kyunki woh unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) dushman hain aur unse naaraaz hain."

e: Abdullah b. Samit reported that Abu Dharr said: Son of my brother, I used to observe prayer two years before the advent of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). I said: To which direction did you turn your face? He said: To which Allah directed me to turn my face. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition that they went to a Kahin and his brother Unais began to praise him until he (in verses declared) him (Unais) as winner (in the contest of poetry), and so we got his camels, mixed them with our camels, and there is in this hadith also these words that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came there and he circumambulated the House and observed two Rak'ahs of prayer behind the Station (of Ibrahim). I came to him and I was the first amongst persons to greet him with Assalam-o-'Alaikum, and I said to Allah's Messenger Let there be peace upon you. And he said: Let there be peace upon you too; who are you? And in the hadith (these words are) also found: Since how long have you been here? And Abu Bakr said: Let him be my guest tonight.
hi: Abdullah bin Samit ne bayan kiya ki Abu Dharr ne kaha: Mere bhai ke bete, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aagman se do saal pehle namaz padha karta tha. Maine kaha: Aap kis simt mein apna chehra modte the? Unhone kaha: Jis simt mein Allah ne mujhe modne ka margdarshan diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath ki woh ek Kahin ke paas gaye aur unke bhai Unais ne unki tareef karni shuru ki yahan tak ki unhone (shayari mein) unhe (Unais ko) fatehyaab qarar diya, aur is tarah humein unke oont mile jinhe humne apne oonton ke saath mila liya, aur is hadees mein ye alfaaz bhi hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye aur unhone Ghar ka tawaaf kiya aur Jagah (Ibrahim ke) ke peeche do rakat namaz padhi. Main unke paas aaya aur main pehla tha jisne unhe Assalamu-Alaikum se salaam kiya, aur maine Allah ke Rasool se kaha: Aap par shaanti ho. Aur unhone kaha: Tumpar bhi shaanti ho; tum kaun ho? Aur hadees mein (ye alfaaz bhi milte hain): Tum yahan kab se ho? Aur Abu Bakr ne kaha: Unhe aaj raat mera mehmaan hone do.

e: Ibn `Abbas reported that when Abu Dharr heard of the advent of the Apostle (ﷺ) in Mecca he said: Brother, ride in this valley and bring information for me about the person who claims that there comes to him information from the Heavens. Listen to his words and then come to me. So he rode on until he came to Mecca and he heard his words (the sacred words of the Holy Prophet) and then came back to Abu Dharr and said: I have seen him exhorting (people) to develop good morals and his expressions can in no way be termed as poetry. He (Abu Dharr) said: I have not been satisfied with it regarding that which I had in my mind (as I sent you). So he took up provisions for the journey and a small water-skin containing water (and set forth) until he came to Mecca. He came to the mosque (Ka`bah) and began to look for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he did not recognize him (the Holy Prophet) and he did not even like that he should ask about him from anyone until it was night, and he slept. `Ali saw him and found him to be a stranger. So he went with him. He followed him but one did not make any inquiry from the other about anything until it was morning. He then brought the water and his provisions to the mosque and spent a day there, but he did not see Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) until it was night. He then returned to his bed, and there happened to pass `Ali and he said: This man has not been able to find his destination until this time. He made him stand and he went with him and no one made an inquiry from his companion about anything. And when it was the third day he did the same. `Ali made him stand up and brought him along with him. He said: By Him, besides Whom there is no god, why don't you tell me (the reason) which brought you here to this town? He said: (I shall do this) provided you hold me promise and a covenant that you would guide me aright. He then did that. He (`Ali) said: Verily, he is truthful and he is a Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and when it is morning, follow me and if I would say anything from which I would sense fear about you I would stand (in a manner) as if I was throwing water and if I move on, you then follow me until I get in (some house). He did that and I followed him until he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He entered (the house) of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with him and listened to his words and embraced Islam at this very place. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: Go to your people and inform them until my command reaches you. Thereupon he said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, I shall say to the people of Mecca this thing at the top of my voice. So he set forth until he came to the mosque and then spoke at the top of his voice (saying): I bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. The people attacked him and made him fall down when al-`Abbas came and he leaned over him and said: Woe be upon you, don't you know that he is from amongst the tribe of Ghifar and your trading route to Syria passes through (the settlements of this tribe), and he rescued him. He (Abu Dharr) did the same on the next day and they (the Meccans) again attacked him and al-`Abbas leaned upon him and he rescued him.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki jab Abu Dharr ne Makkah mein Rasool (SAW) ke aagman ke baare mein suna, unhone kaha: Bhai, is wadi mein sawaari karo aur mere liye us shakhs ke baare mein khabar lao jo daawa karta hai ki unhe Aasmaan se khabar milti hai. Unke alfaaz suno aur phir mere paas aao. To woh sawaar hokar gaye yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche aur unhone unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke muqaddas) alfaaz sune aur phir Abu Dharr ke paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Maine unhe achhe naitik gunon ko vikasit karne ke liye prerit karte dekha hai aur unki abhivyaktiyon ko kisi bhi tarah shayari nahi kaha jaa sakta. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Main isse santusht nahi hua us baat ke silsile mein jo mere zehan mein thi (jab maine tumhe bheja). To unhone safar ke liye raashan aur paani se bhari ek chhoti mashk li (aur nikle) yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche. Woh masjid (Kaaba) mein aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dhoondhne lage aur unhe pehchaana nahi aur unhe ye bhi pasand nahi tha ki woh unke baare mein kisi se poochhein yahan tak ki raat ho gayi, aur woh so gaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe dekha aur paaya ki woh ek ajanabi hain. Is liye woh unke saath gaye. Unhone unka anusaran kiya lekin ek ne doosre se kuch bhi nahi poocha yahan tak ki subah ho gayi. Woh phir paani aur apna raashan masjid mein le aaye aur wahan ek din guzaara, lekin unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko nahi dekha yahan tak ki raat ho gayi. Phir woh apne bistar par wapas gaye, aur usi waqt Ali (Alayhis Salam) guzre aur unhone kaha: Ye shakhs ab tak apni manzil nahi paa saka. Unhone unhe khada kiya aur unke saath gaye aur koi bhi apne saathi se kisi baat ke baare mein nahi poochta. Aur jab teesra din tha unhone waisa hi kiya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe khadhaya aur unhe apne saath laaye. Unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, tum mujhe (wajah) kyun nahi batate jo tumhe is shehar mein le aaya? Unhone kaha: (Main aisa karunga) bashart-e ki tum mujhse vaada aur ehad karo ki tum mujhe sahi raah dikhaoge. Unhone phir aisa kiya. Unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Yaqeenan, woh sachche hain aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain aur jab subah ho, mera anusaran karo aur agar main kuch aisa kahun jismein mujhe tumhaare baare mein dar mehsoos ho, main is tarah khada hoonga jaise main paani phenk raha hoon aur agar main aage badhun, tum tab mera anusaran karo yahan tak ki main (kisi ghar mein) daakhil hoon. Unhone aisa kiya aur maine unka anusaran kiya yahan tak ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas pahunche. Woh unke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (ghar) mein daakhil hue aur unke alfaaz sune aur isi jagah Islam qubool kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Apne logon ke paas jaao aur unhe soochit karo jab tak mera hukum tumhe pahunche. Isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, main Makkah ke logon se buland aawaaz mein ye baat kahunga. To woh nikle yahan tak ki woh masjid mein aaye aur phir buland aawaaz mein bole (ye kehte hue): Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Logon ne unpar hamla kiya aur unhe girAaya jab al-Abbas aaye aur unke uThpar jhuke aur kaha: Tumpar afsos, kya tumhe nahi pata ki woh Ghifar qabile se hain aur Syria ki taraf tumhaara vyaapaar raasta (is qabile ke basne wale ilaake) se guzarta hai, aur unhone unhe bachaaya. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) agle din bhi waisa hi kiya aur unhone (Makkah walon ne) dobara unpar hamla kiya aur al-Abbas unpar jhuke aur unhe bachaaya.

e: (6050) Jarir b. 'Abdullah said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never refused me permission to see him since I embraced Islam and never looked at me but with a smile.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi mujhe unse milne ki ijazat nahi maana jab se maine Islam qubool kiya aur kabhi mujhe muskuraahat ke bina nahi dekha.

e: Jarir reported: Since I embraced Islam Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never refused to see me and he did not see me but with a smile on his face. Ibn Numair has made this addition to this hadith which has been reported on the authority of Ibn Idris that he (Jarir) made this complaint to him (to the Holy Prophet): I cannot sit upon the horse with firmness, whereupon he (Allah's Apostle) struck his chest with his hand and prayed: O Allah, make him steadfast and rightly-guided.
hi: Jarir ne bayan kiya: Jab se maine Islam qubool kiya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi mujhse milne se inkaar nahi kiya aur unhone mujhe kabhi apne chehre par muskuraahat ke bina nahi dekha. Ibn Numair ne is hadees mein ye izafa kiya, jo Ibn Idris ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, ki unhone (Jarir ne) unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) ye shikaayat ki: Main ghode par mazbooti se nahi baith paata, isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) apne haath se unke seene par thoka aur dua ki: Aye Allah, ise sthir aur sahi margdarshit banaa.

e: Jabir reported that there was in pre-Islamic days a temple called Dhu'l- Khalasah and it was called the Yamanite Ka'ba or the northern Ka'ba. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said unto me: Will you rid me of Dhu'l-Khalasah and so I went forth at the head of 350 horsemen of the tribe of Ahmas and we destroyed it and killed whomsoever we found there. Then we came back to him (to the Holy Prophet) and informed him and he blessed us and the tribe of Ahmas.
hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Islam se pehle ke daur mein ek but-khana tha jise Dhu'l-Khalasah kaha jaata tha aur ise Yemeni Kaaba ya uttari Kaaba kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kya tum mujhe Dhu'l-Khalasah se azad karoge aur is liye main Ahmas qabile ke 350 ghudsawaaron ke agua ke soorat mein nikla aur humne ise nasht kiya aur jise bhi humne wahan paaya use qatal kiya. Phir hum unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas wapas aaye aur unhe bataya aur unhone humein aur Ahmas qabile ko barkat di.

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Can't on rid me of Dhu'I-Khalasah, the idol-house of Khath'am, and this idol-house was called the Yamanite Ka'ba. So I went along with 150 horsemen and I could not sit with steadfastness upon the horse. I made the mention of it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he struck his hand on my chest and said: O Allah, grant him steadfastness and make him the guide of righteousness and the rightly-guided one. So he went away and he set fire to it. Then Jarir sent some person to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose Kunya was Abu Arta to give him the happy news about that. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have not come to you (but with the news) that we have left Dhu'l-Khalasah as a scabed camel. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) blessed the horses of Ahmas and the men of their tribe five times.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah al-Bajali ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kya tum mujhe Dhu'l-Khalasah, Khath'am ke murti-ghar, se azad nahi kar sakte, aur ye murti-ghar Yemeni Kaaba kaha jaata tha. Is liye main 150 ghudsawaaron ke saath gaya aur main ghode par sthirta se nahi baith saka. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone apna haath mere seene par maara aur kaha: Aye Allah, use sthirta de aur use sahi margdarshan ka aur sahi margdarshit ka margdarshak bana. To woh nikle aur unhone ise aag laga di. Phir Jarir ne kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja jinki Kunya Abu Arta thi taaki unhe iski khushkhabri di jaaye. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Main aapke paas (sirf) is khabar ke saath aaya hoon ki humne Dhu'l-Khalasah ko ek khaarish-grast oont ki tarah chhod diya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ahmas qabile ke ghodon aur unke logon ko paanch baar barkat di.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ismail with different chains of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Marwan (the words are): "A person giving the glad tidings on behalf of Jarir came or Abu Husain b. Rabi`a came in order to give glad tidings to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)."
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur Marwan ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Jarir ki taraf se khushkhabri dene wala shakhs aaya, ya Abu Husain bin Rabi'a Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushkhabri dene aaye."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to privy and I placed for him water for ablution, When he came out he said: Who placed it here? And in a version of Zuhair they (the Companions) said, and in the version of Abu Bakr (the words are): I said: It is Ibn 'Abbas (who has done that), whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: May Allah grant him deep understanding of religion.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) shauchaalay gaye aur maine unke liye wuzu ka paani rakha. Jab woh bahar aaye, unhone kaha: Ye kisne rakha? Aur Zuhair ki riwayat mein woh (sahaba) bole, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Maine kaha: Ye Ibn Abbas hain (jinhone ye kiya), isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Allah unhe deen ki gehri samajh de.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I saw in a state of sleep as if I have in my hand a piece of silk cloth and there is no place in the Paradise where I intend to reach but that piece of cloth does not fly towards it. I made a mention of it to Hafsa (the sister of Ibn 'Umar) and Hafsa made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I find 'Abdullah b 'Umar a pious person.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine so raha tha maine dekha ki jaise mere haath mein resham ka ek tukda hai aur Jannat mein koi jagah nahi hai jahan main pahunchna chaahta hoon lekin woh kapda uska tukda uski taraf nahi udta. Maine iska zikr Hafsa (Ibn Umar ki behn) se kiya aur Hafsa ne iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe Abdullah bin Umar ek nekokaar shakhs lagta hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that when a person saw anything in sleep during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) he narrated it to Allah's Messenger, and I also had a longing that I should also see in a dream something which I should narrate to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and I was at that time an unmarried young man. I was sleeping in the mosque during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tl) at I saw in a dream as if two Angels have taken hold of me and they have carried me to the fire, and, lo, it was built like the easing of a well and had two pillars like those of a well; and, lo, there were people in it whom I knew and I cried out: I seek refuge with Allah from Hell-fire; I seek refuge with Allah from Hell-fire. Then another Angel joined the two others, and said unto me: You need not fear I narrated this dream to llafsa and she narrated it to Allah's Messenger, whereupon Allah's Apostle said: Worthy is this man Abdullah, O that he would pray at night, and Silim added that Abdullah afterwards slept only but for a small part of the night.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab koi shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein neend mein kuch dekhta, woh ise Allah ke Rasool ko riwayat karta, aur mujhe bhi ye khwaish thi ki main bhi sapne mein kuch dekhun jise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat karun aur main us waqt ek kunwara jawaan aadmi tha. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein masjid mein so raha tha jab maine sapne mein dekha jaise do Farishton ne mujhe pakda hai aur woh mujhe aag ki taraf le gaye hain, aur, dekho, ye ek kuen ki taraah baayi hui thi aur ismein do khambe the kuen jaise; aur, dekho, ismein log the jinhe main jaanta tha aur main chillaaya: Main Jahannam ki aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon; main Jahannam ki aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Phir ek doosra Farishta un doosron ke saath aa mila, aur usne mujhse kaha: Tumhe dar nahi lena chahiye. Maine ye sapna Hafsa se riwayat kiya aur unhone ise Allah ke Rasool ko riwayat kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: Ye aadmi, Abdullah, laayak hai, kaash woh raat mein namaz padhta, aur Salim ne izafa kiya ki Abdullah baad mein raat ke sirf ek chhote hisse mein sote the.

e: Ibn Umar reported: I used to spend nights in the mosque and by that time I had no wife and children. I saw in a dream as if I am being taken to a well. I made a mention of it to Allah's Messenger (may peacebe upon him). The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Main masjid mein raaten guzaarta tha aur us waqt meri koi zauja ya bachche nahi the. Maine sapne mein dekha jaise mujhe ek kuen ki taraf le jaaya ja raha hai. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas reported that Umm Sulaim said (to the Holy Prophet) Allah's Messenger, here is your servant Anas, invoke blessings of Allah upon him. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny, and confer blessings upon him in everything Thou hast bestowed upon him.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim ne (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapke naukar Anas, unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar aur jo bhi Tu unhe de use barkat de.

e: Anas reported (that his mother) Umm Sulaim said (to the Holy Prophet) Allah's Messenger, here is your servant Anas. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya (ki unki maa) Umm Sulaim ne (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapke naukar Anas. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reportedAllah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited us and there was none else (in the house) but I, my mother and my mother's sister Umm Haram. My mother said to him: Allah's Messenger, here is a small servant of yours, invoke blessings of Allah upon him. And he invoked blessings for me (that I should be bestowed upon) every good and this was what he (said) at the end of what be supplicated for me: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny, and cqnfer blessings (upon him) in (each one) of them.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humse milne aaye aur (ghar mein) koi doosra nahi tha siwaay mere, meri maa aur meri maa ki behn Umm Haram ke. Meri maa ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapka chhota naukar, unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Aur unhone mere liye barkat maangi (ki mujhe) har achhaai (di jaaye) aur ye woh tha jo unhone mere liye dua ke ant mein kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar aur unmein se har ek mein (unhe) barkat de.

e: Anas reported: My mother Umm Anas came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And she prepared my lower garment out of the half of her headdress and (with the other half) she covered my upper body and said: Allah's Messenger, here is my son Unais; I have brought him to you for serving you. Invoke blessings of Allah upon him. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny. Anas said: By Allah, my fortune is huge and my children, and grand-children are now more than one hundred.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Meri maa Umm Anas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin. Aur unhone meri neechli kapda apne sirdaastar ke aadhe hisse se taiyaar kiya aur (doosre aadhe se) unhone mera upari badan dhaka aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe mere bete Unais; main unhe aapki sewa ke liye laayi hoon. Unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar. Anas ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, meri daulat bhaari hai aur mere bachche, aur pote-poti ab sau se zyada hain.

e: Anas b. Malik said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed (by our house) that my mother Umm Sulaim listened to his voice and said: Allah's Messenger, let my father and mother be sacrificed for thee, here is Unais (and requested him to invoke blessings upon me). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked three blessings upon me. I have seen (the results) of the two in this very world (in regard to wealth and progeny) and I hope to see (the result) of the third one in the Hereafter.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (humare ghar ke paas se) guzre ki meri maa Umm Sulaim ne unki aawaaz suni aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan ho jaayein, ye rahe Unais (aur unhone unse mere liye barkat maangne ki guzaarish ki). To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne meri khaatir teen barkatein maangi. Maine in mein se do ke (natije) is duniya mein dekhe hain (daulat aur aulaad ke silsile mein) aur mujhe teesri (natija) Aakhirat mein dekhne ki ummeed hai.

e: Anas reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me as I was playing with playmates. He greeted and sent me on an errand and I made delay in going to my mother. When I came to her she said: What detained you? I said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me on an errand. She said: What was the purpose? I said: It is something secret. Therupon she said: Do not then divulge the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to anyone. Anas said: By Allah, if I were to divulge it to anyone, then, O Thabit, I would have divulged it to you.
hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye jab main apne khel-saathiyon ke saath khel raha tha. Unhone salaam kiya aur mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja aur mujhe apni maa ke paas jaane mein der ho gayi. Jab main unke paas aaya unhone kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne roka? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja tha. Unhone kaha: Uska maqsad kya tha? Maine kaha: Ye kuch guptata ki baat hai. Isper unhone kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz kisi ko mat bataana. Anas ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar main ise kisi ko bataata, to, Aye Thabit, main tumhe zaroor bataata.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told me something secretly. I informed none about that and Umm Sulaim asked me about it, but I did not tell her even.
hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe gupt soorat se kuch bataaya. Maine iske baare mein kisi ko soochit nahi kiya aur Umm Sulaim ne mujhse iske baare mein poocha, lekin maine unhe bhi nahi bataya.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that he heard his father (Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas) say: never heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say unto one living and moving about that he was in Paradise except to 'Abdullah b. Salim.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne waalid (Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas) ko ye kehte suna: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kisi zinda aur chalte-phirte shakhs ke baare mein ye kehte nahi suna ki woh Jannat mein hai siwaay Abdullah bin Salim ke.

e: Qais b. 'Ubada reported: I was in the company of some persons, amongst whom some were the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in Medina, that there came a person whose face depicted the fear (of Allah). Some people said: He is a person from amongst the people of Paradise; he is a person from amongst the people of Paradise. He observed two short rak'ahs of prayer and then went out. I followed him and he got into his house and I also got in and we began to converse with each other. And when he became familiar (with me) I said to Him: When you entered (the mosque) before (your entrance in the house) a person said so and so (that you are amongst the people of Paradise), whereupon he said: It is not meet for anyone to say anything which he does not know. I shall (now) tell you why they (say) this. I saw a dream during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and narrated it to him. I seemed to be in a garden ; in the midst of it, there stood an iron pillar, with its base in the earth and its summit in the sky: and upon its summit there was a handhold.
