It was said to me: Climb up this (pillar). I said to him (visitant in the dream): I am unable to do it. Thereupon a helper came to me, and he (supported) me (by catching hold of my) garment from behind and thus helped me with his hand and so I climbed up till I was at the summit of the pillar, and grasped the handhold. It was said to me: Hold it tightly. It was at this that I woke up when (the handhold) was in the grip) of my hand. I narrated it (the dream) to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: That garden implies al-Islam and that pillar implies the pillar of Islam. And that handhold is the firmest faith (as referred to in the Qur'an). And you will remain attached to Islam until you shall die. And that man was 'Abdullah b. Salim.
hi: Qais bin Ubada ne bayan kiya: Main kuch logon ki sohbat mein tha, jinmein Madina mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba (RA) bhi the, ke ek shakhs aaya jiske chehre par (Allah ka) khauf zaahir tha. Kuch logon ne kaha: Ye Jannat ke logon mein se ek shakhs hai; ye Jannat ke logon mein se ek shakhs hai. Unhone do mukhtasar rakat namaz padhi aur phir bahar chale gaye. Main unke peeche gaya aur woh apne ghar mein daakhil hue aur main bhi daakhil hua aur hum aapas mein baatein karne lage. Aur jab woh mujhse mil-julle, maine unse kaha: Jab aap (masjid mein) aaye the, ek shakhs ne aisa-aisa kaha (ki aap Jannat ke logon mein se hain), isper unhone farmaya: Kisi ko bhi aisi baat nahi kehni chahiye jiska usse ilm na ho. Main tumhe abhi bataata hoon ki unhone aisa kyun kaha. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein ek khwaab dekha aur ise unhe riwayat kiya. Mujhe laga jaise main ek baag mein hoon; iske beech mein, loha ka ek khambha khada tha, jiski buniyaad zameen mein thi aur uska sira aasmaan mein tha; aur uske sire par ek pakad thi. Mujhse kaha gaya: Is (khambhe) par chadho. Maine unse (khwaab mein aane wale se) kaha: Main aisa nahi kar sakta. Isper ek madadgaar mere paas aaya, aur usne (mujhe) peeche se mera kapda pakadkar (sahaara diya) aur is tarah apne haath se meri madad ki aur main chadhta gaya yahan tak ki main khambhe ke sire tak pahuncha, aur pakad ko thaam liya. Mujhse kaha gaya: Ise mazbooti se pakdo. Isi waqt main jaaga jab (pakad) mere haath mein thi. Maine ise (khwaab ko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat kiya, isper unhone farmaya: Woh baag Islam ko darsaata hai aur woh khambha Islam ke sutoon ko darsaata hai. Aur woh pakad sabse mazboot imaan hai (jaisa Quran mein zikr kiya gaya hai). Aur tum Islam se juDe rahoge jab tak tum mar na jaao. Aur woh shakhs Abdullah bin Salim the.

e: Qais b. 'Ubaida reported: I was (sitting) in a company in which there were (besides others) Sa'd b. Malik and Ibn 'Umar that 'Abdullah b. Saliim happened to pass (by that side). They (the people sitting in that company) said: He is a person from amongst the dwellers of Paradise. I stood up and said to him: They say such and such (thing about you), whereupon he said: Hallowed be Allah, it is not meet for them to say (anything) of which They have no knowledge. Verily I saw as if a pillar had been raised in a green garden and there had been fixed at its (upper) end a handhold and there was a helper at its base. It was said to me: Climb up. So I climbed up and caught hold of the haildhold. I narrated (the contents of this dream) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: 'Abdullah would die in a state that he would be catching hold of the firmest handhold (he would die holding fast to the faith).
hi: Qais bin Ubaida ne bayan kiya: Main ek majlis mein (baitha) tha jismein Sa'd bin Malik aur Ibn Umar (RA) bhi maujood the ke Abdullah bin Salim wahan se guzre. Unhone (us majlis mein baithe logon ne) kaha: Ye Jannat ke bashindon mein se ek shakhs hai. Main khada hua aur unse kaha: Woh aisa-aisa kehte hain (aapke baare mein), isper unhone farmaya: Allah Paak hai, unhe aisi koi baat nahi kehni chahiye jiska unhe ilm na ho. Yaqeenan maine dekha jaise ek khambha ek sabz baag mein khada kiya gaya hai aur uske (upari) sire par ek pakad lagaayi gayi hai aur uski buniyaad par ek madadgaar tha. Mujhse kaha gaya: chadho. To main chadha aur pakad thaam li. Maine (is khwaab ka byora) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat kiya, isper unhone farmaya: Abdullah is haalat mein marega ki woh sabse mazboot pakad ko thaame hoga (woh imaan ko mazbooti se pakde hue marega).

e: Kharasha b. Hurr reported: I was sitting in a circle in the mosque of Medina and there was an old man, quite handsome. He was 'Abdullah b. Salim. He was telling good things to them (to the people sitting in that company). As he stood up (to depart) the people said: He who is desirous of looking at a person from amongst the people of Paradise should see him. I said: By Allah, I will follow him, and would try to know his residence. So I followed him and he walked on until he reached the outskirts of Medina. He then entered his house. I sought permission from him to get in, and he granted me the permission, saying: My nephew, what is the need (that has brought you here)? I said to him: As you stood up, I heard people say about you: He who is desirous of seeing a person from among the people of Paradise should look at him. So I became desirous of accompanying you. He ('Abdullah b. Salim) said: It is Allah Who knows best about the people of Paradise. I would, however, narrate to you as to why they said like it. (The story is) that while I was asleep (one night) there came to me a person (in the dream) who asked me to stand up. (So I stood up) and he caught hold of my hand and I walked along with him, and, lo, I found some paths on my left and I was about to set out upon them. Thereupon he said to me Do not set yourself on (them) for these are the paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell-fire). Then there were paths leading to the right side, whereupon he said: Set yourself on these paths. We came across a hill and he said to me: Climb up, and I attempted to climb up that I fell upon my buttocks. I made several attempts (but failed to succeed). He led until he came to a pillar (so high) that its upper end touched the sky and its base was in the earth. And there was a handhold at its upper end. He said to me Climb over it. I said: How can I climb upon it, as its upper end touches the sky? He cought hold of my hand and pushed me up and I found myself suspended with the handhold. He then struck the pillar and it fell down, but I remained attached to that handhold until it was morning (and the dream was thus over). I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and narrated it to him. He said: So far as the paths which you saw on your left are concerned, these are paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell) and the paths which you saw on your right, these are the paths of the rightists (the dwellers of Paradise) and the mountain represents the destination of the martyrs which you would not be able to attain. The pillar implies the pillar of Islam. and so far as the handhold is concerned, it implies the handhold of Islam, and you would hold to it fastly until you would meet death.
hi: Kharasha bin Hurr ne bayan kiya: Main Madina ki masjid mein ek majlis mein baitha tha aur wahan ek boodha shakhs tha, kaafi khoobsurat. Woh Abdullah bin Salim the. Woh unhe (us majlis mein baithe logon ko) achhi baatein bata rahe the. Jab woh (jaane ke liye) khade huye, logon ne kaha: Jo koi Jannat ke logon mein se kisi ko dekhna chaahta hai use unhe dekhna chahiye. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, main unka peecha karunga, aur unka ghar jaanne ki koshish karunga. To main unka peecha karta raha aur woh chalte rahe yahan tak ki woh Madina ke bahari ilaake tak pahunche. Phir woh apne ghar mein daakhil hue. Maine unse andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aur unhone mujhe ijazat di ye kehte hue: Mere bhatije, kya zaroorat hai (jo tumhe yahan laayi)? Maine unse kaha: Jab aap khade huye, maine logon ko aapke baare mein ye kehte suna: Jo koi Jannat ke logon mein se kisi ko dekhna chaahe use unhe dekhna chahiye. Is liye mujhe aapke saath jaane ki khwaish hui. Unhone (Abdullah bin Salim ne) kaha: Allah hi behtar jaanta hai Jannat ke logon ke baare mein. Main, halaanki, tumhe riwayat karunga ki unhone aisa kyun kaha. (Kissa ye hai) ki jab main (ek raat) so raha tha ek shakhs mere paas aaya (khwaab mein) jisne mujhse khade hone ko kaha. (Is liye main khada hua) aur usne mera haath thaama aur main uske saath chala, aur, dekho, maine apni baayi taraf kuch raaste paaye aur main unpar chalne hi wala tha. Isper usne mujhse kaha: Inpar khud ko mat le jao kyunki ye baayi taraf walon ke raaste hain (Jahannam ke bashinde). Phir daayi taraf ki taraf jaane wale raaste the, isper usne kaha: In raaston par khud ko le jao. Hum ek pahaad ke paas aaye aur usne mujhse kaha: Chadho, aur maine chadhne ki koshish ki lekin main apni sarrin ke bal gir gaya. Maine kayi koshishen kin (lekin saphal nahi ho paaya). Woh mujhe le gaya yahan tak ki woh ek khambhe ke paas aaya (itna oncha) ki iska upari sira aasmaan ko chhu raha tha aur iski buniyaad zameen mein thi. Aur uske upari sire par ek pakad thi. Usne mujhse kaha: Ispar chadho. Maine kaha: Main ispar kaise chadh sakta hoon, jabki iska upari sira aasmaan ko chhu raha hai? Usne mera haath thaama aur mujhe upar dhakela aur maine khud ko us pakad ke saath latka hua paaya. Phir usne khambhe ko maara aur ye gir gaya, lekin main us pakad se juda raha yahan tak ki subah ho gayi (aur khwaab is tarah khatm hua). Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe ye riwayat kiya. Unhone farmaya: Jahan tak un raaston ka sawaal hai jo tumne apni baayi taraf dekhe, ye baayi taraf walon (Jahannam ke bashindon) ke raaste hain aur jo raaste tumne apni daayi taraf dekhe, ye daayi taraf walon (Jannat ke bashindon) ke raaste hain aur pahaad shaheedon ki manzil ko darsaata hai jise tum haasil nahi kar paaoge. Khambha Islam ke sutoon ko darsaata hai. Aur jahan tak pakad ka sawaal hai, ye Islam ki pakad ko darsaata hai, aur tum ise mazbooti se pakde rahoge yahan tak ki tumhaari mout ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported that 'Umar happened to pass by Hassan as he was reciting verses in the mosque. He (Hadrat 'Umar) looked towards him (meaningfully), whereupon he (gassin) said: I used to recite (verses) when one better than you (the Holy Prophet) had been present (here). He then looked towards Abu Huraira and said to him: I adjure you by Allah (to tell) if you had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (Hassan), give a reply on my behalf; Allah I help him with Ruh-ul-Qudus. He (Abu Huraira) said: By Allah, it is so (i. e. the Prophet actually said these words).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar (RA) Hassan ke paas se guzre jab woh masjid mein sher padh rahe the. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unki taraf (mahatvapurna taur par) dekha, isper unhone (Hassan ne) kaha: Main sher padha karta tha jab tumse behtar (Allah ke Rasool SAW) yahan maujood hote the. Phir unhone Abu Huraira ki taraf dekha aur unse kaha: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon (batane ke liye) ki kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna: Hassan, mere taraf se jawaab do; Allah, Ruh-ul-Qudus se unki madad kar. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, aisa hi hai (yaani Nabi (SAW) ne waaqai ye alfaaz farmaaye).

e: Ibn Musayyib reported that Hassan said to a circle in which there was also Abu Huraira: Abu Huraira, I adjure you by Allah (to tell) whether you-had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this.
hi: Ibn Musayyib ne bayan kiya ki Hassan ne ek majlis mein kaha jismein Abu Huraira bhi maujood the: Abu Huraira, main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon (batane ke liye) ki kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa kehte nahi suna.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman reported that he heard Hassin b. Thabit al-Ansari call Abu Huraira to bear witness by saying: I adjure you by Allah if you had not heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying: Hassin, give a reply on behalf of the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, help him with Ruh-ul-Qudus. Abu Huraira said: Yes, it is so.
hi: Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki unhone Hassan bin Thabit al-Ansari ko Abu Huraira se gawaahi maangte suna ye kehte hue: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon agar tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate nahi suna: Hassan, Allah ke Rasool ki taraf se jawaab do. Aye Allah, Ruh-ul-Qudus se unki madad kar. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Haan, aisa hi hai.

e: Al-Bari' b. 'Azib reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Hassan b. Thibit, write satire (against the non-believers) ; Gabriel is with you.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Hassan bin Thabit, (kaafiron ke khilaaf) vyangya likho; Jibril tumhare saath hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Hassan b. Thabit talked much about 'A'isha. I scolded him, whereupon she said: My nephew, leave him for he defended Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Hisham ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hassan bin Thabit Aisha (RA) ke baare mein bahut baatein karte the. Maine unhe daanta, isper unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Mere bhatije, unhe chhod do kyunki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka difaa kiya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hishim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Masruq reported: I visited 'A'isha when Hassin was sitting there and reciting verses from his compilation: She is chaste and prudent. There is no calumny against her and she rises up early in the morning without eating the meat of the un- mindful. 'A'isha said: But you are not so. Masruq said: I said to her: Why do you permit him to visit you, whereas Allah has said:" And as for him among them who took upon himself the main part thereof, he shall have a grievous punishment" (XXIV. ll)? Thereupon she said: What tornient can be more severe than this that he has become blind? He used to write satire as a rebuttal on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Main Aisha (RA) se milne gaya jab Hassan wahan baithe apne kalam mein se sher padh rahe the: Woh muqaddas aur aqlmand hain. Unpar koi ilzaam nahi hai aur woh subah jaldi uThti hain bina gaafil logon ka gosht khaaye. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Lekin tum aise nahi ho. Masruq ne kaha: Maine unse kaha: Aap unhe apne paas aane ki ijazat kyun dete hain, jabki Allah ne farmaaya hai: "Aur unmein se jisne iska sabse bada hissa apne zimme liya use dukhad azaab milega" (24:11)? Isper unhone kaha: Isse zyada sakht azaab kya ho sakta hai ki woh andhe ho gaye hain? Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se vyangya-jawaab likha karte the.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: 'A'isha reported that Hassin said: Allah's Messenger, permit me to write satire against Abu Sufyan, whereupon he said: How can it be because I am also related to him? Thereupon he (Hassan) said: By Him Who has honoured you. I shall draw you out from them (their family) just as hair is drawn out from the fermented (flour). Thereupon Hassan said: The dignity and greatness belongs to the tribe of Bint Makhzum from amongst the tribe of Hisham, whereas your father was a slave.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hassan ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe Abu Sufyan ke khilaaf vyangya likhne ki ijazat dijiye, isper unhone (Nabi SAW ne) farmaaya: Ye kaise ho sakta hai, jabki main bhi unse rishtedaar hoon? Isper unhone (Hassan ne) kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di, main aapko unse (unke khaandaan se) is tarah nikaal dunga jaise baal khameer se nikaale jaate hain. Isper Hassan ne (aage) kaha: Izzat aur azmat Hisham qabile mein se Bint Makhzum qabile ki hai, jabki tumhaara waalid ek ghulam tha.

e: 'Urwa reported on the same chain of transmitters that Hassan b. Thabit sought permission from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to satirise against the polytheists, but he did not mention Abu Sufyan. And instead of the word al- Khamir, the word al-'Ajin was used.
hi: Urwa ne isi sanad se ye riwayat ki ki Hassan bin Thabit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke khilaaf vyangya likhne ki ijazat maangi, lekin unhone Abu Sufyan ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Aur al-Khamir lafz ki jagah al-Ajin lafz istemal kiya gaya.

e:
'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be uport him) said. Satirise against the (non-believing amongst the) Quraish, for (the satire) is more grievous to them than the hurt of an arrow. So he (the Holy Prophet) sent (someone) to Ibn Rawiha and asked him to satirise against them, and he composed a satire, but it did not appeal to him (to the Holy Prophet). He then sent (someone) to Ka'b b. Malik (to do the same, but what he composed did not appeal to the Holy Prophet). He then sent one to Hassan b. Thabit. As he got into his presence, Hassan said: Now you have called for this lion who strikes (the enemies) with his tail. He then brought out his tongue and began to move it and said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth, I shall tear them with my tongue as the leather is torn. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't be hasty; (let) Abu Bakr who has the best know- ledge of the lineage of the Quraish draw a distinction for you in regard to my lineage, as my lineage is thesame as theirs. Hassan then came to him (Abu Bakr) and after making inquiry (in regard to the lineage of the Holy Prophet) came back to him (the holy Prophet) and said: Allah's Messenger, he (Abu Bakr) has drawn a distinction in vour lineage (and that of the Quraish) By Him Who has sent you with Truth, I shall draw out from them (your name) as hair is drawn out from the flour. 'A'isha said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Hassin: Verily Ruh-ul- Qudus would continue to help you so long as you put up a defence on behalf of Allah and His Messenger. And she said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Hassan satirised against them and gave satisfaction to the (Muslims) and disquieted (the non-Muslims). 
You satirised Muhammad, but I replied on his behalf, 
And there is reward with Allah for this. 
You satirised Muhammad. virtuous, righteous, 
The Apostle of Allah, whose nature is truthfulness. 
So verily my father and his father and my honour 
Are a protection to the honour of Muhammad; 
May I lose my dear daughter, if you don't see her, 
Wiping away the dust from the two sides of Kada', 
They pull at the rein, going upward; 
On their shoulders are spears thirsting (for the blood of the enemy) ; 
our steeds are sweating-our women wipe them with their mantles. 
If you had not interfered with us, we would have performed the 'Umra, 
And (then) there was the Victory, and the darkness cleared away. 
Otherwise wait for the fighting on the day in which Allah will honour whom He pleases. 
And Allah said: I have sent a servant who says the Truth in which there is no ambiguity; 
And Allah said: I have prepared an army-they are the Ansar whose object is fighting (the enemy), 
There reaches every day from Ma'add abuse, or fighting or satire; 
Whoever satirises the Apostle from amongst you, or praises him and helps it is all the same, 
And Gabriel, the Messenger of Allah is among us, and the Holy Spirit who has no match.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Quraish (jo imaan nahi rakhte) ke khilaaf vyangya likho, kyunki (vyangya) unhe teer se lagi chot se zyada dukhad hai. To unhone (Nabi SAW ne) Ibn Rawaha ke paas (kisi ko) bheja aur unse unke khilaaf vyangya likhne ko kaha, aur unhone ek vyangya banaayi, lekin ye unhe (Nabi SAW ko) pasand nahi aayi. Phir unhone Ka'b bin Malik ke paas (kisi ko) bheja (waisa hi karne ke liye, lekin jo unhone banaya woh bhi Nabi SAW ko pasand nahi aaya). Phir unhone Hassan bin Thabit ke paas ek shakhs bheja. Jaise woh unke paas pahunche, Hassan ne kaha: Ab aapne is sher ko bulaya hai jo (dushmanon par) apni poonch se vaar karta hai. Phir unhone apni zubaan bahar nikaali aur ise hilaane lage aur kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, main unhe apni zubaan se is tarah phaad dunga jaise chamda phaada jaata hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jaldi mat karo; Abu Bakr, jinhe Quraish ke vansh ka sabse behtareen ilm hai, tumhare liye mere vansh ke baare mein antar spashth karenge, kyunki mera vansh unka hi hai. Hassan phir unke (Abu Bakr ke) paas gaye aur (Nabi SAW ke vansh ke baare mein) poochh-taachh karke unke (Nabi ke) paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhone (Abu Bakr ne) aapke vansh (aur Quraish ke vansh) mein antar spashth kar diya hai. Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, main unmein se aapka naam is tarah nikaal loonga jaise baal aate se nikaala jaata hai. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hassan se ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan Ruh-ul-Qudus tumhaari madad karte rahenge jab tak tum Allah aur Uske Rasool ki taraf se difaa karte raho. Aur unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Hassan ne unke khilaaf vyangya likhi aur (Musalmaanon ko) santushti di aur (gair-Musalmaanon ko) bechain kiya. Unhone Muhammad ke khilaaf vyangya likhi, lekin maine unki taraf se jawaab diya, Aur ismein Allah ki taraf se sawaab hai. Tumne Muhammad ke khilaaf vyangya likhi, jo nekokaar aur seedhe hain, Allah ke Rasool, jinki fitrat sachchaai hai. Is liye yaqeenan mera waalid aur unke waalid aur meri izzat Muhammad ki izzat ki hifaazat hain; Kaash meri aziz beti kho jaaye, agar tum use na dekho, Kada ke donon taraf se dhool poonchhte hue, Woh lagaam kheenchte hain, upar ki taraf jaate hue; Unke kandhon par barchhein hain jo (dushman ke khoon ki) pyaasi hain; Humaare ghode paseene se tar hain - hamaari auraten unhe apni chaadaron se ponchti hain. Agar tumne humme dakhal na diya hota, hum Umra kar chuke hote, Aur (phir) jeet hoti, aur andhera saaf ho jaata. Warna us din ki jung ka intezaar karo jismein Allah jise chaahega izzat dega. Aur Allah ne farmaaya: Maine ek banda bheja hai jo aisa Sach kehta hai jismein koi ashaknata nahi hai; Aur Allah ne farmaaya: Maine ek fauj taiyaar ki hai - woh Ansar hain jinka maqsad (dushman se) jung hai, Har din Ma'add se bura-bhala, ya jung, ya vyangya pahunchta hai; Tum mein se jo koi Rasool ke khilaaf vyangya likhta hai, ya unki tareef karta hai aur unki madad karta hai, sab barabar hai, Aur Jibril, Allah ke Rasool, humare saath hain, aur Ruh-ul-Qudus jiska koi jodi nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I invited my mother, who was a polytlieist, to Islam. I invited her one day and she said to me something about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I hated. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) weeping and said: Allah's Messenger, I invited my mother to Islam but she did not accept (my invitation). I invited her today but she said to me something which I did not like. (Kindly) supplicate Allah that He may set the mother of Abu Huraira right. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, set the mother of Abu Huraira on the right path. I came out quite pleased with the supplication of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and when I came near the door it was closed from within. My mother heard the noise of my footsteps and she said: Abu Huraira, just wait. And I heard the noise of falling of water. She took a bath and put on the shirt and quickly covered her head with a headdress and opened the door and then said: Abu Huraira, I bear witness to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His bondsman and His Messenger. He (Abu Huraira) said: I went back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and (this time) I was shedding the tears of joy. I said: Allah's Messenger, be happy, for Allah has responded to your supplication and He has set on the right path the mother of Abu Huraira. He (the Holy Prophet) praised Allah, and extolled Him and uttered good words. I said: Allah's Messenger, supplicate to Allah so that He may instill love of mine and that of my mother too in the believing servants and let our hearts be filled with their love, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, let there be love of these servants of yours, i.e. Abu Huraira and his mother, in the hearts of the believing servants and let their hearts be filled with the love of the believing servants. (Abu Huraira said: This prayer) was so well granted by Allah that no believer was ever born who heard of me and who saw me but did not love me.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ko, jo mushrik thin, Islam ki taraf nimantrit kiya. Ek din maine unhe nimantrit kiya aur unhone mujhse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein kuch aisa kaha jo mujhe napasand aaya. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ronde hue aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apni maa ko Islam ki taraf nimantrit kiya lekin unhone (mera nimantran) qubool nahi kiya. Aaj maine unhe nimantrit kiya lekin unhone mujhse kuch aisa kaha jo mujhe napasand aaya. (Meherbani karke) Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par le aaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par le aa. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki dua se khush hokar bahar aaya aur jab main darwaze ke qareeb pahuncha ye andar se band tha. Meri maa ne mere qadmon ki aawaaz suni aur unhone kaha: Abu Huraira, thoda ruko. Aur maine paani girne ki aawaaz suni. Unhone gusl kiya aur qamees pehni aur jaldi se apna sar sirdaastar se dhaaka aur darwaza khola aur phir kaha: Abu Huraira, main gawaahi deti hoon ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Uske banda aur Rasool hain. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas gaya aur (is baar) khushi ke aansu bahaa raha tha. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, khush ho jaayiye, kyunki Allah ne aapki dua qubool ki hai aur Usne Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par la diya hai. Unhone (Nabi SAW ne) Allah ki tareef ki, Uski hamd ki aur achhe alfaaz kahe. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh momino ke dilon mein mera aur meri maa ka muhabbat daal de aur humaare liye bhi unka muhabbat humaare dilon mein daal de, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Apne in bandon, yaani Abu Huraira aur unki maa, ka muhabbat momino ke dilon mein daal de aur unka dil momino ke muhabbat se bhar de. (Abu Huraira ne kaha: Ye dua) Allah ne itni achhi tarah qubool ki ki koi bhi momin paida nahi hua jisne mera zikr suna ya mujhe dekha ho lekin mujhse muhabbat na kiya ho.

e: Al-A'raj reported that he heard Abu Huraira as saying: You are under the impression that Abu Huraira transmits so many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (may peace up upon him) ; (bear in mind) Allah is the great Reckoner. I was a poor man and I served Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) being satisfied with bare subsistence, whereas the immigrants remained busy with transactions in the bazar; while the Ansar had been engaged in looking after their properties. (He further reported) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who spreads the cloth would not forget anything that he would hear from me. I spread my cloth until he narrated something. I then pressed it against my (chest), so I never forgot anything that I heard from him.
hi: Al-A'raj ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhe lagta hai ki Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai; (dhyaan rakho) Allah sabse bada Hisaab lene wala hai. Main ek gareeb aadmi tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha bas guzaare laayak khaana par santusht rehte hue, jabki Muhajirin bazaar mein vyaapaar mein masroof rehte the aur Ansar apni zameenon ki dekhbhaal mein lage rehte the. (Unhone aage riwayat ki) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo apna kapda phailaayega use mujhse jo bhi woh sunega usmein se kuch nahi bhoolega. Maine apna kapda phailaaya yahan tak ki unhone kuch riwayat kiya. Maine phir ise apne seene se lagaaya, is liye main unse jo kuch bhi suna use kabhi nahi bhoola.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with the variation that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Malik conclude with the words of Abu Huraira and there is no mention of a transmission of these from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): " who spreads his cloth," to the end.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Malik ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees Abu Huraira ke alfaazon par khatm hoti hai aur ismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se in alfaazon ki riwayat ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Jo apna kapda phailaata hai," ant tak.

e: 'A'isha reported: Don't you feel surprised at Abu Huraira? He came (one day) and sat beside the nook of my apartment and began to narrate (the hadith of Allah's Apostle). I was hearing while I was engaged in extolling Allah (reciting Subhan Allah) constantly. He stood up before I finished my repetition of Subhan Allah. if I were to meet him I would have warned him in stern words that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not speak so quickly as you talk.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Kya tumhe Abu Huraira par hairat nahi hota? Woh (ek din) aaye aur mere kamre ke ek kone mein baithe aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hadees riwayat karne lage. Main sun rahi thi jabki main lagataar Allah ki tasbeeh (Subhan Allah kehte hue) mein masroof thi. Woh mere tasbeeh khatam karne se pehle hi khade ho gaye. Agar main unse milti to main unhe sakht alfaazon mein chetaavni deti ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni jaldi baat nahi karte the jitna tum karte ho.

e: Ibn Shihab transmitted on the authority of Ibn Musayyib that Abu Huraira said: People say that Abu Huraira transmits so many ahadith, whereas Allah is the Reckoner, and they say: How is it with Muhajirs and the Ansar that they do not narrate ahadith like him (like Abu Huraira)? Abu Huraira said: I tell you that my brothers from Ansar remained busy with their lands and my brothers Muhajirs were busy in transactions in the bazars, but I always kept myself attached to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with bare subsistence. I remained present (in the company of the Holy Prophet), whereas they had been absent. I retained in my mind (what the Prophet said), whereas they forgot it. One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who amongst you spreads the cloth and listens to my talk and would then press it against his chest would never forget anything heard from me. So I spread my mantle and when he had concluded his talk I then pressed it against my chest and so I never forgot after that day anything that he (the Holy Prophet) said. And if these two verses would not have been revealed in the Book I would have never transmitted anything (to anybody):" Those who conceal the clear evidence and the guidance that We revealed" (ii. 159) tip to the last verse.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne Ibn Musayyib ki sanad se ye riwayat ki ki Abu Huraira ne kaha: Log kehte hain ki Abu Huraira itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai, jabki Allah Hisaab lene wala hai, aur woh kehte hain: Muhajirin aur Ansar ka kya hai ki woh iski (Abu Huraira ki) tarah ahadees riwayat nahi karte? Abu Huraira ne kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki mere Ansar bhai apni zameenon mein masroof rehte the aur mere Muhajir bhai bazaaron mein vyaapaar mein masroof rehte the, lekin main hamesha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath juda raha bas guzaare laayak khaana par (santusht rehte hue). Main (Nabi SAW ki sohbat mein) maujood raha, jabki woh gair-haazir rahte the. Maine (jo Nabi ne farmaaya) yaad rakha, jabki woh bhool jaate the. Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo tum mein se apna kapda phailaaye aur mera kalam sune aur phir ise apne seene se lagaaye, woh mujhse jo suna use kabhi nahi bhoolega. To maine apna chogha phailaaya aur jab unhone apni baat khatm ki maine ise apne seene se lagaaya aur isi din ke baad se main unhone (Nabi ne) jo kuch kaha use kabhi nahi bhoola. Aur agar ye do aayaten Kitaab mein nazil na hui hoti, main kabhi kisi ko kuch riwayat na karta: "Jo log saaf saboot aur margdarshan chhupaate hain jo Humne nazil kiya" (2:159) akhri aayat tak.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (and the words are): You say that Abu Huraira narrates so many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Tum kehte ho ki Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ubaidullah b. Rafi', who was the scribe of 'All, reported: I heard 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) as saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me and Zubair and Miqdad saying: Go to the garden of, Khakh  and there you will find a woman riding a camel. She would be in possession of a letter, which you must get from her. So we rushed on horses and when we met that woman, we asked her to deliver that letter to us. She said: There is no letter with me. We said: Either bring out that letter or we would take off your clothes. She brought out that letter from (the plaited hair of) her head. We delivered that letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in which Hatib b. Abu Balta'a had informed some people amongst the polytheists of Mecca about the affairs of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Hatib, what is this? He said: Allah's messenger, do not be hasty in judging my intention. I was a person attached to the Quraish. Sufyan said: He was their ally but had no relationship with them. (Hatib further said): Those who are with you amongst the emigrants have blood-relationship with them (the Quraish) and thus they would protect their families. I wished that when I had no blood-relationship with them I should find some supporters from (amongst them) who would help my family. I have not done this because of any unbelief or apostasy and I have no liking for the unbelief after I have (accepted) Islam. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: You have told the truth. 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, permit me to strike the neck of this hypocrite. But he (the Holy Prophet) said: He was a participant in Badr and you little know that Allah revealed about the people of Badr: Do what you like for there is forgiveness for you. And Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said:" O you who believe, do not take My enemy and your enemy for friends" (lx. 1). And there is no mention of this verse in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr and Zubair and Ishaq has in his narration made a mention of the recitation of this verse by Sufyan.
hi: Ubaidullah bin Rafi, jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke munshi the, ne bayan kiya: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe, Zubair aur Miqdad ko bheja ye kehte hue: Khakh ke baag mein jao aur wahan tumhe ek aurat oont par sawaar milegi. Uske paas ek khat hoga, jo tumhe uske paas se lena hai. To hum ghodon par tez gaye aur jab hum us aurat se mile, humne unse woh khat humein sompne ko kaha. Unhone kaha: Mere paas koi khat nahi hai. Humne kaha: Ya to woh khat nikaalo ya hum tumhare kapde utaar denge. Unhone woh khat apne (gunthe) baalon mein se nikaala. Humne woh khat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pahunchaaya jismein Hatib bin Abu Balta'a ne Makkah ke mushrikeen mein se kuch logon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke maamlon ki jaankaari di thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Hatib, ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri niyat ke baare mein jaldbaazi mein faisla mat kijiye. Main Quraish se juda ek shakhs tha. Sufyan ne kaha: Woh unke sahyogi the lekin unse koi rishtedaari nahi thi. (Hatib ne aage kaha): Jo aapke saath hain Muhajirin mein se unka unse (Quraish se) khoon ka rishta hai aur is tarah woh apne khaandaan ki hifaazat karenge. Meri khwaish thi ki jab mera unse koi khoon ka rishta nahi hai, mujhe unmein se kuch madadgaar mil jaayein jo meri family ki madad karein. Maine ye kufr ya deen se murtad hone ki wajah se nahi kiya aur mujhe Islam qubool karne ke baad kufr se koi lagaav nahi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne sach kaha. Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe is munafiq ki gardan maarne ki ijazat dijiye. Lekin unhone (Nabi SAW ne) farmaaya: Woh Badr mein shaamil the aur tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ne Badr ke logon ke baare mein kya farmaaya: Jo chaaho karo kyunki tumhare liye maafi hai. Aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: "Aye imaan waalo, mere dushman aur apne dushman ko dost mat banao" (60:1). Aur is aayat ka koi zikr Abu Bakr aur Zubair ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein nahi hai aur Ishaq ne apni riwayat mein Sufyan ke zariye is aayat ke padhne ka zikr kiya hai.

e: 'Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me and Abu Marthad al-Ghitnavi and Zubair b. 'Awwam and we were all riders, and he said: Ride on until you reach the garden of Khakh for there is a woman amongst the polytheists and there is a letter with her sent by Hatib to the polytheists; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe, Abu Marthad al-Ghitnavi aur Zubair bin Awwam ko bheja aur hum sab sawaar the, aur unhone farmaaya: Sawaar hokar chalo yahan tak ki tum Khakh ke baag tak pahuncho kyunki wahan mushrikeen mein se ek aurat hai aur uske paas ek khat hai jo Hatib ne mushrikeen ko bheja hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir reported that a slave of Hatib came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) complaining against Hatib and said: Hatib will definitely go to Hell. (But) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You tell a lie; he would not get into that for he had taken part in Badr and in (the expedition of) Hudaibiya.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hatib ke ek ghulam ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aakar Hatib ke khilaaf shikaayat ki aur kaha: Hatib zaroor Jahannam mein jaayenge. (Lekin) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum jhoot bolte ho; woh usmein nahi jaayenge kyunki unhone Badr aur (Hudaibiya ki muhim) mein hissa liya tha.

e: Umm Mubashshir reported that she heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying in presence of Hafsa: God willing, the people of the Tree would never enter the fire of Hell one amongst those who owed allegiance under that. She said: Allah's Messenger, why not? He scolded her. Hafsa said: And there is none amongst you but shall have to pass over that (narrow Bridge). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has said: We would rescue those persons who are God-conscious and we would leave the tyrants to their fate there (xix. 72).
hi: Umm Mubashshir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hafsa (RA) ki maujoodgi mein ye farmaate suna: Agar Allah ne chaaha, jinhone Darakht (ke neeche) wafadaari ki qasam li thi unmein se koi bhi Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil nahi hoga. Unhone (Hafsa ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aisa kyun nahi hoga? Unhone (Nabi ne) unhe daanta. Hafsa ne (phir) kaha: Aur tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jo usse (Pul se) guzre bina rahega. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya hai: Hum un logon ko bachaayenge jo Allah se Darte hain aur zaalimon ko waheen unke haal par chhod denge (19:72).

e: Abu Musa reported: I was in the company of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as he had been sitting in Ji'rana (a place) between Mecca and Medina and Bilal was also there, that there came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a desert Arab, and he said: Muhammad, fulfill your promise that you made with me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Accept glad tidings. Thereupon the desert Arab said: You shower glad tidings upon me very much; then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned towards Abu Musa and Bilal seemingly in a state of annoyance and said: Verily he has rejected glad tidings but you two should accept them. We said: Allah's Messenger, we have readily accepted them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for a cup of water and washed his hands in that and face too and put the saliva in it and then said: Drink out of it and pour it over your faces and over your chest and gladden yourselves. They took hold of the cup and did as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had commanded them to do. Thereupon Umm Salama called from behind the veil: Spare some water in your vessel for your mother also, and they also gave some water which had been spared for her.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha jab woh Ji'rana (ek jagah) mein Makkah aur Madina ke beech baithe the aur Bilal bhi wahan the, ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek registaan ka Arab aaya aur usne kaha: Muhammad, jo vaada aapne mujhse kiya use poora kijiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Khushkhabri qubool karo. Isper registaan ke Arab ne kaha: Aap mujhpar khushkhabri bahut zyada barsaate hain; phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Musa aur Bilal ki taraf mude jaise naaraaz haalat mein hon aur farmaaya: Yaqeenan usne khushkhabri radd kar di hai lekin tum dono ise qubool karo. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humne ise khushi se qubool kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani ka ek pyaala mangwaaya aur usmein apne haath aur chehra dhoya aur usmein lar daali aur phir farmaaya: Ismein se piyo aur ise apne chehron par aur apne seene par daalo aur khush ho jaao. Unhone pyaala pakDa aur waisa hi kiya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe hukum diya tha. Isi waqt Umm Salama ne parde ke peeche se pukaara: Apne bartan mein apni maa ke liye bhi thoda paani bacha rakho, aur unhone unke liye bhi thoda paani bacha kar diya.

e: Abu Burda reported on the authority of his father that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been free from the Battle of Hunain, he sent Abu 'Amir as the head of the army of Autas. He had an encounter with Duraid b. as_Simma. Duraid was killed and Allah gave defeat to his friends. Abu Musa said: He (the Holy Prophet) sent me along with Abu 'Amir and Abu 'Amir received a wound in his knee from the arrow, (shot by) a person of Bani Jusham. It stuck in his knee. I went to him and said: Uncle, who shot an arrow upon you? Abu 'Amir pointed out to Abu Musa and said: Verily that one who shot an arrow upon me in fact killed me. Abu Musa said: I followed him with the determination to kill him and overtook him and when he saw me he turned upon his heels. I followed him and I said to him: Don't you feel ashamed (that you run), aren't you an Arab? Why don't you stop? He stopped and I had an encounter with him and we exchanged the strokes of (swords). I struck him with the sword and killed him. Then I came back to Abu Amir and said: Verily Allah has killed the one who killed you. And he said: Now draw out this arrow. I drew out the arrow and there came out from that (wound) water. Abu 'Amir said: My nephew, go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and convey my greetings to him and tell him that Abu Amir begs you to ask forgiveness for him. And Abu Amir appointed me as the chief of the people and he died after a short time. When I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) I visited him and he had been lying on the cot woven by strings and there was (no) bed over it and so there had been marks of the strings on the back of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and on his sides. I narrated to him what had happened to us and narrated to him about Abu Amir and said to him that he had made a request to the effect that forgiveness should be sought for him (from Allah). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him) called for water and performed ablution with it. He then lifted his hands and said. O Allah, grant pardon to Thy servant Abu Amir. (The Prophet had raised his hands so high for supplication) that I saw the whiteness of his armpits. He again said: O Allah, grant him distinction amongst the majority of Thine created beings or from amongst the people. I said: Allah's Messenger, ask forgiveness for me too. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Allah, forgive the sins of Abdullah b. Qais (Abu Musa Ash'ari) and admit him to an elevated place on the Day of Resurrection. Abu Burda said: One prayer is for abu 'Amir and the other is tor Abu Musa.
hi: Abu Burda ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hunain ki jung se fursat paa gaye, unhone Abu Amir ko Autas ki fauj ka sardaar banaakar bheja. Unka Duraid bin as-Simma se muqaabla hua. Duraid maara gaya aur Allah ne unke doston ko shikast di. Abu Musa ne kaha: Unhone (Nabi ne) mujhe Abu Amir ke saath bheja aur Abu Amir ko unke ghutne par ek teer se zakhm laga, jo Banu Jusham ke ek shakhs ne chalaaya tha. Ye unke ghutne mein phans gaya. Main unke paas gaya aur kaha: Chacha, kisne aap par teer chalaaya? Abu Amir ne Abu Musa ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: Yaqeenan jisne mujhpar teer chalaaya usne dar-asal mujhe qatal kar diya hai. Abu Musa ne kaha: Maine usko qatal karne ke iraade se picha kiya aur use pakad liya aur jab usne mujhe dekha woh apni eDiyon ke bal mud gaya. Maine uska picha kiya aur usse kaha: Kya tumhe sharm nahi aati (ki tum bhaagte ho), kya tum Arab nahi ho? Kyun nahi rukte? Woh ruka aur humaara muqaabla hua aur humne talwaaron se waar exchange kiye. Maine use talwaar se maara aur qatal kar diya. Phir main Abu Amir ke paas wapas aaya aur kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne us shakhs ko maar diya hai jisne aapko maara. Aur unhone kaha: Ab ye teer nikaalo. Maine teer nikaala aur usmein se paani nikla. Abu Amir ne kaha: Mere bhatije, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jao aur unhe mera salaam pahunchaao aur unhe bataao ki Abu Amir ne guzaarish ki hai ki aap unke liye maafi maangein. Aur Abu Amir ne mujhe logon ka sardaar muqarrar kiya aur thodi der baad unka intiqaal ho gaya. Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya main unse mila aur woh rassiyon se buni ek charpaai par lete the aur uspar koi bistar nahi tha aur is liye rassiyon ke nishaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki peeth aur unke pehluon par the. Maine unhe wo sab riwayat kiya jo humaare saath hua tha aur unhe Abu Amir ke baare mein bataya aur unse kaha ki unhone guzaarish ki thi ki unke liye maafi maangi jaaye (Allah se). Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani mangwaaya aur usse wuzu kiya. Phir unhone apne haath uThaaye aur farmaaya: Aye Allah, Apne banda Abu Amir ko maaf kar de. (Nabi ne apne haath itne oonche uThaaye) ki maine unki baaghlon ki safedi dekh li. Unhone phir farmaaya: Aye Allah, use apni bahut si makhlooq mein, ya logon mein, behtareen darja de. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere liye bhi maafi maangiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Abdullah bin Qais (Abu Musa Ash'ari) ke gunah maaf kar aur unhe Qayamat ke din ek uchcha maqaam par daakhil kar. Abu Burda ne kaha: Ek dua Abu Amir ke liye hai aur doosri Abu Musa ke liye.

e: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I recognise the voice of the Ash'arites while they recite the Qur'an as they arrive during the night and I also recognise their station from the recital of the Qur'an during the night time, although I have not seen their encampments as they encamp during the day time. And there is a person amongst them, Hakim; when he encounters the horsemen or the enemies he says to them: My friends command you to wait for them.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main Ash'ari qabile ki aawaaz pehchaanta hoon jab woh Quran padhte hain aur woh raat ko pahunchte hain aur main unki jagah bhi raat ke waqt Quran ki tilawat se pehchaanta hoon, halaanki maine unke padaav din mein nahi dekhe kyunki woh din mein padaav dete hain. Aur unmein se ek shakhs hai, Hakim; jab woh sawaaron ya dushmanon ka saamna karta hai woh unse kehta hai: Mere dost tumhe hukum dete hain ki tum unka intezaar karo.

e: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When the Ash'arites run short of provisions in the campaigns or run short of food for their children in Medina they collect whatever is with them in the cloth and then partake equally from one vessel. They are from me and I am from them.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Ash'ari qabile ke logon ka raashan muhimon mein kam ho jaata hai ya Madina mein unke bachchon ke liye khaana kam ho jaata hai, woh apne paas jo kuch hota hai use ek kapde mein ikattha kar lete hain aur phir ek hi bartan se barabar hissa lete hain. Woh mujhse hain aur main unse hoon.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that the Muslims neither looked to Abu Sufyan (with respect) nor did they sit in his company. he (Abu Sufyan) said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): Allah's Apostle, confer upon me three things. He replied in the affirmative. He (further) said: I have with me the most handsome and the best (woman) Umm Habiba, daughter of Abu Sufyan; marry her, whereupon he said: Yes. And he again said: Accept Mu'awiya to serve as your scribe. He said: Yes. He again said: Make me the commander (of the Muslim army) so that I should fight against the unbelievers as I fought against the Muslims. He said: Yes. Abu Zumnail said: If he had not asked for these three things from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), he would have never conferred them upon him, for it was (his habit) to accede to everybody's (earnest) request.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Musalmaan na Abu Sufyan ki taraf (izzat se) dekhte the na unki sohbat mein baithte the. Unhone (Abu Sufyan ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe teen cheezein ata kijiye. Unhone haan mein jawaab diya. Unhone (aage) kaha: Mere paas sabse khoobsurat aur behtareen (aurat) Umm Habiba hai, Abu Sufyan ki beti; unse shaadi kar lijiye, isper unhone farmaaya: Theek hai. Aur unhone dobara kaha: Mu'awiya ko apne munshi ke soorat mein qubool kijiye. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. Unhone phir kaha: Mujhe (Musalmaan fauj ka) sardaar banaaiye taaki main un logon ke khilaaf jung karun jinke khilaaf maine pehle Musalmaanon ke khilaaf jung ki thi. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. Abu Zumail ne kaha: Agar unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye teen cheezein na maangi hoti, unhone unhe kabhi ata nahi ki hoti, kyunki (unki aadat thi) har kisi ki (sacchi) darkhwaast ko qubool karna.

e: Abu Musa reported: We were in Yemen when we heard of the migration of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We also set out as immigrants to him. And I was accompanied by two brothers of mine, I being the youngest of them; one of them was Abu Burda and the other one was Abu Ruhm, and there were some other persons with them. Some say they were fifty-three or fifty-two persons of my tribe. We embarked upon a boat, and the boat sailed away to the Negus of Abyssinia. There we met Ja'far b. Abu Talib and his companions. Ja'far said: Allall's Messenger (ﷺ) has sent us here and has commanded us to stay here and you should also stay with us. So we stayed with him and we came back (to Medina) and met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when Khaibar had been conquered. He (the Holy Prophet) allocated a share to us and in the ordinary course he did not allocate the share to one who had been absent on the occasion of the conquest of Khaibar but conferred (a share) upon him only who had been present there with him. He, however, made an exception for the people of the boat, viz. for Ja'far and his companions. He allocated a share to them, and some persons from amongst the people said to us, viz. the people of the boat: We have preceded you in migration. Asma' bint 'Umais who had migrated to Abyssinia and had come back along with them (along with immigrants) visited Hafsa, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). (Accordingly), Umar had been sitting with her (Hafsa). As 'Umar saw Asma, he said: Who is she? She (Hafsa) said: She is Asma, daughter of 'Umais. He said: She is an Abyssinian and a sea-woman. Asma said: Yes, it is so. Thereupon 'Umar said: We preceded you in migration and so we have more right to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as compared with you. At this she felt annoyed and said: 'Umar, you are not stating the fact; by Allah, you had the privilege of being in the company of the Messenger (ﷺ) who fed the hungry among you and instructed the ignorant amongst you, whereas we had been far (from here) in the land of Abyssinia amongst the enemies and that was all for Allah and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and, by Allah, I would never take food nor take water unless I make a mention to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of what you have said. We remained in that country in constant trouble and dread and I shall talk about it to Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) and ask him (about it). By Allah, I shall not tell a lie and deviate (from the truth) and add anything to that. So, when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came, she said: Allah's Apostle, 'Umar says so and so. Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: His right is not more than yours, for him and his companions there is one migration, but for you, i. e. for the people of the boat, there are two migrations. She said: I saw Abu Musa and the people of the boat coming to me in groups and asking me about this hadith, because there was nothing more pleasing and more significant for them than this. Abu Burda reported that Asma said: I saw Abu Musa, asking me to repeat this hadith to him again and again.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Yemen mein the jab humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hijrat ki khabar mili. Hum bhi unki taraf hijrat karne nikle. Aur mere saath mere do bhai the, main unmein sabse chhota tha; unmein se ek Abu Burda the aur doosre Abu Ruhm the, aur unke saath kuch aur log bhi the. Kuch kehte hain ki mere qabile ke terpan ya bavan log the. Hum ek kashti par sawaar huye, aur kashti Habsha (Abyssinia) ke Najashi ki taraf chal padi. Wahan hum Ja'far bin Abu Talib aur unke saathiyon se mile. Ja'far ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein yahan bheja hai aur humein yahan rehne ka hukum diya hai aur tumhe bhi humare saath rehna chahiye. Is liye hum unke saath rahe aur (Madina) wapas aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile jab Khaibar fatah ho chuka tha. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) humein hissa diya aur aam taur par unhone Khaibar ki fatah ke waqt gair-haazir shakhs ko koi hissa nahi diya balki sirf usi ko diya jo wahan unke saath maujood tha. Unhone, halaanki, kashti waalon ke liye ek apwaad banaaya, yaani Ja'far aur unke saathiyon ke liye. Unhone unhe hissa diya, aur logon mein se kuch ne humse, yaani kashti waalon se, kaha: Humne hijrat mein tumse sabqat li hai. Asma bint Umais, jinhone Habsha ki taraf hijrat ki thi aur unke (Muhajirin ke) saath wapas aayi thin, Hafsa (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se milne gayin. (Isi waqt), Umar (RA) unke (Hafsa ke) saath baithe hue the. Jab Umar ne Asma ko dekha, unhone kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone (Hafsa ne) kaha: Ye Asma hain, Umais ki beti. Unhone kaha: Ye Habashi hain aur samundari safar karne wali. Asma ne kaha: Haan, aisa hi hai. Isper Umar ne kaha: Humne hijrat mein tumse sabqat li hai is liye humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par tumse zyada haq hai. Isse woh naaraaz hui aur kaha: Umar, aap sach nahi keh rahe; Allah ki qasam, aapko Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein rehne ka saubhaagya mila jinhone tum mein se bhookhon ko khilaaya aur tum mein se jaahilon ko sikhaaya, jabki hum yahan se door Habsha ki zameen mein dushmanon ke beech the aur ye sab Allah aur Allah ke Rasool ki khaatir tha aur, Allah ki qasam, main na khaana khaungi na paani piyungi jab tak main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aapke alfaazon ka zikr nahi karti. Hum us mulk mein lagataar museebat aur khauf mein rahe aur main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baat karungi aur unse (iske baare mein) poochungi. Allah ki qasam, main jhoot nahi bolungi aur (sach se) nahi hatungi aur na ismein kuch izafa karungi. To, jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Umar aisa-aisa kehte hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Unka haq tumse zyada nahi hai, unke aur unke saathiyon ke liye ek hijrat hai, lekin tumhare liye, yaani kashti waalon ke liye, do hijraten hain. Unhone (Asma ne) kaha: Maine Abu Musa aur kashti waalon ko giroh dar giroh mere paas aate dekha aur mujhse ye hadees baar-baar poochte, kyunki unke liye ismein jitni khushi aur ahmiyat thi utni kisi doosri baat mein nahi thi. Abu Burda ne riwayat ki ki Asma ne kaha: Maine Abu Musa ko dekha ki woh mujhse ye hadees baar-baar dohraane ko keh rahe the.

e: 'A'idh b. Amr reported that Abu Sufyan came to Salman, Suhaib and Bilal in the presence of a group of persons. They said: By Allah, the sword of Allah did not reach the neck of the enemy of Allah as it was required to reach. Thereupon Abu Bakr said: Do you say this to the old man of the Quraish and their chief? Then he came to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon'him) and informed him of this. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Abu Bakr, you have perhaps annoyed them and if you annoyed them you have in fact annoyed your Lord. So Abu Bakr came to them and said: O my brothers, I have annoyed you. They said: No, our brother, may Allah forgive you
hi: Aidh bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu Sufyan Salman, Suhaib aur Bilal ke paas ek majlis mein aaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ki talwaar Allah ke dushman ki gardan tak nahi pahunchi jaisa isse pahunchna chahiye tha. Isper Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: Kya tum Quraish ke boodhe aur unke sardaar se aisa kehte ho? Phir woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe iski jaankaari di. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Abu Bakr, shaayad tumne unhe naaraaz kiya hai aur agar tumne unhe naaraaz kiya hai to tumne apne Rab ko naaraaz kiya hai. To Abu Bakr unke paas gaye aur kaha: Mere bhaiyo, maine tumhe naaraaz kiya hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi, humaare bhai, Allah aapko maaf kare.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that it was concerning them (the Ansar) that this verse was revealed, that when the two groups amongst you were about to lose heart and Allah was the Guardian of them both. This concerned Banu Salama and Banu Haritha and we did not like that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, should not have revealed this verse for the fact that Allah (gave an assurance) of being the Guardian of both.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ye aayat unke (Ansar ke) silsile mein nazil hui thi, ki jab tum mein se do giroh himmat harne hi wale the aur Allah unme se donon ka nigehbaan tha. Ye Banu Salama aur Banu Haritha ke baare mein tha aur humein ye pasand nahi tha ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ye aayat na nazil karta kyunki isse pata chalta hai ki Allah donon ka (Aashiq) nigehbaan hai.

e: Zaid b. Arqam reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah,, grant forgiveness to the Ansar, the offspring of the Ansar and the offspring of the offspring of the Ansar. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shulba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Ansar ko, Ansar ki aulaad ko aur Ansar ki aulaad ki aulaad ko maafi de. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sought forgiveness for the Ansar and he said: I think (he also sought forgiveness) for the children of the Ansar and the slaves and the freed men of the Ansar. I have no doubt about it.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke liye maafi maangi aur unhone farmaaya: Mujhe lagta hai (unhone Ansar ke bachchon, ghulamon aur aazad kiye gaye logon ke liye bhi maafi maangi). Mujhe ismein koi shak nahi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw children and women of the Ansar coming back from a wedding feast. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stood up motionless (as a mark of respect) and said: O Allah, (bear witness) (and addressing the Ansar), said: You are dearest to me amongst people, (and said: O Allah (bear witness) (and addressing the Ansar), said: You are dearest to me amongst people. And he meant Ansar.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke bachchon aur auraton ko ek shaadi ki dawat se wapas aate dekha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (izzat ke nishaan ke soorat mein) khade rahe bina hile aur farmaaya: Aye Allah, (gawaah rah) aur (Ansar ko sambodhit karte hue) farmaaya: Tum sab logon mein mujhe sabse aziz ho, aur (aage kaha: Aye Allah, gawaah rah) aur (Ansar ko sambodhit karte hue) farmaaya: Tum sab logon mein mujhe sabse aziz ho. Aur unka matlab Ansar se tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a woman from the Ansar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood aside with her and said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, you are dearest to me amongst the people. He repeated it thrice.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke saath ek taraf khade hue aur farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, tum sab logon mein mujhe sabse aziz ho. Unhone ise teen baar dohraaya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Ansar are my family and my trusted friends. and the people would increase in number whereas they (the Ansar) would become less and less, so appreciate the deeds of those from amongst them who do good and overlook their failings.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ansar mera khaandaan aur mere bharosemand dost hain, aur log tadaad mein badhenge jabki woh (Ansar) kam hote jaayenge, is liye unmein se jo achha karte hain unke amal ki qadar karo aur unki khaamiyon ko nazar-andaaz karo.

e: Abu Usaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The worthiest clans of the Ansar are Banu Najjar, thereafter Banu al-Ashhal; thereafter Banu Harith b. Banu Khazraj; thereafter Banu Sa'idah and there is goodness in all clans of the Ansar. Sa'd said: I see that he (the Holy Prophet) has placed others above us. It was said to (him): He has placed you above many others.
hi: Abu Usaid (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ansar mein sabse behtareen qabile Banu Najjar hain, phir Banu al-Ashhal; phir Banu Harith bin Banu Khazraj; phir Banu Sa'ida aur Ansar ke sab qabilon mein achhaai hai. Sa'd ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (Nabi ne) doosron ko humse upar rakha hai. Unse kaha gaya: Unhone tumhe bahut se doosron se upar rakha hai.

e: Abu Usaid Ansari has reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters. When the Prophet (ﷺ) was marching towards Badr in order
hi: Abu Usaid Ansari ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki. Jab Nabi (SAW) Badr ki taraf march kar rahe the...

e: Anas reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but he has made no mention in the hadith of the words of Sa'd.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki lekin unhone hadees mein Sa'd ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. Talha reported: I heard Abu Sa'ld delivering an address in the presence of Abu 'Utba that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The worthiest settlements of the Ansar are those of Banu Najjar, then of Banu 'Abu al-Ashhal and then of Banu Harith and then of Banu Khazraj and then of the clan of Banu Sa'idah, and if I were to give preference to anyone besides them I would have given preference to my relatives.
hi: Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Talha ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id ko Abu Utba ki maujoodgi mein khitaab dete suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ansar ki sabse behtareen bastiyaan Banu Najjar ki hain, phir Banu Abu al-Ashhal ki, phir Banu Harith ki aur phir Banu Khazraj ki aur phir Banu Sa'ida qabile ki, aur agar main inke ilawa kisi ko tarjeeh deta, to main apne rishtedaaron ko tarjeeh deta.

e: Abu Usaid Ansar reported: I bear witness to the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The best settlements of the Ansar are of those of Banu Najjar, then of Banu 'Abu al-Aslihal and then of Banu Harith b. Khazraj, then of Banu Sa'ida and there is in every settlement of the Ansar good. Abu Salama reported that Abu Usaid said: Can I tell a Iie about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? And if I were a liar, I would have started with my tribe Banu Sa'ida. This was conveyed to Sa'd b. 'Ubida and he found (rankling) in his mind and said: We have been left behind (in the sense) that we have been (mentioned) last of the four. He (Sa'd) sid: Saddle my pony so that I should go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). His nephew saw him and said: Are you going to contradict (the order of) precedence set by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has the best knowledge of it? Is it not sufficient for you that you are the fourth amongst the four (best tribes of the Ansar)? So he returned and said: Allah and His Messenger know best, and he commanded that his pony should be unsaddled.
hi: Abu Usaid Ansari ne bayan kiya: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ansar ki behtareen bastiyaan Banu Najjar ki hain, phir Banu Abu al-Ashhal ki, phir Banu Harith bin Khazraj ki, phir Banu Sa'ida ki aur Ansar ki har basti mein achhaai hai. Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki Abu Usaid ne kaha: Kya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein jhoot bol sakta hoon? Aur agar main jhoota hota, to main apne qabile Banu Sa'ida se shuruaat karta. Ye baat Sa'd bin Ubada tak pahunchi aur unhe (isse) dil mein takleef hui aur unhone kaha: Humein peeche chhod diya gaya hai (is maayne mein) ki humaara zikr chaaron mein aakhir mein hua. Unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: Mera ghoda taiyaar karo taaki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaaun. Unke bhatije ne unhe dekha aur kaha: Kya aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zariye tay ki gayi tarteeb ka virodh karne jaa rahe hain, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iska sabse behtareen ilm hai? Kya ye aapke liye kaafi nahi hai ki aap chaaron (Ansar ke behtareen qabilon) mein chauthe hain? Is liye woh wapas gaye aur kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool behtar jaante hain, aur unhone hukum diya ki unka ghoda wapas rakh diya jaaye.

e: Abu Usaid Ansari reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The worthiest of the Ansar or the worthiest of the settlements and the clans of Ansar; the rest of the hadith is the same, but there is no mention of the story of Sa'd b. 'Ubida (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Abu Usaid Ansari ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ansar mein sabse behtareen, ya Ansar ki bastiyon aur qabilon mein sabse behtareen; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin ismein Sa'd bin Ubada (RA) ke kisse ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying in a large gathering of the Muslims: Should I not tell you of the best clans of the Ansar? They said: Allah's Messenger, (kindly) do this. Thereupon Allah's Messenger said: That is Banu Abd al-Ashhal. They said: Allah's Messenger, then next? He said: Banu Najjar. They again said: Allah's Messenger, then next? He said: Then of Banu Harith b. Khazraj. They then said: Allah's Messenger, then next? He said. Then of Banu Sa'ida. They said: Allah's Messenger, then next? He said: There is good in all the clans of the Ansar. It was upon this that Sa'd b. Ubida stood up in annoyance and said: Are we the last of the four as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has determined (the order of precedence) of their clans? He decided to talk with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on this issue, but the people Of his tribe said to him: Be seated, are you not happy with this that Allah's Messenger' (ﷺ) has mentioned your clan as one of the four (best) clans and those whom he left and did not mention (the order of their precedence) are more than those whom he mentioned? And Sa'd b. 'Ubada dropped the idea of talking to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on this issue).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Musalmaanon ki ek badi majlis mein ye farmaate suna: Kya main tumhe Ansar ke behtareen qabilon ke baare mein na bataaun? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meherbani karke aisa kijiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye Banu Abd al-Ashhal hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir kaun? Unhone farmaaya: Banu Najjar. Unhone phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir kaun? Unhone farmaaya: Phir Banu Harith bin Khazraj. Unhone phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir kaun? Unhone farmaaya: Phir Banu Sa'ida. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir kaun? Unhone farmaaya: Ansar ke sab qabilon mein achhaai hai. Isper Sa'd bin Ubada naaraazgi mein khade huye aur kaha: Kya hum chaaron mein aakhri hain jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unke qabilon ki) tarteeb tay ki hai? Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baare mein baat karne ka faisla kiya, lekin unke qabile ke logon ne unse kaha: Baith jaao, kya aap isse khush nahi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapke qabile ka zikr chaar (behtareen) qabilon mein se ek ke soorat mein kiya hai aur jinka unhone zikr nahi kiya aur jinhe chhod diya woh unse zyada hain jinka unhone zikr kiya? Aur Sa'd bin Ubada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (is baare mein) baat karne ka khyaal chhod diya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I set out along with Jabrir b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali on a journey and he used to serve me. I said to him: Don't do that. Thereupon he said: I have seen Ansar doing this with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I swore by Allah whenever I accompany any one of the Ansar, I would serve him and Ibn Muthanni, and Ibn Bashshir made this addition in their narrations: Jarir was older than Anas, and Ibn Bashshir said: He was of a more advanced age as compared with Anas. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) invoked blessings for the tribes of Ghifar and Aslam.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Jarir bin Abdullah al-Bajali (RA) ke saath ek safar par nikla aur woh meri khidmat kiya karte the. Maine unse kaha: Aisa mat kijiye. Isper unhone kaha: Maine Ansar ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aisa karte dekha hai. Maine Allah ki qasam khayi thi ki jab bhi main Ansar mein se kisi ke saath hoon, main unki khidmat karunga aur Ibn Muthanna aur Ibn Bashshir ne apni riwayaton mein ye izafa kiya: Jarir Anas se umar mein bade the, aur Ibn Bashshir ne kaha: Woh Anas ke muqable zyada umar ke the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghifar aur Aslam qabilon ke liye barkat maangi.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Go to your people and say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) says: Ghifar (is a tribe) to whom Allah granted pardon, and Aslam (is the tribe) to whom Allah granted safety.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Apne logon ke paas jao aur kaho ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) farmaate hain: Ghifar (ek qabila hai) jise Allah ne maafi di hai, aur Aslam (woh qabila hai) jise Allah ne hifaazat di hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: To the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and to the tribe of Ghifar Allah has granted pardon.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aslam qabile ko Allah ne hifaazat di hai aur Ghifar qabile ko Allah ne maafi di hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters on the authority of Jabir and Abu Huraira that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: To the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and to the tribe of Ghifar Allah has granted pardon.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir aur Abu Huraira ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aslam qabile ko Allah ne hifaazat di hai aur Ghifar qabile ko Allah ne maafi di hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: To the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and to the tribe of Ghifar Allah has granted pardon. Verily it is not I that say this, but (it is) Allah the Exalted and Glorious. (who) says this.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aslam qabile ko Allah ne hifaazat di hai aur Ghifar qabile ko Allah ne maafi di hai. Yaqeenan ye main nahi kehta, balki (ye) Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, farmaate hain.

e: Khufaf b. Jura' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in prayer: O Allah, hurl curse upon the tribe of Lihyan and Ri'l aid Dhakwan and Usayya for they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger, (and for) Ghifar Allah has granted pardon and for the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety.
hi: Khufaf bin Jura ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz mein farmaaya: Aye Allah, Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayya qabilon par laanat bhej kyunki unhone Allah aur Uske Rasool ki naafarmani ki, (aur) Ghifar ko Allah ne maafi di hai aur Aslam qabile ko Allah ne hifaazat di hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah has granted pardon to the tribe of Ghifar and to the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and as for Usayya tribe, they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne Ghifar qabile ko maafi di hai aur Aslam qabile ko Allah ne hifaazat di hai aur jahan tak Usayya qabile ka sawaal hai, unhone Allah aur Uske Rasool ki naafarmani ki.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Umar with a slight variation of wording (and the wording) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this on the pulpit.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye mimbar par farmaaya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Umar but through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Ayyub reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The tribes of Ansar, Muzaina and Juhaina and Ghifar and Ashja' and those from Banu 'Abdullah, they are my friends amongst the people and Allah and His Messenger are their protectors.
hi: Abu Ayyub (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ansar, Muzaina, Juhaina, Ghifar aur Ashja qabile, aur Banu Abdullah mein se jo log hain, woh logon mein mere dost hain aur Allah aur Uske Rasool unke sarparast hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Quraish, Ansar, Muzaina, Juhaina and Ghifar, they are my friends and there is no friend of theirs besides Allah and His Messenger.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Quraish, Ansar, Muzaina, Juhaina aur Ghifar, woh mere dost hain aur unka Allah aur Uske Rasool ke siwaay koi doosra dost nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Ibrahim with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'd bin Ibrahim ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The tribes of Ashja', Ghifar and Muzaina and from the tribe of Juhaina they are better than Banu Tamim, Banu Amir and the allies of Asad and Ghatfan.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ashja, Ghifar aur Muzaina qabile aur Juhaina qabile mein se log, Banu Tamim, Banu Amir aur Asad aur Ghatfan ke sahyogiyon se behtar hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, (the tribes of) Ghifar, Aslam, Muzaina, or from the tribe of Juhaina or from the tribe of Muzaina, they would be better in the eye of Allah than Asad, Tayyi, and Ghatfan on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, (Ghifar, Aslam, Muzaina qabile), ya Juhaina qabile se ya Muzaina qabile se, Qayamat ke din Allah ki nazar mein Asad, Tayyi aur Ghatfan se behtar honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Aslam, Ghifar or some people from Muzaina, Juhaina (with the variation of words) are better in the eye of Allah than Asad, Ghatfan, Hawizin and Tamim. The narrator said: I think he also said:" On the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aslam, Ghifar ya Muzaina, Juhaina ke kuch log (alfaazon mein badlaav ke saath) Allah ki nazar mein Asad, Ghatfan, Hawazin aur Tamim se behtar hain. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Qayamat ke din.

e: Abu Bakra reported from his father that al-Aqra' b. Habis reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: How did the tribes of Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina (and I think he also said Juhaina and the narrator is in doubt about it) owe allegiance to you, whereas they plundered the pilgrims? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:" you were to say that Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina and I think Juhaina are better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Amir and Asad, Ghatfan, then would these people (of latter group of tribes) be in loss? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, these people are better than Banu Tamim, Banu Amir, Asad and Ghatfan, and in this hadith of Abu Shaiba (these words are not found) that Muhammad (the narrator) had a doubt about.
hi: Abu Bakra (RA) ne apne waalid se riwayat ki ki Aqra bin Habis ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aakar kaha: Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina (aur mujhe lagta hai unhone Juhaina bhi kaha, aur raawi ko ismein shak hai) ne aapse wafadaari ki qasam kaise li, jabki unhone haajiyon ko lootA? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar tum kehte ki Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina aur mujhe lagta hai Juhaina, Banu Tamim, Banu Amir aur Asad, Ghatfan se behtar hain, to kya ye log (doosre giroh ke qabile) nuksaan mein hote? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, ye log Banu Tamim, Banu Amir, Asad aur Ghatfan se behtar hain, aur Abu Shaiba ki is hadees mein (ye alfaaz nahi milte) jinke baare mein Muhammad (raawi) ko shak tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'qub Dabbi with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'qub Dabbi ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Bakra reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina and Juhaina are better than Banu Tamim, Banu Amir and their allies Banu Asad and Ghatfan.
hi: Abu Bakra (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaina aur Juhaina, Banu Tamim, Banu Amir aur unke sahyogi Banu Asad aur Ghatfan se behtar hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bishr with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bishr ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Bakra reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is your view if Juhaina, Aslam, Ghifar were better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Abdullah b. Ghatfan and 'Amir b. Sa'sa'a' respectively (then what would be status of the latter one)? He said this in a loud voice. They said: Allah's Messenger, they would be definitely at a loss and disadvantage. Thereupon he said: They (the first group) are decidedly better than the others; and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Kuraib the words are: It you were to find that Juhaina, Muzaina and Aslam and Ghifar (are better than...).
hi: Abu Bakra (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaari kya raay hai agar Juhaina, Aslam, Ghifar, kramashah Banu Tamim, Banu Abdullah bin Ghatfan aur Amir bin Sa'sa'a se behtar hon (to phir doosron ki kya haalat hogi)? Unhone ye buland aawaaz mein farmaaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh zaroor nuksaan aur nuksan mein honge. Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh (pehla giroh) doosron se yaqeenan behtar hain; aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: Agar tum paao ki Juhaina, Muzaina, Aslam aur Ghifar (doosron se behtar hain).

e: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I came to Umar b. Khattab and he said to me: The first consignment of Sadaqa brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which brightened the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the faces of his Companions was that of Tayyi.
hi: Adi bin Hatim (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Umar bin Khattab (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhone mujhse kaha: Sadaqe ki pehli khep jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi aur jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka aur unke Sahaba (RA) ka chehra roshan kiya woh Tayyi qabile ki thi.
