e: Abu Huraira reported that Tufail and his companions said: Allah's Messenger, the tribe of Daws has disbelieved and has belied you, so invoke curse upon them. It was said: Let Daws be destroyed, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: Allah guide aright the tribe of Daws and direct them to me.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Tufail aur unke saathiyon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Daws qabile ne kufr kiya hai aur aapko jhoota kaha hai, is liye unpar laanat bhejiye. Kaha gaya: Daws barbaad ho jaaye, isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) farmaaya: Aye Allah, Daws qabile ko sahi raah dikha aur unhein mere paas le aa.

Qutaiba bin Sa'id ne humein riwayat ki, Jarir ne humein riwayat ki, Mughira se, Harith se, Abu Zur'a se, unhone kaha: Abu Huraira (RA) ne kaha: Main hamesha Banu Tamim se muhabbat karta rahunga teen baaton ki wajah se jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Woh meri Ummat mein Dajjal ke khilaaf sabse sakht hain. Unhone kaha: Aur unke sadaqe (Nabi ke paas) aaye aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye humaare qaum ke sadaqe hain. Unhone kaha: Aur unmein se ek qaidi Aisha (RA) ke paas thi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ise azaad kar do kyunki woh Ismail ki aulaad mein se hai.

e: The other hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye doosri hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: There are some distinguishing features of Banu Tamim which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and my love for them is never on the decline after that and the words are: They are the bravest amongst people in the battlefield and there is no mention of (the word)" Dajjal".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Banu Tamim ki kuch khaasiyaten hain jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni aur uske baad se unke prati meri muhabbat kabhi kam nahi hui aur alfaaz hain: Woh jung ke maidaan mein logon mein sabse zyada bahaadur hain aur ismein "Dajjal" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You would find people like those of mine, the good amongst you in the Days of Ignorance would be good amongst you in the days of Islam, provided they have an understanding of it and you will find good amongst people the persons who would be averse to position of authority until it is thrust upon them, and you will find the worst amongst persons one who has double face. He comes with one face to them and with the other face to the others.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhe mere jaise log milenge, Jaahiliyat ke daur mein achhe log Islam ke daur mein bhi achhe honge, bashart-e ki unhe iski (deen ki) samajh ho aur tumhe logon mein sabse achhe woh log milenge jo ohde aur ikhtiyar se dur bhaagte hain jab tak ye unpar thopa na jaaye, aur tumhe logon mein sabse buray woh milenge jo do-mumhe hain. Woh ek chehra unke paas lekar aate hain aur doosra chehra doosron ke paas.

e: This hadith has been transmitted through other chains of transmitters.  The chain of of Abu Zur'a has a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Abu Zur'a ki sanad mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Good amongst the women are those who ride camels. One of them said: They are pious women of the Quraish, and the other one said: The women of the Quraish are kind to the orphans in their childhood and look after the wealth of their spouses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Auraton mein achhi woh hain jo oont par sawaar hoti hain. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Woh Quraish ki nekokaar auraten hain, aur doosre ne kaha: Quraish ki auraten apne bachpan mein anaathon ke prati meherbaan hoti hain aur apne shohar ke maal ki dekhbhaal karti hain.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording and there is no word" orphan".
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein "anaath" lafz nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The women of the Quraish are good amongst the womenfolk. They ride camels and show affection to their children and zealously guard the wealth of their husbands. Abu Huraira said at the end of this narration that Mary, the daughter of Imran, never rode the camel.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Quraish ki auraten auraton mein achhi hain. Woh oont par sawaar hoti hain, apne bachchon se muhabbat dikhaati hain aur apne shohar ke maal ki poori hifaazat karti hain. Abu Huraira ne is riwayat ke ant mein kaha ki Mary, Imran ki beti, ne kabhi oont par sawaari nahi ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave a proposal of marriage to Umm Hani, the daughter of Abu Talib, whereupon she said: Allah's Messenger, I am of an advanced age with a (large) family. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The best women are those who ride (the camels) ; the rest of the hadith is the same but with this difference that, instead of the word Ar'a the word Ahna has been used (and the complete sentence is like this): That they treat children in their childhood with affection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, ko shaadi ka prastaav diya, isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main umar mein bhaari umar ki hoon aur mera (bada) khaandaan hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Behtareen auraten woh hain jo (oont par) sawaar hoti hain; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki "Ar'a" lafz ki jagah "Ahna" lafz istemal kiya gaya hai (aur poora vaakya is tarah hai): Ki woh apne bachpan mein bachchon ke saath muhabbat se pesh aati hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best women who ride the camels are the pious women of the Quraish; they treat with affection children in their childhood and keep a strict watch on the wealth of their spouses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Behtareen auraten jo oont par sawaar hoti hain Quraish ki nekokaar auraten hain; woh apne bachpan mein bachchon ke saath muhabbat se pesh aati hain aur apne shohar ke maal ki sakhti se hifaazat karti hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established fraternity between Abu Ubaida b. Jarrah and Abu Talha.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah aur Abu Talha ke beech bhai-chaara qaim kiya.

e: It was said to Anas b. Malik: You must have heard this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no alliance (hilf) of brotherhood in Islam. Anas said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established the bond of fraternity between the Quraish and the Ansar in his home.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se kaha gaya: Aapne zaroor ye suna hoga ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Islam mein koi (aur) bhai-chaare ka ehad nahi hai. Anas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne ghar mein Quraish aur Ansar ke beech bhai-chaare ka bandhan qaim kiya.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established fraternity between the Quraish and the Ansar in his house at Medina.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina mein apne ghar mein Quraish aur Ansar ke beech bhai-chaara qaim kiya.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no alliance (hilf) in Islam but (the hilf) established in the pre-Islamic days (for good). Islam intensifies and strengthens it.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Islam mein koi (naya) ehad nahi hai, lekin (jo ehad) Islam se pehle ke daur mein (achhaai ke liye) qaim kiya gaya tha, Islam use aur mazboot aur pukhta banaata hai.

e: Abu Burda reported on the authority of his father: We offered the sunset prayer along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). We then said: If we sit (along with Allah's Messenger) and observe night prayer with him it would be very good, so we sat down and he came to us and said: You are still sitting here. I said: Allah's Messenger, we observed evening prayer with you, then we said: Let us sit down and observe night prayer along with you, whereupon he said: You have done well or you have done right. He then lifted his head towards the sky and it often happened that as he lifted his head towards the sky, he said: The stars are a source of security for the sky and when the stars disappear there comes to the sky, i. e. (it meets the same fate) as it has been promised (it would plunge into darkness). And I am a source of safety and security to my Companions and when I would go away there would fall to the lot (of my Companions) as they have been promised with and my Companions are a source of security for the Umma and as they would go there would fall to the lot of my Umma as (its people) have been promised.
hi: Abu Burda ne apne waalid ke hawaale se bayan kiya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maghrib ki namaz padhi. Phir humne kaha: Agar hum (Allah ke Rasool ke saath) baithein aur unke saath raat ki namaz padhein to ye bahut achha hoga, is liye hum baith gaye aur woh humaare paas aaye aur farmaaya: Tum abhi bhi yahan baithe ho. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humne aapke saath maghrib ki namaz padhi, phir humne kaha: Aao hum baithein aur aapke saath raat ki namaz padhein, isper unhone farmaaya: Tumne achha kiya ya tumne sahi kiya. Phir unhone apna sar aasmaan ki taraf uThAya aur aksar aisa hota ki jab woh apna sar aasmaan ki taraf uThAte, woh farmaate: Taare aasmaan ke liye hifaazat ka srot hain aur jab taare gaayab ho jaayenge to aasmaan par (wahi museebat) aayegi, yaani (jo vaada kiya gaya hai woh poora hoga, ye andhere mein doob jaayega). Aur main apne Sahaba ke liye hifaazat aur bharose ka srot hoon aur jab main chala jaunga to (mere Sahaba ke saath) woh hoga jiska unse vaada kiya gaya hai aur mere Sahaba Ummat ke liye hifaazat ka srot hain aur jab woh chale jaayenge to (meri Ummat ke saath) woh hoga jiska unse (unke logon se) vaada kiya gaya hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A time would come for the people when groups of people would set out for fighting in the cause of Allah and it would be said to them: Is there one amongst you who saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? And they would say: Yes, and they would be victorious. Then the people would set out for fighting in the cause of Allah and it would be said to them: Is there one amongst you who saw those (who have had the privilege of sitting in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? And they would say: Yes, and victory would be granted to them. Then a group of persons would set out for fighting in the cause of Allah and it would be said to them: Is there one amongst you who saw one of those who saw those who (had the privilege) of sitting in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? And they would say: Yes, and the Victory would be granted to them.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon ke liye ek waqt aayega jab logon ke giroh Allah ki raah mein jung ke liye nikalenge aur unse poocha jaayega: Kya tum mein koi hai jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha ho? Aur woh kahenge: Haan, aur unhe jeet milegi. Phir log Allah ki raah mein jung ke liye nikalenge aur unse poocha jaayega: Kya tum mein koi hai jisne unhe (unko) dekha ho jinhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithne ka saubhaagya mila tha? Aur woh kahenge: Haan, aur unhe jeet di jaayegi. Phir logon ka ek giroh Allah ki raah mein jung ke liye nikalega aur unse poocha jaayega: Kya tum mein koi hai jisne unhe dekha ho jinhone unhe dekha jinhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithne ka saubhaagya mila tha? Aur woh kahenge: Haan, aur unhe jeet di jaayegi.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would come to the people a time when a detachment would be sent for fighting in the cause of Allah and they would say: See, if you can find amongst them someone from amongst the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). They would find a person and they would be granted victory because of him. Then a second detachment would be sent to them and they would say: Do you find amongst them one who had had the privilege of seeing the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? -and the victory would be granted to them because of him. Then the third detachment would be sent and it would be said to them: See, if you find amongst them (who had had the honour of seeing one) who saw those who saw the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Then the fourth detachment would be sent and it would be said to them: See it you find amongst them one who had the privilege (of seeing) one who saw those who saw those who saw the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and a person would be found and they would be granted victory because of him.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon ke liye ek waqt aayega jab ek dasta Allah ki raah mein jung ke liye bheja jaayega aur woh kahenge: Dekho agar tum unmein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se koi paate ho. Woh ek shakhs paayenge aur unhe uski wajah se jeet milegi. Phir ek doosra dasta unke paas bheja jaayega aur woh kahenge: Kya tum unmein koi paate ho jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ko dekhne ka saubhaagya mila ho? - aur unhe uski wajah se jeet di jaayegi. Phir teesra dasta bheja jaayega aur unse kaha jaayega: Dekho agar tumhe unmein koi mile (jise unhe dekhne ka saubhaagya mila ho) jinhone unhe dekha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ko dekha. Phir chautha dasta bheja jaayega aur unse kaha jaayega: Dekho agar tumhe unmein koi mile jise (unhe dekhne ka saubhaagya mila ho) jinhone unhe dekha jinhone unhe dekha jinhone unhe dekha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ko dekha, aur ek shakhs milega aur unhe uski wajah se jeet di jaayegi.

e: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best of my Umma would be those of the generation nearest to mine. Then those nearest to them, then those nearest to them, then people would come whose witness would precede the oath and the oath will precede the witness. Hannad has not made the mention of Qarn in his narration. Qutaiba said that, instead of the word Qaum, the word Aqwam has been used.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Meri Ummat mein sabse behtareen mere daur se sabse qareeb ki peedhi hai. Phir unke sabse qareeb, phir unke sabse qareeb, phir aise log aayenge jinki gawaahi qasam se pehle hogi aur qasam gawaahi se pehle hogi. Hannad ne apni riwayat mein "Qarn" (peedhi) ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Qutaiba ne kaha ki "Qaum" lafz ki jagah "Aqwam" lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: Abdullah reported: It was asked from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who amongst the people were the best. He said: (People) of my generation, then those next to them, then those next to them, then there would come a people whose evidence would precede their oath and their oath would precede their evidence. Ibrahim said: They forbade us to make vows and bear witness when we were too young.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki logon mein sabse behtareen kaun hain. Unhone farmaaya: Mere daur ke log, phir unke sabse qareeb waale, phir unke sabse qareeb waale, phir aise log aayenge jinki gawaahi unki qasam se pehle hogi aur unki qasam unki gawaahi se pehle hogi. Ibrahim ne kaha: Unhone humein mannat lene aur gawaahi dene se mana kiya jab hum bahut jawaan the.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Mansur on the authority of Abu al-Ahwas and Jarir with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ne Abu al-Ahwas aur Jarir ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki hai.

e: 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The best among people are of my generation, then those next to them. (The narrator said): I do not know whether (he said) it three times or four times. Then there would fellow after them such persons whose evidence would precede the oath, and in case of some others, the oath (would precede) the evidence.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon mein behtareen mere daur ke log hain, phir unke sabse qareeb waale. (Raawi ne kaha): Mujhe nahi pata ki (unhone ye) teen baar kaha ya chaar baar. Phir unke baad aise log aayenge jinki gawaahi qasam se pehle hogi, aur kuch doosron ke maamle mein, qasam gawaahi se pehle hogi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may, peace be upon him) as saying: The best age of my Umma is one in which I was sent (by Allah as an Apostle), then the one next to that. (The narrator said): And Allah knows best whether he stated this third (time) or not. Then there would come people who would love (to look) bulky and they would hasten to the witness box before they are asked to bear witness.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Meri Ummat ka behtareen daur woh hai jismein mujhe (Allah ne Rasool banaakar) bheja, phir uske sabse qareeb waala. (Raawi ne kaha): Aur Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki unhone ye teesri baar kaha ya nahi. Phir aise log aayenge jo apna badan bhaari-bhalka dikhaana pasand karenge aur woh gawaahi dene ke liye jaldbaazi karenge isse pehle ki unse maanga jaaye.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters (but with this variation) that Abu Huraira said: I do not know whether he (the Holy Prophet) said (these words:" Then next" ) twice or thrice.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Abu Huraira ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone (ye alfaaz "phir uske sabse qareeb") do baar kaha ya teen baar.

e: Imran b. Husain reported Allah's-Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best among you (are) the people (who belong to) my age. Then those next to them, then those next to them, then those next to them. 'Imran said: I do not know whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said twice or thrice (the words:" Then next" ) after (saying) about his (own age but he then said): Then after them (after successors or those who would succeed them) would come a people who would give evidence before they are asked for it, and would be dishonest and not trustworthy, who would make vows but would not fulfil them, and would be significant in being bulky.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein behtareen (woh hain jo) mere daur ke log hain. Phir unke sabse qareeb waale, phir unke sabse qareeb waale, phir unke sabse qareeb waale. Imran ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne (khud ke) daur ke baare mein (ye alfaaz "phir sabse qareeb") do baar kaha ya teen baar (lekin unhone phir farmaaya): Phir unke baad (unke baad aane walon ke baad) aise log aayenge jo gawaahi denge isse pehle ki unse maanga jaaye, aur woh beimaan aur na-bharosemand honge, jo mannat lenge lekin use poora nahi karenge, aur woh apna badan bhaari dikhaane mein makhsoos honge.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): I do not know whether he made a mention of two generations after his generation or of the third one too. Shababa said: I heard this from Zahdam b. Mudarrib as he came to me riding a horse for some need and he narrated it to me that he had heard it from 'Imran b. Husain, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yahya and Shababa (the words are): They take an oath but they do not fulfil it, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Bahz there the word is Yafun as transmitted on the authority of Ibn Ja'far.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone apne daur ke baad do peedhiyon ka zikr kiya ya teesri ka bhi. Shababa ne kaha: Maine ye Zahdam bin Mudarrib se suna jab woh kisi zaroorat se ghode par sawaar hokar mere paas aaye aur unhone mujhse ye riwayat ki ki unhone ise Imran bin Husain se suna, aur Yahya aur Shababa ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Woh qasam lete hain lekin use poora nahi karte, aur Bahz ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein lafz "Yafun" hai jaisa Ibn Ja'far ki riwayat mein hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Imran b. Husain through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): The best generation of this Umma is the generation to which I have been sent, then the next one, and there is an addition in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu 'Awana (and the words are): And Allah knows best whether he made a mention of the third (generation) or not; the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Zahdam on the authority of 'Imran. And in the hadith transmitted by Hisham on the authority of Qatada there is an addition of these words: They take an oath whereas they are not asked to take.
hi: Ye hadees Imran bin Husain (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Is Ummat ka behtareen daur woh hai jismein mujhe bheja gaya, phir uske sabse qareeb waala, aur Abu Awana ki riwayat mein ye izafa hai (aur alfaaz hain): Aur Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki unhone teesre (daur) ka zikr kiya ya nahi; baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Zahdam ne Imran ki sanad se riwayat ki. Aur Qatada ki sanad se Hisham ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: Woh qasam lete hain jabki unse ye maanga nahi gaya.

e: 'A'isha reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as to who amongst the people were the best. He said: Of the generation to which I belong, then of the second generation (generation adjacent to my generation), then of the third generation (generation adjacent to the second generation).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki logon mein sabse behtareen kaun hain. Unhone farmaaya: Mere daur ke log, phir doosri peedhi ke (mere daur ke sabse qareeb ki peedhi), phir teesri peedhi ke (doosri peedhi ke sabse qareeb ki peedhi).

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us 'Isha' prayer at the latter part of the night and when he had concluded it by salutations he stood up and said: Have you seen this night of yours? At the end of one hundred years after this none would survive on the surface of the earth (from amount my Companions). Ibn Umar said: People were (not understanding) these words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which had been uttered pertaining to one hundred years. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in fact meant (by these words) that on that day none from amongst those who had been living upon the earth (from amongst his Companions) would survive (after one hundred years) and that would be the end of this generation.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein isha ki namaz raat ke aakhri hisse mein padhayi aur jab unhone salaam ke saath ise khatm kiya woh khade huye aur farmaaya: Kya tumne apni ye raat dekhi? Iske sau saal baad zameen ki satah par koi bhi (mere Sahaba mein se) baaki nahi rahega. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke in alfaazon ko (samajh nahi paaye the) jo sau saal ke baare mein farmaaye gaye the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka waastav mein (in alfaazon se) matlab tha ki us din zameen par jeevit rehne wale kisi bhi shakhs (unke Sahaba mein se) ke sau saal baad zinda nahi rahega aur woh us peedhi ka ant hoga.

e: This hadith has been transmitted by Zuhri on the authority of Ma'mar.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne Ma'mar ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying this one month before his death: You asked me about the Last Hour whereas its knowledge is with Allah. I, however, take an oath and say that none upon the earth, the created beings (from amongst my Companions), would survive at the end of one hundred years.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unki wafaat se ek mahina pehle ye farmaate suna: Tum mujhse Qayamat ke baare mein poochte ho jabki iska ilm sirf Allah ke paas hai. Main, halaanki, qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki zameen par (mere Sahaba mein se) jo bhi jeevit hai woh sau saal ke baad baaki nahi rahega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of the words: " one month before his death".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein in alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Unki wafaat se ek mahina pehle."

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying one mouth before his death (or something like it): None amongst the created beings who had been living by that time (during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle).... 'Abd al-Rahman has interpreted these words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as: The ages (of the people) would be diminished.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni wafaat se ek mahina pehle (ya isi jaisa kuch) ye farmaate suna: Us waqt zameen par jeevit koi bhi shakhs (Allah ke Rasool ke zindagi kaal mein)... Abd al-Rahman ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke in alfaazon ki vyaakhya is tarah ki: (logon ki) umrein kam ho jaayengi.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came back from Tabuk they (his Companions) asked about the Last Hour. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There would be none amongst the created beings living on the earth (who would survive this century).
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Tabuk se wapas aaye unhone Qayamat ke baare mein poocha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Zameen par jeevit koi bhi shakhs (is sadi ko dekh nahi paayega).

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None amongst the created beings (from my Companions) would survive after one hundred years. Salim said: We made a mention of it to him (Jabir), whereupon he said: It means those who had been living on that day.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: (Mere Sahaba mein se) koi bhi sau saal ke baad baaki nahi rahega. Salim ne kaha: Humne iska zikr unse (Jabir se) kiya, isper unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai woh log jo us din zameen par jeevit the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not revile my Companions, do not revile my Companions. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if one amongst you would have spent as much gold as Uhud it would not amount to as much as one much on behalf of one of them or half of it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Mere Sahaba ko bura-bhala mat kaho, mere Sahaba ko bura-bhala mat kaho. Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar tum mein se koi Uhud jitna sona kharch kare (Allah ki raah mein), to ye unmein se kisi ke ek mudd ke barabar bhi nahi hoga, ya uska aadha bhi nahi.

e: Abu Sa'id reported there was some altercation between Khalid b. Walid and Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and Khalid reviled him. Thereupon Allah's Messwger (ﷺ) said: None should revile my Companions. for if one amongst you were to spend as much gold as Uhud, it would not amount to as much as one mudd of one of them or half of it.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Khalid bin Walid aur Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ke beech kuch jhagda hua aur Khalid ne unhe bura-bhala kaha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kisi ko bhi mere Sahaba ko bura-bhala nahi kehna chahiye, kyunki agar tum mein se koi Uhud jitna sona kharch kare, to ye unmein se kisi ke ek mudd ke barabar bhi nahi hoga, ya uska aadha bhi nahi.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-A'mash and there is no mention by Shu'ba and Waki' of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf and Khalid.
hi: Ye hadees al-A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba aur Waki ki riwayaton mein Abd al-Rahman bin Auf aur Khalid ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Usair b. Jabir reported that a delegation from Kufa came to 'Umar and there was a person amongst them who jeered at Uwais. Thereupon Umar said: Is there amongst us one from Qaran? That person came and Umar said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has said: There would come to you a person from Yemen who would be called Uwais and he would leave none in Yemen (behind him) except his mother, and he would have the whiteness (due to leprosy) and he supplicated Allah and it was cured except for the size of a dinar or dirham. He who amongst you meets him should ask him to supplicate for forgiveness (from Allah) for you.
hi: Usair bin Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Kufa se ek numainda mandal Umar (RA) ke paas aaya aur unmein se ek shakhs Uwais ka mazaak uda raha tha. Isper Umar ne kaha: Kya humme se koi Qaran se hai? Woh shakhs aaya aur Umar ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya hai: Tumhaare paas Yemen se ek shakhs aayega jise Uwais kaha jaayega aur woh Yemen mein apni maa ke siwaay kisi ko nahi chhodega, aur unhe (koDh ki wajah se) safedi hogi aur unhone Allah se dua ki aur ye theek ho gayi siwaay ek dinar ya dirham ke barabar hisse ke. Tum mein se jo unse mile use chahiye ki woh unse apne liye maafi ki dua karne ko kahe.

e: 'Umar b. Khattab reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Worthy amongst the successors would be a person who would be called Uwais. He would have his mother (living with him) and he would have (a small) sign of leprosy. Ask him to beg pardon for you (from Allah).
hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ummat ke uttar-aane waalon mein ek qadar-sadqa shakhs hoga jise Uwais kaha jaayega. Unki maa (unke saath rehti) hogi aur unhe koDh ka (choTa) nishaan hoga. Unse maango ki woh tumhare liye (Allah se) maafi maangein.

e: Usair b. Jabir reported that when people from Yemen came to help (the Muslim army at the time of jihad) he asked them: Is there amongst you Uwais b. 'Amir? (He continued finding him out) until he met Uwais. He said: Are you Uwais b., Amir? He said: Yes. He said: Are you from the tribe of Qaran? He said: Yes. He (Hadrat) 'Umar (again) said: Did you suffer from leprosy and then you were cured from it but for the space of a dirham? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: Is your mother (living)? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: There would come to you Uwais b. Amir with the reinforcement from the people of Yemen. (He would be) from Qaran, (the branch) of Murid. He had been suffering from leprosy from which he was cured but for a spot of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been excellent. If he were to take an oath in the name of Allah, He would honour that. And if it is possible for you, then do ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from your Lord). So he (Uwais) begged forgiveness for him. Umar said: Where do you intend to go? He said: To Kufa. He ('Umar) said: Let me write a letter for you to its governor, whereupon he (Uwais) said: I love to live amongst the poor people. When it was the next year, a person from among the elite (of Kufa) performed Hajj and he met Umar. He asked him about Uwais. He said: I left him in a state with meagre means of sustenance. (Thereupon) Umar said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would come to you Uwais b. 'Amir, of Qaran, a branch (of the tribe) of Murid, along with the reinforcement of the people of Yemen. He had been suffering from leprosy which would have been cured but for the space of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been very kind. If he would take an oath in the name of Allah (for something) He would honour it. Ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from Allah) in case it is possible for you. So he came to Uwais and said.: Beg forgiveness (from Allah) for me. He (Uwais) said: You have just come from a sacred journey (Hajj) ; you, therefore, ask forgiveness for me. He (the person who had performed Hajj) said: Ask forgiveness for me (from Allah). He (Uwais again) said: You have just come from the sacred journey, so you ask forgiveness for me. (Uwais further) said: Did you meet Umar? He said: Yes. He (Uwais) then begged forgiveness for him (from Allah). So the people came to know about (the status of religious piety) of Uwais. He went away (from that place). Usair said: His clothing consisted of a mantle, and whosoever saw him said: From where did Uwais get this mantle?
hi: Usair bin Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Yemen se log (Musalman fauj ki) madad ke liye aaye, unhone (Umar ne) unse poocha: Kya tum mein Uwais bin Aamir hain? (Woh unhe dhoondhte rahe) yahan tak ki woh Uwais se mile. Unhone kaha: Kya tum Uwais bin Aamir ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Kya tum Qaran qabile se ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne dobara) kaha: Kya tumhe koDh hua tha aur phir tum ismein se theek huye siwaay ek dirham jitni jagah ke? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Kya tumhaari maa (jeevit hain)? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhaare paas Uwais bin Aamir aayenge Yemen ke logon ki kumak ke saath. (Woh) Qaran se honge, jo Murad qabile ki ek shaakha hai. Unhe koDh hua tha jisse woh theek ho gaye siwaay ek dirham jitni jagah ke. Unka apni maa ke saath vyavahaar behtareen hoga. Agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam len, to Allah use poora karega. Aur agar ye tumhaare liye mumkin ho, to unse guzaarish karo ki woh tumhaare liye (Allah se) maafi maangein. Is liye unhone (Uwais ne) unke (Umar ke) liye maafi maangi. Umar ne kaha: Kahan jaane ka iraada hai? Unhone kaha: Kufa. Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Mujhe iske gavarnar ke naam tumhare liye ek khat likhne do, isper unhone (Uwais ne) kaha: Mujhe gareeb logon ke beech rehna pasand hai. Jab agla saal aaya, Kufa ke khaandaani logon mein se ek shakhs ne Hajj kiya aur Umar se mile. Unhone unse Uwais ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Maine unhe simit saadhanon ki haalat mein chhoda. (Isper) Umar ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhaare paas Uwais bin Aamir aayenge, Qaran se, Murad qabile ki ek shaakha, Yemen ke logon ki kumak ke saath. Unhe koDh hua tha jisse woh theek ho jaate siwaay ek dirham jitni jagah ke. Unka apni maa ke saath vyavahaar bahut meherbaan hoga. Agar woh Allah ke naam par kisi cheez ke liye qasam len, to Allah use poora karega. Unse guzaarish karo ki woh tumhaare liye (Allah se) maafi maangein agar ye tumhaare liye mumkin ho. To woh Uwais ke paas aaye aur kaha: Mere liye (Allah se) maafi maango. Unhone (Uwais ne) kaha: Aap abhi ek muqaddas safar (Hajj) se aaye hain; is liye aap mere liye maafi maango. Unhone (jinhone Hajj kiya tha) kaha: Mere liye maafi maango (Allah se). Unhone (Uwais ne phir) kaha: Aap abhi muqaddas safar se aaye hain, is liye aap mere liye maafi maango. (Uwais ne aage) kaha: Kya aap Umar se mile the? Unhone kaha: Haan. Phir unhone (Uwais ne) unke (Umar ke) liye maafi maangi. Is liye logon ko (Uwais ki) deeni haalat ka pata chala. Woh (us jagah se) chale gaye. Usair ne kaha: Unka libaas ek chogha tha, aur jisne bhi unhe dekha usne kaha: Uwais ko ye chogha kahan se mila?

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You would soon conquer a land where people are in the habit of using foul language. They have a right of kinship upon you. And when you see two persons fighting for the space of a brick, then get out of that. He (Abu Dharr) then happened to pass by Rabila and 'Abd al-Rahman, the two sons of Shurahbil b. Hasana, and they had been disputing for the space of a brick. So he left the land.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum jald hi ek aisi zameen fatah karoge jahan log gandi zubaan istemal karne ki aadat rakhte hain. Unka tumpar rishtedaari ka haq hai. Aur jab tum do logon ko ek EenT ki jagah ke liye lad te dekho, to us zameen se chale jao. Woh (Abu Dharr) phir Rabila aur Abd al-Rahman ke paas se guzre, jo Shurahbil bin Hasana ke do bete the, aur woh ek EenT ki jagah ke liye jhagad rahe the. Is liye unhone woh zameen chhod di.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You would soon conquer Egypt and that is a land which is known (as the land of al-qirat). So when you conquer it, treat its inhabitants well. For there lies upon you the responsibility because of blood-tie or relationship of marriage (with them). And when you see two persons falling into dispute amongst themselves for the space of a brick, than get out of that. He (Abu Dharr) said: I saw Abd al-Rahman b. Shurahbil b. Hasana and his brother Rabi'a disputing with one another for the space of a brick. So I left that (land).
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum jald hi Egypt fatah karoge aur ye ek aisi zameen hai jo (al-qirat ki zameen ke naam se) jaani jaati hai. Is liye jab tum ise fatah karo, uske bashindon ke saath achha vyavahaar karo. Kyunki tumpar unke khoon ya shaadi ke rishte ki wajah se zimmedaari hai. Aur jab tum do logon ko ek EenT ki jagah ke liye aapas mein jhagadta dekho, to us zameen se chale jao. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Maine Abd al-Rahman bin Shurahbil bin Hasana aur unke bhai Rabi'a ko ek EenT ki jagah ke liye aapas mein jhagadta dekha. Is liye maine woh zameen chhod di.

e: Abu Barza reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a person to a tribe amongst the tribes of Arabia. They reviled him and beat him. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and narrated to him (the story of atrocities perpetrated upon him by the people of the tribe). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: If you were to come to the people of 'Uman, they would have neither reviled you nor beaten you.
hi: Abu Barza (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko Arabia ke qabilon mein se ek qabile ke paas bheja. Unhone use bura-bhala kaha aur maara. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe (uske saath hue anyaay ki kahani) sunaayi. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Agar tum Oman ke logon ke paas aate, na woh tumhe bura-bhala kehte na tumhe maarte.

e: Abu Naufal reported: I saw (the dead body) of Abdullah b. Zubair hanging on the road of Medina (leading to Mecca). The Quraish passed by it and other people too, that Abdullah b. Umar happened to pass by it. He stood up there and said: May there be peace upon you, Abu Khubaib (the Kunya of Hadrat 'Abdullah b. Zubair), may there be peace upon you Abu Khubaib, may there be peace upon you, Abu Khubaib! By Allah, I used to forbid you from this; by Allah, I used to forbid you from this, by Allah I used to forbid you from this. By Allah, so far as I know, you had been very much devoted to fasting and prayer and you had been paying very much care to cementing the ties of blood. By Allah, the group to which you belong (are labelled) as (a) wicked (person) is indeed a fine group. Then 'Abdullah b. 'Umar went away. The stand 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) took in regard to the inhuman treatment (meted out to 'Abdullah b. Zubair) and his words (in that connection) were conveyed to Hajjaj (b. Yusuf) and (as a consequence of that) he (the body of Abdullah b. Zubair) was brought down from the stump (the scaffold) by which it was hanging and thrown into the graves of the Jews. He (Hajjaj) sent (his messenger) to Asma' (bint Abu Bakr, 'Abdullah's mother). But she refused to come. He again sent the messenger to her with the message that she must come, otherwise he would bring her forcibly catching hold of her hair. But she again refused and said: By Allah, I will not come to you until you send one to me who would drag me by pulling my hair. Thereupon he said: Bring me my shoes. He put on his shoes and walked on quickly swollen with vanity and pride until he came to her and said: How do you find what I have done with the enemy of Allah? She said: I find that you wronged him in this world, whereas he has spoiled your next life. It has been conveyed to me that you used to call him ('Abdullah b. Zubair) as the son of one having two belts. By Allah, I am indeed (a woman) of two belts. One is that with the help of which I used to suspend high the food of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and that of Abu Bakr (making it out of the reach) of animals and, so far as the second belt is concerned, that is the belt which no woman can dispense with. Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us that in Thaqif, there would be born a great liar and great murderer. The liar we have seen, and as far as the murderer is concerned, I do not find anyone else besides you. 'Thereupon he (Hajjaj) stood up and did not give any reply to her.
hi: Abu Naufal ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) ka (murda badan) Madina ke us raaste par latka hua dekha (jo Makkah jaata hai). Quraish aur doosre log iske paas se guzre yahan tak ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) bhi iske paas se guzre. Woh wahan khade huye aur kaha: Aap par shaanti ho, Abu Khubaib (Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair ki Kunya), aap par shaanti ho, Abu Khubaib, aap par shaanti ho, Abu Khubaib! Allah ki qasam, main aapko isse mana kiya karta tha; Allah ki qasam, main aapko isse mana kiya karta tha, Allah ki qasam, main aapko isse mana kiya karta tha. Allah ki qasam, jahan tak mujhe pata hai, aap roze aur namaz ke bahut zyada pabandh the aur aap rishtedaari ke rishton ko banaaye rakhne ka bahut khyaal rakhte the. Allah ki qasam, jis giroh se aap mutaliq hain use budkaar kaha jaata hai, ye waastav mein ek behtareen giroh hai. Phir Abdullah bin Umar chale gaye. Abdullah (bin Umar) ke is ghair-munasib vyavahaar (Abdullah bin Zubair ke saath) ke baare mein rukh aur unke alfaaz Hajjaj (bin Yusuf) tak pahunchaaye gaye aur (iske natije mein) unhe (Abdullah bin Zubair ke murda badan ko) us khambhe se utaara gaya jispar woh latka hua tha aur Yahudiyon ki qabron mein phenka gaya. Unhone (Hajjaj ne) Asma (bint Abu Bakr, Abdullah ki maa) ke paas apna doot bheja. Lekin unhone aane se inkaar kiya. Unhone dobara apna doot ye payaam dekar bheja ki unhe zaroor aana hoga, warna woh unke baal pakadkar zabardasti unhe le aayenge. Lekin unhone phir inkaar kiya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhaare paas tab tak nahi aaungi jab tak tum ek aisa shakhs na bhejo jo mera baal pakadkar mujhe kheenchte hue le jaaye. Isper unhone (Hajjaj ne) kaha: Mere joote lao. Unhone apne joote pehne aur ghamand aur takabbur mein tez-tez chalte hue unke (Asma ke) paas gaye aur kaha: Aap paati hain ki maine Allah ke dushman ke saath kya kiya? Unhone kaha: Main paati hoon ki tumne is duniya mein unke saath anyaay kiya, jabki unhone tumhaari agli zindagi kharaab kar di hai. Mujhe bataya gaya hai ki tum unhe (Abdullah bin Zubair ko) do kamarband waali ke bete kehte the. Allah ki qasam, main waastav mein do kamarband waali hoon. Ek woh hai jiski madad se main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ka khaana ooncha latkaati thi (jaanwaron ki pahunch se door), aur jahan tak doosre kamarband ka sawaal hai, ye woh kamarband hai jiske bina koi bhi aurat guzaara nahi kar sakti. Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya tha ki Thaqif mein ek bada jhoota aur ek bada qaatil paida hoga. Jhoota humne dekh liya hai aur jahan tak qaatil ka sawaal hai, mujhe tumhaare siwaay koi aur nahi lagta. Isper woh (Hajjaj) khade huye aur unhe koi jawaab nahi diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If the din were at the Pleiades, even then a person from Persia would have taken hold of it, or one amongst the Persian descent would have surely found it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar deen Suraiya (Pleiades taare) ke paas bhi hota, tab bhi Persia ka koi shakhs ise zaroor haasil kar leta, ya Persia ki nasl ka koi shakhs ise zaroor pa leta.

e: Abu Huraira reported: We were sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that Sura al-Jumu'a was revealed to him and when he recited (these words):" Others from amongst them who have not yet joined them," a person amongst them (those who were sitting there) said: Allah's Messenger! But Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) made no reply, until he questioned him once, twice or thrice. And there was amongst us Salman the Persian. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) placed his hand on Salman and then said: Even if faith were near the Pleiades, a man from amongst these would surely find it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithe the ki unpar Sura al-Jumu'a nazil hui aur jab unhone in alfaazon ki tilawat ki: "Aur unmein se doosre log jo abhi tak unse nahi mile," wahan maujood logon mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne koi jawaab nahi diya, yahan tak ki unhone usse ek baar, do baar ya teen baar poocha. Aur humaare beech Salman Farsi maujood the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath Salman par rakha aur phir farmaaya: Agar imaan Suraiya ke paas bhi hota, to inmein se ek shakhs use zaroor pa leta.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You would find people like one hundred camels and you would not find even one (camel) fit for riding.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhe log sau oont jaise milenge aur tumhe unmein se ek bhi sawaari ke laayak nahi milega.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah, 's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Who among the people is most deserving of a fine treatment from my hand? He said: Your mother. He again said: Then who (is the next one)? He said: Again it is your mother (who deserves the best treatment from you). He said: Then who (is the next one)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Again, it is your mother. He (again) said: Then who? Thereupon he said: Then it is your father. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Qutalba, there is no mention of the word" the people".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Logon mein kaun mere achhe sulook ka sabse zyada haqdaar hai? Unhone farmaaya: Teri maa. Usne dobara poocha: Phir kaun? Unhone farmaaya: Phir teri maa. Usne kaha: Phir kaun? Unhone (Nabi ne) farmaaya: Phir teri maa. Usne (phir) kaha: Phir kaun? Isper unhone farmaaya: Phir tera waalid. Qutaiba ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "logon" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person said: Allah's Messenger, who amongst the people is most deserving of my good treatment? He said: Your mother, again your mother, again your mother, then your father, then your nearest relatives according to the order (of nearness).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, logon mein mere achhe sulook ka sabse zyada haqdaar kaun hai? Unhone farmaaya: Teri maa, phir teri maa, phir teri maa, phir tera waalid, phir tere qareebi rishtedaar, qurbat ki tarteeb ke mutabik.

e: Abu Huraira reported: A person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by jarir but with this addition: By your father, you would get the information.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Jarir ne riwayat ki hai lekin is izafe ke saath: Apne waalid ki qasam, tujhe ye jaankaari mil gayi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shubruma with the same chain of transmitters and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Wuhaib there is a slight variation of wording. Same is the case with the hadith transmitted on the authority of Muhammad b. Talha (and the words are): " Who amongst the people deserves the best treatment from me".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shubruma ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Wuhaib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai. Yehi haal Muhammad bin Talha ki riwayat ka hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Logon mein mujhse behtareen sulook ka sabse zyada haqdaar kaun hai."

e: Abdullah b. 'Amr reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought permission (to participate) in Jihad, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Are your parents living? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You should put in your best efforts (in their) service.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Jihad (mein hissa lene) ki ijazat maangi, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Kya tere maa-baap zinda hain? Usne kaha: Haan. Isper unhone farmaaya: To tujhe unki khidmat mein apni poori koshish lagaani chahiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Habib with the several chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Habib ki sanad se kai sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Yazid b. Abu Habib reported that Na'im, the freed slave of Umm Salama, reported to him that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As said: There came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a person and said: I owe allegiance to you for migration and Jihad seeking reward only from Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is one from amongst your parents living? He said: Yes, of course, both are living. He further asked: Do you want to seek reward from Allah? He said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Go back to your parents and accord them benevolent treatment.
hi: Yazid bin Abu Habib ne bayan kiya ki Na'im, Umm Salama ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne unhe riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Main hijrat aur Jihad ke liye aapse wafadaari ki qasam leta hoon, sirf Allah se sawaab chaahte hue. Unhone (Nabi ne) farmaaya: Kya tere maa-baap mein se koi zinda hai? Usne kaha: Haan, donon zinda hain. Unhone phir poocha: Kya tu Allah se sawaab chaahta hai? Usne kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Apne maa-baap ke paas wapas jaao aur unke saath meherbani se pesh aao.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Juraij was one who was devoted to (prayer) in the temple. His mother came to him. Humaid said that Abu Rafi' demonstrated before us like the demonstration made by abu Huraira to whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had demonstrated as his mother called him placing her palms upon the eyebrows and lifting her head for calling him and said: Juraij, it is your mother, so talk to her. She found him at that time absorbed in prayer, so he said (to himself): O Lord, my mother (is calling me) (whereas I am absorbed) in my prayer. He opted for prayer. She (his mother) went back, then came again for the second time and said: O Juraij, it is your mother (calling you), so talk to me. He said: O Allah. there is my mother also and my prayer, and he opted for prayer. She said: O Allah, this Juraij is my son. I pray to talk to him but he refuses to talk to me. O Allah, don't bring death to him unless he has seen the prostitutes, and had she invoked the curse upon him (from the heart of her heart) he would have been involved in some turmoil. There was a shepherd living near by his temple (the temple where Juraij was engaged in prayer). It so happened that a woman of that village came there and that shepherd committed fornication with her and she became pregnant and gave birth to a child. It was said to her: Whose child is this? She said: He is the child of one who is living in this temple. So there came persons with hatchets and spades. They called Juraij. He was absorbed in prayer and he did not talk to them and they were about to demolish that temple that he saw them and then came to them and they said: Ask her (this woman) what she says. He smiled and then touched the head of the child and said: Who is your father? He (the child) said: My father is the shepherd of the sheep, and when they heard this, they said: We are prepared to rebuild with gold and silver what we have demolished from your temple. He said: No, rebuild it with clay as it had been before. He then went up (to his room and absorbed himself in prayer).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Juraij ek aisa shakhs the jo apni ibadatgaah mein (ibadat mein) masroof rehte the. Unki maa unke paas aayi. Humaid ne kaha ki Abu Rafi ne humein woh andaaz dikhaaya jo Abu Huraira ne dikhaaya tha jab unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dikhaaya tha ki unki maa unhe pukaarti hui apni hatheliyaan apni bhawon par rakhkar aur apna sar uThakar unhe pukaarti hain aur kehti hain: Juraij, ye teri maa hai, is liye mujhse baat kar. Woh use us waqt namaz mein masroof paati hain, is liye unhone (khud se) kaha: Aye Rab, meri maa (mujhe pukaar rahi hai) jabki main namaz mein masroof hoon. Unhone namaz ko chuna. Woh (unki maa) wapas chali gayin, phir dobara aayin aur kaha: Aye Juraij, ye teri maa hai, is liye mujhse baat kar. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, meri maa bhi hai aur meri namaz bhi, aur unhone namaz ko chuna. Unhone (unki maa ne) kaha: Aye Allah, ye Juraij mera beta hai. Main dua karti hoon ki woh mujhse baat kare lekin woh mujhse baat karne se inkaar karta hai. Aye Allah, use maut mat de jab tak woh veshyaon ko na dekh le, aur agar unhone (apne dil ki gehraayi se) unpar laanat ki hoti, to woh zaroor kisi mushkil mein pad jaate. Unki ibadatgaah ke qareeb ek gadariya rehta tha. Aisa hua ki us gaon ki ek aurat wahan aayi aur us gadariye ne uske saath badchalni ki aur woh garbhvati ho gayi aur ek bachche ko paida kiya. Usse poocha gaya: Ye kiska bachcha hai? Unhone kaha: Ye us shakhs ka bachcha hai jo is ibadatgaah mein rehta hai. Is liye kuch log kulhaadiyon aur belchon ke saath aaye. Unhone Juraij ko pukaara. Woh namaz mein masroof the aur unse baat nahi ki aur woh us ibadatgaah ko giraane hi wale the ki unhone unhe dekha aur phir unke paas aaye aur unhone kaha: Us (aurat) se poocho ki woh kya kehti hai. Woh muskuraaye aur phir bachche ke sar ko chhua aur kaha: Tera waalid kaun hai? Unhone (bachche ne) kaha: Mera waalid bhedon ka gadariya hai, aur jab unhone ye suna, unhone kaha: Hum sona aur chandi se woh ibadatgaah dobara banaayenge jo humne toDa hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi, ise mitti se dobara banaao jaisa ye pehle tha. Phir woh (apne kamre mein) upar gaye aur namaz mein masroof ho gaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: None spoke in the cradle but only three (persons), Christ son of Mary, the second one the companion of Juraij. Juraij had got constructed a temple and confined himself in that. His mother came to him as he was busy in prayer and she said: Juraij. He said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in) my prayer. He continued with the prayer. She returned and she came on the next day and he was busy in prayer, and she said: Juraij. And he said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in prayer, and he continued with the prayer and she went back, and then on the next day she again came and he was busy in prayer and she said: Juraij. And he said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in my prayer, and he continued with the prayer, and she said: My Lord, don't give him death unless he has seen the fate of the prostitutes. The story of Juraij and that of his meditation and prayer gained currency amongst Bani Isra'il. There was a prostitute who had been a beauty incarnate. She said (to the people): If you like I can allure him to evil. She presented herself to him but he paid no heed (to her). She came to a shepherd who lived near the temple and she offered herself to him and he had a sexual intercourse with her and so she became pregnant arid when she gave birth to a child she said: This is from Juraij. So they came and asked him to get down and demolished the temple and began to beat him. He said: What is the matter? They said: You have committed fornication with this prostitute and she has given birth to a child from your loins. He said: Where is the child? They brought him (the child) and he said: just leave me so that I should observe prayer. And he observed prayer and when he finished, he came to the child. He struck his stomach and said: O boy, who is your father? lie said: He is such shepherd. So they turned towards Juraij, kissed him and touched him (for seeking blessing) and said: We are prepared to construct your temple with gold. He said. No, just rebuild it with mud as it had been, and they did that. Then there was a babe who was sucking his mother that a person dressed in fine garment came riding upon a beast. His mother said: O Allah, make my child like this one. He (the babe) left sucking and began to see towards him, and said: O Allah, don't make me like him. He then returned to the chest and began to suck the milk of his mother. He (Abu Huraira) said: I perceived as if I am seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he is explaining the scene of his sucking milk with his forefinger in his mouth and sucking that. He (Abu Huraira) further reported Allah's Apostle (may be peace upon him) as saying: There happened to pass by him a girl who was being beaten and they were saying: You have committed adultery and you have committed theft and she was saying: Allah is enough for me and He is my good Protector, and his mother said: O Allah, don't make my child like her and he left sucking the milk, and looked towards her and said: O Allah, make me like her, and there was a talk between them. She said: O with shaven head, a good-looking person happened to pass by and I said: O Allah, make my child like him, and you said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and they passed by a girl while they were beating her and saying: You committed fornication and you committed theft, and I said: O Allah, don't make my child like her, and you said: O Allah, make me like her. Thereupon he said: That person was a tyrant, and I said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and they were saying about her: You committed fornication whereas in fact she had not committed that and they were saying: You have committed theft whereas she had not committed theft, so I said: O Allah, make me like her.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Palne mein sirf teen logon ne baat ki: Isa Masih, Mary ke bete, aur doosra Juraij ke saathi (yaani ek bachche). Juraij ne ek ibadatgaah banwaayi thi aur khud ko usmein band kar liya tha. Unki maa unke paas aayi jab woh namaz mein masroof the aur unhone kaha: Juraij. Unhone (Juraij ne) kaha: Mere Rab, meri maa (mujhe pukaar rahi hai jabki main masroof hoon) apni namaz mein. Unhone namaz jaari rakhi. Woh wapas gayin aur agle din phir aayin aur woh namaz mein masroof the aur unhone kaha: Juraij. Aur unhone kaha: Mere Rab, meri maa (mujhe pukaar rahi hai jabki main masroof hoon) namaz mein, aur unhone namaz jaari rakhi aur woh wapas chali gayin aur phir agle din woh dobara aayin aur woh namaz mein masroof the aur unhone kaha: Juraij. Aur unhone kaha: Mere Rab, meri maa (mujhe pukaar rahi hai jabki main masroof hoon meri namaz mein), aur unhone namaz jaari rakhi, aur unhone (maa ne) kaha: Mere Rab, use maut mat de jab tak woh veshyaon ka anjaam na dekh le. Juraij aur unki dhyaan-lagaao aur namaz ki kahani Banu Isra'il mein phaili. Ek veshya thi jo bahut khoobsurat thin. Unhone (logon se) kaha: Agar tum chaho, main use burai ki taraf lubha sakti hoon. Unhone khud ko unke saamne pesh kiya lekin unhone koi dhyaan nahi diya (uski taraf). Woh phir ibadatgaah ke qareeb rehne wale ek gadariye ke paas gayi aur unhone khud ko usse pesh kiya aur usne uske saath jinsi talluq banaya aur is liye woh garbhvati hui aur jab usne bachche ko paida kiya, usne kaha: Ye Juraij ka hai. Is liye woh aaye aur unhe (ibadatgaah se) neeche aane ko kaha aur ibadatgaah gira di aur unhe maarna shuru kiya. Unhone kaha: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Tumne is veshya ke saath badchalni ki hai aur usne tumhaari aulaad ko paida kiya hai. Unhone kaha: Bachcha kahan hai? Woh usse (bachche ko) laaye aur unhone kaha: Mujhe akela chhod do taaki main namaz padh sakoon. Aur unhone namaz padhi aur jab unhone khatm ki, woh bachche ke paas aaye. Unhone uska pet thoka aur kaha: Aye larke, tera waalid kaun hai? Usne kaha: Woh falan-falan gadariya hai. Is liye woh Juraij ki taraf mude, unhe chuma aur unhe (barkat ke liye) chhua aur kaha: Hum tumhaari ibadatgaah sone se banaayenge. Unhone kaha: Nahi, ise mitti se dobara banaao jaisa ye pehle tha, aur unhone aisa hi kiya. Phir ek shakhs raaste se guzra jo apni maa ka doodh pi raha tha ki ek shakhs achhe kapde pehne ek jaanwar par sawaar hokar aaya. Uski maa ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere bachche ko is jaisa bana. Usne (bachche ne) doodh peena chhoda aur uski taraf dekhne laga, aur kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe uske jaisa mat banaa. Woh phir seene ki taraf muda aur apni maa ka doodh peene laga. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai jaise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekh raha hoon woh doodh peene ka drishya apni tarjani ungli munh mein daalkar aur use chooste hue dikha rahe hain. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) aage Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat kiya: Ek larki us raaste se guzri jise maara jaa raha tha aur log keh rahe the: Tumne badchalni ki hai aur tumne chori ki hai, aur woh keh rahi thi: Mere liye Allah kaafi hai aur Woh mera behtareen nigehbaan hai, aur uski maa ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere bachche ko iske jaisa mat banaa, aur usne doodh peena chhoda aur uski taraf dekha aur kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe iske jaisa banaa, aur unke beech (bachche aur maa ke beech) baatchit hui. Unhone (maa ne) kaha: Aye sar munDaaye hue, ek khoobsurat shakhs guzra aur maine kaha: Aye Allah, mere bachche ko uske jaisa bana, aur tune kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe uske jaisa mat bana, aur woh ek larki ke paas se guzre jise woh maar rahe the aur keh rahe the: Tumne badchalni ki aur tumne chori ki, aur maine kaha: Aye Allah, mere bachche ko uske jaisa mat bana, aur tune kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe uske jaisa bana. Isper unhone (bachche ne) kaha: Woh (achhe kapde wala shakhs) ek zaalim tha, aur maine kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe uske jaisa mat bana, aur woh uske (larki ke) baare mein keh rahe the: Tumne badchalni ki, jabki waastav mein usne aisa nahi kiya tha, aur woh keh rahe the: Tumne chori ki, jabki usne chori nahi ki thi, is liye maine kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe uske jaisa bana.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Let him be humbled into dust; let him be humbled into dust. It was said: Allah's Messenger, who is he? He said: He who sees either of his parents during their old age or he sees both of them, but he does not enter Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Use mitti mein zaleel kiya jaaye; use mitti mein zaleel kiya jaaye. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaun hai? Unhone farmaaya: Woh jo apne maa-baap mein se kisi ek ko unki buDhaape ki haalat mein paata hai ya donon ko paata hai, lekin (unki khidmat karke) Jannat mein daakhil nahi hota.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Let him be humbled, let him be humbled. It was said: Allah's Messenger, who is he? He said. He who finds his parents in old age, either one or both of them, and does not enter Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Use zaleel kiya jaaye, use zaleel kiya jaaye. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaun hai? Unhone farmaaya: Woh jo apne maa-baap ko buDhaape mein paata hai, ek ko ya donon ko, aur (fir bhi unki khidmat karke) Jannat mein daakhil nahi hota.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Let him be humbled thrice, and the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye teen baar farmaate suna: Use zaleel kiya jaaye; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn Dinar reported that a desert Arab met Abdullah b. 'Umar on the way to Mecca. 'Abdullah greeted him and mounted him upon the donkey on which he had been riding and gave him the turban that he had on his head. Ibn Dinar (further) reported: We said to him ('Abdullah b. 'Umar): May Allah do good to you, these are desert Arabs and they are satisfied even with meagre (things). Thereupon Abdullah said: His father was loved dearly by 'Umar b. Khattib and I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The finest act of goodness on the part of a son is to treat kindly the loved ones of his father.
hi: Ibn Dinar ne bayan kiya ki Makkah ke raaste mein ek registaan ke Arab, Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se mile. Abdullah ne unhe salaam kiya aur unhe apne gadhe par sawaar kiya jispar woh khud sawaar the, aur unhe apni pagdi bhi de di jo unhone apne sar par pehni thi. Ibn Dinar ne (aage) bayaan kiya: Humne unse (Abdullah bin Umar se) kaha: Allah aapka bhala kare, ye registaan ke Arab hain aur woh thoDe se bhi santusht ho jaate hain. Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Inke waalid ko Umar bin Khattab bahut chaahte the aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Beton ka sabse behtareen nekokaar amal ye hai ki woh apne waalid ke aziz logon ke saath meherbani se pesh aaye.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The finest act of goodness is that a person should treat kindly the loved ones of his father.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Behtareen nekokaar amal ye hai ki koi shakhs apne waalid ke aziz logon ke saath meherbani se pesh aaye.

e: Abdullah b. Dinar reported that when 'Abdullah b. 'Umar set out to Mecea, 'he kept a donkey with him which he used as a diversion from the tedium of journey on the camel's back and had a turban which he tied round his head. One day, as he was riding the donkey a desert Arab happened to pass by him. He ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) said: Arn't you so and so? He said: Yes He gave him his donkey and said: Ride it, and tie the turban round your head. Some of his companions said: May Allah pardon you, you gave to this desert Arab the donkey on which you enjoyed ride for diversion and the turban which you tied round your. head. Thereupon he said: Verily I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The finest act of goodness is the kind treatment of a person to the loved ones of his father after his death and the father of this person was a friend of 'Umar.
hi: Abdullah bin Dinar ne bayan kiya ki jab Abdullah bin Umar (RA) Makkah ke liye nikle, unke saath ek gadha bhi hota tha jise woh oont ki peeth par safar ki thakaan se rahat paane ke liye istemal karte the aur unke paas ek pagdi hoti thi jise woh apne sar par baandhte the. Ek din jab woh gadhe par sawaar the, ek registaan ka Arab unke paas se guzra. Unhone (Ibn Umar ne) kaha: Kya tum falan-falan nahi ho? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone use apna gadha de diya aur kaha: Ispar sawaar ho, aur ye pagdi apne sar par baandho. Unke kuch saathiyon ne kaha: Allah aapko maaf kare, aapne is registaan ke Arab ko woh gadha diya jispar aap thakaan door karne ke liye sawaar hote the aur woh pagdi jo aapne apne sar par baandhi thi. Isper unhone kaha: Yaqeenan maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Behtareen nekokaar amal ye hai ki koi shakhs apne waalid ki maut ke baad unke aziz logon ke saath meherbani se pesh aaye, aur is shakhs ka waalid Umar ka dost tha.

e: Nawwas b. Sam'an al-Ansari reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it.
hi: Nawwas bin Sam'an Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nekokaari aur gunah ke baare mein poocha. Unhone farmaaya: Nekokaari achha mizaj hai aur gunah woh hai jo tere dil mein khatakta hai aur jise tu napasand karta hai ki log ismein ilm hasil karein.

e: Nawwas b. Sam'an reported: I stayed with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for one year. What obstructed me to migrate was (nothing) but (persistent) inquiries from him (about Islam). (It was a common observation) that when anyone of us migrated (to Medina) he ceased to ask (too many questions) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So I asked him about virtue and vice. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your mind and that you disapprove of its being known to the people.
hi: Nawwas bin Sam'an (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein ek saal raha. Mujhe hijrat karne se sirf (baar-baar) unse (Islam ke baare mein) sawaal poochhne ki khwaish ne roka. (Ye ek aam mushaahda tha) ki jab hummein se koi hijrat karta, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se (bahut zyada sawaal) poochhna band kar deta. Is liye maine unse nekokaari aur gunah ke baare mein poocha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Nekokaari achha mizaj hai aur gunah woh hai jo tere dimaag mein khatakta hai aur jise tu napasand karta hai ki logon ko iska ilm ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah created the universe and when He had finished that, ties of relationship came forward and said This is the place for him who seeks refuge from severing (of blood-relationship). He said: Yes. Are you not satisfied that I should keep relationship with one who joins your ties of relationship and sever it with one who severs your (ties of relationship)? They (the ties of blood) said: Certainly so. Thereupon He said: Well, that is how things are for you. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said: Recite if you like:" But if you turn away you are sure to make mischief in the land and cut off the ties of kinship. Those it is whom Allah has cursed, so He has made them deaf and blinded their eyes. Do they not reflect on the Qur'an? Or, are there locks on their hearts?".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan Allah ne kaayanaat banaayi aur jab Woh isse farigh hua, rishtedaari ke rishte aage aaye aur kaha: Ye us shakhs ke liye jagah hai jo (khoon ke rishte) todne se panah maangta hai. Unhone (Allah ne) farmaaya: Haan. Kya tum ismein khush nahi ho ki main uske saath rishta jodun jo tumhaare rishte jodta hai aur usse rishta todun jo tumhaare (rishte) todta hai? Unhone (rishte-naato ne) kaha: Bilkul aisa hi. Isper Unhone farmaaya: Achha, ye tumhaare liye aisa hi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir farmaaya: Agar tum chaho to padho: "Lekin agar tum munh moDte ho, to tum zameen mein zaroor fasaad phailaaoge aur rishton ko todoge. Ye woh log hain jinpar Allah ne laanat ki hai, is liye Usne unhe behra kar diya aur unki aankhein andhi kar din. Kya woh Quran par ghor nahi karte? Ya kya unke dilon par taale hain?"

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The tie of kinship is suspended to the Throne and says: He who unites me Allah would unite him and he who severed me Allah would sever him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Rishtedaari ka rishta Arsh se juda hua hai aur kehta hai: Jo mujhe joDe use Allah joDega aur jo mujhe toDe use Allah toDega.

e: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The severer would not enter Paradise. Ibn Umar said that Sufyan (explained it as): One who severs the tie of kinship would not enter Paradise.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Rishta toDne wala Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga. Ibn Umar ne kaha ki Sufyan ne (iski vyaakhya ki): Woh jo rishtedaari ka rishta todta hai woh Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: Jubair b. Mutlim reported that his father narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The severer of the tie of kinship would not get into Paradise.
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unke waalid ne unhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Rishtedaari ka rishta toDne wala Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who is desirous that his means of sustenance should be expanded for him or his age may be lengthened, should join the tie of relationship.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo chaahta hai ki uski rozi wusat mein di jaaye aur uski umar lambi ki jaaye, use rishtedaari ka rishta joDna chahiye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who likes that his sustenance should be expanded and his age may be lengthened should join the tie of kinship.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo pasand karta hai ki uski rozi mein izafa ho aur uski umar lambi ki jaaye, use rishtedaari ka rishta joDna chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a person said: Allah's Messenger, I have relatives with whom I try, to have close relationship, but they sever (this relation). I treat them well, but they treat me ill. I am sweet to them but they are harsh towards me. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: If it is so as you say, then you in fact throw hot ashes (upon their faces) and there would always remain with you on behalf of Allah (an Angel to support you) who would keep you dominant over them so long as you adhere to this (path of righteousness).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere rishtedaar hain jinke saath main achhe rishte banaane ki koshish karta hoon, lekin woh ye rishta toDte hain. Main unke saath achhaai karta hoon, lekin woh mere saath bura vyavahaar karte hain. Main unke saath meethi baat karta hoon lekin woh mere saath sakhti se pesh aate hain. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Agar aisa hai jaisa tum kehte ho, to tum waastav mein (unke chehron par) garam raakh phenk rahe ho aur Allah ki taraf se hamesha ek (Farishta) tumhaare saath rahega jo tumhe unpar haavi rakhega jab tak tum is (nekokaari ke) raaste par kaayam raho.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Neither nurse mutual hatred, nor jealousy, nor enmity, and become as fellow brothers and servants of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim that he should keep his relations estranged with his brother beyond three days.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Na aapas mein bair paalo, na jalan, na dushmani, aur ek-doosre ke bhai aur Allah ke bande bano. Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai se teen din se zyada munh moDe rahe.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying like this. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi jaisa farmaate suna. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters with the addition of Ibn Uyaina (and the words are): " Do not cut off (mutual relations)."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se Ibn Uyaina ke izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Rishta mat toDo."

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abd al-Razziq (the words are): " Neither nurse grudge nor sever (the ties of kinship), nor nurse enmity."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Abd al-Razzaq ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): "Na bair paalo aur na (rishta) toDo, na dushmani rakho."

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Nurse no grudge, nurse no aversion and do not sever ties of kinship and live like fellow-brothers as servants of Allah. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" As Allah has commanded you."
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Na bair paalo, na jalan rakho aur rishton ko mat toDo aur Allah ke bandon ki tarah aapas mein bhai ban kar raho. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Jaisa Allah ne tumhe hukum diya hai."

e: Abu Ayyub Ansiri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning the other way when they meet; the better of the two is one who is the first to give a greeting.
hi: Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai se teen raaton se zyada rishta toDe rakhe, ki jab woh dono milte hain, ek ek taraf muDe aur doosra doosri taraf, aur donon mein behtareen woh hai jo pehle salaam kare.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording (and the words are): " The one turning away and the other turning away when they meet and one avoids the other and the other also avoids him."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Ek muDe aur doosra bhi muDe jab woh milein aur ek doosre se bache aur woh bhi usse bache.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three days.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi hai ki woh apne bhai se teen din se zyada rishta toDe rakhe.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There should be no estranged relations beyond three days.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Teen din se zyada rishta toDna jaayez nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid suspicion, for suspicion is the gravest lie in talk and do not be inquisitive about one another and do not spy upon one another and do not feel envy with the other, and nurse no malice, and nurse no aversion and hostility against one another. And be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Shak se bacho, kyunki shak baaton mein sabse bada jhoot hai, aur ek-doosre ki taak-jhaank mat karo, aur ek-doosre ki jaasoosi mat karo, aur ek-doosre se hasad mat karo, aur bair mat paalo, aur ek-doosre se dushmani aur adaawat mat rakho. Aur Allah ke bandon ki tarah aapas mein bhai ban kar raho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Don't have estranged relations (with the others) and don't nurse enmity and don't enter into a transaction when the other (has already entered) and be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: (Doosron se) rishta toDe mat raho aur dushmani mat paalo aur jab koi doosra pehle se sauda kar raha ho to us par sauda mat karo, aur Allah ke bandon ki tarah aapas mein bhai ban kar raho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Don't nurse malice against one another, don't nurse aversion against one another and don't be inquisitive about one another and don't outbid one another (with a view to raising the price) and be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek-doosre se bair mat paalo, ek-doosre se dushmani mat rakho, aur ek-doosre ki taak-jhaank mat karo, aur ek-doosre ke muqable (keemat) badhaakar mat bolo, aur Allah ke bandon ki tarah aapas mein bhai ban kar raho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmit ters (and the words are): " Don't sever relations of kinship, don't bear enmity against one another, don't bear aversion against one another and don't feel envy against the other and live as fellow-brothers as Allah has commanded you.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Rishtedaari ke rishte mat toDo, ek-doosre se dushmani mat rakho, ek-doosre se bair mat paalo, aur ek-doosre se hasad mat karo, aur aapas mein bhai ban kar raho jaisa Allah ne tumhe hukum diya hai.
