e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Don't bear aversion against one another and don't be jealous of one another and be servants of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek-doosre se dushmani mat rakho aur ek-doosre se hasad mat karo aur Allah ke bande ban kar raho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Don't nurse grudge and don't bid him out for raising the price and don't nurse aversion or enmity and don't enter into a transaction when the others have entered into that transaction and be as fellow-brothers and servants of Allah. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim. He neither oppresses him nor humiliates him nor looks down upon him. The piety is here, (and while saying so) he pointed towards his chest thrice. It is a serious evil for a Muslim that he should look down upon his brother Muslim. All things of a Muslim are inviolable for his brother in faith: his blood, his wealth and his honour.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Bair mat paalo aur (keemat) badhaane ke liye ek-doosre par bolI mat lagaao aur dushmani ya adaawat mat rakho aur jab doosron ne pehle sauda kar liya ho to uspar sauda mat karo, aur Allah ke bandon ki tarah aapas mein bhai ban kar raho. Ek Musalman doosre Musalman ka bhai hai. Na woh usse zulm karta hai, na use zaleel karta hai, na use hey nazar se dekhta hai. Taqwa yahaan hai, (ye kehte hue) unhone teen baar apne seene ki taraf ishara kiya. Kisi Musalman ke liye ye ek badi burai hai ki woh apne Musalman bhai ko hey nazar se dekhe. Ek Musalman ki har cheez doosre Musalman bhai ke liye apathya hai: uska khoon, uska maal aur uski izzat.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with some addition (and it is this): " Verily Allah does not look to your bodies nor to your faces but He looks to your hearts," and he pointed towards the heart with his fingers.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur izafa ye hai): "Yaqeenan Allah tumhaare jismon ko nahi dekhta, na tumhaare chehron ko, lekin Woh tumhaare dilon ko dekhta hai," aur unhone apni ungliyon se dil ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan Allah tumhaare chehron ko aur tumhaare maal ko nahi dekhta, lekin Woh tumhaare dilon ko aur tumhaare amalon ko dekhta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The gates of Paradise are not opened but on two days, Monday and Thursday. and then every servant (of Allah) is granted pardon who does not associate anything with Allah except the person in whose (heart) there is rancour against his brother. And it would be said: Look towards both of them until there is reconciliation; look toward both of them until there is reconciliation; look towards both of them until there is reconciliation. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail who narrated it on the authority of his father with the chain of transmitters of MaIik, but with this variation of wording:, (Those would not be granted pardon) who bycott each other."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat ke darwaze sirf do dinon mein khole jaate hain, Somvaar aur Guruvaar, aur phir har banda (Allah ke) ko maafi milti hai jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karta siwaay us shakhs ke jiske (dil mein) apne bhai ke prati kInA hai. Aur kaha jaayega: In donon ki taraf dekho jab tak inmein sulah na ho jaaye; in donon ki taraf dekho jab tak inmein sulah na ho jaaye; in donon ki taraf dekho jab tak inmein sulah na ho jaaye. Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone ise apne waalid se, Malik ki sanad se, riwayat ki, lekin is antar ke saath: (Unhe maafi nahi milti) jo ek-doosre ka bahishkaar karte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported it as a marfu' hadith (and the words are): The deeds are presented on every Thursday and Monday and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. grants pardon to every person who does not associate anything with Allah except the person in whose (heart) there is rancour against his brother. It would be said: Put both of them off until they are reconciled.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne ise marfu hadees ke soorat mein riwayat ki (aur alfaaz hain): Amal har Guruvaar aur Somvaar ko pesh kiye jaate hain aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, har us shakhs ko maafi deta hai jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karta siwaay us shakhs ke jiske dil mein apne bhai ke prati kInA hai. Kaha jaayega: In donon ko taal do jab tak inmein sulah na ho jaaye.

e: Abu Huraim reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying The deeds of people would be presented every week on two days, viz. Monday and Thursday, and every believing servant would be granted pardon except the one in whose (heart) there is rancour against his brother and it would he said: Leave them and put them off until they are turned to reconciliation.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon ke amal har hafte do dinon mein pesh kiye jaate hain, yaani Somvaar aur Guruvaar, aur har imaandaar banda ko maafi milti hai siwaay us shakhs ke jiske dil mein apne bhai ke prati kInA hai aur kaha jaayega: Inhe chhod do aur taal do jab tak inmein sulah na ho jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily. Allah would say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who have mutual love for My Glory's sake? Today I shall shelter them in My shadow when there is no other shadow but the shadow of Mine.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah Qayamat ke din farmaayega: Woh kahan hain jinhone Meri Azmat ki khaatir ek-doosre se muhabbat ki? Aaj Main unhe Apni Chhaaya mein panah dunga jab Meri Chhaaya ke siwaay koi doosri chhaaya nahi hogi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A person visited his brother in another town and Allah deputed an Angel to wait for him on his way and when he came to him he said: Where do you intend to go? He said: I intend to go to my brother in this town. He said: Have you done any favour to him (the repayment of which you intend to get)? He said: No, excepting this that I love Mm for the sake of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. Thereupon he said: I am a meesenger to you from, Allah: (to inform you) that Allah loves you as you love him (for His sake).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs ne doosre shehar mein apne bhai se milne ka iraada kiya aur Allah ne rahste mein ek Farishta uska intezaar karne ke liye bheja aur jab woh unke paas aaya, unhone kaha: Tum kahan jaane ka iraada rakhte ho? Usne kaha: Mera iraada is shehar mein apne bhai se milne ka hai. Unhone kaha: Kya tumne unpar koi ehsaan kiya hai (jiska badla lene ka tumhaara iraada hai)? Usne kaha: Nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki main unse Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki khaatir muhabbat karta hoon. Isper unhone (Farishte ne) kaha: Main Allah ki taraf se tumhaare paas ek payaam lekar aaya hoon (ye bataane ke liye) ki Allah tumse (utni hi) muhabbat karta hai jitni tum unse (Uski khaatir) karte ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hammid b. Salama with the same of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hammad bin Salama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Rabi' reported directly from Allah's Apostle (may peace upon him) as saying: The one who visits the sick is in fact like one who is in the fruit garden of Paradise so long as he does not return.
hi: Abu Rabi ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki: Bimaar se milne wala waastav mein Jannat ke phalon ke baag mein hota hai jab tak woh wapas nahi jaata.

e: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who visits the sick continues to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns.
hi: Thauban (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo bimaar se milne jaata hai woh Jannat ke phalon ke baag mein rehta hai jab tak woh wapas nahi jaata.

e: Thauban reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, when a Muslim visits his brother in Islam he is supposed to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns.
hi: Thauban (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, jab koi Musalman apne Islami bhai se milne jaata hai, use samjha jaata hai ki woh Jannat ke phalon ke baag mein hai jab tak woh wapas nahi jaata.

e: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who visits the sick is supposed to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what is this Khurfat-ul-jannah? He said: It is a place abounding in fruits.
hi: Thauban (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo bimaar se milne jaata hai use samjha jaata hai ki woh Jannat ke phalon ke baag mein hai. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, ye Khurfat-ul-Jannah kya hai? Unhone farmaaya: Ye ek jagah hai jahan phal bahutayat mein hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Asim al-Ahwal with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Asim al-Ahwal ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would say on the Day of Resurrection: O son of Adam, I was sick but you did not visit Me. He would say: O my Lord; how could I visit Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? Thereupon He would say: Didn't you know that such and such servant of Mine was sick but you did not visit him and were you not aware of this that if you had visited him, you would have found Me by him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me. He would say: My Lord, how could I feed Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? He said: Didn't you know that such and such servant of Mine asked food from you but you did not feed him, and were you not aware that if you had fed him you would have found him by My side? (The Lord would again say: ) O son of Adam, I asked drink from you but you did not provide Me. He would say: My Lord, how could I provide Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? Thereupon He would say: Such and such of servant of Mine asked you for a drink but you did not provide him, and had you provided him drink you would have found him near Me.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Qayamat ke din farmaayega: Aye Aadam ke bete, Main bimaar tha lekin tu Mujhse milne nahi aaya. Woh kahega: Aye mere Rab, main Tujhse milne kaise aa sakta tha jabki Tu duniyaon ka Rab hai? Isper Woh farmaayega: Kya tujhe nahi pata tha ki Mera falan-falan banda bimaar tha lekin tu usse milne nahi gaya aur kya tujhe iska ilm nahi tha ki agar tu usse milne jaata, to tu Mujhe uske paas paata? Aye Aadam ke bete, Maine tujhse khaana maanga lekin tune Mujhe khaana nahi diya. Woh kahega: Mere Rab, main Tujhe kaise khaana khilaaunga jabki Tu duniyaon ka Rab hai? Woh farmaayega: Kya tujhe nahi pata tha ki Mere falan-falan banda ne tujhse khaana maanga tha lekin tune use khaana nahi diya, aur kya tujhe iska ilm nahi tha ki agar tune use khaana khilaaya hota to tu use Mere qareeb paata? (Rab phir farmaayega:) Aye Aadam ke bete, Maine tujhse peene ko maanga lekin tune Mujhe nahi diya. Woh kahega: Mere Rab, main Tujhe kaise pilaaunga jabki Tu duniyaon ka Rab hai? Isper Woh farmaayega: Mere falan-falan banda ne tujhse peene ko maanga tha lekin tune use nahi diya, aur agar tune use peene ko diya hota to tu use Mere paas paata.

e: 'A'isha reported, I did not see anyone else being afflicted with more severe illness than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). In the narration transmitted by 'Uthman there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine kabhi kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada sakht beemari mein mubtala nahi dekha. Uthman ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported: I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was running a high temperature. I touched his body with my hand and said to him: Allah's Messenger, you are running a high temperature, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes, it is so. I comparatively have a more severe fever than any one of you. I said: Is it because there is a double reward in store for you? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes, it is so. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) again said: When a Muslim falls ill, his compensation is that his minor sins are obliterated just as leaves fall (in autumn). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zubair there is (no mention of these words):" I touched his body with my hands."
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaya jab unhe tez bukhaar tha. Maine apne haath se unka badan chhua aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko tez bukhaar hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Haan, aisa hi hai. Mujhe tum mein se kisi ke muqable zyada tez bukhaar hota hai. Maine kaha: Kya iski wajah ye hai ki aapke liye dugna sawaab rakha gaya hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Haan, aisa hi hai. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir farmaaya: Jab koi Musalman bimaar padta hai, uska muaaviza ye hai ki uske chhote gunah is tarah jhad jaate hain jaise (patjhad mein) patte jhadte hain. Zubair ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (in alfaazon ka koi zikr) nahi hai: "Maine apne haathon se unka badan chhua."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of jarir and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya there is an addition of these words: He said: Yes, by Him in Whose Hand is my life, there is no Muslim upon the earth." The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Jarir ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: Unhone farmaaya: Haan, us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, zameen par koi Musalman nahi hai... Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Aswad reported that some young men from the Quraish visited 'A'isha as she was in Mina and they were laughing. She said: What makes you laugh? They said: Such and such person stumbled against the rope of the tent and he was about to break his neck or lose his eyes. She said: Don't laugh for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If a Muslim runs a thorn or (gets into trouble) severe than this, there is assured for him (a higher) rank and his sins are obliterated.
hi: Aswad ne bayan kiya ki Quraish ke kuch jawaan Aisha (RA) se milne gaye jab woh Mina mein thin aur woh hans rahe the. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne hansaaya? Unhone kaha: Falan-falan shakhs tambu ki rassi mein Thokar khaakar gir gaya aur uski gardan tootne ya uski aankhein jaane ke qareeb thi. Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Mat hanso kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar kisi Musalman ko kaanta chubhta hai ya isse zyada koi museebat aati hai, to uske liye ek (buland) darja tay ho jaata hai aur uske gunah jhad jaate hain.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer does not receive (the trouble) of running a thorn or more than that but Allah elevates him in rank or effaces his sins because of that.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek momin ko kaanta chubhne ya isse zyada museebat aane par (siwaay is ke koi natija nahi milta ki) Allah uska darja buland karta hai ya uski wajah se uske gunah mita deta hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer does not undergo (the trouble) of running a thorn or more than that when Allah effaces his sins.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek momin ko jab kaanta chubhta hai ya isse zyada museebat aati hai, to Allah uski wajah se uske gunah mita deta hai.

e: The above hadith has been transmitted by Hisham with the same chain.
hi: Upar wali hadees Hisham ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no trouble that comes to a believer except that it obliterates from his sins, even if it is the pricking of a thorn
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Koi bhi museebat kisi momin par nahi aati siwaay is baat ke ki ye uske gunahon ko mita deti hai, chahe ye sirf kaante ka chubhna hi kyun na ho.

e: 'A'isha said: No trouble comes to a believer even if it is the pricking of a thorn that it becomes (the means) whereby his sins are effaced or his sins are obliterated. Yazid says: He does not know which word 'Urwa said (whether he said Qussa or Kuffira).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Koi museebat kisi momin par nahi aati chahe ye sirf kaante ka chubhna hi ho lekin ye is baat ka zariya banti hai ki uske gunah mit jaayein ya uske gunah jhad jaayein. Yazid kehte hain: Unhe nahi pata ki Urwa ne kaunsa lafz kaha (chahe unhone "Qussa" kaha ya "Kuffira").

e: 'A'isha reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is nothing (in the form of trouble) that comes to a believer even if it is the pricking of a thorn that there is decreed for him by Allah good or his sins are obliterated.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kisi bhi tarah ki museebat (chubhne ki soorat mein) kisi momin par nahi aati chahe ye sirf kaante ka chubhna hi ho ki uske liye Allah ke zariye koi achhaai tay na ki jaaye ya uske gunah mit na jaayein.

e: Abu Sa'id and abu Huraira reported that they heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Never a believer is stricken with discomfort, hardship or illness, grief or even with mental worry that his sins are not expiated for him.
hi: Abu Sa'id aur Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kabhi bhi kisi momin par takleef, mushkil ya beemari, gam ya yahan tak ki mansik pareshaani bhi nahi aati jiski wajah se uske gunahon ka kaffara na ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported that when this verse was revealed: "Whoever does evil will be requited for it", and when this was conveyed to the Muslims they were greatly perturbed. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Be moderate and stand firm in trouble that falls to the lot of a Muslim (as that) is an expiation for him; even stumbling on the path or the pricking of a thorn (are an expiation for him). Muslim said that 'Umar b. Abd al-Rahman Muhaisin was from amongst the people of Mecca.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: "Jo koi burai karega uska badla usi ke mutabik milega," aur jab ye Musalmaanon tak pahunchi, woh bahut zyada pareshaan hue. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Santulit raho aur us museebat mein Dat kar khade raho jo kisi Musalman par aati hai (kyunki ye) uske liye kaffara hai; yahan tak ki raaste mein Thokar khaana ya kaante ka chubhna bhi (uske liye kaffara hai). Muslim ne kaha ki Umar bin Abd al-Rahman Muhaisin Makkah ke logon mein se the.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib or Umm Musayyib and said: Umm Sa'ib or Umm Musayyib. why is it that you are shivering? She said:" It is fever and may it not be blessed by Allah, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't curse fever for it expiates the sin of the children of Adam just as furnace removes the alloy of iron.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Sa'ib ya Umm Musayyib se milne gaye aur farmaaya: Umm Sa'ib ya Umm Musayyib, ye kya hai ki tum kaanp rahi ho? Unhone kaha: Ye bukhaar hai, isse Allah barkat na de, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Bukhaar ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki ye Aadam ki aulaad ke gunahon ko is tarah door karta hai jaise bhaTTi loha ka mail door karti hai.

e: 'Ata' b. Abi Rabih said: Ibn Abbas said to me: May I show you a woman of Paradise? I said: Yes. He said: Here is this dark-complexioned woman. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I am suffering from falling sickness and I become naked; supplicate Allah for me, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Show endurance as you can do and there would be Paradise for you and, if you desire, I supplicate Allah that He may cure you. She said: I am prepared to show endurance (but the unbearable trouble is) that I become naked, so supplicate Allah that He should not let me become naked, so he supplicated for her.
hi: Ata bin Abu Rabah ne kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne mujhse kaha: Kya main tumhe Jannat ki ek aurat na dikhaaun? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Ye rahi ye saanwli aurat. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Mujhe mirgi ki beemari hai aur main be-parda ho jaati hoon; mere liye Allah se dua kijiye, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Agar tum sabar kar sakti ho to sabar karo aur tumhaare liye Jannat hogi, aur agar tum chaho, to main Allah se dua karta hoon ki Woh tumhe theek kar de. Unhone kaha: Main sabar karne ko taiyaar hoon (lekin jo museebat bardaasht se baahar hai woh ye hai) ki main be-parda ho jaati hoon, is liye Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe be-parda na hone de, is liye unhone unke liye dua ki.

e:
Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: "O My servants, I have forbidden oppression for Myself and have made it forbidden amongst you, so do not oppress one another. O My servants, all of you are astray except for those I have guided, so seek guidance of Me and I shall guide you, O My servants, all of you are hungry except for those I have fed, so seek food of Me and I shall feed you. O My servants, all of you are naked except for those I have clothed, so seek clothing of Me and I shall clothe you. O My servants, you sin by night and by day, and I forgive all sins, so seek forgiveness of Me and I shall forgive you. O My servants, you will not attain harming Me so as to harm Me, and will not attain benefitting Me so as to benefit Me. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to be as pious as the most pious heart of any one man of you, that would not increase My dominion in anything. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to be as wicked as the most wicked heart of any one man of you, that would not decrease My dominion in anything. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to rise up in one place and make a request of Me, and were I to give everyone what he requested, that would not decrease what I have, any more that a needle decreases the sea if put into it. O My servants, it is but your deeds that I record for you and then recompense you for. So let him who finds good, praise Allah, and let him who finds other than that blame no one but himself." 

 Sa'id said that when Abu Idris Khaulini narrated this hadith he knelt upon his knees.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Aye Mere bando, Maine zulm ko Apne liye haraam kiya hai aur ise tumhaare beech bhi haraam kar diya hai, is liye ek-doosre par zulm mat karo. Aye Mere bando, tum sab gumraah ho siwaay unke jinhe Maine sahi raah dikhaayi hai, is liye Mujhse margdarshan maango aur Main tumhe margdarshan dunga. Aye Mere bando, tum sab bhookhe ho siwaay unke jinhe Maine khilaaya hai, is liye Mujhse khaana maango aur Main tumhe khilaaunga. Aye Mere bando, tum sab nange ho siwaay unke jinhe Maine kapda pehnaya hai, is liye Mujhse kapda maango aur Main tumhe pehnaaunga. Aye Mere bando, tum raat aur din mein gunah karte ho, aur Main sab gunah maaf karta hoon, is liye Mujhse maafi maango aur Main tumhe maaf karunga. Aye Mere bando, tum kabhi Mujhe nuksaan pahunchaane ki had tak nahi pahunch sakte ki tum Mujhe nuksaan pahunchaa sako, aur na tum kabhi Mujhe faayda pahunchaane ki had tak pahunch sakte ho ki tum Mujhe faayda pahunchaa sako. Aye Mere bando, agar tum mein sabse pehle aur tum mein sabse aakhri, tum mein se insaan aur tum mein se jinn, tum mein se kisi ek shakhs ke sabse takwaadaar dil jaisa muttaqi ban jaayein, to ismein Meri saltanat mein kuch bhi izafa nahi hoga. Aye Mere bando, agar tum mein sabse pehle aur tum mein sabse aakhri, tum mein se insaan aur tum mein se jinn, tum mein se kisi ek shakhs ke sabse buray dil jaisa buraa ban jaayein, to ismein Meri saltanat mein kuch bhi kami nahi aayegi. Aye Mere bando, agar tum mein sabse pehle aur tum mein sabse aakhri, tum mein se insaan aur tum mein se jinn, ek jagah khade ho jaayein aur Mujhse maang karein, aur agar Main har ek ko woh de dun jo usne maanga, to ismein Mere paas jo hai usmein utni bhi kami nahi aayegi jitni ek sui samundar mein Dubone se samundar mein kami laati hai. Aye Mere bando, ye sirf tumhaare amal hain jinhe Main tumhaare liye darj karta hoon aur phir tumhe unka badla deta hoon. Is liye jo achhaai paaye, use Allah ki hamd karni chahiye, aur jo iske siwaay kuch aur paaye, use apne siwaay kisi aur ko dosh nahi dena chahiye. Sa'id ne kaha ki jab Abu Idris Khaulani ne ye hadees riwayat ki, woh apne ghutnon ke bal baith gaye.

e: The hadith is narrated through Abu Mushir from Sa'id bin 'Abdil'Aziz except that the previous hadith through Marwan was the more complete of the two.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Mushir ke zariye Sa'id bin Abd al-Aziz se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is baat ke ki pichhli hadees jo Marwan ke zariye riwayat ki gayi thi donon mein zyada mukammal hai.

e: This hadith is also transmitted through Ibna Bashr and Muhammad bin Muhammad through Abu Mashur through the same chain, narrated to its (full) extent
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Bashr aur Muhammad bin Muhammad ke zariye Abu Mushir se isi sanad se poori tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that he reported it from his Lord, the Exalted and Glorious: Verily I have made oppression unlawful for Me and for My servants too, so do not commit oppression. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki unhone ise apne Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, se riwayat ki: Yaqeenan Maine zulm ko Apne liye aur Apne bandon ke liye bhi na-jaayez kiya hai, is liye zulm mat karo. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Be on your guard against committing oppression, for oppression is a darkness on the Day of Resurrection, and be on your guard against stinginess for stinginess destroyed those who were before you, as it incited them to shed blood and make lawful what was unlawful for them.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Zulm karne se bacho, kyunki zulm Qayamat ke din andhera hai, aur kanjoosi se bacho kyunki kanjoosi ne tumse pehle ke logon ko barbaad kiya, kyunki isne unhe khoon bahaane aur haraam cheezon ko jaayez banaane par uksaaya.

e: Ibu 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Oppression is the darkness on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Zulm Qayamat ke din andhera hai.

e: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A Muslim is the brother of a fellow-Muslim. He should neither commit oppression upon him nor ruin him, and he who meets the need of a brot'ier, Allah would meet big needs, and he who relieved a Muslim from hardship Allah would relieve him from the hardships to which he would be put on the Day of Resurrection, and he who did not expose (the follies of a Muslim) Allah would conceal his follies on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Salim ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek Musalman doosre Musalman bhai ka bhai hai. Use na to uspar zulm karna chahiye na use barbaad karna chahiye, aur jo apne bhai ki zaroorat poori karta hai, Allah uski zaroorten poori karega, aur jo kisi Musalman ki mushkil door karta hai, Allah uski woh mushkilein door karega jinka use Qayamat ke din saamna hoga, aur jo kisi (Musalman ki khaamiyon ko) chhupaata hai, Allah Qayamat ke din uski khaamiyaan chhupaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do you know who is poor? They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: A poor man amongst us is one who has neither dirham with him nor wealth. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The poor of my Umma would be he who would come on the Day of Resurrection with prayers and fasts and Zakat but (he would find himself bankrupt on that day as he would have exhausted his funds of virtues) since he hurled abuses upon others, brought calumny against others and unlawfully consumed the wealth of others and shed the blood of others and beat others, and his virtues would be credited to the account of one (who suffered at his hand). And if his good deeds fall short to clear the account, then his sins would be entered in (his account) and he would be thrown in the Hell-Fire.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kya tumhe pata hai gareeb kaun hai? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ke Sahaba ne) kaha: Humaare beech gareeb aadmi woh hai jiske paas na dirham hai na maal. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Meri Ummat ka gareeb woh hoga jo Qayamat ke din namazon, roze aur Zakat ke saath aayega lekin (us din khud ko divaaliya paayega kyunki usne apne nekokaar amal khatm kar diye honge) kyunki usne doosron ko gaaliyaan di thin, doosron par jhoote ilzaam lagaaye the, na-jaayez tareeke se doosron ka maal khaaya tha aur doosron ka khoon bahaaya tha aur doosron ko maara tha, aur uski nekokaariyaan un logon ke khaate mein daal di jaayengi (jinhone uske haathon takleef uThaayi thi). Aur agar uske nekokaar amal khaata poora nahi karte, to uske gunah (uske khaate mein) daal diye jaayenge aur use Jahannam ki aag mein Dala jaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: “Rights will certainly be restored to those entitled to them on the Day of Resurrection, (to the point that) even the hornless sheep will lay claim upon the horned one.”
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ke din haqdaaron ko unke haq zaroor wapas milenge, (yahan tak ki) bina siing wali bakri bhi (uske badle) siing waali bakri se apna daawa karegi.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, grants respite to the oppessor. But when He lays Hand upon him, He does not then let him off. Re (the Holy Prophet) then recited this verse:" Such is the chastisement of thy Lord when He chastises the towns (inhabited by) wrongdoing persons. Surely, His punishment is painful, severe" (xi. 103).
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, zaalim ko mohlat deta hai. Lekin jab Woh use pakadta hai to phir use jaane nahi deta. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir ye aayat padhi: "Aisi hai tere Rab ki saza jab Woh anyaayi bastiyon ko saza deta hai. Yaqeenan Uski saza dukhdaayi aur sakht hai" (11:102).

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that two young men, one from the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the other one from the Angr (helpers) fell into dispute and the Muhajir called his fellow Muhajirin, and the Ansari (the helper) called the Ansar (for help). In the meanwhile, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came there and said: What is this, the proclamation of the days of jahiliya (ignorance)? They said: Allah's Messenger, there is nothing serious. The two young men fell into dispute and the one struck at the back of the other. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Well, a person should help his brother whether he is an oppressor or an oppressed. If he is the oppressor he should prevent him from doing it, for that is his help; and if he is the oppressed he should be helped (against oppression).
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do jawaan, ek Muhajirin mein se aur doosra Ansar mein se, jhagad pade aur Muhajir ne apne saathi Muhajirin ko bulaaya aur Ansari ne Ansar ko bulaaya (madad ke liye). Isi beech, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye aur farmaaya: Ye kya hai, Jaahiliyat ke daur ka ailaan? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, koi gambheer baat nahi hai. Do jawaan jhagad pade aur ek ne doosre ki peeth par maara. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Achha, ek shakhs ko apne bhai ki madad karni chahiye chahe woh zaalim ho ya mazlum. Agar woh zaalim hai to use aisa karne se rokna chahiye, kyunki ye uski madad hai; aur agar woh mazlum hai to uski (zulm ke khilaaf) madad ki jaani chahiye.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition that a person from amongst the emigrants struck at the back of a person from the Ansir. The Ansiri said: O Ansar! And the Muhijir said: O Emigrants! Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What are these proclamations of the Days of Ignorance? They said: Allah's Messenger, a person from the emigrants struck at the back of an Ansari, whereupon he said: It is something disgusting. 'Abdullah b. Ubayy heard it and said: They have indeed done it. By Allah, when we would return to Medina the respectable amongst them (the Ansar) would turn away the mean (the emigrants). Thereupon 'Umar said: Permit me so that I should strike the neck of this hypocrite. But he (the Holy Prophet) said: Leave him, the people may not say that Muhammad kills his companions.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par the ki Muhajirin mein se ek shakhs ne Ansar mein se ek shakhs ki peeth par maara. Ansari ne kaha: Aye Ansar! Aur Muhajir ne kaha: Aye Muhajirin! Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye Jaahiliyat ke daur ke kaunse ailaan hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Muhajirin mein se ek shakhs ne Ansari ki peeth par maara, isper unhone farmaaya: Ye ek ghinaunI baat hai. Abdullah bin Ubayy ne ye suna aur kaha: Unhone waaqai aisa kiya hai. Allah ki qasam, jab hum Madina wapas jaayenge, izzatdaar log (Ansar mein se) neech logon ko (Muhajirin ko) nikaal denge. Isper Umar ne kaha: Mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main is munafiq ki gardan maar dun. Lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Use chhod do, log ye na kahein ki Muhammad apne saathiyon ko qatal karta hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a person from the emigrants struck the back of an Ansari. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for compensation. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Leave it. for it is something disgusting. Ibn Mansur said that in the narration transmitted on the authority of Amr (these words are also found):" I heard Jabir."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Muhajirin mein se ek shakhs ne Ansari ki peeth par maara. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur muaaviza maanga. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ise chhod do, kyunki ye ek ghinaunI baat hai. Ibn Mansur ne kaha ki Amr ki riwayat mein (ye alfaaz bhi milte hain): "Maine Jabir se suna."

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A believer is like a brick for another believer, the one supporting the other.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek momin doosre momin ke liye eenT ki tarah hai, ek doosre ko sahaara dete hue.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of believers in regard to mutual love, affection, fellow-feeling is that of one body; when any limb of it aches, the whole body aches, because of sleeplessness and fever.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Momino ki aapas ki muhabbat, sneh aur hamdardi ki misaal ek jism jaisi hai; jab iska koi ang dukhta hai, to poora jism dard mehsoos karta hai, bekhwaabi aur bukhaar ki wajah se.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The believers are like one person; if his head aches, the whole body aches with fever and sleeplessness.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Momin ek shakhs jaise hain; agar unka sar dukhta hai, to poora jism bukhaar aur bekhwaabi se dukhta hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that Muslims are like one body of a person; if the eye is sore, the whole body aches, and if the head aches, the whole body aches.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Musalman ek shakhs ke jism jaise hain; agar aankh mein dard hota hai, to poora jism dukhta hai, aur agar sar mein dard hota hai, to poora jism dukhta hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two persons indulge in hurling (abuses) upon one another, it would be the first one who would be the sinner so long as the oppressed does not transgress the limits.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab do log ek-doosre par (gaaliyaan) barsaate hain, to pehla shakhs gunahgaar hota hai jab tak mazlum apni had se aage na badhe.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Charity does not decrease wealth, no one forgives another except that Allah increases his honor, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sadaqa maal ko kam nahi karta, koi bhi doosron ko maaf nahi karta lekin Allah uski izzat mein izafa karta hai, aur koi bhi Allah ki khaatir khud ko vinamr nahi banaata lekin Allah uska darja buland karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do you know what is backbiting? They (the Companions) said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Backbiting implies your talking about your brother in a manner which he does not like. It was said to him: What is your opinion about this that if I actually find (that failing) in my brother which I made a mention of? He said: If (that failing) is actually found (in him) what you assert, you in fact backbited him, and if that is not in him it is a slander.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kya tumhe pata hai gheebat kya hai? Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Gheebat ka matlab hai apne bhai ke baare mein aisi baat karna jo use pasand na aaye. Unse poocha gaya: Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai agar main waaqai woh (khaami) apne bhai mein paaun jiska maine zikr kiya? Unhone farmaaya: Agar (woh khaami) waaqai usmein paayi jaati hai jo tum kehte ho, to tumne waastav mein uski gheebat ki, aur agar ye usmein nahi hai to ye ilzaam hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The servant (whose fault) Allah conceals in this world, Allah would also conceal (his faults) on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jis banda ki (khaamiyon ko) Allah is duniya mein chhupaata hai, Allah Qayamat ke din bhi (uski khaamiyaan) chhupaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The servant (who conceals) the faults of others in this world, Allah would conceal his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo banda (doosron ki) khaamiyaan is duniya mein chhupaata hai, Allah Qayamat ke din uski khaamiyaan chhupaayega.

e: A'isha reported that a person sought permission from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to see him. He said: Grant him permission. (and also added: ) He is a bad son of his tribe or he is a bad person of his tribe. When he came in he used kind words for him. 'A'isha reported that she said: Allah's Messenger, you said about him what you had to say and then you treated him with kindness. He said: A'isha, verily in the eye of Allah, worst amongst the person in rank on the Day of Resurrection is one whom the people abandon or desert out of the fear of indecency.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se unse milne ki ijazat maangi. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Use ijazat do, (aur ye bhi farmaaya:) Woh apne qabile ka bura beta hai, ya woh apne qabile ka bura shakhs hai. Jab woh andar aaya, unhone uske saath narm alfaazon mein baat ki. Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne uske baare mein woh kaha jo aapko kehna tha aur phir aapne uske saath narmi se pesh aaye. Unhone farmaaya: Aisha, yaqeenan Allah ki nazar mein Qayamat ke din darje mein sabse bura shakhs woh hai jise log uski beHayaai ke Dar se chhoDte hain ya usse door rehte hain.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Munkadir with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Munkadir ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jarir reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good.
hi: Jarir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki: Jo narmi se mehroom hai woh waastav mein achhaai se mehroom hai.

e: Jarir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good.
hi: Jarir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo narmi se mehroom hai woh waastav mein achhaai se mehroom hai.

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good and he who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo narmi se mehroom hai woh waastav mein achhaai se mehroom hai aur jo narmi se mehroom hai woh waastav mein achhaai se mehroom hai.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, verily Allah is kind and He loves kindness and confers upon kindness which he does not confer upon severity and does not confer upon anything else besides it (kindness).
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aisha, yaqeenan Allah meherbaan hai aur Woh meherbaani ko pasand karta hai aur meherbaani ke badle woh ata karta hai jo sakhti ke badle ata nahi karta aur (meherbaani ke ilawa) kisi doosri cheez ke badle nahi ata karta.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Kindness is not to be found in anything but that it adds to its beauty and it is not withdrawn from anything but it makes it defective.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Meherbaani kisi bhi cheez mein nahi hoti lekin ye use zeenat ata karti hai aur ye kisi cheez se hataayi nahi jaati lekin ye use aib-daar bana deti hai.

e: This hadith has been reported by Miqdam b. Shuraih b. Hani with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " 'A'isha mounted upon a wild camel and she began to make that go round and round. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You should show kindness, and then he made a mention of this hadith.
hi: Ye hadees Miqdam bin Shuraih bin Hani ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Aisha (RA) ek jangli oont par sawaar huin aur woh use idhar-udhar ghumaane lagin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhe meherbaani dikhaani chahiye, aur phir unhone ye hadees riwayat ki."

e: 'Imran b. Husain reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in some of his journeys and there was a woman from the Ansar riding a she-camel that it shied and she invoked curse upon that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard it and said: Unload that and set it free for it is accursed. 'Imran said: I still perceive that (dromedary) walking amongst people and none taking any notice of that.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke kuch safaron mein the aur Ansar ki ek aurat ek oontni par sawaar thi jo bidkI aur usne isper laanat ki. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye suna aur farmaaya: (Uske saamaan) ko utaaro aur ise azaad chhoD do kyunki ye laanat-zada hai. Imran ne kaha: Mujhe abhi bhi lagta hai jaise woh (oontni) logon ke beech chal rahi hai aur koi bhi uska koi khyaal nahi karta.

e: 'Imran reported: I perceive as if I am looking towards that dromedary, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Thaqafi (the words are):" Unload it and make its back bare for it is accursed."
hi: Imran (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhe lagta hai jaise main us oontni ki taraf dekh raha hoon, aur Thaqafi ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Ise utaaro aur iski peeth khaali kar do kyunki ye laanat-zada hai."

e: Abu Burza al-Aslami reported that a slave-girl was riding a dromedary and there was also the luggage of people upon it. that she suddenly saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The way of the mountain was narrow and she said (to that dromedary): Go ahead (but that dromedary did not move). She (that slave-girl), out of anger, said: O Allah, let that (dromedary) be damned. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Let the dromedary on which the curse has been invoked not proceed with us.
hi: Abu Barza al-Aslami (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek laundi ek oontni par sawaar thi aur usper logon ka saamaan bhi laada hua tha ki usne achaanak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha. Pahaad ka raasta sankeern tha aur usne (oontni se) kaha: Aage badho (lekin woh oontni nahi hili). Woh (laundi), gusse mein, kehne lagi: Aye Allah, isse (oontni ko) laanat-zada kar de. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jispar laanat ki gayi hai woh oontni humaare saath aage na badhe.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters but with a variation of words (and that is): " By Allah, let that accompany us not which has been damned, or he said like it."
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur woh ye hai): "Allah ki qasam, jispar laanat ki gayi hai woh humaare saath nahi jaayegi, ya unhone isi jaisa kuch farmaaya."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It does not seem proper for a Siddiq that he should be an invoker of curse.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ye kisi Siddiq (sachche insaan) ke liye theek nahi hai ki woh laanat karne wala ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Kuraib with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Kuraib ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zaid b. Aslam reported that 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan sent some domestic goods for decoration to Umm Darda' on his own behalf, and when it was night 'Abd al-Malik got up and called for the servant. It seemed as if he (the servant) was late (in responding to his call), so he ('Abd al-Malik) invoked curse upon him, and when it was morning Umm Darda' said to him: I heard you cursing your servant during the night when you called him, and she said: I heard Abu Darda' as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The invoker of curse would neither be intercessor nor witness on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Zaid bin Aslam ne bayan kiya ki Abd al-Malik bin Marwan ne ghar sajaane ke kuch saamaan Umm Darda ke paas apni taraf se bheje, aur jab raat hui, Abd al-Malik uThe aur khaadim ko bulaaya. Aisa lagta tha ki woh (khaadim) (unke bulaave ka jawaab dene mein) der kar raha tha, is liye unhone (Abd al-Malik ne) uspar laanat ki, aur jab subah hui, Umm Darda ne unse kaha: Maine aapko raat ko apne khaadim ko jab aapne use bulaaya tha laanat karte suna, aur unhone kaha: Maine Abu Darda ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Laanat karne wala na Qayamat ke din sifaarish karne wala hoga na gawaah.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Darda' reported on the authority of Abu Darda' as saying: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The invoker of curse would neither be witness nor intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Umm Darda ne Abu Darda ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Laanat karne wala Qayamat ke din na gawaah hoga na sifaarish karne wala.

e: Abu Huraira reported it was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Invoke curse upon the polytheists, whereupon he said: I have not been sent as the invoker of curse, but I have been sent as mercy."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha gaya: Mushrikeen par laanat kariye, isper unhone farmaaya: Mujhe laanat karne wale ke soorat mein nahi bheja gaya, balki mujhe rahmat ke soorat mein bheja gaya hai.

e: A'isha reported that two persons visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and both of them talked about a thing, of which I am not aware, but that annoyed him and he invoked curse upon both of them and hurled malediction, and when they went out I said: Allah's Messenger, the good would reach everyone but it would not reach these two. He said: Why so? I said: Because you have invoked curse and hurled malediction upon both of them. He said: Don't you know that I have made condition with my Lord saying thus: O Allah, I am a human being and that for a Muslim upon whom I invoke curse or hurl malediction make it a source of purity and reward.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne aaye aur donon ne ek aisi baat par baat ki jiska mujhe ilm nahi hai, lekin isne unhe naaraaz kiya aur unhone donon par laanat ki aur bura-bhala kaha, aur jab woh bahar gaye maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, achhaai sab tak pahunchegi lekin ye in donon tak nahi pahunchegi. Unhone farmaaya: Aisa kyun? Maine kaha: Kyunki aapne donon par laanat ki aur bura-bhala kaha. Unhone farmaaya: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki maine apne Rab ke saamne ye shart rakhi hai: Aye Allah, main ek insaan hoon aur kisi bhi Musalman ke liye jispar main laanat karun ya bura-bhala kahun, ise pavitrata aur sawaab ka zariya bana de.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (the words are): " He had a private meeting with them and hurled malediction upon them and cursed them and sent them out."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Isa ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Unki unke saath ek niji mulaqaat hui aur unhone unpar bura-bhala aur laanat ki aur unhe bahar bhej diya."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, I am a human being and for any person amongst Muslims upon whom I hurl malediction or invoke curse or give him whipping make it a source of purity and mercy.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, main ek insaan hoon aur Musalmaanon mein se kisi bhi shakhs ke liye jispar main bura-bhala kahun ya laanat karun ya use koda maar dun, ise pavitrata aur rehmat ka zariya bana de.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a hadith like it but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi hadees alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa the words are: Make it a source of reward, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (the words are):" Make it a source of mercy."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Isa ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Ise sawaab ka zariya bana de, aur Abu Huraira ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Ise rehmat ka zariya bana de.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, I make a covenant with Thee against which Thou wouldst never go. I am a human being and thus for a Muslim whom I give any harm or whom I scold or upon whom I invoke curse or whom I beat, make this a source of blessing, purification and nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, main Tere saath ek ehad karta hoon jise Tu kabhi nahi toDega. Main ek insaan hoon aur is liye kisi Musalman ko jise main koi nuksaan pahunchaaun ya jise main daantoon ya jispar main laanat karun ya jise main maroon, ise Qayamat ke din uske liye barkat, pavitrata aur Tere qareeb aane ka zariya bana de.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zinad with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Zinad ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salim, the freed slave of Nasriyyin, said: I heard Abu Huraira as saying that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, Muhammad is a human being. I lose my temper just as human beings lose temper, and I have held a covenant with Thee which Thou wouldst not break: For a believer whom I give any trouble or invoke curse or beat, make that an expiation (of his sins and a source of) his nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Salim, Nasriyyin ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne kaha: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ek insaan hai. Mujhe gussa aata hai jaisa insaanon ko aata hai, aur maine Tere saath ek ehad kiya hai jise Tu nahi toDega: Kisi momin ko jise main koi takleef dun ya jispar laanat karun ya jise maroon, ise (uske gunahon ka) kaffara aur Qayamat ke din Tere qareeb aane ka zariya bana de.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, for any believing servant whom I curse make that as a source of nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, jis momin banda par main laanat karun, ise Qayamat ke din Tere qareeb aane ka zariya bana de.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have held covenant with Thee which Thou wouldst not break, so for any believer whom I curse or beat, make that an expiation on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine Tere saath ek ehad kiya hai jise Tu nahi toDega, is liye kisi bhi momin ko jispar main laanat karun ya jise main maroon, ise Qayamat ke din (uske gunahon ka) kaffara bana de.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I am a human being and I have made this term with my Lord, the Exalted and Glorious: For any servant amongst Muslims whom I curse or scold, make that a source of purity and reward. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Main ek insaan hoon aur maine apne Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke saath ye vaada kiya hai: Musalmaanon mein se kisi bhi banda ko jispar main laanat karun ya jise main daantoon, ise pavitrata aur sawaab ka zariya bana de. Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that there was an orphan girl with Umm Sulaim (who was the mother of Anas). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that orphan girl and said: O, it is you; you have grown young. May you not advance in years! That slave-girl returned to Umm Sulaim weeping. Umm Sulaim said: O daughter, what is the matter with you? She said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has invoked curse upon me that I should not grow in age and thus I would never grow in age, or she said, in my (length) of life. Umm Sulaim went out wrapping her head-dress hurriedly until she met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said to her: Umm Sulaim, what is the matter with you? She said: Allah's Apostle, you invoked curse upon my orphan girl. He said: Umm Sulaim, what is that? She said: She (the orphan girl) states you have cursed her saying that she might not grow in age or grow in life. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and then said: Umm Sulaim, don't you know that I have made this term with my Lord. And the term with my Lord is that I said to Him: 1 am a human being and I am pleased just as a human being is pleased and I lose temper just as a human being loses temper, so for any person from amongst my Ummah whom I curse and he in no way deserves it, let that, O Lord, be made a source of purification and purity and nearness to (Allah) on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim (Anas ki maa) ke paas ek anaath larki thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us anaath larki ko dekha aur farmaaya: Aye, ye to tum ho; tum badi ho gayi ho. Tumhaari umar zyada na badhe! Woh laundi rote hue Umm Sulaim ke paas wapas gayi. Umm Sulaim ne kaha: Aye beti, tumhe kya hua? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhpar laanat ki hai ki meri umar na badhe aur is liye meri umar kabhi nahi badhegi, ya unhone kaha, meri (lambi) zindagi mein. Umm Sulaim apna sirdaastar jaldi mein lapetkar bahar gayin yahan tak ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mili. Unhone unse farmaaya: Umm Sulaim, tumhe kya hua? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne meri anaath larki par laanat ki. Unhone farmaaya: Umm Sulaim, ye kya hai? Unhone kaha: Woh (anaath larki) kehti hai ki aapne uspar laanat ki hai ye kehte hue ki uski umar na badhe ya uski zindagi mein izafa na ho. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye aur phir farmaaya: Umm Sulaim, kya tumhe nahi pata ki maine apne Rab ke saath ye shart rakhi hai? Aur mere Rab ke saath meri shart ye hai ki maine Usse kaha: Main ek insaan hoon aur main utna hi khush hota hoon jitna koi insaan khush hota hai aur mujhe utna hi gussa aata hai jitna insaan ko gussa aata hai, is liye meri Ummat mein se kisi bhi shakhs ko jispar main laanat karun jabki woh iske kisi bhi tarah laayak nahi hai, aye Rab, ise (uske liye) pavitrata, safaayi aur (Allah ke) qareeb aane ka Qayamat ke din zariya bana de.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: I was playing with children that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by (us). I hid myself behind the door. He (the Prophet) came and patted my shoulders and said: Go and call Mu'awiya. I returned and said: He is busy in taking food. He again asked me to go and call Mu'awiya to him. I went (and came back) and said that he was busy in taking food, whereupon he said: May Allah not fill his belly! Ibn Muthanna, said: I asked Umm Umayya what he meant by the word Hatani. He said: It means "he patted my shoulders."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main bachchon ke saath khel raha tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (humaare paas se) guzre. Main darwaze ke peeche chhup gaya. Woh (Nabi) aaye aur unhone mere kandhe thoke aur farmaaya: Jaao aur Mu'awiya ko bulaao. Main wapas gaya aur kaha: Woh khaana khaane mein masroof hain. Unhone mujhse phir Mu'awiya ko bulaane ko kaha. Main gaya (aur wapas aaya) aur kaha ki woh khaana khaane mein masroof hain, isper unhone farmaaya: Allah unka pet na bhare! Ibn Muthanna ne kaha: Maine Umm Umayya se poocha ki unka "Hatani" lafz se kya matlab tha. Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai "unhone mere kandhe thoke."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abbas with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The worst amongst the people is the double-faced one; he comes to some people with one face and to others with the other face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon mein sabse bura do-mumhaa shakhs hai; woh kuch logon ke paas ek chehra lekar aata hai aur doosron ke paas doosra chehra.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The worst amongst people is one with the double face. He comes to some people with one face and to others with the other face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Logon mein sabse bura woh hai jiske do chehre hain. Woh kuch logon ke paas ek chehra lekar aata hai aur doosron ke paas doosra chehra.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You will find the worst amongst the people one having double face. He comes to some people with one face and to the others with the other face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhe logon mein sabse bura woh milega jiske do chehre hain. Woh kuch logon ke paas ek chehra lekar aata hai aur doosron ke paas doosra chehra.

e: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported that his mother Umm Kulthum daughter of 'Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait, and she was one amongst the first emigrants who pledged allegiance to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), as saying that she heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A liar is not one who tries to bring reconciliation amongst people and speaks good (in order to avert dispute), or he conveys good. Ibn Shihab said he did not hear that exemption was granted in anything what the people speak as lie but in three cases: in battle, for bringing reconciliation amongst persons and the narration of the words of the husband to his wife, and the narration of the words of a wife to her husband (in a twisted form in order to bring reconciliation between them).
hi: Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne bayan kiya ki unki maa Umm Kulthum, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ki beti, jo pehli aurat prawaasiyon mein se ek thin jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam li thi, ne riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Woh jhoota nahi hai jo logon ke beech sulah karaane ki koshish karta hai aur achhi baat kahta hai (jhagda taalne ke liye), ya woh achhi baat pahunchaata hai. Ibn Shihab ne kaha ki unhone nahi suna ki jhoot ke baare mein kisi baat mein chhoot di gayi ho siwaay teen maamlon mein: jung mein, logon ke beech sulah karaane mein, aur shohar ke alfaaz apni zauja tak pahunchaane mein, aur zauja ke alfaaz apne shohar tak pahunchaane mein (sulah ke maqsad se).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Shihab ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that Muhammad (ﷺ) said: Should I inform you that slandering, that is in fact a tale-carrying which creates dissension amongst people, (and) he (further) said: The person tells the truth until he is recorded as truthful, and lie tells a lie until lie is recorded as a liar.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya main tumhe chugalKhori ke baare mein na bataaun, ye waastav mein logon ke beech phoot Dalne ke liye khabar phailaane wali baat hai, (aur) unhone (aage) farmaaya: Shakhs sach kehta rehta hai yahan tak ki use sachcha darj kar diya jaata hai, aur woh jhoot bolta rehta hai yahan tak ki use jhoota darj kar diya jaata hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truth leads one to Paradise and virtue leads one to Paradise and the person tells the truth until he is recorded as truthful, and lie leads to obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell, and the person tells a lie until he is recorded as a liar.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sach shakhs ko Jannat tak le jaata hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai aur shakhs sach kehta rehta hai yahan tak ki use sachcha darj kar diya jaata hai, aur jhoot behayaai tak le jaata hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur shakhs jhoot bolta rehta hai yahan tak ki use jhoota darj kar diya jaata hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Telling of truth is a virtue and virtue leads to Paradise and the servant who endeavours to tell the truth is recorded as truthful, and lie is obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell-Fire, and the servant who endeavours to tell a lie is recorded as a liar. Ibn Abu Shaiba reported this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sach kehna nekokaari hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai, aur woh banda jo sach kehne ki koshish karta hai use sachcha darj kiya jaata hai, aur jhoot behayaai hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur woh banda jo jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai use jhoota darj kiya jaata hai. Ibn Abu Shaiba ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is obligatory for you to tell the truth, for truth leads to virtue and virtue leads to Paradise, and the man who continues to speak the truth and endeavours to tell the truth is eventually recorded as truthful with Allah, and beware of telling of a lie for telling of a lie leads to obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell-Fire, and the person who keeps telling lies and endeavours to tell a lie is recorded as a liar with Allah.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhaare liye zaroori hai ki sach bolo, kyunki sach nekokaari tak le jaata hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai, aur jo shakhs sach bolta rehta hai aur sach kehne ki koshish karta hai use aakhir mein Allah ke paas sachcha darj kar diya jaata hai, aur jhoot bolne se bacho kyunki jhoot behayaai tak le jaata hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur jo shakhs jhoot bolta rehta hai aur jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai use Allah ke paas jhoota darj kar diya jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and no mention is made in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (of these words): " He who endeavours to tell the truth and endeavours to tell a lie," and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Mushir (the words are):" Until Allah records it".
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Isa ki riwayat mein (in alfaazon ka) koi zikr nahi hai: "Jo sach kehne ki aur jo jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai," aur Mushir ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Yahan tak ki Allah ise darj kar de."

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Whom do you count as" Raqub" amongst you? They (his Companions) said: One who has no children (the children are born unto him but they do not survive). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: He is not a Raqub but Raqub is one who does not find his child as the forerunner (in Paradise). He then said: Whom do you count as a wrestler amongst you? We said: He who wrestles with persons. He said: No, it is not he but one who controls himself when in a fit of rage.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se "Raqub" kise maante ho? Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Woh jiske koi bachche na hon (bachche paida hote hain lekin woh zinda nahi rehte). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Woh Raqub nahi hai, balki Raqub woh hai jo apne bachche ko (Jannat mein) agrasar ke soorat mein na paaye. Unhone phir farmaaya: Tum mein pahalwaan kise maante ho? Humne kaha: Jo logon se kushti ladta hai. Unhone farmaaya: Nahi, ye woh nahi hai, balki woh hai jo apne gusse ke waqt khud par kaabu rakhta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The strong-man is not one who wrestles well but the strong man is one who controls himself when he is in a fit of rage.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Taakatvar aadmi woh nahi hai jo achhi kushti ladta hai balki taakatvar aadmi woh hai jo apne gusse ke waqt khud par kaabu rakhta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: One is not strong because of one's wrestling skillfully. They said: Allah's Messenger, then who is strong? He said: He who controls his anger when he is in a fit of rage.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi shakhs is liye taakatvar nahi hai kyunki woh achhi tarah kushti ladta hai. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir taakatvar kaun hai? Unhone farmaaya: Woh jo apne gusse par kaabu rakhta hai jab use gussa aata hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sulaiman b. Surad reported that two persons abused each other in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and the eyes of one of them became red as embers and the veins of his neck were swollen. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I know of a wording, if he were to utter that, his fit of rage (would be no more and that wording is): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed. The person said: Do you find any madness in me? Ibn al-'Ala' said: Do you see it? And he made no mention of the person.
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage aur unmein se ek ki aankhein angaaron ki tarah laal ho gayin aur uski gardan ki naseen sooj gayin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main ek aisa lafz jaanta hoon ki agar woh use kahe to uska gussa khatam ho jaayega (aur woh lafz hai): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Us shakhs ne kaha: Kya aapko mujhme koi paagalpan nazar aata hai? Ibn al-Ala ne kaha: Kya tum ye dekhte ho? Aur unhone us shakhs ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Sulaiman b. Surad reported that two persons abused each other in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and one of them fell into a rage and his face became red. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw him and said: I know of a wording; if he were to utter that, he would get out (of the fit of anger) (and the wording is): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed. Thereupon, a person went to him who had heard that from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said to him: Do you know what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I know of a wording; if he were to say that, (the fit) would be no more (and the words are): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed. And the person said to him: Do you find me mad?
hi: Sulaiman bin Surad (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage aur unmein se ek gusse mein aa gaya aur uska chehra laal ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha aur farmaaya: Main ek aisa lafz jaanta hoon; agar woh use kahe, to woh (gusse ki haalat se) baahar aa jaayega (aur woh lafz hai): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Isper, ek shakhs uske paas gaya jisne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna tha aur usse kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kya farmaaya? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Main ek lafz jaanta hoon; agar woh use kahe, to (gussa) khatam ho jaayega (aur woh alfaaz hain): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Aur us shakhs ne usse kaha: Kya tumhe main paagal lagta hoon?

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah fashioned Adam in Paradise, He left him as He liked him to leave. Then Iblis roamed round him to see what actually that was and when he found him hollow from within, he recognised that he had been created with a disposition that he would not have control over himself.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Allah ne Aadam ko Jannat mein Dhaala, Usne unhe utni der chhoDa jitna Usne chhoDna pasand kiya. Phir Iblis unke aas-paas ghooma ye dekhne ke liye ki ye waastav mein kya hai aur jab usne unhe andar se khokhla paaya, usne pehchaana ki unhe aise mizaj ke saath banaaya gaya hai ki woh apne aap par kaabu nahi rakh payenge.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Humaid with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Humaid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother he should avoid striking at the face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre par maarne se bachna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zinad and he said: " When one amongst you strikes (at the face)."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Zinad ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Jab tum mein se koi (chehre par) maarta hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should spare his face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre ko bachaana chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should not slap at the face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre par thappad nahi maarna chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Hatim Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) is reported to have said: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid his face for Allah created Adam in His own image.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Ibn Hatim ki riwayat mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ye alfaaz milte hain: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre se bachna chahiye kyunki Allah ne Aadam ko Apni surat par banaaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid the face.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use chehre se bachna chahiye.

e: 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father that Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam happened to pass by some people in Syria who had been made to stand in the sun and olive-oil was being poured upon their heads. He said: What is this? It was said: They are being punished for (not paying) the Kharaj (the government revenue). Thereupon he said: Allah would punish those who torment people in this world (without any genuine reason).
hi: Urwa ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam Syria mein kuch logon ke paas se guzre jinhe dhoop mein khada kiya gaya tha aur unke saron par zaitun ka tel Dala jaa raha tha. Unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Kaha gaya: Unhe Kharaj (sarkaari mahasool) na dene ki saza di ja rahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: Allah unhe saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein (bina kisi vaajib wajah ke) taklif dete hain.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam happened to pass by people, the farmers of Syria, who had been made to stand in the sun. He said: What is the matter with them? They said: They have been detained for Jizya. Thereupon Hisham said: I bear testimony to the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah would torment those who torment people in the world.
hi: Hisham ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam kuch logon ke paas se guzre, Syria ke kisaanon ke, jinhe dhoop mein khada kiya gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Inhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Unhe Jizya (kar) na dene ki wajah se rok kar rakha gaya hai. Isper Hisham ne kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah unhe saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein taklif dete hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition of Jarir that (Hisham b. Hakim) went to Umair b. Sa'd who was then ruler in Palestine and he narrated to him this hadith and he (submitting before the words of the Prophet) commanded that they should be let off and so they were let off.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone Jarir ki riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki (Hisham bin Hakim) Umair bin Sa'd ke paas gaye jo us waqt Palestine mein hakim the aur unhone unhe ye hadees riwayat ki aur unhone (Nabi ke alfaazon ke saamne sar jhukaate hue) hukum diya ki unhe chhod diya jaaye, aur unhe chhod diya gaya.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that Hisham b. Hakim found a person (the ruler of Hims) who had been detaining some Nabateans in connection with the dues of Jizya. He said: What is this? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah would torment those persons who torment people in the world.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Hisham bin Hakim ne ek shakhs (Hims ke gavarnar) ko paaya jo Jizya ke bakaaya ke silsile mein kuch Nabateion ko rok kar rakhe hue the. Unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah un logon ko saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein taklif dete hain.

e: 'Amr heard Jabir as saying: A person happened to come to the mosque with an arrow; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Take hold of its pointed head.
hi: Amr ne Jabir ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs masjid mein ek teer lekar aaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse farmaaya: Iski nokdaar sira pakDo.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that a person happened to come to the mosque with arrows and their iron-ends were exposed, so he was commanded that he should grasp the pointed heads so that these might not do any harm to a Muslim.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs masjid mein teer lekar aaya aur unke loha ke sire khule hue the, is liye use hukum diya gaya ki woh unhe nokdaar hisson se pakDe taaki ye kisi Musalman ko koi nuksaan na pahunchaa payein.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded a person who had been distributing arrows freely in the mosque that he should not move about in the mosque but by catching hold of their iron-heads. Ibn Rumh narrated this with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko jo masjid mein teer bant raha tha hukum diya ki woh masjid mein bina unke loha wale sire pakDe idhar-udhar na jaaye. Ibn Rumh ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

e: Abd Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When any one of you happens to go to a meeting or the bazar with an arrow in his hand he must grasp its pointed head; then (he again said): He must grasp its pointed head. Abu Musa said: By Allah, we did not court death until some of us had flung arrows upon the faces of one another.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi majlis mein ya bazaar mein haath mein teer lekar jaaye, to use uska nokdaar sira pakDna chahiye; phir (unhone dobara farmaaya): Use uska nokdaar sira pakDna chahiye. Abu Musa ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne maut ko tab tak nahi bulaaya jab tak humme se kuch logon ne ek-doosre ke chehron par teer nahi phenke.
