e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) assaying: He who amongst you moves in the mosque or in the bazar and there is an arrow with him he should take hold of its iron-head in his palm, so that none amongst the Muslims should receive any injury from it, or he said, should catch its iron-head.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo tum mein se masjid mein ya bazaar mein chalta hai aur uske paas teer hai, use chahiye ki woh uske loha wale sire ko apni hatheli mein pakDe, taaki kisi Musalman ko isse koi chot na pahunche, ya unhone kaha, use iske loha wale sire ko pakDna chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported: Abu'l-Qasim (the kunya of Allah's Messenger, may peace be upon him), said: He who pointed a weapon towards his brother the angels invoke curse upon him even if he is his real brother so long as he does not abandon it (the pointing of weapon towards one's brother Muslim).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu'l-Qasim (Allah ke Rasool ki kunya) ne farmaaya: Jo apne bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara karta hai, Farishte uspar laanat karte hain chahe woh uska khud ka (sagaa) bhai hi kyun na ho, jab tak woh isse (apne Musalman bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara karna) chhod na de.

e: Abu Huraira reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported a hadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; (one of them was this) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should point a weapon towards his brother, for he does not know that Satan might cause the weapon (to slip) from his hand and (he may injure anyone) and thus he may fall into Hell-Fire.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat ki; (unmein se ek ye thi) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi apne bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara na kare, kyunki use nahi pata ki Shaitaan uske haath se hathiyaar (fisla) sakta hai (aur woh kisi ko zakhmi kar sakta hai) aur is tarah woh Jahannam ki aag mein gir sakta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While a person was going along the path he found a thorny branch upon it. He pushed it to a side and Allah approved (this action) of his and (as a mark of appreciation) granted him pardon.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs raaste par chal raha tha ki usne uspar kaanTedaar shaakha paayi. Usne ise ek taraf hataya aur Allah ne uske is amal ki qadar ki aur (iski qadar-daani ke nishaan ke soorat mein) use maaf kar diya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person while walking along the path saw the branches of a tree lying there. He said: By Allah, I shall remove these from this so that these may not do harm to the Muslims, and he was admitted to Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs raaste par chalte hue wahan padi darakht ki shaakhaon ko dekha. Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main inhe yahan se hataaunga taaki ye Musalmaanon ko koi nuksaan na pahunchaayein, aur use Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that he saw a person enjoying himself in Paradise because of the tree that he cut from the path which was a source of inconvenience to the people.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki unhone ek shakhs ko Jannat mein khush hote dekha us darakht ki wajah se jise usne raaste se kaata tha jo logon ke liye takleef ka srot tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that there was a tree which caused inconvenience to the Muslims; a person came there and cut that (tree) (and thus entered ) Paradise).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki ek darakht tha jo Musalmaanon ko takleef pahunchaata tha; ek shakhs wahan aaya aur usne ise kaata (aur is tarah woh Jannat mein daakhil hua).

e: Abu Barza reported: I said: Allah's Messenger, teach me something so that I may derive benefit from it. He said: Remove the troublesome thing from the paths of the Muslims.
hi: Abu Barza (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe kuch aisa sikhaiye jisse main faayda uThA sakoon. Unhone farmaaya: Musalmaanon ke raaston se takleef dene wali cheezein hataao.

e: Abu Barza reported that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Allah's Messenger, I do not know whether I would survive after you, so confer upon me something by which Allah should benefit me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do this and that and remove the troublesome things from the paths.
hi: Abu Barza (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe nahi pata ki main aapke baad zinda rahunga ya nahi, is liye mujhe kuch aisa ata kijiye jisse Allah mujhe faayda pahunchaaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye aur woh karo aur raaston se takleef dene wali cheezein hataao.

e: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A woman was tormented because of a cat which she had confined until it died and she had to get into Hell. She did not allow it either to eat or drink as it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gayi jise usne band kar rakha tha yahan tak ki woh mar gayi aur usse Jahannam mein daakhil hona pada. Usne use na khaana khaane diya na paani, kyunki woh band thi, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

e: The above hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters with the same meaning
hi: Upar wali hadees isi matlab ke saath ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters. And Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman was tormented because of a cat which she had tied and thus allowed it neither to eat or drink nor set it free so that it might eat the vermin of the earth.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Aur Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gayi jise usne baandh rakha tha aur is tarah use na khaane diya na paani, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) A hadith out of which one was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A woman got into Hell-Fire because of a cat whom she had tied, and thus it could not eat, and she did not let it free so that it could devour the vermin of the earth, until it died.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat ki jismein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek aurat Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil hui ek billi ki wajah se jise usne baandh rakha tha, aur is tarah woh khaa nahi sakti thi, aur usne use azaad nahi kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake, yahan tak ki woh mar gayi.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri and Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: Glory is His lower garment and Majesty is His cloak and (Allah says, ) He who contends with Me in regard to them I shall torment him.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri aur Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Azmat Meri chaadar hai aur Buzurgi Mera kambal hai aur (Allah farmaate hain,) jo in donon ke baare mein Mujhse jhagda karega, Main use saza dunga.

e: Jundub reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stated that a person said: Allah would not forgive such and such (person). Thereupon Allah the Exalted and Glorious, said: Who is he who adjures about Me that I would not grant pardon to so and so; I have granted pardon to so and so and blotted out his deeds (who took an oath that I would not grant pardon to him).
hi: Jundub (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah falan-falan (shakhs) ko kabhi maaf nahi karega. Isper Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Kaun hai jo Mere baare mein qasam khaata hai ki Main falan-falan ko maaf nahi karunga; Maine falan-falan ko maaf kar diya hai aur (us shakhs ke, jisne qasam khayi thi ki Main use maaf nahi karunga) uske amal mita diye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: Many a person with disheveled hair and covered with dust is turned away from the doors (whereas he is held in such a high esteem by Allah) that if he were to adjure in the name of Allah (about anything) Allah would fulfil that.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Bahut se aise log jinke baal uljhe hain aur jo mitti se dhake hain unhe darwazon se bhaga diya jaata hai (jabki Allah ki nazar mein unka darja itna uchcha hai) ki agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam khaayein (kisi cheez ke baare mein), to Allah use poora karega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a person says that people are ruined he is himself ruined. Abu Ishaq said: I do not know whether he said" ahlakahum or ahlakuhum.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab koi shakhs kehta hai ki log barbaad ho gaye, to woh khud barbaad ho jaata hai. Abu Ishaq ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone "Ahlakahum" kaha ya "Ahlakuhum".

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gabriel impressed upon me (kind treatment) towards the neighbour (so much) that I thought as if he would confer upon him the (right) of inheritance.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jibril ne mujhpar padosi (ke saath achhe sulook) ki taakeed itni baar ki ki maine socha ki shaayad woh use virasat mein hissa bhi de denge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gabriel impressed upon me (the kind treatment) towards the neighbour (so much) that I thought as if he would soon confer upon him the (right) of inheritance.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jibril ne mujhpar padosi (ke saath achhe sulook) ki taakeed itni baar ki ki maine socha ki jald hi woh use virasat mein hissa de denge.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Abu Dharr, when you prepare the broth, add water to that and give that (as a present) to your neighbour.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Abu Dharr, jab tum shorba banaao, ismein paani milaao aur ise (tohfe ke soorat mein) apne padosi ko do.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded me thus: Whenever you prepare a broth, add water to it, and have in your mind the members of the household of your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye hukum diya: Jab bhi tum shorba banaao, ismein paani milaao, aur apne padosiyon ke ghar-waalon ka khyaal rakho aur phir unhe adab ke saath ismein se do.

e: Abu Dharr reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to me: Don't consider anything insignificant out of good things even if it is that you meet your brother with a cheerful countenance.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaaya: Achhaai ki kisi cheez ko chhota mat samjho, chahe ye sirf itna ho ki tum apne bhai se khush chehre ke saath milo.

e: Abu Musa reported that when any needy (person) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a need he commanded him to his Companions, saying: Make a recommendation for him, and you would get the reward. Allah, however, gives the verdict through the tongue of His Apostle what He likes most.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi koi zaroorat-mand shakhs kisi zaroorat ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aata, woh apne Sahaba se farmaate: Uski sifaarish karo aur tumhe sawaab milega. Allah, halaanki, Apne Rasool ki zubaan se woh faisla deta hai jo Use sabse zyada pasand hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of good company and that of bad company is that of the owner of musk and of the one (iron-smith) blowing bellows, and the owner of musk would either offer you free of charge or you would buy it from him or you would. smell its pleasant odour, and so far as one who blows the. bellows is concerned, he would either burn your clothes or you shall have to smell its repugnant smell.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Achhi sohbat aur buri sohbat ki misaal mushk waale (attar) aur bhaTThi phookne waale (lohaar) ki misaal jaisi hai, aur mushk waala tumhe (ya to) muft mein dega ya tum use usse khareedoge ya tum iski khushboo mehsoos karoge, aur jahan tak bhaTThi phookne waale ka sawaal hai, woh ya to tumhaare kapde jala dega ya tumhe iski badbudaar khushboo mehsoos karni padegi.

e: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: A woman came to me along with her two daughters. She asked me for (charity) but she found nothing with me except one date, so I gave her that. She accepted it and then divided it between her two daughters and herself ate nothing out of that. She then got up and went out, and so did her two daughters. (In the meanwhile) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me and I narrated to him her story. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who is involved (in the responsibility) of (bringing up) daughters, and he accords benevolent treatment towards them, there would be protection for him against Hell-Fire.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Ek aurat apni do betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi. Usne mujhse (sadaqe ki) maang ki lekin usne mere paas kuch nahi paaya siwaay ek khajoor ke, is liye maine use woh de di. Usne ise qubool kiya aur phir ise apni donon betiyon mein baant diya aur khud isme se kuch nahi khaya. Woh phir uThi aur bahar chali gayi, aur uski donon betiyaan bhi. (Isi beech), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye aur maine unhe uska kissa sunaaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo (betiyon ki parvaarish ki) zimmedaari nibhaata hai, aur unke saath meherbaani ka vyavahaar karta hai, uske liye Jahannam ki aag se hifaazat hogi.

e: 'A'isha reported: A poor woman came to me along with her daughters. I gave her three dates. She gave a date to each of them and then she took up one date and brought that to her mouth in order to eat that, but her daughters expressed desire to eat it. She then divided the date that she intended to eat between them. This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that which she did to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon he said: Verily Allah has assured Paradise for her, because of (this act) of her, or He has rescued her from Hell-Fire.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek gareeb aurat apni betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi. Maine use teen khajooren din. Usne har ek ko ek khajoor di aur phir ek khajoor uThAyi aur ise apne munh mein le jaane hi wali thi ki uski betiyon ne use khaane ki khwaish jataayi. Usne phir woh khajoor jise woh khud khaana chaahti thi unmein baant di. Uska ye (meherbaan) vyavahaar mujhpar gehra asar chhod gaya aur maine jo usne kiya woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr kiya. Isper unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne is (amal) ki wajah se uske liye Jannat ka vaada kiya hai, ya Usne use Jahannam ki aag se bacha liya hai.

e: Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He, who brought up two girls properly till they grew up, he and I would come (together) (very closely) on the Day of Resurrection, and he interlaced his fingers (for explaining the point of nearness between him and that person).
hi: Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo do larkiyon ko unke bade hone tak achhi tarah paalega, woh aur main Qayamat ke din ek saath (bahut qareeb) aayenge, aur unhone (nazdeeki ka spashteekaran karte hue) apni ungliyaan aapas mein jodi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Anyone amongst the Muslims, three of whose children die, and he resigns himself calmly to the will of God, Fire will not touch him but for the fulfilment of the oath.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Musalmaanon mein se koi bhi shakhs, jiske teen bachche mar jaayein, aur woh sabar ke saath Allah ki marzi ko qubool kare, Jahannam ki aag use nahi chhuegi siwaay iske ki qasam poori honi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported by Zuhri on the authority of Malik, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Sufyan (the words are): " He would enter into Fire, except for the fulfilment of the oath."
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne Malik ki sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur Sufyan ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Woh Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil hoga, siwaay iske ki qasam poori honi hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a woman of the Ansar: In case anyone amongst you sees the sad demise of three children of (hers) and she resigns herself to the will of God hoping to get reward, she would be admitted to Paradise. A woman from amongst them said: Allah's Messenger, even if they (the children who die) are two. Thereupon, he (the Holy Prophet, ) said: Even if they are two.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ki ek aurat se farmaaya: Agar tum mein se koi apne teen bachchon ki dukhad maut dekhti hai aur woh sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue Allah ki marzi ko qubool karti hai, use Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega. Unmein se ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar woh (mare hue bachche) do hon? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Chahe woh do hon.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, men receive your instructions; kindly allocate at your convenience a day for us also, on which we would come to you and you would teach us what Allah has taught you. He said: You assemble on such and such a day. They assembled and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and taught them what Allah had taught him and he then said: No woman amongst you who sends her three children as her forerunners (in the Hereafter) but they would serve him as a protection against Hell-Fire. A woman said: What about two and two and two? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Even if they are two and two and two.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mard aapki taalimaat paate hain; meherbaani karke apni suvidha ke mutabik humaare liye bhi ek din muqarrar kijiye, jismein hum aapke paas aayenge aur aap humein woh sikhaayenge jo Allah ne aapko sikhaaya hai. Unhone farmaaya: Tum aisi-aisi din ikattha ho jaao. Woh ikattha huin aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur unhe woh sikhaaya jo Allah ne unhe sikhaaya tha aur phir unhone farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aurat jo apne teen bachchon ko (Aakhirat mein) apne agrasar ke soorat mein bhejti hai, unse Jahannam ki aag ke khilaaf ek hifaazat kavach ki tarah kaam lega. Ek aurat ne kaha: Do bachchon ka kya? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Chahe woh do hon.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Three (children) who die in childhood.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Teen (bachche) jo bachpan mein mar jaate hain.

e: Abu Hassan reported: I said to Abu Huraira that my two children had died. Would you narrate to me anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith which would soothe our hearts in our bereavements? He said: Yes. Small children are the fowls of Paradise. If one of them meets his father (or he said his parents) he would take hold of his cloth, or he said with his hand as I take hold of the hem of your cloth (with my hand). And he (the child) would not take off (his hand) from it until Allah causes his father to enter Paradise. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Tamim with the same chain of transmitters. And he is reported to have said: Did you hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) anything which may soothe our heart in our bereavements? He said: Yes.
hi: Abu Hassan ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) se kaha ki mere do bachchon ka intiqaal ho gaya hai. Kya aap mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi aisi hadees riwayat karenge jo humaare gam mein humaare dilon ko sukoon de? Unhone kaha: Haan. Chhote bachche Jannat ke parinde hain. Agar unmein se koi apne waalid se milta hai (ya unhone kaha unke maa-baap se), woh unka kapda pakDta hai, ya unhone kaha apne haath se, jaise main tumhaare kapde ka kinaara apne haath se pakDta hoon. Aur woh (bachcha) ise tab tak nahi chhodega jab tak Allah uske waalid ko Jannat mein daakhil na kare. Ye hadees Tamim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Aur unhone kaha ki unhone poocha: Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch suna jo humaare gam mein humaare dilon ko sukoon de? Unhone kaha: Haan.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with her child and said: Allah's Apostle, invoke Allah's blessing upon him for I have already buried three. He said: You have buried three! She said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You have, indeed, safeguarded yourself against the torment of Hell with a strong safeguard. 'Umar has made a mention of his father, whereas others have not made a mention of his father.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat apne bachche ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske liye Allah se barkat maangiye kyunki maine pehle hi teen (bachchon) ko dafn kiya hai. Unhone farmaaya: Tumne teen ko dafn kiya! Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne waastav mein khud ko Jahannam ke azaab se ek mazboot hifaazat kavach ke saath bacha liya hai. Umar ne apne waalid ka zikr kiya, jabki doosron ne unke waalid ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with her child and said: Allah's Messenger, he is ailing, and I am afraid (that he may die), as I have already buried three. Thereupon he said: It (their sad demise) would be a protection against Hell-Fire for you. Zuhair has not mentioned the kunya of Abu Ghiyath; he has mentioned his name.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat apne bachche ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye bimaar hai, aur mujhe dar hai (ki ye mar sakta hai), kyunki maine pehle hi teen (bachchon) ko dafn kiya hai. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye (unki dukhad maut) tumhaare liye Jahannam ki aag ke khilaaf hifaazat hogi. Zuhair ne Abu Ghiyath ki Kunya ka koi zikr nahi kiya; unhone unka naam zikr kiya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel and says: Verily, I so and so; you should also love him, and then Gabriel begins to love him. Then he makes an announcement in the heaven saying: Allah loves so and so and you also love him, and then the inhabitants of the Heaven (the Angels) also begin to love him and then there is conferred honour upon him in the earth; and when Allah is angry with any servant He calls Gabriel and says: I am angry with such and such and you also become angry with him, and then Gabriel also becomes angry and then makes an announcement amongst the inhabitants of heaven: Verily Allah is angry with so-and so, so you also become angry with him, and thus they also become angry with him. Then he becomes the object of wrath on the earth also.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Allah kisi banda se muhabbat karta hai, Woh Jibril ko bulaata hai aur farmaata hai: Yaqeenan, Mujhe falan-falan se muhabbat hai; tum bhi usse muhabbat karo, aur phir Jibril bhi usse muhabbat karne lagte hain. Phir woh aasmaan mein ailaan karte hain ye kehte hue: Allah ko falan-falan se muhabbat hai aur tum bhi usse muhabbat karo, aur phir aasmaan ke bashinda (Farishte) bhi usse muhabbat karne lagte hain aur phir uski izzat zameen mein bhi ki jaati hai; aur jab Allah kisi banda se naaraaz hota hai Woh Jibril ko bulaata hai aur farmaata hai: Main falan-falan se naaraaz hoon aur tum bhi usse naaraaz ho, aur phir Jibril bhi naaraaz hote hain aur phir aasmaan ke bashindon mein ailaan karte hain: Yaqeenan, Allah falan-falan se naaraaz hai, is liye tum bhi usse naaraaz ho, aur is tarah woh bhi usse naaraaz ho jaate hain. Phir woh zameen mein bhi gusse ka nishaana banta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Ali' b. Musayyib, there is no mention of (the word)" Anger".
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is antar ke ki Ali bin Musayyib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "Gussa" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Suhail b. Abi Salih, reported: We were in Arafa that there happened to pass Umar b. Abd al-'Aziz and he was the Amir of Hajj. People stood up in order to catch a glimpse of him. I said to my father: Father, I think that Allah loves Umar b. Abd al- 'Aziz. He said: How is it? I said: It is because of the love in people's heart for him. Thereupon he said: By One Who created your father, I heard Abu Huraira narrating from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like one transmitted on the authority of Suhail.
hi: Suhail bin Abi Salih ne bayan kiya: Hum Arafa mein the ki Umar bin Abd al-Aziz wahan se guzre aur woh us waqt Hajj ke Amir the. Log unhe dekhne ke liye khade huye. Maine apne waalid se kaha: Waalid, mujhe lagta hai Allah Umar bin Abd al-Aziz se muhabbat karta hai. Unhone kaha: Ye kaise? Maine kaha: Ye logon ke dilon mein unke prati (jo) muhabbat hai uski wajah se hai. Isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jisne tumhaare waalid ko banaaya, maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat karte suna jo Suhail ki riwayat ki hui hadees jaisi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Saying: Souls are troops collected together and those who familiarised with each other (in the heaven from where these come) would have affinity, with one another (in the world) and those amongst them who opposed each other (in the Heaven) would also be divergent (in the world).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Roohein ikatthi ki gayi fauj jaisi hain aur jo ek-doosre se (Aasmaan mein, jahan se ye aati hain) jaan-pehchaan rakhti hain, unmein (is duniya mein) aapsi lagaav hoga, aur unmein se jinhone ek-doosre ka virodh kiya (Aasmaan mein) woh bhi (is duniya mein) alag-thalag rahenge.

e: Abu Huraira narrated directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: People are like mines of gold and silver; those who were excellent in Jahiliya (during the days of ignorance) are excellent In Islam, when they have, an understanding, and the souls are troops collected together and those who had a mutual familiarity amongst themselves in the store of prenatal existence would have affinity amongst them, (in this world also) and those who opposed one of them, would be at variance with one another.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Log sone aur chandi ki khaanon jaise hain; jo Jaahiliyat ke daur mein behtareen the woh Islam mein bhi behtareen hain, jab unhe (deen ki) samajh ho, aur roohein ikatthi ki gayi fauj jaisi hain aur jinke beech Aasmaan mein, janam se pehle ki haalat mein, aapsi jaan-pehchaan thi, unmein aapsi lagaav hoga, (is duniya mein bhi), aur jinhone unmein se kisi ek ka virodh kiya, woh ek-doosre se alag-thalag rahenge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a desert Arab said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What preparation have you made for that? Thereupon he said: The love of Allah and of His Messenger (that is my preparation for the Last Hour) (for the Day of Resurrection). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek registaan ke Arab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Isper usne kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat (yehi meri Qayamat ke din ki taiyaari hai). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho.

e: Anas reported that a person said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? He (the Holy Prophet) said: What preparation have you made for that? And he gave no details, but said: I love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love. Anas b. Malik reported through another chain of transmitters that a desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him), the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that he said: I have not made much preparations which merit appreciation for myself.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Aur usne koi tafseel nahi di, balki kaha: Mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Anas bin Malik ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye ye riwayat ki ki ek registaan ka Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki usne kaha: Maine apne liye koi khaas taiyaari nahi ki jiski sarahna ki jaaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to Allah's Messenger: When would be the Last Hour? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: What preparation have you made for the Last Hour? He said: The love of Allah and of His Messenger (is my only preparation). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love. Anas said: Nothing pleased us more after accepting Islam than the words of Allah's Apostle: You would be along with one whom you love. And Anas said. I love Allah and His Messenger and Abu Bakr and Umar, and I hope that I would be along with them although I have not acted like them.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne Qayamat ke liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Usne kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat (meri iklauti taiyaari hai). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Anas ne kaha: Islam qubool karne ke baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke in alfaazon se zyada humein kuch pasand nahi aaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Aur Anas ne kaha: Mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar se muhabbat hai, aur mujhe ummeed hai ki main unke saath rahunga chahe maine unke jaisa amal na kiya ho.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) this hadith through another chain of transmitters but he did not make mention of the words of Anas: I love, and what follows subsequently.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki lekin unhone Anas ke ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: "Mujhe muhabbat hai," aur uske baad ki baaton ka bhi koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I were coming out of the mosque that we met a person on the threshold of the mosque and he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What preparation have you made for that? The man became silent and then said: Allah's Messenger, I have made no significant preparation with prayer and fasting and charity but I, however, love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur main masjid se bahar aa rahe the ki humaari mulaqaat masjid ki dahleez par ek shakhs se hui aur usne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Woh shakhs khamosh ho gaya aur phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine namaz, roze aur sadaqe ke saath koi khaas taiyaari nahi ki hai, lekin mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas with different chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is your opinion about the person who loves the people but his (acts or deeds are not identical to theirs)? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person would be along with one whom he loves.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo logon se muhabbat karta hai lekin uske (amal ya kaam unke jaise) nahi hain? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Shakhs unhi ke saath hoga jinse woh muhabbat karta hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa, reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported: It was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is your opinion about the person who has done good deeds and the people praise him? He said: It is glad tidings for a believer (which he has received in this mortal world).
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jisne nekokaar amal kiye hain aur log uski tareef karte hain? Unhone farmaaya: Ye ek momin ke liye khushkhabri hai (jo usne is faani duniya mein paayi hai).

e: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also and the one transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are): " People love him." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Abd-us-Samad (the words are):" People praise him as stated by Hammad."
hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Log usse muhabbat karte hain." Abd-us-Samad ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Log uski tareef karte hain jaisa Hammad ne kaha."

e: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is the most truthful (of the human beings) and his being truthful (is a fact) said: Verily your creation is on this wise. The constituents of one of you are collected for forty days in his mother's womb in the form of blood, after which it becomes a clot of blood in another period of forty days. Then it becomes a lump of flesh and forty days later Allah sends His angel to it with instructions concerning four things, so the angel writes down his livelihood, his death, his deeds, his fortune and misfortune. By Him, besides Whom there is no god, that one amongst you acts like the people deserving Paradise until between him and Paradise there remains but the distance of a cubit, when suddenly the writing of destiny overcomes him and he begins to act like the denizens of Hell and thus enters Hell, and another one acts in the way of the denizens of Hell, until there remains between him and Hell a distance of a cubit that the writing of destiny overcomes him and then he begins to act like the people of Paradise and enters Paradise.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jo (insaanon mein) sabse sachche hain aur jinka sachcha hona ek Haqeeqat hai, ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan tumhaari paidaayish is tarah hoti hai. Tum mein se har ek ki khilqat chaalis din tak uski maa ke pet mein khoon ke soorat mein ikattha rehti hai, iske baad ye chaalis din ki ek aur muddat mein khoon ka Thakka ban jaati hai. Phir ye gosht ka Lotha ban jaati hai aur chaalis din baad Allah is (Lothe) ke paas Apna Farishta bheja hai chaar baaton ka hukum lekar, is liye Farishta uski rozi, uski maut, uske amal aur uski khushnaseebi aur badnaseebi darj karta hai. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, tum mein se koi Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta rehta hai yahan tak ki uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek gaz ki doori bacha rehti hai, ki achaanak (uski) takdeer ki likhaai use pakad leti hai aur woh Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karne lagta hai aur Jahannam mein daakhil ho jaata hai, aur doosra shakhs Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta rehta hai, yahan tak ki uske aur Jahannam ke beech sirf ek gaz ki doori bacha rehti hai ki takdeer ki likhaai use pakad leti hai aur phir woh Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karne lagta hai aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Waki' (the words are): " The creation of any one of you is like this that (semen) is collected in the womb of the mother for forty nights," and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are):" Forty nights and forty days." And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Jarir and 'Isa (the words are):" Forty days."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Waki ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Tum mein se har ek ki khilqat is tarah hoti hai ki (nutfa) chaalis raaton tak maa ke pet mein ikattha rehta hai," aur Shu'ba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Chaalis raat aur chaalis din." Aur Jarir aur Isa ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Chaalis din."

e: Hudhaifa b. Usaid reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: When the drop of (semen) remains in the womb for forty or forty five nights, the angel comes and says: My Lord, will he be good or evil? And both these things would be written. Then the angel says: My Lord, would he be male or female? And both these things are written. And his deeds and actions, his death, his livelihood; these are also recorded. Then his document of destiny is rolled and there is no addition to nor subtraction from it.
hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Jab (nutfe) ki boond maa ke pet mein chaalis ya paintaalis raaton tak rehti hai, Farishta aata hai aur kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye achha hoga ya bura? Aur donon baaten likh di jaati hain. Phir Farishta kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon? Aur ye donon bhi likh di jaati hain. Aur uske amal aur kaam, uski maut, uski rozi; ye bhi darj kiye jaate hain. Phir uska takdeer ka dastaavez lapeta jaata hai aur ismein na koi izafa hota hai na koi kami.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: Evil one is he who is evil in the womb of his mother and the good one is he who takes a lesson from the (fate of) others. The narrator came to a person from amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was called Hudhaifa b. Usaid Ghifari and said: How can a person be an evil one without (committing an evil) deed? Thereupon the person said to him: You are surprised at this, whereas I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When forty-two nights pass after the semen gets into the womb, Allah sends the angel and gives him shape. Then he creates his sense of hearing, sense of sight, his skin, his flesh, his bones, and then says: My Lord, would he be male or female? And your Lord decides as He desires and the angel then puts down that also and then says: My Lord, what about his age? And your Lord decides as He likes it and the angel puts it down. Then he says: My Lord, what about his livelihood? And then the Lord decides as He likes and the angel writes it down, and then the angel gets out with his scroll of destiny in his hand and nothing is added to it and nothing is subtracted from it.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya: Bura woh hai jo apni maa ke pet mein hi bura ho, aur achha woh hai jo doosron ke (anjaam se) sabak leta hai. Raawi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek sahabi ke paas aaya jinhe Hudhaifa bin Usaid Ghifari kaha jaata tha, aur kaha: Koi shakhs bina koi bura amal kiye bura kaise ho sakta hai? Isper us shakhs ne unse kaha: Tumhe isper hairat hota hai, jabki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab nutfe ke pet mein pahunchne ke baad bayaalis raaten guzarti hain, Allah Farishta bhejta hai aur use aakaar deta hai. Phir Woh uski sunne ki taaqat, dekhne ki taaqat, uski khaal, uska gosht, uski haddiyaan banaata hai, aur phir farmaata hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon? Aur tumhaara Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise bhi likh deta hai aur phir kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski umar ke baare mein kya? Aur tumhaara Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise likh deta hai. Phir woh kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski rozi ke baare mein kya? Aur phir Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise likh deta hai, aur phir Farishta apna takdeer ka dastaavez haath mein liye bahar aata hai aur ismein na kuch jodta hai na ghatAta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Tufail reported: I visited Abu Sariha Hudhaifa b. Usaid al-Ghifari who said: I listened with these two ears of mine Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The semen stays in the womb for forty nights, then the angel, gives it a shape. Zubair said: I think that he said: One who fashions that and decides whether he would be male or female. Then he (the angel) says: Would his limbs be full or imperfect? And then the Lord makes thein full and perfect or otherwise as He desires. Then he says: My Lord, what about his livelihood, and his death and what about his disposition? And then the Lord decides about his misfortune and fortune.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Sariha Hudhaifa bin Usaid al-Ghifari se milne gaya jinhone kaha: Maine apne in do kaanon se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Nutfa maa ke pet mein chaalis raaton tak rehta hai, phir Farishta ise aakaar deta hai. Zubair ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (Nabi ne) farmaaya: Woh (Farishta) ise Dhaalta hai aur faisla karta hai ki ye mard hoga ya striyon. Phir woh kehta hai: Kya iske ang poore honge ya adhoore? Aur phir Rab jaisa chaahta hai unhe poora aur mukammal banaata hai ya nahi. Phir woh kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski rozi, aur iski maut aur iske mizaj ke baare mein kya? Aur phir Rab iski badnaseebi aur khushnaseebi ke baare mein faisla karta hai.

e: Hadhaifa b. Usaid Ghifari, a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported it directly from Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him). as he said: There is an angel who looks after the womb when Allah decides to create any- thing after more than forty nights are over; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid Ghifari, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek sahabi, ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Ek Farishta hai jo pet ki dekhbhaal karta hai jab Allah chaalis raaton se zyada ke baad kuch banaane ka faisla karta hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Allah, the Exlated and Glorious, has appointed an angel as the caretaker of the womb, and he would say: My Lord, it is now a drop of semen; my Lord, It is now a clot of blood; my Lord, it has now become a lump of flesh, and when Allah decides to give it a final shape, the angel says: My Lord, would it be male or female or would he be an evil or a good person? What about his livelihood and his age? And it is all written as he is in the womb of his mother.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ek Farishta ko pet ka nigehbaan muqarrar kiya hai, aur woh kahega: Mere Rab, ye ab nutfe ki boond hai; mere Rab, ye ab khoon ka Thakka hai; mere Rab, ye ab gosht ka Lotha ban chuka hai, aur jab Allah ise aakhri aakaar dene ka faisla karta hai, Farishta kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon, ya ye achha hoga ya bura? Iski rozi aur iski umar ke baare mein kya? Aur ye sab kuch likh diya jaata hai jab ye apni maa ke pet mein hi hota hai.

e: Ali reported: We were in a funeral in the graveyard of Gharqad when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we sat around him. He had a stick with him. He lowered his head and began to scratch the earth with his stick, and then said: There is not one amongst you whom a seat in Paradise or Hell has not been allotted and about whom it has not been written down whether he would be an evil person or a blessed person. A person said: Allah's Messenger, should we not then depend upon our destiny and abandon our deeds? Thereupon he said: Acts of everyone will be facilitated in that which has been created for him so that whoever belongs to the company of the blessed will have good works made easier for him and whoever belongs to the unfortunate ones will have evil acts made easier for him. He then recited this verse (from the Qur'an): "Then, who gives to the needy and guards against evil and accepts the excellent (the truth of Islam and the path of righteousness it prescribes), We shall make easy for him the easy end and who is miserly and considers himself above need, We shall make easy for him the difficult end" (xcii. 5-10).
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Hum Gharqad ke qabristan mein ek janaaze mein the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye aur hum unke aas-paas baith gaye. Unke paas ek lakdi thi. Unhone apna sar jhukaaya aur apni lakdi se zameen khodne lage aur phir farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein koi jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho aur jiske baare mein ye na likha gaya ho ki woh bura hoga ya achha. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein phir apni takdeer par bharosa karke apne amal chhod nahi dene chahiye? Isper unhone farmaaya: Har shakhs ke amal usmein aasaan kar diye jaayenge jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai, is liye jo khushnaseebi ke giroh se mutaliq hoga uske liye achhe amal aasaan kar diye jaayenge, aur jo badnaseeb logon se mutaliq hoga uske liye bure amal aasaan kar diye jaayenge. Phir unhone ye Qurani aayat padhi: "Is liye jo zaroorat-mand ko deta hai aur burai se bachne ki koshish karta hai aur behtareen (Islam ke sach aur uske batAye hue nekokaari ke raaste) ko qubool karta hai, Hum uske liye aasaan raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge, aur jo kanjoos hai aur khud ko zaroorat se upar samajhta hai, Hum uske liye mushkil raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge" (92:5-10).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Ali reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting with a wood in his hand and he was scratching the ground. He raised his head and said: There is not one amongst you who has not been allotted his seat in Paradise or Hell. They said: Allah's Messenger. then, why should we perform good deeds, why not depend upon our destiny? Thereupon he said. No, do perform good deeds, for everyone is facilitated in that for which he has been created; then he recited this verse:" Then, who gives to the needy and guards against evil and accepts the excellent (the truth of Islam and the path of righteousness it prescribes), We shall make easy for him the easy end..." (xcii. 5-10).
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) haath mein lakdi liye baithe the aur zameen khod rahe the. Unhone apna sar uThAya aur farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein uski jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir humein nekokaar amal kyun karne chahiye, apni takdeer par bharosa kyun na karein? Isper unhone farmaaya: Nahi, nekokaar amal karo, kyunki har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai; phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Is liye jo zaroorat-mand ko deta hai aur burai se bachne ki koshish karta hai aur behtareen ko qubool karta hai, Hum uske liye aasaan raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge..." (92:5-10).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported that Suriqa b. Malik b. Ju'shuin came and said: Allah's Messenger, explain our religion to us (in a way) as if we have been created just now. Whosoever deeds we do today, is it because of the fact that-the pens have dried (after recording them) and the destitiles have began to operate or these have effects in future? Thereupon he said: The pens have dried tmd destinies have begun to operate. (Suraqa b. Malik) said: If it Is so, then what is the use of doing good deeds? Zuhair said: Then Abu Zubair said something but I could not understand that and I said. What did he say? Thereupon he said: Act, for everyone is facilitated what he intends to do.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein humaara deen samjhaiye jaise humein abhi paida kiya gaya ho. Aaj hum jo bhi amal karte hain, kya iski wajah ye hai ki (Qalam) sookh chuka hai (unhe darj karne ke baad) aur takdeerein kaam karna shuru kar chuki hain ya inka natija mustaqbil mein hoga? Isper unhone farmaaya: Qalam sookh chuka hai aur takdeerein kaam karna shuru kar chuki hain. (Suraqa bin Malik ne) kaha: Agar aisa hai, to nekokaar amal karne ka kya faayda? Zuhair ne kaha: Phir Abu Zubair ne kuch kaha lekin main samajh nahi paaya aur maine kaha: Unhone kya farmaaya? Isper unhone kaha: Amal karo, kyunki har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jo woh karna chaahta hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah with the same wording (and includes these words): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Every doer of deed is facilitated in his action."
hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se isi alfaazon mein riwayat ki gayi hai (aur ismein ye alfaaz shaamil hain): "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Har amal karne wale ke liye uska amal aasaan kar diya jaata hai."

e: 'Imran b. Husain repotted that it was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Has there been drawn a distinction between the people of Paradise and the denizens of hell? He said: Yes. It was again said: (If it is so), then What is the use of doing good deeds? Thereupon he said: Everyone is facilitated in what has been created for him.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Kya Jannat ke logon aur Jahannam ke logon mein antar kiya gaya hai? Unhone farmaaya: Haan. Dobara poocha gaya: (Agar aisa hai), to phir nekokaar amal karne ka kya faayda? Isper unhone farmaaya: Har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmiters with slight variations of wording.
hi: Ye hadees kuch doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeliyon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu al-Aswad reported that 'Imran b Husain asked him: What is your view, what the people do today in the world, and strive for, is it something decreed for them or preordained for them or will their fate in the Hereafter be deterrained by the fact that their Prophets brought them teaching which they did not act upon? I said: Of course, it is something which is predetermined for them and preordained for them. He (further) said: Then, would it not be an injustice (to punish them)? I felt greatly disturbed because of that, and said: Everything is created by Allah and lies in His Power. He would not be questioned as to what He does, but they would be questioned; thereupon he said to me: May Allah have mercy upon you, I did not mean to ask you but for testing your intelligence. Two men of the tribe of Muzaina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion that the people do in the world and strive for, is something decreed for them; something preordained for them and will their fate in the Hereafter be determined by the fact that their Prophets brought them teachings which they did not act upon. and thus they became deserving of punishment? Thereupon, he said: Of course, it happens as it is decreed by Destiny and preordained for them, and this view is confirmed by this verse of the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" Consider the soul and Him Who made it perfect, then breathed into it its sin and its piety" (xci. 8).
hi: Abu al-Aswad ne bayan kiya ki Imran bin Husain (RA) ne unse poocha: Iske baare mein tumhaari kya raay hai, jo log aaj is duniya mein karte hain aur jiski koshish karte hain, kya ye unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai ya pehle se muqarrar kiya gaya hai, ya Aakhirat mein unki takdeer is baat se tay hogi ki unke Nabiyon ne unhe jo taalim di usper unhone amal kiya ya nahi? Maine kaha: Zaroor, ye kuch aisa hai jo unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai aur pehle se muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Unhone (aage) kaha: Phir kya ye anyaay nahi hoga (unhe saza dena)? Mujhe isse bahut pareshaani hui aur maine kaha: Har cheez Allah ne banaayi hai aur Uski taaqat mein hai. Usse ye nahi poocha jaayega ki Woh kya karta hai, lekin unse zaroor poocha jaayega; isper unhone mujhse kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare, mera iraada tumse poochne ka nahi tha balki tumhaari samajh ki pareeksha lene ka tha. Muzaina qabile ke do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai, jo log is duniya mein karte hain aur jiski koshish karte hain, kya ye unke liye tay kiya gaya hai, unke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai, aur Aakhirat mein unki takdeer is baat se tay hogi ki unke Nabiyon ne unhe jo taalim di usper unhone amal nahi kiya, aur is tarah woh saza ke laayak ho gaye? Isper unhone farmaaya: Zaroor, aisa hota hai jaisa Takdeer ne muqarrar kiya hai aur unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai, aur is nazariye ki pushti Allah ki Kitaab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki is aayat se hoti hai: "Rooh ka aur Us Hasti ka jisne ise mukammal banaaya, phir ismein uski burai aur uska taqwa phoonka" (91:8).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, a man would perform the deeds of the people of Paradise for a long time, then his deeds would be concluded with the deeds of the people of Hell. And verily, a man would perform the deeds of the people of Hell for a long time, and then his deeds would be concluded with the deeds of the people of Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, ek shakhs lambe waqt tak Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta hai, phir uske amal Jahannam ke logon jaise amal ke saath khatm hote hain. Aur yaqeenan, ek shakhs lambe waqt tak Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta hai, aur phir uske amal Jannat ke logon jaise amal ke saath khatm hote hain.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that a person performs deeds like the deeds of the people of Paradise apparently before people and he would be amongst the dwellers of Hell and a person acts apparently like the people of Hell, but (in fact) he would be among the dwellers of Paradise.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki ek shakhs zaahiri taur par logon ke saamne Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta hai lekin (asal mein) woh Jahannam ke bashindon mein se hoga, aur ek shakhs zaahiri taur par Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta hai lekin (asal mein) woh Jannat ke bashindon mein se hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: There was argument between Adam and Moses. Moses said to Adam: You are our father. You did us harm and caused us to get out of Paradise. Adam said to him: You are Moses. Allah selected you (for direct conversation with you) and wrote with His own Hand the Book (Torah) for you. Despite this you blame me for an act which Allah had ordained for me forty years before He created me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:. This is how Adam came the better of Moses and Adam came the better of Moses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui. Musa ne Aadam se kaha: Tum humaare waalid ho. Tumne humein nuksaan pahunchaaya aur humein Jannat se bahar nikalne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne unse kaha: Tum Musa ho. Allah ne tumhe chuna (khud se seedhi baatchit ke liye) aur tumhaare liye Apne khud ke Haath se Kitaab (Torah) likhi. Iske bawajood tum mujhe us amal ke liye dosh dete ho jo Allah ne mere liye chaalis saal pehle muqarrar kiya tha isse pehle ki Woh mujhe paida kare. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade, aur Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was argument between Adam and Moses, and Adam came the better of Moses. Moses said to him: You are the same Adam who misled people, and caused them to get out of Paradise. Adam said: You are the same (Moses) whom Allah endowed the knowledge of everything and selected him amongst the people as His Messenger. He said: Yes. Adam then again said: Even then you blame me for an affair which had been ordained for me before I was created.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui, aur Aadam Musa par bhaari pade. Musa ne unse kaha: Tum wahi Aadam ho jinhone logon ko gumraah kiya aur unhe Jannat se bahar nikaalne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne kaha: Tum wahi (Musa) ho jinhe Allah ne har cheez ka ilm diya aur logon mein se apne Rasool ke soorat mein chuna. Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Haan. Aadam ne phir kaha: Iske bawajood tum mujhe us maamle ke liye dosh dete ho jo mere paida hone se pehle hi muqarrar kiya ja chuka tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was an argument between Adam and Moses (peace be upon both of them) in the presence of their Lord. Adam came the better of Moses. Moses said: Are you that Adam whom Allah created with His Hand and breathed into himHis sprit, and commanded angels to fall in prostration before him and He made you live in Paradise with comfort and ease. Then you caused the people to get down to the earth because of your lapse. Adam said: Are you that Moses whom Allah selected for His Messengership and for His conversation with him and conferred upon you the tablets, in which everything was clearly explained and granted you the audience in order to have confidential talk with you. What is your opinion, how long Torah would haye been written before I was created? Moses said: Forty years before. Adam said: Did you not see these words: Adam committed an error and he was enticed to (do so). He (Moses) said: Yes. Whereupon, he (Adam) said: Do you then blame me for an act which Allah had ordained for me forty years before He created me? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This is how Adam came the better of Moses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa (donon par shaanti ho) ke beech unke Rab ki maujoodgi mein bahas hui. Aadam Musa par bhaari pade. Musa ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Aadam ho jinhe Allah ne Apne Haath se banaaya, aur unmein Apni Rooh phoonki, aur Farishton ko unke saamne sajde mein girne ka hukum diya, aur tumhe Jannat mein aaraam aur suvidha ke saath rehne diya? Phir tum apni galti ki wajah se logon ko zameen par utarne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Musa ho jise Allah ne apni Rasool ke soorat mein chuna, aur khud se baatchit ke liye chuna, aur tumhe woh takhtiyaan din, jinmein har cheez saaf tareeke se samjhaayi gayi thi, aur tumhe khaas guptagoo ke liye apni sohbat di? Tumhaari kya raay hai, Torah mere paida hone se kitne saal pehle likhi gayi hogi? Musa ne kaha: Chaalis saal pehle. Aadam ne kaha: Kya tumne ye alfaaz nahi dekhe: Aadam se galti hui aur woh (aisa karne ke liye) uksaaya gaya? Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Haan. Isper unhone (Aadam ne) kaha: Phir tum mujhe us amal ke liye kyun dosh dete ho jo Allah ne mere paida hone se chaalis saal pehle mere liye muqarrar kiya tha? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was an argument between Adam and Moses. Moses said: Are you that Adam whose lapse caused you to get out of Paradise? Adam said to him: Are you that Moses whom Allah selected for His Messengership, for His conversation and you blame me for an affair which had been ordained for me before I was created? This is how Adam came the better of Moses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui. Musa ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Aadam ho jinki galti ki wajah se tum Jannat se bahar nikale gaye? Aadam ne unse kaha: Kya tum wahi Musa ho jinhe Allah ne apni Rasool ke soorat mein chuna aur khud se baatchit ke liye chuna, aur (iske bawajood) tum mujhe ek aise maamle ke liye dosh dete ho jo mere paida hone se pehle hi muqarrar kiya ja chuka tha? Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

e: Abu Huraira narrated a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah ordained the measures (of quality) of the creation fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, as His Throne was upon water.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne makhlooqaat ke naap-tol (ke tareeke) aasmaan aur zameen banaane se pachaas hazaar saal pehle hi tay kar diye the, jab Uska Arsh paani par tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Hani with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of" His Throne was upon water."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Hani ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Uska Arsh paani par tha."

e: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the hearts of all the sons of Adam are between the two fingers out of the fingers of the Compassionate Lord as one heart. He turns that to any (direction) He likes. Then Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) said: 0 Allah, the Turner of the hearts, turn our hearts to Thine obedience.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Aadam ki sab aulaad ke dil Rehmvaan ki do ungliyon ke beech ek dil jaise hain. Woh use jis taraf chaahte hain moD dete hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, dilon ko Modne waale, humaare dilon ko Apni itaat ki taraf moD de.

e: Tawus reported: I found some Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Everything is by measure. And he further said: I heard Abdullah b. 'Umar as saying: There is a neasure for everything-even for incapacity and-capability.
hi: Tawus ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ko ye kehte paaya: Har cheez ek naap ke mutabik hai. Aur unhone aage kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Har cheez ke liye ek naap hai - yahan tak ki bebasi aur salahiyat ke liye bhi.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the polytheists of the Quraish came to have an argument with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to Destiny and then this verse was revealed: " On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces, taste the touch of Fire. Surely, We have created everything according to a measure" (liv. 48).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quraish ke mushrikeen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Taqdeer ke baare mein bahas karne aaye aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Us din jab unhe unke chehron ke bal Jahannam ki aag mein ghaseeta jaayega, (unse kaha jaayega:) Aag ke chhune ka maza chakho. Yaqeenan, Humne har cheez ko ek andaaze ke mutabik banaaya hai" (54:48).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah has fixed the very portion of adultery which a man will indulge in, and which he of necessity must commit. The adultery of the eye is the lustful look, and the adultery of the tongue is the licentious speech, the heart desires and yearns, which the parts may or may not put into effect.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan Allah ne insaan ke liye zina ka woh hissa muqarrar kiya hai jismein woh mubtala hoga aur jise woh zaroor karega. Aankh ka zina hey nazar dekhna hai, aur zubaan ka zina badchalni bhari baat karna hai; dil chaahta hai aur tarasta hai, jise ang haqiqat mein poora karein ya na karein.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Allah fixed the very portion of adultery which a man will indulge in. There would be no escape from it. The adultery of the eye is the lustful look and the adultery of the ears is listening to voluptuous (song or talk) and the adultery of the tongue is licentious speech and the adultery of the hand is the lustful grip (embrace) and the adultery of the feet is to walk (to the place) where he intends to commit adultery and the heart yearns and desires which he may or may not put into effect.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne insaan ke liye zina ka woh hissa muqarrar kiya hai jismein woh mubtala hoga. Ismein koi bachaav nahi hai. Aankh ka zina hey nazar dekhna hai, aur kaanon ka zina badchalni bhari (geet ya baat) sunna hai, aur zubaan ka zina badchalni bhari baat karna hai, aur haath ka zina hey iraade se pakDna (aalingan) hai aur paon ka zina us jagah chalna hai jahan woh zina karne ka iraada rakhta hai, aur dil tarasta hai aur chaahta hai, jise woh (ang) poora kare ya na kare.

e: There is none born but is created to his true nature (Islam). It is his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Magian quite as beasts produce their young with their limbs perfect. Do you see anything deficient in them? Then he quoted the Qur'an., The nature made by Allah in which He has created men there is no altering of Allah's creation; that is the right religion" (ar-Rum:30)
hi: Koi bhi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin woh apni asli fitrat (Islam) ke saath paida hota hai. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Majoosi banaate hain, bilkul jaisa jaanwar apne bachchon ko mukammal angon ke saath paida karte hain. Kya tumhe unmein koi kami dikhti hai? Phir unhone Quran padha: "Wo fitrat jo Allah ne banaayi, jismein Usne insaanon ko paida kiya; Allah ki banaayi hui fitrat mein koi badlaav nahi hai; yehi seedha deen hai" (Ar-Rum: 30).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and there is no mention of his deficiency in limbs.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein unke angon ki kami ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No child is born but upon Fitra. He then said. Recite: The nature made by Allah in which He created man, there is no altering of Allah's nature; that is the right religion."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin Fitrat par. Phir unhone farmaaya: Padho: "Wo fitrat jo Allah ne banaayi, jismein Usne insaan ko paida kiya, Allah ki fitrat mein koi badlaav nahi hai; yehi seedha deen hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No babe is born but upon Fitra. It is his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Polytheist. A person said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion if they were to die before that (before reaching the age of adolescence when they can distinguish between right and wrong)? He said: It is Allah alone Who knows what they would be doing.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin Fitrat par. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Mushrik banaate hain. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai agar woh (bachche) uske (baalig hone se, jab woh sahi aur galat mein farq kar sakte hain) pehle mar jaayein? Unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

e:
It is reported on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya that (the Holy Prophet) said: Every new-born babe is born on the millat (of Islam and he) remains on this until his tongue is enabled to express himself. 
This hadith has been narratted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" Every child is born but on this Fitra so long as he does not express himself with his tongue."
hi: Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Har naya paida hua bachcha Islam ki (asli) millat par paida hota hai (aur woh) isi par rehta hai jab tak uski zubaan khud ko zaahir karne ke laayak nahi ho jaati. Ye hadees Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Har bachcha Fitrat par paida hota hai jab tak woh apni zubaan se khud ko zaahir nahi karta.

e: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upom him) many ahadith and one amongst them is that he is reported to have said: An infant is born according to his (true) nature. It is his parents Who make him a Jew, a Christian, just as a she-camel gives birth to its young ones. Do you find any deficiency in their limbs? You cut their ears (i. e. after birth). They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: What is your opinion about him who dies in infancy? Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is Allah alone Who knows best what they would be doing.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye thi ki unhone farmaaya: Ek bachcha apni (asli) fitrat ke mutabik paida hota hai. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi banaate hain, jaise ek oontni apne bachchon ko paida karti hai. Kya tumhe unke angon mein koi kami dikhti hai? Tum unke kaan (paidaish ke baad) kaTte ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo bachpan mein hi mar jaata hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The mother of every person gives him birth according to his true nature. It is subsequently his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Magian. Had his parents been Muslim he would have also remained a Muslim. Every person to whom his mother gives birth (has two aspects of his life) ; when his mother gives birth Satan strikes him but it was not the case with Mary and her son (Jesus Christ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Har shakhs ki maa use uski asli fitrat ke mutabik paida karti hai. Baad mein uske maa-baap hi use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Majoosi banaate hain. Agar uske maa-baap Musalman hote, to woh bhi Musalman hi rehta. Har shakhs jise uski maa paida karti hai (uski zindagi ke do pehlu hain); jab uski maa use paida karti hai, Shaitaan use chhuta hai, lekin Mary aur unke bete (Isa) ke saath aisa nahi hua tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of the polytheists, whereupon he said: It is Allah Who knows best what they would be doing.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'aib and Ma'qil with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'aib aur Ma'qil ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allahs Messenger (way peace be upon him) was asked about the children of the polytheists who die young. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is Allah Who knows what they would be doing.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke un bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya jo choti umar mein mar jaate hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of the polytheists, whereupon he said: It is Allah alone Who knows what they would be doing according to their creation.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh apni khilqat ke mutabik kya karte.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The young man whom Khadir killed was a non-believer by his very nature and had he survived he would have involved his parents in defiance and unbelief.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jis jawaan larke ko Khadir ne qatal kiya woh apni fitrat mein hi ek gair-imaandaar tha, aur agar woh zinda rehta, to woh apne maa-baap ko naafarmani aur kufr mein daal deta.

e: 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, reported that a child died and I said: There is happiness for this child who is a bird from amongst the birds of Paradise. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't you know that Allah created the Paradise and He created the Hell and He created the dwellers for this (Paradise) and the denizens for this (Hell)?
hi: Aisha (RA), Imaandaaron ki Maa, ne bayan kiya ki ek bachche ka intiqaal ho gaya aur maine kaha: Is bachche ke liye khushi hai jo Jannat ke parindon mein se ek hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ne Jannat banaayi aur Usne Jahannam banaayi aur Usne is (Jannat) ke liye bashinde banaaye aur is (Jahannam) ke liye bhi bashinde banaaye?

e: 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called to lead the funeral prayer of a child of the Ansar. I said: Allah's Messenger, there is happiness for this child who is a bird from the birds of Paradise for it committed no sin nor has he reached the age when one can commit sin. He said: 'A'isha, per adventure, it may be otherwise, because God created for Paradise those who are fit for it while they were yet in their father's loins and created for Hell those who are to go to Hell. He created them for Hell while they were yet in their father's loins.
hi: Aisha (RA), Imaandaaron ki Maa, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ansar ke ek bachche ki janaaza namaz ki agrasi karne ke liye bulaaya gaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, is bachche ke liye khushi hai jo Jannat ke parindon mein se ek hai kyunki usne koi gunah nahi kiya na hi woh us umar tak pahuncha jahan koi gunah kar sake. Unhone farmaaya: Aisha, shaayad aisa na ho, kyunki Allah ne Jannat ke liye un logon ko banaaya jo iske laayak hain jab woh abhi apne waalid ke sulb (nutfe) mein the, aur Jahannam ke liye unhe banaaya jo Jahannam mein jaayenge. Unhe Jahannam ke liye tab banaaya jab woh abhi apne waalid ke sulb mein the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah reported that Umm Habiba, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: 0 Allah, enable me to derive benefit from my husband, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and from my father Abu Sufyan and from my brother Mu'awiya. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: You have asked from Allah about durations of life already set, and the length of days already allotted and the sustenances the share of which has been fixed. Allah would not do anything earlier before its due time, or He would not delay anything beyond its due time. And if you were to ask Allah to provide you refuge from the torment of the HellFire, or from the torment of the grave, it would have good in store for you and better for you also. He (the narrator) further said: Mention was made before him about monkeys, and Mis'ar (one of the narrators) said: I think that (the narrator) also (made a mention) of the swine, which had suffered metamorphosis. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily, Allah did not cause the race of those which suffered metamorphosis to grow or they were not survived by young ones. Monkeys and swine had been in existence even before (the metamorphosis of the human beings).
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umm Habiba, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe mere pati, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), se, aur mere waalid Abu Sufyan se, aur mere bhai Mu'awiya se faayda uThAne ki taufeek de. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne Allah se pehle se tay ki gayi zindagiyon ki muddaton ke baare mein, aur pehle se muqarrar dinon ki lambaai ke baare mein, aur us rozi ke baare mein maanga jiska hissa pehle se tay ho chuka hai. Allah kuch bhi uske muqarrar waqt se pehle nahi karega, ya Woh kuch bhi uske muqarrar waqt se aage taal ke nahi dega. Aur agar tum Allah se Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se, ya qabar ke azaab se panah maangti, to ye tumhaare liye achha aur behtar hota. Unhone (raawi ne) aage kaha: Unke saamne bandaron ka zikr hua aur Mis'ar (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone khinzeer ka bhi zikr kiya jinka soorat badal diya gaya tha. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne un logon ki nasl ko baDhne nahi diya jinka soorat badla gaya, ya unke koi aulad nahi hui. Bandar aur khinzeer (soorat-badlaav se) pehle bhi maujood the.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mis'ar with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bishr and Waki', the torment of the Hell-Fire and the torment of grave have been mentioned together (and there is no conjunction" iw" or" between them).
hi: Ye hadees Mis'ar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Ibn Bishr aur Waki ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein Jahannam ki aag ka azaab aur qabar ka azaab saath-saath zikr kiya gaya hai (aur unke beech koi "ya" ya "aur" istemal nahi kiya gaya).

e: Ibn Mas'dd reported that Umm Habiba said: 0 Allah, enable me to derive benefit from my husband, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and from my father Abu Sufyan, and from my brother Mu'awiya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her: Verily, you have asked Allah about the durations of life already set, and the steps which you would take, and the sustenances the share of which is fixed. Nothing would take place earlier than its due time, and nothing would be deferred beyond that when it is due.
