So, if you were to ask Allah about your safety from the torment of Hell-Fire and from the torment of the grave, it would have been better for you. A person said: Allah's Messenger, what about those apes and swine which suffered metamorphosis? Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, did not destroy a people or did not torment a people, and let their race grow. Apes and swine had been even before that (when the deniers of truth were tormented and suffered metamorphosis). This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyin through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umm Habiba (RA) ne kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe mere pati, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), aur mere waalid Abu Sufyan, aur mere bhai Mu'awiya se faayda uThAne ki taufeek de. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Yaqeenan, tumne Allah se pehle se tay ki gayi zindagiyon ki muddaton ke baare mein, aur woh kadam jo tum uThAogi, aur rozi jiska hissa pehle se tay ho chuka hai, maanga hai. Kuch bhi uske muqarrar waqt se pehle nahi hoga, aur kuch bhi uske muqarrar waqt se aage taala nahi jaayega. Isliye agar tum Allah se Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se aur qabar ke azaab se apni hifaazat maangti, to ye tumhaare liye behtar hota. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, un bandaron aur khinzeeron ka kya jinka soorat badla gaya? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kisi qaum ko barbaad nahi kiya ya kisi qaum ko saza nahi di jiski nasl aage baDhi ho. Bandar aur khinzeer (us daur se) pehle bhi maujood the (jab sach ko jhoota kehne walon ko saza di gayi aur unka soorat badla gaya). Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: Allah did that what He had ordained to do and your" if" opens the (gate) for the Satan.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek taakatvar momin kamzor momin se behtar aur Allah ki nazar mein zyada aziz hai, aur har ek mein achhaai hai, (lekin) woh cheez sanjoyo jo tumhe (Aakhirat mein) faayda pahunchaaye aur Allah se madad maango aur himmat mat haaro, aur agar koi (museebat ke soorat mein) tumhe pahunchti hai, to ye mat kaho: Agar maine woh na kiya hota, to aisa-aisa na hota, balki kaho: Allah ne woh kiya jo Usne tay kiya tha, aur tumhaara "agar" (Shaitaan ke liye) darwaaza kholta hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited (these verses of the Qur'an): "He it is Who revealed to thee (Muhammad) the Book (the Qur'an) wherein there are clear revelations-these are the substance of the Book and others are allegorical (verses). And as for those who have a yearning for error they go after the allegorical verses seeking (to cause) dissension, by seeking to explain them. And none knows their implications but Allah, and those who are sound in knowledge say: We affirm our faith in everything which is from our Lord. It is only the persons of understanding who really heed" (Al-Qur'an 3:7). 'A'isha (further) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (in connection with these verses): When you see such verses, avoid them, for it is they whom Allah has pointed out (in the mentioned verses).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Quran ki) ye aayaten padhi: "Wahi hai Jisne aap (Muhammad) par Kitaab (Quran) nazil ki jismein saaf-saaf aayaten hain - ye Kitaab ka jauhar hain - aur doosri (aayaten) mutashaabihaat (ashaayan matlab wali) hain. Aur jinke dilon mein Kaji hai woh unmein se in mutashaabihaat aayaton ka picha karte hain fitna phailaane ke iraade se, unki vyaakhya dhoondte hue. Aur inka matlab sirf Allah jaanta hai, aur jo ilm mein pukhta hain woh kehte hain: Hum har cheez par imaan laate hain jo humaare Rab ki taraf se hai. Sirf aqlmand log hi asal mein iski qadar karte hain" (3:7). Aisha ne aage riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (in aayaton ke silsile mein) farmaaya: Jab tum aise (mutashaabihaat) aayaten dekho, unse bacho, kyunki ye wahi log hain jinki taraf Allah ne (upar batayi gayi aayaton mein) ishara kiya hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the morning and he heard the voice of two persons who had an argumentation with each other about a verse. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to us (and) the (signs) of anger could be seen on his face. He said: Verily, the (peoples) before you were ruined because of their disputation in the Book.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhone do logon ki aawaaz suni jo Quran ki ek aayat ke baare mein aapas mein bahas kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye (aur) unke chehre par gusse ke nishaan the. Unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, tumse pehle ke log Kitaab ke baare mein aapas mein jhagdne ki wajah se barbaad huye.

e: Jundub b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Recite the Qur'an as long as your hearts agree to do so, and when you feel variance between them (between your hearts and tongues), then get up (and leave its recital for the time being).
hi: Jundub bin Abdullah al-Bajali (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Quran padho jab tak tumhaare dil (padhne se) sehmat hain, aur jab tum unmein (tumhaare dilon aur zubaanon mein) farq mehsoos karo, to (kuch der ke liye padhna) chhod do.

e: Jundub (i. e. Ibn 'Abdullah) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Recite the Qur'an as long as your hearts agree to do so and when you find variance between them, then stand up.
hi: Jundub (Ibn Abdullah) (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Quran padho jab tak tumhaare dil sehmat hain, aur jab tum unmein farq paao, to ruk jao.

e: Abu Imran reported that Jundub told us as we we-re young boys living in Kilfa, that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Recite the Qur'an. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Imran ne bayan kiya ki Jundub ne humein bataya jab hum Kufa mein jawaan larke the, ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha: Quran padho. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The most despicable amongst persons in the eye of Allah is one who tries to fall into dispute with others (for nothing but only to display his knowledge and power of argumentation).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ki nazar mein logon mein sabse ghinauna woh hai jo doosron se jhagda karne ki koshish karta hai (sirf apna ilm aur bahas karne ki taaqat dikhaane ke liye).

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You would tread the same path as was trodden by those before you inch by inch and step by step so much so that if they had entered into the hole of the lizard, you would follow them in this also. We said: Allah's Messenger, do you mean Jews and Christians (by your words)" those before you"? He said: Who else (than those two religious groups)?
hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum wahi raasta apnaaoge jo tumse pehle ke logon ne apnaaya, qadam-ba-qadam, yahan tak ki agar woh chhipkali ke bil mein daakhil hote, to tum bhi ismein unka picha karte. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapka matlab Yahudi aur Isaayi hain ("tumse pehle ke logon" se)? Unhone farmaaya: Aur kaun (in do deeni girohon ke ilawa)?

e: This hadith is reported through Muhammad bin Muttarif from Zayd bin Aslam with the same chain.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Muttarif ke zariye Zayd bin Aslam se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ata' b. Yasir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ata bin Yasir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Ruined, were those who indulged in hair-splitting. He (the Holy Prophet) repeated this thrice.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Barbaad ho gaye woh jinhone baal ki khaal nikaalne wali baaton mein masroof hokar khud ko khatam kiya. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) ise teen baar dohraaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is from the conditions of the Last Hour that knowledge would be taken away and ignorance would prevail (upon the world), the liquor would be drunk, and adultery would become rampant.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ye Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ki ilm uThA liya jaayega aur jahaalat chhaa jaayegi (duniya par), sharaab pee jaayegi, aur zina aam ho jaayega.

e: Qatida reported that Anas b. Malik said: May I not narrate to you a hadith which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which no one would narrate to you after me who would have personally heard it from him (the Holy Prophet) (as I have the good fortune to do so)? -" It is from the signs of the Last Hour that knowledge would be taken away, ignorance would prevail upon (the world), adultery would become common, wine would be drunk, the number of men will fall short and the women would survive (and thus such a disparity would arise in the number of men and women) that there would be one man to look after fifty women.
hi: Qatada ne bayan kiya ki Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Kya main tumhe ek aisi hadees na riwayat karun jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi jise mere baad koi tumhe riwayat nahi karega jisne unhe khud (Pavitr Nabi ko) sunte hue paaya ho (jaisa mujhe ye saubhaagya mila hai)? - "Ye Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ki ilm uThA liya jaayega, jahaalat chhaa jaayegi (duniya par), zina aam ho jaayega, sharaab pi jaayegi, mardon ki tadaad kam ho jaayegi aur auraten zyada bach jaayengi (aur is tarah mardon aur auraton ki tadaad mein itna antar aayega) ki pachaas auraton ki dekhbhaal karne ke liye ek hi mard hoga."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of narrators, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: I was sitting with 'Abdullah and Abu Musa that they reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Prior to the Last Hour, there would be a time when knowledge would be taken away, and ignorance would take its place and there would be bloodshed on a large scale.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah aur Abu Musa (RA) ki sohbat mein baitha tha aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate riwayat ki: Qayamat se pehle ek waqt aayega jab ilm uThA liya jaayega, aur jahaalat iski jagah le legi aur bade paimaane par khoon-kharaba hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) and Abu Musa (al-Asha'ri) through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Mas'ud aur Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Musa (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: I was sitting with Abu Musa and 'Abdullah and they were conversing with each other and Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (that we find in the above-mentioned ahadith).
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Musa aur Abdullah (RA) ki sohbat mein baitha tha aur woh aapas mein baatchit kar rahe the aur Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate riwayat ki (jo humein upar bataayi gayi hadeeson mein milta hai).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (When) the time would draw close to the Last Hour, knowledge would be snatched away, turmoil would be rampant, miserliness would be put (in the hearts of the people) and therewould be much bloodshed. They said: What is al-harj? Thereupon he said: It is bloodshed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: (Jab) Qayamat ka waqt qareeb aayega, ilm chheen liya jaayega, fitna aam ho jaayega, kanjoosi (logon ke dilon mein) daal di jaayegi, aur bahut zyada khoon-kharaba hoga. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: al-Harj kya hai? Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Ye khoon-kharaba hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: The time would draw close to the Last Hour and knowledge would decrease. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ka waqt qareeb aayega aur ilm kam ho jaayega. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira through other chains of narrators and there is no mention of: " Miserliness would be put (in the hearts of the people)."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Kanjoosi (logon ke dilon mein) daal di jaayegi."

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, Allah does not take away knowledge by snatching it from the people but He takes away knowledge by taking away the scholars, so that when He leaves no learned person, people turn to the ignorant as their leaders; then they are asked to deliver religious verdicts and they deliver them without knowledge, they go astray, and lead others astray.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah ilm ko logon se cheenkar nahi uThAta, balki Woh ilm ko ulema ko (is duniya se) uThAkar le jaata hai, isliye jab Woh koi ilm waala shakhs baaki nahi chhodta, log jaahil logon ko apna agua bana lete hain; phir unse deeni fatwe maange jaate hain aur woh bina ilm ke fatwe dete hain, khud gumraah hote hain aur doosron ko bhi gumraah karte hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Umar through other chains of transmitters, but in the hadith transmitted by Umar b. 'Ali there is an addition of these words: , I met 'Abdullah b. 'Amr at the end of the year and I asked him about it, and he narrated to us the hadith as he had narrated before that he had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying.... (The rest of the hadith is the same).
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin Umar bin Ali ki riwayat mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Main saal ke aakhir mein Abdullah bin Amr se mila aur maine unse ismein baare mein poocha, aur unhone humein wahi hadees riwayat ki jaisi unhone pehle riwayat ki thi ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna..." (baaki hadees waisi hi hai).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that 'A'isha said to him: This news has reached me that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr al-'As would pass by us during the Hajj season, so you meet him and ask him (about religious matters) as he has acquired great knowledge from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I thus met him and asked him about things which he narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And amongst these the one he mentioned was that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily, Allah does not take away knowledge from people directly but he takes away the scholars and consequently takes away (knowledge) along with them and leaves amongst persons the ignorant as their leaders who deliver religious verdicts without (adequate) knowledge and themselves go astray and lead others astray. 'Urwa said: When I narrated this to 'A'isha, she deemed it too much (to believe) and thus showed reluctance to accept that (as perfectly true) and said to, 'Urwa: Did he ('Abdullah b. 'Amr) say to you that he had heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: ('Urwa had forgotten to ask this from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr). So when it was the next year, she ('A'isha) said to him ('Urwa): Ibn Amr has come (for Hajj), so meet him. talk to him and ask him about this hadith that he narrated to You (last year on the occasion of the Hajj) pertaining to knowledge. He ('Urwa), said: So I met him, and asked about it and he narrated to me exactly like one that he had narrated (to me) for the first time. So when I informed her ('A'isha) about that, she said: I do not think but this that he has certainly told the truth and I find that be has neither made any addition to it, nor missed anything from it.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne unse kaha: Mujhe khabar mili hai ki Abdullah bin Amr al-As Hajj ke mausam mein humaare paas se guzrenge, isliye tum unse milna aur unse (deeni maamlon ke baare mein) poochna, kyunki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut zyada ilm haasil kiya hai. Main unse mila aur unse un baaton ke baare mein poocha jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki thin. Aur inmein se jo unhone zikr kiya woh ye tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ilm ko logon se seedhe nahi cheenta, balki Woh ulema ko uThAta hai aur is tarah unke saath (ilm) bhi uThA le jaata hai aur logon mein jaahilon ko unka agua chhod deta hai jo bina (paryapt) ilm ke deeni fatwe dete hain aur khud gumraah hote hain aur doosron ko bhi gumraah karte hain. Urwa ne kaha: Jab maine ye Aisha ko riwayat kiya, unhe ye maanne mein bahut zyada lagi aur unhone ise (poori tarah sach) maanne mein hichkichaahat dikhaayi aur Urwa se kaha: Kya unhone (Abdullah bin Amr ne) tumse kaha ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna? (Urwa poochna bhool gaye the ki kya Abdullah bin Amr ne khud ye suna tha.) Isliye jab agla saal aaya, unhone (Aisha ne) Urwa se kaha: Ibn Amr aaye hain (Hajj ke liye), isliye unse milo. Unse baat karo aur unse is hadees ke baare mein poocho jo unhone tumhe (pichhle saal Hajj ke mauke par) ilm ke baare mein riwayat ki thi. Unhone (Urwa ne) kaha: Isliye main unse mila, aur ismein baare mein poocha aur unhone mujhe bilkul waisi hi riwayat ki jaisi unhone pehli baar mujhe riwayat ki thi. Isliye jab maine unhe (Aisha ko) iski jaankaari di, unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone yaqeenan sach kaha hai aur maine paaya ki unhone ismein na koi izafa kiya hai na kuch chhoda hai.

e: Jarir b. Abdullah reported that some desert Arabs clad in woollen clothes came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He saw them in sad plight as they had been hard pressed by need. He (the Holy Prophet) exhorted people to give charity, but they showed some reluctance until (signs) of anger could be seen on his face. Then a person from the Ansar came with a purse containing silver. Then came another person and then other persons followed them in succession until signs of happiness could be seen on his (sacred) face. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who introduced some good practice in Islam which was followed after him (by people) he would be assured of reward like one who followed it, without their rewards being diminished in any respect. And he who introduced some evil practice in Islam which had been followed subsequently (by others), he would be required to bear the burden like that of one who followed this (evil practice) without their's being diminished in any respect.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki kuch registaan ke Arab oon ke kapde pehne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye. Unhone unhe dukhi haalat mein dekha kyunki woh zaroorat ki wajah se bahut tang the. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) logon ko sadaqa dene ki taakeed ki, lekin unhone kuch hichkichaahat dikhaayi yahan tak ki unke chehre par gusse ke nishaan dikhne lage. Phir Ansar mein se ek shakhs chandi bhare ek thaile ke saath aaya. Phir doosra shakhs aaya aur phir doosre log unke peeche aate rahe yahan tak ki unke (Pavitr Nabi ke) mukhda par khushi ke nishaan dikhne lage. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jisne Islam mein koi achha tareeka shuru kiya jiska baad mein (logon ne) anusaran kiya, use uska anusaran karne walon ke barabar sawaab milega, unke sawaab mein kisi bhi tarah ki kami kiye bina. Aur jisne Islam mein koi bura tareeka shuru kiya jiska baad mein (doosron ne) anusaran kiya, use is (bure tareeke) ka anusaran karne walon jitna bojh uThAna padega, unke bojh mein kisi bhi tarah ki kami kiye bina.

e: Jarir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address in which he exhorted people to give charity.
hi: Jarir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek khutba diya jismein unhone logon ko sadaqa dene ki taakeed ki.

e: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The servant does not introduce good practice which is followed after him.... The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi banda achha tareeka shuru nahi karta jiska baad mein anusaran kiya jaaye... Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jarir transmitted this hadith from his father through several other chains of narrators.
hi: Jarir ne ye hadees apne waalid se kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who called (people) to righteousness, there would be reward (assured) for him like the rewards of those who adhered to it, without their rewards being diminished in any respect. And he who called (people) to error, he shall have to carry (the burden) of its sin, like those who committed it, without their sins being diminished in any respect.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne (logon ko) nekokaari ki taraf bulaaya, use uska anusaran karne walon ke barabar sawaab milega, unke sawaab mein kisi bhi tarah ki kami kiye bina. Aur jisne (logon ko) gumraahi ki taraf bulaaya, use us gunah ka bojh uThAna padega jaisa isse karne walon ka hai, unke gunah mein kisi bhi tarah ki kami kiye bina.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, thus stated: I am near to the thought of My servant as he thinks about Me, and I am with him as he remembers Me. And if he remembers Me in his heart, I also remember him in My Heart, and if he remembers Me in assembly I remember him in assembly, better than his (remembrance), and if he draws near Me by the span of a palm, I draw near him by the cubit, and if he draws near Me by the cubit I draw near him by the space (covered by) two hands. And if he walks towards Me, I rush towards him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Main apne banda ke gumaan ke qareeb hoon jo woh Mere baare mein rakhta hai, aur Main uske saath hoon jab woh Mujhe yaad karta hai. Aur agar woh Mujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai, Main bhi use Apne Dil mein yaad karta hoon, aur agar woh Mujhe kisi majlis mein yaad karta hai Main use ek majlis mein yaad karta hoon, uski yaad se behtar (majlis mein), aur agar woh ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon, aur agar woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do haathon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon. Aur agar woh chalte hue Meri taraf aata hai, Main daudte hue uski taraf aata hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of these words: " He draws near Me by the space of a hand, I draw near him by the space (covered) by two hands."
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Woh ek haath ki doori Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do haathon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon."

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported so many ahadith from Abu Huraira and one out of them is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that Allah thus stated: When My servant draws close to me by the span of a palm, I draw close to him by the space of a cubit, and when he draws close to Me by the space of a cubit, I draw close to him by the space (covered) by two hands, and when he draws close to Me by the space (covered by) two hands, I go in hurry towards him.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne Abu Huraira (RA) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Allah ne is tarah farmaaya: Jab mera banda ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon, aur jab woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do haathon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon, aur jab woh do haathon ki doori Mere qareeb aata hai, Main jaldi se uski taraf jaata hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was travelling along the path leading to Mecca that he happened to pass by a mountain called Jumdan. He said: Proceed on, it is Jumdan, Mufarradun have gone ahead. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, who are Mufarradun? He said: They are those males and females who remember Allah much.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah jaane wale raaste par safar kar rahe the ki woh ek pahaad se guzre jise Jumdan kaha jaata tha. Unhone farmaaya: Aage badho, ye Jumdan hai. Mufarradun aage nikal chuke hain. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Mufarradun kaun hain? Unhone farmaaya: Woh mard aur auraten hain jo Allah ko bahut zyada yaad karte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are ninety-nine names of Allah; he who commits them to memory would get into Paradise. Verily, Allah is Odd (He is one, and it is an odd number) and He loves odd number. And in the narration of Ibn 'Umar (the words are):" He who enumerated them."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke ninnyaave naam hain; jo unhe yaad rakhega woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Yaqeenan, Allah Taak (Witr) hai (Woh Ek hai, aur ye ek taak (od) tadaad hai) aur Woh taak (od) tadaad ko pasand karta hai. Aur Ibn Umar ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Jisne unhe ginwaya."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, there are ninety-nine names for Allah, i. e. hundred excepting one. He who enumerates them would get into Paradise. And Hammam has made this addition on the authority of Abu Huraira who reported it from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that he said:" He is Odd (one) and loves odd number."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah ke ninnyaave naam hain, yaani sau ek kam. Jo unhe ginwayega woh Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Aur Hammam ne Abu Huraira ki sanad se, jo unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki, ye izafa kiya ki unhone farmaaya: "Woh Taak (od) hai aur taak tadaad ko pasand karta hai."

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When one of you makes supplication, he should supplicate with a will and should not say: O Allah, confer upon me if Thou likest, for there is none to coerce Allah.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi dua maange, use pukke iraade ke saath dua maangni chahiye aur ye nahi kehna chahiye: Aye Allah, agar Tu chaahe to mujhe ata kar, kyunki koi bhi Allah ko majboor nahi kar sakta.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When one of you makes a supplication (to his Lord) one should not say: O Allah, grant me pardon, if Thou so likest, but one should beg one's (Lord) with a will and full devotion, for there is nothing so great in the eye of Allah which He cannot grant.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi dua maange (apne Rab se), use ye nahi kehna chahiye: Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, agar Tu chaahe, balki use apne (Rab) se pukke iraade aur poori lagan ke saath maangna chahiye, kyunki Allah ki nazar mein koi bhi cheez itni badi nahi hai ki Woh use na de sake.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None of you should say to Allah (like this): O Allah, grant me mercy, if thou so likest. The supplication (of his) should (be permeated with) conviction (that it would be accepted by the Lord), for Allah is the Doer of (everything) He likes to do, and there is none to force Him (to do or not to do this or that).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi Allah se (is tarah) na kahe: Aye Allah, mujhpar rehmat kar, agar Tu chaahe. Uski dua (imaan) ke saath honi chahiye (ki Rab use zaroor qubool karega), kyunki Allah wahi karta hai jo Woh karna chaahta hai, aur koi Use (ye ya woh karne ya na karne ke liye) majboor nahi kar sakta.

e: Anas (b. Malik) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. None of you should make a request for death because of the trouble in which he is involved, but if there is no other help to it, then say: O Allah, keep me alive as long as there is goodness in life for me and bring death to me when there is goodness in death for me.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi apni mushkilon ki wajah se maut ki khwaish na kare, lekin agar iske siwaay koi chaara nahi, to kaho: Aye Allah, mujhe tab tak zinda rakh jab tak zindagi mein mere liye bhalai hai aur mujhe maut de jab maut mein mere liye bhalai hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters, but with a small variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Nadr b. Anas reported, as when Anas was alive, that he said: Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not stated this.." None should make a request for death," I would have definitely done that.
hi: Nadr bin Anas ne bayan kiya, jab Anas zinda the, ki unhone kaha: Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye na farmaaya hota, "Koi bhi maut ki khwaish na kare," to main zaroor aisa karta.

e: Abu Hazim reported: I visited Khabbab who had seven cauteries on his stomach and he said: Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not forbidden us to call for death, I would have done so.
hi: Abu Hazim ne bayan kiya: Main Khabbab se milne gaya jinke pait par saat daag the (daag-daagne ke), aur unhone kaha: Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein maut ki dua maangne se mana na kiya hota, to main zaroor aisa karta.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Isma'il through other chains of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih said: Abu Huraira narrated to us ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and out of these one is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should make a request for death, and do not call for it before it comes, for when any one of you dies, he ceases (to do good) deeds and the life of a believer is not prolonged but for goodness.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Abu Huraira (RA) ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi maut ki khwaish na kare, aur ye iske aane se pehle na maango, kyunki jab tum mein se koi marta hai, woh (nekokaar) amal karna band kar deta hai, aur momin ki zindagi sirf bhalai ke liye badhaayi jaati hai.

e: Ubida b. Samit reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah also loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah also abhors to meet him.
hi: Ubada bin Samit (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubada b. Samit through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ubada bin Samit (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah abhors to meet him. I ('A'isha) said: Allah's Apostle, so far as the feeling of aversion against death is concerned, we all have this feeling. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is not that (which you construe), but (this) that when a believer (at the time of death) is given the glad tidings of the mercy of Allah, His Pleasure, and of Paradise, he loves to meet Allah, and Allah also loves to meet him, and when an unbeliever is given the news of the torment at the Hand of Allah, and Hardship to be imposed by Him, he dislikes to meet Allah and Allah also abhors to meet him.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai. Maine (Aisha ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jahan tak maut se ghrina ka sawaal hai, humme se sabko ye ehsaas hota hai. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Ye woh nahi hai (jo tum samajhti ho), balki (ye) ki jab ek momin ko (maut ke waqt) Allah ki rehmat, Uski khushi aur Jannat ki khushkhabri di jaati hai, woh Allah se milna pasand karta hai, aur Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jab ek kaafir ko Allah ke Haath se azaab aur Uski taraf se sakhti ki khabar di jaati hai, woh Allah se milna napasand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatida with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah also loves to meet him, and who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah abhors to meet him. There is death before (one is able to) meet Allah.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai. Maut Allah se (haqiqi) milne se pehle aati hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves meeting Allah, Allah loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah abhors to meet him. I (Shuraih b. Hani, one of the narrators) came to A'isha and said to her: Mother of the faithful, I heard Abu Huraira narrate from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which, if it is actually so, is a destruction to us. Thereupon she said: Those are in fact ruined who are ruined at the words of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What are (the words which in your opinion would cause your destruction)? He said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had stated: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah too loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah too abhors to meet him, and there is none amongst us who dons not hate death. Thereupon she said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has in fact stated this, but it does not mean what you construe, but it implies (the time) when one loses the lustre of the eye, and there is rattling in the throat, shudder in the body and convulsion in fingers (at the time of death). (It is about this time) that it has been said: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah would love to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah would abhor to meet him
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai. Main (Shuraih bin Hani, raawiyon mein se ek) Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Imaandaaron ki Maa, maine Abu Huraira ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat karte suna jo, agar ye waastav mein aisa hai, humaare liye tabaahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: Woh log waastav mein barbaad hain jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaazon se barbaad hote hain. Woh alfaaz kya hain (jo aapki raay mein tumhaare tabaahi ki wajah honge)? Unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai, aur humme se koi aisa nahi hai jo maut se nafrat na karta ho. Isper unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne waastav mein ye farmaaya hai, lekin iska woh matlab nahi jo tum samajh rahe ho, balki iska matlab (woh waqt hai) jab kisi ki aankhon ki chamak khatm ho jaati hai, aur gale mein ghurghuraahat, badan mein kaanp aur ungliyon mein khinchaav aata hai (maut ke waqt). (Ye us waqt ke baare mein hai ki) ye kaha gaya hai: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karega, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karega.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mutarrif with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mutarrif ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who loves to meet Allah, Allah too loves to meet him, and he who dislikes to meet Allah, Allah abhors to meet him.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Allah se milna pasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand karta hai, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him as saying that Allah thus stated: I live in the thought of My servant as he thinks of Me and with him as he calls Me.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah ne is tarah farmaaya: Main apne banda ke saath uski soch mein rehta hoon jab woh Mera zikr karta hai, aur uske saath jab woh Mujhe pukaarta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: When My servant draws close to Me by the span of a palm, I draw close to him by the cubit and when he draws close to Me by the cubit, I draw close to him by the space (covered) by two armspans, and when he comes to me walking, I go in a hurry towards him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Jab mera banda ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do baazuon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon, aur jab woh chalte hue Mere paas aata hai, Main daudte hue uski taraf jaata hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mu'tamar from his father with the same chain of transmitters, with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Mu'tamar ki sanad se apne waalid ke zariye isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, thus stated: I live in the thought of My servant as he thinks about Me, and I am with him, as he remembers Me. And if he remembers Me in his heart, I also remember him in My Heart, and if he remembers Me in assembly I remember him in the assembly, better than he (does that), and if he draws near Me by the span of a palm I draw near him by the cubit, and if he draws near Me by the cubit I draw near him by the space (covered by) two hands. And if he walks towards Me, I rush towards him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne is tarah farmaaya: Main apne banda ke saath uski soch mein rehta hoon jab woh Mera zikr karta hai, aur Main uske saath hoon jab woh Mujhe yaad karta hai. Aur agar woh Mujhe apne dil mein yaad karta hai, Main bhi use Apne Dil mein yaad karta hoon, aur agar woh Mujhe kisi majlis mein yaad karta hai Main use us majlis mein yaad karta hoon, uski yaad se behtar (majlis mein), aur agar woh ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon, aur agar woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do haathon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon. Aur agar woh chalte hue Meri taraf aata hai, Main daudte hue uski taraf aata hoon.

e: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, stated: " He who comes with goodness, there are in store for him ten like those and even more than those: 'And he who comes with vice, ' it is only for that that he is called to account. I even forgive him (as I like) and he who draws close to Me by the span of a palm I draw close to him by the cubit, and he who draws close to Me by the cubit I draw close to him by the space (covered) by two hands, and he who walks towards Me I rush towards him, and he who meets Me in the state that his sins fill the earth, but not associating anything with Me, I would meet Him with the same (vastness) of pardon (on My behalf)." This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Waki'.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Jo nekokaari lekar aata hai, uske liye das (achhaiyaan) unke jaisi rakhi gayi hain aur usse bhi zyada; aur jo burai lekar aata hai, usse sirf usi (burai) ka hisaab liya jaayega. Main use maaf bhi kar deta hoon (jaisa Main chaahta hoon), aur jo ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon, aur jo ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main do haathon ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon, aur jo chalte hue Meri taraf aata hai, Main daudte hue uski taraf jaata hoon, aur jo Mujhse is haalat mein milta hai ki uske gunahon se zameen bhar gayi ho, lekin usne Mere saath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho, Main use utni hi (vishaal) maafi ke saath milunga. Ye hadees Waki ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and he (further) said: There is for him ten like that (the good he performed) or more than that.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone (aage) kaha: Uske liye das (achhaiyaan) unke (nekokaari ke) jaisi hain ya usse bhi zyada.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited a person from amongst the Muslims in order to inquire (about his health) who had grown feeble like the chicken. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Did you supplicate for anything or beg of Him about that? He said: Yes. I used to utter (these words): Impose punishment upon me earlier in this world, what Thou art going to impose upon me in the Hereafter. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), you have neither the power nor forbearance to take upon yourself (the burden of His Punishment). Why did you not say this: O Allah, grant us good in the world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of Fire. He (the Prophet) made this supplication (for him) and he was all right.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Musalmaanon mein se ek shakhs se milne gaye (unki tabiyat poochne) jo murgi ke chuze jaisa kamzor ho chuka tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya tumne kuch dua maangi thi ya Usse ismein baare mein kuch maanga tha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Main ye alfaaz kaha karta tha: Aye Allah, mujhe (jo saza Tu Aakhirat mein dega) isi duniya mein pehle de de. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), tum mein na iski taakat hai na sabar ki himmat ki (Uski saza ka bojh uThAo). Tumne ye kyun nahi kaha: Aye Allah, humein duniya mein bhalai de aur Aakhirat mein bhalai de, aur humein Jahannam ke azaab se bacha. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) uske liye dua ki aur woh theek ho gaya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Humaid with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Humaid ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited a person from amongst his Companions who had grown as feeble as the chicken. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this variation that he (the Holy Prophet) said: You have not power enough to undergo the torment imposed by Allah. And there is no mention of: He supplicated Allah for him and He cured him.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne Sahaba mein se ek shakhs se milne gaye jo murgi ke chuze jaisa kamzor ho chuka tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Tum mein Allah dwara di gayi saza uThAne ki taakat nahi hai. Aur ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Unhone uske liye Allah se dua ki aur Usne use theek kiya."

e: This hadith had been transmitted on the authority of Anas through another chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying Allah has mobile (squads) of angels, who have no other work (to attend to but) to follow the assemblies of Dhikr and when they find such assemblies in which there is Dhikr (of Allah) they sit in them and some of them surround the others with their wings till the space between them and the sky of the world is fully covered, and when they disperse (after the assembly of Dhikr is adjourned) they go upward to the heaven and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, asks them although He is best informed about them: Where have you come from? They say: We come from Thine servants upon the earth who had been glorifying Thee (reciting Subhan Allah), uttering Thine Greatness (saying Allah o-Akbar) and uttering Thine Oneness (La ilaha ill Allah) and praising Thee (uttering al-Hamdu Lillah) and begging of Thee. Be would say: What do they beg of Me? They would say: They beg of Thee the Paradise of Thine. He (God) would say: Have they seen My Paradise? They said: No, our Lord. He would say: (What it would be then) if they were to see Mine Paradise? They (the angels) said: They seek Thine protection. He (the Lord) would say: Against what do they seek protection of Mine? They (the angels) would say: Our Lord, from the Hell-Fire. He (the Lord) would say: Have they seen My Fire? They would say: No. He (the Lord) would say: What it would be if they were to see My Fire? They would say: They beg of Thee forgiveness. He would say: I grant pardon to them, and confer upon them what they ask for and grant them protection against which they seek protection. They (the angels) would again say: Our Lord, there is one amongst them such and such simple servant who happened to pass by (that assembly) and sat there along with them (who had been participating in that assembly). He (the Lord) would say: I also grant him pardon, for they are a people the seat-fellows of whom are in no way unfortunate.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke chalte-phirte Farishton ke daste hain jinka aur koi kaam nahi (siwaay iske) ki woh Zikr ki majlison ka picha karte hain, aur jab woh aisi majlisen paate hain jinmein (Allah ka) Zikr ho raha hota hai woh unmein baith jaate hain, aur unmein se kuch apne pankhon se ek-doosre ko chaaron taraf se dhak lete hain yahan tak ki unke aur duniyaavi aasmaan ke beech ki jagah poori tarah bhar jaati hai, aur jab woh (Zikr ki majlis khatm hone ke baad) bikhar jaate hain, woh Aasmaan ki taraf jaate hain aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, unse poochte hain, halaanki Woh unke baare mein sabse behtar jaanta hai: Tum kahan se aaye ho? Woh kehte hain: Hum Tere un bandon se aaye hain jo zameen par Teri tasbeeh kar rahe the (Subhan Allah kehte hue), Teri buzurgi bayaan kar rahe the (Allahu Akbar kehte hue) aur Teri wahdaaniyat bayaan kar rahe the (La ilaha illa Allah kehte hue) aur Teri hamd kar rahe the (al-Hamdu Lillah kehte hue) aur Tujhse maang rahe the. Woh farmaayenge: Woh Mujhse kya maang rahe the? Woh kahenge: Woh Teri Jannat maang rahe the. Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Kya unhone Meri Jannat dekhi hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi, humaare Rab. Woh farmaayenge: (Phir kaisa hoga) agar woh Meri Jannat dekh lete? Woh (Farishte) kahenge: Woh Teri panah maangte hain. Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Woh Meri kis cheez se panah maangte hain? Woh (Farishte) kahenge: Humaare Rab, Jahannam ki aag se. Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Kya unhone Meri aag dekhi hai? Woh kahenge: Nahi. Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: (Kaisa hoga) agar woh Meri aag dekh lete? Woh kahenge: Woh Tujhse maafi maangte hain. Woh farmaayenge: Main unhe maaf karta hoon, aur unhe woh deta hoon jo woh maangte hain aur unhe us cheez se panah deta hoon jiski woh panah maangte hain. Woh (Farishte) phir kahenge: Humaare Rab, unmein se ek shakhs aisa bhi hai jo (Teri ibadat karne wale) nahi hain aur woh (bas) wahan se guzra aur unke saath baith gaya (jo us majlis mein shaamil the). Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Main use bhi maaf karta hoon, kyunki woh aise log hain jinki sohbat mein baithne wala koi bhi badnaseeb nahi hota.

e: Qatada asked Anas which Supplication Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) frequently made. He said: The supplication that he (the Prophet made very frequently is this:" O Allah, grant us the good in this world and the good in the Hereafter and save us from the torment of Hell-Fire." He (Qatada) said that whenever Anas had to supplicate he made this very supplication, and whenever he (intended) to make another supplication he (inserted) this very supplication in that.
hi: Qatada ne Anas se poocha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sabse zyada kaunsi dua maanga karte the. Unhone kaha: Woh dua jo unhone (Nabi ne) sabse zyada maangi ye thi: "Aye Allah, humein is duniya mein bhalai de aur Aakhirat mein bhalai de aur humein Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se bacha." Unhone (Qatada ne) kaha ki jab bhi Anas ko dua maangni hoti, woh yehi dua maangte, aur jab bhi woh koi doosri dua maangna chaahte, woh isi dua ko usmein shaamil kar lete.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " Our Lord, grant us the good in this world and the good in the Hereafter and save us from the torment of Hell Fire."
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (in alfaazon mein) dua maanga karte the: "Humaare Rab, humein is duniya mein bhalai de aur Aakhirat mein bhalai de aur humein Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se bacha."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who uttered these words:" There is no god but Allah, the One, having no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything" one hundred times every day there is a reward of emancipating ten slaves for him, and there are recorded hundred virtues to his credit, and hundred vices are blotted out from his scroll, and that is a safeguard for him against the Satan on that day till evening and no one brings anything more excellent than this, except one who has done more than this (who utters these words more than one hundred times and does more good acts) and he who utters:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), and all praise is due to Him," one hundred times a day, his sins are obliterated even if they are equal to the extent of the foam of the ocean.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jisne ye alfaaz kahe: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai. Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai, aur Woh har cheez par qaadir hai" - din mein sau baar, uske liye das ghulamon ko azaad karne ka sawaab hai, aur uske khaate mein sau nekiyaan darj ki jaati hain, aur uske daftar se sau buraiyaan mita di jaati hain, aur ye uss din shaam tak Shaitaan se uska bachaav hai, aur koi bhi isse zyada behtareen (amal) nahi laata siwaay us shakhs ke jisne isse zyada kiya ho, aur jisne "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai," din mein sau baar padha, uske gunah mita diye jaate hain chahe woh samundar ke jhaag jitne hi kyun na hon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who recites in the morning and in the evening (these words):" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection)and all praise is due to Him" one hundred times, he would not bring on the Day of Resurrection anything excellent than this except one who utters these words or utters more than these words.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo subah aur shaam ye alfaaz sau baar padhta hai: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai," woh Qayamat ke din isse behtareen kuch nahi laayega siwaay us shakhs ke jisne ye alfaaz kahe ho ya inse zyada kaha ho.

e: 'Amr b. Maimun reported: He who uttered:" There is no god but Allah, the One, having no partner with Him, His is the Sovereignty and all praise is due to Him and He is Potent over everything" ten times, he is like one who emancipated four slaves from the progeny of Isma'il. Rabi' b. Khuthaim narrated a hadith like this. Sha'bi reported: I said to Rabi': From whom did you hear it? He said: From 'Amr b. Maimun. I came to 'Amr b. Maimun and said to him: From whom did you hear this hadith? He said: from Ibn Abi Laila. I came to Ibn Abi Laila and said to him: From whom did you hear this hadith? He said: From Abu Ayyub Ansari, who narrated from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Amr bin Maimun ne bayan kiya: Jisne ye alfaaz das baar kahe: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai, Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai aur Woh har cheez par qaadir hai," woh us shakhs jaisa hai jisne Ismail ki nasl mein se chaar ghulamon ko azaad kiya. Rabi bin Khuthaim ne isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki. Sha'bi ne kaha: Maine Rabi se poocha: Aapne ye kisse suna? Unhone kaha: Amr bin Maimun se. Main Amr bin Maimun ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Aapne ye hadees kisse suni? Unhone kaha: Ibn Abu Laila se. Main Ibn Abu Laila ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Aapne ye hadees kisse suni? Unhone kaha: Abu Ayyub Ansari se, jinhone ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Two are the expressions which are light on the tongue, but heavy in scale, dear to the Compassionate One:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection) and all praise is due to Him" ;" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), the Great."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Do aise alfaaz hain jo zubaan par halke hain, lekin taraazu mein bhaari hain, Rehmvaan ko aziz hain: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai," "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), Buland-o-Azeem."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The uttering of (these words):" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest," is dearer to me than anything over which the sun rises.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: In alfaazon ka padhna: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), saari hamd Allah ke liye hai, Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, aur Allah sabse Buland hai," mujhe har us cheez se zyada aziz hai jispar suraj chadhta hai.

e: Mu'sab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that a desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: Teach me the words which I should (often) utter. He said: Utter," There is no god but Allah, the One, having no partner with Him. Allah is the Greatest of the great and all praise is due to Him. Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), the Lord of the worlds, there is no Might and Power but that of Allah, the All-Powerful and the Wise." He (that desert Arab) said: These all (glorify) my Lord. But what about me? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You should say:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to righteousness and provide me sustenance." Musa (one of the narrators) said: I think he also said:" Grant me safety." But I cannot say for certain whether he said this or not. Ibn Abi Shaiba has not made a mention of the words of Musa in his narration.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki ek registaan ka Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Mujhe woh alfaaz sikhaiye jo main (aksar) padha karun. Unhone farmaaya: Padho: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai. Allah Buzurgon mein sabse Buzurg hai aur saari hamd Usi ke liye hai. Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), duniyaon ka Rab, na koi Himmat hai na Quwwat siwaay Allah ke, jo Sab par Qaadir aur Hakeem hai." Us (registaan ke Arab) ne kaha: Ye sab (mera Rab) ki tareef karte hain. Lekin mere baare mein kya? Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Tumhe kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar, mujhe nekokaari ki taraf margdarshan de aur mujhe rozi de." Musa (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: "Mujhe hifaazat de." Lekin main pakke taur par nahi keh sakta ki unhone ye kaha ya nahi. Ibn Abu Shaiba ne apni riwayat mein Musa ke alfaaz ka zikr nahi kiya hai.

e: Abu Malik Ashaja'i reported on the authority of his father that whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness and provide me sustenance."
hi: Abu Malik Ashja'i ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki jab bhi koi shakhs Islam qubool karta, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) use ye padhne ki taalim dete: "Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar, mujhe nekokaari ki raah dikha aur mujhe rozi de."

e: Abu Malik reported on the authority of his father that when a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to teach him how to observe prayer and then commanded him to supplicate in these words: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness, grant me protection and provide me sustenance."
hi: Abu Malik ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki jab koi shakhs Islam qubool karta, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) use namaz padhna sikhaate aur phir use in alfaazon mein dua karne ka hukum dete: "Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar, mujhe nekokaari ki raah dikha, mujhe hifaazat de aur mujhe rozi de."

e: Abu Malik reported on the authority Of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to the person who bad come to him and asked him as to how he should beg his Lord, that he should utter these words: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, protect me, provide me sustenance," and he collected his fingers together except his thumb and said: It is in these words (that there is supplication) which sums up for you (the good) of this world and that of the Hereafter.
hi: Abu Malik ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us shakhs se ye farmaate suna jo unke paas aaya tha aur poocha tha ki woh apne Rab se kya maange, ki use ye alfaaz padhne chahiye: "Aye Allah, mujhe maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar, mujhe hifaazat de, mujhe rozi de," aur unhone apni ungliyaan ikattha kin siwaay apne angoothe ke aur kaha: Yehi (in alfaazon) mein woh dua hai jo tumhaare liye is duniya (ki bhalai) aur Aakhirat (ki bhalai) ko samet leti hai.

e: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported that his father told him that he had been in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Is one amongst you powerless to get one thousand virtues every day. Amongst those who had been sitting there, one asked: How one amongst us can get one thousand virtues every day? He said: Recite:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection) one hundred times for (by reciting them) one thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one thousand vices are blotted out.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki unke waalid ne unhe bataya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the jab unhone farmaaya: Kya tum mein se koi har din hazaar nekiyaan haasil karne se aajiz hai? Wahan baithe logon mein se ek ne poocha: Humme se koi har din hazaar nekiyaan kaise haasil kar sakta hai? Unhone farmaaya: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai)" sau baar padho, kyunki (inhe padhne se) hazaar nekiyaan darj ki jaati hain aur hazaar buraiyaan mita di jaati hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who alleviates the suffering of a brother out of the sufferings of the world, Allah would alleviate his suffering from the sufferings of the Day of Resurrection, and he who finds relief for one who is hard-pressed, Allah would make things easy for him in the Hereafter, and he who conceals (the faults) of a Muslim, Allah would conceal his faults in the world and in the Hereafter. Allah is at the back of a servant so long as the servant is at the back of his brother, and he who treads the path in search of knowledge, Allah would make that path easy, leading to Paradise for him and those persons who assemble in the house among the houses of Allah (mosques) and recite the Book of Allah and they learn and teach the Qur'an (among themselves) there would descend upon them tranquility and mercy would cover them and the angels would surround them and Allah mentions them in the presence of those near Him, and he who is slow-paced in doing good deeds, his (high) lineage does not make him go ahead.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo apne bhai ki duniyaavi mushkilon ko halka karta hai, Allah uski mushkilein Qayamat ke din halki karega, aur jo kisi tang-haal shakhs ke liye aasaani dhoondta hai, Allah uske liye Aakhirat mein cheezein aasaan karega, aur jo kisi Musalman ki (khaamiyaan) chhupaata hai, Allah is duniya aur Aakhirat mein uski khaamiyaan chhupaayega. Allah banda ki madad karta rehta hai jab tak banda apne bhai ki madad karta rehta hai, aur jo ilm ki talaash mein raasta apnaata hai, Allah uske liye woh raasta Jannat ki taraf aasaan kar dega aur jo log Allah ke gharon (masjidon) mein se kisi ghar mein ikattha hote hain aur Allah ki Kitaab padhte hain aur aapas mein Quran seekhte-sikhaate hain, unpar sukoon utarta hai aur rehmat unhe dhaak leti hai aur Farishte unhe ghere lete hain aur Allah unka zikr Apne qareeb rehne walon ke saamne karta hai, aur jo nekokaar amal karne mein sust hai, uska (uchcha) vansh use aage nahi le jaata.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Agharr Abi Muslim reported: I bear witness to the fact that both Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id Khudri were present when Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) said: The people do not sit but they are surrounded by angels and covered by Mercy, and there descends upon them tranquillity as they remember Allah, and Allah makes a mention of them to those who are near Him. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Aghar Abi Muslim ne bayan kiya: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Abu Huraira aur Abu Sa'id Khudri donon maujood the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Log kisi majlis mein nahi baithte lekin unhe Farishton ne ghera hota hai aur Rehmat unhe dhaak leti hai, aur unpar sukoon utarta hai jab woh Allah ko yaad karte hain, aur Allah unka zikr un logon ke saamne karta hai jo Uske qareeb hain. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Mu'awiya went to a circle in the mosque and said: What makes you sit here? They said: We are sitting here in order to remember Allah. He said: I adjure you by Allah (to tell me whether you are sitting here for this very purpose)? They said: By Allah, we are sitting here for this very purpose. Thereupon, he said: I have not demanded you to take an oath, because of any allegation against you and none of my rank in the eye of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is the narrator of so few ahadith as I am. The fact is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the circle of his Companions and said: What makes you sit? They said: We are sitting here in order to remember Allah and to praise Him for He guided us to the path of Islam and He conferred favours upon us. Thereupon he adjured by Allah and asked if that only was the purpose of their sitting there. They said: By Allah, we are not sitting here but for this very purpose, whereupon he (the Messenger) said: I am not asking you to take an oath because of any allegation against you but for the fact that Gabriel came to me and he informed me that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, was talking to the angels about your magnificence.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Muawiya masjid ki ek majlis mein gaye aur kaha: Tumhe yahan kis cheez ne baithaya hai? Unhone kaha: Hum yahan Allah ko yaad karne ke liye baithe hain. Unhone kaha: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon (batao ki kya tum sach mein isi maqsad se baithe ho)? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum isi maqsad se baithe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Maine tumse qasam isliye nahi maangi ki mujhe tumpar koi shak hai, balki isliye kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nazar mein mujhse kam ahadees riwayat karne wala koi bhi nahi hai jitna main hoon. Asal baat ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne Sahaba ki ek majlis mein aaye aur poocha: Tumhe kis cheez ne baithaya hai? Unhone kaha: Hum yahan Allah ko yaad karne aur Uski hamd karne baithe hain kyunki Usne humein Islam ki raah dikhaayi aur humpar ehsaan kiya. Isper unhone Allah ki qasam deke poocha ki kya woh sirf isi maqsad se baithe hain. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum sirf isi maqsad se baithe hain, isper unhone (Rasool ne) farmaaya: Main tumse isliye qasam nahi maang raha ki mujhe tumpar koi shak hai, balki isliye ki Jibril mere paas aaye aur unhone mujhe bataya ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Farishton se tumhaari azmat ke baare mein baat kar rahe hain.

e: Al-Agharr al-Muzani, who was one amongst the Companions (of the Holy Prophet) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is (at times) some sort of shade upon my heart, and I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times a day.
hi: Al-Aghar al-Muzani (RA), jo Pavitr Nabi ke Sahaba mein se ek the, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: (Kabhi-kabhi) mere dil par ek kism ka saaya aa jaata hai, aur main din mein sau baar Allah se maafi maangta hoon.

e: Al-Agharr al-Muzani who was from amongst the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reported that Ibn 'Umar stated to him that Allah's Messenger (may peace 'be upon him) said: O people, seek repentance from Allah. Verily, I seek repentance from Him a hundred times a day.
hi: Al-Aghar al-Muzani, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se the, ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne unhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye logo, Allah se tauba maango. Yaqeenan, main din mein sau baar Usse tauba maangta hoon.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: He who seeks repentance (from the Lord) before the rising of the sun from the west (before the Day of Resurrection), Allah turns to him with Mercy.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo (Rab se) tauba maangta hai isse pehle ki suraj pashchim se nikle (Qayamat aane se pehle), Allah uski taraf Apni Rehmat ke saath mudta hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: We were along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on a journey when the people began to pronounce "Allahu Akbar" in a loud voice. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O people, show mercy to yourselves for you are not calling One who is deaf or absent. Verily, you are calling One who is All-Hearing (and) Near to you and is with you. Abu Musa said that he had been behind him (the Prophet) and reciting: "There is neither might nor power but that of Allah." He (the Prophet), while addressing 'Abdullah b. Qais, said: Should I not direct you to a treasure from amongst the treasures of Paradise? I ('Abdullah b. Qais) said: Allah's Messenger, do it, of course. Thereupon he (the Prophet) said: Then recite: "There is no might and no power but that of Allah."
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum ek safar mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the jab log buland aawaaz mein "Allahu Akbar" padhne lage. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye logo, khud par rehm karo, kyunki tum kisi behre ya gairhaazir shakhs ko nahi pukaar rahe. Yaqeenan, tum us Hasti ko pukaar rahe ho jo sab kuch sunta hai, tumhaare qareeb hai aur tumhaare saath hai. Abu Musa ne kaha ki woh unke (Nabi ke) peeche the aur padh rahe the: "Na koi Himmat hai na koi Quwwat siwaay Allah ke." Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne), Abdullah bin Qais ko khitaab karte hue, farmaaya: Kya main tumhe Jannat ke khazanon mein se ek khazana na bataun? Maine (Abdullah bin Qais ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, zaroor bataiye. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Phir padho: "Na koi Himmat hai na koi Quwwat siwaay Allah ke."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Asim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported that he (and his other companions) were climbing upon the hillock along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when any person climbed up, he pronounced (loudly): " There is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest." Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily, you are not supplicating One Who is deaf or absent. He said: Abu Musa or Abdullah b Qais, should I not direct you to the words (which are from) the treasures of Paradise? I said: Allah's Messenger, what are these? He said:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah."
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki woh (aur unke doosre saathi) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek Tille par chadh rahe the aur jab bhi koi shakhs upar chadhta, woh (buland aawaaz mein) padhta: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Allah sabse Buland hai." Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, tum kisi behre ya gairhaazir Hasti se dua nahi kar rahe. Unhone kaha: Abu Musa, ya Abdullah bin Qais, kya main tumhe woh alfaaz na bataun (jo) Jannat ke khazane (mein se hain)? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh kya hain? Unhone farmaaya: "Na koi Himmat hai na koi Quwwat siwaay Allah ke."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Musa with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Musa (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported: We were along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on a journey; the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by A'sim.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein ek safar mein the; baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi A'sim ne riwayat ki.

e: Abu Musa, reported. We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition. The rest of the hadith is the same (and there is an addi- tion of these words in that): " He (the Holy Prophet) said: He Whom you are sup- plicating is nearer to every one of you than the neck of his camel." And there is no mention of these words:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah."
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim mein the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai (aur ismein ye alfaazon ka izafa hai): Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Jis Hasti se tum dua maang rahe ho Woh tum mein se har ek ke apne oont ki gardan se bhi zyada qareeb hai. Aur ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Na koi Himmat hai na Quwwat siwaay Allah ke."

e: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Should I not direct you to the words from the treasures of Paradise, or he said: Like a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? I said: Of course, do that. Thereupon he said:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah."
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Kya main tumhe Jannat ke khazanon mein se woh alfaaz na bataun, ya unhone kaha, Jannat ke khazanon mein se ek khazane jaise? Maine kaha: Zaroor, aisa kijiye. Isper unhone farmaaya: "Na koi Himmat hai na Quwwat siwaay Allah ke."

e: Abu Bakr reported that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Teach me a supplication which I should recite in my prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Recite:" O Allah, I have done great wrong to myself." According to Qutaiba (the words were: ) much (wrong) -there is none to forgive the sins but Thou only, say:" Grant me pardon from Thyself, have mercy upon me for Thou art much Forgiving and Compassionate."
hi: Abu Bakr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Mujhe woh dua sikhaiye jo main apni namaz mein padhun. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Padho: "Aye Allah, maine khud par bada zulm kiya hai." Qutaiba ke mutabik (alfaaz the:) bahut zyada (zulm) - koi bhi gunah maaf nahi kar sakta siwaay Tere - kaho: "Mujhe Apni taraf se maafi de, mujhpar rehmat kar kyunki Tu bahut maaf karne wala aur Rehmvaan hai."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amr b. al-'As that Abu Bakr Siddiq said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Allah's Messenger, teach me a supplication which I should make in my prayer and in my house. The rest of the hadith is the same except with this variation that he said: Much wrong (Zulman Kathira).
hi: Ye hadees Amr bin al-As ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Abu Bakr Siddiq ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe woh dua sikhaiye jo main apni namaz mein aur apne ghar mein maangun. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is antar ke ki unhone kaha: Bahut zulm (Zulman Kathira).

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to make these supplications: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the trial of Hell-Fire; and from the torment of Hell-Fire; and from the trial of the grave and torment of the grave; and from the evil of the trial of the affluence and from the evil of the trial of poverty and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of the turmoil of the Dajjal. O Allah, wash away my sins with snow and hail water, purify my heart from the sins as is purified the white garment from the dirt, and keep away at a distance the sins from me as yawns the distance between the East and the West; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from senility, from sin, and from debt."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ki aag ki azmaayish se; aur Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se; aur qabar ki azmaayish aur qabar ke azaab se; aur khushhaali ki azmaayish ki burai se aur gareebi ki azmaayish ki burai se aur main Dajjal ke fitne ki burai se Teri panah maangta hoon. Aye Allah, mere gunahon ko baraf aur ole ke paani se dho de, mere dil ko gunahon se paak kar jaise safed kapda gandagi se paak kiya jaata hai, aur gunahon ko mujhse itni door kar jitni doori Poorab aur Pashchim ke beech hai; Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, budhape se, gunah se, aur karze se."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from incapacity, from indolence, from cowardice, from senility, from miserliness, and I seek refuge in Thee from the torment of the grave and from trial of the life and death."
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon lachaari se, susti se, buzdili se, budhape se, kanjoosi se, aur main Teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke azaab se aur zindagi aur maut ki azmaayish se."

e: Anas reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (this suppli- cation) but with this variation that these words are not found in that supplication: " From the trial of life and death."
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye dua riwayat ki lekin is antar ke saath ki ismein ye alfaaz nahi milte: "Zindagi aur maut ki azmaayish se."

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to seek refuge in Allah from such things as mentioned in the above-mentioned hadith and from 'miserliness" too.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) upar bataayi gayi hadees mein zikr ki gayi cheezon se aur "kanjoosi" se bhi Allah ki panah maangte the.

e: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) wed to make this supplication: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from miserliness, from sloth and from decrepitude."
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon kanjoosi se, susti se aur zayaf budhape se."

e:
It was narrated from Abu Huraira that: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to seek refuge (in Allah) from the evil of what has been decreed, from misery, from the mockery of (triumphant) enemies, and from severe calamity. 

`Amr (one of the narrators) said in his narration: "Sufyan said: 'I fear I may have added one of them (the phrases)."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) se riwayat kiya gaya ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (Allah se) panah maangte the taqdeer ki burai se, badnaseebi se, dushmanon ki khushi se, aur sakht museebat se. Amr (raawiyon mein se ek) ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Sufyan ne kaha: Mujhe dar hai ki maine inmein se koi ek (alfaaz) izafa kar diya ho.

e: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone lands at a place, and then says:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created," nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place.
hi: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab koi shakhs kisi jagah utarta hai, aur phir kehta hai: "Main Allah ke Kaamil Kalimaat ki panah maangta hoon Uski banaayi hui har cheez ki burai se," use koi nuksaan nahi hoga jab tak woh us padaav se aage nahi jaata.

e: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you stays at a place, he should say:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of that He created." Nothing would then do him any harm until he moves from that place. Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:" Allah's Messenger, I was stung by a scorpion during the night. Thereupon he said: Had you recited these words in the evening:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He created," it would not have done any harm to you.
hi: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi kisi jagah rukta hai, use kehna chahiye: "Main Allah ke Kaamil Kalimaat ki panah maangta hoon Uski banaayi hui har cheez ki burai se." Phir use koi nuksaan nahi hoga jab tak woh us jagah se aage na badhe. Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, raat ko mujhe ek bicchhu ne daansa. Isper unhone farmaaya: Agar tumne shaam ko ye alfaaz padhe hote: "Main Allah ke Kaamil Kalimaat ki panah maangta hoon Uski banaayi hui har cheez ki burai se," to ye tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaata.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Al-Bara' b.
