'Azib reported that Allah's, Messenger (may peace be upon said: When you go to bed, perform ablution as is done for prayer; then lie down pn the right side and recite:" O Allah, I turn my face towards Thee and entrust my affair to Thee. I retreat unto Thee for protection with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship) but Thou only. I affirm my faith in Thine books which Thou revealed and in Thine Apostles whom Thou sent." Make this as the last word of yours (when you go to sleep) and in case you die during that night, you would die upon Fitra (upon Islam). And as I repeated these words in order to commit them to memory, I said:" I affirm my faith in Thy Messenger (Rasul) whom Thou sent." He said: Say:" I affirm my faith in the Apostle (Nabi) whom Thou sent."
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum bistar par jao, namaz jaisa wuzu karo; phir apni daayi taraf letkar padho: "Aye Allah, main apna chehra Teri taraf karta hoon aur apna maamla Tujhe soonpta hoon. Main ummeed ke saath aur Tera Dar rakhte hue Teri panah lene ko lautta hoon. (Museebat se) bachne ki koi jagah aur (mushkil se) chhutkaara dene wala koi nahi siwaay Tere. Main Teri utaari hui Kitaabon par imaan rakhta hoon aur Tere bheje hue Rasoolon par bhi." Ise apne (sone se pehle ke) aakhri alfaaz banaao, aur agar us raat tum mar jao, tum Fitrat (Islam) par maroge. Aur jab maine ye alfaaz yaad karne ke liye dohraaye, maine kaha: "Main Tere bheje hue Rasool par imaan rakhta hoon." Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Kaho: "Main Tere bheje hue Nabi par imaan rakhta hoon."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib with a slight variation of wording and there is this addition in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Husain: " In case you get up in the morning, you will get up with bliss."
hi: Ye hadees al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur Husain ki riwayat mein ye izafa hai: "Agar tum subah uThte ho, to tum khushhaali ke saath uThoge."

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Allah's Messenger (in may peace be upon him) commanded a person (in these words): When you go to bed during night, you should say:" O Allah, I surrender myself to Thee and entrust my affair to Thee, with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship but Thou). I affirm my faith in the Book which Thou revealed and in the Messengers whom Thou sent." If you die in this state you would die on Fitra, and Ibn Bashshdr did not make a mention of" night" in this hadith.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko hukum diya (in alfaazon mein): Jab tum raat ko bistar par jao, tumhe kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah, main khud ko Tujhe soonpta hoon aur apna maamla Tujhe daita hoon, Teri ummeed aur Tera Dar rakhte hue. (Mushkil se) chhutkaara dene wala aur (museebat se) bachne ki jagah koi nahi siwaay Tere. Main us Kitaab par imaan rakhta hoon jo Tune utaari aur un Rasoolon par jo Tune bheje." Agar tum is haalat mein mar jaate ho to tum Fitrat par maroge, aur Ibn Bashshar ne is hadees mein "raat" lafz ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a person: O, so and so, as you go to your bed; the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording that he said:" Thine Apostle whom Thou sent." If you die that night you would die on Fitra and if you get up in the morning you would get up with a bliss.
hi: Ye hadees al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs se kaha: Aye falan-falan, jab tum apne bistar par jao; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is alfaazon ke antar ke saath ki unhone kaha: "Tere bheje hue Rasool par." Agar tum us raat mar jaate ho to tum Fitrat par maroge aur agar tum subah uThte ho to tum khushhaali ke saath uThoge.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded a person (in these words) and there is no mention of this: " if you get up in the morning you would get up with a bliss."
hi: Ye hadees al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko hukum diya (in alfaazon mein) aur ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Agar tum subah uThte ho to tum khushhaali ke saath uThoge."

e: Al-Bara' reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he said: " O Allah, it is with Thine Name that I live and it is with Thine Name that I die." And when he got up he used to say:" Praise is due to Allah, Who gave us life after our death (sleep) and unto Thee is resurrection."
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bistar par jaate, woh kehte: "Aye Allah, Tere naam se main jeeta hoon aur Tere naam se main marta hoon." Aur jab woh uThte, woh kehte: "Sab hamd Allah ke liye hai, Jisne humein humaari maut (neend) ke baad zindagi di aur Teri hi taraf Punarutthaan hai."

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar commanded a person that as he went to bed, he should say: " O Allah, Thou created my being and it is for Thee to take it to its ultimate goal. And its death and life is due to Thee, and if Thou givest it life, safeguard it; and if Thou bringst death, grant it pardon. O Allah, I beg of Thee safety." A person said to him: Did you hear it from Umar? Thereupon he said: (I have heard from one) who is better than Umar, viz. from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Ibn Nafi, reported this on the authority of Abdullah b. Harith but he did not make mention of this" that he heard it himself".
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne ek shakhs ko hukum diya ki jab woh bistar par jaaye, use kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah, Tune mera wajood banaaya aur ise iske aakhri anjaam tak le jaana Tera hi kaam hai. Iski maut aur iski zindagi Tere hi haath mein hai, aur agar Tu ise zindagi deta hai, to iski hifaazat kar; aur agar Tu ise maut deta hai, to ise maafi de. Aye Allah, main Tujhse hifaazat maangta hoon." Ek shakhs ne unse kaha: Kya aapne ye Umar se suna? Isper unhone kaha: (Maine ise suna hai) us Hasti se jo Umar se behtar hain, yaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se. Ibn Nafi ne ise Abdullah bin Harith ki sanad se riwayat ki lekin unhone iska zikr nahi kiya ki unhone ise khud suna tha.

e: Suhail reported that Abu Salih used to command us (in these words): When any one of you intends to go to sleep, he should lie on the bed on his right side and then say:" O Allah. the Lord of the Heavens and the Lord of the Earth and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, our Lord, and the Lord of evervthina, the Splitter of the grain of corn and the datestone (or fruit kernal), the Revealer of Torah and Injil (Bible) and Criterion (the Holy Qur'an), I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of every- thing Thou art to sieze by the forelock (Thou hast perfect control over it). O Allah, Thou art the First, there is naught before Thee, and Thou art the Last and there is naught after Thee, and Thou art Evident and there is nothing above Thee, and Thou art Innermost and there is nothing beyond Thee. Remove the burden of debt from us and relieve us from want." Abu Salih used to narrate it from Abu Huraira who narrated it from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Suhail ne bayan kiya ki Abu Salih humein (in alfaazon mein) hukum diya karte the: Jab tum mein se koi sone ka iraada kare, use apni daayi taraf leTna chahiye aur phir kehna chahiye: "Aye Allah, Aasmaanon ke Rab aur Zameen ke Rab aur Shaandaar Arsh ke Rab, humaare Rab, aur har cheez ke Rab, anaaj ke daane aur khajoor ki gutli (ya phal ki gutli) ko phaadne waale, Torah, Injeel aur Furqaan (Pavitr Quran) ko nazil karne waale, main Teri panah maangta hoon har us cheez ki burai se jise Tu (uski peshaani se) pakadta hai (Tera ispar mukammal aadhipatya hai). Aye Allah, Tu Awwal hai, Tujhse pehle kuch nahi hai, aur Tu Aakhri hai aur Tere baad kuch nahi hai, aur Tu Zaahir hai aur Tujhse upar kuch nahi hai, aur Tu Baatin hai aur Tujhse pare kuch nahi hai. Humse karze ka bojh hata de aur humein zaroorat se mukt kar." Abu Salih ise Abu Huraira se riwayat karte the jinhone ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to command us that as we go to our bedo, we should utter the words (as mention- ed above) and he also said (these words): " From the evil of every animal, Thou hast hold upon its forelock (Thou bast full control over it)."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein hukum diya karte the ki jab hum apne bistar par jaayein, hum upar bataye gaye alfaaz padhein aur unhone ye (bhi) farmaaya: "Har jaanwar ki burai se, jiski peshaani Tere haath mein hai (Tera uspar poora ikhtiyar hai)."

e: Abu Huraira reported that Fatima (the daughter of the Holy Prophet) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for a servant. He said to her: Say:" O Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens" ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (Pavitr Nabi ki beti) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur ek naukar ki maang ki. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) unse kaha: Kaho: "Aye Allah, saat aasmaanon ke Rab"; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you goes to bed, he should take hold of the hem of his lower garment and then should clean (his bed) with the help of that and then should recite the name of Allah for he himself does not know what he left behind him on his bed, and when he intends to lie on bed, he should lie on his right side and utter these words:" Exalted is Allah (He is free from imperfection), my Lord. It is with Thine (grace) that I place my side (upon the bed) and it is with Thee that I take it up (after sleep), and in case You withhold my being (if You cause me to die), then grant pardon to my being, and if You keep (this process of breathing on), then protect it with that with which You protected Your pious servants."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi bistar par jaaye, use apne neeche ke kapde ke kinaare se apna bistar saaf karna chahiye aur phir Allah ka naam lena chahiye kyunki use khud nahi pata ki usne apne peeche apne bistar par kya chhoda hai, aur jab woh bistar par letne ka iraada kare, use apni daayi taraf letna chahiye aur ye alfaaz kehne chahiye: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), mere Rab. Ye Teri hi (meherbani) se hai ki main apna pehlu (bistar par) rakhta hoon aur Tera hi shukriya hai ki main ise (neend ke baad) uThAta hoon, aur agar Tu mera wajood rok le (agar Tu mujhe maut deta hai), to mere wajood ko maafi de, aur agar Tu ise (saans lene ki ye prakriya) jaari rakhta hai, to ise usi tarah mahfooz rakh jaise Tune Apne nekokaar bandon ki hifaazat ki hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ubaidullah b. Umar with the same chain of transmitters and he said: Then utter:" My Lord. with Thine name I place my side and if Thou keepest me alive have mercy upon myself"
hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Umar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: Phir kaho: "Mere Rab, Tere naam se main apna pehlu rakhta hoon aur agar Tu mujhe zinda rakhta hai to mujhpar rehmat kar."

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When you go to bed, say:" Praise is due to Allah Who fed us, provided us drink, sufficed us and provided us with shelter, for many a people there is none to suffice and none to provide shelter."
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum bistar par jao, kaho: "Sab hamd Allah ke liye hai Jisne humein khilaaya, humein pilaaya, humein kaafi diya aur humein panaah di, kyunki bahut se logon ke liye koi kaafi karne waala nahi hai aur koi panaah dene waala nahi hai."

e: Farwa' b. Naufal Ashja'i reported: I asked: 'A'isha, in what words did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicate Allah? She said that he used to utter:" I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I did and from the evil of what I did not."
hi: Farwa bint Naufal Ashja'i ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaunse alfaazon mein Allah se dua maangte the? Unhone kaha ki woh (ye alfaaz) kaha karte the: "Main Teri panah maangta hoon us burai se jo maine ki aur us burai se jo maine nahi ki."

e: Farwa' b. Naufal reported: I asked 'A'isha about the supplication that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made. She said that he used to say:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not done."
hi: Farwa bint Naufal ne bayan kiya: Maine Aisha (RA) se us dua ke baare mein poocha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) maangte the. Unhone kaha ki woh (ye alfaaz) kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon us burai se jo maine ki hai aur us burai se jo maine nahi ki."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. ja'far through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Muhammad bin Ja'far ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Farwa' b. Naufal reported on the authority of 'A'isha that Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I did and from the evil of what I did not."
hi: Farwa bint Naufal ne Aisha (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon us burai se jo maine ki aur us burai se jo maine nahi ki."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say: " O Allah, it is unto Thee that I surrender myself. I affirm my faith in Thee and repose my trust in Thee and turn to Thee in repentance and with Thy help fought my adversaries. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee with Thine Power; there is no god but Thou, lest Thou leadest me astray. Thou art ever-living that dieth not, while the Jinn and mankind die."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, main khud ko Tere hawaale karta hoon. Main Tujhpar imaan rakhta hoon aur Tujhpar bharosa karta hoon aur Teri taraf tauba karta hoon aur Teri madad se apne dushmanon se larai ki. Aye Allah, main Teri Taakat ki panah maangta hoon; Tere siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, kahin Tu mujhe gumraah na kar de. Tu hamesha zinda hai aur kabhi nahi marega, jabki jinn aur insaan marte hain."

e: Abu Huraira reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey in the morning, he used to say: " A listener listened to our praising Allah (for) His goodly trial of us. Our Lord! acompany us, guard us and bestow upon us Thy grace. I am seeker of refuge in Allah from the Fire."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah kisi safar par nikalte, woh kehte: "Ek sunne wale ne humaari Allah ki hamd suni Uski humaari behtareen azmaayish ke liye. Humaare Rab, humaare saath rah, humaari hifaazat kar aur humpar Apna fazl ata kar. Main Allah se Jahannam ki aag se panah maangta hoon."

e: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported on the authority of his father that Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate in these words: " O Allah, forgive me my faults, my ignorance, my immoderation in my concerns. And Thou art better aware (of my affairs) than myself. O Allah, grant me forgiveness (of the faults which I committed) seriously or otherwise (and which I committed inadvertently and de- liberately. All these (failings) are in me. O Allah, grant me forgiveness from the fault which I did in haste or deferred, which I committed in privacy or in public and Thou art better aware of (them) than myself. Thou art the First and the Last and over all things Thou art Omnipotent."
hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in alfaazon mein dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe meri khaamiyaan, meri anjaanpan aur apne maamlon mein meri ziyaadatiyaan maaf kar. Aur Tu mujhse zyada (mere maamlon ke baare mein) jaanta hai. Aye Allah, mujhe (un galtiyon ki) maafi de jo maine jaan-boojh kar ya bina soche-samjhe kiin (aur jo maine anjaane mein aur jaan-boojh kar kiin). Ye sab (khaamiyaan) mujhme hain. Aye Allah, mujhe us galti ki maafi de jo maine jaldbaazi mein ki ya der se ki, jo maine chhupkar ki ya khule taur par ki, aur Tu mujhse zyada (unke baare mein) jaanta hai. Tu Awwal hai aur Aakhir hai aur har cheez par Tu Qaadir hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. And set right for me the affairs of my world wherein is my living. And set right for me my Hereafter on which depends my after-life. And make the life for me (a source) of abundance for every good and make my death a source of comfort for me protecting me against every evil."
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, mere liye mera deen theek kar jo mere maamlon ki hifaazat hai. Aur mere liye meri duniya ke maamle theek kar jismein meri guzar-baseer hai. Aur mere liye meri Aakhirat theek kar jispar meri baad ki zindagi ka daaromadaar hai. Aur meri zindagi ko har achhaai ke liye izafe (ka srot) bana, aur meri maut ko mere liye sukoon ka srot bana, jo mujhe har burai se bachaaye."

e: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah. I beg of Thee the right guidance, safeguard against evils, chastity and freedom from want."
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, main Tujhse sahi margdarshan, buraiyon se hifaazat, paakizgi aur zaroorat se mukti maangta hoon."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ishaq ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zaid b. Alqam reported: I am not going to say anything but only that which Allah's Messenger (may peace be upgn him) used to say. He used to supplicate:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from incapacity, from sloth, from cowardice, from miserliness, decrepitude and from torment of the grave. O Allah, grant to my soul the sense of righteousness and purify it, for Thou art the Best Purifier thereof. Thou art the Protecting Friend thereof, and Guardian thereof. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the knowledge which does not benefit, from the heart that does not entertain the fear (of Allah), from the soul that does not feel contented and the supplication that is not responded."
hi: Zaid bin Alqam (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main sirf woh kahunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the. Woh ye dua maangte: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon lachaari se, susti se, buzdili se, kanjoosi se, budhape se aur qabar ke azaab se. Aye Allah, mere nafs ko taqwa ata kar aur ise paak kar, kyunki Tu ise paak karne wala Behtareen hai. Tu iska Sarparast aur Nigehbaan hai. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon us ilm se jo faayda-mand nahi hai, us dil se jo (Allah ka) Dar mehsoos nahi karta, us nafs se jo santusht nahi hota, aur us dua se jiska koi jawaab nahi milta."

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We entered upon evening and the whole Kingdom of Allah also entered upon evening and praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One Who has no partner with Him." Hasan said that Zubaid reported to him that he memorised it from Ibrahim in these very words." His is the Sovereignty and Praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything. O Allah, I beg of Thee the good of this night and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of this night and the evil which follows it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from torment in the Hell-Fire and from torment in the grave."
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi, aur hamd Allah ke liye hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jiska koi saathi nahi hai." Hasan ne kaha ki Zubaid ne unhe bataya ki unhone ise Ibrahim se in hi alfaazon mein yaad kiya tha: "Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur hamd Usi ke liye hai, aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Aye Allah, main Tujhse is raat ki bhalai maangta hoon aur main Teri panah maangta hoon is raat ki burai se aur uski burai se jo iske baad aati hai. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, ghamand ki burai se. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se aur qabar ke azaab se."

e: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We have entered upon evening and so, too, the whole Kingdom of Allah has entered upon evening. Praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One having no partner with Him." He (the narrator) said: I think that he also uttered (in this supplication these words):" His is tne Sovercignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything. My Lord, I beg of Thee good that lies in this night and good that follows it and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil that lies in this night and from the evil of that which follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from torment of the Hell-Fire and from torment of the grave." And when it was morning he said like this:" We entered upon morning and the whole Kingdom of Allah enter ed upon morning."
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi. Hamd Allah ke liye hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jiska koi saathi nahi hai." Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha (is dua mein): "Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur Usi ki hamd hai aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Mere Rab, main Tujhse is raat ki bhalai aur iske baad aane wali bhalai maangta hoon, aur main Teri panah maangta hoon is raat ki burai se aur uski burai se jo iske baad aati hai. Mere Rab, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, ghamand ki burai se. Mere Rab, main Teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se aur qabar ke azaab se." Aur jab subah hoti woh isi tarah kehte: "Humne subah mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi subah mein daakhil ho gayi."

e: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We have entered upon evening and so has the Kingdom of Allah entere d upon evening; praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah the One, and there is no partner with Him. O Allah, I beg of Thee the blessing of this night and the blessing of that which lies in it. I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of it and what lies in it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from decrepitude, from the evil of vanity, from trial of the world, and from torment of the grave." Zubaid, through another chain of transmitters, has narrated on the authority of Abdullah directly this addition:" There is no god but Allah, the One, there is no partner with Him, His is the Sovereignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything."
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi; hamd Allah ke liye hai, Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai. Aye Allah, main Tujhse is raat ki barkat aur ismein maujood barkat maangta hoon. Main iski burai se aur ismein maujood burai se Teri panah maangta hoon. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, budhape se, ghamand ki burai se, duniya ki azmaayish se, aur qabar ke azaab se." Zubaid ne, ek doosri sanad ke zariye, seedhe Abdullah se ye izafa riwayat ki: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai, Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur hamd Usi ke liye hai, aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenge; (ﷺ) used to supplicate thus: " There is no god but Allah, the One Who conferred upon His armies the honour of victory and helped His servant rout the clans; there is nothing after that."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jisne Apni fauj ko jeet ki izzat di aur Apne banda ki madad ki qabilon ko shikast dene mein; ismein baad kuch nahi hai."

e: 'Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Say," O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path," and when you make a mention of right guidance, keep in mind the right path and when you consider of the straight (path), keep in mind the straightness of the arrow.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Kaho, "Aye Allah, mujhe sahi raah dikha aur mujhe seedhi raah par kaayam rakh," aur jab tum sahi margdarshan ka zikr karo, seedhe raaste ko dhyaan mein rakho aur jab tum seedhepan ke baare mein sochte ho, teer ki seedhaayi ko dhyaan mein rakho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim b. Kulaib with the same chain of transmitters that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Say:" O Allah, I beg of Thee righteousness and adhering to the straight path."
hi: Ye hadees Asim bin Kulaib ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaaya: Kaho: "Aye Allah, main Tujhse nekokaari aur seedhe raaste par chalne ki taufeek maangta hoon."

e: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from (her apartment) in the morning as she was busy in observing her dawn prayer in her place of worship. He came back in the forenoon and she was still sitting there. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: You have been in the same seat since I left you. She said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I recited four words three times after I left you and if these are to be weighed against what you have recited since morning these would outweigh them and (these words) are:" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)."
hi: Juwairiya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (unke kamre se) subah bahar gaye jab woh apni ibadatgaah mein Fajr ki namaz mein masroof thin. Woh Chaasht (din chadhne) ke waqt wapas aaye aur woh abhi bhi wahin baithi thin. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) unse kaha: Tum jab se maine tumhe chhoda hai isi jagah baithi ho. Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Maine tumhe chhodne ke baad chaar alfaaz teen baar padhe aur agar inhe uske muqable rakha jaaye jo tumne subah se ab tak padha hai, ye unse zyada bhaari honge, aur (ye alfaaz hain): "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur Uski hamd hai Uski makhlooq ki tadaad ke mutabik aur Uski khud ki khushi ke mutabik aur Uske Arsh ke wazan ke mutabik aur Uski (hamd ke) alfaazon ko darj karne mein istemal hone wali roshnaai ke mutabik."

e: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by her as she was observing her dawn prayer; or after she had observed her dawn prayer. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that he said: " Hallowed be Allah according to the number of His creation, hallowed be Allah according to the pleasure of His Self, hallowed be Allah according to the weight of His Throne, hallowed be Allah according to the ink used in recording His words."
hi: Juwairiya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas se guzre jab woh Fajr ki namaz mein masroof thin; ya unki Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki unhone farmaaya: "Allah pavitra hai Uski makhlooq ki tadaad ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uski khud ki khushi ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uske Arsh ke wazan ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uske alfaazon ko darj karne mein istemal hone wali roshnaai ke mutabik."

e: It is reported on the authority of Ali that Fatima had corns in her hand because of working at the hand-mill. There had fallen to the lot of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) some prisoners of war. She (Fatima) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) but she did not find him (in the house). She met A'isha and informed her (about her hardship). When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came, she (A'isha) informed him about the visit of Fatima. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them (Fatima and her family). They had gone to their beds. 'Ali further (reported): We tried to stand up (as a mark of respect) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Keep to your beds, and he sat amongst us and I felt the coldness of his feet upon my chest. He then said: May I not direct you to something better than what you have asked for? When you go to your bed, you should recite Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) thirty-four times and Tasbih (Subhan Allah) thirty-three times and Tahmid (al-Hamdu li-Allah) thirty-three times, and that is better than the servant for you.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke haathon par chakki chalaane ki wajah se ghaTTe pad gaye the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jung ke kuch qaidi aaye the. Woh (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayin lekin unhe (ghar mein) nahi paaya. Woh Aisha (RA) se milin aur unhe (apni mushkil ke baare mein) bataya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, unhone (Aisha ne) unhe Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke aane ke baare mein bataya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke (Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aur unke khaandaan ke) paas aaye. Woh apne bistar par ja chuke the. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage (riwayat ki): Humne khade hone ki koshish ki (samman ke nishaan ke soorat mein) lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Apne bistar par hi raho, aur woh humaare beech baith gaye aur maine unke paon ki Thandak apne seene par mehsoos ki. Phir unhone farmaaya: Kya main tumhe usse behtar cheez na bataun jo tumne maanga hai? Jab tum apne bistar par jao, tumhe Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) chauntis (34) baar aur Tasbeeh (Subhan Allah) tettis (33) baar aur Tahmeed (al-Hamdu Lillah) tettis (33) baar padhni chahiye, aur ye tumhaare liye naukar se behtar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but. with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Laili but with this addition: " Ali said: Ever since I heard this (supplication) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), I never abandoned it. It was said to him, Not even in the night of Siffin (battle of Siffin)? He sad: Yes, not even in the night of Siffin,"
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Laila ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Jab se maine ye (dua) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni hai, maine ise kabhi nahi chhoda. Unse poocha gaya: Siffin ki raat bhi nahi? Unhone kaha: Haan, Siffin ki raat bhi nahi (chhoda)."

e: Abu Huraira reported that Fatima came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for a servant and told him of the hardship of household work. He said: You would not be able to get a servant from us. May I not direct you to what is better than the servant for you? Recite Subhaana Allah thirty-three times, al- Hamdu li-Allah thirty-three times and Allah-o-Akbar thirty-four times as you go to bed. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur naukar ki maang ki aur unhe ghar ke kaam ki mushkil bataayi. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Tumhe humaare paas se naukar nahi milega. Kya main tumhe naukar se behtar cheez na bataun? Jab tum bistar par jao Subhan Allah tettis baar, al-Hamdu Lillah tettis baar aur Allahu Akbar chauntis baar padho. Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing. When you listen to the crowing of the cock, ask Allah for His favour as it sees Angels and when you listen to the braying of the donkey, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan for it sees Satan.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum murgi ki bang sunte ho, Allah se Uska fazl maango kyunki woh Farishton ko dekhta hai, aur jab tum gadhe ki aawaaz sunte ho, Shaitaan se Allah ki panah maango kyunki woh Shaitaan ko dekhta hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate during the time of trouble (in these words): " There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Tolerant, there is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Heaven and the earth, the Lord of the Edifying Throne."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mushkil ke waqt ye dua maangte the: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Buzurg hai, Sahansheel hai; Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Shaandaar Arsh ka Rab hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Rab hai, izzat waale Arsh ka Rab hai."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (with these words) and he (uttered these words) at the time of trouble; the rest of the hadith is the same except with this difference that insted of saying: " The Lord of heaven and the earth," he said:" The Lord of the heaven and that of the earth."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte (in alfaazon mein) aur unhone mushkil ke waqt (ye alfaaz) kahe; baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is antar ke ki "Aasmaan aur Zameen ka Rab" kehne ki jagah unhone kaha: "Aasmaan ka aur Zameen ka Rab."

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a sliglit variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked as to which words were the best. He said: Those for which Allah made a choice for His Angels and His servants (and the words are):" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him."
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki kaunse alfaaz sabse behtareen hain. Unhone farmaaya: Woh jinke liye Allah ne Apne Farishton aur Apne bandon ke liye pasand kiya (aur woh alfaaz hain): "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur hamd Usi ke liye hai."

e: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Should I not inform you about the words liked most by Allah? I said: Allah's Mes- senger, do inform me about the words liked most by Allah. He said: Verily, the words liked most by Allah are:" hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him."
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya main tumhe un alfaazon ke baare mein na bataun jo Allah ko sabse zyada pasand hain? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe Allah ko sabse zyada pasand alfaazon ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ko sabse zyada pasand alfaaz hain: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur hamd Usi ke liye hai."

e: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no believing servant who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence) that the Angels do not say: The same be for you too.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Koi bhi imaandaar banda nahi hai jo apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein dua maange lekin Farishte ye na kahen: Tumhare liye bhi wahi ho.

e: Umm Darda' reported: My husband reported that he heard Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) as saying: He who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence), the Angel commissioned (for carrying supplication to his Lord) says: Amen, and it is for you also.
hi: Umm Darda (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere pati (Abu Darda) ne bataya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein dua maangta hai, muqarrar Farishta kehta hai: Aameen, aur tumhaare liye bhi wahi ho.

e: Safwan (and he was Ibn 'Abdullah b. Safwan, and he had been married to Umm Darda') reported: I visited Abu Darda's house in Syria. I did not find him there but Umm Darda' (was present at the house). She said: Do you intend to perform Hajj during this year? I said: Yes. She said: Do supplicate Allah for blessings upon us, for Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon hiin) used to say: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother at his back (in his absence) is responded so long as he makes a supplica- tion for blessings for his brother and the commissioned Angel says: Amen, and says: May it be for you too I I went to the bazar and met Abfi Dardi' and he narrated like this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Safwan (jo Ibn Abdullah bin Safwan the, aur unki shaadi Umm Darda se hui thi) ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Darda ke ghar Syria mein gaya. Maine unhe wahan nahi paaya lekin Umm Darda (ghar mein) maujood thin. Unhone kaha: Kya aap is saal Hajj karne ka iraada rakhte hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Humaare liye barkat ki dua maango, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the: Kisi Musalman ki apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein maangi gayi dua qubool ki jaati hai jab tak woh apne bhai ke liye barkaton ki dua maangta hai aur muqarrar Farishta kehta hai: Aameen, aur kehta hai: Tumhaare liye bhi wahi ho! Main bazaar gaya aur Abu Darda se mila aur unhone bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah riwayat ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Safwan b. 'Abdullah b. Safwan with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Safwan bin Abdullah bin Safwan ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne us banda se khush hota hai jo khaane ka ek Lokma khaate waqt aur peete waqt al-Hamdu Lillah kehta hai.

e: This hadith is reported through Ishaaq bin Yusuf Al-Azraq from Zakariyya bin Abi Za'ida through the same chain.
hi: Ye hadees Ishaq bin Yusuf al-Azraq ke zariye Zakariyya bin Abu Zaida se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The supplication of every one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and says: I supplicated but it was not granted.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se har ek ki dua qubool ki jaati hai agar woh betaab na ho aur ye na kahe: Maine dua maangi thi lekin ye qubool nahi hui.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The supplication of one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and say- I supplicated my Lord but it was not granted.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se kisi ki dua qubool ki jaati hai agar woh betaab na ho aur ye na kahe: Maine apne Rab se dua maangi thi lekin ye qubool nahi hui.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The supplication of the servant is granted in case he does not supplicate for sin or for severing the ties of blood, or he does not become impatient. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what does:" If he does not grow impatient" imply? He said: That he should say like this: I supplicated and I supplicated but I did not find it being responded. and theu he becomes frustrated and abandons supplication.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banda ki dua qubool ki jaati hai jab tak woh gunah ke liye ya rishtedaari ke rishte todne ke liye dua na maange, ya woh betaab na ho. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, "agar woh betaab na ho" ka kya matlab hai? Unhone farmaaya: Ki woh ye kahe: Maine dua maangi aur maine dua maangi lekin maine ise qubool hote nahi paaya, aur phir woh mayoos ho jaata hai aur dua maangna chhod deta hai.

e: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: I stood at the door of Paradise and I found that the overwhelming majority of those who entered therein was that of poor persons and the wealthy persons were detained to get into that. The denizens of Hell were commanded to get into Hell, and I stood upon the door of Fire and the majority amongst them who entered there was that of women.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main Jannat ke darwaze par khada hua aur maine paaya ki jo log bade paimaane par usmein daakhil huye woh gareeb log the, jabki daulatmand logon ko rok kar rakha gaya tha usmein daakhil hone se. Jahannam ke bashindon ko Jahannam mein daakhil hone ka hukum diya gaya, aur main Jahannam ki aag ke darwaze par khada hua aur unmein se bade paimaane par jo log usmein daakhil huye woh auraten thin.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I had a chance to look into the Paradise and I found that majority of the people was poor and I looked into the Fire and there I found the majority constituted by women.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhe Jannat mein jhaankne ka mauka mila aur maine paaya ki zyaadatar log gareeb the, aur maine Jahannam ki aag mein jhaanka aur wahan maine paaya ki zyaadatar log auraten thin.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stated like this: He looked into the Fire of Hell. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi tarah farmaaya: Unhone Jahannam ki aag mein jhaanka. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: This hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Imran b. Husain reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Amongst the inmates of Paradise the women would form a minority.
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat ke bashindon mein auraten kam tadaad mein hongi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mutarrif through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Mutarrif ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicated in these words: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the withdrawal of Thine blessing and the change of Thine protection (from me) and from the sudden wrath of Thine, and from every displeasure of Thine."
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in alfaazon mein dua maangte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon Teri barkaton ke chhin jaane se aur Teri hifaazat ke (mujhse) badal jaane se, aur Tere achaanak gusse se, aur Teri har naaraazgi se."

e: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have not left after me any (chance) of turmoil more injurious to men than the harm done to the men because of women.
hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine apne baad mardon ke liye auraton ki wajah se jitna nuksaandeh fitna chhoda hai, koi doosra fitna nahi chhoda.

e: Usama b. Zaid b. Harith and Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Naufal both reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have not left after me turmoil for the people but the harm done to men by women.
hi: Usama bin Zaid bin Harith aur Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Naufal (RA) donon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine logon ke liye apne baad auraton ki wajah se mardon ko hone wale nuksaan se badhkar koi fitna nahi chhoda.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The world is sweet and green (alluring) and verily Allah is going to install you as vicegerent in it in order to see how you act. So avoid the allurement of women: verily, the first trial for the people of Isra'il was caused by women. And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bashshar the words are:" So that He should see how you act."
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Duniya meethi aur hariyaali (lubhaawani) hai aur yaqeenan Allah tumhe ismein apna khalifa (naib) banaane wala hai ye dekhne ke liye ki tum kaise amal karte ho. Isliye auraton ke lalach se bacho: yaqeenan, Bani Isra'il ke logon ke liye pehli azmaayish auraton ki wajah se aayi thi. Aur Ibn Bashshar ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Taaki Woh dekh sake ki tum kaise amal karte ho."

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Three persons set out on a journey. They were overtaken by rain and they had to find protection in a mountain cave where at its mouth there fell a rock of that mountain and thus blocked them altogether. One of them said to the others: Look to your good deeds that you performed for the sake of Allah and then supplicate Allah, the Exalted, that He might rescue you (from this trouble). One of them said: 0 Allah, I had my parents who were old and my wife and my small children also. I tended the flock and when I came back to them in the evening, I milked them (the sheep, goats, cows, etc.) and first served that milk to my parents. One day I was obliged to go out to a distant place in search of fodder and I could not come back before evening and found them (the parents) asleep. I milked the animals as I used to milk and brought milk to them and stood by their heads avoiding to disturb them from sleep and I did not deem it advisable to serve milk to my children before serving them. My children wept near my feet. I remained there in that very state and my parents too until it was morning. And (0 Allah) if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, grant us riddance from this trouble. (The rock slipped a bit) that they could see the sky. The second one said: 0 Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved more than the men love the women. I wanted to have sexual intercourse with her; she refused but on the condition of getting one hundred dinirs. It was with very great difficulty that I could collect one hundred dinirs and then paid them to her and when I was going to have a sexual intercourse with her, that she said: Servant of Allah, fear Allah and do not break the seal (of chastity) but by lawful means. I got up. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, rid us from this trouble. The situation was somewhat eased for them. The third one said: Allah, I employed a workman for a measure of rice. After he had finished his work I gave him his dues (in the form of) a measure of rice, but he did not accept them. I used these rice as seeds, and that gave a bumper crop and I became rich enough to have cows and flocks (in my possession). He came to me and said: Fear Allah, and commit no crueltv upon me in regard to my dues. I said to him: Takeaway this flock of cows and sheep. He said: Fear Allah and do not make a fun of me. I said: I am not making a fun of you. You take the cows and the flocks. So he took them. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did it for Thine pleasure, case the situation for us. And Allah relieved them from the rest of the trouble.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Teen log ek safar par nikle. Barish ne unhe apni chapet mein le liya aur unhe ek pahaad ki ghufa mein hifaazat dhoondhni padi jiske munh par us pahaad ki ek chattaan gir padi aur unhe poori tarah bandI bana diya. Unmein se ek ne doosron se kaha: Apne un nekokaar amalon ko dekho jo tumne Allah ki khaatir kiye, aur phir Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, se dua maango ki Woh tumhe (is museebat se) chhutkaara de. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere boodhe maa-baap the, aur meri zauja aur mere chhote bachche bhi. Main bhedon ko charaata tha aur jab main shaam ko unke paas wapas aata, main unka doodh nikaalta aur sabse pehle apne maa-baap ko pilaata. Ek din mujhe chaara dhoondne door jaana pada aur main shaam se pehle wapas nahi aa saka aur unhe (maa-baap ko) sote hue paaya. Maine jaanwaron ka doodh nikaala jaisa main aksar nikaalta tha aur unke paas doodh laaya aur unke sar ke paas khada raha, unhe neend se jagaana napasand karte hue, aur maine ye theek nahi samjha ki apne bachchon ko unse pehle doodh pilaaun. Mere bachche mere paon ke qareeb rote rahe. Main isi haalat mein raha aur mere maa-baap bhi yahan tak ki subah ho gayi. Aur (aye Allah) agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. (Chattaan thoda hili) ki woh aasmaan dekh sake. Doosre ne kaha: Aye Allah, meri ek chachaazaad thi jisse main utni hi muhabbat karta tha jitni koi mard aurat se karta hai. Maine usse jinsi ta'alluq banaane ki khwaish jataayi; usne inkaar kiya lekin ek sau dinar dene ki shart par (maan gayi). Bahut mushkil se main sau dinar ikattha kar paaya aur unhe usse diye aur jab main uske saath jinsi ta'alluq banaane hi wala tha, usne kaha: Allah ke banda, Allah se Dar aur is muhar (pavitrata) ko na tod siwaay munasib tareeke ke. Main uT gaya. Aye Allah, agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. Haalat unke liye kuch aasaan ho gayi. Teesre ne kaha: Aye Allah, maine ek mazdoor ko chaawal ki ek naap ke badle kaam par rakha. Jab usne apna kaam poora kar liya, maine use uska mehnataana (chaawal ki us naap ke soorat mein) diya, lekin usne ise qubool nahi kiya. Maine woh chaawal beej ke soorat mein istemal kiye, aur isse bahut bhaari fasal huyi aur main itna daulatmand ho gaya ki mere paas gaayen aur bhedein hui. Woh mere paas aaya aur kaha: Allah se Dar, aur mere haq ke maamle mein mujhpar koi zulm mat kar. Maine usse kaha: (In) gaayon aur bhedon ka rewad le jao. Usne kaha: Allah se Dar, aur mera mazaak mat udaa. Maine kaha: Main tumhaara mazaak nahi udaa raha. Ye gaayen aur rewad le lo. To usne unhe le liya. Aye Allah, agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. Aur Allah ne unhe baaki museebat se bhi mukt kar diya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Musa b. 'Uqba but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Musa bin Uqba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b 'Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Three persons belonging to the earlier Ummahs set out on a journey until they had to spend a night in a cave. The rest of the hadith is the same and the additional words are:" A person amongst them said: O Allah, I had my aged parents and I served them milk before I (served that) to my wife, children and my servants." And in case of the second one, the words are: "She avoided me until she was hard pressed because of famine and she came to me and I gave her one hundred and twenty dinars." And in case of the third one (the words are):" I invested his wages, and it brought profit and, as a result thereof, the merchandise increased and there was an abundance of goods." And he (the narrator said) that they got out of the cave and began to walk.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Purani Ummaton mein se teen log ek safar par nikle yahan tak ki unhe ek ghufa mein raat guzaarni padi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ye izafi alfaaz hain: "Unmein se ek ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere boodhe maa-baap the aur maine unhe apni zauja, bachchon aur apne naukaron se pehle doodh pilaya." Aur doosre ke maamle mein, alfaaz hain: "Woh mujhse bachti rahi yahan tak ki woh akaal ki wajah se sakht museebat mein aa gayi aur mere paas aayi aur maine use ek sau bees dinar diye." Aur teesre ke maamle mein (alfaaz hain): "Maine uski mazdoori mein paisa laga diya, aur isse munafa hua aur natijatan, saamaan mein bahutayat aa gayi." Aur unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki woh ghufa se bahar aaye aur chalne lage.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: I live in the thought of My servant and I am with him as he remembers Me. (The Holy Prophet) further said: By Allah, Allah is more pleased wth the repentance of His servant than what one of you would do on finding the lost camel in the waterless desert. When he draws near Me by the span of his hand. I draw near him by the length of a cubit and when he draws near Me by the length of a cubit. I draw near him by the length of a fathom and when he draws near Me walking I draw close to him hurriedly.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Main apne banda ke saath uski soch mein rehta hoon aur main uske saath hoon jab woh Mujhe yaad karta hai. (Pavitr Nabi ne) aage farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jitna khush tum mein se koi hoga apna gum hua oont bina paani ki registaani zameen mein paakar. Jab woh ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek Fathom (baazuon ki poori lambaai) ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh chalte hue Mere qareeb aata hai, Main jaldi se uski taraf aata hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant when he turns penitently towards Him than one of you would be on finding the lost camel.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jab woh pachhtaawe ke saath Uski taraf mudta hai, us khushi se jo tum mein se kisi ko apna gum hua oont paakar hoti hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Harith b. Suwaid said: I went to see 'Abdullah to inquire about his health as he was sick and he narrated to us a hadith of Allahs Messenger (ﷺ). He heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His believing servant than a person who loses his riding beast carrying food and drink. He sleeps (being disappointed of its recovery) and then gets up and goes in search for that, until he is stricken with thirst. then comes back to the place where he had been before and goes to sleep completely exhausted placing his head upon his hands waiting for death. And when he gets up, lot there is before him his riding beast and his provisions of food and drink. Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the recovery of this riding beast along with the provisions (of food and drink).
hi: Harith bin Suwaid ne kaha: Main Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) se milne gaya unki tabiyat poochne kyunki woh bimaar the, aur unhone humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek hadees riwayat ki. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah apne imaandaar banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jitna us shakhs ko hoga jiska sawaari waala jaanwar, jispar khaana aur paani laada hua ho, gum ho jaaye. Woh (mayoosi mein) so jaata hai aur phir uThta hai aur use dhoondhne nikalta hai, yahan tak ki uski pyaas se haalat kharaab ho jaati hai. Phir woh usi jagah wapas aata hai jahan woh pehle tha aur poori tarah thak-haar kar apne haathon par sar rakhkar so jaata hai, maut ka intezaar karta hua. Aur jab woh uThta hai, dekho, uske saamne uska sawaari waala jaanwar hai aur khaana aur paani ka saamaan bhi. Allah apne banda ki tauba se, us sawaari waale jaanwar aur uske saath saamaan ke milne se zyada khush hota hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a believing man. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ek imaandaar aadmi ki tauba se zyada khush hota hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a believing servant than of a person who set out on a journey with a provision of food and drink on the back of his camel. He went on until he came to a waterless desert and he felt like sleeping. So he got down under the shade of a tree and was overcome by sleep and his camel ran away. As he got up he tried to see (the camel) standing upon a mound. but did not find it. He then got upon the other mound, but could not see anything. He then climbed upon the third mound but did not see anything until he came back to the place where he had been previously. And as he was sitting (in utter disappointment) there came to him the camel, till that (camel) placed its nosestring in his hand. Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the person who found (his lost camel) in this very state. Simak reported that Sha'bi was of the opinion that Nu'min traced it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Simak, however, did not hear that himself.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah apne imaandaar banda ki tauba se us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jo apne oont ki peeth par khaane aur paani ka saamaan lekar ek safar par nikla. Woh chalta gaya yahan tak ki woh ek bina paani ki registaani zameen tak pahuncha aur usse neend aane lagi. Isliye woh ek darakht ki chhaaya mein utra aur usse neend ne aa gheera aur uska oont bhaag gaya. Jab woh utha, usne (oont ko) ek Tille par khada dekhna chaaha, lekin use nahi paaya. Phir woh doosre Tille par chadha, lekin use kuch nazar nahi aaya. Phir woh teesre Tille par chadha lekin use kuch nazar nahi aaya, yahan tak ki woh wapas usi jagah aa gaya jahan woh pehle tha. Aur jab woh (poori tarah niraash) wahan baitha tha, oont uske paas aaya, yahan tak ki us (oont) ne apni naak ki rassi uske haath mein rakh di. Allah apne banda ki tauba se, us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jo (apna gum hua oont) is haalat mein paaye. Simak ne bayaan ki ki Sha'bi ki raay thi ki Nu'man ne ise Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchaya, lekin Simak ne ise khud (Nu'man se) nahi suna.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is your opinion about the delight of a person whose camel loaded with the provisions of food and drink is lost and that moves about with its nosestring trailing upon the waterless desert in which there is neither food nor drink, and lie wanders about in search of that until he is completely exhausted and then accidentally it happens to pass by the trunk of a tree and its nosestring gets entangled in that and he finds it entangled therein? He (in response to the question of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, he would feel highly delighted. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. By Allah, Allah is more delighted at the repentance of His servant than that person (as he finds his lost) camel.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaari kya raay hai us shakhs ki khushi ke baare mein jiska oont, khaane aur paani ke saamaan ke saath, gum ho jaata hai aur woh apni naak ki latakti rassi ke saath bina paani ki registaani zameen mein ghoomta hai jahan na khaana hai na paani, aur woh use dhoondhte huye ghoomta hai yahan tak ki woh poori tarah thak-haar jaata hai aur phir achaanak ye ek darakht ke tane ke paas se guzarta hai aur uski naak ki rassi usmein uljh jaati hai aur usse ye uljhi hui mil jaati hai? Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ke sawaal ke jawaab mein) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, use bahut khushi hogi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, Allah apne banda ki tauba se us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jise (apna gum hua) oont mile.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a servant as he turns towards Him for repentance than this that one amongst you is upon the camel in a waterless desert and there is upon (that camel) his provision of food and drink also and it is lost by him, and he having lost all hope (to get tbat) lies down in the shadow and is disappointed about his camel and there he finds that camel standing before him. He takes hold of his nosestring and then out of boundless joy says: 0 Lord, Thou art my servant and I am Thine Lord. He commits this mistake out of extreme delight.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne banda ki tauba se, jab woh Uski taraf tauba mein mudta hai, usse zyada khush hota hai is baat se ki tum mein se koi apne oont par ho bina paani ki registaani zameen mein aur uspar (oont par) uska khaane aur paani ka saamaan bhi ho aur woh use gum de baithe, aur poori tarah ummeed khoke chhaaya mein leT jaaye aur apne oont se mayoos ho jaaye aur wahan use apne saamne khada wahi oont mile. Woh uski naak ki rassi thaam leta hai aur phir behad khushi mein kehta hai: Aye Rab, Tu mera banda hai aur main Tera Rab hoon. Woh behad khushi ki wajah se ye galti karta hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than if one of you gets up and he finds his camel missing in a waterless desert (and then he accidentally finds it). This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai is baat se ki tum mein se koi uThe aur apna oont bina paani ki registaani zameen mein gum paaye (aur phir achaanak use paa le). Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sirma reported that when the time of the death of Abu Ayyub Ansari drew near, he said: I used to conceal from you a thing which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Had you not committed sins, Allah would have brought into existence a creation that would have committed sin (and Allah) would have forgiven them.
hi: Abu Sirma ne bayan kiya ki jab Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) ki maut ka waqt qareeb aaya, unhone kaha: Main tumse ek baat chhupaya karta tha jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar tum gunah na karte, Allah aisi makhlooq banaata jo gunah karti (aur Allah) unhe maaf kar deta.

e: Abu Ayyub Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you were not to commit sins, Allah would have swept you out of existence and would have replaced you by another people who have committed sin, and then asked forgiveness from Allah, and He would have granted them pardon.
hi: Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar tum gunah na karte, Allah tumhe zameen se hataakar tumhaari jagah aise doosre log laata jo gunah karte, aur phir Allah se maafi maangte, aur Woh unhe maafi deta.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if you were not to commit sin, Allah would sweep you out of existence and He would replace (you by) those people who would commit sin and seek forgiveness from Allah, and He would have pardoned them.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar tum gunah na karte, Allah tumhe zameen se hataakar tumhaari jagah aise log laata jo gunah karte aur Allah se maafi maangte, aur Woh unhe maaf kar deta.

e: Hanzala Usayyidi, who was amongst the scribes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). reported: I met Abu Bakr. He said: Who are you? He (Hanzala) said: Hanzala has turned to be a hypocrite. He (Abu Bakr) said: Hallowed be Allah, what are you saying? Thereupon he said: I say that when we are in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we ponder over Hell-Fire and Paradise as if we are seeing them with our very eyes and when we are away from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we attend to our wives, our children, our business; most of these things (pertaining to After-life) slip out of our minds. Abu Bakr said: By Allah, I also experience the same. So I and Abu Bakr went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: Allah's Messenger, Hanzala has turned to be a hypocrite. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you? I said: Allah's Messenger, when we are in your company, we are reminded of Hell-Fire and Paradise as if we are seeing them with our own eyes, but whenever we go away from you and attend to our wives, children and business, much of these things go out of our minds. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if your state of mind remains the same as it is in my presence and you are always busy in remembrance (of Allah), the Angels will shake hands with you in your beds and in your paths but, Hanzala, time should be devoted (to the worldly affairs) and time (should be devoted to prayer and meditation). He (the Holy Prophet) said this thrice.
hi: Hanzala Usayyidi, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke likhne walon (katibon) mein se the, ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Bakr se mila. Unhone kaha: Tum kaise ho? Unhone (Hanzala ne) kaha: Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Unhone (Abu Bakr ne) kaha: Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), tum ye kya keh rahe ho? Isper unhone kaha: Main kehta hoon ki jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein hote hain hum Jahannam ki aag aur Jannat ke baare mein isi tarah sochte hain jaise hum unhe apni khud ki aankhon se dekh rahe hon, aur jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se door hote hain hum apni zaujaon, apne bachchon, apne dhandhon mein masroof ho jaate hain; inmein se zyaadatar cheezein (Aakhirat se mutaliq) humaare zehan se nikal jaati hain. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe bhi yehi mehsoos hota hai. Isliye main aur Abu Bakr, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jab hum aapki sohbat mein hote hain, humein Jahannam ki aag aur Jannat ki yaad aati hai jaise hum unhe apni khud ki aankhon se dekh rahe hon, lekin jab bhi hum aapse door jaate hain aur apni zaujaon, bachchon aur dhandhon mein masroof hote hain, inmein se bahut si cheezein humaare zehan se nikal jaati hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar tumhaari mansik haalat wahi rahe jo meri maujoodgi mein hoti hai aur tum hamesha (Allah ke) Zikr mein masroof raho, Farishte tumse apne bistaron par aur apne raaston par haath milaayenge, lekin, Hanzala, waqt (duniyaavi maamlon ke liye) alag rakha jaana chahiye aur waqt (namaz aur dhyaan ke liye bhi). Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) ye teen baar farmaaya.

e: Hanzala reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he delivered to us a sermon and made a mention of Hell-Fire. Then I came to my house and began to laugh with my children and sport with my wife. (Hanzala) further reported: I went out and met Abu Bakr and made a mention of that to him. Thereupon he said: I have done the same as you have mentioned. So we went to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: Allah's Messenger, Hanzala has turned to he a hypocrite. And he (the Holy Prophet) said Show respite. And then I narrated to him the story, and Abu Bakr said: I have done the same as he has done. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Hanzala, there is a time for worldly affairs and a time for (worship and devotion), and if your state of mind is always the same as it is at the time of remembrance of Allah, the Angels would shake hands with you and would greet you on the path by saying: As-Salamu-Alaikum.
hi: Hanzala ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur unhone humein khutba diya aur Jahannam ki aag ka zikr kiya. Phir main apne ghar aaya aur apne bachchon ke saath hansne laga aur apni zauja ke saath khelne laga. (Hanzala ne) aage bataya: Main bahar nikla aur Abu Bakr se mila aur unhe iska zikr kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Maine bhi wahi kiya hai jo tumne bataya. Isliye hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Aur unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) kaha: Rukhsat do (aisa keh kar khud ko dosh mat do). Aur phir maine unhe poori kahani sunayi, aur Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine bhi wahi kiya hai jo unhone kiya. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Hanzala, duniyaavi maamlon ke liye ek waqt hai aur (ibadat aur bandagi ke liye) ek waqt hai, aur agar tumhaari mansik haalat hamesha wahi rahe jo Allah ke Zikr ke waqt hoti hai, Farishte tumse haath milaayenge aur tumhe raaste par as-Salamu-Alaikum kahenge.

e: Hanzala Taimi Ufayyidi, the scribe of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported: We were in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he brought to our minds the problems pertaining to Paradise and Hell-Fire. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Hanzala Taimi Usayyidi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke likhne wale, ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein the aur unhone humaare zehan mein Jannat aur Jahannam ki aag se mutaliq maamlon ko taaza kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When Allah created the creation as He was upon the Throne, He put down in His Book: Verily, My mercy predominates My wrath.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Allah ne makhlooqaat banaayi jab Woh Arsh par tha, Usne Apni Kitaab mein ye darj kiya: Yaqeenan, Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: My mercy excels My wrath.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah created the creation, He ordained for Himself and this document is with Him: Verily, My mercy predominates Mv wrath.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Allah ne makhlooqaat banaayi, Usne Apne liye ye muqarrar kiya, aur ye dastaavez Uske paas hai: Yaqeenan, Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah created mercy in one hundred parts and He retained with Him ninety-nine parts, and He has sent down upon the earth one part, and it is because of this one part that there is mutual love among the creation so much so that the animal lifts up its hoof from its young one, fearing that it might harm it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne Rehmat ko sau hisson mein banaaya aur Unnyaave (99) hisse Apne paas rakhe, aur Usne ek hissa zameen par nazil kiya, aur isi ek hisse ki wajah se makhlooqaat mein aapsi muhabbat hai, itni ki jaanwar apne bachche par se apna khur is Dar se uThA leta hai ki kahin use koi nuksaan na pahunche.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah created one hundred (parts of mercy) and He distributed one amongst His creation and kept this one hundred excepting one with Himself (for the Day of Resurrection).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne sau (Rehmat ke hisse) banaaye aur ek hissa Apni makhlooq mein baanta aur ye sau hisse, ek ke ilawa, Apne paas rakhe (Qayamat ke din ke liye).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are one hundred (parts of) mercy for Allah and He has sent down out of these one part of mercy upon the jinn and human beings and animals and the insects, and it is because of this (one part) that they love one another, show kindness to one another and even the beast treats its young one with affection, and Allah has reserved ninety nine parts of mercy with which He would treat His servants on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke paas sau (hisson mein) Rehmat hai aur Usne inmein se ek hissa jinn, insaanon, jaanwaron aur keede-makode par nazil kiya, aur isi (ek hisse) ki wajah se woh ek-doosre se muhabbat karte hain, ek-doosre ke saath meherbaani se pesh aate hain aur jaanwar tak apne bachche ke saath narmi se pesh aata hai, aur Allah ne Rehmat ke ninnyaave (99) hisse apne paas rakhe hain jinse Woh Qayamat ke din Apne bandon ke saath vyavahaar karega.

e: Salman Farisi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, there are one hundred (parts of) mercy for Allah, and it is one part of this mercy by virtue of which there is mutual love between the people and ninety-nine reserved for the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Salman Farsi (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah ke paas sau (hisson mein) Rehmat hai, aur is Rehmat ka ek hissa woh hai jiski wajah se logon mein aapsi muhabbat hai, aur ninnyaave (99) Qayamat ke din ke liye rakhe gaye hain.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Mu'tamir, reported on the authority of his father.
hi: Ye hadees Mu'tamir ki sanad se apne waalid se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Salman reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily, Allah created, on the same very day when He created the heavens and the earth, one hundred parts of mercy. Every part of mercy is coextensive with the space between the heavens. and the earth and He out of this mercy endowed one part to the earth and it is because of this that the mother shows affection to her child and even the beasts and birds show kindness to one another and when there would be the Day of Resurrection, Allah would make full (use of Mercy).
hi: Salman (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne, usi din jab Usne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye, sau (hisson mein) Rehmat banaayi. Rehmat ka har hissa aasmaan aur zameen ke beech ki jagah jitna vishaal hai, aur Usne is Rehmat mein se ek hissa zameen ko diya, aur isi ki wajah se ek maa apne bachche ko muhabbat dikhaati hai aur yahan tak ki jaanwar aur parinde bhi ek-doosre ke saath meherbaani se pesh aate hain, aur jab Qayamat ka din aayega, Allah Rehmat ka poora istemal karega.

e: 'Umar b. Khattab reported that there were brought some prisoners to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst whom there was also a woman, who was searching (for someone) and when she found a child amongst the prisoners, she took hold of it, pressed it against her chest and provided it suck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you think this woman would ever afford to throw her child in the Fire? We said: By Allah, so far as it lies in her power, she would never throw the child in Fire. ' Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more kind to His servants than this woman is to her child.
hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch qaidi laaye gaye jinmein ek aurat bhi thi jo (kisi ki) talaash mein thi aur jab usne qaidiyon mein ek bachcha paaya, usne use pakda, apne seene se lagaaya aur use doodh pilaaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaari kya raay hai, kya ye aurat kabhi apne bachche ko aag mein phenkegi? Humne kaha: Allah ki qasam, jab tak ye uske vash mein hai, woh kabhi apne bachche ko aag mein nahi phenkegi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne bandon ke saath is aurat se zyada meherbaan hai jitna ye apne bachche ke saath hai.

e: 'Ala' reported on the authority of his father who reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If a believer were to know the punishment (in Hell) none would have the audacity to aspire for Paradise (but he would earnestly desire to be rescued from Hell), and if a non-believer were to know what is there with Allah as a mercy. none would have been disappointed in regard to Paradise.
hi: Ala ne apne waalid ke hawaale se, Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar ek momin ko (Jahannam ki) saza ka ilm ho jaaye, koi bhi Jannat mein daakhil hone ki himmat na kare (balki woh bas Jahannam se bachne ki khwaish rakhega), aur agar ek kaafir ko pata chal jaaye ki Allah ke paas kitni Rehmat hai, koi bhi Jannat ke baare mein mayoos na ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a person who had never done any good deed asked the members of his family to burn his dead body when he would die and to scatter half of its ashes over the land and half in the ocean. By Allah, if Allah finds him in His grip, He would torment him with a torment with which He did not afflict anyone amongst the people of the world; and when the person died, it was done to him as he had commanded (his family) to do. Allah commanded the land to collect (the ashes scattered on it) and He commanded the ocean and that collected (ashes) contained in it. Allah questioned him why he had done. that He said: My Lord, it is out of Thine fear that I have done it and Thou art well aware of it, and Allah granted him pardon:.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek shakhs jisne kabhi koi nekokaar amal nahi kiya tha, ne apne khaandaan ke logon se kaha ki jab woh mar jaaye, uske murda badan ko jala dein aur uski aadhi raakh zameen par bikher dein aur aadhi samundar mein. Allah ki qasam, agar Allah use apni pakad mein le, to Woh use aisi saza dega jaisi Usne is duniya mein kisi ko nahi di hai; aur jab us shakhs ki maut hui, uske saath waisa hi kiya gaya jaisa usne hukum diya tha. Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya ki woh (bikheri hui raakh) ikattha kare, aur Usne samundar ko hukum diya, aur usne bhi apni ikattha (raakh) di. Allah ne usse poocha ki usne aisa kyun kiya. Usne kaha: Mere Rab, ye Tere Dar ki wajah se hai ki maine ye kiya, aur Tu isse achhi tarah waaqif hai, aur Allah ne use maafi de di.

e:
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a person committed sin beyond measure and when he was going to die, he left this will: (When I die), bum my dead body and then cast them (the ashes) to the wind and in the ocean. By Allah, if my Lord takes hold of me, He would torment me as He has not tormented anyone else. They did as he had asked them to do. He (the Lord) said to the earth: Return what you have taken. And he was thus restored to his (original form). He (Allah) said to him: What prompted you to do this? He said: My Lord, it was Thine fear or Thine awe, and Allah pardoned him because of this. 

Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a woman was thrown into Hell-Fire because of a cat whom she had tied and did not provide it with food. nor did she set it free to eat vermin of the earth until it died emaciated. 

Az-Zuhri said: (These two ahadith) show that a person should neither feel confident (of getting into Paradise) because of his deeds, nor should he lose (all hopes) of getting into Paradise.
