Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Tumne khud ko chhipaaya nahi tha (paap karte waqt) kyunki tumhaare kaan, tumhaari aankhein aur tumhaari khaal tumhaare khilaaf gawaahi de sakti hai" (41:22).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zaid b. Thabit reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) set out for Uhud. Some of those persons who were with them came back. The Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) were divided in two groups. One group said: We would kill them, and the other one said: No, this should not be done, and it was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" Why should you, then, be two parties in relation to hypocrites?" (iv. 88).
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Uhud ki taraf nikle. Kuch log jo unke saath the, wapas laut gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba do girohon mein baant gaye. Ek giroh ne kaha: Hum unhe (peeche laut jaane walon ko) qatal karenge, aur doosre ne kaha: Nahi, aisa nahi karna chahiye, aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Tumhe munafiqon ke maamle mein do giroh kyun hona chahiye?" (4:88).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the hypocrites behaved in this way that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) set out for a battle, they kept themselves behind, and they became happy that they had managed to sit in the house contrary to (the act of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and when Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) came back, they put forward excuses and took oath and wished that people should laud them for the deeds which they had not done. It was on this occasion that this verse was revealed: " Think not that those who exult in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done-think not them to be safe from the chastisement; and for them is a painful chastisement" (iii. 18).
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jeevan kaal mein munafiq is tarah vyavahaar karte the ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kisi jung par nikalte, woh peeche reh jaate, aur woh khush hote ki unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke amal ke virudh apne ghar mein baithne ka mauka mil gaya, aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wapas aate, woh uzr pesh karte aur qasam khaate aur chaahte ki logon inhe un amalon ke liye tareef karein jo unhone kiye hi nahi. Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Ye mat samjho ki jo log apne amal par khush hote hain aur jo amal unhone kiya hi nahi uske liye tareef paana chahte hain - ye mat samjho ki woh saza se mahfooz hain; aur unke liye dukhad saza hai" (3:188).

e: Humaid b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported that Marwan said to Rafi', his chamberlain, that he should go to Ibn 'Abbas and ask him: If every one of us be punished for his being happy upon his deed and for his being praised for what he has not done, nobody would be saved from the torment. Ibn 'Abbas said: What you have to do with this verse? It has been in fact revealed in connection with the people of the Book." Then Ibn Abbas recited this verse:" When Allah took a covenant from those who had been given the Book: You shall explain it to people and shall not conceal this" (iii. 186), and then Ibn 'Abbas recited this verse:" Think not that those who exult in what they have done and love to be praised for what they have not done" (iii. 186). Ibn 'Abbas (further) said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) asked them about something and then they concealed that and they told him something else and they went out and they thought that they had informed him as lie had asked them and they felt happy of what they had concealed.
hi: Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ne apne darbaan Rafi se kaha ki woh Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas jaakar poochein: Agar humme se har ek ko apne amal par khushi mehsoos karne aur us cheez ke liye tareef chaahne ki wajah se saza di jaaye jo usne kiya hi nahi, to koi bhi azaab se bach nahi paayega. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Tumhe is aayat se kya lena-dena hai? Ye asal mein Kitaab waalon ke silsile mein nazil hui thi. Phir Ibn Abbas ne ye aayat padhi: "Jab Allah ne un logon se ehad liya jinhe Kitaab di gayi thi: Tumhe ye logon ko samjhaani hogi aur ise chhupaana nahi hoga" (3:187), aur phir Ibn Abbas ne ye aayat padhi: "Ye mat samjho ki jo log apne amal par khush hote hain aur jo amal unhone kiya hi nahi uske liye tareef chaahte hain" (3:188). Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha aur phir unhone ise chhupaaya aur unhe kuch aur bataya, aur woh bahar gaye aur unhe laga ki unhone woh bataya jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne poocha tha, aur woh apni is chhupaayi hui baat par khush hue.

e: Qais reported: I said to 'Ammar: What is your opinion about that which you have done in case (of your siding with Hadrat 'Ali)? Is it your personal opinion or something you got from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? 'Ammar said: We have got nothing from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which people at large did not get, but Hudhaifa told me that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had especially told him amongst his Companion, that there would be twelve hypocrites out of whom eight would not get into Paradise, until a camel would be able to pass through the needle hole. The ulcer would be itself sufficient (to kill) eight. So far as four are concerned, I do not remember what Shu'ba said about them.
hi: Qais ne bayan kiya: Maine Ammar (RA) se kaha: Aapne jo kiya (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka saath dete hue), uske baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Kya ye aapki niji raay hai ya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mili koi baat hai? Ammar ne kaha: Humaare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi aisi khaas baat nahi hai jo aam logon ke paas na ho, lekin Hudhaifa ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne Sahaba mein se khaas taur par unhe bataya tha ki baarah munafiq honge jinmein se aTh Jannat mein daakhil nahi honge yahan tak ki oont sui ke chhed se guzar sake. Faoda (bada zakhm) hi unmein se aTh ko (maarne ke liye) kaafi hoga. Jahan tak baaki chaar ka sawaal hai, mujhe yaad nahi ki Shu'ba ne unke baare mein kya kaha.

e: Qais b. 'Ubad reported: We said to 'Ammar: Was your fighting (on the side of 'Ali in the Battle of Siffin) a matter of your own choice or you got its hints from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for it, is likely for one to err in one's own discretion or was it because of any covenant that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got from you? He said: It was not because of any covenant that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got from us which he did get from other people, and he further said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:" In my Ummah." And I think that Hudhaifa reported to me and according to Ghundar (the words are) that he said: In my Ummah, there would be twelve hypocrites and they would not be admitted to Paradise and they would not smell its odour, until the camel would pass through a needle's hole. Dubaila (ulcer) would be enough to (torment them) -a kind of flame of Fire which would appear in their shoulders and it would protrude from their chest.
hi: Qais bin Ubad ne bayan kiya: Humne Ammar (RA) se kaha: Kya Siffin ki jung mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke saath aapka larna aapki khud ki raay thi ya aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi ishara mila tha? Unhone kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile kisi ehad ki wajah se nahi tha jo unhe (usne) doosron se na mila ho, aur aage unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Meri Ummat mein baarah munafiq honge aur woh Jannat mein daakhil nahi kiye jaayenge aur na hi unhe iski khushboo aayegi, yahan tak ki oont sui ke chhed se guzar jaaye. Dubaila (bhaari faoda) unhe (azmaane) ke liye kaafi hoga - ye ek kism ki aag ki lapat hai jo unke kandhon par pragat hogi aur unke seene se bahar nikalegi.

e: Abu Tufail reported that there was a dispute between Hudhaifa and one from the people of Aqaba as it happens amongst people. He said: I adjure you by Allah to tell me as to how many people from Aqaba were. The people said to him (Hudhaifa) to inform him as he had asked. We have been informed that they were fourteen and If you are to be counted amongst them, then they would be fifteen and I state by Allah that twelve amongst them were the enemies of Allah and of His Messenger (ﷺ) in this world. The rest of the three put forward this excuse: We did not hear the announcement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we were not aware of the intention of the people as he (the Holy Prophet) had been in the hot atmosphere. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: The water is small in quantity (at the next station). So nobody should go ahead of me, but he found people who had gone ahead of him and he cursed them on that day.
hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya ki Hudhaifa aur Aqaba ke logon mein se ek ke beech jhagda hua jaisa aksar logon mein hota hai. Usne kaha: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon ki mujhe bataao Aqaba ke kitne log the. Logon ne unse (Hudhaifa se) usko bataane ko kaha jaisa usne poocha tha. Humein bataaya gaya hai ki woh chaudah the aur agar tumhe unmein gina jaaye, to woh pandrah honge, aur main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki unmein se baarah is duniya mein Allah aur Uske Rasool ke dushman the. Baaki teen ne ye uzr pesh kiya: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ailaan nahi suna aur humein logon ke iraade ka koi pata nahi tha kyunki woh (Pavitr Nabi) garam mausam mein the. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Paani thoda hai (agle padaav par). Isliye koi bhi mujhse aage na jaaye, lekin unhone paaya ki kuch log unse aage nikal gaye the aur unhone us din unpar laanat ki.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who climbed this hill, the hill of Murar, his sins would be obliterated as were obliterated the sins of Bani Isra'il. So the first to take their horses were the people of Banu Khazraj. Then there was a ceaseless flow of persons and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them: All of you are those who have been pardoned except the owner of a red camel. We came to him and said to him: You also come on, so that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) may seek forgiveness for you. But he said: By Allah, so far as I am concerned, the finding of something lost is dearer to me than seeking of forgiveness for me by your companion (the Holy Prophet), and he remained busy in finding out his lost thing.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo is pahaad par chadha, Murar ke pahaad par, uske gunah mit jaayenge jaise Banu Isra'il ke gunah mite the. Isliye Banu Khazraj ke log sabse pehle apne ghode uspar chadhaane wale the. Phir logon ka lagataar taanta lag gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tum sab woh ho jinhe maaf kiya gaya hai siwaay ek laal oont ke maalik ke. Hum uske paas gaye aur usse kaha: Tum bhi aao taaki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tumhaare liye bhi maafi maangein. Lekin usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, jahan tak mera sawaal hai, mera gum hua saamaan paana mujhe tumhaare saathi ki mere liye maafi maangne se zyada aziz hai, aur woh apni gum hui cheez dhoondhne mein masroof raha.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who would climb this hill of Murar. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that it was a desert Arab who was finding out his lost thing.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo bhi Murar ke is pahaad par chadhega. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki ye ek registaan ka Arab tha jo apni gum hui cheez dhoondh raha tha.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: There was a person amongst us who belonged to the tribe of Bani Najjar and he recited Sura al-Baqarah and Surat Al-i-'Imran and he used to transcribe for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He ran away as a rebel and joined the People of the Book. They gave it much importance and said: He is the person who used to transcribe for Muhammad and they were much pleased with him. Time rolled on that Allah caused his death. They dug the grave and buried him therein, but they found to their surprise that the earth had thrown him out over the surface. They again dug the grave for him and buried him but the earth again threw him out upon the surface. They again dug the grave for him and buried him but the earth again threw him out upon the surface. At last they left him unburied.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Humme se ek shakhs tha jo Banu Najjar qabile se ta'alluq rakhta tha aur woh Sura al-Baqarah aur Aal-e-Imran padhta tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye likhne ka kaam karta tha. Woh bagavat karke bhaag gaya aur Kitaab waalon (Yahudi ya Isaayi) mein shaamil ho gaya. Unhone use bahut ahmiyat di aur kaha: Ye woh shakhs hai jo Muhammad ke liye likhta tha, aur woh usse bahut khush huye. Waqt guzar gaya yahan tak ki Allah ne uski maut ka intezaam kiya. Unhone qabar khodi aur usmein use dafn kiya, lekin unhe hairat hua ki zameen ne use satah par phenk diya. Unhone dobara uske liye qabar khodi aur use dafn kiya lekin zameen ne use dobara satah par phenk diya. Unhone phir uske liye qabar khodi aur use dafn kiya lekin zameen ne use phir satah par phenk diya. Aakhirkaar unhone use bina dafn kiye chhod diya.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from a journey and as he was near Medina, there was such a violent gale that the mountain seemed to be pressed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This wind has perhaps been made to blow for the death of a hypocrite, and as he reached Medina a notorious hypocrite from amongst the hypocrites had died.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek safar se wapas aa rahe the aur jab woh Madina ke qareeb the, itna tez toofaan aaya ki laga pahaad dab jaayega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye hawa shaayad kisi munafiq ki maut ke liye chalayi gayi hai, aur jab woh Madina pahunche, munafiqon mein se ek badnaam munafiq ka intiqaal ho chuka tha.

e: Iyas reported on the authority of his father: We went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to visit a person suffering from fever. When I placed my hand upon him, I said: By Allah, I have never seen, till this day, a person running higher temperature than he. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), turning his face to his companions, said: May I not inform you of a severer temperature than this which these two persons would run on the Day of Resurrection? And they were two hypocrites riding upon the camel turning their back towards (the Muslims).
hi: Iyas ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek shakhs se milne gaye jo bukhaar se pareshaan tha. Jab maine apna haath uspar rakha, maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine aaj tak kisi ko isse zyada bukhaar mein nahi dekha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chehra apne Sahaba ki taraf moda aur farmaaya: Kya main tumhe is se zyada bukhaar ke baare mein na bataun jo Qayamat ke din in do logon ko hoga? Aur woh do munafiq the jo oont par sawaar the, apni peeth Musalmaanon ki taraf karke.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of a hypocrite is that of a sheep which roams aimlessly between two flocks. She goes to one at one time and to the other at another time.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Munafiq ki misaal us bhed jaisi hai jo do rewadon ke beech bekhabar ghoomti hai. Woh kabhi ek ki taraf jaati hai aur kabhi doosre ki taraf.

e: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying like this but with this change of words: " She sometimes finds a way in one flock and then in another flock."
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isi jaisi baat kehte suna lekin is alfaazon ke antar ke saath: "Woh kabhi ek rewad mein raasta paati hai aur phir doosre rewad mein."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A bulky person would be brought on the Day of judgment and he would not carry the weight to the eye of Allah equal even to that of a gnat. Nor shall We set up a balance for them on the Day of Resurrection" (xviii. 105).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ke din ek bhaari-bharkam shakhs laaya jaayega aur uska wazan Allah ki nazar mein ek machhar ke barabar bhi nahi hoga. "Aur Hum Qayamat ke din unke liye koi taraazu qaayam nahi karenge" (18:105).

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that a Jewish scholar came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and said: Muhammad, or Abu al-Qasim, verily, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious would carry the Heavens on the Day of Judgment upon one finger and earths upon one finger and the mountains and trees upon one finger and the ocean and moist earth upon one finger, and in fact the whole of the creation upon one finger, and then He would stir them and say: I am your Lord, I am your Lord. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled testifying what that scholar had said. He then recited this verse:" And they honour not Allah with the honour due to Him; and the whole earth will be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heaven rolled up in His right hand. Glory be to Him I and highly Exalted is He above what they associate (with Him)" (Az-Zumar:67).
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi aalim Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Muhammad, ya Abu'l-Qasim, yaqeenan, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Qayamat ke din Aasmaanon ko ek ungli par uThAyenge, aur zameenon ko ek ungli par, aur pahaadon aur darakhton ko ek ungli par, aur samundar aur nam zameen ko ek ungli par, aur waastav mein poori makhlooq ko ek ungli par, aur phir unhe hilaayenge aur farmaayenge: Main tumhaara Rab hoon, main tumhaara Rab hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye us aalim ke bayaan ki tasdeeq karte huye. Phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Aur unhone Allah ki wo izzat nahi ki jiske Woh haqdaar hain; aur poori zameen Qayamat ke din Uski mutthi mein hogi aur aasmaan Uske daaye Haath mein lipTa hoga. Allah pavitra hai! Aur Woh us se bahut Buland hai jo woh (log) Uske saath mansoob karte hain" (39:67).

e: This hadlth has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of truemittm (and the words are): A Jew scholar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same, but there is no mention of" then He would stir them." But there is this addition:" I saw Allah's Messengcr (ﷺ) smiling so much that his front teeth appeared and testifying him (th Jew scholar) ; then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited the verse:" And they honour not Allah with the honour due to Him" (xxxix. 67).
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Ek Yahudi aalim Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Phir Woh unhe hilaayenge." Lekin ismein ye izafa hai: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko itna muskuraate dekha ki unke agle daant dikhne lage, aur us Yahudi aalim ki tasdeeq karte huye; phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye aayat padhi: 'Aur unhone Allah ki wo izzat nahi ki jiske Woh haqdaar hain' (39:67)."

e: Abdullah reported that a person from the People of the Book came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and said: Abu al-Qasim, verily, Allah holds the Heavens upon one finger and the earths upon one finger and the trees and moist earth upon one finger and in fact the whole of the creation upon one finger and then say: I am the King. I am the King. And he (the narrator) further said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiling until his front teeth became visible and then he recited the verse: "And they measure not the power of Allah with His true measure" (39:67).
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Kitaab waalon mein se ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, yaqeenan, Allah Aasmaanon ko ek ungli par pakadte hain aur zameenon ko ek ungli par, aur darakhton aur nam zameen ko ek ungli par, aur waastav mein poori makhlooq ko ek ungli par, aur phir farmaate hain: Main Baadshah hoon, Main Baadshah hoon. Aur unhone (raawi ne) aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko muskuraate dekha yahan tak ki unke agle daant dikhne lage, aur phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Aur unhone Allah ki Qudrat ka sahi andaaza nahi lagaaya" (39:67).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, will take in His grip the Earth on the Day of Judgment and He would roll up the sky in His right hand and would say: I am the Lord; where are the sovereigns of the world?
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Qayamat ke din Zameen ko Apni mutthi mein pakdenge aur Aasmaan ko Apne daaye Haath mein lapeTenge aur farmaayenge: Main Rab hoon; duniya ke shaasak kahan hain?

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would fold the Heavens on the Day of Judgment and then He would place them on His right hand and say: I am the Lord; where are the haughty and where are the proud (today)? He would fold the' earth (placing it) on the left hand and say: I am the Lord; where are the haughty and where are the proud (today)?
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Qayamat ke din Aasmaanon ko Lapetenge aur phir unhe Apne daaye Haath par rakhenge aur farmaayenge: Main Rab hoon; ghamandi log kahan hain aur takabbur karne waale kahan hain (aaj)? Woh Zameen ko (Apne) baaye Haath par lapetenge aur farmaayenge: Main Rab hoon; ghamandi log kahan hain aur takabbur karne waale kahan hain (aaj)?

e: Abdullah b. Miqsam reported that he saw Abdullah b. Umar as he narrated Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would take in His hand His Heavens and His Earth, and would say: I am Allah. And He would clench His fingers and then would open them (and say): I am your Lord. I saw the pulpit in commotion from underneath because of something (vib-ating) there. And (I felt this commotion so much) that I said (to myself): It may not fall with Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) upon it.
hi: Abdullah bin Miqsam ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abdullah bin Umar ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye farmaate riwayat karte suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Apne Haath mein Apne Aasmaanon aur Apni Zameen ko pakadenge, aur farmaayenge: Main Allah hoon. Aur Woh Apni ungliyon ko band karenge aur phir unhe kholenge (aur kahenge): Main tumhaara Rab hoon. Maine mimbar ko kisi cheez ki wajah se neeche se hilte dekha (jo usmein kampan paida kar rahi thi), aur (maine ye kampan itna zyada mehsoos kiya) ki maine (khud se) kaha: Kahin ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gir na jaaye.

e: Abdullah b. Miqsam reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported: I saw Allah'h Messenger (ﷺ) upon the pulpit and he was saying that the Mighty Lord, the Exalted and Glorious would take hold of the Heavens and earth in His hand. The rest of the hadith is the same,
hi: Abdullah bin Miqsam ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par dekha aur woh ye keh rahe the ki Mahaan-Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Aasmaanon aur Zameen ko Apne Haath mein pakad lenge. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of my hands and said: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, created the clay on Saturday and He created the mountains on Sunday and He created the trees on Monday and He created the things entailing labour on Tuesday and created light on Wednesday and He caused the animals to spread on Thursday and created Adam (peace be upon him) after 'Asr on Friday; the last creation at the last hour of the hours of Friday, i. e. between afternoon and night. This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur farmaaya: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Shanivaar ko mitti banaayi aur Ravivaar ko pahaad banaaye aur Somvaar ko darakht banaaye aur Mangalvaar ko mehnat waali cheezein banaayi aur Budhvaar ko roshni banaayi aur Guruvaar ko jaanwar failaaye aur Shukravaar ko Asr ke baad Aadam (unpar shaanti ho) ko banaaya - Shukravaar ke aakhri ghante mein, Asr aur raat ke beech, aakhri srijan.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The people will be assembled on the Day of Resurrection on a white plain with a reddish tinge like the loaf of white bread with no marks set up for anyone.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Log Qayamat ke din ek safed maidaan mein ikattha kiye jaayenge jismein halki laali hogi, jaise safed roti ka Tukda, jismein kisi ke liye koi nishaan nahi hoga.

e: 'A'isha reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" The day when the earth would be changed for another earth and Heaven would be changed for another Heaven (XiV. 48), (and inquired: ) (Allah's Messenger), where would the people be on that day? He said: They would be on the Sirat.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke in alfaazon ke baare mein poocha: "Us din jab zameen ko ek doosri zameen se badal diya jaayega aur Aasmaan ko bhi (badal diya jaayega)" (14:48), (aur poocha:) Allah ke Rasool, us din log kahan honge? Unhone farmaaya: Woh Sirat (pul) par honge.

e: Abu al-Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that the earth would turn to be one single bread on the Day of Resurrection and the Almighty would turn it in His hand as one of you turns a loaf while on a journey. It would be a feast arranged in the honour of the people of Paradise. He (the narrator) further narrated that a person from among the Jews came and he said: Abu al-Qasim, may the Compassionate Lord be pleased with you! May I inform you about the feast arranged in honour of the people of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection? He said: Do it, of course. He said: The earth would become one single bread. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked towards us and laughed until his molar teeth became visible. He then again said: May I inform you about that with which they would season it? He said: Do it, of course. He said: Their seasoning would be balim and fish. The Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said: What is this balam? He said: Ox and fish from whose excessive livers seventy thousand people would be able to eat.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Zameen Qayamat ke din ek hi roti ban jaayegi aur Qaadir-e-Mutlaq use Apne Haath mein ghumaayenge jaise tum mein se koi safar ke daurane roti ghumaata hai. Ye Jannat ke logon ke samman mein taiyaar kiya gaya ek dawat hoga. Unhone (raawi ne) aage riwayat ki ki Yahudiyon mein se ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, Rehmvaan Rab aap se khush rahen! Kya main aapko Qayamat ke din Jannat ke logon ke samman mein taiyaar ki gayi is dawat ke baare mein bataun? Unhone kaha: Zaroor bataao. Usne kaha: Zameen ek hi roti ban jaayegi. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaari taraf dekha aur hanse yahan tak ki unke daadhi ke daant dikhne lage. Phir unhone dobara kaha: Kya main aapko bataun ki woh isse kya masaale ke saath khaayenge? Usne kaha: Zaroor bataao. Usne kaha: Unka masaala Baalam aur machhli hoga. Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba ne kaha: Ye Baalam kya hai? Usne kaha: Bael aur machhli, jinke bade jigar mein se sattar hazaar log khaa payenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If ten scholars of the Jews would follow me, no Jew would be left upon the surface of the earth who would not embrace Islam.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar das Yahudi aalim mera anusaran karein, to zameen ki satah par koi bhi Yahudi nahi bachega jo Islam qubool na kare.

e: `Abdullah (b. Mas`ud) reported: As I was going along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in a cultivable land and he (the Holy Prophet) was walking with the support of a wood, a group of Jews happened to meet him. Some of them said to the others: Ask him about the Soul. They said: What is your doubt about it? There is a possibility that you may ask him about anything (the answer of) which you may not like. They said: Ask him. So one amongst them asked him about the Soul. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept quiet and he gave no reply and I came to know that revelation was being sent to him, so I stood at my place and thus this revelation descended upon him:" They ask thee about the Soul. Say: The Soul is by the Commandment of my Lord, and of Knowledge you are given but a little" (xvii. 58).
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek kheti ki zameen par ja raha tha aur woh (Pavitr Nabi) ek lakdi ka sahaara lekar chal rahe the, ki Yahudiyon ka ek giroh humse mila. Unmein se kuch ne doosron se kaha: Unse Rooh ke baare mein poocho. Unhone kaha: Ismein tumhaara kya shak hai? Ho sakta hai tum unse kuch aisa poochho jo tumhe pasand na aaye. Unhone kaha: Unse poocho. Isliye unmein se ek ne unse Rooh ke baare mein poocha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khamosh rahe aur koi jawaab nahi diya, aur mujhe pata chala ki unpar wahi utaari jaa rahi thi, isliye main apni jagah khada raha aur is tarah ye wahi unpar nazil hui: "Woh tumse Rooh ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Rooh mere Rab ke hukum se hai, aur tumhe ilm mein se bahut thoda hi diya gaya hai" (17:85).

e: Abdullah reported: I was walking along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in a field of Medina. The rest of the hadith is the same, but there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Madina ke ek khet mein chal raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was reclining against a tree in the garden. The rest of the hadith is the same with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baag mein ek darakht ka sahaara lekar leTe huye the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Khabbab reported that Al-`As b. Wa'il owed debt to me. I came to him in order to demand that. He said: I will never repay you unless you belie Muhammad. I said: I would never belie Muhammad until you die and you are again raised up. He said: When I would be raised up after death, I would repay your debt when I would get my property and children back. Waki` said: This is how Al-A`mash has narrated and it was on this occasion that this verse was revealed: "Hast thou seen him who disbelieves in Our message and says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children" (xix, 77) up to "he would come to Us alone" (xix, 80).
hi: Khabbab (RA) ne bayan kiya ki al-As bin Wa'il mera karzdaar tha. Main uska taqaaza karne uske paas gaya. Usne kaha: Main tumhe kabhi wapas nahi karunga jab tak tum Muhammad ko jhoota na kaho. Maine kaha: Main kabhi Muhammad ko jhoota nahi kahunga yahan tak ki tumhaari maut ho jaaye aur tumhe dobara zinda kiya jaaye. Usne kaha: Jab mujhe maut ke baad dobara uThAya jaayega, main tumhaara karza chukaunga jab mujhe apna maal aur bachche wapas milenge. Waki ne kaha: Isi tarah A'mash ne riwayat ki, aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Kya tumne use dekha jo Humaari nishaani ko jhoota kehta hai aur kehta hai: Mujhe zaroor maal aur bachche diye jaayenge" (19:77) yahan tak ki "Woh Humaare paas akela aayega" (19:80).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khabbib through another chain of transmitters and the words are. I in the pre-Islamic days used to work as an iron-smith. I did some work for 'As b. Wa'il and came to him for getting the remuneration of my wages.
hi: Ye hadees Khabbab (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: Main Jaahiliyat ke daur mein ek lohaar ka kaam karta tha. Maine Aas bin Wa'il ke liye kuch kaam kiya aur main apni mazdoori lene uske paas aaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Abu Jahl said: O Allah, if he is true, then shower upon us the volley of stones from the sky or inflict upon us a grievous torment, and it was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" 'Allah would never torment them so long as you are amongst them. And Allah is not going to torment them as long as they seek forgiveness. And why is it that Allah should not torment them and they prevent people from coming to the sacred mosque...." (viii. 34) to the end.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu Jahl ne kaha: Aye Allah, agar ye sach hain, to humpar aasmaan se pattharon ki barish barsa, ya humpar koi dukhad azaab utaar, aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Allah unhe kabhi saza nahi dega jab tak tum unke beech ho. Aur Allah unhe saza dene wala nahi hai jab tak woh maafi maangte hain. Aur kya wajah hai ki Allah unhe saza na de jabki woh logon ko Masjid al-Haram (jaane) se rokte hain?" (8:34) akhir tak.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Abu Jahl asked (people) whether Muhammad placed his face (on the ground) in their presence. It was said to him: Yes. He said: By Lat and `Uzza. If I were to see him do that, I would trample his neck, or I would smear his face with dust. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was engaged in prayer and thought of trampling his neck (and the people say) that he came near him but turned upon his heels and tried to repulse something with his hands. It was said to him: What is the matter with you? He said: There is between me and him a ditch of fire and terror and wings. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: If he were to come near me the angels would have torn him to pieces. Then Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse- (the narrator) said: We do not know whether it is the hadith transmitted by Abu Huraira or something conveyed to him from another source: "Nay, man is surely inordinate, because he looks upon himself as self-sufficient. Surely to thy Lord is the return. Hast thou seen him who forbids a servant when he prays? Seest thou if he is on the right way, or enjoins observance of piety? Seest thou if he  denies and turns away? Knowest he not that Allah sees? Nay, if he desists not, We will seize him by the forelock-a lying, sinful forelock. Then let him summon his council. We will summon the guards of the Hell. Nay! Obey not thou him" (lcvi, 6-19). (Rather prostrate thyself.) Ubaidullah made this addition: It was after this that (prostration) was enjoined upon and Ibn Abd al-Ala made this addition that by "Nadiyah" he meant his people.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu Jahl ne poocha (logon se) ki kya Muhammad unke saamne apna chehra (zameen par sajde mein) rakhte hain. Usse kaha gaya: Haan. Usne kaha: Laat aur Uzza ki qasam, agar main unhe aisa karte dekhta, to main unki gardan zameen mein dabaa deta, ya main unke chehre par mitti pot deta. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh namaz mein masroof the aur unki gardan dabaane ka soch raha tha (log kehte hain) ki woh unke qareeb aaya lekin apni eDiyon par pichhe muda aur apne haathon se kuch dhakelne ki koshish karne laga. Usse poocha gaya: Tumhe kya hua? Usne kaha: Mere aur uske beech aag ki ek khaai hai, aur khauf aur pankh (Farishton ke) hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar woh mere qareeb aata to Farishte use tukdon mein phaad dete. Phir Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ye aayat nazil ki - (raawi ne) kaha: Humein nahi pata ki ye Abu Huraira dwara riwayat ki gayi hadees hai ya kisi doosre srot se unhe pahunchi baat: "Nahi, yaqeenan insaan had se aage badh jaata hai, kyunki woh khud ko zaroorat se mukt samajhta hai. Yaqeenan tere Rab ki taraf hi laut kar jaana hai. Kya tumne use dekha jo ek banda ko namaz padhne se rokta hai? Kya tum sochte ho ki agar woh sahi raah par hai, ya taqwa apnaane ka hukum deta hai? Kya tum sochte ho ki agar woh jhutlaata hai aur munh modta hai? Kya use nahi pata ki Allah dekhta hai? Nahi, agar woh baaz nahi aata, to Hum use maathe ke baalon se pakdenge - jhoota, gunahgaar maatha. Phir use apni majlis bulaane do. Hum Jahannam ke pahredaaron ko bulaayenge. Nahi! Uski itaat mat karo" (96:6-19). Ubaidullah ne ye izafa kiya ki iske baad sajde ka hukum diya gaya, aur Ibn Abd al-Ala ne ye izafa kiya ki "Nadiyah" se unka matlab uski qaum tha.

e: Masruq reported: We were sitting in the company of Abdullah and he was lying on the bed that a person came and said: Abd Abd al-Rabmin, a story-teller at the gates of Kinda says that the verse (of the Qur'an) which deals with the" smoke" implies that which is about to come and it would hold the breath of the infidels and would inflict the believers with cold. Thereupon Abdullah got up and said in anger. O people, fear Allah and say only that which one knows amongst you and do not say which he does not know and he should simply say: Allah has the best knowledge for He has the best knowledge amongst all of you. It does not behove him to say that which he does not know. Allah has the best knowledge of it. Verily Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said to His Prophet (ﷺ) to state:" I do not ask from you any remuneration and I am not the one to put you in trouble," and when Allah's Mesqenger (ﷺ) saw people turning back (from religion) he said: O Allah, afflict thern with seven famines as was done in the case of Yusuf, so they were afflicted with famine by which they were forced to eat everything until they were obliged to eat the hides and the dead bodies because of hunger, and every one of them looked towards the sky and he found a smoke. And Abu Sufyan came and he said: Muhammad, you have come to command us to obey Allah and cement the ties of blood- relation whereas your people are undone; supplicate Allah for tlicm. Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said:" Wait for the day when there would be clear smoke from the sky which would envelop people and that would be grievous torivent" up to the words:" you are going to return to (evil)." (if this verse implied the torment of the next life) could the chastisement of the next (life) be averted (as the Qur'an states): On the day when We seize (them) with the most violent seizing; surely We shall exact retribution" (xliv. 16)? The seizing (in the hadith) implies that of the Day of Badr. And so far as the sign of smoke, seizing, inevitability and signs of Rome are concern- ed, they have become things of the past now.
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah (RA) ki sohbat mein baithe the aur woh bistar par leTe huye the ki ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, Kinda ke darwazon par ek kahani sunaane wala kehta hai ki Quran ki aayat jismein "dhuen" ka zikr hai uska matlab hai ki ye jald aane wala hai aur ye kaafiron ki saans rok degi aur momino ko sardi mein Daal degi. Isper Abdullah gusse mein uThe aur kaha: Aye logo, Allah se Daro aur sirf woh baat kaho jiska tumhe ilm hai aur jiska tumhe ilm nahi hai use mat kaho, aur use bas ye kehna chahiye: Allah sabse behtar jaanta hai kyunki Woh tum sab mein sabse zyada jaanta hai. Use ye kehna munasib nahi hai jo use pata nahi hai. Allah sabse behtar jaanta hai. Yaqeenan Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Apne Nabi (SAW) se kehne ko kaha: "Main tumse koi mehnataana nahi maangta aur main tumhe kisi museebat mein daalne wala nahi hoon," aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ko (deen se) mudte dekha, unhone kaha: Aye Allah, unhe saat akaal se pareshaan kar jaise Yusuf ke maamle mein kiya gaya tha, isliye unhe akaal ne itna pareshaan kiya ki bhookh ki wajah se unhe khaal aur murda cheezein bhi khaani padin, aur har shakhs ne aasmaan ki taraf dekha aur usne dhuaan paaya. Aur Abu Sufyan aaye aur unhone kaha: Muhammad, aap humein Allah ki itaat karne aur rishtedaari ke rishte jodne ka hukum dene aaye hain jabki aapki qaum barbaad ho rahi hai; unke liye Allah se dua kijiye. Isper Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: "Us din ka intezaar karo jab aasmaan se saaf dikhne wala dhuaan aayega jo logon ko dhaak lega aur ye ek dukhad azaab hoga" yahan tak ki alfaaz "tum (burai ki taraf) laut jaaoge." (agar ye aayat agli zindagi ke azaab ka zikr karti hai) kya agli zindagi ki saza taali jaa sakti hai (jaisa Quran farmaata hai): "Us din jab Hum sabse sakht pakad se pakdenge; yaqeenan, Hum badla lenge" (44:16)? (Hadees mein zikr kiya gaya) pakadna Badr ke din ka ishara hai. Aur jahan tak dhuen, pakadne, Lizaam, aur Rome ke nishaanon ka sawaal hai, ye ab beeti hui baaten ban chuki hain.

e: Masruq reported that there came to Abdullah a person and said: I have left behind in the mosque a man who explains the Qur'an according to his personal discretion and he explained this verse:" So wait for the day when the Heaven brings a clear smoke." He says that a smoke would come to the people on the Day of Resurrection anl it will withhold breath and they would be inflicted with cold. 'Abdullah said: He who has knowledge should say something and he who has no knowledge should simply say: Allah is best aware. This reflects the understanding of a person that he should say about that which he does not know that it is Allah who knows best. The fact is that when the Quraish disobeyed Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) he supplicated Allah that they should be afflicted with famine and starvation as was done in case of Yusuf. And they were so much hard pressed that a person would ace the sky and he would see between him and the sky something like smoke and they were so much hard pressed that they began to cat the bones, and a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. seek forgiveness for the tribe of Mudar for (its people) have been undone. The Messenger (ﷺ) said: For Mudar? You are overbold, but he supplicated Allah for them. It was upon this that this verse was revealed:" We shall remove the chastisement a little, but they will surely return to evil" (xliv. 15). lie (the narrator) said: There was a downpoor of rain upon them. When there was some relief for them they returned to the same position as they had been before, and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" So wait for the day when the heaven brings a clear smoke enveloping people. This is a grievous torment on the day when We seize them with the most violent seizing; surely, We shall exact retribution." And this (seizing) implied (Battle) of Badr.
hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah ke paas ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Maine masjid mein ek shakhs ko chhoda hai jo Quran ki apni khud ki samajh ke mutabik vyaakhya kar raha hai aur usne is aayat ki vyaakhya ki: "Isliye us din ka intezaar karo jab aasmaan se saaf dikhne wala dhuaan aayega." Woh kehta hai ki Qayamat ke din logon ke paas dhuaan aayega aur ye saans rok dega aur unhe sardi mein Dal dega. Abdullah ne kaha: Jise ilm hai use kuch kehna chahiye aur jise ilm nahi hai use bas kehna chahiye: Allah sabse behtar jaanta hai. Ye ek shakhs ki samajh ko darsaata hai ki use us baare mein kehna chahiye jiska use ilm nahi hai ki Allah hi behtar jaanta hai. Haqiqat ye hai ki jab Quraish ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki naafarmani ki, unhone Allah se dua ki ki unhe akaal aur bhookh se pareshaan kiya jaaye jaisa Yusuf ke maamle mein kiya gaya tha. Aur woh itna pareshaan hue ki koi shakhs aasmaan dekhta aur use apne aur aasmaan ke beech dhuen jaisi koi cheez dikhti, aur woh itna pareshaan hue ki unhone haddiyaan khaani shuru kar din, aur ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Mudar qabile ke liye maafi maangiye kyunki unke log barbaad ho rahe hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mudar ke liye? Tum bahut himmatvar ho, lekin unhone unke liye Allah se dua ki. Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Hum azaab thoda kam karenge, lekin woh zaroor phir burai ki taraf laut jaayenge" (44:15). Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Unpar baarish ki bauchhaar hui. Jab unhe kuch rahat mili, woh usi haalat mein wapas laut gaye jismein woh pehle the, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Isliye us din ka intezaar karo jab aasmaan se saaf dikhne wala dhuaan aayega jo logon ko dhaak lega. Ye ek dukhad azaab hai us din jab Hum sabse sakht pakad se pakdenge; yaqeenan, Hum badla lenge." Aur ye (pakadna) Badr (ki jung ka) ishara hai.

e: Abdullah said that five signs have (become things) of the past (and have proved the truth of the Holy Prophet): (Enveloping) by the smoke, inevitable (punishment to the Meccans at Badr), (the victory of) Rome, (violent) seizing (of the Meccans at Badr) and (the splitting up of) the Moon.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne kaha ki paanch nishaaniyaan (ab) beeti hui baaten ban chuki hain (aur Pavitr Nabi ki sachchaai ko saabit karti hain): (Dhuen se) dhaakna, Lizaam (Makkah walon ki Badr mein saza), (Rome ki) jeet, (sakht) pakadna (Makkah walon ka Badr mein), aur (chaand ka do tukdon mein) batna.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that the words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious: " We will, surely, make them taste the lesser punishment before the severer punishment (that haply they may return)" (xxxii. 21) imply the torments of the world. (victory of) Rome, seizing (of the Meccans), or smoke. And Shalba was in doubt about seizing or smoke.
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke ye alfaaz: "Hum zaroor unhe bade azaab se pehle chhoti saza ka maza chakhaayenge (taaki woh shaayad laut aayein)" (32:21) ka matlab hai duniyaavi azaab. (Rome ki) jeet, (Makkah walon ki) pakad, ya dhuaan. Aur Shu'ba "pakad" ya "dhuaan" ke baare mein shak mein the.

e: Abu Ma'mar reported on the authority of Abdullah that the moon was split up during lifetime by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in two parts and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Bear testimony to this.
hi: Abu Ma'mar ne Abdullah (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki chaand Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jeevan kaal mein do tukdon mein baT gaya tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Iski gawaahi do.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud (who said): We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Mina, that moon was split up into two. One of its parts was behind the mountain and the other one was on this side of the mountain. Allah's Messenger (may peace be upbn him) said to us: Bear witness to this.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (unhone kaha): Hum Mina mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the ki chaand do tukdon mein baT gaya. Iska ek hissa pahaad ke peeche tha aur doosra hissa pahaad ke is taraf. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse farmaaya: Iski gawaahi do.

e: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that the moon was split up in two parts during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The mountain covered one of its parts and one part of it was above the mountain and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Bear witness to this.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki chaand Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jeevan kaal mein do tukdon mein baT gaya. Pahaad ne uske ek hisse ko dhaak liya aur uska ek hissa pahaad ke upar tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Iski gawaahi do.

e: Another chain of transmitters reported the like of this hadith.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that the people of Mecca demanded from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he should show them (some) signs (miracles) and he showed twice the splitting of the moon. This hadlth has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Makkah ke logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se maang ki ki woh unhe (kuch) nishaaniyaan (mojze) dikhaayein aur unhone unhe do baar chaand ka do tukdon mein baTna dikhaya. Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported that the moon was split up in two parts and in the hadith recorded in Abu Dawud, the words are: " The moon was split up into two parts during the life of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki chaand do tukdon mein baT gaya aur Abu Dawud ki hadees mein alfaaz hain: Chaand Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jeevan kaal mein do tukdon mein baT gaya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the moon was split up during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki chaand Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jeevan kaal mein do tukdon mein baT gaya.

e: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is none to show more patience at listening to the most irksome things than Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. 'Partnership is associated to Him (polytheism), and (fatherhood) of a child is attributed to Him, but in spite of this He protects them (people) and provides them sustenance.' This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Musa with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Sabse takleefdeh baaton ko sunne mein Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, se zyada koi sabr nahi rakhta. Uske saath (mushrikeen dwara) shareek jode jaate hain, aur uski (bete ki hasti) mansoob ki jaati hai, lekin iske bawajood Woh unhe (logon ko) hifaazat deta hai aur unhe rozi deta hai. Ye hadees Abu Musa (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Qais reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that none is more forbearing in listening to the most irksome things than Allah, the Exalted. They associate rivals with him, attribute sonhood to Him, but in spite of this He provides them sustenance, grants them safety, confers upon them so many things.
hi: Abdullah bin Qais (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki sabse takleefdeh baaton ko sunne mein Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, se zyada koi sabr nahi rakhta. Woh Uske hareef banaate hain, Uske bete honeka daawa karte hain, lekin iske bawajood Woh unhe rozi deta hai, unhe hifaazat ata karta hai, unhe itni sari cheezein ata karta hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and High, would say to one who shall have to undergo the least torture (on the Day of Resurrection): Would you like to go as ransom if you had all worldly riches; he would say: Yes. Allah would say to him: When you were in the loins of Adam, I demanded from you something easier than this that you should not associate anything with Me. (The narrator says): I think He also said: I would not cause you to enter Hell-Fire but you defied and attributed Divinity (to others besides Me).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, us shakhs se farmaayenge jise Qayamat ke din sabse kam saza bhugatni hogi: Kya tumhe pasand hoga agar tumhaare paas duniya ki saari daulat ho aur tum use fidye ke soorat mein de do (is saza se bachne ke liye)? Woh kahega: Haan. Allah usse farmaayenge: Jab tum Aadam ke sulb mein the, Maine tumse isse aasaan cheez maangi thi ki tum Mere saath kisi ko shareek na karo. (Raawi kehte hain): Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Main tumhe Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil nahi karta, lekin tumne inkaar kiya aur (doosron ko) khudaayi mansoob ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are): I shall cause him to enter Hell." (The words subsequent to these) have not been mentioned.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Main use Jahannam mein daakhil karunga. (Inke baad ke alfaaz) ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be u n him) said: It would be said to the non-believers on the Day of Resurrection: If you were to possess gold, filling the whole earth, would you like to secure your freedom by paying that? He would say: Yes. Thereupon it would be said to him: Something easier (than this) was demanded from you (but you paid no heed to it).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Qayamat ke din gair-imaandaaron se kaha jaayega: Agar tumhaare paas poori zameen bharI hui sona hota, kya tum ise dekar apni azaadi khareedna pasand karte? Woh kahega: Haan. Isper usse kaha jaayega: (Isse) aasaan cheez tumse maangi gayi thi (lekin tumne uspar dhyaan nahi diya).

e: Anas reported this hadlth through another chain of transmitters and the words are: " It would be said to him: You have told a lie; what had been demanded from you was quite easier than this (the belief in the Oneness of Allah)."
hi: Anas (RA) ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki aur alfaaz hain: Usse kaha jaayega: Tumne jhoot bola; tumse jo maanga gaya woh isse kaafi aasaan tha (Allah ki Wahdaaniyat par imaan).

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person said: Allah's Messenger, how  the non-believers be made to assemble on the Day of Resurrection (by crawling) on their faces? Thereupon he said: Is He Who is powerful to make them walk on their feet not powerful enough to make them (crawl) upon their faces on the Day of Resurrection? Qatada said: Of course, it is so. (He adjured): By the might of our Lord.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gair-imaandaaron ko Qayamat ke din unke chehron ke bal (ghisatte hue) kaise ikattha kiya jaayega? Isper unhone farmaaya: Kya woh Hasti Jo unhe unke paon par chalaane mein Qaadir hai, Qayamat ke din unhe unke chehron ke bal (ghisatane) mein Qaadir nahi hai? Qatada ne kaha: Zaroor, aisa hi hai. (Unhone qasam li:) Humaare Rab ki Qudrat ki qasam.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that one amongst the denizens of Hell who had led a life of ease and plenty amongst the people of the world would be made to dip in Fire only once on the Day of Resurrection and then it would be said to him: O, son of Adam, did you find any comfort, did you happen to get any material blessing? He would say: By Allah, no, my Lord. And then that person from amongst the persons of the world be brought who had led the most miserable life (in the world) from amongst the inmates of Paradise. and he would be made to dip once in Paradise and it would be said to him. 0, son of Adam, did you face, any hardship? Or had any distress fallen to your lot? And he would say: By Allah, no,0 my Lord, never did I face any hardship or experience any distress.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jahannam ke bashindon mein se ek jisne duniya mein aaraam aur khushhaali ki zindagi guzaari thi, use Qayamat ke din sirf ek baar aag mein Dubaya jaayega aur phir usse kaha jaayega: Aye Aadam ke bete, kya tumne kabhi koi aaraam paaya, kya tumhe kabhi koi bhalai mili? Woh kahega: Allah ki qasam, nahi, mere Rab. Aur phir duniya waalon mein se woh shakhs laaya jaayega jisne (duniya mein) sabse dukhad zindagi guzaari thi Jannat ke bashindon mein se, aur use Jannat mein ek baar Dubaya jaayega aur usse kaha jaayega: Aye Aadam ke bete, kya tumne kabhi koi mushkil dekhi? Ya tumhaare naseeb mein koi museebat aayi? Aur woh kahega: Allah ki qasam, nahi, mere Rab, mujhe kabhi koi mushkil ya museebat ka saamna nahi karna pada.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily, Allah does not treat a believer unjustly in regard to his virtues. He would confer upon him (His blessing) in this world and would give him reward in the Hereafter. And as regards a non-believer, he would be made to taste the reward (of virtue in this world) what he has done for himself so much that when it would be the Hereafter, he would find no virtue for which he should be rewarded.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah kisi momin ke saath uske nekokaar amalon ke silsile mein anyaay nahi karta. Woh use is duniya mein (Apni barkat) ata karega aur use Aakhirat mein sawaab dega. Aur jahan tak ek gair-imaandaar ka sawaal hai, use apne nekokaar amal ka phal chakhaaya jaayega (is duniya mein) jo usne apne liye kiye, yahan tak ki jab Aakhirat aayegi, use koi bhi nekokaari nahi milegi jiske liye use sawaab diya jaaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus told him: When a non-believer does good he is made to taste Its reward in this world. And so far as the believer is concerned, Allah stores (the reward) of his virtues for the Hereafter and provides him sustenance in accordance with his obedience to Him.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Jab ek gair-imaandaar nekokaari karta hai use iska sawaab is duniya mein chakhaaya jaata hai. Aur jahan tak momin ka sawaal hai, Allah uske nekokaar amalon ka sawaab Aakhirat ke liye jama rakhte hain aur unki Allah ki itaat ke mutabik unhe rozi dete hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Similitude of a believer is that of (a standing) crop which the air continues to toss from one side to another; in the same way a believer always (receives the strokes) of misfortune. The similitude of a hypocrite is that of a cypress tree which does not move until it is uprooted.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Momin ki misaal khadi fasal jaisi hai jise hawa ek taraf se doosri taraf hamesha jhukaati rehti hai; isi tarah momin ko hamesha (badnaseebi ki) chotein padti rehti hain. Munafiq ki misaal saru ke darakht jaisi hai jo tab tak nahi hilta jab tak use jad se ukhaad na diya jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ka'b reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop in a field which is shaken by wind and then it comes to its original position but it stands at its roots. The similitude of a non-believer is that of a cypress tree which stands on its roots and nothing shakes it but it is uprooted (with) one (violent stroke).
hi: Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki momin ki misaal khet mein khadi fasal jaisi hai jise hawa jhukaati hai aur phir ye apni asal jagah par wapas aa jaati hai lekin ye apni jadon par khadi rehti hai. Gair-imaandaar ki misaal saru ke darakht jaisi hai jo apni jad par khada rehta hai aur ise kuch nahi hila sakta lekin ise (ek hi zoradaar) chot se ukhaad diya jaata hai.

e: Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop. The wind sometimes shakes it and sometimes raises it up and then it comes to its destined end. And the similitude of a hypocrite is that of a cypress tree which is not affected by anything but is uprooted once for all.
hi: Ka'b bin Malik (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki momin ki misaal khadi fasal jaisi hai. Hawa kabhi kabhi ise jhukaati hai aur kabhi ise uThAti hai aur phir ye apne muqarrar anjaam tak pahunchti hai. Aur munafiq ki misaal saru ke darakht jaisi hai jise kuch bhi asar nahi karta lekin ise hamesha ke liye ek hi baar mein ukhaad diya jaata hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated through a couple of other chains of transmitters, one which says "the similitude of the disbeliever" instead and another which agrees with the wording of the previous hadith.
hi: Ye hadees do aur sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, ek jismein gair-imaandaar ki misaal ke bajaay ye zikr hai aur doosri jo pichhli hadees ke alfaazon se milti-julti hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ka'b through another chain of transmitters but with " "the similitude of the disbeliever is that of a cypress tree".
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Ka'b (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin gair-imaandaar ki misaal saru ke darakht jaisi hai ke saath.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is a tree amongst trees, the leaves of which do not wither and that is like a Muslim; tell me which that (tree) can be? The people began to think of the trees of the forest. Abdullah said: I thought that it could be the date-palm tree, but I felt hesitant (to say that). They (the Companions) then said: Allah's Messenger, (kindly) tell us which that can be? Thereupon he said: It is the date-palm tree. I made a mention of that to 'Umar, whereupon he said: Had you said that it meant the date-palin tree, this statement of yours (would have been dearer to me) than such and such things.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Darakhton mein ek darakht hai jiske patte kabhi murjhate nahi, aur ye ek Musalman ki tarah hai; mujhe bataao ki ye kaunsa (darakht) ho sakta hai? Log jangal ke darakhton ke baare mein sochne lage. Abdullah ne kaha: Maine socha ki ye khajoor ka darakht ho sakta hai, lekin mujhe (ye kehne mein) hichkichaahat hui. Unhone (Sahaba ne) phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, (meherbani karke) humein bataiye ye kya ho sakta hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye khajoor ka darakht hai. Maine iska zikr Umar se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne kaha hota ki iska matlab khajoor ka darakht hai, to tumhaari ye baat mujhe aisi-aisi cheezon se zyada aziz hoti.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day said to his Companions: Tell me about a tree which has resemblance with a believer. The people began to mention (different) trees of the forest. Ibn 'Umar said: It was instilled in my mind or in my heart and it stuck therein that it implied the date- palm tree. I made up my mind to make a mention of that but could not do that because of the presence of the elderly people there. When there was a hush amongst them (after they had expressed their views), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It Is the date-palm tree.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din apne Sahaba se kaha: Mujhe us darakht ke baare mein bataao jismein ek momin se milta-julta pehlu hai. Log jangal ke (mukhtalif) darakhton ka zikr karne lage. Ibn Umar ne kaha: Ye mere zehan ya mere dil mein aaya aur ismein jam gaya ki iska matlab khajoor ka darakht hai. Maine iska zikr karne ka mann bana liya lekin waha maujood boodhe logon ki wajah se aisa nahi kar paaya. Jab unke beech khaamoshi chha gayi (apni raay zaahir karne ke baad), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye khajoor ka darakht hai.

e: Mujahid said: (I have had the privilege) of accompanying Ibn 'Umar up to Medina but I did not hear him narrate anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except one hadith. And he said: We were in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that there was brought to him the kernel of a date. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Mujahid ne kaha: (Mujhe ye saubhaagya mila) Ibn Umar (RA) ki sohbat mein Madina tak jaane ka lekin maine unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hi hadees riwayat karte suna. Aur unhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein the ki unke paas khajoor ki ek gutli laayi gayi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Mujahid reported: I heard Ibn 'Umar as saying: There was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the kernel. The rest of the hadith is tile same.
hi: Mujahid ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khajoor ki gutli laayi gayi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Ibn Umar reported: We were'in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Tell me of a tree which has resemblance to a Muslim and the leaves of which do not wither. Ibrahim said that perhaps Imam Muslim had stated like this: It constantly bears fruit but I have, however, seen . Ibn Umar said: It crossed my mind that it could be the date-palm tree, but as I saw Aba Bakr and Umar observe silence, I did not deem it fit that I should speak or I should say something. 'Umar said: Had you said so, it would have been dearer to me than such and such thing.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki unhone farmaaya: Mujhe us darakht ke baare mein bataao jo Musalman se milta-julta hai aur jiske patte nahi murjhate. Ibrahim ne kaha ki shaayad Imam Muslim ne is tarah kaha: Iske phal hamesha lagte hain, lekin maine dekha... Ibn Umar ne kaha: Mere zehan mein khyaal aaya ki ye khajoor ka darakht ho sakta hai, lekin jab maine Abu Bakr aur Umar ko khamosh dekha, maine ye theek nahi samjha ki main kuch bolun ya kuch kahoon. Umar ne kaha: Agar tumne aisa kaha hota, to ye mujhe aisi-aisi cheez se zyada aziz hota.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the Satan has lost all hopes that the worshippers would ever worship (him) in the peninsula of Arabia, but he (is hopeful) that he would sow the seed of dissension amongst them.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Shaitaan ne Arabia prayadweep mein ibadat karne walon ke apni ibadat karne ki har ummeed chhod di hai, lekin usse (ye ummeed hai) ki woh unke beech phoot Dalne ke beej boye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: The throne of Iblis is upon the ocean and he sends detachments (to different parts) inorder to put people to trial and the most important figure in his eyes is one who is most notorious in sowing the seed of dissension.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Iblis ka takht samundar par hai aur woh (apne) daste (mukhtalif jagahon par) bhejta hai logon ko pareeksha mein daalne ke liye, aur uski nazar mein sabse mahatvapurna woh hai jo phoot Dalne mein sabse zyada badnaam hai.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Iblis places his throne upon water; he then sends detachments (for creating dissension) ; the nearer to him in rank are those who are most notorious in creating dissension. One of them comes and says: "I did so and so." And he says: "You have done nothing." Then one amongst them comes and says: "I did not spare so and so until I sowed the seed of discord between a husband and a wife." The Satan goes near him and says: "You have done well." A'mash said: He then embraces him.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Iblis apna takht paani par rakhta hai; phir woh (phoot Dalne ke liye) daste bhejta hai; jo phoot Dalne mein sabse zyada badnaam hain woh uske darje mein sabse qareeb hote hain. Unmein se ek aata hai aur kehta hai: Maine aisa-aisa kiya. Aur woh kehta hai: Tumne kuch nahi kiya. Phir unmein se ek aata hai aur kehta hai: Maine falan-falan ko tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak maine pati-patni ke beech phoot ki jad na daal di. Shaitaan uske qareeb jaata hai aur kehta hai: Tumne achha kiya. A'mash ne kaha: Phir woh use gale lagaata hai.

e: Jabir reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upqn him) said: The Satan sends detachments of his own in order to put people to trial and the highest in rank, in his eyes, is one who is most notorious in sowing the seed of dissension.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Shaitaan apne khud ke daste bhejta hai logon ko pareeksha mein daalne ke liye, aur uski nazar mein sabse uche darje wala woh hai jo phoot Dalne mein sabse zyada badnaam hai.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is none amongst you with whom is not an attache from amongst the jinn (devil). They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, with you too? Thereupon he said: Yes, but Allah helps me against him and so I am safe from his hand and he does not command me but for good.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske saath jinn (Shaitaan) mein se koi saathi na ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapke saath bhi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Haan, lekin Allah uske khilaaf meri madad karta hai, isliye main uske haath se mahfooz hoon aur woh mujhe sirf achhaai ka hukum deta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansiir with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A'isha the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out of her (apartment) during the night and she felt jealous. Then he came and he saw me (in what agitated state of mind) I was. He said: A'isha, what has happened to you? Do you feel jealous? Thereupon she said: How can it be (that a woman like me) should not feel jealous in regard to a husband like you. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It was your devil who had come to you, and she said: Allah's Messenger, is there along with me a devil? He said: Yes. I said: Is a devil attached to everyone? He said: Yes. I (Aisha) again said: Allah's Messenger, is it with you also? He said: Yes, but my Lord has helped me against him and as such I am absolutely safe from his mischief.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ko unke kamre se bahar gaye aur unhe jalan mehsoos hui. Phir woh aaye aur unhone dekha ki main kaisi (bechain) haalat mein hoon. Unhone farmaaya: Aisha, tumhe kya hua? Kya tumhe jalan mehsoos ho rahi hai? Isper unhone kaha: Ye kaise ho sakta hai ki (mere jaisi aurat) aapke jaise pati ke prati jalan mehsoos na kare? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye tumhaara Shaitaan tha jo tumhaare paas aaya tha, aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya mere saath bhi ek Shaitaan hai? Unhone farmaaya: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya har kisi ke saath ek Shaitaan hota hai? Unhone farmaaya: Haan. Maine (Aisha ne) phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapke saath bhi hai? Unhone farmaaya: Haan, lekin mere Rab ne uske khilaaf meri madad ki hai aur is tarah main uski shararat se poori tarah mahfooz hoon.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None amongst you would attain salvation purely because of his deeds. A person said: Allah's Messenger, even you? Thereupon he said: Yes, not even I except that Allah wraps me in Mercy, but you should act with moderation. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Bukair b. al-Ashajj with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi sirf apne amalon ki wajah se mukti nahi paayega. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Haan, main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apni Rehmat mein lapet le, lekin tumhe santulit tareeke se amal karna chahiye. Ye hadees Bukair bin al-Ashajj ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is none whose deeds alone would entitle him to get into Paradise. It was said to him: And, Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that my Lord wraps me in Mercy.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske amal akele use Jannat mein daakhil hone ke laayak banaayein. Unse poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki mere Rab mujhe Apni Rehmat mein lapet lein.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is none amongst you whose deeds alone would attain salvation for him. They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in Mercy and He grants me pardon. Ibn 'Aun pointed towards his head with his hand saying: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in His Forgiveness and Mercy.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske amal akele use mukti dila sakein. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apni Rehmat mein lapet le aur mujhe maafi ata kare. Ibn Aun ne apne haath se apne sar ki taraf ishara karte hue kaha: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apni Maafi aur Rehmat mein lapet le.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is none whose deeds alone can'secure salvation for him. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that, the Mercy of Allah should take hold of me.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske amal akele use mukti dila sakein. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah ki Rehmat mujhe apne aagosh mein le le.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None amongst you can get. into Paradise by virtue of his deeds alone. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Grace and Mercy.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi apne amal ki wajah se akele Jannat mein daakhil nahi ho sakta. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apne Fazl aur Rehmat mein lapet le.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Observe moderation in deeds (and if it is not possible, try to be near moderation) and understand that none amongst you can attain salvation because of his deeds alone. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Mercy and Grace.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Amal mein santulan rakho (aur agar ye mumkin na ho to santulan ke qareeb rehne ki koshish karo) aur samjho ki tum mein se koi bhi apne amal ki wajah se akele mukti nahi paa sakta. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apni Rehmat aur Fazl mein lapet le.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through two other chains of transmitters. The wording is, however, the same.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees A'mash ki sanad se do aur sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Alfaaz, halaanki, wahi hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with this addition: " Give them glad tidings".
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Unhe khushkhabri do."

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: None of you would get into Paradise because of his good deeds alone, and he would not be rescued from Fire, not even I, but because of the Mercy of Allah.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi apne nekokaar amalon ki wajah se akele Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga, aur na hi use akele aag se bachaaya jaayega, mujhe bhi nahi, siwaay Allah ki Rehmat ki wajah se.

e: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say: Observe moderation (in doing deeds), and if you fail to observe it perfectly, try to do as much as you can do (to live up to this ideal of moderation) and be happy for none would be able to get into Paradise because of his deeds alone. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in His Mercy, and bear this in mind that the deed loved most by Allah is one which is done constantly even though it is small.
hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the: Santulan (amal mein) rakho, aur agar tum ise poori tarah nahi bana paate, to jitna kar sakte ho utna karne ki koshish karo (is aadarsh ke qareeb rehne ke liye), aur khush raho kyunki koi bhi apne amal ki wajah se akele Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ke Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap bhi nahi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Main bhi nahi, siwaay is baat ke ki Allah mujhe Apni Rehmat mein lapet le, aur ye yaad rakho ki Allah ko sabse zyada aziz amal woh hai jo lagataar kiya jaaye chahe woh choTa hi kyun na ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Musa b. `Uqba with the same chain of transmitters and he did not make a mention of: "Be happy".
hi: Ye hadees Musa bin Uqba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin unhone "khush raho" ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) worshipped so much that his feet were swollen. It was said to him: (Why do you undergo so much hardship despite the fact that) Allah has pardoned for you your earlier and later sins? Thereupon he said: May I not (prove myself) to be a grateful servant (of Allah)?
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni zyada ibadat karte the ki unke paon sooj jaate. Unse poocha gaya: (Aap itni mushkil kyun uThAte hain jabki) Allah ne aapke pehle aur baad ke gunah maaf kar diye hain? Isper unhone farmaaya: Kya main (Allah ka) shukriya guzaar banda na banoon?

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Mughira b. Shu'ba and the words are: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) kept standing in prayer (for such long hours) that his feet were swollen. They (his Companions) said: Verily, Allah has pardoned for thee the earlier and the later of thine sins. Thereupon he said: Should I not prove myself to be a grateful servant (of Allah)?
hi: Ye hadees Mughira bin Shu'ba (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur alfaaz hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni der khade hokar namaz padhte ki unke paon sooj jaate. Unhone (unke Sahaba ne) kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah ne aapke pehle aur baad ke gunah maaf kar diye hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: Kya main (Allah ka) shukriya guzaar banda na banoon?

e: A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) occupied himself in prayer, he observed such a (long) qiyam (posture of standing in prayer) that his feet were swollen. A'isha said: Allah's Messenger you do this (in spite of the fact) that your earlier and later sins have been pardoned for you? Thereupon, he said. A'isha should I not prove myself to be a thanksgiving servant (of Allah)?
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein masroof hote, woh itni der khade rehte (qiyaam ki haalat mein) ki unke paon sooj jaate. Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap ye (mushkil) karte hain jabki aapke pehle aur baad ke gunah maaf kiye jaa chuke hain? Isper unhone farmaaya: Aisha, kya main (Allah ka) shukriya guzaar banda na banoon?

e: Shaqiq reported: We were sitting at the door of Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) waiting for him (to come out and deliver a sermon to us). It was at this time that there happened to pass by us Yazid b. Mu'awiya an-Nakha'i. We said: Inform him ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) of our presence here. He went in and Abdullah b.
