Mas'ud lost no time in coming out to us and said: I was informed of your presence here but nothing hindered me to come out to you but the fact that I did not like to bore you (by stuffing your minds with sermons) as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not deliver us sermon on certain days fearing that it might prove to be boring for us.
hi: Shaqiq ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ke darwaze par baithe unka intezaar kar rahe the (ki woh bahar aakar humein khutba dein). Isi waqt Yazid bin Muawiya al-Nakha'i humaare paas se guzre. Humne unse kaha: (Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko) humaari yahan maujoodgi ki khabar de dijiye. Woh andar gaye aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud jaldi se bahar aaye aur kaha: Mujhe tumhaari yahan maujoodgi ki khabar mil gayi thi, lekin mujhe bahar aane se sirf ek hi baat ne roka aur woh ye ki mujhe ye pasand nahi tha ki main tumhe khutbon se boriyat mein daaloon, jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein kuch khaas dinon mein khutba nahi diya karte the is Dar se ki ye humein boriyat de.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through other chains of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Shaqiq b. Wi'il reported that 'Abdullah used to give us sermon on every Thursday. A person said: Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, we love your talk and so we yearn (to listen to you) and earnestly desire that you should deliver us lecture every day. Thereupon he said: There is nothing to hinder me in giving you talk (every day) but the fact that you may be bored. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not deliver sermons on certain days (fearing that we might be bored).
hi: Shaqiq bin Wail ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah har Guruvaar ko humein khutba diya karte the. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Abu Abd al-Rahman, humein aapki baaton se bahut muhabbat hai isliye humein aapko sunne ki tammanna rehti hai aur humaari dili khwaish hai ki aap humein har din khutba diya karein. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe har din khutba dene se sirf ek hi baat rokti hai aur woh ye ki tumhe boriyat ho sakti hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bhi humein kuch khaas dinon mein khutba nahi diya karte the (is Dar se ki humein boriyat ho).

e: Anas b. Malik reported: The Paradise is surrounded by hardships and the Hell-Fire is surrounded by temptations.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jannat ko mushkilon se ghera gaya hai aur Jahannam ki aag ko lalchaane waali cheezon se ghera gaya hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that: Allah the Exalted and Glorious, said: I have prepared for My pious servants which no eye has ever seen, and no ear has ever heard, and no human heart has ever perceived but it is testified by the Book of Allah. He then recited:" No soul knows what comfort has been concealed from them, as a reward for what they did". (xxxii. 17)
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Maine Apne nekokaar bandon ke liye woh cheezein taiyaar ki hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhi hain, na kisi kaan ne suni hain, aur na kisi insaan ke dil ne mehsoos ki hain, lekin isper Allah ki Kitaab gawaahi deti hai. Phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Koi rooh nahi jaanta ki unke liye kaunsa aaraam chhupaaya gaya hai, unke amalon ke badle mein" (32:17).

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: I have prepared for My pious servants which no eye (has ever) seen, no ear has (ever) heard and no human heart has ever perceived those bounties leaving apart (those bounties) about which Allah has informed you.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Maine Apne nekokaar bandon ke liye woh cheezein taiyaar ki hain jo kisi aankh ne (kabhi) nahi dekhi, kisi kaan ne (kabhi) nahi suni aur kisi insaan ke dil ne (kabhi) mehsoos nahi ki - un barkaton ke ilaawa jinke baare mein Allah ne tumhe pehle hi bataaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: I have prepared for My pious servants which the eye has seen not, and the ear has heard not and no human heart has ever perceived such bounties leaving aside those about which Allah has informed you. He then recited:" No soul knows what comfort has been hidden for thein".
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Maine Apne nekokaar bandon ke liye woh cheezein taiyaar ki hain jo aankh ne nahi dekhi, kaan ne nahi suni aur kisi insaan ke dil ne aisi barkaten mehsoos nahi kin - un barkaton ke ilaawa jinke baare mein Allah ne tumhe bataaya hai. Phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Koi rooh nahi jaanta ki unke liye kaunsi aankhon ki thandak chhupaayi gayi hai."

e: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi reported: I was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he gave a description of Paradise and then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) concluded with these words: There would be bounties which the eye has not seen and the ear has not heard and no human heart has ever perceived them. He then recited this verse:" They forsake (their) beds, calling upon their Lord in fear and in hope, and spend out of what We have given them. So no soul knows what refreshment of the eyes is hidden for them: a reward for what they did" (xxxii. 16-17)
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd al-Sa'idi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein tha jab unhone Jannat ka varnan kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne in alfaazon ke saath baat khatm ki: Wahan aisi barkaten hongi jo na kisi aankh ne dekhi hain, na kisi kaan ne suni hain aur na kisi insaan ke dil ne mehsoos ki hain. Phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Unke pehlu apne bistaron se dur rehte hain, apne Rab ko khauf aur ummeed ke saath pukaarte hain, aur Humne unhe jo diya hai usmein se kharch karte hain. Isliye koi rooh nahi jaanta ki unke liye kaunsi aankhon ki thandak chhupaayi gayi hai, unke amalon ke badle mein" (32:16-17).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider can travel for a hundred years.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiski chhaaya mein ek sawaar sau saal tak safar kar sakta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with the addition of these words: " He will not be able to cover this distance."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Woh is doori ko poori tarah tay nahi kar paayega."

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider can travel for a hundred years without covering (the distance) completely. This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) is reported to have said: In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider of a fine and swift-footed horse would travel for a hundred years without covering the distance completely. There would be the pleasure of Allah for the inmates of Paradise and He would never be annoyed with them.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiski chhaaya mein ek sawaar sau saal tak safar kar sakta hai bina (doori) poori tarah tay kiye. Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ki sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiski chhaaya mein ek behtareen aur tez-raftaar ghode ka sawaar sau saal tak safar karega bina (doori) poori tarah tay kiye. Jannat ke bashindon ke liye Allah ki khushi hogi aur Woh unse kabhi naaraaz nahi honge.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that Allah would say to the inmates of Paradise: O, Dwellers of Paradise, and they would say in response: At thy service and pleasure, our Lord, the good is in Thy Hand. He (the Lord) would say: Are you well pleased now? They would say: Why should we not be pleased, O Lord, when Thou hast given us what Thou hast not given to any of Thy creatures? He would, however, say: May I not give you (something) even more excellent than that? And they would say: O Lord, what thing can be more excellent than this? And He would say: I shall cause My pleasure to alight upon you and I shall never be afterwards annoyed with you.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Allah Jannat ke bashindon se farmaayenge: Aye Jannat ke bashindo! Aur woh jawaab denge: Hum Teri khidmat mein hazir hain aur Teri khushi ke muntazir hain, humaare Rab, achhaai Teri Zaat mein hi hai. Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Kya tum ab khush ho? Woh kahenge: Hum khush kyun na hon, Aye Rab, jabki Tune humein woh diya hai jo Tune Apni kisi doosri makhlooq ko nahi diya? Woh, halaanki, farmaayenge: Kya Main tumhe isse bhi behtareen kuch na dun? Aur woh kahenge: Aye Rab, isse behtar aur kya cheez ho sakti hai? Aur Woh farmaayenge: Main tumhe Apni khushi se nawaazunga aur uske baad kabhi tumse naaraaz nahi hunga.

e: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The inmates of Paradise will look to the upper apartment of Paradise as you see the planets in the sky. I narrated this hadith to Nu'man b. Abi 'Ayyash and he said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri as saying: As you see the shining planets in the eastern and western (sides of) horizon.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat ke bashinde Jannat ke upari kamron ko waise hi dekhenge jaise tum aasmaan mein sitaare dekhte ho. Maine ye hadees Nu'man bin Abu Ayyash ko riwayat ki aur unhone kaha: Maine Abu Sa'id Khudri ko ye kehte suna: Jaise tum poorab aur pashchim ki taraf chamakte sitaare dekhte ho.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Hazim through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Hazim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The inmates of Paradise would see the inmates of the apartment over them just as you see the shining planets which remain in the eastern and the western horizon because of the superiority some have over others. They said: Allah's Messenger, would in these abodes of Apostles others besides them not be able to reach? He said: Yes, they will, by Him, in Whose hand is my life, those who believe in God and acknowledge the Truth, will reach them.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat ke bashinde apne upar ke kamron ke bashindon ko waise dekhenge jaise tum poorab aur pashchim ki taraf chamakte sitaare dekhte ho, kyunki unmein se kuch doosron par darja rakhte hain. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya in (Rasoolon ke) ghar ke maqamon tak doosre log nahi pahunch payenge? Unhone farmaaya: Woh zaroor pahunchenge, Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, woh log bhi jo Allah par imaan rakhte hain aur Sach ko svikaar karte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The people most loved by me from amongst my Ummah would be those who would come after me but everyone amongst them would have the keenest desire to catch a glimpse of me even at the cost of his family and wealth.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Mujhse sabse zyada muhabbat karne wale meri Ummat ke woh log honge jo mere baad aayenge, lekin unmein se har ek ko mujhe ek jhalak dekhne ki bahut zyada khwaish hogi, apne khaandaan aur apni daulat ki keemat par bhi.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: In Paradise there is a street to which they would come every Friday. The north wind will blow and would scatter fragrance on their faces and on their clothes and would add to their beauty and loveliness, and then they would go back to their family after having an added lustre to their beauty and loveliness, and their family would say to them: By Allah, you have been increased in beauty and loveliness after leaving us, and they would say: By Allah, you have also increased in beauty and loveliness after us.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat mein ek raasta hai jahan woh (Jannat ke bashinde) har Juma ko aayenge. Uttari hawa chalegi aur unke chehron aur unke kapdon par khushboo bikher degi aur unki khoobsurati aur suhaani surat mein izafa karegi, aur phir woh apni khoobsurati aur suhaani surat mein izafe ke saath apne khaandaan ke paas wapas jaayenge, aur unka khaandaan unse kahega: Allah ki qasam, hume chhodne ke baad tumhaari khoobsurati aur zyada badh gayi hai, aur woh kahenge: Allah ki qasam, humse alag hone ke baad tumhaari bhi khoobsurati aur zyada badh gayi hai.

e: Muhammad reported that some (persons) stated with a sense of pride and some discussed whether there would be more men in Paradise or more women. It was upon this that Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l Qasim (the Holy Prophet) (ﷺ) said: The (members) of the first group to get into Paradise would have their faces as bright as full moon during the night, and the next to this group would have their faces as bright as the shining stars in the sky, and every person would have two wives and the marrow of their shanks would glimmer beneath the flesh and there would be none without a wife in Paradise.
hi: Muhammad ne bayan kiya ki kuch logon ne ghamand ki bhaavna ke saath charcha ki aur kuch logon ne is baare mein baat ki ki Jannat mein zyada mard honge ya zyada auraten. Isi mauke par Abu Huraira ne ye riwayat ki ki Abu'l-Qasim (Pavitr Nabi) ne farmaaya: Jannat mein sabse pehle daakhil hone waale (bashindon) ke chehre chaudhvin raat raat ke chaand jaise chamakdaar honge, aur unke baad ke giroh ke chehre aasmaan ke chamakte sitaaron jaise honge, aur har shakhs ki do zaujaen hongi aur unki pindliyon ki magaz gosht ke neeche se chamkegi, aur Jannat mein koi bhi zauja ke bina nahi hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The (members of the) first group which would get into Paradise will have their faces as bright as stars in the sky. They would neither pass water, nor void excrement, nor will they suffer from catarrh, nor will they spit, and their combs would be made of gold, and their sweat will be musk, the fuel of their brazier will be aloes, and their wives will be large-eyed maidens and their form would be alike as one single person after the form of their father (Adam) sixty cubits tall.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat mein sabse pehle daakhil hone waale giroh ke (bashindon) ke chehre aasmaan ke sitaaron jaise chamakdaar honge. Woh na peshaab karenge, na malmootra tyaag karenge, na unhe nazla hoga, na woh thookenge, aur unki kanghiyaan sone ki hongi, aur unke seene mein aag (khushboo ke liye) oodh (agarwood) hogi, aur unki zaujaen badi aankhon wali hooren hongi aur unka soorat ek hi jaisa hoga, apne waalid (Aadam) ki tarah, saTh haath ooncha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The first group of my Ummah to get into Paradise would be like a full moon in the night. Then those who would be next to them; they would be like the most significantly glittering stars in regard to brightness, then after them (others) in ranks. They would neither void excrement, nor pass water, nor suffer from catarrh, nor would they spit. And their combs would be made of gold, and the fuel of their braziers would be aloes and their sweat would be musk and their form would be the form of one single person according to the length of their father sixty cubits tall. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Shaiba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Meri Ummat mein Jannat mein sabse pehle daakhil hone waala giroh chaudhvin raat raat ke chaand jaisa hoga. Phir unke baad wale, roshni mein sabse zyada chamakdaar sitaaron jaise honge, phir unke baad (doosre) darjon mein. Woh na malmootra tyaag karenge, na peshaab karenge, na unhe nazla hoga, na woh thookenge. Aur unki kanghiyaan sone ki hongi, aur unke seenon ki aag oodh hogi aur unka pasina mushk jaisa hoga aur unka soorat ek hi shakhs jaisa hoga apne waalid ki lambaai ke mutabik, saTh haath ooncha. Ye hadees Ibn Abu Shaiba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: These are some of the ahidith which Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one is this that he is reported to have said: The (members of the) first group that would be admitted to Paradise would have their faces as bright as full moon during the night. They would neither spit nor suffer catarrh, nor void excrement. They would have their utensils and their combs made of gold and silver and the fuel of their braziers would be aloes and their sweat would be musk and every one of them would have two spouses (so beautiful) that the marrow of their shanks would be visible through the flesh. There would be no dissension amongst them and no enmity in their hearts. Their hearts would be like one heart, glorifying Allah morning and evening.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha: Ye kuch ahadees hain jo Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kin, aur inmein se ek ye hai ki unhone farmaaya: Jannat mein sabse pehle daakhil hone waale giroh ke (bashinde) ke chehre chaudhvin raat raat ke chaand jaise chamakdaar honge. Woh na thookenge na unhe nazla hoga, na woh malmootra tyaag karenge. Unke bartan aur kanghiyaan sone aur chandi ke honge aur unke seenon ki aag oodh hogi aur unka pasina mushk jaisa hoga aur unmein se har ek ki do zaujaen hongi (itni khoobsurat) ki unki pindliyon ka magaz gosht ke neeche se dikhega. Unmein koi bair-bhaav nahi hoga aur unke dilon mein koi dushmani nahi hogi. Unke dil ek dil jaise honge, subah aur shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karte huye.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that the inmates of Paradise would eat and drink but would neither spit, nor pass water, nor void excrement, nor suffer catarrah. It was said: Then, what would happen with food? Thereupon he said: They would belch and sweat (and it would be over with their food), and their sweat would be that of musk and they would glorify and praise Allah as easily as you breathe.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Jannat ke bashinde khaayenge aur peeyenge lekin na thookenge, na peshaab karenge, na malmootra tyaag karenge, na unhe nazla hoga. Poocha gaya: Phir unke khaane ka kya hoga? Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh deakaar aur pasina chhodenge (aur unke khaane ki ye samaapti hogi), aur unka pasina mushk jaisa hoga aur woh Allah ki tasbeeh aur hamd itni aasaani se karenge jitni aasaani se tum saans lete ho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that the inmates of Paradise would eat therein and they would also drink, but they would neither void excrement, nor suffer catarrh, nor pass water, and their eating (would be digested) in the form of belching and their sweat would be musk aged they would glorify and praise Allah as easily ai you breathe.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jannat ke bashinde usmein khaayenge aur peeyenge bhi, lekin na malmootra tyaag karenge, na unhe nazla hoga, na peshaab karenge, aur unka khaana deakaar mein (badalega) aur unka pasina mushk jaisa hoga aur woh Allah ki tasbeeh aur hamd itni aasaani se karenge jitni aasaani se tum saans lete ho.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who would get into Paradise (would be made to enjoy such an everlasting) bliss that he would neither become destitute, nor would his clothes wear out, nor his youth would decline.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Jannat mein daakhil hota hai use (hamesha ke liye aisi) khushhaali di jaayegi ki woh na kabhi tang-haal hoga, na uske kapde puraane honge, na uski jawaani dhalegi.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Huraira both reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be an announcer (in Paradise) who would make this announcement: Verily I there is in store for you (everlasting) health and that you should never fall ill and that you live (for ever) and do not die at all. And that you would remain young and never grow old. And that you would always live in affluent circumstances and never become destitute, as words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, are:" And it would be announced to them: This is the Paradise. You have been made to inherit it for what you used to do". (VII; 43)
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri aur Abu Huraira (RA) donon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: (Jannat mein) ek ailaan karne wala hoga jo ye ailaan karega: Yaqeenan, tumhaare liye (hamesha ke liye) achhi sehat rakhi gayi hai ki tum kabhi bimaar nahi padoge, aur tum (hamesha ke liye) zinda rahoge aur kabhi nahi maroge. Aur tum hamesha jawaan rahoge aur kabhi budhe nahi hoge. Aur tum hamesha khushhaal rahoge aur kabhi tang-haal nahi hoge, jaisa Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke alfaaz hain: "Aur unhe ailaan kiya jaayega: Ye Jannat hai. Tumhe iska waaris banaaya gaya hai us cheez ki wajah se jo tum karte the" (7:43).

e: Abu Bakr b. Abdullah b. Qais reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that in Paradise there would be for a believer a tent of a single hollowed pearl the breadth of which would be sixty miles. It would be meant for a believer and the believers would go around it and none would be able to see the others.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdullah bin Qais ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jannat mein ek momin ke liye ek khokhle moti se banaaya gaya tambu hoga jiski chaudai saTh mil hogi. Ye ek momin ke liye hoga aur momin log iske chaaron taraf ghoomenge aur ek-doosre ko dekh nahi paayenge.

e: Abu Bakr b. Abdullah b. Qais reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that in Paradise there would be a tent made of a single hollowed pearl, the breadth of which would be sixty miles from all sides and there would live a family in each corner and the other would not be able to see the believer who goes around them.
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdullah bin Qais ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jannat mein ek khokhle moti se banaaya gaya tambu hoga, jiski chaudai saTh mil sabhi taraf se hogi aur har kone mein ek khaandaan rahega aur doosra khaandaan us momin ko nahi dekh paayega jo unke aas-paas ghoom raha hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Musa b. Qais who, on the authority of his father, reported the Apostle (ﷺ) to have said that there would be a tent made of a pearl whose height towards the sky would be sixty miles. In each corner, there would be a family of the believer, out of sight for the others.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Bakr bin Abu Musa bin Qais ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne waalid ke hawaale se Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki ek tambu hoga jo moti se banaaya gaya hoga jiski aasmaan ki taraf oonchaai saTh mil hogi. Har kone mein momin ka ek khaandaan hoga, doosron ki nazron se ojhal.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Saihan, Jaihan, Euphrates and Nile are all among the rivers of Paradise.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Saihan, Jaihan, Euphrates aur Nile ye sab Jannat ki nadiyon mein se hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would enter Paradise people whose hearts would be like those of the hearts of birds.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat mein aise log daakhil honge jinke dil parindon ke dil jaise honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, created Adam in His image with His length of sixty cubits, and as He created him He told him to greet that group, and that was a party of angels sitting there, and listen to the response that they give him, for it would form his greeting and that of his offspring. He then went away and said: Peace be upon you! They (the angels) said: May there be peace upon you and the Mercy of Allah, and they made an addition of" Mercy of Allah". So he who would get into Paradise would get in the form of Adam, his length being sixty cubits, then the people who followed him continued to diminish in size up to this day.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Aadam ko Apni surat mein banaaya, saTh haath ooncha, aur jab Usne unhe banaaya, Usne unse kaha ki woh us giroh ko salaam karein, aur woh Farishton ka ek giroh tha jo wahan baitha tha, aur unke salaam ke jawaab ka intezaar karein, kyunki wahi unka aur unki aulad ka salaam banega. Woh gaye aur kaha: As-Salamu-Alaikum. Unhone (Farishton ne) kaha: Wa Alaikum-us-Salaam wa Rahmatullah, aur unhone "wa Rahmatullah" ka izafa kiya. Isliye jo Jannat mein daakhil hoga woh Aadam ki soorat mein daakhil hoga, jinki lambaai saTh haath thi, phir unke baad aane wale log unke qad mein lagataar kam hote gaye aaj tak.

e: Abdullah b. Mas`ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Hell would be brought on that day (the Day of Judgment) with seventy thousand bridles, and seventy thousand angels dragging each bridle.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jahannam us din (Qayamat ke din) sattar hazaar lagaamon ke saath laayi jaayegi, aur har lagaam ko sattar hazaar Farishte kheech rahe honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The fire which sons of Adam burn is only one-seventieth part of the Fire of Hell. His Companions said: By Allah, even ordinary fire would have been enough (to burn people). Thereupon he said: It is sixty-nine parts in excess of (the heat of) fire in this world each of them being equivalent to their heat.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Woh aag jise Aadam ki aulad jalaati hai, Jahannam ki aag ke sattaravein hisse ka sirf ek hissa hai. Unke Sahaba ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, aam aag hi (logon ko jalaane ke liye) kaafi hoti. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye is duniya ki aag se unnhattar hisse zyada garam hai, aur unmein se har hissa unke (yaani duniya ki aag ke) barabar hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abn Huraira through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we heard a terrible sound. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Do you know what (sound) is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Thereupon he said: That is a stone which was thrown seventy years before in Hell and it has'been constantly slipping down and now it has reached its base.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki humne ek bhayaanak aawaaz suni. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya tumhe pata hai ye kya (aawaaz) hai? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye ek patthar hai jo sattar saal pehle Jahannam mein phenka gaya tha aur ye lagataar neeche fisalta raha aur ab ye apni buniyaad tak pahuncha hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abfi Huraira with the same chain of transmitters but with this change of wording that the Prophet (may. peace be upon him) said: It reached at its base and you heard its sound.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is alfaazon ke badlaav ke saath ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye apni buniyaad tak pahuncha hai aur tumne iski aawaaz suni.

e: Samura b. Jundub reported Allah's Apostle (may peace -be upon him) as saying: There will be some to whose ankels the fire will reach, some to whose knees, some to whose waist the fire will reach, and some to whose collar-bone the fire will reach.
hi: Samura bin Jundub (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kuch aise honge jinke tak khoobiyon tak aag pahunchegi, kuch jinke ghutnon tak aag pahunchegi, kuch jinke kamar tak aag pahunchegi, aur kuch jinke gale ki haddi tak aag pahunchegi.

e: Samura b. Jundub reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be among them those to whom the fire will reach up to their ankels and to some of them the fire would reach their knees and to some it would reach their waists and to some it would reach up to their collar-bones.
hi: Samura bin Jundub (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Unmein se kuch aise honge jinke takhne tak aag pahunchegi aur unmein se kuch jinke ghutnon tak aag pahunchegi aur unmein se kuch jinke kamar tak aag pahunchegi aur unmein se kuch jinke gale ki haddi tak aag pahunchegi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: There was a dispute between the Hell and the Paradise and it (the Hell) said: The haughty and the proud would find abode in me. And the Paradise said: The meek and the humble would find their abode in me. Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, (addressing the Hell) said: You are (the means) of My punishment by which I punish those of My servants whom I wish. (And addressing the Paradise) He said: You are only My Mercy by means of which 1 shall show mercy to those whom I wish, but each one of you would be full.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jahannam aur Jannat ke beech ek bahas hui aur usne (Jahannam ne) kaha: Ghamandi aur takabbur karne wale mujhme apni jagah paayenge. Aur Jannat ne kaha: Vinamr aur farotan log mujhme apni jagah paayenge. Isper Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne (Jahannam se khitaab karte hue) farmaaya: Tu Meri saza ka zariya hai jisse Main Apne un bandon ko saza deta hoon jinhe Main chaahta hoon. (Aur Jannat se khitaab karte hue) Usne farmaaya: Tu sirf Meri Rehmat hai jiske zariye Main un logon par Rehmat karunga jinpar Main chaahunga, lekin tum mein se har ek bhar jaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: The Hell and the Paradise fell into dispute and the Hell said: I have been dis- tinguished by the proud and the haughty. And the Paradise said: What is the matter with me that the meek and the humble amongst people and the downtrodden and the simple enter me? Thereupon Allah said to the Paradise: You are (the means) of My Mercy whereby I show mercy to those of My servants whom 1 wish, and He said to the Hell: You are (the means) of punishment whereby 1 punish those of My servants whoml wish. Both of you will be full. The Hell will riot be filled up until Allah puts down His foot in it. The Hell would say: Enough, enough, enough, and at that time it will be filled up, all its parts integrated together.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jahannam aur Jannat ke beech bahas ho gayi aur Jahannam ne kaha: Mujhme ghamandi aur takabbur karne walon ne apna khaas jagah banaayi hai. Aur Jannat ne kaha: Mujhe kya hua hai ki logon mein se farotan, vinamr, dabe hue aur saadhaaran log mujhme daakhil hote hain? Isper Allah ne Jannat se farmaaya: Tu Meri Rehmat hai jiske zariye Main Apne un bandon par Rehmat karunga jinpar Main chaahunga, aur Usne Jahannam se farmaaya: Tu Meri saza hai jiske zariye Main Apne un bandon ko saza dunga jinhe Main chaahunga, aur tum donon bhar jaaoge. Jahannam tab tak nahi bharegi jab tak Allah Apna Qadam usmein na rakh dein. Jahannam kahegi: Bas, bas, bas, aur usi waqt ye bhar jaayegi, uske saare hisse ek-doosre se mil jaayenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The Paradise and the Hell disputed with each other. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat aur Jahannam mein bahas hui. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported that Abu Huraira narrated to them some ahadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of them is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Paradise and the Hell fell into dispute and the Hell said: 1 have been distinguished for accommodating (the haughty and proud in me), and the Paradise said: What is the matter that the meek and the humble and the downtrodden and simple would find an abode in me? Thereupon Allah said to Paradise: You are a (means) of My Mercy. 1 shall show mercy through you to one whom I will from amongst My servants. And lie said to the Hell: You are a (sign) of My chastisement and I shall chastise through you anyone whom I will from amongst My servants and both of you, would be full. And as regards the Hell it would not be full until Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, places His foot therein, and it would say: Enough, enough, enough, and it would be then full and the one part would draw very close to the other one and Allah would not treat unjustly anyone amongst His creation and He would create another creation for the Paradise (to accommodate it).
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne kaha ki Abu Huraira ne unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch ahadees riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat aur Jahannam ke beech bahas hui aur Jahannam ne kaha: Mujhme (ghamandi aur takabburi logon ko) samaane ka khaas jagah hai, aur Jannat ne kaha: Mujhe kya hua hai ki farotan, vinamr, dabe hue aur saadhaaran log mujhme apni jagah paayenge? Isper Allah ne Jannat se farmaaya: Tu Meri Rehmat hai. Main tere zariye Apne un bandon par Rehmat karunga jinhe Main chaahunga. Aur Usne Jahannam se farmaaya: Tu Mera azaab hai. Main tere zariye Apne un bandon ko saza dunga jinhe main chaahunga, aur tum donon bhar jaaoge. Aur jahan tak Jahannam ka sawaal hai, ye tab tak nahi bharegi jab tak Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, usmein Apna Qadam na rakh dein aur ye kahegi: Bas, bas, bas, aur phir ye bhar jaayegi aur uske hisse ek-doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge, aur Allah Apni makhlooq mein se kisi ke saath anyaay nahi karega aur Woh Jannat ke liye (isse bharne ke liye) ek doosri makhlooq banaayega.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Paradise and the Hell disputed with each other. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Abu Huraira up to the words'." It is essential for Me to fill up both of you."
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jannat aur Jahannam mein bahas hui. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki hai in alfaazon tak: "Ye Mere liye zaroori hai ki main tum donon ko bhar dun."

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that the Hell would continue to say: Is there anything more, until Allah, the Exalted and High, would place His foot therein and that would say: Enough, enough, by Your Honour, and some parts of it would draw close to the other.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Jahannam lagataar kahti rahegi: Kya kuch aur hai? Yahan tak ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, usmein Apna Qadam rakhenge aur ye kahegi: Bas, bas, Teri izzat ki qasam, aur uske kuch hisse ek-doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abd al-Wahhab b. Ata' reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious: We would say to Hell on the Day of Ressurection: Have you been completely filled up? and it would say: Is there anything -more? And he stated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: (The sinners) would be thrown therein and it would continue to say: Is there anything more, until Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would keep His foot there- in and some of its part would draw close to the other and it would say: Enough, enough, by Thy Honour and by Thy Dignity, and there would be enough space in Paradise until Allah would create a new creation and He would make them accommo- date that spare place in Paradise.
hi: Abd al-Wahhab bin Ata ne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke alfaazon ke silsile mein ye riwayat ki: Hum Qayamat ke din Jahannam se kahenge: Kya tum poori tarah bhar chuki ho? Aur ye kahegi: Kya kuch aur hai? Aur unhone Anas bin Malik (RA) ke hawaale se ye bayaan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: (Gunahgaaron ko) usmein phenka jaayega aur ye lagataar kehti rahegi: Kya kuch aur hai, yahan tak ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, usmein Apna Qadam rakhenge aur uske kuch hisse ek-doosre ke qareeb aa jaayenge aur ye kahegi: Bas, bas, Teri izzat aur Teri Buzurgi ki qasam, aur Jannat mein itni jagah bachegi ki Allah ek nayi makhlooq banaayega aur unhe Jannat mein us khaali jagah mein basaayega.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There would be left some space in Paradise as Allah would like that to be left. Then Allah would create another creation as He would like.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jannat mein kuch jagah bachegi jitni Allah chaahenge ki bachi rahe. Phir Allah ek nayi makhlooq banaayenge jaisa Woh chaahenge.

e: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Death would be brought on the Day of Resurrection. in the form of a white-coloured ram. Abu Kuraib made this addition: Then it would be made to stand between the Paradise and the Hell. So far as the rest of the hadith is concerned there is perfect agreement (between the two narrators) and it would be said to the inmates of Paradise: Do you recognise this? They would raise up their necks and look towards it and say: Yes, ' it is death. Then it would be said to the inmates of Hell-Fire.. Do you recognise this? And they would raise up their necks and look and say: Yes, it is death. Then command would be given for slaughtering that and then it would be said: 0 inmates of Paradise,, there is an everlasting life for you and no death. And then (addressing) to the inmates of the Hell-Fire, it would be said: 0 inmates of Hell-Fire, there is an everlasting living for you and no death. Allah's Messenger (may peace be u@on him) then recited this verse pointing with his hand to this (material) world:" Warn them, this Day of dismay, and when their affairs would be decided and they would be un- mindful and they believe not" (xix. 39).
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maut Qayamat ke din safed rang ke mendhe ki soorat mein laayi jaayegi. Abu Kuraib ne ye izafa kiya: Phir ise Jannat aur Jahannam ke beech khada kiya jaayega. Baaki hadees mein poora sahmati hai (donon raawiyon ke beech) aur Jannat ke bashindon se poocha jaayega: Kya tum ise pehchaante ho? Woh apni gardan uThAyenge aur uski taraf dekhenge aur kahenge: Haan, ye maut hai. Phir Jahannam ke bashindon se poocha jaayega: Kya tum ise pehchaante ho? Aur woh apni gardan uThAyenge aur dekhenge aur kahenge: Haan, ye maut hai. Phir ise zibah karne ka hukum diya jaayega aur phir kaha jaayega: Aye Jannat ke bashindo, tumhaare liye hamesha ki zindagi hai aur koi maut nahi. Aur phir (Jahannam ke bashindon ko khitaab karte hue) kaha jaayega: Aye Jahannam ke bashindo, tumhaare liye hamesha ki zindagi hai aur koi maut nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir ye aayat padhi apne haath se is (bhautik) duniya ki taraf ishara karte hue: "Unhe pareshaani ke din se Daraao, jab unke maamlon ka faisla ho jaayega jabki abhi woh be-parvaah hain aur woh imaan nahi rakhte" (19:39).

e: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the inmates of Paradise would be admitted to Paradise and the inmates of Hell would be admitted to Hell, it would be said (to the inmates of Paradise): 0 inmates of Paradise. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation (that he only) said. That is the word of Allah, the Exalted. And he did not say: Then Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) recited, and he did not make a mention of his having pointed with his hand towards the (material) world.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Jannat ke bashindon ko Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega aur Jahannam ke bashindon ko Jahannam mein daakhil kiya jaayega, kaha jaayega (Jannat ke bashindon se): Aye Jannat ke bashindo. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki unhone sirf kaha: Ye Allah, Buland, ka farmaan hai, aur unhone ye nahi kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne padha, aur na hi unhone iska zikr kiya ki unhone apne haath se (bhautik) duniya ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah would admit the inmates of Paradise into Paradise and the inmates of Hell into Hell. Then the announcer would stand between them and say: 0 inmates of Paradise, there is no death for you,0 inmates of Hell, there is no death for you. You would live for ever therein.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah Jannat ke bashindon ko Jannat mein daakhil karenge aur Jahannam ke bashindon ko Jahannam mein daakhil karenge. Phir ailaan karne wala unke beech khada hoga aur kahega: Aye Jannat ke bashindo, tumhaare liye koi maut nahi. Aye Jahannam ke bashindo, tumhaare liye koi maut nahi. Tum yahan hamesha zinda rahoge.

e: `Umar b. Muhammad b. Zaid b. `Abdullah b. `Umar b. al-Khattab reported on the authority of his father `Abdullah b. `Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When the inmates of Paradise would go to Paradise and the inmates of Hell would go to Hell, death would be called and it would be placed between the Paradise and the Hell and then slaughtered and then the announcer would announce: O inmates of Paradise, no death. O inmates of Hell-Fire, no death. And it would increase the delight of the inmates of Paradise and it would increase the grief of the inmates of Hell-Fire.
hi: Umar bin Muhammad bin Zaid bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Khattab ne apne waalid Abdullah bin Umar ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Jannat ke bashinde Jannat mein jaayenge aur Jahannam ke bashinde Jahannam mein jaayenge, Maut ko bulaaya jaayega aur ise Jannat aur Jahannam ke beech khada kiya jaayega aur phir zibah kar diya jaayega aur phir ailaan karne wala ailaan karega: Aye Jannat ke bashindo, koi maut nahi. Aye Jahannam ke bashindo, koi maut nahi. Aur isse Jannat ke bashindon ki khushi aur badh jaayegi aur Jahannam ke bashindon ka gam aur badh jaayega.

e: It is transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The molar tooth of an unbeliever or the canine teeth of an unbeliever will be like Uhud and the thickness of his skin a three night's journey.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek gair-imaandaar ki daadhi ka daant Uhud pahaad jaisa hoga aur uski khaal ki moTAI teen raaton ki safar jitni hogi.

e: Abu Huraira reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: The distance of the two shoulders of the non-believer in Hell will be a three-day journey for a swift rider.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Gair-imaandaar ke do kandhon ke beech ki doori Jahannam mein ek tez-raftaar sawaar ke liye teen din ki safar jitni hogi.

e: Haritha b. Wahb reported that he heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: May I not inform you about the inmates of Paradise? They said: Do this, of course. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Every humble person who is considered to be humble if he were to adjure In the name of Allah, He would fulfil it. He then said: May I not inform you about the denizens of Hell-Fire? They said: Yes. And he said: Every haughty, fat and proud (person).
hi: Haritha bin Wahb (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kya main tumhe Jannat ke bashindon ke baare mein na bataun? Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Zaroor bataiye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Har vinamr shakhs jise (samaaj mein) kamzor samjha jaata hai, agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam le, Allah use poora karega. Phir unhone farmaaya: Kya main tumhe Jahannam ke bashindon ke baare mein na bataun? Unhone kaha: Zaroor. Aur unhone farmaaya: Har ghamandi, moti-taazi (aur) takabbur karne wala.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Haritha b. Wahb al-KhuzaIi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: May I not inform you about the inmates of Paradise? (And then informing about them) said: Every meek person who is considered to be humble and if they were to adjure in the name of Allah, Allah would certainly fulfil it. May I not inform you about the inmates of Hell-Fire? They are all proud, mean and haughty.
hi: Haritha bin Wahb al-Khuza'i (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kya main tumhe Jannat ke bashindon ke baare mein na bataun? (Aur phir unke baare mein bataate hue) unhone farmaaya: Har vinamr shakhs jise farotan samjha jaata hai aur agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam le, Allah zaroor use poora karega. Kya main tumhe Jahannam ke bashindon ke baare mein na bataun? Woh sab takabburi, neech aur ghamandi log hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: Many a people with dishevelled hair are driven away from the door (but they are so pious) that if they are to swear in the name of Allah, He would definitely fulfil that.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Bahut se aise log jinke baal uljhe hain unhe darwaze se bhaga diya jaata hai (lekin woh itne nekokaar hain) ki agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam le lein, Woh use zaroor poora karenge.

e: 'Abdullah b. Zam'a reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address and he made a mention of the dromedary and also made a mention of one (base person) who cut off Its hind legs, and he recited: " When the basest of them broke forth with mischief" (xei. 12). When A mischievous person, strong even because of the strength of a family like Abu Zam'a, broke forth. He then delivered instruction in regard to the women saying: There is amongst you who beats his woman, and in the narration on the authority of Abu Bakr, the words are: He flogs her like a slave-girl. And in the narration of Abu Kuraib (the words are): He flogs like a slave and then comforts his bed with the help of that at the end of the day, and he then advised in regard to laughing of people at the breaking of wind and said: One of you laughs at that which you yourself do.
hi: Abdullah bin Zam'a (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khutba diya aur unhone oontni ka zikr kiya aur us shakhs ka bhi zikr kiya jisne uski peechhli tangein kaaTi thin, aur unhone ye padha: "Jab unmein se sabse neech shakhs badhcharhkar upadrav mein aaya" (91:12). Jab ek badmaash shakhs, Abu Zam'a ke khaandaan jaisi taakat waale khaandaan ki wajah se bhi taakatvar, aage badha. Unhone phir auraton ke baare mein taalim di aur kaha: Tum mein se kuch aise hain jo apni aurat ko maarte hain, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Woh use ek laundi ki tarah koda lagaata hai. Aur Abu Kuraib ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Woh use ek ghulam ki tarah koda lagaata hai aur phir din ke aakhir mein usi ke saath apna bistar aaraam-daayak banaata hai, aur phir unhone logon ke hawa nikalne par hansne ke baare mein salaah di aur kaha: Tum mein se kaun hansta hai us cheez par jo tum khud karte ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: I saw 'Amr b. Luhayy b. Qam'a b. Khindif, brother of Bani Ka'b, dragging his Intestines in Fire.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine Amr bin Luhayy bin Qam'a bin Khindif ko, jo Banu Ka'b ke bhai the, apni antriyaan aag mein ghaseete hue dekha.

e: Sa'id b. Musayyib explained" al-bahira" as that animal which is not milked but for the idols. and none amongst the people milks them, and" as-sa'iba" as that animal which is let loose for the deities. Nothing is loaded over it, and Ibn Musayyib narrated that Abu Huraira stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I saw 'Amr b. 'Amir al-Khuzili dragging his intestines in fire and he was the first who devoted animals to deity.
hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne "al-Bahira" ki vyaakhya us jaanwar ke soorat mein ki jise doodh nahi nikaala jaata balki ye murtiyon ke liye chhoda jaata hai, aur koi bhi log unhe doodh nahi nikaalte, aur "as-Sa'iba" us jaanwar ki jise devi-devton ke naam par aazad chhoda jaata hai. Ismein koi bojh nahi laada jaata, aur Ibn Musayyib ne riwayat ki ki Abu Huraira ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Maine Amr bin Amir al-Khuza'i ko apni antriyaan aag mein ghaseete hue dekha, aur woh pehla shakhs the jinhone jaanwaron ko murtiyon ke naam par waqf kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Two are the types amongst the denizens of Hell, the one possessing whips like the tail of an ox and they flog people with their help. (The second one) the women who would be naked in spite of their being dressed, who are seduced (to wrong paths) and seduce others with their hair high like humps. These women would not get into Paradise and they would not perceive the odour of Paradise, although its frag- rance can be perceived from such and such distance (from great distance).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jahannam ke bashindon mein do kism ke log honge - ek jinke paas bael ki dum jaise koDe honge aur woh unse logon ko maarenge; (aur doosri kism) auraten jo kapde pehne huye bhi nange hongi, jo lubhaayi gayi hain aur doosron ko lubhaati hain, jinke baal ooncha jooda banaaye hue oont ke koohan jaise honge. Ye auraten Jannat mein daakhil nahi hongi aur na hi woh Jannat ki khushboo mehsoos karengi, halaanki iski khushboo itni-itni doori se mehsoos ki jaa sakti hai (bahut door se).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you survive for a time you would certainly see people who would have whips in their hands like the tail of an ox. They would get up in the morning under the wrath of Allah and they would get into the evening with the anger of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar tum kuch waqt tak zinda rahe, to tum zaroor aise log dekhoge jinke haathon mein bael ki dum jaise koDe honge. Woh subah Allah ke gusse mein uThenge aur shaam Allah ke gusse mein guzaarenge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you live for a time, you would certainly see people get up (in the morning) in the wrath of Allah and getting into the evening under the curse of Allah, and there would be in their hands (whips) like the tail of an ox.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar tum kuch waqt tak zinda rahe, to tum zaroor logon ko subah Allah ke gusse mein uThte dekhoge aur shaam Allah ki laanat mein daakhil hote dekhoge, aur unke haathon mein bael ki dum jaise (koDe) honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated through five different chains of transmitters and all of them are narrated on the authority of Mustaurid, brother of Bani Fihr, that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, this world (is so insigni- ficant in comparison) to the Hereafter that if one of you should dip his finger- (and wnile saying this Yahyg pointed with his forefinger) -in the ocean and then he should see as to what has stuck to it. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees paanch mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur sab Mustaurid, Banu Fihr ke bhai, ki sanad se hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, ye duniya Aakhirat ke muqable itni chhoti hai ki agar tum mein se koi apni ungli - (aur ye kehte huye Yahya ne apni tarjani ungli se ishara kiya) - samundar mein dubaaye aur phir dekhe ki usmein kya chipka hai. Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that she heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The people would be assembled on the Day of Resurrection barefooted, naked and uncircumcised. I said: Allah's Messenger, will the male and the female be together on the Day and would they be looking at one another? Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, the matter would be too serious for them to look to one another.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Log Qayamat ke din nange paon, nange badan aur bina khatna kiye ikattha kiye jaayenge. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya us din mard aur auraten saath honge aur kya woh ek-doosre ko dekhenge? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aisha, maamla itna sangin hoga ki unhe ek-doosre ko dekhne ki fikar hi nahi hogi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hatim b. Abi Saghira with the same chain of transmitters and there is no mention of the word" uncircum- cised."
hi: Ye hadees Hatim bin Abu Saghira ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein "bina khatna kiye" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deliver an address and he was saying that they would meet Allah barefooted, naked and uncircumcised.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khutba dete suna aur woh keh rahe the ki woh Allah se milenge nange paon, nange badan aur bina khatna kiye.

e: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters on the authority of Ibn Abbas, (and) the words are: While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to deliver a sermon, he said: 0 people, Allah would make you assemble barefooted, naked and uncircumcised (and then recited the words of the Qur'an):" As We created you for the first time, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon us. Lo! We are to perform it, and the first person who would be clothed on the Day of Resurrection would be (Hadrat) Ibrahim (peace be upon him)" and, behold! some persons of my Ummah would be brought and taken to the left and I would say: My Lord, they are my companions, and it would be said: You do not know what they did after you, and I would say just as the pious servant (Hadrat 'Isa) said:, I was a witness regarding them as I remained among them and Thou art a witness over everything, so if Thou chastisest them, they are Thy servants and if Thou for- givest them, Thou art Mighty, Wise" (v. 117-118). And it would be said to him: They constantly turned to their heels since you left them. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Waki' and Mu'adh (and the words are):" What new things they fabricated."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ye hadees kuch aur sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, (aur) alfaaz hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khutba dene khade huye, unhone farmaaya: Aye logo, Allah tumhe nange paon, nange badan aur bina khatna kiye ikattha karega (aur phir Quran ke alfaaz padhe): "Jaise Humne tumhe pehli baar banaaya, waise hi Hum ise dohraayenge. (Ye) Humaare zimme ek vaada hai. Dekho! Hum ise zaroor poora karenge," aur Qayamat ke din sabse pehle jise kapda pehnaaya jaayega woh Ibrahim (unpar shaanti ho) honge, aur, dekho! meri Ummat mein se kuch log laaye jaayenge aur baayi taraf le jaaye jaayenge, aur main kahunga: Mere Rab, ye mere saathi hain, aur kaha jaayega: Tumhe nahi pata unhone tumhare baad kya nayi cheezein banaayin, aur main kahunga jaise nekokaar banda (Isa) ne kaha tha: Main unka gawaah tha jab tak main unke beech rehta tha, aur Tu har cheez ka gawaah hai, isliye agar Tu unhe saza deta hai, woh Tere bande hain, aur agar Tu unhe maaf karta hai, Tu Ghaalib, Hakeem hai (5:117-118). Aur usse kaha jaayega: Woh lagataar apni eDiyon par pichhe muDte gaye jab se tumne unhe chhoda. Ye hadees Waki aur Mu'adh ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Unhone kya nayi cheezein ghadi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying, The people will be assembled in three categories. Those desirous (of Paradise), fearing (Hell), coming two upon the came], three upon the camel, four upon the camel, ten upon the camel and the rest will be assembled, Hell-Fire being with them when they are at midday where they would spend the night and where they would spend the morning and where they would spend the evening.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Log teen giroh mein ikattha kiye jaayenge: kuch khwaishmand (Jannat ke), kuch khauf mein (Jahannam se), (aur baaki) do log ek oont par, teen log ek oont par, chaar log ek oont par, das log ek oont par (sawaar honge), aur baaki (log) ikattha kiye jaayenge, Jahannam ki aag unke saath hogi jab woh dopahar ko ho, jahan woh raat guzaarenge aur jahan woh subah karenge aur jahan woh shaam karenge.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When the people stand before Allah, the Lord of the worlds, each one of them would stand submerged into perspiration up to half of his ears, and there is no mention of the "day" in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanni.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab log Allah, duniyaon ke Rab, ke saamne khade honge, unmein se har ek apne kaanon ke aadhe hisse tak pasine mein Dooba hoga. Aur Ibn Muthanna ki riwayat mein "din" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Umar but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are): " One of them would be completely submerged in perspiration up to half of his ears."
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Unmein se ek apne kaanon ke aadhe hisse tak poori tarah pasine mein Dooba hoga.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: The perspiration would spread on the Day of Resurrection upon the earth to the extent of seventy cubits and it would reach up to their mouths or up to their ears. Thaur is not sure (which words) he used (mouth or ears).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ke din pasina zameen par sattar haath tak phailega aur ye unke munh tak ya unke kaanon tak pahunchega. Thaur (raawiyon mein se ek) ko yakeen nahi hai ki unhone kaunse alfaaz istemal kiye (munh ya kaan).

e: Miqdad b. Aswad reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: On the Day of Resurrection, the sun would draw so close to the people that there woum be left only a distance of one mile. Sulaim b. Amir said: By Allah, I do not know whether he meant by" mile" the mile of the (material) earth or dn instrument used for applying collyrium to the eye. (The Prophet is, however, reported to have said): The people would be submerged in perspiration according to their deeds, some up to their. knees, Some up to the waist and some would have the bridle of perspiration and, while saying this, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pointed his hand towards his mouth.
hi: Miqdad bin Aswad (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ke din suraj logon ke itna qareeb aa jaayega ki sirf ek mil ki doori bachegi. Sulaim bin Amir ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata ki unka matlab zameen ke mil se tha ya us upkaran se jo aankhon mein surma lagaane ke liye istemal hota hai. (Pavitr Nabi ne, halaanki, ye farmaaya): Log apne amalon ke mutabik pasine mein Dubenge, kuch apne ghutnon tak, kuch apni kamar tak aur kuch ki lagaam pasine ki hogi, aur ye kehte hue Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath apne munh ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: 'Iyad b. Him-ar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while delivering a sermon one day, said: Behold, my Lord commanded me that I should teach you which you do not know and which He has taught me today. (He has instructed thus): The property which I have conferred upon them is lawful for them. I have created My servants as one having a natural inclination to the worship of Allah but it is Satan who turns them away from the right religion and he makes unlawful what has been declared lawful for them and he commands them to ascribe partnership with Me, although he has no justification for that. And verily, Allah looked towards the people of the world and He showed hatred for the Arabs and the non-Arabs, but with the exception of some remnants from the People of the Book. And He (further) said: I have sent thee (the Holy Prophet) in order to put you to test and put (those to test) through you. And I sent the Book to you which cannot be washed away by water, so that you may recite it while in the state of wakefulness or sleep. Verily, Allah commanded me to burn (kill) the Quraish. I said: My Lord, they would break my head (like the tearing) of bread, and Allah said: You turn them out as they turned you out, you fight against them and We shall help you in this, you should spend and you would be conferred upon. You send an army and I would send an army five times greater than that. Fight against those who disobey you along with those who obey you. The inmates of Paradise are three: One who wields authority and is just and fair, one who Is truthful and has been endowed with power to do good deeds. And the person who is merciful and kind hearted towards his relatives and to every pious Muslim, and one who does not stretch his hand in spite of having a large family to support. And He said: The inmates of Hell are five: the weak who lack power to (avoid evil), the (carefree) who pursue (everything irrespective of the fact that it is good or evil) and who do not have any care for their family or for their wealth. And those dishonest whose greed cannot be concealed even in the case of minor things. And the third. who betray you. morning and evening, in regard to your family and your property. He also made a mention of the miser and the liar and those who are in the habit of abusing people and using obscene and foul language. Abu Ghassan in his narration did not make mention of" Spend and there would be spent for you."
hi: Iyad bin Himar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din khutba dete hue farmaaya: Dekho, mere Rab ne mujhe hukum diya hai ki main tumhe woh sikhaun jo tumhe nahi pata aur jo Usne mujhe aaj sikhaya (aur unhone kaha ki Rab ne farmaaya): Woh maal jo Maine unhe ata kiya hai unke liye halaal hai. Maine Apne bandon ko is tarah paida kiya hai ki unmein Allah ki ibadat ki taraf svabhaavik jhukav hai, lekin Shaitaan unhe sahi deen se hataata hai aur woh us cheez ko haraam banaata hai jise unke liye halaal kiya gaya hai, aur woh unhe Mere saath shareek jodne ka hukum deta hai, halaanki uske paas iska koi jaayaz jawaab nahi hai. Aur, yaqeenan, Allah ne zameen ke logon ki taraf dekha aur Usne Arabon aur gair-Arabon se ghrina jataayi, siwaay kuch Kitaab waalon ke baaki logon ke. Aur Usne (aage) farmaaya: Maine tujhe (Pavitr Nabi ko) isliye bheja hai taaki main tumhe pareeksha mein daaloon aur tumhaare zariye (doosron ko) pareeksha mein daaloon. Aur Maine tumhaari taraf woh Kitaab bheji hai jise paani se nahi dhoya jaa sakta, taaki tum ise so kar aur jaagte hue padho. Yaqeenan, Allah ne mujhe hukum diya ki main Quraish ko jala dun (qatal karun). Maine kaha: Mere Rab, woh mera sar rotii ki tarah tod denge, aur Allah ne farmaaya: Tum unhe nikaalo jaise unhone tumhe nikaala, tum unse jung karo aur Hum tumhaari isme madad karenge, tumhe kharch karna chahiye aur tumhe ata kiya jaayega. Tum ek fauj bhejo aur Main uske paanch guna zyada bhejunga. Un logon se jung karo jo tumhaari naafarmani karte hain, saath un logon ke jo tumhaari itaat karte hain. Jannat ke bashinde teen kism ke hain: ek jo ikhtiyar rakhta hai aur nyaayi aur insaaf-pasand hai, ek jo sachcha hai aur jise nekokaar amal karne ki taakat di gayi hai. Aur woh shakhs jo rehmdil aur meherbaan-dil hai apne rishtedaaron ke prati aur har nekokaar Musalman ke prati, aur woh jo apna haath nahi phailaata bawajood ek bade khaandaan ke, jiski parvarish uske zimme hai. Aur Usne farmaaya: Jahannam ke bashinde paanch hain: kamzor jinke paas burai se bachne ki taakat nahi hai, (be-parvaah log) jo (har cheez ke peeche bhaagte hain chahe woh achhi ho ya buri) aur jinhe apne khaandaan ya apni daulat ki koi parvaah nahi hai. Aur woh be-imaan log jinka lalach chhoti-chhoti baaton mein bhi chhupa nahi rehta. Aur teesra woh jo tumhaari subah aur shaam tumhaare khaandaan aur tumhaari daulat mein tumse be-imaani karta hai. Unhone kanjoos aur jhoote ka bhi zikr kiya aur un logon ka jo logon ko bura-bhala kehne aur ghatiya, badchalni bhari zubaan istemal karne ke aadi hain. Abu Ghassan ne apni riwayat mein "Kharch karo aur tumhe ata kiya jaayega" ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Iyad b. Himar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave an address one day. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Ye hadees Iyad bin Himar (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din khutba diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Iyad. b. Himar reported tbat, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering an address, he stated that Allah commanded me The rest of the hadith is the same, and there is an addition in it: " Allah revealed to me that we should be humble amongst ourselves and none should show pride upon the others, And it does not behove one to do so, and He also said: There are among you people to follow not caring a bit for their family and property. Qatada said: Abu Abdullah, would this happen? Thereupon he said: Yes. By Allah, I found this in the days of ignorance that a person grazed the goat of a tribe and did not find anyone but their slave-girl (and he did not spare her) but committed adultery with her.
hi: Iyad bin Himar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khutba de rahe the, unhone kaha ki Allah ne mujhe hukum diya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur ismein izafa hai: "Allah ne mujhpar wahi ki ki humein aapas mein farotan rehna chahiye aur kisi ko doosron par ghamand nahi dikhaana chahiye. Aur ye kisi ko shobha nahi deta ki woh aisa kare, aur Usne ye bhi farmaaya: Tum mein se kuch log hain jo apne khaandaan aur apni daulat ki koi parvaah nahi karte." Qatada ne kaha: Abu Abdullah, kya aisa hoga? Isper unhone kaha: Haan. Allah ki qasam, maine Jaahiliyat ke daur mein aisa paaya ki ek shakhs kisi qabile ki bakriyan charaata tha aur usne unke ghar mein sirf unki laundi ko paaya (aur usne use nahi chhoda) balki uske saath zina kiya.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing: When any one of you dies, he is shown his seat (in the Hereafter) morning and evening; if he is amongst the inmates of Paradise (he is shown the seat) from amongst the inmates of Paradise and if he is one from amongst the denizens of Hell (he is shown the seat) from amongst the denizens of Hell, and it would be said to him: That is your seat until Allah raises you on the Day of Resurrection (and sends you to your proper seat).
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi marta hai, use uski (Aakhirat ki) jagah subah aur shaam dikhaayi jaati hai; agar woh Jannat ke bashindon mein se hai to (use uski jagah) Jannat ke bashindon mein se dikhaayi jaati hai, aur agar woh Jahannam ke bashindon mein se hai to (use uski jagah) Jahannam ke bashindon mein se dikhaayi jaati hai, aur usse kaha jaata hai: Ye teri jagah hai jab tak Allah tujhe Qayamat ke din nahi uThAte (aur tujhe teri asli jagah nahi bhejte).

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: When a person dies, he is shown his seat morning and evening. If he is one amongst the inmates of Paradise (he is shown his seat) in Paradise and if he is one amongst the denizens of Hell-Fire (he is shown his seat) in the Hell-Fire. Then it is said to him: That is your seat where you would be sent on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab koi shakhs marta hai, use uski jagah subah aur shaam dikhaayi jaati hai. Agar woh Jannat ke bashindon mein se hai (to use uski jagah) Jannat mein dikhaayi jaati hai, aur agar woh Jahannam ke bashindon mein se hai (to use uski jagah) Jahannam mein dikhaayi jaati hai. Phir usse kaha jaata hai: Ye teri jagah hai jahan tujhe Qayamat ke din bheja jaayega.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: I did not hear this hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) directly but it was Zaid b. Thabit who narrated it from him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was going along with us towards the dwellings of Bani an-Najjar, riding upon his pony, it shied and he was about to fall. He found four, five or six graves there. He said: Who amongst you knows about those lying in the graves? A person said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: In what state did they die? He said: They died as polytheists. He said: These people are passing through the ordeal in the graves. If it were not the reason that you would stop burying (your dead) in the graves on listening to the torment in the grave which I am listening to, I would have certainly made you hear that. Then turning his face towards us, he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from turmoil, its visible and invisible (aspects), and they said: We seek refuge with Allah from turmoil and its visible and invisible aspects and he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal, and they said We seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine ye hadees seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se nahi suni thi balki Zaid bin Thabit ne ise unse riwayat kiya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare saath Banu Najjar ke gharon ki taraf ja rahe the, apne khachchar par sawaar, woh bidaka aur woh gir jaane hi wale the. Unhe wahan chaar, paanch ya chhe qabren mili. Unhone poocha: Tum mein se kaun jaanta hai in qabron mein kaun leta hai? Ek shakhs ne kaha: Main. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) poocha: Unki maut kis haalat mein hui? Usne kaha: Woh mushrik hokar mare. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye log qabar mein pareeksha se guzar rahe hain. Agar ye wajah na hoti ki tum apne murdo ko qabron mein dafn karna band kar doge jab tum qabar ke azaab ko sunte ho jo main sun raha hoon, to main tumhe zaroor sunwaata. Phir apna chehra humaari taraf karke unhone farmaaya: Jahannam ke azaab se Allah ki panah maango. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Hum Jahannam ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangte hain. Unhone farmaaya: Qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maango. Unhone kaha: Hum qabar ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangte hain. Unhone farmaaya: Fitne se, iske zaahiri aur chhupe hue pehluon se, Allah ki panah maango, aur unhone kaha: Hum fitne se aur iske zaahiri aur chhupe hue pehluon se Allah ki panah maangte hain. Unhone farmaaya: Dajjal ke fitne se Allah ki panah maango, aur unhone kaha: Hum Dajjal ke fitne se Allah ki panah maangte hain.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If you were not (to abandon) the burying of the dead (in the grave), I would have certainly supplicated Allah that He should make you listen the torment of the grave.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar ye baat na hoti ki tum apne murdo ko qabron mein dafn karna (Dar se) chhod doge, to main zaroor Allah se dua karta ki Woh tumhe qabar ka azaab sunwaayein.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub through some other chains of transmitters (and the words are): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out after the sun had set and he heard some sound and said: It is the Jews who are being tormented in their graves.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Ayyub (RA) ki sanad se kuch aur sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) suraj ke doobne ke baad bahar gaye aur unhone kuch aawaaz suni aur farmaaya: Ye Yahudi hain jinhe unki qabron mein azaab diya jaa raha hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: When the servant is placed in his grave, his companions retrace their steps, and he hears the noise of their footsteps, two angels come to him and make him sit and say to him: What you have to say about this person (the Prophet)? If he is a believer, he would say: I bear testimony to the fact that he is a servant of Allah and His Messenger. Then it would be said to him: Look to your seat in the Hellfire, for Allah has substituted (the seat of yours) with a seat in Paradise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He would be shown both the seats. Qatada said: It was mentioned to us that his grave (the grave of a believer) expands to seventy cubits and is full with verdure until the Day when they would be resurrected.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab banda apni qabar mein rakha jaata hai aur uske saathi wapas laut jaate hain, woh unke kadmon ki aawaaz sunta hai, do Farishte uske paas aate hain aur use bithaate hain aur usse kehte hain: Tu is shakhs (Pavitr Nabi) ke baare mein kya kehta hai? Agar woh momin hai, to woh kahega: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki woh Allah ke bande aur Uske Rasool hain. Phir usse kaha jaata hai: Apni Jahannam ki jagah ki taraf dekh, kyunki Allah ne (teri jagah ko) Jannat ki jagah se badal diya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Use donon jagahein dikhaayi jaayengi. Qatada ne kaha: Humein bataya gaya ki uski qabar (yaani momin ki qabar) sattar haath tak phailti hai aur hariyaali se bhari hoti hai us din tak jab tak woh dobara zinda nahi kiye jaate.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When the dead body. is placed in the grave, he listens to the sound of the shoes (as his friends and relatives return after burying him).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab murda badan qabar mein rakha jaata hai, woh jooton ki aawaaz sunta hai (jab uske dost aur rishtedaar use dafn karke wapas jaate hain).

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: When the servant is placed in his grave and his friends retrace their steps. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Qatada.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab banda apni qabar mein rakha jaata hai aur uske dost wapas laut jaate hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Qatada ne riwayat ki.

e: Al-Bara' b. `Azib reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: This verse: "Allah grants steadfastness to those who believe with firm word," was revealed in connection with the torment of the grave. It would be said to him: Who is your Lord? And he would say: Allah is my Lord and Muhammad is my Apostle (ﷺ), and that is (what is implied) by the words of Allah, the Exalted: "Allah keeps steadfast those who believe with firm word in this world and in the Hereafter."
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ye aayat: "Allah imaan waalon ko pukhta alfaazon ke saath kaayam rakhta hai," qabar ke azaab ke silsile mein nazil hui thi. Usse poocha jaayega: Tera Rab kaun hai? Aur woh kahega: Allah mera Rab hai aur Muhammad mere Rasool hain, aur yehi hai (jiska ishara) Allah, Buland, ke alfaazon mein hai: "Allah imaan waalon ko pukhta alfaazon ke saath is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein kaayam rakhta hai."

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that this verse: "Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with firm word in this world and the Hereafter" was revealed in connection with the torment of the grave.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ye aayat: "Allah imaan waalon ko pukhta alfaazon ke saath is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein kaayam rakhta hai," qabar ke azaab ke silsile mein nazil hui.

e: Abu Huraira reported: When the soul of a believer would go out (of his body) it would be received bv two angels who would take it to the sky. Hammad (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) mentioned the swetness of its odour, (and further said) that the dwellers of the sky say: Here comes the pious soul from the side of the earth Let there be blessings of Allah upon the body in which it resides. And it is carried (by the angels) to its Lord, the Exalted and Glorious. He would say: Take it to its destined end. And if he is a nonbeliever and as it (the soul) leaves the body-Hammad made a mention of its foul smell and of its being cursed-the dwellers of the sky say: There comes a dirty soul from the side of the earth, and it would be said: Take it to its destined end. Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put a thin cloth which was with him upon his nose while making a mention (of the foul smell) of the soul of a non-believer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab momin ki rooh (uske badan se) nikalti hai, use do Farishte lete hain jo ise aasmaan ki taraf le jaate hain. Hammad (raawiyon mein se ek) ne iski khushboo ki meethaas ka zikr kiya, (aur aage kaha) ki aasmaan ke bashinda kehte hain: Yahan zameen ki taraf se ek nekokaar rooh aa rahi hai. Us jism par Allah ki barkatein ho jismein ye rehti thi, aur ise (Farishton dwara) uske Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke paas le jaaya jaata hai. Woh farmaayenge: Ise uske muqarrar anjaam tak le jaao. Aur agar woh gair-imaandaar hai aur jaise-jaise ye (rooh) badan se nikalti hai - Hammad ne iski badbudaar khushboo ka aur iske laanat-zada hone ka zikr kiya - aasmaan ke bashinda kehte hain: Yahan ek gandi rooh zameen ki taraf se aa rahi hai, aur kaha jaata hai: Ise uske muqarrar anjaam tak le jaao. Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne paas rakha ek patla kapda apni naak par rakh liya jab woh gair-imaandaar ki rooh (ki badbu) ka zikr kar rahe the.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We were along with Umar between Mecca and Medina that we began to look for the new moon. And I was a man with sharp eye- sight, so I could see it, but none except me saw it. I began to say to 'Umar: Don't you see it? But he would not see it. Thereupon Umar said: I would soon be able to see it (when it will shine more brightly). I lay upon bed.
