He then made a mention of the people of Badr to us and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) showed us one day before (the actual battle) the place of death of the people (participating) in (the Battle) of Badr and he was saying: This would be the place of death of so and so tomorrow, if Allah wills. Umar said: By Him Who sent him with truth, they did not miss the places (of their death) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had pointed for them. Then they were all thrown in a well one after another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then went to them and said: O, so and so, the son of so and so; O so and so, the son of so and so, have you found correct what Allah and His Messenger had promised you? I have, however, found absolutely true what Allah had promised with me. Umar said: Allah's Messenger, how are you talking with the bodies without soul in them. Thereupon he said: You cannot hear more distinctly than (their hearing) of what I say, but with this exception that they have not power to make any reply.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Umar (RA) ke saath Makkah aur Madina ke beech the ki humne naya chaand dhoondhna shuru kiya. Aur main tez nazar ka aadmi tha, isliye main ise dekh saka, lekin mere siwaay koi aur ise nahi dekh paaya. Main Umar se kehne laga: Kya aap ise nahi dekh rahe? Lekin unhe woh dikhaayi nahi diya. Isper Umar ne kaha: Main jald hi ise dekh paunga (jab ye zyada chamakdaar hoga). Main apne bistar par leT gaya. Unhone phir humein Badr ke logon ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ek din pehle Badr (ki jung) mein hissa lene wale logon ki maut ki jagah dikhaayi thi aur woh keh rahe the: Ye falan-falan ki maut ki jagah hogi kal, Allah ne chaaha to. Umar ne kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jisne unhe (Nabi ko) sach ke saath bheja, unhone woh jagahein nahi chhoDin jinka ishara Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye kiya tha. Phir woh sab ek-ek karke ek kuen mein phenke gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir unke paas gaye aur kaha: Aye falan-falan, falan-falan ke bete; aye falan-falan, falan-falan ke bete, kya tumne woh sahi paaya jo Allah aur Uske Rasool ne tumse vaada kiya tha? Main, halaanki, ne bilkul sahi paaya jo Allah ne mujhse vaada kiya tha. Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap un jismon se kaise baat kar rahe hain jinmein koi rooh nahi hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Tum mere kahe hue ko usse zyada saaf tareeke se nahi sun sakte (jitna woh sunte hain), siwaay is antar ke ki unke paas jawaab dene ki takat nahi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) let the dead bodies of the unbelievers who fought in Badr (lie unburied) for three days. He then came to them and sat by their side and called them and said: O Abu Jahl b. Hisham, O Umayya b. Khalaf, O Utba b. Rab'ila, O Shaiba b. Rabi'a, have you not found what your Lord had promised with you to be correct? As for me, I have found the promises of my Lord to be (perfectly) correct. Umar listened to the words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, how do they listen and respond to you? They are dead and their bodies have decayed. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, what I am saying to them, even you cannot hear more distinctly than they, but they lack the power to reply. Then'he commanded that they should be buried in the well of Badr.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Badr mein lade gair-imaandaaron ke murda badnon ko teen din tak (bina dafn kiye) chhoda. Phir woh unke paas gaye aur unke bagal mein baithe aur unhe pukaara aur kaha: Aye Abu Jahl bin Hisham, aye Umayya bin Khalaf, aye Utba bin Rabi'a, aye Shaiba bin Rabi'a, kya tumne woh sahi nahi paaya jo tumhaare Rab ne tumse vaada kiya tha? Jahan tak mera sawaal hai, maine apne Rab ke vaadon ko poori tarah sahi paaya hai. Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz sune aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise sunte hain aur aapko jawaab dete hain? Woh mar chuke hain aur unke jism sad chuke hain. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, main unse jo keh raha hoon, tum bhi usse zyada saaf tareeke se nahi sun sakte, lekin unke paas jawaab dene ki takat nahi hai. Phir unhone hukum diya ki unhe Badr ke kuen mein dafn kar diya jaaye.

e: Aba Talha reported: When it was the Day of Badr and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had gained victory over them (the Meccans), he commanded more than twenty persons, and in another hadith these are counted as twenty-four persons, from the non-believers of the Quraish to be thrown into the well of Badr. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Talha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Badr ka din tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unpar (Makkah walon par) jeet haasil ki, unhone hukum diya ki Quraish ke gair-imaandaaron mein se bees se zyada logon ko - aur ek doosri hadees mein inhe chaubis log gina gaya hai - Badr ke kuen mein phenka jaaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who is taken to account on the Day of Resurrection is in fact put to torment. I said: Has Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, not said this: 'He will be made subject to an easy reckoning" (Ixxxiv. 8)? Thereupon he said: (What it implies) is not the actual reckoning, but only the presentation of one's deeds to Him. He who is thoroughly examined in reckoning is put to torment.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jiska Qayamat ke din hisaab liya jaayega, use waastav mein saza di jaayegi. Maine kaha: Kya Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ye nahi farmaaya hai: "Uska hisaab aasaan tareeke se liya jaayega" (84:8)? Isper unhone farmaaya: (Iska matlab) sahi hisaab nahi hai, balki sirf uske amal Uske saamne pesh kiye jaayenge. Jiske hisaab mein poori tarah jaanch ki jaayegi, use saza di jaayegi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Everyone who is reckoned thoroughly is undone. I said: Allah's Messenger, has Allah not called (reckoning) as easy reckoning? Thereupon he said.. It implies only presenta- tion of (one's deeds to Him), but if one is thoroughly examined in reckoning, he in fact is undone.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Har woh shakhs jiske hisaab ki poori tarah jaanch ki jaati hai, woh barbaad ho jaata hai. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya Allah ne (hisaab ko) aasaan hisaab nahi kaha hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Iska matlab hai sirf (amalon ka) pesh kiya jaana, lekin agar kisi ke hisaab ki poori tarah jaanch ki jaati hai, woh waastav mein barbaad hai.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: He who is examined thoroughly In reckoning is undone.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jiske hisaab ki poori tarah jaanch ki jaati hai, woh barbaad hai.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying three days before his death: None of you should court death but only hoping good from Allah
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni wafat se teen din pehle ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi maut ki khwaish na kare siwaay Allah se achhaai ki ummeed rakhte huye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say three days before his death: None of you should die but hoping only good from Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni wafat se teen din pehle ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se koi bhi na mare siwaay Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, se achhaai ki ummeed rakhte huye.

e: Jabir reported: I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying. Every servant would be raised (in the same very state) in which he dies.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Har banda usi haalat mein dobara zinda kiya jaayega jismein uski maut hui.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah intends to chastise a people, He chastises all of them then they would be raised according to their deeds.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Allah kisi qaum ko saza dene ka iraada karta hai, Woh unmein se sabko saza deta hai, phir unhe unke amalon ke mutabik (Qayamat ke din) dobara zinda kiya jaayega.

e: Zainab bint Jahsh reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got up from sleep saying: There is no being worthy of worship except Allah; there is a destruction in store for Arabia because of turmoil which is at hand, the barrier of Gog and Magog has opened so much. And Sufyan made a sign of ten with the help of his hand (in order to indicate the width of the gap) and I said: Allah's Messenger, would we be perished in spite of the fact that there would be good people amongst us? Thereupon he said: Of course, but only when the evil predominates.
hi: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) neend se uThe ye kehte huye: Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai; Arabia ki barbaadi qareeb aa gayi hai us fitne ki wajah se jo nazdeek hi hai, Yajuj-Majuj ki roDi itni khul gayi hai. Aur Sufyan ne apne haath se das ka ishara kiya (khaali jagah ki chaudai dikhaane ke liye). Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge jabki humaare beech nekokaar log hongi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Zaroor, lekin sirf tab jab burai chha jaaye.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zainab bint Jahsh with a slight variation in the chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Zainab bint Jahsh, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out in a state of excitement with his face quite red. And he was saying: There is no god but Allah; there is a destruction in store for Arabia because of the turmoil which is near at hand as the barrier of Gog and Magog has been opened like it, and he (in order to explain it) made a ring with the help of his thumb and forefinger. I said: Allah's Messenger, would we be destroyed despite the fact that there would be pious people amongst us? He said: Yes, when evil would be predominant.
hi: Zainab bint Jahsh (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghabraahat ki haalat mein bahar aaye, unka chehra laal ho gaya tha. Aur woh keh rahe the: Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai; Arabia ki barbaadi qareeb aa gayi hai us fitne ki wajah se jo nazdeek hi hai kyunki Yajuj-Majuj ki roDi is tarah khul chuki hai, aur unhone (iski vyaakhya karte huye) apne angoothe aur tarjani ungli se ek chhalla banaaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum barbaad ho jaayenge jabki humaare beech nekokaar log hongi? Unhone farmaaya: Haan, jab burai chha jaayegi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Today the wall (barrier) of Gog and Magog has been opened so much, and Wuhaib (in order to explain it) made the figure of ninety with the help of his hand.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aaj Yajuj-Majuj ki roDi itni khul gayi hai, aur Wuhaib ne (iski vyaakhya karte huye) apne haath se navve ka aakaar banaaya.

e: Harith b Abi Rabi'a and 'Abdullah b. Safwan both went to Umm Salama, the Mother of the Faithful, and they asked her about the army which would be sunk in the earth, and this relates to the time when Ibn Zubair (was the governor of Mecca). She reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said that a seeker of refuge would seek refuge in the Sacred House and an army would be sent to him (in order to kill him) and when it would enter a plain ground, it would be made to sink. I said: Allah's Messenger, what about him who would be made to accompany this army willy nilly? Thereupon he said: He would be made to sink along with them but he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection on the basis of his intention. Abu Ja'far said. ' This plain, ground means the plain ground of Medina.
hi: Harith bin Abu Rabi'a aur Abdullah bin Safwan donon Umm Salama, Imaandaaron ki Maa, ke paas gaye aur unse us fauj ke baare mein poocha jo zameen mein Doob jaayegi, aur ye us waqt ka zikr hai jab Ibn Zubair (Makkah ke gavarnar the). Unhone riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha ki koi panah maangne wala Pavitr Ghar (Kaaba) mein panah lega aur ek fauj use (qatal karne) bheji jaayegi aur jab woh ek samtal maidaan mein daakhil hogi, use zameen mein Doob diya jaayega. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, us shakhs ka kya jo majboori mein is fauj ke saath jaayega? Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh bhi unke saath Doob jaayega, lekin use Qayamat ke din uski niyat ke aadhaar par dobara zinda kiya jaayega. Abu Ja'far ne kaha: Ye samtal maidaan Madina ka samtal maidaan hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Rufai, with the same chain of transmitters (but with the addition of these words): " When I met Abu Ja'far I told him that she (simply) meant the plain ground. Thereupon Abu Ja'far said: No, by God, she meant the plain ground of Medina.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Rufai ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Jab main Abu Ja'far se mila maine unse kaha ki unka matlab (saadhaaran) samtal maidaan tha. Isper Abu Ja'far ne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, unka matlab Madina ke samtal maidaan se tha."

e: Abdullah b. Safwan reported that Hafsa told him that she had heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: An army would attack this House in order to fight against the inhabitants of this House and when it would be at the plain ground the ranks in the centre of the army would be sunk and the vanguard would call the rear flanks of the army and they would also be sunk and no flank would be left except some people who would go to inform them (their kith and kin). A person (who had been listening to this hadith from Abdullah b. Safwan) said: I bear testimony in regard to you that you are not imputing a lie to Hafsa. And I bear testimony to the fact that Hafsa is not telling a lie about Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Abdullah bin Safwan (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hafsa (RA) ne unhe bataya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek fauj is Ghar (Kaaba) par hamla karegi is Ghar ke bashindon se laDne ke liye, aur jab woh samtal maidaan mein hogi, fauj ke beech ki safen zameen mein Doob jaayengi, aur agli safen peechhli safon ko bulaayengi aur woh bhi Doob jaayengi, aur koi hissa nahi bachega siwaay kuch logon ke jo unhe (unke rishtedaaron ko) khabar dene jaayenge. Ek shakhs ne (jo Abdullah bin Safwan se ye hadees sun raha tha) kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki aap Hafsa par jhoot ka ilzaam nahi laga rahe. Aur main gawaahi deta hoon ki Hafsa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein jhoot nahi bol rahi.

e: Abdullah b. Safwan reported the Mother of the Faithful as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: They would soon seek protection in this House, viz. Ka'ba (the defenceless), people who would have nothing to protect themselves in the shape of weapons or the strength of the people. An army would be sent to fight (and kill) them and when they would enter a plain ground the army would be sunk in it. Yusuf (one of the narrators) said: It was a people of Syria (hordes of Hajjaj) who had been on that day coming towards Mecca for an attack (on 'Abdulllah b. Zubair) and Abdullah b. Safwan said: By God, it does not imply this army.
hi: Abdullah bin Safwan ne Imaandaaron ki Maa (Hafsa) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Woh log jald hi is Ghar, yaani Kaaba, mein panah lenge, (asahaay) log jinke paas apni hifaazat ke liye na hathiyaar honge na logon ki taakat. Unse laDne (aur unhe qatal karne) ke liye ek fauj bheji jaayegi aur jab woh samtal maidaan mein daakhil honge, fauj usmein Doob jaayegi. Yusuf (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Ye Syria ke log the (Hajjaj ke daste) jo us din Makkah ki taraf hamla karne aa rahe the (Abdullah bin Zubair ke khilaaf), aur Abdullah bin Safwan ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, iska matlab ye fauj nahi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was startled in the state of sleep. We said: Allah's Messenger, you have done something in the state of your sleep which you never did before, Thereupon he said: Strange it is that some people of my Ummah would attack the House (Ka'ba) (for killing) a person who would belong to the tribe of the Quraish and he would try to seek protection in the House. And when they would reach the plain ground they would be sunk. We said: Allah's Messenger, all sorts of people throng the path. Thereupon he said: Yes, there would be amongst them people who would come with definite designs and those who would come under duress and there would be travellers also, but they would all be destroyed through one (stroke) of destruction. though they would be raised in different states (on the Day of Resurrection). Allah would, however, raise them according to their intention.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) neend mein chaunk uThe. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne neend mein kuch aisa kiya jo aapne pehle kabhi nahi kiya tha. Isper unhone farmaaya: Hairat ki baat hai ki meri Ummat ke kuch log Ghar (Kaaba) par hamla karenge (ek shakhs ko qatal karne ke liye) jo Quraish qabile se hoga aur woh Ghar mein panah lene ki koshish karega. Aur jab woh samtal maidaan tak pahunchenge woh Doob jaayenge. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hazaaron kism ke log raaste mein bhare hote hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: Haan, unmein aise log honge jo khaas iraade se aayenge aur woh jo majboori mein aayenge, aur musafir bhi honge, lekin sab ek hi tabaahi mein barbaad honge, halaanki (Qayamat ke din) unhe alag-alag haalaton mein dobara zinda kiya jaayega. Allah, halaanki, unhe unki niyat ke mutabik dobara zinda karega.

e: Usama reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) climbed up a battlement amongst the battlements of Medina and then said: You do not see what I am seeing and I am seeing the places of turmoil between your houses as the places of rainfall.
hi: Usama (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina ki ek burj par chadhe aur phir farmaaya: Kya tum wahi dekhte ho jo main dekh raha hoon? Main tumhaare gharon ke beech fitne ki jagahon ko is tarah dekh raha hoon jaise baarish giregi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There will be soon a period of turmoil in which the one who sits will be better than one who stands and the one who stands will be better than one who walks and the one who walks will be better than one who runs. He who would watch them will be drawn by them. So he who finds a refuge or shelter against it should make it as his resort.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jald hi ek fitne ka daur aayega jismein baithne wala khade hone wale se behtar hoga aur khade hone wala chalne wale se behtar hoga aur chalne wala daudne wale se behtar hoga. Jo ise dekhega usse woh khud khinch le jaayega, isliye jo iske khilaaf koi shaandaar panah ya hifaazat paaye, use ise apna Thikaana bana lena chahiye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with this variation of wording that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr, there is an addition of these words: " There is a prayer among prayers ('Asr) and one who misses it is as if his family and property have been ruined."
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein is antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki Abu Bakr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Namazon mein ek namaz hai (Asr) aur jo ise chhoDta hai woh aisa hai jaise uska khaandaan aur uski maal-mata barbaad ho gaye ho."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: There would be turmoil and the one who would sleep would be better than who would be awake and the one who would be awake would be better than one who would stand and one who would stand would be better than one who would run. So he who finds refuge or shelter should take that refuge or shelter.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek fitna aayega aur so raha shakhs jagne wale se behtar hoga aur jagne wala khade hone wale se behtar hoga aur khada hone wala daudne wale se behtar hoga. Isliye jo panah ya hifaazat paaye use woh panah ya hifaazat lena chahiye.

e: Abu Bakra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would soon be turmoil. Behold! there would be turmoil in which the one who would be seated would be better than one who would stand and the one who would stand would be better than one who would run. Behold! when the turmoil comes or it appears, the one who has camel should stick to his camel and he who has sheep or goat should stick to his sheep and goat and he who has land should stick to the land. A person said: 'Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion about one who has neither camel nor sheep nor land? Thereupon, he said: He should take hold of his sword and beat its edge with the help of stone and then try to find a way of escape. O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message) ; O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message) ; O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message). A person said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion if I am drawn to a rank in spite of myself, or in one of the groups and made to march and a man strikes with his sword or there comes an arrow and kills me? Thereupon he said: He will bear the punishment of his sin and that of yours and he would be one amongst the denizens of Hell.
hi: Abu Bakra (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jald hi fitna aayega. Dekho! Fitna aisa hoga ki baithne wala khade hone wale se behtar hoga aur khada hone wala daudne wale se behtar hoga. Dekho! Jab fitna aaye ya pragat ho, jiske paas oont ho use apne oont se juda rehna chahiye, aur jiske paas bakriyan ya bakre hon use apni bakriyon aur bakron se juda rehna chahiye, aur jiske paas zameen ho use apni zameen se juda rehna chahiye. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapki kya raay hai us shakhs ke baare mein jiske paas na oont hai na bakri na zameen? Isper unhone farmaaya: Use apni talwaar pakadni chahiye aur uski dhaar ko patthar se peetkar Thes pahunchaani chahiye, aur phir bachne ka koi raasta dhoondhne ki koshish karni chahiye. Aye Allah, maine (Tera payaam) pahunchaa diya; Aye Allah, maine (Tera payaam) pahunchaa diya; Aye Allah, maine (Tera payaam) pahunchaa diya. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapki kya raay hai agar mujhe apni marzi ke khilaaf kisi safon mein ya girohon mein se ek mein kheech liya jaaye aur march karaaya jaaye aur koi shakhs apni talwaar se vaar kare ya koi teer aaye aur mujhe qatal kar de? Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh apne gunah ka bojh aur tumhaare gunah ka bojh dono uThAyega aur woh Jahannam ke bashindon mein se ek hoga.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Waki' with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Waki ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ahnaf b. Qais reported: I set out with the intention of helping this person (Hadrat 'Ali) when Abu Bakra met me. He said: Ahnaf, where do you intend to go? I said: I intend to help the cousin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), viz. 'Ali. Thereupon he said to me: Ahnaf, go back, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two Muslims confront one another with swords (in hand) both the slayer and the slain would be in Fire. He (Ahnaf) said: I said, or it was said: Allah's Messenger, it may be the case of one who kills. but what about the slain (why he would be put in Hell-Fire)? Thereupon he said: He also intended to kill his companion.
hi: Ahnaf bin Qais ne bayan kiya: Main is shakhs (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ki madad karne ke iraade se nikla ki Abu Bakra mujhse mile. Unhone kaha: Ahnaf, tum kahan jaane ka iraada rakhte ho? Maine kaha: Mera iraada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chachere bhai, yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam), ki madad karne ka hai. Isper unhone mujhse kaha: Ahnaf, wapas jaao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab do Musalman (haathon mein) talwaaren lekar ek-doosre ka saamna karte hain, dono qaatil aur maqtool Jahannam ki aag mein honge. Unhone (Ahnaf ne) kaha: Maine kaha, ya kaha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, ye to us shakhs ke maamle mein ho sakta hai jo qatal karta hai, lekin us maqtool (ka kya) ka jo maara gaya (woh Jahannam mein kyun jaayega)? Isper unhone farmaaya: Kyunki uska bhi apne saathi ko qatal karne ka iraada tha.

e: Ahnaf b. Qais reported on the authority of Abu Bakra that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When two Muslims confront each other with their swords, both the slayer and the slain are doomed to Hell-Fire.
hi: Ahnaf bin Qais ne Abu Bakra (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab do Musalman apni talwaaron ke saath ek-doosre ka saamna karte hain, qaatil aur maqtool dono Jahannam ki aag mein jaate hain.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hammad through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hammad ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Bakra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two Muslims (confront each other) and the one amongst them attacks his brother with a weapon, both of them are at the brink of Hell-Fire. And when one of them kills his companion, both of them get into Hell-Fire.
hi: Abu Bakra (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab do Musalman (ek-doosre ka saamna karein) aur unmein se ek apne bhai par hathiyaar se hamla kare, dono Jahannam ki aag ke kinare par honge. Aur jab unmein se koi apne saathi ko qatal karta hai, dono Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil ho jaate hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) many ahadith and one of them was this: The last Hour will not come until the two parties (of Muslims) confront each other and there is a large-scale massacre amongst them and the claim of both of them is the same.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak (Musalmaanon ke) do giroh ek-doosre ka saamna na karein aur unke beech bade paimaane par khoon-kharaba na ho, aur unmein se dono ka daawa ek hi ho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The last Hour will not come unless there is much bloodshed. They said: What is harj? Thereupon he said: Bloodshed. bloodshed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak bahut zyada khoon-kharaba na ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Harj kya hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Khoon-kharaba, khoon-kharaba.

e: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah drew the ends of the world near one another for my sake. And I have seen its eastern and western ends. And the dominion of my Ummah would reach those ends which have been drawn near me and I have been granted the red and the white treasure and I begged my Lord for my Ummah that it should not be destroyed because of famine, nor be dominated by an enemy who is not amongst them to take their lives and destroy them root and branch, and my Lord said: Muhammad, whenever I make a decision, there is none to change it. I grant you for your Ummah that it would not be destroyed by famine and it would not be dominated by an enemy who would not be amongst it and would take their lives and destroy them root and branch even if all the people from the different parts of the world join hands together (for this purpose), but it would be from amongst them, viz. your Ummah, that some people would kill the others or imprison the others.
hi: Thauban (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ne mere liye duniya ke kinaaron ko ek-doosre ke qareeb kar diya. Aur maine iske poorab aur pashchim ke kinaare dekhe. Aur meri Ummat ki saltanat un kinaaron tak pahunchegi jo mere qareeb laaye gaye hain, aur mujhe laal aur safed khazana diya gaya hai, aur maine apni Ummat ke liye apne Rab se dua ki ki use akaal ki wajah se barbaad na kiya jaaye, aur na hi koi aisa dushman unpar gaalib ho jo unmein se na ho aur jo unki jaanein le le aur unhe jad se ukhaad de, aur mere Rab ne farmaaya: Muhammad, jab bhi main koi faisla karta hoon, use badalne wala koi nahi hai. Main tumhe tumhaari Ummat ke liye ye deta hoon ki akaal se woh barbaad na ho aur na hi koi aisa dushman unpar gaalib ho jo unmein se na ho aur unki jaanein le aur unhe jad se ukhaad de, chahe duniya bhar ke sab log ikattha hokar (isi maqsad ke liye) haath milaayein, lekin (fitna) unhi mein se hoga, yaani tumhaari Ummat mein se, ki kuch log doosron ko qatal karenge ya doosron ko qaid mein daalenge.

e: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. Verily, Allah drew the ends of the world near me until I saw its east and west, and He bestowed upon me two treasures, the red and the white. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Thauban (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne duniya ke kinaaron ko mere liye is tarah samet diya ki maine iski poorab aur pashchim (dono taraf) dekhi, aur Usne mujhe do khazane ata kiye, laal aur safed. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came from a high, land. He passed by the mosque of Banu Mu'awiya, went in and observed two rak'ahs there and we also observed prayer along with him and he made a long supplication to his Lord. He then came to us and said: I asked my Lord three things and He has granted me two but has withheld one. I begged my Lord that my Ummah should not be destroyed because of famine and He granted me this. And I begged my Lord that my Ummah should not be destroyed by drowning (by deluge) and He granted me this. And I begged my Lord that there should be no bloodshed among the people of my Ummah, but He did not grant it.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek oonchi zameen se aaye. Woh Banu Muawiya ki masjid ke paas se guzre, andar gaye aur wahan do rakat namaz padhi aur humne bhi unke saath namaz padhi aur unhone apne Rab se ek lambi dua ki. Phir woh humaare paas aaye aur kaha: Maine apne Rab se teen cheezein maangi hain, aur Usne mujhe do di hain lekin ek nahi di. Maine apne Rab se dua ki ki meri Ummat akaal ki wajah se barbaad na ho aur Usne mujhe ye di. Aur maine apne Rab se dua ki ki meri Ummat doobne (baadh) se barbaad na ho aur Usne mujhe ye bhi di. Aur maine apne Rab se dua ki ki meri Ummat ke logon mein koi khoon-kharaba na ho, lekin Usne ye mujhe nahi di.

e: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came with a group of his Companions and he passed by the mosque of Banu Mu'awiya. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne Sahaba ke ek giroh ke saath aaye aur Banu Muawiya ki masjid ke paas se guzre. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman reported: By Allah, I have the best knowledge amongst people about every turmoil which is going to appear in the period intervening me and the Last Hour; and it is not for the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me something confidentially pertaining to it and he did not tell anybody else about it, but it is because of the fact that I was present in the assembly in which he had been describing the turmoil. and he especially made a mention of three turmoils which would not spare anything and amongst these there would be turmoils like storms in the hot season. Some of them would be violent and some of them would be comparatively mild. Hudhaifa said: All (who were present) except I have gone (to the next world).
hi: Hudhaifa bin al-Yaman (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ki qasam, mujhe logon mein sabse behtareen ilm hai us har fitne ka jo mere aur Aakhri Ghadi ke beech ke daur mein aayegi, aur ye is wajah se nahi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe koi guptata mein baat batayi thi jo unhone kisi doosre ko nahi batayi, balki ye is wajah se hai ki main us majlis mein maujood tha jab woh fitne ka varnan kar rahe the. Aur unhone khaas taur par teen fitnon ka zikr kiya jo kuch bhi baaki nahi chhodenge aur inmein garam mausam ki aandhiyon jaisi fitnaen hongi. Unmein se kuch zabardast aur kuch (nisbatan) halki hongi. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Sab (jo wahan maujood the) mere siwaay (agli duniya mein) jaa chuke hain.

e: Hudhaifa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood before us one day and he did not leave anything unsaid (that he had to say) at that very spot which would happen (in the shape of turmoil) up to the Last Hour. Those who had to remember them preserved them in their minds and those who could not remember them forgot them. My friends knew them and there are certain things which slip out of my mind, but I recapitulate them when anyone makes a mention of them just as a person is lost from one's mind but is recalled to him on seeing his face.
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din humaare saamne khade huye aur unhone us jagah (khade rehte hue) kuch bhi kaha bina nahi chhoda jo (fitne ke soorat mein) Aakhri Ghadi tak hoga. Jinhe ye yaad rakhna tha unhone unhe apne zehan mein sanjo liya aur jo unhe yaad nahi rakh paaye woh unhe bhool gaye. Mere doston ko woh pata thin aur kuch aisi cheezein hain jo mere zehan se nikal jaati hain, lekin jab koi unka zikr karta hai, mujhe woh yaad aa jaati hain, jaise koi shakhs kisi doosre ke chehre ko dekhkar use pehchaan leta hai jo uske zehan se nikal gaya tha.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters up to the words: And he forgot who had to forget that and. he did not make a mention of what follows after this.
hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se in alfaazon tak riwayat ki gayi hai: "Aur woh bhool gaye jinhe bhoolna tha," aur unhone iske baad ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Hudhaifa reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed me of what is going to happen before the approach of the Last Hour. And there is nothing that I did not ask him in this connection except this that I did not ask him as to what would turn the people of Medina out from Medina.
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe woh sab kuch bataya jo Aakhri Ghadi aane se pehle hoga. Aur aisi koi baat nahi hai jo maine unse is silsile mein na poochi ho siwaay iske ki maine unse ye nahi poocha ki Madina ke logon ko Madina se kya bahar nikaalega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Zaid (viz. Amr b. Akhtab) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the dawn prayer and then mounted the pulpit and addressed us until it was (time for the) noon prayer. He then came down the pulpit and observed prayer and then again mounted the pulpit and again addressed us until it was time for the 'Asr prayer. He then again came down and observed the prayer and again mounted the pulpit and addressed us until the sun was set and he informed (about) everything (pertaining to turmoil) that lay hidden in the past and what lies in (the womb) of) the future and the most learned amongst us is one who remembers them well
hi: Abu Zaid (yaani Amr bin Akhtab) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhayi aur phir mimbar par chadhkar humein khutba diya yahan tak ki Zohar ki namaz ka waqt ho gaya. Phir woh mimbar se utre aur namaz padhi aur phir dobara mimbar par chadhe aur humein khutba diya yahan tak ki Asr ki namaz ka waqt ho gaya. Phir woh dobara utre aur namaz padhi aur phir mimbar par chadhe aur humein khutba diya yahan tak ki suraj Doob gaya, aur unhone har us baat ki jaankaari di jo pehle guzar chuki thi aur jo mustaqbil mein hone waali thi, aur humme se sabse zyada ilm rakhne wala woh hai jise ye sab achhi tarah yaad hai.

e: Hudhaifa reported: We were one day in the company of 'Umar that he said: Who amongst you has preserved in his mind most perfectly the hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to the turmoil as he told about it? I said: It is I. Thereupon he said: You are bold (enough to make this claim). And he further said: How? I said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would (first) be turmoil for a person in regard to his family, his property, his own self, his children, his neighbours (and the sins committed in their connection) would be expiated by fasting, prayer, charity, enjoining good and prohibiting evil. Thereupon 'Umar said: I do not mean (that turmoil on a small scale) but that one which would emerge like the mounting waves of the ocean. I said: Commander of the Faithful, you have nothing to do with it, for the door is closed between you and that. He said: Would that door be broken or opened? I said: No, it would be broken. Thereupon he said: Then it would not be closed despite best efforts. We said to Hudhaifa: Did Umar know the door? Thereupon he said: Yes, he knew it (for certain) just as one knows that night precedes the next day. And I narrated to him something in which there was nothing fabricated. Shaqiq (one of the narrators) said: We dared not ask Hudhaifa about that door. So we requested Masruq to ask him. So he asked him and he said: (By that door, he meant) 'Umar.
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum ek din Umar (RA) ki sohbat mein the ki unhone kaha: Tum mein se kisne fitne ke baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hadees ko sabse achhi tarah apne zehan mein rakha hai jaisa unhone iske baare mein bataya tha? Maine kaha: Main. Isper unhone kaha: Tum bahut himmatvar ho (ye daawa karne mein). Aur unhone aage poocha: Kaise? Maine kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kisi shakhs ke liye fitna (sabse pehle) uske khaandaan, uski daulat, uski khud ki zaat, uski aulad, aur uske padosiyon ke silsile mein hogi, (aur is fitne mein huye gunahon ka) kaffara roze, namaz, sadaqa, achhaai ka hukum dena aur burai se rokne se ho jaayega. Isper Umar ne kaha: Mera matlab ye (choti fitna) nahi hai balki woh jo samundar ki uThTi laharon ki tarah pragat hogi. Maine kaha: Ameer-ul-Mominin, aapko ismein koi khatra nahi, kyunki aapke aur uske beech darwaza band hai. Unhone kaha: Kya woh darwaza toDa jaayega ya khola jaayega? Maine kaha: Nahi, ye toDa jaayega. Isper unhone kaha: Phir ye kabhi band nahi kiya ja sakega chahe koi bhi koshish ki jaaye. Humne Hudhaifa se kaha: Kya Umar us darwaze ko jaante the? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, unhe uska pata utna hi yaqeeni tha jitna ki raat kal ke din se pehle aati hai. Aur maine unhe ek hadees riwayat ki jismein koi ghadat hui baat nahi thi. Shaqiq (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Humne Hudhaifa se us darwaze ke baare mein poochne ki himmat nahi ki, isliye humne Masruq se guzaarish ki ki woh unse poochein. Unhone poocha aur unhone kaha: (Us darwaze se unka matlab) Umar the.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa through other chains of transmitters also.
hi: Ye hadees Hudhaifa (RA) ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hudhaifa reported that Umar said: Who would narrate to us (the ahadith pertaining to turmoil) and he reported a hadith similar to these ahadith.
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar ne kaha: Humein (fitne se mutaliq ahadees) kaun riwayat karega? Aur unhone in ahadees jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki.

e: Jundub reported: I came on the day of Jara`a that a person was (found) sitting. I said: They would shed their blood today. That person said: By Allah. not at all. I said: By Allah, of course, they would do it. He said: By Allah, they would not do it. I said: By Allah, of course, they would do it. He said: By Allah, they would not do it, and I have heard a hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I am narrating to you in this connection. I said: You are a bad seat fellow. I have been opposing you since morning and you are listening to me in spite of the fact that you have heard a hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (contrary to my statement). I myself felt that there was no use of this annoyance. (He could tell me earlier that it was a hadith of the Prophet (may peace be upon him], and I would not have opposed him at all.) I turned my face toward him and asked him and he was Hadrat Hudhaifa.
hi: Jundub (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Jara'a ke din aaya to dekha ki ek shakhs baitha hua tha. Maine kaha: Woh aaj apna khoon bahaayenge. Us shakhs ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, bilkul nahi. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, zaroor woh aisa karenge. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, woh aisa nahi karenge. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, zaroor woh aisa karenge. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, woh aisa nahi karenge, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek hadees suni hai jise main tumhe is silsile mein riwayat kar raha hoon. Maine kaha: Tum ek bura saathi ho. Main subah se aapse asahmat ho raha hoon aur aap mujhe sunte rahe jabki aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi hadees pata thi (jo meri baat se ulaT thi). Mujhe khud lagne laga ki is naaraazgi ka koi faayda nahi tha (unhe mujhe pehle hi bata dena chahiye tha ki ye Pavitr Nabi ki hadees hai, to main bilkul asahmat na hota). Maine apna chehra unki taraf moda aur unse poocha aur woh Hazrat Hudhaifa nikle.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come before the Euphrates uncovers a mountain of gold, for which people would fight. Ninety-nine out of each one hundred would die but every man amongst them would say that perhaps he would be the one who would be saved (and thus possess this gold).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Euphrates ek sone ka pahaad zaahir na kare, jiske liye log jhagdenge. Sau mein se ninnyaave log mar jaayenge lekin unmein se har shakhs ye sochega ki shaayad woh hi bach jaayega (aur ye sona haasil kar lega).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " My father said: If you see that, do not even go near it."
hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Mere waalid ne kaha: Agar tum ye dekho, to iske paas bhi mat jaana."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come unless the Euphrates would uncover a treasure of gold, so he who finds it should not take anything out of that.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Euphrates sone ka khazana zaahir na kare, isliye jo ise paaye use ismein se kuch bhi nahi lena chahiye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Euphrates would soon uncover a mountain of gold but he who is present there should not take anything from that.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jald hi Euphrates sone ka ek pahaad zaahir karega, lekin jo wahan maujood ho use ismein se kuch nahi lena chahiye.

e: `Abdullah b. Harith b. Naufal reported: I was standing along with Ubayy b. Ka`b and he said: The opinions of the people differ in regard to the achievement of worldly ends. I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Euphrates would soon uncover a mountain of gold and when the people would bear of it they would flock towards it but the people who would possess that (treasure) (would say): If we allow these persons to take out of it they would take away the whole of it. So they would fight and ninety-nine out of one hundred would be killed. Abu Kamil in his narration said: I and Ubayy b. Ka`b stood under the shade of the battlement of Hassan.
hi: Abdullah bin Harith bin Naufal ne bayan kiya: Main Ubayy bin Ka'b ke saath khada tha aur unhone kaha: Duniyaavi maqsad haasil karne ke baare mein logon ki raay alag-alag hai. Maine kaha: Haan, zaroor. Isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jald hi Euphrates sone ka ek pahaad zaahir karega, aur jab logon ko iski khabar hogi, woh iski taraf umad padenge, lekin jinke paas woh khazana hoga woh kahenge: Agar humne in logon ko ismein se kuch lene diya, to woh sab kuch le jaayenge. Isliye woh laDenge aur sau mein se ninnyaave maare jaayenge. Abu Kamil ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Main aur Ubayy bin Ka'b Hassan ki burj ki chhaaya mein khade the.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Iraq would withhold its dirhams and qafiz; Syria would withhold its mudd and dinar and Egypt would withhold its irdab and dinar and you would recoil to that position from where you started and you would recoil to that position from where you started and you would recoil to that position from where you started, the flesh and blood of Abu Huraira would bear testimony to it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Iraq apne dirham aur qafiz (naap) rok lega; Syria apna mudd (naap) aur dinar rok lega aur Egypt apna irdab (naap) aur dinar rok lega, aur tum wahin wapas laut aaoge jahan se tum shuru hue the, aur tum wahin wapas laut aaoge jahan se tum shuru hue the, aur tum wahin wapas laut aaoge jahan se tum shuru hue the, iski gawaahi Abu Huraira ka khud ka gosht aur khoon dega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until the Romans would land at al-A'maq or in Dabiq. An army consisting of the best (soldiers) of the people of the earth at that time will come from Medina (to counteract them). When they will arrange themselves in ranks, the Romans would say: Do not stand between us and those (Muslims) who took prisoners from amongst us. Let us fight with them; and the Muslims would say: Nay, by Allah, we would never get aside from you and from our brethren that you may fight them. They will then fight and a third (part) of the army would run away, whom Allah will never forgive. A third (part of the army) which would be constituted of excellent martyrs in Allah's eye, would be killed and the third who would never be put to trial would win and they would be conquerors of Constantinople. And as they would be busy in distributing the spoils of war (amongst themselves) after hanging their swords by the olive trees, the Satan would cry: The Dajjal has taken your place among your family. They would then come out, but it would be of no avail. And when they would come to Syria, he would come out while they would be still preparing themselves for battle drawing up the ranks. Certainly, the time of prayer shall come and then Jesus (peace be upon him) son of Mary would descend and would lead them. When the enemy of Allah would see him, it would (disappear) just as the salt dissolves itself in water and if he (Jesus) were not to confront them at all, even then it would dissolve completely, but Allah would kill them by his hand and he would show them their blood on his lance (the lance of Jesus Christ).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Rome ke log al-A'maq ya Dabiq mein na utrein. Ek fauj jismein us waqt zameen ke behtareen sipahi shaamil honge Madina se (unka muqaabla karne) aayegi. Jab woh safon mein taiyaar hongi, Rome ke log kahenge: Humme aur un (Musalmaanon) ke beech mat aao jinhe humne qaidi banaaya hai; humein unse laDne do; aur Musalman kahenge: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhaare aur apne bhaiyon ke beech se kabhi nahi hatenge taaki tum unse laD sako. Phir woh laDenge aur fauj ka ek-tihaai hissa bhaag jaayega, jinhe Allah kabhi maaf nahi karega. Ek-tihaai hissa, jo Allah ki nazar mein behtareen shaheed honge, maare jaayenge, aur ek-tihaai jinki kabhi pareeksha nahi hogi, jeetenge aur woh Constantinople ko fatah karenge. Aur jab woh (jung ke) maal-e-ganimat baantne mein masroof honge apni talwaaren zaitun ke darakhton par latkaakar, Shaitaan chillaayega: Dajjal ne tumhaari jagah tumhaare khaandaan mein le li hai. Woh phir bahar nikalenge, lekin ye be-asar hoga. Aur jab woh Syria pahunchenge, woh (Dajjal) bahar aayega jab tak woh jung ke liye taiyaari kar rahe honge, safen banaate hue. Yaqeenan, namaz ka waqt aayega aur phir Isa (unpar shaanti ho), Mary ke bete, utrenge aur unki agrasi karenge. Jab Allah ka dushman (Dajjal) unhe dekhega, woh (galne lagega) jaise namak paani mein ghulta hai, aur agar Isa unka saamna bhi na karein, to bhi woh poori tarah ghul jaayega, lekin Allah use unke haathon se maar dega aur woh unhe uski neze par uska khoon dikhaayenge (Isa Masih ki neze par).

e: Mustaurid al-Qurashi reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come (when) the Romans would form a majority amongst people. 'Amr said to him (Mustaurid Qurashi): See what you are saying? He said: I say what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon he said: If you say that, it is a fact for they have four qualities. They have the patience to undergo a trial and immediately restore themselves to sanity after trouble and attack again after flight. They (have the quality) of being good to the destitute and the orphans, to the weak and, fifthly, the good quality in them is that they put resistance against the oppression of kings.
hi: Mustaurid al-Qurashi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab aayegi jab Rome ke log logon mein bahumat mein honge. Amr ne unse (Mustaurid Qurashi se) kaha: Dekho tum kya keh rahe ho? Unhone kaha: Main woh keh raha hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai. Isper unhone kaha: Agar tum aisa kehte ho, to ye sach hai kyunki unmein chaar khoobiyaan hain. Unmein pareeksha ke waqt sabar rakhne ki taakat hai aur woh museebat ke baad turant apne aap ko theek kar lete hain aur bhaagne ke baad phir hamla karte hain. Woh (chauthi khoobi ye hai ki woh) zaroorat-mand aur anaathon ke saath achha vyavahaar karte hain, kamzoron ke saath, aur paanchvin khoobi ye hai ki woh baadshaahon ke zulm ke khilaaf pratirodh karte hain.

e: Mustaurid Qurashi reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come when the Romans would form a majority amongst people. This reached 'Amr b. al-'As and he said: What are these ahadith which are being transmitted from you and which you claim to have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Mustaurid said to him: I stated only that which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon 'Amr said: If you state this (it is true), for they have the power of tolerance amongst people at the time of turmoil and restore themselves to sanity after trouble, and are good amongst people so far as the destitute and the weak are concerned.
hi: Mustaurid Qurashi (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab aayegi jab Rome ke log logon mein bahumat mein honge. Ye baat Amr bin al-As tak pahunchi aur unhone kaha: Ye kaunsi ahadees hain jo tumse riwayat ki jaa rahi hain aur jinka tum daawa karte ho ki tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni hain? Mustaurid ne unse kaha: Maine sirf woh bataya jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Isper Amr ne kaha: Agar tum ye kehte ho (to ye sach hai), kyunki fitne ke waqt logon mein sabar rakhne ki taakat unmein hai aur museebat ke baad woh apni sanjeedagi wapas paa lete hain, aur woh logon ke saath achhe hain jahan tak zaroorat-mand aur kamzoron ka sawaal hai.

e: Yusair b. Jabir reported: Once there blew a red storm in Kufah that there came a person who had nothing to say but (these words): `Abdullah b. Mas`ud, the Last Hour has come. He (`Abdullah b. Mas`ud) was sitting reclining against something, and he said: The Last Hour would not come until shares of inheritance are not distributed and there is no rejoicing over spoils of war. Then he said pointing towards Syria, with the gesture of his hand like this: The enemy shall muster strength against Muslims and the Muslims will muster strength against them (Syrians). I said: You mean Rome? And he said: Yes, and there would be a terrible fight and the Muslims would prepare a detachment (for fighting unto death) which would not return but victorious. They will fight until night will intervene them; both the sides will return without being victorious and both will be wiped out. The Muslims will again prepare a detachment for fighting unto death so that they may not return but victorious. When it would be the fourth day, a new detachment out of the remnant of the Muslims would be prepared and Allah will decree that the enemy should be routed. And they would fight such a fight the like of which would not be seen, so much so that even if a bird were to pass their flanks, it would fall down dead before reaching the end of them. (There would be such a large scale massacre) that when counting would be done, (only) one out of a hundred men related to one another would be found alive. So what can be the joy at the spoils of such war and what inheritance would be divided! They would be in this very state that they would hear of a calamity more horrible than this. And a cry would reach them: The Dajjal has taken your place among your offspring. They will, therefore, throw away what would be in their hands and go forward sending ten horsemen, as a scouting party. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I know their names and the names of their forefathers and the color of their horses. They will be the best horsemen on the surface of the earth on that day or amongst the best horsemen on the surface of the earth on that day.
hi: Yusair bin Jabir ne bayan kiya: Ek baar Kufa mein ek laal aandhi chali ki ek shakhs aaya jise kuch aur nahi kehna tha siwaay in alfaazon ke: Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Aakhri Ghadi aa gayi hai. Woh (Abdullah bin Mas'ud) kisi cheez ka sahaara lekar baithe the, aur unhone kaha: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak virasat ka taqseem na ho aur jung ke maal-e-ganimat par khushi na manaayi jaaye. Phir unhone Syria ki taraf apne haath se ishara karte hue kaha: Dushman Musalmaanon ke khilaaf taakat ikattha karega aur Musalman unke (Syrians ke) khilaaf taakat ikattha karenge. Maine kaha: Aapka matlab Rome hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur ye ek bhayaanak jung hogi aur Musalman aakhri saans tak ladne wala ek dasta taiyaar karenge jo bina jeete wapas nahi aayega. Woh laDenge yahan tak ki raat unke beech aayegi; dono taraf bina jeete wapas jaayengi aur dono barbaad ho jaayengi. Musalman phir aakhri saans tak ladne wala ek doosra dasta taiyaar karenge taaki woh bina jeete wapas na aayein. Jab chautha din hoga, Musalmaanon mein se bache huon mein se ek naya dasta taiyaar kiya jaayega aur Allah dushman ki haar tay karega. Aur woh aisi jung laDenge jaisi pehle kabhi nahi dekhi gayi, itni ki agar ek parinda unki safon ke paas se guzre, to woh unke aakhri sire tak pahunchne se pehle hi mar kar gir jaayega. (Itna bada khoon-kharaba hoga) ki jab ginti ki jaayegi, sau rishtedaaron mein se sirf ek zinda milega. To aisi jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein kya khushi ho sakti hai aur virasat mein kya taqseem hona hoga! Woh isi haalat mein honge ki unhe isse bhi zyada bhayaanak museebat ki khabar milegi. Aur unhe ek pukaar sunaayi degi: Dajjal ne tumhaari jagah tumhaari aulad mein le li hai. Woh apne haathon mein jo kuch hoga use phenk denge aur aage badhenge, das ghudsawaar bhejenge jasoosi ke liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhe unke naam pata hain aur unke purvajon ke naam bhi aur unke ghodon ka rang bhi. Woh us din zameen ki satah par sabse behtareen ghudsawaar honge ya us din zameen ki satah ke behtareen ghudsawaaron mein se honge.

e: Jabir reported: I was in the company of Ibn Mas'ud that there blew a red storm. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Mas'ud ki sohbat mein tha ki ek laal aandhi chali. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Jabir reported: I was in the house of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud and the house was fully packed that a red storm blew in Kufah.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke ghar mein tha aur ghar poori tarah bhara hua tha ki Kufa mein ek laal aandhi chali.

e: Nafi' b. Utba reported: We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition that there came a people to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) from the direction of the west. They were dressed in woollen clothes and they stood near a hillock and they met him as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting. I said to myself: Better go to them and stand between him and them that they may not attack him. Then I thought that perhaps there had been going on secret negotiation amongst them. I however, went to them and stood between them and him and I remember four of the words (on that occasion) which I repeat (on the fingers of my hand) that he (Allah's Messenger) said: You will attack Arabia and Allah will enable you to conquer it, then you would attack Persia and He would make you to conquer it. Then you would attack Rome and Allah will enable you to conquer it, then you would attack the Dajjal and Allah will enable you to conquer him. Nafi' said: Jabir, we thought that the Dajjal would appear after Rome (Syrian territory) would be conquered.
hi: Nafi bin Utba (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par the ki kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas pashchim ki taraf se aaye. Woh oon ke kapde pehne huye the aur ek chhote Tille ke paas khade huye aur unse mile jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe huye the. Maine khud se socha: Behtar hoga ki main unke paas jaaun aur unke aur inke beech khada ho jaaun taaki woh unpar hamla na karein. Phir maine socha ki shaayad unke beech koi guptagoo chal rahi hai. Main, halaanki, unke paas gaya aur unke aur unke beech khada ho gaya aur mujhe woh chaar alfaaz yaad hain jinhe main dohraata hoon (apni ungliyon par ginte hue) jo unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Tum Arabia par hamla karoge aur Allah tumhe use fatah karne ki taufeek dega, phir tum Persia par hamla karoge aur Woh tumhe use fatah karne ki taufeek dega. Phir tum Rome par hamla karoge aur Allah tumhe use fatah karne ki taufeek dega, phir tum Dajjal par hamla karoge aur Allah tumhe use fatah karne ki taufeek dega. Nafi ne kaha: Jabir, humein laga ki Dajjal Rome (Syria ke ilaake) ki fatah ke baad pragat hoga.

e: Hudhaifa b. Usaid al-Ghifari reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us all of a sudden as we were (busy in a discussion). He said: What do you discuss about? They (the Companions) said. We are discussing about the Last Hour. Thereupon he said: It will not come until you see ten signs before and (in this connection) he made a mention of the smoke, Dajjal, the beast, the rising of the sun from the west, the descent of Jesus son of Mary (Allah be pleased with him), the Gog and Magog, and land-slides in three places, one in the east, one in the west and one in Arabia at the end of which fire would burn forth from the Yemen, and would drive people to the place of their assembly.
hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid al-Ghifari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) achaanak humaare paas aaye jab hum (ek charcha mein) masroof the. Unhone farmaaya: Tum kis baare mein charcha kar rahe ho? Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Hum Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein charcha kar rahe hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum das nishaaniyaan pehle na dekh lo, aur (is silsile mein) unhone dhuen, Dajjal, us jaanwar, suraj ke pashchim se nikalne, Isa Masih, Mary ke bete, ke utarne, Yajuj-Majuj, aur teen jagahon par zameen ke dhasne ka zikr kiya, ek poorab mein, ek pashchim mein aur ek Arabia mein jiske aakhir mein Yemen se aag nikalegi jo logon ko unke ikattha hone ki jagah tak dhakelegi.

e: Hudhaifa b. Usaid reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was in an apartment and we were beneath that, that he peeped in and said to us: What are you discussing about? We said: (We are discussing about the Last) Hour. Thereupon he said: The Last Hour would not come until the ten signs appear: land-sliding in the east, and land-sliding in the west, and land-sliding in the peninsula of Arabia, the smoke, the Dajjal, the beast of the earth, Gog and Magog, the rising of the sun from the west and the fire which would emit from the lower part of 'Adan. Shu'ba said that 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufai' reported on the authority of Abu Tufail who reported on the authority of Abu Sariha a hadith like this that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not make a mention of (the tenth sign) but he said that out of the ten one was the descent of Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him), and in another version it is the blowing of the violent gale which would drive the people to the ocean.
hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek kamre mein the aur hum uske neeche the ki unhone jhaanka aur humse kaha: Tum kis baare mein charcha kar rahe ho? Humne kaha: Hum (Aakhri) Ghadi ke baare mein charcha kar rahe hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak das nishaaniyaan pragat na hon: poorab mein zameen ka dhasna, pashchim mein zameen ka dhasna, aur Arabia prayadweep mein zameen ka dhasna, dhuaan, Dajjal, zameen ka jaanwar, Yajuj-Majuj, suraj ka pashchim se nikalna aur aag jo Aden ke nichle hisse se nikalegi. Shu'ba ne kaha ki Abd al-Aziz bin Rufai ne Abu Tufail ke hawaale se, jinhone Abu Sariha ke hawaale se, isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (dasvin nishaani ka) koi zikr nahi kiya, lekin unhone kaha ki das mein se ek Isa Masih, Mary ke bete, (unpar shaanti ho) ka utarna hai, aur ek doosri riwayat mein ye ek tez aandhi ka chalna hai jo logon ko samundar ki taraf dhakel degi.

e: Abu Sariha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in an (upper) apartment and we were standing lower to him and discussing (about the Last Hour). The rest of the hadith is the same, and Shu'ba said: I think he also said these words: The fire would descend along with them where they would land and where they would take rest (during midday (it would also cool down for a while). Shu'ba said: This hadith has been transmitted to me through Abu Tufail and Abu Sariha and none could trace it back directly to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). However, there is a mention of the descent of Jesus Christ son of Mary in one version and in the other there is a mention of the blowing of a violent gale which would drive them to the ocean.
hi: Abu Sariha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek (upari) kamre mein the aur hum unse neeche khade unke baare mein (Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein) charcha kar rahe the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur Shu'ba ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Aag unke saath niche aayegi jahan woh utrenge aur jahan woh aaraam karenge (dopahar mein ye bhi Thandi ho jaayegi kuch der ke liye). Shu'ba ne kaha: Ye hadees mujhe Abu Tufail aur Abu Sariha ke zariye pahunchi aur koi bhi ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak nahi le jaa saka. Halaanki, ek riwayat mein Isa Masih, Mary ke bete, ke utarne ka zikr hai aur doosri mein ek tez aandhi ke chalne ka jo unhe samundar ki taraf dhakel degi.

e:
Another chain of transmitters reports the like of the previous two chains.
Abu Sariha reported: We were discussing (the Last Hour) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) looked towards us. The rest of the hadith is the same and the tenth (sign) was the descent of Jesus Christ son of Mary, and Shu'ba said: 'Abd al-'Aziz did not trace it directly to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
hi: Ek doosri sanad ne pichhli do sanadon jaisi hi baat riwayat ki. Abu Sariha ne bayan kiya: Hum (Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein) charcha kar rahe the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaari taraf dekha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur dasvin (nishaani) Isa Masih, Mary ke bete, ka utarna tha, aur Shu'ba ne kaha: Abd al-Aziz ne ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak nahi pahunchaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Last Hour would not come until fire emits from the earth of Hijaz which would illuminate the necks of the camels of the Busra.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Hijaz ki zameen se aag na nikale jo Busra ke oonton ki gardanon ko roshan kar de.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (The Last Hour would not come) until the habitations of Medina would extend to Ihab or Yahab. Zubair said: I said to Suhail how far these were from Medina. He said: So and so miles.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: (Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi) jab tak Madina ki basti Ihab ya Yahab tak na phail jaaye. Zubair ne kaha: Maine Suhail se poocha ki ye Madina se kitni doori par hain. Unhone kaha: Itni-itni mil.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The famine would not break out because of drought, but there would be famine despite heavy rainfall as nothing would grow from the earth.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Akaal sookhe ki wajah se nahi aayega, balki akaal bhaari baarish ke bawajood aayega kyunki zameen se kuch bhi nahi ugega.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (in a state) that he had turned his face towards the east: Behold, turmoil would appear from this side, from where the horns of Satan would appear.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna jab unhone apna chehra poorab ki taraf moda tha: Dekho, fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga, jahan se Shaitaan ke seengh nikalenge.

e: Ibn `Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood by the door (of the apartment of) Hafsa and, pointing towards the east, he said: The turmoil would appear from this side, viz. where the horns of Satan would appear, and he uttered these words twice or thrice and `Ubaidullah b. Sa`id in his narration said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been standing by the door of `A'isha.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hafsa (RA) ke kamre ke darwaze par khade huye aur poorab ki taraf ishara karte huye kaha: Fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga, yaani jahan se Shaitaan ke seengh nikalenge, aur unhone ye alfaaz do ya teen baar kahe, aur Ubaidullah bin Sa'id ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha (RA) ke kamre ke darwaze par khade the.

e: Salim b. Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while turning his face towards the east, said: The turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side - the side where appear the horns of Satan.
hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chehra poorab ki taraf modte huye kaha: Fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga; yaqeenan, fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga; yaqeenan, fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga - jahan Shaitaan ke seengh pragat hote hain.

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from the house of 'Aisha and said: It would be from this side that there would appear the height of unbelief, viz. where appear the horns of Satan, i.e. the east.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aisha (RA) ke ghar se bahar aaye aur kaha: Isi taraf se kufr ki inteha pragat hogi, yaani jahan Shaitaan ke seengh nikalenge, yaani poorab.

e: Ibn Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while pointing his hands towards the east: The turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side (he repeated it thrice) where appear the horns of Satan.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne haathon se poorab ki taraf ishara karte hue ye farmaate suna: Fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga; yaqeenan, fitna isi taraf se pragat hoga (unhone ise teen baar dohraaya) jahan Shaitaan ke seengh pragat hote hain.

e: Ibn Fudail reported on the authority of his father that he heard Salim b. `Abdullah b. `Umar as saying: O people of Iraq, how strange it is that you ask about the minor sins but commit major sins? I heard from my father `Abdullah b. `Umar, narrating that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while pointing his hand towards the east: Verily, the turmoil would come from this side, from where appear the horns of Satan and you would strike the necks of one another; and Moses killed a person from among the people of Pharaoh unintentionally and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: "You killed a person but We relieved you from the grief and tried you with (many a) trial" (xx. 40). Ahmad b. `Umar reported this hadith from Salim, but he did not make a mention of the words: "I heard".
hi: Ibn Fudail ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ko ye kehte suna: Aye Iraq waalo, ye kitna ajeeb hai ki tum choti-choti gunahon ke baare mein poochte ho lekin badi-badi gunahon mein masroof rehte ho? Maine apne waalid Abdullah bin Umar se suna, unhone riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne haath se poorab ki taraf ishara karte hue ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, fitna isi taraf se aayega, jahan se Shaitaan ke seengh nikalte hain aur tum ek-doosre ki gardanein kaaToge; aur Musa ne Firaun ke logon mein se ek shakhs ko anjaane mein qatal kar diya tha aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: "Tumne ek shakhs ko qatal kiya lekin Humne tumhe gam se raha di aur tumhaari kayi tarah se pareeksha li" (20:40). Ahmad bin Umar ne ye hadees Salim se riwayat ki lekin unhone "maine suna" alfaaz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until the women of the tribe of Daus would be seen going round Dhi al-Khalasa (for worship) and Dhi al-Khalasa is a place in Tabala, where there was a temple in which the people of the tribe of Daus used to worship the idol.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Daus qabile ki auraten Dhi al-Khalasa ka tawaaf karte hue (ibadat ke liye) na dekhi jaayein, aur Dhi al-Khalasa Tabala mein ek jagah hai jahan ek mandir tha jismein Daus qabile ke log ek murti ki parastish kiya karte the.

e: 'A'isha reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The (system) of night and day would not end until the people have taken to the worship of Lat and 'Uzza. I said: Allah's Messenger, I think when Allah has revealed this verse:" He it is Who has sent His Messenger with right guidance, and true religion, so that He may cause it to prevail upon all religions, though the polytheists are averse (to it)" (ix. 33), it implies that (this promise) is going to be fulfilled. Thereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: It would happen as Allah would like. Then Allah would send the sweet fragrant air by which everyone who has even a mustard grain of faith in Him would die and those only would survive who would have no goodness in them. And they would revert to the religion of their forefathers.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Raat aur din ka (nizaam) tab tak khatm nahi hoga jab tak log Laat aur Uzza (murtiyon) ki parastish na karne lagein. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera khayal tha ki jab Allah ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Wahi hai Jisne Apne Rasool ko sahi margdarshan aur sachche deen ke saath bheja, taaki Woh ise har deen par galib kare, chahe mushrikeen ise napasand karein" (9:33), (iska matlab hai ki) ye vaada poora hone waala hai. Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) farmaaya: Ye waisa hoga jaisa Allah chaahenge. Phir Allah ek khushboodaar hawa bhejenge jismein Allah par sarson ke daane jitna bhi imaan rakhne wala har shakhs mar jaayega aur sirf woh log bachenge jinmein koi achhaai nahi hogi. Aur woh apne poorvajon ke deen ki taraf laut jaayenge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Ja'far ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until a person would pass by a grave of another person and he would say: I wish it had been my abode.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak koi shakhs kisi doosre shakhs ki qabar ke paas se guzarte hue ye na kahe: Kaash ye meri jagah hoti.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: By Him, in Whose hand is my life, the world would not come to an end until a person would pass by a grave, would roll over it and express the desire that he should be in the place of the occupant of that grave not because of religious reasons but because of this calamity.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, duniya tab tak khatm nahi hogi jab tak koi shakhs kisi qabar ke paas se na guzre, uspar lotpot na ho aur ye khwaish na jataaye ki woh us qabar ke maalik ki jagah hota - deeni wajahon se nahi balki us museebat ki wajah se (jo woh us waqt jhel raha hoga).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, a time would come when the murderer would not know why he has committed the murder, and the victim would not know why he has been killed.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, ek waqt aayega jab qaatil ko nahi pata hoga ki usne kyun qatal kiya, aur jise maara gaya use nahi pata hoga ki use kyun qatal kiya gaya.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The world would not come to an end until a day would come to the people on which the murderer would not know as to why he has killed and the slain would not know as to why he has been murdered. It would be said: Why would It happen? To which he replied: It would be because of general massacre and bloodshed. And the slaughterers and the slain would be in Fire, and in the narration of Ibn Aban, the name of Abu Isma'il has been mentioned.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Duniya tab tak khatm nahi hogi jab tak logon ke liye woh din na aaye jismein qaatil ko nahi pata hoga ki usne kyun qatal kiya, aur maara gaya shakhs nahi jaanega ki use kyun qatal kiya gaya. Poocha gaya: Aisa kyun hoga? Isper unhone jawaab diya: Ye vyapak khoon-kharaba aur maar-kaat ki wajah se hoga. Aur qatal karne wale aur maare gaye dono Jahannam ki aag mein honge, aur Ibn Aban ki riwayat mein Abu Isma'il ka naam zikr kiya gaya hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Ka'ba would be destroyed by an Abyssinian having two small shanks.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kaaba ko ek Habashi (Ethiopian) jiski patli-patli do pindliyaan hongi, barbaad karega.

e: (The above mentioned) hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: (Upar bataayi gayi) hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It would be an Abyssinian having two small shanks who would destroy the House ol Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek Habashi jiski do patli pindliyaan hongi woh Allah ke Ghar, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ko barbaad karega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messengar (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come before a person of Qahtan comes forth driving people with his stick.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Qahtan qabile se ek shakhs na aaye jo apni lakdi se logon ko haankega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The day and the night would not come to an end before a man called al-Jahjah would occupy the throne.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Din aur raat tab tak khatm nahi honge jab tak al-Jahjah naamak ek shakhs takht par baith na jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come unless you fight with people whose faces are like hammered shields and the Last Hour would not come until you would fight against those wearing the shoes of hair.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum aise logon se jung na karo jinke chehre kooTi hui dhaal jaise hain, aur Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum aise logon ke khilaaf jung na karo jo baalon ke joote pehnte hain.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until a people wearing shoes of hair fight against you having their faces like hammered shields.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak baalon ke joote pehnne wale log tumse jung na karein, unke chehre kooTi hui dhaal jaise honge.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until you fight with a people wearing shoes of hair and the Last Hour would not come until you fight with a people having small eyes and broad snub noses.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum baalon ke joote pehnne wale logon se jung na karo, aur Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak tum choti aankhon aur chaude, chapte naak wale logon se jung na karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until the Muslims fight with the Turks-a people whose faces would be like hammered shields wearing clothes of hair and walking (with shoes) of hair.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Musalman Turkon se jung na karein - aise log jinke chehre kooTi hui dhaal jaise honge, baalon ke kapde pehne hue aur baalon ke (joote) pehnkar chalte hue.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You shall fight in the hours to come against a nation wearing shoes made of hair and faces like hammered shields, with red complexion and small eyes.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum aane wali ghadiyon mein ek aisi qaum se jung karoge jo baalon ke bane joote pehnti hogi, jinke chehre kooTi hui dhaal jaise honge, saanwle rang aur choti aankhon ke saath.

e: Abu Nadra reported: "We were in the company of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that he said it may happen that the people of Iraq may not send their qafiz and dirhams (their measures of food stuff and their money). We said: Who would be responsible for it? He said: The non-Arabs would prevent them. He again said: There is the possibility that the people of Syria may not send their dinars and mudds. We said: Who would be responsible for it? He said this prevention would be made by the Romans. He (Jabir b. Abdullah) kept quiet for a while and then reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said there would be a caliph in the last (period) of my Ummah who would freely give handfuls of wealth to the people without counting it. I said to Abu Nadra and Abu al-'Ala: Do you mean 'Umar b. 'Abd al-Aziz? They said: No (he would be Imam Mahdi).
