hi: Abu Nadra ne bayan kiya: Hum Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ki sohbat mein the ki unhone kaha: Ho sakta hai ki Iraq ke log apna qafiz aur dirham (apne khaadya padaarth ke naap aur apni raqam) na bhejein. Humne kaha: Iski wajah kya hogi? Unhone kaha: Gair-Arab log unhe rokenge. Unhone phir kaha: Ho sakta hai ki Syria ke log apne dinar aur mudd na bhejein. Humne kaha: Iski wajah kya hogi? Unhone kaha: Rome ke log ye rukaawat Dalenge. Woh (Jabir bin Abdullah) kuch der khamosh rahe aur phir riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha ki meri Ummat ke aakhri (daur) mein ek khalifa hoga jo daulat ke mutthi bhar-bhar ke log denge bina ginne ke. Maine Abu Nadra aur Abu al-Ala se kaha: Kya aapka matlab Umar bin Abd al-Aziz hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi (woh Imam Mahdi honge).

e: This hadith hab been narrated by Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) I said: There would be amongst your caliphs a caliph who would give handfuls of wealth to the people, but would not count it. In the narration transmitted on the authority of Ibn Hujr, there is a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaare khaleefaon mein se ek khaleefa aisa hoga jo logon ko daulat ke mutthi bhar-bhar de dega, bina ginne ke. Ibn Hujr ki riwayat mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

e: Abu Sa'id and Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There would be in the last phase of the time a caliph who would distribute wealth but would not count.
hi: Abu Sa'id aur Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aakhri daur mein ek khaleefa hoga jo daulat baantega lekin ginega nahi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa`id Khudri reported: One who is better than I informed me, that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to `Ammar as he was digging the ditch (on the ocassion of the Battle of the Ditch) wiping over his head: O son of Summayya, you will be involved in trouble and a group of the rebels would kill you.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mujhse behtar ek shakhs ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ammar se kaha jab woh khaai khod rahe the (Khandaq ki jung ke mauke par), unka sar ponchhte hue: Aye Sumayya ke bete, tum mushkil mein padoge aur bagavat karne walon ka ek giroh tumhe qatal karega.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the same authority but with this variation that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Nabra (the words are): One who is better than I informed me, and he was Abu Qatada, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Khalid instead of the word 'bu'us' there is 'wayys' or 'ya wayys', i.e., " how sad it is".
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Nadra ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Mujhse behtar ek shakhs ne mujhe bataya, aur woh Abu Qatada the, aur Khalid ki riwayat mein "bu'us" lafz ki jagah "wayys" ya "ya wayss" lafz hai, yaani "ye kitni dukhad baat hai."

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Umm Salama that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to 'Ammar: A group of rebels would kill you.
hi: Ye hadees Umm Salama (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ammar se kaha: Bagavat karne walon ka ek giroh tumhe qatal karega.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Umm Salama through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Umm Salama (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Umm Salama reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A band of rebels would kill `Ammar.
hi: Umm Salama (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Bagavat karne walon ka ek giroh Ammar ko qatal karega.

e:
Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: This tribe of the Quraish would kill (people) of my Ummah. They (the Companions) said: What do you command us to do (in such a situation)? Thereupon he said: Would that the people remain aside from them (and not besmear their hands with the blood of the Muslim).

This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Quraish ka ye qabila meri Ummat ke logon ko qatal karega. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Aap humein kya karne ka hukum dete hain (aisi haalat mein)? Isper unhone farmaaya: Kaash log unse alag rahein (aur apne haath Musalmaanon ke khoon se na rangein). Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Kisra (Khusrau king of Persia) would die and Qaisar (Ceasar King of Rome) would die; there would be no Qaisar after him, but, by the One in Whose Hand is my life, you would spend their treasures in the cause of Allah.

This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kisra (Persia ke raja Khusrau) marega aur uske baad koi Kisra nahi hoga; Qaisar (Rome ke raja Ceasar) marega aur uske baad koi Qaisar nahi hoga, lekin, Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, tum unke khazane Allah ki raah mein kharch karoge. Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Hammam b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira reported from Allah's messenger (ﷺ) and in this connection he reported so many hadith (and one of them was this): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Kisra would die and then there would be no Kisra after him. Qaisar would die and there would be no Qaisar after him, but you will distribute their treasures in the cause of Allah.
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kiya, aur is silsile mein unhone bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin (aur unmein se ek ye thi): Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kisra marega aur uske baad koi Kisra nahi hoga. Qaisar marega aur uske baad koi Qaisar nahi hoga, lekin tum unke khazane Allah ki raah mein baantoge.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When Kisra would die there would be no Kisra after him; the rest of the hadith is the same as Abu Huraira reported.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Kisra marega uske baad koi Kisra nahi hoga; baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would lie open for a group of Muslims, or for a group of believers, the treasures of the family of Kisra which would be in the white (palace). In a version of Qutaiba there is definitely the word "Muslim".
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kisra ke khaandaan ke khazane, jo safed (mahal) mein honge, Musalmaanon ke ek giroh ke liye, ya momino ke ek giroh ke liye, khol diye jaayenge. Qutaiba ki riwayat mein zaroor "Musalman" lafz hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like this.
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi ek hadees suni.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) saying: You have heard about a city, one side of which is on land and the other is in the sea (Constantinople). They said: Allah's Messenger, yes. Thereupon he said: The Last Hour would not come unless seventy thousand persons from Bani lshaq would attack it. When they would land there, they will neither fight with weapons nor would shower arrows but would only say: "There is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest," and one side of it would fall. Thaur (one of the narrators) said: I think that he said: The part by the side of the ocean. Then they would say for the second time: "There is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest" and the second side would also fall, and they would say: "There is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest," and the gates would be opened for them and they would enter therein and, they would be collecting spoils of war and distributing them amongst themselves when a noise would be heard saying: Verily, Dajjal has come. And thus they would leave everything there and go back.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne ek shehar ke baare mein suna hai jiska ek hissa zameen par hai aur doosra samundar mein (Constantinople). Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan. Isper unhone farmaaya: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Banu Ishaq ke sattar hazaar log iska hamla na karein. Jab woh wahan utrenge, woh na hathiyaaron se laDenge na teer barsaayenge balki sirf kahenge: Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Allah Sabse Buland hai, aur iska ek hissa gir jaayega. Thaur (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha: Samundar ki taraf ka hissa. Phir woh doosri baar kahenge: Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Allah Sabse Buland hai, aur doosra hissa bhi gir jaayega, aur woh kahenge: Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Allah Sabse Buland hai, aur unke liye darwaze khol diye jaayenge aur woh usmein daakhil ho jaayenge, aur woh maal-e-ganimat ikattha kar rahe honge aur aapas mein baant rahe honge ki ek aawaaz sunayi degi jo kahegi: Yaqeenan, Dajjal aa gaya hai. Aur is tarah woh wahan sab kuch chhodkar wapas laut jaayenge.

e: Thaur b. Zaid has narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Thaur bin Zaid ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You will fight against the Jews and you will kill them until even a stone would say: Come here, Muslim, there is a Jew (hiding himself behind me) ; kill him.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum Yahudiyon se jung karoge aur tum unhe qatal karoge yahan tak ki patthar bhi kahega: Aao, Musalman, yahan ek Yahudi (mere peeche chhupa) hai; use qatal karo.

e: Ubaidullah has reported this hadith with this chain of transmitters (and the Words are): " There is a Jew behind me."
hi: Ubaidullah ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Mere peeche ek Yahudi hai."

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: You and the Jews would fight against one another until a stone would say: Muslim, here is a Jew behind me; come and kill him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum aur Yahudi ek-doosre se jung karoge yahan tak ki patthar kahega: Musalman, yahan mere peeche ek Yahudi hai; aao aur use qatal karo.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Jews will fight against you and you will gain victory over them until the stone would say: Muslim, here is a Jew behind me; kill him.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yahudi tumse jung karenge aur tum unpar jeet haasil karoge yahan tak ki patthar kahega: Musalman, yahan mere peeche ek Yahudi hai; use qatal karo.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The last hour would not come unless the Muslims will fight against the Jews and the Muslims would kill them until the Jews would hide themselves behind a stone or a tree and a stone or a tree would say: Muslim, or the servant of Allah, there is a Jew behind me; come and kill him; but the tree Gharqad would not say, for it is the tree of the Jews.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak Musalman Yahudiyon se jung na karein aur Musalman unhe qatal na kar dein yahan tak ki Yahudi ek patthar ya darakht ke peeche chhup jaayein aur patthar ya darakht kahe: Musalman, ya Allah ke bande, yahan mere peeche ek Yahudi hai; aao aur use qatal karo, lekin Gharqad ka darakht ye nahi kahega, kyunki ye Yahudiyon ka darakht hai.

e: Jabir b. Samura reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Before the Last Hour there would be many liars, and there is an addition in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Ahwas of these words:" I said to him: Did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes."
hi: Jabir bin Samura (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi se pehle bahut se jhoote log honge, aur Abu Ahwas ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein in alfaazon ka izafa hai: "Maine unse kaha: Kya aapne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters. and Simak said: I heard my brother say that jabir had stated: Be on your guard against them.
hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Simak ne kaha: Maine apne bhai ko ye kehte suna ki Jabir ne bataya tha: Un (jhoote logon) se savdhaan raho.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would not come until there would arise about thirty impostors, liars, and each one of them would claim that he is a messenger of Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak taqreeban tees fareb-baaz jhoote na uThen, aur unmein se har ek ye daawa karega ki woh Allah ke Rasool hai.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah reported: We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we happened to pass by children amongst whom there was Ibn Sayyad. The children made their way but Ibn Sayyad kept sitting there (and it seemed) as if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like it (his sitting with the children) and said to him: May your nose he besmeared with dust, don't you bear testimony to the fact that I am the Messenger of Allah? Thereupon he said: No, but you should bear testimony that I am the messenger of Allah. Thereupon 'Umar b. Khattab said: Allah's Messenger, permit me that I should kill him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he is that person who is in your mind (Dajjal ), you will not be able to kill him.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki humaara raasta kuch bachchon se hua, jinmein Ibn Sayyad bhi tha. Bachche titar-bitar ho gaye lekin Ibn Sayyad wahin baitha raha, (aisa lagta tha) jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye napasand aaya (unka bachchon ke saath baithna) aur unhone usse kaha: Teri naak mitti mein sane, kya tu ye gawaahi nahi deta ki main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Isper usne kaha: Nahi, lekin aap ye gawaahi dein ki main Allah ka rasool hoon. Isper Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main use qatal kar dun. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar woh wahi shakhs hai jo tumhaare zehan mein hai (Dajjal), tum use qatal nahi kar paaoge.

e: 'Abdullah reported: We were walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Ibn Sayyad happened to pass by him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: I have concealed for you (something to test you, so tell me that). He said: It is Dukh. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Be off. You cannot get farther than your rank, whereupon 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, permit me to strike his neck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Leave him; if he is that one (Dajjal) whom you apprehend, you will not be able to kill him.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal rahe the ki humaara saamna Ibn Sayyad se hua. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Maine tumhaare liye (kuch tumhaari pareeksha lene ke liye) chhupaaya hai (mujhe bataao ki woh kya hai). Usne kaha: Ye "Dukh" hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Chale jaao. Tum apne darje se aage nahi badh sakte, isper Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main uski gardan maar dun. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Use chhod do; agar woh wahi (Dajjal) hai jiska tumhe khadka hai, tum use qatal nahi kar paaoge.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met him (Ibn Sayyad) and so did Abu Bakr and 'Umar on some of the roads of Medina. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you bear testimony to the fact that I am the Messenger of Allah? Thereupon he said: Do you bear testimony to the fact that I am the messenger of Allah? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I affirm my faith in Allah and in His Angels and in His Books, and what do you see? He said: I see the throne over water. Whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You see the throne of Iblis upon the water, and what else do you see? He said: I see two truthfuls and a liar or two liars and one truthful. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Leave him He has been confounded.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki (Ibn Sayyad se) mulaqaat hui, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi Madina ke kuch raaston mein unse mile. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kya tum gawaahi dete ho ki main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Isper usne kaha: Kya aap gawaahi dete hain ki main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main Allah par, Uske Farishton par aur Uski Kitaabon par apna imaan pushT karta hoon, aur tumhe kya dikhta hai? Usne kaha: Main Arsh ko paani ke upar dekhta hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum Iblis ka takht paani par dekhte ho, aur aur kya dekhte ho? Usne kaha: Main do sachche aur ek jhoota dekhta hoon, ya do jhoote aur ek sachcha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ise chhod do. Woh uljh gaya hai.

e: Jabir b 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met Ibn Sa'id (Sayyad) and there were with him Abu Bakr and 'Umar and Ibn Sayyad was in the company of children. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Ibn Sayyad se mulaqaat hui aur unke saath Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi the aur Ibn Sayyad bachchon ki sohbat mein tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id reported: I accompanied Ibn Sayyad to Mecca and he said to me: What I have gathered from people is that they think that I am Dajjal. Have you not heard Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) as saying: He will have no children, I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said: But I have children. Have you not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He would not enter Mecca and Medina? I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said I have been once in Medina and now I intend to go to Mecca. And he said to me at the end of his talk: By Allah, I know his place of birth his abode where he is just now. He (Abu Sa'id) said: This caused confusion in my mind (in regard to his identity).
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Ibn Sayyad ke saath Makkah gaya aur usne mujhse kaha: Logon se maine jo samjha hai woh ye hai ki woh mujhe Dajjal maante hain. Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate nahi suna: Uski koi aulad nahi hogi? Maine kaha: Haan, zaroor. Isper usne kaha: Lekin mere bachche hain. Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate nahi suna: Woh Makkah aur Madina mein daakhil nahi hoga? Maine kaha: Haan, zaroor. Isper usne kaha: Main ek baar Madina mein tha aur ab Makkah jaane ka iraada rakhta hoon. Aur usne apni baat ke ant mein mujhse kaha: Allah ki qasam, main uski paidaish ki jagah jaanta hoon, uska Thikaana bhi jaanta hoon jahan woh abhi hai. Unhone (Abu Sa'id ne) kaha: Isse mere zehan mein uljhan paida hui (uski asli pehchaan ke baare mein).

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported: Ibn Sa'id said to me something for which I felt ashamed. He said: I can excuse others; but what has gone wrong with you, O Companions of Muhammad, that you take me as Dajjal? Has Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) not said that he would be a Jew whereas I am a Muslim and he also said that he would not have children, whereas I have children, and he also said: verily, Allah has prohibited him to enter Mecca whereas I have performed Pilgrimage, and he went on saying this that I was about to be impressed by his talk. He (however) said this also: I know where he (Dajjal) is and I know his father and mother, and it was said to him: Won't you feel pleased if you would be the same person? Thereupon he said: If this offer is made to me, I would not resent that.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ibn Sa'id ne mujhse kuch aisa kaha jisse mujhe sharm mehsoos hui. Usne kaha: Main doosron ko maaf kar sakta hoon; lekin, aye Muhammad ke Sahaba, tumhe kya hua hai ki tum mujhe Dajjal maante ho? Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye nahi farmaaya ki woh Yahudi hoga jabki main Musalman hoon, aur unhone ye bhi farmaaya ki uski koi aulad nahi hogi, jabki mere bachche hain, aur unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne use Makkah mein daakhil hone se mana kiya hai jabki maine Hajj kiya hai, aur usne ye baaten kehte rehte huye mujhpar aisa asar Daala ki main uski baaton se prabhavit hone hi waala tha. Unhone (usne), halaanki, ye bhi kaha: Main jaanta hoon ki woh (Dajjal) kahan hai aur main uske maa-baap ko bhi jaanta hoon, aur usse poocha gaya: Kya tumhe achha nahi lagega agar tum khud hi woh shakhs ho? Isper usne kaha: Agar mujhe ye pesh kiya jaaye, to mujhe koi aitraaz nahi hoga.

e: Abu Sa`id al-Khudri reported: We came back after having performed Pilgrimage or `Umra and lbn Sa'id was along with us. And we encamped at a place and the people dispersed and I and he were left behind. I felt terribly frightend from him as it was said about him that he was the Dajjal. He brought his goods and placed them by my luggage and I said: It is intense heat. Would you not place that under that tree? And he did that. Then there appeared before us a flock of sheep. He went and brought a cup of milk and said: Abu Sa`id, drink that. I said it is intense heat and the milk is also hot (whereas the fact was) that I did not like to drink from his hands or to take it from his hand and he said: Abu Sa`id, I think that I should take a rope and suspend it by the tree and then commit suicide because of the talks of the people, and he further said. Abu Sa`id he who is ignorant of the saying of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (he is to be pardoned), but O people of Ansar, is this hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) concealed from you whereas you have the best knowledge of the hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst people? Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not say that he (Dajjal) would be a non believer whereas I am a believer? Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not say he would be barren and no child would be born to him, whereas I have left my children in Medina? Did Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) not say: He would not get into Medina and Mecca whereas I have been coming from Medina and now I intend to go to Mecca? Abu Sa`id said: I was about to accept the excuse put forward by him. Then he said: I know the place where he would be born and where he is now. So I said to him: May your whole day be spent.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Hajj ya Umra karke wapas aa rahe the aur Ibn Sa'id humaare saath tha. Aur hum ek jagah rukTe the aur log titar-bitar ho gaye aur main aur woh peeche reh gaye. Main usse bahut dara hua tha kyunki uske baare mein kaha jaata tha ki woh Dajjal hai. Woh apna saamaan laaya aur mere saamaan ke paas rakh diya aur maine kaha: Garmi bahut hai. Kya tum ise us darakht ke neeche nahi rakhoge? Aur usne aisa kiya. Phir humaare saamne bakriyon ka ek jhund aaya. Woh gaya aur doodh ka ek pyaala laaya aur kaha: Abu Sa'id, ye peeyo. Maine kaha ki garmi bahut hai aur doodh bhi garam hai (jabki asal baat ye thi) ki mujhe uske haath se peena pasand nahi tha ya uske haath se lena pasand nahi tha, aur usne kaha: Abu Sa'id, mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe ek rassi lekar use darakht se latka dena chahiye aur logon ki baaton ki wajah se khudkushi kar leni chahiye, aur usne ye bhi kaha: Abu Sa'id, jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baat ka ilm nahi hai (use maafi hai), lekin, aye Ansar ke logo, kya ye hadees tumse chhupi hui hai jabki tum logon mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hadees ka sabse achha ilm rakhte ho? Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye nahi farmaaya ki woh (Dajjal) gair-imaandaar hoga jabki main momin hoon? Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye nahi farmaaya ki woh baanjh hoga aur uske koi bachche nahi honge, jabki maine apne bachche Madina mein chhoDe hain? Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye nahi farmaaya: Woh Madina aur Makkah mein daakhil nahi hoga, jabki main Madina se aa raha hoon aur ab Makkah jaane ka iraada rakhta hoon? Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main uska ye uzr qubool karne hi waala tha. Phir usne kaha: Main jaanta hoon woh jagah jahan woh paida hoga aur woh jagah jahan woh abhi hai. Isliye maine usse kaha: Tera poora din barbaad ho.

e: This hadith has transmitted on the authority of Abu Sa'id that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Ibn Sa'id about the earth of Paradise. Thereupon he said: Abu'l-Qasim, It is like a fine white musk, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: 'You have told the the truth.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ibn Sa'id se Jannat ki mitti ke baare mein poocha. Isper usne kaha: Abu'l-Qasim, ye safed mushk jaisi baariki wali hai, isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Tumne sach kaha.

e: Abu Sa'id reported that Ibn Sayyad asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the earth of Paradise. Whereupon he said: It is like white shining pure musk.
hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Sayyad ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Jannat ki mitti ke baare mein poocha. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye safed, chamakdaar, shuddh mushk jaisi hai.

e: 'Muhammad b. Munkadir reported: As I saw Jabir b. 'Abdullah taking an oath in the name of Allah that it was Ibn Sa'id who was the Dajjal I said: Do you take an oath in the name of Allah? Thereupon he said: I heard 'Umar taking an oath in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to this effect but Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not disapprove of it.
hi: Muhammad bin Munkadir ne bayan kiya: Jab maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko Allah ke naam par qasam khaate dekha ki ye Ibn Sa'id hi Dajjal hai, maine kaha: Kya aap Allah ke naam par qasam khaate hain? Isper unhone kaha: Maine Umar ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein isi tarah qasam khaate suna, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne iska koi virodh nahi kiya.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported: 'Umar b. Khattab went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the company of some persons to Ibn Sayyad that he found him playing with children near the battlement of Bani Maghala and Ibn Sayyad was at that time just at the threshold of adolescence and he did not perceive (the presence of Holy Prophet) until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) struck his back with his hands. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Ibn Sayyad, don't you bear witness that I am the messenger of Allah? Ibn Sayyad looked toward him and he said: I bear witness to the fact that you the messenger of the unlettered. Ibn Sayyad said to the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Do you bear witness to the fact that I am the messenger of Allah? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rejected this and said: I affirm my faith in Allah and in His messengers. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: What do you see? Ibn Sayyad said: It is a Dukh. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May you be disgraced and dishonoured, you would not not be able to go beyond your rank. 'Umar b. Khattab said: Allah's Messenger, permit me that I should strike his neck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he is the same (Dajjal) who would appear near the Last Hour, you would not be able to overpower him, and if he is not that there is no good for you to kill him. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar further narrated that after some time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Ubayy b. Ka'b went towards the palm trees where Ibn Sayyad was. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went near the tree he hid himself behind a tree with the intention of hearing something from Ibn sayyad before Ibn Sayyad could see him, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him on a bed with a blanket around him from which a murmuring sound was being heard and Ibn Sayyad's mother saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) behind the trunk of the palm tree. She said to Ibn Sayyad: Saf (that being his name), here is Muhammad. Thereupon Ibn Sayyad jumped up murmuring and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If she had left him alone he would have made things clear. Abdullah b. Umar told that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up amongst the people and lauded Allah as He deserved, then he made a mention of the Dajjal and said: I warn you of him and there is no Prophet who has not warned his people against the Dajjal. Even Noah warned (against him) but I am going to tell you a thing which no Prophet told his people. You must know that he (the Dajjal) is one-eyed and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, is not one-eyed. Ibn Shihab said: 'Umar b. Thabit al-Ansari informed me that some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed him that the day when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) warned people against the Dajjal, he also said: There would be written between his two eyes (the word) Kafir (infidel) and everyone who would resent his deeds would be able to read or every Muslim would be about to read, and he also said: Bear this thing in mind that none amongst you would be able to see Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, until he dies.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath kuch logon ki sohbat mein Ibn Sayyad ke paas gaye aur unhone use Banu Maghala ke burj ke qareeb bachchon ke saath khelte paaya, aur Ibn Sayyad us waqt bilkul jawaan hone ke kagaar par tha aur usne (Pavitr Nabi ki maujoodgi) tab tak mehsoos nahi ki jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haathon se uski peeth par thapthapaaya nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ibn Sayyad, kya tum gawaahi nahi dete ki main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Ibn Sayyad ne unki taraf dekha aur kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki aap na-padhe likhe logon ke Rasool hain. Ibn Sayyad ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Kya aap gawaahi dete hain ki main Allah ka Rasool hoon? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise mana kiya aur kaha: Main Allah aur Uske Rasoolon par apna imaan pushT karta hoon. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Tumhe kya dikhta hai? Ibn Sayyad ne kaha: Ye "Dukh" hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tujhe zillat aur apmaan mile, tu apne darje se aage nahi badh sakta. Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe ijazat dijiye ki main uski gardan maar dun. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar woh wahi (Dajjal) hai jo Aakhri Ghadi ke qareeb pragat hoga, tum usse jeet nahi paaoge, aur agar woh woh nahi hai, to tumhaare liye use qatal karne ka koi faayda nahi hai. Abdullah bin Umar ne aage riwayat ki ki kuch waqt baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Ubayy bin Ka'b khajoor ke darakhton ki taraf gaye jahan Ibn Sayyad tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) darakht ke qareeb pahunche, woh ek darakht ke peeche chhup gaye taaki Ibn Sayyad ke unhe dekhne se pehle woh Ibn Sayyad se kuch sun sakein, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use ek bistar par dekha jispar ek kambal lipta hua tha jismein se ek gungunaahat ki aawaaz aa rahi thi, aur Ibn Sayyad ki maa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khajoor ke tane ke peeche dekh liya. Usne Ibn Sayyad se kaha: Saf (uska naam), ye rahe Muhammad. Isper Ibn Sayyad gungunaate hue uchhal padha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar usne use akela chhod diya hota, woh cheezein saaf kar deta. Abdullah bin Umar ne bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon ke beech khade huye aur Allah ki jaisi hamd honi chahiye waisi ki, phir unhone Dajjal ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Main tumhe uske baare mein chetaavni deta hoon aur koi bhi Nabi nahi hai jisne apni Ummat ko Dajjal ke khilaaf chetaavni na di ho. Nuh ne bhi (uske khilaaf) chetaavni di thi lekin main tumhe ek aisi baat bataane wala hoon jo kisi Nabi ne apni Ummat ko nahi bataayi. Tumhe pata hona chahiye ki woh (Dajjal) ek-aankh wala hai aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ek-aankh wala nahi hai. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Umar bin Thabit al-Ansari ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne unhe bataya ki jis din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ko Dajjal ke khilaaf chetaavni di, unhone ye bhi farmaaya: Uski donon aankhon ke beech (lafz) "Kafir" likha hoga aur jo bhi uske amalon se pareshaan ho use ise padh lena chahiye ya har Musalman ise padh sakega, aur unhone ye bhi farmaaya: Ye baat apne zehan mein rakho ki tum mein se koi bhi Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ko tab tak nahi dekh paayega jab tak uski maut na ho jaaye.

e: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went along with him in the company of some persons and there was Umar b. Khattab also amongst them till they saw Ibn Sayyad as a young boy just on the threshold of adolescence playing with children near the battlement of Bani Mu'awiya; the rest of the hadith is the same but with these concluding words: " Had his mother left him (to murmur) his matter would have become clear."
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuch logon ki sohbat mein unke saath gaye aur unmein Umar bin Khattab bhi the, yahan tak ki unhone Ibn Sayyad ko ek jawaan larke ke soorat mein bachchon ke saath Banu Muawiya ke burj ke qareeb khelte dekha; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin in samaapti alfaazon ke saath: "Agar uski maa ne use (gungunaate hue) chhod diya hota, uska maamla saaf ho gaya hota."

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by Ibn Sayyad along with his Companions including 'Umar b. Khattab as he was playing with children near the battlement of Bani Maghala and he was also a child by that time. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Ibn Umar (in which there is a mention of) setting out of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with Ubayy b. Ka'b towards the date-palm trees.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne Sahaba, jinmein Umar bin Khattab bhi shaamil the, ke saath Ibn Sayyad ke paas se guzre jab woh Banu Maghala ke burj ke qareeb bachchon ke saath khel raha tha, aur woh us waqt khud bhi ek bachcha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki (jismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Ubayy bin Ka'b ke saath khajoor ke darakhton ki taraf nikalne ka zikr hai).

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar met Ibn Si'id on some of the paths of Medina and he said to him a word which enraged him and he was so much swollen with anger that the way was blocked. Ibn 'Umar went to Hafsa and informed her about this. Thereupon she said: May Allah have mercy upon you, why did you incite Ibn Sayyad in spite of the fact that you knew it would be the extreme anger which would make Dajjal appear in the world?
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ki Madina ke kisi raaste par Ibn Sayyad se mulaqaat hui aur unhone usse aisi baat kahi jisse woh gusse mein aa gaya aur itna phoola ki raasta hi ruk gaya. Ibn Umar Hafsa (RA) ke paas gaye aur unhe iski jaankaari di. Isper unhone kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare, tumne Ibn Sayyad ko kyun uksaaya jabki tumhe pata tha ki uski shadeed gussa hi Dajjal ko duniya mein zaahir karega?

e: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar said: I met lbn Sayyad twice and said to some of them (his friends): You state that it was he (the Dajjal). He said: By Allah, it is not so. I said: You have not told me the truth; by Allah some of you informed me that he would not die until he would have the largest number of offspring and huge wealth and it is he about whom it is thought so. Then Ibn Sayyad talked to us. I then departed and met him again for the second time and his eye had been swollen. I said: What has happened to your eye? He said: I do not know. I said: This is in your head and you do not know about it? He said: If Allah so wills He can create it (eye) in your staff. He then produced a sound like the braying of a donkey. Some of my companions thought that I had struck him with the staff as he was with me that the staff broke into pieces, but, by Allah, I was not conscious of it. He then came to the Mother of the Faithful (Hafsa) and narrated it to her and she said: What concern you have with him? Don't you know that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that the first thing (by the incitement of which) he would come out before the public would be his anger?
hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Ibn Umar ne kaha: Main do baar Ibn Sayyad se mila aur apne kuch (dostoon) se kaha: Tum log ye kehte ho ki woh (Dajjal) hai. Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, aisa nahi hai. Maine kaha: Tumne mujhse sach nahi kaha; Allah ki qasam, tum mein se kisi ne mujhe bataya tha ki woh tab tak nahi marega jab tak uski sabse zyada aulad aur bahut zyada daulat na ho jaaye aur yahi uske baare mein socha jaata hai. Phir Ibn Sayyad ne humse baat ki. Main phir chala gaya aur usse doosri baar mila aur uski aankh sooji hui thi. Maine kaha: Tumhaari aankh ko kya hua? Usne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata. Maine kaha: Ye tumhaare sar mein hai aur tumhe iska pata nahi? Usne kaha: Agar Allah chaahe to Woh ise (aankh ko) tumhaari lakdi mein bhi paida kar sakte hain. Phir usne gadhe ki bang jaisi aawaaz nikaali. Mere kuch saathiyon ko laga ki maine use apni lakdi se maara hai jab woh mere saath tha aur lakdi Tukdon mein toot gayi, lekin, Allah ki qasam, mujhe iska koi hosh nahi tha. Woh phir Imaandaaron ki Maa (Hafsa) ke paas gaye aur unhe ye riwayat ki aur unhone kaha: Tumhe usse kya lena-dena hai? Kya tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha ki pehli cheez jiski wajah se woh (Dajjal) logon ke saamne zaahir hoga woh uska gussa hoga?

e: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). made a mention of Dajjal in the presence of the people and said: Allah is not one-eyed and behold that Dajjal is blind of the right eye and his eye would be like a floating grape.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ki maujoodgi mein Dajjal ka zikr kiya aur farmaaya: Allah ek-aankh wala nahi hai aur dekho, Dajjal daayi aankh se andha hoga aur uski aankh (angoor ki tarah) ubhri hui hogi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is never a prophet who has not warned the Ummah of that one-eyed liar; behold he is one-eyed and your Lord is not one-eyed. On his forehead are the letters k f. r. (Kafir).
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aisa koi Nabi nahi hai jisne apni Ummat ko us ek-aankh wale jhoote se chetaavni na di ho; dekho, woh ek-aankh wala hai aur tumhaara Rab ek-aankh wala nahi hai. Uski peshaani par (Arabi mein) K F R (Kafir) likha hoga.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There would be written three letters k. f. r., i. e. Kafir, between the eyes of the Dajjal.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal ki donon aankhon ke beech teen huroof likhe honge, K F R, yaani Kafir.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Dajjal is blind of one eye and there is written between his eyes the word" Kafir". He then spelled the word as k. f. r., which every Muslim would be able to read.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal ek-aankh se andha hai aur uski donon aankhon ke beech "Kafir" lafz likha hoga. Phir unhone huroof alag-alag bataaye - K F R - jise har Musalman padh paayega.

e: Hudhaifa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Dajjal is blind of left eye with thick hair and there would be a garden and fire with him and his fire would be a garden and his garden would be fire.
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal baayi aankh se andha hai, ghane baalon wala, aur uske saath ek baag aur aag hogi aur uski aag ek baag jaisi hogi aur uska baag aag jaisa hoga.

e:
It was narrated that Hudhaifah said: The Messenger of Allah said: 'I know what the Dajjal will have with him. He will have two
flowing rivers, one that appears to the eye to be clear water, and one that appears to the eye to be flaming fire. If anyone sees that, let him go to the river which he thinks is fire and close his eyes, then lower his head and drink
from it, for it is cool water. The Dajjal has one blind eye, with a layer of thick skin over it, and between his eyes is written "disbeliever," which every believer
will read, whether he is literate or
illiterate.'
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhe pata hai Dajjal ke paas kya hoga. Uske paas do bahti nadiyaan hongi, ek jo aankhon ko saaf paani jaisi lagegi aur doosri jo aankhon ko dahakti aag jaisi lagegi. Agar koi ye dekhe, use us nadi ki taraf jaana chahiye jise woh aag samajhta hai aur apni aankhein band kar leni chahiye, phir apna sar jhukaakar usmein se peena chahiye, kyunki ye Thanda paani hoga. Dajjal ki ek aankh andhi hai jispar ek moti khaal ki parat hai, aur uski donon aankhon ke beech "gair-imaandaar" likha hoga, jise har momin padh paayega, chahe woh padha-likha ho ya na ho.

e: Hudhaifa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: the Dajjal would have with him water and fire and his fire would have the effect of cold water and his water would have the effect of fire, so don't put yourself to ruin. Abu Mas'ud reported: I also heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Hudhaifa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Dajjal ke saath paani aur aag hogi aur uski aag ka asar Thande paani jaisa hoga aur uske paani ka asar aag jaisa hoga, isliye khud ko barbaad mat karo. Abu Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Maine bhi ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hai.

e: 'Uqba b. 'Amr Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported: I went to Hudhaifa b. Yaman and said to him: Narrate what you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to the Dajjal. He said that the Dajjal would appear and there would be along with him water and fire and what the people would see as water that would be fire and that would burn and what would appear as fire that would be water and any one of you who would see that should plunge in that which he sees as fire for it would be sweet, pure water, and 'Uqba said: I also heard it, testifying Hudhaifa.
hi: Uqba bin Amr Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Hudhaifa bin Yaman ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: Jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dajjal ke baare mein suna hai woh mujhe riwayat kijiye. Unhone kaha ki Dajjal pragat hoga aur uske saath paani aur aag honge, aur log jise paani samjhenge woh asal mein aag hogi jo jala degi, aur jise woh aag samjhenge woh asal mein paani hoga, aur tum mein se jo koi ye dekhe use us cheez mein kood padna chahiye jise woh aag samjhta hai kyunki ye meetha, shuddh paani hoga, aur Uqba ne kaha: Maine bhi ise suna hai, Hudhaifa ki gawaahi dete hue.

e: Hudhaifa and Ibn Mas'ud met together. Hudhaifa said: I know more than you as to what there would be along with the Dajjal. There would be along with him two canals (one flowing with water) and the other one (having) fire (within it), and what you would see as fire would be water and what you would see as water would be fire. So he who amongst you is able to see that and is desirous of water should drink out of that which he sees as fire.
hi: Hudhaifa aur Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ek saath mile. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Mujhe tumse zyada pata hai ki Dajjal ke saath kya hoga. Uske saath do naaliyaan hongi (ek paani ki aur doosri) aag ki, aur jise tum aag samjhoge woh paani hogi aur jise tum paani samjhoge woh aag hogi. Isliye tum mein se jo ise dekh sake aur paani chaahta ho, use us se peena chahiye jise woh aag samajhta hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: May I not inform you about the Dajjal what no Apostle of Allah narrated to his people? He would be blind and he would bring along with him an Image of Paradise and Hell-Fire and what he would call as Paradise that would be Hell-Fire and I warn you as Noah warned his people.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Kya main tumhe Dajjal ke baare mein woh na bataun jo kisi Nabi ne apni qaum ko nahi bataya? Woh andha hoga aur apne saath Jannat aur Jahannam ki tasveer laayega aur jise woh Jannat kahega woh asal mein Jahannam hogi, aur main tumhe (uske baare mein) chetaavni deta hoon jaise Nuh ne apni qaum ko di thi.

e:
An-Nawwas b. Sam`an reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a mention of the Dajjal one day in the morning. He (ﷺ) sometimes described him to be insignificant and sometimes described (his turmoil) as very significant (and we felt) as if he were in the cluster of the date-palm trees. When we went to him (to the Holy Prophet) in the evening and he read (the signs of fear) in our faces, he (ﷺ) said: What is the matter with you? We said: Allah's Messenger, you made a mention of the Dajjal in the morning (sometimes describing him) to be insignificant and sometimes very important, until we began to think as if he were present in some (near) part of the cluster of the date-palm trees. Thereupon he (ﷺ) said: I harbor fear in regard to you in so many other things besides the Dajjal. If he comes forth while I am among you, I shall contend with him on your behalf, but if he comes forth while I am not amongst you, a man must contend on his own behalf and Allah would take care of every Muslim on my behalf (and safeguard him against his evil). He (Dajjal) would be a young man with twisted, contracted hair, and a blind eye. I compare him to `Abd-ul-`Uzza b. Qatan. He who amongst you would survive to see him should recite over him the opening verses of Sura Kahf (xviii). He would appear on the way between Syria and Iraq and would spread mischief right and left. O servant of Allah! adhere (to the path of Truth). We said: Allah's Messenger, how long would he stay on the earth? He (ﷺ) said: For forty days, one day like a year and one day like a month and one day like a week and the rest of the days would be like your days. We said: Allah's Messenger, would one day's prayer suffice for the prayers of day equal to one year? Thereupon he (ﷺ) said: No, but you must make an estimate of time (and then observe prayer). We said: Allah's Messenger, how quickly would he walk upon the earth? Thereupon he (ﷺ) said: Like cloud driven by the wind. He would come to the people and invite them (to a wrong religion) and they would affirm their faith in him and respond to him. He would then give command to the sky and there would be rainfall upon the earth and it would grow crops. Then in the evening, their pasturing animals would come to them with their humps very high and their udders full of milk and their flanks stretched. He would then come to another people and invite them. But they would reject him and he would go away from them and there would be drought for them and nothing would be left with them in the form of wealth. 
He would then walk through the waste land and say to it: Bring forth your treasures, and the treasures would come out and collect (themselves) before him like the swarm of bees. He would then call a person brimming with youth and strike him with the sword and cut him into two pieces and (make these pieces lie at a distance which is generally) between the archer and his target. He would then call (that young man) and he will come forward laughing with his face gleaming (with happiness) and it would be at this very time that Allah would send Jesus, son of Mary, and he will descend at the white minaret in the eastern side of Damascus wearing two garments lightly dyed with saffron and placing his hands on the wings of two Angels. When he would lower his head, there would fall beads of perspiration from his head, and when he would raise it up, beads like pearls would scatter from it. Every non-believer who would smell the odor of his self would die and his breath would reach as far as he would be able to see. He would then search for him (Dajjal) until he would catch hold of him at the gate of Ludd and would kill him. Then a people whom Allah had protected would come to Jesus, son of Mary, and he would wipe their faces and would inform them of their ranks in Paradise and it would be under such conditions that Allah would reveal to Jesus these words: I have brought forth from amongst My servants such people against whom none would be able to fight; you take these people safely to Tur. And then Allah would send Gog and Magog and they would swarm down from every slope. The first of them would pass the lake of Tiberias and drink out of it. And when the last of them would pass, he would say: There was once water there. Jesus and his companions would then be besieged here (at Tur, and they would be so much hard pressed) that the head of the ox would be dearer to them than one hundred dinars and Allah's Apostle, Jesus, and his companions would supplicate Allah, Who would send to them insects (which would attack their necks) and in the morning they would perish like one single person. Allah's Apostle, Jesus, and his companions would then come down to the earth and they would not find in the earth as much space as a single span which is not filled with their putrefaction and stench. Allah's Apostle, Jesus, and his companions would then again beseech Allah, Who would send birds whose necks would be like those of Bactrian camels and they would carry them and throw them where God would will. 
Then Allah would send rain which no house of clay or (the tent of) camels' hairs would keep out and it would wash away the earth until it could appear to be a mirror. Then the earth would be told to bring forth its fruit and restore its blessing and, as a result thereof, there would grow (such a big) pomegranate that a group of persons would be able to eat that, and seek shelter under its skin and milch cow would give so much milk that a whole party would be able to drink it. And the milch camel would give such (a large quantity of) milk that the whole tribe would be able to drink out of that and the milch sheep would give so much milk that the whole family would be able to drink out of that and at that time Allah would send a pleasant wind which would soothe (people) even under their armpits, and would take the life of every Muslim and only the wicked would survive who would commit adultery like asses and the Last Hour would come to them.
hi: Nawwas bin Sam'an (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din subah Dajjal ka zikr kiya. Kabhi unhone use mamuli batAya aur kabhi itna sangin batAya (ki humein laga) jaise woh khajoor ke darakhton ke jhund mein hi hai. Jab hum shaam ko unke paas gaye aur unhone humaare chehron par (khauf) padha, unhone farmaaya: Tumhe kya hua? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne subah Dajjal ka zikr (kabhi) mamuli aur (kabhi) bahut sangin taur par kiya, yahan tak ki humein laga jaise woh khajoor ke jhund ke kisi (nazdeeki) hisse mein maujood hai. Isper unhone farmaaya: Dajjal ke ilaawa doosri bahut si baaton se mujhe tumhaare baare mein dar hai. Agar woh mere jeevit rehte pragat hota hai, main tumhaari taraf se usse jhagdunga, lekin agar woh mere na rehte hue pragat hota hai, to har shakhs ko khud apni taraf se usse jhagadna hoga aur Allah mere taraf se har Musalman ki hifaazat karega. Woh (Dajjal) ghungharaale, gunthe baalon wala jawaan hoga aur ek-aankh se andha hoga. Main uski tulna Abd-ul-Uzza bin Qatan se karta hoon. Tum mein se jo bhi zinda rahe aur use dekhe, use uske saamne Sura Kahf ki shuruaati aayaten padhni chahiye. Woh Syria aur Iraq ke raaste par pragat hoga aur daaye-baaye fitna phailaayega. Aye Allah ke bande! (Sach ke raaste par) kaayam raho. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh zameen par kitne din rahega? Unhone farmaaya: Chaalis din, ek din ek saal jaisa aur ek din ek mahine jaisa aur ek din ek hafte jaisa aur baaki din tumhaare aam dinon jaise. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya us ek saal jaise din ki namaz humaare (aam) ek din ki namaz ke liye kaafi hogi? Isper unhone farmaaya: Nahi, balki tumhe waqt ka andaaza lagaakar (namaz padhni chahiye). Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh zameen par kitni tezi se chalega? Isper unhone farmaaya: Hawa se chalte badal jaisi. Woh logon ke paas aayega aur unhe (galat deen ki taraf) bulaayega aur woh usper imaan la aayenge aur usse jawaab denge. Woh phir aasmaan ko hukum dega aur zameen par baarish hogi aur ismein fasal ugegi. Phir shaam ko unke jaanwar unke paas aayenge, unke koohan bahut oonche aur unke thann doodh se bhare, aur unke pehlu phaile hue. Phir woh doosre logon ke paas aayega aur unhe bulaayega. Lekin woh use jhutlaayenge aur woh unse door chala jaayega aur unke liye akaal aayega aur unke paas koi maal nahi bachega. Phir woh viraan zameen se guzrega aur usse kahega: Apna khazana zaahir kar, aur khazana bahar aayega aur uske saamne is tarah ikattha hoga jaise madhu-makkhiyon ka jhund. Phir woh ek bharpoor jawaani wale shakhs ko bulaayega aur talwaar se use maarkar do tukdon mein kaat dega aur (ye tukde) itni doori par honge jitni ek teerandaaz aur uske nishaane ke beech hoti hai. Phir woh (us jawaan shakhs ko) bulaayega aur woh hasta hua, chamakte chehre ke saath aage aayega, aur isi waqt Allah Isa, Mary ke bete, ko bhejenge aur woh Damascus ke poorab mein safed minaar par utrenge, halke zaafraan-rang ke do kapde pehne hue, apne haath do Farishton ke pankhon par rakhkar. Jab woh apna sar jhukaayenge, pasine ki boondein unke sar se girengi, aur jab woh use uThAyenge, moti jaisi boondein bikhrengi. Har gair-imaandaar jo unki khushboo sunghega woh mar jaayega, aur unki saans wahan tak pahunchegi jahan tak unki nazar jaayegi. Phir woh use (Dajjal ko) talaash karenge yahan tak ki Lud ke darwaze par use pakad lenge aur use qatal kar denge. Phir woh log jinhe Allah ne bachaya, Isa, Mary ke bete, ke paas aayenge aur woh unke chehron ko ponchhte aur unhe Jannat mein unka darja bataate, aur isi haalat mein Allah, Isa par ye wahi nazil karenge: Maine Apne bandon mein se aise log paida kiye hain jinse koi bhi laD nahi paayega; tum in logon ko mahfooz taur par Tur pahunchaao. Aur phir Allah, Yajuj-Majuj ko bhejenge aur woh har oonchai se giroh-dar-giroh utar padenge. Unmein se pehla Tiberias ki jheel se guzrega aur usmein se pi lega. Aur jab unmein se aakhri guzrega, woh kahega: Yahan kabhi paani hua karta tha. Isa aur unke saathi phir yahan (Tur mein) ghere jaayenge, (aur itna dabaav paayenge) ki ek bael ka sar unke liye sau dinar se zyada aziz hoga, aur Allah ke Rasool Isa aur unke saathi Allah se dua karenge, Jo unpar keede-makode bhejenge (jo unki gardanon par hamla karenge) aur subah tak woh ek hi shakhs jaise barbaad ho jaayenge. Allah ke Rasool Isa aur unke saathi phir zameen par utrenge aur unhe zameen par itni jagah bhi nahi milegi jitni ek baalisht mein na ho jo unke sad-gale badan aur badbu se bhari na ho. Allah ke Rasool Isa aur unke saathi phir dobara Allah se dua karenge, Jo parinde bhejenge jinki gardanein Bactrian oonton jaisi hongi, aur woh unhe uThAkar wahan phenkenge jahan Allah chaahenge. Phir Allah baarish bhejenge jise koi mitti ka ghar ya oonton ke baalon ka tambu na rok paayega, aur ye zameen ko dho degi yahan tak ki ye ek darpan jaisi lagegi. Phir zameen se kaha jaayega ki woh apna phal zaahir kare aur apni barkat wapas laaye, aur iske natije mein itna bada anaar ugega ki logon ka ek giroh use khaa payega aur uske chhilke ke neeche panah lega, aur ek doodharu gaay itna doodh degi ki ek poora giroh use pee paayega, aur ek doodharu oontni itna doodh degi ki poora qabila use pee paayega aur ek doodharu bhed itna doodh degi ki poora khaandaan use pee paayega, aur us waqt Allah ek khushboodaar hawa bhejenge jo (logon ko) unke baghal ke neeche tak sukoon degi aur har Musalman ki jaan le legi aur sirf badkaar log bacha rahenge jo gadhon ki tarah khulle-aam zina karenge aur Aakhri Ghadi unpar aayegi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition that Gog and Magog would walk until they would reach the mountain of al-Khamar and it is a mountain of Bait-ul-Maqdis and they would say: We have killed those who are upon the earth. Let us now kill those who are In the sky and they would throw their arrows towards the sky and the arrows would return to them besmeared with blood. And in the narration of Ibn Hujr (the words are):" I have sent such persons (Gog and Magog) that none would dare fight against them.
hi: Ye hadees Jabir (RA) ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki Yajuj-Majuj chalte rahenge yahan tak ki woh al-Khamar pahaad tak pahunchein aur ye Bait-ul-Maqdis ka ek pahaad hai, aur woh kahenge: Humne zameen par jo hai use qatal kar diya hai. Ab hum aasmaan mein jo hai use bhi qatal karein, aur woh apne teer aasmaan ki taraf phenkenge aur teer khoon mein sane hue wapas aayenge. Aur Ibn Hujr ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Maine aise log (Yajuj-Majuj) bheje hain jinke khilaaf koi jung karne ki himmat nahi karega.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day gave a detailed account of the Dajjal and in that it was also included: He would come but would not be allowed to enter the mountain passes to Medina. So he will alight at some of the barren tracts near Medina, and a person who would be the best of men or one from amongst the best of men would say to him: I bear testimony to the fact that you are Dajjal about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had informed us. The Dajjal would say: What is your opinion if I kill this (person), then I bring him back to life; even then will you harbour doubt in this matter? They would say: No. He would then kill (the man) and then bring him back to life. When he would bring that person to life, he would say: By Allah, I had no better proof of the fact (that you are a Dajjal) than at the present time (that you are actually so). The Dajjal would then make an attempt to kill him (again) but he would not be able to do that. Abu Ishaq reported that it was said: That person would be Khadir (Allah be pleased with him).
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek din Dajjal ka vistrit varnan kiya aur usmein ye bhi shaamil tha: Woh aayega lekin use Madina ke galiyon mein daakhil hone ki ijazat nahi milegi. Isliye woh Madina ke qareeb kisi banjar ilaake mein utrega, aur ek shakhs jo logon mein sabse behtareen honga, ya behtareen logon mein se ek, usse kahega: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki tum wahi Dajjal ho jiske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya tha. Dajjal kahega: Tumhaari kya raay hai agar main ise (is shakhs ko) qatal kar dun aur phir use dobara zinda kar dun; kya tab bhi tum ismein shak karoge? Woh kahenge: Nahi. Woh phir use (shakhs ko) qatal karega aur dobara zinda kar dega. Jab woh us shakhs ko dobara zinda karega, woh kahega: Allah ki qasam, mujhe is baat ka (yaani ye ki tum Dajjal ho) is waqt se zyada pukhta yaqeen kabhi nahi mila. Dajjal phir use (dobara) qatal karne ki koshish karega lekin woh aisa nahi kar paayega. Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya ki kaha jaata hai ki woh shakhs Khadir (unpar Allah ki shaanti ho) honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Dajjal would come forth and a person from amongst the believers would go towards him and the armed men of the Dajjal would meet him and they would say to him: Where do you intend to go? He would say: I intend to go to this one who is coming forth. They would say to him: Don't you believe in our Lord? He would say: There is nothing hidden about our Lord. They would say: Kill him. Then some amongst them would say: Has your master (Dajjal) not forbidden you to kill anyone without (his consent)? And so they would take him to the Dajjal and when the believer would see him, he would say: O people. he is the Dajjil about whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has informed (us). The Dajjal would then order for breaking his head and utter (these words): Catch hold of him and break his head. He would be struck even on his back and on his stomach. Then the Dajjal would ask him: Don't you believe in me? He would say: You are a false Masih. He would then order him to be torn (into pieces) with a saw from the parting of his hair up to his legs. After that the Dajjal would walk between the two pieces. He would then say to him: Stand, and he would stand erect. He would then say to him: Don't you believe in me? And the person would say: It has only added to my insight concerning you (that you are really the Dajjal). He would then say: O people, he would not behave with anyone amongst people (in such a manner) after me. The Dajjal would try to catch hold of him so that he should kill him (again). The space between his neck and collar bone would be turned into copper and he would find no means to kill him. So he would catch hold of him by his hand and feet and throw him (into the air) and the people would think as if he had been thrown in the Hell-Fire whereas he would be thrown in Paradise. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He would be the most eminent amongst persons in regard to martyrdom in the eye of the Lord of the world.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Dajjal pragat hoga aur momino mein se ek shakhs uski taraf jaayega aur Dajjal ke hathiyaarband log usse milenge aur usse kahenge: Kahan jaane ka iraada hai? Woh kahega: Mera iraada is (Dajjal) ke paas jaane ka hai jo pragat hua hai. Woh usse kahenge: Kya tum humaare Rab par imaan nahi rakhte? Woh kahega: Humaare Rab ke baare mein koi chhupaav nahi hai. Woh kahenge: Ise qatal kar do. Phir unmein se kuch kahenge: Kya tumhaare aaqa (Dajjal) ne tumhe kisi ko (uski ijazat ke bina) qatal karne se mana nahi kiya? Isliye woh use Dajjal ke paas le jaayenge aur jab momin use dekhega, woh kahega: Aye logo, ye wahi Dajjal hai jiske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya tha. Dajjal phir uska sar phodne ka hukum dega aur ye alfaaz kahega: Ise pakDo aur iska sar phod do. Use uski peeth aur uske pait par bhi maara jaayega. Phir Dajjal usse poochega: Kya tum mujhpar imaan nahi rakhte? Woh kahega: Tum jhoota Masih ho. Woh phir hukum dega ki use ek aare se uske baalon ke batwaare se lekar uske paidon tak phaad diya jaaye. Iske baad Dajjal donon tukdon ke beech chalega. Woh phir usse kahega: Khada ho jaao, aur woh seedha khada ho jaayega. Woh phir usse kahega: Kya tum mujhpar imaan nahi rakhte? Aur woh shakhs kahega: Isse mujhe tumhaare baare mein (ki tum waastav mein Dajjal ho) aur zyada yaqeen aa gaya hai. Woh phir kahega: Aye logo, ye mere baad kisi ke saath aisa vyavahaar nahi karega. Dajjal use dobara qatal karne ki koshish karega (taaki use dobara maar sake). Uski gardan aur uski haddi ke beech ki jagah taambe mein badal jaayegi aur use qatal karne ka koi zariya nahi milega. Isliye woh use uske haath-paon se pakadkar phenk dega aur log sochenge ki use Jahannam ki aag mein phenk diya gaya, jabki asal mein use Jannat mein phenka jaayega. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Woh duniya ke Rab ki nazar mein shahaadat ke silsile mein logon mein sabse ooncha darja rakhega.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: No one asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) more about Dajjil than I asked him. He said: He should not be a source of worry to you for he would not be able to do any harm to you. I said: Allah's Messenger, it is alleged that he would have along with him (abundance of) food and water. Thereupon he said: He would be very insignificant in the eye of Allah (even) with all this.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba (RA) ne bayan kiya: Kisi ne bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dajjal ke baare mein utna nahi poocha jitna maine unse poocha. Unhone farmaaya: Woh tumhaare liye fikr ka srot nahi hona chahiye kyunki woh tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaa payega. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaha jaata hai ki uske saath (khaana aur paani) ki bahutayat hogi. Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh Allah ki nazar mein iske bawajood bahut chhota hoga.

e: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that none asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about Dajjal more than I asked him. I (one of the narrators other than Mughira b. Shu'ba) said: What did you ask? Mughira replied: I said that the people alleged that he would have a mountain load of bread and mutton and rivers of water. Thereupon he said: He would be more insignificant in the eye of Allah compared with all this.
hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba (RA) ne bayan kiya ki kisi ne bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dajjal ke baare mein utna nahi poocha jitna maine unse poocha. Maine (raawi ne) poocha: Aapne kya poocha? Mughira ne jawaab diya: Maine kaha ki log daawa karte hain ki uske paas roti aur bhed ka pahaad-jitna anaaj aur paani ki nadiyaan hongi. Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh Allah ki nazar mein in sab cheezon ke muqable bahut chhota hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il through other chains of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported that a person came to him and said: What is this hadith that you narrate that the Last Hour would come at such and such time? Thereupon he said: Hallowed be Allah, there is no god but Allah (or the words to the same effect). I have decided that I would not narrate anything to anyone now. I had only said that you would see after some time an important event that the (sacred) House (Ka'ba) would be burnt and it would happen and definitely happen. He then reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Dajjal would appear in my Ummah and he would stay (in the world) for forty - I cannot say whether he meant forty days, forty months or forty years. And Allah would then send Jesus son of Mary who would resemble 'Urwa b Mas'ud. He (Jesus Christ) would chase him and kill him. Then people would live for seven years that there would be no rancour between two persons. Then Allah would send cold wind from the side of Syria that none would survive upon the earth having a speck of good in him or faith in him but he would die, so much so that even if some amongst you were to enter the innermost part of the mountain, this wind would reach that place also and that would cause his death. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Only the wicked people would survive and they would be as careless as birds with the characteristics of beasts. They would never appreciate the good nor condemn evil. Then Satan would come to them in human form and would say: Don't you respond? And they would say: What do you order us? And he would command them to worship the idols but, in spite of this, they would have abundance of sustenance and lead comfortable lives. Then the trumpet would be blown and no one would hear that but he would bend his neck to one side and raise it from the other side and the first one to hear that trumpet would be the person who would be busy in setting right the tank meant for providing water to the camels. He would swoon and the other people would also swoon, then Allah would send or He would cause to send rain which would be like dew and there would grow out of it the bodies of the people. Then the second trumpet would be blown and they would stand up and begin to look (around). Then it would be said: O people, go to your Lord, and make them stand there. And they would be questioned. Then it would be said: Bring out a group (out of them) for the Hell-Fire. And then it would be asked: How much? It would be said: Nine hundred and ninty-nine out of one thousand for the Hell-Fire and that would be the day which would make the children old because of its terror and that would be the day about which it has been said: "On the day when the shank would be uncovered" (lxviii. 42).
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: Ye kaunsi hadees hai jo aap riwayat karte hain ki Aakhri Ghadi aisi-aisi waqt par aayegi? Isper unhone kaha: Allah pavitra hai, Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai (ya isi jaisi baat). Maine faisla kar liya hai ki ab main kisi ko kuch bhi riwayat nahi karunga. Maine sirf ye kaha tha ki tum jald hi ek mahatvapurna ghatna dekhoge ki Pavitr Ghar (Kaaba) jal jaayega aur ye zaroor hoga. Phir unhone riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal meri Ummat mein pragat hoga aur woh chaalis - main nahi keh sakta ki unka matlab chaalis din tha ya chaalis mahine ya chaalis saal - tak rahega. Aur Allah phir Isa, Mary ke bete, ko bhejenge jo Urwa bin Mas'ud jaisa dikhega. Woh (Isa Masih) uska picha karenge aur use qatal karenge. Phir log saat saal tak jeenge ki do logon ke beech koi dushmani nahi hogi. Phir Allah Syria ki taraf se Thandi hawa bhejenge aur zameen par koi bhi shakhs, jismein zarra bhar bhi achhaai ya imaan ho, nahi bachega, balki woh mar jaayega, itna ki agar tum mein se koi pahaad ke andar bhi chala jaaye, ye hawa wahan bhi pahunchegi aur uski maut ki wajah banegi. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sirf badkaar log bachenge aur woh parindon jaise be-parvaah aur jaanwaron jaisi fitrat wale honge. Woh kabhi achhaai ki qadar nahi karenge aur na burai ki ninda karenge. Phir Shaitaan unke paas insaani soorat mein aayega aur kahega: Kya tum jawaab nahi doge? Aur woh kahenge: Tum humein kya hukum dete ho? Aur woh unhe murtiyon ki parastish karne ka hukum dega, lekin, iske bawajood, unke paas bahutayat mein rozi hogi aur woh aaraam-daayak zindagi jeenge. Phir Singhaa (trumpet) bajaaya jaayega aur koi bhi ise sunkar apni gardan ek taraf jhuka lega aur doosri taraf se use uThAyega, aur us Singhaa ko sabse pehla sunne wala woh shakhs hoga jo oonton ko paani pilaane wale hauz theek karne mein masroof hoga. Woh behosh ho jaayega aur doosre log bhi behosh hongi, phir Allah ek baarish bhejenge jo os jaisi hogi aur ismein se logon ke jism (dobara) ugenge. Phir doosra Singhaa bajaaya jaayega aur woh khade honge aur (idhar-udhar) dekhne lagenge. Phir kaha jaayega: Aye logo, apne Rab ke paas jao, aur unhe wahan khada kiya jaayega. Aur unse sawaal-jawaab hoga. Phir kaha jaayega: (Unmein se) ek giroh ko Jahannam ki aag ke liye nikaalo. Aur phir poocha jaayega: Kitne? Kaha jaayega: Har hazaar mein se nau sau ninnyaave Jahannam ki aag ke liye, aur ye woh din hoga jismein bachche apne khauf ki wajah se boodhe ho jaayenge, aur ye woh din hai jiske baare mein kaha gaya hai: "Us din jab pindli khol di jaayegi" (68:42).

e: Ya'qub b. 'Asim b. Urwa b. Mas'ud reported: I heard a person saying to 'Abdullah b. Amr: You say that the Last Hour would come at such and such time, whereupon he said: I had made up my mind that I would not narrate anything to you. I only said: But you would soon see after some time a very significant affair, for example the burning of the House (Ka'ba). Shu'ba said like this and 'Abdullah b Amr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: The Dajjal would appear in my Ummah. And in another hadith (the words are): None would survive who would have even a speck of faith in his heart, but he would be dead. Muhammad b. Ja'far reported that Shu'ba narrated to him this hadith many a time and I also read it out to him many a time.
hi: Yaqub bin Aasim bin Urwa bin Mas'ud ne bayan kiya: Maine ek shakhs ko Abdullah bin Amr se ye kehte suna: Aap kehte hain ki Aakhri Ghadi aisi-aisi waqt par aayegi, isper unhone kaha: Maine faisla kar liya tha ki main tumhe kuch nahi riwayat karunga. Maine sirf ye kaha tha ki tum jald hi ek bahut mahatvapurna ghatna dekhoge, jaise Pavitr Ghar (Kaaba) ka jalna. Shu'ba ne isi tarah kaha aur Abdullah bin Amr ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal meri Ummat mein pragat hoga. Aur ek doosri hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Koi bhi nahi bachega jiske dil mein zarra bhar bhi imaan ho, balki woh mar jaayega. Muhammad bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki Shu'ba ne unhe ye hadees bahut baar riwayat ki aur maine bhi ise unhe bahut baar padhkar sunaaya.

e: `Abdullah b. `Amr reported: I committed to memory a hadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I did not forget it after I had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The first sign (out of the signs of the appearance of the Dajjal) would be the appearance of the sun from the west, the appearance of the beast before the people in the forenoon and which of the two happens first, the second one would follow immediately after that.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees apne zehan mein rakhi aur maine ise nahi bhula jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Pehli nishaani (Dajjal ke pragat hone ki nishaaniyon mein se) suraj ka pashchim se nikalna hoga, (aur) jaanwar ka logon ke saamne subah ke waqt pragat hona, aur inmein se jo bhi pehle hoga, doosra uske turant baad hoga.

e: Abu Zur'a reported that three persons amongst Muslims had been sitting in Medina in the presence of Marwan b. Hakam and they heard him narrate these signs from him and the first amongst them was the appearance of the Dajjal. 'Abdullah b. 'Amr reported that Marwin said nothing (particular in this connection). I, however, heard a hadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I did not forget that after I had heard that from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he reported a hadith like the foregoing.
hi: Abu Zur'a ne bayan kiya ki teen Musalman Madina mein Marwan bin Hakam ki maujoodgi mein baithe the aur unhone unse ye nishaaniyaan riwayat karte suna, aur unmein pehli Dajjal ka pragat hona thi. Abdullah bin Amr ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ne is silsile mein kuch khaas nahi kaha. Maine, halaanki, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees suni aur ise nahi bhula jab se maine ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, aur unhone upar jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki.

e: Abu Zur'a reported that there was a discussion in the presence of Marwan about the Last Hour, and Abdullah b. 'Amr said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. The rest of the hadith is the same, but there is no mention of forenoon.
hi: Abu Zur'a ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ki maujoodgi mein Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein charcha hui, aur Abdullah bin Amr ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin ismein "subah ke waqt" ka koi zikr nahi hai.

e:
Amir b. Sharahil Sha'bi Sha'b Hamdan reported that he asked Fatima, daughter of Qais and sister of ad-Dahhak b. Qais and she was the first amongst the emigrant women: Narrate to me a hadith which you had heard directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there is no extra link in between them. She said: Very well, if you like, I am prepared to do that, and he said to her: Well, do It and narrate that to me. She said: I married the son of Mughira and he was a chosen young man of Quraish at that time, but he fell as a martyr in the first Jihad (fighting) on the side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When I became a widow, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf, one amongst the group of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), sent me the proposal of marriage. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also sent me such a message for his freed slave Usama b. Zaid. And it had been conveyed to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said (about Usama): He who loves me should also love Usama. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) talked to me (about this matter), I said: My affairs are in your hand. You may marry me to anyone whom you like. He said: You better shift now to the house of Umm Sharik, and Umm Sharik was a rich lady from amongst the Ansar. She spent generously for the cause of Allah and entertained guests very hospitably. I said: Well, I will do as you like. He said: Do not do that for Umm Sharik is a woman who is very frequently visited by guests and I do not like that your head may be uncovered or the cloth may be removed from your shank and the strangers may catch sight of them which you abhor. You better shift to the house of your cousin 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. Umm Maktum and he is a person of the Bani Fihr branch of the Quraish, and he belonged to that tribe (to which Fatima) belonged. So I shifted to that house, and when my period of waiting was over, I heard the voice of an announcer making an announcement that the prayer would be observed in the mosque (where) congregational prayer (is observed). 
So I set out towards that mosque and observed prayer along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was in the row of the women which was near the row of men. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, he sat on the pulpit smiling and said: Every worshipper should keep sitting at his place. He then said: Do you know why I had asked you to assemble? They said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said: By Allah. I have not made you assemble for exhortation or for a warning, but I have detained you here, for Tamim Dari, a Christian, who came and accepted Islam, told me something, which agrees with what I was telling, you about the Dajjal. He narrated to me that he had sailed in a ship along with thirty men of Bani Lakhm and Bani Judham and had been tossed by waves in the ocean for a month. Then these (waves) took them (near) the land within the ocean (island) at the time of sunset. They sat in a small side-boat and entered that island. There was a beast with long thick hair (and because of these) they could not distinguish his face from his back. They said: Woe to you, who can you be? Thereupon it said: I am al-Jassasa. They said: What is al-Jassasa? And it said: O people, go to this person in the monastery as he is very much eager to know about you. He (the narrator) said: When it named a person for us we were afraid of it lest it should be a devil. Then we hurriedly went on till we came to that monastery and found a well-built person there with his hands tied to his neck and having iron shackles between his two legs up to the ankles. We said: Woe be upon thee, who are you? And he said: You would soon come to know about me. but tell me who are you. We said: We are people from Arabia and we embarked upon a boat but the sea-waves had been driving us for one month and they brought as near this island. We got Into the side-boats and entered this island and here a beast met us with profusely thick hair and because of the thickness of his hair his face could not be distinguished from his back. We said: Woe be to thee, who are you? It said: I am al- Jassasa. We said: What is al-Jassasa? And it said: You go to this very person in the monastery for he is eagerly waiting for you to know about you. So we came to you in hot haste fearing that that might be the Devil. He (that chained person) said: Tell me about the date-palm trees of Baisan. We said: About what aspect of theirs do you seek information? He said: I ask you whether these trees bear fruit or not. 
We said: yes. Thereupon he said: I think these would not bear fruits. He said: Inform me about the lake of Tabariyya? We said: Which aspect of it do you want to know? He said: Is there water in it? They said: There is abundance of water in it. Thereupon he said: I think it would soon become dry. He again said: Inform me about the spring of Zughar. They said: Which aspect of it you want to know? He (the chained person) said: Is there water in it and does it irrigate (the land)? We said to him: Yes, there is abundance of water in it and the inhabitants (of Medina) irrigate (land) with the help of it, He said: Inform me about the unlettered Prophet; what has he done? We said: He has come out from Mecca and has settled In Yathrib (Medina). He said: Do the Arabs fight against him? We said: Yes. He said: How did he deal with them? We informed him that he had overcome those in his neighbourhood and they had submitted themselves before him. Thereupon he said to us: Has it actually happened? We said: Yes. Thereupon he said: If it is so that is better for them that they should show obedience to him.
