I am going to tell you about myself and I am Dajjal and would be soon permitted to get out and so I shall get out and travel in the land, and will not spare any town where I would not stay for forty nights except Mecca and Medina as these two (places) are prohibited (areas) for me and I would not make an attempt to enter any one of these two. An angel with a sword in his hand would confront me and would bar my way and there would be angels to guard every passage leading to it; then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) striking the pulpit with the help of the end of his staff said: This implies Taiba meaning Medina. Have I not, told you an account (of the Dajjal) like this? 'The people said: Yes, and this account narrated by Tamim Dari was liked by me for it corroborates the account which I gave to you in regard to him (Dajjal) at Medina and Mecca. Behold he (Dajjal) is in the Syrian sea (Mediterranean) or the Yemen sea (Arabian sea). Nay, on the contrary, he is in the east, he is in the east, he is in the east, and he pointed with his hand towards the east. I (Fatima bint Qais) said: I preserved it in my mind (this narration from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
hi: Amir bin Sharahil Sha'bi Sha'b Hamdan ne bayan kiya ki unhone Fatima, Qais ki beti aur ad-Dahhak bin Qais ki behn, se poocha - aur woh sabse pehli mahila prawaasi thin: Mujhe woh hadees riwayat kijiye jo aapne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni ho, bina kisi aur waaste ke. Unhone kaha: Theek hai, agar tum chaho, main taiyaar hoon. Unhone kaha: Zaroor, ise mujhe riwayat kijiye. Unhone kaha: Maine Mughira ke bete se shaadi ki thi aur woh us waqt Quraish ke chune hue jawaan the, lekin woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se pehle Jihad mein shaheed ho gaye. Jab main bewa ho gayi, Abd al-Rahman bin Auf, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se ek, ne mujhe shaadi ka prastaav bheja. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bhi mujhe apne aazaad kiye hue ghulam Usama bin Zaid ke liye payaam bheja. Aur mujhe bataya gaya tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Usama ke baare mein) kaha tha: Jo mujhse muhabbat karta hai use Usama se bhi muhabbat karni chahiye. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (is silsile mein) mujhse baat ki, maine kaha: Mera maamla aapke haath mein hai. Aap mujhe jiski chaahein shaadi kar dein. Unhone kaha: Behtar hoga ki tum ab Umm Sharik ke ghar chali jaao, aur Umm Sharik Ansar ki ek daulatmand khaatoon thin. Woh Allah ki raah mein sakhaawat se kharch karti thin aur mehmaanon ki bahut achhi tarah mehmaannawaazi karti thin. Maine kaha: Theek hai, main aisa hi karungi jaisa aap chaahte hain. Unhone kaha: Aisa mat karo kyunki Umm Sharik ke paas bahut zyada mehmaan aate hain aur mujhe pasand nahi ki tumhaara sar khula rahe ya kapda tumhaari pindli se hat jaaye aur ajnabi log wahi dekh len jo tumhe napasand hai. Behtar hoga ki tum apne chachere bhai Abdullah bin Amr bin Umm Maktum ke ghar chali jaao, aur woh Quraish ke Banu Fihr shaakha se the, aur woh usi qabile se ta'alluq rakhte the jismein Fatima the. Isliye main us ghar chali gayi, aur jab meri iddat khatm hui, maine ek ailaan karne wale ki aawaaz suni ki masjid mein namaz padhi jaayegi (jahan) samuhik namaz ho rahi hai. Isliye main us masjid ki taraf nikli aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi aur main auraton ki us pankti mein thi jo mardon ki pankti ke qareeb thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni namaz khatm ki, woh muskuraate hue mimbar par baithe aur farmaaya: Har namazi apni jagah baitha rahe. Phir unhone farmaaya: Kya tumhe pata hai maine tumhe kyun ikattha kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Unhone farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, maine tumhe kisi nasihat ya chetaavni ke liye ikattha nahi kiya, balki maine tumhe isliye roka hai kyunki Tamim Dari, ek Isaayi jo aaye aur Islam qubool kiya, ne mujhe kuch bataya jo Dajjal ke baare mein maine jo tumhe pehle bataya tha usse milta-julta hai. Unhone mujhe riwayat ki ki woh Banu Lakhm aur Banu Judham ke tees logon ke saath ek jahaaz mein safar par gaye the aur samundar ki laharen unhe ek mahine tak dhakelti rahin. Phir ye (laharen) unhe suraj doobne ke waqt ek zameen (samundar ke andar taapu) ke qareeb le gayin. Woh ek chhoti kishti mein baithe aur us taapu mein daakhil hue. Wahan ek jaanwar tha jiske ghane baal itne lambe the (ki iski wajah se) woh uska chehra uski peeth se nahi pehchaan paaye. Unhone kaha: Tumpar afsos, tum kaun ho? Isper usne kaha: Main al-Jassasa hoon. Unhone kaha: al-Jassasa kya hai? Aur usne kaha: Aye logo, us shakhs ke paas jaao jo maTh mein hai kyunki woh tumhaare baare mein jaanne ke liye bahut betaab hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Jab usne humaare liye ek shakhs ka naam liya, humein uski wajah se dar laga kahin ye Shaitaan na ho. Phir hum jaldi-jaldi chal padhe yahan tak ki hum us maTh tak pahunche aur wahan ek achhi tarah banaya hua shakhs paaya jiske haath uski gardan se bandhe the aur uske do paeron ke beech takhne tak lohe ki zanjeerein thin. Humne kaha: Tumpar afsos, tum kaun ho? Aur usne kaha: Tumhe jald pata chalega mere baare mein, lekin mujhe bataao tum kaun ho? Humne kaha: Hum Arabia ke log hain aur hum ek kishti mein sawaar huye lekin samundar ki laharon ne humein ek mahine tak dhakela aur humein is taapu ke qareeb le aayin. Hum chhoti kishti mein utre aur is taapu mein daakhil hue aur yahan humein ek jaanwar mila jiske ghane baal itne lambe the ki unki wajah se uska chehra uski peeth se pehchaana nahi jaa sakta tha. Humne kaha: Tumpar afsos, tum kaun ho? Usne kaha: Main al-Jassasa hoon. Humne kaha: al-Jassasa kya hai? Aur usne kaha: Tum us shakhs ke paas maTh mein jao kyunki woh tumhaare baare mein jaanne ke liye betaab hai. Isliye hum tumhaare paas jaldi-jaldi aaye is dar se ki kahin ye Shaitaan na ho. (Us zanjeeron mein bandhe shakhs ne) kaha: Mujhe Baisan ke khajoor ke darakhton ke baare mein bataao. Humne kaha: Unke kis pehlu ke baare mein tum jaankaari chaahte ho? Unhone kaha: Main poochta hoon ki ye darakht phal dete hain ya nahi. Humne kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ye jald hi phal dena band kar denge. Unhone kaha: Mujhe Tabariyya jheel ke baare mein bataao? Humne kaha: Kaunse pehlu ke baare mein tum jaanna chaahte ho? Unhone kaha: Kya ismein paani hai? Unhone kaha: Ismein bahutayat mein paani hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe lagta hai ye jald hi sookh jaayega. Unhone phir kaha: Mujhe Zughar ke chashme ke baare mein bataao. Unhone kaha: Kaunse pehlu ke baare mein tum jaanna chaahte ho? Us (zanjeeron mein bandhe shakhs) ne kaha: Kya ismein paani hai aur kya ye (zameen ki) sinchaai karta hai? Humne unse kaha: Haan, ismein bahutayat mein paani hai aur Madina ke log iske zariye (zameen ki) sinchaai karte hain. Unhone kaha: Mujhe us na-padhe-likhe Nabi ke baare mein bataao; unhone kya kiya hai? Humne kaha: Woh Makkah se nikle hain aur Yathrib (Madina) mein base hain. Unhone kaha: Kya Arab unse jung karte hain? Humne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Unhone unse kaisa vyavahaar kiya? Humne unhe bataya ki unhone apne aas-paas ke logon par jeet haasil ki aur unhone unke saamne aatmasamarpan kar diya. Isper unhone humse kaha: Kya ye waastav mein hua hai? Humne kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Agar aisa hai, to ye unke liye behtar hoga ki woh uski itaat karein. Main tumhe apne baare mein bataane wala hoon: main Dajjal hoon aur jald hi mujhe bahar nikalne ki ijazat milegi, isliye main bahar nikalunga aur zameen mein safar karunga, aur koi bhi shehar aisa nahi chhoDunga jahan main chaalis raaton tak na Thehru, siwaay Makkah aur Madina ke, kyunki ye dono jagahein mere liye mana hain aur main inmein se kisi ek mein bhi daakhil hone ki koshish nahi karunga. Ek Farishta apne haath mein talwaar leke mera saamna karega aur mera raasta rokega aur har raaste par Farishte iski hifaazat ke liye maujood honge; phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni lakdi ke sire se mimbar par thoka aur farmaaya: Iska matlab Taiba hai, yaani Madina. Kya maine tumhe isi jaisi kahani nahi bataayi thi? Logon ne kaha: Haan, aur Tamim Dari ki ye kahani mujhe achhi lagi kyunki ye us kahani ki pushti karti hai jo maine tumhe Madina aur Makkah ke silsile mein pehle bataayi thi. Dekho, woh (Dajjal) Syria ke samundar (Mediterranean) ya Yemen ke samundar (Arabian sea) mein hai. Nahi, balki woh poorab mein hai, woh poorab mein hai, woh poorab mein hai, aur unhone apne haath se poorab ki taraf ishara kiya. Maine (Fatima bint Qais ne) ise apne zehan mein sanjo liya.

e: Al-Sha'bi reported: We visited Fatima b. Qais and she served us fresh dates which are called rutab and she also served us barley. I asked her about that woman in whose case three divorces had been pronounced as to how much time she should count as the waiting period. She said: My husband pronounced three divorces in my case and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted me to spend any waiting period in my family. (It was during this period) that announcement was made for the people to observe prayer in the bigger Mosque. I went there along with people and I was in the front row meant for women and it was adjacent to the last row of men and I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deliver sermon sitting on the pulpit. He said: The cousin of Tamim (Dari) sailed in the ocean. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition:" (I see) as if I am looking to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pointing his rod towards the land (and saying): It is Taiba, i. e. Medina."
hi: Al-Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Hum Fatima bint Qais se milne gaye aur unhone humein taaze khajoor (jinhe Rutab kaha jaata hai) aur jau bhi pesh kiya. Maine unse us aurat ke baare mein poocha jisse teen talaqein di gayi hon, use kitna waqt intezaar karna chahiye. Unhone kaha: Mere pati ne mere maamle mein teen talaqein din aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ijazat di ki main apna intezaar ka waqt apne khaandaan mein guzaroon. (Isi daur mein) badi masjid mein logon ko namaz padhne ka ailaan hua. Main logon ke saath wahan gayi aur main auraton ki agli pankti mein thi jo mardon ki aakhri pankti ke qareeb thi, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par baithkar khutba dete suna. Unhone kaha: Tamim (Dari) ke chachere bhai samundar mein kashti chalaate the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: (Mujhe lagta hai) jaise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni lakdi zameen ki taraf ishara karte dekh rahi hoon (aur keh rahe hain): Ye Taiba hai, yaani Madina.

e: Tamim Dari came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he sailed in an ocean and his ship lost direction and thus landed at an island. They moved about in that land in search of water. There they saw a person who had been pulling his hair. The rest of the hadith is the same. And he (Dajjal) said: If I were to be permitted to set out I would have covered all the lands except Taiba. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) brought (Tamim Dari) before the public and he narrated to them and said: That is Taiba and that is the Dajjal.
hi: Tamim Dari Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ki woh samundar mein kashti chala rahe the aur unki kashti raasta bhatak gayi aur woh ek taapu par utar gaye. Woh us zameen mein paani ki talaash mein ghoome. Wahan unhone ek shakhs dekha jo apne baal khinch raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Aur unhone (Dajjal ne) kaha: Agar mujhe bahar nikalne ki ijazat mile, to main saari zameenon ko dhaak lunga siwaay Taiba ke. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (Tamim Dari ko) logon ke saamne pesh kiya aur unhone unhe riwayat ki aur kaha: Ye Taiba hai aur woh Dajjal hai.

e: Fatima b. Qais reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat on the pulpit and said: O people, Tamim Dari has reported to me that some persons of his tribe sailed in the ocean in a boat and it capsised and then some of them travelled on one of the planks of the boat and they went to an island in the ocean. The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par baithe aur farmaaya: Aye logo, Tamim Dari ne mujhe bataya ki unke qabile ke kuch log samundar mein ek kishti mein chal rahe the aur ye ulaT gayi, aur unmein se kuch log kishti ke ek taKhte par safar karte rahe aur samundar mein ek taapu par pahunche. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There will be no land which would not be covered by the Dajjal but Mecca and Medina, and there would no passage out of the passages leading to them which would not be guarded by angels arranged in rows. Then he (the Dajjal) would appear in a barren place adjacent to Medina and it would rock three times that every unbeliever and hypocrite would get out of it towards him.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aisi koi zameen nahi hai jise Dajjal na dhaake, siwaay Makkah aur Madina ke, aur inki taraf jaane wala koi bhi raasta aisa nahi hoga jise Farishte pankti banaakar na mahfooz karein. Phir woh (Dajjal) Madina ke qareeb ek banjar jagah mein pragat hoga aur ye teen baar hilegi taaki har gair-imaandaar aur munafiq usse (Madina se) nikalkar uski taraf jaaye.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this but with this addition that (the Dajjal would come) and pitch his tent in the waste-land of Juruf and thus there would come out of (the city) every hypocrite, man and woman.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye farmaaya, lekin is izafe ke saath ki (Dajjal aayega) aur Juruf ki banjar zameen mein apna tambu gaadega aur is tarah (shehar se) har munafiq mard aur aurat bahar nikal aayenge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Dajjal would be followed by seventy thousand Jews of Isfahan wearing Persian shawls.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Dajjal ke peeche Isfahan ke sattar hazaar Yahudi honge, Persia ki chaadar pehne huye.

e: Umm Sharik reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The people would run away from the Dajjal seeking shelter in the mountains. She said: Where would be the Arabs then in that day? He said: They would be small in number.
hi: Umm Sharik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Log Dajjal se bhaagenge aur pahaadon mein panah lenge. Unhone kaha: Us din Arab log kahan honge? Isper unhone farmaaya: Woh tadaad mein kam honge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Qatada reported: We used to go to Imran b. Husain passing in front of Hisham b. 'Amir. He, one day, said: You pass by me (in order) to go to some persons, but (amongst the living persons) none remained in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) more than I and none knows more ahadith than I. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would be no creation (creating more trouble) than the Dajjal right from the creation of Adam to the Last Hour.
hi: Abu Qatada (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Hisham bin Amir ke saamne se guzarte hue Imran bin Husain ke paas jaaya karte the. Unhone ek din kaha: Tum log mere paas se doosre logon ki taraf jaane ke liye guzarte ho, lekin (zinda logon mein se) koi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein mujhse zyada lambe waqt tak nahi raha aur koi bhi mujhse zyada ahadees nahi jaanta. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam ki paidaayish se lekar Aakhri Ghadi tak koi makhlooq Dajjal se zyada (mushkil paida karne wali) nahi hogi.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Imran b. Husain with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Imran bin Husain (RA) ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Hasten to do good deeds before six things happen: the rising of the sun from the west, the smoke, the Dajjal, the beast and (the death) of one of you or the general turmoil.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Chhe cheezon ke hone se pehle nekokaar amal karne mein jaldi karo: suraj ka pashchim se nikalna, dhuaan, Dajjal, jaanwar, aur tum mein se kisi ki (maut) ya vyapak fitna.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Hasten in performing these good deeds (before these) six things (happen): (the appearance) of the Dajjal, the smoke, the beast of the earth, the rising of the sun from the west, the general turmoil (leading to large-scale massacre) and death of masses and individuals.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: In chhe cheezon (ke hone) se pehle nekokaar amal karne mein jaldi karo: Dajjal ka pragat hona, dhuaan, zameen ka jaanwar, suraj ka pashchim se nikalna, vyapak fitna (jismein bade paimaane par khoon-kharaba ho) aur bade paimaane par aur ek-ek karke maut.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ma'qil b. Yasar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Worshiping during the period of widespread turmoil is like emigration towards me.
hi: Ma'qil bin Yasar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Vyapak fitne ke daur mein ibadat karna meri taraf hijrat karne jaisa hai.

e: The previous hadith is narrated through Abu Kamil from Hammad with the same chain.
hi: Pichhli hadees Abu Kamil ke zariye Hammad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would affect (most terribly) the wicked persons.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi badkaar logon par (sabse zyada bhayaanak taur par) asar karegi.

e: This hadith has been reported by Sahl b. Sa'd that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I and the Last Hour are (close to each other) like this (and he, in order to explain it) pointed (by joining his) forefinger, (one) next to the thumb and the middle finger (together).
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah (ek-doosre ke qareeb) hain, aur (isse spashth karte hue) unhone apni tarjani ungli, angoothe ke bagal wali, aur beech ki ungli ko jodkar dikhaya.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this. Shu'ba said: I heard Qatada as saying in his narration: The excellence of one over the other. And I do not know whether he narrated it from Anas or Qatada himself said so.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain. Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine Qatada ko apni riwayat mein ye kehte suna: Ek ka doosre par bardaasht. Aur mujhe nahi pata ki unhone ye Anas se riwayat ki ya khud Qatada ne aisa kaha.

e: Shu'ba reported: I heard Qatada and Abu Tayyab narrating that both of them heard Anas as narrating that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this, and Shu'ba drew his forefinger and middle finger near each other while narrating it.
hi: Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Maine Qatada aur Abu Tayyab dono ko riwayat karte suna ki unhone dono ne Anas se suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain, aur Shu'ba ne apni tarjani aur beech ki ungli ko riwayat karte huye ek-doosre ke qareeb kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying like this, but he narrated it through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi baat riwayat ki, lekin unhone ise ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat kiya.

e: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this and (he while doing it) joined the forefinger with the middle finger.
hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain, aur (ye kehte huye) unhone apni tarjani ungli ko beech ki ungli ke saath joda.

e: 'A'isha reported that when the desert Arabs came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) they asked about the Last Hour as to when that would come. And he looked towards the youngest amongst them and said: If he lives he would not grow very old that he would find your Last Hour coming to you (he would see you dying).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab registaan ke Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aate, woh Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein poochte ki ye kab aayegi. Aur unhone unmein sabse choti umar wale shakhs ki taraf dekha aur farmaaya: Agar ye zinda raha, to isse pehle ki woh bahut boodha ho, ye Aakhri Ghadi ko tumhaari taraf aata hua paayega (yaani ye tumhaari maut dekhega).

e: Anas reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as to when the Last Hour would come. He had in his presence a young boy of the Ansar who was called Muhammad. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If this young boy lives, he may not grow very old till (he would see) the Last Hour coming to you.
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki Aakhri Ghadi kab aayegi. Unke saamne Ansar ka ek jawaan larka tha jise Muhammad kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar ye jawaan larka zinda raha, to shaayad ye bahut boodha na ho paaye ki Aakhri Ghadi tumhaari taraf aa jaaye.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): When would the Last Hour come? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) kept quiet for a while. Then looked at a young boy in his presence belonging to the tribe of Azd Shanu'a and he said: If this boy lives he would not grow very old till the Last Hour would come to you. Anas said that this young boy was of our age during those days.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Aakhri Ghadi kab aayegi? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuch der khamosh rahe. Phir unhone Azd Shanu'a qabile ke apne saamne maujood ek jawaan larke ki taraf dekha aur kaha: Agar ye larka zinda raha, to ye bahut boodha nahi ho paayega ki Aakhri Ghadi tumhaari taraf aa jaaye. Anas ne kaha ki us daur mein ye jawaan larka humaari hi umar ka tha.

e: Anas reported: A young boy of Mughira b. Shu'ba happened to pass by (the Holy Prophet) and he was of my age. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: If he lives long he would not grow very old till the Last Hour would come (to the old people of this generation).
hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mughira bin Shu'ba ka ek jawaan larka (Nabi ke) paas se guzra aur woh meri hi umar ka tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar woh lambi zindagi jeeye, to woh bahut boodha nahi ho paayega jab Aakhri Ghadi (is peedhi ke boodhon ki taraf) aa jaaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come (so sudden) that a person would be milking the she- camel and the (milk) would not reach the brim of the vessel that the Last Hour would come, and the two persons would be engaged in buying and selling of the clothes and their bargain would not be struck before the Last Hour would come. And someone would be setting his tank in order and he would have hardly set it right when the Last Hour would come.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi is tarah (achaanak) aayegi ki ek shakhs oontni ka doodh nikaal raha hoga aur doodh bartan ke kinaare tak pahunchne se pehle Aakhri Ghadi aa jaayegi, aur do log kapdon ki khareed-farokht mein masroof honge aur unka sauda Aakhri Ghadi aane se pehle poora nahi hoga. Aur koi apna hauz theek kar raha hoga aur woh use mushkil se hi theek kar paayega ki Aakhri Ghadi aa jaayegi.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Between the two blowings of the trumpet (there would be an interval of forty). They said: Abu Huraira, do you mean forty days? He said: I cannot say anything. They said: Do you mean forty months? He said: I cannot say anything. They said: Do you mean forty years? He said: I cannot say anything. Then Allah would cause the water to, descend from the sky and they (people) will sprout like vegetable. The only thing in a man which would not decay would be one bone (the tailbone) from which the whole frame would be reconstituted on the Day of Resurrection.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Do Singhaa (trumpet) ke bajne ke beech (chaalis ka antar hoga). Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Abu Huraira, aapka matlab chaalis din hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Unhone kaha: Aapka matlab chaalis mahine hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Unhone kaha: Aapka matlab chaalis saal hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Phir Allah aasmaan se paani utaarenge aur log (naye) ugenge sabziyon ki tarah. Insaan mein sirf ek haddi (Ajb, rerdhee ki haddi ka aakhri hissa) hai jo kabhi galti nahi, aur isi se poora dhaancha Qayamat ke din dobara banaaya jaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The earth would consume all of the son of Adam except his tailbone. From it he was created, and from it he will be recreated (on the Day of Resurrection).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Zameen Aadam ki aulad ki har cheez khaa jaayegi siwaay uski Ajb (rerdhee ki haddi ka aakhri hissa) ke. Isi se woh banaaya gaya tha aur isi se woh (Qayamat ke din) dobara banaaya jaayega.

e: Abu Huraira reported so many ahadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and amongst these one was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is a bone in the human being which the earth would never consume and it is from this that new bodies would be reconstituted (on the Day of Resurrection). They said: Allah's Messenger, which bone is that? Thereupon he said: It is the spinal bone.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si ahadees riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Insaan mein ek haddi hai jise zameen kabhi nahi khaayegi, aur isi se (Qayamat ke din) naye jism dobara banaaye jaayenge. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaunsi haddi hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye rerdhee ki haddi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The world is a prison-house for a believer and Paradise for a non-believer.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Duniya momin ke liye ek qaidkhaana hai aur gair-imaandaar ke liye Jannat.

e: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) happened to walk through the bazar coming from the side of 'Aliya and the people were on both his sides. There he found a dead lamb with very short ears. He took hold of his ear and said: Who amongst you would like to have this for a dirham? They said: We do not like to have it even for less than that as it is of no use to us. He said: Do you wish to have it (free of any cost)? They said: By Allah, even if it were alive (we would not have liked to possess that), for there is defect in it as its ear is very short; now it is dead also. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, this world is more insignificant in the eye of Allah than it (this dead lamb) is in your eye.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aaliya ki taraf se bazaar mein guzre aur log unke dono taraf the. Wahan unhe ek mara hua bhed ka bachcha mila jiske kaan bahut chhote the. Unhone uska kaan pakda aur farmaaya: Tum mein se kaun ise ek dirham mein lena chaahega? Unhone kaha: Hum ise itni bhi keemat mein nahi chaahte kyunki ye humaare liye be-kaam hai. Unhone farmaaya: Kya tum ise (bina koi keemat diye) lena chaahoge? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar ye zinda bhi hota (to bhi hum ise na lete), kyunki ismein khaami hai ki iska kaan bahut chhota hai; ab to ye mar bhi chuka hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, ye duniya Allah ki nazar mein isse bhi zyada nagany hai jitni ye (ye mara hua bachcha) tumhaari nazar mein hai.

e: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) narrating a hadith like this with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki, alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father: I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as he was reciting:" Abundance diverts you" (cii. 1). He said: The son of Adam claims: My wealth, my wealth. And he (the Holy Prophet) said: O son of Adam. is there anything as your belonging except that which you consumed, which you utilised, or which you wore and then it was worn out or you gave as charity and sent it forward?
hi: Mutarrif ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh (Sura Takathur) padh rahe the: "Bahutayat tumhe be-parvaah kar deti hai" (102:1). Unhone farmaaya: Aadam ki aulad daawa karti hai: Mera maal, mera maal. Aur unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Aye Aadam ki aulad, tumhaara khud ka kya hai siwaay us cheez ke jise tumne khaaya aur istemal kiya, ya jise tumne pehna aur woh puraana ho gaya, ya jo tumne sadaqe mein diya aur bhej diya?

e: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father: I went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Mutarrif ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A servant says, My wealth. my wealth, but out of his wealth three things are only his: whatever he eats and makes use of or by means of which he dresses himself and it wears out or he gives as charity, and this is what he stored for himself (as a reward for the Hereafter), and what is beyond this (it is of no use to you) because you are to depart and leave it for other people.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banda kehta hai: Mera maal, mera maal, lekin uske maal mein se sirf teen cheezein uski hain: jo woh khaata hai aur istemal karta hai, ya jise pehankar khud ko sajaata hai aur woh puraana ho jaata hai, ya jo woh sadaqe mein deta hai, aur yahi hai jo usne apne liye (Aakhirat ke sawaab ke soorat mein) jama kiya hai, aur jo iske ilaawa hai (uska tumhare liye koi faayda nahi) kyunki tumhe jaana hoga aur ise doosron ke liye chhodna hoga.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Ala bin Abd al-Rahman ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Three things follow the bier of a dead man. Two of them come back and one is left with him: the members of his family, wealth and his good deeds. The members of his family and wealth come back and the deeds alone are left with him.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Teen cheezein murda shakhs ke taboot ke peeche jaati hain. Inmein se do wapas laut aati hain aur ek uske saath rehti hai: uske khaandaan ke log, uska maal aur uske nekokaar amal. Uske khaandaan ke log aur uska maal wapas laut aate hain aur sirf uske amal uske saath rehte hain.

e: `Amr b. `Auf, who was an ally of Banu `Amir b. Luwayy (and he was one amongst them) who participated in Badr along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reported that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu `Ubaida b. Al-Jarrah to Bahrain for collecting Jizya and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a truce with the people of Bahrain and had appointed `Ala' b. Hadrami and Abu `Ubaida (for this purpose). They came with wealth from Bahrain and the Ansar heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida and they had observed the dawn prayer along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, they (the Ansar) came before him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled as he saw them and then said: I think you have heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida with goods from Bahrain. They said: Allah's Messenger, yes, it is so. Thereupon he said: Be happy and be hopeful of that which gives you delight. By Allah, it is not the poverty about which I fear in regard to you but I am afraid in your case that (the worldly) riches way be given to you as were given to those who had gone before you and you begin to vie with one another for them as they vied for them, and these may destroy you as these destroyed them.
hi: Amr bin Auf (RA), jo Banu Amir bin Luwayy ke sahyogi the (aur unhi mein se ek the) aur jinhone Badr ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hissa liya, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Ubaida bin al-Jarrah ko Bahrain jizya ikattha karne bheja aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bahrain ke logon ke saath sulah ki thi aur Ala bin Hadrami ko (is maqsad ke liye) muqarrar kiya tha, saath mein Abu Ubaida ko bhi. Woh Bahrain se maal lekar aaye aur Ansar ne Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Fajr ki namaz padhi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz khatm ki, woh (Ansar) unke saamne aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe dekhkar muskuraaye aur phir farmaaya: Mujhe lagta hai tumne Bahrain se saamaan lekar Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan, aisa hi hai. Isper unhone farmaaya: Khush raho aur jo cheez tumhe khushi degi uski ummeed rakho. Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumhaare baare mein gareebi ka koi dar nahi hai balki mujhe dar hai ki (duniyaavi) daulat tumhe di jaayegi jaisi tumse pehle logon ko di gayi thi aur tum unke jaisa isse haasil karne ke liye pratispardha karoge jaisa unhone kiya, aur ye tumhe usi tarah barbaad kar sakti hai jaise usne unhe barbaad kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri as reported by Yunus with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se Yunus ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: `Abdullah b. `Amr b. al-`As reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: How would you be, O people, when Persia and Rome would be conquered for you? `Abd ar-Rahman b `Auf said: We would say as Allah has commanded us and we would express our gratitude to Allah. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Nothing else besides it? You would (in fact) vie with one another, then you would feel jealous, then your relations would be estranged and then you will bear enmity against one another, or something to the same effect. Then you would go to the poor emigrants and would make some the masters of the others.
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye logo, tum kaisi haalat mein hoge jab Persia aur Rome tumhaare liye fatah kar liye jaayenge? Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha: Hum wahi kahenge jo Allah ne humein hukum diya hai aur hum Allah ka shukriya karenge. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Iske ilaawa aur kuch nahi? Tum waastav mein ek-doosre se pratispardha karoge, phir jalan mehsoos karoge, phir tumhaare rishte kamzor ho jaayenge aur phir tum ek-doosre se dushmani rakhoge, ya isi jaisa kuch. Phir tum gareeb Muhajirin ke paas jaaoge aur unmein se kuchhon ko doosron ka aaqa banaoge.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When one of you looks at one who stands at a higher level than you in regard to wealth and physical structure he should also see one who stands at a lower level than you in regard to these things (in which he stands) at a higher level (as compared to him).
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi apne se maal aur badan ki taraah mein bade darje ke shakhs ki taraf dekhe, use apne se kam darje wale ki taraf bhi dekhna chahiye (in maamlon mein jinmein woh khud se bade darje wale ki taraf dekhta hai).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Look at those who stand at a lower level than you but don't look at those who stand at a higher level than you, for that is better-suited that you do not disparage Allah's favors.

In the chain narrated by Abu Mu'awiya's he said: Upon you.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Un logon ki taraf dekho jo tumse kam darje mein hain, aur un logon ki taraf mat dekho jo tumse zyada darje mein hain, kyunki ye zyada munasib hai taaki tum Allah ki nematon ki qadar kam na karo. Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat ki hui sanad mein unhone kaha: Tumpar.

e: Abu Huraira, narrated that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There were three persons in Bani Isra'il, one suffering from leprosy, the other bald-headed and the third one blind. Allah decided to test them. So He sent an angel who came to the one who was suffering from leprosy and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful colour and fine skin and removal of that which makes me detestable in the eye of people. He wiped him and his illness was no more and he was conferred upon beautiful colour and beautiful skin. He (the angel) again said: Which property do you like most? He said: Camels, or he said: The cow the narrator is, however, doubtful about it, but (out of the persons) suffering from leprosy or baldness one of them definitely said: The camel. And the other one said: Cow. And he (one who demanded camel) was bestowed upon a she-camel, in an advanced stage of pregnancy, and while giving he said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the bald-headed person and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful hair and that (this baldness) may be removed from me because of which people hate me. He wiped his body and his illness was removed and he was bestowed upon beautiful hair, and the angel said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The cow. And he was given a pregnant cow and while handing it over to him he (the angel) said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the blind man and he said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Allah should restore my eyesight so that I should be able to see people with the help of that. He wiped his body and Allah restored to him his eyesight, and he (the angel) also said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The flock of sheep. And he was given a pregnant goat and that gave birth to young ones and it so happened that one valley abounded in camels and the other one in cows and the third one in sheep. He then came to the one who had suffered from leprosy in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a poor person and my provision has run short in my journey and there is none to take me to my destination except with the help of Allah and your favour. I beg of you in His name Who gave you fine colour and fine skin, and the camel in the shape of wealth (to confer upon me) a camel which should carry me in my journey. He said: I have many responsibilities to discharge. Thereupon he said: I perceive as if I recognise you. Were you not suffering from leprosy whom people hated and you were a destitute and Allah conferred upon you (wealth)? He said: I have inherited this property from my forefathers. Thereupon he said: If you are a liar may Allah change you to that very position in which you had been. He then came to the one who was bald-headed in his (old) form and said to him the same what he had said to him (one suffering from leprosy) and he gave him the same reply as he had given him and he said: If you are a liar, may Allah turn you to your previous position in which you had been. And then he came to the blind man in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a destitute person and a wayfarer. My provision have ran short and today there is no way to reach the destination but with the help of Allah and then with your help and I beg of you in the (name) of One Who restored your eyesight and gave you the flock of sheep to give me a sheep by which I should be able to make my provisions for the journey. He said: I was blind and Allah restored to me my eyesight; you take whatever you like and leave whatever you like. By Allah, I shall not stand in your way today for what you take in the name of God. Thereupon, he said: You keep with you what you have (in your possession). The fact is that you three were put to test and Allah is well pleased with you and He is annoyed with your companions.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banu Isra'il mein teen log the, ek kodh se pareshaan, doosra ganjaapan se aur teesra andha. Allah ne unki pareeksha lene ka faisla kiya. Isliye Usne ek Farishta bheja jo kodh se pareshaan shakhs ke paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Khoobsurat rang aur achhi khaal, aur woh cheez jo mujhe logon ki nazron mein ghinauna banaati hai woh door ho jaaye. Usne use ponchha aur uski beemari khatm ho gayi aur use khoobsurat rang aur khoobsurat khaal di gayi. Usne (Farishte ne) dobara kaha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Oont, ya usne kaha: gaay - raawi ko isper shak hai, lekin (in do logon mein se) kodh ya ganjapan se pareshaan shakhs mein se ek ne zaroor kaha: Oont. Aur doosre ne kaha: Gaay. Aur use (oont maangne wale ko) ek garbhvati oontni di gayi, aur dete waqt usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Allah tumhe ismein barkat de. Phir woh ganje shakhs ke paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Khoobsurat baal aur (ye ganjapan) jiski wajah se log mujhse ghrina karte hain woh mujhse door ho jaaye. Usne uska badan ponchha aur uski beemari door ho gayi aur use khoobsurat baal diye gaye, aur Farishte ne kaha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Gaay. Aur use ek garbhvati gaay di gayi, aur use sopte huye usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Allah tumhe ismein barkat de. Phir woh andhe shakhs ke paas aaya aur usne kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Allah meri roshni wapas de taaki main logon ko dekh sakoon. Usne uska badan ponchha aur Allah ne uski aankhon ki roshni wapas kar di, aur usne (Farishte ne) ye bhi poocha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Bhedon ka jhund. Aur use ek garbhvati bakri di gayi jisne bachche paida kiye aur aisa hua ki ek waadi oonton se bhar gayi aur doosri gaayon se aur teesri bhedon se. Phir woh (Farishta) us shakhs ke paas aaya jo pehle kodh se pareshaan tha, apne purane rang-soorat mein, aur usne kaha: Main ek gareeb shakhs hoon aur meri safar mein rasad khatm ho gayi hai aur Allah ki madad aur tumhaari meherbaani ke bina koi mera manzil tak pahunchne mein sahaayak nahi hai. Main tumse Uske naam par bhikh maangta hoon Jisne tumhe khoobsurat rang aur khoobsurat khaal di aur maal ke soorat mein oont diya (mujhe) ek oont dijiye jo mere safar mein mujhe le jaaye. Usne kaha: Mere paas bahut zimmedaariyaan hain. Isper usne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai jaise main tumhe pehchaanta hoon. Kya tum kodh se pareshaan nahi the jinse log ghrina karte the aur tum gareeb the, aur Allah ne tumhe (ye sab) diya? Usne kaha: Ye maal mujhe apne poorvajon se virasat mein mila hai. Isper usne kaha: Agar tum jhoote ho, to Allah tumhe usi haalat mein wapas kar de jismein tum pehle the. Phir woh us shakhs ke paas aaya jo pehle ganja tha, apne purane soorat mein, aur usne wahi kaha jo usne (kodh waale se) kaha tha aur usne bhi wahi jawaab diya jo usne (kodh waale ne) diya tha, aur usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Agar tum jhoote ho, to Allah tumhe wapas usi haalat mein le aaye jismein tum pehle the. Phir woh us andhe shakhs ke paas aaya, apne purane soorat mein, aur usne kaha: Main ek gareeb musaafir hoon. Meri rasad khatm ho chuki hai aur aaj mere paas manzil tak pahunchne ka koi zariya nahi hai siwaay Allah ki madad ke aur phir tumhaari madad ke, aur main tumse Us Hasti ke naam par bhikh maangta hoon Jisne tumhaari aankhon ki roshni wapas di, mujhe ek bhed dijiye jisse main apni safar ke liye rasad jama kar sakoon. Usne kaha: Main andha tha aur Allah ne mujhe (meri) aankhon ki roshni wapas di; tum jo chaaho le lo aur jo chaaho chhod do. Allah ki qasam, main aaj tumhe kisi bhi cheez lene se nahi rokunga jo tum Allah ke naam par lete ho. Isper usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Tum jo kuch tumhaare paas hai apne paas hi rakho. (Asal baat ye hai ki) tum teenon ki pareeksha li gayi thi aur Allah tumse khush hai aur tumhaare saathiyon se naaraaz hai.

e: It is reported on the authority of Amir b. Sa'd that Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas was in the fold of his camels that his son 'Umar came to him. When Sa'd saw him he said: I seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of this rider. And as he got down he said to him: You are busy with your camels and your sheep and you have abandoned people who are contending with one another for kingdom. Sa'd struck his chest and said: Keep quite. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah loves the servant who is God-conscious and is free from want and is hidden (from the view of people).
hi: Amir bin Sa'd ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas apne oonton ke bade mein the ki unke bete Umar unke paas aaye. Jab Sa'd ne unhe dekha, unhone kaha: Main is savaar ki bura-baat se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Aur jab woh (Umar) utre, unhone unse kaha: Aap apne oonton aur apni bhedon mein masroof hain aur aapne un logon ko chhod diya hai jo baadshaahat ke liye aapas mein jhagad rahe hain. Sa'd ne apni chhaati par thoka aur kaha: Khamosh raho. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah us banda se muhabbat karta hai jo Allah ka Dar rakhta hai, zaroorat se mukt hai aur (logon ki nazron se) chhupa hua hai.

e: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas is reported to have, said: By Allah, I am the first person amongst the Arabs to throw an arrow in the cause of Allah and we used to go with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was no food for us to eat but only the leaves of hubla and samur trees (they are wild trees) and as a result thereof one amongst us would relieve himself as does the goat. (How strange it is) that now the people of Banu Asad (the progeny of Zubair) instruct me in religion and try to impose punishment upon me (in regard to it). If it is so (that I am so ignorant of religion), then indeed, I am undone and my deeds have been lost. Ibn Numair, however, did not make a mention of the word (idhan) thus? (in his narration).
hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ki qasam, main Arabon mein sabse pehla shakhs hoon jisne Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaya, aur hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jaate the aur humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi hota tha siwaay hubla aur samur (kaanTedaar jangli darakhton) ke pattoon ke, aur iske natije mein humme se koi bakri jaisa (mal) tyaag karta. (Kitni ajeeb baat hai) ki ab Banu Asad ke log (Zubair ki aulad) mujhe deen mein taalim dete hain aur mujhpar (iske baare mein) saza thopne ki koshish karte hain. Agar aisa hai (ki main deen ke baare mein itna anjaan hoon), to yaqeenan main barbaad ho gaya hoon aur mere amal barbaad ho chuke hain. Ibn Numair ne, halaanki, apni riwayat mein "idhan" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il b. Khalid with the same chain of transmitters and the words are: " One amongst us would relieve himself as the goats do without anything mixing with its excrement."
hi: Ye hadees Ismail bin Khalid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Humme se koi bakriyon ki tarah tyaag karta bina kisi cheez ke uske mal mein mile."

e: 'Umair al-'Adawi reported: 'Utba b. Ghazwan delivered us a sermon and he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: Now coming to the point, verily the world has been given the news of its end and that too quite early. Nothing would be left out of it but only water left in the utensil which its owner leaves, and you are going to shift to an abode which knows no end, and you should shift with the good before you, for we have been told that a stone would be thrown at one side of the Hell and it would go down even for seventy years but would not be able to reach its bottom. By Allah, it would be fully packed. Do you find it something strange, and it has been mentioned that there yawns a distance which one would be able to cover in forty years from one end to another of Paradise, and a day would come when it would be fully packed and you must be knowing that I was the seventh amongst seven who had been with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing to eat but the leaves of the tree until the corners of the mouth were injured. We found a sheet which we tore in two and divided between myself and Sa'd b. Malik. I made the lower garment with halt of it and so did Sa'd make the lower garment with half of it and today there is none amongst us who has not become the governor of a city from amongst the cities (of the Islamic Commonwealth) and I seek refuge with Allah that I should consider myself great whereas I am insignificant in the eye of Allah. Prophethood does not remain for ever and its impact fades with the result that it changes eventually into kingship, and you would soon come to know and experience those rulers who would come after us and see (how far they are from religion).
hi: Umair al-Adawi ne bayan kiya: Utba bin Ghazwan ne humein khutba diya aur Allah ki hamd ki, phir kaha: Ab humaare maqsad par aate hain, yaqeenan, duniya ko uske ant ki khabar mil chuki hai aur ye khabar bhi kaafi jaldi mili hai. Ismein se kuch nahi bachega siwaay us paani ke jo bartan mein bacha hota hai jise uska maalik chhod deta hai, aur tumhe ek aise Thikaane ki taraf badhna hai jiska koi ant nahi, aur tumhe achhaai lekar aage badhna chahiye, kyunki humein bataya gaya hai ki Jahannam ki ek taraf ek patthar phenka jaayega aur woh sattar saal tak neeche girta rahega lekin uske tal tak nahi pahunch paayega. Allah ki qasam, ye poori tarah bhar jaayegi. Kya tumhe ye hairat-angez lagta hai? Aur ye bhi kaha gaya hai ki Jannat ke ek sire se doosre sire tak itni doori phaili hui hai jise koi chaalis saal mein tay kar paayega, aur ek din aayega jab ye bhi bhar jaayegi, aur tumhe pata hona chahiye ki main saat logon mein saatvan tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the aur humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi tha siwaay darakht ke pattoon ke, yahan tak ki humaare munh ke konon mein zakhm ho gaye. Humein ek chaadar mili jise humne do hisson mein phaada aur mere aur Sa'd bin Malik ke beech baant liya. Maine iske aadhe hisse se apna neeche pehna jaane wala kapda banaaya aur Sa'd ne bhi apne aadhe hisse se aisa hi kiya, aur aaj humme se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jo (Islami hukumat mein) kisi shehar ka gavarnar na bana ho, aur main Allah ki panah maangta hoon ki main khud ko bada samjhoon jabki main Allah ki nazar mein bahut chhota hoon. Nabuwwat hamesha ke liye nahi rehti aur iska prabhaav dheere-dheere kam hota hai, natijatan, ye aakhirkaar baadshaahat mein badal jaati hai, aur tum jald hi un shaasakon ke baare mein jaanoge aur unka anubhav karoge jo humaare baad aayenge (aur dekhoge ki woh deen se kitne door hain).

e: Khalid b. 'Umair reported and he had seen the pre-Islamic days also, that 'Uqba b. Ghazwan delivered this address and he was the governor of Basra. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Shaiban.
hi: Khalid bin Umair, jinhone Islam se pehle ka daur bhi dekha tha, ne bayan kiya ki Uqba bin Ghazwan ne ye khutba diya aur woh Basra ke gavarnar the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Shaiban ne riwayat ki.

e: Khalid b. Umair reported: I heard Uqba b. Ghazwan as saving: I found myself as the seventh amongst the seven who had been along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We had nothing to eat but the leaves of hubla (a wild tree) until the corners of our mouths were injured.
hi: Khalid bin Umair ne bayan kiya: Maine Uqba bin Ghazwan ko ye kehte suna: Main saat logon mein saatvan tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the. Humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi tha siwaay hubla (ek jangli darakht) ke pattoon ke, yahan tak ki humaare munh ke konon mein zakhm ho gaye.

e: Abu Huraira reported that they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, will we be able to see our Lord on the Day of Judgment? He said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the sun in the noon when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. He again said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the moon on the fourteenth night when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. Thereupon he said: By Allah Who is One in Whose Hand is my life. you will not face any difficulty in seeing your Lord but only so much as you feel in seeing one of them. Then Allah would sit in judgment upon the servant and would say: O, so and so, did I not honour you and make you the chief and provide you the spouse and subdue for you horses, camels, and afforded you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes. And then it would be said: Did you not think that you would meet Us? And he would say: No. Thereupon He (Allah) would say: Well, We forget you as you forgot Us. Then the second person would be brought for judgment. (And Allah would) say: 0, so and so. did We not honour you and make you the chief and make you pair and subdue for you horses and camels and afford you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes, my Lord. And He (the Lord) would say: Did you not think that you would be meeting Us? And he would say: No. And then He (Allah) would say: Well, I forget you today as you forgot Us. Then the third -one would be brought and He (Allah) would say to him as He said before. And he (the third person) would say: O, my Lord, I affirmed my faith in Thee and in Thy Book and in Thy Messenger and I observed prayer and fasts and gave charity, and he would speak in good terms like this as he would be able to do. And He (Allah) would say: Well, We will bring our witnesses to you. And the man would think in his mind who would bear witness upon him and then his mouth would be sealed and it would be said to his thighs, to his flesh and to his bones to speak and his thighs. flesh and bones would bear witness to his deeds and it would be done so that he should not be able to make any excuse for himself and he would be a hypocrite and Allah would be annoyed with him.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Pavitr Nabi ke Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekh paayenge? Unhone farmaaya: Kya tumhe dopahar ke waqt suraj dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai jab uspar koi baadal na ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone phir kaha: Kya tumhe chaudhvin raat ko chaand dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai jab uspar koi baadal na ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jo Akeli hai aur Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, tumhe apne Rab ko dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi, siwaay itni jitni tumhe inmein se ek ko dekhne mein hoti hai. Phir Allah banda ka hisaab lenge aur farmaayenge: Aye falan-falan, kya Maine tumhe izzat nahi di aur tumhe sardaar nahi banaya aur tumhe zauja nahi di aur ghode aur oont tumhaare adheen nahi kiye aur tumhe apni praja par raaj karne ka mauka nahi diya? Woh kahega: Zaroor. Aur phir kaha jaayega: Kya tumne ye nahi socha tha ki tum Humse miloge? Aur woh kahega: Nahi. Isper Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Hum tumhe bhula denge jaise tumne Humein bhula diya tha. Phir doosre shakhs ko hisaab ke liye laaya jaayega. (Aur Allah farmaayenge) Aye falan-falan, kya Humne tumhe izzat nahi di aur tumhe sardaar nahi banaya aur tumhe zauja nahi di aur ghode aur oont tumhaare adheen nahi kiye aur tumhe apni praja par raaj karne ka mauka nahi diya? Woh kahega: Haan, mere Rab. Aur Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Kya tumne ye nahi socha ki tum Humse miloge? Aur woh kahega: Nahi. Aur phir Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Main tumhe aaj bhula deta hoon jaise tumne Humein bhula diya tha. Phir teesra shakhs laaya jaayega aur Woh (Allah) usse wahi kahenge jo pehle kaha tha. Aur woh (teesra shakhs) kahega: Aye mere Rab, maine Tujhpar aur Teri Kitaab par aur Tere Rasool par apna imaan pushT kiya aur main namaz padhta tha, roze rakhta tha aur sadaqa deta tha, aur woh achhe alfaazon mein baat karega jitna woh kar sakega. Aur Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Hum tumhaare khilaaf Apne gawaah laayenge. Aur woh shakhs (khud se) sochega ki kaun uske khilaaf gawaahi dega, aur uska munh band kar diya jaayega aur uski jaanghon, uske gosht aur uski haddiyon se kaha jaayega ki woh bolein aur uski jaanghen, gosht aur haddiyaan uske amalon ki gawaahi denge, aur ye is tarah kiya jaayega taaki woh khud ke liye koi bahaana na de paaye aur woh ek munafiq hoga aur Allah usse naaraaz honge.

e: Anas b. Malik reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he smiled, and said: Do you know why I laughed? We said: Allah and His Messenger, know best. Thereupon he said: It was because (there came to my mind the) talk which the servant would have with his Lord (on the Day of judgment). He would say: My Lord, have you not guaranteed me protection against injustice? He would say: Yes. Then the servant would say: I do not deem valid any witness against me but my own self, and He would say: Well, enough would be the witness of your self against you and that of the two angels who had been appointed to record your deeds. Then the seal would be set upon his mouth and it would be said to his hands and feet to speak and they would speak of his deeds. Then the mouth would be made free to talk, he would say (to the hands and feet): Be away, let there be curse of Allah upon you. It was for your safety that I contended.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the jab woh muskuraaye aur kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai maine kyun hansi? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: (Ye is baat ki wajah se tha ki mere zehan mein aayi) woh baatchit jo banda apne Rab se (Qayamat ke din) karega. Woh kahega: Mere Rab, kya Aapne mujhe anyaay se hifaazat ka bharosa nahi diya? Woh farmaayenge: Zaroor. Phir banda kahega: Main apne khud ke siwaay kisi aur ki gawaahi mahatva nahi deta jo mere khilaaf ho. Aur Woh farmaayenge: Achha, tumhaari khud ki gawaahi tumhaare khilaaf kaafi hai, aur do Farishton ki bhi jinhe tumhaare amal darj karne ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya tha. Phir uske munh par muhur laga di jaayegi aur uske haathon aur paeron se kaha jaayega ki woh bolein aur woh uske amalon ke baare mein bolenge. Phir munh ko bolne ke liye azaad kar diya jaayega, woh (haath-paeron se) kahega: Door raho, tumpar Allah ki laanat ho. Tumhaari hi hifaazat ke liye to main jhagad raha tha.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, make for the family of Muhammad the provision which is a bare subsistence.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ke khaandaan ke liye itni hi rozi kar jitni bas zaroorat poori kar sake.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: 0 Allah, provide for the, family of Muhammad their subsistence, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of 'Amr (the words are):" O Allah, provide us subsistence"
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ke khaandaan ke liye unki rozi mahaiyaa kar, aur Amr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Aye Allah, humein rozi de."

e: 'Umara b. al-Qa'qa' reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters but instead of the word" qut" (bare subsistence) there has been used the word" Kafaf" (adequate means to meet the needs).
hi: Umara bin Qa'qa ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai lekin "Qut" (bas zaroorat poori karne wali rozi) lafz ki jagah "Kafaf" (zaroorton ko poora karne ke liye kaafi saadhan) lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never had the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eaten to the fill since their, arrival in Medina with the bread of wheat for three successive nights until his (Holy Prophet's) death.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Madina aane ke baad se Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi lagataar teen raaton tak gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, unki maut tak.

e: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eat to his fill the bread of wheat for three successive days until he had run the course of his life.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi lagataar teen dinon tak gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, apne zindagi ke daur mein.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never did the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eat to the fill the bread of barley for two successive days until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi lagataar do dinon tak jau ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat tak.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) (afford to eat to the fill) the bread of wheat beyond three days (successively).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi teen dinon se zyada gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi (lagataar).

e: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (may peace. be upon him) (afford to eat) the bread of wheat for three (successive days) until he ran the course of his life.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ko kabhi lagataar teen dinon tak (khaane ko) gehun ki roti nahi mili, unki poori zindagi mein.

e: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) (afford to eat) the bread of wheat for two days successively. Even (out of these two days) one (was such wherein he could get) only a date.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ko kabhi lagataar do dinon tak (khaane ko) gehun ki roti nahi mili. In do dinon mein se ek din bhi sirf ek khajoor hi mili.

e: 'A'isha reported: We the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) used to spend (the whole) month in which we (did not need to) kindle the fire as (we had nothing to cook) ; we had only dates and water (to fill our bellies).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum, Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan, poora mahina bina aag jalaaye guzaarte (kyunki humaare paas pakaane ko kuch nahi hota); humaare paas sirf khajoor aur paani hota (pet bharne ke liye).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " We used to spend-" And he did not make a mention of the family of Muhammad (ﷺ), and Abu Kuraib made this addition to his hadith which was transmitted on the authority of Ibn Numair (and the words are):" But this that there was brought to us some meat."
hi: Ye hadees Urwa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Hum guzaarte the." Aur unhone Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ka koi zikr nahi kiya, aur Abu Kuraib ne apni hadees mein ye izafa kiya jo unhone Ibn Numair ki sanad se riwayat ki: "Lekin kabhi hume gosht mil jaata."

e: `A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in such a state) that there had been nothing in my wooden tub which a living being could afford to eat but a handful of barley. I had been eating out of that for a fairly long duration when I thought of measuring it and it was almost finished.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye ki mere lakdi ke bartan mein koi bhi zinda insaan khaa sakne laayak sirf ek muTThi jau tha. Main kaafi lambe waqt tak usmein se khaati rahi yahan tak ki maine socha ki ise naap loon aur woh takriban khatm ho chuka tha.

e: 'A'isha used to say to 'Urwa: Son of my sister, by Allah, I used to see the new moon, then the new moon, then the new moon, i. e. three moons in two months, and fire was not kindled in the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I ('Urwa) said: Auntie, then what were your means of sustenance? She said: Dates and water. But it (so happened) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had some Ansar as his neighbours and they had milch animals and they used to send to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some milk of their (animals) and he served that to us.
hi: Aisha (RA) Urwa se kaha karti thin: Mere behn ke bete, Allah ki qasam, maine naya chaand dekha, phir naya chaand, phir naya chaand, yaani do mahinon mein teen chaand, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar mein aag nahi jalaayi jaati thi. Maine (Urwa ne) kaha: Chachi, phir aapki rozi ka zariya kya tha? Unhone kaha: Khajoor aur paani. Lekin (ye bhi hua ki) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Ansar padosi the aur unke paas doodh dene wale jaanwar the aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas unka kuch doodh bhejte the aur woh humein pila dete the.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), that she said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in a state) that it never happened that he could eat to his fill the bread with olive oil twice during a day.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye ki aisa kabhi nahi hua ki unhone din mein do baar zaitun ke tel ke saath roti pet bharkar khayi ho.

e: 'A'isha reported this hadith through other chains of transmitters also (and the words are) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in a state) when the people could afford to eat only the dates and water.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne ye hadees kuch aur sanadon ke zariye bhi riwayat ki (aur alfaaz hain) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye jab log sirf khajoor aur paani hi khaa-pee sakte the.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had died in a state that they could afford to eat two things only: water and dates.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye ki woh sirf do cheezein khaa-pee paate: paani aur khajoor.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sufyan and the words are: " We could not afford to eat to the fill even dates and water."
hi: Ye hadees Sufyan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Hum khajoor aur paani bhi pet bharkar nahi khaa-pee paate the.

e: Abu Huraira reported: By Him in Whose Hand is my life and Ibn 'Abbad also said: By One in Whose hand is the life of Abu Huraira, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) could not afford to provide adequate food to his family which could (fill their bellies) with bread and wheat for three days successively until he left the world.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai - aur Ibn Abbad ne bhi kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein Abu Huraira ki zindagi hai - Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne khaandaan ko lagataar teen dinon tak gehun ki roti pet bharkar khilaane ke liye kaafi rozi mahaiyaa nahi karvaa paaye, jab tak woh is duniya se rukhsat na huye.

e: Abu Hazim reported: I saw Abu Huraira point with his finger many a time and saying: By One in Whose Hand is the life of Abu Huraira, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) could not eat to his fill and provide his family bread of wheat beyond three days successively until he left the world.
hi: Abu Hazim ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira ko baar-baar apni ungli se ishara karte aur ye kehte dekha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein Abu Huraira ki zindagi hai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) pet bharkar khaana nahi khaa paate the aur apne khaandaan ko lagataar teen dinon se zyada gehun ki roti nahi khila paate the jab tak woh is duniya se rukhsat na huye.

e: Nu'man b. Bashir said: Don't you eat and drink according to your heart's desire, whereas I saw that your Prophet (ﷺ) (at times) could not find even an inferior quality of the dates with which he could fill his belly? Qutaiba, however, did not make a mention of It.
hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne kaha: Kya tum apne dil ki khwaish ke mutabik nahi khaate-peete, jabki maine dekha ki tumhaare Nabi (SAW) ko (kabhi-kabhi) ghatiya kism ki khajoorein bhi nahi milti thin jinse woh apna pet bhar sakein? Qutaiba ne, halaanki, iska zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters, with this addition of words: " You are not satisfied with the qualities of dates and butter."
hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Tum khajoor aur makkhan ki khoobiyon se santusht nahi ho."

e: Simak b. Barb reported: I heard Nu'man deliver an address in which he said that (Hadrat) Umar made a mention of what had fallen to the lot of people out of the material world and he said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spend the whole day being upset because of hunger and he could not get even an interior quality of dates with which he could fill his belly.
hi: Simak bin Harb ne bayan kiya: Maine Nu'man ko ek khutba dete suna jismein unhone kaha ki Umar ne is duniyaavi jeevan mein logon ke haath jo aaya uska zikr kiya aur unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bhookh ki wajah se poora din bechain hote dekha aur unhe ghatiya kism ki khajoorein bhi nahi mil paatin jinse woh apna pet bhar sakein.

e:
'Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli reported: I heard that a person asked 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As and heard him saying: Are we not amongst the destitute of the emigrants? Abdullah said to him: Have you a spouse with whom you live? He said: Yes. Abdullah asked: Do you not have a home in which you reside? The man replied "Yes." Abdullah said: Then you are amongst the rich. He said: I have a servant also. Thereupon he (Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As) said: Then you are amongst the kings. 
Abu 'Abd al-Rahman reported that three persons came to 'Abdullah b. Amr b. 'As while I was sitting with him and they said: By Allah, we have nothing with us either in the form of provision, riding animals or wealth. Thereupon he said to them: I am prepared to do whatever you like. If you come to us, we would give you what Allah would make available for you. and if you like I would make a mention of your case to the ruler, and if you like you can show patience also. for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The destitute amongst the emigrants would precede the rich emigrants by forty years in getting into Paradise on the Day of Resurrection. Thereupon they said: We then, show patience and do not ask for anything.
hi: Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli ne bayan kiya: Maine suna ki ek shakhs ne Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As se poocha, aur maine unhe (Abdullah ko) ye kehte suna: Kya hum Muhajirin ke tang-haal logon mein se nahi hain? Abdullah ne usse kaha: Kya tumhaari koi zauja hai jiske saath tum rehte ho? Usne kaha: Haan. Abdullah ne poocha: Kya tumhaare paas rehne ke liye koi ghar hai? Us shakhs ne jawaab diya: Haan. Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Phir to tum daulatmand logon mein se ho. Usne kaha: Mera ek naukar bhi hai. Isper unhone (Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ne) kaha: Phir to tum raajon jaise ho. Abu Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki teen log Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As ke paas aaye jab main unke saath baitha tha aur unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, humaare paas na khaana hai, na sawaari ka jaanwar, na maal. Isper unhone (Abdullah ne) unse kaha: Main jo bhi tumhe pasand ho karne ko taiyaar hoon. Agar tum humaare paas aao, hum tumhe woh denge jo Allah tumhaare liye mahaiyaa karayenge, aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhaare maamle ka zikr shaasak se karunga, aur agar tum chaaho to tum sabar bhi kar sakte ho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Muhajirin mein se tang-haal log daulatmand Muhajirin se chaalis saal pehle Jannat mein daakhil honge. Isper unhone kaha: Phir hum sabar karenge aur kuch bhi nahi maangenge.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said in connection with the people of Hijr (Thamud): Do not enter but weepingly (the habitations) of these people who had been punished by (Allah), and in case you do not feel inclined to weep, then do not enter (these habitations) that you may not meet the same calamity as had fallen to their lot.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hijr (Thamud qabile) ke logon ke silsile mein farmaaya: (In logon ke ghar) mein rote hue hi daakhil ho jinhe (Allah dwara) saza di gayi thi, aur agar tumhe rone ki khwaish nahi hoti, to (in ghar) mein daakhil hi mat ho, taaki tum unhi jaisi museebat ka saamna na karo.

e: Ibn Shihab reported, and he had been talking about the stony abodes of Thamud, and he said: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar said: We were passing along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through the habitations of Hijr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not enter but weepingly the habitations of these persons who committed tyranny among themselves, lest the same calamity should fall upon you as it fell upon them. He then urged his mount to proceed quickly and pass through that valley hurriedly.
hi: Ibn Shihab ne bayan kiya, aur woh Thamud qabile ke pathreele ghar-baar ke baare mein baat kar rahe the, aur unhone kaha: Salim bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hijr ki bastiyon se guzar rahe the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: In logon ke (ghar) mein rote hue hi daakhil ho jinhone aapas mein anyaay kiya, kahin tumpar bhi wahi museebat na aaye jo unpar aayi. Phir unhone apni sawaari ko tezi se aage badhaya aur us waadi se jaldi-jaldi guzar gaye.

e: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the people encamped along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the valley of Hijr, the habitations of Thamud, and they quenched their thirst from the wells thereof and kneaded the flour with it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that the water collected for drinking should be spilt and the flour should be given to the camels and commanded them that the water for drinking should be taken from that well where the she-camel (of Hadrat Salih) used to come.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hijr ki waadi mein, Thamud ki bastiyon mein, ruke aur unhone wahan ke kuon se apni pyaas bujhaayi aur usi paani se aata gundha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki peene ke liye ikattha kiya gaya paani beha diya jaaye aur aata oonton ko khilaaya jaaye, aur unhe hukum diya ki peene ka paani us kuen se liya jaaye jahan (Hazrat Saleh ki) oontni aati thi.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One who makes efforts (for earning to be spent) on a widow and the destitute is like a striver in the cause of Allah, and I think he also said: He is like one who constantly stands for prayer and observes fast without breaking it.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo koi bewa aur zaroorat-mand ki khaatir mehnat karta hai (rozi kamaane ke liye), woh Allah ki raah mein koshish karne wale jaisa hai, aur mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi farmaaya: Woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo lagataar namaz mein khada rehta hai aur roza rakhta hai bina toDe.

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One who looks after the orphan whether he is his relative or not, I and he would be together in Paradise like this, and Malik (explained it) with the gesture by drawing his index finger and middle finger close together.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo koi anaath ki dekhbhaal karta hai, chahe woh uska rishtedaar ho ya na ho, main aur woh Jannat mein is tarah saath honge, aur Malik ne (isse spashth karne ke liye) apni tarjani aur beech ki ungli ko jodkar dikhaya.

e: Abdullah al-Khaulani reported that when Uthman b. 'Affan tried to rebuild the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the people began to talk about this. Uthman b. 'Affan said: You discuss it very much whereas I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who builds a mosque-- and the narrator Bukair said: I think he also said: (for) seeking the pleasure of Allah- Allah would build (a similar house for him in Paradise). and in the narration of Harun (the words are):" A house for him in Paradise."
hi: Abdullah al-Khaulani ne bayan kiya ki jab Uthman bin Affan ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid ko dobara banaane ki koshish ki, log ismein baare mein baaten karne lage. Uthman bin Affan ne kaha: Tum ismein bahut zyada charcha karte ho jabki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo koi masjid banaata hai - aur raawi Bukair ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Allah ki khushi chaahte huye - Allah uske liye (Jannat mein aisi hi ek imaarat) banaayenge. Aur Harun ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar."

e: Mahmud b. Labid reported that 'Uthman b. 'Affan decided to rebuild the mosque (of Allah's Apostle in Medina) but the people did not like this idea and they wished that it should be preserved in the same (old) form. Thereupon he (Hadrat 'Uthman) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who builds a mosque for Allah, Allah would build for him (a house) in Paradise like it.
hi: Mahmud bin Labid ne bayan kiya ki Uthman bin Affan ne (Nabi ki) masjid ko dobara banaane ka faisla kiya lekin logon ko ye vichaar pasand nahi aaya aur woh chaahte the ki ise usi (purane) soorat mein rakha jaaye. Isper unhone (Hazrat Uthman ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo Allah ki khaatir masjid banaata hai, Allah uske liye (Jannat mein) uske jaisi (imaarat) banaayenge.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters with this variation (that the words are): " Allah would build for him a house in Paradise."
hi: Ye hadees Ja'far ki sanad se isi sanad se is alfaaz ke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaayenge."

e: Abu Huraira reported: While a person was in the wilderness he heard a voice from the cloud (commanding it thus): Irrigate the garden of so and so. (After that the clouds slinked aside and poured water on a stony ground. It filled a channel amongst the channels of that land and that person followed that water and he found a person standing in the garden busy in changing the course of water with the help of a hatchet. He said to him: Servant of Allah, what is your name? he said: So and so. And it was that very name which he had heard from the clouds. and he said to him: Servant of Allah, why do you ask me my name? He said: I heard a voice from the clouds of which is the downpour, saying: Water the garden of so and so, like your name. What do you do (for the favour) shown to you by Allah in this matter? He said: Now as you state so. I look what yield I get from it, and I give one-third as charity out of it and I and my children eat one-third of it and one-third I return to it as investment.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek shakhs registaan mein tha ki usne baadal se ek aawaaz suni (jo ise hukum de rahi thi): Falan-falan ke baag ko sinchit kar. Iske baad baadal alag hua aur usne ek pathreeli zameen par paani barsaaya. Iski wajah se us zameen ki naaliyon mein se ek naali paani se bhar gayi aur us shakhs ne us paani ka picha kiya aur usne ek shakhs ko us baag mein dekha jo kulhaadi se paani ka bahaav badalne mein masroof tha. Usne usse kaha: Allah ke bande, tumhaara naam kya hai? Usne kaha: Falan-falan, aur ye wahi naam tha jo usne baadalon se suna tha. Usne (us bagiche wale ne) usse kaha: Allah ke bande, tum mera naam kyun poochh rahe ho? Usne kaha: Maine baadal se ek aawaaz suni jismein se ye barish girti hai, jo keh rahi thi: Falan-falan ke baag ko sinchit kar, jaisa tumhaara naam hai. Is (barkat) ke badle tum kya karte ho jo Allah ne tumpar ki hai? Usne kaha: Ab jab tumne ye baat bataayi hai, main dekhta hoon ki ismein se mujhe kya paidaawaar milti hai, aur main iska ek-tihaai sadaqe mein deta hoon aur main aur mere bachche iska ek-tihaai khaate hain aur ek-tihaai main wapas ismein daalta hoon (nayi paidaawaar ke liye).
