e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Wahb b. Kaisan with the same chain of transmitters but with this change that he said: " I earmark one-third for the poor, the needy and the wayfarers."
hi: Ye hadees Wahb bin Kaisan ki sanad se isi sanad se is badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone kaha: "Main ek-tihaai gareeb, zaroorat-mand aur musaafiron ke liye alag rakhta hoon."

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as stating that Allah the Most High and Exalted said: I am the One, One Who does not stand in need of a partner. If anyone does anything in which he associates anyone else with Me, I shall abandon him with one whom he associates with Allah.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Allah, Buland aur Buzurg, ne farmaaya: Main Akela hoon, Jise kisi saathi ki zaroorat nahi hai. Agar koi shakhs koi aisa amal karta hai jismein woh doosron ko Mere saath shareek karta hai, Main use us (shareek kiye gaye) ke saath hi chhod dunga.

e: Ibn Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone wants to have his deeds widely publicised, Allah will publicise (his humiliation). And if anyone makes a hypocritical display (of his deeds) Allah will make a display of him.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo apne amalon ko logon ke saamne khaas taur par dikhaana chaahta hai (taaki uski tareef ho), Allah use (usi ki tarah) rusva karega. Aur jo dikhaava-pana karta hai, Allah use bhi (usi tarah) zaahir karega.

e: Jundub reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who wants to publicise (his deeds), Allah will publicise (his humility), and he who makes a hypocritical display (of his deeds), Allah will make a display of him.
hi: Jundub (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo apne amalon ko logon ko dikhaana chaahta hai, Allah use rusva karega, aur jo dikhaava-pana karta hai, Allah use zaahir karega.

e: Sufyan reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition: " I did not hear anyone saying besides him that it was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had said so."
hi: Sufyan ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur ye izafa kiya: "Maine unke ilaawa kisi aur ko ye kehte nahi suna ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya tha."

e: Salama b. Kuhail reported: I heard from Jundub, but I did not hear him say this: "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying this."
hi: Salama bin Kuhail ne bayan kiya: Maine ye baat Jundub se suni, lekin maine unhe ye kehte nahi suna: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna."

e: Abu Sufyan reported like that as as-Saduq al-Amin al-Walid b. Harb narrated with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Sufyan ne isi jaisi baat as-Saduq al-Amin (yaani Walid bin Harb) ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki.

e: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The servant speaks words for which he is sent down to the Hell-Fire farther than the distance between the east and the west.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine unhe (Allah ke Rasool ko) ye farmaate suna: Banda kuch aise alfaaz kehta hai jinki wajah se use poorab aur pashchim ke beech ki doori se bhi zyada doori tay karke Jahannam ki aag mein bheja jaata hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The servant speaks words that he does not understand its repercussions but he sinks down in Hell-Fire farther than the distance between the east and the west.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banda aise alfaaz kehta hai jinke natijon ko woh khud nahi samajhta, lekin woh Jahannam ki aag mein poorab aur pashchim ke beech ki doori se bhi zyada doori tak Dooba jaata hai.

e: Shaqiq reported that it was said to Usama b. Zaid: Why don't you visit 'Uthman and talk to him? Thereupon he said: Do you think that I have not talked to him but that I have made you hear? By Allah. I have talked to him (about things) concerning me and him and I did not like to divulge those things about which I had to take the initiative and I do not say to my ruler: "You are the best among people," after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A man will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and thrown in Hell-Fire and his intestines will pour forth in Hell and he will go round along with them, as an ass goes round the mill stone. The denizens of Hell would gather round him and say: O, so and so, what has happened to you? Were you not enjoining us to do what was reputable and forbid us to do what was disreputable? He will say: Of course, it is so; I used to enjoin (upon people) to do what was reputable but did not practise that myself. I had been forbidding people to do what was disreputable, but practised it myself.
hi: Shaqiq ne bayan kiya ki Usama bin Zaid se poocha gaya: Aap Uthman se milkar unse baat kyun nahi karte? Isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhe lagta hai ki maine unse baat nahi ki hai balki sirf tumhe sunane ke liye baat ki? Allah ki qasam, maine unse (unhi cheezon ke baare mein) baat ki hai jo mere aur unke beech ki baat hai aur mujhe ye pasand nahi ki main un baaton ko zaahir karun jinke liye mujhe sabse pehle pehal karni padegi, aur main apne shaasak se ye nahi kehta ki 'Aap logon mein sabse behtareen hain' jab se maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Qayamat ke din ek shakhs laaya jaayega aur Jahannam ki aag mein phenka jaayega aur uski antriyaan Jahannam mein bahar nikal aayengi aur woh unke saath is tarah chakkar kaatega jaise gadha chakki ke patthar ke gird ghoomta hai. Jahannam ke bashinde uske aas-paas ikattha honge aur kahenge: Falan-falan, tumhe kya hua? Kya tum humein achhaai ka hukum nahi dete the aur burai se nahi rokte the? Woh kahega: Zaroor, main achhaai ka hukum deta tha lekin khud us par amal nahi karta tha. Main burai se rokta tha lekin khud usmein masroof rehta tha.

e: Abu Wa'il reported: I was in the company of Usama b. Zaid that a person said: What prevents you to visit Uthman and talk to him for what he does? The rest of the hadith is the same.
hi: Abu Wa'il ne bayan kiya: Main Usama bin Zaid ki sohbat mein tha ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Aap Uthman se milkar unke amal ke baare mein baat kyun nahi karte? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: All the people of my Ummah would get pardon for their sins except those who publicise them. And (it means) that a servant should do a deed during the night and tell the people in the morning that he has done so and so, whereas Allah has concealed it. And he does a deed during the day and when it is night he tells the people, whereas Allah has concealed it. Zuhair has used the word hijar for publicising.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Meri Ummat ke sab logon ko unke gunahon ki maafi milegi siwaay un logon ke jo unhe zaahir karte hain. Aur (iska matlab hai) ki banda raat ko koi amal karta hai aur subah logon ko batata hai ki maine aisa-aisa kiya, jabki Allah ne use chhupaya tha, aur woh din mein koi amal karta hai aur jab raat hoti hai to logon ko batata hai, jabki Allah ne use chhupaya tha. Zuhair ne 'Hijar' lafz zaahir karne ke liye istemal kiya hai.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that two persons sneezed in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He (the Messenger of Allah) invoked mercy for one, and did not invoke for the other. The one for whom he had not prayed said: So and so sneezed and you said: May Allah have mercy upon you. I also sneezed but you did not utter these words for me. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: That person praised Allah, and you did not praise Allah.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein do logon ko chhink aayi. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) ek ke liye Rehmat ki dua ki aur doosre ke liye nahi ki. Jiske liye unhone dua nahi ki, usne kaha: Falan-falan ko chhink aayi aur aapne kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare. Mujhe bhi chhink aayi lekin aapne mere liye ye alfaaz nahi kahe. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Us shakhs ne Allah ki hamd ki thi aur tumne Allah ki hamd nahi ki.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Burda reported: I visited Abu Musa, as he was in the house of the daughter of Fadl b. 'Abbas. I sneezed but he did not respond to it (by saying): Allah may have mercy upon you. Then she sneezed and he (Fadl b. 'Abbas) said: May Allah have mercy upon you. I came back to my mother and informed her about it, and when he came to her she said: My son sneezed in your presence and you did not say:" Allah may have mercy upon you, and she sneezed and you said for her:" May Allah have mercy upon you." Thereupon he said: Your son sneezed but he did not praise Allah and I did not beg mercy of Allah for him and she sneezed and she praised Allah and so I said: May Allah have mercy upon you, as I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you sneezes he should praise Allah and the other should say: May Allah have mercy upon you, and if he does not praise Allah, no mercy should be begged for him.
hi: Abu Burda ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Musa se milne gaya jab woh Fadl bin Abbas ki beti ke ghar mein the. Mujhe chhink aayi lekin unhone iska jawaab (Allah tumpar rehmat kare kehkar) nahi diya. Phir usne (larki ne) chhink li aur unhone (Fadl bin Abbas ne) kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare. Main apni maa ke paas wapas gaya aur unhe iski jaankaari di, aur jab woh unke paas aaye, unhone kaha: Mere bete ko aapki maujoodgi mein chhink aayi aur aapne 'Allah tumpar rehmat kare' nahi kaha, aur ise (larki ko) chhink aayi to aapne uske liye kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare. Isper unhone kaha: Tumhaare bete ko chhink aayi lekin usne Allah ki hamd nahi ki, isliye maine uske liye Allah se rehmat nahi maangi, aur usne (larki ne) chhink li aur Allah ki hamd ki, isliye maine kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi chhinke use Allah ki hamd karni chahiye aur doosre ko kehna chahiye: Allah tumpar rehmat kare, aur agar usne Allah ki hamd nahi ki, to uske liye rehmat na maangi jaaye.

e: Iyas b. Salama b. al-Akwa reported that his father reported to him that he heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A person sneezed in his presence and he said to him: May Allah have mercy upon you. And he then sneezed for the second time and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: He is suffering from cold (and no response is necessary).
hi: Iyas bin Salama bin al-Akwa ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs ko unki maujoodgi mein chhink aayi aur unhone usse kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare. Phir usne doosri baar chhink li aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Ye zukaam hai (isliye is baar koi jawaab zaroori nahi).

e: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The yawning as from the devil. So when one of you yawns he should try to restrain it as far as it lies in his power.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jamhaai Shaitaan ki taraf se hai, isliye jab tum mein se koi jamhaai le, use apni poori taakat se ise rokne ki koshish karni chahiye.

e: The son of Abu Said al-Khudri reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When one of you yawns, he should keep his mouth shut with the help of his hand, for it is the devil that enters therein.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ke bete ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi jamhaai le, use apne haath se apna munh band kar lena chahiye, kyunki isi mein Shaitaan daakhil hota hai.

e: The son of Abu Said al-Khudri reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When one of you yawns, he should try to restrain it with cue help of his hand since it is the Satan that enters therein.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ke bete ne apne waalid ke hawaale se riwayat ki ki jamhaai ko haath se rokne ki koshish karni chahiye.

e: The son of Abu Said al-Khudri reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. When one of you yawns while engaged in prayer, he should try to restrain so far as it lies in his power, since it is the Satan that enter therein.
hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ke bete ne apne waalid ke hawaale se riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein jamhaai le, use apni poori taakat se ise rokne ki koshish karni chahiye, kyunki isi mein Shaitaan daakhil hota hai.

e: Abu Said al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Angels were born out of light and the Jinns were born out of the spark of fire and Adam was born as he has been defined (in the Qur'an) for you (i. e. he is fashioned out of clay).
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Farishte Noor se banaaye gaye hain aur Jinn aag ki chingaari se banaaye gaye hain, aur Aadam usi tarah banaaye gaye jaisa Quran mein tumhe bataya gaya hai (yaani mitti se).

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A group of Bani Isra'il was lost. I do not know what happened to it, but I think (that it 'underwent a process of metamorphosis) and assumed the shape of rats. Don't you see when the milk of the camel is placed before them, these do not drink and when the milk of goat is placed before them, these do drink. Abu Huraira said: I narrated this very hadith to Ka'b and he said: Did you hear this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? I (Abu Huraira) said: Yes. He said this again and again, and I said: Have I read Torah? This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ishaq with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Banu Isra'il ka ek giroh gum ho gaya. Mujhe nahi pata unka kya hua, lekin mujhe lagta hai (ki unka soorat badal gaya aur) unhone chuhon ka soorat dhaaran kar liya. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki jab unke saamne oont ka doodh rakha jaata hai, woh nahi peete, aur jab bakri ka doodh rakha jaata hai, woh pee lete hain. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Maine yehi hadees Ka'b ko riwayat ki aur unhone kaha: Kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone ye baar-baar poocha aur maine kaha: Kya main Torah padhta hoon? Ye hadees Ishaq ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Huraira reported that the rat (is the result of) metamorphosis (of a group of Bani Isra'il) and the proof of this is that when the milk of goat is placed before it, it drinks it, and when the milk of the camel is placed before it, it would not taste it at all. Ka'b said: Did you hear it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: Has Torah been revealed to me?
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki chuha (Banu Isra'il ke ek giroh ka) soorat badli hua soorat hai, aur iska saboot ye hai ki jab bakri ka doodh iske saamne rakha jaata hai, ye ise peeta hai, aur jab oont ka doodh iske saamne rakha jaata hai, ye ise bilkul nahi chakhta. Ka'b ne kaha: Kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Isper unhone kaha: Kya mujhpar Torah nazil ki gayi hai?

e: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The believer does not allow to be stung twice from one (and the same) hole. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Momin ek hi bil se do baar nahi dansa jaata (yaani woh ek hi galti dobara nahi karta). Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Suhaib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Strange are the ways of a believer for there is good in every affair of his and this is not the case with anyone else except in the case of a believer for if he has an occasion to feel delight, he thanks (God), thus there is a good for him in it, and if he gets into trouble and shows resignation (and endures it patiently), there is a good for him in it.
hi: Suhaib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Momin ka maamla ajeeb hai, kyunki uske har maamle mein achhaai hai, aur ye kisi aur ke liye nahi hai siwaay momin ke, kyunki agar use khushi mile, woh (Allah ka) shukriya karta hai, aur isse use achhaai milti hai, aur agar use koi museebat aaye aur woh sabar dikhaaye (aur ise bardaasht kare), to isse bhi use achhaai milti hai.

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported on the authority of his father that a person praised another person in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: Woe be to thee, you have broken the neck of your friend, you have broken the neck of your friend-he said this twice. If one of you has to praise his friend at all, he should say: I think (him to be) so and Allah knows it well and I do not know the secret of the heart and Allah knows the destined end, and I cannot testify his purity against Allah but (he appears) to be so and so.
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein doosre shakhs ki tareef ki. Isper unhone farmaaya: Tumpar afsos, tumne apne dost ki gardan tod di - unhone ye do baar kaha. Agar tum mein se koi apne dost ki tareef karni hi chahe, use kehna chahiye: Mujhe lagta hai ki woh aisa-aisa hai, aur Allah hi behtar jaanta hai, aur main dil ke raaz nahi jaanta aur Allah anjaam jaanta hai, aur main Allah ke saamne uski pavitrata ki gawaahi nahi de sakta, lekin (woh) aisa-aisa lagta hai.

e: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported on the authority of his father that a person was mentioned in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and a person said: Allah's Messenger, no person is more excellent than he after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Woe be to thee, you have broken the neck of your friend, and he said this twice. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If anyone has to praise his brother at all, he should say: I think him to be so and so, and even on this he should say: I do not consider anyone purer than Allah (considers).
hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakra ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ek shakhs ka zikr hua, aur ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ke Rasool ke baad koi shakhs usse zyada behtareen nahi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumpar afsos, tumne apne dost ki gardan tod di, aur unhone ye do baar kaha. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar koi apne bhai ki tareef karni hi chaahe, use kehna chahiye: Mujhe lagta hai ki woh aisa-aisa hai, aur isper bhi use kehna chahiye: Main Allah se zyada kisi ko pavitra nahi maanta.

e: his hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a person lauding another person or praising him too much. Thereupon he said: You killed him, or you sliced the back of a person.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko doosre shakhs ki bahut zyada tareef karte ya tareef mein bahut aage badhte dekha. Isper unhone farmaaya: Tumne use maar diya, ya tumne (us shakhs ki) peeth kaat di.

e: Abu Ma'mar reported that a person lauded a ruler amongst the rulers and Miqdad began to throw dust upon him and he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us that we should throw dust upon the faces of those who shower too much praise.
hi: Abu Ma'mar ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne shaasakon mein se ek shaasak ki tareef ki aur Miqdad uspar mitti phenkne lage aur unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya tha ki hum un logon ke chehre par mitti phenkein jo bahut zyada tareef karte hain.

e: Hammam b. al-Harith reported that a person began to praise 'Uthman and Miqdad sat upon his knee; and he was a bulky person and began to throw pebbles upon his (flatterer's) face. Thereupon 'Uthman said: What is the matter with you? And he said: Verily, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When you see those who shower (undue) praise (upon others), throw dust upon their faces.
hi: Hammam bin Harith ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Uthman ki tareef karne laga aur Miqdad apne ghutnon ke bal baithe - aur woh ek bhaari-bharkam shakhs the - aur unhone uske (tareef karne waale ke) chehre par kankad phenkne shuru kar diye. Isper Uthman ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Aur unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum aisi logon ko dekho jo (behad) tareef karte hain, unke chehron par mitti phenko.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Miqdad through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Miqdad (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It was shown in a vision that I was rinsing my mouth with miswak and two persons began to contend with one another for getting that miswak. One was older than the other. I gave the miswak to the younger one amongst them, but it was said to me: (Let it be given) to the older one. So I gave it to the older one.
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhe khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya ki main miswak se kulla kar raha hoon, aur do log woh miswak lene ke liye aapas mein jhagad rahe the. Unmein se ek doosre se bada tha. Maine miswak choti umar wale ko de di, lekin mujhse kaha gaya: (Isse) bade wale ko do. Isliye maine ise bade wale ko de diya.

e: It was reported that Abu Huraira used to say: Listen to me, inmate of the apartment; listen to me, inmate of the apartment, while 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) had been busy in observing prayer. As she finished prayer, she said to" Urwa: Did you hear his words? And this is how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to utter (so distinctly) that if one intended to count (the words uttered) he would be able to do so.
hi: Riwayat ki gayi hai ki Abu Huraira kaha karte the: Meri baat suno, kamre ke bashindo; meri baat suno, kamre ke bashindo, jabki Aisha (Allah unse khush ho) namaz mein masroof thin. Jab unhone namaz khatm ki, unhone Urwa se kaha: Kya tumne uski baaten suni? Aur ye tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is tarah (itni saaf) baat karte the ki agar koi unke alfaazon ko ginna chaahe, to woh gin sakta tha.

e: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not take down anything from me, and he who took down anything from me except the Qur'an, he should efface that and narrate from me, for there is no harm in it and he who attributed any falsehood to me-and Hammam said: I think he also said:" deliberately" -he should in fact find his abode in the Hell-Fire.
hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhse kuch bhi likhkar mat rakho, aur jisne mujhse kuch bhi Quran ke siwaay likha ho, use woh mita dena chahiye, aur mujhse riwayat karo, ismein koi harj nahi hai, aur jisne mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoota ilzaam lagaaya - aur Hammam ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone 'jaan-boojh kar' bhi kaha - use apna Thikaana Jahannam mein hi banaana chahiye.

e:
Suhaib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus said: There lived a king before you and he had a (court) magician. As he (the magician) grew old, he said to the king: I have grown old, send some young boy to me so that I should teach him magic. He (the king) sent to him a young man so that he should train him (in magic). And on his way (to the magician) he (the young man) found a monk sitting there. He (the young man) listened to his (the monk's) talk and was impressed by it. It became his habit that on his way to the magician he met the monk and set there and he came to the magician (late). He (the magician) beat him because of delay. He made a complaint of that to the monk and he said to him: When you feel afraid of the magician, say: Members of my family had detained me. And when you feel afraid of your family you should say: The magician had detained me. It so happened that there came a huge beast (of prey) and it blocked the way of the people, and he (the young boy) said: I will come to know today whether the magician is superior or the monk is superior. He picked up a stone and said: O Allah, if the affair of the monk is dearer to Thee than the affair of the magician, cause death to this animal so that the people should be able to move about freely. He threw that stone towards it and killed it and the people began to move about (on the path freely). He (the young man) then came to that monk and Informed him and the monk said: Sonny, today you are superior to me. Your affair has come to a stage where I find that you would be soon put to a trial, and in case you are put to a trial don't give my clue. That young man began to treat the blind and those suffering from leprosy and he in fact began to cure people from (all kinds) of illness. When a companion of the king who had gone blind heard about him, he came to him with numerous gifts and said: If you cure me all these things collected together here would be yours. Be said: I myself do not cure anyone. It is Allah Who cures and if you affirm faith in Allah, I shall also supplicate Allah to cure you. 
He affirmed his faith in Allah and Allah cured him and he came to the king and sat by his side as he used to sit before. The king said to him: Who restored your eyesight? He said: My Lord. Thereupon he said: It means that your Lord is One besides me. He said: My Lord and your Lord is Allah, so he (the king) took hold of him and tormented him till he gave a clue of that boy. The young man was thus summoned and the king said to him: O boy, it has been conveyed to me that you have become so much proficient in your magic that you cure the blind and those suffering from leprosy and you do such and such things. Thereupon he said: I do not cure anyone; it is Allah Who cures, and he (the king) took hold of him and began to torment him. So he gave a clue of the monk. The monk was thus summoned and it was said to him: You should turn back from your religion. He, however, refused to do so. He (ordered) for a saw to be brought (and when it was done) he (the king) placed it in the middle of his head and tore it into parts till a part fell down. Then the courtier of the king was brought and it was said to him: Turn back from your religion. Arid he refused to do so, and the saw was placed in the midst of his head and it was torn till a part fell down. Then that young boy was brought and it was said to him: Turn back from your religion. He refused to do so and he was handed over to a group of his courtiers. And he 'said to them: Take him to such and such mountain; make him climb up that mountain and when you reach its top (ask him to renounce his faith) but if he refuses to do so, then throw him (down the mountain). So they took him and made him climb up the mountain and he said: O Allah, save me from them (in any way) Thou likest and the mountain began to quake and they all fell down and that person came walking to the king. The king said to him: What has happened to your companions? He said: Allah has saved me from them. He again handed him to some of his courtiers and said: Take him and carry him in a small boat and when you reach the middle of the ocean (ask him to renounce) his religion, but if he does not renounce his religion throw him (into the water). 
So they took him and he said: O Allah, save me from them and what they want to do. It was quite soon that the boat turned over and they were drowned and he came walking to the king, and the king said to him: What has happened to your companions? He said: Allah has saved me from them, and he said to the king: You cannot kill me until you do what I ask you to do. And he said: What is that? He said: You should gather people in a plain and hang me by the trunk (of a tree). Then take hold of an arrow from the quiver and say: In the name of Allah, the Lord of the young boy; then shoot an arrow and if you do that then you would be able to kill me. So he (the king) called the people in an open plain and tied him (the boy) to the trunk of a tree, then he took hold of an arrow from his quiver and then placed the arrow in the bow and then said: In the name of Allah, the Lord of the young boy; he then shot an arrow and it bit his temple. He (the boy) placed his hands upon the temple where the arrow had bit him and he died and the people said: We affirm our faith in the Lord of this young man, we affirm our faith in the Lord of this young man, we affirm our faith in the Lord of this young man. The courtiers came to the king and it was said to him: Do you see that Allah has actually done what you aimed at averting. They (the people) have affirmed their faith in the Lord. He (the king) commanded ditches to be dug at important points in the path. When these ditches were dug, and the fire was lit in them it was said (to the people): He who would not turn back from his (boy's) religion would be thrown in the fire or it would be said to them to jump in that. (The people courted death but did not renounce religion) till a woman came with her child and she felt hesitant in jumping into the fire and the child said to her: 0 mother, endure (this ordeal) for it is the Truth.
hi: Suhaib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne is tarah farmaaya: Tumse pehle ek raja tha aur uske paas ek jaadugar tha. Jab woh boodha ho gaya, usne raja se kaha: Main boodha ho gaya hoon; mere paas koi jawaan larka bhejiye taaki main use jaadu sikha saku. Raja ne uske paas ek jawaan aadmi bheja taaki woh use taalim de. Aur raaste mein woh larka ek sanyaasi se mila. Woh unki baaton se prabhavit hua. Aisa uska tareeka ban gaya ki raaste mein woh sanyaasi ke paas rukta aur der se jaadugar ke paas pahunchta. Jaadugar usse der ki wajah se maarta. Usne iski shikaayat sanyaasi se ki aur unhone usse kaha: Jab tumhe jaadugar se dar lage, kehna: Mere ghar ke logon ne mujhe roka. Aur jab tumhe apne khaandaan se dar lage, kehna: Jaadugar ne mujhe roka. Isi dauraan ek bada jaanwar aaya jisne logon ka raasta rok diya, aur larke ne kaha: Aaj mujhe pata chalega ki jaadugar behtar hai ya sanyaasi behtar hai. Usne ek patthar uThAya aur kaha: Aye Allah, agar sanyaasi ka maamla Tujhe jaadugar ke maamle se zyada aziz hai, to is jaanwar ko maar de taaki log aazadi se guzar sakein. Usne patthar uski taraf phenka aur use maar diya, aur log guzar gaye. Woh larka phir sanyaasi ke paas gaya aur unhe iski jaankaari di. Sanyaasi ne kaha: Bete, aaj tum mujhse behtar ho. Tumhaara maamla ab us mukaam par pahunch gaya hai jahan mujhe lagta hai jald hi tumhaari pareeksha hogi, aur agar aisa ho, to mera pata mat batana. Woh jawaan andhon aur kodh se pareshaan logon ka ilaaj karne laga aur logon ko har kism ki beemari se theek karne laga. Jab raja ke ek saathi ne, jo andha ho gaya tha, uske baare mein suna, woh bahut se tohfe leke uske paas aaya aur kaha: Agar tum mujhe theek kar do, ye sab tumhaara hoga. Usne kaha: Main khud kisi ko theek nahi karta. Sirf Allah hi theek karta hai, aur agar tum Allah par imaan laao, to main bhi Allah se dua karunga ki Woh tumhe theek kare. Usne Allah par imaan laaya aur Allah ne use theek kar diya aur woh raja ke paas aaya aur unke saath baitha jaise woh pehle baitha karta tha. Raja ne usse kaha: Tumhaari aankhon ki roshni kisne wapas di? Usne kaha: Mere Rab ne. Isper unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki mere siwaay tumhaara koi doosra Rab hai? Usne kaha: Mera Rab aur tumhaara Rab Allah hai. Isliye raja ne use pakda aur use yaatna di yahan tak ki usne larke ka pata bata diya. Larke ko bulaaya gaya aur raja ne usse kaha: Larke, mujhe khabar mili hai ki tum apne jaadu mein itne maahir ho gaye ho ki tum andhon aur kodhiyon ko theek karte ho aur aisi-aisi cheezein karte ho. Isper usne kaha: Main kisi ko theek nahi karta; sirf Allah theek karta hai, aur unhone use pakda aur yaatna deni shuru ki. Usne sanyaasi ka pata bata diya. Sanyaasi ko bulaaya gaya aur unse kaha gaya: Apne deen se mud jaao. Unhone, halaanki, aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone unka sar aare se do tukdon mein chir diya yahan tak ki ek tukda gir gaya. Phir raja ke saathi ko laaya gaya aur usse kaha gaya: Apne deen se mud jaao. Usne inkaar kiya aur uska sar bhi aare se chir diya gaya yahan tak ki ek tukda gir gaya. Phir woh jawaan larka laaya gaya aur usse kaha gaya: Apne deen se mud jaao. Usne inkaar kiya aur use apne kuch darogiyon ke haath saunp diya gaya aur usne unse kaha: Ise falan-falan pahaad par le jaao, use pahaad par chadhaao aur jab tum uski chotti par pahunch jaao (usse deen chhodne ko kaho), aur agar woh inkaar kare, to use (neeche) phenk do. Woh use le gaye aur pahaad par chadhaaya aur usne kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe unse (jaise Tu chaahe) bacha, aur pahaad hilne laga aur woh sab gir gaye aur woh chalte huye raja ke paas wapas aaya. Raja ne usse kaha: Tumhaare saathiyon ka kya hua? Usne kaha: Allah ne mujhe unse bacha liya. Unhone use dobara apne kuch darogiyon ke saath bheja aur kaha: Ise le jao aur use ek chhoti kishti mein samundar ke beech le jaao, aur agar woh apna deen na chhode, to use (paani mein) phenk do. Woh use le gaye aur usne kaha: Aye Allah, mujhe unse aur unke iraade se bacha. Kishti ulaT gayi aur woh sab Doob gaye, aur woh chalte huye raja ke paas wapas aaya, aur raja ne kaha: Tumhaare saathiyon ka kya hua? Usne kaha: Allah ne mujhe unse bacha liya. Aur usne raja se kaha: Tum mujhe tab tak qatal nahi kar sakte jab tak tum woh na karo jo main tumse maangta hoon. Unhone kaha: Woh kya hai? Usne kaha: Logon ko ek maidaan mein ikattha karo aur mujhe ek darakht ke tane se latkao, phir tarkash se ek teer nikaalo aur kaho: Allah ke naam par, us jawaan larke ke Rab ke naam par; phir teer chalaao, aur agar tum aisa karo to tum mujhe qatal kar paaoge. Isliye unhone logon ko maidaan mein bulaaya aur use darakht ke tane se baandha, phir tarkash se ek teer nikaala aur dhanush par rakha aur kaha: Allah ke naam par, us jawaan larke ke Rab ke naam par, aur usne teer chalaaya jo uski kanpTi mein laga. Larke ne apna haath us jagah rakha jahan teer laga aur woh mar gaya, aur log kehne lage: Hum is jawaan larke ke Rab par imaan laaye, hum is jawaan larke ke Rab par imaan laaye, hum is jawaan larke ke Rab par imaan laaye. Raja ke darogi uske paas aaye aur usse kaha gaya: Kya aap dekhte hain? Jo aap rokna chaahte the woh waastav mein Allah ne kar diya hai. Log Rab par imaan le aaye. Raja ne raaste ke mahatvapurna bindron par khaaiyaan khodne ka hukum diya. Jab ye khaaiyaan khud gayin aur unmein aag lagaayi gayi, kaha gaya: Jo apne (yaani larke ke) deen se na muDe use ismein phenk do, ya ismein kood padne ko kaha jaaye. (Log maut ka saamna karte rahe lekin deen nahi chhoda) yahan tak ki ek aurat apne bachche ke saath aayi aur woh aag mein kood padne mein hichkichaayi, aur bachche ne usse kaha: Maa, sabar kar, kyunki tu sach par hai.

e:
'Ubadah b. Walid b. Samit reported: I and my father set out in search of knowledge to a tribe of the Ansar before their death (i. e. before the Companions of the Prophet left the world) and I was the first to meet Abu Yasar, a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was a young man with him who carried the record of letters with him and there was a mantle prepared by the tribe of Ma'afiri upon him. And his servant too had a Ma'afiri mantle over him. My father said to him: My uncle, I see the signs of anger or that of agony on your face. He said: Yes, such and such person, the son of so and so, of the tribe of Harami owed me a debt. I went to his family, extended salutations and said: Where is he? They said: He is not here. Then came out to me his son who was at the threshold of his youth. I said to him: Where is your father? He said: No sooner did he hear your sound than he hid himself behind my mother's bedstead. I said to him: Walk out to me, for I know where you are. He came out. I said to him: What prompted you to hide yourself from me? He said: By God, whatever I would say to you would not be a lie. By Allah, I fear that I should tell a lie to you and in case of making promise with you I should break it, as you are the Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The fact is that I was hard up in regard to money. I said: Do you adjure by Allah? He said: I adjure by Allah. I said: Do you adjure by Allah? He said: I adjure by Allah. I said: Do you adjure by Allah? He said: I adjure by Allah. Then he brought his promissory note and he wrote off (the debt) with his hand and said: Make payment when you find yourself solvent enough to pay me back; if you are not, then there is no liability upon you. These two eyes of mine saw, and he (Abu'I-Yasar) placed his fingers upon his eyes and these two ears of mine heard and my heart retained, and he pointed towards his heart that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who gives time to one who is financially hard up (in the payment of debt) or writes off his debt, Allah will provide him His shadow. I said to him: My uncle, if you get the cloak of your servant and you give him your two clothes, or take his two clothes of Ma'afir and give him your cloak, then there would be one dress for you and one for him. 
He wiped my head and said: O Allah, bless the son of my brother. O, son of my brother, these two very eyes of mine saw and these two ears of mine listened to and this heart of mine retained this, and he pointed towards the heart that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Feed them (the servants) and clothe them (the servants) what you wear, and if I give him the goods of the world, it is easy for me than this that he should take my virtues on the Day of Resurrection. We went on till we came to Jabir b. Abdullah in the mosque and he was busy in observing prayer in one cloth which he had joined at its opposite ends. I made my way through the people till I sat between him and the Qibla and I said: May Allah have mercy upon you. Do you observe prayer with one cloth on your body whereas your mantle is lying at your side? He pointed me with his hand towards my breast just like this and he separated his fingers and bent them in the shape of a bow. And (he said): I thought that a fool like you should come to me so that he should see me as I do and he should then also do like it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us in this very mosque and he had in his hand the twig of the palm-tree and he saw mucus towards the Qibla of the mosque and he erased it with the help of the twig. He then came to us and said: Who amongst you likes that Allah should turn His face away from him? We were afraid. He then again said: Who amongst you likes that Allah should turn His face away from him? We were afraid. He again said: Who amongst you likes that Allah should turn His face away from him? We said: Allah's Messenger, none of us likes it. And he said: If one amongst you stands for prayer, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, is before him he should not spit in front of him, or on his right side, but should spit on his left side beneath his left foot and if he is impelled to do so all of a sudden (in spite of himself) he should then spit in his cloth and fold it in some part of it. (and he further said: ) Bring some sweet-smelling thing. A young man who belonged to our tribe stood up, went and brought scent in his palm. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took that and applied it to the end of that twig and then touched the place where there had been mucus. Jabir said: This is why you should apply scent to your mosques. 
It is reported on the same authority: We set out along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on an expedition of Batn Buwat. He (the Holy Prophet) was in search of al-Majdi b. 'Amr al-Juhani. (We had so meagre equipment) that five. six or seven of us had one camel to ride and so we mounted it turn by turn. Once there wan. the turn of an Ansari to ride upon the camel. He made it kneel down to ride over it (and after having. mounted it), he tried to raise it up but it hesitated. So he said. May there be curse of Allah upon you! Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who is there to curse his camel? He said: Allah's Messenger, it' is I. Thereupon he said: Get down from the camel and let us not have in our company the cursed one. Don't curse your own selves, nor your children. nor your belongings. There is the possibility that your curse may synchronies with the time when Allah is about to confer upon you what you demand and thus your prayer may be readily responded. 
It is reported on the same authority: We set out on an expedition along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until it was evening, and we had been near a. water reservoir of Arabia. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who would be the person who would go ahead and set right the reservoir and drink water himself and serve us with it? Jabir said: I stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, it is I who am ready to do that. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who is the person to accompany Jabir? And then Jabbar b. Sakhr stood up. So we went to that well and poured in that tank a bucket or two of water and plastered it with clay and then began to fill it (with water) until it was filled to the brim. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the first who appeared before us, and he said: Do you (both) permit me to drink water out of it? We said: Yea, Allah's Messenger. He led his camel to drink water and it drank. He then pulled its rein and it stretched its legs and began to urinate. He then took it aside and made it kneel down at another place and then came to the tank and performed ablution. I then got up and performed ablution like the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Jabbar b. Sakhr went in order to relieve himself and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up to observe prayer and there was a mantle over me. I tried to invert its ends but it was too short (to cover my body easily). It had its borders. I then inverted it (the mantle) and drew its opposite ends and then tied them at my neck. I then came and stood upon the left side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He caught hold of me and made me go round behind him, until he made me stand on his right side. Then Jabbar b. Sakhr came. He performed ablution and then came and stood on the left side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) caught hold of our hands together, pushed us back and made us stand behind him. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to look upon me with darting looks, but I did not perceive that. After that I became aware of it and he pointed with the gesture of his hand that I should wrap my loin-cloth. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, he said: Jabir! I said: Allah's Messenger, at thy beck and call. He said: When the cloth around you is inadequate, then tie the opposite ends but when it is small, tie it over the lower body. 
Jabir reported: We set out on an expedition with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the only means of sustenance for every person amongst us was only one date for a day and we used to chew it. And we struck the leaves with the help of our bow and ate them until the sides of our mouths were injured. It so happened one day that a person was overlooked and not given a date. We carried that person and bore witness to the fact that he had not been given that date so he was offered that and he got up and received that. 
Jabir reported: We set out on an expedition along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until we got down at a spacious valley and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to relieve himself. I followed him with a bucket full of water and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked about and he found no privacy but two trees at the end of the valley and Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) went to one of them and took hold of one of its twigs and said: Be thou under my control by the permission of Allah, and so it came under his control like the camel who has its nosestring in the hand of its rider, and then he came to the second tree and took hold of a twig and said: Be thou under my control with the permission of Allah, and it came under his control, and when he came in the middle of the two trees he joined together the two twigs and said: join with the permission of Allah. Jabir said: I was afraid lest Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) should be aware of my nearness and go still farther. And Muhammad b. Abbad has used the word" faitab'd" and I began to talk to myself. And as I saw, I suddenly found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) before me and the two trees were separated and each one of them was standing at its place. I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) standing for a short time, nodding his head towards right and left. Isma'il pointed towards the right and left with the help of his head (in order to demonstrate how the Prophet had pointed). Then he (the Holy Prophet) came to me and said: Jabir did you see my place where I was standing? I said: Allah's Messenger, yes. He then said: Then you should go to those two trees and cut a twig from each of them and go to that place with them where I was standing and stand there where I was standing and place a twig on the right and a twig on the left. Jabir said: I set out and took hold of a stone and broke it and sharpened it and then I came to those trees and cut a twig from each one of them. 
I then came dragging them until I stood at the place where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been standing and placed a twig on the right and a twig on the left. Then I met him and said: Allah's Messenger, I have done that, but (kindly) explain to me the reason for it. Thereupon he said: I passed by two graves the occupants of which had been undergoing torment. I liked to make intercession for them so that the might be relieved of this torment y as long as these twigs remain fresh. Jabir said: We came back to the (camp of the) army and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Jabir, call people for per- forming wudu. I cried: Come and perform wudu, come and perform wudu, come and perform wudu. I said: Allah's Messenger, there is not even a drop of water in the army camp, and there. was a person who used to cool the water for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the old water-skin which kept hanging by the twig. He asked me to go to such and such Ansari and ask him to see if there was any water in that skin. I went to him and cast a glance in it but did not find anything but a drop in the mouth of that water-skin and if I were to draw that, the water-skin's,. dried part would suck it up. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I have not found anything in it but a drop of water in the mouth of the water-skin and now if I were to draw that, it would be absorbed. He said: Go and bring that to me. I brought that to him. He took hold of it -and began to utter something which I could not understand and then pressed it with his hand and gave that to me and said: Jabir, announce for the tub to be brought. So I announced that the tub of the army (be brought). It was brought accordingly and I placed it before him (the Holy Prophet). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) placed his hands in the tub like this: with his fingers stretched out, and then he placed his fingers at the bottom of the tub and said: Jabir, take it (that waters-skin) and pour water over me, by reciting Bismillah, and I poured water and I said: Bismillah, and found water sprouting out between the fingers of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then that tub gushed forth until it was filled up and the Messenger (ﷺ) said: Jabir, make an announcement to the effect: He who needs water should take that. Jabir said: The people came and got water until they were all satiated. I said: Is there anyone left who wants to get it? And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then lifted up his hand from that tub and it was still full. Then the people made a complaint to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunger and he said: May Allah provide you food! We came to the bank of the ocean and the ocean was tossing and it threw out a big animal and we lit fire and cooked it and took it until we had eaten to our heart's content. Jabir said: I and such and such five persons entered Its socket and nobody could see us until we had come out, and we took hold of one of its ribs and twisted it into a sort of arch, then we called the tallest of the persons of the army and the hugest of the camels of the army and it had the big saddle over it, and it could easily pass through it without the rider having need to bend down.
hi: Ubada bin Walid bin Samit ne bayan kiya: Main aur mere waalid Ansar ke ek qabile mein ilm haasil karne nikle, unki maut se pehle. Main sabse pehle Abu Yasar, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek Sahabi, se mila aur unke saath ek jawaan aadmi tha jo khat likhne ka saamaan lekar chal raha tha aur usne Ma'afiri qabile ka bana ek chogha pehna hua tha, aur uske naukar ne bhi Ma'afiri chogha pehna hua tha. Mere waalid ne unse kaha: Mere chacha, mujhe aapke chehre par gusse ya taklif ke nishaan dikh rahe hain. Unhone kaha: Haan, falan-falan, Harami qabile ke ek shakhs ke bete, ka mere upar karza tha. Main uske khaandaan ke paas gaya, unhe salaam kiya aur poocha: Woh kahan hai? Unhone kaha: Woh yahan nahi hai. Phir uska beta bahar aaya jo jawaani ki dahleez par tha. Maine usse poocha: Tumhaara waalid kahan hai? Usne kaha: Jaise hi usne aapki aawaaz suni, woh meri maa ki charpaai ke peeche chhup gaya. Maine usse kaha: Bahar aao, kyunki mujhe pata hai tum kahan ho. Woh bahar aaya. Maine usse kaha: Tumne mujhse chhupne ka faisla kyun kiya? Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main aapko jo bhi kahunga jhoot nahi hoga. Allah ki qasam, mujhe dar tha ki main aapse jhoot bolunga aur aapse kiya gaya vaada todunga, kyunki aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahabi hain. Asal baat ye hai ki main paise ki tangi mein tha. Maine kaha: Kya tum Allah ki qasam khaate ho? Usne kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon. Maine (ye teen baar poocha aur usne teen baar isi tarah jawaab diya). Phir unhone apni chitthi nikaali aur apne haath se karza maaf kar diya aur kaha: Jab tumhaare paas paisa ho tab de dena; agar nahi, to tumpar koi zimmedaari nahi. Meri in do aankhon ne dekha - aur unhone apni ungliyaan apni aankhon par rakhin - aur meri in do kaanon ne suna aur mere dil ne yaad rakha - aur unhone apne dil ki taraf ishara kiya - ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo kisi tang-haal shakhs ko (karza chukaane mein) waqt deta hai ya uska karza maaf karta hai, Allah use Apni chhaaya dega. Maine unse kaha: Mere chacha, agar aap apne naukar ka chogha lekar apne do kapde use de dein, ya uske Ma'afiri kapde lekar apna chogha use de dein, to aapke paas ek poshaak hogi aur uske paas ek. Unhone mera sar ponchha aur kaha: Aye Allah, mere bhatije ko barkat de. Bhatije, meri in do aankhon ne dekha aur meri in do kaanon ne suna aur mere is dil ne yaad rakha - aur unhone dil ki taraf ishara kiya - ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Unhe (naukaron ko) woh khilaao jo tum khaate ho aur unhe woh pehnaao jo tum pehnte ho, aur agar main use duniya ka saara saamaan bhi de dun, ye mere liye isse aasaan hoga ki woh Qayamat ke din mere nekokaar amal le le. Hum chalte gaye yahan tak ki Jabir bin Abdullah ke paas masjid mein pahunche aur woh ek hi kapde mein namaz mein masroof the jise unhone donon sironpar joda hua tha. Main logon ke beech se raasta banaate hue unke aur Qibla ke beech baith gaya aur maine kaha: Allah aappar rehmat kare. Kya aap ek hi kapde mein namaz padhte hain jabki aapka chogha aapke bagal mein rakha hai? Unhone apne haath se mere seene ki taraf isharaa kiya jaise apni ungliyon ko dhanush ki shakl mein moda ho, (aur kaha:) Mujhe laga ki tumhaari jaisi koi (samajh mein kam) shakhs mere paas aayega taaki woh mujhe waisa hi karte dekhe jaise main karta hoon, aur phir woh khud bhi waisa hi kare. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) isi masjid mein humaare paas aaye, unke haath mein khajoor ki daali ka ek Tukda tha, aur unhone Qibla ki taraf kuch balgam dekha aur use us daali se saaf kiya. Phir woh humaari taraf aaye aur farmaaya: Tum mein se kaun chaahega ki Allah uski taraf se Apna chehra pher le? Hum darr gaye. Unhone phir kaha: Tum mein se kaun chaahega ki Allah uski taraf se Apna chehra pher le? Hum darr gaye. Unhone phir kaha: Tum mein se kaun chaahega ki Allah uski taraf se Apna chehra pher le? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humme se koi bhi ye nahi chaahta. Aur unhone farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada ho, to Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, uske saamne hote hain, isliye use apne saamne ya apni daayi taraf nahi thookna chahiye, balki apni baayi taraf, apne baaye paon ke neeche, aur agar achaanak zaroorat pade, to use apne kapde mein thookna chahiye aur use kisi hisse mein mod dena chahiye. (Aur unhone farmaaya:) Koi khushboodaar cheez lao. Humaare qabile ka ek jawaan larka khada hua, gaya aur apni hatheli mein khushboo laaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use liya aur us daali ke sire par lagaaya aur phir us jagah chhua jahan balgam tha. Jabir ne kaha: Isi wajah se tumhe apni masjidon mein khushboo lagaani chahiye. Isi sanad se ye bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Batn Buwat ki muhim par nikle. Woh al-Majdi bin Amr al-Juhani ki talaash mein the. (Humaare paas itna kam saadhan tha) ki humme se paanch, chhe ya saat logon ke liye ek oont hota jispar hum baari-baari sawaar hote. Ek baar Ansar mein se ek shakhs ki baari aayi. Usne oont ko baithaya taaki woh sawaar ho sake aur (sawaar hone ke baad) usne ise uThAne ki koshish ki lekin usne hichkichaahat dikhaayi. Isper usne kaha: Allah ki laanat tumpar ho! Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kaun hai jo apne oont par laanat karta hai? Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main hoon. Isper unhone farmaaya: Oont se utro aur humaari sohbat mein laanat-zada shakhs na rahe. Khud par laanat mat karo, na apne bachchon par, na apne saamaan par. Ho sakta hai tumhaari laanat us waqt ho jab Allah tumhe jo maangte ho woh dene wala ho aur is tarah tumhaari dua turant qubool ho jaaye. Isi sanad se ye bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par nikle yahan tak ki shaam ho gayi aur hum Arabia ke ek paani ke tanke ke qareeb the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kaun hai jo aage jaakar tanka theek kare aur khud paani piye aur humein bhi pilaaye? Jabir ne kaha: Main khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main hoon jo ye karne ko taiyaar hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jabir ke saath kaun jaayega? Isper Jabbar bin Sakhr khade huye. Isliye hum us kuen ki taraf gaye aur us tanke mein ek ya do bucket paani daala aur ise mitti se lipa diya aur phir ise paani se bharna shuru kiya yahan tak ki ye kinaare tak bhar gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sabse pehle humaare saamne aaye aur unhone kaha: Kya tum donon mujhe ismein se paani peene ki ijazat dete ho? Humne kaha: Zaroor, Allah ke Rasool. Woh apne oont ko paani pilaane laaye aur usne piya. Phir unhone uski lagaam kheenchi aur usne apne paon phailaaye aur peshaab karne laga. Phir woh use alag le gaye aur doosri jagah baithaya aur phir tanke ke paas aaye aur wuzu kiya. Main phir utha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jaise wuzu kiya, aur Jabbar bin Sakhr apni zaroorat poori karne gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz padhne ke liye khade hue aur mere paas ek chogha tha. Maine iske siron ko ulatne ki koshish ki lekin ye bahut chhota tha (mera poora badan dhaakne ke liye). Ismein kinaare the. Maine ise ulaTa aur iske viprit siron ko khinch kar apni gardan mein baandh liya. Main phir aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baayi taraf khada hua. Unhone mujhe pakda aur mujhe apne peeche se ghumaakar apni daayi taraf khada kiya. Phir Jabbar bin Sakhr aaye. Unhone wuzu kiya aur phir aakar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baayi taraf khade hue. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humaare haath saath mein pakde, humein peeche dhakela aur humein apne peeche khada kiya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri taraf tez nazron se dekhne lage, lekin maine ise mehsoos nahi kiya. Baad mein mujhe iska ehsaas hua aur unhone ishara kiya ki main apni kamar ka kapda lapeT loon. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz khatm ki, unhone kaha: Jabir! Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main hazir hoon. Unhone kaha: Jab tumhaara kapda kaafi bada ho, to iske viprit siron ko baandho, lekin jab ye chhota ho, to ise neeche ke badan ke gird lapeT lo. Jabir ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par nikle aur humme se har ek ke liye din bhar ki rozi ek hi khajoor thi aur hum use chabaate the. Aur hum apne dhanush se pattoon ko todte aur unhe khaate yahan tak ki humaare munh ke kinaare zakhmi ho jaate. Ek din aisa hua ki ek shakhs bhula diya gaya aur use khajoor nahi mili. Humne us shakhs ki gawaahi di ki use khajoor nahi mili thi, isliye use woh di gayi aur woh khada hua aur usne use liya. Jabir ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par nikle yahan tak ki hum ek vishaal waadi mein utre aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khud ko halka karne gaye. Main paani se bhari ek buket lekar unke peeche gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aas-paas dekha aur unhe koi nijta nahi mili siwaay waadi ke ant mein do darakhton ke. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unmein se ek ki taraf gaye aur uski ek daali pakadi aur kaha: Allah ki ijazat se mere adheen ho jaa, aur ye us tarah unke adheen ho gaya jaise ek oont apni naak ki rassi ke zariye apne sawaar ke adheen hota hai, aur phir woh doosre darakht ki taraf aaye aur uski ek daali pakadi aur kaha: Allah ki ijazat se mere adheen ho jaa, aur ye bhi unke adheen ho gaya, aur jab woh donon darakhton ke beech pahunche, unhone donon daaliyon ko joda aur kaha: Allah ki ijazat se jud jaao. Jabir ne kaha: Mujhe dar tha ki kahin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mere qareeb hone ka pata na chal jaaye aur woh aur dur na chale jaayein. Main khud se baat karne laga. Aur jaisa maine dekha, achaanak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere saamne the aur do darakht alag ho chuke the, aur har ek apni jagah khada tha. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko thodi der khade dekha, apna sar daaye-baaye hilaate hue. Phir woh mere paas aaye aur kaha: Jabir, kya tumne wo jagah dekhi jahan main khada tha? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan. Unhone kaha: Phir tumhe un do darakhton ke paas jaana chahiye aur har ek se ek daali kaatni chahiye aur unhe us jagah le jaana chahiye jahan main khada tha aur wahan khada hokar ek daali daaye aur ek daali baaye rakhni chahiye. Jabir ne kaha: Main gaya aur ek patthar liya, use toda aur teekha kiya, phir un darakhton ke paas aaya aur har ek se ek daali kaati. Main unhe khinchte hue le aaya yahan tak ki main us jagah khada hua jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade the aur ek daali daaye aur ek daali baaye rakh di. Phir main unse mila aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aisa kiya hai, lekin (meherbani karke) mujhe iski wajah bataiye. Isper unhone kaha: Main do qabron ke paas se guzra jinke bashinde azaab mein masroof the. Maine unke liye sifaarish karni chaahi taaki unhe is azaab se raahat mile jab tak ye daaliyaan taaza rahengi. Jabir ne kaha: Hum fauj ke padaav par wapas aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jabir, logon ko wuzu ke liye pukaaro. Maine chillaakar kaha: Aao aur wuzu karo, aao aur wuzu karo, aao aur wuzu karo. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, fauj ke padaav mein paani ki ek boond bhi nahi hai, aur wahan ek shakhs tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye paani Thanda kiya karta tha ek purane paani ke thaile mein jo ek daali se latka rehta. Unhone mujhe falan-falan Ansari ke paas jaakar dekhne ko kaha ki us thaile mein paani hai ya nahi. Main uske paas gaya aur usmein jhaanka lekin usmein kuch nahi paaya siwaay thaile ke munh mein ek boond ke, aur agar main use nikaalta, to thaile ka sookha hissa use sokh leta. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine usmein kuch nahi paaya siwaay thaile ke munh mein ek boond paani ke aur ab agar main use nikaalun, to ye sokh li jaayegi. Unhone kaha: Jao aur woh mere paas laao. Main use unke paas laaya. Unhone use liya aur kuch bola jise main samajh nahi paaya aur phir ise apne haath se dabaya aur mujhe diya aur kaha: Jabir, ailaan karo ki bartan laaya jaaye. Isliye maine ailaan kiya (ki fauj ka bartan laaya jaaye). Ise laaya gaya aur maine ise unke saamne rakha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath us bartan mein is tarah rakhe: apni ungliyon ko phaila kar, aur phir unhone apni ungliyaan bartan ke tal mein rakhin aur kaha: Jabir, ise lo (yaani woh paani ka thaila) aur mujhpar paani daalo, Bismillah kehte hue, aur maine paani daala aur maine kaha: Bismillah, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ungliyon ke beech se paani nikalte paaya. Phir woh tanka bharne laga yahan tak ki ye bhar gaya aur unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Jabir, ailaan karo ki jise paani chahiye woh le le. Jabir ne kaha: Log aaye aur paani liya yahan tak ki sab ser aa gaye. Maine kaha: Kya koi aisa bhi hai jo ye lena chaahta hai? Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne phir apna haath us tanke se uThAya aur ye abhi bhi bhara hua tha. Phir logon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bhookh ki shikaayat ki aur unhone kaha: Allah tumhe khaana de! Hum samundar ke kinare aaye aur samundar ne ek bada jaanwar bahar phenka aur humne aag jalaayi aur ise pakaaya aur khaya yahan tak ki humaara pet bhar gaya. Jabir ne kaha: Main aur mujh jaise paanch aur log uske aankh ke soket mein daakhil hue aur koi humein tab tak nahi dekh sakta jab tak hum bahar na aaye, aur humne uski ek pasli pakdi aur use ek tarah ke khambhe ki tarah moda, phir humne fauj ke sabse lambe shakhs ko aur fauj ke sabse bade oont ko bulaaya jispar bada kaaTha tha, aur woh usmein se aasaani se guzar gaya bina sawaar ko jhukne ki zaroorat pade.

e: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Abu Bakr Siddiq came to the residence of my father ('Azib) and bought a haudaj from him and said to 'Azib: Send your son to my residence (to carry this haudaj), and my father said to me: Carry it (for him). So I carried it and there went along with him (with Abu Bakr) my father in order to fetch its price and he ('Azib) said to Abu Bakr: Abu Bakr, narrate to me what you both did on the night when you set out on a journey along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: We set out during the night and went on walking until it was noon, and the path was vacant and so none passed by that (until) there appeared prominently before us a large rock. It had its shade and the rays of the sun did not reach that place. So we got down at that place. I then went to the rock and levelled the ground with my hands at the place where the Prophet (ﷺ) would take rest under its shade. I then set the bedding and said: Allah's Messenger, go to sleep and I shall keep a watch around you. I went out and watched around him. There we saw a shepherd moving towards that rock with his flock and he intended what we intended (i. e. taking rest). I met him and said to him: Young boy, to which place do you belong? He said: I am a person from Medina. I said, is there any milk in the udders of your sheep and goats? He said: Yes. He took hold of a goat, and I said to him: Clean the udder well so that it should be free from hair, dust and impurity. I saw al-Bara' striking his hand upon the other (to give an indication) how he did that. He milked the goat for me in a wooden cup which he had with him and I had with me a bucket in which I kept water for drinking and for performing ablution. I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and did not like to awaken him from sleep but he was accidentally startled from the sleep. I poured water upon the milk (till It was cold) and I said: Allah's Messenger, take this milk. He then took It and I was delighted and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Is now not the time to march on? I said: Of course. So he marched on after the sun had passed the meridian and Suraqa b. Malik pursued us and we had been walking on soft, level ground. I said: Allah's Messenger, we are about to be overtaken by them. Thereupon he said: Be not grieved. Verily, Allah is with us. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursed him and his horse sank into the earth. I think he also said: I know you have hurled curse upon me. So supplicate Allah for me and I take an oath that I shall turn everyone away who would come in search of you. So he (Allah's Messenger) supplicated Allah and he was rescued and he came back and to everyone he met, he said: I have combed all this side. In short, he diverted everyone whom he met and he in fact fulfilled his promise.
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abu Bakr Siddiq mere waalid (Azib) ke ghar aaye aur unse ek Haudaj khareeda aur Azib se kaha: Apne bete ko mere ghar bhejo (isse le jaane ke liye), aur mere waalid ne mujhse kaha: Ise unke liye le jaao. Isliye maine ise le jaaya aur mere waalid bhi unke saath uski keemat lene gaye aur unhone (Azib ne) Abu Bakr se kaha: Abu Bakr, mujhe bataiye ki us raat aap dono ne kya kiya jab aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath safar par nikle the. Unhone kaha: Hum raat ko nikle aur dopahar tak chalte rahe aur raasta khaali tha, koi usse nahi guzra (yahan tak ki) humaare saamne ek bada pathar zaahir hua. Iski chhaaya thi aur suraj ki kirnein wahan tak nahi pahunchti thin. Isliye hum wahan utre. Main phir us pathar ke paas gaya aur apne haathon se us jagah ki zameen samtal ki jahan Nabi (SAW) uski chhaaya mein aaraam karte. Maine phir bistar bichaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, sojaaiye aur main aapke aas-paas nigraani rakhunga. Main bahar gaya aur unke aas-paas nazar rakhi. Wahan humne ek gadariya us pathar ki taraf apne rewad ke saath aate dekha aur uska bhi wahi iraada tha jo humaara tha (yaani aaraam karna). Main usse mila aur usse kaha: Jawaan larke, tum kaunse khaandaan se ho? Usne kaha: Main Madina se hoon. Maine kaha: Kya tumhaari bakriyon-bhedon mein doodh hai? Usne kaha: Haan. Usne ek bakri pakadi, aur maine usse kaha: Uske thann ko achhi tarah saaf kar do taaki ye baalon, dhool aur gandagi se mukt ho. Maine dekha ki al-Bara apne haath se doosre haath par thok kar dikha rahe the ki usne aisa kaise kiya. Usne mere liye ek lakdi ke pyaale mein doodh nikaala jo uske paas tha aur mere paas ek buket tha jismein main peene aur wuzu ke liye paani rakhta tha. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur mujhe unhe neend se jagaana pasand nahi tha lekin woh khud hi aakasmik uT gaye. Maine doodh mein paani daala (taaki ye Thanda ho jaaye) aur maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye doodh li jiye. Unhone ise liya aur main khush hua aur unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Kya ab aage badhne ka waqt nahi hai? Maine kaha: Zaroor. Isliye woh dopahar dhalne ke baad aage badhe aur Suraqa bin Malik ne humaara picha kiya aur hum narm, samtal zameen par chal rahe the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein pakde jaane ka khatra hai. Isper unhone kaha: Gam mat karo. Yaqeenan, Allah humaare saath hai. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uspar laanat ki aur uska ghoda zameen mein Doob gaya. Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha: Mujhe pata hai tumne mujhpar laanat ki hai. Isliye mere liye Allah se dua kijiye aur main qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki jo bhi tumhaari khoj mein aayega main use hataa dunga. Isliye unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) Allah se dua ki aur woh bacha liya gaya aur wapas gaya aur jisse bhi woh mila, usse kaha: Maine ye poora ilaaka chhaan maara hai. Mukhtasar mein, usne jisse bhi mulaqaat ki, use ghumaa diya aur usne waaqai apna vaada poora kiya.

e: Al-Bara' reported: Abu Bakr purchased a saddle from me for thirteen dirhams; the rest of the hadith is the same, and in the narration of Uthman b. 'Umar, the words are: He (Suraqa b. Malik) drew near Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he (the Holy Prophet) cursed him and his camel sank in the earth up to the belly and he jumped from that and said: Muhammad, I am fully aware of It that it is your doing. Supplicate Allah that He should rescue me from it in which I am (pitchforked) and I give you a solemn pledge that I shall keep this as a secret from all those who are coming after me. Take hold of an arrow out of it (quiver) for you will find my camels and my slaves at such and such place and you can get whatever you need (on showing this arrow). He (the Holy Prophet) said: I don't need your camels. And we (the Prophet and Abu Bakr) came to Medina during the night and the people began to contend as to where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) should reside and he encamped in the tribe of Najjar who were related to 'Abd ul-Muttalib from the side of mother. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) honoured them, then people climbed upon house-top and women also and boys scattered in the way, and they were all crying: Muhammad, Messenger of Allah, Muhammad, Messenger of Allah.
hi: Al-Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu Bakr ne mujhse terah dirham mein ek zeen khareeda; baaki hadees waisi hi hai, aur Uthman bin Umar ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Woh (Suraqa bin Malik) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qareeb aaya aur unhone unpar aur unke oont par laanat ki aur woh zameen mein pet tak Doob gaya aur usmein se uchhal kar bahar aaya aur kaha: Muhammad, mujhe poori tarah pata hai ki ye aapka hi karya hai. Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh mujhe isse bachaaye jismein main phansa hoon, aur main aapko pukhta vaada deta hoon ki main ise har us shakhs se raaz rakhunga jo mere baad aayega. Ek teer nikaal lijiye (mere tarkash se), kyunki aapko mere oont aur mere ghulam aisi-aisi jagah milenge aur aap jo bhi zaroorat ho le sakte hain (ise dikhakar). Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) kaha: Mujhe tumhaare oonton ki zaroorat nahi. Aur hum (Nabi aur Abu Bakr) raat ko Madina aaye aur log jhagadne lage ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kahan rukein, aur woh Najjar qabile mein utre jo Abd al-Muttalib se maa ki taraf se rishta rakhte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka samman badhaaya, phir log apne gharon ki chhaton par chadh gaye aur auraten bhi, aur bachche raaste mein bikhar gaye aur woh sab chilla rahe the: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool; Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool.

e: Hammim b. Munabbih reported: This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and in this connection he narrated some of the ahadith and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It was said to people of Israel: Enter this land saying Hitta (Remove Thou from us the burden of our sins), whereupon We would forgive you your sins, but they twisted (this statement) and entered the gate dragging upon their breech and said: The" grain in the ear."
hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ne bayan kiya: Ye woh hai jo Abu Huraira ne humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kiya, aur is silsile mein unhone kuch ahadees riwayat kin aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Banu Isra'il se kaha gaya: Is zameen mein Hitta (Hamaare gunahon ka bojh humse hataa de) kehte hue daakhil ho, taaki Hum tumhaare gunah maaf kar dein, lekin unhone (is baat ko) badal diya aur apni sarrin ke bal ghisatte hue darwaze mein daakhil hue aur kaha: Bali mein daana.

e: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, sent revelation to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) just before his death in quick succession until he left for his heavenly home, and the day when he died, he received the revelation profusely.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat se thoda pehle unpar lagataar wahi nazil ki yahan tak ki unki wafat ho gayi, aur jis din unka intiqaal hua, unpar bahutayat mein wahi nazil hui.

e: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew said to'Umar: You recite a verse which, if it had been revealed in relation to us, we would have taken that day as the day of rejoicing. Thereupon 'Umar said: I know where it was revealed and on the day when it was revealed and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been at that time when it was revealed. It was revealed on the day of 'Arafa (ninth of Dhu'l Hijjah) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been staying in 'Arafat. Sufyan said: I doubt, whether it was Friday or not (and the verse referred to) is this:" Today I have perfected your religion for you and completed My favours upon you" (v. 4).
hi: Tariq bin Shihab ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi ne Umar se kaha: Aap ek aisi aayat padhte hain, agar ye humaare silsile mein nazil hui hoti, to hum us din ko khushi ka din mante. Isper Umar ne kaha: Mujhe pata hai ye kahan nazil hui, aur jis din ye nazil hui, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kahan the jab ye nazil hui. Ye Arafa ke din (Zil-Hijja ki nau tareekh) nazil hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafat mein maujood the. Sufyan ne kaha: Mujhe shak hai ki ye Juma tha ya nahi (aur us aayat ka ishara ye hai): "Aaj Maine tumhaare liye tumhaara deen mukammal kar diya hai aur tumpar Apni nematon ko poora kar diya hai" (5:3).

e: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew said to 'Umar: If this verse were revealed in relation to the Jews (i e. "This day I have perfected your religion for you and have completed My favours for you and have chosen for you al-Islam as religion") we would have taken the day of rejoicing on which this verse was revealed. Thereupon 'Umar said: I know the day on which it was revealed and the hour when it was revealed and where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had been when it was revealed. It was revealed on the night of Friday and we were in 'Arafat with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at that time.
hi: Tariq bin Shihab ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi ne Umar se kaha: Agar ye aayat Yahudiyon ke silsile mein nazil hui hoti (yaani "Aaj Maine tumhaare liye tumhaara deen mukammal kar diya hai aur tumpar Apni nematon ko poora kar diya hai aur tumhaare liye Islam ko deen ke soorat mein chuna hai") hum us din ko khushi ka din maante jis din ye nazil hui. Isper Umar ne kaha: Mujhe woh din pata hai jab ye nazil hui aur woh ghadi bhi jab ye nazil hui aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt kahan the jab ye nazil hui. Ye Juma ki raat nazil hui aur hum us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Arafat mein the.

e: Tariq b. Shihab reported that a Jew came to 'Umar and said: Commander of the Faithful, there is a verse in your Book, which you recite. Had it been revealed in connection with the Jews, we would have taken it as the day of rejoicing. Thereupon he said: Which verse do you mean? He replied:" This day I have perfected your religion for you and I have completed My favours upon you and I have chosen al-Islam as religion for you." Umar said, I know the day when it was revealed and the place where it was revealed. It was revealed to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at 'Arafat on Friday.
hi: Tariq bin Shihab ne bayan kiya ki ek Yahudi Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ameer-ul-Mominin, aapki Kitaab mein ek aayat hai jise aap padhte hain. Agar ye Yahudiyon ke silsile mein nazil hui hoti, to hum ise khushi ka din maante. Isper unhone (Umar ne) poocha: Aapka matlab kaunsi aayat hai? Usne jawaab diya: "Aaj Maine tumhaare liye tumhaara deen mukammal kar diya hai aur tumpar Apni nematon ko poora kar diya hai aur tumhaare liye Islam ko deen ke soorat mein chuna hai." Umar ne kaha: Mujhe pata hai ye kis din nazil hui aur kahan nazil hui. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Arafat mein, Juma ke din nazil hui.

e: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that he asked 'A'isha about the words of Allah: " If you fear that you will not be able to maintain equity amongst the orphan girls, then marry (those) you like from amongst the women two, three or four." She said: O, the son of my sister, the orphan girl is one who is under the patronage of her guardian and she shares with him in his property and her property and beauty fascinate him and her guardian makes up his mind to marry her without giving her due share of the wedding money and is not prepared (to pay so much amount) which anyone else is prepared to pay and so Allah has forbidden to marry these girls but in case when equity is observed as regards the wedding money and they are prepared to pay them the full amount of the wedding money and Allah commanded to marry other women besides them according to the liking of their heart. 'Urwa reported that 'A'isha said that people began to seek verdict from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after the revelation of this verse about them (orphan girls) and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" They asked thee verdict about women; say: Allah gives verdict to you in regard to them and what is recited to you in the Book about orphan woman, whom you give not what is ordained for them while you like to marry them" (iv. 126). She said: The wording of Allah" what is recited to you" in the Book means the first verse, i. e." if you fear that you may not be able to observe equity in case of an orphan woman, marry what you like in case of woman" (iv. 3). 'A'isha said: (And as for this verse , i. e. and you intend" to marry one of them from amongst the orphan girls" it pertains to one who is in charge (of orphans) having small amount of wealth and less beauty and they have been forbidden that they should marry what they like of her wealth and beauty out of the orphan girls, but with equity, because of their disliking for them.
hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha (RA) se Allah ke ye alfaaz poochhe: "Agar tumhe dar ho ki tum anaath larkiyon ke saath insaaf nahi rakh paaoge, to auraton mein se jo tumhe pasand ho unse shaadi karo, do, teen ya chaar." Unhone kaha: Mere behn ke bete, anaath larki woh hai jo apne sarparast ki nigraani mein hoti hai aur woh uske maal aur apne maal mein shareek hoti hai aur uski daulat aur khoobsurati uski sarparast ko lubhaati hai aur woh use bina uske sahi mahr diye shaadi karne ka mann bana leta hai aur woh utni raqam dene ko taiyaar nahi hota jitni koi doosra shakhs dene ko taiyaar ho. Isliye Allah ne aisi larkiyon se shaadi karna mana kiya siwaay is haalat mein ki insaaf rakha jaaye mahr ke maamle mein aur ve poora mahr dene ko taiyaar hon, aur Allah ne unke ilaawa doosri auraton se shaadi karne ka hukum diya apni dilkhwaish ke mutabik. Urwa ne bayan kiya ki Aisha ne kaha ki log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se in (anaath larkiyon) ke baare mein fatwa maangne lage is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Woh tumse auraton ke baare mein fatwa maangte hain; kaho: Allah tumhe unke baare mein fatwa deta hai aur woh jo tumhe Kitaab mein anaath auraton ke baare mein padha jaata hai, jinhe tum woh nahi dete jo unke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai jabki tum unse shaadi karna chaahte ho" (4:127). Unhone kaha: Allah ke alfaaz "jo tumhe padha jaata hai" ka matlab hai pehli aayat, yaani "agar tumhe dar ho ki tum anaath aurat ke maamle mein insaaf nahi rakh paaoge, to auraton mein se jo tumhe pasand ho unse shaadi karo" (4:3). Aisha ne kaha: (Aur is aayat, yaani) "aur tum in anaath larkiyon mein se kisi ek se shaadi karna chaahte ho", uska ta'alluq us shakhs se hai jo (anaathon ki) dekhbhaal mein hai jiske paas kam daulat aur kam khoobsurati waali larki hai aur unhe mana kiya gaya hai ki woh anaath larkiyon ki daulat aur khoobsurati ki wajah se unse shaadi karein, siwaay is baat ke ki insaaf rakhein, kyunki unhe unse koi lagaav nahi tha.

e: 'Urwa reported that he asked 'A'isha about the words of Allah: " If you fear that you will not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls" ; the rest of the hadith is the same but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Urwa ne bayan kiya ki unhone Aisha (RA) se Allah ke ye alfaaz poochhe: "Agar tumhe dar ho ki tum anaath larkiyon ke maamle mein insaaf nahi rakh paaoge"; baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

e: 'A'isha said that as for the words of Allah: " If you fear that you would not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls)," it was revealed in reference to a person who had an orphan girl (as his ward) and he was her guardian, and her heir, and she possessed property, but there was none to contend on her behalf except her ownself.
