And he (her guardian) did not give her in marriage because of her property and he tortured her and ill-treated her, it was in relation to her that (Allah said: )" If you fear that you would not be able to observe equity in case of orphan girls, then marry whom you like among women," i. e. whatever I have made lawful for you and leave her whom you are putting to torture.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jahan tak Allah ke ye alfaaz hain: "Agar tumhe dar ho ki tum anaath larkiyon ke maamle mein insaaf nahi rakh paaoge," ye ek aise shakhs ke silsile mein nazil hui jiske paas ek anaath larki thi (uski dekhbhaal mein) aur woh uska sarparast tha, aur uska waaris bhi, aur uske paas daulat thi, lekin uski taraf se koi bhi uske haq ke liye jhagadta nahi tha siwaay khud uske. Aur usne (uske sarparast ne) usse iski daulat ki wajah se shaadi nahi ki aur usne use yaatna di aur uske saath bura vyavahaar kiya, isi ke silsile mein (Allah ne farmaaya): "Agar tumhe dar ho ki tum anaath larkiyon ke maamle mein insaaf nahi rakh paaoge, to auraton mein se jo tumhe pasand ho unse shaadi karo," yaani jo bhi maine tumhaare liye jaayez kiya hai, aur use chhod do jise tum yaatna de rahe ho.

e: 'A'isha said in connection with His words (those of Allah): " What is recited to you in the Book about orphan women whom you give not what is ordained for them, while you like to marry them," these were revealed in connection with an orphan girl who was in the charge of the person and she shared with him in his property and he was reluctant to marry her himself and was also unwilling to marry her to someone else (fearing) that (that person) would share in his property (as the husband of that girl), preventing her to marry, neither marrying her himself nor marrying her to another person.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya (Allah ke) in alfaazon ke silsile mein: "Jo tumhe Kitaab mein anaath auraton ke baare mein padha jaata hai, jinhe tum woh nahi dete jo unke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai jabki tum unse shaadi karna chaahte ho," ki ye ek anaath larki ke silsile mein nazil hui jo ek shakhs ki dekhbhaal mein thi aur woh uske maal mein shareek thi aur woh khud usse shaadi karne se hichkichata tha aur woh use kisi aur se bhi shaadi karvaane ko taiyaar nahi tha (is Dar se) ki woh (uska pati) uske maal mein hissedaar ho jaayega, isliye usne use shaadi karne se roka, na khud usse shaadi ki na use kisi aur se shaadi karvaayi.

e: Hisham reported that 'A'isha said in connection with the words of Allah: " They ask thee the religious verdict about women, say: Allah gives you the verdict about them" (iv. 126), that these relate to an orphan girl who is in charge of the person and she shares with him in his property (as a heir) even in the date-palm trees and he is reluctant to give her hand in marriage to any other person lest he (her husband) should partake of his property, and thus keep her in a lingering state.
hi: Hisham ne bayan kiya ki Aisha (RA) ne (Allah ke) in alfaazon ke silsile mein kaha: "Woh tumse auraton ke baare mein fatwa maangte hain; kaho: Allah tumhe unke baare mein fatwa deta hai" (4:127), ki iska ta'alluq ek anaath larki se hai jo ek shakhs ki dekhbhaal mein hai aur woh uske maal mein shareek hai, yahan tak ki khajoor ke darakhton mein bhi, aur woh use kisi doosre shakhs se shaadi karvaane mein hichkichata hai is Dar se ki woh (uska pati) uske maal mein hissedaar ho jaaye, aur is tarah use (larki ko) latakti haalat mein rakhta hai.

e: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that 'A'isha said in connection with His (Allah's) words: " And whoever is poor let him take reasonably (out of it)" that it was revealed in connection with the custodian of the property of an orphan, who is in charge of her and looks after her; In case he is poor, he is allowed to eat out of that.
hi: Hisham ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Aisha (RA) ne (Allah ke) in alfaazon ke silsile mein kaha: "Aur jo koi gareeb hai use munasib maatra mein khaana chahiye" ki ye ek anaath ke maal ke sarparast ke silsile mein nazil hui jo uski dekhbhaal aur uski nigraani karta hai; agar woh gareeb hai to use usmein se khaane ki ijazat hai.

e: 'A'isha reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted: " He who is rich should abstain, and he who is poor may reasonably eat (out of it)" that this was revealed in relation to the guardian of an orphan who is poor; he may get out of that what is reasonable keeping in view his own status of solvency.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne (Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ke) in alfaazon ke silsile mein riwayat ki: "Jo daulatmand hai use dur rehna chahiye, aur jo gareeb hai woh munasib maatra mein khaa sakta hai" ki ye ek anaath ke sarparast ke silsile mein nazil hui jo gareeb hai; woh usmein se itna le sakta hai jitna munasib ho, apni haisiyat ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: 'A'isha reported that these words of Allah: " When they came upon you from above you and from below you and when the eyes turned dull and the hearts rose up to the throats" (xxxiii. 10) pertain to the day of Ditch.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke ye alfaaz: "Jab woh tumhaare upar se aur tumhaare neeche se aaye aur jab aankhein dhundhli ho gayin aur dil gale tak aa gaye" (33:10), Khandaq (khaai) ke din ke silsile mein hain.

e: 'A'isha said in connection with the verse: " And if a woman has reason to fear ill-treatment from her husband or that he might turn away from her" (iv. 128) that it was revealed in case of a woman who had long association with a person (as his wife) and now he intends to divorce her and she says: Do not divorce me, but retain me (as wife in your house) and you are permitted to live with another wife. It is in this context that this verse was revealed.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne is aayat ke silsile mein kaha: "Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne pati se bure vyavahaar ka ya uske munh modne ka dar ho" (4:128) ki ye us aurat ke silsile mein nazil hui jiska ek shakhs (apne pati ke soorat mein) se lambe waqt se ta'alluq raha ho aur ab woh use talaaq dene ka iraada rakhta hai aur woh kehti hai: Mujhe talaaq mat do, balki mujhe (zauja ke soorat mein apne ghar mein) rakho aur tumhe doosri zauja ke saath rehne ki ijazat hai. Isi silsile mein ye aayat nazil hui.

e: 'A'isha said in connection with these words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious: " And if a woman has reason to fear ill-treatment from her husband or that he might turn away from her" that it was revealed in case of a woman who lived with a person and perhaps he does not want to prolong (his relationship with her) whereas she has had sexual relationship with him (and as a result thereof) she got a child from him and she does not like that she should be divorced, so she says to him: I permit you to live with the other wife.
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke in alfaazon ke silsile mein kaha: "Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne pati se bure vyavahaar ka ya uske munh modne ka dar ho," ki ye us aurat ke silsile mein nazil hui jo ek shakhs ke saath rahi ho aur shaayad woh (unke rishte ko) aage badhaana nahi chaahta jabki uske saath uske jinsi ta'alluq se ek bachcha bhi hua ho aur woh ye pasand nahi karti ki use talaaq di jaaye, isliye woh usse kehti hai: Main tumhe doosri zauja ke saath rehne ki ijazat deti hoon.

e: 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father that 'A'isha said to him: O, the son of my sister, the Muslims were commanded to seek forgiveness for the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but they reviled them.
hi: Urwa ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Aisha (RA) ne unse kaha: Mere behn ke bete, Musalmaanon ko hukum diya gaya tha ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ke liye maafi maangein, lekin unhone (kuch logon ne baad mein) unki ninda ki.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Usama with the same chain of narrators.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Usama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: The inhabitants of Kufa differed in regard to this verse:" But whoever slays another believer intentionally, his requital shall be Hell" (iv. 92), so I went to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about it, whereupon he said: This has been revealed and nothing abrogated it.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Kufa ke logon mein is aayat ke baare mein mat-bhinnata thi: "Lekin jo koi jaan-boojh kar kisi imaandaar ko qatal karta hai, uski saza Jahannam hai" (4:92), isliye main Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya aur unse iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ye nazil hui hai aur kisi cheez ne ise mansookh nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of narrators but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: 'Abd al Rahman b. Abzi commanded me that I should ask Ibn 'Abbas about these two verses:" He who slays a believer intentionally his requital shall be Hell where he would abide for ever" (iv. 92). So, I asked him and he said: Nothing has abrogated it. And as for this verse:" And they who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden, except in the cause of justice" (xxv. 68), he (Ibn Abbas) said: This has been revealed in regard to the polytheists."
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Abd al-Rahman bin Abzi ne mujhe hukum diya ki main Ibn Abbas se in do aayaton ke baare mein poochun: "Jo koi jaan-boojh kar kisi imaandaar ko qatal karta hai, uski saza Jahannam hai jahan woh hamesha rahega" (4:92). Isliye maine unse poocha aur unhone kaha: Kisi cheez ne ise mansookh nahi kiya. Aur jahan tak is aayat ka sawaal hai: "Aur woh jo Allah ke saath doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte aur us jaan ko qatal nahi karte jise Allah ne mana kiya hai siwaay insaaf ki khaatir" (25:68), unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) kaha: Ye mushrikeen ke silsile mein nazil hui.

e: Ibn 'Abbas said: This verse was revealed in Mecca:" And they who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden except in the cause of justice" up to the word Muhdana (abased). Thereupon the polytheists said: Islam is of no avail to us for we have made peer with Allah and we killed the soul which Allah had forbidden to do and we committed debauchery, and it was (on this occasion) that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" Except him who repents and believes and does good deeds" up to the end Ibn 'Abbis says: He who enters the fold of Islam and understands its command and then kills the soul there is no repentance for him.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye aayat Makkah mein nazil hui: "Aur woh jo Allah ke saath doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte aur us jaan ko qatal nahi karte jise Allah ne mana kiya hai siwaay insaaf ki khaatir" yahan tak ki "apmaan" lafz tak. Isper mushrikeen ne kaha: Islam humaare liye koi kaam ka nahi hai kyunki humne Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek kiya hai aur humne us jaan ko qatal kiya hai jise Allah ne mana kiya tha aur humne ashleel karya kiya hai, aur isi mauke par Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Siwaay us shakhs ke jo tauba karta hai aur imaan laata hai aur nekokaar amal karta hai" (25:70), akhri tak. Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Jo Islam mein daakhil hota hai aur uske hukumon ko samajhta hai aur phir kisi jaan ko qatal karta hai, uske liye koi tauba nahi hai.

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I said to Ibn Abbas: Will the repentance of that person be accepted who kills a believer intentionally? He said: No. I recited to him this verse of Sura al-Furqan (xix.):" And those who call not upon another god with Allah and slay not the soul which Allah has forbidden except in the cause of justice" to the end of the verse. He said: This is a Meccan verse which has been abrogated by a verse revealed at Medina:" He who slays a believer intentionally, for him is the requital of Hell-Fire where he would abide for ever," and in the narration of Ibn Hisham (the words are): I recited to him this verse of Sura al-Furqan:" Except one who made repentance."
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas se kaha: Kya us shakhs ki tauba qubool ki jaayegi jo jaan-boojh kar kisi imaandaar ko qatal karta hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Maine unhe Sura al-Furqan ki ye aayat padhkar sunaayi: "Aur woh jo Allah ke saath doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte aur us jaan ko qatal nahi karte jise Allah ne mana kiya hai siwaay insaaf ki khaatir" akhri tak. Unhone kaha: Ye Makkah mein nazil hui aayat hai jise Madina mein nazil hui is aayat ne mansookh kar diya: "Jo koi jaan-boojh kar kisi imaandaar ko qatal karta hai, uski saza Jahannam hai jahan woh hamesha rahega," aur Ibn Hisham ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: Maine unhe Sura al-Furqan ki ye aayat padhkar sunaayi: "Siwaay jisne tauba ki."

e: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba reported: Ibn Abbas said to me: Do you know-and in the words of Harun (another narrator): Are you aware of-the last Sura which was revealed in the Qur'an as a whole? I said: Yes," When came the help from Allah and the victory" (cx.). Thereupon, he said: You have told the truth. And in the narration of Abu Shaiba (the words are): Do you know the Sura? And he did not mention the words" the last one".
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba ne bayan kiya: Ibn Abbas ne mujhse kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai - aur Harun (raawiyon mein se ek) ke alfaazon mein: Kya tumhe pata hai poore Quran mein sabse aakhri kaunsi Sura nazil hui? Maine kaha: Haan, "Jab Allah ki madad aayi aur jeet mili" (110). Isper unhone kaha: Tumne sach kaha. Aur Abu Shaiba ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Kya tumhe woh Sura pata hai? Aur unhone "aakhri" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

e: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu 'Umais through the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Umais ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported that some Muslims met a person with a small flock of sheep. He said: As-Salam-o-'Alaikum. They caught hold of him and killed him and took possession of his flock. Then this verse was revealed:" He who meets you and extends you salutations, don't say: You are not a Muslim" (iv. 94). Ibn 'Abbas, however, recited the word as-Salam instead of" as-Salam".
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki kuch Musalman ek shakhs se mile jiske paas bhedon ka ek chhota jhund tha. Usne kaha: As-Salamu-Alaikum. Unhone use pakda aur qatal kar diya aur uska jhund le liya. Phir ye aayat nazil hui: "Jo koi tumse mile aur tumhe salaam kare, mat kaho: Tum Musalman nahi ho" (4:94). Ibn Abbas, halaanki, is lafz ko "as-Salaam" ki jagah "as-Salam" padhte the.

e: Bara' reported: When the Ansar performed the Pilgrimage, they did not enter their houses but from behind. A person from the Ansar came and he began to enter from his door but it was said to him (why he was doing something in contravention to the common practice of coming to the houses from behind). Then this verse was revealed." Piety is not that you come to the doors from behind" (ii. 189).
hi: Bara (RA) ne bayan kiya: Jab Ansar Hajj karte, woh apne gharon mein saamne ke darwaze se daakhil nahi hote balki peeche se. Ansar ka ek shakhs aaya aur usne apne darwaze se daakhil hona shuru kiya lekin usse kaha gaya (ki ye aam prachalit tareeke ke virudh hai, gharon mein peeche se aane ka). Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Nekokaari ye nahi hai ki tum darwazon mein peeche se aao" (2:189).

e: Ibn Mas'ud said: Since our acceptance of Islam and the revelation of this verse in which Allah has shown annoyance to us:" Has not the time yet come for the believers that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah?" (lvii. 16), there was a gap of four years.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: Jab se humne Islam qubool kiya aur jab se ye aayat nazil hui jismein Allah ne humpar naaraazgi zaahir ki: "Kya imaan waalon ke liye abhi waqt nahi aaya ki unke dil Allah ki yaad mein farotan hon?" (57:16), inke beech chaar saal ka antar hai.

e: Ibn Abbas reported: During the pre-Islamic days women circumambulated the Ka'ba nakedly, and said: Who would provide cloth to cover the one who is circumambulating the Ka'ba so that she would cover her private parts? And then she would say: Today will be exposed the whole or the part and what is exposed I shall not make it lawful. It was in this connection that the verse was revealed:" Adorn yourself at every place of worship" (vii. 31).
hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya: Islam se pehle ke daur mein auraten nangi haalat mein Kaaba ka tawaaf karti thin aur kehti thin: Kaun kapda dega us aurat ko jo Kaaba ka tawaaf kar rahi hai taaki woh apne gupt ang dhaak sake? Aur phir woh kehti: Aaj poora ya kuch hissa zaahir hoga aur jo zaahir hoga use main jaayez nahi banaungi. Isi silsile mein ye aayat nazil hui: "Har ibadatgaah mein apne aap ko sajaao" (7:31).

e: Jabir reported that 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul used to say to his slave-girl: Go and fetch something for us by committing prostitution. It was in this connection that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" And compel not your slave-girls to prostitution when they desire to keep chaste in order to seek the frail goods of this world's life, and whoever compels them, then surely after their compulsion Allah is Forgiving, Merciful" (xxiv. 33).
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul apni laundi se kehta tha: Jaao aur humaare liye kuch (paisa) lekar aao badchalni ke zariye. Isi silsile mein Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ne ye aayat nazil ki: "Aur apni laundiyon ko badchalni ke liye majboor mat karo jab woh paak rehna chaahti hain, is duniya ki zindagi ke kshanik saamaan ki khaatir; aur jo unhe majboor karta hai, to unki majboori ke baad bhi Allah Maafi Karne Wala, Rehmvaan hai" (24:33).

e: Jabir reported that 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul had two slave-girls; one was called Musaika and the other one was called Umaima and he compelled them to prostitution (for which'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul compelled them). They made a complaint about this to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it was upon this that this verse was revealed: " And compel not your slave-girls to prostitute" up to the words:" Allah is Forgiving, Merciful."
hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ki do laundiyaan thin; ek ka naam Musaika tha aur doosri ka naam Umaima tha, aur usne unhe badchalni ke liye majboor kiya (Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ne unhe iske liye majboor kiya). Unhone iski shikaayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ki aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur apni laundiyon ko badchalni ke liye majboor mat karo" yahan tak in alfaazon tak: "Allah Maafi Karne Wala, Rehmvaan hai."

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious: " Those to whom they call upon, themselves seek the means or access to their Lord as to whoever of them becomes nearest" (xvii. 57) that it related to a party of Jinn who were being worshipped and they embraced Islam but those who worshipped them kept on worshipping them (though the Jinn whom the misguided people worshipped had become Muslims). It was then that this verse was revealed.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ke in alfaazon ke silsile mein ye riwayat ki: "Woh jinhe woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab tak pahunchne ke zariye dhoondhte hain, ki unmein se kaun (Allah ke) zyada qareeb hai" (17:57), ki ye Jinnon ke ek giroh se ta'alluq rakhta hai jinki parastish hoti thi aur unhone Islam qubool kar liya lekin jo unki parastish karte the woh unki parastish karte rahe (halaanki jin, jinki gumraah logon ne parastish ki thi, khud Musalman ban chuke the). Isi waqt ye aayat nazil hui.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported in connection with the verse: " Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord," that it related to a group of people who worshipped a party amongst the Jinn. The group from amongst the Jinn embraced Islam, but the people kept worshipping them as they did before, and it was (on this occasion) that the verse was revealed:" Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord." This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman with the same chain of transmitters.
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne is aayat ke silsile mein ye riwayat ki: "Woh jinhe woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab tak pahunchne ke zariye dhoondhte hain," ki ye ek giroh se ta'alluq rakhta hai jo Jinnon ke ek giroh ki parastish karte the. Jinn ka woh giroh Islam qubool kar chuka tha, lekin log unhi ki tarah parastish karte rahe jaise pehle karte the, aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jinhe woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab tak pahunchne ke zariye dhoondhte hain." Ye hadees Sulaiman ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abdullah b. Mas'ud said in connection with the verse: " Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord," that that verse was revealed in connection with a party of Arabs who used to worship a group amnogst the jinn; the jinn embraced Islam but the people kept worshipping them without being conscious of it. Then this verse was revealed:" Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord."
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne is aayat ke silsile mein kaha: "Woh jinhe woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab tak pahunchne ke zariye dhoondhte hain," ki ye aayat kuch Arabon ke ek giroh ke silsile mein nazil hui jo Jinnon ke ek giroh ki parastish karte the; jinn Islam mein daakhil ho chuke the lekin log bina jaane unhi ki parastish karte rahe. Phir ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jinhe woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab tak pahunchne ke zariye dhoondhte hain."

e: Sa'id b. Jubair reported: I said to Ibn 'Abbas about Sura Tauba, whereupon he said: As for Sura Tauba, it is meant to humiliate (the non-believers and the hypocrites). There is constantly revealed in it (the pronoun) minhum (of them) and minhom (of them, i. e. such is the condition of some of them) till they (the Muslims) thought that none would be left unmentioned out of them who would not be blamed (for one fault or the other). I again said: What about Sura Anfal? He said: It pertains to the Battle of Badr. I again asked him about Sura al-Hashr. He said: It was revealed in connection with (the tribe) of Banu Nadir.
hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne bayan kiya: Maine Ibn Abbas se Sura Tauba ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Jahan tak Sura Tauba ka sawaal hai, ye (gair-imaandaaron aur munafiqon ko) zaleel karne ke liye hai. Ismein lagataar "minhum" (unmein se) ka zikr hota hai yahan tak ki unhe (Musalmaanon ko) laga ki unmein se koi bhi (kisi na kisi dosh ke liye) bina zikr kiye nahi bachega. Maine phir poocha: Sura Anfal ka kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Badr ki jung ke silsile mein hai. Maine phir unse Sura al-Hashr ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Ye Banu Nadir (qabile) ke silsile mein nazil hui.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported that Umar delivered a sermon on the pulpit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he praised Allah and lauded Him and then said: Now coming to the point. Behold I when the command pertaining to the prohibition of wine was revealed, it was prepared from five things: from wheat, barley, date, grape, honey; and wine is that which clouds the intellect; and O people, I wish Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) could have explained to us in (more) detail the laws pertaining to the inheritance of the grandfather, about one who dies leaving no issue, and some of the problems pertaining to interest.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar par khutba diya aur Allah ki hamd ki, phir kaha: Ab humaare maqsad par aate hain. Dekho! Jab sharaab ko mana karne ka hukum nazil hua, ye paanch cheezon se banaayi jaati thi: gehun, jau, khajoor, angoor, shahad; aur sharaab woh hai jo buddhi ko dhundhla kar deti hai; aur, aye logo, kaash Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (aur) vistaar se dada ke virasat ke maamlon ki jaankaari di hoti, un logon ke baare mein jo koi aulad chhode bina marte hain, aur byaaj se ta'alluq rakhne wali kuch samasyaon ke baare mein bhi.

e: Ibn 'Umar reported: I heard 'Umar b. Khattab delivering sermon on the pulpit ol Allah's messenger (ﷺ) and saying': Now, coming to the point, O people, there was revealed (the command pertaining to the prohibition of wine) and it was prepared (at that time) out of five things: grape, date, honey, wheat, barley, and wine is that which clouds the intellect, and, O people, I wish Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had explained to us in greater detail three things: the inheritance of the grandfather, of one who dies without leaving any issue, and some of the problems of interest.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Umar bin Khattab ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar par khutba dete aur ye kehte suna: Ab humaare maqsad par aate hain, aye logo, (sharaab ko mana karne ka hukum) nazil hua aur ye (us waqt) paanch cheezon se banaayi jaati thi: angoor, khajoor, shahad, gehun, jau, aur sharaab woh hai jo buddhi ko dhundhla kar deti hai, aur, aye logo, kaash Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein teen cheezein aur vistaar se samjhaayi hotin: dada ke virasat ke baare mein, us shakhs ke baare mein jo koi aulad chhode bina marta hai, aur byaaj se ta'alluq rakhne wali kuch samasyaon ke baare mein.

e: This hadith has been transmitted on the same authority but with a slight variation of wording.
hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Abu Dharr took an oath that this verse: " These two adversaries who dispute about their Lord" (xxii. 19) was revealed in connection with those who on the Day of Badr came out (of rows to fight against the non-believers and they were) Hamza, 'Ali, 'Ubaida b. Harith (from the side of the Muslims) and 'Utba and Shaiba, both of them the sons of Rabi'a and Walid b. 'Utba (from the side of the non-believers of Mecca).
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne qasam khaakar kaha ki ye aayat: "Ye do virodhi hain jo apne Rab ke baare mein jhagadte hain" (22:19) un logon ke silsile mein nazil hui jo Badr ke din (safon se) nikle (gair-imaandaaron se ladne ke liye, aur woh the) Hamza, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ubaida bin Harith (Musalmaanon ki taraf se) aur Utba aur Shaiba, donon Rabi'a ke bete, aur Walid bin Utba (Makkah ke gair-imaandaaron ki taraf se).

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr through another chain of transmitters.
hi: Ye hadees Abu Dharr (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: Ibn `Umar narrated that:the Prophet said: "Salat will not be accepted without purification, nor Charity from Ghulul." Hannad said in his narration, "except with purification" [Abu `Eisa said: This Hadith is the most correct thing on this topic, and the best. There are also narrations on this topic from Abu Al-Malih, from his father; and Abu Hurairah and Anas. And Abu Al-Malih bin Usamah's name is `Amir, and they also say it was Zaid bin Usamah bin `Umair Al-Hudhali]
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Taharat ke baghair namaz qabool nahi hoti, aur ghulool (maal-e-ghanimat mein khayanat) se diya gaya sadaqa bhi qabool nahi hota." Hannad ne apni riwayat mein kaha: "Taharat ke saath hi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye is baab mein sabse sahih aur behtareen hadees hai. Is mauzu par Abu al-Malih apne walid se, Abu Hurairah aur Anas (RA) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu al-Malih bin Usamah ka naam Amir tha; kuch log Zaid bin Usamah bin Umair al-Hudhali bhi kehte hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When a Muslim, or believer, performs Wudu', washing his face, every evil that he looked at with his eyes leaves with the water - or with the last drop of water, or an expression similar to that - and when he washes his hands, every evil he did with his hands leaves with the water - or with the last drop of water - until he becomes free of sin
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Musalman, ya momin, wuzu karta hai aur apna chehra dhota hai, to uski aankhon se dekhe hue har gunaah paani ke saath, ya paani ke aakhri qatre ke saath, nikal jata hai. Jab woh apne haath dhota hai, to haathon se kiya hua har gunaah paani ke saath, ya paani ke aakhri qatre ke saath, nikal jata hai; yahan tak ke woh gunaahon se paak ho jata hai.

e: Ali narrated that :the Prophet, said: "The key to Salat is the purification, its Tahrlm is the Takblr, and its Tahlil is the Taslim
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ki chaabi taharat hai; us mein dakhil hone ki takbeer, aur us se nikalne ka salam hai."

e: Jabir bin 'Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The key to Paradise is Salat, and the key to Salat is Wudu
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ki chaabi namaz hai, aur namaz ki chaabi wuzu hai."

e: Anas bin Malik said:"When the Prophet entered the toilet he would say: 'O Allah Indeed I seek refuge in You.'" Shu'bah (one of the narrators) said: "Another time he said: 'I seek refuge in You from AI-Khubthi and al-Khablth.' Or: 'Al-Khubthi and Al-Khaba'ith
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) bait-ul-khala mein dakhil hote to farmate: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika." Shu'bah, jo rawi hain, ne kaha: Ek martaba aap ne farmaya: "Main Khubth aur Khaba'ith se Teri panah maangta hoon." Ya unhon ne kaha: "Al-Khubthi aur Al-Khaba'ith se."

e: Anas bin Malik said:"When the Prophet would enter the toilet 'He said: "O Allah! Indeed I seek refuge in You from Al-Khubith and Al- Khaba'ith
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) bait-ul-khala mein dakhil hote to farmate: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-khubthi wal-khaba'ith."

e: Aishah, [may Allah be pleased with her] said:"When the Prophet would exit the toilet he would say: 'Ghufranak
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) bait-ul-khala se bahar tashrif late to farmate: "Ghufranak" yani, "Ai Allah, Tujh se maghfirat chahta hoon."

e: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you arrives to defecate, then let none of you face the Qiblah while defecating, nor while urinating. And do not have your back towards it, but have it east of you or west of you
hi: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi peshab ya paikhana ke liye jaye, to Qiblah ki taraf rukh karke na paikhana kare aur na peshab; aur na uski taraf peeth kare. Balki mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf rukh kare.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah said:"The Prophet prohibited us from facing the Qiblah while urinating. Then i saw him facing it a year before he died
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne humein Qiblah ki taraf rukh karke peshab karne se mana farmaya. Phir maine aap ko wafat se ek saal pehle us ki taraf rukh karke dekha.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that :he saw the Prophet urinating while facing the Qiblah. Qutaibah narrated that to us, he said: "Ibn Lahi'ah informed us." Jabir's Hadlth about the Prophet is more correct than the Hadith of Ibn Lahi'ah. Ibn Lahi'ah is weak according to the scholars of Hadith. He was graded weak by Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan, and others, [due to his memorization]
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko Qiblah ki taraf rukh karke peshab karte dekha. Qutaibah ne humein riwayat ki ke Ibn Lahi'ah ne humein khabar di. Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein Jabir ki hadees Ibn Lahi'ah ki hadees se zyada sahih hai. Muhaddiseen ke nazdeek Ibn Lahi'ah zaeef hain. Yahya bin Saeed al-Qattan aur dusre muhaddiseen ne un ki yaad-dasht ki wajah se unhe zaeef qarar diya hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar said:"One day I climbed on Hafsah's house, and I saw the Prophet relieving himself while facing Ash-Sham, with his back toward the Ka'bah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Ek din main Hafsah (RA) ke ghar ki chhat par chadha aur maine Nabi (SAW) ko hajat poori karte dekha; aap ka rukh Sham ki taraf tha aur peeth Ka'bah ki taraf thi.

e: Aishah said:"Whoever narrated to you that the Prophet would urinate while standing; then do not believe him. He would not urinate except while squatting." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Umar, Buraidah, [and Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah]
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Jo tum se ye bayan kare ke Nabi (SAW) khade hokar peshab karte the, us ki baat par yaqeen na karo. Aap sirf baith kar peshab karte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Buraidah aur Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah (RA) se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Hudhaifah narrated:"Allah's Messenger came to a waste area used by people, so he urinated on it while standing. I brought him the (water for) Wudu. Then I left to be away from him, but he called me until I was behind him. So he performed Wudu and wiped (Masaba) over his Khuff
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) logon ke istemal ki hui khuli jagah par tashrif laye aur wahan khade hokar peshab kiya. Main aap ke liye wuzu ka paani laya. Main aap se door hone laga, lekin aap ne mujhe bulaya, yahan tak ke main aap ke peechhe khada ho gaya. Phir aap ne wuzu kiya aur apne khuffain par masah kiya.

e: Anas, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, said:"When the Prophet wanted to relieve himself, he would not raise his garment until he was close to the ground
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) hajat poori karna chahte, to zameen ke qareeb hone tak apna kapra upar nahi uthate the.

e: Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah narrated from his father:"The Prophet prohibited that a man should touch his penis with his right hand
hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah ne apne walid se riwayat ki: Nabi (SAW) ne mana farmaya ke aadmi apne daaye haath se apni sharmgah ko chhuye.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazld said, :"They said to Salman, 'Your Prophet taught you about everything, even defecating?' So Salman said, 'Yes. He prohibited us from facing the Qiblah when defecating and urinating, performing Istinja with the right hand, using less than three stones for Istinja, and using dung or bones for Istinja
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne kaha: Logon ne Salman (RA) se kaha: Kya tumhare Nabi ne tumhein har cheez, hatta ke paikhana karne ka tareeqa bhi sikha diya hai? Salman (RA) ne kaha: Haan. Aap ne humein paikhana ya peshab ke waqt Qiblah ki taraf rukh karne, daaye haath se istinja karne, istinja ke liye teen pattharon se kam istemal karne, aur gobar ya haddi se istinja karne se mana farmaya.

e: Abdullah said:"Allah's Messenger went out to relieve himself. So he said: 'Bring me tree stones.'" He said, "So I came with two stones and a piece of dung. So he took the two stones, and left the dung. He said: 'It is Riks (a degenerative or filthy thing)
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) hajat poori karne ke liye tashrif le gaye aur farmaya: Mere liye teen patthar lao. Main do patthar aur gobar ka ek tukra laya. Aap ne do patthar le liye aur gobar ko chhor diya. Aap ne farmaya: Ye riks hai, yani gandagi hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Do not perform Istinja, with dung, nor with bones. For indeed it is provisions for your brothers among the Jinn
hi: Abdullah bin Masud (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Gobar aur haddiyon se istinja na karo, kyunki ye tumhare jinn bhaiyon ka rizq hain.

e: Aishah said:"Encourage your Husbands to clean themselves with water, for I am too shy of them, and Allah's Messenger would do that
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Apne shoharon ko paani se safai karne ki talqeen karo. Main un se ye baat kehne mein haya mehsoos karti hoon, lekin Rasoolullah (SAW) aisa kiya karte the.

e: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah said:I was with the Prophet on a journey. The Prophet had to relieve himself, so he went far away
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shubah (RA) ne kaha: Main ek safar mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha. Aap ko hajat hui to aap kaafi door chale gaye.

e: Abdullah bin Mughaffal narrated that :the Prophet prohibited that a man should urinate in his bathing area. And he said: "It will only cause misgivings." [He said:] There are narrations on This topic from "a man from among the Companions of the Prophet
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne aadmi ko apni ghusl ki jagah par peshab karne se mana farmaya aur farmaya: Is se waswase paida hote hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "If it were not that it would be difficult on my nation, then I would have ordered them to use the Siwak for each prayer
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Agar meri ummat par mushkil na hoti, to main unhein har namaz ke saath miswak karne ka hukum deta.

e: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani said :'I heard Allah's Messenger saying: 'If it were not that it would be difficult on my nation then, I would have ordered them to use the Siwak for each prayer and to delay the Isha prayer until the third of the night.'"He [Abu Salamah, one of the narrators] said: Zaid bin Khalid wouId attend the prayer in the Masjid and his Siwak would be on his ear in the location of the pen on the ear of a writer. He would not get up to pray without cleaning his teeth, then returning it to its location
hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani (RA) ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Agar meri ummat par mushkil na hoti, to main unhein har namaz ke saath miswak karne aur Isha ki namaz ko raat ke ek tihai hissa tak muakhkhar karne ka hukum deta. Abu Salamah, jo rawi hain, ne kaha: Zaid bin Khalid (RA) masjid mein namaz ke liye aate aur un ka miswak kaan par us jagah hota jahan likhne wala apna qalam rakhta hai. Woh namaz ke liye khade na hote jab tak miswak na kar lete, phir use apni jagah rakh dete.

e: Abu Hurairah reported that the :Prophet said: "When on of you awakens in the night, then let him not put his hand into the vessel until he has poured water on two times, or three times, for indeed he does not know where his hand has spent the night
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi raat ko neend se jage, to apna haath bartan mein na dale jab tak us par do ya teen martaba paani na baha le, kyunki use nahi maloom ke raat mein us ka haath kahan raha.

e: Rabah bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Sufyan bin Huwaitib narrated from his grandmother, from her father; she said (that he said):"I heard Allah's Messenger saying: there is no Wudu for one who does not mention Allah's Name over it
hi: Rabah bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Sufyan bin Huwaitib ne apni nani se, aur unhon ne apne walid se riwayat ki ke unhon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jis ne wuzu par Allah ka naam na liya, us ka wuzu nahi.

e: Rabah Bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sufyan bin Huwaitib narrated :the same from his grandmother the daughter of Sa'eed bin Zaid, from her father, from the Prophet
hi: Rabah bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Sufyan bin Huwaitib ne apni nani, Saeed bin Zaid ki beti, se aur unhon ne apne walid se Nabi (SAW) ki yahi riwayat bayan ki.

e: Salamah bin Qais narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When you perform Wudu then sniff water in the nose and blow it out, and when you use small stones (to remove filth) then make it odd (numbered)
hi: Salamah bin Qais (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab wuzu karo to naak mein paani dalo aur use jhaaro; aur jab pattharon se safai karo to un ki tadaad taaq rakho.

e: Abdullah bin Zaid said:"1 saw the Prophet rinse his mouth and sniff water in his nose using one hand, he did that thrice
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ek hi haath se kulli karte aur naak mein paani dalte dekha. Aap ne ye teen martaba kiya.

e: Hassan bin Bilal said:"1 saw Ammar bin Yasir performing Wudu, so he went through his beard (with his hand). It was said to him" - or he said - "1 said: 'You go through your beard?' He said: 'And what is there to prevent me? Indeed I saw Allah's Messenger going through his beard
hi: Hassan bin Bilal ne kaha: Maine Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ko wuzu karte dekha; unhon ne apni daadhi mein ungliyan pherin. Un se kaha gaya, ya maine un se kaha: Aap daadhi mein ungliyan pherte hain? Unhon ne kaha: Is mein kya harj hai? Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko apni daadhi mein ungliyan pherte dekha hai.

e: (In another narration) Ammar narrated :the same from the Prophet
hi: Ek dusri riwayat mein Ammar (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se isi ma'ni ki riwayat bayan ki.

e: Uthman bin Affan narrated that :the Prophet would go through his beard
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) apni daadhi mein ungliyan pherte the.

e: Abdullah bin Zaid narrated that:"Allah's Messenger wiped over his head with his hands, going over the front with them and the rear. He began with the front of his head until they went to the nape of his neck. Then he brought them back again to the place where he began. Then he washed his feet
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne dono haathon se sar ka masah kiya. Haath aage se peechhe le gaye; peshani se shuru kiya, yahan tak ke gardan ke pichhle hisse tak pohanche, phir unhein wapas us jagah le aaye jahan se shuru kiya tha. Phir aap ne paon dhoye.

e: Ar-Rubay' bint Mu'awwidh bin Afra' narrated:"The Prophet wiped his head two times: He began with the rear of his head, then with the front of his head and with both of his ears, outside and Inside of them
hi: Ar-Rubayyi bint Muawwidh bin Afra (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne sar ka do martaba masah kiya. Aap ne sar ke pichhle hisse se shuru kiya, phir aage ke hisse ka, aur dono kaanon ke bahar aur andar ka masah kiya.

e: Ar-Rubayy bint Mu'awidh bin Afra narrated that :she saw the Prophet performing Wudu. She said: "He wiped his head, and what is in the front of it and what is in its rear, and his temples and his ears one time
hi: Ar-Rubayyi bint Muawwidh bin Afra (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte dekha. Unhon ne kaha: Aap ne apne sar ke aage aur peechhe ke hisse, kanpatiyon aur kaanon ka ek martaba masah kiya.

e: Abdullah bin Zaid narrated that :he saw the Prophet performing Wudu, and that he wiped his head with water that was not left over from his hands
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte dekha aur aap ne sar ka masah us paani se kiya jo haathon se bacha hua na tha.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated:"The Prophet wiped his head and his ears: the outside and the inside of them." ($ahih)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne sar aur dono kaanon ke bahar aur andar ka masah kiya. (Sahih)

e: Abu Umamah narrated:"The Prophet performed Wudu; so he washed his face three times, and his hands three times, and wiped his head, and he said: "The ears are part of the head
hi: Abu Umamah (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu kiya; aap ne chehra teen martaba dhoya, haath teen martaba dhoye aur sar ka masah kiya. Aap ne farmaya: Kaan sar ka hissa hain.

e: Asim bin Laqit bin Sabirah narrated from his father that :the Prophet Muhammad said: "When performing Wudu go between the fingers
hi: Asim bin Laqit bin Sabirah ne apne walid se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu karte waqt ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When performing Wudu go between the fingers of your hands and (toes of) your feet
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu karte waqt apne haathon ki ungliyon aur paon ki ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo.

e: Al-Mustawrid bin Shaddad Al-Fihri said :"I saw the Prophet when he was performing Wudu doing that to the toes on his feet with his pinky
hi: Al-Mustawrid bin Shaddad al-Fihri (RA) ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte hue apni chhoti ungli se paon ki ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karte dekha.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Protect the heels from the Fire
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Aediyon ko Aag se bachao.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet performed Wudu one time (for each limb)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu ke har aza ko ek ek martaba dhoya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Prophet performed Wudu two time (for each limb)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu ke har aza ko do do martaba dhoya.

e: Ali narrated that:"The Prophet performed Wudu three times (for each limb)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu ke har aza ko teen teen martaba dhoya.

e: Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah said, :"I asked Abu Ja'far: 'Did Jabir narrate to you that: "The Prophet performed Wudu one time each, and two times, and three times?" He said: "Yes
hi: Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah ne kaha: Maine Abu Jafar se poocha: Kya Jabir (RA) ne aap se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu ke aza ko ek ek, do do aur teen teen martaba dhoya? Unhon ne kaha: Haan.

e: Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah said, :"1 asked Abu Ja'far: 'Did Jabir narrate to you that: "The Prophet performed Wudu one time each?" He said: "Yes
hi: Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah ne kaha: Maine Abu Jafar se poocha: Kya Jabir (RA) ne aap se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu ke aza ko ek ek martaba dhoya? Unhon ne kaha: Haan.

e: Abdullah bin Zaid narrated that:"The Prophet performed Wudu. So he washed his face three times, and washed his hands two times each, and wiped his head, and washed his feet [two times]
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu kiya: Chehra teen martaba dhoya, dono haath do do martaba dhoye, sar ka masah kiya aur paon do do martaba dhoye.

e: Abu Hayyah narrated:"I saw Ali performing Wudu. He washed his hands until he cleaned them, then he rinsed out his mouth three times, sniffed water into his nose and blew it out three times, washed his face three times, and his forearms three times. He wiped his head once, then he washed his feet up to the ankles. Then he stood up, taking what was left over from his purification (water) and drank it while he was standing. Then he said, 'I wanted to show you how Allah's Messenger purified himself
hi: Abu Hayyah ne kaha: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko wuzu karte dekha. Unhon ne haath dhoye yahan tak ke unhein saaf kar liya, phir teen martaba kulli ki, teen martaba naak mein paani dala aur jhaara, chehra teen martaba dhoya aur bazu teen martaba dhoye. Sar ka ek martaba masah kiya, phir takhnon tak paon dhoye. Phir khade hue aur wuzu ke bache hue paani ko khade khade piya. Phir kaha: Main tumhein Rasoolullah (SAW) ka wuzu karke dikhana chahta tha.

e: Abd Khair related a narration similar to that of Abu Hayyah, :from Ali (no. 48). Except that Abd Khair's version includes the following additions: "When he was finished from his purification, he would take what was left over from his purification with his hand to drink it
hi: Abd Khair ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se Abu Hayyah wali riwayat jaisi riwayat bayan ki. Albatta Abd Khair ki riwayat mein ye izafa hai: Jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) wuzu se farigh hote, to bacha hua wuzu ka paani apne haath mein le kar pi lete.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Jibril came to me and he said: 'O Muhammad! When you perform wudu then perform Nadh
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jibreel (AS) mere paas aaye aur kaha: Ai Muhammad, jab aap wuzu karein to naak mein paani dal kar use achhi tarah jhaarein.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Shall I tell you that for which Allah will wipe out your sins, and raise your ranks?" They said, "Of course Allah's Messenger!" He said: "Performing Wudu well in difficulty, and taking many steps to the Masajid, and waiting for Salat after Salat, That is the Ribat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya main tumhein woh cheez na bataun jis se Allah gunaah mita deta aur darjaat buland karta hai? Sahaba ne arz ki: Kyun nahi, Allah ke Rasool. Aap ne farmaya: Sakhti ke waqt bhi achhi tarah wuzu karna, masjidon ki taraf zyada qadam chalna, aur ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ka intezar karna. Yehi ribat hai.

e: Qutaibah said in his narration:"For that is the Ribat, that is the Ribat, that is the Ribat" three times
hi: Qutaibah ne apni riwayat mein kaha: Aap ne "Yehi ribat hai" teen martaba farmaya.

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger had a cloth that he would use to dry off with after Wudu
hi: Aisha (RA) se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ek kapra tha jisse aap wuzu ke baad apne badan ko khushk karte the.

e: Muadh bin Jabal narrated:"I saw the Prophet when he performed Wudu, he wiped his face with the edge of his garment." Abu Eisa said: This Hadith is gharib, and its chain is weak. Rishdin bin Sa'd and Abdur- Rahman bin Ziyad bin An'um Al Ifriqi [narrators in the chain of this Hadith] are weak in Hadith. Some people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet and those after them, permitted using a towel after Wudu. Those who disliked it, only disliked it from the view of the saying: "Wudu is weighed." That as reported from Sa'eed bin Al- Musayyab and Az-Zuhri. Muhammad bin Humaid [Ar-Razi] narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, he said: Ali bin Mujahid narrated to me, and he is trustworthy to me, from me, from: Tha'labah from Az-Zuhri, he said: "The towel is only disliked after Wudu because Wudu is weighed
hi: Muadh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu ke baad apne kapre ke kinare se chehra ponchte dekha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadees gharib hai aur is ki sanad zaeef hai. Is sanad ke rawi Rishdin bin Saad aur Abdur-Rahman bin Ziyad bin Anum al-Ifriqi hadees mein zaeef hain. Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur un ke baad ke kuch ahl-e-ilm ne wuzu ke baad towel istemal karne ki ijazat di. Jin logon ne ise na-pasand kiya, un ki wajah ye riwayat thi ke "Wuzu tola jata hai." Ye Saeed bin al-Musayyab aur Zuhri se manqool hai. Zuhri ne kaha: Wuzu ke baad towel isi liye na-pasand kiya jata hai ke wuzu tola jata hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: 'Whoever performs Wudu, making Wudu well, then says: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan-abduhu wa rasuluhu, Allahummajalni minat tawwabin, waj'alni minal mutatahhirin) 'I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, there are no partners for Him. And I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah! Make me among the repentant, and make me among those who purify themselves.' Then eight gates of Paradise are opened for him, that may enter by whichever of them wishes
hi: Umar bin al-Khattab (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo shakhs achhi tarah wuzu kare, phir kahe: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluhu. Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabin, waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin. Yani: Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai aur us ka koi shareek nahi; aur Muhammad us ke bande aur Rasool hain. Ai Allah, mujhe tauba karne walon aur paak rehne walon mein shamil farma. To us ke liye Jannat ke aath darwaze khol diye jate hain; woh jis darwaze se chahe dakhil ho.

e: Safinah narrated:"The Prophet would perform Wudu with a Mudd, and he would perform Ghusl with a Sa
hi: Safinah (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ek mudd paani se wuzu aur ek saa paani se ghusl farmate the.

e: Ubayy bin Ka'b narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed there is a Shaitan for Wudu' who is called "AI-Walahan." So beware of having misgivings about water
hi: Ubayy bin Kab (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu ke liye ek shaitan hai jise al-Walahan kaha jata hai. Is liye paani ke bare mein waswason se bacho.

e: Anas narrated that :"The Prophet would perform wudu for every Salat, whether he was in state of purity or not in a state of purity
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) har namaz ke liye wuzu karte the, chahe aap ba-wuzu hon ya na hon.

e: It has been related in a narration from Ibn Umar that :the Prophet said: "Whoever performs Wudu while in a state of purity, Allah writes for him on account of it ten good merits
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo shakhs ba-wuzu hote hue dobara wuzu kare, Allah us ke liye das nekiyan likhta hai.

e: Amr bin Amir Al-Ansari narrated that he heard Anas bin Malik saying:"The Prophet would perform Wudu for every Salat." I said, "So what about you, what would you do?" He said I wouId pray all of the prayers with one Wudu, as long as we had not committed Hadath (anything that invalidates Wudu)
hi: Amr bin Amir al-Ansari ne kaha ke unhon ne Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: Nabi (SAW) har namaz ke liye wuzu karte the. Maine poocha: Aur aap log kya karte the? Unhon ne kaha: Jab tak hadas, yani wuzu todne wali koi cheez, na hoti hum ek hi wuzu se tamam namazein padh lete the.

e: Sulaiman bin Buraidah narrated that his father said:"The Prophet would perform Wudu for every Salat. So during the year of the Conquest, he performed all of the prayers with one Wudu, and he wiped over his Khuff. So Umar said, 'You did something that you have not done before?' He replied: "I did it on purpose
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraidah ne apne walid se riwayat ki: Nabi (SAW) har namaz ke liye wuzu karte the. Fatah ke saal aap ne tamam namazein ek hi wuzu se padheen aur khuffain par masah kiya. Umar (RA) ne arz ki: Aap ne aaj woh kaam kiya jo pehle nahi kiya? Aap ne farmaya: Maine ye jaan boojh kar kiya hai.

e: Maimunah said:"I and Allah's Messenger would perform Ghusl for Janabah from one vessel
hi: Maimunah (RA) ne kaha: Main aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ek hi bartan se janabat ka ghusl karte the.

e: Abu Hajib narrated from a man from Banu Ghifar who said:"The Prophet prohibited using the leftover (water) of a woman's Purification
hi: Abu Hajib ne Banu Ghifar ke ek shakhs se riwayat ki: Nabi (SAW) ne aurat ke taharat ke bache hue paani se wuzu karne se mana farmaya.

e: A1-Hakim bin Amr AI-Ghifari narrated that:"The Prophet forbade that a man should perform Wudu with the leftover (water) from a woman's purifcation." Or, he said: "from her drinking
hi: Al-Hakim bin Amr al-Ghifari (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne aadmi ko aurat ke taharat ke bache hue paani se wuzu karne se mana farmaya; ya farmaya: us ke bache hue peene ke paani se.

e: [Ibn Abbas narrated:"One of the wives of the Prophet performed Ghusl with a bowl. Allah's Messenger wanted to perform Wudu with it, so she said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Indeed I am ]unub.' So he said: 'Indeed, water does not become Junub
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ki ek zauja ne ek bartan se ghusl kiya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne us se wuzu karna chaha to unhon ne arz ki: Allah ke Rasool, main junub thi. Aap ne farmaya: Paani junub nahi hota.

e: Abu Sa'eed AI-Khudri narrated:"It was said, 'O Allah's Messenger! Shall we use the water of Buda'ah well to perform ablution while it is a well in which menstruation rags, flesh of dogs and the putrid are dumped?" Allah's Messenger said: 'Indeed water is pure, nothing makes it impure
hi: Abu Saeed al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat hai: Arz kiya gaya: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum Bir Budaah ke paani se wuzu karein, halanke us mein haiz ke kapre, kutton ka gosht aur gandagi dali jati hai? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Paani paak hai; koi cheez use napaak nahi karti.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I heard AlIah's Messenger while he was being asked about water in open areas of the land, and predators and beasts come to it." He said: 'So Allah's Messenger said: 'When the water is two Qullah it does not carry filth
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) se khuli zameen ke us paani ke bare mein poocha gaya jahan darinde aur janwar aate hain. Aap ne farmaya: Jab paani do qullah ho, to woh gandagi qabool nahi karta.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Let none of you urinate [in still water, then perform Wudu with it]
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum mein se koi thehre hue paani mein peshab na kare, phir usi se wuzu kare.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"A man asked Allah's Messenger 'O Messenger of Allah! We sail the seas, and we only carry a little water with us. If we use it for Wudu then we will go thirsty. So shall we perform Wudu from the (water of the) sea?' Allah's Messenger said: 'Its water is pure, and its dead are lawful
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai: Ek shakhs ne arz ki: Allah ke Rasool, hum samandar mein safar karte hain aur saath thoda paani le jate hain. Agar us se wuzu karein to pyase reh jayenge. Kya hum samandar ke paani se wuzu kar sakte hain? Aap ne farmaya: Us ka paani paak hai aur us ka mara hua janwar halal hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet passed by two graves. He said: 'These two are being punished. And they are not being punished for something major. As for this one, he would not protect himself from his urine. As for this one, he used to spread Namimah (slander)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) do qabron ke paas se guzre aur farmaya: In dono ko azaab diya ja raha hai, aur kisi badi baat ki wajah se nahi. Ek peshab ke chhinton se nahi bachta tha, aur dusra namimah, yani chugli, phailata tha.

e: Umm Qais bin Mihsan narrated:"I entered upon the Prophet with a son of mine who was not yet eating food. He urinated on him, so he called for water which he sprinkled over it
hi: Umm Qais bint Mihsan (RA) ne kaha: Main apne us bete ko le kar Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi jo abhi khana nahi khata tha. Us ne aap par peshab kar diya. Aap ne paani mangwaya aur us par chhirak diya.

e: Anas narrated:"Some people from Urainah arrived in Al-Madinah, and they were uncomfortable (and ill from the climate). So Allah's Messenger sent them some camels from charity. He told them: "Drink from their milk and urine." So they killed the camel driver that Allah's Messenger sent, and they violently drove off the camels, and apostatized from Islam. So the Prophet came to them, he cut off their hands and feet on opposite side, and branded their eyes, and threw them in Al-Harrah." Anas said, "So I saw one of them working over the ground with his mouth, until they died
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai: Urainah ke kuch log Madinah aaye aur wahan ki aab-o-hawa se bimar ho gaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein sadaqah ke oonton ke paas bheja aur farmaya: Un ka doodh aur peshab piyo. Phir unhon ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke bheje hue charwahe ko qatl kiya, oonton ko bhaga le gaye aur Islam se phir gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne un par hadd jari ki: un ke haath aur paon mukhalif simton se kaat diye, un ki aankhon ko daag diya aur unhein Harrah mein chhor diya. Anas (RA) ne kaha: Maine un mein se ek ko munh se zameen khodte dekha, yahan tak ke woh mar gaye.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger only poked out their eyes because they had poked out the eyes of the camel driver." Abu 'Eisa said: This Hadfth is Gharib. We do not know anyone who mentioned it other than this shaikh, from Yazid bin Zurai. And it is in accordance with the meaning of Allah's saying: "And wounds equal for equal" It has been reported that Muhammad bin Sirin said: "The Prophet only did this to them before the legislated punishments were revealed
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne un ki aankhen is liye daaghi theen kyunki unhon ne charwahe ki aankhen nikali theen. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadees gharib hai; humein is shaykh ke ilawa kisi aur ka zikr maloom nahi jo Yazid bin Zurai se riwayat karta ho. Ye Allah ke farman, "zakhmon ka badla barabar hai," ke mutabiq hai. Muhammad bin Sirin se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ye saza hudood ke ahkam nazil hone se pehle di thi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "There no Wudu except for a sound or a smell
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu sirf aawaz ya boo ki wajah se toot ta hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you is in the Masjid, and he senses wind between his buttocks then he should not exit until he hears a sound or smells an odor
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein ho aur use apni pichhli taraf se hawa nikalne ka ehsaas ho, to jab tak aawaz na sune ya boo na paye masjid se na nikle.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed Allah does not accept the prayer of one of you when he commits Hadath, until he performs Wudu
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah tum mein se kisi ki namaz us waqt tak qabool nahi karta jab woh hadas kar le, yahan tak ke woh wuzu kar le.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :he saw the Prophet sleeping, while in the prostration position, until he snored or snorted. Then he stoodup to pray. So I said: "O Messenger of Allah! You were sleeping?" He said: "Wudu is not required except for sleeping while reclining. For when one reclines, joints relax
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko sajde ki haalat mein sote dekha, yahan tak ke aap kharate lene lage. Phir aap namaz ke liye khade hue. Maine arz ki: Allah ke Rasool, aap so gaye the? Aap ne farmaya: Wuzu sirf peeth ke bal let kar sone se lazim hota hai, kyunki letne se joron mein dheelapan aa jata hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The companions of Allah's Messenger would sleep, then stand to pray, They would not perform Wudu
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke Sahaba sote, phir namaz ke liye khade ho jate aur wuzu na karte.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Wudu is (required) from what fire has touched, even if it be a piece of cheese
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Wuzu us cheez se lazim hota hai jise aag ne pakaya ho, chahe paneer ka tukra hi ho.

e: Jabir narrated:"Allah's Messenger went out and I went with him. He entered upon a woman from the Ansar. She slaughtered a sheep and he ate from it; and she brought a basket with ripe dates and he ate from it. Then he performed Wudu for Zuhr and prayed. Then he finished, so she brought him something from the remainder of the sheep. So he ate it, then prayed Asr and did not perform Wudu
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) tashrif le gaye aur main bhi aap ke saath tha. Aap Ansar ki ek aurat ke ghar tashrif le gaye. Us ne bakri zibah ki aur aap ne us ka gosht khaya; phir pakke hue khajoor pesh kiye aur aap ne khaye. Phir aap ne Zuhr ke liye wuzu kiya aur namaz padhi. Namaz ke baad us ne bakri ka kuch bacha hua gosht pesh kiya; aap ne khaya, phir Asr ki namaz padhi aur dobara wuzu nahi kiya.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:Allah's Messenger was asked about performing Wudu for camel meat. He said: "Perform Wudu for it." He Was asked about Wudu after eating goat meat. So he said: "Do not perform Wudu for it
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) se Rasoolullah (SAW) se oont ka gosht khane ke baad wuzu ke bare mein poocha gaya. Aap ne farmaya: Is ke baad wuzu karo. Bakri ka gosht khane ke baad wuzu ke bare mein poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya: Is ke baad wuzu na karo.

e: Busrah bint Safwan narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever touches his penis, then he is not to pray until he performs Wudu
hi: Busrah bint Safwan (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo apni sharmgah ko chhuye, woh wuzu kiye baghair namaz na padhe.

e: Busrah narrated :a similar report (as no. 82) from the Prophet
hi: Busrah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se hadees number 82 jaisi riwayat bayan ki.

e: Busrah narrated that :the Prophet said a similar Hadith
hi: Busrah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se isi ma'ni ki hadees bayan ki.

e: Qais bin Talq bin Ali - [and he is] Al-Hanafi narrated from his father, that:the Prophet said: 'Is it other than a piece of his flesh?" Or: "part of him?
hi: Qais bin Talq bin Ali al-Hanafi ne apne walid se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Kya woh tumhare jism ka ek tukra, ya tumhara ek hissa, nahi hai?

e: Urwah narrated from Aishah that:"The Prophet kissed one of his wives, then he went to the prayer and did not perform Wudu." He (Urwah) said: "I said 'Who was it except you?'" [He said:] "So she laughed
hi: Urwah ne Aisha (RA) se riwayat ki: Nabi (SAW) ne apni ek zauja ko bosa diya, phir namaz ke liye tashrif le gaye aur wuzu nahi kiya. Urwah ne kaha: Maine kaha, Aap ke siwa woh kaun ho sakti hain? Is par woh hans deen.

e: Madan bin Abi Talhah narrated from Abu Ad-Darda that :"Allah's Messenger vomited [so he broke fast] so he performed Wudu." So I met Thawban in a Masjid in Damascus, and I mentioned that to him. He said: 'He told the truth, I poured the water for his Wudu
hi: Madan bin Abi Talhah ne Abu ad-Darda (RA) se riwayat ki: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne qay ki, is liye roza khol diya aur wuzu kiya. Main Damascus ki masjid mein Thawban (RA) se mila aur un se ye baat bayan ki. Unhon ne kaha: Us ne sach kaha; main hi aap ke wuzu ke liye paani dalta tha.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"The Prophet asked me: "What is in your Idawah (water skin)?" I said: "Nabidh." He said: "Dates are wholesome and water is pure." He said: "So he performed Wudu with it
hi: Abdullah bin Masud (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne mujh se poocha: Tumhare idawah, yani paani ki mashk, mein kya hai? Maine arz ki: Nabeez hai. Aap ne farmaya: Khajoor paak hai aur paani paak hai. Phir aap ne us se wuzu kiya.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated :the Prophet drank milk. Then he called for water to rinse out his mouth. Then he said: "Indeed it has fat." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi and Umm Salamah. Abu Eisa said: [And] this Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Some of the people of knowledge held the view that one is to wash the mouth after drinking milk and this is recommended according us. Some others did not hold the view that one is to wash out the mouth after drinking milk
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) ne doodh piya, phir kulli ke liye paani mangwaya aur farmaya: Is mein charbi hoti hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sahl bin Saad as-Saidi aur Umm Salamah (RA) se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadees hasan sahih hai. Kuch ahl-e-ilm doodh peene ke baad kulli ko mustahab samajhte hain, aur hamare nazdeek bhi ye mustahab hai; kuch dusre is ke qail nahi hain.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"A man greeted the Prophet (with Salam), and he was urinating, so he did not respond to him
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai: Ek aadmi ne Nabi (SAW) ko salam kiya jab aap peshab kar rahe the, to aap ne jawab nahi diya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Wash the vessel the dog has drunk from seven times: the first or the last of them with dirt. And when the cat drinks out of it, wash it once
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis bartan mein kutta pee le, use saat martaba dho lo, unmein se pehli ya aakhri baar mitti se. Aur jab bartan mein billi pee le, to use ek martaba dho lo."

e: Humaidah bint Ubaid bin Rifa'ah narrated:"Kabshah bint Ka'b bin Malik - she was (married) with Ibn Abi Qatadah - narrated "That Abu Qatadah visited her, [so she said:] 'So I poured water for him to use for Wudu.' She said: 'A cat came to drink, so he lowered he container until it drank.' Kabshah said: 'So he saw me looking at it and said, "O my niece! Are you surprised at that?" So I said yes. He said: "Indeed Allah's Messenger said 'It is not impure, it is only one of those roam around among you
hi: Humaidah bint Ubaid bin Rifa'ah se riwayat hai ke Kabshah bint Ka'b bin Malik - jo Ibn Abi Qatadah ke nikah mein thi - ne bayan kiya ke Abu Qatadah (RA) unke paas aaye. [Kabshah ne kaha:] "Maine unke liye wuzu ka pani dala." Unhon ne kaha: "Ek billi pani peene aayi, to unhon ne bartan ko jhuka diya yahan tak ke usne pi liya." Kabshah ne kaha: "Unhon ne mujhe apni taraf dekhte hue paaya aur farmaya, 'Ae meri bhatiji! Kya tumhe is par hairat hai?' Maine kaha ji haan. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Ye napaak nahi hai, ye to un (jaanwaron) mein se hai jo tumhare paas ghoomte phirte hain'"

e: Hammam bin AI-Harith narrated:"Jarir bin Abdullah urinated, then he performed Wudu, wiping over his Khuff. So he was asked, 'You do this?' He replied, 'What prevents me, when I have seen Allah's Messenger doing it?" He [Ibrahim] said "And they were impressed by the narration of Jarir since he accepted Islam after the revelation Sural Al-Ma'idah." [This is the saying of lbrahim, that is, "They were impressed."] [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Umar, Ali, Hudhaifah, AI-Mughirah, Bilil, Sa'd, Abu Ayyub, Salman, Buraidah, Amr bin Umayyah, Anas, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ya'la bin Murrah, Ubadah bin As-Samit, Usamah bin Shank, Abu Umamah, Jabir, Usamah bin Zaid, and Ibn Ubadah. They call him Ibn Imarah and Ubayy bin Imarah
hi: Hammam bin Al-Harith se riwayat hai: 'Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ne peshaab kiya, phir wuzu kiya aur apne khuffain (mozon) par mash kiya. Unse pucha gaya, "Aap aisa karte hain?" Unhon ne jawab diya, "Mujhe kya cheez rok sakti hai, jab maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa karte dekha hai?"' Unhon ne [Ibrahim] kaha "Aur wo Jarir ki riwayat se mutasir the kyunki unhon ne Surah Al-Ma'idah ke nuzool ke baad Islam qabool kiya tha." [Ye Ibrahim ka qaul hai, yani "Wo mutasir the."] [Unhon ne kaha:] Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Hudhaifah, Al-Mughirah, Bilal, Sa'd, Abu Ayyub, Salman, Buraidah, Amr bin Umayyah, Anas, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ya'la bin Murrah, Ubadah bin As-Samit, Usamah bin Sharik, Abu Umamah, Jabir, Usamah bin Zaid, aur Ibn Ubadah se bhi riwayaten hain. Unhen Ibn Imarah aur Ubayy bin Imarah bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: It has been related from Sahr bin Hawshah that he said:"I saw Jarir bin 'Abdullah performing Wudu and he wiped over his Khuff. I asked him about that. He replied, 'I saw 'I saw Allah's Messenger performing Wudu and he wiped over his Khuff.' So I said to him, before Surah AI-Ma'idah (was revealed) or after AI-Ma'idah?' So he replied, 'I did not acceot Islam until after Al-Ma'idah.'" Qutaibah narrated this to us; (saying) Khalid bin Ziyad At-Tirmidhi narrated it to us, from Muqatil bin Hayyan, from Shahr bin Hawshah, from Jarir. He said: Baqiyyah related it from Ibrahim bin Adham from Muqatil bin Hayyan, from Shahr bin Hawshah, from Jarir. This Hadith is explanatory, because some who dislike wiping over the Khuff give the interpretation that the Prophet's wiping over the two Khuff was before the revelation of Sural Al-Ma'idah. But in his Hadlth, Jarir mentions that he saw the Prophet wiping over his Khuff after the revelation of Surat Al-Ma'idah
hi: Shahr bin Hawshab se riwayat ki gayi hai ke unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Jarir bin Abdullah (RA) ko wuzu karte aur apne khuffain par mash karte dekha. Maine unse is baare mein pucha. Unhon ne jawab diya, "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte aur apne khuffain par mash karte dekha." To maine unse kaha, "Surah Al-Ma'idah se pehle ya Al-Ma'idah ke baad?" To unhon ne jawab diya, "Maine Al-Ma'idah ke baad hi Islam qabool kiya tha."' Qutaibah ne humein ye riwayat batayi; (kaha) Khalid bin Ziyad At-Tirmidhi ne humein Muqatil bin Hayyan se, Shahr bin Hawshab se, Jarir se batayi. Unhon ne kaha: Baqiyyah ne Ibrahim bin Adham se, Muqatil bin Hayyan se, Shahr bin Hawshab se, Jarir se riwayat ki. Ye hadith tashreeh karne wali hai kyunki kuch log jo khuffain par mash karne ke munkir hain, unka tawil ye hai ke Nabi (SAW) ka khuffain par mash Surah Al-Ma'idah ke nuzool se pehle tha, lekin Jarir ne apni riwayat mein zikr kiya hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko Al-Ma'idah ke nuzool ke baad khuffain par mash karte dekha.

e: Khuzaimah bin Thabit narrated:"The Prophet was asked about wiping over the Khuff. So he said: "Three (days) for the traveler, and one day for the resident
hi: Khuzaimah bin Thabit (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) se khuffain par mash ke baare mein pucha gaya. To unhon ne farmaya: "Musafir ke liye teen (din), aur muqeem (ghar par rehne wale) ke liye ek din."'

e: Safwan bin Assal narrated:'When we were traveling, Allah's Messenger would order us not to remove our Khuff for three days and nights, except for Janabah, but not for defecating, urinating, and sleep
hi: Safwan bin Assal (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Jab hum safar mein hote, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein hukum dete ke hum apne khuffain teen din aur raaton tak na utaren, siwaye janabat ke, lekin paakhaana, peshaab, aur neend ke liye utaarne ki zaroorat nahi.'

e: AI-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated:"The Prophet wiped over the Khuff and its bottom
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) ne khuff ke upar aur uske neeche mash kiya.'

e: AI-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated:"I saw the Prophet wiping over the Khuff: on the tops of them
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko khuffain par mash karte dekha: unke upar wale hisse par.'

e: Al-Mughirah bin Shu`bah narrated:"The Prophet performed Wudu' and wiped over his socks and sandals
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur apne moze (jorabain) aur jooton par mash kiya.'

e: Ibn Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated from his father:"The Prophet performed Wudu and wiped over the Khuff and 'Imamah." Abu Bakr (one of the narrators) said: "And indeed I heard it from Ibn Al Mughirah
hi: Ibn Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah apne walid se riwayat karte hain: 'Nabi (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur khuffain aur imamah (pagdi) par mash kiya.' Abu Bakr (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: 'Aur maine ye khud Ibn Al-Mughirah se suna hai.'

e: BilaI narrated:"The Prophet wiped over the Khuff and the Khimar
hi: Bilal (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) ne khuff aur khimar (sar ka poshaak) par mash kiya.'

e: Abu Ubaidah bin Muttammad bin Ammar bin Yasir said:"I asked Jabir bin Abdullah about wiping over the Khuff. He said, 'O my nephew! It is the Sunnah.'" [He said:] "And I asked him about wiping over the lmamah. He said, '[Wipe1 the hair [with water]
hi: Abu Ubaidah bin Muhammad bin Ammar bin Yasir ne kaha: 'Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se khuffain par mash ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne kaha, "Ae mere bhatije! Ye Sunnat hai."' [Unhon ne kaha:] 'Aur maine unse imamah par mash ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne kaha, "Baalon ko paani se tar karo."'

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that his maternal aunt Maimunah said:"I prepared some water for the Prophet to perform Ghusl for Janabah with. So he turned the vessel with his left hand, (pouring some water) over his right. Then he washed his hands. Then he entered his hand into the vessel to pour water over his private area, then he rubbed his hands on the wall, or the ground. Then he rinsed out his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in and blowing it out, and washed his face and forearms. Then he poured water over his head three times, then he poured water over the remainder of his body, then he moved from where he was and washed his feet
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) apni khala Maimunah (RA) se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ke liye ghusl ka paani rakha, to unhon ne janabat ka ghusl kiya. Unhon ne bartan ko apne bayen haath se palat kar apne dahine haath par paani dala. Phir apne dono haath dhoye. Phir apna haath bartan mein daala aur apni sharamgaah par paani bahaya, phir apna haath deewar ya zameen par ragda. Phir kulli ki aur naak mein paani daala, aur apna chehra aur bazuein dhoye. Phir apne sar par teen martaba paani bahaya, phir apne baaki jism par paani bahaya, phir wahan se hat kar apne paon dhoye.'

e: Aishah narrated:"When AlIah's Messenger wanted to perform Ghusl for Janabah, he would begin by washing his hands before putting them into the vessel. Then he would wash his private area, and perform the Wudu (as one does) for Salat. Then he would wet his hair with the water, then he would pour water over his head with his hands three times
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) janabat ka ghusl karna chahte, to pehle apne haath dhote is se pehle ke unhen bartan mein daalen. Phir apni sharamgaah dhote, aur namaz ke liye jaisa wuzu karte hain waisa wuzu karte. Phir apne baalon ko paani se tar karte, phir apne haathon se apne sar par teen martaba paani daalte.'

e: Umm Salamah narrated :"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I am woman with tight braids on my head, should I undo it to perform Ghusl for Janabah? He said: 'No. It is sufficient that you only pour three scoops of water (with hands held together) over your head, then pour water over the rest of your body, to be purified.'" Or he said: "Then you will be purified
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasool Allah! Main aisi aurat hoon jo apne sar ki chotiyan kas kar bandhti hoon, kya janabat ke ghusl ke liye main unhe khol doon? Unhon ne farmaya: "Nahi. Tumhare liye itna kaafi hai ke tum apne sar par teen chullu paani (donon haath jod kar) daalo, phir apne baaki jism par paani bahao, to tum paak ho jaogi."' Ya farmaya: 'To tum paak ho jaogi.'

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Under every hair is sexual impurity so wash (all of) the hair and cleanse the skin
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Har baal ke neeche janabat hai, is liye baalon ko dho lo aur jild ko saaf karo.'

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet would not perform Wudu after the Ghusl
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) ghusl ke baad wuzu nahi karte the.'

e: Aishah narrated:"When the circumcised meets the circumcised, then indeed Ghusl is required. Myself and Allah's Messenger did that, so we performed Ghusl
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Jab khatna wali jagah khatna wali jagah se mil jaaye, to ghusl wajib ho jaata hai. Maine aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya, to humne ghusl kiya.'

e: Aishah narrated that :the Prophet said: "When the circumcised meets the circumcised then Ghusl is required
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab khatna wali jagah khatna wali jagah se mil jaaye, to ghusl wajib ho jaata hai.'

e: Ubayy bin Ka'b narrated:"Water is for water,' was only permitted in the beginning of Islam. Then it was prohibited
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Paani sirf paani ke liye (hai)' - ye sirf Islam ke shuru mein rukhsat (chhoot) thi, phir isse mana kar diya gaya.

e: Ma'mar narrated :a similar narration (as Hadith no. 110) from, Az-Zuhri, with this chain
hi: Ma'mar ne Az-Zuhri se, isi sanad ke saath, (hadith no. 110 jaisi) ek jaisi riwayat ki.

e: Ibn 'Abbas said:"Water is for water' is only about the wet dream
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: 'Paani sirf paani ke liye' - ye sirf ehtelam (wet dream) ke baare mein hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet was asked about a man who finds wetness and he does not remember having a wet dream. So he said: 'He is to perform Ghusl. And (he was asked) about a man who had a wet dream but does not find any wetness, so he said: 'No Ghusl is required of him.' Umm Salamah said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is the woman required to perform Ghusl if she sees that?' He replied: 'Yes. Indeed women are the partners of men
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Nabi (SAW) se us aadmi ke baare mein pucha gaya jo geelapan paata hai lekin usse ehtelam yaad nahi. To unhon ne farmaya: "Wo ghusl kare." Aur (unse pucha gaya) us aadmi ke baare mein jise ehtelam hota hai lekin usse koi geelapan nahi milta, to unhon ne farmaya: "Us par koi ghusl nahi hai." Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya aurat par bhi ghusl hai agar wo aisa dekhe?" Unhon ne jawab diya: "Haan. Beshak auratein bhi mardon ki tarah hain."'

e: Ali narrated:"I asked the Prophet about Al-Madhi. He said: "For Al-Madhi is Wudu, and for AI-Mani is Ghusl
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) se Al-Madhi ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: "Al-Madhi ke liye wuzu hai, aur Al-Mani ke liye ghusl hai."'

e: Sahl bin Hunaif said:"I suffered from a severe and troubling case of Al-Madhi. I was performing Ghusl often because of it. So I mentioned that to Allah's Messenger and asked him about it.
