He said: "You only need to perform Wudu for that." I said: "O Messenger of Allah! How about when it gets on my clothes?" He said: "It is sufficient for you to take a handful of water and sprinkle it n your garment wherever you see that it has touched it
hi: Sahl bin Hunaif (RA) ne kaha: 'Mujhe Al-Madhi ki shiddat aur takleef bahut rehti thi. Is wajah se main aksar ghusl karta tha. Maine ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr ki aur unse is baare mein poocha. Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye sirf wuzu kaafi hai." Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasool Allah! Aur jab ye mere kapdon par lag jaaye to kya karoon? Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye itna kaafi hai ke ek chullu paani lo aur apne kapde par chhirak do jahan tumhe lage ke ye laga hai."'

e: Hammam bin AI-Harith narrated:"Aishah had a guest to whom she lent a yellow wrap for him to sleep in. He had a wet dream, and was too embarrassed to send it to her while the traces of the wet dream were present on it. So he submerged it (washing it) in water, then he sent it to her. Aishah said, "Why did he ruin our garment? It would have been sufficient for him to scrape it off with his fingers. Sometimes I would scrape it off of the garment of Allah's Messenger with my fingers
hi: Hammam bin Al-Harith se riwayat hai: 'Aishah (RA) ke ek mehmaan aaye jinhen unhon ne sone ke liye ek peeli chadar di. Unhen ehtelam ho gaya, aur wo sharminda hue ke chadar wapas bhejein jab tak ehtelam ke nishaan us par mojood the. To unhon ne use paani mein daal kar dhoya, phir wapas bheja. Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Unhon ne humara kapda kyun kharaab kiya? Unke liye itna hi kaafi tha ke wo apni ungliyon se use khurach dein. Kabhi kabhi main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde se apni ungliyon se ye khurach deti thi."'

e: Sulaiman bin Yasar narrated from Aishah, that :she washed Mani from the garment of Allah's Messenger
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar Aishah (RA) se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kapde se mani dhoyi.

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would sleep while he was Junub, and without touching water (performing Ghusl)
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) janabat ki halat mein so jaate, bina paani chhue (yani bina ghusl kiye).'

e: Abu Ishaq:There is a similar report (as no. 1I8) narrated via Abu Ishaq
hi: Abu Ishaq se: Isi jaisi (no. 118 ki tarah) ek riwayat Abu Ishaq ke zariye bayan ki gayi hai.

e: Umar narrated that :he asked the Prophet: "Can one of us sleep while he is Junub?" So he replied: "Yes, when he performs Wudu
hi: Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha: 'Kya hum mein se koi janabat ki halat mein so sakta hai?' To unhon ne jawab diya: 'Haan, jab wuzu kar le.'

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet met him while he was Junub. He said: "[So I slipped away from him - meaning:] I withdrew - to perform Ghusl. Then he returned, so he said: 'Where have you been?' Or: 'Where did you go?' I replied: 'I was Junub.' So he said: 'Indeed the believer is not defiled
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) unse mile jab wo janabat mein the. Unhon ne kaha: "[Main unse chhup gaya - yani] main peeche hat gaya - ghusl karne ke liye. Phir wo laut aaye, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum kahan the?' Ya: 'Tum kahan gaye the?' Maine jawab diya: 'Main janabat mein tha.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Beshak momin napaak nahi hota'"

e: Umm Salamah narrated:Umm Sulaim bint Milhan came to the Prophet and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Indeed Allah is not embarrassed of the truth. So is it required of a woman - meaning Ghusl - when she sees in her sleep similar to what a man sees?' He replied: 'Yes. When she finds water (wetness), then she is perform Ghusl.'" Umm Salamah said: "I said to her: 'O Umm SuIaim! You have disgraced the women
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai: Umm Sulaim bint Milhan (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Beshak Allah haq (baat) se sharmata nahi. To kya aurat par - yani ghusl - wajib hai jab wo neend mein waisa hi kuch dekhe jaisa mard dekhta hai?' Unhon ne jawab diya: 'Haan. Jab wo paani (geelapan) paaye, to wo ghusl kare.'" Umm Salamah ne kaha: "Maine unse kaha: 'Ae Umm Sulaim! Tumne auraton ko sharminda kar diya'

e: Aishah narrated:"Sometimes the Prophet would perform Ghusl from Janabah then come to seek warmth from me, he would hold me and not perform Ghusl
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Kabhi kabhi Nabi (SAW) janabat ka ghusl karte, phir mere paas garmi hasil karne aate, wo mujhe pakad lete aur ghusl nahi karte"

e: Abu Dharr narrated that :AlIah's Messenger said: "Pure clean earth is a purifier for the Muslim; even if he did not find water for ten years. Then if he finds water, then let him use it (for purification) on his skin. For, that is better
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paak mitti Musalman ke liye taharat hai; chahe use das saal tak paani na mile. Phir jab use paani mil jaaye, to wo apni jild par paani ka istemal kare. Kyunki ye behtar hai"

e: Aishah narrated:"Fatimah bint Abi-Hubaish came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I am a woman who suffers from persistent bleeding and I do not become clean. Shall I give up Salat?' He said: 'No. That is only a bIood vessel, it is not menstruation. When your menstruation begins then leave the Salat. And when it ends, then wash the blood from you and perform Salat
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Fatimah bint Abi-Hubaish Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main aisi aurat hoon jise mustahaza (lagataar khoon aane ki bimaari) hai aur main paak nahi hoti. Kya main namaz chhod doon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi. Ye to sirf ek rag hai, ye haiz nahi hai. Jab haiz shuru ho to namaz chhod do. Aur jab wo khatam ho jaaye, to apne aap se khoon dho lo aur namaz padho'"

e: Adiyy bin Thabit narrated from his father, that :the Prophet said about the Mustahadah that she should: "Leave the Salat for the days of her period which she menstruates in, then perform Ghusl, and perform Wudu for every Salat, and observe Saum and perform Salat
hi: Adiyy bin Thabit apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne mustahaza ke baare mein farmaya ke wo: "Apne haiz ke un dinon mein namaz chhode jin mein wo pehle haiz hoti thi, phir ghusl kare, aur har namaz ke waqt wuzu kare, aur roza rakhe aur namaz padhe"

e: A similar narration as no. 120. :Abu Eisa said: Sharik is alone in narrating this Hadith from Abu Al Yaqzan.[He said:] I asked Muhammad (ibn Isma'il AI-Bukhari) about this Hadlth. I said: "Adiyy bin Thabit from his father, from his grandfather; what is the name of Adiyy's grandfather?" But Muhammad did not know his name. And I mentioned to Muhammad that Yahya bin Ma'in said his name is Dinar, and he did not contradict him. Ahmad and 1shaq said ahout the Mustahadah: If she performs Ghusl for every prayer that is more prudent for her, and if she performs Wudu for each prayer, then that is acceptable from her, and if she combines between two prayers with (one) Ghusl then that is acceptable
hi: Isi jaisi riwayat (jaisi upar zikr hui). Abu Isa ne kaha: Sharik akele Abu Al Yaqzan se ye hadith riwayat karte hain. [Unhon ne kaha:] Maine Muhammad (ibn Isma'il Al-Bukhari) se is hadith ke baare mein pucha. Maine kaha: 'Adiyy bin Thabit apne walid se, apne dada se; Adiyy ke dada ka naam kya hai?' Lekin Muhammad ko unka naam maloom nahi tha. Aur maine Muhammad ko Yahya bin Ma'in ka qaul bataya ke unka naam Dinar hai, to unhon ne isse inkar nahi kiya. Ahmad aur Ishaq ne mustahaza ke baare mein kaha: Agar wo har namaz ke liye ghusl kare to ye uske liye zyada ehtiyaat wali baat hai, aur agar wo har namaz ke liye wuzu kare to ye uske liye kaafi hai, aur agar wo do namazon ko ek ghusl ke saath jama kare to ye bhi uske liye kaafi hai

e: Hamnah bint Jahsh narrated:"I had a case of blood flow that was severe and excessive. So I went to the Prophet to inform him and ask him about it. I found him in the house of my sister Zainab bint Jahsh. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah! I suffer from a case of severe and excessive blood flow. So what do you order me to do for it, and does this prevent me from fasting and performing Salat?' He said: 'Tie a cotton rag around yourself and the bIood will go away.' I said, 'It is more than that.' He said: 'Make it tight.' I said, 'It is more than that.' He said: 'Then use a cloth (to bind it).' I said, it is more than that. It flows too much.' So the Prophet said: 'I will order you to do one of two things, which ever of them you do, it will be acceptable for you. You should know which of them you are able to do.' Then he said: 'This is only a blow from Shaitan. Menstruate for six or seven days, which Allah knows, then perform Ghusl. When you see that you have become pure and clean, then perform Salat for twenty-three or twenty-four nights and their days. Perform Salat and fast, and that will be acceptable for you. So do this (if you can) just as (other) women who menstruate and become pure during their periods of menstruation and purity. If (not, and) you are able to delay Zuhr and hasten Asr then perform Ghusl when you have become pure, and pray Zuhr and Asr together. Then delay Maghrib and hasten Isha, then perform Ghusl and combine the two prayers. So do this (if you are able). Then perform Ghusl with the dawn and pray. Do this, and fast if you are able to do so.' Then Allah's Messenger said: 'That is what is preferable to me of the two
hi: Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) se riwayat hai: "Mujhe bahut zyada aur shadeed haiz jaisa khoon aata tha. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi unse fatwa lene aur unhen bataane. Maine unhen apni bahen Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar paaya. Maine kaha, 'Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhe bahut zyada aur shadeed haiz jaisa khoon aata hai. To aap mujhe iske baare mein kya hukum dete hain, kya ye mujhe roza aur namaz se rok deta hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Main tumhe rooi (kapde ka tukda) baandhne ki salah deta hoon, ye khoon rok degi.' Maine kaha, 'Ye usse zyada hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To use kas ke baandho.' Maine kaha, 'Ye usse bhi zyada hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To ek kapda le lo.' Maine kaha, 'Ye usse bhi zyada hai, ye to bahta hi rehta hai.' To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main tumhe do baaton ka hukum dunga, tum in mein se jo bhi karo, wo tumhare liye kaafi hoga. Agar tum in dono par qaboo pa sako, to tum khud behtar jaanti ho.' Phir unhon ne farmaya: 'Ye to sirf Shaitan ki ek thes hai, is liye Allah ke ilm mein che ya saat din tak apne aap ko haiz waali samjho, phir ghusl karo. Jab tumhe lage ke tum paak aur saaf ho chuki ho, to teis ya chaubis raaton aur unke dinon tak namaz padho, aur roza rakho aur namaz padho, ye tumhare liye kaafi hoga. Aur waise hi karo jaise doosri auratein haiz mein hoti hain aur apne haiz aur taharat ke waqt par paak hoti hain. Agar tum Zuhr ko der se aur Asr ko jaldi padh sako, phir jab paak ho jao to ghusl karke Zuhr aur Asr ek saath padh lo, phir Maghrib ko der se aur Isha ko jaldi padho, phir ghusl karke dono namazein saath mila lo, to aisa karo. Aur Fajr ke waqt ghusl karke namaz padho, aisa hi karo, aur agar taaqat rakho to roza bhi rakho.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aur mujhe in dono tareeqon mein se ye zyada pasand hai'"

e: Aishah narrated:"Umm Habibah hint Jahsh sought a verdict from Allah's Messenger. She said 'I suffer from persistent bleeding such that I do not become pere. Shall I give up the Salat?' He said: 'No, that is only a blood vessel. So perform Ghusl then pray.' So she would perform Ghusl for each prayer
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Umm Habibah bint Jahsh ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se fatwa maanga. Unhon ne kaha 'Mujhe mustahaza hai aisa ke main paak nahi hoti. Kya main namaz chhod doon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, ye to sirf ek rag hai. To ghusl karo, phir namaz padho.' To wo har namaz ke liye ghusl karti thi"

e: Mu'adhah narrated that :a woman asked Aishah: "Shouldn't one of us make up her prayers the days of her menstruation?" So she said, "Are you one of the Haruriyyah? Indeed we would menstruate, and we were not ordered to make up
hi: Mu'adhah se riwayat hai ke: "Ek aurat ne Aishah (RA) se pucha: 'Kya hum mein se koi apni haiz ke dinon ki namazon ki qaza kare?' To unhon ne kaha, 'Kya tum Haruriyya (khawarij firqe) mein se ho? Hum haiz hoti thin, aur humein qaza karne ka hukum nahi diya jaata tha'"

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "The menstruating woman does not recite - nor the Junub - anything from the Qur'an." [He said:] There is narration on this topic from Ali
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haiz waali aurat aur janabat waala shakhs Quran mein se kuch bhi na padhen." [Unhon ne kaha:] Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:"When I would menstruate, Allah's Messenger ordered me to wear a waist wrap, then he would fondle me
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Jab mujhe haiz hota, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe hukum dete ke main kamar mein kapda baandh loon, phir wo mujhse mubashirat karte (bagair sambhog ke)"

e: Abdullah bin Sa'd narrated:I asked the Prophet about eating with a menstruating woman. He said: "Eat with her
hi: Abdullah bin Sa'd (RA) se riwayat hai: "Maine Nabi (SAW) se haiz waali aurat ke saath khana khane ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Uske saath khao'"

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger said to me: 'Bring me the Khumrah from the Masjid.' She said: "I said: 'I am menstruating.' He said: 'Indeed your menstruation is not in your hand
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Mujhe masjid se khumrah (chhoti namaz ki chatai) pakdao.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine kaha: main haiz mein hoon.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhara haiz tumhare haath mein nahi hai'"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever engages in sexual intercourse with a menstruating woman, or a woman in her anus, consults a soothsayer, then he has disbelieved in what was revealed to Muhammad
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs haiz waali aurat ke paas jaaye, ya kisi aurat ke pichhle raaste se jaaye, ya kisi kaahin (ghaib ki khabar dene wale) ke paas jaaye, to usne Muhammad (SAW) par nazil ki gayi cheez ka inkaar kar diya"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said about a man who had sexual intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: "He should give half a Dinar in charity
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne us aadmi ke baare mein farmaya jo apni biwi ke paas jaata hai jab wo haiz mein ho: "Wo aadha dinar sadqa kare"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said: "When the blood is red then (give) a Dinar. And when the blood is yellow then half Dinar
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab khoon surkh ho to ek dinar, aur jab khoon zard (peela) ho to aadha dinar"

e: Asma' bint Abu Bakr narrated that :a woman asked the Prophet about a garment that was touched by some menstrual blood. So Allah's Messenger said: "Remove it, and scrub it, then rinse it and pray in it
hi: Asma bint Abu Bakr (RA) se riwayat hai ke: "Ek aurat ne Nabi (SAW) se us kapde ke baare mein pucha jise haiz ka khoon lag jaaye. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Use khurcho (ragad kar utaro), phir paani se malo, phir paani chhirko aur usmein namaz padho'"

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"The time of waiting for Nifas during the time of AIlah's Messenger was forty days. We used to cover our faces with reddish-brown Wars
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Nifas (bachche ki paidaish ke baad khoon) wali auratein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein chalis din tak baithti (intezar karti) thin, to hum apne chehron par kalaf (jhaiyon) ke liye wars (ek zard rang) lagati thin"

e: Anas narrated:"Allah's Messenger would go around to his women with one Ghusl
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) apni sab biwiyon ke paas ek hi ghusl ke saath jaate the.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :the Prophet said: When one of you comes to his wife, then he wants to repeat (it), let him perform Wudu between them
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ke paas jaaye, phir dobara jaana chahe, to donon ke darmiyan wuzu kar le"

e: Hisham bin Urwah narrated from his father, (Urwah) from Abdullah bin AI-Arqam. :He (Urwah) said: "While standing for the prayer he (Abdullah bin Al-Arqam) took a man by the hand leading him forward, he (Abdullah) was in front of the people, and he said: 'I heard Allah's Messenger say: "When standing for the prayer and one of you finds that he has to relieve himself then let him relieve himself first
hi: Abdullah bin Al-Arqam (RA) ne kaha: "Namaz ki iqaamat ho chuki thi, to unhon ne ek aadmi ka haath pakad kar use aage kiya aur wo apni qaum ke imam the, aur kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko farmate sunaa: Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye aur tum mein se koi khud ko qaza-e-haajat ki zaroorat mehsoos kare, to wo pehle qaza-e-haajat kar le'"

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Awf's Umm Walad said, :"I said to Umm Salamah: 'Indeed I am a woman with lengthy hems, and I walk in places of filth.' So she said: 'Allah's Messenger said: "It is purified by what comes after it
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ki Umm Walad (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Umm Salamah (RA) se kaha: 'Main aisi aurat hoon jo apna daaman lamba rakhti hoon, aur main gandi jagahon se guzarti hoon.' To unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Uske baad aane wali (zameen) use paak kar deti hai'"

e: Ammar bin Yasir narrated that :the Prophet ordered him to perform Tayammum by rubbing his face and two palms
hi: Ammar bin Yasir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhen chehre aur donon hatheliyon ke liye tayammum karne ka hukum diya.

e: Ikrimah narrated that :Ibn Abbas was asked ahout Tayammum. He said: "When Allah mentioned Wudu in His Book, He said: "So wash your faces and your hands (forearms) up to the elbows." And He said about Tayammum: "And rub therewith your faces and hands" And He said: "And the male thief and the female thief; cut off their hands." So the Sunnah for cutting is the two hands. So it is only the face and the hands, meaning, Tayammum
hi: Ikrimah se riwayat hai ke Ibn Abbas (RA) se tayammum ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ne apni Kitab mein wuzu ka zikr kiya, to farmaya: 'Apne chehre aur haath (bazuein) kohniyon tak dho lo.' Aur tayammum ke baare mein farmaya: 'Apne chehron aur haathon par mash karo.' Aur farmaya: 'Chor aur chorni, unke haath kaat do.' To haath kaatne ki Sunnat donon hatheliyon tak hai, isi tarah ye sirf chehra aur donon hatheliyan hain, yani tayammum mein"

e: Ali narrated:"Allah's Messenger would recite the Qur'an in all conditions, as long as he was not Junub
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein har haal mein Quran padhate the, jab tak wo janabat mein na hote"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"A Bedouin entered the Masjid while the Prophet was sitting. He prayed, then when he was finished, he said: 'O Allah! Have mercy upon me and Muhammad, and do not have mercy on anyone along with us.' The Prophet turned, towards him and said: 'You have restricted something that is unrestricted.' It was not long before he was urinating in the Masjid. So the people rushed to him. But Prophet said: 'Pour a bucket of water over it - or - a tumbler of water over it.' Then he said: 'You have been sent to make things easy (for the people); you have not been sent to make things difficult for them
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Ek Bedouin (dehati) masjid mein daakhil hua jab Nabi (SAW) baithe hue the. Usne namaz padhi, jab wo faariq ho gaya to usne kaha: 'Ya Allah! Mujh par aur Muhammad (SAW) par reham kar, aur humare saath kisi aur par reham na kar.' Nabi (SAW) uski taraf mudke farmaya: 'Tumne ek wasee (kushada) cheez ko tang kar diya hai.' Zyada der nahi guzri thi ke wo masjid mein peshaab karne laga. To log uski taraf daude, lekin Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Uspar ek dol paani bahaao ya ek bucket paani bahaao.' Phir farmaya: 'Tumhe to logon ke liye aasani paida karne bheja gaya hai, tumhe mushkil paida karne nahi bheja gaya'"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated similar to this (no. 147).:[He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Ibn Abbas, and Wathilah bin AI-Asqa
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne isi jaisi riwayat ki (no. 147). [Unhon ne kaha:] Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), Ibn Abbas (RA), aur Wathilah bin Al-Asqa (RA) se bhi riwayaten hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said: "Jibril (peace be upon him) led me (in Salat) twice at the House. So he prayed Zuhr the first time when the shadow was similar to (the length of) the strap a sandal. Then he prayed Asr when everything was similar (to the length of) its shadow. Then he prayed Maghrib when the sun had set and the fasting person breaks fast. Then he prayed Isha when the twilight had vanished. Then he prayed Fajr when Fajr (dawn) began, and when eating is prohibited for the fasting person. The second time he prayed Zuhr when the shadow of everything was similar to (the length of) it, at the time of Asr the day before. Then he prayed Asr when the shadow of everything was about twice as long as it. Then he prayed Maghrib at the same time as he did the first time. Then he prayed Isha, the later one, when a third of the night had gone. Then he prayed Subh when the land glowed. Then Jibril turned towards me and said: "O Muhammad! These are the times of the Prophets before you, and the (best) time is what is between these two times
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibril (alaihis salaam) ne mujhe (namaz mein) do martaba Khana-e-Ka'ba ke paas imamat karayi. To unhon ne pehli baar Zuhr padhi jab saaya jute ke tasme jitna tha. Phir Asr padhi jab har cheez ka saaya uske barabar tha. Phir Maghrib padhi jab sooraj doob gaya aur roza rakhne wala iftaar karta hai. Phir Isha padhi jab shafaq (surkhi) ghaayab ho gayi. Phir Fajr padhi jab Fajr chamak gayi aur roza rakhne wale par khana haraam ho gaya. Aur doosri baar Zuhr padhi jab har cheez ka saaya uske barabar ho gaya, pichhle din ke Asr ke waqt jitna. Phir Asr padhi jab har cheez ka saaya uske do guna ho gaya. Phir Maghrib usi pehle waqt par padhi. Phir aakhri Isha padhi jab raat ka tihaai hissa guzar gaya. Phir Subh padhi jab zameen roshan ho gayi. Phir Jibril mere taraf mudke kaha: Ae Muhammad! Ye aapse pehle ke Ambiya ka waqt hai. Aur (behtareen) waqt in dono waqton ke darmiyan hai."

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Jibril led me (in Salat)". He mentioned something similar to the Hadith of Ibn Abbas (no. 149) in meaning, but he did not mention: "At the time of Asr the day before
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibril ne meri imamat karayi." Unhon ne Ibn Abbas ki hadith (no. 149) jaisa hi zikr kiya ma'ni mein, lekin unhon ne ye zikr nahi kiya: "Pichhle din ke Asr ke waqt jitna."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Indeed for (the time of) Salat (there is a) beginning and an end. The beginning of the time for the Zuhr prayer is when the sun passes the zenith, and the end of its time is when the time for Asr enters. The beginning of the time for the Asr [prayer] is when its time enters, and the end of its time is when the sun yellows (turns pale). The beginning of the time of Maghrib is when the sun as set, and the end of its time is when the twilight has vanished (i.e., the horizon is invisible because of darkness). The beginning of the time for Isha, the later one, is when the horizon has vanished, and the end of its time is when the night is at its half. The beginning of the time for Fajr is when Fajr begins, and its end is when the sun rises
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak namaz ka ek shuru aur ek aakhir waqt hai. Zuhr ki namaz ka shuru waqt jab sooraj dhalta hai, aur uska aakhri waqt jab Asr ka waqt shuru hota hai. Asr [namaz] ka shuru waqt jab uska waqt shuru hota hai, aur uska aakhri waqt jab sooraj peela pad jaata hai. Maghrib ka shuru waqt jab sooraj doob jaata hai, aur uska aakhri waqt jab shafaq (surkhi) ghaayab ho jaati hai (yani ufuq andhera hone ki wajah se dikhna band ho jaata hai). Aakhri Isha ka shuru waqt jab ufuq ghaayab ho jaata hai, aur uska aakhri waqt jab aadhi raat ho jaati hai. Fajr ka shuru waqt jab Fajr shuru hoti hai, aur uska aakhir waqt jab sooraj tulu hota hai"

e: Sulaiman bin Buraidah narrated that his father said:"A man came to the Prophet to ask him about the times for Salat. So he said: 'Stay with us, In sha Allah.' So he ordered Bilal to call the Iqamah when Fajr began, then he ordered him to call the Iqamah when the Sun passed the zenith, then he prayed Zuhr. Then he ordered him to call the Iqamah to pray Asr while the sun was elevated and white. Then he ordered him (to call the Iqamah for) Maghrib when the (top) edge of the sun had set. Then he ordered him to call the Iqamah for Isha when the horizon (twilight) had vanished. Then he ordered him in the morning (to give the call for Fajr prayer), when the light of Fajr glowed. Then he ordered (him to call the Iqamah for) Zuhr, so he waited well until it had cooled. Then he ordered (him to call the Iqamah for) Asr, so he calIed the Iqamah while the sun was later in its position than what it was (the day before). Then he ordered him to delay Maghrib until right before the twilight had disappeared. Then he ordered (him to call the Iqamah for) Isha, so he called the Iqamah when a third of the night had passed. Then he said: 'Where is the one who asked about he times for the Salat?' So the man said, 'It is I.' So he said: 'The times [or the Salat are what are between these two]
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse namazon ke waqton ke baare mein pucha. To unhon ne farmaya: 'Humare saath theher jao, Insha Allah.' Phir unhon ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi jab Fajr shuru hui. Phir unhen hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi jab sooraj dhal gaya, aur unhon ne Zuhr padhi. Phir unhen hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi aur Asr padhi jab sooraj safed aur buland tha. Phir unhen Maghrib ke liye hukum diya jab sooraj ka kinara dooba. Phir unhen Isha ke liye hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi jab shafaq ghaayab ho gayi. Phir agli subah unhen hukum diya, to unhon ne Fajr ke waqt roshni failne di. Phir unhen Zuhr ke liye hukum diya, to unhon ne intezar kiya yahan tak ke thanda ho gaya. Phir unhen Asr ke liye hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi jab sooraj pichhli baar se peeche (der se) tha. Phir unhen Maghrib der karne ka hukum diya, shafaq ghaayab hone se thoda pehle tak. Phir unhen Isha ke liye hukum diya, to unhon ne iqaamat kahi jab raat ka tihaai hissa guzar gaya. Phir farmaya: 'Kahan hai wo shakhs jisne namazon ke waqton ke baare mein pucha tha?' To us aadmi ne kaha: 'Main hoon.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Namazon ke waqt un dono ke darmiyan hain'"

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would pray Subh (at such time that) the women would leave (after the prayer)" - AI-AnsarI (one of the narrators) said - the women would pass by wrapped in their Mirts and they would not be recognizable due to the darkness." And Qutaibah said: "covered." (instead of "wrapped)
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Subh ki namaz aise padhte ke auratein (namaz ke baad) chali jaatin" - Al-Ansari (raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha - "auratein apni chadaron mein lipti hui guzarti thin, andhere ki wajah se pehchani nahi jaati thin." Aur Qutaibah ne kaha: "dhaki hui" (bajaye "lipti hui" ke).

e: Rafi bin Khadlj said:"I heard Allah's Messenger saying: 'Perform Fajr at AI-Isfar, for indeed its reward is greater
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko farmate sunaa: 'Fajr ko roshni failne tak der karo, kyunki iska sawaab zyada hai'"

e: Aishah narrated:"I have not seen anyone who hastened Zuhr more than Allah's Messenger nor Abu Bakr, nor Umar
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Maine kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se, na Abu Bakr (RA) se, na Umar (RA) se, Zuhr ki namaz mein jaldi karte hue zyada nahi dekha"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger prayed Zuhr when the sun had passed the zenith
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zuhr ki namaz padhi jab sooraj dhal gaya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "In very hot weather, delay the (Zuhr) prayer until it becomes (a bit) cooler, because the severity of heat is from the raging of the Hell
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab garmi shadeed ho jaaye, to (Zuhr ki) namaz thandi hone tak der karo, kyunki shadeed garmi jahannam ki lapat se hai"

e: Abu Dharr narrated:"Allah's Messenger was on a journey and Bilal was with him. So he wanted to call for the prayer, but he (the Prophet) said: 'Let it get cooler.' Then he wanted to call for the prayer, so Allah's Messenger said: 'Let it get to the cooler time of Zuhr.'" He (i.e., Abu Dharr) said: "Until we saw the shadows of the hillocks, then he commanded that the Iqamah be called and then led the people in prayer. Allah's Messenger said: 'The severity of heat is from the raging of Hell, so wait until it becomes cooler for the (Zuhr) prayer
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar mein the aur Bilal (RA) unke saath the. To Bilal ne azaan dena chaha, lekin unhon ne (Nabi SAW ne) farmaya: 'Thanda hone do.' Phir unhon ne dobara azaan dena chaha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Zuhr ke thande waqt tak intezar karo.'" Unhon ne (yani Abu Dharr ne) kaha: "Yahan tak ke humne teelon ka saaya dekha, phir unhon ne iqaamat ka hukum diya aur logon ki imamat ki. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Shadeed garmi jahannam ki lapat se hai, is liye (Zuhr ki) namaz ke liye thanda hone ka intezar karo'"

e: Urwah narrated from Aishah:"Allah's Messenger prayed Asr while the sun was (shining) in her chamber, (and) no shadow appeared in her chamber
hi: Urwah, Aishah (RA) se riwayat karte hain: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Asr ki namaz padhi jab sooraj unke hujre mein chamak raha tha, aur unke hujre mein koi saaya nazar nahi aata tha"

e: Al-Ala bin Abdur-Raman narrated that :he visited Anas bin Malik in his home in Al Basrah after finishing Zuhr, and his home was next to the Masjid. So he said: 'Stand to pray Asr." He (Al-Ala) said: "So we stood to pray. When we were finished he (Anas) said: 'I heard Allah's Messenger saying: "That is the prayer of the hypocrite. He sits watching the sun, until when it is between the horns of the Shaitan he stands and pecks out four (units of prayer), not remembering Allah in them but a little
hi: Al-Ala bin Abdur-Rahman se riwayat hai ke: "Wo Basra mein Anas bin Malik (RA) ke ghar unse milne gaye jab wo Zuhr se faariq hue the, aur unka ghar masjid ke bagal mein tha. To unhon ne kaha: 'Khade ho jao aur Asr padho.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To hum khade hue aur namaz padhi. Jab hum faariq hue, to unhon ne (Anas ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko farmate sunaa: Ye munafiq ki namaz hai. Wo baith kar sooraj ko dekhta rehta hai, yahan tak ke jab wo Shaitan ke do seengon ke darmiyan aa jaata hai, to wo khada hokar chaar (rakat) tez tez chugta hai, un mein Allah ka zikr sirf thoda sa karta hai'"

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would hasten Zuhr more than you (people), while you (people) hasten Asr more than him
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tum logon se zyada Zuhr mein jaldi karte the, aur tum log unse zyada Asr mein jaldi karte ho"

e: Narrator not mentioned:[And I have in my book: "Ali bin Hujr informed me from lsma'il bin Ibrahim, from Ibn Juraij]
hi: Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Ismail ibn Ulayyah se, Ibn Juraij se, Ibn Abi Mulaikah se, Umm Salamah se, isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Aur maine apni kitab mein paaya: Ali bin Hujr ne mujhe Ismail bin Ibrahim se, Ibn Juraij se batayi.

e: Similar narration is reported by Bishr ibn Mu'adh Al-Bari who said that :Isma'il ibn Ulayyah narrated to him from Ibn Juraij. This latter chain is more correct
hi: Aur humein Bishr bin Mu'adh Al-Basri ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ismail ibn Ulayyah ne humein Ibn Juraij se, isi sanad ke saath, isi tarah batayi. Aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Salmah bin AI-Akwa narrated:"Allah's Messenger prayed Maghrib when the sun had set and it (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of darkness)
hi: Salamah bin Al-Akwa (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Maghrib ki namaz padhte jab sooraj doob jaata aur andhere ke parde mein chhup jaata"

e: An-Nu'man bin Bashir said:"I am the most knowledgeable among the people about the prescribed time of this prayer: Allah's Messenger would pray it when the moon set on the third (of the month)
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne kaha: "Main is namaz ke waqt ke baare mein sabse zyada jaanta hoon: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise (Isha ko) chaand ke doobne par padhte the, teesri tareekh ko"

e: An-Nu'man bin Bashir said:A similar narration (from another chain linking to) this chain is also reported
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne (isi jaisi riwayat ki). Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Hushaim ne Abu Bishr se, Habib bin Salim se, An-Nu'man bin Bashir se riwayat ki. Aur Hushaim ne usmein Bashir bin Thabit se zikr nahi kiya. Aur Abu Awanah ki riwayat humare nazdeek zyada sahih hai kyunki Yazid bin Harun ne Shu'bah se, Abu Bishr se, Abu Awanah ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "If it were not that it would be a hardship on my Ummah, then I would have ordered you to delay Isha until the third of the night, or its half
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe apni Ummat par mushkil na hoti, to main unhen hukum deta ke wo Isha ko raat ke tihaai ya aadhe hisse tak der karen"

e: Abu Barzah narrated:"The Prophet would dislike to sleep before Isha and to talk after it
hi: Abu Barzah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Nabi (SAW) Isha se pehle sona aur uske baad baatein karna napasand karte the"

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated:"Allah's Messenger would talk during the night with Abu Bakr about matters concerning the Muslims while I was with them
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Bakr (RA) ke saath raat ko Musalmanon ke maamlaat par baatein karte the, aur main bhi unke saath hota tha"

e: Umm Farwah - and she was one of those who gave pledge of allegiance to the Prophet - narrated:"The Prophet was asked: 'Which deed is the best?' So he said: 'Salat in the beginning of its time
hi: Umm Farwah (RA) - jo un logon mein se thi jinhon ne Nabi (SAW) ki baiyat ki thi - ne riwayat ki: "Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: 'Kaun sa amal sabse behtareen hai?' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Namaz apne shuru waqt mein'"

e: Ali bin AbI Talib narrated that :the Prophet said to him: 'Ali! Three are not to be delayed: Salat when its time comes, a funeral whet it (a prepared body) is present, and the (marriage of a) single woman when there is an equal for her
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Teen cheezon mein der na karo: Namaz jab uska waqt aa jaaye, janaza jab wo (taiyaar hokar) mojood ho, aur kuwari ya bewa aurat jab uske liye barabar ka rishta mil jaaye"

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The beginning of the time for Salat is pleasing to Allah, and the end of its time is pardoned by Allah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ka shuru waqt Allah ki raza hai, aur aakhri waqt Allah ki maafi hai"

e: Abu Amr Ash-Shaibani narrated:"A man said to Ibn Mas'ud: 'Which deed is most virtuous?' He said: 'I asked Allah's Messenger (that). He said: "Salat at the beginning of its time." I asked him: "What is after that O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Being dutiful to one's parents." I said: "What is after that [O Messenger of Allah]?" He said: "Jihad in the Way of Allah
hi: Abu Amr Ash-Shaibani se riwayat hai: "Ek aadmi ne Ibn Mas'ud (RA) se kaha: 'Kaun sa amal sabse afzal hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: Namaz apne waqt par.' Maine pucha: 'Uske baad kya, Ya Rasool Allah?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Waalidain ke saath ehsaan (neki).' Maine pucha: 'Uske baad kya, [Ya Rasool Allah]?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Aur Allah ki raah mein jihad'"

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger did not pray any Salat at the end of its time two times, until Allah took him
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi bhi kisi namaz ko lagataar do baar uske aakhri waqt mein nahi padha, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhen apne paas bula liya"

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever misses the Asr prayer, then it is as if he was robbed of his family and his property
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Asr ki namaz chhod de, goya uske ghar waalon aur uske maal ko lut liya gaya"

e: Abu Dharr narrated that :the Prophet said: "O Abu Dharr! There will be leaders after me who cause the Salat to die; so perform the Salat during its time. If you pray (with them) during its time, then that will be voluntary Salat for you, if not, then you will have attained your Salat
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Abu Dharr! Mere baad aise hukumraan aayenge jo namaz ko marne denge, to tum namaz uske waqt par padho. Agar wo tumhare liye waqt par padhi gayi ho, to ye tumhare liye nafl hogi, warna tumne apni namaz bacha li"

e: Abu Qatadah narrated:"They asked the Prophet about when they sIept past the Salat. He said: 'There is no negligence in sleep, negligence is only while one is awake. So when one of you forgets a Salat, or sleeps through it, then let him pray it when he remembers it
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) ne kaha: "Unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se namaz mein so jaane ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Neend mein koi kotahi nahi hai, kotahi to sirf jaagte hue mein hoti hai. Is liye jab tum mein se koi namaz bhool jaaye, ya usmein so jaaye, to jab use yaad aaye tab wo padh le'"

e: Anas (bin Malik) narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever forgets a Salat then he is to pray it when he remembers it
hi: Anas (bin Malik) (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs namaz bhool jaaye, to jab use yaad aaye tab wo use padh le"

e: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud] narrated:"The idolaters kept Allah's Messenger distracted from four prayers on the Day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of the Trench) until as much as Allah willed of the night had passed. So he ordered Bilal to call the Adhan, then he called the Iqamah to Zuhr, then he called the Iqamah to pray Asr, then he called the Iqamah to pray Maghrib, then he called the Iqamah to pray Isha
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai: "Mushrikeen ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Khandaq ke din chaar namazon se mashghool rakha, yahan tak ke raat ka jitna hissa Allah ne chaha guzar gaya. To unhon ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya, unhon ne azaan di, phir iqaamat kahi aur Zuhr padhi, phir iqaamat kahi aur Asr padhi, phir iqaamat kahi aur Maghrib padhi, phir iqaamat kahi aur Isha padhi"

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"On the Day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of the Trench), Umar bin Al-Khattab came cursing the disbelievers of Quraish and said: 'O Allah's Messenger! I could not offer he Asr prayer until the sun was about to set.' The Prophet said: 'By Allah! I too have not offered the Salat.'" So he said: "We descended into Buthan, Allah's Messenger performed Wudu and we too performed Wudu. Allah's Messenger prayed Asr after the sun had set, then after it he prayed Maghrib
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Khandaq ke din, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) Quraish ke kuffaar ko kosne lage aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main Asr ki namaz mushkil se hi padh saka, sooraj doobne wala tha.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ki qasam! Maine bhi abhi tak namaz nahi padhi.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To hum Buthan mein utre, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya aur humne bhi wuzu kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Asr sooraj doobne ke baad padhi, phir uske baad Maghrib padhi"

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Salatul-Wusta is the Asr prayer
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salatul-Wusta Asr ki namaz hai"

e: Smurah bin Jundub narrated that :the Prophet said: "Salatul-wusta is the Asr prayer
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salatul-Wusta Asr ki namaz hai"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"I head more than one of the Companions of the Prophet; Umar bin Al-Khattab among, and he was one of the most beloved among them to me - (narrating) that Allah's Messenger prohibited the Salat after Fajr until the sun had risen, and the Salat after Asr until the sun had set
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke ek se zyada Sahaba se suna, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) bhi the aur wo mujhe sabse zyada azeez the - ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fajr ke baad sooraj tulu hone tak, aur Asr ke baad sooraj doobne tak namaz se mana farmaya"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet only performed the two rak'ah (units of prayer) after Asr because some wealth came to him which distracted him from the two rak'ah after Zuhr, so he prayed them after Asr, then he did not repeat that
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne Asr ke baad ye do rakat sirf is liye padhin kyunki unke paas kuch maal aaya jisne unhen Zuhr ke baad ki do rakat se mashghool rakha, to unhon ne wo Asr ke baad padhin, phir wo dobara aisa nahi karte the"

e: Abdullah bin Mughaffal narrated that :the Prophet said: "Between every two calls (to prayer) there is a Salat for whoever wills
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har do azaanon (azaan aur iqaamat) ke darmiyan jo chahe namaz padh sakta hai"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever catches a Rak'ah of Subh before the sun has risen, then he has caught Subh. Whoever catches a Rak'ah of Asr before the sun has set, then he has caught Asr
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs sooraj tulu hone se pehle Subh ki ek rakat paa le, to usne Subh paa li. Aur jo shakhs sooraj doobne se pehle Asr ki ek rakat paa le, to usne Asr paa li"

e: Ibn Abbas said:"Allah's Messenger combined the Zuhr and Asr (prayers), and the Maghrib and Isha (prayers) in Al-Madinah, without being in a state of fear, nor due to rain
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Madina mein Zuhr aur Asr, aur Maghrib aur Isha ko jama kiya, bagair kisi khauf ya baarish ke." Unhon ne kaha: "To Ibn Abbas se pucha gaya, isse unka kya matlab tha? Unhon ne kaha: 'Unka maqsad ye tha ke apni Ummat ko tang na karen'"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever combines two prayers without any excuse then he has committed something from the major sins
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs bagair kisi uzr ke do namazon ko jama kare, to usne kabeera gunahon mein se ek gunah kar liya"

e: Albdullah bin Zaid narrated:"When we awoke, we went to Allah's Messenger to inform him of the dream. He said: 'Indeed this dream is true. So go to Bilal, for he has a better and louder voice than you. Convey to him what was said to you, so that he may call (to the prayer) with that.'" He said: "When Umar bin Al-Khattab heard Bilal calling for the prayer he went to Allah's Messenger, and he was dragging his Izar, (as he was hurrying) saying: 'O Allah's Messenger! By the One Who sent you with the truth! I dreamt the same as what he said.''' He said: "So Allah's Messenger said: 'To Allah is the praise, so that confirms it even more
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se riwayat hai: "Jab hum subah uthe, to hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur maine unhen khwab ke baare mein bataya. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Beshak ye sacha khwab hai, is liye Bilal ke saath khade ho jao, kyunki uski awaaz tumse zyada khoobsurat aur lambi hai, jo tumse kaha gaya tha wo use bata do, aur wo usi se azaan de.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Jab Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne Bilal (RA) ki azaan suni, to wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye apna tehband ghaseette hue kehte hue: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, maine bhi waisa hi khwab dekha jaisa unhon ne kaha.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'To Allah ki hamd hai, ye is baat ko aur zyada pukhta karta hai'"

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"When the Muslims arrived in AI-Madinah, they used to assemble for the Salat, and guess the time for it there was no one who called for it (the prayer). One day they discussed that and some of them said that they should use a bell like the bell the Christians use. Others said they should use a trumpet like the horn the Jews use. But Umar [bin Al-Khattab] said: 'Wouldn't it better if we had a man call for the prayer?'" He said: "So Allah's Messenger said: 'O Bilal! Stand up and call for the Salat
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai: "Jab Musalman Madina pahunche, to wo namaz ke liye jama hote aur waqt ka andaza lagate, lekin koi bhi is ke liye pukarta nahi tha. Ek din unhon ne is baare mein baat ki. Kuch ne kaha ke Isaiyon ki ghanti jaisi ghanti rakh len. Kuch ne kaha ke Yahudiyon ke seeng jaisa seeng rakh len. To Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: 'Kya humein ek aadmi nahi bhejna chahiye jo namaz ke liye pukare?'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Bilal! Khade ho jao aur namaz ke liye pukaro'"

e: Abu Mahdhurah narrated that :Allah's Messenger sat with him and taught him the Adhan word for word. Ibrahim said, "It is the same as our Adhan." Bishr said: "So I said to him, 'Repeat it to me.' So he described the Adhan with At-Tarjl
hi: Abu Mahdhurah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen bithaya aur unhen azaan lafz-ba-lafz sikhayi. Ibrahim ne kaha: "Humari azaan jaisi hi." Bishr ne kaha: "To maine unse kaha, 'Mujhe dobara sunao.'" To unhon ne azaan ko tarjee (dohrane) ke saath bayan kiya.

e: Abu Mahdhurah narrated that :the Prophet taught him the Adhan with nineteen phrases, and the Iqamah with seventeen phrases
hi: Abu Mahdhurah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhen azaan unnees kalimon mein aur iqaamat satrah kalimon mein sikhayi.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Bilal was ordered to make the phrases of the Adhan even, and the phrases of the Iqamah odd
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya gaya ke wo azaan ke jumle jode (do-do bar) aur iqaamat ke jumle taak (ek-ek bar) rakhein"

e: Abdullah bin Zaid said:"Allah's Messenger would say each phrase of the call (for prayer) two times, for the Adhan and the Iqamah
hi: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki azaan aur iqaamat mein har jumla do-do bar hota tha"

e: Jabir [bin Abdullah] narrated:"Allah's Messenger said to Bilal: "O Bilal! When you call the Adhan then do so deliberately and slowly, and when you call the Iqamah then be quick. Allow enough time between your Adhan and Iqamah for the person eating to finish what he is eating, the person drinking to finish what he is drinking, and the one who needs time to relive himself, and do not stand until you see me
hi: Jabir [bin Abdullah] (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) se farmaya: 'Ae Bilal! Jab tum azaan do, to aaraam se aur theher theher kar do, aur jab iqaamat kaho, to jaldi karo. Aur apni azaan aur iqaamat ke darmiyan itna waqt rakho ke khaana khaane wala apna khaana khatam kar le, paani peene wala apna paani khatam kar le, aur qaza-e-haajat ke liye jaane wala fariq ho jaaye. Aur jab tak mujhe na dekho khade na ho'"

e: Jabir [bin Abdullah] narrated:(Another chain for) a similar narration (as no)
hi: Jabir [bin Abdullah] (RA) se (isi jaisi riwayat) - ek doosri sanad se.

e: Abu Juhaifah narrated:"I saw Bilal calling the Adhan, and turning, and his (face) was following here and there, and his (index) fingers were in his ears, and Allah's Messenger was in a small red tent" - "I think," he (one of the narrators) said, "it was made from a hide" - so Bilal went out in front of him with an Anazah which he planted (in the ground) at Batha. Allah's Messenger prayed facing it, and a dog and a donkey passed in front of him; he was wearing a red Hullah, and it is as if I am now looking at the radiance of his shins." Sufyan said: "We think that it was a Hibrah
hi: Abu Juhaifah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Bilal (RA) ko azaan dete hue dekha, wo ghoom rahe the aur apna munh idhar udhar kar rahe the, aur unki (shahadat ki) ungliyan unke kaanon mein thin, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ek surkh khaimay mein the - main samajhta hoon unhon ne kaha ke wo chamde ka tha - to Bilal unke aage 'Anazah' (chhoti neze jaisi cheez) leke nikle aur use Batha mein gaad diya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usi ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi. Unke saamne se kutta aur gadha guzarte the, aur unhon ne ek surkh hullah (jode) pehna hua tha, goya main abhi unki pindaliyon ki chamak dekh raha hoon." Sufyan ne kaha: "Humein lagta hai ye Hibrah (Yemeni kapda) tha"

e: Bilal narrated:"Allah's Messenger said [to me]: 'Do not say the Tathwib for any prayer except the Fajr prayer.'" [He said:] There is something on this topic from Abu Mahdhurah. Abu `Eisa said: We do not know of the Hadith of Bilal except as a narration of Abu Isra'il Al-Mula'i. Abu Isra'il did not hear this Hadith from Al-Hakam bin `Utaibah. He said: He only reported it from Al-Hasan bin `Umarah, from Al-Hakam bin `Utaibah. Abu Isra'il's name is [Isma`il bin Abi Ishaq, and he is not strong according to the people of Hadith. The people of knowledge have differed over the interpretation of At-Tathwib. Some of them say that At-Tathwib is when one says "As-Salatu Khairummin An-Nawm, (prayer is better than sleep)" for the Adhan of Fajr. This is the saying of Ibn Al-Mubarak and Ahmad. Ishaq said something different about At-Tathwib, he said: "[The disliked Tathwib] is something that the people started after the Prophet; when the Mu'adh-dhin calls the Adhan and the people are slow in coming, so between the Adhan and the Iqamah he says: 'Qad Qamatis-Salat, Hayya `Alasalat, Hayya `AlalFalah. (Prayer is ready, come to prayer, come to success.)" [He said:] This Tathwib, which Ishaq mentioned, is the one that the people of knowledge dislike, which they innovated after the Prophet. But Ibn Al-Mubarak and Ahmad explained that At-Tathwib is when the Mu'adh-dhin says: "As-Salatu Khairum minan-Nawm, (prayer is better than sleep)" for the Adhan of Fajr. And this is the correct saying, and it is called At-Tathawwub as well, and this is the one chosen by the people of knowledge, and it is their opinion. It has been reported from `Abdullah bin `Umar that he would say: "As-Salatu Khairum-minan-Nawm, (prayer is better than sleep)" for Fajr. It has been reported from Mujahid that he said: "I entered a Masjid with `Abdullah bin `Umar in which the Adhan was called, and we wanted to pray in it. Then the Mu'adh-dhin said the Tathwib. So `Abdullah bin `Umar left the Masjid and said: 'Let us leave the place of this innovator' And he did not pray in it." [He said:] `Abdullah only disliked the Tathwib that the people invented later on
hi: Bilal (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: Kisi bhi namaz mein tathweeb (dohrana) mat kaho, siwaye Fajr ki namaz ke." [Unhon ne kaha:] Is mauzu par Abu Mahdhurah se bhi kuch riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Humein Bilal ki hadith sirf Abu Isra'il Al-Mula'i ki riwayat se hi maloom hai. Abu Isra'il ne ye hadith Al-Hakam bin Utaibah se nahi suni. Unhon ne kaha: Unhon ne ise sirf Al-Hasan bin Umarah se, Al-Hakam bin Utaibah se riwayat kiya. Abu Isra'il ka naam Ismail bin Abi Ishaq hai, aur wo Ahle Hadith ke nazdeek mazboot nahi hain. Ahl-e-ilm ne At-Tathwib ki tafseer mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai. Kuch kehte hain ke At-Tathwib ye hai ke Fajr ki azaan mein "As-Salatu Khairum-minan-Nawm" (namaz neend se behtar hai) kaha jaaye. Ye Ibn Al-Mubarak aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Ishaq ne At-Tathwib ke baare mein doosri baat kahi, unhon ne kaha: [Napasandeeda Tathwib] wo cheez hai jo logon ne Nabi (SAW) ke baad shuru ki; jab Mu'adhdhin azaan de aur log aane mein der karen, to wo azaan aur iqaamat ke darmiyan kahe: 'Qad Qamatis-Salat, Hayya Alas-Salat, Hayya Alal-Falah' (Namaz taiyaar hai, namaz ki taraf aao, kamyaabi ki taraf aao). [Unhon ne kaha:] Ye Tathwib jo Ishaq ne bataya, wahi hai jise ahl-e-ilm napasand karte hain, jo unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke baad ijaad kiya. Lekin Ibn Al-Mubarak aur Ahmad ne bataya ke At-Tathwib ye hai ke Mu'adhdhin Fajr ki azaan mein "As-Salatu Khairum-minan-Nawm" kahe. Aur ye sahih qaul hai, aur ise At-Tathawwub bhi kaha jaata hai, aur yehi wo hai jise ahl-e-ilm ne pasand kiya hai aur unka mauqaf hai. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke wo Fajr mein "As-Salatu Khairum-minan-Nawm" kaha karte the. Mujahid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ke saath ek masjid mein daakhil hua jismein azaan ho chuki thi aur hum usmein namaz padhna chahte the. Phir Mu'adhdhin ne Tathwib kaha. To Abdullah bin Umar (RA) masjid se bahar nikal gaye aur kaha: 'Chalo humein is bid-ati ke paas se nikal jaana chahiye.'" Aur unhon ne usmein namaz nahi padhi. [Unhon ne kaha:] Abdullah ne sirf us Tathwib ko napasand kiya jise logon ne baad mein ijaad kiya.

e: Ziyad bin Al-Harith As-Suda'i narrated:"Allah's Messenger ordered me to call the Adhan for the Fajr prayer. I called the Adhan, then Bilal wanted to call the lqamah. Allah's Messenger said: 'Indeed the brother from Suda' has called the Adhan, and whoever calls the Adhan he calls the Iqamah
hi: Ziyad bin Al-Harith As-Suda'i (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Fajr ki namaz ke liye azaan doon. Maine azaan di, phir Bilal (RA) iqaamat kehna chahte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Suda ke bhai ne azaan di hai, aur jo azaan de wahi iqaamat kahega'"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "None should call the Adhan except for one with Wudu
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Azaan sirf wuzu wala hi de"

e: Ibn Shihab narrated that :Abu Hurairah said: "None should call (for the prayer except for one with Wudu)
hi: Ibn Shihab se riwayat hai ke Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Namaz ke liye sirf wuzu wala hi pukare"

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:The Mu'adh-dhin of Allah's Messenger would wait and he would not call the Iqamah until he saw the Allah's Messenger had come out, he would call the Iqamah when he saw him
hi: Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Mu'adhdhin intezar karte aur iqaamat nahi kehte jab tak wo dekh na lete ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar aa chuke hain, jab unhen dekh lete to iqaamat kehte"

e: Salim narrated from his father (Ibn Umar) that :the Prophet said: "Indeed Bilal calls the Adhan in the night, so eat and drink until you hear the Adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum
hi: Salim apne walid (Ibn Umar) (RA) se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Bilal raat mein azaan deta hai, is liye khao aur piyo yahan tak ke tum Ibn Umm Maktum ki azaan sun lo"

e: Abu Ash-Sha'tha said:"A man exited the Masjid after the Adhan for Asr had been called. So Abu Hurairah said: 'As for this person, he has indeed disobeyed Abul Qasim
hi: Abu Ash-Sha'tha ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Asr ki azaan ke baad masjid se bahar nikal gaya. To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: 'Ye shakhs to Abul Qasim (SAW) ki nafarmani kar chuka'"

e: Malik bin Al-Huwairih said:"A cousin of mine and I arrived as guests of Allah's Messenger. He said to us: 'When you travel then call the Adhan and Iqamah and let the eldest of you lead the prayer
hi: Malik bin Al-Huwairith (RA) ne kaha: "Main aur mera ek chacha zaad bhai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas mehmaan bankar aaye. To unhon ne humse farmaya: 'Jab tum dono safar karo, to azaan aur iqaamat kaho, aur tum mein se jo bada ho wo imamat kare'"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet said: 'Whoever calls the Adhan for seven years, seeking reward for it, salvation from the Fire is written for him
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs sawaab ki niyat se saat saal azaan de, uske liye jahannam se azaadi likh di jaati hai"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The Imam is answerable and the Mu'adh-dhin is entrusted. O Allah! Guide the Imams and pardon the Mu'adh-dhins
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Imam zimmedaar hai aur Mu'adhdhin amanatdaar hai. Ya Allah! Imamon ki rehnumai kar aur Mu'adhdhinon ko bakhsh de"

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whenyou hear the call (to prayer) then say the similar to what the Mu'adh-dhin says
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum azaan sunon, to wahi kaho jo Mu'adhdhin kehta hai"

e: Uthman bin Abi Al-As narrated:"Indeed, amount the last (of orders) Allah's Messenger ordered me with was to employ a Mu'adh-dhin who would not take a wage for his Adhan
hi: Uthman bin Abi Al-As (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apni aakhri wasiyaton mein ye hukum diya ke main aisa Mu'adhdhin rakhoon jo apni azaan par koi ujrat na le"

e: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever says, when he hears the Mu'adh-dhin: (Wa Ana Ashadu An La Ilaha Illallah, Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Wa Anna Muhammadan Abduhu Wa Rasuluhu, Radittu Billahi Rabban Wa Bil-Islam Dinan, Wa Bi Muhammadin Rasulan) 'I too testify that none has the right to be worshiped but Allah, Alone without partners, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger, I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and Muhammad as a Messenger.' - Allah will pardon his sins for him
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Mu'adhdhin ko sunkar kahe: 'Main bhi gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi, wo akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur beshak Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain, main Allah ko Rab maankar, Muhammad ko Rasool maankar, aur Islam ko deen maankar raazi hoon' - uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain"

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever says, when he hears the call: (Allahumma, rabba hadhihidda 'watit-tammati was Salatilqa'imah, ati Muhammadanil wasilata wal-Fadilata, wab'athhu Maqamun Mahmudan alladhi wa'adtahu) 'O Allah! Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad Al-Wasilah and Al-Fadilah, and raise him to the praised station that you promised him' - then intercession on the Day of Resurrection is made lawful for him
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs azaan sunkar kahe: 'Ya Allah! Is mukammal pukar aur qaayam hone waali namaz ke Rab! Muhammad (SAW) ko Waseela aur Fazeelat ata farma, aur unhen us Maqam-e-Mahmood par bhej jiska tu ne unse waada kiya hai' - to Qayamat ke din uske liye shafaat halal ho jaati hai"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The supplication made between the Adhan and Iqamah is not rejected
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Azaan aur iqaamat ke darmiyan ki gayi dua radd nahi hoti"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"On the Night of Isra, fifty prayers were made obligatory upon the Prophet. Then it was decreased until it was made five. Then it was called out: 'O Muhammad! Indeed My Word does not change; these five prayers will be recorded for you as fifty
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Isra ki raat Nabi (SAW) par pachaas namazein farz ki gayin, phir kam karte karte paanch kar di gayin. Phir awaaz aayi: 'Ae Muhammad! Beshak mere yahan baat badalti nahi, aur beshak in paanch ke liye tumhe pachaas ka sawaab milega'"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The five prayers, and Al-Jumuah (the Friday prayer) to Al-Jumuah are atonement for what is between them, as long as the major sins have not been committed
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanch namazein, aur ek Jumme se doosre Jumme tak, un dono ke darmiyan ke gunahon ka kaffara hain, jab tak kabeera gunaah na kiye jaayen"

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Salat in congregation is twenty-seven degrees more virtuous than a man's Salat alone
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jamaat ki namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se sattaais darjay behtar hai"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Indeed a man's Salat in the congregation is increased by twenty five rewards over his Salat alone
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jamaat mein padhi gayi namaz akele padhi gayi namaz se pachees hisson ziyada hai"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "I was about to order my boys to collect bundles of firewood, then order Salat to be held, then burn (the homes) of the people who did not attend the Salat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine socha ke apne naujawanon ko hukum doon ke wo lakdiyon ke gattar jama karen, phir namaz ka hukum doon ke iqaamat ho, phir un logon ke (gharon ko) jala doon jo namaz mein haazir nahi hote"

e: Mujahid said:"Ibn Abbas was asked about a man who fasted during the day and stood (in prayers) during the night, but he did not attend the Friday prayer nor congregational prayer. He replied: 'He is in the Fire
hi: Mujahid ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas (RA) se ek aise aadmi ke baare mein pucha gaya jo din ko roza rakhta aur raat ko namaz mein khada rehta, lekin Jumme aur jamaat mein haazir nahi hota tha. Unhon ne jawab diya: 'Wo jahannam mein hai.'" [Unhon ne kaha:] Hadith ka matlab ye hai ke jamaat aur Jumma se, na-pasandeegi ki wajah se, aur uske haq ki be-parwaahi aur susti ki wajah se, ghair-haazir rehna (jahannam ka baais hai).

e: Jabir hin Yazid hin Al-Aswad [Al-Amir] narrated that his father said:"I attended Hajj with the Prophet. I prayed the Subh (Fajr) prayer with him in Masjid AI-Khaif." He said: "When the Prophet finished, he turned (from the Qiblah) and saw two men at the back of the people who had not prayed with him. He said, 'Bring them to me.' So I brought then while they were shuddering with fear. He said: 'What prevented you from praying with us?" They said: 'O Messenger of Allah!' We prayed at our camp.' So he said: 'Do not do that; when you pray in your camp then you come to a Masjid with a congregation, then pray with them. That will be a voluntary prayer for you
hi: Jabir bin Yazid bin Al-Aswad apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajj mein haazir tha, maine unke saath Masjid Al-Khaif mein Subh ki namaz padhi." Unhon ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) apni namaz se faariq hue aur mudke, to unhon ne piche do aadmiyon ko dekha jinhon ne unke saath namaz nahi padhi thi. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Unhen mere paas lao.'" To unhen laaya gaya jab ke wo dar ke maare kaanp rahe the. Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhen humare saath namaz padhne se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Humne apne khaimon mein namaz padh li thi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo, jab tum apne khaimon mein namaz padh lo, phir kisi masjid mein jamaat ke paas aao, to unke saath bhi namaz padho, ye tumhare liye nafl ho jaayegi"

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"A man came when Allah's Messenger had already prayed, so he said: 'Which of you will give some reward to this person?' So a man stood to pray with him
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) ne kaha: "Ek aadmi aaya jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz padh chuke the. To unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se kaun is par sadqa karega?' To ek aadmi khada hua aur uske saath namaz padhi"

e: Uthman bin Affan narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever attends Isha (prayer) in congregation, then he has (the reward as if he had) stood half of the night. And whoever prays Isha and Fajr in congregation, then he has (the reward as if he had) spend the entire night standing (in prayer)
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Isha jamaat mein padhe, uske liye goya usne aadhi raat qayaam kiya. Aur jo shakhs Isha aur Fajr jamaat mein padhe, uske liye goya usne poori raat qayaam kiya"

e: Jundub bin Sufyan narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever prays the Subh then he is under the protection of Allah's covenant, so do not be treacherous with Allah in his covenant
hi: Jundub bin Sufyan (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Subh ki namaz padhe, wo Allah ki zimmedaari mein aa jaata hai, is liye Allah ki zimmedaari ke baare mein khiyanat na karo"

e: Buraidah Al-Aslami narrated that :the Prophet said: "Give glad tiding to those who walk to the Masajid in the dark; of a complete light on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Buraidah Al-Aslami (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Andhere mein masjidon ki taraf paidal chalne walon ko Qayamat ke din mukammal roshni ki khushkhabri do"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The best rows for the men are the first of them, and the worst are the last of them. And the best rows for the women are the last of them, and the worst are the first of them
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mardon ki behtareen saf pehli hai aur sabse buri aakhri, aur auraton ki behtareen saf aakhri hai aur sabse buri pehli"

e: Narrator not mentioned:And the Prophet said: "If the people knew what (reward) is in the call (Adhan) and the first row, and they found no other way to get that except drawing lots, then they would draw lots
hi: Aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar log jaanen ke azaan aur pehli saf mein kya sawaab hai, phir usse hasil karne ka koi tareeqa na paayen siwaye qura daalne ke, to wo zaroor qura daalte." Unhon ne kaha: Humein Ishaq bin Musa Al-Ansari ne ye bataya, humein Ma'n ne bataya, humein Malik ne, Sumayy se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi tarah bataya.

e: Narrator not mentioned:A Similar narration
hi: Aur humein Qutaibah ne, Malik se, isi jaisi riwayat ki.

e: An-Nu'man bin Bashir said:"Allah's Messenger would straighten our lines. One day he came out and saw a man whose chest was protruding from the people, so he said: 'You must straighten your lines, or Allah will cause disagreement to occur among your faces
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humari safen seedhi karte the. Ek din wo bahar aaye aur unhon ne dekha ke ek aadmi ka seena logon se aage nikla hua hai. To unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum apni safen zaroor seedhi karo, warna Allah tumhare chehron ke darmiyan ikhtilaaf paida kar dega'"

e: Abdullah (Ibn Masud) narrated that :the Prophet said: "Let those among you with understanding and reason be close to me, then those after them, then those after them. And do not separate or dissention will occur among your hearts, and beware of the commotion of the markets
hi: Abdullah (Ibn Mas'ud) (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se aqal aur samajh waale mere qareeb rahen, phir unke baad wale, phir unke baad wale. Aur ikhtilaaf mat karo, warna tumhare dilon mein bhi ikhtilaaf paida ho jaayega. Aur bazaaron ke shor-sharabe se bacho"

e: Abdul-Hamid bin Mahmud said:"We prayed behind one of the Amirs, the people compelled us such that we prayed between two columns. When we had prayed, Anas bin Malik said: 'We would be prevented from this during the time of Allah's Messenger
hi: Abdul-Hamid bin Mahmud ne kaha: "Humne ek ameer ke peeche namaz padhi, logon ne humein majboor kiya to humne do sutoonon ke darmiyan namaz padhi. Jab humne namaz padh li, to Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: 'Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein isse bachte the'"

e: Hilal bin Yasar said:"Ziyad bin Abi Al-Ja'd took me by the hand while we were in Ar Raqqah, he made me stand before a Shaikh who was called Wabisah bin Ma'bad, from Bani Asad. Ziyad said: 'This Shaikh narrated to me that a prayed alone behind the row' - and the Shaikh was listening - 'so Allah's Messenger ordered him to repeat the Salat
hi: Hilal bin Yasar ne kaha: "Ziyad bin Abi Al-Ja'd ne mera haath pakda jabke hum Ar-Raqqah mein the, aur mujhe ek buzurg ke paas khada kiya jise Wabisah bin Ma'bad kaha jaata tha, Bani Asad se. Ziyad ne kaha: 'Is buzurg ne mujhe bataya ke ek aadmi ne akela saf ke peeche namaz padhi' - aur buzurg sun rahe the - 'to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use namaz dobara padhne ka hukum diya'"

e: Wabisah bin Ma'bad narrated:"A man prayed alone behind the row s the Prophet ordered him to repeat the Salat
hi: Wabisah bin Ma'bad (RA) se riwayat hai ke: "Ek aadmi ne akele saf ke peeche namaz padhi, to Nabi (SAW) ne use namaz dobara padhne ka hukum diya"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"I prayed with the Prophet one night. I stood at his left, so Allah's Messenger took me by my head, from behind me, to put me on his right (side)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine ek raat Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, main unke baayen taraf khada ho gaya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mera sar mere piche se pakda aur mujhe apne dahine taraf kar diya"

e: Samurah bin Jundub narrated:"Allah's Messenger ordered us that when we were three, then one of us should stand forward
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke jab hum teen ho, to hum mein se ek aage badhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Jabir, aur Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Samurah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jab teen log hon, to do aadmi Imam ke peeche khade hote hain. Aur Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Alqamah aur Al-Aswad ke saath namaz padhi, to ek ko apne dahine aur doosre ko apne baayen khada kiya, aur ye Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya. Aur kuch logon ne Ismail bin Muslim Al-Makki ki hifz ke baare mein baat ki hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"My grandmother Mutalikah invited Allah's Messenger to a meal that she prepared. He ate from it, then said: 'Stand so tht we may lead you in prayer.'" He said: "I got a Hasir of our which had become dark because of prolonged use, so I washed it with water. Allah's Messenger stood on it, and the orphan and I aligned behind him and the only lady stood behind us. He (Allah's Messenger) led us in two Rak'ah of prayer and then left
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke: "Meri dadi Mulaikah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek khana khilane ke liye bulaya jo unhon ne banaya tha. Unhon ne usmein se khaya, phir farmaya: 'Khade ho jao, main tumhari imamat karta hoon.'" Anas ne kaha: "To main uth kar humari ek chatai ke paas gaya jo lambe istemal se kaali ho chuki thi, maine usse paani se dhoya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uspar khade hue, aur maine aur yateem ne unke peeche saf banayi, aur boodhi aurat humare peeche khadi hui. Unhon ne humein do rakat namaz padhayi, phir chale gaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jab Imam ke saath ek mard aur ek aurat ho, to mard Imam ke dahine khade ho aur aurat unke peeche khadi ho. Aur kuch logon ne is hadith se dalil li hai ke agar aadmi akele saf ke peeche namaz padhe to jaayez hai, aur unhon ne kaha ke bachche ki namaz (shumaar) nahi hoti, aur goya Anas Nabi (SAW) ke peeche akele saf mein the. Lekin baat waisi nahi jaisi unhon ne samjhi, kyunki Nabi (SAW) ne yateem ko unke saath, unke peeche khada kiya, agar Nabi (SAW) yateem ke liye namaz na maante, to unhen apne saath na khada karte, balki unhen apne dahine khada karte. Aur Musa bin Anas se, Anas se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, to unhen apne dahine khada kiya. Aur is hadith mein ye bhi ishara hai ke ye namaz sirf nafl thi, jo Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye barkat laane ke liye padhi.

e: Abu Mas'ud narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The one who recites most of the Book of Allah is to lead the people (in prayers). If they are equal in recitation, then the most knowledgeable in the Sunnah among them. If they are equal regarding the Sunnah, then the earliest of them to emigrate. If they are equal in their emigration then the eldest among them. And a man is not to be led in prayer in the place of his authority, and his spot of esteem in his home is not to be sat on without his permission
hi: Aws bin Dam'aj se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari (RA) ko kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Logon ki imamat wo kare jo unmein Allah ki Kitab ka sabse zyada qaari ho. Agar wo qiraat mein barabar hon, to jo Sunnat ka sabse zyada aalim ho. Agar wo Sunnat mein barabar hon, to jo hijrat mein sabse pehle ho. Agar wo hijrat mein barabar hon, to jo umr mein sabse bada ho. Aur koi aadmi kisi doosre ki hukumat mein uski imamat na kare, aur uske ghar mein uski izzat wali jagah par uski ijazat ke bagair na baithe.'" Mahmud bin Ghailan ne kaha: Ibn Numair ne apni riwayat mein kaha "unmein umr mein sabse pehla." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Anas bin Malik, Malik bin Al-Huwairith, aur Amr bin Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Imamat ka sabse zyada haqdaar wo hai jo Allah ki Kitab ka sabse zyada qaari ho aur Sunnat ka sabse zyada aalim ho. Aur unhon ne kaha: Ghar ka maalik imamat ka zyada haqdaar hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar ghar ka maalik kisi doosre ko ijazat de, to usse namaz padhwane mein koi harj nahi. Aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya aur kaha: Sunnat ye hai ke ghar ka maalik hi namaz padhaye. Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ka qaul \"Koi aadmi kisi doosre ki hukumat mein uski imamat na kare, aur uske ghar mein uski izzat wali jagah par uski ijazat ke bagair na baithe\" - to agar wo ijazat de de, to mujhe ummeed hai ke ijazat sab mein shaamil hai, aur unhon ne isse koi harj nahi samjha agar wo unhe ijazat de ke wo unhe namaz padhayen.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "When one of you leads the people in prayer then let him be brief, for indeed here are among them the young and the old, the weak and the ill. When one of you prays alone, then let him pray as he wishes
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi logon ki imamat kare, to wo mukhtasar kare, kyunki unmein chhote, bade, kamzor, aur bimaar log hote hain. Aur jab wo akele namaz padhe, to jaisa chahe padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Adiyy bin Hatim, Anas, Jabir bin Samurah, Malik bin Abdullah, Abu Waqid, Uthman bin Abi Al-As, Abu Mas'ud, Jabir bin Abdullah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai, unhon ne pasand kiya ke Imam namaz lambi na kare, kamzor, bade, aur bimaar par mushkil hone ke khauf se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Az-Zinad ka naam Abdullah bin Dhakwan hai. Aur Al-A'raj Abdur-Rahman bin Hurmuz Al-Madini hain, unki kuniyat Abu Dawud hai.

e: Anas [bin Malik] narrated:"Allah's Messenger was among the lightest of people in Salat with its completeness
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni namaz mukammal karte hue bhi logon mein sabse halki namaz padhne walon mein se the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Awanah ka naam Waddah hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Qutaibah se pucha, maine kaha: Abu Awanah ka naam kya hai? Unhon ne kaha: Waddah. Maine pucha: Kiske bete? Unhon ne kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom, wo Basra mein ek aurat ka ghulam tha.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "the key to Salat is the purification, its Tahrim is the Takbir, and its Tahlilis the Taslim, and there is no Salat for one who did not recite Al-Hamd and a Surah in the obligatory (prayer) or other prayers
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ki chaabi taharat hai, uski tahreem Takbir hai, aur uski tahleel Taslim hai, aur us shakhs ki namaz nahi jo Al-Hamd (Surah Fatiha) aur koi aur Surah farz ya ghair-farz namaz mein na padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith isnad mein zyada mazboot aur Abu Sa'eed ki hadith se zyada sahih hai, aur humne ise Kitab-ul-Wudu ke shuru mein likha hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain ke namaz ki tahreem Takbir hai, aur aadmi sirf Takbir se hi namaz mein daakhil hota hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Aban, Waki ke mustamli, ko kehte suna, maine Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ko kehte suna: Agar aadmi Allah ke sattar naamon mein se kisi naam se namaz shuru kare aur Takbir na kahe, to uski namaz kaafi nahi. Aur agar Salam se pehle uska wuzu toot jaaye, to main use hukum doonga ke wo wuzu kare, phir apni jagah wapas aakar Salam kare, kyunki maamla apni sahih soorat mein hai. Aur Abu Nadrah ka naam Al-Mundhir bin Malik bin Qut'ah hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"When Allah's Messenger performed the Takbir for Salat he would spread his fingers
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye Takbir kehte, to apni ungliyan phaila lete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Sa'eed bin Sam'an se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab namaz mein daakhil hote, to apne haath poori tarah phaila kar uthate. Aur ye Yahya bin Al-Yaman ki riwayat se zyada sahih hai, aur Yahya bin Al-Yaman ne is hadith mein ghalti ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"When Allah's Messenger would enter the Salat he would raise his hands while they were extended
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye khade hote, to apne haath poori tarah phaila kar uthate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Abdur-Rahman ne kaha: Aur ye Yahya bin Al-Yaman ki hadith se zyada sahih hai, aur Yahya bin Al-Yaman ki hadith ghalat hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever performs Salat for Allah for forty days in congregation, catching the first Takbir, two absolutions are written for him: absolution from the Fire, and absolution from the Fire, and absolution from hypocrisy
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Allah ke liye chalis din tak jamaat mein namaz padhe, pehli Takbir paate hue, uske liye do azaadiyan likh di jaati hain: aag se azaadi, aur munafiqat se azaadi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Anas se mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai, aur maine kisi ko nahi jaana jisne ise marfu' kiya ho siwaye Salm bin Qutaibah ki riwayat ke, Tu'mah bin Amr se, Habib bin Abi Thabit se, Anas se. Aur ye hadith sirf Habib bin Abi Habib Al-Bajali se, Anas bin Malik ke apne qaul ke taur par riwayat hoti hai. Humein Hannad ne bataya, humein Waki ne bataya, Khalid bin Tahman se, Habib bin Abi Habib Al-Bajali se, Anas se isi tarah, lekin unhon ne ise marfu' nahi kiya. Aur Ismail bin Ayyash ne ye hadith Umarah bin Ghaziyyah se, Anas bin Malik se, Umar bin Al-Khattab se, Nabi (SAW) se isi tarah riwayat ki. Aur ye hadith mahfooz nahi hai, aur ye mursal hadith hai, aur Umarah bin Ghaziyyah ne Anas bin Malik ko nahi paaya. Muhammad bin Ismail (Al-Bukhari) ne kaha: Habib bin Abi Habib ki kuniyat Abu Al-Kashuthi hai, aur unhen Abu Umairah bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Abu Sa'eeed Al Khudri narrated:"When Allah;s Messenger stood for Salat during the night, he would say the Takbir (Allahu Akbar), then say: (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa Tabarakasmuka wa Ta'ala Jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk.)
