'Glorious You are O Allah, and with Your praise, and blesses is Your Name, and exalted is Your majesty, and none has the right to be worshipped but You' Then he would say: (A'udhu Bilahi As-Sami'il-Alimi min Ash-Shaitanir-Rajimi, min Hamzihi Wa Nafkhihi wa Nafthihi.)" 'Allah is undoubtedly the greatest.' (Allahu Akbaru Kabira). Then he would say: 'I seek refuge in Allah the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the cursed Shaitan, from his madness, his arrogance, and his poetry
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ko namaz ke liye khade hote, to Takbir kehte, phir kehte: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa Tabarakasmuka wa Ta'ala Jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk' (Pak hai Tu, Ae Allah, aur Teri hi tareef ke saath, aur mubarak hai Tera naam, aur buzurg hai Teri shaan, aur Tere siwa koi maabood nahi). Phir kehte: 'Allahu Akbaru Kabira' (Allah sabse bada hai, bahut bada). Phir kehte: 'A'udhu Billahi As-Sami'il-Alimi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim, min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthihi' (Main sunne wale, jaanne wale Allah ki panah maangta hoon, dhutkare gaye Shaitan se, uske wasme, uske ghuroor, aur uski shairi se)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Jabir, Jubair bin Mut'im, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Sa'eed ki hadith is mauzu par sabse mashhoor hadith hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm mein se kuch ne is hadith ko apnaya, jabke zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne wo qaul liya jo Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo yahi farmate the: \"Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa Tabarakasmuka wa Ta'ala Jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk.\" Aur isi tarah Umar bin Al-Khattab aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Aur zyada tar Tabi'een aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Abu Sa'eed ki hadith ke isnad ke baare mein kuch baat hui hai, Yahya bin Sa'eed Ali bin Ali Ar-Rifa'i ke baare mein baat karte the, aur Ahmad ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih nahi hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Prophet opened the Salat he would say: (Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk)" 'Glorious You are O Allah, and with Your praise, and blessed is Your Name, and exalted is Your majesty, and none has the right to be worshipped but You
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) namaz shuru karte, to kehte: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika wa Tabarakasmuka wa Ta'ala Jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum Aishah ki riwayat mein sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Haritha ki hifz ke baare mein baat hui hai. Aur Abu Ar-Rijal ka naam Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman Al-Madini hai.

e: Ibn Abdullah bin Mughaffal narrated:"While I was praying, I said: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim "In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Beneficent." My father heard me and said: "O my son this is a newly invented matter, beware of the newly-invented.'" He (Ibn Abdullah) said: "I have not seen any one of the Companions of Allah's Messenger who hated a newly invented matter in Islam more than him. And he said: 'Ihave performed Salat with the Prophet, and with Abu Bakr, and Umar, and with Uthman. I did not hear any one of them saying it. So do not say it. When you are performing Salat say: Al-Hamdu lilahi Rabbil-Alamin "All praise is due to Allah the Lord of all that exists
hi: Ibn Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne mujhe namaz mein sunaa jab main keh raha tha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim.' To unhon ne mujhse kaha: 'Ae mere bete! Ye nayi ijaad ki gayi baat hai, is nayi baat se bacho.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur maine Nabi (SAW) ke kisi Sahabi ko nahi dekha jisse zyada Islam mein nayi baaton se nafrat ho. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath, Abu Bakr ke saath, Umar ke saath, aur Uthman ke saath namaz padhi hai, maine unmein se kisi ko ye kehte nahi suna. To tum bhi ye mat kaho, jab namaz padho to kaho: 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ki hadith hasan hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur doosre, aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain ke wo 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' zor se na padhen. Unhon ne kaha: Wo ise apne dil mein kahen.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet would open his Salat with (Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) apni namaz 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' se shuru karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith aisi hai jiska isnad utna mazboot nahi. Aur kai ahl-e-ilm, jo Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se hain, unmein Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, aur Ibn Az-Zubair, aur unke baad ke Tabi'een, isi ke qaayal hain ke 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' zor se padhi jaaye, aur Ash-Shafi'i isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Ismail bin Hammad, Ibn Abi Sulaiman hain. Aur Abu Khalid ko Abu Khalid Al-Walibi kaha jaata hai, unka naam Hurmuz hai, aur wo Kufi hain.

e: Anas narrated:"Allah's Messenger, Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman opened the Salat with (Al-Hamdu-lillahi rabbil-alamin)
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman qiraat 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin' se shuru karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo qiraat 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin' se shuru karte the. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman qiraat 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin' se shuru karte the, iska matlab ye hai ke wo Surah se pehle Fatihatul-Kitab ki qiraat se shuru karte the, iska ye matlab nahi ke wo 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' nahi padhte the. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ka nazariya tha ke 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' se shuru kiya jaaye aur agar qiraat zor se ho to isse bhi zor se padha jaaye.

e: Ubadah bin As-Samil narrated that :the Prophet said: "There is no Salat for the one who does not recite Fatihatil-Kitab
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jo Fatihatul-Kitab na padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Anas, Abu Qatadah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ubadah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Jabir bin Abdullah, Imran bin Husain, aur doosre, unhon ne kaha: Fatihatul-Kitab ki qiraat ke bagair koi namaz kaafi nahi. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Har wo namaz jismein Fatihatul-Kitab na padhi jaaye, wo naaqis aur na-mukammal hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain. Maine Ibn Abi Umar ko kehte suna: Main Ibn Uyainah ke paas atthaara saal aata-jaata raha, aur Al-Humaidi mujhse ek saal bada tha. Aur maine Ibn Abi Umar ko kehte suna: Maine sattar Hajj apne paon paidal chal kar kiye.

e: Wa'il bin Hujr narrated:"I heard the Prophet recite: (Not (the way) of those who earned Your anger, nor those who went astray) and he said: 'Amin.' And he stretched it out with his voice
hi: Wa'il bin Hujr (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko padhte sunaa: '(Ghair Al-Maghdoobi Alaihim Wa La Ad-Dhaalleen)' [na un logon ka jinpar Tera gazab hua, na bhatke huon ka], to unhon ne kaha: 'Ameen.' Aur unhon ne apni awaaz lambi ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Wa'il bin Hujr ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke kai ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain ke aadmi Ameen zor se kahe aur ise chupaye nahi. Aur Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Salamah bin Kuhail se, Hujr Abu Al-Anbas se, Alqamah bin Wa'il se, apne waalid se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne padha: '(Ghair Al-Maghdoobi Alaihim Wa La Ad-Dhaalleen)' to unhon ne kaha: 'Ameen,' aur apni awaaz halki ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Is baare mein Sufyan ki hadith Shu'bah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai, aur Shu'bah ne is hadith ki kai jagah ghalti ki hai, unhon ne kaha 'Hujr Abu Al-Anbas' jabke wo 'Hujr bin Anbas' hai, aur unki kuniyat Abu As-Sakan hai. Aur unhon ne isme 'Alqamah bin Wa'il' zyada kiya, jabke isme Alqamah nahi hai, balki ye 'Hujr bin Anbas' se, 'Wa'il bin Hujr' se hai, aur unhon ne kaha 'awaaz halki ki' jabke asal mein 'awaaz lambi ki' hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur maine Abu Zur'ah se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Is baare mein Sufyan ki hadith Shu'bah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Al-Ala bin Salih Al-Asadi ne Salamah bin Kuhail se, Sufyan ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki.

e: (Another chain) from Wa'il bin Hujr who narrated it from :the Prophet, and it is similar to the narrations of Sufyan from Salamah bin Kuhail
hi: Wa'il bin Hujr (RA) se, ek doosri sanad se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, jo Sufyan ki, Salamah bin Kuhail se riwayat jaisi hi hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said "When the Imam says 'Amin' then (all of you) say 'Amin.' For whoever's 'Amin' concurs with the 'Amin' of the angels, then his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Imam Ameen kahe, to tum bhi Ameen kaho, kyunki jiska Ameen Farishton ke Ameen se mil jaaye, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Al-Hasan narrated that :Samurah said: "there are two pauses that I preserved from Allah's Messenger." But Imran bin Husain rejected that and said: "We preserved one pause." "So we wrote to Ubayy bin Ka'b in Al-Madinah. Ubayy wrote that Samurah was correct." Sa'eed said: "We said to Qatadah: 'What are those two pauses?' He said: 'When he entered into his Salat, and when he finished his recitation.' Then he (Qatadah) said after that: 'And when he recited (Nor those who went astray.)' And he said: 'He liked to pause when he finished the recitation until he caught his breath
hi: Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Do khaamoshiyan hain jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se yaad rakhi hain." To Imran bin Husain ne isse inkar kiya aur kaha: "Humne ek khaamoshi yaad rakhi hai." "To humne Ubayy bin Ka'b ko Madina mein likha, to Ubayy ne likha ke Samurah ne sahih yaad rakha hai." Sa'eed ne kaha: "To humne Qatadah se kaha: 'Ye do khaamoshiyan kya hain?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Jab wo namaz mein daakhil hote, aur jab wo qiraat se faariq hote.' Phir unhon ne baad mein kaha: 'Aur jab wo (Wa La Ad-Dhaalleen) padhte.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur unhen ye pasand tha ke jab qiraat se faariq hon to khaamosh rahen yahan tak ke saans dobara sambhal jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kai ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai, wo pasand karte hain ke Imam namaz shuru karne ke baad aur qiraat se faariq hone ke baad khaamosh rahe. Aur Ahmad, Ishaq, aur humare asaatiza isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Qabisah bin Hulb narrated from :his father who said: "Allah's Messenger lead us in prayer and hold his left hand with his right
hi: Qabisah bin Hulb apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humari imamat karte, to apne baayen haath ko apne dahine haath se pakadte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Wa'il bin Hujr, Ghutaif bin Al-Harith, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hulb ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi apna dahina haath apne baayen haath par namaz mein rakhe. Kuch ne kaha: Unhen naabhi ke upar rakha jaaye. Kuch ne kaha: Unhen naabhi ke neeche rakha jaaye. Aur ye sab unke nazdeek gunjaish waali baat hai. Aur Hulb ka naam Yazid bin Qunafah At-Ta'i hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"Allah's Messenger would say the Takbir for every lowering and raising, standing and sitting, and (so did) Abu Bakr and Umar
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) har jhukne, uthne, khade hone, aur baithne par Takbir kehte the, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Anas, Ibn Umar, Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari, Abu Musa, Imran bin Husain, Wa'il bin Hujr, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se, unmein Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur doosre, aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur zyada tar fuqaha aur ulema isi par hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would say the Takhir while he was going down
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Takbir kehte the jab wo rukoo ya sajda mein jaate. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Aadmi rukoo aur sajda ki taraf jaate hue Takbir kahe.

e: Salim narrated from :his father (Ibn Umar) who said: "I saw Allah's Messenger when he opened the Salat, raising his hands to the level of his shoulders, and (again) when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing." In his narration, Ibn Abi Umar added: "And he wuld not raise them between the two prostrations
hi: Salim apne walid (Ibn Umar) (RA) se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha, jab wo namaz shuru karte, apne haath apne kandhon tak uthate, aur jab wo rukoo mein jaate, aur jab wo rukoo se apna sar uthate." Aur Ibn Abi Umar ne apni riwayat mein zyada kiya: "Aur wo do sajdon ke darmiyan haath nahi uthate the."

e: Salim narrated:Same as 255 (above) with a different chain
hi: Abu Isa ne kaha: Humein Al-Fadl bin As-Sabbah Al-Baghdadi ne bataya, humein Sufyan bin Uyainah ne bataya, humein Az-Zuhri ne isi sanad ke saath, Ibn Abi Umar ki hadith jaisi hi bataya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Wa'il bin Hujr, Malik bin Al-Huwairith, Anas, Abu Hurairah, Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, Muhammad bin Maslamah, Abu Qatadah, Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari, Jabir, aur Umair Al-Laithi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm, unmein Ibn Umar, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abu Hurairah, Anas, Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, aur doosre, aur Tabi'een mein se Al-Hasan Al-Basri, Ata, Tawus, Mujahid, Nafi, Salim bin Abdullah, Sa'eed bin Jubair, aur doosre isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Malik, Ma'mar, Al-Awza'i, Ibn Uyainah, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Haath uthane wale ki hadith saabit hai, unhon ne Az-Zuhri ki hadith, Salim se, apne walid se, zikr ki, aur Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith saabit nahi ke Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath sirf pehli baar uthaye. Humein Ahmad bin Abdah Al-Amuli ne ye bataya, humein Wahb bin Zam'ah ne Sufyan bin Abdul-Malik se, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se bataya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur humein Yahya bin Musa ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Humein Ismail bin Abi Uwais ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Malik bin Anas namaz mein haath uthane ke qaayal the. Yahya ne kaha: Aur humein Abdur-Razzaq ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ma'mar namaz mein haath uthane ke qaayal the. Aur maine Al-Jarud bin Mu'adh ko kehte suna: Sufyan bin Uyainah, Umar bin Harun, aur An-Nadr bin Shumail apne haath uthate the jab wo namaz shuru karte, jab wo rukoo karte, aur jab wo apne sar uthate.

e: Alqamah narrated that :Abdullah bin Mas'ud said: "Shall I not demonstrate the Salat of Allah's Messenger to you?" Then he offered Salat and he did not raise his hands except while saying the first Takbir
hi: Alqamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Kya main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz na dikhaun?" To unhon ne namaz padhi aur apne haath nahi uthaye siwaye pehli baar ke jab unhon ne Takbir kahi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Al-Bara bin Azib se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur Tabi'een mein se kai ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami said:"Umar bin Al-Khattab [may Allah be pleased with him] said to us: 'The knees are the Sunnah for you, so hold the knees
hi: Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami ne kaha: "Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne humse kaha: 'Beshak ghutne par haath rakhna tumhare liye Sunnat qarar diya gaya hai, is liye ghutnon ko pakdo.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd, Anas, Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, Muhammad bin Maslamah, aur Abu Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, isme koi ikhtilaaf nahi siwaye us riwayat ke jo Ibn Mas'ud aur unke kuch saathiyon se aayi hai ke wo Tatbeeq (donon haathon ko jode kar rakhna) karte the. Aur Tatbeeq ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek mansookh hai.

e: Sa'd bin Abi Waqas said:"We would do that, but then we were prohibited from it, and we were ordered to put our hands on our knees
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha: "Hum aisa karte the, phir humein isse mana kar diya gaya, aur humein hukum diya gaya ke hum apni hatheliyan ghutnon par rakhein." Unhon ne kaha: Humein Qutaibah ne bataya, humein Abu Awanah ne Abu Ya'fur se, Mus'ab bin Sa'd se, apne walid Sa'd se isi tarah bataya. Aur Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Sa'd bin Al-Mundhir hai. Aur Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi ka naam Malik bin Rabi'ah hai. Aur Abu Hasin ka naam Uthman bin Asim Al-Asadi hai. Aur Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami ka naam Abdullah bin Habib hai. Aur Abu Ya'fur Abdur-Rahman bin Ubaid bin Nistas hain. Aur Abu Ya'fur Al-Abdi ka naam Waqid hai, aur Waqdaan bhi kaha jaata hai, aur wahi hain jinhon ne Abdullah bin Abi Awfa se riwayat ki. Aur donon Kufa waale hain.

e: Abbas bin Sahl [bin Sa'd] narrated:"Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, and Muhammad bin Maslamah were once together and they were mentioning the Salat of Allah's Messenger. Abu Humaid said: 'I am the most knowledgeable among you of the Salat of Allah's Messenger: Allah's Messenger would bow and place his hands on his knees as if he was grasping them, and he would draw his forearms to hold them away from his sides
hi: Abbas bin Sahl [bin Sa'd] ne kaha: "Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, aur Muhammad bin Maslamah ikattha hue aur unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ka zikr kiya. To Abu Humaid ne kaha: 'Main tum sab se zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein jaanta hoon: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne rukoo kiya to apne haath apne ghutnon par is tarah rakhe goya wo unhe pakad rahe hain, aur apne haath (unglion ko) taan kar apni pasliyon se door kiya.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Humaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko pasand kiya hai ke aadmi rukoo aur sajda mein apne haath apni pasliyon se door rakhe.

e: Ibn Mas'ud narrated that :the Prophet said: "When one of you bows then says while he is bowing: (Subhana Rabbiyal Azim) 'Glorious is my Lord the Magnificent' three times, then he has completed his bowing. And that is the least of it. And when he prostrates and says while prostrating: (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la) 'Glorious is my Lord the Most High' three times, then he has completed his prostrations, and that is the least of it
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi rukoo kare aur apne rukoo mein teen martaba 'Subhana Rabbiyal Azim' (Pak hai mera Rab, sabse azeem) kahe, to uska rukoo mukammal ho gaya, aur ye uska kam se kam darja hai. Aur jab wo sajda kare aur apne sajde mein teen martaba 'Subhana Rabbiyal A'la' (Pak hai mera Rab, sabse buland) kahe, to uska sajda mukammal ho gaya, aur ye uska kam se kam darja hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Hudhaifah aur Uqbah bin Aamir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith ka isnad mutasil nahi hai. Aun bin Abdullah bin Utbah ne Ibn Mas'ud se mulaqat nahi ki. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi rukoo aur sajda mein teen tasbihaton se kam na kare. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Main pasand karta hoon ke Imam paanch tasbihaten kahe, taake uske peeche wale teen tasbihaten paa saken. Aur isi tarah Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha.

e: Hudhaifah narrated that :he performed Salat with the Prophet, and that while he was bowing he would say: (Subhana Rabbiyal Azim); "Glorious is my Lord the Magnificent" and while prostrating: (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la) 'Glorious is my Lord the Most High.' And he would not recite an Ayah mentioning mercy, except that he would stop and ask (for mercy), and he would not recite an Ayah mentioning punishment, except that he would stop and seek refuge (with Allah from it)
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, to wo apne rukoo mein kehte "Subhana Rabbiyal Azim," aur apne sajde mein "Subhana Rabbiyal A'la." Aur jab bhi Rehmat ki koi Ayat aati, wo ruk kar (Allah se) maangte, aur jab bhi Azab ki koi Ayat aati, wo ruk kar panah maangte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: (Another similar narration) This Hadith has been narrated from Hudhaifah :from another route: "That he performed Salat during the night with the Prophet" and he mentioned the Hadith
hi: Aur ye hadith Hudhaifah se ek doosre raaste se bhi riwayat hui hai ke unhon ne raat ko Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, phir unhon ne hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated:"The Prophet prohibited wearing Qassi, and that which is dyed with safflower, and from the gold ring, and from reciting the Quran while bowing
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Al-Qassi (rangeen resham mile kapde) aur Al-Musaffar (kesar rang ke kapde) pehnne se, sone ki anghoothi pehnne se, aur rukoo mein Quran padhne se mana farmaya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, unhon ne rukoo aur sajda mein qiraat karne ko napasand kiya.

e: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari [Al-Badri] narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The Salat is not acceptable if a man is not at rest - meaning his back - while bowing and prostrating
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us aadmi ki namaz kaafi nahi jo rukoo aur sajda mein apni kamar seedhi na rakhe." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali bin Shaiban, Anas, Abu Hurairah, aur Rifa'ah Az-Zuraqi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke aadmi rukoo aur sajda mein apni kamar seedhi rakhe. Aur Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ne kaha: Jo shakhs rukoo aur sajda mein apni kamar seedhi na rakhe, uski namaz fasid hai, Nabi (SAW) ki hadith ki wajah se: \"Us aadmi ki namaz kaafi nahi jo rukoo aur sajda mein apni kamar seedhi na rakhe.\" Aur Abu Ma'mar ka naam Abdullah bin Sakhbarah hai. Aur Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari Al-Badri ka naam Uqbah bin Amr hai.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated:"When Allah's Messenger would raise his head from bowing he would say: (Sami Allahi liman hamidal. Rabba na lakal-hamd, mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa mil'a ma bainahuma wa mil'a ma shi'ia min shay'in ba'd) 'Allah listens to those who praise Him. O our Lord! And to You is the praise that fills the heavens and fills the earth, and fills what is between them, and fills whatever there is beyond that You will.' He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Abi Awfa, Abu Juhaifa, and Abu Sa'eed
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) rukoo se apna sar uthate, to kehte: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa mil'a ma bainahuma wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd' (Allah sunta hai jo uski tareef kare. Ae humare Rab! Aur Teri hi tareef ke saath jo aasmano aur zameen ko bhar de, aur jo un dono ke darmiyan hai use bhi bhar de, aur us cheez ko bhi bhar de jo Tu chahe iske baad)." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Abi Awfa, Abu Juhaifah, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur Ash-Shafi'i isi ke qaayal hain, unhon ne kaha: Ye farz aur nafl donon namazon mein kaha jaaye. Aur kuch Kufa waalon ne kaha: Ye sirf nafl namaz mein kaha jaaye, farz namaz mein nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur unhen Al-Majishuni isliye kaha jaata hai kyunki wo Al-Majishun ki aulad mein se hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When the Imam says: (Sami Allahu liman hamidah) 'Allah listens to those who praise Him. Then (all of you) say: (Rabbana wa lakal-hamd) 'O our Lord! And to You is the praise for whoever's saying concurs with the saying of the angels, then his past sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Imam kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' (Allah sunta hai jo uski tareef kare), to tum kaho: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd' (Ae humare Rab! Aur Teri hi tareef ke saath), kyunki jiska ye kehna Farishton ke kehne se mil jaaye, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se aur unke baad ke kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Imam kahe 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' aur Imam ke peeche wale kahen 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd.' Aur Ahmad isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Ibn Sireen aur doosron ne kaha: Imam ke peeche wale kahen 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' jaisa Imam kehta hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Wa'il bin Hujr narrated:"I saw Allah's Messenger when he prostrated placing his knees (on the ground) before his hands, and when he got up, he raised his hands before his knees
hi: Wa'il bin Hujr (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha, jab wo sajda karte, apne ghutne apne haathon se pehle zameen par rakhte, aur jab wo uthte, apne haath apne ghutnon se pehle uthate." Unhon ne kaha: Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne apni riwayat mein zyada kiya. Yazid bin Harun ne kaha: Aur Sharik ne Aasim bin Kulaib se sirf yehi hadith riwayat ki hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne Sharik se isi tarah riwayat ki ho. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke aadmi apne ghutne apne haathon se pehle rakhe, aur jab uthe to apne haath apne ghutnon se pehle uthaye. Aur Hammam ne Aasim se ye mursal riwayat ki, aur usmein Wa'il bin Hujr ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said; "Is it that one of you intends to kneel in his Salat with the kneeling of the camel?
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi apni namaz mein oont ki tarah baithne ka irada karta hai?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Abu Az-Zinad ki riwayat se sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur ye hadith Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ko Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan aur doosron ne kamzor qarar diya hai.

e: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi narrated:"When the Prophet would prostrate, he placed his nose and his forehead on the ground, and he held his forearms away from his sides, and he placed his hands parallel to his shoulders
hi: Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab sajda karte, to apni naak aur apni peshani zameen se laga dete, aur apne haath apni pasliyon se door rakhte, aur apni hatheliyan apne kandhon ke barabar rakhte. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Wa'il bin Hujr, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Humaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke aadmi apni peshani aur naak par sajda kare. Agar wo sirf peshani par sajda kare, naak par nahi, to kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Ye kaafi hai. Aur doosron ne kaha: Ye kaafi nahi jab tak wo peshani aur naak donon par sajda na kare.

e: Abu Ishaq narrated:"I said to Al-Bara bin Azib: 'Where would the Prophet place his face when he prostrated?' He said: 'Between his hands
hi: Abu Ishaq ne kaha: "Maine Al-Bara bin Azib se pucha: 'Nabi (SAW) sajda karte waqt apna chehra kahan rakhte the?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Apni dono hatheliyon ke darmiyan.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Wa'il bin Hujr aur Abu Humaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko pasand kiya hai ke uske haath uske kaano ke qareeb hon.

e: Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib narrated that he heard :Allah's Messenger Saying: "When the worshipper prostrates with him: His face, his hands, his knees, and his feet
hi: Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jab banda sajda karta hai, to uske saath saat aza sajda karte hain: uska chehra, uski donon hatheliyan, uske donon ghutne, aur uske donon paon." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Jabir, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet ordered that one prostrate on seven bones and that he not gather his hair nor his garment
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ko hukum diya gaya ke wo saat haddiyon par sajda karen, aur apne baal ya apne kapde na samete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubaidallah bin Abdullah bin Arqam Al-Khuza'I narrated from his father (Abdullah bin Arqam), who said:"I was with my father at the plains of Namirah. I passed by a mount and saw Allah's Messenger standing in Salat." He said: "I was looking at the earthiness of his armpits when he prostrated." [That is]: "Whiteness
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Aqram Al-Khuza'i apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Main apne waalid ke saath Namirah ke maidaan mein tha, ek qafila guzra to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein khade the." Unhon ne kaha: "To main unki baghlon ki safedi dekh raha tha jab wo sajda karte, yani unki safedi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Ibn Buhainah, Jabir, Ahmar bin Jaz', Maimunah, Abu Humaid, Abu Mas'ud, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, Muhammad bin Maslamah, Al-Bara bin Azib, Adiyy bin Amirah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye Ahmar bin Jaz' Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se ek aadmi hain, unki sirf ek hadith hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Aqram ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise Dawud bin Qais ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante, aur hum Abdullah bin Aqram Al-Khuza'i ki Nabi (SAW) se koi doosri hadith nahi jaante. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Aqram Al-Khuza'i ki Nabi (SAW) se sirf yehi hadith hai. Aur Abdullah bin Arqam Az-Zuhri Nabi (SAW) ke Sahabi hain, wo Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ke katib the.

e: Jabir narrated that :the Prophet said: "When one of you prostrates, then let him be balanced, and let him not lay his forearms down like the lying of the dog
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi sajda kare, to wo mautadil (seedha, sahih tareeke se) rahe, aur apni bazuein kutte ki tarah bicha kar na rakhe." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Shibl, Anas, Al-Bara, Abu Humaid, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo sajda mein mautadil rehna pasand karte hain aur bazuein darinde ki tarah bichaana napasand karte hain.

e: Anas narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Be balanced in the prostration, and let one of you not spread his forearms (on the ground) in the Salat like the spreading of the dog
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sajde mein mautadil raho, aur tum mein se koi apni bazuein namaz mein kutte ki tarah na bichaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Amir bin Sa'd [bin Abi Waqqas] narrated from his father:"The Prophet ordered placing the hands (on the ground) keeping the feet erect. (by resting feet on the toes and making the tips of the toes facing the Qiblah)
hi: Aamir bin Sa'd [bin Abi Waqqas] apne walid se riwayat karte hain: Nabi (SAW) ne haath (zameen par) rakhne aur paon khade rakhne ka hukum diya (paon ki ungliyon par takiya karte hue aur unke sire Qibla ki taraf rakhte hue).

e: (Another chain that) Amir bin Sa'd narrated:"The Prophet ordered placing the hands (on the ground)." And he mentioned in it: "From his father
hi: Abdullah ne kaha aur Mu'alla bin Asad ne kaha: Humein Hammad bin Mas'adah ne bataya, Muhammad bin Ajlan se, Muhammad bin Ibrahim se, Aamir bin Sa'd se, ke Nabi (SAW) ne haath rakhne ka hukum diya, phir unhon ne isi jaisi baat zikr ki, lekin ismein "apne walid se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan aur kai doosron ne Muhammad bin Ajlan se, Muhammad bin Ibrahim se, Aamir bin Sa'd se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne haath rakhne aur paon khade rakhne ka hukum diya - ye mursal hai, aur ye Wuhaib ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur yehi wo hai jispar ahl-e-ilm ne ittefaq kiya hai aur ise pasand kiya hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:"The Salat of Allah's Messenger (was such that) when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing, and when he prostrated, and when he raised his head from prostration it (all) was nearly the same
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz aisi thi ke jab wo rukoo karte, aur jab wo rukoo se apna sar uthate, aur jab wo sajda karte, aur jab wo sajde se apna sar uthate, ye sab taqreeban barabar hote the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:(Another chain) which is similar
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne (isi jaisi riwayat ki) - ek doosri sanad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Al-Bara said:"When we performed Salat behind Allah's Messenger, he would raise his head from bowing, and no man among us would bend his back until Allah's Messenger prostrated, then we prostrated
hi: Al-Bara (RA), jo jhoote nahi hain, ne kaha: "Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhte, aur wo rukoo se apna sar uthate, to hum mein se koi apni kamar nahi jhukata jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sajda na karte, phir hum sajda karte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Muawiyah, Ibn Mas'adah (lashkaron ke saathi), aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain ke Imam ke peeche wale Imam ki pairvi karte hain jo wo karte hain, wo rukoo nahi karte siwaye uske rukoo ke baad, aur wo sar nahi uthate siwaye uske sar uthane ke baad. Humein maloom nahi ke is baare mein unke darmiyan koi ikhtilaaf ho.

e: Ali narrated:"Allah's Messenger said to me: 'O Ali! I love for you what I love for myself, and I dislike for you what I dislike for myself. Do not squat between prostrations
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Main tumhare liye wahi pasand karta hoon jo main apne liye pasand karta hoon, aur main tumhare liye wahi napasand karta hoon jo main apne liye napasand karta hoon. Do sajdon ke darmiyan Iq'aa mat karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki riwayat mein sirf Abu Ishaq se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se hi jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Al-Harith Al-A'war ko kamzor qarar diya hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is hadith par amal hai, wo Iq'aa ko napasand karte hain. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Anas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Tawus said:"We asked Ibn Abbas about squatting (sitting) on the heels. He said: 'It is the Sunnah.' We said: 'We think that it is difficult for a man.' He said: 'Rather, it is Sunnah of your Prophet
hi: Tawus ne kaha: "Humne Ibn Abbas (RA) se paon par Iq'aa karne ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne kaha: 'Ye Sunnat hai.'" "To humne kaha: 'Humein lagta hai ye aadmi ke liye mushkil hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: "'Balki ye tumhare Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm is hadith ke qaayal hain, wo Iq'aa mein koi harj nahi maante, aur ye Makkah ke kuch fiqh aur ilm ke ahl ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm do sajdon ke darmiyan Iq'aa ko napasand karte hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Between the two prostrations, the Prophet would say: (Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wajburni, wahdini, warzuqni). 'O Allah! Pardon me, have mercy on me, help me, guide me, and grant me sustenance
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) do sajdon ke darmiyan kehte the: "Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wajburni, wahdini, warzuqni" (Ya Allah! Mujhe bakhsh de, mujh par reham kar, meri kami poori kar, mujhe hidayat de, aur mujhe rizq de).

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:(Another chain) which is similar
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se (isi jaisi riwayat) - ek doosri sanad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur isi tarah Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain, wo ise farz aur nafl donon namazon mein jaayez maante hain. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Kamil Abu Al-Ala se mursal riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"[Some of] the Companions of the Prophet complained [to the Prophet] about the hardship of the prostration on them, when they were so spread out, so he said: 'Use your knees
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne Nabi (SAW) se sajde ki takleef ki shikayat ki jab unhen tang jagah miltee, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ghutnon se madad lo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Abu Salih ki riwayat se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, sirf Laith ki riwayat se, Ibn Ajlan se, isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur ye hadith Sufyan bin Uyainah aur kai doosron ne Sumayy se, An-Nu'man bin Abi Ayyash se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur inki riwayat Laith ki riwayat se zyada sahih maloom hoti hai.

e: Malik bin Al-Huwairith Al-Laithi narrated that he saw :Allah's Messenger performing Salat. When he was in an odd number of his Salat, he would not get up until he had sat completely
hi: Malik bin Al-Huwairith Al-Laithi (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ko namaz padhte dekha, jab wo apni namaz ke taak rakat mein hote, to wo tab tak nahi uthte jab tak wo poori tarah baith na jaate. Abu Isa ne kaha: Malik bin Al-Huwairith ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Ishaq aur humare kuch asaatiza isi ke qaayal hain. Aur Malik ki kuniyat Abu Sulaiman hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would get up during his Salat on the tips of his feet
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) namaz mein apne paon ke agle hisse par khade hote." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith par ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi namaz mein apne paon ke agle hisse par khada ho. Aur Khalid bin Ilyas ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek kamzor hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur unhen Khalid bin Iyas bhi kaha jaata hai. Aur Salih Maula At-Tau'amah, Salih bin Abi Salih hain. Aur Abu Salih ka naam Nabhan hai, aur wo Madina ke rehne wale hain.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"Allah's Messenger taught us, that when we sit for every two Rak'ah we should say: (At-Tahyyatulillah, was-salawatu wattayybaat. As-salamu alaika ayyuhannabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Rasuluh.) 'All greetings, prayers, and pure words are Allah. Peace be upon you O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and all of the righteous worshippers of Allah. I testify that nne has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is Allah's servant and Messenger
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein sikhaya ke jab hum har do rakat mein baithen, to hum kahen: 'At-Tahiyyatu Lillahi was-Salawatu wat-Tayyibaat. As-Salamu Alaika Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. As-Salamu Alaina wa Ala Ibadillahis-Salihin. Ashhadu An La Ilaha Illallah wa Ashhadu Anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasooluh' (Saari izzatein, duayein, aur paak baatein Allah ke liye hain. Aap par salamati ho, Ae Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein. Hum par aur Allah ke neik bandon par salamati ho. Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain)." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Jabir, Abu Musa, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai. Aur ye Tashahhud mein Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi sabse sahih hadith hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Humein Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Musa ne bataya, humein Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne Ma'mar se, Khusaif se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine khwab mein Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, to maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Logon ne Tashahhud mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai. To unhon ne farmaya: \"Tum Ibn Mas'ud ka Tashahhud le lo.\"

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Allah's Messenger would teach us the Tashah-hud just as he would teach us the Qur'an. He would say: (At-Tahiyyatu, al mubarakatu, as-salawatu at-tayyibatulillah. Salamun alaika ayyuhan-naibiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, salamun alaina wa ala ibadalillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Raduluh.) 'All greetings, goodness, prayers, and pure words are for Allah. Peace be upon you O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings, Peace be upon us and all of the righteous worshippers of Allah. I testify that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is Allah's worshipper and Messenger
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein Tashahhud isi tarah sikhate the jaise wo humein Quran sikhate the. To wo kehte: 'At-Tahiyyatu, Al-Mubarakatu, As-Salawatu, At-Tayyibatu Lillah. Salamun Alaika Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. Salamun Alaina wa Ala Ibadillahis-Salihin. Ashhadu An La Ilaha Illallah, wa Ashhadu Anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasooluh'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Humaid Ar-Ru'asi ne ye hadith Abu Az-Zubair se, Laith bin Sa'd ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Aiman bin Nabil Al-Makki ne ye hadith Abu Az-Zubair se, Jabir se riwayat ki, aur ye mahfooz nahi hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne Tashahhud mein Ibn Abbas ki hadith ko apnaya.

e: Abdullah bin Mas`ud said:"It is from the Sunnah to say the Tashahhud quietly
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kaha: "Ye Sunnat mein se hai ke Tashahhud aahista se kaha jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Wa'il bin Hujr said:"I arrived in Al-Madinah and I said, 'Let me look at the Salat of Allah's Messenger.' When he sat - meaning for At-Tashah-hud - he spread his left foot, and placed his left hand - meaning on his left thigh - and held his right foot erect
hi: Wa'il bin Hujr ne kaha: "Main Madina aaya, maine kaha main zaroor Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz dekhunga. Jab wo baithe - yani Tashahhud ke liye - to unhon ne apna baayan paon bicha diya aur apna baayan haath - yani apni baayen raan par rakha - aur apna dahina paon khada rakha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Kufa waalon, aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai.

e: Abbas bin SAhl [bin Sa'd] narrated:"Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, and Muhammad bin Maslamah were once together and they were mentioning the Salat of Allah's Messenger. Abu Humaid said: "I am the most knowledgeable among you of the Salat of Allah's Messenger: Indeed Allah's Messenger sat - meaning for Tashah-hud - he spread his left foot, and made the top of his right (foot) face the Qiblah, and he placed his right hand on his right knee, and his left hand on his left knee, and indicated with his finger - meaning the index finge
hi: Abbas bin Sahl [bin Sa'd] ne kaha: "Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, aur Muhammad bin Maslamah ikattha hue aur unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ka zikr kiya. To Abu Humaid ne kaha: 'Main tum sab se zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein jaanta hoon: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baithe - yani Tashahhud ke liye - to unhon ne apna baayan paon bicha diya, aur apne dahine paon ka agla hissa Qibla ki taraf kiya, aur apni dahini hatheli apne dahine ghutne par rakhi aur apni baayen hatheli apne baayen ghutne par rakhi, aur apni ungli - yani shahadat ki ungli - se ishara kiya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Aakhri Tashahhud mein apne chootad par baithe, aur Abu Humaid ki hadith se dalil li, aur kaha: Pehle Tashahhud mein apne baayen paon par baithe aur dahina khada rakhe.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"When the Prophet would sit during the Salat, he would place his right hand on his knee, and raise his finger, the one that is next to the [right] thumb, supplicating with it, and his left hand was spread flat on his left knee
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab namaz mein baithte, to apna dahina haath apne ghutne par rakhte aur apni wo ungli jo angoothe ke bagal mein hai uthate hue dua karte, aur unka baayan haath unke baayen ghutne par bicha hua hota. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, Numair Al-Khuza'i, Abu Hurairah, Abu Humaid, aur Wa'il bin Hujr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Ubaidullah bin Umar ki riwayat se sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur Tabi'een mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Tashahhud mein ishara karna pasand karte hain, aur ye humare asaatiza ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah narrated:"The Prophet would say the Salam from his right and from his left (saying): (As-Salamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, as-Salamu alaikum wa rahmatullah) 'Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy. Peace be upon you, and Allah's mercy
hi: Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) apne dahine aur apne baayen Salam kehte the: "As-Salamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah, As-Salamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Ibn Umar, Jabir bin Samurah, Al-Bara, Abu Sa'eed, Ammar, Wa'il bin Hujr, Adiyy bin Amirah, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would say one Taslim for the Salat while facing forward and turning to his right side a little
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein sirf ek Salam kehte the, apne chehre ki seedh mein, thoda dahini taraf jhukte hue. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hum marfu' sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Muhammad bin Ismail (Al-Bukhari) ne kaha: Zuhair bin Muhammad se Shaam waale munkar hadithein riwayat karte hain, aur Iraq waalon ki riwayat unse zyada milti-julti aur sahih hai. Muhammad ne kaha, aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Goya Zuhair bin Muhammad jo unke paas tha wo wahi nahi hai jinse Iraq mein riwayat ki jaati hai, goya wo koi doosra aadmi hai jiska naam ulat diya gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur namaz mein Salam ke baare mein kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko liya hai, lekin Nabi (SAW) se sabse sahih riwayaten do Salam ke baare mein hain, aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne farz namaz mein ek Salam maana hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Agar chahe to ek Salam kahe, aur agar chahe to do Salam kahe.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Hadhf the Salam is a Sunnah
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Salam ko halka rakhna Sunnat hai." Ali bin Hujr ne kaha: Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha, iska matlab hai ke ise lamba na kheeche. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur yehi wo hai jise ahl-e-ilm pasand karte hain. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Takbir mukhtasar hai aur Salam bhi mukhtasar hai. Aur Hiql ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke wo Al-Awza'i ke katib the.

e: Aishah narrated:"When Allah's Messenger said the Salam he would not remain seated except long enough to say: (Allahumma antas-salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta dhal jalali wal-Ikram) 'O Allah! You are the One free of defects, and perfection is from You. Blessed are You, Possessor of Majesty and Honor
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Salam kehte, to sirf itni der baithte jitni der mein ye kehte: 'Allahumma Antas-Salam, wa Minkas-Salam, Tabarakta Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram' (Ya Allah! Tu hi Salam hai, aur Tujhi se Salamati hai, mubarak hai Tu, ae izzat aur buzurgi wale)."

e: Aishah narrated:(Another chain) which is similar, but he said: (Tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram) "Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor
hi: (isi jaisi riwayat) - isi sanad se, aur unhon ne kaha: "Tabarakta Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Thawban, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Khalid Al-Hadhdha ne ye hadith Aishah ki riwayat mein, Abdullah bin Al-Harith se, Aasim ki hadith jaisi hi riwayat ki. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo Salam ke baad kehte: \"La Ilaha Illallahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku wa Lahul-Hamdu, Yuhyi wa Yumitu, wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir. Allahumma La Mani'a Lima A'taita, wa La Mu'tiya Lima Mana'ta, wa La Yanfa'u Dhal-Jaddi Minkal-Jadd\". Aur unse riwayat hai ke wo kehte: \"Subhana Rabbika Rabbil-Izzati Amma Yasifun, wa Salamun Alal-Mursalin, wal-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin\".

e: Thawban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger, narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When Allah's Messenger wanted to turn from his Salat, he would seek forgiveness from Allah three times, then say: (Allahumma Antas-Salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-Ikram) 'O Allah! You are the One free of defects and perfection is from You. Blessed are You, O Possesor of Majesty and Honor
hi: Thawban (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam, se riwayat hai ke: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni namaz se lautna chahte, to teen martaba Allah se maafi maangte, phir kehte: "Allahumma Antas-Salam, wa Minkas-Salam, Tabarakta Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ammar ka naam Shaddad bin Abdullah hai.

e: Qabisah bin Hulb narrated that his father said:"When Allah's Messenger would lead us in Salat he would turn (to leave) from both sides, on his right and on his left
hi: Qabisah bin Hulb apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humari imamat karte, to donon taraf se lautte, apne dahine aur apne baayen." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Anas, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hulb ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke wo jis bhi taraf se chahe laut sakta hai, chahe dahine se chahe baayen se. Aur donon tareeqe Nabi (SAW) se sahih hain. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Agar unki zaroorat dahini taraf ho to dahine se lautte, aur agar baayen taraf ho to baayen se lautte.

e: Rifa`ah bin Rafi` narrated:"One day Allah's Messenger was sitting in the Masjid" Rifa'ah said: "And we were with him. Then what appeared to be a Bedouin man entered to pray, but he performed his Salat in a very brief manner. He then got up and greeted the prophet with Salam. The Prophet said (returning the greeting): 'And upon you. Go back and perform Salat, for indeed you have no prayed.' So he returned to perform Salat then came and greeted the Prophet with Salam. So he (the Prophet) said (returning the greeting): 'And upon you. Go back and perform Salat, for indeed you have not prayed.' [He did that] two or three times, each time coming to the Prophet, greeted the Prophet with Salam and the Prophet saying: 'And upon you. Go back and perform Salat, for indeed you have not prayed.' - until the people got scared and became very worried that one whose prayer was so brief had not actually prayed. Then in the end the man said: 'Then show me, and teach me, for I am a human who has suffered and is mistaken.' So he said: 'Alright. When you stand for Salat then perform Wudu as Allah ordered you. Then say the Tashahhud, and the Iqamah as well. If you know any Quran then recite it, if not then praise Allah, mention His greatness, and the Tahlil. Then bow such that you are at rest in your bowing, then stand completely, then prostrate completely, then sit such that you are at rest while sitting them stand. When you have done that, then you have completed your Salat, and if you leave out something, then you have made your Salat deficient.' And this was easier on them than the first matter, because if some of this was deficient, It would only reduce the reward of his Salat, it would not have gone entirely
hi: Rifa'ah bin Rafi' (RA) se riwayat hai ke ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein baithe hue the - Rifa'ah ne kaha: aur hum unke saath the - itne mein ek aadmi aaya jo Bedouin jaisa lagta tha, usne namaz padhi, lekin usne apni namaz bahut halki padhi. Phir wo laut kar Nabi (SAW) ko Salam karne aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne (jawabi Salam dete hue) farmaya: "Aur tum par (Salam ho), wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." To wo wapas gaya aur namaz padhi, phir aaya aur Salam kiya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Aur tum par, wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." Aisa do ya teen martaba hua, har baar wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aata, Salam karta, aur Nabi (SAW) kehte: "Aur tum par, wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." To log dar gaye aur unhen mushkil lagi ke jiski namaz itni halki thi usne namaz padhi hi nahi. Aakhirkar us aadmi ne kaha: "To mujhe dikhaiye aur sikhaiye, main to sirf ek insaan hoon jo galti kar sakta hai aur sahih bhi kar sakta hai." To unhon ne farmaya: "Theek hai. Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, to Allah ke hukum ke mutabiq wuzu karo, phir Tashahhud kaho aur Iqaamat karo, agar tumhare paas Quran yaad hai to padho, warna Allah ki tareef karo, uski buzurgi bayan karo, aur Tahleel karo. Phir rukoo karo aur rukoo mein itmenaan se raho. Phir seedhe khade ho. Phir sajda karo aur sajde mein itmenaan se raho. Phir baitho aur baithne mein itmenaan se raho. Phir khade ho. Jab tum ye karoge, to tumhari namaz mukammal ho jaayegi, aur agar tumne ismein se kuch kam kiya, to tumhari namaz mein kami aa jaayegi." Unhon ne kaha: Aur ye pehli baat se unke liye zyada aasan tha, ke agar ismein se kuch kam ho jaaye, to sirf namaz mein kami aayegi, wo poori tarah bekaar nahi hogi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Ammar bin Yasir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Rifa'ah bin Rafi' ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Rifa'ah se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger entered the Masjid, and a man entered and offered Salat. Then he came to give Salam to the Propet. He returned the Salam to him and said: 'Go back and perform Salat, for indeed you have not prayed.' So the man returned to pray as he had prayed. Then he came to give Salam to the Prophet. He returned Salam to him, then [Allah's Messenger] said: 'Go back and perform Salat, for indeed you have not prayed' until he had done that three times. So the man said to him: 'By the One who sent you with the Truth, I do not know any better than this, so teach me.' So he said [to him]: 'When you stand for Salat then say the Takbir, then recite what is easy for you of the Quran. Then bow until you are at rest while bowing, then rise up until you are at rest sitting. Do that in all of your Salat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein daakhil hue, phir ek aadmi daakhil hua aur namaz padhi. Phir wo aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ko Salam kiya. Unhon ne uska Salam wapas kiya aur farmaya: "Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." To wo aadmi wapas gaya aur waisi hi namaz padhi jaisi pehle padhi thi. Phir wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Salam kiya. Unhon ne uska Salam wapas kiya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi," yahan tak ke aisa teen baar hua. To us aadmi ne unse kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, mujhe iske siwa kuch nahi aata, to mujhe sikhaiye." To unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho, to Takbir kaho, phir Quran mein se jo tumhare liye aasan ho wo padho, phir rukoo karo yahan tak ke tum rukoo mein itmenaan se ho jao, phir uthon yahan tak ke tum seedhe khade ho jao, phir sajda karo yahan tak ke tum sajda mein itmenaan se ho jao, phir uthon yahan tak ke tum baithne mein itmenaan se ho jao, aur apni poori namaz mein aisa hi karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ibn Numair ne ye hadith Ubaidullah bin Umar se, Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, aur usmein \"apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se\" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ki, Ubaidullah bin Umar se riwayat zyada sahih hai. Aur Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ne Abu Hurairah se suna hai aur apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ka naam Kaisaan hai, aur Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ki kuniyat Abu Sa'd hai, aur Kaisaan ek ghulam the jo kuch logon ke liye mukatib the.

e: Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata' narrated from Abu Humaid As-Saidi, :he (Muhammad) said: "I heard him saying - while he was among ten of the Companions of the Prophet, one of whom was Abu Qatadah bin Ribi - 'I am the most knowledgeable among you of the Salat of the Allah's Messenger.' They said: 'You did not precede us in his companionship, nor were you in his company more than us.' He said: 'Even still." They said: 'Go ahead.' So he said: 'When Allah's Messenger stood for Salat he would stand with his back straight and raise his hands until they were at the level of his shoulder. Then he would say: (Allahu Akbar) "Allah is Most Great" and bow. Then he would straighten (his back) so that he would not lower his head, nor raise it, and he placed his hands on his knees. Then he said: (Sami Allahu liman hamidah) "Allah listens to those who praise Him." And he raised his hands and stood up straight until all of his bones completely returned to their places. Then he went down to the ground prostrating, then he said: (Allahu Akbar) "Allah is Most Great." Then he held his upper arms away from his midsection, and opened his toes on his feet (facing the Qiblah), then he bend his left foot and sat on it then straightened up until all of his bones completely returned to their placed, then he went down to prostrate. Then he said: (Allahu Akbar) "Allah is Most Great," then he bent his foot and sat and straightened up until all of his bones completely returned to their places. Then he got up. Then in the second Rak'ah he did the same as that, such that when he stood from the two prostrations, he sad the Takbir and raised his hands until they were at the level of his shoulders as he did when he opened the Salat. Then he did like that until it was the Rak'ah in which his Salat was to end, when he moved his left foot over and sat on his side (in the Mutawarrik postion). Then he said the Taslim
hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine unhen suna, jab wo Nabi (SAW) ke das Sahaba ke darmiyan the, unmein se ek Abu Qatadah bin Rib'i the, wo keh rahe the: 'Main tum sab se zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein jaanta hoon.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Tum na to unki sohbat mein humse pehle the, na humse zyada unke paas jaate the." Unhon ne kaha: "Phir bhi." Unhon ne kaha: "To batao." To unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab namaz ke liye khade hote, to seedhe khade hote aur apne haath apne kandhon tak uthate. Phir jab wo rukoo karna chahte, to apne haath apne kandhon tak uthate, phir kehte: 'Allahu Akbar,' aur rukoo karte. Phir seedhe hote, aur na apna sar niche karte, na upar uthate, aur apne haath apne ghutnon par rakhte. Phir kehte: 'Sami' Allahu Liman Hamidah,' aur apne haath uthate aur seedhe khade hote yahan tak ke har haddi apni jagah par seedhi wapas aa jaati. Phir zameen ki taraf jhukte hue sajda karte, phir kehte: 'Allahu Akbar.' Phir apni bazuein apni baghlon se door rakhte aur apne paon ki ungliyan phaila dete, phir apna baayan paon mod kar uspar baith jaate, phir seedhe hote yahan tak ke har haddi apni jagah par seedhi wapas aa jaati. Phir jhuk kar sajda karte, phir kehte: 'Allahu Akbar.' Phir apna paon modte aur baithte aur seedhe hote yahan tak ke har haddi apni jagah par wapas aa jaati. Phir uthte. Phir doosri rakat mein waisa hi karte, yahan tak ke jab wo do sajdon ke baad uthte, to Takbir kehte aur apne haath kandhon tak uthate jaisa unhon ne namaz shuru karte waqt kiya tha. Phir waisa hi karte yahan tak ke jab wo rakat aati jismein unki namaz khatam hoti, to wo apna baayan paon peeche karte aur apni ek taraf par baithte, Mutawarrik ki soorat mein, phir Salam kehte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur \"apne haath uthaana jab wo do sajdon se uthein\" ka matlab ye hai ke jab wo do rakaton se uthein.

e: (Another chain) that Muhammad bin Amir bin Ata narrated from Abu Humaid As-Saidi,:he (Muhammad) said: "I heard him saying - while he was among ten of the Companions of the Prophet, one of whom was Abu Qatadah bin Ribi
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata ne Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi se, das Sahaba ke darmiyan, jinmein Abu Qatadah bin Rib'i bhi the, ye Yahya bin Sa'eed ki hadith jaisi hi hadith bayan ki, aur Abu Aasim ne, Abdul-Hamid bin Ja'far se, ye alfaaz zyada kiye: Unhon ne kaha: "Aapne sach kaha, isi tarah Nabi (SAW) ne namaz padhi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Aasim Ad-Dahhak bin Makhlad ne is hadith mein, Abdul-Hamid bin Ja'far se, ye alfaaz zyada kiye: Unhon ne kaha: "Aapne sach kaha, isi tarah Nabi (SAW) ne namaz padhi."

e: Qutbah bin Malik narrated:"I heard Allah's Messenger reciting for Fajr: And tall date palms in the first Rak'ah
hi: Qutbah bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Fajr mein pehli rakat mein 'Wan-Nakhla Basiqat' padhte suna." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Amr bin Hurayth, Jabir bin Samurah, Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib, Abu Barzah, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Qutbah bin Malik ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Subh mein Surah Al-Waqi'ah padhi. Aur unse riwayat hai ke wo Fajr mein saath se sau Ayaton tak padhte the. Aur unse riwayat hai ke unhon ne 'Idhash-Shamsu Kuwwirat' padhi. Aur Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Abu Musa ko likha ke Subh mein Mufassal ki lambi Surahon se padho. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"For Zuhr and Asr, Allah's Messenger would recite: By the heavens, holding the Buruj and (By the heavens and At-Tariq) and similar to them
hi: Jabir bin Samurah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Zuhr aur Asr mein 'Was-Samai Dhatil-Buruj' aur 'Was-Samai wat-Tariq' aur unke jaisi Surahen padhte the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Khabbab, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Qatadah, Zaid bin Thabit, aur Al-Bara bin Azib se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Samurah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Zuhr mein taqreeban Surah As-Sajdah jitna padha. Aur unse riwayat hai ke wo Zuhr ki pehli rakat mein taqreeban tees Ayaton jitna aur doosri rakat mein taqreeban pandra Ayaton jitna padhte the. Aur Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Abu Musa ko likha ke Zuhr mein Mufassal ke darmiane hisse se padho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Asr ki namaz mein qiraat Maghrib ki namaz jaisi hoti hai, wo Mufassal ki chhoti Surahen padhte hain. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Asr ki namaz qiraat mein Maghrib ki namaz ke barabar hai. Aur Ibrahim ne kaha: Zuhr ki namaz qiraat mein Asr ki namaz se chaar guna zyada hoti hai.

e: Umm Al-Fadl narrated:"Allah's Messenger came out to us with his head bandaged from his illness. He prayed Maghrib, reciting (Surat) Al-Mursalat." [She said:] "He did not pray it again until he met Allah the Might and Sublime
hi: Umm Al-Fadl (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas nikle, unka sar apni beemari mein bandha hua tha. Unhon ne Maghrib padhi aur Surah Al-Mursalat padhi." Unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne uske baad ye Surah kabhi nahi padhi yahan tak ke wo Allah se ja mile." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jubair bin Mut'im, Ibn Umar, Abu Ayyub, aur Zaid bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Al-Fadl ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Maghrib ki donon rakaton mein Surah Al-A'raf padhi. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Maghrib mein Surah At-Tur padhi. Aur Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Abu Musa ko likha ke Maghrib mein Mufassal ki chhoti Surahen padho. Aur Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Maghrib mein Mufassal ki chhoti Surahen padhi. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha, aur Malik se zikr kiya gaya hai ke unhon ne Maghrib ki namaz mein lambi Surahen jaisi At-Tur aur Al-Mursalat padhna napasand kiya. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Main isse napasand nahi karta, balki main pasand karta hoon ke Maghrib ki namaz mein ye Surahen padhi jaayen.

e: Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated that his father (Buraidah) said:"Allah's Messenger would recite: By the sun and its brightness, or similar Surah for the latter Isha (prayer)
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aakhri Isha mein 'Wash-Shamsi wa Duhaha' aur isi jaisi Surahen padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Al-Bara bin Azib aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Buraidah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne aakhri Isha mein 'At-Tini waz-Zaitun' padhi. Aur Uthman bin Affan se riwayat hai ke wo Isha mein Mufassal ke darmiane hisse ki Surahen padhte, jaisi Surah Al-Munafiqun aur uske jaisi. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur Tabi'een se riwayat hai ke unhon ne isse zyada aur kam bhi padha, goya unke nazdeek ismein gunjaish hai. Aur is baare mein sabse behtar baat wo hai jo Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne 'Wash-Shamsi wa Duhaha' aur 'At-Tini waz-Zaitun' padhi.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:"The Prophet would recite: By the fig and the olive for Isha
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne aakhri Isha mein 'At-Tini waz-Zaitun' padhi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubadah bin As-Samit narrated:"Allah's Messenger prayed the Subh prayer, and he had difficulty with the recitation. When turned (after finishing) he said: 'I think that you are reciting behind your Imam?'" He said: "We said: 'Yes, Messenger of Allah, by Allah!' He said: 'Do not do that, except for Umm Al-Kitab, for there is no Salat for one who does not recite it
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Subh ki namaz padhi, aur unhen qiraat mushkil lagi. Jab wo faariq hue, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Mujhe lagta hai tum apne Imam ke peeche padh rahe ho.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Humne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Haan, Allah ki qasam." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo siwaye Umm Al-Quran ke, kyunki jo isse na padhe uski namaz nahi hoti." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Anas, Abu Qatadah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ubadah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Az-Zuhri ne Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi se, Ubadah bin As-Samit se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: \"Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jo Fatihatul-Kitab na padhe.\" Unhon ne kaha: Aur ye zyada sahih hai. Aur Imam ke peeche padhne ke baare mein zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur Tabi'een ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, wo Imam ke peeche padhne ke qaayal hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger turned (after praying) from a Salat in which he recited aloud and said: 'Has any one of you recite along with me just now?' A man said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Indeed I said to myself: Why was I being contended with for the Quran?'" He (Az-Zuhri one of the narrators) said: "So when they heard that from Allah's Messenger, the people stopped reciting with Allah's Messenger in the prayers that Allah's Messenger recited aloud
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek namaz se lautte jismein unhon ne zor se qiraat ki thi, to unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne abhi mere saath padha?" To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasool Allah." Unhon ne farmaya: "Main keh raha tha, mujhe kya ho gaya ke Quran mujh se cheena ja raha hai." Unhon ne kaha: "To jab logon ne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, unhon ne un namazon mein padhna chhod diya jinmein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) zor se padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Imran bin Husain, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Ibn Ukaimah Al-Laithi ka naam Umarah hai, aur unhen Amr bin Ukaimah bhi kaha jaata hai. Aur Az-Zuhri ke kuch shagirdon ne ye hadith riwayat ki aur ye alfaaz zikr kiye: Az-Zuhri ne kaha: \"To jab logon ne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna, unhon ne padhna chhod diya.\" Aur is hadith mein kuch aisa nahi jo un logon ke khilaf jaata ho jo Imam ke peeche padhna maante hain, kyunki Abu Hurairah hi hain jinhon ne Nabi (SAW) se ye hadith riwayat ki, aur Abu Hurairah ne Nabi (SAW) se ye bhi riwayat ki ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Jo shakhs koi namaz padhe jismein Umm Al-Quran na padhi ho, wo naaqis hai, wo naaqis hai, mukammal nahi hai.\" To hadith ke raawi ne unse kaha: \"Main kabhi kabhi Imam ke peeche hota hoon.\" Unhon ne kaha: \"Ise apne dil mein padho.\" Aur Abu Uthman An-Nahdi ne Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: \"Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main pukaroon ke koi namaz Fatihatul-Kitab ki qiraat ke bagair nahi hoti.\" Aur zyada tar Ashab-e-Hadith ne isi ko chuna ke jab Imam zor se padhe to aadmi na padhe, aur kaha: Wo Imam ki khaamoshiyon ka intezar kare. Aur Imam ke peeche qiraat ke baare mein ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai. Zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ne Imam ke peeche qiraat ko maana hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Main Imam ke peeche padhta hoon aur log bhi padhte hain, siwaye kuch Kufa waalon ke, aur main maanta hoon ke jo na padhe uski namaz jaayez hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Imam ke peeche bhi Fatihatul-Kitab chhodne ke baare mein sakhti ki, unhon ne kaha: Koi namaz Fatihatul-Kitab padhe bagair kaafi nahi, chahe akele ho ya Imam ke peeche. Aur unhon ne Ubadah bin As-Samit ki Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ka sahara liya. Aur Ubadah bin As-Samit ne Nabi (SAW) ke baad Imam ke peeche qiraat ki aur Nabi (SAW) ke qaul ki tashreeh ki. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ishaq, aur doosron ka qaul hai. Lekin Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke qaul \"Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jo Fatihatul-Kitab na padhe\" ka matlab hai jab wo akela ho. Aur unhon ne Jabir bin Abdullah ki hadith se dalil li, jahan unhon ne kaha: Jo shakhs ek rakat padhe jismein Umm Al-Quran na padhi ho, usne namaz nahi padhi siwaye jab wo Imam ke peeche ho. Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: To ye Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se ek aadmi hain jinhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke qaul ki tashreeh ki ke ye jab wo akela ho. Aur Ahmad ne is ke saath Imam ke peeche qiraat karna bhi chuna, aur ye ke aadmi Fatihatul-Kitab na chhode chahe wo Imam ke peeche ho.

e: Abu Nu'aim Wahb bin Kaisan narated that he heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah saying:"Whoever prayed a Rak'ah in which he did not recite Umm Al-Qur'an, then he did not pray except if he was behind an Imam." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Nu'aim Wahb bin Kaisan se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Jabir bin Abdullah ko kehte sunaa: "Jo shakhs ek rakat padhe jismein Umm Al-Quran na padhi ho, usne namaz nahi padhi siwaye jab wo Imam ke peeche ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Fatimah the Great narrated:"When Allah's Messenger entered the Masjid he said Salat and Salam upon Muhammad and then said: (Rabbighfirli dhunubi, waftahli abwaba rahmatik) 'O pardon my sins, and open the gates of Your mercy for me.' And when he exited he said Salat and Salam upon Muhammad, and then said: (Rabbighfirli dunubi, waftahli abwaba rakmatik) 'O Lord pardon my sins, and open the gates of Your blessings for me
hi: Fatimah Al-Kubra ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) masjid mein daakhil hote, to Muhammad par Durood aur Salam padhte aur kehte: 'Rabbighfir Li Dhunubi, waftahli Abwaba Rahmatik' (Ae mere Rab! Mere gunaah maaf kar de, aur mere liye apni rehmat ke darwaze khol de).' Aur jab bahar nikalte, to Muhammad par Durood aur Salam padhte aur kehte: 'Rabbighfir Li Dhunubi, waftahli Abwaba Fadlik' (Ae mere Rab! Mere gunaah maaf kar de, aur mere liye apne fazl ke darwaze khol de)."

e: Ismail bin Ibrahim (a narrator in the chain of Hadith no. 314) said:"I met Abdullah bin al Husain in Makkah, so I asked him about this Hadith, so he narrated it to me, he said: 'When Allah's Messenger entered, he said (Rabbi aftahli abwaba rahmatik) 'O Lord, open the gates of Your mercy for me.' And when he exited he said: (Rabbi iftahli abwaba fadlik) 'O Lord, open the gates of Your blessings for me
hi: Ali bin Hujr ne kaha: Ismail bin Ibrahim ne kaha: "Maine Abdullah bin Al-Hasan se Makkah mein mulaqat ki, to maine unse is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne mujhse bayan ki, unhon ne kaha: Jab wo daakhil hote to kehte: 'Rabbi Iftahli Baba Rahmatik.' Aur jab wo nikalte to kehte: 'Rabbi Iftahli Baba Fadlik.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Fatimah ki hadith hasan hai lekin uska isnad mutasil nahi hai. Aur Fatimah bint Al-Husain ne Fatimah Al-Kubra ko nahi paaya, Fatimah Nabi (SAW) ke baad sirf kuch mahine hi zinda rahi.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you comes to the Masjid, then let him perform two Rak'ah before sitting
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein aaye, to baithne se pehle do rakat padhe." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Umamah, Abu Hurairah, Abu Dharr, aur Ka'b bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Qatadah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Muhammad bin Ajlan aur doosron ne Aamir bin Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se, Malik bin Anas ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki hai. Aur Suhail bin Abi Salih ne ye hadith Aamir bin Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se, Amr bin Sulaim Az-Zuraqi se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur ye hadith mahfooz nahi hai, aur sahih Abu Qatadah ki hadith hai. Aur is hadith par humare asaatiza ke nazdeek amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke jab aadmi masjid mein daakhil ho, to jab tak do rakat na padh le na baithe, siwaye kisi uzr ke. Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Aur Suhail bin Abi Salih ki hadith ghalat hai, mujhe Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne ye Ali bin Al-Madini se bataya.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "All of the earth is a Masjid except for the graveyard and the washroom
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Poori zameen masjid hai siwaye qabristan aur ghusl khaane ke."

e: Uthman bin Affan narrated that :he heard Allah's Messenger say: "Whoever builds a Masjid for (the sake of) Allah, then Allah will build a similar house for him in Paradise
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo shakhs Allah ke liye masjid banaye, Allah uske liye Jannat mein waisa hi ghar banayega.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Bakr, Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdullah bin Amr, Anas, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, Umm Habibah, Abu Dharr, Amr bin Absah, Wathilah bin Al-Asqa, Abu Hurairah, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Uthman ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Mahmud bin Labid ne Nabi (SAW) ka zamana paaya, aur Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi ne Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, jab wo dono chhote Madina ke bachche the.

e: It has been related that :the Prophet said: "Whoever builds a Masjid for (the sake of) Allah, be it small or large, then Allah will build a house for him in Paradise
hi: Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Allah ke liye masjid banaye, chahe chhoti ho ya badi, Allah uske liye Jannat mein ghar banayega." Ye humein Qutaibah ne bataya, humein Nuh bin Qais ne Abdur-Rahman Maula Qais se, Ziyad An-Numairi se, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se isi tarah bataya.

e: Ibn Abbbas narrated:"Allah's Messenger cursed the women who visit the graves, and those who use them as Masajid and put torches on them
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un auraton par la'nat ki jo qabron ki ziyarat karti hain, aur un logon par jo qabron par masjid aur diye banate hain." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye Abu Salih Umm Hani bint Abi Talib ke azaad kiye gulam hain, unka naam Badhan hai, aur Badham bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"We would sleep in the Masjid during the time of Allah's Messenger and we were young men
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein masjid mein sote the, jab hum naujawan the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne masjid mein sone ki ijazat di hai. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Isse raat guzarne ya dopahar aaraam karne ki jagah na banaya jaaye. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Ibn Abbas ka qaul liya hai.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather (Abdullah bin Amr Al-As), that :Allah's Messenger prohibited the recitation of poetry in the Masjid, and from selling and buying in it, and (he prohibited) the people from forming circles in it on Friday before the Salat
hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-As (RA) apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne masjid mein sher sunane, usmein khareed-farokht karne, aur Jumme ke din namaz se pehle logon ke masjid mein halqe banane se mana farmaya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Buraidah, Jabir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-As ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Amr bin Shu'aib, Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-As ke bete hain. Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Maine Ahmad, Ishaq, aur doosron ko Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith se dalil lete dekha hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Shu'aib bin Muhammad ne apne dada Abdullah bin Amr se suna hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur jinhon ne Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith ke baare mein baat ki, unhon ne isse isliye kamzor kaha kyunki wo apne dada ke sahife se riwayat karte hain, goya unhen lagta tha ke unhon ne ye ahadith apne dada se sunee nahi thin. Ali bin Abdullah ne kaha, aur Yahya bin Sa'eed se zikr kiya gaya ke unhon ne kaha: Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith humare nazdeek kamzor hai.
