Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne masjid mein khareed-farokht ko napasand kiya hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een ahl-e-ilm se masjid mein khareed-farokht ki chhoot bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se doosri hadithon mein masjid mein sher sunane ki chhoot bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"A man from Banu Khudrah and a man from Banu Amr bin Awf were disputing about the Masjid that was founded upon Taqwa. The man from Banu Khudrah said: 'It is the Masjid of Allah's Messenger.' The other one said that it was Masjid Qub. So they went to ask Allah's Messenger about that. He said: 'It is this - meaning his Masjid - 'and in that one (Masjid Quba) there is much good
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Banu Khudrah ke ek aadmi aur Banu Amr bin Awf ke ek aadmi ne us masjid ke baare mein bahas ki jo taqwa par bunyaad rakhi gayi thi. Khudri ne kaha: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki masjid hai. Aur doosre ne kaha: Ye Masjid Quba hai. To wo dono Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye is baare mein pucchne. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Ye hai' - yani apni masjid - 'aur usmein bhi bahut khair hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Humein Abu Bakr ne, Ali bin Abdullah se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Yahya bin Sa'eed se Muhammad bin Abi Yahya Al-Aslami ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Unmein koi harj nahi tha, aur unke bhai Unais bin Abi Yahya unse zyada mazboot hain.

e: Abu Al-Abrad the freed slave of Banu Khatmah narrated that he heard Usaid bin Zuhair Al-Ansari - and he was one of the Companions of the Prophet - narrated that :the Prophet said: "The Salat in Masjid Quba is like Umrah
hi: Abu Al-Abrad, Banu Khatmah ke azaad kiye gulam, ne riwayat ki ke unhon ne Usaid bin Zuhair Al-Ansari se sunaa - jo Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se the - wo Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hue kehte the ke unhon ne farmaya: "Masjid Quba mein namaz Umrah ke barabar hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sahl bin Hunaif se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Usaid ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur hum Usaid bin Zuhair ki koi doosri sahih riwayat nahi jaante siwaye is hadith ke, aur hum ise Abu Usamah ki, Abdul-Hamid bin Ja'far se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Abu Al-Abrad ka naam Ziyad hai, wo Madina ke rehne wale hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Salat is this Masjid of mine is better than a thousand Salat in another, except for Masjid Al-Haram
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri is masjid mein ek namaz kisi aur masjid mein hazaar namazon se behtar hai, siwaye Masjid Al-Haram ke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Qutaibah ne apni hadith mein Ubaidullah ka zikr nahi kiya, balki unhon ne Zaid bin Rabah se, Abu Abdullah Al-Agharr se, Abu Hurairah se zikr kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Abdullah Al-Agharr ka naam Salman hai. Aur ye Abu Hurairah se kai tareeqon se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Maimunah, Abu Sa'eed, Jubair bin Mut'im, Ibn Umar, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, aur Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "A mount is not saddled (for a journey) except to three Masajid: Al-Masjid Al-Haram, this Masjid of mine, and Masjid Al-Aqsa." [Abu `Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Safar ke liye sirf teen masjidon ki taraf jaanwar par sawaar hokar jaaya jaaye: Masjid Al-Haram, meri ye masjid, aur Masjid Al-Aqsa." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When the Iqamah is called for Salat do not come to it rushing, rather come to it walking, and while you have tranquility. What you catch of it then pray it, and what you missed of it, then complete it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to daudte hue mat aao, balki chalte hue aao, aur tumpar sukoon rahe. Jo tumhen mil jaaye wo padho, aur jo chhoot jaaye use poora karo." Aur is mauzu par Abu Qatadah, Ubayy bin Ka'b, Abu Sa'eed, Zaid bin Thabit, Jabir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Masjid ki taraf chalne ke baare mein ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai, unmein se kuch ne kaha: Agar pehli Takbir chhoot jaane ka khauf ho, to jaldi karo, yahan tak ke unmein se kisi ke baare mein zikr hai ke wo namaz ki taraf daudte the. Aur unmein se kuch ne jaldi karna napasand kiya aur pasand kiya ke aaram aur wiqar se chala jaaye, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, aur unhon ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith par amal hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Agar pehli Takbir chhoot jaane ka khauf ho, to chalne mein jaldi karne mein koi harj nahi.

e: (Another chain with a similar narration) from Abu Hurairah :[from the Prophet]. And this is more correct than the Hadith of Yazid bin Zurai. (no)
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, Abu Salamah ki riwayat jaisi hi. Isi tarah Abdur-Razzaq ne Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se kaha. Aur ye Yazid bin Zurai ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: (Another chain with a similar narration) from Abu Hurairah, :from the Prophet
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "One of you does not cease to be in Salat as long as he is waiting for it. And the angels do not cease praying for one of you as long as he remains in the Masjid (saying): 'Allah! Forgive him. O Allah! Have mercy upon him' - as long as he does not commit Hadath." A man from Hadramawt said: "And just what is Hadath Abu Hurairah?" He said: "Breaking wind, or passing gas
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi tab tak namaz mein hi rehta hai jab tak wo uska intezar karta hai. Aur farishte tum mein se kisi ke liye dua karte rehte hain jab tak wo masjid mein rehta hai: 'Ya Allah! Ise bakhsh de. Ya Allah! Ispar reham kar' - jab tak wo hadath na kare." To Hadramawt ke ek aadmi ne pucha: "Aur hadath kya hai, Ae Abu Hurairah?" Unhon ne kaha: "Hawa kharij hona." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Sa'eed, Anas, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, aur Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Allah's Messenger performed Salat on a Khumrah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khumrah (chhoti namaz ki chatai) par namaz padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Habibah, Ibn Umar, Umm Sulaim, Aishah, Maimunah, aur Umm Kulthum bint Abi Salamah bin Abdul-Asad (jinhon ne Nabi (SAW) se khud nahi sunaa), aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se khumrah par namaz padhna sabit hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur khumrah ek chhoti chatai hoti hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"The Prophet performed Salat on a Hasir
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek chatai par namaz padhi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Siwaye is ke ke kuch ahl-e-ilm ne zameen par namaz padhna Mustahab samjha. Aur Abu Sufyan ka naam Talhah bin Nafi hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger used to mingle with us such that he said to my younger brother: 'O Abu Umair! What did the Nughair do?'" He (Anas) said: "A Bisat of ours would be sprinkled (with water) to perform Salat on
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare saath mil-julte the, yahan tak ke wo mere chhote bhai se kehte: 'Ae Abu Umair! Nughair (chidiya) ka kya hua?'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur humara ek bisaat chhirak kar tayaar ki gayi, to unhon ne uspar namaz padhi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo bisaat aur tunfusah par namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi maante. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abu At-Tayyah ka naam Yazid bin Humaid hai.

e: Mu'adh ibn Jabal narrated:"The Prophet liked to perform Salat in Al-Hitan
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) baghon mein namaz padhna pasand karte the. Abu Dawud ne kaha: Yani baagat. Abu Isa ne kaha: Mu'adh ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Al-Hasan bin Abi Ja'far ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Al-Hasan bin Abi Ja'far ko Yahya bin Sa'eed aur doosron ne kamzor qarar diya hai. Aur Abu Az-Zubair ka naam Muhammad bin Muslim bin Tadrus hai. Aur Abu At-Tufail ka naam Aamir bin Wathilah hai.

e: Muba bin Talhah narrated from his father (Talhah) that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you placed something like the post (handle) of the camel saddle in front of him, then let him perform Salat and not concern himself with who passes beyond that
hi: Musa bin Talhah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne saamne oont ke pichhle hisse jaisi cheez rakh le, to wo namaz padhe aur us se aage koi guzre iski parwaah na kare." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Sahl bin Abi Hathmah, Ibn Umar, Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani, Abu Juhaifah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Talhah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur unhon ne kaha: Imam ka sutrah uske peeche walon ke liye bhi sutrah hai.

e: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhni sent a message to Abu Juhaim asking him what he had heard from Allah's Messenger about passing in front of a person who was performing Salat. Abu Juhaim said :that Allah's Messenger said: "If the one who passed in front of the person performing Salat knew what he was doing, then for him to stop (and wait for forty) would be better for him than to pass in front of him
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani ne Abu Juhaim ke paas ye pucchne bheja ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne ke baare mein kya suna hai. To Abu Juhaim ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne wale ko maloom ho jaaye ke uspar kya gunaah hai, to chaalis khada rehna uske liye behtar hoga is se ke wo uske saamne se guzare." Abu An-Nadr ne kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom unhon ne chaalis din kaha, chaalis mahine, ya chaalis saal. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Juhaim ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ke liye sau saal khada rehna uske liye behtar hai is se ke wo apne bhai ke saamne se guzare jabke wo namaz padh raha ho." Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarna napasand kiya, lekin ye nahi maana ke isse aadmi ki namaz toot jaati hai. Aur Abu An-Nadr ka naam Salim hai, Umar bin Ubaidullah Al-Madini ke azaad kiye gulam.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"I was a companion rider on a female donkey with Al-Fadl. We came while the Prophet and his Companions were performing Salat at Mina." He said: "We dismounted from it and joined the row. The donkey then passed in front of them, and this did not invalidate their Salat
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Main Al-Fadl ke saath ek gadhi par sawaar tha, humein aana hua jab Nabi (SAW) apne Sahaba ke saath Mina mein namaz padha rahe the." Unhon ne kaha: "To hum gadhi se utre aur saf mein shaamil ho gaye, to gadhi unke saamne se guzri, lekin isse unki namaz nahi toot gayi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Al-Fadl bin Abbas, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Koi bhi cheez namaz nahi todti. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Dharr said that :Allah's Messenger said: "When a man performs Salat, and there is nothing in front of him like the post of a saddle, or a camel saddle, then his Salat is severed by (passing of) a black dog, a woman, and a donkey." It was said to Abu Dharr: "What is the problem with the black dog rather than the red or white one?" He said: "O my nephew! I asked Allah's Messenger just as you have asked me. He said: 'The black dog is a Shaitan (devil)
hi: Abdullah bin As-Samit ne kaha: "Maine Abu Dharr ko kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab aadmi namaz padhe aur uske saamne oont ke pichhle hisse jaisi ya oont ke saddle ke darmiane hisse jaisi koi cheez na ho, to uski namaz kaale kutte, aurat, aur gadhe se toot jaati hai.'" Maine Abu Dharr se kaha: "Kaale ka kya khaas hai laal aur safed se?" To unhon ne kaha: "Ae mere bhatije! Tumne mujhse waisa hi sawaal kiya jaisa maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kaala kutta Shaitan hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari, Abu Hurairah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Dharr ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, unhon ne kaha: Namaz gadha, aurat, aur kaala kutta guzarne se toot jaati hai. Ahmad ne kaha: Jispar mujhe koi shak nahi wo ye hai ke kaala kutta namaz todta hai, lekin gadha aur aurat ke baare mein mujhe kuch shak hai. Ishaq ne kaha: Koi cheez namaz nahi todti siwaye kaale kutte ke.

e: Umar bin Abi Salamah narrated that he saw :Allah's Messenger performing Salat in the house of Umm Salamah wrapped in one garment
hi: Umar bin Abi Salamah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Umm Salamah ke ghar mein ek hi kapde mein lipte hue namaz padhte dekha. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Jabir, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, Anas, Amr bin Abi Usaid, Ubadah bin As-Samit, Abu Sa'eed, Kaisan, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, Umm Hani, Ammar bin Yasir, Talq bin Ali, aur Samit Al-Ansari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar bin Abi Salamah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unke baad ke Tabi'een, aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Ek kapde mein namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Aadmi do kapdon mein namaz padhe.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:"When Allah's Messener arrived in Al-Madinah, he faced Bait Al-Maqdis in Salat for sixteen or seventeen months. Allah's Messenger longed to face the direction of the Ka'bah, so Allah Most High revealed: Verily! We have seen the turning of your face towards the heaven. Surely We shall turn you o a Qiblah that shall please you. So turn your face in the direction of Al-Masjid Al-Haram.So he faced the Ka'bah, and he liked that. A man performed the Asr prayer with him, then passed by some of the Ansar who were bowing in Salat for Asr while facing Bait Al-Maqdis." He told them that he had faced the direction of the Ka'bah, so they changed (their direction) while they were bowing." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Umarah bin Aws, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani and Anas
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye, to unhon ne solah ya satrah mahine tak Bait Al-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) chahte the ke wo Ka'bah ki taraf mun karen. To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: '(Ae Nabi) Hum tumhare chehre ka baar baar aasman ki taraf uthna dekh rahe hain, is liye Hum zaroor tumhen us Qibla ki taraf mod denge jise tum pasand karte ho, is liye apna chehra Masjid Al-Haram ki taraf mod lo.' To unhen Ka'bah ki taraf mod diya gaya, aur wo isse pasand karte the. Ek aadmi ne unke saath Asr padhi, phir wo Ansar ke kuch logon ke paas se guzra jo Asr ki namaz mein rukoo mein the, Bait Al-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke. Usne kaha wo gawahi deta hai ke usne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi hai aur unhen Ka'bah ki taraf mod diya gaya hai." Unhon ne kaha: "To wo rukoo hi mein mud gaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Umarah bin Aws, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne ise Abu Ishaq se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Umar said:"They were bowing during the Subh (Fajr) Prayer
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Wo Subh ki namaz mein rukoo mein the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar ki hadith sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "What is between the east and the west is Qiblah
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan sab Qibla hai."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:(Another chain with a similar narration)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi sanad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Abu Ma'shar ki hifz ke baare mein baat ki hai, unka naam Najih hai, Banu Hashim ke azaad kiye gulam. Muhammad ne kaha: Main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta lekin logon ne unse riwayat ki hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Ja'far Al-Makhrami ki, Uthman bin Muhammad Al-Akhnasi se, Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat Abu Ma'shar ki hadith se zyada mazboot aur sahih hai.

e: (Another chain narrating that) Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "What is between the east and the west is Qiblah
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, ke unhon ne farmaya: "Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan sab Qibla hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abdullah bin Ja'far Al-Makhrami isliye kaha jaata hai kyunki wo Al-Miswar bin Makhramah ki aulad mein se hain. Aur ye Nabi (SAW) ke kai Sahaba se riwayat hui hai, \"Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan sab Qibla hai,\" unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), aur Ibn Abbas shaamil hain. Aur Ibn Umar ne kaha: Jab tum Maghrib ko apni dahini taraf aur Mashriq ko apni baayen taraf karo, to un dono ke darmiyan sab Qibla hai jab tum Qibla ki taraf mun karo. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: \"Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan sab Qibla hai\" - ye Mashriq waalon ke liye hai. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne Marw waalon ke liye baayen taraf jhukna behtar samjha.

e: Abdullah bin Amir bin Rabi'ah narrated from his father who said:"We were with the Prophet on a journey on a very dark night and we did not know the direction of the Qiblah. So each man among us prayed in his own direction. In the morning when we mentioned that to the Prophet, then the following was revealed: So where ever you turn, there is the Face of Allah
hi: Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabi'ah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein andheri raat mein the, humein Qibla ka pata nahi tha, to hum mein se har aadmi ne apni-apni taraf namaz padhi. Jab subah hui, to humne Nabi (SAW) ko iska zikr kiya, to ye nazil hua: '(To jis taraf bhi tum mun karo, wahi Allah ka rukh hai)'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith aisi hai jiska isnad utna mazboot nahi, hum ise Ash'ath As-Samman ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Ash'ath bin Sa'eed Abu Ar-Rabi As-Samman ko hadith mein kamzor qarar diya jaata hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar badal mein kisi ne ghair-Qibla ki taraf namaz padhi, phir namaz padhne ke baad usse pata chala ke usne ghair-Qibla ki taraf namaz padhi thi, to uski namaz jaayez hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet prohibited Salat from being performed in seven places: the dung heap, the slaughtering area, the graveyard, the commonly used road, the wash area, in the area that camels rest at, and above the House of Allah (the Ka'bah)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne saat jagahon par namaz padhne se mana kiya: kooda daalne ki jagah, qasaai khaana, qabristan, aam raste ke beech mein, ghusl khaana, oonton ke aaram karne ki jagah, aur Bait Allah ki chhat ke upar.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:(Another chain with a similar narration)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi sanad se, isi mafhoom mein. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Marthad, Jabir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Marthad ka naam Kannaz bin Husain hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar ki hadith ka isnad utna mazboot nahi hai. Aur Zaid bin Jabirah ki hifz ke baare mein baat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Zaid bin Jubair Al-Kufi is se zyada mazboot aur purana hai, aur unhon ne Ibn Umar se sunaa hai. Aur Laith bin Sa'd ne ye hadith Abdullah bin Umar Al-Umari se, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se isi tarah riwayat ki hai. Aur Dawud ki, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat, Laith bin Sa'd ki riwayat se zyada milti-julti aur sahih hai. Aur Abdullah bin Umar Al-Umari ko kuch ahl-e-hadith ne unki hifz ki wajah se kamzor qarar diya hai, unmein Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan bhi hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Perform Salat in sheep pens but do not perform Salat in the camels' resting area
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bakriyon ke baade mein namaz padho, lekin oonton ke aaram karne ki jagah mein namaz mat padho."

e: (Another chain) from Abu Hurairah, :from the Prophet and it is the same or similar
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi ya milti julti. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir bin Samurah, Al-Bara, Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani, Abdullah bin Mughaffal, Ibn Umar, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur humare asaatiza ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abu Hasin ki, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ghareeb hai. Aur Israil ne Abu Hasin se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se mauqoof riwayat ki, aur ise marfu' nahi kiya. Aur Abu Hasin ka naam Uthman bin Aasim Al-Asadi hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Prophet would perform Salat in sheep pens
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) bakriyon ke baade mein namaz padhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu At-Tayyah Ad-Dubai ka naam Yazid bin Humaid hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Prophet dispatched me for something he needed. I came to him while he was performing Salat on his mount, heading east, he made the prostrations lower than the bowing
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe kisi kaam se bheja, jab main aaya to wo apne sawari par Mashriq ki taraf mun karke namaz padh rahe the, aur unka sajda rukoo se neeche tha." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Ibn Umar, Abu Sa'eed, aur Aamir bin Rabi'ah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye hadith Jabir se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, humein unke darmiyan koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi. Wo namaz mein koi harj nahi maante ke aadmi apni sawari par nafl namaz padhe, chahe uska mun Qibla ki taraf ho ya kisi aur taraf.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet performed Salat towards his she-camel, or his mount, and he would perform Salat while on his mount, whichever direction it was facing
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne apne oont ya apni sawari ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi, aur wo apni sawari par jis bhi taraf wo mudti, namaz padhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai, wo oont ki taraf uska sutrah banakar namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi maante.

e: Anas conveyed that :the Prophet said: "When supper is present and the Iqamah for Salat has been called, then begin with supper
hi: Anas (RA), Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchate hue, riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab khaana hazir ho aur namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to pehle khaana khao." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Umar, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unmein Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain, wo kehte hain: Pehle khaana khaaya jaaye, chahe jamaat ki namaz chhoot jaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Al-Jarud ko kehte suna, maine Waki ko kehte suna is hadith ke baare mein: Pehle khaana khaaya jaaye jab khaane ke kharaab hone ka khauf ho. Aur jo kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne is baare mein kaha hai wo pairvi karne ke zyada qareeb hai, unka maqsad ye tha ke aadmi namaz ke liye khada na ho jabke uska dil kisi cheez mein masroof ho. Aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Hum namaz ke liye khade nahi hote jabke humare dilon mein kuch masroofiyat ho.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:the Prophet said: "When the supper is presented and the Iqamah is called for Salat, then begin with the supper
hi: Aur Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab khaana rakh diya jaaye aur namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to pehle khaana khao." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar khaana khate rahe jabke wo Imam ki qiraat sun rahe the.

e: Aishah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When one of you is sleepy and he is performing Salat, then let him lie down until the sleep is gone from him. For when one of you performs Salat while he is sleepy, perhaps he wants to seek forgiveness but he curses himself
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi neend mein ho aur namaz padh raha ho, to wo let jaaye yahan tak ke neend uspar se chali jaaye, kyunki tum mein se koi jab neend ki halat mein namaz padhta hai, to shayad wo maafi maangne ke liye jaaye aur khud ko hi gaali de baithe." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Atiyyah narrated that :a man among them said: "Malik bin Al-Huwairith came to us in our Musalla to narrate. One day when it was time for Salat, we told him to go ahead (to lead the prayer). He said: 'Let one of you go forward, until I narrate to you why I would not go forward (to lead prayer): I heard Allah's Messenger saying: "Whoever visits a people, then he does not lead them, but a man among them leads them
hi: Abu Atiyyah, unmein se ek aadmi, ne kaha: "Malik bin Al-Huwairith humare musalla mein aate the baat karne, ek din namaz ka waqt hua to humne unse kaha: Aage badho. To unhon ne kaha: Tum mein se koi aage badhe, phir main tumhein bataunga main kyun aage nahi badhta - maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo shakhs kisi qaum ki ziyarat kare, wo unki imamat na kare, balki unmein se koi ek unki imamat kare.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Ghar ka maalik imamat ka ziyarat karne wale se zyada haqdaar hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo ijazat de de, to usse namaz padhwane mein koi harj nahi. Aur Ishaq ne Malik bin Al-Huwairith ki hadith ka qaul liya aur ismein sakhti ki ke koi bhi ghar ke maalik ke saamne namaz na padhaye, chahe ghar ka maalik ijazat de de. Unhon ne kaha: Aur isi tarah masjid mein bhi, agar wo unhen ziyarat kare to unhen masjid mein namaz na padhaye, kehte hain unmein se koi unhein namaz padhaye.

e: Thawban narrated that :the Prophet said: "It is not allowed for a man to look into the interior of a man's house until he has been given permission, for if he looks, then he has entered. And one who leads people (in Salat) should not supplicate for himself alone with the exclusion of his congregation. If he does, then he has betrayed them. And one is not to stand for Salat while he has to urinate
hi: Thawban (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi shakhs ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo kisi doosre ke ghar ke andar dekhe jab tak ke ijazat na le, agar wo dekhe to goya wo daakhil ho gaya. Aur wo kisi qaum ki imamat na kare aur khud ke liye koi khaas dua na kare unhen chhod kar, agar wo aisa kare to usne unke saath khiyanat ki. Aur wo namaz ke liye na khade jab wo peshaab/paakhaana rok raha ho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Thawban ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Mu'awiyah bin Salih se, As-Safr bin Nusair se, Yazid bin Shuraih se, Abu Umamah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ye hadith Yazid bin Shuraih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur goya Yazid bin Shuraih ki, Abu Hayy Al-Mu'adhdhin se, Thawban se riwayat isme sabse achhi isnad wali aur mashhoor hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger cursed three people: A man who leads people (in Salat) while they dislike him, a woman who spends a night while her husband is angry with her, and a man who hears: 'Hayya Alal Falah (come to success)' then does not respond
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teen logon par la'nat ki: wo aadmi jo kisi qaum ki imamat kare jabke wo use napasand karte hon, wo aurat jo raat guzare jabke uska shohar usse naraaz ho, aur wo aadmi jo 'Hayya Alal-Falah' suney phir jawab na de." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Talhah, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith sahih nahi hai, kyunki ye hadith Al-Hasan se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Muhammad bin Al-Qasim ke baare mein Ahmad bin Hanbal ne baat ki aur unhen kamzor qarar diya, wo hafiz nahi hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi kisi qaum ki imamat kare jabke wo use napasand karte hon, lekin agar Imam zaalim na ho, to gunaah sirf usi par hai jo use napasand kare. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Is baare mein agar ek, do, ya teen log napasand karen, to usmein koi harj nahi ke wo unhen namaz padhaye, jab tak zyada tar qaum use napasand na kare.

e: Amr bin Al-Harith Al-Mustaliq said:"It used to be said that the people with the worst punishment [on the Day of Judgment] are two: A woman who disobeyed her husband, and a people's Imam whom they dislike
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith Al-Mustaliq ne kaha: "Kaha jaata tha ke Qayamat ke din sabse shadeed azab do logon ko hoga: wo aurat jisne apne shohar ki nafarmani ki, aur wo qaum ka Imam jise wo napasand karte hon." Hannad ne kaha: Jarir ne kaha: Mansoor ne kaha: To humne Imam ke maamle ke baare mein pucha, to humein bataya gaya ke iska matlab sirf zaalim A'immah hain, lekin jo Sunnat qaayam kare, uspar gunaah sirf usi par hai jo use napasand kare.

e: Abu Umamah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "There are three whose Salat would not rise up beyond their ears: The runaway slave until he returns, a woman who spends a night while her husband is angry with her, and a people's Imam whom they dislike
hi: Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen logon ki namaz unke kaanon se aage nahi jaati: bhaga hua ghulam jab tak wo wapas na aaye, wo aurat jo raat guzare jabke uska shohar usse naraaz ho, aur wo qaum ka Imam jise wo napasand karte hon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai is tareeqe se. Aur Abu Ghalib ka naam Hazawwar hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger fell from a horse and got injured, so he led Salat sitting and we also offered Salat sitting. When he completed the Salat he said: "The Imam is appointed to be followed; when he says the Takbir then say the Takbir, when he bows, then bow, and when he raises his head, then raise your heads. When he says: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah (Allah listens to those who praise him)" then say: "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd. (O our Lord! And all praise is Yours.)" and when he prostrates, then prostrate, and when he performs Salat sitting, then pray sitting altogether
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode se gir gaye aur unhen chot lagi, to unhon ne humein baithe hue namaz padhayi, aur humne bhi unke saath baith kar namaz padhi. Phir wo faariq hue aur farmaya: "Imam sirf isliye banaya jaata hai ke uski pairvi ki jaaye. Jab wo Takbir kahe, to tum bhi Takbir kaho. Jab wo rukoo kare, to rukoo karo. Jab wo sar uthaye, to tum bhi uthao. Jab wo kahe 'Sami' Allahu Liman Hamidah,' to tum kaho 'Rabbana wa Lakal-Hamd.' Jab wo sajda kare, to sajda karo. Aur jab wo baith kar namaz padhe, to sab baith kar namaz padho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Abu Hurairah, Jabir, Ibn Umar, aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Anas ki hadith ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghode se gire aur unhen chot lagi, ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne isi hadith ko apnaya, unmein Jabir bin Abdullah, Usaid bin Hudhair, Abu Hurairah, aur doosre shaamil hain. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar Imam baithe hue namaz padhaye, to uske peeche wale sirf khade hokar hi namaz padhen, aur agar wo baith kar padhen to unki namaz kaafi nahi hogi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger performed Salat behind Abu Bakr, during the illness from which he died, and he was sitting
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ke peeche apni us beemari mein namaz padhi jismein unka intiqaal hua, baithe hue." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab Imam baithe hue namaz padhe, to tum bhi baith kar padho." Aur unse riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) apni beemari mein bahar aaye jabke Abu Bakr logon ki imamat kar rahe the, to unhon ne Abu Bakr ke bagal mein namaz padhi, log Abu Bakr ki pairvi kar rahe the aur Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ki pairvi kar rahe the. Aur unse riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ke peeche baithe hue namaz padhi. Aur Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr ke peeche namaz padhi jabke wo baithe hue the.

e: Anas narrated:"Allah's Messenger performed Salat during his illness behind Abu Bakr while seated, wrapped in a garment
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni beemari mein Abu Bakr ke peeche baithe hue namaz padhi, ek kapde mein lipte hue. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur isi tarah Yahya bin Ayyub ne Humaid se, Thabit se, Anas se riwayat ki. Aur kai doosron ne Humaid se, Anas se riwayat ki hai aur usmein Thabit ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur jisne isme Thabit ka zikr kiya wo zyada sahih hai.

e: Ash-Sha'bi narrated:"Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah led us in Salat, and he continued after the two Rak'ah, so the people said: 'Subhan Allah' and he said: 'Subhan Allah' to them. When he finished his Salat he said the Taslim then performed two prostrations of As-Sahw while he was sitting. Then he narrated to them that Allah's Messenger did the same with them as he had done
hi: Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne humein namaz padhayi, wo do rakat ke baad khade ho gaye, to logon ne 'Subhan Allah' kaha, unhon ne bhi unhen 'Subhan Allah' kaha. Jab unhon ne apni baaki namaz padh li, to Salam kaha, phir baithe hue Sahw ke do sajde kiye." Phir unhon ne unhen bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke saath waisa hi kiya jaisa unhon ne kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uqbah bin Aamir, Sa'd, aur Abdullah bin Buhainah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ki hadith kai tareeqon se, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Ibn Abi Laila ki hifz ke baare mein baat ki hai. Ahmad ne kaha: Ibn Abi Laila ki hadith se dalil nahi li jaati. Aur Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Ibn Abi Laila sachche hain lekin main unse riwayat nahi karta kyunki unhen apni sahih hadith apni kamzor hadith se pehchaanne mein mushkil hoti hai, aur jo bhi aisa ho main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta. Aur ye hadith kai tareeqon se, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se riwayat hui hai. Sufyan ne Jabir se, Al-Mughirah bin Shubail se, Qais bin Abi Hazim se, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se riwayat ki. Aur Jabir Al-Ju'fi ko kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kamzor qarar diya hai, Yahya bin Sa'eed aur Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi aur doosron ne unhen chhod diya. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke jab aadmi do rakat mein khada ho jaaye, to wo apni namaz jaari rakhe aur do sajde kare, unmein se kuch ka maana hai Salam se pehle, aur kuch ka maana hai Salam ke baad. Aur jinka maana hai Salam se pehle, unki hadith zyada sahih hai, jo Az-Zuhri aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ne Abdur-Rahman Al-A'raj se, Abdullah bin Buhainah se riwayat ki.

e: Ziyad bin Haqah narrated:"Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah les us in Salat. When he prayed two Rak'ah he stood without sitting. Those who were behind him said 'Subhan Allah' and he indicated to them that they should stand. He said the Taslim when he had finished his Salat and he performed two prostrations of As-Sahw, and said the Taslim. He said that Allah's Messenger did this
hi: Ziyad bin Alaqah ne kaha: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne humein namaz padhayi. Jab unhon ne do rakat padh li, to wo khade ho gaye aur baithe nahi. Unke peeche walon ne unhein 'Subhan Allah' kaha, to unhon ne unhen ishara kiya ke khade ho jaao. Jab wo apni namaz se faariq hue, to Salam kaha, aur Sahw ke do sajde kiye, aur Salam kaha." Unhon ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kiya.

e: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated from his father (Abdullah bin Mas'ud) that he said:"When Allah's Messenger sat for the first two Rak'ah it was as if he was on hot stones." Shu'bah (one of the narrators) said: "Then Sa'd's lips moved (saying) something. So I said: 'Until he stood?' He said: 'Until he stood
hi: Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah bin Mas'ud apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab pehli do rakaton mein baithte, to goya wo garam patharon par baithe hon." Shu'bah ne kaha: Phir Sa'd ne apne honth kuch hilaye, to maine kaha: 'Yahan tak ke wo khade ho jaayen?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Yahan tak ke wo khade ho jaayen.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, lekin Abu Ubaidah ne apne walid se suna nahi hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi pehli do rakaton mein baithna lamba na kare aur Tashahhud ke alawa kuch aur na zyada kare. Unhon ne kaha: Agar wo Tashahhud se zyada kare, to uspar Sahw ke do sajde hain. Isi tarah Ash-Sha'bi aur doosron se riwayat hai.

e: Suhaib narrated:"I passed by Allah's Messenger (S) while he was performing Salat, so I said greeted him with Salam, and he returned it by making signals." He said: "I do not know except that he said: 'He indicated with his finger
hi: Suhaib (RA) ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se guzra jabke wo namaz padh rahe the, to maine unhen Salam kiya, unhon ne mujhe ishare se jawab diya." Unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe sirf itna maloom hai ke unhon ne kaha: apni ungli se ishara kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Bilal, Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I said to Bilal: 'How did the Prophet (S) reply to them when they gave him Salams and he was performing Salat?' He said: 'He would motion with his hand
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Maine Bilal se pucha: Nabi (SAW) unhen kaise jawab dete the jab wo unhen Salam kehte the jabke wo namaz mein hote the? Unhon ne kaha: Wo apne haath se ishara karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Suhaib ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise Laith ki, Bukair se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Zaid bin Aslam se, Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Bilal se pucha: Nabi (SAW) kya karte the jab wo unhen Banu Amr bin Awf ki masjid mein Salam kehte the? Unhon ne kaha: Wo ishare se jawab dete the. Aur mere nazdeek donon hadithein sahih hain kyunki Suhaib ki hadith ka waaqia Bilal ki hadith ke waaqie se alag hai. Aur agar Ibn Umar ne unn donon se riwayat ki hai, to ye mumkin hai ke unhon ne unn donon se suna ho.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger said: "The Tasbih is for the men and clapping is for the women
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tasbih mardon ke liye hai aur taali bajana auraton ke liye hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Sahl bin Sa'd, Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Jab main Nabi (SAW) se ijazat maangta jabke wo namaz padh rahe hote, wo Tasbih kehte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Yawning in prayer (salah) is from the Shaitan, so when one of you yawns then let him suppress (it) as much as possible
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz mein jamhaai Shaitan ki taraf se hai, is liye jab tum mein se koi jamhaai le, to wo jitna ho sake rok le." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri aur Adiyy bin Thabit ke dada se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne namaz mein jamhaai lena napasand kiya hai. Ibrahim ne kaha: Main jamhaai ko khaansi se rokta hoon.

e: Imran bin Husain narrated:"I asked Allah's Messenger (S) about the Salat for a man who is sitting. He said: 'Whoever performs Salat while standing then that is more virtuous. And whoever performs Salat while sitting, then he gets half the rewards of the one standing, and whoever performs Salat while lying down, then he gets half the rewards of the one sitting
hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se aise aadmi ki namaz ke baare mein pucha jo baith kar padhta hai. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo khade hokar namaz padhe wo behtar hai, aur jo baith kar padhe uske liye khade hone wale ka aadha sawaab hai, aur jo let kar padhe uske liye baithne wale ka aadha sawaab hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Anas, As-Sa'ib, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Imran bin Husain ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: This Hadith has been related from Ibrahim bin Tahman with this chain. Except that he said:"From Imran bin Husain who said: 'I asked Allah's Messenger (S) about Salat for a sick person. He said: "He performs Salat standing, if he is not able then sitting, if he is not able then on his side
hi: Ye hadith Ibrahim bin Tahman se, isi isnad se, bhi riwayat hui hai, siwaye is ke ke wo kehte hain: "Imran bin Husain se, unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bimaar aadmi ki namaz ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: Khade hokar namaz padho, agar taaqat na ho to baith kar, agar wo bhi na ho sake to karwat par.'" Ye humein Hannad ne bataya, humein Waki ne Ibrahim bin Tahman se, Husain Al-Mu'allim se ye hadith bataya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne Husain Al-Mu'allim se Ibrahim bin Tahman ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki ho. Aur Abu Usamah aur kai doosron ne Husain Al-Mu'allim se, Isa bin Yunus ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is hadith ka matlab nafl namaz mein hai. Humein Muhammad bin Bashshar ne bataya, humein Ibn Abi Adiyy ne Ash'ath bin Abdul-Malik se, Al-Hasan se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi chahe to nafl namaz khade hokar, baith kar, ya let kar padhe. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka bimaar aadmi ki namaz ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jab wo baith kar bhi na padh sake. Kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Wo apne dahine paslu par let kar padhe. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo apni peeth ke bal let kar padhe, aur uske paon Qibla ki taraf hon. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne is hadith mein kaha: \"Jo baith kar namaz padhe uske liye khade hone wale ka aadha sawaab hai.\" Unhon ne kaha: Ye tandurust aadmi ke liye hai jise koi uzr na ho, yani nafl namazon mein. Lekin jise beemari ya kisi aur wajah se uzr ho aur wo baith kar padhe, to uske liye khade hone wale jaisa hi sawaab hai. Aur is hadith ke kuch hisson mein Sufyan Ath-Thawri ke qaul jaisi baat riwayat hui hai.

e: Hafsah, the wife of the Prophet (S), narrated:"I did not see Allah's Messenger (S) praying voluntary prayers sitting until the year before he died. Then he would perform Salat for the voluntary prayers sitting, and he would recite a Surah and prolong it such that it would be longer than the longest of them
hi: Hafsah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni nafl namaz baithe hue padhte nahi dekha, yahan tak ke unke wafaat se ek saal pehle tak. Phir wo apni nafl namaz baithe hue padhte the aur Surah padhte hue use itna lamba karte ke wo sabse lambi Surah se bhi lambi ho jaati." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah aur Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hafsah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo raat ko baithe hue namaz padhte, jab unki qiraat mein taqreeban tees ya chaalis Ayaten baaki reh jaatin, to wo khade ho jaate aur padhte, phir rukoo karte, phir doosri rakat mein waisa hi karte. Aur unse riwayat hai ke wo baithe hue namaz padhte, jab wo khade hokar padhte to khade hokar rukoo aur sajda karte, aur jab wo baithe hue padhte to baithe hue rukoo aur sajda karte. Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Aur donon hadithon par amal hai. Goya unhon ne donon hadithon ko sahih maana aur donon par amal kiya.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet (S) would perform Salat while sitting. And he would recite while sitting. When about thirty or forty Ayah of his recitation remained he would standup and recite while he was standing, then he would bow and prostrate. Then he would do the same in the second Rak'ah
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) baithe hue namaz padhte, aur baithe hue padhte, jab unki qiraat mein taqreeban tees ya chaalis Ayaten baaki reh jaatin, to wo khade ho jaate aur khade hokar padhte, phir rukoo karte aur sajda karte, phir doosri rakat mein waisa hi karte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bun Shaqiq narrated from Aishah, he said:"I asked her about the voluntary Salat of Allah's Messenger (S), she said: 'He would pray long into the night standing, and long into the night sitting. So when he recited and he was standing, he would bow and prostrate whole he was standing, and when he recited while he was sitting, he bowed and prostrated while he was sitting
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne Aishah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Maine unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki nafl namaz ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne kaha: Wo raat ko lambe waqt tak khade hokar namaz padhte the aur lambe waqt tak baithe hokar. Jab wo khade hokar padhte to khade hokar rukoo aur sajda karte, aur jab wo baithe hue padhte to baithe hue rukoo aur sajda karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that:Allah's Messenger said: "Indeed I hear the crying of a small boy while I am in Salat, so I shorten it in fear that his mother may be tormented
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam! Main namaz mein hote hue bhi bachche ke rone ki awaaz sunta hoon, to main namaz mukhtasar kar deta hoon is khauf se ke uski maa pareshaan na ho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Qatadah, Abu Sa'eed, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:Allah's Messenger said: "The Salat of a women who has reached the age of menstruation is not accepted without a Khimar
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baaligh aurat ki namaz khimar ke bagair qubool nahi hoti." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. \"Al-Haaidh\" ka matlab hai baaligh aurat, yani jab use haiz aane lage. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar aurat baaligh ho gayi ho aur namaz padhe aur uske baal ka koi hissa khula ho, to uski namaz jaayez nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar aurat ke jism ka koi hissa khula ho to uski namaz jaayez nahi. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur kaha gaya hai ke agar uske paon ka upar wala hissa khula ho, to uski namaz jaayez hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) prohibited As-Sadl in the Salat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz mein sadl se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Juhaifah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hum Abu Hurairah ki hadith, Ata se, marfu' sirf Isl bin Sufyan ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka namaz mein sadl ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne namaz mein sadl ko napasand kiya aur kaha: Yahudi aisa karte hain. Aur kuch ne kaha: Namaz mein sadl sirf tab napasand kiya jaata hai jab uspar sirf ek hi kapda ho, lekin agar wo qamees ke upar sadl kare to koi harj nahi. Aur ye Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne namaz mein sadl ko napasand kiya.

e: Abu Dharr narrated that :the Prophet (S) said: "When one of you stands for Salat then he should not smoothen the pebbles, for indeed it is mercy that he is facing
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada ho, to kankar sidhi na kare, kyunki rehmat uske saamne hoti hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Mu'aiqib, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Hudhaifah, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Dharr ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne namaz mein kankar saaf karna napasand kiya aur farmaya: \"Agar tumhen zaroor karna hi ho, to ek hi baar karo.\" Goya unse ek baar ki ijazat riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Mu'aiqib narrated:"I asked Allah's Messenger (S) about smoothening the pebbles during Salat. He said: 'If you must do so, then let it be only once
hi: Mu'aiqib (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz mein kankar saaf karne ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar tumhen zaroor karna hi ho, to ek hi baar karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"The Prophet (S) saw a boy of ours - called Aflah - blowing when he prostrated. So he said: 'O Aflah! Put your face in the dirt
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne humare ek ghulam bachche ko dekha, jise Aflah kaha jaata tha, jab wo sajda karta to phoonk maarta. To unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Aflah! Apna chehra mitti se lagao.'" Ahmad bin Mani ne kaha: Aur Abbad bin Al-Awwam ne namaz mein phoonk maarna napasand kiya aur kaha: Agar wo phoonke to uski namaz nahi tootegi. Ahmad bin Mani ne kaha: Aur humari yehi raay hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch logon ne Abu Hamzah se ye hadith riwayat ki aur kaha: humara ek ghulam jise Rabah kaha jaata tha.

e: (Another chain) in which Abu Hamzah narrated:"A boy of ours named Rabah
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se Abu Hamzah se, aur unhon ne kaha: humara ek bachcha jise Rabah kaha jaata tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Umm Salamah ki hadith ka isnad utna mazboot nahi. Aur Maimoon Abu Hamzah ko kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kamzor qarar diya hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka namaz mein phoonk maarne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Agar namaz mein phoonk maare to namaz dobara padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Namaz mein phoonk maarna napasand kiya jaata hai, aur agar wo apni namaz mein phoonk maare to uski namaz fasid nahi hoti. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Prophet (S) prohibited than a man to pray with his hands on his hip
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne aadmi ko ikhtisaar se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne namaz mein ikhtisaar ko napasand kiya. Aur kuch ne aadmi ke ikhtisaar karte hue chalne ko bhi napasand kiya. Aur ikhtisaar ka matlab hai ke aadmi namaz mein apna haath apni kamar par rakhe ya donon haath apni donon kamar par rakhe. Aur riwayat hai ke Iblees jab chalta hai to ikhtisaar karte hue chalta hai.

e: Abu Rafi narrated that :He passed by Al-Hasan bin Ali while he was performing Salat and he had gathered his locks at the back of his head, so he (Abu Rafi) undid them, and Al-Hasan turned to him angrily. He said: "Resume your Salat and do not be angry, for indeed I heard Allah's Messenger (S) saying: 'That is the seat of Ash-Shaitan
hi: Abu Rafi (RA) se riwayat hai ke wo Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas se guzre jabke wo namaz padh rahe the aur unhon ne apni chotiyan apni gardan ke peeche baandh rakhi thin, to unhon ne unhen khol diya. Al-Hasan ne gusse se unki taraf dekha, to unhon ne kaha: "Apni namaz par tawajjuh do aur gussa mat karo, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Ye Shaitan ki baithne ki jagah hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Salamah aur Abdullah bin Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Rafi ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi namaz mein apne baal baandh kar padhe. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Imran bin Musa Al-Qurashi Al-Makki hain, Ayyub bin Musa ke bhai.

e: Al-Fadl bin Al-`Abbas narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "As-Salat is two and two, with a Tashahhud for every two Rak`ah, with humility, imploring, having a sense of tranquility, pleading and showing helplessness and stretching out your hand" - he said: raising them - "to your Lord, with the insides of them facing your face, saying: 'O Lord! O Lord! And whoever does not do this, then it is like this or that
hi: Al-Fadl bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz do-do rakat hai, har do rakat mein Tashahhud kaho, aur khushu, iltija, aajizi, aur begaanagi dikhao, aur apne haath uthao" - unhon ne kaha: yani unhen apne Rab ki taraf uthao, unki hatheliyan apne chehre ki taraf rakhte hue - "aur kaho: 'Ya Rab! Ya Rab!' Aur jo aisa na kare wo aisa aisa hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ke alawa doosron ne is hadith mein kaha: \"Jo aisa na kare uski namaz naqis hai.\" Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abdu Rabbihi bin Sa'eed se riwayat ki lekin kai jagah ghalti ki, unhon ne \"Anas bin Abi Anas\" kaha jabke wo Imran bin Abi Anas hain, aur unhon ne \"Abdullah bin Al-Harith\" kaha jabke wo Abdullah bin Nafi ibn Al-Amyaa hain, Rabi'ah bin Al-Harith se. Aur Shu'bah ne \"Abdullah bin Al-Harith se, Al-Muttalib se, Nabi (SAW) se\" kaha, jabke ye Rabi'ah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul-Muttalib se, Al-Fadl bin Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Laith bin Sa'd ki hadith Shu'bah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Ka'b bun Ujrah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "When one of you performs Wudu and does so well, then he leaves intending to go to the Masjid, then let him not intertwine his fingers, for indeed he is in Salat
hi: Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi wuzu kare aur ache tareeke se wuzu kare, phir masjid ki taraf jaane ke irade se nikle, to wo apni ungliyan ek doosre mein na uljhaye, kyunki wo namaz mein hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ka'b bin Ujrah ki hadith kai logon ne, Ibn Ajlan se, Laith ki hadith jaisi hi riwayat ki hai. Aur Sharik ne Muhammad bin Ajlan se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi hadith riwayat ki hai, aur Sharik ki riwayat mahfooz nahi hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"It was said to the Prophet (S): 'Which Salat is most virtuous?' He said: 'That with the longest Qunut
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: 'Kaun si namaz sabse afzal hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Lambe Qunut waali.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Hubshi aur Anas bin Malik se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Abdullah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Jabir bin Abdullah se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai.

e: Ma'dan bin Talhah Al Yamari said:"I met Thawban the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (S) and said to him, 'Guide me to a deed by which Allah benefit me, and for which Allah will admit me into Paradise.' He was silent for quite a while, then he turned to me and said: 'Perform prostrations, for I heard Allah's Messenger (S) saying: 'No worshipper performs a prostration to Allah except that by it, Allah will raise him a level, and erase a sin from him for it
hi: Ma'dan bin Talhah Al-Ya'mari ne kaha: "Maine Thawban, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam, se mulaqat ki aur unse kaha: 'Mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jisse Allah mujhe faida pahunchaye aur mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare.' To wo kuch der khaamosh rahe, phir mujhse mudke kaha: 'Sajde karte raho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Koi banda Allah ke liye ek sajda nahi karta magar Allah usse ek darja buland kar deta hai aur ek gunaah mita deta hai.'"

e: Madan [bin Talhah] said:"I met Abu Ad-Darda, and I asked him what I had asked Thawban, so he said: 'Perform prostrations, for I heard Allah's Messenger saying: 'No worshipper performs a prostration to Allah except that by it Allah will raise him a level, and erase a sin from him for it
hi: Ma'dan bin Talhah ne kaha: "Phir main Abu Ad-Darda se mila aur unse wahi pucha jo maine Thawban se pucha tha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Sajde karte raho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Koi banda Allah ke liye ek sajda nahi karta magar Allah usse ek darja buland kar deta hai aur ek gunaah mita deta hai.'" Ma'dan bin Talhah Al-Ya'mari, unhen Ibn Abi Talhah bhi kaha jaata hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abu Umamah, aur Abu Fatimah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Thawban aur Abu Ad-Darda ki hadith rukoo aur sajda ki katharat ke baare mein hasan sahih hai. Aur is mauzu mein ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Namaz mein lamba khade rehna rukoo-sajda ki katharat se afzal hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Rukoo-sajda ki katharat lamba khade rehne se afzal hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Is baare mein Nabi (SAW) se do hadithein riwayat hui hain, aur unhon ne isme koi faisla nahi diya. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Din mein rukoo-sajda ki katharat behtar hai, aur raat mein lamba khada hona behtar hai, siwaye jab kisi aadmi ka raat ka koi khaas hissa ho jise wo poora karta ho, to us waqt rukoo-sajda ki katharat mujhe zyada pasand hai kyunki wo apna hissa bhi poora kar leta hai aur rukoo-sajda ki katharat ka faida bhi le leta hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ishaq ne isliye ye kaha kyunki Nabi (SAW) ki raat ki namaz mein lamba khada hona bataya gaya hai, aur din mein unki namaz mein utna lamba khada hona nahi bataya gaya jitna raat mein bataya gaya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) ordered killing the two black things in Salat; the snake and the scorpion
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz mein do kaali cheezon - saanp aur bicchhu - ko maarne ka hukum diya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne namaz mein saanp aur bicchhu maarna napasand kiya. Aur Ibrahim ne kaha: Namaz mein masroofiyat kaafi hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Buhainah Al-Asdi the ally of Banu Abdul-Muttalib narrated:"The Prophet (S) stood for the Zuhr prayer, and he had a sitting to perform, so when he completed his Salat, he performed two prostrations, saying the Takbir for each prostration. So he was sitting before saying the Salam, and the people prostrated with him in place of the sitting he forgot."
hi: Abdullah bin Buhainah Al-Asdi (RA), Banu Abdul-Muttalib ke halif, se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Zuhr ki namaz mein khade ho gaye jabke unhen baithna tha, jab unhon ne apni namaz mukammal ki, to unhon ne do sajde kiye, har sajde mein Takbir kehte hue, baithe hue, Salam se pehle, aur log bhi unke saath sajde mein gaye us baithne ki jagah jise wo bhool gaye the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abdullah bin Masud narrated:"The Prophet (S) prayed five (Rakah) for Zuhr, so it was said to him: 'Has the prayer been added to, or have you merely forgotten?' So he (S) performed two prostrations after he had said the Salam
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Zuhr paanch rakat padh di. Unse pucha gaya: "Kya namaz mein izafa ho gaya?" To unhon ne Salam ke baad do sajde kiye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah (bin Masud) narrated:"The Prophet (S) performed two prostrations for As-Sahw after talking
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Sahw ke do sajde baat karne ke baad kiye. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Muawiyah, Abdullah bin Ja'far, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Prophet (S) performed two prostrations after the Salam
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne inhen Salam ke baad kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ayyub aur kai doosron ne Ibn Sireen se ye riwayat ki hai. Aur Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi Zuhr paanch rakat padh le, to uski namaz jaayez hai aur wo Sahw ke do sajde kare, chahe wo chauthi rakat mein na baitha ho. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo Zuhr paanch rakat padhe aur chauthi rakat mein Tashahhud jitni der na baithe, to uski namaz fasid ho jaati hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kuch Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Al-Muhallab narrated from Imran bin Husain that :the Prophet (S) led them in Salat he forgot (something) so he performed two prostrations, then the Tashah-hud, then the Salam
hi: Abu Al-Muhallab ne Imran bin Husain se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhen namaz padhayi, unse bhool hui, to unhon ne do sajde kiye, phir Tashahhud padha, phir Salam kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Muhammad bin Sireen ne Abu Al-Muhallab se, jo Abu Qilabah ke chacha hain, is hadith ke siwaye bhi riwayat ki hai. Aur Muhammad ne ye hadith Khalid Al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu Al-Muhallab se riwayat ki. Aur Abu Al-Muhallab ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Amr hai, unhen Muawiyah bin Amr bhi kaha jaata hai. Aur Abdul-Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi, Hushaim, aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Khalid Al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se, poori tarah riwayat ki hai, aur ye Imran bin Husain ki hadith hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Asr ki teen rakaton mein Salam kaha, to Al-Khirbaq naam ka aadmi khada hua. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Sahw ke do sajdon mein Tashahhud ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Unmein Tashahhud aur Salam karen. Aur kuch ne kaha: Unmein Tashahhud aur Salam nahi, aur agar Salam se pehle sajde karen to Tashahhud na karen. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar wo Salam se pehle Sahw ke do sajde kare, to Tashahhud na kare.

e: Iyad bin Hilal said:"I said to Abu Sa'eed: 'One of us performs Salat and we do not know how (much) we prayed.' So he said: 'Allah's Messenger (S) said: "When one of you performs Salat and he does now know how (much) he prayed then let him perform two prostrations while he is sitting
hi: Iyaad bin Hilal ne kaha: "Maine Abu Sa'eed se kaha: 'Hum mein se koi namaz padhta hai lekin use maloom nahi ke usne kaise padhi.' To unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe aur use maloom na ho ke usne kaise padhi, to wo baithe hue do sajde kare.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uthman, Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Sa'eed se doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Jab tum mein se koi ek ya do ke baare mein shak kare, to unhen ek maan le, aur jab do ya teen ke baare mein shak kare, to unhen do maan le, aur usmein Salam se pehle do sajde kare.\" Aur humare asaatiza ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar apni namaz mein shak kare aur use maloom na ho usne kitni padhi, to wo dobara padhe.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Indeed the Shaitan comes to one of you in his Salat confusing him until he does now know how much he has prayed. When one of you experiences that then let him perform two prostrations while sitting
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Shaitan tum mein se kisi ke paas uski namaz mein aata hai aur usse uljha deta hai yahan tak ke use maloom nahi rehta usne kitni namaz padhi, to jab tum mein se koi aisa mehsoos kare, to wo baithe hue do sajde kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bi Awf narrated that he heard the Prophet (S) saying:"When one of you becomes forgetful in his Salat so that he does not know if he prayed one or two, then let him consider it one. When he does not know if he prayed three or four, then let him consider it three, and let him perform two prostrations before he says the Taslim
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Awf (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jab tum mein se koi apni namaz mein bhool jaaye aur use maloom na ho usne ek padhi ya do, to wo ek maan le. Agar use maloom na ho ke usne do padhi ya teen, to wo do maan le. Agar use maloom na ho ke usne teen padhi ya chaar, to wo teen maan le, aur Salam se pehle do sajde kare.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Prophet (S) turned (finished the prayer) after two (Rak'ah), so Dhul-Yadain said: 'Has the prayer been shortened or have you forgotten O Messenger of Allah?" The Prophet (S) said: 'Is what Dhul-Yadain said the truth?' The people said yes, so Allah's Messenger (S) stood to perform the last two (Rakah) of Salat, then he said the Taslim. Then he said the Takbir and prostrated in a manner the same or longer than his (normal) prostrations
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) do rakaton ke baad faariq hue, to Dhul-Yadain ne unse kaha: "Kya namaz kam kar di gayi hai ya aap bhool gaye, Ya Rasool Allah?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya Dhul-Yadain sach keh rahe hain?" Logon ne kaha: "Haan." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur do aur rakat padhi, phir Salam kaha, phir Takbir kahi aur sajda kiya apne aam sajde jitna ya usse lamba, phir Takbir kahi aur uthe, phir sajda kiya apne aam sajde jitna ya usse lamba. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain, Ibn Umar, aur Dhul-Yadain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is hadith ke baare mein ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai, kuch Kufa waalon ne kaha: Agar namaz mein bhool kar ya na jaante hue baat ki jaaye, ya kaise bhi, to namaz dobara padhi jaaye, aur unka daleel ye hai ke ye hadith namaz mein baat karna haraam hone se pehle ki hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne isse sahih hadith maana aur isi ke qaayal ho gaye, unhon ne kaha: Ye us hadith se zyada sahih hai jo Nabi (SAW) se roze daar ke baare mein riwayat hui hai jo bhool kar khaana kha le, ke usse qaza nahi karni, ye to sirf Allah ka diya rizq hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur unhon ne roza daar ke khaane mein Abu Hurairah ki hadith se, iraadatan aur bhool ke darmiyan farq kiya. Aur Ahmad ne Abu Hurairah ki hadith mein kaha: Agar Imam apni namaz mein kuch baat kare jabke wo maanta ho ke usne namaz mukammal kar li hai, phir use pata chale ke usne mukammal nahi ki, to wo apni namaz poori kare. Aur jo Imam ke peeche baat kare jabke usse pata ho ke namaz baaki hai, to uspar farz hai ke wo namaz dobara shuru kare. Aur unhon ne dalil di ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein farz namazon mein zyada-kami hoti thi, is liye Dhul-Yadain ne baat ki jabke unhen yaqeen tha ke unki namaz mukammal ho gayi hai, aur aaj aisa nahi hai, aaj kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo Dhul-Yadain ki baat ke matlab par baat kare kyunki aaj farz namazon mein na zyada hoti hai na kami. Ahmad ne isi tarah ki baat ki. Aur Ishaq ne bhi Ahmad ke qaul jaisi baat is mauzu par kahi.

e: Sa'eed bin Yazid Abu Maslamah said:"I said to Anas bin Malik: 'Would Allah's Messenger (S) perform Salat wearing his sandals?' He said: 'Yes
hi: Sa'eed bin Yazid Abu Maslamah ne kaha: "Maine Anas bin Malik se pucha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne jute pehen kar namaz padhte the?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abdullah bin Abi Habibah, Abdullah bin Amr, Amr bin Hurayth, Shaddad bin Aws, Aws Ath-Thaqafi, Abu Hurairah, aur Ata (Banu Shaibah ka ek aadmi) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:"The Prophet (S) would perform the Qunut in the Subh and Maghrib prayers
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Subh aur Maghrib ki namaz mein Qunut karte the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Anas, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, aur Khufaf bin Ima bin Rahdah Al-Ghifari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Fajr ki namaz mein Qunut ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne Fajr mein Qunut ko maana hai, aur ye Malik aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Fajr mein Qunut sirf tab hai jab Musalmanon par koi museebat aaye, to jab museebat aaye, Imam Musalmanon ke lashkaron ke liye dua kar sakta hai.

e: Abu Malik Al-Ashjai narrated:"I said to my father: 'O my father! You offered Salat behind Allah's Messenger (S), Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali bin Abi Talib here in Al-Kufah for about five years. Did they say the Qunut?' He said: 'It is a newly invented matter my son
hi: Abu Malik Al-Ashja'i ne kaha: "Maine apne walid se kaha: Ae mere waalid! Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke peeche yahan Kufa mein taqreeban paanch saal namaz padhi, kya wo Qunut karte the? Unhon ne kaha: Ae mere bete! Ye nayi baat hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Agar Fajr mein Qunut kare to acha hai, aur agar na kare to bhi acha hai. Aur unhon ne Qunut na karna pasand kiya. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne Fajr mein Qunut ko na maana. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Malik Al-Ashja'i ka naam Sa'd bin Tariq bin Ashyam hai.

e: There is another narration from Abu Malik:There exists another narration from Abu Malik with similar meaning but with different chain
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se Abu Malik Al-Ashja'i se, isi mafhoom mein.

e: Muadh bin Rifa'ah narrated that his father said:"I prayed behind Allah's Messenger (S). I sneezed and said: Al-Hamdulillah, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, mubarakan alaihi kama yuhibbu Rabbana Wa Yarda (All praise is due to Alah, many good blessed praises, blessings for Him as our Lord loves and is pleased with.) When Allah's Messenger (S) prayed and turned (after finishing) he said: 'Who was the speaker during the Salat?' No one spoke. Then he said it a second time: 'Who was the speaker during the Salat?' But no one spoke. Then he said it a third time: 'Who was the speaker during the Salat?'" So Rifa'ah bin Rafi bin Afra said: "It was I, O Messenger of Allah (S)." He said: "What did you say?" He said: "I said: 'Al-Hamdulillah, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, mubarakan alaihi kama yuhibbu Rabbana Wa Yarda. The Prophet (S) said: "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! I saw thirty-some angels competing over which of then would ascend with it
hi: Mu'adh bin Rifa'ah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz padhi. Mujhe chheenk aayi, to maine kaha: 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Hamdan Kathiran Tayyiban Mubarakan Fihi, Mubarakan Alaihi, Kama Yuhibbu Rabbuna wa Yarda' (Allah ki tareef hai, bahut zyada, paak, mubarak, jaisa humara Rab pasand karta hai aur raazi hota hai)." Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padh li aur laute, to unhon ne farmaya: "Namaz mein kisne baat ki?" Kisi ne baat nahi ki. Phir unhon ne dobara kaha: "Namaz mein kisne baat ki?" Kisi ne baat nahi ki. Phir unhon ne teesri baar kaha: "Namaz mein kisne baat ki?" To Rifa'ah bin Rafi bin Afra ne kaha: "Maine, Ya Rasool Allah." Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumne kya kaha?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Al-Hamdu Lillahi Hamdan Kathiran Tayyiban Mubarakan Fihi, Mubarakan Alaihi, Kama Yuhibbu Rabbuna wa Yarda.'" To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, teen se zyada Farishte iski taraf jaldi lapke, kaun isse le jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Wa'il bin Hujr, aur Aamir bin Rabi'ah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Rifa'ah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek ye hadith nafl namaz ke baare mein hai, kyunki kai Tabi'een ne kaha: Agar aadmi ko farz namaz mein chheenk aaye, to wo sirf apne dil mein Allah ki tareef kare, aur unhon ne isse zyada gunjaish nahi di.

e: Zaid bin Arqam narrated:"We used to talk behind Allah's Messenger (S) during the Salat, a man among us would talk to his companions next to him until (the following) was revealed: And stand before Allah with obedience. (2:238) So we were ordered to be silent and prohibited from talking
hi: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche namaz mein baat karte the, hum mein se koi apne saathi se apne bagal mein baat karta, yahan tak ke ye nazil hua: '(Aur Allah ke saamne farmabardaari se khade ho)'. To humein khaamosh rehne ka hukum diya gaya aur baat karne se mana kiya gaya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud aur Muawiyah bin Al-Hakam se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Arqam ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi namaz mein iraadatan ya bhool kar baat kare, to wo namaz dobara padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo iraadatan baat kare to namaz dobara padhe, lekin agar bhool kar ya na jaante hue kare to kaafi hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Asma bin Al-Hakam Al-Fazari said:"I heard Ali saying: 'Indeed I am a man who, when I heard a Hadith from Allah's Messenger (S) then Allah causes me to benefit from it as much as He wills for me to benefit from it. When a man among his Companions narrated to me I ask him to swear an oath to me about it, and when he swears an oath to me I trust him. And Abu Bakr narrated to me - and Abu Bakr told the truth - he said: "I heard Allah's Messenger (S) saying: 'There is no man who commits a sin, then makes Wudu, then performs Salat, then seeks forgiveness from Allah, except that Allah forgives him.' Then he recited this Ayah: Those who when they have committed Fahishah or wronged themselves with eveil, remember Allah. (3:135) until the end of the Ayah
hi: Asma bin Al-Hakam Al-Fazari ne kaha: "Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna: 'Main aisa aadmi tha ke jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi hadith sunta, to Allah mujhe usse jitna chaahta faida pahunchata. Aur jab unke Sahaba mein se koi aadmi mujhe koi hadith sunata, to main use qasam dilata, aur jab wo mujhse qasam khaata to main uski tasdeeq karta. Aur Abu Bakr ne mujhse ye hadith bayan ki, aur Abu Bakr ne sach kaha - unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Koi aadmi gunaah nahi karta, phir uth kar wuzu karta hai, phir namaz padhta hai, phir Allah se maafi maangta hai, magar Allah use maaf kar deta hai.'" Phir unhon ne ye Ayat padhi: '(Aur jo log jab koi bahaya kaam karen ya khud par zulm karen, Allah ko yaad karte hain aur apne gunahon ki maafi maangte hain)'. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Ad-Darda, Anas, Abu Umamah, Mu'adh, Wathilah, aur Abu Al-Yasar (jinka naam Ka'b bin Amr hai) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise Uthman bin Al-Mughirah ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Shu'bah aur kai doosron ne unse riwayat ki aur ise marfu' kiya, Abu Awanah ki hadith jaisi. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Mis'ar ne ise mauqoof riwayat kiya, aur Nabi (SAW) tak marfu' nahi kiya. Aur ye hadith Mis'ar se marfu' bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur hum Asma bin Al-Hakam ki koi doosri marfu' hadith is ke siwaye nahi jaante.

e: (Sabrah bin Ma'bad al-Juhni) narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Teach the boy Salat when he is seven years old, and beat him (if he does not pray) when he is ten
hi: Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani (RA) ke dada se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bachche ko namaz sikhao jab wo saat saal ka ho, aur agar wo namaz na padhe to use maaro jab wo das saal ka ho jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sabrah bin Ma'bad Al-Juhani ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unhon ne kaha: Jo namaz bachcha das saal ke baad chhode wo use dobara padhe. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sabrah, Ibn Ma'bad Al-Juhani hain, unhen Ibn Awsajah bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "When he commits Hadath - meaning a man - and he is sitting in the end of his Salat before saying the Taslim, then his Salat is acceptable
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab wo hadath kare - yani aadmi - aur wo apni namaz ke aakhir mein Salam se pehle baitha ho, to uski namaz jaayez hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad utna mazboot nahi hai, aur log iske isnad mein ikhtilaaf mein rahe hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko liya hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar wo Tashahhud jitni der baithe aur Salam se pehle hadath kare, to uski namaz mukammal ho gayi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo Tashahhud se pehle aur Salam se pehle hadath kare, to wo namaz dobara padhe. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Agar usne Tashahhud na padha ho aur Salam kar diya ho, to ye kaafi hai, Nabi (SAW) ke qaul \"Uski tahleel Taslim hai\" ki wajah se, aur Tashahhud kam ahmiyat wala hai - Nabi (SAW) do rakaton mein khade ho gaye the aur apni namaz jaari rakhi aur Tashahhud nahi kiya. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Agar usne Tashahhud kiya ho aur Salam na kiya ho, to ye kaafi hai. Aur unhon ne Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith se dalil li jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhen Tashahhud sikhaya aur farmaya: \"Jab tum isse faariq ho jao, to tumne apna zimma poora kar liya.\" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Ziyad bin An'um, Al-Ifriqi hain, aur kuch ahl-e-hadith ne unhen kamzor qarar diya hai, unmein Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan aur Ahmad bin Hanbal shaamil hain.

e: Jabir narrated:"We were with the Prophet (S) on a journey when it started to rain on us, so the Prophet (S) said: 'Whoever wishes, let him perform Salat in his place
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, humein baarish ne pakad liya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo chahe apni jagah par namaz padh le.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Samurah, Abu Al-Malih apne walid se, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne baarish aur keechad mein jamaat aur Jumme ki namaz mein na aane ki rukhsat di hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Abu Zur'ah ko kehte suna: Affan bin Muslim ne Amr bin Ali se ek hadith riwayat ki. Aur Abu Zur'ah ne kaha: Humne Basra mein in teen se zyada hafiz kisi ko nahi dekha: Ali bin Al-Madini, Ibn Ash-Shadhkuni, aur Amr bin Ali. Aur Abu Al-Malih ka naam Aamir hai, aur unhen Zaid bin Usamah bin Umair Al-Hudhali bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Some of the poor people came to Allah's Messenger (S) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (S)! The rich pray as we pray, they fast as we fast, but they have wealth with which they free slaves and which they give in charity.' He said: 'When you perform Salat, then say: 'Subhan Allah' thirty-three times, and: 'Al-Hamdulillah' thirty-three times, and: 'Allahu Akbar' thirty-four times, and 'La ilaha illallah' ten times. With that you will have surprassed them, and none would surpass you afterwards
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Gareeb log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Ameer log humari tarah namaz padhte hain aur humari tarah roza rakhte hain, lekin unke paas maal hai jisse wo ghulam azaad karte hain aur sadqa dete hain.'
