Unhon ne farmaya: 'To jab tum namaz padho, to teentees baar Subhan Allah kaho, teentees baar Al-Hamdu Lillah kaho, chauntees baar Allahu Akbar kaho, aur das baar La Ilaha Illallah kaho, isse tum apne se aage nikal gayon ko paa loge, aur tumhare baad koi tumse aage nahi nikalega.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ka'b bin Ujrah, Anas, Abdullah bin Amr, Zaid bin Thabit, Abu Ad-Darda, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Al-Mughirah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Do khasletein hain jinhen koi Musalman shakhs shumaar kare magar Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaye: har namaz ke baad Allah ki das baar tasbih kare, das baar tareef kare, das baar takbir kare, aur apne sone ke waqt tetees baar Allah ki tasbih kare, tetees baar tareef kare, aur chauntees baar takbir kare.\"

e: Amr bin Uthman bin Ya'la bin Murrah narrated from his father, from his grand-father that :They were with the Prophet (S) on a journey. They wound up in a narrow area when Salat became due. Then it began raining from the sky above them, and it was wet beneath them. So Allah's Messenger (S) called the Adhan while he was on his mount, and then the Iqamah, going forward on his mount. He let them in Salat by making gestures, making his prostrations lower than his bowing
hi: Amr bin Uthman bin Ya'la bin Murrah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, wo ek tang jagah pahunche jabke namaz ka waqt ho gaya. Unhen upar se baarish aur neeche se geelapan ka saamna tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni sawari par azaan di aur iqaamat di - ya iqaamat di - phir apni sawari par aage badhe aur unhen ishare se namaz padhayi, apna sajda rukoo se neecha karte hue. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, sirf Umar bin Ar-Rammah Al-Balkhi ne isse riwayat ki hai, aur hum ise sirf unki hadith se hi jaante hain. Aur unse kai ahl-e-ilm ne riwayat ki hai. Aur isi tarah Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke unhon ne apni sawari par paani aur keechad mein namaz padhi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) performed Salat until his feet were swollen, so it was said to him: 'You burden yourself like this, while your past and future sins have been forgiven?' He said: 'Shouldn't I be a grateful worshipper?
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni namaz padhte ke unke paon soojh jaate. To unse kaha gaya: 'Kya aap apne aap ko itni takleef dete hain jabke Allah ne aapke pichhle aur agle sab gunaah maaf kar diye hain?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya main shukr guzar banda na banoon?'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Huraith bin Qabisah narrated:"I arrived in Al-Madinah and said: 'O Allah! Facilitate me to be in a righteous gathering.'" He said: "I sat with Abu Hurairah and said: 'Indeed I asked Allah to provide me with a righteous gathering. So narrate a hadith to me which you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that perhaps Allah would cause me to benefit from it.' He said: 'I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: "Indeed the first deed by which a servant will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection is his Salat. If it is complete, he is successful and saved, but if it is defective, he has failed and lost. So if something is deficient in his obligatory (prayers) then the Lord, Mighty and Sublime says: 'Look! Are there any voluntary (prayers) for my worshipper?' So with them, what was deficient in his obligatory (prayers) will be completed. Then the rest of his deeds will be treated like that
hi: Huraith bin Qabisah ne kaha: "Main Madina aaya aur maine kaha: 'Ya Allah! Mujhe koi neik saathi mila de.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To main Abu Hurairah ke paas baitha aur maine kaha: 'Maine Allah se dua ki hai ke wo mujhe neik saathi de, to aap mujhe koi hadith sunaiye jo aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunee ho, shayad Allah usse mujhe faida pahunchaye.'" To unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Qayamat ke din banda ke amal mein sabse pehle jiska hisaab liya jaayega wo uski namaz hai. Agar wo theek hui, to wo kamyaab aur safal ho gaya, aur agar wo bigdi hui, to wo naakaam aur ghaate mein raha. Agar uski farz namaz mein koi kami reh jaaye, to Rab Azza wa Jall farmaayega: Dekho mere bande ke paas koi nafl hai ke nahi, to us se uski farz namaz ki kami poori ki jaaye. Phir uske baaki sab amal isi tarah honge.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Tamim Ad-Dari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Hurairah se doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Al-Hasan ke kuch shagirdon ne Al-Hasan se, Qabisah bin Huraith se, is hadith ke siwaye bhi riwayat ki hai. Aur mashhoor naam Qabisah bin Huraith hai. Aur Anas bin Hakim se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Aishah narrated that Allah's Messenger (S) said:"Whoever is regular with twelve Rak'ah of Sunnah (prayer), Allah will build a house for him in Paradise: Four Rak'ah before Zuhr, two Rak'ah after it, two Rak'ah after Maghrib, two Rak'ah after Isha, and two Rak'ah before Fajr
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Sunnat ki baarah rakaton par paabandi kare, Allah uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banayega: Zuhr se pehle chaar rakat, uske baad do rakat, Maghrib ke baad do rakat, Isha ke baad do rakat, aur Fajr se pehle do rakat." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Habibah, Abu Hurairah, Abu Musa, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur Mughirah bin Ziyad ke baare mein kuch ahl-e-ilm ne unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki hai.

e: Umm Habibah narrated that Allah's Messenger (S) sad:"Whoever prays twelve Rak'ah in a day and night, a house will be built from him in Paradise: Four Rak'ah before Zuhr, two Rak'ah after it, two Rak'ah after Maghrib, two Rak'ah after Isha, and two Rak'ah before Fajr in the morning Salat
hi: Umm Habibah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs din aur raat mein baarah rakat namaz padhe, uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaya jaayega: Zuhr se pehle chaar, uske baad do, Maghrib ke baad do, Isha ke baad do, aur Fajr ki namaz se pehle do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Anbasah ki, Umm Habibah se, is mauzu par riwayat hasan sahih hai, aur ye Anbasah se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai.

e: Aishah narrated that :Allah's Messenger (S) said: "The two Rak'ah of Fajr are better than the world and what is in it
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr ki do rakat duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hain." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Umar, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne Salih bin Abdullah At-Tirmidhi se, Aishah ki hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I watched the Prophet (S) for a month. In the two Rak'ah before Fajr he would recite: Say: "O you disbelievers!" and Say: "Allah is One
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Maine ek mahine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, wo Fajr se pehle do rakaton mein padhte the: '(Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)' aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad).'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Hafsah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise Ath-Thawri ki, Abu Ishaq se riwayat mein sirf Abu Ahmad ki riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante, aur logon ke nazdeek mashhoor Israil ki, Abu Ishaq se riwayat hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Ahmad se, Israil se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu Ahmad Az-Zubairi thiqah aur hafiz hain. Maine Bundar ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Ahmad Az-Zubairi se behtar hifz waala kisi ko nahi dekha. Aur Abu Ahmad ka naam Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Az-Zubair Al-Kufi Al-Asadi hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When Allah's Messenger (S) prayed the two Rak'ah (before) Fajr if he needed something from me he would talk to me, if not, he would go to Salat
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) Fajr ki do rakat padh lete, agar unhen mujhse koi kaam hota to mujhse baat karte, warna namaz ke liye chale jaate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne Fajr shuru hone ke baad, jab tak Fajr ki namaz na padh le, baat karna napasand kiya, siwaye Allah ke zikr ke ya jo laazmi ho, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "There is no Salat after Al-Fajr (begins) except two prostrations
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr ke baad koi namaz nahi siwaye do sajdon ke." Is hadith ka matlab hai: Fajr shuru hone ke baad koi namaz nahi siwaye Fajr ki do rakaton ke. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Hafsah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Qudamah bin Musa ki riwayat se hi jaante hain, aur unse kai logon ne riwayat ki hai. Aur ye wo hai jispar ahl-e-ilm ka ittefaq hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi Fajr shuru hone ke baad koi namaz padhe siwaye Fajr ki do rakaton ke.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "When one of you prays the two Rak'ah of Fajr then let him lay down on his right (side)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi Fajr ki do rakat padh le, to wo apni dahini taraf let jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab apne ghar mein Fajr ki do rakat padhte, to apni dahini taraf let jaate. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko Mustahab samjha hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "When the Iqamah has been called for the Salat then there is no Salat except the obligatory
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to koi namaz nahi siwaye farz namaz ke." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Buhainah, Abdullah bin Amr, Abdullah bin Sarjis, Ibn Abbas, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur isi tarah Ayyub, Warqa bin Umar, Ziyad bin Sa'd, Ismail bin Muslim, aur Muhammad bin Juhadah ne Amr bin Dinar se, Ata bin Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Hammad bin Zaid aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Amr bin Dinar se riwayat ki lekin ise marfu' nahi kiya. Aur marfu' hadith humare nazdeek zyada sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye to aadmi sirf farz namaz padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai, Ayyash bin Abbas Al-Qitbani Al-Misri ne Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki.

e: Qais narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) went out and the Iqamah was called for the Salat so I prayed As-Subh with him. Then the Prophet (S) turned and found me performing Salat so he said: 'Easy O Qais! Are there two prayers together?' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I did not perform the two Rak'ah (before) Fajr.' He said: 'Then there is no harm
hi: Qais ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bahar aaye aur namaz ki iqaamat ho gayi, to maine unke saath Subh ki namaz padhi. Phir Nabi (SAW) laute aur mujhe namaz padhte paaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Qais! Zara ruko, kya do namazein ikattha?' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine Fajr ki do rakat nahi padhi thi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To phir koi harj nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Ibrahim ki hadith hum isi tarah sirf Sa'd bin Sa'eed ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne kaha: Ata bin Abi Rabah ne Sa'd bin Sa'eed se ye hadith sunee. Aur ye hadith mursal riwayat hoti hai. Aur Makkah ke kuch logon ne is hadith ko liya, unhon ne isse koi harj nahi maana ke aadmi farz ke baad do rakat sooraj tulu hone se pehle padhe. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sa'd bin Sa'eed, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ke bhai hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Qais, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ke dada hain, unhen Qais bin Amr bhi kaha jaata hai, aur Qais bin Qahd bhi. Aur is hadith ka isnad mutasil nahi hai, Muhammad bin Ibrahim At-Taimi ne Qais se suna nahi hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Sa'd bin Sa'eed se, Muhammad bin Ibrahim se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) bahar aaye aur Qais ko dekha. Aur ye Abdul-Aziz ki, Sa'd bin Sa'eed se riwayat se zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Whoever did not pray the two Rak'ah (before) Fajr then let him pray them after the sun has risen
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Fajr ki do rakat na padhe, wo unhen sooraj tulu hone ke baad padh le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne aisa kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne Hammam se is isnad ke saath isi jaisi riwayat ki ho siwaye Amr bin Aasim Al-Kilabi ke. Aur Qatadah ki, An-Nadr bin Anas se, Bashir bin Nahik se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se mashhoor riwayat ye hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Jo shakhs sooraj tulu hone se pehle Subh ki namaz ki ek rakat paa le, usne Subh paa li.\"

e: Ali narrated:"The Prophet (S) would pray four Rak'ah before Az-Zuhr and two Rak'ah after it
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Zuhr se pehle chaar aur uske baad do rakat padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah aur Umm Habibah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai. Abu Bakr Al-Attar ne kaha: Ali bin Abdullah ne Yahya bin Sa'eed se, Sufyan se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Hum Aasim bin Dhamrah ki hadith ki fazilat Al-Harith ki hadith se zyada jaante the. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi Zuhr se pehle chaar rakat padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ishaq, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakat hai, wo har do rakaton ke darmiyan alag hone ko maante hain. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I prayed two Rak'ah with the Prophet (S) before Az-Zuhr and two Rak'ah after it
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur uske baad do rakat padhi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Prophet (S) would not perform the four Rak'ah before Az-Zuhr he would pray them after it
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab Zuhr se pehle chaar rakat na padh paate, to wo unhen uske baad padhte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Al-Mubarak ki riwayat se, is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Qais bin Ar-Rabi ne Shu'bah se, Khalid Al-Hadhdha se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne Shu'bah se riwayat ki ho siwaye Qais bin Ar-Rabi ke. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Umm Habibah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Whoever prays four before Az-Zuhr and four after, Allah makes him prohibited for the Fire
hi: Umm Habibah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Zuhr se pehle chaar aur uske baad chaar rakat padhe, Allah use aag par haraam kar deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Umm Habibah the wife of the Prophet (S) narrated that:She heard Allah's Messenger (S) saying: "Whoever maintains four Rak'ah before Az-Zuhr and four after it, Allah makes him prohibited for the Fire
hi: Anbasah bin Abi Sufyan ne kaha: "Maine apni behen Umm Habibah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ko kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo shakhs Zuhr se pehle chaar aur uske baad chaar rakat par paabandi kare, Allah use aag par haraam kar deta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Al-Qasim, Abdur-Rahman ke bete hain, unki kuniyat Abu Abdur-Rahman hai, wo Abdur-Rahman bin Khalid bin Yazid bin Muawiyah ke azaad kiye gulam hain, wo thiqah Shaam waale hain, aur Abu Umamah ke saathi hain.

e: Ali narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) would pray four Rak'ah before Al-Asr separating between them with At-Taslim upon the angels that are close (to Allah) and those who follow them among the Muslims and the believers
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Asr se pehle chaar rakat padhte the, unke darmiyan qareeb Farishton aur unki pairvi karne wale Musalmanon aur Momino par Salam kehte hue alag karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne pasand kiya ke Asr se pehle chaar rakat mein alag na kiya jaaye, aur is hadith se dalil li. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: \"Unke darmiyan Salam kehte hue alag karna\" ka matlab hai Tashahhud. Aur Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ne raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakat maani, unhon ne Asr se pehle chaar rakaton ko alag karna pasand kiya.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :The Prophet (S) said: "May Allah have mercy upon a man who prays four before Al-Asr
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah us aadmi par reham kare jo Asr se pehle chaar rakat padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hasan hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"I can not enumerate (how many times) I heard Allah's Messenger (S) reciting - in the two Rak'ah after Al-Maghrib and the two Rak'ah before Salatul-Fajr with: Say: "O you disbelievers!" and Say: "He is Allah the One
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Main gin nahi sakta ke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kitni baar Maghrib ke baad ki do rakaton mein aur Fajr se pehle ki do rakaton mein '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)' aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' padhte suna." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith unki riwayat mein ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdul-Malik bin Mi'dan ki, Aasim se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I prayed two Rak'ah after Al-Maghrib with the Prophet (S) in his house
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath unke ghar mein Maghrib ke baad do rakat padhi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Rafi bin Khadij aur Ka'b bin Ujrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I memorized ten Rak'ah from Allah's Messenger (S) which he would pray in a night and a day: Two Rak'ah before Az-Zuhr, two after it; two Rak'ah after Al-Maghrib and two Rak'ah after the latter Isha." He said: "And Hafsah narrated to me that he (S) would pray two Rak'ah before Al-Fajr
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se das rakat yaad ki hain jo wo raat aur din mein padhte the: Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur uske baad do; Maghrib ke baad do rakat aur aakhri Isha ke baad do rakat." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur mujhe Hafsah ne bataya ke wo Fajr se pehle do rakat padhte the." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar :has a similar narration
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Whoever prays six Rak'ah after Al-Maghrib, and he does not speak about anything between them, then they will be counted for him as twelve years of worship
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Maghrib ke baad chhe rakat padhe aur unke darmiyan koi bura kalaam na kare, to wo baarah saal ki ibadat ke barabar shumaar hongi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Maghrib ke baad bees rakat padhe, Allah uske liye Jannat mein ghar banayega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Zaid bin Al-Hubab ki, Umar bin Abi Khath'am se riwayat se hi jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: Umar bin Abdullah bin Abi Khath'am munkar hadith wale hain. Aur unhen bahut kamzor qarar diya gaya hai.

e: Abdullah bin Shaqiq said:"I asked Aishah about the Salat of Allah's Messenger (S). She said: 'He would pray four Rak'ah before Az-Zuhr and two Rak'ah after it, and two after Al-Maghrib, and two Rak'ah after Al-Isha, and two before Al-Fajr
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne kaha: "Maine Aishah se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Wo Zuhr se pehle do rakat aur uske baad do rakat padhte, Maghrib ke baad do rakat, Isha ke baad do rakat, aur Fajr se pehle do rakat.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ki, Aishah se riwayat hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Prophet (S) said: "Salat in the night is two by two. So when you fear the dawn (is near) then make it odd by one, and make that the last of your Salat odd
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ki namaz do-do rakat hai. Jab tumhen Subh ka khauf ho, to ek rakat se Witr kar lo, aur apni aakhri namaz Witr banao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Amr bin Absah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke raat ki namaz do-do rakat hoti hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "The most virtuous fasting after the month of Ramadan is that of Allah's month of Al-Muharram. And the most virtuous Salat after the obligatory is the night prayer
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ramzan ke mahine ke baad sabse afzal roza Allah ke mahine Muharram ka hai. Aur farz ke baad sabse afzal namaz raat ki namaz hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Bilal, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Bishr ka naam Ja'far bin Abi Wahshiyyah hai, aur Abu Wahshiyyah ka naam Iyas hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Abi Sa'eed Al-Maqburi narrated that:Sa'eed bin Abi Sa'eed Al-Maqburi narrated that Abu Salamah informed him that he had asked Aishah: "How was the Salat of Allah's Messenger (A) [at night] during Ramadan?" She said: "Allah's Messenger (S) would pray - neither in Ramadan nor in any other month - more than eleven Rak'ah. He would pray four, and do not ask about their excellence or length, then he would pray four, and do not ask about their excellence or length, then he would pray three." Aishah said: "I asked: 'O Messenger of Allah! Do you sleep before having performed Witr?" He said: 'O Aishah! Indeed my eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep
hi: Abu Salamah ne bataya ke unhon ne Aishah se pucha: "Ramzan mein raat ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki namaz kaisi hoti thi?" To unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ramzan mein ya kisi aur mahine mein gyarah rakaton se zyada nahi padhte the. Wo chaar padhte, unke husn aur lambaai ke baare mein na pucho, phir chaar padhte, unke husn aur lambaai ke baare mein na pucho, phir teen padhte." Aishah ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Kya aap Witr se pehle sote hain?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ae Aishah! Meri aankhen sotin hain lekin mera dil nahi sota."

e: Aishah narrated:"Allah's Messenger (S) would pray eleven Rak'ah at night, making them off with one. When he finished them he would lay down on his right side
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat ko gyarah rakat padhte, unmein se ek se Witr karte, jab unse faariq hote to apni dahini taraf let jaate.

e: Narrator mot mentioned:Another chain with similar narration
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi tareeqe se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet (S) would pray thirteen Rak'ah at night
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) raat ko terah rakat padhte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Jamrah Ad-Dubai ka naam Nasr bin Imran Ad-Dubai hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet (S) would pray nine Rak'ah in the night
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) raat ko nau rakat padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, aur Al-Fadl bin Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrator not mentioned:(Another chain with similar narration)
hi: Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Al-A'mash se isi jaisi riwayat ki, humein ye Mahmud bin Ghailan ne bataya, humein Yahya bin Adam ne, Sufyan se, Al-A'mash se bataya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) se raat ki namaz mein sabse zyada jo riwayat hui hai wo Witr samet terah rakat hai, aur sabse kam jo bataya gaya hai unki raat ki namaz mein wo nau rakat hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Prophet (S) did not pray at night because he was prevented from it by sleep or being sleepy then he would pray twelve Rak'ah during the daytime
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) raat ko namaz na padh paate - kyunki unhen neend ne rok liya ya unki aankhen bhaari ho gayin - to wo din mein baarah rakat padhte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sa'd bin Hisham, Hisham bin Aamir Al-Ansari ke bete hain, aur Hisham bin Aamir Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se hain. Humein Abbas, jo Ibn Abdul-Azeem Al-Anbari hain, ne bataya, humein Attab bin Al-Muthanna ne, Bahz bin Hakim se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Zurarah bin Awfa Basra ke qazi the, aur wo Banu Qushair mein imamat karte the. Ek din unhon ne Subh ki namaz mein padha: '(Phir jab sur mein phoonka jaayega, to wo din bada mushkil din hoga)', to wo mar kar gir gaye, aur main un logon mein tha jo unhen unke ghar tak le gaye.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:Allah's Messenger (S) said: "Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, descends to the earth's heaven every night when the first third of the night has passed. He says: "I am the Sovereign. Is there any who calls upon Me so that I may respond to him? Is there any who asks of Me that I may give him? Is there any who seeks forgiveness from Me so that I may forgive him?' He continues in that until the illumination of Al-Fajr
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah har raat, jab raat ka pehla tihaai hissa guzar jaata hai, duniya ke aasman ki taraf utarta hai, aur farmaata hai: 'Main Baadshah hoon. Kaun hai jo mujhe pukare taake main uski dua qubool karoon? Kaun hai jo mujhse maange taake main use doon? Kaun hai jo mujhse maafi maange taake main use maaf karoon?' Aur wo aisa hi karta rehta hai yahan tak ke Fajr roshan ho jaati hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Abu Sa'eed, Rifa'ah Al-Juhani, Jubair bin Mut'im, Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Ad-Darda, aur Uthman bin Abi Al-As se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai. Aur unse riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Allah Azza wa Jall raat ke aakhri tihaai hisse mein utarta hai\" - aur ye zyada sahih riwayaton mein se hai.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that :The Prophet (S) said to Abu Bakr: "I passed by you while you were reciting and your voice was low." He said: "I let He who, I was consulting hear." He said: "Raise your voice." Then he said to Umar: "I passed by while you were reciting and your voice was loud." So he said: "I repel drowsiness and keep Ash-Shaitan away." So he said: "Lower your voice
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr se kaha: "Main tumhare paas se guzra jabke tum padh rahe the aur apni awaaz halki rakhte hue." Unhon ne kaha: "Main use sunaata hoon jisse main sarguushi karta hoon." Unhon ne farmaya: "Zara awaaz uthao." Aur unhon ne Umar se kaha: "Main tumhare paas se guzra jabke tum padh rahe the aur apni awaaz oonchi karte hue." Unhon ne kaha: "Main sote hue ko jagata hoon aur Shaitan ko bhagata hoon." Unhon ne farmaya: "Zara awaaz halki karo." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Umm Hani, Anas, Umm Salamah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Yahya bin Ishaq ne isko Hammad bin Salamah se isnad ke saath riwayat ki, jabke zyada tar log ye hadith Thabit se, Abdullah bin Rabah se mursal riwayat karte hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet (S) stood (in prayer) with an Ayah from the Qur'an at night
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ek raat Quran ki ek hi Ayat ke saath khade rahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Qais narrated:"I asked Aishah how the recitation of the Prophet (S) was at night. [Would he recite silently o audibly?] So she said: 'He would do both of those. Sometimes he was silent with his recitation and sometimes it was audible.' So I said: 'All praise is due to Allah, the One who made the matter broad
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qais ne kaha: "Maine Aishah se pucha: Raat ko Nabi (SAW) ki qiraat kaisi hoti thi? Kya wo aahista padhte the ya zor se? To unhon ne kaha: 'Wo dono kaam karte the, kabhi aahista padhte aur kabhi zor se.' To maine kaha: 'Shukr hai Allah ka jisne is maamle mein gunjaish rakhi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Zaid bin Thabit narrated that:The Prophet (S) said: "The most virtuous prayer of yours is in your homes, except for the obligatory
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhari sabse afzal namaz tumhare gharon mein hai, siwaye farz ke." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar bin Al-Khattab, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, Aishah, Abdullah bin Sa'd, aur Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Thabit ki hadith hasan hai. Aur is hadith ki riwayat mein logon ka ikhtilaaf hai, Musa bin Uqbah aur Ibrahim bin Abi An-Nadr ne Abu An-Nadr se marfu' riwayat ki, aur Malik bin Anas ne Abu An-Nadr se riwayat ki lekin ise marfu' nahi kiya, aur kuch ne ise mauqoof rakha. Aur marfu' hadith zyada sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :The Prophet (S) said: "Offer Salat in your homes and do not turn them into graves
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne gharon mein namaz padho aur unhen qabristan mat banao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Kharijab bin Hudhafah narrated:"Allah's Messenger came out to us and he said: 'Indeed Allah has assisted you with a Salat that is better for you than red camels: Al-Witr which Allah made for you between the Isha prayer till Al-Fajr has begun
hi: Kharijah bin Hudhafah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare paas nikle aur farmaya: 'Beshak Allah ne tumhen ek namaz se nawaza hai jo tumhare liye surkh oonton se behtar hai: Witr, jise Allah ne tumhare liye Isha ki namaz se lekar Fajr shuru hone tak rakha hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Amr, Buraidah, aur Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Kharijah bin Hudhafah ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Yazid bin Abi Habib ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur kuch muhaddisin ne is hadith mein galtfahmi ki aur \"Abdullah bin Rashid Az-Zurqi\" kaha, jo isme ghalat hai. Aur Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari ka naam Humail bin Basrah hai, aur kuch ne Jamil bin Basrah kaha lekin ye sahih nahi. Aur Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari ek doosre aadmi hain jo Abu Dharr se riwayat karte hain, wo Abu Dharr ke bhatije hain.

e: Ali said:"Al-Witr is not incumbent like your obligatory prayers, but it is a Sunnah of Allah's Messenger who said: "Indeed Allah is Witr (One), and He loves Al-Witr, so perform Al-Witr O people of the Qur'an
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Witr tumhari farz namaz jaisa laazmi nahi, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise Sunnat banaya aur farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Witr hai aur Witr ko pasand karta hai, is liye Witr padho, Ae Ahl-e-Quran!'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai.

e: Sufyan Ath-Thawri and others reported from Abu Ishaq, from Asim bin Damrah, that :Ali said: "Al-Witr is not incumbent like the status of the obligatory prayers, but it is a Sunnah which Allah's Messenger practiced
hi: Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne Abu Ishaq se, Aasim bin Dhamrah se riwayat ki ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Witr tumhari farz namaz ki soorat jaisa laazmi nahi, lekin ye Sunnat hai jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apnayi." Humein ye Muhammad bin Bashshar ne bataya, humein Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se bataya. Aur ye Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir ne Abu Ishaq se, Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki.

e: Sufyan Ath-Thawri and others reported from Abu Ishaq, from Asim bin Damrah, that :Ali said: "Al-Witr is not incumbent like the status of the obligatory prayers, but it is a Sunnah which Allah's Messenger practiced."
hi: Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne Abu Ishaq se, Aasim bin Dhamrah se riwayat ki ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Witr tumhari farz namaz ki soorat jaisa laazmi nahi, lekin ye Sunnat hai jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apnayi." Humein ye Muhammad bin Bashshar ne bataya, humein Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se bataya. Aur ye Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir ne Abu Ishaq se, Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki.

e: Masruq narrated that :he asked Aishah about the Witr of the Prophet. She said: "He would perform Witr during all of the night; (either) its beginning, its middle, or its end. So when he died, his Witr ended, during the approachof As-Sahar
hi: Masruq ne riwayat ki ke unhon ne Aishah se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Witr ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Poori raat mein se, unhon ne Witr shuru mein, darmiyan mein, aur aakhir mein padha. To jab unka intiqaal hua, to unka Witr Sahar tak pahunch chuka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hasin ka naam Uthman bin Aasim Al-Asadi hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari, aur Abu Qatadah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye wo hai jise kuch ahl-e-ilm ne apnaya, Witr raat ke aakhri hisse mein.

e: Masruq narrated that :he asked Aishah about the Witr of the Prophet. She said: "He would perform Witr during all of the night; (either) its beginning, its middle, or its end. So when he died, his Witr ended, during the approachof As-Sahar."
hi: Masruq ne riwayat ki ke unhon ne Aishah se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Witr ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Poori raat mein se, unhon ne Witr shuru mein, darmiyan mein, aur aakhir mein padha. To jab unka intiqaal hua, to unka Witr Sahar tak pahunch chuka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hasin ka naam Uthman bin Aasim Al-Asadi hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari, aur Abu Qatadah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye wo hai jise kuch ahl-e-ilm ne apnaya, Witr raat ke aakhri hisse mein.

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"The Prophet would perform Witr with thirteen . When he was older and became weak he performed Witr with seven."
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) terah rakat se Witr karte the. Jab wo boodhe ho gaye aur kamzor pad gaye, to unhon ne saat se Witr karna shuru kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Salamah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se Witr terah, gyarah, nau, saat, paanch, teen, aur ek rakat se riwayat hui hai. Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Iska matlab jo riwayat hui hai ke Nabi (SAW) terah se Witr karte the, iska matlab ye hai ke wo raat ko Witr samet terah rakat padhte the, is liye raat ki namaz ko Witr ki taraf mansoob kiya gaya. Aur unhon ne isme Aishah se ek hadith riwayat ki aur Nabi (SAW) ke qaul se dalil li ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Witr karo, Ae Ahl-e-Quran!\" Unhon ne kaha: Iska matlab hai raat ki namaz, wo kehte hain: Raat ki namaz sirf Quran waalon par hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The night prayer of Allah's Messenger was thirteen Rak'ah, five of which were his Witr, not sitting in any of them except at the end of them. When the Mu'adh-dhin called the Adhan he would stand to perform two light (Rak'ah)
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki raat ki namaz terah rakat hoti thi, unmein se paanch Witr hote, unmein kisi mein na baithte siwaye aakhri mein. Jab Mu'adhdhin azaan deta, to wo khade hote aur do halki rakat padhte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne paanch se Witr ko maana hai, unhon ne kaha: Unmein kisi mein na baithe siwaye aakhri mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur maine Abu Mus'ab Al-Madini se is hadith ke baare mein pucha: Nabi (SAW) nau aur saat se Witr karte the. Maine pucha: Nau aur saat se kaise Witr karte hain? Unhon ne kaha: Wo do-do rakat padhte aur Salam kehte, aur ek rakat se Witr karte.

e: Ali narrated:"Allah's Messenger would perform Al-Witr with three, reciting nine Surah from the Mufassal in them, reciting three Surah in each Rak'ah with Say: "Allah is One." At the end of them."Muhammad bin Sirin said: "They would perform Al-Witr with five, with three, and with one Rak'ah, and they considered all of that to be good
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) teen se Witr karte, unmein Mufassal ki nau Surahen padhte, har rakat mein teen Surahen padhte, aakhri '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' hoti." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain, Aishah, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abza ne Ubayy bin Ka'b se, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Isi tarah kuch logon ne riwayat ki lekin unmein Ubayy ka zikr nahi kiya, aur kuch ne Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se, Ubayy se zikr kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne isi ko apnaya, unhon ne maana ke aadmi teen se Witr kare. Sufyan ne kaha: Agar chaho paanch se Witr karo, agar chaho teen se, agar chaho ek rakat se. Sufyan ne kaha: Aur jo mujhe pasand hai wo ye hai ke teen rakat se Witr karoon. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Humein Sa'eed bin Ya'qub At-Talqani ne bataya, humein Hammad bin Zaid ne Hisham se, Muhammad bin Sireen se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Wo paanch, teen, aur ek rakat se Witr karte the, aur sab ko acha maante the.

e: Anas bin Sirin narrated that :he asked Ibn Umar about the length of the two Rak'ah (before) Al-Fajr. He said: "The Prophet would pray two and two during the night, and he would perform Al-Witr with one Rak'ah. And he would pray two Rak'ah while he was hearing the Adhan [meaning that they were light]
hi: Anas bin Sireen ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar se pucha, maine kaha: Kya main Fajr ki do rakat lamba karoon? Unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) raat ko do-do rakat padhte aur ek rakat se Witr karte. Aur wo Fajr ki do rakat padhte jabke azaan unke kaan mein hoti" - yani wo unhen halka karte. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Jabir, Al-Fadl bin Abbas, Abu Ayyub, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne maana ke aadmi do rakat aur teesri ke darmiyan alag kare, aur ek rakat se Witr kare. Aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Allah's Messenger would recite during Al-Witr: "Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High' and, 'Say: O you disbelievers!' and, 'Say: Allah is One,' in each Rak'ah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Witr mein '(Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la)', '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)', aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' har rakat mein padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se, Ubayy bin Ka'b se bhi riwayat hai, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Witr ki teesri rakat mein Mu'awwidhatain aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' padhi. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko chuna ke '(Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la)', '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)', aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' padhi jaaye, har rakat mein ek Surah padhi jaaye.

e: Abdul-Aziz bin Juraij said:"I asked Aishah about what (recitation) Allah's Messenger would perform Al-Witr with. She said: 'In the first he would recite: Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High, in the second: Say: O you disbelievers!, and in the third: Say: Allah is One" and, Al-Mu'awwidhatain
hi: Abdul-Aziz bin Juraij ne kaha: "Humne Aishah se pucha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kis chiz se Witr karte the? Unhon ne kaha: Pehli rakat mein '(Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la)' padhte, doosri mein '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)', aur teesri mein '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' aur Mu'awwidhatain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye Abdul-Aziz, Ibn Juraij ke waalid hain, Ata ke saathi, aur Ibn Juraij ka naam Abdul-Malik bin Abdul-Aziz bin Juraij hai. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ne ye hadith Amrah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Al-Hasan bin Ali [may Allah be pleased with him] said:"Allah's Messenger taught me some phrases to say during Al-Witr (Allahummahdini fiman hadait, wa a'fini fiman afait, wa tawallani fiman tawallait, wa barik Li fima atait, wa qini sharra ma qadait, fa Innaka taqdi wa la yuqda Alaik, wa innahu la yadhillu man walait, tabarakta Rabbana wa ta'alait.) 'O Allah guide me among those You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, befriend me among those You have befriended, bless me in what You have granted, and save me from the evil that You decreed. Indeed You decree, and none can pass decree, and none can pass decree upon You, indeed he is not humiliated whom You have befriended, blessed are You our Lord and Exalted
hi: Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe kuch alfaaz sikhaye jo main Witr mein kahoon: 'Allahummahdini Fiman Hadait, wa Aafini Fiman Aafait, wa Tawallani Fiman Tawallait, wa Barik Li Fima A'tait, wa Qini Sharra Ma Qadait, Fa Innaka Taqdi wa La Yuqda Alaik, wa Innahu La Yadhillu Man Walait, Tabarakta Rabbana wa Ta'alait' (Ya Allah! Mujhe hidayat de un logon mein jinhen Tune hidayat di hai, mujhe aafiyat de un logon mein jinhen Tune aafiyat di hai, mujhe apna dost bana un logon mein jinhen Tune apna dost banaya hai, mujhe barkat de jo Tu ne mujhe diya hai, aur mujhe bacha jo Tu ne faisla kiya hai uski buraai se. Beshak Tu faisla karta hai aur Tere khilaf koi faisla nahi kar sakta. Beshak jise Tu apna dost bana le wo zaleel nahi hota. Mubarak hai Tu, humare Rab, aur buland hai Tu)." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Abu Al-Haura As-Sa'di ki riwayat se jaante hain, unka naam Rabi'ah bin Shaiban hai. Aur hum Nabi (SAW) se Witr ke Qunut ke baare mein isse behtar kuch nahi jaante. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Witr mein Qunut ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne saal bhar Witr mein Qunut ko maana, aur rukoo se pehle Qunut ko pasand kiya. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ishaq, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke wo sirf Ramzan ke aakhri aadhe hisse mein hi Qunut karte the, aur rukoo ke baad Qunut karte the. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever sleeps past Al-Witr or forgets it, then let him pray it when he remembers it or when he awakens
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Witr ke waqt so jaaye ya use bhool jaaye, wo jab yaad aaye ya jab jaage, tab padh le."

e: Zaid bin Aslam narrated from his father that:the Prophet said: "Whoever sleeps past his Al-Witr then let him pray it in the morning
hi: Zaid bin Aslam apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apne Witr ke waqt so jaaye, wo subah hote hi padh le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Abu Dawud As-Sijzi, yani Sulaiman bin Al-Ash'ath, ko kehte suna: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal se Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ke baare mein pucha, to unke bhai Abdullah ne kaha: Unmein koi harj nahi. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Muhammad ko Ali bin Abdullah se zikr karte suna ke unhon ne Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ko kamzor qarar diya, aur kaha: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aslam thiqah hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Kufa ke kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ko apnaya, unhon ne kaha: Aadmi jab yaad aaye tab Witr kare, chahe sooraj tulu hone ke baad hi ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "Precede the morning with Al-Witr
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subh se pehle Witr kar lo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Perform Witr before the morning comes upon you
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subh hone se pehle Witr kar lo."

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "When Fajr begins, then every Salat of the night and Al-Witr have gone, so perform Al-Witr before Fajr begins
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Fajr shuru ho jaaye, to raat ki har namaz aur Witr chala jaata hai, is liye Fajr shuru hone se pehle Witr kar lo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sulaiman bin Musa is alfaaz mein akele hain. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Subh ki namaz ke baad koi Witr nahi.\" Aur ye kai ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka bhi yehi qaul hai, wo Subh ki namaz ke baad Witr ko nahi maante.

e: Qais bin Talq bin Ali narrated that :his father said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying: "There are no two Witr in one night
hi: Qais bin Talq bin Ali apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Ek raat mein do Witr nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai us aadmi ke baare mein jo raat ke shuru mein Witr kare phir raat ke aakhir mein khade ho, kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke logon ne Witr todna maana aur kaha: Wo usmein ek rakat aur milaaye aur jitni chaahe namaz padhe, phir apni namaz ke aakhir mein Witr kare, kyunki \"ek raat mein do Witr nahi.\" Aur ye wahi hai jise Ishaq ne apnaya. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha: Agar wo raat ke shuru mein Witr kare, phir so jaaye, phir raat ke aakhir mein khade ho, to wo jitni chaahe namaz padhe aur apna Witr na tode, aur apna Witr jaisa hai waisa hi chhod de. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Kufa waalon, aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur ye zyada sahih hai kyunki doosre tareeqon se riwayat hui hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Witr ke baad namaz padhi.

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"The Prophet would pray two Rak'ah after Al-Witr
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Witr ke baad do rakat padhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur isi jaisi riwayat Abu Umamah, Aishah, aur kai doosron se, Nabi (SAW) se hui hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Yasar narrated:"I was with Ibn Umar on a journey and I fell behind him. He said: 'Where were you?' I said: 'I prayed Al-Witr.' He said: 'Is there not a good exampled for you in Allah's Messenger? I saw Allah's Messenger performing Al-Witr on his mount
hi: Sa'eed bin Yasar ne kaha: "Main ek safar mein Ibn Umar ke saath chal raha tha, main unse peeche reh gaya. Unhon ne kaha: 'Tum kahan the?' Maine kaha: 'Maine Witr padha.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mein tumhare liye achi misaal nahi hai? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni sawari par Witr padhte dekha hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne isi ko apnaya, unhon ne maana ke aadmi apni sawari par Witr kare. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Aadmi sawari par Witr na kare, aur jab wo Witr karna chahe to utar kar zameen par Witr kare. Aur ye kuch Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever prays twelve Rak'ah of Ad-Duha, Allah will build a castle made of gold for him in Paradise
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Duha ki baarah rakat padhe, Allah uske liye Jannat mein sone ka mahal banayega." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Hani, Abu Hurairah, Nu'aim bin Hammar, Abu Dharr, Aishah, Abu Umamah, Utbah bin Abd As-Sulami, Ibn Abi Awfa, Abu Sa'eed, Zaid bin Arqam, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila narrated:"No one informed that they saw Allah's Messenger praying Ad-Duha except Umm Hani. She narrated that Allah's Messenger entered her house on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah. He performed Ghusl and performed eight voluntary Rak'ah such that she had not ever seen him pray any Salat lighter than them, but that he completed the bowing and prostrations
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila ne kaha: "Kisi ne mujhe nahi bataya ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko Duha padhte dekha ho siwaye Umm Hani ke. Unhon ne bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fath-e-Makkah ke din unke ghar mein daakhil hue, ghusl kiya, aur aath rakat namaz padhi, maine unhen kabhi isse halki namaz padhte nahi dekha, siwaye is ke ke wo rukoo aur sajda mukammal karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur goya Ahmad ne is mauzu par sabse sahih cheez Umm Hani ki hadith ko maana. Aur Nu'aim ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne Nu'aim bin Khammar kaha, kuch ne Ibn Hammar, aur Ibn Habbar bhi kaha jaata hai, aur Ibn Hammam bhi, aur sahih Ibn Hammar hai. Aur Abu Nu'aim ne isme galtfahmi ki aur \"Ibn Himaz\" kaha, aur usmein ghalti ki, phir chhod diya aur \"Nu'aim, Nabi (SAW) se\" kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur mujhe ye Abd bin Humaid ne, Abu Nu'aim se bataya.

e: Jubair narrated from Abu Ad-Darda, or Abu Dharr, that :Allah's Messenger narrated that Allah, Blessed and Most High said: "Son of Adam: Perform four Rak'ah for Me in the beginning of the day it will suffice you for the latter part of it
hi: Jubair (RA) ne Abu Ad-Darda ya Abu Dharr se riwayat ki ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bataya ke Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: "Ae Aadam ke bete! Din ki shuruaat mein mere liye chaar rakat padho, main tumhare din ke baaki hisse ke liye kaafi ho jaunga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever continuously performs the two Rak'ah of Ad-Duha his sins will be forgiven, even if they be like the foam of the sea
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Duha ki do rakat par paabandi kare, uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain, chahe wo samundar ke jhaag jitne hi kyun na hon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Waki, An-Nadr bin Shumail, aur kai Aimma ne ye hadith Nahhas bin Qahm se riwayat ki hai, aur hum ise sirf unki riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"The Prophet would pray Ad-Duha until we would say: 'He will not leave it.' And he would leave it until we would say: 'He will not pray it
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Nabi (SAW) Duha padhte, yahan tak ke hum kehte: 'Wo isse nahi chhodenge.' Aur wo ise chhod dete, yahan tak ke hum kehte: 'Wo ise nahi padhenge.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib narrated:"Allah's Messenger would pray four (Rak'ah) after the Zawal of the sun before Az-Zuhr. He said: 'It is an hour in which the gates of the heavens are opened, and I love that a righteous deed should be raised up for me in it
hi: Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sooraj dhalne ke baad, Zuhr se pehle, chaar rakat padhte the, aur farmate: "Ye wo ghadi hai jismein aasman ke darwaze khulte hain, aur main pasand karta hoon ke mere liye usmein koi neik amal upar jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo dhalne ke baad chaar rakat padhte, sirf aakhir mein Salam kehte.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Awfa narrated that :Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Whoever has a need from Allah, or from one of the sons of Adam, then let him perform Wudu', performing it well, then pray two Rak`ah, then praise Allah and say Salat upon the Prophet (ﷺ). Then let him say: (La ilaha illallah Al-Halimul-Karim. Subhan Allah Rabbil-`Arshil-`Azim. Al-Hamdulillahi Rabbil-`Alamin. As'aluka mujibati rahmatika wa `aza'im maghfiratika, wal-ghanimata min kulli birrin, was-salamata min kulli ithmin, la tada` li dhanban illa ghafartahu, wa la hamman illa farrajtahu, wa la Hajatan hiya laka ridan Illa Qadaitaha, ya arham ar-rahimin) 'None has the right to be worshiped but Allah. Al-Halim (the Forbearing) Al-Karim (the Generous). Glorious is Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. I ask You for that which warrants Your mercy, and that which will determine Your forgiveness, and the spoils (fruits) of every righteous deed, and safety from every sin; do not leave a sin for me without forgiving it, nor a worry without relieving it. Or a need that pleases you without granting it. O Most-Merciful of those who have mercy
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise Allah se ya Aadam ki aulad mein se kisi se koi zaroorat ho, to wo wuzu kare aur acha wuzu kare, phir do rakat namaz padhe, phir Allah ki tareef kare aur Nabi (SAW) par Durood padhe, phir kahe: 'La Ilaha Illallahul-Halimul-Karim. Subhan Allahi Rabbil-Arshil-Azim. Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbil-Alamin. As'aluka Mujibati Rahmatika wa Aza'ima Maghfiratika, wal-Ghanimata Min Kulli Birrin, was-Salamata Min Kulli Ithmin. La Tada'li Dhanban Illa Ghafartahu, wa La Hamman Illa Farrajtahu, wa La Hajatan Hiya Laka Ridan Illa Qadaitaha, Ya Arhamar-Rahimin' (Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi, Bardaasht karne wala, Karam karne wala. Pak hai Allah, Buland Arsh ka Rab. Saari tareef Allah ke liye hai, saari duniyaon ka Rab. Main Tujhse Teri rehmat laane wali cheezein maangta hoon, aur Teri maafi ko yakeeni banane wali cheezein, aur har neki mein hissa, aur har gunaah se salamati. Mera koi gunaah na chhod jise Tu maaf na kare, na koi pareshaani jise Tu door na kare, na koi zaroorat jo Tujhe pasand ho jise Tu poori na kare, Ae sabse zyada reham karne wale)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur iske isnad mein kuch baat hai. Faid bin Abdur-Rahman ko hadith mein kamzor qarar diya jaata hai, aur Faid, Abu Al-Warqa hain.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would teach us Al-Isthikhara for all of our affairs just as he would teach us a Surah of the Qur'an, saying: 'When one of you is worried about a matter, then let him perform two Rak'ah other than the obligatory (prayer), then let him say: (Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min falikal-azim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la qadiru, wa ta'lami wa la a'lamu, wa anta allamul-ghayub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khairun li fi dini wa ma'ishati wa aqibati amri, or said: Fi ajili amri wa ajilihi fayassirhu li,thumma barik li fihi, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ishati wa aqibati amri, or said: Fi ajili amri wa ajilihi fasrifhu anni wasrifni anhu waqdur Lil-khaira haithu kana, thumma ardini bih.)" 'O Allah! I consult Your knowledge, and seek ability from Your power, and I ask You from Your magnificent bounty, for indeed You have power and I do not have power, and You know while I do not know, and You know the unseen. O Allah! If you know that this matter is good for me in my religion or my livelihood, and for my life in the Hereafter - or he said: for my present and future - then make it easy for me, then bless me in it. If You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion and my livelihood and my life in the Hereafter - or he said: for my present and future - then divert it from me and divert me from it, enable me to find the good wherever it is, then make me pleased with it."He said: "And he mentions his need
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein har maamle mein Istikharah sikhate the jaise wo humein Quran ki Surah sikhate the. Wo kehte: 'Jab tum mein se koi kisi kaam ka irada kare, to wo farz ke alawa do rakat padhe, phir kahe: Allahumma Inni Astakhiruka Bi'ilmika, wa Astaqdiruka Biqudratika, wa As'aluka Min Fadlikal-Azim, Fa Innaka Taqdiru wa La Aqdiru, wa Ta'lamu wa La A'lamu, wa Anta Allamul-Ghuyub. Allahumma In Kunta Ta'lamu Anna Hadhal-Amra Khairun Li Fi Dini wa Ma'ishati wa Aqibati Amri' - ya kahe: 'Fi Ajili Amri wa Ajilihi' - 'Fayassirhu Li, Thumma Barik Li Fihi, wa In Kunta Ta'lamu Anna Hadhal-Amra Sharrun Li Fi Dini wa Ma'ishati wa Aqibati Amri' - ya kahe: 'Fi Ajili Amri wa Ajilihi' - 'Fasrifhu Anni, wasrifni Anhu, waqdur Liyal-Khaira Haithu Kana, Thumma Ardini Bih' (Ya Allah! Main Teri ilm se hidayat maangta hoon, aur Teri qudrat se taaqat maangta hoon, aur Tujhse Tera bada fazl maangta hoon, kyunki Tu qaadir hai, main qaadir nahi, aur Tu jaanta hai, main nahi jaanta, aur Tu ghaib ka jaanne wala hai. Ya Allah! Agar Tu jaanta hai ke ye kaam mere liye mere deen, meri roz-marra ki zindagi, aur mere anjaam mein - ya kahe: mere hazir aur baad ke maamle mein - behtar hai, to ise mere liye aasan kar de, phir ismein mujhe barkat de. Aur agar Tu jaanta hai ke ye kaam mere liye mere deen, meri roz-marra ki zindagi, aur mere anjaam mein - ya kahe: mere hazir aur baad ke maamle mein - bura hai, to ise mujhse door kar de, aur mujhe usse door kar de, aur jahan bhi khair ho wo mere liye muqarrar kar, phir mujhe usse raazi kar de.)" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur wo apni zaroorat ka naam le." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Al-Mawali ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur wo Madina ke ek thiqah shaikh hain, Sufyan ne unse ek hadith riwayat ki hai, aur kai Aimma ne Abdur-Rahman se riwayat ki hai, wo Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Abi Al-Mawali hain.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :Umm Sulaim came upon the Prophet and said: "Teach me some words that I can say in my Salat." So he said: "Mention Allah's Greatness (saying: Allahu Akbar) ten times, mention Allah's Glory (saying: Subhan Allah) ten times, and mention Allah's praise (saying: Al-Hamdulilah) ten times. Then ask as you like, (for which) He says: 'Yes. Yes
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Umm Sulaim Nabi (SAW) ke paas subah aayi aur kaha: "Mujhe kuch alfaaz sikhaiye jo main apni namaz mein kahoon." To unhon ne farmaya: "Das baar Allah ki buzurgi bayan karo (Allahu Akbar), das baar Allah ki pakizgi bayan karo (Subhan Allah), aur das baar uski tareef karo (Al-Hamdu Lillah). Phir jo chaho maango, wo Allah kahega: Haan, haan." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Amr, Al-Fadl bin Abbas, aur Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se namaz-e-tasbih ke baare mein doosri bhi hadithein riwayat hui hain, aur unmein se koi bhi zyada mazboot sahih nahi. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak aur kai ahl-e-ilm ne namaz-e-tasbih ko maana aur ismein fazilat ka zikr kiya. Humein Ahmad bin Abdah ne bataya, humein Abu Wahb ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se us namaz ke baare mein pucha jismein tasbih padhi jaati hai, to unhon ne kaha: Wo Takbir kahta hai, phir kehta hai: \"Subhanaka Allahumma wa Bihamdika wa Tabarakasmuka wa Ta'ala Jadduka wa La Ilaha Ghairuk,\" phir pandra baar kehta hai: \"Subhan Allah wal-Hamdu Lillahi wa La Ilaha Illallahu Wallahu Akbar,\" phir panah maangta hai aur padhta hai \"Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim\" aur Fatihatul-Kitab aur ek Surah, phir das baar kehta hai: \"Subhan Allah wal-Hamdu Lillahi wa La Ilaha Illallahu Wallahu Akbar,\" phir rukoo karta hai aur wahi das baar kehta hai. Phir rukoo se apna sar uthata hai aur wahi das baar kehta hai. Phir sajda karta hai aur wahi das baar kehta hai. Phir apna sar uthata hai aur wahi das baar kehta hai. Phir doosra sajda karta hai aur wahi das baar kehta hai. Isi tarah chaar rakat namaz padhta hai, to ye har rakat mein pachhattar tasbihat hoti hain, har rakat mein pandra tasbihat se shuru karta hai, phir padhta hai, phir das baar tasbih karta hai. Agar raat ko padhe, to mujhe ye pasand hai ke wo do rakaton mein Salam kahe, aur agar din mein padhe to chahe to Salam kahe, chahe na kahe. Abu Wahb ne kaha: Aur mujhe Abdul-Aziz bin Abi Rizmah ne Abdullah se bataya ke unhon ne kaha: Rukoo mein \"Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim\" se shuru karta hai aur sajda mein \"Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la\" teen baar, phir tasbihat padhta hai. Ahmad bin Abdah ne kaha: Aur humein Wahb bin Zam'ah ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Mujhe Abdul-Aziz, jo Ibn Abi Rizmah hain, ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se kaha: Agar isme bhool ho jaaye, to kya Sahw ke sajdon mein bhi das-das tasbih ki jaaye? Unhon ne kaha: Nahi, ye to sirf teen sau tasbihat hain.

e: Abu Rafi narrated that :Allah's Messenger said to Al-Abbas: "O uncle! Shall I not give to you, shall I not present to you, shall I not benefit you?" He said: "Of course, O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "O uncle! Pray four Rak'ah, reciting in each Rak'ah Fatihatil-Kitab and a Surah. When you are finished your recitation then say: Allahu Akbar, wal-hamdulilah, wa Subhan-Allah, [Wa La Ilaha illallah] 'Allah is Greatest, and all praise is due to Allah, and Glorious is Allah, [and there is none worthy of worship except Allah].' fifteen times before you bow. Then bow and say it ten times, then raise your head and say it ten times. Then prostrate [the second time] and say it ten times. Then raise your head and say it ten times before standing. That is seventy-five in every Rak'ah, which is three-hundred in four Rak'ah. If your sins were like a heap of sand then Allah would forgive you." He said: "O Messenger if Allah! Who is able to say that every day?" He said: "If you can not say it every day then say it every Friday, and if you are not able to say it every Friday then say it every month." And he did not stop saying that until he said: "Then say it every year
hi: Abu Rafi (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Abbas se kaha: "Ae chacha! Kya main aapko kuch na doon, kya main aapko kuch tohfa na doon, kya main aapko faida na pahunchaun?" Unhon ne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasool Allah." Unhon ne farmaya: "Ae chacha! Chaar rakat padho, har rakat mein Fatihatul-Kitab aur ek Surah padho. Jab qiraat khatam ho jaaye to kaho: 'Allahu Akbar, wal-Hamdu Lillahi, wa Subhan Allah, wa La Ilaha Illallah' pandra baar, rukoo se pehle. Phir rukoo karo aur ise das baar kaho. Phir apna sar uthao aur das baar kaho. Phir sajda karo aur das baar kaho. Phir apna sar uthao aur das baar kaho. Phir doosri baar sajda karo aur das baar kaho. Phir apna sar uthao aur khade hone se pehle das baar kaho. Ye har rakat mein pachhattar hote hain, aur chaar rakaton mein teen sau. Agar tumhare gunaah rait ke tude jaisi ho jaayen, to Allah unhen maaf kar dega." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kaun har din ise keh sakta hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Agar har din nahi keh sakte, to har Jumme keh lo, agar Jumme mein na keh sako to mahine mein keh lo." Aur wo isi tarah kehte rahe yahan tak ke unhon ne kaha: "To saal mein keh lo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Abu Rafi ki riwayat mein ghareeb hai.

e: Ka'b bin Ujrah narrated:"We said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We have learned about saying the Salam to you, but how about As-Salat upon you?' He said: 'Say: (Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin Wa Ala ali Muhammadin kama sallaita Ala Ibrahim, Innaka hamidan MAjid, Wa barik Ala Muhammadin wa Ala ali Muhammadin kamma barakta Ala Ibrahim Innaka Hamidan Majid)" O Allah! Send Salat upon Muhammad and upon Muhammad's family just as You have sent Salat upon Ibrahim, indeed You are the Praise and Majestic. And send blessings upon Muhammad and Muhammad's family just as You have sent blessing upon Ibrahim, indeed You are the Praised and Majestic.'Mahmud said: "Abu Usamah said: Za'idah added something for me, from Al-Amash, from Al-Hakam, from Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila, that he said: "We would say 'And upon us along with them
hi: Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) ne kaha: "Humne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Ye Salam aapko kehna to humein maloom ho gaya, lekin Salawat aapko kaise kahen? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kaho: Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammadin wa Ala Aali Muhammadin Kama Sallaita Ala Ibrahim, Innaka Hamidun Majid, wa Barik Ala Muhammadin wa Ala Aali Muhammadin Kama Barakta Ala Ibrahim, Innaka Hamidun Majid' (Ya Allah! Muhammad aur Muhammad ki aal par apni rehmat naazil kar jaise Tu ne Ibrahim par ki, beshak Tu tareef ke qaabil, buzurgi wala hai. Aur Muhammad aur Muhammad ki aal par apni barkat naazil kar jaise Tu ne Ibrahim par ki, beshak Tu tareef ke qaabil, buzurgi wala hai)." Mahmud ne kaha: Abu Usamah ne kaha: Aur Za'idah ne mujhe Al-A'mash se, Al-Hakam se, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila se zyada bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Aur hum kehte the: 'Aur hum par bhi unke saath.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Humaid, Abu Mas'ud, Talhah, Abu Sa'eed, Buraidah, Zaid bin Kharijah (unhen Ibn Jariyah bhi kaha jaata hai), aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ka'b bin Ujrah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila ki kuniyat Abu Isa hai, aur Abu Laila ka naam Yasar hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "The person closest to me on the Day of Judgement is the one who sent the most Salat upon me
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din mujhse sabse zyada qareeb wo hoga jo mujhpar sabse zyada Durood padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs mujhpar ek baar Durood padhe, Allah uspar das baar Durood naazil karta hai aur uske liye das neki likhta hai."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever sends Salat upon me, Allah sends Salat upon him ten times
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs mujhpar ek baar Durood padhe, Allah uspar das baar Durood naazil karta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Aamir bin Rabi'ah, Ammar, Abu Talhah, Anas, aur Ubayy bin Ka'b se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kai ahl-e-ilm se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Rab ka Durood rehmat hai, aur Farishton ka Durood maghfirat maangna hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated:"Indeed the supplication stops between the heavens and the earth. Nothing of it is raised up until you send Salat upon your Prophet
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak dua aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan ruki rehti hai, usmein se koi cheez tab tak upar nahi jaati jab tak tum apne Nabi (SAW) par Durood na padho."

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab [may Allah be pleased with him] said:"No one should sell in our markets except one who has understanding in the religion
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Humari mandi mein sirf wahi shakhs beche jisne deen ki samajh haasil ki ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Abbas, Ibn Abdul-Azeem hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Al-Ala bin Abdur-Rahman, Ibn Ya'qub ke bete hain, wo Al-Huraqah ke azaad kiye gulam hain, aur Al-Ala Tabi'een mein se hain, unhon ne Anas bin Malik aur doosron se sunaa hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'qub, Al-Ala ke waalid, wo bhi Tabi'een mein se hain, unhon ne Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, aur Ibn Umar se sunaa hai. Aur Ya'qub, Al-Ala ke dada, bade Tabi'een mein se hain, unhon ne Umar bin Al-Khattab ka zamana paaya aur unse riwayat ki.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:the Prophet said: "The best day that the sun has risen upon is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it he entered Paradise, and on it, he was expelled from it. And the Hour will not be established except on Friday
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen din jispar sooraj nikla, wo Jumma ka din hai. Ismein Aadam ko paida kiya gaya, ismein unhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya, aur ismein unhe usse nikaala gaya. Aur Qayamat sirf Jumme ke din hi qaayam hogi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Lubabah, Salman, Abu Dharr, Sa'd bin Ubadah, aur Aws bin Aws se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Prophet said: "Seek out the hour that is hoped for on Friday after Asr until the sun has set
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jumme ke din us ghadi ko talaash karo jiski ummeed ki jaati hai, Asr ke baad se sooraj doobne tak." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai, aur ye hadith Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Muhammad bin Abi Humaid ko unki hifz ki wajah se kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kamzor qarar diya hai, unhen Hammad bin Abi Humaid bhi kaha jaata hai, aur unhen Abu Ibrahim Al-Ansari bhi kaha jaata hai, aur wo munkar hadith wale hain. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne maana ke wo ummeed wali ghadi Asr ke baad se sooraj doobne tak hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Zyada tar hadithein us ghadi ke baare mein jismein dua qubool hone ki ummeed hai, Asr ki namaz ke baad hoti hai, aur sooraj dhalne ke baad bhi ummeed hoti hai.

e: Kathir bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that :the Prophet said: "On Friday there is an hour in which the worshipper does not ask Allah for anything except that Allah grants it to him." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! Which hour is it?" He said: "When the prayer is begun until it is finished
hi: Kathir bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jumme mein ek ghadi hai jismein banda Allah se koi bhi cheez maange to Allah use zaroor deta hai." Unhon ne pucha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Wo kaun si ghadi hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Jab namaz shuru ho jaaye yahan tak ke wo khatam ho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Musa, Abu Dharr, Salman, Abdullah bin Salam, Abu Lubabah, Sa'd bin Ubadah, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Amr bin Awf ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Allah's Messenger said: The best day that the sun has risen upon is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it he entered Paradise, and on it, he was sent down from it. And in it there is an hour in which the Muslim worshipper would not stand in Salat, asking Allah for anything except that He would give it to him.'" Abu Hurairah said: "I met Abdullah bin Salam, and I mentioned this Hadith to him. He said: 'I am more knowledgeable about that hour.' So I said: 'Inform me about it, and do not keep any of it from me.' He said: 'It is after al-Asr until the sun has set.' I said: 'How can it be after Al-Asr when Allah's Messenger said: ' the Muslim worshipper would not stand in Salat.' And that is a time that prayer is not performed in?" So Abdullah bin Salam said: 'Didn't Allah's Messenger say: "Whoever sat in a gathering awaiting the Salat then he is in Salat"? I said: 'Of course.' He said: 'Then that is it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Sabse behtareen din jispar sooraj nikla, wo Jumma ka din hai. Ismein Aadam ko paida kiya gaya, ismein unhe Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya, aur ismein unhe usse utaara gaya. Aur ismein ek aisi ghadi hai ke koi Musalman banda namaz padhte hue us waqt se mel na khaaye, Allah se kuch maangte hue, magar wo use de deta hai.'" Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "To meri Abdullah bin Salam se mulaqat hui, maine unse ye hadith zikr ki, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main us ghadi ke baare mein zyada jaanta hoon.' Maine kaha: 'Mujhe bataiye, aur mujhse na chhupaiye.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Wo Asr ke baad se sooraj doobne tak hai.' Maine kaha: 'Ye Asr ke baad kaise ho sakti hai jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: koi Musalman banda namaz padhte hue mel na khaaye. Aur us waqt namaz nahi padhi jaati.' To Abdullah bin Salam ne kaha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne nahi farmaya: Jo shakhs ek majlis mein baith kar namaz ka intezar kare, wo namaz mein hi hota hai.' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To wahi hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur is hadith mein ek lambi kahani hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur \"Mujhe bataiye, aur mujhse na chhupaiye\" ka matlab hai, mujhse kanjoosi na kariye, aur \"Zann\" ka matlab kanjoosi hai, aur \"Zaneen\" shak kiye jaane wala.

e: Salim narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that he heard :the Prophet saying: "Whoever comes on Friday, then let him perform Ghusl
hi: Salim apne walid se, unke waalid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jo Jumme ke liye aaye, wo ghusl kare." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, Al-Bara, Aishah, aur Abu Ad-Darda se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Salim narrated:(Another chain) from Abdullah bin Umar from the Prophet which is similar
hi: Aur Az-Zuhri se, Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Umar se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se ye hadith bhi riwayat hui hai. Humein ye Qutaibah ne bataya, humein Laith bin Sa'd ne Ibn Shihab se, Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Umar se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi bataya. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Az-Zuhri ki, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat, aur Abdullah bin Abdullah ki, apne walid se riwayat, donon hadithein sahih hain. Aur Az-Zuhri ke kuch shagirdon ne Az-Zuhri se kaha ke unhon ne mujhse Abdullah bin Umar ke ghar walon ne, Abdullah bin Umar se bataya.

e: And Yunus and Ma'mar reported, from Az-Zuhri, from Salim Wudu from his father:"Umar bin Al-Khattab was giving a Khutbah on Friday when a man from the Companions of the Prophet entered. So he said: "What time is it?" So he said: 'I don't know, I heard the call and did nothing more than perform Wudu.' So he said: And Wudu again!? I know surely that the Messenger of Allah has ordered Ghusl
hi: Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar se, Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se, Jumme ke din ghusl ke baare mein bhi riwayat hui hai, aur ye hasan sahih hadith hai. Ise Yunus aur Ma'mar ne Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat ki: "Ek baar Umar bin Al-Khattab Jumme ke din khutba de rahe the ke Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi daakhil hue. To unhon ne kaha: 'Ye kaunsi ghadi hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe kuch nahi maloom, maine sirf azaan sunee aur sirf wuzu kiya.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Aur sirf wuzu bhi?! Tumhen to maloom hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghusl karne ka hukum diya tha.'" Humein ye Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Aban ne bataya, humein Abdur-Razzaq ne Ma'mar se, Az-Zuhri se bataya.

e: (Another chain reaching to Az-Zuhri) with this Hadith.Malik reported this Hadith from Az-Zuhri, from Salim who said:"Umar [bin al-Khattab] was giving a Khutbah on Friday." And he mentioned this Hadith
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - Az-Zuhri tak pahunchte hue isi hadith ke saath. Malik ne ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Salim se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Umar bin Al-Khattab Jumme ke din khutba de rahe the." Phir unhon ne ye hadith zikr ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur maine Muhammad se is baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Sahih Az-Zuhri ki hadith hai, Salim se, apne walid se. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Malik se bhi, Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se, isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Aws bin Aws narrated:"Allah's Messenger said to me: 'Whoever performs Ghusl on Friday, and bathes completely, and goes early, arriving early, gets close and listens and is silent, there will be for him in every step he take the reward of a year of fasting and standing (in prayer)
hi: Aws bin Aws (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din ghusl kare aur ghusl karwaaye, jaldi jaaye aur pehle pahunche, qareeb baithe aur sune aur khaamosh rahe, uske liye har kadam par ek saal ke roze aur qayam ka sawaab hoga." Mahmud ne kaha: Waki ne kaha: \"Ghusl kare\" ka matlab hai khud ghusl kare, aur \"ghusl karwaaye\" ka matlab hai apni biwi ko ghusl karwaaye. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne is hadith mein kaha: \"Jo bhi ghusl karwaaye aur khud ghusl kare\" - yani apna sar dhoye aur ghusl kare. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Bakr, Imran bin Husain, Salman, Abu Dharr, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aws bin Aws ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Al-Ash'ath As-San'ani ka naam Shurahil bin Aadah hai. Aur Abu Janab Yahya bin Habib Al-Qassab Al-Kufi hain.

e: Samurah bin Jundah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever performs Wudu on Friday, then he will receive the blessing, and whoever performs Ghusl then Ghusl is more virtuous
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din wuzu kare, to ye kaafi hai aur achi baat hai, aur jo ghusl kare, to ghusl afzal hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Aishah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Qatadah ke kuch shagirdon ne Qatadah se, Al-Hasan se, Samurah bin Jundub se riwayat ki, aur kuch ne Qatadah se, Al-Hasan se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne Jumme ke din ghusl ko pasand kiya lekin maana ke wuzu ghusl ki jagah kaafi ho jaata hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur is baat par dalil ye hai ke Nabi (SAW) ka Jumme ke din ghusl ka hukum ikhtiyaari hai, farz nahi, Umar ki hadith hai jahan unhon ne Uthman se kaha: \"Aur wuzu bhi?! Tumhein to maloom hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Jumme ke din ghusl ka hukum diya tha.\" To agar unhen maloom hota ke ye hukum farz hai, ikhtiyaari nahi, to Umar Uthman ko chhodte nahi jab tak wo unhen wapas na bhejte aur kehte: \"Wapas jaao aur ghusl karo,\" aur Uthman ko ye baat, unke ilm ke bawajood, chhupi na rehti. Lekin is hadith se maloom hota hai ke Jumme ke din ghusl mein fazilat hai, ye kisi par farz nahi.

e: Abu Hurairh narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever performs Wudu, performing his Wudu well, then he comes to the Friday (prayer), and he gets close, listens and is silent, then whatever (sin) was between that and (the last) Friday are forgiven for him, in addition to three days. And whoever touches the pebbles, he has committed Lagha (useless activity)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo wuzu kare aur ache tareeke se wuzu kare, phir Jumme ke liye aaye, qareeb baithe, sune, aur khaamosh rahe, uske liye us Jumme aur pichhle Jumme ke darmiyan ke gunaah, aur teen din zyada, maaf kar diye jaate hain. Aur jo kankar ko chhue, usne befaida kaam kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever performs Ghusl on Friday - the Ghusl for Janabah - then he goes, he is like one who gave a camel in charity. Whoever goes in the second hour then he is like one who gave a cow in charity. Whoever goes in the third hour then he is like the one who have a ram in charity. Whoever goes in the fourth hour then he is like the one who gave a chicken in charity. Whoever goes in the fifth hour, then he is like one who gave an egg in charity. When the Imam comes out, the angels are present listening to the remembrance
