hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din janabat ka ghusl kare, phir jaaye, to goya usne ek oont sadqa kiya. Aur jo doosri ghadi mein jaaye, to goya usne ek gaay sadqa ki. Aur jo teesri ghadi mein jaaye, to goya usne seengon wala mendha sadqa kiya. Aur jo chauthi ghadi mein jaaye, to goya usne murgi sadqa ki. Aur jo paanchvi ghadi mein jaaye, to goya usne anda sadqa kiya. Jab Imam bahar aata hai, to Farishte zikr sunne ke liye haazir ho jaate hain." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Al-Ja'd - meaning Ad-Damri - narrated, and he was a Companion according to the claim of Muhammad bin Amr:"Allah's Messenger said: 'Whoever neglects the Friday prayer three times (in a row) without an excuse, then Allah sets a seal upon his heart
hi: Abu Al-Ja'd Ad-Damri (RA), jo Sahabi the Muhammad bin Amr ke daawe ke mutabiq, ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Jumma teen martaba, isse be-parwaahi ki wajah se, chhode, Allah uske dil par mohar laga deta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, aur Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Al-Ja'd ki hadith hasan hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se Abu Al-Ja'd Ad-Damri ke naam ke baare mein pucha, to unhen unka naam maloom nahi tha, unhon ne kaha: Mujhe unki, Nabi (SAW) se, is hadith ke siwaye koi doosri riwayat maloom nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur hum ye hadith sirf Muhammad bin Amr ki riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Thuwair narrated from a man among the people of Quba, from his father, who was one of the Companions of the Prophet, that :he said: "The Prophet ordered us to attend the Friday prayer in Quba
hi: Thuwair ne Quba waalon mein se ek aadmi se, apne walid se riwayat ki, jo Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se the, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum Quba se Jumma mein haazir hon." Aur Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi is baare mein riwayat hui hai lekin ye sahih nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi cheez sahih nahi hai. Aur Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Jumma us par hai jise raat apne ghar tak pahuncha sake.\" Aur is hadith ka isnad kamzor hai, ye sirf Ma'arik bin Abbad ki, Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se riwayat se hi milti hai. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan ne Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ko hadith mein kamzor qarar diya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai kis par Jumma farz hota hai, kuch ne kaha: Jumma us par farz hai jise raat apne ghar tak pahuncha sake. Aur kuch ne kaha: Jumma sirf us par farz hai jo azaan sunta hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrator not mentioned:I heard Ahmad bin Husain saying: "We were with Ahmad bin Hanbal, so they mentioned the one upon whom the Friday prayer is obligatory. Ahmad did not mention anything about it from the Prophet." Ahmad bin Al-Hasan said: "I said to Ahmad bin Hanbal: 'There is something about it from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet.' So Ahmad bin Hanbal said: 'From the Prophet?' I said: 'Yes.'" [Ahmed bin Hanbal said:] "Hajjaj bin Nusair narrated to us; Mubarik bin Abbad narrated to us from Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet said: "The Friday prayer is required from whomever can return to his family by the night." He said: "So Ahmad [bin Hanbal] became angry with me, and he said to me: 'Seek forgiveness from your Lord, seek forgiveness from your Lord
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Al-Husain ko kehte suna: Hum Ahmad bin Hanbal ke paas the, to unhon ne zikr kiya kis par Jumma farz hai, Ahmad ne Nabi (SAW) se isme kuch zikr nahi kiya. Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal se kaha: Ismein Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se kuch hai." To Ahmad ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) se?" Maine kaha: "Haan." Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ne kaha: Humein Hajjaj bin Nusair ne bataya, humein Ma'arik bin Abbad ne Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bataya ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jumma us par hai jise raat apne ghar tak pahuncha sake." Unhon ne kaha: "To Ahmad bin Hanbal mujhpar naraaz ho gaye aur mujhse kaha: 'Apne Rab se maafi maango, apne Rab se maafi maango.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ahmad bin Hanbal ne aisa isliye kiya kyunki unhon ne is hadith ko kuch nahi samjha aur ise iske isnad ki wajah se kamzor qarar diya.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Prophet would pray the Friday prayer when the sun was declining
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Jumme ki namaz sooraj dhalte hi padhte the.

e: (Another chain) from Anas, :from the Prophet, similarly
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Salamah bin Al-Akwa, Jabir, aur Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ka isi par ittefaq hai ke Jumme ka waqt sooraj dhalne par, Zuhr ke waqt jaisa hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar Jumme ki namaz sooraj dhalne se pehle padhi jaaye to bhi jaayez hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Jisne ise sooraj dhalne se pehle padhi, uspar dobara padhna zaroori nahi.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet would give the Khutbah next to the trunk of a date palm. When he [the Prophet] began using the Minbar the trunk cried out for him until he came to it and held it, so it became quiet
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) khajoor ke ek tane ke paas khutba dete the. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne mimbar banwaya, to wo tana taras kar unke paas aane laga yahan tak ke wo aaya, unhon ne use pakda, to wo shaant ho gaya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Jabir, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ubayy bin Ka'b, Ibn Abbas, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Mu'adh bin Al-Ala Basra ke rehne wale hain, Abu Amr bin Al-Ala ke bhai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet would give a Khutbah on Friday, then sit, then stand and give (another) Khutbah." He said: "Similar to what they do today
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Jumme ke din khutba dete, phir baithte, phir khade hokar khutba dete. Unhon ne kaha: Jaisa tum aaj karte ho. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir bin Abdullah, aur Jabir bin Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko maana ke do khutbon ke darmiyan baith kar alag kiya jaaye.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"I would pray with the Prophet, and his prayer was moderate, and his Khutbah was moderate
hi: Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhta tha, unki namaz mautadil hoti aur unka khutba mautadil hota tha." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ammar bin Yasir aur Ibn Abi Awfa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umayyah narrated from his father who said:"I heard the Prophet reciting, when on the Minbar: And they will cry: "O Malik (keeper of Hell)!"." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and Jabir bin Samurah
hi: Safwan bin Ya'la bin Umayyah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko mimbar par padhte suna: '(Wa Nadaw Ya Malik)' (Aur wo pukarenge: Ae Malik!)." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Jabir bin Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ya'la bin Umayyah ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, aur ye Ibn Uyainah ki hadith hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko chuna ke Imam khutba mein Quran ki kuch Ayaten padhe. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur agar Imam khutba de aur usmein Quran mein se kuch na padhe, to khutba dobara de.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"When Allah's Messenger descending the Minbar he would face our direction
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par khade hote, hum apne chehre unki taraf karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai, aur Mansoor ki hadith hum sirf Muhammad bin Al-Fadl bin Atiyyah ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Muhammad bin Al-Fadl bin Atiyyah kamzor hain, humare asaatiza ke nazdeek unki hadith bekaar hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke jab Imam khutba de to uski taraf mun kiya jaaye. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur is mauzu mein Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi cheez sahih nahi hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"The Prophet was delivering a Khutbah on Friday when a man came. The Prophet said: 'Have you prayed?' He said no. So he said: 'Then stand and pray.'" Abu Eisa said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih [It is the most correct thing about this topic]
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Jumme ke din khutba de rahe the ke ek aadmi aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya tumne namaz padhi?' Usne kaha: Nahi. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Khade ho jao aur rukoo karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, is mauzu par sabse sahih cheez hai.

e: Iyad bin Abdullah bin Abi Sarh narrated:"Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri entered (the mosque) on Friday while Marwan was giving the Khutbah, so he began praying. Two guards came to make him sit down but he refused until he had prayed. When he finished he came to us and we said: 'May Allah have mercy upon you. They nearly harmed you.' He said: 'I was not going to stop performing them (the two Rak'ah) after what I saw from Allah's Messenger.' Then he mentioned that a man who appeared untidy came on Fridy while the Prophet was delivering the Friday Khutbah, so he ordered him to pray two Rak'ah all the while the Prophet was delivering the Khutbah
hi: Iyad bin Abdullah bin Abi Sarh ne riwayat ki ke Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri Jumme ke din daakhil hue jabke Marwan khutba de rahe the, to wo namaz padhne khade ho gaye. Muhaafiz aaye unhen baithane, lekin unhon ne inkar kiya jab tak wo namaz na padh len. Jab wo faariq hue, hum unke paas gaye aur kaha: "Allah aap par reham kare, wo aapko taqreeban nuqsaan pahunchane hi wale the." Unhon ne kaha: "Main unhen do rakat chhodne wala nahi tha us cheez ke baad jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se dekhi." Phir unhon ne zikr kiya ke ek aadmi Jumme ke din bekaar-si haalat mein aaya jabke Nabi (SAW) Jumme ka khutba de rahe the, to unhon ne use hukum diya, to usne do rakat padhi jabke Nabi (SAW) khutba de rahe the. Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha: Sufyan bin Uyainah jab Imam khutba de rahe hote aur wo aate, to do rakat padhte, aur isi ka hukum dete, aur Abu Abdur-Rahman Al-Muqri isi ko maante the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur maine Ibn Abi Umar ko kehte suna: Sufyan bin Uyainah ne kaha: Muhammad bin Ajlan hadith mein thiqah aur ma'mun the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Hurairah, aur Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo daakhil ho jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, to wo baithe aur namaz na padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai. Humein Qutaibah ne bataya, humein Al-Ala bin Khalid Al-Qurashi ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Al-Hasan Al-Basri ko dekha, wo masjid mein daakhil hue Jumme ke din jabke Imam khutba de raha tha, to unhon ne do rakat padhi, phir baithe. Al-Hasan ne aisa sirf hadith ki pairvi mein kiya, unhon ne Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se ye hadith riwayat ki.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever said: 'Be quiet' while the Imam is giving the Khutbah then he has committed Laghw (useless activity)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din, Imam khutba de raha ho, kahe 'Khaamosh raho,' usne befaida kaam kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi baat kare jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, aur unhon ne kaha: Agar koi doosra baat kare, to use sirf ishare se rokna chahiye. Aur unka Salam ka jawab dena aur chheenkne wale ka jawab dena ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Salam ka jawab dena aur chheenkne wale ka jawab dena, Imam ke khutba dene ke waqt bhi, ijazat di, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een aur doosron ne isse napasand kiya, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Sahl bin Ma'adh bin Anas al Jahni narrated from his father that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever steps over the necks of the people on Friday, he has taken a bridge to Hell
hi: Sahl bin Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumme ke din logon ki gardanein langhta hai, wo Jahannam tak ek pul banata hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sahl bin Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Rishdin bin Sa'd ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi Jumme ke din logon ki gardanein langhe, aur ismein sakhti ki. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Rishdin bin Sa'd ke baare mein baat ki aur unhen unki hifz ki wajah se kamzor qarar diya.

e: Sahl bin Ma'adh narrated from his father:"The Prophet prohibited Al-Habwah on Friday while the Imam is delivering the Khutbah
hi: Sahl bin Mu'adh apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Jumme ke din, jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, Al-Habwah se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Marhoom ka naam Abdur-Rahim bin Maimoon hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Jumme ke din, jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, Al-Habwah ko napasand kiya, aur kuch ne isse ijazat di, unmein Abdullah bin Umar aur doosre shaamil hain. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, wo Al-Habwah mein, jabke Imam khutba de raha ho, koi harj nahi maante.

e: Husain narrated:"I heard Umarah bin Rawaibah Ath-Thaqafi - while Bishr bin Marwan was delivering Khutbah and raising his hands in supplication - so Umarah said: 'May Allah disgrace these two insignificant hands, I have seen Allah's Messenger, and he would not do any more than this;'" and Hushaim (one of the narrators) motioned with his index finger
hi: Husain ne kaha: "Maine Umarah bin Ruwaibah Ath-Thaqafi ko sunaa - jabke Bishr bin Marwan khutba de rahe the aur dua mein apne haath uthaa rahe the - to Umarah ne kaha: 'Allah in do chhote haathon ko badsoorat kare, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha hai, aur wo isse zyada kuch nahi karte the'" - aur Hushaim ne shahadat ki ungli se ishara kiya.

e: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid narrated:"The Adhan during the time of Allah's Messenger, Abu Bakr, and Umar was when the Imam came out, [and when] the Iqamah was called for the Salat. Then Uthman [may Allah be pleased with him] added a third call at Az-Zawra
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ke zamane mein azaan tab hoti thi jab Imam bahar aata, aur jab namaz ki iqaamat hoti. Jab Uthman (RA) ka daur aaya, to unhon ne Az-Zawra par teesri azaan zyada ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"Allah's Messenger would talk as necessary after descending from the Minbar
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) mimbar se utarne ke baad zaroorat ki baat karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Jarir bin Hazim ki riwayat se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Jarir bin Hazim ne is hadith mein galtfahmi ki, aur sahih wo hai jo Thabit se, Anas se riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Namaz ki iqaamat ho gayi, to ek aadmi ne Nabi (SAW) ka haath pakda, aur unse baat karta raha yahan tak ke kuch log neend mein aa gaye." Muhammad ne kaha: Aur hadith yahi hai. Aur Jarir bin Hazim kabhi kabhi galtfahmi mein pad jaate hain, lekin wo sachche hain. Muhammad ne kaha: Jarir bin Hazim ne, Thabit se, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se is hadith mein galtfahmi ki, jismein unhon ne kaha: "Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to khade mat ho jab tak mujhe na dekh lo." Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Hammad bin Zaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Hum Thabit Al-Bunani ke paas the, to Hajjaj As-Sawwaf ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se bataya ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to khade mat ho jab tak mujhe na dekh lo." To Jarir ko galtfahmi hui aur unhon ne samjha ke Thabit ne unhen ye Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se bataya.

e: Anas narrated:"I saw the Prophet, after the Iqamah was called for Salat, talking to a man who was standing between him and the Qiblah, he did not stop talking, and I saw some of them getting sleepy from his lengthy standing the Prophet
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, namaz ki iqaamat ho jaane ke baad, ek aadmi unse baat kar raha tha, unke aur Qibla ke darmiyan khada hokar, wo baat karta hi rehta tha, maine humare kuch logon ko Nabi (SAW) ke lambe khade rehne ki wajah se ooghte hue dekha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi the freed slave of Allah's Messenger said:"Marwan left Abu Hurairah in charge of Al-Madinah and he went to Makkah. So Abu Hurairah led us in Salat in Friday, reciting Surah Al-Jumuah (in the first Rak'ah) and in the second prostration (Rak'ah): When the hypocrites come to you." Ubaidullah said: "So I caught up with Abu Hurairah and said to him: 'You recited two Surah that Ali recited in Al-Kufah. Abu Hurairah said: 'Indeed I heard Allah's Messenger reciting them
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam, ne kaha: "Marwan ne Abu Hurairah ko Madina mein apna khalifa banaya aur Makkah chale gaye. To Abu Hurairah ne humein Jumme ke din namaz padhayi, Surah Al-Jumu'ah padhi aur doosri rakat mein: '(Idha Ja'akal-Munafiqun)'." Ubaidullah ne kaha: "To maine Abu Hurairah se mulaqat ki aur unse kaha: Aap wo do Surahen padhte hain jo Ali (Alayhis Salam) Kufa mein padhte the. Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko inhen padhte suna." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, An-Nu'man bin Bashir, aur Abu Inabah Al-Khawlani se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Jumme ki namaz mein '(Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la)' aur '(Hal Ataka Hadithul-Ghashiyah)' padhi. Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke katib hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"For the Fajr prayer on Friday, Allah's Messenger would recite: Alif Lam Mem (which is) revealed in (Surat) As-Sajdah and, Has there not been over man
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Jumme ke din Fajr ki namaz mein Surah As-Sajdah aur '(Hal Ata Alal-Insan)' padhte the." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Shu'bah, aur kai doosron ne Mukhawwal se riwayat ki hai.

e: Salim narrated from his father:"The Prophet would pray two Rak;ah after the Friday prayer
hi: Salim apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hain ke wo Jumme ke baad do rakat padhte the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Nafi se, Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai.

e: Nafi narrated about Ibn Umar:"When he prayed the Friday prayer, he left and prayed two prostrations (Rak'ah) in his house. Then he said: 'Allah's Messenger would do this
hi: Nafi ne Ibn Umar ke baare mein bataya: Jab wo Jumma padh lete, to wo apne ghar jaakar do rakat padhte, phir kehte: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aisa karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "Whoever among you is to pray after the Friday prayer, then let him pray four
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se jo Jumme ke baad namaz padhna chahe, wo chaar rakat padhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Humein Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bataya, humein Ali bin Al-Madini ne Sufyan bin Uyainah se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Hum Suhail bin Abi Salih ko hadith mein bharosemand maante the. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke wo Jumme se pehle chaar aur uske baad chaar rakat padhte the. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Jumme ke baad do rakat, phir chaar rakat padhne ka hukum diya. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne Ibn Mas'ud ke qaul ko apnaya. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Agar masjid mein Jumme ke din namaz padhe to chaar rakat padhe, aur agar apne ghar mein padhe to do rakat padhe. Aur unhon ne dalil di ke Nabi (SAW) Jumme ke baad apne ghar mein do rakat padhte the, aur Nabi (SAW) ki hadith \"Tum mein se jo Jumme ke baad namaz padhna chahe, wo chaar rakat padhe\" se bhi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar hi hain jinhon ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki ke wo Jumme ke baad apne ghar mein do rakat padhte the, aur Ibn Umar khud Nabi (SAW) ke baad masjid mein Jumme ke baad do rakat padhte the, phir un do rakaton ke baad chaar rakat padhte the. Humein ye Ibn Abi Umar ne bataya, humein Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Ibn Juraij se, Ata se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Ibn Umar ko Jumme ke baad do rakat padhte dekha, phir uske baad chaar rakat padhte. Humein Sa'eed bin Abdur-Rahman Al-Makhzumi ne bataya, humein Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Amr bin Dinar se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine kisi ko Az-Zuhri se zyada hadith ka jaankaar nahi dekha, aur maine kisi ko unse zyada dinar aur dirham ko haqeer samajhte nahi dekha, unke nazdeek dinar aur dirham oont ki mengni jaisi haisiyat rakhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Umar ko kehte suna, maine Sufyan bin Uyainah ko kehte suna: Amr bin Dinar, Az-Zuhri se umr mein bade the.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever catches a Rak'ah of the Salat then he has caught the Salat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo namaz ki ek rakat paa le, usne namaz paa li." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo Jumme ki ek rakat paa le, wo uske saath doosri padhe, aur jo unhen baithe hue paa le, wo chaar rakat padhe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Sahl bin Sa'd narrated:"We would not have lunch during the time of Allah's Messenger, nor would we have a siesta, until after the Friday prayer
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein na dopahar ka khaana khaate the na aaraam karte the siwaye Jumme ke baad." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sahl bin Sa'd ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "When one of you becomes sleepy during the Friday prayer, then let him move from where he is sitting
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi Jumme ke din oonghe, to wo apni jagah se hat jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet sent Abdullah bin Rawahah to lead a military detachment, and that corresponded to a Friday. So his companions left early in the day, and he said: 'I will remain behind to pray with Allah's Messenger then meet up with them.' When he prayed with the Prophet, he saw him and said: 'What prevented you from leaving earlier with your companions?' He said: 'I wanted to pray with you then meet up with them.' He said: 'If you have spent [all of] what is in the earth, you would not have achieved the virtue you have had you left early in the day with them
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Rawahah ko ek lashkar mein bheja, aur ye Jumme ke din se mel khaa gaya. Unke saathi subah nikal gaye, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main peeche rukoon aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath namaz padhoon, phir unse mil jaaoon.' Jab unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath namaz padhi, to unhon ne unhen dekha aur farmaya: 'Tumhein apne saathiyon ke saath subah jaane se kya rok liya?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine chaaha ke aapke saath namaz padhoon, phir unse mil jaaoon.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar tum poori zameen ki cheezein bhi kharch kar dete, to bhi tum unki subah jaane ki fazilat ko na paate.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: Shu'bah ne kaha: Al-Hakam ne Miqsam se sirf paanch hadithein sunee hain. Shu'bah ne unhen gina, aur ye hadith un mein shaamil nahi jo Shu'bah ne gine, isliye goya ye hadith Al-Hakam ne Miqsam se suni nahi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Jumme ke din safar karne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne isse koi harj nahi maana ke Jumme ke din safar par nikla jaaye jab tak namaz ka waqt na aa jaaye. Aur kuch ne kaha: Jab subah ho jaaye, to wo Jumma padhne tak na nikle.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated that :Allah's Messenger said: "It is a duty for the Muslims, that they perform Ghusl on Friday, and that each of them wear some of his family's perfume. If he does not find any, then water is a perfume for him
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon par ye farz hai ke wo Jumme ke din ghusl karen, aur unmein se koi apne ghar wale ki khushbu se khud ko khushboo laga le, agar na paaye to paani hi uske liye khushbu hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Ansar mein se ek buzurg se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated:(Another route for the same chain) similar in meaning
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se, Yazid bin Abi Ziyad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Hushaim ki riwayat, Ismail bin Ibrahim At-Taimi ki riwayat se behtar hai. Aur Ismail bin Ibrahim At-Taimi ko hadith mein kamzor qarar diya jaata hai.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated:"It is from the SUnnah to leave for the Eid walking, and to eat something before leaving
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Sunnat mein se hai ke tum Eid ke liye paidal jao, aur jaane se pehle kuch khaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke aadmi Eid ke liye paidal jaaye, aur Fitr ki namaz ke liye jaane se pehle kuch khaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye bhi pasand kiya jaata hai ke koi uzr na ho to sawaari na li jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"Allah's Messenger, Abu Bakr, and Umar would pray during the two Eid before the Khutbah, then they would give the Khutbah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar Eidain mein khutba se pehle namaz padhte, phir khutba dete." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Eidain ki namaz khutba se pehle hoti hai. Aur kaha jaata hai ke sabse pehle namaz se pehle khutba dene wale Marwan bin Al-Hakam the.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"I prayed the two Eid prayers with the Prophet - not one time, not two times - without and Adhan nor an Iqamah
hi: Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Eidain ki namaz ek nahi, do nahi, balki kai baar padhi, bagair azaan ke aur bagair iqaamat ke." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir bin Abdullah aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Eidain ki namaz ke liye ya kisi bhi nafl namaz ke liye azaan nahi di jaati.

e: An-Numan bin Bashir narrated:"For the two Eid and the Friday prayer, the Prophet would recite: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High, and Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming? And sometimes they would occur on he same day, so he would recite the two of them
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Eidain aur Jumme mein '(Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la)' aur '(Hal Ataka Hadithul-Ghashiyah)' padhte the. Aur kabhi kabhi ye dono ek hi din mil jaate, to wo dono padhte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Waqid, Samurah bin Jundub, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: An-Nu'man bin Bashir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur isi tarah Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Mis'ar ne Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Al-Muntashir se, Abu Awanah ki hadith jaisi hi riwayat ki. Aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ke baare mein riwayat mein ikhtilaaf hai, unse Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Al-Muntashir se, apne walid se, Habib bin Salim se, apne walid se, An-Nu'man bin Bashir se riwayat hai. Aur hum Habib bin Salim ki apne walid se koi riwayat nahi jaante. Aur Habib bin Salim, An-Nu'man bin Bashir ke azaad kiye gulam hain, unhon ne An-Nu'man bin Bashir se hadithein riwayat ki hain. Aur Ibn Uyainah se, Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Al-Muntashir se, in logon ki riwayat jaisi bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo Eidain ki namaz mein '(Iqtarabatis-Sa'ah)' padhte the, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah narrated:"Umar bin Al-Khattab asked Abu Waqid Al-Laithi what Allah's Messenger would recite during Al-Fitr and Al-Adha, so he said: 'He would recite: Qaf, By the Glorious Quran and the Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah ne riwayat ki ke Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Abu Waqid Al-Laithi se pucha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fitr aur Adha mein kya padhte the?" Unhon ne kaha: "Wo '(Qaf. Wal-Qur'anil-Majid)' aur '(Iqtarabatis-Sa'atu wan-shaqqal-Qamar)' padhte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah:There is a another chain with similar narration
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Waqid Al-Laithi ka naam Al-Harith bin Awf hai.

e: Kathir bin Abdullah narrated from this father, from his grandfather:"The Prophet said the Takbir in the first (Rak'ah) sever (times) before the recitation, and in the last, five (times) before the recitation
hi: Kathir bin Abdullah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Eidain mein pehli rakat mein qiraat se pehle saat Takbir kahin, aur aakhri mein qiraat se pehle paanch Takbir kahin. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Umar, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Kathir ke dada ki hadith hasan hai, aur ye is mauzu par Nabi (Alaihis Salaam) se riwayat ki gayi sabse achi cheez hai. Unka naam Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unmein Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosre shaamil hain. Aur isi tarah Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Madina mein isi jaisi namaz padhi, aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka bhi yehi qaul hai. Aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Eidain ki Takbir ke baare mein kaha: Pehli rakat mein qiraat se pehle paanch Takbir, aur doosri rakat mein qiraat se pehli shuru hoti, phir rukoo ki Takbir ke saath chaar Takbir kahi jaatin. Aur isi jaisi Nabi (SAW) ke kai Sahaba se riwayat hui hai, aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka bhi.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet went out on the day of Al-Fitr, so he prayed two Rak'ah, then he did not pray before it nor after it
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Fitr ke din bahar nikle, do rakat padhi, phir unse pehle ya baad mein koi namaz nahi padhi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Umar, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke ek jamaat ne, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron mein se, Eidain ki namaz se pehle aur baad namaz padhna maana hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Bakr bin Hafs - and he is Ibn Umar bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqas - narrated about Ibn Umar, that:"He went out on the day of Eid, and he did not pray before it nor after it. He mentioned that the Prophet did so
hi: Abu Bakr bin Hafs, jo Ibn Umar bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas hain, ne Ibn Umar ke baare mein bataya ke wo Eid ke din bahar nikle, na usse pehle na baad mein namaz padhi, aur zikr kiya ke Nabi (SAW) ne aisa hi kiya tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umm Atiyyah narrated:"Allah's Messenger would order the virgins, the mature women, the secluded and the menstruating to go out for the two Eid. As for the menstruating women, they were to stay away from the Musalla and participate in the Muslims supplications." One of them said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What if she does not have a Jilbab? He said: 'Then let her sis lend her a Jilbab
hi: Umm Atiyyah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kunwaari ladkiyon, jawan auraton, parde mein rehne wali auraton, aur haiz waali auraton ko Eidain mein le jaane ka hukum dete the. Haiz waali auraton ko musalla se door rehna hota, aur wo Musalmanon ki dua mein shaamil rehtin. Un mein se ek ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar uske paas jilbab na ho to?" Unhon ne farmaya: "To uski bahen use apni jilbab udhaar de de."

e: There is a similar narration from Umm Atiyyah :with another chain
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - Umm Atiyyah se, isi jaisi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Atiyyah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ko apnaya aur auraton ko Eidain mein jaane ki ijazat di, aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Main aaj kal auraton ka Eidain mein jaana napasand karta hoon, agar aurat zid kare ke wo zaroor jaayegi, to uska shohar use ijazat de ke wo apne purane, mamooli kapdon mein jaaye aur singaar na kare, aur agar wo aisa jaane se inkar kare, to shohar use jaane se rok sakta hai. Aur Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: "Agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) dekhte ke auraton ne kya naya ijaad kar liya hai, to wo unhen masjid se aisa hi rok dete jaise Bani Israel ki auratein roki gayi thin." Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri se riwayat hai ke unhon ne aaj kal auraton ke liye Eid mein jaane ko napasand kiya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"When Allah's Messenger would go out on the day of Eid by one route, he would return by another
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) jab Eid ke din ek raste se nikalte, to doosre raste se lautte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Umar aur Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Tumailah aur Yunus bin Muhammad ne ye hadith Fulaih bin Sulaiman se, Sa'eed bin Al-Harith se, Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ki pairvi mein pasand kiya ke Imam jab ek raste se nikle to doosre se laute. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Jabir ki hadith goya zyada sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated from his father:"The Prophet would not leave on the Day of Fitr until he ate, and he would not eat on the day of Adha until he prayed
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Fitr ke din tab tak nahi nikalte the jab tak kuch kha na lete, aur Adha ke din tab tak nahi khaate the jab tak namaz na padh lete." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Buraidah bin Al-Husaib Al-Aslami ki hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Muhammad ne kaha: Mujhe Thawab bin Utbah ki is hadith ke siwaye koi doosri riwayat maloom nahi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke ek jamaat ne pasand kiya ke Fitr ke din kuch khaaye bagair na nikla jaaye, aur unhen ye bhi pasand hai ke wo khajoor se roza khole, aur Adha ke din tab tak na khaaye jab tak wapas na aa jaaye.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Prophet would have a breakfast of dates on the Day of Fitr before leaving for the Musalla
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Fitr ke din, Musalla ki taraf jaane se pehle, khajooron se roza kholte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I traveled with the Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman; they would pray Zuhr and Asr as two Rak'ah and two Rak'ah, not praying before them nor after them." And Ibn Umar said: "If I was going to pray before it or after it then I would pray it complete
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman ke saath safar kiya; wo Zuhr aur Asr do-do rakat padhte, na unse pehle na unke baad kuch padhte." Aur Abdullah (bin Umar) ne kaha: "Agar main unse pehle ya baad mein kuch padhta, to poora padhta." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Anas, Imran bin Husain, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Yahya bin Sulaim ki isi tarah ki riwayat se jaante hain. Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Ubaidullah bin Umar se, Aal-e-Suraqah ke ek aadmi se, Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Atiyyah Al-Awfi se, Ibn Umar se riwayat hui hai ke Nabi (SAW) safar mein namaz se pehle aur baad mein nafl padhte the. Aur Nabi (SAW) se sahih riwayat hai ke wo safar mein namaz qasr karte the, aur Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman bhi apni khilafat ke shuru mein aisa karte the. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Aishah se riwayat hai ke wo safar mein poori namaz padhti thin. Aur amal us par hai jo Nabi (SAW) aur unke Sahaba se riwayat hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, siwaye is ke ke Ash-Shafi'i kehte hain: Qasr karna safar mein rukhsat hai, agar wo poori namaz padhe to bhi kaafi hai.

e: Abu An-Nadrah said:"Imran bin Husain was asked about the traveler's prayer. He said: 'I performed Hajj with the Messenger of Allah, and he prayed two Rak'ah. I performed Hajj with Abu Bakr, and he prayed two Rak'ah and with Umar, and he prayed two Rak;ah; and with Uthman for six years of his Khilafah, or eight years, and he prayed two Rak'ah
hi: Abu An-Nadrah ne kaha: "Imran bin Husain se musafir ki namaz ke baare mein pucha gaya. Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya, to unhon ne do rakat padhi. Maine Abu Bakr ke saath Hajj kiya, to unhon ne do rakat padhi. Aur Umar ke saath, to unhon ne do rakat padhi. Aur Uthman ke saath, unki khilafat ke chhe ya aath saal, to unhon ne do rakat padhi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"We prayed Zuhr as four with the Prophet in Al-Madinah, and Asr as two Rak'ah in Dhil-Hulaifah
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Zuhr Madina mein chaar rakat padhi, aur Dhul-Hulaifah mein Asr do rakat padhi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet went from Al-Madinah to Makkah, not fearing anyone except Allah the Lord of the worlds, and he prayed two Rak'ah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Madina se Makkah nikle, Allah, saari duniyaon ke Rab, ke siwa kisi se na darte hue, aur unhon ne do rakat padhi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Yahya bin Abi Ishaq Al-Hadrami narrated :that Anas bin Malik said: "We went with the Messenger of Allah from Al-Madinah to Makkah, and he prayed two Rak'ah." He said: "I said to Anas: 'How long did Messenger of Allah stay in Makkah?' He said: 'Ten (days)
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Madina se Makkah nikle, to unhon ne do rakat padhi." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine Anas se pucha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Makkah mein kitne din rahe? Unhon ne kaha: 'Das din.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo apne kisi safar mein unnees din rahe, do rakat padhte hue. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "To agar hum unnees din tak rukein, to hum do rakat padhte hain, aur agar isse zyada rukein, to hum poori namaz padhte hain." Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Jo das din theher jaaye wo poori namaz padhe. Aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Jo pandra din theher jaaye wo poori namaz padhe. Aur unse baarah din bhi riwayat hai. Aur Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Agar wo chaar din theher jaaye to chaar rakat padhe. Aur unse Qatadah aur Ata Al-Khurasani ne isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Dawud bin Abi Hind ne unse iske khilaf riwayat ki. Aur baad mein ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hua, Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waale pandra din ki muddat maante the, unhon ne kaha: Agar wo pandra din theherne ka pakka irada kare, to poori namaz padhe. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Agar wo baarah din theherne ka pakka irada kare, to poori namaz padhe. Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad ne kaha: Agar wo chaar din theherne ka pakka irada kare, to poori namaz padhe. Aur Ishaq ne is mauzu par sabse mazboot mazhab Ibn Abbas ki hadith ko maana, unhon ne kaha kyunki unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, phir Nabi (SAW) ke baad iski tashreeh ki: agar wo unnees din theherne ka pakka irada kare, to poori namaz padhe. Phir ahl-e-ilm ka ittefaq hua ke musafir tab tak qasr karta rahe jab tak wo theherne ka pakka irada na kare, chahe usse saal guzar jaayen.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah traveled on a journey and he prayed two Rak'ah for nineteen days." Ibn Abbas said: "So when we would stay somewhere for nineteen (days) we would pray two Rak'ah , and if we stayed longer than that we would complete the Salat
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek safar kiya aur unnees din tak do-do rakat padhi." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "To hum unnees din tak do-do rakat padhte hain, aur agar isse zyada theherein to chaar padhte hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib said:"I accompanied the Messenger of Allah on eighteen journeys, and I did not see him leave the two Rak'ah when the sun waned before Zuhr
hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath atthaara safar kiye, maine unhen Zuhr se pehle, sooraj dhalte hi, do rakat chhodte kabhi nahi dekha." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith ghareeb hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is baare mein pucha, to unhen ye sirf Laith bin Sa'd ki hadith se maloom thi, aur unhen Abu Busrah Al-Ghifari ka naam maloom nahi tha, aur unhon ne ise hasan maana. Aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) safar mein namaz se pehle aur baad mein nafl nahi padhte the. Aur unse hi, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hai ke wo safar mein nafl padhte the. Phir Nabi (SAW) ke baad ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hua, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne maana ke aadmi safar mein nafl padh sakta hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke ek jamaat ne isse pehle ya baad mein padhna theek nahi samjha. Aur jo safar mein nafl nahi padhta uska matlab ye hai ke usne rukhsat qubool ki, aur jo padhta hai uske liye ismein bahut fazilat hai. Aur ye zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, wo safar mein nafl padhna behtar samajhte hain.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I prayed Zuhr with the Prophet on a journey as two Rak'ah, and two Rak'ah after it
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath safar mein Zuhr do rakat padhi aur uske baad do rakat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Ibn Abi Laila ne ise Atiyyah aur Nafi se, Ibn Umar se riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I prayed with the Prophet both, while a resident and while traveling. So I prayed four for Zuhr with him as a resident, and two Rak'ah after it. I prayed two Rak'ah for Zuhr with him while traveling and two Rak'ah after it, and two Rak'ah for Asr, and he did not pray anything after it. Maghrib while a resident and traveling is the same; three Rak'ah, it is not decreased as a resident nor while traveling. It is Witr of the day, and after it are two Rak'ah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath ghar mein aur safar mein namaz padhi. Ghar mein maine unke saath Zuhr chaar rakat padhi aur uske baad do rakat, aur safar mein maine unke saath Zuhr do rakat padhi aur uske baad do rakat, aur Asr do rakat, aur unhon ne uske baad kuch nahi padha. Aur Maghrib, ghar aur safar mein barabar hai, teen rakat, na ghar mein kam hoti hai na safar mein, ye din ka Witr hai, aur uske baad do rakat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Ibn Abi Laila ki koi hadith mujhe is se zyada acchi nahi lagi, lekin main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta.

e: Mu'adh bin Jabal narrated:"While the Prophet as at the Battle of Tabuk, if he wanted to depart before the sun's decline he would delay Zuhr so that he could pray it together with Asr. If he wanted to depart after the sun's decline, he would hasten Asr to Zuhr, and pray Zuhr and Asr together, and then move it. If he wanted to depart before Maghrib he would delay Maghrib until he prayed it with Isha, and if he wanted to depart after Maghrib he would hasten Isha so that he would pray it along with Maghrib
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein, jab wo sooraj dhalne se pehle safar shuru karte, to Zuhr ko Asr ke saath jama karne tak der karte, aur donon ek saath padhte; aur jab wo sooraj dhalne ke baad safar shuru karte, to Asr ko Zuhr ke saath jaldi karte, aur Zuhr-Asr ek saath padh kar phir safar shuru karte. Aur jab wo Maghrib se pehle safar shuru karte, to Maghrib ko Isha ke saath padhne tak der karte, aur jab wo Maghrib ke baad safar shuru karte, to Isha ko jaldi karte aur Maghrib ke saath padhte. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Umar, Anas, Abdullah bin Amr, Aishah, Ibn Abbas, Usamah bin Zaid, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Usamah se sahih riwayat hai. Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne Ahmad bin Hanbal se, Qutaibah se, ye hadith riwayat ki.

e: (Another chain) Qutaibah narrated :this Hadith to us, meaning the Hadith of Mu'adh
hi: Qutaibah ne humein ye hadith bataya, yani Mu'adh ki hadith. Aur Mu'adh ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, Qutaibah isme akele hain, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne ise Laith se, unke siwa riwayat ki ho. Aur Laith ki, Yazid bin Abi Habib se, Abu At-Tufail se, Mu'adh se riwayat ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek mashhoor Mu'adh ki hadith, Abu Az-Zubair se, Abu At-Tufail se, Mu'adh se hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Zuhr-Asr aur Maghrib-Isha jama kiye. Ise Qurrah bin Khalid, Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik, aur kai doosron ne Abu Az-Zubair Al-Makki se riwayat ki hai. Aur isi hadith ko Ash-Shafi'i mante hain. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq kehte hain: Safar mein do namazon ko ek waqt mein jama karne mein koi harj nahi.

e: Nafi narrated:"Ibn Umar had been requested to urgently attend to one of his wives, so he hurried en route and delayed Maghrib until the twilight disappeared, then he dismounted to combine them (the prayers). Then he informed them that the Messenger of Allah would do that when he was in a hurry on a trip
hi: Nafi ne riwayat ki ke Ibn Umar se apne kisi ghar wale ke liye fariyaad ki gayi, to unhon ne raftaar tez ki aur Maghrib ko der se padha yahan tak ke shafaq ghaayab ho gayi, phir utre aur donon ko jama kiya, phir unhen bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aisa karte the jab safar mein jaldi karte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Laith ki, Yazid bin Abi Habib se riwayat hasan sahih hai.

e: Abbad bin Tamim narrated from his uncle:"The Messenger of Allah went out with the people to seek rain. So he led them in prayer for two Rak'ah, reciting aloud in them, turning his upper wrap around, raising his hands, requesting rain, and facing the Qiblah
hi: Abbad bin Tamim apne chacha se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) log logon ko lekar baarish maangne nikle, to unhen do rakat padhayi, unmein zor se qiraat ki, apni chadar ulti ki, apne haath uthaaye, baarish maangi, aur Qibla ki taraf mun kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Aabil-Lahm se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Zaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abbad bin Tamim ke chacha Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim Al-Mazini hain.

e: Umair, the freed slave of Abi Al-Lahm narrated from Abi Al-Lahm that :he saw the Messenger of Allah at Ahjar Az-Zait, supplicating for rain, and he was raising his hands in supplication
hi: Umair, Aabil-Lahm ke azaad kiye gulam, Aabil-Lahm se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ahjar Az-Zait ke paas dekha, baarish maangte hue, apni donon hatheliyan khole hue dua karte hue. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Qutaibah ne is hadith mein "Aabil-Lahm se" kaha, aur hum unki Nabi (SAW) se koi doosri riwayat is ek hadith ke siwa nahi jaante. Aur Umair, Aabil-Lahm ke azaad kiye gulam, ne Nabi (SAW) se hadithein riwayat ki hain aur wo Sahabi hain.

e: It is narrated from Hisham bin Ishaq - and he was from Ibn Abdullah bin Kinanah - from his father who said:"Al-Walid bin Uqbah, the governor of Al-Madinah, sent me to ask Ibn Abbas about how the Messenger of Allah would perform Salat Al-Istisqa. I came to him and he said: 'The Messenger of Allah would go out in modest dress, humbly, imploring, until he reached the Musalla. He would not give this Khutbah of yours, rather, he would continue supplication and imploring saying the Takbir, and pray two Rak'ah, just as he would pray for the Eid
hi: Ibn Abdullah bin Kinanah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Al-Walid bin Uqbah, jo Madina ke ameer the, ne mujhe Ibn Abbas ke paas bheja unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Istisqa ke baare mein pucchne. Maine unke paas jaakar pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mamooli kapdon mein, aajizi se, ginguzari karte hue nikle, yahan tak ke Musalla par pahunche. Unhon ne tumhare is khutbe jaisa khutba nahi diya, balki wo dua, aajizi, aur Takbir mein lage rahe, aur do rakat namaz padhi jaisa wo Eid mein padhte the.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: (Another chain) from Hisham bin Ishaq bin Abdullah bin Kinanah, from his father, :and he mentioned a similar narration and added: "with humility" to it
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se, aur ismein "aajizi se jhukte hue" ka izafa hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Istisqa ki namaz Eidain ki namaz jaisi padhi jaaye, pehli rakat mein saat aur doosri mein paanch Takbir kahi jaaye, aur unhon ne Ibn Abbas ki hadith se dalil li. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Malik bin Anas se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Istisqa ki namaz mein Eidain jaisi Takbir nahi kahi jaati. Aur An-Nu'man Abu Hanifah ne kaha: Istisqa ki namaz nahi padhi jaati, aur main unhen chadar palatne ka hukum nahi deta, balki wo dua karke wapas laut jaayen. Abu Isa ne kaha: Unhon ne Sunnat ke khilaf kaha.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet prayed during the eclipse. He recited, then bowed, then recited, then bowed, then recited, then bowed. (three times), then he performed two prostrations, and the next one (Rak'ah) was the same
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne suraj grahan mein namaz padhi, qiraat ki, phir rukoo kiya, phir qiraat ki, phir rukoo kiya, phir qiraat ki, phir rukoo kiya, teen martaba, phir do sajde kiye, aur doosri rakat bhi waisi hi thi. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Abdullah bin Amr, An-Nu'man bin Bashir, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah, Abu Mas'ud, Abu Bakrah, Samurah, Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari, Ibn Mas'ud, Asma bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq, Ibn Umar, Qabisah Al-Hilali, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah, aur Ubayy bin Ka'b se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se ye bhi riwayat hui hai ke unhon ne suraj grahan mein chaar rakat, chaar sajdon mein padhi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ka grahan ki namaz mein qiraat ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne pasand kiya ke din mein aahista qiraat ki jaaye. Aur kuch ne zor se qiraat karna pasand kiya, Eidain aur Jumme ki namaz jaisa, aur Malik, Ahmad, aur Ishaq zor se padhna maante hain. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Zor se na padha jaaye. Aur Nabi (SAW) se donon riwayaten sahih hain, sahih hai ke unhon ne chaar rakat, chaar sajdon mein padhi, aur ye bhi sahih hai ke unhon ne chhe rakat, chaar sajdon mein padhi. Aur ye ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek grahan ki lambaai ke hisaab se jaayez hai, agar grahan lamba ho to chhe rakat, chaar sajdon mein padhe, ye jaayez hai, aur agar chaar rakat, chaar sajdon mein padhe aur qiraat lambi kare, ye bhi jaayez hai. Aur humare asaatiza maante hain ke grahan ki namaz sooraj aur chaand dono ke grahan mein jamaat mein padhi jaaye.

e: Aishah narrated:"The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah, so the Messenger of Allah led the people in prayer. He recited a lengthy recitation, then he bowed a lengthy bowing, then he raised his head and recited a lengthy recitation that was less than the first. Then he bowed a lengthy bowing that was less than the first. Then he raised his head and prostrated. Then he did (similar to) that in the second Rak'ah
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Sooraj grahan hua Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne logon ki imamat ki, lambi qiraat ki, phir rukoo kiya, lamba rukoo kiya, phir apna sar uthaya, lambi qiraat ki jo pehli se kam thi, phir rukoo kiya, lamba rukoo kiya jo pehle se kam tha, phir apna sar uthaya aur sajda kiya, phir doosri rakat mein waisa hi kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur isi hadith ko Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq maante hain, wo grahan ki namaz chaar rakat, chaar sajdon mein maante hain. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Pehli rakat mein Umm-ul-Quran aur taqreeban Surah Al-Baqarah jitna aahista padhe, agar din mein ho, phir lamba rukoo kare taqreeban apni qiraat jitna, phir Takbir kehte hue apna sar uthaye aur khada rahe jaisa tha, aur phir Umm-ul-Quran aur taqreeban Aal-e-Imran jitna padhe, phir lamba rukoo kare taqreeban apni qiraat jitna, phir apna sar uthaye, phir kahe "Sami' Allahu Liman Hamidah," phir do mukammal sajde kare, aur har sajde mein taqreeban utni der rahe jitni rukoo mein rahi, phir khada ho aur Umm-ul-Quran aur taqreeban Surah An-Nisa jitna padhe, phir lamba rukoo kare taqreeban apni qiraat jitna, phir Takbir kehte hue apna sar uthaye aur khada rahe, phir taqreeban Surah Al-Maidah jitna padhe, phir lamba rukoo kare taqreeban apni qiraat jitna, phir uthe aur kahe "Sami' Allahu Liman Hamidah," phir do sajde kare, phir Tashahhud kare aur Salam kahe.

e: Samurah bin Jundah narrated:"The Prophet led us in prayer during an eclipse; we did not hear his voice
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne humein grahan mein namaz padhayi, humein unki awaaz sunayi nahi deti thi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet prayed the eclipse payer, and he recited aloud in it
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne grahan ki namaz padhi aur usmein zor se qiraat ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari ne Sufyan bin Husain se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur is hadith ko Malik bin Anas, Ahmad, aur Ishaq maante hain.

e: Salim narrated from his father:"The Prophet prayed Salat Al-Khawf, praying one Rak'ah with one of the two groups, while the other group was facing the enemy. (When the first group finished they first Rak'ah with him), they went and took position (of the second group, facing the enemy). Then the second group came and he led them in another Rak'ah, then he said the Taslim to them, while the group proceeded to complete their (second) Rak'ah. Thereafter, the first group stood up to finish their (second) Rak'ah
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Salat-ul-Khauf padhi, ek jamaat ko ek rakat padhayi jabke doosri jamaat dushman ke saamne thi, phir wo hat gaye aur unki jagah khade ho gaye, aur doosri jamaat aayi, to unhen ek aur rakat padhayi, phir unhen Salam kaha. To ye log khade hue aur apni rakat poori ki, aur wo log khade hue aur apni rakat poori ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai. Aur Musa bin Uqbah ne Nafi se, Ibn Umar se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Hudhaifah, Zaid bin Thabit, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Mas'ud, Sahl bin Abi Hathmah, Abu Ayyash Az-Zuraqi (jinka naam Zaid bin Samit hai), aur Abu Bakrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Malik bin Anas ne Salat-ul-Khauf mein Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ki hadith ko maana, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se Salat-ul-Khauf kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai, aur mujhe is mauzu par sab sahih hadithein lagti hain, lekin main Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ki hadith chunta hoon. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne bhi isi tarah kaha: Nabi (SAW) se Salat-ul-Khauf ki riwayaten saabit hain. Aur unka maanna tha ke jo bhi Nabi (SAW) se Salat-ul-Khauf mein riwayat hui hai wo jaayez hai, ye khauf ki nauiyat par munhasir hai. Ishaq ne kaha: Aur hum Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ki hadith ko doosri riwayaton par tarjeeh nahi dete.

e: Sahl bin Abi Hathmah said about Salat Al-Khawf:"The Imam stands facing the Qiblah while a group of them stand with him, and a group is before the enemy, facing the enemy. He leads them in a Rak'ah, and they perform a bowing by themselves, and they perform two prostrations in their places. Then they go to take the position of the others and the others come (for prayers). He (the Imam) bows for one Rak'ah with them and performs two prostrations with them. That is two for him and one for them, then they perform one bowing and two prostrations
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ne Salat-ul-Khauf ke baare mein kaha: "Imam Qibla ki taraf mun karke khada hota hai, aur unmein se ek jamaat uske saath khadi hoti hai, aur ek jamaat dushman ki taraf, unka mun dushman ki taraf hota hai. Wo unhen ek rakat mein rukoo karata hai, aur wo apne liye ek rakat rukoo karte hain, aur apni jagah do sajde karte hain. Phir wo un doosron ki jagah chale jaate hain, aur wo doosre aa jaate hain, to wo unhen ek rakat mein rukoo karata hai aur unhen do sajde karata hai. Wo do rakat ho jaati hain aur unke liye ek. Phir wo ek rakat rukoo karte hain aur do sajde karte hain."

e: (Abu Eisa said:) Muhammad bin Bash-har said: "I asked Yahya bin Sa'eed (narrators in no. 565) about this Hadith. So he narrated it to me from Shu'bah, from Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim, from his father, from Salih bin Khawwat, from Sahl bin Abi Hathmah, from the Prophet - the same as the Hadith of Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari. And he (Yahya) said to me: "Write it next to it. He did not memorize the Hadith better though, rather it is the same Hadith as that of Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari'" (a Hadith similar to no. 565, with a different chain of narrators)
hi: Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Bashshar ne kaha: "Maine Yahya bin Sa'eed se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne mujhe Shu'bah se, Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Salih bin Khawwat se, Sahl bin Abi Hathmah se, Nabi (SAW) se, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ki hadith jaisi hi bataya. Aur Yahya ne mujhse kaha: Ise iske bagal mein likh lo, main hadith yaad nahi rakhta, lekin ye Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ki hadith jaisi hi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ne ise Al-Qasim bin Muhammad se marfu' nahi kiya, aur isi tarah Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ke saathiyon ne ise mauqoof riwayat kiya, aur Shu'bah ne ise Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim bin Muhammad se marfu' kiya.

e: It was reported by Malik from Yazid bin Ruman, :from Salih bin Khawwat, from someone who prayed Salat Al-Khawf with the Prophet, and he mentioned a similar narration
hi: Malik bin Anas ne Yazid bin Ruman se, Salih bin Khawwat se, us shakhs se jo Nabi (SAW) ke saath Salat-ul-Khauf mein shaamil tha, riwayat ki, aur isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kai logon se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek jamaat ko ek-ek rakat padhi, to Nabi (SAW) ke liye do rakat hui aur unke liye ek-ek rakat. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ayyash Az-Zuraqi ka naam Zaid bin Samit hai.

e: Abu Ad-Darda narrated:"I performed eleven prostrations (of recitation) with the Messenger of Allah, among them was that which is in Surat An-Najm
hi: Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gyarah sajde kiye, unmein wo bhi tha jo Surah An-Najm mein hai."

e: (Another chain in which) Abu Ad-Darda narrated:"I performed eleven prostrations with the Messenger of Allah, among them was that which is in Surat An-Najm
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Abu Ad-Darda se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi, unhi alfaaz mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye Sufyan bin Waki ki, Abdullah bin Wahb se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Mas'ud, Zaid bin Thabit, aur Amr bin Al-As se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ad-Darda ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sa'eed bin Abi Hilal ki, Umar Ad-Dimashqi se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Mujahid narrated:"We were with Ibn Umar, and he said: 'The Messenger of Allah said: "Permit the women to go at night to the Masajid." His son said: 'By Allah! We would not permit them lest they become insidious from that.' So he (Abdullah) retorted: 'May Allah do and such with you.' I say: "The Messenger of Allah said," and you say: "We do not permit them?
hi: Mujahid ne kaha: "Hum Ibn Umar ke paas the, to unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Auraton ko raat ko masjidon mein jaane ki ijazat do.'" To unke bete ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Hum unhen ijazat nahi denge, wo isse fasaad ka zariya bana lengi." To unhon ne kaha: "Allah tumhare saath aisa hi kare jaisa tumne kiya! Main kehta hoon Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, aur tum kehte ho hum unhen ijazat nahi denge?" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Zainab (Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki biwi), aur Zaid bin Khalid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Tariq bin Abdullah Al-Muharibi narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "When you are in Salat then do not spit on your right, but behind you or toward your left, or under your left foot
hi: Tariq bin Abdullah Al-Muharibi (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum namaz mein ho, to apne dahine thook mat, balki apne peeche, ya apne baayen taraf, ya apne baayen paon ke neeche thooko." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Umar, Anas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Tariq ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Al-Jarud ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko kehte suna: Rib'i bin Hirash ne Islam mein kabhi jhoot nahi bola. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne kaha: Kufa waalon mein sabse mazboot Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir hain.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "To spit in the Masjid is a sin, and burying it is its atonement
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Masjid mein thookna ek gunaah hai, aur uska kaffara use dafn karna hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"We prostrated with the Messenger of Allah in: 'Read! In the Name of your Lord' and 'When the heaven is split asunder
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath '(Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-ladhi Khalaq)' aur '(Idhas-Samau Inshaqqat)' mein sajda kiya."

e: (Another chain in which) Abu Hurairah narrated :from the Prophet similarly
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo '(Idhas-Samau Inshaqqat)' aur '(Iqra Bismi Rabbik)' mein sajda karna maante hain. Aur is hadith mein char Tabi'een hain, ek doosre se riwayat karte hue.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prostrated for it - meaning (in Surat) An-Najm - and so did the Muslims, the idolaters, the Jinns, and the people
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isme sajda kiya" - yani Surah An-Najm mein - "aur Musalmanon, mushrikeen, jinnon, aur insaanon ne bhi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Surah An-Najm mein sajda karna maante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha: Mufassal mein koi sajda nahi. Aur ye Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai, aur isi ko Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq maante hain.

e: Zaid bin Thabit narrated:"I recited Surat An-Najm to the Messenger of Allah, and he did not prostrate for it
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Surah An-Najm padhi, to unhon ne ismein sajda nahi kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Thabit ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne is hadith ki tashreeh ki aur kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne sajda isliye chhoda kyunki Zaid bin Thabit ne padha to sajda nahi kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne bhi sajda nahi kiya. Aur unhon ne kaha: Sajda uspar wajib hai jo use sune, unhon ne isse chhodne ki rukhsat nahi di. Aur unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi bagair wuzu ke sune, to jab wo wuzu kare tab sajda kare. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur Ishaq bhi isi ko maante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Sajda sirf us par hai jo ismein sajda karna chahe aur uski fazilat talaash kare, aur unhon ne isse chhodne ki rukhsat di agar wo aisa chahe. Aur unhon ne Zaid bin Thabit ki marfu' hadith se dalil li jahan unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saamne Surah An-Najm padhi, to unhon ne ismein sajda nahi kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Agar sajda wajib hota, to Nabi (SAW) Zaid ko na chhodte jab tak wo sajda na karte aur Nabi (SAW) khud sajda na karte. Aur unhon ne Umar ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne mimbar par ek sajde wali Ayat padhi, to wo utre aur sajda kiya, phir doosre Jumme ismein padha, to log sajde ke liye taiyaar hue, unhon ne kaha: \"Ye hum par farz nahi ki gayi siwaye is ke ke hum chaahen.\" To unhon ne sajda nahi kiya, aur na logon ne kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko maana, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"I saw the Messenger of Allah prostrating for (Surat) Sad." Ibn Abbas said: "It is not one of the resolute prostrations
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Surah Saad mein sajda karte dekha." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Ye lazmi sajdon mein se nahi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, isme sajda karna maana. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Ye ek Nabi ki tauba hai, aur unhon ne isme sajda karna nahi maana.

e: Uqbah bin Amir narrated:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Surah Al-Hajj has been esteemed by two prostrations?' He said: 'Yes, and whoever does not prostrate for them, he should not recite them
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir (RA) ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Surah Al-Hajj ko do sajdon se fazilat di gayi hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Haan, aur jo unmein sajda na kare, wo unhen na padhe.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad zyada mazboot nahi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Umar bin Al-Khattab aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Surah Al-Hajj ko do sajdon se fazilat di gayi hai. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne isme ek sajda maana, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid said:Ibn Juraij said to me: O Hasan! Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid informed me that Ibn Abbas said: "A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I had a dream at night while I was sleeping in which I was praying behind a tree, when I prostrated the tree prostrated along with me. Then I heard it saying: (Allahummaktuh li biha indaka ajran, wad a anni biha wizran, waj'alha li biha indaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min abdiki Dawud.)" (O Allah! Record for me, a reward with You for it, remove a sin for me by it, and store it away for me with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your worshipper Dawud). Al-Hasan said: "Ibn Juraij said to me: 'Your grandfather said to me: 'Ibn Abbas said: 'So the Prophet recited (an Ayah of) prostration then prostrated.'" (He said) "So Ibn Abbas said: 'I listened to him, and he was saying the same as the man informed that the tree had said
hi: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid ne kaha: Ibn Juraij ne mujhse kaha: Ae Hasan! Ubaidullah bin Abi Yazid ne mujhe bataya, Ibn Abbas se, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine raat ko khwab mein dekha ke maine goya ek darakht ke peeche namaz padh rahi hoon, maine sajda kiya to darakht ne mere sajde ke saath sajda kiya. Maine use kehte suna: Ya Allah! Mere liye ismein Apne paas ajr likh, aur ismein mujh se gunaah utaar, aur ise mere liye Apne paas zakheera bana, aur ise mujhse aise qubool kar jaise Tune apne bande Dawud se qubool kiya.'" Al-Hasan ne kaha: Ibn Juraij ne mujhse kaha: Tumhare dada ne mujhse kaha: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "To Nabi (SAW) ne ek sajde wali Ayat padhi, phir sajda kiya." Unhon ne kaha: To Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Maine unhen sunaa, wo waisi hi baat keh rahe the jaisi us aadmi ne unhen darakht ke kehne ke baare mein bataayi thi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Abbas ki riwayat mein hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Aisha narrated:"When the Messenger of Allah would prostrate (for recitation of) the Qur'an, he would say: (Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatihi.) (I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and made its hearing and vision, though His ability and power)
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat mein Quran ke sajde mein kehte the: 'Sajada Wajhiya Lilladhi Khalaqahu wa Shaqqa Sam'ahu wa Basarahu Bihawlihi wa Quwwatihi' (Mera chehra usse sajda karta hai jisne ise banaya, aur uske kaan aur aankhein apni taaqat aur qudrat se banayin)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever slept, (missing) his section or some of it, then he recited it between the Fajr prayer and the Zuhr prayer, it is written for him as if he had recited it in the night
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apna hissa ya uska koi hissa so jaaye, phir use Fajr aur Zuhr ki namaz ke darmiyan padh le, to uske liye aisa likha jaata hai goya usne raat ko padha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Safwan ka naam Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Makki hai, aur unse Al-Humaidi aur bade log riwayat karte hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Muhammad said: 'Does not the one who raises his head before the Imam fear that Allah will transform his head into a donkey's head?
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya jo Imam se pehle apna sar uthaata hai wo isse nahi darta ke Allah uska sar gadhe ke sar mein badal de?" Qutaibah ne kaha: Hammad ne kaha: Mujhe Muhammad bin Ziyad ne bataya, unhon ne bas itna kaha "Kya isse dar nahi lagta." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ziyad Basra ke thiqah hain, unki kuniyat Abu Al-Harith hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:'Mu'adh bin Jabal would pray Al-Maghrib with the Messenger of Allah, then he would return to his people to lead them (in prayer)
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Mu'adh bin Jabal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Maghrib padhte, phir apni qaum ke paas laut kar unki imamat karte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur humare asaatiza Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi qaum ki farz namaz mein imamat kare jabke wo pehle hi wo namaz padh chuka ho, to uski pairvi karne walon ki namaz jaayez hai. Aur unhon ne Jabir ki, Mu'adh ke qisse ki, hadith se dalil li, aur ye sahih hadith hai, aur ye Jabir se kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu Ad-Darda se riwayat hai ke unse pucha gaya us aadmi ke baare mein jo masjid mein daakhil hua jabke log Asr ki namaz mein the aur wo samajh raha tha ye Zuhr ki namaz hai, to usne unki pairvi ki, unhon ne kaha: Uski namaz jaayez hai. Aur Kufa waalon mein se kuch ne kaha: Agar log kisi Imam ki pairvi karein jabke wo Asr padh raha ho aur wo samajh rahe hon ye Zuhr hai, to usne unhen padhayi aur unhon ne uski pairvi ki, to pairvi karne wale ki namaz fasid hai, kyunki Imam aur Ma'moom ki niyat alag ho gayi.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"When we prayed behind the Prophet in the midday heat, we would prostrate on our garments as a protection against the heat
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke peeche dopahar ki garmi mein namaz padhte, to hum apne kapdon par sajda karte garmi se bachne ke liye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir bin Abdullah aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Waki ne bhi ye hadith Khalid bin Abdur-Rahman se riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"When the Prophet prayed Fajr he would remain seated where he had prayed until the sun had risen
hi: Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) Fajr padh lete, to apni namaz ki jagah baithe rehte yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aata." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever prays Fajr in congregation, then sits remembering Allah until the sun has risen, then he prays two Rak'ah, then for him is the reward like that of a Hajj and Umrah." He said: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Complete, complete, complete
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Fajr jamaat mein padhe, phir baith kar Allah ka zikr kare yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aaye, phir do rakat padhe, uske liye ek Hajj aur Umrah ke barabar sawaab hai." Unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mukammal, mukammal, mukammal." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail se Abu Zilal ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Unki hadith taqreeban theek hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Unka naam Hilal hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would glance toward the right and the left during Salat but he would not turn his neck to look behind him
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein dahine aur baayen dekhte the, lekin apni gardan apni peeth ke peeche na modte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Waki ne Al-Fadl bin Musa ki riwayat se ikhtilaaf kiya hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Abi Hind narrated from some of the companions of Ikrimah:"The Prophet would glance during Salat" and he mentioned a similar narration
hi: Kuch Ikrimah ke saathiyon se riwayat hai: Nabi (SAW) namaz mein dekhte the. Phir unhon ne isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Anas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'O my son! Beware of looking around during the Salat, for indeed looking around during Salat is destruction. If you must do so, then in the voluntary (prayers), not in the obligatory (prayers).'" (Da'if)
hi: Anas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Ae mere bete! Namaz mein idhar udhar dekhne se bacho, kyunki namaz mein idhar udhar dekhna barbaadi hai, agar zaroori ho to nafl mein karo, farz mein nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I asked the Messenger of Allah about looking around during the Salat. He said: 'It is a portion which the Shaitan snatches during a man's prayer
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz mein idhar udhar dekhne ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Ye ek hissa hai jise Shaitan aadmi ki namaz se chura leta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Mu'adh bin Jabal narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "When one of you comes to the Salat and (finds) the Imam is in a position, then do as the Imam is doing
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye aaye aur Imam kisi haalat mein ho, to wo waisa hi kare jaisa Imam kar raha hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne ise sirf isi tareeqe se isnad ke saath riwayat ki ho. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi aaye jabke Imam sajda mein ho, to wo bhi sajda kare, lekin agar usse rukoo Imam ke saath chhoot jaaye to wo rakat kaafi nahi hogi. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne isi ko chuna ke Imam ke saath sajda kare, aur kuch se zikr kiya gaya ke shayad wo us sajde mein apna sar na uthaye jab tak use bakhsh na diya jaaye.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah narrated from his father that :the Messenger of Allah said: "When the Iqamah is called for the prayer, then do not stand until you see that I have come out
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to khade mat ho jab tak mujhe na dekh lo ke main nikal aaya hoon." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai, aur Anas ki hadith mahfooz nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Qatadah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, isse napasand kiya ke log Imam ka intezar khade hokar karein. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar Imam masjid mein ho aur namaz ki iqaamat ho jaaye, to log tab khade hon jab Mu'adhdhin kahe \"Qad Qamatis-Salat, Qad Qamatis-Salat.\" Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah said:"I was prayed and the Prophet, Abu Bakr, and Umar were there, so when I sat, I started off with praising Allah, then sending Salat upon the Prophet, then supplicating for myself. So the Prophet said: 'Ask, your request will be granted, ask, your request will be ranted
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) ne kaha: "Main namaz padh raha tha aur Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar unke saath the. Jab main baitha, to maine Allah ki tareef se shuru kiya, phir Nabi (SAW) par Durood, phir apne liye dua ki. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Maango, tumhein diya jaayega. Maango, tumhein diya jaayega.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Fadalah bin Ubaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ahmad bin Hanbal ne Yahya bin Adam se mukhtasar riwayat ki hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet ordered the construction of Masajid in all Dur and that they be kept clean and scented
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mohallon mein masjid banane ka hukum diya, aur ye ke unhen saaf aur khushbudaar rakha jaaye."

e: (Another chain) from Hisham bin Urwah, from his father:"That the Prophet ordered." And he mentioned similarly
hi: Hisham bin Urwah se, apne walid se, ke Nabi (SAW) ne hukum diya, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: (Another chain) from Hisham from Urwah, from his father:"That the Prophet ordered." And he mentioned similarly
hi: Hisham se, Urwah se, apne walid se, ke Nabi (SAW) ne hukum diya, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Sufyan ne kaha: Unka qaul "mohallon mein masjid banana" ka matlab hai qabeele.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "The Salat during the night and the day is two and two
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakat hai."
