Abu Isa ne kaha: Shu'bah ke saathiyon ne Ibn Umar ki hadith mein ikhtilaaf kiya, kuch ne ise marfu' kiya aur kuch ne mauqoof rakha. Aur Abdullah Al-Umari se, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai. Aur sahih wo hai jo Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: \"Raat ki namaz do-do rakat hai.\" Aur thiqah logon ne Abdullah bin Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai aur usmein din ki namaz ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Ubaidullah se, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke wo raat ko do-do rakat aur din ko chaar rakat padhte the. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne maana ke raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakat hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Raat ki namaz do-do rakat hai, aur unhon ne din ki nafl namaz chaar rakat maani, jaisa Zuhr se pehle ki chaar rakat aur baaki nafl namazein. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Asim bin Damrah said:"We asked Ali about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah during the day. He said: 'You will not be able to do that.' We said: 'Whoever among is able (he will)?' So he said: 'When the sun appeared over there (east) like it appears here (west) at Asr, the Messenger of Allah would pray two Rak'ah, and when the sun appeared over there (east) like it appears here (west) at Zuhr, he would pray four Rak'ah. And he would pray four before Zuhr and two after it, and four before Asr separating between every two Rak'ah with At-Taslim upon the angels that are close (to Allah) and those who follow them among the believers, and the Muslims
hi: Aasim bin Damrah ne kaha: "Humne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki din ki namaz ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Tum ise nahi nibha sakte.' To humne kaha: 'Hum mein se jo nibha sake.'" To unhon ne kaha: "Jab sooraj yahan se waisa hota jaisa wahan se Asr ke waqt hota, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) do rakat padhte, aur jab sooraj yahan se waisa hota jaisa wahan se Zuhr ke waqt hota, wo chaar rakat padhte, aur Zuhr se pehle chaar aur uske baad do rakat padhte, aur Asr se pehle chaar rakat padhte, har do rakat ke darmiyan Muqarrab Farishton, Nabiyon, Rasoolon, aur unki pairvi karne wale Momino aur Musalmano par Salam kehte hue alag karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: (Another chain) from Ali :from the Prophet similarly (no)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ki din ki nafl namaz ke baare mein sabse achi riwayat yahi hai. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke wo is hadith ko kamzor maante the. Aur humare nazdeek unhon ne isse isliye kamzor maana - Allah behtar jaanta hai - kyunki isi jaisi koi cheez Nabi (SAW) se sirf isi tareeqe se, Aasim bin Damrah se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat nahi hui. Aur Aasim bin Damrah kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek thiqah hain. Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan ne kaha: Sufyan ne kaha: Hum Aasim bin Damrah ki hadith ki fazilat Al-Harith ki hadith se zyada jaante the.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would not pray in women's covers
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) auraton ke chadaron mein namaz nahi padhte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se ismein rukhsat bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Urwah narrated that Aishah said:"I came while the Messenger of Allah was praying in the house and the door was closed. So he walked until he opened the door for me, then he returned to his place." And she described the door to be in the direction of the Qiblah
hi: Urwah ne Aishah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Main aayi jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ghar mein namaz padh rahe the aur darwaza band tha. To wo chal kar mere liye darwaza khola, phir apni jagah wapas laut gaye." Aur unhon ne darwaze ko Qibla ki taraf batlaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Wa'il said:"A man asked Abdullah bin Mas'ud about this phrase: 'Ghairi asin' or is it Yasin? So he said: 'You can recite all of the Quran besides this [phrase]?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Indeed a people recite it, disbursing it like Ad-Daqqa are dispersed, without it passing their throats. Indeed I am aware of the surahs that are comparable which the Messenger of Allah would recite together.'" He said: "So we told Alqamah to ask him (what they were). He said: "Twenty surahs from the Mufassal from which the Prophet would combine, reciting every two Surah in a Rak'ah
hi: Abu Wa'il ne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) se is lafz ke baare mein pucha: '(Ghairi Aasin)' ya 'Yaasin'. Unhon ne kaha: 'Kya tumne is lafz ke siwa poora Quran padha hai?' Usne kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Kuch log ise aise bikhraate hue padhte hain jaise kharab khajoor bikharti hai, unke gale se neeche nahi jaata. Main to un jodi Surahon ko jaanta hoon jinhen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mila kar padhte the.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To humne Alqamah ko unse pucchne bheja, to unhon ne kaha: Bees Surahen Mufassal se, jinhen Nabi (SAW) har do Surah ek rakat mein mila kar padhte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "When a man performs Wudu and he performs his Wudu well, then he leaves to the Salat, and he did not leave - or he said: He had no urge - except for it, then there is not one step that he takes except that Allah raises him a degree from it, or removes a sin from him for it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aadmi wuzu kare aur ache tareeke se wuzu kare, phir namaz ke liye nikle, aur use kisi aur cheez ne na nikala ho ya kaha: kisi aur cheez ne na ubhaara ho siwaye namaz ke, to wo koi kadam nahi uthaata magar Allah usse ek darja buland kar deta hai ya ek gunaah mita deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sa'd bin Ishaq bin Ka'b bin Ujrah narrated from his father from his grandfather who said:"The Prophet prayed Maghrib in the Masjid of Banu Abdul-Ashbal, and some people stood to offer voluntary prayers, so the Prophet said: 'This Salat is to be performed by you in your homes
hi: Sa'd bin Ishaq bin Ka'b bin Ujrah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Abdul-Ashhal ki masjid mein Maghrib padhi, to kuch log nafl padhne khade ho gaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ye namaz apne gharon mein padho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ka'b bin Ujrah ki riwayat mein ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur sahih wo hai jo Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) Maghrib ke baad ki do rakat apne ghar mein padhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Hudhaifah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Maghrib padhi aur masjid mein namaz padhte rahe yahan tak ke aakhri Isha padh li. To is hadith mein ishara hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Maghrib ke baad ki do rakat masjid mein padhi.

e: Qais bin Asim narrated that:he accepted Islam and the Prophet ordered him to perform Ghusl with water and Sidr
hi: Qais bin Aasim (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Islam qabool kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen paani aur beri ke patton se ghusl karne ka hukum diya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pasand karte hain ke jab aadmi Islam qabool kare to wo ghusl kare aur apne kapde dhoye.

e: Ali bin Abi Talid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The screen between the eyes of the jinns and nakedness of the children of Adam when one of you enters the area of relieving oneself is saying: 'Bismillah
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jinnon ki nazron aur Aadam ki aulad ki sharamgahon ke darmiyan parda ye hai ke jab tum mein se koi bait-ul-khala mein daakhil ho, to 'Bismillah' kahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur iska isnad utna mazboot nahi. Aur Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se, is baare mein kai cheezein riwayat hui hain.

e: Abdullah bin Busr narrated that :the Prophet said: "On the day of Resurrection, my nation will be radiant from prostrating and shining from Wudu
hi: Abdullah bin Busr (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat Qayamat ke din sajdon ki wajah se chamakti hui, aur wuzu ki wajah se roshan peshaani aur haath-paon waali hogi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Abdullah bin Busr ki riwayat mein is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would love to start with the right side when he purified himself, and when he combed, and when putting his sandals on
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni taharat mein, apne baal sanwarne mein, aur apne joote pehen ne mein dahini taraf se shuru karna pasand karte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ash-Sha'tha ka naam Sulaim bin Aswad Al-Muharibi hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: The acceptable Wudu is with two Ratils of water
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wuzu ke liye do ratal paani kaafi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sharik ki riwayat se, isi alfaaz mein, jaante hain. Aur Shu'bah ne Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Jabr se, Anas bin Malik se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ek makkuk se wuzu karte aur paanch makkuk se ghusl karte. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri se, Abdullah bin Isa se, Abdullah bin Jabr se, Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ek mudd se wuzu karte aur ek saa se ghusl karte. Aur ye Sharik ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said, about urine of a male child that suckles: "The urine of the boy is sprinkled, and the girl's urine is washed." Qatadah (one of the narrators) said: "This is so, as long as they do not eat, when they eat, then both of them are washed
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne doodh peete ladke ke peshaab ke baare mein farmaya: "Ladke ke peshaab par chhirko, aur ladki ke peshaab ko dho lo." Qatadah ne kaha: Ye tab tak hai jab tak wo khaana na khaayen, jab wo khaana khaane lagen to donon ko dhoya jaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Hisham Ad-Dastawa'i ne ise Qatadah se marfu' kiya, aur Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah ne Qatadah se mauqoof rakha aur marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Shahr bin Hawshab said:"I saw Jarir bin Abdullah performing Wudu and wiping over his Khuff." He said: "So I asked him: 'What is that?' He said: 'I saw the Prophet performing Wudu and he wiped over his Khuff.' So I said to him: 'Before Al-Ma'idah or after Al-Ma'idah?' He said: 'I did not accept Islam until after Al-Ma'idah
hi: Shahr bin Hawshab ne kaha: "Maine Jarir bin Abdullah ko wuzu karte aur apne khuffain par mash karte dekha." Unhon ne kaha: "To maine unse iske baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko wuzu karte aur apne khuffain par mash karte dekha.'" To maine unse pucha: "Al-Ma'idah se pehle ya Al-Ma'idah ke baad?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine Al-Ma'idah ke baad hi Islam qabool kiya tha."

e: Shahr bin Hawshab said:(Another chain) from Khalid bin Ziyad with similar
hi: Shahr bin Hawshab se, Khalid bin Ziyad se, isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum isi jaisi cheez sirf Muqatil bin Hayyan ki, Shahr bin Hawshab se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante.

e: Ammar narrated:"The Prophet permitted the Junub when he wanted to eat, drink, or sleep, to perform Wudu like the Wudu for Salat
hi: Ammar (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne junub aadmi ko, jab wo khaana, peena, ya sona chahe, namaz ke wuzu jaisa wuzu karne ki rukhsat di." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ka'b bin Ujrah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'I seek refuge in Allah for you O Ka'b bin Ujrah from leader that will be after me. Whoever comes to their doors to approve of their lies and supports them in their oppression, then he is not of me and I am not of him, and he will not meet me at the Hawd. And whoever comes to their doors, or he does not come, and he does not approve of their lies and he does not support them in their oppression, then he is from me and I am from him, and he will meet me at the Hawd. Ka'ab bin Ujrah! Salat is clear proof, and Sawm (fasting) is an impregnable shield, and Sadaqah (charity) extinguishes sins just as water extinguishes fire. O Ka'b bin Ujrah! There is no flesh raised that sprouts from the unlawful except that the Fire is more appropriate for it
hi: Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Main tumhe Allah ki panah mein deta hoon un hukumraanon se jo mere baad aayenge, jo unke darwazon par jaaye aur unke jhoot ki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm mein unki madad kare, wo mujhse nahi hai aur main uss se nahi hoon, aur wo Hauz par mere paas nahi aayega. Aur jo unke darwazon par jaaye ya na jaaye, lekin unke jhoot ki tasdeeq na kare aur unke zulm mein madad na kare, wo mujhse hai aur main usse hoon, aur wo Hauz par mere paas zaroor aayega. Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Namaz daleel hai, roza mazboot dhaal hai, aur sadqa gunaah bujhaata hai jaise paani aag bujhaata hai. Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Haraam maal se palne wala gosht kabhi nahi badhta magar aag hi uske zyada haqdaar hoti hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ubaidullah bin Musa ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Ayyub bin Aa'idh At-Ta'i kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur kaha jaata hai ke unka Irja ki taraf jhukaav tha. Aur maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhen ye sirf Ubaidullah bin Musa ki riwayat se maloom thi, aur unhon ne ise bahut ajeeb samjha.

e: Muhammad said:"Ibn Numair narrated to us from Ubaidullah bin Musa, from Ghalib" with this (Hadith)
hi: Muhammad ne kaha: Ibn Numair ne humein Ubaidullah bin Musa se, Ghalib se, yahi bataya.

e: Sulaim bin Amir narrated:"I heard Abu Umamah saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah giving a Khutbah during the Farewell Hajj, and he said: 'Have Taqwa of your Lord, and pray your five (prayers), and fast your month, and pay the Zakat on your wealth, and obey thosewho are in charge of you, you will enter the Paradise of your Lord.'" He said: "I said to Abu Umamah: 'How old were you when you heard this Hadith (from the Messenger of Allah)?' He said: 'I heard it when I was thirty years old
hi: Sulaim bin Aamir ne kaha: "Maine Abu Umamah ko kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hajjat-ul-Wida mein khutba dete suna, unhon ne farmaya: 'Apne Rab se daro, apni paanchon namazein padho, apna mahina ka roza rakho, apne maal ki zakat do, aur apne hukumraanon ki ita'at karo, tum apne Rab ki Jannat mein daakhil ho jaoge.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To maine Abu Umamah se kaha: 'Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye hadith kab suni thi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine ise sunaa jab main tees saal ka tha.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Dharr narrated:"I came to the Messenger of Allah while he was sitting in the shade of the Ka'bah." He said: "He saw me approaching and he said: 'They are lost on the Day of Judgment! By the Lord of the Ka'bah!'" He said: "I said t myself: Woe is me! Perhaps something has been revealed about me!'" He said: "So I said: 'Who are they, and may my father and mother be ransomed for you.' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'They are those who have much, except for who says like this, and this, and this and motioned with his hand to his front, and t his right, and to his left.' Then he said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! No man will die, leaving a camel or a cow that he did not pay Zakat on, except that it will come on the Day of Judgment larger and fatter than it was, they will tread him under their hooves and butt him with their horns, all of them; such that when the last of them has had a turn, the first returns to him, until he is judged before the people
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo Ka'bah ke saaye mein baithe hue the." Unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne mujhe aate dekha to farmaya: 'Wo Rab-e-Ka'bah ki qasam! Qayamat ke din sabse ghaate mein rahne wale hain.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine apne dil mein socha: Mujhe kya ho gaya, shayad mere baare mein kuch nazil hua hai." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Wo kaun hain, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo hain jinke paas bahut maal hai, siwaye us ke jo aise, aise, aur aise kharch kare" - unhon ne apne saamne, apni dahini taraf, aur apni baayen taraf haath se ishara kiya - "Phir farmaya: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Koi aadmi nahi marta aur oont ya gaay chhodta hai jiski zakat na di ho, magar wo use Qayamat ke din unse bhi bade aur mote soorat mein aayenge, apni khuron se use rondte hue aur apne seengon se use maarte hue, jab bhi aakhri wala guzar jaata hai, pehla wapas aa jaata hai, yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi isi jaisi riwayat hai. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Zakat rokne wale par la'nat ki gayi. Aur Qabisah bin Hulb apne walid se, aur Jabir bin Abdullah aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Dharr ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Dharr ka naam Jundub bin As-Sakan hai, aur unhen Ibn Junadah bhi kaha jaata hai. Humein Abdullah bin Munir ne Ubaidullah bin Musa se, Sufyan Ath-Thawri se, Hakim bin Ad-Dailam se, Ad-Dahhak bin Muzahim se bataya, unhon ne kaha: \"Bahut maal wale\" wo hain jinke paas das hazaar hon. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Munir Marw ke rehne wale, ek neik aadmi hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated :that the Prophet said: "When you pay the Zakat you have fulfilled what is required of you
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum apne maal ki zakat de do, to tumne apna zimma poora kar liya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqe se riwayat hui hai ke unhon ne zakat ka zikr kiya, to ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya mujhpar iske alawa kuch aur hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Nahi, siwaye is ke ke tum apni marzi se kuch aur do."

e: Anas narrated:"We used to hope that an intelligent Bedouin would show up to question the Prophet while we were with him. So one while we were with him, a Bedouin came, kneeling in front of the Prophet, and he said: 'O Muhammad, your messenger came to us and told us that you say that Allah sent you.' So the Prophet say: 'Yes.' He said, 'So, (swear) by the One who raised the heaves, and spread out the earth, and erected the mountains; has Allah sent you?' The Prophet said, 'Yes.' He said: 'Your messenger told us that you say that there are five prayers required from us in a day and a night.' The Prophet said, 'Yes.' He said, 'By the One Who sent you, has Allah ordered that you you?' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Your messenger told us that you say that we are required to fast for a month out of the year.' He said, 'He told the truth.' He said, 'By the One Who sent you, has Allah ordered that you?' The Prophet said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Your messenger told us that Zakat is required from our wealth.' The Prophet said, 'He told the truth.' He said, 'By the One Who sent you, has Allah ordered you that?' The Prophet said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Your messenger told us that you say that we are required to perform Hajj to Allah's House if able to undertake the journey.' The Prophet said, 'Yes.' He said, 'By the One Who sent you, has Allah Commanded you that?' (The Prophet said:) 'Yes.' So he said: 'By the One Who sent you with the Truth, I will not leave any of them, nor surpass them.' Then he got up quickly (leaving). The Prophet said: 'If the Bedouin told the truth, then he will enter Paradise
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Hum tamanna karte the ke koi aqlmand Bedouin aaye aur Nabi (SAW) se sawaal kare jabke hum unke paas hon. Ek din hum isi hasrat mein the ke ek Bedouin aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke saamne ghutne teke, aur kaha: 'Ae Muhammad! Aapka qaasid humare paas aaya aur usne humein bataya ke aap dawa karte hain ke Allah ne aapko bheja hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aasman ko buland kiya aur zameen ko bicha diya aur pahaadon ko khada kiya, kya Allah ne aapko bheja hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Aapka qaasid ne humein bataya ke aap dawa karte hain ke humpar din aur raat mein paanch namazein farz hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne aapko iska hukum diya?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Aapke qaasid ne humein bataya ke aap dawa karte hain ke humpar saal mein ek mahine ka roza farz hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usne sach kaha.' Usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne aapko iska hukum diya?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Aapke qaasid ne humein bataya ke aap dawa karte hain ke humare maal mein zakat farz hai.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usne sach kaha.' Usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne aapko iska hukum diya?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Aapke qaasid ne humein bataya ke aap dawa karte hain ke humpar Bait Allah ka Hajj farz hai jo wahan tak ka raasta paa sake.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko bheja, kya Allah ne aapko iska hukum diya?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.' To usne kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, main inmein se kuch bhi na chhodunga aur na inse aage badhunga.' Phir wo jaldi se khada hua. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar Bedouin ne sach kaha, to wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai. Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: Kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Is hadith ka fiqhi nukta ye hai ke aalim ke saamne padhna aur usse peshkash karna, sunne jaisa hi jaayez hai. Aur unhon ne isse dalil li ke Bedouin ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne peshkash ki aur Nabi (SAW) ne usse tasdeeq ki.

e: Ali narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "I have exempted charity on horses and slaves. So bring charity for silver, one Dirham for every forty Dirham. There is nothing for me (to collect) on one hundred and ninety Dirham, so when it reaches two hundred, then five Dirham of it (are due)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine ghodon aur ghulamon ki zakat maaf kar di hai, is liye chandi ki zakat lao, har chaalis dirham par ek dirham, aur ek sau navve mein kuch nahi. Jab wo do sau tak pahunche, to usmein paanch dirham hain." Aur is mauzu par Abu Bakr As-Siddiq aur Amr bin Hazm se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Al-A'mash, Abu Awanah, aur doosron ne Abu Ishaq se, Aasim bin Damrah se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki hai, aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Uyainah, aur kai doosron ne Abu Ishaq se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Mere nazdeek Abu Ishaq se donon hi sahih hain, mumkin hai ke unhon ne donon se riwayat ki ho.

e: Az-Zuhri narrated from Salim from his father:"The Messenger of Allah had a letter written about charity, but he had not dispatched it to his governors until he died; he kept it with him along with his sword. When he died, Abu Bakr implemented it until he died, as did Umar until he died. In it was: 'A sheep (is due) on five camels, two sheeps on ten, three sheeps on fifteen, four sheeps for twenty, a Bint Makhad on twenty-five to thirty-five. When it is more than that, then a Bint Labun, (is due, till the number of the camels reaches) forty-five. When it is more than that, then a Hiqqah until sixty. When it is more than that, then a Jadhah until seventy-five. When it is more than one hundred and twenty, then a Hiqqah on every fifty, and a Bint Labun on every forty. For sheep; one sheep (is due) for every forty sheeps until one hundred and twenty. When it is more than that, then two sheeps until two hundred. When it is more than that, then three sheeps until three hundred sheep. When it is more than three hundred sheep, then a sheep on every hundred sheep. Then there is nothing until it reaches four hundred. There is no combining the (property of) individuals nor separating the collective (property) fearing Sadaqah. And fr whatever is mixed together that two own, then they are to refer to the total. Neither an old or defective (animal) may be taken for charity
hi: Az-Zuhri, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne zakat ka khatt likhwaaya, lekin apne wafaat tak ise apne aamilon ke paas na bheja, apni talwar ke saath rakh liya. Jab unki wafaat hui, Abu Bakr ne apni wafaat tak isi par amal kiya, aur Umar ne apni wafaat tak. Usmein ye tha: "Paanch oonton par ek bakri, das par do bakriyan, pandra par teen bakriyan, bees par chaar bakriyan, aur pachees par ek do saal ki oontni, chalis tak. Jab isse zyada ho jaaye, to usmein teen saal ki oontni hai, paintalees tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to usmein chaar saal ki oontni hai, saath tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to usmein paanch saal ki oontni hai, pachattar tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to usmein do teen-saal ki oontniyan hain, navve tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to usmein do chaar-saal ki oontniyan hain, ek sau bees tak. Jab ek sau bees se zyada ho, to har pachaas mein ek chaar-saal ki oontni, aur har chaalis mein ek teen-saal ki oontni. Aur bakriyon mein, har chaalis bakriyon par ek bakri, ek sau bees tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to do bakriyan, do sau tak. Jab isse zyada ho, to teen bakriyan, teen sau tak. Jab teen sau se zyada ho, to har sau bakriyon par ek bakri. Phir kuch nahi jab tak char sau tak na pahunche. Aur alag-alag jaanwaron ko zakat se bachne ke liye milaya na jaaye, na milele hue ko alag kiya jaaye. Aur do sharikon ke jaanwar barabar taqseem hote hain. Aur zakat mein boodhi ya aib waali cheez nahi li jaati." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Jab zakat lene wala aata to bakriyon ko teen hisson mein baantta - ek behtareen, ek darmiyana, ek kamzor - aur zakat lene wala darmiyane se leta. Aur Az-Zuhri ne gaayon ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur is mauzu par Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, aur Bahz bin Hakim apne walid se, apne dada se; aur Abu Dharr aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan hai. Aur zyada tar fuqaha ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai. Aur Yunus bin Yazid aur kai doosron ne Az-Zuhri se, Salim se ye hadith riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya, sirf Sufyan bin Husain ne ise marfu' kiya.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :the Prophet said: "A Tabi or a Tabi'ah (is due) on thirty cows, and a Musinnah (is due) on every forty
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tees gaayon mein ek saal ka baachhda ya baachhi, aur chaalis mein ek do-saal ki gaay." Aur is mauzu par Mu'adh bin Jabal se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Abdus-Salam bin Harb ne Khusaif se riwayat ki, aur Abdus-Salam thiqah hafiz hain. Aur Sharik ne ye hadith Khusaif se, Abu Ubaidah se, apni maa se, Abdullah se riwayat ki. Aur Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah ne Abdullah se suna nahi.

e: Mu'adh bin Jabal narrated:"The Prophet sent me to Yemen and ordered me to collect a Tabi or a Tabi'ah on every thirty cows, a Musinnah on every forty, a Dinar for every Halim, or its equivalent of Ma'afir."Abu Eisa said: This Hadith is Hasan. Some of them reported this Hadith from Sufyan, from Al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Masruq: "The Prophet sent Mu'adh to Yemen and ordered him to take..." and this is more authentic
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe Yaman bheja aur mujhe hukum diya ke main har tees gaayon se ek saal ka baachhda ya baachhi loon, aur har chaalis se ek do-saal ki gaay, aur har baaligh se ek dinar ya uske barabar Ma'afir." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Sufyan se, Al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se, Masruq se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yaman bheja aur unhen lene ka hukum diya. Aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Muhammad bin Bash-shar (Al-Abdi) narrated to us, :Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Amr bin Murrah who said: "I asked Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah: 'Did you remember anything from Abdullah?' He said, 'No
hi: Amr bin Murrah ne kaha: "Maine Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah se pucha: Kya aapko Abdullah se kuch yaad hai? Unhon ne kaha: Nahi."

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah sent Mu'adh to Yemen and said to him: "You are going to a people from the People of the Book, so invite them to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that I am the Messenger of Allah. If they comply with that, then inform them that Allah has made five prayers obligatory upon them in a day and a night. If they comply with that, then inform then that Allah has ordained a charity upon their wealth, which is to be taken from the rich among them and given to the poor among them. If they comply with that, then beware of their most precious wealth, and protect yourself from the supplication of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yaman bheja aur unse farmaya: "Tum ek Ahle Kitab qaum ke paas ja rahe ho, to unhen sabse pehle is gawahi ki taraf bulaana ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Agar wo iski ita'at karen, to unhen bataao ke Allah ne unpar din aur raat mein paanch namazein farz ki hain. Agar wo iski ita'at karen, to unhen bataao ke Allah ne unke maal par ek sadqa farz kiya hai jo unke ameeron se liya jaayega aur unke gareebon ko wapas diya jaayega. Agar wo iski ita'at karen, to unke behtareen maal se bachna, aur mazloom ki dua se daro, kyunki uske aur Allah ke darmiyan koi parda nahi." Aur is mauzu par As-Sunabihi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ma'bad, Ibn Abbas ke azaad kiye gulam, ka naam Nafidh hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :the Prophet said: "There is no charity due on less than five camels, and there is no charity due on what is less than five Uqiyah (of silver), and there is no charity due on what is less than five Wasaq
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanch oonton se kam mein koi zakat nahi, paanch uqiya se kam mein koi zakat nahi, aur paanch wasq se kam mein koi zakat nahi." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, Jabir, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: (Another chain of narration that) Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :the Prophet said (similar t Hadith no)
hi: Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se, Abdul-Aziz ki, Amr bin Yahya se riwayat jaisi hi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke paanch wasq se kam mein koi zakat nahi. Aur wasq saath saa hote hain, aur paanch wasq teen sau saa. Aur Nabi (SAW) ka saa paanch aur ek-tihaai ratal hai, aur Kufa waalon ka saa aath ratal hai. Aur paanch uqiya se kam mein koi zakat nahi, uqiya chaalis dirham hai, aur paanch uqiya do sau dirham. Aur paanch dhaud se kam mein koi zakat nahi, yani paanch oonton se kam mein zakat nahi, aur jab pachees oont ho jaayen, to usmein ek do-saal ki oontni hai, aur pachees se kam har paanch oont par ek bakri hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no charity due from a Muslim for his horse nor his slave
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman par apne ghode aur apne ghulam mein koi zakat nahi." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke charne wale ghodon mein koi zakat nahi, aur ghulamon mein bhi koi zakat nahi agar wo khidmat ke liye hon, siwaye is ke ke wo tijaarat ke liye hon, to agar wo tijaarat ke liye hon, to unki qeemat mein zakat hai jab saal poora ho jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "A Ziqq is due for every ten Ziqq of honey
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shehad mein, har das mashkon par ek mashk." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abu Sayyarah Al-Muta'i, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith ke isnad mein kuch baat hai, aur is mauzu mein Nabi (SAW) se koi khaas mazboot cheez sahih nahi. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Shehad mein kuch nahi. Aur Sadaqah bin Abdullah hafiz nahi hain, aur Sadaqah bin Abdullah ki, Nafi se, is hadith ki riwayat mein ikhtilaaf hua hai.

e: Ubaidulah bin Umar narrated that :Nafi said: "Umar bin Adbul-Aziz asked me about charity due on honey, so I said to him: 'We do not have honey that we could give charity from, but Al-Mughirah bin Hakim informed us that he (pbuh) said: 'There is no charity due on honey.' So Umar said: 'That is fair enough for me.' So he wrote to the people that is be lifted, meaning (the duty of paying it) from them
hi: Nafi ne kaha: "Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ne mujhse shehad ki zakat ke baare mein pucha." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Humare paas koi shehad nahi jiski hum zakat den, lekin Al-Mughirah bin Hakim ne humein bataya ke unhon ne kaha: Shehad mein koi zakat nahi." To Umar ne kaha: "Ye theek aur qaabil-e-etemaad hai." To unhon ne logon ko likha ke ye unse maaf kar di jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever acquired wealth, then there is no Zakat on it until the Hawl has passed (while it is in his possession)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo maal haasil kare, uspar koi zakat nahi jab tak wo uske paas saal poora na kar le." Aur is mauzu par Sarra bint Nabhan Al-Ghanawiyyah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Umar said:"Whoever acquired wealth, then there is no Zakat on it until the Hawl has passed while it is in his possession
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Jo maal haasil kare, uspar koi zakat nahi jab tak wo uske paas saal poora na kar le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ayyub, Ubaidullah bin Umar, aur kai doosron ne Nafi se, Ibn Umar se mauqoof riwayat ki. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam hadith mein kamzor hain, Ahmad bin Hanbal, Ali bin Al-Madini, aur doosron ne unhen kamzor qarar diya, wo bahut galtiyan karte hain. Aur kai Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba se riwayat hai ke haasil kiye maal mein zakat nahi jab tak saal poora na ho. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar uske paas aisa maal ho jispar zakat farz hai, to isme bhi zakat hai. Aur agar uske paas haasil kiye maal ke siwa aur koi maal na ho jispar zakat farz hoti, to haasil kiye maal par zakat farz nahi jab tak saal poora na ho. Aur agar usne saal poora hone se pehle maal haasil kiya, to wo haasil kiya maal apne maal ke saath zakat de jispar zakat farz thi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Two Qiblahs in one land are of no benefit, and there is no Jizyah upon the Muslims
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ek zameen mein do Qible sahih nahi, aur Musalmanon par koi Jizya nahi."

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:(A similar narration as no)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se. Aur is mauzu par Sa'eed bin Zaid, aur Harb bin Ubaidullah Ath-Thaqafi ke dada se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith, Qabus bin Abi Zabyan se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Nasrani jab Islam qabool kare, to uski Jizya utar jaati hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ka qaul \"Musalmanon par koi Ushoor nahi\" ka matlab hai Jizya, aur is hadith mein iski tashreeh bhi hai jahan farmaya: \"Ushoor sirf Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon par hai, Musalmanon par koi Ushoor nahi.\"

e: Amr bin Al-Harith bin Al-Mustaliq narrated from the nephew of Zainab, the wife of Abdullah (Ibn Mas'ud) who said:"The Messenger of Allah delivered a sermon to us, and said: 'O you women! Give charity, even if it is from your jewelry, for indeed you will make up most of the people of Hell on the Day of Judgment
hi: Amr bin Al-Harith bin Al-Mustaliq, Zainab (Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki biwi) ke bhatije se riwayat karte hain, Zainab se, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein khutba diya aur farmaya: 'Ae auraton ke jamaat! Sadqa do, chahe apne zewar se ho, kyunki tum Qayamat ke din Jahannam mein sabse zyada hogi.'"

e: Amr bin Al-Harith, the nephew of Zainab, the wife of Abdullah, narrated that :Zainab, the wife of Abdullah narrated similarly from the Prophet
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se Nabi (SAW) se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Abu Mu'awiyah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai, Abu Mu'awiyah ne apni hadith mein galti ki aur "Amr bin Al-Harith se, Zainab ke bhatije se" kaha. Aur sahih ye hai ke ye "Amr bin Al-Harith, Zainab ka bhatija" hai. Aur Amr bin Shu'aib se, apne walid se, apne dada se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne zewar mein zakat maani. Aur is hadith ke isnad mein kuch baat hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur Tabi'een mein se, zewar mein zakat maante hain jo sona ya chandi se bana ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Ibn Umar, Aishah, Jabir bin Abdullah, aur Anas bin Malik shaamil hain, kehte hain: Zewar mein koi zakat nahi. Aur isi tarah kuch Tabi'een fuqaha se riwayat hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, :that two women came to the Messenger of Allah, and they each had a bracelet of gold on their forearms. So he said to them: "Have you paid their Zakat?" They said, "No." The Messenger of Allah said to them: "Would you like for Allah to fashion then into two bracelets of Fire?" They said, "No." He said: "Then pay its Zakat
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke do auraten Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin, unke haathon mein sone ki chudiyaan thin. Unhon ne unse farmaya: "Kya tum inki zakat deti ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya tumhein ye pasand hai ke Allah tumhein aag ki do chudiyaan pehnaaye?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "To inki zakat do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Al-Muthanna bin As-Sabbah ne bhi Amr bin Shu'aib se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Al-Muthanna bin As-Sabbah aur Ibn Lahi'ah hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi cheez sahih nahi.

e: Eisa bin Talhah narrated that :Mu'adh had written to the Prophet to ask him about greens - which is "herbs" - so he (pbuh) said, "There is nothing due on them
hi: Isa bin Talhah se riwayat hai ke Mu'adh ne Nabi (SAW) ko likha unse sabziyon ke baare mein pucchte hue, to unhon ne farmaya: "Unmein kuch nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad sahih nahi, aur is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi cheez sahih nahi, ye sirf Musa bin Talhah se, Nabi (SAW) se, mursal riwayat hoti hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke sabziyon mein koi zakat nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Al-Hasan, Ibn Umarah hain, aur wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek kamzor hain, Shu'bah aur doosron ne unhen kamzor qarar diya, aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne unhen chhod diya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "For what is watered by the heavens and steams, the Ushr is due, and for what is watered by irrigation, half of the Ushr
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo aasman aur chashmon se sinchi jaaye usmein ushr hai, aur jo sichaayi se paani di jaaye usmein aadha ushr hai." Aur is mauzu par Anas bin Malik, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Bukair bin Abdullah bin Al-Ashajj se, Sulaiman bin Yasar aur Busr bin Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se, mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur goya ye zyada sahih hai. Aur Ibn Umar ki hadith is mauzu mein Nabi (SAW) se sahih hai, aur zyada tar fuqaha ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Salim narrated from his father that :the Messenger of Allah instituted the Ushr of what was watered by the heavens and steams, or through natural channels, and half of the Ushr for what is watered by irrigation
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye Sunnat qaayam ki ke jo aasman ya chashmon se sinchi jaaye ya khud-ba-khud paani paaye, usmein ushr hai, aur jo sichaayi se paani di jaaye usmein aadha ushr hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather that :the Prophet addressed the people and said: "As for one who is the guardian of an orphan who has wealth, then let him do business with it and not leave it until it becomes consumed by charity
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko khutba diya aur farmaya: "Suno! Jo kisi yateem ka waali ho jiske paas maal ho, to wo usmein tijaarat kare, aur ise chhode nahi yahan tak ke usse zakat khatam kar de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sirf isi tareeqe se riwayat hui hai aur iske isnad mein baat hai kyunki Al-Muthanna bin As-Sabbah hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur kuch ne ye hadith Amr bin Shu'aib se riwayat ki ke Umar bin Al-Khattab. Phir unhon ne ye hadith zikr ki. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baab mein ikhtilaaf hai, kai Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba ne yateem ke maal mein zakat maani, unmein Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain, aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke ek jamaat ne kaha: Yateem ke maal mein zakat nahi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur Amr bin Shu'aib, Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-As ke bete hain, aur Shu'aib ne apne dada Abdullah bin Amr se suna hai. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ne Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith ke baare mein baat ki aur kaha: Wo humare nazdeek kamzor hai. Aur jinhon ne unhen kamzor kaha, unhon ne isliye kaha kyunki wo apne dada Abdullah bin Amr ke sahife se riwayat karte hain. Lekin zyada tar Ashab-e-Hadith Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith se dalil lete hain aur ise saabit maante hain, unmein Ahmad, Ishaq, aur doosre shaamil hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The injuries caused by the animal are without liability, and mines are without liability, and wells are without liability, and the Khumus is due on Rikaz
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bezubaan jaanwar ke zakhmi karne mein koi zimmedaari nahi, khaan mein koi zimmedaari nahi, kuen mein koi zimmedaari nahi, aur rikaz mein khumus hai." Aur is mauzu par Anas bin Malik, Abdullah bin Amr, Ubadah bin As-Samit, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Mas'ud bin Niyar said:"Sahl bin Abi Hathmah came to a gathering of ours, and he narrated that the Messenger of Allah would say: "When you make an assessment, then take it and leave a third, if you do not leave a third, then leave a quarter
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Mas'ud bin Niyar ne kaha: "Sahl bin Abi Hathmah humari majlis mein aaye aur bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kehte the: 'Jab tum andaza lagao, to lo aur tihai chhod do, agar tihai na chhodo to chauthai chhod do.'" Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Attab bin Aseed, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek andaza lagane mein Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ki hadith par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur andaza lagana ye hai ke jab khajoor ya angoor jaisi fasal pak jaaye jismein zakat hai, to hukumraan ek andaaza lagane wala bhejta hai jo unpar andaza lagaaye. Aur andaza lagana ye hai ke jo isse waqif ho wo dekhe aur kahe: Ismein se munaqqa nikalegi itni-itni, aur khajoor itni-itni. To ye unke liye gin liya jaata hai, aur ismein se ushr ki miqdaar dekhi jaati hai aur unpar tay kar di jaati hai, phir unhen aur unki fasal ko chhod diya jaata hai, wo jo chaahen karen. Jab fasal pak jaaye, to unse ushr liya jaata hai. Isi tarah kuch ahl-e-ilm ne iski tashreeh ki hai, aur Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Attab bin Asid narrated that :the Prophet said about Zakat on grapevines: "They are to be assessed just as the date-palm is assessed. Then its Zakat is paid in raisins just as the Zakat for the date-palm is paid in dried dates
hi: Attab bin Aseed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) logon par ek aadmi bhejte the jo unke angoor ke baaghon aur fasal ka andaza lagaata. Aur isi isnad se, ke Nabi (SAW) ne angooron ki zakat ke baare mein farmaya: "Iska bhi andaza khajoor ki tarah lagaya jaata hai, phir iski zakat munaqqa ke roop mein di jaati hai jaise khajoor ki zakat sookhi khajoor ke roop mein di jaati hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Ibn Juraij ne ye hadith Ibn Shihab se, Urwah se, Aishah se bhi riwayat ki. Aur maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ibn Juraij ki hadith mahfooz nahi, aur Ibn Al-Musayyib ki, Attab bin Aseed se riwayat zyada saabit aur sahih hai.

e: Rafi bin Khadij narrated:"I herd the Messenger of Allah saying: 'The one who works in collecting charity in truth is like the one who fights in the cause of Allah until he returns
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Sadqa par haq ke saath kaam karne wala Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaisa hai, jab tak wo apne ghar wapas na aa jaaye.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Rafi bin Khadij ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Yazid bin Iyad ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek kamzor hain. Aur Muhammad bin Ishaq ki hadith zyada sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The one who commits transgression with charity is like the one who does not pay it
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zakat mein zyadti karne wala usse rokne wale jaisa hai." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Umm Salamah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne Sa'd bin Sinan ke baare mein baat ki. Aur isi tarah Laith bin Sa'd, Yazid bin Abi Habib se, Sa'd bin Sinan se, Anas bin Malik se kehte hain. Aur Amr bin Al-Harith aur Ibn Lahi'ah, Yazid bin Abi Habib se, Sinan bin Sa'd se, Anas se kehte hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Sahih Sinan bin Sa'd hai. Aur unke qaul \"Zakat mein zyadti karne wala usse rokne wale jaisa hai\" ka matlab hai ke zyadti karne wale par bhi utna hi gunaah hai jitna rokne wale par jab wo roke.

e: Jarir narrated that :the Prophet said: "When the charity collector comes to you, then he should not depart from you except while pleased
hi: Jarir (RA) ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab zakat lene wala tumhare paas aaye, to wo tumse raazi hue bagair na jaaye."

e: Jarir narrated :similar (narration to no. 647 with a different chain) from the Prophet
hi: Jarir se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Dawud ki, Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat, Mujalid ki riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Mujalid ko kamzor qarar diya, wo bahut galtiyan karte hain.

e: Awn bin Abi Jubaitah narrated from his father:"The charity collector of the Prophet came to us. So he took the charity from our rich to our poor. I was a orphan boy, so he came to me and gave me a young she-camel from it
hi: Aun bin Abi Juhaifah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke zakat lene wale humare paas aaye, to unhon ne humare ameeron se zakat li aur humare gareebon ko de di. Main ek yateem ladka tha, to unhon ne mujhe usmein se ek jawan oontni di." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Juhaifah ki hadith hasan hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever begs from the people while he has what he needs, he will come on the Day of Judgment and his begging with be scratches or lacerations, or bite marks on his face." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! 'How much is it that one needs?' He said: 'Fifty Dirham, or their value in gold
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs logon se maangta hai jabke uske paas itna hai jo use behtar kar sake, wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uske chehre par khraashein ya nishaan honge." Pucha gaya: "Ya Rasool Allah! Behtar karne wali cheez kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Pachaas dirham, ya uski keemat sone mein." Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne Hakim bin Jubair ke baare mein is hadith ki wajah se baat ki.

e: Mahmud bin Ghaydin narrated to us:Yahya bin Adam narrated to us, Sufyan narrated this Hadith to us from Hakim bin Jubair. So Abdullah bin Uthman, the companion of Shu'bah said to him (Sufyan): "If only someone besides Hakim had narrated this (Hadith)." Sufyan said to him, "So what is with Hakim; Shu'bah would not narrate from him?" He said: "Yes." So Sufyan said: "I heard Zubaid narrating this from Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid
hi: Sufyan ne Hakim bin Jubair se ye hadith bayan ki, to Shu'bah ke saathi Abdullah bin Uthman ne unse kaha: "Agar Hakim ke siwa koi aur ye hadith bayan karta." To Sufyan ne unse kaha: "Hakim mein kya hai ke Shu'bah unse riwayat nahi karte?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." Sufyan ne kaha: "Maine Zubaid ko ye hadith Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid se bayan karte suna hai." Aur humare kuch asaatiza ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ath-Thawri, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi ke paas pachaas dirham hon, to uske liye zakat jaayez nahi. Unhon ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Hakim bin Jubair ki hadith ko nahi apnaya aur ismein gunjaish di, unhon ne kaha: Agar uske paas pachaas dirham ya zyada hon aur wo zaroormand ho, to wo zakat le sakta hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur doosre fuqaha aur ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that :the Prophet said: "Charity is not lawful for the rich nor for the physically fit
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zakat kisi ameer ke liye jaayez nahi, aur na kisi taqatwar tandurust ke liye." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Hubshi bin Junadah, aur Qabisah bin Mukhariq se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne Sa'd bin Ibrahim se ye hadith isi isnad ke saath riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya. Aur doosri hadith mein, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: \"Maangna kisi ameer ke liye jaayez nahi, na taqatwar tandurust ke liye.\" Aur agar aadmi taqatwar aur zaroormand ho aur uske paas kuch na ho, to usse sadqa dena, sadqa dene wale ke liye ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek kaafi hai, aur is hadith ka matlab kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek maangne ke baare mein hai.

e: Hubshi bin Junadah As-Saluli narrated:"During the Farewell Hajj, while the Messener of allah was standing at Arafat, a Bedouin came to him begging while pulling on the edge of his Rida. He gave him something and he left. With that, begging was made unlawful, so the Messenger of Allah said: 'Begging is not lawful for the rich nor for the physically fit, except for the one who is severely poor or in perilous debt. And whoever begs the people (merely) to increase his wealth, then on the Day of Judgment (the wealth he begged for) will be lacerations on his face and heated coals from Hell will be provided for him to eat. Whoever wishes, let him take a little, and whoever wishes, then let him take a lot
hi: Hubshi bin Junadah As-Saluli (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sunaa jabke wo Arafat mein khade the, ek Bedouin unke paas aaya aur unki chadar ka kinara pakad kar unse maanga, unhon ne use de diya aur wo chala gaya. Isi waqt maangna haraam ho gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Maangna kisi ameer ke liye jaayez nahi, na kisi taqatwar tandurust ke liye, siwaye us shakhs ke jo shadeed gareeb ho ya jispar bhaari qarz ho. Aur jo logon se maal badhaane ke liye maange, uske liye Qayamat ke din uske chehre par khraashein hongi, aur wo Jahannam ke jalte hue koyle khaayega. To jo chahe kam le, aur jo chahe zyada le.'"

e: Narrator mentioned in hadith:There is another chain with a similar narration
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi tareeqe se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"During the time of the Messenger of Allah, a man suffered a loss on fruits that he had sold, resulting in more debt. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Give him charity.' So the people gave him charity but it did not cover his debt. So the Messenger of Allah said to his debtors: 'Take what you have and there is nothing for you but that
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek aadmi ko khajooron ki khareed mein nuqsaan hua jise usne khareeda tha, to uska qarz badh gaya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usse sadqa do.'" To logon ne usse sadqa diya lekin wo uska qarz poora karne ke liye kaafi nahi hua. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske qarz-khwaahon se farmaya: "Jo mil jaaye wo le lo, tumhare liye isse zyada kuch nahi." Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Juwairiyah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Bahz bin Hakim narrated from his father, from his grandfather who said:"When something was brought to him, the Messenger of Allah would ask: 'Is this charity or a gift?' If they said: 'Charity.' He would not eat it, and if they said, 'A gift' he would eat it
hi: Bahz bin Hakim apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas koi cheez laayi jaati, to wo pucchte: 'Ye sadqa hai ya tohfa?' Agar log kehte: Sadqa, to wo nahi khaate, aur agar kehte: Tohfa, to khaate the." Aur is mauzu par Salman, Abu Hurairah, Anas, Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Amirah (Mu'arraf bin Wasil ke dada, jinka naam Rushaid bin Malik hai), Maimoon bin Mihran, Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Rafi, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Alqamah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur ye hadith Abdur-Rahman bin Alqamah se, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Aqeel se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Bahz bin Hakim ke dada ka naam Muawiyah bin Haidah Al-Qushairi hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Bahz bin Hakim ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Rafi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that :the Messenger of Allah sent a man from Banu Makhzun to collect charity, so he said to Abu Rafi: "Accompany me so that perhaps you may have some of it." So he said: "Not until I ask the Messenger of Allah." So he went to the Prophet to ask him, and he said: "Charity is not lawful for us, and to be the Mawda of a people to be the same as them
hi: Abu Rafi (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Banu Makhzum ke ek aadmi ko sadqa lene par bheja. Unhon ne Abu Rafi se kaha: "Mere saath chalo, taake shayad tumhein bhi ismein se kuch mile." Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi, jab tak main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaakar unse na pucchoon." To wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Sadqa humare liye jaayez nahi, aur qaum ke azaad kiye gulam khud unmein se hote hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Rafi, Nabi (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam, ka naam Aslam hai, aur Ibn Abi Rafi, Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi hain, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke katib.

e: Hafsah bint Sirin narrated from Ar-Rabab, from her uncle Salman bin Amir that he related that :the Prophet said: "When one of you breaks his fast, then let him do so with dried dates, for they are blessed. Whoever does not find dates, then water, for it is purifying." And he said: "Charity given to the needy is (counted as) charity, and if it is given to relatives it is (counted as) two: charity and nurturing (the ties of kinship)
hi: Salman bin Aamir apne chacha se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi roza khole, to wo khajoor se khole, kyunki usmein barkat hai, aur agar khajoor na mile to paani se, kyunki wo paak hai." Aur farmaya: "Miskeen ko sadqa dena sirf sadqa hai, aur rishtedaar ko dena do cheezein hain: sadqa aur sila-e-rahmi." Aur is mauzu par Zainab (Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki biwi), Jabir, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Salman bin Aamir ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Ar-Rabab, Umm Ar-Raih bint Sulai hain.

e: Fatimah bint Qais narrated that :she asked -or, the Prophet was asked - about Zakat, and he said: "Indeed there is a duty on wealthy aside from Zakat." Then he recited this Ayah which is in Al-Baqarah: 'It is not Al-Birr (piety, righteousness) that you turn your faces.' (Al-Baqarah 2:)
hi: Fatimah bint Qais (RA) ne kaha: "Maine pucha - ya Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya - zakat ke baare mein, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Maal mein zakat ke alawa bhi ek haq hai.'" Phir unhon ne Surah Al-Baqarah ki ye Ayat padhi: '(Neki ye nahi ke tum apne chehre mode)' Ayat.

e: Fatimah bint Qais narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed there is a duty on wealth aside from Zakat
hi: Fatimah bint Qais se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maal mein zakat ke alawa bhi haq hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad utna mazboot nahi. Aur Abu Hamzah Maimoon Al-A'war kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur Bayan aur Ismail bin Salim ne Ash-Sha'bi se ye hadith unka apna qaul riwayat ki, aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "None gives charity from Tayyib - and Allah does not accept but Tayyib - but that Ar-Rahman accepts it with His Right (Hand). Even if it is a date, it is nurtured in the Hand of Ar-Rahman until it is greater than a mountain, just as one of you nurtures his foal or young camel
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi paak kamaai se sadqa nahi deta - aur Allah paak ke siwa qubool nahi karta - magar Rahman use apne dahine haath se le leta hai, chahe wo ek khajoor hi kyun na ho, wo Rahman ki hatheli mein badhta rehta hai, yahan tak ke pahaad se bhi bada ho jaata hai, jaise tum mein se koi apna ghode ka bachcha ya oont ka bachcha palta hai." Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Adiyy bin Hatim, Anas, Abdullah bin Abi Awfa, Harithah bin Wahb, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, aur Buraidah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed Allah accepts charity, and He accepts it with His Right (Hand) to nurture it for one of you, just like one of you would nuture his foal, until the bite (of food) becomes as large as Uhud." The Book of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime testifies to that: 'He accepts repentance from His worshipers, and accepts charity.'And: 'Allah will destroy Riba and give increase for charity.' (Abu Eisa) said: This Hadith is (Hasan) Sahih
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah sadqa qubool karta hai aur ise apne dahine haath se leta hai, phir ise tum mein se kisi ke liye aise palta hai jaise tum mein se koi apna bachhda palta hai, yahan tak ke luqma Uhud pahaad jitna ho jaata hai." Aur iski tasdeeq Allah Azza wa Jall ki Kitab mein bhi hai: '(Aur wahi hai jo apne bandon se tauba qubool karta hai)' aur '(aur sadqaat leta hai)' '(Allah sood ko mitaata hai aur sadqaat ko badhaata hai)'. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi riwayat hui hai. Aur kai ahl-e-ilm ne is hadith aur isi jaisi doosri riwayaton ke baare mein, jo Allah ki sifaton aur Rab Tabarak wa Ta'ala ke har raat duniya ke aasman ki taraf utarne ke baare mein hain, kaha: In cheezon ki riwayaten saabit hain aur inpar imaan laaya jaata hai, aur na inka kaifiyat socha jaata hai na kaha jaata hai \"kaise?\" Isi tarah Malik, Sufyan bin Uyainah, aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne in ahadees ke baare mein kaha: Inhen bina kaifiyat ke guzarne do. Aur Ahl-e-Sunnat wal-Jama'at ke ahl-e-ilm ka yehi qaul hai. Lekin Jahmiyyah ne in riwayaton ka inkaar kiya aur kaha: Ye tashbih hai. Aur Allah Azza wa Jall ne apni Kitab mein kai jagah \"haath,\" \"sunna,\" aur \"dekhna\" ka zikr kiya hai, to Jahmiyyah ne in Ayaton ki tawil ki aur unhen ahl-e-ilm ki tafseer se hat kar tafseer di, aur kaha: Allah ne Aadam ko apne haath se paida nahi kiya. Aur unhon ne kaha: \"Haath\" ka matlab yahan taaqat hai. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Tashbih tab hoti hai jab kaha jaaye \"haath jaisa haath\" ya \"haath ki tarah\" ya \"sunna jaisa sunna\" ya \"sunne ki tarah.\" Agar koi kahe \"sunna jaisa sunna\" ya \"sunne ki tarah\" to ye tashbih hai. Lekin agar koi waise hi kahe jaise Allah Ta'ala ne khud kaha \"haath,\" \"sunna,\" aur \"dekhna\" - aur \"kaise\" na kahe, na \"sunne jaisa\" ya \"sunne ki tarah\" kahe - to ye tashbih nahi, jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne apni Kitab mein farmaya: \"Uske jaisa kuch nahi, aur wo sunne wala, dekhne wala hai.\"

e: Anas narrated that :the Prophet was asked which fast was most virtuous after Ramadan? He said: "Sha'ban in honor of Ramadan" He said: "Which charity is best?" He (pbuh) said: "Charity in Ramadan
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: Ramzan ke baad sabse afzal roza kaun sa hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Sha'ban ka, Ramzan ki azmat ke liye.' Pucha gaya: Aur sabse afzal sadqa kaun sa hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Ramzan mein diya gaya sadqa.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Sadaqah bin Musa unke nazdeek utne mazboot nahi.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed charity extinguishes the Lord's anger and it protects against the evil death
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak sadqa Rab ka gussa bujhaata hai aur buri maut se bachaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Bujaid narrated from his grandmother; :Umm Bujaid - and she was one of those who gave the pledge to the Prophet - she said to the Messenger of Allah: "There is a needy person who stands outside my door, but I cannot find anything to give to him." So the Messenger of Allah said to her: "If you do not find anything to give him except a burnt trotter then hand it over to him
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Bujaid apni dadi Umm Bujaid se riwayat karte hain - jo un logon mein se thin jinhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baiyat ki thi - unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Ek miskeen mere darwaze par khada hota hai, lekin mujhe use dene ke liye kuch nahi milta." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Agar tumhein dene ke liye kuch na mile siwaye jale hue khur ke, to wo hi uske haath mein de do." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Hurairah, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Bujaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab narrated from Safwan bin Umayyah who said:"The Messenger of Allah gave to me on the Day of Hunain, and he was the most hated creature to me. But he did not stop giving to me until he was the most loved creature to me
hi: Safwan bin Umayyah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Hunain ke din diya, jabke wo tamaam makhlooq mein se mujhe sabse zyada napasand the. Wo mujhe dete hi rahe yahan tak ke wo makhlooq mein se mujhe sabse zyada aziz ho gaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Mujhe Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ye ya isi jaisi baat mudhakara mein bataayi. Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Safwan ki hadith Ma'mar aur doosron ne Az-Zuhri se, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se riwayat ki ke Safwan bin Umayyah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe diya. Aur goya ye hadith zyada sahih aur zyada mel khaati hai, ye sirf Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ki hai ke Safwan ne kaha. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Mu'allafatul-Qulub ko dene ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Unhen na diya jaaye. Unhon ne kaha: Wo to sirf Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein wo log the jinhen wo Islam ki taraf mail karne ke liye kuch dete the yahan tak ke wo Musalman ho gaye. Aur unhon ne aaj unhen isi tarah zakat se dena theek nahi samjha, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Kufa waalon, aur doosron ka qaul hai, aur Ahmad aur Ishaq bhi isi ke qaayal hain. Aur kuch ne kaha: Jo aaj bhi aise logon jaisa ho aur Imam unhen Islam ki taraf mail karna munasib samjhe aur unhen de, to ye jaayez hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated from his father:"I was sitting with the Prophet when a woman came to him and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I gave a slave girl to my mother in charity and she died.' He said: 'Your reward is already established, and your right to inherit her has returned it (that Sadaqah) to you.' She said: 'O Messenger of Allah! There was a month of fasting due on her, shall I perform the fast for her?' He said: 'Fast on her behalf.' She said: 'O Messenger of Allah! She never performed Hajj, shall I perform Hajj for her?' He said: 'Yes, perform Hajj on her behalf
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha tha ke ek aurat aayi aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine apni maa ko sadqe mein ek laundi di thi, aur wo intiqaal kar gayi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhara ajr wajib ho gaya, aur wiraasat ne wo tumhein wapas laut di.'" Usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Uspar ek mahine ka roza baaqi tha, kya main uski taraf se roza rakhoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Uski taraf se roza rakho." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Usne kabhi Hajj nahi kiya, kya main uski taraf se Hajj karoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan, uski taraf se Hajj karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Buraidah ki riwayat mein sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai. Aur Abdullah bin Ata ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hain. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar aadmi koi sadqa de, phir usse wirasat mein paa le, to wo uske liye jaayez hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Sadqa to wo cheez hai jo usne Allah ke liye di, agar wo use wirasat mein paaye, to zaroori hai ke wo use isi jaisi jagah mein kharch kare. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Zuhair bin Muawiyah ne ye hadith Abdullah bin Ata se riwayat ki.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :Umar gave a horse to be used in the cause of Allah. Then he saw it being sold, so he wanted to buy it, but the Prophet said: "Do not take back what you have given in charity
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Umar (RA) ne Allah ki raah mein ek ghoda diya, phir unhon ne use bikte dekha to use khareedna chaaha. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne sadqe ko wapas mat lo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Ikrimah narrated from Ibn Abbas that :a man said: "O Messenger of Allah! My mother died, will it benefit her if I give charity on her behalf?" He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'I have a Makhraf, so bear witness that I have given it in charity on her behalf
hi: Ikrimah, Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte hain ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Meri maa intiqaal kar gayi hain, kya use faida hoga agar main uski taraf se sadqa doon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan." Usne kaha: "Mere paas ek bagheecha hai, main aapko gawaah banaata hoon ke maine wo uski taraf se sadqe mein de diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain, wo kehte hain: Marne wale tak sirf sadqa aur dua hi pahunchti hai. Aur kuch ne ye hadith Amr bin Dinar se, Ikrimah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: Aur unke qaul "Mere paas ek makhraf hai" ka matlab hai bagheecha.

e: Abu Umamah Al-Bahili said:"During a sermon of his in the year of the Farewell Hajj, I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'A woman is not to spend anything from her husbands house without her husband's permission.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about food?' He said: 'That is our most virtuous wealth
hi: Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Hajjat-ul-Wida ke saal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khutba mein kehte suna: 'Aurat apne shohar ke ghar se kuch bhi shohar ki ijazat ke bagair kharch na kare.'" Pucha gaya: "Ya Rasool Allah! Khaana bhi nahi?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Wo to humare behtareen maal hain." Aur is mauzu par Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Asma bint Abi Bakr, Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Umamah ki hadith hasan hai.

e: Aishah narrated that :the Prophet said: "When a woman gives in charity from her husband's house, she will get the reward for it, and for her husband is the same as that, and for the trustee is the same as that. The reward of each them will not be decreased at all by the reward of the other, for him is what he earned, and for her is what she spent
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aurat apne shohar ke ghar se sadqa de, to uske liye ajr hai, aur shohar ke liye bhi utna hi, aur khazaanchi ke liye bhi utna hi, aur unmein se kisi ke ajr se doosre ke ajr mein koi kami nahi aati, uske liye jo usne kamaya, aur uske liye jo usne kharch kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "When a woman gives from her husband's home, with a good heart, not to spoil it, then she will get a reward similar to his, for her is the good she intended - and the same is for the trustee
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aurat apne shohar ke ghar se dil ki khushi se de, bagair fasaad ke, to uske liye uske shohar jaisa hi ajr hai, uske liye jo usne neeyat ki achi hai, aur khazaanchi ke liye bhi utna hi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Amr bin Murrah ki, Abu Wa'il se riwayat se zyada sahih hai, aur Amr bin Murrah apni hadith mein Masruq ka zikr nahi karte.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"We would give Zakat Al-Fitr - when the Messenger of Allah was among us - as a Sa of food, or a Sa of barely, or a Sa of dried dates, or a Sa of raisins, or a Sa of cheese. So we did not stop paying it (like that) until Mu'awiyah arrived in Al-Madinah and talked (about it). Among the things he addressed the people with, he said: 'I see that two Mudd of the wheat of Ash-Sham are equal to a Sa of dried dates.' So the people followed that." Abu Sa'eed said: "I will not stop giving it in the manner that I had been giving it
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Zakat-ul-Fitr - jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare darmiyan the - ek saa khaana ya ek saa jau ya ek saa khajoor ya ek saa munaqqa ya ek saa panir nikaalte the. To hum isi tarah dete rahe yahan tak ke Muawiyah Madina aaye aur unhon ne baat ki. Unhon ne logon se jo baatein ki unmein se ek ye thi: 'Mujhe lagta hai Shaam ke gehun ke do mudd, ek saa khajoor ke barabar hain.' To log isi ko apnaane lage." Abu Sa'eed ne kaha: "Lekin main isi tarah nikaalta rahunga jaisa main pehle nikaalta tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo har cheez se ek saa maante hain, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha: Har cheez se ek saa, siwaye gehun ke, jismein aadha saa kaafi hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, wo gehun se aadha saa maante hain.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his grandfather that :the Prophet sent a caller in the roads of Makkah proclaiming "Sadaqatul-Fitr is required upon every Muslim, male or female, free or slave, young or old; it is two Mudd of wheat or its equivalent of a Sa of food
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Makkah ki galiyon mein ek munaadi bheja: "Suno! Zakat-ul-Fitr har Musalman par farz hai, mard ho ya aurat, azaad ho ya ghulam, chhota ho ya bada: gehun ke do mudd, ya iske alawa ek saa khaana." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Umar bin Harun ne ye hadith Ibn Juraij se riwayat ki aur kaha "Al-Abbas bin Mina se," Nabi (SAW) se, aur isme is hadith ka kuch hissa zikr kiya.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Messenger of Allah made Sadaqatul-Fitr an obligation upon the male and female, the free and the bondsmen, as a Sa of dried dates or a Sa of barley." He said: "So the people equated that to half a Sa of wheat
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Zakat-ul-Fitr mard, aurat, azaad, aur ghulam par farz ki, ek saa khajoor ya ek saa jau." Unhon ne kaha: "To log gehun ke aadhe saa ki taraf mud gaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Abbas, Al-Harith bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Dhubab ke dada, Tha'labah bin Abi Sughair, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Messenger of Allah made Sadaqatul-Fitr of Ramadan an obligation - a Sa of dried dates or a Sa of barley - required upon every free person and slave, male and female among the Muslims
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ramzan ki Zakat-ul-Fitr farz ki, ek saa khajoor ya ek saa jau, har azaad ya ghulam, mard ya aurat, Musalmanon par. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Malik ne Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se Ayyub ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki aur ismein "Musalmanon mein se" zyada kiya. Aur kai doosron ne Nafi se riwayat ki lekin "Musalmanon mein se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Agar aadmi ke ghair-Musalman ghulam hon, to wo unki taraf se Zakat-ul-Fitr na de. Aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo unki taraf se de, chahe wo ghair-Musalman hi kyun na hon. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Messenger of Allah would order paying the Zakat before going to the Salat on the day of Fitr
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fitr ke din namaz ke liye subah jaane se pehle zakat nikaalne ka hukum dete the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ko Mustahab samajhte hain ke aadmi Zakat-ul-Fitr namaz ke liye subah jaane se pehle nikaale.

e: Ali narrated:"Al-Abbas asked the Messenger of Allah about paying his charity (Zakat) in advance before its time is due (by being in possession for a whole year), he permitted him to do that
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Al-Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni zakat jaldi dene ke baare mein pucha, uske waqt se pehle, to unhon ne unhen iski rukhsat di.

e: Ali narrated that :the Prophet said to Umar: "We have taken this year's Zakat from Al-Abbas in the previous year
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Umar se farmaya: "Humne Al-Abbas ki zakat pichhle saal ke liye pehle hi le li thi is saal ke liye." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Mujhe zakat jaldi dene ki hadith, Isra'il ki, Al-Hajjaj bin Dinar se riwayat mein, sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai, aur mere nazdeek Ismail bin Zakariya ki, Al-Hajjaj se riwayat, Isra'il ki, Al-Hajjaj bin Dinar se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Al-Hakam bin Utaibah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka zakat waqt se pehle jaldi dene ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, ahl-e-ilm ke ek jamaat ne kaha: Ise jaldi na diya jaaye. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Mujhe pasand hai ke ise jaldi na diya jaaye. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar isse waqt se pehle jaldi diya jaaye to ye kaafi hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that he heard :the Messenger of Allah saying: "For one of you to go out early to gather firewood and carry it on his back so that he can give charity from it and be free of need from the people, is better for him than to ask a man who may give that to him or refuse. Indeed the upper hand (giving) is more virtuous than the lower hand (receiving), and begin with (those who are) your dependants
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Tum mein se koi subah nikle aur apni peeth par lakdiyan uthaaye, phir usse sadqa de aur khud ko logon se be-niyaaz kar le, ye uske liye behtar hai is se ke wo kisi aadmi se maange, chahe wo use de ya na de, kyunki upar wala haath dene wale ka neeche wale haath lene wale se afzal hai. Aur pehle unse shuru karo jinke tum zimmedaar ho.'" Aur is mauzu par Hakim bin Hizam, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, Atiyyah As-Sa'di, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Mas'ud bin Amr, Ibn Abbas, Thawban, Ziyad bin Al-Harith As-Suda'i, Anas, Hubshi bin Junadah, Qabisah bin Mukhariq, Samurah, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, Bayan ki, Qais se riwayat mein ajeeb samjhi jaati hai.

e: Samurah bin Jundub narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Asking is a labor that toils on a man's face, except if a man asks for something from the Sultan (ruler), or he asks for something that he cannot do without
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maangna ek mashaqqat hai jisse aadmi apna chehra thakaata hai, siwaye is ke ke wo kisi hukumraan se maange, ya kisi laazmi cheez ke liye maange." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "On the first night of the month of Ramadan, the Shayatin are shackled, the jinns are restrained, the gates of the Fires are shut such that no gate among them would be opened. The gates of Paradise are opened such that no gate among them would be closed, and a caller calls: 'O seeker of the good; come near!' and 'O seeker of evil; stop! For there are those whom Allah frees from the Fire.' And that is every night
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Ramzan ki pehli raat hoti hai, to Shayateen aur sarkash jinnaat zanjeeron mein jakad diye jaate hain, aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jaate hain, unmein se koi darwaza khula nahi rehta. Aur Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, unmein se koi darwaza band nahi rehta. Aur ek munaadi pukarta hai: 'Ae neki chahne wale! Aage badh! Aur ae buraai chahne wale! Ruk ja!' Aur Allah ke liye aag se azaad hone wale log hain, aur ye har raat hota hai." Aur is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Salman se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever fasts Ramadan and stands (in the night prayer) for it out of faith and seeking a reward (from Allah), he will be forgiven what preceded of his sins. Whoever stands (in the night prayer) on the Night of Al-Qadr out of faith and seeking a reward (from Allah), he will be forgiven what preceded of his sins
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Ramzan ka roza rakhe aur usmein imaan aur sawaab ki niyat se qayaam kare, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain. Aur jo Lailatul-Qadr mein imaan aur sawaab ki niyat se qayaam kare, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain." Ye hadith sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki jo hadith Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ne riwayat ki hai, wo ghareeb hai, hum ise Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki, Al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat mein sirf Abu Bakr ki hadith se hi jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Humein Al-Hasan bin Ar-Rabi ne bataya, humein Abu Al-Ahwas ne Al-A'mash se, Mujahid se bataya, unka qaul: \"Jab Ramzan ki pehli raat hoti hai.\" Phir unhon ne hadith zikr ki. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur ye mere nazdeek Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Do not precede the month with a day nor with two days, unless that fast falls on a day that one of you would have (normally) fasted. Fast with its sighting and break fast with its sighting, and if it is cloudy, then count for thirty days, and then break (the fast)
