hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mahine se ek din ya do din pehle roza mat rakho, siwaye is ke ke wo us roze se mel khaaye jo tum mein se koi pehle se rakhta ho. Chaand dekh kar roza rakho aur chaand dekh kar Eid manaao. Agar tumpar chaand chhup jaaye, to tees din poore karo." Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir ne Rib'i bin Hirash se, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi Ramzan mahine ke shuru hone se pehle, Ramzan ki niyat se, roza jaldi rakhe, aur agar aadmi koi aur roza rakhta ho aur wo isse mel khaa jaaye, to unke nazdeek isme koi harj nahi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Do no precede the month of Ramadan by fasting a day or two before it, unless it is the case of a man who normally performs some fast, then let him fast it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ramzan mahine se ek ya do din pehle roza mat rakho, siwaye is ke ke koi aadmi pehle se koi roza rakhta ho, to wo use rakhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Silah bin Zufar said:"We were with Ammar bin Yasir when a roasted sheep was brought and he said: 'Eat.' Someone among the people said: 'I am fasting.' So Ammar said: 'Whoever fasts on a day in which there is doubt, then he has disobeyed Abul-Qasim (pbuh)
hi: Silah bin Zufar ne kaha: "Hum Ammar bin Yasir ke paas the, ek bhuni hui bakri laayi gayi, to unhon ne kaha: 'Khao.' Kuch log peeche hat gaye, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main roze se hoon.' To Ammar ne kaha: 'Jo shakhs us din roza rakhe jismein logon ko shak ho, usne Abul-Qasim (SAW) ki nafarmani ki.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ammar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke Tabi'een ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi us din roza rakhe jismein shak ho, aur zyada tar ne maana ke agar usne roza rakh liya aur wo Ramzan mahine ka nikla, to wo uski jagah ek din ki qaza kare.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Count the (the appearances of) the crescent of Sha'ban for Ramadan
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sha'ban ke chaand ko Ramzan ke liye gino." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hum isi jaisi sirf Abu Mu'awiyah ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur sahih wo hai jo Muhammad bin Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: \"Ramzan mahine se ek din ya do din pehle roza mat rakho.\" Aur isi jaisi Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, Muhammad bin Amr Al-Laithi ki hadith jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not fast before Ramadan. Fast with its sighting, and break fast with its sighting, and if it is obscured from you, then complete thirty days
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ramzan se pehle roza mat rakho. Chaand dekh kar roza rakho aur chaand dekh kar Eid manaao. Agar tumhare aur uske darmiyan koi cheez rukaawat bane, to tees din poore karo." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abu Bakrah, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Ibn Mas`ud said:"What I fasted with the Prophet that was twenty-nine (days), was more than what we fasted that was thirty." (He said): There are narrations on this topic from `Umar, Abu Hurairah, `A'isha, Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas, Ibn `Abbas, Ibn `Umar, Anas, Jabir, Umm Salamah, Abu Bakrah, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The month is twenty nine (days)
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath jitni baar unnees rakhi, wo tees se zyada bar thi." Aur is mauzu par Umar, Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Umar, Anas, Jabir, Umm Salamah, aur Abu Bakrah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mahina unnees ka bhi hota hai."

e: Anas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah vowed to stay away from his wives for a month, so he stayed in a loft for twenty-nine days. They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, your vow was for a month,' so he said: 'The month is twenty-nine (days)
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon se ek mahine door rehne ki qasam khayi, to wo ek balakhaane mein unnees din rahe." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aapne to ek mahine ki qasam khayi thi." To unhon ne farmaya: "Mahina unnees ka hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"A Bedouin came to the Prophet and said: 'I have seen the crescent.' So he said: 'Do you testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah? Do you testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Yes.' So he said: 'O Bilal! Announce to the people that they should fast tomorrow
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Ek Bedouin Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Maine chaand dekha hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi? Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain?' Usne kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Bilal! Logon mein azaan do ke wo kal roza rakhen.'" Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith mein ikhtilaaf hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne Simak se, Ikrimah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki, aur zyada tar Simak ke saathiyon ne Simak se, Ikrimah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Roze mein ek aadmi ki gawahi qubool ki jaati hai. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Ishaq ne kaha: Sirf do aadmiyon ki gawahi se hi roza rakha jaaye. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ismein ikhtilaaf nahi ke Eid manaane ke liye sirf do aadmiyon ki gawahi qubool hoti hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah narrated from his father that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The two months of Eid will not both be deficient: Ramadn and Dhul-Hijjah
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Eid ke do mahine kam nahi hote: Ramzan aur Dhul-Hijjah." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Bakrah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah se, Nabi (SAW) se, mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Ahmad ne kaha: Is hadith \"Eid ke do mahine kam nahi hote\" ka matlab hai ke ek hi saal mein dono - Ramzan aur Dhul-Hijjah - kam nahi hote, agar unmein se ek kam ho to doosra poora hota hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Iska matlab hai \"Kam nahi hote,\" yani agar unnees ka bhi ho to wo poora hai, kam nahi. Aur Ishaq ke mazhab par, dono mahine ek saath ek hi saal mein kam ho sakte hain.

e: Muhammad bin Abi Harmalah narrated:"Kuraib informed me that Umm Al-Fadl bin Al-Harith sent him to Mu'awiyah in Ash-Sham. He said: 'So I arrived in Ash-Sham and finished her errand, and I saw the crescent of Ramadan while I was in Ash-Sham. We saw the crescent on the night of Friday. Then I arrived in Al-Madinah at the end of the month. Ibn Abbas was questioning me, then he mentioned the crescent and he said: "When did you see the crescent?" I said: "We saw it n the night of Friday." He said: "Did you see it on the night of Friday?" I said: "The people saw it, so they fasted, and Mu'awiyah fasted." He said: "But we saw it on the night of Saturday, so we will not stop fasting until we complete thirty days or we see it." So I said: "Is not the sighting and fasting of Mu'awiyah enough for you?" He said: "This is not how the Messenger of Allah ordered us
hi: Muhammad bin Abi Harmalah ne kaha: "Kuraib ne mujhe bataya ke Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith ne unhen Muawiyah ke paas Shaam bheja. Unhon ne kaha: 'To main Shaam pahuncha aur unka kaam poora kiya, aur mere paas hote hue Ramzan ka chaand nikla jabke main Shaam mein tha. Humne chaand Jumme ki raat dekha. Phir main mahine ke aakhir mein Madina aaya, to Ibn Abbas ne mujhse pucha, phir chaand ka zikr karte hue kaha: Tumne chaand kab dekha? Maine kaha: Humne use Jumme ki raat dekha. Unhon ne kaha: Kya tumne khud use Jumme ki raat dekha? Maine kaha: Logon ne dekha aur unhon ne roza rakha, aur Muawiyah ne bhi roza rakha. Unhon ne kaha: Lekin humne use Hafte ki raat dekha, is liye hum roza rakhte rahenge yahan tak ke tees din poore karen ya use dekhen. Maine kaha: Kya aapko Muawiyah ke dekhne aur roze par bharosa nahi hai? Unhon ne kaha: Nahi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein aisa hi hukum diya hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai ke har shehar waalon ke liye unka apna chaand dekhna maana jaata hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has dried dates, then let him break the fast with that, and whoever does not, then let him break the fast with water, for indeed water is purifying
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo khajoor paaye wo usi se roza khole, aur jo na paaye wo paani se roza khole, kyunki paani paak hai." Aur is mauzu par Salman bin Aamir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne Shu'bah se isi jaisi riwayat ki ho siwaye Sa'eed bin Aamir ke, aur ye hadith mahfooz nahi, aur hum iski koi asal Abdul-Aziz bin Suhaib ki, Anas se riwayat mein nahi jaante. Aur Shu'bah ke saathiyon ne ye hadith Shu'bah se, Aasim Al-Ahwal se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Ar-Rabab se, Salman bin Aamir se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur ye Sa'eed bin Aamir ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur isi tarah unhon ne Shu'bah se, Aasim se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Salman se riwayat ki aur Shu'bah ne ismein Ar-Rabab ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur sahih wo hai jo Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Uyainah, aur kai doosron ne Aasim Al-Ahwal se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Ar-Rabab se, Salman bin Aamir se riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Aun kehte hain \"Umm Ar-Raih bint Sulai se, Salman bin Aamir se.\" Aur Ar-Rabab hi Umm Ar-Raih hain.

e: Salman bin Amir Ad-Dabbi narrated that :the Prophet said: "When one of you breaks his fast, then let him do so with dried dates. And whoever does not find dates, then water, for it is purifying
hi: Salman bin Aamir Ad-Dabbi (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi roza khole, to wo khajoor se khole." Ibn Uyainah ne izafa kiya: "Kyunki usmein barkat hai, aur jo na paaye wo paani se khole, kyunki wo paak hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would break the fast with fresh dates before performing Salat. If there were no fresh dates then (he would break the fast) with dried dates, and if there were no dried dates then he would take a few sips of water
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) namaz padhne se pehle taaza khajooron se roza khola karte the, agar taaza khajoorein na hotin to sookhi khajooron se, aur agar sookhi khajoorein na hotin to paani ke kuch ghoont peete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sardi mein khajooron se aur garmi mein paani se roza khole the.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "The fast is the day the people fast, the breaking of the fast is the day the people break their fast, and the sacrifice is the day the people sacrifice
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roza us din hai jis din tum sab roza rakho, aur Eid-ul-Fitr us din hai jis din tum sab Eid manaao, aur Eid-ul-Adha us din hai jis din tum sab qurbani karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne is hadith ki tashreeh ki aur kaha: Iska matlab ye hai ke roza aur Eid jamaat aur aksar logon ke saath hoti hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When the night advances and the day retreats, and the sun is hidden, then the fast is to be broken
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab raat aa jaaye aur din chala jaaye aur sooraj doob jaaye, to tumne roza khol liya." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sahl bin Sa'd narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The people will remain upon goodness as long as they hasten to break the fast
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log hamesha bhalaai mein rahenge jab tak wo roza jaldi kholte rahenge." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, aur Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sahl bin Sa'd ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur yehi wo hai jise Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne pasand kiya, wo roza jaldi kholna pasand karte the. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He, said: 'Those of My worshippers who are most beloved to me are the quickest to break their fast
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Mere bandon mein se mujhe sabse zyada azeez wo hain jo sabse jaldi roza kholte hain.'"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:(A Hadith similar to no. 700 with a different chain)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se, Al-Awza'i se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Atiyyah said:"Masruq and I entered upon Aishah and we said: 'O Mother of the Believers! There are two men from the Companions of Muhammad, one of them hastens to break the fasts and he hastens to perform Salat. The other delays breaking the fast and he delays the Salat.' She said: 'Which of them hastens to break the fast and hastens to perform the Salat?' We said that it was Abdullah bin Mas'ud. She said: 'This is how the Messenger of Allah did it.' And the other was Abu Musa
hi: Abu Atiyyah ne kaha: "Main aur Masruq Aishah ke paas gaye, humne kaha: 'Ae Ummul-Momineen! Nabi (SAW) ke do Sahaba hain, ek jaldi roza kholta hai aur jaldi namaz padhta hai, aur doosra roza kholne mein aur namaz mein der karta hai.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Kaun jaldi roza kholta hai aur jaldi namaz padhta hai?' Humne kaha: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aisa hi karte the.' Aur doosre Abu Musa the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Atiyyah ka naam Malik bin Abi Aamir Al-Hamdani hai, aur unhen Malik bin Aamir Al-Hamdani bhi kaha jaata hai, aur "Ibn Aamir" zyada sahih hai.

e: Anas (bin Malik) narrated that :Zaid bin Thabit said: "We ate Sahar with the Messenger of Allah, then we stood for the Salat." I (Anas) said: "How long was that?" He said: "About the lengthy of fifty Ayahs
hi: Anas (bin Malik), Zaid bin Thabit se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath sehri ki, phir hum namaz ke liye khade hue." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine pucha: Iska waqt kitna tha? Unhon ne kaha: Taqreeban pachaas Ayaton jitna."

e: Anas (bin Malik) narrated:(Another chain) except that he said: "About the length for reciting fifty Ayahs
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Hisham se, isi jaisi, siwaye is ke ke unhon ne kaha: "Taqreeban pachaas Ayaton ki qiraat jitna." Aur is mauzu par Hudhaifah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Thabit ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne sehri der se karna Mustahab samjha.

e: Talq bin Ali narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Eat and drink, and do not be disturbed by the rising glow, eat and drink until the redness appears to you on the horizon
hi: Talq bin Ali (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khao aur pio, aur tumhein woh chamakti hui roshni jo upar uthti hai pareshan na kare, khao aur pio yahan tak ke tumhare saamne surkhi ufuq mein phail jaaye." Aur is mauzu par Adiyy bin Hatim, Abu Dharr, aur Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Talq bin Ali ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke roze daar par khaana-peena haraam nahi hota jab tak surkh Fajr ufuq mein phail na jaaye. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Samurah bin Jundub narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not let the Adhan of Bilal prevent you from your Sahar, nor the drawn out Fajr, but the Fajr that spreads on the horizon
hi: Samurah bin Jundub (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bilal ki azaan tumhein apni sehri se na roke, na hi lambi Fajr, balki wo Fajr jo ufuq mein failti hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever does not leave false speech, and acting according to it, then Allah is not in any need of him leaving his food and his drink
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jhoothi baat aur uspar amal na chhode, to Allah ko koi zaroorat nahi ke wo apna khaana-peena chhode." Aur is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Partake of Sahar, for indeed there is a blessing in the Sahar
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sehri karo, kyunki sehri mein barkat hai." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Jabir bin Abdullah, Ibn Abbas, Amr bin Al-As, Al-Irbad bin Sariyah, Utbah bin Abd, aur Abu Ad-Darda se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Amr bin Al-As narrated :(similar to no. 708) from the Prophet
hi: Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Humare roze aur Ahle Kitab ke roze ke darmiyan farq sehri ka khaana hai." Ye humein Qutaibah ne bataya, humein Laith ne Musa bin Ali se, apne walid se, Abu Qais (Amr bin Al-As ke azaad kiye gulam) se, Amr bin Al-As se, Nabi (SAW) se isi tarah bataya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Misr waale "Musa bin Ali" kehte hain aur Iraq waale "Musa bin Ula" kehte hain, aur wo Musa bin Ali bin Rabah Al-Lakhmi hain.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah went to Makkah in the Year of the Conquest, so he fasted until he reached Kura Al-Ghamim and the people were fasting with him. Then it was said to him: 'The fast has become difficult for the people, and they are watching you to see what you will do.' So after Asr, he called for a cup of water and drank it while the people were looking at him. Some of them broke the fast while some of them continued their fasting. It was conveyed to him that people were still fasting, so he said: "Those are the disobedient
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fath ke saal Makkah gaye, to unhon ne roza rakha yahan tak ke Kura Al-Ghamim pahunche, aur log unke saath roza rakhte the. To unse kaha gaya: "Logon ko roza mushkil laga raha hai, aur log dekh rahe hain aap kya karte hain." To unhon ne Asr ke baad ek pyala paani mangwaya aur piya jabke log unhen dekh rahe the, to kuch logon ne roza tod diya aur kuch ne rakha rakha. Unhen pata chala ke kuch log abhi bhi roza rakhe hue hain, to unhon ne farmaya: "Wo nafarman hain." Aur is mauzu par Ka'b bin Aasim, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi." Aur ahl-e-ilm ka safar mein roze ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, maana ke safar mein roza na rakhna afzal hai, yahan tak ke kuch ne kaha ke agar safar mein roza rakha to dobara qaza karni chahiye. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne safar mein roza na rakhna chuna. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha: Agar taaqat ho aur roza rakhe to acha hai, aur wo afzal hai, aur agar roza na rakhe to bhi acha hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke qaul \"Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi\" ka matlab, aur jab unhen pata chala ke log roza rakhe hue hain to farmaya \"Wo nafarman hain\" - iska matlab ye hai jab uska dil Allah ki rukhsat qubool karne ki taaqat na rakhta ho. Lekin jo shakhs roza na rakhna jaayez samajhta ho aur phir bhi roza rakhe aur usmein taaqat rakhta ho, to wo mujhe zyada acha lagta hai.

e: Aishah narrated that :Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah about fasting while traveling, and he fasted regularly. So the Messenger of Allah said: 'If you wish then fast, and if you wish then break (the fast)
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se safar mein roze ke baare mein pucha, aur wo lagataar roza rakhte the, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar chaho to roza rakho, aur agar chaho to na rakho." Aur is mauzu par Anas bin Malik, Abu Sa'eed, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Ad-Darda, aur Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith ke Hamzah bin Amr ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed (Al-Khudri) narrated:"We were on a journey with the Messenger of Allah during the month of Ramadan. No one objected to the fast of the one fasting nor the fast breaking of the one who broke his fast
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Ramzan mein safar karte the, to na roza rakhne wale ko roza na rakhne pe aib lagaaya jaata tha, na roza rakhne wale ko roza rakhne pe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"We were on a journey with the Messenger of Allah. Some of us were fasting and some of us broke their fast. The one who broke their fast had no objection to the one who fasted, and the one who fasted had no objection to the one who broke his fast. They saw that whoever had the strength to fast then that was good, and whoever was weak, then breaking it was better
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath safar karte the, humein se kuch roza rakhte the aur kuch nahi rakhte the. Na roza na rakhne wala roza rakhne wale par kuch mehsoos karta tha, na roza rakhne wala roza na rakhne wale par. Wo maante the ke jo taaqat rakhta ho aur roza rakhe to acha hai, aur jo kamzori mehsoos kare aur roza na rakhe to wo bhi acha hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ma'mar bin Abi Huyaiyah narrated that:he asked Ibn Al-Musaiyab about fasting on a journey, so he narrated to him that Umar bin Al-Khattab said: "We fought in two battles along with the Messenger of Allah during Ramadan; the Day of Badr, and the Conquest (of Makkah), so we broke our fast during them
hi: Ma'mar bin Abi Huyaiyah ne Ibn Al-Musayyib se safar mein roze ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne bataya ke Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Ramzan mein do ghazwe kiye, Badr ke din aur Fath ke din, aur humne un dono mein roza nahi rakha." Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne ek ghazwe mein roza na rakhne ka hukum diya. Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab se isi jaisi riwayat hai ke unhon ne dushman se milne ke waqt roza na rakhne ki rukhsat di, aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Anas bin Malik, a man from Banu Abdullah bin Ka'b said:"Some cavalry man of the Messenger of Allah came galloping upon us, so I came to the Messenger of Allah and found him having lunch. He said: "Come and eat." I said: 'I am fasting.' So he said: 'Come and I will narrate to you about the fast - or fasting. Indeed Allah Most High lifted (the fast and) half of the Salat from the traveler, and (He lifted) the fast - or fasting - from the pregnant person, or the breast-feeding person.' And by Allah! The Prophet said both of them or one of them. So woe to me! For I did not eat from the meal of the Prophet
hi: Anas bin Malik, Banu Abdullah bin Ka'b ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghudsawaar humpar hamla karne aaye, to main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhen khaana khaate paaya. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Qareeb aao aur khao.' Maine kaha: 'Main roze se hoon.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Qareeb aao, main tumhein roze ke baare mein bataata hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne musafir se roza aur aadhi namaz maaf ki hai, aur hamla ya doodh pilaane wali se roza maaf kiya hai.' Allah ki qasam! Nabi (SAW) ne ye donon baatein kahin, ya inmein se ek, to kaash main Nabi (SAW) ka khaana khaata!" Aur is mauzu par Abu Umayyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas bin Malik Al-Ka'bi ki hadith hasan hai, aur hum is Anas bin Malik ki, Nabi (SAW) se, is ek hadith ke siwaye koi doosri riwayat nahi jaante. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Hamla aur doodh pilaane wali roza chhodti hain aur qaza karti hain aur khaana khilaati hain. Aur ye Sufyan, Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo roza chhodti hain aur khaana khilaati hain, unpar qaza nahi, aur agar chahen to qaza karen, unpar khaana khilaana nahi. Aur ye Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"A woman came to the Prophet and said: 'My sister died while she had two consecutive months of fasting due.' So he said: 'Do you not see that if there was a debt due from your sister then you would have to pay it?' She said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then the right of Allah is more appropriate
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Ek aurat Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Meri behen intiqaal kar gayi hain aur unpar lagataar do mahine ka roza baaqi tha.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Batao, agar tumhari behen par qarz hota, to kya tum use ada karti?' Usne kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To Allah ka haq zyada haqdaar hai.'" Aur is mauzu par Buraidah, Ibn Umar, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:(A Hadith similar to no. 716 with a different chain)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi isnad se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abu Khalid Al-Ahmar ne ye hadith Al-A'mash se ache tareeke se riwayat ki. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Abu Khalid ke siwa doosron ne bhi Al-A'mash se Abu Khalid ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Mu'awiyah aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Al-A'mash se, Muslim Al-Batin se, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur unhon ne ismein Salamah bin Kuhail, na Ata, na Mujahid ka zikr kiya. Aur Abu Khalid ka naam Sulaiman bin Hayyan hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever died while he had a month to fast, then a needy person should be fed on his behalf in place of every day
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs ek mahine ka roza baaqi rakh kar mar jaaye, to uski taraf se har din ke badle ek miskeen ko khaana khilaya jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hum marfu' sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur sahih wo hai jo Ibn Umar se mauqoof, unka apna qaul, riwayat hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Marne wale ki taraf se roza rakha jaaye. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar marne wale par mannat ka roza baaqi ho to uski taraf se roza rakha jaaye, aur agar Ramzan ki qaza baaqi ho to uski taraf se khaana khilaya jaaye. Aur Malik, Sufyan, aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Koi kisi ki taraf se roza nahi rakhta. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ash'ath, Ibn Sawwar hain. Aur Muhammad mere nazdeek Ibn Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila hain.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "Three things do not break the fast of the fasting person: Cupping, vomiting, and the wet dream
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen cheezein roze daar ka roza nahi todtin: pachhna lagwaana, ulti aana, aur ehtelam hona." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ki hadith mahfooz nahi hai. Aur Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aslam aur Abdul-Aziz bin Muhammad aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Zaid bin Aslam se mursal riwayat ki, aur unhon ne usmein Abu Sa'eed ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Abu Dawud As-Sijzi ko kehte suna: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal se Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Unke bhai Abdullah bin Zaid mein koi harj nahi. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Muhammad ko Ali bin Abdullah Al-Madini se zikr karte suna: Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aslam thiqah hain, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam kamzor hain. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever is overcome by vomiting, then he is not required to make up (the fast), and whoever vomits on purpose, then he must make it up
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise ulti khud aa jaaye, uspar qaza nahi, aur jo jaan-boojh kar ulti kare, wo qaza kare." Aur is mauzu par Abu Ad-Darda, Thawban, aur Fadalah bin Ubaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Hisham ki, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat mein sirf Isa bin Yunus ki riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Muhammad ne kaha: Mujhe ye mahfooz nahi lagti. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai, lekin iska isnad sahih nahi. Aur Abu Ad-Darda, Thawban, aur Fadalah bin Ubaid se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ko ulti aayi to unhon ne roza tod diya. Aur iska matlab ye hai ke Nabi (SAW) nafl roza rakhe hue the, to unhen ulti aayi aur wo kamzor pad gaye, is liye unhon ne roza tod diya. Isi tarah kuch hadithon mein tafseel se riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek Abu Hurairah ki hadith, Nabi (SAW) se, par amal hai ke roze daar ko khud-ba-khud ulti aa jaaye to uspar qaza nahi, aur agar jaan-boojh kar ulti kare to wo qaza kare. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever eats or drinks forgetfully, then he has not broken (the fast), for it was only a provision that Allah provided for him
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhool kar khaaye ya piye, to uska roza nahi tootta, ye to sirf Allah ka diya rizq hai."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:(Another chain) with the same or similar (Hadith as no)
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi ya milti julti. Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Umm Ishaq Al-Ghanawiyyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Agar Ramzan mein bhool kar khaaye, to uspar qaza hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever breaks the fast during Ramadan without an allowance or illness, then if he fasted for all time, his fasting would not make up for it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Ramzan ka ek din bina kisi rukhsat ya bimaari ke roza tode, to poori zindagi ka roza bhi uska badla nahi de sakta, chahe wo poori zindagi roza rakhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abu Al-Mutawwis ka naam Yazid bin Al-Mutawwis hai, aur mujhe unki is ek hadith ke siwa koi aur maloom nahi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:A man came and said: "O Messenger of Allah; I am ruined!" He said: "What has ruined you?" He said: "I had sexual relations with my wife during Ramadan." He said: "Are you able to free a slave?" He said, "No." He said: "Then are you able to fast for two consecutive months?" He said, "No." He said: "Then are you able to feed sixty needy people?" He said, "No." He said: "Sit." So he sat. A big basket full of dates was brought to the Prophet, and he said: "Give it in charity." So he said: "There is no one needier than us between its two mountains." So the Prophet laughing until his pre-molar teeth appeared, and he said: "Then take it to feed your family
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke: Ek aadmi aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Main barbaad ho gaya!" Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhein kya barbaad kar gaya?" Usne kaha: "Maine Ramzan mein apni biwi se sambhog kiya." Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tum ek ghulam azaad kar sakte ho?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "To kya tum lagataar do mahine roza rakh sakte ho?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "To kya tum saath miskeenon ko khaana khila sakte ho?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Baitho." To wo baith gaya. Phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas khajooron se bhara ek bada tokra laaya gaya - aur 'araq' bade tokre ko kehte hain - unhon ne farmaya: "Ise sadqe mein de do." To usne kaha: "Iske do pahaadon ke darmiyan hum se zyada koi gareeb nahi." To Nabi (SAW) itna hanse ke unke daant ki peechhli haddiyan nazar aa gayin. Unhon ne farmaya: "To ise le jaao aur apne ghar walon ko khilaao." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Aishah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai jo shakhs Ramzan mein jaan-boojh kar sambhog se roza tode. Lekin jo shakhs jaan-boojh kar khaane ya peene se roza tode, uske baare mein ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Uspar qaza aur kaffara donon hain, unhon ne khaane-peene ko sambhog jaisa maana. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Uspar sirf qaza hai, kaffara nahi, kyunki Nabi (SAW) se sirf sambhog mein kaffara ka zikr hua hai, khaane-peene mein nahi. Aur unhon ne kaha: Khaana-peena sambhog jaisa nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ka us aadmi se qaul jisne roza toda aur unhon ne usse sadqa diya \"Ise le jaao aur apne ghar walon ko khilaao\" - iske kayi matlab ho sakte hain, mumkin hai ke kaffara sirf usi par ho jo iski taaqat rakhta ho, aur ye aadmi kaffare ki taaqat nahi rakhta tha, jab Nabi (SAW) ne use kuch diya aur wo uska maalik ban gaya, to aadmi ne kaha: Hum se zyada koi zaroormand nahi. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: \"Ise le jaao aur apne ghar walon ko khilaao,\" kyunki kaffara to apni zaroorat se zyada hone par hi hota hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne is haal mein rehne wale ke liye chuna ke wo use khaaye aur kaffara uspar qarz rahe, jab bhi kuch maal ka maalik bane to kaffara ada kare.

e: Abdullah bin Amir bin Rabi'ah narrated from his father who said:"I saw the Prophet - (a number of times) such that I was not able to count - using the Siwak while he was fasting
hi: Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabi'ah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko be-shumaar baar miswaak karte dekha jabke wo roze se the." Aur is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aamir bin Rabi'ah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo roze daar ke miswaak karne mein koi harj nahi maante, siwaye is ke ke kuch ahl-e-ilm ne roze daar ke liye taaza lakdi se miswaak karna napasand kiya, aur unhon ne din ke aakhir mein miswaak karna bhi napasand kiya. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne din ke shuru ya aakhir mein miswaak karne mein koi harj nahi maana, aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne din ke aakhir mein miswaak karna napasand kiya.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that :a man came to the Prophet and said: "My eyes are bothering me, can I use Kuhl while I am fasting?" He said: "Yes
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Meri aankh mein takleef hai, kya main surma laga sakta hoon jabke main roze se hoon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Haan.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith ka isnad mazboot nahi, aur is mauzu par Nabi (SAW) se koi bhi cheez sahih nahi. Aur Abu Aatikah kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka roze daar ke surme ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne isse napasand kiya, aur ye Sufyan, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne roze daar ke liye surme ki rukhsat di, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet would kiss during the month of fasting
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) roze ke mahine mein bosa lete the. Aur is mauzu par Umar bin Al-Khattab, Hafsah, Abu Sa'eed, Umm Salamah, Ibn Abbas, Anas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ka roze daar ke bosa lene ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne boodhe aadmi ko bosa lene ki rukhsat di lekin naujawan ko rukhsat nahi di, is khauf se ke uska roza mehfooz na rahe, aur qurbat unke nazdeek isse zyada sakht hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Bosa lena sawaab kam karta hai lekin roze daar ka roza nahi todta. Aur unhon ne maana ke roze daar agar apne aap par qaboo rakhta ho to bosa le sakta hai, aur agar apne aap par bharosa na ho to bosa lena chhod de taake uska roza mehfooz rahe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would fondle me while he was fasting, and he had the most control among you of his limb (li irbihi)
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse qurbat karte the jabke wo roze se hote the, aur wo tum sab mein apne nafs par sabse zyada qaabu rakhne wale the."

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would kiss and fondle while he was fasting, and he had the most control among you of his limbs
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bosa lete aur qurbat karte the jabke wo roze se hote, aur wo tum sab mein apne nafs par sabse zyada qaabu rakhne wale the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Maisarah ka naam Amr bin Shurahbil hai. Aur "li irbihi" ka matlab hai "apne nafs ke liye."

e: Hafsah narrated that:the Prophet said: "Whoever did not decide to fast before Fajr then there is no fast for him
hi: Hafsah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Fajr se pehle roze ki niyat pakki na kare, uska roza nahi hota." Abu Isa ne kaha: Hafsah ki hadith hum marfu' sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, unka apna qaul riwayat hua hai, aur wo zyada sahih hai. Aur isi tarah ye hadith Az-Zuhri se mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai, aur hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne ise marfu' kiya ho siwaye Yahya bin Ayyub ke. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek iska matlab ye hai: Jo Ramzan mein, ya Ramzan ki qaza mein, ya mannat ke roze mein, Fajr tulu hone se pehle roze ki niyat pakki na kare, agar wo raat ko niyat na kare, to wo kaafi nahi. Lekin nafl roze mein, aadmi ke liye subah hone ke baad bhi niyat karna jaayez hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Umm Hani narrated:"I was sitting with the Prophet when some drink was brought, so he drank from it, then he offered it to me and I drank it. Then I said: 'I have indeed sinned, so seek forgiveness for me.' He said: 'What is that?' I said: 'I was fasting, then I broke the fast.' He said: 'Were you performing a fast that you had to make up?' I said: 'No.' He said: 'Then it is no harm for you
hi: Umm Hani (RA) ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithi hui thi ke unke paas peene ki cheez laayi gayi, unhon ne usmein se piya, phir mujhe di, to maine bhi usmein se piya. Maine kaha: 'Mujhse gunaah ho gaya, mere liye maafi maangiye.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo kya baat hai?' Maine kaha: 'Main roze se thi, to maine roza tod diya.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya ye kisi qaza ka roza tha jo tum poora kar rahi thi?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To tumhein koi nuqsaan nahi.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Simak bin Harb narrated:"A person from the offspring of Umm Hani narrated to me - I met one of the most virtuous among them, and his name was Ja'dah, and Umm Hani was his grandmother - he narrated to me from his grandmother that the Messenger of Allah entered upon her and asked for some drink, and he drank. Then he offered it to her and she drank it. Then she said: "O Messenger of Allah! I was fasting." So the Messenger of Allah said: "The one fasting a voluntary fast is the trustee for himself; if he wishes he fasts, and if he wishes he breaks." Shu'bah (one of the narrators) said: "I said to him (Ja'dah), 'Did you hear this from Umm Hani?' He said: 'No Abu Salih and our family informed us of it from Umm Hani
hi: Simak bin Harb ne kaha: "Umm Hani ke ek bete ne mujhe bataya - main unmein se behtareen se mila, unka naam Ja'dah tha, aur Umm Hani unki dadi thin - unhon ne mujhse apni dadi se riwayat ki ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas gaye aur peene ki cheez mangwaayi, unhon ne piya, phir unhen di, to unhon ne bhi piya. To unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main roze se thi.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Nafl roza rakhne wala apne nafs ka khud ameen hai, agar chahe to roza rakhe, aur agar chahe to na rakhe.'" Shu'bah ne kaha: "Maine unse kaha: Kya tumne ye khud Umm Hani se suna? Unhon ne kaha: Nahi, Abu Salih aur humare ghar walon ne mujhe Umm Hani se bataya." Aur Hammad bin Salamah ne ye hadith Simak bin Harb se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha "Umm Hani ki beti ke bete Harun se, Umm Hani se." Aur Shu'bah ki riwayat behtar hai. Isi tarah humein Mahmud bin Ghailan ne Abu Dawud se bataya, unhon ne kaha "apne nafs ka ameen." Aur humein Mahmud ke siwa doosron ne Abu Dawud se bataya, unhon ne kaha "apne nafs ka hukumraan ya ameen," shak ke saath. Aur isi tarah kai jagah se Shu'bah se "ameen ya hukumraan apne nafs ka" shak ke saath riwayat hui hai. Aur Umm Hani ki hadith ke isnad mein baat hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar nafl roza rakhne wala roza tod de, to uspar qaza nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo khud qaza karna chahe. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ahmad, Ishaq, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah, the Mother of the Believers, narrated:"The Messenger of Allah visited me one day and said: 'Do you have anything (to eat)?'" She said: "I said: 'No.' He said: 'Then I am fasting
hi: Aishah, Ummul-Momineen (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din mere paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhare paas kuch hai?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To phir main roze se hoon.'"

e: Aishah, the Mother of the Believers, narrated:"The Messenger of Allah came to me saying, 'Do you have anything for breakfast?' I said: 'No.' Then he said: 'I am fasting.'" She said: "One day he came to me and I said: 'O Messenger of Allah; I have received a gift for us.' He said: 'What is it?'" She said: "I said 'Hais' He said: 'I began the day fasting'" She said: "Then he ate
hi: Aishah, Ummul-Momineen (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) mere paas aate aur pucchte: 'Kya tumhare paas nashta hai?' Main kehti: 'Nahi.' To wo farmaate: 'Main roze se hoon.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Phir ek din wo aaye, to maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Humein ek tohfa mila hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo kya hai?' Maine kaha: 'Hais.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To main to aaj roze se hi hoon.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Phir unhon ne khaaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"Hafsah and I were both fasting when we were presented some food that we really wanted, so we ate from it. The Messenger of Allah came, and Hafsah beat me to him - she was the daughter of her father - and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We were both fasting when we were presented with some food that we wanted, so we ate from it.' He said: 'Make up another day in its place
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Main aur Hafsah dono roze se thin, humein hamare pasand ka khaana mil gaya, to humne usmein se khaaya. Itne mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aa gaye, to Hafsah mujhse pehle unki taraf badhi - wo apne waalid ki hi beti thi - aur usne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum dono roze se thin, humein hamare pasand ka khaana mila to humne usmein se khaaya.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Uski jagah koi aur din qaza kar lo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Salih bin Abi Al-Akhdar aur Muhammad bin Abi Hafsah ne bhi ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aishah se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Malik bin Anas, Ma'mar, Ubaidullah bin Umar, Ziyad bin Sa'd, aur kai hafiz muhaddiseen ne Az-Zuhri se, Aishah se mursal riwayat ki, aur unhon ne ismein Urwah ka zikr nahi kiya, aur ye zyada sahih hai, kyunki Ibn Juraij se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Az-Zuhri se pucha: Kya Urwah ne aapko Aishah se bataya? Unhon ne kaha: Maine Urwah se ismein kuch nahi suna, lekin maine Sulaiman bin Abdul-Malik ki khilafat mein kuch logon se sunaa jinhon ne Aishah se is hadith ke baare mein pucha tha. Ye humein Ali bin Isa bin Yazid Al-Baghdadi ne bataya, humein Rauh bin Ubadah ne Ibn Juraij se bataya, phir hadith zikr ki. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne isi hadith ko apnaya, unhon ne maana ke agar roza toda jaaye to uspar qaza hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai.

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"I did not see the Prophet fasting two consecutive months except for Sha'ban and Ramadan
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko lagataar do mahine roza rakhte kabhi nahi dekha siwaye Sha'ban aur Ramzan ke." Aur is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Salamah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Salamah se, Aishah se bhi riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kisi mahine mein Sha'ban se zyada roza rakhte nahi dekha, wo taqreeban poora mahina hi roza rakhte the."

e: (Another chain, a Hadith similar to no. 736) for that, from Aishah, :from the Prophet
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - isi mafhoom mein, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne is hadith ke baare mein kaha: Arbi zabaan mein ye jaayez hai ke agar aadmi mahine ke zyada hisse mein roza rakhe, to kaha jaaye "usne poora mahina roza rakha," aur kaha jaata hai "fulan ne poori raat qayaam kiya" jabke shayad usne khaana khaya ho aur kisi kaam mein masroof raha ho. Goya Ibn Al-Mubarak ne donon hadithon ko mel khaate hue dekha, wo kehte hain: Is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke wo mahine ka zyada hissa roza rakhte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Salim Abu An-Nadr aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Abu Salamah se, Aishah se, Muhammad bin Amr ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "When a half of Sha'ban remains then do not fast
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Sha'ban ka aadha hissa baaqi reh jaaye, to roza mat rakho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se, isi alfaaz mein, jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke aadmi roza na rakhta ho, lekin jab Sha'ban ka kuch hissa baaqi rahe to Ramzan ki taiyaari mein roza rakhna shuru kar de. Aur Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, unke qaul se milti julti riwayat hui hai jahan unhon ne farmaya: "Ramzan mahine se pehle roza rakh kar aage mat badho, siwaye is ke ke wo us roze se mel khaaye jo tum mein se koi pehle se rakhta ho." Aur is hadith se pata chalta hai ke ye napasandeegi sirf us shakhs ke liye hai jo jaan-boojh kar Ramzan ki niyat se roza rakhta ho.

e: Aishah narrated:"I could not find the Messenger of Allah one night. So I left and found him at Al-Baqi. He said: 'Did you fear that you had been wronged by Allah and His Messenger?' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I thought that you had gone to one of your wives.' So he said: 'Indeed Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He, descends to the lowest Heavens during the night of the middle of Sha'ban, to grant forgiveness to more than the number of hairs on the sheep of (Banu) Kalb
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Ek raat maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko na paaya, to main bahar nikli aur unhen Baqi mein paaya. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tumhein dar tha ke Allah aur uske Rasool tumpar zulm karenge?' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine socha ke aap apni kisi biwi ke paas gaye hain.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Azza wa Jall Sha'ban ki pandrahwi raat duniya ke aasman ki taraf utarta hai, aur Banu Kalb ki bakriyon ke baal jitne logon se zyada logon ko maaf kar deta hai.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se, Hajjaj ki hadith se, jaante hain. Aur maine Muhammad ko is hadith ko kamzor qarar dete suna, unhon ne kaha: Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne Urwah se suna nahi, aur Hajjaj bin Artaah ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se suna nahi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "The most virtuous fasting after the month of Ramadan is Allah's month Al-Muharram
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ramzan mahine ke roze ke baad sabse afzal roza Allah ke mahine Muharram ka hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai.

e: An-Nu'man bin Sa'd narrated:"A man asked Ali: "Which month do you order me to fast after the month of Ramadan?' He said to him, 'I have not heard anyone ask this except for a man whom I heard asking the Messenger of Allah while I was sitting with him. He said: "O Messenger of Allah! Which month do you order me to fast after the month of Ramadan?" He said: "If you will fast after the month of Ramadan, then fast Al-Muharram, for indeed it is Allah's month in which there is a day that Allah accepted the repentance of a people, and in which He accepts the repentance of other people
hi: An-Nu'man bin Sa'd ne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha: 'Aap mujhe Ramzan mahine ke baad kaun sa mahina roza rakhne ka hukum dete hain?' Unhon ne unse kaha: 'Maine kisi ko ye sawaal poochte nahi suna siwaye ek aadmi ke jise maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poochte suna, main baitha hua tha. Usne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Aap mujhe Ramzan mahine ke baad kaun sa mahina roza rakhne ka hukum dete hain? Unhon ne farmaya: Agar tum Ramzan mahine ke baad roza rakhna chaho, to Muharram rakho, kyunki wo Allah ka mahina hai, ismein ek din hai jismein Allah ne ek qaum ki tauba qubool ki, aur ismein wo doosri qaum ki tauba bhi qubool karta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abdullah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would fasting during the beginning of every month for three days, and Friday was the least of the days that he did not fast
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) har mahine ke shuru mein teen din roza rakhte the, aur bahut kam hi Jumme ke din roza na rakhte." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Jumme ke din roza rakhna Mustahab samjha, aur ye sirf isliye napasand kiya jaata hai ke aadmi sirf Jumme ke din hi roza rakhe, usse pehle ya baad mein na rakhe. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Shu'bah ne Aasim se ye hadith riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "None of you should fast on Friday unless he fasts before it, or he fasts after it
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi sirf Jumme ke din roza na rakhe, siwaye is ke ke wo usse pehle ya baad mein bhi roza rakhe." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Junadah Al-Azdi, Juwairiyah, Anas, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo isse napasand karte hain ke aadmi sirf Jumme ke din hi khaas roza rakhe, usse pehle ya baad mein na rakhe. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Busr narrated from his sister that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not fast on Saturday except for what has been made obligatory upon you (by Allah). If one of you does not find but a grape peal or a tree's twig, then let him chew it
hi: Abdullah bin Busr (RA) apni behen se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hafte ke din roza mat rakho siwaye us roze ke jo Allah ne tumpar farz kiya hai. Agar tum mein se kisi ko angoor ke chhilke ya darakht ki tehni ke siwa kuch na mile, to wo isi ko chaba le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur iski napasandeegi ka matlab ye hai ke aadmi sirf Hafte ke din ko khaas roza ke liye chune, kyunki Yahudi Hafte ke din ki buzurgi karte hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet used to try to fast on Mondays and Thursdays
hi: Rabi'ah Al-Jurashi, Aishah se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Peer aur Jumeraat ke roze ka khaas khayal rakhte the." Aur is mauzu par Hafsah, Abu Qatadah, Abu Hurairah, aur Usamah bin Zaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would fast Saturdays, Sundays, and Mondays in one months, and Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays in the next month
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek mahine mein Hafta, Itvaar, aur Peer roza rakhte the, aur doosre mahine mein Mangal, Budh, aur Jumeraat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne ye hadith Sufyan se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "Deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and I love that my deeds be presented while I am fasting
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amal Peer aur Jumeraat ko pesh kiye jaate hain, is liye main pasand karta hoon ke mera amal roze ki halat mein pesh kiya jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki is mauzu par hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ubaidullah (bin Muslim) Al-Qurashi narrated from his father who said:"I asked - or; the Prophet was asked - about fasting daily. So he said: 'Your family has a right over you.' Then he said: 'Fast Ramadan and that which is after it, and every Wednesday and Thursday. If you do that, then you will have fasted daily, as well as broken (the fast)
hi: Ubaidullah bin Muslim Al-Qurashi apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poochha - ya unse pucha gaya - hamesha roza rakhne ke baare mein, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhare ghar walon ka tumpar haq hai. Ramzan aur uske baad wala mahina roza rakho, aur har Budh aur Jumeraat, to isse tumne hamesha roza bhi rakh liya aur roza chhoda bhi.'" Aur is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muslim Al-Qurashi ki hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Fast the Day of Arafah, for indeed I anticipate that Allah will forgive (the sins) of the year after it, and the year before it
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Arafah ke din ka roza - main Allah se ummeed rakhta hoon ke wo isse pehle wale saal aur baad wale saal ke gunaah maaf kar dega." Aur is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Qatadah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne Arafah ke din roza rakhna Mustahab samjha hai, siwaye jab aadmi khud Arafat mein ho.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet broke (the fast) of Arafah, Umm Fadl sent him some milk to drink
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Arafah mein roza nahi rakha, aur Umm Al-Fadl ne unke paas doodh bheja to unhon ne piya. Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, aur Umm Al-Fadl se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya, unhon ne roza nahi rakha" - yani Arafah ke din - "aur Abu Bakr ke saath, unhon ne bhi roza nahi rakha, aur Umar ke saath, unhon ne bhi nahi rakha, aur Uthman ke saath, unhon ne bhi nahi rakha." Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Arafah mein roza na rakhna Mustahab samajhte hain taake aadmi dua ke liye taaqat rakh sake. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Arafah ke din, Arafat mein hote hue bhi, roza rakha hai.

e: Ibn Abi Najib narrated from his father who said:"Ibn Umar was asked about fasting (the Day of) Arafah (at Arafat). He said: 'I performed Hajj with the Prophet, and he did not fast it, and with Abu Bakr, and he did not fast it, and with Umar, and he did not fast it, and with Uthman, and he did not fast it. I do no fast it, nor order it nor forbid it
hi: Ibn Abi Najih apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Ibn Umar se Arafah mein Arafah ke din roza rakhne ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya, unhon ne roza nahi rakha, aur Abu Bakr ke saath, unhon ne bhi nahi rakha, aur Umar ke saath, unhon ne bhi nahi rakha, aur Uthman ke saath, unhon ne bhi nahi rakha. Aur main khud bhi roza nahi rakhta, na ismein hukum deta hoon na mana karta hoon.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that :the Prophet said: "Fast the Day of Ashura, for indeed I anticipate that Allah will forgive (the sins of) the year before it
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ashura ke din ka roza - main Allah se ummeed rakhta hoon ke wo isse pehle wale saal ke gunaah maaf kar dega." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Muhammad bin Saifi, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, Hind bin Asma, Ibn Abbas, Ar-Rubaiyyi bint Muawwidh bin Afra, Abdur-Rahman bin Salamah Al-Khuza'i apne chacha se, aur Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr kiya ke unhon ne Ashura ke din roza rakhne ki targheeb di. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hum kisi riwayat mein nahi jaante ke unhon ne farmaya "Ashura ke din ka roza ek saal ka kaffara hai," siwaye Abu Qatadah ki hadith mein. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq Abu Qatadah ki hadith ke qaayal hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"Ashura was a day that the Quraish used to fast during Jahiliyyah, and the Messenger of Allah used to fast it. But when (the fast of) Ramadan became obligatory, the Ramadan was the required and Ashura was left. So whoever wanted to, he fasted it, and whoever wanted to, he left it
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Ashura ek aisa din tha jismein Quraish Jahiliyyah mein roza rakhte the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bhi ismein roza rakhte the. Jab wo Madina aaye, to unhon ne bhi roza rakha aur logon ko bhi iska hukum diya. Jab Ramzan farz kar diya gaya, to Ramzan hi farz roza raha aur Ashura chhod diya gaya, ab jo chahe roza rakhe aur jo chahe chhod de." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Qais bin Sa'd, Jabir bin Samurah, Ibn Umar, aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek Aishah ki hadith par amal hai, aur ye sahih hadith hai, wo Ashura ke din ke roze ko wajib nahi maante, siwaye jo iski fazilat ki wajah se khud chahe roza rakhna.

e: Al-Hakam bin Al-Arfaj said:"I met up with Ibn Abbas while he was reclining on his Rida at the Zamzam (well). So I said: 'Inform me about the Day of Ashura. On which day is it fasted?' He said: 'When you see the crescent of Al-Muharram, then count, then fast on the morning of the ninth day.'" He said: 'I said: Is this how Muhammad fasted it?' He said: 'Yes
hi: Al-Hakam bin Al-Arfaj ne kaha: "Main Ibn Abbas ke paas pahuncha jabke wo Zamzam ke paas apni chadar ka takiya banaye lete hue the. Maine kaha: 'Mujhe Ashura ke din ke baare mein bataiye, wo kaun sa din hai jismein main roza rakhoon?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Jab tum Muharram ka chaand dekho, to gino, phir nauvin din ki subah roza rakho.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Kya Muhammad (SAW) isi tarah roza rakhte the?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan."

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah ordered fasting the tenth day for the Day of Ashura
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ashura ka roza dasvin din rakhne ka hukum diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Ashura ke din ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Nauvin din. Aur kuch ne kaha: Dasvin din. Aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: "Nauvin aur dasvin dono roza rakho, aur Yahudiyon ki mukhalafat karo." Aur isi hadith ko Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq maante hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"I did not see the Prophet fasting at all during the ten
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kabhi bhi das dinon mein roza rakhte nahi dekha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah kai logon ne Al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Al-Aswad se, Aishah se riwayat ki hai. Aur Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne ye hadith Mansoor se, Ibrahim se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ko das dinon mein roza rakhte hue nahi dekha gaya. Aur Abu Al-Ahwas ne Mansoor se, Ibrahim se, Aishah se riwayat ki, aur ismein Al-Aswad ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur is hadith mein Mansoor par ikhtilaaf hai, aur Al-A'mash ki riwayat zyada sahih aur mukammal isnad wali hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Aban ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko kehte suna: Al-A'mash Ibrahim ke isnad ko Mansoor se zyada yaad rakhte hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "There are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than those ten days." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! Not even Jihad in Allah Cause?" The Messenger of Allah said: "Not even Jihad in Allah's Cause, unless a man were to out with his self and his wealth and not return from that with anything
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "In das dinon se zyada koi din nahi jismein neik amal Allah ko zyada pasand ho." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya Allah ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi?" Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi, siwaye us aadmi ke jo apni jaan aur apna maal lekar nikle aur usmein se kuch bhi wapas na laaye." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :the Prophet said: "There are no days more beloved to Allah that He be worshipped in them than the ten days of Dhul-Hijjah, fasting every day of them is the equivalent of fasting a year, and standing every night of them (in prayer) is the equivalent of standing on the Night of Qadr
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi din Allah ko Dhul-Hijjah ke das dinon mein ibadat kiye jaane se zyada aziz nahi, unmein har din ka roza ek saal ke roze ke barabar hai, aur unmein har raat ka qayaam Lailatul-Qadr ke qayaam ke barabar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Mas'ud bin Wasil ki, An-Nahhas se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhen ye isi tareeqe ke alawa maloom nahi thi. Unhon ne kaha: Qatadah se, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal isi jaisi kuch riwayat hui hai. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ne An-Nahhas bin Qahm ke baare mein unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki hai.

e: Abu Ayub narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever fasts Ramadan, then follows it with six from Shawwal, then that is (equal in reward) to fasting everyday
hi: Abu Ayyub (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Ramzan ka roza rakhe, phir uske baad Shawwal ke chhe din roza rakhe, to ye hamesha roza rakhne jaisa hai." Aur is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Hurairah, aur Thawban se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ayyub ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ek jamaat ne is hadith ki wajah se Shawwal ke chhe din roze ko Mustahab samjha hai. Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Ye acha hai, ye har mahine teen din ke roze jaisa hai. Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Aur kuch hadithon mein riwayat hai "aur ye roza Ramzan se jud jaata hai." Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne chuna ke ye chhe din mahine ke shuru mein hon. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Agar Shawwal ke chhe din alag-alag roza rakhe, to ye jaayez hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdul-Aziz bin Muhammad ne ye hadith Safwan bin Sulaim se aur Sa'd bin Sa'eed se, Umar bin Thabit se, Abu Ayyub se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Shu'bah ne Warqa bin Umar se, Sa'd bin Sa'eed se ye hadith riwayat ki. Aur Sa'd bin Sa'eed, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ke bhai hain, aur kuch ahl-e-hadith ne Sa'd bin Sa'eed ke baare mein unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki hai. Humein Hannad ne bataya, humein Al-Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) Al-Ju'fi ne Isra'il Abu Musa se, Al-Hasan Al-Basri se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Jab unke paas Shawwal ke chhe dinon ke roze ka zikr hota, to wo kehte: Allah ki qasam! Allah is mahine ke roze se poore saal ke barabar raazi ho gaya hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah took a covenant from me for three: To not sleep except after performing Witr, to fast three days of every month, and to perform the Duha prayer
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse teen baaton ka waada liya: ke main Witr ke bagair na soun, ke main har mahine teen din roza rakhoon, aur ke main Duha ki namaz padhoon."

e: Abu Dharr narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "O Abu Dharr! When you fast three days out of a month, then fast the thirteenth, fourteenth, and fifteenth
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Abu Dharr! Jab tum mahine mein teen din roza rakho, to terah, chaudah, aur pandrah rakho." Aur is mauzu par Abu Qatadah, Abdullah bin Amr, Qurrah bin Iyas Al-Muzani, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Aqrab, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, Qatadah bin Milhan, Uthman bin Abi Al-As, aur Jarir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Dharr ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch hadithon mein riwayat hai ke "Jo shakhs har mahine teen din roza rakhe, wo hamesha roza rakhne jaisa hai."

e: Abu Dharr narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever fasts three days in every month, then that is (similar to) fasting every day.' Then Allah Mighty and Sublime is He, attested to that in His Book, by revealing: Whoever brings a good deed, shall have ten times the like thereof. So a day is like ten
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo har mahine teen din roza rakhe, to ye hamesha roza rakhne jaisa hai.' To Allah Azza wa Jall ne apni Kitab mein iski tasdeeq nazil ki: (Jo neki laaye uske liye uski das guna hai). Ek din das dinon ke barabar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abu Shimr aur Abu At-Tayyah se, Abu Uthman se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Yazid Ar-Rishk said:"I heard Mu'adhah saying to Aishah: 'Did the Messenger of Allah fast three days of every month?' She replied in the affirmative. So she said: 'Which of them would he fast?' She said: 'Which of them he would fast was not noticeable
hi: Mu'adhah ne kaha: "Maine Aishah se pucha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) har mahine teen din roza rakhte the? Unhon ne kaha: Haan. Maine pucha: Kaun se dinon mein rakhte the? Unhon ne kaha: Unhen isse koi farq nahi padta tha ke kis din roza rakhein." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed your Lord said: 'Every good deed is rewarded with ten of the same up to seven hundred times over. Fasting is for Me, and I shall reward for it.' Fasting is a shield from the Fire. The smell coming from the mouth of the one fasting is more pleasant to Allah than the scent of musk. If one of you is abused by an ignorant person while fasting, then let him say: 'Indeed I am fasting
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhara Rab farmaata hai: Har neki uski das guna se saat sau guna tak badhi hui hai. Aur roza mere liye hai aur main hi iska badla dunga. Roza aag se ek dhaal hai, aur roze daar ke muh ki khushbu Allah ke nazdeek mishk ki khushbu se zyada khush-gawaar hai. Aur agar tum mein se kisi ko koi jaahil bura-bhala kahe jabke wo roze se ho, to wo kahe: main roze se hoon." Aur is mauzu par Mu'adh bin Jabal, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ka'b bin Ujrah, Salamah bin Qaisar, aur Bashir Ibn Al-Khasasiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Bashir ka naam Zahm bin Ma'bad hai, aur Al-Khasasiyah unki maa hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Sahl bin Sa'd narrated that:The Prophet said: "There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Raiyyan, those who fast shall be invited into it, and whoever was among those who fasted, then he will enter it; and whoever enters it, he will never thirst again
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat mein ek darwaza hai jise Ar-Rayyan kaha jaata hai, roze daaron ko usmein bulaaya jaayega, to jo roze daaron mein se hoga wo usmein daakhil hoga, aur jo usmein daakhil ho jaaye, wo kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "There are two joys for the fasting person: the joy when he breaks his fast, and the joy of when he meets his Lord
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roze daar ke liye do khushiyaan hain: ek khushi jab wo roza khole, aur doosri khushi jab wo apne Rab se mile." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Qatadah said:"It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What is the case of the one who fasts daily?' He said: 'He did not fast nor break (the fast).'" Or, he said: "He never fasted nor broke (his fast)
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) ne kaha: "Pucha gaya: Ya Rasool Allah! Us shakhs ka kya haal hoga jo hamesha roza rakhe? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Na usne roza rakha na roza chhoda'" - ya "usne roza nahi rakha aur na roza chhoda." Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Abdullah bin Ash-Shikhkhir, Imran bin Husain, aur Abu Musa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Qatadah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ek jamaat, ahl-e-ilm mein se, ne hamesha roza rakhna napasand kiya, aur doosri jamaat ne ise jaayez kaha, unhon ne kaha: Hamesha roza sirf tab hota hai jab Fitr ke din, Adha ke din, aur Tashriq ke dinon mein bhi roza na chhoda jaaye. To jo in dinon mein roza chhode, wo napasandeegi ki hadd se bahar aa jaata hai aur usne poora saal roza nahi rakha hota. Isi tarah Malik bin Anas se riwayat hai aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne isi jaisi baat kahi, unhon ne kaha: In paanch dinon ke siwa - jinhen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya, Fitr ka din, Adha ka din, aur Tashriq ke din - kisi aur din roza chhodna zaroori nahi.

e: Abdullah bin Shaqiq narrated:"I asked Aishah about the Prophet's fasting.' She said: 'He would fast until we said: "He has fasted" and he would abstain from fasting until we said: "He has abstained from fasting." (She said:) 'The Messenger of Allah did not fast an entire month except Ramadan
hi: Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne kaha: "Maine Aishah se Nabi (SAW) ke roze ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne kaha: 'Wo itna roza rakhte ke hum kehte: Ab wo hamesha roza rakhenge, aur itna na rakhte ke hum kehte: Ab wo roza chhod chuke.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ramzan ke siwa kabhi poora mahina roza nahi rakha." Aur is mauzu par Anas aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jafar bin Humaid narrated that:Anas bin Malik was asked about the Prophet's fasting and he said: "He would fast during a month until we thought that he did not want to abstain from fasting during any of it. And, he would not fast during a month until we thought that he did not want to fast during any of it. (There was no time) that I wanted to see if he was performing Salat during the night, except that I would see him praying, nor to see him sleeping, except that I would see him sleeping
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA), unse Nabi (SAW) ke roze ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhon ne kaha: "Wo mahine mein itna roza rakhte ke hum samajhte wo iske ek din bhi roza na chhodna chahte, aur itna roza na rakhte ke hum samajhte wo iska koi din bhi roza rakhna na chahte. Aur agar tum chaho ke raat ko unhen namaz padhte dekho, to tum unhen namaz padhte hi paate, aur agar sote dekhna chaho, to unhen sota hi paate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The most virtuous fast is the fast of my brother Dawud. He would fast a day, and not fast (the next) day. He would not flee at the time of engagement (with the enemy)
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse afzal roza mere bhai Dawud ka roza hai, wo ek din roza rakhte aur ek din chhodte, aur jab dushman se saamna hota to peeche nahi hatte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Sabse afzal roza ye hai ke tum ek din roza rakho aur ek din chhodo. Aur kaha jaata hai ke ye sabse mushkil roza bhi hai.

e: Abu Ubaid, the freed slave of Abdur-Rahman bin Awf narrated:"I witnessed Umar bin Al-Khattab on the Day of Nahr beginning with the Salat before the Khutbah. Then he said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah prohibit fasting on these two days. As for the Day of Fitr, then it is for you to take a break from your fasting, and a celebration for the Muslims. As for the Day of Adha, then eat from the flesh that you have sacrificed
hi: Abu Ubaid, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ke azaad kiye gulam, ne kaha: "Main Umar bin Al-Khattab ke saath Nahr ke din tha, unhon ne khutba se pehle namaz shuru ki, phir kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko in do dinon mein roza rakhne se mana karte suna. Fitr ke din, kyunki wo tumhare roze se tumhaara roza tod dena hai aur Musalmanon ke liye Eid hai. Aur Adha ke din, to tum apni qurbani ke gosht mein se khao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prohibited two fasts: Fasting the Day of Adha and the Day of Fitr
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do din roza rakhne se mana kiya: Adha ke din aur Fitr ke din." Aur is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Abu Hurairah, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Uqbah bin Amir narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "The Day of Arafah, the Day of Nahr, and the Days of Tashriq are Eid for us. The people of Islam, and they are days of eating and drinking
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Arafah ka din, Nahr ka din, aur Tashriq ke din, humare, ahl-e-Islam ke, Eid hain, aur ye khaane aur peene ke din hain." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Sa'd, Abu Hurairah, Jabir, Nubaishah, Bishr bin Suhaim, Abdullah bin Hudhafah, Anas, Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami, Ka'b bin Malik, Aishah, Amr bin Al-As, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Uqbah bin Aamir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Tashriq ke dinon mein roza rakhna napasand karte hain, siwaye is ke ke kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, jo Tamattu' kar rahe ho aur unhen qurbani na mile aur usne das dinon mein roza na rakha ho, use Tashriq ke dinon mein roza rakhne ki rukhsat di hai. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Rafi bin Khadi narrated that:The Prophet said: "The cupper and the one cupped have broke the fast
hi: Rafi bin Khadij (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pachhna lagaane wale aur jispar pachhna lagaya jaaye, dono ka roza toot jaata hai." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Sa'd, Shaddad bin Aws, Thawban, Usamah bin Zaid, Aishah, Ma'qal bin Sinan, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Musa, aur Bilal se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Rafi bin Khadij ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal se zikr kiya gaya ke unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez Rafi bin Khadij ki hadith hai. Aur Ali bin Abdullah se zikr kiya gaya ke unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez Thawban aur Shaddad bin Aws ki hadith hai, kyunki Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne Abu Qilabah se donon hadithein riwayat ki, Thawban ki bhi aur Shaddad bin Aws ki bhi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, roze daar ke liye pachhna lagwaana napasand kiya, yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba raat ko pachhna lagwaate the, unmein Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain, aur Ibn Al-Mubarak isi ke qaayal hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Ishaq bin Mansoor ko kehte suna: Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne kaha: Jo roze mein pachhna lagwaaye, uspar qaza hai. Ishaq bin Mansoor ne kaha: Aur isi tarah Ahmad bin Hanbal aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur mujhe Al-Hasan bin Muhammad Az-Za'farani ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne roze mein pachhna lagwaaya, aur Nabi (SAW) se ye bhi riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Pachhna lagaane wale aur jispar pachhna lagaya jaaye, dono ka roza toot jaata hai.\" Aur main in donon hadithon mein se kisi ko bhi saabit nahi maanta, aur agar aadmi roze mein pachhna lagwaane se bache, to mujhe zyada pasand hai, aur agar roze daar pachhna lagwaaye, to mere nazdeek isse roza nahi tootta. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ash-Shafi'i ka Baghdad mein yehi qaul tha, lekin Misr mein wo rukhsat ki taraf jhuk gaye aur roze daar ke pachhna lagwaane mein koi harj nahi maana, aur unhon ne dalil li ke Nabi (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida mein pachhna lagwaaya jabke wo Ihraam mein aur roze se the.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"the Messenger of Allah was cupped while he was fasting and in Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pachhna lagwaaya jabke wo Ihraam mein aur roze se the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet was cupped while he was fasting
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne pachhna lagwaaya jabke wo roze se the. Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet was cupped somewhere between Makkah and Al-Madinah and he was fasting and in Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Makkah aur Madina ke darmiyan pachhna lagwaaya jabke wo Ihraam mein aur roze se the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne isi hadith ko apnaya aur roze daar ke pachhna lagwaane mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Anas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not perform Wisal" They said: "But you perform Wisal O Messenger of Allah." He said: "I am not like you are, indeed my Lord feeds me and gives me to drink
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wisal mat karo." Unhon ne kaha: "Lekin aap to Wisal karte hain, Ya Rasool Allah!" Unhon ne farmaya: "Main tum mein se kisi jaisa nahi, mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Ibn Umar, Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, aur Bashir Ibn Al-Khasasiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo roze mein Wisal karna napasand karte hain. Aur Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se riwayat hai ke wo kai din tak Wisal karte the aur roza na kholte the.

e: Abu Bakr Bin Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hashim said:"Aishah and Umm Salamah, the wives of the Prophet informed me that the Prophet would find that it was Fajr while he was Junub from (relations with) his wives, then he would perform Ghusl and fast
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Hisham ne kaha: "Aishah aur Umm Salamah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyon, ne mujhe bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ko Fajr aa jaati jabke wo apni biwiyon ki wajah se janabat mein hote, phir wo ghusl karte aur roza rakhte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah aur Umm Salamah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een ne kaha: Agar wo janabat ki halat mein subah kare, to uss din ki qaza kare. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "When one of you is invited to eat then let him respond, if he is fasting then let him pray." Meaning: supplicate
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko khaane ki dawat di jaaye, to wo qubool kare, aur agar wo roze se ho, to wo dua kare" - yani wahan dua kare.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :The Prophet said: "When one of you is invited (to a meal) and he is fasting, then let him said: 'Indeed I am fasting
