hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko dawat di jaaye aur wo roze se ho, to wo kahe: 'Main roze se hoon.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par dono hadithein, Abu Hurairah se, hasan sahih hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "A woman may not fast a day - other than in the month of Ramadan - while her husband is present, except with his permission
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat Ramzan ke mahine ke siwa kisi aur din, apne shohar ke saamne, uski ijazat ke bagair roza na rakhe." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I would not make up what was due upon me from Ramadan except in Sha'ban, until the Messenger of Allah died
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Main apne Ramzan ki jo qaza mujhpar hoti thi, wo sirf Sha'ban mein hi poori karti thi, yahan tak ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Laila narrated from the one who freed her (Umm Amarah) that:The Prophet said: "When those who are not fasting eat in the presence of the fasting person, the angels send Salat upon him
hi: Umm Amarah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab roze daar ke paas khaane wale khaana khaate hain, to Farishte uspar Durood padhte hain."

e: Habib bin Zaid said:"I heard a freed slave of ours called Laila narrated from [his (Habib's) grandmother] Umm Amarah bint Ka'b Al-Ansar, that the Prophet entered upon her and some food was brought to him. He said: 'Eat.' She said: 'I am fasting.' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Indeed the angels send Salat upon the fasting person when (others) eat in his presence, until they finish.' And perhaps he said: 'Until they have eaten their fill
hi: Habib bin Zaid ne kaha: "Maine humari azaad ki hui aurat, Laila naam ki, ko apni dadi Umm Amarah bint Ka'b Al-Ansariyyah se riwayat karte suna, ke Nabi (SAW) unke paas gaye to unhon ne unke saamne khaana rakha, unhon ne farmaya: 'Khao.' To unhon ne kaha: 'Main roze se hoon.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak roze daar par Farishte Durood padhte hain jab uske paas khaana khaya jaaye, yahan tak ke wo faariq ho jaayen.' Aur kabhi kabhi kehte: 'Yahan tak ke wo pet bhar khaa lein.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Sharik ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: (Another chain) from Umm Amarah bint Ka'b Al-Ansari:From the Prophet, that is similar, except that he did not mention "Until they finish, or they have eating their fill
hi: Umm Amarah bint Ka'b Al-Ansariyyah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, siwaye is ke ke unhon ne "yahan tak ke wo faariq ho jaayen ya pet bhar khaa lein" ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Umm Amarah, Habib bin Zaid Al-Ansari ki dadi hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"We would menstruate during the time of the Messenger of Allah, then when we became pure we were ordered to make up the fasts but we were not ordered to make up the Salat
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein haiz mein hoti thin, phir jab paak hoti to hamein rozon ki qaza karne ka hukum diya jaata, aur namazon ki qaza karne ka hukum nahi diya jaata." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ye Mu'adhah se, Aishah se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, hum unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf nahi jaante ke haiz waali aurat roze ki qaza kare lekin namaz ki qaza na kare.

e: Asim bin Laqit bin Sabrah narrated:From his father who said: "I said. 'O Messenger of Allah! Inform me about Wudu.' So he said: "Perform Wudu well, and go between the fingers, and perform Istinshaq extensively except when fasting
hi: Laqit bin Sabrah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhe wuzu ke baare mein bataiye. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wuzu poora karo, ungliyon ke darmiyan khilaal karo, aur naak mein achi tarah paani chadhaao, siwaye is ke ke tum roze se ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne roze daar ke liye naak mein dawa chadhaana napasand kiya hai, aur unhon ne maana ke isse roza tootta hai, aur is hadith mein unke qaul ki tasdeeq hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever stays with a people, then he is not to fast without their permission
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi qaum ke paas mehmaan bankar rahe, to wo unki ijazat ke bagair nafl roza na rakhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith munkar hai, hum kisi bharosemand raawi ko nahi jaante jisne ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah se riwayat ki ho.

e: Abu Hurairah and Aishah narrated:"The Prophet would perform I'tikaf during the last ten (days) of Ramadan until Allah took him
hi: Abu Hurairah aur Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein aitikaaf karte the, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhen apne paas bula liya. Aur is mauzu par Ubayy bin Ka'b, Abu Laila, Abu Sa'eed, Anas, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah aur Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Messenger of Allah wanted to perform I'tikaf, he would perform Fajr prayer and then he would enter his place of I'tikaf
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aitikaaf karna chaahte, to Fajr padhte, phir apne aitikaaf ki jagah daakhil hote." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Yahya bin Sa'eed se, Amrah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Jab aadmi aitikaaf karna chaahe, to Fajr padhe, phir apne aitikaaf ki jagah daakhil ho. Aur ye Ahmad bin Hanbal aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Jab wo aitikaaf karna chaahe, to jis raat aitikaaf karna chaahe uski shaam ko hi sooraj doobne ke saath aitikaaf mein baith jaaye. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would Yujawir (stay in I'tikaf) during the last ten (nights) of Ramadan and he said: 'Seek the Night of Al-Qadr during the last ten (nights) of Ramadan
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein aitikaaf karte aur farmaate: 'Lailatul-Qadr ko Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein talaash karo.'" Aur is mauzu par Umar, Ubayy, Jabir bin Samurah, Jabir bin Abdullah, Ibn Umar, Al-Falatan bin Aasim, Anas, Abu Sa'eed, Abdullah bin Unais, Abu Bakrah, Ibn Abbas, Bilal, aur Ubadah bin As-Samit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur unka qaul "Yujawir" ka matlab hai aitikaaf karte. Aur zyada tar riwayaten Nabi (SAW) se ye hain ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Ise aakhri das dinon mein, har taak raat mein talaash karo.\" Aur Nabi (SAW) se Lailatul-Qadr ke baare mein riwayat hai ke wo ikkiswi, teiswi, pachchiswi, sattaiswi, unattiswi raat, aur Ramzan ki aakhri raat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Mere nazdeek - aur Allah zyada jaanta hai - Nabi (SAW) jaise sawaal poocha jaata waise hi jawab dete, unse kaha jaata: Kya hum ise fulaan raat mein talaash karein? To wo farmaate: Use fulaan raat mein talaash karo. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur mere nazdeek isme sabse mazboot riwayat ikkiswi raat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ubayy bin Ka'b se riwayat hai ke wo qasam khaate the ke wo sattaiswi raat hai, aur kehte the: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein iski alamat bataayi, to humne gina aur yaad rakha. Aur Abu Qilabah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Lailatul-Qadr aakhri das dinon mein badalti rehti hai.

e: Zirr said:"I said to Ubayy bin Ka'b: 'O Abu Al-Mundhir! How do you know that it is the night of the twenty-seventh?' He said: 'Rather, the Messenger of Allah informed us that it is a night (after which) the sun rises without rays, so we counted and we remembered it. By Allah! Ibn Mas'ud learned that it is in Ramadan and that it is the nigh of the twenty-seventh, but he did not want to inform you lest you would depend on it
hi: Zirr ne kaha: "Maine Ubayy bin Ka'b se kaha: Ae Abu Al-Mundhir! Aapko kaise pata ke wo sattaiswi raat hai? Unhon ne kaha: 'Kyun nahi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein bataya ke ye wo raat hai jiski subah sooraj bina kirnon ke nikalta hai.' To humne gina aur yaad rakha. Allah ki qasam! Ibn Mas'ud ko bhi pata tha ke ye Ramzan mein hai aur ye sattaiswi raat hai, lekin unhon ne napasand kiya ke wo tumhein bataayen taake tum sirf usi par bharosa na kar baitho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Uyainah bin Abdur-Rahman narrated:"My father narrated to me: 'The Night of Al-Qadr was mentioned in the presence of Abu Bakrah, so he said: "I do not search for it due to something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah, except for during the last ten (nights); for indeed I heard him say: 'Search for it when nine remain, or; when seven remain, or; when five remain, or; during the last three nights.'" He (Uyainah) said: "During the twenty (nights) of Ramadan, Abu Bakrah used to perform Salat just as he performed Salat during the rest of the year. But when the (last) ten began, he would struggle (performing more Salat during the night)
hi: Uyainah bin Abdur-Rahman apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Abu Bakrah ke saamne Lailatul-Qadr ka zikr hua, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main ise sirf aakhri das dinon mein hi talaash karta hoon, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunaa hai, unhon ne farmaya: Ise nau baaqi rehte, ya saat baaqi rehte, ya paanch baaqi rehte, ya teen baaqi rehte, ya aakhri raat mein talaash karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur Abu Bakrah Ramzan ki pehli bees raaton mein waisi hi namaz padhte the jaisi saal ke baaki dinon mein, phir jab aakhri das dinon mein daakhil hote to koshish badha dete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ali narrated:"The Prophet would awaken his family during the last ten (nights) of Ramadan
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein apne ghar walon ko jagaate the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would struggle (to perform Salat more) during the last ten (nights) more than he would struggle in the rest of it
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aakhri das dinon mein itni koshish karte jitni doosri raaton mein na karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Amir bin Mas'ud narrated that:The Prophet said: "Fasting during the winter is an easy reward
hi: Aamir bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sardi mein roza rakhna aasan ghanimat hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith mursal hai. Aamir bin Mas'ud ne Nabi (SAW) ka zamana nahi paaya, aur wo Ibrahim bin Aamir Al-Qurashi ke waalid hain, jinse Shu'bah aur Ath-Thawri ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Salamah bin Al-Akwa said:"When the following was revealed: 'And for those upon whom it is difficult, (they may) feed a poor person' - if one of us wanted we would not fast, and pay the ransom, until the Ayah after it was revealed abrogating it
hi: Salamah bin Al-Akwa ne kaha: "Jab ye Ayat nazil hui: '(Aur jo iski taaqat rakhte hain unpar ek miskeen ko khaana khilaana fidya hai)' to humein se jo chahta, wo roza chhod deta aur fidya de deta, yahan tak ke iske baad wali Ayat nazil hui jisne ise mansookh kar diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Yazid, Salamah bin Al-Akwa ke azaad kiye gulam, Ibn Abi Ubaid hain.

e: Muhammad bin Ka'b narrated:"I went to Anas bin Malik during Ramadan and he was about to travel. His mount was prepared for him, and he put on his traveling clothes, then he called for some food to eat, and I said to him: 'Is it Sunnah?' He said: 'It is Sunnah.' Then he rode
hi: Muhammad bin Ka'b ne kaha: "Main Ramzan mein Anas bin Malik ke paas gaya jabke wo safar par jaana chaahte the, unki sawaari taiyaar ki jaa chuki thi aur unhon ne safar ke kapde pehen rakhe the, to unhon ne khaana mangwaaya aur khaaya. Maine unse kaha: Kya ye Sunnat hai? Unhon ne kaha: Sunnat hai." Phir wo sawaar ho gaye.

e: (Another chain) from Muhammad bin Ka'b who said:"I went to Anas bin Malik during Ramadan" and he mentioned a similar narration (as no)
hi: Muhammad bin Ka'b se: "Main Ramzan mein Anas bin Malik ke paas gaya," phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ko apnaya aur kaha: Musafir apne ghar mein hi roza chhod sakta hai nikalne se pehle, lekin usse namaz qasr karne ki ijazat nahi jab tak wo shehar ya basti ki deewar se bahar na nikal jaaye. Aur ye Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ka qaul hai.

e: Al-Hasan bin Ali narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The gift for the fasting person is (fragrant) oil and a censer
hi: Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roze daar ke liye tohfa tel aur khushbudaan hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, iska isnad utna mazboot nahi.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Al-Fitr is the day that the people break the fast, and Al-Adha is the day that the people sacrifice
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fitr wo din hai jis din log roza kholte hain, aur Adha wo din hai jis din log qurbani karte hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se pucha, maine unse kaha: Kya Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir ne Aishah se suna hai? Unhon ne kaha: Haan, wo apni hadith mein kehte hain "Maine Aishah se suna." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Prophet would perform I'tikaf during the last ten (nights) of Ramadan. One year he did not perform I'tikaf, so he performed I'tikaf for twenty (nights) in the following year
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein aitikaaf karte the, ek saal unhon ne aitikaaf nahi kiya, to agle saal unhon ne bees din aitikaaf kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Anas bin Malik ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai us aadmi ke baare mein jo apna aitikaaf tod de apni niyat poori karne se pehle, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo apna aitikaaf tod de, to uspar qaza wajib hai. Aur unhon ne is hadith se dalil li ke Nabi (SAW) apne aitikaaf se nikle aur unhon ne Shawwal mein das din aitikaaf kiya. Aur ye Malik ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar uspar aitikaaf ki mannat na ho ya kuch aisa jo usne apne aap par wajib kiya ho, aur wo nafl aitikaaf mein ho aur nikal jaaye, to uspar qaza wajib nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo khud apni marzi se qaza karna chahe, ye uspar farz nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Har amal jismein tumhein daakhil hona zaroori nahi tha, agar tum daakhil ho jao aur phir usse nikal jao, to tumpar qaza zaroori nahi siwaye Hajj aur Umrah ke. Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Messenger of Allah performed I'tikaf, he would bring his head near me so I could comb it, and he would not enter the house except for some personal needs
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aitikaaf karte, to apna sar mere qareeb kar dete aur main use kanghi karti, aur wo ghar mein sirf insaani zaroorat ke liye daakhil hote." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah kai logon ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah aur Amrah se, Aishah se riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ne ise Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah se, Amrah se, Aishah se riwayat ki. Aur sahih Urwah aur Amrah se, Aishah se hai.

e: That was narrated to us by Quraibah :From Al-Laith (a similar narration as no)
hi: (Isi jaisi riwayat) - Laith bin Sa'd se, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah aur Amrah se, Aishah se. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke jab aadmi aitikaaf kare, to wo apne aitikaaf se sirf insaani zaroorat ke liye na nikle. Aur unka ittefaq hai ke wo paakhaana aur peshaab ki zaroorat ke liye nikal sakta hai. Phir ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai bimaar ki iyaadat, Jumme mein haazri, aur janaze mein shaamil hone ke baare mein mu'takif ke liye, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, maana ke wo bimaar ki iyaadat kare, janaze ke saath jaaye, aur Jumme mein haazir ho, agar usne aisi shart rakhi ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Usse in mein se kuch bhi karne ka haq nahi. Aur unhon ne maana ke agar mu'takif kisi aise shehar mein ho jahan Jumma padha jaata hai, to wo Masjid-e-Jaami mein hi aitikaaf kare, kyunki wo apne aitikaaf ki jagah se Jumme ke liye nikalna napasand karte hain aur ye bhi nahi maante ke wo Jumma chhode, to unhon ne kaha: Wo Masjid-e-Jaami ke siwa kahin aitikaaf na kare taake use insaani zaroorat ke siwa apne aitikaaf ki jagah se nikalne ki zaroorat na pade, kyunki unke nazdeek insaani zaroorat ke siwa nikalna aitikaaf ko tod deta hai. Aur ye Malik aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Wo bimaar ki iyaadat na kare aur na janaze ke saath jaaye, Aishah ki hadith ke mutabiq. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Agar usne ye shart rakhi ho, to usse janaze ke saath jaane aur bimaar ki iyaadat karne ka haq hai.

e: Abu Dharr narrated:"We fasted with the Prophet, so he did not pray (the night prayer) with us until seven (nights) of the month remained. Then he (pbuh) led us in prayer until a third of the night had gone, then he did not lead us in prayer on the sixth. Then he led us in prayer on the fifth until half of the night had gone. We said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah! Wouldn't you lead us in prayer for the remainder of the night?' He said: 'Indeed, whoever stands (praying) with the Imam until he finished, then it is recorded for him that he prayed the whole night.; Then he did not lead us in prayer until three (nights) of the month remained. Then he led us in prayer on the third and he called his family and his women to pray with us until we feared missing the Falah" I (Jubair bin Nufair) said to him: "What is the Falah" He said: "The Suhur
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath roza rakha, unhon ne humein namaz nahi padhayi yahan tak ke mahine ke saat din baaqi rah gaye. To unhon ne humein raat ke ek-tihai hisse tak namaz padhayi, phir chhathi raat ko humein namaz nahi padhayi, aur paanchvi raat ko humein aadhi raat tak namaz padhayi. To humne unse kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Kaash aap humein is raat ke baaki hisse mein bhi nafl padhaate. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo shakhs Imam ke saath khada rahe yahan tak ke wo faariq ho jaaye, uske liye poori raat ka qayaam likh diya jaata hai.' Phir unhon ne humein namaz nahi padhayi yahan tak ke mahine ke teen din baaqi rah gaye, aur unhon ne teesri raat ko humein namaz padhayi, aur apne ghar walon aur apni auraton ko bulaya, to unhon ne humein itna padhaya ke humein Falah chhoot jaane ka khauf hone laga." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine unse pucha: Falah kya hai? Unhon ne kaha: Sehri." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Ramzan ke qayaam ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne maana ke Witr samet iktalis rakat padhi jaaye. Aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, aur wahan unke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Nabi (SAW) ke doosre Sahaba se riwayat ke mutabiq, bees rakat par hain. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur isi tarah maine humare shehar Makkah mein paaya, wo bees rakat padhte hain. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Is baare mein kai tarah ki riwayaten hui hain, aur unhon ne ismein koi faisla nahi diya. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Balki hum Ubayy bin Ka'b se riwayat ke mutabiq iktalis rakat chunte hain. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ne Ramzan mein Imam ke saath namaz padhna chuna. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne chuna ke agar aadmi Quran ka qaari ho, to wo akele padhe. Aur is mauzu par Aishah, An-Nu'man bin Bashir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever provides the food for a fasting person to break his fast with, then for him is the same reward as his (the fasting person's), without anything being diminished from the reward of the fasting person
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi roze daar ko roza kholaaye, uske liye bhi usi jaisa ajr hoga, bina is ke ke roze daar ke ajr mein kuch kami aaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would encourage the night prayer in Ramadan without firmly ordering it, and he would say: "Whoever stands (in the night prayer) for Ramadan with faith and seeking the reward (from Allah), then he will be forgiven what has preceded of his sins.' So the Messenger of Allah died and the matter was like that. Then the matter was the same during the Khilafah of Abu Bakr and it continued during a portion of the Khilafah of Umar bin Al-Khattab
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Ramzan ke qayaam ki targheeb dete the, bina unhen sakhti se hukum diye, aur farmaate: 'Jo Ramzan mein imaan aur sawaab ki niyat se qayaam kare, uske pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye jaate hain.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya aur maamla isi tarah raha, phir Abu Bakr ki khilafat mein bhi isi tarah raha, aur Umar bin Al-Khattab ki khilafat ke shuru mein bhi isi tarah raha." Aur is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Abi Sa'eed Al Maqbury narrated:"Abu Shuraih Al-Adawi said tat when Amr bin Sa'eed was sending troops to Makkah he said to him: 'O Amr! Allow me to tell you what the Messenger of Allah said on the day following the Conquest of Makkah. My ears heard it, my heard understood it thoroughly, and with my own eyes, I saw the Prophet when he - after glorifying and praising Allah - said: "Indeed Allah, the Most High, made Makkah a sanctuary, it was not made a sanctuary by the people. So it is not lawful for a man who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood it, nor to cut down its trees. If anybody tries to use the Messenger of Allah to make an excuse for fighting in it, then say to him: 'Indeed Allah permitted His Messenger and He did not permit you.' Allah only allowed it for me for a few hours of one day, and today its sanctity has returned as it was before. So let the one who is present convey to the one who is absent." Abu Shuraih was asked: "What was Amr bin Sa'eeds reply to you?" He said: "I am more knowledgeable about that than you Abu Shuraih! The Haram does not give protection to a disobedient person, nor a person fleeing for murder, nor fleeing for (Kharbah) lawlessness
hi: Abu Shuraih Al-Adawi (RA) ne Amr bin Sa'eed se kaha jabke wo Makkah ki taraf lashkar bhej rahe the: "Mujhe ijazat dijiye, Ae Ameer, ke main aapko ek baat sunaaon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Fath ke agle din kahi thi, jise mere kaanon ne suna, mere dil ne samjha, aur mere aankhon ne dekha jab unhon ne wo kahi: unhon ne Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, phir farmaya: 'Beshak Makkah ko Allah ne haram banaya hai, logon ne nahi banaya. Aur kisi bhi aise aadmi ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, jaayez nahi ke wo ismein khoon bahaaye ya ismein koi darakht kaate. Agar koi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki jung ko bahaana banaakar ismein jung ki rukhsat le, to usse kaho: Beshak Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di thi aur tumhein ijazat nahi di. Aur mujhe bhi ye ijazat sirf din ke ek hisse ke liye di gayi thi, aur aaj iski hurmat waisi hi laut aayi hai jaisi kal thi, aur jo yahan haazir hai wo ise ghair-haazir tak pahunchaaye.'" To Abu Shuraih se pucha gaya: "Amr bin Sa'eed ne aapko kya jawab diya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe tumse zyada iska ilm hai, Ae Abu Shuraih! Haram kisi nafarman ko panah nahi deta, na khoon karke bhaagne wale ko, na kisi jurm karke bhaagne wale ko.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye bhi riwayat hai "ruswaai" ke lafz se. Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Shuraih ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i ka naam Khuwailid bin Amr hai, aur wo Al-Adawi hain aur Al-Ka'bi bhi. Aur unke qaul "kisi jurm karke bhaagne wale" ka matlab hai jurm - wo kehte hain: Jisne koi jurm kiya ho ya khoon kiya ho, phir Haram mein panah le, to uspar hadd qaayam ki jaayegi.

e: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Alternate between Hajj and Umrah; for those two remove poverty and sins just as the bellows removes filth from iron, gold, and silver - and there is no reward for Al-Hajj Al-Mabrur except for Paradise
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hajj aur Umrah ko lagataar karo, kyunki ye dono gareebi aur gunaahon ko aise door karte hain jaise bhatti loha, sona, aur chandi ki maili karti hai. Aur Hajj-e-Mabroor ka koi badla nahi siwaye Jannat ke." Aur is mauzu par Umar, Aamir bin Rabi'ah, Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Hubshi, Umm Salamah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever performs Hajj for Allah, and he does not have sexual relations nor commit any sin, then his previous sins will be forgiven
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Hajj kare aur na koi fahash baat kare na koi gunaah kare, wo aise laut aata hai jaise wo apni maa se paida hone ke din tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hazim Kufi hain, wo Al-Ashja'i hain, unka naam Salman hai, Azzah Al-Ashja'iyyah ke azaad kiye gulam.

e: Ali narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has the provisions and the means to convey him to Allah's House and he does not perform Hajj, then it does not matter if he dies as a Jew or a Christian. That is because Allah said in His Book: 'And Hajj to the House is a duty that mankind owes to Allah, for whomever is able to bear the journey
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs itna maal aur sawaari rakhta ho ke wo use Bait Allah tak pahuncha sake, aur usne Hajj na kiya, to usse koi farq nahi padta ke wo Yahudi ya Nasrani hokar mare, kyunki Allah apni Kitab mein farmaata hai: '(Aur Allah ke liye logon par Bait ka Hajj farz hai, jo wahan tak ka raasta paa sake)'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur iske isnad mein baat hai. Aur Hilal bin Abdullah majhool hain, aur Al-Harith hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What is it that makes Hajj obligatory?' He said: "The provisions and a means of conveyance
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hajj kya cheez farz karti hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Zaad aur Raahilah.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke jab aadmi zaad aur raahilah ka maalik ho jaaye, to uspar Hajj farz ho jaata hai. Aur Ibrahim bin Yazid, Al-Khuzi Al-Makki hain, aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne unki hifz ki wajah se unke baare mein baat ki hai.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated:"When Allah revealed: And Hajj to the House is a duty that mankind owes to Allah, for whomever is able to bear the journey. They said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is that every year?' He remained silent. So they said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is that every year?' He said: 'No. If I had said yes, then it would have been made obligatory.' So Allah revealed: O you who believe! Do not ask about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you trouble
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Jab ye Ayat nazil hui: '(Aur Allah ke liye logon par Bait ka Hajj farz hai, jo wahan tak ka raasta paa sake)' to unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kya har saal?' Wo khaamosh rahe. Phir unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kya har saal?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, aur agar main haan kehta, to wo farz ho jaata.' To Allah ne nazil farmaya: '(Ae imaan waalo! Aisi baaton ke baare mein na poochho jo agar tumpar zaahir ki jaayen to tumhein bura lagen)'." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Al-Bakhtari ka naam Sa'eed bin Abi Imran hai, aur wo Sa'eed bin Fairuz hain.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"The Prophet performed Hajj three times. He performed Hajj twice before his emigration, and he performed one Hajj after he emigrated, and these were accompanied by Umrah. So he drove sixty-three sacrificial animals (Budn) and Ali came from Yemen with the rest of them, among them was a camel of Abu Jahl that has a ring made of silver in its nose. So he (the Messenger of Allah) slaughtered the, and the Messenger of Allah ordered that a piece of each of them be cooked, and he drank from its broth
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne teen Hajj kiye, do hijrat se pehle aur ek hijrat ke baad, jiske saath Umrah bhi thi. To unhon ne teesath oont saath le gaye, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yaman se baaki laaye, unmein Abu Jahl ka oont bhi tha jiski naak mein chandi ki bali thi. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen zabah kiya aur unhon ne hukum diya ke har oont se ek tukda liya jaaye, to unhen pakaya gaya aur wo unka shorba piye.

e: Qatadah narrated:"I said to Anas bin Malik: 'How many times did the Prophet perform Hajj?' He said: 'He performed one Hajj and he performed four Umrah: An Umrah during Dhul-Qa'dah; the Umrah of Al-Hudaibiyah, and Umrah with his Hajj, and an Umrah from Al-Ji'irranah when he divided up the war spoils of Hunain
hi: Qatadah ne kaha: "Maine Anas bin Malik se pucha: Nabi (SAW) ne kitni baar Hajj kiya? Unhon ne kaha: Ek baar Hajj kiya aur chaar Umrah kiye: ek Umrah Dhul-Qa'dah mein, Hudaibiyah ka Umrah, ek Umrah apne Hajj ke saath, aur Ji'irranah ka Umrah jab unhon ne Hunain ki ghaneemat baanti." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrared:"The Messenger of Allah performed four Umrah: The Umrah of Al-Hudaibiyah, a second Umrah the following (year), (which was) the Umrah of Al-Qisas during Dhul-Qa'dah, a third Umrah from Al-Ji'irranah, and the fourth which accompanied his Hajj
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne chaar Umrah kiye: Hudaibiyah ka Umrah, doosra Umrah agle saal, Umrat-ul-Qaza Dhul-Qa'dah mein, teesra Umrah Ji'irranah se, aur chautha jo unke Hajj ke saath tha. Aur is mauzu par Anas, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"When the Prophet wanted to Perform Hajj, he announced it to the people, and they gathered (to accompany him). When he reached Al-Baida he assumed Ihram
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Hajj ka irada kiya, to unhon ne logon mein ailaan karwaaya, to wo jama ho gaye. Jab wo Al-Baida pahunche, to unhon ne Ihraam baandha." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Anas, aur Al-Miswar bin Makhramah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"Al-Baida the one they lie about regarding the Messenger of Allah. By Allah! The Messenger of Allah did not start the Talbiyah except from near the Masjid, near the tree
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Al-Baida, jiske baare mein log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par jhoot bolte hain - Allah ki qasam! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sirf Masjid ke paas se, us darakht ke paas se, Talbiyah shuru ki thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet started the Talbiyah after the Salat
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne namaz ke baad Talbiyah shuru ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne ise Abdus-Salam bin Harb ke siwaye riwayat ki ho. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ko Mustahab samajhte hain ke aadmi namaz ke baad Ihraam baandhe.

e: Aishah narrated:"the Messenger of Allah performed the Ifrad form of Hajj
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj-e-Ifrad kiya. Aur is mauzu par Jabir aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ifrad kiya, aur Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman ne bhi Ifrad kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Agar tum Ifrad karo to acha hai, aur agar Qiran karo to acha hai, aur agar Tamattu karo to acha hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne isi jaisi baat kahi. Unhon ne kaha: Humein Ifrad zyada pasand hai, phir Tamattu, phir Qiran.

e: Anas narrated:"I heard the Prophet saying: (Labbaika Bi'umratin wa Hajjah) 'Here I am for 'Umrah and Hajj
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Labbaik Umrah aur Hajj ke saath.'" Aur is mauzu par Umar aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, aur Kufa waalon aur doosron ne isi ko chuna.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah performed Tamattu, as did Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman. And the first to prohibit it was Mu'awiyah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Tamattu kiya, aur Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman ne bhi kiya. Aur sabse pehle jisne ise mana kiya, wo Muawiyah the."

e: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Nawfal narrated that:He heard Sa'd bin Abi Waqas, and Ad-Dahhak bin Qais while they were mentioning Tamattu after "Umrah until Hajj. Ad-Dahhak bin Qais said: "No one does that except one who is ignorant of the order of Allah, Most High." Sa'd said: "How horrible is it what you have said O my nephew!" So Ad-Dahhak (bin Qais) said: "Indeed Umar bin Al-Khattab has prohibited that." So Sa'd said: "The Messenger of Allah did it, and we did it with him
hi: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Nawfal se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas aur Ad-Dahhak bin Qais ko suna, wo dono Umrah ko Hajj tak Tamattu karne ka zikr kar rahe the. To Ad-Dahhak bin Qais ne kaha: "Aisa sirf wahi karta hai jo Allah ke hukum se na-waqif ho." To Sa'd ne kaha: "Tumne bahut buri baat kahi, Ae mere bhatije!" To Ad-Dahhak bin Qais ne kaha: "Beshak Umar bin Al-Khattab ne isse mana kiya hai." To Sa'd ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse kiya aur humne bhi unke saath kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Salim bin Abdullah narrated that :he had heard a man from Ash-Sham asking Abdullah bin Umar about Tamattu after Umrah until Hajj, so Abdullah bin Umar said: "It is lawful." The man from Ash-Sham said: "But your father prohibited it." So Abdullah bin Umar said: "Is the order to follow my father or is the order (to follow) for the Messenger of Allah?" The man said: "Rather it is for the Messenger of Allah." So he said: "Indeed the Messenger of Allah did it
hi: Salim bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Shaam ke ek aadmi ko Abdullah bin Umar se Umrah ko Hajj tak Tamattu karne ke baare mein pucchte suna, to Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: "Ye halal hai." To Shaami ne kaha: "Aapke waalid ne to isse mana kiya tha." To Abdullah bin Umar ne kaha: "Bataao, agar mere waalid ne isse mana kiya ho aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse kiya ho, to hum mere waalid ke hukum ki pairvi karen ya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ki?" To us aadmi ne kaha: "Balki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ki." To unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse kiya tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Uthman, Jabir, Sa'd, Asma bint Abi Bakr, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, Umrah ke saath Tamattu ko chuna hai. Aur Tamattu ye hai ke aadmi Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah ke saath Ihraam mein daakhil ho, phir theher jaaye yahan tak ke Hajj kare, to wo Mutamatti hai, aur uspar jitni aasani se ho sake ek qurbani hai, aur agar na paaye to Hajj mein teen din aur ghar wapas laut kar saat din roza rakhe. Aur Mutamatti ke liye ye Mustahab hai ke agar wo Hajj mein teen din roza rakhe, to das dinon mein roza rakhe aur unka aakhri din Arafah ka din ho, aur agar das dinon mein roza na rakhe, to Tashriq ke dinon mein roza rakhe, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba ke qaul mein, unmein Ibn Umar aur Aishah shaamil hain, aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo Tashriq ke dinon mein roza na rakhe, aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-hadith Hajj mein Umrah ke saath Tamattu chunte hain, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet would say the following for the Talbiyah: "Labbaik Allahumma labbaik. Labbaik la sharika laka labbaik. Innal-hamda wan-ni;mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika laka." ('I respond to Your call O Allah! I respond to Your call. You have no partner. I respond to Your call. All praise, thanks and blessings are for You. All sovereignty is for You. And You have no partners with You)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ki Talbiyah ye thi: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Sharika Laka Labbaik, Innal-Hamda wan-Ni'mata Laka wal-Mulk, La Sharika Lak." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Jabir, Aishah, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Agar Talbiyah mein Allah ki buzurgi bayan karte hue kuch aur bhi zyada kare, to koi harj nahi, Insha Allah, lekin mujhe zyada pasand hai ke sirf Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiyah par hi iktifa kiya jaaye. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur humne isliye kaha ke Allah ki buzurgi bayan karte hue izafa karne mein koi harj nahi, kyunki Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne Talbiyah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se yaad rakhi thi, phir Ibn Umar ne apni taraf se apni Talbiyah mein izafa kiya: \"Labbaik war-Raghba'u Ilaika wal-Amal.\"

e: Nafi` narrated:When Ibn Umar would say the talbiyah he would continue saying: "Labbaik Allahumma labbaik. Labbaik la sharika laka labbaik. Innal-hamda wan-ni`mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika laka" (I respond to Your call O Allah! I respond to Your call, You have no partner, I respond to You call. All praise, thanks and blessings are for You. And You have no partners with You). He said: "Abdullah bin Umar would say: 'This is the Talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah.' He would himself add the following after the Talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah: "Labbaik labbaika wa-sa'daik, wal-khairuu fi yadaik. Labbaika war-raghba'u ilaika wal-amal" ('I respond to Your call, and I am obedient to Your orders, all good is in Your Hands. I respond to Your call and the requests and deeds are for You)
hi: Nafi ne kaha: "Jab Ibn Umar Talbiyah kehte, to jaate hue Talbiyah kehte: 'Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Sharika Laka Labbaik, Innal-Hamda wan-Ni'mata Laka wal-Mulk, La Sharika Lak.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur Abdullah bin Umar kehte the: Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiyah hai." Aur wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Talbiyah ke baad apni taraf se izafa karte: "Labbaik Labbaika wa Sa'daik, wal-Khairu Fi Yadaik, Labbaik war-Raghba'u Ilaika wal-Amal." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that:The Messenger of Allah was asked: "Which Hajj is the most virtuous?" He said: "That with raised voices (Al-Ajj) and the flow of blood (of the sacrifice) (Ath-Thajj)
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: "Sabse afzal Hajj kaun sa hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Buland awaaz se Talbiyah kehna aur qurbani ka khoon bahaana."

e: Sahl bin Sa'd narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no Muslim who says the Talbiyah except that - on his right and left, until the end f the land, from here to there - the rocks, or trees, or mud say the Talbiyah
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman Talbiyah nahi kehta magar uske dahine aur baayen jo bhi pathar, darakht, ya mitti ka dhela hota hai, wo bhi Talbiyah kehta hai, yahan tak ke zameen yahan se wahan tak khatam ho jaaye." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Bakr ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Abi Fudaik ki, Ad-Dahhak bin Uthman se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur "Al-Ajj" ka matlab hai buland awaaz se Talbiyah kehna, aur "Ath-Thajj" ka matlab hai qurbani ke jaanwaron ka khoon bahaana.

e: Khallad bin As-Sa'ib (bin Khalad) narrated from his father:Who said that the Messenger of Allah said: "Jibril came to me and ordered me to order my Companions to raise their voices with the Ihlal, or; the Talbiyah
hi: Khallad bin As-Saib apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibril mere paas aaye aur mujhe hukum diya ke main apne Sahaba ko hukum doon ke wo Ihraam aur Talbiyah mein apni aawazein buland karen." Aur is mauzu par Zaid bin Khalid, Abu Hurairah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Khallad ki, apne walid se, hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Zaid bin Thabit narrated from his father :who said that he saw the Prophet disrobing for his Ihlal and to perform Ghusl
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko apne Ihlaal ke liye kapde utaarte aur ghusl karte dekha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Ihraam ke waqt ghusl karna Mustahab samjha hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:A man said: "Where should we begin our Hil (Ihram) O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "The people of Al-Madinah begin their Hil (Ihram) from Dhul-Hulaifah, the people from Ash-Sham from Al-Juhfah, and the people of Najd from Qarn." And he (Ibn Umar) said: ("And they say:) "And the people of Yemen from Yalamlam
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum kahan se Ihraam baandhen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Madina waale Dhul-Hulaifah se Ihraam baandhein, Shaam waale Al-Juhfah se, aur Najd waale Qarn se." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur log kehte hain: Aur Yaman waale Yalamlam se." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir bin Abdullah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet made Al-Aqiq the Miqat for the people of the west
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Mashriq waalon ke liye Al-Aqiq ko Miqat muqarrar kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib hain.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"A man stood and said 'O Messenger of Allah! What clothing do you command us to wear in Al-Haram?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Do not wear shirts, nor pants, nor burnooses, nor turbans, nor Khuff - unless one does not have any sandals, then let him wear Khuff, but let him cut them below the ankles. And do not wear any cloth that has been touched by saffron or Wars. And the woman in Ihram is not to cover her face, nor wear gloves
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi khada hua aur usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aap humein Haram mein kaun se kapde pehenne ka hukum dete hain?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qamees, pajaame, hooded chogha, pagdi, aur khuffain na pehno, siwaye is ke ke kisi ke paas do joote na hon, to wo khuffain pehen le aur unhen taakhno se neeche kaat le. Aur koi bhi aisa kapda na pehno jisme za'faran ya wars laga ho. Aur Ihraam waali aurat apna chehra na dhaanke aur dastaane na pehne." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:He heard the Messenger of Allah say: "If the Muhrim cannot find an Izar, then let him wear pants, and if he cannot find sandals, them let him wear Khuff
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Muhrim agar tehband na paaye, to wo pajaama pehen le, aur agar joote na paaye, to khuffain pehen le." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar Muhrim ko tehband na mile to wo pajaama pehen le, aur agar joote na mile to khuffain pehen le. Aur ye Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne Ibn Umar ki, Nabi (SAW) se, is hadith par amal kiya: "Agar joote na paaye, to khuffain pehen le aur unhen taakhno se neeche kaat le." Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai, aur Malik bhi isi ke qaayal hain.

e: Ya'la bin Umayyah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah saw a Bedouin who was in Ihram wearing a cloak. So he ordered him to remove it
hi: Ya'la bin Umayyah (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne ek Bedouin ko dekha jo Ihraam mein tha aur usne jubbah pehna hua tha, to unhon ne use utaarne ka hukum diya.

e: Ya'la bin Umayyah narrated:A Hadith similar to no. 835 with a different chain
hi: Ya'la bin Umayyah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, isi mafhoom mein. Ye zyada sahih hai aur is hadith mein ek waaqia hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Qatadah aur Al-Hajjaj bin Artaah aur kai doosron ne Ata se, Ya'la bin Umayyah se riwayat ki. Aur sahih wo hai jo Amr bin Dinar aur Ibn Juraij ne Ata se, Safwan bin Ya'la se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki.

e: Aishah narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Five are Fawasiq which may be killed in the Haram: the mouse, the scorpion, the crow, the kite, and the barbed dog
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanch fasiq jaanwar Haram mein maare jaayen: chuha, bicchhu, kauwa, cheel, aur kaate wala kutta." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that:The Prophet said: "The Muhrim may kill the wild beast of prey, the rabid dog, the mouse, the scorpion, the kite, and the crow
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Muhrim hamla karne wale darinde, kaate wale kutte, chuhe, bicchhu, cheel, aur kauwe ko maar sakta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Unhon ne kaha: Muhrim hamla karne wale darinde ko maar sakta hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Jo bhi darinda logon par ya unke jaanwaron par hamla kare, Muhrim use maar sakta hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah was cupped while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne pachhna lagwaaya jabke wo Muhrim the. Aur is mauzu par Anas, Abdullah Ibn Buhainah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Muhrim ke liye pachhna lagwaane ki rukhsat di hai, unhon ne kaha: Wo baal na katwaaye. Aur Malik ne kaha: Muhrim pachhna sirf zaroorat mein lagwaaye. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Muhrim ke liye pachhna lagwaane mein koi harj nahi, aur wo baal na nikaale.

e: Nubaih bin Wahb narrated:"Ibn Ma'mar wanted to have his son married. S he sent me to Aban bin Uthman who was the Amir of the (Hajj) season. I went to him and said: 'Your brother wants to marry his son and he would like for you to witness that.' He said: 'I think he is but a crude Bedouin; indeed the Muhrim is not to marry nor have someone married'" - or he said similarly - then he narrated from Uthman similar in Marfu form (from the Prophet)
hi: Nubaih bin Wahb ne kaha: "Ibn Ma'mar apne bete ki shaadi karna chahte the, to unhon ne mujhe Aban bin Uthman ke paas bheja, jo us waqt Makkah mein Hajj ke mausam ke Ameer the. Main unke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Aapke bhai apne bete ki shaadi karna chahte hain, aur wo chahte hain ke aap ismein gawaah bane.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe to wo sirf ek gawaar Bedouin lagta hai, Muhrim na nikah karta hai na kisi ka nikah karwaata hai.' Ya jaisa unhon ne kaha, phir unhon ne Uthman se isi jaisi baat marfu' riwayat ki." Aur is mauzu par Abu Rafi aur Maimunah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Uthman ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye kuch Tabi'een fuqaha ka qaul hai, aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, wo Muhrim ke nikah karne ko jaayez nahi maante, unhon ne kaha: Agar wo nikah kare, to uska nikah baatil hai.

e: Abu Rafi narrated:"The Messenger of Allah married Maimunah while he was Halal, and he stayed with her while he was Halal, and I was the messenger between the two of them
hi: Abu Rafi (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Maimunah se nikah kiya jabke wo Halal the, aur unhon ne unke saath rukhsati ki jabke wo Halal the, aur main unke darmiyan qaasid tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet married Maimunah while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Maimunah se nikah kiya jabke wo Muhrim the. Aur is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: (Another chain) that Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet married Maimunah while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ibn Abbas se ke Nabi (SAW) ne Maimunah se nikah kiya jabke wo Muhrim the.

e: (Another chain) that Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet married Maimunah while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ibn Abbas se ke Nabi (SAW) ne Maimunah se nikah kiya jabke wo Muhrim the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai. Aur Abu Ash-Sha'tha ka naam Jabir bin Zaid hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke Maimunah se nikah karne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hua hai, kyunki Nabi (SAW) ne unse Makkah ke raaste mein nikah kiya, to kuch ne kaha: Unhon ne unse Halal hote hue nikah kiya aur nikah ki baat zaahir hui jabke wo Muhrim the, phir unhon ne Sarif mein rukhsati ki jabke wo Halal the, aur Maimunah ka intiqaal Sarif mein hua, jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke saath rukhsati ki thi, aur wahin unhen dafn kiya gaya.

e: Yazid bin Al-Asamm narrated about Maimunah:"The Messenger of Allah married he while he was Halal and he stayed with her while he was Halal. She died in Sarif, and we buried her at the (site of the) tent where he had stayed wit her
hi: Yazid bin Al-Asamm, Maimunah se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse nikah kiya jabke wo Halal the, aur unke saath rukhsati ki jabke wo Halal the, aur unka intiqaal Sarif mein hua, aur humne unhen usi khaimay ki jagah dafn kiya jahan unhon ne unke saath rukhsati ki thi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Yazid bin Al-Asamm se mursal riwayat ki ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Maimunah se nikah kiya jabke wo Halal the.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that:The Prophet said: "The land game is lawful for you while you are in Ihram as long as you did not hunt it - or - it was not hunted for you
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khushki ka shikaar tumhare liye halal hai jabke tum Ihraam mein ho, jab tak tum khud shikaar na karo ya tumhare liye shikaar na kiya jaaye." Aur is mauzu par Abu Qatadah aur Talhah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith tafseeli hadith hai. Aur Al-Muttalib ka Jabir se sunna hum nahi jaante. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Muhrim ke liye shikaar khaane mein koi harj nahi maante jab wo khud shikaar na kare ya uske liye shikaar na kiya jaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye is mauzu par riwayat hui sabse achi aur sabse tafseeli hadith hai, aur isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that:He was with the Prophet and when he got to one of the roads of Makkah some of the companions were Muhrim and he (Abu Qatadah) was not a Muhrim. So he saw a wild donkey, so he mounted his horse, asked his companions to give him his whip but they refused, so he asked them to give him his spear and they refused. So he (himself) took it and struck the donkey killing it. Some of the Companions of the Prophet ate it and some of them refused. When they caught up to the Prophet they asked him about that and he said: "It is only food which Allah fed you
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) se riwayat hai ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath the, jab wo Makkah ke raaste mein the, wo apne Muhrim saathiyon se peeche reh gaye jabke wo khud Muhrim nahi the. To unhon ne ek jangli gadha dekha, to wo apne ghode par sawaar hue aur apne saathiyon se apna kora maangaa, unhon ne inkar kar diya, to unhon ne apna neza maanga, unhon ne wo bhi na diya. To unhon ne khud use liya, phir gadhe par jhapatte hue use maar diya. To Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ne usmein se khaaya aur kuch ne inkar kiya. Jab wo Nabi (SAW) se mile to unhon ne unse iske baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ye to sirf ek khaana hai jo Allah ne tumhein khilaaya."

e: (Another chain that) Abu Qatadah narrated:About the wild donkey, and it is similar to the (previous) narrated of Abu An-Nadr except that in the narration of Zaid bin Aslam he said that the Messenger of Allah said: "Do you have any of its meat left with you?
hi: Abu Qatadah se jangli gadhe ke baare mein, Abu An-Nadr ki hadith jaisi, siwaye is ke ke Zaid bin Aslam ki hadith mein hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare paas iska kuch gosht hai?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:As-S'ab bin Jath-thamah informed him that the Messenger of Allah had passed him at Al-Abwa or Bawaddan. He (As-S'ab) gave him a wild donkey but he refused it. When the Messenger of Allah noticed on his face that he was upset, he said: "We would not refuse you, but we are in Ihram
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke As-Sa'b bin Jaththamah ne unhen bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas Al-Abwa ya Waddan mein guzre, to usne unhen ek jangli gadha tohfe mein diya, unhon ne use wapas kar diya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske chehre par napasandeegi dekhi, to unhon ne farmaya: "Humne tumhein wapas isliye nahi kiya ke humein tumse koi shikayat hai, balki hum Ihraam mein hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne isi hadith ko apnaya aur Muhrim ke liye shikaar khaana napasand kiya. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Humare nazdeek is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke unhon ne use isliye wapas kiya kyunki unhen shak hua ke ye unke liye shikaar kiya gaya hai, aur unhon ne ehtiyaat ki wajah se use chhod diya. Aur Az-Zuhri ke kuch shagirdon ne ye hadith Az-Zuhri se riwayat ki aur kaha: Usne unhen jangli gadhe ka gosht tohfe mein diya, aur ye mahfooz nahi hai. Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Zaid bin Arqam se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"We went with the Messenger of Allah during Hajj or Umrah and we encountered a swarm of locusts. We began striking at them with our whips and set our staffs, and the Prophet said: "Eat it, for indeed it is game of the sea
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj ya Umrah mein nikle, humare saamne tiddiyon ka ek jhund aa gaya, to hum unhen apne koron aur lathiyon se maarne lage. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Inhe khao, kyunki ye samundar ka shikaar hain.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abu Al-Muhazzim ki, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Abu Al-Muhazzim ka naam Yazid bin Sufyan hai, aur Shu'bah ne unke baare mein baat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Muhrim ko tiddi shikaar karne aur khaane ki rukhsat di hai, aur kuch ne maana ke agar wo shikaar kare aur khaaye to uspar sadqa hai.

e: Ibn Abi Ammar said:"I asked Jabir bin Abdullah: 'Is the hyena game?' He said: 'Yes'" He said: "I said: 'Can it be eaten?' He said: 'Yes.'" He said: "I said: 'Did the Messenger of Allah say that?' He said: 'Yes
hi: Ibn Abi Ammar ne kaha: "Maine Jabir bin Abdullah se pucha: 'Kya lakadbagga shikaar hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Kya main use khaa sakta hoon?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Kya ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai ke agar Muhrim lakadbagga shikaar kare, to uspar jaza hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet performed Ghusl for entered Makkah at Fakhkh
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne Makkah mein daakhil hone ke liye Fakhkh mein ghusl kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith mahfooz nahi hai. Aur sahih wo hai jo Nafi ne Ibn Umar se riwayat ki ke wo Makkah mein daakhil hone ke liye ghusl karte the. Aur Ash-Shafi'i isi ke qaayal hain, Makkah mein daakhil hone ke liye ghusl karna Mustahab hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam hadith mein kamzor hain, Ahmad bin Hanbal aur Ali bin Al-Madini aur doosron ne unhen kamzor qarar diya, aur hum ye hadith marfu' sirf unki riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"When Prophet came to Makkah he entered it from its higher side, and left from its lower side
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) Makkah aaye, to unhon ne uske oopri hisse se daakhil hokar niche wale hisse se nikale." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet entered Makkah during the daytime
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) din ke waqt Makkah mein daakhil hue. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Al-Muhajir Al-Makki said:Jabir bin Abdulla was asked about a man raising his hands when he sees the House (Ka'bah). So he said: 'We performed Hajj with the Messenger of Allah and we did it
hi: Al-Muhajir Al-Makki ne kaha: "Jabir bin Abdullah se pucha gaya: Kya aadmi Bait dekh kar apne haath uthaaye? To unhon ne kaha: Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajj kiya, kya hum aisa karte the?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Bait dekh kar haath uthaana hum sirf Shu'bah ki, Abu Qaza'ah se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Abu Qaza'ah ka naam Suwaid bin Hujair hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"When the Prophet arrived in Makkah, he entered the Masjid and touched the (Black) Stone, then went to his right and performed Raml (walking quickly) for three (circuits) and walking for four. Then he came to the Maqam and said: 'And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.' Then he performed two Rak'ah while the Maqam was between him and the House. Then he came to the (Black) Stone after the two Rak'ah to touch it, then he left to As-Safa - I think - he said: Indeed As-Safa and Al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) Makkah pahunche, to unhon ne Masjid mein daakhil hokar Hajr-e-Aswad ko chhua, phir apni dahini taraf badhe aur teen chakkar Raml mein aur chaar chakkar aam chaal mein poore kiye. Phir wo Maqam ke paas aaye aur kaha: '(Aur Ibrahim ke Maqam ko namaz ki jagah banao)' to unhon ne do rakat padhi jabke Maqam unke aur Bait ke darmiyan tha. Phir wo do rakaton ke baad Hajr ke paas aaye aur use chhua, phir Safa ki taraf nikle - mujhe lagta hai unhon ne kaha - '(Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain)'." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Prophet performed Raml from the (Black) Stone to the (Black) Stone for three (circuits), and he walked four (circuits)
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Hajr se Hajr tak teen chakkar Raml mein poore kiye aur chaar chakkar aam chaal mein. Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Agar wo jaan-boojh kar Raml chhod de, to usne bura kiya lekin uspar kuch nahi, aur agar wo pehle teen chakkaron mein Raml na kare, to baaki mein bhi na kare. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Makkah waalon par aur jo wahan se Ihraam baandhta hai uspar Raml nahi.

e: Abu Tufail narrated:"I was with Ibn Abbas, and Mu'awiyah would not pass any corner without touching it. So Ibn Abbas said to him: 'the Prophet would not touch any besides the Black Stone and the Yemeni corner.' So Mu'awiyah said: 'There is no part of the House that is untouchable
hi: Abu Tufail ne kaha: "Main Ibn Abbas ke saath tha, aur Muawiyah jab bhi kisi rukn ke paas se guzarte to use chhoote. To Ibn Abbas ne unse kaha: 'Nabi (SAW) sirf Hajr-e-Aswad aur Rukn-e-Yamani ko chhoote the.' To Muawiyah ne kaha: 'Bait ka koi hissa aisa nahi jise chhoda jaaye.'" Aur is mauzu par Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke sirf Hajr-e-Aswad aur Rukn-e-Yamani ko chhua jaaye.

e: Ibn Ya'la narrated from his father:"The Prophet performed Tawaf of the House Mudtabi'an, and he was wearing a Burd
hi: Ibn Ya'la apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Bait ka Tawaf Mudtabi' hokar kiya, aur unhon ne ek chadar pehni hui thi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Ath-Thawri ki, Ibn Juraij se riwayat hai, hum ise sirf unki hadith se jaante hain, aur ye hasan sahih hadith hai. Aur Abdul-Hamid, Ibn Jubair bin Shaibah hain, Ibn Ya'la se, apne walid Ya'la bin Umayyah se.

e: Abbas bin Rabi'ah said:"I saw Umar bin Al-Khattab kissing the (Black) Stone and saying: 'I am kissing you while I know that you are just a stone, and if I had not seen the Messenger of Allah kissing you, I would not kiss you
hi: Aabis bin Rabi'ah ne kaha: "Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab ko Hajr ko chumte aur kehte suna: 'Main tumhein chumta hoon aur jaanta hoon ke tum sirf ek pathar ho, aur agar maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhein chumte na dekha hota, to main tumhein na chumta.'" Aur is mauzu par Abu Bakr aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Az-Zubair bin Arabi narrated:That a man asked Ibn Umar about touching the (Black) Stone, so he said: "I saw the Prophet touching it and kissing it." So the man said: "What is your view if there is a throng (around the Ka'bah) and what is your view if the people overpowered me?" Ibn Umar said: "Leave 'What is your view' in Yemen. I saw the Prophet touching it and kissing it
hi: Az-Zubair bin Arabi se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Ibn Umar se Hajr ko chhoone ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko use chhoote aur chumte dekha hai." To us aadmi ne kaha: "Aap batayen agar mujhpar bheed ho jaaye, aap bataayen agar mujhe dhakka mil jaaye?" To Ibn Umar ne kaha: "'Aap bataayen' ko Yaman mein rakh do, maine Nabi (SAW) ko use chhoote aur chumte dekha hai." Ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Hajr ko chumna Mustahab samajhte hain, agar mumkin na ho aur wo wahan tak na pahunch sake, to apne haath se use chhoo le aur apna haath chum le, aur agar wahan tak bhi na pahunche, to jab uske saamne pahunche to uski taraf mun karke Takbir kahe. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"When the Prophet arrived in Makkah, he performed seven (circuits) of Tawaf around the House. Then he came to the Maqam and said: And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer. Then he prayed behind the Maqam. Then he came to the (Black) Stone to touch it. Then he said: 'We begin with what Allah began with.' So he began at As-Safa and recited: Indeed As-Safa and Al-Marwah are among the Symbols of Allah
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne jab Makkah pahunche to Bait ka saat chakkar Tawaf kiya. Phir wo Maqam ke paas aaye aur padha: '(Aur Ibrahim ke Maqam ko namaz ki jagah banao)' to unhon ne Maqam ke peeche namaz padhi. Phir wo Hajr ke paas aaye aur use chhua, phir kaha: "Hum wahin se shuru karte hain jahan se Allah ne shuru kiya." To unhon ne Safa se shuru kiya aur padha: "(Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Safa se shuru kiya jaaye Marwah se pehle, aur agar Marwah se shuru kare Safa se pehle, to ye kaafi nahi hoga aur Safa se shuru karna hoga. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai us shakhs ke baare mein jo Bait ka Tawaf kare lekin Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i na kare yahan tak ke wapas laut jaaye, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i na kare yahan tak ke Makkah se nikal jaaye, to agar use yaad aaye jabke wo uske qareeb ho, to wo wapas jaaye aur Safa-Marwah ka Sa'i kare, aur agar use yaad na aaye yahan tak ke apne shehar pahunch jaaye, to ye kaafi hai aur uspar ek qurbani hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar usne Safa-Marwah ka Tawaf chhoda yahan tak ke apne shehar wapas laut gaya, to ye kaafi nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Safa-Marwah ka Tawaf wajib hai, Hajj sirf isi se sahih hota hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah only performed the Sa'i of the House and of As-Safa and Al-Marwah to show his strength to the idolaters
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bait ka aur Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i sirf isliye ki taake mushrikeen ko apni taaqat dikhaayen." Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ko Mustahab samajhte hain ke Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i ki jaaye. Aur agar wo Sa'i na kare aur Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan chale, to unhon ne ise jaayez maana.

e: Kathir bin Jumhan said:"I saw Ibn Umar walking at the place of Sa'i so I said to him: 'Do you walk at the place of Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwah?' He said: 'If I performed Sa'i, then it is because I saw the Messenger of Allah performing Sa'i there, and if I walked, then it is because I have seen the Messenger of Allah walking. And I am an old man
hi: Kathir bin Jumhan ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar ko Sa'i ki jagah mein chalte dekha, to maine unse kaha: Kya aap Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i ki jagah mein chalte hain? Unhon ne kaha: Agar maine Sa'i ki, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Sa'i karte dekha hai, aur agar maine chal kar guzra, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chal kar guzarte dekha hai, aur main ek boodha aadmi hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Umar se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet performed Tawaf upon his mount, so when he arrived at the (Black Stone) corner, he pointed to it
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni sawari par Tawaf kiya, jab wo rukn tak pahunche to unhon ne ishara kiya." Aur is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Tufail, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isse napasand kiya ke aadmi Bait ka aur Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan Tawaf sawaar hokar kare, siwaye kisi uzr ke. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Whoever performed Tawaf around the House fifty time, he will be as free of his sins as the day his mother bore him
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Bait ka pachaas martaba Tawaf kare, wo apne gunahon se aise nikal jaata hai jaise apni maa se paida hone ke din tha." Aur is mauzu par Anas aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith ghareeb hai. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ye sirf Ibn Abbas ka apna qaul riwayat hota hai.

e: Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani said:"We considered Abdullah bin Sa'eed bin Jubair to be better than his father, and he had a brother named Abdul-Malik bin Sa'eed bin Jubair who also reported from him
hi: Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani ne kaha: "Log Abdullah bin Sa'eed bin Jubair ko apne waalid se afzal maante the. Aur Abdullah ke ek bhai the jinhen Abdul-Malik bin Sa'eed bin Jubair kaha jaata tha, unhon ne bhi unse riwayat ki hai."

e: Jubair bin Mut'im narrated that :the Prophet said: "O Banu Abd Manaf! Do not prevent anyone from performing Tawaf around this House, and Salat, whichever hour it is of the night or day
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Banu Abd Manaf! Kisi ko bhi is Bait ka Tawaf karne aur raat ya din ki jis bhi ghadi mein chahe namaz padhne se mat roko." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jubair bin Mut'im ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abdullah bin Abi Najih ne bhi ise Abdullah bin Baba se riwayat ki hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Makkah mein Asr aur Subh ke baad namaz ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Asr aur Subh ke baad namaz aur Tawaf mein koi harj nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ki isi hadith se dalil li. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo Asr ke baad Tawaf kare to namaz na padhe yahan tak ke sooraj doob jaaye, isi tarah agar wo Subh ki namaz ke baad Tawaf kare to namaz na padhe yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aaye. Aur unhon ne Umar ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne Subh ki namaz ke baad Tawaf kiya to unhon ne namaz nahi padhi aur Makkah se nikal gaye yahan tak ke Zi-Tuwa mein utre aur sooraj nikalne ke baad namaz padhi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:During the two Rak'ah of Tawaf, the Messenger of Allah recited the two Surat of Ikhlas, "Say: O you disbelievers!" and: "Say: He is Allah, (the) One
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Tawaf ki do rakaton mein do Ikhlaas Surahen padhin: '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)' aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)'.

e: Ja'far bin Muhammad narrated from his father:that he considered it recommended for the two Rak'ah of Tawaf to recite: Say: "O you disbelievers!" and: Say: "He is Allah, (the) One
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Tawaf ki do rakaton mein '(Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun)' aur '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' padhna Mustahab samjha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye Abdul-Aziz bin Imran ki hadith se zyada sahih hai, aur Ja'far bin Muhammad ki, apne walid se, is baare mein riwayat, Ja'far bin Muhammad ki, apne walid se, Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Aur Abdul-Aziz bin Imran hadith mein kamzor hain.

e: Zaid bin Uthai said:XI asked Ali: "What is it that you were sent with?" He said: "With four things: None will be admitted into Paradise except for the soul that is a Muslim. None is to perform Tawaf around the House while naked. The Muslims and the idolaters will not be gathering (in Makkah) together after this year. And for whomever there is a covenant between him and the Prophet, then his covenant is (valid) until its term, and for that in which there was no term, then it shall be four months
hi: Zaid bin Uthai ne kaha: "Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pucha: Aap kis cheez ke saath bheje gaye the? Unhon ne kaha: Chaar baaton ke saath: Jannat mein sirf Musalman jaan hi daakhil hogi, aur koi bhi nangi halat mein Bait ka Tawaf na kare, aur Musalman aur mushrik is saal ke baad ikattha na honge, aur jiske aur Nabi (SAW) ke darmiyan koi ahd ho, to uska ahd uski muddat tak hai, aur jiske liye koi muddat nahi, uske liye chaar mahine hain." Aur is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai.

e: Zaid bin Uthai said:(Another chain) and they said: "Zaid bin Yuthai" and this is more correct
hi: Zaid bin Uthai ne kaha: (Doosri sanad se) aur unhon ne kaha "Zaid bin Yuthai." Aur ye zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Shu'bah ne ismein galti ki aur "Zaid bin Uthail" kaha.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet left me while he had a joyous look of contentment and he returned to me grieving. So I asked him about that and he said: 'I entered the Ka'bah, and I wished that I had not done it. I fear that my Ummah will follow me (in that) after me
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) mere paas se nikle jabke unki aankhein thandi thin aur dil khush tha, phir wo mere paas laute jabke wo ghamgeen the. Maine unse pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Main Ka'bah mein daakhil hua, aur mujhe afsos hai ke maine aisa kyun kiya, mujhe darr hai ke mere baad meri Ummat isi mein mushkil mein pad jaayegi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated from Bilal:"The Prophet performed Salat in the interior of the Ka'bah." And Ibn Abbas said: "He did not perform Salat in it, but he said the Takbir
hi: Ibn Umar (RA), Bilal se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ka'bah ke andar namaz padhi. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Unhon ne namaz nahi padhi, balki Takbir kahi. Aur is mauzu par Usamah bin Zaid, Al-Fadl bin Abbas, Uthman bin Talhah, aur Shaibah bin Uthman se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Bilal ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Ka'bah mein namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi maante. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Ka'bah mein nafl namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi. Aur unhon ne Ka'bah mein farz namaz padhna napasand kiya. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Ka'bah mein farz aur nafl donon padhne mein koi harj nahi, kyunki taharat aur Qibla ke baare mein nafl aur farz ka hukum ek jaisa hai.

e: Al-Aswad bin Yazid narrated that:Ibn Az-Zubair said to him: "Narrated to me from what the Mother of the Believers used to (secretly) inform you about" - meaning Aishah - so he said: "She narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Had your people not been still close to the pre-Islamic period of ignorance, then I would demolish the Ka'bah and rebuild it with two doors.'" He said: "So when Ibn Az-Zubair came to power he demolished it and rebuilt it with two doors
hi: Al-Aswad bin Yazid se riwayat hai ke Ibn Az-Zubair ne unse kaha: "Mujhe wo baat bataao jo Ummul-Momineen" - yani Aishah - "aapko bataati thin." To unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Agar tumhari qaum Jahiliyyah se abhi abhi nikli hui na hoti, to main Ka'bah gira deta aur usmein do darwaze bana deta.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To jab Ibn Az-Zubair ke haath mein iqtidaar aaya, to unhon ne use gira diya aur usmein do darwaze bana diye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I wanted to enter the House to perform Salat in it, so the Messenger of Allah took me by the hand and put me in the Hijr, and he said: 'Perform Salat in the Hijri if you want to enter the House. For indeed it is part of the House, but your people considered it insignificant when they built the Ka'bah, so they put it outside the House
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Main chahti thi ke main Bait mein daakhil hokar usmein namaz padhoon, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur mujhe Hijr mein le gaye, aur farmaya: 'Hijr mein namaz padho agar tum Bait mein daakhil hona chahti ho, kyunki ye to Bait ka hi ek hissa hai, lekin tumhari qaum ne jab Ka'bah banaya to isse kam kar diya aur Bait se bahar nikaal diya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Alqamah bin Abi Alqamah, Alqamah bin Bilal hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The Black Stone descended from the Paradise, and it was more white than milk, then it was blackened by the sins of the children of Adam
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hajr-e-Aswad Jannat se utra tha aur wo doodh se bhi zyada safed tha, phir Bani Aadam ki khataaon ne use kaala kar diya." Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that :He heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Indeed the Corner and the Maqam are two corundums from the corundum of Paradise. Allah removed their lights, and if their lights had not been removed then they would illuminate what is between east and the west
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Beshak Rukn aur Maqam Jannat ke yaqoot mein se do yaqoot hain, Allah ne unki roshni mita di, aur agar unki roshni na mitaayi jaati, to wo Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan sab kuch roshan kar dete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Abdullah bin Amr se unka apna qaul riwayat hota hai. Aur is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai, aur ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Ata reported that Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah led us in Salat at Mina for Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and Fajr, then he left in the morning to Arafat
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Mina mein Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, aur Fajr padhayi, phir wo subah Arafat ki taraf gaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ismail bin Muslim ke baare mein unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki gayi hai.

e: Al-Hakam reported from Miqsam, that Ibn Abbas narrated:That the Prophet prayed Zuhr and Fajr in Mina, then he left in the morning to Arafat
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Mina mein Zuhr aur Fajr padhi, phir wo subah Arafat ki taraf gaye. Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Az-Zubair aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Miqsam ki, Ibn Abbas se riwayat - Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya ne kaha: Shu'bah ne kaha: Al-Hakam ne Miqsam se sirf paanch cheezein sunee hain. Aur unhon ne unhen gina, aur ye hadith un mein shaamil nahi jo Shu'bah ne gine.

e: Aishah said:"We said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Shall we build a structure to shade you at Mina? He said: 'No., Mina is a resting place for whoever arrives
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Humne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Kya hum aapke liye Mina mein ek saaya dene wala ghar na banaayen? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, Mina to jo pehle aaye uski theharne ki jagah hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Harithah bin Wahb said:"I prayed two Rak'ah with the Prophet at Mina, and the people were as secure as they ever were, and even more so
hi: Harithah bin Wahb (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Mina mein namaz padhi jabke log sabse zyada aman mein the, aur unki zyada tar namaz do rakat thi." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn Umar, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Harithah bin Wahb ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath Mina mein do rakat padhi, aur Abu Bakr ke saath, aur Umar ke saath, aur Uthman ke saath bhi unki khilafat ke shuru mein do rakat padhi." Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Makkah waalon ke Mina mein namaz qasr karne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Makkah waalon ke liye Mina mein namaz qasr karna jaayez nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo Mina mein musafir ho. Aur ye Ibn Juraij, Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Makkah waalon ke liye Mina mein namaz qasr karne mein koi harj nahi. Aur ye Al-Awza'i, Malik, Sufyan bin Uyainah, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ka qaul hai.

e: Amr bin Dinar narrated from Amr bin Abdulah bin Safwan, that Yazid bin Shaiban said:"Ibn Mirba Al-Ansari came to us while we were standing at our places" (Amr bin Sinar said:) a place that Amr (bin Abdullah) indicated was far - "and he said: 'I am a messenger whom the Messenger of Allah sent to you to say: 'Stay with your (Hajj) rites, for indeed you are following a legacy left by Ibrahim
hi: Yazid bin Shaiban ne kaha: "Ibn Mirba Al-Ansari humare paas aaye jabke hum Mauqif mein khade the, ek aisi jagah jise Amr door bataate hain - to unhon ne kaha: 'Main tumhare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka qaasid hoon, wo kehte hain: Apne mashaair par khade raho, kyunki tum Ibrahim ki wiraasat par ho.'" Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Jubair bin Mut'im, aur Ash-Sharid bin Suwaid Ath-Thaqafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mirba Al-Ansari ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Uyainah ki, Amr bin Dinar se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Ibn Mirba ka naam Yazid bin Mirba Al-Ansari hai, aur unki sirf yehi ek hadith maloom hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Quraish and those who followed their religion - and they were called Al-Hums - would stand at Al-Muzdalifah, and they would say: 'We are the people of Allah.' The others would stand at Arafat, so Allah the Mighty and Sublime revealed: Then depart from where the people depart
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Quraish aur unke deen par chalne wale, jinhen Al-Hums kaha jaata tha, Muzdalifah mein khade hote aur kehte: 'Hum Allah ke qareebi log hain.' Aur unke siwa doosre log Arafat mein khade hote. To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: '(Phir wahan se palto jahan se log palte hain)'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.
