Aur is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke Makkah waale Haram se bahar nahi jaate the, aur Arafah Haram se bahar hai, to Makkah waale Muzdalifah mein khade hote aur kehte: 'Hum Allah ke qareebi log hain,' yani Allah ke ghar walon jaisa, aur Makkah waalon ke siwa doosre log Arafat mein khade hote. To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: '(Phir wahan se palto jahan se log palte hain)'. Aur Al-Hums Haram waale hain.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated:"The Messenger of Allah stopped at Arafat and said: 'This is Arafah and it is a place of standing. And all of Arafat is a place for standing.' Then he departed when the sun had set and took Usamah bin Zaid as a companion rider, and he was motioning with his hand as was his custom, and the people were striking (their camels) on the right and the left to try and catch them, so he said: 'O you people! Be calmm.' Then he came to Jama and performed the two Salat there combined. When the morning came, he went to Quzah and stood there and said: 'This is Quzah, and it is a place of standing, and all of Jama is a place for standing.' Then he departed until he arrived at Wadi Muhassir. Then he stuck his she-camel and she trotted until he passed the valley. Then he stopped and took Al-Fadl as a companion rider and went to the Jamrah to stone it. Then he went to Al-Manhar and said: 'This is Al-Manhar, and all of Mina is a place for sacrifice.' A young girl from Khath'am came to ask him for a verdict, she said: 'Indeed my father is an elderly man who has lived until Allah has made Hajj obligatory, so would he be rewarded if I perform Hajj for him? He said: 'Perform Hajj for your father.'" He said: "And he turned the neck of Al Fadl. So Al-Abbas said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Why did you turn the neck of your cousin?' He said: 'I saw a young man and a young woman, and they were not safe from Shaitan.' A man came to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah! I performed (Tawaf) Al-Ifadah before shaving.' He said: 'Shave, and there is no harm'" - or: 'Clip and there is no harm'" He said: "Someone else came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I did the sacrifice before stoning.' So he said: 'Stone, and there is no harm.'" He said: "Then he went to the House (Ka'bah) to perform Tawaf around it, then he went to Zamzam and said: 'O tribe of Abdul-Muttalib! If it were not that the people would rush upon you then I would remove it
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Arafah mein khade hue aur farmaya: 'Ye Arafah hai aur ye Mauqif hai, aur poora Arafah Mauqif hai.' Phir wo sooraj doobne par wahan se palte, aur Usamah bin Zaid ko apni sawari par saath baithaya, aur apne haath se apni aadat ke mutabiq ishara karte, aur log dahine-baayen apne oonton ko maar rahe the, wo unki taraf mudte aur kehte: 'Ae logo! Sukoon rakho.' Phir wo Jam aaye, wahan unhon ne dono namazein ikattha padhayin. Jab subah hui to wo Quzah aaye aur wahan khade hue aur kaha: 'Ye Quzah hai aur ye Mauqif hai, aur poora Jam Mauqif hai.' Phir wo wahan se rawaana hue yahan tak ke Wadi Muhassir tak pahunche, to unhon ne apni oontni ko thoka to wo tez chali yahan tak ke wadi paar kar li, phir wo ruke aur Al-Fadl ko apni sawari par saath baithaya. Phir wo Jamrah ke paas aaye aur use rami mari. Phir wo Manhar aaye aur farmaya: 'Ye Manhar hai, aur poora Mina Manhar hai.' Aur Khath'am qabile ki ek jawan ladki ne unse fatwa maanga, usne kaha: 'Mera waalid ek boodha aadmi hai, unpar Allah ka Hajj farz ho chuka hai, kya kaafi hoga agar main unki taraf se Hajj karoon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apne waalid ki taraf se Hajj karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Aur unhon ne Al-Fadl ki gardan mod di." To Al-Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aapne apne chacha zaad bhai ki gardan kyun modi?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Maine ek jawan aadmi aur ek jawan aurat ko dekha, to mujhe Shaitan se unke baare mein bharosa na hua." Phir ek aadmi unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Maine baal katwaane se pehle hi rawaana ho gaya." Unhon ne farmaya: "Baal munda lo ya katwa lo, koi harj nahi." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur ek aur aadmi aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Maine rami se pehle hi qurbani zabah kar di." Unhon ne farmaya: "Rami karo, koi harj nahi." Unhon ne kaha: "Phir wo Bait ke paas aaye aur uska Tawaf kiya, phir wo Zamzam ke paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Ae Banu Abdul-Muttalib! Agar mujhe dar na hota ke log tumse iske paani ka haq chheen lenge, to main khud shaamil ho jaata.'" Aur is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki riwayat mein sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Ayyash ki hadith se. Aur kai logon ne Ath-Thawri se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Arafah mein Zuhr ke waqt Zuhr aur Asr ko ikattha karna maante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar aadmi apne khaimay mein namaz padhe aur Imam ke saath haazir na ho, to agar chahe to wo bhi waisi hi ikattha kare jaisi Imam ne ki. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Zaid bin Ali, Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ke bete hain, alaihis-salaam.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Prophet hurried through Wadi Muhassir." Bishr (one of the narrators) added: "He departed from Jam calmly and he ordered them (the people) to be calm." And Abu Nu'aim (one of the narrators) added: "And he ordered them to do the stoning with what was similar to pebbles for Al-Khadhf' And he said: "Perhaps I will not see you after this year
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Wadi Muhassir mein tezi se chale. Bishr ne izafa kiya: "Aur wo Jam se sukoon ke saath rawaana hue, aur unhon ne logon ko sukoon ka hukum diya." Aur Abu Nu'aim ne izafa kiya: "Aur unhon ne unhen chhoti kankariyon jaisi kankariyan marne ka hukum diya," aur farmaya: "Shayad main is saal ke baad tumhein na dekhoon." Aur is mauzu par Usamah bin Zaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Malik narrated:"Ibn Umar prayed at Jam (Muzdalifah), so he combined two prayers with the Iqamah, and he said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah doing the same as this at the place
hi: Abdullah bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Ibn Umar ne Jam mein namaz padhi, to unhon ne ek hi iqaamat se do namazein ikattha padhin, aur kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko is jagah aisa hi karte dekha hai."

e: (Another chain) that Sa'eed bin Jubair narrated :Similarly from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet
hi: Sa'eed bin Jubair, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat karte hain. Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Ayyub, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Jabir, aur Usamah bin Zaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith, Sufyan ki riwayat mein, Ismail bin Abi Khalid ki riwayat se zyada sahih hai, aur Sufyan ki hadith sahih hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai kyunki Maghrib ki namaz Jam pahunchne se pehle nahi padhi jaati, to jab wo Jam yani Muzdalifah pahunche, to wo do namazein ek hi iqaamat se ikattha kare, aur unke darmiyan koi nafl na padhe, aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ne chuna hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Wo azaan aur do iqaamaton se Muzdalifah mein Maghrib aur Isha ikattha kare, Maghrib ke liye azaan de aur iqaamat kahe aur Maghrib padhe, phir iqaamat kahe aur Isha padhe. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mar narrated that:Some people among the residents of Najd came to the Messenger of Allah while he was at Arafat. They were questioning him, so he ordered a caller to proclaim: "The Hajj is Arafah. Whoever came to Jam during the night, before the time of Fajr, then he has attended the Hajj. The days of Mina are three, so whoever hastens (leaving after) two days, then there is no sin upon him, and whoever delays, then there is no sin upon him." Muhammad said: "Yahya added: 'And he took a companion rider to proclaim it
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mar se riwayat hai ke Najd waale kuch log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke wo Arafah mein the, unhon ne unse sawaal kiya, to unhon ne ek munaadi ko hukum diya, to usne pukaara: "Hajj Arafah hai. Jo Jam ki raat Fajr se pehle aa jaaye, usne Hajj paa liya. Mina ke din teen hain, jo do din mein jaldi kare, uspar koi gunaah nahi, aur jo der kare, uspar bhi koi gunaah nahi." Muhammad ne kaha: Yahya ne izafa kiya: "Aur unhon ne ek aadmi ko apni sawari par saath baithaya to usne pukaara."

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mar narrated:(Another chain) with a similar narration (as no)
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mar se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi mafhoom mein. Aur Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha: Sufyan bin Uyainah ne kaha: Ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki riwayat ki gayi sabse achi hadith hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mar ki hadith par ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek amal hai ke jo Fajr tulu hone se pehle Arafat mein khada na ho, uska Hajj chhoot gaya, aur agar wo Fajr tulu hone ke baad aaye to ye kaafi nahi hoga, to wo use Umrah bana le aur agle saal Hajj kare. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Shu'bah ne Bukair bin Ata se Ath-Thawri ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Al-Jarud ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko kehte suna, unhon ne is hadith ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Ye hadith Hajj ke maasil ki maa hai.

e: Urwah bin Mudarris bin Aws bin Harithah bin Lam At-Ta'i narrated:"I came to the Messenger of Allah at Al-Muzdalifah when he left for the Salat. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I came from the two mountains of (the tribe of) Tai, wearing out my mount and exhausting myself. By Allah! I did not leave a Habl (sand dune) without stopping on it. So is there Hajj for me?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever attends this Salat of ours, and stays here with us until departing, while he has stood during the night or the day before that at Arafat, then he has completed his Hajj and fulfilled his Tafath
hi: Urwah bin Mudarris bin Aws bin Harithah bin Lam At-Ta'i ne kaha: "Main Muzdalifah mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab wo namaz ke liye nikle, maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main Ta'i qabile ke do pahaadon se aaya hoon, maine apni sawari ko thaka diya aur khud ko bhi thaka diya, Allah ki qasam! Maine koi bhi teela chhoda nahi jispar main na theher gaya ho, to kya mera Hajj ho gaya?' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo humari is namaz mein haazir ho aur humare saath khada rahe yahan tak ke hum rawaana ho, aur usne isse pehle Arafah mein raat ya din mein qayaam kiya ho, to uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya aur uska tafath khatam ho gaya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unke qaul "tafath" ka matlab hai unki ibadat/rasm. Unke qaul "Maine koi bhi teela chhoda nahi jispar main na theher gaya ho" - jab wo ret ka ho to use "habl" kaha jaata hai, aur jab pathar ka ho to use "jabal" kaha jaata hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah sent me with the Thaqal (load of baggage) during the night from Jam
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Jam se raat ko saamaan ke saath bheja." Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Umm Habibah, Asma bint Abi Bakr, aur Al-Fadl bin Abbas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet advanced the weak among his family and he said: 'Do not stone the Jamrah until the sun has risen
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne apne kamzor ghar walon ko pehle bheja aur farmaya: "Jamrah ko sooraj nikalne se pehle na maaro." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is hadith par ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek amal hai, wo maante hain ke kamzor log Muzdalifah se raat ko hi Mina ki taraf pehle chale jaayen. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne Nabi (SAW) ki isi hadith se kaha ke wo sooraj nikalne se pehle rami na karen. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne raat ko rami karne ki rukhsat di. Aur Nabi (SAW) ki hadith par amal hai ke wo rami na karen. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith \"Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe saamaan mein bheja\" sahih hadith hai, kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Mushash se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se, Al-Fadl bin Abbas se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne apne kamzor ghar walon ko Jam se raat ko pehle bheja. Aur ye galat hadith hai, Mushash ne ismein galti ki aur Al-Fadl bin Abbas ka izafa kiya. Aur Ibn Juraij aur doosron ne ye hadith Ata se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki, aur unhon ne ismein Al-Fadl bin Abbas ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Mushash Basra ke rehne wale hain, Shu'bah ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Prophet would stone on the Day of An-Nahr during the morning light, as for (the days) afterwards, then (he would do it) after the Zenith of the sun
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Nahr ke din chaasht ke waqt rami karte the, aur uske baad sooraj dhalne ke baad." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Nahr ke din ke baad sooraj dhalne ke baad hi rami ki jaaye.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet departed before the rising of the sun
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) sooraj nikalne se pehle rawaana ho gaye. Aur is mauzu par Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Jahiliyyah ke log sooraj nikalne tak intezar karte the, phir rawaana hote the.

e: Amr bin Maimun narrated:"We were halted at Jama when Umar bin Al-Khattab said: 'The idolaters would not depart until the sun had risen and they would say: "Let the sun shine on Thabir" and indeed the Messenger of Allah contradicted them.' So Umar departed before the rising of the sun
hi: Amr bin Maimun ne kaha: "Hum Jam mein khade the, to Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: 'Mushrikeen sooraj nikalne tak rawaana nahi hote the, aur kehte the: Thabir pahaad chamak jaaye. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki mukhalafat ki.'" To Umar sooraj nikalne se pehle rawaana ho gaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"I saw the Messenger of Allah stoning the Jimar with what was similar to pebbles for Al-Khadhaf
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhoti kankariyon jaisi kankariyon se Jimar ki rami karte dekha." Aur is mauzu par Sulaiman bin Amr bin Al-Ahwas apni maa se, jo Umm Jundub Al-Azdiyyah hain, aur Ibn Abbas, Al-Fadl bin Abbas, Abdur-Rahman bin Uthman At-Taimi, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Mu'adh se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm isi ko chunte hain ke jin kankariyon se rami ki jaati hai wo chhoti kankariyon jaisi hon.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah stoned the Jimar when the sun had passed the zenith
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sooraj dhalne ke baad Jimar ki rami karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet stoned the Jamrah on the Day of An-Nahr while riding
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Nahr ke din sawaar hokar Jamrah ki rami ki. Aur is mauzu par Jabir, Qudamah bin Abdullah, aur Umm Sulaiman bin Amr bin Al-Ahwas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur kuch ne Jimar tak paidal jaana chuna. Aur Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo Jimar tak paidal jaate the. Aur is hadith ka humare nazdeek matlab ye hai ke unhon ne kisi din sawaari ki taake unki pairvi ki jaaye unke amal mein, aur donon hadithein ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek istemal hoti hain.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet would walk when stoning the Jimar, both going and returning
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab Jimar ki rami karte, to jaate aur wapas aate hue paidal chalte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne ise Ubaidullah se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo Nahr ke din sawaar ho, aur uske baad ke dinon mein paidal chale. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur jisne ye kaha, goya wo Nabi (SAW) ke amal ki pairvi karna chahta tha kyunki Nabi (SAW) se sirf itna riwayat hai ke wo Nahr ke din sawaar hue jab wo Jimar ki rami karne gaye, aur Nahr ke din sirf Jamrat-ul-Aqabah ki rami ki jaati hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid narrated:"When Abdullah went to stone Jamrat Al-Aqabah, he went to the middle of the valley, faced the Ka'bah, and proceeded to stone the Jamrah at its southern wall. Then he stoned with seven pebbles, saying: "Allahu Akbar" with each pebble. Then he said: 'By Allah except Whom none is worthy of worship. This is where the one stoned to whom Surat Al-Baqarah was revealed
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid ne kaha: "Jab Abdullah Jamrat-ul-Aqabah ke paas aaye, to wo wadi ke andar gaye aur Qibla ki taraf mun kiya, aur Jamrah ko apni dahini abru ki taraf rakh kar rami karne lage. Phir unhon ne saat kankariyaan maarin, har kankari ke saath Takbir kehte hue. Phir unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi maabood nahi, isi jagah se rami ki thi us Zaat ne jispar Surah Al-Baqarah nazil hui.'" Isi jaisi. Aur is mauzu par Al-Fadl bin Abbas, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo isi ko chunte hain ke aadmi wadi ke andar se saat kankariyon se rami kare, har kankari ke saath Takbir kehte hue. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne rukhsat di hai, agar wadi ke andar se rami mumkin na ho, to jahan se ho sake rami kare, chahe wadi ke andar na ho.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Stoning the Jimari and Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwah are only done for the establishment of Allah's remembrance
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jimar ki rami aur Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan Sa'i sirf Allah ka zikr qaayam rakhne ke liye rakhi gayi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Qudamah bin Abdullah said:"I saw the Prophet stoning the Jimar upon his she-camel; there was no hitting, nor crowding, nor: 'Look out! Look out
hi: Qudamah bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko apni oontni par Jimar ki rami karte dekha, na koi maarpeet thi na dhakka-mukki na 'Hato, hato' ki awaazein." Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Handhalah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Qudamah bin Abdullah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai, ye Aiman bin Nabil ki hadith hai, aur wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hain.

e: Jabir narrated:"We slaughtered with the Messenger of Allah during the year of Al-Hudaibiyah: a cow for seven, and a Badanah for seven
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Humne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiyah ke saal gaay saat aadmiyon ki taraf se aur oont saat aadmiyon ki taraf se zabah kiya." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, Aishah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke oont saat ki taraf se aur gaay saat ki taraf se hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke gaay saat ki taraf se aur oont das ki taraf se hai. Aur ye Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne isi hadith se dalil li. Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hum sirf ek hi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"We were with the Prophet on a journey (on the Day of) Adha, so seven of us shared in a cow, and ten for a camel
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath safar mein the. Adha aa gaya, to humne gaay mein saat aadmi aur oont mein das aadmi shareek kiye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Husain bin Waqid ki hadith hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet garlanded two sandals and marked the Hadi on the right side at Dhul-Hulaifah, and removed the blood from it
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne do joote garden mein daale aur Dhul-Hulaifah mein Hadi ko dahini taraf se ash'aar diya aur uska khoon saaf kiya. Aur is mauzu par Al-Miswar bin Makhramah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hassan Al-A'raj ka naam Muslim hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Ash'aar maante hain. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Yusuf bin Isa ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko is hadith ki riwayat ke waqt kehte suna: Is mauzu par ahl-e-raay ke qaul ko mat dekho, kyunki Ash'aar Sunnat hai, aur unka qaul bid'at hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur maine Abu As-Sa'ib ko kehte suna: Hum Waki ke paas the, to unhon ne apne paas baithe ek aise shakhs se jo raay dekhta tha, kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ash'aar kiya? Wo aadmi kehta hai: Aur Abu Hanifah kehte hain ye musla hai. Us aadmi ne kaha: Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Ash'aar musla hai. Unhon ne kaha: To maine Waki ko sakht gussa hote dekha, aur unhon ne kaha: Main tumse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki baat karta hoon, aur tum Ibrahim ke qaul ki baat karte ho, tumhein to isse zyada haqdaar hai ke tumhein qaid kar diya jaaye phir jab tak tum apne is qaul se peeche na hato tumhein na chhoda jaaye.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet purchased his Hadi in Qudaid
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne apna Hadi Qudaid se khareeda. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Ath-Thawri ki hadith se sirf Yahya bin Al-Yaman ki riwayat mein hi jaante hain. Aur Nafi se riwayat hai ke Ibn Umar ne apna Hadi Qudaid se khareeda. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I twisted the garlands for the Hadi of the Prophet, then he did not assume Ihram, nor did he avoid any clothing
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Hadi ke haar bune, phir unhon ne Ihraam nahi baandha aur na koi kapda chhoda." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Jab aadmi Hadi ko haar pehnaaye jabke wo Hajj ka irada rakhta ho, to uspar koi kapda ya khushbu haraam nahi hoti jab tak wo Ihraam na baandhe. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Jab aadmi apne Hadi ko haar pehnaaye, to uspar wahi farz ho jaata hai jo Muhrim par farz hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I twisted the garlands for all of the Hadi of the Messenger of Allah, which were sheep, then he did not assume Ihram
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Hadi ke haar buna karti thi, jo sab bakriyaan hoti thin, phir wo Ihraam nahi baandhte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo bakriyon ko haar pehnaana maante hain.

e: Najiyah Al-Khuza'i (the Companion of the Messenger of Allah) said:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What should be done with the afflicted among the Hadi?' He said: 'Slaughter them, then dip their sandals in their blood, then leave them so that the people can eat them
hi: Najiyah Al-Khuza'i, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke oonton ke saathi, ne kaha: "Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Oonton mein se jo kharaab ho jaaye, uska kya karoon? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Use zabah kar do, phir uske joote ko uske khoon mein doob de, phir logon aur uske darmiyan chhod do taake wo use khaayen.'" Aur is mauzu par Dhuwaib Abu Qabisah Al-Khuza'i se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Najiyah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Nafl Hadi mein agar wo kharaab ho jaaye, to na wo khaaye na uske saathiyon mein se koi, aur usse logon ke darmiyan chhod diya jaaye taake wo use khaayen, aur ye uski taraf se kaafi ho gaya. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unhon ne kaha: Agar usne usmein se kuch khaaya, to jitna khaaya uska tawaan de. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo Nafl Hadi mein se kuch khaaye, to jisne khaaya wo zimmedaar hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:That the Prophet saw a man driving his Badanah so he said to him: "Ride it." He said: "O Messenger of Allah! It is a Badanah." So on the third or fourth time he said to him: "Ride it. And woe to you
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko apna Badanah hankate dekha, to unhon ne unse farmaya: "Ispar sawaar ho jao." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Ye Badanah hai." Unhon ne teesri ya chauthi baar unse kaha: "Ispar sawaar ho jao, tumpar afsos!" Ya "Tumhein khaak mile!" Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Hurairah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, Badanah par sawaar hone ki rukhsat di hai jab uski peeth ki zaroorat ho. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo uspar sawaar na ho jab tak zaroorat na pade.

e: Anas bin Malik narrted:"When the Messenger of Allah stoned the Jamrah, he slaughtered his sacrifice, then he presented the barber the right side (of his head) and he shaved it, then he gave (the hair) to Abu Talhah. Then he presented the left side to him and he shaved it. Then he said: 'Divide it (the hair) among the people
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Jamrah ki rami ki, to unhon ne apni qurbani zabah ki, phir naai ko apni dahini taraf di, usne mundwa diya, phir unhon ne wo baal Abu Talhah ko de diye. Phir unhon ne unhen apni baayen taraf di, usne mundwa di, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ise logon mein baant do.'" Isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "May Allah have mercy upon those who shaved" saying it one or two times, then he said: "And those who shortened
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna sar mundwaaya, aur unke kuch Sahaba ne bhi mundwaaya, aur kuch ne baal katwaaye." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah baal mundwaane walon par reham kare' - ek ya do baar - phir farmaya: 'aur baal katwaane walon par bhi.'" Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Ibn Umm Al-Hussain, Marib, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Maryam, Hubshi bin Junadah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo aadmi ke liye apna sar mundwaana chunte hain, aur agar wo baal katwaaye, to wo maante hain ke ye kaafi hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ali narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prohibited that a woman should shave her head
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aurat apna sar mundwaaye."

e: (Another chain) with similar (as no. 914) from Khilas:But he did not mention "from Ali
hi: Khilas se, isi jaisi, siwaye is ke ke unhon ne ismein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith mein iztiraab hai. Aur ye hadith Hammad bin Salamah se, Qatadah se, Aishah se bhi riwayat hui hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aurat apna sar mundwaaye. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo aurat ke liye sar mundwaana nahi maante, aur wo maante hain ke uspar sirf baal katwaana hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated:"A man asked the Messenger of Allah: 'I shaved before slaughtering.' So he said: 'Slaughter, and there is no harm.' Another man asked him: 'I performed the sacrifice before stoning.' He said: 'Stone, and there is no harm
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha aur kaha: "Maine zabah karne se pehle hi baal mundwaa liye." Unhon ne farmaya: "Zabah karo, koi harj nahi." Aur ek doosre ne unse pucha aur kaha: "Maine rami se pehle hi zabah kar li." Unhon ne farmaya: "Rami karo, koi harj nahi." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Umar, aur Usamah bin Sharik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar usne ek rasm ko doosre se pehle kar liya, to uspar ek qurbani hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I put perfume with musk in it on the Messenger of Allah before he assumed Ihram, and on the Day of An-Nahr before he performed Tawaf around the House
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ihraam baandhne se pehle aur Nahr ke din Bait ka Tawaf karne se pehle mishk waali khushbu lagayi." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke Muhrim jab Nahr ke din Jamrat-ul-Aqabah ki rami kare, zabah kare, aur baal mundwaaye ya katwaaye, to uske liye har wo cheez halal ho jaati hai jo uspar haraam thi, siwaye auraton ke. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Uske liye sab kuch halal ho jaata hai siwaye auraton aur khushbu ke. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, isi ko apnaya hai, aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Al-Fadl bin Abbas narrated:"I was a companion rider with the Messenger of Allah from Jam to Mina. He did not cease saying the Talbiyah until stoning Jamrat Al-Aqabah
hi: Al-Fadl bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Jam se Mina tak apni sawari par saath baithaya, aur wo Talbiyah kehte rahe yahan tak ke unhon ne Jamrah ki rami ki." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Mas'ud, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Fadl ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Haji Talbiyah tab tak na chhode jab tak Jamrah ki rami na kare. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:(that the Prophet): "Would stop saying the Talbiyah during "Umrah when he touched the (Black) Stone
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se marfu' riwayat hai ke wo Umrah mein Hajr ko chhoote hi Talbiyah band kar dete the. Aur is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Mu'tamir Talbiyah tab tak na chhode jab tak Hajr ko chhoo na le. Aur kuch ne kaha: Jab wo Makkah ke gharon tak pahunche to Talbiyah band kar de. Aur amal Nabi (SAW) ki hadith par hai, aur isi ke Sufyan, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet delayed the visiting Tawaf until the night
hi: Ibn Abbas aur Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Tawaf-e-Ziyarat ko raat tak muakhkhar kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Tawaf-e-Ziyarat ko raat tak muakhkhar karne ki rukhsat di hai, aur kuch ne Nahr ke din hi ziyarat karna Mustahab samjha, aur kuch ne isse zyada gunjaish di, Mina ke aakhri dinon tak muakhkhar karna bhi.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman would camp at Al-Abtah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman Al-Abtah mein qayaam karte the." Aur is mauzu par Aishah, Abu Rafi, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith sahih hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdur-Razzaq ki, Ubaidullah bin Umar se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Al-Abtah mein qayaam karna Mustahab samjha hai, bagair isse wajib maane, siwaye jo khud pasand kare. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Al-Abtah mein qayaam karna ibadat mein se kuch nahi, ye to sirf ek jagah hai jahan Nabi (SAW) ne qayaam kiya tha.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"At-Tahsib is nothing, it is only a place that the Messenger of Allah camped at
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "At-Tahsib kuch nahi hai, ye to sirf ek jagah hai jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qayaam kiya tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: At-Tahsib ka matlab hai Al-Abtah mein qayaam karna. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah only camped at Al-Abtah because it was easier for his departure
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sirf Al-Abtah mein isliye qayaam karte the kyunki wo unke nikalne ke liye zyada aasan tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi jaisi riwayat.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"A woman held a boy of hers up for the Messenger of Allah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is there Hajj for this one' He said: 'Yes, and you will be rewarded
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Ek aurat ne apne bete ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne uthaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kya isse Hajj hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Haan, aur tumhein ajr milega.'" Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Jabir ki hadith ghareeb hai.

e: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid narrated:"My father took me for Hajj with the Messenger of Allah during the Farewell Hajj, and I was seven years old
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne mujhe Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hajj karwaaya, jabke main saat saal ka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: (Another chain) from Jabir bin Abdullah:From the Prophet, with similar (Hadith of Muhammad bin Tarif no)
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi, yani Muhammad bin Tarif ki hadith jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ittefaq hai ke agar bachcha baaligh hone se pehle Hajj kare, to baaligh hone ke baad uspar Hajj farz hai, wo Hajj Hajj-e-Islam ki jagah kaafi nahi hoga. Isi tarah ghulam bhi agar ghulami mein Hajj kare, phir azaad ho jaaye, to uspar Hajj farz hai agar wo raasta paaye, aur ghulami ki halat mein kiya gaya Hajj uski jagah kaafi nahi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"When we performed our Hajj with the Prophet we would say the Talbiyah for the women and we would stone for the boys
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: "Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajj karte the, to hum auraton ki taraf se Talbiyah kehte aur bachchon ki taraf se rami karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ittefaq hai ke aurat ki taraf se koi aur Talbiyah nahi kehta, balki wo khud apni taraf se Talbiyah kehti hai, aur uske liye buland awaaz se Talbiyah kehna napasand kiya jaata hai.

e: Al-Fadl bin Abbas narrated:"A woman from Khath'am said: 'O Messenger of Allah! My father has lived until Allah has made Hajj obligatory, and he is an elderly man who is not able to sit on the back of a camel.' So he (pbuh) said: 'Perform Hajj for him
hi: Al-Fadl bin Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mere waalid par Allah ka farz Hajj aa gaya hai, aur wo ek boodhe aadmi hain, oont ki peeth par seedhe baith nahi sakte." Unhon ne farmaya: "Unki taraf se Hajj karo." Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Buraidah, Husain bin Auf, Abu Razin Al-Uqaili, Saudah bint Zam'ah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Fadl bin Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Ibn Abbas se, Husain bin Auf Al-Muzani se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ye bhi Ibn Abbas se, Sinan bin Abdullah Al-Juhani se, apni phuphi se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai. Aur ye Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se in riwayaton ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez wo hai jo Ibn Abbas ne Al-Fadl bin Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur mumkin hai ke Ibn Abbas ne ise Al-Fadl aur doosron se, Nabi (SAW) se suna ho, phir isse Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya aur mursal riwayat ki aur jisse suna use zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur is mauzu mein Nabi (SAW) se ek se zyada hadith sahih hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain, wo maante hain ke marne wale ki taraf se Hajj kiya jaaye. Aur Malik ne kaha: Agar usne wasiyat ki ho ke uski taraf se Hajj kiya jaaye, to uski taraf se Hajj kiya jaaye. Aur kuch ne zinda ke liye bhi rukhsat di hai agar wo boodha ho ya aisi halat mein ho ke Hajj karne ki taaqat na rakhta ho. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated from his father who said:"A woman came to the Prophet and said: 'My mother died and she did not perform Hajj should I perform Hajj on her behalf?' He said: 'Yes, perform Hajj on her behalf
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aurat Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Meri maa intiqaal kar gayin aur unhon ne Hajj nahi kiya, kya main unki taraf se Hajj karoon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Haan, unki taraf se Hajj karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Razin Al-Uqaili narrated:That he went to the Prophet and said: "O Messenger of Allah! My father is an elderly man who is not able to perform Hajj nor Umrah nor undertake a journey.' He said: 'Perform Hajj on behalf of your father and perform Umrah
hi: Abu Razin Al-Uqaili (RA) se riwayat hai ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mere waalid ek boodhe aadmi hain, na Hajj kar sakte hain na Umrah, na safar." Unhon ne farmaya: "Apne waalid ki taraf se Hajj karo aur Umrah bhi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is hadith mein Umrah ka zikr sirf isliye hua ke Nabi (SAW) se ye maloom ho ke aadmi kisi doosre ki taraf se Umrah kar sakta hai. Aur Abu Razin Al-Uqaili ka naam Laqit bin Aamir hai.

e: Jabir narrated that:The Prophet was asked about whether Umrah was obligatory? He said: "No. But if you perform Umrah it is more virtuous
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: Kya Umrah wajib hai? Unhon ne farmaya: "Nahi, lekin agar tum Umrah karo to wo behtar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Umrah wajib nahi. Aur kaha jaata tha: Hajj do tarah ke hain, Hajj-e-Akbar Nahr ke din, aur Hajj-e-Asghar Umrah hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Umrah Sunnat hai, humein koi maloom nahi jisne isse chhodne ki rukhsat di ho, aur ismein koi mazboot cheez nahi hai ke ye nafl hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se ek isnad ke saath riwayat hui hai jo kamzor hai, aisi isnad se dalil nahi li jaati. Aur humein Ibn Abbas se maloom hua hai ke wo ise wajib maante the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye sab Ash-Shafi'i ka kalaam hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:That the Prophet said: "Umrah has been entered into Hajj until the Day of Resurrection
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umrah Qayamat ke din tak Hajj mein daakhil ho gayi hai." Aur is mauzu par Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju'shum aur Jabir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Aur is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah karne mein koi harj nahi. Isi tarah Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ne kaha. Aur is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke Jahiliyyah ke log Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah nahi karte the, jab Islam aaya to Nabi (SAW) ne isme rukhsat di aur farmaya: \"Umrah Qayamat ke din tak Hajj mein daakhil ho gayi hai,\" yani Hajj ke mahinon mein Umrah karne mein koi harj nahi. Aur Hajj ke mahine Shawwal, Dhul-Qa'dah, aur Dhul-Hijjah ke das din hain, aadmi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo Hajj ke mahinon ke siwa kisi aur waqt Hajj ka Ihraam baandhe. Aur Hurmat waale mahine Rajab, Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah, aur Muharram hain. Isi tarah kai ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Umrah to 'Umrah atones for the sins between them, and for A1-Hajj Al-Mabrur there is no reward except Paradise
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ek Umrah se doosre Umrah tak unke darmiyan ke gunaah maaf ho jaate hain, aur Hajj-e-Mabroor ka koi badla nahi siwaye Jannat ke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Amr bin Aws narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr:"The Prophet ordered Abdur-RAhman bin Abi Bakr to (accompany) Aishah to perform Umrah from At-Tan'im
hi: Amr bin Aws, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr ko hukum diya ke wo Aishah ko At-Tan'im se Umrah karwaayen. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Muharrish Al-Kabi narrated:"The Messenger of Allah left Al-Ji'irranah during the night for Umrah, then he entered Makkah during he night and performed his Umrah. Then he left there during the night, then he was in Al-Ji'irranah by the morning, as if he had spent the night. When the sun passed the zenith in the morning he left from the midst of Sarif until he came on a road from amidst Sarif. It is because of this that his Umrah was concealed from the people
hi: Muharrish Al-Ka'bi se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Al-Ji'irranah se raat ko Umrah ke liye nikle, Makkah mein raat ko daakhil hue aur apna Umrah poora kiya, phir usi raat wapas nikle aur subah Al-Ji'irranah mein aise the goya wahin raat guzari ho. Jab agle din sooraj dhal gaya, to wo Sarif ki wadi se nikle yahan tak ke Jam ke raaste par Sarif ki wadi mein pahunche, isi wajah se unka Umrah logon se chhupa raha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur hum Muharrish Al-Ka'bi ki, Nabi (SAW) se, is hadith ke siwaye koi doosri riwayat nahi jaante.

e: Urwah said:Ibn Umar was asked: In which month did the Messenger of Allah perform Umrah? He said: 'During Rajab.' So Aishah said: 'The Messenger of Allah did not perform Umrah except that he was with him - meaning Ibn Umar - and he did not ever perform Umrah in the month of Rajab
hi: Urwah ne kaha: "Ibn Umar se pucha gaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kis mahine mein Umrah kiya? Unhon ne kaha: Rajab mein." Aishah ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi Umrah nahi kiya magar wo" - yani Ibn Umar - "unke saath the, aur unhon ne kabhi Rajab ke mahine mein Umrah nahi kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Habib bin Abi Thabit ne Urwah bin Az-Zubair se suna nahi hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet performed Umrah four times, one of them was during Rajab
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne chaar baar Umrah kiya, unmein se ek Rajab mein tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Al-Bara narrated:"The Prophet performed Umrah during Dhul-Qa'dah
hi: Al-Bara (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Dhul-Qa'dah mein Umrah kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Umm Ma'qil narrated that:The Prophet said: "Umrah during Ramadan is equal to Hajj
hi: Umm Ma'qil se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ramzan mein Umrah, Hajj ke barabar hai." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Wahb bin Khanbash se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kaha jaata hai Haram bin Khanbash. Bayan aur Jabir ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Wahb bin Khanbash se riwayat ki. Aur Dawud Al-Awdi ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Haram bin Khanbash se riwayat ki. Aur Wahb zyada sahih hai. Aur Umm Ma'qil ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se saabit hai ke Ramzan mein Umrah Hajj ke barabar hai. Ishaq ne kaha: Is hadith ka matlab waisa hi hai jaisa Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Jo '(Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad)' padhe, usne goya Quran ka tihaai hissa padh liya.\"

e: Ikrimah narrated from Al-Hajjaj bin Amr who narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever suffers a fracture or becomes lame them he (leaves the state of Ihram) and is required to perform another Hajj." I (Ikrimah) mentioned that to Abu Hurairah and Ibn Abbas and they said: "He told the truth
hi: Ikrimah, Al-Hajjaj bin Amr se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tootey ya langda ho jaaye, to wo Halal ho jaata hai, aur uspar doosra Hajj hai." Maine ye baat Abu Hurairah aur Ibn Abbas ko bataayi, to unhon ne kaha: "Usne sach kaha." Isi jaisi riwayat. Unhon ne kaha: "Aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Isi tarah kai logon ne Hajjaj As-Sawwaf se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Ma'mar aur Muawiyah bin Sallam ne ye hadith Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Ikrimah se, Abdullah bin Rafi se, Al-Hajjaj bin Amr se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Hajjaj As-Sawwaf ne apni hadith mein Abdullah bin Rafi ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Hajjaj ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hafiz hain. Aur maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Ma'mar aur Muawiyah bin Sallam ki riwayat zyada sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"Duba'ah bint Az-Zubair came to the prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I want to perform Hajj so should I state a condition?' He said: 'Yes.' She asked: 'So how should I say it?' He said: 'Say; "Labbaik Allahumma labbaika mahilli minal Ard haithu tahbisuni (I respond to Your call O Allah, I respond to Your call, I will exit Ihram any where on the earth where You prevent me)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Dhuba'ah bint Az-Zubair Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Main Hajj karna chahti hoon, kya main shart lagaaoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhon ne kaha: "Kaise kahoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik, Mahilli Minal-Ardi Haithu Tahbisuni' (Main haazir hoon, Ya Allah, main haazir hoon, main haazir hoon, meri Halal hone ki jagah zameen mein wahi hai jahan Tu mujhe roke)." Aur is mauzu par Jabir, Asma bint Abi Bakr, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Hajj mein shart lagaana maante hain, aur kehte hain: Agar usne shart lagaayi aur beemari ya uzr aa gaya, to usse Halal hone aur apne Ihraam se nikalne ka haq hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Hajj mein shart lagaana nahi maana aur kaha: Agar usne shart lagaayi, to usse apne Ihraam se nikalne ka haq nahi, aur wo use aisa hi maante hain jaise usne shart na lagaayi ho.

e: Salim narrated that :His father disliked making a condition during Hajj and he said: 'Is not the Sunnah of your Prophet enough for you?
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke wo Hajj mein shart lagaane ko napasand karte the aur kehte the: "Kya tumhare liye tumhare Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat kaafi nahi?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"It was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah that Safiyyah bint Huyai got her menses during the days of Mina, so he said: "Will she prevent us (from departing)?" They said: "She has done (Tawaf) Al-Ifadah/" So the Messenger of Allah said: "In that case there is no harm
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr kiya ke Safiyyah bint Huyai ko Mina ke dinon mein haiz aa gayi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya wo humein rok legi?" Unhon ne kaha: "Wo Tawaf-e-Ifadah kar chuki hain." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "To phir koi harj nahi." Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar aurat Tawaf-e-Ziyarat kar le, phir usse haiz aa jaaye, to wo rawaana ho jaaye, uspar kuch nahi. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar said:"Whoever performs Hajj to the House, then let the last of their acts be at the House, except for menstruating women. The Messenger of Allah gave them permission (to leave)." (Sahih Mawquf)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Jo Bait ka Hajj kare, to uska aakhri kaam Bait ke saath hi ho, siwaye haiz waali auraton ke. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen rukhsat di." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Ibn Umar said:"Whoever performs Hajj to the House, then let the last of their acts be at the House, except for menstruating women. The Messenger of Allah gave them permission (to leave)." (Sahih Mawquf)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Jo Bait ka Hajj kare, to uska aakhri kaam Bait ke saath hi ho, siwaye haiz waali auraton ke. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen rukhsat di." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Al-Harith bin Abdullah bin Aws said:"I heard the Prophet saying: 'Whoever performs Hajj to this House, or Umrah, then let the last of his acts be at the House'" So Umar said: "May your hand be humiliated! You heard this from the Messenger of Allah but did not inform us of it?
hi: Al-Harith bin Abdullah bin Aws ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo is Bait ka Hajj ya Umrah kare, to uska aakhri kaam Bait ke saath hi ho.'" To Umar ne unse kaha: "Tumhare haath ruswaa hon, tumne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunaa aur humein na bataaya?" Aur is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Harith bin Abdullah bin Aws ki hadith ghareeb hai. Isi tarah kai logon ne Hajjaj bin Artaah se isi jaisi riwayat ki, aur Hajjaj se is isnad ke kuch hisse mein ikhtilaaf hua hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Messenger of Allah performed Qaran for Hajj and Umrah, so he performed one Tawaf for both of them
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umrah ko Qiran kiya, to unhon ne dono ke liye ek hi Tawaf kiya. Aur is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Qaarin ek hi Tawaf karta hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne kaha: Wo do Tawaf kare aur do Sa'i kare. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever assumes Ihram for Hajj and Umrah, then it is acceptable for him to perform one Tawaf and one Sa'I for them both, until he exits Ihram for both of them together
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Hajj aur Umrah ka Ihraam baandhe, to uske liye ek Tawaf aur ek Sa'i dono ke liye kaafi hai, yahan tak ke wo dono se Halal ho jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, isi lafz mein Ad-Darawardi akele hain. Aur kai logon ne ise Ubaidullah bin Umar se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya, aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami narrated :(that the Prophet said): "The Muhajir may stay for three (days) in Makkah after carrying out his rites
hi: Al-Ala bin Al-Hadrami se marfu' riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Muhajir apne rasm poore karne ke baad Makkah mein teen din reh sakta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi isi isnad ke saath marfu' riwayat hui hai.

e: Ibn Umar said:"When the Prophet would come home from a battle, or Hajj, or Umrah, when he was it a tract of land or raised area he would say 'Allahu Akbar (Allah is Most Great)' three times, then say: 'La Ilaha illallah Wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-Hamdu wa Huwa ala kulli shai'in qadir. A'ibuna ta'ibun abidun saa'ihuna li Rabbina Hamiduna, Sadaqallahu wa'dahu wa nasara abdahu wa hazamal-ahzab Wahdah. (None has the right to be worshiped but Allah Alone without partners. To Him belongs the sovereignty and to Him belongs the praise, and He has power over all things. We are returning, repenting, worshipping, traveling for our Lord, and we are praising. Allah has told the truth, and kept His promise and helped His worshipper, and routed the confederates, Alone)
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) jab kisi ghazwe, Hajj, ya Umrah se laut kar aate, aur zameen ki koi buland jagah ya oonchai par chadhte, to teen baar Takbir kehte, phir kehte: 'La Ilaha Illallahu Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu, Lahul-Mulku wa Lahul-Hamdu wa Huwa Ala Kulli Shai'in Qadir. Aayiboona Taaiboona Aabidoona Saaihoona Li-Rabbina Haamidoon. Sadaqallahu Wa'dahu wa Nasara Abdahu wa Hazamal-Ahzaaba Wahdah.'" Aur is mauzu par Al-Bara, Anas, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"We were with the Messenger of Allah on a journey when he saw a man fall from his camel, his neck was broken and he died, and he was a Muhrim. So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Wash him with water and Sidr, and shroud him in his garments, and do not cover his head. For indeed he will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment saying the Talbiyah
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, unhon ne ek aadmi ko apne oont se gir kar dekha, uski gardan toot gayi aur wo mar gaya jabke wo Muhrim tha. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Use paani aur beri ke patton se ghusl do, aur use uske do kapdon mein kafan do, aur uska sar na dhaankna, kyunki wo Qayamat ke din Talbiyah kehte hue uthaya jaayega.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Jab Muhrim mar jaaye, to uska Ihraam khatam ho jaata hai aur uske saath waisa hi kiya jaata hai jaisa ghair-Muhrim ke saath kiya jaata hai.

e: Nubaih bin Wahb narrated that :Umar bin Ubaidullah bin Ma'mar was complaining about his eyes while he was a Muhrim. He asked Aban bin Uthman about it and he said: "Bandage it with some aloes, for I heard Uthman bin Affan mentioning that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Bandage it with aloes
hi: Nubaih bin Wahb se riwayat hai ke Umar bin Ubaidullah bin Ma'mar ki aankhon mein takleef thi jabke wo Muhrim the, unhon ne Aban bin Uthman se pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Ispar sabar ka lep lagao, kyunki maine Uthman bin Affan ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat karte suna, unhon ne farmaya: 'Ispar sabar ka lep lagao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Muhrim ke liye koi bhi dawa istemal karne mein koi harj nahi maante jab tak usmein khushbu na ho.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Laila narrated from Ka'b bin Ujrah that:The Prophet passed by him while he was at Al-Hudaibiyah, before entering Makkah, and he was a Muhrim. He had lit a fire under a cooking pot and lice were falling all over his face. So he (the Prophet) said: "Have these lice of yours troubled you?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Shave and feed six of the poor with a Faraq" and a Faraq is three Sa - "or fast three days, or slaughter a sacrifice." Ibn Abi Najih (one of the narrators) said: "Or slaughter a sheep
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila, Ka'b bin Ujrah se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke wo Hudaibiyah mein the, Makkah mein daakhil hone se pehle, aur wo Muhrim the, wo ek deg ke neeche aag jala rahe the aur jooein unke chehre par gir rahi thin. To unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein ye jooein takleef de rahi hain?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." Unhon ne farmaya: "Baal mundwaa lo aur chhe miskeenon ko ek faraq khilaao" - aur faraq teen saa ka hota hai - "ya teen din roza rakho, ya ek qurbani zabah karo." Ibn Abi Najih ne kaha: "Ya ek bakri zabah karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar Muhrim apna sar mundwaaye, ya aisa kapda pehne jo Ihraam mein pehnana uske liye jaayez na ho, ya khushbu lagaaye, to uspar kaffara hai jaisa Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai.

e: Abi Al-Baddah bin Adi narrated from his father:"The Prophet permitted the shepherds to stone a day and leave a day
hi: Abi Al-Baddah bin Aasim bin Adiyy apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne charwahon ko rukhsat di ke wo ek din rami karen aur ek din chhod den. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Ibn Uyainah ne riwayat ki. Aur Malik bin Anas ne Abdullah bin Abi Bakr se, apne walid se, Abi Al-Baddah bin Aasim bin Adiyy se, apne walid se riwayat ki. Aur Malik ki riwayat zyada sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne charwahon ko rukhsat di ke wo ek din rami karen aur ek din chhod den, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abi Al-Baddah bin Asim bin Adi narrated from his father:"The Messenger of Allah permitted the camel herders who were in the camp (at Mina) to stone on the Day of An-Nahr then to gather the stoning of two days after the Day of An-Nahr, so that they stoned them during one of them." Malik said: "I think that he said about the first of them: 'They they should stone on the day of departure
hi: Abi Al-Baddah bin Aasim bin Adiyy apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne oonton ke charwahon ko, jo waheen raat guzaarte the, rukhsat di ke wo Nahr ke din rami karen, phir Nahr ke baad ke do dinon ki rami ikattha kar len aur unmein se ek din mein rami kar len." Malik ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai unhon ne kaha pehle din mein, phir wo Nafar ke din rami karen." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Ibn Uyainah ki, Abdullah bin Abi Bakr se riwayat se zyada sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"When Ali returned to the Messenger of Allah from Yemen he said: 'For what did you intended the Talbiyah?' He replied: 'I intended the Talbiyah for what the Messenger of Allah announced it.' So he (pbuh) said: 'If I did not have the Hadi with me then I would exit Ihram
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) Yaman se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, to unhon ne pucha: "Tumne kis niyat se Talbiyah kaha?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine wahi niyat ki jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ki." Unhon ne farmaya: "Agar mere paas Hadi na hota, to main Halal ho jaata." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ali narrated:"I asked the Messenger of Allah about the day of Al-Hajj Al-Akbar and he said: 'They Day of An-Nahr
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Hajj-e-Akbar ke din ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahr ka din.'"

e: Ali narrated:"They day of Al-Hajj Al-Akbar is the Day of An-Nahr
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Hajj-e-Akbar ka din Nahr ka din hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur unhon ne ise marfu' nahi kiya, aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih hai, aur Ibn Uyainah ki mauqoof riwayat, Muhammad bin Ishaq ki marfu' riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Isi tarah kai hafiz muhaddiseen ne Abu Ishaq se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se mauqoof riwayat ki hai. Aur Shu'bah ne Abu Ishaq se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha "Abdullah bin Murrah se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se" mauqoof.

e: Ibn Ubaid bin Umair narrated from his father:"Ibn Umar was clinging on the two corners (in a manner that I had not seen any of the Companions of the Prophet doing) so I said: 'O Abu Abdur-Rahman! You are clinging on the two corners in a manner that I have not seen any of the Companions of the Prophet clining.' So he said: 'I do it because I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Touching them atones for sins." And I heard him saying: "Whoever performs Tawaf around this House seven times and he keeps track of it, then it is as if he freed a slave." And I heard him saying: "One foot is not put down, nor another raised except that Allah removes a sin from him and records a good merit for him
hi: Ibn Ubaid bin Umair apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Ibn Umar do rukn par itni bheed karte the jitni maine Nabi (SAW) ke kisi Sahabi ko karte nahi dekha. Maine kaha: "Ae Abu Abdur-Rahman! Aap do rukn par itni bheed karte hain jitni maine Nabi (SAW) ke kisi Sahabi ko karte nahi dekha." Unhon ne kaha: "Main isliye karta hoon kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Inhen chhoona gunahon ka kaffara hai.' Aur maine unhen kehte suna: 'Jo is Bait ka saat chakkar Tawaf kare aur ise gin le, ye ek gulam azaad karne jaisa hai.' Aur maine unhen kehte suna: 'Wo koi kadam nahi rakhta aur na uthaata magar Allah usse ek gunaah mita deta hai aur uske liye ek neki likh deta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Hammad bin Zaid ne Ata bin As-Saib se, Ibn Ubaid bin Umair se, Ibn Umar se isi jaisi riwayat ki, aur usmein apne walid ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said: "Tawaf around the House is similar to Salat except that you talk during it. So whoever talks in it, then let him not say but good
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bait ke gird Tawaf namaz jaisa hai, siwaye is ke ke tum ismein baat kar sakte ho, to jo isme baat kare, wo sirf achi baat kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Tawus aur doosron se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur hum ise marfu' sirf Ata bin As-Saib ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Mustahab samajhte hain ke aadmi Tawaf mein sirf zaroorat ke waqt ya Allah ke zikr ke liye ya ilm ki baat ke liye baat kare.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said about the (Black) Stone: "By Allah! Allah will raise it on the Day of Resurrection with two eyes by which it sees and a tongue that it speaks with, testifying to whoever touched it in truth
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajr ke baare mein farmaya: "Allah ki qasam! Allah ise Qayamat ke din is haal mein uthaayega ke uski do aankhein hongi jinse wo dekhega, aur ek zabaan hogi jisse wo bolega, gawaahi dega us shakhs ke haq mein jisne ise sachai se chhua."

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet would apply oil that is not scented (Ghair Muqattat) while he was a Muhrim
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Ihraam mein tel lagaate the, lekin khushbudaar tel nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Muqattat ka matlab hai khushbudaar. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Farqad As-Sabakhi ki, Sa'eed bin Jubair se riwayat ke siwaye nahi jaante. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ne Farqad As-Sabakhi ke baare mein baat ki hai, aur logon ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Hisham bin Urwah narrated :from his father about Aishah, that she would carry some Zamzam water, and she would say: "Indeed the Messenger of Allah would carry it
hi: Hisham bin Urwah apne walid se, Aishah se riwayat karte hain ke wo Zamzam ka paani le jaati thin aur bataati thin ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bhi ise le jaate the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Abdul-Aziz bin Rufai narrated:"I said to Anas bin Malik: 'Narrated something to me that you understand about where the Messenger of Allah performed Zuhr on the Day of Tarwiyah.' He said: 'In Mina.'" "I said: 'So where did he pray Asr on the day of departure?' He said: 'In Al-Abtab.' Then he said: 'Do what your leaders do
hi: Abdul-Aziz bin Rufai ne kaha: "Maine Anas bin Malik se kaha: 'Mujhe koi aisi baat bataiye jo aapko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se yaad ho, Tarwiyah ke din unhon ne Zuhr kahan padhi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Mina mein.'" Maine kaha: "To Nafar ke din unhon ne Asr kahan padhi?" Unhon ne kaha: "Al-Abtah mein." Phir unhon ne kaha: "Waisa hi karo jaisa tumhare ameer karte hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, Ishaq bin Yusuf Al-Azraq ki, Ath-Thawri se riwayat mein ghareeb samjha jaata hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The believer is not afflicted by the prick of a thorn or what is worse (or greater) than that, except that by it Allah raises him in rank and removes sin from him
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ko koi kaanta ya usse zyada koi cheez nahi lagti magar Allah usse ek darja buland karta hai aur ek khataa mita deta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah, Abu Hurairah, Abu Umamah, Abu Sa'eed, Anas, Abdullah bin Amr, Asad bin Kurz, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar, aur Abu Musa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Nothing afflicts the believer, whether fatigue, grief, disease - even a worry that concerns him - except that by it, Allah removes something from his bad deeds
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ko koi thakan, gham, ya bimaari nahi lagti, yahan tak ke koi fikr jo use pareshan kare, magar Allah usse uski buraaiyan mita deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye is mauzu mein hasan hadith hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Al-Jarud ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko kehte suna: Fikr ke baare mein isse kaffara hone ka koi zikr nahi suna gaya siwaye is hadith mein. Unhon ne kaha: Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Ata bin Yasar se, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Thawban narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed the Muslim remains in the Khurfah (harvest) of Paradise while he visits his brother Muslim
hi: Thawban (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Musalman apne Musalman bhai ki mizaajpursi karta hai, to wo Jannat ke bagichon mein rehta hai." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Musa, Al-Bara, Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Thawban ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Ghifar aur Aasim Al-Ahwal ne ye hadith Abu Qilabah se, Abu Al-Ash'ath se, Abu Asma se, Thawban se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Jisne ye hadith Abu Al-Ash'ath se, Abu Asma se riwayat ki, wo zyada sahih hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Abu Qilabah ki hadithein, Abu Asma se hi hain, siwaye is hadith ke, jo mere nazdeek Abu Al-Ash'ath se, Abu Asma se hai.

e: (Another chain) from Thawban who narrated that:The Prophet said similarly, but he added in it: "They said: 'What is the Khurfah of Paradise?' And he said: "Its harvest
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Thawban se, isi jaisi, aur usmein izafa kiya: pucha gaya: "Jannat ka bagicha kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Uski fasal." (Doosri sanad se) Thawban se, Nabi (SAW) se, Khalid ki hadith jaisi, aur usmein Abu Al-Ash'ath ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch logon ne ise Hammad bin Zaid se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Thuwair [and he is Ibn Abi Fakhitah] narrated that :His father said: "Ali took me by the hand and said: 'Come with us to pay a visit to Al-Hasan.' So we found that Abu Musa was with him.' Ali - peace be upon him - said: 'O Abu Musa! Did you come to visit (the sick) or merely (stop by to) visit?' He said: 'No, to visit (the sick).' So Ali said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "No Muslim visits (the sick) Muslims in the morning, except that sevety-thousand angels, sent Salat upon him until the evening, and he does not visit at night except that seventy thousand angels sent Salat upon him until the morning, and there will be a garden for him in Paradise
hi: Thuwair (jo Ibn Abi Fakhitah hain) apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne mera haath pakda aur kaha: 'Chalo humare saath Al-Hasan ki mizaajpursi ke liye.' To humne unke paas Abu Musa ko paaya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: 'Kya aap mizaajpursi ke liye aaye hain, Ae Abu Musa, ya sirf milne?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Nahi, mizaajpursi ke liye.'" To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo Musalman kisi Musalman ki subah mizaajpursi kare, to shaam tak sattar hazaar Farishte uspar rehmat ki dua karte hain, aur agar wo shaam ko mizaajpursi kare, to subah tak sattar hazaar Farishte uspar rehmat ki dua karte hain, aur uske liye Jannat mein ek bagheecha hoga.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye hadith Ali (Alayhis Salam) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai, unmein se kuch ne ise mauqoof rakha aur marfu' nahi kiya. Aur Abu Fakhitah ka naam Sa'eed bin Alaqah hai.

e: Harithah bin Mudarrib said:"I entered upon Khabab and he had been cauterized on his stomach. He said: 'I do not know any of the Companions of the Prophet who met with the trial I have met with. Indeed I could not find a Dirham during the time of the Prophet, and (now) outside my house there are forty thousand. If it were not that the Messenger of Allah forbade us' - or: 'forbade' - 'from wishing for death, then I would wish for it
hi: Harithah bin Mudarrib ne kaha: "Main Khabbab ke paas gaya, unke pet mein daagh lagaya gaya tha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke kisi Sahabi ka pata nahi jisne mujh jaisi museebat jhelli ho. Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein main ek dirham bhi nahi rakhta tha, aur ab mere ghar ke ek konay mein chalis hazaar hai. Aur agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein maut ki tamanna karne se mana na kiya hota - ya mana kiya - to main isse maut ki tamanna karta.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Abu Hurairah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Khabbab ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Anas bin Malik se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: \"Tum mein se koi apni takleef ki wajah se maut ki tamanna na kare, balki kahe: Ya Allah! Mujhe zinda rakh jab tak zindagi mere liye behtar hai, aur mujhe maut de jab maut mere liye behtar hai.\"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that:The Prophet said that (a Hadith similar to no)
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne isi jaisi baat kahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that:Jibril came to the Prophet and said: "O Muhammad! Are you suffering?" He said: "Yes." He said: "In the Name of Allah, I recite a prayer (Ruqyah) over you, from the evil of every person and evil eye. In the Name of Allah I recite a prayer (Ruqyah) over you, may Allah cure you
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Jibril Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ae Muhammad! Kya aap bimaar hain?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke naam se main aapko har us cheez se dam karta hoon jo aapko takleef de, har jaan ki buraai se aur hasad karne wali nazar se, Allah ke naam se main aapko dam karta hoon, aur Allah aapko shifa de."

e: Abdul-Aziz bin Suhaib said:"Thabit Al-Bunani and I entered upon Anas bin Malik, and Thabit said: 'O Abu Hamzah! I am suffering from an illness. So Anas said: 'Shall I not recite the Ruqyah of the Messenger of Allah over you?' He said: 'Why, yes.' He said: 'O Allah! Lord of mankind, removed the harm, and cure (him). Indeed You are the One Who cures, there is none who cures except you, a cure that leaves no disease
hi: Abdul-Aziz bin Suhaib ne kaha: "Main aur Thabit Al-Bunani, Anas bin Malik ke paas gaye, Thabit ne kaha: 'Ae Abu Hamzah! Mujhe takleef hai.' Anas ne kaha: 'Kya main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke dam se dam na karoon?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Kyun nahi.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Allahumma Rabban-Nasi Mudhhibal-Ba'si Ishfi Antash-Shafi, La Shafiya Illa Anta, Shifaan La Yughaadiru Saqama" (Ya Allah! Logon ke Rab, takleef door karne wale, shifa de, Tu hi shifa dene wala hai, Tere siwa koi shifa dene wala nahi, aisi shifa jo koi bimaari na chhode)." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Maine Abu Zur'ah se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, maine unse kaha: Abdul-Aziz ki, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'eed se riwayat zyada sahih hai ya Abdul-Aziz ki, Anas se hadith? Unhon ne kaha: Donon sahih hain. Aur Abdus-Samad bin Abdul-Warith ne apne waalid se, Abdul-Aziz bin Suhaib se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'eed se, aur Abdul-Aziz bin Suhaib se, Anas se riwayat ki.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "A Muslim man has no right to spend two nights while he has something to will, except while his will is recorded with him
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman aadmi ka haq nahi ke wo do raatein guzare jabke uske paas koi aisi cheez ho jiske liye wasiyat karni ho, magar uski wasiyat uske paas likhi hui ho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sa'd bin Malik said:"The Messenger of Allah came to visit me while I was sick. He said: 'Do you have a will?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'For how much?' I said: 'All of my wealth, for the cause of Allah.' He said: 'What did you leave for your children?'" He (Sa'd) said: "They are rich in goodness.' He said: 'Will a tenth.'" He (Sa'd) said: "He (pbuh) continued decreasing it until he said: 'Will a third, and a third is too great.'" (One of the narrators:) Abdur-Rahman said: "We considered it recommended that it be less than a third, since the Messenger of Allah said: 'And a third is too great
hi: Sa'd bin Malik ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri mizaajpursi ke liye aaye jabke main bimaar tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tumne wasiyat ki?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kitni?' Maine kaha: 'Mera sara maal Allah ki raah mein.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Phir tumne apni aulad ke liye kya chhoda?' Maine kaha: 'Wo achi tarah maal daar hain.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Das-waan hissa wasiyat karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Phir main isse kam karta raha yahan tak ke unhon ne farmaya: 'Tihaai wasiyat karo, aur tihaai bhi bahut hai.'" Abu Abdur-Rahman ne kaha: Aur hum pasand karte hain ke tihaai se kam kiya jaaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul \"Aur tihaai bhi bahut hai\" ki wajah se. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sa'd ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye kai tareeqon se riwayat hui hai, aur kabhi \"Aur tihaai bada hai\" bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke aadmi tihaai se zyada wasiyat na kare, aur wo pasand karte hain ke tihaai se kam ho. Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Log wasiyat mein paanchwan hissa chautahai se kam, aur chautahai tihaai se kam pasand karte the, aur jisne tihaai ki wasiyat ki usne kuch nahi chhoda, aur uske liye sirf tihaai hi jaayez hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:The Prophet said: "Instruct your dying to say: (La illaha illallah) 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne marne walon ko 'La Ilaha Illallah' sikhaao." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Umm Salamah, Aishah, Jabir, aur Su'da Al-Murriyyah (jo Talhah bin Ubaidullah ki biwi hain) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Umm Salamah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said to us: 'When you attend to the sick or dying then say only good, for indeed the angels say "Amin" to what you say.'" She said: "When Abu Salamah died I went to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Abu Salamah has died.' He said: 'Then say: "O Allah forgive me and him, and give me a good replacement for him." She said: "I said tat, and Allah gave a replace that was better than him: The Messenger of Allah
hi: Umm Salamah ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse farmaya: 'Jab tum bimaar ya marne wale ke paas jaao, to achi baat kaho, kyunki Farishte tumhari baaton par 'Ameen' kehte hain.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Jab Abu Salamah ka intiqaal hua, to main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Abu Salamah ka intiqaal ho gaya.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To kaho: Allahumma Ighfir Li wa Lahu wa A'qibni Minhu Uqba Hasanah' (Ya Allah! Mujhe aur unhen maaf kar, aur mujhe unke badle mein achha badla de)." Unhon ne kaha: "Maine wo kaha, to Allah ne mujhe unse behtar badla diya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Shaqiq, Ibn Salamah Abu Wa'il Al-Asadi hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Salamah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Mustahab tha ke marne wale ko maut ke waqt 'La Ilaha Illallah' sikhaya jaaye. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar usne ek baar kaha, to jab tak wo uske baad kuch aur na kahe, use dobara sikhaana theek nahi, aur ismein usse zyada nahi karna chahiye. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai ke jab unhen maut aayi, to ek aadmi unhen 'La Ilaha Illallah' baar baar sikhaane laga, to Abdullah ne unse kaha: \"Jab maine ek baar kaha, to main usi par hoon jab tak main kuch aur na kahoon.\" Aur Abdullah ke qaul ka matlab ye tha ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya, unhon ne farmaya: \"Jiski aakhri baat 'La Ilaha Illallah' ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.\"

e: Aishah narrated:"I saw the Messenger of Allah while he was dying. He had a cup with water in it, he put his hand in the cup then wiped his face with the water, then said: 'O Allah! Help me with the throes of death and the agony of death
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha jabke wo maut ke qareeb the, unke paas paani ka ek pyala tha, wo apna haath usmein daalte, phir apna chehra paani se poonchhte, phir kehte: 'Allahumma A'inni Ala Ghamaraatil-Maut' (Ya Allah! Maut ki sakhtiyon mein meri madad kar), ya 'Sakaraatil-Maut'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I was not envious of anyone whose death was easy after I saw the severity the death of the Messenger of Allah
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine kisi ki bhi aasaan maut par rashk nahi kiya, us sakhti ke baad jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maut mein dekhi."

e: Alqamah narrated:"I heard Abdullah saying: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "The believer's soul seeps out, and I do not like the death like that of a donkey." They said: "And what is the death of a donkey?" He said: "A sudden death
hi: Alqamah ne kaha: "Maine Abdullah ko kehte suna: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Momin ki jaan pasine ke saath nikalti hai, aur mujhe gadhe jaisi maut pasand nahi.' Pucha gaya: 'Gadhe ki maut kya hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Achaanak maut.'"

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "There is nothing that the two Guardian Angels raise to Allah that they have preserved in a day or night, and Allah finds good in the beginning of the scroll and in the end of the scroll, except that Allah Most High says: 'Bear witness that I have forgiven my servant for what is included in the scroll
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do hifazat karne wale Farishte Allah ke paas wo cheez le jaate hain jo unhon ne raat ya din mein mehfooz ki hoti hai, agar Allah safhe ke shuru mein aur safhe ke aakhir mein neki paaye, to Allah Ta'ala farmaata hai: 'Main tumhein gawaah banaata hoon ke maine apne bande ke safhe ke donon sirre ke darmiyan sab kuch maaf kar diya.'"

e: Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated from his father, that:The Prophet said: "The believer dies with sweat on his brow
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin apni peshaani par pasina lekar marta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Humein maloom nahi ke Qatadah ne Abdullah bin Buraidah se suna hai.

e: Thabit narrated from Anas, that:The Prophet entered upon a young man while he was dying. So he said: "How do you feel?" He said: "By Allah! O Messenger of Allah! Indeed I hope in Allah and I fear from my sins." So the Messenger of Allah said: "These two will not be gathered in a worshipper's heart at a time such as this, except that Allah will grant him what he hopes and make him safe from what he fears
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ek naujawan ke paas gaye jabke wo maut ke qareeb tha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Tum apne aap ko kaisa paate ho?" Usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhe Allah se ummeed hai aur apne gunahon se dar hai." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ye donon kisi bande ke dil mein aise mauqe par ikattha nahi hote magar Allah use wo deta hai jiski wo ummeed rakhta hai, aur use us cheez se mehfooz rakhta hai jiska wo darta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Thabit se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Beware of An-Na'i, for indeed announcing one's death is from the deeds of Jahliyyah
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "An-Na'i se bacho, kyunki An-Na'i Jahiliyyah ke kaam mein se hai." Abdullah ne kaha: An-Na'i ka matlab hai marne wale ki khabar dena. Is mauzu par Hudhaifah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: (Another chain) from Abdullah :(from the Prophet) similar (to no. 984), but he did not narrate it in Marfu form, and he did not mention in it: "An-Na'i is announcing of one's death
hi: (Doosri sanad se) Abdullah se, isi jaisi, marfu' nahi kiya, aur usmein "An-Na'i marne wale ki khabar dena hai" ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye Anbasah ki, Abu Hamzah se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Aur Abu Hamzah Maimoon Al-A'war hain, aur wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek mazboot nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne An-Na'i ko napasand kiya, unke nazdeek An-Na'i ye hai ke logon mein pukaara jaaye ke fulaan mar gaya taake wo uske janaze mein shaamil hon.
