Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Apne rishtedaaron aur bhaaiyon ko bataane mein koi harj nahi. Aur Ibrahim se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Aadmi apne rishtedaaron ko bataaye, ismein koi harj nahi.

e: Bilal bin Yahya Al-Absiy narrated that:Hudaifah (bin Al-Yaman) said: "When I do not announce about me to anyone, indeed I fear that it would be An-Na'i, and I heard the Messenger of Allah prohibiting from An-Na'i
hi: Bilal bin Yahya Al-Absi se riwayat hai ke Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman ne kaha: "Jab main maroon, to mere baare mein kisi ko na bataana, mujhe darr hai ke ye An-Na'i ho jaaye, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko An-Na'i se mana karte suna." Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Anas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "(Real) Patience is at the first stroke of the calamity
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabr pehli chot mein hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that:The Messenger of Alllah said: "(Real) Patience is at the first stroke of the calamity
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabr pehli chot ke waqt hota hai." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad narrated from Aishah:"The Prophet kissed Uthman bin Maz'un when he died, and he was crying." Or, he (one of the narrators) said: "His eyes were brimming with tears
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Uthman bin Maz'un ko chooma jabke wo mar chuke the, aur wo ro rahe the, ya kaha: unki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Abu Bakr ne Nabi (SAW) ko chooma jabke wo mar chuke the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umm Atiyyah narrated:"One of the daughters of the Prophet died, so he said: 'Wash her an odd number of times, three, or five, or more than that as you see fit. Wash her with water and Sidr, and in the last (washing) add camphor, or something from camphor. When you are finished then inform me.' When we finished we informed him so he gave us his waist-sheet and said 'Wrap her in it
hi: Umm Atiyyah ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki ek beti ka intiqaal ho gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Isse taak teen, paanch, ya usse zyada baar ghusl do, jaisa tumhein munasib lage, aur ise paani aur beri se dho, aur aakhri baar mein kaafoor ya kaafoor ka kuch hissa daal do, jab tum faariq ho jao to mujhe bataana.'" To jab hum faariq hue, humne unhen bataya, to unhon ne humein apna tehband diya aur kaha: "Isse iski lipeti hui chadar bana do." Hushaim ne kaha: Aur doosron ki hadith mein hai, mujhe nahi maloom shayad Hisham bhi unmein se the, unhon ne kaha: "Aur humne unke baal teen chotiyon mein baandhe." Hushaim ne kaha: Mera khayaal hai unhon ne kaha: "To humne unhen unke peeche daal diya." Hushaim ne kaha: Khalid ne humein doosron se alag, Hafsah aur Muhammad se, Umm Atiyyah se bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse farmaya: 'Unki dahini taraf se aur wuzu ki jagahon se shuru karo.'" Is mauzu par Umm Sulaim se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Atiyyah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Mayyat ka ghusl janabat ke ghusl jaisa hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Humare nazdeek mayyat ke ghusl ki koi muqarrar hadd nahi, aur iski koi maloom soorat nahi, lekin use paak kiya jaaye. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Malik ne sirf ek mujmal baat kahi hai: \"Dhoya jaaye aur saaf kiya jaaye,\" aur agar mayyat saaf paani ya kisi aur paani se saaf ho jaaye, to ye uske ghusl ke liye kaafi hai, lekin mujhe zyada pasand hai ke usse teen ya usse zyada baar dhoya jaaye, teen se kam na kiya jaaye, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: \"Isse teen ya paanch baar ghusl do.\" Aur agar teen se kam baar mein wo saaf ho jaaye, to ye kaafi hai, aur unka khayaal nahi ke Nabi (SAW) ke qaul ka matlab sirf teen ya paanch baar saaf karna hai, koi muqarrar hadd nahi. Isi tarah fuqaha ne kaha, aur wo hadith ke matlab ko zyada jaante hain. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Ghusl paani aur beri se ho, aur aakhri mein kaafoor ka kuch hissa daala jaaye.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The best scent is the perfume of musk
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse achi khushbu mishk hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that:The Prophet was asked about musk and he said: "It is the best of your perfumes
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se mishk ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Wo tumhari sabse achi khushbu hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne mayyat ke liye mishk ko napasand kiya hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ise Al-Mustamirr bin Ar-Rayyan ne bhi Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: Al-Mustamirr bin Ar-Rayyan thiqah hain. Yahya ne kaha: Khulaid bin Ja'far thiqah hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Ghusl for one who washed him and Wudu for one who carried himm
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo ise ghusl de, wo ghusl kare, aur jo ise uthaaye, wo wuzu kare" - yani mayyat ko. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai, aur Abu Hurairah se ye mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai us shakhs ke baare mein jo mayyat ko ghusl de, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, kaha: Jab wo mayyat ko ghusl de, to uspar ghusl hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Uspar wuzu hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Main mayyat ke ghusl ke baad ghusl karna Mustahab samajhta hoon, aur main ise wajib nahi maanta. Isi tarah Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Jo mayyat ko ghusl de, mujhe ummeed hai uspar ghusl wajib na ho, lekin wuzu ke baare mein kam se kam kaha jaata hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Wuzu zaroori hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo mayyat ko ghusl de, agar wo na ghusl kare na wuzu kare, to koi harj nahi.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Wear the white among your garments, for indeed they are among the best of your garments, and shroud your dead in them
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne kapdon mein safed pehno, kyunki wo tumhare behtareen kapdon mein se hai, aur apne marne walon ko usmein kafan do." Is mauzu par Samurah, Ibn Umar, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur isi ko ahl-e-ilm Mustahab samajhte hain. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Mujhe zyada pasand hai ke use un kapdon mein kafan diya jaaye jinmein wo namaz padhta tha. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Humein sabse pasandeeda kapda wo hai jismein safed rang ho kafan diya jaaye, aur achha kafan Mustahab hai.

e: Abu Qatadah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When one of you shrouds his brother, then let him use the best of his shrouds
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ki dekhbhaal kare, to wo uska kafan achha kare." Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Sallam bin Abi Muti ne unke qaul "Aur tum mein se koi apne bhai ka kafan achha kare" ke baare mein kaha: Iska matlab hai kapda mote hona chahiye, patla nahi.

e: Hisham bin Urwah narrated from his father that:Aishah said: "The Prophet was shrouded in three white Yemeni cloths, there was no shirt nor turban among them." He said: "So they mentioned the saying of the others to Aishah, that there were two garments and a Habir Burd. She said: 'A Burd was brought, but they refused it and they did not shroud him in it
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ko teen safed Yamani kapdon mein kafan diya gaya, jinmein na kurta tha na pagdi." Unhon ne kaha: To Aishah ke saamne logon ka qaul zikr kiya gaya do kapdon aur ek chaadar ke baare mein. To unhon ne kaha: "Chaadar laayi gayi thi, lekin unhon ne use wapas kar diya aur usmein kafan nahi diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah shrouded Hamzah bin Abdul-Muttalib in one cloth of Namirah
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hamzah bin Abdul-Muttalib ko ek kapde mein, Namirah mein kafan diya. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Mughaffal, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kafan ke baare mein mukhtalif riwayaten hui hain, aur Aishah ki hadith Nabi (SAW) ke kafan ke baare mein riwayat hui hadithon mein sabse sahih hai. Aur Aishah ki hadith par zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek amal hai. Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Aadmi ko teen kapdon mein kafan diya jaaye, agar chaho to kurta aur do lipeti hui chaadaron mein, aur agar chaho to teen lipeti hui chaadaron mein, aur agar do kapde na milen to ek kapda kaafi hai, aur do kapde bhi kaafi hain, aur teen jise mil jaayen unke liye zyada pasandeeda hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aurat ko paanch kapdon mein kafan diya jaaye.

e: Abdullah bin Ja'far said:"When the news of the death of Ja'far came, the Prophet said: 'Prepare some food for the family of Ja'far, for indeed something has happened to them that will keep them busy
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne kaha: "Jab Ja'far ki maut ki khabar aayi, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ja'far ke ghar walon ke liye khaana banao, kyunki unke paas aisi cheez aayi hai jo unhen masroof rakhegi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm mayyat ke ghar walon ke paas kuch bhejna Mustahab samajhte the, kyunki wo museebat mein masroof hote hain. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ja'far bin Khalid, Ibn Sarah hain, aur wo thiqah hain, Ibn Juraij ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that:The Prophet said: "He who slaps (his) cheeks, tears (his) clothes and calls with the call of the Jahliyyah is not one of us
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo hum mein se nahi jo gareban phaade, gaal peete, aur Jahiliyyah ki pukaar pukaare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ali bin Rabi'ah Al-Asadi said:"A man died among the Ansar named Qarazah bin Ka'b, and he was being wailed over. So Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah came and ascended the Minbar. He uttered thanks and praise to Allah and said: "As for the gravity of wailing in Islam, indeed I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'The one who is wailed over is punished as long as he is being wailed over
hi: Ali bin Rabi'ah Al-Asadi ne kaha: "Ansar ka ek aadmi mar gaya jise Qarazah bin Ka'b kaha jaata tha, uspar naukha kiya gaya. To Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah aaye aur mimbar par chadhe, Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, aur kaha: 'Islam mein naukhe ka kya kaam? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Jispar naukha kiya jaaye, use usi ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai.'" Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Musa, Qais bin Aasim, Abu Hurairah, Junadah bin Malik, Anas, Umm Atiyyah, Samurah, aur Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Mughirah ki hadith ghareeb hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"There are four matters in my nation that are from the matters of Jahiliyyah which the people will not leave: Wailing, slandering one's lineage, Al-Adwa - a camel gets mange, so one hundred camels get mange - but who gave the first camel mange? And Al-Anwa (saying): "We got rain because of this or that celestial positioning
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein chaar cheezein Jahiliyyah ki baaton mein se hain jinhen log nahi chhodenge: naukha, nasab par ilzaam lagaana, Al-Adwa - ek oont ko khaarish ho gayi to sau oonton ko khaarish ho gayi - lekin pehle oont ko khaarish kisne di? Aur Al-Anwa kehna: Humein fulaan sitare ki wajah se baarish hui." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The deceased is punished for the crying of his family over him
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mayyat ko uske ghar walon ke uspar rone ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne mayyat par rona napasand kiya, unhon ne kaha: Mayyat ko uske ghar walon ke rone ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai, aur unhon ne isi hadith ko liya. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Mujhe ummeed hai agar usne apni zindagi mein unhen mana kiya ho, to iski wajah se uspar kuch nahi.

e: Musa bin Abi Musa Al-Asha'ri narrated from his father that:The Messenger of Allah said: "No one dies and they stand over him crying and saying: 'O what a great man he was! O how respectful he was!' except that two angels are appointed for him to poke him (saying): 'Is that you?
hi: Musa bin Abi Musa Al-Ash'ari apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi mayyat nahi marta ke uska rone wala khada hokar kahe 'Haaye mera pahaad!' ya 'Haaye mera sardaar!' ya isi jaisi baat, magar uspar do Farishte muqarrar kiye jaate hain jo use dhakke dete hain (aur kehte hain): 'Kya tum aise the?'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Yahya bin Abdur-Rahman narrated from Ibn Umar that:The Prophet said: "The deceased is punished for the crying of his family over him." So, Aishah said: "May Allah have mercy upon him. He has not lied, but he is mistaken. It is only that the Messenger of Allah said about a Jewish man who died: 'The deceased is being punished and his family is crying over him
hi: Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Mayyat ko uske ghar walon ke uspar rone ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai." To Aishah ne kaha: "Allah unpar reham kare, unhon ne jhoot nahi bola, lekin unhen galatfahmi hui. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek aadmi ke baare mein farmaya tha jo Yahudi hote hue mara: 'Mayyat ko zaroor azaab diya jaata hai, aur uske ghar wale uspar rote hain.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Qarazah bin Ka'b, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Usamah bin Zaid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Aishah se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko liya aur is Ayat ki tafseer ki: \"(Koi bojh uthaane wala doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega).\" Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"The Prophet took Abdur-Rahman bin Awf by the hand and went with him to his son Ibrahim. He found him in his last breaths, so he took him and put him on his lap and cried. Abdur-Rahman said to him: 'You cry? Didn't you prohibit (your followers) from crying?' He said: 'No. But I prohibited two foolish immoral voices: A voice during a calamity while clawing at one's face and tearing one's clothes, and Shaitan's scream.'" And there is more that is stated in the Hadith
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ka haath pakda aur unhen unke bete Ibrahim ke paas le gaye, unhen aakhri saanson mein paaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen liya aur apni god mein rakha, aur ro pade. To Abdur-Rahman ne unse kaha: 'Aap rote hain? Kya aapne rone se mana nahi kiya tha?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, lekin maine do bewaquf aur badkaar aawazon se mana kiya tha: museebat ke waqt ki aawaz, chehre nochna aur gareban phaadna, aur Shaitan ki cheekh.'" Aur hadith mein isse zyada baatein bhi hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Bakr - and he is Ibn Muhammad bin Amr bin Hazm - narrated from his father, that:Amrah informed him that she heard Aishah, while it was being mentioned to her that Ibn Umar had said that the deceased would be punished for the crying of the living (over him). So Aishah said: 'May Allah forgive Abu Abdur-Rahman. He has not lied, but he is mistaken in the understanding. Rather, the Messenger of Allah passed by a Jewish woman who was being cried over, so he said: 'They are crying over her and she is being punished in her grave
hi: Amrah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Aishah ko suna, unse zikr kiya gaya ke Ibn Umar keh rahe hain: "Mayyat ko zindon ke uspar rone ki wajah se azaab diya jaata hai." To Aishah ne kaha: "Allah Abu Abdur-Rahman ko maaf kare, unhon ne jhoot nahi bola, lekin wo bhool gaye ya unhen ghalti hui. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek Yahudi aurat ke paas se guzre jispar rona ho raha tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ye log uspar rote hain, aur wo apni qabr mein azaab paa rahi hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Salim narrated that:His father said: "I saw the Prophet, Abu Bakr, and Umar walking in front of the funeral
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ko janaze ke aage chalte dekha."

e: Salim bin Abdullah narrated that his father said:"I saw the Prophet, Abu Bakr, and Umar walking in front of the funeral
hi: Salim bin Abdullah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ko janaze ke aage chalte dekha."

e: Az-Zuhri said:"The Prophet, Abu Bakr, and Umar would walk in front of the funeral." Az-Zuhri said: "Salim informed me that his father would walk in front of the funeral
hi: Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar janaze ke aage chalte the." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Aur Salim ne mujhe bataya ke unke waalid janaze ke aage chalte the." Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith isi tarah Ibn Juraij, Ziyad bin Sa'd, aur kai doosron ne Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se, Ibn Uyainah ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Ma'mar, Yunus bin Yazid, Malik, aur kai hafiz muhaddiseen ne Az-Zuhri se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) janaze ke aage chalte the. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Aur Salim ne mujhe bataya ke unke waalid janaze ke aage chalte the. Aur ahl-e-hadith sab maante hain ke ismein mursal hadith zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Yahya bin Musa ko kehte suna: Abdur-Razzaq ne kaha: Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Az-Zuhri ki is baare mein mursal hadith Ibn Uyainah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Aur mera khayaal hai Ibn Juraij ne ise Ibn Uyainah se liya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Hammam bin Yahya ne ye hadith Ziyad (jo Ibn Sa'd hain), Mansoor, Bakr, aur Sufyan se, Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat ki. Aur wo Sufyan bin Uyainah hain jinse Hammam ne riwayat ki. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka janaze ke aage chalne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, maana ke uske aage chalna afzal hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur is mauzu mein Anas ki hadith mehfooz nahi.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would walk in front of the funeral, as did Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman janaze ke aage chalte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ye galat hadith hai, Muhammad bin Bakr ne ismein galti ki, aur ye hadith Yunus se, Az-Zuhri se sahih riwayat hoti hai ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar janaze ke aage chalte the. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Aur Salim ne mujhe bataya ke unke waalid janaze ke aage chalte the. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Yahya, the Imam of Banu Taimillah, narrated from Abu Majid :From Abdullah bin Mas'ud who said: "We asked the Messenger of Allah about walking behind the funeral. He said: 'Less than a trot. For if he was good, then you will be hastening him to it (goodness), and if he was evil, then it id only an inhabitant of the Fire that is being taken away." The funeral is (to be) followed. The one who precedes it shall not have the reward of those who follow it
hi: Yahya, Banu Taimillah ke Imam, Abu Majid se riwayat karte hain, Abdullah bin Mas'ud se: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se janaze ke peeche chalne ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Halke chaal se, agar wo neik tha to tum use jaldi le jaate ho neki ki taraf, aur agar wo bura tha to sirf Jahannami hi door kiye jaate hain. Janaza chala jaata hai, wo peeche nahi aata, aur jo uske aage nikal jaaye wo uske saath nahi hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Abdullah bin Mas'ud ki riwayat mein sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko is Abu Majid ki hadith ko kamzor qarar dete suna. Aur Muhammad ne kaha: Al-Humaidi ne kaha: Ibn Uyainah ne kaha: Yahya se pucha gaya: Ye Abu Majid kaun hai? Unhon ne kaha: Ek udta hua parinda tha jisne humein bataya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, isi ko apnaya, wo maante hain ke uske peeche chalna afzal hai. Aur isi ko Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ishaq maante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Abu Majid ek majhool aadmi hai, maloom nahi, unse sirf do hadithein riwayat hoti hain, Ibn Mas'ud se. Aur Yahya, Banu Taimillah ke Imam, thiqah hain, unki kuniyat Abu Al-Harith hai, aur unhen Yahya Al-Jabir bhi kaha jaata hai, aur Yahya Al-Mujbir bhi, aur wo Kufi hain, Shu'bah, Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Abu Al-Ahwas, aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Thawban narrated:"We went with the Prophet (following) a funeral. He saw people riding so he said: 'Are you not ashamed? Indeed Allah's angels are on their feet, while you are on the backs of your beasts
hi: Thawban (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek janaze mein nikle, unhon ne kuch logon ko sawaar dekha, to farmaya: 'Kya tumhein sharam nahi aati? Allah ke Farishte apne paaon par hain, aur tum apne jaanwaron ki peeth par ho.'" Is mauzu par Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah aur Jabir bin Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Thawban ki hadith mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Mauqoof zyada sahih hai.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"We were with the Prophet (following) the funeral of Ibn Ad-Dahbah, and he was on a horse that was walking quickly, and we were around him, and he was trotting
hi: Jabir bin Samurah ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Abu Ad-Dahdah ke janaze mein the, wo apne ghode par the aur wo tez chal raha tha, hum unke ird-gird the, aur wo tez qadam bhar raha tha."

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"The Prophet followed the funeral of Ibn Ad-Dahdah walking and he returned on horseback
hi: Jabir bin Samurah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Ad-Dahdah ke janaze ki paidal pairvi ki aur ghode par wapas laute. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Hurry up with the funeral (procession) for if it was good, you are advancing it to good, and if it was evil, then you are taking it off your necks
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Janaze ko jaldi le jaao, agar wo neik tha to tum use bhalai ki taraf le ja rahe ho, aur agar wo bura tha to tum use apni gardanon se utaar rahe ho." Is mauzu par Abu Bakrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Messenger of Allah came to Hamza on the Day of Uhud, he stood over him and saw that he had been mutilated. He said: Had it not been that Safiyyah would be distressed, then I would have left him to be eaten by the beasts until he was gathered on the Day of Judgment from their stomachs." He said: "Then he called for a Namirah to shroud him with. When it was extended over his head, it left his feet exposed, and when it was extended over his feet, it left his head exposed." He said: "There were many dead and few cloths." He said: "One, two and three men were shrouded in one cloth and buried in one grave." He said: "So the Messenger of Allah was asking which of them knew the most Quran, so he could put him toward the Qibalh." He said: "So the Messenger of Allah buried them and he did not perform (funeral prayers) for them
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Uhud ke din Hamzah ke paas aaye, unke paas khade hue, dekha ke unka muthla kiya gaya hai, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar Safiyyah ko bura na lagta, to main use aise hi chhod deta yahan tak ke jaanwar use khaate, yahan tak ke wo Qayamat ke din unke pet se uthaaya jaata.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Phir unhon ne Namirah mangwaayi aur unhen usmein kafan diya, jab wo unke sar par khinchi jaati to unke paaon nazar aate, aur jab unke paaon par khinchi jaati to unka sar nazar aata." Unhon ne kaha: "To maqtool bahut ho gaye aur kapde kam ho gaye." Unhon ne kaha: "To ek aadmi, do aadmi, aur teen aadmi ek hi kapde mein kafan diye jaate aur phir ek hi qabr mein dafn kiye jaate. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke baare mein poochhte: 'Inmein se sabse zyada Quran kisko yaad hai?' Phir use Qibla ki taraf aage rakhte." Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen dafn kiya aur unpar namaz-e-janaza nahi padhi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Anas ki hadith mein sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Namirah purani chaadar ko kehte hain.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Messenger of Allah would visit the sick, attend the funerals, ride a donkey, accept the invitation of a slave, and on the Day of Banu Quraizah he was on a donkey muzzled with a cord of fibers and a pack-saddle made of fibers
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar ki mizaajpursi karte, janaze mein shaamil hote, gadhe par sawaar hote, aur ghulam ki dawat qubool karte, aur Banu Quraizah ke din wo ek gadhe par the jise khajoor ke reshon ki rassi se lagaam di gayi thi, aur uspar khajoor ke reshon ka zeen tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Muslim ki, Anas se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Muslim Al-A'war ko kamzor qarar diya jaata hai, aur wo Muslim bin Kaisan Al-Mula'i hain, unke baare mein baat hui hai, aur Shu'bah aur Sufyan ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"When the Messenger of Allah died, they disagreed over where to bury him. So Abu Bakr said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying something which I have not forgotten, he said: "Allah does not take (the life of ) a Prophet except at the location in which He wants him to be buried.'" So they buried him at the spot of his bed
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to unke dafn ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hua. To Abu Bakr ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch sunaa hai jo main bhoola nahi, unhon ne farmaya: Allah kisi Nabi ki jaan sirf uss jagah leta hai jahan wo dafn hona pasand karta hai. Unhen unke bistar ki jagah dafn karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr Al-Mulaiki ko unki hifz ki wajah se kamzor qarar diya jaata hai. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai, Ibn Abbas ne ise Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat kiya.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Mention good things about your dead, and refrain from (mentioning) their evil
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne marne walon ki achhaiyon ka zikr karo, aur unki buraiyon se bacho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Imran bin Anas Al-Makki munkar hadith wale hain. Aur kuch logon ne ise Ata se, Aishah se riwayat ki hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Imran bin Abi Anas Misri, Imran bin Anas Al-Makki se zyada purane aur mazboot hain.

e: Ubadah bin As-Samit said:"When the Messenger of Allah follows a corpse, he would not sit until (the deceased was) placed in the Lahd. A rabbi came upon him and said: 'This is what we do, O Muhammad'" He said: "So the Messenger of Allah sat, and he said: 'Differ from them
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) janaze ki pairvi karte, to jab tak use qabr ke lahad mein na rakh diya jaata, wo baithte nahi the. To ek yahudi aalim unke saamne aaya aur kaha: 'Ham aisa hi karte hain, Ae Muhammad!' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) baith gaye aur farmaya: 'Unki mukhalafat karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Bishr bin Rafi hadith mein mazboot nahi hain.

e: Abu Sinan said:"I buried my son Sinan and Abu Talhah Al-Khawlani was sitting on the rim of the grave. When I wanted to leave he took me by my hand and said: 'Shall I not inform you of some good new O Abu Sinan!' I said: 'Of course.' He said: 'Ad-Dahhak bin Abdur-Rahman bin Arzab narrated to me, from Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When a child of the slave (of Allah) died, Allah says to the angels: "Have you taken the fruits of his work." They reply: "Yes." So He says: "What did My slave say?" They reply: "He praised you and mentioned that to You is the return." So Allah says: "Build a house in Paradise for My slave, and name it 'the house of praise
hi: Abu Sinan ne kaha: "Maine apne bete Sinan ko dafn kiya, aur Abu Talhah Al-Khawlani qabr ke kinare baithe hue the. Jab main jaane laga, unhon ne mera haath pakda aur kaha: 'Kya main tumhein khushkhabri na doon, Ae Abu Sinan?' Maine kaha: 'Kyun nahi.' To unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe Ad-Dahhak bin Abdur-Rahman bin Arzab ne bataya, Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari se, ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab kisi bande ka bachcha marta hai, to Allah apne Farishton se kehta hai: Kya tumne mere bande ke bachche ki jaan le li? Wo kehte hain: Haan. To wo kehta hai: Kya tumne uske dil ka phal le liya? Wo kehte hain: Haan. To wo kehta hai: Mere bande ne kya kaha? Wo kehte hain: Usne Teri tareef ki aur \"Inna Lillahi wa Inna Ilaihi Raji'un\" kaha. To Allah kehta hai: Mere bande ke liye Jannat mein ek ghar banao aur use \"Bait-ul-Hamd\" naam do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Prophet prayed and in the funeral prayer he for An-Najashi, said four Takbir
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne An-Najashi ki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur chaar Takbir kahin. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Ibn Abi Awfa, Jabir, Yazid bin Thabit, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Yazid bin Thabit, Zaid bin Thabit ke bhai hain, aur wo unse bade hain, unhon ne Badr mein shirkat ki, aur Zaid ne Badr mein shirkat nahi ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo janaze mein chaar Takbir maante hain. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila said:"Zaid bin Arqam would say four Takbir for our funerals. (Once) he said five Takbir for a funeral so we asked him about that and he said: 'The Messenger of Allah would say those Takbir
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila ne kaha: "Zaid bin Arqam humare janazon mein chaar Takbir kehte the, aur unhon ne ek janaze mein paanch Takbir kahin, to humne unse iske baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhen kehte the.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Arqam ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, isi ko apnaya, wo janaze mein paanch Takbir maante hain. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Agar Imam janaze mein paanch Takbir kahe, to Imam ki pairvi ki jaaye.

e: Abu Ibrahim Al-Ashhali narrated :from his father who said: "When the Messenger of Allah would perform the Salat for the funeral he would said: (Allahammaghfir li-hayyina wa mayyittina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana) 'O Allah! Forgive our living and our deceased, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our male and our female
hi: Abu Ibrahim Al-Ashhali apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab janaze ki namaz padhte to kehte: 'Allahumma Ighfir Li-Hayyina wa Mayyitina wa Shahidina wa Ghaibina wa Saghirina wa Kabirina wa Dhakarina wa Unthana' (Ya Allah! Humare zinda aur marne walon ko, hazir aur ghaib walon ko, chhote aur bade ko, mard aur aurat ko maaf kar de)." Yahya ne kaha: Aur mujhe Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman ne, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi bataya, aur usmein izafa kiya: \"Allahumma Man Ahyaitahu Minna Fa Ahyihi Alal-Islam, wa Man Tawaffaitahu Minna Fa Tawaffahu Alal-Iman\" (Ya Allah! Jise Tu humein se zinda rakhe, use Islam par zinda rakh, aur jise Tu humein se maut de, use imaan par maut de). Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Aishah, Abu Qatadah, Awf bin Malik, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ibrahim ke walid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Hisham Ad-Dastawa'i aur Ali bin Al-Mubarak ne ye hadith Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki hai. Aur Ikrimah bin Ammar ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Ikrimah bin Ammar ki hadith mehfooz nahi, aur Ikrimah ko Yahya ki hadith mein kabhi kabhi ghalati hoti hai. Aur ye hadith Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Is mauzu mein sabse sahih riwayat Yahya bin Abi Kathir ki, Abu Ibrahim Al-Ashhali se, apne walid se hai. Maine unse Abu Ibrahim ke naam ke baare mein pucha, to unhen ye maloom nahi tha.

e: Awf bin Malik said:"I heard the Messenger of Allah, while he was performing Salat for a deceased person. I could hear him saying in his prayer: (Allahummagfir lahu, war hamhu, waghsilhu bil-baradi (waghsilhu) kama yughsaluth-thawb) 'O Allah! Forgive him, have mercy upon him, and wash him with (snow or ice) (and wash him) just as a garment is washed
hi: Awf bin Malik ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ek mayyat ki namaz-e-janaza padhte suna, to maine unki namaz se samjha: 'Allahumma Ighfir Lahu wa Irhamhu wa Ighsilhu Bil-Baradi, wa Ighsilhu Kama Yughsalath-Thawb' (Ya Allah! Ise maaf kar aur ispar reham kar, aur ise baraf se dho, aur ise aise dho jaise kapda dhoya jaata hai)." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Is mauzu par sabse sahih cheez yehi hadith hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet recited Fatihatil-Kitab for a funeral (prayer)." (Da'if Jiddan)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne janaze mein Fatihatul-Kitab padhi. Is mauzu par Umm Shareek se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith ka isnad utna mazboot nahi. Ibrahim bin Uthman, Abu Shaibah Al-Wasiti hain, munkar hadith wale. Aur Ibn Abbas se sahih ye hai ke unka apna qaul hai: Sunnat mein se hai ke janaze mein Fatihatul-Kitab padhi jaaye.

e: Talhah bin Abdullah bin Awf narrated:"Ibn Abbas performed Salat for a funeral and he recited Fatihatil-Kitab. So I asked him about it and he said: 'It is from the Sunnah' or, 'From the completeness of the Sunnah
hi: Talhah bin Abdullah bin Awf ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas ne ek janaze ki namaz padhi aur Fatihatul-Kitab padhi. Maine unse pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Ye Sunnat mein se hai' ya 'Sunnat ki takmeel mein se hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo pehli Takbir ke baad Fatihatul-Kitab padhna chunte hain. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Namaz-e-janaza mein kuch padha nahi jaata, ye to sirf Allah ki tareef, Nabi (SAW) par Durood, aur mayyat ke liye dua hai. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Talhah bin Abdullah bin Awf, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ke bhatije hain, Az-Zuhri ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Marthan bin Abdullah Al-Yazani narrated:"When Malik bin Hubairah performed Salat for a funeral and the people were few he would divide them into three groups (rows) then say: 'The Messenger of Allah said: "For whomever three rows perform Salat, then it is granted
hi: Marthad bin Abdullah Al-Yazani ne kaha: "Jab Malik bin Hubairah janaze ki namaz padhte aur log kam hote, to unhen teen hisson mein baant dete, phir kehte: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jispar teen saffein namaz padhen, uski maghfirat wajib ho gayi.'" Is mauzu par Aishah, Umm Habibah, Abu Hurairah, aur Maimunah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Malik bin Hubairah ki hadith hasan hai, isi tarah kai logon ne Muhammad bin Ishaq se riwayat ki hai. Aur Ibrahim bin Sa'd ne Muhammad bin Ishaq se ye hadith riwayat ki aur Marthad aur Malik bin Hubairah ke darmiyan ek aadmi daakhil kiya. Aur inki riwayat humare nazdeek zyada sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Prophet said: "No one among the Muslim dies, and Salat is performed for him by a community of Muslims reaching one hundred, and they intercede (supplicate) for him, except that their intercession for him is accepted." In his narration, 'Ali bin Hujr said: "One hundred or more than that
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman nahi marta ke uski namaz Musalmanon ki ek jamaat padhe, jo sau tak pahunche, aur uski shifa'at karen, magar unki shifa'at qubool ki jaati hai." Ali bin Hujr ne apni hadith mein kaha: "Sau ya usse zyada." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur kuch logon ne ise mauqoof rakha aur marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhni narrated:"There are three times that the Messenger of Allah prohibited us from performing Salat in, burying our dead in: When the sun's rising appears until it has risen up; when the sun is at the zenith until it passes, and when the sun begins its setting, until it has set
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani ne kaha: "Teen waqt aise the jinmein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humein namaz padhne ya apne marne walon ko dafn karne se mana karte the: jab sooraj nikalna shuru hota yahan tak ke wo buland ho jaaye, jab dopahar ka sooraj seedha khada hota yahan tak ke wo dhal jaaye, aur jab sooraj doobne ke qareeb hota yahan tak ke wo doob jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo in waqton mein janaze ki namaz napasand karte hain. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Is hadith ka matlab hai ke un waqton mein hum apne marne walon ko dafn karen, yani janaze ki namaz padhen. Aur unhon ne sooraj nikalne, sooraj doobne, aur dopahar ke waqt, sooraj dhalne tak, janaze ki namaz napasand ki. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Un waqton mein janaze ki namaz padhne mein koi harj nahi jinmein namaz napasand ki jaati hai.

e: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated that:The Prophet said: "The rider is to be behind the funeral (procession), and the walker where he wishes, and the child should be prayed over
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sawaar janaze ke peeche ho, aur paidal jahan chahe rahe, aur bachche ki namaz-e-janaza padhi jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Bachche ki namaz padhi jaaye chahe wo cheekha na ho, jab ye maloom ho jaaye ke wo paida hua tha. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir narrated that:The Prophet said: "The child is not prayed over, nor does he inherit, nor is he inherited from until one is sure he was alive at birth
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bachche ki namaz-e-janaza nahi padhi jaati, na wo wirasat paata hai na uski wirasat li jaati hai, jab tak wo cheekhe na." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith mein logon mein ikhtilaaf hua hai, kuch ne ise Abu Az-Zubair se, Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se marfu' riwayat ki. Aur Ash'ath bin Sawwar aur kai doosron ne Abu Az-Zubair se, Jabir se mauqoof riwayat ki. Aur Muhammad bin Ishaq ne Ata bin Abi Rabah se, Jabir se mauqoof riwayat ki. Aur ye marfu' hadith se zyada sahih maloom hota hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, wo kehte hain: Bachche ki namaz nahi padhi jaati jab tak wo cheekhe na. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah performed Salat over Suhail bin Al-Baida in the Masjid
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Suhail bin Al-Baida ki namaz-e-janaza Masjid mein padhi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Malik ne kaha: Mayyat ki namaz Masjid mein nahi padhi jaati. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Mayyat ki namaz Masjid mein padhi jaati hai, unhon ne isi hadith se dalil li.

e: Abu Ghalib narrated:"I prayed for the funeral of a man with Anas bin Malik, so he stood parallel to his head. Then they came with the body of a woman from the Quraish. They said: 'O Abu Hamzah perform the prayer for her.' So he stood parallel to her waist. Al-Ala bin Ziyad said to him: 'Is this how you saw the Messenger of Allah standing in the place for the funeral as you did for her, and for a place that you stood for the man?' He said: 'Yes.' When he was finished he said: 'Remember (this)
hi: Abu Ghalib ne kaha: "Maine Anas bin Malik ke saath ek aadmi ke janaze ki namaz padhi, to wo uske sar ki seedh mein khade hue. Phir Quraish ki ek aurat ka janaza laaya gaya, unhon ne kaha: 'Ae Abu Hamzah! Iski namaz padhaiye.' To wo takht ke beech ki seedh mein khade hue." To Al-Ala bin Ziyad ne unse kaha: "Kya aapne Nabi (SAW) ko isi tarah dekha, janaze mein woh jagah lete hue jo aapne is aurat aur us aadmi ke liye li?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." Jab wo faariq hue, to unhon ne kaha: "Yaad rakho." Is mauzu par Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki ye hadith hasan hai, aur kai logon ne Hammam se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Waki ne ye hadith Hammam se riwayat ki lekin usmein galti ki, unhon ne \"Ghalib se, Anas se\" kaha, aur sahih Abu Ghalib se hai. Aur ye hadith Abdul-Warith bin Sa'eed aur kai doosron ne Abu Ghalib se, Hammam ki riwayat jaisi hi riwayat ki hai. Aur logon mein ikhtilaaf hai is Abu Ghalib ke naam ke baare mein, kuch kehte hain unka naam Nafi hai, aur kuch kehte hain Rafi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko apnaya, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Samurah bin Jundab narrated:"The Prophet prayed over a woman, so he stood at her middle
hi: Samurah bin Jundab se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aurat ki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur uske beech mein khade hue. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ise Husain Al-Mu'allim se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Ka'b bin Malik narrated that:Jabir bin Abdullah informed him that the Prophet had put two men together in one cloth from those who were killed at (the battle of) Uhud, then he said: "Which of them memorized the more of the Qur'an?" When one of them was indicated to him, he put him in the Lahd (first) and said: "I am a witness for those people on the Day of Judgment." And he ordered that they be buried in their blood, and that they not be prayed over, nor washed
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Ka'b bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Jabir bin Abdullah ne unhen bataya ke Nabi (SAW) Uhud ke shaheedon mein se do aadmiyon ko ek kapde mein ikattha karte, phir kehte: "Inmein se Quran zyada kisne yaad kiya hai?" Jab unhen unmein se ek ki taraf ishara kiya jaata, to unhen lahad mein pehle rakhte aur kehte: "Main in logon par Qayamat ke din gawaah hoon." Aur unhon ne unhen unke khoon mein hi dafn karne ka hukum diya, na unki namaz padhi na unhen ghusl diya gaya. Is mauzu par Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Az-Zuhri se, Abdullah bin Tha'labah bin Abi Su'air se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ne ise Jabir se zikr kiya. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka shaheed ki namaz-e-janaza ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Shaheed ki namaz nahi padhi jaati. Aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad qaayal hain. Aur kuch ne kaha: Shaheed ki namaz padhi jaati hai. Aur unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne Hamzah ki namaz padhi. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ishaq qaayal hain.

e: Ash-Shaibani narrated that:Ash-Sha'bi said: "I was informed by one who saw the Prophet: He (pbuh) saw a solitary grave, s he lined his Companions (behind him) to pray over it." It was said to him (Ash-Sha'bi): "Who informed you?" He said: "Ibn Abbas
hi: Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Mujhe usne bataya jisne Nabi (SAW) ko dekha: unhon ne ek akeli qabr dekhi, to apne Sahaba ki saf uske peeche banaayi aur uski namaz padhi." Unse pucha gaya: "Aapko kisne bataya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas." Is mauzu par Anas, Buraidah, Yazid bin Thabit, Abu Hurairah, Aamir bin Rabi'ah, Abu Qatadah, aur Sahl bin Hunaif se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Qabr par namaz nahi padhi jaati. Aur ye Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Jab mayyat dafn ho jaaye aur uski namaz na padhi gayi ho, to qabr par namaz padhi jaaye. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak qabr par namaz padhna maante the. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Ek mahine tak qabr par namaz padhi jaaye. Unhon ne kaha: Humne Ibn Al-Musayyib se zyada se zyada ye suna hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Sa'd bin Ubadah ki maa ki qabr par ek mahine baad namaz padhi.

e: Sa'eedbin Musayyab narrated:"Umm Sa'd died while the Prophet was absent. So when he arrived he performed Salat over her, and a month had already passed
hi: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se riwayat hai ke Umm Sa'd ka intiqaal hua jabke Nabi (SAW) ghaib the. Jab wo aaye, to unhon ne unki namaz padhi jabke ek mahina guzar chuka tha.

e: Imran bin Husain narrated that :the Prophet said: "Indeed your brother An-Najashi has died. So stand to perform Salat for him." He (Imran) said: "We stood and lined up just as the deceased is lined up for, and we prayed for him just as the deceased is prayed for
hi: Imran bin Husain ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse farmaya: 'Tumhara bhai An-Najashi intiqaal kar gaya hai, khade ho jao aur uski namaz padho.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To hum khade hue aur saf banayi jaisi mayyat ke liye banayi jaati hai, aur humne uski namaz padhi jaisi mayyat ki namaz padhi jaati hai." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abu Sa'eed, Hudhaifah bin Aseed, aur Jarir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever performs the funeral prayer then he will get a reward equal to a Qirat. Whoever follows it until it is buried then he will get a reward equal to two Qirat, one of them, or the least of them, is similar to Uhud (mountain)." This was mentioned to Ibn Umar, so he sent a message to Aishah to ask her about that, and she said: "Abu Hurairah has told the truth." So Ibn Umar said: "We have missed many Qirat
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi janaze ki namaz padhe, uske liye ek Qirat hai, aur jo uski pairvi kare yahan tak ke uska dafn poora ho jaaye, uske liye do Qirat hain, unmein se ek ya chhota Qirat Uhud jitna hai." To maine ye baat Ibn Umar se zikr ki, to unhon ne Aishah ke paas qaasid bheja aur unse pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Abu Hurairah ne sach kaha." To Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Humne bahut se Qirat gawaa diye." Is mauzu par Al-Bara, Abdullah bin Mughaffal, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Sa'eed, Ubayy bin Ka'b, Ibn Umar, aur Thawban se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Abu Muhazzim said:"I accompanied Abu Hurairah for ten years, and I heard him saying: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Whoever follows a funeral, and carries it three times, then he has fulfilled the right that is required from him
hi: Abu Al-Muhazzim ne kaha: "Main das saal Abu Hurairah ke saath raha, maine unhen kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo janaze ki pairvi kare aur teen martaba use uthaaye, to usne uska haq ada kar diya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne ise isi isnad se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya. Aur Abu Al-Muhazzim ka naam Yazid bin Sufyan hai, Shu'bah ne unhen kamzor qarar diya.

e: Amir bin Rabi'ah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whenever you see a funeral (procession), stand up until it goes ahead of you or it is put down
hi: Aamir bin Rabi'ah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum janaza dekho, to uske liye khade ho jaao yahan tak ke wo tumse aage nikal jaaye ya rakh diya jaaye." Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, Sahl bin Hunaif, Qais bin Sa'd, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aamir bin Rabi'ah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whenever you see a funeral (procession), stand up (for it). Whoever follows it, then do not sit down until it is put down
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum janaza dekho, to uske liye khade ho jaao, aur jo uski pairvi kare, wo tab tak na baithe jab tak wo rakh na di jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith is mauzu mein hasan sahih hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo janaze ki pairvi kare, wo tab tak na baithe jab tak wo logon ke kandhon se utaar na di jaaye. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron se, riwayat hai ke wo janaze se aage nikal jaate aur baith jaate is se pehle ke janaza unke paas pahunche. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Mas'ud bin Al-Hakim narrated that standing for the funeral (procession) until it is put down was mentioned, and 'Ali bin Abi Talib mentioned and 'Ali bin Abi Talib said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood, then (later) he sat". (Sahih) There are narrations on this topic from Al-Hasan bin 'Ali, and Ibn 'Abbas. Abu Eisa said: The Hadith of 'Ali is a Hasan Sahih Hadith, regarding which there are narrations from four of the Tabi'in narrating it from each other. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. Ash-Shafi'i said: "This is the most correct thing on this topic" This Hadith abrogates first Hadith: "Whenever you see a funeral (procession), stand up [for it]." Ahmad said: "If he wants, he stands, and if he wants, he does not stand." His proof is that it has been reported that the Prophet (ﷺ) stood, then sat, and this is what Ishaq bin Ibrahim said. (Abu Eisa said:) As for the saying of 'Ali: The Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the funeral and then sat, he means that the Prophet (ﷺ) would stand when he saw a funeral (procession), then he did not do so later, so he would not stand when he saw the funeral (procession)
hi: Mas'ud bin Al-Hakam ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki ke janaze ke liye khade rehne, yahan tak ke wo rakh di jaaye, ka zikr hua, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue, phir baith gaye." Is mauzu par Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ismein chaar Tabi'een ki riwayat hai, ek doosre se. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur ye is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez hai. Aur ye hadith pehli hadith ko mansookh karti hai: \"Jab tum janaza dekho to khade ho jaao.\" Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Agar wo chahe to khade ho, aur agar chahe to na khade ho. Aur unhon ne dalil li ke Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo khade hue phir baith gaye. Isi tarah Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke qaul ka matlab \"Allah ke Rasool (SAW) janaze mein khade hue phir baith gaye\" ye hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab janaza dekhte to khade ho jaate, phir baad mein isse chhod diya, to wo janaza dekhte hue khade nahi hote the.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Prophet said: "The Lahd is for us and the hole is for other than us
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lahad humare liye hai, aur shaq doosron ke liye." Is mauzu par Jarir bin Abdullah, Aishah, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"When he Prophet put the deceased in the grave" He said: And Abu Khalid (one of the narrators) said [one time]: "When he placed the deceased in the Lahd" - "He said one time: 'In the Name of Allah, by His command and upon the Millah of the Messenger of Allah.' and one time he said: 'In the Name of Allah, by His command and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab mayyat ko qabr mein daakhil karte - aur Abu Khalid ne ek baar kaha: jab mayyat ko uski lahad mein rakhte - to ek baar kehte: "Bismillahi wa Billahi wa Ala Millati Rasoolillah" (Allah ke naam se aur Allah ki madad se aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki millat par), aur ek baar kehte: "Bismillahi wa Billahi wa Ala Sunnati Rasoolillah" (Allah ke naam se aur Allah ki madad se aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat par). Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu As-Siddiq An-Naji ne ise Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur Abu As-Siddiq An-Naji se, Ibn Umar se, mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Ja'far bin Muhammad narrated that:His father said: "The one who made the Lahd in the grave of the Messenger of Allah was Abu Talhah. And the one who placed the velvet cloth under him was Shuqran a freed slave of Messenger of Allah
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki qabr mein lahad banayi, wo Abu Talhah the, aur jisne unke neeche makhmali chaadar daali, wo Shuqran the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam." Ja'far ne kaha: Aur mujhe Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Shuqran ko kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam! Maine hi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke neeche qabr mein makhmali chaadar daali thi." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Shuqran ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne Uthman bin Farqad se ye hadith riwayat ki.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"A red velvet cloth was placed in the grave of the Prophet
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki qabr mein ek surkh makhmali chaadar rakhi gayi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne Abu Hamzah Al-Qassab se riwayat ki, unka naam Imran bin Abi Ata hai, aur Abu Jamrah Ad-Dhuba'i se bhi riwayat hui hai, unka naam Nasr bin Imran hai, aur donon Ibn Abbas ke Sahaba mein se hain. Aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke unhon ne mayyat ke neeche qabr mein kuch bhi rakhna napasand kiya. Aur isi ko kuch ahl-e-ilm ne apnaya.

e: Abu Wa'il narrated:"Ali said to Abu Al-Hayyaj Al-Asadi: 'I am dispatching you with what the Prophet dispatched me: "That you not leave an elevated grave without leveling it, nor an image without erasing it
hi: Abu Wa'il ne kaha: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Al-Hayyaj Al-Asadi se kaha: 'Main tumhein wahi cheez dekar bhejta hoon jo Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe dekar bheja tha: Koi bhi buland qabr aisi na chhodo jise tum barabar na kar do, aur koi bhi tasveer aisi na chhodo jise tum mita na do.'" Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo qabr ko zameen se buland karna napasand karte hain. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Main qabr ko utna hi buland karna pasand karta hoon jitna se pata chal jaaye ke ye qabr hai, taake use paaon na rakha jaaye aur na uspar baitha jaaye.

e: Abu Marthan Al-Ghanawi narrated that:The Prophet said: "Do not sit on the graves nor perform Salat towards them
hi: Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qabron par mat baitho aur na unki taraf mun karke namaz padho." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Amr bin Hazm, aur Bashir Ibn Al-Khasasiyah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: (Another chain) from Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi :from the Prophet, similar (to no. 1050), but it does not contain "From Abu Idris" and this is what is correct
hi: Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi se, Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi, lekin ismein "Abu Idris se" nahi hai, aur yehi sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad ne kaha: Ibn Al-Mubarak ki hadith galat hai, Ibn Al-Mubarak ne ismein galti ki aur ismein "Abu Idris Al-Khawlani se" ka izafa kiya, jabke ye sirf Bisr bin Ubaidullah se, Wathilah bin Al-Asqa se hai, isi tarah kai logon ne Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bin Jabir se riwayat ki hai aur ismein "Abu Idris Al-Khawlani se" nahi hai, aur Bisr bin Ubaidullah ne Wathilah bin Al-Asqa se suna hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prohibited plastering graves, writing on them, building over them, and treading on them
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne qabron par chuna lagaane, unpar likhne, unpar imaarat banaane, aur unpar paaon rakhne se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Jabir se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne, unmein Al-Hasan Al-Basri shaamil hain, qabron par mitti lagaane ki rukhsat di hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Qabr par mitti lagaane mein koi harj nahi.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah passed by the graves of Al-Madinah, so he turned his face towards them and said: (As-Salamu alaikum ya ahlul-qubur! Yaghfirul-lahu lana wa lakun, antum salafuna wa nahnu bil-athar.) 'Peace be upon you O inhabitants of the grave! May Allah forgive us and you; you are our predecessors and we are to follow you
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina ki qabron ke paas se guzre, to unki taraf apna chehra mod kar farmaya: "As-Salamu Alaikum Ya Ahlal-Qubur, Yaghfirullahu Lana wa Lakum, Antum Salafuna wa Nahnu Bil-Athar" (Tum par salaam ho, Ae qabron waalo! Allah humein aur tumhein maaf kare, tum humare pehle jaane waale ho aur hum tumhare peeche hain)." Is mauzu par Buraidah aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Kudainah ka naam Yahya bin Al-Muhallab hai, aur Abu Zabyan ka naam Husain bin Jundub hai.

e: Sulaiman bin Buraidah narrated from his father that:The Messenger of Allah said: "I had prohibited you from visiting the graves. But Muhammad was permitted to visit the grave of his mother: so visit them, for they will remind you of the Hereafter
hi: Buraidah se, apne walid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, lekin ab Muhammad ko apni maa ki qabr ki ziyarat ki ijazat di gayi hai, to inki ziyarat karo, kyunki wo Aakhirat ki yaad dilaati hai." Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Hurairah, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Buraidah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo qabron ki ziyarat mein koi harj nahi maante. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Mulaikah said:"Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr died in Al-Hubshi" He said: "He was carried to Makkah to be buried there. So when Aishah arrived she went to the grave of Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr and she said: "We were like two drinking companions of Jadhimah for such a long time that they would say: 'They will never part.' So when we were separated it was as if I and Malik - due to the length of unity - never spent a night together
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Mulaikah ne kaha: "Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr ka intiqaal Hubshi mein hua." Unhon ne kaha: "To unhen Makkah le jaaya gaya aur wahin dafn kiya gaya. Jab Aishah pahunchi, to wo Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr ki qabr ke paas aayin aur kaha: 'Hum Jadhimah ke do saathiyon ki tarah zamane ke ek arse tak sath rahe, yahan tak ke kaha jaata: Ye kabhi juda nahi honge. Jab hum juda hue, to aisa lagta hai maine aur Malik ne itni lambi rifaqat ke baad kabhi ek raat bhi saath nahi guzari.' Phir unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Agar main tumhare paas hoti to tumhein wahin dafn karti jahan tum mare, aur agar main hazir hoti to main tumhari ziyarat na karti.'"

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Indeed the Messenger of Allah cursed the women who visit the graves
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qabron ki bar-bar ziyarat karne wali auraton par la'nat ki. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Hassan bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne maana ke ye us waqt se pehle ka hai jab Nabi (SAW) ne qabron ki ziyarat ki rukhsat di, jab unhon ne rukhsat di to uski rukhsat mein mard aur auraten dono shaamil ho gaye. Aur kuch ne kaha: Auraton ke liye qabron ki ziyarat isliye napasand ki gayi kyunki unmein sabr kam hota hai aur betaabi zyada hoti hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet entered a grave during the night, so a torch was lit for him. He took it (the deceased) in from the direction of the Qiblah, and he said: 'May Allah have mercy upon you, you were often invoking (Allah) by reciting the Qur'an.' And he said: 'Allahu Akbar four times
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) raat ko ek qabr mein daakhil hue, to unke liye ek chiraag jalaya gaya, unhon ne mayyat ko Qibla ki taraf se liya aur kaha: "Allah tumpar reham kare, tum bahut aah bharne wale aur Quran ki tilawat karne wale the." Aur unhon ne chaar Takbir kahin. Is mauzu par Jabir aur Yazid bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai, jo Zaid bin Thabit ke unse bade bhai hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain, wo kehte hain: Mayyat ko qabr mein Qibla ki taraf se daakhil kiya jaaye. Aur kuch ne kaha: Use seedha khainch kar utaara jaaye. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne raat ko dafn karne ki rukhsat di hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"A funeral (procession) passed by the Messenger of Allah and they were praising him with good statements. So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Granted.' Then he said: 'You are Allah's witnesses on the earth
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas se ek janaza guzra, to logon ne uski achi tareef ki, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Wajib ho gayi.'" Phir farmaya: "Tum zameen par Allah ke gawaah ho." Is mauzu par Umar, Ka'b bin Ujrah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dill narrated:"I arrived in Al-Madinah and while I was sitting with Umar bin Al-Khattab they passed by with a funeral, over (a person) whom they were praising with good. Umar said: 'Granted.' I said to Umar: 'What is granted?' He said: 'I said as the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no Muslim about whom three bear witness, except that he is granted Paradise." He said: "And two (as well)." He said: 'We did not ask the Messenger of Allah about one
hi: Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dili ne kaha: "Main Madina aaya aur Umar bin Al-Khattab ke paas baitha, to unke paas se ek janaza guzra, logon ne uski achi tareef ki, to Umar ne kaha: 'Wajib ho gayi.'" Maine Umar se kaha: "'Wajib ho gayi' kya matlab?" Unhon ne kaha: "Main wahi keh raha hoon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha, unhon ne farmaya: 'Jis Musalman ke liye teen log gawaahi den, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Humne kaha: Aur do?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Aur do bhi." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek ke baare mein nahi pucha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dili ka naam Zalim bin Amr bin Sufyan hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Any Muslim who has lost three of his children will not be touched by the Fire, except for what will fulfill the oath
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke teen bachche nahi marte magar unhen aag chhoo nahi sakti, siwaye qasam poori karne ke liye jitni chhue." Is mauzu par Umar, Mu'adh, Ka'b bin Malik, Utbah bin Abd, Umm Sulaim, Jabir, Anas, Abu Dharr, Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Tha'labah Al-Ashja'i, Ibn Abbas, Uqbah bin Aamir, Abu Sa'eed, aur Qurrah bin Iyas Al-Muzani se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Tha'labah Al-Ashja'i ki Nabi (SAW) se sirf yehi ek hadith hai, aur wo Al-Khushani nahi hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has three that precede him (in death) while they did not reach the age of puberty, then they will be a well-fortified fortress for him against the Fire
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske teen bachche pehle chale jaayen jo baaligh na hue hon, wo uske liye aag se ek mazboot qila ban jaate hain." Abu Dharr ne kaha: "Maine do bheje hain." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aur do bhi." To Ubayy bin Ka'b, jo qariyon ke sardaar the, ne kaha: "Maine ek bheja hai." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aur ek bhi, lekin ye pehli chot ke waqt hai."

e: Abdurabbih bin Bariq Al-Hanafi said:"I heard my grandfather, the father of my mother, Simak bin Al-Walid Al-Hanadi narrating, that he heard Ibn Abbas narrated, that he heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Whoever has two predecessors (in death) among my Ummah, then Allah will admit them into Paradise."So Aishah said to him: "What about one from your Ummar who has one precessor?" He (pbuh) said: "And whoever has one predecessor O Muwaffaqqah!" So she said: "What about one who does not have a predecessor from your Ummah?" He said: "I am the predecessor for my Ummah: you will never suffer (in grief) for (the loss of) anyone similar to me
hi: Abdurabbih bin Bariq Al-Hanafi ne kaha: "Maine apne nana, apni maa ke waalid, Simak bin Al-Walid Al-Hanafi ko bayan karte suna, unhon ne Ibn Abbas ko bayan karte suna, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jiske do bachche pehle chale jaayen meri Ummat mein se, Allah unhen unki wajah se Jannat mein daakhil karega.' To Aishah ne unse kaha: 'Aur jiska ek bachcha pehle chala jaaye aapki Ummat mein se?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Aur jiska ek bhi ho, Ae Muwaffaqah!' Unhon ne kaha: 'Aur jiska koi bhi na ho aapki Ummat mein se?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To main hi meri Ummat ka aage jaane wala hoon, mujh jaisa unhen kabhi nahi milega.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The martyrs are five: Those who die of the plague, stomach illness, drowning, being crushed, and the martyr in the cause of Allah
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaheed paanch hain: Taun se marne wala, pet ki bimari se marne wala, doobne wala, dab kar marne wala, aur Allah ki raah mein shaheed hone wala." Is mauzu par Anas, Safwan bin Umayyah, Jabir bin Atik, Khalid bin Urfutah, Sulaiman bin Surad, Abu Musa, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Ishaq As-Sabi'i said:"Sulaiman bin Surad said to Khalid bin Urfutah - or, Khalid said to Sulaiman - 'Did you hear the Messenger of Allah saying: "Whoever is killed by his stomach then he will not be punished in the grave"?' One of them said to the other: "Yes
hi: Abu Ishaq As-Sabi'i ne kaha: "Sulaiman bin Surad ne Khalid bin Urfutah se kaha - ya Khalid ne Sulaiman se kaha - 'Kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna: Jise uska pet maare, use qabr mein azaab nahi diya jaata?' To unmein se ek ne doosre se kaha: 'Haan.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is mauzu mein hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Usamah bin Zaid narrated that:The Prophet mentioned the plague and said: "It is an abiding punishment or chastisement that was sent upon a group of the children of Isra'il. So when it occurs in a land while you are in it, then do not leave it. And when it occurs in a land while you are not in it, then do not enter it
hi: Usamah bin Zaid se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne taun ka zikr kiya aur farmaya: "Ye ek baaqi maandaa azaab hai - ya azaab - jo Bani Israel ke ek girohon par bheja gaya tha, to jab wo kisi zameen mein waqe ho aur tum wahan ho, to wahan se na nikalo, aur jab wo kisi zameen mein waqe ho aur tum wahan na ho, to wahan mat jaao." Is mauzu par Sa'd, Khuzaimah bin Thabit, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Jabir, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Usamah bin Zaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubadah bin As-Samit narrated that:The Prophet said: "Whoever loves to meet Allah, then Allah loves to meet him. And whoever dislikes meeting Allah, then Allah dislikes meeting him
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se milna pasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai." Is mauzu par Abu Musa, Abu Hurairah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ubadah bin As-Samit ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sa'd bin Hisham narrated that:Aishah mentioned that the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever loves to meet Allah, then Allah loves to meet him. And whoever dislikes meeting Allah, then Allah dislikes meeting him." She said: "O Messenger of Allah! All of us dislike death." He said: "It is not like that. But when the believer is given the good news of Allah's mercy, His pleasure, and His Paradise, then he loves to meet Allah and Allah loves to meet him. Whereas when the disbeliever is given the news of Allah's punishment and His wrath, he dislikes meeting Allah, and Allah dislikes meeting him
hi: Sa'd bin Hisham se riwayat hai ke Aishah ne zikr kiya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se milna pasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna napasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai." Unhon ne kaha: "To maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Hum sab maut ko napasand karte hain." Unhon ne farmaya: "Ye baat nahi, balki Momin ko jab Allah ki rehmat, uski raza, aur uski Jannat ki khushkhabri di jaati hai, to wo Allah se milna pasand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai. Aur Kafir ko jab Allah ke azaab aur uske gusse ki khabar di jaati hai, to wo Allah se milna napasand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna napasand karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jabir bin Samurah narrated:"A man killed himself, so the Prophet did not perform Salat over him
hi: Jabir bin Samurah se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne khud ko qatl kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne uski namaz-e-janaza nahi padhi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne kaha: Har us shakhs ki namaz padhi jaaye jo Qibla ki taraf namaz padhta ho, aur khud ko qatl karne wale ki bhi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Imam khud ko qatl karne wale ki namaz na padhe, aur Imam ke siwa koi aur uski namaz padh sakta hai.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah narrated from his father that:The Prophet was brought a (deceased) man to perform Salat over. So the Prophet said: "Pray for your companion; for indeed he had a debt upon him." Abu Qatadah said: "It shall be upon me." So the Messenger of Allah said: "To pay it off?" (He said: "To pay it off.") So he performed the prayer for him
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek aadmi laaya gaya taake uski namaz padhi jaaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne saathi ki namaz padho, kyunki uspar qarz hai." Abu Qatadah ne kaha: "Wo mere zimme hai." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ada karne ke saath?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ada karne ke saath." To unhon ne uski namaz padhi. Is mauzu par Jabir, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, aur Asma bint Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Qatadah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"A deceased man would be brought to the Messenger of Allah while a debt was due upon him. So he would say: 'Has he left anything to pay off his debt?' If he was told that he had left something to pay it then he would pray (the funeral prayer) for him. Otherwise he would tell the Muslims: 'Pray for your companion.' So when Allah granted him the victories, he stood and said: 'I am more worthy in the case of the believers than they themselves are. So whoever among the believers dies and leaves a debt behind, then it is up to me to fulfill it. And whoever leaves wealth behind, then it is for his heirs
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek marne wala aadmi laaya jaata jispar qarz hota, to wo poochhte: "Kya usne apne qarz ke liye kuch ada karne layak chhoda hai?" Agar unhen bataya jaata ke usne ada karne layak chhoda hai, to wo uski namaz padhte, warna Musalmanon se kehte: "Apne saathi ki namaz padho." Jab Allah ne unhen fatah ata ki, to wo khade hue aur farmaya: "Main Momino ke unke nafson se zyada haqdaar hoon, to jo Musalmanon mein se mar jaaye aur qarz chhode, to uska ada karna mujhpar hai, aur jo maal chhode, to wo uske waarison ke liye hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When the deceased - or he said when one of you - is buried, two angels, black and blue (eyed_ come to him. One of them is called Al-Munkar, and the other An-Nakir. They say: 'What did you used to say about this man?' So he says what he was saying (before death) 'He is Allah's slave and His Messenger. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.' So they say: 'We knew that you would say this.' Then his grave is expanded to seventy by seventy cubits, then it is illuminated for him. Then it is said to him: 'Sleep.' So he said: 'Can I return to my family to inform them?' They say: 'Sleep as a newlywed, whom none awakens but the dearest of his family.' Until Allah resurrects him from his resting place.""If he was a hypocrite he would say: 'I heard people saying something, so I said the same; I do not know.' So they said: 'We knew you would say that.' So the earth is told: 'Constrict him.' So it constricts around him, squeezing his ribs together. He continues being punished like that until Allah resurrects him from his resting place
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mayyat ko dafn kiya jaata hai - ya kaha: tum mein se koi - to uske paas do Farishte aate hain, kaale aur neeli aankhon waale, unmein se ek ko Munkar kaha jaata hai aur doosre ko Nakir. Wo poochhte hain: 'Is aadmi ke baare mein tum kya kehte the?' To wo kehta hai jo pehle kehta tha: 'Wo Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool hai, main gawaahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi aur Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain.' To wo kehte hain: 'Humein pehle se maloom tha ke tum ye kahoge.' Phir uski qabr mein sattar hath lambi aur sattar hath chaudi jagah kar di jaati hai, phir usmein roshni kar di jaati hai, phir usse kaha jaata hai: 'So jao.' To wo kehta hai: 'Kya main apne ghar walon ke paas laut kar unhen bata sakta hoon?' Wo kehte hain: 'Dulhe ki neend jaisi so jao, jise sirf uske sabse pyare ghar wale hi jagaate hain, yahan tak ke Allah use uski usi jagah se uthaaye.'" "Aur agar wo munafiq tha, to wo kehta: 'Maine logon ko kuch kehte suna, to maine bhi wahi kaha, mujhe nahi maloom.' To wo kehte: 'Humein pehle se maloom tha ke tum ye kahoge.' To zameen se kaha jaata hai: 'Ispar tang ho jaao.' To wo ispar tang ho jaati hai, yahan tak ke uski paslian ek doosre mein ghus jaati hain, aur wo isi tarah azaab paata rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah use uski usi jagah se uthaaye." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Zaid bin Thabit, Ibn Abbas, Al-Bara bin Aazib, Abu Ayyub, Anas, Jabir, Aishah, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai, sabne Nabi (SAW) se qabr ke azaab ke baare mein riwayat ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When a person dies, he is shown his place [both in the morning and the evening]. If he is one of the people of Paradise; he is shown his place among the people of Paradise, and if he one of the people of the Fire; he is shown his place among the people of the Fire. Then it is said to him: 'This is your place until Allah resurrects you on the Day of Judgment
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mayyat marta hai, to uski jagah subah aur shaam usse dikhaayi jaati hai, agar wo Jannat waalon mein se hai to Jannat waalon ki jagah, aur agar wo Jahannam waalon mein se hai to Jahannam waalon ki jagah, phir usse kaha jaata hai: 'Ye teri jagah hai, yahan tak ke Allah tujhe Qayamat ke din uthaaye.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Whoever consoles a person with an affliction, then he gets the same reward as him
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi museebat zada ko taziyat de, uske liye uske jaisa hi ajr hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise marfu' sirf Ali bin Aasim ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur kuch logon ne ise Muhammad bin Suqah se isi isnad se mauqoof riwayat ki aur marfu' nahi kiya. Aur kaha jaata hai ke Ali bin Aasim ko isi hadith ki wajah se sabse zyada museebat jhelni padi, log unpar naaraz hue.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "No Muslim dies on the day of Friday, nor the night of Friday, except that Allah protects him from the trials of the grave
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman Jumme ke din ya Jumme ki raat nahi marta, magar Allah use qabr ke fitne se bacha leta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad muttasil nahi. Rabi'ah bin Saif sirf Abu Abdur-Rahman Al-Hubuli se, Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat karte hain, aur humein Rabi'ah bin Saif ka Abdullah bin Amr se sunna maloom nahi.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said to him: "O Ali! Three are not to be delayed: Salat when it is due, the funeral when it is presented, and (marriage) for the single woman when someone compatible is found
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Teen cheezein der na ki jaayen: namaz jab uska waqt aa jaaye, janaza jab hazir ho jaaye, aur bewa aurat jab uske liye kuf'u mil jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur mujhe iska isnad muttasil nahi lagta.

e: Abu Barzah narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever consoles a bereaved mother, he will be clothes with a Burd in Paradise
hi: Abu Barzah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi gham-zada maa ko taziyat de, use Jannat mein ek chaadar pehnaayi jaayegi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad mazboot nahi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said, 'Allahu Akbar' over the deceased, so he raised his hands with the first Takbir, and he placed his right (hand) over his left
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek janaze ki Takbir kahi, to unhon ne pehli Takbir mein apne haath uthaaye aur dahina haath baayen par rakha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek aadmi har Takbir mein apne haath uthaaye janaze mein. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Wo sirf pehli baar apne haath uthaaye. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se zikr kiya gaya ke unhon ne kaha: Namaz-e-janaza mein wo apna dahina haath baayen par na rakhe. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Wo apna dahina haath baayen par rakhe jaise namaz mein karta hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Rakhna mujhe zyada pasand hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The believer's soul is suspended by his debt until it is settled for him
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki jaan uske qarz ke saath latki rehti hai yahan tak ke wo ada kar diya jaaye."

e: (Another chain) Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The believer's soul is suspended by his debt until it is settled for him
