hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se: "Momin ki jaan uske qarz ke saath latki rehti hai yahan tak ke wo ada kar diya jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur ye pehli se zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Ayyub narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Four are from the Sunan of the Messengers: Al-Hayat, using Atar, the Siwak, and marriage
hi: Abu Ayyub (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chaar cheezein Rusul ki Sunnaton mein se hain: haya, khushbu lagana, miswaak, aur nikah." Is mauzu par Uthman, Thawban, Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Najih, Jabir, aur Akkaf se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ayyub ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"We went with Allah's Messenger, while we were young men who had nothing. He said: 'O young men! You should marry, for indeed it helps in lowering the gaze and protecting the private parts. Whoever among you is not able to marry, then let him fast, for indeed fasting will diminish his sexual desire
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath nikle jabke hum naujawan the aur humare paas kuch nahi tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae naujawano! Tum par nikah zaroori hai, kyunki wo nazar ko neechi rakhta hai aur sharamgah ki hifazat karta hai. Aur jo tum mein se nikah na kar sake, wo roza rakhe, kyunki roza uske liye dhaal hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Qatadah narrated from Al-Hasan, from Samurah that:The Prophet prohibited celibacy
hi: Qatadah, Al-Hasan se, Samurah se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne tabattul se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Sa'd, Anas bin Malik, Aishah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab narrated from Sa'b bin Abi Waqqas:"The Messenger of Allah refused Uthman bin Ma'zun (when he asked) regarding celibacy, and if he had permitted it for him, then we would have castrated ourselves
hi: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uthman bin Maz'un ko tabattul se roka, aur agar unhon ne unhein ijazat di hoti to hum khud ko khassi kar lete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with proposes to (someone under the care) of one of you, then marry to him. If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and abounding discord (Fasad)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare paas koi aisa aadmi rishta le kar aaye jiske deen aur akhlaaq se tum raazi ho, to uska nikah kar do, agar tum aisa na karoge to zameen mein fitna aur bada fasaad hoga." Is mauzu par Abu Hatim Al-Muzani aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith mein Abdul-Hamid bin Sulaiman ke khilaaf riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hatim Al-Muzani narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with comes to you then marry (her to) him. If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and discord (Fasad). If you do not do so, then there will be turmoil (Fitnah) in the land and discord (Fasad)." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! What if there was something about him?" He said: "When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with comes to you then marry him." (And he (pbuh) said this) three times
hi: Abu Hatim Al-Muzani ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare paas koi aisa aadmi aaye jiske deen aur akhlaaq se tum raazi ho, to uska nikah kara do, agar tum aisa na karoge to zameen mein fitna aur fasaad hoga." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar usmein kuch hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare paas koi aisa aadmi aaye jiske deen aur akhlaaq se tum raazi ho, to uska nikah kara do." Teen martaba. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Hatim Al-Muzani ki sohbat rahi hai, aur humein unki Nabi (SAW) se sirf yehi ek hadith maloom hai.

e: Jabir narrated that:The Prophet said: "Indeed the woman is married for her religion, her wealth, and her beauty, so take the one with religion, and may your hands be dusty
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat se uske deen, uske maal, aur uske husn ki wajah se nikah kiya jaata hai, to tum deen waali ko pakdo, tumhare haath khaak-aalood hon." Is mauzu par Awf bin Malik, Aishah, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Bakr bin Abdullah Al-Muzani narrated that :Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah proposed to a woman, so the Prophet said: "Look at her, for indeed that is more likely to make things better between the two of you
hi: Bakr bin Abdullah Al-Muzani se riwayat hai ke Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne ek aurat ko rishta bheja, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Use dekh lo, kyunki ye tum donon ke darmiyan mohabbat rehne ke zyada qareeb hai." Is mauzu par Muhammad bin Maslamah, Jabir, Anas, Abu Humaid, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ko apnaya aur kaha: Use dekhne mein koi harj nahi jab tak koi haraam cheez na dekhi jaaye. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unke qaul "tum donon ke darmiyan mohabbat rehne ke zyada qareeb hai" ka matlab hai: tum donon ke darmiyan mohabbat zyada der tak qaayam rahegi.

e: Abu Al-Balj narrated from Muhammad bin Hatib Al-Jumahi who said that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The distinction between the lawful and the unlawful is the Duff and the voice
hi: Muhammad bin Hatib Al-Jumahi ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haraam aur halal ke darmiyan farq daf aur awaaz hai." Is mauzu par Aishah, Jabir, aur Ar-Rubaiyyi bint Muawwidh se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Hatib ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Balj ka naam Yahya bin Abi Sulaim hai, aur unhen Ibn Sulaim bhi kaha jaata hai. Aur Muhammad bin Hatib ne Nabi (SAW) ko dekha tha jabke wo ek chhote larke the.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Publicize this marriage, and hold it in the Masjid, and beat the Duff for it
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is nikah ka ailaan karo, ise masjidon mein karo, aur ispar daf bajaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye is mauzu mein ghareeb hasan hadith hai. Aur Isa bin Maimoon Al-Ansari hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur Isa bin Maimoon jo Ibn Abi Najih se tafseer riwayat karte hain, wo thiqah hain.

e: Ar-Rubai bint Muawwidh said:"The morning after the consummation of my marriage, the Prophet came and sat on my bed as far from me as you are sitting now, and our little girls started beating the Duff and reciting verses mourning my father who had been killed in the battle of Badr. One of them said: 'Among us is a Prophet who knows what will happen tomorrow.' On that the Prophet said: 'Stop saying this, and keep on saying what you were saying before
hi: Ar-Rubaiyyi bint Muawwidh ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye aur meri rukhsati ki subah mere paas daakhil hue, wo mere bistar par baithe jaise tum mere paas baithe ho, aur humari kuch chhoti bachchiyan apne daf bajaa rahi thin aur Badr ke din shaheed hue mere baap-daadaon ka zikr kar rahi thin, yahan tak ke unmein se ek ne kaha: 'Aur hum mein ek Nabi hain jo kal ki baat jaante hain.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse farmaya: 'Ye baat chhod do, aur wahi kaho jo isse pehle keh rahi thi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:When supplicating for the newlywed, the Prophet would say: (Barak Allahu laka wa baraka alaik, wa jama'a bainakuma fi khair.) "May Allah bless you and send blessings upon you, and bring goodness between you
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab kisi ki shaadi par mubarakbaad dete, to kehte: "Barakallahu Laka wa Baraka Alaika wa Jama'a Bainakuma Fi Khair" (Allah tumhein barkat de aur tumpar barkat naazil kare, aur tum donon ko bhalai mein jama kare). Is mauzu par Aqil bin Abi Talib se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "If anyone of you, when having sexual intercourse with his wife, says: (Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-Shaitana wa jannibish-Shaitana ma razaqtana) 'In the Name of Allah, O Allah! Protect me from Shaitan and protect what you bestow upon us from Shaitan' - then if Allah decrees that they should have a child, Shaitan will not be able to harm him
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum mein se koi apni biwi ke paas aaye to kahe: 'Bismillah, Allahumma Jannibnash-Shaitana wa Jannibish-Shaitana Ma Razaqtana' (Allah ke naam se, Ya Allah! Humein Shaitan se door rakh aur jo Tu humein de use bhi Shaitan se door rakh), to agar Allah unke darmiyan koi bachcha muqarrar kare, to Shaitan use nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah married me in Shawwal, and he took up residence with me in Shawwal
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse Shawwal mein nikah kiya, aur unhon ne meri rukhsati Shawwal mein hi ki." Aur Aishah ye pasand karti thin ke unki auraton ki rukhsati Shawwal mein ho. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Ath-Thawri ki, Ismail bin Umayyah se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:The Messenger of Allah saw some traces of saffron on `Abdur-Rahman bin `Awf so he said: 'What is this?' He said: 'I married a woman for the amount of gold equal to a date stone.' So he said: 'May Allah bless you. Have a banquet, even if with only one sheep
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abdur-Rahman bin Awf par zaafraan ka nishaan dekha, to farmaya: "Ye kya hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine ek aurat se ek khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sone mein nikah kiya hai." Unhon ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein barkat de, walima karo chahe ek bakri se hi ho." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, Jabir, aur Zuhair bin Uthman se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona teen dirham aur ek-tihaai ke barabar hota hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Ye paanch dirham aur ek-tihaai ke barabar hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Prophet had a banquet for Safiyyah bint Huyayy with Sawiq and dates
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Safiyyah bint Huyai ke liye sawiq aur khajoor se walima kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: (Another chain similar to the narration as no. 1095) :Others have reported this Hadith from Ibn Uyainah, from Az-Zuhri, from Anas, and they did not mention "from Wa'il, from his son Nawf" in it
hi: Kai logon ne ye hadith Ibn Uyainah se, Az-Zuhri se, Anas se riwayat ki, aur ismein "Wa'il se, unke bete se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sufyan bin Uyainah is hadith mein tadlees karte the, kabhi ismein "Wa'il se, unke bete se" ka zikr nahi karte the aur kabhi karte the.

e: Ibn Mas'ud narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Having food on the first day is was is obligatory, and having food on the second day is Sunnah, and having food on the third day is to be heard of, and whoever wants to be heard of, Allah will make him heard of
hi: Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pehle din ka khaana haq hai, doosre din ka khaana Sunnat hai, aur teesre din ka khaana dikhawa hai, aur jo dikhawa kare, Allah use ruswaa karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hum marfu' sirf Ziyad bin Abdullah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Ziyad bin Abdullah ki riwayaton mein bahut ajeeb aur munkar baatein hoti hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko Muhammad bin Uqbah se zikr karte suna, unhon ne kaha: Waki ne kaha: Ziyad bin Abdullah apni izzat ke bawajood hadith mein jhoot nahi bolte.

e: Ibn Umar narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Accept the invitation when you are offered
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhein dawat di jaaye, to dawat mein jao." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Hurairah, Al-Bara, Anas, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud narrated:"A man named Abu Shu'aib came to a slave of his, who was a butcher, and said: 'Prepare some food for me that will be sufficient for five, for I have seen hunger in the face of the Messenger of Allah.' So he prepared some food. Then he sent a message to the Prophet inviting him and those who were sitting with him. When the Prophet stood, he was followed by a man who was not with them when they were invited. When the Messenger of Allah arrive at the door he said to the owner of the house: 'A man who was not with us when you invited us followed us, if you permit him, he will enter.'" He said: We have permitted him, let him enter
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: "Abu Shu'aib naam ka ek aadmi apne qassab gulam ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Mere liye itna khaana banao jo paanch logon ke liye kaafi ho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre par bhook dekhi hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To usne khaana banaya, phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas paigham bheja aur unhen aur unke saath baithe logon ko bulaaya. Jab Nabi (SAW) khade hue, to ek aadmi unke peeche chal pada jo dawat ke waqt unke saath nahi tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) darwaze tak pahunche, to unhon ne ghar ke maalik se kaha: 'Ek aadmi humare peeche aaya hai jo humare saath nahi tha jab tumne humein bulaaya tha, agar tum ijazat do to wo daakhil ho jaaye.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Humne use ijazat de di, wo daakhil ho jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"I married a woman and went to the Prophet, he said: 'O Jabir! Have you married?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'A virgin or a matron?' I said: 'A matron.' He said: 'Why didn't you marry a young girl, so that you may play with her and she with you?' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Abdullah (his father) died and left behind seven - or nine - daughter, so I have brought someone who can look after them.'" (He said:) "So he supplicated for me
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Maine ek aurat se nikah kiya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tumne nikah kiya, Ae Jabir?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kunwaari ya bewa?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi, balki bewa.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kunwaari kyun na ki jiske saath tum khelte aur wo tumhare saath khelti?' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Abdullah intiqaal kar gaye aur saat ya nau betiyan chhod gaye, to main aisi laaya jo unki dekhbhaal kar sake.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne mere liye dua ki." Is mauzu par Ubayy bin Ka'b aur Ka'b bin Ujrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Abdullah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Musa narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no marriage except with a Wali
hi: Abu Musa se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Imran bin Husain, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whichever woman married without the permission of her Wali her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If he entered into her, then the Mahr is for her in lieu of what he enjoyed from her private part. If they disagree, then the Sultan is the Wali for one who has no Wali
hi: Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat apne wali ki ijazat ke bagair nikah kare, to uska nikah baatil hai, uska nikah baatil hai, uska nikah baatil hai. Agar usne uske saath sambhog kiya ho, to uske liye mahr hai jo usne uski sharamgah se haasil kiya, aur agar unmein jhagda ho, to Sultan uska wali hai jiska koi wali na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :the Prophet said: "The adulteresses are the ones who marry themselves without Bayyinah (proof)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bad-chalan auraten wo hain jo bina gawaah ke apna nikah khud karti hain."

e: (Another chain) from Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah, with similar (narration), :And he did not narrate it in Marfu form, and this is more correct
hi: Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah se, isi jaisi, lekin marfu' nahi kiya. Aur ye zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith mehfooz nahi, hum kisi ko nahi jaante jisne ise marfu' kiya ho siwaye Abdul-A'la ki, Sa'eed se, Qatadah se marfu' riwayat ke. Aur Abdul-A'la se, Sa'eed se ye hadith mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai, aur sahih wo hai jo Ibn Abbas se unka apna qaul riwayat hai: \"Gawaah ke bagair nikah nahi.\" Isi tarah Qatadah ke saathiyon ne Qatadah se, Jabir bin Zaid se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki: \"Gawaah ke bagair nikah nahi.\" Aur isi tarah kai logon ne Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah se isi jaisi mauqoof riwayat ki hai. Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain, Anas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke Tabi'een aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: \"Gawaahon ke bagair nikah nahi.\" Unmein se guzre huon ka ismein koi ikhtilaaf nahi, siwaye kuch baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf sirf ismein hai ke agar ek gawaah doosre ke baad gawaahi de, to zyada tar Kufa waalon aur doosron ke nazdeek nikah jaayez nahi jab tak donon gawaah nikah ke aqad ke waqt saath saath gawaahi na den. Aur kuch Madina waalon ne dekha ke agar ek doosre ke baad gawaah bane, to ye jaayez hai agar wo ise zaahir karen. Aur ye Malik bin Anas aur doosron ka qaul hai. Isi tarah Ishaq ne Madina waalon se naqal kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Ek mard aur do auraton ki gawaahi nikah mein jaayez hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"The Messenger of Allah taught us the Tashah-hud for Salat and the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah." He said: "The Tashah-hud for Salat is: (At-Tahiyyatulilah, was-walawtu wat-tayyibatu. As-Salamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullilahi wa barakatuhu, As-Salamu alina wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ashahadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduha wa Raduluh.) 'All greetings, prayers, and pure words are for Allah. Peace be upon you O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and all of the righteous worshippers of Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshiped but Allah. and I testify that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger."And the Tashah-hud for Al-Hajjah is: 'Indeed all praise is due to Allah, we seek His aid, and we seek His forgiveness, and we seek refuge with Allah from the evils of our souls and the mischief of our deeds. (Innal-Hamdlillahi nasta'inuhu, wa nastaghfirhu, wa na'udhu billahi min sharuri anfusina, wa sayy'ita a'malina, man yahdihi, sala mudilla lahu, wa manyudlil, fala Hadiya lahu, wa ashadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Rasuluh) 'Whoever He guides - meaning Allah - then here is none to lead him astray, and whomever He misleads, then there is no guide for him. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His worshipper and Messenger.'" He said: "And he recited three Ayat
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein namaz ka tashahhud aur zaroorat ka tashahhud sikhaya, farmaya: 'Namaz ka tashahhud: At-Tahiyyatu Lillahi Was-Salawatu Wat-Tayyibatu, As-Salamu Alaika Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu, As-Salamu Alaina wa Ala Ibadillahis-Salihin, Ashhadu An La Ilaha Illallah wa Ashhadu Anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasooluh.' Aur zaroorat ka tashahhud: 'Innal-Hamda Lillahi Nasta'inuhu wa Nastaghfiruhu wa Na'oodhu Billahi Min Shuroori Anfusina wa Sayyi'ati A'malina, Man Yahdihillahu Fala Mudilla Lah, wa Man Yudlil Fala Hadiya Lah, wa Ashhadu An La Ilaha Illallah wa Ashhadu Anna Muhammadan Abduhu wa Rasooluh.'" Aur teen Ayaten padhi jaati hain. Abthar ne kaha: To Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne humein unki tafseer batayi: "(Allah se daro jaisa darne ka haq hai, aur na maro magar is haal mein ke tum Musalman ho)." "(Us Allah se daro jiske naam par tum ek doosre se maangte ho, aur rishton ka bhi khayal rakho, beshak Allah tumpar nigraan hai)." "(Allah se daro aur seedhi baat kaho)." Is mauzu par Adiyy bin Hatim se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah ki hadith hasan hai, Al-A'mash ne ise Abu Ishaq se, Abu Al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Shu'bah ne ise Abu Ishaq se, Abu Ubaidah se, Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur donon hadithein sahih hain kyunki Isra'il ne inhen jama kiya aur kaha: Abu Ishaq se, Abu Al-Ahwas aur Abu Ubaidah se, Abdullah bin Mas'ud se, Nabi (SAW) se. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Nikah bina khutbe ke jaayez hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur doosre ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Every Khutbah that does not have the Tashah-hud in it, then it is like a severed hand
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har khutba jismein tashahhud na ho, wo katee hui haath jaisa hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "A matron should not be given in marriage until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be given in marriage until her permission is sought, and her silence is her permission
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bewa aurat ka nikah tab tak na kiya jaaye jab tak uski raay na li jaaye, aur kunwaari ka nikah tab tak na kiya jaaye jab tak uski ijazat na li jaaye, aur uski ijazat uski khaamoshi hai." Is mauzu par Umar, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, aur Al-Urs bin Amirah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke bewa ka nikah tab tak na kiya jaaye jab tak uski raay na li jaaye, aur agar waalid ne uski raay liye bagair uska nikah kar diya aur usne isse napasand kiya, to zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek nikah fasakh ho jaata hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka kunwaariyon ke nikah ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jab waalid unka nikah karte hain, zyada tar Kufa waalon aur doosron ke nazdeek: agar waalid ne baaligh kunwaari ka nikah uski marzi ke bagair kiya aur usne waalid ke nikah se raazi na hokar isse napasand kiya, to nikah fasakh ho jaata hai. Aur kuch Madina waalon ne kaha: Waalid ka kunwaari ka nikah karna jaayez hai chahe wo napasand kare. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The matron has more right to herself than her Wali, and the virgin is to give permission for herself, and her silence is her permission
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bewa aurat khud apne bare mein apne wali se zyada haqdaar hai, aur kunwaari se uski ijazat li jaati hai, aur uski ijazat uski khaamoshi hai." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne ye hadith Malik bin Anas se riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch logon ne wali ke bagair nikah jaayez maanne mein isi hadith se dalil li hai, lekin is hadith mein wo baat nahi jo unhon ne dalil li hai, kyunki Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hai: \"Wali ke bagair nikah nahi,\" aur isi tarah Ibn Abbas ne Nabi (SAW) ke baad fatwa diya, unhon ne kaha: \"Wali ke bagair nikah nahi.\" Aur Nabi (SAW) ke qaul \"Bewa khud apne bare mein apne wali se zyada haqdaar hai\" ka matlab, zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek, ye hai ke wali uska nikah uski raazi mandi aur uske hukum ke bagair na kare, agar usne uska nikah kar diya to nikah fasakh hai, jaisa Khansa bint Khidam ki hadith mein hai jahan unke waalid ne unka nikah kiya jabke wo bewa thin, to unhon ne isse napasand kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unka nikah radd kar diya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "An orphan is to be consulted about herself, then if she is silent that is her permission, and if she refuses, then do not authorize it (the marriage) for her" (meaning: when she attains the age of puberty and refuses it)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yateem ladki se uske bare mein raay li jaati hai, agar wo khaamosh rahe to yehi uski ijazat hai, aur agar wo inkar kare to uspar koi jaayaz nahi." Is mauzu par Abu Musa, Ibn Umar, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka yateem ladki ke nikah ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne dekha ke agar yateem ladki ka nikah kiya jaaye, to nikah tab tak ruka rahega jab tak wo baaligh na ho jaaye, jab wo baaligh ho jaaye to usse ikhtiyar hai ke nikah ko jaayaz karaar de ya fasakh kare. Aur ye kuch Tabi'een aur doosron ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Yateem ladki ka nikah jaayez nahi jab tak wo baaligh na ho jaaye, aur nikah mein ikhtiyar jaayez nahi. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, aur doosre ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Agar yateem ladki nau saal ki ho jaaye aur uska nikah kiya jaaye aur wo raazi ho jaaye, to nikah jaayez hai aur usse koi ikhtiyar nahi jab wo baaligh ho jaaye. Aur unhon ne Aishah ki hadith se dalil li ke Nabi (SAW) ne unke saath rukhsati ki jabke wo nau saal ki thin. Aur Aishah ne kaha: Jab ladki nau saal ki ho jaaye to wo aurat hai.

e: Samurah bin Jundab narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Whichever woman is given in marriage by two Wali, then her case is in accordance with the first of them, and whoever sells something to two men, then it is for the first of them
hi: Samurah bin Jundab se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat ka nikah do wali karen, to wo pehle wale ki hai, aur jo koi ek cheez do aadmiyon ko beche, to wo pehle wale ki hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, humein unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi ke agar do walion mein se ek ne doosre se pehle nikah kar diya, to pehle ka nikah jaayez hai aur doosre ka fasakh, aur agar donon ne ek saath nikah kar diya, to dono ka nikah fasakh hai. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that:The Prophet said: "Whichever slave gets married without the permission of his owner, then he is a fornicator
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jo gulam apne maalik ki ijazat ke bagair nikah kare, wo zaani hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke gulam ka apne maalik ki ijazat ke bagair nikah jaayez nahi. Aur ye Ahmad, Ishaq, aur doosron ka qaul hai bagair kisi ikhtilaaf ke.

e: (Another chain) Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that:Abdullah narrated that the Prophet said: "Whichever slave gets married without the permission of his owner, then he is a fornicator
hi: Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se: "Jo gulam apne maalik ki ijazat ke bagair nikah kare, wo zaani hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr bin Rabi'ah narrated from his father:"A woman from Banu Fazarah was married for (the dowry of) two sandals. So the Messenger of Allah said to her: 'Do you approve of (exchanging) yourself and your wealth for two sandals?' She said: 'Yes.'" He said: "So he permitted it
hi: Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabi'ah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Banu Fazarah ki ek aurat ne do jooton ke badle nikah kiya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya tum apni jaan aur apne maal ko do jooton ke badle raazi ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." To unhon ne isse ijazat de di. Is mauzu par Umar, Abu Hurairah, Sahl bin Sa'd, Abu Sa'eed, Anas, Aishah, Jabir, aur Abu Hadrad Al-Aslami se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aamir bin Rabi'ah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka mahr ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Mahr jispar dono raazi hon. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Mahr chautahai dinar se kam nahi hoga. Aur kuch Kufa waalon ne kaha: Mahr das dirham se kam nahi hoga.

e: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi narrated that:A woman came to the Messenger of Allah and said: "I present myself to you (for marriage)." So she stood for a long time. Then a man said: "O Messenger of Allah! Marry her to me if you have no need of her." So he said: "Do you have anything to give her as a dowry?" He said: "I have nothing except this Izar." So the Messenger of Allah said: "If you give her your Izar then you will have no Izar, so search for something." He said: "I did not find anything." He said: "Search for something, even if it just an iron ring." He said: So he searched but he did not find anything. The Messenger of Allah said: "Do you have any Qur'an (memorized)?" He said: "Yes. This Surat and that Surat." And he named the Surat. So the Messenger of Allah said: "I marry her to you for what you have (memorized) of the Qur'an
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek aurat aayi aur kaha: "Maine apni jaan aap ko sonp di." To wo der tak khadi rahi. Ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar aapko iski zaroorat na ho to iska nikah mujhse kara dijiye." Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare paas kuch hai jo tum ise mahr mein do?" Usne kaha: "Mere paas sirf ye tehband hai." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum apna tehband use de doge to tum bina tehband ke baithoge, to koi aur cheez talaash karo." Usne kaha: "Mujhe kuch nahi mil raha." Unhon ne farmaya: "Talaash karo chahe ek loha ki anguthi hi ho." To usne talaash ki aur kuch na paaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein Quran mein se kuch yaad hai?" Usne kaha: "Haan, fulaan Surah aur fulaan Surah," aur unhon ne Surahon ke naam liye. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumse iska nikah us Quran ke badle kara diya jo tumhein yaad hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne isi hadith ko apnaya, unhon ne kaha: Agar uske paas mahr dene ke liye kuch na ho aur usne Quran ki ek Surah ke badle nikah kiya, to nikah jaayez hai aur wo use Quran ki ek Surah sikhaaye. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Nikah jaayez hai aur uske liye uski jaisi auraton ka mahr muqarrar kiya jaaye. Aur ye Kufa waalon, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Al-Ajfa (As-Salami) said:"Umar bin Al-Khattab said: 'Do not exaggerate in the dowries of women. If doing so was honorable in the world or Taqwa before Allah then Allah's Prophet would have been the first of you to do it. I do not know of the Messenger of Allah marrying any of his women, nor giving any of his daughters in marriage, for more than twelve Uqiyah
hi: Abu Al-Ajfa As-Salami ne kaha: "Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: 'Suno! Auraton ke mahr mein zyaadti mat karo, kyunki agar ye duniya mein izzat ki baat hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek taqwa hoti, to Allah ke Nabi (SAW) tum sabse zyada iske haqdaar hote. Mujhe nahi maloom Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni kisi biwi se nikah kiya ho ya apni kisi beti ka nikah kiya ho baarah uqiya se zyada mein.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Ajfa As-Salami ka naam Haram hai. Aur uqiya ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek chalis dirham ki hoti hai, aur baarah uqiya char sau assi dirham hoti hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated:"The Messenger of Allah emancipated Safiyyah and he made her emancipation her dowry
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Safiyyah ko azaad kiya aur unki azaadi ko hi unka mahr banaya. Is mauzu par Safiyyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne napasand kiya ke uski azaadi ko hi uska mahr banaya jaaye, balki azaadi ke alawa uske liye ek alag mahr muqarrar kiya jaaye. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa narrated from his father that the Messenger of Allah said:"Three will receive their reward twice: A slave who fulfills the rights of Allah and the rights of his owners, then he will be given his reward twice. And a man who has a beautiful slave girl, so he teaches her good manners, then he frees her, then he married her seeking the Face of Allah by that; then he will be given his reward twice. And a man who believed in an earlier Book, then another Book came to him and he believed in it; then he will be given his reward twice
hi: Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen log doharaa ajr paate hain: ek gulam jo Allah ka haq aur apne maalikon ka haq ada kare, use doharaa ajr milta hai. Aur ek aadmi jiske paas ek khoobsurat laundi ho, wo usse achi tarbiyat de, phir use azaad kare, phir usse nikah kare, Allah ki raza chahte hue, use bhi doharaa ajr milta hai. Aur ek aadmi jo pehli Kitab par imaan laaya, phir doosri Kitab aayi to usmein bhi imaan laaya, use bhi doharaa ajr milta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Musa ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa ka naam Aamir bin Abdullah bin Qais hai.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather that:The Prophet said: "Whichever man married a woman and entered into her, then it is not lawful for him to marry her daughter. If he did not enter into her then he may marry her daughter. And whichever man married a woman and he entered into her, or he did not enter into her, then it is not lawful for him to marry her mother
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis aadmi ne kisi aurat se nikah karke uske saath sambhog kiya ho, uske liye uski beti se nikah karna jaayez nahi, aur agar usne uske saath sambhog na kiya ho, to wo uski beti se nikah kar sakta hai. Aur jis aadmi ne kisi aurat se nikah kiya ho, chahe usne uske saath sambhog kiya ho ya na kiya ho, uske liye uski maa se nikah karna jaayez nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith apne isnad ki wajah se sahih nahi. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Agar aadmi ne kisi aurat se nikah kiya, phir use talaaq de di sambhog se pehle, to uske liye uski beti se nikah karna jaayez hai, aur agar aadmi ne beti se nikah kiya aur use talaaq de di sambhog se pehle, to uske liye uski maa se nikah karna jaayez nahi, Allah Ta'ala ke qaul \"(Aur tumhari biwiyon ki maaon)\" ki wajah se. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The wife of Rifa'ah Al-Qurzi came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'I was with Rifa'ah and he divorced me irrevocably. Then I married Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair, but he only has the likes of the fringe of a garment.' So he said: 'Perhaps you want me to return to Rifa'ah? No, not until you taste his sweetness, and he tastes your sweetness
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Rifa'ah Al-Qurazi ki biwi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Main Rifa'ah ke nikah mein thi, unhon ne mujhe talaaq de di aur meri talaaq poori kar di, to maine Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zubair se nikah kiya, lekin unke paas sirf kapde ke jhaalar jaisa hi kuch hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tum Rifa'ah ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Nahi, jab tak tum uska maza na chakh lo aur wo tumhara maza na chakh le.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Anas, Ar-Rumaisa ya Al-Ghumaisa, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar aadmi apni biwi ko teen talaaqein de, phir wo kisi aur se nikah kare, phir wo use sambhog se pehle talaaq de de, to wo pehle shohar ke liye halal nahi hogi jab tak doosre shohar ne uske saath sambhog na kiya ho.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah and Ali narrated:"The Messenger of Allah cursed the Muhill and the one the Muhallal was done for
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muhallil aur jiske liye muhallal kiya jaaye, dono par la'nat ki." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Jabir ki hadith mualla hai. Isi tarah Ash'ath bin Abdur-Rahman ne Mujalid se, Aamir se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, aur Aamir ne Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur is hadith ka isnad mazboot nahi kyunki Mujalid bin Sa'eed ko kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kamzor qarar diya hai, unmein Ahmad bin Hanbal shaamil hain. Aur Abdullah bin Numair ne ye hadith Mujalid se, Aamir se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki. Aur ismein Ibn Numair se galti hui hai, pehli hadith zyada sahih hai. Aur Mughirah aur Ibn Abi Khalid aur kai doosron ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated:"The Messenger of Allah cursed the Muhill and the one the Muhallal was done for
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muhallil aur jiske liye muhallal kiya jaaye, dono par la'nat ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Qais Al-Awdi ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Tharwan hai. Aur ye hadith Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab, Uthman bin Affan, Abdullah bin Umar, aur doosre shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Tabi'een fuqaha ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Al-Jarud bin Muadh ko Waki se zikr karte suna, unhon ne kaha: Isi ka qaayal hoon, aur kaha: Is mauzu mein ahl-e-raay ke qaul ko phenk dena chahiye. Jarud ne kaha: Waki ne kaha aur Sufyan ne kaha: Agar aadmi ne kisi aurat se sirf halal karne ke liye nikah kiya, phir usse rakhne ka khayal aaya, to use rakhna uske liye tab tak jaayez nahi jab tak wo ek naye nikah se uska nikah na kare.

e: Ali bin Abi Talib narrated:"The Prophet prohibited the Mut'ah with women, and the meat of domestic donkeys during (the campaign of) Khaibar
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne auraton se Mut'ah karne se aur ghar ke gadhon ke gosht se Khaibar ke waqt mana kiya. Is mauzu par Sabrah Al-Juhani aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur Ibn Abbas se Mut'ah ki rukhsat ki kuch baat riwayat hui hai, phir wo apne qaul se palat gaye jab unhen Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein khabar mili. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ka hukum Mut'ah ke haraam hone par hai, aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Muhammad bin Ka'b narrated that:Ibn Abbas said: "Mut'ah was only during the beginning of Islam. A man would arrive in a land that he was not familiar with so he would marry a woman for the extent of time that he thought he would remain there. So his Mut'ah was upheld and his case was fine until the (following) Ayah was revealed: Except their wives or what their right hands possess. Then every private part other than those became unlawful
hi: Muhammad bin Ka'b, Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Mut'ah Islam ki shuruat mein thi, aadmi kisi shehar mein aata jahan uski koi jaan-pehchaan na hoti, to wo utne waqt ke liye ek aurat se nikah karta jitne waqt wo wahan rehne ka soch raha hota, to wo uska saamaan aur uski cheezein sambhaalti, yahan tak ke ye Ayat nazil hui: '(Siwaye apni biwiyon ke ya jo unke daahine haath ke maalik hon)' - Ibn Abbas ne kaha: To in donon ke siwa har sharamgah haraam hai."

e: Imran bin Husain narrated that :The Prophet said: "There is no Jalab, no Janab, and no Shighar in Islam. And whoever takes some property by force, then he is not from us
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam mein jalab nahi, janab nahi, aur shighar nahi, aur jo koi cheez lootlekar chheene, wo hum mein se nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Anas, Abu Raihanah, Ibn Umar, Jabir, Muawiyah, Abu Hurairah, aur Wa'il bin Hujr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"The Prophet prohibited Shighar
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne shighar se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo shighar nikah ko jaayez nahi maante. Aur shighar ye hai ke aadmi apni beti ka nikah is shart par kare ke doosra bhi apni beti ya behen ka nikah usse kare, aur unmein koi mahr na ho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Shighar ka nikah fasakh hai aur jaayez nahi, chahe unke liye koi mahr muqarrar kiya jaaye. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ata bin Abi Rabah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha: Unka nikah baaqi rakha jaaye aur unke liye unki jaisi auraton ka mahr muqarrar kiya jaaye. Aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet prohibited marrying a woman along with her paternal aunt or along with her maternal aunt
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aurat ka nikah uski phuphi ya khaala ke saath ek waqt mein ho. Aur Abu Hariz ka naam Abdullah bin Husain hai. Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Umar, Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Umamah, Jabir, Aishah, Abu Musa, aur Samurah bin Jundab se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prohibited that a woman be married along with her paternal aunt, or the paternal aunt along with her brother's daughter, or a woman with her maternal aunt, or the maternal aunt along with her sister's daughter, and the younger is not to be married with the older, nor the older with the younger
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aurat ka nikah uski phuphi ke saath ho, ya phuphi ka uske bhatije ki beti ke saath, ya aurat ka uski khaala ke saath, ya khaala ka uski behen ki beti ke saath ek waqt mein. Chhoti ka nikah badi ke saath ek waqt mein na ho, na badi ka chhoti ke saath. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, humein unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi ke aadmi ke liye aurat aur uski phuphi ya khaala ko ikattha karna jaayez nahi, agar usne aurat ka nikah uski phuphi ya khaala ke saath kiya, ya phuphi ka uske bhatije ki beti ke saath, to unmein se doosre ka nikah fasakh hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ash-Sha'bi ne Abu Hurairah ko paaya aur unse riwayat ki. Maine Muhammad se isi baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ash-Sha'bi ne ek aadmi se, Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed the conditions most deserving to be fulfilled are those that make the private parts lawful among you
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse zyada poori karne ke laayak sharten wo hain jinke zariye tumne sharamgahon ko halal kiya hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi ne kisi aurat se nikah kiya aur shart rakhi ke wo use uske shehar se bahar na le jaaye, to usse use bahar le jaane ka haq nahi. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ki shart uski shart se pehle hai. Goya unhon ne dekha ke shohar ko use bahar le jaane ka haq hai, chahe usne shohar se shart rakhi ho ke wo use bahar na le jaaye. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ko chuna hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kuch Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"Ghilan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi accepted Islam and he had ten wives in Jahiliyyah who accepted Islam along with him. So the Prophet ordered (him) to chose four (of them)
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Ghailan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi Musalman hue aur unki das biwiyan Jahiliyyah mein thin, unhon ne bhi unke saath Islam qabool kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen hukum diya ke wo unmein se chaar chun len. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Ma'mar ne Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: Ye hadith mehfooz nahi, aur sahih wo hai jo Shu'aib bin Abi Hamzah aur doosron ne Az-Zuhri se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Mujhe Muhammad bin Suwaid Ath-Thaqafi se bataya gaya ke Ghailan bin Salamah Musalman hue jabke unke paas das biwiyan thin. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Az-Zuhri ki hadith, Salim se, apne walid se, ye hai ke Thaqif ke ek aadmi ne apni biwiyon ko talaaq de di, to Umar ne unse kaha: \"Ya to apni biwiyon se rujoo karo, ya main tumhari qabr ko sangsaar karoonga jaise Abu Righal ki qabr ko sangsaar kiya gaya.\" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur humare saathiyon, unmein Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq shaamil hain, ke nazdeek Ghailan bin Salamah ki hadith par amal hai.

e: Abu Wahb Al-Jaishani narrated that:He heard Ibn Fairuz Ad-Dhailami narrating from his father: "I went to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I accepted Islam and I had two sisters (as wives).' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Chose whichever of them you will
hi: Abu Wahb Al-Jaishani se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Ibn Fairuz Ad-Dailami ko apne walid se riwayat karte suna: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine Islam qabool kiya aur mere nikah mein do behnein hain.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo tum chaho unmein se chun lo.'"

e: Abu Wahb Al-Jaishani narrated from Ad-Dhahhak bin Fairuz Ad-Dailami from his father:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I accepted Islam and I had two sisters (as wives).' So Messenger of Allah said: 'Chose whichever of them you will
hi: Abu Wahb Al-Jaishani, Ad-Dahhak bin Fairuz Ad-Dailami se, apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine Islam qabool kiya aur mere nikah mein do behnein hain.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo tum chaho unmein se chun lo.'" Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Wahb Al-Jaishani ka naam Ad-Dailam bin Hausha hai.

e: Ruwaifi bin Thabit narrated that :the Prophet said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then he does not levy his water on someone else's child
hi: Ruwaifi bin Thabit se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, wo apna paani kisi doosre ke bachche ko na de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi Ruwaifi bin Thabit se riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke agar aadmi hamla laundi khareede, to wo uske saath tab tak sambhog na kare jab tak wo bachcha na jan de. Is mauzu par Abu Ad-Darda, Ibn Abbas, Al-Irbad bin Sariyah, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated:"We got some captives on the day of Awtas, and they had husbands among their peopled. They mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah, so the following was revealed: And women who are already married, except those whom your right hands posses
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ne kaha: "Humein Autas ke din kuch qaidi milen jinke apni qaum mein shohar the, to unhon ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr ki, to ye Ayat nazil hui: '(Aur shaadi-shuda auraten, siwaye jo tumhare daahine haath ke maalik hon)'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari narrated:"The Messenger of Allah prohibited the price of a dog, the dowry of a fornicator, and the payment made to the fortune-teller
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutte ki qeemat, zaani aurat ki kamaai, aur kaahin ki ujrat se mana kiya." Is mauzu par Rafi bin Khadij, Abu Juhaifah, Abu Hurairah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "A man is not to sell over his brother's sale, nor is he to propose to whom his brother has proposed
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi aadmi apne bhai ki khareed-farokht par khareed-farokht na kare, aur na apne bhai ke rishte par rishta bheje." Is mauzu par Samurah aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Malik bin Anas ne kaha: \"Apne bhai ke rishte par rishta bhejna\" napasand karne ka matlab ye hai ke jab aadmi kisi aurat ko rishta bheje aur wo raazi ho jaaye, to kisi aur ke liye uske rishte par rishta bhejna jaayez nahi. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Is hadith ka matlab \"Aadmi apne bhai ke rishte par rishta na bheje\" - humare nazdeek ye hai ke jab aadmi kisi aurat ko rishta bheje aur wo raazi ho jaaye aur uski taraf jhuk jaaye, to kisi aur ke liye uske rishte par rishta bhejna jaayez nahi, lekin uski raazi mandi ya jhukaav maloom hone se pehle, use rishta bhejne mein koi harj nahi, aur iski dalil Fatimah bint Qais ki hadith hai jab wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayin aur unse zikr kiya ke Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifah aur Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ne unhein rishta bheja, to unhon ne farmaya: \"Abu Jahm to aisa aadmi hai jo auraton se apni laathi neechi nahi karta, aur Muawiyah faqeer hai, uske paas maal nahi, lekin Usamah se nikah karo.\" To is hadith ka matlab, humare nazdeek, Allah zyada jaanta hai, ye hai ke Fatimah ne unhen apni raazi mandi in donon mein se kisi ek ke baare mein nahi batayi thi, aur agar unhon ne batayi hoti, to wo unhen isse alag kisi aur ki taraf ishara na karte jo unhon ne zikr kiya.

e: Abu Bakr bin Al-Jahm narrated:"Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman and I visited Fatimah bint Qais. She narrated to us that her husband had divorced her three times, and he did not leave her with anywhere to live nor any wealth. She said: 'He left ten Aqfizah for me with the son of his uncle: five were of barley, five of wheat.' She said: 'I went to the Messenger of Allah and mentioned that to him.' She said: 'He said: 'He is correct.'" (She said: ) 'So he ordered me to complete my Iddah in the home of Umm Sharik. But then the Messenger of Allah said to me: "Umm Sharik's home is visited by Muhajirun, so spend your Iddah in the home of Ibn Umm Maktum, for there you can remove your garments and he will not see you. Then when your Iddah is completed and someone proposed to you come to me." 'So when my Iddah completed. Abu Jahm and Mu'awiyah proposed to me.' She said: 'I went to the Messenger of Allah and mentioned that to him, and he said: "As for Mu'awiyah, he is a man with no wealth, and as for Abu Jahm he is a man who is harsh with women." She said: 'Then Usamah bin Zaid proposed to me, and he married me. So Allah blessed me with Usamah
hi: Abu Bakr bin Al-Jahm ne kaha: "Main aur Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman, Fatimah bint Qais ke paas gaye, to unhon ne humein bataya ke unke shohar ne unhen teen talaaq de di aur unke liye na rehne ki jagah di na nafqa. Unhon ne kaha: 'Aur unhon ne mere liye das aqfiza rakh diye unke chacha zaad ke paas, paanch jau aur paanch gehun.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unse ye zikr kiya.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To unhon ne farmaya: Usne sach kaha.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To unhon ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Umm Shareek ke ghar mein apni iddat guzaroon. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: Umm Shareek ka ghar wo ghar hai jahan Muhajireen aate hain, lekin tum Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein apni iddat guzaro, kyunki wahan tum apne kapde utaar sakti ho aur wo tumhein nahi dekhega, aur jab tumhari iddat khatam ho jaaye aur koi tumhein rishta bheje, to mujhe zaroor bataana.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Jab meri iddat khatam hui, to Abu Jahm aur Muawiyah ne mujhe rishta bheja.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unse ye zikr kiya, to unhon ne farmaya: Muawiyah to aisa aadmi hai jiske paas maal nahi, aur Abu Jahm to auraton par sakht hai.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Phir Usamah bin Zaid ne mujhe rishta bheja to unhon ne mujhse nikah kiya, to Allah ne Usamah mein mere liye barkat di.'" Ye hadith sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne ye hadith Abu Bakr bin Al-Jahm se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai aur usmein izafa kiya, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Usamah se nikah karo."

e: Jabir narrated:"We said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We practice Azl, but the Jews claim that it is minor infanticide.' So he said: 'The Jews lie. When Allah wants to create it, nothing can prevent Him
hi: Jabir ne kaha: "Humne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum azl karte the, to Yahudiyon ka khayal tha ke ye chhoti maut hai.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Yahudi jhoot bolte hain, Allah jab kisi ko paida karna chahta hai, to koi use rok nahi sakta.'" Is mauzu par Umar, Al-Bara, Abu Hurairah, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated:"We practiced Azl while the Qur'an was being revealed
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Hum azl karte the jabke Quran naazil ho raha tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne azl ki rukhsat di hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Azaad aurat se azl ke baare mein uski raay li jaaye, laundi se raay nahi li jaati.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"Azl was mentined before the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'Why would one of you do that?
hi: Abu Sa'eed ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne azl ka zikr hua, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se koi aisa kyun karta hai?' Ibn Abi Umar ne apni hadith mein izafa kiya, aur nahi kaha 'tum mein se koi na kare.' Donon ne apni hadith mein kaha: 'Kyunki koi jaan aisi nahi jise paida hona ho magar Allah hi uska Khaliq hai.'" Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Abu Sa'eed se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne azl ko napasand kiya hai.

e: Abu Qilabah narrated from Anas bin Malik, :He (Abu Qilabah) said: "If I wish, I could say: 'The Messenger of Allah said'" but he said: "The Sunnah when a man married a virgin after he already has a wife, is that he stays with her seven (nights). And when he married a matron when he already has a wife, he stays with her three (nights)
hi: Abu Qilabah, Anas bin Malik se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Agar main chahoon to keh sakta hoon ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, lekin unhon ne kaha: Sunnat ye hai ke jab aadmi apni biwi ke hote hue kunwaari se nikah kare, to wo uske paas saat din theher, aur jab bewa se nikah kare, to teen din theher." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ishaq ne ise Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Anas se marfu' riwayat ki, aur kuch ne marfu' nahi kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Jab aadmi apni biwi ke hote hue kunwaari se nikah kare, to wo uske paas saat din theher, phir uske baad unke darmiyan barabari se waqt taqseem kare, aur jab bewa se nikah kare, to teen din theher. Aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Jab kunwaari se nikah kare apni biwi ke hote hue, to uske paas teen din theher, aur jab bewa se nikah kare, to do raatein theher. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated that:The Prophet would divide (his time) equally between his wives and said: "O Allah! This is my division in what I have control over, so do not punish me for what You have control over which I do not have control over
hi: Abu Qilabah, Abdullah bin Yazid se, Aishah se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) apni biwiyon ke darmiyan taqseem karte the aur adl karte the, aur kehte: "Allahumma Hadhihi Qismati Fima Amliku, Fala Talumni Fima Tamliku wa La Amliku" (Ya Allah! Ye meri taqseem hai jispar mera ikhtiyar hai, to mujhe us cheez mein malamat na kar jispar Tera ikhtiyar hai aur mera nahi). Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith isi tarah kai logon ne Hammad bin Salamah se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abdullah bin Yazid se, Aishah se riwayat ki hai ke Nabi (SAW) taqseem karte the. Aur Hammad bin Zaid aur kai doosron ne Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se mursal riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) taqseem karte the. Aur ye Hammad bin Salamah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur unke qaul "mujhe malamat na kar us cheez mein jispar Tera ikhtiyar hai aur mera nahi" ka matlab, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi tarah tafseer ki hai, mohabbat aur dili chaahat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "When a man has two wives and he is not just between them, he will come on the Day of Judgment with one side drooping
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab aadmi ki do biwiyan hon aur wo unke darmiyan adl na kare, to wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uska ek pehlu jhuka hua hoga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sirf Hammam bin Yahya ne Qatadah se sanad ke saath riwayat ki. Aur Hisham Ad-Dastawa'i ne Qatadah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha "kaha jaata tha." Aur hum ye hadith marfu' sirf Hammam ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Hammam thiqah hafiz hain.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather:"The Messenger of Allah returned his daughter Zainab to Abul-As bin Ar-Rabi with a new dowry and a new wedding
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni beti Zainab ko Abul-As bin Ar-Rabi' ko naye mahr aur naye nikah ke saath laut aayi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith apne isnad mein baat rakhta hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai ke agar aurat apne shohar se pehle Islam qabool kar le, phir uska shohar iddat ke dauraan Islam qabool kar le, to uska shohar usse zyada haqdaar hai jab tak wo iddat mein hai. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Al-Awza'i, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"The Prophet returned his daughter Zainab to Abul-As bin Ar-Rabi after six years in the first marriage without renewing the marriage
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni beti Zainab ko Abul-As bin Ar-Rabi' ko chhe saal baad pehle hi nikah par laut aayi, aur naya nikah nahi kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ke isnad mein koi baat nahi, lekin humein is hadith ki wajah maloom nahi, shayad ye Dawud bin Husain ki hifz ki wajah se aayi ho.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:"A man became a Muslim during the time of the Prophet, then his wife became a Muslim, so he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! She accepted Islam along with me, so return her to me.' So he returned her to him
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein Musalman hua, phir uski biwi bhi Musalman ho gayi, to usne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Usne mere saath hi Islam qabool kiya tha, to use mujhe laut do.' To unhon ne use use laut diya." Ye hadith sahih hai. Maine Abd bin Humaid ko kehte suna: Maine Yazid bin Harun ko Muhammad bin Ishaq se ye hadith aur Hajjaj ki, Amr bin Shu'aib se, apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne apni beti Zainab ko Abul-As ko naye mahr aur naye nikah ke saath laut aaya, zikr karte suna. Yazid bin Harun ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith ka isnad zyada acha hai. Aur amal Amr bin Shu'aib ki hadith par hai.

e: Alqamah narrated that :Ibn Mas'ud was asked about a man who married a woman and he did not stipulate the dowry for her, and he did not enter into her until he died. So Ibn Mas'ud said: "She gets the same dowry as other women, no less and no more, she has to observe the Iddah, and she gets inheritance." So Ma'qil bin Sinan Al-Ashja'I stood and said: "The Messenger of Allah judged the same as you have judged regarding Birwa bint Washiq, a woman of ours." So Ibn Mas'ud was happy about that
hi: Alqamah ne kaha: "Ibn Mas'ud se ek aadmi ke baare mein pucha gaya jisne ek aurat se nikah kiya aur uske liye mahr muqarrar nahi kiya aur uske saath sambhog se pehle hi mar gaya." To Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: "Usse uski jaisi auraton ka mahr milega, na kam na zyada, aur uspar iddat hai aur usse wirasat milegi." To Ma'qil bin Sinan Al-Ashja'i khade hue aur kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Birwa bint Washiq ke baare mein, jo humari qaum ki aurat thi, wahi faisla diya jo aapne diya." To Ibn Mas'ud isse khush hue. Is mauzu par Al-Jarrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Ath-Thawri, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Zaid bin Thabit, Ibn Abbas, aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain, ke nazdeek: agar aadmi ne kisi aurat se nikah kiya aur uske saath sambhog na kiya aur uske liye mahr muqarrar na kiya yahan tak ke mar gaya, to unhon ne kaha: Usse wirasat milegi lekin mahr nahi, aur uspar iddat hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar Birwa bint Washiq ki hadith saabit hoti, to Nabi (SAW) se riwayat mein hujjat hoti. Aur Ash-Shafi'i se riwayat hai ke wo Misr mein is qaul se palat gaye aur Birwa bint Washiq ki hadith ke qaayal ho gaye.

e: Ali (bin Abi Talib) narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“Indeed Allah has made unlawful through suckling whatever He made unlawful through lineage.”
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne dudh pilaane se wahi haraam kiya hai jo nasab se haraam kiya hai." Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Abbas, aur Umm Habibah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:“Indeed Allah has made unlawful through suckling whatever He made unlawful through birth.”
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne dudh pilaane se wahi haraam kiya hai jo paidaish se haraam kiya hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, humein unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi.

e: Aishah narrated:“My uncle through suckling came and asked permission (to enter) but I refused to admit him until I asked the Messenger of Allah. So the Messenger of Allah said: “Let him in since he is your uncle.’” She said: “It is only the woman who suckled me; I was not suckled by the man.’ So he said: ‘Indeed he is your uncle, so let him in.’”
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Mera doodh-shareek chacha aaya aur mujhse ijazat maangi, to maine unhein ijazat dene se inkar kiya jab tak main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se na pooch loon. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Unhein tumhare paas aane do, kyunki wo tumhare chacha hain.' Maine kaha: 'Mujhe to sirf aurat ne dudh pilaya tha, mard ne nahi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo tumhare chacha hi hain, unhein aane do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo mard ke doodh ko napasand karte the, aur is mauzu ki asal Aishah ki hadith hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne mard ke doodh ki rukhsat di hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Amr bin Ash-Shariq narrated that Ibn Abbas was asked about the case in which a man had two slave girls, one of them suckled a girl and the other suckled a boy, is it lawful for the boy to marry the girl? She said:“No, the semen is the same.”
hi: Amr bin Ash-Shariq, Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte hain ke unse ek aadmi ke baare mein pucha gaya jiski do laundiyaan thin, unmein se ek ne ek ladki ko dudh pilaya aur doosri ne ek larke ko, kya us larke ke liye us ladki se nikah karna jaayez hai? To unhon ne kaha: "Nahi, dono ka baap ek hi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye "mard ke doodh" ki tafseer hai, aur yehi is mauzu ki asal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Az-Zubair narrated from Aishah from the Prophet who said:“One sip or two sips do not make a prohibition.”
hi: Aishah (RA), Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karti hain, unhon ne farmaya: "Ek ya do ghoont haraam nahi karte." Is mauzu par Umm Al-Fadl, Abu Hurairah, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, aur Ibn Az-Zubair se bhi riwayat hai. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah se, apne walid se, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, farmaya: "Ek ya do ghoont haraam nahi karte." Aur Muhammad bin Dinar ne Hisham bin Urwah se, apne walid se, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se, Az-Zubair se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Muhammad bin Dinar Al-Basri ne ismein Az-Zubair se, Nabi (SAW) se ka izafa kiya, jo mehfooz nahi. Aur ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek sahih Ibn Abi Mulaikah ki, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Maine Muhammad se isi ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Sahih Ibn Az-Zubair se, Aishah se hai, aur Muhammad bin Dinar ki hadith galat hai, Muhammad bin Dinar ne ismein galti ki aur "Az-Zubair se" ka izafa kiya, jabke ye sirf Hisham bin Urwah, apne walid se, Az-Zubair se hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Aishah ne kaha: Quran mein das maloom dudh-pilaai naazil hui thi, phir usmein se paanch mansookh ho gayi aur paanch maloom dudh-pilaai reh gayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua aur maamla isi tarah tha. Isi tarah Ishaq bin Musa Al-Ansari ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ma'an ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Malik ne humein Abdullah bin Abi Bakr se, Amrah se, Aishah se isi jaisi bataya. Aur isi par Aishah aur Nabi (SAW) ki kuch biwiyan fatwa deti thin, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad ne Nabi (SAW) ki hadith se "Ek ya do ghoont haraam nahi karte" ko liya, aur unhon ne kaha: Agar koi Aishah ke paanch dudh-pilaai ke qaul ko apnaaye, to ye ek mazboot mazhab hai, lekin wo ismein kuch kehne se hichkichaate the. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne dudh-pilaai ka kam aur zyada dono haraam kiya jab wo pet tak pahunche. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Al-Awza'i, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Waki, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Abdullah bin Abi Mulaikah narrated:“Ubaid bin Abi Maryam narrated to me from Uqbah bin Al-Harith” and, he (Abdullah bin Abi Mulaikah) said: “And I heard it from Uqbah bin Al-Harith, but to me, the narration of Ubaid is better preserved; he said: (Uqbah bin Al-Harith narrated: ) “I married a woman, then a black woman came to us and she said: ‘I suckled both of you.’ So I went to the Prophet and said: ‘I married so-and-so the daughter of so-and-so, then a black women came to us, and said: “I suckled both of you” but she is a liar.’” He said: “Then he (pbuh) turned away from me.” He said: “So I went around to face him (and he (pbuh) turned his face away from me) so I said: ‘She is a liar.’ He said: ‘How can you stay with her while she claims that she suckled both of you? Leave her.’”
hi: Uqbah bin Al-Harith ne kaha: "Maine ek aurat se nikah kiya, to humare paas ek kaali aurat aayi aur kaha: 'Maine tum donon ko dudh pilaya hai.' Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Maine fulaan bint fulaan se nikah kiya, to humare paas ek kaali aurat aayi aur kaha: Maine tum donon ko dudh pilaya hai, jabke wo jhooti hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To wo mujhse mun mod kar chale gaye." Unhon ne kaha: "To main unke saamne aaya, unhon ne apna chehra mera mod liya, to maine kaha: 'Wo jhooti hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Aur uske saath kaise reh sakte ho jabke usne dawa kiya hai ke usne tum donon ko dudh pilaya hai? Use chhod do.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Uqbah bin Al-Harith ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Ibn Abi Mulaikah se, Uqbah bin Al-Harith se riwayat ki aur ismein Ubaid bin Abi Maryam ka zikr nahi kiya aur "Use chhod do" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne dudh-pilaai mein ek aurat ki gawaahi jaayez maani. Aur Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Dudh-pilaai mein ek aurat ki gawaahi jaayez hai aur uski qasam bhi li jaati hai. Aur isi ke Ahmad aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Ek aurat ki gawaahi jaayez nahi jab tak zyada na hon. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Maine Al-Jarud ko kehte suna: Maine Waki ko kehte suna: Ek aurat ki gawaahi faisle mein jaayez nahi, lekin ehtiyaat mein uski mukhalfat nahi ki jaati.

e: Umm Salamah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“No prohibition results from suckling except for what penetrates the intestines while on the breast before weaning.”
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dudh-pilaai sirf usi se haraam hoti hai jo aanton mein cheer daale seene par aur wo doodh chhudaane se pehle ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke dudh-pilaai sirf wahi haraam karti hai jo do saal se kam ki umar mein ho, aur do poore saal ke baad jo ho, wo kuch bhi haraam nahi karta. Aur Fatimah bint Al-Mundhir bin Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, Hisham bin Urwah ki biwi hain.

e: Hajjaj bin Hajjaj Al-Aslami narrated that His father asked the Prophet:“O Messenger of Allah! What will remove the responsibility of the foster relationship from me?” So he said: “A Ghurrah: a male slave or a female slave.”
hi: Hajjaj bin Hajjaj Al-Aslami apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhse dudh-pilaai ki zimmedaari kya door karti hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ek achha gulam ya laundi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur unke qaul "Mujhse dudh-pilaai ki zimmedaari kya door karti hai" ka matlab, dudh-pilaai ki zimmedaari aur uska haq hai, wo kehte hain: Jab tum doodh pilaane wali ko ek gulam ya laundi do, to tumne uski zimmedaari poori kar di. Aur Abu Tufail se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath baitha tha, ek aurat aayi, to Nabi (SAW) ne apni chaadar bichhaa di yahan tak ke wo uspar baith gayi, jab wo chali gayi to kaha gaya: Unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko dudh pilaya tha.

e: Aishah narrated:“Barfah’s husband was a slave, so the Messenger of Allah let her chose, and she chose herself, and if he was a free man she would not have had a choice.”
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Barirah ka shohar gulam tha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen ikhtiyar diya, to unhon ne khud ko chuna, aur agar wo azaad hote to unhen ikhtiyar na diya jaata."

e: Aishah narrated:“Barfah’s husband was a free man, so the Messenger of Allah let her choose.”
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Barirah ka shohar azaad tha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen ikhtiyar diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah Hisham ne apne walid se, Aishah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Barirah ka shohar gulam tha. Aur Ikrimah ne Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Maine Barirah ke shohar ko dekha, wo gulam the, unhein Mughith kaha jaata tha. Isi tarah Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar laundi azaad shohar ke nikah mein ho aur wo azaad ho jaaye, to usse koi ikhtiyar nahi, ikhtiyar tab hota hai jab wo azaad ho jaaye aur gulam shohar ke nikah mein ho. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Al-A'mash ne Ibrahim se, Al-Aswad se, Aishah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Barirah ka shohar azaad tha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhen ikhtiyar diya. Aur Abu Awanah ne ye hadith Al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Al-Aswad se, Aishah se Barirah ke qisse mein riwayat ki, Al-Aswad ne kaha: Aur unka shohar azaad tha. Aur kuch Tabi'een aur unke baad ke ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated:“Barfahs husband was a black slave belonging to Banu Al-Mughirah. On the day that Barirah was freed. By Allah! It is as if I can see him in the streets of Al-Madinah behind her. Indeed tears were flowing down his beard while he was trying to get her to chose to stay with him, but she did not do it.”
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Barirah ka shohar Banu Al-Mughirah ka ek kaala gulam tha jis din Barirah azaad hui. Allah ki qasam! Goya main unhein Madina ki galiyon aur uske aatraaf mein dekh raha hoon, unke aansu unki daadhi par beh rahe the, wo unhein raazi karne ki koshish kar rahe the taake wo unhein chun len, lekin unhon ne aisa nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah, Sa'eed bin Mihran hain, aur unki kuniyat Abu An-Nadr hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“The child is for the bed, and for the fornicator is the stone.”
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bachcha bistar waale ka hai, aur zaani ke liye pathar." Is mauzu par Umar, Uthman, Aishah, Abu Umamah, Amr bin Kharijah, Abdullah bin Amr, Al-Bara bin Aazib, aur Zaid bin Arqam se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Az-Zuhri ne ye hadith Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir (bin Abdullah) narrated:“The Prophet saw a woman, then he went to Zainab to fulfill his need and he left. He said: ‘Indeed when the woman enters, she enters in the image of Shaitan. So when one of you sees a woman that he is fascinated with, then let him go to his wife, for indeed with her (his wife) is the same as that which is with her.”
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aurat ko dekha, to wo Zainab ke paas gaye aur apni zaroorat poori ki aur nikle, aur farmaya: "Jab aurat saamne aati hai, to wo Shaitan ki soorat mein aati hai, to jab tum mein se koi aurat dekhe aur wo use pasand aa jaaye, to wo apne ghar wale ke paas jaaye, kyunki uske paas bhi wahi hai jo uske paas hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith sahih hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that The Prophet said:“If I were to order anyone to prostrate to anyone, then I would order the wife to prostrate to her husband.”
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main kisi ko kisi ke aage sajda karne ka hukum deta, to main aurat ko apne shohar ke aage sajda karne ka hukum deta." Is mauzu par Mu'adh bin Jabal, Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju'shum, Aishah, Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Abi Awfa, Talq bin Ali, Umm Salamah, Anas, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se, Muhammad bin Amr ki, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat mein, hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Talq bin Ali narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“When a man calls his wife to fulfill his need, then let her come, even if she is at the oven.”
hi: Talq bin Ali ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aadmi apni biwi ko apni zaroorat ke liye bulaaye, to wo aa jaaye, chahe wo tandoor par hi kyun na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Umm Salamah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“Whichever woman dies while her husband is pleased with her, then she enters Paradise.”
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat mar jaaye jabke uska shohar usse raazi ho, to wo Jannat mein daakhil hogi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“The most complete of the believers in faith, is the one with the best character among them. And the best of you are those who are best to your women.”
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momino mein sabse mukammal imaan wala wo hai jiska akhlaaq sabse acha ho, aur tum mein sabse behtareen wo hain jo apni auraton ke saath akhlaaq mein sabse behtareen hon." Is mauzu par Aishah aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Sulaiman bin Amr bin Al-Ahwas said:“My father narrated to me that he witnessed the farewell Hajj with the Messenger of Allah. So he thanked and praised Allah and he reminded and gave admonition. He mentioned a story in his narration and he (the Prophet) said: “And indeed I order you to be good to the women, for they are but captives with you over whom you have no power than that, except if they come with manifest Fahishah (evil behavior). If they do that, then abandon their beds and beat them with a beating that is not harmful. And if they obey you then you have no cause against them. Indeed you have rights over your women, and your women have rights over you. As for your rights over your women, then they must not allow anyone whom you dislike to treat on your bedding (furniture), nor to admit anyone in your home that you dislike. And their rights over you are that you treat them well in clothing them and feeding them.”
hi: Sulaiman bin Amr bin Al-Ahwas ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne mujhe bataya ke wo Hajjat-ul-Wida mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hazir the, to unhon ne Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, aur yaad dilaayi aur nasihat ki, phir hadith mein ek qissa zikr kiya, unhon ne farmaya: 'Suno! Auraton ke saath achi salook karo, kyunki wo tumhare zimme qaidiyon jaisi hain, tumhein unke baare mein iske alawa aur koi ikhtiyar nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo koi khula fahash kaam karen. Agar wo aisa karen, to unse bistar mein alag reh jaao aur unhein maaro ek aisi maar jo sakht na ho. Phir agar wo tumhari baat manen, to unpar koi raasta na dhundo. Suno! Tumhara haq tumhari auraton par hai aur tumhari auraton ka haq tumpar hai. Tumhara haq tumhari auraton par ye hai ke wo tumhare bistar par kisi aise shakhs ko na baithaayen jise tum napasand karte ho, aur na tumhare gharon mein kisi aise shakhs ko ijazat den jise tum napasand karte ho. Suno! Aur unka haq tumpar ye hai ke tum unke saath achi tarah pesh aao unke kapdon aur khaane mein.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur unke qaul "tumhare zimme qaidiyon jaisi hain" ka matlab hai: tumhare haathon mein qaidi hain.

e: Ali bin Talq narrated that A Bedouin came to the Prophet and said:“O Messenger of Allah! A man among us would be in the desert and a small smell would come from him, (what should he do) while the water is scarce? So the Messenger of Allah said: “When one of you breaks wind then let him perform Wudu, and do not go into your women in their behinds for indeed Allah is not shy of the truth.”
hi: Ali bin Talq ne kaha: "Ek Bedouin Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum mein se aadmi jangal mein hota hai to usse hawa nikalti hai, aur paani kam hota hai.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se kisi ki hawa nikle, to wo wuzu kare, aur auraton ke peechhle raste se na jao, kyunki Allah haq se sharmaata nahi.'" Is mauzu par Umar, Khuzaimah bin Thabit, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali bin Talq ki hadith hasan hai. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Mujhe Ali bin Talq ki, Nabi (SAW) se, is ek hadith ke siwa koi aur riwayat maloom nahi, aur mujhe ye hadith Talq bin Ali As-Suhaimi ki hadith se alag maloom hoti hai. Aur unka khayal tha ke ye Nabi (SAW) ke ek doosre Sahabi hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“Allah will not look at a man who enters a man or a woman in the behind.”
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah us aadmi ki taraf nazar nahi karega jo kisi mard ya aurat ke peechhle raste se aaya ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Waki ne bhi ye hadith riwayat ki.

e: Ali narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“When one of you breaks wind then let him perform Wudu, and do not go into your women through their behinds.”
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki hawa nikle, to wo wuzu kare, aur auraton ke peechhle raste se na jao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ali bin Talq hain.

e: Maimunah bin Sa’d who was a servant for the Prophet, narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“The parable of the woman who walks to impress others in adornments for other than her family, is that of darkness on the Day of Judgment: There is no light for her.”
