hi: Maimunah bint Sa'd, jo Nabi (SAW) ki khidmatgar thin, se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us aurat ki misaal jo apne ghar walon ke siwa doosron ko dikhane ke liye singhaar mein iterti phire, wo Qayamat ke din ke andhere jaisi hai, jismein koi roshni nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Musa bin Ubaidah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Musa bin Ubaidah apni hifz ki wajah se hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur wo sachche hain. Aur kuch logon ne ise Musa bin Ubaidah se riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“Allah becomes jealous and the believer becomes jealous. Allah’s jealousy occurs when a believer does what He has made unlawful for him.”
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ghairat karta hai aur Momin bhi ghairat karta hai, aur Allah ki ghairat ye hai ke Momin wo kare jo uspar haraam kiya gaya hai." Is mauzu par Aishah aur Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Urwah se, Asma bint Abi Bakr se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur donon hadithein sahih hain. Aur Hajjaj As-Sawwaf, Hajjaj bin Abi Uthman hain, aur Abu Uthman ka naam Maisarah hai, aur Hajjaj ki kuniyat Abu As-Salt hai, Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan ne unhein thiqah qarar diya.

e: Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“It is not lawful for a woman who believers in Allah and the Last Day to travel on a trip that is three days or more, unless she is accompanied by her father, her brother, her husband, her son, or someone who is a Mahram to her.”
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, jaayez nahi ke wo teen din ya usse zyada ka safar kare, magar uske saath uska waalid, uska bhai, uska shohar, uska beta, ya koi aisa mahram ho." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Aurat ek din aur ek raat ka safar mahram ke bagair na kare." Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo aurat ko mahram ke bagair safar karna napasand karte hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtilaaf hai us aurat ke baare mein jo maal daar ho aur uska koi mahram na ho, kya wo Hajj kare? Kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Uspar Hajj wajib nahi kyunki mahram raaste ka hissa hai, Allah Azza wa Jall ke qaul \"(Jo wahan tak ka raasta paa sake)\" ki wajah se, unhon ne kaha: Agar uska mahram na ho, to usse wahan tak ka raasta nahi milta. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar raasta mahfooz ho, to wo logon ke saath Hajj ke liye nikle. Aur ye Malik bin Anas aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“A woman is not to travel the distance of a day and a night unless she is accompanied by someone who is a Mahram.”
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat ek din aur ek raat ka safar mahram ke bagair na kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Uqbah bin Amir narrated that The Messenger of Allah said:“Beware of entering upon women.” So a man from the Ansar said: ‘”O Messenger of Allah! What do you think about Hamu? So he said: “The Hamu is death.”
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Auraton ke paas jaane se bacho." To Ansar ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Shohar ke bhai ke baare mein aapka kya khayal hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Shohar ka bhai to maut hai." Is mauzu par Umar, Jabir, aur Amr bin Al-As se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Uqbah bin Aamir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur auraton ke paas jaane ki napasandeegi ka matlab, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ke mutabiq, ye hai jahan unhon ne farmaya: "Koi aadmi kisi aurat ke saath akela na rahe, warna teesra unke saath Shaitan hoga." Aur unke qaul "shohar ka bhai" - kaha jaata hai wo shohar ka bhai hai, goya unhon ne isse napasand kiya ke wo uske saath akela rahe.

e: Jabir narrated that The Prophet said:“Do not enter upon Al-Mughibar (the women whose husband are absent), for indeed the Shaitan flows through one of you as the blood flows.” We said: “And you?” He said: “And me, but Allah helped me over him, so I am safe.”
hi: Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Un auraton ke paas mat jao jinke shohar ghar mein na hon, kyunki Shaitan tum mein se kisi ke andar khoon ki tarah daudta hai." Humne kaha: "Aur aapke andar bhi?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Mere andar bhi, lekin Allah ne iske khilaaf meri madad ki, to main mehfooz hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne Mujalid bin Sa'eed ki hifz ki wajah se unke baare mein baat ki hai. Maine Ali bin Khashram ko kehte suna: Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Nabi (SAW) ke qaul ki tafseer mein kaha, "Lekin Allah ne iske khilaaf meri madad ki, to main mehfooz hoon," yani main usse mehfooz hoon. Sufyan ne kaha: Aur Shaitan Musalman nahi hota. Aur "Un auraton ke paas mat jao jinke shohar ghar mein na hon" - "Mughibaat" wo auraten hain jinke shohar ghar mein na hon, aur "Mughibaat" "Mughibah" ki jama hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that The Prophet said:“The woman is Awrah, so when she goes out, the Shaitan seeks to tempt her.”
hi: Abdullah, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne farmaya: "Aurat parda hai, to jab wo bahar nikalti hai, to Shaitan usse takta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Mu’adh bin Jabal narrated that The Prophet said:“No woman annoys her husband in the world except that his wife among the Al-Huril-Ain said: ‘Do not annoy him, may Allah destroy you, he is only like a guest with, soon he will part from you for us.’”
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Koi aurat is duniya mein apne shohar ko takleef nahi deti, magar Hoor-ul-Ain mein se uski biwi kehti hai: 'Use takleef mat de, Allah tujhe barbaad kare, wo to tere paas ek mehmaan hai, jald hi wo tujhse juda hokar humare paas aa jaayega.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Ismail bin Ayyash ki, Shaam waalon se riwayat zyada theek hoti hai, aur unki Hijaz aur Iraq waalon se riwayaton mein munkar baatein hoti hain.

e: Yunus bin Jubair said:"I asked Ibn Umar about a man who divorced his wife while she was menstruating. So he said: 'Don't you know Abdullah bin Umar?' Indeed he divorced his wife while she was menstruating, so Umar asked the Prophet about that, and he ordered him to take her back.'" He said: "I said: And that divorce is counted? He said: And that divorce is counted? He said: 'What else would you think if he was helpless and foolish?
hi: Yunus bin Jubair ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar se ek aadmi ke baare mein pucha jisne apni biwi ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di. To unhon ne kaha: 'Kya tum Abdullah bin Umar ko jaante ho? Unhon ne apni biwi ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di thi, to Umar ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, to unhon ne unhen hukum diya ke wo unse rujoo karen.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: To kya wo talaaq shumaar hogi? Unhon ne kaha: To phir kya? Batao agar wo bebas ho jaaye aur bewaquf ban jaaye?"

e: Salim narrated that:His father divorced his wife during her menses, so Umar asked the Prophet about that and he said: "Tell him to take her back, then let him divorce her while she is pure or pregnant
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne apni biwi ko haiz mein talaaq di, to Umar ne Nabi (SAW) se pucha, unhon ne farmaya: "Use hukum do ke wo usse rujoo kare, phir usse paak halat mein ya hamla halat mein talaaq de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Yunus bin Jubair ki, Ibn Umar se, hadith hasan sahih hai, aur isi tarah Salim ki, Ibn Umar se, hadith bhi. Aur ye hadith Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Sunnat ki talaaq ye hai ke wo use paak halat mein, sambhog ke bagair talaaq de. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar usne teen talaaq di jabke wo paak thi, to ye bhi Sunnat ke mutabiq hogi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Teen talaaq Sunnat ke mutabiq nahi hogi jab tak wo ek-ek karke na di jaaye. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unhon ne hamla aurat ki talaaq ke baare mein kaha: Wo jab chahe use talaaq de sakta hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo har mahine ek talaaq de.

e: Abdullah bin Yazid bin Rukanah narrated from his father, from his grandfather who said:'O Messenger of Allah! I irrevocably divorced my wife.' So he said: 'What did you intend by that?' I said: 'One (divorce).' He said: '(Do you swear) By Allah?' I said: 'By Allah.' He said: 'Then it is as you intended
hi: Abdullah bin Yazid bin Rukanah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine apni biwi ko qata'i talaaq de di.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhara isse kya irada tha?' Maine kaha: 'Ek talaaq.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah ki qasam?' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To wahi hai jo tumne irada kiya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ismein iztiraab hai. Aur Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Rukanah ne apni biwi ko teen talaaq di. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ka "qata'i talaaq" ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai ke unhon ne qata'i talaaq ko ek maana, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne use teen maana. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Ismein aadmi ki niyat dekhi jaati hai, agar usne ek ki niyat ki to ek, aur agar teen ki niyat ki to teen, aur agar do ki niyat ki to bhi sirf ek hogi. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Qata'i talaaq mein, agar usne uske saath sambhog kiya ho, to wo teen talaaqein hain. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Agar usne ek ki niyat ki to ek, jispar rujoo ka ikhtiyar hai, aur agar do ki niyat ki to do, aur agar teen ki niyat ki to teen.

e: Hammad bin Yazid said:"I said to Abu Ayyub: 'Do you know of anyone who said that: "Your case is up to you?" counts as three besides Al-Hasan?' He said: "No, not besides Al-Hasan.' Then he said: 'O Allah forgive me - except for what has been narrated to me by Qatadah, from Kathir the freed slave of Banu Samurah, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, that the Prophet said: "Three.'"Abu Ayyub said: 'So I met Kathir the freed slave of Banu Samurah and asked him about it, but he was not aware of it. So I returned to Qatadah and informed him about that and he said: "He forgot
hi: Hammad bin Zaid ne kaha: "Maine Ayyub se kaha: 'Kya tumhein maloom hai ke Al-Hasan ke siwa kisi ne \"Tumhara maamla tumhare haath mein hai\" ko teen talaaq maana ho?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Nahi, Al-Hasan ke siwa koi nahi.' Phir unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Allah, maaf kar - siwaye is ke ke mujhe Qatadah ne bataya, Kathir se, jo Ibn Samurah ke azaad kiye gulam hain, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: \"Teen.\"'" Ayyub ne kaha: "To main Kathir se mila - Ibn Samurah ke azaad kiye gulam - aur maine unse pucha, to unhen ye maloom nahi tha. To main Qatadah ke paas laut kar gaya aur unhen bataya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Wo bhool gaye.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sulaiman bin Harb ki, Hammad bin Zaid se riwayat se jaante hain. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Humein Sulaiman bin Harb ne Hammad bin Zaid se ye bataya, aur ye Abu Hurairah se mauqoof hai. Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith marfu' maloom nahi. Aur Ali bin Nasr hafiz, sahib-e-hadith the. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka "Tumhara maamla tumhare haath mein hai" ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud shaamil hain, ne kaha: Ye ek hai. Aur ye Tabi'een aur unke baad ke kai ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai. Aur Uthman bin Affan aur Zaid bin Thabit ne kaha: Faisla wahi hai jo usne khud faisla kiya. Aur Ibn Umar ne kaha: Jab wo uska maamla uske haath mein de aur wo khud ko teen talaaq de de aur shohar inkar kare aur kahe: 'Maine uska maamla sirf ek talaaq ke liye uske haath mein diya tha,' to shohar se qasam li jaaye aur uska qaul, qasam ke saath, maana jaaye. Aur Sufyan aur Kufa waalon ne Umar aur Abdullah ke qaul ko apnaaya. Aur Malik bin Anas ne kaha: Faisla wahi hai jo usne khud faisla kiya. Aur ye Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur Ishaq ne Ibn Umar ke qaul ko apnaaya.

e: Aishah said:"The Messenger of Allah gave us the choice, so we chose him. So was that a divorce?
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ikhtiyar diya, to humne unhen chuna, to kya ye talaaq thi?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ikhtiyar ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, Umar aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar usne khud ko chuna, to wo ek talaaq-e-baa'in hai. Aur unse ye bhi riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Ek talaaq jispar rujoo ka ikhtiyar hai, aur agar usne apne shohar ko chuna to kuch nahi. Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar usne khud ko chuna, to wo ek talaaq-e-baa'in hai, aur agar usne apne shohar ko chuna, to ek talaaq jispar rujoo ka ikhtiyar hai. Aur Zaid bin Thabit ne kaha: Agar usne apne shohar ko chuna to ek, aur agar usne khud ko chuna to teen. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm aur fuqaha, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur unke baad ke, is mauzu mein Umar aur Abdullah ke qaul ko apnaate hain, aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Ahmad bin Hanbal ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke qaul ko apnaaya.

e: Fatimah bint Qais said:"My husband divorced me three times during the time of the Prophet. So the Messenger of Allah said: 'There is no housing for you nor maintenance.'" Al-Mughirah (one of the narrators) said: "I mentioned that to Ibrahim and he said: Umar said: "We do not leave the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of our Prophet for the saying of a woman, and we do not know if she remembered or forgot." And Umar used to give her (the divorced woman) housing and maintenance
hi: Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: Fatimah bint Qais ne kaha: "Mere shohar ne mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein teen talaaq di, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tumhare liye na rehne ki jagah hai na nafqa.'" Al-Mughirah ne kaha: "To maine ise Ibrahim se zikr kiya, unhon ne kaha: Umar ne kaha: 'Hum Allah ki Kitab aur humare Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat ko ek aurat ki baat ki wajah se nahi chhodenge, jismein humein nahi maloom ke usne yaad rakha ya bhool gayi.' Aur Umar unhen rehne ki jagah aur nafqa dete the." Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Main Fatimah bint Qais ke paas gaya aur unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke iske baare mein faisle ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Unke shohar ne unhen qata'i talaaq di, to unhon ne rehne ki jagah aur nafqe ke baare mein jhagda kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen na rehne ki jagah di na nafqa.'" Aur Dawud ki hadith mein hai, unhon ne kaha: "Aur unhon ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein iddat guzaaroon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, unmein Al-Hasan Al-Basri, Ata bin Abi Rabah, aur Ash-Sha'bi shaamil hain, aur isi ke Ahmad aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Unhon ne kaha: Talaaq-shuda aurat ke liye rehne ki jagah aur nafqa nahi hai jab uske shohar ko rujoo ka ikhtiyar na ho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Umar aur Abdullah shaamil hain, ne kaha: Teen talaaq waali aurat ke liye rehne ki jagah aur nafqa hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Uske liye rehne ki jagah hai lekin nafqa nahi. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Al-Laith bin Sa'd, aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Humne uske liye rehne ki jagah Allah ki Kitab ki wajah se maani, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: \"(Unhen unke gharon se mat nikaalo aur na wo khud nikalein, siwaye is ke ke wo koi khula fahash kaam karen)\", unhon ne kaha: Ye badzabaani hai ke wo apne ghar walon par badzabaani kare. Aur unhon ne dalil di ke Fatimah bint Qais ko Nabi (SAW) ne rehne ki jagah nahi di kyunki wo apne ghar walon par badzabaani karti thin. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur uske liye nafqa nahi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Fatimah bint Qais ke qisse ki hadith ki wajah se.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his grandfather, from his father, that:The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no vow for the son of Adam over what he has no control, and there is no emancipating he can do for one whom he does not own, and there is no divorce for him regarding that which he has no control over
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam ki aulad ke liye us cheez mein koi mannat nahi jispar uska ikhtiyar na ho, aur na uske liye us cheez ko azaad karna hai jiska wo maalik na ho, aur na uske liye us cheez ki talaaq hai jispar uska ikhtiyar na ho." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Mu'adh bin Jabal, Jabir, Ibn Abbas, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye is mauzu mein sabse achi riwayat hai. Aur ye zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ka qaul hai, ye Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Jabir bin Abdullah, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib, Al-Hasan, Sa'eed bin Jubair, Ali bin Al-Husain, Shuraih, Jabir bin Zaid, aur kai Tabi'een fuqaha se riwayat hai, aur isi ke Ash-Shafi'i qaayal hain. Aur Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne "muqarrar aurat" ke baare mein kaha: Wo talaaq ho jaati hai. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i, Ash-Sha'bi, aur doosre ahl-e-ilm se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Jab waqt muqarrar kare to nafiz ho jaata hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai, ke agar usne kisi khaas aurat ka naam liya ya waqt muqarrar kiya ya kaha 'Agar main fulaan ilaqe se nikah karoon,' to agar usne nikah kiya to talaaq ho jaati hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne is mauzu mein sakhti ki aur kaha: Agar usne aisa kiya, to main nahi kehta ke ye haraam hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Agar usne nikah kiya, to main use apni biwi se juda hone ka hukum nahi deta. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Main "muqarrar aurat" mein Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith ki wajah se ijazat deta hoon, aur agar usne usse nikah kiya, to main nahi kehta ke uski biwi uspar haraam ho gayi. Aur Ishaq ne ghair-muqarrar mein gunjaish di. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak se zikr kiya gaya ke unse ek aadmi ke baare mein pucha gaya jisne talaaq ki qasam khaayi ke wo nikah nahi karega, phir usne nikah karne ka soch liya, kya usse ye rukhsat hai ke wo un fuqaha ke qaul ko apnaaye jinhon ne ismein rukhsat di hai? To Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Agar wo is qaul ko sahih maanta ho is masla mein aazmaaish se pehle, to usse ye qaul apnaane ka haq hai, lekin jo isse raazi na ho aur jab aazmaaish aaye to unke qaul ko apnaana chaahe, to main usse ye jaayez nahi maanta.

e: Muzahir bin Aslam narrated that Al-Qasim narrated from Aishah that:The Messenger of Allah said: "The divorce for a slave woman is two divorces, and her Iddah is two menstruations
hi: Muzahir bin Aslam ne kaha: Al-Qasim ne Aishah se riwayat ki ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Laundi ki talaaq do talaaqein hain, aur uski iddat do haiz hain." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise marfu' sirf Muzahir bin Aslam ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Muzahir ke ilm mein humein is hadith ke siwa aur kuch maloom nahi. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narraed that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Allah has permitted my Ummah what occurs in their mines, as long as it is not spoken or acted upon
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne meri Ummat ko maaf kiya us cheez mein jo unke dil mein aati hai, jab tak wo use kahe na ya uspar amal na kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar aadmi apne dil mein talaaq ke baare mein soche, to kuch nahi hota jab tak wo use kahe na.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Three are serious when they are serious, and serious when they are in jest: Marriage, divorce, and return
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen cheezein, unki sanjeedgi bhi sanjeedgi hai aur unka mazaak bhi sanjeedgi hai: Nikah, talaaq, aur rujoo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: AR-Rubayyi bint Mu'awwidh bin Al-Afra narrated:that she got a Khul during the time of the Prophet. So the Prophet ordered her - or: she was ordered - that she observe an Iddah of a menstruation
hi: Ar-Rubaiyyi bint Muawwidh bin Al-Afra se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein khula liya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen hukum diya - ya unhen hukum diya gaya - ke wo ek haiz ki iddat guzaarein. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ar-Rubaiyyi ki sahih hadith ye hai ke unhen ek haiz ki iddat guzaarne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that :The wife of Thabit bin Qais was granted a Khul from her husband during the time of the Prophet. So the Prophet ordered her to observe an Iddah of a menstruation
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Thabit bin Qais ki biwi ne Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein apne shohar se khula liya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen hukum diya ke wo ek haiz ki iddat guzaarein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka khula lene wali ki iddat ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Khula lene wali ki iddat talaaq-shuda ki iddat hai, teen haiz. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ahmad aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Khula lene wali ki iddat ek haiz hai. Ishaq ne kaha: Agar koi ise apnaaye, to ye ek mazboot mazhab hai.

e: Thawban narrated that:The Prophet said: "The women who seek a Khul are hypocrites
hi: Thawban se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Khula lene wali auraten munafiq hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad mazboot nahi. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat bina wajah ke apne shohar se khula le, wo Jannat ki khushbu nahi sungegi."

e: Thawban narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Whichever woman seeks a Khul from her husband without harm (cause), then the scent of Paradise will be unlawful for her
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat bina wajah ke apne shohar se talaaq maange, to uspar Jannat ki khushbu haraam hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed the woman is like a rib, if you try to straighten her you will break her, and if you leave her, what you enjoy from her will be with the crookedness
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat paslian jaisi hai, agar tum use seedha karna chaho to use tod doge, aur agar tum use chhod do to tum usse faida uthaaoge, tirchhi hone ke bawajood." Is mauzu par Abu Dharr, Samurah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"I had a wife whom I loved, but my father disliked her, so he ordered me to divorce her but I refused. I mentioned that to the Prophet and he said: 'O Abdullah bin Umar! Divorce your wife
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Meri ek biwi thi jisse main mohabbat karta tha, lekin mere waalid use napasand karte the. Mere waalid ne mujhe hukum diya ke main use talaaq de doon, to maine inkar kiya. Maine ye baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Abdullah bin Umar! Apni biwi ko talaaq de do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Abi Dhi'b ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:The Prophet said: "No woman should ask for the divorce of her sister (in religion) in order to spill what is in her container
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat apni bahen ki talaaq na maange taake uske bartan mein jo hai wo bahaa de." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that :The Messenger of Allah said: "Every divorce is valid except the divorce of the Ma'tuh person whose reason is overcome." (Da'if Jiddan)
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har talaaq jaayez hai siwaye us pagal ki talaaq ke jiski aqal khatam ho gayi ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum marfu' sirf Ata bin Ajlan ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Ata bin Ajlan kamzor hain, hadith mein unki koi haisiyat nahi. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke us pagal ki talaaq jiski aqal khatam ho gayi ho jaayez nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo aisa pagal ho jo kabhi kabhi hosh mein aata ho, to wo apne hosh ki halat mein talaaq de.

e: Hisham bin Urwah narrated from his father, from Aishah that she said:"The people were such that a man would divorce his wife when he wanted to divorce her, and she remained his wife when he wanted to take her back while she was in her Iddah, and he could divorce a hundred times, or even more, such that a man could say to his wife: 'By Allah! I will neither divorce you irrevocably, nor give you residence ever!' She would say: 'And how is that?' He would say: 'I will divorce you, and whenever your Iddah is just about to end I will take you back. So a woman went to Aishah to inform her about that, and Aishah was silent until the Prophet came. So she told him and the Prophet was silent, until the Qur'an was revealed: Divorce is two times, after that, retain her on reasonable terms or release her with kindness.'" So Aishah said: "So the people could carry on with divorce in the future, (knowing) who was divorced, and who was not divorced
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Log aur aadmi jitni chaahe apni biwi ko talaaq de sakta tha, aur wo uski biwi rehti agar wo iddat mein hi usse rujoo kar le, chahe usne sau baar ya usse zyada talaaq di ho, yahan tak ke ek aadmi ne apni biwi se kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Main tumhein na talaaq doonga ke tum mujhse alag ho jao, na kabhi tumhein panah doonga.' Usne kaha: 'Wo kaise?' Usne kaha: 'Main tumhein talaaq doonga, aur jab bhi tumhari iddat khatam hone ko hogi, main tumse rujoo kar loonga.'" Wo aurat gayi yahan tak ke Aishah ke paas aayi aur unhein bataya, to Aishah khaamosh rahin yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) aaye, to unhon ne unhein bataya, to Nabi (SAW) khaamosh rahe yahan tak ke Quran naazil hua: "(Talaaq do baar hai, phir ya to achi tarah rakhna hai ya achi tarah chhod dena)." Aishah ne kaha: "To log naye sire se talaaq shuru karne lage, jisne talaaq di thi aur jisne nahi di thi." Hisham bin Urwah, apne walid se isi jaisi riwayat karte hain, isi mafhoom mein, aur ismein Aishah ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Ya'la bin Shabib ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Al-Aswad narrated from Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak who said:"Subai'ah delivered twenty-three or twenty-five days after her husband had died. So when she was ready (finished post-natal bleeding) she adorned herself for marriage, but she was rebuked for doing that, so it was mentioned to the Prophet and he said: "If she has done that then her time has come
hi: Al-Aswad, Abu As-Sanabil bin Ba'kak se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Subai'ah ne apne shohar ki maut ke teis ya pachees din baad bachcha jana. Jab wo paak hui, to unhon ne nikah ki taraf raghbat dikhaayi, to unhen isse mana kiya gaya, to ye baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki gayi, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar usne aisa kiya, to uska waqt poora ho gaya.'" Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu As-Sanabil ki hadith is tareeqe se mash'hoor hai. Aur humein Al-Aswad ka Abu As-Sanabil se sunna maloom nahi. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Mujhe maloom nahi ke Abu As-Sanabil Nabi (SAW) ke baad zinda rahe. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke hamla aurat jiska shohar mar gaya ho, jab wo bachcha jane, to uske liye nikah jaayez ho jaata hai chahe uski iddat khatam na hui ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Wo dono muddaton mein se aakhri tak iddat guzaare. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Sulaiman bin Yasir narrated that :Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas and Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman mentioned the pregnant women whose husband died and she gave birth after the death of her husband. So Ibn Abbas said: "She observes Iddah until the end of the two terms." Abu Salamah said: "Rather, she is allowed when she gives birth." Abu Hurairah said: "I am with my nephew," meaning Abu Salamah.So he sent a message to Umm Salamah the wife of the Prophet. She said: "Subai'ah Al-Aslamiyyah gave birth a short time after her husband died, so she sought the judgment of the Messenger of Allah and he ordered her to get married
hi: Sulaiman bin Yasar se riwayat hai ke Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman ne us hamla aurat ke baare mein baat ki jiska shohar mar gaya ho aur wo apne shohar ki maut ke waqt bachcha jane. To Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Wo dono muddaton mein se aakhri tak iddat guzaare." Aur Abu Salamah ne kaha: "Balki wo bachcha janne ke waqt halal ho jaati hai." Aur Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Main apne bhatije ke saath hoon," yani Abu Salamah. To unhon ne Umm Salamah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke paas paigham bheja, to unhon ne kaha: "Subai'ah Al-Aslamiyyah ne apne shohar ki maut ke thode hi arse baad bachcha jana, to unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se fatwa maanga, to unhon ne unhen nikah karne ka hukum diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Humaid bin Nafi narrated that :Zainab bint Abi Salamah said: "I entered upon Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet when her father Sufyan bin Harb died. So she asked for some perfume that had something yellow saffron or something else, so a girl applied it to her and put some on her cheeks. Then she said: 'By Allah! I have no need for perfume except that I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "It is not lawful for a woman who believers in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for the dead more than three days, except for her husband (in which case it is) four months and ten days
hi: Zainab bint Abi Salamah ne kaha: "Main Umm Habibah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke paas gayi jab unke waalid Abu Sufyan bin Harb intiqaal kar gaye, to unhon ne khushbu mangwaayi jismein zard rang ka khaluq ya kuch aur tha, to unhon ne ek laundi ko laga diya, phir apne gaalon ko chhua, phir kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Mujhe khushbu ki koi zaroorat nahi, sirf isliye lagayi kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, jaayez nahi ke wo kisi mayyat par teen din se zyada sog kare, siwaye shohar ke, uske liye chaar mahine aur das din.'"

e: Humaid bin Nafi narrated that :Zainab said: "So I entered upon Zainab bint Jahsh when her brother died. She called for some perfume and put it on, then said: 'By Allah! I have no need for perfume except that I heard the Messenger of Allah said: "It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for the dead more than three nights, except for her husband (in which case it is) four months and ten days
hi: Zainab ne kaha: "Phir main Zainab bint Jahsh ke paas gayi jab unke bhai intiqaal kar gaye, to unhon ne khushbu mangwaayi aur usmein se laga li, phir kaha: 'Allah ki qasam! Mujhe khushbu ki koi zaroorat nahi, sirf isliye lagayi kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, jaayez nahi ke wo kisi mayyat par teen raaton se zyada sog kare, siwaye shohar ke, uske liye chaar mahine aur das din.'"

e: Humaid bin Nafi narrated that :Zainab said: "And I heard my mother, Umm Salamah said: 'A woman came to the Messenger of Allah and she said: "O Messenger of Allah! My daughter's husband died, and she is suffering from an eye ailment, so can she use Kohl?" the Messenger of Allah said: "No" two or three time. Each time (she asked) he said "no." Then he said: "It is just a mater of four months and ten (days). During Jahliyyah one of you would throw a clump of camel dung when one year passed
hi: Zainab ne kaha: "Aur maine apni maa Umm Salamah ko kehte suna: 'Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Meri beti ka shohar intiqaal kar gaya hai aur unki aankhon mein takleef hai, kya hum unhein surma laga sakte hain? To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Nahi.' Do ya teen martaba, har baar 'Nahi' hi kaha. Phir farmaya: 'Ye to sirf chaar mahine aur das din ki baat hai, aur Jahiliyyah mein tum mein se koi saal poora hone par oont ka gobar phenkti thi.'" Is mauzu par Furai'ah bint Malik, jo Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ki behen hain, aur Hafsah bint Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Zainab ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke jiska shohar mar gaya ho wo apni iddat mein khushbu aur singhaar se bachti hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Salamah bin Sakhr Al-Bayadi narrated:that the Prophet said, about the one who uttered Zihar and had intercourse before the atonement: "One atonement
hi: Salamah bin Sakhr Al-Bayadi se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, us zihaar karne wale ke baare mein jo kaffara ada karne se pehle sambhog kar le, unhon ne farmaya: "Ek hi kaffara." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar usne kaffara ada karne se pehle sambhog kiya, to uspar do kaffare hain. Aur ye Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that:A man came to the Prophet, and he had uttered Zihar upon his wife then he had intercourse with her. So he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I uttered Zihar against my wife, then I had intercourse with her before atoning.' He (pbuh) said: "What caused you to do that, may Allah have mercy upon you?' He said: 'I saw her anklets in the moonlight.' He said: 'Then do not go near her until you have done what Allah ordered (for it)
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jisne apni biwi se zihaar kiya tha aur uske saath sambhog kar liya tha, usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Maine apni biwi se zihaar kiya, phir kaffara ada karne se pehle uske saath sambhog kar liya." Unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhein isse kis cheez ne majboor kiya, Allah tumpar reham kare?" Usne kaha: "Maine chaandni mein unki payal dekh li." Unhon ne farmaya: "To uske paas na jao jab tak tum wo na kar lo jiska Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai."

e: Abu Salamah and Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman (bin Thawban) narrated that :Salman bin Sakhr Al-Ansari - from Banu Bayadah - said that his wife was like the back of his mother to him until Ramadan passed. After half of Ramadan had passed he had intercourse with his wife during the night. So he went to the Messenger of Allah to mention that to him. The Messenger of Allah said to him: "Free a slave." He said: "I don't have one." So he said: "Then fast two consecutive months." He said: "I am unable." He said: "Feed sixty needy people." He said: "I can not." So the Messenger of Allah said to Farwah bin Amr: "Give him that Araq - and it is a large basket that holds fifteen or sixteen Sa - to feed sixty needy people
hi: Abu Salamah aur Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Thawban riwayat karte hain ke Salman bin Sakhr Al-Ansari, jo Banu Bayadah mein se the, unhon ne apni biwi ko apni maa jaisa haraam kar liya yahan tak ke Ramzan guzar jaaye. Jab Ramzan ka aadha hissa guzra, to unhon ne raat ko uske saath sambhog kar liya, to wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur ye zikr kiya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ek gulam azaad karo." Unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi milta." Unhon ne farmaya: "To do mahine lagataar roza rakho." Unhon ne kaha: "Mujhse nahi hota." Unhon ne farmaya: "Saath miskeenon ko khaana khilaao." Unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi milta." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Farwah bin Amr se farmaya: "Unhein wo tokra do" - jo pandrah ya solah saa ka ek bada tokra tha - to farmaya: "Saath miskeenon ko khaana khilaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Kaha jaata hai Salman bin Sakhr, aur kaha jaata hai Salamah bin Sakhr Al-Bayadi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek zihaar ke kaffare mein isi hadith par amal hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah swore Ila from his wives, and he made something unlawful and he made himself unlawful what was lawful, and he made atonement for his oath
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apni biwiyon se ilaa khaayi, aur haraam kiya, to unhon ne haraam ko halal bana diya aur qasam mein kaffara rakh diya." Is mauzu par Anas aur Abu Musa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Maslamah bin Alqamah ki, Dawud se hadith, Ali bin Mushir aur doosron ne Dawud se, Ash-Sha'bi se, ke Nabi (SAW) ne mursal riwayat ki, aur ismein Masruq se, Aishah se ka zikr nahi hai, aur ye Maslamah bin Alqamah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur "Ilaa" ye hai ke aadmi qasam khaaye ke wo apni biwi ke paas chaar mahine ya usse zyada nahi jaayega. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jab chaar mahine guzar jaayen, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Jab chaar mahine guzar jaayen, to use roka jaaye, ya to wo wapas aaye ya talaaq de. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Jab chaar mahine guzar jaayen, to wo ek talaaq-e-baa'in hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Sa'eed bin Jubair narrated:"I was asked about those who were involved in the case of Li'an and if they are to be separated, during the leadership of Mus'ab bin Az-Zubair. I did not know what to say. So I went to the house of Abdullah bin Umar and I sought permission to enter. I was told that he was taking a nap, but he heard me talking and he said: 'Is it Ibn Jubair? Enter. You would not have come except for a need.'"He said: "So I entered and found him lying on a saddlecloth from his mount. I said: 'O Abu Abdur-Rahman! Are those involved in Li'an separated?' He said: 'Glorious is Allah! Yes. The first who asked about that was so-and-so the son of so-and-so. He came to the Prophet and said: "O Messenger of Allah! If one of us saw his wife committing adultery what should he do? If he were to say anything, his statement would be a horrible matter, and if he were to remain silent, his silence about the matter would be horrible." "He said: 'So the Prophet remained silent and did not answer him. Afterwards he came to the Prophet and said: "The one who asked you about it has been tried by it." So Allah revealed these Ayat from Surat An-Nur. And those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves - until the end of those Ayat. So he called for the man and recited the Ayat to him and admonished him, reminded him, and he told him: "Indeed the punishment of the world is less than the punishment of the Hereafter." So he said: "Nay! By the One Who sent you with the truth! I did not lie about her." Then he did the same with the woman, admonished her and reminding her and he told her: "Indeed the punishment of the world is less than the punishment of the Hereafter." She said: "Nay! By the One Who sent you with the truth! He is not telling the truth.'" "He said: 'So he started with the man: He testified four times, by Allah that he is one of the truthful, and the fifth time that the curse of Allah be upon him if he was one of the liars. Then the same with the woman: She testified four times by Allah, that he was one of the liars, and the fifth time that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was one of the truthful. Then he separated the two of them
hi: Sa'eed bin Jubair ne kaha: "Mujhse Mus'ab bin Az-Zubair ki hukumat mein li'an karne walon ke baare mein pucha gaya, kya unhein juda kiya jaaye? To mujhe nahi maloom tha ke kya kahoon. To main uthkar Abdullah bin Umar ke ghar gaya, unse ijazat maangi, to mujhe bataya gaya ke wo aaraam kar rahe hain. Unhon ne meri baat sun li aur kaha: 'Kya ye Ibn Jubair hai? Andar aao, tum zaroorat ke bagair nahi aaye hoge.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To main andar gaya, wo apni sawari ki gaddi par lete hue the. Maine kaha: 'Ae Abu Abdur-Rahman! Kya li'an karne walon ko juda kiya jaata hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Subhan-Allah! Haan. Iske baare mein sabse pehle poochne wala fulaan bin fulaan tha, wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Batayiye agar hum mein se koi apni biwi ko fahash kaam karte dekhe, to wo kya kare? Agar wo bole, to ek bade maamle ki baat bolega, aur agar khaamosh rahe, to ek bade maamle par khaamosh rahega.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Nabi (SAW) khaamosh rahe aur usse jawab nahi diya. Kuch waqt baad wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Jiske baare mein maine aapse pucha tha, usmein main khud mubtala ho gaya hoon.' To Allah ne Surah An-Nur ki ye Ayaten naazil ki: '(Aur jo log apni biwiyon par ilzaam lagaayen aur unke paas apni jaan ke siwa koi gawaah na ho)' yahan tak ke Ayaten khatam hui. To unhon ne aadmi ko bulaya, use Ayaten padh kar sunaayi, use nasihat ki aur yaad dilaya, aur use bataya ke duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se aasaan hai. To usne kaha: 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, maine uspar jhoot nahi bola.' Phir unhon ne aurat se bhi wahi kiya, use nasihat ki, yaad dilaya, aur use bataya ke duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se aasaan hai, to usne kaha: 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, wo sach nahi keh raha.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To pehle aadmi se shuru hua, usne chaar baar Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ke wo sachchon mein se hai, aur paanchvi baar ke Allah ki la'nat ho uspar agar wo jhoothon mein se ho. Phir aurat se, usne chaar baar Allah ki qasam khaakar gawaahi di ke wo jhoothon mein se hai, aur paanchvi baar ke Allah ka gussa uspar ho agar wo sachchon mein se ho. Phir unhon ne dono ko juda kar diya." Is mauzu par Sahl bin Sa'd, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Hudhaifah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai.

e: Ibn Umar narrated:"A man pronounced the Li'an on his wife, and the Prophet separated the two of them, and he decide that the child belonged to the mother
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne apni biwi se li'an kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhen juda kar diya, aur bachche ko maa se joda." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Zainab bint Ka'b bin Ujrah narrated that :Al-Furay'ah bint Malik bin Sinan - the sister of the Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri - informed her that she went to the Messenger of Allah to ask him if she could return to her family in Banu Khudrah. Her husband had gone out searching for his runaway slaves, and when he was in Turaf Al-Qadum he caught up with them and they killed him. She said: "So I asked the Messenger of Allah if I could return to my family since my husband had not left me a home that he owned nor any maintenance." She said: "So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Yes.' Then I left. When I was in the courtyard," or, "in the Masjid, the Messenger of Allah called me" or, "summoned for me to come back t him and he said: 'What did you say?'" She said: "So I repeated the store that I had mentioned to him about the case of my husband. He said: 'Stay in your house until what is written reaches its term.'" She said: "So I observed my Iddah there for four months and ten (days)." She said: "During the time of Uthman, he sent a message to me asking me about that, so I informed him. He followed it and judged accordingly
hi: Zainab bint Ka'b bin Ujrah se riwayat hai ke Al-Furai'ah bint Malik bin Sinan, jo Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ki behen hain, ne unhein bataya ke wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi thin, unse ye poochhne ke liye ke kya wo apne khaandaan Banu Khudrah ke paas laut sakti hain, kyunki unke shohar apne bhaage hue gulamon ki talaash mein nikle the, yahan tak ke Taraf Al-Qadum pahunche to unhon ne unhein pakad liya aur unhein qatl kar diya. Unhon ne kaha: "To maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ke main apne khaandaan ke paas laut jaaoon, kyunki mere shohar ne mere liye na koi ghar chhoda jiske wo maalik hon na koi nafqa." Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To main wapas laut gayi, yahan tak ke jab main kamre mein thi ya masjid mein, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe pukaara - ya mujhe bulaane ka hukum diya, to mujhe bulaaya gaya - to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumne kya kaha tha?'" Unhon ne kaha: "To maine unse wo qissa dohraaya jo maine unhein apne shohar ke baare mein bataya tha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apne ghar mein raho yahan tak ke likhi hui muddat apne waqt tak pahunche.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To maine wahan chaar mahine aur das din iddat guzaari." Unhon ne kaha: "Jab Uthman ka zamana aaya, to unhon ne mere paas paigham bheja aur mujhse iske baare mein pucha, to maine unhein bataya, to unhon ne isi ki pairvi ki aur isi ke mutabiq faisla diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, wo iddat waali aurat ko apne shohar ke ghar se, jab tak uski iddat khatam na ho jaaye, kahin aur jaana jaayez nahi maante. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Aurat jahan chahe iddat guzaar sakti hai, chahe wo apne shohar ke ghar mein iddat na guzaare. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Jab chaar mahine guzar jaayen, to wo ek talaaq-e-baa'in hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the one who consumed Riba, and the one who charged it, those who witnessed it, and the one who recorded it." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, Jabir [and Abu Juhaifah]. The Hadith of 'Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sood khaane wale, sood khilaane wale, uske dono gawaahon, aur usse likhne wale par la'nat ki." Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, aur Abu Juhaifah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said about the major sins:"Associating partners with Allah, disobeying parents, killing oneself, and false speech." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Abu Bakrah, Ayman bin Khuraim, and Ibn 'Umar Abu 'Eisa said: The Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne kabeera gunahon ke baare mein farmaya: "Allah ke saath shirk karna, waalidain ki nafarmani karna, jaan ka qatl karna, aur jhoothi gawaahi dena." Is mauzu par Abu Bakrah, Aiman bin Khuraim, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: An-Numan bin Bashir narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S) said:"The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between that are matters that are doubtful (not clear); many of the people do not know whether it is lawful or unlawful. So whoever leaves it to protect his religion and his honor, then he will be safe, and whoever falls into something from them, then he soon will have fallen into the unlawful. Just like if someone grazes (his animals) around a sanctuary, he would soon wind up in it. Indeed for every king is a sanctuary (pasture), and indeed Allah's sanctuary is what He made unlawful."
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Halal saaf hai aur haraam saaf hai, aur inke darmiyan kuch shubha waali cheezein hain jinhein zyada tar log nahi jaante ke wo halal hain ya haraam. To jo shakhs apne deen aur apni izzat ko bachaane ke liye unhein chhod de, wo mehfooz ho gaya, aur jo unmein se kisi cheez mein padta hai, wo jald hi haraam mein pad jaayega, jaise koi apne jaanwaron ko kisi hifazat waali zameen ke ird-gird charaaye, to wo jald usmein daakhil ho jaayega. Suno! Har baadshah ki ek hifazat waali zameen hoti hai, aur suno! Allah ki hifazat waali zameen uski haraam ki hui cheezein hain.'"

e: Narrated Isma'il bin 'Ubaid bin Rifa'ah: From his father, from his grandfather, that he went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to the Musalla, and he saw the people doing business so he said: 'O people of trade!' and they replied to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turning their necks and their gazes towards him, and he said: Indeed the merchants will be resurrected on the Day of judgement with the wicked, except the one who has Taqwa of Allah, who behaves charitably and is truthful.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. And they also say Isma'il bin 'Ubaidullah bin Rifa'ah
hi: Ismail bin Ubaid bin Rifa'ah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke saath Musalla ki taraf nikle, unhon ne dekha log khareed-farokht kar rahe hain, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ae tajiron ke giroh!" To unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki baat ka jawab diya aur apni gardanein aur nigahein unki taraf uthayin, to unhon ne farmaya: "Beshak tajir Qayamat ke din badkaar uthaaye jaayenge, siwaye us shakhs ke jo Allah se dare, neki kare, aur sach bole." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kaha jaata hai Ismail bin Ubaidullah bin Rifa'ah bhi.

e: Narrated Abu Dharr: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "There are three whom Allah will not look at on the Day of Judgement, nor will He purify them, and theirs is a painful punishment." We said: "Who are they O Messenger of Allah ? For they have indeed failed and are lost!" He sai: "The Mannan, the one whose Izar hangs (below the ankels) and the one who promotes his merchandise with false oath." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Umamah bin Tha'labah, 'Imran bin Husain, and Ma'qil bin Yasar [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Dharr is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen log hain jinhein Allah Qayamat ke din nazar nahi karega, na unhein paak karega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai." Maine kaha: "Ye kaun hain, Ya Rasool Allah? Wo to nakaam aur ghaate mein rahe!" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ehsaan jataane wala, apna tehband takhno se neeche latkaane wala, aur jhooti qasam khaakar apna saamaan bechne wala." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Umamah bin Tha'labah, Imran bin Husain, aur Ma'qil bin Yasar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Dharr ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Umarah bin Hadid: From Shakr Al-Ghamidi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "O Allah bless my Ummah in what they do early (in the day)." He said: "Whenever he (ﷺ) would dispatch a military expedition or an army, he would send them in the first part of the day." And Sakhr, a man who was a merchant, used to send his goods for trade during the beginning of the day, so he became rich, and his wealth increased. [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Buraidah, Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Ibn 'Umar, Ibn 'Abbas, and Jabir. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Sakhr Al-Ghamidi is a Hasan Hadith. We do not know of a narration that Sakhr Al-Ghamidi reported from the Prophet (ﷺ) other than this Hadith. Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported this Hadith from Shu'bah, from Ya'la bin 'Ata
hi: Sakhr Al-Ghamidi ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ya Allah! Meri Ummat ke liye unki subah ki jaldi mein barkat de." Unhon ne kaha: Aur jab wo koi lashkar ya fauj bhejte, to unhen din ke shuru mein bhejte the. Aur Sakhr ek tajir the, jab wo apni tijarat bhejte to din ke shuru mein bhejte, to wo maal daar ho gaye aur unka maal badh gaya. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Mas'ud, Buraidah, Anas, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sakhr Al-Ghamidi ki hadith hasan hai. Aur humein Sakhr Al-Ghamidi ki Nabi (SAW) se is hadith ke siwa koi aur riwayat maloom nahi. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne ye hadith Shu'bah se, Ya'la bin Ata se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wearing two thick Qitri garments on. When he would sit, he would sweat since they were so heavy for him. Some clothes arrived from Ash-Sham for so-and-so, the Jew. I said: 'Perhaps you could dispatch a request to him to buy some garments (on credit) from him until it is easy (to pay). So he sent a message to him and he said: 'I know what he wants. He only wants to take away my wealth' or 'my Dirham.' So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'He has lied, indeed he knows that I am the one with the most Taqwa among them, and the best at fulfilling trusts among them.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, Anas, and Asma' bint Yazid. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of 'Aishah is Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith. Shu'bah has also reported it from 'Umarah bin Abi Hafsah. He said: I heard Muhammad bin Firas Al-Basri saying: "I heard Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi saying: 'One day Shu'bah was asked about this Hadith, and he said: "I will not narrate it to you (people) until you stand up before Harami bin 'Umarah [bin Hafsah] to kiss his head." He said: 'And Harami was there among the people.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] Meaning: "approving of this Hadith
hi: Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas do mote Qitri kapde the, jab wo baithte to pasine se wo unpar bhaari ho jaate. Sham se ek Yahudi fulaan ke paas kapda aaya. Maine kaha: 'Kaash aap unke paas paigham bhejte aur unse do kapde udhaar par khareed lete, jab aasaani ho to ada kar dete.' To unhon ne unke paas paigham bheja, to usne kaha: 'Mujhe maloom hai wo kya chahte hain, wo to bas mera maal ya mere dirham le jaana chahte hain.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usne jhoot bola, use maloom hai ke main sabse zyada Allah se darne wala aur amaanat ada karne wala hoon.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Anas, aur Asma bint Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah ne bhi ye hadith Umarah bin Abi Hafsah se riwayat ki hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Firas Al-Basri ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi ko kehte suna: Ek din Shu'bah se is hadith ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: "Main tumhein ye hadith nahi sunaaunga jab tak tum Harami bin Umarah bin Abi Hafsah ke paas jaakar unka sar na chumo." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Harami logon mein maujood the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Yani is hadith ki taareef karte hue.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The Prophet (ﷺ) died while his armour was pawned for twenty Sa' of food that he got for his family." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua jabke unki zirah bees saa anaaj ke badle girvi thi, jo unhon ne apne ghar walon ke liye li thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas: I walked to the Prophet (ﷺ) with some barley bread that has some rancid oil poured over it. The Prophet (ﷺ) had pawned his armour with a Jew for twenty Sa' of food that he got for his family. That day (he pawned it), I heard him saying: 'Not for one evening has the household of Muhammad had a Sa' of dates or a Sa' of grain.' And on that day he had nine wives." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas jau ki roti aur baasi chikni cheez lekar gaya, aur unki zirah ek Yahudi ke paas bees saa anaaj ke badle girvi thi jo unhon ne apne ghar walon ke liye li thi, aur maine unhein ek din kehte suna: 'Muhammad (SAW) ke ghar mein ek raat bhi na khajoor ka ek saa raha na anaaj ka ek saa,' jabke us waqt unke paas nau biwiyan thin." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abbad bin Laith Al-Karabisi [Al-Basri]: "Abdul Majid bin Wahb narrated to us, he said: 'Al-'Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah said to me: "Shall I not read to you a letter that was written for me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ?'" He said: 'I said: "Of course." So he took out a letter for me: "This is what Al-'Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah purchased from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): He purchased from him a slave' - or - 'a female slave, having no ailments, nor being a runaway, nor having any malicious behavior. Sold by a Muslim to a Muslim.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from 'Abbad bin Laith. More than one of the people of Hadith have reported this Hadith from him
hi: Abdul Majid bin Wahb ne kaha: Al-Adda bin Khalid bin Hawdhah ne mujhse kaha: "Kya main tumhein wo khat na padh kar sunaaoon jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere liye likha tha?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor." To unhon ne mere liye ek khat nikaala: "Ye wo hai jo Al-Adda bin Khalid bin Hawdhah ne Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool (SAW), se khareeda, unse ek gulam ya laundi khareedi, jismein na koi bimari hai na koi chhupi hui khaami na koi kharaabi, ek Musalman ka doosre Musalman se bikri jaisi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abbad bin Laith ki hadith se jaante hain, aur ahl-e-hadith mein se kai logon ne unse ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to the people of weights and measures: "Indeed you have been entrusted with two matters that nations preceding you in the past were destroyed for." [Abu 'Eisa said:] We do not know this Hadith to be Marfu' except through the narration of Husain bin Qais, and Husain bin Qais was graded weak in Hadith. This has been reported as Maquf narration from Ibn 'Abbas with a Sahih chain of narration
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne naap-tol karne walon se farmaya: "Tumhein do aisi cheezon ka zimma diya gaya hai jinki wajah se tumse pehle ki ummatein tabaah ho gayin." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum marfu' sirf Husain bin Qais ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Husain bin Qais hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur ye Ibn Abbas se ek sahih isnad ke saath mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sold a saddle blanket and a drinking bowl. He (ﷺ) said: "Who will buy saddle blanket and drinking bowl ?". So a man said: "I will take them for a Dirham." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Who will give more than a Dirham ? Who will give more that a Dirham ?" A man agreed to give him two Dirham, so he sold them to him. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. We do not know of it except from the narration of Al-Akhdar bin 'Ajlan, and 'Abdullah Al-Hanafi who is reporting from Anas, is Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge, they did not see any harm in auctioning the spolis of war and inheritance. Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman and others among the people of Hadith reported from Al-Akhdar bin 'Ajlan
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chaadar aur ek pyala becha, aur farmaya: "Ye chaadar aur pyala kaun khareedega?" To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Maine inhein ek dirham mein le liya." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaun ek dirham se zyada dega? Kaun ek dirham se zyada dega?" To ek aadmi ne unhein do dirham diye, to unhon ne unhein usse bech diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Al-Akhdar bin Ajlan ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Abdullah Al-Hanafi jo Anas se riwayat karte hain, wo Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne maal-e-ghanimat aur wirasat ki neelaami mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman aur ahl-e-hadith mein se kai doosron ne Al-Akhdar bin Ajlan se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "A man among the Ansar decided to free a slave of his after his death. He died but he left no wealth behind beside the slave. So the Prophet (ﷺ) sold him and Nu'aim [bin 'Abdullah] bin An-Nah-ham bought him." Jabir said: "He was Coptic slave who died during the first year of the leadership of Ibn Az-Zubair." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih and it has been reported through more than one route from Jabir bin 'Abdullah. This Hadith is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They did not see any harm in the sale of Mudabbar. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. There are those among people of knowledge, among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, who disliked selling the Mudabbar. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik and Al-Awza'i
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Ansar ke ek aadmi ne apne gulam ko mudabbar banaya, phir wo mar gaya aur usne uske siwa koi maal nahi chhoda, to Nabi (SAW) ne use bech diya, aur Nu'aim bin Abdullah bin An-Nahham ne use khareeda. Jabir ne kaha: Wo ek Qibti gulam tha jo Ibn Az-Zubair ki hukumat ke pehle saal mar gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur Jabir bin Abdullah se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne mudabbar ki bikri mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne mudabbar ki bikri ko napasand kiya. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik, aur Al-Awza'i ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas'ud: From the Prophet (ﷺ): "He prohibited meeting the owners of the goods." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn 'Umar, and a man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Mas'ud se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne saudagaron se raaste mein mil kar khareedne se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Umar, aur Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited meeting the goods being brought (to the market). If someone were to meet them and buy them, then the owner of the goods retains the option when he reaches the market." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib narration of Ayyub (a narrator). The Hadith if Ibn Mas'ud is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. There are those among the people of knowledge who disliked meeting the owners of the goods, saying that it is a type of deception. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, and others among our companions
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya ke qafile ko mandi mein pahunchne se pehle raaste mein mil kar saamaan khareeda jaaye, aur agar koi aisa kare aur khareed le, to saamaan ka maalik mandi mein pahunchne par ikhtiyar rakhta hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ayyub ki riwayat mein hasan ghareeb hai, aur Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne raaste mein mil kar khareedne ko napasand kiya, ye ek tarah ka dhoka hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur humare doosre saathiyon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The dweller of the town is not to sell for the Bedouin." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Talhah, Jabir, Anas, Ibn 'Abbas, Hakim bin Abi Yazid from his father, 'Amr bin 'Awf Al-Muzani the grandfather of Kathir bin 'Abdullah, and a man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shehri Bedouin ke liye na beche." Is mauzu par Talhah, Jabir, Anas, Ibn Abbas, Hakim bin Abi Yazid apne walid se, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani jo Kathir bin Abdullah ke dada hain, aur Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The dweller of the town is not to sell for the Bedouin, leave the people ; Allah provides for some of them through others." [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith, and this Hadith of Jabir is a Hasan Sahih Hadith as well. This Hadith is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They dislike the dweller of the town to sell for the Bedouin, while some of them permitted the town dweller to purchase for the Bedouin. Ash-Shafi'i said: "It is disliked for the dweller of the town to sell for the Bedouin, and if he does sell, then the sale is permissible
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shehri Bedouin ke liye na beche, logon ko chhod do, Allah unmein se kuch ko kuch ke zariye rizq deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur is mauzu mein Jabir ki hadith bhi hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne shehri ka Bedouin ke liye bechna napasand kiya. Aur kuch ne shehri ke Bedouin ke liye khareedne ki rukhsat di. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Shehri ka Bedouin ke liye bechna napasand hai, aur agar usne becha, to bikri jaayez hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited Muhaqalah and Muzabanah. [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Ibn 'Abbas, Zaid bin Thabit, Sa'd, Jabir, Rafi' bin Khadij, and Abu Sa'eed. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. Muhaqalah is selling corps for wheat, and Muzabanah is selling dates that are on the date-palm for dried dates. This is acted upon according to the most of the people of knowledge, they disliked sales of Muhaqalah and Muzabanah
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muhaqalah aur muzabanah se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Zaid bin Thabit, Sa'd, Jabir, Rafi bin Khadij, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur muhaqalah khade khet ko gehun ke badle bechna hai. Aur muzabanah khajoor ke darakht par lagi khajoor ko sukhi khajoor ke badle bechna hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne muhaqalah aur muzabanah ki bikri ko napasand kiya.

e:
Narrated Anas bin Malik:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sold a saddle blanket and a drinking bowl. He (ﷺ) said: "Who will buy saddle blanket and drinking bowl ?". So a man said: "I will take them for a Dirham." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Who will give more than a Dirham ? Who will give more that a Dirham ?" A man agreed to give him two Dirham, so he sold them to him.


 This Hadith is Hasan. We do not know of it except from the narration of Al-Akhdar bin 'Ajlan, and 'Abdullah Al-Hanafi who is reporting from Anas, is Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi.


This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge, they did not see any harm in auctioning the spolis of war and inheritance.


Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman and others among the people of Hadith reported from Al-Akhdar bin 'Ajlan.
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek chaadar aur ek pyala becha, aur farmaya: "Ye chaadar aur pyala kaun khareedega?" To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Maine inhein ek dirham mein le liya." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaun ek dirham se zyada dega? Kaun ek dirham se zyada dega?" To ek aadmi ne unhein do dirham diye, to unhon ne unhein usse bech diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Al-Akhdar bin Ajlan ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Abdullah Al-Hanafi jo Anas se riwayat karte hain, wo Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne maal-e-ghanimat aur wirasat ki neelaami mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman aur ahl-e-hadith mein se kai doosron ne Al-Akhdar bin Ajlan se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited selling date-palms until they have blossomed
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khajoor ke darakht ko us waqt tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak wo pak kar rang na badle.

e: With this (same as no. 1226) chain:"The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited selling ears (of grain) until they have whitened (shown their kernals) and are safe from blight, he forbade it for the seller and the buyer." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Anas, Ibn 'Abbas, Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, and Zaid bin Thabit. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They dislike selling fruits before their usefulness appears, this is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq
hi: Isi isnad se ke Nabi (SAW) ne bali ko us waqt tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak wo safed na ho jaaye aur aafat se mehfooz na ho jaaye, bechne wale aur khareedne wale dono ko mana kiya. Is mauzu par Anas, Aishah, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, aur Zaid bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne phalon ko unki pakaai zaahir hone se pehle bechna napasand kiya. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited selling grapes until they appear and selling grains until they become firm." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it being Marfu' except from the narration of Hammad bin Salamah
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor ko us waqt tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak wo kaale na ho jaayen, aur daane ko us waqt tak bechne se mana kiya jab tak wo sakht na ho jaayen. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise marfu' sirf Hammad bin Salamah ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited the sale of Habalil-Habalah." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas and Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. And Hababil-Habalah is the offspring of the offspring (of an animal). It is an invalid sale according to the people of knowledge and it is type of Gharar sale. Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Ayyub, from Sa'eed bin Jubair, from Ibn 'Abbas. 'Abdul Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi and others reported it from Ayyub, from Sa'eed bin Jubair and Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and this is more correct
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne "habal-ul-habalah" ki bikri se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Abbas aur Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur "habal-ul-habalah" us bachche ki paidaish hai jo abhi paida hone wale bachche ke pait mein hai, aur ye ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek fasakh shuda bikri hai, aur ye gharar ki bikriyon mein se hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Ayyub se, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki hai. Aur Abdul Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi aur doosron ne Ayyub se, Sa'eed bin Jubair aur Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the Gharar sale, and the Hasah sale." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Sahih Hadith. This Hadith is acted upon according to the people of knowledge, they dislike the Gharar. Ash-Shafi'i said: "The Gharar sale includes selling fish that are in the wate, selling a slave that has escaped, selling birds that are in the sky, and similar type of sales. And the meaning of Hasah sale is when the seller says to the buyer: 'When I toss the pebble at you, then the sale between you and I is final.' This resembles the sale of Munabadhah and this is one of the selling practices of the people of Jahiliyyah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne gharar ki bikri aur kankar ki bikri se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne gharar ki bikri napasand ki. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Gharar ki bikriyon mein paani mein machli bechna, bhaage hue gulam ko bechna, aasman mein parinde ko bechna, aur isi tarah ki bikriyan shaamil hain. Aur kankar ki bikri ka matlab ye hai ke bechne wala khareedne wale se kahe: "Jab main tumhari taraf kankar phenkoon, to hum donon ke darmiyan bikri wajib ho jaayegi." Ye munabadhah ki bikri se milta julta hai, aur ye Jahiliyyah walon ki bikriyon mein se tha.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited two sales in one." There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, Ibn 'Umar, and Ibn Mas'ud. [Abu Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. Some of the people of knowledge have explained it by saying that two sales in one is when one says: "I will sell you this garment for ten in cash, and twenty on credit." He does not distinguish between either of the two sales. But when he distinguishes it as being one of them, then there is no harm when one of them is agreed upon. Ash-Shafi'i said: "Included in the meaning of what the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited of regarding two sales in one, is if one said: 'I will sell you the house of mine for that (price), upon the condition that you sell me you alve for this (price). When I get the slave, then you get the house.' In this way the sales are distinguished without the prices being known, and neither of them knows what will happen at the conclusion of it (the agreement)
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek bikri mein do bikriyon se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Ibn Umar, aur Ibn Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Kuch ahl-e-ilm ne "ek bikri mein do bikriyon" ki tafseer ki, unhon ne kaha: Ye ye hai ke bechne wala kahe: "Main tumhein ye kapda nagad das mein aur udhaar bees mein bechta hoon," aur dono bikriyon mein se kisi ek par juda na ho. Lekin agar wo unmein se kisi ek par juda ho jaaye, to koi harj nahi jab aqad unmein se ek par ho. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) ke "ek bikri mein do bikriyon" se mana karne ke matlab mein ye bhi shaamil hai ke bechne wala kahe: "Main tumhein apna ye ghar itne mein bechta hoon is shart par ke tum apna gulam mujhe itne mein becho, jab mujhe tumhara gulam mil jaaye to tumhein mera ghar mil jaayega." Ye ek aisi bikri hai jismein qeemat maloom nahi, aur donon mein se koi nahi jaanta ke unka sauda kis par tay hoga.

e: Narrated Hakim b. Hizam:"I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I said: 'A man came to me asking to buy something that I did not have. Can I buy it from the market for him and then give it to him?' He said: 'Do not sell what is not with you.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Mere paas ek aadmi aata hai aur mujhse aisi cheez maangta hai jo mere paas nahi hoti, kya main mandi se uske liye khareed kar phir usse bech doon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo tumhare paas nahi hai wo mat becho.'" Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Hakim b. Hizam: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited me from selling what was not with me." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. He said: There is something on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar. Ishaq bin Mansur said: "I said to Ahmad: 'What is the meaning of the prohibition from a loan along with a sale? He said: 'That he gives him a loan and then he makes a sale to him greater then it's actual worth. And, it carries the meaning of him loaning it to him in exchange for something (as collateral), so he says: 'If you are unable to pay it (the loan), the it (the collateral) will be a sale for you.' Ishaq [bin Rahuwyah] said as he said. And I said to Ahmad: 'What about selling what one does not possess?' He said: 'To me it does not apply except in cases of food - meaning one has not taken possession of it.' And Ishaq said the same for all of what is measured or weighed. Ahmad said: 'When he says: "I will sell you this garment, with the condition that I am the tailor for it, and I am the one who bleaches it.' This is an example of two conditions in one sale. But if he says: "I am selling it to you with the condition that I am its tailor," then there is no harm in it. And, if he said: "I am selling it to you with the condition that I am the one who bleaches it" then there is no harm in it, because this is only one condition.' And Ishaq said as he said
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe us cheez ko bechne se mana kiya jo mere paas na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Ishaq bin Mansur ne kaha: Maine Ahmad se kaha: "'Salaf aur bikri' se mana karne ka kya matlab hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ye ke wo use qarz de, phir uspar ek aisi bikri kare jismein uski asal qeemat se zyada le." Aur ye bhi ho sakta hai ke wo usse kisi cheez ke liye salaf de, phir kahe: "Agar tumhare paas taiyaar na ho, to ye tumpar ek bikri hogi." Ishaq ne bhi yehi kaha. Maine Ahmad se kaha: "Aur us cheez ki bikri ke baare mein jiski zimmedaari nahi li?" Unhon ne kaha: "Mere nazdeek ye sirf khaane ki cheezon mein hai jo qabza mein na ho." Ishaq ne kaha jaisa unhon ne kaha, har us cheez mein jo napi ya tauli jaati ho. Ahmad ne kaha: Agar wo kahe "Main tumhein ye kapda bechta hoon aur iski silaai aur safaai mera zimma hai," to ye do sharton jaisa hai ek bikri mein. Aur agar wo kahe "Main tumhein bechta hoon aur iski silaai mera zimma hai," to koi harj nahi, ya kahe "Main tumhein bechta hoon aur iski safaai mera zimma hai," to koi harj nahi, kyunki ye sirf ek shart hai. Ishaq ne bhi yehi kaha.

e: Narrated Ayyub: 'Amr bin Shu'aib narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me from his father' until he mentioned 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'It is not lawful to lend and sell, nor two conditions in a sale, nor to profit from what is not possessed, nor to sell what one does not have.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Hakim bin Hizam is a Hasan Hadith, it has been reported from him through other routes. Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani and Abu Bishr report from Yusuf bin Mahak, from Hakim bin Hizam. [Abu 'Eisa said:] 'Awf and Hisham bin Hassan reported this Hadith from Ibn Sirin, from Hakim bin Hizam from the Prophet (ﷺ). And this is a Mursal Hadith. Ibn Sirin only reported it from Ayyub As-Sikhtiyani from Yusuf bin Mahak, from Hakim bin Hizam like this
hi: Ayyub se riwayat hai, Amr bin Shu'aib ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Mere waalid ne mujhe apne waalid se bataya, yahan tak ke unhon ne Abdullah bin Amr ka zikr kiya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salaf aur bikri jaayez nahi, na ek bikri mein do shartein, na us cheez ka munafa jiski zimmedaari na li ho, na us cheez ki bikri jo tumhare paas na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hakim bin Hizam ki hadith hasan hai, jo unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani aur Abu Bishr ne Yusuf bin Mahak se, Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat ki hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Awf aur Hisham bin Hassan ne Ibn Sirin se, Hakim bin Hizam se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur ye hadith mursal hai, Ibn Sirin ne ise sirf Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani se, Yusuf bin Mahak se, Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Hakim b. Hizam: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited me from selling what was not with me."
