[Abu 'Eisa said:] Waki' reported this Hadith from Yazid bin Ibrahim, from Ibn Sirin, from Ayyub, from Hakim bin Hizam, and he did not mention in it: "From Yusuf bin Mahak." And the narration of 'Abdus-Samad (a narrator in the chain of Hadith no. 1235) is more correct. Yahya bin Abi Kathir reported this Hadith from Ya'la bin Hakim, from Yusuf bin Mahak, from 'Abdullah bin 'Ismah, from Hakim bin Hizam, from the Prophet (ﷺ). This Hadith is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, they dislike for a man to sell what is not with him
hi: Hakim bin Hizam ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe us cheez ko bechne se mana kiya jo mere paas na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Waki ne ye hadith Yazid bin Ibrahim se, Ibn Sirin se, Ayyub se, Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat ki, aur ismein Yusuf bin Mahak ka zikr nahi kiya, aur Abdus-Samad ki riwayat zyada sahih hai. Aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne ye hadith Ya'la bin Hakim se, Yusuf bin Mahak se, Abdullah bin Ismah se, Hakim bin Hizam se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne aadmi ke liye us cheez ko bechna napasand kiya jo uske paas na ho.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited selling the Wala' and conferring it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. We do not know of it except as a narration of 'Abdullah bin Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar. This Hadith is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. Yahya bin Sulaim reported this Hadith from 'Ubaidullah bin 'Umar, from Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ), saying "That he prohibited selling the Wala' and conferring it." But this is mistake from Yahya bin Sulaim. Because 'Abdul Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi, 'Abdullah bin Numair and others reported it from 'Ubaidullah bin 'Umar, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ). And this is more correct than the narration of Yahya bin Sulaim
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wala ko bechne aur hiba karne se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Abdullah bin Dinar ki, Ibn Umar se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai. Aur Yahya bin Sulaim ne ye hadith Ubaidullah bin Umar se, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki ke unhon ne wala ko bechne aur hiba karne se mana kiya. Aur ye Yahya bin Sulaim ki galti hai. Aur Abdul Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi, Abdullah bin Numair, aur kai doosron ne Ubaidullah bin Umar se, Abdullah bin Dinar se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai, aur ye Yahya bin Sulaim ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Samurah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited bartering animals on credit." He said: There are narration on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, Jabir, Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Samurah is Hasan Sahih Hadith. It is correct that Al-Hasan heard from Samurah, this is what 'Ali bin Al-Madini and others said. Regarding (the prohibition of) bartering animals on credit, this is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri and the people of Al-Kufah, and it is the view of Ahmad. Some of the people of knowledge, among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, permitted bartering animals for animals on credit. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i and Ishaq
hi: Samurah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne jaanwar ko jaanwar ke badle udhaar par bechne se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Al-Hasan ka Samurah se sunna sahih hai, isi tarah Ali bin Al-Madini aur doosron ne kaha. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek jaanwar ko jaanwar ke badle udhaar par bechne mein isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ahmad qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne jaanwar ko jaanwar ke badle udhaar par bechne ki rukhsat di. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Animals [two for one] are not proper on credit, and there is no harm in a hand to hand (exchange)." The Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do jaanwar ek jaanwar ke badle udhaar par theek nahi, aur haath-se-haath mein koi harj nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "A slave came to give the pledge to the Prophet (ﷺ) for Hijrah, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not realize that he was a slave. So his master came to get him and the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Sell him to me.' So he purchased him for two black slaves. Then he would not pledge from anyone until he asked him if he was a slave." [He said:] There is something on this topic from Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Jabir is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. There is no harm in a slave for two slaves in hand to hand exchange, but they differ when it is on credit
hi: Jabir ne kaha: "Ek gulam aaya aur Nabi (SAW) se hijrat par bai'at ki, jabke Nabi (SAW) ko nahi maloom tha ke wo gulam hai. To uska maalik use lene aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ise mujhe bech do.' To unhon ne use do kaale gulamon ke badle khareed liya, phir wo kisi se bai'at nahi lete the jab tak uspar pucha na jaaye ke kya wo gulam hai." Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke ek gulam do gulamon ke badle haath-se-haath mein koi harj nahi, lekin unka udhaar ke maamle mein ikhtilaaf hai.

e: Narrated 'Ubadah bin As-Samit: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Gold for gold, kind for kind; silver for silver, kind for kind; dried-dates for dried-dates, kind for kind; wheat for wheat, kind for kind; salt for salt, kind for kind; and barley for barley, kind for kind. Whoever increases or seeks an increase, then he dealt with Riba. Sell gold for silver as you wish, hand to hand; and sell wheat for dried-dates as you wish, hand to hand; and sell barley for dried-dates as you wish, hand to hand." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Bilal, And Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of 'Ubadah bin As-Samit is Hasan Sahih. Some of them reported this Hadith from Khalid, with this chain, and he said: "Sell wheat for barley as you wish, hand to hand." Some of them reported this Hadith from Khalid, from Abu Qilabah, from Ash'ath, from 'Ubadah from the Prophet (ﷺ). In that Hadith, they added that Khalid said: "Abu Qilabah said: "Sell wheat for barley as you wish, hand to hand." This Hadith is acted upon according to the people of knowledge, they do not think that one may sell wheat for wheat except when it is the same kind for the same kind, and (the same for) barely in exchange for barley, kind for kind. When the items are themselves different, then there is no harm in one being more than the other if it is hand to hand. This is saying of most of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. It is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Ash-Shafi'i said: "And the proof for that is the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ): 'Sell barley for wheat as you wish, hand to hand.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] Some of the people of knowledge considered it disliked that wheat be sold for barely unless it was kind for kind. This is the view of Malik bin Anas, but the first view is more correct
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Sona sone ke badle barabar barabar, chandi chandi ke badle barabar barabar, khajoor khajoor ke badle barabar barabar, gehun gehun ke badle barabar barabar, namak namak ke badle barabar barabar, aur jau jau ke badle barabar barabar. Jo zyada de ya zyada le, usne sood kiya. Sona chandi ke badle jaise chaho becho, haath-se-haath, aur gehun khajoor ke badle jaise chaho becho, haath-se-haath, aur jau khajoor ke badle jaise chaho becho, haath-se-haath." Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Bilal, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ubadah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Khalid se isi isnad se riwayat ki aur kaha: "Gehun jau ke badle jaise chaho becho, haath-se-haath." Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Khalid se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu Al-Ash'ath se, Ubadah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki aur usmein izafa kiya, Khalid ne kaha: Abu Qilabah ne kaha: "Gehun jau ke badle jaise chaho becho," phir hadith zikr ki. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo gehun ko gehun ke badle sirf barabar barabar bechna maante hain, aur jau ko jau ke badle sirf barabar barabar. Aur jab qismein alag ho jaayen, to haath-se-haath mein kam-zyada bechne mein koi harj nahi. Aur ye zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ka qaul hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur iski dalil Nabi (SAW) ka qaul hai: "Jau gehun ke badle jaise chaho becho, haath-se-haath." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne gehun ko jau ke badle sirf barabar barabar bechna napasand kiya. Aur ye Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai, lekin pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Nafi': "Ibn 'Umar and I went to Abu Sa'eed and he narrated to us: 'the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said - and I heard him with these [two] ears: "Do not sell gold for gold except kind for kind, nor sliver for silver except kind for kind, do not exchange more of one than the other, and do not sell what is not present from them for what is present." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, Abu Hurairah, Hisham bin 'Amir, Al-Bara', Zaid bin Arqam, Fadalah bin 'Ubaid, Abu Bakrah, Ibn 'Umar, Abu Ad-Darda', and Bilal. [He said:] The Hadith of Abu Sa'eed, from the Prophet (ﷺ) [about Riba] is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, except for what has been related from Ibn 'Abbas; he did not see any harm in exchanging gold for gold or silver for silver, more for less, when it is done hand in hand, and he said: "Riba' is only in credit." Similar it has been related from some of his companions. It has been related that Ibn 'Abbas changed his opinion when Abu Sa'eed narrated it to him from the Prophet (ﷺ). The first view is more correct. And this is acted upon according to the people of knowledge [among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others]. It is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. It has been reported that Ibn Al-Mubarak said: "There is no difference over exchange
hi: Nafi ne kaha: "Main aur Ibn Umar Abu Sa'eed ke paas gaye, to unhon ne humein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya - maine ise apne in donon kaanon se suna - 'Sona sone ke badle sirf barabar barabar mat becho, aur chandi chandi ke badle sirf barabar barabar, ek doosre se zyada na ho, aur unmein se maujood ko ghair-maujood ke badle mat becho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Abu Hurairah, Hisham bin Aamir, Al-Bara, Zaid bin Arqam, Fadalah bin Ubaid, Abu Bakrah, Ibn Umar, Abu Ad-Darda, aur Bilal se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Sa'eed ki, Nabi (SAW) se, sood ke baare mein hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, siwaye is ke jo Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke wo sona sone ke badle kam-zyada bechna, aur chandi chandi ke badle kam-zyada bechna, jab haath-se-haath ho, uspar koi harj nahi maante the. Aur unhon ne kaha: Sood sirf udhaar mein hota hai. Aur isi tarah unke kuch saathiyon se bhi kuch aisi baat riwayat hui hai. Aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke wo apne is qaul se palat gaye jab Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ne unhein Nabi (SAW) se hadith bataayi. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Sarf mein koi ikhtilaaf nahi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "I would sell camels at Al-Baqi', so I would sell them for Dinar but take in place of them Dirham, and, I would sell for silver and take Dinar in its place. So I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and found him leaving the house of Hafsah. I asked him about that and he said: 'There is no harm in that when it (equals) the price.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] We do not know of this Hadith being Marfu' except from the narration of Simak bin Harb from Sa'eed bin Jubair, from Ibn 'Umar. Dawud bin Abi Hind narrated this Hadith from Abu Sa'eed bin Jubair, from Ibn 'Umar in Mawquf form. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. There is no harm in paying for gold with silver and silver with gold. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge, among the Companions and others, disliked that
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Main Al-Baqi mein oont becha karta tha, to main dinar mein bechta aur uski jagah dirham le leta, aur dirham mein bechta aur uski jagah dinar le leta. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya, unhein Hafsah ke ghar se nikalte paaya, to maine unse iske baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Qeemat ke mutabiq lene mein koi harj nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum marfu' sirf Simak bin Harb ki, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Umar se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Dawud bin Abi Hind ne ye hadith Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Umar se mauqoof riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke sona chandi se aur chandi sona se lene mein koi harj nahi. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne isse napasand kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn Shihab: From Malik bin Aws bin Hadathan that he said: "I once said: 'Who can change some Dirham?' So Talhah bin 'Ubaidullah - and he was with 'Umar bin Al-Khattab - said: "Leave your gold with us, then return to us when our servant comes and we will give you your silver." 'Umar bin Al-Khattab said: "No! By Allah! Either give him his silver or return his gold to him. Indeed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Silver for gold is Riba, except for hand to hand; and wheat for wheat is Riba except for hand to hand; and barley for barley is Riba except hand to hand; and dried-dates for dried-dates is Riba except for hand to hand.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. And the meaning of Ha' Wa Ha' is hand to hand
hi: Malik bin Aws bin Al-Hadathan ne kaha: "Main aaya aur keh raha tha: Kaun dirham badlega? To Talhah bin Ubaidullah, jo Umar bin Al-Khattab ke paas the, ne kaha: 'Apna sona humein dikhao, phir humare paas aana jab humara khaadim aa jaaye, hum tumhein tumhari chandi denge.' To Umar ne kaha: 'Hargiz nahi, Allah ki qasam! Ya to use uski chandi do, ya uska sona use wapas karo, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Chandi sone ke badle sood hai siwaye haath-se-haath ke, aur gehun gehun ke badle sood hai siwaye haath-se-haath ke, aur jau jau ke badle sood hai siwaye haath-se-haath ke, aur khajoor khajoor ke badle sood hai siwaye haath-se-haath ke.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur unke qaul "haath-se-haath" ka matlab hai.

e: Narrated Salim: From his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever purchases a date-palm after it has been pollinated then its fruits are for the one who sold it, unless the buyer made it a condition. And whoever purchases slave who has property, then his property is for the one who sold him, unless the buyer made it a condition." [He said:] There is something on this topic from Jabir. The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. Similarly, it has been reported by more than one route from Az-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) "Whoever purchases a date-palm after it has been pollinated, then its fruits are for seller, unless the buyer made it a condition. And whoever purchases a slave who has property, then his property is for the seller, unless the buyer made it a condition." And it has been reported from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever purchases a date-palm that has been pollinated, then its fruits are for the seller, unless the buyer made it a condition." It has been reported from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from 'Umar, that he (ﷺ) said: "Whoever sold a slave who has property, his property is for the seller, unless the buyer made it a condition." This is how the two Ahadith were reported by 'Ubaidullah bin 'Umar and others from Nafi'. Some of them have also reported this Hadith from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ). 'Ikrimah bin Khalid reported similar to the Hadith of Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ). This Hadith is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. It is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "The Hadith of Az-Zuhri from Salim, from his father, from the Prophet (ﷺ) is the most correct [of what has been reported on this topic]
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jo khajoor ka darakht paraagit hone ke baad khareede, to uska phal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe. Aur jo gulam khareede jiske paas maal ho, to uska maal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe." Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah kai tareeqon se Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jo khajoor ka darakht paraagit hone ke baad khareede, to uska phal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe. Aur jo gulam beche jiske paas maal ho, to uska maal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe." Aur Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo khajoor ka darakht paraagit ho chuka ho khareede, to uska phal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe." Aur Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jo gulam beche jiske paas maal ho, to uska maal bechne wale ka hai, siwaye is ke ke khareedne wala shart rakhe." Isi tarah Ubaidullah bin Umar aur doosron ne Nafi se donon hadithein riwayat ki hain. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith bhi Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Ikrimah bin Khalid ne Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se Salim ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Az-Zuhri ki, Salim se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith is mauzu mein sabse sahih hai.

e: Narrated Nafi': From Ibn 'Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Both the buyer and the seller retain the option as long as they have not separated or they give each other than option." He (Nafi') said: "So when Ibn 'Umar purchased something while he was sitting, he would stand to complete the sale
hi: Nafi, Ibn Umar se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Khareedne wala aur bechne wala dono ko ikhtiyar hai jab tak wo juda na hon ya ikhtiyar chun na len." Unhon ne kaha: To Ibn Umar jab koi bikri karte aur baithe hote, to wo khade ho jaate taake unke liye bikri wajib ho jaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Barzah, Hakim bin Hizam, Abdullah bin Abbas, Abdullah bin Amr, Samurah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Juda hona badan se hota hai, baaton se nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke qaul "jab tak wo juda na hon" ka matlab, unke nazdeek, baaton se juda hona hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai, kyunki Ibn Umar hi ne Nabi (SAW) se ye riwayat ki, aur wo apni riwayat ke matlab ko sabse zyada jaanne wale hain, aur unse riwayat hai ke jab wo bikri wajib karna chahte, to wo chal kar jaate taake unke liye wajib ho jaaye. Isi tarah Abu Barzah Al-Aslami se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Hakim b. Hizam: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Both the buyer and the seller retain the option as long as they have not separated. If they spoke the truth and clarified (any defects or conditions), then they would be blessed in their sale, and if they hid something and lied then their sale would be deprived of blessings." And this is a Sahih Hadith. This is how it was reported from Abu Barzah Al-Aslami, that two men came disputing to him after the sale of a horse, and they were on a ship, so he said: "I did not see the two of your separate, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The buyer and the seller retain the choice as long as they did not separate.'" Some of the people of knowledge, among the people of Al-Kufah and others, held the view that the separation refers to speech. This is the saying of [Sufyan] Ath-Thawri. This has been reported from Malik bin Anas, and it has been reported from Ibn al-Mubarak that he said: "How could this be refuted ?" And the Hadith about it from the Prophet (ﷺ) is Sahih, and it strenghtens this view. And the meaning of the saying of the Prophet (ﷺ): "Except for the optional sale" is, that (while they are still together) the seller gives the buyer the option to cancel after the conclusion of the sale. If he chooses to agree to the sale, then he does not have the choice to cancel the sale after then, even if they did not separate. This is how Ash-Shafi'i and others explained it. And what strenghtens the view of those who said that the separation refers to them parting, (and) it does not refer to speech, is the (following) Hadith of 'Abdullah bin 'Amr from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khareedne wala aur bechne wala dono ko ikhtiyar hai jab tak wo juda na hon. Agar unhon ne sach bola aur khaamiyaan zaahir kin, to unki bikri mein barkat di jaayegi, aur agar unhon ne chhupaaya aur jhoot bola, to unki bikri ki barkat mit jaayegi." Ye hadith sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Barzah, Hakim bin Hizam, Abdullah bin Abbas, Abdullah bin Amr, Samurah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Juda hona badan se hota hai, baaton se nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke qaul "jab tak wo juda na hon" ka matlab baaton se juda hona hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai kyunki Ibn Umar hi ne Nabi (SAW) se ye riwayat ki, aur wo apni riwayat ke matlab ko sabse zyada jaanne wale hain, aur unse riwayat hai ke jab wo bikri wajib karna chahte, to wo chal kar jaate taake unke liye wajib ho jaaye. Isi tarah Abu Barzah Al-Aslami se riwayat hai ke do aadmiyon ne ek ghode ki bikri ke baad unke paas jhagda kiya, jabke wo ek kashti mein the, to unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi lagta tum donon juda hue ho," aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khareedne wala aur bechne wala dono ko ikhtiyar hai jab tak wo juda na hon." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Kufa waalon aur doosron mein se, is baat ke qaayal hain ke juda hona baaton se hota hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai. Isi tarah Malik bin Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main ise kaise radd karoon jabke iske baare mein Nabi (SAW) se hadith sahih hai?" Aur unhon ne isi mazhab ko mazboot kiya. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke qaul "siwaye ikhtiyar ki bikri ke" ka matlab ye hai ke bechne wala khareedne wale ko bikri wajib hone ke baad ikhtiyar de, to agar usne ikhtiyar diya aur usne bikri ko chuna, to uske baad use bikri fasakh karne ka ikhtiyar nahi, chahe wo juda na huye hon. Isi tarah Ash-Shafi'i aur doosron ne iski tafseer ki hai. Aur jo baat un logon ke qaul ko mazboot karti hai jo kehte hain ke juda hona badan se hota hai na ke baaton se, wo Abdullah bin Amr ki, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Both the buyer and the seller retain the option as long as they did not separate, unless they agreed to making it optional. And it is not lawful for him to separate from his companion, fearing that he will change his mind." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan and this means separating from him after the sale, fearing that he will change his mind. And if the separation referred to speech, and there was no option left for him after the sale, then this Hadith would be meaningless, since he (ﷺ) said: "And it is not lawful for him to separate from his companion, fearing that he will change his mind
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khareedne wala aur bechne wala dono ko ikhtiyar hai jab tak wo juda na hon, siwaye is ke ke bikri ikhtiyar waali ho, aur uske liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne saathi se is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur iska matlab ye hai ke wo bikri ke baad is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le, aur agar juda hona baaton se hota aur bikri ke baad koi ikhtiyar na hota, to is hadith ka koi matlab na hota jab unhon ne farmaya: "Aur uske liye jaayez nahi ke wo is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "They (the two) are not separate from a sale except in agreement. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo dono bikri se sirf raazi mandi ke saath juda hon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Prophet (ﷺ) gave a Bedouin the option after a sale." This Hadith is Hasan Gharib
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne bikri ke baad ek Bedouin ko ikhtiyar diya. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas: That there was a man who was not very sensible and he would make purchases. So his family came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Stop him (from making purchases)." So Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) called him to prohibit him, and he said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have no patience for business." So he said: "When you are buying, say: 'Hand to hand, and no cheating.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is a narration on this topic from Ibn 'Umar. The Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. They say that the free man can be prevented from selling and buying when his intellect is weak. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the scholars did not think that the free person who had attained the age of responsibility could be prevented from that
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi tha jiske sauda-baazi mein kamzori thi aur wo khareed-farokht karta tha, to uske ghar wale Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Ispar pabandi lagaayiye." To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur mana kiya, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhse khareed-farokht chhodi nahi jaati." To unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum khareed-farokht karo, to kaho: 'Haath-se-haath, aur koi dhoka nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Anas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Azaad aadmi par khareed-farokht mein pabandi lagaayi jaa sakti hai jab uski aqal kamzor ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne baaligh azaad aadmi par pabandi lagaana theek nahi maana.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever purchased an animal that has not been milked, then he the choice when he milks it, if he wishes he may return it, returning a Sa' of dried dates along with it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narration on this topic from Anas, and a man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi musarraah khareede, to use doodh nikaalne ke baad ikhtiyar hai, agar wo chaahe to use wapas kare aur uske saath ek saa khajoor bhi wapas kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever purchases an animal that has not been milked, then he retains the option for three days. If he returns it, then he is to return with it a Sa' of food, not Samra' " [Abu 'Eisa said:] The meaning of "Not Samra'" is "not wheat." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This Hadith is acted upon according to our companions, among them Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo koi musarraah khareede, to use teen din ka ikhtiyar hai, agar usne use wapas kiya, to uske saath ek saa khaana wapas kare, gehun nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur humare saathiyon ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unmein Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq shaamil hain. Aur unke qaul "gehun nahi" ka matlab hai: gehun ke siwa.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : That he sold a camel to the Prophet (ﷺ) and made a condition that he could ride it to (return to) his family. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. It has been reported through other routes from Jabir. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They consider it allowed to make a condition in a sale when it is one condition. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge said that it is not allowed to make a condition in a sale, nor to complete a sale when there is a condition for it
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek oont becha aur shart rakhi ke wo usse apne ghar tak sawaari karenge. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur Jabir se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo bikri mein shart lagaana jaayez maante hain jab wo ek hi shart ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Bikri mein shart jaayez nahi, aur bikri poori nahi hoti agar usmein shart ho.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "A riding animal can be ridden while it is pawned, and a milking animal can be milked while it is pawned, and it is up to the one riding and drinking (the milk) to maintain it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. We do now know of it being Marfu' except by the narration of 'Amir Ash-Sha'bi from Abu Hurairah. Others have reported this Hadith from Al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah in Mawquf form. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge, and it is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge said that one may not benefit in any way from what is pawned
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sawaari ka jaanwar girvi hone ki halat mein sawaari ke liye istemal ho sakta hai, aur doodh dene wala jaanwar girvi hone ki halat mein doodh peene ke liye istemal ho sakta hai, aur jo sawaari kare aur doodh piye uspar uska kharcha hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise marfu' sirf Aamir Ash-Sha'bi ki, Abu Hurairah se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur doosron ne ye hadith Al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se mauqoof riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Girvi rakhi cheez se kisi tarah ka faida uthaana jaayez nahi.

e:
Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib:From his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Both the buyer and the seller retain the option as long as they did not separate, unless they agreed to making it optional. And it is not lawful for him to separate from his companion, fearing that he will change his mind."


 This Hadith is Hasan and this means separating from him after the sale, fearing that he will change his mind. And if the separation referred to speech, and there was no option left for him after the sale, then this Hadith would be meaningless, since he (ﷺ) said: "And it is not lawful for him to separate from his companion, fearing that he will change his mind."
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khareedne wala aur bechne wala dono ko ikhtiyar hai jab tak wo juda na hon, siwaye is ke ke bikri ikhtiyar waali ho, aur uske liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne saathi se is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur iska matlab ye hai ke wo bikri ke baad is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le, aur agar juda hona baaton se hota aur bikri ke baad koi ikhtiyar na hota, to is hadith ka koi matlab na hota jab unhon ne farmaya: "Aur uske liye jaayez nahi ke wo is dar se juda ho ke wo apna ikhtiyar wapas le le."

e: Narrated Al-Aswad: From 'Aishah that she wanted to purchase Barirah, but they (he owners) made the condition that they would retain the Wala'. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Buy her, the Wala' is only for the one who gives the price, or for the one who grants the favor." [He said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of 'Aishah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. And Mansur bin Al-Mu'tamir's Kunyah is Abu 'Attab. Abu Bakr Al-'Attar Al-Basri narrated to us from 'Ali bin Al-Madini who said: "I heard Yahya bin Sa'eed saying: 'When you get a narration from Mansur, then your hand has been filled with goodness without needing others.' Then Yahya said: 'I did not find anyone more reliable in (narrating from) Ibrahim An-Nakha'i and Mujahid than Mansur." [He said:] Muhammad informed me from 'Abdullah bin Abi Al-Aswad who said: " 'Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi said: 'Mansur is the most reliable of the people of Al-Kufah
hi: Al-Aswad, Aishah se riwayat karte hain ke wo Barirah ko khareedna chahti thin, to unke maalikon ne wala apne liye rakhne ki shart rakhi, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise khareed lo, wala to sirf usi ka hai jisne qeemat di ho ya jisne ehsaan kiya ho." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir ki kuniyat Abu Attab hai. Abu Bakr Al-Attar Al-Basri ne humein Ali bin Al-Madini se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Yahya bin Sa'eed ko kehte suna: "Jab tumhein Mansoor se hadith mile, to tumhara haath bhalai se bhar gaya, tumhein aur kisi ki zaroorat nahi." Phir Yahya ne kaha: "Mujhe Ibrahim An-Nakha'i aur Mujahid ke baare mein Mansoor se zyada mazboot koi nahi milta." Unhon ne kaha: Aur mujhe Muhammad ne Abdullah bin Abi Al-Aswad se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne kaha: "Mansoor Kufa waalon mein sabse mazboot hain."

e: Narrated Habib bin Abi Thabit: From Hakim bin Hizam, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Hakim bin Hizam with a Dinar to buy an animal for Udhiyyah (an animal for sacrifice) for him. He purchases an Udhiyyah which he sold and profited a Dinar from, so he purchased another in its place. And he returned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with Udhiyyah and the Dinar, so he said: 'The sheep is for sacrifice and Dinar is for charity.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] We do not know of the Hadith of Hakim bin Hizam except through this route, and Habib bin Abi Thabit did not hear from Hakim bin Hizam - in my view
hi: Habib bin Abi Thabit, Hakim bin Hizam se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hakim bin Hizam ko ek dinar dekar bheja taake wo unke liye ek qurbani ka jaanwar khareedein. Unhon ne ek qurbani khareedi, phir usse bech kar ek dinar ka munafa kamaya, to unhon ne uski jagah doosri khareed li. Phir wo qurbani aur dinar lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, to unhon ne farmaya: "Bakri qurbani ke liye hai aur dinar sadqa ke liye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Humein Hakim bin Hizam ki hadith sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai, aur mere nazdeek Habib bin Abi Thabit ne Hakim bin Hizam se suna nahi hai.

e:
Narrated Anas:That there was a man who was not very sensible and he would make purchases. So his family came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Stop him (from making purchases)." So Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) called him to prohibit him, and he said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have no patience for business." So he said: "When you are buying, say: 'Hand to hand, and no cheating.'"


 There is a narration on this topic from Ibn 'Umar.


The Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith.


This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. They say that the free man can be prevented from selling and buying when his intellect is weak. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the scholars did not think that the free person who had attained the age of responsibility could be prevented from that.
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi tha jiske sauda-baazi mein kamzori thi aur wo khareed-farokht karta tha, to uske ghar wale Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Ispar pabandi lagaayiye." To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur mana kiya, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhse khareed-farokht chhodi nahi jaati." To unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum khareed-farokht karo, to kaho: 'Haath-se-haath, aur koi dhoka nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Anas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Azaad aadmi par khareed-farokht mein pabandi lagaayi jaa sakti hai jab uski aqal kamzor ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne baaligh azaad aadmi par pabandi lagaana theek nahi maana.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When the penalty (of blood money) goes to a Mukatab, or an inheritance, then he inherits in accordance with as much as he is freed from it." And the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The Mukatab is given the blood-money of a free person in accordance to what he has paid (for his freedom), and that of a slave in accordance to what remains." [He said:] There is something on this from Umm Salamah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Hadith. This is how it was reported from Yahya bin Abi Kathir from 'Ikrimah, from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet (ﷺ). Khalid bin Al-Hadh-dha' reported it from 'Ikrimah, from 'Ali as his saying. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. Most of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others said that the Mukatab remains a slave as long as he still owes a Dirham. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq
hi: Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab mukatab ko diyat ya wirasat mile, to use utna hi milega jitna wo azaad ho chuka hai uske hisaab se." Aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mukatab ko jitna usne ada kiya hai uske hisaab se azaad aadmi ki diyat di jaayegi, aur jitna baaki hai uske hisaab se gulam ki diyat." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Isi tarah Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Khalid Al-Hadhdha ne Ikrimah se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se unka apna qaul riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Mukatab gulam hi rehta hai jab tak uspar ek dirham bhi baaki ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivering a Khutbah in which he said: "Whoever gives a writ of emancipation to his slave, for one hundred Uqiyyah, and he pays it to him less then ten Uqiyah." - or he said: "Ten Dirham" - "then he becomes incapable (of paying the remainder), the he remains a slave." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. And this acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others: The Mukatab is a slave as long as something remains due from him for his Kitabah. Al-Hajjaj bin Artat reported similarly from 'Amr bin Shu'aib
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khutba dete hue kehte suna: "Jo apne gulam ke saath sau uqiya ki katibah kare, aur usne das uqiya - ya das dirham - ke siwa sab ada kar diya, phir wo aage ada na kar saka, to wo gulam hi rahega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke mukatab gulam hi rehta hai jab tak uski katibah ka koi hissa baaki ho. Aur Hajjaj bin Artaah ne Amr bin Shu'aib se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Umm Salamah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you (women) has a Mukatab ho has with him what will fulfill (the Kitabah) then observe Hijab from him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. And the meaning of this Hadith according to the people of knowledge is that of caution. They say that the Mukatab is not freed, even if he has the amount to pay, until he pays it
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ke mukatab ke paas ada karne ke liye kuch ho, to us se parda karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek is hadith ka matlab ehtiyaat par hai, unhon ne kaha: Mukatab azaad nahi hota, chahe uske paas ada karne ke liye kuch ho, jab tak wo ada na kar de.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whichever person becomes bankrupt, and a man finds his particular merchandise with him, then he is more deserving of it than others. [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Samurah and Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge and it is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge said that he is just like one of the debtors. This is the view of the people of Al-Kufah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo aadmi divaaliya ho jaaye, aur koi aadmi apna saamaan usi haalat mein uske paas paaye, to wo doosron se zyada uska haqdaar hai." Is mauzu par Samurah aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Wo doosre qarzdaaron jaisa hi hai. Aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Waddak: That Abu Sa'eed said: "We had some wine that belonged to an orphan. When Al-Ma'idah was revealed I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it, I said: 'It belongs to an orphan.' He said: 'Spill it out.'" [He said:] There is something on this topic from Anas bin Malik. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Sa'eed is a Hasan [Sahih] Hadith. Similar to this has been reported through other routes from the Prophet (ﷺ). Some of the people of knowledge stated according to this, they dislike the usage of wine for making vinegar. And the only thing that they disliked about it, and Allah knows best, is for a Muslim to have wine in his house until it becomes vinegar. Abu Al-Waddak's name is Jabr bin Nawf
hi: Abu Al-Waddak se riwayat hai ke Abu Sa'eed ne kaha: "Humare paas ek yateem ki sharaab thi. Jab Surah Al-Ma'idah naazil hui, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha aur kaha: 'Ye ek yateem ki hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Bahaa do.'" Is mauzu par Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan hai, aur Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi ke mutabiq kaha, unhon ne sharaab ko sirka banaana napasand kiya. Aur unhon ne isse sirf isliye napasand kiya, Allah zyada jaanta hai, kyunki Musalman apne ghar mein sharaab rakhe jab tak wo sirka na ban jaaye. Aur kuch ne sharaab ke sirke ki rukhsat di agar wo pehle se sirka ban chuki ho. Abu Al-Waddak ka naam Jabr bin Nauf hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Fulfill the trust for the one who entrusted you, and do not cheat the one who cheated you." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Some of the people of knowledge followed this Hadith, they said that when something belonging to a man is with another and he leaves (with it), then he has something that belongs to him, he may not withhold from him an equivalent to what the other took of his. Some of the people of knowledge among the Tabi'in allowed that. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, he said: "If one man has some Dirham that belong to another, and the second has some Dinar belonging to the first, he may not withhold any in place of his Dirham, unless it so happens that he has some Dirham of his, then in that case he can withhold some of his Dirham equal to what he is owed by the first
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amaanat us shakhs ko ada karo jisne tumhein amaanat di ho, aur jisne tumhare saath khayanat ki ho uske saath khayanat mat karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isi hadith ko apnaaya aur kaha: Agar kisi aadmi ka kisi doosre par kuch haq ho aur wo use lekar chala jaaye, phir uski koi cheez uske paas aa jaaye, to usse itni rakam rokne ka haq nahi jitni uski gayi thi. Aur kuch Tabi'een ahl-e-ilm ne isme rukhsat di, aur ye Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar uspar dirham baaki hon aur uske paas dinar aa jaayen, to usse apne dirham ki jagah rokne ka haq nahi, siwaye is ke ke uske paas uske dirham aa jaayen, to us waqt use apne dirham mein se utna rokne ka haq hai jitna uspar baaki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah: "During the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage, I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying during the Khutbah: "The borrowed is to be returned, and the guarantor is responsible, and the debt is to be repaid." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Samurah, Safwan bin Umayyah, and Anas. [He said:] The Hadith of Abu Umamah is a Hasan Gharib Hadith. It has also been reported through other routes besides this, from Abu Umamah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Umamah ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Hajjat-ul-Wida ke saal apne khutbe mein kehte suna: 'Udhaar li hui cheez wapas ki jaati hai, zaamin zimmedaar hota hai, aur qarz ada kiya jaata hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Samurah, Safwan bin Umayyah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Umamah ki hadith hasan hai, aur ye Abu Umamah se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Qatadah: From Al-Hasan, from Samurah, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Upon the hand is what it took, until it is returned." Qatadah said: "Then Al-Hasan forgot, so he said: 'It is something you entrusted, he is not liable for it.' " Meaning the borrowed property. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Some of the people pf knowledge, among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, followed this Hadith. They said that the possessor of the borrowed thing is liable. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i and Ahmad. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions and others said that the possessor of the borrowed this is not liable unless there is dispute. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri and the people of Al-Kufah, and it is the view of Ishaq
hi: Qatadah, Al-Hasan se, Samurah se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath par wahi zimmedaari hai jo usne liya, jab tak wo wapas na kare." Qatadah ne kaha: Phir Al-Hasan bhool gaye aur kaha: "Wo tumhara amaanatdaar hai, uspar koi zimmedaari nahi," yani udhaar li hui cheez ke baare mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne isi ko apnaaya aur kaha: Udhaar lene wala zimmedaar hota hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i aur Ahmad ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Udhaar lene wale par koi zimmedaari nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo khilaaf-warzi kare. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ishaq qaayal hain.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Ibrahim : From Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab, from Ma'mar bin 'Abdullah bin Nadlah who said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Hoarding is nothing but sin.' So I (Muhammad) said to Sa'eed: "O Abu Muhammad! You hoard?" He said: "And Ma'mar would hoard." It is also been reported that Sa'eed bin Musayyab would hoard oil, (camel) fodder, and the like. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, Abu Umamah, and Ibn 'Umar. The Hadith of Ma'mar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge, they dislike hoarding food, and some of them make a concession for hoarding things other than food. Ibn Al-Mubarak said: "There is no harm in hoarding cotton, goat pelts and like
hi: Muhammad bin Ibrahim, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Ma'mar bin Abdullah bin Nadlah se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Zakheera-andozi sirf gunahgaar hi karta hai.'" To maine Sa'eed se kaha: "Ae Abu Muhammad! Aap to zakheera-andozi karte hain." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur Ma'mar bhi zakheera-andozi karte the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ke baare mein riwayat hai ke wo tel aur gehun waghaira ki zakheera-andozi karte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Umamah, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ma'mar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne khaane ki zakheera-andozi ko napasand kiya. Aur kuch ne khaane ke siwa cheezon ki zakheera-andozi mein rukhsat di. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Rooi aur chamde waghaira ki zakheera-andozi mein koi harj nahi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not go out to meet the market (caravan), do not leave animals un-milked (to deceive the buyer), nor out-spend one another." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud and Abu Hurairah. The Hadith if Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge, they dislike selling the Muhaffalah, and it is the Musarrah that has not been milked by its owner in days or more than that, so the milk accumulates in its udder to impress the purchaser. This is a type of deceit and misrepresentation
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qafile se aage jaakar na milo, na jaanwaron ka doodh rok kar unhein bhara na rakho, aur ek doosre ka maal fizool na khilaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne muhaffalah ki bikri napasand ki, jo musarraah hai jiska doodh uska maalik kai dinon tak na nikaale taake uske thanon mein doodh jama ho jaaye aur khareedne wala dhoke mein aa jaaye. Ye ek tarah ka dhoka aur gharar hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever takes a false oath to deprive a Muslim of his wealth, he will meet Allah while He is angry with him." Al-Ash'ath bin Qais said: "It is about me, by Allah! There was a dispute about some land between myself and a man from the Jews who denied my ownership of it, so I took him to the Prophet (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'Do you have any proof ?' I said: 'No'. So he said to Jew: 'Take an oath.' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! If he takes an oath then my property will be gone!' So Allah, Most High revealed: Verily those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths.. until the end of the Ayah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Wa'il bin Hujr, Abu Musa, Abu Umamah bin Tha'labah Al-Ansari, and 'Imran bin Husain. The Hadith of Ibn Mas'ud is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi jhoothi qasam khaaye taake uske zariye kisi Musalman ka maal chheen le, wo Allah se milega aur Allah usse naaraz hoga." To Al-Ash'ath bin Qais ne kaha: "Ye baat mere baare mein hai, Allah ki qasam! Aisa hi hua tha, mere aur ek Yahudi aadmi ke darmiyan ek zameen ka jhagda tha, usne mera inkar kiya, to main use Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Kya tumhare paas koi saboot hai?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' To unhon ne Yahudi se farmaya: 'Qasam khao.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! To wo qasam khaayega aur mera maal le jaayega.' To Allah Ta'ala ne ye Ayat naazil ki: '(Beshak jo log Allah ke ahd aur apni qasmon ko thodi qeemat mein bechte hain)' aakhir Ayat tak." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Wa'il bin Hujr, Abu Musa, Abu Umamah bin Tha'labah Al-Ansari, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas'ud: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When the two parties (in a deal) disagree then the seller's statement is taken as valid, and the purchaser retains the option." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Mursal. 'Awn bin 'Abdullah did not see Ibn Mas'ud. This Hadith has also been reported from Al-Qasim bin 'Abdur-Rahman, from Ibn Mas'ud from the Prophet (ﷺ). But it also Mursal. [Abu 'Eisa said:] Ishaq bin Mansur said: "I said to Ahmad: what if when the two parties disagree and there is no proof (what is done)?' He said: 'The saying of the owner of the merchandise is taken as valid or they both refuse.' And Ishaq said as he did, and that in every case where his saying is taken, he must swear.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] Similar to this has been reported from some of the people of knowledge among the Tabi'in, Shuraih is among those
hi: Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab khareedne aur bechne wale mein ikhtilaaf ho jaaye, to bechne wale ki baat maani jaayegi, aur khareedne wale ko ikhtiyar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith mursal hai, Awn bin Abdullah ne Ibn Mas'ud ko nahi paaya. Aur ye hadith Al-Qasim bin Abdur-Rahman se, Ibn Mas'ud se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur ye bhi mursal hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ishaq bin Mansur ne kaha: Maine Ahmad se kaha: "Jab khareedne aur bechne wale mein ikhtilaaf ho aur koi saboot na ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Saamaan ke maalik ki baat maani jaayegi, ya dono wapas kar den." Ishaq ne bhi yehi kaha, aur jiski baat maani jaaye uspar qasam hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah kuch Tabi'een ahl-e-ilm se bhi riwayat hai, unmein Shuraih shaamil hain.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal: From Iyas bin 'Abd al-Muzani who said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited selling water." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Buhaisah from her father, Abu Hurairah, 'Aishah, Anas and 'Abdullah bin 'Amr. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Iyas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, they dislike selling water. This is the view of Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling water, Al-Hasan al-Basri is one of them
hi: Iyas bin Abd Al-Muzani ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne paani bechne se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Jabir, Buhaisah apne walid se, Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Anas, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Iyas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne paani bechna napasand kiya. Aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne paani bechne ki rukhsat di, unmein Al-Hasan Al-Basri shaamil hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not withhold surplus water so that it is prevented from the pasture." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Al-Munhal's name is 'Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im, he is from Al-Kufah, and he is oen that Habib bin Abi Thabit reports from. Abu Al-Munhal Sayyar bin Salamah is from Al-Basrah, he is the companion of Abu Barzah Al-Aslami
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ziyaada paani rokna napasand hai taake uski wajah se ghaas rok di jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Minhal ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im hai, wo Kufi hain, aur unse Habib bin Abi Thabit riwayat karte hain. Aur Abu Al-Minhal Sayyar bin Salamah Basri hain, Abu Barzah Al-Aslami ke saathi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited studding the stallion." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah, Anas, and Abu Sa'eed. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Ibn 'Umar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. There are those who made concession for accepting an honorarium for that
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne nar jaanwar ke jufti karaane ki fees se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur kuch ne iske badle tohfa qubool karne ki rukhsat di.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "A man from (the tribe of) Kilab asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about studding a stallion and he prohibited it. So he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We stud the stallions so that we get honorarium (from the owners of the female horse)!' So he permitted it for honorarium." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except as a narration of Ibrahim bin Humaid, from Hisham bin 'Urwah
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Kilab qabile ke ek aadmi ne Nabi (SAW) se nar jaanwar ki jufti fees ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne use mana kiya, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum nar ko jufti karaate hain aur humein tohfa diya jaata hai." To unhon ne use tohfe ki rukhsat de di. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibrahim bin Humaid ki, Hisham bin Urwah se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Rafi' b. Khadij: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The earnings of the cupper is filth, the earnings of the fornicator (from harlotry) is filth, and the price of a dog is filth." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Masu'd, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn 'Umar, and 'Abdullah bin Ja'far. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Rafi' is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, they disliked the price of a dog. This the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted the price of the hunting dog
hi: Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pachhne lagaane wale ki kamaai khabees hai, zaani aurat ki kamaai khabees hai, aur kutte ki qeemat khabees hai." Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Mas'ud, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Umar, aur Abdullah bin Ja'far se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Rafi ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kutte ki qeemat napasand ki. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne shikaari kutte ki qeemat ki rukhsat di.

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of a dog, the earnings of the fornicator (from harlotry), and the news of the fortune-teller." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutte ki qeemat, zaani aurat ki kamaai, aur kaahin ki ujrat se mana kiya. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Muhayyisah of Banu Harithah: From his father, that he sought permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to take the wages for cupping and he (ﷺ) forbade him from it. He continued asking him and seeking his permission until he said: "Use it to give fodder to your water-carrying camels, and to feed your slaves." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Rafi' bin Khadij, Abu Juhaifah, Jabir, and As-Sa'ib bin Yazid. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Muhayyisah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. Ahmad said: "If I am asked for something by cupper then I deny him, acting upon this Hadith
hi: Ibn Muhayyisah, Banu Harithah ke bhai, apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se pachhne lagaane ki ujrat lene ki ijazat maangi, to unhon ne unhein isse mana kiya, wo unse poochte aur ijazat maangte rahe, yahan tak ke unhon ne farmaya: "Ise apne paani bharne wale oont ko khilaao, aur apne gulamon ko khilaao." Is mauzu par Rafi bin Khadij, Abu Juhaifah, Jabir, aur As-Sa'ib bin Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhayyisah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: "Agar koi pachhne lagaane wala mujhse maange, to main use mana karta hoon, isi hadith par amal karte hue."

e: Narrated Anas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was cupped. Abu Talhah did the cupping. So he ordered that he be given two Sa' of food, and he spoke to his masters to reduce his taxes. He said: 'The most virtuous of what you treat with is cupping.' Or, he said: 'The best of your treatments is cupping.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Ibn 'Abbas, and Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), and others permitted paying the cupper. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i
hi: Humaid se riwayat hai ke Anas se pachhne lagaane wale ki kamaai ke baare mein pucha gaya, to Anas ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pachhne lagwaaya, aur unhein Abu Taibah ne pachhna lagaaya, to unhon ne unhein do saa khaana dene ka hukum diya aur unke maalikon se baat ki, to unhon ne unke khiraaj mein kami kar di, aur farmaya: 'Sabse achi cheez jisse tum ilaaj karo, wo pachhna lagwaana hai.'" Ya "'Tumhari sabse achi dawaon mein se pachhna lagwaana hai.'" Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne pachhne lagaane wale ki kamaai ki rukhsat di. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of the dog and the cat." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is some confusion (Idtirab) in the chain for this Hadith. The price of a cat is not correct. This Hadith has been reported from Al-A'mash, from some of his companions, from Jabir, and they caused some confusion for Al-A'mash in this narration. There are those among the people of knowledge who disliked the price of a cat, and some of them permitted it. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. It has been reported from Ibn Al-Fudail, from Al-A'mash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ), through other than this route
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutte aur billi ki qeemat se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ke isnad mein iztiraab hai, aur billi ki qeemat ke baare mein ye sahih nahi. Aur ye hadith Al-A'mash se, unke kuch saathiyon se, Jabir se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur is riwayat mein Al-A'mash par log ikhtilaaf karte hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne billi ki qeemat ko napasand kiya, aur kuch ne rukhsat di, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ibn Fudail ne Al-A'mash se, Abu Hazim se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqe se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating the cat and from its price." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib. We do not know of any major (known) narrators who reports from 'Umar bin Zaid (one of the narrators) besides 'Abdur-Razzaq
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne billi khaane aur uski qeemat lene se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur humein Umar bin Zaid se koi bada raawi riwayat karta hua maloom nahi siwaye Abdur-Razzaq ke.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Muhazzim: From Abu Hurairah who said: "The price of a dog was prohibited, except for the hunting dog." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is not correct from this route. Abu Al-Muhazzim's name is Yazid bin Sufyan, and Shu'bah bin Al-Hajjaj criticized him and graded him weak. Similar to this has been reported from Jabir, from the Prophet (ﷺ), but its chain is also not correct
hi: Abu Al-Muhazzim, Abu Hurairah se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Kutte ki qeemat se mana kiya gaya, siwaye shikaari kutte ke. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se sahih nahi. Aur Abu Al-Muhazzim ka naam Yazid bin Sufyan hai, aur Shu'bah bin Al-Hajjaj ne unke baare mein baat ki aur unhein kamzor qarar diya. Aur ye Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi isi jaisi riwayat hui hai, lekin uska isnad bhi sahih nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not sell the (slave) female singers, not purchase them, nor teach them (to sing). And there is no good in trading in them, and their prices are unlawful. It was about the likes of this that this Ayah was revealed: And among mankind is he who purchases idle talk to divert from the way of Allah." [He said:] There is narration about this from 'Umar bin Al-Khattab. [Abu 'Eisa said:] We only know of the Hadith of Abu Umamah, like this, from this route. Some of the people of knowledge have criticized 'Ali bin Yazid (one of the narrators) and graded him weak, and he is from Ash-Sham
hi: Abu Umamah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gaane waali laundiyon ko na becho, na khareedo, na unhein sikhaao, aur unki tijarat mein koi bhalai nahi, aur unki qeemat haraam hai. Isi jaisi baaton ke baare mein ye Ayat naazil hui: '(Aur logon mein se kuch aise hain jo fizool baaton ko khareedte hain taake Allah ke raaste se bhataayen)' aakhir Ayat tak." Is mauzu par Umar bin Al-Khattab se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Humein Abu Umamah ki hadith isi tareeqe se hi maloom hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Ali bin Yazid ke baare mein baat ki aur unhein kamzor qarar diya, wo Shaam ke rehne wale hain.

e: Narrated Abu Ayyub: "I narrated heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Whoever seperates a mother from her child, Allah seperates him and his most beloved on the Day of Judgement.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib
hi: Abu Ayyub ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo maa aur uske bachche ko juda kare, Allah use aur uske sabse aziz logon ko Qayamat ke din juda kar dega.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali : "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave me two boys who were brothers, so I sold one of them, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'O, 'Ali! What happened to your boy?' So I informed him, and he said: 'Return him, return him.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, disliked separating between the captives when selling them. Some of the people of knowledge permitted separating the children that were born in the land of Islam, but the first view is more correct. It has been related that Ibrahim An-Nakha'i seperated a mother and her child in a sale, so he was asked about that. He said: "I sought her permission for that and she approved
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe do gulam bhai diye, to maine unmein se ek ko bech diya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Tumhare gulam ka kya hua?' Maine unhein bataya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Use wapas lao, use wapas lao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne qaidiyon ko bikri mein juda karna napasand kiya, aur maa aur uske bachche, waalid aur bachche, aur bhai-behnon ko bikri mein juda karna napasand kiya jaata hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne un bachchon ko juda karne ki rukhsat di jo Islam ki sarzameen mein paida hue hon. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne bikri mein ek maa aur uske bachche ko juda kiya, to unse iske baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: "Maine usse ijazat maangi thi aur wo raazi ho gayi thi."

e: Narrated 'Aishah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged: "The produce is for the responsible one." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This Hadith has been reported through routes other than this, and this acted upon according to the people of knowledge
hi: Urwah, Aishah se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke "Khiraaj uski hai jo zimmedaar ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) judged that the produce is produce is for the responsible one." [He said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, Gharib as a Hadith of Hisham bin 'Urwah (a narrator). [Abu 'Eisa said:] Muslim bin Khalid Az-Zanji reported this Hadith from Hisham, from 'Urwah. Jarir reported it from Hisham as well. It is said that the narration of Jarir has Tadlis in in it, that Jarir committed the Tadlis, he did not hear it from Hisham bin 'Urwah. As for the meaning of "the produce is for the responsible one," he is the man who purchased the slave then the slave produced for him, and he found some defect in him so he returned him to the seller. Then the produce (of his work) is the purchaser's. In cases similar to this, the produce is for the responsible one. [Abu 'Eisa said:] Muhammad bin Isma'il called this Hadith Gharib, as a narration of 'Umar bin 'Ali (one of the narrators). I said: "Do you think that he committed Tadlis?" He said:"No
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne faisla diya ke "Khiraaj uski hai jo zimmedaar ho." Ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Ismail ne is hadith ko Umar bin Ali ki riwayat mein ghareeb qarar diya. Maine kaha: "Kya aapko lagta hai ye tadlees hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Muslim bin Khalid Az-Zanji ne ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah se riwayat ki hai, aur Jarir ne bhi Hisham se riwayat ki hai. Aur Jarir ki riwayat mein kaha jaata hai ke ismein tadlees hai, Jarir ne isme tadlees ki, unhon ne Hisham bin Urwah se suna nahi. Aur "khiraaj zimmedaari ke saath" ki tafseer ye hai: aadmi gulam khareede aur uska faida uthaaye, phir usmein koi khaami paaye aur use bechne wale ko wapas kare, to jo faida hua wo khareedne wale ka hai, kyunki agar gulam mar jaata to wo khareedne wale ke maal se jaata. Isi tarah ke masaail mein "khiraaj zimmedaari ke saath" hota hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever enters an orchard then let him eat, but not take any in his garment." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, 'Abbad bin Shurahbil, Rafi' bin 'Amr, 'Umair the freed slave of Abi Al-Lahm, and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is Gharib Hadith. We do not know of it from this route except from Yahya bin Sulaim. Some of the people of knowledge have permitted the wayfarer to eat from the fruits, and some of them disliked it without paying
hi: Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo koi bagh mein daakhil ho, to wo khaaye, lekin apne daaman mein na le jaaye." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Abbad bin Shurahbil, Rafi bin Amr, Umair jo Abi Al-Lahm ke azaad kiye gulam hain, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise is tareeqe se sirf Yahya bin Sulaim ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne musafir ke liye phal khaane ki rukhsat di hai, aur kuch ne bagair qeemat diye ise napasand kiya.

e: Narrated Rafi' bin 'Amr: "I was throwing stones at a date-palm belonging to some of the Ansar. They took me along with them to the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: "O Rafi'! Why were you throwing stones at their date-palm?'" He said: "I said: 'Out of hunger, O Messenger of Allah! He said: 'Do not throw stones at them, eat what falls. May Allah fill you and quench your thirst.'" This Hadith is Hasan Gharib Sahih
hi: Rafi bin Amr ne kaha: "Main Ansar ke khajoor ke darakhton par patthar maar raha tha, to unhon ne mujhe pakad liya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaye. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Rafi! Tum unke darakhton par patthar kyun maar rahe the?' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Bhook ki wajah se.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Patthar mat maaro, jo gir jaaye wo khaao, Allah tumhein sair kare aur pilaaye.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about hanging fruits (on the trees), so he said: "Whoever is in need and picks some of it without taking any in his garment, then there is no sin upon him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) se latakte hue phalon ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Jo zaroortmand ho aur usmein se kuch le le, bagair apne daaman mein le jaaye, to uspar koi gunaah nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Muhaqalah, Al-Muzabanah, Al-Mukhabarah, and making an exception (in a sale) unless it is made known." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, Gharib from this route as narration of Yunus bin 'Ubaid, from 'Ata, from Jabir
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muhaqalah, muzabanah, mukhabarah, aur bikri mein istisna se mana kiya, siwaye is ke ke wo maloom ho. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se, Yunus bin Ubaid ki, Ata se, Jabir se riwayat mein, hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever buys food, then he is not to sell it until he takes possession of it." Ibn 'Abbas said: "All things are considered the same (in this regard)." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Ibn 'Umar, and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi khaana khareede, to wo use na beche jab tak use poora na le le." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Aur mera khayaal hai har cheez isi jaisi hai." Is mauzu par Jabir, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne khaane ko bechna napasand kiya jab tak khareedne wala use qabza mein na le le. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne un cheezon ke baare mein rukhsat di jo na napi jaati hon na tauli jaati hon, na khaayi jaati hon na piya jaati hon, ke unhein poora liye bagair bech diya jaaye. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek sakhti sirf khaane mein hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "None of you is to sell over the sale of others, nor to propose over the proposal of others." [He said:] There are narration on this topic from Abu Hurairah and Samurah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. And it has been reported from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he said: "Do not haggle in competition with your brother's haggling." And the meaning of sale in this Hadith of the Prophet (ﷺ), according to some of the people of knowledge is to haggle
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi doosre ki bikri par bikri na kare, aur na doosre ke rishte par rishta bheje." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Aadmi apne bhai ke daam par daam na lagaaye." Aur is hadith mein "bikri" ka matlab, kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek, daam lagaana hai.

e: Narrated Anas: From Abu Talhah that he said: "O Prophet of Allah! I had purchased some wine for the orphans under my care. He said: 'Spill out the wine, and break the jugs.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, 'Aishah, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn 'Umar, and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Talhah, Ath-Thawri reported this Hadith from As-Suddi, from Yahya bin 'Abbad, from Anas: "That Abu Talhah was with him" and this is more correct than the narration of Al-laith (no)
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Abu Talhah ne kaha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi! Maine apne zer-e-nigraani yateemon ke liye sharaab khareedi thi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Sharaab bahaa do aur matke tod do." Is mauzu par Jabir, Aishah, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn Umar, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Talhah ki hadith - Ath-Thawri ne ye hadith As-Suddi se, Yahya bin Abbad se, Anas se riwayat ki ke Abu Talhah unke paas the, aur ye Al-Laith ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) 'Can wine be used for vinegar?' He said: 'No'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: "Kya sharaab ko sirka banaya jaaye?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed ten involved in wine: The one who presses it, the one who has it pressed, its drinker, its carrier, and the one it is carried to, its server, its seller, the consumption of its price, the one who purchases it and the one it was purchased for." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib as a narration of Anas. Similar to this has been reported from Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud, and Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sharaab ke baare mein das logon par la'nat ki: usse nichodne wala, jiske liye nichoda jaaye, uska peene wala, uska le jaane wala, jiske liye le jaayi jaaye, uska pilaane wala, uska bechne wala, uski qeemat khaane wala, uska khareedne wala, aur jiske liye khareedi jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Anas ki riwayat mein ghareeb hai. Aur isi jaisi Ibn Abbas, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Samurah bin Jundab: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When one of you comes upon livestock, if its owner is with it then seek his permission. If he permits him then let him milk it and drink. If there is no one with it then call out three times, if someone answers then seek his permission. If no one answers then let him milk it and drink without carrying (any of it away)." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar and Abu Sa'eed. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Samurah is a Hasan Gharib Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge, and it is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. [Abu 'Eisa said:] 'Ali bin Al-Madini said: "It is correct that Al-Hasan heard this from Samurah." Some of the people of Hadith criticized the narrations of Al-Hasan from Samurah, they said that he only narrated from a writing of Samurah
hi: Samurah bin Jundab se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi kisi maweshi ke paas aaye, agar uska maalik wahan ho, to usse ijazat maange, agar wo ijazat de to doodh nikaale aur piye, lekin le jaaye nahi. Aur agar wahan koi na ho, to teen baar awaaz de, agar koi jawab de to usse ijazat maange, agar koi jawab na de to doodh nikaale aur piye, lekin le jaaye nahi." Is mauzu par Umar aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Ahmad aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Al-Hasan ka Samurah se sunna sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-hadith ne Al-Hasan ki, Samurah se, riwayat ke baare mein baat ki aur kaha: Wo sirf Samurah ke likhe hue se hi riwayat karte hain.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : That during the Year of the Conquest, while he was in Makkah, he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "Indeed Allah and His Messenger unlawful the sale of wine, dead carcasses, the pig, and idols."
