They said: "O Messenger of Allah! What about the fat of carcasses? For indeed it is used to coat the ships, skins are oiled with it, and people use it for lamps?" He said: "No. It is unlawful." Then, with that, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "May Allah fight (curse) the Jews! Indeed Allah made the fat unlawful for them, they melted it, sold it, and consumed its price." [He said:] There are narrations of this topic from 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Jabir is Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Fatah ke saal, jabke wo Makkah mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Beshak Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharaab, murda jaanwar, suar, aur buton ki bikri haraam ki hai." To kaha gaya: "Ya Rasool Allah! Murda jaanwar ki charbi ke baare mein aapka kya khayal hai? Kyunki usse kashtiyan lipi jaati hain, chamde par lagaayi jaati hai, aur log usse chiraag jalaate hain?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Nahi, wo haraam hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi mauqe par farmaya: "Allah Yahudiyon se ladta rahe! Allah ne unpar charbi haraam ki, to unhon ne usse pighla kar becha aur uski qeemat khaayi." Is mauzu par Umar aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Ours is not a bad example: The one who takes back his gift is like the dog who takes back his vomit." [He said:] On this topic, there is the narration from Ibn 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he said: "It is not lawful for anyone that has given a gift to take it back, except for a father who gives something to his son
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humari misaal buri nahi hai, apni di hui cheez wapas lene wala kutte jaisa hai jo apni qai ki taraf laut kar aata hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo koi tohfa de, phir usse wapas le, siwaye us waalid ke jo apne bete ko de."

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: That he heard Tawus narrating from Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas, and they both narrated this Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ). (A Hadith similar to no. 1298). [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas (ra), is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This Hadith is acted upon according to soe of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ). They said whoever gives a gift to a closely related relative, then he is not to take back his gift. And whoever gives a gift to someone other then a close relative, then he may take it back as long as it has not been reciprocated. This is the view of Ath-Thawri. Ash-Shafi'i said: "It is not lawful for any that has given a gift to take it back except for what the father gave to his son." Ash-Shafi'i argued with the Hadith of 'Abdullah bin 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ): "It is not lawful for anyone that has given a gift to take it back, except for a father who give something to his son
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Tawus ko Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte suna, dono ne ye hadith Nabi (SAW) tak marfu' kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo koi apne mahram rishtedaar ko tohfa de, usse wapas lene ka haq nahi, aur jo koi ghair-mahram ko tohfa de, usse wapas lene ka haq hai jab tak uske badle mein kuch na diya jaaye. Aur ye Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo koi tohfa de, phir usse wapas le, siwaye us waalid ke jo apne bete ko de. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne Abdullah bin Umar ki, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith se dalil li, unhon ne farmaya: "Kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo koi tohfa de, phir usse wapas le, siwaye us waalid ke jo apne bete ko de."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: From Zaid bin Thabit that the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Muhalaqah and Al-Muzabanah, except that he permitted those practice Al-'Araya to sell it for a like estimation. [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and Jabir. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith if Zaid bin Thabit: This is how Muhammad bin Ishaq reported this Hadith. Ayyub, 'Ubaidullah bin 'Umar, and Malik bin Anas reported it from Nafi', from 'Ibn Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Muhalaqah and Al-Muzabanah." With this chain of narration, it has been reported from Ibn 'Umar, from Zaid bin Thabit, from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he permitted Al-'Araya in cases less that five Wasq. This is more correct than the narration of Muhammad bin Ishaq
hi: Ibn Umar, Zaid bin Thabit se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne muhaqalah aur muzabanah se mana kiya, siwaye is ke ke unhon ne araaya waalon ko ijazat di ke wo use uske andaaze ke barabar bechen. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Thabit ki hadith - isi tarah Muhammad bin Ishaq ne ye hadith riwayat ki. Aur Ayyub, Ubaidullah bin Umar, aur Malik bin Anas ne Nafi se, Ibn Umar se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne muhaqalah aur muzabanah se mana kiya. Aur isi isnad se, Ibn Umar se, Zaid bin Thabit se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne araaya mein rukhsat di, aur ye Muhammad bin Ishaq ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever buys food, then he is not to sell it until he takes possession of it." Ibn 'Abbas said: "All things are considered the same (in this regard)."


 There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Ibn 'Umar, and Abu Hurairah.


 The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith.
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi khaana khareede, to wo use na beche jab tak use poora na le le." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Aur mera khayaal hai har cheez isi jaisi hai." Is mauzu par Jabir, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne khaane ko bechna napasand kiya jab tak khareedne wala use qabza mein na le le. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne un cheezon ke baare mein rukhsat di jo na napi jaati hon na tauli jaati hon, na khaayi jaati hon na piya jaati hon, ke unhein poora liye bagair bech diya jaaye. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek sakhti sirf khaane mein hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: From Zaid bin Thabit that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) permitted selling in Al-'Araya by estimating it. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Sahih. And this is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. Among them Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. They said Al-'Araya is an exception from the general scope of the prohibition of the Prophet (ﷺ) when he prohibited Al-Muhaqalah and Al-Muzabanah. They argued using this Hadith of Zaid bin Thabit and the Hadith of Abu Hurairah. They said that he may buy what is less than five Wasq. According to some of the people of knowledge, this means that the Prophet (ﷺ) wanted to make less restriction for them on this matter because they complained to him saying: "We dont by anything with dried dates except fruit." So he permitted them to buy less than five Wasq worth so they could eat fresh dates
hi: Ibn Umar, Zaid bin Thabit se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne araaya ki bikri ko uske andaaze ke mutabiq karne ki rukhsat di. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unmein Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq shaamil hain, unhon ne kaha: Araaya, Nabi (SAW) ke muhaqalah aur muzabanah se mana karne ke aam hukum se mustasna hai, aur unhon ne Zaid bin Thabit ki hadith aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith se dalil li, aur kaha: Use paanch wasq se kam khareedne ka haq hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek iska matlab ye hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye isme aasaani chaahi kyunki unhon ne unse shikaayat ki thi aur kaha tha: "Humein khajoor ke phal khareedne ke liye sirf khajoor ke daane hi milte hain," to unhon ne unhein paanch wasq se kam mein rukhsat di ke wo khareed kar taaza khaayen.

e: Narrated Bushair bin Yasar, the freed slave of Banu Harithah: Rafi' bin Khadij and Sahl bin Abi Hathmah narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Muzabanah sales, (buying) fruits with dried dates, except for those who practice Al-'Araya - for he permitted it for them - and from buying grapes with raisins, and from every fruit by its estimation. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib from this route
hi: Bushair bin Yasar, Banu Harithah ke azaad kiye gulam, riwayat karte hain ke Rafi bin Khadij aur Sahl bin Abi Hathmah ne unhein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muzabanah se mana kiya, yani phal ko khajoor ke badle bechna, siwaye araaya waalon ke, unhein ijazat di gayi thi, aur angoor ko kishmish ke badle bechne se, aur har phal ko uske andaaze ke mutabiq bechne se. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not practice An-Najsh." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge, they disliked An-Najsh. [Abu 'Eisa said:] An-Najsh is when a man who knows about the goods comes to the owner of the goods to offer him more than what it is worth, doing so in the presence of the buyer. He intends to seduce the buyer while he himself does not want to buy it, rather he only wants to deceive the buyer with his offer. And this is type of deceit. Ash-Shafi'i said: "If a man commits An-Najsh the he has sinned due to what he has done, but the sale is permissible, because the buyer did not commit An-Najsh
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Najsh mat karo." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne najsh ko napasand kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur najsh ye hai ke koi aadmi jo saamaan ke baare mein jaanta hai, saamaan ke maalik ke paas aaye aur uski qeemat se zyada bhaav laga de, jab khareedne wala wahan maujood ho, taake khareedne wala dhoke mein aa jaaye, jabke uska khareedne ka koi irada na ho, wo sirf khareedne wale ko apni bhaav se dhoka dena chahta hai, aur ye ek tarah ka dhoka hai. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Agar koi najsh kare, to najsh karne wala apne kiye par gunaahgaar hoga, lekin bikri jaayez hai kyunki bechne wale ne najsh nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Qais: "Makhrafah Al-'Abdi and I brought linens from Hajar. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us in bargain with us with some pants. There was someone with me who weighed (the goods) to determine the value. So the the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the one weighing: 'Weigh and add more.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jabir and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Suwaid is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. The people of knowledge consider it recommended to add more when weighing. Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Simak, so he said: "From Abu Safwan" and he mentioned the narration
hi: Suwaid bin Qais ne kaha: "Main aur Makhrafah Al-Abdi Hajar se kapda laaye, to Nabi (SAW) humare paas aaye aur humse pajaamon ke baare mein daam-bhaav kiya, mere paas ek taulne wala tha jo mazdoori par tolta tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne taulne wale se farmaya: 'Tol aur zyada de.'" Is mauzu par Jabir aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Suwaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm tolne mein zyada dena mustahab maante hain. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Simak se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha "Abu Safwan se," aur hadith zikr ki.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever grants respite to an indigent or alleviates it for him, Allah will shade him on the Day of Judgement under His Throne, a Day in which there is no shade except His shade." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Al-Yasar, Abu Qatadah, Hudhaifah, Abu Mas'ud, 'Ubadah, and Jabir. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith if Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith from this route
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi tangdast ko mohlat de ya uska qarz maaf kar de, Allah use Qayamat ke din apne Arsh ke saaye mein jagah dega, jis din uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya na hoga." Is mauzu par Abu Al-Yasar, Abu Qatadah, Hudhaifah, Ibn Mas'ud, Ubadah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Mas'ud: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A man among those before you was called to reckon and nothing good was found with him. Except that he was a wealthy man so he used to mix with the pople and he would tell his servant to be lenient with the insolvent. So Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He, said: 'We are more worthy of that than him, so be lenient with him.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Al-Yasar is Ka'b bin 'Amr
hi: Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumse pehle ke logon mein se ek aadmi ka hisaab liya gaya, aur uske paas koi neki na mili, siwaye is ke ke wo ek maal daar aadmi tha, wo logon ke saath len-den karta tha, aur apne naukaron ko hukum deta tha ke wo tangdast ko chhod den. To Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Hum iske zyada haqdaar hain, ise chhod do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Yasar, Ka'b bin Amr hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Procrastination (in paying a debt) by a rich person is oppression. So if your debt is transferred from your debtor to a rich debtor, you should agree." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, and Ash-Sharid bin Suwaid Ath-Thaqafi
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Maal daar ka qarz ada karne mein taal-matol karna zulm hai, aur jab tum mein se kisi ka qarz kisi maal daar par munaqil kiya jaaye, to wo maan le." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Ash-Sharid bin Suwaid Ath-Thaqafi se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Procrastination (in paying a debt) by a rich person is oppression. So if your debt is transfered from your debtor you should agree, and do not make two sales in one sale." [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is the Abu Hurairah (no. 1308) is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. And its meaning is that when the debt of one of you is transferred then agree. Some of the people of knowledge said when a man is offered to transfer his debt to a rich man and he does so, then the transferor is free of it, he is not to seek its return from the transferor. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge said: "When this wealth could not be collected due to bankruptcy of the one it was transferred to, then he may seek its return to the first one." They argue this view with the saying of 'Uthman and others, when they said: "There is nothing due on a Muslim's wealth that is lost." Ishaq said: "The meaning of this Hadith: 'There is nothing due on a Muslim's wealth that is lost' this is when a man transfers it to another whom he thinks is wealthy, then he becomes bankrupt, so there is nothing due on the Muslim's wealth that is lost
hi: Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Maal daar ka taal-matol karna zulm hai, aur jab tumhara qarz kisi maal daar par munaqil kiya jaaye, to use maan lo, aur ek bikri mein do bikriyan mat karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur iska matlab ye hai ke jab tum mein se kisi ka qarz kisi maal daar par munaqil kiya jaaye, to wo maan le. To kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Jab aadmi ka qarz kisi maal daar par munaqil kiya jaaye aur usne maan liya, to munaqil karne wala bari ho gaya, use munaqil karne wale se wapas lene ka haq nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar iska maal us shakhs ke divaaliya hone ki wajah se doob jaaye jispar munaqil kiya gaya tha, to usse pehle wale se wapas lene ka haq hai. Aur unhon ne Uthman aur doosron ke qaul se dalil li jab unhon ne kaha: "Musalman ke maal par koi nuqsaan nahi." Ishaq ne kaha: Is hadith "Musalman ke maal par koi nuqsaan nahi" ka matlab ye hai: jab aadmi ka qarz kisi doosre par munaqil kiya jaaye jise wo maal daar samajhta ho, phir wo muflis nikle, to Musalman ke maal par koi nuqsaan nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited sales of Al-Munabadhah and Al-Mulamasah." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed and Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. And the meaning of (Munabadhah) in this Hadith is when it is said: "When I throw something to you then the sale between you and I is concluded." And Al-Mulamasah is that he says: "When you touch something then the sale is concluded." Even if he did not see it at all, like if it was inside of a bag or something else. There are merely sales practices of the people of Jahiliyyah so they were prohibited
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne munabadhah aur mulamasah ki bikri se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is hadith mein "munabadhah" ka matlab ye hai ke wo kahe: "Jab main tumhari taraf cheez phenkoon, to hum donon ke darmiyan bikri wajib ho jaayegi." Aur "mulamasah" ye hai ke wo kahe: "Jab tum cheez ko chhuo, to bikri wajib ho jaayegi," chahe usne wo cheez bilkul na dekhi ho, jaise wo thaile ke andar ho ya kuch aur. Ye sirf Jahiliyyah waalon ki bikriyan thin, isliye inse mana kiya gaya.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived in Al-Madinah, they were paying in advance for fruits. So he said: 'Whoever pays in advance, then let him pay in advance for known measurements (of dates), and known weights for a specified period of time.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Abi Awfa and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abza. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They allow for advanced payments on food, garments and other things in which the limits and description are known. They differed over delay in delivery of animals. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others thought that delay in delivery of animals is allowed. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, disliked delay in delivery of animals. This is the saying of Sufyan and the people of Al-Kufah. And Abu Al-Minhal's (a narrator) name is 'Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye jabke log khajoor mein salaf karte the, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo salaf kare, wo maloom naap aur maloom tol mein, maloom muddat tak salaf kare.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne khaane, kapdon, aur doosri cheezon mein salaf ko jaayez maana jinki hadd aur sifat maloom ho. Aur unka jaanwaron mein salam ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne jaanwaron mein salam ko jaayez maana. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne jaanwaron mein salam ko napasand kiya. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Abu Al-Minhal ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : That Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever has a partner in an orchard, then he is not to sell his share of that until he proposes that to his partner." [Abu 'Eisa said:] The chain of this Hadith is not connected. I heard Muhammad bin Isma'il saying: It is said that "Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri died during the lifetime of Jabir bin 'Abdullah." He said: "And Qatadah did not hear from him, nor did Abu Bishr." Muhammad said: "We do not know of any of them hearing from Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri except that 'Amr bin Dinar possibly heard from his during the lifetome of Jabir bin 'Abdullah." He said: "Qatadah only narrated from a writing of Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri, and he has a book from Jabir bin 'Abdullah." Abu Bakr Al-'Attar 'Abdul Quddus narrates to us, he said: " 'Ali bin Al-Madini said: 'Yahya bin Sa'eed said: "Sulaiman At-Taymi said: 'They went with the book of Jabir bin 'Abdullah to Al-Hasan Al-Basri and he took it' - or he said - 'and they reported it. Then they took it to Qatadah and reported it, so they gave it to me but I did not report it [he said: 'I refused it'] This was narrated to us by Abu Bakr Al-'Attar from 'Ali bin Al-Madini
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska kisi bagh mein shareek ho, to wo apna hissa na beche jab tak apne shareek ko na dikhaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad muttasil nahi. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Kaha jaata hai ke Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri, Jabir bin Abdullah ki zindagi mein hi mar gaye. Unhon ne kaha: "Aur Qatadah aur Abu Bishr ne unse suna nahi." Muhammad ne kaha: "Aur humein maloom nahi ke unmein se kisi ne Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri se suna ho, siwaye is ke ke Amr bin Dinar ne shayad Jabir bin Abdullah ki zindagi mein hi unse suna ho." Unhon ne kaha: "Qatadah sirf Sulaiman Al-Yashkuri ke likhe hue se riwayat karte hain, aur unke paas Jabir bin Abdullah se ek kitaab thi." Abu Bakr Al-Attar Abdul Quddus ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: Sulaiman At-Taimi ne kaha: "Wo Jabir bin Abdullah ki kitaab Al-Hasan Al-Basri ke paas le gaye, to unhon ne use liya" - ya kaha "riwayat ki" - "phir wo use Qatadah ke paas le gaye, to unhon ne use riwayat ki, aur wo mere paas laaye, lekin maine use riwayat nahi ki," yani maine use radd kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Az-Zubair: From Jabir that the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Muhaqalah, Al-Muzabanah, Al-Mukhabarah, and Al-Mu'awamah, and he permitted it in the case of Al-'Araya. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Az-Zubair, Jabir se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne muhaqalah, muzabanah, mukhabarah, aur mu'awamah se mana kiya, aur araaya mein rukhsat di. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "Prices became excessive during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so they said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Set prices for us!' So he said: 'Indeed Allah is Al-Musa'ir, Al-Qabid, Al-Basir, Ar-Razzaq. And I am hopeful that I meet my Lord and none of you are seeking (recompense from) me for an injustice involving blood or wealth.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein bhaav badh gaye, to logon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Humare liye bhaav muqarrar kar dijiye.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah hi bhaav muqarrar karne wala, rokne wala, phailaane wala, aur rizq dene wala hai. Aur mujhe ummeed hai ke main apne Rab se milu is haal mein ke tum mein se koi mujhse khoon ya maal ke zulm ka mutaalba na kar raha ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed by a pile of food. He put his fingers in it and felt wetness. He said: 'O owner of the food! What is this ?' He replied: 'It was rained upon O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Why not put it on top of the food so the people can see it?' Then he said: 'Whoever cheats, he is not one of us.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Abu Al-Hamra', Ibn 'Abbas, Buraidah, Abu Burdah bin Niyar, and Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. They dislike cheating and they say that cheating is unlawful
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaane ke ek dher ke paas se guzre, to unhon ne apna haath usmein daala, unki ungliyaan geeli ho gayin. Unhon ne farmaya: "Ae khaane waale! Ye kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Ismein baarish gir gayi thi, Ya Rasool Allah." Unhon ne farmaya: "To tumne ise khaane ke oopar kyun nahi rakha taake log ise dekh sakein?" Phir farmaya: "Jo dhoka de, wo hum mein se nahi." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Al-Hamra, Ibn Abbas, Buraidah, Abu Burdah bin Niyar, aur Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne dhoka dena napasand kiya aur kaha: Dhoka dena haraam hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a camel of a particular age on loan. He gave back to him a camel of a better age than the one he was given. He said: 'The best among you is the best in repaying.'" He said: There is something on this topic from Abu Rafi'. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. Shu'bah and Sufyan reported it from Salamah. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge, they saw no harm is taking a camel of a particular age as a loan. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq. But some of them disliked that
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek khaas umar ka oont udhaar liya, phir unhon ne usse behtar umar ka oont wapas kiya aur farmaya: 'Tum mein sabse behtareen wo hai jo qarz ada karne mein sabse achha ho.'" Is mauzu par Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah aur Sufyan ne ye hadith Salamah se riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne oont ki khaas umar udhaar lene mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya.

e:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever grants respite to an indigent or alleviates it for him, Allah will shade him on the Day of Judgement under His Throne, a Day in which there is no shade except His shade."


 There are narrations on this topic from Abu Al-Yasar, Abu Qatadah, Hudhaifah, Abu Mas'ud, 'Ubadah, and Jabir.


 The Hadith if Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith from this route.
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi tangdast ko mohlat de ya uska qarz maaf kar de, Allah use Qayamat ke din apne Arsh ke saaye mein jagah dega, jis din uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya na hoga." Is mauzu par Abu Al-Yasar, Abu Qatadah, Hudhaifah, Ibn Mas'ud, Ubadah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Rafi', the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "The Messenger of Allah got a camel in advance. Some camels from the charity." Abu Rafi' said: "So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told me to pay the man back for his camel. I said: 'I did not find among the camels but a superior selection of Raba'. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Give it to him, for indeed the base of people is the best of them in repaying.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Rafi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke azaad kiye gulam, se riwayat hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek jawaan oont udhaar liya, phir unke paas sadqe ke oont aaye." Abu Rafi ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main us aadmi ko uska oont ada karoon. Maine kaha: 'Mujhe oonton mein sirf ek behtareen chaar-saala oont milta hai.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Use de do, kyunki logon mein sabse behtareen wo hai jo qarz ada karne mein sabse achha ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Allah loves tolerance in selling, tolerance in buying, and tolerance in repaying." He said: There is something on this topic from Jabir. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib. Some of them reported this Hadith from Yunus, from Sa'eed Al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah bikri mein narmi, khareedari mein narmi, aur qarz ada karne mein narmi pasand karta hai." Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Yunus se, Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Allah forgave a man who was before you: He was tolerant when selling, tolerant when purchasing, and tolerant when repaying." He said: This Hadith is Gharib Sahih Hasan from this route
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne tumse pehle ke ek aadmi ko maaf kiya jo naram tha jab wo bechta, naram tha jab wo khareedta, naram tha jab wo qarz maangta." Ye hadith is tareeqe se sahih hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi ko Masjid mein bikri ya khareedari karte dekho, to kaho: 'Allah tumhari tijarat mein munafa na de.' Aur jab tum kisi ko ismein kuch khoyi hui cheez ka elaan karte dekho, to kaho: 'Allah tumhein wo wapas na kare.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne Masjid mein bikri aur khareedari karna napasand kiya. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Masjid mein bikri aur khareedari ki rukhsat di.

e:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived in Al-Madinah, they were paying in advance for fruits. So he said: 'Whoever pays in advance, then let him pay in advance for known measurements (of dates), and known weights for a specified period of time.'"


He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Abi Awfa and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abza.


 The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They allow for advanced payments on food, garments and other things in which the limits and description are known. They differed over delay in delivery of animals. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others thought that delay in delivery of animals is allowed. This is the view of Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others, disliked delay in delivery of animals. This is the saying of Sufyan and the people of Al-Kufah. And Abu Al-Minhal's (a narrator) name is 'Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im.
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina aaye jabke log khajoor mein salaf karte the, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo salaf kare, wo maloom naap aur maloom tol mein, maloom muddat tak salaf kare.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abza se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne khaane, kapdon, aur doosri cheezon mein salaf ko jaayez maana jinki hadd aur sifat maloom ho. Aur unka jaanwaron mein salam ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne jaanwaron mein salam ko jaayez maana. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne jaanwaron mein salam ko napasand kiya. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Abu Al-Minhal ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Mut'im hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allah (sallAllahu Alayhi wa sallam) said:"Whoever asks for a position as a judge, then he left on his own. And whoever is forced onto it, Allah sends an angel down to him so that he can be correct." (Daif)
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo qazaa ka ohda maange, use uske hawaale kar diya jaata hai, aur jispar zabardasti thopa jaaye, Allah uspar ek Farishta utaarta hai jo use seedha rakhta hai."

e: Anas narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Whoever seeks to be a judge, and asks others to intercede for him with it, then he will be left on his own. And whoever is coerced into it, Allah sends an angel down to him so that he can be correct." (Daif)
hi: Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo qazaa ka ohda chaahe aur uske liye sifarish maange, use uske hawaale kar diya jaata hai, aur jispar zabardasti thopa jaaye, Allah uspar ek Farishta utaarta hai jo use seedha rakhta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Isra'il ki, Abdul-A'la se riwayat se zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Whoever takes the responsibility of judge, or is appointed as judge between the people, then he has been slaughtered without a knife
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo qazaa ka ohda sambhaale ya logon ke darmiyan qaazi banaya jaaye, to goya use bina chhuri ke zibah kar diya gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"When the judge passes a judgement in which he strived and was correct, then he receives two rewards. And when he judges and is mistaken, then he receives one reward
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab qaazi faisla kare aur ijtihaad kare aur theek kare, to uske liye do ajr hain, aur jab faisla kare aur ghalti kare, to uske liye ek ajr hai." Is mauzu par Amr bin Al-As aur Uqbah bin Aamir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Hum ise Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki, Yahya bin Sa'eed se riwayat mein sirf Abdur-Razzaq ki, Ma'mar se, Sufyan Ath-Thawri se riwayat se hi jaante hain.

e: Some men who were companions of Mu'adh narrated from Mu'adh that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Mu'adh to Yemen, so he (ﷺ) said:"How will you judge?" He said: "I will judge according to what is in Allah's Book." He said: "If it is not in Allah's Book ?" He said: "Then with the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." He said: "If it is not in the Sunnah of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?" He said: "I will give in my view." He said: "All praise is due to Allah, the One Who made the messenger of the Messenger of Allah suitable
hi: Mu'adh ke kuch saathi, Mu'adh se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yaman bheja, to unhon ne farmaya: "Tum kaise faisla karoge?" Unhon ne kaha: "Main Allah ki Kitab ke mutabiq faisla karoonga." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aur agar Allah ki Kitab mein na ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ke mutabiq." Unhon ne farmaya: "Aur agar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat mein na ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Main apni raay se ijtihaad karoonga." Unhon ne farmaya: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaasid ko tofeeq di."

e: (Another chain of narrators) from some people from the inhabitants of Hims, from Mu'adh, from the Prophet (ﷺ), with similar
hi: Hims ke kuch logon se, Mu'adh se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur mere nazdeek iska isnad muttasil nahi. Aur Abu Awn Ath-Thaqafi ka naam Muhammad bin Ubaidullah hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Indeed, the most beloved of people to Allah on the Day of Judgement, and the nearest to Him in the status is the just Imam. And the most hated of people to Allah and the furthest from Him in status is the oppressive Imam
hi: Abu Sa'eed ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din Allah ko sabse zyada mehboob aur uski nashist ke sabse qareeb aadil imam hai, aur Allah ko sabse zyada napasand aur uski nashist se sabse door zaalim imam hai." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Abi Awfa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: [Abdullah] Ibn Abi Al-Awfa narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"[Indeed] Allah is with the judge as long as he is not unjust. So when he is unjust, He leaves him and he is attended by Shaitan
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Awfa ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah qaazi ke saath hota hai jab tak wo zulm na kare, jab wo zulm kare, to Allah usse alag ho jaata hai aur Shaitan uske saath lag jaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Imran Al-Qattan ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Ali narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'When two men come to you seeking judgement, do not judge for the first until you have heard the statement of the other. Soon you will know how to judge.'" 'Ali said: "I did not err since then
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Jab do aadmi tumhare paas faisla karwaane aayen, to pehle ke liye faisla mat karo jab tak doosre ki baat na sun lo, phir tumhein maloom ho jaayega ke kaise faisla karna hai.'" Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Iske baad main hamesha theek qaazi raha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abul-Hasan narrated that 'Amr bin Murrah said to Mu'awiyah:"I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'No Imam closes his door on one in need, dire straits and poverty, except that Allah closes the gates of the Heavens from his dire straits, his needs, and his poverty.' So Mu'awiyah appointed a man to look after the needs of the people
hi: Abul-Hasan riwayat karte hain ke Amr bin Murrah ne Muawiyah se kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Koi bhi imam jo zaroortmand, museebat-zada, aur muhtaaj ke liye apna darwaza band kare, to Allah uske liye aasman ke darwaaze uski museebat, uski zaroorat, aur uski muhtaaji se band kar deta hai.'" To Muawiyah ne logon ki zarooraton ke liye ek aadmi muqarrar kiya. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Amr bin Murrah ki hadith ghareeb hai, aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Amr bin Murrah Al-Juhani ki kuniyat Abu Maryam hai.

e: (Another chain) from Abu Maryam the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Maryam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahabi, se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi hadith, isi mafhoom mein. Aur Yazid bin Abi Maryam Shaam ke hain, aur Bureid bin Abi Maryam Kufi hain, aur Abu Maryam, Amr bin Murrah Al-Juhani hain.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah narrated:"My father wrote to 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Bakrah who was a judge: "Do not pass a judgement between two people while you are angry, for indeed I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'The judge should not judge between two people while he is angry
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne Ubaidullah bin Abi Bakrah ko, jo qaazi the, likha: 'Do logon ke darmiyan faisla mat karo jabke tum gusse mein ho, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Qaazi do logon ke darmiyan faisla na kare jabke wo gusse mein ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Bakrah ka naam Nufai hai.

e: Mu'adh bin Jabal narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dispatched me to Yemen. When I had left, he sent a message after me, so I returned and he said: 'Do you know why I sent a message to you ? Do not take anything without my permission, for that will be Ghulul, and whoever commits Ghulul, he comes with what he took on the Day of Judgement. This is why I called you, so now go and do your job
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Yaman bheja, jab main chal pada, to unhon ne mere peechhe paigham bheja, mujhe wapas bulaaya gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tumhein maloom hai maine tumhein kyun bulaaya? Meri ijazat ke bagair kuch bhi mat lena, kyunki wo khayanat hai, aur jo khayanat kare, wo Qayamat ke din apni chorai hui cheez lekar aayega. Isi liye maine tumhein bulaaya, ab apne kaam par jao.'" Is mauzu par Adiyy bin Amirah, Buraidah, Al-Mustaurid bin Shaddad, Abu Humaid, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Mu'adh ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abu Usamah ki, Dawud Al-Awdi se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the one who bribes and the one who takes a bribe for a judgement
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne rishwat dene wale aur faisle mein rishwat lene wale par la'nat ki. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Aishah, Ibn Hadidah, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman se, Abdullah bin Amr se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu Salamah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai, lekin ye sahih nahi. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abdur-Rahman ko kehte suna: Abu Salamah ki, Abdullah bin Amr se, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith is mauzu mein sabse achi aur sabse sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cursed the one who bribes and the one who takes a bribe
hi: Abdullah bin Amr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne rishwat dene wale aur rishwat lene wale par la'nat ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"If trotter (lacking meat) were given to me I would accept it, and if I was invited to (a meal of) it I would accept
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe ek khur tohfe mein diya jaaye, to main use qubool karoonga, aur agar mujhe uske liye bulaaya jaaye, to main jaaunga." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah, Salman, Muawiyah bin Haidah, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Alqamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umm Salamah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Indeed you come to me with your disputes, and I am only a human being, perhaps one of you is more eloquent at presenting his argument than the other. If I judge for one of you, giving him something from the rights of his brother, then it is only a piece of the Fire that I am giving him, so do not take anything from it
hi: Umm Salamah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum log apne jhagde lekar mere paas aate ho, aur main sirf ek insaan hoon, ho sakta hai tum mein se koi apna dalail zyada acchi tarah pesh karta ho doosre se, to agar main tum mein se kisi ke liye uske bhai ke haq mein se kuch faisla de doon, to main use sirf aag ka ek tukda de raha hoon, wo usmein se kuch na le." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umm Salamah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Alqamah bin Wa'il [bin Hujr] narrated from his father who said:"A man from Hadramawt and a man from Kindah came to the Prophet (ﷺ). The Hadrami said: 'O Messenger of Allah! This person took some land of mine.' The Kindi said:'It is my land, It is in my possession, and he has no right to it.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) said to the Hadrami:'Do you have proof?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Then you will have the oath.' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah! This man is a liar, it makes not difference what he takes an oath for, he is not ashamed of doing anything!' He said: 'There is nothing you deserve from him except that.' He said: So the man was left to take an oath for it, and in the meantime, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'If he takes an oath [for your property] to wrongfully consume it, He will meet Allah while He is angry with him
hi: Alqamah bin Wa'il bin Hujr apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Hadramaut ka ek aadmi aur Kindah ka ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye. Hadrami ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Isne meri zameen par qabza kar liya hai.' To Kindi ne kaha: 'Ye meri zameen hai aur mere qabze mein hai, isse ismein koi haq nahi.' To Nabi (SAW) ne Hadrami se farmaya: 'Kya tumhare paas koi saboot hai?' Usne kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To tumhein uski qasam milegi.' Usne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Ye aadmi fajir hai, use koi parwaah nahi kis baat par qasam khaaye, aur wo kisi cheez se nahi bachta.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Usse tumhein sirf yehi milega.' Wo aadmi qasam khaane chala gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jab wo peeth phera to farmaya: 'Agar usne tumhara maal zulm se khaane ke liye qasam khaayi, to wo Allah se milega aur Allah usse mun mode hoga.'" Is mauzu par Umar, Ibn Abbas, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Al-Ash'ath bin Qais se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Wa'il bin Hujr ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that during a Khutbah, the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"The proof is due from the claimant, and the oath is due from the one the claim is made against
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne apne khutbe mein farmaya: "Saboot da'wa karne wale par hai, aur qasam jispar da'wa kiya jaaye uspar hai." Ye hadith apne isnad mein baat rakhta hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ubaidullah Al-Arzami hadith mein apni hifz ki wajah se kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, Ibn Al-Mubarak aur doosron ne unhein kamzor qarar diya.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged that the oath is due from the one the claim is made against
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke qasam jispar da'wa kiya jaaye uspar hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke saboot da'wa karne wale par hai aur qasam jispar da'wa kiya jaaye uspar hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed judgement based on an oath along with one witness." Rabi'ah (one of the narrators) said: "A son of Ibn Sa'd bin 'Ubadah informed me saying: 'We found in a book of Sa'd that the Prophet (ﷺ) passed judgement based on an oath along with a witness
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla diya. Rabi'ah ne kaha: Aur Sa'd bin Ubadah ke ek bete ne mujhe bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Humne Sa'd ki kitaab mein paaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla diya." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Ibn Abbas, aur Surraq se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla diya, hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Jabir narrated:"The Prophet (ﷺ) passed judgement based on oath along with a witness
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla diya.

e: Ja'far bin Muhammad narrated from his father:"The Prophet (ﷺ) passed judgement based on an oath along with one witness." He said: "And 'Ali judged between you based on it
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla diya. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne tum mein isi ke mutabiq faisla diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ye zyada sahih hai, isi tarah Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Ja'far bin Muhammad se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur Abdul-Aziz bin Abi Salamah aur Yahya bin Sulaim ne ye hadith Ja'far bin Muhammad se, apne walid se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ko huqooq aur maal ke maamlon mein jaayez maana. Aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Ek gawaah ke saath qasam se faisla sirf huqooq aur maal ke maamlon mein diya jaata hai. Aur Kufa waalon aur doosron mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm ne ek gawaah ke saath qasam ke zariye faisla dena theek nahi maana.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Whoever frees a portion" or, he said: "a part" or he said: "a share he owns of a slave, then he can afford the remainder of the price according to the reasonable price, then he will be free. Otherwise he has freed as much as he has freed (only)." Ayyub (one of the narrators) said: "Perhaps Nafi said in this Hadith: 'Meaning he has freed as much of him as he has freed
hi: Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo apna hissa - ya kaha: apna bhaag, ya kaha: apna shareek hissa - kisi gulam mein azaad kare, aur uske paas itna maal ho jo insaaf ke mutabiq uski qeemat tak pahunche, to wo poora azaad ho jaayega, warna jitna azaad kiya utna hi azaad hua." Ayyub ne kaha: Aur shayad Nafi ne is hadith mein kaha, yani "jitna azaad kiya utna hi azaad hua." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur Salim ne bhi apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Salim narrated from his father that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Whoever frees a portion of a slave he owns, then he can afford the remainder of the price, then he should free him with his wealth
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apna hissa jo kisi gulam mein ho azaad kare, aur uske paas itna maal ho jo uski qeemat tak pahunche, to wo apne maal se poora azaad ho jaayega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Whoever frees a portion" or he said: "a part of a slave, then he should finish paying his price if he can afford it. If he can not afford to pay reasonable price then he should be allowed to work to earn the amount that will free him without overburdening him." (Another chain) similar, and he said: "a part
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apna hissa - ya kaha: apna bhaag - kisi gulam mein azaad kare, to uski poori qeemat ada karna uske apne maal se hoga agar uske paas maal ho, aur agar uske paas maal na ho, to uski insaaf ke mutabiq qeemat lagayi jaaye, phir gulam ko us hisse ke liye mehnat karne di jaaye jo azaad nahi kiya gaya, use bojh mein daale bagair." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Isi jaisi, aur "shaqisan" kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah Aban bin Yazid ne Qatadah se, Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Qatadah se riwayat ki, lekin usmein mehnat karne ki baat zikr nahi ki. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka mehnat karne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isme mehnat karna maana. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar gulam do aadmiyon ke darmiyan ho aur unmein se ek apna hissa azaad kare, to agar uske paas maal ho, to wo apne saathi ke hisse ka tawaan de aur gulam ko apne maal se azaad kare, aur agar uske paas maal na ho, to gulam mein se jitna azaad hua utna hi azaad rahe aur mehnat na karayi jaaye. Aur unhon ne Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat se dalil li. Aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad qaayal hain.

e: Samurah narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"The lifelong gift is permitted for its inhabitant" or:"is an inheritance for its inhabitant
hi: Samurah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umra uske malik ke liye jaayez hai" ya "uske malik ke liye wirasat hai." Is mauzu par Zaid bin Thabit, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, Aishah, Ibn Az-Zubair, aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Jabir narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Whichever man is given a lifelong gift for himself and his offspring, then it belongs to the one whom it was given, it does not return to the one who gave it, for he has given a gift which shall be included in the inheritance
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis aadmi ko umra uske aur uski aulad ke liye diya jaaye, to wo usi ka hai jise diya gaya, wo us shakhs ki taraf wapas nahi jaata jisne diya, kyunki usne aisa tohfa diya jismein wirasat shaamil ho gayi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah Ma'mar aur kai doosron ne Az-Zuhri se Malik ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki. Aur kuch logon ne Az-Zuhri se riwayat ki aur ismein "aur uski aulad ke liye" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar wo kahe "Ye tumhare liye tumhari zindagi bhar aur tumhari aulad ke liye hai," to wo usi ka hai jise umra diya gaya, wo pehle wale ki taraf wapas nahi jaata. Aur agar usne "tumhari aulad ke liye" na kaha ho, to wo pehle wale ki taraf wapas jaata hai jab umra paane wala mar jaaye. Aur ye Malik bin Anas aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqe se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Umra uske malik ke liye jaayez hai." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar umra paane wala mar jaaye, to wo uske waarison ka hai, chahe uski aulad ke liye na kaha gaya ho. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Jabir narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"The lifelong gift is permitted for its inhabitant, and the Ruqba is permitted for its inhabitant
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umra uske malik ke liye jaayez hai, aur ruqba uske malik ke liye jaayez hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Abu Az-Zubair se isi isnad se, Jabir se mauqoof riwayat ki aur marfu' nahi kiya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke ruqba bhi umra jaisa jaayez hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Kufa waalon aur doosron ne umra aur ruqba mein farq kiya, unhon ne umra jaayez maana aur ruqba jaayez nahi maana. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ruqba ki tafseer ye hai ke wo kahe: "Ye cheez tumhare liye hai jab tak tum zinda ho, agar tum mujhse pehle mar jao to ye mujhe wapas mil jaayegi." Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Ruqba umra jaisa hai, wo usi ka hai jise diya jaaye, aur pehle wale ki taraf wapas nahi jaata.

e: Kathir bin 'Amr bin 'Awf Al-Muzani narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Reconciliation is allowed among the Muslims, except for reconciliation that makes the lawful unlawful, or the unlawful lawful. And the Muslims will be held to their conditions, except the conditions that make the lawful unlawful, or the unlawful lawful
hi: Kathir bin Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon ke darmiyan sulh jaayez hai, siwaye us sulh ke jo halal ko haraam kare ya haraam ko halal kare, aur Musalman apni sharton par kaayam rahen, siwaye us shart ke jo halal ko haraam kare ya haraam ko halal kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Al-A`raj narrated from Abu Hurairah, saying:“I heard him saying: ‘the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When one of you seeks his neighbor’s permission to affix a wooden beam in his wall, then do not prevent him."' When Abu Hurairah narrated it, they tilted their heads, so he said: ‘Why do I see that you are averse to it? By Allah! I will continue to narrate it among you
hi: Al-A'raj, Abu Hurairah se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine unhein kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se kisi ka padosi apni deewar mein lakdi gaadne ki ijazat maange, to use na roko.'" Jab Abu Hurairah ne ye hadith sunaayi, log apna sar jhukaane lage, to unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe kya hua hai ke main tumhein isse mun modte dekhta hoon? Allah ki qasam! Main ise tumhare kandhon ke darmiyan zaroor phenkoonga." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Mujammi bin Jariyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Ash-Shafi'i qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm se, unmein Malik bin Anas shaamil hain, riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Usse apne padosi ko apni deewar mein lakdi rakhne se rokne ka haq hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“The oath is based upon what will make your companion believe you.” [Qutaibah (one of the narrators) said: “ What will make you believed by your companion”
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qasam usi baat par hai jispar tumhara saathi tumhein sacha maane." Aur Qutaibah ne kaha: "Jispar tumhara saathi tumhein sacha maane." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Hushaim ki, Abdullah bin Abi Salih se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Abdullah bin Abi Salih, Suhail bin Abi Salih ke bhai hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Ahmad aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar qasam lene wala zaalim ho, to niyat qasam khaane wale ki hai, aur agar qasam lene wala mazloom ho, to niyat qasam lene wale ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Make the road seven forearm lengths.”
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raaste ko saat haath ka rakho."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"When you disagree over the road, then make it seven forearm lengths
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum raaste ke baare mein jhagda karo, to use saat haath ka rakho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Waki ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Bushair bin Ka'b Al-Adawi ki, Abu Hurairah se, hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Qatadah se, Bashir bin Nahik se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, aur ye mehfooz nahi.

e: Abu Maimunah narrated from Abu Hurairah who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) gave a boy the choice between his father and his mother
hi: Abu Maimunah, Abu Hurairah se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek larke ko apne waalid aur apni maa ke darmiyan ikhtiyar diya. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Abdul-Hamid bin Ja'far ke dada se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Maimunah ka naam Sulaim hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Larke ko uske waalidain ke darmiyan ikhtiyar diya jaata hai jab unke darmiyan bachche ke baare mein jhagda ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Jab bachcha chhota ho, to maa zyada haqdaar hai, aur jab larka saat saal ka ho jaaye, to use apne waalidain ke darmiyan ikhtiyar diya jaaye.

e: Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Indeed the most wholesome of what you consume is from your earnings, and indeed your children are from your earnings
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum jo sabse achi cheez khaate ho wo tumhari kamaai mein se hai, aur tumhari aulad tumhari kamaai mein se hai." Is mauzu par Jabir aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Waalid ka haath apne bachche ke maal mein khula hai, wo jo chahe le sakta hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Wo uske maal se sirf zaroorat ke waqt hi le.

e: Anas narrated:"One of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) gave the Prophet (ﷺ) some food in a bowl. Then 'Aishah broke the bowl with her hand, and discarded what was in it. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Food for food and vessel for vessel
hi: Anas ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki ek biwi ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek pyaale mein khaana bheja, to Aishah ne apne haath se pyaala tod diya aur usmein jo tha wo bikhar gaya. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khaana khaane ke badle, aur bartan bartan ke badle.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) borrowed a bowl which broke, so he guaranteed (compensated) it for them
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek pyaala udhaar liya, wo toot gaya, to unhon ne unhein iski zimmedaari uthaayi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith mehfooz nahi. Aur mere nazdeek Suwaid ka irada wahi hadith tha jo Ath-Thawri ne riwayat ki, aur Ath-Thawri ki hadith zyada sahih hai. Abu Dawud ka naam Umar bin Sa'd hai.

e: Narrated Nafi':that Ibn 'Umar said: "I was reviewed before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the army, and I was fourteen years old, but he did not accept me. Then I was reviewed before him in the army later while I was fifteen years old, and he accepted me." Nafi' said: "I narrated this Hadith to 'Uman bin 'Abdul Azeez and he said: 'This is the limit that distinguishes between childhood and adulthood.' Then he wrote to give salaries to whoever reached fifteen years old." (Another chain) from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ) and it is similar, but he did not mention in it that 'Umar bin 'Abdul-'Aziz wrote that this is the limit that distinguishes between youth and childhood and adulthood. In his narration, Ibn 'Uyainah said (that Nafi' said): "I narrated it to 'Umar bin 'Abdul-'Aziz and he said: 'This is the limit that distinguishes between children and soldiers
hi: Nafi se riwayat hai ke Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek lashkar mein pesh kiya gaya jabke main chaudah saal ka tha, to unhon ne mujhe qubool nahi kiya. Phir agle saal mujhe ek lashkar mein pesh kiya gaya jabke main pandrah saal ka tha, to unhon ne mujhe qubool kar liya." Nafi ne kaha: "Maine ye hadith Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ko bataayi, to unhon ne kaha: 'Ye chhote aur bade ke darmiyan hadd hai.' Phir unhon ne likha ke jo pandrah saal ka ho jaaye use tankhwaah muqarrar ki jaaye." Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, lekin ismein ye zikr nahi kiya ke Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ne likha ke ye chhote aur bade ke darmiyan hadd hai. Ibn Uyainah ne apni hadith mein zikr kiya, Nafi ne kaha: "To maine ye Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ko bataayi, to unhon ne kaha: 'Ye bachchon aur jangjuon ke darmiyan hadd hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain, wo maante hain ke jab larka pandrah saal poore kar le, to uska hukum mardon jaisa hai, aur agar wo pandrah se pehle hi baaligh ho jaaye, to bhi uska hukum mardon jaisa hai. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Buloogh ki teen nishaaniyaan hain: pandrah saal poore hona, ya ehtelaam, aur agar umar aur ehtelaam maloom na ho, to zair ke baalon ka ugna.

e: Narrated Al-Bara':"My maternal uncle Abu Burdah Ibn Niyar passed by me and he had a flag with him. I said: 'Where are you going ?' He said: 'the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dispatched me to a man who married a woman his father had married to: that I should bring him his head
hi: Al-Bara se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Mere mamu Abu Burdah bin Niyar mere paas se guzre, unke haath mein jhanda tha. Maine kaha: 'Kahan ja rahe ho?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek aise aadmi ke paas bheja hai jisne apne waalid ki biwi se nikah kiya, ke main uska sar le aaun.'" Is mauzu par Qurrah Al-Muzani se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Bara ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Az-Zubair:"A man from the Ansar disputed with Az-Zubair before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the canals of Harrah which they used to irrigate the date palms. The Ansari said: 'Let the water pass'. But he refused, So they brought their dispute to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to Az-Zubair: 'O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) then let the water pass to you neighbor.' The Ansari became angry and said:'[O Messenger of Allah!] Is this because he is your aunt's son?' The face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) changed color. Then he said: 'O Zubair! Irrigate (your land) and then withhold the water until it reaches the walls.' Az-Zubair said: 'By Allah! I think that this Ayah was revealed about that: But no, by your Lord, they can have no Faith until they make you (O Muhammad) judge in all disputes between them, and find in themselves no resistance against your decisions and accept (them) with full submission
hi: Abdullah bin Az-Zubair se riwayat hai ke Ansar ke ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne Az-Zubair se Al-Harrah ke us naale ke baare mein jhagda kiya jisse wo khajoor ke darakhtaon ko seenchate the. To Ansari ne kaha: "Paani chhod do wo baha jaaye." Lekin unhon ne inkar kiya, to unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne apna jhagda pesh kiya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Az-Zubair se farmaya: "Ae Zubair! Sinchai karo, phir paani apne padosi ki taraf bhej do." To Ansari ko gussa aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya isliye ke wo aapki phuphi ka beta hai?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya, phir unhon ne farmaya: "Ae Zubair! Sinchai karo, phir paani roko yahan tak ke wo deewar tak wapas aa jaaye." To Az-Zubair ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Mujhe lagta hai ye Ayat isi baare mein naazil hui: '(Nahi, tumhare Rab ki qasam, wo imaan nahi laayenge jab tak wo apne aapas ke jhagdon mein tumhein faisla karne wala na maan len)'." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Imran bin Husain:"A Man from the Ansar freed six slaves of his upon his death, and he did not have any wealth aside from them. That was conveyed to the Prophet (ﷺ), and he said some harsh words about him." He said: "Then he called for them and he divided them and had them draw lots. So he freed two of them and left four as slaves
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Ansar ke ek aadmi ne apni maut ke waqt apne chhe gulam azaad kar diye, aur uske paas unke siwa koi maal nahi tha. Ye baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhon ne usse sakht baat kahi, phir unhen bulaaya aur unhein teen-teen hisson mein baanta, phir unke darmiyan qura andaazi ki, do ko azaad kiya aur chaar ko gulam hi rehne diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Imran bin Husain ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, wo isme aur doosre maamlon mein qura andaazi ka istemal maante hain. Aur kuch Kufa waalon aur doosron ne qura andaazi ko theek nahi maana, unhon ne kaha: Har gulam ka tihaai azaad kiya jaaye aur baaqi do-tihaai ki qeemat ke liye use mehnat karne di jaaye.

e: Kathir bin 'Amr bin 'Awf Al-Muzani narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Reconciliation is allowed among the Muslims, except for reconciliation that makes the lawful unlawful, or the unlawful lawful. And the Muslims will be held to their conditions, except the conditions that make the lawful unlawful, or the unlawful lawful."
hi: Kathir bin Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon ke darmiyan sulh jaayez hai, siwaye us sulh ke jo halal ko haraam kare ya haraam ko halal kare, aur Musalman apni sharton par kaayam rahen, siwaye us shart ke jo halal ko haraam kare ya haraam ko halal kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Rafi' bin Khadij:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever farms a people's land without their permission, then nothing he farms belongs to him and its finances are due to him
hi: Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi qaum ki zameen mein unki ijazat ke bagair kheti kare, to fasal mein se uska koi haq nahi, uska sirf kharcha use milega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated An-Nu'man bin Bashir:That his father gave a slave to a son of his. So he went to the Prophet (ﷺ) to have him witness it. He (ﷺ) said: 'Have you given a gift similar to this one to all of your sons?' He replied: 'No'. So he said: 'Then take him back
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir se riwayat hai ke unke waalid ne apne ek bete ko ek gulam tohfe mein diya, to wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye taake wo iski gawaahi den. Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumne apne sab bachchon ko isi jaisa tohfa diya hai jaisa isse diya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "To ise wapas le lo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur An-Nu'man bin Bashir se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek bachchon ke darmiyan barabari karna mustahab hai, yahan tak ke kuch ne kaha: Apne bachchon ke darmiyan chumne mein bhi barabari kare. Aur kuch ne kaha: Bachchon ke darmiyan tohfe aur inaam mein barabari kare, larka aur larki barabar. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Bachchon ke darmiyan barabari ye hai ke larke ko do larkiyon ke hisse jitna diya jaaye, jaise wirasat ki taqseem. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Samurah:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The neighbor of a home has more right to the home
hi: Samurah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghar ka padosi ghar ka zyada haqdaar hai." Is mauzu par Ash-Sharid, Abu Rafi, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The neighbor has more right to his preemption. He is to be waited for even if he is absent, when their paths are the same
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padosi apni shufa ka zyada haqdaar hai, uska intezar kiya jaaye chahe wo gair-haazir ho, jab unka raasta ek hi ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur humein maloom nahi ke Abdul-Malik bin Abi Sulaiman ke siwa kisi ne ye hadith Ata se, Jabir se riwayat ki ho. Aur Shu'bah ne isi hadith ki wajah se Abdul-Malik bin Abi Sulaiman ke baare mein baat ki, aur Abdul-Malik ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek amaanatdaar aur thiqah hain, humein maloom nahi ke Shu'bah ke siwa kisi ne isi hadith ki wajah se unke baare mein baat ki ho. Aur Waki ne bhi Shu'bah se, Abdul-Malik bin Abi Sulaiman se ye hadith riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak se, Sufyan Ath-Thawri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Abdul-Malik bin Abi Sulaiman ek tarazoo hain," yani ilm mein. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai ke aadmi apni shufa ka zyada haqdaar hai chahe wo gair-haazir ho, jab wo aaye to use shufa ka haq hai chahe kitna hi waqt guzar gaya ho.

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When the boundaries are defined and the streets are fixed, then there is no preemption
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab hadd muqarrar ho jaayen aur raaste alag kar diye jaayen, to phir shufa nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Abu Salamah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Umar bin Al-Khattab aur Uthman bin Affan shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke kuch Tabi'een fuqaha, jaise Umar bin Abdul-Aziz aur doosre, qaayal hain, aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, unmein Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari, Rabi'ah bin Abi Abdur-Rahman, aur Malik bin Anas shaamil hain, aur isi ke Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain, wo shufa sirf shareek ke liye maante hain, aur padosi ke liye shufa nahi maante jab wo shareek na ho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Shufa padosi ke liye hai. Aur unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se marfu' hadith se dalil li, unhon ne farmaya: "Ghar ka padosi ghar ka zyada haqdaar hai," aur farmaya: "Padosi apne qareebi ka zyada haqdaar hai." Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Abbas:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The partner is the preemptor, and preemption is in everything
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shareek shafi hai, aur shufa har cheez mein hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Abu Hamzah As-Sukkari ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Abdul-Aziz bin Rufai se, Ibn Abi Mulaikah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki, aur ye zyada sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne isi jaisi riwayat ki lekin usmein Ibn Abbas ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek shufa sirf gharon aur zameenon mein hoti hai, unhon ne har cheez mein shufa nahi maana. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Shufa har cheez mein hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhni:"A man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about lost items. So he said: 'Make a public announcement about it for one year. Remember its string, its contained, and its sack. Then use it, and if its owner comes then give it to him.' So he said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about the stray sheep?' He said:'Take it, for it is either for you, your brother, or the wolf.' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What about stray camel?'" He said: "Then the Prophet (ﷺ) got angry until his cheeks became red or his face became red. He said: 'What concern is it of yours? It has its feet and its water reserve until it reaches its owner
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se guma ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ek saal iska elaan karo, phir uski dori, uska thaila, aur uski bandhan pehchaan lo, phir use istemal karo, aur agar iska maalik aa jaaye, to use de do." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aur bhatki hui bakri?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Use le lo, wo tumhari hai, ya tumhare bhai ki, ya bhediye ki." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aur bhatka hua oont?" Unhon ne kaha: To Nabi (SAW) ko gussa aa gaya yahan tak ke unke gaal laal ho gaye ya unka chehra laal ho gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Tumhein isse kya matlab? Uske paas apne paaon aur apna paani hai yahan tak ke wo apne maalik ko mile." Zaid bin Khalid ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Yazid, jo Al-Munba'ith ke azaad kiye gulam hain, ki, Zaid bin Khalid se riwayat, hasan sahih hai, aur unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Is mauzu par Ubayy bin Ka'b, Abdullah bin Amr, Al-Jarud bin Al-Mu'alla, Iyad bin Himar, aur Jarir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne guma mein rukhsat di, agar usne ek saal elaan kiya aur pehchaanne wala na mila, to wo usse faida uthaa sakta hai. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Ek saal elaan kare, agar maalik aa jaaye to theek, warna sadqa kar de. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai, aur ye Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, wo guma waale ke maal daar hone par usse faida uthaana theek nahi maante. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Wo usse faida uthaa sakta hai chahe wo maal daar ho, kyunki Ubayy bin Ka'b ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek thaili mili jismein sau dinar the, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein elaan karne aur phir faida uthaane ka hukum diya, aur Ubayy Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se ek maal daar aadmi the, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein elaan karne ka hukum diya, unhein pehchaanne wala na mila, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein khaane ka hukum diya. Agar guma sirf usi ke liye halal hoti jiske liye sadqa halal hai, to ye Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke liye halal na hoti, kyunki Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein ek dinar mila, unhon ne elaan kiya, pehchaanne wala na mila, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein khaane ka hukum diya, jabke unke liye sadqa halal nahi tha. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne, agar guma choti ho, to usse faida uthaane aur elaan na karne ki rukhsat di. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo ek dinar se kam ho, to use ek juma tak elaan kare. Aur ye Ishaq bin Ibrahim ka qaul hai.

e: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhni narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the lost item. He said:"Make a public announcement about it for one year, if it is claimed then give it to him. Otherwise remember its sack, string, and its count. Then use it, and if its owner comes, give it to him
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se guma ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ek saal elaan karo, agar pehchaana jaaye to de do, warna uska thaila, uski dori, aur uska shumaar yaad rakho, phir use istemal karo, aur jab uska maalik aaye to use de do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Zaid bin Khalid ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Ahmad ne kaha: Is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez yehi hadith hai.

e: Suwaid bin Ghafalah said:"I went out with Zaid bin Suhan and Salman bin Rabi'ah, and found a whip." In his narration Ibn Numair (one of the narrators) said: "I found a lost whip and took it. They said: 'Leave it'. I said: 'I will not leave it to be eaten by predators. I will take it to make use of it.' So I met up with Ubayy bin Ka'b and asked him about that. So he narrated the Hadith, he said: 'That is fine. I found a sack containing one hundred Dinar during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)' He said: 'So I brought it to him. He said to me: "Make a public announcement about it for one year." So I announced it for a year but did not find anyone to claim it. Then I brought it to him. He said to me: "Make a public announcement about it for another year." So I announced it for a year but did not find anyone to claim it. Then I brought it to him. He said: "Make a public announcement about if for another year." And he said: "Remember its amount, its container and its string. If someone comes seeking it and informs you of its amount and its string, then give it to him, otherwise use it
hi: Suwaid bin Ghafalah ne kaha: "Main Zaid bin Suhan aur Salman bin Rabi'ah ke saath nikla, mujhe ek kora mila." Ibn Numair ne apni hadith mein kaha: "Mujhe ek chhoda hua kora mila aur maine use le liya." Unhon ne kaha: "Ise chhod do." Maine kaha: "Main ise nahi chhodunga ke darinde use khaayen, main ise zaroor loonga aur faida uthaaunga." To main Ubayy bin Ka'b ke paas gaya aur unse iske baare mein pucha aur unhein hadith sunayi, to unhon ne kaha: "Tumne acha kiya. Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek thaili mili jismein sau dinar the." Unhon ne kaha: "To main use lekar unke paas gaya, to unhon ne mujhse farmaya: 'Ek saal iska elaan karo.' To maine ek saal elaan kiya lekin mujhe koi pehchaanne wala nahi mila, phir main use lekar unke paas gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ek aur saal elaan karo.' Maine elaan kiya, phir main use lekar unke paas gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ek aur saal elaan karo,' aur farmaya: 'Iska shumaar, iski thaili, aur iski dori yaad rakho, agar iska talabgaar aaye aur tumhein iske shumaar, thaili, aur dori ke baare mein bataaye, to use de do, warna isse faida uthaao.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Isma'il bin Ibrahim from Ibn 'Awn, from Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar said:"Umar got some land from Khaibar and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I got some wealth from Khaibar and I never ever had any wealth as plentiful as it, so what do you order me (to do with it)?' He said: 'If you wish, make it a grant and give charity from it.' So 'Umar gave it in charity: That is not to be sold entirely, nor given away, nor inherited, to be used to produce charity for the needy, those who are near it, for freeing slaves, for the cause of Allah, the wayfarer, the guest, and that there is no harm on its custodian consuming what is customary from it, or eating from its charity, without trying to amass wealth from it
hi: Ismail bin Ibrahim, Ibn Aun se, Nafi se riwayat karte hain ke Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Umar ko Khaibar mein zameen mili, to unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhe Khaibar mein aisa maal mila hai jaisa maal mujhe kabhi itna qeemti nahi mila, aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar tum chaho to iski asal ko roke rakho aur ise sadqa kar do.'"
