To Umar ne ise sadqa kar diya, ke iski asal na bechi jaayegi, na hiba ki jaayegi, na wirasat mein di jaayegi, unhon ne ise gareebon, rishtedaaron, gulamon ko azaad karne, Allah ki raah mein, musaafiron, aur mehmaanon ke liye sadqa kiya, iske mutawalli par koi harj nahi ke wo isse dastoor ke mutabiq khaaye ya kisi dost ko khilaaye bagair maal jama karne ki niyat ke. Unhon ne kaha: To maine ise Muhammad bin Sirin se zikr kiya, to unhon ne kaha: "maal jama na karte hue." Ibn Aun ne kaha: To mujhe ek doosre aadmi ne bataya ke unhon ne ise ek surkh chamde ke tukde mein padha, "maal jama na karte hue." Ismail ne kaha: Aur maine ise Ibn Ubaidullah bin Umar ke paas padha, usmein "maal jama na karte hue" tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, humein zameenon aur doosri cheezon ke waqf ki ijazat mein pehle logon ke darmiyan koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi.

e: Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"When a person dies, his deeds are cut off except for three: Continuing charity, knowledge that others benefited from, and a righteous son who supplicates for him
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab insaan marta hai, to uska amal khatam ho jaata hai, siwaye teen cheezon ke: jaari sadqa, aisa ilm jisse faida uthaaya jaaye, aur nek aulad jo uske liye dua kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The injuries caused by the animal are without liability, and wells are without liability, and mines are without liability, and the Khumus is due on Rikaz." (Another Chain) from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ) with similar meaning
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gaay-bakri jaise gunge jaanwar ka zakhm mu'aaf hai, kuaan mu'aaf hai, khaan mu'aaf hai, aur rikaz mein paanchwan hissa hai." Isi jaisi. Is mauzu par Jabir, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani, aur Ubadah bin As-Samit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ki hadith "Gunge jaanwar ka zakhm mu'aaf hai" ki tafseer: iska matlab hai, ye maaf hai, ismein koi diyat nahi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur unke qaul "Gunge jaanwar ka zakhm mu'aaf hai" ki tafseer kuch ahl-e-ilm ne ki, unhon ne kaha: Gunga jaanwar wo hai jo apne maalik se chhoot jaaye, to jo nuqsaan wo chhootne ki halat mein kare, uske maalik par koi tawaan nahi. "Aur khaan mu'aaf hai" - iska matlab hai: jab aadmi khaan khode aur usmein koi insaan gir jaaye, to uspar koi tawaan nahi, isi tarah kuaan, jab aadmi ise raaste ke liye khode aur usmein koi insaan gir jaaye, to uske maalik par koi tawaan nahi. "Aur rikaz mein paanchwan hissa hai" - aur rikaz wo hai jo Jahiliyyah waalon ki dabi hui cheezon mein mile. To jo rikaz paaye, wo usmein se paanchwan hissa hukumat ko de, aur baaki uska hai.

e: Narrated Sa'eed bin Zaid:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever revives a barren land then it is for him, and there is no right for the unjust root
hi: Sa'eed bin Zaid se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi banjar zameen ko aabaad kare, wo usi ki hai, aur zaalim ki jad ka koi haq nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Usse hukumat ki ijazat ke bagair banjar zameen aabaad karne ka haq hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Usse hukumat ki ijazat ke bagair aabaad karne ka haq nahi. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai. Is mauzu par Jabir, Amr bin Awf Al-Muzani jo Kathir ke dada hain, aur Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Muhammad bin Al-Muthanna ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Maine Abu Al-Walid At-Tayalisi se unke qaul "zaalim ki jad ka koi haq nahi" ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Zaalim jad wo ghaasib hai jo aisi cheez le jo uski na ho. Maine kaha: "Ye wo aadmi hai jo doosre ki zameen mein ped lagaaye?" Unhon ne kaha: "Wahi hai."

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever revives a barren land, then it is for him
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi banjar zameen aabaad kare, wo usi ki hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Shumair:that Abyad bin Hammal visited the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who asked him to set aside a reserve of salt(a mine). So he reserved it for him. As he was turning away, a man in the gathering said: "Do you know what you reserved for him ? You merely reserved stagnant water for him." He (Shumair) said: "So he left him." He (Shumair) said: "So he asked him (the Prophet (ﷺ)) about making a private pasture of Arak (a type of tree)." He said: "As long as it is not harmed by the hooves of the camels." So I (At-Tirmidhi) recited that before Qutaibah and he said: "Yes". (Another chain) with similar meaning
hi: Shumair se riwayat hai ke Abyad bin Hammal Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse ek namak ki khaan maangi, to unhon ne unhein wo de di. Jab wo mud kar chale, to majlis mein baithe ek aadmi ne kaha: "Kya aapko maloom hai aapne unhein kya de diya? Aapne unhein bahne wala paani de diya hai." Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne wo unse wapas le li." Unhon ne kaha: Aur unhon ne unse arak ki hifazat waali zameen ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Jahan tak oonton ke halke paaon na pahunchen." To Qutaibah ne isse tasdeeq ki aur kaha: "Haan." Isi jaisi. Al-Ma'rib Yaman ka ek ilaqa hai. Is mauzu par Wa'il aur Asma bint Abi Bakr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abyad bin Hammal ki hadith ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek jaageeron ke baare mein isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke imam ke liye jaayez hai ke wo jise theek samjhe use jaageer de.

e: Narrated 'Alqamah bin Wa'il:from his father that the Prophet (ﷺ) set aside a land reserve for him in Hadramawt. (One of the narrators added): "And he sent Mu'awiyah with him to reserve it for him
hi: Alqamah bin Wa'il apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Hadramaut mein ek zameen jaageer di. Mahmud ne kaha: Aur humein Nadr ne Shu'bah se bataya, aur usmein izafa kiya ke unhon ne unke saath Muawiyah ko bheja taake wo unhein ye jaageer de den. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "No Muslim plants a plant or sows a crop, then a person, or a bird, or an animal eats from it, except that it will be charity for him
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman aisa nahi jo koi ped lagaaye ya koi khet boye, phir usmein se koi insaan, ya parinda, ya jaanwar khaaye, magar wo uske liye sadqa ban jaata hai." Is mauzu par Abu Ayyub, Jabir, Umm Mubashshir, aur Zaid bin Khalid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Prophet (ﷺ) made a deal with the people of Khaibar for half of what was produced from it, whether fruits or crops
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Khaibar waalon ke saath adhi paidawaar ke badle mu'aamla kiya, chahe wo phal ho ya fasal. Is mauzu par Anas, Ibn Abbas, Zaid bin Thabit, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek muzara'ah mein aadhe, tihaai, ya chauthai par koi harj nahi maana. Aur kuch ne pasand kiya ke beej zameen ke maalik ki taraf se ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne tihaai aur chauthai par muzara'ah napasand kiya, lekin khajoor ke baaghon ki musaqaat tihaai aur chauthai par jaayez maani. Aur ye Malik bin Anas aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Muzara'ah tab hi sahih hai jab zameen sone-chandi ke badle kiraaye par li jaaye.

e: Narrated Rafi' bin Khadij:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us from a matter that was of benefit for us. When one of us had some land and we would let someone use it for a portion of its produce or some Dirham. He said: 'When one of you has some land then let him grant it to his brother, or let him farm it
hi: Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ek aisi cheez se mana kiya jo humare liye faida mand thi, jab humein se kisi ke paas zameen hoti, to hum use uski paidawaar ke hisse ke badle ya kuch dirham ke badle de dete the." Aur unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ke paas zameen ho, to wo apne bhai ko de de ya khud usmein kheti kare."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not prohibit share-cropping. But he ordered that they be helpful with each other
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne muzara'ah ko haraam nahi kiya, balki hukum diya ke wo ek doosre ke saath narmi kare. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Rafi ki hadith mein iztiraab hai, ye hadith Rafi bin Khadij se unke chachaon se riwayat hoti hai, aur unse Zuhair bin Rafi se bhi riwayat hoti hai jo unke chachaon mein se ek hain, aur ye hadith unse mukhtalif riwayaton mein riwayat hui hai. Is mauzu par Zaid bin Thabit aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas'ud:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged for the accidental blood-Money: Twenty Bint Makhad, twenty make Ibn Makhad, twenty Bint Labunm twenty Jadha'ah, and twenty Hiqqah. (Another chain) with similar meaning
hi: Khishf bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Ibn Mas'ud ko kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khata ki diyat mein faisla diya: bees bint-e-makhaz, bees ibn-e-makhaz nar, bees bint-e-laboon, bees jaza'ah, aur bees hiqqah." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hum marfu' sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur Abdullah se mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ittefaq hai ke diyat teen saal mein li jaati hai, har saal diyat ka tihaai, aur unhon ne maana ke khata ki diyat aaqilah par hoti hai. Aur kuch ne maana ke aaqilah aadmi ke waalid ki taraf ke rishtedaar hain. Aur ye Malik aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Diyat sirf mardon par hai, auraton aur bachchon par nahi, asaba mein se har aadmi par chautahai dinar dala jaata hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Aadhe dinar tak, agar diyat poori ho jaaye to theek, warna unke sabse qareebi qabile ko dekha jaaye aur unpar ye zimma daala jaaye.

e: Narrated Amr bin Shu'aib:from his father, from his grandfather that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever kills [a believer] deliberately, he is handed over to the guardians of the one killed. If they wish to, they have him killed, and if they wish to, they take the blood-money. That is thirty Hiqqah, thirty Jadha'ahs and forty pregnant camels. Whatever (amount more) they require from him, than that is for them (if they choose)." THat is because of the severity of blood-money
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Momin ko jaan boojh kar qatl kare, use maqtool ke waarison ke hawaale kar diya jaata hai, agar wo chaahen to qisas len, aur agar chaahen to diyat len, aur wo hai: teen hiqqah, teen jaza'ah, aur chaalis hamla oontniyaan. Aur jispar wo sulh karen wo unka hai." Aur ye zyada sakhti ki wajah se hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Ikrimah:from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ) made the blood-money twelve thousand
hi: Ikrimah, Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne diyat baarah hazaar muqarrar ki.

e: (Another chain) from 'Ikrimah from the Prophet (ﷺ) and it is similar but he did not mention "from Ibn 'Abbas" in it. There is much more criticism than this for (this) narration of Ibn 'Uyainah
hi: Ikrimah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, lekin ismein Ibn Abbas ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Ibn Uyainah ki hadith mein isse zyada baat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur humein maloom nahi ke Muhammad bin Muslim ke siwa kisi ne is hadith mein Ibn Abbas ka zikr kiya ho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne diyat das hazaar maani, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Main diyat sirf oonton mein jaanta hoon, wo sau oont hain ya unki qeemat.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib:from his father, from his grandfather that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Regarding the Mawadih; five, five
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zakhmon mein jo haddi tak pahunchen, paanch-paanch oont hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai ke moozihah mein paanch oont hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The blood-money for the fingers on the hands and (the toes of) the feet is the same: Ten camels for each finger
hi: Ikrimah, Ibn Abbas se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haathon aur pairon ki ungliyon ki diyat barabar hai, har ungli ke liye das oont." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Musa aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur isi ke Sufyan, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq qaayal hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "These and these are the same." referring to the little finger and thumb
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ye aur ye barabar hain," yani chhoti ungli aur angootha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu As-Safar:"A man from the Quraish broke a tooth of a man from the Ansar. So he appealed to Mu'awiyah against him. He said to Mu'awiyah: 'O Commander of the Believers! This person broke one of my teeth.' Mu'awiyah said: 'We will try to get satisfaction for you.' And the other person insisted that Mu'awiyah get him to agree [but he was not satisfied]. So Mu'awiyah said him: 'It is up to your companion.' Abu Ad-Darda' was sitting with him, so Abu Ad-Darda said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying [he said: 'My ears heard and my heart remembered]: "There is no man who is struck in his body and he forgives for it, except that Allah raises him a level and removes a sin from him.'" The Ansari said: 'Did you hear that from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?' He said: "My ears heard it and my heart remembered it.' He said: 'Then I will leave it to him.' Mu'awiyah said: 'Surely you should not suffer.' So he ordered that he be given some wealth
hi: Abu As-Safar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Quraish ke ek aadmi ne Ansar ke ek aadmi ka daant tod diya, to usne Muawiyah se iski shikaayat ki. Usne Muawiyah se kaha: 'Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Isne mera daant tod diya.' Muawiyah ne kaha: 'Hum tumhein raazi kar denge.' Aur doosre ne Muawiyah par zor diya, lekin wo raazi na hua, to Muawiyah ne usse kaha: 'Apne saathi se khud nipat lo.'" Aur Abu Ad-Darda unke paas baithe the, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Koi aadmi nahi jise apne jism mein koi museebat pahunche aur wo isse maaf kar de, magar Allah usse ek darja buland karta hai aur ek khataa mita deta hai.'" Ansari ne kaha: "Kya aapne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunaa?" Unhon ne kaha: "Mere kaanon ne isse suna aur mere dil ne isse yaad rakha." Usne kaha: "To main isse iske liye chhod deta hoon." Muawiyah ne kaha: "Yaqeenan main tumhein nakaam nahi karoonga," to unhon ne uske liye maal ka hukum diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur mujhe Abu As-Safar ka Abu Ad-Darda se sunna maloom nahi. Aur Abu As-Safar ka naam Sa'eed bin Ahmad hai, aur kaha jaata hai Ibn Yuhmid Ath-Thawri.

e: Narrated Anas:that a girl went out in Al-Madinah wearing some silver ornaments. A Jew grabbed her and fractured her head with a stone, and he took the jewelry she had on. He said: "She was found with some spark of life in her, and was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: 'Did such and such person strike you?' She nodded 'no' with her head. He said: 'Such and such?' until he named the Jew and she nodded 'yes' with her head." He said: "He was brought and recognized so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that his head be crushed between two stones
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek chhoti bachchi zewar pehne bahar nikli, ek Yahudi ne use pakad liya, uska sar patthar se kuchal diya aur uske zewar le liye." Unhon ne kaha: "Use us haalat mein paaya gaya jab usmein zindagi ki hi ramaq baaki thi, use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, unhon ne pucha: 'Kya fulaan ne tumhein maara?' Usne apne sar se ishara kiya: 'Nahi.' Unhon ne pucha: 'Fulaan ne?' Yahan tak ke unhon ne Yahudi ka naam liya, to usne apne sar se ishara kiya: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To use pakda gaya, usne iqbaal kiya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya, to uska sar do pattharon ke darmiyan kuchla gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Qisas sirf talwaar se hoga.

e: Narrated 'Alqamah bin Wa'il:from his father that the Prophet (ﷺ) set aside a land reserve for him in Hadramawt. (One of the narrators added): "And he sent Mu'awiyah with him to reserve it for him."
hi: Alqamah bin Wa'il apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Hadramaut mein ek zameen jaageer di. Mahmud ne kaha: Aur humein Nadr ne Shu'bah se bataya, aur usmein izafa kiya ke unhon ne unke saath Muawiyah ko bheja taake wo unhein ye jaageer de den. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed the first cases to be judged between the people are those of bloodshed
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bandon ke darmiyan sabse pehle jis maamle mein faisla kiya jaayega wo khoon ke maamlon mein hoga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Indeed the first cases to be judged between the worshippers are those of bloodshed
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bandon ke darmiyan sabse pehle jis maamle mein faisla kiya jaayega wo khoon ke maamlon mein hoga."

e: Narrated Abul-Hakam Al-Bajali:"I heard Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah mentioning from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he said: 'If the inhabitants of the heavens and the inhabitants of the earth all took part in shedding the blood of believer, then Allah would cast them (all) in the Fire
hi: Abul-Hakam Al-Bajali se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri aur Abu Hurairah ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr karte suna, unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar aasman waale aur zameen waale sab ek Momin ke khoon mein shareek ho jaayen, to Allah unhein aag mein daal dega.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Abul-Hakam Al-Bajali, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Nu'm Al-Kufi hain.

e: Narrated Suraqah bin Malik bin [Ju'shum]:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged that the son is to suffer retaliation for [killing] his father, but the father is not to suffer retaliation for [killing] his son
hi: Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju'shum se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas maujood tha jab unhon ne waalid ko bete ke badle qisas dilaaya, lekin bete ko waalid ke badle qisas nahi dilaaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum Suraqah ki hadith se sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain, aur iska isnad sahih nahi. Ismail bin Ayyash ne Muthanna bin As-Sabbah se ye riwayat ki, aur Muthanna bin As-Sabbah hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur ye hadith Abu Khalid Al-Ahmar ne Hajjaj bin Artaah se, Amr bin Shu'aib se, apne walid se, apne dada se, Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat ki hai. Aur ye hadith Amr bin Shu'aib se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai, aur is hadith mein iztiraab hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar waalid apne bete ko qatl kare, to use uske badle qatl nahi kiya jaata, aur agar wo apne bete par tohmat lagaaye, to use hadd nahi di jaati.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The father does not suffer retaliation for [killing] the son
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Waalid ko bete ke badle qisas nahi diya jaata."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'The Hudud are not carried in the Masjid, and the father is not killed for the son
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Masjidon mein hudood qaayam nahi ki jaatin, aur waalid ko bete ke badle qatl nahi kiya jaata." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum is isnad se marfu' sirf Ismail bin Muslim ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Ismail bin Muslim Al-Makki ke baare mein kuch ahl-e-ilm ne unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The blood of a Muslim man, who testifies that none has the right to be worshipped Allah, is not lawful except for one of three cases: The (previously married or) married adulterer, a life for a life, and the one who leaves the religion and parts from the Jama'ah (the community of Muslims)
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman aadmi ka khoon jo gawaahi deta ho ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, halal nahi hai magar teen mein se ek soorat mein: shaadi-shuda zaani, jaan ke badle jaan, aur apna deen chhodne wala jo jamaat se alag ho jaaye." Is mauzu par Uthman, Aishah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Mas'ud ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed, whoever kills a Mu'ahid that has a covenant from Allah and a covenant from His Messenger (ﷺ), then he has violated the covenant with Allah and the covenant of His Messenger, so he shall not smell the fragrance of Paradise; even though its fragrance can be sensed from the distance of seventy autumns
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suno! Jo kisi mu'ahid ko qatl kare, jise Allah aur uske Rasool ki zimmedaari haasil ho, to usne Allah ki zimmedaari todi, wo Jannat ki khushbu nahi sungega, jabke uski khushbu sattar saal ke faasle se mehsoos hoti hai." Is mauzu par Abu Bakrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Abu Hurairah se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) assigned the same blood-money for the two 'Amiris as that of the Muslims, and they had covenant from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne dono Aamiri bhaiyon ki diyat Musalmanon ki diyat jitni di, aur unka Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ahd tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abu Sa'd Al-Baqqal ka naam Sa'eed bin Al-Marzuban hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"When Allah granted His Messenger (ﷺ) victory over Makkah, he stood (to deliver an address) among the people. He thanked and praised Allah, then he said: 'And from whomever (one of his relatives) was killed, then he has two options to choose from: Either to pardon or that he be killed
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko Makkah ki fatah di, to wo logon mein khade hue, Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, phir farmaya: 'Aur jiska koi maqtool ho, to use do rahon mein se behtar ka ikhtiyar hai, ya to wo maaf kar de, ya wo qisas le.'" Is mauzu par Wa'il bin Hujr, Anas, aur Abu Shuraih Khuwailid bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Shuraih Al-Ka'bi:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Allah made Makkah sacred, it was not made sacred by the people. Whoever believes in Allah, and the Last Day, then let them not shed blood in it, nor cut down any of its trees. If one tries to make an excuse by saying: 'It was made lawful for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)' then indeed Allah made it lawful for me but He did not make it lawful for the people, and it was only made lawful for me for an hour of a day. Then it is returned to being sacred until the Day of Judgement. Then, to you people of Khuza'ah who killed this man from Hudhail: I am his 'Aqil, so whomever (one of his relatives) is killed after today, then his people have two options; either they have him killed, or they take the blood-money from him
hi: Abu Shuraih Al-Ka'bi se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Makkah ko haram banaya hai, logon ne nahi banaya. Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, wo yahan khoon na bahaye, na yahan koi ped kaate. Agar koi rukhsat leta hua kahe: 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye halal ki gayi thi,' to Allah ne ise mere liye halal kiya, logon ke liye nahi, aur wo bhi din ke sirf ek ghante ke liye halal ki gayi, phir wo Qayamat tak haram hai. Ae Khuza'ah qabile! Tumne Huzail ke is aadmi ko qatl kiya hai aur main uska aaqil hoon, to jiska bhi is din ke baad koi maqtool ho, uske ghar walon ko do rahon mein se ikhtiyar hai, ya to wo qisas len ya diyat len." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, isi tarah Shaiban ne bhi Yahya bin Abi Kathir se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jiska koi maqtool ho, use qisas lene, maaf karne, ya diyat lene ka haq hai." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi ke qaayal hain, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"A man was killed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so the killer was brought to the man's guardian. The killer said: 'O Messenger of Allah! By Allah! I did not mean to kill him.' So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Then if what he is saying is true, and you kill him, you would enter the Fire.' So he let the man go." He said: "His hands were bound behind him with a Nis'ah." He said: "So he left, dragging his Nis'ah." [He said:] "So he was called Dhan-Nis'ah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek aadmi qatl kiya gaya, to qaatil ko maqtool ke wali ke hawaale kiya gaya. Qaatil ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Allah ki qasam! Maine ise qatl karne ka irada nahi kiya tha.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar wo sacha hai aur tum ise qatl kar do, to tum aag mein dakhil hoge.'" To us aadmi ne use chhod diya. Unhon ne kaha: "Aur wo ek rassi se bandha hua tha." Unhon ne kaha: "To wo apni rassi ghaseetta hua nikla." Unhon ne kaha: "To wo 'Dhun-Nis'ah' kehlaane laga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur "Nis'ah" ek rassi hai.

e: Narrated Buraidah:from his father who said: "Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dispatched a commander of an army he would exhort him personally; that he should have Taqwa of Allah, and regarding those of the Muslims who are with him; that he should be good to them. He would say: 'Fight in the Name of Allah and in Allah's curse. Fight those who disbelieve in Allah and fight, do not be treacherous, nor mutilate, nor kill a child
hi: Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab kisi lashkar ke ameer ko bhejte, to unhen khaas taur par Allah ka taqwa ikhtiyar karne ki, aur unke saath ke Musalmanon ke saath bhalai karne ki naseehat karte, farmate: 'Allah ke naam se jihaad karo, Allah ki raah mein, jo Allah ka inkar kare usse jang karo, jihaad karo, khayanat mat karo, ahd na todo, muthla mat karo, aur kisi bachche ko qatl mat karo.'" Aur hadith mein ek qissa hai. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Shaddad bin Aws, Imran bin Husain, Anas, Samurah, Al-Mughirah, Ya'la bin Murrah, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Buraidah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ne muthla ko napasand kiya.

e: Narrated Shaddad bin Aws:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Allah has decreed Ihsan in everything. So when you kill, then do the killing well, and when you slaughter, then do the slaughtering well. Let one of you sharpen his blade, and let him comfort his animal (before slaughtering)
hi: Shaddad bin Aws se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne har cheez mein ehsaan farz kiya hai. To jab tum qatl karo, to achi tarah qatl karo, aur jab tum zabah karo, to achi tarah zabah karo, aur tum mein se koi apni chhuri tez kare aur apne zabah kiye jaane wale jaanwar ko aaraam de." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Al-Ash'ath As-San'ani ka naam Shurahbil bin Aadah hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged that a Ghurrah male slave or female slave be given in the case of a fetus. The one of the judgement was made against said: 'Should we give something for one who did not drink, not eat, nor cry out to shed a tear, the likes of which is useless?' So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'This is the speech of a poet. Rather it requires a Ghurrah: a male slave or a female slave
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jenin ke baare mein ek ghurrah ka faisla diya. Jispar faisla diya gaya usne kaha: 'Kya hum use dein jisne na piya na khaaya na chillaaya na cheekha? Aisi cheez to be-hisaab hai.' To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ye to shayar ki baat kar raha hai, balki isme ek ghurrah hai, gulam ya laundi.'" Is mauzu par Hamal bin Malik bin An-Nabighah aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Ghurrah gulam ya laundi ya paanch sau dirham hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Ya ghoda ya khachchar.

e: Narrated Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah:"Two women co-wives, (were fighting), and one of them hit the other with a stone or a tent post, causing her to have a miscarriage. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) judged that a Ghurrah male or female slave should be given for fetus, and he required it from the Asabah of the woman." (Another Chain) for this Hadith [and it is similar to this]
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se riwayat hai ke do sautanein thin, unmein se ek ne doosri ko patthar ya khaime ke khambe se maara, jismein uska hamla gir gaya. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jenin ke baare mein ghurrah, gulam ya laundi, ka faisla diya, aur ise aurat ke asaba par daala. Al-Hasan ne kaha: Aur humein Zaid bin Hubab ne Sufyan se, Mansoor se isi jaisi hadith bataayi. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Juhaifah said:"I said to 'Ali: O Commander of the Believers! Do you have anything written that is not in Allah's Book?' He said: 'By the One Who splits the seed and creates the soul, I have not learned from it except what understanding of the Qur'an Allah gives to a man, and what is in this sheet of paper.' I said: 'What is in the paper?' He said: 'It is the 'Aql, the (ransom for) release of captives, and the judgement that no believer is killed for a disbeliever
hi: Abu Juhaifah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: 'Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Kya aapke paas koi khaas cheez hai jo Kitabullah mein nahi hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne daane ko phaada aur jaan banayi, mujhe ismein sirf wahi samajh maloom hai jo Allah kisi aadmi ko Quran mein deta hai, aur jo is safhe mein hai.' Maine kaha: 'Aur is safhe mein kya hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Ismein aql, qaidiyon ki rihaai, aur ye hai ke koi Momin kaafir ke badle qatl na kiya jaaye.'" Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Momin kaafir ke badle qatl nahi kiya jaata. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Musalman mu'ahid ke badle qatl kiya jaata hai. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib:from his father, from his grandfather that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The Muslim is not killed for disbeliever." And with this chain, it has been narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The blood-money paid for disbeliever is half of the blood-money paid for a believer
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman kaafir ke badle qatl nahi kiya jaata." Aur isi isnad se, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Kaafir ki diyat Momin ki diyat ki aadhi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu mein Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Yahudi aur Nasrani ki diyat ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Yahudi aur Nasrani ki diyat mein wahi mana jo Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai. Aur Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ne kaha: Yahudi aur Nasrani ki diyat Musalman ki diyat ki aadhi hai. Aur isi ke Ahmad bin Hanbal qaayal hain. Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Yahudi aur Nasrani ki diyat chaar hazaar dirham hai, aur Majoosi ki diyat aath sau dirham. Aur isi ke Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ishaq qaayal hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Yahudi aur Nasrani ki diyat Musalman ki diyat jaisi hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Samurah:that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever kills his slave, then we will kill him, and whoever maims his slave, then we will maim him
hi: Samurah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne gulam ko qatl kare, hum use qatl karenge, aur jo apne gulam ko apang kare, hum use apang karenge." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een ahl-e-ilm ne, unmein Ibrahim An-Nakha'i shaamil hain, isi ko apnaaya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne, unmein Al-Hasan Al-Basri aur Ata bin Abi Rabah shaamil hain, kaha: Azaad aur gulam ke darmiyan jaan mein na qisas hai na jaan se kam mein. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Agar wo apne gulam ko qatl kare, to use uske badle qatl nahi kiya jaata, aur agar wo kisi doosre ke gulam ko qatl kare, to use qatl kiya jaata hai. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab:that 'Umar would say: "The blood-money upon the tribe, and the wife does not inherit any of her husband's blood-money." Until Ad-Dahhak bin Sufyan Al-Kulabi informed him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wrote to me, that Ashaim Ad-Dibabi's wife inherited the blood-money of her husband
hi: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se riwayat hai ke Umar kehte the: "Diyat aaqilah par hai, aur biwi apne shohar ki diyat se kuch wirasat nahi paati," yahan tak ke Ad-Dahhak bin Sufyan Al-Kilabi ne unhein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein likha: "Ashiyam Ad-Dibabi ki biwi ko unke shohar ki diyat mein se wirasat do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated 'Imran bin Husain:"A man bit the hand of another man. The man who was bitten pulled his hand out, causing two of his incisors (teeth) to fall out. They brought their case of the Prophet (ﷺ). So he said: "One of you bites his brother like the stallion bites? There is no blood-money for you.' So Allah Most High revealed: Wounds, equal for equal
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi ka haath kaata, to usne apna haath kheench liya, jispar uske do daant toot gaye. Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas jhagda le gaye, to unhon ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ko aise kaate jaise nar oont kaatta hai? Tumhare liye koi diyat nahi." To Allah ne naazil kiya: "(Aur zakhmon mein qisas hai)." Is mauzu par Ya'la bin Umayyah aur Salamah bin Umayyah se bhi riwayat hai, jo do bhai hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Imran bin Husain ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Bahz bin Hakim:from his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet (ﷺ) imprisoned a man for an accusation, then he let him go
hi: Bahz bin Hakim apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko tohmat mein qaid kiya, phir use chhod diya. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Bahz ki, apne walid se, apne dada se, hadith hasan hai. Aur Ismail bin Ibrahim ne Bahz bin Hakim se ye hadith isse zyada mukammal aur lambi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Sa'eed bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever is killed over his wealth then he is a martyr. [And whoever steals a hand-span of land, he will bear seven earths on the Day of Resurrection]
hi: Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne maal ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai, aur jo zameen mein se ek bhi bitta chura le, use Qayamat ke din saat zameenon ka tauq pehnaaya jaayega." Aur Hatim bin Siyah Al-Maruzi ne is hadith mein izafa kiya, Ma'mar ne kaha: Mujhe Az-Zuhri se pahuncha hai, aur maine unse suna nahi, ke isme izafa kiya: "Jo apne maal ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai." Isi tarah Shu'aib bin Abi Hamzah ne ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Talhah bin Abdullah se, Abdur-Rahman bin Amr bin Sahl se, Sa'eed bin Zaid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Az-Zuhri se, Talhah bin Abdullah se, Sa'eed bin Zaid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur Sufyan ne ismein Abdur-Rahman bin Amr bin Sahl ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr:that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever is killed over his wealth, then he is martyr
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne maal ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Sa'eed bin Zaid, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan hai, aur unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne aadmi ko apni jaan aur apne maal ke liye ladne ki rukhsat di hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Wo apne maal ke liye ladta hai chahe wo do dirham hi ho.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"When Allah granted His Messenger (ﷺ) victory over Makkah, he stood (to deliver an address) among the people. He thanked and praised Allah, then he said: 'And from whomever (one of his relatives) was killed, then he has two options to choose from: Either to pardon or that he be killed.'"
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ne apne Rasool ko Makkah ki fatah di, to wo logon mein khade hue, Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, phir farmaya: 'Aur jiska koi maqtool ho, to use do rahon mein se behtar ka ikhtiyar hai, ya to wo maaf kar de, ya wo qisas le.'" Is mauzu par Wa'il bin Hujr, Anas, aur Abu Shuraih Khuwailid bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Zaid:that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "Whoever is killed over his wealth then he is a martyr, and whoever is killed over his religion, then he is a martyr, and whoever is killed over his blood, then he is martyr, and whoever is killed over his family, then he is martyr
hi: Sa'eed bin Zaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jo apne maal ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai, aur jo apne deen ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai, aur jo apne khoon ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai, aur jo apne ghar walon ke liye qatl kiya jaaye, wo shaheed hai." Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hatamah:Yahya (one of the narrators) said: And I think it was from Rafi' bin Khadij - that 'Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid and Muhaiysah bin Mas'ud bin Zaid went out and when they reached Khaibar they separated while there. Then Muhayyisah found 'Abdullah bin Sahl murdered [so he buried him]. Then he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with Huwayyisah bin Mas'ud and Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl. The youngest of the people, Abdur-Rahman, went to speak ahead of his companions. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: "Let the eldest of you speak." So he was silent and two companions spoke. So he conversed with them and they mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the murder of 'Abdullah bin Sahl. He said to them: "If fifty of you can swear an oath then you will have the right against the murderer." They said: "How can we take an oath when we did not witness it?" He said: "Then fifty of Jews can swear to clear the charge with you?" They said: "How could we accept the oaths of a disbelieving people?" So when he saw that, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid the blood-money." (Another Chain) from Sahl bin Abi Hathman and Rafi' bin Khadij, and the meaning is similar to this Hadith
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathmah se riwayat hai, Yahya ne kaha, aur mera khayaal hai Rafi bin Khadij se bhi, dono ne kaha: "Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid aur Muhayyisah bin Mas'ud bin Zaid nikle, jab wo Khaibar pahunche, to wo wahan kisi kaam se alag ho gaye. Phir Muhayyisah ne Abdullah bin Sahl ko maqtool paaya, unhein qatl kar diya gaya tha, to unhon ne unhein dafn kiya. Phir wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, wo aur Huwayyisah bin Mas'ud aur Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl, jo sabse chhote the. Abdur-Rahman apne donon saathiyon se pehle bolne lage, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Bade ko bolne do.' To wo khaamosh ho gaye aur unke donon saathi bole, phir unhon ne unke saath baat ki." To unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Abdullah bin Sahl ke qatl ka zikr kiya, to unhon ne unse farmaya: "Kya tum pachaas qasmein khaaoge taake tum apne saathi ke haqdaar - ya apne qaatil ke haqdaar - ho jao?" Unhon ne kaha: "Hum kaise qasam khaayen jabke humne dekha hi nahi?" Unhon ne farmaya: "To Yahudi pachaas qasmon se tumhein bari kar den." Unhon ne kaha: "Hum kaafir qaum ki qasmein kaise qubool karen?" Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye dekha, to unhon ne khud diyat ada ki. Sahl bin Abi Hathmah aur Rafi bin Khadij se isi jaisi, isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek qasaamah mein isi hadith par amal hai, aur kuch Madina ke fuqaha ne qasaamah se qisas ka faisla maana. Aur kuch Kufa waalon aur doosron ne kaha: Qasaamah qisas wajib nahi karti, balki diyat wajib karti hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The pen has been lifted from three; for the sleeping person until he awakens, for the boy until he becomes a young man and for the mentally insane until he regains sanity
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen logon se qalam utha liya gaya hai: sone wale se jab tak wo jaage, bachche se jab tak wo javan ho, aur pagal se jab tak use hosh aaye." Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch logon ne zikr kiya "aur larke se jab tak wo baaligh ho jaaye." Aur humein maloom nahi ke Al-Hasan ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se suna ho. Aur ye hadith Ata bin As-Saib se, Abu Zabyan se, Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai. Aur Al-A'mash ne ise Abu Zabyan se, Ibn Abbas se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se mauqoof riwayat ki, marfu' nahi kiya. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Hasan Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke zamane mein the aur unhein paaya bhi tha, lekin humein maloom nahi ke unhon ne unse suna ho. Aur Abu Zabyan ka naam Husain bin Jundab hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): "Avert the legal penalties from the Muslims as much as possible, if he has a way out then leave him to his way, for if the Imam makes a mistake in forgiving it would be better than making mistake in punishment
hi: Aishah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon se hudood ko jitna ho sake door karo, agar uske liye koi raasta nikal aaye to use raasta de do, kyunki Imam ka maaf karne mein ghalti karna, saza dene mein ghalti karne se behtar hai."

e: (Another chain) which is similar to the narration of Muhammad bin Rabi'ah (a narrator in no.1424) but he did not narrate it in Marfu' form
hi: Yazid bin Ziyad se, Muhammad bin Rabi'ah ki hadith jaisi, lekin marfu' nahi kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hum marfu' sirf Muhammad bin Rabi'ah ki, Yazid bin Ziyad Ad-Dimashqi se, Az-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Waki ne ise Yazid bin Ziyad se isi jaisi riwayat ki lekin marfu' nahi kiya, aur Waki ki riwayat zyada sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kai Sahaba se isi jaisi baat riwayat hui hai ke unhon ne aisa hi kaha. Aur Yazid bin Ziyad Ad-Dimashqi hadith mein kamzor hain, aur Yazid bin Abi Ziyad Al-Kufi isse zyada mazboot aur purane hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens of the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi Momin se duniya ki museebaton mein se ek museebat door kare, Allah usse Aakhirat ki museebaton mein se ek museebat door karega, aur jo koi kisi Musalman ki khaami chhupaaye, Allah duniya aur Aakhirat mein uski khaami chhupaayega, aur Allah bande ki madad mein rehta hai jab tak bande apne bhai ki madad mein rehta hai." Is mauzu par Uqbah bin Aamir aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith isi tarah kai logon ne Al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, Abu Awanah ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Asbat bin Muhammad reported it from Al-A'mash who said: "It has been narrated to me from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)," and it is similar. [It is as if this is more correct than the first narration.] (Another chain) for this Hadith
hi: Asbat bin Muhammad ne Al-A'mash se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Mujhe Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi baat bataayi gayi, aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih maloom hoti hai. Ubaid bin Asbat bin Muhammad ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Mere waalid ne mujhe Al-A'mash se ye hadith bataayi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim, he doesn't oppress him and doesn't put him into ruin, and whoever is concerned for the needs of his brother, Allah is concerned for his needs, and whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens of the Day of Judgement and whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) on the Day of Judgement
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman Musalman ka bhai hai, wo uspar zulm nahi karta aur na use barbaad hone deta hai, aur jo apne bhai ki zaroorat mein rehta hai, Allah uski zaroorat mein rehta hai, aur jo kisi Musalman ki museebat door kare, Allah usse Qayamat ke din ki museebaton mein se ek museebat door karega, aur jo kisi Musalman ki khaami chhupaaye, Allah Qayamat ke din uski khaami chhupaayega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Umar ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ma'iz bin Malik: "Is what has reached me about you true?" He said: "What has reached you about me?" He said: "It has reached me that you had relations with the slave-maid of the family of so-and-so" He said: "Yes." So he testified four times, and he gave the order that he be stoned
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ma'iz bin Malik se farmaya: "Kya sach hai jo mujhe tumhare baare mein pahuncha?" Unhon ne kaha: "Kya pahuncha aapko mere baare mein?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Mujhe pahuncha hai ke tumne fulaan khaandaan ki laundi ke saath ghalat kaam kiya." Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." To unhon ne chaar baar gawaahi di, to unhon ne unhein rajm karne ka hukum diya. Is mauzu par As-Sa'ib bin Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Simak bin Harb se, Sa'eed bin Jubair se mursal riwayat ki, aur ismein Ibn Abbas ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"Ma'iz Al-Aslamu came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said that he had committed adultery, so he (ﷺ) turned away from him. Then he approached from his other side and said: '[O Messenger of Allah!] I have committed adultery.' So he turned away from him. The he came from his other side and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I have committed adultery.' So he gave the order (for stoning) upon the fourth time. He was taken to Al-Harrah and stoned with rocks, he ran swiftly until he passed a man with a camel whip who beat him with it, and the people beat him until he died. They mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that he ran upon feeling the rocks at the time of death. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Why didn't you leave him?
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Ma'iz Al-Aslami Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha ke unhon ne zina kiya hai. To unhon ne unse mun mod liya, phir wo doosri taraf se aaye aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine zina kiya hai.' To unhon ne unse mun mod liya, phir wo doosri taraf se aaye aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine zina kiya hai.' To chauthi baar unhon ne unke baare mein hukum diya, to unhen Al-Harrah le jaaya gaya aur pattharon se rajm kiya gaya. Jab unhein pattharon ka ehsaas hua, to wo tez daudne lage, yahan tak ke ek aadmi ke paas se guzre jiske paas oont ki jabdi thi, usne unhein usse maara aur logon ne unhein maara yahan tak ke wo mar gaye." To unhon ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr ki ke wo bhaage the jab unhein pattharon aur maut ka ehsaas hua, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne unhein kyun na chhod diya?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur ye Abu Hurairah se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Abu Salamah se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:"A man from the tribe of Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and confessed adultery. He turned away from him, the he confessed (again). Then he turned away from him (again) until he had testified against himself four times. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Are you insane?" He said:"No" He said: "Are you married?" He said: "Yes". So he gave the order and he was stoned at the Musalla. He ran when he was stuck by the stones, and he was caught and stoned until he died. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spoke well of him but he did not perform the (funeral) Salat for him
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Aslam qabile ka ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur zina ka iqrar kiya, to unhon ne unse mun mod liya, phir unhon ne iqrar kiya, to unhon ne mun mod liya, yahan tak ke unhon ne apne khilaaf chaar baar gawaahi di. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum pagal ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." To unhon ne unke baare mein hukum diya, to unhein Musalla mein rajm kiya gaya. Jab pattharon ne unhein tang kiya, to wo bhaage, to unhein pakda gaya aur rajm kiya gaya yahan tak ke wo mar gaye. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke baare mein achi baat kahi, lekin unki namaz-e-janaza nahi padhi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai ke zina ka iqrar karne wala jab apne khilaaf chaar baar iqrar kare, to uspar hadd laagu ki jaaye. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar wo apne khilaaf ek baar iqrar kare, to uspar hadd laagu ki jaaye. Aur ye Malik bin Anas aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur is qaul ki dalil Abu Hurairah aur Zaid bin Khalid ki hadith hai ke do aadmiyon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jhagda kiya, to unmein se ek ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mere bete ne iski biwi se zina kiya hai," poori lambi hadith, aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Unais! Iski biwi ke paas jao, agar wo iqrar kare to use rajm karo." Aur unhon ne ye nahi kaha "agar wo chaar baar iqrar kare."

e: Narrated 'Aishah:"The Quraish were troubled by the affair of a woman from the tribe of Makhzum who stole. So they said: 'Who will speak about her to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?' They said: 'Who can do it other than Usamah bin Zaid, the one dear to the Messenger of Allah?' So Usamah spoke with him, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Do you intercede about a penalty from Allah's penalties?' Then he stood up and adressed the people saying: 'Those before you were only destroyed because they used to leave a noble person if he stole. And if a weak person stole they would establish the penalty upon him. And by Allah! If Fatimah bint Muhammad stole, then I would cut off her hand
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Quraish ko Makhzoom khaandaan ki us aurat ke maamle ne pareshaan kiya jisne chori ki thi, to unhon ne kaha: "Kaun Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein baat karega?" To unhon ne kaha: "Kaun himmat kar sakta hai Usamah bin Zaid ke siwa, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mehboob hain?" To Usamah ne unse baat ki, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum Allah ki hudood mein se ek hadd mein sifarish kar rahe ho?" Phir wo khade hue aur khutba diya, farmaya: "Tumse pehle ke log isliye halaak hue ke jab unmein koi izzatdaar chori karta, to wo use chhod dete, aur jab koi kamzor chori karta, to uspar hadd laagu karte. Allah ki qasam! Agar Muhammad ki beti Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) chori karti, to main uska haath kaat deta." Is mauzu par Mas'ud bin Al-Ajma, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stoned, Abu Bakr stoned, and I stoned. If I didn't dislike that I add to the Book of Allah. I would have written it in the Mushaf, for I fear that there will come a people and they will not find it in the Book of Allah, so they will disbelieve in it
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne rajm kiya, Abu Bakr ne rajm kiya, aur maine rajm kiya, aur agar mujhe Allah ki Kitab mein izafa karna napasand na hota, to main ise Mus'haf mein likh deta, kyunki mujhe darr hai ke kuch log aayenge aur ise Allah ki Kitab mein na paayenge, to uska inkar karenge." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Umar se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Umar bin Al-Khattab said:"Verily Allah sent Muhammad (ﷺ) with the truth, and he revealed the Book to him. Among what was revealed to him was the Ayah of stoning. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stoned, and we stoned after him. I fear that time will pass over the people such that someone will say 'We do not see stoning in the Book of Allah.' They will be misguided by leaving an obligation which Allah revealed. Indeed stoning is the retribution for the adulterer if he was married and the evidence has been established, or due to pregnancy, or confession
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne kaha: "Beshak Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) ko haq ke saath bheja aur unpar Kitab naazil ki, to jo unpar naazil hua usmein rajm ki Ayat thi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne rajm kiya aur humne unke baad rajm kiya. Aur mujhe darr hai ke logon par lamba waqt guzar jaaye, to koi kehne wala kahe: 'Humein rajm Allah ki Kitab mein nahi milta,' to wo Allah ki naazil ki hui ek farz ko chhod kar gumraah ho jaayen. Suno! Rajm zaani par haq hai jab wo shaadi-shuda ho aur saboot mil jaaye, ya hamal ho, ya iqrar ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Umar (RA) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin 'Abdullah bin 'Uthbah:That he heard from Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, and Shibl, that they were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and two men came to him disputing. So one of them stood before him and said: "I ask you by Allah, O Messenger of Allah! Only that you would judge between us by the book of Allah." So his disputant said - and he was more eloquent that him: "I agree of O Messenger of Allah! Judge between us by the Book of Allah, and allow me to speak. My son was a servant for this man and he committed adultery with his wife. So they told me that my son was to be stoned. I paid him one hundred female sheep and a female slave. Then I met some people from the people of knowledge and they said that my son was to be lashed one hundred times, and to be banished for a year and that stoning is only for this man's wife." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! I will judge between you two by the Book of Allah. The one hundred female sheep and the female slave should be returned to you. For your son is one hundred lashes and banishment for a year. O Unais! Go to this Man's wife, and if she confesses then stone her." He went to her and she confessed, so he stoned her
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah, Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, aur Shibl se riwayat karte hain ke wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas the, to unke paas do aadmi jhagda karte hue aaye. To unmein se ek unke saamne khada hua aur kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, Ya Rasool Allah! Ke aap humare darmiyan Allah ki Kitab ke mutabiq faisla karen." To uske musaafir ne, jo usse zyada faseeh tha, kaha: "Haan, Ya Rasool Allah! Humare darmiyan Allah ki Kitab ke mutabiq faisla kariye, aur mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main baat karoon. Mera beta ispar naukar tha, usne iski biwi se zina kiya, to mujhe bataya gaya ke mere bete par rajm hai, to maine sau bakriyon aur ek khadim ke badle fidya diya. Phir main kuch ahl-e-ilm se mila, to unhon ne kaha ke mere bete par sau koda aur ek saal ki jila-watani hai, aur rajm to sirf iski biwi par hai." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai! Main tum donon ke darmiyan Allah ki Kitab ke mutabiq faisla karoonga: sau bakriyaan aur khadim tumhein wapas kiye jaayenge, aur tumhare bete par sau koda aur ek saal ki jila-watani hai. Aur Ae Unais! Iski biwi ke paas jao, agar wo iqrar kare to use rajm karo." To wo unke paas gaye, unhon ne iqrar kiya, to unhein rajm kiya gaya.

e: (Another chain) with similar
hi: Isi jaisi riwayat.

e: (Another chain) with similar
hi: Isi jaisi riwayat. Is mauzu par Abu Bakrah, Ubadah bin As-Samit, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Abbas, Jabir bin Samurah, Hazzal, Buraidah, Salamah bin Al-Muhabbiq, Abu Barzah, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah aur Zaid bin Khalid ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah Malik bin Anas, Ma'mar, aur kai doosron ne Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah se, Abu Hurairah aur Zaid bin Khalid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur unhon ne isi isnad se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki ke unhon ne farmaya: "Jab laundi zina kare, to use koda maaro, aur agar wo chauthi baar zina kare, to use bech do chahe ek dhaage ke badle." Aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah se, Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, aur Shibl se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha "hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas the." Isi tarah Ibn Uyainah ne donon hadithon ko Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, aur Shibl se ikattha riwayat ki, aur Ibn Uyainah ki hadith mein wahm hai, Sufyan bin Uyainah ne ismein galti ki, ek hadith ko doosri mein daal diya. Aur sahih wo hai jo Muhammad bin Al-Walid Az-Zubaidi, Yunus bin Yazid, aur Az-Zuhri ke bhatije ne Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah se, Abu Hurairah aur Zaid bin Khalid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab laundi zina kare, to use koda maaro." Aur Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah se, Shibl bin Khalid se, Abdullah bin Malik Al-Awsi se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab laundi zina kare." Aur yehi ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek sahih hai. Aur Shibl bin Khalid ne Nabi (SAW) ko nahi paaya, wo sirf Abdullah bin Malik Al-Awsi se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hain, aur yehi sahih hai, aur Ibn Uyainah ki hadith mehfooz nahi. Aur unse riwayat hai ke unhon ne kaha "Shibl bin Hamid," jo ghalat hai, sahih Shibl bin Khalid hai, aur kaha jaata hai Shibl bin Khulaid bhi.

e: Narrated 'Ubadah bin As-Samit:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Take from me. For Allah has a way made for them : For the married person who commits adultery with a married person is one hundred lashes, then stoning. And for the virgin who commits adultery with a virgin is one hundred lashes and banishment for a year
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhse seekho, Allah ne unke liye raasta banaaya hai: shaadi-shuda ka shaadi-shuda ke saath sau koda phir rajm, aur kunwaara ka kunwaari ke saath sau koda aur ek saal ki jila-watani." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Ubayy bin Ka'b, aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud aur doosre shaamil hain, ne kaha: Shaadi-shuda ko koda bhi maara jaata hai aur rajm bhi kiya jaata hai. Aur isi taraf kuch ahl-e-ilm gaye hain, aur ye Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Abu Bakr aur Umar aur doosre shaamil hain, ne kaha: Shaadi-shuda par sirf rajm hai, koda nahi maara jaata. Aur Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi kai hadithon mein riwayat hai, Ma'iz aur doosron ke qisse mein, ke unhon ne rajm ka hukum diya aur rajm se pehle koda maarne ka hukum nahi diya. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, aur Ahmad ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Imran bin Husain:"A woman from Juhainah confessed before the Prophet (ﷺ) that she had committed adultery, and she said: 'I am pregnant.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) called for her guardian and said: 'Be good to her and if she gives birth to her child then tell me.' So he did so, and then he (ﷺ) gave the order that her clothes be bound tightly around her. Then he ordered her to be stoned and she was stoned. Then he performed (funeral) Salat for her. So 'Umar bin Al-Khattab said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah! You stoned her then you prayed for her?!' He said: 'She has repented a repentance that, if distributed among seventy of the people of Al-Madinah, it would have sufficed them. Have you ever seen something more virtuous than her sacrificing herself for the sake of Allah?
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Juhainah qabile ki ek aurat ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne zina ka iqrar kiya aur kaha: "Main hamla hoon." To Nabi (SAW) ne uske wali ko bulaya aur farmaya: "Uske saath achi tarah pesh aao, aur jab wo bachcha jan de, to mujhe bataana." Usne aisa kiya, to unhon ne uske baare mein hukum diya, uske kapde uspar kas diye gaye, phir unhon ne use rajm karne ka hukum diya, to use rajm kiya gaya, phir unhon ne uski namaz-e-janaza padhi. To Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unse kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aapne use rajm kiya, phir uski namaz padhte hain?" To unhon ne farmaya: "Usne aisi tauba ki hai ke agar wo Madina ke sattar logon mein baanti jaaye, to unke liye kaafi hoti. Aur kya tumne kabhi isse behtar koi cheez dekhi hai ke usne apni jaan Allah ke liye qurbaan kar di?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stoned a Jew and Jewess
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek Yahudi aur ek Yahudi aurat ko rajm kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur hadith mein ek qissa hai, aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samurah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) stoned a Jew and a Jewess
hi: Jabir bin Samurah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek Yahudi aur ek Yahudi aurat ko rajm kiya. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Al-Bara, Jabir, Ibn Abi Awfa, Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Jaz', aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir bin Samurah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jab Ahl-e-Kitab aapas mein jhagda karen aur Musalmanon ke haakimon ke paas apna maamla le jaayen, to wo unke darmiyan Kitab, Sunnat, aur Musalmanon ke ahkaam ke mutabiq faisla karen. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Unpar zina mein hadd laagu nahi ki jaati. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e:
Narrated Sahl bin Abi Hatamah:Yahya (one of the narrators) said: And I think it was from Rafi' bin Khadij - that 'Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid and Muhaiysah bin Mas'ud bin Zaid went out and when they reached Khaibar they separated while there. Then Muhayyisah found 'Abdullah bin Sahl murdered . Then he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with Huwayyisah bin Mas'ud and Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl. The youngest of the people, Abdur-Rahman, went to speak ahead of his companions. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: "Let the eldest of you speak." So he was silent and two companions spoke. So he conversed with them and they mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the murder of 'Abdullah bin Sahl. He said to them: "If fifty of you can swear an oath then you will have the right against the murderer." They said: "How can we take an oath when we did not witness it?" He said: "Then fifty of Jews can swear to clear the charge with you?" They said: "How could we accept the oaths of a disbelieving people?" So when he saw that, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid the blood-money." 
(Another Chain) from Sahl bin Abi Hathman and Rafi' bin Khadij, and the meaning is similar to this Hadith.
hi: Sahl bin Abi Hathmah aur Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Abdullah bin Sahl bin Zaid aur Muhayyisah bin Mas'ud bin Zaid nikle, jab wo Khaibar pahunche, to wahan alag ho gaye, phir Muhayyisah ne Abdullah bin Sahl ko murda paaya, use qatl kar diya gaya tha, to unhon ne use dafn kiya, phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, wo aur Huwayyisah bin Mas'ud aur Abdur-Rahman bin Sahl, jo sabse chhote the. Abdur-Rahman apne saathiyon se pehle bolne lage, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Bade ko baat karne do.' To wo khaamosh ho gaye aur unke donon saathi bole, phir unhon ne bhi unke saath baat ki." To unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Abdullah bin Sahl ke qatl ka zikr kiya, to unhon ne unse farmaya: "Kya tum pachaas qasam khaaoge taake apne saathi ka haq apne qaatil se le sako?" Unhon ne kaha: "Hum kaise qasam khaayen jabke humne dekha hi nahi?" Unhon ne farmaya: "To Yahudi tumhein pachaas qasmon se bari kar denge." Unhon ne kaha: "Hum kaafir qaum ki qasmein kaise qubool karen?" Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye dekha, to unhon ne khud diyat ada ki. Isi jaisi riwayat, isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek qasaamah mein isi hadith par amal hai. Aur Madina ke kuch fuqaha ne qasaamah ke saath qisaas ko maana. Aur Kufa waalon aur doosron mein se kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Qasaamah qisaas wajib nahi karta, sirf diyat wajib karta hai.

e: Narrated 'Ubadah bin As-Samit:"We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) [in a gathering] and he said: 'Pledge to me that you will not associate [anything as] partners with Allah, and that you will not steal nor commit adultery.' He recited to them the Ayah. (And he said:)'Whoever among you dies, then this reward is with Allah, and whoever among you does some of this and then he is punished, it is atonement for him. And whoever does some of this and Allah covers it for him, then it is up to Allah; if He wills, He will punish them, and if He wills, He will forgive him
hi: Ubadah bin As-Samit ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek majlis mein the, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Mujhse bai'at karo is baat par ke tum Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek na karoge, na chori karoge, na zina karoge,' unhon ne unhein Ayat padh kar sunaayi, 'to jo tum mein se poora kare, uska ajr Allah ke zimme hai, aur jo isme se kuch kare aur uspar saza payi jaaye, to wo uske liye kaffara hai, aur jo isme se kuch kare aur Allah usse chhupa de, to wo Allah ke hawaale hai, agar chaahe to azaab de aur agar chaahe to maaf kar de.'" Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jarir bin Abdullah, aur Khuzaimah bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ubadah bin As-Samit ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Maine is mauzu mein nahi suna ke hudood unke ahl ke liye kaffara hain, isse behtar koi baat. Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Aur main pasand karta hoon ke jo koi gunaah kare aur Allah usse chhupa de, wo khud apne aap ko chhupaaye aur apne aur apne Rab ke darmiyan tauba kare. Isi tarah Abu Bakr aur Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne ek aadmi ko hukum diya ke wo khud ko chhupaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If one of your slave girl commits illegal sexual intercourse, then whip her three times according to the Book of Allah, and if she does it again then sell her, even if it is for a rope made of hair
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki laundi zina kare, to use Allah ki Kitab ke mutabiq teen baar koda maare, aur agar wo dobara kare, to use bech de, chahe baalon ki rassi ke badle." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid, aur Shibl se, Abdullah bin Malik Al-Awsi se, bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne maana ke aadmi apne gulam par hukumat ke bagair hadd laagu kar sakta hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Ye hukumat ko diya jaaye, wo khud hadd laagu na kare. Aur pehla qaul zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu 'Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami:"Ali gave a Khutbah, and said: 'O people, establish the penalties upon your slaves, those married from them and those unmarried. A slave girl of the Prophet (ﷺ) committed illegal sexual intercourse so he ordered me to whip her. I went to her and she was just experiencing her post-natal bleeding, so I feared that if I were to whip her I would kill her' - or he said: 'She would die' - 'so I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and I told that to him. So he said: 'You did well
hi: Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami ne kaha: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne khutba diya aur kaha: 'Ae logo! Apne gulamon par hudood laagu karo, chahe wo shaadi-shuda hon ya na hon. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek laundi ne zina kiya, to unhon ne mujhe hukum diya ke main use koda maaroon. To dekha ke wo naye-naye nifaas mein thi, to mujhe darr hua ke agar main use koda maaroon to main use qatl kar doonga - ya kaha: wo mar jaayegi - to main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein ye baat bataayi, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumne acha kiya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur As-Suddi ka naam Isma'il bin Abdur-Rahman hai, wo Tabi'een mein se hain, unhon ne Anas bin Malik se suna aur Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) bin Abi Talib ko dekha.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) implemented the penalty by beating forty times, with two shoes - Mis'ar (one of the narrators) said: "It think it was for wine
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do jooton se chaalis hadd lagayi. Mis'ar ne kaha: Mera khayaal hai ye sharaab ke baare mein tha. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdur-Rahman bin Azhar, Abu Hurairah, As-Sa'ib, Ibn Abbas, aur Uqbah bin Al-Harith se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Sa'eed ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu As-Siddiq An-Naji ka naam Bakr bin Amr hai, aur kaha jaata hai Bakr bin Qais.

e: Narrated Anas:That a man who had drunk wine was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ), so he beat him about forty times with two stalks of a palm tree. So Abu Bakr did similarly, and by the time 'Umar became Khalifah he sought council from the people. And 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf said: 'I see that the lightest penalty is eighty lashes,' so 'Umar ordered that
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek aadmi laaya gaya jisne sharaab pi thi, to unhon ne use do khajoor ki shaakhon se chaalis baar maara, aur Abu Bakr ne bhi aisa hi kiya. Jab Umar ka zamana aaya, to unhon ne logon se mashwara kiya, to Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai sabse halki hadd assi hai." To Umar ne isi ka hukum diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke sharaabi ki hadd assi hai.

e: Narrated Mu'awiyah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever drinks wine, then lash him. If he returns to it, then on the fourth time kill him
hi: Muawiyah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo sharaab piye, use koda maaro, aur agar wo chauthi baar dobara kare, to use qatl karo." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ash-Sharid, Shurahbil bin Aws, Jarir, Abu Ar-Ramad Al-Balawi, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muawiyah ki hadith - isi tarah Ath-Thawri ne bhi Aasim se, Abu Salih se, Muawiyah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Juraij aur Ma'mar ne Suhail bin Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abu Salih ki, Muawiyah se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith, is mauzu mein, Abu Salih ki Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur ye sirf shuru mein tha, phir baad mein mansookh ho gaya. Isi tarah Muhammad bin Ishaq ne Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo sharaab piye, use koda maaro, aur agar wo chauthi baar dobara kare, to use qatl karo." Unhon ne kaha: Phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas iske baad ek aadmi laaya gaya jisne chauthi baar sharaab pi thi, to unhon ne use maara aur qatl nahi kiya. Isi tarah Az-Zuhri ne Qabisah bin Dhu'aib se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: To qatl hataa diya gaya aur ye rukhsat ban gayi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, humein purane aur naye zamane mein unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi. Aur isi ko mazboot karti hai wo baat jo Nabi (SAW) se kai tareeqon se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman aadmi ka khoon, jo gawaahi deta ho ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, halal nahi, siwaye teen mein se ek soorat mein: jaan ke badle jaan, shaadi-shuda zaani, aur apna deen chhodne wala."

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to cut the hand for a fourth of a Dinar and beyond that
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) chautahai dinar aur usse zyada mein haath kaata karte the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye hadith Amrah se, Aishah se, doosre tareeqon se bhi marfu' riwayat hui hai, aur kuch logon ne ise Amrah se, Aishah se mauqoof riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cut the hand for a shield worth three Dirham
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek dhaal ke badle haath kaata jiski qeemat teen dirham thi. Is mauzu par Sa'd, Abdullah bin Amr, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, aur Aiman se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, unmein Abu Bakr As-Siddiq shaamil hain, ne paanch dirham mein haath kaata. Aur Uthman aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke unhon ne chautahai dinar mein kaata. Aur Abu Hurairah aur Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Paanch dirham mein haath kaata jaata hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een fuqaha ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne chautahai dinar ya usse zyada mein kaatna maana. Aur Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Kaata nahi jaata magar ek dinar ya das dirham mein." Aur ye ek mursal hadith hai, Qasim bin Abdur-Rahman ne Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat ki, aur Qasim ne Ibn Mas'ud se suna nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Das dirham se kam mein na kaata jaaye. Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Das dirham se kam mein na kaata jaaye," lekin iska isnad muttasil nahi.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Muhariz said:"I asked Fadalah bin 'Ubaid about hanging the hand around the neck of the thief: 'Is this from the Sunnah?' He said: 'A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with a thief so his hand was cut off, and then he ordered that it be hung around his neck
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Muhairiz ne kaha: "Maine Fadalah bin Ubaid se pucha chor ki gardan mein uska kaata hua haath latkaane ke baare mein, kya ye Sunnat hai? Unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek chor laaya gaya, to uska haath kaata gaya, phir unhon ne hukum diya, to use uski gardan mein latka diya gaya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Umar bin Ali Al-Muqaddami ki, Hajjaj bin Artaah se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Muhairiz, Abdullah bin Muhairiz ke bhai hain, Shaami.

e: Narrated Jabir :That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "There is no cutting of the hand for the traitor, or the embezzler, nor the plunderer
hi: Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Khayanat karne wale, cheenne wale, aur chupke se le jaane wale par haath kaatna nahi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Mughirah bin Muslim ne bhi ise Abu Az-Zubair se, Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se, Ibn Juraij ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Rafi' bin Khadij:That he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "There is no cutting of the hand for fruits or palm marrow
hi: Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Phal aur khajoor ke gudde mein haath kaatna nahi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah kuch logon ne Yahya bin Sa'eed se, Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban se, apne chacha Wasi bin Habban se, Rafi bin Khadij se, Nabi (SAW) se, Al-Laith bin Sa'd ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Malik bin Anas aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Yahya bin Sa'eed se, Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban se, Rafi bin Khadij se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur ismein Wasi bin Habban ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Busr Bin Artah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The hands are not cut in the battles
hi: Busr bin Artah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jung mein haath nahi kaate jaate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ibn Lahi'ah ke siwa doosron ne bhi isi isnad se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur kaha jaata hai Busr bin Abi Artah bhi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, unmein Al-Awza'i shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke jung mein dushman ke saamne hadd laagu na ki jaaye, is darr se ke jispar hadd laagu ki jaaye wo dushman se ja mile. Jab imam dushman ki sarzameen se nikal kar Islam ke ilaqe mein laut aaye, to jisne khata ki ho uspar hadd laagu kare. Isi tarah Al-Awza'i ne kaha.

e: Habib bin Salim said:"A man was brought to An-Nu'man bin Bashir who had relations with the slave girl of his wife. He said: 'I give you judgement about her case according to the judgement of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): If she made her lawful for him, then I will lash him one hundred times, and if she did not make her lawful, then I will stone him
hi: Habib bin Salim ne kaha: "An-Nu'man bin Bashir ke paas ek aadmi laaya gaya jisne apni biwi ki laundi ke saath ghalat sambhog kiya tha. Unhon ne kaha: 'Main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke faisle ke mutabiq faisla doonga: agar usne use uske liye halal kiya ho, to main use sau koda maarunga, aur agar usne use halal na kiya ho, to main use rajm karunga.'"

e: (Another chain) from An-Nu'man bin Bashir with similar
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir se, isi jaisi. Is mauzu par Salamah bin Al-Muhabbiq se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: An-Nu'man ki hadith ke isnad mein iztiraab hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Qatadah ne Habib bin Salim se ye hadith nahi suni, unhon ne ise Khalid bin Urfutah se riwayat ki. Aur Qatadah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Habib bin Salim ne mujhe ye likh kar bheji. Aur Abu Bishr ne bhi Habib bin Salim se ye hadith nahi suni, unhon ne bhi ise Khalid bin Urfutah se riwayat ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ka us aadmi ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jo apni biwi ki laundi ke saath ghalat sambhog kare, Nabi (SAW) ke kai Sahaba se, unmein Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Umar shaamil hain, riwayat hai ke uspar rajm hai. Aur Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: Uspar hadd nahi, lekin usse ta'zeer di jaaye. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq isi taraf gaye hain jo An-Nu'man bin Bashir ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki.
