e: Narrated 'Abdul-Jabbar bin Wa'il bin Hujr:That his father said: "A woman was forced to commit illegal sexual relations during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not enforce the legal punishment upon her, but he enforced it upon the one who had done it to her." And the narrator did not mention him assigning a dowry to her
hi: Abdul-Jabbar bin Wa'il bin Hujr apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek aurat ke saath zabardasti ki gayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uspar hadd nahi lagayi, balki jisne uske saath zabardasti ki thi uspar hadd lagayi." Aur zikr nahi kiya gaya ke unhon ne uske liye koi mahr muqarrar kiya ho. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad muttasil nahi, aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abdul-Jabbar bin Wa'il bin Hujr ne apne waalid se nahi suna aur na unhein paaya, kaha jaata hai ke unki paidaish apne waalid ki maut ke kai mahine baad hui. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke zabardasti ki gayi aurat par koi hadd nahi.

e: Narrated 'Alqamah bin Wa'il Al-Kindi:From his father: "A women went out during the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) to go to Salat, but she was caught by a man and he had relations with her, so she screamed and he left. Then a man came across her and she said: 'That man has done this and that to me', then she came across a group of Emigrants (Muhajirin) and she said: 'That man did this and that to me.' They went to get the man she thought had relations with her, and they brought him to her. She said: 'Yes, that's him.' So they brought him to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and when he ordered that he be stoned, the man who had relations with her, said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I am the one who had relations with her.' So he said to her: 'Go, for Allah has forgiven you.' Then he said some nice words to the man (who was brought). And he said to the man who had relations with her: 'Stone him.' Then he said: 'He has repented a repentance that, if the inhabitants of Al-Madinah had repented with, it would have been accepted from them
hi: Alqamah bin Wa'il Al-Kindi apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein ek aurat namaz ke liye nikli, to ek aadmi ne use raaste mein pakad liya, usse zabardasti apni haajat poori ki, to wo cheekhi, aur wo bhaag gaya. Ek aadmi uske paas se guzra, to usne kaha: "Us aadmi ne mere saath aisa aisa kiya." Aur wo Muhajireen ke ek giroh ke paas se guzri, to usne kaha: "Us aadmi ne mere saath aisa aisa kiya." To wo gaye aur us aadmi ko pakda jise usne shak kiya tha ke usne uske saath ye kiya, aur use uske paas laaye, to usne kaha: "Haan, yehi hai." To wo use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye, jab unhon ne use rajm karne ka hukum diya, to woh aadmi jisne uske saath ye kiya tha khada hua aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Main hoon jisne uske saath ye kiya." To unhon ne us aurat se farmaya: "Jao, Allah ne tumhein maaf kar diya." Aur unhon ne us pakde gaye aadmi se achi baat kahi, aur us aadmi se jisne uske saath ye kiya tha, farmaya: "Ise rajm karo." Aur farmaya: "Isne aisi tauba ki hai ke agar Madina waale bhi aisi tauba karte, to unse qubool ki jaati." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Alqamah bin Wa'il bin Hujr ne apne waalid se suna hai, aur wo Abdul-Jabbar bin Wa'il se bade hain, aur Abdul-Jabbar bin Wa'il ne apne waalid se nahi suna.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whomever you see having relations with an animal then kill him and kill animal." So it was said to Ibn 'Abbas: "What is the case of the animal?" He said: "I did not hear anything from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about this, but I see that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) disliked eating its meat or using it, due to the fact that such a (heinous) thing has been done with that animal
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise tum kisi jaanwar ke saath ghalat kaam karte paao, use qatl karo aur jaanwar ko bhi qatl karo." To Ibn Abbas se pucha gaya: "Jaanwar ka kya kasoor hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein kuch nahi suna, lekin mera khayaal hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye napasand tha ke uska gosht khaaya jaaye ya usse faida uthaaya jaaye, jabke uske saath aisa amal ho chuka ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Amr bin Abi Amr ki, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whomever you find doing the actions of the people of Lut then kill the one doing it, and the one it is done to
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise tum Loot ki qaum ka amal karte paao, to karne wale aur jiske saath kiya jaaye dono ko qatl karo." Is mauzu par Jabir aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se, sirf isi tareeqe se maloom hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ishaq ne ye hadith Amr bin Abi Amr se riwayat ki aur kaha: "Mal'oon hai wo jo Loot ki qaum ka amal kare," aur ismein qatl ka zikr nahi kiya, aur ismein zikr kiya: "Mal'oon hai wo jo kisi jaanwar ke paas jaaye." Aur ye hadith Aasim bin Umar se, Suhail bin Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Karne wale aur jiske saath kiya jaaye dono ko qatl karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ke isnad mein baat hai, aur humein maloom nahi ke Suhail bin Abi Salih se Aasim bin Umar Al-Umari ke siwa kisi ne ye riwayat ki ho. Aur Aasim bin Umar hadith mein apni hifz ki wajah se kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka Looti ki hadd ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne maana ke uspar rajm hai, chahe wo shaadi-shuda ho ya na ho, aur ye Malik, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch Tabi'een fuqaha, unmein Al-Hasan Al-Basri, Ibrahim An-Nakha'i, aur Ata bin Abi Rabah aur doosre shaamil hain, ne kaha: Looti ki hadd zaani ki hadd hai. Aur ye Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Jabir:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "What I fear most from my Ummah is the behavior of the people of Lut
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat par jispar mujhe sabse zyada darr hai, wo Loot ki qaum ka amal hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil bin Abi Talib ki, Jabir se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Narrated 'Ikrimah:That 'Ali burnt some people who apostasized from Islam. This news reached Ibn 'Abbas, so he said: "If it were me I would have killed them according to the statement of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever changes his religion then kill him.' And I would not have burned them because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Do not punish with the punishment of Allah.' So this reached 'Ali, and he said: "Ibn 'Abbas has told the truth
hi: Ikrimah se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kuch logon ko jala diya jo Islam se murtad ho gaye the, to ye baat Ibn Abbas tak pahunchi, to unhon ne kaha: "Agar main hota, to main unhein qatl kar deta, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki wajah se: 'Jo apna deen badle, use qatl karo.' Lekin main unhein jalaata nahi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki wajah se: 'Allah ke azaab se azaab mat do.'" To ye baat Ali (Alayhis Salam) tak pahunchi, to unhon ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas ne sach kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek murtad ke baare mein isi par amal hai. Aur unka aurat ke murtad hone ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ki jamaat ne kaha: Use qatl kiya jaaye, aur ye Al-Awza'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unmein se kuch ne kaha: Use qaid kiya jaaye, qatl nahi kiya jaaye, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Musa:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever carries weapons against us, he is not from us
hi: Abu Musa se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humpar hathiyaar uthaaye, wo hum mein se nahi." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Ibn Az-Zubair, Abu Hurairah, aur Salamah bin Al-Akwa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Musa ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jundab:That he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "The punishment of the Sahir is a strike of the sword
hi: Jundab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaadugar ki hadd talwaar ka ek waar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum marfu' sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Isma'il bin Muslim Al-Makki hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur Isma'il bin Muslim Al-Abdi Al-Basri, Waki ne kaha, wo thiqah hain. Aur ye Al-Hasan se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur Jundab se sahih mauqoof hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas ka qaul hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Jaadugar sirf tab qatl kiya jaata hai jab uska jaadu kufr tak pahunchaaye, aur agar uska amal kufr se kam ho, to humein uspar qatl theek nahi lagta.

e: Narrated Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whomever you find stealing from the spoils of war while in the path of Allah, then burn his belongings." Salih (one of the narrators) said: "I entered upon Maslamah and with him was Salim bin 'Abdullah. There was a man there who had stolen from the spoils of war, so Salim narrated this Hadith. So he ordered accordingly, and his belongings were burnt. There was a Mushaf in his belongings, so Salim said: 'Sell this and give its proceeds as charity
hi: Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise tum Allah ki raah mein maal-e-ghanimat mein khayanat karte paao, to uska saamaan jala do." Salih ne kaha: "To main Maslamah ke paas gaya, unke saath Salim bin Abdullah the, unhon ne ek aadmi ko khayanat karte paaya, to Salim ne ye hadith bataayi, to unhon ne hukum diya, to uska saamaan jala diya gaya, to uske saamaan mein ek Mushaf mila, to Salim ne kaha: 'Ise becho aur uski qeemat sadqa kar do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Al-Awza'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ise sirf Salih bin Muhammad bin Za'idah ne riwayat ki, wo Abu Waqid Al-Laithi hain, aur wo munkar hadith wale hain. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) se ghaal ke baare mein kai hadithon mein riwayat hai, lekin unmein uska saamaan jalaane ka hukum nahi diya gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "If a man says to another man: 'O you Jew' then beat him twenty times. If he says: 'O you effeminate' then beat him twenty times. And whoever has relations with someone that is a Mahram then kill him
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab koi aadmi kisi doosre aadmi se kahe 'Ae Yahudi!' to use bees koda maaro, aur jab wo kahe 'Ae mukhannath!' to use bees koda maaro, aur jo kisi mahram rishtedaar ke saath ghalat kaam kare, use qatl karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Ibrahim bin Isma'il hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur humare saathiyon ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo mahram rishtedaar ke paas jaanbujh kar jaaye, uspar qatl hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Jo apni maa se nikah kare, use qatl kiya jaaye. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Jo mahram rishtedaar ke saath ghalat kaam kare, use qatl kiya jaaye. Aur Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hai, Al-Bara bin Aazib aur Qurrah bin Iyas Al-Muzani ne riwayat ki ke ek aadmi ne apne waalid ki biwi se nikah kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne use qatl karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Burdah bun Niyar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "No one is to be lashed more than ten lashes except for a legal punishment among Allah's punishments
hi: Abu Burdah bin Niyar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das koda se zyada na maaro jaayen, siwaye Allah ki hudood mein se kisi hadd mein." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Bukair bin Al-Ashajj ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ta'zeer ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, aur ta'zeer ke baare mein sabse achi riwayat yehi hadith hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur ye hadith Ibn Lahi'ah ne Bukair se riwayat ki lekin ismein ghalti ki, unhon ne kaha "Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir bin Abdullah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se," aur ye ghalat hai, sahih Al-Laith bin Sa'd ki hadith hai, jo sirf "Abdur-Rahman bin Jabir bin Abdullah se, Abu Burdah bin Niyar se, Nabi (SAW) se" hai.

e: Narrated Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We are a people who hunt.' He said: 'If you send your dog and you mentioned the Name of Allah upon it, and he catches something for you, then eat it.' I said: 'Even if he kills it?' He said: 'Even if he kills it.' I said: 'We are a people who shoot (at game).' He said: 'What you catch with your bow, then eat it.'" He said: "Then I said:'Indeed we are a people who travel. We come across Jews, Christians, and Zoroastrians, and we do not find vessels other than theirs.' He said: 'If you do not find other than them, then wash them with water, then eat and drink from it
hi: Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum shikaar karne wale log hain.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tum apna kutta chhodo aur usspar Allah ka naam lo, aur wo tumhare liye pakde, to khaao.' Maine kaha: 'Aur agar wo maar de?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Chahe wo maar hi de.' Maine kaha: 'Hum teer chalaane wale log hain.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo tumhari kamaan tumhein wapas de de, use khaao.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Hum safar karne wale log hain, hum Yahudiyon, Nasraniyon, aur Majoosiyon ke paas se guzarte hain, to humein unke bartanon ke siwa kuch nahi milta.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar tumhein unke siwa kuch na mile, to unhein paani se dho lo, phir unmein khaao aur piyo.'" Is mauzu par Adiyy bin Hatim se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Aa'idhullah bin Abdullah, Abu Idris Al-Khawlani hain, aur Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani ka naam Jurthum hai, aur kaha jaata hai Jurthum bin Nashir, aur kaha jaata hai Ibn Qais.

e: Narrated Mu'awiyah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever drinks wine, then lash him. If he returns to it, then on the fourth time kill him."
hi: Muawiyah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo sharaab piye, use koda maaro, aur agar wo chauthi baar dobara kare, to use qatl karo." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ash-Sharid, Shurahbil bin Aws, Jarir, Abu Ar-Ramad Al-Balawi, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Muawiyah ki hadith - isi tarah Ath-Thawri ne bhi Aasim se, Abu Salih se, Muawiyah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Juraij aur Ma'mar ne Suhail bin Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abu Salih ki, Muawiyah se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith, is mauzu mein, Abu Salih ki Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur ye sirf shuru mein tha, phir baad mein mansookh ho gaya. Isi tarah Muhammad bin Ishaq ne Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo sharaab piye, use koda maaro, aur agar wo chauthi baar dobara kare, to use qatl karo." Unhon ne kaha: Phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas iske baad ek aadmi laaya gaya jisne chauthi baar sharaab pi thi, to unhon ne use maara aur qatl nahi kiya. Isi tarah Az-Zuhri ne Qabisah bin Dhu'aib se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: To qatl hataa diya gaya aur ye rukhsat ban gayi. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai, humein purane aur naye zamane mein unke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi. Aur isi ko mazboot karti hai wo baat jo Nabi (SAW) se kai tareeqon se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman aadmi ka khoon, jo gawaahi deta ho ke Allah ke siwa koi maabood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, halal nahi, siwaye teen mein se ek soorat mein: jaan ke badle jaan, shaadi-shuda zaani, aur apna deen chhodne wala."

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:"We have been forbidden from the game caught by a Zoroastrian's dog
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Humein Majoosi ke kutte ke shikaar se mana kiya gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo Majoosi ke kutte ke shikaar ki rukhsat nahi dete. Aur Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazzah, Al-Qasim bin Nafi Al-Makki hain.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the game caught by a falcon. So he said: 'What it catches for you, then eat it
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se baaz ke shikaar ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo tumhare liye pakde, use khaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Mujalid ki, Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo baazon aur shaheen ke shikaar mein koi harj nahi maante. Aur Mujahid ne kaha: Baaz wo parinda hai jisse un darindon mein se shikaar kiya jaata hai jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: \"(Aur jinhein tumne sikhaaya hai un darindon mein se),\" unhon ne kutton aur us parinde ki tafseer ki jinse shikaar kiya jaata hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne baaz ke shikaar ki rukhsat di hai chahe wo usmein se kuch khaaye, aur unhon ne kaha: Uski taalim to bas itni hai ke wo bulaane par aa jaaye. Aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya, aur zyada tar fuqaha ne kaha: Aadmi khaaye, chahe usne usmein se kuch khaaya ho.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I shoot some game and then find my arrow in it the next day.' He said: 'If you know that your arrow killed it, and you dont see any marks of predators, then eat it
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main shikaar par teer chalaata hoon, phir agle din usmein apna teer paata hoon.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tumhein maloom ho ke tumhare teer ne use maara hai aur usmein kisi darinde ka nishaan na ho, to khaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abu Bishr aur Abdul-Malik bin Maisarah se, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Adiyy bin Hatim se riwayat ki, aur donon hadithein sahih hain. Is mauzu par Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about hunting, so he said: 'Mention Allah's Name when you shoot your arrow. Then, if you find it dead, eat from it, unless you found that it has fallen in (some body of) water. Then do not eat it, for you do not know if the water killed it, or your arrow
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaar ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tum apna teer chalaao, to Allah ka naam lo, agar tumhein wo maara hua mile, to khaao, siwaye is ke ke tumhein wo paani mein gira hua mile, to na khaao, kyunki tumhein nahi maloom ke paani ne use maara ya tumhare teer ne.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the game caught by a trained dog. He said: 'If you mention the Name of Allah when you send your trained dog, then eat from what it catches for you. But if it eats from it, then do not eat it, for he only caught it for himself.' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What do you say about when our dogs get mixed with other dogs.' He said: 'You only mentioned the Name of Allah over your dog, you did not mention it over the others.'" Sufyan said: "He disliked for him to eat it
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sikhaaye hue kutte ke shikaar ke baare mein pucha. Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tum apna sikhaaya hua kutta chhodo aur Allah ka naam lo, to jo wo tumhare liye pakde use khaao, aur agar wo khud khaaye, to na khaao, kyunki usne to sirf apne liye pakda.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Aap kya farmaate hain agar humare kutton mein doosre kutte mil jaayen?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumne to sirf apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya tha, doosre par nahi liya.'" Sufyan ne kaha: Main isse khaana napasand karta hoon. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek shikaar aur zibah ke jaanwar ke baare mein isi par amal hai ke agar wo paani mein gir jaayen, to na khaaya jaaye. Aur kuch ne kaha: Zibah ke jaanwar ke baare mein, agar uski gardan kaati jaaye aur wo paani mein gir kar mar jaaye, to use khaaya jaaye, aur ye Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka us kutte ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jo shikaar mein se khaaye, zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Agar kutta usmein se khaaye, to na khaao. Aur ye Sufyan, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne usmein se khaane ki rukhsat di, chahe kutta usmein se khaaye.

e: Narrated Busr Bin Artah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The hands are not cut in the battles."
hi: Busr bin Artah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jung mein haath nahi kaate jaate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ibn Lahi'ah ke siwa doosron ne bhi isi isnad se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur kaha jaata hai Busr bin Abi Artah bhi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, unmein Al-Awza'i shaamil hain, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo maante hain ke jung mein dushman ke saamne hadd laagu na ki jaaye, is darr se ke jispar hadd laagu ki jaaye wo dushman se ja mile. Jab imam dushman ki sarzameen se nikal kar Islam ke ilaqe mein laut aaye, to jisne khata ki ho uspar hadd laagu kare. Isi tarah Al-Awza'i ne kaha.

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:That a man from his people hunted a rabbit or two and slaughtered them with Marwah. Then he hung them up until he met the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so he asked him about that, and he (ﷺ) told him to eat them
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke unki qaum ke ek aadmi ne khargosh ya do khargosh shikaar kiye, unhein ek patthar se zibah kiya, phir unhein latka liya yahan tak ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mile, to unhon ne unse pucha, to unhon ne unhein khaane ka hukum diya. Is mauzu par Muhammad bin Safwan, Rafi, aur Adiyy bin Hatim se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne patthar se zibah karne ki rukhsat di hai aur khargosh khaane mein koi harj nahi maana, aur ye zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, aur kuch ne khargosh khaana napasand kiya. Aur Ash-Sha'bi ke saathiyon ka is hadith ki riwayat mein ikhtilaaf hai, Dawud bin Abi Hind ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Muhammad bin Safwan se riwayat ki. Aur Aasim Al-Ahwal ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Safwan bin Muhammad ya Muhammad bin Safwan se riwayat ki. Aur Muhammad bin Safwan zyada sahih hai. Aur Jabir Al-Ju'fi ne Ash-Sha'bi se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Qatadah ki, Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat jaisi riwayat ki, aur ho sakta hai Ash-Sha'bi ki riwayat donon se ho. Muhammad ne kaha: Ash-Sha'bi ki, Jabir se, hadith mehfooz nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda':"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating the Mujath-thamah, and it is what is trapped and killed by arrows
hi: Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujaththamah khaane se mana kiya, aur wo hai jise teer se rok kar maara jaaye." Is mauzu par Irbad bin Sariyah, Anas, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Jabir, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ad-Darda ki hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Umm Habibah bint Al-'Irbad:From her father: "On the day of Khaibar, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating the meat of every predator that has canine teeth, the meat of every bird that has talons, the meat of the domestic donkey, the Mujath-thamah, the Khalisah, and from having relations with a pregnant slave until she gives birth to what is in her womb." Muhammad bin Yahya said: "Abu 'Asim was asked about Mujath-thamah and he said: "To ensnare a bird or something and then shoot it." He was asked about Khalisah, so he said: "(Prey) that a man finds with a wolf or a predator, then he takes it from him but it dies in his hand before it can be slaughtered
hi: Umm Habibah bint Al-Irbad apne walid se riwayat karti hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din har naab waale darinde ka gosht, har panjewale parinde ka gosht, palaltu gadhon ka gosht, mujaththamah, khaleesah, aur hamla laundiyon ke saath sambhog karne se, jab tak wo bachcha jan na den, mana kiya. Muhammad bin Yahya ne kaha: Abu Aasim se mujaththamah ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhon ne kaha: Ye ke parinde ya kisi cheez ko khada karke usspar teer maara jaaye. Aur khaleesah ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: Bhediya ya darinda jise aadmi pakad le aur usse cheen le, phir wo uske haath mein zibah se pehle hi mar jaaye.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited taking a living thing as a shooting target
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke kisi jaandaar cheez ko nishaana banaaya jaaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Slaughtering the fetus is (achieved by) the slaughtering of its mother
hi: Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jenin ka zibah uski maa ke zibah se hi ho jaata hai." Is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Umamah, Abu Ad-Darda, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abu Al-Waddak ka naam Jabr bin Nauf hai.

e: Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported from 'Asim, from Abu Razin, from Ibn 'Abbas who said:"Whoever has relations with beast, then there is no legal punishment for him."
hi: Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Aasim se, Abu Razin se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Jo kisi jaanwar ke saath ghalat kaam kare, uspar koi hadd nahi. Ye hadith Muhammad bin Bashshar ne humein bataayi, unhon ne kaha: Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne humein bataya. Aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Jabir:"On the Day of Khaibar, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating domesticated donkeys, the meat of mules, every predator that possesses canine teeth, and every bird that possesses talons
hi: Jabir ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne - yani Khaibar ke din - palaltu gadhe, khachchar ka gosht, aur har naab waale darinde aur har panjewale parinde ko haraam kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Irbad bin Sariyah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited every predator that possesses canine teeth
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har naab waale darinde ko haraam kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Ikrimah:That 'Ali burnt some people who apostasized from Islam. This news reached Ibn 'Abbas, so he said: "If it were me I would have killed them according to the statement of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever changes his religion then kill him.' And I would not have burned them because the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Do not punish with the punishment of Allah.' So this reached 'Ali, and he said: "Ibn 'Abbas has told the truth."
hi: Ikrimah se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kuch logon ko jala diya jo Islam se murtad ho gaye the, to ye baat Ibn Abbas tak pahunchi, to unhon ne kaha: "Agar main hota, to main unhein qatl kar deta, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki wajah se: 'Jo apna deen badle, use qatl karo.' Lekin main unhein jalaata nahi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki wajah se: 'Allah ke azaab se azaab mat do.'" To ye baat Ali (Alayhis Salam) tak pahunchi, to unhon ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas ne sach kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek murtad ke baare mein isi par amal hai. Aur unka aurat ke murtad hone ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ahl-e-ilm ki jamaat ne kaha: Use qatl kiya jaaye, aur ye Al-Awza'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur unmein se kuch ne kaha: Use qaid kiya jaaye, qatl nahi kiya jaaye, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Kufa waalon ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-'Ushara':From his father that he said: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is there no slaughtering except upon the neck and the throat ?' He said: 'If you stab its thigh it would be accepted to you
hi: Abu Al-Ushara apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kya zibah sirf gale aur galay ke gaddhe mein hi hota hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar tum uski jaangh mein hi bhonk do, to bhi tumhare liye kaafi hoga.'" Ahmad bin Mani ne kaha: Yazid bin Harun ne kaha: Ye majboori ki halat mein hai. Is mauzu par Rafi bin Khadij se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Hammad bin Salamah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur humein Abu Al-Ushara ki, apne walid se, is hadith ke siwa koi aur riwayat maloom nahi. Aur Abu Al-Ushara ke naam mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch kehte hain unka naam Usamah bin Qihtim hai, aur kaha jaata hai Yasar bin Barz, aur kaha jaata hai Ibn Balz, aur kaha jaata hai unka naam Utarid hai, apne dada ki taraf mansoob.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever kills a gecko in one strike, he has such and such reward, and if he kills it on the second strike, he will have such and such reward, and if he kills it on the third strike, then he has such and such reward
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo pehli maar mein chhipkali maare, uske liye itni-itni neki hai, aur agar wo use doosri maar mein maare, to uske liye itni-itni neki hai, aur agar wo use teesri maar mein maare, to uske liye itni-itni neki hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Sa'd, Aishah, aur Umm Shareek se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Kill snakes and kill Dhut-Tufyatain and Al-Abtar, because they blind the sight and cause abortions of fetuses
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Saanpon ko maaro, aur Zut-Tufyatain aur Al-Abtar ko maaro, kyunki wo nazar cheenne ki koshish karte hain aur hamal girate hain." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, Abu Hurairah, aur Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Umar se, Abu Lubabah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne iske baad gharon ke saanpon ko maarne se mana kiya, jinhein "Awaamir" kaha jaata hai, aur Ibn Umar se, Zaid bin Al-Khattab se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Saanpon ko maarne mein sirf us saanp ko maarna napasand kiya jaata hai jo patla ho, jaise chandi ho, aur chalte waqt lachakta na ho.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "If a man says to another man: 'O you Jew' then beat him twenty times. If he says: 'O you effeminate' then beat him twenty times. And whoever has relations with someone that is a Mahram then kill him."
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab koi aadmi kisi doosre aadmi se kahe 'Ae Yahudi!' to use bees koda maaro, aur jab wo kahe 'Ae mukhannath!' to use bees koda maaro, aur jo kisi mahram rishtedaar ke saath ghalat kaam kare, use qatl karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Ibrahim bin Isma'il hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur humare saathiyon ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Jo mahram rishtedaar ke paas jaanbujh kar jaaye, uspar qatl hai. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Jo apni maa se nikah kare, use qatl kiya jaaye. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Jo mahram rishtedaar ke saath ghalat kaam kare, use qatl kiya jaaye. Aur Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hai, Al-Bara bin Aazib aur Qurrah bin Iyas Al-Muzani ne riwayat ki ke ek aadmi ne apne waalid ki biwi se nikah kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne use qatl karne ka hukum diya.

e: Narrated Abu Laila:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When a snake appears in your dwellings then say to it: We ask you - by covenant of Nuh, and by the covenant of Sulaiman bin Dawud - that you do not harm us.' If it returns, then kill it
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Abu Laila ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab ghar mein saanp nazar aaye, to usse kaho: 'Hum tumhein Nuh ke ahd aur Sulaiman bin Dawud ke ahd ki qasam dete hain ke tum humein takleef mat do.' Agar wo dobara aaye, to use maar do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Thabit Al-Bunani ki hadith mein sirf isi tareeqe se, Ibn Abi Laila ki hadith se, jaante hain.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If it were not that dogs were part of a nation among the nations, then I would order to that all of them be killed. So kill every one of them that is all black
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar kutte ek qaum na hote, to main sabko qatl karne ka hukum deta, to unmein se har us kutte ko maaro jo bilkul kaala ho." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Jabir, Abu Rafi, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch hadith mein riwayat hai ke "kaala kutta Shaitan hai." Aur kaala kutta wo hai jismein safed rang ka koi hissa na ho. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaale kutte ke shikaar ko napasand kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever keeps a dog" - or: "acquires a dog" - "neither of hunting nor to guard livestock, then two Qirat are deducted from his reward, daily
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo aisa kutta rakhe jo na shikaari ho na maweshiyon ki hifazat karne wala, uske ajr se har din do qirat kam ho jaate hain." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mughaffal, Abu Hurairah, aur Sufyan bin Abi Zuhair se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Ya kheti ki hifazat waala kutta."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered killing dogs, except for the hunting dog, or the dog that guards livestock." It was said to him: "Abu Hurairah would say: 'or a farm dog' so he (Ibn 'Umar) said: "Abu Hurairah had a farm
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, siwaye shikaari kutte ya maweshiyon ki hifazat karne wale kutte ke. Unhon ne kaha: Unse kaha gaya: "Abu Hurairah kehte the: 'Ya kheti ki hifazat waala kutta.'" To unhon ne kaha: "Abu Hurairah ke paas kheti thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal:"I was one of those who held up the branches from the tree away from the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was delivering the Khutbah saying: 'If it were not that dogs were a nation among nations, then I would order that they be killed. So kill every one among them that is all black. There is one inhabiting a home in which they keep a dog but their deeds are decreased by one Qirat every day - except for a hunting dog, or a farm dog, or a sheep dog
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne kaha: "Main un logon mein se tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke chehre se ped ki shaakhein hataate the jabke wo khutba de rahe the, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar kutte ek qaum na hote, to main unhein qatl karne ka hukum deta, to unmein se har us kutte ko maaro jo bilkul kaala ho. Aur koi bhi ghar wala kutta paalta hai magar unke amal se har din ek qirat kam ho jaata hai, siwaye shikaari kutte, kheti ki hifazat waale kutte, ya bakriyon ki hifazat waale kutte ke.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur ye hadith Al-Hasan se, Abdullah bin Mughaffal se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever acquires a dog - with the exception of a dog to guard livestock, a hunting dog, or a farm dog - each day a Qirat is deducted from his reward
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kutta paale, siwaye maweshiyon ki hifazat waale, shikaari, ya kheti ki hifazat waale kutte ke, uske ajr se har din ek qirat kam hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ata bin Abi Rabah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne kutta rakhne ki rukhsat di, chahe aadmi ke paas sirf ek bakri ho.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I shoot some game and then find my arrow in it the next day.' He said: 'If you know that your arrow killed it, and you dont see any marks of predators, then eat it.'"
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main shikaar par teer chalaata hoon, phir agle din usmein apna teer paata hoon.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tumhein maloom ho ke tumhare teer ne use maara hai aur usmein kisi darinde ka nishaan na ho, to khaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abu Bishr aur Abdul-Malik bin Maisarah se, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Adiyy bin Hatim se riwayat ki, aur donon hadithein sahih hain. Is mauzu par Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim:"I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about hunting, so he said: 'Mention Allah's Name when you shoot your arrow. Then, if you find it dead, eat from it, unless you found that it has fallen in (some body of) water. Then do not eat it, for you do not know if the water killed it, or your arrow.'"
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaar ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Jab tum apna teer chalaao, to Allah ka naam lo, agar tumhein wo maara hua mile, to khaao, siwaye is ke ke tumhein wo paani mein gira hua mile, to na khaao, kyunki tumhein nahi maloom ke paani ne use maara ya tumhare teer ne.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A human does no action from the actions on the day of Nahr more beloved to Allah then spilling blood (of sacrificial animals). On the Day of Judgement, it will appear with its horns, and hair, and hooves, and indeed the blood will be accepted by Allah from where it is received before it even falls upon earth, so let your heart delight in it
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahr ke din insaan koi aisa amal nahi karta jo Allah ko khoon bahaane se zyada pasand ho. Wo Qayamat ke din apne seengon, baalon, aur khuron ke saath aayega, aur khoon zameen par girne se pehle hi Allah ke yahan ek jagah rakh diya jaata hai, to isse apna dil khush karo." Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain aur Zaid bin Arqam se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Hisham bin Urwah ki hadith mein sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abu Al-Muthanna ka naam Sulaiman bin Yazid hai, unse Ibn Abi Fudaik ne riwayat ki hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Qurbani mein uske malik ke liye har baal ke badle ek neki hai." Aur ye bhi riwayat hai "uske seengon ke badle."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered two horned male sheep which were mostly white. He slaughtered them with his hand and mentioned Allah's Name, and he said 'Allahu Akbar', and put his foot on their side
hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do seengwale, zyada tar safed mendhon ki qurbani ki, unhein apne haath se zibah kiya, Allah ka naam liya, Takbir kahi, aur apna paaon unke pehlu par rakha. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Aishah, Abu Hurairah, Abu Ayyub, Jabir, Abu Ad-Darda, Abu Rafi, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Bakrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Hanash:That 'Ali used to slaughter two male sheep, one for the Prophet (ﷺ) and the other for himself. When this was mentioned to him, he said: "He ordered me to" - meaning the Prophet (ﷺ) - "So I will never leave it
hi: Hanash se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) do mendhe qurbani karte the, ek Nabi (SAW) ki taraf se aur doosra apni taraf se, to unse iske baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne mujhe iska hukum diya" - yani Nabi (SAW) ne - "to main ise kabhi na chhodunga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Shareek ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne mayyat ki taraf se qurbani karne ki rukhsat di hai, aur kuch ne isse jaayez nahi maana. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Mujhe zyada pasand hai ke uski taraf se sadqa kiya jaaye aur qurbani na ki jaaye, aur agar qurbani ki jaaye, to usmein se kuch na khaaya jaaye, balki poori sadqa kar di jaaye. Muhammad ne kaha: Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Ise Shareek ke siwa doosron ne bhi riwayat ki hai. Maine unse pucha: Abu Al-Hasna ka naam kya hai? To unhein maloom nahi tha. Muslim ne kaha: Unka naam Al-Hasan hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered a horned male ram of fine pedigree, (around) his mouth was black, and his legs were black, and (around) his eyes was black
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek seengwale, achi nasal ke mendhe ki qurbani ki, jo kaale mun se khaata, kaale pairon se chalta, aur kaali aankhon se dekhta tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Hafs bin Ghiyath ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda':"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating the Mujath-thamah, and it is what is trapped and killed by arrows."
hi: Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujaththamah khaane se mana kiya, aur wo hai jise teer se rok kar maara jaaye." Is mauzu par Irbad bin Sariyah, Anas, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Jabir, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ad-Darda ki hadith ghareeb hai.

e:
Narrated Umm Habibah bint Al-'Irbad:From her father: "On the day of Khaibar, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited eating the meat of every predator that has canine teeth, the meat of every bird that has talons, the meat of the domestic donkey, the Mujath-thamah, the Khalisah, and from having relations with a pregnant slave until she gives birth to what is in her womb."
Muhammad bin Yahya said: "Abu 'Asim was asked about Mujath-thamah and he said: "To ensnare a bird or something and then shoot it." He was asked about Khalisah, so he said: "(Prey) that a man finds with a wolf or a predator, then he takes it from him but it dies in his hand before it can be slaughtered."
hi: Umm Habibah bint Al-Irbad apne walid se riwayat karti hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din har naab waale darinde ka gosht, har panjewale parinde ka gosht, palaltu gadhon ka gosht, mujaththamah, khaleesah, aur hamla laundiyon ke saath sambhog karne se, jab tak wo bachcha jan na den, mana kiya. Muhammad bin Yahya ne kaha: Abu Aasim se mujaththamah ke baare mein pucha gaya, unhon ne kaha: Ye ke parinde ya kisi cheez ko khada karke usspar teer maara jaaye. Aur khaleesah ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: Bhediya ya darinda jise aadmi pakad le aur usse cheen le, phir wo uske haath mein zibah se pehle hi mar jaaye.

e: Narrated Abu Kibash:"I brought a Jadha' sheep to Al-Madinah (for sale) but it remained with me. I saw Abu Hurairah and I asked him about it, so he said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "The best male" - or - "female Udhiyah is that from the Jadha' sheep." He said: "So the people took note of that (they became interested in buying)
hi: Abu Kibash ne kaha: "Main Madina ek saal ki jaz' bakriyaan laaya, lekin wo mere paas hi reh gayin. Maine Abu Hurairah se mulaqat ki aur unse pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Jaz' bhed sabse achi qurbani hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To log usspar toot pade." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Umm Bilal bint Hilal apne walid se, Jabir, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye Abu Hurairah se mauqoof bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Uthman bin Waqid, Muhammad bin Ziyad bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Al-Khattab ke bete hain. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke bhed ka jaz' qurbani mein kaafi hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Slaughtering the fetus is (achieved by) the slaughtering of its mother."
hi: Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jenin ka zibah uski maa ke zibah se hi ho jaata hai." Is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Umamah, Abu Ad-Darda, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqe se bhi Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hui hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Abu Al-Waddak ka naam Jabr bin Nauf hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey when the (Day of) Adha came, so we shared seven for a cow and ten for a camel
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, to Adha ka waqt aa gaya, to humne gaay mein saat aur oont mein das log shareek kiye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Al-Aswad As-Sulami apne walid se, apne dada se, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Fadl bin Musa ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Jabir:"We performed the Nahr (sacrifice) with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Al-Hudaibiyyah: A camel for seven (persons) and a cow for seven (persons)
hi: Jabir ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiyah mein badanah saat ke liye aur gaay saat ke liye zibah ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Oont das ke liye bhi kaafi hai, aur unhon ne Ibn Abbas ki hadith se dalil li.

e: Narrated Hujayyah bin 'Adi:"Ali said: 'A cow is for seven.' I said: "And if it gives birth?' He said: 'Then slaughter its offspring with it.' I said: 'What if it is lame?' He said: 'When it has reached the place of ritual.' I said: 'What if it has a broken horn?' He said: 'There is no harm, we were ordered' - or - 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered us, to check the two eyes and the two ears
hi: Hujayyah bin Adiyy ne kaha: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: 'Gaay saat ke liye hai.' Maine kaha: 'Aur agar wo bachcha jane?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Uske bachche ko bhi usi ke saath zibah karo.' Maine kaha: 'Aur langdi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Jab wo zibah ki jagah tak pahunch jaaye.' Maine kaha: 'Aur toota hua seeng?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Koi harj nahi, humein hukum diya gaya' - ya 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya' - 'ke hum aankhon aur kaanon ko achi tarah dekhen.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ise Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne bhi Salamah bin Kuhail se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited that an animal with a A'dab (stump) horn or ear should be slaughtered as a sacrifice." Qatadah (one of the narrators) said: "So I mentioned this to Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab and he said: 'The A'dab is that which equals or more than that
hi: Jurayy bin Kulaib An-Nahdi, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aisi qurbani ki jaaye jiska seeng ya kaan aadha ya usse zyada kata ho." Qatadah ne kaha: To maine ye baat Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se zikr ki, to unhon ne kaha: "Adab wo hai jo aadhe ya usse zyada tak pahunch jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Ata bin Yasar:"I asked Abu Abyub [Al-Ansari] how the slaughtering was done during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: 'A man would sacrifice a sheep for himself and the people in his household. They would eat from it and feed others, until the people (later) would boast about it and it became as you see now
hi: Ata bin Yasar ne kaha: "Maine Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari se pucha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein qurbaniyaan kaisi hoti thin? To unhon ne kaha: 'Aadmi apni aur apne ghar walon ki taraf se ek bakri qurbani karta, wo khaate aur doosron ko khilaate, yahan tak ke log isme fakhr karne lage, to ye waisa ban gaya jaisa tum dekhte ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Umarah bin Abdullah, Madina ke hain, Malik bin Anas ne unse riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne ek mendhe ki qurbani ki aur farmaya: "Ye us ke liye jo meri Ummat mein se qurbani na kar sake." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Bakri sirf ek jaan ke liye kaafi hai, aur ye Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak aur doosre ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Jabalah bin Suhaim :That a man asked Ibn 'Umar about the Udhiyah, "Is it obligatory?" So he said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed the Udhiyah as did the Muslims." He repeated the question. So he said: "Do you understand ?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered as did the Muslims
hi: Jabalah bin Suhaim se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Ibn Umar se qurbani ke baare mein pucha, "Kya ye wajib hai?" To unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Musalmanon ne qurbani ki." Usne dobara pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Kya tum samajhte ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur Musalmanon ne qurbani ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke qurbani wajib nahi, balki wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnaton mein se ek Sunnat hai jise amal mein laana mustahab hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar :"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stayed in Al-Madinah for ten years performing the Udhiyah
hi: Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina mein das saal thehre, qurbani karte rahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib :"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivered a sermon to us on the Day of Nahr and he said: 'None of you should slaughter until he performs the Salat." He said: 'So my maternal uncle stood and said: ' O Messenger of Allah, this is the day in which meat is disliked, and I hastened my sacrifice to feed my family and the people of my dwellings - or - 'my neighbors.' He said: 'Repeat your slaughter with another.' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) I have a she-kid that has better meat than my sheep, should I slaughter it?' He said: 'Yes, and it is better and it will suffice for you, but a Jadha' will not be accepted after you
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr ke din khutba diya aur farmaya: 'Tum mein se koi tab tak zibah na kare jab tak wo namaz na padh le.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To mere mamu khade hue aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Ye wo din hai jismein gosht napasand kiya jaata hai, aur maine apni qurbani jaldi kar li taake apne ghar walon aur apne ghar ke logon' - ya 'apne padosiyon' - 'ko khila saku.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To phir ek aur zibah karo.' Usne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Mere paas doodh waali bakri ka bachcha hai jo do gosht wali bakriyon se behtar hai, kya main use zibah kar loon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Haan, aur wo tumhari donon qurbaniyon mein se behtar hai, lekin tumhare baad kisi ke liye jaz' kaafi nahi hoga.'" Is mauzu par Jabir, Jundab, Anas, Uwaimir bin Ashqar, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Zaid Al-Ansari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke shehar mein tab tak qurbani na ki jaaye jab tak Imam namaz na padh le. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne gaanv waalon ko subah sadiq ke waqt zibah karne ki rukhsat di hai, aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ijma hai ke bakri ka jaz' kaafi nahi, wo kehte hain: Jaz' sirf bhed mein se kaafi hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "None of you should eat from the meat of his sacrificial animal beyond three days
hi: Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apni qurbani ka gosht teen din se zyada na khaaye." Is mauzu par Aishah aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye mana Nabi (SAW) ki taraf se pehle tha, phir baad mein isme rukhsat di gayi.

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Buraidah:From his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "I used to prohibit you from (eating) the meat of Sacrifice beyond three days so that those who have the ability would give to those who do not have it. So (now) eat as you like, feed others, and save from it
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qurbani ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya tha taake maal daar tangdast ki madad kar sake, ab jo tumhein achha lage khaao, khilaao, aur zakheera karo." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, Nubaishah, Abu Sa'eed, Qatadah bin An-Nu'man, Anas, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Buraidah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated 'Abis bin Rabi'ah:"I said to the Mother of the Believers: 'Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibit from the meat of the sacrifice?' She said: 'No, but only a few people could slaughter, so he liked that they feed those who did not slaughter. (Later) we would store a leg to eat after ten days
hi: Aabis bin Rabi'ah ne kaha: "Maine Ummul-Momineen se kaha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) qurbani ke gosht se mana karte the?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Nahi, lekin log kam qurbani karte the, to unhon ne pasand kiya ke jinhon ne qurbani nahi ki unhein khilaaya jaaye, aur hum to paaon rakh dete the aur das din baad khaate the.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ummul-Momineen, Aishah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi hain, aur ye hadith unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There is no Fara' or 'Atirah." The Fara' is the first of the offspring that would be born to them, so they would slaughter it. The 'Atirah was an animal that they would slaughter during Rajab to honor the month of Rajab, since it was the first of the sacred months
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na fara hai na atirah." Aur fara pehli paidaish hai jo unke liye paida hoti thi, to wo use zibah karte the. Is mauzu par Nubaishah, Mikhnaf bin Sulaim, aur Abu Al-Ushara apne walid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur atirah wo zabh thi jo wo Rajab mein karte the, Rajab ke mahine ki izzat karte hue kyunki ye Hurmat waale mahinon mein se pehla mahina hai, aur Hurmat waale mahine Rajab, Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah, aur Muharram hain, aur Hajj ke mahine Shawwal, Dhul-Qa'dah, aur Dhul-Hijjah ke das din hain, isi tarah Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron se Hajj ke mahinon ke baare mein riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Yusuf bin Mahak:They entered upon Hafsah bint 'Abdur-Rahman to ask her about the 'Aqiqah. She informed them that 'Aishah had informed her, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered them that for a boy, two sheep were sufficient, and for a girl one sheep
hi: Yusuf bin Mahak se riwayat hai ke wo Hafsah bint Abdur-Rahman ke paas gaye aur unse Aqiqah ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne unhein bataya ke Aishah ne unhein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke larke ki taraf se do barabar bakriyaan aur larki ki taraf se ek bakri. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Umm Kurz, Buraidah, Samurah, Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Amr, Anas, Salman bin Aamir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Hafsah, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq ki beti hain.

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi':That his father said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say the Adhan in the ear of Al-Hasan bin 'Ali - when he was born to Fatimah - the Adhan of Salat
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha ke jab Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) ne Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko paida kiya, to unhon ne unke kaan mein namaz ki Azaan di." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek Aqiqah mein isi par amal hai jo Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqon se riwayat hai, larke ki taraf se do barabar bakriyaan aur larki ki taraf se ek bakri. Aur Nabi (SAW) se ye bhi riwayat hai ke unhon ne Al-Hasan ki taraf se ek bakri se Aqiqah ki, aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi hadith ki taraf gaye hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered killing dogs, except for the hunting dog, or the dog that guards livestock." It was said to him: "Abu Hurairah would say: 'or a farm dog' so he (Ibn 'Umar) said: "Abu Hurairah had a farm."
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, siwaye shikaari kutte ya maweshiyon ki hifazat karne wale kutte ke. Unhon ne kaha: Unse kaha gaya: "Abu Hurairah kehte the: 'Ya kheti ki hifazat waala kutta.'" To unhon ne kaha: "Abu Hurairah ke paas kheti thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Umm Kurz:That she asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the 'Aqiqah. He said: "For the boy is two sheep, and for the girl is one, it will not harm you if they (i.e. the sheep) are male or female
hi: Umm Kurz se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Aqiqah ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Larke ki taraf se do bakriyaan aur larki ki taraf se ek, aur tumhein koi nuqsaan nahi chahe wo nar hon ya maada." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The best of Udhiyah (sacrifice) is a ram, and the best (burial) shroud is the Hullah
hi: Abu Umamah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen qurbani mendha hai, aur sabse behtareen kafan hullah hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ufair bin Ma'dan hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain.

e: Narrated Mikhnaf bin Sulaim:"We were standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at 'Arafat when I heard him say: 'O you people! For every household each year is Udhiyah (sacrifice) and 'Atirah. Do you know what an 'Atirah is ? It is that which you call Ar-Rajabiyyah
hi: Mikhnaf bin Sulaim ne kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath Arafat mein khade the, to maine unhein kehte suna: 'Ae logo! Har ghar wale par har saal ek qurbani aur atirah hai. Kya tumhein maloom hai atirah kya hai? Ye wo hai jise tum Rajabiyyah kehte ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Aun ki hadith mein isi tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin 'Ali bin Al-Husain:That Ali bin Abi Talib said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had the 'Aqiqah for Al-Hasan with one sheep, and said: 'O Fatimah! Shave his head and give the weight of his hair in silver as charity.'" He said: "So I weighed it, and it was the weight of a Dirham or a bit of a Dirham
hi: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain se riwayat hai ke Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Hasan ki taraf se ek bakri se Aqiqah ki, aur farmaya: 'Ae Fatimah (Alayhas Salam)! Uska sar mundwaao aur uske baal ke barabar chandi sadqa karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne use tola, to uska wazan ek dirham ya usse kuch kam tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad muttasil nahi. Aur Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko nahi paaya.

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah:From his father, that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave a Khutbah, then he descended and called for two rams and slaughtered them
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne khutba diya, phir utre aur do mendhe mangwaaye aur unhein zibah kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:"I attended the Eid Al-Adha' with the Prophet (ﷺ) at the Musalla. When he finished his Khutbah, he descended from his Minbar and was given a male sheep. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered it with his hand and said: 'Bismillah, Wa Allahu Akbar, this from me and whoever does not slaughter from my Ummah
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath Musalla mein Adha ke din hazir tha, jab unhon ne apna khutba poora kiya, to wo apne mimbar se utre, unke paas ek mendha laaya gaya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use apne haath se zibah kiya aur kaha: 'Bismillah wallahu Akbar, ye meri taraf se aur meri Ummat mein se jisne qurbani na ki ho uski taraf se.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke aadmi zibah karte waqt kahe "Bismillah wallahu Akbar," aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur Al-Muttalib bin Abdullah bin Hantab ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke unhon ne Jabir se suna nahi.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A human does no action from the actions on the day of Nahr more beloved to Allah then spilling blood (of sacrificial animals). On the Day of Judgement, it will appear with its horns, and hair, and hooves, and indeed the blood will be accepted by Allah from where it is received before it even falls upon earth, so let your heart delight in it."
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahr ke din insaan koi aisa amal nahi karta jo Allah ko khoon bahaane se zyada pasand ho. Wo Qayamat ke din apne seengon, baalon, aur khuron ke saath aayega, aur khoon zameen par girne se pehle hi Allah ke yahan ek jagah rakh diya jaata hai, to isse apna dil khush karo." Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain aur Zaid bin Arqam se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Hisham bin Urwah ki hadith mein sirf isi tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abu Al-Muthanna ka naam Sulaiman bin Yazid hai, unse Ibn Abi Fudaik ne riwayat ki hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Qurbani mein uske malik ke liye har baal ke badle ek neki hai." Aur ye bhi riwayat hai "uske seengon ke badle."

e: Narrated Umm Salamah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever sees the crescent of Dhul-Hijjah, and wants to slaughter a sacrifice he should not take from his hair nor from his nails
hi: Umm Salamah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo Dhul-Hijjah ka chaand dekhe aur qurbani karna chaahe, to wo apne baal aur naakhun na kaate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur sahih Amr bin Muslim hai, unse Muhammad bin Amr bin Alqamah aur kai doosron ne riwayat ki hai. Aur ye hadith Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Umm Salamah se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqe se bhi isi jaisi riwayat hui hai. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib qaayal the, aur isi hadith ki taraf Ahmad aur Ishaq gaye hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne isme rukhsat di, unhon ne kaha: Apne baal aur naakhun kaatne mein koi harj nahi. Aur ye Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai, unhon ne Aishah ki hadith se dalil li ke Nabi (SAW) Madina se Hadi bhejte the, aur wo un cheezon se nahi bachte the jinse Muhrim bachta hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There is no vowing for disobedience, and its atonement is the atonement of an oath
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gunaah ki mannat nahi hoti, aur uska kaffara qasam ka kaffara hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Jabir, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih nahi kyunki Az-Zuhri ne ye hadith Abu Salamah se nahi suni. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Kai logon ne, unmein Musa bin Uqbah aur Ibn Abi Atiq shaamil hain, Az-Zuhri se, Sulaiman bin Arqam se, Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur hadith yehi hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "There is no vowing in disobedience to Allah, and its atonement is the atonement of an oath
hi: Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Allah ki nafarmani mein mannat nahi hoti, aur uska kaffara qasam ka kaffara hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur ye Abu Safwan ki, Yunus se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Aur Abu Safwan Makki hain, unka naam Abdullah bin Sa'eed bin Abdul-Malik bin Marwan hai, unse Al-Humaidi aur ahl-e-hadith ke kai bade log riwayat karte hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Allah ki nafarmani mein mannat nahi hoti, aur uska kaffara qasam ka kaffara hai. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne Az-Zuhri ki, Abu Salamah se, Aishah se, hadith se dalil li. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: Nafarmani mein mannat nahi hoti aur usmein koi kaffara nahi. Aur ye Malik aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib:A Marfu' narration (from the Prophet (ﷺ)), saying: "A crippled animal whose limp is obvious is not to be slaughtered as sacrifice, nor an animal with a bad eye whose blindness is obvious, nor a sick animal whose sickness is obvious, nor an emaciated animal that has no marrow (in its bones)."
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se marfu' riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Aisi langdi qurbani nahi ki jaaye jiska langdapan zaahir ho, na kaani jiska aib zaahir ho, na bimaar jiski bimari zaahir ho, na dubli-patli jismein maghz na ho."

e: Narrated Thabit bin Adh-Dahhak:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "It is not for a person to vow about that over which he has no control
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Bande par us cheez ki mannat nahi jiska wo malik na ho." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Uqbah bin 'Amir:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The atonement of a vow when it is not specified is the atonement of an oath
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mannat mein kuch muqarrar na ho, to uska kaffara qasam ka kaffara hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "O 'Abdur-Rahman! Do not ask for a position of leadership, for if you receive it due to asking, you will be left alone with it, and if you receive it without asking, then you will be aided in it. And if you take an oath and you see that something else is better than it, then do what is better, and make an atonement for your oath
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Abdur-Rahman! Amaarat na maango, kyunki agar tumhein wo maangne se mile, to tum usi ke hawaale kar diye jaaoge, aur agar wo tumhein bina maange mile, to tumhein usmein madad milegi. Aur jab tum kisi baat par qasam khaao aur phir dekho ke usse behtar koi cheez hai, to jo behtar hai wo karo aur apni qasam ka kaffara ada karo." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Adiyy bin Hatim, Abu Ad-Darda, Anas, Aishah, Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Hurairah, Umm Salamah, aur Abu Musa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever takes an oath, and then he sees that something else is better than it, then he should make atonement for his oath and then do it
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo kisi baat par qasam khaaye, phir dekhe ke usse behtar koi doosri cheez hai, to wo apni qasam ka kaffara ada kare aur wo behtar cheez kare." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke qasam todne se pehle kaffara kaafi hota hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Sirf qasam todne ke baad hi kaffara diya jaaye. Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Agar wo qasam todne ke baad kaffara de, to mujhe zyada pasand hai, aur agar qasam todne se pehle kaffara de, to bhi kaafi hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever swears about an oath and says: 'If Allah wills (Insha Allah), then there is no breaking of the oath against him
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi baat par qasam khaaye aur kahe 'Insha Allah,' to usne istisna kar liya, uspar koi qasam todne ki zimmedaari nahi." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Ubaidullah bin Umar aur doosron ne ise Nafi se, Ibn Umar se mauqoof riwayat ki hai. Isi tarah Salim se, Ibn Umar se mauqoof riwayat hui hai. Aur humein maloom nahi ke Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani ke siwa kisi ne ise marfu' kiya ho, aur Isma'il bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Ayyub kabhi ise marfu' karte the aur kabhi nahi karte the. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke agar istisna qasam se juda ho, to uspar koi qasam todne ki zimmedaari nahi, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Al-Awza'i, Malik bin Anas, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever swears [about an oath] and says: 'If Allah wills (Insha Allah), then he will not have broken it
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi baat par qasam khaaye aur kahe 'Insha Allah,' to uski qasam nahi tootegi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Isma'il se iske baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith ghalat hai, Abdur-Razzaq ne ismein galti ki, unhon ne ise Ma'mar ki, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, is hadith se mukhtasar kar diya, unhon ne farmaya: "Sulaiman bin Dawud ne kaha: Aaj raat main sattar auraton ke paas jaaunga, har aurat ek larka paida karegi. To wo unke paas gaye, lekin unmein se sirf ek aurat ne aadha bachcha paida kiya." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar unhon ne 'Insha Allah' kaha hota, to jaisa unhon ne kaha waisa hi hota." Isi tarah Abdur-Razzaq se, Ma'mar se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se ye poori hadith riwayat hui hai, aur usmein "sattar auraton" kaha gaya hai. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Sulaiman bin Dawud ne kaha: Aaj raat main sau auraton ke paas jaaunga."

e: Narrated Salim:From his father (Ibn 'Umar) that the Prophet (ﷺ) heard 'Umar saying: "By my father, By my father!" So he said: "Verily Allah prohibits you from swearing by your father." So 'Umar said: "By Allah I did not swear by him after that, neither intentionally nor in narrating
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain, Nabi (SAW) ne Umar ko kehte suna: "Mere waalid ki qasam, mere waalid ki qasam!" To unhon ne farmaya: "Suno! Allah tumhein apne waalidon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai." To Umar ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Iske baad maine kabhi bhi iski qasam nahi khayi, na jaanbujh kar na kisi ki baat naqal karte hue." Is mauzu par Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Qutailah, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Ubaid ne kaha: Unke qaul "na kisi ki baat naqal karte hue" ka matlab hai: maine kisi doosre se ise naqal nahi kiya, yani maine kisi doosre se ise zikr nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came across 'Umar while he was on his mount, and he was swearing by his father. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Verily Allah prohibits you from swearing by your fathers. So let the one who swears, swear by Allah, or be silent
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umar ke paas pahunche jabke wo ek qaafile mein the aur apne waalid ki qasam khaa rahe the, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein apne waalidon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai, jo qasam khaana chaahe wo Allah ki qasam khaaye ya khaamosh rahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Sa'd bin 'Ubaidah:That Ibn 'Umar heard a man saying: "No by the Ka'bah" so Ibn 'Umar said: "Nothing is sworn by other than Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: 'Whoever swears by other than Allah, he has committed disbelief or shirk
hi: Sa'd bin Ubaidah se riwayat hai ke Ibn Umar ne ek aadmi ko kehte suna: "Nahi, Ka'bah ki qasam." To Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam nahi khayi jaati, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam khaaye, usne kufr kiya ya shirk kiya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne is hadith ki tafseer ki ke unke qaul "usne kufr kiya ya shirk kiya" ka matlab sakhti/taakeed hai. Aur iski dalil Ibn Umar ki hadith hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Umar ko kehte suna: "Mere waalid ki qasam, mere waalid ki qasam!" To unhon ne farmaya: "Suno! Allah tumhein apne waalidon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai." Aur Abu Hurairah ki, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo apni qasam mein 'Laat aur Uzza ki qasam' kahe, wo 'La ilaha illallah' kahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye waisi hi baat hai jaisi Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Riya shirk hai." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne is Ayat ki tafseer ki: "(Aur jo apne Rab se milne ki ummeed rakhta ho, to wo nek amal kare)," unhon ne kaha: Riya na kare.

e: Narrated Anas:"A Woman vowed to walk to the House of Allah, so the Prophet (ﷺ) asked about that, and he said: 'Verily Allah is in no need of her walking, order her to ride
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aurat ne Allah ke ghar tak paidal chalne ki mannat maani, to Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah ko uske paidal chalne ki koi zaroorat nahi, use hukum do ke wo sawaari kare.'" Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar koi aurat paidal chalne ki mannat maane, to wo sawaari kare aur ek bakri Hadi ke taur par de.

e: Narrated 'Ata bin Yasar:"I asked Abu Abyub  how the slaughtering was done during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: 'A man would sacrifice a sheep for himself and the people in his household. They would eat from it and feed others, until the people (later) would boast about it and it became as you see now."
hi: Ata bin Yasar ne kaha: "Maine Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari se pucha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein qurbaniyaan kaisi hoti thin? To unhon ne kaha: 'Aadmi apni aur apne ghar walon ki taraf se ek bakri qurbani karta, wo khaate aur doosron ko khilaate, yahan tak ke log isme fakhr karne lage, to ye waisa ban gaya jaisa tum dekhte ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Umarah bin Abdullah, Madina ke hain, Malik bin Anas ne unse riwayat ki hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne ek mendhe ki qurbani ki aur farmaya: "Ye us ke liye jo meri Ummat mein se qurbani na kar sake." Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Bakri sirf ek jaan ke liye kaafi hai, aur ye Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak aur doosre ahl-e-ilm ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not vow, for the vows does not prevent what is decreed at all, and it only causes the miser to spend (of his wealth)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mannat mat maano, kyunki mannat taqdeer mein kuch nahi badalti, isse to bas kanjoos se maal nikalwaya jaata hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne mannat napasand ki. Aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne kaha: Napasandeegi ka matlab hai itaa'at aur nafarmani, dono mein mannat, aur agar aadmi itaa'at ki mannat maane aur use poora kare, to usmein uske liye ajr hai, lekin mannat khud napasand ki jaati hai.

e: Narrated 'Umar:"I said:'O Messenger of Allah! I had vowed to perform I'tikaf in Al-Masjid Al-Haram for a night during the era of Jahiliyyah.' He said: 'Fulfill your vow
hi: Umar ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine Jahiliyyah mein Masjid-e-Haram mein ek raat ke liye e'tikaaf ki mannat maani thi.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apni mannat poori karo.'" Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi hadith ki taraf gaye hain, unhon ne kaha: Agar aadmi Islam qabool kare aur uspar itaa'at ki mannat baaki ho, to use poora kare. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ne kaha: E'tikaaf sirf roze ke saath hota hai. Aur doosre ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: E'tikaaf karne wale par roza zaroori nahi, siwaye is ke ke wo khud apne aap par roza farz kare. Aur unhon ne Umar ki hadith se dalil li ke unhon ne Jahiliyyah mein ek raat e'tikaaf ki mannat maani thi, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein use poora karne ka hukum diya. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Salim bin 'Abdullah:From this father (Ibn Umar) who said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) often would swear with this oath: 'No! By the Changer of the Hearts
hi: Salim bin Abdullah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aksar is qasam se qasam khaate the: 'Nahi, dilon ko palatne waale ki qasam!'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:"I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Whoever frees a believing slave, then Allah frees a limb from the Fire for each of his limbs, such that he frees his private parts in lieu of his private parts
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jo koi Momin gulam azaad kare, Allah uske badle uske har ang ke liye uska ek ang aag se azaad karega, yahan tak ke uski sharamgah ke badle uski sharamgah azaad karega.'" Is mauzu par Aishah, Amr bin Absah, Ibn Abbas, Wathilah bin Al-Asqa, Abu Umamah, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Ka'b bin Murrah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Ibn Al-Had ka naam Yazid bin Abdullah bin Usamah bin Al-Had hai, wo Madina ke thiqah hain, unse Malik bin Anas aur ahl-e-ilm ke kai logon ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Muqarrin Al-Muzani:"We were seven brothers without a servant except one, and one of us slapped her, so the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to free her
hi: Suwaid bin Muqarrin Al-Muzani ne kaha: "Maine humein saat bhai dekha, humare paas sirf ek khidmatgaar thi, to humein se ek ne usse thappad maara, to Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum usse azaad kar den." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kai logon ne ye hadith Husain bin Abdur-Rahman se riwayat ki, unmein se kuch ne hadith mein zikr kiya: "Usne uske chehre par maara."

e: Narrated Thabit bin Adh-Dahhak:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam while lying, then he is as he said
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Islam ke siwa kisi doosre deen ki jhoothi qasam khaaye, wo waisa hi ho jaata hai jaisa usne kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka is baare mein ikhtilaaf hai jab aadmi Islam ke siwa kisi deen ki qasam khaaye aur kahe "Main Yahudi hoon ya Nasrani hoon agar maine aisa aisa kiya," phir wo aisa kaam kare, to kuch ne kaha: Usne bada gunaah kiya, lekin uspar koi kaffara nahi, aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, isi ke Malik bin Anas qaayal hain, aur Abu Ubaid isi taraf gaye hain.
