Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een, aur doosron, ne kaha: Uspar kaffara hai, aur ye Sufyan, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Uqbah bin 'Amir:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! My sister vowed that she would walk to the House barefoot and without Khimar (covering).' The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Verily Allah will not do anything with the misery of your sister. She should ride, and cover, and fast three days
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Meri behen ne mannat maani hai ke wo Bait tak nange paaon aur bina sar dhake chalegi.' To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ko tumhari behen ki takleef se kuch faida nahi, wo sawaari kare, sar dhake, aur teen din roze rakhe.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever among you swears, saying in his oath: 'By Al-Lat! By Al-'Uzza!' Then let him say 'La ilaha illa Allah' And whoever says: 'Come let me gamble with you!' Then let him give in charity
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tum mein se qasam khaaye aur apni qasam mein kahe 'Laat aur Uzza ki qasam,' to wo 'La ilaha illallah' kahe, aur jo kahe 'Aao, main tumse juaa khelu,' to wo sadqa kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Mughirah, Al-Khawlani Al-Himsi hain, unka naam Abdul-Quddus bin Al-Hajjaj hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:That Sa'd bin 'Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a vow that was due from his mother, who died before fulfilling it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Fulfill it for her
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Sa'd bin Ubadah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek mannat ke baare mein fatwa maanga jo unki maa par thi, jo unhon ne poori karne se pehle hi intiqaal kar gayin, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unki taraf se ise poora karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Umamah, and other than him from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"Any Muslim man who frees a Muslim man, then it is his salvation from the Fire - each of his limbs suffices for a limb of himself. And any Muslim man that frees two Muslim women, then are his salvation from the Fire - each of their limbs suffices for a limb of himself. And any Muslim woman that frees a Muslim woman, then she is her salvation from the Fire - each of her limb suffices for a limb of herself
hi: Abu Umamah aur Nabi (SAW) ke doosre kai Sahaba se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo Musalman aadmi kisi Musalman aadmi ko azaad kare, to wo uski aag se nijaat ka zariya banta hai, uska har ang uske ek ang ke liye kaafi hota hai. Aur jo Musalman aadmi do Musalman auraton ko azaad kare, to wo uski aag se nijaat ka zariya bante hain, unka har ang uske ek ang ke liye kaafi hota hai. Aur jo Musalman aurat kisi Musalman aurat ko azaad kare, to wo uski aag se nijaat ka zariya banti hai, uska har ang uske ek ang ke liye kaafi hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur hadith mein ye ishara hai ke mardon ke liye mard gulamon ko azaad karna, auraton ko azaad karne se afzal hai, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul ki wajah se: "Jo kisi Musalman aadmi ko azaad kare, to wo uski aag se nijaat ka zariya banta hai, uska har ang uske ek ang ke liye kaafi hota hai."

e: Narrated Abu Al-Bakhtari:"An Army from the armies of the Muslims, whose commander was Salman Al-Farisi, besieged one of the Persian castles. They said: 'O Abu 'Abdullah! Should we charge them?' He said: 'Leave me to call them (to Islam) as I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) call them.' So Salman went to them and said: 'I am only a man from among you, a Persian, and you see that the Arabs obey me. If you become Muslims then you will have the likes of what we have, and from you will be required that which is required from us. If you refuse, and keep your religion, then we will leave you to it, and you will give us the Jizyah from your hands while you are submissive.' He said to them in Persian: 'And you are other than praiseworthy and if you refuse then we will equally resist you.' They said: 'We will not give you the Jizyah, we will fight you instead.' So they said: 'O Abu 'Abdullah! Should we charge them?' He said: 'No.'" He said: "So for three days he called them to the same (things), and then he said: 'Charge them.'" He said: "So we charged them, and we conquered the castle
hi: Abu Al-Bakhtari se riwayat hai ke Musalmanon ki ek fauj, jiske ameer Salman Al-Farisi the, ne Fars ke ek qile ko gher liya. Unhon ne kaha: "Ae Abu Abdullah! Kya hum unpar hamla na karen?" Unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe unhein dawat dene do jaise maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unhein dawat dete suna tha." To Salman unke paas gaye aur unse kaha: "Main to tum mein se hi ek aadmi hoon, Farsi, tum dekhte ho ke Arab meri baat maante hain. Agar tum Islam qabool kar lo, to tumhein wo sab milega jo humein milta hai aur tumpar wahi zimmedaari hogi jo humpar hai. Aur agar tum apne deen par hi rehna chaaho, to hum tumhein usi par chhod denge, aur tum humein apne haath se jizya do, aur tum choti soorat mein ho." Unhon ne kaha: Aur unhon ne unse Farsi mein baat ki: "Aur tum tareef ke laayak nahi ho." "Aur agar tum inkar karo, to hum tumse barabar ki takkar mein ladenge." Unhon ne kaha: "Hum jizya nahi denge, balki hum tumse ladenge." To unhon ne kaha: "Ae Abu Abdullah! Kya hum unpar hamla na karen?" Unhon ne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne teen din tak unhein isi tarah dawat di, phir kaha: "Unpar hamla karo." Unhon ne kaha: "To humne unpar hamla kiya aur us qile ko fatah kiya." Is mauzu par Buraidah, An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin, Ibn Umar, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Salman ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Ata bin As-Saib ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Abu Al-Bakhtari ne Salman ko nahi paaya kyunki unhon ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko nahi paaya, aur Salman Ali (Alayhis Salam) se pehle intiqaal kar gaye the. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se, isi taraf gaye hain, unhon ne maana ke jung se pehle dawat di jaaye, aur ye Ishaq bin Ibrahim ka qaul hai, unhon ne kaha: Agar unhein pehle dawat di jaaye, to acha hai, isse zyada rob padega. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Aaj koi dawat nahi. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Aaj mujhe koi nahi maloom jise dawat di jaaye. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Dushman se tab tak nahi lada jaata jab tak unhein dawat na di jaaye, siwaye is ke ke wo jaldi kar den, aur agar aisa na ho, to unhein dawat pahunch chuki hoti hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Asim Al-Muzani:From his father and he was a Companion who said: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dispatched any army or battalion, he would say to them: 'If you see a Masjid, or hear someone calling the Adhan, then do not kill anyone
hi: Ibn Aasim Al-Muzani apne walid se riwayat karte hain, jo Sahabi the, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab koi fauj ya dasta bhejte, to unse kehte: 'Agar tum koi masjid dekho ya azaan dene wale ki awaaz suno, to kisi ko qatl mat karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Ibn Uyainah ki hadith hai.

e: Narrated Anas:"When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set out for Khaibar, he approached it at night and when he came to a people during the night, he would not attack them until morning. So when the morning came, the Jews came out with their shovels and baskets, then when they saw him, they said: 'Muhammad! By Allah Muhammad has come with the Khamis (an army).' So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Allahu Akbar! Khaibar is destroyed, for whenever we approach the land of people - then what an evil morning for those who have been warned
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab Khaibar ke liye nikle, to raat ko wahan pahunche, aur jab wo kisi qaum ke paas raat ko pahunchte, to subah tak unpar hamla na karte. Jab subah hui, to Yahudi apne fawde aur tokre lekar nikle, jab unhon ne unhein dekha, to kaha: "Muhammad! Allah ki qasam! Muhammad lashkar lekar aa gaye." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allahu Akbar! Khaibar barbaad ho gaya, jab hum kisi qaum ke aangan mein utarte hain, to unke liye jinhein khabardaar kiya gaya tha, kaisi buri subah hoti hai!"

e: Narrated Abu Talhah:"When the Prophet (ﷺ) overtook a people he would stay at the outskirts of their city for three nights
hi: Abu Talhah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab kisi qaum par ghalib aate, to unke aangan mein teen raatein thehrte. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur Humaid ki, Anas se, hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne raat mein hamla karne aur raat guzaarne ki rukhsat di, aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya. Aur Ahmad aur Ishaq ne kaha: Dushman par raat ko hamla karne mein koi harj nahi. Aur "Muhammad ne Khamis se muqabla kiya" ka matlab lashkar hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) burnt the palm trees of Bani Nadir and cut them down at Al-Buwairah. So Allah revealed: Whatever you cut down of their palm trees, or you left them standing on their trunks, then it was by the permission of Allah, and in the order to disgrace the rebellious.(59:)
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bani An-Nadir ke khajoor ke darakht jalaaye aur kaate, jo Al-Buwairah thi, to Allah ne ye Ayat naazil ki: "(Jo bhi tumne khajoor ka koi darakht kaata ya use apni jadon par khada chhoda, to wo Allah ke hukum se tha, aur taake fasiqon ko ruswaa kiya jaaye)." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi taraf gaye hain, unhon ne darakht kaatne aur qile tabaah karne mein koi harj nahi maana. Aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya, aur ye Al-Awza'i ka qaul hai. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Aur Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne Yazid ko phaldaar darakht kaatne ya aabaad jagah ko tabaah karne se mana kiya, aur unke baad Musalmanon ne isi par amal kiya. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: Dushman ki zameen mein jalaana aur darakht aur phal kaatna koi harj nahi. Aur Ahmad ne kaha: Kuch jagahon mein isse bachne ka koi raasta nahi hota, lekin bewajah na jalaaya jaaye. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: Jalaana Sunnat hai jab isse unhein zyada nuqsaan pahunche.

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah:From his father, that the Prophet (ﷺ) gave a Khutbah, then he descended and called for two rams and slaughtered them.
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne khutba diya, phir utre aur do mendhe mangwaaye aur unhein zibah kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah:"I attended the Eid Al-Adha' with the Prophet (ﷺ) at the Musalla. When he finished his Khutbah, he descended from his Minbar and was given a male sheep. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slaughtered it with his hand and said: 'Bismillah, Wa Allahu Akbar, this from me and whoever does not slaughter from my Ummah.'"
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath Musalla mein Adha ke din hazir tha, jab unhon ne apna khutba poora kiya, to wo apne mimbar se utre, unke paas ek mendha laaya gaya, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use apne haath se zibah kiya aur kaha: 'Bismillah wallahu Akbar, ye meri taraf se aur meri Ummat mein se jisne qurbani na ki ho uski taraf se.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke aadmi zibah karte waqt kahe "Bismillah wallahu Akbar," aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Aur Al-Muttalib bin Abdullah bin Hantab ke baare mein kaha jaata hai ke unhon ne Jabir se suna nahi.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The best companions are four, the best Saraya (military unit) is four hundred, the best army is four thousand, and twelve thousand will not be beaten due to being too few." This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, it was not narrated with a chain by anyone important besides Jarir bin Hazim, and this Hadith was only reported from Az-Zuhri, from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form. Hibban bin 'Ali Al-'Anazi reported it from 'Uqail, from Az-Zuhri, from 'Ubaidullah, from 'Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and Al-Laith bin Sa'd reported it from Sa'd, from 'Uqail, from Az-Zuhri, from the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Mursal form
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse achi jamaat chaar hai, sabse achi sariyah chaar sau hai, sabse achi fauj chaar hazaar hai, aur baarah hazaar kam nahi hote agar wo kam ho jaayen." Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, ise Jarir bin Hazim ke siwa kisi bade ne isnad se riwayat nahi ki, aur ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Nabi (SAW) se sirf mursal riwayat hui hai. Aur Hibban bin Ali Al-Anazi ne ise Uqail se, Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah bin Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Aur Al-Laith bin Sa'd ne ise Uqail se, Az-Zuhri se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Yazid bin Hurmuz: That Najdah Al-Haruri wrote to Ibn 'Abbas asking if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would fight along with women, and if he would fix a share of the spoils of war for them. Ibn 'Abbas wrote to him: "You wrote to me asking me if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would fight along with women. He did fight along with them, as they would treat the wounded. They received something from the spoils of war, but as for their share, then he did not fix a share for them." There is something on this topic from Anas and Umm 'Atiyyah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge. It is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri and Ash-Shafi'i. Some of them said that a share is given to the woman and the boy, and this is the view of Al-Awza'i. Al-Awza'i said: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave a portion to the boys at Khaibar, and the Aimmah of the Muslims gave a portion to every child born in the land of war." Al-Awza'i said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) gave a portion to the women at Khaibar, and that was followed by the Muslims after him." This was narrated to us by 'Ali bin Khashram (who said): "'Eisa bin Yunus narrated this to us from Al-Awza'i." The meaning of his saying: "They received something from the spoils of war" it is said that he conferred something on them (the women) from the spoils of war
hi: Yazid bin Hurmuz se riwayat hai ke Najdah Al-Haruri ne Ibn Abbas ko likha aur unse pucha ke kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) auraton ke saath jung karte the aur kya wo unhein maal-e-ghanimat mein hissa dete the? To Ibn Abbas ne unhein likha: "Tumne mujhe likha ke kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) auraton ke saath jung karte the, haan wo unke saath jung karte the, to wo bimaaron ka ilaaj karti thin aur unhein maal-e-ghanimat mein se kuch diya jaata tha, lekin hissa nahi diya jaata tha." Is mauzu par Anas aur Umm Atiyyah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ne kaha: Aurat aur bachche ko hissa diya jaaye, aur ye Al-Awza'i ka qaul hai. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) ne Khaibar mein bachchon ko hissa diya, aur Musalmanon ke imamon ne dushman ki zameen mein paida hone waale har bachche ko hissa diya. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) ne Khaibar mein auraton ko bhi hissa diya, aur unke baad Musalmanon ne isi par amal kiya. Ye humein Ali bin Khashram ne bataayi, unhon ne kaha: Isa bin Yunus ne humein Al-Awza'i se ye bataayi. Aur unke qaul "unhein maal-e-ghanimat mein se kuch diya jaata tha" ka matlab hai: unhein maal-e-ghanimat mein se kuch de diya jaata tha, unhein kuch diya jaata tha.

e: Narrated 'Umair, the freed slave of Abil-Lahm: "I participated at Khaibar with my masters. They spoke about me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and told him that I was a slave." He said: "So he ordered me to take up the sword, and I found myself dragging it, so he ordered that I be given something from the goods. I presented a Ruqyah that I used to treat the possessed with, so he ordered me leave some of it and keep some of it." There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to the some of the people of knowledge. A complete portion is not given to slave, but something is conferred upon him. This is the view of Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq
hi: Umair, Abi Al-Lahm ke azaad kiye gulam, ne kaha: "Main Khaibar mein apne aaqaon ke saath hazir tha, to unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mere baare mein baat ki aur unhein bataya ke main gulam hoon." Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne mujhe talwaar pehnaane ka hukum diya, main use ghaseetta hua chalta tha, to unhon ne mujhe kuch maamooli saamaan dene ka hukum diya, aur maine unke saamne wo ruqyah pesh ki jisse main pagalon ka ilaaj karta tha, to unhon ne mujhe uska kuch hissa phenkne aur kuch rakhne ka hukum diya." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke gulam ko poora hissa nahi diya jaata, balki usse kuch de diya jaata hai. Aur ye Ath-Thawri, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There is no vowing for disobedience, and its atonement is the atonement of an oath."
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gunaah ki mannat nahi hoti, aur uska kaffara qasam ka kaffara hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Jabir, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih nahi kyunki Az-Zuhri ne ye hadith Abu Salamah se nahi suni. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Kai logon ne, unmein Musa bin Uqbah aur Ibn Abi Atiq shaamil hain, Az-Zuhri se, Sulaiman bin Arqam se, Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Muhammad ne kaha: Aur hadith yehi hai.

e: Narrated Abu Musa: "I arrived upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Khaibar along with a group of the Ash'ari tribe. He gave us shared along with those that conquered it." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. Al-Awza'i said: "Whoever meets up with the Muslims before the horses, share is distributed, then he is given a share." And Buraid's (a narrator) Kunyah is Abu Buraidah and he is trustworthy. Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn 'Uyainah and others report from him
hi: Abu Musa ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Ash'ari qabile ke kuch logon ke saath Khaibar mein pahuncha, to unhon ne humein bhi unhi logon ke saath hissa diya jinhon ne use fatah kiya tha." Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Jo Musalmanon se ghodon ka hissa taqseem hone se pehle mil jaaye, use bhi hissa diya jaata hai. Aur Buraid ki kuniyat Abu Buraidah hai, wo thiqah hain, unse Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Uyainah, aur doosron ne riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever vowed to obey Allah, then he should obey Him. And whoever vowed to disobey Allah, then he should not disobey Him."
hi: Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ki itaa'at ki mannat maane, wo uski itaa'at kare, aur jo Allah ki nafarmani ki mannat maane, wo uski nafarmani na kare."

e: Another Chain with similar meanings.
hi: Isi jaisi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne bhi ise Al-Qasim bin Muhammad se riwayat ki. Aur ye kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Malik aur Ash-Shafi'i qaayal hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ki nafarmani na kare, aur jab mannat nafarmani mein ho, to usmein qasam ka kaffara nahi.

e: Narrated Thabit bin Adh-Dahhak:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "It is not for a person to vow about that over which he has no control."
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Bande par us cheez ki mannat nahi jiska wo malik na ho." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri : "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited selling the spoils of war until it has been distributed." There is something on this topic from Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne maal-e-ghanimat ko taqseem hone se pehle khareedne se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Umm Habibah bint 'Irbad bin Sariyah: From her father who told her that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited intercourse with female prisoners, until they deliver what is in their wombs." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Ruwaifi' bin Thabit, and the Hadith of 'Irbad is a Gharib Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. Al-Awza'i said: "When a man purchases a slave girl from the captives and she is pregnant, then it has been related from 'Umar bin Al-Khattab that he said: 'Do not have intercourse with the pregnant women until she gives birth.'" Al-Awza'i said: "As for the free women, then the Sunnah about them has passed, in that the 'Iddah is observed." All of this was narrated to me by 'Ali bin Khushram who said: " 'Eisa bin Yunus narrated to us from Al-Awza'i
hi: Umm Habibah bint Irbad bin Sariyah apne walid se riwayat karti hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qaidi auraton ke saath sambhog karne se mana kiya jab tak wo apna hamal na jan dein. Is mauzu par Ruwaifi bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai, aur Irbad ki hadith ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Jab aadmi qaidiyon mein se koi hamla laundi khareede, to Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Hamla aurat ke saath sambhog na kiya jaaye jab tak wo bachcha na jan de." Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Aur azaad auraton ke baare mein Sunnat guzar chuki hai ke unhein iddat ka hukum diya gaya hai. Ye mujhe Ali bin Khushram ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Isa bin Yunus ne humein Al-Awza'i se ye bataya.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever takes an oath, and then he sees that something else is better than it, then he should make atonement for his oath and then do it."
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo kisi baat par qasam khaaye, phir dekhe ke usse behtar koi doosri cheez hai, to wo apni qasam ka kaffara ada kare aur wo behtar cheez kare." Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke qasam todne se pehle kaffara kaafi hota hai, aur ye Malik bin Anas, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Sirf qasam todne ke baad hi kaffara diya jaaye. Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne kaha: Agar wo qasam todne ke baad kaffara de, to mujhe zyada pasand hai, aur agar qasam todne se pehle kaffara de, to bhi kaafi hai.

e: Narrated Abu Ayyub: That he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "Whoever separates between a mother and her child, then Allah will separate between him and his beloved on the Day of Judgement." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from 'Ali. This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They dislike separating the captives, the mother and her child, the son and the father, and brothers
hi: Abu Ayyub se riwayat hai, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jo maa aur uske bachche ke darmiyan judaai daale, Allah Qayamat ke din uske aur uske azizon ke darmiyan judaai daalega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne qaidiyon mein maa aur uske bachche, bachche aur waalid, aur bhaiyon ke darmiyan judaai daalna napasand kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur maine Bukhari ko kehte suna: Abu Abdur-Rahman Al-Hubuli ne Abu Ayyub se suna hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that Jibra'il had indeed descended upon him to say to him: "Tell them - meaning your Companions - to choose regarding the captives of Badr, between either killing them or ransoming the, so that the amount killed by them will correspond similarly to them." So they said: "Ranson, even though some of us may be killed." There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Barzah, and Jubair bin Mut'im. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib as a narration of Ath-Thawri. We do not know of it except through the report of Za'idah. Abu Usamah reported similar to this from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from 'Abidah, from 'Ali, from the Prophet (ﷺ) Ibn 'Awn reported it from Ibn Sirin, from 'Abidah, from 'Ali, from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form. Abu Dawud Al-Hafiri's ( a narrator in this chain) name is 'Umar bin Sa'd
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya ke Jibrael unpar utre aur unse kaha: "Unhein" - yani unke Sahaba ko - "Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein ikhtiyar do: qatl ya fidya, is shart par ke agle saal unmein se utne hi qatl kiye jaayenge." Unhon ne kaha: "Fidya, chahe humein se log qatl kiye jaayen." Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Barzah, aur Jubair bin Mut'im se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith Ath-Thawri ki hadith mein hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Abi Za'idah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abu Usamah ne ise Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Abidah se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Aun ne ise Ibn Sirin se, Abidah se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki. Aur Abu Dawud Al-Hafiri ka naam Umar bin Sa'd hai.

e: Narrated 'Imran bin Husain: That the Prophet (ﷺ) ransomed two men for the Muslims with a man from the idolaters. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. The paternal uncle of Abu Al-Muhallab's name is 'Abdur Rahman bin 'Amr, and they also say it was Muhawiyah bin 'Amr. And Abu Qilabah's name is 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Jarmi (narrator in the chain) This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet(ﷺ) and others. It is for the Imam to decide to be generous with whom he wills among the captives, or to kill whom he wills among them, or to ransom whom he wills among them. Some of the people of knowledge preferred killing over ransoming. Al-Awzai' said: "It has been conveyed to me. that this Ayah is abrogated: Thereafter (is the time) either for generosity (to free them without ranson) or ransom (47:4). It was abrogated by: Kill them wherever you find them (2:191). This was narrated to us by Hannad (who said): "Ibn Al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Al-Awza'i." Ishaq bin Mansur said: "I said to Ahmad: 'When the captives are captured' is killing or ransoming better to you?' He said: 'If they are able to ransom' then there is no harm in it. And if they kill, then I do not know of any harm in it.'" Ishaq said: "Wiping them out is better to me, unless it is someone well-known, so that it is hoped that a large amount will be obtained for him
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne do Musalmanon ko ek mushrik ke badle fidya diya. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Qilabah ke chacha Abu Al-Muhallab hain, unka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Amr hai, aur kaha jaata hai Muawiyah bin Amr, aur Abu Qilabah ka naam Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Jarmi hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai ke Imam ko haq hai ke wo jise chaahe qaidiyon mein se ehsaan kare, jise chaahe qatl kare, aur jise chaahe fidya de. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne fidya ke muqaable qatl ko chuna. Aur Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Mujhe pahuncha hai ke ye Ayat mansookh hai, Allah Ta'ala ka qaul: "(Phir ya to ehsaan karo ya fidya lo)," ise "(Aur unhein jahan bhi pao qatl karo)" ne mansookh kiya. Ye humein Hannad ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ibn Al-Mubarak ne humein Al-Awza'i se bataya. Ishaq bin Mansur ne kaha: Maine Ahmad se kaha: "Jab qaidi pakda jaaye, to qatl behtar hai ya fidya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Agar wo fidya de sakein, to isme koi harj nahi. Aur agar unhein qatl kiya jaaye, to mujhe usmein bhi koi harj maloom nahi." Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Mujhe zyada dushman ko kamzor karna pasand hai, siwaye is ke ke wo koi jaana-pehchaana aadmi ho, to main usse zyada faida ki ummeed karta hoon.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That a woman was found killed in one of the expeditions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rebuked that, and he prohibited killing women and children. There are narrations on this topic from Buraidah and Rabah - and they say he was Riyah - bin Ar-Rabi', Al-Aswad bin Sari', Ibn 'Abbas, and As-Sa'b bin Jaththamah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others. They disliked killing women and children. This is the view of Sufyan Ath-Thawri and Ash-Shafi'i. Some of the people of knowledge made an exception for killing the women who had children with them during night attacks, this is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq, they permitted it in night attacks
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kisi ghazwe mein ek aurat murda paayi gayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isse napasand kiya aur auraton aur bachchon ko qatl karne se mana kiya. Is mauzu par Buraidah, Rabah, Al-Aswad bin Sari, Ibn Abbas, aur As-Sa'b bin Jaththamah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron, ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne auraton aur bachchon ko qatl karna napasand kiya. Aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Ash-Shafi'i ka qaul hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne raat ke hamle mein auraton aur bachchon ke qatl ho jaane ki rukhsat di, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne raat ke hamle ki rukhsat di.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "I was informed by As-Sa'b bin Jaththamah who said: " I said: "O Messenger of Allah our horses trampled over women and children of the idolaters." He said: "They are from their fathers.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "As-Sa'b bin Jaththamah ne mujhe bataya, unhon ne kaha: 'Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Humare ghodon ne mushrikeen ki auraton aur unke bachchon ko kuchal diya.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo apne baapon mein se hain.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us with an army and said: 'If you see so-and-so, and so-and-so' referring to two men from the Quraish: 'then burn them with fire.' Then, upon our departure, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'I ordered you to burn so-and-so, and so-and-so with fire, and indeed, none punishes with fire except Allah. So if you see them, then kill them.'" There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas and Hamzah bin 'Amr Al-Aslami. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. In this Hadith, Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned a man (narrating) between Sulaiman bin Yasar and Abu Hurairah. Others reported this Hadith the same as Al-Laith reported it(here, without a man between them). The narration of Al-Laith bin Sa'd is more appropriate and more correct
hi: Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ek dasta bhejte hue kaha: 'Agar tumhein fulaan aur fulaan milen' - Quraish ke do aadmiyon ka naam lete hue - 'to unhein aag se jala do.' Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jab hum nikalne wale the to kaha: 'Maine tumhein fulaan aur fulaan ko aag se jalaane ka hukum diya tha, lekin aag se sirf Allah hi azaab de sakta hai, to agar tum unhein pao, to unhein qatl kar do.'" Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai.

e: Narrated Thawban: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever dies and he is free of three: Kibr (Pride), Ghulul, and debt, he will enter paradise." There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhni Footnote: Ghulul refers to goods stolen from the spoils of war, or concealed, before it is divided among the soldiers
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne farmaya: "Jo teen cheezon se paak hokar mare - takabbur, ghulool, aur qarz - wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Thawban:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever's soul departs from his body while he is free of three: Kanz (buried treasure), Ghulul, and debt, then he will enter paradise." This is how Sa'eed narrated it: "Kanz" while Abu 'Awanah said in his narration: "Kibr" and he did not mention "from Ma'dan" in it. But the narration of Sa'eed is more correct
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiski rooh uske jism se juda ho jaaye jabke wo teen cheezon se paak ho - dabi hui daulat, ghulool, aur qarz - wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Isi tarah Sa'eed ne "dabi hui daulat" kaha, aur Abu Awanah ne apni hadith mein "takabbur" kaha aur ismein "Ma'dan se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Sa'eed ki riwayat zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Simak Abu Rumail Al-Hanafi: "I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated to me that he said: "It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah! So-and-so has been martyred.' He said: "No! I saw him in the fire of garment he pilfered from the spoils of war.' He said: 'Stand up O 'Umar! Call out that no one enters paradise except the believers.' Three times." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib
hi: Simak Abu Zumail Al-Hanafi ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne mujhe bataya, unhon ne kaha: Kaha gaya: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Fulaan shaheed ho gaye.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, maine unhein aag mein dekha, unhon ne ek chaadar chura li thi maal-e-ghanimat mein se.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Khade ho, Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Aur ailaan karo ke sirf Momin hi Jannat mein daakhil hote hain,' teen baar." Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to go to battle with Umm Sulaim, and other women with her, from the Ansar, who would give water and attend to the wounded." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Ar-Rabi' bin Mu'awwidh. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Sulaim aur unke saath kuch Ansar ki auraton ke saath jung mein jaate the, jo paani pilaati thin aur zakhmiyon ka ilaaj karti thin. Is mauzu par Ar-Rubaiyyi bint Muawwidh se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali: From the Prophet (ﷺ), that Kisra sent him a gift so he accepted, and that kings gave him gifts and he accepted them. There is something about this from Jabir. This is a Hasan Gharib Hadith. Thuwair (a narrator in the chain) is Ibn Abi Fakhitah, whose name was Sa'eed bin 'Illaqah, and Thuwair's Kunyah was Abu Jahm
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke Kisra ne unhein tohfa bheja, to unhon ne use qubool kiya, aur baadshahon ne unhein tohfe bheje, to unhon ne unhein qubool kiya. Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Thuwair, Ibn Abi Fakhitah hain, aur Abu Fakhitah ka naam Sa'eed bin Alaqah hai, aur Thuwair ki kuniyat Abu Jahm hai.

e: Narrated 'Iyad bin Himar: That he gave the Prophet (ﷺ) a gift or a camel, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Have you accepted Islam?" He said: "No." He said: "Then I have been prohibited from the Zabd (gift) of the idolaters." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. And the meaning of his saying: "I haven been prohibited from the Zabd (gifts) of the idolaters" is their gifts. It has been reported about the Messenger (ﷺ) that he used to accept the gifts of the idolaters while a dislike for that is mentioned in this Hadith. And the implication is that this was after he used to accept from them, and then he later forbade their gifts
hi: Iyad bin Himar se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek tohfa ya ek oontni di, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne Islam qubool kiya?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "To mujhe mushrikeen ke tohfe se mana kiya gaya hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur unke qaul "mujhe mushrikeen ke tohfe se mana kiya gaya hai" ka matlab hai unke tohfe. Aur Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke wo mushrikeen ke tohfe qubool karte the, aur is hadith mein napasandeegi ka zikr hai, ho sakta hai ye us waqt ka ho jab unhon ne unse qubool karna band kar diya aur unke tohfon se mana kar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Bakrah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) was met by some affair that made him happy, so he prostrated to Allah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route, as a narration of Bakkar bin 'Abdul-'Aziz. This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, they held the view that one could perform the prostration of gratitude. And Bakkar bin 'Adbul-'Aziz bin Abi Bakrah is Muqarib (average) in Hadith
hi: Abu Bakrah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek khushkhabri aayi jisse wo khush hue, to unhon ne Allah ke liye sajda kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf isi tareeqe se, Bakkar bin Abdul-Aziz ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, unhon ne shukrane ka sajda maana. Aur Bakkar bin Abdul-Aziz bin Abi Bakrah hadith mein ausat darje ke hain.

e: Narrated Thabit bin Adh-Dahhak:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever swears by a religion other than Islam while lying, then he is as he said."
hi: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Islam ke siwa kisi doosre deen ki jhoothi qasam khaaye, to wo waisa hi hai jaisa usne kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka ismein ikhtilaaf hai, agar aadmi Islam ke siwa kisi doosre deen ki qasam khaaye aur kahe: "Main Yahudi ya Nasrani hoon agar maine ye kiya," phir wo aisa kare, to kuch ne kaha: Usne bada gunaah kiya lekin uspar koi kaffara nahi. Aur ye Madina waalon ka qaul hai, aur isi ke Malik bin Anas qaayal hain, aur isi qaul ki taraf Abu Ubaid gaye hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba, Tabi'een aur doosron ne kaha: Uspar kaffara hai. Aur ye Sufyan, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Faid: "I heard Sulaim bin 'Amir saying: 'There was a treaty between Mu'awiyah and the people of Rome. He was making an expedition into their lands so that when the period of the treaty was expires he would attack them. So when a man upon an animal' - or - 'upon a horse said: "Allahu Akbar! Fulfillment not betrayal!" - and it turned out to be 'Amr bin 'Abasah - Mu'awiyah asked him about that. He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Whoever has a treaty between himself and a people, then let him not violate the treaty nor try to change it until its time has passed, or , in retribution for a similar offense.'" He said: "So Mu'awiyah returned with the people." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abul-Faid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Sulaim bin Aamir ko kehte suna: Muawiyah aur Rome waalon ke darmiyan ek ahd tha, aur wo unke ilaqon mein safar karte the, yahan tak ke jab ahd khatam hone laga, to unhon ne unpar hamla karne ka irada kiya. To ek aadmi, jaanwar ya ghode par sawaar, keh raha tha: 'Allahu Akbar! Wafa, khayanat nahi.' Ye Amr bin Absah the. Muawiyah ne unse iske baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Jiska kisi qaum ke saath ahd ho, wo na to ahd tode na use sakht kare, jab tak uska waqt guzar na jaaye, ya wo unhein baraabar tor par ahd khatam karne ki khabar de.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Muawiyah log lekar wapas laut aaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed the one who betrays will have a banner erected for him on the Day of Judgement." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. I asked Muhammad about the Hadith of Suwaid, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Umarah bin 'Umair, from 'Ali, from the Prophet (ﷺ) who said: "For every person who betrays there will be banner." He said: "I do not know of this Hadith being Marfu
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Khayanat karne wale ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda gaada jaayega." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Maine Muhammad se Suwaid ki, Abu Ishaq se, Umarah bin Umair se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne farmaya: "Har khayanat karne wale ka ek jhanda hoga." To unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe ye hadith marfu' maloom nahi."

e: Narrated Jabir:"On the day of (the battle of) Al-Ahzab, Sa'd bin Mu'adh was struck by an arrow such that the upper vein or lower vein of his forearm was severed. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) tried to stop it with fire, but it made his arm bleed profusely so he left it. Then he did it another time but it caused it to bleed profusely. Upon seeing that he said: 'O Allah! Do not allow my soul depart until my eyes are comforted by elimination of Banu Quraizah.' He pressed his vein closed and it did not bleed a drop before they surrendered to the arbitration of Sa'd bin Mu'adh. He (the Prophet (ﷺ)) sent to him (Sa'd) who judged that their men should be killed, their women should be spared, and that the Muslims may share them among themselves. With this, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'You have judged according to Allah's judgement for them.' And they were four hundred. Then when he finished killing them, his vein opened up and he died." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed and 'Atiyyah Al-Qurazi. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ahzab ke din Sa'd bin Muaz ko teer laga, jisse unki bazoo ki rag kat gayi. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aag se use daagh diya, to unka haath sooj gaya, to unhon ne use chhod diya, to khoon bahne laga, to unhon ne dobara daagh diya, to unka haath phir sooj gaya. Jab unhon ne ye dekha, to kaha: 'Ya Allah! Meri jaan tab tak na nikaal jab tak Banu Quraizah se meri aankh thandi na ho jaaye.'" To unki rag ruk gayi aur ek boond bhi na tapki, yahan tak ke wo Sa'd bin Muaz ke faisle par utar aaye. To unhon ne unhein bulaaya, unhon ne faisla diya ke unke mard qatl kiye jaayen aur unki auraten zinda rakhi jaayen, Musalman unse madad len. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne unke baare mein Allah ka faisla theek kiya." Aur wo chaar sau the. Jab unke qatl se faarigh hue, to unki rag phat gayi aur wo mar gaye. Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Atiyyah Al-Qurazi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Samurah bin Jundab: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Kill the elder men among the idolaters and spare the Sharkh amont them." And the Sharkh are the boys who did not begin to grow pubic hair. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Hajjaj bin Artah narrated similarly from Qatadah
hi: Samurah bin Jundab se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mushrikeen ke boodhon ko qatl karo aur unke naujawanon ko zinda chhodo." Aur "shar-kh" wo larke hain jinke baal abhi nahi ugay. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Hajjaj bin Artaah ne Qatadah se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Atiyyah Al-Qurazi: "We were presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of (the battle of) Quraizah. Whoever had pubic hair was killed and whoever did not was left to his way. I was of those who did not have pubic hair so I was left to my way." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They consider pubic hair an indication of the age of responsibility, if it is not known whether he has had a wet dream, or his age. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq
hi: Atiyyah Al-Qurazi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humein Quraizah ke din Nabi (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya gaya, to jiske baal ug aaye the wo qatl kiya gaya, aur jiske nahi ugay the use chhod diya gaya. Main un mein se tha jinke baal nahi ugay the, to mujhe chhod diya gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo baalon ka ugna buloogh maante hain agar ehtelaam ya umar maloom na ho. Aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said during his Khutbah: "Fulfill the allegiances sworn in Jahiliyyah for it" - meaning Islam - "does not add to them except in gravity. And do not initiate new allegiances in Islam." [He said:] There are narration on this topic from 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf, Umm Salamah, Jubair bin Mut'im, Abu Hurairah, Ibn 'Abbas, and Qais bin 'Asim. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khutbe mein farmaya: "Jahiliyyah ke ahd poore karo, kyunki Islam use aur mazboot hi karta hai, aur Islam mein naya ahd na banaao." Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Umm Salamah, Jubair bin Mut'im, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, aur Qais bin Aasim se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Bajalah bin 'Abdah : "I was a scribe for Jaz' bin Mu'awiyah at Manadhir when 'Umar's letter came to us (saying): 'Inspect the Zoroastrians around you to take the Jizyah from them. For indeed 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf informed me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took the Jizyah from the Zoroastrians of Hajar.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan
hi: Bajalah bin Abdah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Jaz bin Muawiyah ka Manazir mein munshi tha, humare paas Umar ka khat aaya: 'Apne ilaqe ke Majoos ko dekho aur unse jizya lo, kyunki Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hajar ke Majoos se jizya liya tha.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Bajalah: That 'Umar would not take the Jizyah from the Zoroastrians until 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) took Jizyah from the Zoroastrians of Hajar." There is more dialogue in the Hadith than this. And this Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Bajalah se riwayat hai ke Umar Majoos se jizya nahi lete the, yahan tak ke Abdur-Rahman bin Awf ne unhein bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ne Hajar ke Majoos se jizya liya tha. Aur is hadith mein isse zyada baat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Malik :From Az-Zuhri, that Sa'ib bin Yazid said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took the Jizyah from the Zoroastrians of Bahrain, and 'Umar took it in Persia, and 'Uthman took it from the Persians." I asked Muhammad about this, so he said: "It is: 'Malik from Az-Zuhri from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Malik se, Az-Zuhri se riwayat hai ke As-Sa'ib bin Yazid ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bahrain ke Majoos se jizya liya, aur Umar ne Faaris se liya, aur Uthman ne Faaris waalon se liya." Maine Muhammad se isi ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Ye Malik, Az-Zuhri se, Nabi (SAW) se hai."

e: Narrated 'Uqbah bin 'Amir: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We come across a people and they do not host us, and they do not give us our rights, and we do not take anything from them. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'If they refuse such that you can only take by force, then take.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. It has been reported by Al-Laith bin Sa'd from Yazid bin Abi Habib as well. This Hadith only means that they would go out for battles and they would pass a people among whom they would not find any food to buy for a price. So the Prophet (ﷺ) told them: If they refuse to sell you, such that you have to take it forcefully, then take it. This is how the explanation has been related in some of the Ahadith. And it has been related that 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, may Allah be please with him, would order similarly
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum kisi qaum ke paas se guzarte hain, na wo humari mehmaan-nawaazi karte hain na hamara koi haq ada karte hain, aur hum unse kuch nahi lete.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar wo inkar karen aur tumhein zabardasti lena pade, to le lo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Al-Laith bin Sa'd ne bhi Yazid bin Abi Habib se ye riwayat ki hai. Aur is hadith ka matlab ye hai ke wo jihaad ke liye nikalte the aur kisi qaum ke paas se guzarte, unhein khareedne layak khaana nahi milta, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse kaha: "Agar wo bechne se inkar karen aur tumhein zabardasti lena pade, to le lo." Isi tarah kuch hadithon mein tafseer riwayat hui hai. Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai ke wo isi jaisa hukum dete the.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That on the day of Conquest of Makkah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There is no Hijrah after the conquest, there is only Jihad and intention, and when you are called to go forth (for battle), then go." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and 'Abdullah bin Hubshi. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported it similarly from Mansur bin Al-Mu'tamir
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Makkah ki fatah ke din farmaya: "Fatah ke baad koi hijrat nahi, balki jihaad aur niyat hai, aur jab tumhein bulaaya jaaye, to nikal pado." Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abdullah bin Hubshi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne bhi Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Yahya bin Abi Kathir: From Abu Salamah, from Jabir bin Abdullah about the statement of Allah, most High: Allah was pleased with the believers when they gave the pledge to you under the tree (48:18). that Jabir said: "We pledged to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that we would not flee, and we did not pledge to him for death." [He said:] There are narration on this topic from Salamah bin Al-Akwa', Ibn 'Umar, 'Ubadah, and Jarir bin 'Abdullah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is been reported from 'Eisa bin Yunus, from Al-Awza'i, from Yahya bin Abi Kathir who said: "Jabir bin 'Abdullah said" and he did not mention Abu Salamah on it
hi: Yahya bin Abi Kathir se riwayat hai, Abu Salamah se, Jabir bin Abdullah se, Allah Ta'ala ke qaul "(Yaqeenan Allah Momino se raazi ho gaya jab wo darakht ke neeche tumse bai'at kar rahe the)" ke baare mein, Jabir ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baat par bai'at ki ke hum bhaagenge nahi, humne unse maut par bai'at nahi ki." Is mauzu par Salamah bin Al-Akwa, Ibn Umar, Ubadah, aur Jarir bin Abdullah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Isa bin Yunus se, Al-Awza'i se, Yahya bin Abi Kathir se bhi riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha," aur usmein Abu Salamah ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: Narrated Yazid bin Abi 'Ubaid: "I said to Salamah bin Al-Akwa': "For what did you pledge to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Al-Hudaibiyyah?" He said: "For death." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Salamah bin Al-Akwa se kaha: 'Aap logon ne Hudaibiyah ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kis baat par bai'at ki?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maut par.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "We used to pledge to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to hear and obey." So he would say to us: "As much as you are able." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunne aur maanne par bai'at karte the, to wo humse farmate: 'Jitni tumhari taaqat ho.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye dono hadithein hasan sahih hain.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "We did not pledge to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for death, but only that we would not flee." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, meaning both of the Ahadith are Sahih. Some of his Companions pledged to him for death, they said only: "We will not leave from in front of you as long as we are not killed." While others pledged him by saying: "We will not flee
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se maut par bai'at nahi ki, humne to sirf isi baat par bai'at ki ke hum bhaagenge nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur dono hadithon ka matlab sahih hai, kuch Sahaba ne unse maut par bai'at ki, unhon ne kaha: "Hum aapke saamne se tab tak na hatenge jab tak qatl na ho jaayen," aur doosron ne unse bai'at ki aur kaha: "Hum bhaagenge nahi."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Three will not be spoken to by Allah on the Day of Judgement, nor will they be purified, and for them is a painful torment: A man that gave a pledge to an Imam, and if he gives to him he fulfills it, and if he does not give to him he does not fulfill not fulfill it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen log hain jinse Allah Qayamat ke din baat nahi karega, na unhein paak karega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai: wo aadmi jisne kisi Imam se bai'at ki, agar Imam ne use diya to wo wafa karta hai, aur agar nahi diya to wo wafa nahi karta." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur isi par bagair kisi ikhtilaaf ke amal hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "A slave came to give the pledge to the Prophet (ﷺ) for Hijrah, but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not realize that he was a slave. So his master came, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Sell him to me.' So he purchased him for two black slaves. After this he (ﷺ) would not take the pledge from anyone until he asked him if he was a slave." [He said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Jabir is Hasan Gharib Sahih, we do not know of it except as a narration of Abu Az-Zubair
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek gulam aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se hijrat par bai'at ki, jabke Nabi (SAW) ko ehsaas nahi tha ke wo gulam hai. To uska maalik aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ise mujhe bech do.' To unhon ne use do kaale gulamon ke badle khareed liya, aur uske baad kisi se bai'at nahi lete the jab tak uspar pucha na jaaye ke kya wo gulam hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai, hum ise sirf Abu Az-Zubair ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Ibn Al-Munkadir heard Umaimah bin Ruqaiqah saying:"I pledged to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with some women. He said to us: 'In as much as you are able and capable.' I said: 'Allah and His Messenger are more merciful to us than we are to ourselves,' then I said: 'O Messenger of Allah take the pledge from us.'" - Sufyan (one of the narrators) said: meaning: 'shake (hands) on it with us' - "so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'My statement to one hundred women is like my statement to one.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Aishah, from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, and Asma' bint Yazid. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, we do not know of it except as a narration of Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir. Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, and others reported this Hadith from Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir similarly. He said: I asked Muhammad about this Hadith and he said: "I am not aware of a Hadith other than this from Umaimah bint Ruqaiqah." There is another woman named Umaimah who narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Al-Munkadir ne Umaimah bint Ruqaiqah ko kehte suna: "Maine kuch auraton ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bai'at ki, to unhon ne humse farmaya: 'Jitna tum kar sako aur jitni tumhari taaqat ho.' Maine kaha: 'Allah aur uske Rasool humpar humse zyada meherbaan hain.'" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Humse bai'at lijiye." Sufyan ne kaha: unka matlab tha: humse haath milaayiye. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri baat sau auraton ke liye waisi hi hai jaisi ek aurat ke liye." Is mauzu par Aishah, Abdullah bin Umar, aur Asma bint Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Malik bin Anas, aur kai doosron ne ye hadith Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe Umaimah bint Ruqaiqah se is hadith ke siwa aur koi hadith maloom nahi." Aur Umaimah ek doosri aurat bhi hain jinki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadith hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' : "We used to say that the participants of Badr on the Day of Badr were like the number of companions of Talut, three hundred and thirteen men." [He said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Ath-Thawri and others reported it from Abu Ishaq
hi: Al-Bara se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Hum kaha karte the ke Badr ke din Badr ke sahaba Talut ke saathiyon ki tadaad jitne the, teen sau terah aadmi." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne bhi Abu Ishaq se ye riwayat ki hai.

e:
Narrated Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the pots of the Zorastrians. He said: 'Clean them by washing them, and then cook in them.' And he prohibited every predator and possessor of canines."


This Hadith has been reported through routes other than this from Abu Tha'labah. Abu Idris Al-Khawlani reported it from Abu Tha'labah. Abu Qilabah did not hear from Abu Tha'labah, he only reported it from Abu Asma', from Abu Tha'labah.
hi: Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Majoos ke bartanon ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Unhein dho kar saaf karo aur unmein pakaao.'" Aur unhon ne har naakhun waale shikaari jaanwar se mana kiya. Aur ye hadith Abu Tha'labah se doosre tareeqe se bhi riwayat hui hai, Abu Idris Al-Khawlani ne ise Abu Tha'labah se riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Qilabah ne Abu Tha'labah se suna nahi, unhon ne to ise Abu Asma se, Abu Tha'labah se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Abayah bin Rifa'ah: From his father, from his grandfather Rafi' bin Khadij, who said: "We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, when the hasty people went rushing ahead to the sheep to cook them, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the rear of the people. Then he passed the kettled and ordered that they be weighed, then he distributed it between them and equated a camel to ten sheep." [Abu 'Eisa said:] Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported it from his father, from 'Abayah, from his grandfather Rafi' bin Khadij, and he did not mention "from his father" in it. This was narrated to us by Mahmud bin Ghailan (who said:) "Waki' narrated it to us from Sufyan." And this is more correct. 'Abayah bin Rifa'ah heard from his grandfather Rafi' bin Khadij. He said: There are narrations on this topic from Tha'labah bin Al-Hakam, Anas, Abu Rihanah, Abu Ad-Darda, 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah, Zaid bin Khalid, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, and Abu Ayyub
hi: Abayah bin Rifa'ah apne walid se, apne dada, Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek safar mein the, log jaldi mein aage badh gaye aur maal-e-ghanimat se jaldi kuch le kar pakaane lage, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) peeche the. Wo deghon ke paas se guzre, unhon ne hukum diya to unhen ulat diya gaya, phir unhon ne unke darmiyan taqseem ki, ek oont ko das bakriyon ke barabar rakha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne apne walid se, Abayah se, unke dada Rafi bin Khadij se riwayat ki, aur usmein "apne walid se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Ye humein Mahmud bin Ghailan ne bataya, humein Waki ne Sufyan se bataya. Aur ye zyada sahih hai, aur Abayah bin Rifa'ah ne apne dada Rafi bin Khadij se suna hai. Is mauzu par Tha'labah bin Al-Hakam, Anas, Abu Raihanah, Abu Ad-Darda, Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah, Zaid bin Khalid, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Anas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever plunders then he is not of us." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a Hadith of Anas
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo loot-maar kare, wo hum mein se nahi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Anas ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not precede the Jews and the Christians with the Salam. And if one you meets one of them in the path, then force him to its narrow portion." [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Anas, and Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari the Companion of the Prophet (ﷺ). [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. And regarding the meaning of this Hadith: "Do not precede the Jews and the Christians": Some of the poeple of knowledge said that it only means that it is disliked because it would be honoring them, and the Muslims were ordered to humiliate them. For this reason, when one of them is met on the path, then the path is not yielded for him, because doing so would amount to honoring them
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon ko salaam mein pehle mat kaho, aur jab tum raaste mein unmein se kisi se milo, to unhein raaste ke tang hisse ki taraf majboor karo." Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Anas, aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahabi Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur is hadith "Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon ko salaam mein pehle mat kaho" ka matlab, kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Iski napasandeegi isliye hai kyunki ismein unki taazeem hoti, jabke Musalmanon ko unhein zaleel karne ka hukum diya gaya hai. Isi tarah jab unmein se kisi se raaste mein mulaaqaat ho, to uske liye raasta na chhoda jaaye, kyunki ismein unki taazeem hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed when a Jew gives Salam to one of you, then he is only saying: 'As-Samu 'Alaikum' (Death be upon you) so say: "Alaik (And upon you).'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Yahudi tum mein se kisi ko salaam kare, to wo dar-asal 'As-Saam Alaikum' kehta hai, to tum 'Alaik' kaho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Qais bin Abu Hazim: From Jarir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a military expedition to Khath'am. So some people (living there) sought safety by prostrating, but they were met quickly and killed. News of this reached the Prophet (ﷺ) upon which he commanded that they be given half of the 'Aql (blood money). And he said: "I am free from every Muslim that lives among the idolaters." They said:"O Messenger of Allah: How is that ?" He said: "They should not see each other's campfires
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khath'am ki taraf ek dasta bheja, to kuch log sajda kar ke bachne ki koshish karne lage, lekin unhein jaldi qatl kar diya gaya. Ye baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhon ne unke liye aadhi diyat ka hukum diya, aur farmaya: "Main us har Musalman se bari hoon jo mushrikeen ke darmiyan rehta hai." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kyun?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Unke aur unke aag ke sholay ek doosre ko na dikhein."

e: Narrated Qais bin Abu Hazim: Similar to the narration of Abu Mu'aqiyah (no. 1604) but he did not mention in it: "from Jarir" in it, and that is more correct. There is something on this topic from Samurah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] Most of the companions of Isma'il said: "From Isma'il, from Qais bin Abu Hazim, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a military expedition." and they did not mention: "from Jarir" in it. Hammad bin Salamah reported similar to the narration of Abu Mu'awiyah, from Al-Hajjaj bin Artah, from Isma'il bin Abi Khalid, from Qais from Jarir [He said:] I heard Muhammad saying: "What is correct is the narration of Qais from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form." Samurah bin Jundab repoted that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Do not live among the idolaters, and do not assemble with them, for whoever lives among them or assembles with them then he is similar to them
hi: Qais bin Abi Hazim se riwayat hai, Abu Muawiyah ki hadith jaisi, lekin ismein "Jarir se" ka zikr nahi kiya, aur ye zyada sahih hai. Is mauzu par Samurah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Ismail ke zyada tar saathiyon ne kaha: "Qais bin Abi Hazim se, ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek dasta bheja," aur ismein "Jarir se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Hammad bin Salamah ne Hajjaj bin Artaah se, Ismail bin Abi Khalid se, Qais se, Jarir se, Abu Muawiyah ki hadith jaisi riwayat ki. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Sahih ye hai ke Qais ki, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith mursal hai. Aur Samurah bin Jundab ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Mushrikeen ke saath na raho aur na unke saath mil-jul kar raho, jo unke saath rahe ya mil-jul kar rahe, wo unhi jaisa hai."

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If I live - if Allah wills - I will expel the Jews and the Christians from the Arabian Peninsula
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main zinda raha - Insha-Allah - to main Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon ko Jazeerat-ul-Arab se nikaal doonga."

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "Umar bin Al-Khattab informed me that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: 'I will expel the Jews and the Christians from the Arabian Peninsula, and I will not leave anyone in it except a Muslim." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai: "Umar bin Al-Khattab ne mujhe bataya ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Main Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon ko Jazeerat-ul-Arab se zaroor nikaaloonga, aur ismein sirf Musalman ko hi chhodunga.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "Fatimah came to Abu Bakr and said: 'Who will inherit from you?' He said: 'My family and my son.' She said: 'So what about me? I do not get inheritance from my father?' So Abu Bakr said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: 'We are not inherited from' but I support those whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to support, and I spend upon those whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spent upon." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, Talhah, Az-Zubair, 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf, Sa'd and 'Aishah. The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib from this route. It is only reported with a chain by Hammad bin Salamah and 'Abdul Wahhab bin 'Ata, from Muhammad bin 'Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah. I asked Muhammad about this Hadith and he said: "No one is known to have reported it from Muhammad bin 'Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah except from Hammad bin Salamah. 'Abdul Wahhab bin 'Ata reported it from Muhammad bib 'Amr, from Abu Salamah, and from Abu Hurairah and it is similar to the narration of Hammad bin Salamah. And this Hadith has been reported through other routes from Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) Abu Bakr ke paas aayin aur kaha: 'Aapki wirasat kaun paayega?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Mere ghar wale aur mera beta.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To phir main apne waalid se wirasat kyun nahi paati?' To Abu Bakr ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Humari wirasat nahi hoti. Lekin main un logon ka khayal rakhta hoon jinka Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khayal rakhte the, aur main un par kharch karta hoon jinpar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kharch karte the.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Talhah, Az-Zubair, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Sa'd, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, ise sirf Hammad bin Salamah aur Abdul Wahhab bin Ata ne Muhammad bin Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se sanad ke saath riwayat kiya hai. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe maloom nahi ke Hammad bin Salamah ke siwa kisi ne ise Muhammad bin Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki ho." Aur Abdul Wahhab bin Ata ne Muhammad bin Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se Hammad bin Salamah ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That Fatimah came to Abu Bakr and 'Umar may Allah be pleased with them both, to ask them about her inheritance from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). They said: "We heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: 'I am not inherited from.'" So she said: 'By Allah! I will never talk to you two again.' So she died having not talked to them." 'Ali bin 'Eisa said: "The meaning of not speaking to you two is: 'Never again regarding this inheritance, because you two are truthful
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Fatimah (Alayhas Salam), Abu Bakr aur Umar (RA) ke paas aayin, unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se apni wirasat maangne, to unhon ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Meri wirasat nahi hoti.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Main tum dono se kabhi baat nahi karoongi." To wo mar gayin aur unse baat nahi ki. Ali bin Isa ne kaha: "Main tum dono se baat nahi karoongi" ka matlab hai isi wirasat ke maamle mein hamesha ke liye, tum dono sacche ho. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Malik bin Aws bin Al-Hadathan: "I entered upon 'Umar bin Al-Khattab. (Then) Uthman bin 'Affan, Az-Zubair, 'Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, and Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas entered. Then 'Ali and Al-'Abbas came disputing. 'Umar said to them: ' I ask you, by Allah the One by Whose Will the heavens and the earth are maintained, do you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "We are not inherited from, what we leave is charity?" They said: 'Yes.' 'Umar said: 'When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died, Abu Bakr said: "I am the caretaker of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)" So you and he went to Abu Bakr and you sought your inheritance from the son of your brother, and he sought the inheritance of his wife from her father. So Abu Bakr said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "We are not inherited from, what we leave is charity." And Allah knows that he is truthful, innocent, instructing and following the truth.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is a lengthy story along with the Hadith. And this Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a narration of Malik bin Anas
hi: Malik bin Aws bin Al-Hadathan se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Umar bin Al-Khattab ke paas gaya, unke paas Uthman bin Affan, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas aaye. Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Abbas jhagadte hue aaye. To Umar ne unse kaha: 'Main tumhein us Allah ki qasam deta hoon jiske hukum se aasman aur zameen qaayam hain, kya tumhein maloom hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Humari wirasat nahi hoti, jo hum chhodein wo sadqa hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Umar ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Abu Bakr ne kaha: 'Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka wali hoon.' To tum aur ye Abu Bakr ke paas aaye, tum apne bhatije se apni wirasat maangte ho aur ye apni biwi ki wirasat unke waalid se maangta hai. To Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Humari wirasat nahi hoti, jo hum chhodein wo sadqa hai. Aur Allah jaanta hai ke wo sachche, nek, seedhe, aur haq ki pairvi karne wale the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur hadith mein ek lambi kahaani hai. Ye hadith Malik bin Anas ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Al-Harith bin Malik bin Al-Barsa': "On the day of the Conquest of Makkah, I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: 'This is not to be battled over after today, until the Day of Judgement.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, Sulaiman bin Surad, and Muti' This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, and it is a narration of Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah from Ash-Sha'bi, we do not know of it except from his narration
hi: Al-Harith bin Malik bin Al-Barsa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Makkah ki fatah ke din Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Aaj ke baad Qayamat tak isse jung nahi ki jaayegi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Sulaiman bin Surad, aur Muti se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah ki, Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat hai, hum ise sirf unki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin : "I fought along with the Prophet (ﷺ), and if Fajr had begun he would wait until the sun rose, and when it rose he would fight. And if it was the middle of the daytime, he would wait until the sun passed the zenit, and when it passed the zenith he would fight until 'Asr. Then he would wait until he prayed 'Asr, then he would fight." He said: "And it is used to be said during that (time) the the wind of victory was raging, and the believers would supplicate for their armies in their Salat." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith has been reported from An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin through a chain that is more connected that this. Qatadah did not see An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin. An-Nu'man died during the Khilafah of 'Umar
hi: Nu'man bin Muqarrin se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath jihaad mein gaya, jab fajr hoti to wo ruk jaate yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aata, jab wo nikal aata to wo jang karte, jab dopahar ho jaati to wo ruk jaate yahan tak ke sooraj dhal jaata, jab sooraj dhal jaata to wo Asr tak jang karte, phir ruk jaate yahan tak ke Asr ki namaz padhte, phir jang karte." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur us waqt kaha jaata tha ke fatah ki hawaayen chalti hain, aur Momin apni namaz mein apne lashkaron ke liye dua karte hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Nu'man bin Muqarrin se ek isse zyada muttasil isnad se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Qatadah ne Nu'man bin Muqarrin ko nahi paaya, aur Nu'man bin Muqarrin Umar ki khilafat mein wafaat paa gaye.

e: Narrated Ma'qil bin Yasar: "Umar bin Al-Khattab sent An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin to Al-Hurmuzan." And he mentioned the Hadith in its entirety. An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin said: "I participated (in battles) with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So when he did not fight in the beginning if the daytime, he would wait until the sun passed the zenith, and the wind of victory would rage, and victory would descent upon them." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. 'Alqamah bin 'Abdullah (one of the narrators) is the brother of Bakr bin 'Abdullah Al-Muzani
hi: Ma'qil bin Yasar se riwayat hai ke Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Nu'man bin Muqarrin ko Al-Hurmuzan ki taraf bheja, phir unhon ne poori hadith bayan ki, unhon ne kaha ke Nu'man bin Muqarrin ne kaha: "Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maujood tha, jab wo din ke shuru mein jang nahi karte to sooraj dhalne aur hawaayen chalne aur fatah utarne ka intezar karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Alqamah bin Abdullah, Bakr bin Abdullah Al-Muzani ke bhai hain.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "At-Tiyarah is from Shirk, and none among us (it influences) except that Allah will remove it with Tawakkul (reliance)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] I heard Muhammad bin Isma'il saying: "Sulaiman bin Harb used to say about this Hadith: 'And none among us (it influences) except that Allah will remove it with Tawakkul (reliance)' - Sulaiman would say: 'To me, this is a saying of 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud.'" There are narrations on this topic from Sa'd, Abu Hurairah, Habis At-Tamimi, 'Aishah and Ibn 'Umar. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, we do not know of it except as a narration of Salamah bin Khuail. Shu'bah also reported this Hadith from Salamah
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tiyarah shirk mein se hai." Aur "hum mein se koi aisa nahi jo isse mahfooz ho, lekin Allah tawakkul se ise door kar deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Habis At-Tamimi, Aishah, Ibn Umar, aur Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Salamah bin Kuhail ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Shu'bah ne bhi Salamah se ye hadith riwayat ki hai. Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: Sulaiman bin Harb is hadith mein kehte the: "Aur hum mein se koi aisa nahi jo isse mahfooz ho, lekin Allah tawakkul se ise door kar deta hai" - Sulaiman kehte the: "Mere nazdeek ye Abdullah bin Mas'ud ka apna qaul hai, 'aur hum mein se koi nahi.'"

e: Narrated Anas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There is no 'Adwa and no Tiyarah, and I like Fa'l." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! What is Fa'l?" He said: "A good statement." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na koi bimari khud-ba-khud failti hai, na koi badshaguni, aur mujhe fa'l pasand hai." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Fa'l kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Achi baat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to like it when he set out upon an affair if he heard: "O directed one, O successful one." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ko ye baat pasand thi ke jab wo kisi zaroorat ke liye nikalte, to sunein: "Ae seedhi raah paane wale! Ae kaamyaab hone wale!" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e:
Narrated Thawban:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever's soul departs from his body while he is free of three: Kanz (buried treasure), Ghulul, and debt, then he will enter paradise."


This is how Sa'eed narrated it: "Kanz" while Abu 'Awanah said in his narration: "Kibr" and he did not mention "from Ma'dan" in it. But the narration of Sa'eed is more correct.
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiski rooh jism se juda ho aur wo teen cheezon se bari ho - khazana chhupaana, ghulool, aur qarz - wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Isi tarah Sa'eed ne "kanz" kaha, aur Abu Awanah ne apni hadith mein "kibr" kaha, aur usmein "Ma'dan se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Sa'eed ki riwayat zyada sahih hai.

e:
Narrated Simak Abu Rumail Al-Hanafi:"I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab narrated to me that he said: "It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah! So-and-so has been martyred.' He said: "No! I saw him in the fire of garment he pilfered from the spoils of war.' He said: 'Stand up O 'Umar! Call out that no one enters paradise except the believers.' Three times."


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib.
hi: Simak Abu Zumail Al-Hanafi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna: Umar bin Al-Khattab ne mujhe bataya, unhon ne kaha: Kaha gaya: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Fulaan shaheed ho gaya hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Hargiz nahi, maine use aag mein dekha, ek chaadar ki wajah se jo usne maal-e-ghanimat mein se chura li thi.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Khade ho jao, Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Aur elaan karo ke Jannat mein sirf Momin hi daakhil honge,' teen martaba." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "It was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what equals Jihad?' He said: 'Verily, you (people) are not capable of it.' So they repeated it to him two or three times, each time he said, 'You (people) are not capable of it.' Then he said the third time: 'The example of the Mujahid in the path of Allah is like the one who fasts and stands (in prayer) and does not slacken from Salat, nor fasting, until the Mujahid in the cause of Allah returns.'" There are narrations on this topic from Ash-Shifa', 'Abdullah bin Hubshi, Abu Musa', Abu Sa'eed, Umm Malik Al-Bahziyyah, and Anas. This Hadith is a Hasan Sahih. And it has been reported through more than one route from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Kaha gaya: Ya Rasool Allah! Jihaad ke barabar kya hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum ismein taaqat nahi rakhte.' Unhon ne do ya teen baar ye baat dohraayi, har baar wo yehi kehte: 'Tum ismein taaqat nahi rakhte.'
