To teesri baar unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wale ki misaal us qayaam karne wale, roza rakhne wale jaisi hai jo namaz aur roze se sust nahi hota, yahan tak ke Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wala laut aaye.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ash-Shifa, Abdullah bin Hubshi, Abu Musa, Abu Sa'eed, Umm Malik Al-Bahziyyah, aur Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: meaning: Allah Mighty and Sublime is He says: 'The Mujahid in My cause, he has guarantee fro Me. If I I seize him, I cause him to inherit Paradise, and if I return him, I return him with a reward or spoils of war.'" [He said:] This Hadith is Gharib Sahih from this route
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, yani Allah Azza wa Jall farmaata hai: "Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wala mujhpar zimmedaari hai, agar main uski jaan le loon, to use Jannat ki wirasat doonga, aur agar main use wapas laaoon, to use ajr ya maal-e-ghanimat ke saath wapas laaoonga." Unhon ne kaha: Ye is tareeqe se sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Fadalah bin 'Ubaid: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The deeds of everyone who dies are sealed. Except for the one who dies guarding the frontier from the enemy, in the cause of Allah. For indeed his actions are increased for him until the Day of Judgement, and he is secure from the tribulation of the grave." And I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "The Mujahid is one who strives against his own soul." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir and Jabir. The Hadith is Fadalah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Fadalah bin Ubaid se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har marne wale ke amal par mohar lagayi jaati hai, siwaye us shakhs ke jo Allah ki raah mein sarhad ki hifazat karte hue mare, kyunki uska amal Qayamat ke din tak barhta rehta hai, aur wo qabr ke fitne se mahfooz rehta hai." Aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Mujahid wo hai jo apne nafs se jihaad kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uqbah bin Aamir aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Fadalah bin Ubaid ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Aswad : From 'Urwah [bin Az-Zubair], and Sulaiman bin Yasar, that they reported to him from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever fasts a day in the cause of Allah, Allah shall distance him from the Fire by seventy autumns." One of them said "seventy" and the other said: "forty". [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is a Gharib Hadith from this route. Abu Al-Aswad's name is Muhammad bin 'Abdur-Rahman bin Nawfal Al-Asadi Al-Madani. There are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed, Anas, 'Uqbah bin 'Amir, and Abu Umamah
hi: Abu Al-Aswad se riwayat hai, Urwah bin Az-Zubair aur Sulaiman bin Yasar se, unhon ne Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ki raah mein ek din roza rakhe, Allah use aag se sattar saal door kar deta hai." Unmein se ek ne "sattar" kaha aur doosre ne "chalis" kaha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Al-Aswad ka naam Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Nawfal Al-Asadi Al-Madani hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Anas, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri : That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "A worshipper does not fast a day in the cause of Allah except that, that day (of fasting) distances the Fire from his face by seventy autumns." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi banda Allah ki raah mein ek din roza nahi rakhta magar wo din aag ko uske chehre se sattar saal door kar deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah Al-Bahili: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever fasts a day in the cause of Allah, Allah shall put between him and the Fire a trench whose distance is like that between the heavens and the earth." This Hadith is Gharib as a narration of Abu Umamah
hi: Abu Umamah Al-Bahili se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ki raah mein ek din roza rakhe, Allah uske aur aag ke darmiyan ek khandaq bana deta hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan hai." Ye hadith Abu Umamah ki riwayat mein ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Khuraim bin Fatik: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever spends a sum in the cause of Allah, it is recorded for him seven-hundred fold." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are something on this topic from Abu Hurairah. This Hadith is Hasan, we only know of it from the narration of Ar-Rukain bin Ar-Rabi' (a narrator in the chain of this Hadith)
hi: Khuraim bin Fatik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ki raah mein kharch kare, uske liye saat sau guna likha jaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Ar-Rukain bin Ar-Rabi ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated 'Adi bin Hatim At-Tai: That he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), "Which charity is most virtuous?" He said, "The service of a worshipper in the cause of Allah, or providing the shade of tent, or mount in the cause of Allah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith has been reported from Mu'awiyah bin Salih in Mursal form.And Zaid has been contradicted concerning part of its chain. He said: And Al-Walim bin Jamil has reported this Hadith from Al-Qasim Abu 'Abdur-Rahman, from Abu Umamah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Adiyy bin Hatim At-Ta'i se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha: "Kaunsa sadqa sabse afzal hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein ek gulam ki khidmat, ya khaime ka saaya, ya Allah ki raah mein ek nar jaanwar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Muawiyah bin Salih se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai, aur Zaid ke isnad ke kuch hisse mein ikhtilaaf hua hai. Unhon ne kaha: Aur Al-Waleed bin Jameel ne ye hadith Al-Qasim Abu Abdur-Rahman se, Abu Umamah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The most virtuous of charitable spending is the shade of a tent in the cause of Allah, or giving a servant in the cause of Allah, or a riding camel in the cause of Allah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib Sahih, and it is more correct to me than the narration of Mu'awiyah bin Salih
hi: Abu Umamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse afzal sadqa Allah ki raah mein khaime ka saaya hai, ya Allah ki raah mein khaadim ka tohfa, ya Allah ki raah mein ek nar jaanwar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai, aur mere nazdeek ye Muawiyah bin Salih ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prepares a fighter in Allah's cause, he has participated in a military expedition, and whoever looks after the family of a fighter, he has participated in a military expedition." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, and it has been reported through more than one route
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne Allah ki raah mein ek jang karne wale ko taiyaar kiya, usne khud jang ki, aur jisne kisi jang karne wale ke ghar walon ki dekhbhaal ki, usne khud jang ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prepares a fighter in Allah's cause, or looks after the family of a fighter, then he has participated in a military expedition." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne Allah ki raah mein ek jang karne wale ko taiyaar kiya ya uske ghar walon ki dekhbhaal ki, usne khud jang ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said similarly
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne isi jaisi farmaya.

e: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever prepares a fighter in Allah's cause, he has participated in a military expedition, and whoever watches after the family of a fighter, he has participated in a military expedition." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne Allah ki raah mein ek jang karne wale ko taiyaar kiya, usne khud jang ki, aur jisne kisi jang karne wale ke ghar walon ki dekhbhaal ki, usne khud jang ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Yazid bin Abu Maryam: "Abayah bin Rifa'ah bin Rafi' met me while I was walking to the Friday prayer. He said: 'Have glad tidings, for indeed these footsteps of yours are in the cause of Allah. I heard Abu 'Abs say: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever get his two feet dusty in the path of Allah, then they are prohibited for the Fire.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. Abu 'Abs's name is 'Abdur-Rahman bin Jabr. There are narrations on this topic from Abu Bkar and a man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: Yazid bin Abi Maryam is a man from Ash-Sham. Al-Walid bin Muslim, Yahya bin Hamzah, and some others among the people of Ash-Sham report from him. Buraid bin Abi Maryam is form Al-Kufah. His father is one of the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) whose name was Malik bin Rabi'ah. [Buraid bin Abi Maryam heard from Anas bin Malik. Abu Ishaq Al-Hamdani, 'Ata bin As-Sa'ib, Yunus bin Abi Ishaq, and Shu'bah reported Ahadith from Buraid bin Abi Maryam]
hi: Yazid bin Abi Maryam se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Abayah bin Rifa'ah bin Rafi mujhse mile jabke main Jumme ki namaz ke liye paidal ja raha tha. Unhon ne kaha: 'Khushkhabri ho, ye tumhare qadam Allah ki raah mein hain, maine Abu Abs ko kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jiske paaon Allah ki raah mein khaak-aalood hon, wo aag par haraam hain.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Abu Abs ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Jabr hai. Is mauzu par Abu Bakr aur Nabi (SAW) ke ek Sahabi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Yazid bin Abi Maryam Shaam ke ek aadmi hain, unse Al-Waleed bin Muslim, Yahya bin Hamzah, aur Shaam ke kai doosron ne riwayat ki hai. Aur Buraid bin Abi Maryam Kufi hain, unke waalid Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se the, unka naam Malik bin Rabi'ah hai. Buraid bin Abi Maryam ne Anas bin Malik se suna, aur unse Abu Ishaq Al-Hamdani, Ata bin As-Saib, Yunus bin Abi Ishaq, aur Shu'bah ne hadithein riwayat ki hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A man who wept out of the fear of Allah shall not enter the Fire until the milk returns to the udder; and dust in the cause of Allah and the smoke of Hell shall not come together." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Muhammad bin 'Abdur-Rahman is freed slave of Abu Talhah, and he is from Al-Madinah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo aadmi jo Allah ke darr se roya, wo aag mein daakhil nahi hoga yahan tak ke doodh thanon mein wapas aa jaaye, aur Allah ki raah ki gard aur Jahannam ka dhuan kabhi ikattha nahi honge." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman, Abu Talhah ke azaad kiye gulam hain, Madine ke rehne wale.

e: Narrated Shurahbil bin As-Samt: "O Ka'b bin Murrah! Relate (something) to is from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and be cautious. He said: 'I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: "Whoever develops some gray hair in Islam, it shall be a light from him on the Day of Judgement." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Fadalah bin 'Ubaid and 'Abdullah bin 'Amr. The narration of Ka'b bin Murrah was reported like this from Al-A'mash, from 'Amr bin Murrah. This Hadith is been reported from Mansur, from Salim bin Abu Al-Ja'd, and he included a man between him and between Ka'b bin Murrah in the chain. He is called: "Ka'b bin Murrah," and he is called: "Murrah bin Ka'b Al-Bahzi," and the one known among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) is Ka'b bin Murrah Al-Bahzi, he reported some Ahadith from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Kaab bin Murrah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jiske Islam mein baal safed hue, wo Qayamat ke din uske liye ek noor honge.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Fadalah bin Ubaid aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Kaab bin Murrah ki hadith hasan hai. Isi tarah Al-A'mash ne Amr bin Murrah se ye riwayat ki hai. Aur ye hadith Mansoor se, Salim bin Abi Al-Ja'd se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur unhon ne unke aur Kaab bin Murrah ke darmiyan isnad mein ek aadmi daakhil kiya. Aur kaha jaata hai Kaab bin Murrah, aur kaha jaata hai Murrah bin Kaab Al-Bahzi, aur Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se maroof Murrah bin Kaab Al-Bahzi hain, unhon ne Nabi (SAW) se kai hadithein riwayat ki hain.

e: Narrated Amr bin 'Abasah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever develops some gray hair in the cause of Allah, it shall be a light for him in the Day of Judgement. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. As for Haiwah bin Shuraih, (the remainder of his name is) Ibn Yazid Al-Himsi
hi: Amr bin Absah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske Allah ki raah mein baal safed hue, wo Qayamat ke din uske liye ek noor honge." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Haiwah bin Shuraih, Ibn Yazid Al-Himsi hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The forelocks of horses contain good until the Day of Judgement. The horse is for three (purposes): It is for one man a reward, and it is for one man a shelter (from poverty), and it is from one man a burden. As for the one who acquires it for the cause of Allah and then prepares it for that; it is for him a reward, nothing disappears into its stomach except that Allah writes it for him as a reward." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Malik bin Anas narrated similar to this Hadith from Zaid bin Aslam from Abu Salih from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghodon ki peshaani mein Qayamat tak ke liye khair bandhi hui hai. Ghode teen tarah ke logon ke liye hote hain: kisi ke liye ajr, kisi ke liye parda, aur kisi par bojh. Jispar ajr hai wo hai jo use Allah ki raah mein rakhe aur use uske liye taiyaar kare, wo uske liye ajr hai, uske pait mein koi cheez nahi jaati magar Allah uske liye ajr likh deta hai." Aur hadith mein ek qissa hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne bhi Zaid bin Aslam se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e:
Narrated Yazid bin Abi 'Ubaid:"I said to Salamah bin Al-Akwa': "For what did you pledge to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Al-Hudaibiyyah?" He said: "For death."


This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Salamah bin Al-Akwa se kaha: 'Aap logon ne Hudaibiyah ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kis baat par bai'at ki?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maut par.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Najih As-Sulami: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "Whoever shoots an arrow in the cause of Allah, then he has the reward of freeing a slave." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Najih is 'Amr bin 'Abasah As-Sulami, and 'Abdullah bin Al-Azraq is 'Abdullah bin Zaid
hi: Abu Najih As-Sulami se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jisne Allah ki raah mein ek teer chalaaya, uske liye ek gulam azaad karne ka ajr hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai. Aur Abu Najih, Amr bin Absah As-Sulami hain, aur Abdullah bin Al-Azraq, Abdullah bin Zaid hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'There are two eyes that shall not be touched by the Fire: An eye that wept from the fear of Allah, and an eye that spent the night standing on guard in the cause of Allah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Uthman and Abu Raihanah. The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Gharib Hadith, we do not know of it except through the narration of Shu'aib bin Ruzaiq
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Do aankhein hain jinhein aag chhoo nahi sakti: ek wo aankh jo Allah ke darr se royi, aur ek wo aankh jo Allah ki raah mein raat bhar pehra deti rahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uthman aur Abu Raihanah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Shu'aib bin Ruzaiq ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Anas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Dying in the cause of Allah expiates every sin." Jibril said: "Except for debt." So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Except the debt." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ka'b bin 'Ujrah, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, and Abu Qatadah. This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it as a Hadith of Abu Bakr (a narrator) except from this Shaikh (Yahya bin Talhah) He said: I asked Muhammad bin Isma'il about this Hadith and he did not know it. He said: "I think that he intended the Hadith of Humaid, from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ) that he said: 'There is none from the people of Paradise who would like to return to the world except for the martyr
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein qatl hona har gunaah ka kaffara hai." To Jibril ne kaha: "Siwaye qarz ke." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Siwaye qarz ke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Kaab bin Ujrah, Jabir, Abu Hurairah, aur Abu Qatadah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Abu Bakr ki hadith mein sirf is shaikh ki hadith se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhen maloom nahi tha, aur unhon ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai unka irada Humaid ki, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith thi, unhon ne farmaya: 'Jannat waalon mein se koi nahi jise duniya mein wapas jaana achha lage, siwaye shaheed ke.'"

e: Narrated Ka'b bin Malik: From his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The souls of the martyrs are in green birds, suspended from the fruit of Paradise, or the trees of Paradise." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ka'b bin Malik apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shuhada ki roohein hare parindon mein hain, jo Jannat ke phalon ya Jannat ke darakhton se lataki hoti hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I was shown the first of (every) three to enter Paradise: A martyr, an 'Atif, who is a Muta'affif, and a slave who perfected his worship of Allah, and was sincere to his masters." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Jannat mein daakhil hone wale pehle teen dikhaaye gaye: shaheed, paak-daaman aadmi jo apne aap ko rokta hai, aur wo gulam jisne Allah ki achi ibadat ki aur apne maalikon ke saath khair-khwaahi ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Anas: That the Prophet (ﷺ), "There is no person who dies having good (prepared for him) with Allah, who wishes to return to the world, and to have the world and all it contains, except for the martyr because of what he knows about the virtue of martyrdom. For, indeed he loves to return to the world so that he may be killed another time." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Ibn 'Umar said: "Sufyan bin 'Uyainah said: "Amr bin Dinar was older than Az-Zuhri
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi banda nahi jise Allah ke paas koi achi cheez mile aur wo duniya mein wapas jaana pasand kare, chahe use duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai wo sab mil jaaye, siwaye shaheed ke, kyunki wo shahadat ki fazilat dekhta hai, to wo duniya mein wapas jaana pasand karta hai taake wo dobara qatl ho jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha: Sufyan bin Uyainah ne kaha: Amr bin Dinar, Az-Zuhri se umar mein bade the.

e: Narrated Fadalah bin 'Ubaid: That he heard 'Umar bin Al-Khattab saying: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'The martyrs are four: A believing man whose faith is good, he meets the enemy and proves faithful to Allah until he is killed. That is the one to whom the people will raise up their eyes like this on the Day of Judgement' and he raised his head until his Qalansuwah fell - [he said:] I do not know if it was 'Umar's Qalansuwah or the Qalansuwah of the Prophet (ﷺ) that fell - he said, 'And a believing man whose faith is good (but not as brave as first), he meets the enemy, but due to cowardice, it only appears that he was struck with a thorn of an acacia tree when an unexpected arrow comes to him, yet it kills him. He is among the second level. And a believing man who has mixed righteous deed with another evil one, he meets his enemy and proves faithful to Allah until he is killed. This one is in the third level. And a believing man who wasted himself (in wrongdoing), he meets the enemy and proves faithful to Allah until he is killed. This one is in the fourth level.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, it is not known except as a narration of 'Ata bin Dinar. He said: I heard Muhammad saying: "Sa'eed bin Abi Ayyub reported this Hadith from 'Ata bin Dinar - from some Shaikhs of Khawlan - and he did not mention 'from Abu Yazid' in it." And he said: "'Ata bin Dinar; there is no harm in him
hi: Fadalah bin Ubaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne Umar bin Al-Khattab ko kehte suna: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Shuhada chaar tarah ke hain: ek Momin aadmi jiska imaan achha ho, dushman se mile aur Allah se sacha rahe yahan tak ke qatl ho jaaye, wahi hai jispar log Qayamat ke din apni aankhein isi tarah uthaayenge' - aur unhon ne apna sar utha diya yahan tak ke unki topi gir gayi - unhon ne kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom ye Umar ki topi thi ya Nabi (SAW) ki - unhon ne farmaya: 'Aur ek Momin aadmi jiska imaan achha ho, dushman se mile, magar buzdili ki wajah se aisa lage jaise uski khaal talha ke kaanton se pheenchi gayi ho, phir koi bahka hua teer aaye aur use qatl kar de, to wo doosre darje mein hai. Aur ek Momin aadmi jisne nek amal ke saath bura amal bhi mila liya ho, dushman se mile aur Allah se sacha rahe yahan tak ke qatl ho jaaye, wo teesre darje mein hai. Aur ek Momin aadmi jisne apne aap par zyaadti ki ho, dushman se mile aur Allah se sacha rahe yahan tak ke qatl ho jaaye, wo chauthe darje mein hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ata bin Dinar ki hadith se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Sa'eed bin Abi Ayyub ne ye hadith Ata bin Dinar se riwayat ki aur "Khaulan ke kuch buzurgon se" kaha, aur ismein "Abu Yazid se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur unhon ne kaha: Ata bin Dinar mein koi harj nahi.

e: Narrated Ishaq bin 'Abdullah bin Abi Talhah: That he heard Anas [bin Malik] saying: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to visit Umm Haram bint Milhan, who would offer him meals. Umm Haram was the wife of 'Ubadah bin As-Samit. Once the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited her and she provide him with some food and started inspecting this head for lice. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept and afterwards he awoke smiling. She said: 'I said: "What causes you to smile, O the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ?" He said: "Some of my followers who were displayed before me )in a dream) as fighters in Allah's cause, riding on a ship this ocean who were kings upon thrones, or like kings upon thrones." I said: "O Messenger of Allah! Supplicate to Allah to make me among them.'" So he supplicated for her. Then he lay down his head to sleep. Then he woke up and he was smiling. She said: 'So I said to him: "What causes you to smile, O the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?" He said: "Some of my followers who were displayed before me (in a dream) as fighters in Allah's cause," and he said similar to what he said earlier. She said: 'I said: "O Messenger of Allah! Supplicate to Allah to make me among them." He said: "You are the earlier ones.'" He said: "So Umm Haram rode on the sea during the time of Mu'awiyah bin Abu Sufyan. She was thrown from the riding animal after she arrived from the ocean voyage, and she died." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Umm Haram bint Milhan is the daughter of Umm Sulaim, the maternal aunt of Anas bin Malik
hi: Ishaq bin Abdullah bin Abi Talhah, Anas bin Malik se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne unhein kehte suna: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Umm Haram bint Milhan ke paas jaate the, wo unhein khaana khilaati thin. Umm Haram, Ubadah bin As-Samit ki biwi thin. Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas gaye, unhon ne unhein khaana khilaaya aur unke sar mein jooein dekhne baith gayin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) so gaye, phir hansta hua jaage. Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine kaha: Aapko kis baat par hansi aa rahi hai, Ya Rasool Allah? Unhon ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke kuch log mere saamne is samundar ke beech safar karte hue Allah ki raah mein jang karte pesh kiye gaye, takhton par baadshahon jaise, ya baadshahon jaise takhton par.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Allah se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi unmein shaamil kare.' To unhon ne unke liye dua ki, phir apna sar rakh kar so gaye, phir hansta hua jaaga. Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine unse kaha: Aapko kis baat par hansi aa rahi hai, Ya Rasool Allah? Unhon ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke kuch log mere saamne Allah ki raah mein jang karte pesh kiye gaye,' pehli baar jaisi baat kahi. Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Allah se dua kijiye ke mujhe bhi unmein shaamil kare.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tum pehlon mein se ho.'" Unhon ne kaha: To Umm Haram ne Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ke zamane mein samundar ka safar kiya, jab wo samundar se nikli to apni sawaari se gir gayin aur intiqaal kar gayin. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Umm Haram bint Milhan, Umm Sulaim ki behen hain, aur Anas bin Malik ki khaala hain.

e: Narrated Abu Musa: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about a man who fights out of bravery, one who fights out of protection (for himself or others), and one who fought to be seen. Which of them is in the cause of Allah ? He said: 'Whoever fought so that the Word of Allah is supreme, then he is in Allah's cause.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from 'Umar. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Musa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya us aadmi ke baare mein jo bahaduri ke liye ladta hai, jo hamiyat ke liye ladta hai, aur jo dikhawe ke liye ladta hai, in mein se kaunsa Allah ki raah mein hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo isliye lade ke Allah ka kalima buland rahe, wo Allah ki raah mein hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Deeds are but with intentions, and for the man is only what he intended. So one whose emigration was to Allah and His Messenger, then his emigration was to Allah and His Messenger. And one whose emigration was to the world, to attain some of it, or woman, to marry her, then his emigration was to what he emigrated. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Malik bin Anas, Sufyan Ath-Thawri and more than one of the A'immah narrated this Hadith from Yahya bin Sa'eed. And we do not know of it except as a narration from Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari. 'Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi said: "It is necessary that we put this Hadith in every chapter
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amal to sirf niyaton par hain, aur har aadmi ke liye wahi hai jiski usne niyat ki. To jiski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf ho, uski hijrat Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf hi hai, aur jiski hijrat duniya haasil karne ke liye ya kisi aurat se nikah karne ke liye ho, uski hijrat usi cheez ki taraf hai jiske liye usne hijrat ki." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Malik bin Anas, Sufyan Ath-Thawri, aur kai imamon ne ye Yahya bin Sa'eed se riwayat ki hai, aur hum ise sirf Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari ki hadith se jaante hain. Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne kaha: "Chahiye ke hum ye hadith har baab mein rakhein."

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah is better that the world and what is in it. And the place (the size) of a whip in Paradise is better than the world and what is in it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Ayyub, and Anas. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein subah nikalna duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur Jannat mein ek koday jitni jagah duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Ayyub, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah and Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah, or in the afternoon, is better than the world and what is in it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. The Abu Hazim who reported from Ashl bin Sa'd is Abu Hazim Az-Zahid. He is from Al-Madinah, and his name is Salamah bin Dinar. While [this] Abu Hazim who reported from Abu Hurairah is Abu Hazim Al-Ashja'i Al-Kufi, whose name is Salman, and he is the freed slave of 'Azzah Al-Ashja'iyyah
hi: Abu Hurairah aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein subah ya shaam nikalna duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Hazim jinhon ne Sahl bin Sa'd se riwayat ki, wo Abu Hazim Az-Zahid hain, Madine ke rehne wale, unka naam Salamah bin Dinar hai. Aur ye Abu Hazim jinhon ne Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, wo Abu Hazim Al-Ashja'i Al-Kufi hain, unka naam Salman hai, aur wo Azzah Al-Ashja'iyyah ke azaad kiye gulam hain.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: A man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by ravine containing a small spring of thirst quenching water, so he was amazed by how pleasant it was. So he said: 'I should leave the people and stay in this ravine. But I will not do it until I seek permission from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).' So he mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: 'Do not do so. For indeed one of you standing in the cause of Allah is more virtuous that his Salat in his house for seventy years. Do you not love that Allah forgive your sins and admit you into Paradise ? Then fight in the cause of Allah, for whoever fights in Allah's cause for the time it takes for two milkings of a camel, then Paradise is obligatory for him.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se ek aadmi ek ghaati se guzra jismein meethe paani ka ek chashma tha, uske husn ne unhein khush kar diya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Kaash main logon se alag hokar isi ghaati mein reh jaaun, lekin main aisa tab tak nahi karunga jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat na le loon.' To unhon ne ye baat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr ki, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Aisa mat karo, kyunki tum mein se kisi ka Allah ki raah mein khada hona uske ghar mein sattar saal namaz padhne se afzal hai. Kya tumhein pasand nahi ke Allah tumhein maaf kare aur tumhein Jannat mein daakhil kare? Allah ki raah mein jihaad karo, jo Allah ki raah mein itni der jang kare jitni der oontni ka doodh nikalne mein lagti hai, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Anas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "To go out in the cause of Allah in the morning, or the afternoon, is better than the world and what is in it. And the space that a bow of one of you - or the space that his hand - would occupy in Paradise is better than the world and what is in it. And if a woman among the women inhabiting Paradise were to appear to the people of the earth, then she would illuminate what is between the ( the heavens and the earth), and a pleasant scent would fill up what is between them, and the scarf on her head is better than the world and what is in it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein subah ya shaam nikalna duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur tum mein se kisi ki kamaan jitni jagah ya haath jitni jagah Jannat mein duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai. Aur agar Jannat ki auraton mein se koi aurat zameen ki taraf jhaanke, to wo unke darmiyan ki har cheez roshan kar de aur unke darmiyan ki har cheez khushbu se bhar de, aur uske sar ka rumaal duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Shall I not inform you of the best of the people ? A man who takes hold of the reins of his horse in Allah's cause. Shall I not inform you of the one who comes after him ? The man who secludes himself from the people with a small group of sheep of his, thereby fulfilling Allah's right. Shall I not inform you about the worst of the people ? A man who is asked by (the Name of) Allah, but not given by Him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib from this route. This Hadith has been reported through other routes from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein sabse behtareen aadmi na bataaun? Wo aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein apne ghode ki lagaam thaame hue hai. Kya main tumhein uske baad wale ke baare mein na bataaun? Wo aadmi jo apni chhoti si bakriyon ke saath alag rehta hai, unmein Allah ka haq ada karta hai. Kya main tumhein sabse bure aadmi ke baare mein na bataaun? Wo aadmi jisse Allah ke naam par maanga jaaye lekin wo uske naam par na de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Abi Umamah bin Sahl bin Hunaif: From his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever asks Allah for Martyrdom sincerely in his heart, Allah will grant the status of martyrdom for him, even if he were to die in his bed." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib as a narration of Sahl bin Hunaif. We do not know of it except from the report of 'Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih. 'Abdullah bin Salih reported it from 'Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih, and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih's kunyah is Abu Shuriah, and he is from Iskandarani. There is something on this topic from Mu'adh bin Jabal
hi: Sahl bin Abi Umamah bin Sahl bin Hunaif apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se sacche dil se shahadat maange, Allah use shuhada ke darje pahuncha deta hai, chahe wo apne bistar par hi mare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Sahl bin Hunaif ki hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abdullah bin Salih ne bhi Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih se ye riwayat ki hai, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Shuraih ki kuniyat Abu Shuraih hai, wo Iskandarani hain. Is mauzu par Mu'adh bin Jabal se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Mu’adh bin Jabal : That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever asks Allah to be killed in His cause sincerely from his heart, Allah shall give him the reward of martyrdom. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se sacche dil se uski raah mein qatl hona maange, Allah use shaheed ka ajr deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There are three for whom it is a right upon Allah to help him: The Mujahid in the cause of Allah, the Mukatab who intends to fulfill (the Kitabah), and the one getting married who intends chastity." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen log hain jinki madad karna Allah par haq hai: Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wala, wo mukatab jo ada karna chahta ho, aur wo nikah karne wala jo paak-daamani chahta ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "None is wounded in Allah's cause - and Allah knows better about who has been injured in His cause - except that he will come on the Day of Resurrection with his wound the color of blood but its scent will be the scent of musk." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. It has been reported through other routes from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Allah ki raah mein zakhmi nahi hota - aur Allah zyada jaanta hai ke uski raah mein kaun zakhmi hua - magar wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke rang khoon ka hoga aur khushbu mishk ki hogi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Mu’adh bin Jabal : That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Whoever fought in the cause of Allah - a Muslim man - for the time it takes for two milkings of a camel, then Paradise is obligatory for him. And whoever suffered a wound in the cause of Allah, or he suffers from an injury, then he will come on the Day of Resurrection while (his blood will be) more copius that it ever was, its color the color of saffron, and its scent like that of musk." This Hadith is Sahih
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Musalman aadmi Allah ki raah mein itni der jang kare jitni der oontni ka doodh nikalne mein lagti hai, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai. Aur jo Allah ki raah mein zakhmi ho ya koi museebat jhele, to wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uska khoon jitna zyada tha usse bhi zyada, uska rang zafraan jaisa aur uski khushbu mishk jaisi hogi." Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: 'Which deed is the most virtuos ? And which deed is the best ?' He (ﷺ) said: 'Faith in Allah and His Messenger.' It was said: 'Then what ?' He said: 'Jihad is the hump (the most prominent) of the deeds.' Then what O Messenger of Allah ? He said: 'Then Hajj Mabrur.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, it has been reported through other routes from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya: Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai? Ya kaunsa amal sabse behtareen hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah aur uske Rasool par imaan.' Pucha gaya: 'Phir kya?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Jihaad, jo amal ki koohaan hai.' Pucha gaya: 'Phir kya, Ya Rasool Allah?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Phir Hajj-e-Mabroor.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa Al-Ash'ari: "I heard my father saying in the presence of the enemy: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed, the gates of Paradise are under the shadows of the swords.'" A man among the people with ragged appearance said: 'Have you heard what you mentioned from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ?' He said: 'Yes.' So he returned to his comrades and bid them Salam (farewell), broke the sheath of his sword, and began fighting with it until he was killed." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Sahih Gharib. We do not know it except as a narration of Ja'far bin Sulaiman [Ad-Dubai']. (One of the narrators) Abu 'Imran Al-Jawni's name is 'Abdul Malik bin Habib. As for Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa, Ahmad bin Hanbal said: "That is his name
hi: Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa Al-Ash'ari se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine apne waalid ko dushman ke saamne kehte suna: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat ke darwaze talwaron ke saaye tale hain.'" To ek phate-purane libaas wale aadmi ne kaha: "Kya aapne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sunaa?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." To wo apne saathiyon ki taraf laut gaya aur kaha: "Main tumhein salaam kehta hoon." Aur usne apni talwar ki miyaan tod di aur usse ladta raha yahan tak ke qatl ho gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ja'far bin Sulaiman Ad-Dubai ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abu Imran Al-Jauni ka naam Abdul Malik bin Habib hai. Aur Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa - Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: yehi unka naam hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri : that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Which of the people are most virtuous?" He said: "A man who take part in Jihad in Allah's cause." They said: "Then whom?" He said: "Then a believer who stays in one of the mountains path out of Taqwa for his Lord, leaving the people secure from his evil." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya: Log mein sabse afzal kaun hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad kare.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Phir kaun?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Phir wo Momin jo kisi ghaati mein apne Rab se dar kar rahe aur logon ko apni buraai se mehfooz rakhe.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "None of the people of Paradise would wish to return to the world except for the martyr who indeed would love to return to the world saying that he would love to be killed ten times in Allah's cause because of what he has seen of the honor that He has given him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat waalon mein se koi nahi jise duniya mein wapas jaana achha lage, siwaye shaheed ke, wo duniya mein wapas jaana chahega, kahega: 'Yahan tak ke main das martaba Allah ki raah mein qatl ho jaaun,' us izzat ki wajah se jo Allah ne use di hai aur jo wo dekhta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Another chain from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ) with similar in its meaning. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Al-Miqdam bin Ma'diykarib: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "There are six things with Allah for the martyr. He is forgiven with the first flow of blood (he suffers), he is shown his place in Paradise, he is protected from punishment in the grave, secured from the greatest terror, the crown of dignity is placed upon his head - and its gems are better than the world and what is in it - he is married to seventy two wives along Al-Huril-'Ayn of Paradise, and he may intercede for seventy of his close relatives." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Al-Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaheed ke liye Allah ke paas chhe khasiyaten hain: khoon ke pehle qatre ke saath uski maghfirat ki jaati hai, use Jannat mein uski jagah dikhayi jaati hai, use qabr ke azaab se bachaaya jaata hai, use sabse bade khauf se mahfooz rakha jaata hai, uske sar par waqar ka taaj rakha jaata hai jiska ek yaqoot duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, uska nikah Hoor-ul-Ain ki bahattar biwiyon se kiya jaata hai, aur usse apne bahattar rishtedaaron ki sifarish karne ki ijazat di jaati hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Sahl bin Sa'd: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "(Ribat) Guarding the frontier for a day in the cause of Allah is better than the world and what is in it. And an afternoon the worshipper spends in the cause of Allah - or a morning - is better than the world and what is on it. And the space occupied by the whip of one of you in Paradise is better than the world and what is on it." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein ek din sarhad ki hifazat karna duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur tum mein se kisi ke koday jitni jagah Jannat mein duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur banda Allah ki raah mein jo shaam ya subah guzaare, wo duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir: "Salman Al-Farisi passed by Shurahbil bin As-Simt while he was in garrison in which he and his companions were suffering from difficulties. He said to him: 'Shall I narrate to you - O Ibn As-Simt - a Hadith I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ?' He said: 'Of course.' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "(Ribat) Guarding the frontier for a day in the cause of Allah is more virtuous" - and perhaps he said: "better, than fasting a month and standing (in prayer) for it. And whoever dies in it, he is protected from the trials of the grave, and his deeds (continuously) multiplied until the Day of Resurrection. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan
hi: Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Salman Al-Farisi, Shurahbil bin As-Simt ke paas se guzre, jabke wo apni sarhad ki chowki par the aur unpar aur unke saathiyon par sakhti thi. Unhon ne kaha: 'Kya main tumhein na sunaaun, Ae Ibn As-Simt, ek hadith jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Kyun nahi.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Allah ki raah mein ek din sarhad ki hifazat karna afzal hai' - aur shayad unhon ne kaha: 'behtar hai' - 'ek mahine ke roze aur qayaam se, aur jo ismein mar jaaye, use qabr ke fitne se bachaaya jaata hai aur uska amal Qayamat ke din tak barhta rehta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever meets Allah without any traces from Jihad he meets Allah with a defect. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib as a narration of Al-Walid bin Muslim from Isma'il bin Rafi'. Isma'il bin Rafi' was graded weak by some of the people of Hadith. I heard Muhammad saying: "He is trustworthy, average (Muqarib) in Hadith." This Hadith has been reported from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ) through other than this route. Regarding the Hadith of Salman, its chain is not connected, Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir did not see Salman Al-Farisi. This Hadith has been reported from Ayyub bin Musa, from Makhul, from Shurahbil bin As-Simt from Salman, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se jihaad ka koi asar liye bagair mile, wo Allah se is haal mein milega ke usmein ek khaami hogi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Al-Waleed bin Muslim ki, Ismail bin Rafi se, riwayat mein ghareeb hai. Aur Ismail bin Rafi ko kuch ahl-e-hadith ne kamzor qarar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: "Wo thiqah, hadith mein ausat darje ke hain." Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqe se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai. Aur Salman ki hadith ka isnad muttasil nahi, Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir ne Salman Al-Farisi ko nahi paaya. Aur ye hadith Ayyub bin Musa se, Makhul se, Shurahbil bin As-Simt se, Salman se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Salih, the Freed slave of Uthman : "I heard Uthman while on the Minbar saying: 'I did not inform you about a Hadith I had heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), out of dismay that you might part from me. Then it occurred to me that I should narrate to you so that one may choose from these matters accordingly. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "(Ribat) Guarding the frontier for a day in Allah's cause is beter in status than thousand days doing other than that.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. Muhammad bin Ism'ail said: "Abu Salih, the freed slave of 'Uthman's name is Burkan
hi: Abu Salih, Uthman bin Affan ke azaad kiye gulam, se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Uthman ko mimbar par kehte suna: 'Maine tumse ek hadith chhupayi jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi, isliye ke tum mujhse alag na ho jao, phir mujhe khayaal aaya ke main tumhein wo sunaaun taake har aadmi apne liye jo chaahe wo chun le. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: Allah ki raah mein ek din sarhad ki hifazat karna baaqi jagahon mein hazaar din se behtar hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: Uthman ke azaad kiye gulam Abu Salih ka naam Turkan hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The martyr does not sense the touch of death except as one of you senses the touch of a (bug) bite. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib Sahih
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaheed ko qatl ka jo ehsaas hota hai wo bas itna hai jitna tum mein se kisi ko kisi cheez ke chubhne ka ehsaas hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Umamah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "There is nothing more beloved to Allah than two drops and two traces: A teardrop shed out of fear of Allah, and a drop of blood shed in Allah's cause. As for the two traces: A trace resulting in Allah's cause, and and a trace resulting from one of the duties that Allah made obligatory." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib
hi: Abu Umamah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek do boondon aur do nishaanon se zyada mehboob koi cheez nahi: Allah ke darr se aansu ki boond, aur Allah ki raah mein bahaaya gaya khoon ka qatra. Aur do nishaanon mein se: Allah ki raah ka nishaan, aur Allah ke faraayez mein se kisi farz ka nishaan." Unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Bring me a shoulder blade or tablet." Then he wrote: Not equal are those of believers who sit. 'Amr bin Umm Maktum who was behind him said: "Is there an exemption for me?" So the following was revealed: Except those who are disabled. There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, Jabir and Zaid bin Thabit. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih and it is a Hadith that is Gharib from the narration of Sulaiman At-Taimi from Abu Ishaq. And Shu'bah and Ath-Thawri reported this Hadith from Abu Ishaq
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere paas kandhe ki haddi ya takhti laao." To unhon ne likhwaaya: "(Momino mein se baithne wale barabar nahi hain)." Aur Amr bin Umm Maktum unke peeche the, unhon ne kaha: "Kya mere liye koi rukhsat hai?" To naazil hui: "(Siwaye un logon ke jo apang hain)." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Jabir, aur Zaid bin Thabit se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Sulaiman At-Taimi ki, Abu Ishaq se riwayat mein ghareeb hai. Aur Shu'bah aur Ath-Thawri ne bhi Abu Ishaq se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: A man came to Prophet (ﷺ) seeking permission to go for Jihad. So he said: 'Do you have parents (living)? ' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then it is for them that you should perform Jihad.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. (One of the narrators) Abul-Abbas is the blind (Al-A'ma) poet (Ash-Sha'ir), from Makkah, and his name is As-Sa'ab bin Farrukh
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jihaad ki ijazat maangne, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya tumhare waalidain hain?' Usne kaha: 'Haan.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To unhi ke saath jihaad karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Abbas, ye andhe shayar hain, Makki, unka naam As-Saib bin Farrukh hai.

e: Narrated Al-Hajjaj bin Muhammad: That Ibn Juraij commented on Allah's saying: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and those in authority among you. He said: "Abdullah bin Hudhafah bin Qais bin 'Adi As-Sahmi was sent by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) over a military expedition. I was informed of that by Ya'la bin Muslim, from Sa'eed bin Jubair, from Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. We do not know if it except as a narration of Ibn Juraij
hi: Al-Hajjaj bin Muhammad se riwayat hai ke Ibn Juraij ne Allah Ta'ala ke qaul "(Allah ki farmaanbardaari karo aur Rasool ki farmaanbardaari karo aur apne mein se ikhtiyaar walon ki)" ke baare mein kaha: "Abdullah bin Hudhafah bin Qais bin Adiyy As-Sahmi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek dasta par bheja." Mujhe ye Ya'la bin Muslim ne, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, Ibn Abbas se bataya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Juraij ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If the people knew what I know about being alone, then a rider would not journey at night." - meaning alone
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar log wo jaanein jo main akela hone ke baare mein jaanta hoon, to koi sawaar akela raat mein safar na kare." Yani akele.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The (lone) rider is a Shaitan, and two raiders are two Shaitan. Three is a travelling party. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar (no, 1673) is Hasan Sahih. We do not know of it except from this route ; as a narration of 'Asim. And he is Ibn Muhammad bin Zaid bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar. Muhammad said: "He is trustworthy, truthful. And 'Asim bin 'Umar Al-'Umari is weak in Hadith, I do not report anything from him." The Hadith of 'Abdullah bin 'Amr (no. 1674) is better
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Akela sawaar Shaitan hai, aur do sawaar do Shaitan hain, aur teen ek qaafila hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se, Aasim ki hadith se jaante hain, aur wo Muhammad bin Zaid bin Abdullah bin Umar ke bete hain. Aur Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan hai. Muhammad ne kaha: Wo thiqah, sachche hain. Aur Aasim bin Umar Al-Umari hadith mein kamzor hain, main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta. Aur Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "War is deceit." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Zaid bin Thabit, 'Aishah, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Asma' bint Yazid bin As-Sakan, Ka'b bin Malik and Anas bin Malik. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jang chaal hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Zaid bin Thabit, Aishah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Asma bint Yazid bin As-Sakan, Ka'b bin Malik, aur Anas bin Malik se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Ishaq: "I was next to Zaid bin Arqam when he was asked: 'How many battles did the Prophet (ﷺ) fight ?' He said: 'Nineteen.' So I said: 'How many battles did you take part in with him ?' he said: 'Seventeen.' I said: 'Which of them was the first?' He said: 'Dhat Al-Ushaira' or Al-'Usaira'. '" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Ishaq se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Zaid bin Arqam ke paas baitha tha, unse pucha gaya: 'Nabi (SAW) ne kitni ghazwe ladi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Unnees.' Maine kaha: 'Aapne unke saath kitni ladi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Satrah.' Maine kaha: 'Inmein se pehli kaunsi thi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Dhat Al-Ushaira ya Al-Usaira.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) positioned us during the night at Badr." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Abu Ayyub. This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route. I asked Muhammad bin Isma'il about this Hadith, but he did not know it, and he said: "Muhammad bin Ishaq heard from 'Ikrimah." And when I saw him, he had a good opinion about Muhammad bin Humaid Ar-Razi, then he considered him weak later
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Awf se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne humein Badr mein raat ko taiyaar kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Maine Muhammad bin Ismail se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhen ye maloom nahi tha, aur unhon ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Ishaq ne Ikrimah se suna." Aur jab maine unhein dekha, unki Muhammad bin Humaid Ar-Razi ke baare mein achi raay thi, phir baad mein unhon ne unhein kamzor qarar diya.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Awfa: "I heard him saying" - meaning the Prophet (ﷺ) - "while supplicating against the Ahzab: 'O Allah, Revealer of Book! Severe is reckoning! Rout the Ahzab and shake them.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn Masu'd This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Abi Awfa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine unhein" - yani Nabi (SAW) ko - "Ahzab ke khilaaf dua karte suna, unhon ne farmaya: 'Ya Allah! Kitab naazil karne wale, jaldi hisaab lene wale! Ahzab ko shikast de. Ya Allah! Unhein shikast de aur unhein hila de.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered Makkah, and his standard was white." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do know of it except as a narration of Yayha bin Adam from Sharik. He said: I asked Muhammad about this Hadith, but he did not know it except as a narration of Yahya bin Adam from Sharik, he said: "More than one narrator has narrated to us from Sharik from 'Ammar bin Abu Az-Zubair from Jabir: 'The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Makkah and he was wearing a black 'Imamah.'" Muhammad said: "This is the Hadith." [Abu 'Eisa said:] Duhn is a branch of Bajilah (the tribe), and 'Ammar ad-Duhni (one of the narrators) is 'Ammar bin Mu'awiyah Ad-Duhni, and his kunyah is Abu Mu'awiyah, he is from Al-Kufah, and he is trustworthy according to the people of Hadith
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue jabke unka jhanda safed tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Yahya bin Adam ki, Shareek se riwayat se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhen ye sirf Yahya bin Adam ki, Shareek se riwayat se maloom tha, aur unhon ne kaha: "Humein kai logon ne Shareek se, Ammar se, Abu Az-Zubair se, Jabir se bataya ke Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue jabke unpar ek kaali pagdi thi." Muhammad ne kaha: "Yehi hadith hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Duhn, Bajilah qabile ki ek shaakh hai, aur Ammar Ad-Duhni, Ammar bin Muawiyah Ad-Duhni hain, unki kuniyat Abu Muawiyah hai, wo Kufi hain, aur ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hain.

e: Narrated Yunus bin 'Ubaid: the freed salve of Muhammad bin Al-Qasim said: "Muhammad bin Al-Qasim sent me to Al-Bara' bin 'Azib to ask him about the flag of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: 'It was a black square of Namirah.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Al-Harith bin Hassan, and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we don know know of it except from the report of Ibn Abi Za'idah. And Abu Ya'qub Ath-Thaqafi's name is Ishaq bin Ibrahim. 'Ubaidullah bin Musa also reports from him
hi: Yunus bin Ubaid, Muhammad bin Al-Qasim ke azaad kiye gulam, se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Al-Qasim ne mujhe Al-Bara bin Aazib ke paas bheja ke unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jhande ke baare mein pucha jaaye. Unhon ne kaha: 'Wo kaala aur chaukor tha, ek dhaari daar chaadar se bana hua.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Al-Harith bin Hassan, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibn Abi Za'idah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abu Ya'qub Ath-Thaqafi ka naam Ishaq bin Ibrahim hai, unse Ubaidullah bin Musa ne bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The flag of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was black, and his standard was white." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib from this route, as a narration of Ibn 'Abbas
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka jhanda kaala tha aur unka standard safed tha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se, Ibn Abbas ki hadith mein, hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Al-Muhallab bin Abi Sufrah: From one who heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: "If you suffer a surprise attack from the enemy then say: 'Ha Min, they will not be victorious.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Salamah bin Al-Akwa'. This is how some of them reported it from Abu Ishaq, the same as the narration of Ath-Thawri. And it has been reported from him, from Al-Muhallab bin Abi Sufrah from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form
hi: Al-Muhallab bin Abi Sufrah se, kisi ne jisne Nabi (SAW) ko sunaa, riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Agar dushman tumpar raat mein achaanak hamla kare, to kaho: 'Ha-Mim, unhein madad nahi milegi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Salamah bin Al-Akwa se bhi riwayat hai. Isi tarah kuch logon ne Abu Ishaq se, Ath-Thawri ki riwayat jaisi, riwayat ki hai, aur unse, Al-Muhallab bin Abi Sufrah se, Nabi (SAW) se, mursal bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated 'Uthman bin Sa'd: That Ibn Sirin said: "I made my sword like the sword of Samurah bin Jundab. Samurah claimed that he made his sword like the sword of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and it was a Hanafiyah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except through this route. Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan has criticized 'Uthman bin Sa'd the scribe, and he graded him weak due to his memory
hi: Ibn Sirin se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine apni talwar Samurah bin Jundab ki talwar ki tarah banaayi, aur Samurah ka dawa tha ke unhon ne apni talwar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki talwar ki tarah banaayi thi, aur wo Hanafiyah thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Qattan ne Uthman bin Sa'd Al-Katib ke baare mein baat ki hai aur unki hifz ki wajah se unhein kamzor qarar diya.

e: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri : "During the year of the conquest, when the Prophet (ﷺ) reached Marr Zahran, he told us that we would meet the enemy. So he ordered us to break the fast, and we [all] broke our fast." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, and there is something on this topic from Ibn 'Umar
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) fatah ke saal Marr Az-Zahran pahunche, to unhon ne humein dushman se mulaaqaat ki khabar di, to unhon ne humein roza todne ka hukum diya, aur hum sab ne roza tod diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The Prophet (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talhah called Mandub. He said: 'There is nothing to be frightened of, and we found him to be (quick) like the sea.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Ibn 'Amr Al-'As
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Abu Talhah ke ek ghode par sawaar hue jise Mandub kaha jaata tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Koi khauf ki baat nahi thi, aur humne use samundar jaisa tez paaya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Amr bin Al-As se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "There was a cause of fright in Al-Madinah. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) borrowed a horse of ours called Mandub. He said: 'I have not seen anything to be frightened of, and we found him to be (quick) like the sea.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Madina mein khauf phaila, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humara ek ghoda udhaar liya jise Mandub kaha jaata tha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Humne koi khauf ki baat nahi dekhi, aur humne use samundar jaisa tez paaya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Prophet (ﷺ) was the nicest person among the people, the most generous of the people, and the bravest among the people." He said: "The inhabitants of Al-Madinah became freightened one night upon hearing a loud noise." He said: "So the Prophet (ﷺ) met them upon an unsaddled horse belonging to Abu Talhah, with a sword hanging around his neck. He said: 'I found him to be (quick) like the sea.'" - meaning the horse. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) logon mein sabse zyada bahadur, sabse zyada sakhi, aur sabse zyada bahaadur the." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur ek raat Madina waale khauf-zada ho gaye jab unhon ne ek awaaz suni." Unhon ne kaha: "To Nabi (SAW) unse Abu Talhah ke bagair-zeen ghode par mile, apni talwar gale mein daale hue, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Dar mat, dar mat.'" To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine use samundar jaisa paaya," yani ghode ko. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Ishaq: From Al-Bara' bin 'Azib who said: "A man said to us: 'Did you flee from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) O Abu 'Umarah ?'" He said: "No, By Allah! I did not flee from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but som hasty people fled and (the tribe of) Hawazin assaulted them with arrows. The Messenger of Allah (Saws) was on his white muls, and Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin 'Abdul Muttalib was holding its reigns. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was saying: 'I am the Prophet without lie, I am the son of 'Abdul-Muttalib.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, and Ibn 'Umar
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne humse kaha: 'Kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bhaag gaye the, Ae Abu Umarah?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne peeth nahi phera, lekin jaldi baaz log peeth pher gaye the, Hawazin ne unpar teeron se hamla kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne khachchar par the, aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul-Muttalib uski lagaam thaame hue the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) farma rahe the: Main Nabi hoon, jhoot nahi, main Abdul-Muttalib ka beta hoon.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "Indeed we saw the day of Hunain, and indeed the two armies fled from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and there did not remain one hundred men with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib as a narration of 'Ubaidullah. We do not know of it except from this route
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine humein Hunain ke din dekha, dono giroh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se peeth pher gaye the, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath sau aadmi bhi nahi bache the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, Ubaidullah ki riwayat mein, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Talib bin Hujair: From Hud bin 'Abdullah bin Sa'd, from his grandfather Mazidah, who said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of the Conquest and there was gold and silver on his sword." Talib said: "So I asked him about the silver and he said: 'The hand-guard of his sword was of silver.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic form Anas. This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Hud's (great) grandfather's name is Mazidah Al-'Asari
hi: Talib bin Hujair se riwayat hai, Hud bin Abdullah bin Sa'd se, apne dada Mazidah se, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) fatah ke din daakhil hue jabke unki talwar par sona aur chandi tha." Talib ne kaha: To maine unse chandi ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: "Talwar ki mooth chandi ki thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Hud ke dada ka naam Mazidah Al-Asari hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The hand-guard on the sword of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was made from silver." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. This is how it has been reported from Hamam from Qatadah from Anas. While some of them reported it from Qatadah, from Sa'eed bin Abu Al-Hasan who said: "The hand-guard on the sword of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was made from silver
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki talwar ki mooth chandi ki thi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Isi tarah Hammam se, Qatadah se, Anas se riwayat hui hai. Aur kuch logon ne Qatadah se, Sa'eed bin Abi Al-Hasan se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki talwar ki mooth chandi ki thi.

e: Narrated Az-Zubair bin Al-'Awwam: "On the Day of Uhud, the Prophet (ﷺ) wore two coats of mail. He tried to get up on a boulder but was not able to, so Talhah squatted under him, lifting the Prophet (ﷺ) upon it such that he could sit on the boulder. So he said: (Paradise) "It is obligated from Talhah.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Safwan bin Umayyah and As-Sa'ib bin Yazid. This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except through the narration of Muhammad bin Ishaq
hi: Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Uhud ke din Nabi (SAW) ne do zirahein pehni thin, wo ek chattaan par chadhne ki koshish ki lekin nahi chad sake, to Talhah unke neeche baith gaye, Nabi (SAW) unpar chadhe yahan tak ke chattaan par seedhe khade ho gaye, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: Talhah ne wajib kar liya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Safwan bin Umayyah aur As-Sa'ib bin Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Muhammad bin Ishaq ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) entered (Makkah) during they year of the Conquest, and upon his head was a helmet (Mighfar). It was said to him: 'Ibn Khatal is clinging to the covering of the Ka'bah.' So he said: 'Kill him.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. We do knot know of anyone important who reported it other than Malik from Az-Zuhri
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) fatah ke saal daakhil hue jabke unke sar par khod thi. Unse kaha gaya: 'Ibn Khatal Ka'bah ke pardon se lataka hua hai.' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Use qatl karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, humein Malik ke siwa, Az-Zuhri se riwayat karne wala koi bada raawi maloom nahi.

e: Narrated 'Urwah Al-Bariqi: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Goodness will remain in the forelocks of horses until the Day of Judgement: (They bring about) Rewards and spoils of war." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Abu Sa'eed, Jarir, Abu Hurairah, Asma' bin Yazid, Al-Mughira bin Shu'bah, and Jabir. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. 'Urwah is Ibn Al-Ja'd Al-Bariqi, and they say he is 'Urwah bin Al-Ja'd. Ahmad bin Hanbal said: "The Fiqh of this Hadith is that Jihad is with every Imam until the Day of Judgement
hi: Urwah Al-Bariqi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khair Qayamat tak ghodon ki peshaani mein bandhi hui hai: ajr aur maal-e-ghanimat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Sa'eed, Jarir, Abu Hurairah, Asma bint Yazid, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Urwah, Ibn Al-Ja'd Al-Bariqi hain, aur kaha jaata hai Urwah bin Al-Ja'd. Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Is hadith ka fiqh ye hai ke jihaad Qayamat tak har imam ke saath hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The blessing of the horse is in its redness." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route, from the narration of Shaiban
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghode ki barkat uske laal rang mein hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se, Shaiban ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Abu Qatadah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The best horse is the black one with a spot on the face, and white on the upper lip. Then the one with some white on his lower legs, except for the right. So if it is no black, then the Kumait (red one with black on its ears and its mane) with these markings
hi: Abu Qatadah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen ghoda wo kaala hai jiski peshaani par safed nishaan ho aur oopar ka honth safed ho, phir wo jiske safed nishaan ho aur pindli safed ho, siwaye dahine ke. Aur agar kaala na ho, to laal-bhoora ho isi nishaan ke saath."

e: Another chain with similar meaning. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib Sahih
hi: Isi jaisi, isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) disliked Shikal in horses. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Shu'bah reported similarly from 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Khath'ami, from Abu Zur'ah (one of the narrators in the chain of this Hadith), from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ). Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir's name is Harim. Muhammed bin Hammad Ar-Razi narrated to us (he said): "Jarir narrated to us from 'Umarah bin Al-Qa'qa' who said: 'Ibrahim An-Nakha'i said to me: "When you narrate from me, then narrate from me from Abu Zur'ah, for one time he narrated a Hadith to me, then I asked him about it two years later, and he did not leave a letter out of it
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ghodon mein "shikaal" ko napasand kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah ne bhi Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Khath'ami se, Abu Zur'ah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Zur'ah bin Amr bin Jarir ka naam Harim hai. Muhammad bin Humaid Ar-Razi ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Jarir ne humein Umarah bin Al-Qa'qa se bataya, unhon ne kaha: Ibrahim An-Nakha'i ne mujhse kaha: "Jab tum mujhse riwayat karo, to Abu Zur'ah se riwayat karo, kyunki unhon ne mujhe ek baar ek hadith sunaayi, phir maine unse kai saal baad wahi hadith pucha, to unhon ne usmein ek harf bhi kam nahi kiya."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) arranged for the Mudammar among horses to race from Al-Hafiya' to Thaniyyah Al-Wada', between which was a distance of six miles. And for whatever horse was not among the Mudammar, they raced from Thaniya Al-Wada' to the Masjid of Banu Zuraiq, between which was a distance of a mile. I was among those who raced, and my horse jumped along with me over a wall." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah, Jabir, Anas, and 'Aishah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a narration of Ath-Thawri
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taiyaar kiye hue ghodon ki daud Al-Hafiya se Thaniyyat-ul-Wida tak karwaayi, jinke darmiyan chhe meel ka faasla tha, aur bagair taiyaar kiye ghodon ki Thaniyyat-ul-Wida se Banu Zuraiq ki Masjid tak, jinke darmiyan ek meel ka faasla tha. Aur main un mein se tha jinhon ne daud lagayi, mera ghoda ek deewar par se kood gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Jabir, Aishah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith Ath-Thawri ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "No stake is acceptable except in archery, racing a camel, and racing a horse
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi shart-bandi jaayez nahi siwaye teer-andaazi, oont ki daud, ya ghode ki daud ke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was a slave (of Allah), who would order as he has ben ordered to. He did not give an order to us instead of the people regarding anything except for three: He ordered us that we make our Wudu' well (Isbagh), that we not eat from charity, and the we not mate a donkey with a horse." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from 'Ali. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported this from Abu Jahdam, who said: "From 'Ubaidullah bin 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas, from Ibn 'Abbas." He said I heard Muhammad saying: "The narration of Ath-Thawri is not preserved. Ath-Thawri made a mistake in it. What is correct is what Ismail bin 'Ulaiyyah and 'Abul-Warith bin Sa'eed reported from Abu Jahdam, from 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaidullah bin 'Abbas from Ibn 'Abbas
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Allah ke ek hukum maanne wale banda the, unhon ne humein logon se alag koi khaas hukum nahi diya siwaye teen cheezon ke: unhon ne humein hukum diya ke hum wuzu poora karen, hum sadqe ka khaana na khaayen, aur hum gadhe ko ghodi par na chadhaayen." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne ye Abu Jahdam se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Abbas se, Ibn Abbas se." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: Ath-Thawri ki hadith mehfooz nahi, Ath-Thawri ne isme ghalti ki, aur sahih wo hai jo Ismail bin Ulayyah aur Abdul-Warith bin Sa'eed ne Abu Jahdam se, Abdullah bin Ubaidullah bin Abbas se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Ad-Darda': That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: "Seek your weak for me. For indeed you sustenance and aid is only by your weak." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Ad-Darda se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Mere liye apne kamzoron ko talaash karo, kyunki tumhein rizq aur madad tumhare kamzoron ki wajah se hi milti hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "The angels do no accompany a group among whom there is a dog or a bell." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Umm Habibah, and Umm Salamah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farishte us qaafile ke saath nahi hote jismein kutta ya ghanti ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Aishah, Umm Habibah, aur Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' : "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent two armies, place 'Ali bin Abi Talib as the commanded of one of them, and Khalid bin Al-Walid over the other. He said: 'Where there is fighting, then 'Ali (is in command).'" He said: "So 'Ali conquered a fortress and took a slave girl. Khalid [bin Al-Walid] wrote a letter and sent me with it to the Prophet (ﷺ), to speak against him for it. So I arrived to the Prophet (ﷺ) to read the letter. The color of his face changed, the he said: 'What do you think about a man who loves Allah and His Messenger, and Allah and His Messenger love him?'" He said: "I said: 'I seek refuge from angering Allah and angering His Messenger, I am only the Messenger.' So he was silent. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something about this from Ibn 'Umar. This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from the narration of Al-Ahwas bin Jawwab. And his saying: "To speak against him for that." refers to An-Namimah
hi: Al-Bara se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne do lashkar bheje, ek par Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko ameer banaya aur doosre par Khalid bin Al-Waleed ko, aur farmaya: "Jab jang ho, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ameer honge." Unhon ne kaha: To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne ek qila fatah kiya aur usmein se ek laundi li, to Khalid bin Al-Waleed ne mere saath Nabi (SAW) ko khat bheja jismein unki chughli ki. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, unhon ne khat padha, to unka rang badal gaya, phir unhon ne farmaya: "Us aadmi ke baare mein tumhara kya khayaal hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah aur uska Rasool bhi usse mohabbat karte hain?" Unhon ne kaha: Maine kaha: "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon Allah ke gusse aur uske Rasool ke gusse se, main to bas ek paigham pahunchaane wala hoon." To wo khaamosh ho gaye. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Ahwas bin Jawwab ki hadith se jaante hain. Unke qaul "chughli ki" ka matlab hai: aisi baat jo fasaad daale.

e:
