Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "None is wounded in Allah's cause - and Allah knows better about who has been injured in His cause - except that he will come on the Day of Resurrection with his wound the color of blood but its scent will be the scent of musk."


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. It has been reported through other routes from the Prophet (ﷺ).
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Allah ki raah mein zakhmi nahi hota - aur Allah zyada jaanta hai ke uski raah mein kaun zakhmi hua - magar wo Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke rang khoon ka hoga aur khushbu mishk ki hogi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Umm Al-Husain Al-Ahmasiyyah: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivering Khutbah during the farewell Hajj, and he was wearing a Burd which he had wrapped from under his armpit." She said: "I was look at muscle of his upper arm quivering and I heard him saying: O you people! Have Taqwa of Allah. If a mutilated Ethiopian slave is put in command over you, then listen to him and obey him, as long as he upholds the Book of Allah among you.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and 'Irbad bin Sariyah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, it has been reported through other routes from Umm Husain
hi: Umm Al-Husain Al-Ahmasiyyah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hajjat-ul-Wida mein khutba dete suna, unhon ne ek chaadar pehni hui thi jise unhon ne apni baghal ke neeche se lapeta hua tha." Unhon ne kaha: "To main unke baazu ke mansal ko hilta hua dekh rahi thi, maine unhein kehte suna: 'Ae logo! Allah ka taqwa ikhtiyar karo, aur agar tumpar ek kaat-chhat waala Habshi gulam ameer banaya jaaye, to uski baat suno aur maano, jab tak wo tumhare darmiyan Allah ki Kitab qaayam rakhe.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Irbad bin Sariyah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Umm Husain se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Hearing and obeying is required from every Muslim man - in what he like and what he dislikes - as long as he is not ordered with disobedience. If he is ordered with disobedience, then no hearing or obeying is required of him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, 'Imran bin Husain, and Al-Hakam bin 'Amr Al-Ghifari. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sunna aur maanna Musalman aadmi par farz hai, chahe use pasand ho ya napasand, jab tak use gunaah ka hukum na diya jaaye. Agar use gunaah ka hukum diya jaaye, to na sunna hai na maanna." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Imran bin Husain, aur Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Yahya:From Mujahid from Ibn 'Abbas who said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited instigating fights between beasts
hi: Abu Yahya se, Mujahid se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jaanwaron ke darmiyan ladaane se mana kiya.

e:
Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri :that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: "Which of the people are most virtuous?" He said: "A man who take part in Jihad in Allah's cause." They said: "Then whom?" He said: "Then a believer who stays in one of the mountains path out of Taqwa for his Lord, leaving the people secure from his evil." 


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya: Log mein sabse afzal kaun hai? Unhon ne farmaya: 'Wo aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein jihaad kare.' Unhon ne kaha: 'Phir kaun?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Phir wo Momin jo kisi ghaati mein apne Rab se dar kar rahe aur logon ko apni buraai se mehfooz rakhe.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited branding on the face and striking (it)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne chehre par daagh lagaane aur chehre par maarne se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e:
Another chain from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ) with similar in its meaning.


[Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah: That he heard is father, narating a Hadith, which he heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in which he stood among them, mentioning to them that Jihad in the cause of Allah and faith in Allah were the most virtuous of deeds. Then a man stood and said: "O Messenger of Allah! If I were killed in the cause of Allah, would my sins forgiven ?" So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Yes, If you are killed in Allah's cause, and you are patient, seeking the reward, advancing, not fleeing." Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "What was it that you said?" So he replied: "If I were killed in the cause of Allah, would my sins be removed (forgiven)?" So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Yes, If you are patient, seeking the reward, advancing, not fleeing - except debt. For Jibril said that to me." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Anas, Muhammad bin Jahsh, And Abu Hurairah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Some of them reported this Hadith from Sa'eed Al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ) similar to this. Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari and more than one narrator reported this from Sa'eed Al-Maqburi from 'Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah, from his fahter, from the Prophet (ﷺ). This is more correct than the narration of Sa'eed Al-Maqburi from Abu Hurairah
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne unhein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye hadith bayan karte suna ke wo unke darmiyan khade hue aur unhein bataya ke Allah ki raah mein jihaad aur Allah par imaan sabse afzal amal hain. To ek aadmi khada hua aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar main Allah ki raah mein qatl ho jaaun, to kya mere gunaah maaf ho jaayenge?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, agar tum Allah ki raah mein qatl ho jao, sabr karte hue, ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue, aage badhte hue, peeth na pherte hue." Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne kya kaha tha?" Maine kaha: "Agar main Allah ki raah mein qatl ho jaaun, to kya mere gunaah maaf ho jaayenge?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, agar tum sabr karte hue, ajr ki ummeed rakhte hue, aage badhte hue, peeth na pherte hue ho, siwaye qarz ke, kyunki Jibril ne mujhse ye kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Muhammad bin Jahsh, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Ansari aur kai doosron ne isi jaisi Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur ye Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ki, Abu Hurairah se riwayat se zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Hisham bin 'Amr: "On the day of Uhud, the wounded complained to the Messenger of Allah, so he said: 'Dig, and make it wide, and appropriate, and bury two and three in one grave. And advance the one who knew the most Qu'ran.' My father had died so he placed before two men." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Khabbab, Jabir, and Anas. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Sufyan Ath-Thawri and others reported this Hadith from Ayyub, from Humaid bin Hilal, from Hisham bin 'Amir. And Abu Ad-Dahma's (a narrator in the chain) name is Qirfah bin Buhais or Baihas
hi: Hisham bin Aamir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Uhud ke din zakhmiyon ki shikaayat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Qabrein khodo, unhein wasee aur achi banaao, aur do ya teen ko ek hi qabr mein dafn karo, aur jise sabse zyada Quran yaad ho use aage rakho.'" To mere waalid ka intiqaal hua, to unhein do aadmiyon ke aage rakha gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Khabbab, Jabir, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur doosron ne ye hadith Ayyub se, Humaid bin Hilal se, Hisham bin Aamir se riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Ad-Dahma ka naam Qirfah bin Buhais ya Baihas hai.

e: Narrated Abu 'Ubaidah: That 'Abdullah said: "On the Day of Badr when the captives were gathered, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'What do you (people) say about these captives?'" Then he mentioned the story in the lengthy Hadith. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations of this topic from 'Umar, Abu Ayyub, Anas, and Abu Hurairah This Hadith is Hasan, and Abu 'Ubaidah did not hear from his father. It has been reported that Abu Hurairah said: "None was more apt to seek council of his Companions than the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Badr ka din hua aur qaidiyon ko laaya gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'In qaidiyon ke baare mein tumhara kya khayaal hai?'" Phir unhon ne is hadith mein ek lambi kahaani zikr ki. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Abu Ayyub, Anas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan hai, aur Abu Ubaidah ne apne waalid se suna nahi. Aur Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada apne Sahaba se mashwara karte nahi dekha."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The idolaters wanted to purchase the body of a man who was from the idolaters. But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused to trade with them [for him]." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from a narration of Al-Hakam. Al-Hajjaj bin Artah also reported it from Al-Ahkam. Ahmad bin Al-Hasan said: "I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal saying: 'Ibn Abi Laila's narrations are not used as proof." Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "Ibn Abi Laila is truthful, but his correct Ahadith are not recognizable from his weak ones. And I do not report anything from him." Ibn Abi Laila is truthful, and Faqih, the problem is only in the chain. Nasr bin 'Ali narrated to us, [he said:] "Abdullah bin Dawud narrated us, from Sufyan Ath-Thawri who said: 'Our Fuqaha' are Ibn Abi Laila and 'Abdullah bin Shubrumah
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke mushrikeen ne mushrikeen mein se ek aadmi ki laash khareedni chaahi, lekin Nabi (SAW) ne unhein wo bechne se inkar kar diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Hakam ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Hajjaj bin Artaah ne bhi Al-Hakam se ye riwayat ki hai. Aur Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ne kaha: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Ibn Abi Laila ki riwayaton se dalil nahi li jaati." Aur Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: "Ibn Abi Laila sachche hain, lekin unki sahih hadith unki kamzor hadith se pehchaani nahi jaati, aur main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta." Aur Ibn Abi Laila sachche, faqeeh hain, unhein sirf isnad mein galtiyaan hoti hain. Nasr bin Ali ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Abdullah bin Dawud ne Sufyan Ath-Thawri se bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Humare fuqaha Ibn Abi Laila aur Abdullah bin Shubrumah hain."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Messenger of Allah sent us on a military expedition, and the people turned to escape. So we arrived in Al-Madinah and concealed ourselves in it and we said: 'We are ruined.' Then we went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and we said: 'O Messenger of Allah! We are those who fled.' He said: 'Rather you are Al-'Akkarun (those who are regrouping) and I am your reinforcement. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. We do not know of it except as a narration of Yazid bin Abi Ziyad. And the meaning of his saying: "The people turned to escape" is that they fled from the fighting. As for the meaning of his saying: "Rather you are Al-'Akkarun," the 'Akkar is the one who flees to his Imam in order that he may help him, it does not mean fleeing from the advancing army
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ek dasta mein bheja, to log peeth pher kar bhaag gaye. Hum Madina aaye aur wahan chhup gaye aur kaha: 'Hum barbaad ho gaye.' Phir hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Hum wo hain jo bhaage.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, balki tum wapas aane wale ho, aur main tumhara giroh hoon.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Yazid bin Abi Ziyad ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur unke qaul "log peeth pher kar bhaag gaye" ka matlab hai ke wo jang se bhaag gaye. Aur unke qaul "balki tum wapas aane wale ho" ka matlab: "Al-Akkar" wo hai jo apne imam ki taraf bhaag kar aata hai taake uski madad kare, uska irada jang se bhaagne ka nahi hota.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "On the day of Uhud, my father's sister came with my father to bury him in a cemetery of ours. So one of the callers of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called out: 'Return those killed to where they were lying." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. And (one of the narrators) Nubaih is trustworthy
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Uhud ka din hua, to meri phuphi mere waalid ko lekar aayi taake unhein humari qabron mein dafn karein, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke munaadi ne pukaara: 'Maqtoolon ko unki jagah wapas kar do.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Nubaih thiqah hain.

e: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) arrived from Tabuk, the people went out to Thaniyyah Al-Wada' to meet him." As-Sa'ib said: "I went out with the people, and I was a boy." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Tabuk se laute, to log unhen Thaniyyat-ul-Wida tak milne ke liye nikle." As-Sa'ib ne kaha: "To main bhi logon ke saath nikla, main us waqt ek larka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab: "The wealth of Banu An-Nadir was among the spoils of war which Allah granted upon His Messenger (ﷺ) which the Muslims did not gain with the rush of their horses nor camel. So it was purely for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would set aside a year's worth of expenditure for his family, then he would use what remained of it for horses and weapons to be used in Allah's cause." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Sufyan bin 'Uyainah reported this Hadith from Ma'mar, from Ibn Shihab
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Banu An-Nadir ka maal un maalon mein se tha jo Allah ne apne Rasool ko diya, jinhein Musalmanon ne na ghode se na oont se haasil kiya, aur wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye khaas tha. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne ghar walon ka ek saal ka kharcha alag rakhte, phir jo baaqi rehta use Allah ki raah mein jaanwaron aur hathiyaron ke saaz-o-samaan mein lagaate." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Sufyan bin Uyainah ne ye hadith Ma'mar se, Ibn Shihab se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Wearing silk and gold has made unlawful for the males of my Ummah and lawful for its females. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, 'Uqbah bin 'Amir, Anas, Umm Hani, Hudhaifah, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, 'Imran bin Husain, 'Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, Jabir, Abu Raihanah, Ibn 'Umar, Al-Bara', and Wathilah bin Al-Asqa', and this Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Resham aur sone ka pehnna meri Ummat ke mardon par haraam kiya gaya hai aur unki auraton ke liye halal kiya gaya hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Uqbah bin Aamir, Anas, Umm Hani, Hudhaifah, Abdullah bin Amr, Imran bin Husain, Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, Jabir, Abu Raihanah, Ibn Umar, Al-Bara, aur Wathilah bin Al-Asqa se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Musa ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Suwaid bin Ghafalah: That 'Umar gave a Khutbah at Al-Jabiyah and he said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited silk except for two finger's worth of space, or three, or four." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Suwaid bin Ghafalah se riwayat hai ke Umar ne Al-Jabiyah mein khutba diya aur kaha: "Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne resham se mana kiya siwaye do ungliyon, teen, ya chaar ungliyon jitni jagah ke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That 'Abdur Rahman bin 'Awf and Az-Zubair bin Al-'Awwam complained of lice to the Prophet (ﷺ) during a battle that they participated in. So he permitted them to wear silk shirts. He (Anas) said: "I saw them wearing them." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Abdur-Rahman bin Awf aur Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam ne apni ek ghazwe mein Nabi (SAW) se jooon ki shikaayat ki, to unhon ne unhein resham ke kurte pehenne ki rukhsat di. Unhon ne kaha: Maine unhein wo pehne dekha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Waqid bin 'Amr bin Sa'd bin Mu'adh: "Anas bin Malik arrived. So I went to him and he said: 'Who are you ?' I said: 'I am Waqid bin 'Amr [bin Sa'd bin Ma'adh].'" He said: "So he began to cry and he said: 'You resemble Sa'd. Sa'd was one of the greatest people, and of the tallest. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sent a cloak of Dibaj with gold woven into it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wore it and ascended the Minbar. Then he stood, or sat, and the people began touching it, and they said: 'We never saw a garment like this before today.' So he said: 'Are you amazed at this ? The handkerchiefs of Sa'd in Paradise are better than what you see.'" He said: There is something on this topic from Asma' bint Abu Bakr. This Hadith is Sahih
hi: Waqid bin Amr bin Sa'd bin Muaz se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Anas bin Malik aaye, to main unke paas gaya, unhon ne kaha: 'Tum kaun ho?' Maine kaha: 'Main Waqid bin Amr bin Sa'd bin Muaz hoon.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To wo rone lage aur kaha: 'Tum Sa'd se milte julte ho, aur Sa'd logon mein sabse tagde aur sabse lambe the, aur unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek jubbah bheja tha jo dibaj ka tha jismein sona buna hua tha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use pehna aur mimbar par chadhe, khade hue ya baithe, to log use chhoone lage aur kaha: Humne aaj jaisa kapda kabhi nahi dekha.'" To unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tum ise dekh kar hairaan ho? Sa'd ke Jannat mein ke rumaal is se behtar hain jo tum dekh rahe ho." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Asma bint Abi Bakr se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' : "I have not seen anyone with hair past his shoulders in a red Hullah more handsome than the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He had hair that would flow on his shoulders, (and he had) broad shoulders (and he was) not too short and not too long." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jabir bin Samurah, Abu Rimthah, and Abu Juhaifah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Al-Bara se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kisi lambe baal wale ko surkh hullah mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zyada khoobsurat nahi dekha, unke baal unke kandhon tak jaate the, unke kandhe chaude the, na wo choTe the na lambe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir bin Samurah, Abu Rimthah, aur Abu Juhaifah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Ali: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited wearing Al-Qassi and what was dyed with 'Usfur." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Anas and 'Abdullah bin 'Amr
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe Al-Qassi aur kusum se range hue kapde pehnne se mana kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Salman: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about fat, cheese, and furs, so he said: 'The lawful is what Allah made lawful in His Book, the unlawful is what Allah made unlawful in his Book, and what He was silent about; then it is among that for which He has pardoned.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There is something on this topic from Al-Mughirah, and this Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it being Marfu' except from this route. Sufyan and others reported it from Sulaiman At-Taimi, from Abu 'Uthman, from Salman as his own saying. It is as if the Mawquf narration is more correct. I asked Al-Bukhari about this Hadith and he said: 'I do not think it is preserved. Sufyan reported it from Sulaiman At-Taimi from Abu 'Uthman, from Salman in Mawquf form.' Al-Bukhari said: "Saif bin Harun is Muqarib (Average) in Hadith, and as for Saif bin Muhammad from 'Asim, his narrations are left
hi: Salman se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ghee, panir, aur khaal ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Halal wahi hai jo Allah ne apni Kitab mein halal kiya, aur haraam wahi hai jo Allah ne apni Kitab mein haraam kiya, aur jis cheez ke baare mein wo khaamosh raha, wo un cheezon mein se hai jinhein usne maaf kar diya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Al-Mughirah se bhi riwayat hai, aur ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise marfu' sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Sufyan aur doosron ne Sulaiman At-Taimi se, Abu Uthman se, Salman se, unka apna qaul riwayat ki hai, aur goya mauqoof hadith zyada sahih hai. Maine Al-Bukhari se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi lagta ye mehfooz hai. Sufyan ne Sulaiman At-Taimi se, Abu Uthman se, Salman se mauqoof riwayat ki." Al-Bukhari ne kaha: "Saif bin Harun hadith mein ausat darje ke hain, aur Saif bin Muhammad, Aasim se, unki hadith chhodi jaati hai."

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "A sheep died so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to its owners: 'Why dont you remove its skin, then tan it so you can have something useful from it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Salamah bin Al-Muhabbaq, Maimunah, and 'Aishah. The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is Hasan Sahih. Similar to this has been reported through other routes from Ibn 'Abbas from the Prophet (ﷺ). And it has been related from Ibn 'Abbas from Maimunah, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and, it has been related from him from Sawdah. I heard Muhammad saying the Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas from Maimunah from the Prophet (ﷺ) were correct. And he said: "It implies that it was reported from Ibn 'Abbas from Maimunah from the Prophet (ﷺ), and that Ibn 'Abbas reported it from the Prophet (ﷺ), and he did not mention Maimunah in it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, and it is the view of Sufyan At-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, and Ishaq
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek bakri mar gayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske maalikon se kaha: 'Kya tumne uski khaal nahi utaari, phir use rangaa, phir usse faida uthaaya?'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Salamah bin Al-Muhabbaq, Maimunah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur isi jaisi doosre tareeqon se bhi Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai. Aur Ibn Abbas se, Maimunah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur unse Sawdah se bhi riwayat hui hai. Maine Muhammad ko Ibn Abbas ki, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith aur Ibn Abbas ki, Maimunah se, hadith ko sahih qaraar dete suna, aur unhon ne kaha: "Mumkin hai Ibn Abbas ne ise Maimunah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki ho, aur Ibn Abbas ne ise Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat ki ho aur usmein Maimunah ka zikr nahi kiya ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, aur ye Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, Ash-Shafi'i, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Any skin tanned, then it has been made pure." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge, they say that when the skin of a dead animal has been tanned then it has been made pure. [Abu 'Eisa said:] Ash-Shafi'i said: "Any dead animals skin that is tanned, then it has been made pure, except for the dog and the pig." Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) disliked skins of predators even when tanned, and this is the view of 'Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ahmad and Ishaq, and they were firm about not wearing them and performing Salat in them. Ishaq bin Ibrahim said: "The saying of the Prophet (ﷺ):'Any skin that is tanned, then it has been made pure' only refers to the skins of animals whose meat is eaten." This is how it was explained by An-Nasr bin Shumail
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi khaal rangi jaaye, wo paak ho jaati hai." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo kehte hain: Mari hui jaanwar ki khaal jab rangi jaaye, to wo paak ho jaati hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: "Jo bhi mari hui jaanwar ki khaal rangi jaaye, wo paak ho jaati hai, siwaye kutte aur suar ke." Aur unhon ne isi hadith se dalil li. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba aur doosron ne, shikaari jaanwaron ki khaalon ko napasand kiya chahe wo rangi hui hon, aur ye Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Ahmad, aur Ishaq ka qaul hai, unhon ne inhein pehnne aur inmein namaz padhne mein sakhti ki. Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke qaul "Jo bhi khaal rangi jaaye, wo paak ho jaati hai" ka matlab sirf un jaanwaron ki khaal hai jinka gosht khaaya jaata hai. Isi tarah An-Nasr bin Shumail ne iski tafseer ki hai. Aur Ishaq ne kaha: An-Nasr bin Shumail ne kaha: "Ihaab" sirf un jaanwaron ki khaal ko kaha jaata hai jinka gosht khaaya jaata hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim: "A letter came from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Do not use the skins of dead animals, nor tendons.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. This Hadith has been related to 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim from some Shuyukh of his, and this is not acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge. And this Hadith has been related from 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim, that he said: "A letter came to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) two months before he died." He said: I heart Ahmad bin Al-Hasan saying: "Ahmad bin Hanbal followed this Hadith due to it mentioning that it was two months before he (ﷺ) died. Then Ahmad left this Hadith because of their Idtirab in its chain, since some of them reported it, saying: 'From 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim from some Shuyukh of his from Juhainah
hi: Abdullah bin Ukaim se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek khat aaya: 'Mari hui jaanwar ki khaal aur pattho se faida na uthaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ye Abdullah bin Ukaim se unke kuch buzurgon ke hawaale se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal nahi. Aur ye hadith Abdullah bin Ukaim se bhi riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humare paas Nabi (SAW) ka khat unki wafaat se do mahine pehle aaya." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Ahmad bin Hanbal is hadith ki taraf jaate the kyunki usmein zikr hai ke ye unki wafaat se do mahine pehle ki baat hai, aur wo kehte the: "Ye Nabi (SAW) ka aakhri hukum tha." Phir Ahmad bin Hanbal ne is hadith ko chhod diya jab logon ne iske isnad mein ikhtilaaf kiya, kuch ne "Abdullah bin Ukaim se, unke Juhainah ke kuch buzurgon se" riwayat ki.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "On the day of judgement, Allah will not look at one who arrogantly drags his garment. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Hudhaifah, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Samurah, Abu Dharr, 'Aishah and Hubaib bin Mughfil. The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Qayamat ke din us shakhs ki taraf nazar nahi karega jo ghamand se apna kapda ghaseette." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Hudhaifah, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Samurah, Abu Dharr, Aishah, aur Hubaib bin Mughfil se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever arrogantly drags his garment, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Judgement." So Umm Salamah said: "What should the women do with their hems?" He said: "Slacken them a handspan." So she said: "Then their feet will be uncovered." He said: "Then slacken them a forearm's length and do not add to that." He said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. In the Hadith there is a concession for women to drag their Izar because it covers them better
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo ghamand se apna kapda ghaseette, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nazar nahi karega." To Umm Salamah ne kaha: "To auraten apni jhaalar ka kya karen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ek bitta neeche latka len." Unhon ne kaha: "To phir unke paaon khul jaayenge." Unhon ne farmaya: "To ek haath neeche latka len, usse zyada na karen." Unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Umm Salamah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) slackened Fatimah's garment a hand-span." [Abu 'Eisa said:] Some of them reported it from Hammad bin Salamah, from 'Ali bin Zaid, from Al-Hasan, from his father, from Umm Salamah
hi: Umm Salamah se riwayat hai: "Nabi (SAW) ne Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) ke kapde ko ek bitta neeche karne di." Abu Isa ne kaha: Kuch logon ne Hammad bin Salamah se, Ali bin Zaid se, Al-Hasan se, apni maa se, Umm Salamah se riwayat ki. Aur is hadith mein auraton ke liye izaar ghaseetne ki rukhsat hai, kyunki isse unka satar behtar dhaka jaata hai.

e: Narrated Abu Burdah: "'Aishah brought a patched woolen Kisa' (cloak), and a thick Izar, She said: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died in these.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali and Ibn Mas'ud. The Hadith if 'Aishah is Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Abu Burdah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Aishah ne humein ek band-mota oon ka libaas aur ek mota izaar nikaal kar dikhaaya aur kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki rooh in donon mein qabz hui thi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai, aur Aishah ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn Mas'ud: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "On the day of His Lord spoke to him, Musa was wearing a wool Kisa', a wool Jubbah, a wool Kummah, wool pants, and his sandals were made of the skin of a dead donkey." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except from the the narration of Humaid Al-A'raj. And Humaid - Ibn 'Ali Al-A'raj - I Heard Muhammad saying: "Humaid bin 'Ali Al-A'raj is Munkar in Hadith." While Humaid ibn Qais Al-A'raj Al-Makki, the companion of Mujahid is trustworthy. The Kummah is a small cap
hi: Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis din unke Rab ne Musa se baat ki, Musa par oon ka libaas, oon ka jubbah, oon ki topi, aur oon ki pajaama thi, aur unki chappal mari hui gadhe ki khaal ki thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Humaid Al-A'raj ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Humaid, Ibn Ali (Alayhis Salam) Al-Kufi hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: "Humaid bin Ali Al-A'raj munkar hadith wale hain, aur Humaid bin Qais Al-A'raj Al-Makki, Mujahid ke saathi, thiqah hain." Aur "Kummah" chhoti topi hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "On the day of the Conquest, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Makkah, and he was wearing a black 'Imamah." [He said:] THere are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, 'Amr bin Huraith, Ibn 'Abbas, Rukanah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith is Jabir is Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) fatah ke din Makkah mein daakhil hue jabke unpar ek kaali pagdi thi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Amr bin Huraith, Ibn Abbas, aur Rukanah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Nafi': That Ibn 'Umar said: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would wear an 'Imamah would hang between his shoulders." Nafi' said: "Ibn 'Umar would hang his 'Imamah between his shoulders." 'Ubaidullah said: "And I saw Al-Qasim and Salim doing that." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. And there is something on this topic from 'Ali. And this Hadith of 'Ali about this is not correct due to its chain
hi: Nafi se riwayat hai ke Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Jab Nabi (SAW) pagdi baandhte, to use apne dono kandhon ke darmiyan latka dete." Nafi ne kaha: Aur Ibn Umar apni pagdi apne dono kandhon ke darmiyan latka dete the. Ubaidullah ne kaha: Aur maine Al-Qasim aur Salim ko aisa karte dekha. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat hai, lekin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki is baare mein hadith apne isnad ki wajah se sahih nahi.

e: Narrated 'Ali bin Abi Talib: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited me from rings of gold, and from wearing Al-Qassi, and from reciting in the bowing and prostration positions, and from wearing what was dyed with 'Usfur." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe sone ki anguthi pehenne se, Al-Qassi pehnne se, ruku aur sajde mein Quran padhne se, aur kusum se range hue kapde pehnne se mana kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Imran bin Husain: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited us from (wearing) rings of gold." [He said:] THere are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Ibn 'Umar, Abu Hurairah, and Mu'awiyah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of 'Imran is a Hasan Hadith. Abu At-Tayyah's (a narrator) name is Yazid bin Humaid
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein sone ki anguthi pehenne se mana kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Imran ki hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu At-Tayyah ka naam Yazid bin Humaid hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Prophet (ﷺ) had ring made of silver and its stone (Fass) was Ethiopian." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar and Buraidah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib from this route
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki anguthi chandi ki thi, aur uska nagina Habashi tha." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Buraidah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The ring of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was made of silver, its Fass was from it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib from this route
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki anguthi chandi ki thi, uska nagina bhi chandi ka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) had a ring of gold made for him which he wore on his right (hand). Then he sat on the Minbar and said: 'I did indeed have this ring on my right hand' then he discarded it and the people discarded their rings." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Jabir, 'Abdullah bin Ja'far, Ibn 'Abbas, 'Aishah, and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is Hasan Sahih Hadith. This Hadith has been reported similarly from 'Nafi, from Ibn 'Umar, through routes other than this, and it was not mentioned in it that the ring was on his right hand
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek sone ki anguthi banwaayi aur use apne dahine haath mein pehna, phir mimbar par baithe aur farmaya: "Maine ye anguthi apne dahine haath mein pehni thi." Phir unhon ne use phenk diya, aur logon ne bhi apni anguthiyaan phenk din. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Abdullah bin Ja'far, Ibn Abbas, Aishah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, doosre tareeqon se bhi isi jaisi riwayat hui hai, lekin usmein ye zikr nahi kiya gaya ke unhon ne use dahine haath mein pehna.

e: Narrated As-Salt bin 'Abdullah bin Nawfal: "Ibn Abbas wore a ring on his right hand. And I do not doubt he said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing a ring on his right hand.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "The Hadith is Muhammad bin Ishaq from As-Salt bin 'Abdullah bin Nawfal is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: As-Salt bin Abdullah bin Nawfal se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abbas ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha, aur mujhe koi shak nahi ke unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Ishaq ki, As-Salt bin Abdullah bin Nawfal se, hadith hasan sahih hai."

e: Narrated Ja'far bin Muhammad : Narrated from his father who said: "Al-Hasan and Al-Husain wore their ring on their left hand." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ja'far bin Muhammad apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) apne baayen haath mein anguthi pehante the." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Hammad bin Salamah: "I saw Ibn Rafi' [and he is 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Rafi', the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) - and Aslam was the name of Ibn Abi Rafi] wearing a ring on his right, so I asked him about that. He said, 'I saw 'Abdullah bin Ja'far wearing a ring on his right hand, and he ['Abdullah bin Ja'far] said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wore a ring on his right hand." He said: Muhammad [bin Isma'il] said: "This is the most correct thing related from the Prophet (ﷺ) on this topic
hi: Hammad bin Salamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abi Rafi ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha, to maine unse iske baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Abdullah bin Ja'far ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha.'" Aur Abdullah bin Ja'far ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehante the." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: "Ye is mauzu mein sabse sahih cheez riwayat hui hai."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a ring made from silver, so he had 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah' engraved on it. Then he said: 'Do not engrave with it.' [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Sahih Hasan. As for the meaning of his saying: "Do not engrave with it" - he was prohibiting that anyone have "Muhammad, Messenger of Allah" engraved on his ring
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne chandi ki ek anguthi banwaayi aur usmein "Muhammad Rasoolullah" khudwaaya, phir farmaya: "Isi tarah koi aur na khudwaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hasan hai. Aur unke qaul "Isi tarah koi aur na khudwaaye" ka matlab: unhon ne mana kiya ke koi apni anguthi par "Muhammad Rasoolullah" khudwaaye.

e: Narrated Anas: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the area in which he would relieve himself, he would remove the ring." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab bait-ul-khala mein daakhil hote, to apni anguthi utaar dete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik:"The inscription on the ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was in three lines: 'Muhammad' on a line, 'Messenger' on a line, and 'Allah' on a line
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki anguthi par khudaai teen satar mein thi: 'Muhammad' ek satar, 'Rasool' ek satar, aur 'Allah' ek satar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The inscription on the ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) was in three line: 'Muhammad' on a line, 'Messenger' on a line, 'Allah' on a line." And Muhammad bin Yahya (one of the two who narrated to him) did not say: "Three lines" in his narration. There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih Gharib
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki anguthi par khudaai teen satar mein thi: 'Muhammad' ek satar, 'Rasool' ek satar, aur 'Allah' ek satar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited having images in the house, and he prohibited making them." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Abu Talhah, 'Aishah, Abu Hurairah, and Abu Ayyub. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Jabir is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghar mein tasveer rakhne se mana kiya, aur unhein banaane se bhi mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abu Talhah, Aishah, Abu Hurairah, aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Jabir ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu An-Nadr: From 'Ubaidullah bin 'Abdullah bin 'Utbah, that he entered upon Abu Talhah Al-Ansari to pay him a visit (while he was ill), and he found Sahl bin Hunaif with him. He said: "Abu Talhah called for someone to remove a sheet that was under him. Sahl said to him: 'Why did you remove it?' He replied: 'Because it contains images on it, and the Prophet (ﷺ) said about them what you know.' Sahl said: 'Do he not say: Except for markings on a garment?' He said: 'Yes, but this is better to me.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utbah se riwayat hai ke wo Abu Talhah Al-Ansari ki bimaar-pursi ke liye unke paas gaye. Unhon ne kaha: To maine unke paas Sahl bin Hunaif ko paaya. Unhon ne kaha: To Abu Talhah ne kisi ko bulaaya taake wo unke neeche se ek chaadar hataaye. To Sahl ne unse kaha: "Aap ise kyun hata rahe hain?" Unhon ne kaha: "Kyunki ismein tasveerein hain, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unke baare mein jo kaha wo aapko maloom hai." Sahl ne kaha: "Kya unhon ne ye nahi kaha: 'Siwaye kapde par naqsh ke'?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan, lekin ye mere dil ko zyada acha lagta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever fashions an image, he will be punished by Allah until he breathes into it - meaning the soul - and he cannot breath (a soul) into it. And whoever listens to a people's conversation, while they have gone away from him for it, then He will have lead poured into his ears on the Day of Judgement." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Juhaifah, 'Aishah, and Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Abbas is a Hasan Sahih Hadith
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi tasveer banaaye, Allah use tab tak azaab dega jab tak wo usmein rooh na phoonke, aur wo usmein rooh nahi phoonk sakta. Aur jo koi kisi qaum ki baaton ko sune jabke wo usse bachte hue apni baat kar rahe hon, to Qayamat ke din uske kaan mein sisa dala jaayega." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Juhaifah, Aishah, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Abbas ki hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Change the gray, and do not resemble the Jews." He said: There are narration on this topic from Az-Zubair, Ibn 'Abbas, Jabir, Abu Dharr, Anas, Abu Rimthah, Al-Jahdamah, Abu At-Tufail, Jabir bin Samurah, Abu Juhaifah, and Ibn 'Umar. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Hadith, and it has been reported through other routes from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Safed baalon ko badlo, aur Yahudiyon jaisa mat bano." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Az-Zubair, Ibn Abbas, Jabir, Abu Dharr, Anas, Abu Rimthah, Al-Jahdamah, Abu At-Tufail, Jabir bin Samurah, Abu Juhaifah, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Abu Hurairah ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Abu Hurairah se doosre tareeqon se bhi, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Dharr: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed the best of what the gray may be changed with is Henna' and Katam." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dili's (a narrator in this chain) name is Zalim bin 'Amr bin Sufyan
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Safed baalon ko badalne ke liye sabse achi cheez mehndi aur katam hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dili ka naam Zalim bin Amr bin Sufyan hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was of average height, neither tall nor very short, he had a good build, brown in complexion, his hair was neither curly nor straight, and when he walked he swayed slightly." He said: There are narration on this topic from 'Aishah, Al-Bara', Abu Hurairah, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, Wa'il bin Hujr, and Umm Hani'. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Anas is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith from this route, as a narration of Humaid
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) darmiyani qad ke the, na lambe na choTe, jism ke achhe, rang ke saanwle, unke baal na ghunghraale the na seedhe, jab wo chalte to thoda jhoomte." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Al-Bara, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, Wa'il bin Hujr, aur Umm Hani se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Anas ki hadith is tareeqe se, Humaid ki hadith mein, hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would perform Ghusl using (water from) the same vessel. He had hair reaching above his shoulders and below his earlobes." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. [Abu 'Eisa said:] It has been reported from other routes that 'Aishah said: "I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would perform Ghusl using (water from) the same vessel." And the following statement is not mentioned in it: "He had hair reaching above his shoulders [and below his earlobes'." It was only mentioned by 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Az-Zinad, and he is trustworthy, a Hafiz, and Malik bin Anas stated that he was trustworthy and ordered recording (Ahadith) from him
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the, aur unke baal kandhon se kuch neeche aur kaan ki lau se upar tak the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi Aishah se riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek hi bartan se ghusl karte the," lekin unhon ne isme ye harf zikr nahi kiya: "unke baal kandhon se kuch neeche aur kaan ki lau se upar tak the." Aur Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Az-Zinad thiqah hain, Malik bin Anas unhein thiqah maante the aur unse likhne ka hukum dete the.

e:
Narrated Umm Al-Husain Al-Ahmasiyyah:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivering Khutbah during the farewell Hajj, and he was wearing a Burd which he had wrapped from under his armpit." She said: "I was look at muscle of his upper arm quivering and I heard him saying: O you people! Have Taqwa of Allah. If a mutilated Ethiopian slave is put in command over you, then listen to him and obey him, as long as he upholds the Book of Allah among you.'"


 There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and 'Irbad bin Sariyah. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, it has been reported through other routes from Umm Husain.
hi: Umm Al-Husain Al-Ahmasiyyah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hajjat-ul-Wida mein khutba dete suna, unhon ne ek chaadar pehni hui thi jise unhon ne apni baghal ke neeche se lapeta hua tha." Unhon ne kaha: "To main unke baazu ke mansal ko hilta hua dekh rahi thi, maine unhein kehte suna: 'Ae logo! Allah ka taqwa ikhtiyar karo, aur agar tumpar ek kaat-chhat waala Habshi gulam ameer banaya jaaye, to uski baat suno aur maano, jab tak wo tumhare darmiyan Allah ki Kitab qaayam rakhe.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah aur Irbad bin Sariyah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Umm Husain se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e:
Narrated Ibn 'Umar:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Hearing and obeying is required from every Muslim man - in what he like and what he dislikes - as long as he is not ordered with disobedience. If he is ordered with disobedience, then no hearing or obeying is required of him."


 There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, 'Imran bin Husain, and Al-Hakam bin 'Amr Al-Ghifari. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sunna aur maanna Musalman aadmi par farz hai, chahe use pasand ho ya napasand, jab tak use gunaah ka hukum na diya jaaye. Agar use gunaah ka hukum diya jaaye, to na sunna hai na maanna." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Imran bin Husain, aur Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited two types of dress: As-Sama', and that a man sits with his legs drawn up in a garment, while there is nothing covering his private area. [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Ibn 'Umar, 'Aishah, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, and Abu Umamah. The Hadith if Abu Hurairah is a Hasan Sahih Gharib Hadith from this route. This has been reported through other routes from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne do tarah ke pehnaawon se mana kiya: "As-Samma" aur ye ke aadmi apne kapde mein aise baithe ke uski sharamgah par kuch na ho. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Umar, Aishah, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abu Hurairah ki hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai, aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Allah has cursed the woman who artificially lengthens and the woman who seeks to have her hair artificially lengthened, and the woman who tattoos and the woman who seeks tattooed." Nafi' (one of the narrators) said: "Tattooing was on the gums." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud, 'Aishah, Asma' bint Abi Bakr, Ma'qil bin Yasar, Ibn 'Abbas, and Mu'awiyah
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne baal jodne wali aur jodwaane wali par, aur gudwaane wali aur gudaane wali par la'nat ki." Nafi ne kaha: Gudaai masoodon mein hoti thi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Mas'ud, Asma bint Abi Bakr, Ibn Abbas, Ma'qil bin Yasar, aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited riding (while sitting on) Miyathir." [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali and Mu'awiyah. The Hadith if Al-Bara' is Hasan Sahih. Shu'bah reported similarly from Ash'ath bin Abi Ash-Sha'tha' in the lengthy Hadith
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein 'Miyathir' par sawaari karne se mana kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Aur hadith mein ek qissa hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Muawiyah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Al-Bara ki hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah ne bhi Ash'ath bin Abi Ash-Sha'tha se isi jaisi riwayat ki, aur hadith mein ek qissa hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The only bed that the Messenger of Allah had which he slept was [made of a tanned skin] stuffed with palm-fibres." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He Said: There are narrations on thus topic from Hafsah and Jabir
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ka bistar jispar wo sote the, chamde ka tha jismein khajoor ke resho ki bharaai thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Hafsah aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Umm Salamah: "The most loved garment to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the Qamis (long shirt)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. We only know of it as a narration of 'Abdul-Mu'min bin Khalid (a narrator in the chain of this Hadith) who was alone in narrating it, and he is from Al-Marwaz. Some of them report this Hadith from Abu Tumailah, from 'Abdul-Mu'min bin Khalid, from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah, from his mother, from Umm Salamah. He said: I heard Muhammad bin Ism'ail saying: "The narration of Ibn Buraidah from his mother, from Umm Salamah is more correct, Abu Tumailah mentioned 'his mother' in it
hi: Umm Salamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ko sabse pyara kapda qamees tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdul-Mu'min bin Khalid ki hadith se jaante hain, wo isme akele hain, aur wo Marwazi hain. Aur kuch logon ne ye hadith Abu Tumailah se, Abdul-Mu'min bin Khalid se, Abdullah bin Buraidah se, apni maa se, Umm Salamah se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Umm Salamah:"The most loved garment to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the Qamis (long shirt)
hi: Umm Salamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ko sabse pyara kapda qamees tha." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: "Ibn Buraidah ki, apni maa se, Umm Salamah se, hadith zyada sahih hai, Abu Tumailah ne isme 'apni maa se' zikr kiya."

e: Narrated Umm Salamah:"The most loved garment to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the Qamis (long shirt)
hi: Umm Salamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse pyara kapda qamees tha."

e: Narrated Asma' bint Yazid bin As-Sakan Al-Ansariyyah:"The sleeves of (the shirt) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were to the wrist." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib
hi: Asma bint Yazid bin As-Sakan Al-Ansariyyah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aasteen kalai tak thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on a Qamis he began with the right side. [Abu 'Eisa said:] Others have reported this Hadith from Shu'bah with this chain, but they dod narrate it in Marfu' form, only 'Abdus-Samad narrated it Marfu
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab qamees pehnte, to dahini taraf se shuru karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Kai logon ne ye hadith Shu'bah se isi isnad se, Abu Hurairah se mauqoof riwayat ki, aur humein maloom nahi ke Abdus-Samad bin Abdul-Warith ke siwa kisi ne ise Shu'bah se marfu' riwayat ki ho.

e:
Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:"The idolaters wanted to purchase the body of a man who was from the idolaters. But the Prophet (ﷺ) refused to trade with them ."


 This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from a narration of Al-Hakam. Al-Hajjaj bin Artah also reported it from Al-Ahkam. Ahmad bin Al-Hasan said: "I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal saying: 'Ibn Abi Laila's narrations are not used as proof." Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "Ibn Abi Laila is truthful, but his correct Ahadith are not recognizable from his weak ones. And I do not report anything from him." Ibn Abi Laila is truthful, and Faqih, the problem is only in the chain.


Nasr bin 'Ali narrated to us,  "Abdullah bin Dawud narrated us, from Sufyan Ath-Thawri who said: 'Our Fuqaha' are Ibn Abi Laila and 'Abdullah bin Shubrumah.'"
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke mushrikeen ne mushrikeen mein se ek aadmi ki laash khareedni chaahi, lekin Nabi (SAW) ne unhein wo bechne se inkar kar diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Hakam ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Hajjaj bin Artaah ne bhi Al-Hakam se ye riwayat ki hai. Aur Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ne kaha: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Ibn Abi Laila ki riwayaton se dalil nahi li jaati." Aur Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: "Ibn Abi Laila sachche hain, lekin unki sahih hadith unki kamzor hadith se pehchaani nahi jaati, aur main unse kuch riwayat nahi karta." Aur Ibn Abi Laila sachche, faqeeh hain, unhein sirf isnad mein galtiyaan hoti hain. Nasr bin Ali ne humein bataya, unhon ne kaha: Abdullah bin Dawud ne Sufyan Ath-Thawri se bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Humare fuqaha Ibn Abi Laila aur Abdullah bin Shubrumah hain."

e: Narrated 'Urwah bin Al-Mugirah bin Shu'bah: From his father: "The Prophet (ﷺ) wore a Roman Jubbah with tight sleeves." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Urwah bin Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek Roomi jubbah pehna jiski aasteen tang thi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ash-Sha'bi: From Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah: "Dihyah Al-Kalbi gave a pair of Khuff to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so he wore them." [Abu 'Eisa said:] Isra'il said: "From Jabir, from 'Amir: 'And a Jubbah, so he wore them until they tore. And the Prophet (ﷺ) did not know whether they were from a slaughtered animal or not.'" This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Abu Ishaq, the one who reported from Ash-Sha'bi, is Abu Ishaq Ash-Shaibani, and his name is Sulaiman. Al-Hasan bin 'Ayyash is the brother of Abu Bakr bin 'Ayyash
hi: Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne kaha: "Dihyah Al-Kalbi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do khuff tohfe mein diye, to unhon ne wo pehne." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Isra'il ne Jabir se, Aamir se, "aur ek jubbah bhi diya, to unhon ne wo dono pehne yahan tak ke wo phat gaye, Nabi (SAW) ko maloom nahi tha ke wo zibah kiye hue jaanwar ke chamde se bane the ya nahi." Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Abu Ishaq jinhon ne ye Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat ki, wo Abu Ishaq Ash-Shaibani hain, unka naam Sulaiman hai, aur Al-Hasan bin Ayyash, Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ke bhai hain.

e:
Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:"When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) arrived from Tabuk, the people went out to Thaniyyah Al-Wada' to meet him." As-Sa'ib said: "I went out with the people, and I was a boy."


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Tabuk se laute, to log unhen Thaniyyat-ul-Wida tak milne ke liye nikle." As-Sa'ib ne kaha: "To main bhi logon ke saath nikla, main us waqt ek larka tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Al-Malih:"The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited predator skins." And this chain is more correct
hi: Abu Al-Malih se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) ne shikaari jaanwaron ki khaalon se mana kiya. Aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Qatadah:"I asked Anas bin Malik: 'How were the sandals of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ? He said: 'They had two straps
hi: Qatadah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Anas bin Malik se pucha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki chappal kaisi thi?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Unke do fite the.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Qatadah: From Anas: "The sandals of the Prophet (ﷺ) had two straps." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, and Abu Hurairah
hi: Qatadah, Anas se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki chappal ke do fite the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not walk in one sandal, either wear both sandals, or go barefoot." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He said: There is something on this topic from Jabir
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi ek hi chappal mein na chale, ya to dono pehne ya dono utaare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited that a man should put on sandals while he is standing." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. 'Ubaidullah bin 'Amr Ar-Raqqi reported this Hadith from Ma'mar, from Qatadah, from Anas. Both of the Ahadith are not correct according to the people of Hadith. Al-Harith bin Nabhan is not a Hafiz according to them, and we do not know any basis for the narration of Qatadah from Anas
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aadmi khada hokar chappal pehne. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ubaidullah bin Amr Ar-Raqqi ne ye hadith Ma'mar se, Qatadah se, Anas se bhi riwayat ki, aur ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek dono hadithein sahih nahi hain. Aur Al-Harith bin Nabhan unke nazdeek hafiz nahi hain, aur humein Qatadah ki, Anas se, hadith ki koi asal maloom nahi.

e: Narrated Anas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited that a man should put on sandals while he is standing." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib. Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "This Hadith is not correct, not the Hadith of Ma'mar from 'Ammar bin Abi 'Ammar, from Abu Hurairah (no)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aadmi khada hokar chappal pehne. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ubaidullah bin Amr Ar-Raqqi ne ye hadith Ma'mar se, Qatadah se, Anas se bhi riwayat ki, aur ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek dono hadithein sahih nahi hain. Aur Al-Harith bin Nabhan unke nazdeek hafiz nahi hain, aur humein Qatadah ki, Anas se, hadith ki koi asal maloom nahi.

e: Narrated 'Aishah:"Sometimes the Prophet (ﷺ) would walk in one sandal
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Kabhi kabhi Nabi (SAW) ek hi chappal mein chalte the."

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim: From his father, about 'Aishah that: "She would walk in one sandal." This is more correct. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This is how it was reported by Sufyan Ath-Thawri and others, from 'Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim, in Mawquf form, and this is more correct
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim apne walid se riwayat karte hain, Aishah ke baare mein, ke wo ek hi chappal mein chalti thin. Aur ye zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kai doosron ne Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Qasim se mauqoof riwayat ki hai, aur ye zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you dons sandals, then let him begin with the right. And when he removes them then let him begin with left, so that the right will be the first to put on and the last of them removed." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi chappal pehne, to dahine se shuru kare, aur jab utaare, to baayen se shuru kare, taake dahini pehle pehni jaaye aur aakhir mein utaari jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: 'If you want to stick with me, then suffice yourself in the world with the provisions of the rider. And beware of gatherings of the rich, and do not consider a garment to be worn out until it has been patched.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except as a narration of Salih bin Hassan. He said: I heard Muhammad bin Isma'il saying: "Salih bin Hassan is Munkar is Hadith." And Salih bin Hassan - the one who Ibn Abi Dhi'b reports from - is trustworthy. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The meaning of this saying: "And beware of gathering of the rich" is similar to what was related from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet (ﷺ), that he said: "Whoever sees one that has been more favored than him in appearance and provision, then let him look at the one who is less than him, rather than one who is favored more than him. For indeed it is more appropriate so that he not scorn Allah's favors [upon him]." And it has been related from 'Awn bin 'Abdullah who said: "I accompanied the rich, and did not see anyone with more troubles than me. I saw a beast that was better than my beast, and a garment that was better than my garment. And I accompanied the poor, and felt at ease
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Jab tum mere saath milna chaho, to duniya se sirf itna hi kaafi samjho jitna ek musafir ka safar ka saamaan hota hai, aur maal-daaron ki majlison se bacho, aur kisi kapde ko purana mat samjho jab tak use paivand na lagaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Salih bin Hassan ki hadith se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: "Salih bin Hassan munkar hadith wale hain, aur Salih bin Abi Hassan jinse Ibn Abi Dhi'b riwayat karte hain, wo thiqah hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur unke qaul "aur maal-daaron ki majlison se bacho" ka matlab, us jaisi hai jo Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne se zyada nawaazish paaye hue shakhs ko soorat aur rizq mein dekhe, to use us shakhs ki taraf dekhna chahiye jo usse kam ho, jinpar use khud fazilat haasil hai, kyunki isse zyada mumkin hai ke wo Allah ki neh'mat ko haqeer na samjhe." Aur Aun bin Abdullah bin Utbah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine maal-daaron ki sohbat ki, to mujhe apne se zyada pareshaan koi nahi mila, main dekhta ke koi jaanwar mere jaanwar se behtar hai aur koi kapda mere kapde se behtar hai. Phir maine gareebon ki sohbat ki, to mujhe sukoon mila."

e:
Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim:"A letter came from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Do not use the skins of dead animals, nor tendons.'"


 This Hadith is Hasan. This Hadith has been related to 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim from some Shuyukh of his, and this is not acted upon according to most of the people of knowledge. And this Hadith has been related from 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim, that he said: "A letter came to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) two months before he died."


He said: I heart Ahmad bin Al-Hasan saying: "Ahmad bin Hanbal followed this Hadith due to it mentioning that it was two months before he (ﷺ) died. Then Ahmad left this Hadith because of their Idtirab in its chain, since some of them reported it, saying: 'From 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim from some Shuyukh of his from Juhainah.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Ukaim se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humare paas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ek khat aaya: 'Mari hui jaanwar ki khaal aur pattho se faida na uthaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ye Abdullah bin Ukaim se unke kuch buzurgon ke hawaale se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal nahi. Aur ye hadith Abdullah bin Ukaim se bhi riwayat hui hai, unhon ne kaha: "Humare paas Nabi (SAW) ka khat unki wafaat se do mahine pehle aaya." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Ahmad bin Al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Ahmad bin Hanbal is hadith ki taraf jaate the kyunki usmein zikr hai ke ye unki wafaat se do mahine pehle ki baat hai, aur wo kehte the: "Ye Nabi (SAW) ka aakhri hukum tha." Phir Ahmad bin Hanbal ne is hadith ko chhod diya jab logon ne iske isnad mein ikhtilaaf kiya, kuch ne "Abdullah bin Ukaim se, unke Juhainah ke kuch buzurgon se" riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed - who is 'Abdullah bin Busr: "I heard Abu Kabshah Al-Anmari saying: 'The Kimam (caps) of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were Buthan (stretched over the head).'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Munkar, 'Abdullah bin Busr is from Al-Basrah, and he is weak according to the people of Hadith. Yahya bin Sa'eed and others graded him weak. Buthun means expansive
hi: Abu Sa'eed, jo Abdullah bin Busr hain, se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Abu Kabshah Al-Anmari ko kehte suna: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke Sahaba ki topiyan chaudi hoti thin.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith munkar hai. Aur Abdullah bin Busr Basri hain, wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek kamzor hain, Yahya bin Sa'eed aur doosron ne unhein kamzor qarar diya. Aur "buth" ka matlab hai: chaudi, khuli hui.

e: Narrated Hudhaifa: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took hold of the calf of my shin - or his shin - and he said: "This is the place of the Izar, if you must lower it, then the Izar has no right to be on the ankles." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Ath-Thawri and Shu'bah reported it from Abu Ishaq
hi: Hudhaifah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne meri pindli ke gosht ko - ya apni pindli ko - pakda aur farmaya: 'Ye izaar ki jagah hai, agar tum na maano to isse neeche, agar tum phir bhi na maano to izaar ka takhno par koi haq nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ne bhi ise Abu Ishaq se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Ja'far bin Muhammad bin Rukanah: From his father that Rukanah wrestled the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) won the match. Rukanah said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: 'Indeed what distinguishes between us and between the idolater is the turban over the cap.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Its chain is not established, and we do not know of Abu Al-Hasan Al-'Asqalani, nor Ibn Rukanah
hi: Abu Ja'far bin Muhammad bin Rukanah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Rukanah ne Nabi (SAW) se kushti ladi, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein pachhaad diya. Rukanah ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Humare aur mushrikeen ke darmiyan farq topiyon ke oopar pagdiyaan hain.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, aur iska isnad mazboot nahi. Aur humein Abu Al-Hasan Al-Asqalani na Ibn Rukanah maloom hain.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Buraidah: From his father who said: "A man wearing an iron ring came to the Prophet (ﷺ). So he said to him: 'What is this I see on you, jewelry of the people of the Fire ?' Then he came wearing a ring of brass. So he said: 'What is this smell of idols I sense on you ?' Then he came wearing a ring of gold. So he said to him: 'What is this jewelry of the people of Paradise I see on you ?' So he said: 'What should I use then ?' He said: 'From silver, but not its entire weight." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib and there are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and 'Abdullah bin Muslim's Kunyah is Abu Taibah, and he is from Al-Marwaz
hi: Abdullah bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jispar loha ki anguthi thi. To unhon ne unse farmaya: 'Mujhe kya hua ke main tumpar Jahannam waalon ka zewar dekh raha hoon?' Phir wo unke paas pital ki anguthi pehne aaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Mujhe kya hua ke main tumse buton ki badbu paa raha hoon?' Phir wo unke paas sone ki anguthi pehne aaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Mujhe kya hua ke main tumpar Jannat waalon ka zewar dekh raha hoon?' Usne kaha: 'To main kis cheez ki banaaun?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Chandi ki, lekin ek misqaal poori na karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Abdullah bin Muslim ki kuniyat Abu Taibah hai, aur wo Marwazi hain.

e: Narrated Ibn Abi Musa: "I heard 'Ali saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Qassi, the red Mitharah, and wearing rings on this and this.' And he pointed to the index and middle fingers." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Ibn Abi Musa is Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa and his name is 'Amir bin 'Abdullah bin Qais
hi: Ibn Abi Musa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Al-Qassi, laal Mitharah, aur is ungli aur is ungli mein anguthi pehnne se mana kiya' - aur unhon ne shahaadat aur beech ki ungli ki taraf ishara kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abi Musa, Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa hain, unka naam Aamir bin Abdullah bin Qais hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "The garment the Messenger (ﷺ) like most to wear was the Hibrah." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse pyara kapda jo wo pehante the, wo Hibrah tha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Yunus: From Qatadah, that Anas said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never ate on a table, nor on small plates, not did he eat thin bread." He (Yunus) said: "I asked Qatadah: 'So what did he eat on ?' He said: 'On these leather dining sheets.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Muhammad bin Bash-har said: "This Yunus is Yunus Al-Iskaf." And 'Abdul-Warith bin Sa'eed reported similarly from Sa'eed bin Abi 'Arubah, from Qatadah, from Anas [From the Prophet (ﷺ]
hi: Yunus se riwayat hai, Qatadah se, ke Anas ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi mez par khaana nahi khaya, na chhoti plate mein, aur na unke liye patli roti banayi gayi." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Qatadah se pucha: "To wo kis cheez par khaate the?" Unhon ne kaha: "In chamde ke dastarkhwaanon par." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Muhammad bin Bashshar ne kaha: "Ye Yunus, Yunus Al-Iskaf hain." Aur Abdul-Warith bin Sa'eed ne bhi Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah se, Qatadah se, Anas se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Hisham b. Zaid: "I heard Anas saying: 'Once we provoked a rabbit at Marr Az-Zahran. So the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rushed after it, and I caught up to it and captured it. I brought it to Abu Talhah who slaughtered it with Marwah. He sent me with its legs - or its thighs - to the Prophet (ﷺ) so he could eat it.'" He (Hisham) said: "I said: 'He ate it?' He said:'He accepted it.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] There are narrations on this topic from Jubair, 'Ammar, Muhammad bin Safwan, and they say: Muhammad bin Saifi. This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is acted upon according to the people of knowledge. They saw no harm in eating rabbit. Some of the people of knowledge disliked eating rabbit, they said that it menstruates
hi: Hisham bin Zaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Anas ko kehte suna: "Humne Marr Az-Zahran mein ek khargosh ko bhagaaya, to Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba uske peeche daude, maine use pakad liya aur giraft mein le liya, aur main use Abu Talhah ke paas laaya, unhon ne use ek dhaardaar patthar se zibah kiya, phir unhon ne uski raan - ya koolha - Nabi (SAW) ke paas mere saath bheja, to unhon ne use khaaya." Unhon ne kaha: Maine kaha: "Unhon ne use khaaya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Unhon ne use qubool kiya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Ammar, aur Muhammad bin Safwan se bhi riwayat hai, aur unhein Muhammad bin Saifi bhi kaha jaata hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi par amal hai, wo khargosh khaane mein koi harj nahi maante. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne khargosh khaana napasand kiya aur kaha ke wo khoon behata hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about eating a mastigure and he said: 'I do not eat it, and I do not prohibit eating it.'" [He said:] There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn 'Abbas, Thabit bin Wadi'ah, Jabir, and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih The People of knowledge have differed over eating mastigure. Some of the people of knowledge among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) and others permitted it, while others considered it disliked. It has been related that Ibn 'Abbas said: "Mastigure was eaten on the dining spread of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) only avoided it because it was distasteful to him
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se saanp-chhipkali khaane ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Main ise nahi khaata aur na ise haraam qaraar deta hoon." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Abbas, Thabit bin Wadi'ah, Jabir, aur Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ahl-e-ilm ka dhab khaane mein ikhtilaaf hai, Nabi (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba aur doosron ne isme rukhsat di, aur kuch ne isse napasand kiya. Aur Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Dhab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke dastarkhwaan par khaayi gayi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise sirf isliye chhoda kyunki unhein wo napasand thi."

e: Narrated Ibn Abi 'Ammar: "I asked Jabir: 'Is badger kind of game animal?' He said: 'Yes.'" He said: "I said: 'Should I eat it?' He said: 'Yes.'" He said: 'I said: 'Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say that ?' He said: 'Yes.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Some of the people of knowledge followed this. They did not see any harm eating badger. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. A Hadith has been related from the Prophet (ﷺ) indicating disapproval of eating badger but its chain is not strong. Some of the people of knowledge disliked eating badger. This is the view of Ibn Al-Mubarak. Yahya bin Al-Qattan said: "Jarir bin Hazm reported this Hadith from 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaid bin 'Umair, from Ibn Abi 'Ammar, from Jabir, from 'Umar, as his saying. And the narration of Ibn Juraij (a narrator in the chain of this Hadith) is more correct. And Ibn Abi 'Ammar is 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Abdullah bin Abi 'Ammar Al-Makki
hi: Ibn Abi Ammar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Jabir se pucha: 'Kya lakadbagga shikaar mein shaamil hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Kya main ise khaaun?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine unse kaha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi taraf gaye hain, unhon ne lakadbagga khaane mein koi harj nahi maana, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se lakadbagga khaana napasand karne ki ek hadith riwayat hui hai, lekin uska isnad mazboot nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne lakadbagga khaana napasand kiya, aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Yahya Al-Qattan ne kaha: Jarir bin Hazim ne ye hadith Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair se, Ibn Abi Ammar se, Jabir se, Umar ka apna qaul riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Juraij ki hadith zyada sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abi Ammar, Abdur-Rahman bin Abdullah bin Abi Ammar Al-Makki hain.

e: Narrated Khuzaimah bin Jaz': "I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about eating badger. He said: 'Does anyone eat badger?' So I asked him about eating wolf' He said: 'Does anyone who has any good in him eat wolf?'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] The chain for this Hadith is not strong. We do not know of it except as a narration of Isma'il bin Muslim from 'Abdul-Karim Abi Umayyah. Some of the people of Hadith have criticized Isma'il and 'Abdul Karim Abi Umayyah. And he is 'Abdul-Karim bin Qais, who is Ibn Abi Al-Mukhariq. While 'Abdul-Karim bin Malik Al-Jazari is trustworthy
hi: Khuzaimah bin Jaz se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se lakadbagga khaane ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya koi lakadbagga bhi khaata hai?' Aur maine unse bhediye khaane ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya koi bhediya bhi khaata hai jismein kuch bhalai ho?'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad mazboot nahi, hum ise sirf Ismail bin Muslim ki, Abdul-Karim Abi Umayyah se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-hadith ne Ismail aur Abdul-Karim Abi Umayyah ke baare mein baat ki hai, aur wo Abdul-Karim bin Qais bin Abi Al-Mukhariq hain, jabke Abdul-Karim bin Malik Al-Jazari thiqah hain.

e: Narrated Jabir: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) allowed us to eat horse meat, and he forbade us from eating donkey meat." He said: There is something on this from Asma' bin Abi Bakr. Abu 'Eisa said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is how it was reported by more than one narrator, from 'Amr bin Dinar from Jabir. Hammad bin Zaid reported it from 'Amr bin Dinar from Muhammad bin 'Ali, from Jabir. The narration of Ibn 'Uyainah (no. 1793) is more correct. He said: I heard Muhammad saying: "Sufyan bin 'Uyainah is better at memorizing than Hammad bin Zaid
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ghode ka gosht khilaya, aur humein gadhe ke gosht se mana kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Asma bint Abi Bakr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur isi tarah kai logon ne Amr bin Dinar se, Jabir se riwayat ki hai. Aur Hammad bin Zaid ne ise Amr bin Dinar se, Muhammad bin Ali se, Jabir se riwayat ki, aur Ibn Uyainah ki riwayat zyada sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad ko kehte suna: "Sufyan bin Uyainah, Hammad bin Zaid se zyada yaad rakhne wale hain."

e:
Narrated As-Salt bin 'Abdullah bin Nawfal:"Ibn Abbas wore a ring on his right hand. And I do not doubt he said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing a ring on his right hand.'"


 Muhammad bin Isma'il said: "The Hadith is Muhammad bin Ishaq from As-Salt bin 'Abdullah bin Nawfal is a Hasan Sahih Hadith."
hi: As-Salt bin Abdullah bin Nawfal se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abbas ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha, aur mujhe koi shak nahi ke unhon ne kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apne dahine haath mein anguthi pehne dekha.'"
