Abu Isa ne kaha: Muhammad bin Ismail ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Ishaq ki, As-Salt bin Abdullah bin Nawfal se, hadith hasan sahih hai."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "On the day of Khaibar, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited every predator possessing canines, and the Mujath-thamah, and the domestic donkey." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Jabir, Al-Bara', Ibn Abi Awfa, Anas, Al-'Irbad bin Sariyah, Abu Tha'labah, Ibn 'Umar and Abu Sa'eed. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. 'Abdul-'Aziz bin Muhammad and others reported this Hadith from Muhammad bin 'Amr, and they only mentioned one phrase: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited every predator possessing canines
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din har naakhun waale shikaari jaanwar, "mujaththamah", aur paalthu gadhe ko haraam kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Jabir, Al-Bara, Ibn Abi Awfa, Anas, Al-Irbad bin Sariyah, Abu Tha'labah, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abdul-Aziz bin Muhammad aur doosron ne Muhammad bin Amr se ye hadith riwayat ki, aur unhon ne sirf ek jumla zikr kiya: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har naakhun waale shikaari jaanwar se mana kiya."

e: Narrated Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the pots of Zorastrians. He said: 'Clean them by washing them, and then cook in them." And he prohibited every predator possessing canines." This is a well known Hadith of Abu Tha'labah, and it has been reported from him through routes other than this. And Abu Tha'labah's name is Jurthum, and they say: Jurhum, and they say: Nashib. This Hadith has also been mentioned by Abu Qilabah from Abu 'Asma Ar-Rahbi, from Abu Tha'labah
hi: Abu Tha'labah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Majoos ke bartanon ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Unhein dho kar saaf karo aur unmein pakaao.'" Aur unhon ne har naakhun waale shikaari jaanwar se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye Abu Tha'labah ki mash'hoor hadith hai, aur ye unse doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu Tha'labah ka naam Jurthum hai, aur kaha jaata hai Jurhum, aur kaha jaata hai Nashib. Aur ye hadith Abu Qilabah se, Abu Asma Ar-Rahbi se, Abu Tha'labah se bhi zikr hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani: That he said: "O Messenger of Allah! We live in a land of the People of Book and we cook in their containers, and drink in their vessels." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If you do not find other than them, then rinse them with water." The he said: "O Messenger of Allah! We live in a land of game, so what should we do ?" He said: "When you send your trained dog, and you mentioned the Name of Allah, and he kills it, then eat it. And when you shoot it with your bow, and it is killed, then eat it.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum ahl-e-Kitab ki zameen mein rehte hain, hum unke bartanon mein pakaate hain aur unke bartanon mein peete hain." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein unke siwa kuch na mile, to unhein paani se dho lo." Phir unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum shikaar ki zameen mein rehte hain, to hum kya karen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum apna sikhaya hua kutta bhejo aur Allah ka naam lo, aur wo shikaar ko maar de, to use khaao, aur agar wo sikhaya hua na ho, magar tumne use zibah kiya ho, to use khaao, aur jab tum apna teer chalaao aur Allah ka naam lo, aur wo maar de, to use khaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: From Maimunah that a mouse fell in some cooking fat and died. So the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about that and he said: "Remove it (the mouse) and what was around it and then eat it (the fat)." He said: There are something on this topic from Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This Hadith has been related from Az-Zuhri, from 'Ubaidullah, from Ibn 'Abbas, saying: "The Prophet (ﷺ) as asked" and they did not mention Maimunah in it. The narration of Ibn 'Abbas from Maimunah is more correct. Ma'mar reported similar from Az-Zuhri, from Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ). But this hadith is not preserved. He said: I heard Muhammad bin Isma'il saying: "The Hadith of Ma'mar from Az-Zuhri, from Sa'eed bin al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)" - and he mentioned in it: 'That he was asked about it, so he said: "When it (the coking fat) is solid then remove it (the mouse) and what was around it. And when it is liquid then do not use it.'" This is a mistake. Ma'mar made a mistake with it. And he said: What is correct is the narration of Az-Zuhri from 'Ubaidullah, from Ibn 'Abbas, and Maimunah
hi: Ibn Abbas se, Maimunah se riwayat hai ke ek chuhiya ghee mein gir kar mar gayi, to Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Use aur uske aas-paas ka nikaal do aur baaki khaao." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Ubaidullah se, Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hui hai ke Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya, aur usmein Maimunah ka zikr nahi kiya gaya, aur Ibn Abbas ki, Maimunah se, hadith zyada sahih hai. Aur Ma'mar ne Az-Zuhri se, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki, aur ye hadith mehfooz nahi. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail ko kehte suna: "Ma'mar ki, Az-Zuhri se, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se hadith mein zikr hai ke unse iske baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Agar wo jama hua ho, to use aur uske aas-paas ka nikaal do, aur agar wo baha hua ho, to uske paas na jao.' Ye galat hai, Ma'mar ne isme galti ki." Unhon ne kaha: Aur sahih Az-Zuhri ki, Ubaidullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Maimunah se hadith hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Let none of you wat with his left hand nor drink with his left hand, for indeed Ash-Shaitan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, 'Umar bin Abi Salamah, Salamah bin Al-Akwa', Anas bin Malik, and Hafsah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This is how Malik and Ibn 'Uyainah reported it from Az-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr bin 'Ubaidullah, from Ibn 'Umar. Ma'mar and 'Uqail reported it from Az-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar. And the narration of Malik and Ibn 'Uyainah is more correct
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne baayen haath se na khaaye aur na piye, kyunki Shaitan apne baayen haath se khaata aur peeta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Umar bin Abi Salamah, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, Anas bin Malik, aur Hafsah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Isi tarah Malik aur Ibn Uyainah ne Az-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr bin Ubaidullah se, Ibn Umar se riwayat ki hai. Aur Ma'mar aur Uqail ne Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se riwayat ki, aur Malik aur Ibn Uyainah ki riwayat zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri:From Salim, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you eats, then let him eat with his right hand, and let him drink with his right hand, for indeed Ash-Shaitan eats with his left hand, and he drinks with his left hand
hi: Az-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to dahine haath se khaaye, aur dahine haath se piye, kyunki Shaitan apne baayen haath se khaata hai aur baayen haath se peeta hai."

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you eats, then let him lick his fingers, for indeed he does not know in which of them is the blessing." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Ka'b bin Malik, and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route, as a narration of Suhail. I asked Muhammad about this Hadith, so he said: "This is among the diverse narrations of 'Abdul-'Aziz, we do not know of it except from his narration
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to apni ungliyaan chaate, kyunki use nahi maloom ke unmein se kis mein barkat hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Ka'b bin Malik, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se, Suhail ki hadith se jaante hain. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Ye Abdul-Aziz ki hadith hai, ikhtilaaf waali hai, ye sirf unki hadith se jaani jaati hai."

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When one of you eats food, and he drops a pieces of it, then let him remove anything suspicious from it and eat it. Do not leave it for Ash-Shaitan." He said: There is something about this from Anas
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi khaana khaaye aur uska ek nawaala gir jaaye, to wo usmein se jo bhi shak-shubha waali cheez ho use hataaye, phir use khaaye, aur use Shaitan ke liye na chhode." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Anas: "When the Prophet (ﷺ) ate, he would lick his three fingers, and he said: 'If one of you drops a piece (of food) then let him remove any harm (dirt) from it and eat it, and do not leave it for Ash-Shaitan.' And he would order us to finish (clean) the dish. And he said: 'Indeed you do not know in which part of your food is the blessing.' [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib Sahih
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab khaana khaate, to apni teen ungliyaan chaatte the, aur farmaate: "Jab tum mein se kisi ka nawaala gir jaaye, to wo usse gandagi hataaye aur use khaaye, aur use Shaitan ke liye na chhode." Aur unhon ne humein hukum diya ke hum plate saaf kar den, aur farmaya: "Tumhein nahi maloom ke tumhare khaane mein kahan barkat hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid: "My grandmother, Umm 'Asim narrated to me - and she was the slave woman of Sinan bin Salamah - she said: 'Nubaishah Al-Khair entered upon us while we were eating from a large bowl. He narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever eats from A Qas'ah, then licks it, the Qas'ah will seek forgiveness for him." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except through the narration of Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid. And Yazid bin Harun and others among the A'immah reported this Hadith from Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid
hi: Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Meri dadi Umm Aasim ne mujhe bataya - wo Sinan bin Salamah ki maa-e-walad thin - unhon ne kaha: 'Nubaishah Al-Khair humare paas aaye jabke hum ek bade katore mein khaana kha rahe the. Unhon ne humein bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo koi katore mein khaaye, phir use chaat le, katora uske liye maghfirat maangta hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Yazid bin Harun aur kai imamon ne bhi Al-Mu'alla bin Rashid se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed the blessing descends to the middle of the food, so eat from its edges, and do not eat from its middle." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. It is only known through the narration of 'Ata' bin As-Sa'ib. Shu'bah and Ath-Thawri reported from 'Ata' bin As-Sa'ib. There is something about this topic from Ibn 'Umar
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Barkat khaane ke beech mein utarti hai, to unke kinaaron se khaao aur beech se mat khaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, ye sirf Ata bin As-Saib ki hadith se jaana jaata hai. Aur Shu'bah aur Ath-Thawri ne bhi Ata bin As-Saib se ye riwayat ki hai. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever eats from these - the first time, he said garlic, then he said - garlic, onion, and leek, then let him not approach our Masjid." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, Abu Ayyub, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir bin Samurah, Qurrah [bin Iyas Al-Muzani] and Ibn 'Umar
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi in mein se khaaye" - pehli baar unhon ne "lehsun" kaha, phir kaha - "lehsun, pyaaz, aur gandana, to wo humari masjidon ke qareeb na aaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Abu Ayyub, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Jabir bin Samurah, Qurrah bin Iyas Al-Muzani, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin Samurah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was staying with Abu Ayyub. When he ate some food, he would send what was left to him. So one day he sent him some food but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not eat from it. So Abu Ayyub went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'It contained garlic.' So he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Is it unlawful?' He said: 'No, I dislike it because of its odor.'" He said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir bin Samurah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Ayyub ke paas theher rahe the. Aur jab wo khaana khaate, to unhein uska bacha hua hissa bhej dete. Ek din unhon ne unhein khaana bheja, lekin Nabi (SAW) ne usmein se nahi khaaya. Jab Abu Ayyub Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein ye zikr kiya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Ismein lehsun hai.' To unhon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kya ye haraam hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, lekin main ise uski badbu ki wajah se napasand karta hoon.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Sharik bin Hanbal:That 'Ali said: "Eating garlic was prohibited except when cooked
hi: Sharik bin Hanbal se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Lehsun khaana mana hai siwaye pakaaya hua ho."

e: Narrated Sharik bin Hanbal:That 'Ali said: "Eating garlic is no good, except when cooked." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This chain of this Hadith is not strong. It has been reported as a saying of 'Ali and it has been reported from Sharik bin Hanbal from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form. Muhammad said: "Al-Jarrah bin Malih (one of the narratos) is truthful, and Al-Jarrah bin Ad-Dahhak is Muqarib (average) in Hadith
hi: Sharik bin Hanbal se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Lehsun khaana theek nahi, siwaye pakaaya hua ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad mazboot nahi, aur ye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka apna qaul bhi riwayat hui hai, aur ye Sharik bin Hanbal se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Muhammad ne kaha: "Al-Jarrah bin Malih sachche hain, aur Al-Jarrah bin Ad-Dahhak hadith mein ausat darje ke hain."

e: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Burdah: From his father that Umm Ayyub informed him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had stayed with them, and they prepared some food for him containing some of these vegetables. But he disliked eating it, so he said to his Companions: "Eat it, for I am not like you are, I fear that I will offend my companion." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. Umm Ayyub is the wife of Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abi Burdah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Umm Ayyub ne unhein bataya ke Nabi (SAW) unke paas theher gaye, to unhon ne unke liye khaana taiyaar kiya jismein in mein se kuch saag the, lekin unhon ne ise khaana napasand kiya, to unhon ne apne Sahaba se farmaya: "Ise khaao, main tum jaisa nahi hoon, mujhe dar hai ke main apne saathi ko takleef pahunchaaunga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Umm Ayyub, Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari ki biwi hain.

e: Narrated Abu Khaldah:That Abu Al-'Aliyah said: "garlic is among the good provisions." Abu Khaldah's name is Khalid bin Dinar, and he is trustworthy according to the people of Hadith. He saw Anas bin Malik and heard narrations from him. Abu Al-'Aliyah's name is Rufai' and he is Ar-Riyahi. 'Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi said: "Abu Khaldah was preferable, reliable
hi: Abu Khaldah se riwayat hai ke Abu Al-Aliyah ne kaha: "Lehsun achi rizq mein se hai." Aur Abu Khaldah ka naam Khalid bin Dinar hai, wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hain, unhon ne Anas bin Malik ko paaya aur unse suna. Aur Abu Al-Aliyah ka naam Rufai hai, wo Ar-Riyahi hain. Abdur-Rahman bin Mahdi ne kaha: "Abu Khaldah ek behtareen Musalman the."

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Close the door, tie the water-skin, turn over the vessel, or cover the vessel, and extinguish the torch. Indeed Ash-Shaitan does not open what is closed, nor undo what is fastened, nor uncover a vessel, but the small vermin may cause a fire in people's houses." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar, Abu Hurairah, and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, and it has been reported through other routes from Jabir
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Darwaza band karo, mashk ka munh bandho, bartan ulta rakho ya dhaanp do, aur chiraag bujha do, kyunki Shaitan koi band cheez nahi kholta, na koi bandhi hui cheez khol sakta hai, na koi dhaanka hua bartan khol sakta hai, aur beshak choohe logon ke gharon mein aag laga dete hain." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Jabir se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Salim: From his father, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Do not leave the fire (burning) in your houses when you sleep." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum sote ho, to apne gharon mein aag jalti hui na chhodo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited taking two dates at a time until seeking permission from one's companion." He said: There is something on this topic from Sa'd the freed slave of Abu Bakr. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do khajoorein ikattha lene se mana kiya jab tak apne saathi se ijazat na le. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd, Abu Bakr ke azaad kiye gulam, se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "A house without dates, its inhabitants will be hungry." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Salma the wife of Abu Rafi'. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib from this route. We do not know of it to be a narration of Hisham bin 'Urwah except through this route. He said: I asked Al-Bukhari about this Hadith and he said: "I do not know of anyone who reported it other than Yahya bin Hassan
hi: Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Wo ghar jismein khajoor na ho, uske ghar wale bhookhe hain." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Salma, Abu Rafi ki biwi, se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Hisham bin Urwah ki hadith se sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Al-Bukhari se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom ke Yahya bin Hassan ke siwa kisi ne ise riwayat ki ho."

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Allah is pleased with the slave who, upon eating his food or drinking his drink, he praises Him for it." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir, Abu Sa'eed, 'Aishah, Abu Ayyub, and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. More than one narrator has reported it from Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah similarly, and we do not know of it except through the narration of Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah apne bande se raazi ho jaata hai ke wo khaana khaaye ya paani piye, phir uspar uski hamd kare." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uqbah bin Aamir, Abu Sa'eed, Aishah, Abu Ayyub, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur kai logon ne Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai, aur hum ise sirf Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took the hand of a leper and put it in the Qas'ah. Then he said: 'Eat in Allah's Name, trusting in Allah and relying upon Him.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This is a Gharib Hadith, we do not know of it except through the report of Yunus bin Muhammad, from Al-Mufaddal bin Fadalah, a Shaikh from Al-Basrah. There is another Shaikh from Al-Basrah named Al-Mufaddal bin Fadalah, who is more reliable han this one and more popular. Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Habib bin Ash-Shahid, from Ibn Buraidah: "That Ibn 'Umar took the hand of a leper" and the narration of Shu'bah is more appropriate to me and more correct
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek korhi ka haath pakda aur use apne saath katore mein daala, phir farmaya: "Khaao, Allah ke naam se, Allah par bharosa karte hue aur usi par tawakkul karte hue." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Yunus bin Muhammad ki, Al-Mufaddal bin Fadalah se riwayat se jaante hain, jo Basra ke ek shaikh hain. Aur Al-Mufaddal bin Fadalah ek doosre Misri shaikh hain jo isse zyada thiqah aur mash'hoor hain. Aur Shu'bah ne ye hadith Habib bin Ash-Shahid se, Ibn Buraidah se riwayat ki ke Ibn Umar ne ek korhi ka haath pakda, aur Shu'bah ki hadith mere nazdeek zyada mazboot aur sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The disbeliever eats with seven intestines and the believer eats with one intestine." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. He said: There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari, Abu Musa, Jahjah Al-Ghifari, Maimunah, and 'Abdullah bin 'Amr
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaafir saat aanton se khaata hai, aur Momin ek hi aant se khaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Basrah Al-Ghifari, Abu Musa, Jahjah Al-Ghifari, Maimunah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a disbeliever as a guest. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that a sheep be milked so he could drink. Then another was milked so he could drink, then another, so he drank until he had drank the milk of seven sheep. The he awoke the next morning and accepted Islam. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that a sheep be milked so he could drink its milk, then he ordered for another but he could not finish it. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The believer drinks with one intestine and the disbeliever drinks with seven.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Sahih Hasan Gharib as a narration of Suhail
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek kaafir mehmaan aaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek bakri ka hukum diya, use doodha gaya, to usne piya, phir doosri, to usne piya, phir teesri, to usne piya, yahan tak ke usne saat bakriyon ka doodh pi liya. Phir agli subah wo Musalman ho gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek bakri ka hukum diya, use doodha gaya, to usne uska doodh piya, phir unhon ne ek aur ka hukum diya, lekin wo use poora na kar saka. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ek hi aant mein peeta hai, aur kaafir saat aanton mein peeta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Suhail ki riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e:
Narrated Abu Hurairah:"When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put on a Qamis he began with the right side.


 Others have reported this Hadith from Shu'bah with this chain, but they dod narrate it in Marfu' form, only 'Abdus-Samad narrated it Marfu'.
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab qamees pehnte, to dahini taraf se shuru karte." Abu Isa ne kaha: Kai logon ne ye hadith Shu'bah se isi isnad se, Abu Hurairah se mauqoof riwayat ki, aur humein maloom nahi ke Abdus-Samad bin Abdul-Warith ke siwa kisi ne ise Shu'bah se marfu' riwayat ki ho.

e: Narrated Abu Ya'fur Al-'Abdi: That 'Abdullah bin Abi Awfa was asked about locust. He said: "I participated in six military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (saws, (and) we ate locust." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This is how Sufyan bin 'Uyainah reported this Hadith from Abu Ya'fur. He said: "Six military expeditions," while Sufyan Ath-Thawri reported this Hadith from Abu Ya'fur, and he said: "Seven military expeditions." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Umar and Jabir. He said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Yu'fur's name is Waqid. They also call him Waqdan. There is another Abu Ya'fur whose name is 'Adbur-Rahman bin 'Ubaid bin Nistas
hi: Abu Ya'fur Al-Abdi se riwayat hai ke Abdullah bin Abi Awfa se tiddiyon ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke saath chhe ghazwe kiye, hum tiddiyaan khaate the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Sufyan bin Uyainah ne Abu Ya'fur se ye hadith riwayat ki aur "chhe ghazwe" kaha, aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kai doosron ne Abu Ya'fur se ye hadith riwayat ki aur "saat ghazwe" kaha. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ya'fur ka naam Waqid hai, unhein Waqdan bhi kaha jaata hai, aur doosre Abu Ya'fur ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Ubaid bin Nistas hai.

e: Narrated Abu Ya'fur: That Ibn Abi Awfa said: "We participated in seven military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), (and) we ate locust." [Abu 'Eisa said:] Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Abu Ya'fur, from Ibn Awfa and said: "We participated in military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and) we ate locust." This was narrated to us by Muhammad bin Bash-shar (who said): "Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us from Shu'bah
hi: Abu Ya'fur se riwayat hai, Ibn Abi Awfa se, unhon ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath saat ghazwe kiye, hum tiddiyaan khaate the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abu Ya'fur se, Ibn Abi Awfa se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ghazwe kiye, hum tiddiyaan khaate the." Humein ye Muhammad bin Bashshar ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ja'far ne bataya, humein Shu'bah ne isi jaisi bataya.

e: Narrated At-Taimi: From Jabir bin 'Abdullah and Anas bin Malik who said: "When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) supplicated against locusts he would say: 'O Allah! Destroy the locusts, kill the large among him, and destroy the small, spoil his core, and cut off his rear. Take their mouths from our livelihood and our sustenance. Verily, You indeed listen to the supplication!' So a man said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How is it that you supplicate against one of the Allah's armies that He cut off their rear?'" He said: "So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'They are bit scattered from a fish in the ocean.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib. We do not know of it except from this route. And Musa bin Muhammad bin Ibrahim At-Taimi has been criticized. He narrates many Gharib and Munkar narrations. His father Muhammad bin Ibrahim is trustworthy, and he is from Al-Madinah
hi: At-Taimi se riwayat hai, Jabir bin Abdullah aur Anas bin Malik se, dono ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jab tiddiyon ke khilaaf dua karte, to kehte: 'Ya Allah! Tiddiyon ko halaak kar, unke badon ko qatl kar, aur unke chhoton ko halaak kar, unke andon ko kharaab kar, aur unki jad kaat de, aur unke munh humari rozi aur rizq se rok de, tu dua sunne wala hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aap Allah ke lashkaron mein se ek lashkar ke khilaaf uski jad kaatne ki dua kaise karte hain?" Unhon ne kaha: To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ye samundar mein ek machli ka chhinta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Musa bin Muhammad bin Ibrahim At-Taimi ke baare mein baat ki gayi hai, wo bahut ghareeb aur munkar riwayaton wale hain, aur unke waalid Muhammad bin Ibrahim thiqah hain, wo Madani hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited eating the Jallalah and milking it." He said: There is something on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Ath-Thawri reported it from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne 'Jallalah' khaane aur uska doodh peene se mana kiya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Ath-Thawri ne ise Ibn Abi Najih se, Mujahid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki.

e: Narrated 'Urfajah bin As'ad:"My nose was severed on the Day of Al-Kulab during Jahiliyyah. So I got a nose of silver which caused an infection for me, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered me to get a node made of gold."
hi: Urfajah bin As'ad se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jahiliyyah mein Yaum-ul-Kulaab ke din meri naak kat gayi thi, to maine chandi ki ek naak banwaayi, lekin usmein badbu aane lagi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main sone ki naak banwaaun."

e: Narrated Zahdam Al-Jarmi: "I entered upon Abu Musa while he was eating chicken, and he said: 'Sit and eat, for indeed I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating it.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. This Hadith has been reported through other routes from Zahdam, and we do not know of it except as the narration of Zahdam. (One of the narrators) Abu Al-'Awwam is 'Imran Al-Qattan
hi: Zahdam Al-Jarmi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Abu Musa ke paas gaya jabke wo murgi kha rahe the, to unhon ne kaha: 'Aao, khao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise khaate dekha hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi Zahdam se riwayat hui hai, aur hum ise sirf Zahdam ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abu Al-Awwam, Imran Al-Qattan hain.

e: Narrated Zahdam: From Abu Musa who said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating chicken meat." He said: The Hadith has more statements that this. And this Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani also reported this Hadith from Al-Qasim At-Tamimi, and, from Abu Qilabah, from Zahdam Al-Jarmi
hi: Zahdam se, Abu Musa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko murgi ka gosht khaate dekha." Unhon ne kaha: Aur hadith mein isse zyada baat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani ne bhi ye hadith Al-Qasim At-Tamimi se, aur Abu Qilabah se, Zahdam Al-Jarmi se riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Ibrahim bin 'Umar bin Safinah: From his father, from his grandfather that he said: "I ate bustard meat with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route. Ibn Abi Fudaik reported from Ibrahim bin 'Umar bin Safinah and he has been called Buraih bin 'Umar bin Safinah
hi: Ibrahim bin Umar bin Safinah apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath houbara ka gosht khaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Ibrahim bin Umar bin Safinah se Ibn Abi Fudaik ne riwayat ki hai, aur unhein Buraih bin Umar bin Safinah bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Narrated Umm Salamah: That she brought a side of roasted meat to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so he ate it from it and stood for Salat, and did not perform Wudu' He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin Al-Harith, Al-Mughirah, and Abu Rafi' [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib from this route
hi: Umm Salamah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek bhuni hui pasli pesh ki, to unhon ne usmein se khaaya, phir namaz ke liye khade ho gaye aur wuzu nahi kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Al-Harith, Al-Mughirah, aur Abu Rafi se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Abu Juhaidah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "As for me, I do not eat while reclining." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and 'Abdullah bin Al-'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih, we do not know of it except as a narration of 'Ali bin Al-Aqmar. Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah, Sufyan bin Sa'eed, and other reported this Hadith from 'Ali bin Al-Aqmar. And Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Sufyan Ath-Thawri from 'Ali bin Al-Aqmar
hi: Abu Juhaifah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahan tak meri baat hai, main takiya lagaakar nahi khaata." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdullah bin Amr, aur Abdullah bin Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Ali bin Al-Aqmar ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Zakariyya bin Abi Za'idah, Sufyan Ath-Thawri, aur kai doosron ne Ali bin Al-Aqmar se ye hadith riwayat ki hai, aur Shu'bah ne bhi Sufyan Ath-Thawri se, Ali bin Al-Aqmar se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) liked sweets and honey." This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. 'Ali bin Mus-hir reported it from Hisham bin 'Urwah, and there is more stated in the Hadith than this
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) meethi cheezein aur shahad pasand karte the." Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Ali bin Mus-hir ne bhi Hisham bin Urwah se ye riwayat ki hai, aur hadith mein isse zyada baat hai.

e: Narrated 'Alqamah bin Al-Muzani: From his father, who said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When one of you buys meat, then let him increase its broth. For, if he does not find any meat you'll have broth; and it is one of the two meats." And there are narrations on this topic from Abu Dharr. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except through this route, as a narration of Muhammad bin Fada', who is Muhammad bin Fada' Al-Mu'abbar, and he has been criticized by Sulaiman bin Harb. 'Alqamah bin 'Abdullah is the brother of Bakr bin 'Abdullah Al-Muzani
hi: Alqamah bin Abdullah Al-Muzani apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi gosht khareede, to uska shorba zyada banaaye, aur agar use gosht na mile, to use shorba mile, aur wo gosht ki hi ek kism hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se, Muhammad bin Fada ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Muhammad bin Fada, Al-Mu'abbir hain, aur Sulaiman bin Harb ne unke baare mein baat ki hai. Aur Alqamah bin Abdullah, Bakr bin Abdullah Al-Muzani ke bhai hain.

e: Narrated Abu Dharr: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Let one of you not consider any good to be insignificant. If he has nothing, then let him meet his brother with a smiling face. If you buy some meat or cook something in a pot, then increase its broth, and serve some of it to your neighbor." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Shu'bah reported it from Abu 'Imran Al-Jawni
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi kisi neki ko haqeer na samjhe, aur agar kuch na paaye, to apne bhai se khushdili se mile, aur agar tum gosht khareedo ya haandi pakaao, to uska shorba zyada rakho aur apne padosi ko usmein se de do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Shu'bah ne bhi Abu Imran Al-Jauni se ye riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Abu Musa: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Many a man achieved perfection, but no woman achieved perfection except for Mariam the daughter of 'Imran, and Asiyah the wife of Fir'awn. And the superiority of 'Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over other foods." He said: There is something on this topic from 'Aishah and Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Musa se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bahut se mard mukammal hue, lekin auraton mein se sirf Maryam bint Imran aur Firaun ki biwi Aasiyah hi mukammal huin. Aur Aishah ki auraton par fazilat waisi hai jaisi Sareed ki baaki khaanon par fazilat hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Al-Harith: "My father had me married so he invited people, and Safwan bin Umayyah was among them. So he said: 'Indeed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Bite the meat (with your teeth) for indeed it is more enjoyable and more wholesome. He said: There are narration on this topic from 'Aishah and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] We do not know of this Hadith except through the narration of 'Abdul-Karim. Some of the people of knowledge have criticized 'Abdul-Karim Al-Mu'allim because of his memory, Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani was among them
hi: Abdullah bin Al-Harith se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Mere waalid ne mera nikah karaaya aur logon ko bulaaya, unmein Safwan bin Umayyah bhi the, to unhon ne kaha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: Gosht ko daanton se noch kar khaao, kyunki ye zyada lazzat-dar aur zyada saazgaar hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Abdul-Karim ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Abdul-Karim Al-Mu'allim ke baare mein baat ki hai, unmein Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani shaamil hain, unki hifz ki wajah se.

e: Narrated Ja'far bin 'Amr bin Umayyah Ad-Damri: From his father who said that he saw the Prophet (ﷺ) making incisions (with a knife) into a piece of a lamb shoulder which he ate from, then he went to perform Salat without performing Wudu'. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih and there is something on this topic from Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah
hi: Ja'far bin Amr bin Umayyah Ad-Damri apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek bakri ke shaane se gosht kaatte aur usmein se khaate dekha, phir wo namaz ke liye chale gaye aur wuzu nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: "Some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and a foreleg was presented to him, and he used to like it, so he bit from it." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud, 'Aishah, 'Abdullah bin Ja'far, and Abu 'Ubaidah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Hayyan's (a narrator in the chain) name is Yahya bin Sa'eed bin Hayyan At-Taimi. Abu Zur'ah bin 'Amr bin Jarir's name is Harim
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke paas gosht laaya gaya, unhein aage ki taang di gayi jo unhein pasand thi, to unhon ne usmein se kaata." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Aishah, Abdullah bin Ja'far, aur Abu Ubaidah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hayyan ka naam Yahya bin Sa'eed bin Hayyan At-Taimi hai, aur Abu Zur'ah bin Amr bin Jarir ka naam Harim hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The foreleg was not the part of the meat that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) liked most, but he would not get meat but occasionally. So it would be hastened to him because it cooks quickly." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except from this route
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Aage ki taang Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse pyara gosht nahi thi, lekin unhein gosht kabhi kabhi hi milta tha, to ise unke paas jaldi bheja jaata kyunki ye sabse jaldi pak jaati hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirka kitna acha salaan hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah aur Umm Hani se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is." Another chain with similar except that he (ﷺ) said: "What an excellent condiment, or, (the most excellent of) condiments is vinegar." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib from this route. It is not known as a Hadith of Hisham bin 'Urwah except through the narration of Sulaiman bin Bilal
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirka kitna acha salaan hai." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi, lekin usmein unhon ne kaha: "Salaan ya salaanon mein sabse acha sirka hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai, ye Hisham bin Urwah ki hadith mein sirf Sulaiman bin Bilal ki riwayat se jaana jaata hai.

e: Narrated Umm Hani' bint Abi Talib: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon me and said: 'Do you have anything?' I said: 'No, except a piece of hard bread and vinegar.' so he said: 'Bring it, for a house that has vinegar is not impoverished of condiments." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib from this route. We do not know of it as a Hadith of Umm Hani' except through this route. Abu Hamzah Ath-Thumali's (a narrator in the chain) name is Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah. And Umm Hani' died some time after 'Ali bin Abi Talib. I asked Muhammad about this Hadith. He said: "I do not know Ash-Sha'bi hearing from Umm Hani'." So I said: "How is Abu Hamzah according to you?" He said: "Ahmad bin Hanbal criticized him, but he is Muqarib (average) in Hadith to me
hi: Umm Hani bint Abi Talib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhare paas kuch hai?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi, siwaye sookhe tukdon aur sirke ke.'" To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise laao, kisi ghar mein sirka ho to wo salaan se khaali nahi hota." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Umm Hani ki hadith se sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abu Hamzah Ath-Thumali ka naam Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah hai, aur Umm Hani ka intiqaal Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke kaafi arse baad hua. Maine Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein pucha, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom ke Ash-Sha'bi ne Umm Hani se suna ho." To maine kaha: "Abu Hamzah aapke nazdeek kaise hain?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ahmad bin Hanbal ne unke baare mein baat ki hai, lekin mere nazdeek wo ausat darje ke hain."

e: Narrated Jabir: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "What an excellent condiment vinegar is." There are narrations on this topic from 'Aishah and Umm Hani', and this is more correct than the narration of Mubarak bin Sa'eed (no)
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirka kitna acha salaan hai." Ye Mubarak bin Sa'eed ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The Prophet (ﷺ) would eat melon with fresh dates." He said: There is something on about this from Anas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib. Some of them reported it form Hisham bin 'Urwah from his father in Mursal form from the Prophet (ﷺ), without mentioning "from 'Aishah" in it, And Yazid bin Ruman reported this Hadith from 'Urwah, from 'Aishah
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) tarbooz taaza khajoor ke saath khaate the. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne ise Hisham bin Urwah se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki, aur usmein "Aishah se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur Yazid bin Rumaan ne Urwah se, Aishah se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Ja'far: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would eat snake cucumber with fresh dates. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib, we do not know of it except as a narration of Ibrahim bin Sa'd
hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) kheera taaza khajoor ke saath khaate the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibrahim bin Sa'd ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Anas: "Some of people from 'Urainah arrived in Al-Madinah, and they were uncomfortable (with the climate). So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent them some camels from charity. He told them: "Drink from their milk and urine." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a narration of Thabit. This Hadith has been reported through other routes from Anas. Abu Qilabah reported it from Anas, and Sa'eed bin Abu 'Arubah reported it from Qatadah, from Anas
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Urainah qabile ke kuch log Madina aaye, to unhein wahan ka mausam raas na aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein sadqe ke oonton ke paas bheja aur farmaya: "Unka doodh aur peshaab piyo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se, Thabit ki riwayat mein, hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi Anas se riwayat hui hai, Abu Qilabah ne ise Anas se riwayat ki, aur Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah ne ise Qatadah se, Anas se riwayat ki.

e: Narrated Salman: "I read in the Tawrah that the blessing for food is in the Wudu' after it. So I mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ), telling him what I read in the Tawrah. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'The food's blessing is in the Wudu' before it and the Wudu' after it.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from Anas and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] We do not know of this Hadith except as a narration of Qais bin Ar-Rabi'. Qais [bin Ar-Rabi'] was graded weak in Hadith. Abu Hashim Ar-Rumani's (a narrator in the chain) name is Yahya bin Dinar
hi: Salman se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Taurat mein padha ke khaane ki barkat uske baad wuzu karne mein hai. To maine ye baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, unhein bataya ke maine Taurat mein kya padha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khaane ki barkat khaane se pehle wuzu karne aur khaane ke baad wuzu karne mein hai.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Hum ye hadith sirf Qais bin Ar-Rabi ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Qais bin Ar-Rabi hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain. Aur Abu Hashim Ar-Rumani ka naam Yahya bin Dinar hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cae out from the toilet and some food was brought to him. They said: 'Shall we bring you some water for Wudu'?' He said: 'I have only been ordered to perform Wudu' when standing for Salat.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan [Sahih]. 'Amr bin Dinar has reported it from Sa'eed bin Al-Huwairith, from Ibn 'Abbas. 'Ali bin Al-Madini said: 'Sufyan Ath-Thawri disliked washing the hands before eating food, and he disliked placing the bread under the bowl
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bait-ul-khala se nikle, unke saamne khaana rakha gaya, to logon ne kaha: "Kya hum aapke liye wuzu ka paani na laayen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Mujhe to sirf wuzu karne ka hukum diya gaya hai jab main namaz ke liye khadaa hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Amr bin Dinar ne bhi ise Sa'eed bin Al-Huwairith se, Ibn Abbas se riwayat ki. Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: "Sufyan Ath-Thawri khaane se pehle haath dhona napasand karte the, aur roti ko katore ke neeche rakhna bhi napasand karte the."

e: Narrated 'Ikrash bin Dhu'aib: "Banu Murrah bin 'Ubaid sent me to bring the Sadaqah from their wealth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I arrived with him in Al-Madinah and found him sitting between the Muhajirin and the Ansar." He said: "Then he took my hand and brought me to the home of Umm Salamah and he said: 'Do you have any food?' So a bowl containing a lot of Tharid with pieces of meat was brought to us, and presented for us to eat from it. So I began wandering my around it while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ate from what was in front of him. He grabbed my right hand with his left hand, then he said: 'O 'Ikrash! Eat from one spot, for indeed the food is one.' Then a plate containing various dried dates" - or fresh dates - 'Ubaidullah (a narrator) was not sure. He said: "I began eating what was in front of me, while the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) roamed about the plate. He said: 'O 'Ikrash! Eat from wherever you like, for indeed it is not all from the same variety.' Then water was brought, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed his hands, and with the wetness of his hands he wiped his face, his forearms, and his head, and he said: 'O Ikrash! This is the Wudu' for that which has been altered by fire.'" [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it except through the narration of Al-'Ala' bin Al-Fadl, and Al-Ala'was alone with this narration, and there is more in the story in the Hadith. And we do not know a Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ) by 'Ikrash except this
hi: Ikrash bin Dhu'aib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Banu Murrah bin Ubaid ne mujhe apne maal ka sadqa lekar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja. Main Madina unke paas aaya, to maine unhein Muhajireen aur Ansar ke darmiyan baithe paaya." Unhon ne kaha: "Phir unhon ne mera haath pakda aur mujhe Umm Salamah ke ghar le gaye, aur farmaya: 'Kya kuch khaana hai?' To humare paas ek bada katora laaya gaya jismein bahut sa sareed aur gosht ke tukde the, aur hum usmein se khaane lage, to maine apna haath uske alag-alag hisson mein maara, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne saamne se khaa rahe the. To unhon ne apne baaye haath se mera dahina haath pakda, phir farmaya: 'Ae Ikrash! Ek jagah se khaao, kyunki ye ek hi khaana hai.' Phir humare paas ek thaal laaya gaya jismein rang-birangi taaza khajoorein ya sookhi khajoorein thin, Ubaidullah ko shak hai." Unhon ne kaha: "To main apne saamne se khaane laga, jabke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka haath poore thaal mein ghoomta raha, aur unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Ikrash! Jahan se chaho khaao, kyunki ye ek hi qism ki nahi hain.' Phir humare paas paani laaya gaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne haath dhoye aur apne haathon ki geelahat se apna chehra, apne baazu, aur apna sar poncha, aur farmaya: 'Ae Ikrash! Ye us cheez ka wuzu hai jise aag ne badal diya ho.'" Aur hadith mein ek qissa hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Ala bin Al-Fadl ki hadith se jaante hain, Al-Ala is hadith mein akele hain, aur humein Ikrash ki, Nabi (SAW) se, is ke siwa koi aur hadith maloom nahi.

e: Narrated Abu Talut: "I entered upon Anas bin Malik while he was eating gourd, and he was saying: 'O you tree! I do not like you but because of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) liked you.'" He said: There is something on this topic from Hakim bin Jarir, from his father. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib from this route
hi: Abu Talut se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Anas bin Malik ke paas gaya jabke wo kaddu kha rahe the, aur wo keh rahe the: 'Ae ped! Main tujhe sirf isliye pasand karta hoon kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tujhe pasand karte the.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Hakim bin Jabir apne walid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taking from the sides around the dish - meaning the gourd. Since then I still like it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. This Hadith has been reported through more than one route from Anas bin Malik
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko plate mein dhoondte dekha - yani kaddu ko - to main hamesha se isse mohabbat karta hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi Anas se riwayat hui hai, aur riwayat hui hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne kaddu dekha aur unse pucha: "Ye kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ye kaddu hai, hum ise apne khaane mein badhaate hain."

e:
Narrated Ibn Abi 'Ammar:"I asked Jabir: 'Is badger kind of game animal?' He said: 'Yes.'" He said: "I said: 'Should I eat it?' He said: 'Yes.'" He said: 'I said: 'Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say that ?' He said: 'Yes.'"


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.


Some of the people of knowledge followed this. They did not see any harm eating badger. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. A Hadith has been related from the Prophet (ﷺ) indicating disapproval of eating badger but its chain is not strong. Some of the people of knowledge disliked eating badger. This is the view of Ibn Al-Mubarak. Yahya bin Al-Qattan said: "Jarir bin Hazm reported this Hadith from 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaid bin 'Umair, from Ibn Abi 'Ammar, from Jabir, from 'Umar, as his saying. And the narration of Ibn Juraij (a narrator in the chain of this Hadith) is more correct. And Ibn Abi 'Ammar is 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Abdullah bin Abi 'Ammar Al-Makki.
hi: Ibn Abi Ammar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Jabir se pucha: 'Kya lakadbagga shikaar mein shaamil hai?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Kya main ise khaaun?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine unse kaha: 'Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa kaha?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Haan.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm isi taraf gaye hain, unhon ne lakadbagga khaane mein koi harj nahi maana, aur ye Ahmad aur Ishaq ka qaul hai. Aur Nabi (SAW) se lakadbagga khaana napasand karne ki ek hadith riwayat hui hai, lekin uska isnad mazboot nahi. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne lakadbagga khaana napasand kiya, aur ye Ibn Al-Mubarak ka qaul hai. Yahya Al-Qattan ne kaha: Jarir bin Hazim ne ye hadith Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair se, Ibn Abi Ammar se, Jabir se, Umar ka apna qaul riwayat ki. Aur Ibn Juraij ki hadith zyada sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abi Ammar, Abdur-Rahman bin Abdullah bin Abi Ammar Al-Makki hain.

e: Narrated Abu Asid: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Eat of its oil and use it (the olives), for indeed it is from a blessed tree." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib from this route. We only know of it from the narration of Sufyan At-Thawri, from 'Abdullah bin 'Eisa
hi: Abu Aseed se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaitoon ka tel khaao aur ise lagaao, kyunki ye ek mubarak ped se hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki, Abdullah bin Eisa se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Isma'il bin Abi Khalid: From his father that Abu Hurairah informed them that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "When the servant of one of you has endured heat and smoke preparing his food for him, then let him take him by the hand and make him sit him down with him. If he refuses, then let him take a morsel and feed him with it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Khalid is the father of Isma'il, his name is Sa'd
hi: Ismail bin Abi Khalid apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ke khaadim ne uska khaana taiyaar karte hue garmi aur dhuan bardaasht kiya ho, to wo uska haath pakde aur use apne saath bithaaye. Agar wo inkar kare, to wo ek nawaala le kar use khilaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Khalid, Ismail ke waalid, ka naam Sa'd hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Spread the (greetings of) Salam, feed others, strike the heads (of the enemy disbelievers); you will inherit Paradise." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, Ibn 'Umar, Anas, 'Abdus-Salam, 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Aish, and Shuraih bin Hani' from his father. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a narration of [Ibn Ziyad] from Abu Hurairah
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Salaam phailaao, khaana khilaao, aur dushmanon ke sar par maaro, tum Jannaton ke waaris bano ge." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Ibn Umar, Anas, Abdullah bin Salaam, Abdur-Rahman bin Aa'ish, aur Shuraih bin Hani apne walid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Ziyad ki, Abu Hurairah se riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "(All of you) worship Ar-Rahman, feed others, spread the (greeting of) Salam, then you will enter Paradise in security." He said: This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahman ki ibadat karo, khaana khilaao, aur salaam phailaao, tum salaamati ke saath Jannat mein daakhil hoge." Unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Take the 'Asha' meal, even if it is just with a handful of something to fill. For indeed avoiding the 'Asha' is from senility." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Munkar, we do not know of it except from this route. 'Anbasah was graded weak is Hadith. 'Abdul-Malik bin 'Allaq is unknown
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ka khaana khaao, chahe ek mutthi kharab khajoor ho, kyunki raat ka khaana chhodna budhaape ki nishaani hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith munkar hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Anbasah hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur Abdul-Malik bin Allaq majhool hain.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Abi Salamah: That he entered upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he has some food. He said: "Sit down O my son! Mention Allah's Name and eat with your right hand, and eat what is nearest to you." [Abu 'Eisa said:] It has been reported from Hisham bin 'Urwah, from Abu Wajzah As-Sa'idi, from a man from Muzainah, from 'Umar bin Abu Salamah. The Companions of Hisham bin 'Urwah differed in reporting this Hadith. Abu Wajzah As-Sa'di's name is Yazid bin 'Ubaid
hi: Umar bin Abi Salamah se riwayat hai ke wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye jabke unke paas khaana tha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ae mere bete! Qareeb aao, Allah ka naam lo, apne dahine haath se khaao, aur jo tumhare qareeb ho usmein se khaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Hisham bin Urwah se, Abu Wajzah As-Sa'idi se, Muzainah qabile ke ek aadmi se, Umar bin Abi Salamah se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Hisham bin Urwah ke saathiyon ka is hadith ki riwayat mein ikhtilaaf hai. Aur Abu Wajzah As-Sa'di ka naam Yazid bin Ubaid hai.

e:
Narrated Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani:That he said: "O Messenger of Allah! We live in a land of the People of Book and we cook in their containers, and drink in their vessels." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "If you do not find other than them, then rinse them with water."


The he said: "O Messenger of Allah! We live in a land of game, so what should we do ?" He said: "When you send your trained dog, and you mentioned the Name of Allah, and he kills it, then eat it. And when you shoot it with your bow, and it is killed, then eat it.'"


 This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.
hi: Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum ahl-e-Kitab ki zameen mein rehte hain, hum unke bartanon mein pakaate hain aur unke bartanon mein peete hain." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein unke siwa kuch na mile, to unhein paani se dho lo." Phir unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Hum shikaar ki zameen mein rehte hain, to hum kya karen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Jab tum apna sikhaya hua kutta bhejo aur Allah ka naam lo, aur wo shikaar ko maar de, to use khaao, aur agar wo sikhaya hua na ho, magar tumne use zibah kiya ho, to use khaao, aur jab tum apna teer chalaao aur Allah ka naam lo, aur wo maar de, to use khaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Ash-Shaitan has a sense of taste, for which he licks, so beware of him. So whoever spends the night with [a smell] on his hand and something happens to him, then let him not blame anyone but himself." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib from this route. It has also been reported in a narration of Suhail bin Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaitan mehsoos karne wala, chaatne wala hai, to apne aap ko usse bachao. Jo koi raat guzaare jabke uske haath mein charbi ki badbu ho, aur use kuch nuqsaan pahunche, to wo sirf apne aap ko malaamat kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur ye Suhail bin Abi Salih ki, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat mein bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever spends the night with [a smell] on his hand and something happens to him, then let him not blame anyone but himself." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it as a narration of Al-'Amash except through this route
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi raat guzaare jabke uske haath mein charbi ki badbu ho, aur use kuch nuqsaan pahunche, to wo sirf apne aap ko malaamat kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Al-A'mash ki hadith se sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Every intoxicant is Khamr, and every intoxicant is unlawful. Whoever drinks Khamr in this world, and dies continuing it, he will not drink it in the Hereafter. He said: There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, 'Ubadah, Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari, and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The Hadith of Ibn 'Umar is a Hasan Sahih Hadith. It has been reported through other routes from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ). Malik bin Anas reported it from Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar in Mawquf - not Marfu' form
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har nasha-aawar cheez khamr hai, aur har nasha-aawar cheez haraam hai, aur jo koi duniya mein sharaab piye aur usi ki lat mein mar jaaye, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi peeyega." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, Abdullah bin Amr, Ubadah, Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Umar ki hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Nafi se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Aur Malik bin Anas ne ise Nafi se, Ibn Umar se mauqoof riwayat ki, marfu' nahi kiya.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whoever drinks Khamr, Salat is not accepted from him for forty days. If he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance. It he returns to it, then Allah will not accept his Salat for forty days. If he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance. If he returns to it, then Allah will not accepts his Salat for forty days. If he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance. If he returns to it a fourth time, Allah will not accept his Salat for forty days, and if he were to repent, Allah would not accept his repentance, and he will be given to drink from the river of Al-Khabal." They said: "O Aby 'Abdur-Rahman! What is the river of Al-Khabal?" He said: "A river of the pus from the inhabitants of the Fire." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. Similar to this has been reported from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr and Ibn 'Abbas from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi sharaab piye, Allah uski namaz chaalis subah tak qubool nahi karta, agar wo tauba kare, to Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai, agar wo phir piye, to Allah uski namaz chaalis subah tak qubool nahi karta, agar wo tauba kare, to Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai, agar wo phir piye, to Allah uski namaz chaalis subah tak qubool nahi karta, agar wo tauba kare, to Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai, agar wo chauthi baar phir piye, to Allah uski namaz chaalis subah tak qubool nahi karta, aur agar wo tauba kare, to Allah uski tauba qubool nahi karta, aur use Nahr-ul-Khabal se pilaayega." Pucha gaya: "Ae Abu Abdur-Rahman! Nahr-ul-Khabal kya hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Jahannum waalon ke pip ki ek nahar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur isi jaisi Abdullah bin Amr aur Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about Bit' so he said: "All drinks that intoxicate are unlawful." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se "bit'a" ke baare mein pucha gaya, to unhon ne farmaya: "Har nasha-aawar peene ki cheez haraam hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: That the Prophet (ﷺ) "Every intoxicant is unlawful." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Musa, Al-Ashajj, Al-Asri', Dailam, Maimunah, 'Aishah, Ibn 'Abbas, Qais bin Sa'd, An-Nu'man bin Bashir, Mu'awiyah, 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal, Umm Salamah, Buraidah, Abu Hurairah, Wa'il bin Hujr, and Qurrah Al-Muzani. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan. Similar was reported from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ). Both of these are Sahih. More than one narrator reported similarly from Muhammad bin 'Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and from Abu Salamah, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ)
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Har nasha-aawar cheez haraam hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Musa, Al-Ashajj Al-Asri, Dailam, Maimunah, Ibn Abbas, Qais bin Sa'd, An-Nu'man bin Bashir, Muawiyah, Wa'il bin Hujr, Qurrah Al-Muzani, Abdullah bin Mughaffal, Umm Salamah, Buraidah, Abu Hurairah, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur isi jaisi Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai, aur dono sahih hain, kai logon ne Muhammad bin Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai, aur Abu Salamah se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Whatever a lot of it intoxicates, a little of it is unlawful." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Sa'd, 'Aishah, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, Ibn 'Umar, and Khawwat bin Jubair. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib as a narration of Jabir
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis cheez ki zyada maatra nasha kare, uski kam maatra bhi haraam hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'd, Aishah, Abdullah bin Amr, Ibn Umar, aur Khawwat bin Jubair se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Jabir ki riwayat mein hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Every intoxicant is unlawful. Whatever a Faraq of it intoxicates, then a handful of it is unlawful." [Abu 'Eisa said:] One of them said in his Hadith: "A sip of it is unlawful." He said: This Hadith is Hasan. Al-Laith bin Abi Sulaim and Ar-Rabi' bin Sabih reported similar to the narration of Mahdi bin Maimun from Abu 'Uthman Al-Ansari. Abu 'Uthman Al-Ansari's (a narrator in this chain) name is 'Amr bin Salim, and they say: "Umar bin Salim" (as well)
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har nasha-aawar cheez haraam hai, jiska ek 'faraq' nasha kare, uski ek mutthi bhi haraam hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Unmein se ek ne apni hadith mein kaha: "Uska ek ghoont bhi haraam hai." Unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Laith bin Abi Sulaim aur Ar-Rabi bin Sabih ne bhi Abu Uthman Al-Ansari se Mahdi bin Maimun ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Uthman Al-Ansari ka naam Amr bin Salim hai, unhein Umar bin Salim bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Narrated Sulaiman At-Taimi: From Tawus, that a man came to Ibn 'Umar and said: "Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibit Nabidh prepared in eartherware vessels?" He said: "Yes" So Tawus said: "I heard that from him, by Allah." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Abu Awfa, Abu Sa'eed, Suwaid, 'Aishah, Ibn Az-Zubair, and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Sulaiman At-Taimi se riwayat hai, Tawus se, ke ek aadmi Ibn Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mitti ke bartan mein banaayi gayi nabidh se mana kiya tha?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." To Tawus ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Maine ye unse suna hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa, Abu Sa'eed, Suwaid, Aishah, Ibn Az-Zubair, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Zadhan: "I asked Ibn 'Umar about what containers the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited. He informed us in your language, and he explained it to us in our language. He said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited Al-Hantamah, and it is an earthenware container, and he prohibited Ad-Dubba', and it is gourd, and he prohibited An-Naqir, and it is the trunk of a date-palm that is hollowed out or carved, and he prohibited Al-Muzaffat, and it is coated with pitch. And he ordered that Nabidh be prepared in water-skins." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Umar, 'Ali, Ibn 'Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, 'Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mur, Samurah, Anas, 'Aishah, 'Imran bin Husain, 'A'idh bin 'Amr, Al-Hakam Al-Ghifari, and Maimunah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Zadhan se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar se pucha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaunse bartanon se mana kiya, humein humari zabaan mein bataao aur humari zabaan mein iski tafseer karo." To unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Al-Hantamah se mana kiya, aur wo mitti ka bartan hai, aur Ad-Dubba se mana kiya, aur wo kaddu hai, aur An-Naqir se mana kiya, aur wo khajoor ke ped ki jad hai jise khoda ya taraasha jaata hai, aur Al-Muzaffat se mana kiya, aur wo tarkol laga hua bartan hai, aur hukum diya ke nabidh mashkon mein banayi jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umar, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Ibn Abbas, Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, Abdur-Rahman bin Ya'mur, Samurah, Anas, Aishah, Imran bin Husain, Aa'idh bin Amr, Al-Hakam Al-Ghifari, aur Maimunah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Sulaiman bin Buraidah: From his father, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "I had indeed forbidden you from using containers, but the container does not make anything lawful nor unlawful, rather every intoxicant is unlawful." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Sulaiman bin Buraidah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein bartanon se mana kiya tha, lekin bartan kisi cheez ko na halal karta hai na haraam, aur har nasha-aawar cheez haraam hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited using (certain) containers. So the Ansar complained about that to him. They said: 'We will have no vessels!' so he said: 'If so then use them.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, and 'Abdullah bin 'Amr. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bartanon se mana kiya, to Ansar ne unse shikaayat ki aur kaha: 'Humare paas koi aur bartan nahi hai!' Unhon ne farmaya: 'To phir istemal karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Sa'eed, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "We would prepare Nabidh for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a water-skin which was fastened at the top and it has a small hole. We would prepare Nabidh in it during the morning, and drink it during the evening. And we would prepare Nabidh in it during the evening and drink it during the morning." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, and Ibn 'Abbas. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib, we do not know of it as a narration of Yunus bin 'Ubaid except through this route. This Hadith has also been reported through routes other than this from 'Aishah
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke liye ek mashk mein nabidh banaate the jise oopar se bandha jaata tha aur uske neeche ek chhota chhed hota tha, hum use subah banaate aur wo use shaam ko peete, aur hum use shaam ko banaate aur wo use subah peete." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Abu Sa'eed, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Yunus bin Ubaid ki hadith se sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain, aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi Aishah se riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated An-Nu'man bin Bashir: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Indeed Khamr comes from wheat, Khamr comes from barely, Khamr comes from dates, Khamr comes from rasins, and Khamr comes from honey." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib
hi: An-Nu'man bin Bashir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gehun se khamr banti hai, jau se khamr banti hai, khajoor se khamr banti hai, kishmish se khamr banti hai, aur shahad se khamr banti hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Narrated 'Umar: "Indeed Khamr comes from wheat." And he mentioned this Hadith
hi: Umar se riwayat hai: "Gehun se khamr banti hai," aur unhon ne ye hadith zikr ki.

e: Narrated 'Umar bin Al-Khattab: "Indeed Khamr comes from wheat." [After mentioning this, he said:] and this is more correct than the narration of Ibrahim bin Muhajir (no. 1872). 'Ali bin Al-Madini said: "Yahya bin Sa'eed said: 'Ibrahim bin Al-Muhajir is not strong [in Hadith].'" And it has also been reported through other rotes from Ash-Sha'bi, from An-Nu'man bin Bashir
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab se riwayat hai: "Gehun se khamr banti hai," isi jaisi. Aur ye Ibrahim bin Muhajir ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: "Ibrahim bin Muhajir hadith mein mazboot nahi the." Aur ye doosre tareeqon se bhi Ash-Sha'bi se, An-Nu'man bin Bashir se riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Abu Kathir As-Suhaimi: That he heard Abu Hurairah saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Khamr comes from these two trees (plants): The datepalm and the grape (vine)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih. Abu Kathir As-Suhaimi is Al-Ghubari, and his name is Yazid bin 'Abdur-Rahman bin Ghufailah and Shu'bah reported this Hadith from 'Ikrimah bin 'Ammar
hi: Abu Kathir As-Suhaimi se riwayat hai, unhon ne Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khamr in do darakhton se hai: khajoor aur angoor." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Kathir As-Suhaimi, Al-Ghubari hain, unka naam Yazid bin Abdur-Rahman bin Ghufailah hai. Aur Shu'bah ne bhi Ikrimah bin Ammar se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Narrated Jabir bin ‘Abdullah : "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited making Nabidh from unripend dates and fresh dates together. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kachchi khajoor aur taaza khajoor ko ikattha nabidh banaane se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Sa'eed: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited mixing of unripe dates and dates, and mixing of raisins and dates (for making Nabidh), and he prohibited the jars that Nabidh is made in." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Anas, Jabir, Abu Qatadah, Ibn 'Abbas, Umm Salamah, and Ma'bad bin Ka'b from his mother. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne kachchi khajoor aur khajoor ko mila kar, aur kishmish aur khajoor ko mila kar mana kiya, aur mitti ke bartanon mein nabidh banaane se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Anas, Abu Qatadah, Ibn Abbas, Umm Salamah, aur Ma'bad bin Ka'b apni maa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Shu'bah bin Al-Hakam: "I heard Ibn Abi Laila narrating that Hudhaifah asked for water, so someone brought him a vessel made from silver. He threw it, and said: 'I have indeed forbade him, but he refused to stop! Indeed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited drinking from silver and gold vessels, and from wearing silk and Dibaj, and he (ﷺ) said: "If is for them in this world, and for you in the Hereafter." He said: There are narrations on this topic from Umm Salamah, Al-Bara', and 'Aishah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Shu'bah, Al-Hakam se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Laila ko riwayat karte suna ke Hudhaifah ne paani maanga, to ek aadmi unke paas chandi ka bartan laaya, to unhon ne use phenk diya aur kaha: "Maine use mana kiya tha lekin usne baaz aane se inkar kiya! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne chandi aur sone ke bartanon mein peene se, aur resham aur dibaj pehnne se mana kiya, aur farmaya: 'Ye unke liye duniya mein hai aur tumhare liye Aakhirat mein.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Salamah, Al-Bara, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Qatadah: From Anas: "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited that a man should drink while standing." (Qatadah said:) So it was said: "And eating ?" He (Anas) said: "That is worse." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Qatadah, Anas se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne aadmi ko khade hokar peene se mana kiya. To pucha gaya: "Aur khaana?" Unhon ne kaha: "Wo aur zyada sakht hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: "We would eat during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while we were walking, and we would drink while we were standing." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib as a narration of 'Ubaidullah bin 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar. 'Imran bin Hudair reported this Hadith from Abu Al-Bazari, from Ibn 'Umar. Abu Al-Bazari's name is Yazid bin 'Utarid
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein chalte hue khaana khaate the aur khade hokar peete the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ubaidullah bin Umar ki, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se riwayat mein sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Imran bin Hudair ne ye hadith Abu Al-Bazari se, Ibn Umar se riwayat ki. Aur Abu Al-Bazari ka naam Yazid bin Utarid hai.

e: Narrated Al-Jarud bin Al-'Ala': "The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited drinking while standing." And there are narrations on this topic from Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, and Anas. And this Hadith is Hasan Gharib. This Hadith was reported from other narrators, from Sa'eed, from Qatadah, from Abu Muslim, from Al-Jarud, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The Muslim's wandering (animal) stirs the Fire." Al-Jarud bin Al-Mu'alla is called Ibn Al-'Al' but what is correct is Al-Mu'alla
hi: Al-Jarud bin Al-Mu'alla se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne khade hokar peene se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah, aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Isi tarah kai logon ne ye hadith Sa'eed se, Qatadah se, Abu Muslim se, Al-Jarud se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Qatadah se, Yazid bin Abdullah bin Ash-Shikhkhir se, Abu Muslim se, Al-Jarud se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman ka bhatka hua jaanwar aag ki chingaari hai." Aur Al-Jarud, Ibn Al-Mu'alla Al-Abdi hain, Nabi (SAW) ke Sahabi, unhein Al-Jarud bin Al-Ala bhi kaha jaata hai, lekin sahih Ibn Al-Mu'alla hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The Prophet (ﷺ) drank from Zamzam while he was standing." He said: There are narrations on this topic from 'Ali, Sa'd, 'Abdullah bin 'Amr and 'Aishah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Zamzam ka paani khade hokar piya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Sa'd, Abdullah bin Amr, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Amr bin Shu'aib: From his father, from his grandfather who said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drinking while standing and sitting." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khade aur baithe dono halaton mein peete dekha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e:
Narrated Abu Ya'fur:That Ibn Abi Awfa said: "We participated in seven military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), (and) we ate locust."


 Shu'bah reported this Hadith from Abu Ya'fur, from Ibn Awfa and said: "We participated in military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and) we ate locust."
