This was narrated to us by Muhammad bin Bash-shar (who said): "Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us from Shu'bah."
hi: Abu Ya'fur se riwayat hai, Ibn Abi Awfa se, unhon ne kaha: "Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath saat ghazwe kiye, hum tiddiyaan khaate the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Shu'bah ne ye hadith Abu Ya'fur se, Ibn Abi Awfa se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ghazwe kiye, hum tiddiyaan khaate the." Humein ye Muhammad bin Bashshar ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ja'far ne bataya, humein Shu'bah ne isi jaisi bataya.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Let none of you drink all at once like the camel. But drink two or three times, mentioning Allah's Name when you drink, and praising Him when you (finish)." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib. Yazid bin Sinan Al-Jazari is Abu Farwah Ar-Ruhawi
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi oont ki tarah ek saans mein na piye, balki do ya teen saans mein piyo, jab piyo to Allah ka naam lo, aur jab uthaao to uski hamd karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Yazid bin Sinan Al-Jazari, Abu Farwah Ar-Ruhawi hain.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "When the Prophet (ﷺ) drank, he would breathe two times." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Gharib, we do not know of it except as a narration of Rishdin bin Kuraib. He said: I asked [Abu Muhammad] 'Abdullah bin 'Abdur-Rahman about Rishdin bin Kuraib: "Is he stronger (in narration), or Muhammad bin Kuraib?" He said: "Neither are better to me. Rishdin bin Kuraib is preferred over them to me." He said: I asked Muhammad bin Isma'il about this, so he said: "Muhammad bin Kuraib is preferred over Rishdin bin Kuraib." To me, the correct view is what Abu Muhammad 'Abdullah bin 'Abdur-Rahman said: Rishdin bin Kuraib is more preferred and he is elder. He lived to see Ibn 'Abbas, and they are brothers, and they both have Munkar narrations in their reports
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) jab peete, to do baar saans lete. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Rishdin bin Kuraib ki hadith se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Abdur-Rahman se Rishdin bin Kuraib ke baare mein pucha, maine kaha: "Kya wo zyada mazboot hain ya Muhammad bin Kuraib?" To unhon ne kaha: "Dono kareeb hain, aur Rishdin bin Kuraib mere nazdeek zyada raajih hain." Unhon ne kaha: Maine Muhammad bin Ismail se ye pucha, to unhon ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Kuraib, Rishdin bin Kuraib se zyada raajih hain." Aur mere nazdeek sahih baat Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Abdur-Rahman ki hai: Rishdin bin Kuraib zyada raajih aur bade hain, unhon ne Ibn Abbas ko paaya aur unhein dekha, aur wo dono bhai hain, aur donon ke paas munkar riwayaten hain.

e: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri : That the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited blowing into the drink. A man said: "What about if one sees something floating in the vessel?" He said: "Spill it out (removing that)." He said: "I can not drink in one breath." He said: "Then remove the cup away from your mouth." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ayyub bin Habib se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Abu Al-Muthanna Al-Juhani ko Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se zikr karte suna ke Nabi (SAW) ne peene mein phoonk maarne se mana kiya. To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Agar mujhe bartan mein koi tinka dikhe?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Use bahaa do." Usne kaha: "To main ek hi saans mein sair nahi hota." Unhon ne farmaya: "To phir piyaala apne munh se hataao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited breathing in the vessel, or blowing into it." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne bartan mein saans lene ya phoonk maarne se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah: From his father, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "When one of you drinks, then do not breathe into the vessel." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi piye, to bartan mein saans na le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ubaidullah bin 'Abdullah narrated a report (of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from Abu Sa'eed, that he prohibited bending the mouths of the water-skins. He said:There are narrations on this topic from Jabir, Ibn 'Abbas, and Abu Hurairah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat karte hain ke unhon ne mashkon ka munh modne se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Jabir, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Eisa bin 'Abdullah bin Unais: From his father who said: "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) standing at a hanging water-skin, so he bent it, then drank from it." He said: There is something on this topic from Umm Salamah. [Abu 'Eisa said:] The chain of this Hadith is not Sahih. 'Abdullah bin 'Umar Al-'Umari (a narrator in the chain) was graded weak due to his memory, and I do not know if he heard from 'Eisa or not
hi: Eisa bin Abdullah bin Unais apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ek latki hui mashk ke paas khade dekha, unhon ne use moda, phir uske munh se paani piya." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Umm Salamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith ka isnad sahih nahi. Aur Abdullah bin Umar Al-Umari hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, aur mujhe nahi maloom ke unhon ne Eisa se suna ya nahi.

e: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abi 'Amrah: From his grandmother Kabshah who said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon me. He drank from a hanging water-skin while standing. So I went to its mouth and cut it off." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih Gharib. Yazid bin Yazid bin Jabir is the brother of 'Adbur-Rahman bin Yazid bin Jabir. He died earlier than him
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Amrah apni dadi Kabshah se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye aur ek latki hui mashk ke munh se khade hokar paani piya, to main uske munh ki taraf khadi hui aur usse kaat liya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Yazid bin Yazid bin Jabir, Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bin Jabir ke bhai hain, aur unka intiqaal unse pehle hua.

e: Narrated Anas bin Malik: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was brought some milk which was mixed with some water. On his right was a Bedouin and on his left was Abu Bakr. So he drank, then he gave it to the Bedouin and said: 'The right, then the right.'" He said: There are narrations on this topic from Ibn 'Abbas, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ibn 'Umar, and 'Abdullah bin Busr. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas doodh laaya gaya jismein paani milaya gaya tha, aur unke dahine taraf ek Bedouin tha aur unke baaye taraf Abu Bakr the, to unhon ne piya, phir Bedouin ko diya aur farmaya: "Dahina, phir dahina." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Sahl bin Sa'd, Ibn Umar, aur Abdullah bin Busr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated Abu Qatadah: That the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The one providing water for people is the last of them to drink." He said: There is something on this topic from Ibn Abi Awfa. [Abu 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih
hi: Abu Qatadah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qaum ko paani pilaane wala sabse aakhir mein peeta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abi Awfa se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Narrated 'Aishah: "The drink most beloved to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the sweet, cool drink." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This was reported similarly by more than one narrator from Ibn 'Uyainah from Ma'mar, from Az-Zuhri, from 'Urwah from 'Aishah. What is correct what was reported by Az-Zuhri from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sabse mahboob peene ki cheez meethi, thandi cheez thi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah kai logon ne Ibn Uyainah se, Ma'mar se, Az-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aishah se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai, aur sahih baat wo hai jo Az-Zuhri se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat hui hai.

e: Narrated Az-Zuhri: "The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked: 'Which drink is the best ?' He said: 'The sweet, cool drink." [Abu 'Eisa said:] This is how 'Abdur-Razzaq reported it from Ma'mar, from Az-Zuhri, from the Prophet (ﷺ) in Mursal form. This is more correct that the narration of Ibn 'Uyainah (no)
hi: Az-Zuhri se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) se pucha gaya: "Kaunsi peene ki cheez sabse achi hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Meethi, thandi cheez." Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Abdur-Razzaq ne Ma'mar se, Az-Zuhri se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki, aur ye Ibn Uyainah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai.

e: Bahz bin Hakim narrated from his father, from his grandfather who said:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Who most deserves(my) reverence?' He said: 'Your mother.'" He said: "I said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.'" He said: "I said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.'" He said: "I said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Then your father, then the nearest relatives, then the nearest relatives
hi: Bahz bin Hakim apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Sabse zyada kis ke saath achha sulook karoon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apni maa ke saath.' Maine kaha: 'Phir kis ke saath?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apni maa ke saath.' Maine kaha: 'Phir kis ke saath?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Apni maa ke saath.' Maine kaha: 'Phir kis ke saath?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Phir apne waalid ke saath, phir jo sabse qareebi ho usi tarah.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Umar, Aishah, aur Abu Ad-Darda se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Bahz bin Hakim, Ibn Muawiyah bin Haidah Al-Qushairi hain. Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Shu'bah ne Bahz bin Hakim ke baare mein baat ki hai, lekin wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek thiqah hain, aur Ma'mar, Ath-Thawri, Hammad bin Salamah, aur kai imamon ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud said:"I asked the Messenger of Allah: 'O Messenger of Allah! Which is the most virtuous of deeds?' He said: 'Salat during its appropriate time.' I said: 'Then what, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Being dutiful to one's parents.' I said: 'Then what, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Jihad in the cause of Allah.' Then the messenger of Allah was silent, and if I had asked him more, he would have told me more
hi: Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Namaz apne waqt par.' Maine kaha: 'Phir kya, Ya Rasool Allah?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Waalidain ke saath neki.' Maine kaha: 'Phir kya, Ya Rasool Allah?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah ki raah mein jihaad.'" Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse khaamosh ho gaye, aur agar main unse aur maangta to wo mujhe aur bataate. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Ash-Shaibani, Shu'bah, aur kai doosron ne Al-Waleed bin Al-Aizar se ye riwayat ki hai, aur ye hadith doosre tareeqon se bhi Abu Amr Ash-Shaibani se, Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hui hai. Aur Abu Amr Ash-Shaibani ka naam Sa'd bin Iyas hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:the Prophet said: "The Lord's pleasure is in the parent's pleasure, and the Lord's anger is in the parent's anger."(Hasan)
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rab ki raza waalid ki raza mein hai, aur Rab ka gussa waalid ke gusse mein hai." Muhammad bin Bashshar ne humein bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ja'far ne bataya, Shu'bah se, Ya'la bin Ata se, apne walid se, Abdullah bin Amr se isi jaisi, lekin unhon ne ise marfu' nahi kiya, aur ye zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Isi tarah Shu'bah ke saathiyon ne Shu'bah se, Ya'la bin Ata se, apne walid se, Abdullah bin Amr se mauqoof riwayat ki, aur humein maloom nahi ke Khalid bin Al-Harith ke siwa kisi ne Shu'bah se ise marfu' kiya ho. Aur Khalid bin Al-Harith thiqah, mamoon hain. Maine Muhammad bin Al-Muthanna ko kehte suna: "Maine Basra mein Khalid bin Al-Harith jaisa aur Kufa mein Abdullah bin Idris jaisa koi nahi dekha." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami narrated from Abu Ad Darda'.:He said that a man came and said : "I have a wife whom my mother has ordered me to divorce." So Abu Ad-Darda said: " I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'The father is the middle gate to Paradise. So if you wish, then neglect that door, or protect it
hi: Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami se riwayat hai, Abu Ad-Darda se, ke ek aadmi unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Meri ek biwi hai aur meri maa mujhe use talaaq dene ka hukum de rahi hai." Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Waalid Jannat ke darwazon mein se beech ka darwaza hai, agar tum chaaho to is darwaze ko zaaya karo ya ise mehfooz rakho." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha aur kabhi Sufyan ne kaha "meri maa," aur kabhi kaha "mera waalid." Ye hadith sahih hai. Aur Abu Abdur-Rahman As-Sulami ka naam Abdullah bin Habib hai.

e: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah narrated from his father who said:" The messenger of Allah said: 'Shall I not tell you of the biggest of the major sins?' they said : 'Of course! O Messenger of Allah!' He said: 'To join partners with Allah, and disobeying one's parents.'"He said : " He sat up, and he had been reclining. He said: 'And false testimony, or false speech.' And the Messenger of Allah would not stop saying it until we said (to ourselves): 'I wish that he would stop
hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakrah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein sabse bade kabeera gunahon ke baare mein na bataaun?" Unhon ne kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasool Allah!" Unhon ne farmaya: "Allah ke saath shirk karna aur waalidain ki nafarmani karna." Unhon ne kaha: Aur wo takiya lagaaye baithe the, phir wo baith gaye aur farmaya: "Aur jhoothi gawaahi, ya jhooti baat." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye kehte rahe yahan tak ke humne kaha: "Kaash wo khaamosh ho jaate." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Bakrah ka naam Nufai bin Al-Harith hai.

e: Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "It is among the greatest of sins that a man should curse his parents." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! Does a man curse his parents?" He said: "Yes. He verbally abuses the father of a man, who in turn, verbally abuses his father, and he (retaliates and) curses his mother , so he curses his mother
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kabeera gunahon mein se ye hai ke aadmi apne waalidain ko bura-bhala kahe." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya koi apne waalidain ko bura-bhala kehta hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan, wo kisi aadmi ke waalid ko bura-bhala kahe, to wo bhi uske waalid ko bura-bhala kahega, aur wo uski maa ko bura-bhala kahe, to wo bhi uski maa ko bura-bhala kahega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that :the Prophet said: "Among the most dutiful of deeds is that a man nurture relations with the people his father was friends with
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Sabse behtareen neki ye hai ke aadmi apne waalid ke dosti waalon se rishta rakhe." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Aseed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye isnad sahih hai, aur ye hadith Ibn Umar se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Al-Bara' bin Azib narrated that :the Prophet said: "The maternal aunt holds the same status as the mother
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khaala maa ke darje mein hai." Aur hadith mein ek lambi kahaani hai. Ye hadith sahih hai.

e: (Another chain) From Ibn 'Umar:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have been afflicted by a tremendous sin. Is there any repentance for me?" He said: "Do you have your mother?" The man said: "No." He said: "Do you have any maternal aunts?" The man said: "Yes." He said: "Then be dutiful to them
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhse ek bada gunaah hua hai, kya mere liye koi tauba hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumhari koi maa hai?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumhari koi khaala hai?" Usne kaha: "Haan." Unhon ne farmaya: "To uske saath neki karo." Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Bara bin Aazib se bhi riwayat hai.

e: (Another chain) From Abu Bakr bin Hafs, from the Prophet (ﷺ), and it is similar, but he did not mention "from Ibn `Umar" in it. This is more correct than the Hadith of Abu Mu'awiyah, and Abu Bakr bin Hafs is Ibn 'Umar bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (narrators in the chain of this Hadith)
hi: Abu Bakr bin Hafs se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi, lekin ismein "Ibn Umar se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur ye Abu Muawiyah ki hadith se zyada sahih hai. Aur Abu Bakr bin Hafs, Ibn Umar bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas hain.

e: Abu Harairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Three supplications are accepted , there is no doubt in them (about them being accepted): The supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler, and the supplication of his father against his son
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen duayen qubool hoti hain, jinmein koi shak nahi: mazloom ki dua, musafir ki dua, aur waalid ki apne bete ke khilaaf dua." Abu Isa ne kaha: Al-Hajjaj As-Sawwaf ne bhi ye hadith Yahya bin Abi Kathir se Hisham ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Abu Ja'far jinhon ne Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, unhein Abu Ja'far Al-Mu'azzin kaha jaata hai, humein unka naam maloom nahi, aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne unse kai hadithein riwayat ki hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "A son could not do enough for his father, unless he found him as a slave and purchased him to set him free
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi aulad apne waalid ka haq ada nahi kar sakti, siwaye is ke ke wo use gulam paaye aur use khareed kar azaad kar de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Suhail bin Abi Salih ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur kai doosron ne bhi Suhail bin Abi Salih se ye hadith riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Salamah said:" Abu[Ar-Raddad] Al-Laithi complained(of an illness). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf visited him. He said: 'The best of you, and the most apt to maintain good relations, as far as I know, is Abu Muhammad('Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf). So 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf' said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah saying : "Allah, Most Blessed and Most High, said: 'I am Allah, and I am Ar-Rahman. I created the Rahim(womb), and named it after My Name. So whoever keeps good relations with it, I keep good relation with him, and whoever severs it, I am finished with him
hi: Abu Salamah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Abu Ar-Raddad Al-Laithi bimaar hue, to Abdur-Rahman bin Awf unki bimaar-pursi ke liye gaye, to unhon ne kaha: 'Jahan tak mujhe maloom hai, ye tum mein sabse behtar aur sabse zyada sila-rahmi karne wale ho, Ae Abu Muhammad.'" To Abdur-Rahman ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Allah ne farmaya: 'Main Allah hoon, aur main Rahman hoon, maine rahim ko paida kiya aur ise apne naam se ek hissa diya, to jo koi ise jodega, main use jodunga, aur jo koi ise kaatega, main use kaat doonga.'" Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Abi Awfa, Aamir bin Rabi'ah, Abu Hurairah, aur Jubair bin Mut'im se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Sufyan ki, Az-Zuhri se, hadith sahih hai. Aur Ma'mar ne ye hadith Az-Zuhri se, Abu Salamah se, Raddad Al-Laithi se, Abdur-Rahman bin Awf se riwayat ki, aur Ma'mar isi tarah kehte hain. Muhammad ne kaha: "Ma'mar ki hadith galat hai."

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that:the Prophet said: "Merely maintaining the ties of kinship is not adequate. But connecting the ties of kinship is when his ties to the womb are severed and he connects it
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sila-rahmi karne wala wo nahi jo sirf badla utaare, balki sila-rahmi karne wala wo hai jo, jab uska rishta toota ho, use jode." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Salman, Aishah, aur Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im narrated from his father, that:the Messenger of Allah said: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise." Ibn Abi 'Umar said: "Sufyan said: 'Meaning: Ties of the womb
hi: Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rishta kaatne wala Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga." Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha: Sufyan ne kaha: yani rishtedaari kaatne wala. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Umar bin 'Abdul-'Aziz said:'a righteous woman, Khawlah bint Hakim said: "The Messenger of Allah came out during the middle of the day, while holding one of the sons of his daughter in his arms. He was saying: 'You are what makes them stingy, cowardly and ignorant. And you are but Raihanillah
hi: Ibrahim bin Maisarah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Suwaid ko kehte suna: Maine Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ko kehte suna: Neik aurat Khawlah bint Hakim ne bataya, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek din nikle jabke unhon ne apni beti ke do beton mein se ek ko god mein liya hua tha, aur wo keh rahe the: 'Tum log bakhili, buzdili, aur nadaani ka sabab bante ho, lekin tum Allah ke raihaan mein se ho.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Al-Ash'ath bin Qais se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ibn Uyainah ki, Ibrahim bin Maisarah se, hadith hum sirf unki hadith se jaante hain. Aur humein maloom nahi ke Umar bin Abdul-Aziz ne Khawlah se suna ho.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"Al-Aqra' bin Habis saw the prophet kissing Al-Hasan"- Ibn Abi 'Umar (one of the narrators) said:"Al-Hasan and Al-Husain." So he said: 'I have ten children and I do not kiss any one of them.' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever shows no mercy, he will be shown no mercy
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Al-Aqra bin Habis ne Nabi (SAW) ko Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko chumte dekha" - Ibn Abi Umar ne kaha: Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ya Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) - to usne kaha: "Mere das bachche hain, maine unmein se kisi ko nahi chooma." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo reham na kare, uspar reham nahi kiya jaata." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Salamah bin Abdur-Rahman ka naam Abdullah bin Abdur-Rahman bin Awf hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "There is no one who has three daughters, or three sisters, and he treats them well, except that he enters paradise
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis kisi ki teen betiyaan ya teen behnein hon, aur wo unke saath achha sulook kare, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Uqbah bin Aamir, Anas, Jabir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ka naam Sa'd bin Malik bin Sinan hai, aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Sa'd bin Malik bin Wuhaib hain. Aur unhon ne is isnad mein ek aadmi ka izafa kiya hai.

e: Aishah narrated that the:Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever is tried with something from daughters, and he is patient with them, they will be a barrier from the Fire for him
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi betiyon se aazmaaya jaaye aur unpar sabr kare, to wo uske liye aag se ek parda ban jaayengi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Bakr bin 'Ubaidullah bin Anas bin Malik narrated [from Anas] that:the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever raises two girls then I and he will enter Paradise like these two." And he indicated with his two fingers
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo do larkiyon ki parwarish kare, main aur wo Jannat mein isi tarah daakhil honge," aur unhon ne apni do ungliyon se ishara kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Aishah said:"A woman came to me with two daughters. She was asking (for food) but I did not have anything with me except a date. So I gave it to her and she divided it between her two daughters without eating any of it herself. Then she got up to leave, and the Prophet entered, and I informed him about her. So the Prophet said: " Whoever is tested something from these daughters (and he/she passes the test), they will be a screen for them from the Fire
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aurat apni do betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi aur maangne lagi, lekin usne mere paas ek khajoor ke siwa kuch na paaya, to maine wo use de di, usne use apni donon betiyon mein baant diya aur khud usmein se kuch na khaaya, phir wo khadi hokar chali gayi. To Nabi (SAW) andar aaye, maine unhein ye bataya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo bhi in betiyon se aazmaaya jaaye, wo uske liye aag se ek parda ban jaayengi.'" Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that :the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters, or two sisters and he keeps good company with them and fears Allah regarding them, then Paradise is for him
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis kisi ki teen betiyaan ya teen behnein hon, ya do betiyaan ya do behnein hon, aur wo unke saath achha sulook kare aur unke baare mein Allah se dare, to uske liye Jannat hai." Unhon ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that:the Prophet said: Whoever takes in an orphan among the Muslims to raise, to feed him and give him drink, Allah admits him into Paradise without a doubt, unless he has done a sin for which he is not forgiven
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Musalmanon mein se kisi yateem ko apne khaane aur peene ke liye apne paas rakhe, Allah use zaroor Jannat mein daakhil karega, siwaye is ke ke usne aisa gunaah kiya ho jo maaf na kiya jaaye." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Murrah Al-Fihri, Abu Hurairah, Abu Umamah, aur Sahl bin Sa'd se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Hanash, Husain bin Qais hain, unki kuniyat Abu Ali (Alayhis Salam) Ar-Rahbi hai, aur Sulaiman At-Taimi unhein Hanash kehte hain, wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek kamzor hain.

e: Sahl bin Sa'd narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: " I and the sponsor of an orphan shall be in Paradise like these two."And he indicaed with his fingers, meaning his index and his middle finger
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main aur yateem ki kafaalat karne wala Jannat mein aise honge," aur unhon ne apni ungliyon se ishara kiya, yani shahaadat aur beech ki ungli. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that:"An older man came to talk to the Prophet, and the people were hesitant to make room for him. The Prophet said: ;He is not one of us who does not have mercy on our young and does not respect our elders
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek buzurg Nabi (SAW) se milne aaye, to log unhein jagah dene mein der karne lage, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Wo hum mein se nahi jo humare choton par reham na kare aur humare buzurgon ki izzat na kare.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Zarbi, Anas bin Malik aur doosron se munkar hadithein riwayat karte hain.

e: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated that his father, from his grandfather, who said that the Messenger of Allah said:'He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, nor knows the honor of our elders
hi: Amr bin Shu'aib apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo hum mein se nahi jo humare choton par reham na kare aur humare buzurgon ki sharafat na pehchaane." Isi jaisi doosri riwayat mein hai: "Aur humare buzurgon ka haq na pehchaane."

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:" He is not one of us who does not have mercy upon our young, respect our elders, and command good and forbid evil
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wo hum mein se nahi jo humare choton par reham na kare, humare buzurgon ki izzat na kare, achi baat ka hukum na de, aur buri baat se na roke." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ishaq ki, Amr bin Shu'aib se, hadith hasan sahih hai, aur ye Abdullah bin Amr se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai. Kuch ahl-e-ilm ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ke qaul "hum mein se nahi" ka matlab, "humari Sunnat mein se nahi" ya "humare adab mein se nahi." Aur Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne kaha: Sufyan Ath-Thawri is tafseer ko "hum mein se nahi" ka inkaar karte the, wo kehte the: iska matlab "humari tarah nahi" hai.

e: Jarir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever does not show mercy to the people, Allah will not show mercy to him
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo logon par reham nahi karta, Allah uspar reham nahi karta." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Abu Sa'eed, Ibn Umar, Abu Hurairah, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul- Qasim said:"Mercy is not removed (from anyone) except from a wicked one
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Abul-Qasim (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Reham sirf badnaseeb se hi cheeni jaati hai." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Abu Uthman jinhon ne Abu Hurairah se riwayat ki, unka naam maloom nahi, kaha jaata hai wo Musa bin Abi Uthman ke waalid hain, jinse Abu Az-Zinad ne riwayat ki hai, aur Abu Az-Zinad ne Musa bin Abi Uthman se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se kai hadithein riwayat ki hain. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abdullah bin 'Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman. Be merciful on the earth, and you will be shown mercy from Who is above the heavens. The womb is named after Ar-Rahman, so whoever connects it, Allah connects him, and whoever severs it, Allah severs him
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Reham karne walon par Rahman reham karta hai. Zameen walon par reham karo, aasman wala tumpar reham karega. Rahim, Rahman ke naam se nikli hui shaakh hai, to jo ise jode, Allah use jodta hai, aur jo ise kaate, Allah use kaat deta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jarir bin 'Abdullah narrated :" I pledged to the Prophet to establish the Salat, give the Zakat, and to give sincere advice to every Muslim
hi: Jarir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se namaz qaayam karne, zakat dene, aur har Musalman ki khair-khwaahi karne par bai'at ki." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that:the Messenger of Allah said: "The religion is An-Nasihah" three times. They said: "O Messenger of Allah! For Whom?" He said : "To Allah , His books, the A'immah of the Muslims, and their average people
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Deen naseehat hai." Teen martaba. Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kiske liye?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Allah ke liye, uski Kitab ke liye, Musalmanon ke imamon ke liye, aur unke aam logon ke liye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Tamim Ad-Dari, Jarir, Hakim bin Abi Yazid apne walid se, aur Thawban se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: "The Muslim is the brother to the Muslim, he does not cheat him, lie to him, nor deceive him. All of the Muslim is unlawful to another Muslim: His Honor, his wealth, and his blood. At-taqwa is here. It is enough evil for a man that he belittle his brother Muslim
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman Musalman ka bhai hai, na wo uske saath khayanat kare, na jhoot bole, na use zaleel kare. Har Musalman ka doosre Musalman par sab kuch haraam hai: uski izzat, uska maal, aur uska khoon. Taqwa yahan hai." Aur unhon ne apne seene ki taraf ishara kiya. "Aadmi ke liye itni buraai kaafi hai ke wo apne Musalman bhai ko haqeer samjhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abu Ayyub se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Musa Al-Ash'arf narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: The believer is to the believer like parts of a building, each one of them supporting the other
hi: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin Momin ke liye ek imaarat jaisa hai, uska ek hissa doosre hisse ko mazboot karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: "Indeed (each) one of you is the reflection of his brother. So if he sees something harmful in him, then let him remove it from him
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ka aaina hai, to agar wo usmein koi takleef dekhe, to use door kar de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Yahya bin Ubaidullah ko Shu'bah ne kamzor qarar diya hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: "Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement. And whoever helps ease a difficulty in the world, Allah will grant him ease from a difficulty in the world and in the Hereafter. And whoever covers (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will cover (his faults) for him in the world and the Hereafter. And Allah is engaged in helping the worshipper as long as the worshipper is engaged in helping his brother
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi Musalman se duniya ki koi museebat door kare, Allah uski Qayamat ke din ki museebaton mein se ek museebat door karega. Aur jo koi duniya mein kisi tangdast ko aasaani de, Allah use duniya aur Aakhirat dono mein aasaani dega. Aur jo koi duniya mein kisi Musalman ki khaami chhupaaye, Allah duniya aur Aakhirat dono mein uski khaami chhupaayega. Aur Allah banda ki madad mein rehta hai jab tak banda apne bhai ki madad mein rehta hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar aur Uqbah bin Aamir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Awanah aur kai doosron ne bhi ye hadith Al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Ad-Darda narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever protects his brother's honor, Allah protects his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection
hi: Abu Ad-Darda se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo apne bhai ki izzat ki hifazat kare, Allah Qayamat ke din uske chehre se aag hataayega." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Asma bint Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three (days); they come fare to fare and this one turns away, and that one turns away. The best of them is the one who initiates the Salam
hi: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne bhai se teen din se zyada rooth kar rahe, ke jab wo dono mile to ye mun modle aur wo mun mode, aur unmein se behtareen wo hai jo pehle salaam kare." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Anas, Abu Hurairah, Hisham bin Aamir, aur Abu Hind Ad-Dari se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas said:: "When 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf arrived in Al-Madinah, the Messenger of Allah established a bond of brotherhood between him and sa'd bin Ar-Rabi. So he said to him: "Come here, I will divide my wealth and give you half, and I have two wives, I will divorce one of them, and when she completes her waiting period you may marry her." He said: " May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. Show me where the market is." So they showed him where the market was and he did not return that day except with some cottage cheese and cooking fat which he had earned as a profit. The Messenger of Allah saw him after that, and he had traces of yellow on him. So he said to him: "What is this?" He said: "I married a woman from the Ansar." He said : " What dowry did you give her?" He said: " A date-stone(of gold) - ( one of the narrators) Humaid said: "Or he said: - gold equal to the weight of a date-stone." So he said: 'Have a banquet, even if with only a sheep
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Jab Abdur-Rahman bin Awf Madina aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ke darmiyan bhaichaara qaayam kiya, to unhon ne unse kaha: 'Aao, main tumhein apna aadha maal de deta hoon, aur meri do biwiyaan hain, main unmein se ek ko talaaq de doonga, jab uski iddat poori ho jaaye, to tum usse nikah kar lena.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Allah tumhein tumhare ghar walon aur tumhare maal mein barkat de, mujhe bazaar ka raasta dikhaao." To unhon ne unhein bazaar ka raasta dikhaaya, aur us din wo bagair kuch munafe ke, panir aur ghee ke saath hi wapas aaye. Baad mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein dekha jabke unpar zard rang ka nishaan tha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Ye kya hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Maine Ansar ki ek aurat se nikah kiya." Unhon ne farmaya: "To tumne uske liye kya mahr diya?" Unhon ne kaha: "Ek khajoor ki guthli" - Humaid ne kaha: ya kaha - "khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona." To unhon ne farmaya: "Walima karo, chahe ek bakri se hi ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona teen dirham aur ek-tihaai ke barabar hai. Aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim ne kaha: Khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona paanch dirham ke barabar hai. Maine Ishaq bin Mansur ko inhi dono se ye zikr karte suna.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that it was said:" O Messenger of Allah! What is backbiting?" He said : " Mentioning your brother with that which he does not like." He said " What if what I said about him is so?" He said: "If what you said about him is so, then you have backbitten him, and if it is not as you said, then you have slandered him
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Pucha gaya: "Ya Rasool Allah! Gheebat kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ka zikr aisi baat se karna jo use napasand ho." Unhon ne kaha: "Aap ka kya khayaal hai agar usmein wahi ho jo main keh raha hoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Agar usmein wahi ho jo tum keh rahe ho, to tumne uski gheebat ki, aur agar usmein wahi na ho jo tum keh rahe ho, to tumne uspar tohmat lagaayi." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Barzah, Ibn Umar, aur Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Do not cut off one another, nor desert one another, nor hate one another, nor envy one another. Be you , O worshippers o Allah, brothers. It is not lawful for the Muslim to shun his brother for more than three(days)
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ek doosre se rishta na todo, ek doosre se peeth na pherlo, ek doosre se bughz na rakho, ek doosre se hasad na karo, aur Allah ke bande, bhai bano. Aur kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne bhai se teen din se zyada rooth kar rahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Salim narrated from his father who said that the Messenger of Allah said:"There is to be no envy except for two: A man to whom Allah grants wealth and he spends from it during the hours of the night and the hours of the day. And a man to whom Allah grants (memorization of) the Quran so he stands with it (in prayer) during the hours of the night and the hours of the day
hi: Salim apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hasad sirf do mein jaayez hai: ek aadmi jise Allah ne maal diya aur wo use raat aur din kharch karta hai, aur ek aadmi jise Allah ne Quran diya aur wo raat aur din usse khada hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur isi jaisi Ibn Mas'ud aur Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Jabir narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Indeed Ash-Shaitan has despaired of getting those who perform Salat to worship him.But he is engaged in sowing hatred among them
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaitan is baat se maayoos ho gaya hai ke namaz padhne wale uski ibadat karen, lekin wo unke darmiyan fasaad daalne mein lagaa hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Sulaiman bin Amr bin Al-Ahwas apne walid se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Sufyan ka naam Talhah bin Nafi hai.

e: Umm Kulthum bint 'Uqbah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"One who brings peace between people is not a liar, he says something good, or reports something good
hi: Umm Kulthum bint Uqbah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Wo jhoota nahi jo logon ke darmiyan sulh karaaye, to wo achi baat kahe ya achi baat barhaa kar bataaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Asma bint Yazid narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"it is not lawful to lie except in three cases: Something the man tells his wife to please her, to lie during war, and to lie in order to bring peace between the people
hi: Asma bint Yazid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jhoot sirf teen jagah jaayez hai: aadmi apni biwi se baat kare use raazi karne ke liye, aur jang mein jhoot, aur logon ke darmiyan sulh karaane ke liye jhoot." Aur Mahmud ne apni hadith mein kaha: "Jhoot sirf teen jagah theek hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise Asma ki hadith se sirf Ibn Khuthaim ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Dawud bin Abi Hind ne ye hadith Shahr bin Hawshab se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, aur usmein "Asma se" ka zikr nahi kiya. Is mauzu par Abu Bakr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Sirmah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever causes harm, Allah harms him, and whoever is harsh, Allah will be harsh with him
hi: Abu Sirmah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi nuqsaan pahunchaaye, Allah use nuqsaan pahunchaayega, aur jo koi sakhti kare, Allah uspar sakhti karega." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Is mauzu par Abu Bakr se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Cursed are those who harm a believer, or plot to do so
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Malaoon hai wo jo kisi Momin ko nuqsaan pahunchaaye ya uske khilaaf saazish kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Jibril – may the Salawat of Allah be upon him – continued to recommend me about (treating) the neighbors so (kindly and politely), that I thought he would order me to make them heirs.”
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibril mujhe padosi ke baare mein hamesha wasiyat karte rahe, yahan tak ke mujhe laga ke wo use waaris bana denge." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Mujahid narrated:"Abdullah bin Amr had a sheep slaughtered for his family, so when he came he said: 'Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? Have you given some to our neighbor, the Jew? I heard the Messenger of Allah saying: 'Jibril continued to advise me about (treating) the neighbors so (kindly and politely), that I thought he would order me (from Allah) to make them heirs
hi: Mujahid se riwayat hai ke Abdullah bin Amr ke ghar mein unke liye ek bakri zibah ki gayi, jab wo aaye to unhon ne kaha: "Kya tumne humare Yahudi padosi ko diya? Kya tumne humare Yahudi padosi ko diya? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Jibril mujhe padosi ke baare mein hamesha wasiyat karte rahe, yahan tak ke mujhe laga ke wo use waaris bana denge.'" Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Anas, Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad, Uqbah bin Aamir, Abu Shuraih, aur Abu Umamah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith Mujahid se, Aishah aur Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Abdullah bin Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek sabse behtareen saathi wo hai jo apne saathi ke saath sabse behtareen ho, aur Allah ke nazdeek sabse behtareen padosi wo hai jo apne padosi ke saath sabse behtareen ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Abdur-Rahman Al-Hubuli ka naam Abdullah bin Yazid hai.

e: Abu Dharr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Allah has made some of your brothers as slaves under your care. So whoever has his brother under his care, then let him feed him from his food, and let him clothe him from his clothes. And do not give him a duty that he cannot bear, and if you give him a duty he cannot bear, then assist him with it
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare bhai jinhein Allah ne tumhare maatehat naujawan banaaya hai, to jiske maatehat uska bhai ho, wo use apne khaane mein se khilaaye aur apne kapdon mein se pehnaaye, aur use itni zimmedaari na de jo uski taaqat se zyada ho, aur agar de bhi de to uski madad kare." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ali (Alayhis Salam), Umm Salamah, Ibn Umar, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"The one who treats his slaves badly will not enter paradise
hi: Abu Bakr se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Bure sulook wala malik Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani aur kai doosron ne Farqad As-Sabakhi ke baare mein unki hifz ki wajah se baat ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that Abul-Qasim, the Prophet of Repentance, said :"If somebody slanders his slave (by accusing him of committing illegal sexual intercourse) and the slave is innocent from what he says, Allah will impose the punishment upon him on the Day of Resurrection, unless it is as he said about him
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Abul-Qasim (SAW), tauba ke Nabi, ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne gulam par ilzaam lagaaye jabke wo us baat se bari ho jo usne kaha, uspar Qayamat ke din hadd qaayam ki jaayegi, siwaye is ke ke wo waisa hi ho jaisa usne kaha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Abi Nu'm, Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Nu'm Al-Bajali hain, unki kuniyat Abul-Hakam hai. Is mauzu par Suwaid bin Muqarrin aur Abdullah bin Umar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Mas'ud [Al-Ansari] said:"I was beating a slave of mine and I heard someone behind me saying: 'Beware O Abu Mas'ud! Beware O Abu Mas'ud!' So I turned around and saw that it was the Messenger of Allah. He said: 'Allah has more power over you than you do over him." Abu Mas'ud said: "I have not beaten any slave of mine since then
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main apne ek gulam ko maar raha tha, to maine apne peeche se ek kehne wale ko sunaa: 'Jaan lo, Ae Abu Mas'ud! Jaan lo, Ae Abu Mas'ud!' To main mudka, aur dekha ke wo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain, unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah tumpar isse zyada qudrat rakhta hai jitni tum uspar rakhte ho.'" Abu Mas'ud ne kaha: "Iske baad maine kabhi apne kisi gulam ko nahi maara." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibrahim At-Taimi, Ibrahim bin Yazid bin Shareek hain.

e: Abdullah bin 'Umar narrated:"A man came to the Prophet and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' The Prophet was silent. Then he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! How many times should the servant be pardoned?' He said: ' Seventy times each day
hi: Abdullah bin Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main khaadim ko kitni baar maaf karoon?' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaamosh rahe, phir usne kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main khaadim ko kitni baar maaf karoon?' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Har din sattar martaba.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abdullah bin Wahb ne bhi Abu Hani Al-Khaulani se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Aur Al-Abbas, Ibn Julaid Al-Hajri Al-Misri hain.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"When one of you beats his servant then he (should) remember Allah and, withhold your hands
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne khaadim ko maare, aur Allah ka naam yaad kare, to apne haath rok le." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abu Harun Al-Abdi ka naam Umarah bin Juwain hai.

e: Jabir bin Sumurah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"That a man should discipline his son is better for him than to have given a Sa' in charity
hi: Jabir bin Samurah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka apne bete ko adab sikhaana ek saa sadqa karne se behtar hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Nasih, Ibn Al-Ala Kufi hain, wo ahl-e-hadith ke nazdeek mazboot nahi, aur ye hadith sirf is tareeqe se maloom hai.

e: Ayyub bin Musa narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah said :"There is no gift that a father gives his son more virtuous than good manners
hi: Ayyub bin Musa apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi waalid ne apne bete ko achhe adab se behtar koi tohfa nahi diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Aamir bin Abi Aamir Al-Khazzaz ki hadith se jaante hain, aur wo Aamir bin Salih bin Rustum Al-Khazzaz hain, aur Ayyub bin Musa, Ibn Amr bin Sa'eed bin Al-Aas hain. Aur mere nazdeek ye mursal hadith hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"The Prophet would accept gifts and he would give something in return
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) tohfa qubool karte the aur uske badle mein kuch dete the. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Anas, Ibn Umar, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb sahih hai, hum ise marfu' sirf Eisa bin Yunus ki, Hisham se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo logon ka shukriya ada nahi karta, wo Allah ka bhi shukriya ada nahi karta." Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah
hi: Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo logon ka shukriya ada nahi karta, wo Allah ka bhi shukriya ada nahi karta." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Al-Ash'ath bin Qais, aur An-Nu'man bin Bashir se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Dharr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity, commanding good and forbidding evil is charity, your giving directions to a man lost in the land is charity for you. Your seeing for a man with bad sight is a charity for you, your removal of a rock, a thorn or a bone from the road is charity for you. Your pouring what remains from your bucket into the bucket of your brother is charity for you
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ke chehre par muskuraana tumhare liye sadqa hai, achi baat ka hukum dena aur buri baat se rokna sadqa hai, kisi bhatke hue aadmi ko raasta dikhaana tumhare liye sadqa hai, kamzor nazar wale aadmi ke liye dekhna tumhare liye sadqa hai, raaste se patthar, kaanta, ya haddi hataana tumhare liye sadqa hai, aur apne dol se apne bhai ke dol mein paani daalna tumhare liye sadqa hai." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Jabir, Hudhaifah, Aishah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Zumail ka naam Simak bin Al-Waleed Al-Hanafi hai.

e: Al-Bara bin Azib narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"Whoever gives someone some milk or silver, or guides him through a strait, then he will have the reward similar to freeing a slave
hi: Al-Bara bin Aazib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Jo koi doodh ka tohfa de, ya chandi ka tohfa de, ya kisi tang raaste mein raasta dikhaaye, uske liye ek gulam azaad karne jaisa ajr hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Abu Ishaq ki, Talhah bin Musarrif se riwayat mein hasan sahih ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir aur Shu'bah ne bhi Talhah bin Musarrif se ye hadith riwayat ki hai. Is mauzu par An-Nu'man bin Bashir se bhi riwayat hai. Aur unke qaul "chandi ka tohfa de" ka matlab, dirhamon ka qarz dena hai. Aur unke qaul "ya kisi tang raaste mein raasta dikhaaye" ka matlab, raaste ki hidayat dena hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"When a man was walking on the road, he found a thorny branch and removed it. Allah appreciated his action by forgiving him
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Ek aadmi raaste par chal raha tha, jab usne ek kaante wali daali paayi to use hata diya, to Allah ne uski qadar ki aur use maaf kar diya." Is mauzu par Abu Barzah, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said :"When a man narrates a narration, then he looks around, then it is a trust
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jab koi aadmi koi baat sunaaye, phir peeche palat kar dekhe, to wo ek amaanat hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur hum ise sirf Ibn Abi Dhi'b ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Asma bint Abi Bakr said:" O the Messenger of Allah! I have nothing except what was given to me by (my husband) Az-Zubair, shall I give it (in charity)?'" It was said: "Do not hold (your wealth) so that Allah will hold against you
hi: Asma bint Abi Bakr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Mere paas kuch nahi hai siwaye us cheez ke jo Az-Zubair mujhe dete hain, to kya main sadqa de sakti hoon?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan, apne maal ko band mat karo, warna Allah tumpar band kar dega." Yani gin gin kar mat rakho, warna Allah tumpar gin gin kar dega. Is mauzu par Aishah aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Prophet said:"Generosity is close to Allah, close to Paradise, close to the people and far from the Fire. Stinginess is far from Allah, far from Paradise, far from the people and close to the Fire. The ignorant generous person, is more beloved to Allah than the worshiping stingy person
hi: Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Sakhi Allah ke qareeb hai, Jannat ke qareeb hai, logon ke qareeb hai, aag se door hai. Aur kanjoos Allah se door hai, Jannat se door hai, logon se door hai, aag ke qareeb hai. Aur nadaan sakhi, Allah Azza wa Jall ke nazdeek kanjoos aabid se zyada mahboob hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise Yahya bin Sa'eed ki, Al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se riwayat mein sirf Sa'eed bin Muhammad ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Two traits are not combined in a believer: Stinginess and bad manners
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do khaslatein Momin mein ikattha nahi hoti: kanjoosi aur bura akhlaaq." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sadaqah bin Musa ki hadith se jaante hain. Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The swindler, the stingy person, and the Mannan shall not enter Paradise
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Dhokebaaz, ehsaan jataane wala, aur kanjoos Jannat mein daakhil nahi honge." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The believer is naively noble and the stingy person is deceitfully treacherous
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin sadaadil aur karamvala hai, aur badkaar dhokebaaz aur kamina hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"A man's spending on his family is charity
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka apne ghar walon par kharch karna sadqa hai." Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Amr bin Umayyah Ad-Damri, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Thawban narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The most virtuous of the Dinar is the Dinar spent by a man on his dependants, and the Dinar spent by a man on his beast in the Cause of Allah, and the Dinar spent by a man on his companions in the Cause of Allah." Abu Qilabah (one of the narrators) said: " He began with the dependants." Then he said: "And which man is greater in reward than a man who spends upon his depandants, having little ones by which Allah causes him to abstain (from the unlawful) and by which Allah enriches him
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse afzal dinar wo hai jo aadmi apne ghar walon par kharch kare, aur wo dinar jo aadmi Allah ki raah mein apne jaanwar par kharch kare, aur wo dinar jo aadmi Allah ki raah mein apne saathiyon par kharch kare." Abu Qilabah ne kaha: Unhon ne ghar walon se shuru kiya. Phir unhon ne kaha: "To wo kaunsa aadmi hai jo us aadmi se zyada ajr paaye jo apne chhote bachchon par kharch kare, jinke zariye Allah use paakdaman rakhta hai aur Allah use maal-daar karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Shuraih Al-'Adawf said:"My eyes saw the Messenger of Allah, and my ears heard him speaking when he was speaking and he said: 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then let him honor his guest with his reward.' They said: 'What is the reward?' He said: ' A day and a night.' He said: 'And hospitality is for three days, whatever is beyond that is charity. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, then let him say what is good or keep silent
hi: Abu Shuraih Al-Adawi se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Meri aankhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha aur mere kaanon ne unhein sunaa jab unhon ne farmaya: 'Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, wo apne mehmaan ka ikraam kare, uska inaam.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Uska inaam kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ek din aur ek raat, aur mehmaan-nawaazi teen din hai, aur uske baad jo ho wo sadqa hai. Aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, wo achi baat kahe ya khaamosh rahe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Shuraih Al-Kabi narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:: "Hospitality is for three days, and his reward is a day and a night, and whatever is spent on him after that is charity. And it is not lawful for him (the guest) to stay so long as to cause him harm
hi: Abu Shuraih Al-Ka'bi se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mehmaan-nawaazi teen din hai, aur uska inaam ek din aur ek raat hai, aur uske baad jo uspar kharch kiya jaaye wo sadqa hai, aur uske liye jaayez nahi ke wo uske paas theher jaaye yahan tak ke use tang kar de." Is mauzu par Aishah aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Malik bin Anas aur Al-Laith bin Sa'd ne bhi Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se ye riwayat ki hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i, Al-Ka'bi hain, aur wo Al-Adawi hain, unka naam Khuwailid bin Amr hai. Aur unke qaul "uske paas na theher" ka matlab: mehmaan uske paas itna na theher ke ghar ke maalik par sakhti ho jaaye, aur "haraj" tangi hai, unke qaul "yahan tak ke use tang kar de" ka matlab hai: yahan tak ke uspar tangi kar de.

e: Safwan bin Sulaim narrated that the Prophet said:"The one who looks after a widow and a poor person is like the Mujahid in the cause of Allah, or like the one who fasts all the day and stands (in prayer) all the night
hi: Safwan bin Sulaim se riwayat hai, unhon ne ise Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchaaya, unhon ne farmaya: "Bewa aur miskeen ki dekhbhaal karne wala Allah ki raah mein jihaad karne wale jaisa hai, ya us jaisa jo din mein roza rakhta hai aur raat mein qayaam karta hai." Isi jaisi Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai. Aur Abu Al-Ghaith ka naam Salim hai, Abdullah bin Muti ke azaad kiye gulam, aur Thawr bin Zaid Madani hain, aur Thawr bin Yazid Shaami hain.

e: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Every good is charity. Indeed among the good is to meet your brother with a smiling face, and to pour what is left in your bucket into the vessel of your brother
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har achi cheez sadqa hai, aur achi cheezon mein se ye hai ke tum apne bhai se khush chehre ke saath milo, aur apne dol se jo bacha ho use apne bhai ke bartan mein daalo." Is mauzu par Abu Dharr se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Abide by truthfulness. For indeed truthfulness leads to righteousness. And indeed righteousness leads to Paradise. A man continues telling the truth and trying hard to tell the truth until he is recorded with Allah as a truthful person. Refrain from falsehood. For indeed falsehood leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire. A slave (of Allah) continues lying and trying hard to lie, until he is recorded with Allah as a liar
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sach par qaayam raho, kyunki sach neki ki taraf le jaata hai, aur neki Jannat ki taraf le jaati hai. Aur aadmi sach bolta rehta hai aur sach ki koshish karta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke paas usse sacha likh diya jaata hai. Aur jhoot se bacho, kyunki jhoot gunaah ki taraf le jaata hai, aur gunaah aag ki taraf le jaata hai. Aur banda jhoot bolta rehta hai aur jhoot ki koshish karta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke paas usse jhoota likh diya jaata hai." Is mauzu par Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, Umar, Abdullah bin Ash-Shikhkhir, aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"When the slave (of Allah) lies, the angel goes a mile away from him because of the stench of what he has done."Yahya said: "(I asked) 'Abdur-Rahim bin Harun if he approved of it,and he said 'Yes
hi: Yahya bin Musa se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Abdur-Rahim bin Harun Al-Ghassani se kaha: "Kya aapko Abdul-Aziz bin Abi Rawwad ne, Nafi se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab banda jhoot bolta hai, to Farishta uski badbu ki wajah se ek meel door ho jaata hai jo wo laaya hai'?" Yahya ne kaha: To Abdur-Rahim bin Harun ne isse tasdeeq ki aur kaha: "Haan." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain, aur Abdur-Rahim bin Harun isme akele hain.

e: Aishah narrated:"There was no behavior more hated to the Messenger of Allah than lying. A man would lie in narrating something in the presence of the Prophet, and he would not be content until he knew that he had repented
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kisi bhi bure akhlaaq se zyada koi cheez napasand nahi thi jitna jhoot, aur jab koi aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke saamne kuch jhoot bol deta, to wo uske dil mein rehta yahan tak ke usse maloom ho jaata ke usne uski tauba kar li hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Anas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Al-Fuhsh is not present in anything but it mars it, and Al-Haya' is not present in anything but it beautifies it
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fahash-goi kisi cheez mein nahi hoti magar use bad-numa banaa deti hai, aur haya kisi cheez mein nahi hoti magar use khoobsurat banaa deti hai." Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdur-Razzaq ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Abdullah bin 'Amr said; "The Messenger of Allah said:"The best of you are those best in conduct.' And the Prophet was not one who was obscene, nor one who uttered obscenities
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein sabse behtareen wo hai jiska akhlaaq sabse acha ho." Aur Nabi (SAW) na fahash-go the na fahash-goi karne wale. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Samurah bin Jundab narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Do not curse yourselves with Allah's curse, nor with His anger, nor with the Fire
hi: Samurah bin Jundab se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ek doosre par Allah ki la'nat, uske gusse, ya aag se la'nat na karo." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Umar, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The believer does not insult the honor of others, nor curse, nor commit Fahishah, nor is he foul
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin taana-zani karne wala nahi hota, na la'nat karne wala, na fahash-go, na badzabaan." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Abdullah se doosre tareeqon se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that a man cursed the wind in the presence of the Prophet, so he said:"Do not curse the wind, for it is merely doing as ordered , and whoever curses something undeservingly, then the curse returns upon him
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne hawa ko bura-bhala kaha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Hawa ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki wo hukum ki paaband hai, aur jo koi kisi aisi cheez ko bura-bhala kahe jiska wo haqdaar na ho, to wo la'nat usi par palat aati hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, humein maloom nahi ke Bishr bin Umar ke siwa kisi ne ise musnad kiya ho.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Learn enough about your lineage to facilitate keeping your ties of kinship. For indeed keeping the ties of kinship encourages affection among the relatives, increases the wealth, and increases the lifespan
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne nasab ke baare mein itna seekho jitna tumhein apni rishtedaari jodne mein kaam aaye, kyunki sila-rahmi ghar walon mein mohabbat paida karti hai, maal mein izafa karti hai, aur umar mein barhotri karti hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai. Aur unke qaul "umar mein barhotri" ka matlab: umar mein izafa.

e: Abudullah bin 'Amr narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"No supplication is more readily responded to, than the supplication made for someone who is absent
hi: Abdullah bin Amr se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi dua isse zyada jaldi qubool nahi hoti jitni ghaayab shakhs ki ghaayab shakhs ke liye dua." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Al-Ifriqi hadith mein kamzor qarar diye jaate hain, wo Abdur-Rahman bin Ziyad bin An'um hain, aur Abdullah bin Yazid, Abu Abdur-Rahman Al-Hubuli hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"(The burden of) what is said by the two who vilify each other is upon the one who initiated it, as long as the one who was wronged does not transgress
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do galiyaan dene walon ke darmiyan jo kuch kaha jaaye uska bojh shuruaat karne wale par hai, jab tak mazloom hadd se aage na badhe." Is mauzu par Sa'd, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Abdullah bin Mughaffal se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Do not vilify the dead (and) by that harm the living
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Murdon ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki isse tum zinda logon ko takleef pahunchaate ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Sufyan ke saathiyon ka is hadith mein ikhtilaaf hai, kuch ne Al-Hafari ki riwayat jaisi riwayat ki, aur kuch ne Sufyan se, Ziyad bin Alaqah se riwayat ki, unhon ne kaha: Maine ek aadmi ko Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ke paas isi jaisi hadith Nabi (SAW) se sunaate suna.

e: Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Verbally abusing the Muslim is disobedience and fighting him is disbelief." Zubaid said:"I said to Abu Wa'il: 'Did you hear it from 'Abdullah?' He said: 'Yes
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman ko gaali dena fisq hai, aur usse ladna kufr hai." Zubaid ne kaha: Maine Abu Wa'il se pucha: "Kya aapne ye khud Abdullah se suna?" Unhon ne kaha: "Haan." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ali narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Indeed in Paradise there are chambers, whose outside can be seen from their inside, and their inside can be seen from their outside." A Bedouin stood and said : 'Who are they for, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "For those who speak well, feed others, fast regularly, and perform salat [for Allah] during the night while the people sleep
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat mein aise kamre hain jinke bahar ka hissa andar se aur andar ka hissa bahar se dikhaayi deta hai." To ek Bedouin khada hua aur kaha: "Ye kiske liye hain, Ya Rasool Allah?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ke liye jo achi baat kare, khaana khilaaye, roze mein musalsal rahe, aur raat mein Allah ke liye namaz padhe jabke log soye hon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abdur-Rahman bin Ishaq ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"How wonderful it is for one of them that he obeys Allah and fulfills the rights of his master." Meaning the slave. And Ka'b said: "Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kitni achi baat hai unmein se kisi ke liye ke wo apne Rab ki farmaanbardaari kare aur apne malik ka haq ada kare" - yani gulam. Aur Ka'b ne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach kaha." Is mauzu par Abu Musa aur Ibn Umar se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"There shall be upon dunes of musk- I think he said: On the Day of Judgment- a slave who fulfills Allah's right and the right of his patron (master), a man who leads a people (in prayer)) and they are pleased with him. And a man who calls for the five prayers during every day and night
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen log kasturi ke teelon par honge" - mera khayaal hai unhon ne kaha "Qayamat ke din" - "ek wo gulam jisne Allah ka haq aur apne maalikon ka haq ada kiya, ek wo aadmi jo kisi qaum ka imam bane aur wo usse raazi hon, aur ek wo aadmi jo har din aur raat mein paanch namazon ke liye azaan de." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki, Abul-Yaqzan se riwayat mein sirf Waki ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abul-Yaqzan ka naam Uthman bin Qais hai, unhein Ibn Umair bhi kaha jaata hai, jo zyada mash'hoor hai.

e: Abu Dharr said:"The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'Have Taqwa of Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to wipe it out, and treat the people with good behavior
hi: Abu Dharr se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Jahan bhi ho, Allah ka taqwa ikhtiyar karo, aur buraai ke baad neki karo, wo use mita degi, aur logon ke saath achhe akhlaaq se pesh aao." Unhon ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Beware of Zann (suspicion), for indeed Zann is the falsest of speech
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Gumaan se bacho, kyunki gumaan sabse jhooti baat hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Unhon ne kaha: Maine Abd bin Humaid ko Sufyan ke kuch saathiyon se zikr karte suna ke Sufyan ne kaha: Gumaan do tarah ka hai, ek gunaah waala gumaan aur ek gunaah na waala gumaan. Jo gunaah waala gumaan hai wo ye hai ke aadmi kuch gumaan kare aur usse zabaan par bhi laaye, aur jo gunaah na waala gumaan hai wo ye hai ke aadmi gumaan kare lekin usse zabaan par na laaye.

e: Anas narrated:" The Messenger of Allah used to mingle with us such that he said to my younger brother: 'O Abu 'Umair! What did the Nughair do?
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare saath ghul-mil jaate the, yahan tak ke wo mere chhote bhai se kehte: 'Ae Abu Umair! Nughair ka kya hua?'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"They said: 'O Messenger of Allah! You joke with us?' He said: 'Indeed I do not say except what is true.'" (Hasan)
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aap humse mazaak karte hain?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Main sirf sach hi kehta hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated:"A man sought a mount from the Messenger of Allah who said: 'Indeed, I will let you ride on a she-camel's child.' So he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! What can ashe-camel's child do?' So the Messenger of Allah said: 'Are camels borne from other than she-camels?
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sawaari maangi, to unhon ne farmaya: "Main tumhein ek oontni ke bachche par sawaar karaunga." To usne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Main oontni ke bachche ka kya karoonga?" To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya oont oontniyon ke siwa kisi aur se paida hote hain?" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"O possessor of two ears!" Mahmud said: "Abu Usamah said: 'He only meant it as a joke
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ae do kaanon wale!" Mahmud ne kaha: Abu Usamah ne kaha: yani unhon ne unse mazaak kiya. Ye hadith sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever avoids lying while he is doing so falsely, a house will be built for him on the skirts of Paradise. Whoever avoids arguing while he is in the right, a house will be built for him in its midst. And whoever has good character, a house will be built for him in its heights
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi jhoot chhode jabke wo baatil hai, uske liye Jannat ke kinaare mein ghar banaya jaayega. Aur jo koi jhagda chhode jabke wo haq par ho, uske liye uske beech mein ghar banaya jaayega. Aur jo apna akhlaaq achha kare, uske liye uske sabse oonche hisse mein ghar banaya jaayega." Ye hadith hasan hai, hum ise sirf Salamah bin Wardan ki, Anas bin Malik se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"It is enough sin for you that you never stop disputing
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye itna hi gunaah kaafi hai ke tum hamesha jhagda karte raho." Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Ibn Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Do not argue with your brother, do not joke with him, and do not make a promise, only to not fulfill it
hi: Ibn Abbas se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Apne bhai se jhagda mat karo, uske saath mazaak mat karo, aur usse koi waada mat karo phir use tod do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur Abdul-Malik mere nazdeek Ibn Abi Bashir hain.

e: Aisha narrated:"A man sought permission to enter upon the Messenger of Allah while I was with him, so he said: 'What an evil son of his tribe, or brother of his tribe.' Then he admitted him and spoke with him. When he left, I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! You said what you said about him. Then you talked politely with him?' He said: 'O 'Aishah! Indeed among the evilest of people are those whom the people avoid, or who the people leave, fearing his filthy speech
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi jabke main unke paas thi, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Kya hi bura hai apne qabile ka beta, ya apne qabile ka bhai.' Phir unhon ne use ijazat di aur usse narmi se baat ki. Jab wo chala gaya, to maine unse kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Aapne uske baare mein jo kaha wo kaha, phir aap usse narmi se baat karne lage?' To unhon ne farmaya: 'Ae Aishah! Logon mein sabse bure wo hain jinhein log unki fahash-goi se bachne ke liye chhod dete hain.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Muhammad bin Sirin narrated from Abu Hurairah - and I think he (narrated it from the Prophet) who said:"Love your beloved moderately, perhaps he becomes hated to you someday. And hate whom you hate moderately, perhaps he becomes your beloved someday
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, mera khayaal hai unhon ne ise marfu' kiya, unhon ne kaha: "Apne mehboob se munaasib mohabbat karo, shayad wo kisi din tumhara dushman ban jaaye. Aur apne dushman se munaasib bughz rakho, shayad wo kisi din tumhara mehboob ban jaaye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is isnad se ghareeb hai, hum ise is tareeqe se hi jaante hain. Aur ye hadith Ayyub se ek doosre isnad se bhi riwayat hui hai, Al-Hasan bin Abi Ja'far ne ise riwayat ki hai, aur ye bhi kamzor hadith hai, unka isnad Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi (SAW) se hai, aur sahih baat ye hai ke ye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka apna mauqoof qaul hai.

e: Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever has a mustard seed's weight of pride (arrogance) in his heart, shall not be admitted into Paradise. And whoever has a mustard seed's weight of faith in his heart, shall not be admitted into the Fire
hi: Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske dil mein raai ke daane ke barabar bhi ghamand ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga, aur jiske dil mein raai ke daane ke barabar bhi imaan ho, wo aag mein daakhil nahi hoga." Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Salamah bin Al-Akwa, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever has a speck of pride (arrogance) in his heart, shall not be admitted into Paradise. And whoever has a speck of faith in his heart, shall not be admitted in to the Fire.'" He said: "So a man said to him: 'I like for my clothes to be nice, and my sandals to be nice?'
