So he said: 'Indeed Allah loves beauty. But pride is refusing the truth and belittling the people
hi: Abdullah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jiske dil mein zarre ke barabar bhi ghamand ho, wo Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga, aur wo aag mein daakhil nahi hoga - yani jiske dil mein zarre ke barabar imaan ho." Unhon ne kaha: To ek aadmi ne unse kaha: "Mujhe achha lagta hai ke mera kapda achha ho aur meri chappal achi ho." Unhon ne farmaya: "Allah husn ko pasand karta hai, lekin ghamand ye hai ke haq ko na maane aur logon ko haqeer samjhe." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne is hadith ki tafseer mein kaha: "Jiske dil mein zarre ke barabar bhi imaan ho, wo aag mein daakhil nahi hoga" ka matlab ye hai ke wo hamesha ke liye aag mein nahi rahega. Aur isi tarah Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jiske dil mein zarre ke barabar bhi imaan ho, wo aag se nikaal diya jaayega." Aur kai Tabi'een ne is Ayat ki tafseer ki: "(Humare Rab! Jise tu aag mein daakhil kare, to usne use ruswaa kar diya)," unhon ne kaha: Jise tu aag mein hamesha ke liye rakhe, usne use ruswaa kar diya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Iylas bin Salamah bin Al-Akwa' narrated from his father that the Messenger of Allah said:"A man shall remain exalting himself until he is written among the tyrants, so that he suffers from their afflictions
hi: Iyas bin Salamah bin Al-Akwa apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi apne aap ko bada samajhta rehta hai yahan tak ke wo zaalimon mein likh diya jaata hai, phir usse wahi museebat pahunchti hai jo unhein pahunchi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Jubair bin Mut'im narrated from his father who said:"They (meaning the people in general) told me that I was proud, while I rode a donkey, wore a cloak, and I milked the sheep. And the Messenger of Allah said to me: "Whoever does these, then there is no pride (arrogance) in him
hi: Jubair bin Mut'im apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Tum log mujhse kehte ho ke mujhme ghamand hai, jabke maine gadhe par sawaari ki hai, chaadar odhi hai, aur bakri ka doodh nikaala hai. Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo ye kare, uske andar ghamand ki koi baat nahi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Ad-Dardh narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Nothing is heavier on the believer's Scale on the Day of Judgment than good character. For indeed Allah, Most High, is angered by the shameless obscene person
hi: Abu Ad-Darda se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ke Qayamat ke din ke taraazu mein achhe akhlaaq se zyada bhaari koi cheez nahi hai, aur Allah fahash-go, badzabaan ko sakht napasand karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Abu Hurairah, Anas, aur Usamah bin Shareek se bhi riwayat hai. Aur ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Ad-Dardh narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Nothing is placed on the Scale that is heavier than good character. Indeed the person with good character will have attained the rank of the person of fasting and prayer
hi: Abu Ad-Darda se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Taraazu mein achhe akhlaaq se zyada bhaari koi cheez nahi rakhi jaati, aur achhe akhlaaq wala roze aur namaz waale ke darje tak pahunch jaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith is tareeqe se ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah was asked about that for which people are admitted into Paradise the most, so he said:"Taqwa of Allah, and good character." And he was asked about that for which people are admitted into the Fire the most, and he said: " The mouth and the private parts
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha gaya ke sabse zyada log kis cheez ki wajah se Jannat mein daakhil hote hain, to unhon ne farmaya: "Allah ka taqwa aur achhe akhlaaq." Aur unse pucha gaya ke sabse zyada log kis cheez ki wajah se aag mein daakhil hote hain, to unhon ne farmaya: "Munh aur sharamgah." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Abdullah bin Idris, Ibn Yazid bin Abdur-Rahman Al-Awdi hain.

e: Abu Wahb narrated that :'Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak explained good character, and then he said: "It is a smiling face, doing one's best in good, and refraining from harm
hi: Abu Wahb se riwayat hai ke Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ne achhe akhlaaq ki tareef ki aur kaha: "Wo khush-mizaaji, neki karna, aur takleef se bachna hai."

e: Abu Al-Ahwas narrated from his father who said:"I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I stayed with a man who did not entertain me nor behave hospitably with me. Then he came to stay with me, shall I reciprocate the same to him?' He (ﷺ said: 'No, entertain him." He said: 'He (ﷺ saw me wearing tattered clothes and said:'(Do you have any wealth?' I said: 'Allah has given me various kinds of wealth through camels and goats.' He said: 'Then let it be seen on you)
hi: Abul-Ahwas apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main ek aadmi ke paas se guzarta hoon, wo meri mehmaan-nawaazi nahi karta na mujhe mehmaan banaata hai, phir wo mere paas se guzarta hai, to kya main usse badla loon?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Nahi, uski mehmaan-nawaazi karo.'" Unhon ne kaha: Aur unhon ne mujhe pheeke kapdon mein dekha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare paas maal hai?" Maine kaha: "Har tarah ka maal, Allah ne mujhe oont aur bakriyaan di hain." Unhon ne farmaya: "To wo tumpar dikhna chahiye." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Jabir, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abul-Ahwas ka naam Awf bin Malik bin Nadlah Al-Jushami hai. Aur unke qaul "uski mehmaan-nawaazi karo" ka matlab: use mehmaan banaao, aur "qira" mehmaan-nawaazi hai.

e: Hudhaifah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:“Do not be a people without a will of your own, saying: 'If people treat us well, we will treat them well; and if they do wrong, we will do wrong,' but accustom yourselves to do good if people do good, and do not behave unjustly if they do evil.”
hi: Hudhaifah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bina apni raay ke log mat bano jo kehte hain: agar log achha karen to hum bhi achha karenge, aur agar wo zulm karen to hum bhi zulm karenge. Balki apne aap ko is baat par mustahkam karo ke agar log achha karen to tum achha karo, aur agar wo bura karen to tum zulm mat karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever visits the sick, or visits his brother in Allah (faith), a caller calls out: 'May you have goodness and livelihood be good, and may you dwell in an adobe in Paradise
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi bimaar ki bimaar-pursi kare ya Allah ke liye apne kisi bhai se milne jaaye, ek pukaarne wala use pukaarta hai: 'Tum achhe ho, tumhara chalna achha raha, aur tumne Jannat mein apna thikaana bana liya.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Sinan ka naam Eisa bin Sinan hai. Aur Hammad bin Salamah ne bhi Thabit se, Abu Rafi se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi kuch riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Al-Haya is from faith, and faith is in Paradise. Obscenity is from rudeness, and rudeness is in the Fire
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haya imaan mein se hai, aur imaan Jannat mein hai, aur badzabaani jafa mein se hai, aur jafa aag mein hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Umar, Abu Bakrah, Abu Umamah, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abdullah bin Sarjis Al-Muzam narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Taking the good route is a part of the twenty-four parts of Prophethood
hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis Al-Muzani se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achi seerat, itmenaan, aur mitanasib chaal, nubuwwat ke chaubees hisson mein se ek hissa hai." Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah said to the Ashajj 'Abdul-Qais:"Indeed there are two traits in you that Allah loves: Forbearance, and deliberateness
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ashajj Abdul-Qais se farmaya: "Tumhare andar do khaslatein hain jinhein Allah pasand karta hai: bardaasht aur itmenaan." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Is mauzu par Al-Ashajj Al-Asri se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Abdullah-Muhaimin bin 'Abbas bin Sahl bin Sa'd As-Saidi narrated from his father, from his grandfather, who said that the Messenger of Allah said:"Deliberateness is from Allah, and haste is from the Ash-shaitan
hi: Abdul-Muhaimin bin Abbas bin Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi apne walid se, apne dada se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Itmenaan Allah ki taraf se hai, aur jaldbaazi Shaitan ki taraf se hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai. Aur kuch ahl-e-hadith ne Abdul-Muhaimin bin Abbas bin Sahl ke baare mein baat ki hai aur unki hifz ki wajah se unhein kamzor qarar diya. Aur Ashajj bin Abdul-Qais ka naam Al-Mundhir bin Aa'idh hai.

e: Abu Ad-Darda narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever was given his share of gentleness, then he has been given a share of good. And whoever has been prevented from his share of gentleness, then he has been prevented from his share of good
hi: Abu Ad-Darda se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jise narmi ka hissa mila, use bhalaai ka hissa mila, aur jise narmi ke hisse se mehroom rakha gaya, use bhalaai ke hisse se mehroom rakha gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah, Jarir bin Abdullah, aur Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah sent Mu'adh [bin Jabal] to Yemen, and said: 'Beware of the supplication of the oppressed; for indeed there is no barrier between it and Allah
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Yaman bheja aur farmaya: "Mazloom ki dua se bacho, kyunki uske aur Allah ke darmiyan koi parda nahi hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas, Abu Hurairah, Abdullah bin Umar, aur Abu Sa'eed se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Ma'bad ka naam Naafidh hai.

e: Anas narrated:that "I served the Prophet for ten years. He never said Uff and never blamed me by saying: 'Why did you do so' or why did you not do so?' And the Messenger Of Allah had the best character among all of the people. I never touched Khazz nor silk, nor anything softer than the hand of the Messenger of Allah, nor have I smelled musk, or a fragrance sweeter than the sweat of the Messenger of Allah
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ki das saal khidmat ki, unhon ne kabhi mujhse 'Uff' nahi kaha, na kabhi kisi kaam par jo maine kiya ye kaha 'tumne kyun kiya,' na kabhi kisi kaam par jo maine chhoda ye kaha 'tumne kyun chhoda.' Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) logon mein sabse achhe akhlaaq wale the. Maine kabhi resham ya khazz nahi chhua, na koi cheez chhui jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hatheli se zyada narm ho, aur maine kabhi kasturi nahi soonghi, na koi khushbu jo Nabi (SAW) ke paseene se zyada khushboodaar ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Aishah aur Al-Bara se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Abdullah Al-Jadali narrated:"I asked 'Aishah about the character of the Messenger of Allah. She said: 'He was not obscene, nor uttering obscenities, nor screaming in the markets, he would not return an evil with an evil, but rather he was pardoning and forgiving
hi: Abu Abdullah Al-Jadali se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Aishah se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke akhlaaq ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Wo na fahash-go the, na fahash-goi karne wale, na bazaaron mein cheekhne wale, aur na wo buraai ka badla buraai se dete, balki wo maaf karte aur darguzar karte.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Abdullah Al-Jadali ka naam Abd bin Abd hai, unhein Abdur-Rahman bin Abd bhi kaha jaata hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"I was not jealous of any wife of the Prophet as I was jealous of Khadijah, and it was not because I saw her. It was only because the Messenger of Allah mentioned her so much, and because whenever he would slaughter a sheep, he would look for Khadijah's friends to gift them some of it
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ki kisi biwi par utni ghairat nahi ki jitni Khadijah par ki, jabke main unse mili bhi nahi thi, aur ye sirf isliye tha kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unka bahut zikr karte the, aur jab wo bakri zibah karte, to Khadijah ki saheliyon ko dhoondte aur unhein tohfa dete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Jabir narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Indeed the most beloved among you to me, and the nearest to sit with me on the Day of Judgment is the best of you in character. And indeed, the most disliked among you to me, and the one sitting furthest from me on the Day of Judgement are the Thartharun, and the Mutashaddiqun and the Muthafaihiqun." They said: "O Messenger of Allah! We know about the Thartharun, and the Mutashaddiqun, but what about the Muthafaihiqun?"' He said:"The arrogant
hi: Jabir se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se mujhe sabse zyada mehboob aur Qayamat ke din mere sabse qareeb baithne wala wo hai jiska akhlaaq sabse achha ho, aur tum mein se mujhe sabse zyada napasand aur Qayamat ke din mujhse sabse door baithne wala wo hai jo bahut bolne wala, munh se rassi khinchne wala, aur ghamand se baat karne wala ho." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Humne bahut bolne wale aur munh se rassi khinchne wale ko jaan liya, lekin ghamand se baat karne wala kaun hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ghamandi log." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Hurairah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"The believer is not one who curses others
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin la'nat karne wala nahi hota." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Mas'ud se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur kuch logon ne isi isnad se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Momin ke liye la'nat karne wala hona theek nahi." Aur ye hadith isse wazeh karti hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said:"Teach me something that is not too much for me so that, perhaps, I may abide by it." He (S.A.W) said: "Do not get angry." He repeated that (the request) a number of times, each time he replied: 'Do not get angry
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Mujhe kuch sikhaayiye, aur zyada na sikhaayiye taake mujhe yaad rahe.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Gussa mat karo.' Usne ye baat kai baar dohraayi, har baar unhon ne kaha: 'Gussa mat karo.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abu Sa'eed aur Sulaiman bin Surad se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Abu Hasin ka naam Uthman bin Aasim Al-Asadi hai.

e: Sahl bim Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever suppresses his rage while he is able to unleash it, Allah will call him before the heads (leaders) of creation on the Day of Judgement, so that he can inform Him of which of the Hur he would like
hi: Sahl bin Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apna gussa piye jabke wo use nikaal sakta ho, Allah use Qayamat ke din tamaam makhlooq ke saamne bulaayega yahan tak ke use ikhtiyar de ke wo jo bhi Hoor chaahe chun le." Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"No young person honors an elder due to his age, except that Allah appoints for him one who will honor him at that age
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi naujawan kisi budhe ki uski umar ki wajah se izzat nahi karta, magar Allah uske liye kisi ko muqarrar kar deta hai jo uski umar mein uski izzat kare." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is shaikh Yazid bin Bayan ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Abu Ar-Rijal Al-Ansari koi aur hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.A.W) said:"The gates of Paradise are opened on Monday and Thursday. In them, (will enter) whoever has not associated anything with Allah will be forgiven, except for the two who shun each other, (about whom) it is said: 'Return these two until they make amends
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ke darwaaze Somwaar aur Guruwaar ko khole jaate hain, to unmein us har shakhs ki maghfirat ki jaati hai jo Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek nahi karta, siwaye un donon ke jo aapas mein rooth kar rahe hon, kaha jaata hai: 'In dono ko roko yahan tak ke wo sulh kar len.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kuch riwayaton mein hai: "In dono ko chhod do yahan tak ke wo sulh kar len." Unhon ne kaha: Aur unke qaul "Muhtajireen" ka matlab hai: jo aapas mein rishta tod chuke hon. Aur ye isi jaisi hai jo Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke liye jaayez nahi ke wo apne bhai se teen din se zyada rooth kar rahe."

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"Some persons from the Ansar asked for (something) from the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) and he gave them. They again asked him for (something), and he gave them. Then he said: 'whatever of good that I have, I would never hoard it from any of you. (Remember) whoever abstains from asking others, Allah will make him content, and whoever tries to make due, Allah will suffice him. And whoever remains patient, Allah will make him patient. Nobody can be given a blessing better and more encompassing than patience
hi: Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai ke Ansar ke kuch log Nabi (SAW) se maangne aaye, to unhon ne unhein diya, phir unhon ne unse maanga, to unhon ne unhein diya, phir unhon ne farmaya: "Mere paas jo bhi bhalaai hoti hai, main use tumse hargiz nahi rokta, aur jo khud ko be-niyaaz samjhe, Allah use be-niyaaz kar dega, aur jo paak-daaman rehne ki koshish kare, Allah use paak-daaman rakhega, aur jo sabr karne ki koshish kare, Allah use sabr ata karega, aur kisi ko sabr se behtar aur zyada wasee koi cheez nahi di gayi." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Indeed among the worst of people to Allah, on the Day of Judgment, is the two faced person
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din logon mein sabse bura wo hai jiske do chehre hon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas aur Ammar se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Hammam bin Al-Harith said:"Aman passed by Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman and it was said to him: "This person conveys news about the people to the leaders.' So Hudaifah said: 'The Messenger of Allah said: 'The Qatat shall not enter paradise.'" (Sahih)Sufyan said: "The Qatat is the Nammam
hi: Hammam bin Al-Harith se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman ke paas se guzra, to unse kaha gaya: 'Ye aadmi hukmaraanon ko logon ki baaten pahunchaata hai.' To Hudhaifah ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Chughli-khor Jannat mein daakhil nahi hoga.'" Sufyan ne kaha: Aur "qattat," "nammam" hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Umamah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.A.W) said:"Al-Haya' and Al-'Iy are two branches of faith, and Al-Badha and Al-Bayan are two branches of Hypocrisy
hi: Abu Umamah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Haya aur kam-goi imaan ki do shaakhein hain, aur badzabaani aur zyada-goi nifaq ki do shaakhein hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abu Ghassan Muhammad bin Mutarrif ki hadith se jaante hain. Unhon ne kaha: Aur "Iy" kam bolna hai, aur "badzabaani" baaton mein fahash hai, aur "bayan" bahut bolna hai jaise wo khateeb jo khutba dete hain aur baaton mein wusa'at karte hain aur unmein logon ki taareef karte hain aisi baat mein jo Allah ko raazi nahi karti.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that two men arrived during the time of the Messenger of Allah delivering an address. The people were amazed by their speech, so the Messenger of Allah turned to us and said:"Indeed there is magic in eloquence'-or- 'Indeed some eloquence is magic
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke do aadmi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zamane mein aaye aur khutba diya, to log unki baaton par hairaan hue, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humari taraf mudke farmaya: "Bayan mein jaadu hai," ya "kuch bayan jaadu hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ammar, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Abdullah bin Ash-Shikhkhir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Charity does not diminish wealth, Allah does not increase a man in anything for his pardoning (others) but in honor, and none humbles himself for Allah but Allah raises him
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadqa maal ko kam nahi karta, aur Allah kisi aadmi ko maafi dene ki wajah se sirf izzat mein hi badhaata hai, aur koi Allah ke liye tawaadu ikhtiyar nahi karta magar Allah use buland karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdur-Rahman bin Awf, Ibn Abbas, aur Abu Kabshah Al-Anmari, jinka naam Umar bin Sa'd hai, se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Umar narrated that Prophet said:"Oppression shall be darkness on the Day of Judgment
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zulm Qayamat ke din andheriyaan hain." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr, Aishah, Abu Musa, Abu Hurairah, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith Ibn Umar ki riwayat mein hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) never criticized any food. if he liked it, he would eat it, and if not, he would leave it
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi khaane mein aib nahi nikaala, agar wo unhein pasand hota to khaate, warna chhod dete." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Hazim, Al-Ashja'i Al-Kufi hain, unka naam Salman hai, Azzah Al-Ashja'iyyah ke azaad kiye gulam.

e: Nafi' narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:“The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) ascended the Minbar and called out with a raised voice: ’O you who accepted Islam with his tongue, while faith has not reached his heart! Do not harm the Muslims, nor revile them, nor spy on them to expose their secrets. For indeed whoever tries to expose his Muslims brother’s secrets, Allah exposes his secrets wide open, even if he were in the depth of his house.’” He (Nafl’) said: ‘ One day Ibn ‘Umar looked at the House- or – the Ka’bah and said: ‘What is it that is more honored than you, and whose honor is more sacred than yours! And the believer’s honor is more sacred to Allah than yours.’”
hi: Ibn Umar se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par chadhe aur buland aawaaz se pukaara: 'Ae wo log jinhon ne apni zabaan se Islam qubool kiya lekin imaan unke dilon tak nahi pahuncha! Musalmanon ko takleef mat do, unhein taana mat maaro, aur unke aibon ke peechhe mat lago, kyunki jo koi apne Musalman bhai ke aibon ke peechhe lagta hai, Allah uske aibon ke peechhe lagta hai, aur jiske aibon ke peechhe Allah lag jaaye, wo use ruswaa kar deta hai, chahe wo apne kamre ke andar hi kyun na ho.'" Unhon ne kaha: Aur ek din Ibn Umar ne Ka'bah ki taraf dekha aur kaha: "Tum kitni azeem ho aur tumhari hurmat kitni azeem hai, lekin Momin Allah ke nazdeek tumse zyada hurmat wala hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Husain bin Waqid ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"There is no forbearance except for the one who stumbled, and there is no wisdom except for the one who has experience." (Dai'f)
hi: Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bardaasht karne wala nahi jab tak wo thokar na khaaye, aur koi hakeem nahi jab tak use tajurba na ho." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Jabir narrated that the Prophet (s.a.w) said:"Whoever is given a gift, then if he finds something let him reciprocate. If he has nothing, then let him mention some praise. For whoever has mentioned some praise, then he has expressed his gratitude. And whoever refrains (from doing so) then he has committed Kufr. And whoever pretends to be satisfied by that which he was not given, he is like the one who wears a garment of falsehood
hi: Jabir se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhon ne farmaya: "Jise koi tohfa diya jaaye aur usmein se kuch mile, to wo uska badla de, aur jise kuch na mile, to wo uski tareef kare, kyunki jo tareef kare, usne shukriya ada kiya, aur jo chhupaaye, usne na-shukri ki, aur jo aisi cheez se sajta hai jo use nahi di gayi, wo do jhoot ke kapde pehnne wale jaisa hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Is mauzu par Asma bint Abi Bakr aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Aur unke qaul "aur jo chhupaaye, usne na-shukri ki" ka matlab: usne us ne'mat ki na-shukri ki.

e: Usamah bin Zaid narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Whoever some good was done to him, and he says: 'May Allah reward you in goodness' then he has done the most that he can of praise
hi: Usamah bin Zaid se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske saath koi neki ki jaaye, aur wo karne wale se kahe: 'Jazaakallahu Khairan,' to usne tareef mein poori koshish kar li." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan, umda, ghareeb hai, hum ise Usamah bin Zaid ki hadith se sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain. Aur isi jaisi Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Maine Muhammad se ye pucha, unhein maloom nahi tha.

e: Qatadah bin An-Nu'man narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"When Allah loves a slave, He prevents him from the world, just as one of you prevents his sick from water." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Qatadah bin An-Nu'man se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi banda se mohabbat karta hai, to use duniya se bachaata hai, jaise tum mein se koi apne bimaar ko paani se bachaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Suhaib aur Umm Al-Mundhir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Aur ye hadith Mahmud bin Labid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal bhi riwayat hui hai. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi, lekin ismein Qatadah bin An-Nu'man ka zikr nahi kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Qatadah bin An-Nu'man Az-Zafari, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri ke maa ki taraf se bhai hain, aur Mahmud bin Labid ne Nabi (SAW) ko paaya aur dekha jabke wo ek chhote larke the.

e: Umm Al-Mundhir said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon me, while `Ali was with him, and we had a cluster of unripe dates hanging." She said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began eating, and `Ali ate with him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to `Ali: 'Stop, stop, for you are still recovering.' So `Ali sat and the Prophet (ﷺ) ate." She said: "I made some chard and barley for them, so the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'O `Ali eat from this, for indeed it will be more suitable for you." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Umm Al-Mundhir se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye, unke saath Ali (Alayhis Salam) the, aur humare paas latki hui kachchi khajoorein thin." Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaane lage aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) bhi unke saath khaane lage. To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se farmaya: 'Ruk jao, ruk jao, Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Kyunki tum abhi sehat-yaab ho rahe ho.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Ali (Alayhis Salam) baith gaye aur Nabi (SAW) khaate rahe." Unhon ne kaha: "To maine unke liye chukandar aur jau banaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Ali (Alayhis Salam)! Isse khaao, ye tumhare liye zyada munaasib hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Fulaih ki hadith se jaante hain. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi, lekin usmein unhon ne kaha "tumhare liye zyada faidemand hai." Ye hadith umda ghareeb hai.

e: Usamah bin Sharik said:"Some Bedouins asked: 'O Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) shall we treat (our ill)?' He said: 'Yes, O worshipers of Allah! Use remedies. For indeed Allah did not make a disease but He made a cure for it' - or - 'a remedy. Except for one disease.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah (s.a.w)! What is it?' He said: 'Old age
hi: Usamah bin Shareek se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Bedouinon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Kya hum ilaaj karayen?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Haan, Ae Allah ke bando! Ilaaj karao, kyunki Allah ne koi bimari nahi rakhi magar uska ilaaj bhi rakha hai" - ya kaha "dawa" - "siwaye ek bimari ke." Unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Wo kya hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Budhaapa." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Hurairah, Abu Khuzamah apne walid se, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Aishah narrated:"Whenever one of the wives of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) became (feverishly) ill, he would order that some broth be prepared. Then he would tell them to take some of the broth. And he would say: 'It firms the heart of the grieved, and it rids the worries from the heart of the ill just as one of you removes dirt from her face with water." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar walon mein se jab koi bukhar mein mubtala hota, to wo shorba banaane ka hukum dete, phir wo banaaya jaata, phir wo unhein hukum dete ke wo usmein se piyen, aur wo kehte the: 'Ye ghamgeen ke dil ko mazboot karta hai, aur bimaar ke dil se pareshaani door karta hai jaise tum mein se koi paani se apne chehre se gandagi door karti hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Ibn Al-Mubarak ne bhi ise Yunus se, Az-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aishah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Doosri sanad se isi mafhoom mein.

e: Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Do not force your sick to eat, for indeed Allah, Blessed and Most High, provides them food and drink."(Dai'f)
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bimaaron ko khaane ke liye majboor mat karo, kyunki Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala unhein khilaata aur pilaata hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf is tareeqe se jaante hain.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Use this black seed. For indeed it contains a cure for every disease except As-Sam" And As-Sam is death
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is kaale daane ko istemal karo, kyunki isme har bimari ka ilaaj hai, siwaye 'saam' ke." Aur "saam" maut hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Buraidah, Ibn Umar, aur Aishah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur kaala daana "shuniz" hai.

e: Anas narrated "Some people from Urainah arrived in Al-Madinah, and they were uncomfortable (with the climate). So the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) sent them some camels from charity. He told them:"Drink from their milk and Urine
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Urainah qabile ke kuch log Madina aaye, to unhein wahan ka mausam raas na aaya, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein sadqe ke oonton ke paas bheja aur farmaya: "Unka doodh aur peshaab piyo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated (from the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w)):"Whoever kills himself with (an instrument of)iron, he will come on the Day Of Judgment with his iron in his hand, to continually stab himself in his stomach with it, in the fire of Jahannam, dwelling in that state eternally. And whoever kills himself with poison, then his poison will be in his hand, to continually take it in the Fire of Jahannam, dwelling in that state eternally
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, mera khayaal hai unhon ne ise marfu' kiya, unhon ne kaha: "Jo koi apne aap ko loha se maare, wo Qayamat ke din aayega aur uska loha uske haath mein hoga, wo usse apne pet mein zakhm karta rahega, Jahannam ki aag mein hamesha ke liye. Aur jo koi apne aap ko zeher se maare, to uska zeher uske haath mein hoga, wo Jahannam ki aag mein use pita rahega, hamesha ke liye."

e: Abu Hurairah narrated (that the the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w)) said:"Whoever kills himself with (an instrument of)iron, his iron will be in his hand, to continually stab himself in his stomach with it, in the fire of Jahannam, dwelling in that state eternally. And whoever kills himself with poison, then his poison will be in his hand, to continually take it in the Fire of Jahannam, dwelling in that state eternally. And whoever throws himself from a mountain to kill himself, then he will be continually throwing himself in the Fire of Jahannam, dwelling in that state eternally." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne aap ko loha se maare, uska loha uske haath mein hoga, wo usse apne pet mein zakhm karta rahega, Jahannam ki aag mein hamesha ke liye. Aur jo koi apne aap ko zeher se maare, to uska zeher uske haath mein hoga, wo Jahannam ki aag mein use pita rahega, hamesha ke liye. Aur jo koi pahaad se gir kar apne aap ko maare, to wo Jahannam ki aag mein girta rahega, hamesha ke liye." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai, aur ye pehli hadith se zyada sahih hai. Isi tarah kai logon ne ye hadith Al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Muhammad bin Ajlan ne Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki, unhon ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne aap ko zeher se maare, use Jahannam ki aag mein azaab diya jaayega," aur usmein "hamesha ke liye" ka zikr nahi kiya. Aur isi tarah Abu Az-Zinad ne Al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai, aur ye zyada sahih hai, kyunki riwayaton mein aata hai ke ehle-tauheed ko aag mein azaab diya jaayega phir unhein usse nikaala jaayega, aur ye zikr nahi kiya gaya ke wo usmein hamesha rahenge.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) forbade from cures that are Khabith." [Abu 'Elsa said:] Meaning poison
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khabees dawa se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: yani zeher.

e: Simak narrated that he heard 'Alqamah bin Wa'il narrate from his father, that he witnessed the Prophet (s.a.w) being asked by Suwaid bin Tariq -or Tariq bin Suwaid- about Khamr, and he forbade it. So he said:"We use it as a treatment." So the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: "It is certainly not a treatment, rather, it is a disease." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Simak se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Alqamah bin Wa'il ko apne walid se riwayat karte suna ke unhon ne Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aur Suwaid bin Tariq - ya Tariq bin Suwaid - ne unse sharaab ke baare mein pucha, to unhon ne unhein isse mana kiya, to usne kaha: "Hum ise ilaaj ke liye istemal karte hain." To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ye dawa nahi, balki ye khud ek bimari hai." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Indeed the best of what you treat is As-Sa'ut, Al-Ladud, cupping and laxatives.' So when the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) was suffering his companions treated him with Al-Ladud, and when they were finished he said: 'Treat them with Al-Ladud.' So all of them except Al-Abbas were treated with Al-Ladud."(Daif)
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jinse tum ilaaj karo unmein sabse achi cheezein ye hain: naak se dawa lena, munh mein dawa daalna, pachhna lagwaana, aur julaab lena." Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimaar hue, to unke Sahaba ne unke munh mein dawa daali, jab wo faarigh hue to unhon ne farmaya: "Inhein bhi munh mein dawa dilaao." Unhon ne kaha: To Al-Abbas ke siwa sab ke munh mein dawa dilaayi gayi.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Indeed the best of what you treat is As-Sa'ut, Al-Ladud, cupping and laxatives.' And the best of what you use for Kuhl is Ithmid, for it clears the vision and grows the hair (eye-lashes)." And he said:" The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) had a Kuhl holder with which he would apply Kuhl before sleeping three in each eye
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jinse tum ilaaj karo unmein sabse achi cheezein ye hain: munh mein dawa daalna, naak se dawa lena, pachhna lagwaana, aur julaab lena, aur jis surme se tum aankhon mein surma lagao usmein sabse achi cheez ithmid hai, kyunki wo aankhon ki roshni saaf karta hai aur baal ugaata hai." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ek surmedaani thi jisse wo sote waqt teen-teen baar har aankh mein surma lagaate the. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, aur ye Abbad bin Mansoor ki hadith hai.

e: Imran bin Husain narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) prohibited cauterization. He said:"We were tested (with severe medical condition) so we were cauterized, but we did not have good results, nor was it successful for us." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne daagh lagaane se mana kiya. Unhon ne kaha: To hum aazmaaish mein pade aur humne daagh lagaaya, lekin humein kaamyaabi na mili aur na hi faida hua. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi, Imran bin Husain se, unhon ne kaha: Humein daagh lagaane se mana kiya gaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Uqbah bin Aamir, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated:"The Prophet (S.A.W) cauterized As'ad bin Zurarah for Shawkah
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne As'ad bin Zurarah ko kaante ke zakhm ki wajah se daagh lagaaya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ubayy aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Anas narrated:"The Prophet (S.A.W) would get cupped in his jugular veins and his upper back. And he would get cupped on the seventeenth (of the month), (or) the nineteenth, and (or) the twenty first
hi: Anas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni gardan ki dono nason aur apne kandhon ke beech mein pachhna lagwaate the, aur wo satrah, unnees, ya ikkis ko pachhna lagwaate the." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Abbas aur Ma'qil bin Yasar se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn Mas'ud said:"The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) narrated about the Night of Isra', saying that he did not pass an assembly of angels except that they ordered him: 'Order cupping among your Ummah
hi: Ibn Mas'ud se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Mairaaj ki raat ke baare mein bataaya ke wo Farishton ki kisi bhi jamaat ke paas se nahi guzre magar unhon ne unhein hukum diya: "Apni Ummat ko pachhna lagwaane ka hukum do." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith Ibn Mas'ud ki riwayat mein hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abbad bin Mansur narrated from 'Ikrimah who said:"Ibn 'Abbas had three boys who were cuppers. He would use the proceeds from two of them for himself and his family, and one of them would cup him and his family." He said: " Ibn 'Abbas said: 'The Prophet (S.A.W) said: 'How excellent is the slave who cups, letting the blood, relieving the back, and clearing the vision." And he said: "Indeed the best for you to cup on are the seventeenth, the nineteenth, and the twenty-first." And he said: "Indeed the best of what you treat is As-Sa'ut, Al-Ladud, cupping and laxatives." And indeed, The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) was given medicine by Al-Abbas and his companions. So the The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: "Who gave me this medicine?" All of them were silent, so he said that there shall not remain anyone in the house but he should be treated with Ladud except for his uncle Al-Abbas.'" An-Nadr said: "Al-Ladud is Al-Wajur
hi: Ikrimah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ibn Abbas ke teen naujawan gulam the jo pachhna lagate the, unmein se do unhein aur unke ghar walon ke liye kamaate the, aur ek unhein aur unke ghar walon ko pachhna lagaata tha." Unhon ne kaha: Aur Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kitna acha gulam hai pachhna lagaane wala, wo khoon nikaalta hai, peeth ko halka karta hai, aur aankhon ki roshni saaf karta hai." Aur unhon ne kaha: "Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko oopar le jaaya gaya, to wo Farishton ki kisi bhi jamaat ke paas se nahi guzre magar unhon ne kaha: 'Pachhna lagwaao.'" Aur unhon ne kaha: "Sabse achha waqt pachhna lagwaane ka satrahvan, unnisvan, aur ikkisvan din hai." Aur unhon ne kaha: "Jinse tum ilaaj karo unmein sabse achi cheezein ye hain: naak se dawa lena, munh mein dawa daalna, pachhna lagwaana, aur julaab lena." Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Al-Abbas aur unke saathiyon ne munh mein dawa dilayi, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe kisne dawa dilayi?" To sab khaamosh rahe, to unhon ne kaha: "Ghar mein koi bhi na bache jise munh mein dawa na di jaaye," siwaye unke chacha Al-Abbas ke. Abd ne kaha: An-Nadr ne kaha: "Ladud, Wajur hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Abbad bin Mansoor ki hadith se jaante hain. Is mauzu par Aishah se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Ali bin 'Ubaidullah narrated that his grandmother [Salma] - who used to serve the The Prophet (S.A.W) said:"There was no wound nor cut on the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) but he would order me to put Hinna on it." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Ali bin Ubaidullah apni dadi Salma se riwayat karte hain - jo Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat karti thin - unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko koi bhi zakhm ya chot nahi hoti thi magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe hukum dete ke main uspar mehndi lagaaun." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Faaid ki hadith se jaante hain. Doosri sanad se isi mafhoom mein.

e: Aqqar bin Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah narrated from his father who said that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"Whoever seeks treatment by cauterization, or with Ruqyah, then he has absolved himself of At-Tawakkul (reliance upon Allah)
hi: Aqqar bin Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi daagh lagwaaye ya jhaad-phoonk karwaaye, wo tawakkul se bari ho gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn Abbas, aur Imran bin Husain se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas narrated that :the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) permitted Ruqyah for the scorpion sting, the(evil) eye, and An-Namlah. Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Anas se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bichhoo ke dank, nazar, aur "namlah" se jhaad-phoonk ki rukhsat di. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye mere nazdeek Muawiyah bin Hisham ki, Sufyan se riwayat se zyada sahih hai. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Buraidah, Imran bin Husain, Jabir, Aishah, Talq bin Ali, Amr bin Hazm, aur Abu Khuzamah apne walid se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Imran bin Husain narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said:"No Ruqyah except for the (evil) eye and the scorpion sting
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jhaad-phoonk sirf nazar ya bichhoo ke dank ke liye hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Shu'bah ne bhi ye hadith Husain se, Ash-Sha'bi se, Buraidah se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"The Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) would seek refuge from the jinn and the (evil) eye of humans, until Al-Mu'awwidhatain were revealed. So when they were revealed he used them and left other than them
hi: Abu Sa'eed se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jinnaat aur insaan ki bad-nazar se panah maangte the, yahan tak ke Mu'awwidhatain naazil huin. Jab wo naazil huin, to unhon ne unhi ko apnaaya aur baaki sab chhod diya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Asma' bint 'Umaish said:" I said: 'O Messenger of Allah (S.A.W)! Some of Ja'far's children have suffered from an accelerated case of the inflammation of the eye, so should I have them treated with Ruqyah?' He said: 'Yes,for indeed if there was anything that could overcome the Decree, then the evil eye would overcome it
hi: Asma bint Umais se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Ja'far ke bachchon par nazar jaldi asar karti hai, kya main unke liye jhaad-phoonk karwaaun?" To unhon ne farmaya: "Haan, kyunki agar koi cheez taqdeer se aage badh sakti, to nazar hi badh jaati." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Imran bin Husain aur Buraidah se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) used to seek refuge for Al-Hasan and Al-Husain saying:""U'idhukuma bikalimatillahi-tammati,min kulli shaitanin wa hammatin, wa minkulli'ainin lammah (I seek refuge for the two of you in the Perfect Words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every harmful eye)." And he would say: "It is with this that Ibrahim would seek refuge for Ishhaq and Ismail [peace be upon them]." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ke liye panah maangte the aur kehte: 'Ausee bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaitanin wa hammatin, wa min kulli aynin lammah' (Main tum dono ko Allah ke mukammal kalimaat se panah dilaata hoon har Shaitan aur zeharile jaanwar se, aur har nazar-lagane wali aankh se). Aur wo kehte: 'Isi tarah Ibrahim, Ishaq aur Ismail (alaihimas-salaam) ke liye panah maangte the.'" Doosri sanad se isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Hayyah bin Habis At-Tamimi narrated:My father narrated that he heard the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) saying: "There is nothing to Al-Ham, and the eye is real
hi: Hayyah bin Habis At-Tamimi apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Ulloo mein koi asar nahi hai, aur nazar haqeeqat hai."

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said:"If there was anything that could overcome the Decree then the (evil) eye would overcome it, and when you are requested to wash (due to it) then wash
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar koi cheez taqdeer se aage badh sakti, to nazar hi badh jaati, aur jab tumhein ghusl karne ko kaha jaaye, to ghusl karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Abdullah bin Amr se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih ghareeb hai. Aur Hayyah bin Habis ki hadith ghareeb hai. Aur Shaiban ne bhi Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, Hayyah bin Habis se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Aur Ali bin Al-Mubarak aur Harb bin Shaddad usmein "Abu Hurairah se" ka zikr nahi karte.

e: Abu Sa'eed narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) dispatched us on a military expedition. We camped with some people and asked them to entertain us but they did not entertain us. Their leader was stung so they came to us saying: 'Is there anyone among you who can treat a scorpion sting with Ruqyah?' I said: 'Yes I can. But I will not do any Ruqyah until you give us some sheep.' They said: 'Then we shall give you thirty sheep.' We accepted that,and I recited Al-Hamda [Lillah] seven times. He became better and we took the sheep." He said: "We became concerned about that being permissible and said: 'Do not be hasty until we reach the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W)." He said: "When we arrived with him I mentioned what I did to him. He(S.A.W)said: 'How did you know that it was a Ruqyah? Take the sheep, and assign me a share among you
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ek dasta mein bheja, to hum ek qaum ke paas theher gaye aur unse mehmaan-nawaazi maangi, lekin unhon ne humari mehmaan-nawaazi nahi ki. Phir unke sardar ko dank laga, to wo humare paas aaye aur kaha: 'Kya tum mein koi hai jo bichhoo ke dank ke liye jhaad-phoonk karta ho?' Maine kaha: 'Haan, main hoon, lekin main tab tak jhaad-phoonk nahi karoonga jab tak tum humein bakriyaan na do.' Unhon ne kaha: 'To hum tumhein teis bakriyaan denge.' Humne qubool kiya, to maine unpar 'Alhamdulillah' saat baar padhi, to wo theek ho gaya aur humne bakriyaan le lin." Unhon ne kaha: "To humein isme kuch shak hua, humne kaha: 'Jaldi mat karo yahan tak ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaao.'" Unhon ne kaha: "Jab hum unke paas aaye, to maine unhein wo bataya jo maine kiya tha, unhon ne farmaya: 'Aur tumhein kaise maloom hua ke ye jhaad-phoonk hai? Bakriyaan le lo, aur mere liye bhi tum mein se ek hissa lagaao.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Nadrah ka naam Al-Mundhir bin Malik bin Qut'ah hai. Aur Ash-Shafi'i ne muallim ke liye Quran sikhaane par ujrat lene ki ijazat di aur unke liye shart lagaana bhi jaayez maana. Aur unhon ne isi hadith se dalil li. Aur Shu'bah, Abu Awanah, aur kai doosron ne Abu Bishr se ye hadith Abu Al-Mutawakkil se, Abu Sa'eed se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai.

e: Abu Sa'eed Al Khudri narrated:"Some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) came across a tribe of Bedouins that did not entertain them,nor behave hospitality with them. Their leader became ill, and they came to us saying: 'Do you have any medicine?'We said: ' Yes. But you did not entertain us nor have us as guests so we will not do anything until you give us something.' Then they gave sheep for that." He said: 'So a man from us began reciting the Opening of the Book (Surat Al-Fatihah) and he was cured. So when we came to the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) we mentioned to him, He said: 'How did you know it was Ruqyah?' And he did not mention any prohibition against it,and he said: 'Eat , and assign me a share among you from them (Sheep)
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba Arab ke ek qabile ke paas se guzre, unhon ne unki mehmaan-nawaazi nahi ki na unhein mehmaan banaya. Unka sardaar bimaar pad gaya, to wo humare paas aaye aur kaha: 'Kya tumhare paas koi dawa hai?' Humne kaha: 'Haan, lekin tumne humari mehmaan-nawaazi nahi ki na humein mehmaan banaya, isliye hum tab tak kuch nahi karenge jab tak tum humein kuch ujrat na do.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne isi par bakriyon ka ek jhund muqarrar kiya." Unhon ne kaha: "To hum mein se ek aadmi unpar Surah Al-Fatihah padhne laga, to wo theek ho gaya. Jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein ye zikr kiya, to unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhein kaise maloom hua ke ye jhaad-phoonk hai?'" Aur unhon ne isse mana nahi kiya, balki farmaya: "Khaao, aur mere liye bhi tum mein se ek hissa lagaao." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith sahih hai, aur ye Al-A'mash ki, Ja'far bin Iyas se riwayat se zyada sahih hai.

e: Abu Khizamah narrated from his father who said:"I asked the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W): 'O Messenger of Allah(S.A.W)! Do you think that the Ruqyah we use, the treatments we use, and what we seek to protect ourselves will contradict anything from Allah's Decree?' He said: 'They are from Allah's Decree
hi: Abu Khuzamah apne walid se riwayat karte hain, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se pucha: Ya Rasool Allah! Aapka kya khayaal hai us jhaad-phoonk ke baare mein jo hum karwaate hain, us dawa ke baare mein jo hum istemal karte hain, aur us bachaav ke baare mein jo hum ikhtiyar karte hain, kya ye Allah ki taqdeer mein se kuch tabdeel karta hai?" Unhon ne farmaya: "Ye bhi Allah ki taqdeer mein se hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Doosri sanad se isi jaisi.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said:"Al-'Ajwah is from Paradise and it contains a cure for poison. Truffles are a form of manna, and its liquid is a cure for the eye
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ajwa Jannat se hai, aur usmein zeher ka ilaaj hai, aur 'kamah' mann mein se hai, aur uska paani aankh ke liye shifa hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Sa'eed bin Zaid, Abu Sa'eed, aur Jabir se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith is tareeqe se hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Sa'eed bin Aamir ki, Muhammad bin Amr se riwayat se jaante hain.

e: Sa'eed bin Zaid narrated that the Prophet (S.A.W) said:"Truffles are a form of manna, and its liquid is a cure for the eye
hi: Sa'eed bin Zaid se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kamah mann mein se hai, aur uska paani aankh ke liye shifa hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that people among the Companions of the Prophet (S.A.W) would say:"Truffles are the earth's smallpox." So the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: "Truffles are a form of manna, and its liquid is a cure for the eye. Al-'Ajwah is from Paradise, and it contains a cure for poison
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein se kuch logon ne kaha: "Kamah zameen ki chechak hai." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kamah mann mein se hai, aur uska paani aankh ke liye shifa hai, aur Ajwa Jannat se hai, aur wo zeher ka ilaaj hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai.

e: Qatadah said:"It was narrated to me that Abu Hurairah said: 'I took three truffles, or five, or seven, and pressed them. Then I put their liquid in a bottle, and I used it on the eyes of a slave girl of mine so she was cured
hi: Qatadah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe bataaya gaya ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Maine teen kamah, ya paanch, ya saat liye, unhein nichoda, phir unka paani ek shishi mein daala aur usse apni ek laundi ki aankhon mein lagaaya, to wo theek ho gayi."

e: Qatadah said:"It was narrated to me that Abu Hurairah said:'Ash-Shuniz is a cure for every disease except As-Sam.' Qatadah said: "One takes twenty-one seeds daily, and puts them in a cloth, then infuses (water) and sniffs two drops in his right nostril, and one drop in the left. The second (day) two drops are sniffed in the left, and one drop in the right. The third (day) two drops in the right and one drop in the left
hi: Qatadah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Mujhe bataaya gaya ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Shuniz har bimari ka ilaaj hai siwaye 'saam' ke." Qatadah ne kaha: "Har din ikkis daane liye jaayen, ek kapde mein daale jaayen, phir unhein bhigo diya jaaye, phir har din daahni naak mein do boondein aur baayen naak mein ek boond daali jaaye. Doosre din baayen naak mein do boondein aur daahni naak mein ek boond. Teesre din daahni naak mein do boondein aur baayen naak mein ek boond."

e: Abu Masud Al-Ansari narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) prohibited the price of a dog,the earnings of a fornicator (from fornication), and the payment made to the fortune-teller
hi: Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kutte ki keemat, zaani aurat ki kamaai, aur kaahin ki ujrat se mana kiya. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Eisa Ibn 'Abdur-Raman bin Abi Laila said:"I entered upon 'Abdullah bin 'Ukaim Abu Mabad Al-Juhani to visit him, while he had Humrah. I said:'Why don't you hang something?' He said: 'Death is better than that. The Prophet (S.A.W) said: "Whoever hangs something, he is entrusted to it." Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Eisa bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Main Abdullah bin Ukaim Abu Ma'bad Al-Juhani ke paas gaya unki bimaar-pursi ke liye jabke unhein 'humrah' thi. Humne kaha: 'Kya aap kuch latka nahi lete?' Unhon ne kaha: 'Maut isse zyada qareeb hai. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jo koi kuch latkaaye, use usi ke supurd kar diya jaata hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Abdullah bin Ukaim ki hadith hum sirf Muhammad bin Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Abdullah bin Ukaim ne Nabi (SAW) se suna nahi, aur wo Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein kehte the: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein likha." Doosri sanad se isi mafhoom mein. Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Uqbah bin Aamir se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Rafi' bin Khadij narrated that the Prophet (S.A.W) said:"Fever is from the agitation of the Fire, so cool it with water
hi: Rafi bin Khadij apne dada se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bukhar aag ke josh mein se hai, to use paani se thanda karo." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Asma bint Abi Bakr, Ibn Umar, Az-Zubair ki biwi, Aishah, aur Ibn Abbas se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said:"Fever is from the heat of the Hell, so cool it with water." Another chain reports similar narration
hi: Aishah se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bukhar Jahannam ki tapish mein se hai, to use paani se thanda karo." Doosri sanad se, Fatimah bint Al-Mundhir se, Asma bint Abi Bakr se, Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Aur Asma ki hadith mein isse zyada baat hai, aur dono hadithein sahih hain.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated:"For fever, and all pains, the Prophet (S.A.W) would teach them to say: Bismillahil-Kabir; a'udhu billahil-'Azimi min sharri kulli 'irqin na'arin, wa min sharri harrin-nar. (In the name of Allah the Great, I seek refuge with Allah the Magnificent from the evil of every gushing vein, and from the evil of the heat of the Fire)
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) unhein bukhar aur har dard ke liye ye kehna sikhaate the: "Bismillahil-Kabir, A'oozu Billahil-Azeem min sharri kulli irqin na'aarin, wa min sharri harrin-naar." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Ibrahim bin Ismail bin Abi Habibah ki hadith se jaante hain. Aur Ibrahim ko hadith mein kamzor qarar diya jaata hai. Aur "irqin ya'aarin" bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: Aishah narrated from Wahb's daughter - and she is Judamah - who said:"I heard the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) saying: 'I wanted to prohibit Al-Ghilah, but the Persians and Romans did it, and they did not kill their children
hi: Aishah se, Wahb ki beti se - jo Judamah hain - riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: 'Maine "ghilah" se mana karna chaaha, lekin maine dekha ke Faaris aur Rome waale aisa karte hain aur apni aulad ko nuqsaan nahi pahunchaate.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Is mauzu par Asma bint Yazid se bhi riwayat hai. Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Malik ne bhi ise Abu Al-Aswad se, Urwah se, Aishah se, Judamah bint Wahb se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai. Malik ne kaha: "Ghilah ye hai ke aadmi apni biwi se humbistari kare jabke wo doodh pilaa rahi ho."

e: Aishah narrated from Judamah bint Wahb Al-Asadiyyah that she heard the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) saying:"I intended to prohibit Al-Ghilah until I remembered that the Persians and Romans do that, without any harm to their children
hi: Aishah se, Judamah bint Wahb Al-Asadiyyah se riwayat hai ke unhon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Maine 'ghilah' se mana karne ka pakka iraada kar liya tha, yahan tak ke mujhe yaad dilaaya gaya ke Rome aur Faaris waale aisa karte hain aur unki aulad ko koi nuqsaan nahi pahunchta." Malik ne kaha: "Ghilah ye hai ke aadmi apni biwi ko chhue jabke wo doodh pilaa rahi ho." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai.

e: Qatadah narrated from Abu 'Abdullah that Zaid bin Arqam said:"The Prophet (S.A.W) would acclaim oil and Wars for (the treatment of) pleurisy." Qatadah said: "And it is put in the mouth on the side which he is suffering
hi: Qatadah, Abu Abdullah se, Zaid bin Arqam se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) "zaat-ul-janb" ke liye zaitoon ka tel aur wars ki tareef karte the. Qatadah ne kaha: "Aur ye us taraf ke munh mein daala jaata hai jispar wo shikaayat karta hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Abu Abdullah ka naam Maimun hai, wo Basra ke ek shaikh hain.

e: Maimun Abu' Abdullah said:"I heard Zaid bin Arqam say: 'The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) ordered us to use Qust Al-Bahri and oil to treat Pleurisy
hi: Maimun Abu Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Maine Zaid bin Arqam ko kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum 'zaat-ul-janb' ka ilaaj samundar ke qust aur zaitoon ke tel se karen." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb sahih hai, hum ise sirf Maimun ki, Zaid bin Arqam se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur kai ahl-e-ilm ne Maimun se ye hadith riwayat ki hai. Aur "zaat-ul-janb" tapedik hai.

e: Uthman bin Abi Al-'As narrated:"The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) came to me while I had a pain that almost ruined me. So,the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: 'Rub it with your right hand seven times and say A`udhu bi `Izzatillah Wa Qudratihi wa Sultanihi min sharri ma ajid." ("I seek refuge in Allah's might, power, an authority, from the evil of what I suffer.)" He said: "So I did it, and Allah removed what I had, and I never ceased telling my family and others to do it
hi: Uthman bin Abi Al-As se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye jabke mujhe ek dard tha jo mujhe halaak kar raha tha, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apne dahine haath se saat baar maslo aur kaho: A'oozu bi Izzatillahi wa Qudratihi min sharri ma ajid.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To maine aisa kiya, to Allah ne mera dard door kar diya, aur main hamesha apne ghar walon aur doosron ko isi ka hukum deta raha." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Asma' bint 'Umais narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) asked her what they used as a laxative. She said:"Shubrum" He said: "It is hot and too strong." She said:"Then I used Senna as a laxative." So the Prophet (S.A.W) said: "If there was anything that would have a cure for death in it, then it would have been Senna
hi: Asma bint Umais se riwayat hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse pucha: "Tum julaab ke liye kya istemal karti ho?" Unhon ne kaha: "Shubrum." Unhon ne farmaya: "Garam, tezaab jaisa." Unhon ne kaha: "Phir maine 'sana' se julaab liya." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar kisi cheez mein maut se bachaav ka ilaaj hota, to wo 'sana' mein hota." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai. Yani julaab ki dawa.

e: Abu Sa'eed said:"A man came to the Prophet (S.A.W) and said: 'My brother is suffering from loose bowels.' He said: 'Let him drink Honey.' So he drank it. Then he came and said: O Messenger of Allah (S.A.W)! He has drunk honey, but it has only made him more worse.' So the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: ' Let him drink honey.'" He said: "So he drank it. Then he came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (S.A.W)! I gave him some more to drink, but it has only made him more worse.'" He said: "The Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said: 'Allah has told the truth,and your brother's stomach has lied. Give him honey to drink'. So he gave him some more honey to drink and he was cured
hi: Abu Sa'eed ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Mere bhai ka pet chal raha hai.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Use shahad pilaao.' To usne use pilaaya, phir wo aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine use shahad pilaaya, lekin isse to dast aur badh gaye.' To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Use shahad pilaao.' To usne use pilaaya, phir wo unke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Maine use shahad pilaaya, lekin isse to dast aur badh gaye.'" Unhon ne kaha: "To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne sach kaha, aur tumhare bhai ka pet jhoot bol raha hai, use shahad pilaao.' To usne use shahad pilaaya, to wo theek ho gaya." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Prophet (S.A.W) said:"There is no Muslim worshiper who visits one who is ill - other than at the time of death - and he says seven times: As'alullah Al-'Azeem Rabbal 'Arshil 'Azeem an yashfik ('I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne to cure you') except when he will be cured
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Musalman banda kisi bimaar ki mizaajpursi ke liye jaaye jiski maut ka waqt abhi na aaya ho, aur wo saat baar kahe: 'As'alullahal-Azeema Rabbal-Arshil-Azeemi ay-yashfiyaka,' magar use aafiyat mil jaati hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai, hum ise sirf Al-Minhaal bin Amr ki hadith se jaante hain.

e: Thawban narrated that the Prophet (S.A.W) said:"When one of you suffers from fever - and indeed fever is a piece of the Fire - let him extinguish it with water. Let him stand in a flowing river facing the direction of it and say: Allahummashfi 'abdaka wa saddik Rasulak ('In the name off Allah. O Allah! Cure your slave and testify to Your Messenger.)' Doing so after Salat As-Subh(Fajr) and before the rising of the sun. Let him submerse himself in it three times, for three days. If he is not cured in three, then five. If he is not cured in five, then seven. If he is not cured in seven, then nine. For indeed it will not remain after nine, with the permission of Allah
hi: Thawban se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko bukhar aaye - aur bukhar aag ka ek tukda hai - to use paani se bujhaaye, ek behte hue darya mein utre, paani ke bahaav ke saamne khada ho, aur kahe: 'Bismillah, Allahumma-ishfi abdaka wa saddiq Rasoolak,' Fajr ki namaz ke baad, sooraj nikalne se pehle, phir teen din tak teen baar usmein doobe. Agar teen din mein theek na ho, to paanch din, agar paanch din mein theek na ho, to saat din, agar saat din mein theek na ho, to nau din, kyunki wo Allah ki ijazat se nau din se zyada nahi jaata." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hazim said:"While I was listening, Sahl bin Sa'd was asked: 'What were the wounds of the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) treated with?' He said: 'None is alive who is more knowledgeable of it than I. 'Ali would come with water in his shield, and Fatimah would use it to wash his blood off,and a mat was burnt for him and his wounds were filled with it(its ashes)
hi: Abu Hazim se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Sahl bin Sa'd se pucha gaya jabke main sun raha tha: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zakhm ka ilaaj kis cheez se kiya gaya?' To unhon ne kaha: 'Koi baaqi nahi jo mujhse zyada isse waqif ho. Ali (Alayhis Salam) apni dhaal mein paani laate the aur Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) unse khoon dhoti thin, aur unke liye ek chataai jalaayi gayi, phir unke zakhm mein wo bhari gayi.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said:"The parable of the ill when he is cured and becomes healthy is that of hail that falls from the heavens in its purity and its color
hi: Anas bin Malik se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bimaar jab theek ho jaaye aur sehat-yaab ho, to uski misaal us olay jaisi hai jo aasman se apni safaai aur apne rang mein girta hai."

e: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that the Messenger of Allah (S.A.W) said:"When one of you visits the ill, then reassure him regarding his lifespan. Indeed that will not repel anything, but it will comfort his soul
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum bimaar ke paas jaao, to uski umar ke baare mein use tasalli do, kyunki isse kuch tabdeel nahi hota, lekin isse uska dil khush hota hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Prophet(S.A.W) visited a man who was ill, so he said:"Cheer up, for indeed Allah said: 'It is My Fire which I impose upon My sinning slave as his portion of the Fire." (Hasan) Al-Hasan said: "They would hope that the fever that occurred at night would atone for any deficiency caused by sins
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ki bimaar-pursi ki jise bukhar tha, to unhon ne farmaya: "Khushi manao, kyunki Allah farmaata hai: 'Ye meri aag hai jo main apne gunahgaar bande par musallat karta hoon taake wo uska aag ka hissa ban jaaye.'" Doosri sanad se: Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Wo log raat ke bukhar ko apne gunahon ki kami ka kaffara samajhte hue chaahte the."

e: Sahl bim Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Whoever suppresses his rage while he is able to unleash it, Allah will call him before the heads (leaders) of creation on the Day of Judgement, so that he can inform Him of which of the Hur he would like."
hi: Sahl bin Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apna gussa piye jabke wo use nikaal sakta ho, Allah use Qayamat ke din tamaam makhlooq ke saamne bulaayega yahan tak ke use ikhtiyar de ke wo jo bhi Hoor chaahe chun le." Ye hadith hasan ghareeb hai.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) said:"Whoever leaves wealth then it is for his heirs, and whoever leaves poor dependents then it (the responsibility) is for me
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi maal chhode, wo uske waarison ka hai, aur jo koi mohtaaj aulad chhode, wo meri zimmedaari hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Jabir aur Anas se bhi riwayat hai. Aur Az-Zuhri ne ise Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi (SAW) se isse zyada lambi aur mukammal riwayat ki hai. "Zaya" ka matlab hai: barbaad, jiske paas kuch na ho, to main uski parwarish aur kharch uthaata hoon.

e: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) said:"Learn the laws of inheritance and the Quran, and teach the people, for I am a mortal
hi: Abu Hurairah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran aur meeraath ke ehkaam seekho, aur logon ko sikhaao, kyunki main uth jaane wala hoon." Abu Isa ne kaha: Is hadith mein iztiraab hai. Aur Abu Usamah ne ye hadith Auf se, ek aadmi se, Sulaiman bin Jabir se, Ibn Mas'ud se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki. Doosri sanad se isi mafhoom mein. Aur Muhammad bin Al-Qasim Al-Asadi ko Ahmad bin Hanbal aur doosron ne kamzor qarar diya hai.

e: Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:"The wife of Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi came with her two daughters from Sa'd to he Messenger of Allah(S.A.W)and said; O Messenger of Allah(S.A.W)! these two are daughters of Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi who fought along with you on the day of Uhud and was martyred. Their uncle took their wealth, without leaving any wealth for them, and they will not be married unless they have wealth.' He said: 'Allah will decide on that matter.' The ayah about inheritance was revealed, so the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) sent (word) to their Uncle saying: Give the two daughters of Sa'd two thirds, and give their mother one eighth, and whatever remains, then it is for you
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ki biwi apni do betiyon ko lekar jo Sa'd se thin, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Ye Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ki do betiyaan hain, inke waalid aapke saath Uhud ke din shaheed ho gaye, aur inke chacha ne inka maal le liya, unke liye koi maal nahi chhoda, aur inka nikah bhi tab hi hoga jab inke paas maal ho.' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Allah is baare mein faisla karega.'" To meeraath ki ayat naazil hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke chacha ke paas paigham bheja aur farmaya: "Sa'd ki donon betiyon ko do-tihaai do, aur unki maa ko aathwan hissa do, aur jo baaki bache wo tumhara hai." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai, hum ise sirf Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil ki hadith se jaante hain, aur Shareek ne bhi Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil se ye riwayat ki hai.

e: Huzail bin Shurahbil said:"A man came to Abu Musa and Salman bin Rabiah and asked them about a daughter, a son's daughter, a father's sister and a mother's sister. So they said: 'For the daughter is half, for the sister of the father and the mother is what remains.' And they said to him: Go to Abdullah (bin Masud) and ask him, for surely he will concur with us.' So he went to 'Abdullah mentioning that to him and informing him what they had said. 'Abdulah said: 'If that were the case, then I would ave erred and not been among the rightly-guided (on the matter). Rather, I will judge with what the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) judged: For the daughter is half, for the son's daughter a sixth, totaling two-thirds and for the sister is what remains
hi: Huzail bin Shurahbil se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Abu Musa aur Salman bin Rabi'ah ke paas aaya aur unse ek beti, pote ki beti, aur ek sagi behn ke baare mein pucha. To unhon ne kaha: 'Beti ke liye aadha, aur sagi behn ke liye jo baaqi bache.' Aur unhon ne usse kaha: 'Abdullah ke paas jao aur unse pucho, wo bhi humari taeed karenge.'" To wo Abdullah ke paas aaya aur unhein ye zikr kiya aur unhein bataya ke unhon ne kya kaha tha. Abdullah ne kaha: "To main gumraah ho jaaunga aur hidayat paane walon mein se nahi hoonga, balki main inke baare mein waisa hi faisla karoonga jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla kiya: Beti ke liye aadha, pote ki beti ke liye chhathaa hissa jo do-tihaai poora kare, aur behn ke liye jo baaqi bache." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai. Aur Abu Qais Al-Awdi ka naam Abdur-Rahman bin Tharwan Al-Kufi hai, aur Shu'bah ne bhi Abu Qais se ye riwayat ki hai.

e: Al-Harith narrated that 'Ali said:"You recite this ayah: After payment of legacies he(or she) may have bequeathed or debts, without causing harm. And indeed the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) judged the debt before the will and that the children (sons and daughters)from the same mother and father inherit,not the sons from various mothers. The man inherits from his brother from his father, and his mother, not his brother from his father. Another chain reports a similar narration
hi: Al-Harith se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Tum ye ayat padhte ho: '(Us wasiyat ke baad jo tum karo ya qarz ke baad)', aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wasiyat se pehle qarz ka faisla diya, aur ye ke sagi maa ke bete ek doosre ke waaris hote hain, alag-alag maaon ke beton ke bagair, aadmi apne sagi maa-baap ke bhai ka waaris hota hai, apne sirf waalid ki taraf se bhai ka nahi." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi.

e: Al-Harith narrated that 'Ali said:"The Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) judged that the children (sons and daughters) from the same mother and father inherit, not the sons from various mothers
hi: Al-Harith se riwayat hai ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne faisla diya ke sagi maa ke bete ek doosre ke waaris hote hain, alag-alag maaon ke beton ke bagair." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hum sirf Abu Ishaq ki, Al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwayat se jaante hain. Aur kuch ahl-e-ilm ne Al-Harith ke baare mein baat ki hai, aur zyada tar ahl-e-ilm ke nazdeek isi hadith par amal hai.

e: Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:"The Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) came to visit me while I was ill at Banu Salamah. I said : 'O Prophet of Allah(S.A.W)! How shall I divide my wealth among my children?' But he did not say anything to me, until the following was revealed: Allah commands you regarding your children's (inheritance): to the male, a portion equal to that of two females
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri bimaar-pursi ke liye mere paas aaye jabke main Banu Salamah mein bimaar tha, to maine kaha: 'Ya Nabi Allah! Main apna maal apni aulad ke darmiyan kaise taqseem karoon?' Unhon ne mujhe koi jawab nahi diya, phir ye naazil hui: '(Allah tumhein tumhari aulad ke baare mein wasiyat karta hai: larke ke liye do larkiyon ke barabar hissa)' ayat." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Aur Shu'bah, Ibn Uyainah, aur doosron ne bhi ise Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se, Jabir se riwayat ki hai.

e: Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:"I was ill, so the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W)came to visit me and found me unconscious. He came walking while Abu Bakr and 'Umar were with him. The Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) performed Wudu, then poured the remaining water on me, so I came to my senses. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah(S.A.W)! how shall I dispose of my wealth?' - or - 'What shall I do with my wealth?' He did not reply anything to me" -and he had nine sisters- "until the Ayah about the inheritance was revealed: they ask you for a legal verdict. Say: "Allah directs (thus) about Al-Kalalah." Jabir said: "It was revealed regarding me
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: "Main bimaar hua, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) meri bimaar-pursi ke liye aaye, unhon ne mujhe behosh paaya, to wo Abu Bakr aur Umar ke saath paidal aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne wuzu kiya, phir apna bacha hua wuzu ka paani mujhpar dhaala, to mujhe hosh aa gaya. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasool Allah! Main apne maal ka kya faisla karoon?' ya 'Main apne maal ka kya karoon?' Unhon ne mujhe koi jawab nahi diya" - aur unki nau behnein thin - "yahan tak ke meeraath ki ayat naazil hui: '(Wo tumse fatwa maangte hain, keh do: Allah tumhein Kalaalah ke baare mein fatwa deta hai)' ayat." Jabir ne kaha: "Ye mere baare mein naazil hui." Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai.

e: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) said:"Give the shares of inheritance to those who are entitled to them. As for what remains, then it is for the closet male relative." Another chain reports similar narration
hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meeraath ke hisse unke haqdaaron ko do, aur jo baaqi bache wo sabse qareebi mard ke liye hai." Doosri sanad se isi jaisi. Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan hai, aur kuch logon ne ise Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se mursal riwayat ki hai.

e: Imran bin Husain narrated:"A man came to the Prophet (S.A.W) and said" 'My son died, so what do I inherit from him?' He said: 'For you is a sixth.' When he turned to leave,he called him and said: 'For you is another sixth.' So when he turned to leave , he called him saying: 'The last sixth is consumable for you
hi: Imran bin Husain se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Ek aadmi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Mera beta mar gaya, to uski meeraath mein mera kya hissa hai?' Unhon ne farmaya: 'Tumhare liye chhathaa hissa hai.' Jab wo palta, to unhon ne use bulaaya aur farmaya: 'Tumhare liye ek aur chhathaa hissa hai.' Jab wo palta, to unhon ne use bulaaya aur kaha: 'Doosra chhathaa hissa khaana hai.'" Abu Isa ne kaha: Ye hadith hasan sahih hai. Is mauzu par Ma'qil bin Yasar se bhi riwayat hai.

e: Qabisah bin Dhuw'aib said:"A grandmother - the mother of a mother, or the mother of a father - came to Abu Bakr and she said: 'a son of my son' - or, 'a son of my daughter died, and I have been informed that there is a right ( from the wealth) for me in the Book.' So Abu Bakr said: 'I do not find that there is a right for you in the Book, and I have not heard that the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) judged anything for you. I shall ask the people.' So, Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah testified that the Messenger of Allah(S.A.W) gave her (case) a sixth. He said: 'And who heard that along with you?' He said: 'Muhammad bin Maslamah.'" He said: "So he gave her a sixth. Then the other grandmother who was left behind came to 'Umar." Sufyan said: "And Ma'mar said to me in addition, from Az-Zuhri - and I do not remember it to be from Az-Zuhri, rather I remember it to be from Ma'mar - that 'Umar said: 'If the two of you are together then it is for both of you, and whichever of you is alone with it (the sixth), then it is for her
hi: Qabisah bin Dhu'aib se riwayat hai, unhon ne kaha: "Daadi - maa ki maa ya waalid ki maa - Abu Bakr ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Mere pote ya meri beti ka beta mar gaya hai, aur mujhe bataaya gaya hai ke Allah ki Kitab mein mera bhi haq hai.'" To Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Mujhe Kitab mein tumhara koi haq nahi milta, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumhare liye kuch faisla dete nahi suna, main logon se poochunga." Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne poocha, aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne gawaahi di ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhein chhathaa hissa diya tha." Unhon ne kaha: "Aur tumhare saath kisne ye suna?" Unhon ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Maslamah." Unhon ne kaha: "To unhon ne unhein chhathaa hissa diya. Phir doosri daadi jo unse mukhtalif thin, Umar ke paas aayin."
